Nɛ ke yo kua e huno nɛ e ya gba nɔ kpa a, e puɛ gba.” Yesu gbaa jokuɛwi Nɛ ni komɛ ngɔ jokuɛ tsɔwi kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ konɛ e ta a he; se kaseli ɔmɛ wo a hɛ la.
Se benɛ Yesu na a, e tsui fia, nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ ha jokuɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko tsi mɛ blɔ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he we Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ kaa jokuɛ nyafii ɔ, e be mi sɛe kulaa.” Nɛ e fua mɛ atuu, nɛ e ngɔ e ninehi ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ e gbaa mɛ.
Nyumu niatsɛ ɔ Nɛ benɛ e je kpo kɛ ma blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko sa fo kɛ ba na lɛ nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni ma pee nɛ ma na neneene wami?” Nɛ Yesu bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni he je o ngɛ mi tsɛe ke nɔ kpakpa?
Nɔ kpakpa ko be kaa ja Mawu nɔ kake.
Tse o le kita amɛ: ‘Koo gbe nɔmlɔ, ko puɛ gba, koo ju, koo ye lakpa odase, koo sisi nɔ, buu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ!’ ” Se nyumu ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, i ye enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si.” Nɛ Yesu hyɛ lɛ nɛ e tsui nu lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “E piɛ mo nɔ́ kake.
Yaa nɛ o ya jua niki tsuo nɛ o ngɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ ha ohiafohi, nɛ o ma na juetli ngɛ hiɔwe; nɛ o ba nɛ o ba nyɛɛ ye se.” Se nyumu ɔ hɛ mi tsake ngɛ munyu ɔ he, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho kɛ dɔmi, ejakaa e ngɛ nihi fuu.
Yesu hyɛ e he kɛ kpe, nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ e wa ha niatsɛmɛ kaa a maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi!” Kaseli ɔmɛ a he mi po ngɛ e munyu ɔmɛ a he.
Se Yesu tsa nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Bimɛ, tse nyɛ na bɔ nɛ e wa ha nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ a nihi a nɔ ɔ kaa a maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi!
E wɛ́ hi afukpɔngɔ kaa e maa gu abui hɛngmɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e waa haa niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ.” A he mi po saminya, nɛ a bi a he ke: “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ yi wami a ma nyɛ ma he mɔ?” Nɛ Yesu hyɛ mɛ nɛ e ke: “Nimli a blɔfami ɔ a be nyɛe maa pee, se pi ngɛ Mawu blɔfami; ejakaa Mawu blɔfami ɔ lɛɛ a nyɛɔ nihi kulaa peɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro je nya ke: “Hyɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa si nihi tsuo kulaa nɛ wa ba nyɛɛ o se.” Yesu ke: “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ ko be nɛ e si we loo nyɛmimɛ nyumuhi loo nyɛmimɛ yihi loo tsɛ loo nyɛ loo yo loo bimɛ loo zugbahi ngɛ imi kɛ sane kpakpa a he, nɛ e be wehi kɛ nyɛmimɛ nyumuhi kɛ nyɛmimɛ yihi kɛ nyɛmɛ kɛ bimɛ kɛ zugbahi kɛ yi wami hu totoe lafa nae ngɛ be nɛ ɔ mi lokoo kɛ neneene wami hulɔ ngɛ je nɛ maa ba a mi.
Se kekletsɛmɛ fuu maa pee se kpɛli, nɛ se kpɛli maa pee kekletsɛmɛ.” Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu nɔ́ nɛ ji si etɛ Jeha nɛ ɔ a ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem, nɛ Yesu nyɛɛ a hɛ mi; kaseli ɔmɛ a he nua si mɛ, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ ngɛ gbeye yee.
Nɛ e ngɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ekohu kɛ ya se nɛ e bɔni mɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ɔ demi ke: “Oʼɛ, wa yaa Yerusalem, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ wo osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a maa bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha majeli ɔmɛ; ni nɛ ɔmɛ maa ye e he fɛu, nɛ a maa la lada ngɔ pue e nɔ, nɛ a maa fia lɛ kplibi, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ; nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, e maa te si ekohu.” Yakobo kɛ Yohane nibimi ɔ Nɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ, ba Yesu ngɔ ba de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa maa suɔ nɛ o pee nɔ́ ko ha wɔ.” Nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni nyɛ suɔ kaa ma pee ha nyɛ?” a de lɛ ke: “Ha wɔ he blɔ konɛ wa ti nɔ kake nɛ hi o hiɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake hu nɛ hi o muɔ nɔ ngɛ o nyami ɔ mi.” Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ li nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bie ɔ; anɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ɛye kplu ɔ nɛ ma nu ɛ maa nu, aloo nyɛ ma nyɛ nɛ a baptisi nyɛ kɛ baptisimi nɛ a kɛ maa baptisi mi ɔ lo?” Nɛ a ke: “Wa ma nyɛ.” Se Yesu de mɛ ke: “Kplu ɔ nɛ ma nu ɔ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa nu, nɛ baptisimi nɛ a kɛ maa baptisi mi ɔ a kɛ maa baptisi nyɛ lɛɛ, se ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ye muɔ nɔ himi ɔ, pi ye nɔ nɛ i kɛ haa, se mohu nihi nɛ a dla to ha amɛ a nɔ ʼi.” Benɛ ni nyɔngma a nu ɔ, a muklii mi fu Yakobo kɛ Yohane.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ma amɛ a nɔ yeli ɔ yeɔ a nɔ kaa nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nɛ a kpɛti nimli ngua amɛ ngɛ a nɔ he wami.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ blɔ be jã; se mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa nɛ e pee nɔmlɔ ngua ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ e pee e he nyɛ sɔmɔlɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ hlaa nɛ e pee nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e pee e he ni ɔmɛ a tsɔlɔ.
Ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu bɛ́ nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ, se mohu e ba sɔmɔ konɛ e ngɔ e klaa ngɔ ha kaa kpɔmi nɔ ngɛ nihi fuu a he.” Yesu tsa Bartimeo hɛyuyuilɔ ɔ Nɛ a ba Yeriko, nɛ benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ asafo gidiglɛmɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, Bartimeo, hɛyuyuilɔ ɔ nɛ ji Timeo bi ɔ, hii si ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ tue ngɛ nɔ bae.
Nɛ benɛ e nu kaa Yesu Nazareno ɔ ʼi ɔ, e bɔni ngmlaa kpami ke: “Yesu David, bi naa mi mɔbɔ!” Nihi fuu ke e yi ke e pee kɔ.
Se e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ mohu pe kekle ɔ ke: “David bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Yesu da si, nɛ e ke: “Nye tsɛ lɛ kɛ ba!” Nɛ a tsɛ hɛyuyuilɔ ɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Na tsui, tee si, e ngɛ mo tsɛe!” Nɛ e sake e tade nɔha a ngɔ fɔ he, nɛ e te si pam, nɛ e ba Yesu ngɔ.
Yesu bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae kaa ma pee ha mo?” Nɛ hɛyuyuilɔ ɔ de lɛ ke: “Rabuni, (Nyɔmtsɛ) i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma hyɛ nɔ ekohu.” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Yaa, o hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo!” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e hyɛ nɔ ekohu, nɛ e nyɛɛ Yesu se ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi Benɛ a ngɛ Yerusalem sue nɛ a su Betfage kɛ Betania ngɛ Nuyoku ɔ he ɔ, Yesu tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ya kɔpe nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi haa nɛ ɔ mi.
Nyɛ lejɛ ɔ sumi pɛ, nyɛ maa na teji bi nɛ a muɔ lɛ si nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hi e nɔ hyɛ; nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ kɛ ba.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ ke: ‘Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee’ ɔ, nyɛ de lɛ ke: ‘E he ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hiae, se e be kɛe nɛ a maa kpale lɛ kɛ ba ekohu.’ ” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya nɛ a ya na teji bi ɔ nɛ a muɔ lɛ si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya ngɛ blohu ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ a ngɛ lɛ pɛnee ɔ, nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a ti ni komɛ bi mɛ ke: ‘Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ teji bi ɔ pɛnee ya pee?’ Nɛ a de mɛ bɔ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ɔ, nɛ a ngmɛ mɛ blɔ.
A kɛ teji bi ɔ ba Yesu ngɔ; nɛ a kɛ a tadehi pue e nɔ, nɛ e kuɔ hi e nɔ.
Nihi fuu kɛ a tadehi ha blɔ ɔ nɔ; nɛ ni komɛ hu po tso kɔnihi kɛ je pu ɔ mi nɛ a kɛ pue blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ wɔ lele ke: “Hosiana!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ!
A gbaa wa tsɛ David matsɛ yemi nɛ ma a!
Hosiana ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!” Nɛ Yesu sɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e ya sɔlemi we ɔ; nɛ e hyɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ benɛ je bɔni jɔmi ɔ, e si lejɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ho Betania ya.
Yesu gbiɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ E nɔ je na a, benɛ a je Betania kɛ ma a, hwɔ ye Yesu.
Nɛ e na ngmɔkɔ tso ko ngɛ lokoo nɛ ba ngɛ yi, nɛ e ho ya hyɛ kaa alinɔ e maa na nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ lo.
Se benɛ e su he ɔ, e nɛ nɔ́ ko kaa ja ba sɔuu, ejakaa ngmɔkɔ womi be sui lolo.
Yesu wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ ke: “Nɔ ko be o nɔ yiblii yee gblee kɛ maa ya neneene!” Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ nu.
Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ Benɛ a su Yerusalem ɔ, Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ e bɔni nihi nɛ ngɛ ni juae kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ni hee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ hemi.
E sake sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a kplɔɔɔ ɔmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lahuɛhi juae ɔmɛ a sɛ̃ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si.
Nɛ e ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ tloo nɔ́ ko kɛ gu sɔlemi we ɔ. Nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ ni ke: “A ngma ke: ‘A ma tsɛ ye we ɔ jejemawɛli kulaa a sɔlemi we.’ Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ pee ojofiali a kplo.” Nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ nu, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ a hla bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a kpata e hɛ mi; se a ngɛ lɛ gbeye yee, ejakaa asafo ɔ kulaa nya kpɛ a he ngɛ e ni tsɔɔmi ɔ he.
Ke su gbɔkuɛ ɔ, e jee ma a mi.
Ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he nikasemi Nɛ mɔtu mla, benɛ a bee ɔ, a na kaa ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ ngla kɛ e sipoku tsuo.
Petro kai nɛ e de Yesu ke: “Rabi, hyɛ, ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ nɛ o gbiɛ ɔ ngla!
Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ he Mawu ye!
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ nɛ ma de yoku nɛ ɔ ke: ‘Hia nɛ o ya nɔ wo mi!’ nɛ e ji nɔ ngɛ e tsui mi, se mohu e heɔ yeɔ kaa nɔ nɛ e de ɔ a maa pee ɔ, e maa ba mi ha lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nihi abɔ kulaa nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ sɔlemi mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye kaa nyɛ ma na nɛ a kɛ ma ha nyɛ.
Nɛ be saa be nɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, ke nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ko he sane ko ɔ, nyɛ kɛ ke lɛ, konɛ nyɛ hiɔwe tsɛ ɔ hu kɛ nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ nɛ ke nyɛ.
[ Se ke nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ki ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hu kɛ nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ be nyɛ kee.”] He blɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ Nɛ a kpale ba Yerusalem ekohu.
Nɛ benɛ Yesu ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni he blɔ o ngɛ nɛ o kɛ peɔ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ, aloo mɛnɔ ha mo he blɔ nɛ o kɛ pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Imi hu ma bi nyɛ nɔ kake nɛ nyɛ ha mi heto, konɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ he blɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ i kɛ peɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ.
Yohane baptisimi ɔ, hiɔwe e je aloo nimli a dɛ mi e je?
Nyɛ ha mi heto!” Nɛ mɛ sɔuu a sa nya ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “Kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Ke wa de ke e je hiɔwe ɔ, e ma bi wɔ ke: ‘Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ he we lɛ yi mɔ?’ Nɛ ke wa ke e je nimli a dɛ mi ɔ,” (a ngɛ ma a gbeye yee ejakaa nihi tsuo buu Yohane gbalɔ niinɛ.)
A he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Wa li.” Nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Lɛɛ imi hu i be nyɛ tsɔɔe nɔ he blɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ i kɛ peɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ mɔ.’
Wai ngmɔ ɔ mi apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he abɛ ɔ Nɛ Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu ngɛ abɛhi a mi ke: “Nyumu ko pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ e po piɛ wo he; e tsua wai tɛ muɔ, nɛ e ma mɔ ngɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ ha huli apaa yemi, nɛ e doma.
Benɛ e su wai yiblii lami be ɔ, e tsɔ tsɔlɔ ko kɛ ya apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ, konɛ a ya ngɔ e blɔfami nɔ ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ba.
Se a nu tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ a fia lɛ kpa, nɛ a wo lɛ blɔ kɛ e dɛ gu.
E kpale tsɔ tsɔlɔ kpa ko hu kɛ ya a ngɔ; nɛ a ywia e yi nɛ a pue e hɛ mi si.
Jeha nɛ ɔ hu e tsɔ nɔ kpa ko ekohu nɛ lɛɛ a gbe lɛ; kɛ ni kpa komɛ hulɔ; a fia ni komɛ kpa, nɛ a gbe ni komɛ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ e ngɛ nɔ kake nɛ piɛ, e binyumu nɛ e suɔ.
Nyagbe ɔ, e tsɔ lɛ a ngɔ nɛ e ke: ‘A ma gbo ye bi ɔ zo.’ Se kikɛmɛ a paatsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ de a he ke: Ni yelɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ha waa gbe lɛ, nɛ gbo si ni ɔmɛ maa pee wa nɔ.
Nɛ a nu lɛ nɛ a gbe lɛ, nɛ a wo lɛ kɛ je wai ngmɔ ɔ mi sake fɔ he.
“Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, mɛni wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ maa pee?
E maa ba kpata apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ ma ha ni kpa komɛ.
Anɛ nyɛ kane we kikɛmɛ a ngmami nɛ ɔ: ‘Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ kua a, Kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ plɛ kɔ nya tɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi enɛ ɔ je, Nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ ngɛ wa hɛngmɛ mi?’ ” Yudafo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a nu, ejakaa a le kaa a he nɛ e bu kikɛmɛ a abɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ, se a ngɛ asafo ɔ gbeye yee.
Nɛ a si lɛ nɛ a je.
Oniatsumi he sanebimi Nɛ a tsɔ Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ Herodebi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ konɛ a ba da lɛ ngɛ munyu tutui mi.
Nɛ benɛ a ba a, a ba de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa anɔkualetsɛ ji mo, nɛ o yi nɔ hɛ mi munyu tumi gbeye, ejakaa o hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi, mohu o tsɔɔ Mawu blɔ ɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi.
Anɛ e da blɔ kaa a tsuɔ onia haa Kaisare aloo e dɛ?
Wa ha aloo wa ko ha?” Se nɛ e na a osato peemi ɔ, e de mɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi kae?
Nyɛɛ kɛ sika ko nɛ ba nɛ ma hyɛ.” Nɛ a kɛ ba.
Nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ foni ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛnɔ biɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ɔ?” A de lɛ ke: “Kaisare nɔ ʼi.” Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ kɛ Kaisare nihi nɛ ha Kaisare, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nihi nɛ ha Mawu.” Nɛ e he pee mɛ nyakpɛ kɛ be nɔ.
Ni gbogboehi a sitemi he sanebimi Nɛ Sadukifohi nɛ deɔ ke ni gboggboehi a si temi ko be hu ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose ngma ha wɔ ke: ‘Ke nɔ ko nyɛmi gbo nɛ e si e yo nɛ e si we bi ɔ́, e nyɛmi ɔ nɛ ngɔ e yo ɔ nɛ e fɔ bimɛ ngɔ ha e nyɛmi ɔ.’ Jeha nɛ ɔ, nyɛmimɛ kpaago hi si, nɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ yo, nɛ e gbo nɛ e si we bi.
Nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ hu ngɔ yo ɔ, nɛ e gbo, nɛ lɛ hu e si we bi ko ngɛ e se; nɛ nɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ hu ja nɔuu kɛ.
Ni kpaago ɔ tsuo kɛ yo ɔ hi si, nɛ a si we bimɛ ngɛ a se.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a se ɔ, yo ɔ hu ba gbo.
Lɔ ɔ ni gbogboehi a sitemi ɔ mi, benɛ a maa te si ɔ, a ti mɛnɔ yo e maa pee, ejakaa ni kpaago ɔ tsuo kɛ lɛ hi si?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Anɛ pi ngmami ɔ kɛ Mawu he wami nɛ nyɛ li ɔ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tɔe nɛ ɔ lo?
Ejakaa benɛ a maa te si kɛ maa je gbeje ɔ, a be yo ngɔe nɛ pohu a be gbae; se mohu a ma plɛ kaa hiɔwe bɔfohi.
Se kaa ni gbogboehi maa te si ekohu ɔ, anɛ nyɛ kane we ngɛ Mose womi ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ Mawu de lɛ ngɛ mio tso ɔ he sane ɔ mi ke: ‘Imi lɛɛ, Abraham Mawu kɛ Isak Mawu kɛ Yakob Mawu ji mi’ ɔ?
Enɛ tsɔɔ kaa, Mawu ɔ pi ni gbogboehi a Mawu ji lɛ, se hɛkali a Mawu ji lɛ.
Nyɛ ngɛ tɔe babauu.” Kita ngua a Nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ nu kaa a ngɛ lɛ sanehi, bie ɔ hu ba, nɛ benɛ e na kaa Yesu ha mɛ heto saminya a e bi lɛ ke: “Te nɔ nɛ ji kita amɛ kulaa a ti kekleekle nɔ́ hu?” Yesu he lɛ nɔ ke: “Kekleekle nɔ ji: ‘Bu tue, Israel, Nyɔmtsɛ wa Mawu ɔ, lɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ kake, nɛ suɔ Nyɔmtsɛ o Mawu ɔ kɛ o tsui tsuo kɛ o klaa tsuo kɛ o juɛmi tsuo!’ Kita nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ji: Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa mo nitsɛ o he.’ Kita ko be nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ.” Mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ de lɛ ke: “Saminya, tsɔɔlɔ; o tu anɔkuale kaa Mawu kake pɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ nɔ kpa ko be, ja lɛ kɛkɛ ɔ; kaa o maa suɔ Mawu kɛ o tsui tsuo kɛ o juɛmi tsuo kɛ o klaa tsuo kɛ o he wami tsuo kɛ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa mo nitsɛ o he ɔ, e pe sami bɔhi kɛ bɔhi tsuo kulaa.” Nɛ benɛ Yesu na kaa e ha lɛ heto ngɛ ni lemi nya a, e de lɛ ke: “O kɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ kpɛti kɛ we.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ ko kɛ́ lɛ sane ko bimi hu.
Mesia a he sanebimi Nɛ benɛ Yesu ngɛ ni tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e bi ke: “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ deɔ ke Kristo ɔ David bi ji lɛ ɔ?
Ejakaa David nitsɛ de ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nya ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Hii ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ, Kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o henyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ pee o nane si sɛ.’ Ke David nitsɛ tsɛɛ lɛ Nyɔmitsɛ ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ e ji e bi mɔ?” Nɛ nihi fuu bu lɛ tue kɛ bua jɔmi.
Yesu bɔ kɔkɔ ngɛ mlaatsɔɔli ɔmɛ a he Nɛ Yesu de mɛ ngɛ e ni tsɔɔmi ɔ mi ke: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi ngɛ mlaa tsɔɔli nɛ suɔ tade wuyawuya womi kɛ si slami kɛ jua nɔ ngami ɔmɛ a he.
Ninɛmɛ nɛ suɔ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi hehi ngɛ kpe he, kɛ okplɔɔ yi himi ngɛ niyeni si, nɛ mii yalɔyi a wehi, nɛ he tsɔɔmi he ɔ a sɔlee sɔlemi gagaagahi.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a fɔbu maa pe nine.” Yalɔyo ɔ onia a Nɛ Yesu ya hi sikato he ɔ hanɔ, nɛ e ngɛ hyɛe bɔ nɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ sika ngɛ daka a mi woe ɔ. Nɛ niatsɛmɛ babauu kɛ fuu ba wo mi.
Nɛ yalɔyo ko hu ba nɛ e kɛ kaplɛ enyɔ nɛ sui pɛsɛwa ba wo mi.
Nɛ Yesu tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ e de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: “Kikɛmɛ a yalɔyo ohiafo nɛ ɔ kɛ fuu ba wo mi pe ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kɛ eko ba wo daka a mi ɔ. Ejakaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a na nɛ be nɔ ɔ eko a kɛ ba wo mi; se nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ e hia mi nɛ e kɛ ngɛ e he lɛɛ ɔ tsuo e kɛ ba wo mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Sɔlemi we ɔ puemi he gbami Benɛ Yesu ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ a t inɔ kake de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, hyɛ tɛ komɛ a klemi kake kɛ tsuhi nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ!” Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “O ngɛ kikɛmɛ a tsu kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔmɛ hyɛe?
A be tɛ kake sie ngɛ eko nɔ nɛ a be tsitsɛɛe ngɔ fia si.” Nɔnami kɛ yiwamihi Nɛ bene e hii si ngɛ Nuyoku ɔ nɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ hanɔ ɔ, Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ Andrea bi lɛ ngɛ se ke: “Tsɔɔ wɔ be mi nɛ a maa pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ke ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi ɔ, mɛni ji a he okadi?” Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e bɔni mɛ demi ke: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya konɛ nɔ ko ko mlɔɔ nyɛ.
Nihi fuu maa ba ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ a ma de ke: ‘Ami ji lɛ!’ nɛ a maa mlɔɔ nihi fuu.
Se ke nyɛ nu tahi kɛ ta sanehi a he ɔ, nyɛ ko hao, ejakaa ja a ba mi, se nyagbe ɔ sui lolo.
Ma maa te si ngɔ wo ma, nɛ matsɛ yemi maa te si ngɔ wo matsɛ yemi, nɛ zugba mimiɛmi maa ba ngɛ hehi slɔɔtohi, nɛ hwɔ maa ba.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ji kɔɔmi ɔmɛ a sisi jemi.
“Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ le nyɛ he nɔ hyemi, ejakaa a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ maa ya guahi a nɔ, nɛ a maa fia nyɛ kpa ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ maa da ganɔhi kɛ matsɛmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ ye he, konɛ nyɛɛ ye odase ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Nɛ ja a fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ jejemawɛ tsuo lolo.
Se ke a kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya ha a, nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɔ to ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma de he; se mohu nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma ha nyɛ ngɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ de ɔ nɛ; ejakaa tsa pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, se mohu mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ʼi.
Se nyɛmi maa ngɔ nyɛmi ngɔ ha gbenɔ, nɛ tsɛ hu kɛ bi ma ha; nɛ bimɛ maa te si ngɔ si a fɔli, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ma ha nɛ a gbe mɛ.
Nɛ nihi tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he; se nɔ nɛ hɛɛ mi kɛ gbee nya a, a ma he e yi wami.” Hehiami ngua a “Se ke nyɛ na ma doku ninye ni ɔ kaa e maa si ngɛ he nɛ e sɛ kaa e maa a, (nɔ nɛ ngɛ kanee ɔ, e kɔ se,) lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yudea a, a tu fo kɛ ya yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu yi mi ɔ, e ko kple si, aloo nɛ e sɛ we mi ya ngɔ nɔ́ ko; nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ si ɔ, e ko kpale e se ba ngɔ e tade.
Se musu tloo yihi nɛ hɛɛ muklii kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɔ hae ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi.
Se nyɛɛ sɔle konɛ nyɛ fotumi ɔ nɛ ko ba ngɛ fiɛ be mi.
Se jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, he hiami nɛ a nɛ́ e nɔ eko hyɛ kɛ je je nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ sisije hluu kɛ ba su mwɔnɔmwɔnɔ maa ba, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a be e nɔ nae hu.
Nɛ ja Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ po ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, ke pi jã a, lɛɛ a be he lo ko he lo ko yiwami hee; se nihi nɛ e hla amɛ a he ɔ, e po ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
“Nɛ lɛ be ɔ mi ɔ, ke nɔ ko de nyɛ ke: ‘Hyɛ, Kristo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!’ aloo ‘Hyɛ, e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!’ ɔ, nyɛ ko he ye.
Ejakaa lakpa kristohi kɛ lakpa gbali maa te si nɛ a maa pee okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi, konɛ, ke e maa hi ɔ, a mlɔɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ a hla a tete.
Se Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya; i de nyɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ to.” Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ bami “Se jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ngɛ he hiami nɛ ɔ se ɔ, pu maa tsɔ diblii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ hu be kpee.
Nɛ dodoehi ma tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ba fia si, nɛ a ma mimiɛ he wamihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kaa e ma ngɛ bɔkuhi a mi kɛ he wami ngua kɛ nyami.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa tsɔ e bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a ma bua nihi nɛ e hla amɛ a nya kɛ maa je kɔɔhiɔ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ je zugba nyagbe he kɛ ya si hiɔwe nyagbe he.” Ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he nikasemi “Nyɛɛ kase ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he abɛ ɔ. Ke e su be nɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ tsɛ̃ nɛ e bɔ ba a, nyɛ le kaa latsa be ɔ su ta.
Ja nɔuu nyɛ hu ke nyɛ na kaa kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba mi ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa be ɔ su agbohi a nya ta.
Anɔkuale mi i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, loko yi nɔ nɛ ɔ maa be ɔ, ja ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi lolo.
Hiɔwe kɛ zugba maa be kɛ ho, se ye munyu ɔmɛ be bee kɛ ho.” Nɔ ko li ligbi ɔ lo ngmlɛfia a Se jamɛ a ligbi ɔ loo ngmlɛfia a, nɔ ko li; hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ li, nɛ Bi ɔ hu li, ja Tsɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, nyɛɛ fɔ nyɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, ejakaa nyɛ li be mi nɛ be ɔ maa su.
E ngɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ hia blɔ, nɛ e si e we, nɛ e ha e webi ɔmɛ he blɔ kɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ni tsumi, nɛ e fã agbo nya hyɛlɔ ɔ ke e bu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ huɔ, ejakaa nyɛ li be mi nɛ wetsɛ ɔ ma, eko ɔ gbɔkuɛ, nyɔ mi kpɛti, loo kungwɔ nɔ kpami be, loo mɔtu; konɛ e ko ba tlukaa nɛ e ba na nyɛ kaa nyɛ ngɛ mahɛ hwɔe.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee nɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo i ngɛ dee: Nyɛɛ huɔ!”
A so Yesu yi nɔ Benɛ e piɛ ligbi enyɔ nɛ a maa ye Hetsɔmi kɛ Akpiti ligbi ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ hla bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a nu Yesu ga mi nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Se a ke: “Pi ngɛ nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ, konɛ basabasa peemi nɛ ko ba ma a mi.” A pɔ Yesu nu ngɛ Betania Benɛ Yesu ngɛ Betania ngɛ Simon, tsitsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi nɛ e hii si ngɛ niye ni he ɔ, yo ko nɛ hɛɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ e mi nardo nu ngmingmiingmi nɛ he jua wa nitse ɔ ba; nɛ e ywia alabastro tɔ ɔ, nɛ e plɛ nu ɔ ngɔ pue Yesu yi mi.
Se ni komɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mi mi la de a he ke: “Mɛni he je nɛ e puɛ nu ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Ejakaa jinɛ kikɛmɛ a nu nɛ ɔ ɔ, a ma nyɛ maa jua pe cedi lafa etɛ na a kɛ ha ohiafohi!” Nɛ a muklii mi fu lɛ.
Se Yesu ke: “Nyɛɛ jɔɔ lɛ yɔyɔɔmi!
Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ngɛ lɛ haoe ɔ?
E tsu ni saminyayooyo ha mi.
Ejakaa ohiafo ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ daa, nɛ be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ suɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ mɛ kpakpa maa pee; se imi lɛɛ pi daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ e ma nyɛ; e sɛ hlami ba pɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nu ngɔ to ye pumi.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: He tsuaa he nɛ a maa fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a ngɛ, ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a maa sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ yo nɛ ɔ pee nɛ ɔ hu kɛ ma kai lɛ.” Yuda kplɛɛnɔ kaa e maa tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda Iskariot, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ɔ, pue nɔ kɛ ho osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ ya konɛ e ya tsɔɔ mɛ Yesu se blɔ.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ a nu ɔ, a nya, nɛ a wo lɛ si ke a ma ha lɛ sika.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hla bɔ nɛ e maa pee nɛ e ha a nine nɛ su e nɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ye Hetsɔmi niyeni ɔ Akpiti nyami ligbi ɔmɛ a mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, benɛ a ngɛ Hetsɔmi to bi ɔ gbee ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke: “Jije o suɔ kaa wa ya dla ni ngɔ to ha mo nɛ o ya ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ?” Nɛ e tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ya ma a mi, nɛ nyumu ko nɛ tloo nyu kɛ buɛ kɛ nyɛ maa kpe; nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se; nɛ he nɛ e ma ya sɛ ɔ, nyɛ de lejɛ ɔ wetsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ke: Jije nibwɔhi a to he tsu ɔ nɛ i kɛ ye kaseli ɔmɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ ngɛ?’ Nɛ e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ hiɔwe asa ngua ko nɛ a wo mi ni nɛ a dla mi; nyɛ dla ni ngɔ to wɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho ma a mi ya nɛ a ya na bɔ nɛ e de mɛ ɔ, nɛ a dla Hetsɔmi niye ni ɔ ngɔ to.
Nɛ benɛ e su gbɔkuɛ ɔ, e kɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
Benɛ a hii si nɛ a ngɛ ni yee ɔ, Yesu ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ — nɔ ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ ni yee.” Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hao, nɛ a bi lɛ kakaaka ke: “Imi lo?” Se e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake ʼi, nɔ nɛ nine nɛ kɛ ye nine ngɛ kpee ngɛ ka a mi ɔ. Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ e he ɔ mohu; se musu tloo nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ se blɔ ɔ!
Afani nɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Niyeni ɔ sisitomi Nɛ benɛ a ngɛ ni yee ɔ, Yesu ngɔ abolo nɛ e jɔɔ nɔ, nɛ e kuɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ ha mɛ nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ hee.
Enɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso.” Nɛ e wo kplu ɔ hu nɛ e na si, nɛ e kɛ ha mɛ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu eko.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Enɛ ɔ ji ye muɔ nɛ ji somi ɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ puɛ si ngɛ nihi fuu a he ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, i be wai nɛ ɔ eko nue hu kɛ yaa su ligbi nɛ ma nu wai he ɔ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.” Nɛ benɛ a la yijemi la ko ɔ, a je kpo kɛ ho Nuoku ɔ nɔ ya.
Yesu gba Petro kuami ngɔ to Nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nane ma kpata ejakaa a ngma ke: ‘Ma fia to hyɛlɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ to ɔmɛ maa gbe fia.’ Se ke a tle mi si se ɔ, ma sɛ nyɛ hlami kɛ maa ya Galilea.” Se Petro de lɛ ke: “Ke ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa je o he ɔ, imi lɛɛ i be o he jee.” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke: “Mwɔnɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, kungwɔ be nɔ kpae si enyɔ nɛ o ma kpa ngɛ ye se si etɛ.” Se Petro tu munyu kɛ kã pe kekle ɔ ke: “Ke i kɛ mo ma gbo tete ɔ, i be kpae ngɛ o se!” Nɛ mɛ tsuo a de ja nɔuu.
Yesu ya sɔle ngɛ Getsemane Nɛ a ba he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ Getsemane, nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ konɛ ma ya sɔle lolo.” Nɛ e ngɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ gbeye nu lɛ nɛ e hao babauu; nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ye klaa ngɛ haoe wawɛɛ kɛ yaa gbenɔ mi po; nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ niɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ fɔ nyɔ!” Nɛ e ya e hɛ mi bɔɔ, nɛ e bu si, nɛ e sɔle, konɛ, ke e maa hi ɔ, ngmlɛfia nɛ ɔ nɛ be e he; nɛ e ke: “Abba, Tsaatsɛ!
O nyɛɔ nihi tsuo peɔ; je kplu nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye nɔ; se kɛ̃ ɔ pi bɔ nɛ i suɔ, se bɔ nɛ o suɔ.” Nɛ e ba ba na mɛ kaa a ngɛ mahɛ hwɔe, nɛ e de Petro ke: “Simon, o ngɛ mahɛ hwɔe?
O nyɛ we nyɔ nɛ o fɔ ngmlɛfia kake lo?
Nyɛɛ fɔ nyɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ nyɛ ko sɛ ka mi.
Mumi ɔ ngɛ kplɛɛe mohu se he lo ɔ he wɛ́.” Nɛ e kpale ho ekohu nɛ e ya sɔle, nɛ e tu jamɛ a munyu ɔ nɔuu.
Nɛ benɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, e ba na kaa a hwɔ mahɛ, ejakaa nyɔ gbe mɛ, nɛ a li nɔ heto nɛ a ngɛ lɛ hae.
Nɛ e ba nɔ́ nɛ ji si etɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mahɛ hwɔe kɛ mwɔɔ nɛ ɔ?
E hiɛ!
Ngmlɛfia a su, oʼɛ, a ngɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔe kɛ ngɛ yayami peeli a dɛ mi woe.
Nyɛɛ te si nɛ nyɛ ha waa ho, oʼɛ, ye se blɔ tsɔɔlɔ ɔ su si ta!” Yesu seblɔtsɔɔmi kɛ e numi Benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Yuda, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ɔ ba kɛ nihi fuu nɛ je osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ klaatehi kɛ tsohi.
Se se blɔ tsɔɔlɔ ɔ to mɛ okadi ko ke: “Nɔ nɛ nya he nɛ ma fiɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ nu lɛ nɛ nyɛ kpaka lɛ kɛ ho sɔkee.” Nɛ benɛ Yuda su si nɔuu pɛ nɛ e ba Yesu ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Rabi!” nɛ e fiɔ e nya he.
Nɛ a ba pue Yesu nɔ nɛ a nu lɛ.
Se nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake hia klaate, nɛ e kɛ fia osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e po e tue.
Nɛ Yesu wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Imi numi nyɛ ba kɛ klaatehi kɛ tsohi kaa a nuu ojo fialɔ nɛ ɔ?
Daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ nihi a ni ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ nui mi; se benɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔmɛ nɛ na ba mi he je.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo si lɛ.
Se niheyo ko nɛ sa kploba ngɛ e mlɛ mi ɔ nyɛɛ e se, nɛ a ka lɛ numi; se e si kploba a nɛ e tu fo kɛ e he gu.
Yesu ngɛ gua ngua a hɛ mi Nɛ a kpaka Yesu kɛ ho osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ ya, nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nya ba kpe si ngɛ e ngɔ.
Nɛ Petro nyɛɛ e se ngɛ tsitsaa kɛ ya sɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a mɔ ɔ kpo ɔ kpɛti, nɛ e kɛ we mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ya hii si nɛ e ngɛ la hlue.
Nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ gua mluku ɔ tsuo hla Yesu he sane ko konɛ a da nɔ kɛ gbe lɛ; se a nɛ́ eko.
Nihi fuu ye lakpa odase kɛ si lɛ, se a odase ɔmɛ sɔɛ.
Nɛ ni komɛ te si nɛ a ye lakpa odase kɛ si Yesu ke: “Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu nɛ e de ke: ‘Imi lɛɛ ma ku sɔlemi tsu nɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ nine pee ɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛ mi ɔ ma ma ekpã nɛ pi nine nɛ a kɛ pee.’ ” Se lɔ ɔ tete po hu ɔ, a odase ɔmɛ sɔɛ.
Nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a te si dasi ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e bi Yesu ke: “O be heto hae lo?
Mɛni odase ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ yee kɛ ngɛ mo sie nɛ ɔ?” Se e kpɛ we e kuɔ si nɛ e ha we heto.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a kpale bi lɛ ekohu ke: “Mo ji Kristo, nɔ nɛ a gbaa a bi ɔ lo?” Nɛ Yesu ke: “Imi, nɛ nyɛ maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kaa e hii si ngɛ Ope ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ e ma ngɛ hiɔwe bɔku ɔmɛ a mi.” Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a hia e tade ɔ nɛ e ke: “Mɛni odasefohi wa kpale ngɛ hlae ekohu?
Nyɛ nu e musu bɔmi ɔ; kɛ nyɛ susu kɛɛ?” Nɛ mɛ tsuo a bu lɛ fɔ ke e sa gbenɔ.
Nɛ ni komɛ bɔni lada lami kɛ e nɔ puemi; nɛ a fi e hɛ mi nɛ a hɛɛ lɛ ni, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Gbaa!” Nɛ we mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ pue e nɔ kɛ lɛ ma gbami.
Petro kua Yesu Benɛ Petro ngɛ sisi ɔ ngɛ mɔ ɔ kpɛti ɔ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma weyi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ba; nɛ benɛ e na Petro nɛ e ngɛ la hlue ɔ, e hyɛ lɛ nɛ e ke: “Tse mo hu o kɛ Yesu Nazareno ɔ lɛ ngɛ?” Se e kua nɛ e ke: “I li nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, nɛ i nui sisi tete.” Nɛ e je kpo kɛ ho kue ɔ si ya, kɛkɛ nɛ kungwɔ kpã nɔ.
Nɛ yiheyo ɔ na lɛ ekohu, nɛ e kpale bɔni ninɛmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ demi kɛ: “A ti nɔ kake ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Se Petro kua ekohu.
Nɛ pee se bɔɔ ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ de Petro ekohu ke: “Anɔkuale mi ɔ, a ti nɔ kake ji mo, ejakaa Galileano ji mo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro bɔni gbiɛmi kɛ kita kami ke: I li nɔmlɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ e he munyu tue nɛ ɔ.” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ kungwɔ kpa nɔ nɛ ji si enyɔ; nɛ Petro kai munyu nɛ Yesu de lɛ ɔ ke: “Kungwɔ be nɔ kpae si enyɔ nɛ o ma kpa ngɛ ye se si etɛ” ɔ. Nɛ benɛ e kai ɔ e wo ya.
Yesu ngɛ Pilato hɛ mi Mɔtu mla a, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ gua ngua a tsuo ya da nɛ a fi Yesu nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ya ha Pilato Nɛ Pilato bi lɛ ke: “Mo ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ lo?” Nɛ e he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Ja o de ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ po e nya fuu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Pilato bi lɛ ekohu ke: “O be he nɔ́ ko dee lo?
Hyɛ o nya sɔuu nɛ a ngɛ poe!” Se Yesu de we nɔ ko hu, nɛ Pilato hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa.
A bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ Se daa ke e su nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngmɛɛ pamino kake nɛ a biɔ ɔ he haa mɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Baraba nɛ a wo lɛ tsu mi kɛ atua tsɔli kpa komɛ nɛ gbe nɔmlɔ ngɛ atua tsɔmi ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ asafo ɔ ba ba bɔni lɛ pɛɛ kpami ke e pee kaa bɔ nɛ e peɔ daa a ngɔ ha mɛ.
Se Pilato he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ suɔ kaa ma ngmɛɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ he ha nyɛ lo?” Ejakaa e le kaa ninyɛ he je nɛ esɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ nu lɛ kɛ ba ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ wo aafo ɔ yi mi ke a ha e ngmɛɛ Baraba mohu he ngɔ ha mɛ.
Nɛ Pilato he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ekohu ke: “Lɛɛ mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee nɔ nɛ nyɛ tsɛɛ lɛ Yudafohi a matsɛ ɔ he mɔ?
Se a kpa huhui ekohu ke: “Sɛu lɛ!” Nɛ Pelato bi mɛ ke: “Se mɛni yayami po e pee?” Se a kpa huhui wawɛɛ pe kekle ɔ ke: “Sɛu lɛ!” Se akɛnɛ Pilato ngɛ hlae nɛ e sa asafo ɔ hɛ mi he je ɔ, e ngmɛɛ Baraba he ha mɛ; nɛ Yesu ɔ lɛɛ e fia lɛ kplibi, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ha nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.
Aslaafo ɔmɛ ye Yesu he fɛu Nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ kpaka Yesu kɛ ho amlaalo mɔ ɔ mi ya, nɛ a tsɛ aslaafohi asafo ɔ tsuo kɛ ba kpe.
Nɛ a wo lɛ tade tsu ko, nɛ a pee mio jlasi ko kɛ fi e yi.
Nɛ abɔni lɛ ngami kɛ: “Wa nga mo oo, Yudafohi a matsɛ.
Nɛ a kɛ paplo fia e yi kpɛti, nɛ a la lada ngɔ pue e nɔ, nɛ a kpla si nɛ a ja lɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a ye e he fɛu se ɔ, a je e tade tsu ɔ ngɛ e he, nɛ a ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tade ɔmɛ ngɔ wo lɛ, nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ho nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.
Yesu sɛumi kɛ e gbenɔ Nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ nyɛ Simon Kireneno ko nɛ je ngmɔ si kɛ bee nɛ ji Aleksandro kɛ Rufo mɛ a tsɛ ɔ nɔ ke e wo Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ. Nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ya he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ Golgota, e sisi ji Yikoklodonya.
Nɛ a ha lɛ wai nɛ a kɛ mire (tsopa) futu mi ke e nu; se e kua.
Nɛ benɛ a sɛu lɛ ɔ, a dla e tade ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a fɔ nɔ sɔ, nɔ́ nɛ mo nɔ o maa ngɔ.
Se mɔtu ngmlɛ nɛɛ mi a sɛu lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ a ngma sane nɛ a kɛ fɔ e nɔ ɔ ngɛ e yi je ke: “Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ”.
Nɛ a sɛu awiyeli enyɔ piɛ e he, nɔ kake ngɛ e hiɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ nɔ kake ngɛ e muɔ nɔ.
[Nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ de ke: “Nɛ a bu lɛ ngɔ si yayami peeli a nɔ”] ɔ ba mi.
Nɛ nihi nɛ bee ɔ tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Yesu, nɛ a mimiɛ a yi nɛ a ke: “Ei, mo nɛ o kuɔ sɔlemi tsu nɛ okpaleɔ maa lɛ ligbi etɛ ɔ, jee seumi tso ɔ nɔ kɛ kple si nɛ o he mo nitsɛ o yi wami!” Ja nɔuu osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ hu ye e he fɛu ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “E he ni kpahi a yi wami, se lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ ɔ lɛɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e he; Kristo, Israel matsɛ ɔ, e je sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ kɛ kple si koo, konɛ waa na nɛ wa he ye!” Nɛ nihi nɛ a sɛu ngɔ piɛ e he ɔ hu ye e he fɛu.
Nɛ benɛ su ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, diblii wo ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ kɛ ya si ngmlɛ etɛ mi.
Nɛ ngmlɛ etɛ mi ɔ, Yesu kpa ngmlaa kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke: “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” E sisi ji: “Ye Mawu, Ye Mawu, mɛ he je nɛ o kua mi?” Nɛ benɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ nu ɔ, a ke: “Oʼɛ, e ngɛ Elia tsɛe.” Nɛ nɔ ko sa fo nɛ e ya ngɔ wosuma kɛ sɔ da nɛ kua mi, nɛ e kɛ ma paplo nya ha lɛ ke e nu nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ ha waa mlɛ nɛ waa hyɛ kaa Elia ma ba je lɛ lo?” Nɛ Yesu kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nya.
Nɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi pomi bo ɔ mi gba kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba ma si.
Se benɛ aslaafohi lafa a nyatsɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ e hanɔ ɔ na kaa e kpa ngmlaa kikɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nya a, e ke: “Niinɛ kaa kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, Mawu bi ʼi!” Nɛ yi komɛ hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ se banee ngɛ hyɛe; a ti ni komɛ ji Maria Magdalena, kɛ Maria, Yakobo wayo kɛ Yosemɛ a nyɛ ɔ, kɛ Salome, nihi nɛ benɛ e ngɛ Galilea nɛ a nyɛɛ e se nɛ a sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ, kɛ yi kpa komɛ fuu nɛ kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ. Yesu pumi Nɛ benɛ su gbɔkuɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ e ji he dlami ligbi nɛ nyɛɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ hɛ mi he ɔ, Yosef nɛ je Arimatia, nɛ ji gua ngua a mi nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ biɛ nɛ lɛ hu e ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ, ba nɛ e kɛ kã pue nɔ kɛ ya Pilato ngɔ, nɛ e ya bi Yesu gbogboe ɔ.
Se Pilato hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa kaa e gbo momo; nɛ e tsɛ aslaafohi lafa a yatse ɔ nɛ e bi lɛ ke e gbo kɛ lo?
Nɛ benɛ e nu kɛ je aslaafohi lafa a nyatsɛ ɔ nya a, e kɛ gbogbo ɔ ke Yosef.
Nɛ Yosef ya he kploba, nɛ e ba je lɛ kɛ kple si nɛ e kɛ kploba a ha e he, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya fɔ yɔkɔ nɛ a kpɛ ngɛ tɛ sa mi ɔ mi, nɛ e kpɛne tɛ ko kɛ tsi muɔ ɔ nya.
Nɛ Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria, Yose nyɛ ɔ ngɛ hyɛe he nɛ a kɛ lɛ fɔ ɔ.
Yesu sitemi Nɛ benɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ be ɔ, Maria Magdalena kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria kɛ Salome ya he tsopa kɛ e he via konɛ a ba nɛ a kɛ ba kpa Yesu gbogboe ɔ. Nɛ otsi ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ mɔtu mla, pu si temi be ɔ, a ba muɔ ɔ nya.
Nɛ a bi a he ke: “Mɛnɔ ma kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ je muɔ ɔ nya ha wɔ?” Se benɛ a yaa wo a hɛ nɔ ɔ, a na kaa a kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ ho se ya, ejakaa e kle saminya.
Nɛ benɛ a sɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi ɔ, a na niheyo ko nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ je nɛ e wo tade hiɔ gagaaga; nɛ a hɛli si.
Se e de mɛ ke.
“Nyɛ ko ye gbeye!
Nyɛ ngɛ Yesu Nazareno nɛ a sɛu ɔ hlae; e te si, e be hiɛ ɔ; oʼɛ, he nɛ a kɛ lɛ fɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ Petro, ke e ngɛ nyɛ hlami sɛe kɛ yaa Galilea; lejɛ ɔ nyɛ maa na lɛ ngɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ e de nyɛ ɔ.” Nɛ a je kpo oya nɛ a tu fo kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ he; a nu sawale nɛ a nya kpɛ a he; a de we nɔ ko nɔ́ ko, ejakaa a ngɛ gbeye yee.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ Maria Magdalena [ Benɛ Yesu te si mɔtu mla ngɛ otsi ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ kekleekle nɛ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ ji Maria Magdalena, nɔ nɛ mi nɛ pe hia mumi yayamihi kpaago kɛ je ɔ. Nɛ lɛ e ya nɛ e ya sɛɛ ngɔ ha nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ hi si nɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee nɛ a ngɛ ya foe ɔ.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ, benɛ a nu kaa Yesu hɛ ngɛ nɛ e na lɛ ɔ, a he we lɛ yi.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli enyɔ Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu je e he kpo ngɛ su kpa mi tsɔɔ a ti ni enyɔ, benɛ a ngɛ si slae kɛ yaa ngmɔ si ɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho ya de nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ, se a he we mɛ tete po yi.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ Pee se ɔ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ nitsɛ, benɛ a hii si ngɛ niye ni he ɔ, nɛ e ka a hɛ mi ngɛ hemi nɛ a he we yi kɛ a tsui wami ɔ he, ejakaa a he we nihi nɛ na lɛ ngɛ e sitemi ɔ se ɔ yi.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ya je ɔ tsuo kulaa mi nɛ nyɛ ya fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a bɔ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ nɛ a baptisi lɛ ɔ, a ma he e yi wami, se nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ, a maa bu lɛ fɔ.
Se okadihi nɛ maa nyɛɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔmɛ a se ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ye biɛ mi ɔ, sa maa hia mumi yayamihi; a maa tu munyu hehi; a ma wo sinɔhi a nɔ; nɛ ke a nu nɔ́ ko nɛ gbee nɔ ɔ, e be mɛ yayami ko pee; a kɛ a ninehi ma pue hiɔtsɛmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a he maa wa mɛ.
Yesu hiɔweyami Kɛkɛ ɔ, benɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ tu munyu se ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ we ya hi si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kaseli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya fiɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ tsu ni, nɛ e wo munyu ɔ he wami kɛ okadihi nɛ piɛ he ɔ.]
BLEMA NGMAMI NƐ A KƐ GBE NYA A EKO [ Yi ɔmɛ ya Petro kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ a ya bɔ mɛ kpiti nihi kulaa nɛ a de mɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu nitsɛ gu e kaseli ɔmɛ a nɔ ha nɛ munyu klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ daa nɛ haa neneene wami ɔ gbɛ fia kɛ je beleku kɛ ya si bonyoku.]
Sisijemi Akɛnɛ nihi fuu kɔ fɔ a nɔ kaa a maa ngma sanehi nɛ ba mi ngɛ wa kpɛti ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ na kɛ a hɛngmɛ kɛ je sisije nɛ a ji munyu ɔ he sɔmɔli ɔmɛ fie tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ, e sa ye hɛ mi kaa imi hu, nɛ i hla lɛ tsuo mi fitsofitso kɛ je sisije ɔ, ma ngma pɛpeepɛ ha mo, Teofilo kpakpa; kone o na munyuhi nɛ a tsɔɔ mo ɔ mi anɔkuale.
Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ fɔmi he siwomi Yuda matsɛ Herode yinɔ ɔ, osɔfo ko hi si nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zakaria nɛ je Abia osɔfohi a weku ɔ mi; nɛ e yo ɔ je Aaron bimɛ yi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e biɛ ji Elisabet.
Nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo ɔ dali ji mɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a yeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kitahi kɛ e mlaa amɛ kulaa nɔ, nɛ piami ko be a he.
Se a be bi, ejakaa Elisabet ɔ yosa ʼi, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo a bwɔ.
Bene Zakaria ngɛ ni tsue kaa osɔfo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ osɔfo yemi blɔnya tomi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, e ba mi kaa a hla lɛ kaa e ya Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi nɛ e ya sa tsopa kɛ e he via, nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sami be ɔ mi ɔ, ma asafo ɔ tsuo ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ agbo ɔ nya.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e daa si ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sami latɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ benɛ Zakaria na lɛ ɔ, e tsui po nɛ e ye gbeye.
Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Koo ye gbeye, Zakaria, ejakaa a bu o pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue, nɛ o yo Elisabet ma fɔ bi nyumu ha mo, nɛ o wo lɛ biɛ Yohane.
E maa pee mo buajɔmi kɛ nyami, nɛ nihi fuu ma nya e fɔmi ɔ he.
Ejakaa e maa pee nɔ ngua ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ e be wai loo da nɛ nya wa ko nue, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ma hyi lɛ tɔ kɛ maa je e nyɛ muklii mi lokoo.
Nɛ e maa kpale Israelbi ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu kɛ maa ba Nyɔmtsɛ, a Mawu ɔ ngɔ.
Nɛ e maa sɛ e hlami ngɛ Elia mumi kɛ e hewami mi, nɛ e ya dɔ tsɛmɛ a tsui kɛ ba a bimɛ a he, kɛ tue gboli kɛ ba dali a ni lemi mi, nɛ e dla ma a ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Zakaria de bɔfo ɔ ke: “Mɛni i kɛ maa le enɛ ɔ?
Ejakaa imi lɛɛ nɔmoyo ji mi, nɛ ye yo hu bwɔ.” Nɛ bɔfo ɔ ha lɛ heto ke: “Imi ji Gabriel nɛ daa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ nɛ, nɛ a tsɔ mi ke ma ba de mo nɛ ma sɛɛ Sane Kpakpa nɛ ɔ ha mo.
Nɛ oʼɛ, o nya ma ma nɛ o be nyɛe munyu tumi kɛ maa su ligbi nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi, ejakaa o he we munyu ɔmɛ nɛ maa ba mi ngɛ a be mi ɔ yi.” Nɛ ma a ngɛ Zakaria mlɛe, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa akɛnɛ e se ya kɛ ngɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi ɔ.
Se bene e je kpo e nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu, nɛ a kɔ se kaa e ya na nɔ́ ko ngɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi.
E fɔ mɛ nine se e nyɛ we munyu nɛ e tu.
Nɛ benɛ e sɔmɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta a, e je kɛ ho lɛ nitse e we ɔ mi ya.
Nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a se ɔ, e yo Elisabet ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e laa e he hlami enuɔ nɛ e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ je ye zo ɔ ngɛ nimli a kpɛti.” Yesu fɔmi he gbami Hlami nɛ ji ekpa a nɔ ɔ, Mawu tsɔ bɔfo Gabriel kɛ ya Galilea ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Nazaret ɔ mi, ngɛ zangmayo ko nɛ a bi e si ha nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yosef nɛ je David weku ɔ mi ɔ ngɔ.
Zangmayo ɔ biɛ ji Maria.
Nɛ bɔfo ɔ ba e ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Mo he manye, mo nɔ nɛ a dloo mo, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ!” Se benɛ e nu ɔ, e tsui po, nɛ e susu ke mɛni ngami ji nɛ ɔ?
Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Koo ye gbeye, Maria, ejakaa o hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Bu tue, lo ma na muklii nɛ o ma fɔ bi nyumu, nɛ o wo lɛ biɛ Yesu.
E maa pee nɔmlɔ ngua, nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ Hiɔweno ɔ bi, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu maa ngɔ e tsɛ David matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.
Nɛ e maa ye Yakob we ɔ nɔ matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe.” Maria bi bɔfo ɔ ke: “Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ enɛ ɔ maa ba mi?
I li nyumu.” Nɛ bɔfo ɔ ha lɛ heto ke: “Mumi Klɔuklɔu maa ba o nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ jamɛ a bi klɔuklɔu ɔ hu nɛ o ma fɔ ɔ, a ma tsɛ lɛ Mawu bi.
Nɛ oʼɛ, o wekuno Elisabet ɔ hu ngɔ bi nyumu hɔ ngɛ e bwɔmi si, nɛ nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ yosa a na hlami ekpa.
Ejakaa nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko wɛ́ hi Mawu.” Nɛ Maria ke: “Oʼɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ weyo ji mi, e ba mi ngɛ o munyu ɔ nya!” Nɛ bɔfo ɔ si lɛ.
Maria ya slaa Elisabet Nɛ Maria te si ngɛ lɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ e pue nɔ oya kɛ ho Yudea ma ko ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ mi ya, nɛ e ya sɛ Zakaria we ɔ mi nɛ e nga Elisabet.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ Elisabet nu Maria ngami ɔ, bimwɔyo ɔ hua ngɛ e mi mi; nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi Elisabet tɔ.
Nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “A gbaa mo ngɛ yihi a ti, nɛ a gbaa o mi mi bi ɔ!
Nɛ jije enɛ ɔ je kɛ ba ha mi nɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ nyɛ ma ye ngɔ nɛ ɔ?
Se oʼɛ, amlɔ pɛ nɛ o ngami ɔ pɛ ngɛ ye tue mi ɔ, bimwɔyo ɔ kɛ nyami hua ngɛ ye muklii mi.
Nɛ sa gbaa mo, mo nɔ nɛ o he ye kaa munyuhi nɛ a je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ba de ɔ maa ba mi ɔ.” Maria yijemi la Nɛ Maria ke: “Ye klaa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ agboje ɔ fiɛe, Nɛ ye mumi ngɛ Mawu ye yiwami-helɔ ɔ yi jee, Kaa e kai e weyo humi nɛ e ji ɔ, Ejakaa oʼɛ, kɛ je mwɔ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, yi nɔhi kulaa maa gbaa mi.
Ejakaa Ope ɔ pee ni nguahi ha mi; Nɛ klɔuklɔu ji e biɛ ɔ, Nɛ e mɔbɔ nami ngɛ nihi nɛ yee lɛ gbeye ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ yaa su yi nɔhi a yinɔ.
E kɛ e nine tsu hewami ni tsumi; Nihi nɛ woɔ a he ngɛ a tsui mi susumi mi ɔ, e gbɛ mɛ fia.
E kpa hewali kɛ je a sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, Nɛ e wo nihi nɛ ji humi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
E ha hwɔ hwɔli tɔ kɛ ni kpakpahi, Nɛ he nali ɔmɛ ɔ, e fie mɛ kɛ ho dɛ gu.
E ye bua e wenyumu Israel, Konɛ e kai e mɔbɔ nami ɔmɛ, Kaa bɔ nɛ e de wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, Kɛ ha Abraham kɛ e nina kɛ yaa neneene ɔ.” Nɛ Maria kɛ Elisabet hi si maa pee hlami ete, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho e ma a mi ya.
Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ fɔmi Jeha nɛ ɔ Elisabet fɔmi be su, nɛ e fɔ bi nyumu.
Nɛ benɛ e pakabi kɛ e wekuli nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na lɛ mɔbɔ babauu ɔ, a kɛ lɛ nya.
Nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, a ba bimwɔyɔ ɔ pomi, nɛ jinɛ a kɛ e tsɛ biɛ Zakaria a yaa wo lɛ.
Se e nyɛ he nɔ nɛ e de ke: “Dɛbi, se a wo lɛ Yohane mohu!” Nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Nɔ ko be o weku ɔ mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ja!” Nɛ a kɛ a nine pee okadi kɛ bi e tsɛ bɔ nɛ e suɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ.
Nɛ e bi tso sleeti ko, nɛ e ngma ngɛ nɔ ke: “Yohane ji e biɛ.” Nɛ e pee mɛ tsuo nyakpɛ.
Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ Zakaria nya bli nɛ e lilɛ kpa pɛne, nɛ e tu munyu kɛ je Mawu yi.
Nɛ gbeye nu e pakabi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a tu ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo he munyu ngɛ Yudea yoku ɔmɛ kulaa nɔ.
Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nu ɔ ngɔ to a yi mi nɛ a ke: “Mɛni po jokuɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee?
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nine ngɛ e nɔ.
Zakaria gbami Nɛ e tsɛ Zakaria hyi gbagbaagba kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu, nɛ e gba de ke: “A gbaa Nyɔmtsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, Kaa de ba slaa e ma a, nɛ e tsu Kpɔmi nihi ha mɛ, Nɛ e tle yi wami hemi koli si Ngɔ ha wɔ ngɛ e wenyumu David we ɔ, Kaa bɔ nɛ e de kɛ je blema lokoo ngɛ e gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nya a; Ke e ma he wa yi wami kɛ maa je Wa henyɛli kɛ nihi nɛ wa he tsɛɛ mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi; Nɛ e na wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ.
Nɛ e kai e somi klɔuklɔu ɔ, Kita nɛ e ka wa tsɛ Abraham ɔ, Ke e ma ha a je wɔ kɛ je wa henyɛli a dɛ mi, Nɛ wa sɔmɔ lɛ nɛ gbeye yemi ko ko hi mi, Ngɛ he tsɔmi kɛ dami mi Ngɛ e hɛ mi wa ligbihi abɔ tsuo Nɛ mo, jokuɛ nɛ ɔ, A ma tsɛ mo hiɔwe lokoono ɔ gbalɔ; Ejakaa o maa sɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hlami Nɛ o ya dla e blɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ to lɛ, Konɛ o ngɔ yi wami hemi he ni lemi Ngɔ ha e ma a ngɛ a he yayami mi, Ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ mɔbɔ nami Nɛ haa e mi mi saa lɛ ɔ nya, Nɔ́ nɛ ha je nami nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ ba slaa wɔ nɛ ɔ, Konɛ je mi nɛ tsɔ ha nihi Nɛ hii si ngɛ diblii gbenɔ hɔ mi ɔ, Nɛ e plɛ wa nane kɛ ya he jɔmi blɔ ɔ nɔ.” Nɛ jokuɛ ɔ ba wa, nɛ e he wa ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ e hi nga a nɔ kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Israel.
Yesu fɔmi Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e ba mi kaa hiɔngɔ ko je Kaisare Augusto ngɔ ba ke a kane je ɔ tsuo nɛ a ngma.
Enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle nɔ kanemi nɛ ba nɔ be mi nɛ Kirenio ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Siria a. Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho lɛ nitse e ma mi ya konɛ a ya ngma e biɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yosef hu je Nazaret ma a mi ngɛ Galilea, nɛ e ya Betlehem nɛ ji David ma nɛ ngɛ Yudea a mi, ejakaa e je David we kɛ e weku ɔ mi, konɛ a ngma lɛ kɛ Maria, e yo nɛ e bi e si nɛ e mi wa a biɛ.
Benɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e fɔmi be ba su.
Nɛ pe fɔ bi nyumu, e kekleekle bi ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ bo ngɔ blaa lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ fɔ lohwehi a niye ni nɔ mi, ejakaa a nɛ blɔ ngɛ nibwɔhi a to he ɔ. Tohyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ To hyɛli komɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi nɔuu nɛ ngɛ nyɔ fɔe kɛ ngɛ a tohi a he bue nyɔ mi.
Nɛ oʼɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba da a kasa nya, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami kpɛ bɔle mɛ, nɛ a ye gbeye wawɛɛ.
Nɛ bɔfo ɔ de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye; ejakaa oʼɛ, ma sɛɛ bua jɔmi sane kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ji ma tsuo nɔ ɔ ha nyɛ, kaa mwɔ nɛ ɔ a fɔ yi wami helɔ nɛ ji Kristo, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, ngɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ David ma a mi.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi ha nyɛ; Nyɛ maa na bimwɔyo ɔ nɛ a kɛ bo blaa e he nɛ e hwɔɔ si ngɛ lohwehi a niye ni nɔ mi.” Nɛ tlukaa a, hiɔwe ta ngua ba piɛ bɔfo ɔ he, nɛ a je Mawu yi de ke: “Hɛ mi nyami ha Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo, Nɛ he jɔmi nɛ ba zugba a nɔ Ha nihi nɛ sa e hɛ mi.” Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ je a ngɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, to hyɛli ɔmɛ de a he ke: “Nyɛ ha waa ho Betlehem ya koo, nɛ wa ya hyɛ sane nɛ ba nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je tsɔɔ wɔ nɛ ɔ.” Nɛ a ho nɔuu nɛ a ya na Maria kɛ Yosef kɛ bimwɔyo ɔ nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ lohwehi a niye ni nɔ mi.
Nɛ benɛ a ya na lɛ ɔ, a jaje sane nɛ a sɛɛ ngɔ ha mɛ ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ he ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nu ɔ hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ sɛɛ ha mɛ ɔ he.
Se Maria kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo to nɛ e susuu he ngɛ e tsui mi.
Nɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ kpale a se nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a je e yi ngɛ nihi tsuo kulaa nɛ a nu nɛ a na a he, kaa bɔ nɛ a sɛɛ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ.
A wo Yesu biɛ Nɛ benɛ ligbi kpaanyɔ su nɛ a maa po jokuɛ ɔ, a wo lɛ Yesu, kaa bɔ nɛ bɔfo ɔ wo lɛ momo loko a ngɔ e hɔ ɔ.
A ngɔ Yesu ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ Nɛ benɛ a gbe he tsukɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ Mose Mlaa a nya a, a kɛ Yesu ya Yerusalem konɛ a kɛ lɛ ya tsɔɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mlaa a mi ke: “Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ bliɔ muklii nya a, a ma tsɛ lɛ klɔuklɔu ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Nɛ a ya sã bɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a de ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mlaa a mi ke: “Lahuɛhi enyɔ loo beleku lahuɛ tsɔwi enyɔ.” Jeha nɛ ɔ nyumu ko ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simeon; nɛ lɛ nyumu ɔ dalɔ ji lɛ nɛ e yee Mawu gbeye; e ngɛ Israel bua jɔmi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ngɛ e nɔ.
Nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ je kpo tsɔɔ lɛ ke e be gboe ja e na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Kristo ɔ lolo.
Nɛ Mumi ɔ kpaka lɛ kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Nɛ benɛ jokuɛ Yesu fɔli ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ ba konɛ a ba tsu bɔ nɛ ji Mlaa a blɔ nya ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e he lɛ ngɔ fɔ e kɔni bɔkɔ mi, nɛ e gbaa Mawu nɛ e ke: “Jeha nɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ, ha o wenyumu nɛ ya, Ngɛ o munyu ɔ nya ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Ejakaa ye hɛngmɛ na o yi wami hemi ɔ” Nɔ́ nɛ o dla ngɔ ma ma tsuo hɛ mi, La nɛ ma bli majemajeli ɔmɛ a hɛ Nɛ maa wo o ma Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ, Nɛ Yesu tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ nya kpɛ a he ngɛ nihi nɛ a de ngɛ e he ɔ he.
Nɛ Simeon gbaa mɛ nɛ e de e nyɛ Maria ke: “Oʼɛ, a kɛ bi nɛ ɔ da si ha nihi fuu a si gbeemi kɛ a si temi ngɛ Israel, kɛ okadi nɛ a maa tu munyu nɔ si, nɛ mo nitse hu, ha maa gbɔ o tsui mi; konɛ a je tsuihi fuu a susumihi kpo.” Nɛ gbalɔyo ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hana nɛ ji Fanuel biyo nɛ je Asher weku ɔ mi, nɛ e bwɔ saminya, nɛ e kɛ e huno hi si jeha kpaago kɛ je e yihe mi, se jeha nɛ ɔ yalɔ yo ji lɛ, nɛ e ye maa pee jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ eywiɛ.
E ji sɔlemi we ɔ kulaa, se e jaa Mawu kɛ hwɔ hami kɛ pɛɛ kpami nyɔ kɛ pia.
Lɛ hu e ba ngɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a mi nɔuu, nɛ e ba je Mawu yi, nɛ e tu jokuɛ ɔ he munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kpɔmi ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ.
A kpale kɛ ho Nazaret ya Nɛ benɛ a gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo nya ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mlaa a nya a, a kpale a se kɛ ho Nazaret, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma a mi, ya ngɛ Galilea.
Nɛ jokuɛ ɔ ba wa, nɛ e he wa ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ nile, nɛ Mawu dloomi ngɛ e nɔ.
Yesu ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ Daa jeha a, Yesu fɔli ɔmɛ yaa Yerusalem ya yeɔ Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ɔ. Nɛ benɛ e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, a ya Yerusalem kaa bɔ nɛ nyami ligbi ɔ yemi blɔ nya toɔmi ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ benɛ a gbe ligbi ɔmɛ a nya nɛ a kpale a se ekohu ɔ, jokuɛ Yesu ɔ kpɛ se ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ li.
Se a susu kaa e futu asafo ɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a nyɛɛ ligbi kake blɔ nyɛɛmi ya hia lɛ ngɛ a wekuli kɛ a huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Nɛ benɛ a nɛ́ lɛ ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ba Yerusalem ekohu ba hia lɛ.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa ligbi etɛ se ɔ, a ya na lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ e hii si ngɛ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ e ngɛ mɛ tue bue, nɛ e ngɛ mɛ ni bie.
Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lɛ tue bue ɔ nya kpɛ a he ngɛ e ni lemi kɛ e heto nɛ e ngɛ hae ɔmɛ a he.
Nɛ benɛ a na lɛ ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he; e nyɛ bi lɛ ke: “Ye bi, mɛ he je o pee wɔ kikɛ?
Oʼɛ, i kɛ o tsɛ hia mo kɛ hɛdɔ.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Mɛ he je nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa e sa kaa ma hi si ngɛ nihi nɛ ji tsaatsɛ nɔ ɔ mi lo?” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a nui munyu nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu ɔ sisi.
Nɛ e kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Nazaret ya, nɛ e ba e he si ha mɛ.
Nɛ e nyɛ ngɔ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ to e tsui mi.
Nɛ Yesu wa ngɛ ni lemi kɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi, nɛ Mawu kɛ nimli na e he bua jɔmi.
Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ fiɛmi Jeha nɛ ɔ, Kaisare Tiberio matsɛ yemi jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ mi, benɛ Pontio Pilato ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Yudea, nɛ Herode ngɛ amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma yee ngɛ Galilea, nɛ e nyɛmi Filipo hu ngɛ matsɛ ngua yee ngɛ Iturea kɛ Trakɛniti zugba amɛ a nɔ, nɛ Lisania ngɛ amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma yee ngɛ Abileene, nɛ Anna kɛ Kaiafa ngɛ osofɔ nikɔtɔmahi yee ɔ, Mawu munyu ba Zakaria bi Yohane ngɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Nɛ e kpa Yordan kpo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi nɛ e fiɛ baptisimi nɛ a kɛ naa tsui tsakemi kɛ yayami pami; kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaia womi ɔ mi ke: “Nɔ ko ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ nga a nɔ ke: ‘Nyɛ dla Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ, Nyɛ ha e blɔ ngua amɛ nɛ a da tlɔmɔɔ.
A maa tsi dɔgba tsuaa dɔgba, Nɛ a ma ha yoku tsuaa yoku Kɛ kpongu tsuaa kpongu maa ba si, Nɛ a ma ha nihi nɛ kpɛ ɔmɛ maa da, Nɛ blɔ nɛ nɔ ngɛ googãgoogã a maa sɔ; Nɛ he lo tsuo kulaa maa na Mawu yiwami hemi ɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ e baptisi mɛ ɔ ke: “Sinɔhi a nina, mɛnɔ tu munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ke nyɛɛ tu muklii mi fumi nɛ ma a nya fo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ wo yiblii nɛ sa tsui tsakemi; nɛ nyɛ ko bɔni demi ngɛ nyɛ yi mi ke: ‘Wa tsɛ ji Abraham,’ ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Mawu ma nyɛ ma tle bimɛ a si kɛ je tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɔ ha Abraham.
Se jeha nɛ ɔ hu, gbiɛ ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a sipoku ɔmɛ a nɔ momo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tso tsuaa tso nɛ wui yiblii kpakpahi ɔ, a maa po nɛ a ma sake ngɔ fɔ la mi.” Nɛ asafo ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ mɛni waa pee mɔ?” Nɛ e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe tade enyɔ ɔ, e kɛ nɔ nɛ be eko ɔ nɛ dla; nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ ngma hu, e pee ja nɔuu.” Nɛ onia tsuli hu ba konɛ a baptisi mɛ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni waa pee?” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ko he pe bɔ nɛ a to ha nyɛ ɔ.” Nɛ aslaafohi hu ba bi lɛ ke: “Nɛ wɔ hu, mɛni waa pee?” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ko hɛɛ nɔ ko soisoi, nɛ nyɛ ko po nɔ ko nya yaka gu; nɛ nyɛ ha nyɛ hiɔwo nɛ sa nyɛ hɛ mi.” Se benɛ ma a tsuo hɛ ngɛ nɔ, nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ susue ngɛ a tsui mi ngɛ Yohane he kaa be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ lɛ ji Kristo ɔ, Yohane he nɔ nɛ e de ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke: “Imi lɛɛ, nyu i kɛ baptisi nyɛ; se nɔ ko nɛ he wa pe mi ma, nɛ i sɛ nɔ nɛ pɛneɔ e tokotahi a nya kpa, lɛ e kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ la maa baptisi nyɛ, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ e nɔ mi sami tsine ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e maa bɛɛ zugba a fitsofitso, nɛ e ma bua ngma a nya ngɔ to e gba a mi, se tsakati ɔ, e kɛ la nɛ gbo we maa sã.” Nɛ e de ni kpa komɛ fuu hu kɛ wo mɛ ga, kɛ fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a tsɔɔ mɛ, Se amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma Herode ɔ, akɛnɛ Yohane ka e hɛ mi ngɛ e nyɛmi Filipo yo Herodia a he, kɛ ni yayahi tsuo nɛ lɛ Herode ɔ pee he je ɔ, e kpale pee enɛ ɔ ngɔ si nɔ kaa e nu Yohane ngɔ wo tsu mi.
Yesu baptisimi E ba mi kaa benɛ a baptisi ni ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, a baptisi Yesu hulɔ; nɛ benɛ e ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, hiɔwe nya bli nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kple si kɛ su nɛ ngɛ kaa okpo kɛ ba e nɔ.
Nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke: “Mo ji ye suɔmi bi ɔ nɛ, mo o he ye tsui ngɛ!” Yesu Wekukpa Nɛ benɛ Yesu je e ni tsumi sisi ɔ, e ye maa pee jeha nyingmi etɛ, nɛ bɔ nɛ a susuu ɔ, e ji Yosef bi, Heli bi, Matat bi, Levi bi, Melki bi, Yanai bi Yosef bi, Matatia bi, Amos bi, Nahum bi, Esli bi, Nagai bi, Maat bi, Matatia bi, Semein bi, Yosek bi, Yoda bi, Yohanan bi, Resa bi, Zerubabel bi, Shealtiel bi, Neri bi, Melki bi, Adi bi, Kosam bi, Elamadam bi, Er bi, Yoshua bi, Eliezer bi, Yorim bi, Matat bi, Levi bi, Simeon bi, Yuda bi, Yosef bi, Yonam bi, Eliakim bi, Melea bi, Mena bi, Matata bi, Natan bi, David bi, Ishai bi, Obed bi, Boaɛ bi, Salmon bi, Nahashon bi, Aminadab bi, Admin bi, Arni bi, Hezron bi, Perez bi, Yuda bi, Yakob bi, Isak bi, Abraham bi, Tera bi, Nahor bi.
Serug bi, Reu bi, Peleg bi, Eber bi, Shela bi, Kainan bi, Arpakshad bi, Shem bi, Noa bi, Lamek bi, Metusela bi, Henok bi, Yared bi, Mahalalel bi, Kainan bi, Enos bi, Set bi, Adam bi, Mawu bi.
A ka Yesu Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu, nɛ Mumi klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi lɛ tɔ ɔ kpale e se kɛ je Yordan he, nɛ Mumi ɔ kpaka lɛ kɛ ya nga a nɔ, nɛ abosiami ya ka lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ.
Nɛ lɛ be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ hwɔ ye lɛ.
Nɛ abosiami de lɛ ke: “Ke Mawu bi ji mo ɔ, lɛɛ de tɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ e plɛ abolo.” Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “A ngma ke: Ti abolo kɛke nɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ guu kɛ hii si.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ abosiami ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya yo gaga ko nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ je mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ hɛngmɛfia.
Abosiami de lɛ ke: Mo ma ngɔ hewami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ a nyami ɔmɛ ngɔ ha, ejakaa imi a ngɔ ha, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, lɛ i kɛ haa.
Kɛ o ma kpla si nɛ o ja mi ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa maa pee o nɔ.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “A ngma ke: ‘Ja Nyɔmtsɛ o Mawu ɔ, nɛ lɛ kɛkɛ o sɔmɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ abosiami ngɔ Yesu kɛ ba Yerusalem nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba da sɔlemi tsu ɔ yi mi poplooplo ɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Ke Mawu bi ji mo ɔ, sakee o he ngɔ fia si, ejakaa a ngma ke: ‘Mawu ma fã e bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a bu o he,’ kɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu: ‘A maa hɛɛ mo ngɛ a dɛ mi konɛ o nane ko si tɛ ko.’ ” Se Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “A de ke: ‘Koo ka Nyɔmtsɛ o Mawu ɔ.’ ” Benɛ abosiami ka lɛ ngɛ blɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, e si lɛ lolo.
Yesu je e nitsumi sisi ngɛ Galilea Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kpale e se ngɛ Mumi ɔ nya kɛ ba Galilea; nɛ e he sane jije ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi tsuo.
E tsɔɔ ni ngɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo je e yi.
A kua Yesu ngɛ Nazaret Nɛ Yesu ba Nazaret he nɛ a lɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ, e ya kpe he ɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ.
E te si konɛ e kane ni, nɛ a ngɔ gbalɔ Yesaia womi ɔ ngɔ sɔle lɛ.
Nɛ benɛ e bli womi ɔ mi ɔ, e na he nɛ a ngma ngɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ ye nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pɔ mi nu konɛ ma fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ohiafohi, Konɛ ma fiɛ he yemi ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɔgue ɔmɛ, Kɛ nɔ́ hyemi ha hɛyuyuili.
Nɛ ma fiɛ jeha ko nɛ sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.” Nɛ e hluɛ womi ɔ nɛ e ngɔ ha sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e be ya hi si; nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ bɔni lɛ hyemi too.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ bɔni munyu tumi ke; “Mwɔnɛ ɔ ngmami nɛ ɔ ba mi ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.” Nɛ nihi tsuo ye lɛ odase, nɛ a nya kpɛ a he ngɛ dloomi munyuhi nɛ je e nya a he, nɛ a de ke: “Anɛ pi Yosef bi nyumu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?” Se e de mɛ ke: “Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ nyɛ maa bu mi abɛ nɛ ɔ ke: ‘Tsopatsɛ, tsa mo nitse o he!
Nihi abɔ nɛ wa nu kaa o pee ngɛ Kapernaum ɔ, pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ji mo nitse o ma a mi hulɔ.’ ” Nɛ e ya nɔ nɛ e de ke: “Niinɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a bui gbalɔ ko ngɛ lɛ nitse e ma mi.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Yalɔ yi fuu ngɛ Israel ngɛ Elia yinɔ ɔ benɛ a nga hiɔwe nya jeha etɛ kɛ hlami ekpa sɔuu nɛ hwɔ ngua ba zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ; se a tsɔ we Elia kɛ yɛ́ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔ kaa ja yalɔ yo ko nɛ ngɛ Zarefat ngɛ Zidon zugba a nɔ ɔ ngɔ.
Nɛ tsitsɛmɛ fuu ngɛ Israel ngɛ gbalɔ Elisha be ɔ mi, se a tsa we a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kaa ja Naeman, Siriano ɔ.” Nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ tsuo a muklii mi fu benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ ɔ.
A te si nɛ a tsitsɛɛ le kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ho yoku nɛ a ma a maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ nya ya.
Se e gblee a kpɛti zaa kɛ je.
Nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi Nɛ Yesu ba Kapernaum, ma ko nɛ ngɛ Galilea a mi nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ ni ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he ngɛ e nitsɔɔmi ɔ he, ejakaa e munyu ɔ mi ngɛ hewami.
Jeha nɛ ɔ nyumu ko ngɛ kpe he ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “Aa, mɛni sane waa kɛ mo ngɛ, mo Yesu Nazareno?
O ba wa hɛ mi kpatami lo?
I le nɔ nɛ ji mo, mo ji Mawu Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu nga e yi nɛ e ke: “Ma o nya nɛ o je e mi!” Mumi yayami ɔ sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e je e mi, nɛ e yi lɛ awi ko, Ni ɔmɛ tsuo a he nya si mɛ, nɛ a de a he ke: “Mɛni munyu ji nɛ ɔ!
Ejakaa he blɔ kɛ hewami e kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ nɛ a jee kpo ɔ nɛ!” Nɛ Yesu he sane gbɛ fia lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi tsuo.
Yesu tsa nihi fuu Yesu je kpe he ɔ nɛ e ya sɛ Simon we ɔ mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ Simon nganyɛ fɔɔ si kɛ asla ku ko nɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e pee he no ko.
Yesu hɛ lɛ su hiɔtsɛ ɔ he nɛ e nga asla a yi, nɛ asla a po ngɛ e nɔ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ e te si nɛ e sɔmɔ mɛ.
Pu si nɔmi be ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ hiɔhi slɔɔtohi hɛɛ mɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ ba Yesu ngɔ.
Nɛ e ngɔ e ninehi pue mɛ tsuo a nɔ kakaaka nɛ etsa mɛ.
Mumi yayamihi hu je nihi fuu a mi nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Mo ji Mawu bi ɔ nɛ!” Nɛ e nga a yi nɛ e ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a de ke a le kaa lɛ ji Kristo ɔ. Yesu fiɛ ngɛ Yudea Nɛ benɛ je na a, Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho nga nɔ he ko ya.
Asafo ɔ bɔni lɛ hlami nɛ benɛ a na lɛ ɔ, a hla kaa a tsi e nya konɛ e ko je a ngɔ.
Se e de mɛ ke: “E sa kaa i ya fiɛɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he Sane Kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ma kpa kome hulɔ, ejakaa lɔ ɔ he a tsɔ mi kɛ ba ngɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsa e fiɛmi ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yudea kpe he ɔmɛ.
Yesu tsɛ kekleekle kaseli ɔmɛ Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu daa si ngɛ Genesaret Taku ɔ nya nɛ nihi fuu pueɔ si ngɛ e nɔ nɛ a ngɛ Mawu munyu ɔ tue bue ɔ, e na lɛ enyɔ nɛ a muɔ mɛ si ngɛ taku ɔ nya; se hɛli ɔmɛ je mi nɛ a ngɛ a ya amɛ a he fɔe.
Yesu ya sɛ lɛ ɔ kake nɛ ji Simon nɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ konɛ e tsɛ̃ kɛ ya hɛ mi bɔɔ.
E be hi si nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ ni kɛ je lɛ ɔ mi.
Benɛ e jɔɔ munyu ɔ tumi ɔ, e de Simon ke: “Nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ kɛ ya he nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ fɔ̃ nyɛ ya amɛ konɛ nyɛɛ gbe lo.” Simon de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ wa tsu ni gbegbelii se wa nɛ nɔ́ ko; se kɛ ɔ, ngɛ o munyu ɔ nya a, ma fɔ̃ ya a.” Nɛ benɛ a pee ja a, a gbe lo babauu bɔ nɛ piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a ya amɛ ko gba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a fɔ a huɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ kpa a mi ɔ nine ke a ba nɛ a ba piɛ a he.
A ba nɛ a ba wo lɛ enyɔ ɔme tsuo tɔtɔɔtɔ bɔ nɛ piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a ko mu.
Benɛ Simon Petro na enɛ ɔ ɔ, e nɔ si ngɛ Yesu nane nya nɛ e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ jee ye kasa nya, ejakaa yayami peelɔ ji mi!” Nɛ e kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ tsuo a he mi po ngɛ lo fuu nɛ a gbe ɔ he; nɛ ja nɔuu e pee Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji Simon he piɛli ɔmɛ.
Nɛ Yesu de Simon ke: “Koo ye gbeye!
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, o ma sa nimli.” Nɛ a kɛ lɛ ɔmɛ ba kple, nɛ a si kulaa nɛ a nyɛɛ e se.
Yesu hã tsitsɛ ko he tso E ba mi kaa benɛ Yesu ngɛ ma a eko mi ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ tsi pue e he tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; benɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si nɛ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke o suɔ ɔ, o ma nyɛ kaa o haa ye he tsɔɔ.” Yesu kpa e nine mi nɛ e ta e he nɛ e ke: “I suɔ, o he nɛ tsɔ!” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ tsi ɔ ta ngɛ e he.
Nɛ Yesu bɔ lɛ kɔkɔ ke: “Ko de nɔ ko, se mohu yaa nɛ o kɛ o he ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ nɛ o sa bɔ ngɛ o he tsɔmi ɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ Mose wo kita a, konɛ e pee odase ngɔ ha ni ɔmɛ.’ Se e he sane ɔ gbɛ fia babauu mohu.
Nihi fuu ba bua a he nya nɛ a ba bu lɛ tue nɛ a tsa a hiɔ ɔmɛ.
Se ke pee ɔ, e sãa e he si kɛ yaa nga a nɔ he komɛ banee nɛ e ya sɔlee.
Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ hule Jeha nɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ eko nɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ ni tsɔɔe ɔ, Farisifohi kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli nɛ je Galilea kɛ Yudea ma amɛ tsuo nɔ kɛ Yerusalem ba a hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ a je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hewami ɔ kpo tsɔɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Nɛ oʼɛ, ni komɛ kɛ nyumu ko nɛ hule nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ sa nɔ ba, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ sɛ we ɔ mi konɛ a kɛ lɛ ba fɔ e hɛ mi.
Nɛ benɛ a nɛ́ bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a kɛ lɛ maa ba ngɛ asafo ɔ he ɔ, a kuɔ kɛ ya tsu ɔ yi mi, nɛ a kpɔ siaudo ɔ nɔ zu ɔ, nɛ a siu lɛ kɛ e sa a kɛ gu mi kɛ ya fɔ̃ ni ɔma a kpɛti ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi.
Benɛ Yesu na a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, e de hiɔtsɛ ɔ ke: “Maminyumu, a ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo.” Mlaatsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ bɔni susumi ke: “Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ tuɔ musu bɔmi munyu nɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ yayamihi kɛ pa kaa ja Mawu kɛkɛ?” Se benɛ Yesu kpa a susumi ɔmɛ si ɔ, e bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ susue ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ɔ?
Te nɔ́ nɛ demi wɛ hu?
Nɔ́ nɛ a ma de ke: ‘A ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo,’ aloo nɔ́ nɛ a ma de ke: ‘Tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ ɔ?’ Se benɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɛ he blɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kaa e ngɔɔ yayamihi ngɔ paa a,” e de nɔ nɛ hule ɔ ke: “I ngɛ mo dee ke: ‘Tee si nɛ o wo o sa a nɛ o ya o we mi.’ ” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nyumu ɔ te si ngɛ a hɛ mi nɛ e wo nɔ́ nɛ e hwɔɔ si ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho e we mi ya kɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami womi.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami nɛ a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nɛ a ke: “Wa na nyakpɛ ni mwɔnɛ ɔ.” Yesu tsɛ Levi Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu je kpo nɛ e ya na onia tsulɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Levi nɛ e hii si ngɛ onia tsumi he ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ye se.’ ” Nɛ e si e ni ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ e te si nyɛɛ e se.
Levi ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngua ngɛ e we ɔ mi ha Yesu, nɛ onia tsuli kɛ ni kpahi fuu kɛ mɛ ba ye ni.
Nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tu munyu huitihuiti wo e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ onia tsuli kɛ yayami peeli ngɛ ni yee nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ?” Yesu ha heto nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ ngɛ hewami ɔ, e hia we mɛ tsopatsɛ, se nihi nɛ ngɛ gboe ɔ mohu e hia.
I bɛ dali a tsemi, se mohu yayami peeli kɛ ha tsui tsakemi.” Hwɔhami he sane Kɛkɛ nɛ a bi Yesu ke: “Mɛ he je nɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ pɔɔ hwɔ hami kɛ sɔlemi, nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a kaseli ɔmɛ hu peɔ ja nɔuu, nɛ moo lɛɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ yeɔ ni nɛ a nuu ɔ?” Yesu de mɛ ke: “Anɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ha yo kpeemi he biali ɔmɛ nɛ a ha hwɔ benɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ kɛ mɛ ngɛ lolo nɛ ɔ?
Be maa ba nɛ a maa ngɔ ayɛflo huno ɔ kɛ maa je a ngɔ, nɛ lɛ be ɔ loko a maa ha hwɔ.” Yesu bu mɛ abɛ nɛ ɔ hulɔ ke: “Nɔ ko gba we bo he nya kɛ ta we tade momo mi; se ke a pee ja a, e ma gba ehe ɔ, nɛ bo nya nɛ a je ngɛ ehe ɔ nya a kɛ momo ɔ ya be yee.
Nɛ nɔ ko ngɔɛ wai he wui lohwe he womi tɔ momohi a mi se ke a pee ja a, wai he ɔ ma pɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔmɛ nɛ e ma pue si, nɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔmɛ hu ma puɛ.
Wai he ɔ, lohwe he womi tɔ hehi a mi a kɛ woɔ.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu nɔ ko nui wai momo nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ nɛ e hla ehe, ejakaa e deɔ ke: ‘Momo ɔ hi.’ ”
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he sane Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ko nɔ ɔ, Yesu ya gu blɛfo ngmɔhi a mi nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ sake blɛfo tso mumu ɔ nɛ a hlue nɛ a kpe.
Farisifo ɔmɛ ekomɛ bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e dɛ blɔ kaa a peɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ pee nɛ ɔ?” Nɛ Yesu ha mɛ heto ke: “Anɛ nyɛ kane we nɔ nɛ David pee, benɛ hwɔ ye lɛ kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ, bɔ nɛ e sɛ Mawu we ɔ nɛ e ya kukuɔ abolo nɛ a kɛ maa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ e dɛ blɔ kaa a yeɔ kaa ja osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛkɛ ɔ, nɛ e ye nɛ e kɛ e ko ha nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ hulɔ ɔ?” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ tete nyɔmtsɛ ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ.” Nyumu nɛ nine kake gbo ɔ Jeha nɔ, Hejɔɔmi Ligbi kpa ko hu nɔ ɔ, Yesu ya kpe he ɔ nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ni.
Nɛ nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine gbo.
Se Mlaatsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ huɔ lɛ kaa e ma tsa hiɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ lo, konɛ a na nɔ́ ko nɛ a da nɔ kɛ ya po e nyɛ.
Se Yesu le a susumi ɔmɛ nɛ e de nyumu nɛ nine gbo ɔ ke: “Tee si ba da kpɛti!” Nɛ e te si ba da si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ ko; anɛ e da blɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ kaa a peɔ kpakpa loo yayami, kaa a heɔ nɔ yiwami loo a kpataa e hɛ mi?” Nɛ e hyɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kɛ kpe, nɛ e de nyumu ɔ ke: “Kpa o nine ɔ mi!” E pee ja, nɛ a tsa e nine ɔ.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a gli nɛ a bɔni Yesu he ga tomi bɔ nɛ a maa pee lɛ ha.
Yesu hla bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ, e ba mi ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔmi kaa Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho yoku ɔ nɔ ya nɛ e ya sɔle, nɛ e fɔ nyɔ kɛ sɔle kɛ tsɛ Mawu.
Nɛ benɛ je na a, e tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ e hla a kpɛti ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ e tsɛ mɛ bɔfohi hulɔ ɔ: Simon nɔ nɛ e wo lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ, kɛ e nyɛmi Andrea; Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo; Mateo kɛ Toma; Yakobo, Alfeo bi ɔ, kɛ Simon, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Zelote (Hɛdɔlɔ) ɔ; Yuda, Yakobo nyɛmi ɔ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, nɔ nɛ ba plɛ seblɔtsɔɔlɔ ɔ. Yesu tsɔɔ ni nɛ e tsa nihi Nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ kple si kɛ ba, nɛ a ba da he ko gbajaa kɛ e kaseli asafo ɔ, kɛ nihi fuu nɛ je Yudea tsuo kɛ Yerusalem kɛ Tiro kɛ Zidon wo nya ma amɛ a mi nɛ ma lɛ tue bumi kɛ a hiɔhi a tsami ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ mɛ haoe ɔ, nɛ e tsa mɛ.
Nɛ asafo mluku ɔ tsuo ngɛ hlae nɛ a ta e he, ejakaa hewami ngɛ e mi jee kɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo tsae.
Buajɔmi kɛ kɔmɔyemi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu plɛ e hɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ e ke: “A gbaa nyɛ, ohiafo ɔmɛ; ejakaa nyɛ nɔ́ ji Mawu matsɛyemi ɔ nɛ.
“A gbaa nyɛ nihi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ nyɛ yee amlɔ nɛ ɔ; ejakaa a ma ha nyɛ maa tɔ.
“A gba nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ya foe amlɔ nɛ ɔ; ejakaa nyɛ maa muɔ.
“A gbaa nyɛ, ke nihi nyɛ nyɛ, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ po tako mi, nɛ a jɛ nyɛ, nɛ a po nyɛ biɛ mi kaa biɛ yaya ngɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ he ɔ. Nyɛ nya ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ tuu kɛ buajɔmi ejakaa oʼɛ, nyɛ hiɔwo ngɛ hiɔwe; ejakaa ja nɔuu a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee gbali ɔmɛ.
“Se nyɛ niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, musu tloo nyɛ; ejaka nyɛ na nyɛ buawomi momo.’ “Musu tloo nyɛ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ tɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ; ejakaa hwɔ maa ye nyɛ.
Musu tloo nyɛ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ muɔe amlɔ nɛ ɔ; ejakaa nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ nɛ nyɛ ma fo ya.
“Musu tloo nyɛ ke nihi tsuo tu nyɛ he munyu kpakpa a, ejakaa ja nɔuu a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee lakpa gbali ɔmɛ!” Henyɛli a suɔmi “Se nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue bue nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ henyɛli; nyɛɛ pee nihi nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ ɔ kpakpa.
Nyɛɛ gbaa nihi nɛ gbiɛɛ nyɛ; nyɛɛ sɔle ha nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi.
Nɔ nɛ ma gba o tue kake mi ma a, plɛ kake ɔ hu ngɔ ha lɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ma kpɔ o nɔ bɔ ɔ, koo nyɛ lɛ o gugue tade ɔ hu he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa mo nɔ́ ko ɔ, ha lɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ma kpɔ o nihi ɔ, ko bi lɛ hu.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nihi nɛ pee ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja nɔuu ngɔ ha mɛ.
“Nɛ ke nyɛ suɔ nihi nɛ suɔ nyɛ ɔ, mɛni sina nyɛ ngɛ?
Ejakaa yayami peeli hu suɔ nihi nɛ suɔ mɛ.
Nɛ ke nyɛ peɔ kpakpa ha nihi nɛ peɔ nyɛ kpakpa a, mɛni sina nyɛ ngɛ?
Ejakaa yayami peeli hu peɔ ja nɔuu.
Nɛ ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi pa nihi nɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa a ma ha nyɛ ekohu ɔ, mɛni sina nyɛ ngɛ?
Ejakaa yayami peeli hu kɛ nihi paa yayami peeli konɛ a na ja bɔ nɔuu.
Mohu nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ henyɛli, nɛ nyɛɛ pee kpakpa nɛ nyɛɛ pa nɛ nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ́ ko blɔ kulaa, nɛ nyɛ hiɔwo maa hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma plɛ Hiɔweno ɔ bimɛ, ejakaa e muklii mi jɔɔ haa tlumuhi kɛ nimli yayamihi.
Nyɛɛ na mɔbɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ hu naa mɔbɔ ɔ.” Kojomi yaya “Nyɛ ko kojo konɛ a ko kojo nyɛ; nyɛ ko bu fɔ, konɛ a ko bu nyɛ fɔ; nyɛ kɛ pa, nɛ a kɛ maa pa nyɛ.
Nyɛ ha, nɛ a ma ha nyɛ; susumi nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ a nyɛ nɔ nɛ a mimiɛ nɛ e hyi kɛ be nɔ nihi ma ngɔ pue nyɛ tɛ nɔ; ejakaa susumi nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ susuu ɔ, lɔɔ a maa kpale ngɔ susu ha nyɛ.” Nɛ Yesu bu mɛ abɛ ko hu ke: “Anɛ hɛyuyuilɔ ma nyɛ tsɔɔ hɛyuyuilɔ blɔ lo?
Anɛ pi muɔ mi nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo a maa ya nɔ?
Kaselɔ pa we e tsɔɔlɔ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a tsɔse lɛ kɛ pi si ɔ maa pee kaa e tsɔɔlɔ.
“Mɛ he je o naa ngu nyafii nɛ ngɛ o nyɛmi hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ, nɛ plai nɛ ngɛ mo nitse o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ lɛɛ o yo we ɔ?
Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ o ma nyɛ de o nyɛmi ke: ‘Mami, ha ma je ngu nyafii nɛ ngɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ,’ benɛ o nɛ plai nɛ ngɛ mo nitse o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ?
osatotsɛ, je plai ɔ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ kekle, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko o maa na paa nɛ o je ngu nyafii ɔ ngɛ o nyɛmi ɔ hɛngmɛ nɔ.
Tso kɛ e yiblii “Ejakaa tso kpakpa ko be nɛ woɔ yiblii yaya, nɛ jeha nɔ hu tso yaya ko hu be nɛ woɔ yiblii kpakpa.
Ejakaa tso tsuaa tso nitsɛ yiblii a kɛ leɔ lɛ: Ejakaa a la we ngmɔkɔ ngɛ zezlehi a nɔ, nɛ pohu a la we wai yiblii ngɛ mio tsohi a nɔ.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa jeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa kɛ jee e tsui mi juetli kpakpa a mi, nɛ nɔmlɔ yayami hu jeɔ nɔ́ yaya kɛ jee e tsui mi juetli yaya a mi, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ hyi nɔmlɔ tsui kɛ be nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e nya deɔ.” Tsumali enyɔ ɔ “Se mɛ he je nyɛ tsɛɛ mi: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ,’ nɛ nyɛ pee we nihi nɛ i deɔ ɔ?
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa ye ngɔ nɛ e nuɔ ye munyu ɔmɛ nɛ e yeɔ nɔ ɔ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ha: E ngɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ benɛ e maa ma tsu ɔ, e tsua si voo nɛ e to sisi ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ; nɛ benɛ pa hia a, e si tsu ɔ, se e nyɛ we lɛ nɛ e hule, mɛni he je ɔ, a to sisi ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ nuɔ nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ ma tsu ngɛ zugba hɛ mi nɛ a tui sisi; nɛ pa a si lɛ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ e hule, nɛ jamɛ a tsu ɔ hulemi ɔ kle.”
Yesu tsa Roma aslaafohi lafa a nyatsɛ ko wenyumu Benɛ Yesu tu munyu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo ma a tue mi se ɔ, e sɛ Kapernaum.
Jeha nɛ ɔ Roma aslaafohi lafa a nyatsɛ ko wenyumu nɛ e suɔ saminya ngɛ hiɔ nue nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
Nɛ benɛ e nu Yesu he ɔ, e tsɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔmahi komɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a bakpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e ba nɛ e ba tsa e wenyumu ɔ. Benɛ a ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a kpa lɛ pɛɛ wawɛɛ ke: “Nɔ nɛ o maa pee enɛ ɔ ngɔ ha a, e sa lɛ; ejakaa e suɔ wa ma a, nɛ kpe he ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ma ha wɔ.” Nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ ho.
Nɛ benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ e maa su we ɔ mi ɔ, aslaafohi lafa a nyatsɛ ɔ tsɔ e huɛmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, koo hao o he, ejakaa i sɛ nɔ nɛ o sɛɛ e kue mi; lɔ ɔ he hu nɛ i bui ye he kaa e sa mi kaa i baa o ngɔ ɔ nɛ, se mohu tu munyu kɛkɛ nɛ a ma tsa ye wenyumu ɔ. Ejakaa imi po nɛ i ji nɔmlɔ nɛ a yeɔ e nɔ ɔ, i ngɛ aslaafohi ngɛ ye sisi, nɛ ke i de nɔ nɛ ɔ ke: ‘Yaa’ a, e yaa; nɛ ke i de nɔ kpa hu ke: ‘Ba’ a, e baa; nɛ ke i de ye tsɔlɔ ke: ‘Pee enɛ ɔ’ ɔ, e peɔ.” Se benɛ Yesu nu ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa, nɛ e plɛ̃ e he nɛ e de asafo nɛ nyɛɛ e he ɔ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Israel mi tete po i nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ kle kaa enɛ ɔ lolo.” Nɛ benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba we ɔ mi ɔ, a ba na e wenyumu ɔ nɛ e na hewami.
Yesu tle yalɔyo ko bi nyumu ko si Nɛ je na nɔ ɔ, e ba mi kaa Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Nain ɔ mi ya, nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu kɛ asafo babauu kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ.
Nɛ benɛ e su ma a agbo ɔ nyɛ tã a, oʼɛ a tloo nɔ gbogboe ko kɛ ngɛ kpo jee nɛ e nyɛ bi kake pɛ ji lɛ, nɛ yalɔyo ji yo ɔ, nɛ ma a mi bihi fuu piɛ e he.
Nɛ benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na lɛ ɔ, e mi mi sa lɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e de lɛ ke “Ko fo ya!” Nɛ e ba nɛ e ba pɛtɛ daka a he nɛ nihi nɛ tloo ɔ da si.
Nɛ Yesu ke: “Niheyo, i ngɛ mo de ke: Tee si!” Nɛ nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ te si hi si, nɛ e bɔni munyu tumi; nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ha e nyɛ.
Nɛ gbeye nu mɛ tsuo, nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ke: “Gbalɔ kpetekpleenyɛ te si ngɛ wa kpɛti, nɛ Mawu ba slaa e ma a.” Nɛ Yesu he sane nɔ jije ngɛ Yudea kɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi tsuo.
Tsɔli nɛ je Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ ngɔ ɔ Nɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ya sɛɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ha lɛ, nɛ Yohane tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ, nɛ e tsɔ mɛ Yesu ngɔ ke: “Mo ji nɔ nɛ ma a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ?” Se benɛ nyumu ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a ke: “Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ tsɔ wɔ o ngɔ ke: ‘Anɛ mo ji nɔ nɛ ma a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ’ ” Lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu ɔ, e tsa nihi fuu a hiɔhi kɛ a hehiamihi kɛ mumi yayamihi, nɛ nihi fuu hu nɛ hɛ̃ yu ɔ, e ha a hyɛ nɔ.
Nɛ Yesu ha tsɔli ɔmɛ heto ke: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya sɛɛ ha Yohane nihi nɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ, kaa hɛyuyuili ngɛ nɔ hyɛe, nihi nɛ hule ngɛ nyɛɛe, tsitsɛmɛ a he ngɛ tsɔe, tuekpokuli ngɛ nɔ nuɛ, ni gbogboehi ngɛ si tee, nɛ a ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ ngɛ ohiafohi tsɔɔe; nɛ a gbaa nɔ nɛ ye he sane be e nane kpatae ɔ. Benɛ Yohane tsɔli ɔmɛ je se ɔ, Yesu bɔni Yohane he munyu tumi kɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsɔɔmi ke: “Mɛni nyɛ je kpo ya hyɛ ngɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ?
Glã nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ mimiɛe lo?
Aloo mɛni hyɛmi ya nyɛ ho?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ woɔ tade bɔdɔɔ?
oʼɛ, nihi nɛ woɔ tade nɛ ngɛ fɛo nɛ a yeɔ ni kpakpahi ɔ, matsɛmɛ a wehi a mi a hii Aloo mɛni hyɛmi ya nyɛ ho?
Gbalɔ lo?
Ee, i ngɛ nyɛ de ke, nɔ nɛ pa gbalɔ tete.
Nɔ nɛ ɔ he ji bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ ke: ‘Oʼɛ i ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ tsɔe kɛ sɛ o hlami, nɔ nɛ ma dla o blɔ ɔ ngɔ to mo ɔ.’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nihi nɛ yihi fɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, gbalɔ ko be nɛ pã Yohane; se nɔ nɛ ji nyafii ngɛ Mawu matsɛyemi ɔ mi ɔ pã lɛ.” Nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ nu ɔ kɛ onia tsuli ɔmɛ bu Mawu bemi akɛnɛ a kɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ baptisimi ɔ baptisi mɛ ɔ.
Se Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ mlaatsɔɔli ɔmɛ kua Mawu yi mi tomi nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ a he ɔ, akɛnɛ a ha we nɛ Yohane nɛ baptisi mɛ ɔ.
“Jeha nɛ ɔ mɛni he ma ngɔ kikɛmɛ a yinɔbi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to mɔ, nɛ a ngɛ kaa mɛni?
A ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi nɛ hii si ngɛ jua nɔ, nɛ a ngɛ a sibi tsɛe ngɛ dee ke: ‘Wa kpã bɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ dui; wa je ya ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ fo we.’ Ejakaa Yohane, baptisilɔ ɔ ba, nɛ e yi abolo, nɛ e nui wai, nɛ nyɛ ke: ‘Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi.’ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba nɛ e yeɔ ni nɛ e nuu nɔ́ ko, nɛ nyɛ ke: ‘Oʼɛ, nyumu jiklɔɔtsɛ kɛ danulɔ, onia tsuli kɛ yayami peeli a huɛ;’ Nɛ a bu Mawu ni lemi ɔ bemi ngɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.” Yesu ngɛ Simon Farisifono ɔ we ɔ mi Nɛ Farisifono ko tsɛ lɛ konɛ e kɛ lɛ ba ye ni.
Nɛ e ya Farisifono ɔ we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ niyeni ɔ he.
Nɛ oʼɛ, yo ko nɛ ji yayami peelɔ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, benɛ e na le kaa e ngɛ ni yee ngɛ Farisifono ɔ we ɔ mi ɔ, e hɛɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ e mi tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ba.
Nɛ e ba da Yesu nane he ngɛ e se je, nɛ e fo ya, nɛ vo nyu ɔ pue e nane ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu, nɛ e fiɔ e nane ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a kpa he.
Se benɛ Farisifono ɔ nɛ tsɛ Yesu ni yemi ɔ na a, e de ngɛ e mi ke: “Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ gbalɔ ji lɛ jinɛ e maa le nɔ́ nɔmlɔ kɛ nɔ́ yo nɛ ngɛ e he tae nɛ ɔ kaa yayami peelɔ ji lɛ.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Simon, i ngɛ sane ko nɛ ma de mo.” Nɛ Simon ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, de!” “Ni fliilɔ ko ngɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ enyɔ; nɔ kake hɛɛ lɛ cedi lafa enuɔ, nɛ nɔ kake hu nyingmi enuɔ.
Se akɛnɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ maa wo ɔ, e ngɔ ke mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo.
A ti mɛnɔ lɛ maa suɔ lɛ wawɛɛ?” Simon ha heto ke: “I susu kaa nɔ nɛ e ngɔ fuu ngɔ ke ɔ.” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “O bua he saminya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e plɛ e hɛ mi ha yo ɔ, nɛ e de Simon ke: “O ngɛ kikɛmɛ a yo nɛ ɔ hyɛe?
I ba sɛ o we ɔ mi nɛ ɔ, o hi mi nyu nɛ ma kɛ fɔ ye nane he, se yo nɛ ɔ kɛ vo nyu fɔ ye nane he, nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu.
Ye nya hu o fiɔ we he; se kikɛmɛ a yo nɛ ɔ, kɛ je nɛ i ba nɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ ɔ ɔ, e jɔɔ we ye nane he fiɔmi.
Nu hu o kɛ kpa we ye yi mi; se kikɛmɛ a yo nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ kpa ye nane he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo dee ke: E he yayamihi nɛ hiɛ ɔ, a kɛ pa lɛ, ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ kle, se nɔ nɛ a ngɔ nyafii ngɔ pa a, e suɔmi ɔ klee we.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de yo ɔ ke: “A ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ hii si ngɛ niyemi ɔ si ɔ bɔni demi ngɛ a yi mi ke: “Mɛnɔ po ji nɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɔɔ yayami ngɔ paa nɛ ɔ?” Se Yesu de yo ɔ ke: “O hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he o yiwami, yaa ngɛ hejɔmi mi!”
Yihi nɛ kɛ Yesu nyɛɛ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ya kpa mahi kɛ kɔpehi a mi nɛ e fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he Sane Kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi; nɛ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ piɛ e he, kɛ yi komɛ hu nɛ a hia a mumi yayamihi nɛ a tsa a hiɔhi: Maria, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Magdalena, nɔ nɛ mumi yayami kpaago je e mi ɔ, kɛ Yohana, Herode tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma Kusa yo ɔ, kɛ Susana, kɛ ni kpahi fuu nɛ kɛ a nihi sɔmɔɔ mɛ ɔ. Nidulɔ ɔ he abɛ ɔ Benɛ asafo babauu ba bua a he nya nɛ nihi nɛ je ma slɔɔtohi a nɔ ɔ hu ba e ngɔ ɔ, e bu mɛ abɛ ke: “Nidulɔ ko pue nɔ kɛ ho e wuhi fiami ya.
Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ wu ɔmɛ fiae ɔ, eko ya nɔ blɔ tue nɛ a naa nɔ, nɛ hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba ba kukuɔ.
Eko ya nɔ tɛ sa nɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɛ e puɛ ɔ, e ngla ejakaa e nɛ zugba jɔjɔɛ.
Nɛ eko ya nɔ miohi a kpɛti, nɛ mio ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ puɛ nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Nɛ eko hu ya nɔ zugba kpakpa nɔ, nɛ e puɛ, nɛ e wo yiblii totoe lafa.” Benɛ e de ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e wo e gbi nɔ nɛ e de ke: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue nɛ e kɛ maa nu ɔ, e nu.” Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ Yesu bu abɛhi Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke: “Kɛ ji abɛ nɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?” E de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ a ha nyɛ he blɔ kaa nyɛɛ le Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi laami sane ɔmɛ, se ni kpa amɛ lɛɛ ngɛ abɛhi a mi, konɛ a hyɛ, se a ko na, nɛ a nu, se a ko nu sisi.” Yesu tsɔɔ nidulɔ ɔ he abɛ ɔ sisi Jeha nɛ ɔ abɛ ɔ sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Wu ɔ ji Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ.
Nihi nɛ ya nɔ blɔ tue ɔ ji ninɛmɛ nɛ nuɔ munyu ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ abosiami baa ba saa munyu ɔ ngɛ a tsui mi konɛ a ko he ye nɛ a he a yiwami.
Nihi nɛ ya nɔ tɛ sa nɔ ɔ ji nihi nɛ benɛ a nu ɔ, a heɔ munyu ɔ kɛ buajɔmi, se akɛnɛ a be sipoku he je ɔ a heɔ yeɔ be kpiti kɛkɛ, nɛ ka be mi ɔ a kuaa a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ. Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ miohi a kpɛti ɔ ji nihi nɛ benɛ a nu ɔ, a yaa, se je nɛ ɔ mi he nya gbamihi kɛ ni namihi kɛ je mi ngɔmi yemi gbee mɛ nɛ a wui yiblii nɛ hi kɛ pi si.
Se zugba kpakpa mi nɔ́ ɔ ji nihi nɛ benɛ a nu munyu ɔ, a kɛ toɔ tsui kpakpa mi, nɛ a kɛ tsui si tomi hɛɛ mi nɛ a woɔ yiblii.” Kane nɛ a kɛ ma sowe sisi “Nɔ ko su we kane nɛ e kɛ sowe bu nɔ aloo nɛ e kɛ ma sa tso sisi; se mohu kane tso nɔ e kɛ maa konɛ nihi nɛ ma a nɛ na la a. Ejakaa nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ laa nɛ a be kpo jee, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu nɔ́ ko be nɛ a bu nɔ nɛ a be lee nɛ a be nya blie.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi ngɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue ɔ he; ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, a ma ha lɛ; se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ, a ma kpɔ nɔ́ nɛ e peɔ lɛ kaa e ngɛ ɔ tete ngɛ e dɛ.” Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba, se asafo ɔ he ɔ a nyɛ we nɛ a su e he.
Nɛ a de lɛ ke: “O nyɛ kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ se ngɛ hlae nɛ a na mo.” Se e ha mɛ heto ke: “Ye nyɛ kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ji ninɛmɛ nɛ nuɔ Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ a yeɔ nɔ!” Yesu jɔɔ Wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ ngua ko he Ligbi ko ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya sɛ lɛ mi nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ha waa ya taku ɔ se je;” kɛkɛ nɛ a je wo.
Benɛ a yaa a, mahɛ nɔ e nɔ.
Wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ ngua ko ba fia ngɛ taku ɔ hɛ mi nɛ a lɛ ɔ hyi kɛ nyu nɛ a sɛ haomi mi.
Nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba tsɛ̃ɛ lɛ nɛ a ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ, wa yi tã tã.” Se nɛ e hɛ tsɛ ɔ, e nga kɔɔhiɔ kɛ wo nɛ gli ɔ yi, nɛ a he jɔ, nɛ a ngmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Jije nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ?” Nɛ a ye gbeye nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa nɛ a de a he ke: “Mɛni nɔmlɔ slɔɔto ko po je nɛ ɔ nɛ e ngaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛ nyu tete yi nɛ a buɔ lɛ tue nɛ ɔ?” Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ e mi A ba su Gergesebi ɔmɛ a zugba nɛ ngɛ Galilea hanɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ benɛ e ba kple ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ e mi nɛ je ma a mi kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
Nɛ e wui tade gblee, nɛ e hi we mi ja yɔkɔhi a mi kɛkɛ.
Nɛ be nɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ gbi wawɛɛ de ke: “Mɛni sane i kɛ mo ngɛ, mo Yesu, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ bi?
I kpa mo pɛɛ ko pii mi!” Ejakaa Yesu nga mumi yayami ɔ yi ke e je nyumu ɔ mi.
E nuu lɛ kpitikpiti, nɛ a woɔ lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔhi nɛ a kaa lɛ pã kɛ tsiɔ e nya, se etsɔɔ nihi nɛ a kɛ woɔ lɛ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ mumi yayami ɔ kpakaa lɛ kɛ yaa nga a mi.
Yesu bi lɛ ke: “Kɛ a tsɛɛ mo kɛɛ?” Nɛ e ke: “Asafo;” ejakaa mumi yayamihi fuu lɛ a ngɛ ye mi ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e ko hia mɛ nɛ e ha a ya sɛ muɔ voo ɔ mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ kpotoo asafo kuu ngua ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ ni yee ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ; nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a ya sɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a mi.
Nɛ e ngmɛ mɛ blɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mumi yayami ɔmɛ je nyumu ɔ mi, nɛ a ya sɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ mɛ kuu mluku ɔ tsuo wo fo kɛ kple yoku ɔ kɛ ya pue taku ɔ mi nɛ a gbo.
Nɛ benɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ hyɛe ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ, a tu fo nɛ a ya sɛ̃ɛ ngɛ ma a kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ je kpo kɛ ho nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ hyɛmi ya; nɛ a ba Yesu ngɔ nɛ a ba na nyumu nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ je e mi ɔ nɛ e hii si ngɛ Yesu nane nya nɛ e wo tade, nɛ e hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ, nɛ a ye gbeye.
Nɛ nihi nɛ na a hu sɛ̃ɛ mɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a tsa nɔ nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ e mi ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Gergesebi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi ɔ tsuo ba ba kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e je a ngɔ nɛ e ho, ejakaa gbeye nu mɛ nitsɛnitsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e ya sɛ lɛ ɔ mi kɛ kpale e se.
Nyumu ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ je e mi ɔ kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si.
Se Yesu wo lɛ blɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Kpale o se kɛ ho o we mi ya, nɛ o ya sɛ̃ɛ ni nguahi nɛ Mawu pee ha mo ɔ.” Nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya fiɛ ni nguahi nɛ Yesu pee ha lɛ ɔ ngɛ ma a mi tsuo.
Yairo bi yo ɔ kɛ yo nɛ ta Yesu tade he ɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu kpale e se kɛ ba a, asafo ɔ nya e he, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ lɛ mlɛe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ oʼɛ, nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yairo nɛ ji kpe he nɔkɔtɔma a ba nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya nɛ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ konɛ e ba e we ɔ mi, ejakaa e ngɛ biyo kaketoo pɛ nɛ ye maa pee jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ e miɔ nɛ ma gbo.
Benɛ Yesu yaa a, asafo ɔ tɔtɔ lɛ.
Nɛ yo ko nɛ muɔ ngɛ dɛe ngɛ e he jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ e puɛ e nihi tsuo kulaa kɛ ha tsopatsɛmɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we lɛ nɛ e tsa a, ba je Yesu se je nɛ e ta e tade nya fiami ɔ he, nɛ amlɔ ɔ e muɔ dɛmi ɔ se po.
Yesu bi ke: “Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ ta ye he ɔ?” Benɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo kua a, Petro kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ke: “Mawetsɛ, asafo ɔ tɔtɔ mo nɛ a ngɛ mo miae, nɛ o ngɛ bie ke: ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ ta ye he ɔ” Se Yesu ke: “Nɔ ko ta ye he, ejakaa i nu he kaa hewami ko je ye mi.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ benɛ yo ɔ na kaa e hi lɛ laami hu ɔ, e kɛ hedomi ba ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e ba jaje nɔ́ he je nɛ e ta e he ɔ kɛ bɔ nɛ e he wa lɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ. Yesu de lɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ kulaa hɛ mi ke: “Biyo, o tsui nɛ nɔ o mi, o hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo; yaa ngɛ hejɔmi mi!” Benɛ Yesu ngɛ munyu ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko je kpe he nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi ba de lɛ ke: “O biyo ɔ gbo; koo doo tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nya.” Se benɛ Yesu nu ɔ, e he nɔ ke: “Koo ye gbeye; he ye kɛkɛ nɛ e yi ma na wa.” Nɛ benɛ Yesu ba we ɔ mi ɔ, e ngmɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko blɔ nɛ e sɛ tsu ɔ mi kaa ja Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo kɛ jokuɛ ɔ tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ pɛ.
Nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ ya foe nɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
Se Yesu ke: “Nyɛ ko fo ya; e gbo we, se mahɛ e ngɛ hwɔe.” Nɛ a muɔ lɛ, ejakaa a le kaa e gbo.
Se Yesu nu e nine si nɛ e tsɛ lɛ ke: “Jokuɛyo, tee si!” Nɛ jokuɛ ɔ mumi ɔ kpale ba e mi ekohu, nɛ e te si amlɔ ɔ nɔuu; nɛ Yesu fa ke a ha jokuɛ ɔ nɔ ko nɛ e ye.
E fɔli ɔmɛ a nya kpɛ a he; se Yesu wo mɛ si veveeve ke a ko sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ ngɔ ha nɔ ko.
Yesu tsɔ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu tsɛ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ kpe nɛ e ha mɛ hewami kɛ he blɔ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ tsuo nɔ, nɛ a tsa hiɔhi hulɔ.
Nɛ e tsɔ mɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ fiɛmi kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ a tsami E de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ko hɛɛ nɔ́ ko kɛ ha nyɛ blɔhiami ɔ, nyɛ ko hɛɛ dɛ hɛɛmi tso loo kotoku loo abolo loo sika loo tade enyɔ.
We tsuaa we mi nɛ nyɛ ma ya sɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa su nyɛ maa je.
Nihi abɔ nɛ he we nyɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ maa je jamɛ a ma a mi ɔ, nyɛ blɛ nyɛ nane si zu ɔ kɛ ye mɛ odase.” Nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya kpa ma amɛ a mi ya fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a nɛ a tsa nihi ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Herode pee yoyooyo Amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma Herode nu nihi nɛ a pee ɔmɛ tsuo he, nɛ e pee yoyooyo, ejakaa ni komɛ de ke Yohane te si kɛ je gbeje.
Ni komɛ hu de ke Elia je e he kpo, nɛ ni kpa komɛ hu de ke blema gbali ɔmɛ eko te si ekohu.
Se Herode ke: “Yohane ɔ, i po e yi; se mɛnɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ nue ngɛ e he nɛ ɔ?” Nɛ e hla kaa e na lɛ.
Yesu ha ni akpe enuɔ niyeni Nɛ benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba a, a ba sɛɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a ya pee ɔ ngɔ ha Yesu.
Nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho nga a nɔ he ko banee ya ngɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Betsaida a kasa nya Se benɛ asafo ɔ na lɛ ɔ, a bu e nɔ.
E he mɛ hɛmuɔ nɛ e fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ e tsa nihi nɛ tsami he hia mɛ ɔ. Benɛ je bɔni jɔmi ɔ, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke: “Wo asafo ɔ blɔ konɛ a ya ma amɛ kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle wɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a mi nɛ a ya to lejɛ ɔ nɛ a na niyeni ejakaa nga mi wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Se Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ha mɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye.” Se a ke: “Abolo enuɔ kɛ lo enyɔ pɛ wa ngɛ, lɛɛ ja wa ya nɛ wa ya he niyeni ba ha asafo nɛ ɔ tsuo.” (Ejakaa ni ɔmɛ a yibɔ maa pee nyumuhi akpe enuɔ).
E de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ ha nɛ a hi si kutuu kutuu nyingmi enuɔ enuɔ nya.” A pee ja nɛ a ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo hi si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kukuɔ abolo enuɔ kɛ lo enyɔ ɔ nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe nɛ e gbaa nɔ, nɛ e kuɔ nɛ e kɛ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ma asafo ɔ hɛ mi.
Nɛ a ye nɛ mɛ kulaa a tɔ, nɛ a kukuɔ bibli nɛ piɛ ɔ kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Petro odase nɛ e ye ngɛ Yesu he Ligbi ko benɛ Yesu nɔ kake ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ e ngɔ; nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Ni ɔmɛ deɔ ke mɛnɔ jimi?” A ha lɛ heto ke: “Yohane, baptisilɔ ɔ; nɛ ni komɛ deɔ ke: Elia; nɛ ni kpa komɛ hu deɔ ke: Blema gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko lɛ e te si ekohu.” Nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ deɔ ke mɛnɔ ji mi?” Petro he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Mawu we Kristo ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bɔ mɛ kkɔ ke a ko wo nɔ ta ngɔ de nɔ ko.
Yesu tu e manehlu kɛ e gbenɔ he munyu Nɛ Yesu ke: “Ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ na amanehlu babauu, nɛ ma mikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaatsɔɔli ɔmɛ kua lɛ, nɛ a gbe lɛ, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si ekohu.” Nɛ e de ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke: “Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e kua e he nɛ e wo e seumi tso ɔ ngɔ tloo daa ligbi kɛ nyɛɛ ye se.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ laa e klaa ngɛ ye he ɔ, e ma he e yiwami.
Ejakaa mɛni se nɔmlɔ naa, ke e na je mluku ɔ tsuo, se e laa lɛ nitsɛ e he aloo e sake e he ngɔ fɔ he ɔ?
