Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ imi kɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ a he peɔ lɛ zo ɔ, lɛ hu e he maa pee Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ zo benɛ e maa ba ngɛ lɛ nitse e nyami ɔ kɛ e tsɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ mi ɔ.
Se niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: ni komɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ a kpɛti nɛ a be gboe kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa na Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ.” Yesu nɔmlɔ tso su tsake E ba mi kaa munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a se maa pee ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, Yesu ngɔ Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho sɔlemi ya ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, e hɛ mi tsake nɛ e tade ɔ hiɛ futaa nɛ e ngɛ kpee klaiklai.
Nɛ oʼɛ, nyumuhi enyɔ kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu, mɛ ji Mose kɛ Elia, nihi nɛ ba je a he kpo ngɛ hɛ hii nyami mi nɛ a kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ e je mi nya nɛ e ma ya gbe ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ he ɔ.
Se mahɛ gbe Petro kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ; nɛ benɛ a hɛ tsɛ kulaa a, a na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ nyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a. Nɛ benɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ Yesu sie ɔ, Petro de Yesu ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, e hi kaa waa hi hiɛ ɔ, nɛ ha nɛ waa ma bo tsu etɛ, o nɔ kake kɛ Mose nɔ kake kɛ Elia nɔ kake;” se e li nɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ. Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ dee ɔ, bɔku ko ba ha a nɔ; nɛ benɛ a sɛ bɔku ɔ mi ɔ, a ye gbeye.
Nɛ gbi ko je bɔku ɔ mi de ke: “Ye suɔmi bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue!” Benɛ a nu gbi ɔ se ɔ, Yesu nɔ kake pɛ a na.
Nɛ a ma a nya, nɛ jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ a sɛɛ we nihi nɛ a na a eko ha we nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Yesu tsa jokuɛ nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi Nɛ e ba mi kaa e nɔ je na benɛ a je yoku ɔ nɔ kɛ ngɛ si kplee ɔ, nihi fuu kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
Nɛ oʼɛ, nyumu ko je ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti kpa ngmlaa ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, hyɛ ye bi ɔ, se lɛ pɛ ji ye bi.
Oʼɛ, mumi ko nuu lɛ nɛ e kpaa ngmlaa tlukaa, nɛ e haa e huaa gɛgɛnii, nɛ e nya fiaa hwɔli, nɛ e gbɔnyɔɔ lɛ hluu loko e jee e mi.
I kpa o kaseli ɔmɛ pɛɛ ke a hia lɛ, se a nyɛ we.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e ke: ‘Oo yi nɔ bihi nɛ he we yi nɛ be a jebo nɔ!
Mɛni be i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si nɛ ma hɛɛ nyɛ kɛ ya su?
O kɛ o bi ɔ nɛ ba hiɛ ɔ!” Se benɛ jokuɛ ɔ ma a, mumi yayami ɔ po lɛ fɔ̃ si nɛ e ha e hua.
Se Yesu nga mumi ɔ yi, nɛ e tsa jokuɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha e tsɛ ɔ ekohu.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he ngɛ Mawu he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ he.
Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu ekohu Se benɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa ngɛ nihi tsu nɛ Yesu pee ɔ he ɔ, e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ha kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ sɛ nyɛ tue mi, ejakaa a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ wo nimli a dɛ mi.” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a nɛ́ munyu nɛ ɔ nya, nɛ a kɛ laa mɛ konɛ a ko nu sisi, nɛ a ngɛ gbeye yee kaa a ma bi lɛ munyu ɔ he nɔ ko.
Mɛnɔ ji nɔ ngua pe kulaa?
Nɛ nya sami ko ba te si ngɛ a kpɛti kaa mɛnɔ ji nɔ ngua pe kulaa ngɛ a kpɛti.
Se benɛ Yesu na le a tsui mi susumi ɔ, e ngɔ jokuɛ nyafii ko nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba da e kasa nya; nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ jokuɛ nyafii nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e ngɔ mi; nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɔ mi ɔ, e ngɔɔ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ ji nyafii ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, lɛ nɔuu ji nɔ ngua.” Nɔ nɛ ti si wui nyɛ ɔ, e piɛ nyɛ he Yohane he nɔ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa na nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ o biɛ ngɛ mumi yayami hiae, nɛ wa tsi lɛ blɔ, ejakaa e kɛ wɔ nyɛɛ we o se.” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Nyɛ ko tsi lɛ blɔ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ ti si wui nyɛ ɔ, e ngɛ nyɛ blɔfami.” Samaria kɔpe ko kua Yesu Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ ligbi nɛ a maa ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho hiɔwe ya su ta a, e ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ pi Yerusalem nɛ e yaa lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ e tsɔ tsɔli kɛ sɛ e hlami; nɛ a ya sɛ Samariabi a ma ko mi konɛ a ya dla he ko ngɔ to lɛ.
Se a he we lɛ, ejakaa a na ngɛ e hɛ mi kaa e yaa Yerusalem.
Nɛ benɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ na enɛ ɔ ɔ, a ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, o suɔ kaa wa de nɛ la nɛ je hiɔwe ba sa mɛ lo?” Se Yesu plɛ e he nɛ e ka a hɛ mi, nɛ a ho ma kpa ko mi ya.
Yesu senyɛɛmi Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ a yaa ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko ba de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ma nyɛɛ o se kɛ maa ya he tsuaa he nɛ oyaa.” Se Yesu de lɛ ke: “Kɔkɔbohi ngɛ muɔhi, nɛ hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ hu ngɛ tsuhi, se Nɔmlɔ Bi o lɛɛ e be he nɛ e kɛ e yi fɔɔ.” Nɛ e de nɔ kpa ke: “Nyɛɛ ye se!” Se lɛɛ e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ngmɛɛ mi blɔ nɛ ma ya ya pu tsaatsɛ lolo.” Se Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ha nɛ ni gbogboehi nɛ pu a ni gbogboehi se mo lɛɛ yaa nɛ o ya fiɛ Mawu matsɛyemi ɔ!” Nɛ nɔ kpa hu ke: “Ma nyɛɛ o se, Nyɔmtsɛ, se ngmɛɛ mi blɔ nɛ ma ya ya sɛ ye weli lolo.” Se Yesu de lɛ ke: “Nɔ nɛ kɛ e nine pɛtɛɛ na kpakplaa he nɛ e plɛɛ e kuɛ hyɛɛ e se ɔ, e sɛ́ Mawu matsɛyemi ɔ.”
Yesu tsɔ ni nyingmi kpaago kɛ enyɔ Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hia ni nyingmi kpaago kɛ enyɔ kpã hu, nɛ e tsɔ mɛ enyɔenyɔ kɛ sɛ e hlami kɛ ya ma tsuaa ma nɔ kɛ he tsuaa he nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa ya a. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ni kpami ɔ hiɛ, se ni tsuli ɔmɛ pi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ kpa ni kpami Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ konɛ e tsɔ ni tsuli kɛ ya e ni kpami ɔ he.
Nyɛɛ ya!
oʼɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔe kaa to bihi ngɛ ogbeteehi a kpɛti.
Nyɛ ko hɛɛ sika kpɛɛ loo kotoku loo tokotahi, nɛ nyɛ ko nga nɔ ko ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ we tsuaa we mi nɛ nyɛ maa sɛ ɔ, kekleekle ɔ nyɛ de ke: ‘Manye nɛ ba we nɛ ɔ mi!’ Nɛ ke hejɔmi bi ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ hejɔmi ɔ maa hi e nɔ; se ke pi jã a, e maa kpale e se kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.
Nɛ nyɛɛ hi jamɛ a we ɔ mi nɔuu, nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɛ nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ a ma ha nyɛ ɔ ejakaa ni tsulɔ ɔ, e hiɔwo sa lɛ.
Nyɛ ko klɛ̃ kɛ je we mi kɛ ya we mi.
Nɛ ma tsuaa ma mi nɛ nyɛ maa sɛ nɛ a ma he nyɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ nyɛɛ ye.
Nɛ nyɛ tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ de mɛ ke: ‘Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ na nyɛ.
Se ma tsuaa ma mi nɛ nyɛ maa sɛ nɛ a he we nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ je kɛ ho gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ya nɛ nyɛ de ke: ‘Wa ngɛ nyɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi bunyuku tete nɛ ngɛ wa nanehi a he ɔ blɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ puee; se kɛ ɔ nyɛ na le kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ na nyɛ.’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e maa fani Sodom tete ngɛ jamɛ a ma a he.” Mahi nɛ he we yi ɔ “Musu tloo mo, Korazin!
Musu tloo mo, Betsaida!
Ejakaa kaa hewami ni tsumihi nɛ a tsu ngɛ nyɛ mi nɛ ɔ, Tiro kɛ Zidon a tsu ngɛ jinɛ a hii si ngɛ kpekpe kɛ lazu mi nɛ a tsake a tsui momoomo.
Se kojomi ɔ mi ɔ, e maa fani Tiro kɛ Zidon ngɛ nyɛ he!
Nɛ mo, Kapernaum, pi hiɔwe nɛ a wo o nɔ kɛ ho?
A maa ba mo si kɛ maa ya gbeje lokoo!
“Nɔ nɛ buɔ nyɛ tue ɔ, imi tue e buɔ ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ kuaa nyɛ ɔ, imi e kuaa a nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ kuaa mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ e kuaa a nɛ.” Ni nyingmi kpaago kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a sekpalemi Ni nyingmi kpaago kɛ enyɔ ɔ kpale a se kɛ ba kɛ buajɔmi nɛ a ba de ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, o biɛ ɔ he ɔ mumi yayamihi tete baa a he si haa wɔ.” Se e de mɛ ke: “I na Satan kaa oslaba nɛ tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ si.
Oʼɛ, i ha nyɛ he blɔ nɛ nyɛɛ naa sinɔhi kɛ nyingmogblakotohi kɛ henyɛlɔ ɔ hewami ɔ kulaa nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛ yayami pee.
Se kɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko na enɛ ɔ he buajɔmi kaa mumi ɔmɛ baa a he si ngɔ haa nyɛ ɔ, se mohu nyɛ na buajɔmi kaa a ngma nyɛ biɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.” Yesu bua jɔ Jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu bua jɔ ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi nɛ e ke: “I ngɛ o yi jee, Tsaatsɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ laa ni leli kɛ ga leli, nɛ o je ngɔ tsɔɔ bimwɔwi.
Ee, Tsaatsɛ, ejakaa jã ji bɔ nɛ sa o hɛ mi.
“Tsaatsɛ tu nihi tsuo kulaa ngɔ wo ye dɛ, nɛ nɔ ko li nɔ nɛ ji Bi ɔ, ja Tsɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ, ja Bi ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ Bi ɔ suɔ kaa e je lɛ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu plɛ e hɛ mi ha e kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ e de mɛ ngɛ se zaa ke: “A gbaa hɛngmɛhi nɛ naa nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ de kɛ: Gbali kɛ matsɛmɛ fuu hla kaa a ko na nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ, se a nɛ, kɛ jeha nɛ ɔ kaa a ko nu nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ se a nui.” Samariano mɔbɔnalɔ ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ mlaatsɔɔlɔ ko te si da si nɛ e tsɔ e nya kɛ bi lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni ma pee nɛ ma na neneene wami?” Se Yesu bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni a ngma ngɛ Mlaa a mi ɔ, nɛ kɛ o kaneɔ lɛ kɛɛ?” Mlaatsɔɔlɔ ɔ ha lɛ heto ke: “Suɔ Nyɔmtsɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ je o tsui kulaa, kɛ o klaa kulaa, kɛ o hewami kulaa, kɛ o juɛmi kulaa mi, kɛ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ hu kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Bɔ nɛ o ha heto ɔ da, pee ja nɛ o yi ma na wami.” Se mlaatsɔɔlɔ ɔ, akɛnɛ e ngɛ hlae nɛ e bu e he bemi he je ɔ, e bi Yesu ke: Mɛnɔ ji mami?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Nyumu ko pue nɔ kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ yaa Yeriko nɛ e ya nɔ ojo fiali komɛ a kpɛti.
A kpɔ e he tade ɔ nɛ a plaa lɛ, nɛ a je, nɛ a si lɛ nɛ e gbo fã kɛ fã.
E ba mi kaa osɔfo ko ba gu lɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ; nɛ benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e tsɔ e he kɛ be.
Nɛ ja nɔuu Levino ko hu, benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ nɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e tsɔ e he kɛ be.
Se Samariano ko nɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ba su he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e muklii mi sa lɛ, nɛ e ya e ngɔ, nɛ e ya fi e pa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e plɛ nu kɛ wai pue nɔ, nɛ e pa wo lɛ ngɔ hi lɛ nitsɛ e lohwe nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya nibwɔhi a to he nɛ e ya hyɛ e nɔ.
Nɛ e nɔ je na, benɛ e yaa a, e je cedi enyɔ ngɔ ha nibwɔhi a tohetsɛ ɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Hyɛ lɛ saminya, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma pa puɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, ke i kpale ye se kɛ ba a, ma wo mo hiɔ.’ Jeha nɛ ɔ, ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti mɛnɔ o susu kaa e pee nɔ nɛ ya nɔ ojo fiali a kpɛti nɔ huɛ?” E ha heto ke: “Nɔ nɛ na lɛ mɔbɔ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Mo hu yaa nɛ o ya pee ja nɔuu.” Yesu ya slaa Marta ke Maria E ba mi kaa benɛ a yaa a, Yesu ya sɛ kɔpe ko mi.
Nɛ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marta a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho e we mi ya.
Marta ngɛ nyɛmi yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Maria, nɛ lɛ hu e ba hi si ngɛ Yesu nane nya nɛ e bu e munyu ɔ tue.
Se Marta hao e he fuu tsɔ ngɛ sɔmɔmi babauu he, nɛ e ba Yesu ngɔ ba de ke: “Mawetsɛ, o nɛ́ kaa mami ɔ si mi nɛ ye nɔ kake i ngɛ sɔmɔe nɛ ɔ?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ de lɛ nɛ lɛ hu e ba piɛ ye he.” Se Yesu ha heto nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Marta, Marta, o ngɛ o he nya gbae nɛ o ngɛ o he haoe ngɛ nihi fuu he; se nɔ́ kake lɛ he hia.
Nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ lɔ ɔ Maria ngɔ ɔ nɛ, nɛ a be kpɔe ngɛ e dɛ.”
Yesu nitsɔɔmi ngɛ sɔlemi he Ligbi ko ɔ, Yesu ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ he ko, nɛ benɛ e gbe nya a, e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, tsɔɔ wɔ sɔlemi, kaa bɔ nɛ Yohane hu tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ ɔ.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ nyɛ de ke: ‘Tsaatsɛ, O biɛ ɔ he nɛ tsɔ; O matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ ba.
Ha wɔ wa daa ligbi ngma.
Nɛ o kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ nɛ pa wɔ, Ejakaa wɔ hu waa kɛ paa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tɔ́ɔ wa nɔ ɔ. Nɛ o kɛ wɔ ko ya ka mi.’ ” Nɛ ɛ de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ kpɛti mɛnɔ nɛ ngɛ huɛ nɛ e maa ya e ngɔ nyɔ mi kpɛti nɛ e ma ya de lɛ ke: ‘Ye huɛ, paa mi abolo etɛ, ejakaa ye huɛ ko nɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ba to mi, nɛ i be nɔ ko nɛ i kɛ maa ma e hɛ mi;’ nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ be nɔ hee ke: ‘Koo doo ye nya, a nga sinya a mo, nɛ imi kɛ ye bimɛ sɛ sa mi; i be nyɛe si ma te nɛ ma ba ha mo.’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke ka e huɛ nɛ ji lɛ ɔ he jinɛ e be si tee nɛ e ha lɛ, se e nya doomi ɔ he ɔ, e maa te si kɛ̃, nɛ e ma ha lɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hlae.
Nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛ bi, nɛ a ma ha nyɛ; nyɛ hla, nɛ nyɛ maa na; nyɛ si, nɛ a ma bli ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ biɔ ɔ, e nine suu nɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ hlaa a, e naa; nɛ nɔ nɛ siɔ ɔ, a bliɔ haa lɛ.
Se tsɛ te nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛɛ, nɛ ke e bi bi lɛ abolo, nɛ e ma ha lɛ tɛ?
Aloo ke e bi lɛ lo ɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ sinɔ ngɔ pee lo ngɔ ha lɛ?
Aloo ke e bi lɛ kungwɔ hlui ɔ, nɛ e ma ha lɛ nyingmogblakoto?
Lɛɛ ke nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ji nimli yayamihi ɔ, nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ peɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nike ni kpakpahi kee nyɛ bimɛ ɔ, nyɛmɛ nɔuu nɛ nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ be Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔe ha nihi nɛ biɔ lɛ ɔ?” Yesu kɛ Beelzebul Nɛ Yesu ngɛ mumi yayami ko nɛ ji amuɛti hiae, nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ mumi yayami ɔ je kpo ɔ amuɛti ɔ tu munyu, nɛ ni ɔmɛ a nya kpɛ a he.
Se a ti ni komɛ de ke: “Beelzebul, mumi yayami ɔmɛ a tsɛ ɔ he wami nya e hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ ni komɛ hu ka lɛ kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe okadi ko hlae ngɛ e dɛ.
Se, akɛnɛ Yesu le a juɛmi ɔmɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke: “Ma tsuaa ma nɛ gbaa woɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ, e ywiaa, nɛ we nɛ gbaa woɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ, e ywiaa.
Nɛ ke Satan hu gba wo lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa da si?
Ejakaa nyɛ ke Beelzebul he wami nya i hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se ke imi lɛɛ, Beelzebul he wami i kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ hiaa mɛ?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mɛ nɔuu lɛ a maa kojo nyɛ.
Se ke Mawu nine nguɛ i kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ su nyɛ ngɔ.
“Ke hewalɔ ko hɛɛ e dade mi kɛ ngɛ e mɔ he bue ɔ, e nihi tsuo kulaa ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; se ke nɔ nɛ he wa pe lɛ ba tua lɛ nɛ e ye e nɔ kunimi ɔ, e kpɔɔ e ta hwumi nihi nɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ fɔɔ nɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e dlaa e ta yibu ni ɔmɛ a mi.
“Nɔ nɛ be ye blɔfami ɔ, e kɛ mi na, nɛ nɔ nɛ kɛ mi bua we nya a, e ngɛ gbee kɛ ngɛ fiae.” Mumi yayami ɔ sekpalemi “Ke mumi yayami ko je nɔmlɔ mi ɔ, e ya nyɛɛ hehi nɛ nyu be kɛ hlaa he jɔmi, nɛ ke e nɛ́ eko ɔ, e de ɔ ke: ‘Ma kpale ye se kɛ ya ye we he nɛ i je ɔ.’ Nɛ ke e ba a, e ba naa kaa a bɛɛ mi nɛ a dla mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e yaa nɛ e ya ngɔɔ mumi kpahi kpaago nɛ ji mumi yayamihi pe lɛ ngɔ piɛɔ e he nɛ a ya sɛɛ e mi nɛ a hii lejɛ ɔ, nɛ jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ sekpɛ sihihii ɔ plɛɔ yayami pe kekle nɔ ɔ.” Buajɔmi nitsɛ Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ e ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ dee ɔ, yo ko nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ wo e gbi nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “A gbaa muklii nɛ hɛɛ mo kɛ nyɔ nɛ o pupɔ ɔ!” Se Yesu he nɔ ke: “E ngɛ mi ja mohu, se a gbaa ninɛmɛ nɛ nuɔ Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ɔ!” Farisifo ɔmɛ ngɛ okadi hlae Benɛ asafo ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya fuu ɔ, Yesu bɔni demi ke: “Yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, yi nɔ bi yayamihi ʼi.
A ngɛ okadi hlae, se a be mɛ eko hae kaa ja gbalɔ Yona okadi ɔ. Ejakaa bɔ nɛ Yona plɛ okadi ha Ninivebi ɔmɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma plɛ ngɔ ha kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ.
Leneyi manye ɔ kɛ yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ maa te si ngɛ kojomi ɔ mi, nɛ e maa bu mɛ fɔ, ejaakɛ e je zugba a nyagbe he lokoo ba bu Salomo ni lemi tue; nɛ oʼɛ, nɔ́ nɛ pe Salomo ni lemi ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔji Ninivebi ɔmɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ maa te si ngɛ kojomi ɔ mi nɛ a maa bu mɛ fɔ, ejakaa a tsake a tsui ngɛ Yona fiɛmi ɔ nya; nɛ oʼɛ, nɔ́ nɛ pe Yona fiɛmi ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!” Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ la “Nɔ ko su we kane ngɔ mɛ́ kɔkɔɔ mi loo sowe sisi, se mohu kane tso nɔ e kɛ maa, konɛ nihi nɛ ma we ɔ mi sɛmi ɔ, a na e kpɛmi ɔ. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kane ji hɛngmɛ.
Ke o hɛngmɛ nɔ tsɔ ɔ, o nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ hu mi tsɔɔ; se ke o hɛngmɛ hi ɔ, o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hu woɔ diblii.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ la nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ ko plɛ diblii.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke o nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ mi tsɔ nɛ he ko he ko wui diblii ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ tsuo mi ma tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kane kɛ e kpɛmi tsoo haa mo ɔ.” Yesu kã Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ Mlaatsɔɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Yesu munyu ɔ nya gbemi pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Farisifono ko ba tsɛ lɛ ni yemi.
E ya we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ niyeni ɔ he.
Se benɛ Farisifono ɔ na kaa e fɔ we e he loko e maa ye ni ɔ, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: “Mwɔnɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ nyɛ tsuɔ kplu he kɛ kã se, se nyɛ mi hyi tɔ kɛ ju kɛ yi mi wami.
Kuasiahi!
Anɛ nɔ nɛ pee semi ɔ, pi lɛ kɛ̃ nɛ e pee mi ɔ hulɔ lo?
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ ngɔ ha ohiafohi, nɛ oʼɛ, nihi tsuo he ma tsɔ ha nyɛ.
“Se musu tloo nyɛ, Farisifohi, kaa nyɛ hãa kowɛ kɛ pui kɛ bahi slɔɔtohi tsuo mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake, nɛ nyɛ siɔ dami sane yemi kɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ!
Jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛ peɔ enɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko si ekolɔ ɔ hulɔ.
“Musu tloo nyɛ, Farisifohi, kaa nyɛ suɔ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi hehi ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ ngami ngɛ juahi a nɔ!
Musu tloo nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ kaa yɔkɔhi nɛ ji si, nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ nɔ ɔ li!” Nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, nihi nɛ o ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ ɔ, o kɛ ngɛ wɔ hu ahlua bɔe.” Yesu ke: “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ hu musu tloo nyɛ, kaa nyɛɛ kɛ tlomihi nɛ hi tloomi tloɔ nihi, se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nine nguɛ kake tɛ tlomi ɔmɛ a he.
Musu tloo nyɛ, kaa nyɛ maa gbali ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbe ɔ a pu he ɔmɛ; lɛɛ niinɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he odase yee, nɛ e ngɔ nyɛ nya ejakaa mɛ lɛ a gbe mɛ mohu, se nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa a pu he ɔmɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he nɔuu nɛ Mawu ni lemi ɔ de ke: ‘Ma tsɔ gbali kɛ bɔfohi kɛ ya a ngɔ, nɛ a maa gbe a ti ni komɛ, nɛ a maa wa a ti ni komɛ yi mi, ʼɔ nɛ, konɛ gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ tsuo nɛ a pue si kɛ je je mi sisije ɔ, a bi si ngɛ yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ’ kɛ je Habel muɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya su Zakaria, nɔ nɛ a gbe ngɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ kɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ kpɛti ɔ muɔ ɔ nɔ.
Ee, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a ma bi si ngɛ yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ!
“Musu tloo nyɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli, ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ ni lemi ɔ nya safe ɔ kɛ je!
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ nyɛ sɛ we mi, nɛ nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa sɛ mi ɔ hu nyɛ tsiɔ mɛ blɔ.” Nɛ benɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho ɔ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ je a hɛ ka lɛ nɛ a bɔni e nya munyu hiɔmi babauu, nɛ a da lɛ, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a wo e nya tso kpɛ konɛ a ya po e nya.
Osatopeemi he kɔkɔbɔmi Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, benɛ nihi akpe akpehi abɔ ba bua a he nyɛ nɛ nihi ngɛ nihi a nɔ nae ɔ, Yesu bɔni e kaseli ɔmɛ demi ke: “Kekleekle ɔ, nyɛ hɛ̃ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a ma sasɛ nɛ ji osato peemi ɔ he.
Se nɔ́ ko be nɛ a tsi nɔ nɛ a be lɛ kpo jee, aloo nɛ a ngɔ laa nɛ a be lee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛ de ngɛ diblii mi ɔ, a maa nu ngɛ la hɛ mi; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tu ngɔ wo tue mi ngɛ se tsuhi a mi ɔ, a maa fiɛ ngɛ tsuhi a yi mi.” Nɔ nɛ sa gbeyeyemi “Se nyɛ, ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛ ko ye nihi nɛ gbee nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ a be nɔ́ ko nɛ a ma nyɛ maa pee hu ɔ gbeye.
Se ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ ye gbeye: Nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ ke e gbe se ɔ nɛ e ngɛ he blɔ kaa e ma sake ngɔ fɔ gehena mi ɔ gbeye.
Ee, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, lɛ gbeye nyɛɛ ye.
“Anɛ pi pesewahi enyɔ nɛ a juaa otokliihi enuɔ lo?
Se Mawu hɛ ji akpɛti kake ngmelu nɔ.
Se snyɛ yi bwɔmi tete a kane kulaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ye gbeye; nyɛ he jua wa pe otokliihi babauu.” Yesu he odaseyemi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi “I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbaa mi woɔ ye ta ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu ma gba mi nɛ e maa wo e ta ngɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; se nɔ nɛ kuaa mi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, a ma kua lɛ ngɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
“Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tu munyu ko ngɔ si Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, a kɛ maa pa lɛ; se Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛɛ, nɔ nɛ maa tu musu bɔmi munyu ko ngɔ si lɛ ɔ, a kɛ be lɛ pae.
“Ke a kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ matsɛmɛ kɛ ganɔhi a hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko gba nyɛ he nya ngɛ bɔ nɛ loo nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma je nyɛ nya loo nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma de ɔ he.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ de ɔ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu.” Niatsɛ kuasia a he abɛ ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko je asafo ɔ mi ba de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, de ye nyɛmi ɔ nɛ e kɛ mi nɛ dla gbo si ni ɔmɛ.” Se Yesu de lɛ ke: “Maminyumu, mɛnɔ wo mi kojolɔ loo ni dlalɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ?” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ saminya ngɛ hɛ tsumi he; ejakaa pi nɔmlɔ ni nɛ e na nɛ be nɔ ɔ mi nɛ e wami ngɛ.” Nɛ e bu mɛ abɛ ke: “Nyumu niatsɛ ko zugba ba ni babauu; nɛ e susu ngɛ e yi mi ke: ‘Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ, akɛnɛ i be he nɛ i kɛ ye ngmɔ mi ni maa to nɛ ɔ?’ Nɛ e ke: ‘Nɔ nɛ ma pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ma kuɔ ye gba a ngɔ pue si, nɛ ma ma nguahi, nɛ ma to ye ngmɔ mi ni kɛ ye ni ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ ma de ye klaa ke: Ye klaa, o ngɛ nihi babauu nɛ a ngɔ to ha mo jehahi fuu; jɔɔ o he, ye nɛ o nu, nɛ o tsui nɛ nɔ o mi!’ Se Mawu de lɛ ke: ‘Kuasia, nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, a ma bi o klaa si ngɛ o dɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ o dla ngɔ to ɔ, mɛnɔ nihi a maa pee?’ Jã nɔ nɛ toɔ juetli ngɔ haa lɛ nitsɛ e he, se e pi niatsɛ ngɛ Mawu blɔfami ɔ ngɛ.” He kɛ Mawu nɔ fɔmi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɛ nyɛ klaa a he, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye, aloo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa wo.
Klaa a pe ngma, nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hu pe tade.
Nyɛ susu kuakualabite ɔmɛ a he; ejakaa a du we ni, jeha nɛ ɔ hu a kpa we, na a be nito he loo ngma gba po, se Mawu lɛɛ mɛ; nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ he jua wa hluu pe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ!
Se nyɛ ti mɛnɔ nɛ ke e gba e he nya a nɛ e ma nyɛ tsa e kami nya ninekpɔ mi kake?
Se ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɔ́ nɛ ji nyafii nɛ nyɛɛ pee ɔ, mɛ he je nyɛ gbaa nyɛ he nyɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔ?
Nyɛ susu mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ a puɛɛ; a tsu we ni, nɛ jeha nɔ hu a tsɛ̃ we kpa, se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Salomo kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ tete mia we kaa enɛ ɔmɛ a ti kake.
Jeha nɛ ɔ ke hu nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ e ngɛ nga nɔ nɛ hwɔɔ nɛ a kɛ woɔ abolo tsu mi ɔ nɛ Mawu miaa lɛ kikɛ ɔ, anɛ e be nyɛ miae hluu pe mɛ, nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi ɔ!
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ko bi nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye aloo nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu nyɛ yi mi nɛ ko pee nyɛ kɔsikɔsi.
Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se je nɛ ɔ mi majeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ dii; se nyɛ tsɛ ɔ le kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ nyɛ hiae.
Nyɛ hla Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ se blɔ mohu nɛ a maa ngɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ piɛ he ha nyɛ.” Hiɔwe juetli “Koo ye gbeye, asafo kuu nyafii, ejakaa nyɛ tsɛ ɔ ngɛ he tsui kaa e maa ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ jua nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ pee kpakpa.
Nyɛ hla sika kpɛɛhi nɛ be momo pee; nyɛɛ to juetli nɛ be tae ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ juɔ ko be he sue nɛ wɔyewɔye kpe we ni ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa he nɛ nyɛ juetli ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nyɛ tsui hu maa hi.” Sɔmɔli nɛ buu “Nyɛɛ fi nyɛ Tnlɛ mi nɛ nyɛ ha nyɛ kane ɔmɛ nɛ tso; nɛ nyɛɛ pee kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ a nyɔmtsɛ blɔ hyɛe be mi nɛ e maa je yokpeemi ɔ kɛ ba a, konɛ ke e ba nɛ e ba si ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ a bli lɛ amlɔ.
A gbaa jamɛ a tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ benɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba a nɛ e ma ba na mɛ kaa a ngɛ nyɔ fɔe ɔ!
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke e maa mia nɛ e ma ha a hi si ngɛ niyeni he, nɛ e maa ba ba sɔmɔ mɛ.
Nɛ ke e ba nyɔ mi kpɛti loo makɛ nɛ e ba na mɛ jã a, a gbaa jamɛ a tsɔli ɔmɛ!
Se nyɛ na le enɛ ɔ kaa, ke wetsɛ ɔ le ngmlɛfia nɔ nɛ juɔ ɔ baa a jinɛ e maa bu nɛ e be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ a ywia e tsu ɔ ngɔ wo mi.
Lɔɔ he ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ dla nyɛ he ngɔ to, ejakaa, ngmlɛfia nɛ nyɛ hɛ be nɔ ɔ nɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba.” Sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ kɛ sɔmɔlɔ lakpatsɛ Petro de Yesu ke: “Mawetsɛ, wɔ o ngɛ kikɛmɛ a abɛ nɛ ɔ bue ɔ, aloo ni ɔmɛ tsuo hu ngɛ mi?” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha heto ke: “Se mɛnɔ mɔ ji tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma anɔkualetsɛ kɛ ni lelɔ, nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa wo lɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e webihi a nɔ, konɛ e ha mɛ a niyeni ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ?
A gbaa jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba nɛ e ma ba na lɛ kaa e ngɛ jã pee ɔ. I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke e maa wo lɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e ni ɔmɛ kulaa nɔ.
Se ke jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ de ngɛ e tsui mi ke: ‘Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ e bami be ɔ tsɛe kɛ ngɛ toe,’ nɛ e ma bɔni wenyumuhi kɛ weyi ɔmɛ gbemi kɛ da numi kɛ da demi ɔ; jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba ngɛ ligbi nɛ e hyɛ we lɛ blɔ kɛ ngmlɛfia nɛ e li nɔ, nɛ e ma ba poo e mi, nɛ e ma ha lɛ e blɔfami nɔ kɛ ablaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
“Se jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ le e nyɔmtsɛ suɔmi nya ni nɛ e dla we e he ngɔ tui nɛ e pa pee we e suɔmi nyɛ ni ɔ, a maa fia lɛ kpa fuu; se nɔ nɛ li nɛ e ya pee kpa fiami ni ɔ, a maa fia lɛ kpa bɔɔ ko.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a ngɔ fuu ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, a ma hla fuu ngɛ e dɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ a tu fuu ngɔ wo e dɛ ɔ, a ma bi nɔ́ nɛ be nɔ si ngɛ e dɛ.” Migbami nɛ baa ngɛ Yesu he “I ba nɛ ma ba wo la ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ ke e hle momo ɔ, mɛni i ngɛ hlae ekohu!
I ngɛ baptisimi ko nɛ a kɛ maa baptisi mi, nɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye he ngɛ mi hiae kɛ maa su be nɛ a maa gbe nya!
Anɛ nyɛ susu kaa hejɔmi hami i ba ngɛ je ɔ mi lo?
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Dɛbi, se mi gbami mohu.
Ejakaa kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ ɔ, ni enuɔ maa gba ngɛ we kake mi, ni etɛ maa te si ngɔ wɔ ni enyɔ, nɛ ni enyɔ hu maa te si ngɔ wo ni etɛ; mi gbami maa ba tsɛ kɛ e bi nyumu, kɛ binyumu hu kɛ e tsɛ a kpɛti; kɛ nyɛ kɛ biyo kpɛti, kɛ biyo hu kɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nganyɛ kɛ e nganyɛ, e bi ɔ yo ɔ, kpɛti kɛ lɛ hu e kɛ e nganyɛ, e huno nyɛ ɔ, kpɛti.” Be ɔ lemi Nɛ e de asafo ɔmɛ hu ke: “Ke nyɛ na bɔku nɛ ngɛ e he nya buae ngɛ bonyoku (pu sinɔ he) ɔ, amlɔ ɔ nyɛ deɔ ke: ‘Hiɔmi maa nɛ,’ nɛ e baa mi ja; nɛ ke leneyi (wo si) kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ fiae ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke: ‘Latsa maa ba,’ nɛ e baa mi.
Osatotsɛmɛ, nyɛ le hiɔwe kɛ je mi nihi a sisi tsɔɔmi; se kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ li yi nɔ nɛ ɔ sisitsɔɔmi ɔ?” O kɛ o pɛbilɔ ɔ nɛ dla “Nɛ mɛ he je nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kojo we nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ ha we nyɛ he ɔ?
Se ke o kɛ o pɛbilɔ yaa kojolɔ hɛ mi ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ dla ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, konɛ e ko sã mo ya ha kojolɔ ɔ, nɛ kojolɔ ɔ hu ngɔ mo ngo ha polisi ɔ, nɛ polisi ɔ wo mo tsu mi.
I ngɛ mo dee ke: O be lejɛ ɔ jee gblegbleegblee ja o wo nyagbe pesewa a lolo.”
Tsakee o blɔ ɔmɛ nɛ o he mi ko kpata Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ sɛ̃ɛ Galileabi nɛ Pilato ngɔ a muɔ ngɔ futu a bɔ sami ɔmɛ a mi ɔ he sane ɔ ha lɛ.
Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Anɛ nyɛ susu kaa kikɛmɛ a Galileabi nɛ ɔmɛ ji yayamipeeli pe Galileabi ɔmɛ tsuo he je nɛ a na kikɛmɛ a amanehlu nɛ ɔ lo?
Dɛbi, se mohu i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ tsakee we nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata ja kɛ̃.
Aloo nyɛ susu kaa nihi nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ nɛ Siloa mɔ ɔ hule pue a nɔ nɛ e gbe mɛ ɔ, mɛ kɛkɛ ji yayami peeli pe nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ lo?
Dɛbi, se mohu i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ tsakee we nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata jã kɛ.” Ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ wui yiblii ɔ he abɛ ɔ Nɛ e bu mɛ kikɛmɛ a abɛ nɛ ɔ ke: “Nɔ ko du ngmɔkɔ tso ngɛ e wai ngmɔ mi, nɛ e ya e nɔ yiblii hlami, se e nɛ eko.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ngmɔ hulɔ ɔ ke: ‘Oʼɛ jeha etɛ ji nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, i baa ba hlaa yiblii ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ɔ nɔ, se i nɛ eko.
Poo lɛ ngɔ fɔ si.
Mɛ he je hu nɛ e ngɛ zugba a gbee ɔ?’ Se ngmɔ hulɔ ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, ha nɛ e hi si jeha nɛ ɔ hulɔ kɛ maa su be nɛ ma tsua he nɛ ma wo sisi kuku, kaa alinɔ e maa wo yiblii lo; se ke pi ja a loko o po lɛ ngɔ fɔ si.’ ” Yesu tsa yo ko nɛ kpɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ eko nɔ ɔ, Yesu ngɛ ni tsɔɔe ngɛ kpe he ɔ eko, nɛ oʼɛ, yo ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ mumi yayami wo lɛ hiɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ, nɛ e kpɛ, nɛ enyɛ we e mi nɛ e kpa kulaa po.
Se benɛ Yesu na lɛ ɔ, e tsɛ lɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Yo, a pɛne mo ngɛ o hiɔ ɔ mi!” Nɛ e kɛ e ninehi pue e nɔ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e da tlɔmɔɔ, nɛ e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Se kpe he nɔkɔtɔma a muklii mi wo la akɛnɛ Yesu tsa nɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ e he nɔ nɛ e de asafo ɔ ke: “Ligbi ekpa lɛ ngɛ nɛ sa kaa a tsuɔ ni ngɛ mi; lɔ ɔ he je ɔ nyɛɛ ba ngɛ lɛ be ɔmɛ a mi konɛ a tsa nyɛ, se pi ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ!” Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Osatotsɛmɛ!
Anɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ pɛne we e na loo e teji ngɛ niyeni nɔ́ ɔ he kpakaa we lɛ ya ha we lɛ nyu lo?
Oʼɛ, kikɛmɛ a yo nɛ ɔ nɛ ji Abraham bi yo nɛ Satan fi lɛ kikɛmɛ a jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, anɛ e dɛ́ kaa a pɛneɔ lɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a kpa nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ lo?” Nɛ benɛ e de enɛ ɔ ɔ, zo gbe e henyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ asafo ɔ tsuo na buajɔmi ngɛ nyakpɛ nihi nɛ e pee ɔ kulaa he.
Sinapi wu ɔ he abɛ ɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu ke: “Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa mɛni, nɛ mɛni he ma ngɔ to?
E ngɛ kaa sinapi wu kake ngmelu nɛ nyumu ko ngɔ nɛ e ya du ngɛ e ngmɔ mi, nɛ e puɛ, nɛ e pee tso kpetekpleenyɛ, nɛ hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ baa ba peɔ tsuhi ngɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ a mi.” Ma sasɛ ɔ he abɛ ɔ Nɛ e de ekohu ke: “Mɛni he ma ngɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ to?
E ngɛ kaa ma sasɛ nɛ yo ko ngɔ nɛ e ngɔ wo sowe etɛ mi kɛ ya su be nɛ kulaa sa.” Agbo tokofii ɔ Nɛ Yesu ya kpa mahi kɛ kɔpehi a mi tsɔɔ ni, nɛ e po mi kɛ yaa Yerusalem.
Nɛ nɔ ko bi lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, anɛ nihi bɔɔ kɛkɛ yiwami a ma he lo?” Se e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ plee agbo tokofii ɔ mi sɛmi he, ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nihi fuu ma hla nɛ a sɛ mi, se a be nyɛe.
“Be mi nɛ we tsɛ ɔ te si nɛ e ya nga sinya a, nɛ nyɛ ma bɔni sinya a simi ngɛ se je, nɛ nyɛ ma de ke: ‘Nyɔ́mtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ, bli wɔ,’ nɛ e ma he nɔ nɛ e ma de nyɛ ke: I li he nɛ nyɛ je’ ɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ nyɛ ma bɔni demi ke: ‘Wa ye ni nɛ wa nu ni ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ o tsɔɔ ni ngɛ wa magbɛ ɔmɛ a mi.’ Nɛ e ma de mɛ ke: ‘I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke i li he nɛ nyɛ je; nyɛɛ je ye nɔ nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ tsuɔ nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ!’ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ya fomi kɛ lungu nya kpemi maa hi, benɛ nyɛ maa na Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a fie nyɛ ɔ. Nɛ nihi maa je beleku (pu je he) kɛ bonyoku (puisinɔ he) kɛ omlɛyi (hue mi je) kɛ leneyi (wo si je) maa ba nɛ a ma ba hi okplɔɔ he ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Nɛ oʼɛ, sekpɛtsɛmɛ ngɛ nɛ maa pee kekletsɛmɛ, na kekletsɛmɛ hu ngɛ nɛ maa pee sekpɛtsɛmɛ.
Suɔmi nɛ Yesu ngɛ kɛ ha Yerusalem Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Farisifo ɔmɛ ekomɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke: “Jee hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ho, ejakaa Herode ngɛ mo hlae nɛ e gbe.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de jamɛ a kɔkɔbo ɔ ke: Oʼɛ, i ngɛ mumi yayamihi hiae, nɛ i ngɛ nihi tsae mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ hwɔɔ, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ ma gbe nya.’ Se kɛ̃ ɔ ja i nyɛɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ hwɔɔ kɛ hwɔɔ se, ejakaa e be mi bae kaa a maa gbe gbalɔ ko ngɛ he ko kaa ja Yerusalem.
“Yerusalem, Yerusalem, mo nɛ o gbee gbali ɔmɛ, nɛ o fiaa nihi nɛ a tsɔɔ mɛ o ngɔ ɔ tɛ, si nyɛmɛ i hla kaa i buaa o bimɛ ɔmɛ a nya, kaa bɔ nɛ kungwɔ buaa e bimɛ a nyɛ ngɔ woɔ e pɛlihi a sisi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ we.’ Oʼɛ, a si nyɛ we ɔ we doku ha nyɛ.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛ be mi nae hu kɛ maa su be nɛ e maa ba mi kaa nyɛ ma de ke: ‘A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ!’ ”
Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛ ko Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ko nɔ ɔ, Yesu ya ni yemi ngɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake we mi, nɛ a huɔ lɛ.
Nɛ oʼɛ nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ hulemi hiɔ nue.
Nɛ Yesu de mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ ke: “Anɛ e da blɔ kaa a tsaa nɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ lo?” Se a pui e nya mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e pɛtɛ e he nɛ e tsa lɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ blɔ ke e ho.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ nɛ ke e teji loo e na ya nɔ vu mi ɔ nɛ e ya be lɛ jee amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ?” Se a nyɛ we enɛ ɔmɛ a heto nɛ a ha hu.
Nibwɔpeemi kɛ hesibami Nɛ benɛ Yesu yo bɔ nɛ a ngɛ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi he hlae ɔ, e bu nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ abɛ, nɛedemɛke?
“Ke nɔ ko kpee mo kɛ yaa yo kpeemi okplɔɔ he ɔ, ko ya hi yimɛ a je; eko ɔ alinɔ e kpee nɔ ko nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe mo, konɛ nɔ nɛ kpee o kɛ jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ ko ba nɛ e ba de mo ke: ‘Ha nɔ nɛ ɔ blɔ,’ nɛ lɔ ɔ lɛɛ o kɛ zo ma ya hi nane si je.
Se mohu ke a kpee mo ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya hi nane si je, konɛ ke nɔ nɛ kpee mo ɔ ba a, nɛ e ba de mo ke: ‘Huɛ, ba yimɛ a je.’ Lɔ ɔ lɛɛ o hɛ mi maa ba nyami ngɛ nihi nɛ o kɛ hii si ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si, nɛ nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a ma wo e nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de nɔ nɛ kpee lɛ ɔ ke: “Ke o ngmɛ piani loo gbɔkuɛ okplɔɔ ɔ, ko tsɛ o huɛmɛ loo o nyɛmimɛ loo o wekuli loo o kpɔ mi niatsɛmɛ, konɛ alinɔ mɛ hu a ba kpee mo eko ngɔ ma nya.
Se ke o ngmɛ okplɔo ɔ, tsɛ ohiafohi kɛ glɔtsɛmɛ kɛ pɔtsɛmɛ kɛ heyuyuili mohu, nɛ a maa gbaa mo, akɛnɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ maa to mo nane mi ɔ; ejakaa a maa to mo nane mi ngɛ dali a si temi ɔ mi.” Okplɔɔ ngua a he abɛ ɔ Nɛ benɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ hii si ngɛ niyeni si ɔ a ti nɔ kake nu ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e de Yesu ke: “A gbaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ abolo ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi!” Se Yesu de lɛ ke: “Nyumu ko ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngua, nɛ e kpee nihi fuu; nɛ benɛ e su ni yemi be ɔ, e tsɔ e tsɔlɔ ke e ya de nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ ke: ‘Nyɛɛ ba, ejakaa a gbe nihi kulaa nya’ Se mɛ tsuo kulaa a bɔni lakpa kake yemi.
Kekle nɔ ɔ de lɛ ke: ‘I he ngmɔ ko nɛ e sa kaa ma ya nɛ ma ya hyɛ; i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o na ha mi.’ Nɛ nɔ kpa ke: ‘I he na blablɛ enuɔ nɛ i yaa ma ya ka mɛ ma hyɛ; i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o na ha mi.’ Nɛ nɔ kpa hu ke: ‘I kpee yo nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ i be nyɛe ma ba.’ Nɛ kikɛmɛ a tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ ba nɛ e ba jaje ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa ngɔ tsɔɔ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ we tsɛ ɔ muklii mi fu, nɛ e de tsɔlɔ ɔ ke: ‘Jee kpo esɔ kɛ ya ma a mi gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ kɛ magbɛ ɔme kɛ puɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛ, nɛ o ya ngɔ ohiafohi kɛ glɔtsɛmɛ kɛ hɛyuyuili kɛ pɔtsɛmɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.’ Nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, a pee bɔ nɛ o de ɔ, se kɛ ɔ blɔ pa ngɛ.’ Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de tsɔlɔ ɔ ke: ‘Jee kpo nɛ o ya nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a ba, konɛ ye we ɔ nɛ hyi tɔ.’ Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: ‘Ke nihi nɛ a kpee ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko sa e nyɛ ye niyeni ɔ fii!’ ” Kristo kaselɔ peemi Nihi babauu kɛ Yesu nyɛɛ, nɛ e plɛ e he nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ke nɔ ko ma ye ngɔ nɛ e nyɛ́ e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ kɛ e yo kɛ e bimɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ nyumuhi kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e klaa hu tete ɔ, e be nyɛe ye kaselɔ peemi.
Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wo we e seumi tso ngɔ tloo kɛ nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e be nyɛe ye kaselɔ peemi.
Ejakaa nyɛ ti mɛnɔ nɛ ke e ngɛ hlae nɛ e ma mɔ ɔ nɛ e be si hie nɛ e bu nya nɛ e hyɛ lolo kaa e ngɛ nihi bɔ nɛ maa su nya gbemi lo?
Konɛ e ko ba kaa, benɛ e je sisi nɛ e ya nyɛ we nya nɛ e gbe ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ na a ba bɔni e he fɛu yemi ke: ‘Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ bɔni mɔ mami, se e nyɛ we nya nɛ e gbe.’ Aloo te matsɛ nɛ ke e kɛ matsɛ kpa ko yaa hwu ta a nɛ e be si hie nɛ e susu he nɛ e hyɛ kaa nɔ nɛ hɛɛ nimli akpɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ ma e nɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, e ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe kɛ nimli akpe nyɔma lo?
Ke pi ja a, benɛ matsɛ kake ɔ nyɛɛ tsitsa lokoo kɛ ma a, e maa tsɔ tsɔli kɛ ya e ngɔ ya kpa kpatami he pɛɛ.
Ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kua we nihi kulaa nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, be nyɛe ye kaselɔ peemi.” Ngo nɛ nya nyu gbo “Ngo hi; se ke ngo nya nyu gbo ɔ, mɛni a ma kɛ wo lɛ ngo ekohu?
E hi nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ kaa zu loo kuku tete; a tsɛɛ ngɔ pueɔ he.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue nɛ e kɛ maa nu ɔ, e nu.”
To nɛ laa a Jeha nɛ ɔ onia tsuli kɛ yayami peeli ɔmɛ tsuo hɛ mɛ su e he nɛ a ba bu lɛ tue.
Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tu munyu huitihuiti nɛ a de ke: “Nɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ yayami peeli yeɔ ni.” Nɛ e bu mɛ kikɛmɛ a abɛ nɛ ɔ ke: “Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ nɛ ke e ngɛ to lafa nɛ a kpɛti kake laa a, e be nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔ sie ngɛ nga a nɔ nɛ e ya hla nɔ́ nɛ laa a kɛ maa su benɛ e maa na lɛ?
Nɛ ke e na lɛ ɔ, e woɔ lɛ fɔɔ ekonɔ nɛ e naa bua jɔmi; nɛ ke e ba we mi ɔ, e tsɛɛ e huɛmɛ kɛ e pakabi kɛ kpee, nɛ e deɔ mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ na buajɔmi, ejakaa i na ye to ɔ nɛ laa a.’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ja nɔuu buajɔmi maa ba hiɔwe ngɛ yayami peelɔ kake nɛ tsakee e tsui ɔ he pe dali nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ nɛ tsui tsakemi he hia we mɛ ɔ.” Sika nɛ laa a “Aloo te yo nɛ ngɛ sika hiɔ nyɔngma nɛ ke kpɔ kake laa a nɛ e be kane sue nɛ e bɛɛ we ɔ mi nɛ e hla fitsofitso kɛ maa su be nɛ e maa na?
Nɛ ke e na a, e tsɛɛ e huɛmɛ kɛ e pakabi kɛ kpee nɛ e deɔ mɛ ke: ‘Nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ na bua jɔmi, ejakaa i na ye sika kpɔ nɛ laa a.’ Ja nɔuu i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, bua jɔmi baa Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ yayami peelɔ kake nɛ tsakee e tsui ɔ he.” Bi nyumu nɛ laa a Nɛ e ke: “Nyumu ko ngɛ bimɛ nyumuhi enyɔ.
Nɛ a kpɛti jokuɛyo ɔ de e tsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Tsaatsɛ, ha mi o ni ɔmɛ a mi nɔ́ nɛ ji ye blɔfami nɔ.’ Nɛ e dla e ni ɔmɛ a mi ngɔ ha mɛ.
Nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e sui be ko kɛkɛ nɛ jokuɛ ɔ bua kulaa nya, nɛ e doma kɛ ho he ko lokoo ya, nɛ Hejɛ ɔ ekɛ je mi bami sakasaka ya kpata e ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ.
Se benɛ e puɛ kulaa a, hwɔ nɛ nya wa ko ba te si ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ e bɔni lɛ fimi.
Nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e kɛ e he ya bɔ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ eko he; nɛ e ha e ya e ngmɔ ɔ mi ya lɛ kpotoohi.
Nɛ e jio lɛ kaa jinɛ e ko na yɔ nɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ yeɔ ɔ eko nɛ e ye nɛ e tɔ, se nɔ ko hi lɛ.
Nɛ benɛ e hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ ɔ, e ke: ‘Yaa hyɛ tsaatsɛ apaatsɛmɛ abɔ sɔuu nɛ ngɛ niyeni babauu nɛ a pee we he nɔ ko, nɛ imi lɛɛ hwɔ gɛ mi gbee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ. Ma te si nɛ ma ya tsaatsɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ya de lɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛ, i pee yayami si Mawu kɛ mo, nɛ i sɛ́ kaa a tsɛɔ mi o bi hu; ngɔɔ mi ngɔ pee o apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ eko.” ’ Nɛ e te si nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ba e tsɛ ngɔ.
“Se benɛ e nyɛɛ tsitsa lokoo kɛ ma a, e tsɛ na lɛ, nɛ e muklii mi sa lɛ, nɛ e sa fo kɛ ho ya fua lɛ nɛ e fiɔ e nya he.
Nɛ e bi ɔ de lɛ ke: ‘Tsaatsɛ, i pee yayami kɛ si Mawu kɛ mo, nɛ i sɛ kaa a tsɛɔ mi o bi hu!’ Se e tsɛ ɔ de sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ke: ‘Nyɛ ya je tade nɛ ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa a kɛ ba esɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba wo lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo e nine si ga kɛ e nane hu tokota; nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ na bi nɛ tu zɔ ɔ kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba gbe, nɛ nyɛ ha waa ye ni nɛ wa na bua jɔmi; ejaakaa ye bi nɛ ɔ gbo, nɛ e hɛ tsɛ ekohu; e laa nɛ a na lɛ.’ Nɛ a bɔni nyami.
“Se e bi nɔkɔtɔma a ngɛ ngmɔ mi, nɛ benɛ e ma nɛ e su we ɔ mi ta a, e nu saku kɛ dohi a he.
E tsɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake kɛ ba se, nɛ e bi lɛ ke: ‘Mɛni a ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?’ Nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘O nyɛmi ɔ ba, nɛ o tsɛ gbe na bi nɛ tu zɔ ɔ ejakaa e su e dɛ mi kpɛii nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he.’ Nɛ e muklii mi fu, nɛ e kplɛɛ we we ɔ mi sɛmi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e tsɛ ɔ je kpo nɛ e ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ.
Se e he nɔ nɛ e de e tsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Hyɛ jehahi abɔ sɔuu nɛ i sɔmɔ mo, nɛ i tɔ we o kita ko nɔ gblee, nɛ imi lɛɛ o ha we mi to ku ko tete po gblee konɛ i kɛ ye huɛmɛ nɛ nya; se mwɔnɛ nɛ o bi nɛ ɔ nɛ kɛ ajuamahi ya ye o ni ɔmɛ ba a, lɛɛ o gbe na bi nɛ tu zɔ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.’ Nɛ e tsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: ‘Ye bi, mo lɛɛ o kɛ mi lɛ ngɛ daa nɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, o nɔ ʼi, se e sa kaa wa nya nɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ wa he, ejakaa o nyɛmi nɛ ɔ gbo, nɛ e hɛ tsɛ ekohu, e laa, nɛ a na lɛ.’ ”
Tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma kutupɔtsɛ ɔ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ hu ke: “Nyumu niatsɛ ko hi si nɛ e ngɛ tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma ko nɛ a ba po e nya ngɔ ha lɛ ke e ngɛ e ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpatae.
E tsɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ nue ngɛ o he nɛ ɔ?’ Ba bu o nɔkɔtɔma yemi ɔ he akɔɔtaa ejakaa o be nɔkɔtɔma nyɛe maa ye hu.
Nɛ tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a de ngɛ e yi mi ke: ‘Nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ nɔkɔtɔma yemi ɔ kpɔe ngɛ ye dɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?
I be nyɛe si ma tsua, nɛ nɔ bami hu ngɛ mi zo pee.
I na bɔ nɛ ma pee nɛ ke a kpa mi nɔkɔtɔma yemi ɔ nɛ a he mi ngɛ a wehi a mi.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ e nyɔmtsɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba kakaaka; e bi kekle nɔ ɔ ke: ‘Hiɔ nyɛmɛ o hɛɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ?’ Nɛ e ke: ‘Nu tɔ lafa.’ Nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘He o womi ɔ nɛ o hi si esɔ nɛ o ngma nyingmi enuɔ.
Nɛ nɔ kpa hu e bi lɛ ke: ‘Nɛ mo nɛɛ, hiɔ nyɛmɛ o hɛɛ?’ E ha heto ke: ‘Ngma kpɛɛ lafa.’ Nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘He o womi ɔ nɛ o ngma nyingmi kpaanyɔ.’ Nɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma kutupɔtsɛ ɔ yi kaa e ye sane ɔ ga mi.
Ejakaa je nɛ ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ le a nɔ ɔ mi ga pe la bi ɔmɛ.
“Nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛɛ ngɔ kutupɔ ni nami ɔ eko ngɔ pee huɛmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ he; konɛ, ke e puɛ nyɛ ɔ, nɛ a he nyɛ kɛ ya neneene si himi mi.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ́ ko nyafii mi anɔkuale ɔ, e yeɔ babauu hu mi anɔkuale.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ yi nɔ́ ko nyafii mi anɔkuale ɔ, e yi babauu hu mi anɔkuale.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke nyɛ yi kutupɔ ni nami ɔ po mi anɔkuale ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ji ni nami nitsɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ maa tu kɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ?
Nɛ ke nyɛ yi nɔ kpa nɔ́ mi anɔkuale ɔ, mɛnɔ maa ngɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ?
“Wenyumu ko be nyɔmtsɛmɛ enyɔ nyɛe ma sɔmɔ, ejakaa eko ɔ e maa nyɛ nɔ kake nɛ e maa suɔ nɔ kpa a, aloo e maa pɛtɛ nɔ kake he, nɛ e maa gbe nɔ kpa a he guɛ.
Nyɛ be Mawu kɛ ni nami nyɛe ma sɔmɔ.” Yesu munyuhi komɛ Nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ nɛ ji sikasuɔli ɔmɛ nu ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a muɔ lɛ.
Nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ji nihi nɛ nyɛ buu nyɛ he bemi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi; se Mawu lɛɛ e le nyɛ tsuihi a mi, ejakaa nɔ nɛ ji gojoo ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, eji nɔ ko nɛ Mawu nyɛɛ.
“Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ gba kɛ ba su Yohane nɔ; kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ nɔ nɔ, a ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi he Sane Kpakpa a fiee, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ sɛɛ mi ka nya.
E wɛ hi hiɔwe kɛ zugba kaa a maa be kɛ ho pe nɔ́ nɛ Mlaa a mi ngu kake maa nɔ si.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fieɔ e yo nɛ e ya ngɔɔ nɔ kpa a, e puɛ gba; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ yo nɛ e huno fie lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e puɛ gba.” Niatsɛ ɔ kɛ Lazaro “Jeha nɔ nyumu niatsɛ ko ngɛ, nɛ e woɔ tade tsu kɛ klala nɛ ngɛ fɛu, nɛ e naa bua jɔmi, nɛ e peɔ afɛu ni daa nɛ ɔ. Nɛ ohiafo ko hu ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Lazaro, nɛ a ngɔ lɛ ba fɔ si ngɛ e gbo ɔ nya kɛ e he pahi fuu bam.
Nɛ e jloɔ lɛ kaa e na niyeni bibli nɛ jee niatsɛ ɔ okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ pue ɔ si ɔ eko nɛ e ye; se gbehi lɛ baa nɛ a ba lɔɔ e pa amɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa ohiafo ɔ ba gbo, nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi ba ba wo lɛ kɛ ho Abraham mi si ya; nɛ niatsɛ ɔ hu ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ.
Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ he hiami mi ngɛ gbeje nɛ e ma wo e hɛ nɔ ɔ, e na Abraham ngɛ lokoo, kɛ Lazaro ngɛ e mi si.
Nɛ e kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ ke: ‘Etsɛ Abraham, naa mi mobɔ nɛ o tsɔ Lazaro nɛ e kɛ e nine nguɛ nya ya sɔ nyu mi nɛ e kɛ ba jɔɔ ye lilɛ he, ejakaa i ngɛ nɔ nae ngɛ la lilɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.’ Se Abraham de lɛ ke: ‘Ye bi, kaii kaa moo lɛɛ o na o ni kpakpa amɛ ngɛ o wami be ɔ mi, nɛ ja nɔuu Lazaro hu na ni yayahi, se jeha nɛ ɔ a ngɛ e bua jɔɔe ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ moo lɛɛ a ngɛ mo piie.
Nɛ enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa se hu ɔ, dɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ko ngɛ waa kɛ nyɛ kpɛti, konɛ nihi nɛ hlaa nɛ a je lejɛ ɔ kɛ po mi kɛ ba wa ngɔ ɔ a ko nyɛ.’ Se niatsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ mɔ, tsaatsɛ, nɛ o tsɔ Lazaro tsaatsɛ we ɔ, ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛmimɛ enuɔ, benɛ pee nɛ e ya ye odase ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, konɛ mɛ hu a ko ba piimi he nɛ ɔ.’ Nɛ Abraham de lɛ ke: ‘Mose kɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ; ha a bu kɔlɔ ɔmɛ tue!
Se lɛɛ e ke: ‘Dɛbi, Etsɛ Abraham, ke nɔ ko je gbeje kɛ ya a ngɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a ma tsake a tsui.
Se Abraham de lɛ ke: ‘Ke a bui Mose kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tue ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke nɔ ko te si kɛ je gbeje tete ɔ, a yi mi be plee.’ ”
Yayami Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ ja nane kpatami nihi ba; se musu tloo nɔ nɛ a guu e nɔ kɛ baa a!
Afani nɛ a kɛ teji wɛ muɔ e kuɛ nɛ a ya sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ wo mi pe nɛ e ma kpata tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nane.
Nyɛɛ yɛ nɛ hi!
“Ke o nyɛmi tɔ o nɔ ɔ, kã e hɛ mi; nɛ ke e pia e he ɔ, kɛ pa lɛ.
Nɛ ke si kpaago nɛ e tɔ o nɔ ligbi kake, nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba o ngɔ si kpaago ligbi kake nɛ e ke: ‘I pia ye he!’ ɔ, kɛ pa lɛ.” Hemi kɛ yemi Nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ de Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: “Piɛ wa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he ha wɔ!” Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: “Ke nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kaa sinapi wu ngu kake ɔ, jinɛ nyɛ ma de sikamino tso nɛ ɔ ke: ‘Hia kɛ o sipoku nɛ o ya ma wo mi!’ nɛ e maa bu nyɛ tue.” Sɔmɔlɔ ko blɔnyanitsumi “Se nyɛ ti mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɛ e kɛ na kpakpla ngɛ hue aloo e ngɛ lohwehi lɛe, nɛ ke e je ngmɔ mi kɛ ba pɛ ɔ, e ma de lɛ ke: ‘Ba hi si esɔ esɔ nɛ o ye ni?’ Se e be lɛ dee mohu ke: ‘Dla nɔ́ nɛ ma ye ɔ ngɔ ma si, nɛ o mia konɛ o sɔmɔ mi nɛ ma ye ni nɛ ma nu nɔ́ ko lolo, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ konɛ mo hu o ye ni nɛ o nu nɔ́ ko?’ Anɛ e maa na jamɛ a sɔmɔlɔ ɔ si kaa e pee nɔ́ nɛ a fa lɛ ɔ?
I kpa we si.
Ja nɔuu nyɛ hu, ke nyɛ pee nihi kulaa nɛ a fa nyɛ ɔ́, nyɛ de ke: ‘Sɔmɔli nɛ he be se nami komɛ ji wɔ; nɔ́ nɛ ji wa blɔ nya kaa wa tsuɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ pɛ wa tsu nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ ” Yesu tsa tsitsɛmɛ nyɔngma Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ Yesu yaa Yerusalem ɔ, e ya gu Samaria kɛ Galilea kpɛti.
Nɛ benɛ e ya sɛ ma ko mi ɔ, nyumuhi tsitsɛmɛ nyɔngma kɛ lɛ ba kpe, nɛ a daa si ngɛ se tsitsa lokoo.
Nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Mawetsɛ Yesu naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Nɛ benɛ e na mɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ.” Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ a yaa a, a he tsi ɔ ta.
Se a ti nɔ kake ɔ, benɛ e na kaa a tsa lɛ ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ba nɛ e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami kɛ gbi wawɛɛ.
Nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi ba bu si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e na lɛ si.
Se nɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, Samariano ʼi.
Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Anɛ pi nimli nyɔngma nɛ he ta a?
Se nimli nɛɛ ɔ jije a ngɛ?
Blɔɔ a nɛ́ a ti nɔ ko nɛ kpaleɔ e se kɛ hɛ mi nyami ba haa Mawu, kaa ja maseno nɛ ɔ lo?” Nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Tee si nɛ o ya; o hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo!” Matsɛyemi ɔ bami Nɛ benɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke: “Te be nɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ba” a, e ha mɛ heto ke: “Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ bɛ́ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a naa; nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a be dee ke: ‘Oʼɛ, e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!
aloo oʼɛ, e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!’ ejakaa oʼɛ, Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi.” Nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Be maa ba nɛ nyɛ ma hla Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ligbi ɔmɛ eko nɛ nyɛɛ na, nɛ nyɛ be nae.
Nɛ a ma de nyɛ ke: ‘Oʼɛ, e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, aloo: oʼɛ e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!’ Nyɛ ko ya, nɛ nyɛ ko nyɛɛ a se.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ oslaba ngaa nɛ e haa hiɔwe sisi fa kpɛɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ̃ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa hi ngɛ e ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Se kekleekle ɔ, ja e na amanehlu babauu, nɛ kikɛmɛ a yi nɔbi nɛ ɔmɛ kua lɛ.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ e ba mi ngɛ Noa ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, jã nɔuu e maa ba mi ngɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ligbi ɔmɛ a mi hulɔ.
A ngɛ ni yee, a ngɛ da nue, a ngɛ yihi ngɔe, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ gba hae kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ.
Noa sɛ daka a mi nɛ nyu afua a ba nɛ e ba kpata mɛ tsuo kulaa a hɛ mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ bɔ nɛ e ba mi ngɛ Lot ligbi ɔmɛ a mi hulɔ ɔ, a ngɛ ni yee, a ngɛ da nue, a ngɛ ni hee, a ngɛ ni juae, a ngɛ tsohi due, nɛ a ngɛ tsuhi mae; se ligbi nɛ Lot je Sodom ɔ, Mawu nɛ la kɛ suɔɔ kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e kpata mɛ tsuo kulaa a hɛ mi.
Ja nɔuu kɛ e maa ba ligbi nɛ a ma je Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kpo ɔ.
“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu yi mi nɛ e nihi ngɛ we mi ɔ, e ko kple si ba kukuɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ si hu e ko kple si kɛ ba we mi.
Nyɛ kai Lot yo ɔ!
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa laa lɛ ɔ, e ma he e yiwami.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nyumuhi enyɔ maa hwɔ sa kake nɔ, a maa ngɔ nɔ kake nɛ a ma si nɔ kake.
Yi enyɔ maa wɛɛ ngɛ he kake, a maa ngɔ nɔ kake, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake.
[ Ni enyɔ maa hi ngmɔ si, a maa ngɔ nɔ kake nɛ a ma si nɔ kake.
]” Nɛ a bi lɛ ke “Mawetsɛ, jije?” Se e de mɛ ke: “He nɛ nɔ gbogboe fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ okpokuhi buaa a he nya ngɛ.”
Yalɔyo ɔ kɛ kojolɔ ɔ he abɛ ɔ Nɛ Yesu bu mɛ abɛ ko kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e sa kaa a sɔlee daa nɛ e ko gbe nɔ nya.
Nɛ e ke: “Kojolɔ ko ngɛ ma ko nɔ, nɛ e yi Mawu gbeye, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu e bui nɔmlɔ ko.
Yalɔyo ko ngɛ jamɛ a ma mi, nɛ e ba e ngɔ ba de ke: ‘Fã ye he kɛ je ye henyɛlɔ ɔ dɛ mi!’ Nɛ e kplɛɛ we hluu.
Se pee se ɔ, e de ngɛ e yi mi ke: ‘Engɛ mi kaa i yi Mawu gbeye, nɛ i bui nɔmlɔ hulɔ; se akɛnɛ kikɛmɛ a yalɔyo nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye nya dooe he je ɔ, ma fã e he, konɛ nyagbe ɔ nɛ e ko ba pue ye hɛ mi si.’ ” Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ kojolɔ yi si fialɔ ɔ de ɔ tue!
Nɛ ke Mawu maa ku e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nihi nɛ e hla nɛ kpaa ngmla kɛ tsɛɛ lɛ nyɔ kɛ pia a nɔ hluu tete po ɔ, anɛ e ba be a he fae?
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e ma fa a he oya.
Se benɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba a, anɛ e ma ba na hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ zugba a nɔ lo?” Farisifono ɔ kɛ oniatsulɔ ɔ he abɛ ɔ Nɛ e bu ni komɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he nɔ kaa dali ji mɛ nɛ a gbee ni kpahi a he guɛ ɔ hu abɛ nɛ ɔ: “Ni enyɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho sɔlemi ya ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Nɔ kake ɔ Farisifono ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ kpa a onia tsulɔ ʼi.
Farisifono ɔ ya da lokoo, nɛ e sɔle kikɛ ngɛ e yi mi: ‘Mawu, i naa mo si kaa i be kaa ni kpa amɛ, jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ, kutupɔtsɛmɛ, gba puɛli, loo kaa kikɛmɛ a onia tsulɔ nɛ ɔ hulɔ.
I haa hwɔ si enyɔ ngɛ otsi mi; si ngɔɔ ni hi tsuo nɛ i naa a mi dlami nyɔngma ngɔ haa.’ Se onia tsulɔ ɔ daa si ngɛ se lokoo, nɛ e mi nɛ e wo e hɛ nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe tete; se mohu e ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ e tsui mi nɛ e ke: ‘Mawu, o kɛ mi nɛ ji yayami peelɔ ɔ nɛ kpata!’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho e we mi ya nɛ a wo lɛ nguɔ pe nɔ kaketsɛ ɔ. Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a ma wo e nɔ.” Yesu gbaa jokuɛwi tsɔwi Nɛ ni komɛ hu kɛ bimwɔwi ba Yesu ngɔ konɛ e ta a he; nɛ benɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ na a, a gbɛ wo mɛ.
Se Yesu tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ ha jɔkuɛwi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko tsi mɛ blɔ; ejakaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ kaa jokuɛ nyafii ko ɔ, e be mi sɛe kulaa.” Nyumu niatsɛ ɔ Nɛ nɔkɔtɔma ko ba bi lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni ma pee konɛ ma na neneene wami?” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Mɛni he je o ngɛ mi tsɛe ke nɔ kpakpa?
Nɔ kpakpa ko be kaa ja nɔ kake; lɛ ji Mawu.
O le kita amɛ kaa: “Ko puɛ gba; koo gbe nɔmlɔ; koo ju; koo ye lakpa odase; buu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ.’ ” Se nyumu ɔ ke: “I ye enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɔ kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si.” Nɛ benɛ Yesu nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, e de lɛ ke: “E piɛ mo nɔ́ kake.
Yaa jua nihi kulaa nɛ o ngɛ ɔ nɛ o dla sika a ha ohiafohi, nɛ o ma na juetli ngɛ hiɔwe; nɛ o ba ba nyɛɛ ye se.” Se benɛ e nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, e ye kɔmɔ wawɛɛ ejakaa e ngɛ nihi babauu.
Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu na kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee wawɛɛ ɔ, e ke: “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e wa ha nihi nɛ ngɛ nihi kaa a maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi!
Ejakaa e wɛ hi afukpɔngɔ kaa e maa gu abui hɛngmɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e waa haa niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ.” Se nihi nɛ nu ɔ ke: “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ yi wami a ma nyɛ ma he mɔ?” Yesu ke: “Nihi nɛ nimli nyɛ we nɛ a pee ɔ, Mawu lɛɛ e nyɛɔ peɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro ke: “Oʼɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa si wa nihi tsuo kulaa nɛ wa ba nyɛɛ o se.” Yesu de mɛ ke: “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ e si we loo yo loo nyɛmimɛ nyumuhi loo fɔli loo bimɛ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he, nɛ e be nane mi tomi si abɔ nae ngɛ be nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ je nɛ maa ba a mi hu e be neneene wami nae.” Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu nɔ nɛ ji si etɛ Nɛ Yesu tsɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ kɛ ba e kasa nya nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, wa yaa Yerusalem, nɛ a maa gbe nihi kulaa nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma ngɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ he ɔ nya.
Ejakaa a ma je lɛ ngɔ wo wɔ jali a dɛ mi, nɛ a maa ye e he fɛu, nɛ a maa wa lɛ yi mi, nɛ a maa la lada ngɔ pue e nɔ, nɛ a kɛ kplibi maa fia lɛ, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ, e maa te si ekohu.” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a nui ni nɛ ɔmɛ a ti kake po sisi, nɛ a ngɔ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ sisi numi ngɔ laa mɛ, nɛ a kɔ we munyuhi nɛ e tuɔ se.
Yesu tsa hɛyuyuilɔ nɔbalɔ ko Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ Yesu su Yeriko haa a, hɛyuyuilɔ ko hii si ngɛ blɔ ɔ tue ngɛ nɔ bae.
Nɛ benɛ e nu kaa nihi fuu bee ɔ, e bi nɔ́ nɛ ji.
Nɛ a de lɛ ke Yesu Nazareno ɔ lɛ bee.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ke: “Yesu, David bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi ɔ ke e yi ke e ma e nya; se kɔlɔ ɔ mohu ha e kpa ngmlaa pe kekle ɔ ke: “David bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Yesu da si, nɛ e fa ke a kɛ lɛ nɛ ba e ngɔ.
Nɛ benɛ e su e he ɔ, e bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae kaa ma pee ha mo?” Nɛ e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa ma hyɛ nɔ ekohu.” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Hyɛ nɔ, o hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo!” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e hyɛ nɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛ e se nɛ e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami; nɛ benɛ asafo ɔ tsuo na a, a je Mawu yi.
Yesu kɛ Zakeo Yesu ya sɛ Yeriko nɛ e ngɛ mi poe kɛ yaa.
Nɛ oʼɛ, nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zakeo, nɛ onia tsulɔ nɔkɔtɔma kɛ niatsɛ ji lɛ.
E ngɛ hlae nɛ e na Yesu nɛ e le lɛ, se nihi babauu ɔ he ɔ, e nyɛ we ejakaa nɔmlɔ kpiti ji lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa fo kɛ sɛ hlami nɛ e ya kuɔ sikamore tso ko, konɛ e hyɛ lɛ, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ blɔ e maa gu.
Nɛ Yesu su lejɛ ɔ, e wo e hɛ nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Zakeo, o he nɛ esɔ nɛ o kple si, ejakaa o we ɔ mi ma to mwɔnɛ ɔ.” Nɛ Zakeo he sɔ kɛ kple si nɛ e fua Yesu atuu.
Nɛ benɛ ni ɔmɛ na a, mɛ tsuo a tu munyu huitihuiti ke: ‘E ya to nyumu yayami peelɔ ngɔ.” Se Zakeo da si nɛ e de Nyɔmtsɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, oʼɛ, ma ngɔ ye nihi fa ngɔ ke ohiafohi, nɛ ke i kɛ yaka nya pomi kpɔ nɔ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, ma ku ngɔ bɔ he si eywiɛ ha lɛ.” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Mwɔnɛ yi wami hemi ba we nɛ ɔ mi, ejakaa lɛ hu Abraham bi ji lɛ.
Ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba nɔ nɛ laa a hlami kɛ yi wami hemi.” Sika kpɔ ɔ he abɛ ɔ Benɛ a ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tue bue ɔ, e bu abɛ ko kɛ si nɔ, ejakaa e su Yerusalem tã nɛ a susu kaa amlɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ma je e he si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e ke: Ablade ko doma kɛ ho lokoo ya konɛ e ya ngɔ e matsɛ yemi nɛ e kpale kɛ ba.
E tsɛ e sɔmɔli nyɔngma nɛ e je cedi nyingmi enyɔ ngɔ ha mɛ; nɛ e de mɛ ke: ‘Nyɛ plɛ he kɛ ya su ma ba.’ Se e ma mi bi ɔmɛ nyɛ lɛ, nɛ a tsɔ tsɔli kɛ fie e se ke: ‘Wa sume nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ o ba ye wa nɔ matsɛ.’ “Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ e nine ya su matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba a, e fa ke a tsɛ jamɛ a sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nɛ e ngɔ e sika a ngɔ ha a kɛ ba, konɛ e na nɔ́ nɛ a na ngɛ sika a he plɛmi mi’ Nɛ kekle nɔ ɔ ba ba de ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, sika a fɔ nyɔngma.’ Nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Ayekoo, sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa, akɛnɛ o ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ nyafii kulaa mi he ɔ, ye ma nyɔngma nɔ.’ Nɛ nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ba ba de ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, o sika a fɔ enuɔ.’ Nɛ lɛ hu e de lɛ ke: ‘Mo hu ye ma enuɔ nɔ.’ Nɛ nɔ kake ɔ hu ba ba de ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, oʼɛ o sika a nɛ i fi ngɔ wo duku mi ngɔ to ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i ya ye mo gbeye ejakaa o yi mi wa; o woɔ nɔ́ nɛ o ngɔ fɔɛ si, nɛ o kpaa nɔ́ nɛ o du we.’ Se nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: ‘Sɔmɔlɔ yayami, mo nitsɛ o nya mi munyu ma kɛ kojo mo.’ Nɛ o le kaa yi mi walɔ ji mi; i woɔ nɔ nɛ i ngɔ fɔɛ si, nɛ i kpaa nɔ nɛ i du we ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o kɛ ye sika a ya ha we tsakeli ɔmɛ, konɛ ke i ba a nɛ ma ba he ye ni kɛ hekpa?’ Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a ke: ‘Nyɛ kpɔ sika a ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ cedi nyingmi enyɔ ɔ.’ Nɛ a de lɛ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, e ngɛ cedi nyingmi enyɔ.’ ‘I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, lɛ nɔuu a ma ha; se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tete a ma kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ.
Se jamɛ a ye henyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ sume kaa ma ye a nɔ matsɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba gbe mɛ ngɛ ye hɛ mi.’ ” Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi Nɛ benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ ɔ, e be sɛ hlami kɛ ma Yerusalem blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ e su Betfage kɛ Betania ngɛ yoku nɛ a tsɛɛ Nuyoku ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ; e ke: “Nyɛɛ ya kɔpe nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ mi, nɛ ke nyɛ sɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa na teji bi nɛ nɔ ko hi e nɔ hyɛ muɔɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ ke: ‘Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lɛ pɛnee’ ɔ, nyɛ de lɛ ke: ‘E he ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hiae.’ ” Nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a tsɔ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya na kaa bɔ nɛ e de mɛ ɔ.
Se benɛ a ngɛ teji bi ɔ pɛnɛe ɔ, nɔtsɛ ɔ bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ teji bi ɔ pɛnee?” Nɛ a ke: “E he ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hiae.” Nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba Yesu ngɔ nɛ a kɛ a tadehi pue teji bi ɔ nɔ, nɛ a wo Yesu ngɔ hi nɔ.
Nɛ benɛ e yaa a, a kɛ a tadehi ha blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ benɛ e su he nɛ a kpleɔ Nuyoku ɔ ngɛ ɔ, e kaseli asafo ɔ tsuo bɔni nyami, nɛ a je Mawu yi wawɛɛ ngɛ he wami ni tsumihi tsuo nɛ a na a he; a ke: “A gbaa matsɛ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ, hejɔmi ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!” Nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ je asafo ɔ mi de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, ka o kaseli ɔmɛ.” Se Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke ni ne ɔmɛ ma ma a nya a, lɛɛ tɛhi ma kpa ngmlaa.” Yesu fo ya pue Yerusalem nɔ Nɛ benɛ Yesu su ta nɛ e na ma a, e fo ya pue e nɔ, nɛ e ke: “E ji ngɛ o ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, o na le nihi nɛ hi ha o he jɔmi jinɛ saii!
Se jeha nɛ ɔ a ngɔ laa mo.
Ejakaa o ligbi hi ma, nɛ o henyɛli ɔmɛ maa tsua muɔ ngɔ wo o he, nɛ a maa po klaangma ngɔ wo o he, nɛ a ma sa o yi ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ a maa ngɔ mo ngɔ fia si kɛ o bimɛ nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ, nɛ a be tɛ kake sie ngɛ eko nɔ ngɛ o mi, ejakaa o yo we o slaami be ɔ!” Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ Nɛ Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ e bɔni nihi nɛ ngɛ ni juae ngɛ mi ɔ fiemi; e de mɛ ke: “A ngma ke: ‘Ye we ɔ, sɔlemi we ʼi,’ se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ pee ojofiali a kplo!” Nɛ Yesu ya tsɔɔ ni daa ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ; se osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ ma a mi nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpata e hɛ mi; se a li blɔ nɔ nɛ a maa gu, ejakaa ma mluku ɔ tsuo heɔ lɛ yeɔ, nɛ a buɔ lɛ tue.
He blɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ E ba mi kaa ligbi ɔ eko nɔ benɛ Yesu ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ ngɛ ma a tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔ wɔ he blɔ nɛ o ngɛ he je nɛ o peɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ ha mo kikɛmɛ a he blɔ nɛ ɔ?” E ha mɛ heto ke: “Imi hu ma bi nyɛ sane kake nɛ nyɛ ha mi heto: Yohane baptisimi ɔ nɛɛ, hiɔwe e je aloo nimli a dɛ mi e je?” Se a sa nya ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “Ke wa de ke e je hiɔwe ɔ, e ma de ke: ‘Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ he we lɛ yi mɔ?’ Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ ke wa de ke e je nimli a dɛ mi ɔ, ma a kulaa maa fia wɔ tɛ, ejakaa a kpa si kaa Yohane ɔ, gbalɔ ʼi.” Nɛ aha lɛ heto ke a li he nɛ e je.
Nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Lɛɛ imi hu i be nyɛ tsɔɔe nɔ́ he blɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ i kɛ peɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ.” Wai ngmɔ ɔ mi apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he abɛ ɔ Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e bu ma a abɛ nɛ ɔ ke: “Nyumu ko pee wai ngmɔ nɛ e ngɔ ha huli apaa yemi, nɛ e doma, nɛ e se ya kɛ.
Nɛ benɛ be ɔ su ɔ e tsɔ tsɔlɔ ko kɛ ya huli ɔmɛ a ngɔ konɛ a ha lɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ mi yiblii ɔ eko; se apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ fia lɛ ni, nɛ afie lɛ kɛ dɛ̃ gu.
E kpale tsɔ tsɔlɔ kpa ko hu, se lɛ hu a fia lɛ ni, nɛ a pue e hɛ mi si, nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ dɛ gu.
E kpale tsɔ nɔ nɛ ji etɛ; se lɛ hu a plaa lɛ, nɛ a tsitsɛɛ e kuɛ se kɛ je kpo Nɛ wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?
Ma tsɔ ye bi nɛ i suɔ ɔ; eko ɔ lɛɛ ke a na lɛ ɔ, a ma gbo lɛ zo.’ Se benɛ huli ɔmɛ na lɛ ɔ, a de a he ke: ‘Ni yelɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ha waa gbe lɛ, konɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ pee wa nɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsitsɛɛ e kuɛ se kɛ je wai ngmɔ ɔ mi nɛ a ya gbe lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ maa pee mɛ kɛɛ?
E ma ba kpata huli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e maa ngɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ ngɔ ha ni kpahi.” Se benɛ a nu ɔ a ke: “Kpaoo!” Se Yesu hyɛ mɛ kɛ kpe nɛ e ke: “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngma nɛ ɔ mɔ, ke: ‘Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ sake fɔ he ɔ, Kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ plɛ kɔ nya tɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nɔ tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e mi ma tsɔtslɔɔ; se nɔ nɔ nɛ e maa nɔ ɔ, e maa wɛɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.” Oniatsumi he sane Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a nu Yesu ngɛ lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu se a ya ye ma a gbeye, ejakaa a kɔ se kaa a he nɛ e bu kikɛmɛ a bɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ a wo e he ka, nɛ a tsɔ huɔli, nihi nɛ pee a he kaa dali, konɛ a wo e nya tso kpɛ benɛ pee nɛ a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo amlaalo hewami kɛ he blɔ ɔ dɛ mi.
Nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa o tuɔ munyu nɛ o tsɔɔ ni dami nya, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu o hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi, se mohu anɔkuale mi o tsɔɔ Mawu blɔ ɔ ngɛ.
Anɛ e da kaa wa tsuɔ onia haa Kaisare, aloo e dɛ?” Se benɛ Yesu kpa a ga a si ɔ, e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ngɔ cedi kɛ ba nɛ ma hyɛ!
Mɛnɔ foni kɛ biɛ lɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ?” Nɛ a ha lɛ heto ke: “Kaisare nɔ ʼi.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Kaisare nihi ngɔ ha Kaisare, nɛ Mawu nihi ɔ nyɛ ngɔ ha Mawu!” Nɛ a nyɛ we e nya tso kpɛ ko nɛ a wo ngɛ ma a hɛ mi, nɛ e heto ɔ pee mɛ nyakpe nɛ a ma a nya.
Ni gbogboehi a sitemi he sane Nɛ Sadukifo ɔmɛ hu nɛ tsɔɔ kaa ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ, a ti ni komɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose ngma ha wɔ ke: ‘Ke nɔ ko nyɛmi nɛ ngɛ yo gbo nɛ e si we bi ɔ, e nyɛmi ɔ nɛ ngɔ e yo ɔ konɛ e wo nina ngɔ ha e nyɛmi ɔ.’ Jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛmimɛ kpaago hi si, nɛ a kpɛti nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ yo, nɛ e gbo nɛ e si we bi.
Nɛ e se nɔ ɔ ngɔ yo ɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e gbo nɛ e si we bi.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ hu ngɔ lɛ, nɛ ja nɔuu ni kpaago ɔ tsuo pee; se a si we bimɛ nɛ a gbo.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a se ɔ yo ɔ hu ba gbo.
Lɛɛ ni gbogboehi a si temi ɔ mi ɔ, a ti mɛnɔ yo e maa pee, ejakaa mɛ ni kpaago ɔ tsuo kɛ lɛ hi si?” Yesu ha mɛ heto ke: “Je nɛ ɔ mi bimɛ ngɔɔ yo, nɛ a kɛ yo haa gba; se nihi nɛ maa sa je nɛ ma a kɛ ni gbogboehi a si temi ɔ nami ɔ, a ngɔɛ yo, nɛ pohu a kɛ yo ha we gba; nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a be gboe hulɔ, ejakaa a ngɛ kaa hiɔwe bɔfohi nɛ Mawu bimɛ ji mɛ, akɛnɛ si temi bimɛ ji mɛ he je ɔ.
Se kaa ni gbogboehi maa te si ekohu ɔ, Mose nitsɛ tsɔɔ ngɛ hue kpɔ ɔ sane ɔ mi benɛ e tsɛ Mawu ke, Abraham Mawu kɛ Isak Mawu kɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ. Mawu ɔ, e pi ni gbogboehi a Mawu, se mohu hɛ kali a Mawu ji lɛ; ejakaa e hɛ mi ɔ nihi tsuo kulaa hɛ ngɛ.” Se mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, o munyu ɔ ngɔ.” Nɛ a kɛ́ lɛ sane ko bimi hu.
Mesia a he sane Nɛ Yesu bi mɛ ke: “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ a deɔ ke Kristo ɔ David bi ji lɛ ɔ?
Ejakaa David nitsɛ de ngɛ La womi ɔ mi ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Hii ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ, Kɛ maa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o henyɛli ɔmɛ Ngɔ pee o nane si sɛ̃.’ Ke David tsɛ lɛ ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ’ lɛɛ kɛ peɔ kɛɛ nɛ e ji e bi mɔ?” Yesu bɔ mlaatsɔɔli ɔmɛ a he kɔkɔ Ma a tsuo hɛ mi nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a he, se a suɔ tade wuyawuyahi a mi nyɛɛmi, nɛ a suɔ jua nɔ ngamihi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi hehi ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ okplɔɔ yi himi ke a tsɛ ni yemi; nihi nɛ mii yalɔyi a wehi, nɛ lakpa tomi he ɔ, a sɔlee sɔlemi gagaagahi ɔ; ni nɛ ɔmɛ a fɔ bumi maa pe nine.”
Yalɔyo ɔ onia a Yesu wo e hɛ nɔ nɛ e na niatsɛmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nike ni kɛ ngɛ onia daka a mi woe.
Nɛ e na yalɔyo ohiafo ko hu ba nɛ e kɛ kaplɛ tsɔwi enyɔ nɛ sui pesewa ba wo mi.
Nɛ e ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Kikɛmɛ a yalɔyo ohiafo nɛ ɔ kɛ fuu ba wo mi pe ni ɔmɛ tsuo; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a na nɛ be nɔ ɔ eko a kɛ ba wo Mawu nike ni ɔ mi ɔ nɛ, se nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, e hia mi ni nɛ e kɛ hyɛɛ e he nɔ ɔ tsuo e kɛ ba wo mi ɔ nɛ.” Yesu tu sɔlemi we ɔ puɛmi he munyu Benɛ ni komɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he munyu tue, bɔ nɛ a kɛ tɛ nɛ ngɛ fɛu kɛ nike ni dla lɛ ɔ, e ke: “Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, be maa ba nɛ a be e mi tɛ kake sie ngɛ eko nɔ nɛ a be tsitsɛɛe ngɔ fia si.” Amanehlu kɛ yiwami Nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, lɛɛ mɛni be ni nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi, nɛ mɛni okadi maa ba benɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi ɔ?” Nɛ Yesu ke: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ a ko mlɔɔ nyɛ; ejakaa nihi fuu maa ba ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ a ma de ke: ‘Ami ʼi;’ kɛ jeha nɛ ɔ: ‘Be ɔ su tã.’ Nyɛ ko bu mɛ tue.
Nɛ ke nyɛ nu tahi kɛ atua tsɔmihi a he ɔ, nyɛ tsui ko po, ejakaa ja kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba mi lolo, se kɛ̃ ɔ nyagbe ɔ sui lolo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ma maa te si ngɔ wo ma, nɛ matsɛ yemi hu maa te si ngɔ wo matsɛ yemi; nɛ zugba mimiɛmi nɛ nya wa maa ba hehi slɔɔtohi tsuo kɛ hwɔ kɛ gbenɔ hiɔhi, nɛ gbeye nihi kɛ okadi nguahi maa je hiɔwe kɛ ba.
“Se loko enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa maa ba a, a maa nu nyɛ, nɛ a maa wa nyɛ yi mi, nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ ha ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ pamitsɛmɛ a tsuhi a mi, nɛ a ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ maa ya matsɛmɛ kɛ ganɔhi a hɛ mi ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he?
Nɛ enɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ he blɔ kɛ ye ye he odase.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ le ngɔ to, konɛ nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma fa nyɛ he ɔ he; ejakaa ma ha nyɛ nya kɛ ni lemi nɛ nyɛ henyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo be nya nyɛe maa da, nɛ a be nya nyɛe maa ku hulɔ.
Se fɔli tete kɛ nyɛmimɛ kɛ wekuli kɛ huɛmɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ ha, nɛ a ma ha a gbe nyɛ ti ni komɛ; nɛ nihi tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he.
Se nyɛ yi bwɔmi kake kike be laae.
Nyɛ tsui si tomi nyɛ ma kɛ he nyɛ klaa amɛ a yi wami.” Yesu tu Yerusalem puɛmi he munyu “Ke nyɛ na kaa a bɔ sada wo Yerusalem he ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ na le kaa e puemi be ɔ su.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yudea a, a tu fo kɛ ya yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a je kpo nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a ko ba ma a mi.
Ejakaa lueyemi ligbi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, konɛ nihi kulaa nɛ a ngma a nɛ ba mi.
Musu tloo yihi nɛ hɛɛ mi kɛ nyɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɔ hae ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ. Ejakaa fimi nɛ nya wa maa ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ mi mi fumi hu maa ba kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ a maa nɔ ngɛ klaate nya, nɛ a maa ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ maa ya majemaje tsuo, nɛ majeli ɔmɛ maa naa Yerusalem nɔ kɛ maa su be nɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ a be ɔ maa su.” Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ bami “Okadihi maa ba pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi a mi, nɛ fimi maa ba majeli ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ a maa do yoyooyo ngɛ wo kɛ oslɔkehi a pɛmi he; nɛ nimli maa hɛli ngɛ gbeye kɛ nihi nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ blɔ hyɛmi he; ejakaa a ma mimiɛ hiɔwe hewami ɔmɛ tete.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kaa e ma ngɛ bɔku mi kɛ hewami kɛ hɛ mi nyami babauu.
Ke ni nɛ ɔmɛ bɔni mi bami ɔ, nyɛɛ da si tutuutu nɛ nyɛ wo nyɛ yi nɔ, ejakaa nyɛ kpɔmi ɔ ngɛ sue.” Ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he nikasemi Nɛ Yesu bu mɛ abɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ hyɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ kɛ tsohi tsuo kulaa; be mi nɛ a ngɛ ba sue lokoo ɔ, ke nyɛ na a, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa latsa be su si ta.
Ja nɔuu hu ke nyɛ na kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi bae ɔ, nyɛ na le kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ su si ta.
“Niinɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ nɛ ɔ be bee, ja ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa ba mi lolo.
Hiɔwe kɛ zugba maa be kɛ ho se ye munyu ɔmɛ be bee kɛ ho.” E hia kaa a huɔ “Nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ konɛ jiklɔɔ yemi kɛ da demi kɛ nya mi ngma he haomi nɛ ko he nyɛ tsui nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ba ti nyɛ si tlukaa; ejakaa e maa ba nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ zugba mluku ɔ tsuo nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ huɔ be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle konɛ nyɛ nyɛ hihi nɛ maa ba nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa mi nɛ nyɛɛ je, nɛ nyɛ nyɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nɛ nyɛɛ da.” Piani ɔ Yesu tsɔɔ ni ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ ke je jɔ ɔ, e yaa yoku nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nuyoku ɔ nɔ nɛ e ya hwɔɔ.
Nɛ mɔtu mla a, ma a tsuo baa e ngɔ ba buɔ lɛ tue ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ.
A so Yesu yi nɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ akpiti nyami ligbi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hetsɔmi ɔ ba su.
Nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ hla bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a gbe Yesu; se a ngɛ ma a gbeye yee.
Yuda kplɛɛ kaa e maa tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Abosiami ya sɛ Yuda, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Iskariot nɛ ji ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake ɔ mi.
Nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya tu munyu bɔ nɛ e maa pee nɛ e je Yesu ngɔ ha mɛ.
Nɛ a nya, nɛ a wo lɛ si ke a ma ha lɛ sika; nɛ e kplɛɛ, nɛ e hla be nɛ sa nɛ e kɛ je lɛ ngɔ ha mɛ zaa.
Yesu dla e he kɛ ha Hetsɔmi niyeni ɔ yemi Kɛkɛ nɛ akpiti nyami ligbi nɛ sa kaa a gbee Hetsɔmi to bi ɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ ba su; nɛ Yesu tsɔ Petro kɛ Yohane nɛ e ke: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya dla Hetsɔmi niyeni ɔ ngɔ to wɔ konɛ wa ba ye.” Nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Jije o suɔ kaa wa ya dla ngɔ to ngɛ?” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ke nyɛ sɛ ma a mi ɔ, oʼɛ, nyumu ko kɛ nyɛ maa kpe nɛ e tloo nyu buɛ, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya we mi he nɛ e yaa sɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya de wetsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ke wa ba de mo ke: Jije nibwɔhi a tsu ɔ nɛ i kɛ ye kaseli ɔmɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi niyeni ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ ngɛ?’ Nɛ e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ hiɔwe asa kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɛ a dla mi; lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ya dla ni ɔ ngɔ to ngɛ.” Nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya na kaa bɔ nɛ e de mɛ ɔ, nɛ a ya dla Hetsɔmi niyeni ɔ ngɔ to.
Nyɔmtsɛ niyeni ɔ sisitomi Nɛ benɛ ngmlɛfia a su ɔ, Yesu ya hi si ngɛ niyeni ɔ he, nɛ bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ hu piɛ e he.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Pe i ngɛ hlae nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa ye kikɛmɛ a Hetsɔmi nɛ ɔ loko ma na amanehlu ɔ; ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: I be eko yee hu kɛ yaa su be nɛ e maa ba mi ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.” Nɛ e wo kplu ɔ, nɛ e na si, nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ dla; ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: i be wai tso yiblii nɛ ɔ eko nue hu kɛ yaa su be nɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ba.” Nɛ e kɛ̃ abolo, nɛ e na si, nɛ e kuɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ nɛ e ke: “Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a ngɔ ha ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.” Ja nɔuu e wo kplu ɔ hu ngɛ niyeni ɔ se, nɛ e ke: “Kikɛmɛ a kplu nɛ ɔ ji somi he ɔ ngɛ ye muɔ nɛ a ngɔ pue si ha nyɛ ɔ mi.
“Se oʼɛ, nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ ɔ nine kɛ ye nine ngɛ ka a mi; ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ yaa kaa bɔ nɛ a so ngɔ to momo ɔ lɛɛ, se musu tloo nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ!” Nɛ a bɔni a he bimi ke a kpɛti mɛnɔ po maa pee enɛ ɔ. Agbopeemi he nyasami Nya sami ba te si ngɛ a kpɛti kaa a ti mɛnɔ a maa bu agbo pe kulaa.
Se Yesu de mɛ ke: “Majeli ɔmɛ a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ a nɔ odehehi a sane, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ a nɔ he wami ɔ, a tsɛɛ mɛ kplɔkɔtɔtsɛmɛ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e be nyɛ ja; se mohu nɔ nɛ ji nɔ ngua ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e plɛ kaa jokuɛyo, nɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔkɔtɔma a hu kaa nɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ.
Ejakaa te nɔ nɛ pe e nyɛmi nɛɛ: nɔ nɛ hii okplɔɔ he ɔ, aloo nɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ɔ?
Anɛ pi nɔ nɛ hii okplɔɔ he ɔ lo?
Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa nɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ.
“Se nyɛ ji nihi nɛ kɛ mi hi si ngɛ ye ka amɛ a mi; nɛ imi hu i ngɛ matsɛ yemi toe ha nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ to ha mi ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ ye nɛ nyɛɛ nu ngɛ ye kplɔɔ ɔ he ngɛ ye matsɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ hi sɛhi a nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kojo Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ.” Yesu gba Petro kuami ngɔ to “Simon, Simon, oʼɛ, Satan bi blɔ, konɛ e sa nyɛ mi kaa ngma; se imi lɛɛ i kpa pɛɛ ha mo, konɛ o hemi kɛ yemi ko ta; nɛ mo hu, ke o kpale ɔ, wo o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ he wami.” Se Petro de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, i dla ye he ngɔ to nɛ ke tsu mi oo, gbenɔ mi oo, nɛ i kɛ mo maa ya.” Nɛ Yesu ke: “Petro, i ngɛ mo de ke mwɔnɛ kungwɔ be nɔ kpae, nɛ o ma kua si etɛ ke o li mi.” Sika kpɛɛ kɛ kotoku kɛ klaate Nɛ Yesu bi mɛ ke: “Benɛ i tsɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ we sika kpɛɛ kɛ kotoku kɛ tokotahi ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko hia nyɛ lo?” Nɛ a ke: “Nɔ ko nɔ ko hia we wɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Se jeha nɛ ɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ sika kpɛɛ ɔ, e ngɔ; ja nɔuu hu nɔ nɛ ngɛ kotoku.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ be klaate ɔ, e jua e tade nɛ e kɛ he eko.
Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ́ nɛ a ngma nɛ ɔ hu ja e ba mi ngɛ ye he ke: ‘Nɛ a bu lɛ ngɔ si mlaa tɔli ɔmɛ a nɔ;’ ejakaa ye he sane ɔmɛ ma mi.” Nɛ a ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, oʼɛ klaatehi enyɔ.” Se e de mɛ ke: “E hiɛ.” Yesu sɔle Nɛ Yesu je kpo, nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Nuyoku ɔ nɔ ya; nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ e se.
Nɛ benɛ e su leje ɔ, e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ nyɛ ko sɛ ka mi.” Nɛ e sã e he si kɛ je a ngɔ maa pee tɛ fɔmi kɛmi, nɛ e kpla si, nɛ e sɔle ke: “Tsaatsɛ, ke o suɔ ɔ, je kplu nɛ ɔ kɛ je ye nɔ!
Se kɛ̃ ɔ pi bɔ nɛ i suɔ, se mohu bɔ nɛ mo o suɔ.” [ Nɛ bɔfo ko je hiɔwe ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ he wami.
Nɛ benɛ e he ngɛ lɛ hiae ɔ, e ha e sɔlemi ɔ mi wa.
Nɛ e he latsa plɛ kaa muɔloku nɛ ngɛ tslee kɛ ngɛ si puee.]
Nɛ benɛ e te si kɛ je sɔlemi ɔ mi nɛ e ba e kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, e ba na mɛ kaa a ngɛ mahɛ hwɔe ngɛ aywlɛho nya; nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mahɛ hwɔe?
Nyɛɛ te si nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ nyɛ ko sɛ ka mi.” A nu Yesu Benɛ Yesu ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, oʼɛ asafo ko, nɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yuda a nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e hɛ lɛ su Yesu he konɛ e fiɔ e nya he.
Se Yesu de lɛ ke: “Yuda, o kɛ nya he fiɔmi ngɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ se blɔ tsɔɔe?” Nɛ benɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ na nɔ nɛ ma a, a de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, wa ja klaate lo?” Nɛ a ti nɔ kake ja osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a tsɔlɔ ɔ klaate nɛ e po e hiɛ ɔ nɔ tue.
Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Enɛ ɔ hiɛ.” Nɛ e ta e tue ɔ he nɛ e tsa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ sɔlemi we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ ma lɛ numi ɔ ke: “Ye nɔ nyɛ je kpo kɛ ba lɛ klaatehi kɛ tsohi kaa a baa awiyelɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ?
Daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ wo we nyɛ nine nɔ ngɛ ye nɔ; se nyɛ ngmlɛfia a kɛ diblii ɔ he wami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Petro kua Yesu Kɛkɛ nɛ a nu Yesu nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ho osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi ya.
Se Petro nyɛɛ se ngɛ lokoo.
Nɛ benɛ a slɛ la ngɛ mɔ ɔ kpo ɔ kpɛti nɛ a ho hi si ngɛ he ɔ, Petro hu ho ya hi si ngɛ a kpɛti.
Nɛ yiheyo ko na lɛ nɛ e hii si ngɛ la a he, nɛ e hyɛ lɛ too nɛ e ke: “Nyumu nɛ ɔ hu kɛ lɛ nɛ ngɛ.” Se Petro kua nɛ eke: “Maa, i li lɛ!” Lɔ ɔ se bɔɔ ɔ, nɔ kpa hu na lɛ nɛ e ke: “Mo hu a ti nɔ ko ji mo.” Se Petro ke: “Tsaatsɛ, pi a ti nɔ ko ji mi!” Lɔ ɔ se maa pee ngmlɛfia kake ɔ, nɔ kpa hu ma nɔ mi veveeve ke: “Niinɛ kaa nyumu nɛ ɔ hu kɛ lɛ nɛ ngɛ; ejakaa Galileano hu ji lɛ!” Se Petro ke: “Tsaatsɛ, i li nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ!” Nɛ amlɔ nɔuu, benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, kungwɔ kpa nɔ.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ plɛ e he, nɛ e hyɛ lɛ nɛ Petro kai Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Kungwɔ be nɔ kpae, nɛ o ma kpa ngɛ ye se si etɛ” ɔ. Nɛ Petro je kpo, nɛ e ya fo ya wawɛɛ.
A ye Yesu he fɛu, nɛ a fia lɛ ni Nihi nɛ hɛɛ Yesu mi ɔ ye e he fɛu, nɛ a fia lɛ ni.
Nɛ a fi e hɛ mi, nɛ a gba e hɛ mi ma, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Gbaa, mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ gba mo ma a?” Nɛ a de ni kpahi fuu kɛ bɔ musu ngɔ si lɛ.
Yesu ngɛ gua a hɛ mi Benɛ je na a, ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a nya ba bua, nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ho a gua a hɛ mi ya, nɛ a ke: “Ke mo ji Kristo ɔ, de wɔ.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ke i de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ be hee maa ye; nɛ ke sane ko nɛ i bi hu, nyɛ be mi heto hae.
Se kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa hi Mawu he wami ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a ke: “Lɛɛ, tse mo ji Mawu bi ɔ?” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee; ami ʼi.” Se a ke: “Mɛni wa pa ngɛ odase yeli hlae yaa pee?
ejakaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu kɛ je e nya.”
Yesu ngɛ Pilato hɛ mi Nɛ asafo mluku ɔ tsuo te si nɛ a kpaka Yesu kɛ ya Pilato ngɔ.
Nɛ a bɔni e nya pomi ke: “Wa na nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ wa ma a yi puɛe nɛ e ngɛ onia tsumi kɛ Kaisare hami gue, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke lɛ nitsɛ ji Kristo, matsɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ Pilato bi lɛ ke: “Ane mo ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ lo?” Nɛ Yesu ha lɛ heto kɛ: “Mo lɛ o de.” Nɛ Pilato de osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ asafo ɔmɛ ke: “I nɛ fɔ bumi sane ko ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ he.” Se a kã nɔ pe kekle ɔ, nɛ a ke: “E ngɛ ma a mi hliihlii woe kɛ e ni tsɔɔmi ngɛ Yudea tsuo, nɛ e bɔni kɛ je Galilea kɛ ba su hiɛ ɔ.” Yesu ngɛ Herode hɛ mi Se benɛ Pilato nu Galilea he ɔ, e bi ke: “Nyumu ɔ nɛɛ, Galileano ʼi lo?” Nɛ benɛ e na le kaa e je Herode nɔ yemi he ɔ, e ha a kɛ lɛ ho Herode nɔ nɛ ba Yerusalem ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ngɔ ya.
Benɛ Herode na Yesu ɔ, e na bua jɔmi babauu, ejakaa tsa pi mwɔnɛ nɛ e je bɔni lɛ hlami nɛ e na, ejakaa e nu e he sanehi fuu, nɛ e hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e maa pee nyakpɛ nɔ ko nɛ e na.
Nɛ e bi lɛ munyuhi fuu, se e ha we lɛ kake po heto.
Nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ba da si nɛ a po e nya babauu.
Nɛ benɛ Herode kɛ e aslaafo ɔmɛ bɔ lɛ ahlua nɛ a ye e he fɛu, nɛ a wo lɛ tade saminyayoo ko ɔ, e ha a kɛ lɛ ho Pilato ngɔ ya ekohu.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ nɔuu nɛ Pilato kɛ Herode nu huɛ, se jinɛ sa a akɛ a he yi.
A bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ Nɛ Pilato tsɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ma a kɛ ba kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ ba ha mi ke e ngɛ ma a yi puɛe, nɛ oʼɛ, i hla e sane ɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi, se i nɛ fɔ bumi sane ko ngɛ e he ngɛ sanehi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ba po e nya a eko eko mi.
Nɛ Herode hu nɛ́ eko, ejakaa e kpale lɛ kɛ ba, akɛnɛ e pee we nɔ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ma ha nɛ a fia lɛ kpa nɛ ma ngmɛɛ e he.” [ Se daa nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, Pilato ngmɛɔ nɔ kake he ngɔ haa mɛ.]
Se mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Gbee nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ o ngmɛɛ Baraba he ngɔ ha wɔ!” (Nɔ ko nɛ atua ko nɛ a tsɔ ngɛ ma a mi kɛ awi yemi he nɛ a wo lɛ tsu mi ɔ.)
Se akɛnɛ Pilato ngɛ hlae nɛ e ngmɛɛ Yesu he he je ɔ, e kɛ mɛ tu munyu e kohu.
Se a kpale kpa ngmlaa ekohu ke: “Sɛu, sɛu lɛ!” Pilato bi mɛ nɔ nɛ ji si etɛ ke: “Se nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ mɛni yayami e pee?
I nɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ ngɛ e he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ ma ha a fia lɛ kpa nɛ ma ngmɛɛ e he.” Se a ka nɔ kɛ gbi wawɛɛ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a sɛu lɛ; nɛ a gbi ɔ kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a nɔ ɔ ye nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato po sane ɔ yi ke a pee bɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ. Nɛ e ngmɛɛ nɔ nɛ atua tsɔmi kɛ awi yemi he nɛ a wo lɛ tsu mi nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ he; se Yesu ɔ lɛɛ, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ngɛ a hlami ɔ nya.
Yesu sɛumi Benɛ a kpaka Yesu kɛ yaa a, a nu Simon, Kireeneno ko, nɛ je ngmɔ si kɛ ma a, nɛ a wo sɛumi tso ɔ ngɔ tloo lɛ, nɛ e kɛ nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Nɛ ma a mi nihi fuu kɛ yihi hu nɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee nɛ ngɛ e he ya foe ɔ nyɛɛ e se.
Se Yesu plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ ha mɛ n e ke: “Yerusalem bi yi, nyɛ ko fo ya ha mi; se mohu nyɛ fo ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he kɛ nyɛ bimɛ.
Ejakaa oʼɛ, be ma nɛ a ma de ke: ‘A gbaa yosahi kɛ muklii nɛ fɔ we hyɛ kɛ nyɔhi nɛ a pupɔ we hyɛ!’ Lɛ be ɔ mi ɔ, a ma bɔni yo ɔmɛ demi ke: ‘Nyɛ ba nɔ wa nɔ!’ kɛ yoku ɔmɛ hu ke: ‘Nyɛ ba ha wa nɔ!’ Ejakaa ke tso mumu nɛ a pee enɛ ɔ ɔ, tso gbligbli ɔ lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee lɛ kɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpaka yayami peeli kpa enyɔ hu ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ho nɛ a ya gbe mɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a su he nɛ a tsɛɛ Yikoklodonya a, a sɛu lɛ kɛ yayami peeli ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɔ kake ngɛ e hiɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake hu ngɛ e muɔ nɔ.
Nɛ Yesu de ke: “Tsaatsɛ kɛ pa mɛ, se a li nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ.” Nɛ a fɔ̃ sɔ kɛ dla e tade ɔmɛ.
Nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ hyɛe.
Nɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ hu li lɛ de ke: “E heɔ ni kpahi a yi wami, ke lɛ ji Kristo nɔ nɛ Mawu hla a, ha nɛ e he lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami!” Nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ hu ye e he fɛu, nɛ a ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba ha lɛ dã nɛ kua, nɛ a ke: “Ke mo ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ, he mo nitsɛ o yi wami!” Nɛ a ngma a he sane ko hu ngɛ e yi je ke: “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ yayami peeli nɛ a sɛu ɔ a ti nɔ kake bɔ lɛ ahlua ke: “Ke mo ji Kristo ɔ, je mo nitsɛ o he kɛ wɔ hulɔ!” Se nɔ kpa a he nɔ nɛ e ka e hɛ mi ke: “Anɛ mo hu nɛ o ngɛ fɔ bumi kake ɔ nɔuu mi nɛ ɔ, o yi Mawu gbeye lo?
Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nɔ ɔ sa wɔ, ejakaa wa ni peemi nihi a he hiɔwo wa na a nɛ; se nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e pee we nɔ ko nɛ sɛ́.” Nɛ e de Yesu ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaii mi, benɛ o maa ba ngɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ.” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Niinɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ke: Mwɔnɛ o kɛ mi maa hi Paradeiso!” Yesu gbenɔ Nɛ piani maa pee ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi ɔ, diblii wo ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo kɛ ya su gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ mi; nɛ pu tsɔ diblii, nɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi pomi bo ɔ mi gba ngɛ kpɛti tutuutu.
Nɛ Yesu kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛ, o dɛ mi i ngɛ ye mumi ɔ tue kɛ ngɛ woe nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Nɛ benɛ e de kikɛ ɔ, e ngɔ e nya.
Se benɛ aslaafohi lafa a nya tsɛ ɔ na nɔ nɛ a pee ɔ, e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami nɛ e ke: “E ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ ɔ dalɔ ʼi!” Nɛ nihi nɛ ba ni hyɛmi ɔ tsuo, benɛ a na nihi nɛ a pee ɔ, a si a gugue nɛ a kpale a se.
Se nihi nɛ le Yesu ɔ tsuo kɛ “yihi nɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ je Galilea a hu daa si ngɛ se banee ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ hyɛe.
Yesu pumi Nɛ oʼɛ, nyumu ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yosef, nɛ ji kpe ngua a mi nɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa kɛ dalɔ, nɛ je Arimatia, Yudafo ɔmɛ a ma a eko nɔ; lɛɛ e kplɛɛ we a yi mi tomi kɛ a nipeemi ni ɔmɛ, na e ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ blɔ nyɛɛ.
Lɛ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Pilato ngɔ ya nɛ e ya kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e ngɔ Yesu gbogboe ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ; nɛ e je lɛ kɛ kple si, nɛ e ngɔ kploba ngɔ blaa lɛ, nɛ e ya to lɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ nɛ a kpɛ ngɛ tɛ sa nɛ a tui nɔ ko ngɛ mi hyɛ ɔ mi.
Nɛ lɛ ligbi ɔ Hedlami kɛ tomi ligbi ʼi, nɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ su ta.
Nɛ yi ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ Yesu je Galilea ba a nyɛɛ se, nɛ a ba hyɛ pumi he ɔ kɛ bɔ nɛ a to e gbogboe ɔ ha a. Nɛ a kpale a se nɛ a ya dla tsopa kɛ e he via, nɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ a pee kpoo ngɛ Mlaa a nya.
Yesu sitemi Otsi ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ mɔtu mla a, yi ɔmɛ ba yɔkɔ ɔ he, nɛ a hɛɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a dla to ɔ kɛ ba.
Nɛ a na kaa a kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ nya; se benɛ a sɛ mi ɔ, a nɛ́ Mawetsɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ. Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ a pee yaa ngɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, oʼɛ, nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ wo tade klaiklai ba da a kasa nya.
Se benɛ a ngɛ gbeye yee nɛ a ma a hɛ̃ si ɔ, nyumu ɔmɛ de mɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hɛ kalɔ ɔ hlae ngɛ ni gbogboehi a kpɛti?
E be hiɛ ɔ, se mohu e te si!
Nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ e de nyɛ benɛ e ngɛ Galilea a, ke: ‘Ja a ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ wo yayami peeli a dɛ mi, nɛ a sɛu lɛ, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ nɛ e te si ekohu.’ ” Nɛ a kai e munyu ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ he, nɛ a ya sɛɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ha ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ.
Se Maria Magdalena kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria kɛ yihi nɛ piɛ a he ɔ ji nihi nɛ ba sɛɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ pee kaa nyazia ngɛ a tue mi, nɛ a he we yi.
Se Petro te si nɛ e sa fo kɛ ya yɔkɔ ɔ he; nɛ benɛ e kɔkɔ e yi si nɛ e hyɛ mi ɔ e na kploba amɛ nɛ a pueɔ si ekpa ekpa.
Nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho we mi ya, nɛ e nya kpɛ e he ngɛ nɔ nɛ ba a he.
Sislami kɛ Emao yami Nɛ oʼɛ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ nɔuu ɔ, a kpɛti ni enyɔ ngɔ pue nɔ kɛ yaa kɔpe ko nɛ kɛ Yerusalem kemi maa pee sitomi nya kpaago nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Emao ɔ mi.
Nɛ a ngɛ hihi nɛ ba amɛ kulaa a he ni sɛɛe ngɛ a kpɛti.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ sɛɛe nɛ a ngɛ a he sanehi bie ɔ, Yesu nitsɛ ba na mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ.
Se a ha a hɛngmɛhi a nɔ nɛ a ko yo lɛ.
Nɛ Yesu bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ sɛɛe ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ?” Nɛ a da si kɛ a hɛ mi mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Nɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kleopa a ha heto nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Anɛ mo pɛ ji nibwɔ ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ li sanehi nɛ ba lejɛ ɔ ngɛ be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ lo?” Nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni sanehi?” Nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Yesu Nazareno ɔ nɛ ji gbalɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ ni tsumi kɛ munyu tumi mi ngɛ Mawu kɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi ɔ he sane ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ wa osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ wa ma nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ lɛ ha nɛ a bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ a sɛu lɛ ɔ.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa jinɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma kpɔ Israel ɔ nɛ; nɛ enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, mwɔnɛ ji ligbi etɛ nɛ a pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ.
Se jeha nɛ ɔ wa ti yi komɛ hu ha wa nya kpɛ wa he, ejakaa a ya yɔkɔ ɔ he mla mi, nɛ benɛ a nɛ́ e gbogboe ɔ, a ba nɛ a ba de ke bɔfohi komɛ hu je a he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a de ke e hɛ ngɛ.
Nɛ nihi nɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ya yɔkɔ ɔ he, nɛ a ya na kaa bɔ nɛ yi ɔmɛ de ɔ nɔuu; se Yesu ɔ nɛ a nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Oo kuasiahi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ siɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ngɛ nihi tsuo nɛ gbali ɔmɛ de ɔ hemi kɛ yemi he.
Anɛ pi nɛ e sa kaa Kristo ɔ nɛ na amanehlu nɛ ɔmɛ konɛ e sɛ e nyami ɔ mi lo?” Nɛ e bɔni kɛ je Mose kɛ gbali ɔmɛ kulaa nɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ tsuo mi ngɛ e he ɔ sisi.
Nɛ a su kɔpe nɛ a yaa a, nɛ e pee kaa nɔ nɛ e yaa e hɛ kpɛ.
Nɛ a nyɛ e nɔ, nɛ a ke: “O kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si, ejakaa je ngɛ jɔe nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ du ma bu.” Nɛ e ya kɔpe ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya hi si.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ e kɛ mɛ hii si ngɛ niyeni ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo nɛ e gbaa nɔ, nɛ e kuɔ mi nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ a hɛngmɛ bli nɛ a yo lɛ; se e laa ngɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu.
Nɛ a de a he ke: “Anɛ wa tsui he dɔɛ la ngɛ wa mi benɛ e kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi ɔ?” Nɛ a te si ngɛ lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ a ba na ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ a bua a he nya; nɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ de mɛ ke: “E ngɛ mi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ te si, nɛ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ Simon.” Nɛ mɛ hu a bɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a yo lɛ ngɛ abolo mi kuɔmi ɔ mi ɔ. Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ Nɛ benɛ a ngɛ munyu ɔ tue nɔuu ɔ, Yesu nitsɛ ba da a kpɛti nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ he manye!” Se a hɛli si nɛ a ye gbeye, a susu kaa kpade a ngɛ nae ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nyɛ tsui ngɛ poe?
Nɛ mɛni he je hulɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ jee ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ ye ninehi kɛ ye nanehi kaa imi nitsɛ ʼi; nyɛɛ ta ye he nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ; ejakaa kpade ko be he lo kɛ wu kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe kaa i ngɛ nɛ ɔ.” Nɛ benɛ e de enɛ ɔ ɔ, e ngɔ e ninehi kɛ e nanehi ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Se benɛ a he we yi kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ bua jɔmi sɔuu he nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa a, e bi mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ a yeɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ lo?” Nɛ a ha lɛ lo kpɔ fã ko nɛ a hoo; nɛ e sɔle, nɛ e ye ngɛ a hɛ mi.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Enɛ ɔmɛ ji ye munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ lolo ɔ nɛ, kaa ja nihi kulaa nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ kɛ La amɛ a mi ngɛ ye he ɔ na ba mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e bli a juɛmi nya, konɛ a na ngmami ɔmɛ a nya.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Bɔ nɛ a ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa Kristo nɛ na amanehlu nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ a fiɛ tsui tsakemi kɛ yayami pami ngɛ e biɛ ɔ mi ngɔ tsɔɔ mahi tsuo, nɛ a bɔni kɛ je Yerusalem.
Nɛ nyɛ ji kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase yeli.
Nɛ oʼɛ, i ngɛ hae nɛ Tsaatsɛ si womi ɔ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ Yerusalem ma a mi kɛ ya su be nɛ a maa je hiɔwe ba wo nyɛ he wami.” A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho hiɔwe ya Nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ je kpo kɛ ho Betania kasa nya ya, nɛ e wo e ninehi a nɔ nɛ e gbaa mɛ.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ e ngɛ mɛ gbaae ɔ, e je a ngɔ nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya.
Nɛ a ja lɛ, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya kɛ bua jɔmi babauu; nɛ a ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ daa nɛ ɔ, nɛ a jɔɔ we Mawu yi jemi kɛ lɛ gbaami.
Wami munyu Sisi je ɔ mi ɔ Munyu ɔ ngɛ, nɛ munyu ɔ kɛ Mawu lɛ ngɛ, nɛ Munyu ɔ Mawu ʼi.
Lɛ nɔuu sisije ɔ e kɛ Mawu ngɛ.
Lɛ e nɔ a gu kɛ pee nihi kulaa, nɛ a si we lɛ se kɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
E mi wami ngɛ, nɛ wami ɔ ji nimli a la a nɛ; nɛ la a ngɛ tsoe ngɛ diblii ɔ mi, nɛ diblii ɔ nyɛ we nya nɛ e da.
Nyumu ko ngɛ nɛ Mawu tsɔ lɛ kɛ ba, a tsɛɛ lɛ Yohane.
Lɛɛ odase yemi he nɛ e ba, nɛ e ba ye la a he odase, kone nihi kulaa nɛ gu e nɔ nɛ a he ye.
Pi lɛ ji la a; se mohu la a he odase yemi he nɛ e ba.
La nitse nɛ tsoo haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ lɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.
Je ɔ mi e ngɛ, nɛ e nɔ a gu kɛ pee je ɔ, se je ɔ li lɛ.
Lɛ nitse e nihi a ngɔ e ba, nɛ nihi nɛ ji lɛ nitse e ni ɔmɛ he we lɛ.
Se nihi abɔ nɛ he lɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ heɔ e biɛ ɔ nɔ ye ɔ, e ha mɛ he blɔ kaa a pee Mawu bimɛ, nihi nɛ pi muɔ loo he loo nyumu ko suɔmi nya, se mohu Mawu mi a je kɛ fɔ mɛ.
Nɛ Munyu ɔ plɛ he lo, nɛ e ba hi wa kpɛti, nɛ wa na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kaa Tsɛ ɔ Bi kaketoo ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ dloomi kɛ anɔkuale hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Yohane ye e he odase nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ke: “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ngɛ e he ke: ‘Nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ ye se ɔ, e pa mi’ ejakaa e ngɛ loko i ngɛ.” Ejakaa e hyi mi ɔ mi je nɛ wɔ tsuo wa na dloomi ngɔ si dloomi nɔ.
Ejakaa Mlaa a Mose nɔ a gu nɛ a ngɔ ha, se dloomi kɛ anɔkuale ɔ, Yesu Kristo nɔ e gu kɛ ba.
Mawu ɔp nɔ ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ; Bi kaketoo nɛ ngɛ Tsɛ o mi si ɔ, lɛ nɛ e ba je lɛ si ngɔ tsɔɔ paa.
