Yohane Baptisilɔ ɔ fiɛmi Enɛ ɔ ji Yohane odase nɛ e ye, bene Yudafo ɔmɛ tsɔ osɔfohi kɛ Levibihi kɛ je Yerusalem nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ ji mo?” ɔ. Nɛ e gba mi paa nɛ e laa we nɔ, nɛ e gba mi de ke: “Tsa pi imi ji Kristo ɔ.” Nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ ji mo mɔ?
Elia ji mo lo?” Nɛ e ke: “Tsa pi lɛ ji mi.” “Gbalɔ ji mo lo?” Nɛ e he nɔ ke: “Dɛbi.” Jeha nɛ ɔ a bi lɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ ji mo?
konɛ wa na heto ko kɛ ya ha ninɛmɛ nɛ tsɔ wɔ ɔ. Kɛ o deɔ ngɛ mo nitse o he kɛɛ?” E ke: “Imi ji nɔ nɛ gbi nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ nga a nɔ ke: ‘Nyɛ dla Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ,’ kaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaia de ɔ.” Ninɛmɛ nɛ atsɔ ɔ je Farisifo ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke: “Ke pi mo ji Kristo ɔ, loo Elia loo gbalɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je o ngɛ baptisie mɔ?” Yohane he nɔ ke: “Imi lɛɛ i baptisii ngɛ nyu mi, se nɔ ko daa si ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li lɛ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ ye se, se e sɛ ye hlami, nɔ nɛ i sɛ kaa i pɛneɔ e tokota nya kpa a.” A pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Betania ngɛ Yordan se, he nɛ Yohane ngɛ baptisie ngɛ ɔ. Mawu To Bi ɔ E nɔ je na a, Yohane na Yesu ma e ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Oʼɛ Mawu To bi ɔ nɛ woɔ je ɔ he yayami ɔ kɛ yaa a!
Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ngɛ e he ke: ‘Nyumu ko ma ngɛ ye se, nɛ e pã mi,’ ejakaa e ngɛ loko i ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ imi lɛɛ i li lɛ, se mohu bene pee nɛ a je lɛ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Israel he je nɛ i ba ngɛ baptisie ngɛ nyu mi nɔ nɛ.” Yohane ye odase ke: “I na Mumi ɔ nɛ kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kaa lahuɛ, nɛ e ba ma e nɔ.
Nɛ imi lɛɛ i li lɛ, se nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba baptisi ngɛ nyu mi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e de mi ke: ‘Nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ o maa na kaa Mumi ɔ ngɛ kplee nɛ e ngɛ e nɔ hie ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ baptisii ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi ɔ nɛ.’ Nɛ i na, nɛ i ye he odase kaa lɛ ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ.” Yesu kekleekle kaseli ɔmɛ E nɔ je na nɔ ɔ, Yohane kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ daa si, nɛ bene Yesu bee ɔ, e hyɛ lɛ nɛ e ke: “Oʼɛ Mawu lo Bi ɔ!” Nɛ kaseli enyɔ ɔmɛ nu e munyu ɔ, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Yesu plɛ e he nɛ benɛ e na kaa a nyɛɛ e se ɔ, e bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” Nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Rabi” (e sisi ji Tsɔɔlɔ) “jije o hii?” E de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ.” A ya nɛ a ya na he nɛ e hii ɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ hi si jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Nɛ gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ eywiɛ mi ʼi.
Ni enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nu nɛ Yohane tu munyu ɔ nɛ a ya nyɛɛ e se ɔ a ti nɔ kake ji Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi ɔ. Andrea ya na lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi Simon kekle, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Wa na Mesia a.” (E sisi ji Kristo, loo cnɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu.)
Nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba Yesu ngɔ.
Nɛ benɛ Yesu hyɛ lɛ ɔ, e ke: “Mo ji Simon, Yona bi ɔ, a ma tsɛ mo Kefa.” (E sisi ji Petro loo tɛ sa.)
Yesu tsɛ Filipo kɛ Natanael Je na nɔ ɔ, Yesu to e yi mi kaa e maa ya Galilea, nɛ e na Filipo, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ye se!” Filipo je Betsaida, Andrea kɛ Petromɛ a ma a mi.
Filipo hu na Natanael, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Wa na nɔ nɛ Mose ngma e he sane ngɛ Mlaa a mi, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu ngma e he sane ɔ, Yesu, Yosef bi nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.” Nɛ Natanael de Filipo ke: “Anɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko ma nyɛ Nazaret maa je lo?” Filipo de lɛ ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ.” Yesu na Natanael ma e ngɔ, nɛ e de ngɛ e he ke: “Oʼɛ anɔkuale Israelno, nɔ nɛ sisimi be e mi.” Natanael bi Yesu ke: “Jije o le mi ngɛ?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “I na mo loko Filipo tsɛ mo, be mi nɛ o ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ sisi ɔ.” Natanael he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Rabi, mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ, mo ji Israel matsɛ ɔ nɛ!” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nɛ i de mo ke i na mo ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ sisi ɔ he je o heɔ yeɔ nɛ ɔ?
O maa na ni nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔ.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa na kaa hiɔwe nya bli nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ si kplee ngɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ.”
Yokpeemi ngɛ Kana E nɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, a kpee yo ngɛ Kana ngɛ Galilea, nɛ Yesu nyɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ a kpee Yesu hu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ya yo kpeemi ɔ. Nɛ bene wai ɔ sui ɔ, Yesu nyɛ de lɛ ke: “A be wai.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Maa, mɛni sane i kɛ mo ngɛ?
Ye ngmlɛfia a sui lolo.” E nyɛ de sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ke: “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ma de nyɛ ɔ nyɛɛ pee.” Ngmawe ekpa maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he fɔmi he; kake peɔ paya buɛhi enyɔ loo etɛ.
Yesu de sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ wo ngmawe ɔmɛ a mi nyu nɛ a hyi.” Nɛ a wo a mi nyu nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ yɛ eko ya ha da nya dalɔ ɔ.” Nɛ a kɛ ya.
Se bene da nya dalɔ ɔ sa e nya nyu nɛ plɛ wai ɔ nɛ e li he nɛ a kɛ je se sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nɛ yɛ nyu ɔ kɛke lɛ a le ɔ, e tsɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, wai kpakpa e kɛ ba maa si kekle, nɛ bene ni ɔmɛ tɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ se loko a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɛ ɔ baa; se moo lɛɛ o ngɔ wai kpakpa a mohu ngɔ to kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ.” Enɛ ɔ Yesu kɛ je e nyakpɛ ni ɔmɛ a sisi ngɛ Kana ngɛ Galilea, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ, nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ he e nɔ ye.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Kapernaum ya, lɛ kɛ e nyɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ, se a yi ligbi fuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a Hetsɔmi ɔ su ta nɛ Yesu ya Yerusalem.
E ya na nihi nɛ ngɛ nahi kɛ tohi kɛ lahuɛhi juae kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ sika tsakee hulɔ nɛ a hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Nɛ e ngɔ tangme tsɔwi nɛ e kɛ pee kplibi nɛ e kɛ fie mɛ tsuo kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ tohi kɛ na amɛ; nɛ e plɛ sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a sika a ngɔ pue si, nɛ e tsitsɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si; nɛ e de ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lahuɛ ɔmɛ juae ɔ ke: “Nyɛ je ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ; nyɛ ko ngɔ Tsaatsɛ we ɔ ngɔ pee jua nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kai kaa a ngma ke: “O we ɔ he hɛdɔ ɔ maa ye mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Mɛni okadi o kɛ ngɛ wɔ tsɔɔe kaa o ngɛ he blɔ nɛ o peɔ enɛ ɔmɛ?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ku sɔlemi tsu nɛ ɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛ mi ɔ ma ma ekohu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: “Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ekpa a kɛ ma sɔlemi tsu nɛ ɔ, nɛ moo lɛɛ ligbi etɛ o kɛ maa ma lo?” Se lɛɛ e nɔmlɔ tso sɔlemi tsu ɔ he munyu e ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ benɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ kai kaa e de enɛ ɔ, nɛ a he ngmami ɔ kɛ munyu nɛ Yesu tu ɔ ye.
Yesu le nihi tsuo Jeha nɛ ɔ, benɛ Yesu ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ Hetsɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nihi fuu na nyakpɛ nihi nɛ e pee ɔ, nɛ a he e biɛ ɔ nɔ ye.
Se Yesu nitsɛ lɛɛ e kɛ e he fɔɛ a nɔ, ejakaa e le mɛ tsuo.
Nɛ e hia we lɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ye nɔmlɔ he odase ngɔ ha lɛ, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ mi.
Yesu kɛ Nikodemo Nyumu ko ngɛ nɛ je Farisifo ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nikodemo nɛ ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma.
Lɛ lɛ e ba Yesu ngɔ nyɔ mi, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke: “Rabi, wa le kaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ba ji mo, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee nyakpɛ nihi nɛ o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔmɛ, kaa ja Mawu kɛ nɔ ɔ ngɛ.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke: Ke a ji hiɔwe fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ, e be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nae.” Nikodemo bi lɛ ke: “Kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ benɛ nɔmlɔ bwɔ ɔ nɛ a ma fɔ lɛ hu?
Anɛ e ma nyɛ e nyɛ muklii mi maa sɛ ekohu nɛ a fɔ lɛ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuɛle mi ke: Ke a ji nyu kɛ Mumi mi fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ, e be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi nyɛe maa sɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ a je he lo mi fɔ ɔ, he lo ʼi; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a je Mumi mi fɔ ɔ, Mumi ʼi.
O hɛ mi ko pee mo yaa kaa i de mo enɛ ɔ ke: ‘Ja a je hiɔwe fɔ nyɛ’ ɔ. Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, he nɛ e suɔ e fiaa kɛ yaa, nɛ e fiami o nuɔ, se o li he nɛ e jee kɛ he nɛ e yaa: ja ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a je Mumi mi fɔ lɛ.” Nikodemo he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Tse Israel tsɔɔlɔ ji mo nɛ o li enɛ ɔmɛ?
I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ́ nɛ wa le ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ wa deɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa na a, kɔlɔ ɔ he odase wa yeɔ, se nyɛ ngɔɛ wa odase ɔ. Ke i de nyɛ zugba nɔ nihi nɛ nyɛ he we yi ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ke ide nyɛ hiɔwe nihi ɔ nɛ nyɛ ma he ye?
Nɔ ko kue kɛ yɛ hiɔwe, kaa ja nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kple si ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.” Nɛ bɔ nɛ Mose wo sinɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu sa kaa a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ.
Konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ hɛ mi ko kpata, se mohu e na neneene wami.
Ejakaa Mawu suɔ je ɔ saminya, nɛ e ngɔ e bi kake ɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ hɛ mi ko kpata, se mohu e na neneene wami.
Ejakaa Mawu tsɔɛ e bi ɔ kɛ bɛ je ɔ mi konɛ e ba kojo je ɔ, se mohu konɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ he je ɔ yi wami.
Nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ, a kojo we lɛ, se nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ, a kojo lɛ momo, ejakaa e he we Mawu bi kake ɔ nɔ yi.
Se kojomi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa la a ba je ɔ mi, nɛ nimli suɔ diblii ɔ mohu pe la a, ejakaa a ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ yayami ʼi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni yayamihi ɔ nyɛɛ la a, nɛ e bɛ la a he, konɛ a ko je e ni tsumi ɔmɛ kpo.
Se nɔ nɛ peɔ anɔkuale nihi ɔ baa la a he, konɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ je kpo, ejakaa Mawu mi a tsu mɛ ngɛ.
Yesu kɛ Yohane Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yudea zugba a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba hi lejɛ ɔ nɛ e baptisii.
Nɛ Yohane hu ngɛ baptisie ngɛ Ainon, ngɛ Salim kasa nya, ejakaa nyu fuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nihi baa nɛ a baptisii mɛ; ejakaa lɛ be ɔ mi ɔ a wui Yohane tsu mi lolo.
Jeha nɛ ɔ nya sami ba te si ngɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ Yudafono ko kpɛti ngɛ he tsukɔmi he.
Nɛ a ba Yohane ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke: “Rabi, nɔ nɛ kɛ mo hi Yordan se nɛ o ye e he odase ɔ, oʼɛ, lɛ nitse e ngɛ baptisie, nɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ e ngɔ yae.” Yohane he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Nɔmlɔ be nyɛe ma na nɔ́ ko, ja a je hiɔwe ngɔ ha lɛ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ odase yee ha mi kaa i de ke ‘Pi imi ji Kristo ɔ, se mohu a tsɔ mi kɛ sɛ e hlami.’ Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ji ayɛflo ɔ, lɛ ji ayɛflo huno; se ayɛflo huno ɔ huɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lɛ tue bue ɔ, nya e nyaa ngɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ gbi he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ye kikɛmɛ a nyami nɛ ɔ ba mi.
Ja lɛɛ e ya nɔ, nɛ imi lɛɛ i ba si.” Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ba a pe nihi kulaa.
Nɔ nɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ, zugba a nɔ e je, nɛ zugba a he munyu e tuɔ.
Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ba a pe nihi kulaa, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e na nɛ e nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he odase e yeɔ; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔɛ e odase ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e odase ɔ yeɔ ɔ maa nɔ mi kaa anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ ɔ, Mawu munyu e tuɔ; ejakaa Mawu haa lɛ e Mumi ɔ faa.
Tsɛ ɔ suɔ Bi ɔ, nɛ e tu nihi kulaa ngɔ wo e dɛ.
Nɔ nɛ heɔ Bi ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ngɛ neneene wami; se nɔ nɛ bui Bi ɔ tue ɔ, e be wami nae, se mohu Mawu mi mi fumi hii e nɔ.
Yesu kɛ Samaria yo ɔ Benɛ Yesu na le kaa Farisifo ɔmɛ nu kaa e ngɛ kaseli nae nɛ e ngɛ nihi babauu baptisie pe Yohane ɔ, (pohu Yesu nitse ɔ lɛɛ e baptisi we, se mohu e kaseli ɔmɛ lɛ a baptisii) e je Yudea nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ yaa Galilea ekohu.
Se ja e gu Samaria.
Jeha nɛ ɔ e ba su ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sikar a he, ngɛ zugba kpɔ ko nɛ Yakob ngɔ ha e bi Yosef ɔ kasa nya.
Yakob vu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ akɛnɛ pɔ tɔ Yesu kɛ blɔ ɔ nyɛɛmi he je ɔ, e be ya hi si ngɛ vu ɔ he.
E maa pee ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi.
Samaria yo ko ba nyu yɛmi, nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ha mi nyu ɔ eko nɛ ma nu.” (Ejakaa e kaseli ɔmɛ ho ma a mi ya nɛ e yaa he niyeni.)
Nɛ Samaria yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ mo Yudano ɔ, o ngɛ mi Samariano ɔ nyu bae nɛ o nu ɔ?” (Ejakaa Yudafohi kɛ Samariabihi yi.)
Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Kaa o le Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ mo dee ke: ‘Ha mi eko ma nu’ ɔ, jinɛ mo mohu o maa ba lɛ nɛ e ha mo wami nyu.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, o be nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ maa yɛ, nɛ vu ɔ hu mi kuɔ; jije o ma na wami nyu ɔ kɛ je mɔ?
Anɛ o pe wa tsɛ Yakob nɛ ha wɔ vu nɛ ɔ, nɛ lɛ nitse e nu mi nyu, kɛ e bimɛ kɛ e lohwe ɔmɛ ɔ lo?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuu nyu nɛ ɔ eko ɔ, kuma maa ye lɛ ekohu; se nɔ nɛ nuu nyu nɛ imi ma ha lɛ ɔ, kuma be lɛ yee gblee kɛ maa ya neneene; se mohu nyu nɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ ma plɛ nyu hɛngmɛ nɛ baa kɛ yaa neneene wami mi ngɛ e mi.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha mi nyu ɔ eko kone kuma ko ye mi, nɛ i ba hiɛ ɔ ba yɛ nyu hu.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Yaa nɛ o ya tsɛ o huno nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.” Yo ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “I be huno.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “O tu anɔkuale kaa o ke: ‘I be huno’ ɔ; ejakaa o hi hunomɛ enuɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ o kɛ ngɛ piɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, pi o huno; enɛ ɔ lɛɛ o tu anɔkuale.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, i na kaa gbalɔ ji mo.
Yoku nɛ ɔ nɔ wa tsɛmɛ sɔle ngɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ke Yerusalem ji he nɛ sa kaa a sɔle ngɛ.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Maa, he mi ngɔ ye kaa ngmlɛfia a ma nɛ pi yoku nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ pohu pi Yerusalem nɛ nyɛ ma ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ li nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ jae ɔ; wɔɔ lɛɛ, wa le nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ jae ɔ, ejakaa yi wami hemi ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ a ngɔ e je.
Se ngmlɛfia a ma nɛ e su momo benɛ anɔkuale jali ɔmɛ ma ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi kɛ anɔkuale mi, ejakaa nihi nɛ jaa lɛ kikɛ ɔ Tsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ hlae.
Mawu ɔ Mumi ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, ja a ja lɛ ngɛ mumi kɛ anɔkuale mi.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke: “I le kaa Mesia nɛ e tsɛɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ ma; nɛ ke e ba a, e maa sɛɛ wɔ nihi tsuo kulaa.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Imi nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue nɛ ɔ, ami ʼi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa e kɛ yo ngɛ munyu tue; se kɛ ɔ nɔ ko bi we lɛ ke: “Mɛni o ngɛ lɛ bie ɔ?” loo “Mɛni munyu o kɛ lɛ ngɛ tue ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ si e paya buɛ ɔ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho ma a mi ya, nɛ e ya de ni ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ nyumu ko nɛ jaje nihi tsuo nɛ i pee ɔ ngɔ ha mi, kaa pi Kristo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a je ma a mi nɛ a ba e ngɔ.
Lɛ be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke: “Rabi, ye nɔ́ ko.” Se e de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ ngma nɛ i yeɔ nɛ nyɛ li.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ bi a he ke: “Anɛ nɔ ko ba ha lɛ nɔ́ ko ye lo?” Yesu de mɛ ke: “Ye ngma ji kaa ma pee nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ni, nɛ ma gbe e ni tsumi ɔ nya.” “Anɛ nyɛ de we ke: ‘Epiɛ hlami eywiɛ nɛ blɛfo kpɔmi be maa su’?
oʼɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛ wo nyɛ hɛ nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ a gba futaa momo ha ni kpami.
Nɔ nɛ kpaa a naa e hiɔwo, nɛ e kpaneɔ yiblii ɔmɛ a nya ngɔ toɔ neneene wami, konɛ nɔ nɛ duɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ kpaa a tsuo a nya si kake.
Ejakaa enɛ ɔ mi nɛ munyu nɛ a de ke: ‘Nɔ ko duɔ nɛ nɔ ko kpaa’ a baa mi ngɛ.
Imi lɛɛ i tsɔ nyɛ konɛ nyɛ yakpa nɔ́ nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ gbo he dengme; ni kpahi tsu ni ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba ye mi ni.” Nɛ Samariabi ɔmɛ nɛ je jamɛ a ma a mi ɔ a ti nihi fuu he e nɔ ye ngɛ yo ɔ munyu nɛ e kɛ ye odase ke: “E de mi nihi kulaa nɛ i pee hyɛ” ɔ nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Samariabi ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ɔ, a ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e kɛ mɛ ba hi si; nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi enyɔ.
Nɛ nihi fuu nɛ pe kekletsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu he ye ngɛ lɛ nitse e munyu ɔ nya; nɛ a de yo ɔ ke: “Jeha nɛ ɔ wa ngɛ hee ngɛ yee, pi ngɛ o munyu ɔ nya hu; ejakaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu, nɛ wa na le kaa, niinɛ, nɔ nɛ ɔ ji je ɔ yi wami helɔ nɛ ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.” Yesu tsa ma nɔkɔtɔma ko bi nyumu ko Nɛ ligbi enyɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu pue nɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Galilea ya.
Ejakaa Yesu nitse ye odase ke gbalɔ ko hɛ mi be nyami ngɛ lɛ nitse e ma mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ e ba Galilea a, Galileabi ɔmɛ nɛ na nihi tsuo nɛ e pee ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ he lɛ hɛmuɔ, ejakaa mɛ hu a ya nyami ligbi ɔ yemi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ba Kana ngɛ Galilea, he nɛ e ha nyu plɛ wai ngɛ ɔ, ekohu.
Matsɛ wenyumu ko ngɛ Kapernaum nɛ e bi ngɛ gboe.
Nɛ benɛ e nu kaa Yesu je Yudea kɛ ba Galilea a, e ya e ngɔ nɛ e ya fa kue ha lɛ ke e ba nɛ e ba tsa e bi ɔ, ejakaa e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ke nyɛ nɛ́ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi ɔ, nyɛ he we yi.” Matsɛ wenyumu ɔ de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ba loko ye bi ɔ nɛ gbo.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Yaa, o bi ɔ yi na wa.” Nyumu ɔ he munyu nɛ Yesu de lɛ ɔ ye nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Nɛ benɛ e yaa a, e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ bakpe, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “O bi nyumu ɔ na he wami.” Nɛ e bi mɛ ngmlɛfia nɔ nɛ e bɔni he wami nami ɔ; nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Hiɛ piani ngmlɛ kake mi nɛ asla a po ngɛ e nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɛ ɔ kɛ na kaa lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “O bi ɔ he mi wa lɛ” ɔ; nɛ e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo he ye.
Enɛ ɔ ji nyakpɛ nihi enyɔ nɛ Yesu pee, be nɛ e je Yudea kɛ ba Galilea a.
Yesu tsa nyumu ko Enɛ ɔ se ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ nyami ligbi yee, nɛ Yesu ya Yerusalem.
Jeha nɛ ɔ taku ko ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ tohi agbo ɔ kasa nya, nɛ Hebri gbi mi ɔ a tsɛɛ lɛ Betesda, nɛ kue enuɔ ngɛ he.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a mi hiɔtsɛmɛ fuu, hɛ yuyuili, pɔtsɛmɛ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ hule pueɔ si ngɛ, [nɛ a ngɛ nyu ɔ mi klemi mlɛe.
Ejakaa be komɛ ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfo ko kpleɔ si kɛ baa taku ɔ mi, nɛ e ba klɛɔ nyu ɔ mi; kɛkɛ ɔ, o mi klemi ɔ se ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ya nɔɔ nyu ɔ mi kekle ɔ, hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ nɛ ngɛ e he ɔ tãa.]
Nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ hiɔ hɛɛ lɛ jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Nɛ benɛ Yesu na lɛ nɛ e fɔɔ si, nɛ e le kaa e se kɛ hluu ɔ, e bi lɛ ke: “O suɔ kaa o na he wami lo?” Hiɔtsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke: “Mawetsɛ, i be nɔ ko nɛ ke a ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi nɛ e ma wo mi ya fɔ taku ɔ mi; se ke i yaa a, nɔ kpa sɛɛ ye hlami ya nɔɔ mi.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Tee si, wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ!” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ he mi wa lɛ, nɛ e wo e sa a, nɛ e nyɛɛ.
Se lɛ ligbi ɔ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ʼi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ de nɔ nɛ a tsa a ke: “Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; o be he blɔ kaa o tloɔ o sa.” E he nɔ ke: “Nɔ nɛ tsa mi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ de mi ke: ‘Wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ.’ ” Jeha nɛ ɔ a bi lɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ de mo ke: ‘Wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ’ ɔ?” Se nɔ nɛ a tsa a li nɔ nɛ ji, ejakaa nihi fuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ Yesu sã e he si.
Pee se ɔ Yesu ya na lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, o na he wami; koo pee yayami hu, kone nɔ́ ko yaya nɛ pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ ko ba o nɔ.” Nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha Yudafo ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji nɔ nɛ tsa lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ je a hɛ ka Yesu, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe, ejakaa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ e pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛ ngɛ ni tsue kɛ mwɔɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ni tsue.” Enɛ ɔ he titli Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ nɛ, ejaksaa pi Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e ble, se mohu e tsɛ Mawu ke lɛ nitse e tsɛ, nɛ e kɛ Mawu sɔ.
Bi ɔ he blɔ nɛ e ngɛ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Bi ɔ nitse be e yi mi nyɛe maa to kɛ pee nɔ ko, ja nɔ nɛ se naa kaa Tsɛ ɔ peɔ ɔ; ejakaa nihi tsuo nɛ Tsɛ ɔ peɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu Bi ɔ hu peɔ.
Ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ suɔ Bi ɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ lɛ nihi kulaa nɛ lɛ nitse e peɔ ɔ, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ lɛ ni tsumi nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ tete, nɛ nyɛ nya maa kpɛ nyɛ he.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tleɔ ni gbogboehi a si nɛ e haa mɛ wami ɔ, ja kɛ̃ Bi ɔ hu haa nihi nɛ e suɔ ɔ wami.
Ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ kojo we nɔ ko, se e tu kojomi ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo Bi ɔ dɛ; konɛ nihi tsuo bu Bi ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a buu Tsɛ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ bui Bi ɔ, e bui Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ hulɔ.
“I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu nɛ e heɔ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ngɛ neneene wami, nɛ e be kojomi mi yae, se mohu e po mi ngɛ gbenɔ mi kɛ ho wami mi ya.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Ngmlɛfia a ma, nɛ e su ta, nɛ ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa nu Mawu Bi ɔ gbi, nɛ nihi nɛ nuɔ ɔ yi ma na wa.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ wami ngɛ lɛ nitse e mi ɔ, ja kɛ̃ e ha Bi ɔ hu ke e hi wami ngɛ lɛ nitse e mi.
Nɛ e ha lɛ he blɔ kaa e kojo hulɔ, ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ji lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ ko pee nyɛ nyakpɛ; ejakaa ngmlɛfia a ma, nɔ́ mi nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ maa nu e gbi, nɛ a maa je kpo, nihi nɛ pee kpakpa a maa te si kɛ maa ya wami mi, nɛ nihi nɛ tsu ni yayahi ɔ maa te si kɛ maa ya kojomi mi.” Yesu he odasefohi “Imi nitse i be ye yi mi nyɛe maa to kɛ pee nɔ ko; bɔ nɛ i nuɔ ɔ, ja i kojoɔ, nɛ ye kojomi ɔ dami kojomi ʼi, ejakaa i hia we nɔ́ nɛ imi nitsɛ i suɔ, se mohu nɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔ?
Ke imi nitsɛ ye he odase i yeɔ ɔ, ye odase ɔ pi anɔkuale.
Nɔ kpa ko ngɛ nɛ yeɔ ye he odase, nɛ i le kaa e odase nɛ e yeɔ ngɛ ye he ɔ anɔkuale ʼi!
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsɔ kɛ ya Yohane ngɔ, nɛ e ye anɔkuale ɔ he odase.
Se imi lɛɛ i ngɔɛ nɔmlɔ ko odase; se benɛ pee nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami he je i ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ dee ɔ nɛ.
Yohane ji kane nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ ngɛ kpee ɔ nɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ be kpiti kɛkɛ ngɛ e la a mi.
Se imi lɛɛ, i ngɛ odase nɛ pe Yohane nɔ ɔ, ejakaa ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi kaa ma gbe nya a, lɛ ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ nɔuu yeɔ ye he odase kaa Tsɛ ɔ lɛ tsɔ mi.
Nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ye ye he odase.
Nyɛ nui e gbi hyɛ ɔ, pohu nyɛ nɛ e subai hyɛ; nɛ e munyu ɔ nui si ngɛ nyɛ mi, ejakaa nya he we nɔ nɛ e tsɔ ɔ yi.
Nyɛ hla ngmami ɔmɛ a mi; ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ susuu kaa kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a mi nyɛ naa neneene wami ngɛ, nɛ kɔlɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu ji nihi nɛ yeɔ ye he odase ɔ nɛ.
Se nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ baa ye ngɔ nɛ nyɛ na wami.
“I hla we nimli a hɛ mi nyami.
Se mohu i kpa nyɛ si kaa nyɛ be Mawu suɔmi ngɛ nyɛ mi.
Imi lɛɛ i ba ngɛ Tsaatsɛ biɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ he we mi; ke nɔ kpa ko ba ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ma he lɛ.
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hɛ mi nyɛmi he hae ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, se hɛ mi nyami nɛ jee Mawu kake too ɔ ngɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ di se ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ he ye mɔ?
Nyɛ ko susu kaa ma po nyɛ nya ngɔ ha Tsɛ ɔ; nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ nya poe, lɛ ji Mose, nɔ nɛ nɔ nɔuu nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ɔ.
Se kaa nya he Mose ye jinɛ, imi hu nyɛ ma he mi ye; ejakaa ye he sane e ngma a nɛ.
Se ke nyɛ he we e ngmami ɔmɛ yi ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma he ye munyu ɔmɛ maa ye mɔ?”
Yesu ha ni akpe enuɔ niyeni Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho Galilea Wo nɛ ji Tiberia Wo ɔ se ya.
Nɛ nihi fuu nyɛɛ e se, ejakaa a na okadihi nɛ e pee ngɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ. Yesu ya yoku ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya hi si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a nyami ligbi ɔ su ta.
Benɛ Yesu wo e hɛ nɔ nɛ e na kaa nihi babauu ma e ngɔ ɔ, e bi Filipo ke: “Jije wa ma ya he abolo ngɛ ha ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye?” Se enɛ ɔ ɔ, e de kɛ ka lɛ, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee.
Filipo he nɔ ke: “Cedi lafa enyɔ nya abolo be mɛ sue, bɔ nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na nyamiwo bɔ kakaaka po.” E kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, Andrea, nɛ ji Simon Petro nyɛmi ɔ, de lɛ ke: “Jokuɛ nyumuyo ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ngma abolo enuɔ kɛ lo tsɔwi enyɔ; se nihi fuu nɛ ɔ, jije enɛ ɔ maa su ha mɛ?” Se Yesu ke: “Nyɛ ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ a hi si.” (Nga fuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.)
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumuhi nɛ a yibɔ maa su akpe enuɔ ɔ be ya hi si.
Nɛ Yesu kukuɔ abolo ɔmɛ, nɛ benɛ e na si ɔ, e dla ngɔ ha nihi nɛ hii si ɔmɛ kɛ lo ɔ hu eko, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae.
Benɛ a tɔ ɔ, ɔ de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ bua bibli nɛ piɛ ɔ nya konɛ nɔ́ ko ko laa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bua ngma abolo enuɔ bibli nɛ a ye piɛ ɔ nya wo kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ benɛ ni ɔmɛ na okadi nɛ Yesu pee ɔ, a ke: “Niinɛ, nɔ nɛ ɔ ji gbalɔ ɔ nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.” Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu yo kaa a maa ba nɛ a ba nu lɛ ka nya nɛ a ya wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ, e nɔ kake e sã e he si kɛ ho yoku ɔ nɔ ya ekohu?
Yesu nyɛɛ nyu hɛ mi Benɛ su gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho wo ɔ nya ya; nɛ a ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ a ngɛ wo ɔ poe kɛ yaa Kapernaum.
Se nɛ diblii wo nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, Yesu bɛ́ a ngɔ.
Nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngua ko ba fia he je ɔ wo ɔ puɛ.
Nɛ benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ hlui lɛ ɔ maa pee si tomi nya etɛ loo eywiɛ ɔ, a na Yesu nɛ nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma nɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa su lɛ ɔ he, nɛ a ye gbeye.
Se e de mɛ ke: “Ami ʼi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a suɔ kaa a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba lɛ ɔ mi; nɛ amlɔ ɔ, lɛ ɔ ya kple ngɛ he nɛ a yaa a. Ni ɔmɛ hla Yesu Je na nɔ ɔ, asafo nɛ daa si ngɛ wo ɔ se ɔ na kaa lɛ kpa ko be lejɛ ɔ hu, nɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ sɛ we lɛ ɔ mi, se mohu e kaseli ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Lɛ kpa kome je Tiberia ba he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na si nɛ a ye abolo ɔ ngɛ ɔ kasa nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ benɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kaa Yesu loo e kaseli ɔmɛ be lejɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a sɛ lɛhi a mi, nɛ a ba Kapernaum ba ngɛ Yesu hlae.
Yesu ji wami ngma Nɛ benɛ a ba na lɛ ngɛ wo ɔ se ɔ, a bi lɛ ke: “Rabi, mɛni be o ba hiɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Tsa pi okadihi nɛ nyɛ na a he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ ɔ, se mohu akɛnɛ nyɛ ye abolo ɔ eko nɛ nyɛ tɔ ɔ he je.
Nyɛ ko tsu ngma nɛ puɛɛ ɔ he ni, se mohu nyɛ tsu ngma nɛ hii si kɛ yaa neneene wami mi nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma ha nyɛ ɔ he ni, ejakaa lɛ e nya Tsɛ Mawu ɔ sɔu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa ma tsu Mawu ni tsumi ɔmɛ?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Mawu ni tsumi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa nyɛ he nɔ nɛ e tsɔ ɔ nɔ ngɔ ye.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a bi lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ mɛni okadi o peɔ nɛ waa na konɛ wa he mo ngɔ ye?
Mɛni o tsuɔ?
Wa tsɛmɛ ye mana ngɛ nga a nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: ‘E ha mɛ abolo kɛ je hiɔwe nɛ a ye’ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Pi Mose ji nɔ nɛ ha nyɛ abolo ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ se Tsaatsɛ mohu lɛ haa nyɛ abolo nɛ jee hiɔwe ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa Mawu abolo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ jee hiɔwe kpleɔ si nɛ ngɔɔ wami ngɔ haa je ɔ nɛ.” Jeha nɛ ɔ a de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha wɔ abolo nɛ ɔ daa.” Se Yesu de mɛ ke: “Imi ji wami ngma a nɛ; nɔ nɛ baa ye ngɔ ɔ, hwɔ be lɛ yee gblegbleegblee, nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, kuma be lɛ tɔe gblegbleegblee.
“Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ na mi se kɛ ɔ nyɛ he we yi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi ɔ maa ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ baa ye ngɔ ɔ, i be lɛ fiee kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ejakaa pi imi nitsɛ ye suɔmi nya ni peemi he nɛ i je hiɔwe kɛ ba ngɛ se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ni peemi he.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ni ɔ nɛ, kaa nihi tsuo nɛ e ngɔ ha mi ɔ, ma ko ha nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɛ laa, se mohu ma tle lɛ si ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji Tsaatsɛ suɔmi nya ni ɔ nɛ, kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ Bi ɔ nɛ e heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e na neneene wami, nɛ imi ɔ, ma tle lɛ si ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ tu e he munyu huhuuhu ke e de ke: “Imi ji abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ nɛ;” nɛ a ke: “Anɛ pi Yosef bi Yesu ɔ nɛ wa le e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ mɔ nɛ e deɔ ke: ‘I je hiɔwe’ ɔ?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ko tu munyu huhuuhu ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e maa ba ye ngɔ, kaa ja Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ gbla lɛ lolo, nɛ imi lɛɛ ma tle lɛ si ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.
A ngma ngɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ mi ke: ‘Mɛ tsuo kulaa a maa pee nihi nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ mɛ ni.’ Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ Tsɛ ɔ munyu nɛ e kaseɔ hulɔ ɔ, baa ye ngɔ.
Tsa pi kaa nɔ ko na Tsɛ ɔ hyɛ, ja nɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, lɛ lɛ e na Tsɛ ɔ.
“I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ngɛ neneene wami.
Imi ji wami abolo ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ tsɛmɛ ye mana ngɛ nga a nɔ nɛ a gbo?
Enɛ ɔ ji abolo nɛ jee hiɔwe baa a nɛ, konɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ye nɛ e ko gbo.
Imi ji abolo nɛ hɛ̃ ngɛ nɛ je hiɔwe ba a nɛ; ke nɔ ko ye abolo nɛ ɔ eko ɔ, e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Se abolo nɛ i kɛ ma ha a ji ye he lo nɛ i kɛ ma ha ngɛ je ɔ wami he ɔ nɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ sa nya ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “Kɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ ngɔ e he lo ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa ye ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Ke nyɛ yi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ he lo nɛ nyɛɛ nu e muɔ ɔ, nyɛ be wami ngɛ nyɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye he lo nɛ e nuu ye muɔ ɔ, e ngɛ neneene wami, nɛ imi lɛɛ ma tle lɛ si ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa ye he lo ɔ ngma nitsɛ ʼi, nɛ ye muɔ ɔ nunui nɔ́ nitsɛ ʼi.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye he lo nɛ e nuu ye muɔ ɔ, e hii ye mi nɛ imi hu i hii e mi.
Bɔ nɛ Tsɛ, hɛ kalɔ, ɔ tsɔ mi, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ he nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu nɔ nɛ yeɔ mi ɔ hu maa hi si ngɛ ye he.
Abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ba nɛ ɔ, e be kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye nɛ a gbo ɔ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ abolo nɛ ɔ ɔ, e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.” Yesu de ni nɛ ɔmɛ benɛ e ngɛ ni tsɔɔe ngɛ kpe he ko ngɛ Kapernaum ɔ. Neneene wami munyuhi Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, benɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, a ke: “Munyu nɛ he wa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; mɛnɔ ma nyɛ tue bu?” Se benɛ Yesu yo kaa e kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ huhuue ngɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke: “Anɛ enɛ ɔ lɛ ngɛ nyɛ nane kpatae nɛ ɔ?
Se ke nyɛ na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ yaa hiɔwe he nɛ e ngɛ sa a, kɔlɔ ɔ nɛɛ?
Mumi ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa wami ɔ nɛ; he lo ɔ he be se nami ko.
Munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, mumi ʼi, nɛ wami ʼi.
Se nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ a he we yi.” Ejakaa Yesu le kɛ je sisije ɔ nihi nɛ he we yi ɔ kɛ nɔ hu nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ. Nɛ e ke: “Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i de nyɛ ke: Nɔ ko be ye ngɔ nyɛe maa ba, ja Tsɛ ɔ ha lɛ he blo ɔ nɛ.” Kɛ je enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu kpale a se nɛ a kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ we hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ke: “Nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa je lo?” Simon Petro he nɔ ke: “Mawetsɛ, mɛnɔ ngɔ wa maa ya?
Mo lɛ o ngɛ neneene wami munyu ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he ye, nɛ wa na le hulɔ kaa mo ji Mawu nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ!” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Anɛ pi nyɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ i hla lo?
Se nyɛ kpɛti nɔ kake ɔ abosiami ʼi.” Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi ɔ, he munyu e ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ; ejakaa lɛ ji ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ nɛ.
Yesu kɛ e nyɛmimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kpa si ngɛ Galilea, se e sume kaa e ya kpaa si ngɛ Yudea ejakaa Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe.
Jeha nɛ ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a ba tsuhi nyami ligbi ɔ su ta.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Jee hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ya Yudea, konɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ hu a na nihi nɛ o tsuo ɔmɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa a le lɛ ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko ngɛ laami mi.
Ke ni nɛ ɔmɛ o peɔ ɔ, je o he si ngɔ tsɔɔ je ɔ.” Se e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tete he we e nɔ yi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Ye be sui lolo, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be ɔ daa nɛ ɔ e su.
Je ɔ be nyɛe nyɛ maa nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ e nyɛɛ mi, ejakaa i yeɔ e he odase kaa e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ ni tsumi yayamihi ʼi.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ya nyami ligbi nɛ ɔ yemi se imi lɛɛ i na we ma ya, ejakaa ye be ɔ sui lolo.” Benɛ e de mɛ ja a, e hi si bɔɔ ko ngɛ Galilea.
Yesu ya ba tsuhi nyami ligbi ɔ yemi Se benɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ho ɔ, lɔ ɔ se loko lɛ hu e ya nyami ligbi ɔ, se e je we e he si, se mohu kaa laami mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ bɔni lɛ hlami ngɛ nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ke: “Jije e ngɛ?” Nɛ munyu kusikusi fuu ba asafo ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Yesu he.
Ni komɛ de ke: “Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ;” nɛ ni komɛ hu ke: “Dɛbi, blɔ mohu e haa asafo ɔ tlaa.” Pohu nɔ ko ji paa tui e he munyu ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a gbeye yemi he.
Benɛ e su nyami ligbi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ni.
Nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nyɛ kpɛ a he nɛ a de ke: “Kɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ kase we ni ɔ pee kɛɛ nɛ e le womihi a mi nihi nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ye ni tsumi ɔ, tsa pi ye nɔ, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e pee e suɔmi nya ni ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma yo ngɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ he kaa Mawu dɛ mi e je aloo imi nitsɛ ye yi mi i toɔ nɛ i tuɔ munyu.
Nɔ nɛ toɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi nɛ e tuɔ munyu ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi nyami e ngɛ hlae, se nɔ nɛ hlaa nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, lɛɛ anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ ko be e mi.
Anɛ pi Mose nɛ ha nyɛ Mlaa a lo?
Nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko yi Mlaa a nɔ.
Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ nyɛ maa gbe ɔ?” Asafo ɔ he nɔ nɛ a ke: “Mumi yayami ngɛ o mi; mɛnɔ ngɛ mo hlae nɛ e gbe?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ni tsumi kake i tsu nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nya kpɛ nyɛ he ngɛ he.
Mose lɛ ngɔ nɔ pomi ha nyɛ (pi kaa lɛ Mose ɔ ngɔ e je, se mohu e je tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ), nɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ poo nɔ.
Ke Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ a poo nɔ benɛ pee nɛ a ko tɔ Mose Mlaa a, mɛni he ne nyɛ mi mi fuɔ mi kaa i tsa nɔmlɔ mluku ɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ?
Nyɛ ko hyɛ hɛ mi kɛ kojo, se mohu nyɛɛ kojo dami kojomi.” Anɛ lɛ ji Mesia a lo?
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yerusalembi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ke: “Anɛ pi nɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Nɛ oʼɛ, munyu e ngɛ tue pãa nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ a de we lɛ nɔ ko.
Eko ɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nikɔtɔma amɛ ba na le kaa Kristo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ɔ niinɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa le he nɛ e je; se Kristo ɔ lɛɛ, benɛ e maa ba a, nɔ ko be lee he nɛ e je.” Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu ngɛ ni tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke: “Nyɛ le mi, nɛ nyɛ le he nɛ i je hulɔ; i tui imi nitsɛ ye yi mi kɛ bɛ́, se mohu anɔkualetsɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi nɛ nyɛ li ɔ nɛ.
Se imi lɛɛ i le lɛ, ejakaa e ngɔ i je nɛ lɛ lɛ tsɔ mi.” Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a nu, se nɔ ko tɛ́ e he, ejakaa e ngmlɛfia a sui lolo.
Se asafo ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu he e nɔ ye, nɛ a ke: “Benɛ Kristo maa ba a, anɛ e maa pee okadihi fuu pe nihi nɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔmɛ lo?” A tsɔ nɛ a ya nu Yesu Farisifo ɔmɛ nu kaa asafo ɔ ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ dee kusikusi ngɛ e he; nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ tsɔli konɛ a ya nu lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Be bɔɔ ko pɛ e piɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, nɛ ma ya nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ngɔ.
Nyɛ ma hia mi, se nyɛ be mi nae, nɛ he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ be lejɛ ɔ nyɛe maa ba.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ bi a he ke: “Jije nɔ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɛ wa be lɛ nae?
Anɛ nihi nɛ gbɛ fia Helabi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ngɔ e maa ya nɛ e ya tsɔɔ Helabi ɔmɛ a ni lo?
Mɛni munyu e tu nɛ ɔ: ‘Nyɛ ma hla mi nɛ nyɛ be mi nae, nɛ he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ be lejɛ ɔ nyɛe maa ba’ a?” Wami pa Nyagbe ligbi nɛ ji nyami ligbi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ligbi ngua a nɔ ɔ, Yesu ya da si nɛ e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke: “Ke kuma ngɛ nɔ ko tɔe ɔ, e ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba nu nyu; nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, — bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ, wami pahi maa je e muklii mi kɛ be.
Mumi ɔ nɛ nihi nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ ma na a he nɛ e de enɛ ɔ ɔ nɛ; se Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ na we nɛ e ba, ejakaa a na we nɛ a wo Yesu hɛ mi nyami.
Ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti gba Benɛ asafo ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ ɔ, a ke: “Gbalɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ niinɛ.” Ni komɛ ke: “Kristo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Se ni kpa komɛ hu ke: “Anɛ Kristo ɔ, Galilea e maa je lo?
Anɛ ngmami ɔ de we ke: ‘David powu ɔ mi kɛ Betlehem ma, he nɛ David hi ɔ, lejɛ ɔ Kristo ɔ maa je’ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ migbami ba asafo ɔ mi ngɛ e he.
Se jinɛ a ti ni komɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a nu lɛ, se kɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nyɛ we e he nɛ e ta.
Yudafo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔmahi nɛ he we yi ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya, nɛ a bi mɛ ke: “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ bɛ ɔ?” Tsɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke: “Bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ nɔ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nɔ ko tui munyu ja gblee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ he nɔ ke: “Anɛ nyɛ hu a mlɔɔ nyɛ?
Anɛ nyɛ na nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ loo Farisifo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko he e nɔ ye?” Se asafo nɛ li mlaa nɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ.
Nikodemo, a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ ba Yesu ngɔ be ko ɔ, he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ke a nui nɔ ko nya mi gbi nɛ a le nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ, wa Mlaa a buu lɛ fɔ lo?” A he nɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Anɛ mo hu Galilea o je lo?
Hla mi nɛ o hyɛ, se gbalɔ ko ti si kɛ ji Galilea hyɛ.” [ Nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho e we mi ya.
Yo nɛ a nu lɛ ngɛ ajuamabɔmi mi ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho Nuyoku ɔ nɔ ya.
Nɛ mɔtu mla a, e ba sɔlemi we ɔ ekohu, nɛ ma a tsuo ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ya hi si, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ ni.
Nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ yo ko nɛ a nu lɛ ngɛ ajuama bɔmi mi ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ha e ba da a kpɛti, nɛ a de Yesu ke: “Tsɔɔlɔ, kikɛmɛ a yo nɛ ɔ ɔ, ajuama bɔmi mi tutuutu a nu lɛ ngɛ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ Mlaa a mi ɔ, Mose wo wɔ kita ke a fia kikɛmɛ a yihi tɛ; se kɛ mo hu o deɔ kɛɛ?” Se enɛ ɔ ɔ, a de kɛ da lɛ konɛ a na nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ ya po e nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu sɔ́ si, nɛ e kɛ e nguɛ ngma ni ngɛ zugba mi.
Se benɛ a ngɛ nɔ ngɛ lɛ bie ɔ, e wo e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ti nɔ nɛ yayami ko be e he ɔ, lɛ kekle e fia lɛ tɛ ɔ.” Nɛ e kpale sɔ̃ si ekohu, nɛ e ngma ni ngɛ zugba mi.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ a nu ɔ, a bɔni kpo jemi kakaaka, kɛ je kekle nɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si sekpɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ba piɛ Yesu nɔ kake kɛ yo ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ kpɛti.
Benɛ Yesu wo e hɛ̃ nɔ nɛ e nɛ́ nɔ ko kaa ja yo ɔ, e bi lɛ ke: “Maa, jije o nya poli ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Anɛ nɔ ko bui mo fɔ lo?” Nɛ e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ ko bui mi fɔ.” Nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ imi hu i bui mo fɔ mɔ.
Yaa nɛ o ko ya pee yayami hu.”] Yesu ji je ɔ la Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ tu munyu ekohu nɛ e ke: “Imi ji je ɔ la a nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e be diblii mi nyɛe gblegbleegblee, se mohu e ma na wami la a.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Farisifo ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Moo lɛɛ, mo nitsɛ o he odase o ngɛ yee; o dase ɔ be mi.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ke i ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye he odase yee hu po ɔ, ye dase ɔ ngɛ mi, ejakaa i le he nɛ i je kɛ he nɛ i yaa, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ li he nɛ i je loo he nɛ i yaa.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kojoɔ he lo nya; imi lɛɛ i kojo we nɔ ko.
Nɛ ke i kojoɔ tete po hu ɔ, ye kojomi ɔ anɔkuale ʼi, ejakaa pi ye nɔ kake ʼi, se mohu i kɛ Tsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ. Nɛ pohu nyɛ Mlaa a mi ɔ, a ngma ke: ‘Ni enyɔ a odase ɔ anɔkuale ʼi.
Imi, lɛɛ i yeɔ imi nitsɛ ye he odase, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hu yeɔ ye he odase.” Jeha nɛ ɔ a bi lɛ ke: “Jije o tsɛ ɔ ngɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Nyɛ li mi nɛ nyɛ pa li Tsaatsɛ.
Kaa nyɛ le mi ɔ, nyɛ ko le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.” Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nito he ɔ benɛ e ngɛ ni tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ; nɛ nɔ ko nui lɛ, ejakaa e ngmlɛfia a sui.
Nyɛ be nyɛe he nɛ i yaa a maa ya Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kpale de mɛ ekohu ke: “Imi lɛɛ i yaa, se nyɛ ma hla mi, nɛ nyɛ he yayami mi nyɛ ma gbo ngɛ.
He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be lejɛ ɔ nyɛe maa ba.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: “Anɛ e yaa gbe e he he je nɛ e deɔ ke: ‘He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be lejɛ ɔ nyɛe maa ba’ a?” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ je sisi nɛ ɔ, se imi lɛɛ hiɔwe i je.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ je je nɛ ɔ mi, se imi lɛɛ i ji je nɛ ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ma gbo ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a mi ɔ nɛ; ejakaa ke nyɛ he we yi kaa imi nɛ ɔ ji lɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma gbo ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a mi.” Jeha nɛ ɔ a bi lɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ ji mo?” Nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Lɔ ɔ nɔuu i de nyɛ kɛ je sisi ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ he sanehi fuu nɛ ma de nɛ ma kɛ kojo nyɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ anɔkualetsɛ ʼi, nɛ imi lɛɛ nihi nɛ i nu kɛ je e nya a, lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu i deɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ je ɔ nɛ.” A li kãa Tsɛ ɔ he munyu e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Ke nyɛ na nyɛ wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa ami ʼi, nɛ kãa i to we ye yi mi i pee we nɔ́ ko, se mohu nɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ tsɔɔ mi ɔ ja i deɔ.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ, Tsɛ ɔ si we ye nɔ kake, ejakaa imi lɛɛ, nɔ́ nɛ sa e hɛ mi i peɔ daa.” Benɛ e ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ dee ɔ, nihi fuu he e nɔ ye.
Odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de Yudafo ɔmɛ nɛ he lɛ ye ɔ ke: “Ke nyɛ hi si ngɛ ye munyu ɔ mi ɔ, ye kaseli nitsɛmɛ ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa le anɔkuale ɔ, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.” A he nɔ ke: “Abraham nina ji wɔ, nɛ wa pee we nɔ ko nyɔguɛhi hyɛ; kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ mo o deɔ ke: ‘Nyɛ maa ye nya he’ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ nyɔguɛ ji lɛ.
Nyɔguɛ hi we mi kɛ yɛ neneene, se bi hii si kɛ yaa neneene.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke bi ɔ ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he niinɛ.
I le kaa Abraham nina ji nyɛ; nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe, ejakaa ye munyu sɛ we nyɛ mi.
Ini lɛɛ nihi nɛ i na ngɛ Tsaatsɛ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ i deɔ; nɛ nyɛ hu nihi nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je nyɛ tsɛ nya a, kɔlɔ ɔ nyɛ peɔ.” A he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Wa tsɛ ji Abraham.” Yesu de mɛ ke: “Abraham bimɛ ji nyɛ jinɛ nyɛ ma tsu Abraham ni tsumihi.
Se jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe, imi nɔmlɔ ko nɛ i de nyɛ anɔkuale nɛ i nu ngɛ Mawu nya a; Abraham pee we enɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ tsɛ ni tsumihi nyɛ tsuɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Wɔɔ lɛɛ, a fɔ we wɔ ngɛ ajuama bɔmi mi; tsɛ kake wa ngɛ, lɛ ji Mawu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Mawu ji nyɛ tsɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa suɔ mi, ejakaa imi lɛɛ, Mawu ngɔ i je kɛ ba; nɛ pohu i to we imi nitsɛ ye yi mi kɛ bɛ, se mohu lɛ nɛ tsɔ mi.
Mɛni he je nyɛ nɛ́ ye munyu nya a?
E je ye munyu tue nɛ nyɛ bui ɔ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ tsɛ nɛ nyɛ je e mi ji abosiami, nɛ nyɛ tsɛ ɔ tsui nya ni nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee.
Lɛɛ nɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ kɛ je blema, nɛ e hi si ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi, ejakaa anɔkuale be e mi.
Ke e ngɛ lakpa yee ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nihi a he munyu e tuɔ, ejakaa lakpatsɛ kɛ nya ngɔli a tsɛ ji lɛ.
Se imi lɛɛ, akɛnɛ i tuɔ anɔkuale he je ɔ, nyɛ he we mi yi.
Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ buu mi fɔ ngɛ yayami ko he?
Se ke anɔkuale i tuɔ ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ he we mi yi ɔ?
Nɔ nɛ je Mawu mi ɔ, e nuɔ Mawu munyu; lɔ ɔ he nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nui ɔ nɛ, ejakaa nyɛ ji Mawu mi.” Yesu kɛ Abraham Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a de Yesu ke: “Anɛ e be mi kaa wa ke Samariano ji mo, nɛ mumi yayami hu ngɛ o mi ɔ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Mumi yayami be ye mi, se pe i ngɛ Tsaatsɛ puae, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ ngɛ ye he guɛ gbee mohu.
I hla we imi nitsɛ ye hɛ mi nyami, se nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ hlaa nɛ e kojoɔ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Ke nɔ ko ye ye munyu ɔ nɔ ɔ, e be gboe gblegbleegblee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Kpaako wa na le kãa mumi yayami ngɛ o mi.
Abraham gbo, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu gbo, nɛ moo lɛɛ o deɔ ke: ‘Ke nɔ ko ye ye munyu ɔ nɔ ɔ, e be gboe ligbi ko ligbi ko kɛ maa ya neneene.’ Anɛ o pe wa tsɛ Abraham nɛ gbo ɔ?
Nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu gbo.
Kɛ o ngɛ o he tsɛe kɛɛ nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Ke i wo imi nitsɛ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, ye hɛ mi nyɛmi ɔ pi nɔ́ ko.
Tsaatsɛ ji nɔ nɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami, nɔ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke nyɛ Mawu ji lɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ yo we lɛ, se imi lɛɛ i le lɛ.
Ke i de ke i li lɛ ɔ, ma pee nyangɔlɔ kaa nyɛ; se i le lɛ nɛ i yeɔ e munyu nɔ.
Nyɛ tsɛ Abraham hia kɛ bua jɔmi kãa e ko na ye ligbi ɔ, nɛ e na nɛ e bua jɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “O na we nɛ o ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ nɛ o na Abraham lo?” Yesu de mɛ ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: I ngɛ loko Abraham ngɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ da kukuɔ tɛ nɛ a maa fia lɛ; se Yesu laa e he, nɛ e je sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ ho.
Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛyuyuilɔ Benɛ Yesu bee ɔ, e na nyumu ko nɛ e hɛ yu kɛ je e fomi mi.
Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke: “Rabi, mɛnɔ lɛ pee yayami, nɔ nɛ ɔ loo e fɔli, he je nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Tsa pi nɔ nɛ ɔ loo e fɔli nɛ pee yayami, se mohu benɛ pee nɛ Mawu ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ na je po ngɛ e mi he je.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ, nɛ je na nɛ ɔ ɔ, ja wa tsu nɔ nɛ tsɔ wɔ ɔ ni tsumi ɔmɛ; je maa jɔ, benɛ nɔ ko be ni nyɛe ma tsu hu.
Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ɔ, je ɔ la ji mi.” Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ ɔ, e la lada ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ e kɛ lada a pɔtɔ zu, nɛ e ngɔ zu ɔ ngɔ ha hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ hɛngmɛ nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Yaa du ngɛ Siloam (e sisi ji: nɔ nɛ a tsɔ lɛ) taku ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ho nɛ e ya du, nɛ e ba nɛ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpɔ mi bi kɛ nihi nɛ na lɛ sa kaa nɔ balɔ ji lɛ ɔ de ke: “Anɛ pi nɔ nɛ jinɛ e hii si nɛ e baa nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?” Ni komɛ ke “lɛ ʼi;” ni komɛ hu ke: “E je lɛ;” lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e ke: “Ami ʼi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a bi lɛ ke: “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o hɛngmɛ bli ɔ?” E he nɔ ke: “Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesu ɔ lɛ pɔtɔ zu, nɛ e kɛ ha ye hɛngmɛ nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke: ‘Yaa Siloam taku ɔ mi nɛ o ya du.’ Nɛ benɛ i ya nɛ i ya du ɔ, i hyɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Jije e ngɛ?” E de mɛ ke: “I li.” Farisifo ɔmɛ bi tsami ɔ he munyu Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ nɔ nɛ sa nɛ e hɛ yu ɔ yɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Se ligbi nɛ Yesu pɔtɔ zu nɛ e kɛ bli nyumu ɔ hɛngmɛ ɔ, Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ʼi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ hu kpale bi lɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e hyɛ nɔ ɔ. Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Zu nɛ a pɔtɔ e kɛ ha ye hɛngmɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ i ya du, nɛ i ngɛ nɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Farisifo ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke: “Nyumu nɛ ɔ ji Mawu ngɔ, ejakaa e yi Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ.” Ni komɛ hu ke: “Kɛ nɔmlɔ ko nɛ ji yayami peelɔ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ okadihi kaa enɛ ɔmɛ pee?” Nɛ migbami ba a kpɛti.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a bi hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ ke: “Mo hu kɛ o ngɛ dee ngɛ e he kɛɛ, akɛnɛ e bli o hɛngmɛ ɔ?” Nɛ e ke: “Gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Se Yudafo ɔmɛ he we yi kaa hɛ yuyuilɔ ji lɛ sa loko e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ a ya tsɛ nɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ ɔ fɔli, nɛ a bi mɛ ke: “Anɛ nyɛ bi ɔ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ?” E fɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke: “Wa le kaa wa bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; wa le kaa a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ; se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe jeha nɛ ɔ ɔ, lɛɛ wa li; jeha nɛ ɔ hu, nɔ nɛ bli e hɛngmɛ ɔ, wa li; nyɛ bi lɛ, e wa, lɛ nitsɛ e maa tu munyu ha e he.” E fɔli ɔmɛ de enɛ ɔ ejakaa a ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ gbeye yee.
Se Yudafo ɔmɛ so ngɔ to kaa, ke nɔ ko gba mi de ke, lɛ ji Kristo ɔ, a maa fie lɛ kɛ maa je kpe he ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ de ke: “E wa, nyɛ bi lɛ nitsɛ” ɔ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɛ nyumu nɛ sa nɛ e ji hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Ngɔɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha Mawu; se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɔ yayami peelɔ ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Yayami peelɔ ji lɛ jio, i li; nɔ́ kake i le, kaa jinɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ji mi, se jeha nɛ ɔ i ngɛ nɔ hyɛe.” Nɛ a bi lɛ ekohu ke: “Mɛni e pee mo?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ e bli o hɛngmɛ ɔ?” E he nɔ nɛ e ke: “I de nyɛ momo, nɛ nyɛ nui; mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ bu tue ekohu?
Anɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ ma plɛ e kaseli lo?” A je lɛ ke: “Mo ji e kaselɔ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mose kaseli ji wɔ.
Wa le kaa Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu; se nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, wa li he nɛ e je.” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Ei, enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa nyɛ li he nɛ e je, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ e bli ye hɛngmɛ!
Wa le kaa Mawu bui yayami peeli tue; se ke nɔ ko yee lɛ gbeye nɛ e peɔ e suɔmi nya ni ɔ, e buɔ lɛ tue.
Kɛ je nɛ a bɔ je ɔ nɛ ɔ, a nui hyɛ kaa nɔ ko bli nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ hɛngmɛ gblee.
Kãa nɔ nɛ ɔ ji Mawu ngɔ ɔ, jinɛ e be nyɛe nɔ́ ko maa pee.” A he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke “Moo lɛɛ, yayami mi nitsɛ a fɔ mo ngɛ, nɛ mo mohu o ngɛ wɔ ni tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ?” Nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ je kpe he ɔ. Mumi mi hɛyumi Yesu nu kaa a fie lɛ; nɛ benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e bi lɛ ke: “O heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ nɔ yeɔ lo?” E he nɔ ke: “Mɛnɔ ji lɛ, Mawetsɛ, konɛ ma he e nɔ ma ye?” Yesu de lɛ ke: “O na lɛ momo, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, lɛ nɔuu ʼi.” Nɛ e ke: “I heɔ yeɔ, Mawetsɛ;” nɛ e ja lɛ.
Nɛ Yesu ke: “Kojomi he nɛ i ba je nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ, konɛ nihi nɛ hyɛ we nɔ ɔ, a hyɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ, a plɛ hɛ yuyuli.” Nɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu enɛ ɔ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke: “Anɛ wɔ hu wa hɛ yu lo?” Yesu de mɛ Ke: “Kaa nyɛ hɛ yu mohu ɔ, jinɛ yayami be nyɛ he; se jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ deɔ ke: ‘Wa ngɛ nɔ hyɛe;’ lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ he kɛ mwɔɔ.”
To ɔmɛ a he abɛ ɔ “Anɔkuale mi i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ nɛ gui sinya a nya nɛ e kɛ se to ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi se mohu e guu he kpa kɛ kuɔ ɔ, juɔ kɛ ojofialɔ ji lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ guu sinya a nya kɛ sɛɛ mi ɔ, to ɔmɛ a hyɛlɔ ji lɛ.
Lɛ, sinya nya hyɛlɔ ɔ bliɔ haa, nɛ to ɔmɛ nuɔ e gbi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e to ɔmɛ a biɛ tsɛɛ mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ jee kpo.
Nɛ ke e bli e to ɔmɛ ɔ, e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ to ɔmɛ nyɛɛ e se, ejakaa a le e gbi.
Se nɔ kpa a, a be e se nyɛɛe, se mohu a maa tu fo kɛ je e ngɔ, ejakaa a li ni kpahi a gbi.” Yesu bu mɛ abɛ nɛ ɔ, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a nui munyu nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ sisi.
Yesu ji tohyɛlɔ kpakpa Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu kpale de mɛ ekohu ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Imi ji to ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ nya sinya a nɛ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba a, juɔhi kɛ ojo fiali ji mɛ; se to ɔmɛ bui mɛ tue hulɔ.
Imi ji sinya a nɛ.
Imi lɛɛ, ke nɔ ko gu ye mi kɛ sɛ mi ɔ, a ma he e yi wami, nɛ e maa sɛ mi nɛ e maa je kpo, nɛ e ma na niyeni.
Juɔ bɛ gu, se jumi kɛ nɔ gbemi kɛ hɛmi kpatami he e baa ngɛ; imi lɛɛ i ba benɛ pee nɛ a na wami nɛ a na nɛ e be nɔ.
“Imi ji to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ.
To hyɛlɔ kpakpa a ngɔɔ e klaa ngɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ e to ɔmɛ a nane mi.
Se nɔ nɛ ji apafono nɛ e pi to ɔmɛ a hyɛlɔ, nɔ nɛ to ɔmɛ pi e nihi ɔ, naa kaa ogbetee ma, nɛ e siɔ to ɔmɛ nɛ e tuu fo, nɛ ogbetee, ɔ ba nuu mɛ nɛ e gbɛɛ to ɔmɛ fiaa.
Apafono ɔ tuu fo, ejakaa apafono ji lɛ, nɛ to ɔmɛ a he nɔ dɔɛ lɛ.
Imi ji tohyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ, nɛ i le ye tohi, nɛ ye to ɔmɛ hu le mi, kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ le mi, nɛ imi hu i le Tsɛ ɔ; nɛ i ngɔɔ ye wami ngɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ to ɔmɛ a nane mi.
I ngɛ to kpa komɛ nɛ ji to tsu nɛ ɔ mi; nɛ kɔlɔ ɔmɛ hu, ja i ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a ba nu ye gbi, nɛ to ɔmɛ pee kuu kake kɛ hyɛlɔ kake.
“Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi ɔ nɛ, ejakaa i ngɔɔ ye wami ngɔ fɔɔ si, konɛ ma kpale ngɔ.
Nɔ ko kpɔ we ngɛ ye dɛ, se mohu imi nitsɛ lɛ i ngɔ fɔɔ si.
I ngɛ he wami kaa i kɛ haa, nɛ i ngɛ he wami kaa i ngɔɔ ekohu; bɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ de mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, mi gbami kpale ba Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpɛti ekohu.
Nɛ a ti nihi fuu ke: “Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi, nɛ e nu godo; mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lɛ tue bue?” Ni komɛ hu ke: “Nɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi nya mi munyuhi ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Anɛ mumi yayami ma nyɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ hɛngmɛ ma bli lo?” Yudafo ɔmɛ kua Yesu Be su nɛ a ngɛ sɔlemi tsu he tsukɔmi kaimi nyami ligbi yee ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ fiɛ be ʼi.
Nɛ Yesu ngɛ si slae ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ Salomo ablanaa a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ba bua wo e he, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Kɛ yaa su mɛni be o ma ha wa yi mi maa jɔɔ wɔ kɔsikɔsi peemi ngɛ o he?
Ke mo ji Kristo ɔ de wɔ paa.” Yesu he nɔ ke: “I de nyɛ nɛ nyɛ he we yi.
Ni tsumihi nɛ i tsuɔ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ biɛ mi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ lɛ ngɛ ye he odase yee; se nyɛ he we yi, mɛni he je ɔ, nyɛ pi ye to ɔmɛ eko.
Ye to ɔmɛ nuɔ ye gbi, nɛ i le mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ ye se, nɛ imi nɔuu lɛ i haa mɛ neneene wami, nɛ a hɛ mi be kpatae kɛ maa ya neneene nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, nɔ ko be mɛ kpɔe ngɛ ye dɛ.
Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɔ mɛ ha mi ɔ pe nihi tsuo, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e ma kpɔ mɛ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ dɛ.
Imi kɛ Tsaatsɛ tsuo ɔ, kake ʼi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kukuɔ tɛ ekohu nɛ a maa fia lɛ.
Yesu he nɔ ke: “I tsɔɔ nyɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi fuu nɛ je Tsaatsɛ ngɔ.
Te jamɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ nyɛ maa fia mi tɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ?” Yudafo ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Tsa pi ni tsumi kpakpa ko he nɛ wa maa fia mo tɛ ngɛ ɔ, se mohu musu bɔmi he je, ejakaa mo nɛ nɔmlɔ ji mo ɔ, o tsɛɔ o he ke Mawu.” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Anɛ a ngmɛ́ ngɛ nyɛ Mlaa mi ke: ‘I ke, mawuhi ji nyɛ’ ɔ lo?
Ke e tsɛ nihi nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ba a ngɔ ɔ tete ke mawuhi, nɛ ngmami ɔ yi lakpa a, nyɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ nɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ pee lɛ klɔuklɔu nɛ e tsɔ lɛ kɛ ba je ɔ mi ɔ he ke: ‘O bɔ musu;’ mɛni he je ɔ, i de ke: Mawu bi ji mi ɔ lo?
Ke i tsu we Tsaatsɛ ni tsumihi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko he mi ye; se ke i tsuɔ ɔ, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛ he we mi yi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ he ni tsumi ɔmɛ ye mɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ le nɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi, nɛ imi hu i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɛ hlae ekohu nɛ a nu lɛ, se e je a dɛ.
Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho Yordan se ya ekohu, he nɛ Yohane baptisi ngɛ kekle ɔ, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ nihi fuu ba e ngɔ nɛ a ke: “Yohane pee we okadi ko mohu, se nihi tsuo nɛ Yohane de ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ he ji anɔkuale.” Nɛ nihi fuu he e nɔ ye ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Lazaro gbenɔ Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Lazaro, nɛ je Betania, Maria kɛ e nyɛmi Martamɛ a kɔpe ɔ ngɛ gboe.
(Maria nɛ ngɔ nu kɛ e he via kɛ kpa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu e nan ehe ɔ nyɛmi Lazaro lɛ ngɛ gboe nɛ ɔ ne.)
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e nyɛmi yi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, oʼɛ, nɔ nɛ o suɔ ɔ ngɛ gboe.” Se benɛ Yesu nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, e ke: “Kikɛmɛ a hiɔ nɛ ɔ pi gbenɔ hiɔ, se mohu Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ he je, benɛ pee nɛ a wo Mawu Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami.” Yesu suɔ Maria kɛ e nyɛmi yo ɔ kɛ Lazaro tsuo.
Benɛ e nu e hiɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hi si ngɛ he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ ligbi enyɔ.
Nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ ha waa ya Yudea ekohu.” Kaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Rabi, e sui be ko nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a fia mo tɛ, nɛ o yaa lejɛ ɔ ekohu nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Anɛ pi ngmlɛfia nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ngɛ ligbi kake mi lo?
Ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ piani ɔ, e tɛ we si, mɛni he je ɔ, e naa je nɛ ɔ mi la a.
Se ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ nyɔ mi ɔ e tɛɔ si, ejakaa la be e mi.” Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ e de mɛ ke: “Wa huɛ Lazaro hwɔ mahɛ; se i yaa nɛ ma ya tsɛ̃ɛ lɛ ngɛ mahɛ ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mahɛ e ngɛ hwɔeɔ, lɛɛ e ma na he wami mɔ.” Se e gbenɔ he munyu Yesu tu ɔ nɛ; se mɛɛ lɛɛ a susu kaa mahɛ nitsɛ he munyu e ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu de mɛ paa ke: “Lazaro gbo; nɛ nyɛ he ɔ e ngɔ ye nya kaa i be lejɛ ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he ye.
Nyɛ ha waa ya e ngɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Toma, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Didimo ɔ, de e nyamimɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ke: “Nyɛ ha wɔ hu waa ya nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ya gbo.” Yesu ji sitemi ɔ kɛ wami ɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu su lejɛ ɔ, e ba na kaa Lazaro ye ligbi eywiɛ momo ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi.
Betania kɛ Yerusalem kpɛti kɛmi maa pee si tomi nya enyɔ.
Nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu ba Marta kɛ Mariamɛ a ngɔ konɛ a ba ye mɛ kɔmɔ ngɛ a nyɛmi nyumu ɔ gbenɔ ɔ he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ, benɛ Marta nu kaa Yesu ma a, e te si nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe; se Maria lɛɛ e hii si ngɛ we ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Marta de Yesu ke: “Mawetsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ, mami ɔ ko gbo we.
Se jeha nɛ hu ɔ, i le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma bi Mawu ɔ, e ma ha mo.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “O nyɛmi nyumu ɔ maa te si.” Marta de lɛ ke: “I le kaa e maa te si ngɛ ni gbogboehi a si temi ɔ mi ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Imi ji sitemi ɔ kɛ wami ɔ nɛ; nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, ke e gbo tete po ɔ, e hɛ maa hi ngmengmle, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ e heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e be gboe gblegbleegblee.
O heɔ enɛ ɔ yeɔ lo?” Marta de lɛ ke: “Ee, Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa mo ji Kristo, Mawu Bi nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.” Yesu fo ya Nɛ benɛ Marta de lɛ kikɛ ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya tsɛ e nyɛmi Maria a zaa, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba, nɛ e ngɛ mo tsɛe.” Benɛ Maria nu ɔ, e te si oya nɛ e ba e ngɔ.
Se Yesu na we nɛ e su kɔpe ɔ, se e ngɛ he nɛ Marta kɛ lɛ kpe ngɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, benɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi nɛ a ngɛ lɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ na kaa Maria sa e he kɛ je kpo ɔ, a fie e se, a susu kaa be nɛ ɔ mi piɔ, e yaa yɔkɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e ya fo ya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Maria ba he nɛ Yesu ngɛ ɔ nɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e nɔ e nane nya nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ, mami ɔ ko gbo we.” Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu na lɛ kaa e ngɛ ya foe kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ hu nɛ kɛ lɛ ba a, kaa mɛ hu a ngɛ ya foe ɔ, e wo bua ngɛ e mumi mi nɛ e hao.
Nɛ e bi ke: “Jije nyɛ to lɛ ngɛ?” A de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, ba nɛ o ba hyɛ.” Nɛ Yesu fo ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ ha!” Se a ti ni komɛ ke: “Nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ bli hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ hengmɛ ɔ, anɛ e be nɔ́ ko nyɛe maa pee konɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ko gbo lo?” Yesu tle Lazaro si Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kpale wo bua ngɛ e mi ekohu, nɛ e ya yɔkɔ ɔ nɔ; se tɛ puɔ ʼi, nɛ tɛ tsi nya.
Yesu ke: “Nyɛ je tɛ ɔ.” Marta, nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ nyɛmi yo ɔ, de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ ɔ puɛ, ejakaa e ye ligbi eywiɛ.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Anɛ i de we mo ke ke o he ye ɔ, o maa na Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a je tɛ ɔ ngɛ he nɛ nɔ gbogboe ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ Yesu wo e hɛ nɔ nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛ, i naa mo si kaa o bu mi tue.
Se imi lɛɛ i le kaa o buɔ mi tue; se asafo ɔ nɛ daa si ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ dee, konɛ a he ye kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi.” Nɛ benɛ e de kikɛ ɔ, e tsɛ lɛ kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke: “Lazaro leee, jee kpo!” Nɛ nɔ gbogboe ɔ je kpo, bo nɛ a kɛ pu lɛ ɔ blaa e nane, nɛ duku fi e hɛ mi.
Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ nɛ nyɛ ha e ya.” A so Yesu yi nɔ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ nɛ ba Maria ngɔ ɔ a ti nihi fuu he Yesu nɔ ye, benɛ a na nihi nɛ e pee ɔ.
Se a ti ni komɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Farisifo ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya nɛ a ya sɛɛ ha mɛ nihi nɛ Yesu pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ tsɛ kpe, nɛ a ke: “Kɛ wa ngɛ pee kɛɛ?
Nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ okadi slɔɔtohi fuu pee.
Ke wa ngmɛ lɛ blɔ kikɛ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ tsuo ma he e nɔ maa ye; nɛ Romabi ɔmɛ maa ba nɛ a ma ba kpɔ wa sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ wa zugba a kulaa.” Se a ti nɔ kake, Kaifa nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma yee ngɛ jamɛ a jeha a mi ɔ, de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ li nɔ ko kulaa, nɛ pohu nyɛ susuu we kaa e hi wa wɔ kaa nɔ kake nɛ gbo ngɛ ma a nane mi, pe nɔ́ nɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata.” Se enɛ ɔ ɔ, pi lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e to e yi mi nɛ e de; se mohu osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ ji lɛ ngɛ jamɛ jeha a nɔ ɔ he je; pe e gba kaa Yesu ma gbo ngɛ ma a nane mi; nɛ pi ngɛ ma a kɛkɛ nane mi, se benɛ pee nɛ e bua Mawu bimɛ nɛ gbɛ fia a hu nya ngɔ pee kake.
Nɛ kɛ je lɛ ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, a to a yi mi ke a maa gbe; lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu ji paa nɛ e nyɛɛ ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpɛti hu, se e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho zugba ko nɛ ngɛ nga a nya a nɔ ya, ngɛ ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Efraim ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a Hetsɔmi ɔ su ta.
Nɛ nihi babauu je zugba a tsuo nɔ kɛ ho Yerusalem ya, konɛ a ya tsukɔ a he loko Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ su.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni Yesu hlami, nɛ benɛ a daa si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, a de a he ke: “Kɛ nyɛ susuu kɛɛ; anɛ e be Nyami ligbi ɔ bae?” Se osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ wo si ke, ke nɔ ko le he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, e ba wo a tue nɔ, konɛ a ya nu lɛ.
A pɔ Yesu nu ngɛ Betania Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ e piɛ ligbi ekpa nɛ a maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, Yesu ba Betania, he nɛ Lazaro, nɔ nɛ gbo nɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngmɛ lɛ okplɔɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Marta sɔmɔ; se Lazaro piɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ hii si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔmɛ a he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Maria ngɔ nardo nu ngmingmiingmi nɛ he jua wa saminya nɛ ngmɛɛ sɛni tɛ kake, nɛ e kɛ ba kpa Yesu nanehi a he, nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu e nane ɔmɛ a he; nɛ nu ɔ he via kpe we ɔ mi tsuo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda Iskariot, e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ de ke: “Mɛni he je a jua we nu nɛ ɔ cedi lafa etɛ nɛ a kɛ ha ohiafohi?” Se enɛ ɔ nɛ e de nɛ ɔ, pi ohiafo ɔmɛ a he nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ dɔe he je, se mohu juɔ ji lɛ, nɛ lɛ lɛ e toɔ sika kpɛɛ ɔ, nɛ e juɔ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɔ woɔ mi ɔ eko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu ke: “Koo doo e nya; e pee enɛ ɔ ngɔ to ye pumi ligbi ɔ. Ejakaa ohiafo ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ daa, se imi lɛɛ, pi daa nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi ngɛ.” A so Lazaro yi nɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu na le kaa Yesu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba, pi ngɛ Yesu kɛkɛ he, se mohu konɛ a na Lazaro nɔ nɛ e tle si kɛ je gbeje ɔ hulɔ.
Nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ muɔ a yi mi kpɔ kaa a maa gbe Lazaro hulɔ.
Ejakaa e he nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu ya nɛ a ya he Yesu nɔ ye ɔ nɛ.
Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi E nɔ je na a, nihi babauu nɛ ba nyami ligbi ɔ yemi ɔ, benɛ a nu kaa Yesu ma Yerusalem ɔ, a kukuɔ tã ba, nɛ a je kpo ya kpee lɛ, nɛ a wɔ lele ke: “Hosiana!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ, Israel matsɛ ɔ!” Se Yesu na teji bi ko nɛ e kuɔ hi nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Koo ye gbeye, Zion bi yo; Oʼɛ, o matsɛ ɔ ma, E hi teji bi nɔ.” Se e kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ́ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi mla mi, se benɛ a wo Yesu hɛ mi nyami se ɔ loko a kai kaa a ngma ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ lɔ ɔ a pee ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ asafo ɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ be mi nɛ e tsɛ Lazaro kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ mi nɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ ye he odase.
Enɛ ɔ he je hulɔ nɛ asafo ɔ ya kpee lɛ ɔ nɛ, mɛni he je ɔ, a nu kaa e pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Farisifo ɔmɛ de ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “Tse nyɛ na kaa nyɛ nyɛ we nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛɛ pee fɛɛ; oʼɛ, je ɔ iɛ hia hɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ nɛ.” Helabi komɛ ba hla Yesu Helabi komɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ ba nɛ a ba ja Mawu ngɛ nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba Filipo nɛ je Betsaida ngɛ Galilea a ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa ngɛ hlae kaa waa na Yesu.” Filipo ba nɛ e ba de Andrea, nɛ Andrea kɛ Filipo tsuo ba de Yesu.
Nɛ Yesu he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Ngmlɛfia a nɛ a maa wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyam ɔ su.
Anɔkuale mi i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Ke ngma ngu nɔɛ zugba nɛ e gbo ɔ, lɛɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ nɔuu e maa hi; se ke e gbo ɔ, e woɔ yiblii fuu.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ e wami ɔ, e laa lɛ, se nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e wami ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e maa to lɛ kɛ maa ya neneene wami mi.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ mi sɔmɔe ɔ, e nyɛɛ ye se, nɛ he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ye sɔmɔlɔ ɔ hu maa hi.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ mi sɔmɔe ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa wo lɛ.” Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu “Jeha nɛ ɔ ye klaa ngɛ haoe, nɛ mɛni ma de?
Tsaatsɛ, he mi ngɛ ngmlɛfia nɛ ɔ mi!
Pohu enɛ ɔ he nɔuu i ba ngɛ a ngmlɛfia nɛ ɔ mi.
Tsaatsɛ, wo o biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami!” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke: “I na wo e hɛ mi nyami momo, nɛ ma kpale wo e hɛ mi nyami ekohu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a nu ɔ de ke: “Hiɔwe si;” ni komɛ hu ke: “Hiɔwe bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ tu munyu.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Tsa pi ye he nɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ba ngɛ, se nyɛ mohu nyɛ he.
Jeha nɛ ɔ je nɛ ɔ mi kojomi ɔ su; kpaako a maa hia je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ ɔ ngɔ sake ngɔ fɔ he.
Nɛ imi lɛɛ, ke a wo ye nɔ kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ, ma gbla nihi tsuo kɛ maa ba ye ngɔ.” Se enɛ ɔ ɔ, e de kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ. Asafo ɔ he nɔ ke: “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nu ngɛ Mlaa a mi ke Kristo ɔ hii si kɛ yaa neneene; nɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ moo lɛɛ o deɔ ke: ‘Ja a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ?’ Mɛnɔ ji kikɛmɛ a Nɔmlɔ Bi nɛ ɔ?” Yesu de mɛ ke: “Be kpiti kɛkɛ e piɛ ha la a ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Be abɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ la a nɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ, konɛ diblii ko ba na nyɛ; se nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ diblii mli ɔ, e li he nɛ e yaa.
Be abɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ la a nɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ he la a nɔ ngɔ ye, konɛ nyɛ plɛ la bimɛ.” Yesu de ni nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e ho nɛ e ya laa e he.
Yudafo ɔmɛ he we yi E ngɛ mi kaa Yesu pee nyakpɛ ni nguahi ngɛ a hɛ mi, se kɛ ɔ a he we e nɔ yi; konɛ gbalɔ Yesaia munyu nɛ e tu ɔ nɛ na ba mi ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛnɔ he wa sane ɔ ye, Nɛ mɛnɔ a je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nine ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ?” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a he ye ɔ nɛ, ejakaa Yesaia kpale de ekohu ke: “E yu a hɛngmɛ, Nɛ e wlua a tsui; Konɛ a ko na kɛ a hɛngmɛ, Nɛ a na nya kɛ a tsui, Nɛ a kpale a se, nɛ i tsa mɛ.” Ni nɛ ɔmɛ Yesaia de, ejakaa e na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nɛ e tu he munyu.
Se kɛ ɔ, nikɔtɔma amɛ tete a ti nihi fuu he e nɔ ye, se Farisifo ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a ja je we paa, konɛ a ko fie mɛ kɛ je kpe he ɔ; ejakaa a suɔ nimli a hɛ mi nyami pe Mawu nɔ́.
Yesu munyu kojoɔ Yesu de boboobo ke: “Nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, pi ye nɔ nɛ e heɔ yeɔ, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ. Nɛ nɔ nɛ naa mi ɔ naa nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ. Imi lɛɛ i ba je ɔ mi kaa la, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ko hi diblii ɔ mi.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko nu ye munyu nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, tsa pi imi nɛ ma kojo lɛ, ejakaa i bɛ nɛ ma ba kojo je ɔ, se mohu i ba nɛ ma ba he je ɔ yi wami.
Nɔ nɛ kuaa mi nɛ e pɛtɛ we ye munyu ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ kojo lɛ; munyu nɛ i tu ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu maa kojo lɛ ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa imi lɛɛ i to we imi nitsɛ ye yi mi i tu we munyu; se Tsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, lɛ mohu e wo mi kita, nɔ́ nɛ ma de kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma tu.
Nɛ i le kaa e kita a neneene wami ʼi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ de mi ɔ, ja i deɔ.”
Yesu fɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a nane he Loko Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ɔ maa su ɔ, akɛnɛ Yesu le kaa e ngmlɛfia nɛ e kɛ maa je je ɔ mi kɛ ya Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ su he je ɔ, bɔ nɛ e suɔ e nihi nɛ ngɛ je nɔ mi ɔ, ja e suɔ mɛ kɛ pi si.
Nɛ benɛ a ngɛ ni yee ɔ, blɔɔ abosiami ngɔ wo Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi ɔ, tsui mi momo kaa e tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ.
Nɛ Yesu le kaa Tsɛ ɔ tu nihi tsuo kulaa ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ kaa Mawu ngɔ e je nɛ e kpale yaa Mawu ngɔ ɔ, e te si ngɛ niyeni ɔ si, nɛ e je e tade ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ e ngɔ papahu ngɔ muɔ e mlɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e plɛ nyu ngɔ wo tsɛsi mi, nɛ e bɔni e kaseli ɔmɛ a nane he fɔmi, nɛ e kɛ papahu nɛ muɔ e mlɛ mi ɔ tsu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ba su Simon Petro nɔ, nɛ lɛɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o ngɛ ye nane he fɔe nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ o li, se ke pee se ɔ o maa le.” Petro de lɛ ke: “Ko fɔ ye nane he kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Ke i fɔ we o he ɔ, o be blɔfami nɔ́ ko ngɛ ye ngɔ.” Simon Petro de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, lɛɛ pi ye nane he kɛkɛ, se mohu ye nine kɛ ye yi mi hulɔ.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Nɔ nɛ a du e he ɔ, e hia we lɛ he fɔmi, ja e nane he kɛkɛ, se e he je kɛ pi si.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he je mohu, se pi nyɛ tsuo.” Ejakaa e le nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he nɛ e de ke: ‘Tsa pi nyɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ he je’ ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ, benɛ e fɔ a nane ɔmɛ a he nɛ e kukuɔ e tade ɔmɛ nɛ e ya hi si ekohu ɔ, e ke: “Nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ i pee ha nyɛ nɛ ɔ lo?
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsɛɛ mi tsɔɔlɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, na nyɛ tɔ we, ejakaa ja ji mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ, ke imi tsɔɔlɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, i fɔ nyɛ nane he ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ fɔɔ nyɛ sibi a nane he.
Se okadi i to nyɛ, konɛ bɔ nɛ i pee ha nyɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nyɔguɛ pa we e nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu tsɔlɔ pa we nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ le ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ ke nyɛ ye nɔ.
“Pi nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he munyu nɛ i ngɛ tue ɔ; imi lɛɛ i le nihi nɛ i hla; se mohu benɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a nɛ ba mi ke: Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye dɛ mi abolo ɔ, e wo e nane seja nɔ ngɔ si mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ngɔ to loko e ba mi, konɛ ke e ba mi ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa ami ʼi.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ nɛ heɔ nɔ nɛ i tsɔ ɔ, imi nɔuu e heɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ mi ɔ, e heɔ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hulɔ.” Yesu gba e seblɔtsɔɔmi ngɔ to Benɛ e de ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hao ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ e gba mi kpoo nɛ e de ke: “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hyɛ a sibi a hɛ mi, se a nɛ nɔ tutuutu he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ.
Se kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ Yesu suɔ ɔ kpasa e gugue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Simon Petro ma lɛ hɛ̃ ke e bi lɛ nɔ he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ.
Se lɛɛ e be nɔ Yesu gugue mi nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, mɛnɔ ʼi?
Yesu be nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ i kɛ nyamiwo bɔ ɔ maa sɔ mi ngɔ ha a nɛ.” Nɛ e kɛ nyamiwo bɔ ɔ sɔ mi nɛ e ngɔ ha Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi ɔ. Nɛ nyamiwo bɔ ɔ se pɛ nɛ Satan sɛ e mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, pee nɛ e sɔ!” Se nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ he je nɛ e de lɛ ja a.
A ti ni komɛ susu kaa, akɛnɛ Yuda lɛ toɔ sika kpɛɛ ɔ he nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ya he nihi nɛ he hia wɔ ngɔ to nyami ligbi ɔ,” aloo kaa e ngɔ nɔ ko ngɔ ha ohiafohi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ benɛ e he nyamiwo bɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e je kpo.
Se je jɔ.
Kita he ɔ Benɛ Yuda je kpo se ɔ, Yesu ke: “Jeha nɛ ɔ a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ e mi.
Ke a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ e mi ɔ, Mawu hu maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi, nɛ e maa wo e hɛ mi nyami oya.
Bimɛ tsɔwi, be bɔɔ kɛkɛ e piɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si; nyɛ ma hla mi, nɛ bɔ nɛ i de Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: ‘He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be lejɛ ɔ nyɛe maa bɛ’ a, jã i ngɛ nyɛ hu dee jeha nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kita he i ngɛ nyɛ woe, kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he.
Kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ɔ, jã nyɛ hu nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he.
Ke nyɛ suɔ nyɛ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ nihi tsuo kɛ maa le kaa ye kaseli ji nyɛ.” Yesu gba Petro kuami Simon Petro bi lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, jije o yaa?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “He nɛ i yaa a, o be nyɛe ye se maa nyɛɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, se o maa nyɛɛ ye se hwɔɔ se ko.” Petro de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, mɛni he je i be o se nyɛe ma nyɛɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ?
Ye wami tete ma ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ o he.” Yesu he nɔ ke: “O maa ngɔ o wami ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ ye he lo?
I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke: Kungwɔ be nɔ kpae nɛ o ma kpa ngɛ ye se si etɛ.”
Yesu ji blɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ “Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui; nyɛ he Mawu nɔ nyɛɛ ye, nɛ imi hu nyɛ he ye nɔ nyɛɛ ye.
Sihi hehi fuu ngɛ Tsaatsɛ we ɔ; ke pi ja jinɛ, i de nyɛ momo; ejakaa i yaa nɛ ma ya dla blɔ he ngɔ to nyɛ.
Nɛ ke i ya nɛ i ya dla blɔ he ngɔ to nyɛ ɔ, ma ba ekohu nɛ ma ba ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya he nɛ imi nitsɛ i ngɛ ɔ, konɛ he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ hi lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ he nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ le, nɛ blɔ ɔ hu, nyɛ le.” Toma de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, wa li he nɛ o yaa, nɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa maa le blɔ ɔ?” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ami ji blɔ ɔ kɛ anɔkuale ɔ kɛ wami ɔ; nɔ ko bɛ́ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, kaa ja e gu ye nɔ.
Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ, nyɛ ko le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ; nɛ kɛ je mwɔnɛ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa nyɛ na lɛ.” Filipo de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, tsɔɔ wɔ Tsɛ ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ hiɛ ha wɔ.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Pi mwɔnɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, o li mi lolo lo, Filipo?
Nɔ nɛ na mi ɔ, e na Tsɛ ɔ, nɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o deɔ ke: ‘Tsɔɔ wɔ Tsɛ ɔ?’ Anɛ o he we yi kaa i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi nɛ Tsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ye mi lo?
Munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tuɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i toɔ nɛ i deɔ; se Tsɛ ɔ nɛ hii ye mi ɔ, lɛ lɛ e tsuɔ ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ he mi nyɛɛ ye kaa i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi nɛ Tsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ye mi; se ke pi ja a, nyɛ he mi nyɛɛ ye ngɛ jamɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.
Anɔkuale mi, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nɔ nɛ heɔ ye nɔ yeɔ ɔ, ni tsumihi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e ma tsu, nɛ e ma tsu nihi nɛ pe kɔlɔ ɔmɛ tete, ejakaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ma pee, konɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami ngɛ Bi ɔ mi.
Ke nyɛ kpa nɔ ko he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, ma pee.” Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he siwomi “Ke nyɛ suɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye ye kita amɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ imi lɛɛ ma bi Tsɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ Hepiɛlɔ kpa, konɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si kɛ ya neneene; anɔkuale mumi ɔ nɛ je ɔ nyɛ we lɛ nɛ e ngɔ ɔ, mɛni he je ɔ, e nɛ́ lɛ, nɛ pohu e li lɛ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa e kɛ nyɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e maa hi nyɛ mi.
“I be nyɛ sie ahusa, i ma nyɛ ngɔ.
E piɛ bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ je ɔ be mi nae hu; se nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ mi nae, ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ maa hi ngmengmle.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ maa le kaa i ngɛ ye tsɛ mi nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ ye mi nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ mi.
“Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ye kita amɛ nɛ e yeɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ suɔ mi; nɛ nɔ nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ imi hu ma suɔ lɛ, nɛ ma je ye he si ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ.” Yuda, pi Iskariot ɔ, bi lɛ ke “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni ba he je nɛ wɔ kɛkɛ o ma je o he si ngɔ tsɔɔ nɛ o be jee ngɔ tsɔɔ je ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Ke nɔ ko suɔ mi ɔ, e maa ye ye munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ wa maa ba e ngɔ, nɛ waa kɛ e ngɔ maa pee wa sihi he.
Nɔ nɛ sume mi ɔ, e yi ye munyu nɔ.
Nɛ munyu nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue ɔ, pi ye nɔ, se mohu Tsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɔ ʼi.
“I de nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ be mi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ.
Se Hepiɛlɔ ɔ nɛ ji Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ maa tsɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, lɛ e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ nihi kulaa, nɛ e ma kai nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ.
“Hejɔmi i ngɛ sie ha nyɛ; hejɔmi nɛ ji ye nɔ ɔ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae, pi bɔ nɛ je ɔ haa a nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
Nyɛ nu kaa i de nyɛ ke: ‘I yaa, nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ.’ Nyɛ suɔ mi jinɛ nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi kaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, ejakaa Tsaatsɛ kle pe mi.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ loko e ba mi, konɛ ke e ba mi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛɛ ye.
I kɛ nyɛ be munyu tue fuu hu, ejakaa je ɔ mi matsɛ ɔ ma, se e be he wami ko nyɛ nyɛ nɔ.
I peɔ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ fa mi ɔ konɛ je ɔ nɛ na le kaa i suɔ Tsɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ te si, nyɛɛ ba waa je hiɛ ɔ!”
Yesu ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ nɛ “Imi ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ Tsaatsɛ ji ngmɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ye he kɔni tsuaa kɔni nɛ wui yiblii ɔ, e poo, nɛ eko tsuaa eko nɛ woɔ yiblii ɔ, e sãa he, benɛ pee nɛ e wo yiblii pe kekle ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ he je momo ngɛ munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ he.
Nyɛɛ hi ye mi, nɛ imi hu ma hi nyɛ mi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ tso kɔni be nyɛe maa je lɛ nitsɛ e mi nɛ e wo yiblii kaa ja e ma wai tso ɔ he ɔ, ja nyɛ hu nyɛ be nyɛe kaa ja nyɛ hi ye mi.
“Imi ji wai tsɔ ɔ, nyɛ ji kɔni ɔmɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hii ye mi nɛ imi hu i hii e mi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e woɔ yiblii fuu; ejakaa ke pi imi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ be nɔ ko nyɛe maa pee.
Ke nɔ ko hi ye mi ɔ, a sakee lɛ fɔɔ he kaa tso kɔni, nɛ e gbliɔ, nɛ a buaa nya ngɔ woɔ la mi, nɛ a sãa.
Ke nyɛ hi ye mi nɛ ye munyu ɔ hi nyɛ mi ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ɔ, a maa pee ha nyɛ.
Enɛ ɔ a kɛ woɔ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami, ke nyɛ wo yiblii fuu, nɛ nyɛ plɛ ye kaseli ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi ɔ, ja imi hu i suɔ nyɛ; nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ ye suɔmi ɔ mi.
Ke nyɛ ye ye kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi ye suɔmi ɔ mi; kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ye Tsaatsɛ kita amɛ a nɔ nɛ i ngɛ e suɔmi ɔ mi ɔ.
“I de nyɛ enɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ ye bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hi nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hyi.
Enɛ ɔ ji ye kita a, kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ɔ. Nɔ ko be suɔmi nɛ kle pe enɛ ɔ, kaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ e wami ngɔ fɔ si ha e huɛmɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee nihi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ he kita woe nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ye huɛmɛ ji nyɛ.
I tsɛ we nyɛ nyɔguɛhi hu, ejakaa nyɔguɛ li nɔ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ peɔ; se mohu huɛmɛ i tsɛ nyɛ, ejakaa nihi tsuo nɛ i nu ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nya a, i wo nɔ ta de nyɛ.
Tsa pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hla mi, se imi mohu lɛ i hla nyɛ, nɛ i to nyɛ konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya wo yiblii, nɛ nyɛ yiblii ɔ nɛ hi si; konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Enɛ ɔ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi.” Je ɔ nyɛmi “Ke je ɔ nyɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi kekle e nyɛ.
Kaa je ɔ mi nyɛ je jinɛ, je ɔ maa suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nihi, se akɛnɛ nyɛ ji je ɔ mi se imi mohu lɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ he nɛ je ɔ nyɛɛ nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi munyu nɛ i tu nyɛ ɔ nɔ ke: ‘Nyɔguɛ pa we e nyɔmtsɛ.’ Ke a wa mi yi mi ɔ, a maa wa nyɛ hu yi mi; ke a ye ye munyu ɔ nɔ ɔ, a maa ye nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.
A maa ngɔ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pee nyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he, mɛni he je ɔ, a li nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ. I bɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ba tu munyu jinɛ, yayami ko be a he; se enɛ ɔ ɔ, a be a he yayami ɔ he nya jemi ko.
Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ mi ɔ, e ngɛ Tsaatsɛ hu nyɛe.
Kaa i tsu we ni tsumihi nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko tsu we eko hyɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti jinɛ, yayami ko be a he; se enɛ ɔ lɛɛ a na nɛ kɛ ɔ, a ngɛ mi nyɛe kɛ Tsaatsɛ tsuo.
Sa nɛ e ba jã benɛ pee nɛ munyu nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mlaa a mi ɔ nɛ ba mi ke: ‘A nyɛ mi gu!’ “Se Hepiɛlɔ ɔ, nɛ ma tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji anɔkuale Mumi ɔ nɛ jee Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ baa a, lɛ nɛ ke e ba a, e maa ye ye he odase; nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa ye odase, ejakaa nyɛɛ kɛ mi lɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije.”
I de nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ nane nɛ ko kpata.
O A maa fie nyɛ kɛ maa je kpe he ɔmɛ.
Nɛ be maa ba tete nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbee nyɛ ɔ a ma susu kaa e kɛ ngɛ Mawu jae.
Nɛ a maa pee enɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa a li Tsɛ ɔ loo imi hulɔ.
Se i de nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ ke be ɔ su ɔ nɛ nyɛ kai kaa i wo nɔ ta de nyɛ, se kɛ je sisije ɔ i de we nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ lɛ ngɛ.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nitsumi “Se jeha nɛ ɔ ɔ, fi yaa nɔ nɛ tso mi ɔ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko bi we mi ke: ‘Jije o yaa?’ Se nɛ i wo ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ta de nya he je ɔ, kɔmɔ yemi hyi nyɛ tsui mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ anɔkuale dee: e hi ha nyɛ kaa ma je; mɛni he je ɔ, ke i ji ɔ, Hepiɛlɔ ɔ be nyɛ ngɔ bae; se ke i je ɔ, ma ha e ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Nɛ lɛɛ, ke e ba a, e ma kã je ɔ ngɛ yayami he kɛ dami he kɛ kojomi he: Yayami he, ejakaa a he we ye nɔ yi; dami he, ejakaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu; kojomi he, ejakaa a kojo je ɔ mi matsɛ ɔ.
“I ngɛ nihi fuu nɛ piɛ nɛ ma de nyɛ; se nyɛ be nyɛe he maa pɛtɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ; se ke anɔkuale Mumi ɔ na ba a, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ anɔkuale ɔ kulaa mi blɔ; ejakaa e be lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi toe kɛ tu munyu, se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa nu ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ e ma de, nɛ nihi nɛ ma a, e maa wo nɔ ta de nyɛ.
Lɛ e maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa e maa ngɔ ye nɔ ɔ eko nɛ e maa wo nɔ ta de nyɛ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ye nɔ ʼi; lɔ ɔ he nɛ i de ke: ‘E maa ngɔ ye nɔ ɔ eko nɛ e wo nɔ ta de nyɛ’ ɔ nɛ.” Kɔmɔ kɛ buajɔmi “E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na mi; ejakaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ bi a he ke: “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ wɔ dee nɛ ɔ: ‘Epiɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na mi,’ nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu; ‘I yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ’?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a ke: “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ: ‘E piɛ bɔɔ’?
Wa li nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ.” Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu na kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a bi lɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nɛ i ke e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he bie nɛ ɔ?
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma fo nɛ nyɛ maa wo ya, se je ɔ ma nya.
Nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, se nyɛ kɔmɔ yemi ɔ ma plɛ bua jɔmi.
Ke yo nu kɔɔmi ɔ, e haoɔ, ejakaa e ngmlɛfia a su.
Se benɛ e fɔ bi ɔ se ɔ, e kai we dengme ɔ hu ngɛ bua jɔmi nɛ e naa kaa e fɔ nɔmlɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ hu, jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee mohu, se ma na nyɛ ekohu, nɛ nyɛ tsui maa nɔ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ, na ko be kpɔe ngɛ nyɛ dɛ.
“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ be mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ bie.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke: Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e ma ha nyɛ.
Kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ kpa we nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi; nyɛ kpa pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma na, konɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hyi.” Je ɔ nɔ kunimiyemi “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, abɛhi a mi i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue ngɛ ɔ nɛ; se be ma nɛ i kɛ nyɛ be munyu tue ngɛ abɛhi a mi hu, se mohu paa ma jaje tsɛ ɔ he sane ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma kpa pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi, se i de we nyɛ ke imi lɛ ma bi Tsɛ ɔ ha nyɛ, ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ suɔ nyɛ, mɛni he je ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ i je.
Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ i je kɛ ba je ɔ mi, jeha nɛ ɔ hu, i ngɛ je ɔ mi jee kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.” Ekaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, jeha nɛ ɔ o tu munyu faii nɛ o tu we munyu ngɛ abɛhi a mi.
Jeha nɛ ɔ wa kɔ se kaa o le nihi tsuo nɛ e hia we kaa nɔ ko nɛ bi mo sane ko.
Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu ngɔ o je.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ hee ngɛ yee lo?
oʼɛ, ngmlɛfia a ma, nɛ e su po, nɛ nyɛ maa gbɛ fia nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ngɔ e blɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa je ye nɔ kake he; se pi ye nɔ kake ʼi, ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ.
I de nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ wo nyɛ bua ngɛ ye mi.
Je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he hiami nyɛ ma na, se kɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsui nɛ nɔ nyɛ mi.
I ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi!”
Yesu kpa pɛɛ kɛ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ Benɛ Yesu de ni nɛ ɔmɛ se ɔ, e wo e hɛ nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛ, ngmlɛfia a su.
Wo o bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami, konɛ o bi ɔ hu nɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami.
Ejakaa o ha lɛ he blɔ ngɛ he lo tsuo nɔ, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ o ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, e ha mɛ neene wami.
Se enɛ ɔ ji neneene wami ɔ nɛ, kaa a le mo, anɔkuale Mawu kake ɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ o tsɔ ɔ. Imi lɛɛ i wo o hɛ mi nyami ngɛ zugba a nɔ, akɛnɛ ni tsumi ɔ nɛ o ha mi tsumi ɔ i gbe nya a. Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, Tsaatsɛ, ngɔɔ hɛ mi nyami nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ o ngɔ loko a bɔ je ɔ ngɔ wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
“I je o biɛ ɔ si ngɔ tsɔɔ nimli nɛ o ngɔ kɛ je je ɔ mi ha mi ɔ. O nihi ji mɛ, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha mi, nɛ a ye o munyu ɔ nɔ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ a le kaa nihi kulaa nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, o ngɔ a je, ejakaa munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi ɔ, i ngɔ ha mɛ; nɛ a he, nɛ a na le faii kaa o ngɔ i je, nɛ a he ye kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi.
Imi lɛɛ, mɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ hae; tsa pi je ɔ nɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ hae, se mohu nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, ejakaa o nihi ji mɛ; nɛ ye nihi tsuo kulaa a, o nɔ ʼi, nɛ o nɔ hu ɔ, ye nɔ ʼi, nɛ ye hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ a mi.
Nɛ i be je ɔ mi hu, se ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ imi lɛɛ i ma o ngɔ.
Tsaatsɛ klɔuklɔu, nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, to mɛ ngɛ o biɛ ɔ mi, benɛ pee nɛ a pee kake kaa wɔ.
Benɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, i to mɛ ngɛ o biɛ ɔ mi; nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, i bu a he, nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko laa we, ja laami bi ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a nɛ ba mi.
Se jeha nɛ ɔ ɔ, i ma o ngɔ, nɛ i ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ dee ngɛ je ɔ mi, konɛ a na ye bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ e nu si ngɛ a mi?
I ngɔ o munyu ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ je ɔ ngɛ mɛ nyɛe, ejakaa a ji je ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ji je ɔ mi ɔ?
I bi we kaa o je mɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi, se mohu kaa o bu a he kɛ je nɛ ɔ yayami ɔ dɛ mi.
A ji je ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ji je ɔ mi ɔ. Pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi; o munyu ɔ anɔkuale ʼi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ o tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ mɛ je ɔ mi tsɔe.
Nɛ a he nɛ imi nitsɛ i peɔ ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ, konɛ mɛ hu a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ anɔkuale mi.
“Se pi ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ngɛ ɔ, se nihi nɛ ma he ye nɔ maa ye ngɛ a munyu ɔ nya a hulɔ.
Konɛ mɛ tsuo a pee kake, kaa bɔ nɛ mo, Tsaatsɛ, o ngɛ ye mi nɛ imi hu i ngɛ o mi ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a pee kake ngɛ wa mi, konɛ je ɔ nɛ he ye kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi.
Nɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, i ngɔ ha mɛ, konɛ sa pee kake, kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ kake ɔ. I ngɛ a mi, nɛ mo hu o ngɛ yɛ mi, konɛ a pee kake kɛ pi si, nɛ je ɔ nɛ le kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi, nɛ o suɔ mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi ɔ.
“Tsaatsɛ, nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ i suɔ kaa he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ mɛ hu a kɛ mi ba hi lejɛ ɔ, konɛ a na ye hɛ mi nyami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, ejakaa o suɔ mi loko a to je ɔ sisi.
Tsaatsɛ dalɔ, je ɔ li mo, se imi lɛɛ i le mo, nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ le kaa mo lɛ o tsɔ mi; nɛ i je o biɛ ɔ si ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ ma kpale je lɛ si ngɔ tsɔɔ, konɛ suɔmi nɛ o kɛ suɔ mi ɔ nɛ hi a mi nɛ imi hu ma hi a mi.”
Yesu numi Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ se ɔ, e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ je kpo nɛ a ya po Kedron pa a kɛ ho he nɛ abɔɔ ko ngɛ ɔ ya, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ sɛ mi.
Se Yuda, nɔ nɛ ya tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ, hu le lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ pɔɔ kpemi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ Yuda ya ngɔ aslaafohi kɛ tsɔli kɛ je osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ kanehi kɛ hahi kɛ dadehi kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ Yesu le nihi tsuo nɛ ma e nɔ ɔ, e je kpo nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” A he nɔ ke: “Yesu Nazareno ɔ.” Yesu de mɛ ke: “Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Se Yuda, nɔ nɛ ya tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ hu kɛ mɛ daa si.
Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ e de mɛ ke: “Imi ji nɛ ɔ” ɔ, a gbee senya senya nɛ a ya pue si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale bi mɛ ekohu ke: “Mɛnɔ nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” Nɛ a ke: “Yesu, Nazareno ɔ.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “I de nyɛ ke: Ami ʼi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke imi nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ha ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya.” (Konɛ munyu nɛ a tu ke: “Nihi nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, i ha we nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɛ laa” a nɛ ba mi.)
Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon Petro nɛ hɛɛ klaate ɔ hia nɛ e kɛ ja osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ e po e hiɛ ɔ nɔ tue; se nyɔguɛ ɔ biɛ ji Malko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu de Petro ke: “Ngɔɔ o klaate ɔ ngɔ wo e kpo ɔ mi.
Anɛ kplu nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ, ma ko nu lo?” Yesu ngɛ Hana hɛ mi Kɛkɛ nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ kɛ asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a tsɔli ɔmɛ nu Yesu nɛ a fi lɛ, nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ho Hana ngɔ ya kekle, ejakaa Kaiafa nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma yee ngɛ lɛ jeha a nɔ ɔ ngatsɛ ji lɛ.
Kaiafa ji nɔ nɛ wo Yudafo ɔmɛ ga kaa e hi kaa nɔ kake gboɔ ngɛ ma a nane mi ɔ nɛ.
Petro kua Yesu Nɛ Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kpa ko hu nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Se osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a le jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yesu sɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a mɔ ɔ kpo ɔ kpɛti; se Petro daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jamɛ a kaselɔ kpã a nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a le ɔ je kpo, nɛ e ya de yo nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ Petro kɛ ba we ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ de Petro ke: “Tse mo hu nyumu nɛ ɔ kaseli ɔmɛ eko ji mo?” E ke: “Dɛbi.” Se nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a kɛ hã slɛ la, ejakaa fiɛ ngɛ, nɛ a ngɛ la hluee; nɛ Petro hu kɛ mɛ daa si ngɛ la a eko hluee.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a bi Yesu sane Jeha nɛ ɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a bi Yesu e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ e tsɔɔmi ɔ he munyu.
Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Pãa i tuɔ munyu kɛ tsɔɔ je ɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ i tsɔɔ ni ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, he nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ tsuo kpee ngɛ ɔ, nɛ i de we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ laami mi.
Mɛni he je o ngɛ imi mohu bie?
Bi ninɛmɛ nɛ ba buɔ mi tue ɔ nɔ́n ɛ i deɔ mɛ; oʼɛ, ni nɛ ɔmɛ le nihi nɛ i deɔ ɔ.” Se benɛ e de kikɛ ɔ, sɔmɔli nɛ daa si ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake gba Yesu ma nɛ e ke: “Heto nɛ o ha osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a ji nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Ke i de nɔ́ yaya ko ɔ, ye nɔ́ yaya a he odase, se ke kpakpa a, mɛni he je o ngɛ mi gbee?” Nɛ Hana ha a kɛ lɛ ya osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Kaiafa ngɔ ngɛ kpa mi.
Petro kua Yesu ekohu Se Simon Petro daa si nɛ e ngɛ la hluee.
Jeha nɛ ɔ a de lɛ ke: “Tse mo hu e kaseli ɔmɛ e ko ji mo?” E kua nɛ e ke: “Dɛbi.” Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ ji nɔ nɛ Petro po e tue ɔ wekuno ɔ, ke: “Anɛ i nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi lo?” Nɛ Petro kua ekohu, kɛkɛ nɛ nɔuu nɛ kungwɔ kpa nɔ.
Yesu ngɛ Pilato hɛ mi Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpaka Yesu kɛ je Kaiafa ngɔ kɛ ho kojomi he ɔ ya.
Nɛ e su makɛ.
Mɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ lɛɛ a sɛ we kojomi he ɔ, konɛ a ko ble a he, benɛ pee nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ Pilato je kpo kɛ ba a ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Mɛni sane nyɛɛ kɛ ba ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ nɔ fɔe?” A he nɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Pi yayami peelɔ ji lɛ jinɛ waa kɛ lɛ ba be mo hae.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ya kojo lɛ ngɛ nyɛ mlaa a nya.” Yudafo ɔmɛ de lɛ ke: “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa gbee nɔ ko.” (Konɛ Yesu munyu nɛ e tu kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ nɛ ba mi.)
Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato kpale sɛ kojomi he ɔ ekohu, nɛ e tsɛ Yesu nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Anɛ mo ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Mo nitsɛ o yi mi o to ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee nɛ ɔ, aloo ni komɛ lɛ a de mo ja ngɛ ye he?” Pilato he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Anɛ Yuda no ji mi lo?
Mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ lɛ a ngɔ mo ha mi.
Mɛni o pee?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Ye matsɛ yemi ɔ ji je nɛ ɔ mi; ye matsɛ yemi ɔ je je nɛ ɔ mi jinɛ, ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ maa plee he, konɛ a ko ngɔ mi ngɔ ha Yudafo ɔmɛ; se enɛ ɔ ɔ, ye matsɛ yemi ɔ ji hiɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Pilato bi lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ matsɛ ji mo kɛ̃ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke: “Jã o de ɔ nɛ; ejakaa matsɛ ji mi.
Imi lɛɛ enɛ ɔ he a fɔ mi, nɛ enɛ ɔ he nɔuu i ba je ɔ mi ngɛ, konɛ ma ba ye anɔkuale ɔ he odase.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ nuɔ ye gbi.” Pilato bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni ji anɔkuale?” A bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ Nɛ benɛ e de enɛ ɔ ɔ, e je kpo kɛ ho Yudafo ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya ekohu, nɛ e ya de mɛ ke: “Imi lɛɛ i nɛ fɔ bumi sane ko kulaa ngɛ e he.
Se nyɛ ngɛ blɔ nya ko kaa i ngmɛɔ nɔ kake he haa nyɛ ngɛ Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ɔ nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ suɔ nɛ ma ngmɛɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ he ha nyɛ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa ekohu ke: “Tsa pi nɔ nɛ ɔ, se Baraba mohu!” Kpahu Baraba a ojo fialɔ ji lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato ngɔ Yesu nɛ e fia lɛ kplibi, nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ ngɔ mio kɛ pee jlasi nɛ a kɛ fi e yi, nɛ a wo lɛ tade tsutsu ko, nɛ a ba e ngɔ ba de ke: “Wa nga mo oo, Yudafohi a matsɛ!” Nɛ a gba e hɛ mi ma.
