Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato je kpo ekohu nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, i kɛ lɛ ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ma nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ na le kaa i nɛ fɔbumi sane ko ngɛ e he.” Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu je kpo nɛ mio jlasi ɔ fi e yi nɛ e wo tade tsutsu ɔ. Nɛ Pilato de mɛ ke: “Ne nɔmlɔ ɔ!” Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ na lɛ ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Sɛu lɛ, sɛu lɛ!” Pilato de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ nɛ nyɛ ya sɛu mɔ, ejakaa imi lɛɛ i nɛ fɔ bumi sane ko ngɛ e he.” Yudafo ɔmɛ he nɔ ke: “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ Mlaa, nɛ wa Mlaa a nya a, e sa gbenɔ, ejakaa e pee e he Mawu bi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Pilato nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, e ye gbeye pe kekle ɔ; nɛ e sɛ kojomi he ɔ ekohu, nɛ e bi Yesu ke: “Jije o je?” Se Yesu pui e nya mi.
Nɛ Pilato de lɛ ke: “O be ye nya mi poe?
Anɛ o li kaa i ngɛ he blɔ kaa i sɛuu mo, nɛ i ngɛ he blɔ hulɔ kaa i ngmɛɔ o he lo?” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ke pi hiɔwe nɛ a je ngɔ ha mo ɔ, jinɛ o be he wami ko nae ngɛ ye nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ nɛ je mi wo o dɛ mi ɔ he yayami ɔ kle pe o nɔ ɔ.” Kɛ je lɔ ɔ se ɔ Pilato hla kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e he; se Yudafo ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke: “Ke o ngmɛɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ he ɔ, o pi Kaisare huɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peɔ e he matsɛ ɔ, e te si ngɔ wo Kaisare.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Pilato nu kekɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ ɔ, e kɛ Yesu je kpo, nɛ e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, ngɛ he nɛ a ka tɛ ngɛ, nɛ Hebri mi ɔ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gabata a.
Se Hetsɔmi ɔ dlami kɛ tomi ligbi ʼi, nɛ maa pee piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi.
Nɛ Pilato de Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: “Ne nyɛ matsɛ ɔ!” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke: “O kɛ lɛ nɛ ya, o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya!
Sɛu lɛ!” Pilato bi mɛ ko: “Nyɛ matsɛ ɔ, ma sɛu lɛ lo?” Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ he nɔ ke: “Wa be matsɛ ko kaa ja Kaisare.” A sɛu Yesu Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha mɛ nɛ a ya sɛu.
Nɛ a ngo Yesu kɛ ho.
Nɛ lɛ nitse e tloo e seumi tso ɔ kɛ ya he nɛ a tsɛɛ Yikoklodonya, nɛ Hebri mi ɔ a tsɛɛ lɛ Golgota a. Lejɛ ɔ a ya sɛu lɛ ngɛ; nɛ a kɛ ni kpahi enyɔ piɛ e he, nɔ kake ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ kɛke hu ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ Yesu ngɛ a kpɛti.
Nɛ Pilato ngma womi ko ngɔ mɛtɛ e seumi tso ɔ yi mi; bɔ nɛ e ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yesu, Nazareno, Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.” Womi nɛ ɔ ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu kane, ejakaa he nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ kɛ ma a mi kɛ we; nɛ a ngma ngɛ Hebri kɛ Hela kɛ Roma gbi mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ de Pilato ke: “Koo ngma ke: ‘Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ’ se mohu kaa lɛ lɛ e de ke: ‘Ami ji Yudafo ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.’ ” Pilato he nɔ ke: “Nɔ nɛ i ngma a, i ngma.” Benɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ sɛu Yesu se ɔ, a kukuɔ e tade ɔmɛ, nɛ a dla mi mi dlami eywiɛ, aslaafo no kake nɔ́ kake, kɛ e gugue tade ɔ hulɔ.
Se gugue tade ɔ be tsami he; a lo kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba ma si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a de ngɛ a kpɛti ke: “Nyɛ ko ha nɛ wa gba kɔlɔ ɔ, se nyɛ ha waa fɔ nɔ sɔ, konɛ waa na nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee.” Benɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ de ke: ‘A dla ye tade ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a he, Nɛ ye he bo ɔ a fɔ́ nɔ sɔ’ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ pee ɔ nɛ.
Se Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛ nyɛmi yo, Maria, Klopa yo ɔ, kɛ Maria Magdalena daa si ngɛ Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ kasa nya.
Nɛ, benɛ Yesu na e nyɛ kɛ kaselɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ daa si ɔ, e de e nyɛ ke: “Maa, o bi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Pee se ɔ, e de kaselɔ ɔ ke: “Oʼɛ, o nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Nɛ kɛ je lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ ɔ, kaselɔ ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e we mi ya.
Yesu gbenɔ Nɛ enɛ ɔ se ɔ, akɛnɛ Yesu le kaa a gbe nihi kulaa nya momo ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ na ba mi ɔ, e ke: “Kuma ngɛ mi yee.” Jeha nɛ ɔ nɔ́ maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke e mi da nɛ kuã tɔtɔɔtɔ; nɛ a ngɔ wosuma ngɔ sɔ da nɛ kua a mi, nɛ a ngɔ ma paploo nya, nɛ a ngɔ to e nya he.
Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Yesu he da nɛ kuã a, e ke: “A gbe nya!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ma e yi si, nɛ e ngɔ e nya.
A gbɔ Yesu kasa mi nɔ́ Kɛkɛ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ya kpa Pilato pɛɛ ke a kuɔ a nanehi nɛ a je mɛ, benɛ pee nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ko hi seumi tso ɔ nɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ, ejakaa he dlami kɛ tomi ligbi ʼi, nɛ jamɛ a Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ ji ligbi ngua.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ aslaafo ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya kuɔ nihi nɛ a sɛu ngɔ piɛ Yesu he ɔmɛ a nanehi, kekleekle nɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ tsuo.
Se benɛ a su Yesu nɔ nɛ a na kaa e gbo momo ɔ, lɛɛ a kuɔ we e nanehi; se mohu aslaafo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake kɛ blɔ gbɔ e kasa mi, nɛ amlɔ ɔ muɔ kɛ nyu be kɛ je mi.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ na a, lɛ e ye he odase nɛ ɔ nɛ, e odase ɔ anɔkuale ʼi, nɛ e le kaa anɔkuale e ngɛ tue, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he ye.
Ejakaa a pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ke: “A be e wu ko kue” ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, ngmami kpa ko ke: “A maa hyɛ nɔ nɛ a gbɔ lɛ nɔ ɔ.” Yesu pumi Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yosef nɛ je Arimatia nɛ ji Yesu kaselɔ, se Yudafo ɔmɛ a he gbeye he ɔ e je we e he si ɔ, ya bi Pilato, konɛ e ha nɛ e ya je Yesu gbogboe ɔ; nɛ Pilato ha lɛ he blɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya je Yesu gebogboe ɔ kɛ ho.
Nɛ Nikodemo, nɔ nɛ kekle ko nɛ e ba Yesu ngɔ nyɔ mi ɔ, hu kɛ mire kɛ aloe nɛ a futu maa pee sɛni tɛ jiɔmi lafa ba.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ Yesu gbogboe ɔ nɛ a kɛ kploba kɛ tsopa amɛ fi lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yudafohi peɔ kɛ puɔ nɔ ɔ.
Se he nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ, abɔɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ yɔkɔ he ko ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi nɛ a tui no ko ngɛ mi hyɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya dla Yesu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he dlami kɛ tomi ligbi ɔ he, ejakaa yɔkɔ ɔ he kɛ we.
Yɔkɔ mi gu ɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ, otsi ɔ mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ makɛ mla benɛ zugba mi tɛ̃ lolo ɔ, Maria Magdalena ba yɔkɔ ɔ he, nɛ e na kaa a je tɛ ɔ kɛ je muɔ ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e sa fo, nɛ e ba Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kake nɛ Yesu suɔ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ e ba de mɛ ke: “A wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ je muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ wa li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Petro kɛ jamɛ a kaselɔ kake ɔ je kpo, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ yaa yɔkɔ ɔ he.
Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo wo fo; se kaselɔ kake ɔ be Petro he, nɛ lɛ kekle e ya su yɔkɔ ɔ he; nɛ benɛ e kɔkɔ e yi si nɛ e hyɛ mi ɔ, e na kploba amɛ nɛ a pueɔ si, se e sɛ we yɔkɔ ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon nyɛɛ e se kɛ ba, nɛ e ba sɛ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e na kploba amɛ nɛ a pueɔ si; se duku nɛ a kɛ fi e yi ɔ fɔ we si ngɛ kploba amɛ a kasa nya, se mohu e fɔɔ si ngɛ he kpa banee bɔ nɛ a fi ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ kaselɔ kake ɔ hu nɛ ba yɔkɔ ɔ he kekle ɔ sɛ mi, nɛ e na, nɛ e he ye; (ejakaa a na we nɛ a le ngami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke ja e te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ.)
Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho a we mi ya.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ Maria Magdalena Se Maria daa si ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ se je ngɛ ya foe.
Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ ya a foe ɔ, e kɔkɔ e yi si nɛ e hyɛ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e na hiɔwe bɔfohi enyɔ nɛ a wo ni hiɔ nɛ a hii si ngɛ he nɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ fɔ si ngɛ ɔ, nɔ kake ngɛ e yi je, nɛ nɔ kake hu ngɛ e nane si je.
Nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Maa, mɛni he je o ngɛ ya foe?” E de mɛ ke: “Ejakaa a wo ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ ho, nɛ i li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ.” Nɛ benɛ e de enɛ ɔ ɔ, e plɛ e he nɛ e hyɛ e se, nɛ e na Yesu daa si, se e li kaa Yesu.
Yesu bi lɛ ke: “Maa, mɛni he je o ngɛ ya foe?
Mɛnɔ o ngɛ hlae?” Maria susu kaa be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ abɔɔ mi dlalɔ ɔ ʼi, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Etsɛ ke mo lɛ o wo lɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ ɔ, tsɔɔ mi he nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya fɔ̃, konɛ ma ya wo lɛ.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Maria!” Nɛ Maria plɛ e he, nɛ e de lɛ ngɛ Hebri mi ke: “Rabuni” (e sisi ji: Tsɔɔlɔ.)
Yesu de lɛ ke: “Koo ta ye he; ejakaa i na we ma ya hiɔwe ngɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ lolo; se yaa ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ o ya de mɛ ke: I yaa hiɔwe ngɛ Tsaatsɛ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ tsɛ kɛ ye Mawu kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Maria Magdalena ba nɛ e ba sɛɛ ha kaseli ɔmɛ ke e na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɛ bɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ Jeha nɛ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ ji otsi ɔ mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ gbɔkuɛ ɔ nɔuu, benɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he gbeye he je ɔ a nga he nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ bua a he nya ɔ sinya amɛ ɔ, Yesu ba nɛ e ba da a kpɛti nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ he manye!” Nɛ benɛ e de ja a, e ngɔ e dɛ mi kɛ e kasa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ na bua jɔmi kaa a na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu kpale de mɛ ekohu ke: “Nyɛ he manye!
Bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi ɔ, ja imi hj i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔe ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ benɛ e de ja a, e mu ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ he Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ!
Nihi a he yayami nɛ nyɛ ma ngɔ pa a, a ngɔ pa; nɛ nihi a he yayami nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa to ɔ, a ngɔ to.” Yesu kɛ Toma Se Toma, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Didimo (hayo) ɔ be a kpɛti nɛ Yesu ba a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ kaseli kpa amɛ de lɛ ke: “Wa na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Se e de mɛ ke: “Ja i na e dɛ mi plɛkobi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ i kɛ ye nguɛ sia plɛkobi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ i kɛ ye nine hɔ e kasa mi ɔ loko ma he ye.” Nɛ ligbi kpaanyɔ se ekohu ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ tsu mi, nɛ Toma hu piɛ a he.
Nɛ a nga sinya amɛ, nɛ Yesu ba, nɛ e ba da a kpɛti nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ he manye!” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de Toma ke: “O kɛ o nine nguɛ nɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ba hyɛ ye dɛ mi ɔ, nɛ o kɛ o nine ba hɔ ye kasa mi ɔ, nɛ o ko je nɔ́, se mohu o he ye.” Toma he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ ye Mawu.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Toma, nɛ o na mi he je ɔ o he ye; a gbaa ninɛmɛ nɛ a nɛ se kɛ̃ ɔ a heɔ yeɔ ɔ.” Nɔ nɛ he je nɛ a ngma womi nɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ okadi kpahi fuu hu ngɛ nɛ Yesu pee ngɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a ngmɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi; se enɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngma, konɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Yesu ji Kristo, Mawu bi ɔ nɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ he ye ɔ, nɛ nyɛ na wami ngɛ e biɛ ɔ mi.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli kpaago Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu kpale je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ Tiberia Wo ɔ nya.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Simon Petro kɛ Toma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Didimo ɔ, kɛ Natanael nɛ je Kana ngɛ Galilea a, kɛ Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni kpahi enyɔ hu ngɛ he kake kutuu.
Simon Petro de mɛ ke: “I yaa wo.” A de lɛ ke: “Wɔ hu waa kɛ mo maa ya.” A pue nɔ nɛ a ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ lɛ nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ a gbi nɔ́ ko.
Se benɛ je ngɛ nae ɔ, Yesu ba da wo ɔ nya, se kaseli ɔmɛ “li kaa Yesu.
Jeha nɛ ɔ Yesu bi mɛ ke: “Bimɛ, nyɛ gbe lo ko lo?” A he nɔ ke: “Dɛbi.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ fɔ ya a ngɛ lɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ je, nɛ nyɛ ma na nɔ́ ko.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a fɔ ya a, nɛ lo ɔmɛ a hiemi nya a, a nyɛ we ya a nɛ a sã?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ kaselɔ n Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ de Petro ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ʼi.” Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Simon Petro nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ʼi ɔ, e kɛ e tade ɔ muɔ e mlɛ mi, ejakaa e hii si kɛ e he gu, nɛ e tu nɔ wo ɔ mi.
Se kaseli kpa amɛ gu lɛ nyafii ɔ mi kɛ ba, ejakaa a kɛ zutgba he kɛ we, maa pee nine kpɔ mi kami lafa enyɔ loo nɔ́ kɛkɛ, nɛ a ngɛ ya a kɛ lo ɔmɛ sãe.
Nɛ benɛ a ba kple ɔ, a na hã kɛ la ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ lo pueɔ si ngɛ nɔ, kɛ abolo.
Nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ kɛ lo nɛ nyɛ gbe piɔ ɔ eko nɛ ba.” Simon Petro ya lɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ya gbla ya a kɛ ba zugba kɛ e mi lo nguahi fuu tɔ, lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ etɛ.
Lo ɔmɛ hiɛ kikɛ mohu, se kɛ̃ ɔ ya a gba we.
Yesu de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ba wo nyɛ nya mi nɔ́ ko.” Kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ́ lɛ bimi ke: “Mɛnɔ ji mo?” Ejakaa a le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ba nɛ e ba kɛ̃ abolo ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ, kɛ lo ɔ hulɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛ nɛ Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ ekaseli ɔmɛ, benɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ. Yesu kɛ Petro Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ a ye ni ɔ ta a, Yesu bi Simon Petro ke: “Simon, Yona bi, o suɔ mi pe ni nɛ ɔmɛ lo?” Simon de lɛ ke: “Ee, Mawetsɛ, o le kaa i suɔ mo.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ ye to bi ɔmɛ!” Yesu kpale bi lɛ nɔ nɛ ji si enyɔ ke: “Simon, Yona bi, o suɔ mi lo?” E he nɔ ke: “Ee, Mawetsɛ, o le kaa i suɔ mo.” E de lɛ ke: “Hyɛ ye to ɔmɛ!” Yesu bi lɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji si etɛ ke: “Simon, Yona bi, o suɔ mi lo?” E dɔ Petro kaa e bi lɛ si etɛ sɔuu ke: ‘O suɔ mo lo?’ ɔ; nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, o le nihi kulaa, o le kas i suɔ mo.” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Lɛɛ ye to omɛ!
I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke: Benɛ o ji niheyo ɔ, mo nitsɛ o miaa nɛ o nyɛɛ he nɛ o suɔ; se ke o bwɔ ɔ, o ma kpã o nine mi, nɛ nɔ kpa maa mia mo, nɛ e kɛ mo maa ya he nɛ o sume.” (E de enɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ.)
Nɛ benɛ e de lɛ enɛ ɔ ɔ, e de lɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ye se.” Yesu kɛ kaselɔ kpa a Se benɛ Petro plɛ e he ɔ, e na kaselɔ nɛ Yesu suɔ ɔ nyɛɛ se, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ kpasa Yesu gugue ngɛ niyeni ɔ si nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛnɔ maa tsɔɔ o se blɔ?” ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Petro na lɛ ɔ, e bi Yesu ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, se nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛɛ?” Yesu de lɛ ke: “Ke i suɔ kaa e hi si kɛ ya su ye bami be ɔ, o he sane mɛni ji kɔlɔ ɔ?
Moo lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye se!” Kɛkɛ nɛ munyu nɛ ɔ gbɛ fia ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ke jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ be gboe.
Kpahu Yesu de we ke e be gboe, se mohu e ke: “Ke i suɔ kaa e hi si kɛ ya su ye bami be ɔ, o he sane mɛni ji kɔlɔ ɔ?” Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ yeɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase, nɛ lɛ lɛ ngma mi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ wa le kaa e odase ɔ anɔkuale ʼi.
Nyagbe Ni kpahi fuu hu ngɛ nɛ Yesu pee, nɛ ke a ke a maa ngma lɛ tsuo kakaaka a, i susu kaa je ɔ nitsɛ be nyɛe womihi nɛ jinɛ a maa ngma a maa to.
Teofilo, ngɛ ye kekle womi ɔ mi ɔ, i ngma nihi kulaa nɛ Yesu ba pee nɛ e tsɔɔ kɛ je e ni tsumi sisije ɔ, kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a. Loko a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, e gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ kɛ wo e kaseli nɛ e hla amɛ kita.
E amanehlu ɔ se ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ, e gu blɔhi fuu a nɔ je e he kpo tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ kaa hɛ kalɔ, nɛ a na lɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he munyu.
Nɛ bene e kɛ mɛ ba kpe ɔ, e wo mɛ hiɔngɔ ke: “Nyɛ ko je Yerusalem, se mohu nyɛɛ mle tsɛ ɔ si womi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu ngɛ ye nya a; ejakaa Yohane ɔ, nyu e kɛ baptisi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e be kɛe nɛ a kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu maa baptisi nyɛ.” A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho hiɔwe ya Jeha nɛ ɔ nihi nɛ ba bua a he nya a bi lɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, anɛ kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔ mi o ma tle o matsɛ yemi ɔ si ngɔ ha Israel ɔ lo?” Yesu de mɛ ke: “Pi nyɛ blɔ nya ji kaa nyɛ maa le be ɔmɛ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ to ngɛ lɛ nitse e he wami nya a; se ke Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ na ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma na he wami nɛ nyɛ ma plɛ ye he odaseyeli ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria tsuo kɛ yaa su zugba a nyagbe he.” Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɛ lɛ hyɛe nɔuu, nɛ a wo lɛ, nɛ bɔku ko ngɔ lɛ kɛ je a hɛ mi kɛ ho.
Nɛ benɛ e yaa nɛ a ngɛ hiɔwe hyɛe too ɔ, oʼɛ, nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ wo tade hiɔ daa si ngɛ a kasa nya, nɛ a ke: “Nyɛ Galilea nyumuhi, mɛni he je nyɛ daa si ngɛ hiɔwe hyɛe kikɛ?
Kikɛmɛ a Yesu nɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ je nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ ɔ ɔ, ye maa ba ja nɔuu, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ na kaa e yaa hiɔwe nɛ ɔ.” Yuda nanemimalɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ je yoku nɛ a tsɛɛ Nyuoku nɛ kɛ Yerusalem kɛmi maa pee Hejɔɔmi Ligbi blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ kɛ ba Yerusalem ekohu.
Nɛ benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ, a ya hiɔwe tsu ko mi, he nɛ Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo kɛ Andrea, Filipo kɛ Toma, Bartolomeo kɛ Mateo, Yakobo, Alfeo bi ɔ kɛ Simon, ma he doolɔ ɔ, kɛ Yakobo bi Yuda hii ɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ yi ɔmɛ kɛ Yesu nyɛ Maria kɛ e nyɛmimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ juɛmi kake hɛɛ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami wawɛɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Petro te si da kaseli ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nihi nɛ bua a he nya a, maa pee nihi lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ, nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, e sa kaa jamɛ a ngmami nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de to ngɛ David nya ngɛ Yuda nɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ ya nu Yesu ɔ blɔ ɔ he ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Ejakaa a bu lɛ ngɔ si wa nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ e blɔ nya ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ mi.
“Se kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɔ e yayami nɛ e pee mi hiɔwo ɔ kɛ he abɔɔ, nɛ e ya ma e yi si, nɛ e mi gba enyɔ nɛ e mi ni tsuo pã pue si.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ na le enɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ a tsɛɛ jamɛ a abɔɔ ɔ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbi mi ke Akeldama, e sisi ji “muɔ abɔɔ”.
“Ejakaa a ngma ngɛ Lahi a womi ɔ mi ke: ‘Ha e sihi he ɔ nɛ plɛ we doku, Nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ko hi mi,’ kɛ; jeha nɛ ɔ hu: ‘Nɛ e sɔmɔmi ni tsumi ɔ ha nɔ kpa nɛ ngɔ.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa nyumuhi nɛ kɛ wɔ nyɛɛ be tsuaa be nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu yaa baa ngɛ wa kpɛti, kɛ je Yohane baptisimi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ je wa ngɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ plɛ e si temi ɔ he odase yelɔ ngɔ piɛ wa he.” Nɛ a hla ni enyɔ, Yosef nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barsaba nɛ a wo lɛ Yusto hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Maria ngɔ da si.
Nɛ a sɔle ke: “Mo, Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ o le nimli kulaa a tsui mi, tsɔɔ ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ nɛ o hla, kone e ngɔ kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi kɛ bɔfo ni tsumi nɛ Yuda je mi ngɔ lɛ nitse e blɔ ɔ.” Nɛ pa fɔ́ a nɔ sɔ, nɛ sɔ ɔ ya nɔ Maria nɔ, nɛ a bu lɛ ngɔ si bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ nɔ.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ bami Benɛ Pentekoste ligbi (loo ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ ɔ) su ɔ, mɛ tsuo a nya ba bua kɛ juɛmi kake ngɛ he kake.
Nɛ si kake ɔ, pɛmi ko nɛ ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko je hiɔwe ba, nɛ e ba hyi we he nɛ a hii si ngɛ ɔ tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Nɛ ni kome nɛ a gba mi nɛ ngɛ kaa la lilɛhi pue; nɛ a ba ma a yi kpɛti kakaaka.
Nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ba hyi mɛ tsuo kulaa tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ a bɔni gbi slɔɔto slɔɔtohi tumi, kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɔ wo a nya a.
Se Yudafohi Mawu gbeye yeli kome ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ je majemaje kulaa nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Se benɛ a nu kikɛmɛ a pɛmi nɛ ɔ ɔ, nihi babauu ba bua a he nya nɛ a he mi po ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nu kaa a ngɛ lɛ nitse e ma mi gbi tue.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa, nɛ a de a he ke: “Oʼɛ, anɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ munyu nɛ ɔ tue tsuo nɛ ɔ, pi Galileabihi ʼi lo?
Se kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitse e ma mi he nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ ɔ gbi nue nɛ ɔ?
Partiabihi kɛ Mediabihi kɛ Elambihi, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Mesopotamia kɛ Yudea kɛ Kapadokia, Ponto kɛ Asia, Frigia kɛ Pamfilia, Mizraim kɛ Libia ni ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Kireene kasa nya, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ je Roma, Yudafohi kɛ nihi nɛ plɛ Yudafohi, Kretabihi kɛ Arabiabihi: Wa ngɛ nue kaa a ngɛ Mawu ni ngua amɛ jajee ngɛ wa je gbihi a mi.” Nɛ mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he nɛ a dɛ yaa, nɛ nɔ nɛ de nɔ nɛ ke: “Kɛ ji enɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?” Se ni kome hu ye fɛu ke: “A de dã.” Petro munyu nɛ e tu Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro kɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ te si da si, nɛ e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ asafo ɔ ke: “Yuda nyumuhi kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le enɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu ye munyu ɔ tue: Tsa pi dã nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ de kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue ɔ, ejakaa mɔtu ngmlɛ nɛɛ kɛkɛ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; se mohu enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yoel de ɔ ke: (Mawu ke:) ‘Nɛ e maa ba mi ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, Kaa ma nɛ ye mumi ɔ ngɔ pue he lo kulaa nɔ, Nɛ nyɛ bimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ yi ɔmɛ maa gba, Nɛ nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ maa na ninamihi, Nɛ nyɛ nikɔtɔma a mɛ maa nla nlamihi, Nɛ, ye tsɔli nyumuhi kɛ yi ɔmɛ hu a nɔ Ma nɛ ye mumi ɔ ngɔ pue Ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a maa gba.
Nɛ ma pee nyakpɛ nihi ngɛ hiɔwe Kɛ okadihi hu ngɛ zugba a nɔ, Muɔ kɛ la kɛ lakusu.
Pu maa tsɔ diblii Nɛ nyɔhiɔ ma plɛ muɔ Loko Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ngua nɛ ngɛ nyami ɔ maa ba Nɛ e maa ba mi kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ ɔ, a ma he e yi wami.’ “Tsaatsɛmɛ Israelbihi, nyɛɛ bu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ tue.
Yesu Nazare no ɔ ji nyumu nɛ Mawu kɛ he wami ni tsumihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi kɛ okadihi nɛ e gu e nɔ kɛ pee ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ ye e he odase ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le ɔ. Yesu nɛ ɔ nɛ a je lɛ ngɛ Mawu yi mi tomi kɛ e ni nɛ e le ngɔ to ɔ nya ngɔ ha a, nyɛ gu nihi nɛ li mlaa amɛ a nine nɔ nyɛ sɛu lɛ nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ.
Lɛ nɔuu si Mawu tle nɛ e pɛne gbenɔ piimi kpa amɛ, ejakaa gbenɔ be nyɛe e nya tsimi.
Ejakaa David de ngɛ e he ke: ‘I naa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi daa, Ejakaa e ngɛ ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ, kone ma ko dede.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ye tsui nɔ ye mi, Nɛ ye lilɛ ngɛ nyae, Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ ye he lo hu maa jɔɔ e he ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi, Ejakaa o be ye klaa sie ngɛ gbeje, Nɛ o be hae nɛ o nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ puɛ.
O ha i le wami blɔ ɔ, Nɛ o ma ha ye tsui maa nɔ ye mi faa ngɛ o hɛ mi.’ “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, nyɛ ha ma tu munyu faii ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ blemano David he, kaa e gbo nɛ a pu lɛ, nɛ e yɔkɔ ngɛ wa kpɛti kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ.
Akɛnɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ nɛ e le kaa Mawu ka lɛ kita ke e mi mi bimɛ ɔmɛ eko maa hi e sɛ̃ ɔ nɔ he je ɔ, e na ngɔ to nɛ e tu Kristo si temi ɔ he munyu, kaa a be e klaa sie ngɛ gbeje nɛ e he lo hu be puee.
Kikɛmɛ a Yesu nɛ ɔ Mawu tle lɛ si; lɔ ɔ he odase yeli ji wɔ kulaa.
Jeha nɛ ɔ akɛnɛ a wo e nɔ kɛ ho Mawu hiɛ ɔ nine nɔ ya nɛ e na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he si womi ɔ kɛ je Tsɛ ɔ dɛ he je ɔ, e nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ ngɔ pue si.
Ejakaa David yɛ hiɔwe, cse lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Hii ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ, Kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o henyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ pee o nane si maangoo.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha Israel we ɔ kulaa nɛ le tutuutu kaa Mawu ngɔ kikɛmɛ a Yesu nɛ nyɛ sɛu lɛ nɛ ɔ ngɔ pee Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo.” Benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ, e gbɔ a tsui mi, nɛ a de Petro kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?” Petro de mɛ ke: Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha a baptisi lɛ ngɔ wo Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, konɛ a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma na Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɔke nɔ ɔ. Ejakaa si womi ɔ nyɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ se lokoo, nihi abɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ wa Mawu ɔ ma tsɛ kɛ maa ba a, a nɔ ʼi.” Nɛ e tu munyu kpahi fuu e kɛ ye odase nɛ e kɛ wo mɛ ga ke: “Nyɛ ha a he nyɛ yi wami kɛ je yi nɔ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃e nɛ ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛhe e munyu ɔ ye ngɛ tsui mi jɔmi nya a, a baptisi mɛ, nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, a ngɔ klaahi maa pee akpe etɛ ngɔ piɛ a he.
Nɛ a hɛɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ kɛ huɛ bɔmi ɔ kɛ abolo mi kumi ɔ kɛ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami ɔmɛ a mi.
Ninɛmɛ nɛ he ye ɔmɛ a sihimi Nɛ gbeye nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ a gu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nine nɔ kɛ pee nyakpɛ ni kɛ okadihi fuu.
Nɛ nihi nɛ he ye ɔ kulaa ngɛ he kake, nɛ a pee a nihi tsuo kulaa kake.
Nɛ a jua a zugba amɛ kɛ a he ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a dla ngɔ ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo bɔ nɛ he hia nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Nɛ daa ligbi ɔ, a kɛ juɛmi kake yaa sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a kuɔ abolo ngɛ wehi a mi, nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ tsui klɔuu yeɔ ni, nɛ a jeɔ Mawu yi, nɛ a hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ ma mluku ɔ kulaa hɛ mi.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔɔ nihi nɛ a he a yi wami ɔ ngɔ piɛɛ asafo ɔ he daa ligbi.
A tsa akpaketsɛ ko Ligbi ko gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ, sɔlemi yami be ɔ, Petro kɛ Yohane nyɛɛ kɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔ. Nyumu ko ngɛ nɛ ji akpaketsɛ kɛ je e nyɛ muklii mi, nɛ a woɔ lɛ daa kɛ ba hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we sinya nɛ a tsɛɛ sinya saminyayoo ɔ nya, konɛ e ba ni ngɛ nihi nɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Benɛ e na Petro kɛ Yohane nɛ a yaa sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e ba mɛ nɔ́ ko.
Se Petro kɛ Yohane hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ Petro de lɛ ke: “Hyɛ wa hɛ mi.” E dɔ e hɛngmɛ to a nɔ, e hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e ma na nɔ́ ko kɛ je a dɛ.
Se Petro ke: “Sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu ɔ, i be eko; se nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ i kɛ ngɛ mɔ hae nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ngɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazare no ɔ, biɛ mi ɔ, tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ!” Nɛ e pɛtɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine mi nɛ e wo e nɔ da si; nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e nane kɛ e kpɔji nya amɛ a mi wa lɛ; nɛ e hlu da si nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ hlumi kɛ Mawu yi jemi.
Nɛ ma mluku ɔ tsuo na lɛ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe nɛ e ngɛ Mawu yi jee.
Benɛ a kpa si kaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ sinya saminyayoo ɔ nya nɛ e hii nɔ bae ɔ, a he mi po nɛ a nya kpɛ a he babauu ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ha lɛ ɔ he.
Petro fiɛmi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ Akɛnɛ akpaketsɛ nɛ a tsa a ngɛ Petro kɛ Yohane bɛbɛ mi he je ɔ, ma a kulaa bu kɛ ba bua a he nyɛ ngɛ a ngɔ ngɛ ablanaa nɛ a tsɛɛ Salomo nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a he mi po.
Se benɛ Petro na enɛ ɔ ɔ, e de ma a ke: “Nyɛ Israel nyumuhi, mɛ he je nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ yaa pee ngɛ enɛ ɔ he?
Aloo mɛ he je nyɛ ngɛ wɔ hyɛe too kikɛ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wami loo wa Mawu jami nya waa kɛ ha nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe nɛ ɔ?
Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ nɛ ji wa tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ wo e tsɔlɔ Yesu hɛ mi nyami; nɔ nɛ nyɛ je lɛ ngɔ ha nɛ nyɛ kua lɛ ngɛ Pontio Pilato hɛ mi, benɛ lɛɛ e pee e juɛmi kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e he ɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kua nɔ klɔuklɔu kɛ dalɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ke a ngmɛɛ nɔmlɔ awi yelɔ mohu he ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ Wami Matsɛ ɔ, nyɛ gbe lɛ.
Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he odaseyeli ji wɔ.
Nɛ e biɛ ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nya nɛ a tsa nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ nyɛ le ɔ; nɛ e nɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ha e pee kpitikplii ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, mamimɛ, i le kaa fimi nɛ nyɛ li he je nɛ nyɛ pee kaa nyɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ̃.
Se nihi nɛ Mawu de ngɔ to momo ngɛ we gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, kaa Kristo maa na amanehlu ɔ, e ha e ba mi ja.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui nɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se, kone a gbe nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ, benɛ pee nɛ he jɔmi be nɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ba, konɛ e tsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ e je ngɔ to nyɛ momo ɔ; nɔ nɛ sa kaa e ya hi hiɔwe kɛ ya su nihi kulaa a blɔnya tomi be nɛ Mawu tu he munyu ngɛ e gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nya kɛ je blema a. Ejakaa Mose de tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ, ma tle gbalɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa imi si kɛ maa je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue ngɛ nihi kulaa nɛ e ma de ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ mi.
Nɛ e maa ba mi kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ tue bue ɔ, a ma kpata e hɛ mi kulaa kɛ maa je ma a mi.’ Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ gbali tsuo nɛ tu munyu kɛ je Samuel kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ nɔ ɔ, wo kikɛmɛ a ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ hu tã ngɔ to.
Nyɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ kɛ somi ɔ bimɛ, somi nɛ Mawu kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ so, benɛ e de Abraham ke: ‘O nina mi nɛ a maa gbaa zugba a nɔ wekuhi kulaa ngɛ’ ɔ. Nɛ Mawu tle e tsɔlɔ Yesu si ɔ, nyɛ kekle nyɛ ngɔ e tsɔ lɛ nɛ e ba gbaa nyɛ nɛ e kpale nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ je e ni yayami ɔmɛ a he.”
Petro kɛ Yohane ngɛ gua a hɛ mi Se benɛ Petro kɛ Yohane ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ ngɛ ma a tsɔɔe ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ Sadukifo ɔmɛ ba pue a nɔ, ejakaa a muklii mi fu kaa a ngɛ ma a ni tsɔɔe, nɛ a ngɛ jajee ngɛ tsɔɔe ke Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje.
Nɛ a nu mɛ, nɛ a wo mɛ tsu mi kɛ ya su e nɔ je na, ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ je jɔ.
Se nihi nɛ nu munyu ɔ a kpɛti nihi fuu he ye, nɛ nyumu ɔmɛ a yibɔ maa su akpe enyɔ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ, e ba mi kaa e nɔ je na a, a ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Hana, kɛ Kaiafa kɛ Yohane kɛ Aleksandro kɛ nihi abɔ nɛ je osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a weku ɔ mi ɔ. Nɛ a ya ngɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba da kpɛti, nɛ a bi mɛ ke: “Mɛnɔ he wami nya, aloo mɛnɔ biɛ mi nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ ngɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ ma mi ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ Israel nikɔtɔmahi!
Ke a kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu yee mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpakpa nɛ a pee kikɛmɛ a hiɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ he kaa mɛnɔ nɔ a gu kɛ tsa lɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ tsuo kɛ Israel ma mluku ɔ kulaa a na nɛ a le kaa, Yesu Kristo, Nazare no ɔ, nɛ nyɛ sɛu, nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e biɛ mi nɔ nɛ ɔ daa si ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ e he mi wa lɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛ nɔuu ji tɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ji tsu fiali ɔmɛ gbe he guɛ, nɛ e ba plɛ kɔ nya tɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa yi wami hemi be nɔ ko nɔ ko mi; nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, biɛ kpã ko be hiɔwe sisi nɛ a ngɔ ha nimli nɛ sa kaa a gu nɔ kɛ he wa yi wami.” Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ a na Petro kɛ Yohane kã a nɛ a kpa si kaa pi womi mi leli kɛ ni leli kome ji mɛ ɔ, e pee a hɛ mi yaa, nɛ a kɔ se kaa a kɛ Yesu hi si.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu, akɛnɛ a na nɔmlɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ daa si he je ɔ, a nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a de.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a fa mɛ ke a je gua a mi kɛ je kpo bɔɔ.
A ya dami nɛ a ke: “Kɛ wa maa pee nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛɛ?
ejakaa okadi ngua nɛ a pee ɔ ngɛ pãa ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ wa be nyɛe ma kua.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ e ko gbɛ fia fuu ko hu ngɛ ma a mi he je ɔ, nyɛ ha waa wo a he gbeye, konɛ a ko tu munyu ngɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ mi ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu.” Nɛ a tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a wo mɛ kita kadikadi ke a ko wo nɔ tã, nɛ a ko tsɔɔ ni ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi kulaa hu.
Se Petro kɛ Yohane he nɔ nɛ a de mɛ ke: “Ke e da blɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa a bu nyɛ mohu tue pe Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ kojo.
Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nyɛe kaa ja wa de nihi nɛ wa na kɛ nihi nɛ wa nu ɔ.” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ, benɛ a kpale wo a he gbeye ɔ, a ngmɛɛ a he, ejakaa a nɛ́ bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a maa pii mɛ ngɛ ma a he, ejakaa nihi tsuo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami woe ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ he; ejakaa nɔmlɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ nyakpɛ tsami nɛ ɔ ye pe jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Asafo ɔ kpa pɛɛ kɛ bi hewamiwomi Se benɛ a ngmɛɛ a he ɔ, a ba a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a ba sɛɛ nihi kulaa nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ de mɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ.
Benɛ a nu ɔ, a kɛ juɛmi kake wo a gbi nɔ ha Mawu nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba kɛ wo kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ: “Mo nɔ nɛ o gu wa tsɛ David, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, nya de ke: ‘Mɛni he je je ma amɛ ngɛ hoo pee, Nɛ ma a hu ngɛ yaka nihi susue nɛ ɔ?
Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ te da si, Nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ hu a nya ba bua Ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.’ Niinɛ, Herode kɛ Pontio Pilato kɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ kɛ Israel ma amɛ hu ba bua a he nya ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ngɔ wo o tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu Yesu, nɔ nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, konɛ a pee nihi tsuo nɛ o nine kɛ o yi mi tomi ɔ to ngɔ fɔ si ke a pee ɔ. Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu Nyɔmtsɛ, hyɛ a he gbeye nɛ a ngɛ woe ɔ, nɛ o ha o sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kɛ kã fuu nɛ jaje o munyu ɔ, nɛ o kpã o nine mi nɛ o ha a tsa nihi, nɛ a gu o tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu Yesu ɔ biɛ mi kɛ pee okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi.” Benɛ a sɔle ɔ, he nɛ a nya ba bua ngɛ ɔ mimiɛ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi mɛ tsuo tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ a kɛ kã jaje Mawu munyu ɔ. Asafo ɔ pee a nihi kulaa kake Nihi babauu nɛ he ye ɔ kulaa hɛɛ tsui kake kɛ mumi kake, nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko tsɛ we e nihi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ mi eko ke lɛ nitse e nɔ, se mohu a ngɔ kulaa ngɔ pee kake.
He wami kpetekpleenyɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu sitemi ɔ he odase nɛ dloomi kpetekpleenyɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo kulaa a nɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti nɛ e fiɔ lɛ, ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ ngɛ zugbahi loo wehi ɔ juaa, nɛ a kɛ nihi nɛ a jua amɛ a nya sika a baa, nɛ a kɛ ba pueɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ a nane nya, nɛ a dlaa ngɔ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔ nɛ he hiaa lɛ ɔ. Nɛ Yose, nɔ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ wo Barnaba (e sisi ji “Buawomibi”) ɔ, nɛ ji Levi no nɛ e se je Kipro ɔ, ngɛ zugba ko, nɛ e jua, nɛ e kɛ sika a ba nɛ e kɛ ba pue bɔfo ɔmɛ a nane nya.
Anania kɛ Safira Se nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania nɛ a tsɛɛ e yo hu ke Safira a ya jua zugba ko, nɛ e kɛ yi ni ɔ fã ko to se, nɛ e yo ɔ hu le he nɔ́ ko.
Nɛ e kɛ fã ko ba nɛ e kɛ ba pue bɔfo ɔmɛ a nane nya.
Se Petro ke: “Anania, mɛni he je Satan hyi o tsui mi tɔ, nɛ o ye lakpa ngɔ tsɔɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ o kɛ zugba a yi ni ɔ fã ko to se?
Benɛ e ngɛ ɔ, pi o nɔ ʼi, nɛ benɛ o jua hu ɔ, sika a pi mo nitse o nɔ lo?
Mɛni he je o susu kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ ko ngɛ o tsui mi?
Tsa pi nimli nɛ o ye lakpa ngɔ tsɔɔ nɛ ɔ, se Mawu mohu ʼi.” Nɛ benɛ Anania nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e nɔ si nɛ e gbo.
Nɛ gbeye ngua nu ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nu ɔ. Nihewi ɔmɛ te si, nɛ a ba dla gbogboe ɔ, nɛ a wo lɛ kɛ je kpo nɛ a ya pu.
Nɛ maa pee ngmlɛfia etɛ se ɔ, e ba mi kaa e yo ɔ hu nɛ li sane nɛ ba a ba lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ Petro bi lɛ ke: “De mi, anɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ jua zugba a ha ji nɛ ɔ lo?” Nɛ Safira ke: “Ee ja ʼi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de lɛ ke: “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ pee kake nɛ nyɛ ka Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ nɛ ɔ?
Oʼɛ, nihi nɛ ho ya pu o huno ɔ a nanehi a nya lɛ ngɛ sinya a nya a nɛ, nɛ a ma wo mo hu kɛ ho.” Kɛkɛ nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ e nɔ si ngɛ e nane nya nɛ e gbo.
Nɛ benɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba na kaa e gbo ɔ, a wo lɛ kɛ ho nɛ a ya pu ngɛ e huno ɔ kasa nya.
Nɛ gbeye kpetekpleenyɛ nu asafo mluku ɔ tsuo kɛ nihi nɛ nu ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ. Okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi A gu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nine nɔ kɛ pee okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi fuu ngɛ ma a mi; nɛ mɛ tsuo a kɛ juɛmi kake hi Salomo ablanaa a nɔ.
Nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ́ kaa e kɛ yi flɛflɛ ma ya bɔ a he, se maa buu mɛ saminya.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a kɛmihi nɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi babauu ba piɛ a he, hluu tete po nɛ a woɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ baa blɔ ɔmɛ a he ba pueɔ sahi kɛ sa tsohi a nɔ, konɛ ke Petro bee ɔ, e nini kɛkɛ nɛ pue a ti ni kome a nɔ.
Nɛ nihi fuu je mahi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ mi ba bua a he nya, nɛ a hɛɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ mɛ haoe ɔ kɛ ba nɛ a tsa mɛ kulaa.
A wa bɔfo ɔmɛ yi mi Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a te si kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ nɛ ji Sadukifo ɔmɛ a ku ɔ, nɛ a hɛ̃ dɔ wawɛɛ.
Nɛ a ba nuu bɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ya wo mɛ tsu mi.
Se nyɔmi ɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ba bli tsu ɔ sinya amɛ nɛ e je mɛ, nɛ e ke: “Nyɛɛ ya sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ nyɛ ya da si nɛ nyɛɛ jaje kikɛmɛ a wami he nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ kulaa ngɔ tsɔɔ maa.” Nɛ a pee bɔ nɛ a de mɛ ɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ mɔtu mla kɛ ho sɔlemi we ɔ ya nɛ a ya tsɔɔ ni.
Jeha nɛ ɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ ba, nɛ a ba tsɛ gua ngua a kɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya tsu ɔ mi konɛ a ya je bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba Se benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, a nɛ mɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a kpale a se ba sɛɛ ke: “Tsu ɔ wa na kaa a nga nya kpɛii, nɛ buli ɔmɛ hu daa si ngɛ sinya amɛ a nya; se benɛ wa bli ɔ, wa nɛ́ nɔ ko ngɛ mi.” Se benɛ osɔfo ɔ kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ ɔ, a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa kɛ enɛ ɔ nyagbeni ma ya ba ha kɛɛ?
Nɛ nɔ ko ba ba sɛɛ ha mɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ wo tsu ɔ mi ɔ daa si ngɛ sɔlemi we ngɛ ma a ni tsɔɔe.” Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya kpaka mɛ kɛ ba, pi kã nya, ejakaa a ngɛ ma a gbeye yee nɛ a ko ba fia mɛ tɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a kɛ mɛ ba a, a kɛ mɛ ba da gua ngua a hɛ mi; nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a bi mɛ ke: “Pi kita nɛ wa wo nyɛ kadikadi ke nyɛ ko tsɔɔ ni ngɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ?
Oʼɛ, nyɛ ha Yerusalem hyi tɔ kɛ nyɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ muɔ baa wa nɔ.” Se Petro kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a ke: “E sa kaa a buɔ Mawu mohu tue pe nimli.
Yesu nɛ nyɛ sɛu ngɛ tso nɔ nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ ɔ, wa tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ tle lɛ si.
Lɛ e nɔ Mawu wo kɛ ho e hiɛ ɔ nɔ ya, nɛ e wo lɛ ganɔ kɛ yi wami helɔ, konɛ e ha Israel nɛ na tsui tsakemi kɛ yayami pami.
Nɛ wɔ ji kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase yeli, ja nɔuu ji Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ.” Benɛ a nu ɔ, e gbɔ a tsui mi, nɛ a to a yi mi ke a maa gbe mɛ.
Se Farisifono ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gamaliel, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ ma a kulaa buu lɛ ɔ, te si da si ngɛ gua ngua a kpɛti, nɛ efa ke a kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ je kpo bɔɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Israelbi, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ maa ye ha.
Ejakaa ningmi nɛ ɔ ɔ, Teuda te si nɛ e ke nɔ ko ji lɛ, nɛ nyumuhi maa pee lafa eywiɛ kɛ a he ya bɔ e he; se a gbe lɛ, nɛ nimli abɔ nɛ bu lɛ tue ɔ kulaa gbɛ fia, nɛ a yi hɛ si.
Nɔ nɛ ɔ se ɔ Yuda, Galilea no ɔ te si ngɛ nihi a kanemi ligbi ɔmɛ ami, nɛ e muɔ asafo babauu ngɔ pue e se.
Lɛ hu e hɛ mi kpata, nɛ nihi nɛ bu lɛ tue ɔ tsuo hu gbɛ fia.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ nyɛ ko di a se, ejakaa ke nimli a dɛ mi kikɛmɛ a yi mi tomi nɛ ɔ loo kikɛmɛ a ni tsumi nɛ ɔ je ɔ, e ma puɛ.
Se ke Mawu dɛ mi e je ɔ, nyɛ be nyɛe ma puɛ; konɛ nyɛ ko ba pee nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ a kɛ Mawu ngɛ ta hwue.” Nɛ a bu lɛ tue; nɛ a tsɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a fia mɛ kpa nɛ a wo mɛ kita ke a ko tu munyu ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi hu, nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a je gua ngua a hɛ mi kɛ ho kɛ bua jɔmi kaa e biɛ ɔ he ɔ, a bu mɛ nihi nɛ sa kaa a bɔ mɛ ahlua.
Nɛ daa ligbi ɔ, a jɔɔ we ni tsɔɔmi kɛ Yesu Kristo fiɛmi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ wehi a mi.
Hepiɛli kpaago ɔ Jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi, benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɛe ɔ, munyu huitihuiti ko ba te si ngɛ Helenibi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Hebribi ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa hɛ jee a yalɔyi ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ a daa hyemi ɔ blɔfami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ tsɛ kaseli asafo ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a de mɛ ke: “E sɛ kaa wa siɔ Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ wa ya sɔmɔɔ ngɛ okplɔɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ hla nyɛ kpɛti ni kpaago nɛ ngɛ biɛ kpakpa nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ ni lemi hyi mɛ tɔ, konɛ waa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to kikɛmɛ a ni tsumi nɛ he hia nɔ nya.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ, wa maa hɛɛ sɔlemi kɛ munyu ɔ he sɔmɔmi ɔ mi.” Munyu ɔ sa asafo mluku ɔ tsuo hɛ mi; nɛ a hia Stefano, nyumu ko nɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi lɛ tɔ ɔ, kɛ Filipo kɛ Prokoro kɛ Nikanora kɛ Timon kɛ Parmena kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he piɛlɔ Nikolao nɛ je Antiokia a, nɛ a kɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba da bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ a sɔle nɛ a kɛ a ninehi pue a nɔ.
Nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ blɛke, nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a he ba hiɛ babauu ngɛ Yerusalem; nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tete po a kpɛti nihi fuu buɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tue.
A nu Stefano Nɛ Stefano, nɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ he wami hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, pee nyakpɛ nihi kɛ okadi nguahi ngɛ ma a mi.
Se ni kome nɛ je kpe he nɛ a tsɛɛ Nihi nɛ ye a he ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ, kɛ Kireenebi kɛ Aleksandriabi kɛ nihi nɛ je Kilikia kɛ Asia a, a ti ni kome te si nɛ a kɛ Stefano sa nya.
Se a nyɛ we ni lemi kɛ mumi nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ nya nɛ a da.
Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, a ya wo ni komɛ yi nɛ a ba de ke: “Wa nu kaa e tuɔ Mose kɛ Mawu he musu bɔmi munyuhi.” Nɛ a wo ma bi ɔmɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli amɛ yi, nɛ a te si kɛ ba pue e nɔ nɛ a ba nu lɛ, nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ya gua ngua a hɛ mi.
Nɛ a kɛ lakpa odase yeli ba da si, nɛ a de ke: “Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ jɔɔ we munyu tumi kɛ He Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ Mlaa a simi gblee; ejakaa wa nu kaa e de ke: ‘Yesu Nazare no ɔ, ma puɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma tsake blɔnyahi nɛ Mose ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ.’ ” Nɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ gua ngua a mi ɔ tsuo dɔ a hɛngmɛ ngɔ to e nɔ, nɛ a na e hɛ mi kaa Mawu bɔfo ko hɛ mi.
Stefano fiɛmi Nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a bi Stefano ke: “Anɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ja lo?” Nɛ Stefano ke: “Mamimɛ kɛ Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue.
Hɛ mi nyami Mawu ɔ je e he kpo tsɔɔ wa tsɛ Abraham, benɛ e ngɛ Mesopotamia, nɛ e na we nɛ e ba hi Haran ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Jee o zugba a nɔ kɛ o weku mi kɛ ya zugba niɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ e je Kaldeabi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ya hi Haran.
Nɛ benɛ e tsɛ gbo se ɔ, Mawu ha e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba kikɛmɛ a zugba nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e hi lɛ zugba ko, bɔ nɛ a kɛ nane maa nɔ tete.
Se e wo lɛ si kaa e ma ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ e nina nɛ ma ngɛ e se ɔ kaa a nɔ́, pohu jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e be bi po.
Se bɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ tu munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘E nina ma ya to nibwɔ ngɛ ma se zugba ko nɔ, nɛ a maa ye mɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ a maa wa mɛ yi mi jeha lafa eywiɛ.’ Nɛ Mawu ke: ‘Ma kojo jamɛ a ma nɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ a maa je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba ja mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ.’ Nɛ Mawu ngɔ nɔ pomi he somi ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.
Nɛ somi nɛ ɔ mi e fɔ Isak ngɛ, nɛ e po lɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ. Nɛ Isak fɔ Yakob, nɛ Yakob fɔ blematsɛmɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ.
“Nɛ blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ hɛ tsumi jua Yosef kɛ ho Mizraim ya.
Se Mawu kɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e je lɛ ngɛ dengmehi kulaa mi, nɛ e ha e hɛ mi ba nyami, nɛ e ha e le ni ngɛ Mizraim matsɛ Farao hɛ mi, nɛ e wo lɛ ganɔ ngɛ Mizraim kɛ lɛ nitse e we ɔ kulaa nɔ.
Se hwɔ kɛ dengme kpetekpleenyɛ ba Mizraim ke Kanaan zugba a tsuo kulaa nɔ, nɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ́ ni nɛ a ye.
Nɛ benɛ Yakob nu kaa blɛfo ngɛ Mizraim ɔ, kekleekle ɔ, e tsɔ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ ɔ, Yosef ha e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ yo lɛ, nɛ Farao hu ba le Yosef weku ɔ. Nɛ Yosef tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ Yakob kɛ e weku ɔ tsuo kɛ ba, a yi bɔ ji nyingmi kpaago kɛ enuɔ.
Yakob pue nɔ kɛ ho Mizraim ya, nɛ lɛ kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ba Shekem, nɛ a ba pu mɛ ngɛ gɔ nɛ Abraham je sika kɛ he ngɛ Shekem tsɛ Hemor bi ɔmɛ a dɛ ɔ mi.
“Se benɛ si womi be ɔ nɛ Mawu ka Abraham he kita a su ɔ, ma a ba kle, nɛ a he ba hiɛ ngɛ Mizraim zugba a nɔ, kɛ ya su be nɛ matsɛ kpa nɛ li Yosef ɔ ba ye Mizraim nɔ.
Lɛ nɛ e kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi si ngɛ sisimi blɔ nɔ nɛ e pee mɛ yayami, kaa e ha a sake a bimɛ bimwɔwi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he, benɛ pee nɛ a ko hi je mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu a fɔ Mose.
E he ngɛ fɛu ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a lɛ lɛ ngɛ e tsɛ we ɔ hlami etɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ he ɔ, Farao biyo ɔ ya wo lɛ, nɛ e lɛ lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ pee lɛ nitse e bi.
A tsɔɔ Mose Mizraim nile tsuo, nɛ e na he wami ngɛ munyuhi kɛ ni tsumihi a mi.
“Benɛ Mose ye jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ, e ba e yi mi kaa e ma ya slaa e nyɛmimɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ.
Nɛ benɛ e na kaa a ngɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake yayami pee ɔ, e fã e he, nɛ e to Mizraim no nɛ a ngɛ lɛ yayami pee ɔ nane mi, nɛ e gbe Mizraim no ɔ.
(Jinɛ e susu kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ma kɔ se kaa Mawu ngɛ e nine nɔ gue nɛ e kɛ kpɔ mɛ; se a kɔ we se.)
E nɔ je na a, e ba na nyɛmimɛ enyɔ komɛ nɛ a ngɛ kunɔ nɔe, nɛ e kpata mɛ ke: ‘Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛmimɛ ji nyɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he yayami pee nɛ ɔ?’ Se nɔ nɛ pee e nyɛmi yayami ɔ tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ ya se nɛ e ke: ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ wo mo wa nɔ ganɔ kɛ kojolɔ?
Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o gbe mi kaa bɔ nɛ o gbe Mizraim no ɔ hiɛ ɔ?’ Munyu nɛ ɔ he ɔ Mose tu fo nɛ e ya to nibwɔ ngɛ Midian zugba a nɔ, nɛ e fɔ bimɛ nyumuhi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
“Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ se ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ Sinai yoku ɔ he nga a nɔ ngɛ la lilɛ mi ngɛ pu ko mi.
Nɛ benɛ Mose na a, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa ngɛ ni nami ɔ he.
Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ lɛ hɛe kɛ ngɛ he sue konɛ e hyɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbi de lɛ ke: ‘Imi ji o tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ.’ Nɛ Mose he do blibliibli nɛ e ka kaa e ma ya hyɛ.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: ‘Je o tokota amɛ ngɛ o nane, ejakaa he nɛ o daa si ngɛ ɔ, zugba klɔuklɔu ʼi.
I na ye ma nɛ ngɛ Mizraim ɔ a dengme ɔ, nɛ a zanuelami ɔ hu i nu, nɛ i kple si kɛ ma mɛ jemi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ba nɛ ma tsɔ mo Mizraim.’ “Jamɛ a Mose ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ a kua nɛ a de ke: ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ wo mo wa nɔ ganɔ kɛ kojolɔ’ ɔ, lɛ kɛ̃ Mawu gu bɔfo ɔ nɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ le ngɛ pu ɔ mi ɔ nɔ tsɔ lɛ kaa ganɔ kɛ kpɔlɔ.
Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e kpaka mɛ ke je kpo, nɛ e pee nyakpɛ nihi kɛ okadihi ngɛ Mizraim zugba a nɔ kɛ Wotsu ɔ mi kɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Lɛ ji jamɛ a Mose nɛ de Israelbi ɔmɛ ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma tle gbalɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa imi si kɛ maa je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɔ ha nyɛ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue.’ Mose ji nɔ nɛ kɛ asafo ɔ hi nga a nɔ nɛ e da bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yoku ɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ e he wami munyu ɔmɛ ba ha wɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ɔ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we nɛ a bu lɛ tue se mohu a hɛɛ lɛ soisoi, nɛ a tsui kpale kɛ ho Mizraim ya ekohu, nɛ a de Aaron ke: ‘Pee mawuhi ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ a nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi, ejakaa kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ kpakpa wɔ kɛ je Mizraim zugba a nɔ nɛ ɔ, wa li nɔ́ nɛ ya ba e nɔ.’ Nɛ jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a pee na bi, nɛ a sa bɔ ngɔ ha amaga a, nɛ a na mɛ nitse a nine nya ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he bua jɔmi.
Se Mawu plɛ e he nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he kaa a ja hiɔwe nihi, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ mi ke: ‘Nyɛ Israel we, Anɛ imi nɛ nyɛ sã lohwehi kɛ ni yeni bɔ ɔ ngɔ ha Ngɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ lo?
Molok bo tsu mohu nyɛ wo tloo Kɛ nyɛ Mawu Remfan ɔ dodoe ɔ nɛ ji amagahi Nɛ nyɛ puɛ nɛ nyɛ jaa mɛ ɔ; Nɛ Babilon se ma muɔ nyɛ kɛ maa ho.’ “Watsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛ odase Bo Tsu ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
A pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ke e pee lɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji kaa bɔ nɛ e na a. Benɛ watsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nine su nɔ ɔ, a kɛ Yosua hɛɛ kɛ ba majeli nɛ Mawu fie ngɛ watsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ a zugba a nɔ.
Hiɛ ɔ e hi kɛ ba su David be ɔ mi.
Lɛ e hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nɛ e kpa pɛɛ ke e maa pee sihi he ko ngɔ ha Yakob Mawu ɔ.
Se Salomo ma tsu ha lɛ.
“Pohu Hiɔwe no ɔ, tsa hi tsuhi nɛ a kɛ ninehi pee ɔmɛ a mi, kaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ hu de ɔ ke: ‘Hiɔwe ɔ ye matsɛ sɛ ʼi, Nɛ zugba a ye nane si maangoo ʼi.
Mɛni tsu nyɛ maa ma ha mi mɔ?
Jeha nɛ ɔ jije ji ye he jɔɔmi he ɔ?
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Anɛ pi ye nine nɛ pee enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa lo?’ “Nyɛ kuɛ wali kɛ amaga jali ngɛ tsuihi kɛ tuehi a mi!
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ nyɛ kuɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nya; bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, jã nyɛ hu nyɛ peɔ.
Gbali ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ wɛ́ lɛ yi mi hyɛ?
Nɛ a gbe nihi nɛ gba sa ngɛ dalɔ ɔ bami ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ plɛ e se blɔ tsɔɔli kɛ awi yeli ɔ, nyɛ nɛ nyɛ na mlaa a ngɛ bɔfohi a ni tsumi nya nɛ nyɛ yi nɔ ɔ.” A fia Stefano tɛ Se benɛ a nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e gbɔ a tsui mi, nɛ a kpe a lungu nya pue e nɔ.
Se lɛɛ akɛnɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, e hyɛ hiɔwe too, nɛ e na Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ Yesu nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ e ke: “Oʼɛ, i ngɛ hyɛe nɛ hiɔwe nya bli kɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ.” Se a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ a tsi a tue, nɛ a kɛ juɛmi kake ke kɛ ba e nɔ, nɛ a tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ.
Nɛ odasefo ɔmɛ ngɔ a bo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue niheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Saulo ɔ nane nya.” Nɛ benɛ a fia Stefano tɛ ɔ, e fã Yesu nɛ e ke: “Mawetsɛ Yesu, he ye mumi ɔ!” Nɛ e kpla si, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “Mawetsɛ, koo ngɔ kikɛmɛ a yayami nɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ!” Nɛ benɛ e de kikɛ ɔ, e ngɔ e nya.
Saulo wa asafo ɔ yi mi Stefano gbemi ɔ ngɔ Saulo hu nya.
Nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ nɔuu ɔ, yi mi wami kpetekpleenyɛ te si wo asafo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a gbɛ fia Yudea kɛ Samaria ni ɔmɛ a mi, ja bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛkɛ e piɛ.
Nyumuhi Mawu gbeye yeli komɛ ya dla Stefano ngɔ to, nɛ a fo lɛ wawɛɛ.
Se Saulo lɛɛ, e ka asafo ɔ hɛ mi kpatami.
E sɛɛ wehi a mi nɛ e ya nuu nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ e ya woɔ mɛ tsu mi.
Sane Kpakpa a fiɛmi ngɛ Samaria Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ gbɛ fia a ya kpa si, nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a. Nɛ Filipo ya Samaria ma ko nɔ, nɛ e ya fiɛ Kristo he sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Nɛ nihi babauu kɛ juɛmi kake bu munyuhi nɛ Filipo ngɛ tue ɔ tue, benɛ a nu nɛ a na okadihi nɛ e pee ɔ. Ejakaa nihi fuu nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi ɔ mumi ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ a je a mi, nɛ a tsa nihi nɛ hule kɛ akpaketsɛmɛ fuu hulɔ.
Nɛ bua jɔmi babauu ba jamɛ a ma a mi.
Se nyumu ko ngɛ ma a mi momo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon nɛ tsuɔ kunya nɛ e haa Samariabi ɔmɛ a nya kpɛɛ a he; e tsɔɔ e he kaa nɔmlɔ ngua je lɛ.
Nimli wawi kɛ nimli nguahi kulaa buɔ lɛ tue nɛ a deɔ ke: “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji Mawu he wami nɛ a tsɛɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ akɛnɛ e je kɛ kɛ e kunya tsumi ɔ ha a nya kpɛ a he he je ɔ, a buɔ lɛ tue.
Se benɛ a he Filipo nɛ fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ he sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ ye ɔ, wa baptisi nyumuhi kɛ yihi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon nitse hu he ye, nɛ a baptisi lɛ, nɛ e kɛ Filipo bɔni nyɛɛmi, nɛ benɛ e na okadihi kɛ he wami ni tsumi nguahi nɛ a pee ɔ, e nya kpɛ e he.
Se benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ na kaa Samariabi ɔmɛ pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ ya a ngɔ.
Benɛ a ba lejɛ ɔ, a ba sɔle ha mɛ, benɛ pee nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ejakaa Mumi ɔ bɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ lolo, se baptisimi kɛkɛ a baptisi mɛ wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ a ninehi pue a nɔ, nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Benɛ Simon na kaa bɔfo ɔmɛ a ninehi kɛ nihi a nɔ puemi ɔ haa a naa Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, e kɛ sika ba ba ha mɛ nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ ha imi hu kikɛmɛ a he wami nɛ ɔ eko, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ i kɛ ye ninehi ma pue e nɔ ɔ, e na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.” Se Petro de lɛ ke: “O kɛ o sika a tsuo hɛ mi nɛ kpata, ejakaa o susuu kaa Mawu nɔke nɔ ɔ sika a kɛ heɔ!
O be blɔ nya loo blɔ fami nɔ́ ko ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ mi; ejakaa o tsui dɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ ɔ pia o he ngɛ o nɔ yayami ɔ he, nɛ o kpa Mawu pɛɛ kaa alinɔ a maa ngɔ o tsui mi susumi ɔ ngɔ pa mo lo.
Ejakaa i na kaa duɔ doomi kɛ nɔ́ yayami kpã a mi o ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ Simon he nɔ ke: “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpa Nyɔmtsɛ pɛɛ ha mi, konɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ de nɛ ɔmɛ eko nɛ ko ba ye nɔ.” Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ a ye odase nɛ a tu Nyɔmtsɛ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ma Yerusalem ɔ, a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ Samariabi ɔmɛ a kɔpehi fuu a mi.
Filipo kɛ Etiopia manye sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba de Filipo ke: “Tee si nɛ o ya leneyi (wo si je) ngɛ blɔ nɛ je Yerusalem kɛ yaa Gaza nɛ pee ma doku ɔ nɔ.” Nɛ e te si nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Nɛ oʼɛ, nyumu Etiopia no ko nɛ ji Etiopiabihi a manye Kandake ɔ sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a ta lɛ nɛ a buu nɛ hyɛɛ e juetli tsuo nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E be kɛ ya Yerusalem ya ja Mawu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ e kpale e se ngɛ e zugba lɛ mi kɛ yaa, nɛ e ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaia womi ɔ kanee.
Nɛ Mumi ɔ de Filipo ke: “Yaa e ngɔ nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya hi si.” Benɛ Filipo sa fo kɛ yaa a, e nu kaa e ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaia womi ɔ kanee, nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Anɛ o ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ kanee ɔ sisi nue piɔ?” Nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma nyɛ hu, kaa ja nɔ ko tsɔɔ mi?” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa Filipo pɛɛ ke e ba nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba hi si.
Se ngmami ɔ he nɛ e ngɛ kanee ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A kpaka lɛ kɛ ho kaa jijɔ nɛ a yaa gbe lɛ, Nɛ bɔ nɛ jijɔ bi peɔ kpoo ngɛ e he bwɔmi salɔ hɛ mi ɔ, Ja nɔuu e kpɛ we e kuɔ si.
E he si bami ɔ mi ɔ, a je e kojomi ɔ kɛ ho; Se e nina a, mɛnɔ maa sɛɛ he ni?
Ejakaa a ngɔ e wami ɔ kɛ je zugba a nɔ.” Nɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a de Filipo ke: “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛnɔ he munyu gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ tue ɔ?
Lɛ nitsɛ e he loo nɔ kpa?” Filipo pa e nya mi nɛ e bɔni kɛ je kikɛmɛ a ngmami nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e jaje Yesu he sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ lɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ba su nyu ko he, nɛ maa je sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a nyɛ a, e ke: “Oʼɛ nyu; mɛni tsiɔ ye baptisimi nya?” [ Se Filipo ke: “Ke o heɔ yeɔ kɛ o tsui kulaa a, lɛɛ blɔ ngɛ he.” Nɛ e he nɔ ke: “I heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu Kristo ji Mawu bi ɔ nɛ.”] Nɛ e fa ke zugba lɛ ɔ nɛ da si, nɛ Filipo kɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a tsuo kple si kɛ ho nyu ɔ mi ya, nɛ e baptisi lɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a je nyu ɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ sa Filipo kɛ je; nɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a nɛ́ lɛ hu, se e pue nɔ kɛ ho kɛ nyami.
Se Filipo ɔ lɛɛ a na lɛ ngɛ Azoto; nɛ benɛ e ngɛ mi poe ɔ, e jaje sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ ma amɛ kulaa a mi kɛ ya si e ba su Kaisarea.
Saulo tsuitsakemi Saulo ngɛ nɔ ngɛ he gbeye womi kɛ nɔ gbemi mumi mue kɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaseli ɔmɛ a nɔ puee kɛ mwɔɔ.
E ya osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ, nɛ e ya bi lɛ womihi nɛ e kɛ ya Damasko kpe he ɔmɛ, benɛ pee nɛ ke e na ni kome nɛ hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyumuhi jio, yihi jio, nɛ e fi mɛ nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Se bnɛ e nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa nɛ e su Damasko ta a, si kake too ɔ, la kpɛ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba bɔle lɛ, nɛ e tsɔ fia si, nɛ e nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ lɛ dee ke: “Saulo, Saulo, mɛ he je o ngɛ mi yi mi wae?” Nɛ e ke: “Mo mɛnɔ, Mawetsɛ?” Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: “Imi ji Yesu, nɔ nɛ o ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ nɛ.
Tee si nɛ o ya ma a mi nɛ a maa tsɔɔ mɔ nɔ nɛ sa kaa o pee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumuhi nɛ kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ ɔmɛ a nya ma kɛ daa si, a ngɛ gbi ɔ nue mohu se a nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Saulo te si; se benɛ e bli e hɛngmɛ ɔ, e hyɛ we nɔ; nɛ a pɛtɛ e nine nya nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya Damasko.
E hyɛ we nɔ, jeha nɛ ɔ hu e yi ni nɛ e nui nɔ ko hulɔ ligbi etɛ sɔuu.
Se kaselɔ ko ngɛ Damasko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania; nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ngɛ ninami mi ke: “Anania!” Nɛ e ke: “Ne mi, Nyɔmtsɛ.” Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: “Tee si nɛ o ya gbɛjegbɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ Tlɔmɔɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ o ya bi nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Saulo nɛ je Tarso ɔ si ngɛ Yuda we ɔ mi; oʼɛ, e ngɛ sɔlee.” Nɛ Saulo na ngɛ ninami mi kaa nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania a ma e ngɔ, nɛ e kɛ eninehi ngɛ e nɔ fɔe, benɛ pee nɛ e hyɛ nɔ ekohu.
Se Anania he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, i nu kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ he sane ngɛ nihi fuu a nya kaa e pee o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ni yayami babauu.
Nɛ hiɛ ɔ hu tete, e na he blɔ kɛ je osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ kaa e ba fi nihi tsuo nɛ tɛliɔ ngɛ o biɛ ɔ mi ɔ.” Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: “Yaa, ejakaa nɔ nɛ ɔ ji ye dɛ mi dade nɛ a hla ha mi, konɛ e hɛɛ ye biɛ ɔ kɛ ya majemajeli kɛ matsɛmɛ kɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi.
Ejakaa ma tsɔɔ lɛ dengmehi abɔ nɛ e maa na ngɛ ye biɛ ɔhe.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Anania pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ e ninehi pue e nɔ nɛ e ke: “Maminyumu Saulo, Mawetsɛ Yesu, nɔ nɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ mo benɛ o ma ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ tsɔ mi o ngɔ, benɛ pee nɛ o hyɛ nɔ ekohu nɛ o hyi fuu kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ ni komɛ je e hɛngmɛ nɔ pue si kaa lo toto nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ amlɔ, nɛ e te si nɛ a baptisi lɛ; nɛ e ye ni, nɛ e he wa lɛ.
Nɛ e kɛ kaseli nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ hi si be bɔɔ ko.
Saulo fiɛ ngɛ Damasko Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu, e fiɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji Mawu bi ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ nihi kulaa nɛ nu ɔ nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a ke: “Anɛ pi nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ kpataa nihi nɛ tɛliɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Nɛ hiɛ ɔ hu tete, lɔ ɔ nɔuu he e ba ngɛ, konɛ e ba fi mɛ nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ ya osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ?” Se Saulo na hewami babauu, nɛ e ha Yudafohi nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔmɛ a nya mi munyu ta, ejakaa e tsɔɔ mɛ pãa kaa nɔ nɛ ɔ ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.
Be saii se ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ ya sae yi nɔ ke a maa gbe lɛ.
Se Saulo ba nu a somi ɔ he.
Nɛ a buu ma a agbo ɔmɛ a nya daa nyɔ kɛ pia benɛ pee nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Se kaseli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ wo kusii mi nyɔ mi, nɛ a siu lɛ kɛ gu gli ɔ nɔ kɛ ya ma si.
Saulo ngɛ Yerusalem Benɛ Saulo ba Yerusalem ɔ, e ka e he kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a he bɔmi, se mɛ tsuo a ngɛ lɛ gbeye yee, a he we yi kaa kaselɔ ji lɛ.
Se Barnaba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha mɛ bɔ nɛ Paulo na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu, kɛ bɔ nɛ e pee kã ngɛ Yesu biɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Damasko.
Nɛ e kɛ mɛ yaa baa ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ e pee kã ngɛ Yesu biɛ ɔ mi.
Nɛ e kɛ Helenebi ɔmɛ tu munyu nɛ e kɛ mɛ hla nihi a nya; se mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe.
Benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a ya sɛ lɛ Kaisarea, nɛ a ha e ho Tarso ya.
Jeha nɛ ɔ asafo ɔ na he jɔmi ngɛ Yudea kɛ Galilea kɛ Samaria tsuo, nɛ a nane nu si, nɛ a nyɛɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye yemi mi, nɛ a he sange mɛ ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ bua womi mi.
Petro ngɛ Lida kɛ Yopa E ba mi kaa benɛ Petro ya kpa he ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, e ba ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ Lida a hu a ngɔ.
Nɛ e ba na nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ainea nɛ e fɔɔ si ngɛ sa nɔ kɛ kuɔmi hiɔ jeha kpaanyɔ sɔuu.
Nɛ Petro de lɛ ke: “Ainea, Yesu Kristo ngɛ mo tsae; tee si nɛ mo nitsɛ o dla o sa a!” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ, e te si.
Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Lida kɛ Saron ɔ na lɛ, nɛ a tsake kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Se yo kaselɔ ko ngɛ Yopa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tabita, e sisi ji Dorka (odabɔ).
Lɛɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi kɛ ohiafohi a hyemi.
Se e ba mi kaa jamɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e ba nu hiɔ nɛ e gbo.
A du ha lɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ hiɔwe tsu ko mi.
Se akɛnɛ Lida kɛ Yopa kɛ we, nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nu kaa Patro ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a tsɔ nyumuhi enyɔ kɛ ya e ngɔ ya kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e ko hlua si, se e ba a ngɔ oya.
Petro te si nɛ e kɛ mɛ ho.
Nɛ benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ya hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi, nɛ yaloyi ɔmɛ tsuo ba daa si ngɛ e kasa nya ngɛ ya foe, nɛ a kɛ gugue tadehi kɛ tadehi nɛ Dorka pee benɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ ngɛ lɛ tsɔɔe.
Nɛ Petro fie mɛ kulaa kɛ je kpo, nɛ e kpla si nɛ e sɔle, nɛ e plɛ e he kɛ ya nɔ gbogboe ɔ ngɔ nɛ e ke: “Tabita, tee si!” Nɛ e bli e hɛngmɛ, nɛ benɛ e na Petro ɔ, e te si hi si.
Nɛ Petro nu e nine si, nɛ e wo e nɔ; nɛ e tsɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba da a hɛ mi hɛkalɔ.
Nɛ a nu he ngɛ Yopa tsuo, nɛ nihi fuu he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ ye.
Nɛ Petro hi Yopa be saii ngɛ Simon, lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ ngɔ.
Petro kɛ Kornelio Nyumu ko ngɛ Kaisarea nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kornelio nɛ ji Italia aslaafo ɔmɛ a nɔ Sasafoatsɛ.
Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo yee Mawu gbeye, nɛ e peɔ ma mi bi ɔmɛ kpakpahi fuu, nɛ e kpaa Mawu pɛɛ daa.
Ligbi ko gbɔkuɛ maa pee ngmlɛ etɛ mi ɔ, e na ngɛ ninami mi paa kaa Mawu bɔfo ko ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke: “Kornelio!” Nɛ e hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ e ye gbeye nɛ e ke: “Mo mɛnɔ ʼi, Nyɔmtsɛ?” Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke: “O sɔlemihi kɛ ni kpakpahi nɛ o peɔ ɔ ba su hiɔwe nɛ, e pee kaimi nɔ́ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba.
E ya to Simon lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ nɛ we ngɛ wo ɔ nya a ngɔ.” Benɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu ɔ je ɔ, e tsɛ e webi ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ kɛ aslaafono ko nɛ yee Mawu gbeye nɛ ji nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ e sɛɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ e tsɔ mɛ Yopa.
Enɔ je na a, benɛ a nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa su ma a mi ɔ, Petro ho sɔlemi ya ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi, maa pee ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi.
Hwɔ ye lɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ ko hlae nɛ e ye.
Se benɛ a ngɛ niyeni ɔ pee ɔ, e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ́ nɔ e nɔ, nɛ e na kaa hiɔwe nya bli, nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ si kplee kaa bo ngua nɛ a hɛɛ e kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔ mi nɛ a ngɛ siue kɛ ma zugba.
Zugba nɔ lohwe nane eywiɛeywiɛtsɛmɛ kɛ waami lohwehi, kɛ hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsmɛ slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo eko ngɛ mi.
Nɛ gbi ko de lɛ ke: “Petro, tee si, gbee nɛ o ye!” Se Petro ke: “Dɛbi, Nyɔmtsɛ, ejakaa i yi yakayaka nɔ́ ko loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hyɛ.” Nɛ gbi ɔ kpale de lɛ nɔ nɛ ji si enyɔ ke: “Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsukɔ he ɔ, koo bu lɛ kaa yakayaka nɔ́ ko.” A pee ja si etɛ, nɛ a wo nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ekohu.
Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Petro dɛ yaa kaa kɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ e na nɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ ɔ, oʼɛ, nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ Kornelio tsɔ ɔ ngɛ Simon we ɔ si bie, nɛ a ba da agbo ɔ nya.
A tsɛ nɛ a bi ke: “Anɛ hiɛ ɔ Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ ba to ɔ lo?” Se benɛ Petro ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e na a he susue ɔ, Mumi ɔ de lɛ ke: “Oʼɛ nyumuhi etɛ komɛ ngɛ mo hlae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ tee si nɛ o kple si nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ ho, nɛ koo je nɔ, ejakaa imi lɛ i tsɔ mɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro kple si, nɛ e ya de nyumu ɔmɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ nɛ; mɛni sane he nyɛ ba ngɛ?” Nɛ a ke: “Asafoatsɛ Kornelio, nɛ ji nyumu dalɔ kɛ Mawu gbeye yelɔ nɛ Yudafohi a ma mluku ɔ kulaa tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa a, lɛ hiɔwe bɔfo klɔuklɔu ko de lɛ ke e tsɔ nɛ a ba kpee mo kɛ ba e we ɔ mi, konɛ e bu o nya munyu tue.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba we ɔ mi nɛ e ba pee mɛ nibwɔ.
Nɛ e nɔ je na a, Petro kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yopa a a ti ni komɛ piɛ e he.
E nɔ je na ekohu ɔ, a ya su Kaisarea.
Kornelio ngɛ mɛ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ e tsɛ e wekuli kɛ e huɛmɛ kpakpahi kɛ ba kpe.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ Petro ngɛ we ɔ mi sɛe ɔ, Kornelio kɛ lɛ ba kpe, nɛ e ba bu si ngɛ e nane nya nɛ e ja lɛ.
Se Petro wo e nɔ, nɛ e ke: “Tee si, se imi hu nɔmlɔ ji mi.” Nɛ e kɛ lɛ ngɛ ni sɛɛe kɛ ya sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ eya na nihi babauu nɛ ba bua a he nya a. Nɛ Petro de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le bɔ nɛ Yuda no be he blɔ kaa e kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ji ma kpã mi no bɔɔ aloo e baa e ngɔ.
Se imi lɛɛ, Mawu tsɔɔ mi ke ma ko tsɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yaka nɔmlɔ, loo nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we.
Lɔ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ benɛ a tsɔ ba kpee mi ɔ, i je we nya nɛ i ba nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ i ngɛ nyɛ bie ke: Mɛni sane he je nɛ nyɛ tsɔ kɛ ba kpee mi ɔ?” Kornelio ha heto ke: “Mwɔnɔ ji ligbi eywiɛ ɔ, i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ ye we ɔ mi maa pee gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ mi; nɛ oʼɛ, nyumu ko nɛ wo tade klaiklai ba da ye hɛ mi, nɛ e ke: ‘Kornelio, a bu o sɔlemi ɔ tue, nɛ o ni kpakpahi nɛ o peɔ ɔ hu a kai ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa, nɛ a ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba.
E ya to Simon lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ nɛ we ngɛ wo ɔ nya a ngɔ.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ i tsɔ o ngɔ, nɛ o pee saminya kaa o ba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ ɔ wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, konɛ waa bu nihi tsuo kulaa nɛ Mawu de mo ngɔ to ɔ tue.” Petro munyu nɛ e tu Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro pa e nya mi nɛ e ke: “Niinɛ, i kpa si kaa Mawu pi nimli a hɛ mi hyɛlɔ; se mohu ma tsuaa ma mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ yee lɛ gbeye nɛ e tsuɔ dami nihi ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ saa e hɛ mi.
Mawu tsɔ nɛ a kɛ munyu ɔ ya ha Israelbi, nɛ a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ jaje he jɔmi sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, lɛ ji nihi tsuo a Nyɔmtsɛ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le sane ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Yudea tsuo, nɛ e je sisi kɛ je Galilea, ngɛ baptisimi nɛ Yohane fiɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ he wami ngɔ pɔ Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ nu, nɛ e kpaa si peɔ kpakpa, nɛ e tsaa nihi kulaa nɛ abosiami haoɔ mɛ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu kɛ lɛ ngɛ.
Nɛ wɔ ji nihi tsuo kulaa nɛ e pee ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ Yerusalem ɔ he odase yeli; nɔ nɛ a sɛu ngɛ tso nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ ɔ. Lɛ nɔuu Mawu tle si ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ paa, tsa pi ma mluku ɔ tsuo, se mohu odase yeli nɛ Mawu hla ngɔ to momo ɔ, nɛ ji wɔ nihi nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ye ni nɛ waa kɛ lɛ nu, benɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ se ɔ. Nɛ e wo wɔ kita ke waa fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a nɛ waa ye odase kaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ Mawu je ngɔ to nɛ e kojo hɛ kali kɛ ni gbogboehi ɔ nɛ.
Lɛ e he odase gbali ɔmɛ kulaa yeɔ, kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ ma na e he yayami pami ngɛ e biɛ ɔ he.” Majemajeli ɔmɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ Benɛ Petro ngɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue nɔuu ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba nihi tsuo nɛ nu munyu ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ Yudafohi nɛ he ye nɛ a kɛ Petro ba a nya kpɛ a he kaa a nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɔke nɔ ɔ ngɔ pue majemajeli ɔmɛ hu a nɔ.
Ejakaa a nu kaa a ngɛ ma se munyuhi slɔɔtohi tue, nɛ a ngɛ Mawu yi jee.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro he nɔ ke: “Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ nyu nya maa tsi, nɛ a ko baptisi ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ka wɔ kɛ̃ ɔ lo?” Nɛ e fa ke a baptisi mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ ko.
Petro amaniɛ nɛ e bɔ Yerusalem asafo ɔ Bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a tsuo nu kaa majeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ hu pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ he.
Nɛ benɛ Petro ba Yerusalem ɔ, nihi nɛ je ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ kɛ lɛ na, a ke: “O ya mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ a ngɔ nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya ye ni.” Se Petro je sisi nɛ e bɔ mɛ amaniɛ ɔ tsuo ke: “I ngɛ Yopa ma a mi i ngɛ sɔlee, nɛ e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɔ ye nɔ, nɛ i na ninami ko kaa nɔ́ ko je hiɔwe kaa bo ngua ko nɛ a hɛɛ e kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɛ siue kɛ ma zugba, nɛ e ba ye ngɔ tataata.
Se benɛ i hyɛ mi too ɔ, i na zugba lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ kɛ nga mi lohwehi kɛ waami nihi kɛ hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ngɛ mi.
Nɛ i nu gbi ko hu nɛ de mi ke: ‘Petro, tee si, gbee nɛ o ye!’ Se i de ke: ‘Dɛbi, Nyɔmtsɛ, ejakaa i yi yakayaka nɔ́ ko loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hyɛ.’ Se gbi nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ he nɔ nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ ke: ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsukɔ he ɔ, mo ko bu lɛ yakayaka nɔ́ ko.’ A pee jã si etɛ, nɛ a sa kulaa kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ekohu, Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ nyumuhi etɛ ba da we he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ agbo ɔ nya; a tsɔ mɛ kɛ je Kaisarea kɛ ba ye ngɔ.
Nɛ mumi ɔ de mi ke i kɛ mɛ nɛ ya nɛ ma ko to tslee.
Nyɛmimɛ ekpa nɛ ɔmɛ hu kɛ mi ya; nɛ wa ya sɛ nyumu ɔ we ɔ mi.
Nɛ e sɛɛ wɔ bɔ nɛ e na bɔfo ɔ ngɛ e we ɔ mi nɛ e daa si nɛ e de lɛ ke: ‘Tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba, lɛ e ma de mo munyuhi nɛ a maa gu nɔ kɛ he mo kɛ o we ɔ kulaa yi wami.’ Se benɛ i bɔni munyu ɔ tumi ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba ma a nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e ba ma wɔ hu wa nɔ kekle ɔ. Nɛ i kai Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ e tu ke: ‘Yohane ɔ, e kɛ nyu baptisi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ a maa baptisi nyɛ kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu’ ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ ke Mawu ha mɛ jamɛ a nɔke nɔ́ ɔ nɔuu nɛ e ha wɔ nɛ wa heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɔ yeɔ hulɔ ɔ, imi lɛɛ, mɛnɔ ji mi nɛ ma nyɛ Mawu nya ma tsi?” Se benɛ a nu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ma a nya, nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami de ke: ‘Lɛɛ majeli ɔmɛ hu Mawu ha mɛ tsui tsakemi nɛ a kɛ he a yi wami!’ Antiokia asafo ɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ nihi nɛ gbɛ fia ngɛ Stefano amanenlu ɔ mi ɔ po mi kɛ ya Foinike kɛ Kipro kɛ Antiokia lokoo, se a fiɛ we munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ we nɔ ko nɔ ko kaa ja Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛkɛ.
Se a ti ni komɛ ɔ, Kiprobihi kɛ Kireenebihi ji mɛ, nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba Antiokia ba tu munyu tsɔɔ Helabi ɔmɛ hulɔ, nɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu he sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ a he, nɛ nihi babauu he ye, nɛ a tsake kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Nɛ a he sane nɛ ɔ ba su Yerusalem asafo ɔ tue mi, nɛ a tsɔ Barnaba Antiokia.
Nɛ benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ba na Mawu dloomi ɔ, e bua jɔ e he, nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ tsuo ke a kɛ tsui nɛ fi si nɛ pɛtɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ nɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ hemi kɛ yemi.
Nɛ a ngɔ nihi babauu kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Nɛ Barnaba pue nɔ kɛ ho Tarso ya ya hla Saulo, nɛ benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ ba Antiokia ekohu.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa a kɛ asafo ɔ hi si jeha mluku, nɛ a tsɔɔ nihi babauu ni, nɛ Antiokia ji he nɛ a wo kaseli ɔmɛ biɛ kekleekle ngɛ ke Kristofohi.
Se kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, gbali komɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ba Antiokia.
Nɛ a kpɛti nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Agabo ɔ te si, nɛ e tsɔɔ ngɛ Mumi ɔ nya kaa hwɔ kpetekpleenyɛ maa ba je mi tsuo kulaa, nɛ e ba mi ja ngɛ Kaisare Klaudio yi nɔ.
Kaseli ɔmɛ kpɛ mi kaa a ma tsu nɔ́ ko ngɔ mane nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a nɛ a kɛ ya pɛne mɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ.
Nɛ a pee ja, nɛ a ngɔ mane nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ gu Barnaba kɛ Saulo nɔ.
A wa asafo ɔ yi mi babauu Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, matsɛ Herode wo e nine nɔ, konɛ e pee asafo ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ yayami.
E kɛ klaate gbe Yohane nyɛmi Yakobo.
Nɛ benɛ e na kaa e ngɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nya a, e ya nɔ nɛ e nu Petro hulɔ.
Se akpiti ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ʼi.
Nɛ benɛ e nu lɛ ɔ, e wo lɛ tsu mi, nɛ e tu lɛ ngɔ wo aslaafohi eywiɛeywiɛ kuhi eywiɛ dɛ mi nɛ a bu e he.
E susu kaa Hetsɔmi ɔ se ɔ e kɛ lɛ maa ba ma a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a tsi Petro nya ngɛ tsu ɔ mi mohu, se asafo ɔ hɛɛ sɔlemi mi kɛ ha lɛ wawɛɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
A je Petro ngɛ tsu mi Se benɛ Herode ke e kɛ lɛ maa ba ma a hɛ mi ɔ, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Petro hwɔɔ si ngɛ aslaafohi enyɔ a kpɛti, nɛ a wo lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔhi enyɔ, nɛ buli hu daa si ngɛ sinya a nya ngɛ tsu ɔ he bue.
Nɛ oʼɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba da e kasa nya, nɛ la kpɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi.
Bɔfo ɔ gba Petro kasa ma nɛ e tsɛ̃ɛ lɛ ke: “Tee si esɔesɔ!” Nɛ e kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ e nine.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke: “Mia nɛ o fi o tokota amɛ!” Nɛ Petro pee ja.
Nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Haa o bo ɔ nɛ o nyɛɛ ye se!” Nɛ Petro nyɛɛ e se kɛ je kpo, se e li kaa nɔ́ nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɛ pee ɔ ngɛ mi, se e pee lɛ kaa e ngɛ ni nae.
Se benɛ a be kekle buli ɔmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ji enyɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a su dade agbo nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa ma a mi ɔ he nɛ lɛ nitse e bli ha mɛ, nɛ a je kpo kɛ po gbɛjegbɛ kake mi, kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ si lɛ.
Benɛ Petro hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ ɔ, e ke: “Kpaako i na le tutuutu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔ e bɔfo kɛ ba nɛ e ba je mi ngɛ Herode dɛ mi kɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a ma a ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ kulaa mi.” Nɛ benɛ e yo enɛ ɔ ɔ, e ba Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ nyɛ Maria we ɔ mi, he nɛ nihi fuu ba bua a he nya ngɛ nɛ a ngɛ sɔlee ɔ.
Se benɛ Petro si agbo ɔ, yiheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rode ɔ ba tue bumi.
Benɛ e yo Petro gbi ɔ, bua jɔmi sɔuu nya a, e bli we agbo ɔ, se mohu e tu fo kɛ ho ya de ke Petro daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ se.
Se a de lɛ ke: “O nu godo.” Se e ma nɔ mi ke e ngɛ mi ja.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ke: “Lɛɛ e dbɔfo ʼi.” Se Petro ngɛ nɔ ngɛ sie, nɛ benɛ a bli ɔ, a na lɛ, nɛ a nya kpɛ a he.
Se e wo mɛ nine ke a pee kɔ, nɛ e bɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je lɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ; nɛ e ke: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya sɛɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Yakobo kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.” Nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho he kpa ya.
Benɛ je na a, pi haomi bi nɛ ba aslaafo ɔmɛ a kpɛti akɛnɛ a li nɔ́ nɛ ba Petro nɔ ɔ.
Se benɛ Herode hla lɛ nɛ e nɛ́ lɛ ɔ, e kojo buli ɔmɛ nɛ e fa ke a gbe mɛ.
Nɛ Herode si Yudea kɛ ho Kaisarea ya nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Herode gbenɔ Jeha nɛ ɔ Herode muklii mi fu Tirobi ɔmɛ kɛ Zidonbi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ; nɛ a kɛ juɛmi kake ba e ngɔ.
A ba hla matsɛ ɔ sɔmɔlɔ Blasto ɔ he blɔ nɛ a ba kpa pɛɛ, ejakaa matsɛ ɔ zugba nɔ ni a yeɔ.
Se ligbi nɛ a to ko nɔ ɔ, Herode wo e matsɛ tade ɔ, nɛ e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu.
Nɛ ni ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke: “Mawu gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, se tsa pi nɔmlɔ gbi ʼi.” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo fia lɛ nɔ, ejakaa e kɛ nyami ɔ ha we Mawu, nɛ e wo gɔgɔ, nɛ e gbo.
Se Mawu munyu ɔ keke nɛ e gbɛ fia.
Benɛ Barnaba kɛ Saulo gbe a sɔmɔmi ɔ nya a, a kpale a se kɛ je Yerusalem, nɛ a ngɔ Yohane, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.
A hla Saulo kɛ Barnaba nɛ a tsɔ mɛ Gbali kɛ tsɔɔli komɛ ngɛ Antiokia asafo ɔ mi, mɛ ji Barnaba kɛ Simeon, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Niger ɔ, kɛ Lukio Kireene no ɔ, kɛ Manahen, nɔ nɛ a lɛ lɛ kɛ amlalo Herode ɔ, kɛ Saulo.
Benɛ a ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ jae nɛ a ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ke: “Nyɛ je Barnaba kɛ Saulo ngɔ ha mi kɛ ha ni tsumi nɛ i tsɛ mɛ ngɛ he ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ha hwɔ nɛ a sɔle, nɛ a kɛ a ninehi pue a nɔ nɛ a wo mɛ blɔ.
Saulo kɛ Barnaba ngɛ Kipro Jeha nɛ ɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsɔ mɛ ke a ya he je ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho Seleukia ya, nɛ a sɛ lɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a hia kɛ ho Kipro ya.
Benɛ a su Salami ɔ, a fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ.
Nɛ a kɛ Yohane hu nyɛɛ kaa a sɔmɔlɔ.
Nɛ benɛ a po mi ngɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ nyu bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ba su Pafo ɔ, a na Yuda no kunya yelɔ kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Bar-yesu ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ amlaalo Sergio Paulo ngɔ lɛ be ɔ mi ɔ. Sergio Paulo ji nyumu hɛ si kalɔ ko; lɛ nɛ e tsɛ Barnaba kɛ Saulo kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ngɛ hlae nɛ e bu Mawu munyu ɔ tue.
Se Elima, kunya yelɔ ɔ (ja ji e biɛ ɔ sisi ngɛ Hela gbi mi) ka nɛ e tsi a nya, nɛ e ngɛ hlae nɛ e kpale amlaalo ɔ kɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
Nɛ Saulo, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Paulo hulɔ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ e ke: “Oo, abosiami bi nɛ sisimi kɛ kutupɔ tsuo hyi mo tɔtɔɔtɔ, mo dami kulaa henyɛlɔ; anɛ o be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ tlɔmɔɔ ɔmɛ a kpemi jɔɔe?
nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ oʼɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nine fɔɔ si ngɛ o nɔ, nɛ o hɛ ma yu, nɛ o be pu hyɛe kɛ yaa su be ko.” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ afua kɛ diblii wo lɛ, nɛ e lilaa si ngɛ nihi hlae nɛ a ta e dɛ mi nɛ a ya je lɛ blɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ amlaalo ɔ, benɛ e na nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ, e he ye, nɛ e he nya si lɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔɔmi ɔ he.
Paulo ba Antiokia nɛ ngɛ Pisidia a Benɛ Paulo kɛ e nimli ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Pafo ɔ, a ba Perge ngɛ Pamfilia; nɛ Yohane kpale ngɛ a se, snɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya ekohu.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a je Perge nɛ a po mi kɛ ba Antiokia ngɛ Pisidia.
A ya kpe he ɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ nɛ a ya hi si.
Nɛ benɛ a kane a Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ se ɔ, kpe he ɔ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ ba de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, ke nyɛ ngɛ munyu kɛ tsɔɔmi ko nɛ nyɛ maa tu ngɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ tu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo te si da si, nɛ e fɔ e nine nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Israel nyumuhi kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yee Mawu gbeye, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Kikɛmɛ a Israel ma nɛ ɔ Mawu lɛ hla wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ benɛ a ya to nibwɔ ngɛ Mizraim zugba a nɔ ɔ, e wo ma a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e nine nɛ e wo nɔ ɔ je mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. E hɛɛ mɛ nɛ e lɛ mɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ maa pee jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ e kpata majemaje ma kpaago hɛ mi ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ ye dla a zugba a mi ngɔ ha mɛ, konɛ e plɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ lɔ ɔ se maa pee jeha lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ɔ, e ha mɛ kojoli kɛ ba su gbalɔ Samuel nɔ.
Nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ a bi matsɛ, nɛ Mawu ngɔ Kish bi Saul, nyumu ko nɛ je Benyamin wetso ɔ mi ɔ ha mɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Nɛ benɛ e kpa lɛ ɔ, e wo David nɔ, nɛ e wo lɛ a nɔ matsɛ, nɔ nɛ he odase nɛ e ye ke: ‘I na David, Ishai bi ɔ, nyumu nɛ i ngɛ e he tsui, nɔ nɛ maa pee ye suɔmi nya ni ɔmɛ kulaa.’ Nɔ nɛ ɔ nina mi Mawu je Yesu kɛ je, dngɛ si womi ɔ nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ pee Israel yi wami helɔ.
Yohane sɛ hlami ba fiɛ baptisimi nɛ a kɛ naa tsui tsakemi ngɔ tsɔɔ Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo kulaa.
Nɛ loko Yohane maa gbe e nitsumi ɔ nya a, e ke: ‘Mɛnɔ nyɛ susuu kaa i ji?
Tsa pi imi ji nɔ nɛ blɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ.
Se oʼɛ, nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se, nɛ i sɛ́ nɔ nɛ pɛneɔ e tokota ngɛ e nane.’ “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, Abraham nina kɛ nyɛ kpɛti nihi nɛ yee Mawu gbeye, nyɛ a kɛ kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi muyu nɛ ɔ ba ha.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ kɛ a ma a mi nikɔtɔma amɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ a li Yesu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu anui gbali ɔmɛ a munyu nɛ a kaneɔ daa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ nɛ lɔ ɔ ha gbali ɔmɛ a gbami ɔmɛ ba mi.
Nɛ pohu a nɛ́ gbenɔ sane ko ngɛ e he mohu, se kɛ ɔ a kpa Pilato pɛɛ ke e gbe lɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a ha nihi kulaa nɛ a ngma ngɛ e he ɔ ba mi ɔ, a je lɛ ngɛ tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya to lɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ ko mi.
Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje; nɛ e je e he kpo ligbihi fuu kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ je Galilea kɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ, nihi nɛ ji e odase yeli ha ma a. Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ, si nɛ e wo wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ he sane kpakpa a wa ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu ha e ba mi ha wɔ nɛ wa ji a bimɛ ɔ, kaa nɛ e tle Yesu si kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ La nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi hu ke: ‘Ye bi ji mo, mwɔnɛ i fɔ mo’ ɔ.
“Se akɛnɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e be e se kpalee kɛ ya puɛmi mi hu he je ɔ, e de kikɛ: ‘Ma ngɔ David dloomi nihi nɛ maa si kpɛii ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ.’ Lɔ ɔ he hu nɛ e de ngɛ he kpa ke: ‘O be hae nɛ o nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ na puɛmi’ ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa David ɔ, benɛ e tsu Mawu yi mi tomi nya ni ngɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, e gbo nɛ a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ piɛ e tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ e puɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si ɔ puɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɔ a guu kɛ jajeɔ yayamipami ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa nihi kulaa nɛ a be nyɛ nguɔ nyɛe maa wo ngɛ he ngɛ Mose Mlaa a nya a, nɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, a woɔ lɛ nguɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ bɔ nɛ gbali ɔmɛ de ɔ ko ba nyɛ nɔ ke: ‘Nyɛ he guɛ gbeli, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ pee nyɛ yaa, nɛ nyɛɛ laa; Ejakaa ma tsu ni tsumi ko ngɛ nyɛ yi nɔ, Ni tsumi ko nɛ ke nɔ ko sɛɛ ha nyɛ tete po ɔ, Nyɛ be hee maa ye kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ” Se benɛ Paulomɛ je Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ, majeli ɔmɛ kpa mɛ pɛɛ ke a ba jaje kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ekohu ngɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi nɛ ma a nɔ.
Se benɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ kpa a, Yudafohi kɛ nihi nɛ a tsake mɛ ngɔ pee Yudafohi nɛ a yee Mawu gbeye ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu nyɛɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba se, nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a wo mɛ ga ke a pɛtɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ he.
Nɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ nɔ ɔ, e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ ma mluku ɔ kulaa ba bua a he nya nɛ a ba bu Mawu munyu ɔ tue.
Se benɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ na asafo ɔmɛ ɔ, hunga jemi babauu te si ngɛ a mi, nɛ a kɛ munyu tumi-kɛ-simi kɛ musu bɔmi munyu ku nihi nɛ Paulo ngɛ dee ɔ nya.
Nɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba tu munyu kɛ kã ke: “Nyɛ kekle e sa kaa a jajeɔ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ, se akɛnɛ nyɛ kua munyu ɔ nɛ nyɛ bui nyɛ he kaa nyɛ sa neneene wami ɔ he je ɔ, oʼɛ, wa dɔ wa yi kɛ yaa majeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Ejakaa jã Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo wɔ kita ke: ‘I ngɔ mo ngɔ to kaa majeli ɔmɛ a la, Konɛ o plɛ yi wami hemi kɛ ya su zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ.” Benɛ majeli ɔmɛ nu e nɛ ɔ ɔ, a na bua jɔmi, nɛ a wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ a je ngɔ to neneene wami ɔ he ye.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ gbɛ fia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi tsuo.
Se Yudafo ɔmɛ wo yihi Mawu gbeye yeli nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɛ ma a mi nihi nɛ hɛ mi ka si ɔmɛ a yi mi, nɛ a ha yi mi wami te si ngɔ wo Paulo kɛ Barnaba, nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a kpo ɔmɛ a mi.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a blɛ a nane he bunyuku ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Ikoniom ya.
Nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba ngɛ Ikoniom E ba mi kaa benɛ a ngɛ Ikoniom ɔ, Paulo kɛ Barnaba ya Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ nɛ a ya tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ saminya, nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ Helabi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he ye.
Se Yudafohi tue gboli ɔmɛ puɛ majeli ɔmɛ a tue, nɛ a ha a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ wo nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a se kɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ kã tu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he munyu, nɛ lɛ hu e ye e dloomi munyu ɔ he odase nɛ e ha a gu a nine nɔ pee okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi fuu.
Se ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a mi gba enyɔ: Fã piɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a he, nɛ fã hu piɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a he.
Se benɛ majeli ɔmɛ kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ bu kɛ ba nɛ a ba pee mɛ hãihãi nɛ a fia mɛ tɛ ɔ; a na le, nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho Likaonia mahi nɛ ji Listra kɛ Derbe kɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi ya, nɛ a ya fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba ngɛ Listra Nyumu ko ngɛ Listra nɛ e nyɛ we si nɛ e da, se si e hii nɛ e ji nɔ nɛ hule kɛ je e nyɛ muklii mi lokoo nɛ e nyɛɛ we gblee.
Nɛ benɛ Paulo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, e bu lɛ tue.
Nɛ benɛ Paulo hyɛ lɛ too nɛ e na kaa e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kaa a ma tsa lɛ ɔ, e kɛ gbi wawɛɛ de lɛ ke: “Tee si nɛ o da o nane nɔ tlɔmɔɔ!” Nɛ e hlu ma si nɛ e nyɛɛ.
Nɛ benɛ ni ɔmɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Paulo pee ɔ, a de ngɛ Likaonia gbi mi ke: “Mawu ɔmɛ plɛ a he kaa nimli kɛ kple si kɛ ba wa ngɔ.” Nɛ a tsɛ Barnaba ke Dio, kɛ Paulo hu ke Herme, ejakaa lɛ titli lɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ nɛ.
Se Dio osɔfo nɛ ngɛ a ma a agbo ɔ nya a hɛɛ nakuhi kɛ nyinyla kɛ ba agbo ɔ nya, konɛ lɛ kɛ asafo ɔ kɛ sa bɔ.
Se benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Barnaba kɛ Paulo nu he ɔ, a gba a tadehi nɛ a sa fo kɛ ya sɛ asafo ɔ kpɛti kɛ ngmlaa ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ, mɛni nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?
wɔ hu nimli adesahi ji wɔ kaa nyɛ nɔuu, nɛ wa ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe, konɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ je kikɛmɛ a yakayaka ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ ba Mawu hɛkalɔ ɔ ngɔ, nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba kɛ wo kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ; nɔ nɛ blemabi ɔmɛ a yinɔhi nɛ be ɔ mi ɔ, e ha majemajeɔ tsuo nyɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e jɔɔ we lɛ nitsɛ e he odase yemi, se mohu e peɔ kpakpa nɛ e haa hiɔmi jee hiɔwe nɛɛ haa nyɛ, kɛ jehahi nɛ baa ni fuu hulɔ, e kɛ ngma kɛ bua jɔmi woɔ nyɛ tsuihi a mi tɔ.” Nɛ a gbo dengme loko a kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsi bɔ nɛ jinɛ ni ɔmɛ maa sã ha mɛ ɔ nya.
Se Yudafohi komɛ je Antiokia kɛ Ikoniom ba lejɛ ɔ ba wo asafo ɔmɛ a yi mi; a fia Paulo tɛ, nɛ a sã lɛ si kɛ je ma a mi, a susu kaa e gbo.
Se benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, e te si nɛ e ho ma a mi ya.
Nɛ e nɔ je na a, e kɛ Barnaba pue nɔ kɛ ho Derbe ya.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba ba Antiokia ekohu Benɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ ma a, nɛ a ha nihi fuu tsake pee kaseli ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ho Listra kɛ Ikoniom kɛ Antiokia ya.
A kpale wo kaseli ɔmɛ a mumi mi wami ɔ he wami, nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ ke a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu e sa kaa wa guu dengme fuu mi kɛ sɛɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Nɛ a hia nikɔtɔmahi ngɔ to asafo tsuaa asafo nya, nɛ a kɛ sɔlemi kɛ hwɔ hami tu mɛ ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ nɔ nɛ a he ye ɔ dɛ mi.
Nɛ a po mi ngɛ Pisidia nɛ a ba Pamfilia.
Nɛ benɛ a fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ Perge ɔ, a ngɔ pue nɔ kɛ ba Atalia.
Nɛ a sɛ lɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a hia kɛ ba Antiokia, ngɛ he nɛ a tu mɛ ngɔ wo Mawu dloomi ɔ dɛ mi kɛ ha ni tsumi nɛ a tsu gbe nya a ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ a ba lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ba bua asafo ɔ nya a, a sɛɛ mɛ nihi nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ ya tsu ɔ kulaa, kɛ bɔ nɛ e bli blɔ ngɔ ha majeli ɔmɛ.
Nɛ a kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ hi si be saii.
A kpe ngɛ Yerusalem Ni komɛ je Yudea kɛ ba nɛ a ba tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke: “Ke a pui nyɛ ngɛ Mose Mlaa a nya a, a be nyɛ yiwami nyɛe ma he.” Nɛ benɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ mɛ sa nya nɛ a kɛ mɛ je nɔ hluu ɔ, a to kaa Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ a ti ni komɛ hu nɛ ya bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔmɛ a ngɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ benɛ asafo ɔ ba je mɛ blɔ ɔ, a gu Foinike kɛ Samaria nɛ a sɛɛ majeli ɔmɛ a tsakemi ɔ he sane ha mɛ, nɛ a kɛ ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo na bua jɔmi wawɛɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a su Yerusalem ɔ, asafo ɔ kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ he mɛ hɛmuɔ, nɛ a sɛɛ nihi kulaa nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ tsu ɔ ha mɛ.
Se ni komɛ nɛ je Farisifo ɔmɛ a ku ɔ mi nɛ he ye ɔ te si nɛ a de ke: “Ja a po mɛ nɛ a wo mɛ kita ke a ye Mose Mlaa a nɔ.” Nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba bua a he nya konɛ a hla kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ mi.
Se benɛ a sa nya hluu ɔ, Petro te si da si, nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa kɛ je lokoo nɛ Mawu hla mi kaa majeli ɔmɛ a nu sane kpakpa a kɛ je ye nya, nɛ a he ye.
Nɛ Mawu nɛ le tsui mi nihi ɔ ye mɛ odase nɛ e ha mɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ e hlɛ́ nimli a mi ngɛ waa kɛ mɛ kpɛti, nɛ e kɛ hemi kɛ yemi tsukɔ a tsuihi a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jeha nɛ ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ Mawu kae nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ pã tso nɛ waa kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kulaa nyɛ we tloomi fɔ́ɔ kaseli ɔmɛ a ko nɔ?
Se wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ mohu nɔ a maa gu kɛ he waa kɛ mɛ tsuo yiwami.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma a nya nɛ a bu Barnaba kɛ Paulo nɛ sɛɛ mɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi abɔ nɛ Mawu gu a nine nɔ kɛ pee ngɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ tue.
Benɛ a tu munyu ɔta a, Yakobo he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Simeon sɛɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu ba slaa majemajeli ɔmɛ kekle, nɛ e hla a kpɛti ma ko ngɔ ha e biɛ ɔ. Nɛ gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔmɛ hu kɛ enɛ ɔ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ nɛ a ngma ke: ‘Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, ma kpale ye se kɛ ba, Nɛ ma dla David bo tsu nɛ ku ɔ ma ma; Nɛ o tsu kokue ɔmɛ hu ma fia ekohu, Nɛ ma tle lɛ si ngɔ ma si; Benɛ pee nɛ nimli nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ kulaa hu Nɛ a kɛ ye biɛ wo mɛ ɔ A hla Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se blɔ.’ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha a le enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa kɛ je lokoo ɔ lɛ de.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji kaa a ko doo nihi nɛ kpale a se kɛ je majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ ɔ nya tsɔ.
Se mohu a ngma mɛ ke a nyɛ wɔ nihi kɛ a ajuama bɔmi kɛ lohwehi nɛ a kika mɛ kɛ gbe kɛ dmuɔ.
Ejakaa kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ Mose ngɛ nihi nɛ fiɛɔ lɛ ngɛ ma tsuaa ma nɔ, nɛ daa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ a kaneɔ e womi ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ.” Womi nɛ a ngma mane mejeli nɛ he ye ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ asafo mluku ɔ kulaa ma nya si kaa a hia nyumuhi komɛ kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a tsɔ mɛ kɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ ya Antiokia.
Mɛ ji Yuda, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barsaba hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Sila, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nikɔtɔma amɛ.
Nɛ a ngma womi ngɔ ha mɛ ke: “Bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ biɔ nyɛmimɛ nɛ je majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Antiokia kɛ Siria kɛ Kilikia a saminya.
Akɛnɛ wa nu kaa wa ti nikomɛ pue nɔ kɛ ba ba doo nyɛ nya kɛ munyuhi komɛ nɛ a kɛ puɛ nyɛ juɛmi de ke a po nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye Mose Mlaa a nɔ, pohu wa wui mɛ jamɛ a kita ko he je ɔ, e sa wa hɛ mi kaa, nɛ wa nya pee kake nɛ ɔ ɔ, waa hia nihi ngɔ piɛ Barnaba kɛ Paulo nɛ wa suɔ ɔ he nihi nɛ ji nimli nɛ ngɔ a wami ngɔ ha ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ ɔ he ɔ, konɛ waa tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa tsɛ Yuda kɛ Sila, konɛ mɛ hu a kɛ a nya mi munyu ba jaje kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Ejakaa e sa Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e sa wɔ hu wa hɛ mi kaa, waa kɛ tlomi ko nɛ ko fɔ nyɛ nɔ hu, kaa ja nihi nɛ he hia nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.
Kaa nyɛɛ nyɛ lo nɛ a gbe ha wɔhi kɛ muɔ kɛ lohwehi nɛ a kika a kuɛ kɛ ajuama bɔmi.
Ke nyɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ pee saminya.
Nyɛɛ hi si saminya!” Jeha nɛ ɔ, benɛ a wo bɔfo ɔmɛ blɔ ɔ, a ba Antiokia, nɛ a ba bua asafo ɔ nya nɛ a je womi ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a kane ɔ, a bua jɔ a he ngɛ a bua womi munyu ɔ he.
Se Yuda kɛ Sila a, akɛnɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu gbali ji mɛ he je ɔ, a kɛ munyuhi babauu jɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a bua nɛ a wo mɛ he wami.
Nɛ benɛ a se kɛ bɔɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo mɛ blɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi kɛ ho nihi nɛ tsɔ mɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya.
[ Se Sila lɛɛ, e suɔ kaa e maa hi lejɛ ɔ.]
Paulo kɛ Barnaba hi Antiokia nɛ a tsɔɔ ni nɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he sane kpakpa a, nɛ ni kpa komɛ fuu hu pee ja.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba gba a mi Be ko se ɔ Paulo de Barnaba ke: “Ha waa kpale wa se ya slaa wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ma tsuaa ma nɛ wa fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, nɛ waa hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ.” Barnaba hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa a maa ngɔ Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.
Se Paulo lɛɛ, e susu kaa e sɛ́ kaa a ngɔ nɔ nɛ kpale ngɛ a se ngɛ Pamfilia nɛ e kɛ mɛ yɛ́ ni tsumi ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, enɛ ɔ pee mɛ nya sami babauu nɛ e ha a gba a mi, nɛ Barnaba ngɔ Marko ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ a gu lɛ mi kɛ ho Kipro ya.
Se Paulo lɛɛ, e hia Sila ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tu lɛ ngɔ wo Mawu dloomi ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Nɛ e gu Siria kɛ Kilikia ya wo asafo ɔmɛ he wami.
Paulo kɛ Sila ngɔ Timoteo Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo ba Derbe kɛ Listra.
Nɛ oʼɛ, kaselɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Timoteo, Yudayo ko nɛ he ye ɔ bi, se e tsɛ ɔ Helano ʼi.
Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Listra kɛ Ikoniom ɔ yeɔ e he odase kpakpa.
Paulo hla kaa e kɛ Timoteo nɛ ya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ e ngɔ lɛ nɛ e po lɛ ngɛ Yudafohi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi ɔ he; ejakaa mɛ kulaa a le kaa e tsɛ ɔ Helano ʼi.
Se benɛ a ngɛ ma amɛ a nɔ kpae ɔ, a kɛ mlaahi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ wo ɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a ye nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ asafo ɔ na he wami ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, nɛ a he hiɛɛ daa ligbi.
Paulo ninami ngɛ Troia Akɛnɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsi mɛ blɔ ke a ko fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ Asia he je ɔ, a po mi ngɛ Frigia kɛ Galatia zugba a nɔ.
A ba Misia ni ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a ka kaa a maa ya Bitinia, se Yesu Mumi ɔ ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a gu Misia nɛ a ba Troia.
Nɛ nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ Paulo na ni, kaa nyumu Makedonia no ko daa si ngɛ lɛ pɛɛ kpae ke: “Ba Makedonia nɛ o ba ye bua wɔ!” Se benɛ e na ni ɔ pɛ ɔ, amlɔ ɔ wa hla kaa waa ya Makedonia, ejakaa wa na le tutuutu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɛ wɔ kɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ, konɛ wa ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Lidia tsakemi ngɛ Filipi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa hia kɛ lɛ kɛ je Troia nɛ wa nyɛɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛ ya Samotrake, nɛ e nɔ je na a wa ba Neapoli.
Nɛ wa je lejɛ ɔ, wa ya Filipi nɛ ji Makedonia zugba a nɔ ma ngua kɛ Romabi a nɔ yemi he.
Wa hi ma nɛ ɔ mi be saii.
Nɛ Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa je ma a mi kɛ ya pa nya he nɛ wa juɛmi de wɔ ke a pɔɔ sɔlemi ngɛ ɔ, nɛ wa hi si nɛ waa kɛ yihi nɛ ba bua a he nyɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tu munyu.
Nɛ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Lidia nɛ ji kɔjai jualɔ ko nɛ je Tiatira ma a mi nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ɔ hu nu.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bli e tsui nya, kaa e bu nihi nɛ Paulo ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
Nɛ benɛ a baptisi lɛ kɛ e we ɔ, e kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke: “Ke nyɛ bu mi kaa i he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye anɔkuale mi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ba ye we ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba hi lejɛ ɔ.” Nɛ e hɛɛ wɔ hluu nɛ wa kplɛɛ nɔ.
A wo Paulo kɛ Sila tsu mi E ba mi kaa ligbi ko benɛ wa yaa he nɛ a sɔlee ngɛ ɔ, tsɔlɔyo ko nɛ klaami mumi ngɛ e mi kɛ wɔ ba kpe; e kɛ e klaami ɔ haa e nyɔmtsɛmɛ naa ni fuu.
