E nyɛɛ waa kɛ Paulo se, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ke: “Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ tsɔli ji mɛ, nɛ a ngɛ yi wami hemi blɔ ɔ jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe.” Nɛ e pee ja ligbihi fuu.
Se e dɔ Paulo wawɛɛ, nɛ e plɛ e he nɛ e de mumi ɔ ke: “I ngɛ mo fae ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa o je e mi.” Nɛ e je kpo ngɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu.
Se benɛ e nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na kaa a ni nami hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ be hu ɔ, a nu Paulo kɛ Sila nɛ a sã mɛ kɛ ya ganɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ jua a nɔ.
Benɛ a kpaka mɛ kɛ ya asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, a ke: “Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji Yudafohi ɔ ngɛ wa ma a mi hliihlii woe.
Nɛ a ngɛ kusumihi komɛ tsɔɔe nɛ wa be he blɔ ka wa pɛtɛɛ he loo wa yeɔ nɔ, ejakaa Romabi ji wɔ.” Nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ hu te si wo mɛ nɛ a po klaangma wo a he, nɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ha a je a tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ a fa ke a fia mɛ kpa.
Nɛ benɛ a fia mɛ kpa saminya a, a wo mɛ tsu mi, nɛ a wo pa mi tsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ kita ke e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to sɔkee.
Nɛ akɛnɛ a wo lɛ kikɛmɛ a kita he je ɔ, e kɛ mɛ ya wo tsu nɛ ngɛ se je ɔ mi, nɛ e bɔ a nanehi pa.
Se nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ sɔlee nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ Mawu yi jee; nɛ pa mi tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ tue bue.
Nɛ tlukaa a, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ; nɛ tsu ɔ fanesi ɔmɛ mimiɛ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ sinya amɛ kulaa bli, nɛ mɛ tsuo a kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ a he.
Se benɛ pa mi tsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ hɛli si kɛ je mahɛ mi nɛ e na kaa tsu ɔ sinya amɛ kulaa a nya fɔɔ si ɔ, e hia klaate nɛ jinɛ e maa gbe e he, ejakaa e susu kaa pa mi tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu fo.
Se Paulo nga ke: “Koo pee o he yayami ko, se wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ pã mi tsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ tsɛ nɛ a ba ha lɛ la, nɛ e sa fo kɛ sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ hedomi be nɔ Paulo kɛ Sila hɛ mi; nɛ e kɛ mɛ je kpo nɛ e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma na yi wami hemi?” Nɛ a ke: “He Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ngɔ ye, nɛ a ma he o kɛ o we ɔ kulaa yi wami.” Nɛ a jaje Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ. Nɛ e ngɔ mɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ngmlɛfia a nɔuu, nɛ e fɔ a kpa amɛ a nya ha mɛ, nɛ a baptisi lɛ kɛ e we ɔ mi bimɛ kulaa amlɔ ɔ nɔuu.
Nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya ngmɛ mɛ okplɔɔ, nɛ e kɛ e we ɔ kulaa nya kaa e he Mawu ye.
Se benɛ je na a, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ aslaafohi ba de ke: “Ngmɛɛ nimli ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ho”.
Se pa mi tsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ jaje kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ Paulo ke: “Asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba ke a ngmɛɛ nyɛ he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ je kpo, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛɛmi saminya.” Se Paulo de mɛ ke: “Wɔ nɛ Romabi ji wɔ nɛ a bui wɔ fɔ ɔ, a fia wɔ kpa, nɛ a wo wɔ tsu mi hulɔ, nɛ kpaako a ngɛ wɔ fiee zaa lo?
Dɛbi, se mohu ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ba nɛ a ba je wɔ.” Nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ ya jaje kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Romabi ji mɛ ɔ, a ye gbeye.
Nɛ a ba ba kpa mɛ pɛɛ, nɛ benɛ a je mɛ ɔ, a kpa mɛ pɛɛ ke a je ma a mi.
Se benɛ a je tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a ho Lidia we ɔ mi ya.
Nɛ benɛ a na nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a jɔɔ a bua a, a pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ Tesalonika Jeha nɛ ɔ a gu Amfipoli kɛ Apolonia, nɛ a ba Tesalonika, he nɛ Yudafohi a kpe he ko ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ Paulo ya a ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya sa nya Hejɔɔmi Ligbi etɛ sɔuu ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a he.
E blɛke munyu ɔ mi tsɔɔ mɛ faii kaa ja Kristo ɔ na amanehlu nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ kaa “kikɛmɛ a Yesu, nɛ i ngɛ e he sane jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ, ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ a ti ni komɛ kplɛɛ nɛ a kɛ a he bɔ Paulo kɛ Sila he, kɛ Helabi Mawu gbeye yeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi babauu, kɛ yihi nɛ a buu mɛ hu fuu.
Se e pee Yudafo ɔmɛ tai, nɛ a ya kpaka yakayaka nimli ɔmɛ a kpɛti dikali komɛ ngɔ piɛ a he, nɛ benɛ a nya ba kpane fuu ɔ, a wo ma a mi hliihlii.
A ya tua Yason we ɔ, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpaka Paulo kɛ Sila ya ha ma a.
Se benɛ a nɛ́ mɛ ɔ, a kpaka Yason kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kɛ ya ma a mi nikɔtɔma amɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ plɛ je mi hɛ mi ngɔ bu si nɛ ɔ ba hiɛ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ Yason he mɛ to.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kuɔ Kaisare mlaa a nya deɔ ke matsɛ kpa ko ngɛ nɛ ji Yesu ko.” Nɛ a ha ma a mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo nu sawale kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a he se dami ni ngɛ Yason kɛ ni kpa amɛ a dɛ ɔ, a ngmɛɛ a he.
Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ Beroia Nɛ amlɔ ɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ je Paulo kɛ Sila blɔ nyɔ mi kɛ ho Beroia ya.
Nɛ benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ a ya sɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a su hi pe ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a je a yi mi pɛtɛ munyu ɔ he, nɛ daa a kpaa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi hyɛɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ja lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a ti nihi fuu he ye, kɛ Helayi nɛ ngɛ biɛ kɛ nyumuhi hu fuu.
Se benɛ Yudafohi nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika a nu he kaa Paulo ya jaje Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ Beroia hulɔ ɔ, a ba lejɛ ɔ hu nɛ a ba wo ni ɔmɛ yi, nɛ a pee basabasa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ amlɔ ɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ya je Paulo blɔ nɛ e ya gu wo hɛ mi; se Sila kɛ Timoteo hi lejɛ ɔ.
Se nihi nɛ ya sɛ Paulo ɔ kɛ lɛ ya su Atene tɔɔ.
Akɛnɛ Paulo sɛ mɛ ke a ha Sila kɛ Timoteo nɛ a ba e ngɔ oya he je ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Paulo ngɛ Atene Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ Paulo ngɛ mɛ mlɛe ngɛ Atene ɔ, e mumi mi wo la ngɛ e mi, benɛ e na ma a nɛ mi hyi tɔ kɛ amagahi sɔuu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e kɛ Yudafohi nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ kɛ Mawu gbeye yeli ɔmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ kpee daa nɛ ɔ ngɛ jua a nɔ ɔ saa nya.
Se ni leli nɛ je Epikurotsɛmɛ kɛ Stoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kɛ lɛ sa nya; nɛ ni komɛ ke: “Mɛni nyapuutsɛ nɛ ɔ ma de po?” Ni komɛ hu ke: “E ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ jajeɔ ma se wɔhi a he sane tsɔɔ;” ejakaa e jaje Yesu kɛ e si temi he sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ mɛ.
Nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Areopago (kojomi he) ɔ, nɛ a ke: “Anɛ o ma ha waa le tsɔɔmi he nɛ o ngɛ he munyu tue nɛ ɔ lo?
Ejakaa o ha wa tue nu ma se sanehi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa ngɛ sisi hlae nɛ waa le.” Se Atenebihi tsuo kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ piɛ mɛ pɛ ji sane he ko sɛɛmi kɛ tue bumi.
Paulo ya da Areopago ɔ kpɛti nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Atenebihi, i naa ngɛ nihi kulaa mi kaa nyɛ jaa wɔhi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ejakaa benɛ i bee nɛ i hyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ jae ɔ, i na bɔ sami latɛ ko hu nɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ke: ‘Mawu nɛ a li ɔ nɔ ʼi.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ nyɛ li lɛ se kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e he sane i ngɛ jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Mawu nɛ pee je ɔ kɛ e mi nihi kulaa, nɛ ji hiɔwe kɛ zugba nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, e hi sɔlemi tsuhi nɛ a kɛ nine pee mi, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a kɛ nimli a ninehi ja we lɛ, kaa nɔ ko nɛ nɔ́ ko fiɔ lɛ; lɛ mohu e dɛ mi wami kɛ mumi kɛ nihi tsuo jee kɛ baa haa nimli kulaa.
Muɔ kake e kɛ pee nimli adesahi kulaa nɛ a hi zugba a tsuo hɛ mi, nɛ yinɔhi nɛ e to ɔ kɛ a sihi he ɔmɛ a huzu ɔmɛ ɔ, e kpɛ mi ngɔ to momo, konɛ a hla Mawu se blɔ, kaa eko ɔ ke a lilaa si ɔ, a maa na lɛ lo; pohu e kɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpɛti kɛ we.
Ejakaa ‘E mi nɔuu wa hɛ ngɛ ngɛ, nɛ wa tsɛ̃ɛ wa he, nɛ wa ngɛ ngɛ.’ Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ latsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu de ɔ ke: ‘Se lɛ nɔuu e nina ji wɔ hulɔ’ ɔ.
Se ke Mawu nina ji wɔ ɔ, e sɛ kaa wa susuu kaa Mawu su ɔ ngɛ kaa sika tsu loo sika hiɔ loo tɛ ko nɛ nɔmlɔ kɛ e ga kɛ e juɛmi pee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be nɛ a li ɔ Mawu ku e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, se jeha nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ nimli kulaa nɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ kita woe kaa a tsake a tsui.
Ejakaa e to ligbi ko nɛ e maa gu nyumu ko nɛ e to ɔ nɔ kɛ kojo je mluku ɔ tsuo ngɛ dami nya; e ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ le enɛ ɔ, ejakaa e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje.” Se benɛ a nu ni gbogboehi a si temi he ɔ, ni komɛ ye e he fɛu, nɛ ni komɛ hu ke: “Wa maa kpale bu mo tue ekohu ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.” Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Paulo je a kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se nyumuhi komɛ kɛ a he bɔ e he nɛ a he ye.
A kpɛti ni komɛ ji Dionisio, Areopagono ɔ, kɛ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Damari ɔ, kɛ ni kpa komɛ nɛ piɛ a he.
Paulo ngɛ Korinto Enɛ ɔ se ɔ Paulo je Atene nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Korinto ya.
Nɛ e ya na Yudano ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Akwila nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ Ponto nɛ e je Italia kɛ ba kɛ we, kɛ e yo Priskila (ejakaa Kaesare Klaudio fa Yudafohi tsuo ke a je Roma), nɛ e ya a ngɔ.
Nɛ akɛnɛ e kɛ mɛ tsuo tsuɔ ni tsumi kake he je ɔ, e kɛ mɛ hi si, nɛ a tsuɔ ni; a ni tsumi ji bo tsu peemi.
Se daa Hejɔɔmi Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ya tuɔ munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi ngɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e tsake Yudafohi kɛ Helabi ɔmɛ.
Benɛ Sila kɛ Timoteo je Makedonia ba a, munyu ɔ nyɛ Paulo nɔ, nɛ e ye odase veveeve ngɔ tsɔɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ a ku e nya nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si lɛ ɔ, e huanya e tade ɔ mi nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ muɔ nɛ tloo nyɛ.
Imi lɛɛ musu ko be ye nɔ, kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, ma ya majemajeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ho Mawujalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Titio Yusto nɛ e we tsa kpe he ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɔ ya.
Se kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma Krispo ɔ kɛ e we mluku ɔ kulaa he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ ye, nɛ Korintobi ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu hu nɛ nu ɔ, a he ye, nɛ a baptisi mɛ.
Nyɔ ko mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de Paulo ngɛ ninami mi ke: “Koo ye gbeye, se mohu de, nɛ o ko ma o nya, ejakaa i kɛ mo ngɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be o he tae, nɛ e be mo yayami ko pee; ejakaa yi ngɛ nihi fuu ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi.” Nɛ Paulo hi akpɛti jeha kake kɛ hlami ekpa, nɛ e tsɔɔ Mawu munyu ɔ. Benɛ Galio ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Akaia a, Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ juɛmi kake te si wo Paulo, nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ya kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi; a ya de ke: “Nyumu nɛ ɔ woɔ ni ɔmɛ a yi mi nɛ a je mlaa a se kɛ ja Mawu.” Se benɛ Paulo ma bli e nya pɛ ɔ, Galio de Yudafo ɔmɛ ke: “Yudafohi, e ji ju kɛ fɔ̃ sane ko ʼi jinɛ, e sa kaa ma bu nyɛ tue.
Se ke munyu loo biɛhi loo nyɛ mlaa a he sane komɛ ʼi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ; ejakaa i sume kaa i kojoɔ kikɛmɛ a sanehi.” Nɛ e fie mɛ kɛ je kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Helabi ɔmɛ tsuo nu kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma Sostene ɔ, nɛ a fia lɛ ni ngɛ kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, se enɛ ɔmɛ eko eko dɔɛ Galio.
Paulo kpale kɛ ba Antiokia Se benɛ Paulo hi lejɛ ɔ be saii se ɔ, e sɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e sɛ lɛ mi kɛ yaa Siria; nɛ Priskila kɛ Akwila kɛ lɛ ho.
Nɛ e ya sɛ e yi ngɛ Kenkrea, ngɛ e si womi ko nya.
Nɛ e ba Efeso, nɛ e si mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se lɛ nitse lɛɛ e ya kpe he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ya sa nya.
Nɛ benɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e kɛ ngɛ a ngɔ bɔɔ ɔ, e kplɛɛ we.
Se mohu e sɛ mɛ ke: “Bɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee ɔ ja i ya ye nyami ligbi nɛ ma nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem; se ke Mawu suɔ ɔ, ma kpale ye se kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.” Nɛ e hia kɛ je Efeso.
Benɛ e ya kple ngɛ Kaisarea a, e ya Yerusalem nɛ e ya nga asafo ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Antiokia ya.
E hi lejɛ ɔ bɔɔ, nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ, e pue nɔ ekohu nɛ e ya kpa Galatia kɛ Frigia zugba amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ e wo kaseli ɔmɛ kulaa he wami.
Apolo ngɛ Efeso kɛ Korinto Yudano ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolo nɛ e se je Aleksandria nɛ ji nyumu nya mi tsɔlɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi hulɔ ɔ ba Efeso.
A tsɔɔ nyumu nɛ ɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ he ni, nɛ e ngɛ kã ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ e tsɔɔ Yesu he ni fitsofitso, pohu Yohane baptisimi ɔ kɛkɛ e le.
Nɛ e bɔni kã nya munyu tumi ngɛ kpe he ɔ.
Se benɛ Akwila kɛ Priskila nu e he ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba a ngɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ Mawu blɔ ɔ fitsofitso.
Benɛ Apolo susu kaa e maa po mi kɛ ya Akaia a, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ na kã nɛ a ngma womi ya ha kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ wo mɛ ga ke a he lɛ hɛmuɔ.
Benɛ e ba lejɛ ɔ, e ye bua nihi nɛ gu dloomi ɔ nɔ he ye ɔ babauu.
Ejakaa e kɛ he wami ku Yudafo ɔmɛ a nya nɛ e kɛ ngmami ɔmɛ tsɔɔ mɛ faii kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.
Paulo ngɛ Efeso Benɛ Apolo ngɛ Korinto ɔ, Paulo ya kpa mahi nɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a ɔ nɔ mi kɛ ba je Efeso.
Nɛ e ba na kaseli komɛ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Benɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ nyɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lo?” Nɛ a de lɛ ke Mumi Klɔuklɔu ko ngɛ he ko jio, wa nui tete.” Nɛ e bi mɛ ke: “Lɛɛ mɛni mi a baptisi nyɛ ngɔ wo mɔ?” Nɛ a ke: “Yohane baptisimi ɔ mi.” Nɛ Paulo ke: “Yohane ɔ, tsuitsakemi baptisimi e kɛ baptisi, se e de ma a ke, a he nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ e se ɔ mohu nɔ ngɔ ye, lɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, a ha a baptisi mɛ ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi.
Nɛ benɛ Paulo kɛ e ninehi pue a nɔ ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kple a nɔ, nɛ a tu munyu slɔɔtohi nɛ a gba.
Se nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Paulo ya kpe he ɔ, nɛ e ya tu munyu kɛ kã, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ ni hlami etɛ sɔuu, nɛ e bɔ mɔde nɛ e ha a le Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ.
Se benɛ ni komɛ wlua a tsui nɛ a bui tue nɛ a tu tsɔɔmi ɔ he munyu yaya ngɛ asafo ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, e je a ngɔ nɛ e je kaseli ɔmɛ hu kɛ je a kpɛti, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ e ya tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tirano ɔ ni kasemi he ɔ. Nɛ e pee enɛ ɔ jeha enyɔ sɔuu, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Asia, Yudafohi nɛ Helabi kulaa, nu Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu munyu ɔ. Skeva bimɛ ɔmɛ Nɛ Mawu gu Paulo nine nɔ e kɛ tsu he wami ni tsumihi hulɔ nɛ pɔɛ he, hluu po nɛ a ngɔɔ e dukuhi kɛ e tade hɛ mi hami bohi tete ya haa hiɔtsɛmɛ a nɔ nɛ a hiɔ ɔmɛ jɔɔ, nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hu jee a mi.
Se Yudafohi klaali nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kpaa si ɔ, a ti ni komɛ hu ka nɛ a kɛ Yesu biɛ nɛ ke nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi ɔmɛ a yi ke: “I na Yesu nɛ Paulo ngɛ fiɛɛe ɔ.” Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Skeva, Yuda no ɔ, bimɛ nyumuhi kpaago ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ peɔ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se mumi yayami ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke: “Yesu ɔ, i le lɛ, nɛ Paulo hu i le lɛ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔmɛ ji nyɛ?” Nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi ɔ tua mɛ, nɛ e nine gu a nɔ nɛ e pee mɛ pasaa, nɛ a kɛ a he gu kɛ plaamihi tu fo kɛ je jamɛ a we ɔ mi.
Nɛ benɛ Yudafohi kɛ Helabihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, gbeye nu mɛ, nɛ a wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami nitsɛnitsɛ.
Nɛ nihi nɛ he ye ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi fuu hu ba nɛ a ba jaje a ni peemi ni ɔmɛ paa ngɔ tsɔɔ.
Nɛ kunya tsuli ɔmɛ hu a ti nihi babauu ba nɛ a kɛ a womi ɔmɛ ba pue si nɛ a sã ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi; nɛ benɛ a bu nya a e pee sika hiɔ kpɔ akpe-nyingmi enuɔ.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ gu nɛ e kɛ wa nɛ e kɛ ye kunimi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Basabasapeemi ba te si ngɛ Efeso Benɛ a gbe ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nya a, Paulo to e yi mi ngɛ mumi ɔ nya kaa e ma ya gu Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛ ya Yerusalem, nɛ e ke: “Ke i su lejɛ ɔ, ja i ya slaa Roma hulɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ a ti nihi enyɔ, Timoteo kɛ “Erasto, Makedonia, se lɛ nitse lɛɛ e hi Asia be bɔɔ.
Se jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, basabasa peemi wawɛɛ ko ba te si ngɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ he.
Sika hiɔ galɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Demetrio ɔ kɛ sika hiɔ peɔ Artemi sɔlemi tsuhi nɛ haa jamɛ a gali ɔmɛ naa ni fuu ngɛ mi.
E tsɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ni ɔ eko ɔ kɛ ba kpe, nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛ le kaa kikɛmɛ a ga nɛ ɔ waa kɛ naa wa ni fuu ɔ, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue kaa, pi Efeso nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu piɛ bɔɔ nɛ e su Asia kulaa nɛ kikɛmɛ a Paulo nɛ ɔ plɛ nihi babauu yi mi nɛ e deɔ ke: ‘Nihi nɛ a kɛ nine pee ɔ pi mawuhi ji mɛ’.
Nɛ pi wa ni tsumi nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ he guɛ nɛ ma gbo, se mohu mawuyo Artemi ngua a sɔlemi we ɔ hu a be lɛ bue ha nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, nɛ e nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ Asia kɛ je mluku ɔ hu jaa a nya maa ba si.” Benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, a mi mi wo la saminya nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Efesobi Artemi ɔ, he walɔ ngua ʼi!” Nɛ ma a mi kulaa pee basabasa; nɛ a kɛ juɛmi kake sa kɛ ho ni hyemi he ɔ ya, nɛ a ya nuu Gaio kɛ Aristarko nɛ ji Makedoniabi nɛ piɛ Paulo he kɛ hia blɔ ɔ.
Se benɛ Paulo susu kaa e maa ya ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we lɛ; nɛ Asia ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ hu nɛ ji Paulo huɛmɛ ɔ tsɔ e ngɔ ba wo lɛ ga ke e ko ka kãa e maa ya ni hyemi he ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ ni komɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kikɛ ɔ, ni komɛ hu ngɛ ekpã dee; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ gidigidi pee, se a ti nihi fuu li nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ a ba kpe ɔ tete.
Nɛ a sã Aleksandro kɛ je ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, ejakaa Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ e kuɛ se tsitsɛe kɛ ma hɛ kpɛ.
Se Aleksandro fɔ̃ e nine; e ngɛ hlae nɛ e je e nya kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ.
Se benɛ a kpa si kaa Yudano ji lɛ ɔ, mɛ kulaa a kɛ gbi kake kpa ngmlaa maa pee ngmlɛfia enyɔ sɔuu ke: “Efesobi Artemi ɔ he walɔ ngua ʼi!” Se benɛ ma a mi womi ngmalɔ ɔ kpata ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Efesobi, mɛnɔ po lɛ li kaa Artemi ngua a kɛ amaga nɛ kple si kɛ je Dio ngɔ ɔ Efesobi a ma nɛ ɔ mi nɛ e wɔnɔ ɔ ngɛ?
Jeha nɛ ɔ akɛnɛ enɛ ɔ he be nɔ́jemi ko he je ɔ e sa kaa nyɛɛ pee kɔ dii, nɛ nyɛ ko pee gidigidi ko.
Nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɔ; a pi sɔlemi we ɔ ni juli ɔ, a pi nyɛ mawuyo ɔ he musu bɔli hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Demetrio aloo e huɛmɛ gali ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ ko ngɛ sane ko ɔ, kojomi ligbihi ngɛ, nɛ amlaalofo ɔmɛ hu ngɛ; nyɛ ha a kɛ sane ɔ nɛ ya a hɛ mi.
Se ke munyu kpa komɛ a nya nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, ma gua a nɛ ye ngɛ mlaa nya.
Ejakaa piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ wa ko na sane, ke mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ hoo peemi nɛ ɔ he nɛ a ya po wa nya kaa atua wa ngɛ tsɔe ɔ, mɛni nya jemi wa ngɛ?” Nɛ benɛ e de enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e wo asafo ɔ blɔ.
Paulo ya Makedonia kɛ Hela Se benɛ gidigidi peemi ɔ se po ɔ, Paulo tsɔ ya tsɛ kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba kpe, nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ e sɛ mɛ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ yaa Makedonia.
Nɛ benɛ e ya gu lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi nɛ e wo mɛ ga kɛ munyuhi fuu ɔ, e ba Hela, nɛ e ye hlami etɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ wo lɛ ka benɛ e ngɛ hlae nɛ e hia kɛ ya Syria a he je ɔ, e to e yi mi kaa e maa kpale e se kɛ ya gu Makedonia ekohu.
Nɛ Sopatre, Beroia no ɔ nɛ ji Pirho bi ɔ, kɛ Aristarko kɛ Sekundo, Tesalonikabi ɔmɛ, kɛ Gaio, Derbe no ɔ, kɛ Timoteo, kɛ Tihiko kɛ Tromfimo, Asiabi ɔmɛ, kɛ lɛ ya Asia.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ sɛ hlami nɛ a ya mlɛ wɔ ngɛ Troia.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hia kɛ je Filipi ngɛ akpiti ligbi ɔmɛ a se, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi enuɔ ɔ, wa ya su a ngɔ ngɛ Troia, nɛ wa hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago.
Paulo kɛ Troia asafo ɔ ye sɛ Otsi ɔ mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ kpane a he nya konɛ a kuɔ abolo ɔ, Paulo tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ kɛ ya su nyɔ mi kpɛti, ejakaa e nɔ je na mɔtu ɔ e maa je.
A su kane fuu ngɛ hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi he nɛ a kpane a he nya ngɛ ɔ.
Se niheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Eutiko ɔ hii si ngɛ saflɛ ɔ nya, nɛ mahɛ gbe lɛ, ejakaa Paulo munyu ɔ se kɛ.
Mahɛ ɔ sɔuu ha e tsɔ kɛ je siaudo etɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ba nɔ si, nɛ a ya wo lɛ nɛ e gbo.
Se Paulo kple si nɛ e ya bu e nɔ, nɛ e fua lɛ nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ ko pee hoo, ejakaa wami ngɛ e mi.” Nɛ benɛ e kuɔ kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, e ba ku abolo ɔ, nɛ e ye eko, nɛ e tsa e munyu ɔ nɔ hluu kɛ ba su je nami, kɛkɛ nɛ e pue nɔ.
Nɛ a kɛ niheyo ɔ ho hɛ kalɔ nɛ a bua jɔ a he nitse.
Paulo si Troia kɛ ya Mileeto Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa sɛ hlami kɛ ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ wa hia kɛ ya Aso nɛ wa ya ngɔ Paulo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e de wɔ ngɔ to momo ke e maa gu zugba.
Nɛ benɛ e ba na wɔ ngɛ Aso ɔ, wa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ wa ba Mitilene.
Wa hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e nɔ je na a, wa ba su Kio hanɔ.
Nɛ e nɔ je na nɔ ekohu ɔ wa ba su Samo, nɛ wa hi Trogilo, nɛ e nɔ je na a wa ba Mileeto.
Paulo pee e juɛmi kaa e maa tsɔ Efeso he, benɛ pee nɛ e ko kɛ ngɛ Asia; ejakaa e ngɛ esɔ mie, nɛ ke e ma nyɛ ɔ nɛ e ya ye Pentekoste ligbi ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
Paulo kɛ Efeso nikɔtɔma amɛ ye sɛ Paulo tsɔ kɛ je Mileeto nɛ a ya tsɛ Efeso nikɔtɔma amɛ ba ha lɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a ba e ngɔ ɔ, e de mɛ ke: “Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si be mluku ɔ tsuo, kɛ je kekleekle ligbi nɛ i ba Asia a. I sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ he si bami juɛmi tsuo kɛ vo nyu fuu kɛ kahi nɛ ba ye nɔ ngɛ Yudafohi a ka womi ɔmɛ a mi, bɔ nɛ i laa we nyɛ nihi nɛ he ngɛ se nami ha nyɛ ɔ eko nɔ, nɛ i jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ faii ngɛ ma nɔ kɛ we tsuaa we mi hulɔ; nɛ i ye tsui tsakemi kɛ Mawu hami kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he odase ngɔ tsɔɔ Yudafohi kɛ Helabihi kulaa.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, oʼɛ e fi mi ngɛ mumi mi he je ɔ i yaa Yerusalem, nɛ i li nihi nɛ maa ba ye nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kaa ja nɔ́ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ yeɔ odase faii ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi kaa kpa kɛ amanehluhi lɛ ngɛ mi mlɛe ɔ?
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i bui enɛ ɔmɛ a mi kake ngmelu, nɛ ye wami hu i bui kaa e he jua wa ngɛ ye hɛ mi, benɛ pee nɛ i kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ gbe ye blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ kɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ i na kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu dɛ mi, kaa ma ye Mawu dloomi sane kpakpa a he odase faii, ɔ nya.
“Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, oʼɛ, i le kaa, nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i nyɛɛ nyɛ kpɛti kɛ fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ, nyɛ be ye hɛ mi nae hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ i ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe, kaa i yi nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko muɔ yi musu.
Ejakaa i jaje Mawu yi mi tomi mluku ɔ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ i laa we eko nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ le nyɛ he nɔ hyemi kɛ tohi a kuu ɔ kulaa nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu wo nyɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛ Mawu asafo ɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ he ɔ. Ejakaa i le kaa ke i je ɔ, ogbetee ni hali maa sɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ a be tohi a kuu ɔ yi baae.
Nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpɛti hu ɔ, nyumuhi nɛ tuɔ nihi nɛ dɛ maa te si, nɛ a ma kpaka kaseli ɔmɛ ngɔ pue a se.
Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ nyɛɛ huɔ nɛ nyɛ kai kaa jeha etɛ sɔuu i kɛ vo nyu jɔɔ we nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɔkɔ bɔmi nyɔ kɛ pia.
“Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, mamimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ tue kɛ ngɛ Mawu kɛ e dloomi munyu ɔ dɛ mi woe, lɛ lɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma ha nyɛ nane nɛ pi si nɛ e ngɔ wɔfase ni ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a tsukɔ a he ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ye hɛ kɔɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko sika hiɔ loo sika tsu loo tade nɔ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa, nihi nɛ hiaa mi kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nine nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu i kɛ tsu he ni.
I kɛ kulaa tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa jã e sa kaa a tsu ni nɛ a kɛ ye bua nihi nɛ be he wami, nɛ a kai Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu munyu ɔmɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ke: ‘Nɔ hami mi ngɛ gbaami pe hemi.’ ” Nɛ benɛ e de kikɛ ɔ, e kplã si nɛ mɛ tsuo a sɔle.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a fo ya wawɛɛ, nɛ a nɔ Paulo kuɛ nɔ, nɛ a fiɔ e nya he.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɔ mɛ titli ji munyu nɛ e de ke a be e hɛ mi nae hu ɔ. Nɛ a ya je lɛ blɔ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi.
Paulo ya Yerusalem Jeha nɛ ɔ e ba mi kaa benɛ waa kɛ mɛ ye sɛ nɛ wa gba mi ɔ, wa hia tɛ̃ɛ kɛ ba Koo, nɛ e nɔ je na a waba Rodo, nɛ wa je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba Patara.
Nɛ benɛ wa ya na lɛ ko nɛ yaa Foinike ɔ, wa sɛ mi nɛ wa pue nɔ.
Se benɛ wa ngɛ Kipro hyɛe ngɛ wa hɛ mi ɔ, wa fia lɛ fɔ muɔ nɔ nɛ wa ba Siria, nɛ wa ba kple ngɛ Tiro, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ a ma je lɛ ɔ mi ni ngɛ.
Wa bi kaseli ɔmɛ a si, nɛ benɛ wa na mɛ ɔ, wa hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago.
Nɛ a gu mumi ɔ nɔ de Paulo ke e ko ya Yerusalem.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa benɛ wa ye ligbi ɔmɛ tã a, wa pue nɔ, nɛ a kɛ a yihi kɛ a bimɛ kulaa ba je wɔ blɔ kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ wa kpla si ngɛ wo ɔ nya nɛ wa sɔle.
Nɛ benɛ waa kɛ wa he ye sɛ ɔ, wa sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ mɛ hu a kpale a se kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa je Tiro kɛ ba Ptolemai nɛ waa kɛ gbe wo hɛ mi nyɛɛmi ɔ nya.
Wa ya nga nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hi si ligbi kake.
E nɔ je na a wa pue nɔ kɛ ho Kaisarea ya, nɛ wa ya sɛ sane kpakpa fiɛlɔ Filipo nɛ ji ni kpaago ɔ a kpɛti nɔ kake ɔ we mi, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ hi si.
E ngɛ bimɛ yihewi eywiɛ nɛ gbaa.
Benɛ wa hi lejɛ ɔ be saii ɔ, gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Agabo ɔ je Yudea ba.
Benɛ e ba wa ngɔ ɔ, e ngɔ Paulo mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ e kɛ fi lɛ nitse e ninehi kɛ e nanehi nɛ e ke: Bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Nyumu nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ɔ, kikɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ maa fi lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo majemajeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Se benɛ wa nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, waa kɛ lejɛ ɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e ko ya Yerusalem ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo he nɔ nɛ e ke: “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ ya foe kɛ ma tsɔ ye tsui?
Se imi lɛɛ, pi fimi kɛkɛ nɛ i dla ye he ngɔ to, se mohu gbenɔ nitse ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ ɔ he ngɛ Yerusalem.” Se akɛnɛ e kplɛɛ we he je ɔ, wa pee kɔ nɛ wa ke: “A pee nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ wa bo tlomi nɛ wa pue nɔ kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Kaseli nɛ je Kaisarea a a ti ni komɛ kɛ wɔ ho, nɛ a ha wa yato Mnason, Kipro no ko nɛ ji kaselɔ kɛ je kɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Paulo ya slaa Yakobo Benɛ wa su Yerusalem ɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ he wɔ hɛmuɔ.
Nɛ e nɔ je na a Paulo kɛ wɔ ya Yakobo ngɔ; nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ benɛ e nga mɛ ɔ, e bɔ mɛ nihi nɛ Mawu gu e sɔmɔmi ɔ nɔ tsu ngɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ kakaaka.
Benɛ a nu ɔ, a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Mami, hyɛ Yudafohi akpehi abɔ nɛ a he ye nɛ ɔ; mɛ tsuo ɔ, Mlaa a he hɛdɔli ji mɛ.
Se a ba sɛɛ o he sane ha mɛ kaa o tsɔɔ Yudafohi nɛ ngɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ke a kua Mose, nɛ o deɔ ke a ko po a bimɛ, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a ko nyɛɛ a kusumi nɛ ɔmɛ a se.
Jeha nɛ ɔ kɛ a maa pee kɛɛ?
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ma a nya ma ba kpane sa; ejakaa a maa nu kaa o ba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ pee nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ mo de nɛ ɔ: Wa ngɛ nyumuhi eywiɛ nɛ wo si.
Ngɔɔ mɛ nɛ o kɛ mɛ tsuo ya tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ o wo nɔ́ nɛ a haa a ngɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a sɛ a yi nɛ ni ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ na kaa, nihi nɛ a ba sɛɛ ngɛ o he ɔ be mi, se mohu mo nitsɛ po o baa o je mi ngɛ Mlaa a nya, nɛ o yeɔ nɔ.
Se majemajeli a bimɛ nɛ he ye ɔ a he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa ngma nɛ wa kpɛ mi kaa a ko ye kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ eko nɔ, se mohu a nyɛ bɔ nɛ a sa ha wɔhi kɛ muɔ kɛ lohwehi nɛ a kita a kuɛ kɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛkɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e nɔ je na a Paulo kpaka nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ho, nɛ benɛ e kɛ mɛ kulaa tsukɔ a he ɔ, e kɛ mɛ sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya fiɛ he tsukɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ a nyagbe ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ faii kɛ ya su be nɛ a sa bɔ ɔ ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
A nu Paulo ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ Benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa gbe ligbi kpaago ɔ nya a, Yudafohi nɛ je Asia a na lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a su asafo ɔ ngɔ wo e he.
Nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ Israelbi, nyɛ ba piɛ wa he!
oʼɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ tuɔ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ Mlaa a kɛ hiɛ ɔ he munyu yaya ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi tsuo ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ; nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ e kɛ Helabi ba sɔlemi we ɔ ba ble he klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ hulɔ.” Ejakaa a na lɛ kɛ Trofimo nɛ je Efeso ɔ ngɛ ma a mi mo he je ɔ, a susu kaa lɛ nɛ Paulo kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ ma mluku ɔ kulaa bu, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ sa fo kɛ ba kpane a he nya; nɛ a nu Paulo nɛ a sa lɛ kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ je kpo, nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, a nga sinya amɛ.
Se benɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe lɛ ɔ, a ya ju si sɛɛ ha asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ke Yerusalem kulaa pee gidigidi.
Nɛ amlɔ ɔ, e ngɔ aslaafohi kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ kple si kɛ fo kɛ ba na mɛ.
Se benɛ a na asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a kɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ ɔ, a jɔɔ Paulo ni fiami.
Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a hɛ lɛ su e he nɛ e pɛtɛ e he, nɛ e fa ke a wo lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔhi enyɔ, nɛ e bi nɔ nɛ ji lɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee.
Se asafo ɔ mi ni komɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kikɛ, nɛ ni komɛ hu ngɛ ekpa dee.
Nɛ akɛnɛ e nɛ́ mi anɔkuale ngɛ hoo peemi ɔ he ɔ, e fa ke a kɛ lɛ nɛ ya mɔ ɔ mi.
Nɛ benɛ e su atlaakpe ɔ nya a, e ba mi kaa asafo ɔ gidigidi peemi he je ɔ aslaafo ɔmɛ wo lɛ, ejakaa ma bi asafo jiji ɔ nyɛɛ se ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ke: “Agbe lɛ!” Paulo je e nya Benɛ a kɛ Paulo ba sɛ mɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e bi asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ke: “I ngɛ he blɔ kaa i kɛ mo tuɔ munyu ko lo?” Asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtama a ke: “O tuɔ Hela gbi lo?
Lɛɛ pi mo ji Mizraim no ɔ nɛ lingmi nɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ atua tsɔmi ba nɛ e kpaka nyumuhi awiyeli akpe eywiɛ ngɔ pue e se kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya a lo?” Nɛ Paulo ke: “Imi lɛɛ Yuda no ji mi, nɛ i je Tarso, Kilikia ma ko nɛ ngɛ biɛ ɔ mi.
Se i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi blɔ nɛ ma tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a.” Nɛ benɛ a ha lɛ blɔ ɔ, Paulo da atlaakpe ɔ nɔ, nɛ e fɔ ma a nine, nɛ benɛ lejɛ ɔ jɔ klanaa a, e tu munyu ngɛ Hebri gbi mi de ke:
“Mamimɛ kɛ tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu ye nya jemi nɛ ɔ tue.” Nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Hebri gbi e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, a pee kɔ dii pe kekle ɔ. Nɛ e ke: “I mi lɛɛ Yuda no ji mi, nɛ a fɔ mi ngɛ Tarso ngɛ Kilikia mohu, se ma nɛ ɔ mi a lɛ mi ngɛ, nɛ Gamaliel nane nya a tsɔse mi ngɛ, ngɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Mlaa a nya fitsofitso, nɛ ye hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ Mawu sane he, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ pee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. I waa nihi nɛ hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ yi mi kɛ ya suu gbenɔ mi, nɛ i fiɔ nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo ngɔ haa nɛ a woɔ mɛ tsu mi, bɔ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a tete kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kulaa yeɔ mi odase ɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu hu lɛ a ha mi womi nɛ jinɛ ma kɛ ya ha nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ, nɛ ma fi nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ a gbla a tue.” Paulo sɛɛ e tsakemi “Se e ba mi kaa benɛ i nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ i su Damasko ta maa pee pudami be mi ɔ, tlukaa a la ko nɛ kpemi nya wa je hiɔwe ba bɔle mi; nɛ i tsɔ fia si, nɛ i nu gbi ko de mi ke: ‘Saulo, Saulo, mɛ he je o ngɛ mi yi mi wae?’ Nɛ i he nɔ ke: ‘Mo mɛnɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ?’ Nɛ e de mi ke: ‘Imi Yesu, Nazareno ɔ, nɛ o ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ ʼi.’ Nihi nɛ kɛ mi nyɛɛ ɔ na la a, nɛ a ye gbeye, se a nui nɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ gbi.
Nɛ i ke: ‘Mɛni ma pee, Nyɔmtsɛ?’ Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de mi ke: ‘Tee si nɛ o ya Damasko, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a maa tsɔɔ mo nihi kulaa nɛ a to kaa o pee ɔ.’ Nɛ benɛ i hyɛ we nɔ́ hu ngɛ jamɛ a la a kpemi ɔ nya a, nihi nɛ kɛ mi nyɛɛ ɔ pɛtɛ ye nine mi nɛ a ya sɛ mi Damasko.
“Nyumu ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ngɛ Mlaa a nya, nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa.
Lɛ nɛ e ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba da ye kasa nyɛ nɛ e de mi ke: ‘Maminyumu Saulo, hyɛ nɔ!’ Nɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu ɔ i na lɛ.
Nɛ e ke: ‘Wa tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ hla mo ngɔ to nɛ o le e suɔmi nya ni nɛ o na Dalɔ ɔ nɛ o nu e nya mi gbi ko; ejakaa o ma plɛ e he odaseyelɔ, konɛ o ye nihi tsuo kulaa nɛ o na nɛ o nu ɔmɛ a he odase ngɔ tsɔɔ nimli kulaa.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ mɛ he je o ngɛ tslee toe?
Tee si nɛ o ha a baptisi mo nɛ a fɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he nɛ o tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ.’ A tsɛ Paulo kɛ ha majemaje fiɛmi “Benɛ i kpale ye se kɛ ba Yerusalem ekohu nɛ i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ́ nɔ ye nɔ, nɛ i na lɛ nɛ e ngɛ mi dee ke: ‘Pee esɔ nɛ o je Yerusalem, ejakaa a be ye he odase nɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ tue bue.’ Nɛ i ke: ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a le kaa imi nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ sa a i woɔ nihi nɛ heɔ o nɔ yeɔ ɔ tsu mi, nɛ i fiaa mɛ ni ngɛ kpe he tsuaa kpe he, nɛ benɛ a pue Stefano, o he odaseyelɔ ɔ, muɔ si ɔ, imi hu i daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ye bua jɔ e gbenɔ he, nɛ i bu nihi nɛ gbe lɛ ɔmɛ a bo ɔmɛ a he.’ Nɛ e de mi ke: ‘Yaa, ejakaa ma tsɔ mo majemajeli nɛ ngɛ lokoo ɔmɛ a ngɔ.’ ” Nɛ a bu lɛ tue kɛ ba su kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a wo a gbi nɔ nɛ a de ke: “A kɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ je zugba a nɔ!
Ejakaa e sɛ́ kaa e hii je mi.” Se benɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae nɛ a ngɛ a tadehi kpɔe nɛ a ngɛ bunyuku gbee kɛ ngɛ kɔɔyɔ mi woe ɔ, asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a fa ke a kɛ lɛ nɛ ya mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e de ke a ngɔ kplibi kɛ hla e yi mi, konɛ e le nɔ́ sane he je nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ lɛ woe kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
Se benɛ a fi lɛ nɛ a maa fia lɛ kpa a, Paulo bi asafoatsɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke: “Nyɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa nyɛ fiaa Roma no ko nɛ a bui lɛ fɔ ɔ kplibi lo?” Se benɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ nu enɛ ɔ ɔ, e ya asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ nɛ e ya de lɛ ke: “Mɛni o maa pee nɛ ɔ?
Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ Roma no ʼi.” Asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ba nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke: “De mi, anɛ Roma no ji mo lo?” Nɛ Paulo ke: “Ee.” Nɛ asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a he nɔ ke: “Sika fuu i kɛ he kikɛmɛ a ma mi no plɛmi nɛ ɔ.” Nɛ Paulo ke: “Se imi lɛɛ pe a kɛ fɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ nihi nɛ yaa hla e yi mi ɔ je e kasa nya.
Asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a hu, akɛnɛ e fi lɛ he je ɔ, benɛ e na le kaa Roma no ji lɛ ɔ, e tsui po.
Paulo ngɛ gua ngua a hɛ mi Se akɛnɛ asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ngɛ hlae nɛ e le nɔ́ tutuutu he je nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ po e nya a, e nɔ je na nɔ ɔ, e pɛne lɛ, nɛ e fa ke osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ gua ngua a kulaa nɛ ba.
Nɛ e kɛ Paulo kple si, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya da a hɛ mi.
Paulo tɛ̃tɛ̃ e hɛ mi nɛ e hyɛ gua ngua a kɛ kpe nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, imi lɛɛ he nile kpakpa sɔuu i kɛ ba ye je mi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Anania fa nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a ke a gba e nya ma.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo de lɛ ke: “Ma kɛ̃ Mawu ma gba mo, mo gli nɛ a sa he kalo!
O hii si ngɛ mi kojoe ngɛ Mlaa a nya, nɛ o pa jee Mlaa a se faa ke a gba mi ma?” Se nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a de lɛ ke: “Ee!
Mawu osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a o ngɛ jɛe nɛ ɔ?” Nɛ Paulo ke: “Mamimɛ, i li kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ʼi; ejakaa a ngma ke: ‘Koo tu o ma mi nɔkɔtɔma he munyu yaya.’ ” Se benɛ Paulo kpa si kaa fã kake ɔ Sadukifohi ji mɛ, nɛ fã kpa a Farisifohi ʼi ɔ, e nga ngɛ gua ngua a kpɛti ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, imi lɛɛ Farisifo no ji mi kɛ Farisifo no bi hulɔ.
Hɛ nɔ kami kɛ ni gbogboehi a si temi ɔ he a ngɛ mi kojoe nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Benɛ e de kikɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ pɛ sɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ kɛ Sadukifo ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ aafo ɔ mi gba enyɔ.
Ejakaa Sadukifo ɔmɛ deɔ ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu hiɔwe bɔfo loo mumi ko hu be.
Se Farisifo ɔmɛ deɔ ke enyɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ.
Nɛ huhui babauu ba te si, nɛ mlaatsɔɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Farisifo ɔmɛ a se ɔ te si nɛ a pɛ de ke: “Wa nɛ nɔ ko yaya ko ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he.
Se ke alinɔ mumi ko loo hiɔwe bɔfo ko nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu ɔ nɛɛ?” Se benɛ pɛ ɔ mi ba wa a, asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ye gbeye kaa eko ɔ a ma tsɔtslɔɔ Paulo mi he je ɔ, e fa aslaafo ɔmɛ ke a kple si nɛ a ya kpɔ lɛ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ ba mɔ ɔ mi.
Se e nɔ nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba da e kasa nyɛ nɛ e ke: “Paulo, ha o tsui nɛ nɔ o mi, ejakaa bɔ nɛ o ye hye odase ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ ɔ ɔ, ja o ya ye odase jã nɔuu ngɛ Roma hulɔ.” A so Paulo yi nɔ Se e nɔ je na a, Yudafo ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ya so, nɛ a kã a he kita kaa a be ni yee nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a be nɔ́ ko nue ja a gbe Paulo lolo.
Nihi nɛ ya so nɛ a kã a he kita nɛ ɔmɛ pe nimli nyingmi eywiɛ.
Nɛ a ya osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ ya de ke: “Waa kɛ kita kami so kaa, wa be wa nya mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko woe ja wa gbe Paulo lolo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ gua ngua a tsuo ya de asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a, konɛ e kɛ Paulo nɛ kple si kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ e sane ɔ mi nyɛ ma hyemi fitsofitso.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ loko e maa su nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, wa dla wa he nɛ wa maa gbe lɛ.” Se Paulo nyɛmiyo bi ko nu a ka womi ɔ he, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ya mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e ya wo Paulo tue nɔ.
Paulo tsɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ke: “Ngɔɔ kikɛmɛ a niheyo nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ, ejakaa e ngɛ munyu ko nɛ e maa sɛɛ ha lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ nɛ e ya de ke: “Pamino Paulo ɔ tsɛ mi kɛ ya e ngɔ, nɛ e kpa mi pɛɛ ke i kɛ kikɛmɛ a niheyo nɛ ɔ nɛ ba o ngɔ, ejakaa e ngɛ munyu ko nɛ e maa sɛɛ ha mo.” Nɛ asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a nu e nine si, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya se, nɛ e bi lɛ ke: “Mɛni sane o ngɛ nɛ o ma de mi?” Nɛ e ke: “Yudafo ɔmɛ pee kake ke a ma ba bi mo nɛ hwɔɔ ɔ nɛ o kɛ Paulo nɛ kple si kɛ ba gua ngua a hɛ mi, kaa nɔ́ nɛ e sane ɔ mi a ma hlami fitsofitso.
Se moo lɛɛ koo kplɛɛ ha mɛ, ejakaa a kpɛti nihi pe nyingmi eywiɛ wo ka, a kɛ kita kami ya so kaa a be ni yee, hɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nue ja a gbe lɛ lolo.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ a dla a he, nɛ a ngɛ o nya tue bue.” Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a wo niheyo ɔ blɔ, nɛ e wo lɛ hiɔngɔ ke: “Ko de nɔ ko nɔ ko ke o wo sane nɛ ɔ nɔ tã de mi.” A kɛ Paulo ya ha amlaalo Felike Nɛ e tsɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni enyɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ke: “Nyɛ dla aslaafohi lafa enyɔ kɛ okpɔngɔtsɛmɛ nyingmi kpaago kɛ hlɔtsɛmɛ hu lafa enyɔ nɛ a ya Kaisarea gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛɛ nɛɛ mi.” Nɛ e de ke, a dla okpɔngɔhi hulɔ ngɔ to nɛ a ha Paulo nɛ hi nɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ha amlaalo Felike sɔkee.
Nɛ e ngma womi nɛ e de ngɛ mi ke: “Klaudio Lisia biɔ amlaalo kpakpa Felike saminya!
Kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ ɔ, Yudafo ɔmɛ nu lɛ nɛ jinɛ a maa gbe lɛ.
Se benɛ i na le kaa Roma no ji lɛ ɔ, ikɛ aslaafohi ya ya kpɔ lɛ.
Nɛ akɛnɛ i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma le nɔ́ sane he je nɛ a ngɛ e nya poe ɔ, i kɛ lɛ ya a gua ngua a hɛ mi, nɛ i na kaa a Mlaa a he nguane jemi sane komɛ a he nɛ a ngɛ e nya poe ɔ nɛ, se sane ko nɛ sa gbenɔ aloo tsu mi womi ko be e he.
Se benɛ a ba ju si de mi ke Yudafo ɔmɛ wo nyumu ɔ ka a, amlɔ ɔ, i tsɔ ke a kɛ lɛ nɛ ba o ngɔ, nɛ i fa le nya poli ɔmɛ hu ke a ba o hɛ mi nɛ a ba jaje sanehi nɛ a kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ.
He manye!” Kɛkɛ nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ ngɔ Paulo kaa bɔ nɛ a fa mɛ ɔ, nɛ a nyɛɛ nyɔ ɔ mi nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba Antipatri.
E nɔ je na a, a ha okpɔngɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ ho, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a kpale a se kɛ ba mɔ ɔ mi ekohu.
Benɛ a su Kaisarea nɛ a kɛwomi ɔ ya ha amlaalo ɔ, a kɛ Paulo hu ba da e hɛ mi.
Nɛ benɛ amlaalo ɔ kane womi ɔ, e bi ke jije zugba nɔ e je, nɛ benɛ e na le kaa Kilikia e je ɔ, e ke: “Ke o nya poli ɔmɛ hu ba a, kɔlɔ ɔ loko ma bu mo tue saminya.” Nɛ e fa ke a kɛ lɛ ya to Herode mɔ ɔ mi.
Yudafo ɔmɛ po Paulo nya Ligbi enyɔ se ɔ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Anania kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ ekomɛ kɛ otsiame ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tertulo ɔ ba lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba jaje Paulo he sane ngɔ tsɔɔ amlaalo ɔ. Nɛ benɛ a ya tsɛ Paulo kɛ ba a, Tertulo bɔni e nya pomi, nɛ e ke: “Wa nɔmo Felike, akɛnɛ o yinɔ nɛ ɔ wa tue mi jɔ wɔ babauu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu o nɔ hyɛmi ɔ nya a o ha nihi fuu ba hɛngmɛ nɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ he ɔ, wa naa mo si babauu daa nɛ ɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa he.
Se benɛ pee nɛ ye munyu se nɛ ko kɛ fuu tsɔ he je ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu wɔ tue bɔɔ ngɛ o mi mi himi nya.
E ji anɔkuale kaa wa na nyumu nɛ ɔ kaa e ji nihi a tue puɛlɔ, e woɔ Yudafohi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ ɔ yi mi nɛ a tsɔ atua, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu e ji Nazaretsɛmɛ a kuu ɔ nya kpa.
E ka sɔlemi we ɔ blemi nɛ wa nu lɛ.
[Nɛ jinɛ wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa kojo lɛ ngɛ wa Mlaa a nya.
Se asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma Lisia ba nɛ e ba kpɔ lɛ ngɛ wa dɛ ka nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ho, nɛ e fa e nya poli ɔmɛ ke a ba o ngɔ], nɛ ke mo nitsɛ o bi e nya mi munyu ɔ, o maa na sanehi nɛ wa ngɛ e nya poe ngɛ he ɔ kulaa.” Nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ hu ka nɔ, nɛ a ma nɔ mi ke munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ja.
Paulo je e nya ngɛ Felike hɛ mi Se benɛ amlaalo ɔ fɔ Paulo nine ke e tu munyu ɔ, e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e ke: “Akɛnɛ i le kaa tsa pi mwɔnɛ nɛ o je bɔni zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ amlaalo yemi he je ɔ, i na bua jɔmi nɛ ma kɛ je ye nya.
Ke o bu ɔ, o maa na kaa ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ pɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i ba be kɛ ho Yerusalem ya ke ma ya ja Mawu.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu a nɛ mi hyɛ kaa i kɛ nihi ngɛ nya sae, aloo i ngɛ nihi bue ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, aloo kpe he ɔmɛ, aloo ma a mi.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu sanehi nɛ a kɛ ngɛ ye nɔ fɔe nɛ ɔ, a be nya nyɛe maa tsɔɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mi gbae pãa ngɛ dee ji enɛ ɔ kaa, tsɔɔmi nɛ a ngɛ tsɛe ke nyangɔ tsɔɔmi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu nya i jaa wa tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ngɛ; i heɔ nihi kulaa nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a mi ɔ yeɔ.
I ngɛ Mawu nɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa ni gbogboehi a si temi maa ba, nɛ dali kɛ nihi nɛ dɛ́ kulaa maa te si, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu blɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ hyɛe.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i kɛ ye he fɔɛ si ɔ nɛ, benɛ pee nɛ ma na he nile nɛ yobu be he ngɛ Mawu kɛ nimli a hɛ mi ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.
“Nɛ jehahi fuu a se ɔ, i ba nɛ i kɛ nike ni ba ha ye ma a nɛ ma sã bɔ hulɔ.
Enɛ ɔ mi nɛ a na mi kaa i ngɛ ye he tsukɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, se a nɛ́ mi kɛ asafo ko ɔ, a n nɛ́ mi kɛ hoopeemi ko hulɔ.
Se Yudafohi komɛ nɛ je Asia a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, jinɛ mɛ nɛ sa kaa a ba o hɛ mi, nɛ ke a ngɛ ye he sane ko ɔ nɛ a ba jaje.
Aloo ni nɛ ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ po, ke a na nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ngɛ ye he benɛ i daa si ngɛ gua ngua a hɛ mi ɔ, a de; kaa ja kikɛmɛ a munyu kake nɛ benɛ i da a kpɛti nɛ i wo ye gbi nɔ de ke: Ni gbogboehi a sitemi he je nyɛ ngɛ mi kojoe mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ’ ɔ he kɛkɛ.” Se akɛnɛ Felike le kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ he sane pɛpɛɛpe he je ɔ, e tsɛ̃ mɛ ngɔ to, nɛ e ke: “Ke asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma Lisia ba a, ma hyɛ nyɛ sane ɔ ma ye.” Nɛ e fa asafoatsɛ ɔ ke e ngɔ Paulo ngɔ to, nɛ e ha e na hejɔmi, nɛ ke e he nimli ma lɛ sɔmɔmi loo slaami ɔ e ko tsi mɛ blɔ.
Paulo ngɛ Felike kɛ Drusila hɛ mi Se be saii se ɔ, Felike kɛ e yo Drusila nɛ ji Yudayo ɔ ba, nɛ e ha a ya tsɛ Paulo kɛ ba, konɛ e bu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi he sane ɔ tue.
Se benɛ e ngɛ dami kɛ he nɔ yemi kɛ kojomi nɛ maa ba a he munyu tue ɔ, Felike ye gbeye wawɛɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke: “Yaa lolo; se ke i na ye he deka hu ɔ, ma tsɛ mo ekohu.” Se jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa Paulo ma ha lɛ sika konɛ e ngmɛɛ e he, kɔlɔ ɔ he nɛ e tsɛɛ lɛ kpitikpiti nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba sɛɛ ni ɔ nɛ.
Se jeha enyɔ se ɔ, Porkio Festo ba ye Felike nane mi; nɛ akɛnɛ Felike suɔ kaa e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yudafo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi he je ɔ, e si Paulo ngɛ tsu ɔ mi.
Paulo ngɔ e sane ɔ ngɔ ha Kaisare yemi Festo ba ye amlaalo, ligbi etɛ se pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e je Kaisarea kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ ba po Paulo nya ha lɛ, nɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ, nɛ a bi ke e hyɛ a hɛ mi nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ Paulo kɛ ba Yerusalem; ejakaa a wo e he ka konɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Se Festo he nɔ ke, Paulo nɛ hi tsu ɔ mi ngɛ Kaisarea, se lɛ nitsɛ hu e be kɛe nɛ e maa ya lejɛ ɔ, he je ɔ e ke: “Nyɛ ha nyɛ nya dali ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ mi nɛ ya lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ke sane yaya ko ngɛ nyumu ɔ he ɔ nɛ a de.” Nɛ benɛ e ye maa pee ligbi kpaanyɔ loo nyɔngma ngɛ a ngɔ ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Kaisarea ya, nɛ e nɔ je na a e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e fa ke a kɛ Paulo nɛ ba.
Se benɛ e ba lejɛ ɔ, Yudafohi nɛ je Yerusalem ba a ba bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe nɛ a kɛ nya pomi sanehi fuu nɛ nya wa ba pue Paulo nɔ, se a nyɛ we nya nɛ a tsɔɔ.
Paulo je e nya de ke: “I tɔ́ we Yudafohi a mlaa ko ɔ, jeha nɛ ɔ hu, i tɔ́ we sɔlemi we ɔ loo Kaisare nɔ.” Se akɛnɛ Festo suɔ kaa e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yudafo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi he je ɔ, e bi Paulo ke: “O suɔ kaa o ya Yerusalem nɛ ma ya kojo mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo?” Se Paulo ke: “Kaisare kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi i daa si ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ, he nɛ sa kaa a kojoɔ mi ngɛ ɔ. Yudafo ɔmɛ ɔ, i tɔ́ we a ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ o le saminya a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke i ye sane yaya ko nɛ i pee nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ ɔ, i kua we gbenɔ.
Se ke sanehi nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ye nya poe ngɛ he nɛ ɔ eko eko be mi ɔ, nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ngɔ mi ngɔ wo a dɛ mi.
I ngɔ ye sane ɔ ngɔ ha Kaisare yemi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Festo kɛ e ga woli ɔmɛ hla mi, nɛ e ke: “Nɛ o kɛ o sane ɔ ha Kaisare yemi nɛ ɔ ɔ, Kaisare ngɔ nɔuu o maa ya.” Paulo ngɛ Agripa kɛ Bernike hɛ mi Be ko se ɔ, matsɛ Agripa kɛ Bernike ba Kaisarea nɛ a ba nga Festo.
Nɛ benɛ a ye be saii ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Festo jaje Paulo sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ matsɛ ɔ nɛ e ke: “Nyumu ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ Felike si lɛ ngɛ tsu mi; benɛ i ya Yerusalem ɔ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ ba ye ngɔ kɛ e nya pomi, nɛ a kpa mi pɛɛ ke ma bu lɛ fɔ.
I ha mɛ heto ke, e be Romabi a mlaa mi kaa a gbaa nɔ ko nɔ ngɔ haa gbenɔ, ja nɔ nɛ a po e nya a kɛ e nya poli ɔmɛ kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi nɛ nɔ ɔ na he blɔ je e nya ngɛ sane nɛ a ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ he lolo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a nya ba bua ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ɔ, i tui tslee, se je na nɔ ɔ, i ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ i fa ke a ngɔ nyumu ɔ kɛ ba.
Se benɛ e nya poli ɔmɛ ba da si ɔ, a kɛ sanehi nɛ i susu ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngu kake bɛ́ ba pui e nya, se mohu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a Mawu jami he nguane jemi sanehi komɛ kɛ Yesu ko nɛ e gbo nɛ Paulo ma nɔ mi ke e hɛ ngɛ ɔ he sanehi a hɛɛ kɛ ba.
Se akɛnɛ i li bɔ nɛ ma pee kɛ hla kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a mi he je ɔ, i bi lɛ ke e maa suɔ kaa e ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya ye kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ lo?
Se akɛnɛ Paulo dai e sane ɔ ngɔ ha Kaisare nitsɛ yemi he je ɔ, i fa ke a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to kɛ ya su be nɛ ma ha a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Kaisare ngɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Agripa de Festo ke: “Jinɛ imi hu ma suɔ kaa ma bu nɔmlɔ ɔ tue.” Nɛ e ke: “Hwɔɔ ɔ o maa bu lɛ tue.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e nɔ je na a, benɛ Agripa kɛ Bernike mia gbegbelii kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ nikɔtɔmahi kɛ ma a mi nimli ngua amɛ ba sɛ sane tue bumi he ɔ, Festo fa, nɛ a kɛ Paulo ba.
Nɛ Festo ke: “Matsɛ Agripa, kɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ Yudafohi asafo mluku ɔ kulaa ba kpa mi pɛɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ hiɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ a kpa ngmlaa wo mi ke e sɛ́ kaa e hii je mi hu ɔ hyɛe.
Se imi lɛɛ i na kaa e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ, nɛ akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tu e sane ɔ ngɔ wo Kaisare dɛ mi he je ɔ, i ma nya si kaa a kɛ lɛ ya ha lɛ.
Se i be sane tutuutu ko nɛ jinɛ ma ngma ya ha nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ ba nyɛ hɛ mi, benɛ pee nɛ ke a hla sane ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ ma na nɔ́ ko ma ngma.
Se e peɔ mi kaa e dɛ́ kaa a ngɔɔ pamino ko ngɔ maneɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ we nɔ́ nɛ a ke e pee.”
Paulo je e nya ngɛ Agripa hɛ mi Kɛkɛ nɛ Agripa de Paulo ke: “A ngmɛ mo blɔ kaa o ja o gbi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo fɔ e nine nɛ e je e nya ke: “Matsɛ Agripa, e ngɔ ye nya kaa ma je ye nya mwɔnɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi, ngɛ nihi tsuo nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ ye nya poe ɔ he.
O le Yudafo ɔmɛ a blɔ nya ni ɔmɛ kɛ nguane jemi sane ɔmɛ kulaa mi pɛpɛɛpɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o to tsui nɛ o bu mi tue.
“Yudafo ɔmɛ tsuo le bɔ nɛ i hi si ha kɛ je ye nihe mi, bɔ nɛ i hi ye ma a mi kɛ Yerusalem ha kekle ɔ. Ke a suɔ kaa a maa ye he odase ɔ, a le mi sa kɛ je sisije ɔ, kaa i ba ye je mi ngɛ wa jami ɔ mi kuu nɛ ngɛ veveeve pe kulaa nya, kaa Farisifono.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, si nɛ Mawu wo wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ he nɛ i daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ a ngɛ mi kojoe nɔ nɛ.
Kɔlɔ ɔ nɔ wa wetso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ hɛ ngɛ he je nɛ a hɛɛ nyɔ kɛ pia jami nɛ nya wa a mi, benɛ pee nɛ a nine nɛ su nɔ.
Matsɛ Agripa, kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ he je nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ ye nya poe nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ nyɛ buu kaa e be mi kaa Mawu tleɔ ni gbogboehi a si ɔ?
“Imi nitsɛ hu e pee mi kaa e sa kaa ma pee nihi fuu nɛ ma kɛ te si ngɔ si Yesu, Nazareno ɔ biɛ ɔ. I na pee ja hulɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ akɛnɛ i na he blɔ kɛ je osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ he je ɔ, i wo ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi fuu tsu mi, nɛ ke a maa gbe mɛ ɔ, ye nya ngɛ mi eko.
Nɛ i pɔɔ mɛ yi mi wami ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ kulaa, nɛ i waa mɛ yi mi kaa a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi, nɛ i nuu a he godo wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ i waa mɛ yi mi kɛ yaa ma se mahi a mi tete.
Paul sɛɛ e tsakemi ɔ “Enɛ ɔ nɔ nɔuu i nyɛɛ nɛ i hia blɔ kɛ yaa Damasko ngɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a he wami blɔ ngmɛmi nya.
Nɛ piani katakata, benɛ i nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, matsɛ, i na la ko nɛ ngɛ kpɛe pe pu je hiɔwe ba bɔle mi kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ mi nyɛɛ ɔ. Nɛ benɛ wɔ tsuo wa ya nɔ si ɔ, i nu gbi ko nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke: ‘Saul, Saul, Mɛni he je o ngɛ mi yi mi wae?
E wa ha mo kaa o maa hia nazi ngɔ si lohwehi a kpakami tso nya dade ɔ.’ Nɛ i ke: ‘Mo mɛnɔ ʼi, Nyɔmtsɛ?’ Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: ‘Imi Yesu nɛ o ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ ʼi.
Tee si nɛ o da o nane nɔ; enɛ ɔ he nɛ i je ye he kpo tsɔɔ mo nɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ ma pee mo sɔmɔlɔ kɛ odase yelɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ o na kɛ nihi nɛ ma je ye he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo ngɛ he ɔmɛ a he.
Ma je mo kɛ maa je ma a kɛ majemajeli nɛ i ngɛ mo a ngɔ tsɔe ɔ a dɛ mi, nɛ o ya bli a hɛngmɛ komɛ a kpale kɛ je diblii mi kɛ ba la he, kɛ je abosiami he wami mi kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, nɛ a na a he yayami pami kɛ gbo si ni ngɛ nihi nɛ a kɛ ye nɔ hemi kɛ yemi pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti.’ ” Paulo sɛɛ e nitsumi he ni “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Matsɛ Agripa, i gbo we kikɛmɛ a hiɔwe kpo jemi nɛ ɔ nɔ tue; se mohu i jaje ngɔ tsɔɔni hi nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ kekle, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yudea zugba a nɔ kulaa, kɛ majeli ɔmɛ hulɔ, ke a tsake a tsui nɛ a kpale kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ nɛ a tsu nihi nɛ sa tsui tsakemi.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je nɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ nu mi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a ka mi gbemi ɔ nɛ.
Se Mawu yemi kɛ buami nya i kɛ daa si kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ i ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ nimli tsɔwi kɛ nimli nguahi tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I tu we munyu ko kaa ja nihi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ kɛ Mose hu de ke a maa ba a, kaa Kristo ɔ maa na amanehlu, nɛ e ba plɛ kekleekle nɔ ngɛ ni gbogboehi a sitemi ɔ mi, nɛ e ba jaje la a he sane ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a kɛ majeli ɔmɛ.” Benɛ Paulo je e nya kikɛ ɔ, Festo de kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke: “Paulo, godo o ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ!
Womi kasemi sɔuu lɛ ha o ngɛ godo nue nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Se Paulo ke: “I nui godo, wa nɔmo Festo, se anɔkuale kɛ hɛ si kami munyu i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ munyu tue kɛ kã kɛ ngɛ lɛ tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ le sane nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
I kpa we si kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ eko ngɛ nɛ a kɛ laa lɛ; ejakaa tsa pi laami mi nɛ a pee enɛ ɔ ngɛ.
Tse o heɔ gbali ɔmɛ yeɔ, Matsɛ Agripa?
I le kaa o heɔ yeɔ.” Agripa de Paulo ke: “Piɛ bɔɔ nɛ o ko ha ye yi mi plɛ nɛ i pee Kristofono.” Se Paulo ke: “I na nɛ jinɛ Mawu ha ba mi kaa, e piɛ bɔɔ jio, e piɛ fuu jio, pi mo o nɔ kake kɛkɛ, se mohu nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ mi tue bue mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ hu ko plɛ kaa i mi, se pã nɛ ɔmɛ eko kɛkɛ nɛ a ko ka mɛ.” Nɛ benɛ e de kikɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ kɛ amlaalo ɔ kɛ Bernike kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ mɛ hii si ɔ te si, nɛ a ya se, nɛ a ya da, nɛ a ke: “Nyumu nɔ pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ loo tsu mi womi.” Nɛ Agripa de Festo ke: “Kaa nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ e sane ɔ ngɔ ha we Kaisare yemi jinɛ, a ma nyɛ e he maa ngmɛɛ.”
Paulo Roma yami Bɛnɛ a ma nya si kaa wa maa ya Italia a, a ngɔ Paulo kɛ pamitsɛmɛ kpa komɛ hu ngɔ wo asafoatsɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yulio nɛ je Agusto ta asafo ɔ mi ɔ dɛ mi.
Benɛ wa sɛ Adramitio lɛ ko nɛ maa hia kɛ ya gu Asia wo nya ma amɛ a nɔ ɔ mi ɔ, wa hia, nɛ Aristarko, Makedonia no ko nɛ je Tesalonika a piɛ wa he.
Nɛ e nɔ je na a, wa ya da Zidon, nɛ akɛnɛ Yulio hɛɛ Paulo dɔdɔɔdɔ he je ɔ, e ngmɛ lɛ blɔ ke e ya jɔɔ e he.
Nɛ wa hia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, wa tsɔ Kipro zugba nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ he, ejakaa wa ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kpee.
Nɛ benɛ wa po Kilikia kɛ Pamfilia wo ɔ, wa ba da Mira ngɛ Likia.
Asafoatsɛ ɔ na Aleksandria lɛ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ yaa Italia, nɛ e je wɔ ngɔ wo mi.
Wa nyɛɛ blɛoo be saii, nɛ beble loko wa su Knido hanɔ, nɛ akɛnɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ngmɛ́ wɔ blɔ he je ɔ, wa tsɔ Kreta he kɛ ba Salmone.
Nɛ beble loko wa po mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Lɛsimuɔmi he kpakpa nɛ kɛ Lasea ma a he kɛ we ɔ.
Se jeha nɛ ɔ, benɛ wa puɛ be fuu nɛ wo hɛ mi nyɛɛmi ɔ hu pee dengme, ejakaa hwɔhami be ɔ be mo he je ɔ, Paulo wo mɛ ga. E ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ, i na kaa dengme gbomi kɛ nihi a hɛ mi kpatami babauu maa ba blɔ hiami nɛ ɔ mi, pi lɛ mi ni ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu wa wami nitsɛ hulɔ.” Se asafoatsɛ ɔ heɔ kudɔɔtsɛ ɔ kɛ lɛtsɛ ɔ yeɔ pe munyu nɛ Paulo ngɛ tue ɔ.
Se akɛnɛ lɛ si muɔmi he ɔ hi saminya bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ maa ye fiɛ be ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ti nihi fuu wo ga ke a hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ nɛ a hyɛ kaa a ma nyɛ su Foinike nɛ ji Kreta lɛ si muɔmi he nɛ ngɛ leneyi-bonyoku kɛ omleyi-bonyoku kpɛti ɔ lo, konɛ a ya ye fiɛ be ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ ngua Nɛ benɛ leneyi kɔɔhiɔ bɔni fiami blɛoo ɔ, e pee mɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ ba mi, nɛ a hia kɛ be ngɛ Kreta he tataata.
Se e kɛ we kɛkɛ nɛ wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ omleyi-beleku kɔɔhiɔ ɔ hia kɛ ba kpee mɛ.
Se benɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ sɛ lɛ ɔ mi nɛ e nyɛ we nya dami hu ɔ, wa ngmɛɛ he nɛ e fɔ nɔ.
Nɛ benɛ wa sa fo kɛ tsɔ zugba kpɔ nyafii ko nɛ wo bɔle lɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Klaudia, kɔɔhiɔ ya he ɔ he ɔ, dengme kɛ pɔtɔ loko wa nyɛ boto ɔ nu.
Nɛ benɛ a wo boto ɔ nɔ ɔ, a kɛ kpahi fi lɛ, nɛ akɛnɛ a ngɛ gbeye yee kaa alinɔ a ma ya nɔ zia mɔsɔ (Sirti) ɔ mi he je ɔ, a gbe abalaa a, nɛ a fɔ́ nɔ kɛkɛ.
Nɛ akɛnɛ wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ngɛ wɔ fiae basabasa wawɛɛ he je ɔ, je na nɔ ɔ, a je lɛ ɔ mi ni ɔmɛ eko ngɔ pue he.
Nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ waa kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa ninehi je lɛ ɔ he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he.
Akɛnɛ wa nɛ́ pu loo dodoehi ligbihi fuu, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ fiae ngɛ wɔ kpee ɔ nya wa wawɛɛ he je ɔ, jeha nɛ ɔ wa hɛ̃ bé nɔ kaa wa maa yɛ.
Se benɛ a yi ni be saii ɔ, Paulo te si da a kpɛti nɛ e ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ, jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛ buɔ mi tue nɛ a ko hia ngɛ Kreta nɛ a ba na kikɛmɛ a dengme kɛ nihi a hɛ mi kpatami nɛ ɔ. Jeha nɛ ɔ hu i ngɛ nyɛ ga woe ke nyɛ na tsui; ejakaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko yi be tae, ja lɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.
Ejakaa nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu nɔ nɔ́ nɛ i ji kɛ nɔ hu nɛ i sɔmɔɔ ɔ bɔfo ba da ye kasa nya, nɛ e ke: ‘Koo ye gbeye, Paulo!
Ja a kɛ mo ya da Kaisare hɛ mi kɛ̃.
Nɛ oʼɛ, Mawu ngɔ nihi kulaa nɛ kɛ mo nyɛɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɔ ke mo.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ na tsui, tsaatsɛmɛ, ejakaa i heɔ Mawu yeɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ba de mi ɔ, ja nɛ e maa ba mi.
Se bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, wa ma ya sa si ngɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ko nɔ kɛ.” Se benɛ nyɔ nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ su, nɛ wa ngɛ kpakae kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae ngɛ Adria wo ɔ nɔ, maa pee nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ, lɛ mi nitsuli ɔmɛ susu kaa a su zugba ko he.
A fɔ kalemi kpa, nɛ a na gugue nyingmi enyɔ; nɛ benɛ a ya a hɛ mi bɔɔ ɔ, a f ɔ ekohu, nɛ a na gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ye gbeye kaa alinɔ wa ma ya nɔ tɛ sahi a nɔ, nɛ a fɔ osɛkɛhi eywiɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ se je, a kɛ ngɛ je nami mlɛe.
Se benɛ lɛ mi nitsuli ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a tu fo kɛ je lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a bua nɛ a si boto ɔ ngɔ ma wo ɔ hɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a yaa fɔ́ osɛkɛhi ngɛ lɛ ɔ yi je.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo de asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ ke: “Ke ni nɛ ɔmɛ je lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ yi be wami nae.” Kɛkɛ nɛ aslaafo ɔmɛ po boto ɔ he kpa amɛ, na a ha e ya nɔ si.
Kɛ ma je nami mi ɔ, Paulo kpa mɛ tsuo pɛɛ ke a ye nɔ́ ko, nɛ e ke: “Mwɔnɛ ji ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ sɔuu nɛ nyɛ yi ni, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko yɛ nyɛ nya mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye ni; ejakaa lɔ ɔ lɛ ma ha nyɛ yi ma na wa, ejakaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko yi bwɔmi kake be e yi mi jee ngɔ nɔ si.” Nɛ benɛ e de jã a e kɛ̃ loo e wo abolo nɛ e na Mawu si ngɛ mɛ kulaa a hɛ mi, nɛ e ku mi nɛ e bɔni yemi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ kulaa a na tsui, nɛ mɛ hu a ye ni.
Wɔ kula ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ wa nya suu nimli lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi kpaago kɛ ekpa.
Se benɛ a ye ni nɛ a tɔ ɔ, a sake blɛfo nɛ a wo ɔ ngɔ pue wo ɔ mi, nɛ a ha lɛ ɔ pee huyɛhuyɛ.
Lɛ ɔ butumi Nɛ benɛ je na a, a li zugba a, se a na wo nya kɔkɔɔmi he ko kɛ e nya zia, nɛ a to a yi mi kaa, ke a ma nyɛ ɔ, a ma ha lɛ ɔ ya sa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ a po osɛkɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo wo ɔ mi, nɛ a pɛne kudɔɔ ɔ he kpa amɛ hulɔ, nɛ a wo kpɛti a balaa a kɛ kpee kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ngɛ fiae ɔ, nɛ a plɛ lɛ ɔ yi ngɔ ha wo nya blɔ.
Se akɛnɛ a ya nɔ wo enyɔ kpe he he je ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ɔ ya sa si; e yi je ɔ ya hɛ si kpɛii, se e supa a, oslɔke ɔmɛ a nyawami ɔ ywia lɛ.
Aslaafo ɔmɛ a yi mi tomi ji kaa a maa gbe pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ konɛ a ti nɔ ko nɛ ko sle kɛ ho nɛ e ba tu fo.
Se akɛnɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e he Paulo yi wami he je ɔ, e tsi a yi mi tomi ɔ nya, nɛ e fa ke ninɛmɛ nɛ le slemi ɔ kekle a tu ngɔ pue wo ɔ mi, nɛ a ya nu kpo; se ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ a ti ni komɛ a bu gbegbelihi a nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Tnɛ kulaa a nu kpo sɔkee ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Paulo ngɛ Melita Nɛ benɛ wa je mi sɔkee ɔ loko wa ba le kaa zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ biɛ ji Melita.
Lejɛ ɔ tsɛmɛ pee wɔ kpakpa babauu; ejakaa a slɛ la nɛ a he wɔ tsuo kulaa kɛ hɛmuɔ ngɛ hiɔmi nɛmi babauu kɛ fiɛ ɔ he.
Se benɛ Paulo bua lɛ tsɔwi nya nɛ e kɛ yaa wo la a mi ɔ, sinɔ ko je la gligli ɔ mi mla e nine he.
Se benɛ lejɛ ɔ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na lohwe ɔ nɛ mla Paulo nine he ɔ, a de a he ke: “Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ awiyelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ a he e yi wami kɛ je wo ɔ mi lɛɛ, se lueyemi ngmɛ́ lɛ blɔ nɛ e yi nɛ na wa.” Se Paulo huanya lohwe ɔ ngɔ wo la a mi, nɛ e yi lɛ awi ko.
Se a hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e maa fuu loo e maa fia si gbo tlukaa.
Se benɛ a hyɛ blɔ hluu nɛ a na kaa nɔ́ ko slɔɔto ko pee we lɛ ɔ, a tsake a juɛmi nɛ a ke mawu ko ji lɛ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Publio ɔ ngɛ a bɔɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi.
Lɛ lɛ e he wɔ kɛ hɛmuɔ nɛ e kɛ tsui mi jɔmi pee wɔ nibwɔ ligbi etɛ sɔuu.
Se e ba mi kaa asla kɛ muklii mi pa nu Publio tsɛ kɛ fɔɔ si.
Paulo ya e ngɔ, nɛ e sɔle nɛ e ngɔ e ninehi ngɔ pue e nɔ nɛ e tsa lɛ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ benɛ a pee enɛ ɔ ɔ, ni kpa komɛ hu nɛ ngɛ gboe ngɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ba, nɛ a tsa mɛ.
Nɛ mɛ hu a wo wa hɛ mi nyami babauu, nɛ benɛ wa hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, a ha wɔ nihi nɛ hia wɔ.
Paulo je Melita kɛ ya Roma Hlami etɛ se ɔ wa ya sɛ Aleksandria lɛ ko nɛ e he so ji Dioskurioi (aloo hawi) nɛ ba ye fiɛ be ɔ ngɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔnɔ ɔ mi, nɛ wa hia kɛ ho.
Nɛ benɛ wa ya da si ngɛ Sirakusa a, wa hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ.
Nɛ wa je lejɛ ɔ, wa lɔgɔ si kɛ ba Regio; nɛ je na nɔ ɔ, benɛ leneyi kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ba fia a, wa pue nɔ, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ wa su Putueli.
Wa ba na nyɛmimɛ komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke waa kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si ligbi kpaago.
Kɛkɛ nɛ wa ba su Roma.
Nɛ benɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu wa he ɔ, a ba kpee wɔ ngɛ Apiiforo kɛ Tretaberna.
Benɛ Paulo na mɛ ɔ e na Mawu si nɛ e na tsui.
Paulo ngɛ Roma Benɛ wa ba su Roma a, asafoatsɛ ɔ je pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a, se Paulo lɛɛ, a ngmɛ lɛ blɔ kaa e hi he nɛ e suɔ, se aslaafono ko buu e he.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa ligbi etɛ se ɔ Paulo ha a tsɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ ɔ kɛ ba kpe; nɛ benɛ a nya ba bua a, e de mɛ ke: “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ mamimɛ, i tɔ̃ we ma a loo wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ blɔ nya ni ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ, a ngɔ mi ngɔ wo Romabi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ngɛ Yerusalem kaa pamino.
Benɛ a hla ye sane ɔ mi ɔ, a suɔ kaa a ngmɛɛ ye he, ejakaa gbenɔ sane ko be ye he kulaa.
Se akɛnɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we he je ɔ, e fi mi kaa ma ngɔ ye sane ɔ ngɔ ha Kaisare yemi, se pi kaa i ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ i kɛ maa po yema a nya.
Jeha nɛ ɔ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ he je nɛ i tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ ma na nyɛ nɛ ma kɛ nyɛ nɛ tu munyu; ejakaa Israel hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ he je nɛ a wo mi kikɛmɛ a kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa na we womi komɛ kɛ ji Yudea ngɛ o he, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko bɛ́ hiɛ ɔ ba sɛɛ we o he sane ko aloo o he munyu yaya ko.
Se wa suɔ kaa wa maa bu o juɛmi ɔ tue; ejakaa kikɛmɛ a kuu nɛ ɔ wa le kaa a tuɔ e he munyu yaya ngɛ he tsuaa he.” Nɛ benɛ a to lɛ ligbi ɔ, a ti nihi fuu ba e ngɔ ngɛ e to he ɔ, nɛ e jaje Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ e ye he odase faii, nɛ e je Mose Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a mi hla konɛ a yi mi nɛ plɛ̃ kɛ ba Yesu blɔfami kɛ je mɔtu kɛ ya su gbɔkuɛ.
Ni komɛ he e munyuhi nɛ e tu ɔmɛ ye, se ni komɛ hu he we yi.
Nɛ akɛnɛ a nya ya pee we kake he je ɔ, a je benɛ Paulo tu nyagbe munyu kake nɛ ɔ: “Niinɛ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu de ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaia nya tsɔɔ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke: ‘‘Yaa ma nɔ ngɔ nɛ o ya de ke: Numi ɔ nyɛ maa nu lɛɛ, se nyɛ be sisi nue, Nɛ nami ɔ nyɛ maa na lɛɛ, se nyɛ be se kɔe.
Ejakaa ma nɛ ɔ tsui ti, Nɛ a tue wa kɛ nɔ numi, Nɛ a mia a hɛngmɛ Konɛ a ko na kɛ a hɛngmɛ Nɛ a ko nu kɛ a tue, Nɛ a tsui hu ko na sisi, Nɛ a kpale nɛ i tsa mɛ.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa, a tsɔ nɛ a kɛ Mawu Yi wami hemi sane ɔ ya ha majeli ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu tue hulɔ.” [ Nɛ benɛ Paulo tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ je, nɛ a je nɔ babauu ngɛ a kpɛti.]
Nɛ Paulo hi we nɛ a ba ha lɛ ɔ mi jeha mluku enyɔ, nɛ e heɔ nihi kulaa nɛ baa e ngɔ ɔ, nɛ e fiɛɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kã babauu jajeɔ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo he sane ɔmɛ tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko tsi lɛ blɔ.
Womi nɛ ɔ je Paulo, nɛ ji Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kɛ bɔfo nɛ a tsɛ lɛ nɛ a je lɛ ngɔ to kɛ ha Sane Kpakpa a fiɛmi ɔ ngɔ.
Sane Kpakpa nɛ ɔ ɔ, Mawu wo he si ngɔ to momo kɛ gu e gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Ngmami Klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi.
Sane nɛ ɔ kɔɔ e Bi ɔ, nɔ nɛ a je David nina mi fɔ lɛ ngɛ he lo blɔfami ɔ he, nɔ nɛ ngɛ he tsɔmi mumi ɔ nya a, a gu ni gbogboehi a si temi nɔ je lɛ tsɔɔ ngɛ he wami mi kaa Mawu bi, Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. E nɔ i gu nɛ i na dloomi kɛ bɔfo ni tsumi ɔ kone ma ha majemaje ɔ kulaa nɛ bu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tue, ngɛ e biɛ ɔ he: nihi a kpɛti nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ, nyɛ nihi nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ba pee Yesu Kristo nihi ɔ. I ngɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae ya ha nihi nɛ Mawu suɔ nɛ ji ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ nɛ a ngɛ Roma a kulaa: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Sina sɔlemi Kekleekle ɔ, i ngɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ gue kɛ ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ si nae ngɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ he, ejakaa a gbaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he sane ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Ye dase ji Mawu, nɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ ngɛ ye mumi mi ngɛ e Bi ɔ Sane Kpakpa a mi ɔ, kaa i jɔɔ we nyɛ kaimi ligbi ko ligbi ko.
I kpaa pɛɛ daa ngɛ ye sɔlemihi a mi, kaa alinɔ Mawu suɔmi nya a, hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, blɔ ma bli ha mi nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ lo.
Ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ nyɛ he, konɛ ikɛ mumi mi dloomi nike ni ɔ eko ba ha nyɛ, bene pee nɛ a kɛ wo nyɛ he wami.
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa, konɛ a wo i kɛ nyɛ tsuo he wami ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ tsuo wa mi ɔ mi.
Se mamimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kaa i pɔɔ ye yi mi tomi kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ kone ma ba na yiblii komɛ ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ i na ke je majeli kpa amɛ a kpɛti ɔ, se a tsi ye nya kɛ ba ta piɔ.
I hɛɛ Helabi kɛ nihi nɛ a pi Helabi, ni leli kɛ nihi nɛ a li ni kulaa hiɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ka ye nɔ kake ye he ɔ, i ko suɔ kaa nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Roma a hulɔ ɔ, ma ba fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Sane Kpakpa a hewami Ejakaa Kristo Sane Kpakpa a he zo pee we mi, mɛni he je ɔ, e ji Mawu he wami nɛ a kɛ heɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ yi wami, Yuda no kekle kɛ Hela no hulɔ.
Ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ mi a jeɔ Mawu dami kpo ngɛ, kɛ jee hemi kɛ yemi mi kɛ yaa hemi kɛ yemi mi; kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ke: “Dalɔ nɛ guu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ yi ma na wa.” Adesahi a fɔyemi Ejakaa a jeɔ Mawu mi mi fumi kpo kɛ jee hiɔwe kɛ baa nimli nɛ kɛ ni yayamihi kɛ musu bɔmi tsiɔ anɔkuale ɔ blɔ ɔ kulaa nɔ, ejakaa Mawu he nihi nɛ a ma nyɛ le ɔ jee kpo paa ngɛ a mi, ejakaa Mawu je tsɔɔ mɛ paa.
Mɛni he je ɔ, e he nihi nɛ a nɛ́ nɛ ji e neneene hewami kɛ e Mawu nɛ e ji ɔ kulaa a, kɛ je adebɔ sisije lokoo ɔ, a guu e nihi nɛ e pee ɔmɛ a nɔ yɔseɔ nɛ a naa paa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a be nya jemi ko.
A le Mawu lɛɛ, se a wui e hɛ mi nyami kaa Mawu nɛ a nɛ lɛ si hulɔ, se a epe posoposo ngɛ a juɛmihi a mi, nɛ a tsui nɛ kɔ we sane se ɔ mi wo diblii.
A tsɛɛ a he ni leli, se a plɛ kuasiahi.
Mawu nɛ puɛ we ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ a tsake ngɔ ha nɔmlɔ nɛ puɛɛ ɔ subai henɔ ko kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ lohwe nane eywiɛ eywiɛtsɛmɛ kɛ waami nihi anɔ.
Akɛnɛ kuasiahi ji mɛ he je ɔ Mawu ngmɛɛ a he ngɛ a kɔnɔhi nɛ ngɛ tai ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he peɔ zo nihi.
A ngɔɔ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ kɛ tsakee lakpa, nɛ a jaa nɛ a sɔmɔɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ pe Bɔlɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ a gbaa kɛ yaa neneene ɔ!
Amen.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Mawu ngmɛɛ a he ngɔ ha zo nihi a he hɛdɔmi ɔ nɛ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ a to nɛ a peɔ ɔ, a yi ɔmɛ tsake hɛ mi ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ a pee we.
Nɛ ja nɔuu a nyumu ɔmɛ hu jɔɔ yo he nɔ nɛ a to nɛ a peɔ ɔ peemi nɛ a hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ a kɔnɔ yayami ɔ mi kɛ nyɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a se, nɛ nyumuhi kɛ nyumuhi tsuɔ zo ni, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ a na a tɔmi ɔ he hiɔwo nɛ sa ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a bui kaa e sa kaa a leɔ Mawu ngɛ a ni lemi mi ɔ, Mawu hu ngmɛɛ a he ha juɛmi nɛ sɛ, konɛ a pee nihi nɛ sɛ.
A hyi tɔ kɛ ni yayamihi, yiwitso, hɛ tsumi, yayami; a hyi tɔ kɛ nyɛmi, awi yemi, pɛ, sisimi, nihi a he munyu tumi; sieku yeli, Mawu nyɛli, nɔ buili, he tsɔɔli, fiali, nɔ́ yayami he ga tsɔli, fɔli a nɔ tue gboli, nihi nɛ be yi mi, kutupɔtsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ nɛ mɔbɔ; nihi nɛ le Mawu mlaa a tutuutu, kaa nihi nɛ tsuɔ lɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a sa gbenɔ, nɛ kɛ ɔ pi peemi kɛkɛ nɛ a peɔ, se mohu a naa ni nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he tsui hulɔ.
Mawu kojomi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mo, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ o kojoɔ ɔ, o be nya jemi ko; ejakaa nɔ he nɛ o kojoɔ nɔ kpa ngɛ ɔ, o kɛ buu mo nitsɛ o he fɔ; ejakaa mo nɛ o kojoɔ nihi ɔ, jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ nɔuu o tsuɔ.
Wa le kaa Mawu fɔ bumi ɔ sa nihi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ pɛ.
Se mo nɔmlɔ nɛ o kojoɔ nihi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o peɔ ja nɔuu ɔ, anɛ o susuu kaa moo lɛɛ o he maa je Mawu kojomi ɔ mi lo?
Aloo pe o ngɛ e mi mi himi kɛ e nɔ he tsui nami kɛ e tsui si tomi babauu ɔ he guɛ gbee, se o li kaa Mawu mi mi jɔmi ɔ pe e ngɛ o he piɛe nɛ o pia o he lo?
Se o kɛ o tsui wami kɛ o he nɛ o pia we ɔ ngɛ mi mi fumi nyɛ buae ngɔ ha mo nitsɛ o he ngɔ to mi mi fumi kɛ Mawu dami kojomi kpo jemi ligbi ɔ. Ejakaa e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa e ni tsumi ɔmɛ: Nihi nɛ kɛ kpakpa peemi kɛ tsui si tomi hlaa hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu kɛ si himi nɛ puɛ we ɔ, Mawu ma ha mɛ neneene wami.
Se nihi nɛ suɔ pɛ nɛ a bui anɔkuale ɔ tue, se a buɔ ni yayahi mohu tue ɔ, a nɔ ji mi mi fumi kɛ mi mi la.
Dengme kɛ he hiami maa ba nɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni yaya nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, Yuda no nɔ kekle kɛ Hela no hu nɔ.
Se hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu kɛ he jɔmi maa ba nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni kpakpahi ɔ nɔ, Yuda no kekle kɛ Hela no hulɔ.
Ejakaa Mawu hlɛ nimli a mi.
Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ be Mlaa nɛ a pee yayami ɔ, a maa laa hulɔ nɛ a be mlaa; nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ gu mlaa a nɔ pee yayami ɔ, Mlaa a nɔuu a kɛ maa kojo mɛ.
Ejakaa pi mlaa nuli ɔmɛ ji dali ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, se mlaa nɔ yeli mohu ji ninɛmɛ nɛ a maa bu kaa dali.
Ejakaa, ke maje li a bimɛ nɛ be mlaa a kɛ a fɔmi mi su ɔ tsuɔ Mlaa a nya ni ɔ, mɛ nihi nɛ a be mlaa a, a ji mlaa ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he; kɔlɔ ɔ a kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngma Mlaa a ni tsumi ɔ ngɛ a tsui mi, nɛ a he nile hu yeɔ odase, nɛ a susumi ɔmɛ poo a nya aloo a jeɔ a nya ngɛ ligbi nɛ Mawu maa gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ kojo nimli a laami mi ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ye Sane Kpakpa a nya a. Yudafo ɔmɛ kɛ Mlaa a Se ke moo lɛɛ a tsɛɛ mo Yuda no, nɛ o hɛ ngɛ Mlaa a nɔ, nɛ o fiaa fɔɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ o le e suɔmi nya ni ɔmɛ, nɛ o le nihi nɛ hi, ejakaa a je Mlaa a mi kɛ tsɔɔ mo, nɛ o buu o he kaa o ji hɛ yuyuili a blɔ tsɔɔlɔ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi ɔmɛ a la, kɛ nihi nɛ li ni a tsɔselɔ, kɛ bimwɔwi a tsɔɔlɔ, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ nile kɛ anɔkuale nɛ ngɛ Mlaa a mi ɔ su ɔ, jeha nɛ ɔ mo nɛ o tsɔɔ ni kpahi a ni ɔ, o tsɔɔ we mo nitsɛ o he lo?
O fiɛɔ ke “a ko ju,” se o ju we lo?
O deɔ ke “a ko bɔ ajuama,” se o bɔɛ ajuama lo?
O nyɛɛ amagahi, se o ju we a sɔlemi we nihi lo?
Mo nɛ o kɛ Mlaa a fia a, o kɛ Mlaa a nɔ tɔmi ɔ gbee Mawu he guɛ.
Ejakaa nyɛ he ɔ, a tuɔ Mawu biɛ ɔ he musu bɔmi munyuhi ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a.
Se ke o yeɔ Mlaa a nɔ ɔ, jinɛ nɔ pomi he ngɛ se nami; se ke o pee o he Mlaa a nɔ tɔlɔ ɔ, o pomi ɔ plɛ mɔmlɔtɔ.
Se ke mɔmlɔtɔsɛ yeɔ Mlaa a blɔnya amɛ a nɔ ɔ, anɛ a be e mɔmlɔtɔ ɔ bue kaa pomi lo?
Fɔmi mi mɔmlɔtɔsɛ nɛ yeɔ Mlaa a nɔ ɔ maa kojo mo nɛ o gu ngmami okadi kɛ nɔ pomi nɔ kɛ pee o he mlaa nɔ tɔlɔ ɔ. Ejakaa pi nɔ nɛ a naa lɛ kaa Yuda no kɛkɛɛkɛ ɔ ji Yuda no, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu pi kpo nɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ ji pomi; se mohu nɔ nɛ ji Yudafo no ngɛ mi mi je ɔ lɛ ji Yuda no; nɛ tsui mi nɔ pomi nɛ ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ pi ngmami okadi mi ɔ, ji nɔ pomi nɛ e yi jemi ɔ ji nimli a ngɔ, se mohu Mawu ngɔ e jee.
Jeha nɛ ɔ mɛni ji Yuda no ni nɛ e na kɛ be nɔ mɔ?
Aloo mɛni se nami lɛ ngɛ nɔ pomi mi?
E hiɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ.
Kekleekle nɔ ji kaa a tu Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ wo Yudafo ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Se ke ni komɛ he we yi ɔ, mɛni ʼi?
A he nɛ a he we yi ɔ ma ha Mawu anɔkuale yemi ɔ maa pee yaka lo?
Dɛbi!
Mawu ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ʼi, se snɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ ɔ, nya ngɔlɔ ʼi, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Bene pee nɛ o ye manye ngɛ o munyu ɔmɛ a mi, Nɛ o ye nguɔ ngɛ o kojomi ɔ mi.” Se ke wa ni yayami ɔmɛ haa Mawu dami ɔ jee kpo ɔ, kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Anɛ Mawu tɔ ke e kɛ mimifumi ba wa nɔ ɔ lo?
(I ngɛ munyu tue kaa bɔ nɛ nimli tuɔ munyu.)
Dɛbi!
Ejakaa ke ja a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ Mawu maa kojo je ɔ?
Se ke ye nya ngɔmi ɔ haa Mawu anɔkuale hiɛɛ kɛ bee nɔ ha e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a yaa nɔ kojoɔ mi kaa yayami peelɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ e sɛ kaa waa pee yayami konɛ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ ba?
Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ ni komɛ poo ngɔ fɔɔ wa nɔ ke wa deɔ.
Jamɛ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a fɔ bumi ɔ da pɛ.
Nɔ ko be nɛ da Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ?
Anɛ wɔ Yudafo ɔmɛ wa hi pe ni kpa amɛ lo?
Tsa pi ja kulaa; ejakaa wa po Yudafohi kɛ Helabi tsuo a nya momo kaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ yayami sisi; kaa bɔ nɛ wa ngma a ke: “Dalɔ ko be, nɔ kake ngmelu be; Ni lelɔ ko be, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ hlaa Mawu se blɔ.
Mɛ tsuo kulaa a tla blɔ, Mɛ tsuo kulaa a puɛ; Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peɔ nɔ kpakpa, Nɔ kake po be.
Yɔkɔ nɛ a bli nya ji a kuɔ si; A kɛ a lilɛ sisiɔ nɔ, Sinɔ duɔ ngɛ a nya mi.
Gbiɛmi kɛ doomi hyi a nya mi tɔ.
A he sɔɔ ke muɔ si puemi.
Hɛ mi kpatami kɛ kɔmɔ yemi ngɛ a blɔhi a nɔ, Nɛ he jɔmi blɔ ɔ a li.
Mawu gbeye yemi ko be a hɛ mi.” Jeha nɛ ɔ wa le kaa nihi kulaa nɛ Mlaa a deɔ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Mlaa a sisi ɔ e ngɛ dee, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ko na nya, nɛ je mluku ɔ tsuo nɛ ye fɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a be mlaa ni tsumi nɔ gue kɛ wo he lo ko he lo ko nguɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi; ejakaa mlaa a nɔ a guu kɛ leɔ yayami.
Yayamipami nɛ jee Kristo nɔhemikɛyemi mi Se jeha nɛ ɔ, a si Mlaa a se nɛ a je Mawu dami ɔ kpo paa, nɛ lɔ ɔ he odase Mlaa a kɛ gbali ɔmɛ yeɔ; kɔlɔ ɔ ji Mawu dami nɛ a guu Yesu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ a kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ. Ejakaa slɔɔto ko be: ejakaa nihi tsuo peɔ yayami, nɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ bɔ mɛ, nɛ a kɛ e dloomi ɔ woɔ mɛ nguɔ yaka kɛ guu kpɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ nɔ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ Mawu je ngɔ to kaa kpatami nɔ kɛ gu e muɔ ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ, konɛ e je e dami ɔ kpo ngɛ e hɛ nɛ e je kɛ je yayamihi nɛ a pee sa a nɔ ngɛ Mawu tsui si tomi ɔ he; konɛ e je e dami ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ be nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e ye nguɔ nɛ e wo nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu nɔ yeɔ ɔ hu nguɔ.
Jeha nɛ ɔ jije fiami ɔ ngɛ?
A je lɛ kɛ je.
Mɛni mlaa nɔ a gu?
Ni tsumi hi a nɔ lo?
Dɛbi, hemi kɛ yemi mlaa nɔ mohu a gu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa ngɔɔ lɛ kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɔ a guu kɛ woɔ nɔmlɔ nguɔ, se pi mlaa ni tsumihi a nɔ.
Anɛ Mawu ɔ, e ji Yudafohi kɛkɛ a Mawu lo?
Anɛ pi majeli ɔmɛ hu a Mawu lo?
Ee, majeli ɔmɛ hu a nɔ ʼi.
Ke e ngɛ mi kaa Mawu ɔ Mawu kake ʼi, nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya e buu nɔ pomi bemi, nɛ e kpale guu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ buu mɔmlɔtɔ bemi ɔ, lɛɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ gue nɛ wa ha Mlaa a nɛ pee yaka lo?
Dɛbi, waa kɛ ngɛ Mlaa a nɔ mi mae mohu.
Abraham hemi kɛ yemi Lɛɛ mɛni wa ma de ke wa tsɛ Abraham na ngɛ he lo blɔfami mɔ?
Ejakaa ke ni tsumihi a nɔ a gu kɛ wo Abraham nguɔ ɔ, jinɛ e ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ e maa fia ngɔ fɔ nɔ, se lɛɛ pi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Se kɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ kɛɛ?
“Abraham he Mawu ye, Nɛ a bu kɔlɔ ɔ dami ha lɛ.” Nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni ɔ, a bui e hiɔwo ɔ kaa dloomi nɔ ko, se mohu e blɔ nya ʼi.
Se nɔ nɛ tsu we ni, se e heɔ nɔ nɛ woɔ yayami peelɔ nguɔ ɔ yeɔ ɔ, a buu e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kaa dami kɛ haa lɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ David hu deɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ Mawu siɔ ni tsumihi a se nɛ e buu dami haa lɛ ɔ he ke: “A gbaa nihi nɛ a ngɔ a mlaa tɔmi ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ, Nɛ a tsi a he yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ; A gbaa nyumu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bui e he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ hi lɛ ɔ.” Jeha nɛ kikɛmɛ a gbaami nɛ ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔ kɛkɛ a kɛ gbaa aloo mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ?
Ejakaa wa deɔ ke a bu Abraham hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kaa dami ngɔ ha lɛ.
Mɛni be mi a pee enɛ ɔ?
Be nɛ a po lɛ ɔ, aloo be nɛ a pui lɛ ɔ?
Tsa pi be mi nɛ a po lɛ ɔ, se mohu be mi nɛ e ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ ɔ. Nɛ be mi nɛ a po lɛ ɔ, e nine su nɔ pomi he okadi ɔ nɔ kaa dami nya sɔumi nɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu he nɛ e he ye be mi nɛ e ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ lokoo ɔ nya, konɛ e pee tsɛ kɛ ha nihi kulaa nɛ heɔ yeɔ benɛ a ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔ nɛ a bu dami ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ hulɔ, nɛ jeha nɛ e pee ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔ a tsɛ hulɔ kɛ ha nihi nɛ a pui mɛ se mohu a ngɔ wa tsɛ Abraham nane ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ e ngɛ be mi nɛ e ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ lokoo ɔ. Mawu siwomi nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi Pi mlaa nɔ nɛ Mawu gu kɛ wo Abraham loo e nina si kaa e maa ye je ɔ nɔ ɔ, se mohu hemi kɛ yemi dami nɔ a gu.
Ejakaa ke mlaa sisibi ɔmɛ ji ni yeli ɔ, lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ pee yaka, nɛ si womi ɔ hu be nɔ hu.
Se Mlaa a tsɛɔ Mawu mi mi fumi kɛ baa, mɛni he je ɔ, he nɛ mlaa be ɔ, mlaa nɔ tɔmi hu be.
Se enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ, benɛ pee nɛ e pee dloomi sane, konɛ si womi ɔ nɛ ma si kpɛii ngɔ ha e nina tsuo, pi Mlaa sisibi ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu nihi nɛ je Abraham, nɛ ji wɔ tsuo wa tsɛ ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “I ngɔ mo ngɔ pee majeli fuu a tsɛ,” ngɛ Mawu nɔ nɛ e he yeɔ ɔ hɛ mi, nɔ nɛ tsɛɛ ni gbogboehi a hɛ, nɛ e tsɛɔ nihi nɛ be ɔ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ momo ɔ. Nɛ jinɛ he nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko be ɔ, Abraham hɛ ngɛ nɔ kɛ̃ nɛ e he ye, konɛ e plɛ majeli fuu a tsɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a de lɛ ke: “Ja o nina maa hi” ɔ. Nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi gbɔjɔɔ we, nɛ e susuu we lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso gbomi nɛ e gbo momo ɔ, akɛnɛ e ye maa pee jeha lafa, kɛ Sara fɔmi nɛ e fɔ we ɔ he.
E yi mi pee we lɛ enyɔ enyɔ ngɛ Mawu si womi ɔ he kaa nɔ nɛ e he we yi, se mohu e na he wami ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, nɛ e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ e ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ saminya kaa nɔ nɛ e wo he si ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa pee hulɔ.
Kɔlɔ ɔ he hu nɛ a bu lɔ ɔ dami ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se pi lɛ kɛkɛ e he nɛ a ngma ke, “a bu dami ngɔ ha lɛ” ɔ, se mohu wɔ nihi nɛ a maa bu ngɔ ha a hu wa he, wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa heɔ nɔ nɛ tle wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ.
A ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ngɛ wa tɔmi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a tle lɛ si ekohu ngɛ wa nguɔ womi ɔ he.
Waa kɛ Kristo huɛbɔmi Jeha nɛ ɔ akɛnɛ a gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ wo wɔ nguɔ he je ɔ, waa kɛ Mawu kpɛti ngɛ he jɔmi ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he.
Lɛ e nɔ wa gu nɛ waa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ na blɔ kɛ ba dloomi nɛ wa daa si ngɛ mi ɔ mi, nɛ wa fiaa fɔɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu wa fiaa ngɛ dengme gbomihi a mi hulɔ, ejakaa wa le kaa dengme gbomi ɔ tsɛɛ tsui si tomi kɛ baa, nɛ tsui si tomi ɔ hu tsɛɛ nihi a si kpami kɛ baa, nɛ nihi a si kpami ɔ tsɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kɛ baa.
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ gbi nɔ zo, ejakaa a gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ a ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ nɔ plɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ ngɔ wo wa tsui mi.
Ejakaa be mi nɛ wa he wɛ ɔ lokoo nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ha yayami peeli.
Ejakaa e maa wa loko nɔ ko ma gbo ha dalɔ ko; se nɔ́ kpakpa ko he ɔ, eko ɔ, nɔ ko ma si e gugue kaa e maa gbo.
Se Mawu jeɔ e suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ kpo tsɔɔ, kaa be mi nɛ wa ji yayami peeli lokoo nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ wa nane mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ ɔ, nɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ ngɛ e muɔ ɔ he he je ɔ, a maa gu e nɔ kɛ he wa yi wami hluu kɛ je mi mi fumi ɔ mi.
Ejakaa ke be mi nɛ wa ji henyɛli ɔ nɛ a kɛ Mawu bi ɔ gbenɔ ba kpata waa kɛ Mawu kpɛti ɔ, jeha nɛ nɛ a kpata nɛ ɔ, a ma he wa yi wami hluu ngɛ e wami ɔ mi.
Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu wa fiaa fɔɔ Mawu nɔ hulɔ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he, nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ wa gu jeha nɛ kɛ na kpatami ɔ. Adam kɛ Yesu Kristo Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ kake nɔ yayami gu kɛ ba je ɔ mi, nɛ gbenɔ gu yayami nɔ kɛ ba a, lɔ ɔ ha gbenɔ sa nimli tsuo, mɛni he je ɔ, mɛ tsuo a pee yayami.
Yayami ngɛ je ɔ mi loko a ha Mlaa a; se akɛnɛ Mlaa be he je ɔ a bui yayami ɔ.
Se kɛ ɔ gbenɔ ye tsɛ kɛ je Adam yi nɔ kɛ ba su Mose yi nɔ ngɛ nihi po nɛ pee we yayami nɛ ngɛ kaa Adam tɔmi ɔ nɔ, nɛ Adam ji nɔ nɛ maa ba a he okadi.
Se bɔ nɛ si gbeemi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, pi ja nɛ dloomi nɔke nɔ ɔ hu ngɛ.
Ejakaa ke nɔ kake si gbeemi he je nɛ nihi fuu gbo ɔ, Mawu dloomi kɛ nɔke nɔ nɛ gu nɔmlɔ kake nɛ ji Yesu Kristo ɔ dloomi nɔ kɛ ba a hiɛ kɛ be nɔ babauu ha nihi fuu.
Bɔ nɛ si gbeemi ɔ gu nɔ kake nɛ pee yayami ɔ nɔ kɛ ba a, pi ja nɛ dloomi ɔ ngɛ: ejakaa kojomi ɔ je nɔ kake mi nɛ e plɛ fɔ bumi, se dloomi nɔke nɔ ɔ je si gbeemihi fuu a mi nɛ e plɛ nyɔguɛ yemi.
Ejakaa ke nɔ kake si gbeemi ɔ he je nɛ gbenɔ gu lɛ nɔ kake ɔ nɔ ye tsɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nihi nɛ na dloomi kɛ dami nɔke nɔ nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ ɔ maa gu nɔ kake nɛ ji Yesu Kristo ɔ nɔ maa ye tsɛ ngɛ wami mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a gu nɔ kake si gbeemi nɔ bu nimli tsuo fɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ a gu nɔ kake dami nɔ wo nimli kulaa wami nguɔ.
Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ a gu nɔmlɔ kake tue gbomi ɔ nɔ ha nihi fuu plɛ yayami peeli ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ a maa gu nɔ kake ɔ tue bumi ɔ nɔ a ma ha, nihi fuu hu ma plɛ dali.
Se Mlaa a ba hɔ kpɛ konɛ si gbeemi ɔ nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ.
Se he nɛ yayami hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ Mawu dloomi ɔ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ babauu ngɛ; konɛ bɔ nɛ yayami ɔ ye tsɛ ngɛ gbenɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu dloomi ɔ maa gu dami nɔ kɛ ye tsɛ hulɔ kɛ maa ya neneene wami mi ngɛ Yesu Kristo wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he.
Kristo mi wami kɛ yayami mi gbenɔ Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Waa hi yayami ɔ mi konɛ Mawu dloomi nɛ hiɛ lo?
Dɛbi!
Wɔ nɛ wa gbo ngɔ ha yayami ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa hɛ maa tsa nɔ hi ngmengmle ngɛ e mi?
Aloo nyɛ li kaa wa ti nihi abɔ nɛ a baptisi ngɔ wo Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, e gbenɔ ɔ mi a baptisi wɔ ngɔ wo lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ baptisimi nɛ a baptisi wɔ ngɔ wo e gbenɔ ɔ mi ɔ pu waa kɛ lɛ tsuo, konɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a tle Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyɛmi nya a, ja nɔuu kɛ wɔ hu waa nyɛɛ ngɛ wami nɛ plɛ ehe mi.
Ejakaa ke waa kɛ lɛ pee kake ngɛ e gbenɔ nɛ e gbo ɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ lɛ maa pee kake ngɛ e si temi ɔ mi hulɔ.
Wa le enɛ ɔ kaa a sɛu wa nɔmlɔ tso momo ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he konɛ yayami nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hɛ mi nɛ kpata nɛ wa ko sɔmɔ yayami hu.
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, e kɛ yayami gba mi.
Ke waa kɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa waa kɛ lɛ ma na wami hulɔ, ejakaa wa le kaa nɛ a tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje nɛ ɔ ɔ, e be gboe hu; gbenɔ be e nɔ nyɔmtsɛ yee hu.
Ejakaa nɛ e gbo ɔ, yayami e gbo ha si kake pɛ; se nɛ e hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, Mawu e hɛ ngɛ ha.
Ja nyɛ hu nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ a gbo ha yayami nɛ a hɛ ngɛ kɛ ha Mawu ngɛ Yesu Kristo wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ha yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ma gbo ɔ nɔ tsɛ nɛ nyɛ bu lɛ tue ngɛ e kɔnɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ ha yayami kaa ni yayami ɔmɛ a tahwumi nihi, se mohu nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ tsɛ kɛ je gbeje, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ nɛ pee dami tahwumi nihi ngɔ ha Mawu.
Ejakaa yayami be nyɛ nɔ he wami nae, ejakaa pi mlaa sisi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ, se mohu dloomi sisi nyɛ ngɛ.
Dami mi nyɔguɛhi Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ?
Waa pee yayami akɛnɛ wa be Mlaa sisi se dloomi mohu sisi wa ngɛ ɔ lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ he ngɔ peɔ nyɔguɛhi haa nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e nyɔguɛhi ji nyɛ nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ lo?
— yayami nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi ɔ jio, loo tuebumi nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa dami mi ɔ jio.
Se sina ha Mawu kaa jinɛ sa a yayami nyɔguɛhi ji nyɛ, se jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛ je nyɛ tsui tsuo mi kɛ bu kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ wo mi nɛ ɔ tue.
A kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi nɛ nyɛ ye nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ plɛ dami nyɔguɛhi.
Bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tuɔ munyu i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ nɛ, ngɛ nyɛ he lo gbedemi ɔ he.
Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pee hiemi nihi kɛ mlaa tɔmi nyɔguɛhi kɛ sɛ mlaa tɔmi mi ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ jeha nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pee dami nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha klɔuklɔu peemi.
Be mi nɛ nyɛ ji yayami nyɔguɛhi ɔ, nyɛ ye nyɛ he kɛ je dami ɔ dɛ mi.
Lɛɛ mɛni yiblii nyɛ wo ngɛ lɛ be ɔ mi?
Yiblii nɛ zo gbe nyɛ ngɛ he jeha nɛ; ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji gbenɔ.
Se jeha nɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi nɛ nyɛ plɛ Mawu nyɔguɛhi nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ wo yiblii ha klɔuklɔu peemi nɛ we nyagbe ji neneene wami ɔ. Ejakaa yayami dɛ mi hiɔwe ɔ gbenɔ ʼi; se Mawu dloomi nike ni ɔ neneene wami ʼi ngɛ Kristo Yesu wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Gbasihimi nɔhyɛmi nɔ Mamimɛ, tse nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ le Mlaa a le kaa Mlaa a yeɔ nɔmlɔ nɔ ngɛ e wami be ɔ kulaa mi lo?
Ejakaa yo nɛ ngɛ huno ɔ, mlaa fi lɛ ngɔ mɛtɛ e huno nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ he; se ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, e kɛ e huno ɔ mlaa a be sane ko hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ, ke e huno ɔ ngɛ je mi nɛ e ya gba nɔ kpa a, a tsɛɛ lɛ yo gba puɛlɔ.
Se ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, lɛɛ e ye e he kɛ je mlaa a mi, nɛ ke e ya gba nyumu kpa a, e pi yo gba puɛlɔ hu.
Mamimɛ, ja nɔuu nyɛ hu a kɛ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbe nyɛ ngɔ ha Mlaa a, konɛ nyɛ plɛ nɔ kpa na ji nɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ nihi, konɛ waa wo yiblii ha Mawu.
Ejakaa bene wa ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, yayamihi a he hɛdɔ ɔmɛ guu mlaa a nɔ tsuɔ ni ngɛ wa he ni ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ waa kɛ wo yiblii ha gbenɔ.
Se jeha nɛ waa kɛ Mlaa a be sane ko hu, ejakaa wa gbo ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ hɛɛ wami ɔ, bene pee nɛ wa sɔmɔ ngɛ mumi nɛ plɛ ehe ɔ mi, se pi ngɛ Mlaa momo ɔ nya.
Mlaa kɛ yayami Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Anɛ Mlaa a yayami ʼi lo?
Dɛbi!
Se mohu ke pi Mlaa a he jinɛ i li yayami.
Ejakaa jinɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ ji hɛ̃kɔ, ke pi Mlaa a nɛ de ke: “O hɛ ko kɔ nihi a nɔ.” Se kita a nɔ yayami gu kɛ na he blɔ nɛ e kɛ tsɛ akɔnɔ nihi tsuo wo ye mi; ejakaa ke Mlaa be ɔ, yayami hu gbo.
I hi si hyɛ nɛ i be mlaa, se bene kita a ba a, yayami ɔ hɛ tsɛ ekohu.
Se imi lɛɛ i gbo, nɛ i na kaa kita a nɛ a kɛ ha mi ngɛ wami he ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ tsɛ gbenɔ ngɔ ha mi.
Ejakaa yayami gu kita a nɔ na he blɔ nɛ e kɛ sisi mi nɛ e kɛ lɔ ɔ nɔuu gbe mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mlaa a ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ Kita a hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu nɛ e da nɛ e hi.
Lɛɛ nɔ́ kpakpa a plɛ gbenɔ ha mi lo?
Dɛbi!
Se mohu bene pee nɛ yayami ɔ nɛ je si kaa yayami he ɔ, e kɛ nɔ́ kpakpa a nɔuu tsɛ gbenɔ ngɔ ha mi, konɛ yayami ɔ nɛ gu kita a nɔ nɛ e plɛ yayami nɛ be nɔ.
Nɔmlɔ mi suhi enyɔ Wa le kaa Mlaa a mumi mi nɔ́ ʼi; se imi lɛɛ he lo nɔmlɔ ji mi, nɛ a jua mi ngɔ ha yayami.
Nɔ nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ i li; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ nɛ i peɔ, se nɔ́ nɛ i nyɛɛ mohu ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ i peɔ.
Se ke nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ nɔuu i peɔ ɔ, i kplɛɔ kaa Mlaa a hi.
Lɛɛ jeha nɛ pi imi nɛ i tsuɔ kɔlɔ ɔ hu, se mohu yayami nɛ hii ye mi ɔ lɛ tsuɔ.
Ejakaa i le kaa ye mi, lɔ ɔ ji ye he lo ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ ko kpakpa ko be lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa suɔmi ɔ i ngɛ eko mohu, se kpakpa peemi lɛ bɔ mi.
Ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ i suɔ ɔ, i pee we, se nɔ́ yayami nɛ i sume ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ mohu i peɔ.
Se ke nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ kɛ̃ i peɔ ɔ, lɛɛ tsa pi imi nɛ i peɔ kɔlɔ ɔ hu, se mohu yayami nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ lɛ peɔ.
Lɛɛ i naa mlaa nɛ ɔ kaa imi nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, yayami mohu mɛtɛ ye he.
Ejakaa ye mi blɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ bua jɔɔ ngɛ Mawu Mlaa a he.
Se i naa mlaa muno ko ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso he ni ɔmɛ a mi nɛ kɛ ye juɛmi mlaa a hwuɔ ta, nɛ e ngɔɔ mi nyɔguɛ ngɔ haa yayami mlaa a nɛ ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso he ni ɔmɛ a mi ɔ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ni ngɛ mɔbɔ ji mi; mɛnɔ lɛ ma je mi kɛ maa je kikɛmɛ a gbenɔ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ɔ dɛ mi?
Sina ha Mawu kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ.
Jeha nɛ imi nɔuu i kɛ ye juɛmi sɔmɔɔ Mawu mlaa a lɛɛ, se i kɛ ye he lo sɔmɔɔ yayami mlaa.
Mumi mi wami Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ fɔ ko fɔ ko be nɛ a kɛ maa bu nihi nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ. Ejakaa mlaa nɛ ji wami kɛ mumi mlaa a nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ kpɔ mi ngɛ yayami kɛ gbenɔ mlaa a dɛ mi.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee ngɛ gbedemi nɛ he lo ɔ gbede he je ɔ, Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bi ɔ ngɛ su nɛ ngɛ kaa yayami he lo su mi, nɛ ngɛ yayami he hulɔ, konɛ e bu yayami ɔ fɔ ngɛ he lo ɔ mi, konɛ a gbe mlaa a dami ɔ nya ngɛ wa mi, wɔ nihi nɛ wa nyɛɛ we ngɛ he lo nya, se mohu mumi nya wa nyɛɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ he lo nya a, he lo nihi a he a susuu, se nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ mumi nya a susuu mumi mi nihi a he.
Ejakaa he lo juɛmi ɔ lɛɛ gbenɔ ʼi, se mumi juɛmi ɔ, wami kɛ he jɔmi ʼi.
Ejakaa he lo juɛmi ɔ Mawu nyɛmi ʼi, ejakaa e bɛ e he si ha we Mawu mlaa a, nɛ pohu e be nyɛe tete.
Nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ he lo mi ɔ be nyɛe nɛ a sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Se ke e ngɛ mi kaa Mawu Mumi hii nyɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ be he lo ɔ sisi, se mohu mumi ɔ sisi nyɛ ngɛ.
Ke nɔ ko be Kristo Mumi ɔ, lɛɛ tsa pi Kristo nɔ́ ji lɛ.
Se ke Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbo ngɛ yayami he lɛɛ, se mumi ɔ ji wami ngɛ dami he.
Se ke nɔ nɛ tle Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ɔ Mumi ɔ hii nyɛ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje ɔ ma ha nyɛ nɔmlɔ tsohi nɛ ma gbo ɔ hu yi ma na wami ngɛ e Mumi nɛ hii nyɛ mi ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, hiɔtsɛmɛ ji wɔ, se pi he lo hiɔ nɛ wa hɛɛ nɛ wa maa hi si ngɛ he lo nya.
Ejakaa ke he lo nya nyɛ hii si ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma gbo.
Se ke nyɛɛ kɛ Mumi ɔ gbee he lo ɔ ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ yi ma na wa.
Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ Mawu Mumi ɔ kpakaa mɛ ɔ, mɛ ji Mawu bimɛ.
Ejakaa pi nyɔguɛ yemi mumi nɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛ ma pa ye gbeye, se mohu nyɛ na bimɛ a plɛmi mumi, nɔ́ mi nɛ wa kpaa ngmlaa ngɛ ke: “Abba,” Tsaatsɛ!
ɔ. Mawu Mumi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ wa mumi ɔ yeɔ odase kaa Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ.
Nɛ ke bimɛ ji wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ we ni yeli hu ji wɔ, Mawu we ni yeli kɛ Kristo nyɛmimɛ we ni yeli, ke e ngɛ mi kaa waa kɛ lɛ naa amanehlu ɔ, konɛ a wo waa kɛ lɛ hɛ mi nyami hulɔ.
Hwɔɔ se nyami Ejakaa i susuu kaa mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ nyami nɛ hwɔɔ se a ma je kpo ha wɔ ɔ sɔɛ.
Ejakaa adebɔ ni ɔmɛ a blɔ hyemi kpikpimaa a ngɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ wa kpo jemi ɔ mlɛe.
Ejakaa a ngɔ adebɔ ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo yakayaka ni a sisi, pi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya, se mohu ngɛ nɔ nɛ ba mɛ si ɔ he, ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi, ejakaa adebɔ ni ɔmɛ hu maa ye a he kɛ maa je puemi nyɔguɛ yemi ɔ mi kɛ maa ya Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ a nyami he yemi ɔ mi.
Ejakaa wa le kaa adebɔ ni ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wɔ ngɛ kɛmɛe nɛ a kɛ wɔ ngɛ kɔɔe kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ.
Nɛ tsa pi mɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu wɔ nitsɛmɛ tete, wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa na Mumi ɔ kekle yiblii ɔmɛ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa laa zanue ngɛ wa mi, nɛ wa hyɛɛ bimɛ a plɛmi nɛ ji wa nɔmlɔ tso kpɔmi ɔ blɔ.
Ejakaa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nya a he wa yi wami ngɛ.
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ a naa a, e pi hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi.
Ejakaa mɛnɔ hɛ hii nɔ́ nɛ a naa a nɔ?
Se ke nɔ́ nɛ wa nɛ́ ɔ nɔ wa hɛ ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ wa kɛ tsui si tomi hyɛɛ lɛ blɔ.
Ja nɔuu Mumi ɔ hu yeɔ buaa wa gbedemi ɔ; ejakaa bɔ nɛ sa kaa wa ko sɔle kɛ bi nɔ nɛ da a, wa li; se Mumi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ kɔmɔ yemi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale daa mi haa wɔ.
Se Mawu nɛ hlaa tsuihi a mi ɔ le nɔ́ nɛ ji Mumi ɔ juɛmi ɔ, ejakaa e daa mi haa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.
