Se wa le kaa, nihi tsuo mi ɔ, Mawu yeɔ buaa nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ konɛ e hi ha mɛ, mɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a tsɛ mɛ ngɛ e yi mi tomi nya a. Ejakaa nihi nɛ e le mɛ momo ɔ, mɛ e je ngɔ to konɛ a subai nɛ hi kaa e bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, konɛ Bi ɔ e pee nyɛmimɛ fuu a kpɛti bi nɔkɔtɔma.
Nihi nɛ e je ngɔ to ɔ, mɛ nɔuu e tsɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ e tsɛ ɔ, mɛ nɔuu nguɔ e wo; nɛ nihi nɛ e wo nguɔ ɔ, mɛ nɔuu a hɛ mi nyami e wo.
Mawu suɔmi ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔ?
Ke Mawu ngɛ wa se ɔ, mɛnɔ maa te si ngɔ wo wɔ?
Mawu nɛ kamaa we wɔ elɛ nitsɛ e Bi ɔ, se mohu e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ngɛ wɔ tsuo wa nane mi ɔ, anɛ e be nihi tsuo kulaa ngɔe ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ke wɔ lo?
Mɛnɔ maa po nihi nɛ Mawu hla amɛ a nya?
Mawu ji nɔ nɛ woɔ nguɔ.
Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ buu fɔ ɔ?
Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ e gbo, se nɔ́ nɛ pe kɔlɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si hulɔ, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e pa daa mi haa wɔ.
Mɛnɔ ma gba waa kɛ Kristo suɔmi ɔ mi?
Amanehlu loo tsui pomi loo yi wami loo hwɔ loo he gu nyɛɛmi loo he gbeye womi loo klaate?
Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ke: “O he ɔ, a gbee wɔ hluu je nami kɛ ya siɔ du bubui, A buu wɔ kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe mɛ.” Se kɛ̃ ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ, wa guu nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ nɔ yeɔ kunimi babauu.
Ejakaa i ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa gbenɔ jio, wami jio, hiɔwe bɔfohi jio, nɔ yeli jio, he wamihi jio, nihi nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔmɛ jio, nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ jio, hiɔwe jio, sisi jio, aloo nihi nɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ a mi nɔ́ kpa ko jio, a be nyɛe ma gba waa kɛ Mawu suɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, mi ɔ mi.
Mawu hla Israel Anɔkuale i ngɛ dee ngɛ Kristo mi, i yi lakpa, nɛ ye he ni lemi hu yeɔ mi odase ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi, kaa i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee babauu, nɛ ye tsui yeɔ daa.
Ejakaa i na nɛ jinɛ a je mi ngɛ Kristo he kaa musutsɛ ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ ji ye wekuli ngɛ he lo blɔfami ɔmɛ a nane mi, nihi nɛ ji Israelbi nɛ a nɔ ji bimɛ a plɛmi ɔ kɛ nyami ɔ kɛ somi ɔ, kɛ mlaa hami kɛ jami ɔ kɛ si womi ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ji tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nihi a mi hu nɛ Kristo tete je ngɛ he lo blɔfami ɔ, lɛ nɛ ji Ope ngɛ nihi kulaa nɔ, Mawu nɛ a gbaa kɛ yaa neneene ɔ. Amen.
Se pi kaa Mawu munyu ɔ pee yaka.
Ejakaa tsa pi nihi nɛ je Israel mi ɔ tsuo ji Israel; nɛ jeha nɛ hu, pi kaa nɛ Abraham nina ji mɛ ɔ he je ɔ, bimɛ ji mɛ tsuo kulaa, se mohu: “Nihi nɛ je Isak mi ɔ, a ma tsɛ mɛ o nina.” Lɔ ɔ ji kaa, tsa pi he lo nya bimɛ ɔmɛ ji Mawu bimɛ, se si womi bimɛ ɔmɛ mohu a buu kaa nina.
Ejakaa si womi munyu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Hiɛ ɔ jeha nya kpemi ɔ ma ba, nɛ Sara ma na bi nyumu.” Se pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu wa tsɛ Isak kake ɔ nɔuu nɛ Rebeka kɛ na muklii.
Se benɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ bimɛ, nɛ jeha nɛ a tsu we nɔ kpakpa loo nɔ yaya ko ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ Mawu yi mi nɛ e to ngɛ e hlami nya a nɛ ma si, nɛ e ko je ni tsumihi a mi, se mohu e je nɔ nɛ tsɛɛ nɔ ɔ, Mawu de lɛ ke: “Nɔkɔtɔma a ma sɔmɔ jokuɛ ɔ.” Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Yakob ɔ, i suɔ lɛ, se Esau ɔ, i nyɛ lɛ” ɔ. Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Anɛ Mawu yeɔ sane ko nɛ dɛ lo?
Dɛbi!
Ejakaa Mawu de Mose ke: “Nɔ nɛ i naa lɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu mɔbɔ ma na, nɛ nɔ nɛ ye mi mi saa mi haa lɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu ye mi mi maa sa mi ha.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ pi nɔmlɔ suɔmi nya aloo e mɔdebɔmi nya, se mohu Mawu nɛ naa mɔbɔ ɔ sane ʼi.
Ejakaa ngami ɔ de Farao ke: “Enɛ ɔ nɔuu he je nɛ i tle mo si konɛ ma je ye he wami kpo kɛ gu o nɔ, konɛ a wo ye biɛ ta ngɛ zugba a kulaa nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, nɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, e naa lɛ mɔbɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ e suɔ hu ɔ, e wluaa e tsui.
Mawu mimifumi kɛ e mɔbɔnami Se jeha nɛ o ma bi mi ke: “Mɛni he je Mawu piaa nɔ mɔ?” Ejakaa mɛnɔ ma nyɛ e yi mi tomi ɔ nya maa ku?
Se mɛnɔ ji mo, mo nɔmlɔ, nɛ o kɛ Mawu tsuaa nuku?
Anɛ buɛ ɔ ma de nɔ nɛ puɛ lɛ ɔ ke: “Mɛni he je o puɛ mi kikɛ” ɔ lo?
Aloo buɛpuɛlɔ ɔ be he wami ngɛ zu ɔ nɔ, kaa e kɛ zu kake nɛ a pɔtɔ ɔ nɔuu eko maa puɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, nɛ e kɛ eko hu maa puɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ hɛ mi be nyami lo?
Se ke Mawu suɔ kaa e je e mi mi fumi kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nɛ e ha a le e he wami ɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, e toɔ e tsui si babauu kɛ hɛɛ mi mi la womi nihi nɛ sa hɛ mi kpatami ɔ, nɛ jeha nɛ hu ke e haa a leɔ e hɛ mi nyami hiɛmi ɔ hu ngɛ e mɔbɔ nami nihi nɛ e dla ngɔ to ha hɛ mi nyami ɔ, mɛni o ma de?
Se jã e tsɛ wɔ hulɔ, pi ninɛmɛ nɛ je Yudafo ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ kɛkɛ, se nihi nɛ je majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ hulɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ e de ngɛ Hosea womi ɔ mi ke: “Ma tsɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ pi ye nihi ɔ ke ye nihi, Nɛ ma nɛ a sume lɛ ɔ ke ma nɛ a suɔ.
Nɛ e maa ba mi kaa, He nɛ a de mɛ ngɛ ke: ‘Pi ye ma ji nyɛ’ ɔ, Lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma tsɛ mɛ Mawu hɛkalɔ ɔ bimɛ ngɛ.” Se Yesaia kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Israel he ke: “Ke Israelbi ɔmɛ a yibɔ ngɛ kaa wo nya zia a, nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ a yi wami a ma he.
Ejakaa sane kpiti Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ye ngɛ zugba a nɔ.” Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yesaia de ngɔ to momo ɔ ke: “E ji e ya pee kaa tahi a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ́ nina ko ngɔ hi wɔ jinɛ, wa ngɛ kaa Sodoma, nɛ wa plɛ kaa Gomora pɛ.” Israel kɛ Sane Kpakpa a Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Lɔ ɔ ji majeli a bimɛ nɛ di dami se ɔ na dami nɛ ji dami nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ; se Israel mohu nɛ dii dami mlaa a se ɔ, e nine sui dami mlaa a nɔ.
Mɛni he je?
Ejakaa a gui hemi kɛ yemi nɔ kɛ hla we, se mohu kaa nihi nɛ guu ni tsumihi a nɔ kɛ hlaa.
Ejakaa a tɛ tɛmi tɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Oʼɛ, i kɛ tɛ kɛ nane kpatami tɛ sa ko Ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion, Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ, Zo be lɛ gbee.”
Mamimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ ye tsui hlaa kɛ pɛɛ nɛ i kpaa Mawu haa Israel ji kaa a he a yi wami.
Ejakaa i ngɛ he odase yee kaa a hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ Mawu he mohu, se pi ngɛ ni lemi nya.
Ejakaa a li Mawu dami ɔ, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a dami mohu a hlaa nɛ a ngɔ ma si he je ɔ, a bɛ́ a he si hi Mawu dami ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo ji Mlaa a nyagbe, nɛ lɛ ji dami kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ. Yiwamihemi ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ Ejakaa Mose ngma ngɛ dami nɛ je Mlaa mi ɔ he ke: “Nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ yi ma na wa ngɛ mi.” Se bɔ nɛ dami nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ deɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ko de ngɛ o tsui mi ke: ‘Mɛnɔ maa kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe?’ (lɔ ɔ ji, konɛ e ya ngɔ Kristo kɛ kple si); aloo: ‘Mɛnɔ ma kple si kɛ ya sisi muɔ nɛ ɔ mi?’ ” (lɔ ɔ ji, konɛ e ya ngɔ Kristo kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba).
Se mohu kɛ e deɔ kɛɛ?
Mawu munyu ɔ na mo ngɛ o nya mi kɛ o tsui mi tsuo; (kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu ji hemi kɛ yemi munyu nɛ wa fiɛɛ ɔ nɛ).
Ke o kɛ o nya jaje ke Yesu ji Nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ o he ye ngɛ o tsui mi kaa Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a ma he o yi wami.
Ejakaa tsui a kɛ heɔ yeɔ kɛ yaa dami mi, nɛ nya a kɛ jajeɔ kɛ yaa yi wami hemi mi.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee.” Ejakaa slɔɔto ko be Yuda no kɛ Hela no kpɛti; ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ kake mɛ kulaa a ngɛ, nɛ niatsɛ hu ji lɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɛ lɛ ɔ. Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ ɔ, a ma he e yi wami.
Se kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ nɔ nɛ a he we lɛ yi ɔ?
Nɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma he nɔ nɛ a nui e he sane ɔ ngɔ ye?
Nɛ jeha nɛ hu, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a maa nu ke fiɛlɔ ko be ɔ?
Nɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a maa fiɛ ke a tsɔ we mɛ ɔ?
Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa fiɛli nɛ fiɛɛ ni kpakpa amɛ a nanehi ngɛ fɛu ha!” Se kɛ̃ ɔ, pi nihi tsuo nɛ bu sane kpakpa a tue.
Ejakaa Yesaia deɔ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛnɔ he wa sane ɔ ye?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, sane tue bumi mi e jee, nɛ sane tue bumi hu guu Mawu munyu ɔ nɔ kɛ baa.
Se i ngɛ bie ke: “Anɛ numi nɛ a nui lo?” Niinɛ kaa a gbi jije kɛ ho zugba mluku ɔ tsuo nɔ ya, nɛ a munyu ɔ su je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ.
I ngɛ bie ekohu ke: “Anɛ Israel li lo?” Mose sɛ hlami de ke: “Ma ha nyɛ maa je ma nɛ pi ma ko he hunga; Nɛ i kɛ ma ko nɛ li nɔ́ ko maa wo nyɛ mi mi la.” Nɛ Yesaia kɛ kã de ke: “I ha nihi nɛ hla we mi ɔ na mi, Nɛ i je ye he kpo tsɔɔ nihi nɛ bi we ye si ɔ.” Se Israel ɔ, e de mɛ ke: “Daa je nami i tsɛɛ ye nine mi haa Ma tue gboli kɛ sane nya jeli.”
Mawu mɔbɔnami kɛ ha Israel Jeha nɛ i ngɛ bie ke: Anɛ Mawu kua e ma a lo?
Dɛbi!
Ejakaa imi hu Israel no ji mi, nɛ i je Abraham nina kɛ Benyamin weku ɔ mi.
Mawu kua we e ma nɛ e le to momo ɔ. Aloo nyɛ li nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ngɛ Elia yi nɔ ɔ, benɛ e da Mawu hɛ mi nɛ e po Israel nya ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ, o gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, a gbe mɛ, nɛ o bɔ sami latɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a hule mɛ pue si, nɛ e piɛ ye nɔ kaketoo, nɛ a ngɛ mi hlae nɛ a gbe.” Se mɛni heto Mawu ha lɛ?
“I si nyumuhi aakpe kpaago ngɔ ha ye he nɛ na we nɛ a kɛ a nakutsohi nɛ kpla si ngɔ ha Baal.” Jã kɛ̃ mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi hu e piɛ ni komɛ nɛ a hla mɛ ngɛ dloomi nya.
Se ke dloomi nya ʼi ɔ, lɛɛ pi ngɛ ni tsumihi a nya hu; ejakaa lɔ ɔ lɛɛ dloomi ɔ pi dloomi hu.
Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ?
Nɔ́ nɛ Israel ngɛ hlae ɔ, e nine sui nɔ; se ninɛmɛ nɛ a hla a, a nine su nɔ; ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a wlua a tsui, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Mawu ngɔ kɔnuɛ demi mumi ko ngɔ fɔ a nɔ, hɛngmɛhi nɛ a kɛ hyɛ we nɔ, kɛ tuehi nɛ a kɛ nui nɔ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ.” Nɛ David de ke: “Ha a ni yemi okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ pee lohwe pɛlitsɛ dumi kpa, Kɛ klama kɛ temi nɔ́ kɛ tue gblami ha mɛ.
Ha a hɛ mi nɛ wo diblii, nɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́, Nɛ daa nɛ ɔ o ha a dɔ kɔmɔɔ.” Jeha nɛ i ngɛ bie ke: “Blɔɔ pe a tɛ si nɛ a nɔ si butuu lo?” Dɛbi!
Se mohu a gu a sigbeemi ɔ nɔ kɛ he maje li ɔmɛ a yi wami, konɛ e ha a je hunga.
Se ke a si gbeemi ɔ plɛ je ɔ ni nami, nɛ a nɔ gbɔmi ɔ hu plɛ majeli ɔmɛ a ni nami ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ a gbaami ɔ maa hiɛ ha kɛɛ, ke Israel tsuo tsake ɔ?
Majeli ɔmɛ a yiwamihemi Se nyɛ majeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Be abɔ nɛ imi ji maje li ɔmɛ a bɔfo nɛ ɔ ɔ, ma wo ye sɔmɔmi ɔ hɛ mi nyami, kaa eko ɔ, i kɛ ma ha ye wekuli ɔmɛ maa je hunga, nɛ ma he a ti ni komɛ a yi wami lo.
Ejakaa ke a kuami ɔ ji je ɔ kɛ Mawu kpɛti kpatami ɔ, lɛɛ a yi wami hemi ɔ anɛ pi si temi kɛ gbeje jemi ʼi lo?
Ke ma nɛ a sa a ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, lɛɛ jã ma mluku ɔ kulaa hu ngɛ; nɛ ke tso sipoku ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, lɛɛ jã kɔni ɔmɛ hu ngɛ.
Ke a po tso kɔni ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ a ngɔ mo nɛ o ji nga mi nu tso ɔ ngɔ ta he, nɛ o na nu tso ɔ poku ɔ kɛ e mi nyu ɔ eko ɔ, koo fia ngɛ kɔni ɔmɛ a nɔ; ke o fia ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, oʼɛ, tsa pi mo nɛ o hɛɛ poku ɔ, se poku ɔ mohu lɛ hɛɛ mo.
Jeha nɛ eko ɔ, o ma de ke: Pe a po kɔni ɔmɛ, benɛ pee nɛ a ngɔ mi ngɔ ta tso ɔ he.
Saminya; hemi nɛ a he we yi he je nɛ a po mɛ; nɛ moo lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi o kɛ daa si nɛ ɔ nɛ.
O yi ko fu, se mohu yee o he gbeye.
Ejakaa, ke Mawu baa we tso ɔ nitsɛ kɔni ɔmɛ a yi ɔ, eko ɔ, mo hu e be o yi baae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hyɛ Mawu mi mi himi kɛ e sane wami ɔ tsuo.
E sane wa ngɛ nihi nɛ gbee si ɔmɛ a nɔ, se moo lɛɛ e mi mi hi ngɛ o nɔ, ke o hi e mi mi himi ɔ mi ɔ; ke pi ja a, a maa po mo ngɔ sake ngɔ fɔ he.
Nɛ mɛ hu, ke a ngmɛɛ hemi nɛ a he we yi ɔ he ɔ, a maa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ta he; ejakaa Mawu ma nyɛ maa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ta he.
Nɛ ke moo lɛɛ pe a po mo ngɛ tso nɛ ji nga mi nu tso ngɛ bɔ su nya a he, nɛ a ngɔ mo ngɔ ta nu tso kpakpa a he, nɔ́ ko nɛ a pɔɛ peemi ɔ, nihi nɛ a ji tso ɔ nitsɛ kɔni ɔmɛ ɔ, a nɛ a be mɛ ngɔe ngɔ ta mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nu tso ɔ he hluu lo?
Mawu mɔbɔnami kɛ ha nimli I sume kaa ma laa nyɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ nɔ, mamimɛ, konɛ nyɛ ko bu nyɛ he ni leli, ke: Pe a wlua Israel tsui fa kɛ fa kɛ yaa si be nɛ majemajeli ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ɔ maa su, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko a ma he Israel tsuo yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Jelɔ ɔ maa je Zion kɛ maa ba, Nɛ e ma ba je Yakob he nɔ yayami peemi ɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, Nɛ enɛ ɔ ji i kɛ mɛ wa kpɛti somi ɔ, Kaa ma je a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ho.” Ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a blɔfami ɔ, he nyɛli ji mɛ ngɛ nyɛ he.
Se ngɛ hlami ɔ blɔfami ɔ, a suɔ mɛ ngɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Ejakaa Mawu pia we e he ngɛ e dloomi ni ɔmɛ kɛ e tsɛmi ɔ he.
Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ sa a nyɛ hu nyɛ bui Mawu tue, se jeha nɛ a na nyɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ a tuegbenɔ ɔ he ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ̃ mɛ hu a tue gbo, konɛ bɔ nɛ a na nyɛ mɔbɔ ɔ mɛ hu a na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Ejakaa Mawu nga nihi kulaa a yi ngɔ wo tuegbenɔ mi, benɛ pee nɛ e na mɛ kulaa mɔbɔ.
Mawu yijemi Oo, bɔ nɛ Mawu Ni hiɛhiɛ kɛ ga kɛ ni lemi mi kuɔ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
E kojomi ɔmɛ ɔ, a nyɛ we sisi nami, nɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ bu, a nyɛ we hiɔmi!
“Ejakaa mɛnɔ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi ɔ, Aloo mɛnɔ wo lɛ ga hyɛ?
Aloo mɛnɔ sɛ hlami ha lɛ nɔ́ ko, Nɛ jinɛ a ko to lɛ nane mi?” Ejakaa e dɛ mi nihi tsuo je, nɛ e nɔ a gu kɛ ba, nɛ lɛ nɔuu a ngɛ kɛ ha.
A ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ ya neneene!
Amen.
Wami ngɛ Mawu sɔmɔmi mi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, i kɛ Mawu mɔbɔ nami ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, kaa nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ ngɔ da si kaa bɔ klɔuklɔu nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ he tsɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ nyɛ jami ɔ nɛ pee mumi mi jami.
Nɛ nyɛ je mi bami ko pee kaa je mi bihi a je mi bami, se mohu nyɛ ha Mawu nɛ tsake nyɛ juɛmi, konɛ nyɛ yɔse nihi nɛ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni kpakpahi nɛ sa e hɛ mi saminya nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ.
Se i kɛ dloomi nɛ a kɛ dloo mi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ dee ke e ko bu lɛ nitsɛ e he babauu tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ sa kaa e buu e he, se mohu e susu hɛ si kami susumi, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu kale hemi kɛ yemi kalemi ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ. Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake he ɔ wa ngɛ he nihi fuu, se he ni ɔmɛ tsuo tsu we ni tsumi kake ɔ, ja nɔuu wɔ fuu nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso kake ji wɔ ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, e nyɛmi he nɔ́ ji lɛ.
Nɛ ngɛ dloomi nɛ a ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ nya a, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ dloomi ke ni slɔɔtohi slɔɔtohi: Ke gbami ʼi ɔ, waa gba ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kalemi ɔ nya.
Ke sɔmɔmi ʼi ɔ, waa hɛɛ sɔmɔmi ɔ nɔuu mi; ke ni tsɔɔmi ɔ, wa hɛɛ ni tsɔɔmi ɔ mi; nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi ɔ, e hɛɛ munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ mi; nɔ nɛ dlaa ni ngɔ haa nihi ɔ, e pee kɛ tsui jɔjɔɛ.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔkɔtɔma a, e bɔ mɔde.
Nɔ nɛ naa mɔbɔ ɔ, e pee kɛ tsui mi jɔmi.
Suɔmi ɔ, osato ko hi mi.
Nyɛɛ nyɛ yayami kulaa; nyɛɛ pɛtɛ nɔ kpakpa he.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛ a suɔmi nɛ suɔ nyɛ he; nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ bu nɛ ha e nyɛmi kekle.
Nyɛ mɔde bɔmi ɔ nya ko ba si; nyɛ mumi ɔ he nɛ dɔ la; nyɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nyɛ nya ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi; nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ dengme gbomi mi; nyɛɛ hɛɛ sɔlemi mi daa.
Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kɔmɔ ɔ e pee nyɛ kɔmɔ; nyɛɛ bɔ nibwɔ peemi he mɔde.
Nyɛɛ gbaa nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ, nyɛɛ gbaa nɛ nyɛ ko gbiɛ.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ nɛ nya, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ya foe ɔ nɛ fo.
Nyɛ susu nɔ́ kake; nyɛ ko susu ni nguahi, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ he si bali ɔmɛ nɛ bɔ.
Nyɛ ko bu nyɛ he nileli.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ yayami ngɔ ma nɔ ko nɔ ko yayami nane mi.
Nyɛ susu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ nimli kulaa a hɛ mi ɔ he.
Ke e maa hi ɔ, nyɛ blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nimli tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Suɔli, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he lue, se mohu nyɛɛ ngmɛ mi mi fumi ɔ blɔ; ejakaa a ngma ke: “Ye nɔ ji lue yemi, Imi ma to nane mi, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke hwɔ ngɛ o he nyɛlɔ yee ɔ, ha lɛ ni nɛ e ye.
Ke kuma ngɛ lɛ tɔe ɔ, ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu; ejakaa ke o pee ja a, o ma kpane hã kɛ la nya ngɔ pue e yi kpɛti.
Ko ha yayami nɛ ye o nɔ, se mohu o kɛ kpakpa peemi nɛ ye yayami nɔ.
Blɔnyanitsumi ngɛ ma mi Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba e he si ngɔ ha nɔ yeli nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ. Ejakaa he blɔ ko be nɛ e ji Mawu ngɔ; se he blɔhi nɛ ngɛ ɔ Mawu nɛ to.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tee si siɔ he blɔ ɔ, Mawu blɔ nya tomi ɔ e ngɛ si tee kɛ ngɛ woe ɔ nɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ tee si ja a ma na a kojomi.
Ejakaa nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ɔ tsa pi tsumi kpakpahi a he gbeye nɛ a woɔ, se ni tsumi yayahi mohu.
Anɛ o suɔ nɛ o ko ye nɔ yelɔ ɔ gbeye lo?
Lɛɛ pee nɔ kpakpa, nɛ o ma na yi jemi kɛ maa je e dɛ mi; ejakaa Mawu sɔmɔlɔ ji lɛ ngɛ o he, konɛ e hi ha mo.
Se ke o pee nɔ́ nɛ ji nɔ́ yayami ɔ, yee gbeye!
Ejakaa tsa pi yaka nɛ e hɛɛ hiɔ ɔ; se e ji Mawu sɔmɔlɔ nɛ kɛ mi mi fumi yeɔ lue ngɛ nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni yayahi ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa a baa he si, pi ngɛ Mawu abofu ɔ kɛkɛ he, se mohu ngɛ he ni lemi he hulɔ.
Enɛ he je hulɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuɔ onia a nɛ.
Ejakaa Mawu tsɔli ji mɛ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ bɔ nɛ ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ blɔ nya a, nyɛɛ pee ha lɛ; onia tsumi jio, ma onia womi jio, gbeye yemi jio, nɔ bumi jio.
Nyɛmimɛ a suɔmi Nyɛ ko hɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hiɔ, kaa ja suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sibi ɔ. Ejakaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ye Mlaa a nɔ ta.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ a de ke: “Koo bɔ ajuama!
Koo gbe nɔmlɔ!
Koo ju!
Koo ye lakpa odase!
O hɛ ko kɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ!” ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa, kɛ ekpa komɛ hu nɛ ngɛ ɔ, hɔ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ji: “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he” ɔ mi.
Suɔmi pee we e nyɛmi nɔ yayami ko, lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, suɔmi pɛ ji Mlaa a nɔ yemi.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ wa le be ɔ kaa jeha nɛ ngmlɛfia nɛ waa kɛ maa te si kɛ je mahɛ mi ɔ su; ejakaa jeha nɛ wa yi wami hemi ɔ na wɔ pe kekle benɛ wa he ye ɔ. Nyɔ ɔ be ta, na je nami na wɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha nɛ waa ngmɛɛ diblii mi ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ waa wo la ta hwumi ni ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ba wa je mi saminya bɔ nɛ sa piani, pi ngɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kɛ da demi mi; pi ngɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛ ya homi mi; pi ngɛ pɛ kɛ hunga jemi mi; se mohu nyɛɛ wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo, nɛ nyɛ ko ha he lo ɔ he susumi ɔ ba plɛ he lo ɔ se dimi.
Koo kojo o nyɛmi Nɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ atuu, se nyɛ ko kojo e susumi ɔmɛ.
Nɔ ko ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ e kɛ yeɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ; se nɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, pui kɛkɛ e yeɔ.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ɔ, e ko gbe nɔ nɛ yi ɔ he guɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ yi ɔ, e ko kojo nɔ nɛ yeɔ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ lɛ.
Moo lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kojoɔ nɔ kpa sɔmɔlɔ?
Lɛ nitsɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ e daa si aloo e nɔɔ si haa; se a ma ha e maa da si, ejakaa Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e ma ha e da si.
Nɔ ko buu ligbi ko pe eko, nɛ nɔ ko hu buu ligbi tsuaa ligbi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na lɛ nitsɛ e juɛmi ɔ nɔ he wami.
Nɔ nɛ buu ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ e buu haa; nɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ ni ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ eyeɔ haa, ejakaa e naa Mawu si.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ yi ni ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ e yi ha, nɛ e naa Mawu si hulɔ.
Ejakaa wa ti nɔ ko hɛ ka we hi lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Se ke wa hɛ ngɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wa hɛ ngɛ kɛ ha; nɛ ke wa gbo hu, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wa gbo kɛ ha.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nihi ji wɔ.
Ejakaa enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Kristo gbo nɛ e te si nɛ e hɛ ngɛ benɛ pee nɛ e plɛ ni gbogboehi kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ kulaa a Nyɔmtsɛ.
Se moo lɛɛ mɛni he je nɛ o kojoɔ o nyɛmi?
Aloo mo hu mɛni he je nɛ o gbee o nyɛmi he guɛ?
Ejakaa wɔ tsuo kulaa wa maa da Kristo kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Ejakaa a ngma ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Akɛnɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, Nakutso tsuaa nakutso ma kpla si ha mi; Nɛ lilɛ tsuaa lilɛ maa jaje Mawu ngɔ tsɔɔ.” Lɛɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e he akɔtaa ngɛ ha Mawu.
Ko ha nɛ onyɛmi nɛ gbee si Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ waa kojo wa he hu; se enɛ ɔ mohu nyɛɛ kojo, kaa nɔ ko ko to tɛmi nɔ́ loo kpangmi ko ngɔ ha e nyɛmi.
I le, nɛ jeha nɛ hu i ngɛ nɔ he wami ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu mi, kaa nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛl ɛ nitsɛ e ji he blemi nɔ́ ja nɔ nɛ buu nɔ́ ko kaa he blemi nɔ́ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e plɛɛ he blemi nɔ́ kɛ haa.
Se ke niyeni ko he je nɛ o haa o nyɛmi yeɔ kɔmɔ ɔɔ lɛɛ tsa pi suɔmi nya nɛ o ngɛ o je mi bae ngɛ ɔ hu.
O kɛ o niyeni ɔ ko kpata nɔ nɛ Kristo ba gbo ha lɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a tu nyɛ nɔ kpakpa a he munyu yaya.
Ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, e pi ni yemi kɛ ni numi, se mohu e ji dami kɛ he jɔmi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi bua jɔmi.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Kristo ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Mawu naa e he tsui, nɛ e saa nimli a hɛ mi hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jeha nɛ, nyɛ ha waa di he jɔmi nihi kɛ nihi nɛ waa kɛ ma ha wa nyɛmimɛ a nane maa nu si ɔ mohu a se.
Ko puɛ Mawu ni tsumi ɔ ngɛ niyeni ko he.
Nihi tsuo he tsɔ lɛɛ, se kɛ ɔ, e ji yayami ha nɔ nɛ yeɔ kɛ toɔ kpangmi ɔ. E hi kaa o yi lo nɛ jeha nɛ hu o nui wai loo nɔ́ ko nɛ maa to o nyɛmi kpangmi loo nɛ e ma ha e nane ma kpata aloo nɛ e ma ha e kɔni mi maa jɔ.
Moo lɛɛ o ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi.
Kɛ to ha mo nitsɛ o he ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ kojo we lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e buu kaa e hi ɔ mi ɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ yi mi tɛ̃ lɛ ɔ, ke e ye ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ, mɛni he je ɔ, e ji hemi kɛ yemi mi; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ji hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, yayami ʼi.
Pee ha ni kpahi Wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa ngɛ he wami ɔ, e sa kaa wa kpeɔ ɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ a be he wami ɔ kɛ a gbɔjɔmi ɔmɛ, nɛ wa ko susu wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he.
Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sa e nyɛmi hɛ mi, konɛ e hi ha lɛ nɛ e nane nɛ nu si.
Ejakaa Kristo hu susu we lɛ nitsɛ e he; se mohu kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a: “Ninɛmɛ nɛ bɔ mo ahlua a, a hlua bɔmi ɔ ba nɔ ye nɔ.” Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ a ngma ngɔ to momo ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he ni tsɔɔmi he a ngma ngɔ to ngɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ waa kɛ tsui si tomi kɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ na hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi.
Se tsui si tomi kɛ bua jɔmi Mawu ɔ, e ha nɛ nyɛ na juɛmi kake ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa Kristo Yesu; konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kake kɛ nya kake nɛ wo Mawu kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Sane Kpakpa nɛ a kɛ ha majeli ɔmɛ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo he nyɛ kɛ ba Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi ɔ.
Se i ngɛ dee ke Yesu Kristo plɛ sɔmɔlɔ kɛ ha Yudafo ɔmɛ ngɛ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ he, konɛ e kɛ ma si nɛ a wo tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ a nɔ mi, konɛ majeli ɔmɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ mɔbɔ nami he, kaa bɔ nɛ sa ngma a ke: “Enɛ ɔ he ɔ ma je o yi ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti, Nɛ ma wo o biɛ ta kɛ la.” Nɛ e pa de ke: “Nyɛ majeli, nyɛɛ kɛ e ma a nɛ nya!” Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu: “Nyɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi, nyɛ majeli kulaa, Nɛ nyɛ je e yi wawɛɛ, nyɛ mahi kulaa!” Nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ Yesaia de ke: “Isai sipoku ɔ maa ba, Nɔ nɛ maa te si konɛ e baye majeli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ; Lɛ e nɔ majeli ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ.” Jeha nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi Mawu ɔ nɛ ngɔ bua jɔmi kɛ he jɔmi tsuo ngɔ wo nyɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, konɛ nyɛ na hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ be nɔ ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu he wami mi.
Nɔ he je nɛ Paulo ngma womi kɛ kã Se mamimɛ, imi nitsɛ hu i ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ ngɛ nyɛ he kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ tete nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ mi mi himi, nɛ ni lemi kulaa hyi nyɛ tɔ, nɛ nyɛ nyɛɔ tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ he hulɔ.
Se i kɛ kã fuu ngma munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ mane nyɛ, konɛ ma kɛ kai nyɛ ngɛ dloomi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ɔ he, konɛ ma plɛ Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ ha majeli ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsu Mawu Sane Kpakpa a he osɔfo ni tsumi ɔ, konɛ majeli ɔmɛ nɛ plɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi saminya nɛ a tsukɔ he ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ i ngɛ fiami nihi ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ngɛ Mawu blɔfami ni ɔmɛ a mi.
Ejakaa i be kae kaa ma de nɔ́ ko kaa ja nɔ́ nɛ Kristo gu ye nɔ tsu ngɔ ha majeli ɔmɛ a tue bumi, ngɛ munyu kɛ ni peemi nihi a mi, ngɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi a he wami mi, ngɛ Mawu Mumi he wami mi; enɛ ɔ he nɛ i je Yerusalem kɛ bɔle si hluu kɛ ya su Ilirikum, nɛ i fiɛ Kristo Sane Kpakpa a kɛ gbe nya a nɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ma ye hɛ mi ji kaa, he nɛ a wui Kristo biɛ ta ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ma jaje Sane Kpakpa a ngɛ, benɛ pee nɛ ma ko ya fia ngɔ to nɔ kpa sisitomi nɔ.
Se mohu kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Nihi nɛ a jaje we e he sane ko ngɔ tsɔɔ we mɛ ɔ, A maa na, Nɛ nihi nɛ nui ɔ, A maa nu sisi.” Paulo Romayami he blɔnyatomi Enɛ ɔ nɔuu lɛ tsi mi blɔ hluu nɛ i bɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ.
Se jaha nɛ akɛnɛ i be nɔ́ ko peemi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi hu, nɛ jeha nɛ i je jehahi fuu hla kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ ma hia blɔ kɛ maa ya Spania a, ma ba nyɛ ngɔ; ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa ke ma gu lejɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ, ma ba na nyɛ hɛ mi konɛ, ke i na bua jɔmi bɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ se ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya je mi blɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ.
Se jeha nɛ ɔ, i hia blɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem, nɛ ma ya sɔmɔ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ lolo.
Ejakaa Makedonia kɛ Akaia tsuo kɛ tsui mi jɔmi tsu onia ko kɛ yaa ha klɔuklɔu bihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a kpɛti ohiafo ɔmɛ.
Tsui mi jɔmi nya a pee ngɛ niinɛ mohu, se jeha nɛ a hɛɛ mɛ hiɔ.
Ejakaa ke majeli ɔmɛ na a mumi mi ni kpakpa amɛ eko ɔ, lɛɛ e sa kaa mɛ hu a kɛ he lo mi ni kpakpa amɛ eko nɛ sɔmɔ mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke i gbe enɛ ɔ nya nɛ i ngɔ nike ni nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha mɛ ɔ, ma ba gu nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ya Spania.
I le kaa ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, Kristo gbaami hiɛmi ɔ mi ma ba ngɛ.
Se i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he kɛ Mumi ɔ suɔmi he, kaa nyɛɛ piɛ ye he kɛ plee ngɛ nyɛ sɔlemihi nɛ nyɛ sɔlee ngɔ haa mi ngɛ Mawu hɛ ni ɔ mi, konɛ a je mi kɛ je tue gboli nɛ ngɛ Yudea amɛ a dɛ mi, konɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ i yaa sɔmɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, e sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi saminya, konɛ ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, i kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ ma ba wo ye tsui ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ.
He jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo sɛmanemi munyuhi I ngɛ wa nyɛmi yo Foibe nɛ ji Kenkrea asafo ɔ sɔmɔlɔ ɔ yi jee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae, konɛ nyɛ he lɛ hɛ muɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ piɛ e he ngɛ ni tsumi tsuaa ni tsumi nɛ nyɛ he maa hia lɛ ngɛ mi ɔ mi; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ hu, e ji nihi fuu kɛ imi nitsɛ hu ye he piɛlɔ.
Nyɛ nga Priska kɛ Akwila, nɛ ji ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ ha mi, nihi nɛ kɛ a he wo gbenɔ mi ngɛ ye wami he, nɛ pi imi kɛkɛ nɛ i naa mɛ si, se mohu majeli ɔmɛ a mi asafo ɔmɛ kulaa hu ngɛ mɛ si nae.
Nyɛ nga asafo nɛ ngɛ a we ɔ hulɔ.
Nyɛ nga ye suɔlɔ Epaineto nɛ ji kekleekle nɔ ngɛ Asia nɛ kɛ e he ha Kristo ɔ. Nyɛ nga Maria nɛ gbo wa he dengme fuu ɔ. Nyɛ nga Androniko kɛ Yunia, ye wekuli nɛ a wo i kɛ mɛ tsu mi, nɛ a ngɛ biɛ ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ akpɛti nɛ a sɛ ye hlami ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ. Nyɛ nga Amplia, nɔ nɛ i suɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. Nyɛ nga Urbano nɛ ji wa huɛ ni tsulɔ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, kɛ ye suɔlɔ Staki.
Nyɛ nga Apele nɔ nɛ he nu si ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ. Nyɛ nga nihi nɛ je Aristobulo we mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ. Nyɛ nga ye wekuno Herodion ɔ. Nyɛ nga nihi nɛ je Marsiko we mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. Nyɛ nga Trifaina kɛ Trifosa nɛ bɔɔ mɔde ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. Nyɛ nga Persi, nɔ nɛ a suɔ nɛ e tsu ni fuu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. Nyɛ nga Rufo, nɔ nɛ a hla ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ e nyɛ pee mi bi hulɔ ɔ. Nyɛ nga Asinkrito, Felgon, Herma, Patroba, Herme kɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛ nga Filogo kɛ Yulia, Nerea kɛ e nyɛmi yo ɔ, kɛ Olimpa kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ kulaa.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuu nɛ nga nyɛ he.
Kristo asafo ɔ tsuo biɔ nyɛ.
Nyagbe nitsɔɔmi Jeha nɛ, mamimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nihi nɛ jee tsɔɔmi nɛ nyɛ kase ɔ se nɛ a kɛ mi gbamihi kɛ kpangmi tomi nihi baa amɛ a he, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ he kɛ je a he.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ kikɛ ɔ, pi wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ a sɔmɔɔ, se mohu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muklii; nɛ a kɛ nya mi dɔkɔɔ kɛ sisimi munyuhi mlɔɔ nihi nɛ li yayami ɔmɛ a tsui.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ tue bumi ɔ nihi tsuo nu he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ i na nyɛ he bua jɔmi.
Se i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he ni leli ngɛ nɔ kpakpa blɔfami; se nɔ yayami blɔfami ɔ, nihi nɛ a li nɔ́ ko.
Se e be kɛe nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ maa naa Satan nɔ kulaa ngɛ nyɛ nane si.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!
Ye huɛ ni tsulɔ Timoteo kɛ ye wekuli Lukio kɛ Yason kɛ Sosipatre biɔ nyɛ.
Imi Tortio hu nɛ i ngma kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ ɔ i biɔ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Gaio nɛ ji i kɛ asafo ɔ kulaa wetsɛ ɔ biɔ nyɛ.
Erasto nɛ ji ma sika tolɔ ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Kwarto biɔ nyɛ.
[Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ hi si!
Amen.]
Nyagbe yijemi sɔlemi Se nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛ fi si wawɛɛ ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a kɛ Yesu Kristo fiɛmi ɔ nya, ngɛ laami sane nɛ a ngɔ laa kɛ je neneene lokoo ɔ kpo jemi nya a, nɔ́ nɛ jeha nɛ je ngɔ tsɔɔ paa ngɛ neneene Mawu ɔ kita nya a, nɛ a gu gbali ɔmɛ a ngmami ɔmɛ a nɔ wo nɔ ta tsɔɔ majeli ɔmɛ kulaa konɛ a bu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tue — lɛ Mawu nɛ ji ni lelɔ kake too ɔ, a ngɔ nyami ngɔ ha ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi kɛ ya neneene!
Amen.
Paulo, Yesu Kristo bɔfo nɛ a tsɛ ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, kɛ wa nyɛmi Sostene ngma ya ha Mawu asafo nɛ ngɛ Korinto ɔ, nihi nɛ a tsukɔ a he ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi nɛ ji ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ kɛ nihi kula nɛ tsɛɛ waa kɛ mɛ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ.
Gbaami ngɛ Kristo mi I naa ye Mawu ɔ si daa nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛ he, ngɛ Mawu dloomi nɛ a ngɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ he, kaa nihi kulaa mi ɔ, a ha nyɛ plɔke ngɛ e mi, ngɛ munyu tsuaa munyu kɛ ni lemi tsuaa ni lemi blɔfami.
Kaa bɔ nɛ a ma Kristo he odase ɔ nɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ e piɛ́ nyɛ dloomi ke nɔ ko, nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo kpojemi ɔ blɔ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e ma wlua nyɛ kɛ maa ya nyagbe konɛ piami ko ko hi nyɛ he ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu, nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba e bi Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hue bɔmi ɔ mi ɔ. Migbami ngɛ asafo ɔ mi Se, mamimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, kaa nyɛ nya nɛ pee kake nɛ mi gbami ko ba nyɛ kpɛti, se mohu nyɛ kulaa nyɛ yi mi kɛ nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake.
Ejakaa mamimɛ, Kloe we mi bi ɔmɛ ba wo ye tue nɔ ke pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ ji kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ deɔ ke: “Ami lɛɛ, Paulo nɔ ji mi; ami lɛɛ, Apolo nɔ ji mi; ami lɛɛ, Kefa nɔ ji mi, ami lɛɛ Kristo nɔ ji mi.” Anɛ a gba Kristo mi lo?
Anɛ Paulo a sɛu ha nyɛ ɔ lo?
Aloo Paulo biɛ mi a baptisi nyɛ ngɔ wo ɔ lo?
I naa Mawu si kaa i baptisi we nyɛ ti nɔ ko, kaa ja Krispo kɛ Gaio konɛ nɔ ko ko de ke i baptisi nihi ngɔ wo imi nitsɛ ye biɛ mi.
Nɛ i baptisi Stefana we ɔ se nɛ ɔ ɔ, i li kaa i baptisi nɔ ko piɛ he hu lo.
Ejakaa Kristo tsɔ we mi baptisimi, se mohu sane kpakpa a fiɛmi, nɛ pi ngɛ ni lemi munyuhi a mi tete, kone Kristo seumi tso ɔ nɛ ko pee yaka.
Kristo ji Mawu hewami kɛ e nilemi Ejakaa seumi tso ɔ he sane ɔ ji kuasiahi a sane ha nihi nɛ hɛ mi kpataa a, se wɔ nihi nɛ a heɔ wa yi wami ɔ, e ji Mawu he wami ha wɔ.
Ejakaa fa ngma ke: “Ma puɛ ni leli a ni lemi, Nɛ ga leli a ga a hu ma ha e pee yaka.” Jije ni lelɔ ngɛ?
Jije womi mi lelɔ ngɛ?
Jije je nɛ ɔ mi sanemi hlalɔ ngɛ?
Anɛ Mawu ha we nɛ je ɔ mi ni lemi ɔ nɛ plɛ kuasiahi a sane lo?
Se akɛnɛ je ɔ gui Mawu ni lemi ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ e ni lemi ɔ nɛ le Mawu he je ɔ, e sa Mawu hɛ mi kaa e kɛ kuasiahi a sane ɔ nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ he nihi nɛ heɔ ye ɔ a yi wami.
Ejakaa Yudafo ɔmɛ ɔ, okadihi a si a biɔ, nɛ Helabi hu hlaa ni lemi se wɔɔ lɛɛ, Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ wa fiɛɔ, nɔ nɛ plɛ kpangmi ha Yudafohi kɛ kuasiahi a sane ha majemajeli ɔmɛ; se nihi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ ɔ tsuo, Yudafohi jio, Helabihi jio, Kristo nɛ ji Mawu he wami kɛ Mawu ni lemi ɔ wa fiɛɔ ngɔ haa mɛ.
Ejakaa Mawu kuasiahi a sane ɔ mi ngɛ ni lemi pe nimli a ni lemi, nɛ Mawu gbɔjɔmi ɔ he wa pe nimli a he wami.
Mamimɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa nyɛ tsɛmi ɔ, tsa pi he lo blɔfami ni leli fuu nɛ a tsɛ, tsa pi he wali fuu, tsa pi odehehi fuu.
Se mohu je nɛ ɔ mi kuaisa amɛ Mawu hla, kone e kɛ gbe ni leli ɔmɛ zo.
Nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi gbɔjɔmi ni ɔmɛ hu Mawu hla konɛ e kɛ gbe nihi nɛ he wa amɛ zo.
Nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nihi nɛ a bui kɛ nihi nɛ a gbe he guɛ ɔ Mawu hla, kɛ nihi nɛ pi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ tete, konɛ e ha nihi nɛ ji nɔ́ ko ɔmɛ nɛ pee yaka; benɛ pee nɛ he lo ko he lo ko ko fia ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Se Mawu lɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, nɔ nɛ plɛ ni lemi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ kɛ dami kɛ he tsukɔmi kɛ kpɔmi ha wɔ ɔ, konɛ: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ fiae ɔ, e fia ngɔ fɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ,” kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a.
Kristo ngɛ seumi tso ɔ nɔ he sane Imi hu, mamimɛ, benɛ i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, pi nyamitsɔmi loo nilemi fuu nɛ i kɛ ba ba jaje Mawu laami sane ɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ; ejakaa i to we imi nitsɛ ye yi mi kaa ma le nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kaa ja Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ a sɛu ɔ. Nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si ngɛ gbɔjɔmi kɛ gbeyeyemi kɛ hedomi babauu mi; nɛ ye munyu kɛ ye sanefiɛmi ɔ hu ji nimli a nilemi munyuhi nɛ plɛɛ nɔ yi mi mi, se mohu e je mumi kɛ hewami tsɔɔmi mi, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ko da nimli a nilemi nɔ, se mohu e da Mawu hewami nɔ.
Mawu nilemi Se kɛ ɔ, wa tuɔ nilemi munyu ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a hi kɛ pi si ɔmɛ a kpɛti, se tsa pi je nɔ mi nilemi aloo je nɔ mi nikɔtɔmahi nɛ bee kɛ yaa amɛ a nɔ ʼi; se mohu Mawu nilemi nɛ a kɛ laa ngɛ laami sane mi ɔ wa deɔ, nɔ nɛ Mawu dla to ha wa hɛminyamiwomi loko a bɔ je ɔ, nɔ nɛ je nɔ mi nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li ɔ; ejakaa a le jinɛ a be hɛminyami Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛue.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ pa ngma a: “Nihi nɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ, nɛ tue hu nui, Nɛ e bɛ nɔmlɔ ko tsui mi hyɛ Ji nihi nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ to nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ.” Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, Mawu gu E mumi ɔ nɔ je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ; ejakaa Mumi ɔ hlaa nihi kulaa mi, Mawu nihi nɛ mi kuɔ tete.
Se nimli a kpɛti mɛnɔ le nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ mi, kaa ja nɔmlɔ ɔ mumi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ?
Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ Mawu mi ni ɔmɛ hu nɔ ko nɔ ko li, kaa ja Mawu mumi ɔ. Wɔɔ lɛɛ, pi je nɔ mi mumi ɔ nɛ wa na, se mohu mumi nɛ je Mawu mi ɔ, konɛ waa le nihi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo wɔ ɔ. Kɔlɔɔmɛ hu wa deɔ, pi nimli a nilemi munyuhi nɛ waa kɛ deɔ, se mohu munyuhi nɛ Mumi ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ mumi mi nihi toɔ mumi mi nihi a he.
Se nɔmlɔ su nɛ a kɛ fɔ lɛ ɔ he we Mawu Mumi ɔ ni ɔmɛ; ejakaa e peɔ lɛ kaa kuasiahi a sane ʼi, nɛ e nɛ́ nya, ejaka mumi a kɛ hlaa nya.
Mumi mi nɔmlɔ ɔ kojoɔ nihi kulaa, se lɛɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kojo we lɛ.
“Ejakaa mɛnɔ lɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ lɛ ni?” Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛɛ Kristo juɛmi.
Mawu sɔmɔli Mamimɛ, i be nyɛe nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu kaa mumi mi nimli, se mohu kaa he lo mi nimli, kaa bimwɔwi ngɛ Kristo mi.
Nyɔ i ha nyɛ, se tsa pi ngma nɛ jiɔ, ejakaa nyɛ nyɛ́ we.
Nɛ jeha nɛ hu tete nyɛ nyɛ́ we kɛ mwɔɔ, ejakaa he lo mi nimli ji nyɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Se be abɔ nɛ hungajemi kɛ pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kɛ mwɔɔ nɛ ɔ, anɛ pi he lo mi nimli ji nyɛ nɛ nimli a je mi nyɛ ngɛ bae ɔ lo?
Ejakaa benɛ nɔ ko ke: “Ami lɛɛ, Paulo nɔ ji mi; nɛ nɔ ko hu ke: Ami lɛɛ, Apolo nɔ ji mi” ɔ, anɛ pi he lo mi nimli ji nyɛ lo?
Jeha nɛ Apolo ji mɛnɔ?
Paulo ji mɛnɔ?
Mɛ ji sɔmɔli nɛ nyɛ gu a nɔ he ye, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ ha lɛ ɔ. Imi lɛɛ i ma; Apolo pue nɔ nyu; se Mawu ha e wa.
Blɔɔ jeha nɛ tsa pi nɔ nɛ ma a ji nɔ ko, nɛ pi nɔ nɛ pue nɔ nyu ɔ hulɔ, se mohu nɔ nɛ ha e wa nɛ ji Mawu ɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ ma kɛ nɔ nɛ pue nɔ nyu ɔ tsuo ɔ kake ʼi; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na lɛ nitsɛ e hiɔwo ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ni tsumi nya.
Ejakaa Mawu he piɛli ni tsuli ji wɔ; Mawu cngmɔ, Mawu tsu ji nyɛ.
Mawu dloomi nɛ e kɛ dloo mi ɔ nya a, i to tsu ɔ sisi kaa tsu fialɔ galɔ ko, se nɔ kpa lɛ fia nɔ.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nɔ fiae ha a konɛ e hi.
Ejakaa nɔ ko be sisi kpa ko nɛe maa to pe nɔ́ nɛ a to momo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo ɔ. Ke nɔ ko kɛ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, tɛ nɛ he jua wa, tsohi, nga loo go ma sisi tomi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a maa na nɔ tsuaa nɔ ni tsumi ɔ paa, ejakaa ligbi ɔ ma je lɛ kpo, ejakaa la mi e maa je kpo ngɛ, nɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ni tsumi ngɛ ɔ, la a nɔuu ma je lɛ si.
Ke nɔ ko ni tsumi nɛ e fia ngɔ ma nɔ ɔ maa da si ɔ, e ma na hiɔwo; se ke nɔ ko ni tsumi maa sã a, e nine maa nyɛ si; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ, a ma he e yi wami, se kɛ ɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ gu la mi.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa Mawu sɔlemi tsu ji nyɛ nɛ Mawu Mumi ɔ hii nyɛ mi lo?
Ke nɔ ko puɛ Mawu sɔlemi tsu ɔ, Mawu ma puɛ lɛ.
Ejakaa Mawu sɔlemi tsu ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, lɔ ɔ ji nyɛ.
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ko mlɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Ke nɔ ko susu kaa ni lelɔ ji lɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e pee e he kuasia, konɛ e plɛ ni lelɔ.
Ejakaa je nɛ ɔ mi ni lemi ɔ ji kuasiahi a sane ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Ejakaa a ngma ke: “Enuu ni leli ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi temi ɔ mi.” Kɛ jeha nɛ hu: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le ni leli a juɛmi ɔmɛ kaa yaka nihi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko ko fia ngɔ fɔ nimli a nɔ: se nihi kulaa a nyɛ nɔ ʼi, Paulo jio, Apolo jio, Kefa jio, je ɔ jio, wami jio, gbenɔ jio, nihi nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔmɛ jio, nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ jio, kulaa a nyɛ nɔ ʼi; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, Kristo nihi ji nyɛ, nɛ Kristo ɔ, Mawu nɔ ʼi.”
Kristo sɔmɔli Bɔ pɛ nɛ sa nɛ nimli nɛ bu wɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa Kristo sɔmɔli kɛ Mawu laami sane ɔmɛ a nɔ sɔmɔli nikɔtɔmahi.
Nɔ nɛ piɛ nɛ a hlaa ngɛ sɔmɔli nikɔtɔma amɛ a dɛ ji kaa, a na a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kaa anɔkualetsɛ.
Se imi lɛɛ i bui lɛ sane slɔɔto ko kaa nyɛ kojoɔ mi aloo kaa a kɛ nimli a kojomi maa kojo mi; se imi nitsɛ ɔ, i kojo we ye he.
Ejakaa i li nɔ ko yaya ko ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye he mohu, se kɛ ɔ pi lɔ ɔ he nɛ a maa wo mi nguɔ ngɛ; nɔ nɛ kojoɔ mi ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko kojo nɔ ko loko e su be ɔ, kɛ yaa su be nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba, nɔ nɛ kɛ diblii mi nihi nɛ a kɛ laa a tete maa ba la hɛ mi nɛ e ma je tsuihi a mi juɛmi ɔmɛ a si ɔ. Lɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na e yi jemi kɛ maa je Mawu dɛ mi.
Mamimɛ, nyɛ he nɛ i kɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɔmɛ ngɛ i kɛ Apolo he toeɔ nɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kase wɔ nɛ nɔ ko ko susu pe nɔ nɛ a ngma a, konɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kɛ he nɔ womi ko bu nɔ ko pe nɔ ko.
Mɛnɔ ha eslo mo?
Nɛ jeha nɛ mɛni o ngɛ nɛ pi nɛ a kɛ ha mo?
Se ke pe a kɛ ha mo ɔ, mɛ he je o fiaa kaa nɔ nɛ pi nɛ pe a kɛ ha mo ɔ?
Nyɛ tɔ mo, nyɛ na ni mo, nyɛ si wɔ se nɛ nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee.
I na nɛ jinɛ nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee niinɛ, konɛ wɔ hu waa kɛ nyɛ nɛ ye!
Ejakaa e peɔ mi kaa Mawu ngɔ wɔ nihi nɛ wa ji bɔfo ɔmɛ mohu ngɔ pee se kpɛli, kaa nihi nɛ a gbaa a nɔ ngɔ ha gbenɔ ejakaa a kɛ wɔ pee hyɛmi nihi ha je ɔ kɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kɛ nimli.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ, kuasiahi ji wɔ ngɛ Kristo he, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ni leli ji nyɛ ngɛ Kristo mi.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ, gbɔjɔli ji wɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, he wali ji nyɛ; nyɛ lɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛ mi be nyami.
Kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, hwɔ kɛ kuma yee wɔ, nɛ wa nyɛɛ wa he gu, nɛ a gbaa wɔ mahi, nɛ wa be hi he tutuutu ko, nɛ wa gboɔ dengme waa kɛ wa ninehi tsuɔ ni; benɛ a ngɛ wɔ jɛe ɔ, wa ngɛ gbaae; benɛ a ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ, wa toɔ wa tsui si; benɛ a ngɛ wa biɛ puee ɔ, wa ngɛ pɛɛ kpae.
Wa plɛ kaa je ɔ kuku nɔ nihi, nihi kulaa a dwɔmi kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ. I ngmɛ́ nyɛ enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ma kɛ gbe nyɛ zo, se mohu i ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe kaa ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ.
Ejakaa ke nyɛ ngɛ nɔ hyɛli akpe-nyɔngma tete ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, kɛ ɔ pi tsɛmɛ fuu nɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Ejakaa i gu Sane Kpakpa a nɔ kɛ fɔ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpaa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kase mi.
Enɛ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ i tsɔ Timoteo nɛ ji ye suɔmi bi kɛ anɔkualetsɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ; e ma kae nyɛ bɔ nɛ i baa ye je mi haa ngɛ Kristo mi, kaa bɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ ngɛ asafo tsuaa asafo mi, ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ.
Se akɛnɛ nyɛ ti ni komɛ susu kaa i be nyɛ ngɔ bae he je ɔ, a wo a he nɔ.
Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba na ninɛmɛ nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔmɛ a he wami, se pi a munyu.
Ejakaa tsa pi munyu mi nɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ, se mohu he wami mi.
Kɛ nyɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae kɛɛ?
Ma hɛɛ tso kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, aloo ma ba ngɛ suɔmi kɛ mi mi jɔmi mumi mi?
Ajuamabɔmi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi Angɛ de ngɛ nyɛ he niinɛ kaa ajuama bɔmi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, ajuama bɔmi nɛ be majemajeli ɔmɛ a mi tete, kaa nɔ ko maa ngɔ e tsɛ yo.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he?
Sa nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ benɛ pee nɛ a je nɔ nɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
Imi nɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi se mohu mumi mi i ngɛ ngɛ ɔ, i kojo nɔ nɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ mo, kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ i ke, ke nyɛ kpe ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, nɛ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he wami piɛ nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ wo Satan dɛ mi, konɛ e he lo ɔ hɛ mi nɛ kpata, nɛ a he e mumi ɔ yi wami ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ fiami ɔ be fɛu.
Nyɛ li kaa ma sasɛ nyafii saa ma mluku ɔ kulaa lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ je ma sasɛ momo ɔ, konɛ nyɛ plɛ ma he, kaa bɔ nɛ ma akpiti ji nyɛ ɔ; ejaaa a gbe wa Hetsɔmi To Bi nɛ ji Kristo ɔ ha wɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha waa ye Hetsɔmi bua jɔmi ligbi ɔ, pi kɛ ma sasɛ momo, nɛ jehanɛ hu pi kɛ yayami loo nɔ yayami peemi ma sasɛ, se mohu kɛ anɔkuale akpiti ngmingmiingmi.
Ye womi nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i ke nyɛɛ kɛ ajuama bɔli ko bɔ.
Pi je nɛ ɔ mi bimɛ a ti ya holi loo hɛ tsuli loo amim yeli loo wɔ jali a he munyu kulaa nɛ i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ, ejakaa kaa mɛ jinɛ, ja nyɛ je je ɔ mi.
Se jehanɛ, i ngma nyɛ ke ke nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ nyɛmi ɔ ji ajuama bɔlɔ loo hɛ tsulɔ loo wɔ jalɔ loo nɔ jɛlɔ, loo da delɔ loo amim yelɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko ye ni tete.
Se ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ, mɛni a kojomi kɔɔ ngɛ ye he?
Anɛ pi ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ nɛ nyɛ kojoɔ lo?
Ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ, Mawu ji nɔ nɛ kojoɔ mɛ.
Nyɛ je nɔ yayami ɔ ke je nyɛ kpɛti.
Munyu nɛ a kɛ nyɛmimɛ yeɔ Tse ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi na sane ko ɔ, e jee blɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya yeɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ ja we Mawu ɔ a ngɔ, se e kɛ lɛ yɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a ngɔ lo?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ji ninɛmɛ nɛ maa kojo je ɔ lo?
Nɛ ke nyɛ maa piɛ he nɛ a kojo je ɔ, anɛ nyɛ sɛ́ nihi nɛ kojoɔ munyu tsɔ wi lo?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa wa maa kojo hiɔwe bɔfohi tete po hluu nɛ e ba slɔ je nɛ ɔ mi munyuhi?
Jehanɛ, ke nyɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi munyuhi komɛ a yemi ɔ, mɛ he je nyɛ haa nihi nɛ a bui mɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi yeɔ mɔ?
Zo gbi nyɛ piɔ?
Anɛ ni lelɔ kaketoo po be nyɛ kpɛti, nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ e nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti munyu nɛ e tu lo?
Se mohu nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi yaa kojomi ngɛ nihi nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ po a ngɔ!
Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ gbee si mo, akɛnɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he yeɔ munyu ɔ. Mɛ he je nyɛ ha we nɛ a ye nyɛ amim mohu?
Mɛni he je nyɛ ha we nɛ a sisi nyɛ mohu?
Se nyɛ mohu nyɛ peɔ nihi nɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛ sisiɔ nihi nɛ ji nyɛ nyɛmimɛ tete.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa yayami peeli a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue lo?
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a mlɔɔ nyɛ!
Ajuama bɔli loo wɔ jali loo gba puɛli loo nyumuhi nɛ kɛ nyumuhi peɔ yakayakani, loo juɔhi loo hɛ dooli loo da deli loo nɔ jɛli loo amim yeli a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue kulaa.
Sa a, nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɛ kikɛ; se jahanɛ a du nyɛ he, nɛ a kpale tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ a wo nyɛ nguɔ hulɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ kɛ wa Mawu ɔ Mumi ɔ mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami I ngɛ nihi kulaa he blɔ mohu, se kɛ ɔ pi nihi kulaa nɛ hi.
I ngɛ nihi kulaa he blɔ mohu, se i be hae nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ye ye nɔ.
Ngma ngɛ ha muklii, nɛ muklii hu ngɛ ha ngma, se Mawu ma ha enyɔ ɔ kulaa se maa po.
Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, pi ajuama bɔmi he nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ, se mohu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he e ngɛ ngɛ, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ha nɔmlc tso ɔ. Nɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu tle Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, ja e ma tle wɔ hu si ngɛ e he wami nya.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ ɔ Kristo he nihi ji mɛ lo?
Lɛɛ ma ngɔ Kristo he ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pee ajuama he nihi lo?
Dɛbi!
Aloo nyɛ li kaa nɔ nɛ kɛ e he ya bɔɔ ajuama he ɔ, e kɛ lɛ plɛ nɔmlɔ tso kɛke lo?
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke: “Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔ kulaa a ma plɛ he lo kake.” Se nɔ nɛ kɛ e he bɔɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ lɛ peɔ mumi kake.
Nyɛɛ tu ajuama bɔmi nya fo!
Yayami tsuaa yayami nɛ nɔmlɔ peɔ ɔ, pi e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ e ngɛ; se nɔ nɛ bɔɔ ajuama a, e peɔ yayami siɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ. Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ sɔlemi tsu ʼi, nɛ nyɛ pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ lo?
Ejakaa a he nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Gbasihimi he sane Jehanɛ, ngɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngma ba ha mi ɔmɛ a he ɔ: E hi ha nyumu kaa e ko ta yo he; se ajuama bɔmi he ɔ, nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yo, nɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ gba lɛ nitsɛ e huno.
Yotsɛ ɔ nɛ pee e yo ɔ blɔ nya ni ngɔ ha lɛ, nɛ yo ɔ hu nɛ pee ja nɔuu ngɔ ha e huno.
Yo ɔ be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɔ, se mohu e huno ɔ lɛ ngɛ.
Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ huno ɔ hu be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɔ, se e yo ɔ lɛ ngɛ.
Nyɛ ko kua nyumu kɛ yo buami ja nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔ tsuo nyɛ kplɛɛ kaa nyɛ maa pee ja, kɛ ya su be ko, konɛ nyɛ na deka nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ nyɛɛ pee kake ekohu, konɛ Satan ko tsɔ nyɛ nya ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ nɛ nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ ye ɔ he.
I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ ga womi nya se pi ngɛ kita nya.
Ke ka ye he ɔ jinɛ nimli kulaa nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e dloomi nike ni kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi, nɔ ko nɔ́ kikɛ, nɛ nɔ ko hu ekpa.
Nyumukuyo ɔmɛ kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke: E hi ha mɛ ke a hi si kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nɔ.
Se ke a nyɛ we a he nɔ nɛ a ye ɔ, a sɛ gba si himi mi; ejakaa gba si himi hi pe nɔ́ nɛ akɔnɔ maa hao mo.
Ninɛmɛ nɛ sɛ gba si himi mi ɔ, imi, nɛ tsa pi imi tete, se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mohu lɛ ngɛ mɛ kita woe ke, yo ko je gba.
Nɛ ke e je gba tete po ɔ, e hi si ja, nɛ e ko gba, aloo e kɛ e huno ɔ ya dla; nɛ yotsɛ ɔ hu e ko ngmɛɛ e yo he.
Se ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, pi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, se imi i ngɛ mɛ dee ke: ke nyɛmi ko ngɛ yo ko nɛ he we yi, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ yo ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, e ko ngmɛɛ e he.
Nɛ ke yo ko hu ngɛ huno ko nɛ he we yi, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ nyumu ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, e ko kua lɛ gbami.
Ejakaa a tsukɔɔ nyumu nɛ he we yi ɔ hu he ngɛ yo ɔ mi, nɛ a tsukɔɔ yo nɛ he we yi ɔ hu he ngɛ huno ɔ mi.
Ejakaa ke pi ja jinɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ hu a he sɛ mu; se jehanɛ ɔ, a he tsɔ.
Se ke nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ e he si sae kɛ yaa a, e ya; a yi nyɛmi nyumu lo nyɛmi yo nyɔguɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
He jɔmi mi Mawu tsɛ wɔ ngɛ.
Yo, mo o ma he o huno ɔ yi wami jio, o le?
Aloo nyumu, mo hu lɛ o ma he o yo ɔ yi wami jio, o le?
Hii si bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɛ mo ɔ Bɔ nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ha a, e hi si ja.
Ja i to hulɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ kulaa mi.
Kɛ a po nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e ko pee e he mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ; mɔmlɔtɔ mi a tsɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hu, e ko po e he.
Nɔpomi pi nɔ́ ko, nɛ mɔmlɔtɔ hu pi nɔ́ ko, se Mawu kita amɛ a nɔ yemi mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ he hia.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsɛmi nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ mi nɔuu e hi.
Ke nyɔguɛ ji mo nɛ a tsɛ mo jio, ko ha lɔ ɔ nɛ dɔ mo; se ke o ma nyɛ o he kpɔ ɔ, bɔɔ he mɔde.
Nɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ji nyɔguɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ odehe ʼi.
Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ nɛ e ji odehe ɔ, Kristo nyɔguɛ ʼi.
A he nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ; nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he nimli a nyɔguɛhi.
Mamimɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ mi nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ mi nɔuu e hi ngɛ Mawu mi.
Yihewi nɛ gba we kɛ yalɔyi a he sane Jehanɛ yihewi nɛ gba we ɔ, i be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kita ko ha mɛ, se nɔ́ nɛ wi susuu ɔ i ngɛ dee, kaa nɔ ko nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na lɛ mɔbɔ konɛ e ye anɔkuale.
Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i susuu kaa e hi ji: Amlɔ nɛ ɔ he hiami nɛ ɔ he ɔ, e hi ha nɔmlɔ kaa e hi si bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ. Ke a fi mo mɛtɛ yo he jio, ko hia pɛnemi; a pɛne mo kɛ je yo he jio, ko hia yo.
Se ke o ngɔ yo hu ɔ, o pee we yayami; nɛ ke yiheyo hu gba a, e pee we yayami; se he lo blɔfami dengme ni nɛ ɔmɛ ma na, se imi lɛɛ, nyɛ he ya i ngɛ foe.
Mamimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji kaa, be ɔ pi hu; nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ji kaa, yitsɛmɛ tete a pee kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ be eko; nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ya foe ɔ hu a pee kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ fo we ya; nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ hu a pee kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ nya we; nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ hu a pee kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ be nɔ́ ko; nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ tsuɔ je nɛ ɔ he ni ɔ, a pee kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ tsu we he ni; ejakaa je nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ wa naa a bee kɛ yaa.
Se i suɔ kaa nyɛ ko na haomi.
Nɔ nɛ ngɔɛ yo ɔ, e kɛ e he tsuo haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ni tsumi ɔ, bɔ nɛ e maa pee nɛ e sane nɛ sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo ɔ, haoɔ e he ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nihi a he, bɔ nɛ e maa pee nɛ e sane nɛ sa e yo ɔ hɛ mi.
Eslo yogbayo, nɛ jehanɛ hu eslo zangmayo.
Nɔ nɛ gba we ɔ kɛ e he tsuo haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ni tsumi ɔ, konɛ e pee klɔuklɔu ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kɛ mumi tsuo blɔfami.
Se nɔ nɛ gba a haoɔ e he ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nihi a he, benɛ pee nɛ e sane nɛ sa e huno hɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ kpakpa he i ngɛ dee ngɛ, pi nyɛ kuɛ kpa nɛ i ngɛ woe, se mohu benɛ pee nɛ e pee fɛu, konɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ ko doo nyɛ nya.
Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e bi yo nɛ nɔ zangma a, e ko wa tsɔ loko e gba, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ e sa nɛ a pee he nɔ́ ko ɔ, e pee bɔ nɛ e suɔ; e pee we yayami ko ke e ya gba.
Se nɔ nɛ daa si kpɛii ngɛ e tsui mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fi we lɛ, se e ngɛ he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nɔ ɔ, nɛ e ma nya si ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui mi kaa e maa baa e bi zangmayo ɔ yi ɔ, e pee saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ ha gba a e pee saminya, se nɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ ha we gba a pee saminya pe nɔ kaketsɛ ɔ. Yo ɔ, be abɔ nɛ e huno hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, a kɛ mlaa fi lɛ; se ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, e ngɛ he blɔ kaa e gbaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ, se ja a pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Se ke e hi si bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, ye juɛmi nya a, e ngɛ bua jɔmi babauu; nɛ e peɔ mi kaa imi hu i ngɛ Mawu mumi.
Wɔhi a nya bɔsami niyeni Jehanɛ ngɛ wɔhi a nya bɔ sami niyeni ɔmɛ a he ɔ, wa le kaa “wɔ kulaa wa le ni.” Ni lemi haa nɔ woɔ e he nɔ, se suɔmi haa nɔ nane nuu si.
Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e le nɔ́ ko ɔ, e li nɔ́ ko bɔ nɛ sa kaa e le.
Se ke nɔ ko suɔ Mawu ɔ, lɛ Mawu le.
Jehanɛ ngɛ wɔhi a nya bɔ sami niyeni a yemi he ɔ, wa le kaa wɔ ko wɔ ko pi nɔ́ ko ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ jehanɛ mawu ko mawu ko be ja Mawu kake kɛkɛ.
Ejakaa ke ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ “mawuhi” ɔ, hiɔwe a ngɛ jio, zugba a nɔ a ngɛ jio, kaa bɔ nɛ “mawuhi” pɔ he nɛ “nyɔmtsɛmɛ” hu pɔ he ɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ wɔɔ lɛɛ, Mawu kaketoo wa ngɛ, Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ mi nɛ nihi kulaa je nɛ wa ngɛ ha lɛ ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kake hu nɛ ji Yesu Kristo ɔ, nɔ nɔ nɛ nihi kulaa gu kɛ ba nɛ wɔ hu wa gu e nɔ ɔ.
Se kɛ ɔ pi nihi tsuo a mi nɛ kikɛmɛ a ni lemi nɛ ɔ ngɛ.
Ni komɛ ngɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ nɛ a kɛ wɔhi a nɔ hemi kɛ yemi yeɔ wɔhi a nya bɔ sami niyeni, nɛ akɛnɛ a he ni lemi gbɔjɔ he je ɔ, a bleɔ lɛ.
Ngma kɛ wɔ yɛ Mawu hɛ mi; ke wa yeɔ ɔ, e ha we nɛ waa hi pe nine, nɛ jehanɛ ke wa yi hu, wa laa we nɔ ko.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ nyɛ he blɔ nɛ ɔ ko ba plɛ kpangmi ha nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔmɛ.
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko na mo nɛ ji “ni lelɔ” ɔ kaa o hii si ngɛ wɔ piɛ mi ngɛ ni yee ɔ, anɛ pi he wami nɛ o ngɛ nɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ he ni lemi woe konɛ e ya ye wɔhi a nya bɔ sami niyeni ɔmɛ lo?
Lɔ ɔ lɛɛ, o “ni lemi” ɔ ma nyɛ ma ha nyɛmi nɛ gbɔjɔ nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ lɛ hu e he ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Se ke nyɛ peɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ yayami kikɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ plaa a he ni lemi nɛ he wɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ Kristo nyɛ ngɛ yayami ɔ pee kɛ ngɛ sie ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ngma ma ha ye nyɛmi nane ma kpata a, lɔɔ lɛɛ i be lo yee gblegbleegblee hu, konɛ ma ko ha ye nyɛmi ɔ nane nɛ kpata.
Bɔfo blɔ nya kɛ e nitsumi Anɛ i hɛɛ we ye he lo?
Anɛ pi bɔfo ji mi lo?
Anɛ i nɛ Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo?
Pi ye nine nya ni tsumi ji nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi lo?
Ke pi bɔfo ji mi kɛ ha ni kpahi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ i ji kɛ ha nyɛ; ejakaa ye bɔfo ni tsumi ɔ nya sɔumi nɔ ji nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ faa ye he ngɛ nihi nɛ biɔ ye he sane ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa yeɔ ni nɛ wa nuu lo?
Anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa waa kɛ nyɛmi yo nɛ ji wa yo nvɛɛ kaa bɔfo kpa amɛ hu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ Kefa?
Aloo i kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ lɛ be he blɔ kaa wa jɔɔ ni tsumi lo?
Aslaafono te nɛɛ nɛ bɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he apaa kɛ ya ta hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ peɔ wai ngmɔ nɛ e yi e mi yiblii ɔ eko?
Aloo mɛnɔ lɛ lɛɛ lohwehi a kuu nɛ e nui a nyɔ nyu ɔ eko?
Nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, anɛ nimli kɛkɛ lɛ peɔ ja?
Anɛ mlaa hu de we ja nɔuu lo?
Ejakaa a ngma ngɛ Mose Mlaa a mi ke: “Koo wo na nɛ gblɛɛ blɛfo ɔ nya kotoku.” Anɛ nahi a he nɛ dɔɔ Mawu he je nɛ pi wa he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ lo?
Ejakaa wa he nɔuu nɛ a ngma ke, nɔ nɛ huɔ ɔ, e kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ hu, nɛ nɔ nɛ hluɛɛ blɛfo hu e hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa e maa ye eko.
Ke wɔɔ lɛɛ wa duɔ mumi mi nihi haa nyɛ ɔ, anɛ e ji nɔ ko tsɔ kaa wa ma kpa he lo mi nihi lo?
Jehanɛ hu ke ni kpahi ngɛ kikɛmɛ a he blɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ, anɛ pi wɔ mohu nɛ wa ngɛ pe mɛ po lo?
Se kɛ ɔ, wa pee we kikɛmɛ a he blɔ nɛ ɔ he nɔ ko, se mohu wa to wa tsui si ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi, konɛ wa ko tsi Kristo Sane Kpakpa a blɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nihi nɛ tsuɔ ni ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, sɔlemi we ni ɔmɛ eko nɔuu a yeɔ lo?
Nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ sami latɛ ɔ nɔ ni ɔmɛ eko nɔuu a naa lo?
Jã nɔuu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ to kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ jajeɔ Sane Kpakpa a, a ye sane kpakpa a he ni.
Se imi lɛɛ, i pee we kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kake po he nɔ ko.
Nɛ i ngmɛ́ enɛ ɔ konɛ a pee ja ngɔ ha mi, ejakaa ke ka nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ma ha ye fiami ɔ nɛ pee yaka a, afani nɛ i gbo mohu.
Ejakaa ke i jaje sane kpakpa a po hu ɔ, e pee we mi fiami; ejakaa a ngɔ fi ye nɔ kaa ma jaje, ejakaa ke i jaje we sane kpakpa a, kusiɛ ha mi!
Ejakaa ke imi nitsɛ ye suɔmi nya nɛ i tsu enɛ ɔ ɔ, i ngɛ hiɔwo, se ke pi suɔmi nya tete ɔ, a tu sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma yemi ni tsumi ngɔ wo ye dɛ kɛ̃.
Jehanɛ mɛni ji ye hiɔwo mɔ?
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa ke i ngɛ sane kpakpa a jajee ɔ, ma jaje lɛ yaka, nɛ i he we nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo Sane Kpakpa a he, benɛ pee nɛ ma ko pee ye he blɔ nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a fiɛmi mi ɔ he nɔ ko tsɔ ko.
Pohu i hɛɛ ye he nɛ i pi nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɔguɛ, kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ ye he pee nihi tsuo a sɔmɔlɔ, benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su nihi babauu a nɔ.
I plɛ Yudafono ha Yudafo ɔmɛ benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su Yudafohi a nɔ.
Ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mlaa sisi hulɔ ɔ, i pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ mlaa sisi ngɔ ha mɛ, pohu imi nitsɛ ɔ, i be mlaa sisi, benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mlaa sisi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
I plɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ be mlaa ngɔ ha ninɛmɛ nɛ be mlaa a, pohu i pi nɔ ko nɛ be Mawu mlaa; se mohu i ngɛ Kristo mlaa sisi, benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su ninɛmɛ nɛ be mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
I plɛ kaa nɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ ha gbɔjɔli ɔmɛ benɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su gbɔjɔli ɔmɛ a nɔ.
I plɛ ye he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɔ ha nihi kulaa konɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ ma kɛ he ni komɛ a yi wami.
Sane Kpakpa a he nɛ i peɔ enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ, benɛ pee nɛ imi hu ma na e mi ni ɔmɛ eko.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ tuu fo ɔ, mɛ kulaa a tuu mohu se nɔ kake kɛkɛ nɛ naa ayekoo ni ɔ lo?
Nyɛɛ tu fo ɔ ja konɛ nyɛ nine nɛ su nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ hu nɛ kaa e he mi kɛ kunɔ ɔ, e hɛ kaa si ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.
Jehanɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a peɔ ja konɛ a na jlasi nɛ puɛɔ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ konɛ wa na nɔ nɛ puɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fo nɛ i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ, i tui lɛ putuputu; kunɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɔe nɛ ɔ, pi kɔɔhiɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nɔe; se mohu i gbaa imi nitsɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mahi nɛ i yeɔ lɛ nyɔguɛ, konɛ imi nɛ i fiɛɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ɔ, imi nitsɛ lɛɛ a ko sake mi ngɔ fɔ he.
Amagahi a he kɔkɔbɔmi Se, mamimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛ kai kaa wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hi bɔ ku ɔ sisi, nɛ mɛ tsuo a po wo ɔ, nɛ a baptisi mɛ kulaa ngɔ wo Mose mi ngɛ bɔ ku ɔ kɛ wo ɔ mi, nɛ mɛ kulaa a, mumi mi niyeni kake ɔ nɔuu a ye, nɛ mɛ kulaa a nu mumi mi tɛ sa nɛ kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ ɔ mi nyu, nɛ tɛ sa a ji Kristo?
Se kɛ̃ ɔ Mawu na we a ti nihi fuu a he tsui, ejakaa a kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Se a kɛ enɛ ɔmɛ to wɔ okadi konɛ wa ko ha ni yayahi nɛ pee wɔ akɔnɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee mɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ hu nyɛ ko plɛ amaga jali kaa a ti ni komɛ pee ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “Ma a be hi si, nɛ a ye ni, nɛ a nu da, kɛkɛ nɛ a te si nɛ a bɔni fiɛmi.” Nɛ jehanɛ hu wa ko bɔ ajuama kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ bɔ nɛ ligbi kake nɔ ɔ nihi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ yi tã a. Nɛ jehanɛ hu wa ko ka Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ ka lɛ nɛ sinɔhi ba kpata a hɛ mi ɔ. Nɛ jehanɛ hu nyɛ ko tu munyu huitihuiti kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ tu munyu huitihuiti nɛ nɔ́ puɛlɔ ɔ ba kpata a hɛ mi ɔ.
A pee mɛ enɛ ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ a kɛ to okadi ha ni kpahi; nɛ a ngma kaa kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ kɛ ha wɔ, wɔ nihi nɛ je ɔ nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ na wɔ ɔ; benɛ pee nɛ nɔ nɛ susuu kaa e daa si ɔ, e hyɛ e he nɛ hi konɛ e ko nɔ si.
Ka ko bɛ nyɛ nɔ nɛ pi nɔmlɔ he nɔ́; se anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu, nɔ nɛ be hae nɛ a ka nyɛ pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ, se mohu e kɛ ka a nɔuu maa je blɔ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ je mi hulɔ, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛɛ da.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ tu wɔ jami nya fo!
I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kaa a kɛ ni leli tuɔ munyu; nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kɔ nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ se.
Gbaami kplu ɔ nɛ wa gbaa a, anɛ pi waa kɛ Kristo kake peemi ngɛ e muɔ ɔ mi lo?
Abolo nɛ wa kuɔ ɔ, anɛ pi waa kɛ Kristo kake peemi ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi lo?
Ejakaa abolo kake ʼi, nɛ wɔ fuu ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso kake ji wɔ, ejakaa wɔ kulaa wa yeɔ abolo kake ɔ eko.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ he lo blɔfami Israel ɔ; anɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ bɔ sami ni ɔmɛ ɔ pi huɛ nɛ a kɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔe ɔ lo?
Lɛɛ kɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ?
Kaa amaga ji nɔ ko, aloo kaa amaga bɔ ji nɔ ko?
Dɛbi, se mohu i ngɛ dee ke bɔ nɛ wɔ jali ɔmɛ saa a, mumi yayamihi a saa ngɔ haa se pi Mawu; se i sume kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mumi yayamihi bɔɔ huɛ.
Nyɛ be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kplu ɔ kɛ mumi yayamihi a kplu ɔ nyɛe maa nu si kake.
Nyɛ be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ ni kɛ mumi yayamihi a nɔ ɔ nɔ ni nyɛe maa ye si kake.
Aloo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi la wa ngɛ woe?
Anɛ wa he wa pe lɛ lo?
“Wa ngɛ nihi tsuo he blɔ,” se pi nihi tsuo nɛ hi.
“Wa ngɛ nihi tsuo he blɔ,” se pi nihi tsuo nɛ haa nɔ nane nuu si.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko plee ngɔ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, se mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ plee ngɔ ha e nyɛmi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ juae ngɛ lo jua nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye; se he ni lemi he ɔ, nyɛ ko bi mi; ejakaa “zugba a kɛ e mi ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ ʼi.” Ke nihi nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko kpee nyɛ ni yemi nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa ya a, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa ma nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɛ nyɛ ko bi mi, ngɛ he ni lemi he.
Se ke nɔ ko de nyɛ ke: “Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ amaga bɔ sami nihi ʼi” ɔ, nyɛ ko ye ngɛ nɔ nɛ wo nyɛ tue nɔ ɔ kɛ he ni lemi he je.
Se he ni lemi nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ ɔ, pi mo nitsɛ o nɔ ɔ, se mohu nɔ kpa nɔ ɔ.
Se mɛ he je nɔ kpa he ni lemi maa kojo ye he yemi ɔ?
Ke sina i kɛ ye ɔ, mɛ he je a tuɔ ye he munyu yaya ngɛ nihi nɛ i na si ngɛ he ɔmɛ a he?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ni nyɛ ngɛ yee jio, ni nyɛ ngɛ nue jio, aloo nɔ kpa ko nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee jio, nyɛɛ pee kulaa kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɛ ko pee kpangmi ngɔ ha Yudafohi kɛ Helabihi kɛ Mawu asafo ɔ kulaa; kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i suɔ kaa nihi kulaa mi ɔ ma sa nihi kulaa a hɛ mi, nɛ i hla we nɔ́ nɛ hi ha imi nitsɛ ye he, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ hi ha nihi fuu, konɛ a he a yiwami.
Yinɔhami ngɛ sɔlemi Nyɛɛ kase mi kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i kaseɔ Kristo ɔ.
Se, mamimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ yi jee kaa nyɛ kaii mi ngɛ nihi tsuo mi, nɛ tsɔɔmihi nɛ i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ hɛɛ mi bɔ pɛ nɛ i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ.
Se i suo kaa nyɛɛ le kaa nyumu tsuaa nyumu yi ji Kristo, nɛ yo tsuaa yo hu yi ji nyumu, nɛ Kristo yi ji Mawu.
Nyumu nɛ sɔlee aloo e gbaa nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ ko haa e yi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ e yi ɔ he guɛ gbee.
Se yo tsuaa yo nɛ sɔlee aloo e gbaa nɛ e hɛ̃ɛ e yi ɔ nɔ gu ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɛ e yi ɔ he guɛ gbee; ejakaa e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e sɛ e yi nɔuu kɛ.
Ejakaa ke yo hɛ́ e yi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e sã e yi ɔ nɔ mɔ.
Se ke e ngɛ lɛ zo pee kaa e ma sã eyi ɔ nɔ loo e maa sɛ e yi ɔ, lɛɛ e ha e yi ɔ nɔ mɔ.
Se nyumu lɛɛ, e sɛ kaa e haa e yi ɔ nɔ, ejakaa Mawu subai kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ji lɛ; se yo lɛɛ, nyumu hɛ mi nyami ji lɛ.
Ejakaa nyumu ji yo mi, se yo mohu lɛɛ je nyumu mi.
Nɛ jehanɛ hu, a bɔɛ nyumu ngɛ yo he se yo mohu a bɔ ngɛ nyumu he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e sa nɛ yo nɛ na he wami he okadi ko ngɛ e vi ɔ nɔ.
Ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyumu ko si yo se, nɛ ɔ hu ko si nyumu se.
Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ yo je nyumu mi ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ nyumu hu gu yo mi kɛ ba; se nihi kulaa je Mawu mi.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hla mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Anɛ e ngɛ fɛu kaa yo maa sɔle ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nɛ e hɛ́ e yi nɔ lo?
Anɛ fɔmi su nitsɛ tsɔɔ we nyɛ kaa, ke nyumu fia e yi kusuu ɔ, e ngɛ zo ha lɛ, se yo lɛɛ ke e fia e yi kusuu ɔ, e ji hɛ mi nyami ha lɛ lo?
Ejakaa a kɛ yi bwɔmi ɔ ha lɛ kaa he hami nɔ.
Se ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e pee e he nya sãlɔ ngɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pee we ja, nɛ Mawu asafo ɔmɛ hu pee we ja.
Nyɔmtsɛ Niyeni ɔ Kita nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ, pi nyɛ yi nɛ i kɛ ngɛ jee, ejakaa ke nyɛ kpe ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi, se mohu nɔ́ yaya lɛ jee mi.
Se kekleekle ɔ, i nuɔ kaa ke nyɛ ya bua nyɛ he nyɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ, mi gbamihi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ i heɔ yeɔ fã kɛ fã; ejakaa e sa kaa migbami nɛ te si ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti konɛ ni kpakpa amɛ a je a he si paa ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Jehanɛ ke nyɛ nya ba bua ngɛ he kake ɔ, pi Nyɔmtsɛ Niyeni ɔ yemi nɛ nyɛ ba; ejakaa kikɛmɛ a nyɛ ni yemi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e ni ye ni nɛ e yeɔ, nɛ benɛ hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, blɔɔ nɔ ko de da.
Anɛ nyɛ be wehi nɛ nyɛ maa ye ni nɛ nyɛ maa nu ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ lo?
Aloo Mawu asafo ɔ he guɛ nyɛ ngɛ gbee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si puee ɔ?
Kɛ ma de nyɛ kɛɛ?
Ma je nyɛ yi lo?
Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ i be nyɛ yi jee ngɛ he.
Ejakaa imi nitsɛ nɔ́ nɛ i na kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ dɛ mi nɛ i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa: Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ɔ, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo, nɛ e na si, nɛ e kuɔ mi, nɛ e ke: “Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a kuɔ ngɛ nyɛ ke.
Nyɛɛ pee e nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.” Ja nɔuu e wo kplu ɔ hu ngɛ niyeni ɔ se, nɛ e ke: “Kikɛmɛ a kplu nɛ ɔ ji somi he ɔ ngɛ ye muɔ ɔ mi.
Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ; si abɔ nɛ nyɛ maa nu ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.” Ejakaa si abɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ kikɛmɛ a bolo nɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ nuu kikɛmɛ a kplu nɛ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbenɔ ɔ jajee kɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛ maa su be nɛ e maa ba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ kikɛmɛ a abolo nɛ ɔ nɛ e nuu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kplu ɔ bɔ nɛ sɛ́ ɔ, e ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ e muɔ ɔ nɔ tɔe.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ka lɛ nitsɛ e he loko e ye abolo nɛ ɔ eko nɛ e nu kplu nɛ ɔ eko; ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɛ e nuu bɔ nɛ sɛ́ ɔ, kojomi mohu e yeɔ nɛ e nuu haa e he ejakaa e bui Nyɔmtsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ. Kɔlɔ ɔ he hu nɛ nyɛ ti nihi fuu ngɛ gboe nɛ a he wɛ mɛ, nɛ nihi babauu hu gbo nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se e ji wa kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he hyɛɛ jinɛ a be wɔ kojoe.
Se ke a kojo wɔ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi ʼi, benɛ pee nɛ a ko bu wɔ kɛ je ɔ kulaa fɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, ke nyɛ nya ba bua nɛ nyɛ maa ye ni ɔ, nyɛɛ mlɛ nyɛ sibi.
Se ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, e ye ni ngɛ we mi lolo, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he nya buami ɔ ko tsɛ kojomi ha nyɛ.
Nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ke i ba a, ma to mɛ blɔ nɔ.
Mumi mi dloomi nike nihi Jehanɛ, mamimɛ, i suɔ kaa ma ha nyɛɛ le nɔ́ ko ngɛ mumi mi nihi a he.
Nyɛ le kaa benɛ nyɛ ji wɔ jali ɔ, amaga mumuihi a ngɔ a kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a kpaka nyɛ ha a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa, nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ Mawu mumi mi ɔ, de we ke Yesu ɔ musutsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma de ke Yesu ji Nyɔmtsɛ hulɔ, kaa ja Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kpaka lɛ.
Dloomi nike nihi slɔɔtohi ngɛ, se mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa.
Sɔmɔmi ni tsumihi slɔɔtohi hu ngɛ, se Nyɔmtsɛ kake ɔ nɔuu a kɛ sɔmɔɔ; nɛ ni tsumihi slɔɔtohi hu ngɛ, se Mawu kake ɔ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ tsuo kulaa ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, a haa Mumi ɔ jeɔ e he kpo ngɛ e mi konɛ e hi ha nihi.
Mumi ɔ haa nɔ ko ni lemi munyu; nɛ nɔ ko hu jamɛ a Mumi ɔ nɔuu haa lɛ nihi a sisi nami he ni lemi.
Lɛ Mumi ɔ nɔuu haa nɔ ko hemi kɛ yemi; nɛ nɔ kpa hu tsami dloomi nike nihi, Nɔ ko ɔ, he wami nihi a tsumi; nɔ ko ɔ gbami; nɔ ko hu mumihi a si kpami; nɔ ko hu gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi; nɛ nɔ kpa hu munyuhi a sisi tsɔɔmi.
Se kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa a, Mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ tsuo, nɛ e dlaa ngɔ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ kakaaka, bɔ nɛ e suɔ.
Nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ e he nihi slɔɔtohi Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kake ʼi, se e hɛɛ he nihi fuu, nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nihi fuu ɔ kulaa ji nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ, ja nɔuu hu ji Kristo.
Ejakaa Yudafohi ji wɔ jio, Helabihi ji wɔ jio, nyɔguɛhi jio, he yeli jio, wɔ tsuo ɔ Mumi kake mi a gu a baptisi wɔ ngɔ wo nɔmlɔ tso kake mi; nɛ wɔ tsuo Mumi kake akɛ ha wɔ nɛ waa nu.
Ejakaa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hu pi he nɔ kake ʼi, se fuu ʼi.
Ke nane ma de ke: “Akɛnɛ i pi nine he je ɔ, i pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ eko” ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ eko lo?
Nɛ ke tue hu ma de ke: “Akɛnɛ i pi hɛngmɛ he je ɔ, i pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ eko” ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ eko lo?
Ke nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ kulaa ji hɛngmɛ ɔ, jije nɔ numi ngɛ?
Ke nɔ numi sɔuu ʼi ɔ, jije nɔ he fu numi ɔ ngɛ?
Se jehanɛ Mawu kɛ he nɔ́ tsuaa he nɔ́ ma nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he bɔ nɛ e suɔ.
Se ke mɛ kulaa ji he nɔ́ kake ɔ, jije nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ngɛ?
Se jehanɛ he nihi fuu ʼi mohu, se nɔmlɔ tso kake ʼi.
Hɛngmɛ be nyɛe ma de nine ke: “I be o he ni tsumi;” nɛ jehanɛ hu yi be nyɛe ma de nanehi ke: “I be nyɛ he ni tsumi.” Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nihi nɛ peɔ wɔ kaa a he wɛ́ kulaa a, mɛ mohu a he hiaa wɔ titli, nɛ nihi nɛ e peɔ wɔ kaa a ji nɔmlɔ tso he nihi nɛ hɛ mi be nyami kulaa a, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ titli a hɛ mi nyami wa woɔ, nɛ wa he nihi nɛ be fɛu ɔ mohu naa he fɛu; se wa he nihi nɛ ngɛ fɛu momo ɔ, a hia we hɛ mi nyami womi.
Se Mawu tsla nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ngɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ titli e kɛ bu haa; konɛ mi gbami nɛ ko ba nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi, se mohu he ni ɔmɛ nɛ baa a sibi a yi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nɛ ke he nɔ kake ngɛ nɔ nae ɔ, he ni ɔmɛ kulaa kɛ lɛ naa nɔ.
Nɛ ke he nɔ kake hɛ mi ba nyami hu, he ni ɔmɛ kulaa kɛ lɛ naa bua jɔmi.
Jehanɛ nyɛ tsuo ɔ, Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ji nyɛ, nɛ kakaaka a, e he nihi.
Nɛ kekleekle ɔ, Mawu wo ni komɛ bɔfohi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi, nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, gbali, nɔ́ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, tsɔɔli; kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ he wami ni tsuli, kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ, hiɔhi a tsami dloomi nike nihi, yemi kɛ buami, nɔyemihi, gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi.
Anɛ nihi tsuo ji bɔfohi lo?
Anɛ nihi tsuo ji gbali lo?
Anɛ nihi tsuo ji tsɔɔli lo?
Anɛ nihi tsuo ji he wami ni tsuli lo?
Anɛ nihi tsuo lɛ ngɛ hiɔhi a tsami dloomi nike nihi lo?
Anɛ nihi tsuo lɛ tuɔ munyu slɔɔtohi lo?
Anɛ nihi tsuo lɛ tsɔɔ munyuhi a sisi lo?
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ ngɛ dloomi nike nihi nɛ hi saminya amɛ a he.
Nɛ ma kpale tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ nɛ hi pe kulaa.
Suɔmi Ke i kɛ nimli kɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi a lilɛ tuɔ munyu se be suɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i ngɛ kaa ayawa nɛ jijeɔ loo ngmlɛ nɛ pɛɛ.
Nɛ ke i ngɛ gbami, nɛ i naa laami mi nihi kulaa nya, nɛ i le nihi kulaa, nɛ ke i ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kulaa hulɔ, bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ yokuhi ma hia, se i be suɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i pi nɔ́ ko?
Nɛ ke i ngɔ ye nihi kulaa ngɔ ke nihi, nɛ ke i ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso ngɔ ha nɛ a sa mi, se i be suɔmi ɔ, i na we se ko.
Suɔmi toɔ e tsui si, e mi mi hi; suɔmi ji hunga; suɔmi fiɛ̃, e pee we pupuupu, e pee we nihi nɛ sɛ, e plee we lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ he, e mi mi wui la, e kɛ nɔ tɔmi wui e mi.
E nya we nɔ yayami he, se mohu e nyaa anɔkuale he?
Suɔmi maa e nya ngɛ nihi kulaa mi, e heɔ nihi kulaa yeɔ, e ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi, e miaa e hɛ mi ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.
Suɔmi se pui gblegbleegblee.
Se ke gbamihi ʼi ɔ, a se maa po; ke munyuhi slɔɔtohi a tumi ʼi ɔ, a maa jɔɔ; ke ni lemi ʼi ɔ, e se maa po.
Ejakaa wa ni nɛ wa le ɔ, fã kɛ fã ʼi, nɛ wa gbami hu fa kɛ fa ʼi.
Se ke nɔ́ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ ba a, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji fa kɛ fa a se maa po.
Benɛ i ji bimwɔyo ɔ, i tuɔ munyu kaa bimwɔyo, i juɛɛ ni a he kaa bimwɔyo, i susuu kaa bimwɔyo; se benɛ i ba plɛ nyumu nɔkɔtɔma a, i sake bimwɔwi a ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue se.
Ejakaa mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ahuhuɛ mi wa guu kɛ hyɛɛ nɔ tsuu, se jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.
Mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, i le ni fã kɛ fã, sɛ jamɛ a bɛ ɔ ɔ mi ɔ, ma lɛ ni kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ a le mi kɛ pi si ɔ.
Se jehanɛ hemi kɛ yemi, hɛ kɛ nɔ tɔmi, suɔmi, kikɛmɛ a nihi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ hii si; se suɔmi ji a kpɛti nɔ nɛ pe kulaa.
Mumi mi dloomi nike nihi Nyɛɛ di suɔmi se.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ ngɛ mumi mi nihi a he, se titli ɔ, gbami.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔto ko ɔ, pi nimli nɛ e kɛ ngɛ tue, se Mawu mohu, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko nui, se mumi mi e ngɛ laami munyu ɔmɛ tue ngɛ.
Nɔ nɛ gbaa a, nimli e gbaa ngɔ tsɔɔ konɛ e kɛ ha a nane nɛ nu si nɛ e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ nɛ e jɔɔ a bua.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔto ko ɔ, yeɔ buaa lɛ nitsɛ e he, se nɔ nɛ gbaa a, e yeɔ buaa asafo ɔ.
Se i ko suɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ko tu munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔtohi Se nɔ́ nɛ i ko suɔ titli ji kaa nyɛɛ gba, ejakaa nɔ nɛ gbaa a, e pe nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔtohi, ja e tsɔɔ sisi hulɔ konɛ e ye bua asafo ɔ kulaa.
Jehanɛ, mamimɛ, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ba tu munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔtohi nɛ pi kpo jemi loo ni lemi loo gbami loo ni tsɔɔmi ko ɔ, mɛni se i haa nyɛ naa?
Kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ wami be mi ɔ pɛɛ ɔ, bɛ jio, saku jio, ke e pɛmi ɔ mi tsɔ we ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a maa le nɔ nɛ a ngɛ kpae aloo nɔ nɛ a ngɛ fiae ɔ nɛɛ?
Ejakaa ke titimati pɛ́ pɛmi nɛ ngɛ faii ɔ, mɛnɔ ma dla e he ngɔ to ta?
Ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛ hu, ngɛ munyu tumi blɔfami ɔ, ke nyɛ tu we munyu nɛ sisi ngɛ faii ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a maa le nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ?
Ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ munyu tue woɔ kɔhiɔ mi.
Gbi slɔɔtohi fuu ngɛ je ɔ mi mohu, se eko eko be nɛ be sisi.
Se jehanɛ ke i nui munyu ɔ sisi ɔ, lɛɛ ma plɛ maje no ngɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ hu ma plɛ maje no ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
Be abɔ nɛ nyɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ mumi mi nihi a he ɔ, ja nɔuu hu nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde konɛ nyɛɛ be nɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ ma ha asafo ɔ maa wa a mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ lilɛ slɔɔto ko ɔ, e sɔle konɛ e nyɛ sisi hu nɛ e tsɔɔ.
Ejakaa ke i sɔlee kɛ lilɛ slɔɔto ɔ, ye mumi ɔ sɔlee lɛɛ, se ye juɛmi ɔ piɛ we he.
Jeha nɛ kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?
I kɛ mumi maa sɔle, nɛ i kɛ juɛmi hu maa sɔle.
Ma fia kɛ mumi, nɛ ma la kɛ juɛmi hulɔ.
Ejakaa ke o kɛ mumi ngɛ Mawu yi jee ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ li mi eko ɔmɛ a blɔ he ɔ ma de Amen ngɔ si o sina a nɔ, akɛnɛ e li nɔ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ?
Moo lɛɛ, o ngɛ si nae saminya mohu, se kɛ ɔ, o yi bua we nɔ kpa a kulaa.
I naa ye Mawu ɔ si kaa i pe nyɛ tsuo ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi mi.
Se ke ɔ, ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ, i suɔ kaa i kɛ ye juɛmi nɛ tu munyu kakaaka enuɔ, konɛ ma kɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi a ni mohu, pe nɔ nɛ ma tu munyu kakaaka akpe nyɔngma ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a mi.
Mamimɛ, nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he jokuɛwi ngɛ juɛmi blɔfami, se yayami blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he bimwɔwi, se juɛmi blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he nihi nɛ a wa.
A ngma ngɛ Mlaa a mi ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: Gbi slɔɔtohi a mi kɛ nya slɔɔtohi a nɔ Ma gu nɛ i kɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ maa tu munyu, Se lɔ ɔ hu tete a be mi tue bue.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ gbi slɔɔtohi ɔmɛ ɔ a pi okadi ha ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ, se mohu a ji okadi ha ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi.
Gbami ɔ, e pi ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a nɔ, se mohu ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ ye ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, ke asafo mluku ɔ tsuo nya ba bua ngɛ he kake, nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ gbi slɔɔtohi ngɛ munyu tue, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ li mi eko aloo ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ hu ba lejɛ ɔ, anɛ a be dee ke nyɛ ngɛ godo nue lo?
Se ke ni ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ gbae, nɛ nɔ ko nɛ he we yi aloo e li mi eko ba lejɛ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ tsuo ma kã lɛ, ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa kojo lɛ, a ma je e tsui mi laami nihi a kpo paa nɛ lɔ ɔ ma ha e kɛ e hɛ mi ma bu si nɛ e ja Mawu, nɛ e maa jaje ke Mawu ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti niinɛ.
Blɔnyatomi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi Lɛɛ mɛni mɔ, mamimɛ?
Ke nyɛ nya ba bua, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ la ko, nɔ ko hu ngɛ tsɔɔmi ko, nɔ ko ngɛ gbi slɔɔto ko, nɔ ko ngɛ kpo jemi ko, nɔ ko ngɛ sisi tsɔɔmi ko ɔ, a pee kulaa bɔ nɛ e maa ye bua nihi.
Ke a ngɛ gbi slɔɔto tue ɔ, nyɛ ha ni enyɔ loo ke e hiɛ hluu ɔ, ni etɛ pɛ nɛ tu, kakaaka, nɛ nɔ kake hu nɛ tsɔɔ sisi.
Ke sisi tsɔɔlɔ ko be ɔ, e ma e nya ngɛ asafo ɔ mi, se e tu munyu ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ Mawu.
Se gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, ni enyɔ loo ni etɛ nɛ tu munyu, nɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ a susu he.
Se ke a je nɔ ko kpo tsɔɔ nɔ ko nɛ hii si ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ e jɔɔ tumi.
Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa gba, kakaaka, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kase nɔ ko nɛ a tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi kulaa kɛ wo mɛ he wami.
Gbali a mumi baa a he si haa gbali ɔmɛ, ejakaa Mawu ɔ, e pi basabasa peemi Mawu, se mohu he jɔmi Mawu, kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ he tsɔli asafo ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ. Nyɛ ha yi ɔmɛ nɛ pee kɔ ngɛ asafo kpehi a mi, ejakaa a ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a tu munyu, se mohu a ba a he si kaa bɔ nɛ Mlaa a hu deɔ ɔ. Ke a suɔ kaa a kase nɔ ko ɔ, a bi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hunomɛ ngɛ we mi.
Ejakaa e ngɛ zo ha yihi kaa a maa tu munyu ngɛ asafo kpehi a mi.
Anɛ nyɛ ngɔ Mawu munyu ɔ je?
Aloo nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɔ e ba?
Ke e peɔ nɔ ko kaa gbalɔ loo mumi mi nɔmlɔ ji lɛ ɔ, e sa nɛ e le kaa nɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ nɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kita ʼi; se ke nɔ ko li enɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko le lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ ngɛ gbami he, nɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi hu nyɛ ko tsi nya.
A pee nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔ nɛ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ blɔ nya blɔ nya.
Kristo sitemi Jehanɛ, mamimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ kaie kaa Sane Kpakpa a nɛ i jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ pɛtɛ he hulɔ nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ mi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ a kɛ heɔ nyɛ yi wami hulɔ, ke nyɛ pɛtɛ he bɔ nɛ i jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, ke pi ja a lɛɛ nyɛ he ye yaka gu.
Ejakaa sanehi nɛ he hia pe kulaa nɛ a kɛ ha mi nɛ imi hu i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ ji kaa, Kristo gbo ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a nya, kaa a pu lɛ, nɛ a tle lɛ si ekohu ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a nya; nɛ kaa e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Kefa, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ pe lafa enuɔ si kake, nihi nɛ a ti nihi fuu ngɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ, se ni komɛ hu gbo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Yakobo, lɔ ɔ se ɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.
Se mɛ kulaa a se ɔ, e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ imi hulɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ a kpatu fɔ lɛ ɔ. Ejakaa imi lɛɛ, i ji enɔ wayo kulaa ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ i sɛ́ tete kaa a tsɛɛ mi bɔfo po, ejakaa i wa Mawu asafo ɔ yi mi.
Se Mawu dloomi nya i kɛ ji nɔ nɛ i ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ e dloomi nɛ e kɛ dloomi ɔ pee we yaka; se mohu, i tsu ni wawɛɛ pe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, se pi imi tete, se mohu Mawu dloomi nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, imi jio, mɛ jio, enɛ ɔ ji wa fiɛmi, nɛ enɛ ɔ hu ji nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ he ye.
Wa sitemi Jehanɛ ke a fiɛ ngɛ Kristo he kaa a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ti ni komɛ deɔ ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ?
Se ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo hu a tle we lɛ si.
Nɛ ke a tle we Kristo si ɔ, lɛɛ wa fiɛmi ɔ pee yaka, nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ hu pee yaka gu.
Jeha nɛ a kpa wɔ si kaa Mawu he lakpa odase yeli ji wɔ, ejakaa wa ye Mawu he odase kaa e tle Kristo si, nɔ nɛ, ke e ngɛ mi kaa ni gbogboehi ti si ɔ, lɛɛ e tle we lɛ si?
Ejakaa ke a tle we ni gbogboehi a si ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo hu a tle we lɛ si.
Nɛ jehanɛ ke a tle we Kristo si ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ pee yaka nɛ nyɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a mi kɛ mwɔɔ; lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nihi nɛ gbo ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ hu laa.
Ke wami nɛ ɔ mi kɛkɛ wa hɛ ngɛ Kristo nɔ ngɛ ɔ, wa ni ngɛ mɔbɔ pe nimli kulaa.
Se anɔkuale ɔ ji kaa, a tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, e pee kekleekle nɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ gbo ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ gbenɔ gu nɔmlɔ nɔ kɛ ba a, ja nɔuu si temi ɔ hu gu nɔmlɔ nɔ kɛ ba.
Ejakaa, kaa bɔ nɛ Adam mi nɛ nihi kulaa gboɔ ngɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ̃ Kristo mi nɛ mɛ kulaa a yi ma na wa ngɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ he: Kekleekle nɔ ji Kristo, lɔ ɔ se ɔ nihi nɛ ji Kristo ni ɔmɛ ngɛ e bami ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se loko nyagbe ɔ maa ba, benɛ e maa ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha Mawu nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ; nɛ e maa po nɔ yemi kulaa kɛ he blɔ kulaa kɛ he wami kulaa se ɔ. Ejakaa ja Kristo ye matsɛ kɛ maa su be nɛ Mawu maa ngɔ henyɛli kulaa ngɔ wo e nane si.
Nyagbe henyɛlɔ nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi ji gbenɔ.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke: “Mawu ngɔ nihi tsuo kulaa ngɔ wo e nane si.” Se ke e de ke a ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ wo e sisi ɔ, blɔɔ e ngɛ paa kaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ wo e sisi ɔ be mi.
Se e benɛ a ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ wo Bi ɔ sisi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ Bi ɔ nitsɛ hu maa ngɔ e he ngɔ wo nɔ nɛ ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ wo e sisi ɔ sisi, konɛ Mawu nɛ pee nihi kulaa yi.
Ejakaa, kɛ nihi nɛ haa a baptisii mɛ ngɛ ni gbogboehi a nane mi ɔ maa pee kɛɛ?
Ke ni gbogboehi be si tee kulaa a, mɛ he je mɔ nɛ a haa a baptisii mɛ ngɛ ni gbogboehi a nane mi ɔ?
Mɛ he je wɔ hu wa naa amane ngmlɛfia tsuaa ngmlɛfia a?
I na nyɛ he fiami nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, kaa i gboɔ daa nɛ ɔ. Ke nimli a blɔfami nɛ i kɛ “lohwe dikali” hwu ta ngɛ Efeso ɔ, jinɛ mɛni se i naa?
Ke ni gbogboehi ti si ɔ, “Nyɛ ha waa ye ni nɛ waa nu ni, ejakaa hwɔɔ ɔ wa ma gbo!” Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sisi nyɛ.
“Huɛ yaya bɔmi puɛɔ je mi bami kpakpa.” Nyɛ ha nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ tsɔ nyɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami; ejakaa nyɛ ti ni komɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ Mawu he.
I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee nɛ ma kɛ gbe nyɛ zo.
Nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a kɛ maa te si Se eko ɔ nɔ ko ma bi ke: “Kɛ ni gbogboehi maa pee kɛ te si kɛɛ?
Nɛ jehanɛ mɛni nɔmlɔ tso a ma kɛ ba?” Lohwe!
Nɔ́ nɛ mo nitsɛ o du ɔ, ja e gbo lolo loko e yi ma na wa.
Nɛ jehanɛ hu, nɔ́ nɛ o duɔ ɔ, pi tso nɛ maa puɛ ʼi, se mohu dumi wu ngmelu kɛkɛ, ke ngma jio, nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ eko ʼi jio.
Mawu haa wu ɔ tso bɔ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ wu tsuaa wu ɔ, e haa lɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tso.
Pi he lo tsuo ji he lo kake, se mohu eslo nimli a he lo, nɛ e slo lohwehi a he lo, eslo nyu mi lohi a nɔ, nɛ eslo lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ a nɔ hulɔ.
Hiɔwe nɔmlɔ tsohi ngɛ, nɛ zugba nɔ nɔmlɔ tsohi hu ngɛ; se kɛ ɔ eslo hiɔwe nihi a hɛ mi nyami, nɛ eslo zugba nɔ ni ɔmɛ hu a nɔ.
Eslo pu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ eslo hlami hu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ eslo dodoehi a hɛ mi nyami; ejakaa eslo dodoe kake hɛ mi nyami ngɛ dodoe kpa hɛ mi nyami he.
Jã nɔuu ji ni gbogboehi a sitemi ɔ hulɔ.
A duɔ lɛ ngɛ puemi mi, a tleɔ lɛ si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we mi; a duɔ lɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ be nyami mi, a tleɔ lɛ si ngɛ nyami mi; a duɔ lɛ ngɛ gbɔlemi mi, a tleɔ lɛ si ngɛ he wami mi.
A duɔ klaa nɔmlɔ tso, a tleɔ mumi nɔmlɔ tso si.
Ke klaa nɔmlɔ tso ngɛ ɔ, mumi nɔmlɔ tso hu ngɛ.
Jã a ngma hulɔ ke: “Adam nɛ ji kekle nɔmlɔ ɔ plɛ klaa nɛ hɛ ngɛ; nyagbe Adam ɔ plɛ mumi nɛ haa nɔ yi naa wa.” Se tsa pi mumi nɔ ɔ ji kekle nɔ, se mohu klaa nɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ se ɔ mumi nɔ ɔ. Kekle nɔmlɔ nɛ je zugba a mi ɔ, zu ʼi, nɔmlɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ je hiɔwe.
Bɔ nɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ no ɔ ngɛ ɔ, jã zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ; nɛ bɔ nɛ hiɔwe no ɔ ngɛ ɔ, ja hiɔwe bi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wa hɛɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ no ɔ subai ɔ, jã nɔuu wa maa hɛɛ hiɔwe no ɔ hu subai.
Mamimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ji kaa, he lo kɛ muɔ nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue, nɛ jehanɛ puemi hu nine be nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we ɔ nɔ sue.
Oʼɛ, laami sane i ngɛ nyɛ dee nɛ ɔ nɛ: Tsa pi wɔ tsuo kulaa nɛ wa ma gbo ɔ, se a ma tsake wɔ tsuo, tlukaa ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi, benɛ a ma kpa nyagbe titimati ɔ; ejakaa a ma kpa titimati, nɛ a ma tle ni gbogboehi a si nɛ a be puɛe hu, nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ, a ma tsake wɔ.
Ejakaa ja puɛmi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we ɔ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a gbomi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ gbo we ɔ.
Se benɛ kikɛmɛ a puemi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we ɔ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a gbomi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ gbo we ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ munyu nɛ a ngma a maa ba mi ke: “A mi gbenɔ ngɛ kunimi yemi mi.
Mo gbenɔ, jije o kɛ̃ɛ ɔ ngɛ?
Mo gbeje, jije o kunimi yemi ɔ ngɛ?” Se gbenɔ kɛ̃ɛ ji yayami, nɛ yayami he wami ji Mlaa a.
Se sina ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ guu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ haa wa yeɔ kunimi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ fi si nɛ nyɛ ko gbɔle, nɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ni tsumi ɔ mi daa nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ le kaa nyɛ dengme gbomi ɔ be yaka pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Oniatsumi kɛ ha Yerusalem asafo ɔ Jehanɛ ngɛ onia nɛ a tsuɔ kɛ haa Mawu webi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ i to ha Galatia asafo ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja.
Daa otsi kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je nɔ́ ko ngɔ to, ngɛ bɔ nɛ e naa a nya, konɛ ma ko ba loko a tsu onia a. Nɛ ke i ba a, ma tsɔ nihi nɛ nyɛ buu kaa a sa kɛ womi nɛ a hɛɛ nyɛ nike ni ɔmɛ kɛ ya Yerusalem.
Se ke e sa kaa imi hu ma ya a, i kɛ mɛ maa ya.
Paulo yimitomi Se ma ya gu Makedonia loko ma ba nyɛ ngɔ, ejakaa Makedonia ma ya gu.
Eko ɔ ma hi nyɛ gɔ bɔɔ, nɛ eko ɔ ma ye fiɛ̃ be ɔ hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ he tsuaa he nɛ i yaa a nɛ nyɛ ya je mi blɔ.
Ejakaa i sume kaa ma na nyɛ ngɛ blɔ kpɛ kɛkɛ, se ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ngmɛ mi blɔ ɔ, ma kɛ bɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ.
Se ma hi Efeso kɛ maa su Pentekoste ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa a bli sinya kpetekpleenyɛ nya ha mi, kɛ ha ni tsumi fuu nɛ maa wo yiblii, se ninɛmɛ nɛ kuɔ nya a hu hiɛ.
Ke Timoteo ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ni tsumi nɔuu e ngɛ tsue kaa imi.
Kɔlɔ ɔ he ɔ nɔ ko ko bu lɛ kaa pi nɔ ko ji lɛ; se nyɛ je lɛ blɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi konɛ e ba ye ngɔ.
Ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e kɛ nyamimɛ ɔmɛ maa ba.
Wa nyɛmi Apolo ɔ, i kpa lɛ pɛɛ hluu nɛ e kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, se e kplɛɛ we kulaa kaa e maa ba amlɔ nɛ ɔ, se ke e na e he deka hu e maa ba.
Nyagbe munyuhi Nyɛɛ huɔ, nyɛɛ da si kpɛii ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, nyɛɛ pee nyumu, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ wa!
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ nihi kulaa ngɛ suɔmi mi.
Mamimɛ, nyɛ le Stefana we mi bi ɔmɛ kaa mɛ ji Akaia kekleekle yiblii, nɛ a ngɔ Mawu webi ɔmɛ a sɔmɔmi ɔ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ.
I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha ni nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ni nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde ɔ. I na buajɔmi ngɛ Stefana kɛ Fortunato kɛ Akaiko bami ɔ he, ejakaa nɛ nyɛ be ye ngɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛ lɛ a ba ye nyɛ nɛne mi.
Ejakaa a ba wo ye bua kaa bɔ nɛ a wo nyɛ hu nyɛ bua a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nyɛɛ le mɛ saminya.
Asia asafo ɔmɛ biɔ nyɛ.
Akwila kɛ Priskila kɛ asafo nɛ ngɛ a we ɔ mi ɔ biɔ nyɛ saminya ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kulaa biɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛ nga nyɛ he kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuklɔu.
Ami Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya biɔmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔ ko sume Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sane ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ e plɛ musutsɛ!
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ, ba!
(Maran ata.)
Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!
Ye suɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi!
Amen.
Imi Paulo, nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ɔ ngma ya ha Mawu asafo nɛ ngɛ Korinto kɛ he tsɔli kulaa nɛ ngɛ Akaia tsuo ɔ: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa tsɛ Mawu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ.
Paulo naa Mawu si A gbaa Mawu kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji mi mi sali a tsɛ, kɛ ɛbua womi kulaa Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ jɔɔ wa bua ngɛ wa nɔ nami ɔmɛ kulaa mi, konɛ wɔ hu wa nyɛ nɛ waa kɛ bua womi nɛ Mawu kɛ woɔ wa bua a nɛ wo nihi nɛ naa amanehlu tsuaa amanehlu ɔmɛ a bua.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ Kristo amanehlu ɔmɛ baa wa nɔ kɛ bee nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ Kristo he ɔ, wa bua womi ɔ hu hiɛɛ kɛ bee nɔ.
Se ke amanehlu wa naa a, nyɛ bua womi kɛ yi wami hemi he ʼi; nɛ ke wa bua a woɔ hu, e ji nyɛ bua womi nɛ haa nyɛ toɔ nyɛ tsui si kpoo kɛ naa amanehlu nɛ wa naa a nɔuu eko.
Nɛ wa hɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ gbɔle we, ejakaa wa le kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ naa amanehlu ɔ eko ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛ naa bua womi ɔ hu eko.
Mamimɛ, wa sume kaa waa ngɔ wa nɔ́ nɛ wa na ngɛ Asia a kɛ laa nyɛ.
Wa na nɔ tsɔ, pe bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ po, nɛ wa hɛ be je mi himi nɔ tete.
Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa na ngɛ wa mi paa kaa wa ma gbo, konɛ wa ko ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he nɔ, se mohu wa ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɛ tleɔ ni gbogboehi a si ɔ nɔ, Mawu nɛ je wɔ kɛ je gbenɔ nɛ ngɛ gbeye nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɛ wɔ jee kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ e nɔ kaa e maa kpale je wɔ kulaa.
Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ piɛ wa he kɛ kpa pɛɛ konɛ nihi fuu nɛ na si ha wɔ ngɛ dloomi nike nihi nɛ a kɛ ha wɔ ngɛ nihi fuu a pɛɛ kpami ɔ he.
Paulo tsake e yimitomi ɔmɛ Se wa fiami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: wa he ni lemi odase nɛ e yeɔ wɔ, kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu peemi kɛ he tsɔmi mi wa ba wa je mi ngɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, titli ɔ, ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ pi he lo mi ni lemi nya, se mohu Mawu dloomi nya.
Ejakaa wa ngmɛ́ ni kpahi ha we nyɛ, pe nihi nɛ nyɛ kaneɔ nɛ jehanɛ hu nyɛ le, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ maa le kɛ maa ya nyagbe hulɔ ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ na le wɔ hulɔ fa kɛ fa, kaa nyɛ fiami nɔ́ ji wɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ji wa nɔ́ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ he je nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ kekle ɔ nɛ, konɛ nyɛ na dloomi si enyɔ.
Ma ba gu nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ya Makedonia, nɛ jehanɛ hu ma kpale ye se kɛ je Makedonia kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu, konɛ nyɛ ya je mi blɔ kɛ ya Yudea.
Blɔɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi kikɛ ɔ, yi flɛflɛ i kɛ pee lo?
Aloo ye yi mi nɛ i to ɔ, he lo nya i to ngɛ konɛ ma de “Ee,” kɛ “Dɛbi,” ngɛ be kake mi lo?
Mawu ji wa odase, kaa wa munyu nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, e pi “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” ngɛ be kake mi.
Ejakaa Mawu bi Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ i kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo fiɛ e he sane ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e pi “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” se mohu e ji “Ee”.
Ejakaa Mawu si womihi abɔ nɛ ngɛ ɔ, e mi “Ee” ɔ ngɛ, nɛ e mi nɔuu “Amen” ɔ ngɛ, konɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Se Mawu ji nɔ nɛ haa waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo nane pii si ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ e pɔ wɔ nu, nɛ e sɔu wa nya, nɛ e kɛ Mumi ɔ yi ba pomi nɔ́ ha wɔ ngɛ wa tsui mi hulɔ.
Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ Mawu tsɛe nɛ ba ye ye klaa he odase kaa yɛ yi baami he je nɛ i na we ma ba Korinto ɔ nɛ.
Wa yi nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nyɔguɛ, ejakaa nyɛ daa si tutuutu ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, se mohu wa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ ngɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi he ni tsue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i pee ye juɛmi kaa i kɛ kɔmɔ yemi be nyɛ ngɔ bae hu.
Ejakaa ke i ha nyɛ ye kɔmɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ haa ye bua jɔɔ mɔ, kaa ja nɔ nɛ i ha e ye kɔmɔ ɔ nɔuu?
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ngma nyɛ enɛ ɔ, konɛ, ke i ba a, ma ko ba ye kɔmɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ jinɛ sa kaa i naa a he bua jɔmi ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ kaa ye bua jɔmi ji nyɛ tsuo nyɛ bua jɔmi.
Se tsui yemi kɛ fimi babauu mi i je kɛ ngma nyɛ, kɛ gu vo nyu babauu hu mi, tsa pi nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ he je, se mohu nɛ nyɛɛ na suɔmi babauu nɛ i suɔ nyɛ.
Nɔtɔlɔ he yayamipami Se ke nɔ ko ha a ye kɔmɔ ɔ, pi imi nɛ e ha i ye kɔmɔ se (kone ye nya nɛ ko wa tsɔ ɔ) e ha nyɛ kulaa nyɛ ye kɔmɔ ko kɛ.
Jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ, e hɛ mi nɛ nihi fuu kã a hiɛ ha lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ nyɛ kɛ pa lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ e bua mohu, konɛ kɔmɔ yemi fuu tsɔ ɔ ko ba ha e nine mi nɛ wo nyu.
