Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpaa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ha e le kaa nyɛ suɔ lɛ, ejakaa enɛ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ womi ɔ nɛ, konɛ ma kɛ ka nyɛ kaa nyɛ buɔ tue ngɛ nihi kulaa mi lo?
Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ ko paa lɛ ɔ, imi hu i kɛ paa lɛ, ejakaa imi hu, ke i kɛ nɔ́ ko pa a, nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ pa a, i kɛ pa ngɛ nyɛ he ngɛ Kristo hɛ mi, konɛ Satan nine nɛ ko su wa nɔ, ejakaa e juɛmi ɔmɛ ɔ a kɛ laa wɔ.
Paulo tsuiyemi ngɛ Troa Bene i ba Troa ngɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a he nɛ ya bli sinya ha mi ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i hao ngɛ mumi mi, ejakaa i nɛ́ ye nyɛmi Tito; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i sɛ mɛ nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ba Makedonia.
Kunimiyemi kɛ gu Kristo nɔ Se sina ha Mawu, ejakaa ngɛ waa kɛ Kristo kake peemi mi ɔ, e haa wa yeɔ kunimi daa, nɛ e haa e he nilemi he via a guu wa nɔ jee kpo ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Ejakaa Kristo he viami kpakpa ji wɔ ha Mawu ngɛ nihi nɛ a heɔ a yi wami kɛ nihi nɛ a hɛ mi kpataa a kulaa mi: ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa ji gbenɔ via ha mɛ kɛ yaa gbenɔ mi, se ni kpa amɛ ɔ, wa ji wami via ha mɛ kɛ yaa wami mi.
Nɛ mɛnɔ lɛ sa ha enɛ ɔmɛ?
Ejakaa wa be kaa ni komɛ nɛ juaa Mawu munyu ɔ, se mohu wa tuɔ lɛ ngmingmiingmi bɔ nɛ e je Mawu mi ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, ngɛ Kristo mi.
Somi He ɔ he sɔmɔli Anɛ pe wa kpale ngɛ wa he yi jee?
Aloo e hia kaa wa hɛɛ yi jemi womi, kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ hɛɛ kɛ ba haa nyɛ loo kɛ jee nyɛ ngɔ ɔ lo?
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ji wa womi nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo wa tsui mi nɛ nihi tsuo le nɛ a kaneɔ.
A je nyɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ paa kaa nyɛ ji Kristo womi nɛ wa ngma, pi kɛ ni ngmami nyu, se mohu Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ mumi ɔ a kɛ ngma, pi ngɛ tɛ sleetihi a nɔ, se mohu tsui nɛ ji he lo sleeti nɔ.
Kristo he nɛ wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu blɔfami: pi kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ ɔ wa sa nɛ wa susu kaa nɔ ko je wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa mi, se wa sami ɔ Mawu mi nɛ e je; lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ha wa sa, nɛ wa plɛ Somi He ɔ he sɔmɔli, pi ngmami okadi nɔ́ se mohu mumi nɔ́, ejakaa ngmami okadi ɔ gbee nɔ, se mumi ɔ haa nɔ yi naa wami.
Se ke gbenɔ sɔmɔmi nɛ a kpɛ ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ ɔ hɛ mi ba nyami bɔ nɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ nyɛ we Mose hɛ mi nɛ a hyɛ po ngɛ nyami nɛ se poo ɔ he ɔ, anɛ mumi sɔmɔmi ɔ be nyami pee hluu pe kɔlɔ ɔ lo?
Ejakaa, ke fɔ bumi sɔmɔmi ɔ hɛ mi ba nyami ɔ, anɛ dami sɔmɔmi ɔ hɛ mi be nyami bae kɛ be nɔ lo?
Niinɛ, ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hɛ mi nyami sa a, hɛ mi be nyami bae hu ngɛ hɛ mi nyami kpã nɛ pã lɛ ɔ he.
Ejakaa ke nɔ́ nɛ se poo ɔ ba kɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ɔ mohu hɛ mi nyami ɔ hiɛ hluu.
Jehanɛ, akɛnɛ wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa peɔ ka babauu, nɛ wa pee we kaa Mose nɛ kɛ hɛ mi hami nɔ ha e hɛ mi, konɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ ko hyɛ nɔ nɛ se poo ɔ nya gbemi ɔ.
Se mohu a nga a juɛmi nya.
Ejakaa kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, jamɛ a hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ nɔuu lɛ ha Somi Momo ɔ kanemi ɔ nɔ; ejakaa Kristo mi pɛ nɛ e se poo ngɛ.
Se kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ a ngɛ Mose Womi ɔ kanee ɔ, hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ha a tsuihi a nɔ; se ke a kpale a se kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, a ma je hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ. Jehanɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji Mumi ɔ nɛ; nɛ he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ he yemi ngɛ.
Se wɔ kulaa nɛ waa kɛ hɛ mi kpetekplee hyɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, kaa a hyɛɛ ahuhuɛ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ tsakee kɛ ngɛ jamɛ a subai ɔ nɔuu plɛe kɛ ngɛ hɛ mi nyami mi jee kɛ yaa hɛ mi nyami mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ je Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ ji Mumi ɔ ngɔ.
Mumi mi juetli ngɛ zu buɛhi a mi Akɛnɛ wa hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a na wɔ mɔbɔ ɔ, wa ji fɔ́, Wa kua zo nihi nɛ a kɛ laa a, nɛ wa bɛ wa je mi ngɛ kutupɔ mi, nɛ jehanɛ hu wa futuu we Mawu munyu ɔ, se mohu waa kɛ anɔkuale ɔ kpo jemi ɔ jeɔ wa he yi ngɔ tsɔɔ ni mli a he nilemi tsuo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Se ke pe a ha wa Sane Kpakpa a nɔ tete po ɔ, nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae ɔmɛ a mi kɛkɛ a ha nɔ ngɛ, nihi a mi nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi mawu ɔ yu nihi nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a hɛngmɛ ngɛ, konɛ Kristo, nɛ ji Mawu subai ɔ, hɛ mi nyami ɔ sane kpakpa a la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ɔ nɛ ko kpɛ ha mɛ.
Ejakaa pi wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he nɛ wa ngɛ fiee, se mohu Kristo Yesu, kaa lɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ sɔmɔli ji wɔ ngɛ Yesu he.
Ejakaa Mawu nɛ de ke: “La nɛ je diblii mi nɛ e kpɛ” ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e kpɛ ngɛ wa tsui mi hulɔ, konɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami he ni lemi ɔ nɛ kpɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi.
Se wa hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a juetli nɛ ɔ ngɛ zu buɛhi a mi, konɛ he wami nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ ɔ nɛ pee Mawu nɔ́, se pi wa nɔ́.
A haoɔ wɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a yi wa nɔ; wa yi mi peɔ wɔ enyɔ enyɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa nine mi wui nyu; a waa wɔ yi mi, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a kua we wɔ; a fiaa wɔ si, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa gbo we; daa nɛ ɔ wa hɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbenɔ ɔ ngɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi kɛ nyɛɛ, konɛ Yesu wami ɔ hu nɛ je kpo ngɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi.
Ejakaa wɔ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, a tu wɔ ngɔ wo gbenɔ dɛ mi ngɛ Yesu he, konɛ Yesu wami ɔ hu nɛ je kpo ngɛ wa he lo nɛ ma gbo ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, gbenɔ tsuɔ ni ngɛ wa mi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, wami tsuɔ ni ngɛ nyɛ mi.
Se akɛnɛ wa ngɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mumi ɔ nɔuu, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ke: “I he ye, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ i de” ɔ, wɔ hu wa heɔ yeɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he je ɔ wa deɔ hulɔ; ejakaa wa le kaa nɔ nɛ tle Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si ɔ, e ma tle waa kɛ Yesu si, nɛ e kɛ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo ma ba da e hɛ mi.
Ejakaa nyɛ he nɛ a ngɛ enɛ ɔ kulaa pee, konɛ dloomi nɛ hiɛ babauu nɛ gu nihi fuu a sina nɔ kɛ be nɔ kɛ ha Mawu hɛ mi nyami womi.
Hemi kɛ yemi nya sihimi Lɔ ɔ he nɛ wa tsui pui ɔ nɛ, se ke wa kpo nɔ blɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ puɛɔ kulaa tete po ɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ, wa mi nɔmlɔ ɔ plɛɔ ehe daa ligbi.
Ejakaa wa nɔ nami nɛ nya wa nɛ se kɛ we nɛ ɔ ngɛ neneene hɛ mi nyami babauu nɛ be nɔ nɛ he jua wa hluu nya buae ha wɔ.
Wɔ nɛ wa pi nihi nɛ hyɛɛ nihi nɛ a naa a, se mohu nihi nɛ a nɛ ɔ wa hyɛɛ ɔ; ejakaa nihi nɛ a naa a hii si be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ, se nihi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔ hii si kɛ yaa neneene.
Ejakaa wa le kaa, ke a ku wa zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bo tsu nɔ hu, wa ngɛ tsu ko nɛ je Mawu ngɔ, we ko nɛ pi nine nɛ a kɛ pee, nɛ hii si kɛ yaa neneene, ngɛ hiɔwe.
Ejakaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa laa zanue tete ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi, nɛ wa hɛ jaa kaa a ngɔ wa tsu nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ ngɔ wo wɔ, nɛ ke a ngɔ wo wɔ kikɛ ɔ, lɔɔ lɛɛ a be wɔ nae kaa nihi nɛ hɛɛ a he gu.
Ejaka wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ hu, akɛnɛ wa he hiaa wɔ he je ɔ, wa laa zanue, ejakaa wa sume kaa a je wa he nihi, se mohu wa suɔ kaa a wo wɔ ni ngɔ pue nɔ, konɛ wami ɔ nɛ mi nɔ nɛ gboɔ ɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ dla wɔ ha tsakemi nɛ ɔ nɔuu ji Mawu, nɔ nɛ ha wɔ Mumi ɔ kaa se dami nɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa naa tsui daa, nɛ wa le kaa be abɔ nɛ wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ ɔ ɔ, wa doma kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ (ejakaa hemi kɛ yemi nya wa nyɛɛ ngɛ, se pi ni nami nya); se wa ngɛ tsui, nɛ e sa wa hɛ mi mohu kaa waa doma kɛ je nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ wa ya hi we ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ oti nɛ wa ngɔ ma wa hɛ mi ji kaa, we wa ngɛ jio, pe wa doma jio, nɛ waa sa e hɛ mi.
Ejakaa ja wɔ kulaa wa pue paa ngɛ Kristo kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na nihi nɛ e pee ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi ɔ he hiɔwo, bɔ nɛ e pee ɔ, kpakpa ʼi jio, yaya ʼi jio.
Mawu kɛ huɛbɔmi ngɛ Kristo mi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ wale Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he nɛ ngɛ gbeye he je ɔ, wa tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nimli, se Mawu le bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ he ni lemi mi hu ɔ nyɛ le wɔ.
Tsa pi wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa yi nɛ wa ngɛ jee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ekohu, se mohu waa kɛ ngɛ nyɛ blɔ hae konɛ nyɛ kɛ fia ngɔ fɔ wa nɔ, konɛ nyɛ na eko nɛ nyɛ kɛ de ninɛmɛ nɛ fiaa ngɛ hɛ mi se pi tsui mi ɔ. Ejakaa ke godo wa ngɛ nue ɔ, Mawu wa ngɛ nue kɛ ngɛ hae, nɛ ke wa ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ hu ɔ, e ngɛ ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa Kristo suɔmi ɔ nyɛɛ wa nɔ nɛ wa ngɔɔ lɛ kaa ke nɔ kake gbo nihi kulaa a yi gbenɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ni ɔmɛ kulaa gbo.
Nɛ e gbo nihi kulaa a yi gbenɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ, a hɛ ko hi ngmengmle ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he hu, se mohu a hɛ nɛ hi ngmengmle ha nɔ nɛ gbo nɛ a tle lɛ si ekohu ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, wa kojo we nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ he lo nya hu; nɛ ke be nɛ be ɔ mi ɔ wa le Kristo ngɛ he lo nya tete ɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ jehanɛ wa li lɛ ja hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, bɔ nɔ́ he ji lɛ; blema ni ɔmɛ be kɛ ho; oʼɛ, nihi kulaa plɛ ehe.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa je Mawu dɛ mi, nɔ nɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ dla waa kɛ Tsɛ ɔ kpɛti, nɛ e kɛ kpatami sɔmɔmi ɔ ha wɔ ɔ; lɔ ɔ ji kaa Mawu gu Kristo nɔ nɛ e kɛ je ɔ ngɛ huɛ pee, nɛ e bui a nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ hi mɛ, nɛ e tu huɛ peemi munyu ɔ ngɔ wo wa dɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ji bɔfohi ngɛ Kristo nane mi, kaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu gu wa nɔ nɛ e kɛ nihi ngɛ munyu tue: Wa daa si ngɛ Kristo nane mi ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae ke: Nyɛ ha a dla nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu kpɛti!
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ li yayami ɔ, wa he ɔ Mawu ha e plɛ yayami, konɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa plɛ Mawu dami ngɛ e mi.
Akɛnɛ wa ji Mawu hepiɛli ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔ mi he je ɔ, wa tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ konɛ nyɛ ko he Mawu dloomi ɔ yaka; ejakaa e ke: “Be nɛ sa mi i bu mo tue ngɛ, Nɛ yi wami hemi ligbi nɔ hu i ye bua mo ngɛ.” Oʼɛ, be nɛ sa saminya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; oʼɛ, yi wami hemi ligbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, wa pi kpangmi ha nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi, konɛ a ko gbe sɔmɔmi ɔ he guɛ, se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, waa kɛ wa he nɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu sɔmɔli ngɛ tsui si tomi babauu mi, ngɛ nɔ namihi a mi, ngɛ fimihi a mi, ngɛ he hiamihi a mi, ngɛ ni fiamihi a mi, ngɛ pamitsɛmɛ a tsuhi a mi, ngɛ hoo peemihi a mi, ngɛ dengme gbomihi a mi, ngɛ nyɔ fɔmihi a mi, ngɛ hwɔ hamihi a mi, ngɛ he tsɔmi mi, ngɛ ni lemi mi, ngɛ juɛmi nɛ se kɛɛ mi, ngɛ mi mi himi mi, ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi, ngɛ suɔmi klɔuu mi, ngɛ anɔkuale munyu tumi mi, ngɛ Mawu he wami mi, kɛ gu dami ta hwumi nihi kɛ ha hiɛ ɔ kɛ muɔ, kɛ gu hɛ mi nyami kɛ heguɛ gbemi mi; kɛ gu nɔ he munyu yaya tumi kɛ nɔ he munyu kpakpa tumi mi; kaa nɔ sisili, kɛ̃ ɔ anɔkualetsɛmɛ ji wɔ; kaa nihi nɛ a li mɛ, kɛ̃ ɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ le wɔ; kaa nihi nɛ a gbo, nɛ oʼɛ, wa hɛ ngɛ; kaa nihi nɛ ra gblaa a tue, se kɛ ɔ a gbi wɔ; kaa kɔmɔ yeli, se wa bua jɔɔ daa; kaa ohiafohi, se wa tsakee nihi fuu ngɔ peɔ niatsɛmɛ; kaa nihi nɛ be nɔ́ ko, se kɛ̃ ɔ wa ngɛ nihi kulaa.
Waa kɛ nyɛ tu munyu faii, Korintobi, wa pã wa tsui mi hu ha nyɛ.
Blɔ ngɛ wa mi ha nyɛ, se nyɛ mohu lɛ nyɛ nga nyɛ tsui nya wo wɔ.
Nyɛ hu nyɛ ha nyɛ tsui mi nɛ bli ja nɔuu nɛ nyɛ kɛ to wɔ nane mi (i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kaa ye bimɛ.)
Wɔjami he kɔkɔbɔmi Nyɛɛ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ ko pee kake.
Ejakaa mɛni bɔmi dami kɛ mlaatɔmi ngɛ?
Aloo mɛni bɔmi la kɛ diblii ngɛ?
Nɛ mɛni gbi kake peemi Kristo kɛ Belial ngɛ?
Aloo mɛni ni dlami nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ?
Nɛ jehanɛ hu, mɛni kake peemi Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ amagahi ngɛ?
Ejakaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ sɔlemi tsu ji nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu de ke: “Ma hi a mi, nɛ ma nyɛɛ a kpɛti, Nɛ ma pee a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.” Kɔlɔ ɔ he ɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke: “Nyɛɛ je a kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he Nɛ nyɛ ko ta mu nɔ́ ko he, Nɛ ma he nyɛ atuu.
Nɛ ma pee nyɛ tsɛ, Nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa pee ye bimɛ nyumuhi kɛ ye bimɛ yihi, Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, ope ɔ, de ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Jehanɛ, mamimɛ nɛ a suɔ, akɛnɛ wa na si womi nɛ ɔmɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ ha wa fɔ wa he kɛ je he lo kɛ mumi mi mu kulaa mi, nɛ waa hi kɛ pi si ngɛ he tsɔmi mi ngɛ Mawu gbeye yemi mi.
Paulo bua jɔmi Nyɛ ha wɔ blɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi!
Wa pee we nɔ ko nɔ ko yayami ko; wa puɛ we nɔ́ ko, wa yi nɔ ko amimi.
I de we enɛ ɔ nɛ ma kɛ bu nyɛ fɔ, ejakaa i de momo ke nyɛ ngɛ wa tsui mi, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ nɛ gbo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ yi nɛ na wami.
I ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi babauu ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ, i fiaa fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ babauu.
I hyi tɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, i hyi tɔ kɛ be nɔ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ wa nɔ nami ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ. Ejakaa bene wa ba Makedonia a hu ɔ, wa nɔmlɔ tso na we he jɔmi kulaa, se mohu he tsuaa he ɔ, nɔ́ sɔuu wa na; wa kpo nɔ blɔ ɔ, pɛ; wa mi blɔ ɔ, gbeye yemi.
Se Mawu, nɔ nɛ jɔɔ nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔmɛ a bua a, e kɛ Tito bami ɔ jɔɔ wa bua.
Se pi e bami ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu bua womi nɛ e na kɛ je nyɛ ngɔ ɔ hulɔ, ejakaa e ba bɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛ maa na mi, kɛ nyɛ kɔmɔ yemi ɔ, kɛ ye he mɔde nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bɔe ɔ, enɛ ɔ he ɔ i na bua jɔmi babauu pe keklee ɔ. Ke ye womi ɔ ha nɔ́ ko dɔ nyɛ po ɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ i pia we ye he.
E dɔ mi kɛ̃, ejakaa jamɛ a womi ɔ dɔ nyɛ mohu, se be kpiti kɛkɛ e dɔ nyɛ.
Se jehanɛ ɔ, ye bua jɔ, pi ngɛ dɔmi nɛ e dɔ nyɛ ɔ he, se mohu akɛnɛ e dɔ nyɛ nɛ e ha nyɛ pia nyɛ he ɔ he je.
Ejakaa e dɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi konɛ e ko je wɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko laa nyɛ.
Ejakaa dɔmi nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ tsɛɛ he piami nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa yi wami hemi mi kɛ baa, nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko pia we e he ngɛ he ɔ; se je nɛ ɔ mi dɔmi ɔ tsɛɛ gbenɔ kɛ baa.
Ejakaa oʼɛ, kikɛmɛ a dɔmi nɛ e dɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ mɔde bɔmi, nya jemi, tsui la womi, gbeye yemi, hɛja, hɛ dɔmi kɛ lue yemi tete nɛ e tsɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ mi!
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he tsɔɔ wɔ kaa nyɛ he tsɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i ngma nyɛ tete po ɔ, tsa pi nɔ nɛ tɔ ɔ he je, jehanɛ hu tsa pi nɔ nɛ a tɔ e nɔ ɔ he je, se mohu benɛ pee nɛ wa he mɔde nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bɔe ɔ nɛ je kpo paa ha nyɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa bua jɔ.
Se wa bua womi ɔ be nɔ babauu kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ wa na ngɛ Tito bua jɔmi ɔ he, ejakaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ha e tsui nɔ e mi.
Ejakaa ke i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ fia ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ, nyɛ gbi mi zo.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nihi tsuo ngɛ anɔkuale mi ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ wa fiami hu nɛ wa fia ngɔ tsɔɔ Tito ɔ pee anɔkuale.
Nɛ e ngɛ nyɛ he tsui babauu pe kekle ɔ, ejakaa e kaii nyɛ kulaa nyɛ tue bumi ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi he lɛ hɛmuɔ ɔ. I na bua jɔmi kaa ma nyɛ ma ngɔ ye he ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ kulaa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
Kristofohi a nɔhami Se, mamimɛ, wa ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le dloomi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha ngɛ Makedonia asafo ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, kaa nɔ nami ka babauu mi ɔ, a bua jɔmi ɔ be nɔ kɛ̃, nɛ a hia nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ hu be nɔ kɛ je e he kpo ngɛ mi mi himi ni hami mi, ejakaa i ngɛ odase yee kaa a ha bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ, nɛ a ha pe bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ tete ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya, nɛ a kɛ hɛdɔ babauu kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke waa kɛ kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ kɛ huɛ bɔmi nɛ ngɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ya ha klɔuklɔubi ɔmɛ, nɛ pi kaa bɔ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu, ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, a ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ngɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kekle kɛ wɔ hulɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ha wa kpa Tito pɛɛ, konɛ bɔ nɛ e je sisi momo sa a, ja nɔuu e gbe kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ hu nya ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Nɛ jehanɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ bee nɔ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi: ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ munyu tumi kɛ ni lemi kɛ mɔde bɔmi kulaa kɛ suɔmi nɛ je nyɛ mi nɛ ngɛ wa mi ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ konɛ kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ mi hu ɔ nyɛɛ be nɔ.
Tsa pi mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ hae; se mohu ni kpahi a mɔde bɔmi i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ kae ngɛ hyɛe, kaa e ngɛ klɔuu lo.
Ejaka nyɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ, kaa lɛ nɛ ji niatsɛ ɔ, e plɛ ohiafo ngɛ nyɛ he, konɛ nyɛɛ gu e hia a nɔ kɛ plɛ niatsɛmɛ.
Ga kɛkɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ hi ha nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ gbe nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ je sisi jeha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ nya, tsa pi ngɛ peemi mi kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ suɔmi mi hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, nyɛɛ gbe ni tsumi ɔ nya; nyɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ gbe nya kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ je sisi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ha bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ.
Ejakaa ke tsui ngɛ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ mo nɔ o ngɛ ɔ, maa muɔ Mawu hɛ, pi bɔ nɛ o be.
I de we enɛ ɔ nɛ ma kɛ ha ni komɛ he jɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hao, se mohu konɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ pee pɛpɛɛpɛ; kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ be nɔ ɔ ya ye bua ninɛmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a nɔ́ nɛ be nɔ ɔ ba ye bua nyɛ konɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ pa ngma a ke: “Nɔ nɛ buaa fuu nya, a, E na we eko ngɛ se, Nɔ nɛ buaa bɔɔ nya hu ɔ, E piɛ́ eko hi lɛ.” Se sina ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɔ nyɛ he mɔde bɔmi nɛ ɔ ngɔ wo Tito tsui mi ɔ. E bu wa pɛɛ nɛ wa kpa lɛ ɔ tue mohu se akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ ɔ mɔde bɔlɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, e ba nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya.
Nyɛmi nɛ wa tsɔ piɛ e he nɛ ɔ, ngɛ yi jemi ngɛ Sane Kpakpa a he ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ kulaa mi.
Nɛ pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se asafo ɔmɛ hia lɛ to hulɔ nɛ e kɛ wɔ nɛ nyɛɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ wa ngɛ sɔmɔe ngɛ he nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ ni tsumi ɔ he suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ; ejakaa wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa tsi enɛ ɔ nya nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko tu wa he munyu yaya ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nike ni agbo nɛ wa ngɛ sɔmɔe ngɛ he nɛ ɔ he.
Wa yi mi tomi ji kaa waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, pi ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa tsɔ wa nyɛmi ɔ hu kɛ piɛ a he, nɔ nɛ wa ka lɛ si abɔ ngɛ nihi fuu mi, nɛ wa na kaa e bɔɔ mɔde, se jehanɛ e ngɛ mɔde bɔe pe kekle ɔ ngɛ e hɛ nɛ e kɛ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ fuu ɔ he, Tito ɔ, ye he piɛlɔ kɛ mami ni tsulɔ ji lɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ hu, asafo ɔmɛ a bɔfohi kɛ Kristo hɛ mi nyami ji mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kɛ fiami nɛ wa fiaa fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛmimɛ a yemi kɛ buami E hia we kaa ma ngma nyɛ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ a kɛ ya sɔmɔɔ klɔuklɔubi ɔmɛ a he.
Ejakaa i le bɔ nɛ nyɛ na he tsui ha, nɛ i fia fɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ he ngɔ tsɔɔ Makedoniabi ɔmɛ kaa Akaiabi dla a he ngɔ to lingmi jeha a lokoo; nɛ nyɛ mɔde bɔmi ɔ wo nihi fuu kã.
I ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsɔe konɛ wa fiami nɛ wa fia ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ e ko pee yaka ngɛ enɛ ɔ blɔfami, nɛ nyɛ dla nyɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ wa de ɔ; nɛ ke Makedoniabi ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ mi ba a, a ko ba na nyɛ kaa nyɛ dla we nyɛ he nɛ wa hɛ mi (wa ko de ke nyɛ hɛ mi) ba pue si ngɛ kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i susu kaa ma kpa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ pɛɛ nɛ a sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ a ba dla kikɛmɛ a nike ni nɛ nyɛ wo si momo nɔ ngɔ to, konɛ e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ a dla ngɔ to momo kaa jɔɔmi nɔ́ ko se pi nɔ nyɛmi nɔ́ ko.
Nyɛ kai enɛ ɔ kaa, nɔ nɛ luɛɛ nihi a he kɛ duɔ ɔ, e kɛ he luɛmi hu ma kpa; nɛ nɔ nɛ duɔ fuu ɔ, fuu nɔuu e ma kpa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha bɔ nɛ e ma nya si momo ngɛ e tsui mi nɛ e ko je kɔmɔ yemi loo fimi mi; ejakaa nɔ nɛ haa ngɛ tsui mi jɔmi nya a Mawu suɔ.
Se Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e ma ha nyɛ ni kpakpahi kulaa kɛ be nɔ, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ kpe nyɛ kulaa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi daa nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ be nɔ ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa mi, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke: “E gbɛɛ fiaa ngɔ haa ohiafo ɔmɛ; E mɔbɔ nami ɔ hii si kɛ yaa neneene.” Se, nɔ nɛ kɛ dumi wuhi kee dulɔ nɛ e kɛ abolo hu haa yemi ɔ, e ma ha nyɛ dumi wuhi nɛ hiɛ, nɛ e ma ha dami yiblii ɔmɛ hu maa fu nɛ nyɛ plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ pee muklii mi hili kɛ pi si, nɛ a gu wa nɔ nɛ a kɛ sina nɛ ha Mawu.
Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a yemi kɛ buami nɛ ɔ he sɔmɔmi ɔ, tsa pi klɔuklɔubi ɔmɛ a fimi kɛkɛ nɛ e pɛneɔ, se mohu e haa a naa Mawu si babauu kɛ bee nɔ hulɔ.
Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a sɔmɔmi nɛ ɔ mi yiblii he ɔ, a woɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ tue bumi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ jajeɔ Kristo sane kpakpa a kɛ huɛ bɔmi klɔuu nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ kɛ nihi kulaa bɔɔ ɔ he.
Nɛ mɛ hu a kɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ nyɛ hami tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a suɔ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu dloomi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ be nɔ ɔ he.
Se sina ha Mawu ngɛ e nike ni nɛ a be nyɛe he ni maa sɛɛ ɔ he!
Paulo fa e fiɛmi nitsumi ɔ he Imi Paulo nitsɛ i kɛ Kristo mi mi jɔmi kɛ kpoo peemi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, imi nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ i ji humi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, se ke i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ i hiaa kã woɔ nyɛ ɔ. I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko ha ma hia kã ngɔ wo nyɛ ejakaa i le kaa ma nyɛ kã ma hia ngɔ wo nihi nɛ susuu kaa wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ he lo nyɛ a. E ngɛ mi kaa he lo mi wa ngɛ mohu, se wa hwui wa ta a ngɛ he lo nya.
Ejakaa wa tahwumi ni ɔmɛ ɔ, tsa pi he lo mi nihi ʼi, se mohu he wami nihi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ kuɔ mɔ nguahi; wa kuɔ susumihi kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ siɔ Mawu ni lemi ɔ, nɛ wa ngɔɔ juɛmi tsuaa juɛmi nyɔguɛ haa Kristo tue bumi; ke nyɛ tue bumi ɔ hyi ɔ, wa dla wa he ngɔ to konɛ waa gbla tuegbenɔ tsuo he tue.
Nyɛ ngɛ nihi hyɛe kaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ngɔɔ e hɛ fɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he nɔ kaa Kristo nɔ ji lɛ ɔ, e susu he ekohu, kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ji Kristo nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ wɔ hu wa ji Kristo nihi.
Ejakaa ke fiami po ma fia kɛ be nɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ wa kɛ ha nyɛ nane nɛ nu si nɛ pi kaa waa kɛ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi po he ɔ, zo be mi gbee,— konɛ ma ko pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ woɔ nyɛ he gbeye ngɛ womihi a mi kɛkɛ.
Ejakaa a deɔ ke: “E womi ɔmɛ a mi munyu ɔmɛ jiɔ, nɛ a mi wa mohu, se ke lɛ nɔmlɔ ɔ nitsɛ e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e he wɛ́, nɛ e munyu ɔ he be akɔnɔ ko.” Jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ e le kaa, bɔ nɛ wa munyu ngɛ ngɛ womihi a mi ke wa be ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ, ke wa ngɛ ɔ, wa ni peemi nihi hu ngɛ.
Wa kɛ́ kaa wa maa bu wa he ngɔ si ni komɛ a nɔ, aloo waa kɛ wa he maa to ni komɛ nɛ jeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he yi ɔmɛ a he; mɛɛ lɛɛ, akɛnɛ a kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he kaleɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, nɛ a kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he toɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he he je ɔ, a be juɛmi.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, wa be fiae tsɔ, se mohu ngɛ susumi kpa nɛ Mawu susu ngɔ ha wɔ, nɛ wa kɛ su nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nya.
Ejakaa wa kpã we wa mi tsɔ kaa nihi nɛ sui nyɛ ngɔ, ejakaa waa kɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a su nyɛ ngɔ hulɔ.
Wa fiɛ pe nine ngɛ ni kpahi a nitsumihi a he; se wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa, ke nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ wae ɔ, wa ma plɛ nimli nguahi ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa ni tsumi nya, nɛ wa maa be nɔ tete, konɛ wa ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ nyɛ se je ni ɔmɛ a mi nɛ wa ko fia ngɔ fɔ hehi nɛ ni kpahi tsu ni ngɛ momo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
“Se nɔ nɛ fiaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ e fia ngɔ fɔ!” Ejakaa pi nɔ nɛ jeɔ e he yi ɔ ji nɔ nɛ sa, se mohu nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ jeɔ e yi ɔ.
Paulo kɛ lakpa bɔfo ɔmɛ I na nɛ jinɛ nyɛ ko na ha ye biɛmi ɔ bɔɔ, kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛɛ na ha mi.
Ejakaa i jee nyɛ he hunga haa Mawu; ejakaa i bi nyɛ si ha Kristo, konɛ ma ngɔ zangmayo nɛ he tsɔ ya ha nyumu kake.
Se i ngɛ gbeye yee kaa alinɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ sinɔ ɔ kɛ e kutupɔ ɔ mlɔɔ Hawa a, ja nɔuu a ma puɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ juɛmi kɛ je klɔu peemi nɛ nyɛ je tsɔɔ Kristo ɔ mi.
Ejakaa ke nɔ nɛ ma a ba fiɛɛ yesu kpã nɛ wa fiɛ we, aloo mumi kpa ko nɛ nyɛ na we sa, aloo sane kpakpa kpã ko nɛ nyɛ he we ɔ, nyɛ heɔ lɛ saminya.
Ejakaa i susuu kaa e piɛ́ mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko loko i kɛ bɔfo ngua amɛ maa sɔ.
Se ke i ji nɔmlɔ ko nɛ li nɔ ko ngɛ munyu tumi blɔfami tete ɔ, i pi ja ngɛ ni lemi blɔfami; se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, wa je enɛ ɔ kpo paa ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.
Aloo blɔɔ, nɛ i ba ye he si konɛ a wo nyɛ nɔ, nɛ i fiɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ yaka a, i pee yayami lo?
Benɛ i ngɛ ni tsue ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, asafo kpahi lɛ wo mi hiɔ.
E ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ i ngɛ mɛ jue konɛ ma kɛ ba sɔmɔ nyɛ.
Nɛ benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ e fi mi tete ɔ, i hɛ wi nɔ ko nɔ ko, ejakaa nihi nɛ hia mi ɔ, nyɛmimɛ nɛ je Makedonia ba a ha su ye dɛ.
I le ye he nɔ hyemi konɛ ma ko plɛ tlomi ha nyɛ.
Be abɔ nɛ Kristo anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ ye mi nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be ye fiami nɛ ɔ nya tsie ngɛ Akaia ni ɔmɛ a mi.
Mɛni he je?
Kaa i sume nyɛ he je loo?
Mawu le.
Nɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ, ma pee, konɛ ma kɛ tsi nihi nɛ ngɛ ye he sane hlae ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ a ko na he blɔ nɛ a fia kɛ de ke mɛ hu a ngɛ ni nɛ wa ngɛ tsueɔ nɔuu tsue.
Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji lakpa bɔfohi ni tsuli sisili nɛ tsakee a he peɔ Kristo bɔfohi.
Enɛ ɔ be nyakpɛ tete; ejakaa Satan nitsɛ tsakee e he peɔ la bɔfo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ hu tsakee a he peɔ kaa dami sɔmɔli ɔ, e pi nɔ́ ko ngua ko; mɛɛ lɛɛ a nyagbe maa pee bɔ nɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Paulo amanehlu nɛ e na kaa bɔfo I ngɛ dee ekohu ke: Nɔ ko ko bu mi kuasia, se ke pi ja a, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ mi kaa kuasia mɔ, konɛ imi hu ma fia bɔɔ ko.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, i de we kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nya mi munyu, se mohu kaa kuasia tuɔ munyu, ngɛ kikɛmɛ a fiami hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ mi.
Akɛnɛ nihi fuu fiaa ngɛ he lo nya he je ɔ, imi hu ma fia eko.
Akɛnɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ ni leli ji nyɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ heɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ be yi mi ɔmɛ hɛmuɔ.
Ejakaa, ke nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ yee, ke nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ adufude yee, ke neɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ klama tsɔe, ke nɔ ko ngɛ e he nɔ woe ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma gbae ɔ, nyɛ kplɛɔ lɛ.
I kɛ zo ngɛ dee ke, wa pee gbedee tsɔ!
Se nɔ́ mi nɛ nɔ ko peɔ ka ngɛ ɔ — I ngɛ munyu tue kaa kuasia — imi hu i peɔ ka ngɛ mi.
Hebribi ji mɛ lo?
Imi hu eko ji mi.
Israelbi ji mɛ lo?
Imi hu eko ji mi.
Abraham nina ji mɛ lo?
Imi hu eko ji mi.
Kristo sɔmɔli ji mɛ lo?
— i ngɛ munyu tue kaa nɔ nɛ yi mi puɛ — i pe mɛ; ngɛ pɔtɔ ni tsumihi nɛ be nɔ mi, ngɛ ni fiamihi nɛ hiɛ tsɔ mi, ngɛ tsu mi womi babauu mi, ngɛ gbenɔ muɔ nya kpitikpiti.
Yudafohi fia mi kpa, si enuɔ, eko tsuaa eko ɔ, piɛ kake nɛ maa pee nyingmi eywiɛ.
A fia mi tso si etɛ, a fia mi tɛ si kake, i kɛ lɛ butu si etɛ, i ye je nami kɛ je jɔmi ngɛ wo mi; i hia blɔ kpitikpiti, i na nɔ ngɛ pahi a hɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ ojo fiali a dɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ ye wekubi a dɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ majeli a dɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ ma mi, i na nɔ ngɛ nga nɔ, i na nɔ ngɛ wo hɛ mi, i na nɔ ngɛ lakpa nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti; ngɛ ni tsumi kɛ pɔtɔ mi, ngɛ nyɔ fɔmihi a mi kpitikpiti, ngɛ hwɔ kɛ kuma mi, ngɛ hwɔ hamihi a mi kpitikpiti, ngɛ fiɛ̃ kɛ he gu nyɛɛmi mi?
e slo nihi nɛ ngɛ se; kɛ jehanɛ hu haomi nɛ i naa daa kɛ asafo ɔmɛ kulaa a he susumi.
Mɛnɔ gbɔleɔ, nɛ i mi lɛɛ i gbɔle we?
Mɛnɔ nane a kpataa, nɛ ye mi mi sɛ̃ mi ha lɛ?
Ke e hia kaa ma fia kɛ ɔ, ma fia ngɔ fo ye gbɔlemi nihi a nɔ.
Mawu kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Tsɛ, nɔ nɛ a gbaa kɛ ya siɔ neneene ɔ, le kaa i yi lakpa.
Benɛ i ngɛ Damasko ɔ, ganɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ Areta sisi ɔ ha a huɔ ngɛ Damaskobi ɔmɛ a ma a mi ngɛ mi hlae nɛ e nu, nɛ a kɛ mi gu saflɛ mi ngɛ plɔ mi kɛ kple si ngɛ gli ɔ nɔ, nɛ i tu fo kɛ je e dɛ.
Paulo ni namihi kɛ kpo jemihi E hia kaa ma fia, se se nami ko be he; kɛ̃ ɔ ma sɛɛ ni namihi kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpo jemihi a he ni.
I le nɔmlɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi; jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ji nɛ ɔ ɔ, a sa kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe nɛ ji etɛ ɔ ya; e ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, i li; e be nɔmlɔ tso mi hu jio, i li; Mawu lɛ le.
I le kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ — e ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, e be nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, i li, Mawu lɛ le — kaa a sa lɛ kɛ ho Paradeiso ya nɛ e ya nu munyuhi nɛ a be nyɛe maa tu nɛ nɔmlɔ ko be he blɔ kaa e woɔ ta.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he ma fia ngɛ, se i be fiae ha imi nitsɛ ye he, kaa ja ngɛ ye gbɔlemi ɔmɛ a he.
Ejakaa ke i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma fia a, i be kuasia ejakaa ma tu anɔkuale; se ye hɛ i ngɛ kue kɛ ngɛ nɔ fɔe, konɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko bu mi pe bɔ nɛ e naa mi ɔ aloo nɔ́ nɛ e ko ɔ e nuɔ ngɛ ye nya a.
Se benɛ pee nɛ ma ko wo ye he nɔ tsɔ ko ngɛ kpo jemihi nɛ kle saminya nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a ha mi mio ko ngɛ ye he womi mi, nɛ ji Satan bɔfo, konɛ e gba mi mahi, nɛ ma ko wo ye he nɔ tsɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kpa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ si etɛ sɔuu konɛ e je ye nɔ; nɛ e de mi ke: “Ye dloomi ɔ hiɛ ha mo, ejakaa ye he wami ɔ gbedee peemi mi e pii si ngɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i suɔ saminya kaa ma fia ngɔ fɔ ye gbɔlemi ɔmɛ a nɔ mohu, konɛ Kristo he wami ɔ nɛ bu ye he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, ye bua jɔɔ ngɛ gbedee peemihi a mi, ngɛ hɛdo nihi a nami mi, ngɛ haomihi a mi, ngɛ yi wamihi a mi, ngɛ fimihi a mi; ejakaa ke i pee gbedee ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ mohu i naa he wami.
Paulo ye Korintobi ɔmɛ a he kɔmɔ I ye kuasiahi a sane kɛ fiami nɛ ɔ; nyɛ lɛ nyɛ nyɛ ye nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa sa nɛ nyɛ mohu lɛ nyɛ jeɔ ye yi; ejakaa e piɛ́ mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ i kɛ bɔfo ngua amɛ nɛ sɔ, pohu i pi nɔ ko tete.
Bɔfo peemi he okadi ɔmɛ mohu ɔ, a pee ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ tsui si tomi tsuo mi, ngɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi kɛ he wami ni tsumihi a mi.
Ejakaa mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kpɛ asafohi nɛ piɛ omɛ a se, kaa ja yemi kɛ buami nɛ i kɛ doo we nyɛ nya kɛkɛ ɔ?
Nyɛɛ ngɔ kikɛmɛ yayami nɛ ɔ ngɔ pa mi!
Oʼɛ enɛ ɔ ji si etɛ nɛ i dla ye he kaa i ma nyɛ ngɔ, se i kɛ ye he ba be nyɛ nɔ fɔe; ejakaa tsa pi nyɛ sika nɛ i ngɛ hlae, se mohu nyɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Ejakaa e sɛ́ kaa bimɛ buaa nihi a nya ngɔ toɔ a fɔli, se mohu fɔli lɛ buaa nihi a nya ngɔ toɔ a bimɛ.
Se i suɔ babauu kaa ma puɛ nihi kulaa nɛ i ngɛ kɛ imi nitsɛ ye he tete ngɛ nyɛ klaa amɛ a he.
Ke i suɔ nyɛ babauu kikɛ ɔ, e sɛ́ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛɛ suɔ mi ja lo?
Se akɛnɛ i kɛ ye he fɔɛ nyɛ nɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ma de ke i nu nyɛ ngɛ ga mi; ejakaa ye hɛ mi tɛ̃ pe nyɛ.
Anɛ i gu nihi nɛ i tsɔɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ eko nɔ ye nyɛ amimi lo?
I kpa Tito pɛɛ nɛ i tsɔ lɛ kɛ wa nyɛmi ɔ; anɛ Tito ba ye nyɛ amimi lo?
Anɛ pi lɛ mumi ɔ nɔuu nɛ waa kɛ nyɛɛ?
Pi kɔlɔ ɔ nanema he ɔmɛ a mi nɔuu nɛ wa nyɛɛ?
Nyɛ susuu kaa wa nya sɔuu wa ngɛ jee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ lo?
Pi ja, Mawu hɛ mi wa ngɛ dee ngɛ, ngɛ Kristo mi, se, mamimɛ, ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa a, nyɛ nane si numi he je nɛ wa ngɛ dee.
Ejakaa i ngɛ gbeye yee kaa alinɔ ke i ba a, i ba be nyɛ nae bɔ nɛ i ko suɔ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ be mi nae bɔ nɛ nyɛ ko suɔ; kaa eko ɔ pɛ, hunga jemi, mi mi la, huhui, sieku yemi, munyu huitihuiti tumi, he nɔ womi, basabasa peemi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa ke i ba a, ye Mawu ɔ maa ba mi si ekohu ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ ma ye kɔmɔ ha nihi nɛ pee yayami sa nɛ a tsakee we a tsui ɔmɛ a ti nihi fuu, ngɛ a mu nihi kɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛ ya homi ɔ he.
Nyagbe kɔkɔbɔmi kɛ sɛyemi Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛ nɛ i ma nyɛ ngɔ.
Odase yeli enyɔ loo etɛ nya a, sane tsuaa sane nya nɛ ma si.
I de to mo, nɛ jehanɛ i ngɛ dee ngɔ to, kaa bɔ nɛ i de benɛ i ba nyɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu jehanɛ hu, nɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, i ngɛ nihi nɛ pee yayami sa a kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ kulaa dee ke, ke i ba ekohu ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ he be nyɛ kee; akɛnɛ nyɛ ngɛ okadi ko hlae nɛ nyɛ kɛ na kaa Kristo lɛ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ ye mi, nɔ nɛ gbɔle we ngɛ nyɛ mi, se mohu e he waa ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ; ejakaa gbedemi he a sɛu lɛ ɔ nɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ Mawu he wami nya a, e hɛ ngɛ; nɛ wɔ hu wa gbɔleɔ ngɛ e mi; se Mawu he wami nɛ ngɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya a, waa kɛ lɛ hɛ maa hi ngmengmle.
Nyɛɛ ka nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he hyɛ kaa nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi lo.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nɛ hi.
Aloo nyɛ li nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he kaa Yesu Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi lo?
Ke pi ja a, lɛɛ nihi nɛ sɛ kulaa ji nyɛ.
Se ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ maa le kaa, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pi nihi nɛ sɛ́.
Se i ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae, konɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami ko kulaa, tsa pi kaa konɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ waa pee kaa nihi nɛ sa he je, se mohu konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da, ke po a maa ngɔ lɛ kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nyɛ we.
Ejakaa wa be nɔ́ ko nyɛe maa pee ngɔ si anɔkuale ɔ, se mohu ke nɔ́ ko nɛ wa maa pee ɔ, wa maa pee ngɔ ha anɔkuale ɔ. Wa naa bua jɔmi ke wa pee gbedee, nɛ nyɛ mohu nyɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he pɛɛ hu wa kpaa, kɔlɔ ɔ ji nyɛ himi kɛ si pimi ɔ nɛ.
Kɔlɔ ɔ he hu nɛ i ngma enɛ ɔ benɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ, konɛ ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ko ye wawɛɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha mi ngɛ dlami se pi puemi he ɔ nya.
Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si, nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi ga, nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake, nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ suɔmi kɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
Nyɛ nga nyɛ he kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuklɔu.
Ni Klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ, kɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ, kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu huɛ bɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo nɛ ji bɔfo nɛ pi nimli nɛ wo lɛ, nɛ pi nɔmlɔ ko nɔ hu nɛ e gu, se mohu, Yesu Kristo kɛ Tsɛ Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, nɔ e gu ɔ, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ, ngma ya ha Galata asafo ɔmɛ: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ; nɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he, konɛ e je wɔ kɛ je je yaya nɛ ngɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya; nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene ɔ!
Amen.
Sane Kpakpa kake ɔ Ye hɛ mi pee mi yaa kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu ɔ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he tsɔe kɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo dloomi ɔ nya a he jee kɛ yaa sane kpakpa kpa ko he; nɛ kɛ ɔ, ekpa ko be, mohu ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi puee, nɛ a ngɛ hlae kaa a plɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
Se ke wɔ po, loo bɔfo nɛ je hiɔwe tete, ba ba jaje sane kpakpa kpa ko tsɔɔ nyɛ, ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ ɔ se ɔ, jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ e pee musutsɛ!
Kaa bɔ nɛ wa de momo ɔ, ja nɔuu i ngɛ dee ekohu ke: Ke nɔ ko ba ba jaje sane kpakpa kpa ko tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ he nɛ ɔ se ɔ, jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ e pee musutsɛ!
Blɔɔ jehanɛ nimli a hɛ mi i ngɛ hlɛe nɛ ma sa loo Mawu?
Aloo i ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi hlae ma sa?
Ejakaa ke i ngɛ nɔ ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi sae kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ pi Kristo tsɔlɔ ji mi.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Paulo plɛ bɔfo Se i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le, mamimɛ, kaa sane kpakpa nɛ i jaje ɔ, pi nimli a nya nɛ e je.
Ejakaa pi nɔmlɔ ko dɛ mi nɛ i na kɛ je, nɛ pi tsɔɔmi hu nɛ a tsɔɔ mi; se mohu Yesu Kristo kpo jemi nya i na ngɛ.
Ejakaa nyɛ nu ye sa je mi bami he ngɛ Yudafohi a jami ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ i wa Mawu asafo ɔ yi mi babauu nɛ i kpata e hɛ mi, nɛ i pã wa juahi fuu ngɛ Yudafohi a jami ɔ mi ngɛ ye wɛli a kpɛti, nɛ ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ wa tsɛmɛ a blema sanehi nɛ a kɛ ha wɔ ɔmɛ a he.
Se benɛ e sa Mawu nɛ je mi to kɛ je maa muklii mi lokoo nɛ e kɛ e dloomi ɔ tsɛ mi kɛ ba a hɛ mi, kaa e ma je lɛ nitsɛ e bi ɔ kpo ngɛ ye mi, konɛ ma jaje e he sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, amlɔ ɔ, i kɛ he lo kɛ muɔ yɛ he dami, nɛ jehanɛ i yɛ́ Yerusalem hu ngɛ nihi nɛ ji bɔfohi loko ji imi hu i ba plɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se mohu i pue nɔ kɛ ho Arabia ya, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kpale ye se kɛ ba Damasko ekohu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ lɔ ɔ se jeha etɛ ɔ, i ya Yerusalem nɛ i kɛ Petro ya sɛɛ ni, nɛ i hi e ngɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ.
I nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kpa ko kaa ja Yakobo, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛmi ɔ. Nihi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, oʼɛ, Mawu hɛ mi i ngɛ dee ngɛ, i yi lakpa.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ba Siria kɛ Kilikia ni ɔmɛ a mi.
Se nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, a li ye hɛ mi ngɛ Yudea Kristo asafo ɔmɛ a mi; se mohu a nuɔ kɛkɛ kaa nɔ nɛ wa wɔ yi mi sa a, jehanɛ e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ sa nɛ e kpata hɛ mi ɔ he sane kpakpa a jajee kɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe; nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ye he.
Paulo kɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ Kɛkɛ nɛ, lɔ ɔ se jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ sɔuu ɔ, i kɛ Barnaba kpale kɛ ya Yerusalem, nɛ i ngɔ Tito hu ngɔ piɛ ye he.
I ya ngɛ kpo jemi ko nya, nɛ i kɛ sane kpakpa nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ya fɔ a hɛ mi, se titli ɔ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ a hɛ mi, benɛ pee nɛ fo nɛ i tuu ɔ aloo i ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ e ko pee yaka.
Se Tito tete nɛ e kɛ mi ngɛ nɛ e ji Hela no ɔ, a nyɛ́ we enɔ kaa a po lɛ, ejakaa lakpa nyɛmimɛ komɛ ju si sɛ asafo ɔ mi kulɔɔ, konɛ a ba huɔ wa he nɛ wa ye ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, konɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ; se mɛɛ lɛɛ wa kplɛɛ we nɛ waa bu mɛ tue ngmlɛfia kake tete, konɛ sane kpakpa a anɔkuale ɔ nɛ e hi si sɔkee ha nyɛ.
Se ninɛmɛ nɛ a buu mɛ kaa a ngɛ biɛ ɔ, — bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ sa a, pi ye he sane ko, Mawu hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi, — ejakaa imi lɛɛ, ninɛmɛ nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we mi nɔ́ ko ngɔ piɛ we he; se mohu, a na kaa a tu mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ a kpɛti sane kpakpa a fiɛmi ngɔ wo ye dɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a tu nɔ poli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ wo Petro dɛ ɔ. Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsu ni ngɛ Petro mi nɛ e ha e ye bɔfo ngɛ nɔ poli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e tsu ni ngɛ imi hu ye mi ngɛ majeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Benɛ a yo dloomi nɛ a kɛ ha mi ɔ, Yakobo kɛ Kefa kɛ Yohane nɛ a buu mɛ kaa titimahi ɔ, kɛ huɛ bɔmi hiɛ ɔ nine sa i kɛ Barnaba dɛ, konɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ waa ya majeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ya nɔ poli ɔmɛ a kpɛti; se ohiafohi kɛkɛ a ke wa kai, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he mɔde i bɔ kaa ma pee.
Paulo kã Kefa hɛ mi ngɛ Antiokia Se benɛ Kefa ba Antiokia a, i da e hɛ mi nɛ i kã e hɛ mi, ejakaa e nɔ be mi.
Ejakaa loko ni komɛ maa je Yakobo ngɔ kɛ ba a, e kɛ majeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ ni; se benɛ a ba a, e sã e he si, nɛ e tsɔ e he, ejakaa e ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ je nɔ poli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ gbeye yee.
Nɛ Yudafohi nɛ piɛ ɔ hu kɛ lɛ pee jamɛ a osato ɔ, nɛ a gbla Barnaba tete ngɔ wo a sato peemi ɔ mi.
Se benɛ i na kaa a nyɛɛ we tutuutu ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi anɔkuale ɔ nya a, i de Kefa ngɛ mɛ kulaa a hɛ mi ke: “Ke mo nɛ o ji Yuda no ɔ, o peɔ o nihi kaa maje no se pi kaa Yuda no ɔ, mɛni he je o nyɛɛ majeli ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa a pee a nihi kaa Yudafohi ɔ?” Hemi kɛ yemi a kɛ he Yudafohi kɛ majeli a yiwami A fɔ wɔ Yudafohi, nɛ wa pi yayami peeli nɛ je majeli ɔmɛ a mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa le kaa a wui nɔmlɔ nguɔ kɛ ji mlaa ni tsumihi a mi, kaa ja a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kɛkɛ nɔ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wɔ hu wa he Kristo Yesu nɔ ye, konɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ kɛ je Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi, nɛ pi mlaa ni tsumihi a mi; ejakaa a be he lo ko he lo ko nguɔ woe kɛ je mlaa ni tsumihi a mi.
Jehanɛ, ke wɔ nɛ wa hlaa kaa a wo wɔ nguɔ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, a na wɔ kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu yayami peeli ji wɔ ɔ, blɔɔ lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo fiɔ yayami se lo?
Pi ja!
Ejakaa ke nihi nɛ i kuɔ pueɔ si ɔ i kpaleɔ maa ekohu ɔ, blɔɔ i tsɔɔ ye he kaa nɔ tɔlɔ ji mi.
Ejakaa imi lɛɛ i gu mlaa a nɔ kɛ gbo ha mlaa a, konɛ ye hɛ nɛ hi ngmengmle ha Mawu.
A sɛu mi kɛ Kristo; he je ɔ pi imi nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ hu, se Kristo lɛ hɛ ngɛ ngɛ ye mi; se ye hɛ nɛ ngɛ ngɛ he lo mi jehanɛ ɔ, Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ suɔ mi nɛ e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ ye he ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi ye hɛ ngɛ ngɛ.
I kua we Mawu dloomi ɔ, ejakaa, ke mlaa nɔ dami guu kɛ baa a, lɛɛ Kristo gbo yaka gu.
Mlaa loo hemi kɛ yemi Oo, Galatabi nɛ be yi mi!
Mɛnɔ gbiɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko bu anɔkuale ɔ tue — nihi a hɛ mi nɛ a tɛni Yesu Kristo ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ a sɛu.
Nyɛ ha ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ kake: Mlaa ni tsumihi a mi nyɛ na Mumi ɔ kɛ je, aloo hemi kɛ yemi tue bumi mi?
Anɛ kikɛ nyɛ be yi mi lo?
Nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Mumi je sisi ɔ, jehanɛ he lo nyɛɛ kɛ maa gbe nya lo?
Nɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ na nɛ ɔ, yaka gu nyɛ na lo?
Ke yaka gu hu po ʼi ɔ, blɔɔ Mawu nɛ kɛ Mumi ɔ kee nyɛ nɛ e tsuɔ he wami nihi ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, mlaa ni tsumihi a mi e tsuɔ ngɛ aloo hemi kɛ yemi tue bumi mi?
A ngma ke: “Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ a bu enɛ ɔ dami ngɔ ha lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, mɛ nɔuu ji Abraham bimɛ.
Se akɛnɛ ngmami ɔ na momo kaa hemi kɛ yemi mi Mawu maa wo majeli ɔmɛ nguɔ ngɛ he je ɔ, e jaje sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ Abraham ngɔ to kaa: “O mi a maa gbaa majemaje li ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ.” Lɛɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, a gbaa mɛ kɛ Abraham nɛ he ye ɔ. Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ je mlaa ni tsumihi a mi ɔ, gbiɛmi ngɛ a nɔ; ejakaa a ngma ke: “A gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mlaa Womi ɔ mi ɔ nɛ e ye nɔ ɔ.” Jehanɛ e ngɛ paa kaa mlaa a mi ɔ, a be nɔ ko nɔ ko nguɔ woe ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, ejakaa dalɔ ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi mi e yi ma na wami ngɛ.
Se mlaa a, pi hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ e je, se mohu nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ yi ma na wami ngɛ mi.
Kristo kpɔ wɔ kɛ je mlaa a gbiɛmi ɔ mi, akɛnɛ e plɛ gbiɛmi ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ, ejakaa a ngma ke: “A gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kplaa si ngɛ tso nɔ” ɔ; konɛ Abraham gbaami ɔ nɛ ba maje li ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, nɛ waa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ na Mumi ɔ si womi ɔ. Mlaa a kɛ si womi ɔ Mamimɛ, nyɛ ha ma ngɔ nimli a si himi mi nɔ ko kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ nya.
Nɔmlɔ si womi tete ɔ, ke a ma nɔ mi ɔ, nɔ ko kua we, nɛ jehanɛ hu nɔ ko piɛ we he nɔ ko.
Jehanɛ Abraham ɔ, a tu si womi munyu ɔmɛ ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ e nina a. E de we ke: “Kɛ e nina amɛ,” kaa nɔ nɛ nihi fuu a nɔ ʼi, se mohu kaa nɔ kake nɔ, ke: “Kɛ o nina a,” nɔ nɛ ji Kristo ɔ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ ji: Mlaa nɛ a wo jeha lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi etɛ se ɔ, e gui somi nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ to Kristo ɔ nɛ e ha si womi ɔ nɛ pee yaka.
Se ke gbo si ni ɔ je mlaa a mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ tsa pi si womi ɔ mi nɛ e je mɔ; se Mawu kɛ ke Abraham kɛ gu si womi nɔ.
Jehanɛ mɛni ji mlaa a mɔ?
Nɔ tɔmihi a he nɛ a kɛ piɛ he, kɛ maa su be nɛ Abraham nina nɛ a wo si ngɔ ha a maa ba; Hiɔwe bɔfohi a nɔ a gu kɛ wo si kɛ gu mi dalɔ nɔ.
Se mi dalɔ he hia we ha nɔ kake, nɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ kake ʼi.
Nɔ́ nɛ mlaa tsuɔ Anɛ mlaa a kuɔ Mawu si womi ɔmɛ a nya lo?
Dɛbi!
Ejakaa e ji a wo mlaa ko nɛ ma nyɛ wami ma ha jinɛ e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa mlaa mi dami ɔ je.
Se mohu ngmami ɔ ngɔ je ɔ kulaa ngɔ wo yayami sisi, konɛ a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ nɛ a kɛ si womi ɔ nɛ ha nihi nɛ he yeɔ ɔ.
Se loko hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ba a, a kɛ wɔ wo mlaa sisi, nɛ a nga wa yi ngɔ to hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a ma je kpo ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mlaa a plɛ wa tsɔselɔ kɛ yaa Kristo ngɔ, konɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi.
Se nɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ba nɛ ɔ, wa be tsɔselɔ ɔ sisi hu.
Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo ɔ Mawu bimɛ ji nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ; ejakaa nyɛ nihi abɔ nɛ a baptisi nyɛ ngɔ wo Kristo mi ɔ, nyɛ wo Kristo.
Yudano be ɔ, Helano hu bé hu; nyɔguɛ bé ɔ, odehe hu bé hu; nyumu be ɔ, yo hu be hu; ejakaa nyɛ tuso ɔ, nɔ kake ji nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.
Se ke Kristo nihi ji nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Abraham nina ji nyɛ, kɛ gbo si ni yeli hulɔ ngɛ si womi ɔ nya.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji, be abɔ nɛ gbo si ni yelɔ ɔ ji bimwɔyo ɔ slɔɔto ko be e kɛ sɔmɔlɔ kpɛti, kpahu lɛ ji ni ɔmɛ tsuo a tsɛ; se e ngɛ nɔ hyɛli kɛ sɔmɔli nikɔtɔmahi a sisi kɛ yaa su be nɛ Tsɛ ɔ to ɔ. Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ wɔ hu, benɛ wa ji bimwɔwi ɔ, a kɛ wɔ wo je nɛ ɔ mi adebɔ mumihi a nyɔguɛ yemi ɔ sisi.
Se benɛ be nɛ a to ɔ su ɔ, Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bi ɔ kɛ ba, yo ko ba fɔ lɛ, e ba mlaa sisi, konɛ e ba kpɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ mlaa sisi ɔ, nɛ wa na bi peemi he blɔ.
Se akɛnɛ bimɛ ji nyɛ he je ɔ, Mawu tsɔ e bi ɔ Mumi ɔ kɛ ba nyɛ tsui mi, nɔ nɛ kpaa ngmlaa ke: “Abba, Tsaatsɛ!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o pi sɔmɔlɔ hu, se mohu bi ji mo.
Nɛ ke bi ji mo ɔ, lɛɛ Mawu ni yelɔ hu ji mo ngɛ Kristo he.
Paulo ye Galatabi ɔmɛ a he kɔmɔ Se be nɛ be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ li Mawu, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he pee nyɔguɛhi ngɔ ha nihi nɛ pi mawu ji mɛ ngɛ a bɔmi su nya a; se jehanɛ, nɛ nyɛ le Mawu, aloo mohu, nɛ Mawu le nyɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ peɔ kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ pa kpaleɔ nyɛ se kɛ yaa sisi jemi nihi nɛ nyɛ we nɔ́ ko nɛ a pee nɛ a ye ohia amɛ a ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ pa hlaa kaa nyɛɛ kpale sɔmɔ mɛ ekohu ɔ nɛɛ?
Nyɛ buu ligbihi kɛ hlamihi kɛ behi kɛ jehahi a he akɔɔtaa fitso-fitso.
I ngɛ gbeye yee, kaa nyɛ ma ha ma gbo nyɛ he yaka dengme.
I ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ pee kaa imi, ejakaa imi hu i ngɛ kaa nyɛ.
Nyɛ pee we mi yayami ko; se nyɛ le kaa he lo gbedemi mi i je kɛ jaje sane kpakpa a ngɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ kekle ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji nya tsɔmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, nyɛ gbi he guɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu nyɛ nyangee we mi; se mohu nyɛ he mi kaa Mawu bɔfo, kaa Kristo Yesu nitsɛ.
Jehanɛ jije nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ ngɛ?
Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ he odase yee kaa, e maa hi jinɛ, nyɛ ko hia nyɛ hɛngmɛhi tete ha mi.
Nɛ i tuɔ anɔkuale tsɔɔ nyɛ he je ɔ, blɔɔ i plɛ nyɛ henyɛlɔ lo?
Pi nyɛ he dengme kpakpa ko nɛ ni kpa amɛ ngɛ gboe nɛ ɔ; se mohu a ngɛ hlae nɛ a tsi nyɛ wa ngɔ blɔ, konɛ nyɛ gbo mɛ mohu a he dengme.
E sa kaa nyɛ gbo dengme ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ fɛu he daa; nɛ pi benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.
Ye bimɛ kpakpahi, i nu kɔɔmi ngɛ nyɛ fɔmi he ekohu kɛ maa su be nɛ a maa bɔ Kristo subai ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi.
I na nɛ jinɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kasa nya amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsake blɔ nɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ, ejakaa i ngɛ haoe ngɛ nyɛ he!
Hagar kɛ Sara kaa nɔhyɛmi nɔ Nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛɛ hi mlaa sisi ɔ, nyɛ de mi, anɛ nyɛ nui nɔ nɛ mlaa a de ɔ lo?
A ngma ke Abraham ngɛ bimɛ enyɔ, nɔ kake ɔ, e kɛ sɔmɔlɔyo ɔ lɛ fɔ; nɔ kake hu e kɛ odehe ɔ lɛ fɔ.
Se jehanɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ e kɛ sɔmɔlɔyo ɔ fɔ ɔ, a fɔ lɛ ngɛ he lo nya; se nɔ nɛ e kɛ odehe ɔ fɔ ɔ, a fɔ lɛ ngɛ si womi ɔ nya.
Kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a kɛ buu abɛ.
Yi nɛ ɔmɛ ji somi enyɔ ɔ nɛ; kake ɔ je Sinai yoku ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi e fɔɔ woɔ; lɛ ji Hagar.
Hagar ji Sinai yoku ɔ ngɛ Arabia; se e kɛ mwɔnɔmwɔnɔ Yerusalem ɔ tsa we nɔ, ejakaa e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ji nyɔguɛhi.
Se hiɔwe Yerusalem ɔ ji odehe ɔ nɛ, nɔ nɛ ji wɔ kulaa wa nyɛ ɔ. Ejakaa sa ngma ke: “La nyami la, mo yosa nɛ o fɔ we; Nɛ o hwɔ lele kɛ bua jɔmi, mo nɛ o kɔɔ we; Ejakaa nɔ nɛ a kua lɛ ɔ mohu bimɛ maa hiɛ pe nɔ nɛ ngɛ huno ɔ po!” Jehanɛ, mamimɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ Si womi ɔ bimɛ ji wɔ kaa Isak.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ be ɔ mi hu, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ he lo nya a waa nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ mumi nya a yi mi ɔ, jã nɔuu kɛ̃ e ngɛ mwɔnɔmwɔnɔ hu.
Se kɛ ngmami ɔ de kɛɛ?
“Fie sɔmɔlɔyo ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ, ejakaa e sɛ́ kaa nyɔguɛyo ɔ bi ɔ kɛ odehe ɔ bi ɔ nɛ ye gbo si ni ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, wa pi sɔmɔlɔyo ɔ bimɛ, se mohu odehe ɔ bimɛ ji wɔ.
Nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ heyemi ɔ he Kristo pee wɔ odehehi, nɛ e ha wa ye wa he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii nɛ nyɛ ko ha a bɔ nyɛ nyɔguɛ yemi pã a hu.
Oʼɛ, imi Paulo, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ha a po nyɛ ɔ Kristo he be se nami ko ha nyɛ.
Se i pa ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ nɛ a po lɛ ɔ tsɔɔe kaa e hɛɛ hiɔ kaa é ye mlaa mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ.
Nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa a wo nyɛ nguɔ ngɛ mlaa mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo be sane ko; nyɛ gbee si kɛ je dloomi ɔ mi.
Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ, Mumi ɔ nɔ wa guu waa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi mlɛɛ dami hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, pi nɔ pomi nɛ nyɛɔ nɔ́ ko peɔ, nɛ pi mɔmlɔtɔ hulɔ, se mohu hemi kɛ yemi nɛ guu suɔmi nɔ tsuɔ ni ɔ ʼi.
Nyɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe saminya; mɛnɔ po lɛ tsi nyɛ blɔ kaa nyɛ ko bu anɔkuale ɔ tue?
Juɛmi tsakemi nɛ ɔ ɔ, tsa pi Mawu nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ mi nɛ e je.
Ma sasɛ nyafii saa ma mluku ɔ tsuo.
Imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi, kaa nyɛ be juɛmi kpa ko juɛe, se nɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ puee ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ji ɔ, e musu maa tloo lɛ.
Imi lɛɛ, mamimɛ, ke nɔ pomi i ngɛ fiee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kɛ mwɔɔ?
Ke ja a, lɛɛ seumi tso ɔ he sane ɔ, e pi nya tsɔmi nɔ́ hu.
Oo, i na jinɛ nihi nɛ woɔ nyɛ yi mi ɔ puɛ̃ loo ta mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.
Ejakaa he yemi mi a tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ngɛ, mamimɛ; se nyɛ he yemi ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ko ha e plɛ he blɔ ha he lo ɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ gu suɔmi mi kɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ he.
Ejakaa mlaa mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ yemi ngɛ munyu kake nɛ ɔ mi ke: “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.” Se ke nyɛ kɔɔ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ plaa nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ ko puɛ nyɛ he!
Mumi ɔ kɛ nɔmlɔ su Se i ke: Ke nyɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ mumi nya a, nyɛ be he lo akɔnɔ ɔmɛ a nya ni pee.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ he lo ɔ dii se ɔ kɛ mumi ɔ yi, nɛ nihi nɛ mumi ɔ hu dii se ɔ kɛ he lo ɔ yi.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he yi, konɛ nyɛ ko pee nihi nɛ nyɛ suɔ.
Se ke mumi ɔ lɛ kpakpaa nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ be mlaa sisi.
Se he lo ɔ ni tsumi ɔmɛ jee kpo paa, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ ji gba puemi, ajuama bɔmi, mu ni tsumi, ya homi wɔ jami, nyuami, nyɛmi, pɛ, hunga jemi, mi mi la womi, ngmlaa kpami, atua tsɔmi, mi gbami, hɛ tsumi, da demi, fiɛmi yaya kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛkaa enɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ i de nyɛ ngɔ to, kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momoɔ, ke: nihi nɛ peɔ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue.
Se Mumi ɔ yiblii ji suɔmi, bua jɔmi, he jɔmi, tsui si tomi, mi mi himi, kpakpa peemi, hemi kɛ yemi, he si bami, hɛ si kami; enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ mlaa ko gui.
Se nihi nɛ ji Kristo Yesu nihi ɔ, a sɛu he lo ɔ kɛ e he numi nihi kɛ e kɔnɔ ɔmɛ kulaa.
Ke wa hɛ ngɛ ngmengmle ngɛ Mumi ɔ mi ɔ, nya ha waa nyɛɛ ngɛ Mumi ɔ nya hulɔ.
Wa hɛ ko kɔ yakayaka hɛ mi nyami nɔ, nɛ wa ko wo wa sibi a muklii mi la nɛ wa he ba tsɛ̃ wa sibi.
Nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ he kɛ tloo nyɛ tlomihi Mamimɛ, ke tlukaa nɛ nɔ ko tɔ ɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ji mumi mi nimli ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ dla jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ekohu ngɛ mi mi jɔmi mumi mi; nɛ o le o he nɔ hyemi konɛ mo hu a ko ka mo.
Nyɛ tlomi ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ he kɛ tloo, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa ye Kristo mlaa a nɔ.
Ejakaa ke e peɔ nɔ ko kaa nɔ ko ji lɛ nɛ e pi nɔ ko ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he e ngɛ sisie.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ka lɛ nitsɛ e ni tsumi nɛ e hyɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko e maa na nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi nɛ e fia ngɔ fɔ nɔ, se pi nɔ kpa nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa tloo lɛ nitsɛ e tlomi.
Nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ Mawu munyu ɔ tsɔɔe ɔ, e kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ dla ni kpakpahi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko mlɔɔ nyɛ he: Mawu ɔ, a yi e he fɛu yaka.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ duɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu e ma kpa hulɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ duɔ ni ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he lo mi ɔ, e he lo ɔ mi e ma kpa puemi kɛ je.
Se nɔ nɛ duɔ ni ngɛ Mumi mi ɔ, Mumi ɔ mi nɔuu e ma kpa neneene wami kɛ je.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ pɔ nɛ tɔ nyɛ kɛ kpakpa peemi, ejakaa ke wa nine mi wui nyu ɔ, wa ma kpa hulɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ wa ngɛ deka he je ɔ, nyɛ ha waa pee nihi tsuo kpakpa, se titli ɔ, ninɛme nɛ ji hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ.
Nyagbe kɔkɔbɔmi kɛ sɛyemi Nyɛɛ hyɛ womi sɔuu nɛ i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye nine ngma nyɛ ngɛ ningma nguahi a mi.
Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a nyɛɛ nyɛ nɔ kaa a po nyɛ, benɛ pee nɛ a ko wa mɛ yi mi ngɛ Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ he.
Nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ nitsɛmɛ tete yi mlaa a nɔ; se mohu a ngɛ hlae nɛ a po nyɛ, konɛ a fia ngɔ fɔ nyɛ he lo ɔ nɔ.
Se imi lɛɛ e ya je ngɛ se lokoo kaa ma fia ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ kaa ja wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɔ a gu kɛ sɛu je ɔ ha mi, nɛ imi hu a sɛu mi ha je ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo mi ɔ, nɔ pomi pi nɔ́ ko, nɛ mɔmlɔtɔ hu pi nɔ́ ko, se mohu bɔmi he kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ ko.
Nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔ nya a, he jɔmi kɛ mɔbɔnami nɛ ba mɛ kɛ Mawu webi kulaa a nɔ!
Jehanɛ, nɔ ko ko doo ye nya hu; ejakaa i hɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu plaami okadi ɔmɛ ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hi si, mamimɛ!
Amen.
Paulo, nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, ngma ya ha ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ yeɔ ɔ: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Mumi mi gbaami ngɛ Kristo mi A gbaa Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ mumi mi gbaami tsuaa mumi mi gbaami gbaa wɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nihi a mi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ. E hla wɔ ngɛ Kristo mi loko a to je ɔ sisi, konɛ waa pee klɔuklɔu nɛ piami ko ko hi wa he ngɛ e hɛ mi.
E je wɔ ngɛ suɔmi mi ngɔ to ha e he nɛ waa pee e bimɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo he, kaa bɔ nɛ sa e hɛ mi ngɛ e suɔmi nya a, konɛ a kɛ je e dloomi hɛ mi nyami ɔ yi, nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ dloo wɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ a suɔ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo mi nɔuu wa na kpɔmi ɔ ngɛ nɛ ji yayamihi a pami ɔ, ngɛ e muɔ ɔ he ngɛ e dloomi hiɛmi ɔ nyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ e ha kɛ be nɔ ha wɔ ngɛ ni lemi kɛ nɔ sisi numi kulaa mi.
E ha wa le e yi mi tomi ɔ mi laami sane nɛ e to kaa e maa gbe nya ngɛ Kristo mi, ha be ɔmɛ a yinɔ ɔ blɔ nya tomi, konɛ e ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ to yi kake sisi ngɛ Kristo mi, nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ke nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kulaa.
Lɛ e mi nɔuu wa na gbo si ni ɔmɛ hu ngɛ, wɔ nihi nɛ a je ngɔ to ngɛ nɔ nɛ tsuɔ nihi kulaa a yi mi tomi nya, bɔ nɛ sa lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi ga womi ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa sɛ hlami ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Kristo nɔ ɔ, wa plɛ e he mi nyami ɔ yi jemi.
Kristo ɔ nɔuu nɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ, benɛ nyɛ nu anɔkuale munyu ɔ nɛ ji nyɛ yi wami hemi ɔ he sane kpakpa a; lɛ nɔuu e mi a kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ a wo he si ɔ sɔu nyɛ nya ngɛ benɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji wa gbo si ni ɔmɛ a yi ba pomi nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ kpɔ e nihi nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ je e hɛ mi nyami ɔ yi.
Paulo pɛɛ kpami Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi hu, benɛ i nu nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi, kɛ nyɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa he ɔ, i jɔɔ we si nami ngɛ nyɛ he, se i kaii nyɛ ngɛ ye pɛɛ kpamihi a mi.
I kpaa pɛɛ konɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Mawu nɛ ji hɛ mi nyami Tsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ ni lemi kɛ nɔ kpo jemi mumi ngɛ lemi nɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ saminya a mi, nɛ nyɛ mi hɛngmɛ ɔ nɛ bli, konɛ nyɛɛ le nɔ nɛ ji e tsɛmi ɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ, kɛ e weye ni ɔ hiɛmi ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji e he wami ɔ klemi nɛ be nɔ babauu ha wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ ngɛ e nyɛmi ɔ he wami ni tsumi ɔ nya, nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ngɛ Kristo mi benɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e kɛ lɛ hi e hiɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nihi a mi, ngɛ nɔkɔtɔma yemi kɛ he blɔ kɛ he wami kɛ nɔ yemi tsuo kɛ biɛ tsuaa biɛ nɛ a wo, pi ngɛ be nɛ ɔ mi kɛkɛ, se be nɛ maa ba a mi hulɔ ɔ; Mawu ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ to Kristo nane si, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to nihi kulaa yi ngɔ ha asafo ɔ. Asafo ɔ ji Kristo nɔmlɔ tso kɛ nɔ nɛ woɔ nihi tsuo tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ nihi kulaa mi ɔ.
Kɛ je gbenɔ mi kɛ ba wami mi Sa a, nyɛ ji ni gbogboehi ngɛ tue gbomi kɛ yayamihi a mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi kɔɔhiɔ mi he wami ɔ nɔ yelɔ, nɛ ji mumi nɛ tsuɔ ni mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ngɛ tuegbenɔ bihi a mi ɔ su ɔ nya; kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a mi wɔ tsuo hu wa ba wa je mi ngɛ sa ngɛ wa he lo akɔnɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ wa tsu nihi nɛ he lo kɛ juɛmi suɔ ɔ, nɛ wa ji Mawu muklii mi fumi bimɛ ngɛ wa fɔmi su ɔ nya kaa nihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.
Se Mawu nɛ e mɔbɔ nami hiɛ babauu ɔ, gu lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi babauu nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ wɔ nɛ wa ji ni gbogboehi ngɛ tuegbenɔ mi ɔ, e tsɛ̃ɛ waa kɛ Kristo tsuo hɛ; dloomi a kɛ he nyɛ yi wami!
E tle waa kɛ lɛ si, nɛ e ngɔ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo ngɔ hi hiɔwe nihi a mi ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, konɛ be nɛ maa ba a mi ɔ, e je lɛ nitsɛ e dloomi ɔ hiɛmi nɛ be nɔ ɔ kpo, kɛ e mi mi himi nɛ e ngɛ ha wɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ. Ejakaa dloomi a kɛ he nyɛ yi wami kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ, nɛ enɛ ɔ lɛɛ, pi nyɛ mi nɛ e je, Mawu nɔke nɔ ʼi, pi ni tsumihi a mi nɛ e je, konɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko fia.
Mawu nine nya ni tsumi nihi ji wɔ, a bɔ wɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi kɛ ha ni tsumi kpakpahi nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ to konɛ waa nyɛɛ ngɛ mi ɔ. Kakepeemi ngɛ Kristo mi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kai kaa nyɛ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ ji wɔ jali ngɛ he lo blɔfami nɛ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ tsɛɛ nyɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ nyɛ be Kristo, nɛ nyɛ ji ni kpahi ngɛ Israel kɛ nibwɔhi ngɛ si womi somi ɔmɛ a blɔfami hulɔ; nyɛ be hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko, nɛ nyɛ be Mawu tete ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi.
Se jehanɛ, Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, nyɛ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ lokoo ɔ, nyɛ gu Kristo muɔ ɔ nɔ hɛ kɛ ba.
Ejakaa lɛ ji wa he jɔmi, nɔ nɛ ngɔ wɔ majeli kɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ kulaa ngɔ pee kake, nɛ e ku gli piɛ nɛ ngɛ kpɛti nɛ ji ninye ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he lo gu Mlaa a nɛ ngɛ kita amɛ a mi ɔ, konɛ e kɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ bɔ nɔmlɔ he kake ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi nɛ e ha he jɔmi nɛ ba, nɛ e gu sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ kɛ dla mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kulaa a kɛ Mawu kpɛti ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake mi, nɛ e gbe ninye ɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi.
E ba ba jaje he jɔmi sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ lokoo ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ ba a hulɔ; ejakaa e nɔ wɔ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kulaa guu kɛ naa blɔ ngɛ mumi kake mi kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, nyɛ pi nibwɔhi kɛ ni kpahi hu, se mohu nyɛ ji ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a huɛmɛ ma mi bi kɛ Mawu we bi nɛ a fia nyɛ ngɔ ma bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a sisi tomi ɔ nɛ e kɔ nya tɛ ji Kristo Yesu ɔ nɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ tsɛ̃ tsu mluku ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo mi pee kake, nɛ e ngɛ klee ngɛ sɔlemi tsu klɔuklɔu pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi, nɔ nɛ mi nɛ a fia nyɛ hu ngɔ wo ngɔ pee Mawu sihi he ngɛ Mumi ɔ mi ɔ.
Paulo nitsumi ha majeli Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Paulo, nɛ ji Kristo Yesu pa mi no ha nyɛ maje li a bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko ɔ nyɛ maa nu Mawu dloomi nɛ a ngɔ ha mi ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ blɔ nya tomi ɔ he, kaa kpo jemi nɔ Mawu gu kɛ ha i kɛ le laami sane ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ bɔɔ ko momo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ke nyɛ kane ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ nyɛ kɛ na bɔ nɛ i nu Kristo laami sane ɔ sisi ha.
Laami sane nɛ ɔ, yinɔhi nɛ be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a ha we nimli a bimɛ nɛ a le, kaa bɔ nɛ jehanɛ ɔ a je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ e bɔfohi kɛ gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɛ Mumi mi, kaa maje li a bimɛ ɔmɛ hu ji ni yeli ɔmɛ ekomɛ, kɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ni ɔmɛ ekomɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ si ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ hu ekomɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he.
Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ he sɔmɔlɔ ji mi ngɛ Mawu dloomi nike nihi nɛ a gu e he wami ni tsumi nɔ ngɔ ha mi ɔ nya.
Imi nɛ i ji nɔ wayo pe he tsɔli ɔmɛ kulaa a, a ngɔ kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi, kaa ma jaje Kristo nihiɛmi nɛ a be sisi nyɛe maa na kɛ gbe nya a he sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ maje li ɔmɛ, nɛ ma ha nihi kulaa a hɛ mi nɛ tsɔ mɛ nɛ a le nɔ́ nɛ ji laami sane nɛ a ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu nɔ nɛ bɔ nihi kulaa a blɔ nya tomi ɔ mi, konɛ jehanɛ a gu asafo ɔ nɔ nɛ a ha nikɔtɔmahi kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ he blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nihi a mi ɔ nɛ a le Mawu ni lemi nɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ, ngɛ neneene yi mi nɛ e to ngɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, mi ɔ nya, nɔ nɛ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi wa gu kɛ na kã kɛ he blɔ ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae, konɛ nyɛ tsui ko po ngɛ ye nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nae ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ he, ejakaa nyɛ hɛ mi nyami ʼi.
Kristo suɔmi Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kplaa si haa Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ mi nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ naa e biɛ nitsɛ ɔ, konɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi nyɛmi hiɛmi ɔ nya a, e ha nyɛɛ gu e Mumi ɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ he nɛ wa kpitikplii ngɛ nyɛ mi nɔmlɔ ɔ blɔfami, nɛ a gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ nɛ Kristo nɛ hi si ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi nɛ nyɛ sipoku nɛ pi si nɛ nyɛɛ ma si gbugbuugbu ngɛ suɔmi mi, konɛ nyɛ na he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ yɔse nɔ́ nɛ ji blimi kɛ kami kɛ mi kuɔmi kɛ hiɔwe yami ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ le Kristo suɔmi nɛ pa ni lemi tsuo ɔ, konɛ Mawu himi kɛ si pimi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ tsuo tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ peɔ kɛ bee nɔ babauu pe nihi kulaa nɛ wa kpaa he pɛɛ loo wa susuu, ngɛ e he wami nɛ tsuɔ ni ngɛ wa mi ɔ nya a, lɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha ngɛ asafo nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ngɛ yi nɔhi kulaa mi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene!
Amen.
Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kake ʼi Imi nɛ i ji pa mi no ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa nyɛɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ sa tsɛmi nɛ a kɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, ngɛ he si bami kɛ humi peemi tsuo mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tsui si tomi nɛ suɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ to mumi kake peemi ɔ ngɛ he jɔmi kpa nɛ fi nyɛ ɔ mi, kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ mumi kake, kaa bɔ nɔuu nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ hulɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsɛmi hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kake ɔ mi ɔ: Nyɔmtsɛ kake, hemi kɛ yemi kake, baptisimi kake, Mawu kɛ nihi kulaa a Tsɛ kake nɛ ngɛ nihi kulaa nɔ, nɛ e guu nihi tsuo mi nɛ e ngɛ nihi tsuo mi ɔ.
Se wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, a ngɔ dloomi ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ ngɛ Kristo nike ni ɔmɛ a kalemi ɔ nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Ngmami ɔ ke: “E kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya Nɛ e ngɔ nyɔguɛhi fuu ngɔ piɛ e he, Nɛ e kɛ nike nihi ha nimli.” Se nɛ a ke “E kuɔ” ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ?
E sisi ji e kple si kɛ ya zugba a sisi ni ɔmɛ a mi kekle.
Nɔ nɛ kple si ɔ, lɛ nɔuu hu ji nɔ nɛ kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwehi kulaa a yi mi, konɛ e hyi je ɔ kulaa tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Nɛ lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ha ni komɛ plɛ bɔfohi, ni komɛ gbali, ni komɛ hu sane kpakpa fiɛli, nɛ ni komɛhu nɔ hyɛli kɛ tsɔɔli, konɛ a kɛ gla he tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ ha sɔmɔmi ni tsumi ɔ, kɛ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ fiami, kɛ maa su be nɛ wɔ kulaa wa maa su Mawu Bi ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ e he ni lemi kake peemi ɔ he nɛ waa pee nyumu nɛ su kɛ pi si ngɛ Kristo klemi muzaamu ɔ susumi nya; konɛ wa ko ya nɔ nɛ waa pee bimwɔwi nɛ tsɔɔmi kɔɔhiɔ tsuaa tsɔɔmi kɔɔhiɔ mimiɛɛ mɛ, nɛ a kpakaa mɛ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ nimli a ga yaya tomi mi, ngɛ sisimi ga kɛ kutupɔ nya.
Se mohu waa pee anɔkualetsɛmɛ ngɛ suɔmi mi, nɛ waa wa ngɛ nihi kulaa blɔfami, ngɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ nɔuu nɛ ji yi ɔ he; lɛ e mi nɛ nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ tsuo nuu e he siɔ nɔ, nɛ kpɔ nya tsuaa kpɔ nya tsuɔ ni kaa bɔ nɛ a to ha lɛ ɔ, nɛ e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ waa nɛ e heɔ si ngɛ suɔmi mi.
Wami he ngɛ Kristo mi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ dee, nɛ i ngɛ nɔ mi mae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi, kaa nyɛ ko nyɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ majeli a bimɛ kpa amɛ hu nyɛɛ ngɛ a yaka juɛmi ɔ mi ɔ hu; ejakaa a juɛmi ɔ mi wo diblii, nɛ nibwɔhi ji mɛ ngɛ wami nɛ Mawu haa a blɔfami, akɛnɛ nɔ lemi bɔ́ mɛ nɛ a tsui hu ti ɔ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pee we mɛ zo hu he je ɔ, a ngɔ a he ngɔ ha ya homi, nɛ a kɛ hɛ tsumi tsuɔ tai nihi tsuo kulaa.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ pi ja nɛ nyɛ kase ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, ke e ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ nu e he, nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ e mi hulɔ, bɔ nɛ ji anɔkuale ngɛ Yesu mi ɔ, nyɛ sake nyɛ sa je mi bami ɔ nya nɔmlɔ momo nɛ puɛ ngɛ sisimi se dimi ɔmɛ a nya a ngɔ fɔ he, nɛ nyɛ plɛ nimli hehi ngɛ nyɛ juɛmi kɛ mumi mi, nɛ nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ he nɛ a bɔ ngɛ Mawu subai nɔ ngɛ anɔkuale dami kɛ he tsɔmi mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ sake lakpa ngɔ fɔ he nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi nɛ tu anɔkuale, ejakaa nɔmlɔ tso kake he nihi ji wɔ.
Nyɛ muklii mi nɛ fu, se nyɛ ko pee yayami; pu ko nɔ si ngɛ nyɛ mi mi fumi ɔ nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko fɔ si ha Abosiami.
Juɔ ɔ, e ko ju hu, se mohu e bɔ mɔde nɛ e kɛ e ninehi nɛ tsu ni tsumi kpakpa, konɛ e na nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ha nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ. Munyu yaya ko nɛ ko je nyɛ nya kulaa; se mohu munyu nɛ hi nɛ e hia, konɛ e ha nɔ nane nɛ pi si, konɛ a kɛ dloo nihi nɛ nuɔ ɔ. Nɛ nyɛ ko pee Mawu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔdɔ nɔ́, nɔ mi nɛ pa sɔu nyɛ nya ngɛ ngɔ to kpɔmi ligbi ɔ. Nyɛ ha mi mi doomi kɛ mi mi la kɛ muklii mi fumi kɛ huhui kɛ musu bɔmi kulaa se nɛ po ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kɛ yayami tsuaa yayami.
Nyɛ mi mi nɛ jɔ ha nyɛ sibi, nyɛ muklii mi nɛ sa nyɛ ha nyɛ sibi, nyɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ sibi, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɔ pa nyɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ.
Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ kaa la bimɛ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee Mawu kaseli kaa bimɛ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ suɔmi mi kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu suɔ wɔ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he kaa nɔ́ke nɔ́ kɛ bɔ nɛ he via nɛ a kɛ ha Mawu.
Se ajuama bɔmi kɛ mu ni tsumi tsuo loo he tsemi ɔ, a ko wo ta tete ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔuhi, kɛ zo ni tsumi kɛ yakayaka munyu kɛ fɛu yemi hu nɛ sɛ́ ɔ; se mohu sina.
Ejakaa nyɛ le enɛ ɔ momo kaa, ajuama bɔlɔ ko ajuama bɔlɔ ko loo mu ni tsulɔ ko loo hɛ tsulɔ ko nɛ ji wɔ jalɔ be blɔ nya ngɛ Kristo kɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko kɛ munyu gu nɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ; ejakaa jamɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ Mawu muklii mi fumi baa tuegbenɔ bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko bɔ a he.
Ejakaa sa a diblii ji nyɛ, se jahanɛ ɔ nyɛ plɛ la ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Lɛɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ kaa la bimɛ mɔ.
Ejakaa la a yiblii ji mi mi himi kɛ dami kɛ anɔkuale tsuo.
Nyɛɛ ka nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hyɛ kaa e sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi lo.
Nyɛɛ kɛ diblii ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ wui yiblii ɔ ko bɔ, se mohu nyɛ je mɛ si.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ a juɔ si peɔ ɔ ngɛ zo kaa a maa wo ta tete.
Se nihi tsuo nɛ a jeɔ si ɔ, la a a kɛ jeɔ mɛ si paa; ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kpɛɛ ɔ la ʼi.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ a de ke: “O hɛ nɛ tsɛ, mo nɔ nɛ o ngɛ mahɛ hwɔe ɔ, Nɛ o te si kɛ je gbeje, Nɛ Kristo maa tso ha mo” ɔ, nɛ!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa hi si ha, pi kaa nihi nɛ li nɔ́, se mohu kaa ni leli, nihi nɛ tsuɔ a deka he ni, ejakaa yi nɔ nɛ ɔ, yi nɔ yaya ʼi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he nihi nɛ be yi mi, se mohu nyɛ yo nihi nɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ni ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ ko de da, nɔ́ mi nɛ sakasaka peemi ngɛ ɔ, se mohu nyɛ hyi tɔ kɛ Mumi ɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he nɛ tu munyu ngɛ saku fiami kɛ yi jemi lahi kɛ mumi mi lahi a mi; nyɛ la nɛ nyɛɛ fia saku ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ na Mawu kɛ Tsɛ ɔ si daa ngɛ nihi kulaa he ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi.
Yigbayi kɛ a hunomɛ Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɔ ha nyɛ he ngɛ Kristo gbeye yemi mi?
Nyɛ yigbayi ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hunomɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peɔ ngɔ haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Ejakaa huno ɔ ji yo ɔ yi, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ji asafo ɔ yi, nɛ lɛ nɔuu ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi wami helɔ ɔ.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ asafo ɔ baa e he si ngɔ haa Kristo ɔ, ja nɔuu yi ɔmɛ hu a pee ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hunomɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
Nyɛ, hunomɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yihi, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu suɔ asafo ɔ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ e he ɔ, konɛ e kɛ nyu he dumi ɔ nɛ tsukɔ e he ngɛ munyu mi nɛ e ha e pee klɔuklɔu, konɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ da si ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kaa hɛ mi nyami asafo nɛ he be piami ko loo hɛ mi kuami ko loo jamɛ a nɔ́ ko, se mohu e pee klɔuklɔu nɛ piami ko ko hi e he.
Jã sa kaa hunomɛ hu nɛ suɔ a yihi kaa bɔ nɛ a suɔ mɛ nitsɛ a nɔmlɔ tsohi.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ e yo ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he e suɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ ko nyɛ́ lɛ nitsɛ e he lo hyɛ, se mohu e lɛɛ lɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛɛ asafo ɔ; ejakaa e nɔmlɔ tso he nihi nɛ je e he lo kɛ e wuhi a mi ji wɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kulaa a ma plɛ he lo kake.
Kikɛmɛ a laami sane nɛ ɔ mi jiɔ, se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee kɛ ngɛ Kristo kɛ asafo ɔ he toe.
E sa kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e yo ja, kaa lɛ nitsɛ e he, konɛ yo ɔ hu nɛ bu e huno ɔ.
Bimɛ kɛ a fɔli Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli ɔmɛ tue ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi; ejakaa enɛ ɔ da.
“Buu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ,” kɔlɔ ɔ ji kekleekle kita nɛ hɛɛ si womi ke: “Konɛ e hi ha mo, nɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.” Nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a mi mi la, se mohu nyɛɛ lɛ mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi kɛ ga womi mi.
Sɔmɔli kɛ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ Nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he lo blɔfami nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tue kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi ngɛ tsui klɔu peemi mi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peɔ ngɔ haa Kristo ɔ; pi kɛ hɛ mi hɛ mi sɔmɔmi kaa nihi nɛ hlaa nimli a hɛ mi nyami, se mohu kaa Kristo tsɔli nɛ jee a tsui mi peɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ni, nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi sɔmɔɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ʼi, se tsa pi nimli, nɛ nyɛ kai kaa nɔ́ ko kpakpa nɛ mo nɔ o peɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he hiɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa wo mo, sɔmɔlɔ jio, odehe jio.
Nɛ nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mɛ ja nɔuu, nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ mɛ haihai hɛɛmi, nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ kulaa ngɛ nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi.
Mawu ta hwumi ni ɔmɛ kulaa Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ he nɛ wa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e he wami nyɛmi ɔ mi.
Nyɛɛ wo Mawu ta hwumi ni ɔmɛ kulaa, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ Abosiami ga tsɔmi ɔmɛ a nya nɛ nyɛɛ da.
Ejakaa tsa pi he lo kɛ muɔ nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ, se mohu waa kɛ nɔkɔtɔma yemihi kɛ he blɔhi kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yemihi nɛ ngɛ mwɔnɔmwɔnɔ diblii ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ mumi yayami asafo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe nihi a mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ Mawu ta hwumi ni ɔmɛ kulaa mi konɛ nyɛ nyɛ ligbi yaya a nya nɛ nyɛɛ da, nɛ benɛ nyɛ gbe kulaa nya a nɛ nyɛ nyɛ si nɛ nyɛɛ da.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ da si, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ anɔkuale nɛ fi nyɛ mlɛ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ wo dami dama a, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa a fiɛmi he nyami nɛ wo nyɛ nane.
Lɛ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi tsɛi ɔ mi, nɔ nɛ nyɛ ma kɛ nyɛ nɔ yayami kɛɛ mi bihi nɛ tsoo ɔ kulaa gbe ɔ. Nɛ yi wami hemi dade pɛɛ ɔ hu nyɛ bu kɛ mumi mi klaate nɛ ji Mawu munyu ɔ; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami tsuo sɔle daa ha klɔuklɔubi ɔmɛ kulaa kɛ imi hulɔ, konɛ, ke i bli ye nya a, a ha mi munyu nɛ ma kɛ ka nɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a mi laami sane ɔ, nɔ he nɛ i ngɛ bɔfo yee ngɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ mi nɛ ɔ, konɛ ma tu munyu kɛ ka ngɛ mi, bɔ nɛ sa kaa ma tu ɔ. Nyagbe sɛyemi Se benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ kɛ nihi nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, wa suɔmi nyɛmi Tihiko, nɛ ji sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, maa bɔ nyɛ kulaa; ejakaa enɛ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ i tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ha, nɛ e wo nyɛ bua.
Hejɔmi, kɛ suɔmi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ!
Dloomi nɛ je wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ suɔ le kɛ pii si ɔ nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Yesu Kristo sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, ngma ya ha ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ngɛ Filipi kɛ a nɔ hyɛli kɛ a sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kulaa: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Paulo pɛɛ kpami kɛ ha e womi ɔ kaneli I naa ye Mawu ɔ si be tsuaa be nɛ e kaii nyɛ, ngɛ ye daa pɛɛ kpamihi tsuo nɛ i kpaa ngɔ haa nyɛ kulaa a mi, nɛ i kɛ bua jɔmi kpaa pɛɛ ngɛ wa he nɛ nyɛ piɛɔ ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi mi kɛ je kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ kɛ ba su amlɔ nɛ ɔ he; i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ enɛ ɔ nɔuu nɔ, kaa nɔ nɛ bɔni ni tsumi kpakpa ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e ma tsa nɔ kɛ maa su e maa gbe nya ngɛ Yesu Kristo ligbi ɔ nɔ.
E sa kaa ma susu enɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ he, ejakaa i suɔ nyɛ, ejakaa benɛ a wo mi tsu mi ngɛ sane kpakpa a he ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ tsuo na Mawu dloomi ɔ eko.
Mawu ji ye dase kaa ye hɛ jaa ngɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ he ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi mi sami ɔ nya.
Enɛ ɔ he pɛɛ i kpaa kaa, nyɛ suɔmi ɔ nɛ hiɛ kɛ ya nɔ, nɛ e be nɔ pe kekle ɔ ngɛ ni lemi kɛ nɔ se kɔmi tsuo blɔfami, nɛ nyɛ yo nihi nɛ hi nitsɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ hi klɔuu nɛ piami ko ko hi nyɛ blɔfami kɛ yaa su Kristo ligbi ɔ nɔ, nɛ dami yiblii nɛ a woɔ ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ ha Mawu hɛ mi nyami womi kɛ yi jemi.
Kristo ji wami Se, mamimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kaa sanehi nɛ ba ye nɔ ɔ ha sane kpakpa a ya nɔ mohu, nɛ e ha ye tsu mi womi ngɛ Pretorio (Kaisare aslaafohi a mɔ) ɔ mi ngɛ Kristo he ɔ pee nɔ́ nɛ nihi kulaa le.
Nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ a ti nihi fuu gu ye tsu mi womi ɔ nɔ na kã babauu pe kekle ɔ kɛ ngɛ Mawu munyu ɔ jajee nɛ a yi gbeye.
Ni komɛ lɛɛ ninye kɛ hluɛnu he a fiɛɔ Kristo ɔ nɛ; se ni komɛ hu kɛ juɛmi kpakpa fiɛɔ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ jee suɔmi mi kɛ fiɛɔ, ejakaa a le kaa sane kpakpa a he fami he je nɛ i fɔɔ si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ; se ni kpa komɛ ɔ, hluɛnu mi a jee kɛ fiɛɔ Kristo, nɛ pi fiɛmi nitsɛ ʼi, se mohu a juɛmi ji kaa a kɛ dengme maa piɛ ye tsu mi womi ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mɛni?
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, lakpa tomi nya jio, anɔkuale nya jio, Kristo kɛ̃ a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ; nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ngɛ bua jɔmi.
Nɛ jehanɛ hu ma na bua jɔmi.
Ejakaa i le kaa enɛ ɔ ma plɛ ye yi wami hemi ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ Yesu Kristo Mumi ɔ yemi kɛ buami nya, ngɛ ye blɔ hyemi kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ nya, kaa zo be mi gbee ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi, se mohu, bɔ nɛ a peɔ daa a, jã jehanɛ hu a kɛ kã tsuo maa wo Kristo hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso mi, ngɛ wami mi jio, gbenɔ mi jio.
Ejakaa imi lɛɛ Kristo ji ye wami, nɛ gbenɔ ɔ ye se nami ʼi.
Se ke he lo mi wami nɛ ɔ nɔuu haa ye ni tsumi woɔ yiblii ɔ, lɛɛ i li e mi nɔ́ nɛ ma ngɔ; i ngɛ haoe ngɛ ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a he: I ngɛ hlae nɛ ma je je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ i kɛ Kristo ya hi si, ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ hi hluu.
Se nyɛ he ɔ, he lo mi si himi nɛ ɔ he hia pe kɔlɔ ɔ. I ngɛ enɛ ɔ nɔ mi mami kaa i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si nɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ ya hɛ mi, konɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ fu, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi ngɛ mi, konɛ nyɛ mimifliimi ɔ nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, ngɛ ye he, ngɛ kpe nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ekohu ɔ he.
Jehanɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma sane blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi sbɔ nɛ sa Kristo sane kpakpa a kɛkɛ, konɛ, ke i ba ba na nyɛ jio, i kɛ nyɛ be jio, ma nu nyɛ he kaa nyɛ daa si ngɛ mumi kake mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kake ngɛ sane kpakpa a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he plee.
Nɛ nyɛ ko ha nɛ henyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ wo nyɛ he gbeye ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu ji hɛ mi kpatami okadi ha mɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, e ji yi wami hemi okadi ha nyɛ, nɛ enɛ ɔ je Mawu dɛ mi.
Ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ a dloo nyɛ ngɛ Kristo he, pi ngɛ e nɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi kɛkɛ, se mohu kaa nyɛ na nɔ ngɛ e he hulɔ, nɛ jamɛ a pleemi kake ɔ nɔuu nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ ye he nɛ jehanɛ hu nyɛ nuɔ ngɛ ye he ɔ mi i ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kristo hesibami kɛ e gbojemi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Kristo mi munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi ko ngɛ ke suɔmi bua womi ko ngɛ, ke mumi mi huɛ bɔmi ko ngɛ, ke muklii mi sami kɛ mɔbɔ nami ko ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha ye bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hyi tɔ, kaa nyɛ hɛɛ susumi kake, nyɛ hɛɛ suɔmi kake, klaa kake, juɛmi kake.
Nyɛ ko ngmɛ mi gbami loo yaka hɛ mi nyami hlami blɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami juɛmi nɛ bu nyɛ sibi pe nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he; nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ko fo e nɔ mi, se e fo e nyɛmi nɔ mi.
Juɛmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ pee nyɛ hu nyɛ juɛmi, nɔ nɛ Mawu su ɔ mi e ngɛ mohu, se e bui sɔmi nɛ e kɛ Mawu sɔ ɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ sa kaa e pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ; se mohu e kpa ngɛ e he ngɔ fɔ si, e ngɔ sɔmɔlɔ su ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, e plɛ kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ e si himi blɔfami hu a na lɛ kaa nɔmlɔ.
E ba e he si nɛ e bu tue kɛ ya gbenɔ mi, kɛ ya sɛumi tso nɔ gbenɔ mi tete.
Enɛ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ Mawu wo e nɔ gojoo nɛ e dloo lɛ biɛ nɛ pa biɛ tsuaa biɛ, konɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nakutso nɛ kpla si ha Yesu biɛ ɔ, nɛ lilɛ tsuaa lilɛ nɛ jaje paa ke Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wo Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Lakpɛmi ngɛ je ɔ mi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ buɔ tue daa nɛ ɔ, pi benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu titli ɔ, jehanɛ nɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ɔ hu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi nɛ tsu nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yi wami hemi ɔ he ni, ejakaa suɔmi nɛ a maa suɔ jio, peemi nɛ a maa pee jio, Mawu ji nɔ nɛ tsuɔ lɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɛ mi ngɛ e suɔmi nya.
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ nihi kulaa nɛ munyu huitihuiti kɛ nɔ jemi ko ba mi; konɛ nyɛ he ko hi piami, nɛ nyɛɛ pee he tsɔli, Mawu bimɛ nɛ a he be piami ko ngɛ yi nɔ kpɛkpɛɛ nɛ be e jebo nɔ nɛ ɔ mi, nihi a kpɛti nɛ nyɛ tsoo kaa kane ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ wami munyu ɔ mi, konɛ e plɛ fiami nɔ ha mi ngɛ Kristo ligbi ɔ nɔ, kaa ye fotumi ɔ pee we yaka, nɛ ye dengme gbomi ɔ hu pee we gu.
Se ke a plɛ ye muɔ ngɔ pue nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi bɔ kɛ jami ɔ nɔ po ɔ, i ngɛ he tsui nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tsuo ma na bua jɔmi; ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ na bua jɔmi.
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito Ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu mi kaa e be kɛe nɛ ma tsɔ Timoteo kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ ke i nu bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma na tsui.
Ejakaa i be nɔ ko nɛ e juɛmi kɛ ye juɛmi sɔ nɛ nyɛ he sane dɔɔ lɛ nitsɛnitsɛ kaa lɛ; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nihi a he a pleɔ, se pi Kristo Yesu nihi.
Se nyɛ le e ni tsumi, kaa e kɛ mi sɔmɔɔ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he kaa bi kɛ e tsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa ke i na ye sane ɔ nya pɛ ɔ, ma tsɔ lɛ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Se ye hɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ, kaa imi nitsɛ hu, e be kɛe nɛ ma ba.
Se kɛ ɔ, i susu kaa e hia kaa ma tsɔ wa nyɛmi Epafrodito, nɛ ji ye huɛ ni tsulɔ kɛ ta bulɔ kɛ nyɛ tsɔlɔ kɛ ye hia a he sɔmɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, ejakaa e hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ akɛnɛ nyɛ nu kaa e be he wami he je ɔ, e ngɛ haoe.
E ngɛ mi kaa e nu hiɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ piɛ bɔɔ nɛ e ko gbo, se kɛ ɔ Mawu na lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ pi lɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu imi hu, konɛ ma ko ye kɔmɔ ngɔ to kɔmɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he titli nɛ i bɔ mɔde tsɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ ke nyɛ na lɛ ekohu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi nɛ imi hu ma ko ye kɔmɔ tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi, kɛ bua jɔmi babauu, nɛ nyɛɛ bu kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kaa nihi nɛ sa bumi; ejakaa Kristo ni tsumi ɔ he ɔ, e su gbenɔ he tataata, nɛ e sake e wami ngɔ fɔ he, konɛ e kɛ gbe nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma sɔmɔ mi ɔ nya.
Anɔkuale dami Nɛ nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi!
Pɔ tɔɛ ye he kaa ma ngma nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ekohu, ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ e haa nyɛ fiɔɔ si.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ gbe ɔmɛ a he.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ ni tsuli yaya amɛ a he, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ nɔ pomi he!
Ejakaa wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa jaa Mawu ngɛ mumi nya, nɛ waa kɛ wa hɛ fɔɛ he lo nɔ, se Kristo Yesu nɔ mohu wa fiaa ngɔ fɔɔ ɔ, wɔ mohu ji ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Pohu imi hu i ngɛ nɔ ko ngɛ he lo blɔfami nɛ jinɛ i kɛ ye hɛ maa fɔ nɔ.
Ke e peɔ nɔ ko kaa e ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ nɔ ngɛ he lo blɔfami ɔ, ye nɔ ɔ pe.
Ligbi nɛ ji ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ nɔ a po mi, Israel fɔfɔɛ kɛ Benyamin wetso ɔ mi no ji mi, Hebri no mi Hebri no, nɛ Mlaa a nya a Farisifo no hulɔ, mɔde bɔmi blɔfami ɔ, asafo ɔ yi mi walɔ ji mi, nɛ dami ngɛ Mlaa a nya a, piami ko be ye he.
Se kɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ji senami ha mi sa a, i bu kɔlɔ ɔmɛ kaa nihi nɛ laa ngɛ Kristo he.
Niinɛ kaa i buu lɛ tsuo kaa nihi nɛ laa ngɛ Kristo Yesu, ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, he ni lemi nɛ pe kulaa a he, lɛ e he nɛ nihi kulaa bɔ mi, nɛ i buu mɛ kaa kuku nɔ nihi, konɛ Kristo mohu nɛ pee ye nɔ, nɛ a na mi ngɛ e mi kaa i be imi nitsɛ ye dami nɛ je Mlaa mi, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ gu Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ nɛ ji dami nɛ je Mawu dɛ mi ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya a i ngɛ, nɛ ma le lɛ kɛ e si temi ɔ he wami ɔ kɛ e manehlu ɔmɛ a mi huɛ bɔmi ɔ, nɛ ma pee kaa lɛ ngɛ e gbenɔ ɔ blɔfami, kaa alinɔ, ye nine maa su ni gbogboehi a si temi ɔ nɔ lo.
Paulo kunimi yemi Pi kaa ye nine su nɔ momo aloo i hi kɛ pi si mo, se mohu i ngɛ fo tue konɛ ye nine nɛ su nɔ, ligbi abɔ nɛ Kristo Yesu nine su imi hu ye nɔ ɔ. Mamimɛ, i bui ye he kaa ye nine su nɔ, se nɔ́ nɛ ma de ji: nihi nɛ ngɛ se blɔ ɔ, i ngɛ ye hɛ jee ngɛ nɔ, se nihi nɛ ngɛ hɛ kpɛ ɔ a he mohu i ngɛ plee, nɛ i ngɛ fo tue kɛ yaa hɛ kpɛ kɛ maa su Mawu tsɛmi nɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ jlasi ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpɛti nihi abɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a juɛmi nɛ ɔ; nɛ ke nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ susuu lɛ ekpa a, Mawu ma je kɔlɔ ɔ hu kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
E he hia kaa waa ya wa hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa nine su nɔ mo ɔ mi nɛ waa nyɛɛ ngɛ jamɛ a susumi kpa a nɔuu nya nɛ wa susu nɔ kake.
Mamimɛ, nyɛɛ kase mi, nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ wa toɔ nyɛ okadi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ mɛ.
I de nyɛ enɛ ɔ si abɔ, nɛ jeha nɛ ɔ hu i kɛ vo nyu ngɛ dee, ke Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ henyɛli ji mɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a nyagbe ji hɛ mi kpatami, nɛ a muklii ji a mawu, nɛ a zo nihi a mi a hɛ mi nyami ngɛ, nɛ je mi nihi a he kɛkɛ a susuu.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma a hiɔwe e ngɛ, he nɛ wa hyɛɛ yi wami helɔ nɛ ji Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ blɔ kɛ jee ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma tsake wa nɔmlɔ tso nɛ hɛ mi be nyami ɔ, konɛ e pee kaa e numinyami nɔmlɔ tso ɔ su, ngɛ e he wami ni tsumi nɛ ekɛ nyɛɛ ngɔɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ toɔ e sisi hu ɔ nya a.
Nyagbe gawomi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ nɛ ye hɛ jaa ngɛ nyɛ he, ye bua jɔmi kɛ ye jlasi, nyɛɛ da si ja ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi, nyɛ nihi nɛ i suɔ.
I ngɛ Evodia ga woe, nɛ i ngɛ Sintika hu ga woe kaa a juɛmi nɛ pee kake ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Nɛ mo hu, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ye huɛ sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa, kaa o ye bua yi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ mi tsu sane kpakpa a he ni ɔ, kɛ Klemente hu kɛ ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli kpahi nɛ a biɛ ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi ɔ. Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi daa!
Nɛ ma de ekohu ke: Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ!
Nyɛ mi mi jɔmi ɔ nyɛ ha nimli kulaa nɛ le!
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ su si ta.
Nyɛ ko hao ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he, se mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ sina nɛ wo nyɛ hiami ni ɔmɛ a ta ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ Mawu he jɔmi nɛ pe juɛmi kulaa a maa bu nyɛ tsuihi kɛ nyɛ juɛmi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi!
Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nihi nɛ da, nihi nɛ sa bu, nihi nɛ hi, nihi nɛ he tsɔ, nihi nɛ a suɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ biɛ kpakpa amɛ kulaa, ke je mi bami kpakpa ko ngɛ, ke yi jemi ko hu ngɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu!
Nihi hu nɛ nyɛ kase nɛ nyɛ pɛtɛ he nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ ye he ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu nyɛɛ pee, nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
Nike ni he sina I na bua jɔmi babauu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kaa jehanɛ nyɛ ya nɔ ekohu ngɛ ye he susumi mi; nyɛ susu ye he lɛɛ, se he blɔ nɛ nyɛ ya na we.
Pi kaa fimi nya nɛ i ngɛ munyu tue nɛ ɔ, ejakaa imi lɛɛ i kase kaa si himi tsuaa si himi nɛ i ngɛ mi ɔ ye bua nɛ jɔ ye he.
I le ohia mi si himi, nɛ i le ni kpɔtɔɔ mi si himi hulɔ; i gblee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ nihi kulaa mi, tɔ jio, huɔ jio, ni nami jio, ohia jio, I nyɛɔ nihi kulaa peɔ ngɛ kristo, nɔ nɛ woɔ ni he wami ɔ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ nyɛ pee saminya kaa nyɛ ba ye bua mi ngɛ ye nɔ nami ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ nyɛ Filipibi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ hu ɔ, nyɛ le kaa sane kpakpa a sisi jemi mi, benɛ i pue nɔ kɛ je Makedonia a, asafo ko be nɛ kɛ mi bɔɔ huɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hami kɛ hemi blɔfami kaa ja nyɛ kɛkɛ; ejakaa benɛ i ngɛ Tesalonika a hu ɔ, nyɛ mane mi nihi nɛ hiaa mi ɔmɛ si kake kɛ si enyɔ kulaa.
Pi kaa nike ni i ngɛ hlae, se mohu i ngɛ se nami nɛ ma ha nyɛ kɔtaa a maa su kɛ be nɔ ha nyɛ ɔ hlae.
I na nihi kulaa kɛ be nɔ, i tɔ kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mane Epafrodito kɛ ba ha mi ɔ nɛ ji via jemi kpakpa kɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ. Ye Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ nihi kulaa nɛ hiaa nyɛ ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi nyami hiɛmi ɔ nya, ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.
Anuminyami ha wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neene.
Amen.
Nyagbe sɛyemi Nyɛ nga he tsɔlɔ tsuaa he tsɔlɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.
Nyɛmimɛ nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ.
He tsɔli ɔmɛ kulaa, se titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ je Kaisare we ɔ, ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ɔ, ngma ya ha he tsɔli nɛ ngɛ Kolose ɔ kɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ he ye nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ.
Sina sɔlemi Wa naa Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ, si daa nɛ ngɛ nyɛ he ngɛ wa sɔlemihi a mi, ejakaa wa nu nyɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ hemi kɛyemi kɛ nyɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ he tsɔli ɔmɛ kulaa a he, ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ a ngɔ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ he.
Nyɛ nu momo ngɛ sane kpakpa a anɔkuale munyu ɔ mi, nɔ́ nɛ su nyɛ ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ je mluku ɔ kulaa mi, nɛ e woɔ yiblii nɛ e kekee kaa bɔ nɛ e peɔ ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti kɛ je ligbi nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ nyɛ na le Mawu dloomi ɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ: kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ kase hulɔ ngɛ Epafra, nɔ nɛ ji wa huɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɛ wa suɔ, nɛ ji Kristo anɔkuale sɔmɔlɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nya a, lɛ nɔuu e ba bɔ wɔ nyɛ Mumi ɔ mi suɔmi he sane.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ wɔ hu, kɛ je ligbi nɛ wa nu ɔ, wa jɔɔ we sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ nyɛ hami, konɛ nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ e suɔmi nya nihi a lemi ngɛ mumi mi ni lemi kɛ sisinami tsuo mi; konɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ e sa e hɛ mi saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yiblii ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa mi; nɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ ngɛ Mawu he ni lemi mi, nɛ a kɛ he wami tsuo nɛ wo nyɛ he wami ngɛ e hɛ mi nyami nyɛmi ɔ nya ngɛ tsui si tomi nɛ se kɛɛ ɔ kulaa mi.
Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ na Tsɛ ɔ si, nɔ nɛ ha wa sa nihi nɛ yeɔ klɔuklɔu bimɛ a gbo si ni ɔ eko ngɛ la mi, nɛ e je wɔ kɛ je diblii he wami ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ba to e suɔmi bi ɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e mi wa na kpɔmi ɔ nɛ ji wa he yayami pami ɔ ngɛ, ngɛ e muɔ ɔ he.
Kristo kɛ e nitsumi Kristo ji Mawu nɛ a nɛ́ ɔ subai, bɔ nihi kulaa a kpɛti tete ɔ; ejakaa e mi a bɔ nihi tsuo kulaa ngɛ, nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nihi nɛ a naa kɛ nihi nɛ a nɛ́, matsɛ sɛhi jio, nɔ yemihi jio, nɔkɔtɔma yemihi jio, he blɔhi jio, ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, e nɔ a gu nɛ a bɔ, nɛ lɛ nɔuu a bɔ ha.
Lɛ nɔuu lɛ ngɛ loko nihi tsuo kulaa ngɛ, nɛ nihi tsuo kulaa a, e mi a ngɛ.
Lɛ nɔuu ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ ji asafo ɔ yi, nɔ nɛ ji sisije ɔ, ni gbogboehi a kpɛti tete ɔ, konɛ lɛ e pee kekleekle nɔ ngɛ nihi tsuo kulaa mi.
Ejakaa e sa Mawu hɛ mi kaa fuu hyimi kulaa nɛ hi e mi; nɛ e gu lɛ nɔuu e nɔ kɛ dla e kɛ nihi tsuo kulaa a kpɛti, nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gu e sɛumi tso nɔ gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ha he jɔmi ba a. Nyɛ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ jir ni kpahi kɛ shenyɛli ngɛ nyɛ juɛmi kɛ ni tsumi yaya amɛ a mi ɔ, jehanɛ, e kɛ e he lo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gu gbenɔ mi kɛ kpata ha nyɛ, konɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛ da si kaa ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ he be piami ko loo nya pomi ko ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii, nɛ nyɛ ko sã nyɛ he kɛ je sane kpakpa a nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ a fiɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe sisi, nɛ imi Paulo hu i sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he ɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ he.
Paulo sɔmɔmi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi Jehanɛ ye bua jɔɔ ngɛ ye nɔ namihi nɛ i naa ngɛ nyɛ he ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ i haa nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ Kristo amanehulu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ hyiɔ tɔ ngɛ ye he lo ɔ mi ha e nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ji asafo ɔ.
A pee mi sɔmɔlɔ ngɛ Mawu blɔ nya tomi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ blɔfami ɔ nya, kaa ma ha Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ ba mi, nɔ́ nɛ ji laami sane nɛ a ngɔ laa kɛ je blema lokoo kɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, se jehanɛ a je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa a ha a le nɔ́ nɛ ji kikɛmɛ a laami sane nɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami hiɛmi ɔ ngɛ ma jeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ ji Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ ji hɛ mi nyami hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ. Lɛ e he sane wa fiɛɔ, nɛ wa woɔ nɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ ga, nɛ wa tsɔɔ nɔmlɔ ni ngɛ ni lemi tsuaa ni lemi mi, konɛ waa kɛ nɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ nɛ da si kaa nɔ́ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.
Kɔlɔ ɔ he dengme i ngɛ gboe nɛ i ngɛ plee ngɛ ni tsumi nɛ a kɛ he wami tsuɔ ngɛ ye mi ɔ nya.
I suɔ kaa ma ha nyɛɛ le nyɛ he dengme babauu nɛ i ngɛ gboe ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea kɛ nihi abɔ nɛ nɛ́ ye hɛ mi ngɛ he lo mi ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a na tsui, nɛ a pee kake ngɛ suɔmi mi kɛ pɛtɛ sisi numi nɛ mi kuɔ nɛ a ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ ɔ kulaa mi, nɛ a le Mawu kɛ Kristo laami sane ɔ, nɔ́ mi nɛ a ngɔ ga kɛ ni lemi juetli ɔ kulaa ngɔ laa ngɛ ɔ. I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee konɛ nɔ ko kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu ko ko sisi nyɛ.
Ejakaa ke i kɛ nyɛ be ngɛ he lo blɔfami hu, mumi blɔfami ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ ye bua jɔɔ, nɛ i naa nyɛ blɔ nya tomi kɛ si fimi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ daa si ngɛ Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ. Kristo mi wami hiɛmi Akɛnɛ nyɛ he Kristo Yesu, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, atuu nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ e mi, nɛ nyɛ sipoku nɛ pi si, nɛ a ma nyɛ ngɛ e nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ du si ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɔuu nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ tsui nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ sina.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ je mi ni lemi kɛ yaka sisimi ko ngɔ nyɛ nyɔgue, ngɛ nimli a blema sanehi kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi mumihi nɛ ji Kristo mi ɔ nya.
Ejakaa e mi Mawu fuu hyimi ɔ kulaa hii ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso su mi; nɛ nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ e mi, lɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔkɔtɔma yemi kɛ he blɔ tsuo yi ɔ, nɔ mi nɛ a po nyɛ hu ngɛ, kɛ nɔ pomi nɛ pi he lo mi pomi, se mohu Kristo pomi nɛ jeɔ wɔ kɛ jee he lo nɔmlɔ tso yayami mi ɔ; ejakaa a pu nyɛ ngɔ piɛ e he ngɛ baptisimi ɔ mi, nɔ mi hu nɛ a tle nyɛ si ngɛ, ngɛ Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ he wami ni tsumi ɔ nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nya a.
