Nɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ji ni gbogboehi ngɛ nyɛ nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ he lo mɔmlɔtɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e ha nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo wami, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ kulaa pa nyɛ; nɛ e gba wa he womi nɛ a ngma, nɛ ngɛ Mlaa amɛ a mi nɛ da si si wɔ ɔ, nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu e je ngɛ kpɛti kɛ ho, nɛ e ka ngɔ mɛtɛ sɛumi tso ɔ he.
E kplɔ nɔkɔtɔma yemihi kɛ he blɔ ɔmɛ a he nihi, nɛ e bɔ mɛ ahlua pãa, nɛ e sã mɛ kɛ nyɛɛ e se ngɛ e kunimi yemi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ kojo nyɛ ngɛ ni yeni, loo ni numi, loo nyami ligbi, loo hluami he, loo Hejɔɔmi Ligbihi a blɔfami, ejakaa nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ a he nini kɛkɛ ʼi, se nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ji Kristo nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ buu e he kaa e pe nihi kulaa ngɛ ni nami ko he ɔ nɛ bu nyɛ fɔ nɛ e fi nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hlami nya kaa a kɛ he si bami juɛmi nɛ ja hiɔwe bɔfohi; e he lo juɛmi ɔ hãa e woɔ e he nɔ yakatsuaa; kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ, e hɛɛ we Kristo nɛ ji yi ɔ mi, nɔ mi nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa naa nihi nɛ hiaa lɛ, kɛ guu kpɔjihi kɛ panihi a nɔ kɛ waa bɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ. Gbomi kɛ wami ngɛ Kristo mi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo gbo kɛ ha je nɛ ɔ mi sisije ni ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ haa a woɔ nyɛ mlaa kɛ mwɔɔ ke: “Koo pɛtɛ he, nɛ koo sa o nya, nɛ koo ta he tete” ɔ?
Jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ kulaa a, a he ni tsumi mi nɔuu a hɛ mi kpataa ngɛ, ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nimli a kitahi kɛ tsɔɔmihi, nɛ a ji nihi nɛ hɛɛ ni lemi munyu ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya jami kɛ he si bami juɛmi kɛ nɔmlɔ tso yi mi wami mi mohu, se a pi nihi nɛ he ngɛ se nami nɛ kuɔ he lo ɔ he numi nihi a nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke a tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si ɔ, nyɛ hla nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ Kristo ngɛ nɛ e hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu, pi nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Ejakaa nyɛ gbo nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ wami ɔ kɛ Kristo tsuo ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu mi.
Benɛ Kristo, nɔ nɛ ji wa wami ɔ ma pue ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ma pue ngɛ anuminyami mi.
Wami momo kɛ ehe ɔ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ gbe nyɛ he nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ: ajuama bɔmi, mu ni tsumi, mi mi la, akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ hɛ tsumi nɛ ji wɔ jami ɔ, nihi a he nɛ Mawu muklii mi fumi baa tuegbenɔ bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nihi a mi nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ nyɛɛ sa, benɛ nyɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ peɔ ja amɛ a kpɛti ɔ.
Se jehanɛ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ sake kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa ngɔ pue he, nihi nɛ ji muklii mi fumi, mi mi la, hetsɛ, musu bɔmi munyu, zo munyu ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nya mi.
Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa, ejakaa nyɛ je nɔmlɔ momo ɔ kɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he; nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ he nɛ plɛɔ ehe ekohu kɛ yaa ni lemi mi ngɛ nɔ nɛ bɔ lɛ ɔ subai ɔ nya; he nɛ Hela no kɛ Yuda no, nɔ nɛ a po lɛ kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ, jekɔno kɛ Skite no, nyɔguɛ kɛ odehe ko be hu, se mohu Kristo ji nihi kulaa ngɛ nihi kulaa mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ bimɛ nɛ Mawu hia, ni klɔuklɔuhi kɛ suɔli ji nyɛ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ wo mi mi jɔmi, mɔbɔ nami, he si bami, kpoo peemi, tsui si tomi kaa tade, nɛ ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko na sane ko ɔ, nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi nɛ nyɛ kɛ pa nyɛ he, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu kɛ pa nyɛ ɔ, ja nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee.
Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛɛ wo suɔmi nɛ ji kpa nɛ fiɔ nihi kulaa peɔ kake ɔ kaa tade.
Nɛ nyɛ ha Mawu he jɔmi ɔ nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake mi ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ le si nami.
Nyɛ ha Kristo munyu ɔ nɛ hi nyɛ mi babauu ngɛ ni lemi tsuaa ni lemi mi; nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ni nɛ nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ngɛ saku fiamihi kɛ yi jemi lahi kɛ mumi mi lahi a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sina nɛ la ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ha Mawu.
Nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ munyu tumi loo ni tsumi blɔfami ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kulaa ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ gu e nɔ kɛ na Mawu kɛ Tsɛ ɔ si.
Wami he ɔ mi sihimi Yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɔ ha nyɛ hunomɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi.
Hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yihi, nɛ nyɛ yi mi ko wa ngɛ a nɔ.
Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli a tue ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ blɔfami, ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ lɛ sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi saminya.
Tsɛmɛ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bihi a muklii mi la, konɛ a nine mi nɛ ko wo nyu.
Sɔmɔli, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he lo blɔfami nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a tue ngɛ nihi kulaa mi, pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi, kaa nihi nɛ hlaa nimli a hɛ mi nyami, se mohu ngɛ tsui kpakpa mi kaa nihi nɛ yee Mawu gbeye.
Nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kɛ pee, kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ hae se pi nimli, nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nyɛ nine maa su gbo si ni ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ kaa nyɛ hiɔwo, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe.
Nɔ nɛ peɔ nihi nɛ dɛ́ blɔ ɔ ma na nihi nɛ dɛ́ blɔ ɔ he hiɔwo, nɛ hɛ mi hyemi ko be mi.
Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa pɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.
Nyagbe gawomi Nyɛɛ sɔle daa, nyɛɛ fɔ nyɔ ngɛ mi kɛ sina; nɛ jehanɛ snyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ hulɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ bli munyu ɔ sinya a ha wɔ nɛ wa kɛ fiɛ Kristo laami sane ɔ, nɔ́ he nɛ i fɔɔ si ngɛ kpa mi nɛ ɔ, konɛ ma je kɔlɔ ɔ si paa bɔ nɛ da kaa ma de ɔ. Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ ni lemi nya, ngɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ se ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ tsu nyɛ deka a he ni.
Nyɛ ha nyɛ munyu he nɛ tsɔ daa, nɛ ngo nɛ hi mi, nɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ heto.
Nyagbe sɛyemi Tihiko, nɛ ji suɔmi nyɛmi kɛ anɔkuale sɔmɔlɔ kɛ huɛ tsɔlɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, maa bɔ nyɛ ye he sane ɔmɛ tsuo.
Enɛ ɔ he nɔuu nɛ i tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ ma nu nyɛ he, nɛ e wo nyɛ bua, nɛ i ngɔ Onesimo nɛ ji anɔkualetsɛ kɛ nyɛmi nɛ a suɔ nɛ je nyɛ kpɛti ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he; a ma ba bɔ nyɛ hiɛ ɔ sanehi kulaa.
Aristarko, ye huɛ pa mi no ɔ, kɛ Marko nɛ ji Barnaba nyɛmi bi ɔ, (nɔ nɛ he nɛ nyɛ na womi ɔmɛ ɔ, ke e ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ), kɛ Yesu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yusto ɔ, nihi nɛ je ninɛmɛ nɛ a po mɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he; a ji bua womi kɛ ha mi.
Epafra nɛ je nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ji Kristo sɔmɔlɔ nɛ daa nɛ ɔ e kaii nyɛ ngɛ e sɔlemihi a mi, konɛ nyɛɛ da si nɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ nyɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nihi kulaa mi ɔ, ke e biɔ nyɛ.
I ngɛ e he odase yee kaa e gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Hierapoli ɔmɛ a he.
Luka, tsopatsɛ nɛ a suɔ ɔ, kɛ Dema ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Wa biɔ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea a, kɛ Nimfa kɛ asafo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ. Nɛ ke a kane womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha a kane ngɛ Laodikea asafo ɔ mi hulɔ, nɛ a ha nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kane Laodikea nɔ ɔ. Nɛ nyɛ de Arkipo ke: “Hyɛ nɛ o tsu sɔmɔmi ni tsumi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ o gbe nya kɛ pi si!” Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya womi nɛ i ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ kai ye kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ!
Dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ngma ya ha Tesalonika asafo nɛ ngɛ Mawu, Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Tesalonikabi ɔmɛ a sihihii kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi Wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ wa woɔ nyɛ ta ngɛ wa pɛɛ kpamihi a mi, nɛ wa jɔɔ we.
Wa kaii nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ suɔmi mɔde bɔmi ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi mi tsui si tomi ɔ ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Ejakaa mamimɛ nɛ Mawu suɔ, wa le hlami nɛ a hla nyɛ ɔ, kaa wa sane kpakpa a bɛ́ nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ munyu tumi mi kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami kɛ nɔ mi mami babauu mi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le, bɔ nɛ wa plɛ ba wa je mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ. Nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ plɛ waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaseli, akɛnɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu mi bua jɔmi he munyu ɔ ngɛ dengme babauu mi ɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛ plɛ okadi ha nihi kulaa nɛ he ye ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia a. Ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ munyu ɔ je nɛ e gbɛ fia, pi ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛkɛ, se mohu nyɛ hemi nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu nɔ yeɔ ɔ jije kɛ ho he tsuaa he ya, nɛ e hia we wɔ nɔ́ ko demi tete.
Ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbɛ wa slaami ɔ he munyu ɔ fia kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ kpale kɛ je amagahi a he kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ba sɔmɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ e bi ɔ nɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ blɔ hyɛe kɛ je hiɔwe, Yesu ne je wɔ kɛ je mi mi fumi nɛ maa ba a mi ɔ.
Paulo nitsumi ngɛ Tesalonika Mamimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa slaami nɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ pee we yaka, se mohu wa na ka ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ mi, nɛ waa kɛ fiɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ nya tsimi babauu mi; pohu wa na nɔ kɛ be, nɛ a wa wɔ yi mi hulɔ ngɛ Filipi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ. Ejakaa wa munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ, pi sisimi loo mu ni tsumi loo lakpa mi nɛ e je; se mohu kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu bu wɔ nihi nɛ sa kaa a tu sane kpakpa a ngɔ wo wa dɛ mi ɔ, ja wa deɔ, pi bɔ nɛ sa nimli a hɛ mi, se mohu bɔ nɛ sa Mawu nɛ kaa tsuihi hyɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Ejakaa wa tu we nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu ko hyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, nɛ wa to we hɛ tsumi he lakpa ko hulɔ, Mawu ji odase; jehanɛ wa hla we nimli a hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ aloo ni kpa komɛ a ngɔ, pohu wa ngɛ he blɔ kaa waa kɛ wa he fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ, akɛnɛ Kristo bɔfohi ji wɔ ɔ.
Se mohu wa mi mi jɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛ a nyɛ hɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ ɔ. Akɛnɛ wa suɔ nyɛ saminya he je ɔ, wa ngɛ he tsui kaa pi Mawu sane kpakpa a kɛkɛ nɛ waa kɛ ma ha nyɛ, se mohu wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa wami tete, ejakaa wa suɔ nyɛ wawɛɛ.
Mamimɛ, nyɛ hɛ ngɛ wa pɔtɔ kɛ wa dengme gbomi ɔ nɔ, kaa benɛ pee nɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko he je ɔ, nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo wa ngɛ ni tsue, nɛ wa pa ngɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ kɛ Mawu ji odase yeli kaa wa je mi nɛ wa ba ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he yeɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ngɛ klɔuu, e da, nɛ piami ko be he.
Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ wa hɛɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ ko hɛɛ e bimɛ.
Wa wo nyɛ he wami, wa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ wa su nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e matsɛ yemi kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wɔ hu wa naa Mawu si nɛ wa jɔɔ we ɔ nɛ, ejakaa benɛ nyɛ nine su Mawu munyu nɛ nyɛ nu ngɛ wa nya a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ pɛtɛ he kaa Mawu munyu, kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hu niinɛ ɔ, se pi kaa nimli a munyu ko ʼi; se mohu e ji Mawu munyu nɛ tsuɔ he wami nihi ngɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ, mamimɛ, nyɛ plɛ Mawu asafo nɛ ngɛ Yudea a kaseli ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, ejakaa dengme nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu mɛ hu a na ngɛ Yudafo ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nihi nɛ gbe Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbali ɔmɛ hulɔ, nɛ a waa wɔ hu yi mi, nɛ a sɛ́ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ nimli tsuo yi, nihi nɛ tsiɔ wɔ blɔ hulɔ kaa wa ko tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ maje li ɔmɛ konɛ a he a yi wami.
Enɛ ɔ a kɛ woɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ fuu tɔ daa nɔ; se jehanɛ Mawu mi mi fumi na mɛ.
Paulo suɔ nɛ e ya slaa Tesalonikabi ɔmɛ ekohu Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, mamimɛ, akɛnɛ waa kɛ nyɛ mi gba be kpiti ko ngɛ he lo mi se pi tsui mi he je ɔ, waa kɛ hɛja babauu bɔ mɔde nitsɛ konɛ waa na nyɛ hɛ mi ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ wa hla kaa waa ba nyɛ ngɔ — imi, Paulo ɔ, i hla si kake kɛ si enyɔ sɔuu — se Satan tsi wɔ blɔ.
Ejakaa mɛni ji wa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi loo wa bua jɔmi loo wa fiami jlasi ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi ngɛ e bami be ɔ mi ɔ?
Anɛ pi nyɛ nɔuu lo?
Ejakaa nyɛ nyɛ ji wa hɛ mi nyami kɛ wa bua jɔmi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ wa nyɛ we hu ɔ, wa kplɛɛ kaa a je wa he kɛkɛ ngɛ Ateene, nɛ wa tsɔ wa nyɛmi Timoteo, nɛ ji Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kɛ wa huɛ ni tsulɔ ngɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a mi ɔ, konɛ e ba wo nyɛ he wami nɛ e ha nyɛ fi si ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, konɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ nami nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nane nɛ kpata.
Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ha wɔ nɔuu ji kɔlɔ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa de nyɛ ngɔ to ke wa maa na nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ba mi nɛ nyɛ le ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ imi hu, benɛ i nyɛ we hu ɔ, i tsɔ konɛ ma kɛ le nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, kaa alinɔ nɔ kalɔ ɔ ba ka nyɛ nɛ e ha wa dengme nɛ wa gbo ɔ pee yaka lo?
Se jehanɛ nɛ Timoteo je nyɛ ngɔ ba wa ngɔ nɛ e ba bɔ wɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kɛ nyɛ suɔmi kɛ kaimi kpakpa nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kaii wɔ daa a, kɛ nyɛ hɛ̃ nɛ ngɛ jae kaa nyɛ ma na wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa hɛ̃ jaa ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ, e nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mamimɛ, wa nɔ nami kɛ wa haomi ɔmɛ kulaa mi ɔ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ha wa bua jɔ ngɛ nyɛ he.
Jehanɛ wa na he wami he, akɛnɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. Kɛ wa maa na Mawu si ngɛ nyɛ he ngɛ bua jɔmi tsuo nɛ wa na ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ɔ he kɛɛ?
Nyɔ kɛ pia kulaa wa kpaa pɛɛ babauu, konɛ waa na nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ wa ha nyɛ nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ. Jehanɛ, Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ ha wa blɔ ɔ nɛ da kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛɛ be nɔ kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ nyɛ he kɛ nihi kulaa a, kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa suɔ nyɛ ɔ; benɛ pee nɛ e ha nyɛ tsui nɛ pi si ngɛ klɔuklɔu peemi mi nɛ piami ko ko hi nyɛ he, ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa a bami be ɔ mi.
Sihimi nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ga woe ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu mi, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ kase kɛ je wa ngɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi ha ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee hulɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ ja.
Ejakaa nyɛ le kita nɛ wa wo nyɛ ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni kaa nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ, lɔ ɔ ji kaa nyɛɛ tsi nyɛ he nya kɛ je ajuama bɔmi he, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ ɔ hɛɛmi ngɛ he tsɔmi kɛ bu mi, pi ngɛ akɔnɔ hɛ dɔmi mi, kaa bɔ nɛ maje li a bimɛ nɛ li Mawu ɔ peɔ ɔ; konɛ nɔ ko ko ye e nyɛmi amimi nɛ e sisi lɛ ngɛ sane ko mi ejakaa enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he tue gblalɔ ji Mawetsɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ngɔ to nɛ wa ye he odase ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu tsɛ we wɔ ngɔ hi mu ni tsumi, se mohu he tsɔmi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ, nɔ nɛ bui tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ ko nɛ e bui ɔ, se mohu Mawu nɔ nɛ ngɔ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ wo nyɛ mi ɔ ʼi.
E hia we kaa ma ngma nyɛ ngɛ nyɛmimɛ a suɔmi he, ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he; ejakaa nyɛ peɔ ja hulɔ haa nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia tsuo kulaa a.
Se wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, kaa nyɛɛ ya nɔ pe kekle ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ hi si kpoo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko wo ni kpahi a sane mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nine nɛ tsu ni, kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ko hia nyɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami Se, mamimɛ, wa suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le ninɛmɛ nɛ a gbo ɔmɛ a he sane, konɛ nyɛ ko ye kɔmɔ kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ be hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko ɔ. Ejakaa ke wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu gbo nɛ e te si ɔ, ja nɔuu Mawu maa gu Yesu nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔmɛ hu ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ba.
Wa ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ko nya, kaa wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ maa hi ngmengmle nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ mi ɔ, be ninɛmɛ nɛ a gbo ɔmɛ a hlami sɛe.
Ejakaa lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kɛ ose hemi kɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma gbi kɛ Mawu titimati maa je hiɔwe kɛ kple si, nɛ ni gbogboehi nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ kekle maa te si, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ma sa waa kɛ mɛ kulaa ngɛ bɔkuhi a mi kɛ maa ya Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpeemi ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, nɛ jã waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa hi si daa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wo nyɛ bua.
Nyɛ dla nyɛ he ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami ɔ Se be kɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, mamimɛ, e hia we kaa waa ngma nyɛ.
Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le tutuutu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ maa ba kaa juɔ baa nyɔ mi ɔ. Ejakaa be mi nɛ a ma de ke: “He jɔmi ngɛ, nɛ wa ngɛ sɔkee!” ɔ, lɛ be ɔ mi nɔuu hɛ mi kpatami ma ba tua mɛ si kake too, kaa kɔɔmi tuaa yo nɛ muklii wa a, nɛ a be mi jee gblegbleegblee.
Se, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be diblii mi nɛ ligbi ɔ ma ba ti nyɛ si kaa juɔ.
Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo ɔ la bimɛ ji nyɛ kɛ piani bimɛ hulɔ; wa pi nyɔ loo diblii bimɛ.
Lɛɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha waa hwɔ mahɛ kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ, se mohu nyɛ ha waa fɔ nyɔ nɛ wa hɛ nɛ ka si.
Ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ hwɔɔ mahɛ ɔ, nyɔ mi a hwɔɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ deɔ da a, nyɔ mi a deɔ.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ akɛnɛ piani bimɛ ji wɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ha wa hɛ nɛ ka si, nɛ waa wo hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi dama a, nɛ wa bu dade pɛɛ nɛ ji yi wami hemi hɛ kɛ nɔfɔmi ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu to we wɔ ha mi mi fumi, se mohu e to wɔ nɛ wa na yi wami hemi ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi, nɔ nɛ gbo wa yi gbenɔ konɛ wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, waa kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ye bua mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ. Nyagbe gawomi kɛ sɛyemi Se, mamimɛ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ kaa znyɛɛ le nihi nɛ tsuɔ ni ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ a ji nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi nɛ a tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya ngɛ suɔmi mi ngɛ a ni tsumi ɔ he.
Nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ he jɔli ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ wo ninɛmɛ nɛ fɔɔ ɔmɛ he wami; nyɛɛ ye bua ninɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ha nihi kulaa.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ nɔ ko ko ngɔ yayami ngɔ to yayami nane mi, se mohu daa nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ di kpakpa peemi se ngɔ ha nyɛ he kɛ nihi kulaa.
Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ daa; nyɛɛ sɔle be tsuaa be; nyɛɛ na si ngɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mi; ejakaa lɔ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ngɛ nyɛ blɔfami.
Nyɛ ko gbe Mumi ɔ; nyɛ ko bu gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔmɛ kaa pi nɔ́ ko nɛ sa bumi.
Nyɛɛ ka nihi kulaa hyɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he.
Nyɛɛ sa nyɛ he kɛ je nɔ́ fɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛ yayami su ɔ he.
He jɔmi Mawu ɔ nitsɛ nɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kulaa kɛ pi si, nɛ e hyɛ nyɛ mumi kɛ nyɛ klaa kɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa nɔ nɛ piami ko ko hi he ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami be ɔ mi.
Anɔkualetsɛ ji Mawu nɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ lɛ nɔuu e maa pee hulɔ.
Mamimɛ, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha wɔ.
Nyɛ nga nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ nya he fiɔmi klɔuklɔu.
I ngɛ nyɛ kita kae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi kaa nyɛ ha a kane kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛmimɛ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kulaa!
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ngma ya ha Tesalonika asafo nɛ ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ: Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Kojomi ngɛ Kristo bami be ɔ mi E sa kaa wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ he bɔ nɛ sa, mamimɛ, ejakaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ klee wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛe kɛ ngɛ nɔ yae hulɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ tete wa fiaa ngɔ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Mawu asafo ɔmɛ a mi, ngɛ nyɛ tsui si tomi kɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi nɛ a waa kɛ nyɛ nɔ namihi nɛ nyɛ miaa nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ mi ɔmɛ a he.
Enɛ ɔ ji Mawu kojomi nɛ da a he okadi nɛ a naa paa, konɛ a bu nyɛ kaa nyɛ sa Mawu matsɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ nae ngɛ he ɔ. E da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ haoe ɔ, e maa hao mɛ ngɔ to nane mi; nɛ nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ haoe ɔ, e ma ha waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo he jɔɔmi, benɛ a ma je Mawetsɛ Yesu kpo kɛ maa je hiɔwe kɛ e he wami bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe maa gbla nihi nɛ li Mawu kɛ nihi nɛ bui wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo sane kpakpa a tue ɔmɛ a tue.
A ma na hiɔwo nɛ ji neneene hɛ mi kpatami kɛ maa je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ e he wami ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ he, benɛ e maa ba nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a maa na e nyakpɛ nihi ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ he e nɔ ye ɔ kulaa mi ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, ejakaa a he wa dase nɛ wa ye ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ ye.
Enɛ ɔ he je hu nɛ wa kpaa pɛɛ daa haa nyɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ wa Mawu ɔ nɛ ha nyɛɛ sa tsɛmi ɔ, nɛ ngɛ e he wami nya a, e ha nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa tsuaa nɔ́ kpakpa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, benɛ pee nɛ a wo wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami ngɛ e mi, ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nya.
Dikalɔ ɔ Ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ kɛ wa nya nɛ a ma bua ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, mamimɛ, kaa nyɛ ko ha nɛ a kɛ mumi ko loo munyu ko loo womi ko nɛ a ma de ke e je wa ngɔ ɔ nɛ puɛ nyɛ juɛmi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Ligbi ɔ ba momo.
Nyɛ ko ha nɔ ko nɛ e sisi nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɔ, ejakaa ja Mawu jami kuami ɔ ba lolo, nɛ a je dikalɔ nɛ ji hɛ mi kpatami bi ɔ kpo, nɔ nɛ maa wo e he nɔ nɛ e maa te si ngɔ si nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ mawu loo mawu jami ɔ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma ya hi Mawu we ɔ kaa mawu ko nɛ e ma tsɛ e he kaa lɛ ji Mawu ɔ. Nyɛ kai we kaa, benɛ i kɛ nyɛ̃ ngɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ lo?
Nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e kpo jemi ɔ blɔ tsie ɔ. Ejakaa mlaa kuami laami sane ɔ ngɛ ni tsue momo; se ja a je nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ngɛ blɔ tsie ɔ kɛ je blɔ mi lolo.
Nɛ lɔ ɔ loko a ma je dikalɔ ɔ kpo paa, nɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu kɛ e nya mi mumi ɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ e kɛ e bami ɔ kpɛmi ɔ ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Dikalɔ ɔ maa be kɛ Satan ni tsumi nɛ mi wa ngɛ lakpa he wami kɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi tsuo mi, kɛ nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ kulaa nɛ a kɛ mlɔɔ nihi nɛ laa amɛ, ejakaa a pɛtɛ we anɔkuale suɔmi ɔ he konɛ a kɛ he a yi wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Mawu maa tsɔ sisimi nɛ nya wa kɛ maa ba a ngɔ konɛ a he lakpa a nɛ a ye, konɛ a kojo nihi kulaa nɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi, se a naa nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔmɛ mohu a he tsui ɔ.
A hla nyɛ ha yi wami hemi Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, e sa kaa wa naa Mawu si daa ngɛ nyɛ he, mamimɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ, ejakaa Mawu hla nyɛ kɛ je sisije ngɔ ha yi wami hemi ngɛ mumi ɔ klɔuklɔu peemi kɛ anɔkuale ɔ hemi kɛ yemi mi, enɛ ɔ he nɛ e gu wa sane kpakpa a nɔ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛ na wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ da si, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nihi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ munyu mi loo womi mi ɔmɛ a mi.
Se lɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu nɛ suɔ wɔ nɛ e kɛ neneene bua womi kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kpakpa ha wɔ ngɛ dloomi nya a, lɛ nɔuu e maa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ e maa wo nyɛ he wami ngɛ munyu kpakpa kɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuo mi.
Nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha wɔ Nyagbe ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha wɔ, konɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ gbɛ fia kɛ fo kɛ ya nɔ, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami, kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ hulɔ ɔ; nyɛ kpa pɛɛ nɛ a je wɔ kɛ je yi mi wali kɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi, ejakaa pi nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi.
Se anɔkualetsɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he kɛ maa je dikalɔ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ.
Se wa hɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kaa, nihi nɛ wa wo nyɛ he kita a, nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ nyɛ maa pee hulɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ plɛ nyɛ tsui kɛ ya Mawu suɔmi kɛ Kristo tsui si tomi ɔ he.
Bɔ nɛ e hia kaa a tsu ni Se, mamimɛ, wa ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛmi tsuaa nyɛmi nɛ tsu we ni nɛ nyɛɛ we ngɛ nihi nɛ wa tu ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi ɔ nya a ko bɔ.
Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa e sa kaa nyɛ kaseɔ wɔ; ejakaa wa pee we hejɔ benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu wa yi nɔ ko ku yaka, se mohu waa kɛ mɔde bɔmi kɛ pɔtɔ tsuɔ ni nyɔ kɛ pia, benɛ pee nɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko.
Tsa pi kaa wa be jamɛ a he blɔ, se mohu, konɛ waa ngɔ wa he ngɔ pee nɔ hyemi nɔ ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ hu ɔ, wa wo nyɛ kita ke, ke nɔ ko sume kaa e tsuɔ ni ɔ, lɛɛ e ko ye ni hu mɔ.
Ejakaa wa nuɔ kaa ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ peɔ hejɔ nɛ a tsu we ni se mohu a ngɔɔ a nya ngɔ woɔ nihi a sanehi a mi.
Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ mɛ fae nɛ wa ngɛ mɛ ga woe ngɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo mi kaa a tsu ni kpoo nɛ a ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a dɛ mi ngma.
Mamimɛ, nyɛ ko ha pɔ nɛ tɔ nyɛ kɛ kpakpa peemi.
Se ke nɔ ko bui wa munyu nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ tue ɔ, nyɛ kadi lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko bɔ, konɛ zo nɛ gbe lɛ.
Nyɛ ko bu lɛ kaa henyɛlɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmi.
Nyagbe sɛyemi Lɛ he jɔmi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ ha nyɛ he jɔmi daa ngɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si!
Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya biɔmi nɛ ji okadi ngɛ ye womi tsuaa womi mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Bɔ nɛ i ngmaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu, wa yi wami helɔ ɔ, kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo, wa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ, kita nya a, ngma ya ha Timoteo nɛ ji e bi nitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu kɛ Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Tsɔɔmi yaya he kɔkɔbɔmi Kaa bɔ nɛ benɛ i yaa Makedonia nɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ ke o hi si ngɛ Efeso konɛ o bɔ ni komɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpahi, nɛ jehanɛ hu a ko di nyaziahi kɛ weku sisi tsɔɔmi tslalaa se, ejakaa enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ jemi baa mohu pe Mawu blɔ nya tomi nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ, jamɛ a pɛɛ ɔ i ngɛ mo kpae ekohu.
Kita a nya gbemi ji suɔmi nɛ je tsui nɛ mi tsɔ kɛ he nile kpakpa kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ lakpa ko be mi ɔ mi, nihi nɛ ni komɛ je se, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho yaka munyu he ya.
A ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee a he mlaa tsɔɔli, pohu a nɛ nihi nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ loo nihi nɛ a ngɛ nɔ mi mae tutuutu ɔmɛ a sisi.
Wa le kaa mlaa a hi ha nɔ nɛ tsuɔ he ni bɔ nɛ sa mlaa, nɛ e le enɛ ɔ, kaa dalɔ ɔ a wui lɛ mlaa, se mohu mlaa nɔ tɔli kɛ tue gboli, mlaa a woɔ: nihi nɛ ja we Mawu kɛ yayami peeli, nihi nɛ hɛ mi be nyami kɛ he bleli, tsɛ gbeli kɛ nyɛ gbeli, awi yeli, ajuama bɔli, nyumuhi nɛ kɛ nyumuhi hwɔɔ si, nɔmlɔ juli, nya ngɔli, kita mi kuli kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa yi ɔ, ngɛ Mawu nɛ a gbaa lɛ ɔ nyami sane kpakpa nɛ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ nya.
Mawu mɔbɔnami he sina I naa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ wo mi he wami ɔ si, kaa e bu mi anɔkualetsɛ nɛ e ngɔ mi ngɔ wo sɔmɔmi ɔ mi, imi nɛ kekle ɔ i ji musu bɔlɔ kɛ yi mi walɔ kɛ nɔ builɔ; se kɛ ɔ, a na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa i li nɛ i pee, ngɛ hemi nɛ i he we yi ɔ he.
Se wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ plɛ e dloomi nɛ hiɛ babauu kɛ be nɔ ɔ pue ye nɔ, nɛ e ha i hyi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ. E ji anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a pɛtɛ he kulaa, kaa Kristo Yesu ba je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e ba he yayami peeli a yi wami, nihi a kpɛti nɛ imi ji titima a; se kɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔ he nɛ a na mi mɔbɔ ɔ nɛ, konɛ imi kekle ye mi nɛ Kristo nɛ je e tsui si tomi ɔ kulaa kpo ngɛ, nɛ a kɛ to okadi ha nihi nɛ ma he e nɔ ngɔ ye, nɛ a na neneene wami.
Neneene Matsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbo we, nɔ nɛ ji Mawu kake ɔ, a ngɔ bu kɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene!
Amen.
Ye bi Timoteo, i ngɛ mo kita nɛ ɔ woe, ngɛ gbamihi nɛ a gba sa ngɛ o he ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ o kɛ hwu ta kpakpa a, nɛ o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ he ni lemi kpakpa, nɔ́ nɛ ni komɛ sake fɔ he nɛ a kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ya sa si ɔ; a ti ni komɛ ji Himeneo kɛ Aleksandro, nihi nɛ i tu ngɔ wo Satan dɛ mi, konɛ a gbla a tue nɛ a ko tu musu bɔmi munyuhi hu ɔ.
Asafo mi jami Kekleekle ɔ, nɔ nɛ i ngɛ he ga woe ji kaa a hɛɛ spɛɛ kpamihi, sɔlemihi, mi damihi, sinamihi a mi ha nimli kulaa, ngɔ ha matsɛmɛ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya, konɛ waa hi si kpoo ngɛ he jɔmi mi, ngɛ Mawu jami kɛ je mi bami kpakpa nɛ sa mi.
Ejakaa enɛ ɔ hi nɛ e ngɔɔ Mawu nɛ ji wa yi wami helɔ ɔ nya, nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e he nimli tsuo a yi wami, konɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu kake lɛ ngɛ, kɛ Mawu kɛ nimli a mi dalɔ kake hu nɛ ji nɔmlɔ Kristo Yesu ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɔ e he ngɔ ha kaa kpɔmi nɔ ha nimli tsuo, nɛ ji odase nɛ a yeɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ; enɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mi fiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo (anɔkuale i ngɛ tue ngɛ Kristo mi, i yi lakpa!
), maje li a tsɔɔlɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ hlae kaa nyumuhi nɛ a sɔle ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ a wo a ninehi nɛ he tsɔ nɔ nɛ mi mi fumi loo nya sami ko hi mi.
Ja nɔuu yihi hu, a kɛ tade nɛ sa kɛ humipeemi kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi tsɔ nɛ dla a he, pi kɛ yi hɔɔmi slɔɔto ko loo sika loo adiagba loo tade nɛ he jua wa se mohu kɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi nɛ sa yihi nɛ tsɔɔ a he kaa Mawu jali ji mɛ ɔ. Yo nɛ pee kpoo nɛ e kase ni ngɛ tue bumi tsuo mi.
I ngmɛ́ yo blɔ kaa e tsɔɔ ni aloo e ye nyumu nɔ, se mohu e pee kpoo.
Ejakaa Adam kekle a bɔ, lɔ ɔ se ɔ Hawa.
Nɛ pi Adam nɛ a sisi ɔ, se yo ɔ a sisi, nɛ e sɛ tɔmi mi.
Se a ma he e yi wami kɛ maa gu bimɛ a fɔmi mi, ke a hi si ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi kɛ he tsɔmi kɛ juɛmi hu nɛ sa mi ɔ.
Asafo nɔ hyɛli Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ hyɛmi ni tsumi hlae ɔ, e ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa hlae.” Se e sa kaa nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ hi si bɔ nɛ a be e he sane ko nae, nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo kake, hɛ si kalɔ, nɔ nɛ juɛmi mi tsɔ, nɔ nɛ baa e je mi saminya, nibwɔ peelɔ, nɔ nɛ le ni tsɔɔmi; pi da delɔ, pi nine kpokpookpo tsɛ, se mohu nɔ nɛ he jɔ, nɔ nɛ pɛ́, nɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɛ sika nɔ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ saminya, nɛ e bimɛ buɔ lɛ tue nɛ a buu lɛ.
Se ke nɔ ko li lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ hyɛmi ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ hyɛ Mawu asafo ɔ nɔ kɛɛ?
Jehanɛ pi nɔ nɛ sɛ Mawu jami mi kɛ we, konɛ e ko wo e he nɔ nɛ e nɔ abosiami kojomi mi.
E sa kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ hu a ye e he odase kpakpa, konɛ e ko na biɛ yaya nɛ e sɛ abosiami klama mi.
Asafo mi sɔmɔli a hepiɛli Asafo mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ hu, e sa kaa a pee nimli nɛ a hɛ mi jiɔ, pi nya enyɔenyɔtsɛmɛ, pi da deli, pi hɛ tsuli, se nihi nɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ laami sane ɔ ngɛ he nile nɛ he tsɔ mi.
Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu a ka mɛ nɛ a hyɛ lolo; lɔ ɔ se ke sane ko be a he ɔ, a sɔmɔ.
Yi ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu; a pee nihi nɛ a hɛ mi jiɔ, pi sieku yeli, se a hɛ nɛ ka si, a ye anɔkuale ngɛ́ nihi kulaa mi.
Asafo mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nɛ pee yo kakaakatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ yeɔ a bimɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nihi a nɔ saminya.
Ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ saminya a, a naa bu, kɛ kã babauu ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ mi.
Laami sane ngua a I ngɛ mo enɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e be kɛe nɛ ma ba o ngɔ.
Se ke ye se ya kɛ ɔ nɛ o le bɔ nɛ sa nɛ nihi nɛ a ba je mi ha ngɛ Mawu we, nɛ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ asafo ɔ anɔkuale ɔ titima kɛ e sepimi nɔ́ ɔ mi.
Nɔ jemi be he kaa Mawu jami laami sane ɔ, e mi kuɔ.
Mawu je e he si paa ngɛ he lo mi, E ye nguɔ ngɛ mumi mi, E je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ bɔfohi, A fiɛ lɛ ngɛ majeli a kpɛti, A he e nɔ ye ngɛ je mi, A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ nyami mi.
Lakpa tsɔɔli Mumi ɔ deɔ paa ke, nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ni komɛ ma kua hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, nɛ a ma ya nyɛɛ sisimi mumihi kɛ mumi yayamihi a tsɔɔmihi a se, ngɛ nya ngɔli a sato peemi mi, nihi nɛ a he nile gbo kaa nɔ nɛ a sã kɛ dade kɛ la, nɛ a tsiɔ yo ngɔmi blɔ, nɛ a deɔ ke a nyɛ ngma nɛ Mawu bɔ kaa nihi nɛ heɔ yeɔ nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ kɛ sina nɛ ye ɔ. Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ e hi, nɛ a nyɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ sina yeɔ ɔ, ejakaa a kɛ Mawu munyu kɛ sɔlemi tsukɔɔ he.
Kristo Yesu sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa Ke o tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, o maa pee o he Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa, nɔ nɛ lɛɛ e he kɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa nɛ o nyɛɛ se ɔ.
Se yimowi a yakayaka nyazia amɛ ɔ guu.
Bɔɔ Mawu jami mohu he mɔde.
Ejakaa nɔmlɔ tso he mɔde bɔmi he se nami pi, se Mawu jami he ngɛ se nami ngɛ nihi tsuo kulaa mi, nɛ e ngɛ wami nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ maa ba a he si womi.
Enɛ ɔ ji anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a pɛtɛ he saminya.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wa gboɔ dengme nɛ wa haa a jɛɛ wɔ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nimli kulaa a yi wami helɔ, titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ. Wo ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he kita nɛ o tsɔɔ.
Ko ha nɔ ko nɛ gbe o he guɛ ngɛ niheyo nɛ o ji ɔ he, se mohu o kɛ o he nɛ pee nɔ hyemi nɔ ngɔ ha ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, ngɛ munyu tutui mi, ngɛ jemi bami mi, ngɛ suɔmi mi, ngɛ mumi, mi ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, ngɛ he tsɔmi mi.
Hii womi kanee kɛ ga womi kɛ ni tsɔɔmi kɛ ya su be nɛ ma ba.
Koo ngmɛɛ o dloomi ke nɔ nɛ a ngɔ ha mo kɛ gu gbami kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ninehi nɛ a kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ he.
Mo gbo ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he dengme, o kɛ ohe nɛ wo mi kulaa, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na o nɔ yami paa.
O hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ kɛ o tsɔɔmi ɔ, hii si ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a mi; ejakaa ke o pee enɛ ɔ ɔ, o ma he mo nitsɛ kɛ nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ kulaa yi wami.
Asafo nɔhyɛmi Koo tu nɔkɔtɔma ko hɛ mi munyu wawɛɛ, se mohu o tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa o tsɛ; nihewi hu kaa nyɛmimɛ; yi nikɔtɔma amɛ kaa nyɛmɛ; yihewi ɔmɛ hu kaa nyɛmimɛ yihi ngɛ he tsɔmi tsuo mi.
Yalɔyi nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, buu mɛ.
Ke yalɔyo ko ngɛ bimɛ loo bibimɛ ɔ, a kase Mawu gbeye yemi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a we mi kekle, nɛ a to a fɔli ɔmɛ nane mi pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejakaa enɛ ɔ ngɛ fɛu nɛ e sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ ji yalɔyo niinɛ nɛ e piɛ e nɔ kake too ɔ, ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ e hɛɛ pɛɛ kpami kɛ sɔlemi mi nyɔ kɛ pia.
Se yo nɛ fiɛɛ nyumu fiɛmi ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ mohu se e gbo.
Wo mɛ mlaa ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ a he konɛ a ko na a he munyu ko nɛ a tu.
Ke nɔ ko hyɛ we lɛ nitsɛ e nihi, titli ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ɔ, e kpa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ se, nɛ afani nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ e he.
Koo ngɔ yalɔyo nɛ na we nɛ e ye jeha nyingmi ekpa ngɔ wo sɔmɔmi ɔ mi, ja nɔ nɛ gba nyumu kake, nɔ nɛ a tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa kaa e tsu ni kpakpahi, lɔ ɔ ji: ke e lɛ bimɛ, ke e pee nihi nibwɔ, ke e fɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nane he, ke e ye bua nihi nɛ naa amanehlu ɔ, ke e di ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa nitsumi kpakpa se ɔ.
Se yalɔyi nɛ wɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, koo ngɔ mɛ, ejakaa ke nyumu sumi sɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, a jee Kristo se ya hlaa gba; nɛ a naa kojomi ejakaa a ngmɛɛ a kekle hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ se ɔ a kaseɔ hejɔ peemi kɛ si pomi ngɛ wehi a mi, nɛ pi hejɔ kɛkɛ nɛ a peɔ, se a peɔ a he sieku yeli, kɛ si jeli nɛ tuɔ munyu nɛ sɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i suɔ kaa yalɔyihi nɛ wɛ́ lolo ɔ a gba, nɛ a fɔ bimɛ, nɛ a ye a we nɔ, nɛ a ko ha he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ na sane ko nɛ e kɛ jɛ wɔ; ejakaa ni komɛ kpale ya nyɛɛ Satan se momo.
Se ke nyumu lo yo nɛ heɔ yeɔ ngɛ yalɔyihi ɔ, e hyɛ mɛ nɛ e ko pee tlomi kɛ ha asafo ɔ, konɛ asafo ɔ nɛ hyɛ yalɔyihi nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Nikɔtɔmahi nɛ tsuɔ a ni saminya a, e sa kaa a ngɔ bu totoe enyɔ ngɔ ha mɛ, titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ bɔɔ munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi he mɔde ɔ. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke: “Koo wo na nɛ gblɛɔ blɛfo ɔ nya kotoku;” kɛ: “Nitsulɔ ɔ, e hiɔwo sa lɛ.” Ke a po nɔkɔtɔma ko nya a, ko he kplɛɛ kaa ja ngɛ odasefohi enyɔ loo etɛ nya lolo.
Ninɛmɛ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, ka mɛ ngɛ nihi kulaa a hɛ mi, konɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ hu nɛ ye gbeye.
I ngɛ mo mlaa woe ngɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ e bɔfohi nɛ e hia amɛ a hɛ mi, kaa o ye ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ o ko hyɛ nihi a hɛ mi kɛ kojo, nɛ jehanɛ hu, o ko hia nɔ mi.
Koo ngɔ po nine ngɔ pue nɔ ko nɔ oya, nɛ jehanɛ hu, koo ngɔ o he ngɔ futu ni kpahi a he yayamihi a mi.
To o he nyaii.
Koo nu nyu sɔuu, se nuu wai bɔɔ ngɛ o muklii kɛ o hiɔhi nɛ nuu mo kpitikpiti ɔmɛ a he.
Ni komɛ a he yayamihi jee kpo paa mla, nɛ a sɛɛ a hlami kɛ yaa kojomi mi, se ni komɛ a nɔ hu kpɛɛ se.
Ja nɔuu ni tsumi kpakpahi hu jee kpo paa, nɛ nihi nɛ ji kpo paa a hu a be nyɛe nɛ a kɛ maa laa.
Lakpa tsɔɔmi Sɔmɔli tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ, a bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa nihi nɛ bu tsuo sa mɛ, konɛ a ko tu Mawu biɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ he musu bɔmi munyu.
Se nyɔguɛhi nɛ ngɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ nɛ he ye ɔ, a ko gbe a he guɛ, se mohu a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya akɛnɛ nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ he je ɔ, ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ naa ni tsumi ɔ mi nihi ɔ, nihi nɛ he ye kɛ suɔli ʼi.
Tsɔɔ mɛ enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o wo mɛ ga ngɛ he.
Lakpa tsɔɔmi kɛ ninami nitsɛ Ke nɔ ko tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpa ko, nɛ e ngɔɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo munyuhi nɛ tsaa nɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu jami nya tsɔɔmi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e wo e he nɔ, nɛ e li nɔ ko, se mohu e ngɛ gboe kɛ nɔ jemi kɛ nya sami nɛ hɛkɔ, pɛ, musu bɔmi munyuhi, nihi a he susumi yaya jee mi ɔ, nɛ ji yakayaka ngmlaa kpami nɛ nimli nɛ a juɛmi puɛ nɛ a kpɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ a dɛ nɛ a susuɔ kaa Mawu jami ji ni nami ɔ.
Se niinɛ, ni nami agbo ji Mawu jami, ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e nihi a he ɔ. Ejakaa waa kɛ nɔ ko nɔ́ ko bɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ e fɔɔ si paa kaa wa be nyɛe waa kɛ nɔ ko maa ya hulɔ.
Se ke wa ngɛ ngma kɛ he hami nihi kɛkɛ ɔ, e sa kaa wa bua nɛ jɔ he.
Nihi nɛ hlaa nɛ a na ni fuu ɔ, nɔɔ ka kɛ klama kɛ kuasiahi akɔnɔhi fuu nɛ puɛɔ nɔ nɛ tsɛɛ nihi ngɔ woɔ hɛ mi kpatami kɛ laami mi ɔ mi.
Ejakaa ni yayahi kulaa sipoku ji sika suɔmi nɛ ni komɛ di se nɛ a tla blɔ kɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ piimi babauu gbɔ a tsui mi ɔ. Nitsɔɔmi kɛ ha Timoteo nitsɛ Se moo lɛɛ, oo Mawu nɔmlɔ, tuu ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nya fo, nɛ o nyɛɛ dami, Mawu jami, hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi, tsui sitomi kɛ mi mi jɔmi se.
Hwu hemi kɛ yemi ta kpakpa a, pɛtɛ neneene wami ɔ he, nɔ́ he hulɔ nɛ a tsɛ mo kɛ ba benɛ o jaje jajemi kpakpa ngɛ odasefohi fuu a hɛ mi, ɔ. I ngɛ mo kita woe ngɛ Mawu nɛ haa nihi tsuo kulaa wami ɔ kɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ ye jajemi kpakpa a he odase ngɛ Pontio Pilato yi nɔ ɔ hɛ mi, kaa o ye kita a nɔ, nɛ kpa ko loo piami ko ko hi he kɛ yaa su wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ hewami nɔyelɔ kake nɛ da gbaa, matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa je kpo ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e be mi ɔ; nɔ nɛ lɛ e nɔ kake lɛ ngɛ neneene si himi nɛ gbenɔ be mi, nɛ e hii la nɛ a be nyɛemaa su he ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ ko nɔmlɔ ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, nɛ e be lɛ nyɛe maa na hulɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji neneene bu kɛ he wami ɔ. Amen.
Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wo mɛ kita konɛ a ko susu ni nguahi, nɛ a ko ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ni nami nɛ be sɔkee ɔ nɔ, se mohu Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ haa wɔ babauu ke waa ye mi ngɔmi ɔ.
A pee kpakpa, nɛ a plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ kpakpa peemi blɔfami, a suɔ nɔ hami, a ko pee kpɛle, a to juetli ngɔ ha a he, nɛ e pee sisi tomi kpakpa ha be nɛ maa ba a, konɛ a pɛtɛ anɔkuale wami ɔ he.
Oo Timoteo!
nihi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ baa yi, nɛ o kua yakayaka ni sɛɛmi nɛ bleɔ nɔ kɛ nɔ jemi munyu nɛ je lakpa ni lemi mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ni komɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ nɛ a tla blɔ kɛ je hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he ɔ. Dloomi ɔ kɛ mo nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya kɛ wami nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ he si womi nya a, ngma ya ha e suɔmi bi Timoteo ɔ: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Sinami kɛ he wami womi I naa Mawu nɛ i kɛ ye nimeli jaa ngɛ he nile klɔuu mi ɔ si, kaa i jɔɔ we mo kaimi gblee ngɛ ye pɛɛ kpamihi a mi nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ ke i kai o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ, i hlaa kaa ma na mo, konɛ ye bua nɛ jɔ.
Ye hɛ ngɛ o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ lakpa be mi ɔ nɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kekle nɛ e ngɛ o na Loise kɛ o nyɛ Eunike mi, nɛ i ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ kaa e ngɛ mo hu o mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo kaie kaa, Mawu dloomi ke nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o mi ngɛ ye nine nɛ i kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ nya a, tle lɛ si nɛ e tso, ejakaa Mawu hi wɔ gbeye yemi mumi, se mohu he wami kɛ suɔmi kɛ juɛmi nɛ sa mumi ekɛ ha wɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zo ko pee mo ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he odase yemi ɔ he aloo ngɛ imi nɛ i ji e pa mi no ɔ he, se mohu o kɛ mi gbo dengme ngɛ sane kpakpa a he ngɛ Mawu he wami nya.
Nɔ nɛ he wa yi wami nɛ e kɛ tsɛmi klɔuklɔu tsɛ wɔ, pi ngɛ wa ni tsumihi a nya, se mohu ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi kɛ e dloomi nya, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɔ ha wɔ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi loko a bɔ je ɔ, nɛ jehanɛ a gu wa yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo he kpo jemi ɔ nɔ je lɛ si paa a; nɔ nɛ po gbenɔ se nɛ e je wami kɛ neneene si himi kpo tsɔɔ wɔ ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi, nɔ́ he nɛ a wo mi fiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo kɛ maje li ɔmɛ a tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ nae nɔ nɛ.
Se kɛ ɔ, e pee we mi zo, ejakaa i le nɔ nɛ i he ye ɔ, nɛ i ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ kaa e ma nyɛ nihi nɛ e to ha mi ɔmɛ a he maa bu kɛ ya si jamɛ a Ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Pɛtɛ tsami munyu nɛ o nu kɛ je ye nya a nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ɔ he ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ mi.
Ni kpakpahi nɛ a tu wo o dɛ ɔ buu he ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ hii wa mi ɔ he wami nya!
O le enɛ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Asia a tsuo kpa ngɛ ye se, a ti ni komɛ ji Fegelo kɛ Hermogene.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na Onesiforo we ɔ mɔbɔ, ejakaa e baa kpitikpiti, ba haa mi tsui, nɛ zo pee we lɛ ngɛ ye tsu mi womi ɔ he; se benɛ e ba Roma a e bɔ mɔde ba hla mi nɛ e na mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha e na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi mɔbɔnami ngɛ jamɛ a Ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ e plɛ kɛ sɔmɔ mi ngɛ Efeso ɔ, o le pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kristo Yesu ta bulɔ anɔkualetsɛ Jehanɛ moo lɛɛ, ye bi, o he nɛ wa ngɛ dloomi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ mi.
Nihi nɛ o nu ngɛ ye nya ngɛ odasefohi fuu a nya a, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu o tu ngɔ wo nimli anɔkualetsɛmɛ a dɛ, nihi nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a ma kɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi hulɔ.
Mia o hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ nami mi, kaa Yesu Kristo ta bulɔ kpakpa ko.
Nɔ ko nyɛɛ we ta blɔ nɛ e kɛ e he wo we mi munyuhi a mi, ejakaa e suɔ kaa e sa e tatsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɔ ko he plee hu ɔ, a be lɛ manye jlasi fie, kaa ja e plee he ngɛ mlaa nya.
Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ tsuɔ ni ɔ, lɛ kekle sa kaa e ye ngmɔ ni ɔ eko.
Susuu nɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ he.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha o na nihi kulaa sisi.
O hɛ nɛ hi Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ te si kɛ je gbeje nɛ je David nina mi ɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ i fiɛ ngɛ ye sane kpakpa a mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ he amane nɛ i ngɛ nae, kɛ yaa su kpa mi tete, kaa yayami peelɔ ko; se kɛ ɔ, Mawu munyu ɔ, a wui lɛ kpa Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ i miaa ye hɛ mi ngɛ sanehi kulaa mi ngɛ nihi nɛ ahla mɛ ɔ a he, konɛ mɛ hu a nine nɛ su yi wami hemi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ kɛ neneene hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɔ.
Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke waa kɛ lɛ gbo ɔ, waa kɛ lɛ ma na wami hulɔ.
Ke wa mia wa hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ nami mi ɔ, waa kɛ lɛ maa ye matsɛ hulɔ; Ke wa kpa ngɛ e se ɔ, lɛ hu e ma kpa ngɛ wa se.
Ke wa pee we wa he anɔkualetsɛmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa hi si anɔkualetsɛ, ejakaa e be nyɛe ma je lɛ nitsɛ e he se.” Nitsulɔ kpakpa Kaii mɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o ma nɔ mi ha mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, ykonɛ a ko hwu lilɛ ta nɛ se nami ko be he, se e butuu nihi nɛ nuɔ ɔ mohu ɔ. Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o da si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa znɔ ko nɛ sa, ni tsulɔ nɛ gbo we zo nɛ tsɔɔ anɔkuale munyu ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se yakayaka ni sɛɛmi nɛ bleɔ nɔ ɔ, sã o he kɛ je he; ejakaa e fieɔ nihi kɛ jee Mawu he kɛ yaa lokoo, nɛ a munyu ɔ ma sã nɔ kaa hiɔ yaya sãa nɔ ɔ: a ti ni komɛ ji Himeneo kɛ Fileto, nihi nɛ tla blɔ kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ he, nɛ a deɔ ke si temi ɔ be momo, nɛ a butuu ni komɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ.
Se Mawu sisi tomi tɛ na he wa a maa si kpɛii, nɛ e hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a nyasɔomi nɔ nɛ ɔ: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le lɛ nitsɛ e ni ɔmɛ,” kɛ: “Ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ Kristo biɛ ɔ ta a nɛ sã e he kɛ je nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a he.” We ngua ko mi ɔ pi sika tsu nihi kɛ sika hiɔ nihi kɛkɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se mohu tso nihi kɛ zu nihi hu ngɛ mi, ekomɛ ɔ a buo, se ekomɛ hu a bui.
Jehanɛ ke nɔ ko tsukɔ e he kɛ je kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e ma plɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a buu nɛ a tsukɔ he klɔuu nɛ hi ha wetsɛ ɔ saminya nɛ a dla lɛ kɛ ha ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa.
Se nihewi a kɔnɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, tuu nya fo, nɛ o kɛ nihi nɛ tsɛɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ jee tsui nɛ mi tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ dami, hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi kɛ he jɔmi se.
Se kuasiahi a nɔ jemi nɛ a kɛ kase we nɔ ko ɔ guu, ejakaa o le kaa e kɛ pɛ baa.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, e sɛ kaa e pɛɛ, se mohu e mi nɛ jɔ ha nihi kulaa, nɔ nɛ le ni tsɔɔmi, nɔ nɛ toɔ e tsui si haa yayami, nɔ nɛ kɛ mi mi jɔmi tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi nɛ tee si siɔ lɛ ɔ, kaa alinɔ Mawu ma ha mɛ tsui tsakemi nɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ lo?
nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ tsɔ mɛ kɛ je abosiami klama a mi, ejakaa e kɛ du mɛ nɛ a pee e suɔmi nya ni.
Nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ Se na nɛ o le kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, he hiami be maa ba.
Ejakaa nimli ma plɛ a he hesuɔli, sikasuɔli, fiali, he woli, musu bɔli, fɔli a nɔ tue gboli, otlumuhi, nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we, nihi nɛ plee we nɔ he, somi mi kuli, sieku yeli, nihi nɛ nyɛ we a kɔnɔ nɔ nɛ a ye, nihi nɛ a hɛ jɔɛ, nihi nɛ sume nɔ́ kpakpa, nɔ se blɔ tsɔɔli, yi mi wali, he nɔ woli, nihi nɛ suɔ fiɛmi nɛ ngɔɔ pe Mawu, nihi nɛ hɛɛ Mawu jami su, se a kua e mi he wami ɔ. Sã o he kɛ je kikɛmɛ a nimli a he?
Ejakaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ ji nihi nɛ juɔ si sɛɛ wehi a mi nɛ a ya ngɔɔ yihi nɛ be yi mi nɛ yayami ye a nɔ nɛ akɔnɔ slɔɔtohi kpakaa mɛ nɛ a hlaa ni kasemi, se kɛ ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ Yane kɛ Yambre te si si Mose ɔ, ja nɔuu kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kuɔ anɔkuale ɔ nya, nihi nɛ a yi mi puɛ, nihi nɛ pi ni komɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ blɔfami.
A be a hɛ mi yae tsɔ ko, ejakaa a kuasia peemi ɔ maa je kpo paa ngɛ nihi tsuo a hɛ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ Yane kɛ Yambremɛ a nɔ ɔ hu je kpo ɔ. Nyagbe ni tsɔɔmi Se moo lɛɛ, o le ye tsɔɔmi, ye je mi bami, ye yi mi tomi, ye hemi kɛ yemi, ye tsui si tomi, ye suɔmi, ye hɛ mi miami, ye nɔ namihi, ye omane hluhi nɛ i na ngɛ Antiokia kɛ Ikonium kɛ Listra a; yi mi wamihi abɔ nɛ i na nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je mi kɛ je kulaa mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nihi kulaa hu nɛ hlaa kaa a hi si ngɛ Mawu jami nya ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, a maa wa mɛ yi mi.
Se nimli yayamihi kɛ sisili maa ya hɛ mi ngɛ yayami peemi mi; a sisiɔ nihi, nɛ mɛ hu a sisiɔ mɛ.
Se moo lɛɛ hii si ngɛ nihi nɛ o kase nɛ o ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ ɔmɛ a mi, ejakaa o le nɔ nɛ nya nɛ o kase kɛ je, nɛ o jokuɛwi a si o je nɛ o le ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ ma nyɛ ma ha o le nihi nɛ maa gu Kristo Yesu nɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ kɛ ya yi wami hemi mi ɔ. Ngmami tsuaa ngmami nɛ je Mawu mumi mi ɔ, e hi ha ni tsɔɔmi kɛ hɛ mi kami kɛ nɔ dlami kɛ tsɔsemi nɛ ngɛ dami mi ɔ, konɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si, nɛ a dla lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ha ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa.
I ngɛ mo dee faii ngɛ Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ maa ba ba kojo hɛ kali kɛ ni gbogboehi ngɛ e bami kɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi ke: Fiɛ munyu ɔ, koo jɔɔ, deka ngɛ jio, deka be jio, ka hɛ mi, wo ga, bɔɔ kɔkɔ ngɛ tsui si tomi kɛ ni tsɔɔmi kulaa mi.
Ejakaa be ko maa ba nɛ a be anɔkuale tsɔɔmi ɔ tue bue hu, ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔnɔ ɔmɛ a nya, se mohu a ma bua tsɔɔli a nya ngɔ wo a he, ninɛmɛ nɛ ma de mɛ nihi nɛ a suɔ kaa a nu.
A ma blɛ anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ pue a tue se, nɛ a maa kpale ya bu nyaziahi mohu tue.
Se moo lɛɛ, o hɛ nɛ ka si ngɛ nihi kulaa mi, mia o hɛ mi ngɛ dengme gbomihi a mi, tsu sane kpakpa jajelɔ ni tsumi ɔ, nɛ gbee o sɔmɔmi ni tsumi ɔ nya kulaa!
Ejakaa ami lɛɛ, a ngɛ ye muɔ plee kɛ ngɛ si puee mo kaa bɔ, nɛ ye jemi be ɔ su.
Ta kpakpa a, i hwu; fo ɔ, i tu gbe nya; hemi kɛ yemi ɔ i hɛɛ mi; nɔ nɛ piɛ nɛ fɔɔ si ha mi ji dami jlasi ɔ, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ ji dami kojolɔ ɔ ma ha mi ngɛ jamɛ a Ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ pi ye nɔ kake nɛ e ma ha, se mohu nihi kulaa nɛ suɔ e bami ɔ hulɔ ɔ. Slɔmi ha Timoteo nitsɛ Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ mla.
Ejakaa nɛ Dema suɔ amlɔ amlɔ je nɛ ɔ mi he je ɔ, e je ye he kɛ ho Tesalonika ya; Kreske ho Galata ya, Tito ho Dalmatia ya; Luka pɛ lɛ e kɛ mi ngɛ.
Ngɔɔ Marko nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba, ejakaa e hi ha mi ngɛ sɔmɔmi ɔ he.
Tihiko ɔ lɛɛ i tsɔ lɛ Efeso.
Kotoku ɔ nɛ i je he ngɛ Troia ngɛ Karpo ngɔ ɔ, o kɛ ba, kɛ womi ɔmɛ hulɔ, se titli ɔ lohwehi a he womi nɛ a ngmaa ni ngɛ nɔ ɔ. Aleksandro, sɔlɔ ɔ, peemi yayami wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ to lɛ nane mi ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a nya.
Mo hu hyɛ o he nɔ nɛ hi ngɛ e he, ejakaa e te si ngɔ si wa munyu ɔmɛ wawɛɛ.
Ngɛ ye kekle nya jemi ɔ mi ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ya sɛ mi, se mohu mɛ kulaa a si mi, a ko bu enɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ.
Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ fi ye se nɛ e wo mi he wami, konɛ a gu ye nɔ kɛ ma fiɛmi ɔ nɔ mi, nɛ maje li ɔmɛ kulaa a nu, nɛ a je mi kɛ je jata a nya mi.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je mi kokooko kɛ maa je ni yayahi kulaa mi, nɛ e ma he ye yi wami kɛ maa ya e hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi: Lɛ a ngɔ anuminyami ngɔ ha kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene!
Amen.
Nyagbe sɛyemi I biɔ Priska kɛ Akwila kɛ Onesiforo we ɔ. Erasto ngɛ Korinto; se Trofimo ɔ, i si lɛ ngɛ Mileto nɛ e ngɛ gboe.
Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba loko fiɛ be ɔ nɛ su.
Eubulo kɛ Pude kɛ Lino kɛ Klaudia kɛ nyamimɛ ɔmɛ kulaa ke a biɔ mo.
Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ o mumi ɔ nɛ hi si!
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo, Mawu sɔmɔlɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo.
Ahla mi nɛ a tsɔ mi nɛ ma ya ye bua ninɛmɛ nɛ Mawu hla amɛ a hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ ma kɛ mɛ nɛ ba anɔkuale nɛ wa jami ɔ tsɔɔ, nɛ maa si ngɛ neneene wami ɔ he hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ mi.
Mawu nɛ yi lakpa a wo wɔ kikɛmɛ a wami nɛ ɔ he si loko a bɔ je mi be ɔmɛ, nɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, e je lɛ si ngɛ e munyu ɔ mi.
Fiɛmi sane nɛ ɔ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ ngɛ Mawu nɛ ji wa yi wami helɔ ɔ fami nya.
I ngma ya ha Tito nɛ ji ye bi nitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ nɔuu blɔfami ɔ: Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo, wa yiwami helɔ ɔ, dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Tito nitsumi ngɛ Kreta Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ i si mo ngɛ Kreta a ji konɛ o to nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ blɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ o wo nikɔtɔmahi ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi, kaa bɔ nɛ i de mo momo ɔ: lɔ ɔ ji, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee nɔ ko nɛ piami ko be e he, nɛ e ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo kake, nɛ e ngɛ bimɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ nɛ a tui a he munyu yaya kaa yaholi loo tuegboli ji mɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, e sɛ kaa piami ko hii e he, akɛnɛ Mawu we mi sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma ji lɛ he je ɔ; pi nɔ nɛ peɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui nya ni, pi mi mi latsɛ, pi da nulɔ, pi nine kpokpookpotsɛ, pi kpɛletsɛ, se mohu nibwɔ peelɔ, nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɔ nɛ juɛmi ka si, dalɔ, nɔ nɛ he tsɔ, nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka si, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ anɔkuale tsɔɔmi ɔ mi, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi ngɛ ni tsɔɔmi nɛ tsaa nɔ ɔ mi, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ tee si siɔ munyu ɔ hu, e ka a hɛ mi.
Ejakaa nihi fuu ngɛ nɛ ji atua tsɔli kɛ yakayaka munyu tuli nɛ sisiɔ nɔ, titli ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ je nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ; nihi nɛ sa kaa a ku a nya, ejakaa a butuu we mlukuhi kulaa, nɛ zo nihi a se nami he ɔ a tsɔɔ tsɔɔmihi nɛ dɛ.
A ti nɔ ko nɛ ji mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbalɔ ɔ de ke: “Kretabi yeɔ lakpa daa; lohwe yayamihi kɛ jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ kɛ hejɔli.” Odase nɛ ɔ ɔ anɔkuale ʼi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kã a hɛ mi veveeve, konɛ a he nɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ a ko bu Yudafohi a nyazia amɛ kɛ nimli nɛ kpaleɔ kɛ jee anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ a kita amɛ tue.
Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, nihi kulaa he tsɔ ha mɛ; se nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we kɛ nihi nɛ he we yi ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ he tsɔ ha mɛ, se mohu a yi mi kɛ a he nile kulaa mi sɛ mu.
A deɔ ke a le Mawu, se a kɛ a ni tsumihi kuaa lɛ, nɛ a ji musutsɛmɛ, kɛ tue gboli, nihi nɛ hi ha ni tsumi kpakpa ko kulaa.
Tsɔɔmi kpakpa Se moo lɛɛ tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpakpa a. Nimowi ɔmɛ ɔ, kãa a hɛ nɛ ka si, a pee nihi nɛ a hɛ mi jiɔ, a juɛmi nɛ ka si, a he nɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ suɔmi kɛ tsui si tomi mi.
Yimowi hu ja nɔuu kãa a ba a je mi bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
A ko tu nihi a he munyu a ko pee dadeli, a pee nihi nɛ tsɔɔ ni kpakpahi, konɛ a tsɔɔ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ a suɔ a hunomɛ, a suɔ a bimɛ, a hɛ nɛ ka si, a he nɛ tsɔ, a baa a we yi saminya, a mi mi nɛ jɔ, a ba a he si ha a hunomɛ, konɛ a ko tu Mawu munyu ɔ he musu bɔmi munyu.
Nihewi hu ja nɔuu, tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ konɛ a juɛmi nɛ ka si.
Nɛ nihi kulaa blɔfami ɔ, ngɔɔ mo nitsɛ o he ngɔ to mɛ okadi ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi a he, nɛ ni tsɔɔmi mi ɔ, o tsɔɔ tsɔɔmi klɔuu, nihi nɛ haa nɔ hɛ mi jiɔ, munyu kpakpa nɛ a be he nɔ yaya ko nae nɛ a ma de, benɛ pee nɛ zo nɛ gbe nɔ nɛ kɛ wɔ yi ɔ, ejakaa e be wa he nɔ́ yaya ko nɛ e ma de.
Sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, de mɛ ke a ba a he si ngɔ ha a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, a sa a hɛ mi ngɛ nihi tsuo mi, a ko je munyu nya, a ko ju, se mohu a kɛ anɔkuale yemi nitsɛ nɛ tsɔɔ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ wo Mawu nɛ ji wa yi wami helɔ ɔ tsɔɔmi ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.
Ejakaa Mawu dloomi nɛ a kɛ heɔ nimli kulaa a yi wami ɔ je kpo, nɛ e tsɔseɔ wɔ konɛ wa kua nɔ yaya peemi kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ waa kɛ juɛmi kpakpa kɛ dami kɛ Mawu gbeye yemi nɛ hi si ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ waa hyɛ Mawu Ope ɔ kɛ wa yiwami helɔ Yesu Kristo gbaami nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ he kpo jemi ɔ blɔ; nɔ nɛ ngɔ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa nane mi, konɛ e kpɔ wɔ kɛ je nɔ tɔmi kulaa mi, nɛ e tsukɔ wa he ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma klɔuu nɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi a he.
De mɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ ga ngɛ he, nɛ o kã a hɛ mi ngɛ he kɛ he wami tsuo.
Ko ha nɔ ko nɛ ngɔ mo kaa nɔ nɛ sɛ bumi.
Kristofohi a jemibami Kaii mɛ nɛ a ba a he si ngɔ ha nikɔtɔmahi kɛ nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, a bu mɛ tue, a dla a he kɛ ha ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa, a ko tu nɔ ko he munyu yaya, a ko hla pɛ; se mohu a pee kpoo, nɛ a kɛ a he nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kaa a he jɔ.
Ejakaa sa a wɔ hu wa li nɔ́ ko, tue gboli, blɔ dali, nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ akɔnɔ ni kɛ helo se di ni slɔɔtohi fuu, nɛ wa baa wa je mi ngɛ ni yayahi kɛ he tsɛmi mi, wa he ngɛ tai, nɛ wa nyɛɛ wa he.
Se benɛ Mawu nɛ ji yi wami helɔ ɔ mi mi jɔmi kɛ e nimli a he dɔmi ɔ je kpo ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ pi dami ni tsumihi nɛ wa tsu nya, se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e mɔbɔ nami nya, kɛ gu ehe fɔmi, he dumi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ehe peemi ɔ nɔ he wa yiwami, nɔ nɛ gu Yesu Kristo wa yi wami helɔ ɔ nɔ plɛ pue wa nɔ babauu ɔ, konɛ bɔ nɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ ngɛ lɛ nɔuu e dloomi nya a, a ha waa pee neneene wami ɔ yeli ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ nya.
Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ mi i ngɛ hlae kaa o ma, konɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a he Mawu nɔ ye ɔ, a bɔ nitsumi kpakpahi a he mɔde.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ fɛu nɛ hi ha nimli.
Se kuasiahi a nɔ jemi kɛ weku sisi tsɔɔmi kɛ pɛ kɛ mlaa he kunɔ nɔmi ɔ, sã o he kɛ je he, ejakaa a he be senami nɛ a pi nɔ́ ko.
Nɔ ko nɛ kɛ mi gbami baa a, ke o bɔ lɛ kɔkɔ si kake kɛ si enyɔ ɔ, kua lɛ; ejakaa o le kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ ja a e je e glɔ nɔ, nɛ e he yayami ɔ buu lɛ fɔ.
Nyagbe nitsɔɔmi Ke i tsɔ Artema loo Tihiko kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ ngɛ Nikopoli, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ i to kaa ma ya ye fiɛ be ɔ ngɛ.
Bɔɔ mɔɔde nɛ o wo Zena, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ kɛ Apolo blɔ saminya nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he ko hia mɛ.
Se ha nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa ni ɔmɛ hu nɛ kase ni tsumi kpakpahi a he mɔde bɔmi, ke e fi loo e hia nɔ ko ɔ, konɛ a ko pee nihi nɛ wui yiblii.
Ninɛmɛ nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ kulaa ke a biɔ mo.
Wa biɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ suɔ wɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ. Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Paulo nɛ ji Kristo Yesu opa mi no ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ngma ya ha Filemon, wa suɔlɔ kɛ wa huɛ ni tsulɔ ɔ, kɛ asafo nɛ kpee ngɛ o we ɔ tsuo kɛ wa nyɛmi yo Apia, kɛ Arkipo nɛ ji wa huɛ ta bu lɔ ɔ. Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Filemon suɔmi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi I naa ye Mawu ɔ si daa, nɛ i woɔ o ta ngɛ ye pɛɛ kpamihi a mi, akɛnɛ i nuɔ o suɔmi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o hɛɛ ngɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ; nɛ i kpaa pɛɛ kaa kikɛmɛ a huɛ bɔmi nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ ha mo sisi numi ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa nɛ wa nyɛɔ tsuɔ ha Kristo Yesu ɔ mi.
Ejakaa i na bua jɔmi babauu kɛ tsui ngɛ o suɔmi ɔ he, mami, akɛnɛ o ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a tsui nɔ a mi ɔ. Pɛɛkpami ha Onesimo Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ mi kaa i ngɛ kã babauu ngɛ Kristo mi nɛ ma kɛ wo mo kita ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa he, kɛ̃ ɔ, suɔmi he ɔ, pɛɛ mohu i ngɛ mo kpae.
Hyɛ imi nɔmoyo Paulo bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu i ji Yesu Kristo pa mi no nɛ ɔ; i kpa mo pɛɛ ngɛ yebi Onesimo nɛ i fɔ ngɛ ye tsu mi womi ɔ mi ɔ he, nɔ nɛ sa a e he be se nami ko ha mo, se jeha nɛ ɔ e he ngɛ se nami saminya ha i kɛ mo tsuo ɔ. I ha e ngɛ kpalee kɛ ma o ngɔ.
He lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o ma he imi nitsɛ.
I ko suɔ kaa e kɛ mi nɛ hi si konɛ e sɔmɔ mi ngɛ o nane mi ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi mi.
Se i sume kaa ma je o se kɛ pee nɔ́ ko, benɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ o maa pee ɔ e ko ba pee nɔ nyɛmi nya ni, se mohu tsui mi jɔmi nya ni.
Ejakaa eko ɔ enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyɛ kpɛti gba bɔɔ ɔ nɛ, konɛ jehanɛ e hi o ngɔ kulaa, pi kaa sɔmɔlɔ hu, se mohu nɔ nɛ pe sɔmɔlɔ tete, nɔ nɛ ji suɔmi nyɛmi, nɛ i fiɛ we e he, nɛ mo mohu e ji o nɔ kulaa ngɛ he lo kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔfami ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ jehanɛ ke o buu mi kaa o nyɛmi ɔ, he lɛ kaa o ma he imi nitsɛ.
Ke e ye mo sane yaya ko aloo ke e hɛɛ mo hiɔ ko ɔ, buu jamɛ a akɔtaa a ba ha mi.
Imi Paulo nitsɛ, i ngɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ye nine kaa, ma wo mo hiɔ (e hia we kaa ma kai mo ke o hɛɛ mi mo nitsɛ o yi hiɔ tete.)
Ee, mami, ha ma na o he se ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi; ha ye tsui nɛ nɔ ye mi ngɛ Kristo mi.
Akɛnɛ ye hɛ ngɛ o nɔ kaa o maa bu mi tue he je nɛ i ngma mo nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa i le kaa o maa pee pe bɔ nɛ i de mo nɛ ɔ tete.
Jehanɛ dla he ko ngɔ to mi, ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ pɛɛ kpami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a maa ngmɛɛ ye he ha nyɛ ekohu.
Nyagbe sɛyemi Epafra, nɛ ji ye huɛ pa mi no ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ ke e biɔ mo, kɛ Marko hulɔ kɛ Aristarko kɛ Dema kɛ Luka, nihi nɛ ji ye huɛmɛ ni tsuli.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Mawu munyu nɛ e kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ Blema be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Mawu kɛ wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu munyu kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ, ngɛ blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ, se ngɛ nyagbe ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e Bi ɔ nya e kɛ wɔ tu munyu ngɛ, nɔ nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee nihi kulaa yelɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɔ hu nɛ e gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi ni ɔmɛ; nɔ hu nɛ ji e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kpɛmi ɔ su ɔ henɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami munyu ɔ hɛɔ nihi kulaa a, benɛ e tsukɔ wa he kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e ho ya hi si ngɛ hɛ mi nyamitsɛ agbo ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.
Bi ɔ kle pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ Enɛ ɔ he ɔ Bi ɔ kle pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ akɛnɛ biɛ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ kle pe a nɔ ɔ. Ejakaa te bɔfo nɛ Mawu de lɛ hyɛ ke: “Ye bi ji mo, Mwɔnɛ i fɔ mo?” Loo, “Ma pee e tsɛ, Nɛ lɛ hu e maa pe ye bi?” ɔ nɛɛ?
Nɛ benɛ e kɛ e bi Tete ɔ ma je ɔ mi ɔ, e kpale de ke: “Ha Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ a ja lɛ.” Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, e de ngɛ a he ke: “Nɔ nɛ plɛɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ peɔ kɔɔhiɔhi, Nɛ e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ hu e peɔ mɛ la lilɛhi” ɔ.
Se Bi ɔ lɛɛ e de ngɛ e he ke: “Oo Mawu, o matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene Nɛ o matsɛ yemi tso ɔ, dami matsɛ yemi tso ʼi, O suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, o nyɛɛ nɔ́ yaya peemi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Mawu nɛ ji o Mawu ɔ Kɛ bua jɔmi nu ɔ pɔ mo pe o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.” Kɛ jehanɛ: “Nyɔmtsɛ, sisije ɔ, Mo lɛ o to zugba a sisi, Nɛ hiɔwe ɔ, o nine nya ni tsumi ʼi.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata, se moo lɛɛ, o ngɛ daa, nɛ mɛ tsuo a maa bwɔ kaa tade; Nɛ o ma koklo mɛ kaa bo, nɛ a ma tsake; Se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ o jeha amɛ tɛ̃.” Se hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ po nɛ e de ngɛ e he hyɛ ke: “Hii ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ Kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ O he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ pee o nane si sɛ?” ɔ nɛɛ?
Anɛ mɛ kulaa a, pi mumihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ ji mɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ ma na yi wami hemi ɔ a sɔmɔmi he je nɛ a tsɔ mɛ?
Yi wami hemi ngua a Lɔ ɔ he ɔ e sa kaa waa pɛtɛ nihi nɛ wa nu ɔmɛ a he wawɛɛ konɛ wa ko tsɔ kɛ je he.
Ejakaa ke munyu nɛ a tu ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi a nya a maa si kpɛii, nɛ a wo nɔ tɔmi tsuaa nɔ tɔmi kɛ tuegbenɔ tsuaa tuegbenɔ he hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa a, kɛ wa maa pee kɛ tu nya fo kɛɛ, ke wa bui kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ?
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ji nɔ nɛ tu he munyu kekle, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nu ɔ hu ma nɔ mi ha wɔ, nɛ Mawu nitsɛ hu kɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi kɛ hewami nihi slɔɔtohi kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hami ɔ ngɛ he odase yee kɛ ngɛ nɔ sie, ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya.
Yi wami hemi mi hɛminyɛɛlɔ Ejakaa pi hiɔwe bɔfohi a sisi nɛ e kɛ je nɛ maa ba nɛ wa ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ wo.
Nɔ ko ye he odase faii ngɛ he ko ke: “Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ o kaii lɛ?
Loo nɔmlɔ bi hu nɛ o hɛ ngɛ e he nɔ?
Piɛ bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ o ha e kɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi nɛ sɔ; O kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu fi lɛ jlasi.” O ngɔ nihi kulaa ngɔ woʼe nane si.
Ejakaa ke e kɛ nihi kulaa wo e nane si ɔ, e piɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ wui e sisi.
Jehanɛ wa na we nɛ waa na kaa a kɛ nihi tsuo wo e sisi.
Se nɔ nɛ a ha nɛ piɛ bɔɔ nɛ e kɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔ ɔ, wa na kaa Yesu ʼi, nɔ nɛ gbenɔ mi amanehlu ɔ he nɛ a kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu fi lɛ jlasi ɔ, benɛ pee nɛ Mawu dloomi nya a e sa e nya gbenɔ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Ejakaa e sa lɛ, nɔ nɛ he nɛ nihi kulaa ngɛ kɛ nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ a gu nɛ nihi kulaa ngɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ bimɛ babauu kɛ baa hɛ mi nyami mi ɔ, kaa e ha a yi wami hemi tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a nɛ gu amanehluhi a mi nɛ e hi kɛ pi si.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsukɔɔ nihi a he kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a tsukɔɔ a he ɔ kulaa je nɔ kake mi, lɔɔ he je nɛ zo pee we lɛ kaa e ma tsɛ mɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ eke: “Ma wo o biɛ ɔ tã ngɔ tsɔɔ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ; Asafo kpɛti hu ma la kɛ je o yi ngɛ.” Kɛ jehanɛ hu: “Ma ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.” Kɛ jehanɛ: “Oʼɛ mi kɛ bimɛ nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ akɛnɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛ he lo kɛ muɔ he je ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɔ kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu eko kaa mɛ, konɛ e gu gbenɔ nɔ kɛ kpata nɔ nɛ ngɛ gbenɔ nɔ he wami nɛ ji abosiami ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e kpɔ nihi nɛ gbenɔ gbeye yemi he ɔ a plɛ pee nyɔguɛhi ngɛ a wami be kulaa mi ɔ. Ejakaa e fɔɔ si faii kaa, tsa pi hiɔwe bɔfohi nɛ e yeɔ buaa, se mohu Abraham nina e yeɔ buaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nihi kulaa blɔfami ɔ, e sa kaa e hi kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ e plɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ kɛ anɔkuale osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, konɛ e kpa ma a yi musu.
Ejakaa akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ ɔ e na amanehlu nɛ a ka lɛ he je ɔ, e nyɛɔ e yeɔ buaa ninɛmɛ nɛ a kaa mɛ ɔ.
Yesu kle pe Mose Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ tɛ̃tɛ̃ nyɛ hɛ mi, nyɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ na hiɔwe tsemi ɔ eko, nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ Yesu wa hemi kɛ yemi jajemi ɔ he bɔfo kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a; nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ nɛ hla lɛ ɔ anɔkuale, kaa bɔ nɛ Mose hu ye Mawu we ɔ kulaa nɔ anɔkuale ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ bɔɔ we ko ɔ bu hiɛ pe we ɔ nɔ́ ɔ, ja nɔuu Yesu hu hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe Mose.
We tsuaa we ɔ nɔ ko kɛ̃ lɛ bɔɔ, se nɔ nɛ bɔɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ji Mawu.
Mose ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ kaa sɔmɔlɔ, konɛ e ye nihi nɛ a ma de ɔmɛ a he odase; se Kristo ɔ e ye anɔkuale kaa bi ngɛ Mawu we ɔ nɔ; lɛ e we ji wɔ, ke wa hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kã kɛ fiami ɔ mi kpɛii kɛ ya su nyagbe ɔ. Hejɔɔmi ha Mawu webi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de ɔ: “Mwɔnɛ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ, Nyɛ ko wlua nyɛ tsui, Kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ mi mi la womi ɔ mi, Ngɛ nyatsɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, He nɛ nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ ye nya nɛ a ka mi, Nɛ a na ye ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ, jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ye mi mi fu jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ Nɛ i ke: ‘Daa nɛ ɔ a tlaa blɔ ngɛ a juɛmi mi, Nɛ a li ye blɔ ɔmɛ.’ Lɔ ɔ ha ye mi mi fu nɛ i ka kita Ke: ‘Ke a sɛ ye he jɔɔmi ɔ mi fii!’ ” Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, mamimɛ, konɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ko hi tsui nɛ he we yi nɛ e kpale kɛ je Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ he; se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ligbi tsuaa ligbi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ “mwɔnɛ” ɔ, konɛ yayami ko sisi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ wlua nyɛ tsui.
Ejakaa Kristo he piɛli ji wɔ ke wa hɛɛ wa he nɛ waa kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ mi kpɛii kɛ ya su nyagbe ɔ. Ngmami ɔ de ke: “Mwɔnɛ ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ, Nyɛ ko wlua nyɛ tsui Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee Benɛ nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atua a.” Nihi nɛ nu ɔ a ti mɛnɔmɛ lɛ a wo e mi mi la a?
Anɛ pi ninɛmɛ nɛ kɛ Mose je Mizraim ɔ tsuo ʼi?
Nɛ mɛnɔmɛ e mi mi fu jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu ɔ?
Anɛ pi ninɛmɛ nɛ pee yayami nɛ a fia si gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ lo?
Nɛ mɛnɔmɛ a nɔ e kã kita ngɔ fɔ kaa a be e he jɔɔmi ɔ mi sɛe ɔ?
Anɛ pi tuegboli ɔmɛ lo?
Nɛ wa naa kaa hemi nɛ a he we yi ɔ he nɛ a nyɛ we mi nɛ a sɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ Mawu si e he jɔɔmi ɔ mi sɛmi he si womi ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ alinɔ e ko ba mi kaa e fɔ wa ti nɔ ko.
Ejakaa wɔ hu a fiɛ Sane kpakpa a ngɔ ha wɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a fiɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ nɔuu; se kɛ̃ ɔ munyu nɛ a nu ɔ he ya bɛ́ se nami ha mɛ, ejakaa ninɛmɛ nɛ nu ɔ kɛ hemi kɛ yemi pɛtɛ we he.
Ejakaa wɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ wa he ye ɔ wa ngɛ jamɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ mi sɛe, kaa bɔ nɛ e de ɔ ke: “Lɔ ɔ ha i kɛ mi mi fumi ka kita ke: ‘Ke a sɛ ye he jɔɔmi ɔ mi fii!’ ” pohu a gbe Mawu ni tsumi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ je je mi sisije lokoo.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ e de ngɛ he ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi kpaago ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nɛ Mawu jɔɔ e he ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi kpaago ɔ nɔ ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ kulaa mi;” nɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ e kpale de ke: “Ke a sɛ ye he jɔɔmi ɔ mi fii!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ akɛnɛ e fɔɔ si kaa ni komɛ maa sɛ mi, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a fiɛ Sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ kekle ɔ sɛ we mi ngɛ hemi nɛ a he we yi ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu kpale to ligbi kpa ko ekohu, nɛ e de ngɛ David nya, ngɛ be babauu nɛ ɔ se ke, Mwɔnɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ la de sa a, “Mwɔnɛ ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ, Nyɛ ko wlua nyɛ tsui.’ ” Ejakaa kaa Yosua na ha mɛ he jɔɔmi jinɛ, pee se ɔ Mawu ko tu we ligbi kpa ko he munyu hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ he jɔɔmi ligbi yemi ko fɔɔ si kɛ ha Mawu ma a. Ejakaa nɔ nɛ sɛ e he jɔɔmi ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu e jɔɔ e he ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu jɔɔ e he ngɛ e nɔ ɔ mi ɔ. Lɔɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha waa bɔ mɔde, konɛ waa sɛ jamɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ mi, nɛ nɔ ko ko nyɛɛ jamɛ a tue gbomi blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e laa.
Ejakaa Mawu munyu hɛ ngɛ nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e nya ba pe klaate nya enyɔtsɛ, nɛ e gbuu kɛ sɛɛ mi kɛ ya suu be nɛ e gbaa klaa kɛ mumi ɔ kɛ kpɔji nya amɛ kɛ wu mi zɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ji tsui mi susumihi kɛ juɛmi ɔmɛ a kojolɔ.
A laa we bɔ nɔ́ ko ngɛ e hɛ mi, se nihi kulaa ngɛ paa nɛ a bli nɔ ngɛ lɛ nɔ nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ sane ɔ hɛngmɛ mi.
Yesu osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ngua a Jehanɛ, akɛnɛ wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ngua nɛ po mi kɛ gu hiɔwe nihi a mi, nɛ ji Yesu, Mawu bi ɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha waa pɛtɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he wawɛɛ.
Ejakaa wa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, e pi nɔ nɛ be nyɛe maa nu wa gbɔjɔmi ɔmɛ a he ha wɔ, se e ji nɔ ko nɛ a ka lɛ ngɛ nihi kulaa blɔfami kaa wɔ, nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ yayami ko yayami ko be e he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha waa kɛ kã nɛ hɛ wɔ kɛ su dloomi sɛ ɔ he, konɛ wa nine nɛ su mɔbɔ nami nɔ nɛ wa na dloomi nɛ maa ye bua wɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Ejakaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma tsuaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a hia ngɛ nimli a kpɛti ɔ, a wo lɛ osɔfo konɛ e da nimli a nane mi ngɛ Mawu nihi a blɔfami, konɛ e kɛ nike nihi kɛ bɔhi ba ha ngɛ yayamihi a he, kaa nɔ ko nɛ nyɛɔ e nuɔ nɔ́ he haa nihi nɛ li ni kɛ nihi nɛ tla blɔ ɔ, akɛ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu ɔ gbedemi bɔle e he kɛ kpe ɔ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa, kaa bɔ nɛ e peɔ haa ma a, e pee ja nɔuu ngɔ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ e sa yayamihi a he bɔ.
Nɛ nɔ ko ngɔɛ hɛ mi nyami nɔ ha we lɛ nitsɛ e he, kaa ja Mawu tsɛ lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ Aaron hu ɔ. Ja nɔuu Kristo hu, pi lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma yemi mi, se mohu Mawu nɛ de lɛ ke: “Ye bi ji mo, mwɔnɛ i fɔ mo” ɔ, lɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Kaa bɔ nɛ e de ngɛ he kpa hu ke: “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene Ngɛ Melkizedek blɔ ɔ nɔ.” Ngɛ Yesu he lo be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, e ngɔ sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami nɛ ngmlaa kpami nɛ nya wa kɛ vo nyu piɛ he sa bɔ ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma he lɛ kɛ je gbenɔ mi ɔ, nɛ a bu lɛ tue hulɔ, ejakaa e buu Mawu.
Nɛ pohu Mawu bi ji lɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ e kase tue bumi ngɛ amanehluhi nɛ e na amɛ a mi, nɛ benɛ a ha e hi kɛ pi si ɔ, e plɛ nɔ nɛ mi nɛ neneene yi wami hemi jee kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ, ejakaa Mawu wo lɛ osɔfo kaa Melkizedek.
Sigbeemi he kɔkɔbɔmi Wa ngɛ munyuhi fuu nɛ wa maa tu ngɛ enɛ ɔ he, se a sisi tsɔɔmi hu wa, ejakaa nyɛ tue mi ti; ejakaa nyɛ nɛ jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛ plɛ tsɔɔli mohu ngɛ be ɔ nya a, e hia kaa a tsɔɔ nyɛ Mawu munyu ɔ mi sisije ni ɔmɛ ekohu, nɛ nyɛ plɛ nihi nɛ nyɔ nyu hia mɛ, se pi niyeni nitsɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pupɔɔ nyɔ ɔ li nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, ejakaa bimwɔyo ji lɛ.
Se ninɛmɛ nɛ wa a, a nɔ ji niyeni nitsɛ, nihi nɛ tsɔse a he numi ni ɔmɛ le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ kpakpa kɛ yayami kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ha wa si Kristo he sisije ni tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ, nɛ waa po mi kɛ ya tsɔɔmihi nɛ sa kɛ ha nikɔtɔmahi a he; nɛ wa ko kpale to nitsumihi nɛ gbo a he tsui tsakemi kɛ Mawu nɔ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ baptisimihi a he ni tsɔɔmi kɛ ninehi kɛ nɔ nɔ puemi, kɛ gbogboehi a si temi kɛ neneene kojomi he sane ɔmɛ a sisi ekohu.
Enɛ ɔ wa maa pee ke Mawu ngmɛ blɔ.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ la tso ngɛ a nɔ hyɛ nɛ a sa a nya hiɔwe nɔ́ke nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ eko nɛ a sa a nya Mawu munyu kpakpa a kɛ je nɛ maa ba a mi hewami ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se nɛ a gbee si ɔ, a be nyɛe ma tsake mɛ ngɔ pee ni hehi ekohu ha tsui tsakemi, akɛnɛ a ngɛ Mawu bi ɔ sɛue ekohu kɛ ngɛ a he hae nɛ a ngɛ lɛ ahlua bɔe he ɔ. Zugba nɛ mii nyu nɛ nɛɛ pueɔ e nɔ kpitikpiti nɛ baa ni nɛ hi ha ninɛmɛ nɛ huɔ nɔ ɔ naa Mawu gbaami ɔ eko; se ke mio kɛ hu e puɛɛ ɔ, a kuaa lɛ, nɛ Mawu gbiɛmi baa e nɔ, nɛ e nyagbe ji a kɛ la maa sa.
Se mamimɛ, wa ngɛ kikɛ dee mohu, se kɛ̃ ɔ wa hɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ kaa nyɛ sane hi pe ja, nɛ yi wami hemi maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se.
Ejakaa Mawu pi nɔ nɛ yeɔ sane nɛ dɛ́ nɛ e hɛ maa je nyɛ ni tsumi ɔ nɔ kɛ suɔmi he dengme nɛ nyɛ gbo ngɛ e biɛ ɔ he, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sɔmɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ pa kɛ ngɛ mɛ sɔmɔe kɛ mwɔ ɔ. Wa ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ kikɛmɛ a mɔde bɔmi nɛ ɔ nɔuu, konɛ a ma hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ nɔ mi kɛ ya su nyagbe, konɛ nyɛ ko pee hejɔ se mohu nyɛɛ kase ninɛmɛ nɛ guu hemi kɛ yemi kɛ tsui si tomi nɔ naa si womi ɔ. Mawu siwomi nɛ tsakee we Benɛ Mawu wo Abraham si ɔ, akɛnɛ e be nɔ ko nɛ pe lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ma kã lɛ kita he je ɔ, e ka lɛ nitsɛ e he kita, nɛ e ke: Niinɛ, ma gbaa mo, nɛ ma ha o nina maa hiɛ.
Nɛ akɛnɛ Abraham to e tsui si he je ɔ, e nine su si womi ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa nimli ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ pe mɛ ɔ kita a kaa, nɛ a nya sami nyagbe tsuo ji kita kami nɛ a kɛ maa sane tsuaa sane nɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ benɛ Mawu hia kaa e tsɔɔ si womi ɔ yeli ɔmɛ kaa e yi mi tomi ɔ tsakee we kulaa a, e kɛ kita ma nɔ mi, konɛ waa gu sanehi enyɔ nɛ tsakee we nɛ Mawu be nyɛe maa ngɔ nya ngɛ mi ɔ nɔ kɛ na bua womi nɛ wa, konɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa ya sawe ɔ, wa kɛ hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ngɛ wa hɛ mi ɔ mi; wa hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɔ kaa wa klaa sɛkɛ nɛ tsɔ we nɛ pi si kpɛii kɛ sɛ mi kɛ ho tsu mi pomi bo ɔ se ya tɔɔ, he nɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ ji Yesu, nɔ nɛ plɛ neneene osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma kaa Melkizedek ɔ sɛ ha wɔ ɔ.
Osɔfo Melkizedek Se Melkizedek nɛ ɔ ɔ, lɛ ji Salem matsɛ, Mawu ope ɔ, osɔfo nɛ kɛ Abraham ya kpe benɛ e kpale e se kɛ je matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gbemi mi ngɛ ta mi nɛ e gbaa lɛ, nɛ Abraham ha lɛ ni ɔmɛ kulaa mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ nɛ.
Melkizedek biɛ ɔ, e kekle sisi tsɔɔmi ji “Dami Matsɛ” nɛ jehanɛ hu e ji “Salem Matsɛ,” nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ sisi hu ji “Hejɔmi Matsɛ.” E be tsɛ, e be nyɛ, e be weku kpa, nɛ e be ligbihi a sisije loo wami nyagbe tete, e ngɛ kaa Mawu Bi ɔ; e hii si kaa osɔfo kɛ yaa neneene.
Jehanɛ nyɛ susu he, bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ agbo jemi ngɛ ha: Blemano Abraham ɔ tete ngɔ ta yi bu ni kpakpa amɛ a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ngɔ ha lɛ!
Wa le kaa Levibi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi nɛ tsuɔ osɔfo ni tsumi ɔ hu ngɛ kita ko ngɛ Mlaa a nya, kaa a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ngɛ ma a dɛ, lɔ ɔ ji ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ, pohu mɛ hu a je Abraham mi.
Se Melkizedek nɛ be weku sisi tsɔɔmi ko ngɛ Levibi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ ɔ ɔ, e he midlami mi nyɔngma a mi kake ngɛ Abraham po dɛ, nɛ e gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ si womi ɔmɛ tete.
Nguane jemi ko be he kulaa kaa nɔ nɛ kle pe e nyɛmi ɔ lɛ e gbaa nɔ nɛ klee we ɔ. Jehanɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ, nimli nɛ gboɔ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ, se lejɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ ngmami ɔ ye e he odase kaa e hɛ ngɛ ngmengmle ɔ lɛ he.
Nɛ, ke ma de jã a, kɛ gu Abraham nɔ ɔ, a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Levi nɛ heɔ lɔ ɔ hu dɛ; ejakaa e ngɛ e tsɛ Abraham ɔ mi mi momo bene Melkizedek kɛ lɛ ba kpe ɔ. Jehanɛ ke himi kɛ si pimi gu Levi osɔfo yemi ɔ nɔ kɛ ba a (ejakaa e yi nɔ a wo ma a mlaa ngɛ), lɛɛ mɛni he je e hia kɛ̃ kaa osɔfo kpa ko nɛ te si nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek, nɛ pi kaa Aaron ɔ mɔ?
Ejakaa ke a tsake osɔfo yemi ɔ, lɛɛ e hia kaa a tsake Mlaa a hulɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ he nɛ a de ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, je wɛtso kpa ko mi, nɔ mi nɛ nɔ ko ji kɛ ba tsu we bɔ sami latɛ ɔ he ni hyɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ le kaa Yuda mi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je, jamɛ a wetso ɔ Mose de we he nɔ́ ko ngɛ osɔfo yemi he.
Osɔfo kpã ko kaa Melkizedek Nɔ́ nɛ haa sane ɔ jee kpo paa a ji kaa osɔfo kpã ko te si nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek, nɔ nɛ pi he lo kita mlaa nya nɛ a wo lɛ osɔfo ngɛ, se mohu wami nɛ puɛ we ɔ he wami nya.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ yeɔ odase ke: Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek.
Ejakaa kita nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ, akɛnɛ e be he wami nɛ e he be se nami ko he ɔ a gu, ejakaa Mlaa ha we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ hi kɛ pi si, se jehanɛ a kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ hi pe lɔ ɔ nɛ waa kɛ suu Mawu he ɔ ba je mi.
Enɛ ɔ peemi mi ɔ a si we Mawu kita a se.
Ni kpa amɛ ɔ, a wo mɛ osɔfohi mohu se a ka we kita ko.
Se Yesu lɛɛ, kita kami a kɛ wo lɛ, benɛ Mawu de lɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ka kita Nɛ e be e he piae: Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene” ɔ. Jehanɛ somi nɛ Yesu daa si ngɛ mi ɔ hi pe kulaa.
Slɔɔto kpa ko hu ji, mɛɛ lɛɛ, akɛnɛ gbenɔ ha we nɛ a se nɛ kɛ he je ɔ, mɛ fuu a ye osɔfo; se Yesu lɛɛ, akɛnɛ e hii si kɛ yaa neneene he je ɔ, e sɔfo yemi ɔ se pui.
Lɔ ɔ he hu ɔ e nyɛɔ nihi nɛ guu e nɔ kɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔmɛ a yi wami heɔ, ejakaa e ngɛ daa konɛ e da mi ha mɛ.
Yesu ji Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ sa wɔ pɛ: nɔ nɛ he tsɔ, nɛ yayami ko be e he, nɛ e he be piami ko, nɛ e tsɔ e he kɛ je yayami peeli a he, nɛ a wo e nɔ kɛ be hiɔwe, he; nɔ nɛ e hia we lɛ, kaa osɔfo nikɔtɔma kpa amɛ, kaa daa ligbi ɔ e sã lɛ nitsɛ e he yayami ɔmɛ a he bɔ kekle loko e sã ma a hu nɔ; ejakaa e pee enɛ ɔ si kake nyɔngloo, benɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ sã bɔ ɔ. Ejakaa Mose Mlaa a, nimli gbɔjɔli e ngɔ woɔ osɔfo nikɔtɔmahi ɔ nɛ, se Mawu kita nɛ ba ngɛ Mlaa a se ɔ he munyu ɔ wo Bi nɛ hi kɛ pi si kɛ yaa neneene ɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma.
Yesu wa sɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Se nihi nɛ wa ngɛ dee ɔ kulaa yi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma, nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ he walɔ ngua a matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, kaa he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ anɔkuale bo tsu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ ma nɛ pi nɔmlɔ ko nɛ ma a mi sɔmɔlɔ.
Ejakaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma tsuaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a, a wo lɛ konɛ e ngɔ nike nihi kɛ bɔ sami nihi kɛ ba ha, lɔ ɔ he je ɔ e hia kaa nɔ nɛ ɔ hu e na nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ba ha.
Se kaa zugba a nɔ e ngɛ jinɛ, e be osɔfo tete pee, ejakaa osɔfohi nɛ kɛ nike nihi ya haa ngɛ Mlaa nya a ngɛ; nihi nɛ hiɔwe ni ɔmɛ a henɔ kɛ a nini kɛkɛ a sɔmɔɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ Mose, benɛ e maa ma bo tsu ɔ ke: “Hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ o pee ni ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ henɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ ɔ nya.” Se jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu na osɔfo yemi nɛ hi pe kekle nɔ ɔ, ejakaa somi nɛ hi pe kekle nɔ ɔ nɛ a da si womihi nɛ hi pe kekle ni ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ kã kita a mi dalɔ ji lɛ.
Ejakaa kaa kekle somi ɔ hi kɛ pi si jinɛ a be blɔ hlae ngɔ ha nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu piaa mɛ: E ke: “Oʼɛ, ligbihi ma, Nɛ i kɛ Israel we ɔ kɛ Yuda we ɔ Maa so somi he ko, Pi kaa somi nɛ i kɛ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ so Benɛ i pɛtɛ a nine mi nɛ i kɛ mɛ je Mizraim zugba a nɔ ɔ; Ejakaa a yi ye somi ɔ nɔ Nɛ imi hu i bui a he akɔtaa, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji somi nɛ i kɛ Israel we ɔ maa so Ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a se ɔ nɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ke: I kɛ ye mlaahi maa wo a juɛmi mi, Nɛ ma ngma ngɔ wo a tsui mi, Nɛ ma pee a Mawu Nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.
Nɛ a ti nɔ ko be e huɛ loo e nyɛmi tsɔɔe ke: ‘Le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.’ Ejakaa mɛ kulaa a maa le mi, Kɛ maa je a kpɛti nɔ nyafii nɔ Kɛ yaa su nɔ ngua nɔ.
Ejakaa ma na mɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ a nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ a he, Nɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ hu i be kaie ligbi ko ligbi ko.” Somi he nɛ ɔ he munyu ɔ, ha kekle nɔ ɔ pee momo.
Se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ pee momo kɛ nɔ́ nɛ bwɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ e maa laa.
Hiɔwe kɛ Zugba nɔ nɔ jami Jehanɛ kekle somi ɔ hu ngɛ Mawu jami blɔ nya nihi kɛ He klɔuklɔu nɛ ji je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ.
A ma bo tsu ko ngɔ ma si, nɛ e kpo nɔ je ɔ, kane tso kɛ okplɔɔ kɛ hɛ mi mami abolohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ ke He klɔuklɔu.
Nɛ tsu mi pomi bo nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ se bo tsu ɔ a tsɛɛ lɛ He klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.
Lejɛ ɔ tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ kɛ somi daka nɛ a kɛ sika ha he kulaa a ngɛ, lɔ ɔ mi sika kplu kɛ mana a kɛ Aaron tso nɛ su ba a kɛ somi tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔ nɔ nyami kerubim nɛ ha kpatami sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ, nihi nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ wa be nyɛe a he munyu tumi kakaaka a. Bɔ nɛ a dlaa kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ haa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: osɔfo ɔmɛ yaa kekle bo tsu ɔ mi daa ligbi ya tsuɔ Mawu jami he ni; se bo tsu nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a kɛkɛ lɛ yaa mi si kake daa jeha, nɛ e si we muɔ nɛ e ya, nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ ya haa ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ kɛ ma a tɔmihi nɛ a li ɔmɛ a he ɔ. Enɛ ɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ pãa kaa be abɔ nɛ kekle bo tsu ɔ maa si kɛ mwɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, lɛɛ blɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa he klɔuklɔu ɔ a na we nɛ a bli.
Enɛ ɔ ji mwɔnɛ mwɔnɛ be nɛ ɔ he abɛ nɛ a bu.
Lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa a kɛ nike nihi kɛ bɔ sami nihi be nyɛe ma ha nɔ́ nɛ dɛ́ ɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ he nile blɔfami nihi nɛ kɔɔ niye ni kɛ numi nihi kɛ he dumi slɔɔtohi nɛ ji he lo blɔ nya nihi a he nɛ a to ke a pee kɛ ya su ehe peemi be ɔ.
Se Kristo nɛ ba ba ye ni kpakpahi nɛ maa ba amɛ a he osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a, gu bo tsu nɛ kle nɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ pi nine nɛ a kɛ pee, lɔ ɔ ji kaa pi je nɛ ɔ mi bɔ nihi a mi nɛ e je ɔ mi, nɛ pohu, pi tokuhi loo na bimɛ a muɔ, se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ɔ e kɛ sɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ mi si kake nyɔngloo, nɛ e kɛ na neneene kpɔmi ɔ. Ejakaa ke nahi kɛ tokui a muɔ kɛ na bimɛ a lazu nɛ a kɛ fiãa nihi nɛ bleɔ a he ɔ nɔ ɔ fɔɔ a he nɛ a he tsɔɔ ngɛ he lo blɔfami ɔ, si nyɛmɛ nɔuu nɛ Kristo, nɛ gu neneene mumi ɔ nɔ ngɔ e he nɛ piami ko be he ngɔ ha Mawu ɔ muɔ be wa he ni lemi he fɔe kɛ je ni tsumi gbogboehi a mi, konɛ wa sɔmɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ?
Enɛ ɔ nɔuu he je nɛ e ji somi he ɔ mi dalɔ ɔ nɛ, benɛ pee nɛ e gu gbenɔ nɔ kɛ kpata kekle somi ɔ nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ, konɛ nihi nɛ a tsɛ ɔmɛ a nine nɛ su neneene gbo si ni ɔmɛ a he si womi ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa he nɛ si womi nɛ haa a yeɔ gbo si ni ngɛ ɔ, e hia kaa nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ e gbo lolo, ejakaa si womi nɛ haa a yeɔ gbo si ni ɔ, ja si wolɔ ɔ gbo loko e naa he wami, se ke e hɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔ ɔ, e be he wami.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ kekle nɔ́ ɔ hu a si we muɔ se kɛ wui ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa benɛ Mose fiɛ kita amɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ ma mluku ɔ kulaa ngɛ mlaa a nya a, e ngɔ na bimɛ kɛ tokuhi a muɔ kɛ nyu kɛ jijɔ he bwɔmi tsutsu kɛ hisopo, nɛ e kɛ fia womi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ ma mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ, e ke: “Oʼɛ, somi ɔ nɛ Mawu kã nyɛ he kita a muɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ bo tsu ɔ hu kɛ Mawu jami he ni ɔmɛ kulaa, e kɛ muɔ ɔ fia nɔ ja nɔuu.
Nɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ, e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a kɛ muɔ tsukɔɔ nihi kulaa he ngɛ mlaa a nya; nɛ ke a pue we muɔ si ɔ, a kɛ pɛ́.
Kristo bɔsami ɔ jeɔ yayami Lɛɛ e hia kaa nihi nɛ ji hiɔwe ni ɔmɛ a henɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ngɔ enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsukɔ he; se hiɔwe ni ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, bɔhi nɛ hi pe kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ tsukɔɔ he.
Ejakaa pi he klɔuklɔu nɛ a kɛ ninehi pee nɛ ji nɔ́ ɔ nitsɛ henɔ kɛkɛ mi nɛ Kristo ya sɛ ɔ, se mohu hiɔwe nitsɛ e ya sɛ, konɛ jehanɛ ya je e he kpo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ha wɔ.
Pohu e ya sɛ we lejɛ ɔ konɛ e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha daa daa, kaa bɔ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a ya sɛɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ daa jeha kɛ muɔ nɛ pi lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ ɔ; ejakaa ke ja a, jinɛ sa kaa e na amanehlu kpiti kpiti kɛ je je mi siiije lokoo; se jehanɛ ɔ, si kake kɛkɛ a je lɛ kpo ngɛ je mi be ɔmɛ a nyagbe mi, konɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he nɛ e kɛ sa bɔ ɔ kɛ je yayami ɔ. Nɛ be abɔ nɛ e fɔɔ si ha nimli kaa si kake a gboɔ nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ a maa kojo mɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu Kristo hu, a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha si kake, konɛ e tloo nihi fuu a he yayami kɛ ho.
E ma je e he kpo nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ, pi ngɛ yayami he, se mohu konɛ e ba he ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ a yi wami.
Ejakaa ni kpakpahi nɛ maa ba amɛ a nini kɛkɛ Mlaa a hɛɛ, se pi ni ɔmɛ a subai nitsɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ daa jeha bɔhi nɛ a saa nɔtonɔto ɔ nɛ ha nihi nɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔ nɛ a hi kɛ pi si.
Jinɛ a ko jɔɔ bɔ ɔmɛ sami, ejakaa nihi nɛ ba jaa Mawu ɔ, ke a tsukɔ a he si kake pɛ ɔ, a be fɔ ko nɛ a yeɔ ngɛ a he yayamihi a he kulaa hu.
Se mohu bɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, kaimi a kɛ kaii yayamihi daa jeha, ejakaa a be nyɛe maa ngɔ nahi kɛ tokuhi a muɔ kɛ je yayamihi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Kristo ma je nɔ mi ɔ, ye de Mawu ke: “Bɔ kɛ nike ni ɔmɛ ɔ, o sume, Se nɔmlɔ tso o dla ha mi Bɔ nɛ a kɛ lohwehi saa kɛ yayami he bɔ ɔmɛ Sɛ́ o hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke: ‘Oʼɛ, i ba, Oo Mawu, Nɛ ma ba pee o suɔmi nya ni Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ ye he ngɛ Mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ.’ ” Kekle ɔ e ke: “Bɔ kɛ nike nihi kɛ lohwehi a bɔhi kɛ yayami he bɔ ɔmɛ ɔ o sume, nɛ e sɛ́ o hɛ mi hulɔ,” (nihi nɛ a kɛ ba haa ngɛ Mlaa a nya a); kɛkɛ nɛ e ke: “Oʼɛ, i ba nɛ ma ba pee mo, Mawu, o suɔmi nya ni.” Lɔ ɔ Mawu jeɔ kekle bɔ sami ni ɔmɛ konɛ e ngɔ Kristo nɔ ɔ ngɔ ma nane mi.
A kɛnɛ Yesu Kristo pee Mawu suɔmi nya ni he je ɔ, a tsukɔ wa he kɛ gu e nɔmlɔ tso nɛ e kɛ ha si kake nyɔngloo ɔ nɔ.
Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo ɔ, ligbi tsuaa ligbi ɔ, e daa si nɛ e sɔmɔɔ, nɛ e saa jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu kpitikpiti, nihi nɛ nyɛ we yayami nɛ a je ligbi ko ligbi ko ɔ. Kristo lɛɛ e sa yayamihi a he bɔ si kake nyɔngloo, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ji kaa, e ngɛ mlɛe kɛ maa su be nɛ a maa ngɔ e henyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ maa pee e nane si maangoo.
Ejakaa bɔ kake nɛ e sa a, e kɛ ha nihi nɛ a tsukɔ a he ɔ hi kɛ pi si nyɔngloo.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu yeɔ wɔ odase.
Kekleekle ɔ, e ke: “Enɛ ɔ ji somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa so Ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a se, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de: I kɛ ye mlaa amɛ maa wo a tsui mi, Nɛ ma ngma ngɔ wo a juɛmi mi Nɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ a nɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ ɔ, i be kaie kulaa hu.” Nɛ he nɛ a kɛ enɔmɛ pa ngɛ ɔ, yayami he bɔ sami ko be hu.
Nyɛ ha waa hɛ kɛ su Mawu he Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, akɛnɛ wa ngɛ he blɔ ngɛ Yesu muɔ ɔ nya nɛ wa kɛ maa sɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ blɔ he nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ e je ha wɔ ɔ kɛ gu tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e he lo ɔ mi, nɛ jehanɛ wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma ngua nɛ yeɔ Mawu we ɔ nɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hɛ kɛ su Mawu he kɛ tsui klɔuu ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ ɔ mi, kɛ tsui hu nɛ a tsukɔ he nɛ e be he ni lemi yaya ko hulɔ, kɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a kɛ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ du he.
Nyɛ ha waa pɛtɛ wa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ wa jaje ɔ mi wawɛɛ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ.
Nyɛ ha wa susu wa sibi a he, konɛ wa hɛ nɛ e dɔ ngɛ suɔmi kɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi a he.
Nyɛ ko ha waa jɔɔ wa he nya buami, kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ pɔɔ peemi ɔ, se mohu waa wo wa he ga, nɛ titli ɔ, akɛnɛ nyɛ na kaa Ligbi ɔ ngɛ sue nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa ke wa bua nɛ wa peɔ yayami ngɛ benɛ wa le anɔkuale ɔ se ɔ, lɛɛ yayamihi a he bɔsami ko be hu, kojomi blɔ hyemi nɛ ngɛ gbeye kɛkɛ, kɛ la gligli nɛ maa sa nihi nɛ nyɛɛ Mawu ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuaa Mose Mlaa a, a gbee lɛ, nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ ni enyɔ loo ni etɛ a dase yemi nya.
Mɛni tuegblami nɛ nya wa po nyɛ susu kaa e sa nɔmlɔ ko nɛ bui Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ e bu somi muɔ nɛ a kɛ tsukɔ e he ɔ kaa yaka nɔ ko, nɛ e pee dloomi mumi ɔ nidɔ ni ɔ?
Ejakaa wa le nɔ nɛ de ke: “Ye nɔ ji tue gblami, imi ma wo he hiɔ” ɔ. Nɛ jehanɛ: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa kojo lɛ nitsɛ e ma a.” Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ dɛ mi nɔmi ngɛ gbeye pam.
Se nyɛ kai kekle be ɔmɛ, benɛ Mawu la a tso ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ amanehlu babauu mi.
Be komɛ ɔ jemi kɛ amanehlu sɔuu ha nyɛ plɛ hyemi nihi, nɛ be komɛ hu nyɛ plɛ nihi nɛ a pee mɛ ja amɛ a huɛmɛ nɔnali.
Nyɛ muklii mi sa nyɛ ngɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a bɔ mɛ pa amɛ a he, nɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ a ha amɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi kplɛɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ le kaa nyɛ ngɛ juetli nɛ hi pe kɔlɔ ɔ babauu nɛ hii si daa ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ mi kã a he, ejakaa e ngɛ hiɔwo ngua.
Tsui si tomi he hia nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ni, nɛ nyɛ nine nɛ e su siwomi ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ: “E piɛ bɔɔ kɛkɛ Nɛ nɔ nɛ ma a maa ba, Nɛ e be kɛe kulaa; Se zdalɔ nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi ɔ Yi ma na wa; Nɛ ke e kpale kɛ je ye se ɔ Ye klaa be e he buajɔmi nae.” Se wɔɔ lɛɛ tsa pi nihi nɛ kpaleɔ kɛ yaa hɛ mi patami mi mi ɔ a ti nikomɛ ji wɔ se mohu wɔ ji nihi nɛ kɛ hemi kɛ yemi naa a klaa yi wami hemi ɔ a ti ni komɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi Hemi kɛ yemi ji nihi nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ he waminami kɛ nihi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔmɛ a nɔ mi mami.
Ejakaa lɔ ɔ mi a ye blemabi ɔmɛ a he odase kpakpa ngɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi waa kɛ yoɔ kaa Mawu munyu a kɛ bɔ je ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ nihi nɛ a naa amɛ a mi a je kɛ pee nihi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔmɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi Habel kɛ sa bɔ nɛ pe Kain nɔ ɔ ha Mawu, nɛ lɔ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ a ye e he odase kaa dalɔ ji lɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa Mawu he e nike ni ɔmɛ; nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɔ mwɔ pohu e gbo.
Hemi kɛ yemi he a ngɔ Henok kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, konɛ e ko gbo, nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho.
Ngmami ɔ ye e he odase kaa loko a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ɔ, Henok sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Ke hemi kɛ yemi be ɔ, a be Mawu hɛ mi nyɛe maa sa, ejakaa nɔ nɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔ, ja e he ye kaa e ngɛ, nɛ e ji ninɛmɛ nɛ hlaa e se blɔ ɔ a hiɔ wolɔ hulɔ.
Hemi kɛ yemi Noa hu kɛ bu Mawu tue, benɛ e fa lɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ dla daka kɛ ha e we ɔ yi wami hemi; e hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ɔ nɔ hu e gu nɛ e bu je ɔ fɔ, nɛ e kɛ na dami nɛ je hemi kɛ yemi mi.
Hemi kɛ yemi Abraham kɛ bu tue, benɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho he nɛ Mawu wo lɛ si ke e ma ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ ya; nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho, pohu e li he nɛ e yaa.
Hemi kɛ yemi e kɛ ya to nibwɔ ngɛ si womi zugba a nɔ kaa nɔ kpa, nɛ e kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob nɛ e kɛ mɛ ji jamɛ a si womi ɔ nɔuu yeli ɔ hi si ngɛ bo tsuhi a mi; ejakaa Abraham ngɛ ma nɛ ngɛ sisi tomi nɛ he wa nɛ e tolɔ kɛ e malɔ ji Mawu ɔ blɔ hyɛe.
Hemi kɛ yemi Sara hu kɛ na he wami nɛ e kɛ na muklii, nɛ lɛ nɛ e bwɔ tsɔ kɛ be nɔ ɔ fɔ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ, e bu lɛ anɔkualetsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ a je nɔ kake nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ gbo mo ɔ mi nɛ a fɔ nihi nɛ hiɛ babauu kaa hiɔwe dodoehi loo wo nya zia nɛ a be nyɛe maa kane ɔ nɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi mi ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa gbo ngɛ.
Lokoo kɛkɛ a na nihi nɛ a wo he si ɔmɛ ngɛ, nɛ a nya he, pohu a nine sui nɔ, nɛ a ye odase kaa nibwɔhi kɛ masetsɛmɛ ji mɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ?
Ejakaa nihi nɛ deɔ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ faii kaa a ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma hlae.
