Nɛ kaa a hɛ ngɛ ma nɛ a je mi ɔ nɔ jinɛ, a ko na he blɔ kɛ ko kpale a se kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya ekohu.
Se jehanɛ, a ngɛ ma ko nɛ hi pe lɔ ɔ nɛ ji hiɔwe nɔ ɔ hlae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee we Mawu zo kaa a ma tsɛ lɛ a Mawu, ejakaa e dla ma ngɔ to mɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi nya Abraham ngɔ Isak ngɔ ha kaa bɔ, benɛ a ka lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ e bi kake ɔ ba ha, benɛ e nine su si womi ɔ nɔ momo ɔ, lɛ nɔ nɛ Mawu de lɛ ke: “Isak mi a maa je kɛ tsɛ o nina,” a. Abraham ngɔ lɛ kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma tle Isak si kɛ je gbeje tete, nɛ niinɛ, ke a ma de ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e nine su e nɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Hemi kɛ yemi Isak kɛ gbaa Yakob kɛ Esau ngɛ nihi nɛ maa ba amɛ a he.
Hemi kɛ yemi Yakob kɛ gbaa Yosef bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ benɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, nɛ e ma e yi si ngɛ e dɛma tso ɔ nɔ nɛ e sɔle.
Hemi kɛ yemi Yosef hu kɛ wo Israelbi ɔmɛ a Mizraim jemi ɔ nɔ ta benɛ e su e gbenɔ be ɔ, nɛ e wo lɛ nitsɛ e wu ɔmɛ a he kita a. Hemi kɛ yemi Mose fɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ laa hlami etɛ, benɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ, ejakaa a na kaa jokuɛ ɔ he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ a yi matsɛ hiɔngɔ nɛ e wo ɔ gbeye.
Hemi kɛ yemi he nɛ Mose nitsɛ, benɛ e wa a, e kua ke a ko tsɛ lɛ Farao biyo ɔ bi, e suɔ mohu kaa e kɛ Mawu ma a nɛ na amanehlu, pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa ye yayami mi ngɔmi be bɔɔ ko.
E bu Kristo ahluabɔmi ɔ kaa ni babauu pe Mizraim juetli, ejakaa e ngɛ hiɔwo ɔ hyɛe.
Hemi kɛ yemi Mose kɛ je Mizraim nɛ e yi matsɛ ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ gbeye; e kpale we e se, kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ ɔ hyɛe.
Hemi kɛ yemi Mose kɛ to Hetsɔmi ɔ kɛ muɔ dikimi ɔ sisi, konɛ bɔfo nɔ hɛ mi kpatalɔ ɔ ko ba gbe Israelbi ɔmɛ a bi tete ɔmɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi Israelbi ɔmɛ kɛ po Wo Tsu ɔ kaa zugba gbligbli, nɔ́ nɛ Mizraimbi ɔmɛ hu ka peemi se wo ɔ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho ɔ. Hemi kɛ yemi nya Yeriko gli ɔmɛ kuɔ pue si, benɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ bɔle lɛ ligbi kpaago ɔ. Hemi kɛ yemi he nɛ Rahab, yaholɔ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ gbo we ɔ nɛ, ejakaa e he slaali ɔmɛ kɛ bua jɔmi.
Nɛ mɛni ma de ekohu?
Ejakaa i be ye he deka nae bɔ nɛ ma kɛ sɛɛ Gideon kɛ Barak, Samson kɛ Yefta, David kɛ Samuel, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ hulɔ a he sane, nihi nɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ye matsɛ yemihi a nɔ kunimi, a tsu dami nihi, a nine su si womihi a nɔ, a tsi jatahi a nya, a gbe la he wami, a je klaatehi a nya, a na he wami kɛ je gbɔlemi mi, a he wa ngɛ ta mi, a bu masetsɛmɛ a ta a. Yihi a nine su a nihi nɛ gbo ɔmɛ a nɔ ekohu kɛ gu si temi nɔ.
Se ni kpa komɛ hu, a kɛ piimi gbe mɛ, akɛnɛ a kplɛɛ we kpɔmi, konɛ a te si kɛ ya wami kpakpa mi ɔ. Ni komɛ hu a ye a he fɛu nɛ a fia mɛ kplibi.
Nɛ a bɔ mɛ pa nɛ a wo mɛ tsu mi; a fia mɛ tɛ, a kɛ sau poo a mi, a kɛ klaate gbe mɛ; a ha a wo jijɔhi kɛ apletsihi a he womi kɛ nyɛɛ, ohia hia mɛ, a wa mɛ yi mi, a pee mɛ ni yeyee; je ɔ hi ha mɛ.
A wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kɛ yokuhi a nɔ kɛ tɛ puɔhi kɛ zugba puɔhi a mi.
Nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, a ye a he odase kpakpa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he mohu, se a nine sui si womi ni ɔmɛ a nɔ, ejakaa Mawu dla nɔ́ ko kpakpa ngɔ to wɔ, konɛ a ko hi kɛ pi si si wɔ.
Wa Tsɛ Mawu Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ wɔ hu, be abɔ nɛ wa ngɛ odase yeli babauu nɛ mimla wɔ kaa bɔku nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha wa je nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ tsiɔ wa nya kɛ yayami nɛ fi wɔ ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ hɛ mi miami nɛ tu fo nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ wa hɛ mi ɔ, nɛ waa hyɛ hemi kɛ yemi sisi jelɔ kɛ nya gbelɔ nɛ ji Yesu ɔ, nɔ nɛ nyami nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ he ɔ, e mia e hɛ mi ngɛ seumi tso ɔ he amanehlu ɔ mi, nɛ e bui zo ɔ, nɛ e kɛ ya hi si ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ susu nɔ mi nɛ e gblee, bɔ nɛ e to e tsui si ngɛ si nɛ yayami peeli te ngɔ si lɛ ɔ mi, konɛ nyɛ nine mi ko wo nyu nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɛ he.
Ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ yayami ta nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ sui he nɛ a ma pue nyɛ muɔ si ngɛ ɔ lolo.
Anɛ nyɛ hɛ je bua womi munyu nɛ kɛ nyɛ tuɔ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ bimɛ tuɔ munyu ɔ nɔ?
ke: “Ye bi, koo ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi ɔ kaa nɔ ko nyafii, Nɛ jehanɛ ke e ka o hɛ mi ɔ, ko ha o nine mi nɛ wo nyu; Ejakaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ, lɛ e tsɔseɔ, Nɛ e fiaa bi tsuaa bi nɛ e ngɔ peɔ e nɔ ɔ kpa.” Nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ mi kaa e ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi; ejakaa te bi nɛ ngɛ nɛ e tsɛ tsɔse we lɛ nɛɛ?
Ke nyɛ na we tsɔsemi nɛ nihi tsuo naa a eko ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ajuama bimɛ ji nyɛ, se pi bimɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Jehanɛ wa ngɛ he lo blɔfami tsɛmɛ nɛ tsɔseɔ wɔ nɛ wa buu mɛ; anɛ e sɛ́ kaa waa ba wa he si ngɔ ha mumihi a tsɛ ɔ mohu babauu konɛ wa yi nɛ e na wa?
Ejaka mɛɛ lɛɛ, be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ a tsɔseɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ sa a hɛ mi; se Mawu lɛɛ, e tsɔseɔ wɔ, konɛ e hi ha wɔ konɛ wa na e klɔuklɔu peemi ɔ eko.
Se tsɔsemi tsuaa tsɔsemi ɔ, a mlɔ nɛ ɔ ɔ, e pee we nɔ kaa bua jɔmi nɔ́, se dɔmi nɔ́ mohu; se ke pee se ɔ, e woɔ he jɔmi yiblii nɛ ji dami ɔ haa nihi nɛ gu nɔ kase nɔ́ ko ɔ. Nitsɔɔmi kɛ kɔkɔbɔmi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ wo ninehi nɛ mi jɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kpa nakutsohi nɛ gbɔle ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ, konɛ pɔtsɛ ko nɛ ko sane si, se mohu a tsa lɛ.
Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, kɛ he tsɔmi nɛ ke nɔ ko si nɛ e be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nae ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ ko ko ngmɛɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ he, konɛ poku kɛ doomi ko ko puɛ nɛ e hao nyɛ nɛ e ble nihi fuu kɛ e duɔ ɔ; konɛ nɔ ko ko pee e he ajuama bɔlɔ, loo yaka nɔmlɔ kaa Esau nɛ jua e bi tete blɔ nya a kɛ he si kake niye ni ɔ. Ejakaa nyɛ le kaa, benɛ pee se nɛ e hla kaa e na gbaami ɔ, a kua lɛ; ejakaa e na we tsui tsakemi he blɔ, pohu e kɛ vo nyu hla se blɔ.
Ejakaa nyɛ bɛ yoku nɛ a taa he nɛ ngɛ sae kɛ la, kɛ bɔku kɛ diblii kɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngua, kɛ titimati pɛmi, kɛ gbi pɛmi nɛ nihi nɛ nu ɔ kpa pɛɛ ke a ko tu e ko piɛ he hu ɔ he; ejakaa mlaa nɛ a wo ke: “Ke lohwe ko tete ta yoku ɔ he ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ” ɔ, a nyɛ we nɔ nɛ a ye; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e na a ngɛ gbeye babauu tsɔ nɛ Mose ke: “I ngɛ gbeye yee, nɛ i he ngɛ doe blibliibli.” Se mohu, Zion yoku ɔ he nyɛ ba, kɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ma nɛ ji hiɔwe Yerusalem ɔ, kɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi akpe akpehi abɔ, kɛ kekleekle bimɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ Mawu nɛ ji nihi kulaa a kojolɔ ɔ, kɛ dali nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔmɛ a mumi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yesu nɛ ji somi he midalɔ ɔ, kɛ muɔ nɛ a kɛ fia nɛ tuɔ munyu kpakpa pe Habel nɔ ɔ ngɔ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi konɛ nyɛ ko kua nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ munyu ɔ, ejakaa ke nihi nɛ kua nɔ nɛ tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ munyu ɔ a he ji mi ɔ, lɛɛ ke wa kpale kɛ je nɔ nɛ jee hiɔwe tuɔ munyu ɔ se ɔ, wɔ mohu wa he be mi jee kɔkɔɔkɔ; nɔ gbi nɛ mimiɛ zugba a ngɛ lɛ be ɔ mi ɔ, se jehanɛ e wo si ke: “E piɛ si kake nɛ ma mimiɛ, pi zugba a kɛkɛ, se hiɔwe hulɔ,” ɔ. Munyu nɛ ke: “E piɛ si kake” ɔ, e kɛ tsɔɔ faii kaa, nihi nɛ a mimiɛ ɔmɛ ma tsake, ejakaa nihi nɛ a bɔ ʼi, konɛ nihi nɛ be mimiɛe ɔmɛ nɛ hi si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ wa na matsɛ yemi nɛ a be nyɛe ma mimiɛ nɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha waa na si, nɛ wa kɛ sɔmɔ Mawu bɔ nɛ sa e hɛ mi kɛ bu kɛ gbeye yemi; ejakaa wa Mawu ɔ la nɛ puɛɔ nɔ hu ji lɛ.
Mawu hɛ mi sami Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he daa kaa nyɛmimɛ.
Nibwɔ peemi hu, nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ, ejakaa lɔɔ nɔ ni komɛ gu kɛ pee hiɔwe bɔfohi nibwɔ, nɛ a li.
Nyɛ kai ninɛmɛ nɛ a wo mɛ tsu mi ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ lɛ ngɛ tsuɔ mi, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ nae ɔ, akɛnɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi kɛ mwɔ ɔ.
A wo gba hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ a ko ble gba sa a hulɔ; se ajuama bɔli kɛ gba puɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu maa kojo mɛ.
Sika suɔmi nɛ ko sɛ nyɛ si himi mi, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ he, ejakaa Mawu ke: “I be mo sie, nɛ jehanɛ hu i be mo kuae ligbi ko ligbi ko.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ma de kɛ kã ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji ye he piɛlɔ, I be gbeye yee; Mɛni nɔmlɔ ma nyɛ mi pee?” Nyɛ kai nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli, nihi nɛ tu Mawu munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ hyɛ a je mi si himi ɔ nyagbe, nɛ nyɛɛ kase a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ. Yesu Kristo ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hiɛ̃ kɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Tsɔɔmi slɔɔtohi kɛ tsɔɔmi kpahi kɛ nyɛ nɛ lilaa si; ejakaa e hi kaa a kɛ Mawu dloomi nɛ wo wa tsui he wami, se pi niye ni nɛ ha we nɛ nihi nɛ tsuɔ he ni ɔmɛ a na se ko ɔ. Wa ngɛ bɔ sami latɛ ko nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ be he blɔ kaa a yeɔ e nɔ ni; ejakaa lohwehi nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔɔ a muɔ kɛ yaa he klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ yayami he ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ɔ, a ya sãa ngɛ sada a se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yesu hu, benɛ pee nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ɔ nɛ tsukɔ ma a he ɔ, a gbo ɔ se e na amanehlu ɔ ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jeha nɛ, nyɛ ha waa je kpo kɛ ya e ngɔ ngɛ sada a se nɛ wa ya tloo e ahlua bɔmi ɔ. Ejakaa wa be ma nɛ ngɛ daa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, se ma nɛ maa ba a mohu se blɔ wa ngɛ hlae.
Lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ waa gu Yesu nɔ nɛ waa kɛ yi jemi bɔ ba ha Mawu daa; kɔlɔ ɔ ji waa jaje e biɛ ɔ yi jemi kɛ wa nya.
Nyɛ hɛ ko je kpakpa peemi kɛ ni kemi nɔ, ejakaa jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ saa Mawu hɛ mi saminya.
Nyɛɛ bu nyɛ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tue nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɔ ha mɛ; ejakaa mɛ lɛ a buu nyɛ klaa amɛ a he kaa nihi nɛ maa bu he akɔtaa, konɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ, se pi kɛ zanue lami, ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔ hi ha nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ, ejakaa wa ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa wa ngɛ he nile kpakpa, nɛ wa ngɛ hlae kaa waa ba wa je mi saminyayoo ngɛ nihi kulaa mi.
Nɛ i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ babauu kaa nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha mi, konɛ a kpale mi ha nyɛ mla.
Sɔlemi He jɔmi Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ je to ɔmɛ a hyɛlɔ ngua nɛ ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ je gbeje ngɛ neneene somi ɔ muɔ ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ e dla nyɛ ngɔ ha ni tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ni tsumi kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ pee e suɔmi nya ni, nɛ e gu Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ mi; lɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha kɛ ya si neneene kɛ neneene ɔ!
Amen.
Nyagbe sɛyemi Se, mamimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pɛtɛ munyu tumi kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ he, ejakaa munyu kpiti i ngma mane nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa a ngmɛɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo he, nɛ ke e ba mla a, i kɛ lɛ maa ba ba na nyɛ.
Wa biɔ nyɛ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kulaa kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpe.
Ninɛmɛ nɛ je Italia a ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Yakobo, nɛ ji Mawu kɛ Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, ngma ya ha wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ gbɛ fia a: Nyɛ he manye!
Hemi kɛ yemi kɛ nilemi Mamimɛ, ke nyɛ sɛ ka slɔɔtohi fuu a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ kaa bua jɔmi sɔuu; ejakaa nyɛ le kaa kami nɛ a kaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tsɛɛ tsui si tomi kɛ baa.
Nyɛ ha tsui si tomi ɔ nɛ gbe e nitsumi nya kɛ pi si, konɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si, nɛ nyɛɛ su, nɛ e ko piɛ nyɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Se ke e hia nyɛ ti nɔ ko ni lemi ɔ, e kpa Mawu nɛ haa nihi kulaa faa kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ e ka we nɔ hɛ mi ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ngɔ ha lɛ.
Se e kpa pɛɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi, nɛ e ko je nɔ́, ejakaa nɔ jelɔ ɔ e ngɛ kaa oslɔke nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ yaa kɛ baa.
Jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ko ko susu kaa e ma na nɔ́ ko kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi; juɛmi enyɔenyɔtsɛ ko nyɛɛ we tutuutu ngɛ e blɔhi a nɔ.
Ohia kɛ ninami Nyɛmi nɛ ji ohiafo ɔ, e fia ke Mawu wo e nɔ ɔ, nɛ niatsɛ ɔ, e fia ke Mawu ba lɛ si, ejakaa e ma ngla kaa nga mi mɔmɔ.
Ejakaa pu tee si nɛ e tsoo nɛ e gbliɔ nga a, nɛ e mɔmɔ ɔmɛ wɔleɔ pueɔ si nɛ e fɛu ɔ puɛɔ.
Ja nɔuu niatsɛ hu hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Kami Agbaa nyumu nɛ toɔ e tsui si ngɛ ka mi, ejakaa ke a ka lɛ nɛ e nyɛ nya da a, e ma na wami jlasi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo he si ha ninɛmɛ nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ. Ke a ka nɔ ko ɔ, e ko de ke: ‘Mawu ngɔ a je kɛ ka mi.’ Ejakaa Mawu ɔ a kɛ́ lɛ ngɛ ni yayamihi a mi, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e kɛ́ nɔ ko.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e kɔnɔ nɛ gblaa lɛ nɛ mlɔɔ lɛ ɔ lɛ kaa lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ akɔnɔ ɔ, ke e ngɔ ho ɔ, e fɔɔ yayami, nɛ yayami hu, ke e wa a, e fɔɔ gbenɔ.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a mlɔɔ nyɛ, mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ.
Dloomi ni kpakpahi kulaa kɛ nike ni nɛ hi kɛ pi si kulaa a, hiɔwe e jee kɛ kpleɔ si, kɛ jee Mawu nɛ ji lahi a tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɔ nɛ mi nɛ su tsakemi kɛ plɛmi ko be ɔ. Lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya a kɛ anɔkuale munyu ɔ fɔ wɔ, konɛ waa pee e nibɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi kekleekle yiblii.
Numi kɛ peemi Mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ kai enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ ko je nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ he nɛ sɔ kɛ nɔ numi, e humi si kɛ munyu tumi, e muklii mi nɛ ko fu mla.
Ejakaa nyumu muklii mi fumi tsu we Mawu dami nya ni.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ sake mu ni tsumi kɛ subai yayamihi kulaa ngɔ pue he, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami nɛ he munyu ɔ nɛ a du ngɛ nyɛ mi nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma he nyɛ klaa yi wami ɔ. Nyɛɛ pee munyu ɔ nɔ yeli, se pi munyu ɔ nuli kɛkɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he.
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ji munyu ɔ nulɔ kɛkɛ se pi e nɔ yelɔ hulɔ ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ hyɛɛ e hɛ mi su ɔ ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi; ejakaa e hyɛɛ e he, nɛ e jee kɛ yaa nɛ amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e hɛ jee bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ nɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ he yemi mlaa nɛ hi kɛ pi si kãii, nɛ e hɛ hii he be tsuaa be, nɛ e pi nɔ nɛ nuɔ nɛ e hɛ jee nɔ, se mohu e ji e nɔ yelɔ nɛ tsuɔ he ni ɔ, jamɛ a tsɛ ɔ Mawu maa gbaa lɛ ngɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi mi.
Se ke e peɔ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kaa Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ nɛ e kɔɛ e lilɛ mi ɔ, e ngɛ e he sisie, nɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɔ jami ɔ ji yaka.
Mawu jami nɛ he tsɔ nɛ he be mu ko ngɛ Mawu tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa a slaa ahusahi kɛ yalɔyi ngɛ a hiamihi a mi, nɛ e to e he nɛ je ɔ ko wo e he mu.
Hɛ mi hyɛmi he kɔkɔ bɔmi Mamimɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ nihi a hɛ mi hyɛmi ko futu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ ji hɛ mi nyami Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Ejakaa ke nyumu ko nɛ wo sika ga kɛ tade nɛ ngɛ fɛu ba sɛ nyɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ ohiafo ko hu nɛ wo tade yaya ba sɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ bu nɔ nɛ wo tade nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke: “Moo lɛɛ ba hi he kpakpa nɛ ɔ;” nɛ ohiafo ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke: “Moo lɛɛ da lejɛ ɔ,” aloo “Ba hi ye nane nya ngɛ hiɛ ɔ” ɔ, anɛ pi nihi a mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi yayami ngɛ kojoe nɛ ɔ lo?
Mamimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Anɛ pi je nɛ ɔ mi ohiafohi nɛ ji niatsɛmɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi blɔfami ɔ nɛ Mawu hla, konɛ matsɛyemi nɛ e wo he si ngɔ ha ninɛmɛ nɛ a suɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ e pee a nɔ lo?
Nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ gbee ohiafo ɔ he guɛ.
Anɛ pi niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ yeɔ nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ mɛ nɔuu lɛ a kpakaa nyɛ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔmɛ?
Anɛ pi mɛ nɔuu nɛ a gbee biɛ kpakpa nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ ɔ he guɛ ɔ lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ ye kita nɛ ji Mlaa a mi go nɛ deɔ ke: “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he” ɔ nɔ ngɛ ngmami ɔ nya a, lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee saminya.
Se ke nihi a hɛ mi nyɛ hyɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ yayami pee nɛ Mlaa a buu nyɛ fɔ kaa mlaa tɔli.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ maa ye Mlaa mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ tete, se e ma tɔ ngɛ kake mi ɔ, e tɔ kulaa nɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ de ke: “Koo bɔ ajuama” a, lɛ nɔuu lɛ de ke: “Koo gbe nɔmlɔ.” Nɛ ke o bɔɛ ajuama, se o gbee nɔmlɔ ɔ, mlaa tɔlɔ ji mo.
Nyɛɛ tu munyu nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ nihi kaa nihi nɛ he yemi mlaa a kɛ maa kojo mɛ.
Ejakaa kojomi mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ nɛ́ mɔbɔ ɔ, a be lɛ mɔbɔ nae; mɔbɔ nalɔ yi kojomi gbeye.
Hemi kɛ yemi kɛ ni tsumi Mamimɛ, ke nɔ ko ke e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, se e be ni tsumihi ɔ mɛni se nami lɛ ngɛ mi?
Anɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ma nyɛ e yi wami ma he lo?
Ke nyɛmi nyumu ko loo nyɛmi yo ko hɛɛ e he gu nɛ e nɛ e nya mi ngma, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ya de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi; nyɛ ya hlue la, nɛ nyɛ ya ye ni nɛ nyɛɛ tɔ” — se e ha we mɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hiae ɔ, mɛni se nami lɛ ngɛ mi?
Ja nɔuu hemi kɛ yemi hu, ke ni tsumihi be he ɔ, e ji hemi kɛ yemi gbogboe.
Se nɔ ko ma de ke: “Moo lɛɛ o ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ imi lɛɛ, i ngɛ ni tsumihi;” tsɔɔ mi o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ni tsumihi be he ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma je ye ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi ma tsɔɔ mo ye hemi kɛ yemi ɔ. Moo lɛɛ o heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu ɔ nɔ kake ʼi.
O pee saminya!
Mumi yayami ɔmɛ hu heɔ yee ja, nɛ a he doo kɛ gbeye yemi.
Oo, kuasia, o ngɛ hlaɔ nɛ o le kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ni tsumihi be he ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi gbogboe ʼi lo?
Wa tsɛ Abraham ɔ, anɛ pi ni tsumihi a nɔ nɛ a da kɛ wo lɛ nguɔ, benɛ e kɛ e bi Isak ya fɔ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ lo?
Tse o na kaa hemi kɛ yemi kɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ, nɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi e je nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ hi kɛ pi si ɔ nɛ, nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke: “Nɛ Abraham he Mawu nɛ ɔ ye nɛ a bu enɛ ɔ dami ha lɛ” ɔ ba mi, nɛ a tsɛ lɛ ke “Mawu huɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ na kaa ni tsumihi a mi a jee kɛ woɔ nɔmlɔ nguɔ, se pi hemi kɛ yemi kɛkɛ mi.
Ja nɔuu Rahab, ajuama a hu, anɛ pi ni tsumihi a nɔ nɛ a da kɛ wo lɛ nguɔ, benɛ e he bɔfo ɔmɛ atuu nɛ e je mɛ blɔ kɛ gu blɔ kpa nɔ ɔ lo?
Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ mumi be mi ɔ ji gbogboe ɔ, ja nɔuu hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ni tsumihi be he ɔ ji hemi kɛ yemi gbogboe.
Lilɛ Mamimɛ, nyɛ fuu nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he tsɔɔli, ejakaa nyɛ le kaa wɔ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, wa kojomi nya maa wa.
Ejakaa wɔ tsuo kulaa wa tɔɔ fuu.
Ke nɔ ko tɔ we ngɛ munyu mi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ji lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ maa ye e nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ.
Ke waa kɛ okpɔngɔ nya mi dade woɔ a nya mi konɛ a bu wɔ tue ɔ, wa ma nyɛ kpaka mɛ kɛ ya he nɛ wa suɔ.
Oʼɛ, lɛhi hu, e ngɛ mi kaa a kle hluu, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa kpakaa mɛ, se kudɔɔ nyafii ko kɛkɛ a kɛ kudɔɔ mɛ kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ lɛ kudɔɔtsɛ ɔ suɔ.
Ja nɔuu lilɛ hu, e ji nɔmlɔ tso he nɔ ko nyafii, se efiãa ni nguahi, oʼɛ, la nyafii hu, nyɛɛ hyɛ hue abɔ sɔuu nɛ e saa!
Nɛ lilɛ ɔ hu la ʼi, wa he ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lilɛ ji ni yayahi a je nɛ bleɔ nɔmlɔ tso mluku ɔ kulaa.
E maa ma je mi si himi kulaa nya la kɛ la nɛ jee abosiami a je nitsɛ.
Nɔmlɔ nyɛɔ jɔɔ nga mi lohwehi kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ waa kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ wo mi ɔmɛ a su tsuaa su he; se lilɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ ko nɔmlɔ ko nyɛ we e he jɔɔmi; nɔ́ yayami nɛ plegeje nɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ duɔ nɛ gbee nɔ ʼi.
Lɔ ɔ nɔuu waa kɛ gbaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ Tsɛ ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ nɔuu hulɔ waa kɛ gbiɛɛ nimli nɛ a bɔ ngɛ Mawu subai nɔ ɔ. Nya kake ɔ nɔuu mi gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi jee.
Mamimɛ, enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e sɛ́ nɛ e baa ja.
Anɛ nyu hɛngmɛ baa nyu mua kɛ ngo nyu kɛ jee e hɛngmɛ kake ɔ nɔuu mi lo?
Mamimɛ, anɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ma nyɛ nu tso yiblii maa wo, aloo wai tso maa wo ngmɔkɔ?
Ja nɔuu kɛ́ ngo nyu ko be nyu mua nyɛe maa pee.
Ni lemi nɛ je hiɔwe Mɛnɔ ji ni lelɔ kɛ sane se kɔlɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti?
Ha nɛ e kɛ je mi bami kpakpa nɛ tsɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nitsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ kpoo peemi kɛ ni lemi mi.
Se ke hunga jemi yaya kɛ pɛ, kɛ he suɔmi ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko fia nɛ nyɛɛ ye lakpa ngɔ si anɔkuale ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a ni lemi nɛ ɔ, pi hiɔwe nɛ e je, se mohu zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɔ́ ʼi, he lo nya nɔ́ ʼi, mumi yayamihi a nɔ́ ʼi.
Ejakaa he nɛ hunga jemi kɛ pɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ sakasaka peemi kɛ ni yayahi kulaa ngɛ.
Se ni lemi nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ, kekleekle ɔ, e he tsɔ, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e he jɔ, e hɛ ka si, e buɔ tue, e hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ mɔbɔ nami kɛ yiblii kpakpahi, e ji nɔ́, e pee we osato.
Dami yiblii ɔ, nihi nɛ peɔ he jɔmi nihi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a duɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Je ɔ kɛ huɛbɔmi Jije tahi kɛ kunɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ je?
Anɛ pi nyɛ kɔnɔhi nɛ hwuɔ ta ngɛ nyɛ he ni ɔmɛ a mi ɔ mi nɛ a je lo?
Nihi peɔ nyɛ akɔnɔ, se nyɛ na we; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ gbee nɔ; nyɛ jee hunga, se nyɛ nine nyɛ we nɔ nɛ e su; lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ nɔɔ kunɔ nɛ nyɛ pɛɛ; nyɛ na we nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ kpa we he pɛɛ.
Nyɛ kpaa pɛɛ, nɛ nyɛ na we, ejakaa nyɛ kpaa pɛɛ yaya konɛ nyɛ kpata ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ kɔnɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Gbapuɛli!
Nyɛ li kaa je nɛ ɔ kɛ huɛbɔmi ɔ Mawu nyɛmi ʼi lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɛ e kɛ je ɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ ɔ, e ji Mawu henyɛlɔ.
Aloo nyɛ susu kaa yaka nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ke: “Hunga jemi se mumi nɛ hii wa mi ɔ dii” ɔ?
Se Mawu dloɔ nɔ babauu.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke: “Mawu ɔ, e kuɔ he woli a nya, se he si bali e dloɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Mawu; nyɛɛ te si ngɔ wo Abosiami, nɛ e maa tu nyɛ nya fo.
Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ su Mawu he, nɛ e maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su nyɛ he Nyɛ fɔ nyɛ dɛ, nyɛ yayami peeli, nɛ nyɛ ha nyɛ tsui he nɛ tsɔ, nyɛ juɛmi enyɔenyɔtsɛmɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ, nyɛɛ wo ya nɛ nyɛ fo; nyɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ plɛ kɔmɔ yemi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ hu nɛ plɛ hɛ mi si puemi.
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ma wo nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛmi kojomi he kɔkɔbɔmi Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi a he sieku, mamimɛ.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ e nyɛmi he munyu aloo e kojoɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, Mlaa a e ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ sie, nɛ Mlaa a e ngɛ kojoe ɔ nɛ.
Ke o ngɛ Mlaa a kojoe, ɔ pi Mlaa a nɔ yelɔ ji mo, se Mlaa a kojolɔ mohu ji mo.
Nɔ kake ji mlaa wolɔ kɛ kojolɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami nɛ e kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi hulɔ; se moo lɛɛ, mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kojoɔ o nyɛmi?
Fiami he kɔkɔbɔmi Jehanɛ, nyɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke: “Mwɔnɛ loo hwɔɔ ɔ wa maa ya kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ loo kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ wa ya ye jeha kake ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ wa ya ye jua, nɛ wa na se,” kpahu nyɛ li hwɔɔ sane.
Ejakaa mɛni ji nyɛ wami ɔ?
E ji afua nɛ woɔ be bɔɔ ko, nɛ ke pee se ɔ e laa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa mohu nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke: “Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ nɛ wa yi na wami ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ wa maa pee enɛ ɔ loo enɛ.” Se jehanɛ nyɛ fiaa ngɛ nyɛ he womi ɔmɛ a mi; kikɛmɛ a fiami nɛ ɔ kulaa a yayami ʼi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ le kpakpa peemi nɛ e pee we ɔ, e ji yayami ha lɛ.
Kɔkɔbɔmi ha niatsɛmɛ Jehanɛ, nyɛ niatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue, nyɛ fo ya nɛ nyɛ wɔ lele ngɛ dengmehi nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔmɛ a he!
Nyɛ ni babauu ɔ sa, nɛ nyɛ tade ɔmɛ hu wɔyewɔyehi ye.
Nyɛ sika tsu kɛ nyɛ sika hiɔ ɔmɛ nɔ kana, nɛ a he kana amɛ maa ye nyɛ he odase, nɛ e maa sã nyɛ he womi mi kaa la.
Nyɛ bua juetli nya ngɔ to ngɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi.
Oʼɛ, ni tsuli nɛ kpa nyɛ ngmɔ ni nɛ nyɛ wui mɛ hiɔ ngɛ sisimi nya a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae, nɛ nihi nɛ bua nyɛ ni ɔmɛ a nya amɛ a ngmlaa a sɛ Asafo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tue mi.
Nyɛ ye nyɛ nya ni ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ho ya.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ tsui hluu kɛ ya su gbemi ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ bu dalɔ ɔ fɔ, nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ, nɛ e tsi we nyɛ nya.
Tsuisitomi kɛ sɔlemi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ mamimɛ, nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si, kɛ ya su Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ hulɔ ɔ mlɛɔ zugba a ni bami nɛ he jua wa, nɛ e toɔ e tsui si ngɛ he kɛ ya suu be nɛ gbo kɛ gbiɛ nyu nɛɛ ɔ; nyɛ hu nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si; nyɛɛ da si tutuutu, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ su ta.
Mamimɛ, nyɛ ko pia nyɛ sibi konɛ Mawu ko kojo nyɛ.
Oʼɛ, kojolɔ ɔ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya.
Mamimɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ gbali nɛ tu munyu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ ngɔ pee amanehlu kɛ tsui si tomi nɔ hyɛmi nɔ.
Wa tsɛɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ toɔ a tsui si ɔ ke nihi nɛ a gbaa.
Nyɛ nu Hiob tsui si tomi ɔ he, nɛ nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ to lɛ ha ngɛ nyagbe mi ɔ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi saa lɛ babauu nɛ e muklii mi jɔ hulɔ.
Se titli ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛ ko ka kita, hiɔwe jio, zugba jio, aloo kita kpa ko jio; nyɛ “Ee” nɛ pee ee, nɛ “Dɛbi” nɛ pee dɛbi, konɛ nyɛ ko sɛ kojomi mi.
Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ, e sɔle; kɛ nɔ ko bua jɔ ɔ, e la yi jemi la.
Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko be he wami ɔ, e tsɛ asafo ɔ mi nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi nɛ a sɔle ha lɛ, nɛ hemi kɛ yemi sɔlemi nɛ ɔ ma he hiɔtsɛ ɔ yi wami, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tle lɛ si, nɛ ke e pee yayami ɔ, a kɛ maa pa lɛ.
Nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle ngɔ ha nyɛ he, konɛ a tsa nyɛ.
Dalɔ sɔlemi nɛ mi wa a nyɛɔ nihi babauu tsuɔ.
Elia ji nɔmlɔ adesa kaa wɔ nɔuu, nɛ e sɔle sɔlemi ko konɛ hiɔmi ko nɛ, nɛ e nɛ́ ngɛ zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ kɛ hlami ekpa sɔuu.
Nɛ e kpale sɔle, nɛ Mawu ha hiɔmi nɛ, nɛ zugba a ba ni.
Mamimɛ, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko tla blɔ kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ mi nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ lɛ kpalee ekohu ɔ, ha nɛ e le kaa nɔ nɛ kpaleɔ yayami peelɔ kɛ jee e blɔ tlami mi ɔ ma he yayami peelɔ ɔ klaa yi wami kɛ je gbenɔ mi, nɛ e maa ha yayamihi fuu nɔ.
Petro nɛ ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, ngma ya ha nibwɔhi nɛ gbɛ fia Ponto, Kapodokia, Asia kɛ Bitinia a. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a hla, ngɛ Tsɛ Mawu ɔ yi mi tomi nya, ngɛ Mumi ɔ he tsukɔmi mi, kɛ ha Yesu Kristo tue bumi kɛ he fɔmi ngɛ e muɔ ɔ mi.
Dloomi kɛ hejɔmi nɛ e hiɛ fuu ha nyɛ!
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ hɛ ngɛ A gbaa Mawu kɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ fɔ wɔ ehe ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mɔbɔnami babauu ɔ nya, ngɔ ha hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ Yesu Kristo si nɛ ete kɛ je gbeje ɔ he.
Enɛ ɔ haa wɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ gbo si ni nɛ puɛ we, nɛ mu be he, nɛ kpa we, nɛ a ngɔ to ngɛ hiɔwe ha nyɛ ɔ he, nyɛ nihi nɛ a gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ buu nyɛ he ngɛ Mawu he wami nya ngɔ toɔ yi wami hemi nɛ a dla ngɔ to nɛ a ma je kpo ngɛ nyagbe be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ. Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ enɛ ɔ he, pohu e maa hia kaa nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ bɔɔ ko amlɔ nɛ ngɛ kahi slɔɔtohi a mi; konɛ a na nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi sami ɔ kaa e he jua wa babauu.
Sika tsu po nɛ puɛɛ ɔ, a kaa ngɛ la mi; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ he jua wa pe sika tsu ɔ hu sa nɛ a ka lɛ konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e hi si.
Lɛɛ, nyɛ nine maa su yi jemi kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu nɔ ngɛ Yesu Kristo kpo jemi ɔ mi, nɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ mohu, se nyɛ suɔ lɛ, nɔ nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu nyɛ nɛ lɛ mohu, se nyɛ he e nɔ ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ mi mi fliɔ nyɛ kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ nyami babauu nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale, ejakaa nyɛ nine maa su hemi kɛ yemi nyagbe nɛ ji nyɛ klaa amɛ a yi wami hemi ɔ nɔ.
Kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ gbali nɛ gba ngɛ dloomi nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ he ɔ hla se blɔ, nɛ a bi si; nɛ a kpale bi be ɔ si, be nɛ kɛ bɔ nɛ Kristo Mumi nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ je tsɔɔ, benɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ amanehlu nɛ maa ba Kristo nɔ kɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ maa ba ngɛ kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a se ɔ he odase yee kɛ ngɛ toe ɔ. Nɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ gbali ɔmɛ ke, tsa pi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ʼi, se nyɛ mohu nyɛ he nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nihi nɛ jehanɛ nihi nɛ jaje sane kpakpa a tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ a tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi tete hɛ jaa ngɛ he kaa a ko na mi.
Sihimi klɔuklɔu Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ juɛmi kɛ ha ni tsumi, nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ dloomi nɛ a kɛ ma ha nyɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo kpo jemi ɔ mi ɔ nɔ kulaa.
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he kaa bimɛ tue buli, nɛ nyɛ ko ba nyɛ je mi ngɛ sa benɛ nyɛ li nɔ́ ko ɔ mi akɔnɔ ɔmɛ a nya hu, se mohu ɔ, bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu ngɛ nyɛ je mi bami tsuo mi.
Ejakaa pa ngma ke: “Nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu ejakaa klɔuklɔu ji mi.” Nɛ ke nyɛ tsɛɔ nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nihi a hɛ mi se e kojoɔ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ni tsumi nya a ke nyɛ tsɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi nɛ ba nyɛ je mi ngɛ nyɛ wami be nɛ piɛ nɛ ɔ mi.
Nyɛ le kaa pi nihi nɛ puɛɔ, kaa juɛtɛɛ loo sika tsu, a kɛ kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ yakayaka je mi bami nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je nyɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ mi, se mohu, Kristo, nɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa to bi nɛ he be piami loo mu ko ɔ muɔ nɛ he jua wa a.
A hla lɛ momo sa loko a to je ɔ sisi, se e a je lɛ kpo ngɛ be ɔmɛ a nyagbe mi ngɛ nyɛ he.
Nyɛ gu e nɔ he Mawu, nɔ nɛ tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e wo e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ye, benɛ pee nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi kɛ nyɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ hi Mawu nɔ.
Jehanɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ tsukɔ nyɛ klaa amɛ a he ngɛ anɔkuale tue bumi mi ha nyɛmimɛ a he dɔmi nɛ lakpa be mi he je ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ tsui klɔuu nɛ suɔ nyɛ he saminya.
Ejakaa a fɔ nyɛ ehe, nɛ pi munyu nɛ puɛɔ, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we mi a je kɛ fɔ nyɛ kɛ gu Mawu hɛ kalɔ, nɔ nɛ hii si daa a munyu ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa “He lo kulaa ngɛ kaa nga.
Nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kulaa ngɛ kaa nga mi mɔmɔ.
Nga gbliɔ nɛ e mi mɔmɔ ɔmɛ wɔleɔ; Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ hii si kɛ yaa neneene.” Enɛ ɔ ji munyu nɛ a jaje tsɔɔ nyɛ ke Sane Kpakpa a nɛ.
Wami tɛ kɛ ma klɔuklɔu ɔ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ sake yayami tsuo kɛ kutupɔ tsuo kɛ osato kɛ ninyɛ kɛ nihi a he munyu tumi kulaa ngɔ pue he.
Nyɛɛ pee kaa bimwɔwi nɛ a fɔ he nɛ ngɛ mumi mi nyɔ nyu klɔuu hlae nɛ a nu, konɛ nyɛɛ wa kɛ na yi wami hemi.
Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ: “Nyɛ sa nyɛ nya Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mimijɔmi ɔ.” Nyɛɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa tɛ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ nimli kua lɛ mohu, se Mawu lɛɛ, e hla lɛ nɛ e he jua wa ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ hu, nyɛ ha a ngɔ nyɛ kaa tɛ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ a kɛ fia mumi mi sɔlemi tsu nɛ nyɛɛ pee osɔfohi a weku konɛ nyɛɛ sã mumi mi bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ.
Ejakaa e ngɛ ngmami ɔ mi ke: “Oʼɛ, i kɛ kɔ nya tɛ ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion, Tɛ nɛ a hla nɛ he jua wa, Nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ e nɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, tɛ nɛ ɔ he jua wa ha nyɛ; se ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ, “tɛ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ kua a, kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ plɛ kɔ nya tɛ kɛ si tɛmi tɛ kɛ nane kpatami tɛ sa ha mɛ.” Nɛ ngmami kpã ko hu de ke: “Enɛ ɔ ji si tɛmi tɛ Kɛ nane kpatami tɛ sa ha mɛ.” Ejakaa akɛnɛ a bui munyu ɔ tue he je ɔ, a tɛ si nɛ kɔlɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu to ha mɛ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, weku nɛ a hla ji nyɛ, matsɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ osɔlohi, je ma klɔuklɔu, ma nɛ e ngɔ pee e nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ jaje nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ je diblii ɔ mi kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e nyakpɛ la a he ɔ agbo jemi ɔ. Sa a, nyɛ pi ma, se jehanɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ji nyɛ; sa a, a nɛ nyɛ mɔbɔ, se jehanɛ ɔ, a na nyɛ mɔbɔ.
Mawu nyɔguɛhi Mamimɛ, i ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe kaa nibwɔhi kɛ blɔ hiali kaa nyɛɛ nyɛ he lo se dimi nihi nɛ kɛ klaa hwuɔ ta, nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya ngɛ maje li a bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, konɛ nɔ́ mi nɛ a tuɔ nyɛ he munyu ngɛ kaa yayami peeli ɔ, nyɛ ni tsumi kpakpahi nɛ a naa a, a kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ e bami ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nimli a blɔ nya tomi tsuaa blɔ nya tomi, ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he, matsɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ jio, amlaalofohi nɛ e tsɔ ngɛ yayami peeli a tue gblami he kɛ kpakpa peeli a yi jemi he ɔ jio.
Ejakaa ja ji Mawu suɔmi nya ni, kaa nyɛɛ kɛ kpakpa peemi nɛ tsi nihi nɛ be yi mi ɔmɛ a kuasia peemi ɔ nya.
Kaa sodehehi, se pi ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ odehe yemi nɛ ɔ kɛ peɔ yayami nɔ hami nɔ, se mohu kaa Mawu sɔmɔli.
Nyɛɛ bu nɔ tsuaa nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ; nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye; nyɛɛ bu matsɛ.
Kristo amanehlu ɔ kaa nɔhyɛmi nɔ́ Sɔmɔli, nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi tsuo nɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ, pi nimli kpakpahi kɛ mi mi hili kɛkɛ, se mohu nimli yayamihi hulɔ.
Ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji dloomi ke Mawu he nilemi he je nɛ nɔ ko nyɛɔ nidɔ ni nya daa, nɛ e naa amanehlu nɛ sɛ ɔ. Ejakaa ke nyɛ tɔ nɛ a fia nyɛ ni ngɛ he, nɛ nyɛ to nyɛ tsui si ngɛ mi ɔ, mɛni se nami lɛ ngɛ mi?
Se ke nɔ́ kpakpa nyɛ pee nɛ nyɛ na amanehlu ngɛ he, nɛ nyɛ to nyɛ tsui si ngɛ mi ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔ ji dloomi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Enɛ nɔuu he nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ, ejakaa Kristo hu na amanehlu ha nyɛ nɛ e kɛ to okadi kɛ fɔ̃ si ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e nane ma he ɔmɛ a se, lɛ nɔ nɛ e pee we yayami nɛ jeha nɛ hu lakpa ko ji e nya mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ benɛ a ngɛ lɛ jɛe ɔ, e jɛ we nɔ ko tui nane mi, benɛ e ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e gbiɛ́ nɔ ko, se mohu e tu e sane ngɔ wo nɔ nɛ kojoɔ dami nya a dɛ mi.
Yesu nitsɛ tloo wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hi kɛ ya sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ, konɛ wa gbo ha yayami nɛ wa hɛ hi ngmengmle ha dami, nɔ nɛ he pahi nɛ a kɛ tsa nyɛ ɔ. Ejakaa jinɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ laa, se jeha-nɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ klaa amɛ a lɛlɔ kɛ nɔhyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔ.
Yigbayi kɛ hunomɛ Ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ yigbayi ɔmɛ hu, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hunomɛ, konɛ ke ni komɛ he we munyu ɔ yi tete po ɔ, a si munyu ɔ se nɛ a gu yi ɔmɛ a je mi bami nɔ nɛ nine nɛ su a nɔ, ejakaa a naa nyɛ je mi bami nɛ he tsɔmi kɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ mi ɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ yi gbɔmi kɛ sika ni womi kɛ tade womi nɛ ko lua nyɛ he, se mohu nyɛ he fɛu ɔ, a na ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, ngɛ mumi nɛ he jɔ nɛ ngɛ kpoo nɛ puɛ we ɔ mi, kɔlɔ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ he jua wa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Ejakaa sa a, jã yi klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hu nɛ hɛ ngɛ Mawu nɔ ɔ dla a he, nɛ a ba a he si ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hunomɛ; kaa bɔ nɛ Sara bu Abraham tue nɛ e tsɛ lɛ e nyɔmtsɛ tete ɔ; Sara bi yihi ji nyɛ ke nyɛ peɔ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ yi haomi ko gbeye ɔ. Nyɛ, hunomɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ ni lemi nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bu nɛ bu yo ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ he wɛ tsɔ ko, akɛnɛ a kɛ nyɛ tsuo ji wami dloomi ɔ ni yeli ɔ, konɛ a ko tsi nyɛ sɔlemi ɔmɛ a blɔ.
Kpakpapeemi he nɔnami Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ mi mi nɛ jɔ ha nyɛ sibi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si.
Nyɛɛ kɛ yayami ko ma yayami nane mi aloo jɛmi ngɛ jɛmi nane mi, se mohu nyɛɛ gbaa, ejakaa nyɛ le kaa enɛ ɔ he nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ nine nɛ su gbaami ɔ nɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ: “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ e na wami Nɛ e na ligbi kpakpahi ɔ, E kɔ e lilɛ mi Nɛ e ko ye lakpa.
E sa e he kɛ je yayami he nɛ e pee kpakpa.
E hla he jɔmi nɛ e nyɛɛ kɔlɔ ɔ se.
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛngmɛ ngɛ dali a he, Nɛ e buɔ a pɛɛ kpamihi tue; Se nihi nɛ peɔ ni yayamihi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je e hɛ̃ ka mɛ.” Nɛ ke nyɛ bɔɔ nɔ kpakpa peemi he mɔde ɔ, mɛnɔ maa pee nyɛ yayami?
Se ke dami he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae tete po ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ!
Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ko hao hulɔ, se Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi.
Nyɛ dla nyɛ he ngɔ to daa nɛ, konɛ ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ sisi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ nyɛ lɛ heto nɛ nyɛ ha; se nyɛɛ pee kɛ mi mi jɔmi kɛ bu.
Nyɛɛ hɛɛ he nile kpakpa, konɛ nɔ mi nɛ a tu nyɛ he munyu ngɛ kaa yayami peeli ɔ, zo nɛ gbe nihi nɛ gbe nyɛ je mi bami kpakpa nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ he guɛ ɔ. Ejakaa ke Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ na amanehlu ɔ, e hi mohu kaa nyɛ maa na kaa kpakpa peeli pe nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa yayami peeli.
Ejakaa Kristo nitsɛ hu na amanehlu si kake nyɔngloo ngɛ yayamihi a he, lɛ dalɔ ɔ, ngɛ nihi nɛ dɛ ɔmɛ a nane mi, konɛ e kɛ wɔ nɛ ya Mawu ngɔ.
A gbe lɛ ngɛ he lo blɔfami mohu, se a ha lɛ wami ngɛ mumi blɔfami.
Nɛ lɛ Mumi ɔ nɔuu mi e gu kɛ ya mumihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu mi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya fiɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ blema a, a bui Mawu tue benɛ e to e tsui si nɛ e mlɛ mɛ hluu ngɛ Noa be ɔmɛ a mi, benɛ a ngɛ daka ngua a kpɛe ɔ. Nihi bɔɔ nɛ ngɛ deka a mi — nihi kpaanyɔ — aklaahi a yi wami a he kɛ gu nyu mi.
Enɛ ji baptisimi nyu ɔ he okadi nɛ a kɛ heɔ wa yi wami, nɔ́ nɛ pi he womi nɔ mu jemi, se mohu e ji he nile kpakpa somi nɛ e kɛ Mawu soɔ, kɛ guu Yesu Kristo si temi ɔ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ e hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ a ngɔ hiɔwe bɔfohi kɛ he blɔhi kɛ he wamihi ngɔ wo e sisi ɔ.
Wami he Akɛnɛ Kristo na amanehlu ha wɔ ngɛ he lo mi he je ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ jamɛ a juɛmi ɔ nɔuu nɛ mia kaa ta hwumi nihi, ejakaa nɔ nɛ na amanehlu ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e jɔɔ yayami peemi, konɛ be nɛ piɛ ha lɛ ngɛ he lo mi si himi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e ko hi si ngɛ nimli a kɔnɔhi a nya, se mohu ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nihi a nya.
Ejakaa wa puɛ be babauu ngɛ be nɛ be momo ɔ mi kɛ pee nihi nɛ wɔ jali ɔmɛ peɔ, nɛ wa ba wa je mi ngɛ ya homi, akɔnɔhi, da demi, fiɛmi sakasakahi, jiklɔɔ kɛ wɔ jami ninyɛ nihi a mi.
E peɔ wɔ jali ɔmɛ nyakpɛ kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ yɛ́ kikɛmɛ a sakasaka peemi titãa nɛ ɔ nɔuu mi nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tuɔ nyɛ he munyu yaya; se a maa bu akɔtaa ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ dla e he ngɔ to nɛ e maa kojo hɛ kãli kɛ ni gbogboehi tsuo ɔ. Ejakaa enɛ he je nɛ a jaje sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ni gbogboehi tete hu, ninɛmɛ nɛ a kojo mɛ ngɛ nimli a kojomi nya ngɛ he lo blɔfami mohu, se a hɛ maa hi ngmengmle kaa Mawu ngɛ mumi blɔfami.
Mawu nike nihi a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi Nihi tsuo a nyagbe ɔ su ta; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ juɛmi mi nɛ tsɔ nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si kɛ ha sɔlemi.
Se titli ɔ, suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ nyɛ he ɔ mi nɛ wa, ejakaa suɔmi haa yayamihi babauu nɔ.
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ sibi nibwɔ nɛ zanue lami ko hi mi.
Bɔ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ na dloomi ke ni ɔ, nyɛ kɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ he, kaa Mawu dloomi nihi slɔɔto ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi.
Ke munyu nɔ ko ngɛ tue ɔ, e tu lɛ kaa Mawu munyu; ke sɔmɔmi nɔ ko ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, e je he wami nɛ Mawu dloo lɛ ɔ mi; konɛ a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nihi kulaa mi, nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji nyami ɔ, kɛ he wami ɔ, kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene ɔ!
Amen.
Kristofono nɔnami Suɔli, nyɛ ko ha amanehlu la nɛ a kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae ɔ nɛ pee nyɛ sane slɔɔto ko, kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko slɔɔto ko lɛ ngɛ nyɛ pee ɔ, se mohu si abɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo amanehlu ɔ eko nae ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, konɛ e hɛ mi nyami kpo jemi ɔ mi hu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɛ nyɛ mi nɛ flii nyɛ.
Ke Kristo biɛ ɔ he nihi jɛɛ nyɛ ɔ, da gbaa nyɛ, ejakaa hɛ mi nyami Mumi kɛ Mawu Mumi ɔ kpleɔ si kɛ baa nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ko na amanehlu kaa awiyelɔ loo juɔ loo yayami peelɔ aloo nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ e he woɔ ni kpahi a sanehi a mi.
Se ke nɔ ko ngɛ amanehlu nae kaa Kristofono ɔ, zo ko pee lɛ, se mohu e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ngɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ he.
Ejakaa be nɛ a maa je kojomi sisi kɛ maa je Mawu we ɔ su ta.
Ke wa nɔ kekle e je ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ bui Mawu sane kpakpa a tue ɔ, kɛ a nyagbe maa pee kɛɛ?
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ, “Ke dengme loko a ma he dalɔ yi wami ɔ, Lɛɛ, nɔ nɛ yi Mawu gbeye kɛ yayami peelɔ ɔ, jije e maa da?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ninɛmɛ nɛ naa amanehlu ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a hu a tu a klaahi ngɔ wo bɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ a ya nɔ ngɛ kpakpa peemi mi.
Mawu asafo ɔ Jehanɛ, nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, imi nɛ ji nyɛ nyɛmi nɔkɔtɔma kɛ Kristo amanehlu ɔmɛ a he odase yelɔ nɛ ma na hɛ mi nyami nɛ a ma je kpo ɔ hu eko ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke: Nyɛɛ lɛ Mawu asafo nɛ a ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ, pi ngɛ nɔ nyɛmi nya, se mohu ngɛ suɔmi nya; jehanɛ hu, pi ngɛ se nami nɛ ngɛ zo he, se mohu tsui mi jɔmi nya; jehanɛ hu, pi kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ asafo ɔmɛ a nɔ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a sane, se mohu nihi nɛ toɔ okadi haa asafo kuu ɔ. Nɛ benɛ to hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ma je e he kpo ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su hɛ mi nyami jlasi nɛ ngla we ɔ nɔ.
Ja nɔuu nyɛ, jokuɛwi ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nikɔtɔma amɛ.
Nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɔ ha nyɛ sibi nɛ nyɛɛ wo he si bami kaa tade, ejakaa “Mawu kuɔ he woli a nya, se e dloɔ he si bali.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɛ Mawu nine nɛ he wa a sisi, konɛ e wo nyɛ nɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ haomi kulaa ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, ejakaa lɛ lɛ juɛii nyɛ he.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, nyɛɛ huɔ; ejakaa nyɛ he nyɛlɔ, abosiami ɔ, ngɛ si poe kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae ngɛ nɔ nɛ e maa mi hlae.
Nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ tsi lɛ blɔ, ejakaa nyɛ le kaa jamɛ a amanehlu ɔmɛ nɔuu nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi hu ngɛ nae.
Se dloomi tsuo kulaa Mawu nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba e neneene hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, ke nyɛ na amanehlu bɔɔ nɔ tã a, lɛ nitsɛ e ma dla nyɛ pɛ, nɛ e maa waje nyɛ, nɛ e maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ maa pi si.
Lɛ nɔuu a maa ngɔ nyami kɛ he wami ngɔ ha kɛ maa ya nenene kɛ neneene!
Amen.
Nyagbe sɛyemi I gu wa nyɛmi Silvano nɛ ji anɔkualetsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i buu lɛ ɔ nɔ ngma nyɛ bɔɔ nɛ ɔ i kɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe, nɛ i ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ se fiee kaa enɛ ɔ ji Mawu anɔkuale dloomi ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ da si ngɛ mi.
Asafo nɛ a hla ngɛ Babilon ngɔ piɛ wa he ɔ kɛ ye bi Marko hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛ nga nyɛ sibi kɛ suɔmi nya he fiɔmi.
Nyɛ he manye, nyɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ!
Amen.
Simon Petro nɛ ji Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kɛ bɔfo ɔ, ngma ya ha nihi nɛ nine su hemi kɛ yemi nɛ he jua wa kaa wa nɔ ɔ nɔuu nɔ, ngɛ wa Mawu kɛ wa yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo dami ɔ mi ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ Mawu kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he ni lemi ɔ mi!
Mawu nɔtsɛmi kɛ nɔhlami E mawu he wami ɔ ngɔ nihi kulaa nɛ hi ha wami kɛ Mawu jami ngɔ ke wɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ gu lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi nyami kɛ e himi nɔ kɛ tsɛ wɔ ɔ mi.
Blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ a gu nɛ a ngɔ si womi nguahi nguahi nɛ a he jua wa amɛ ngɔ ke wɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ gu kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ nyɛ na Mawu fɔmi su ɔ eko nɛ nyɛɛ tu je nɛ ɔ mi puɛmi nɛ ngɛ akɔnɔ mi ɔ nya fo.
Enɛ ɔ nɔuu he je ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɔde bɔmi tsuo nɛ ngɔ kpakpa peemi ngɔ piɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi he, nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyumu peemi ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi; se ngɛ nyɛ nyumu peemi ɔ mi hu ɔ, nyɛ je ni lemi kpo; nɛ ni lemi ɔ mi hu ɔ, hɛ si kami; nɛ hɛ si kami ɔ mi ɔ, tsui si tomi; nɛ tsui si tomi ɔ mi ɔ mawu jami; nɛ mawu jami mi ɔ, nyɛmimɛ a he dɔmi; nɛ nyɛmimɛ a he dɔmi mi ɔ, suɔmi.
Ejakaa ke kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ hiɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, e be hae nɛ nyɛ maa pee hejɔli aloo nihi nɛ wui yiblii ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he ni lemi ɔ blɔfami.
Se nɔ nɛ be kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ hɛyuyuilɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e nɛ́ tsitsaa ni, akɛnɛ e hɛ je nɔ kaa a fɔ e sa yayami ɔmɛ pue he ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ wa je nyɛ tsɛmi kɛ nyɛ hlami ɔ, ejakaa ke nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ ɔ, nyɛ be si gbee gblegbleegblee.
Ejakaa kikɛmɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ a maa gu kɛ ngmɛ nyɛ blɔ kɛ sɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo neneene matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma kai nyɛ daa nɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he, pohu nyɛ le momo nɛ nyɛ nane pi si ngɛ anɔkuale nɛ ngɛ ɔ mi.
Se be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ kikɛmɛ a bo tsu nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ɔ, i buu lɛ kaa e da kaa i kɛ kaimi nɛ tsɛ̃ɛ nyɛ hɛ; ejakaa i le ka aye bo tsu nɛ ɔ kpami maa pee oya, kaa bɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo hu je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mi ɔ.
Se ma bɔ he mɔde konɛ ye je mi jemi se ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ be tsuaa be.
Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ he odase yeli Ejakaa pi nyaziahi nɛ a sia ngɛ ga mi ɔ, se wa nyɛɛ kɛ jaje wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he wami kɛ e bami ɔ he sane tsɔɔ nyɛ, se mohu wɔ ji odase yeli nɛ na e hɛ mi nyami kpete-kpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ wa hɛngmɛ.
Ejakaa e na bu kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ, benɛ jamɛ a gbi ɔ je hɛ mi nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi ba e ngɔ ke: “Nɔ nɛ ji ye suɔmi bi nɛ i naa e he tsui ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ kikɛmɛ a gbi nɛ ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu kaa hiɔwe e je, benɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ. Nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa na gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ mi mami.
E maa hi ha nyɛ ke nyɛ bu tue, ejakaa e ngɛ kaa la ko nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ he ko nɛ wo diblii, kɛ maa su be nɛ je maa na nɛ nɔkɔ ɔ maa te si ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi.
Kekleekle ɔ, nyɛɛ le enɛ kaa nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e maa tsɔɔ ngmami ɔ mi gbami ko sisi kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e sisi tsɔɔmi.
Ejakaa gbami ko bɛ́ ngɛ nɔmlɔ suɔmi nya hyɛ, se mohu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ kpleɔ Mawu nimli klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a tuɔ munyu.
Lakpa tsɔɔli Lakpa gbali te si hyɛ ngɛ Israelbi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kaa bɔ nɔuu nɛ lakpa tsɔɔli maa ba nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti ɔ.
A kɛ hɛ mi kpatami tsɔɔmihi ma ba hɔ mi zaa, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ kpɔ mɛ ɔ po, a ma kua lɛ, nɛ a kɛ hɛ mi kpatami nɛ he ngɛ oya maa ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ nihi fuu maa nyɛɛ a ya homi ɔ se, nɛ a he ɔ, a maa tu anɔkuale blɔ ɔ he munyu yaya.
Nɛ a kɛ kutupɔ munyuhi maa jua nyɛ ngɛ hɛ tsumi mi, nihi nɛ kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, a kojomi hlua we si, nɛ a hɛ mi kpatami ɔ hu be mahɛ hwɔe.
Ejakaa Mawu ngɔɛ bɔfohi nɛ pee yayami ɔmɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e tsitsɛɛ mɛ wo gbeje muɔ mi, he nɛ a fi mɛ kɛ diblii kpa ngɔ to ha kojomi.
Mawu ngɔɛ blema je ɔ he ngɔ ki lɛ; se mohu Noa nɛ fiɛ dami sane ɔ kɛ ni kpaago ɔ kɛkɛ yi e baa; nɛ e kɛ nyu afua a ba nihi nɛ kua Mawu ɔmɛ a je ɔ nɔ.
Mawu puɛ Sodom kɛ Gomora ma amɛ, nɛ e sa mɛ kɛ la kɛ to odadi ha nihi nɛ ma kua Mawu ɔ. Nɛ e je Lot, dalɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ hao ngɛ nɔ tɔli ɔmɛ a ya homi je mi bami he ɔ kɛ je mi; ejakaa a mlaa tɔmi ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ dalɔ ɔ na nɛ e nu, benɛ e ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, pii e tsui nɛ da a daa nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le bɔ nɛ e peɔ nɛ e jeɔ dali ngɛ ka mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e peɔ nɛ e haa nimli yayamihi hii piimi mi kɛ maa su kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ, se titli ɔ, nihi nɛ nyɛɛ he lo se ngɛ he blemi akɔnɔ mi, nɛ a gbee Mawu nɔ yemi he guɛ ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsui wa, nɛ a woɔ a he, nɛ a bui hiɔwe bɔfohi tete, nɛ a tuɔ a he munyu yaya.
Pohu hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ po nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kle pe kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ kojo we mɛ kɛ he guɛ gbemi ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Se kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa lohwehi nɛ be juɛmi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ha numi kɛ gbemi.
A tuɔ nihi nɛ a li he nɔ́ ko ɔmɛ a he munyu yaya, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata kaa nga mi lohwehi; a kɛ nɔ nami maa wo mɛ nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a he hiɔ.
A buu kpo nɔ ya homi kaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɔ; mutsɛmɛ nɛ he ngɛ tai ji mɛ, a hoɔ ya ngɛ a blɔ laami ɔmɛ a mi benɛ a kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ni yee ɔ.
A hyɛ we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kaa ja yi ya holi, nɛ a hɛ jɔɛ kɛ yayami peemi; a mlɔɔ nihi nɛ nane pi si ɔmɛ; a ngɛ hɛ tsumi tsui; musu bimɛ ji mɛ.
A je blɔ nɛ da a nɔ, nɛ a tla blɔ kɛ ya nyɛɛ Bosor bi Bileam, nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ yayami peemi mi hiɔwo ɔ, blɔ ɔ nɔ; se lɛɛ, a kã e hɛ mi ngɛ e mlaa tɔmi ɔ he; teji nɛ tu we munyu ɔ kɛ nɔmlɔ gbi tu munyu, nɛ e tsi gbalɔ ɔ kuasia peemi ɔ nya.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa nyu vuhi nɛ nyu be a mi, bɔkuhi nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ yaa, nihi nɛ a kɛ diblii tsitsliitsli ɔ to ha mɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ. Akɛnɛ nya puu munyu nguahi jee a nya mi he je ɔ, a guu he lo akɔnɔhi a nɔ nɛ a kɛ ya homi mlɔɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ je wɔ jami mi kɛ we ɔ.
A woɔ mɛ si ke a maa ye a he, pohu mɛ nitsɛ mɛ ɔ puemi nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ, ejakaa nɔmlɔ peɔ nyɔguɛ ngɔ haa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ yeɔ e nɔ ɔ. Ejakaa ke a gu Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo he ni lemi ɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ tu je nɛ ɔ mi mu ni ɔmɛ a nya fo, nɛ lɔ ɔ ɔmɛ ami nɔuu a kpale du mɛ ngɛ, nɛ a ye a nɔ ekohu ɔ, a nyagbe si himi ɔ peɔ yayami pe kekle ɔ. Ejakaa afani nɛ a na we nɛ a le dami blɔ ɔ pe nɛ a le nɛ kɛ̃ ɔ, a kpale kɛ je kita klɔuklɔu nɛ a tu ngɔ wo a dɛ mi ɔ he.
Abɛ ɔ ba mi niinɛ ngɛ a he ke: “Gbe kpaleɔ e se kɛ yaa lɛ nitsɛ e vie he, nɛ kpotoo nɛ a du ha lɛ ɔ ya wuɔ mɔsɔ.”
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami ɔ he siwomi Mamimɛ, enɛ ɔ ji womi nɛ ji enyɔ sɔuu nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, nɛ lɛ tsuo mi ɔ, i kɛ kaimi tsɛ̃ɛ nyɛ juɛmi klɔuu ɔ hɛ.
I suɔ kaa nyɛ kai gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a munyuhi nɛ a tu sa a, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ yi wami helɔ ɔ kita nɛ bɔfohi nɛ a tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ. Kekleekle ɔ, nyɛɛ le enɛ ɔ kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nɔ he fɛu yeli maa ba kɛ he fɛu yemi, nihi nɛ maa nyɛɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔnɔ ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ma de ke: “Jije e bami ɔ he si womi ɔ ngɛ?
Ejakaa kɛ je be nɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbo nɛ ɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ nihi ngɛ kɛ je je ɔ bɔmi sisije mi ɔ, ja nɔuu a ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Pe a bua nɛ a jeɔ a hɛ ngɛ enɛ nɔ kaa hiɔwe ngɛ kɛ je blema lokoo, nɛ zugba hu je nyu mi, nɛ e gu nyu mi kɛ ba ma si ngɛ Mawu munyu nya; nɛ nyu nɔuu nɔ e gu nɛ nyu afua ngɔ jamɛ a be ɔ mi je ɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi kpata a nɛ.
Se hiɔwe kɛ zugba nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e munyu lɛ hɛɛ mɛ kɛ to ha la, nɛ a kɛ mɛ to kɛ yaa su kojomi kɛ nimli nɛ kua Mawu ɔ a hɛ mi kpatami ligbi ɔ.
Se, mamimɛ, nyɛ hɛ ko je sane kake nɛ ɔ nɔ, kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, ligbi kake ngɛ kaa jeha akpe, nɛ jeha akpe hu ngɛ kaa ligbi kake.
Tsa pi kɛmi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha e si womi ɔ se ngɛ kɛe, kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ buu kaa e se ngɛ kɛe ɔ, se mohu e tsui si e ngɛ toe kɛ ngɛ wɔ hae, ejakaa e sume kaa ni komɛ nɛ laa, se mohu kaa nihi tsuo a tsake a tsui.
Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ maa ba ka juɔ baa nyɔ mi, nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ, hiɔwe maa be kɛ ho kɛ huami wawɛɛ, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi sisije ni ɔmɛ maa sle ngɛ la mi, nɛ je ɔ kɛ e mi ni tsumi ɔmɛ maa sã.
Jehanɛ, akɛnɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata he je ɔ, mɛni nimli sa kaa nyɛ pee ngɛ je mi bami klɔuklɔu kɛ Mawu jami mi?
Sa nɛ nyɛɛ pee nihi nɛ hyɛɛ Mawu ligbi ɔ bami ɔ blɔ, lɛ be ɔ mi nɛ hiɔwe ma mle kɛ la nɛ e maa sã, nɛ je mi sisije nihi hu maa sle ngɛ la mi.
Se ngɛ e si womi ɔ nya a, wa ngɛ hiɔwe he ko kɛ zugba he nɛ dami hii mi ɔ blɔ hyɛe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mamimɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a blɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ kpɛti nɛ hi he jɔmi nɛ a na nyɛ nɛ mu loo piami ko ko hi nyɛ he ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ bu wa Nyɔmtsɛ tsui si tomi ɔ kaa yi wami hemi, kaa bɔ nɛ wa suɔmi nyɛmi Paulo ɔ hu ngma nyɛ ngɛ ni lemi nɛ a kɛ ha lɛ ɔ nya a. E tuɔ enɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu ngɛ e womi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.
E womi ɔmɛ a mi ni komɛ a sisi numi yee, nɛ nihi nɛ kase we nɔ́ ko kɛ nihi nɛ a nane pi si ɔ tsɔɔ sisi kpa, kaa bɔ nɛ a peɔ ngmamihi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ hu, kɛ kpataa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, mamimɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ le momosa he je ɔ, nyɛɛ huɔ, konɛ a kɛ nimli yayamihi a sisimi sane ɔ ko ba gbla nyɛ hu, nɛ nyɛ ba gbee si kɛ je nyɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Se nyɛ keke ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ yi wami helɔ Yesu Kristo dloomi kɛ ni lemi ɔ mi.
Lɛ nɔuu a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha jehanɛ kɛ daa.
Amen.
Wami Munyu ɔ Wa ngma nyɛ Wami Munyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ; nɔ́ nɛ wa nu nɛ wa na kɛ wa hɛngmɛ; nɔ́ nɛ wa hyɛ nɛ wa nine ta he.
Nɛ wami ɔ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ: nɛ wa na, nɛ wa yeɔ he odase, nɛ wa jajeɔ neneene wami ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ nɛ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ he sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ wa na nɛ wa nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa jajeɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ.
Se oʼɛ, wa huɛ bɔmi ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ ke e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ waa kɛ bɔɔ.
Wa ngɛ nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae konɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si.
Mawu ji la Enɛ ɔ ji bɔfo sane nɛ wa nu kɛ je e ngɔ nɛ wa kpale ngɛ jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ, kaa Mawu ɔ la ji lɛ, nɛ diblii ko be e mi kulaa.
Ke wa de ke waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ huɛ bɔe, se wa nyɛɛ diblii ɔ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ lakpa yee nɛ wa tu we anɔkuale.
Se ke wa nyɛɛ ngɛ la a mi, kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛ la a mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ wa he ngɛ huɛ bɔe, nɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo muɔ ɔ tsukɔɔ wa he kɛ jee yayami tsuaa yayami mi.
Ke wa de ke yayami ko be wa he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wa ngɛ sisie, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.
Ke wa jaje wa he yayami ɔmɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ kɛ dalɔ ji Mawu, e kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa wɔ, nɛ e maa tsukɔ wa he kɛ maa je nihi, nɛ dɛ blɔ kulaa mi.
Ke wa ke wa pee we yayami ɔ, lɛɛ wa ngɛ Mawu lakpatsɛ bue, nɛ e munyu ɔ be wa mi.
Kristo wa hepiɛlɔ Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, konɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami.
Se ke nɔ ko pee yayami po hu ɔ, wa ngɛ mi dalɔ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, Yesu Kristo, dalɔ ɔ; iɛ ji wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he kpatami nɔ́; se pi ngɛ wa nɔ́ ɔ kɛkɛ he, se mohu je mluku ɔ tsuo nɔ́ ɔ he hulɔ.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ waa kɛ maa nɔ mi kaa wa le lɛ, ke wa yeɔ e kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke: “I le lɛ,” nɛ e yi e kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ be e mi.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ e munyu ɔ nɔ ɔ, niinɛ, lɛ e mi Mawu suɔmi ɔ pi si ngɛ.
Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ leɔ kaa wa ngɛ e mi.
Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke e ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo nyɛɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e nyɛɛ ja nɔuu.
Kita he ɔ Mamimɛ, pi kita he ko nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, se mohu kita momo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ: Kita momo ɔ ji munyu nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ.
Se kɛ ɔ kita he i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, nɔ́ nɛ ji anɔkuale ngɛ Kristo mi kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ mi ɔ, ejakaa diblii ɔ ngɛ bee, nɛ anɔkuale la a ngɛ tsoe jehanɛ.
Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke e ngɛ la a mi nɛ e nyɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyami ɔ, diblii ɔ mi e ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e hii la a mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nane kpatami nɔ́ ko be e mi; se nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, diblii ɔ mi e ngɛ, nɛ diblii ɔ mi e nyɛɛ, nɛ e li he nɛ e yaa, ejakaa diblii ɔ yu e hɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, bimɛ tsɔwi, ejakaa a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ ngɛ Kristo biɛ ɔ he.
I ngɛ nyɛ ngmɛe, tsaatsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, nihewi, ejakaa nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.
I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, jokuɛwi, ejakaa nyɛ le Tsɛ ɔ. I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, tsaatsɛmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. I ngɛ nyɛ ngmae, nihewi, ejakaa nyɛ he wa, nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ hii nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.
Nyɛ ko suɔ je ɔ aloo nihi hu nɛ ngɛ je ɔmi ɔ. Ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, lɛɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔmi ɔ be e mi.
Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, he lo ɔ se dimi ni ɔmɛ kɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ se dimi ni ɔmɛ kɛ si himi ɔ mi he womi ɔ, ji Tsɛ ɔ mi, se mohu je ɔ mi e je.
Je ɔ bee kɛ yaa kɛ e mi se dimi ni ɔmɛ, se nɔ nɛ peɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e hii si kɛ yaa neneene.
Lakpa kristo Ye bimɛ, nyagbe ngmlɛfia a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kaa lakpa kristo ɔ ma, nɛ jehanɛ lakpa kristohi fuu ba, he je ɔ, wa le kaa nyagbe ngmlɛfia a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wa kpɛti a je kɛ ho, se kɛ ɔ, pi wa ti ni komɛ ji mɛ, ejakaa wa ti ni komɛ ji mɛ jinɛ a kɛ wɔ ko hi si; se a je benɛ pee nɛ a je a he si kaa tsa pi mɛ tsuo ji wa kpɛti nihi.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ na nu pɔmi kɛ je Nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ. Tsa pi kaa nyɛ li anɔkuale ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, se mohu kaa nyɛ le, nɛ nyɛ le kaa lakpa ko lakpa ko ji anɔkuale ɔ mi.
Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji lakpatsɛ?
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ deɔ ke pi Yesu ji Kristo ɔ. Nɔ nɛ kuaa Tsɛ ɔ kɛ Bi ɔ, lɛ ji lakpa kristo ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuaa Bi ɔ, e kuaa Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ heɔ Bi ɔ, e ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ, nyɛ ha kɔlɔ ɔ nɛ hi nyɛ mi.
Ke nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa hi Bi ɔ kɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ ji si nɛ Kristo wo wɔ ɔ nɛ; neneene wami ɔ. I ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae ngɛ nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a puɛ nyɛ tue ɔ he.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nu pɔmi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je e ngɔ ɔ hii nyɛ mi, nɛ e hia we nyɛ nɔ ko nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ni, se mohu bɔ nɛ e nu pɔmi ɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nihi kulaa, nɛ e ji anɔkuale se pi lakpa a, he je ɔ, bɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hi e mi.
Nɛ jehanɛ, bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ hi e mi, konɛ e puemi ɔ mi ɔ, wa na kã nɛ zo ko gbe wɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ e bami ɔ mi.
Ke nyɛ le kaa dalɔ ji Kristo ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ytsuɔ dami ni ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ.
Mawu bimɛ Nyɛɛ hyɛ suɔmi abɔ sɔuu nɛ Tsɛ ɔ kɛ suɔ nyɛ, kaa a tsɛ wɔ Mawu bimɛ nɛ wa ji nɛ!
Enɛ he ɔ, je ɔ li wɔ, ejakaa e li lɛ hulɔ.
Mamimɛ, jehanɛ ɔ, Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ, nɛ a na we nɛ a je bɔ nɛ wa maa hi ha a si; se wa le kaa benɛ Kristo ma pue ɔ, wa maa hi kaa lɛ, ejakaa wa maa na lɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ peɔ e he klɔuklɔu kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ hu e ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu mlaa nɔ tɔe, ejakaa yayami ji mlaa nɔ tɔmi.
Nɛ nyɛ le kaa Kristo je e he kpo konɛ e wo wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ho, nɛ yayami ko be e mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hii Kristo mi ɔ, e pee we yayami.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, e nɛ lɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu e li lɛ.
Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ.
Nɔ nɛ tsuɔ dami nihi ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ji dalɔ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ peɔ yayami ɔ, e je abosiami mi, ejakaa kɛ je sisije lokoo nɛ abosiami pee yayami.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu Bi ɔ je e he kpo konɛ e puɛ abosiami ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e pee we yayami, ejakaa Mawu su ngɛ e mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be yayami nyɛe maa pee, ejakaa Mawu bi ji lɛ.
Enɔ mi nɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ Mawu bimɛ kɛ abosiami bimɛ a kpɛti ɔ jeɔ e he si paa ngɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsu we dami nihi ɔ, nɛ e sume e nyɛmi hulɔ ɔ, pi Mawu bi ji lɛ.
Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi Ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji fiɛmi nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ kaa waa suɔ wa sibi; wa ko pee kaa Kain nɔ nɛ je nɔ yayami ɔ mi nɛ e gbe e nyɛmi ɔ. Mɛni he je nɛ e gbe e nyɛmi ɔ?
Ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ɔ yayami ʼi, se e nyɛmi ɔ nɔ ɔ da.
Mamimɛ, ke je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ko pee nyɛ yaa.
Wa le kaa wa po mi kɛ je gbenɔ mi kɛ ho wami mi ya, ejakaa wa suɔ wa nyɛmimɛ.
Nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi ɔ, e hii gbenɔ mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko be neneene wami ngɛ e mi.
Enɛ ɔ mi wa naa suɔmi ngɛ, kaa Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ wa he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ e sa kaa wɔ hu waa kɛ wa wami fɔɔ si ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ a he.
Ke nɔ ko na je nɔ mi ni, nɛ e na kaa e fi nyɛmi, nɛ e nga e tsui nyɛ wo lɛ ɔ, kɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ maa pee kɛ hi e mi kɛɛ?
Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛ ko ha waa suɔ nimli ngɛ munyu tutui mi loo ngɛ lilɛ nɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu ngɛ ni tsumi kɛ anɔkuale mi.
Mawu hɛ mi kãpeemi Enɛ waa kɛ maa le kaa anɔkuale ɔ mi wa je, nɛ wa ma tsɔ wa tsui ngɔ fɔ wa mi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Ke wa tsui buu wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu kle pe wa tsui, nɛ e le nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mamimɛ, ke wa tsui bui wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ ka ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa baa iɛ ɔ, wa naa kɛ jee e dɛ mi, ejakaa e kita amɛ ɔ, wa yeɔ nɔ, nɛ wa peɔ nihi nɛ sa e hɛ mi.
Nɛ enɛ ji e kitaa a nɛ, kaa wa he e Bi Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ nɔ ngɔ ye, nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo wɔ kita a. Nɔ nɛ yeɔ e kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii emi.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ waa kɛ leɔ kaa e hii wa mi ji mumi nɛ e ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ.
Anɔkuale mumi kɛ lakpa mumi Suɔli, nyɛ ko he mumi tsuaa mumi ngɔ ye, se mohu nyɛɛ ka mumi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa Mawu mi a je lo; ejakaa lakpa gbali fuu je kpo kɛ ba je ɔ mi.
Enɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma yo Mawu mumi ɔ: Mumi tsuaa mumi nɛ jajeɔ paa kaa Yesu Kristo ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e je Mawu mi.
Nɛ mumi tsuaa mumi nɛ jaje we kaa Yesu Kristo ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, pi Mawu mi nɛ e je, se mohu e ji lakpa kristo mumi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu e he kaa e ma a, nɛ jehanɛ tete e ngɛ je ɔ mi momo.
Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ je Mawu mi, nɛ nyɛ ye lakpa gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi; ejakaa mumi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ kle pe mumi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ je ɔ mi a je, lɔ ɔ he ɔ a tuɔ munyu kaa ninɛmɛ nɛ je je ɔ mi, nɛ je ɔ buɔ mɛ tue.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu mi wa je; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le Mawu ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ji Mawu mi ɔ e bui wɔ tue.
Lɔ ɔ waa kɛ naa anɔkuale mumi ɔ kɛ lakpa mumi ɔ. Mawu Suɔmi Mamimɛ, nyɛ ha waa suɔ wa sibi, ejakaa suɔmi ɔ Mawu mi e je, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ, nɛ e le Mawu.
Nɔ nɛ sume nɔ ɔ, e li Mawu; ejakaa Mawu ɔ suɔmi ji lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ mi Mawu suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ jee kpo ngɛ, kaa Mawu tsɔ iɛ nitsɛ e Bi kake ɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ waa gu e nɔ nɛ wa na wami.
Enɛ ɔ mi suɔmi ɔ ngɛ: pi kaa wɔ iɛ wa suɔ Mawu se mohu kaa lɛ nɛ e suɔ wɔ, nɛ e tsɔ e Bi ɔ ke e ba pee wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he kpatami nɔ.
Mamimɛ, ke Mawu suɔ wɔ kikɛ ɔ, esa kaa wɔ hu waa suɔ wa sibi.
Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ.
Ke wa suɔ wa he ɔ, Mawu hii wa mi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ hii kɛ pii si ngɛ wa mi.
Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ leɔ kaa wa hii Mawu mi nɛ lɛ hu e hii wa mi, ejakaa e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e Mumi ɔ eko ngɔ ha wɔ.
Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa na, nɛ wa ngɛ odase yee kaa Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ e Bi ɔ kaa je ɔ yi wami helɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jajeɔ paa kaa Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ, Mawu hii e mi, nɛ lɛ hu e hii Mawu mi.
Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa le, nɛ wa he Mawu suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ ye.
Mawu ɔ suɔmi ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ nɛ hii suɔmi mi ɔ, e hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii e mi.
Enɛ ɔ mi suɔmi ɔ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ ngɛ wa mi, konɛ wa na kã ngɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ; ejakaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, jã wɔ hu wa ngɛ ngɛ je nɛ mi.
Gbeye be suɔmi mi, se mohu suɔmi nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ fieɔ gbeye, ejakaa piimi ngɛ gbeye yemi mi, se nɔ nɛ yee gbeye ɔ, e na we nɛ e hi kɛ pi si ngɛ suɔmi mi.
Wa suɔ lɛ ejakaa lɛ kekle e suɔ wɔ.
Ke nɔ ko de ke: “I suɔ Mawu,” nɛ e nyɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ sume lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi nɛ e naa a, Mawu nɛ e nɛ́ ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ lɛ maa suɔ?
Kita nɛ ji nɔ nɛ waa kɛ je Kristo ngɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi hulɔ.
Je ɔ nɔ kunimiyemi Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ.
Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ fɔlɔ ɔ, suɔ bi ɔ nɛ e fɔ ɔ hulɔ.
Enɛ waa kɛ leɔ kaa wa suɔ Mawu bimɛ, ke wa suɔ Mawu nɛ wa yeɔ e kita amɛ a nɔ ɔ. Ejakaa enɛ ji suɔmi nɛ wa suɔ Mawu kaa waa ye e kita amɛ a nɔ; nɛ e kita amɛ a nya wɛ́, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a je Mawu mi kɛ fɔ lɛ ɔ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ kunimi; nɛ wa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ waa kɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ kunimi ɔ nɛ.
Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ kunimi ɔ, kaa ja nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ?
Yesu Kristo he odaseyemi Yesu Kristo ji nɔ nɛ gu nyu kɛ muɔ mi kɛ ba a nɛ; pi nyu ɔ mi kɛkɛ se mohu ngɛ nyu kɛ muɔ ɔ mi.
Nɛ Mumi ɔ ji nɔ nɛ yeɔ odase, ejakaa Mumi ɔ ji anɔkuale ɔ nɛ.
Odase yeli etɛ lɛ ngɛ, Mumi ɔ, kɛ Nyu ɔ, kɛ Muɔ ɔ; nɛ mɛ ni etɛ ɔ tsuo kake ʼi.
Ke wa he nimli a odase ɔ, Mawu odase ɔ kle pe kɔlɔ ɔ; nɛ enɛ ji odase nɛ Mawu ye ngɛ e Bi ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ, e ngɛ odase ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui mi; se nɔ nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ, ha e plɛ lakpatsɛ, ejakaa e he we odase nɛ Mawu ye ngɛ e Bi ɔ he ɔ yi.
Enɛ ɔ ji odase ɔ, kaa Mawu ngɔ neneene wami ngɔ ha wɔ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a wami nɛ ɔ peɔ wa nɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Bi ɔ, e ngɛ wami; nɔ nɛ be Bi ɔ e be wami hulɔ.
Neneene wami I ngɛ nyɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae konɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ biɛ ɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ ngɛ neneene wami.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ ji ka nɛ wa ngɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ, kaa, ke wa ba nɔ́ ko ngɛ e suɔmi nya a, e buɔ wɔ tue.
Nɛ ke wa le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wa baa lɛ ɔ e buɔ wɔ tue ɔ, blɔɔ wa le kaa nihi nɛ wa baa lɛ ɔ, wa nine su nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko na e nyɛmi nɛ e ngɛ yayami pee nɛ pi gbenɔ yayami ɔ, e bi Mawu, nɛ e ma ha lɛ wami, enɛ kɔɔ nihi nɛ peɔ yayami nɛ pi gbenɔ yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Gbenɔ yayami ko ngɛ, se pi enɛ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ dee ke e bi ɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔ yayami ʼi, se yayami ko ngɛ nɛ pi gbenɔ yayami.
Wa le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e pee we yayami; se mohu Mawu Bi ɔ buu e he, nɛ nɔ yayami ɔ tɛ e he.
Wa le kaa wa je Mawu mi nɛ je mluku ɔ tsuo ngɛ nɔ yayami ɔ sisi.
Wa le kaa Mawu Bi ɔ ba, nɛ e ba ha wɔ juɛmi konɛ waa le anɔkualetsɛ ɔ. Wa ngɛ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ mi, ngɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo mi; lɛ ji anɔkuale Mawu ɔ kɛ neneene wami ɔ. Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɛ hi ngɛ wɔhi a he.
Nɔkɔtɔma a ngma ya ha Awula nɛ a hia lɛ kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ i suɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi, nɛ pi ye nɔ kake kɛkɛ, se nihi kulaa nɛ a le anɔkuale ɔ, ngɛ anɔkuale nɛ hii wa mi nɛ e kɛ wɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ he.
Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je tsɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ jehanɛ e je Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo, Tsɛ ɔ Bi ɔ, dɛ mi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi mi.
Anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi I na bua jɔmi babauu kaa i na o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kaa a nyɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ wo wɔ kita a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ i ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae, Awula, pi kita he ko nɛ i ngɛ mo ngmae, se mohu nɔ nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ: kaa waa suɔ wa he.
Enɛ ɔ ji suɔmi ɔ nɛ, kaa waa nyɛɛ ngɛ e kita amɛ a nya.
Enɛ ɔ ji kita a nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ suɔmi mi.
Ejakaa sisili tuu ba je ɔ mi, nihi nɛ jaje we kaa Yesu Kristo ba ngɛ he lo mi; nɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ji sisilɔ kɛ lakpa kristo ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he saminya, konɛ nyɛ ko laa nihi nɛ wa tsu ɔ, se mohu nyɛ na hiɔwo nɛ sa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jee nɛ e hi si ngɛ Kristo tsɔɔmi ɔ mi ɔ, e be Mawu.
Nɔ nɛ hii Kristo tsɔɔmi ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ lɛ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ kɛ Bi ɔ. Ke nɔ ko ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ e hɛɛ we kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko he lɛ kɛ ba nyɛ we mi, nɛ nyɛ ko fɔ lɛ tete; ejakaa nɔ nɛ fɔɔ lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ pe ɔ kake ngɛ e ni tsumi yaya amɛ ami.
Nyagbe sɛyemi I ngɛ nihi fuu nɛ ma ngma nyɛ mohu, se i sume kaa i kɛ womi kɛ ningma nyu ngmaa, se mohu ye he ngɛ nɔ kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ba tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, konɛ wa bua jɔmi ɔ nɛ hyi.
O nyɛmi yo nɛ a hia a bimɛ ɔmɛ ke a biɔ mo.
Nɔkɔtɔma a ngma ya ha Gaio nɛ a suɔ ɔ, nɔ nɛ imi hu i suɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Mami nɛ i suɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ kaa o ya nɔ ngɛ nihi kulaa mi nɛ o he nɛ wa mo kaa bɔ nɛ i le nɛ o klaa hu ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa i na bua jɔmi babauu benɛ nyɛmimɛ komɛ ba nɛ a ba ye o nɔkuale ɔ he odase, bɔ nɛ o nyɛɛ ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ. Nɔ ko pee we mi bua jɔmi pe enɛ kaa ma nu kaa ye bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi.
A je Gaio yi Mami nɛ i suɔ, nɔ nɛ o tsuɔ kɛ haa nyɛmimɛ nɛ ji nibwɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, anɔkuale mi o peɔ ngɛ.
A ba ye o suɔmi ɔ he odase ngɛ asafo ɔ hɛ mi.
O maa pee saminya ke ɔ wo mɛ blɔ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo biɛ ɔ he ɔ, a je kpo kɛ ho, nɛ da he we nɔ ko ngɛ maje li ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa wɔ Kristofo ɔmɛ wa he kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ atuu, konɛ waa kɛ mɛ nɛ dla anɔkuale ɔ he ni tsumi ɔ. Diotrefe kɛ Demetrio I ngma womi kpiti ko ngɔ mane asafo ɔ, se Diotrefe nɔ nɛ hlaa nɔkɔtɔma yemi ɔ bui nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ke i ba hu, ma wo e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he sane nɔ, bɔ nɛ e tuɔ wa he munyu yaya, nɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tete pi ha lɛ.
Lɛ nitsɛ ɔ, e he we nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu nihi nɛ suɔ kaa a pee ja a, e tsiɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ e fieɔ mɛ kɛ jee asafo ɔ mi.
Mami nɛ i suɔ, koo kase nɔ yaya, se moo kase nɔ kpakpa mohu.
Nɔ nɛ peɔ nɔ kpakpa a, e je Mawu mi; nɔ nɛ peɔ nɔ yaya a, e nɛ Mawu.
Demetrio ɔ lɛɛ, nihi tsuo kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nitsɛ tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa, nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ e he odase yee, nɛ nyɛ le kaa wa odase ɔ anɔkuale ʼi.
Nyagbe sɛyemi I ngɛ nihi fuu nɛ ma ngma, se i sume kaa i kɛ ningma nyu kɛ ningma tso ngmaa.
Ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e piɛ bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ ma na mo, nɛ wa maa tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.
He manye!
O huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ke a biɔ mo.
Nga wa huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka ha wɔ.
Yuda, nɛ ji Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kɛ Yakobo nyɛmi ɔ ngma ya ha nihi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ nɛ a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ Tsɛ Mawu ɔ mi nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to ha Yesu Kristo ɔ. Mɔbɔ nami kɛ he jɔmi kɛ suɔmi babauu ha nyɛ!
Lakpa tsɔɔli Mamimɛ, akɛnɛ i ngɛ mɔde bɔe nitsɛ nɛ ma ngma nyɛ wɔ tsuo wa yi wami hemi ɔ he sane ɔ he je ɔ, i na kaa e sa nɛ ma ngma nɛ ma kɛ wo nyɛ he wami konɛ nyɛɛ plee hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi si kake nyɔngloo ɔ he.
Ejakaa ni komɛ ju si kɛ sɛ mi, nihi nɛ blema lokoo a je nɛ a ngma a he sane ngɔ fɔ si ha kikɛmɛ a fɔ bumi nɛ, nɔ yaya peeli nɛ ngɔɔ wa dloomi ɔ kɛ bɔɔ ajuama, nɛ a kuaa Mawu nɛ ji nɔ yelɔ kake pɛ ɔ, kɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ. Nyɛ le enɛ lɛɛ, se i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma kai nyɛ, kaa benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ je e ma a kɛ je Mizraim ɔ, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kpata nihɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi hu nɛ hɛɛ we mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma yemi ɔ mi, se mohu a je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a si himi he ɔ, e kɛ neneene kpahi fi mɛ ngɔ to diblii tsitsliitsli mi ha Ligbi ngua a nɔ kojomi ɔ. Nyɛ kai Sodoma kɛ Gomora kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle mɛ nɛ a bɔ ajuama nɛ a nyɛɛ he lo se hluu kaa bɔfo ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ; a neneene la ami hiɔwo nɛ a naa a ngɛ kaa okadi ko kɛ ha nihi tsuo.
Ja nɔuu ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu bleɔ he lo ɔ ngɛ a nlamihi a mi, nɛ a gbee Mawu nɔ yemi ɔ he guɛ, nɛ a tuɔ bɔfohi a he munyu yaya.
Se bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Mikael tete po, pee we enɛ.
E kɛ abosiami pɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ sa nya ngɛ Mose flu ɔ he.
Mikael gbiɛ́ abosiami kɛ musu bɔmi munyu ko, se mohu e ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ kã o hɛ mi!” Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ tuɔ munyu siɔ nihi kulaa nɛ a li, se nihi nɛ a le ngɛ a fɔmi su ɔ nya kaa lohwehi nɛ li ni ɔ, kɔlɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu lɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.
Musu tloo mɛ!
a ngɔ Kain blɔ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ a he ya wo Bileam sisimi he hiɔwo ɔ mi, nɛ Kora atua tsɔmi ɔ mi a hɛ mi kpata ngɛ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ woɔ nyɛ suɔmi niye ni ɔ he mu, ejakaa a kɛ nyɛ yeɔ ni nɛ zo pee we mɛ; a lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.
A ngɛ kaa bɔku nɛ nyu be mi nɛ kɔɔhiɔ kpakaa kɛ bɔleɔ si, tsohi nɛ a yi ba amɛ wɔle nɛ a wui yiblii; a gbo si enyɔ nɛ a hia mɛ kɛ a sipokuhi.
A ngɛ kaa wo mi oslɔkehi hulɔ nɛ ngɛ hamahama nɛ jeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zo ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pueɔ he.
A ngɛ ka dodoehi nɛ laa blɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu dla diblii tsitsliitsli ɔ ngɔ to kɛ yaa neneene ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ Henok nɔ nɛ ji nɔ kapaago kɛ je Adam nɔ ɔ gba ngɛ ke: “Oʼɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kɛ e klɔuklɔu bihi akpe nyɔngma nyɔngmahi abɔ, nɛ e maa kojo nimli tsuo, nɛ e ma ka nɔ yayami peeli ngɛ a ni yayami hi tsuo nɛ a tsu ɔ kɛ musu bɔmi munyu tsuo nɛ yayami peeli Mawu kuali tu ngɛ Mawu he ɔ he.” Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu yaya, sieku yeli kɛ nɔ piali nɛ nɔ muɛ́ a hɛ nɛ a nyɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔnɔ yayahi a se; a peɔ nya puu, nɛ a gbee nimli a yi mi ngɛ se nami he.
Kɔkɔbɔmi kɛ nitsɔɔmi Se, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kai munyuhi nɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔmɛ tu sa a; ejakaa a de nyɛ ke: “Nyagbe be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ he fɛu yeli nɛ nyɛɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔnɔ yaya amɛ a nya a maa ba.” Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ kɛ mi gbami baa a nɛ, he lo mi nimli nɛ be mumi.
Se, mamimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ ha nyɛ nane nɛ pi si ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ he ngɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ wa Mawetsɛ Yesu mɔbɔ nami ɔ blɔ, konɛ nyɛ na neneene wami.
Nyɛɛ na ninɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi peɔ mɛ kɔsikɔsi ɔ mɔbɔ: nyɛ je mɛ kɛ je la a mi.
Nyɛɛ na ni kpahi hu mɔbɔ kɛ mɔbɔ nami nɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ mi; se nyɛɛ hie sa tade nɛ a kɛ he lo akɔnɔ wo lɛ mu ɔ. Yijemi sɔlemi Lɛ, nɔ nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ maa bu nyɛhe nɛ nyɛ ko tɛ si, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ ya da e nyami ɔ hɛ mi nɛ piami ko ko hi nyɛ he ngɛ bua jɔmi mi ɔ, Mawu nɛ ji ni lelɔ kake kɛ wa yi wami helɔ ngɛ Yesu Kristo wa Mawetsɛ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje, nɔ yemi kɛ he blɔ kulaa ngɔ ha jehanɛ kɛ daa.
Amen.
Yesu Kristo kpo jemi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha lɛ nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nihi nɛ sa kaa e ba mi ngɛ be kpiti mi, nɛ e kɛ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ nɛ e kɛ ba tsɔɔ e sɔmɔlɔ Yohane, nɔ nɛ ye Mawu munyu ɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo odase ɔ he odase ngɛ nihi tsuo nɛ e na a he ɔ.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ kaneɔ ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ nuɔ gbami munyu ɔmɛ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔɔ nihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ɔ ngɔ toɔ ɔ, ejakaa be ɔ su ta.
Munyuhi nɛ a kɛ nga Asafohi kpaago ɔ Yohane ngma ya ha asafohi kpaago nɛ ngɛ Asia a: Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi ha nyɛ, kɛ je nɔ nɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa a, kɛ nɔ nɛ maa ba a dɛ mi, nɛ kɛ je mumihi kpaago nɛ ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ ngɔ, nɛ kɛ je Yesu Kristo, nɛ ji odaseyelɔ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ, ni gbogboehi a kpɛti kekleekle bi kɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔyelɔ ɔ dɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ tsukɔ wa he kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ngɔ wɔ pee matsɛmɛ a weku [kɛ] osɔfohi ngɔ ha e Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami kɛ nɔ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene!
Amen.
Oʼɛ, e ma kɛ bɔku ɔmɛ, nɛ hɛngmɛ tsuaa hɛngmɛ maa na lɛ kɛ nihi nɛ gbɔɔ lɛ ni ɔ hulɔ, nɛ zugba a nɔ weku ɔmɛ kulaa maa wo ya ngɛ e he.
Ee, Amen.
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa a, kɛ nɔ nɛ maa ba, nɛ ji ope ɔ, ke: “Ami ji Alfa a kɛ Omega a” (kekleekle nɔ kɛ nyagbe nɔ).
Kristo he ninami Imi Yohane nɛ ji nyɛ nyɛmi kɛ nyɛ huɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo amanehlu ɔ kɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ e tsui si tomi ɔ mi ɔ, i ngɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Patmo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Mawu munyu ɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo he odase yemi he.
Mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ nɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ngua ko ngɛ ye se kaa titimati nɛ de mi ke: “Ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ nae ɔ ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ o kɛ mane asafohi kpaago nɛ ngɛ Efeso, kɛ Smirna, kɛ Pergami, kɛ Tiatira kɛ Sarde, kɛ kɛ Filadelfia, kɛ Laodikea a. I plɛ ye he kone ma hyɛ gbi nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ. Nɛ bene i plɛ ye he ɔ, i na sika kane tsohi kpaago, kɛ nɔ ko ngɛ kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ sa kpɛti nɛ ngɛ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi, nɛ e wo tade klɔii nɛ e kɛ sika kpa fi e gugue; nɛ e yi kɛ e yi bwɔmi hiɛɛ kaa to he bwɔmi hiɔ, kaa snoo, nɛ e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ kaa la lilɛhi, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa ayawa klaiklai nɛ tsu ngɛ flɔnɔɔ mi, nɛ e gbi ngɛ kaa nyu babauu pɛmi.
Nɛ e hɛɛ dodoehi kpaago ngɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine mi, nɛ hiɔ kɛ e nya enyɔ nɛ nya mi ba je kpo ngɛ e nya mi, nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ kaa pu nɛ ngɛ tsoe wawɛɛ.
Nɛ benɛ i na lɛ ɔ, i nɔ si ngɛ e nane nyɛ kaa nɔ gbogboe; nɛ e kɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine fɔ ye nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke: “Koo ye gbeye; ami ji kekleekle nɔ ɔ kɛ nyagbe nɔ ɔ, kɛ hɛkalɔ.
I gbo, nɛ oʼɛ, ye hɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene, nɛ i hɛɛ gbeje kɛ gbenɔ nya safe ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ ngmaa nihi nɛ o na a, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ maa ba ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ: dodoehi kpaago nɛ o na ngɛ ye hiɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ laami sane ɔ, kɛ sika kane tsohi kpaago ɔ. Dodoehi kpaago ɔ ji asafohi kpaago ɔmɛ a bɔfohi, kɛ kane tsohi kpaago nɛ o na a ji asafohi kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Sɛ kɛ ha Efeso asafo ɔ “Ngmaa ya ha Efeso asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ke: “Nihi nɛ nɔ nɛ hɛɛ dodoehi kpaago ɔ ngɛ e hiɛ ɔ nine mi nɛ e nyɛɛ sika kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ o dengme gbomi ɔ, kɛ o tsui si tomi ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ o kplɛɛ we nimli yayami ɔmɛ a ni peepee ɔmɛ a nɔ, se ɛo ka nihi nɛ deɔ ke bɔfohi ji mɛ se a pi ja a, nɛ o na kaa lakpatsɛmɛ ji mɛ.
Nɛ o hɛɛ mi, nɛ o toɔ o tsui si, nɛ ye biɛ ɔ he ɔ, o bɔɔ mɔde, nɛ pɔ tɔɛ mo.
Se kɛ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane ko, lɔ ɔ ji kaa, o sume mi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi sa a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ kaii he nɛ o je kɛ nɔ si ɔ, nɛ o tsake o tsui, nɛ o tsu kekle ni tsumi ɔmɛ; se ke pi ja a, ma ba o ngɔ oya, nɛ ma je o kane tso ɔ kɛ maa je e ma he ɔ, ja o pia o he.
Se kɛ ɔ, o ngɛ enɛ, kaa o nyɛɛ Nikolaimɛ a ni tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ imi hu i nyɛɛ ɔ.
“Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ.
“Nɔ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ɔ, ma ha lɛ wami tso ɔ nɛ ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ Paradeiso ɔ mi ɔ nɔ yiblii ɔ eko nɛ e ye.” Sɛ kɛ ha Smirna asafo ɔ “Nɛ Smirna asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ kekleekleno ɔ kɛ nyagbeno ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbo nɛ e hɛ ngɛ ekohu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ o dengme gbomi ɔmɛ kɛ o hia a, — se kɛ ɔ niatsɛ ji mo — nɛ i le ni yayahi nɛ nihi nɛ deɔ ke Yudafohi ji mɛ se a pi ja se mohu a ji Satan kpe mi bimɛ ɔ deɔ ngɛ o he ɔ. Koo ye amanehlu nɛ o maa na eko eko gbeye, oʼɛ, abosiami maa ngɔ nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɔ wo tsu mi, kone a kɛ ka nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa na amanehlu ligbi nyɔngma.
Pee anɔkualetsɛ kɛ ya su gbenɔ mi, nɛ ma ha mo wami jlasi ɔ.
“Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ.
“Kunimi yelɔ ɔ, a be lɛ nɔ ko yaya ko pee ngɛ gbenɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi.” Sɛ kɛ ha Pergamo asafo ɔ “Nɛ Pergamo asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa yaha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ snɔ nɛ hɛɛ hiɔ kɛ e nya mi enyɔ nɛ nya ba a de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: I le he nɛ o hii ɔ, he nɛ Satan matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. O hɛɛ ye biɛ ɔ mi, nɛ o kua we o hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a mi po, bene a gbe Antipa, ye o daseyelɔ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, he nɛ Satan hii ɔ.
Se kɛ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane bɔɔ ko: ejakaa o ngɛ nihi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ hɛɛ Bileam nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ Balak kaa e tsɔ Israelbi ɔmɛ klama nɛ a ye nihi nɛ a kɛ sa bɔ ha wɔhi nɛ a bɔ ajuama a tsɔɔmi ɔ mi.
Ja nɔuu hu o ngɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ Nikolaibihi a tsɔɔmi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ tsakee o tsui; se ke pi ja a, ma ba o ngɔ mla, nɛ i kɛ ye nya mi hiɔ́ ɔ kɛ mɛ ma ba hwu ta.
“Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ.
“Nɔ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ɔ, ma ha lɛ mana nɛ a kɛ laa a eko nɛ e ye, nɛ ma ha lɛ tɛ hiɔ, nɛ tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ngma biɛ he nɛ nɔ ko li ja nɔ nɛ naa a.” Sɛ kɛ ha Tiatira asafo ɔ “Nɛ Tiatira asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ e hɛngmɛ ngɛ kaa la lilɛ nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa ayawa nɛ kpɛɔ nylamnylam ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kɛ o suɔmi ɔ kɛ o sɔmɔmi ɔ kɛ o hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kɛ o tsui si tomi ɔ, nɛ i le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kaa sekpɛ ni ɔmɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ tete.
Se kɛ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane ko, kaa o ngmɛ yo Yesabel nɛ tsɛɛ e he gbalɔ ɔ blɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ni, nɛ e mlɔɔ mɛ, nɛ a bɔ ajuama, nɛ a ye ni nɛ a kɛ sa bɔ ha wɔhi.
I ha lɛ be konɛ e kɛ tsake e tsui, se e sume nɛ e tsake kɛ je ajuama bɔmi ɔ mi.
Oʼɛ, i kɛ lɛ maa fɔ sa nɔ, nɛ i kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ puɛ gba a hu maa wo nɔ nami kpatekpleenyɛ mi, ja a tsake a tsui kɛ je e ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi.
Ma gbe e bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ asafo ɔmɛ kulaa ma na maa le kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ leɔ juɛmi kɛ tsui mi susumihi, nɛ ma wo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ e ni tsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ.
“Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee, nyɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ Tiatira a, nihi abɔ nɛ hɛɛ we tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ li ‘Satan muɔhi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ’ (kaa bɔ nɛ a deɔ ɔ) I kɛ tlomi kpã ko be nyɛ nɔ fɔe.
Se nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nyɛɛ hɛɛ mi ka ya su be nɛ ma ba.
Nɛ kunimi yelɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ hɛɔ ye ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya suu nyagbe ɔ, ma ha lɛ he wami ngɛ je ma amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ dade tso ma kpaka mɛ, nɛ e maa ywia mɛ kaa a ywiaa zu buɛhi, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i na kɛ je Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ɔ; nɛ ma ngɔ nɔkɔ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.
“Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ.”
Sɛ kɛ ha Sarde asafo ɔ “Nɛ Sarde asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu mumihi kpaago ɔ kɛ dodoehi kpaago ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ kaa o hɛɛ biɛ kaa o hɛ ngɛ, se o gbo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fo hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ o waje nihi nɛ piɛ nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbo ɔ. Ejakaa i nɛ o ni tsumi ɔmɛ eko nɛ hi kɛ pi si ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
Lɔɔ he ɔ kaii nɔ́ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo kɛ bɔ nɛ o nu ɔ nɛ o kɛ to, nɛ o tsake o tsui.
Se jehanɛ ke o hɛ tsɛ́ ɔ, ma tua mo kaa juɔ, nɛ o be lee ngmlɛfia nɔ nɛ ma ba a kulaa.
Se kɛ ɔ, o ngɛ nihi bɔɔ ko ngɛ Sarde, nihi nɛ wui a tade ɔmɛ mu; a kɛ mi maa nyɛɛ ngɛ tade hiɔhi a mi, ejakaa a sa ja.
Kunimi yelɔ ɔ, a maa wo lɛ tade hiɔ, nɛ i be e biɛ gbee ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi gblegbleegblee, nɛ ma wo e biɛ ta ngɛ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
“Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ deɔ ɔ. Sɛ kɛ ha Filadelfia asafo ɔ “Nɛ Filadelfia asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ David safe ɔ, nɔ nɛ bliɔ nɛ nɔ ko nga we, nɛ e ngaa hulɔ nɛ nɔ ko bli we ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: I le o ni tsumi ɔmɛ; nɛ oʼɛ, i bi sinya ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ o hɛ kpɛ, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga, ejakaa he wami bɔɔ ngɛ, se o ye ye munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ o kua we ye biɛ ɔ. Oʼɛ, i kɛ ni komɛ nɛ je Satan kpe he ɔ nɛ deɔ ke Yudafohi ji mɛ se e be mi ja, se mohu lakpa mohu a ngɛ yee ɔ maa ba o hɛ mi; oʼɛ, ma ha nɛ a ba nɛ a ba nu o nane nɛ a ja mo, konɛ a le kaa imi lɛɛ i suɔ mo.
Ejakaa o ye ye munyu nɛ deɔ ke o to o tsui si ɔ nɔ he je ɔ, ma baa o yi ngɛ ka ngmlɛfia nɛ maa ba je mluku ɔ kulaa nɔ nɛ a kɛ maa ka nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ mi.
Oʼɛ, i ma oya; pɛtɛ nɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ he nɛ wa, konɛ nɔ ko ko kpɔ o jlasi ɔ!
Kunim yelɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee Titima ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e be kpo jee hu, nɛ ma ngma ye Mawu ɔ biɛ, kɛ ye Mawu ɔ ma nɛ ji Yerusalem he nɛ jee ye Mawu ngɔ ɔ biɛ, kɛ mi nitsɛ ye biɛ he ɔ ngɛ e nɔ.
“Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ!” Sɛ kɛ ha Laodikea asafo ɔ “Nɛ Laodikea asafo ɔ bɔfo ɔ, ngmaa ya ha lɛ ke: “Nihi nɛ Amen ɔ nɛ ji odase yelɔ anɔkualetsɛ ɔ kɛ anɔkua leyelɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu adebɔ ɔ sisije ɔ de ji nɛɔ nɛ: I le oni tsumi ɔmɛ kaa o be yluduu nɛ o be kɛlakɛla hulɔ.
Oo, jinɛ o ko pee yluduu loo o ko pee kɛlakɛla!
Se kikɛ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ o ngɛ kulɔkulɔ nɛ o be yluduu nɛ o be kɛlakɛla hulɔ he je ɔ, ma la mo ngɛ ye nya mi ngɔ pue he.
Ejakaa o deɔ ke: ‘Niatsɛ ji mi nɛ i ngɛ ni, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi,’ nɛ o li kaa o ngɛ dengme mi nɛ o ni hu ngɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ ohiafo kɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ kɛ hegutsɛ ji mo, i ngɛ mo ga woe ke o he sika nɛ a tsu he ngɛ la mi kɛ je ye ngɔ, kone o na ni, kɛ tade hiɔ, kone o wo nɛ o he gu nɛ ngɛ zo ɔ nɛ ko fɔ si, kɛ hɛngmɛ tsopa nɛ o kɛ nga o hɛngmɛ nɔ, kone o hyɛ nɔ.
Imi lɛɛ, nihi abɔ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, i kãa mɛ nɛ i gblaa a tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o hɛ nɛ dɔ nɛ o tsake o tsui!
Oʼɛ i daa si ngɛ sinya a se nɛ i ngɛ sie; ke nɔ ko nu ye gbi nɛ e bli sinya a, ma ba e ngɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ ma ba ye ni nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ mi maa ye.
Kunimi yelɔ ɔ, ma ha lɛ blɔ nɛ e kɛ mi nɛ hi ye matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ye kunimi nɛ i kɛ Tsaatsɛ hii si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
“Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee o.”
Hiɔwe Ma wu jami Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ i hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, sinya ko nɛ a bli ngɛ hiɔwe.
Kekleekle gbi nɛ i nu nɛ ngɛ kaa titimati nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ke: “Kuɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nihi nɛ maa ba mi ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se.” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ Mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ oʼɛ, matsɛ sɛ ko maa si ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ, ke o hyɛ lɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa kaa yaspi kɛ sardi, nɛ alale bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ he, nɛ ke o hyɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa smaragde tɛ.
Nɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ sɛhi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ hii si ngɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; sa wo tade hiɔhi, nɛ sika jlasi fi a yi.
Nɛ oslaba gbami kɛ gbi kɛ hiɔwe simi je matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi, nɛ la hahi kpaago nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ ji Mawu mumihi kpaago ɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Nɛ nɔ́ ko kaa ahuhuɛ wo nɛ hɛ mi tsɔ kaa kristolo ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ nɛ hɛngmɛhi hyi a hɛ mi kɛ a se tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kpɛti kɛ e he kulaa.
Kekleekle hɛ kalɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa jata, nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa na, ne hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa kɔle nɛ e ngɛ tee.
Nɛ hɛkali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ ple ekpa ekpa, nɛ a he kɛ a mi tsuo hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ hɛngmɛ sɔuu, nɛ a jɔɔ we lami nyɔ kɛ pia ke: “Klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu ji Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, Nɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ maa ba a.” Nɛ benɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ ngɔ nyami kɛ agboje kɛ sina kɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene ɔ hae ɔ, nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ buɔ si ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene ɔ jae, nɛ a sakee a jlasi ɔmɛ ngɔ pueɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ a deɔ ke: “Wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa Mawu, mo ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa O ngɔ hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje kɛ he wami ɔ Ejakaa mo lɛ ɔ bɔ nihi kulaa, Nɛ o suɔmi nya a ngɛ nɛ a bɔ mɛ ngɛ.”
Womi ɔ kɛ Tobi ɔ I na womi kpo ko ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngma ni ngɛ e mi kɛ e se tsuo, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ nya sɔumi ni kpaago.
Nɛ i na bɔfo ngua ko nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe kɛ gbi ngua ke: “Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa e bli womi ɔ nya nɛ e tsɔ e nya sɔumi ni ɔmɛ?” Se nɔ ko nɔ ko be hiɔwe loo zugba a nɔ loo zugba a sisi nɛ ma nyɛ womi ɔ nya nɛ e bli loo nɛ e hyɛ mi.
Nɛ i fo ya hluu, ejakaa a nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ sa kaa e bli womi ɔ nya nɛ e kane loo nɛ e hyɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake de mi ke: “Ko fo ya!
oʼɛ jata a nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji David nina a, ye kunimi, nɛ e bli womi ɔ nya, nɛ e tsɔ e nya sɔumi ni kpaago ɔ.” Nɛ i hyɛ nɛ oʼɛ, matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, Tobi ko daa si kaa nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ koli kpaago kɛ hɛngmɛ kpaago nɛ ji Mawu mumi kpaago ɔ nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ. Nɛ Tobi ɔ ba, nɛ e ba he womi kpo ɔ kɛ je nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɛ ɔ nine mi.
Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ womi ɔ hee ɔ, hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔ kɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ bu si ngɛ Tobi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ kpã saku kɛ sika tɔhi kɛ a mi tsopa kɛ e he via tɔtɔɔtɔ nɛ ji klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a sɔlemi ɔmɛ.
Nɛ a la la he ko de ke: “Mo lɛ sa kaa o heɔ womi ɔ Nɛ o tsɔɔ e nya sɔumi ɔmɛ, Ejakaa a gbe mo, Nɛ o kɛ o muɔ ɔ kpɔ wɔ ha Mawu Kɛ je wetso tsuaa wetso kɛ munyu tsuaa munyu Kɛ ma tsuaa ma kɛ je ma tsuaa je ma mi.
Nɛ ɔ ngɔ wɔ ngɔ pee matsɛmɛ kɛ osɔfohi Ha wa Mawu ɔ, Nɛ wa maa ye matsɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.” Nɛ i hyɛ, nɛ i nu bɔfohi fuu nɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a he kɛ kpe ɔmɛ a gbi, nɛ a nya ji akpe nyɔngma totoe akpe nyɔngma kɛ akpe totoe akpe, nɛ a kɛ gbi ngua de ke: “Tobi nɛ a gbe ɔ, Sa nɛ e ngɔ he wami kɛ ni nami Kɛ ni lemi kɛ nyɛmi kɛ agboje kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ gbaami.” Nɛ i nu kaa bɔ ni ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ zugba a sisi kɛ wo hɛ mi kɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ ke: “A ngɔ gbaami kɛ agboje kɛ hɛ mi nyami Kɛ nɔ yemi ngɔ ha nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ Kɛ Tobi ɔ kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene!” Nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔ ke: “Amen.” Nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ bu si, nɛ a ja nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene ɔ.
Nya sɔumi nihi Kɛkɛ nɛ i na kaa Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi kpaago ɔ kake; nɛ i nu kaa hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake kɛ gbi nɛ ngɛ kaa hiɔwe simi de ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!” I hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, okpɔngɔ hiɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e nɔ ɔ hɛɛ kɛɛ, nɛ a ha lɛ jlasi, nɛ e je kpo kaa kunimi yelɔ, konɛ e ya ye kunimi.
Nɛ benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ de ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!” Nɛ okpɔngɔ kpa ko nɛ tsuɔ je kpo, nɛ a ha nɔ nɛ hi e nɔ ɔ he blɔ ke e je he jɔmi kɛ je zugba a nɔ, konɛ nimli nɛ a gbe a he, nɛ a ha lɛ klaate ngua ko.
Nɛ benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ de ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!” I hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, okpɔngɔ yumu, nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e nɔ ɔ hɛɛ sɛni ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ke: “Ngma susumi nɔ́ kake ligbi kake hiɔwo, blɛfo susumi nihi etɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo, se nu kɛ wai ɔ lɛɛ koo ta he!” Benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, i nu hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ gbi ke: “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!” I hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, okpɔngɔ lazu lazu; nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e nɔ ɔ biɛ ji Gbenɔ, nɛ Gbeje nyɛɛ e se; nɛ a ha mɛ he blɔ konɛ a kɛ klaate kɛ hwɔ kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kɛ zugba a nɔ awi yemi lohewehi nɛ gbe zugba a mi dlami eywiɛ mi kake.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ, nɛ i na nihi nɛ a gbe ngɛ Mawu munyu ɔ kɛ odase nɛ a ye ɔ he ɔ a klaahi ngɛ bɔsami latɛ ɔ sisi; nɛ a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ Klɔuklɔu kɛ Anɔkuayelɔ, mɛni be o maa kojo nɛ o maa gbla nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ gbe wɔ ɔmɛ a tue?” A hã a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ tade hiɔ klɔii, nɛ a de mɛ ke a jɔɔ a he be bɔɔ ko lolo kɛ ya su be nɛ a nyɛmimɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kɛ anyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a maa gbe mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a gbe mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu ɔ a hiemi maa sɔ.
Nɛ i na benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji ekpa a, nɛ oʼɛ, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ pu plɛ kaa kpekpe kotoku yumu, nɛ nyɔhiɔ mluku ɔ plɛ kaa muɔ, nɛ hiɔwe dodoehi tsɔ fia si kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔkɔ tso yiblii ngmlikiti wɔleɔ pueɔ si benɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngua ngɛ fiae ɔ. Nɛ hiɔwe hɛ lɛ kɛ ho kaa womi nɛ a hluɛ; nɛ a tsitsɛɛ yoku tsuaa yoku kɛ wo kpɔ tsuaa wo kpɔ kɛ je e blɔ he.
