Nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ nimli ngua amɛ kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ he wali ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɔguɛ tsuaa nyɔguɛ kɛ odehe tsuaa odehe ya laa a he ngɛ muɔhi a mi kɛ tɛkplohi a mi, nɛ fa de yoku ɔmɛ kɛ tɛ sa amɛ ke: “Nyɛ ba nɔ wa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ laa wɔ kɛ je nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ Tobi ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ nya.
Ejakaa e mi mi fumi ligbi ngua a su, nɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ si maa da?”
Israelbi akpe lafa nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na hiɔwe bɔfohi eywiɛ nɛ a daa si ngɛ zugba kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ zugba a nɔ kɔɔhiɔ eywiɛ ɔ mi, konɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ko fia ngɛ zugba a nɔ loo wo nɔ loo tso ko nɔ.
Nɛ i na bɔfo kpa ko nɛ e ngɛ kuɔe kɛ ngɛ pu site he jee kɛ ma, nɛ e hɛɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nya sɔumi nɔ.
E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kɛ de bɔfohi eywiɛ nɛ a ha mɛ he wami kaa a pee zugba a kɛ wo ɔ yayami ɔ ke: “Nyɛ ko pee zugba a loo wo ɔ loo tso ɔmɛ yayami ko kɛ maa su be nɛ waa kɛ nya sɔumi nɔ ma kadi wa Mawu ɔ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ nya lolo.” Nɛ a demi nihi nɛ a kɛ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kadi mɛ ɔ a yibɔ; nimli akpe lafa nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a kɛ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kadi mɛ kɛ je Israelbi ɔmɛ a wetso tsuaa wetso mi.
Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, a kɛ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kadi nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ; Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ; Gad wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, Aser wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, Nafatali wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, Manase wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, Simeon wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma lɛ enyɔ, Isakar wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, Zebulon wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, Yosef wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, nimli akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Asafo kuu ngua a Enɛ ɔ se ɔ i hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, nimli asafo nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane nɛ je je mi ma tsuaa je mi ma kɛ wɛtsohi kɛ mahi kɛ mahi a nɔ gbihi a mi nɛ a daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ Tobi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a wo tade hiɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ tã kuɔmihi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke: “Yi wami hemi ɔ ji wa Mawu nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ Tobi ɔ nɔ́!” Nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ nikɔtɔmahi hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe, nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a ja Mawu ke: “Amen!
Gbaami kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ ni lemi kɛ sina kɛ agboje kɛ he wami kɛ nyami ha wa Mawu ɔ kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene!
Amen!” Nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake he nɔ nɛ e bi mi ke: “Ninɛmɛ nɛ a wo tade hiɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ ʼi, nɛ jije a je?” Nɛ i de lɛ ke: “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o le.” Nɛ e de mi ke: “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a je nɔ nami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ha a hiɛ futaa ngɛ Tobi ɔ muɔ ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ a ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a jaa lɛ nyɔ kɛ pia ngɛ se sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ maa ma e bo tsu ɔ ngɔ to anɔ.
Hwɔ be mɛ yee hu, nɛ kuma hu be mɛ tɔe hu, nɛ jeha nɛ hu, pu loo latsa ko be a he sae hu; ejakaa Tobi ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kpɛti ɔ maa lɛ mɛ, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ kɛ maa ya wami nyu vuhi a he, nɛ Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu kulaa.
Nya sɔumi nɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ Benɛ Tobi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, a pee dii ngɛ hiɔwe maa pee ngmlɛfia fa.
Nɛ i na hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, nɛ a ngɔ Titimati kpaago ngɔ ha mɛ.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo kpa ko ba nɛ e ba da bɔ sami latɛ ɔ he, nɛ e hɛɛ sika tsopa ke e he via sami nɔ́, nɛ a ha lɛ tsopa kɛ e he via fuu konɛ e kɛ piɛ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ kulaa a sɔlemi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ sika bɔ sami latɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a lasuku ɔ te si kɛ je hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ dɛ mi kɛ ya piɛ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔmɛ a he kɛ ho Mawu hɛ mi ya.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ wo tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e je bɔ sami latɛ ɔ nɔ la a eko ngɔ wo mi tɔtɔɔtɔ, nɛ e ngɔ hɛ pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ hiɔwe simi kɛ gbihi kɛ oslaba gbami kɛ zugba mimiɛmi ba.
Titimati ɔmɛ Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ nɛ hɛɛ titimati kpaago ɔ dla a he konɛ a ma kpa.
Kekleekle hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ kpa, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu loo hiɔmi tɛ kɛ la nɛ muɔ futu mi ba nɛ e ba pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a mi dlami etɛ mi kake sã, nɛ ba mumuhi tsuo sã.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ kpa, nɛ a sake nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa yoku nɛ ngɛ tsoe kɛ la ngɔ fɔ wo mi, nɛ wo ɔ midlami etɛ mi kake plɛ muɔ, nɛ wo ɔ mi nihi nɛ a bɔ nɛ ngɛ wami ɔ a midlami etɛ mi kake gbo, nɛ lɛhi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake hɛ mi kpata.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji etɛ ɔ kpa, nɛ dodoe ngua nɛ ngɛ tsoe kaa ha tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ si, nɛ e nɔ pa amɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake kɛ nyu hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Dodoe ɔ biɛ ji Doodoomi, nɛ nyu ɔmɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake plɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ duɔ, nɛ nimli babauu nɛ nu ɔ gbo, ejakaa e duɔ.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ kpa, nɛ a fia pu mi dlami etɛ mi kake kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake kɛ dodoehi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake nɔ́, nɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kakaaka a wo diblii, nɛ piani mi dlami etɛ mi kake ɔ, je mi tsɔ we nɛ nyɔ mi hu ja kɛ.
Nɛ i na, nɛ i nu kɔle ko he nɛ ngɛ tee ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ngɛ dee ke: “Musu tloo, musu tloo, musu tloo nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ,” benɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi etɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ma kpa a titimati ɔmɛ ɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i na dodoe ko je hiɔwe ba nɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ muɔ voo ɔ nya safe ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.
Nɛ e bli muɔ voo ɔ nya, nɛ lasuku te si kɛ je muɔ ɔ mi kaa abolo tsu ngua mi lasuku, nɛ pu kɛ hiɔwe wo diblii ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi lasuku ɔ he.
Nɛ baalɛhi je lasuku ɔ mi kɛ ba zugba a nɔ; nɛ a ha mɛ he wami kaa he wami nɛ nyingmogblakotohi hɛɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Nɛ a de mɛ ke a ko pee zugba a nɔ nga loo ba mumu loo tso ko yayami ko, kaa ja nimli nɛ be Mawu nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ okadi ngɛ a hɛ nya a kɛkɛ.
Nɛ a tsi a nya kaa a ko gbe nimli ɔmɛ, se mohu a pii mɛ hlami enuɔ.
Nɛ a nya yeyee ɔ ngɛ kaa nyingmogblakoto nɛ tsɛ̃ɔ nɔ nya yemi.
Lɛ hlami enuɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nimli ma hia gbenɔ, se a be nae, nɛ a maa suɔ kaa a ko gbo, se gbenɔ maa tu a nya fo.
Baalɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔhi nɛ a dla mɛ kɛ yaa ta, nɛ ni komɛ fi a yi kaa sika jlasi, nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kaa nimli a hɛ mi; nɛ a yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa yihi a yi bwɔmi, nɛ a lunguhi ngɛ kaa jatahi a nɔ.
A wo damihi kaa dade demahi, nɛ a plehi a mi pɛmi ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔhi babauu kɛ zugba lɛhi nɛ hɛɛ fo kɛ yaa ta; nɛ a ngɛ hlemi kaa nyingmogblakotohi, nɛ kɛ̃ɛ ngɛ a hlemi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ngɛ he wami kaa a pee nimli yayami hlami enuɔ.
Nɛ a matsɛ ji muɔ woo ɔ mi bɔfo ɔ, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke Abadon, nɛ ngɛ Hela gbi mi ɔ, a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolion (Hɛmikpatalɔ).
Kekleekle musu ɔ be; oʼɛ, musuhi enyɔ ma ngɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji ekpa a kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je sika tsu bɔ sami latɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ kolohi eywiɛ ɔmɛ a mi de hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji ekpa a nɛ hɛɛ titimati ɔ ke: “Pɛne hiɔwe bɔfohi eywiɛ nɛ a fi mɛ ngɛ Eufrate pa ngua a nya a!” A pɛne hiɔwe bɔfohi eywiɛ ɔ nɛ a dla to ngmlɛfia a kɛ ligbi ɔ kɛ hlami ɔ kɛ jeha a, konɛ a gbe nimli a mi dlami etɛ mi kake.
Nɛ aslaafohi nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ ɔ, i nu kaa a nya ji akpe nyingmi enyɔ totoe akpe nyɔngma.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ i na okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a nɔ hili ɔmɛ ngɛ ni nami ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: A damahi nɛ a wo ɔ su ngɛ kaa la kɛ alamua yumu kɛ kungwɔ zɔ; nɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a yihi ngɛ kaa jatahi a yi, nɛ la kɛ lasuku kɛ suɔɔ ngɛ hiae kɛ ngɛ a nya mi jee.
Kikɛmɛ a haomi etɛ nɛ ji la kɛ lasuku kɛ suɔɔ nɛ ngɛ hiae kɛ ngɛ a nya mi jee nɛ ɔ, a kɛ gbe nimli a mi dlami etɛ mi kake.
Ejakaa okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he wami ngɛ a nya mi kɛ a hlemihi a mi, ejakaa a hiemi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa sinɔhi, nɛ yihi ngɛ a he, nɛ kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ peɔ yayami.
Nɛ nimli nɛ piɛ nɛ a gbi mɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a tsakee we a tsui kɛ ji a nine nya ni tsumi ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a jɔɔ mumi yayamihi kɛ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ ayawa kɛ tɛ kɛ tso amagahi nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ nɛ a nui nɔ́ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a nyɛɛ ɔ jami.
Jehanɛ hu, a tsake we a tsui kɛ ji a awi yemi kɛ a nyuami kɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛ a jumi ɔmɛ a mi.
Hiɔwe Bɔfo ɔ kɛ womi kpo wayo ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ i na hiɔwe bɔfo kpa ko nɛ he wa nɛ e je hiɔwe kɛ ngɛ si kplee, nɛ e ha bɔku, nɛ alale ngɛ e yi kpɛti, nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ kaa pu, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa la titimahi.
Nɛ e hɛɛ womi kpo wayo ko nɛ a bli nya ngɛ e dɛ mi; nɛ e kɛ e hiɛ ɔ nane ma wo nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e muɔ nane hu ma zugba nɔ.
Nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kaa jata huaa; nɛ benɛ e ngɛ huae ɔ, hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ wo a gbi mi.
Benɛ hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ wo a gbi mi ɔ, jinɛ i miɔ nɛ ma ngma; nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ je hiɔwe de mi ke: “Sɔuu nihi nɛ hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ de ɔ nya, nɛ o ko ngma.” Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ nɛ i na kaa e daa si ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ wo e hiɛ ɔ nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e tsɛ nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ zugba kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ wo kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ nɛ e kɛ ka kita ke: “Be ko be ko be hu!
Se mohu ke hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji kpaago ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, kɛkɛ lɛɛ a gbe Mawu laami sane ɔ hu nya, bɔ nɛ e jaje Sane Kpakpa a tsɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ ɔ.” Nɛ gbi nɛ i nu kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e ke: “Yaa nɛ o ya he womi ɔ nɛ a bli nya a ngɛ bɔfo nɛ daa si ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ dɛ.” I ya bɔfo ɔ ngɔ, nɛ i ya de lɛ ke: “Ngɔɔ womi kpo wayo ɔ ngɔ ha mi.” Nɛ e de mi ke: “He nɛ o ye; e maa duɔ ngɛ o mi mi, se e maa ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ ngɛ o nya mi kaa hwo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i he womi kpo wayo ɔ ngɛ bɔfo ɔ dɛ nɛ i ye, nɛ e ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ ngɛ ye nya mi kaa hwo, nɛ benɛ i ye ɔ, e duɔ ngɛ ye mi mi.
Nɛ e de mi ke: “E sa kaa o gba ekohu ngɛ nimli kɛ majamaje kɛ mahi a nɔ gbihi kɛ matsɛmɛ fuu a he.”
Odaseyeli enyɔ ɔ Nɛ a ha mi gla tso ko nɛ ngɛ kaa kalemi tso ko nɛ a ke: “Tee si nɛ o kale Mawu sɔlemi tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ jaa Mawu ngɛ mi ɔ; se kpo nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ agbo ɔ nya a, si kɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ o ko kale, ejakaa a kɛ ha majemaje li ɔmɛ konɛ a naa ma klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ hlami nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Nɛ ma ha ye odaseyeli enyɔ ɔ ma bu kpekpe nɛ a maa gba ligbihi akpe kɛ lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.” Odaseyeli enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ji nu tsohi enyɔ ɔ kɛ kane tsohi enyɔ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ zugba a nɔ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko ngɛ hlae nɛ e pee mɛ yayami ɔ, la jee a nya mi saa a he nyɛli ɔmɛ; nɛ ke nɔ ko ngɛ hlae nɛ e pee mɛ yayami ɔ, ja nɔuu a maa gbe lɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa sa ngaa hiɔwe nya konɛ hiɔmi ko nɛ ngɛ a gbami ligbi ɔmɛ a mi; nɛ a ngɛ he blɔ hulɔ ngɛ nyu ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa a haa a plɛɔ peɔ muɔ, nɛ a kɛ haomi haoɔ zugba a si abɔ nɛ a suɔ.
Nɛ ke a gbe a odaseyemi ɔ nya a, lohwe ɔ nɛ je muɔ voo ɔ mi ɔ kɛ mɛ maa hwu ta, nɛ e maa ye a nɔ, nɛ e maa gbe mɛ; nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ma pue si ngɛ ma ngua nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ngɛ mumi mi ke Sodoma kɛ Mizraim ɔ, he nɛ a sɛu a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ magbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ ma amɛ kɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ kɛ gbihi slɔɔto ɔmɛ kɛ majemaje li ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ maa hyɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ligbi etɛ̃ kɛ fa, nɛ a be kplɛe nɛ a pu mɛ.
Nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ma nya ngɛ a gbenɔ ɔ he, nɛ a mi mi maa flii mɛ, nɛ a maa ke a he nihi, ejakaa kikɛmɛ a gbali enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ hao ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Nɛ ligbi etɛ kɛ fa a se ɔ, wami mumi je Mawu ngɔ ba a mi, nɛ a te si da a nane nɔ, nɛ gbeye nɛ nya wa nu nihi nɛ na mɛ ɔ. Nɛ gbali enyɔ ɔmɛ nu gbi kpetekpleenyɛ je hiɔwe de mɛ ke: “Nyɛɛ kuɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ!” Nɛ a kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ bɔku ɔ mi, nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ na mɛ.
Nɛ lɛ ngmlɛfia a nɔ nɔuu ɔ, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ ma a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake hule, nɛ zugba mimiɛmi ɔ mi ɔ, a gbe nimli akpe kpaago.
Ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɔ ha hiɔwe Mawu ɔ. Musu nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ be; nɛ oʼɛ musu nɛ ji etɛ ɔ ma oya.
Titimati nɛ ji kpaago ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji kpaago ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ a nu gbi nguahi ngɛ hiɔwe ke: “Je nɛ mi matsɛ yemi ɔ plɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e Kristo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene kɛ neneene!” Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ kɛ a hɛ mi bu si, nɛ a ja Mawu de ke: “Wa naa mo si, mo Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, Mo nɔ nɛ o ngɛ nɛ o hi si ɔ, Kaa o ngɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ Nɛ o bɔni matsɛyemi, Nɛ majemaje li ɔmɛ a mi mi fu, Ejakaa o mi mi fumi be ɔ su Nɛ a maa kojo ni gbogboe ɔmɛ Nɛ a maa wo o sɔmɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ Kɛ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ hiɔ, nimli wawi kɛ nimli nguahi Nɛ yee o biɛ ɔ gbeye ɔ.
Be su nɛ a ma puɛ nihi nɛ puɛɔ zugba a.” Nɛ a bli Mawu sɔlemi tsu ɔ nya ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ a na e somi daka a ngɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi, nɛ oslaba, kɛ gbi kɛ hiɔwe simi kɛ zugba mimiɛmi kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu loo hiɔmi tɛ babauu ba.
Yo ɔ kɛ sinɔ ngua a Kɛkɛ nɛ a na okadi ngua ko ngɛ hiɔwe: yo ko nɛ e kɛ pu ha e he, nɛ nyɔhiɔ ngɛ e nane si, nɛ dodoe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ jlasi fi e yi; nɛ e mi wa, nɛ e ngɛ ngmlaa kpae, nɛ e ngɛ kɔɔe, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ nae nɛ e ma fɔ.
Nɛ a na okadi kpa ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ oʼɛ, sinɔ ngua tsutsuutsu kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma, nɛ matsɛ pɛɛ kpaago bu e yi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ ehlemi ngɛ hiɔwe dodoehi a midlami etɛ mi kake gblae, nɛ e tsɔ mɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ.
Nɛ sinɔ ngua a ba da yo nɛ ma fɔ ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ, ke e fɔ ɔ nɛ e mi e bi ɔ. Nɛ yo ɔ fɔ bi nyumu nɔ nɛ kɛ dade tso ma kpaka maje li ɔmɛ kulaa a; nɛ a sa e bi ɔ kɛ ho Mawu ngɔ ya ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ kasa nya.
Nɛ yo ɔ tu fo kɛ ho nga nɔ he ko ya, he nɛ Mawu dla to ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, konɛ a ya lɛ lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ligbihi akpe kɛ lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.
Nɛ ta te si ngɛ hiɔwe: Mikael kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ hia sinɔ ngua a yi nɔ ta.
Nɛ sinɔ ngua a bɔfo ɔmɛ piɛ e he kɛ hwu, se a ye a nɔ, nɛ a nɛ blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ha mɛ hu.
Nɛ a sake sinɔ ngua kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji blema sinɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nyapolɔ loo Abosiami nɛ sisiɔ je mluku ɔ tsuo ɔ, ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ a sake e bɔfo ɔmɛ hu ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ ngɔ piɛ e he.
Nɛ i nu gbi ngua ko ngɛ hiɔwe ke: “Jehanɛ yi wami hemi ɔ kɛ he wami ɔ kɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ plɛ wa Mawu ɔ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ he blɔ ɔ ha e Kristo (nɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu) ɔ, ejakaa a sake wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nya polɔ ɔ nɛ poo a nya ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyɔ kɛ pia a ngɔ fɔ he.
Nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ, Tobi ɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a odase yemi munyu ɔ, a kɛ ye e nɔ, nɛ a klɔɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wami he kɛ ya su gbenɔ mi tete.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hiɔwe kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ na bua jɔmi!
Musu tloo je ɔ kɛ wo!
Ejakaa Abosiami kple si kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, e gli wawɛɛ, ejakaa e le kaa be bɔɔ kɛkɛ e piɛ ha lɛ.” Nɛ benɛ sinɔ ngua a na kaa a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ ɔ, e tiu yo ɔ nɛ fɔ bi nyumu ɔ.
Se a ngɔ kɔle ngua a ple enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha yo ɔ, konɛ e te kɛ ya nga a nɔ ngɛ e blɔ he ɔ, he nɛ a maa lɛ lɛ ngɛ jeha etɛ kɛ fa nɛ sinɔ ɔ be lɛ nae hu ɔ. Nɛ sinɔ ɔ su nyu nɛ ngɛ kaa pa kɛ je e nya mi kɛ pue yo ɔ se, konɛ nyu ɔ nɛ sa lɛ kɛ ho.
Se zugba a ye bua yo ɔ; nɛ zugba a bli e nya mi nɛ e mii nyu ɔ nɛ sinɔ ngua a su kɛ je e nya mi ngɔ pue he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ sinɔ ngua a mi mi fu yo ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho konɛ e kɛ yo ɔ nina nɛ piɛ nɛ yeɔ Mawu kita amɛ a nɔ nɛ a hɛɛ Yesu Kristo he odase yemi ɔ mi ɔ ya hwu ta.
Nɛ e ya da wo nya zia a nɔ.
Lohwe enyɔ ɔmɛ Kɛkɛ nɛ i na lohwe ko nɛ e ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi jee kɛ ma, nɛ e ngɛ koli nyɔngma kɛ e yi kpaago, nɛ matsɛ pɛɛhi nyɔngma bu e koli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ musubɔmi biɛhi ngɛ e yi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ i na a ngɛ kaa ogbetee, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa osisibliisii nanehi, nɛ e nya ngɛ kaa jata nya.
Nɛ sinɔ ngua a ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami ɔ kɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ he blɔ ngua a ngɔ ha lɛ.
Nɛ i na e yi ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ a plaa lɛ gbenɔ plaami, se a tsa e gbenɔ plaami ɔ, nɛ je mluku ɔ kulaa nya kpɛ a he ngɛ lohwe ɔ he.
Nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo ja sinɔ ngua a nɛ ngɔ he blɔ ɔ ngɔ ha lohwe ɔ, nɛ a ke: “Mɛnɔ ngɛ kaa lohwe, ɔ nɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa hwu ta?” A ha lohwe ɔ nya nɛ e kɛ tu munyu nguahi kɛ musu bɔmi munyuhi, nɛ a ha lɛ he blɔ nɛ e pee enɛ hlami nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Nɛ e pã e nya mi nɛ e tu musu bɔmi munyui kɛ si Mawu, nɛ etu e biɛ ɔ kɛ he nɛ e hii ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ hii hiɔwe ɔ a he musu bɔmi munyuhi.
Nɛ a ha lɛ he blɔ nɛ e kɛ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ nɛ hwu ta nɛ e ye a nɔ, nɛ a ha lɛ he blɔ ngɛ wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso kɛ ma tsuaa ma kɛ mahi a nɔ gbihi tsuo kɛ je ma tsuaa je ma nɔ.
Nɛ nihi kulaa nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ma ja lɛ, nihi nɛ a ngmɛ́ a biɛ ngɛ Tobi nɛ a gbe ɔ wami womi ɔ mi kɛ je je mi sisije ɔ.
“Ke nɔ ko ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu!
Ke a to nɔ ko kɛ ha nyɔguɛ yemi ɔ, nyɔguɛ yemi mi e maa ya; ke nɔ ko kɛ klaate gbe nɔ ɔ, ja a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ.
Hiɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a tsuisitomi kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i na lohwe kpa ko nɛ e ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ngɛ zugba a mi jee, nɛ e ngɛ koli enyɔ kaa to bi, nɛ e tuɔ munyu kaa sinɔ ngua.
Nɛ e tsuɔ kekle lohwe ɔ he blɔ ɔmɛ kulaa he ni ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e haa zugba a kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ jaa kekle lohwe ɔ nɛ a tsa e gbenɔ plaami ɔ. Nɛ e peɔ okadi nguahi, nɛ e haa la po jee hiɔwe baa zugba a nɔ ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi.
Nɛ e kɛ nyakpɛ nihi nɛ e na he blɔ kaa e pee ngɛ lohwe ɔ hɛ mi ɔ sisiɔ ninɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, nɛ e deɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ke, a pee amaga ngɔ ha lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ klaate plaa lɛ nɛ e hɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ a ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ mumi nɛ ha lohwe ɔ amaga a, konɛ lohwe ɔ amaga a nɛ tu munyu nɛ e ha a gbe nimli kulaa nɛ ja we lohwe ɔ amaga a. Nɛ e haa nimli tsuo, nimli tsɔwi kɛ nimli nguahi, niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiafohi, odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi kplɛɔ nɛ a kadi mɛ ngɛ a hiɛ ɔ nine loo a hɛ̃ nya.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɔ́ ko nɛ e he loo e jua, ja nɔ nɛ ngɛ okadi ɔ loo lohwe ɔ biɛ loo e biɛ ɔ yibɔ ɔ kɛkɛ.
Hiɛ ɔ nilemi ɔ ngɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e bu lohwe ɔ yibɔ ɔ he akaɔtaa, ejakaa yibɔ ɔ daa si ha nɔmlɔ biɛ; nɛ yibɔ ɔ ji lafa ekpa kɛ nyingmi ekpa kɛ ekpa.
Nihi nɛ a kpɔ ɔmɛ a la Kɛkɛ nɛ i hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, Tobi ɔ daa si ngɛ Zion yoku ɔ nɔ, nɛ nimli akpe lafa nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ngma e biɛ kɛ e Tsɛ biɛ ngɛ a hɛ nya a piɛ e he.
Nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je hiɔwe kaa nyu babauu pɛmi, nɛ jehanɛ hu kaa hiɔwe simi wawɛɛ pɛmi.
Gbi nɛ i nu ɔ ngɛ kaa sakufiali nɛ hɛɛ a sakuhi nɛ a ngɛ fiae ɔ a gbi.
Nɛ a ngɛ Ta he ko lae ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ nɔ ko nyɛ we la a nɛ e kase, ja nimli akpe lafa nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɛ a kpɔ kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛkɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ kɛ yihi ble we a he, ejakaa nihewi nɛ ngɔɛ yihi ji mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ Tobi ɔ se kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ e yaa a. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a kpɔ kɛ je nimli a kpɛti nɛ a plɛ kekleekle yiblii ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ Tobi ɔ.
A nɛ́ lakpa ko ngɛ a nya mi, ejakaa piami ko be a he.
Hiɔwe bɔfohi etɛ ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ i na hiɔwe bɔfo kpa ko nɛ e ngɛ tee ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, nɛ e hɛɛ neneene Sane Kpakpa nɛ e yaa jaje ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ je ma tsuaa je ma kɛ wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso kɛ mahi a nɔ gbi slɔɔtohi kɛ ma tsuaa ma a, nɛ e kɛ gbi ngua de ke: “Nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ ha lɛ, ejakaa e kojomi ngmlɛfia a su.
Nyɛ ja nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba kɛ wo kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi nɛ baa a.” Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo kpa nɛ ji enyɔ nyɛɛ se nɛ e ke: “E ywia, Babilon ma ngua a ywia, ejakaa e ha majemaje ɔ kulaa nu e ajuama bɔmi ɔ he mi mi fumi da a eko.” Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo kpa nɛ ji etɛ nyɛɛ a se, nɛ e kɛ gbi ngua de ke: “Ke nɔ ko ja lohwe ɔ kɛ e maga a, nɛ e heɔ e kadi ɔ ngɛ e hɛ nya loo e nine nɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e maa nu Mawu cmi mi fumi da nɛ a tsa we mi nɛ ngɛ e mi mi fumi kplu ɔ mi ɔ eko, nɛ a ma pii lɛ ngɛ la gligliigli ɔ mi ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ Tobi ɔ hɛ mi.
Nɛ a plaami ɔ lasuku ɔ tee si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene; nɛ nihi nɛ ja lohwe ɔ kɛ e maga, a kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he e biɛ ɔ okadi ɔ na we he jɔmi nyɔ kɛ pia.
Hiɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ nɛ yeɔ Mawu kita amɛ kɛ Yesu nɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ ɔ a tsui si tomi ɔ ngɛ.
Nɛ i nu gbi kɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ dee ke: “Ngmaa: A gbaa ni gbogboehi nɛ gboɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ. Ee, Mumi ɔ ke, konɛ a jɔɔ a he kɛ je a haomi ɔmɛ a mi; se a ni tsumi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se.” Ngma kpami ngɛ je ɔ mi Kɛkɛ nɛ i hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, bɔku hiɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔ nɔ kaa Nɔmlɔbi ɔ, nɛ e kle e yi si kɛ sika jlasi, nɛ e hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Nɛ bɔfo kpa ko je kpo kɛ je sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi nɛ e kɛ gbi ngua kpa ngmlaa kɛ de nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔ nɔ ke: “O kɛ o ngma kpami ha a nɛ wo mi nɛ o kpa ni, ejakaa ngma kpami ngmlɛfia a su, nɛ zugba a nɔ ngma a gbli.” Nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔ nɔ ɔ sake e ngma kpami ha a ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ a kpa zugba a nɔ ngma a. Nɛ bɔfo kpa ko je kpo kɛ je sɔlemi tsu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ mi, nɛ lɛ hu e hɛɛ ha nɛ nya ba.
Nɛ bɔfo kpa ko je kpo kɛ je bɔ sami latɛ ɔ mi, nɔ nɛ ngɛ la nɔ he wami, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ nɔ nɛ hɛɛ ha nɛ nya ba a ke: “O kɛ o ha nɛ nya ba a nɛ wo mi nɛ o poo nɛ o bua zugba a nɔ wai yiblii sawe ɔmɛ a nya, ejakaa wai yiblii ɔ fu.” Nɛ bɔfo ɔ sake e ha a ngɔ fɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ e bua zugba a nɔ wai yiblii ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ wo Mawu mi mi la wai ngami nɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi.
Nɛ a naa wai ngami nɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ ma a se, nɛ muɔ je wai ngami nɔ ɔ mi kɛ kuɔ kɛ ya su okpɔngɔhi a nya mi dade ɔmɛ a he maa pee si tomi lafa enyɔ.
Hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ nyagbe haomi ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ i na okadi kpa ko ngɛ hiɔwe; e kle nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ: hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago nɛ a hɛɛ haomi kpaago nɛ ji nyagbe ni ɔmɛ, ejakaa kɔlɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ maa gbe Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i na nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa wo nɛ ngɛ kaa ahuhuɛ nɛ a kɛ la futu mi, nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ye lohwe ɔ kɛ e maga a kɛ e kadi ɔ kɛ e biɛ ɔ yibɔ ɔ nɔ kunimi ɔ daa si ngɛ wo nɛ ngɛ kaa ahuhuɛ ɔ nya, nɛ a hɛɛ Mawu saku ɔmɛ.
Nɛ a la Mawu tsɔlɔ Mose la a kɛ Tobi ɔ la a ke: “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, O ni tsumi ɔmɛ kle, nɛ a ngɛ nyakpɛ!
Mo je ma amɛ a nɔ matsɛ, O blɔ ɔmɛ da, nɛ anɔkuale ji mɛ.
Mɛnɔ po lɛ be mo gbeye yee Nyɔmtsɛ, Nɛ e be o biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami woe?
Ejakaa mo o nɔ kake too ji nɔ klɔuklɔu.
Nɛ je ma amɛ kulaa maa ba nɛ a ba ja ngɛ o hɛ mi, Ejakaa a je o dami ni ɔmɛ a si paa.” Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ i hyɛ, nɛ oʼɛ, a bli odase bo tsu sɔlemi tsu ɔ nya ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ nɛ hɛɛ haomi kpaago ɔ je kpo kɛ je sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a wo kploba nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe, nɛ a fi a gugue kɛ sika kpɛti fimi nihi.
Nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngɔ sika tsinesa kpaago nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ Mawu nɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene ɔ mi mi la a ngɔ ha hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ. Nɛ sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi hyi tɔ kɛ lasuku nɛ je Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ e he wami ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nyɛ we sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi nɛ e sɛ kɛ maa su be nɛ a maa gbe hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔmɛ a haomi kpaago ɔmɛ a nya.
Mawu mi mi fumi tsinesa amɛ Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ngua ko nɛ je sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi nɛ e ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ dee ke: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya plɛ Mawu mi mi fumi tsinesa kpaago ɔmɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ!” Nɛ kekleekle nɔ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ; nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ lohwe ɔ okadi ɔ ngɛ a he ɔ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ jaa e maga a hia pa yayahi nɛ yee nɔ.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo wo mi, nɛ e plɛ muɔ kaa nɔ gbogboe nɔ́, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ gbo.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji etɛ ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo pahi kɛ nyu hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyu ɔ plɛ muɔ.
Nɛ i nu nɛ nyu ɔmɛ a nɔ bɔfo ɔ ngɛ dee ke: “Dalɔ ji mo, Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa kɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ejakaa o nɔ da ngɛ o kojomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
A pue klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ si, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ muɔ nɔuu o ha mɛ nɛ a nu, ejakaa e sa mɛ ja.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ bɔ sami latɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ke: “Ee, Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, anɔkuale kɛ dami ji o kojomi ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue pu ɔ nɔ; nɛ a ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ la nɛ sa nimli.
Nɛ e la dɔmi babauu ɔ sa nimli nɛ tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ biɛ ɔ, se a tsakee we a tsui nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ pue lohwe ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e matsɛ yemi he ɔ wo diblii, nɛ nimli ta a lilɛ ngɛ nɔ nami he, nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ a nɔ nami kɛ a pa amɛ a he, se a tsakee we a tsui kɛ ji a ni tsumi ɔmɛ a mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji ekpa a plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo Eufrate pa ngua a mi, nɛ e mi nyu ɔ mii, konɛ a kɛ dla blɔ ngɔ ha matsɛmɛ nɛ je puje he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i na mumi yayami etɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa ovɔnɔhi loo kuɔwihi ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ngɛ sinɔ ngua a nya mi kɛ lohwe ɔ nya mi kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ nya mi jee; ejakaa mumi yayamihi a mumi ji mɛ, nɛ a peɔ nyakpɛ nihi, nɛ a yaa matsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ je mluku ɔ kulaa mi ɔ ngɔ, konɛ a ya bua a nya kɛ ya Mawu Ope ɔ ligbi ngua a nɔ ta a.
“Oʼɛ i ma kaa juɔ.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ huɔɔ nɛ e hyɛɛ e tade ɔmɛ a nɔ saminya a, konɛ e ko nyɛɛ he gu nɛ e zo ba je kpo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ bua matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nya kɛ ho he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke Harmagedon ɔ ya.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo nɛ ji kpaago ɔ plɛ e tsinesa a mi ni ɔmɛ ngɔ wo kɔɔhiɔ mi; nɛ gbi ngua ko je hiɔwe sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi kɛ je matɛ sɛ ɔ mi de ke: “A gbe nya!” Nɛ oslaba kɛ pɛmi kɛ hiɔwe simi ba, nɛ zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ, bɔ nɛ kɛ je be nɛ nimli ba zugba a nɔ nɛ ɔ, a nɛ́ jamɛ a zugba mimiɛmi ngua nɛ ngɛ kaa enɛ hyɛ.
Nɛ ma ngua a mi gba etɛ, nɛ maje li ɔmɛ a ma amɛ hule, nɛ a kai Babilon kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, konɛ a ngɔ e mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a kplu ɔ mi da a ngɔ ha lɛ.
Nɛ zugba kpɔ tsuaa zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ tu fo, nɛ yoku ɔmɛ ɔ a nɛ́ mɛ hu.
Nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu loo hiɔmi tɛ babauu nɛ kake jiɔmi maa pee sɛni mi tɛ jiɔmi pau lafa nɛ kɛ je hiɔwe ba pue nimli a nɔ; nɛ nimli ɔmɛ tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔmɛ a haomi ɔ he, ejakaaa a haomi ɔ nya wa tsɔ.
Ajuama kpanaaku ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago ɔ nɛ a hɛɛ tsinesa kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ba nɛ e kɛ mi ba tu munyu ke: “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ajuama kpanaaku ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nyu babauu ɔ nɔ ɔ kojomi ɔ, nɔ nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ de da kɛ e ajuama bɔmi da a.” Nɛ e kpaka mi kɛ ho nga nɔ ya ngɛ mumi mi; nɛ i na yo ko nɛ hii si ngɛ lohwe nɛ tsuɔ kaa muɔ ko nɔ nɛ musu bɔmi biɛhi kpe e he, nɛ e ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma.
Nɛ yo ɔ wo tade nɛ hɛɛ alamua yumu su kɛ tade nɛ tsuɔ kaa muɔ, nɛ a kɛ sika kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa kɛ adiagba wo lɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ sika kplu nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ e ajuama bɔmi ɔ mi ninye nihi kɛ mu ni ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi; nɛ a ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e hɛ nya nɛ ji laami sane ke: “Babilon ngua a, zugba a nɔ ajuama a kɛ ninye ni ɔmɛ a nyɛ.” Nɛ i na yo ɔ kaa klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a muɔ ɔ kɛ Yesu he odase yeli ɔmɛ a muɔ ɔ de lɛ da.
Benɛ i na lɛ ɔ ye nya kpɛ ye he wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ de mi ke: “Mɛni he je o nya ngɛ o he kpɛe?
Ma sɛɛ mo yo ɔ kɛ lohwe nɛ e hii si ngɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma a he laami sane ɔ. Lohwe ɔ nɛ o na a hi si hyɛ, se e be hu.
E maa je muɔ voo ɔ mi kɛ je kpo kɛ ba be kɛ ho hɛ mi kpatami mi ya; nɛ nihi nɛ a ngɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ a ngmɛ́ a biɛ ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi kɛ je je mi sisije ɔ nya maa kpɛ a he, ke a na lohwe ɔ nɛ hi si hyɛ nɛ e be hu nɛ e maa ba a.
“Hiɛ ɔ juɛmi nɛ ni lemi ngɛ mi ɔ ngɛ.
Yi kpaago ɔ ji yoku kpaago nɛ yo ɔ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ, nɛ matsɛmɛ kpaago hu ji mɛ: nihi enuɔ ɔ gbee si, nɛ nɔ kake ngɛ, nɛ nɔ kpa a na we nɛ e ba, nɛ ke e ba a, ja e hi si bɔɔ.
Nɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ hi si sa nɛ e be ɔ ji matsɛ nɛ ji kpaanyɔ, nɛ e je kpaago ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e yaa shɛ mi kpatami mi.
“Koli nyɔngma nɛ o na a, matsɛmɛ nyɔngma ʼi, nihi nɛ matsɛ yemi ko sui a dɛ, se kɛ ɔ, a kɛ lohwe ɔ na he blɔ kaa matsɛmɛ ngmlɛfia kake.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ a kɛ a he wami kɛ a blɔ nya a ha lohwe ɔ kulaa.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ Tobi ɔ maa huw ta, nɛ Tobi ɔ maa ye a nɔ, ejakaa lɛ ji nyɔmtsɛmɛ a Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ matsɛmɛ a Matsɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ a kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ ji ninɛmɛ nɛ a tsɛ kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ a hia kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ.” Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ de mi ke: “Nyu ɔ nɛ o na nɛ yo ajuama a hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ ji mahi kɛ asafohi kɛ je mahi kɛ mahi a nɔ gbihi.
Nɛ koli nyɔngma nɛ o na a, kɛ lohwe ɔ, maa nyɛ ajuama a, nɛ a ma kpɔ e nihi kulaa nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma kpa e he bo, nɛ a maa ye e he lo, nɛ a kɛ la maa sa lɛ.
Ejakaa Mawu kɛ wo a tsui mi konɛ a pee e yi mi tomi ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ a kɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ ha lohwe ɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ a maa gbe nihi nɛ Mawu de ɔmɛ a nya.
“Nɛ yo ɔ nɛ o na a ji ma ngua nɛ yeɔ je ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ.”
Babilon butumi Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, i na hiɔwe bɔfo kpa ko nɛ e ngɛ si kplee kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe jee, nɛ e ngɛ he blɔ ngua, nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ hã je ɔ mi kulaa tsɔ.
E kɛ̃ e he nɛ e kpa ngmlaa kɛ gbi ngua ke: “E ywia, Babilon ngua a ywia, nɛ e plɛ mumi yayamihi a si himi he, kɛ mumi yayamihi kulaa a tsu, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ tsuaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ he tsɔ we nɛ he ngɛ tai ɔ hu tsu.
Ejakaa e ha je ma amɛ kulaa nu e ajuama bɔmi he mi mi fumi da a eko, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ zugba a nɔ jua yeli ɔmɛ plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ e ya homi ɔ he wami ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi kpa ko kɛ je hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ dee ke: “Nyɛɛ je e mi, ye ma, Konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko pee kake ngɛ e he yayami ɔmɛ a mi, Nɛ nyɛ ko na e haomi ɔ eko.
Ejakaa e he yayami ɔmɛ su hiɔwe lokoo, Nɛ Mawu kai e ni yayami ɔmɛ Nyɛɛ wo lɛ hiɔ kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ hu e wo nyɛ hiɔ ɔ, Nɛ nyɛɛ ku ngɔ bɔ he totoe enyɔ ha lɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ sa e ni tsumi ɔmɛ; Kplu ɔ nɛ e futu ha nyɛ ɔ, Nyɛ futu lɛ totoe enyɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.
Nyɛ pii lɛ nɛ nyɛɛ wo lɛ aywlɛho Kaa bɔ nɛ e wo lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi nyami kɛ ya homi ɔ Ja nɔuu nyɛ ha e piimi kɛ e ywlɛho ɔ nɛ pee.
Ejakaa e deɔ ngɛ e tsui mi ke: ‘I hii si kaa manye!
I pi yalɔyo, Nɛ i be aywlɛho ko nae!’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi kake nɔ e haomi ɔmɛ maa ba, Gbenɔ kɛ aywlɛho kɛ hwɔ, Nɛ a kɛ la maa sa lɛ, Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu nɛ kojoɔ ɔ he wa.” Nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho ya a ma fo lɛ, nɛ a maa wo ya ngɛ e he, benɛ a maa na e sami ɔ lasuku ɔ.
A maa da se lokoo ngɛ e piimi ɔ he gbeye yemi ɔ he, nɛ a ma de ke: “Musu tloo, musu tloo, ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, Babilon, ma nɛ he wa a!
ejakaa ngmlɛfia kake mi nɛ o kojomi ɔ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Zugba a nɔ jua yeli ɔmɛ ma fo lɛ nɛ a maa ye lɛ kɔmɔ, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko he we a jua yemi ni ɔmɛ hu: Sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, kɛ adiagba, kɛ kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu kɛ bo nɛ ngɛ kaa alamua yumu, kɛ seda kɛ bo nɛ tsuɔ tsutsuutsu, kɛ tso tsuaa tso nɛ jee via, kɛ suɔ wu nihi tsuo, kɛ tso nɛ he jua wa nitsɛnitsɛ, kɛ akɔblee kɛ dade marmara tɛ nihi tsuo, kɛ sinamon kɛ amomon kɛ tsopahi kɛ a he viahi kɛ mimɛ kɛ ohɛ nɛ jee via, kɛ da kɛ nu, kɛ sikisiai kɛ ngma, kɛ nahi kɛ tohi, kɛ okpɔngɔhi kɛ zugba lɛhi, kɛ nyɔguɛhi kɛ nimli a klaahi.
Nɛ yiblii nɛ jloɔ mo ɔ je o nya mi, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kɛ nihi nɛ kpɛɔ nylamnylam ɔ bɔ mo, nɛ o be mɛ nae kulaa hu.
Jua yeli nɛ plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ maa da se lokoo ngɛ e nɔ nami ɔ gbeye yemi ɔ he, nɛ a ma fo ya nɛ a maa ye kɔmɔ; nɛ a ma de ke: “Musu tloo, musu tloo ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ buɔ kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu kɛ bo nɛ ngɛ kaa alamua yumu kɛ bo nɛ tsuɔ tsutsuutsu, nɛ dlaa e he kɛ sika tsu kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ adiagba a; ejakaa ngmlɛfia kake pɛ mi ɔ kikɛmɛ a ni babauu nɛ ɔ kulaa plɛ ma doku.” Nɛ lɛ kudɔlɔ tsuaa lɛ kudɔlɔ kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hii lɛ mi kɛ yaa he ko, kɛ lɛ mi bi kɛ nihi abɔ nɛ tsuɔ wo nɔ ni ɔ da si ngɛ se lokoo, nɛ benɛ a na e sami ɔ lasuku ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke: “Te ma nɛ ngɛ kaa ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ nɛɛ?” Nɛ a kɛ bunyuku wo a yi mi, nɛ a kɛ ya kɛ kɔmɔyemi kpa ngmlaa ke: “Musu tloo, musu tloo ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nɛ nihi kulaa nɛ a ngɛ lɛhi ngɛ wo hɛ mi ɔ plɛ niatsɛmɛ ngɛ e mi jua yemi nihi nɛ a he jua wa a he; ejakaa ngmlɛfia kake pɛ mi nɛ e plɛ ma doku nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Mo hiɔwe, kɛ nyɛ klɔuklɔu bihi kɛ bɔfohi kɛ gbali, nyɛ nya ngɛ e butumi ɔ he, ejakaa Mawu kojo lɛ ha nyɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ko nɛ he wa wo tɛ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa wɛ ngua, nɛ e sake ngɔ fɔ wo mi nɛ e ke: “Kikɛ nɛ ɔ a ma sake Babilon ma ngua a ngɔ fɔ he tlukaa, nɛ a be lɛ nae kulaa hu.
Nɛ a be saku fiali kɛ latsɛmɛ kɛ bɛ kpali kɛ titimati kpali ɔmɛ a gbi nue kulaa hu ngɛ o mi, nɛ a be galɔ ko galɔ ko nɛ le ga nae kulaa hu ngɛ o mi, nɛ a be wɛɛmi nya nue kulaa hu ngɛ o mi, nɛ kane la be tsoe kulaa hu ngɛ o mi, nɛ a be ayɛflo huno kɛ ayɛflo gbi nue kulaa hu ngɛ o mi, ejakaa o jua yeli ɔmɛ ji zugba a nɔ nimli nguahi, ejakaa o kunya yemi ɔ, a kɛ sisi ma jeli ɔmɛ kulaa.
Babilon mi a na gbali kɛ klɔuklɔu bihi kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a gbe ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a muɔ ɔ ngɛ.”
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, i nu gbi ngua nɛ ngɛ kaa nimli asafo babauu gbi ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ dee ke: “Haleluya!
Yi wami hemi kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje kɛ he wami ɔ ji Nyɔmtsɛ wa Mawu ɔ nɔ!
Ejakaa zanɔkuale kɛ dami ji e kojomi ɔmɛ, akɛnɛ e kojo ajuama kpanaaku ɔ nɛ kɛ e juama bɔmi ɔ puɛ zugba a, nɛ Mawu ye e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ a muɔ ɔ he lue.” Nɛ a kpa ngmlaa nɔ́ nɛ ji si enyɔ ke: “Haleluya!
E lasuku ɔ tee si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ neneene.” Nɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔ bu si nɛ a ja Mawu nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ a ke: “Amen, Haleluya!” Tobi ɔ yokpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ Nɛ gbi ko je matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi de ke: “Nyɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ji e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yee lɛ gbeye ɔ, nimli tsɔwi kɛ nimli nguahi kulaa!” Nɛ i nu gbi ko kaa nimli asafo babauu gbi kɛ nyu babauu pɛmi kɛ hiɔwe simi nɛ nyɛ wa pɛmi nɛ ngɛ dee ke: “Haleluya!
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu Ope ɔ, ngɛ matsɛ yee.
Nyɛ ha wa bua nɛ jɔ nɛ wa mi nɛ flii wɔ nɛ waa wo e hɛ mi nyami; ejakaa Tobi ɔ yokpeemi ɔ su, nɛ e yo ɔ dla e he ngɔ to.
Nɛ a hã lɛ kploba nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ngɛ kpee nylamnylam konɛ e bu.” (Ejakaa kploba ji klɔuklɔu bi ɔmɛ a ni tsumi kpakpa amɛ ɔ nɛ.)
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ de mi ke: “Ngmaa: A gbaa nihi nɛ a tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba Tobi ɔ yo kpeemi okplɔɔɔ ɔ he ɔ.” Nɛ e de mi ke: “Mawu anɔkuale munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i bu si ngɛ e nane nya konɛ ma ja lɛ.
Nɛ e de mi ke: “Koo pee!
O nyɛmi sɔmɔlɔ kɛ o nyɛmimɛ nɛ hɛɛ Yesu odase mi ɔ a ti nɔ ko ji mi.
Ja Mawu mohu!” Ejakaa Yesu odase ɔ ji gbami mumi ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ hiɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ i na nɛ a bli hiɔwe nya, nɛ oʼɛ, okpɔngɔ hiɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ, a tsɛɛ lɛ ke: Anɔkualetsɛ kɛ Dalɔ; dami nya e kojo ɔ nɛ e hwuɔ ta ngɛ.
E hɛngmɛhi ngɛ kaa la lilɛhi, nɛ e bu matsɛ pɛɛhi fuu, nɛ a ngma e biɛ ko nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li ja lɛ nitsɛ kɛkɛ; nɛ e wo tade ko nɛ a kɛ sɔ muɔ mi, nɛ a tsɛɛ e biɛ ke: “Mawu Munyu ɔ.” Nɛ tahi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hi okpɔngɔ hiɔhi a nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ e se, nɛ a wo kploba nɛ he tsɔ.
Nɛ klaate nɛ nya ba ngɛ e nya mi jee konɛ e kɛ kɔlɔ ɔ nɛ fia majeli a bimɛ ɔmɛ ni; nɛ e kɛ dade tso nɛ kpaka mɛ.
Nɛ lɛ nɔuu e maa naa Mawu Ope ɔ mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a wai ngami nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ a ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e tade kɛ e fiɔ he ke: “Matsɛmɛ a Matsɛ kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a Nyɔmtsɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i na hiɔwe bɔfo ko nɛ daa si ngɛ pu mi, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kɛ de lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ tee ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo ke: “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ Mawu okplɔɔ ngua a he, konɛ nyɛ ba ye matsɛmɛ a lo kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ a lo kɛ he wali a lo kɛ okpɔngɔhi a lo kɛ nihi nɛ hii a nɔ ɔmɛ a lo kɛ odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi kɛ nimli tsɔwi kɛ nimli nguahi kulaa a lo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i na lohwe ɔ kɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a ta nɛ a bua nya a, konɛ a kɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ e ta a ya hwu ta.
Nɛ a nu lohwe ɔ kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ nɛ pee nyakpɛ nihi ngɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e kɛ sisi nihi nɛ he lohwe ɔ okadi ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ jaa e maga a.
A ngɔ ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa hɛ ngmengmle ngɔ wo la taku nɛ ngɛ tsoe gligliigli ɔ mi.
Nɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a kɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ klaate nɛ jee e nya mi ɔ gbe mɛ, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo ye a lo ɔ nɛ a tɔ.
Jeha akpe ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ i na bɔfo ko nɛ e ngɛ si kplee kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe jee, nɛ e hɛɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya safe ɔ kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ngua ko ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Nɛ e nu sinɔ ngua a, blema sinɔ nɛ ji Abosiami loo Satan ɔ, nɛ e fi lɛ jeha akpe, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo muɔ voo ɔ mi, nɛ e nga e yi nɛ e sɔu nya, konɛ e ko sisi je mi ma amɛ hu kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa gbe jeha akpe ɔ nya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ ja a pɛne lɛ be bɔɔ ko.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i na matsɛ sɛhi kɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ a nɔ ɔ; a ngɔ kojomi ngɔ ha mɛ.
Nɛ i na nihi nɛ a po a yi ngɛ Yesu he odase yemi ɔ kɛ Mawu munyu ɔ he ɔ a klaa amɛ, kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ ja we lohwe ɔ loo e maga a nɛ a he we e kadi ɔ ngɛ a hɛ nya loo a dɛ mi ɔ.
A hɛ ngɛ, nɛ a kɛ Kristo ye matsɛ jeha akpe.
Se ni gbogboehi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a hɛ na we nɛ e tsɛ kɛ maa su be nɛ a maa gbe jeha akpe ɔ nya.
E nɛ ji kekleekle si temi ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ a gbaa kɛ nɔ klɔuklɔu ji nɔ nɛ ma na blɔ nya ngɛ kekleekle si temi ɔ mi; gbenɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ be he wami ko ngɛ jamɛ a nimli ɔmɛ a nɔ; se mohu a ma plɛ Mawu kɛ Kristo osɔfohi, nɛ a kɛ lɛ maa ye matsɛ jeha akpe.
A ye Satan nɔ Jeha akpe ɔ se ɔ, a maa pɛne Satan kɛ maa je e tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e maa je kpo konɛ e ya sisi je mahi nɛ ngɛ zugba kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Gog kɛ Magog, konɛ e bua a nya kɛ kpe nɛ a ya ta, nihi a hiemi nɛ ngɛ kaa wo nya zia a. Nɛ a gbɛ fia zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ya bɔle ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a ta a kɛ ma nɛ a suɔ ɔ kɛ kpe.
Nɛ la je Mawu ngɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ba sa mɛ butuu.
Nɛ Abosiami ɔ nɛ sisi mɛ ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo la gligliigli taku ɔ mi, he nɛ lohwe ɔ kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ hu ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma pii mɛ nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ maa ya neneene kɛ neneene.
Nyagbe kojomi ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ i na matsɛ sɛ hiɔ ngua ko, kɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ, nɛ zugba kɛ hiɔwe tu fo ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ a nɛ blɔ ha mɛ.
Nɛ i na ni gbogboe ɔmɛ, ni tsɔwi kɛ ni nguahi nɛ a daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
A bli womihi a nya, nɛ a bli womi kpa ko nɛ ji wami womi ɔ hu nya.
Nɛ akojo ni gbogboe ɔmɛ, ni tsɔwi kɛ ni nguahi, ngɛ nihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ nya, bɔ nɛ sa a ni tsumi ɔmɛ.
Nɛ wo je ni gbogboehi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ ngɔ ha, nɛ gbenɔ kɛ gbeje je ni gbogboehi nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ ngɔ ha; nɛ a kojo mɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔ nɛ sa e ni tsumi ɔmɛ.
Nɛ gbenɔ kɛ gbeje lɛɛ, a sake mɛ ngɔ pue la taku ɔ mi.
Enɛ ɔ ji gbenɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ a nɛ́ kaa a ngma e biɛ ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi ɔ, a sakee lɛ ngɔ fɔɔ la taku ɔ mi.
Hiɔwe he kɛ zugba he Kɛkɛ nɛ i na dhiɔwe he kɛ zugba he, ejakaa kekle hiɔwe ɔ kɛ kekle zugba a be kɛ ho, nɛ wo be hu.
Nɛ imi Yohane i na ma klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ ji Yerusalem he ɔ je Mawu ngɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ngɛ si kplee, nɛ a dla lɛ kaa ayɛflo nɛ a wo lɛ ni ha e huno.
Nɛ i nu gbi ngua ko je matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi de ke: “Oʼɛ Mawu bo tsu ɔ ngɛ nimli a kpɛti, nɛ e maa hi a kpɛti, nɛ a maa pee e ma, nɛ Mawu nitsɛ kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ e maa pee a Mawu.
Nɛ Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu kulaa, nɛ gbenɔ be si hie hu, nɛ kɔmɔ yemi ko kɛ ya fomi ko kɛ nɔ nami ko hu be si hie hu, ejakaa kekle ni ɔmɛ be kɛ ho.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ de ke: “Oʼɛ, i ngɛ nihi kulaa ehe pee.” Nɛ e de mi ke: “Ngmaa, ejakaa kikɛmɛ a munyuhi nɛ ɔmɛ ji munyuhi nitsɛ nɛ maa si kpɛii.
Nɛ e de mi ke: “A gbe nya.
Ami ji Alfa a kɛ Omega a nɛ, sisije ɔ kɛ nyagbe ɔ. Nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ tɔe ɔ, ma ha lɛ wami nyu vu ɔ mi nyu ɔ eko nɛ e nu yaka gu.
Kunimi yelɔ ɔ maa pee kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa yelɔ, nɛ ma pee e Mawu, nɛ lɛ hu e maa pee ye bi.
Se ninɛmɛ nɛ ji sfɔli kɛ ninɛmɛ nɛ he we yi kɛ nihi nɛ peɔ ninyɛ nihi kɛ awi yeli kɛ ya holi kɛ nyuali kɛ wɔ jali kɛ lakpatsɛmɛ kulaa a, a ma na a blɔ nya ngɛ taku ɔ nɛ ngɛ tsoe kɛ la gligliigli ɔ mi, nɔ́ nɛ ji gbenɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ.” Yerusalem he ɔ Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi kpaago nɛ hɛɛ tsinesa kpaago nɛ hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ nyagbe haomi kpaago ɔ a kpɛti nɔ kake ba ye ngɔ nɛ e kɛ mi ba tu munyu ke: “Ba, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ayɛflo ɔ nɛ ji Tobi ɔ yo ɔ.” Nɛ e ngɔ mi ngɛ mumi mi kɛ ho yoku ngua ko nɛ ya hiɔwe nɔ ya, nɛ e tsɔɔ mi ma ngua a nɛ ji Yerusalem klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ngɛ si kplee, nɛ ye hɛɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ; nɛ e ngɛ kpee kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa pe kulaa, kaa yaspi tɛ nɛ mi tsɔ kaa kristalo ahuhuɛ.
E ngɛ gbogbo ngua ko nɛ ya hiɔwe, kɛ agbohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ daa si ngɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ngma biɛhi ngɛ a nɔ nɛ ji Israel bi ɔmɛ a wɛtsohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ a biɛhi.
Agbohi etɛ ngɛ beleku je (pu je he), nɛ agbohi etɛ ngɛ omlɛyi (hue mi je), nɛ agbohi etɛ ngɛ leneyi (wo si je), nɛ agbohi etɛ ngɛ bonyoku (pu sinɔ he).
Nɛ ma a he gli ɔ ngɛ sisi tomihi (aloo fanesihi) ɔnyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ Tobi ɔ bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ a mi.
Nɛ nɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ hɛɛ sika tsu glã kalemi tso konɛ e kɛ kale ma a kɛ e gbo ɔmɛ kɛ e he gli ɔ. Ma a fɔɔ si kɔ nya eywiɛ nɛ e kami ngɛ kaa e blimi nɔuu.
Nɛ e kɛ glã a kale ma a, nɛ e pee si tomi nya akpe kake kɛ lafa enuɔ.
E kami kɛ e blimi kɛ e hiɔwe yami sɔ.
Nɛ e kale e gli ɔ nɛ e pee nane kami lafa enyɔ kɛ nyɔngma kɛ ekpa ngɛ nɔmlɔ kalemi nɔ́ nɛ bɔfo ɔ hɛɛ ɔ nya.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ fia e gli ɔ ji yaspi tɛ, nɛ ma a sika tsu nɛ ngɛ kaa ahuhuɛ nɛ hɛ mi tsɔ ʼi.
Nɛ ma a gli ɔ sisi tomi ɔ, a dla lɛ kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa slɔɔtohi kulaa: Kekleekle sisi tomi ɔ yaspi, nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ safiro, nɔ́ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ kalkedon, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ smaragdo, nɔ́ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ sardoniki, nɔ́ nɛ ji ekpa a sadio, nɔ́ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ krisolito, nɔ́ nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ berilo, nɔ́ nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ topasion, nɔ́ nɛ ji nyɔngma a krisopraso, nɔ́ nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ hiakinto, nɔ́ nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ametisto.
Nɛ agbohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, adiagba nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ʼi, nɛ agbo kake ɔ adiagba kake a kɛ pee.
Nɛ ma a mi blɔ ɔ sika tsu nitsɛ ʼi, nɛ e mi tsɔ kaa ahuhuɛ.
I nɛ sɔlemi tsu ko ngɛ ma a mi, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope ɔ kɛ Tobi ɔ ji e sɔlemi tsu.
Nɛ pu loo nyɔhiɔ kpemi hia we ngɛ ma a mi, ejakaa Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsoo ngɛ mi, nɛ Tobi ɔ ji la nɛ kpɛɛ ngɛ mi.
Nɛ maje li ɔmɛ maa nyɛɛ ngɛ e la a mi, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ mi nyami kɛ ba mi.
Nɛ e gbo ɔmɛ ɔ, a be ngae ligbi ko ligbi ko; ejakaa nyɔ be lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a kɛ je mi ma amɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ a bu ɔ maa ba mi.
Nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ nɔ nɛ peɔ ninyɛ nihi kɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa be mi sɛe kulaa, kaa ja ninɛmɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ Tobi ɔ wami womi ɔ mi ɔ?
Nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ tsɔɔ mi wami nyu pa klɔuu nɛ mi tsɔ kaa kristalo ahuhuɛ nɛ ngɛ Mawu kɛ Tobi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi jee kɛ ngɛ ma a gbejegbɛ ɔ mi gue, nɛ ma a kpɛti kɛ pa a tue hiɛ ɔ kɛ hiɛ ɔ kulaa a wami tso ɔ maa si, nɛ e woɔ yiblii si nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, hlami tsuaa hlami ɔ, e woɔ yiblii si kake, nɛ tso ɔ yi ba amɛ ɔ, a kɛ tsaa je ma amɛ.
Nɛ musu ko musu ko be lejɛ ɔ hu.
Mawu kɛ Tobi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa ma si ngɛ e mi, nɛ e sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ lɛ, nɛ a maa na e hɛ mi, nɛ e biɛ ɔ maa hi a hɛ nya.
Nɛ nyɔ be lejɛ ɔ hie, nɛ kane loo pu kpemi he be mɛ hiae, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ ma kpɛ ha mɛ, nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene kɛ neneene.
Yesu bami Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ de mi ke: “Anɔkuale munyu nɛ maa si pim ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ a mumi ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ konɛ e ba tsɔɔ e sɔmɔli nihi nɛ sa kaa a ba nɔuu ɔ.” “Oʼɛ i ma nɔuu.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ mi gbami munyu ɔmɛ toɔ ɔ.” Nɛ imi, Yohane, ji nɔ nɛ na nɛ e nu ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ benɛ i nu nɛ i na a, i bu si nɛ ma ja ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mi ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nane nya.
Nɛ e de mi ke: “Koo pee!
ejakaa o nyɛmi sɔmɔlɔ kɛ gbali kɛ nihi nɛ toɔ kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ mi munyu ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ ko ji mi; ja Mawu mohu!” Nɛ e de mi ke: “Koo sɔu kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ mi gbami munyu ɔmɛ a nya, ejakaa be ɔ su.
Nɔ nɛ dɛ ɔ, ha e ya nɔ nɛ e pee nihi nɛ dɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ji mutsɛ ɔ, ha e ya nɔ nɛ e wo e he mu; nɛ nɔ nɛ ji dalɔ ɔ, ha e ya nɔ nɛ e tsu dami ni ɔmɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ha e ya nɔ nɛ e hi klɔuklɔu.” “Oʼɛ, i ma nɔuu, nɛ i hɛɛ ye hiɔwo ɔ kɛ ma, nɛ ma wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ e ni tsumi ɔ nya.
Ami ji Alfa a kɛ omega a nɛ, sisije ɔ kɛ nyagbe ɔ, kekleekle nɔ ɔ kɛ nyagbe nɔ ɔ.” A gbaa nihi nɛ fɔɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he ɔ, konɛ a na wami tso ɔ nɔ yiblii ɔ yemi he blɔ, nɛ a gu a gbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ sɛ ma a mi.
Se ma a se ɔ, gbe ɔmɛ kɛ nyuali ɔmɛ kɛ ya holi ɔmɛ kɛ awi yeli ɔmɛ kɛ amaga jali ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ lakpa nɛ ngɔɔ nya a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
“Imi Yesu, i tsɔ ye bɔfo ɔ konɛ e ba ye ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi.
Ami ji David sipoku ɔ kɛ e nina a, nɔkɔ nɛ ngɛ kpee ɔ.” Mumi ɔ kɛ Ayɛflo ɔ ke: “Ba!” Nɛ nɔ nɛ nuɔ ɔ, e de ke: “Ba!” Nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ tɔe ɔ, e ba, nɛ nɔ nɛ suɔ ɔ, e ba nɛ e ba yɛ wami nyu ɔ yaka gu.
Nyagbe Imi Yohane i ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ mi gbami munyu ɔmɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ke: Ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ́ ko piɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, Mawu maa ngɔ haomihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ mi ɔ ngɔ piɛ he ngɔ ha lɛ.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko je nɔ́ ko kɛ je kikɛmɛ a gbami womi nɛ mi munyu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Mawu ma je e blɔ nya kɛ maa je wami tso ɔ yiblii ɔ yemi kɛ ma klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ nihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ mi ɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ kikɛmɛ a ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase ɔ ngɛ dee ke: “Ee, i ma nɔuu.” Amen.
Ee, ba, Mawetsɛ Yesu!
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!
Amen.
Je ɔ bɔmi sane Sisije ɔ, benɛ Mawu bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, je ɔ be su pɔtɛɛ ko; e fɔɔ si gu.
Diblii kpii ha muɔ voo kɛ e mi nyu babauu ɔ nya, nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ si bɔlee ngɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu fa ke, “La nɛ ba”; nɛ la ba.
Mawu na la a, nɛ la a muɔ e hɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mawu je la a kɛ je diblii ɔ he.
E wo la a biɛ ke “Piani” nɛ e tsɛ diblii ɔ ke “Nyɔ.” Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee kekleekle ligbi.
- Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mawu fa ke, “Nɔ́ ko nɛ ba nɛ e ba gba nyu ɔ mi enyɔ”.
Nɛ e ba mi ja.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu pee nɔ́ ko kɛ gba nyu ɔ mi; nyu ɔ fa ba je nɔ́ ɔ sisi, nɛ fa ba je e yi mi.
Mawu wo nɔ́ ɔ biɛ ke “Hiɔwe”.
Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji enyɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mawu fa ke, “Nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ sisi ɔ nɛ bua e he nya ngɛ he kake, konɛ zugba gbigbli nɛ je kpo.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.
Mawu wo he nɛ gbli ɔ biɛ ke “Zugba”, nɛ nyu ɔ nɛ bua e he nya a, e tsɛ lɛ ke “Wo”.
Mawu na, nɛ e muɔ e hɛ.
Jehanɛ Mawu fa ke, “Tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a puɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ: tsohi nɛ woɔ ngma loo wu, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ yiblii.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.
Ba kɛ tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi puɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, eko tsuaa eko kɛ e yiblii.
Mawu na ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ.
Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji etɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ Mawu fa ke, “Kanehi nɛ a ba hiɔwe konɛ a kɛ na slɔɔto ngɛ piani kɛ nyɔ a kpɛti, nɛ́ a tsɔɔ jeha mi gbamihi jehahi, kɛ be nɛ a kɛ yeɔ nyami ligbihi pɔtɛɛ komɛ.
Kane ɔmɛ nɛ a tso ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ a la a nɛ kpɛ kɛ hyɛ zugba a nɔ.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.
Mawu pee kane ngua enyɔ: e pee kane nɛ tsoɔ wawɛɛ pe kulaa a nɛ e ye piani nɔ, kɛ kaketsɛ ɔ hu nɛ e ye nyɔ nɔ.
E pee dodoehi hulɔ.
Mawu ngɔ kane ɔmɛ ngɔ to hiɔwe, konɛ a tso kɛ hyɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ́ a ye piani kɛ nyɔ a nɔ, nɛ́ a gba la kɛ diblii a mi.
Mawu na ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ.
Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji eywiɛ.
Jehanɛ Mawu fa ke, “Nyu ɔ nɛ wo lo slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu, nɛ́ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a hi tee ngɛ hiɔwe.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔ wo mi lohwe nguanguahi, pa mi lo munomunohi, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi.
Mawu na ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ.
Mawu gbaa mɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ he nɛ hiɛ; nyɛ hyi wo ɔ mi, konɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ hu nɛ a hiɛ babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.” Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji enuɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mawu fa ke, “Lohwe slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a ba zugba a nɔ: we mi lohwehi kɛ pu mi lohwehi, lohwe agboagbohi kɛ lohwe wawihi.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.
Mawu bɔ lohwe tsuaa lohwe: pu mi lohwehi, we mi lohwehi, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si.
Mawu na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ.
Mawu de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ waa pee nɔmlɔ adesa; a maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a maa je wɔ.
A maa ye lo ɔmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, pu mi lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si ngɛ zugba a tsuo a nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔ nɔmlɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛ ɔ; e bɔ nyumu kɛ yo.
Mawu gbaa mɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛɛ hiɛ; nyɛɛ hyi zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ nyɛɛ ye zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye lo ɔmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ zugba a nɔ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I ngɔ tsohi kulaa nɛ woɔ ngma, loo wu, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ yiblii ngɛ zugba a nɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye.
Se pu mi lohwe ɔmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ lohwe kpa amɛ tsuo lɛɛ i ha mɛ nga nɛ a kpe, kɛ ba mumu nɛ a ye.” Nɛ e ba mi ja.
Mawu na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ, nɛ a muɔ e hɛ saminya.
Nɛ je jɔ, nɛ je na; nɛ e pee ligbi nɛ ji ekpa.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu pee nɛ e kɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mawu tsu ní ligbi ekpa, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e jɔɔ e he.
E gbaa ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ ligbi klɔuklɔu; jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ e bɔ je ɔ gbe nya, nɛ e jɔɔ e he, ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ e tsu kɛ bɔ je ɔ, e gbe nya.
Sane nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu bɔ je ɔ. Ngmɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Eden ɔ Benɛ Yawɛ Mawu bɔ je ɔ, tso ko tso ko be zugba a nɔ, nɛ nga ko hu puɛ́ ngɛ nɔ; ejakaa e ha we nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ lolo; nɛ nɔ ko hu be nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ hue.
Se ke pee ɔ, nyu jeɔ zugba a mi kɛ ba pɔɔ zugba a hɛ mi tsuo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu ngɔ zugba zu kɛ puɛ nɔmlɔ, nɛ e mu mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami ngɔ wo nɔmlɔ gugwɔ puɔ mi; nɛ nɔmlɔ pee adesa hɛngmengmletsɛ.
Yawɛ Mawu pee ngmɔ ko ngɛ Eden, ngɛ beleku je, nɛ lejɛ ɔ e ngɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ e puɛ ɔ ngɔ to.
E ha tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi puɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi: tsohi nɛ ngɛ fɛu, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ yiblii nɛ a yeɔ.
Tso nɛ haa nɔ wami, kɛ tso nɛ haa nɔ leɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami maa si ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu.
Pa ko je Eden kɛ ba gu ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e haa ngmɔ ɔ nyu.
Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, pa a gba kɔni eywiɛ.
A tsɛɛ kekleekle kɔni ɔ ke Pishon.
Lɛ ji pa nɛ bɔle Havila zugba a tsuo, he nɛ a naa sika tsu ngɛ ɔ.
A naa sika tsu ngmingmiingmi, nu kɛ e he via, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Pa kɔni enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji Gihon; lɛ ji pa nɛ bɔle Kush zugba a tsuo.
Pa kɔni etɛne ɔ biɛ ji Tigris; e bee ngɛ Asiria beleku je.
Kɔni eywiɛne ɔ ji Yufrate.
Jehanɛ Yawɛ Mawu ngɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ kɛ ya to Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi, konɛ e hu mi nɛ e hyɛ nɔ.
E wo lɛ mlaa ke, “Tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ye eko tsuaa eko yiblii faa, ja tso ɔ nɛ haa nɔ leɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami ɔ pɛ.
Koo ye jamɛ a tso ɔ yiblii; ligbi nɛ o maa ye eko ɔ, o ma gbo.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu de ke, “E hí kaa nyumu ɔ nɔ kake too nɛ hi si; ma ha lɛ he piɛlɔ nɛ sa lɛ.” -Yawɛ Mawu de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa benɛ e ngɔ zugba zu kɛ puɛ je nɛ ɔ mi lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo gbe nya a, ekoeko be nɛ sa nɔmlɔ kaa e he piɛlɔ.
Nɔmlɔ ɔ wo lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo biɛ: we mi lohwehi, pu mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ.
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ eko ɔ, jã pee e biɛ.
Se lɛ nɔmlɔ ɔ nitsɛ lɛɛ a na we he piɛlɔ nɛ sa we lɛ lolo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu ha mahe vii ko ba nɔ nyumu ɔ nɔ, nɛ benɛ e ngɛ mahe ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Mawu je nyumu ɔ kasa wu kake nɛ e kɛ he lo tsi lejɛ ɔ. Yawɛ Mawu ngɔ kasa wu ɔ nɛ e je ngɛ nyumu ɔ he ɔ kɛ pee yo, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ba ha nyumu ɔ. Nyumu ɔ de ke, “Ɛhɛɛ!
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i na ye henɔ tutuutu: imi nitsɛ ye muɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A je lɛ kɛ je nyumu mi; a ma tsɛ lɛ yo.” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ nyumu siɔ e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e ngɔɔ e he ya mɛtɛɛ e yo he nɛ a peeɔ nɔ kake ɔ nɛ.
Nyumu ɔ kɛ e yo ɔ tsuo hɛɛ a he gu, se zo pee we mɛ.
Nɔmlɔ gbo tue Nga mi lohwehi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ Mawu pee ɔ, sinɔ ji gatsɛ pe mɛ tsuo.
Sinɔ bi yo ɔ ke, “Anɛ Mawu de nyɛ niinɛ ke tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye ekoeko nɔ yiblii lo?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Wa ma nyɛ maa ye tso yiblii tsuaa tso yiblii, ja tso ɔ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu ɔ pɛ.
Mawu ke wa ko ye jamɛ a tso ɔ yiblii, nɛ wa ko ta he hulɔ; ke wa pee ja a, wa ma gbo.” Sinɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Oo, nyɛ be gboe!
Mawu de ja, ejakaa e le kaa ke nyɛ ye jamɛ a tso ɔ yiblii ɔ, nyɛ hɛngmɛ ma bli, nɛ nyɛ maa hi kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ; nyɛ maa le kpakpa kɛ yayami.” Yo ɔ na kaa tso ɔ ngɛ fɛu; e na kaa tso ɔ yiblii ɔ maa ngɔ, nɛ e ma ha nɛ nɔ maa le ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ eko nɛ e ye, nɛ e ha e huno ɔ hu eko nɛ e ye.
Benɛ a ye tso yiblii ɔ pɛ nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a na anɔkuale ɔ; a na kaa a hɛɛ a he gu, nɛ a kpɛ ba kɛ pee bo nɛ a kɛ ha a mlɛ mi.
Jamɛ a gbɔkuɛ ɔ, benɛ kɔɔhiɔ yluduu ko ngɛ fiae ɔ, nyumu ɔ kɛ e yo ɔ nu Yawɛ Mawu he nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Yawɛ Mawu tsɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Jije o ngɛ?” E he nɔ ke, “I nu o he ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi; ye tsui po, nɛ i ya laa ye he, ejakaa i hɛɛ ye he gu.” Mawu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ de mo ke o hɛɛ o he gu ɔ?
Tso yiblii ɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ko ye ɔ, tse o ya ye eko?” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yo ɔ nɛ o ngɔ ba piɛ ye he ɔ, lɛ nɛ ha mi tso ɔ yiblii ɔ eko nɛ i ye.” Yawɛ Mawu bi yo ɔ ke, “Mɛni ha nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Sinɔ ɔ lɛ mlɔɔ mi; enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ye ɔ nɛ.” Mawu gbla a tue Yawɛ Mawu de sinɔ ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a gbiɛ mo pe je mi lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo.
Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, o maa sã si ngɛ o muklii mi nɔ; nɛ o maa ye zu o wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ma pee o kɛ yo ɔ he nyɛli; o nina kɛ lɛ hu e nina maa pee he nyɛli.
A maa fia o yi nɔ́, nɛ mo hu o maa kɔ a nane se ja.” Jehanɛ, e de yo ɔ ke, “Ma ha nɛ o maa na nɔ́ ngɛ o hɔ ngɔmi kɛ o bi fɔmi mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o maa suɔ o huno ɔ, nɛ lɛ nɛ e maa ye o nɔ.” - Nyumu ɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ Mawu de lɛ ke, “O ya bu o yo ɔ tue nɛ o ye tso ɔ yiblii ɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ko ye ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i gbiɛ zugba zu ɔ; nga kɛ mio maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ, nɛ nga nɔ tsohi ji nɔ́ nɛ o maa ye.
O ma tsu ní kpakpataa nɛ o maa nyla o hɛ mi latsa loko zugba a maa ba ní bɔ nɛ sa ha mo nɛ o ye.
O maa pee enɛ ɔ daa kɛ yaa si a maa pu mo ngɛ zu ɔ nɛ i tĩ kɛ puɛ mo ɔ mi.
Zu ji mo, nɛ o maa kpale kɛ ya zu mi ekohu.” Adam wo e yo ɔ biɛ ke Hawa, nɛ e de ke, “I wo mo kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nimli adesahi tsuo a nyɛ ji mo.” Nɛ Yawɛ Mawu ngɔ lohwehi a he womi kɛ kpɛ tade ngɔ wo Adam kɛ e yo ɔ.
A fie Adam kɛ Hawa kɛ je ngmɔ ɔ mi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyumu ɔ ngɛ kaa wa ti nɔ kake pɛ, nɛ e le kpakpa kɛ yayami.
Ma hyɛ nɛ e ko ya tsɔ tso ɔ nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ e yiblii nɛ e ye, nɛ e ba hi je mi kɛ ya neneene.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu je Adam we; e fie lɛ kɛ je Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi, konɛ e ya hu zugba zu ɔ nɛ a kɛ puɛ lɛ ɔ. E fie nyumu ɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ kerubhi kɛ klaate ya to Eden ngmɔ ɔ beleku je, konɛ a bu blɔ ɔ nɛ a guu nɔ kɛ yaa tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ he.
Klaate ɔ ngɛ tsoe plamplam kaa la, nɛ e ngɛ e he poe.
Kain kɛ Habel Adam kɛ e yo Hawa na bɔmi, nɛ Hawa ba na mi nɛ e fɔ binyumu, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Kain.
Hawa de ke, “I wo lɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛ ye he nɛ i kɛ na binyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kain se ɔ, Hawa fɔ binyumu ekohu nɛ e wo lɛ Habel.
Habel ní tsumi ji to hyɛmi, se Kain lɛɛ ngmɔ hulɔ ji lɛ.
Be ko ɔ, Kain ngɔ e ngmɔ mi ní ɔmɛ eko kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Habel hu ngɔ kekleekle bi nɛ e jijɔ ɔmɛ eko fɔ ɔ kɛ ba.
E gbe lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lo ɔ hehi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ sã bɔ.
Yawɛ bua jɔ Habel kɛ e bɔ ɔ he.
Se Kain lɛɛ Yawɛ na we e he bua jɔmi; e bɔ ɔ hu Yawɛ he we.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Kain mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e hɛ dɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi Kain ke, “Mɛni he je o mi mi fu nɛ o tu o hɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
E ji o pee nɔ́ nɛ hi jinɛ i ko na o he bua jɔmi.
Se akɛnɛ o ya pee we nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, yayami buu si ngɛ o sinya a nya kaa lohwe dikalɔ nɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa tu mla mo.
Se, hyɛ nɛ o ye yayami ɔ nɔ.” Pee se ɔ, Kain de e senɔ Habel ke, “Ha nɛ waa ho nga nɔ ya.” Benɛ a ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, Kain nu e senɔ ɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi Kain ke, “Jije o senɔ Habel ngɛ?” E he nɔ ke, “I li; imi lɛ i hyɛɛ ye senɔ ɔ nɔ lo?” Jehanɛ, Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de Kain ke, “O senɔ ɔ muɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ, e hia kaa ma ye e he lue.
Zugba a mii o senɔ ɔ nɛ o gbe ɔ e muɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbiɛ mo.
Ke o hu ɔ, zugba a be ní bae ha mo hu; o maa bɔ kó, nɛ o maa wo lalaalo ngɛ je ɔ mi.” Kain de Yawɛ ke, “Ye tue gblami ɔ nya wa ha mi tsɔ.
Mwɔnɛ ɔ, o fie mi kɛ je zugba a nɔ, nɛ i be o hɛ mi bae hu.
Ma bɔ kó, nɛ ma wo lalaalo ngɛ je ɔ mi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na mi ɔ maa gbe mi.” Se Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, pi ja!
Ke nɔ ko gbe mo ɔ, a maa gbla nɔ ɔ tue si kpaago.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ to Kain he so, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke nɔ ko na lɛ nɛ e ko gbe lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Kain je Yawɛ hɛ mi nɛ e ya hi Nod zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Eden beleku je.
Kain nina Kain kɛ e yo ɔ na bɔmi; yo ɔ ngɔ hɔ nɛ e fɔ binyumu, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Henok.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Kain ngɛ ma ko poe, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɔ e binyumu ɔ biɛ kɛ wo ma a. Henok fɔ Irad, Irad fɔ Mehuyael, Mehuyael fɔ Metushael, nɛ Metushael fɔ Lamek.
Lamek ngɔ yihi enyɔ, Ada kɛ Zila.
Ada fɔ Yabal; e nina ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hii bo tsuhi a mi nɛ a lɛɛ lohwehi ɔ nɛ.
A tsɛɛ e nyɛminyumu ke Yubal; lɛɛ e nina ji saku fiali kɛ bɛ kpali tsuo.
Zila hu fɔ binyumu; e biɛ ji Tubal Kain.
Lɛɛ e kɛ akɔblee kɛ dade sɔɔ níhi.
Tubal Kain nyɛmiyo ji Naama.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Lamek de e yi ɔmɛ ke, “Ada kɛ Zila, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Lamek yihi, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ tue.
I gbe niheyo ko, ejakaa e fia mi nɔ́, nɛ e plaa mi.
Ke a maa ye Kain he lue si kpaago ɔ, Lamek lɛɛ a maa ye e he lue si nyingmi kpaago kɛ kpaago.” Set kɛ Enosh Adam kɛ e yo ɔ na bɔmi ekohu nɛ e fɔ binyumu, nɛ Hawa wo lɛ biɛ ke Set.
Hawa de ke, “I wo lɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu ha mi binyumu kɛ to Habel nɛ Kain gbe lɛ ɔ nane mi.” Set hu fɔ binyumu nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Enosh.
Jamɛ a be ɔ ji be nɛ nimli bɔni Yawɛ biɛ tsɛmi kɛ lɛ jami.
Adam nina Adam nina he sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ Mawu bɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, e pee nɔmlɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ e ngɛ ɔ. E bɔ nyumu kɛ yo nɛ e gbaa mɛ, nɛ e wo mɛ biɛ ke “adesa.” Benɛ Adam ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu ko nɛ je lɛ saminya, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Set.
Benɛ a fɔ Set se ɔ, Adam hi si jeha nɛ e fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi.
Adam ye jeha nɛ e gbo.
Benɛ Set ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Enosh.
Nɛ́ a fɔ Enosh se ɔ, Set hi si jeha nɛ e fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jeha abɔ nɛ Set ye loko e gbo ji .
Benɛ Enosh ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kenan.
Nɛ́ a fɔ Kenan se ɔ, Enosh hi si jeha .
E fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi, nɛ e gbo benɛ e ye jeha .
Benɛ Kenan ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mahalalel.
Nɛ́ a fɔ Mahalalel se ɔ, Kenan hi si jeha .
E fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi, nɛ e gbo benɛ e ye jeha .
Benɛ Mahalalel ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yared.
Nɛ́ a fɔ Yared se ɔ, Mahalalel hi si jeha .
E fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi, nɛ e gbo benɛ e ye jeha .
Benɛ Yared ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Enok.
Nɛ́ a fɔ Enok se ɔ, Yared hi si jeha .
E fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi, nɛ e gbo benɛ e ye jeha .
Benɛ Enok ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Metusela.
Nɛ́ a fɔ Metusela se ɔ, Enok kɛ Mawu hi si saminya jeha .
E fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi, nɛ e hi si jeha .
Enok kɛ Mawu hi si saminya e wami be ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a nɛ lɛ hu; ejakaa Mawu ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho.
Benɛ Metusela ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Lamek.
Nɛ́ a fɔ Lamek se ɔ, Metusela hi si jeha .
E fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi, nɛ e gbo benɛ e ye jeha .
Benɛ Lamek ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu.
E de ke, “Dengme nɛ wa ngɛ gboe kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ gbiɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, bi nɛ ɔ ma ba wo wa bua.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo jokuɛ ɔ biɛ ke Noa.
Benɛ a fɔ Noa se ɔ, Lamek hi si jeha .
E fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyi kpahi, nɛ e gbo benɛ e ye jeha .
Benɛ Noa ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumuhi etɛ.
Mɛ ji Shem, Ham, kɛ Yafet.
Adesa yi mi wa Nimli adesahi a he ba hiɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ a fɔ biyihi.
Mawu binyumu ɔmɛ ekomɛ na kaa yi nɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ fɛu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ a suɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de ke, “I be hae nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ hi je mi kɛ ya neneene; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ gboɔ ji lɛ.
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, nɔmlɔ be yee pe jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi, benɛ Mawu binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ nimli a biyi ɔmɛ, ba na bɔmi, nɛ a kɛ mɛ bɔni fɔmi ɔ, oblaihi ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Mɛ ji blema katsɛmɛ, kɛ nimli nɛ a he biɛ.
Benɛ Yawɛ na kaa nimlihi a yi mi wa, nɛ nɔ́ yaya pɛ a susuɔ daa nɛ ɔ, e dɔ lɛ nɛ e pia e he kaa e bɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ wo je ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ de ke, “Ma kpata nɔmlɔ nɛ i bɔ ɔ e hɛ mi; pi nɔmlɔ kɛkɛ, se lohwehi tsuo: nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si.
E dɔ mi kaa i pee mɛ.” Se Noa lɛɛ, Yawɛ bua jɔ e he.
Noa he sane - Noa he sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Noa ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Shem, Ham, kɛ Yafet.
Noa nɛ ɔ, piami ko be e he; e be ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji dalɔ, nɛ e peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní.
Se nimli kpa amɛ lɛɛ a peeɔ yayami ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ basabasa ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu na kaa je ɔ puɛ, ejakaa nimli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ yayami pee.
Mawu de Noa ke, “I to kaa ma kpata nimli adesahi tsuo kulaa a hɛ mi, ejakaa a ha je ɔ tsuo pee kɛ yayami sɔuu.
Ɛɛ, ma kpata a kɛ je ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ngɔɔ tso kpakpa nɛ o kɛ kpɛ lɛ.
Moo pee tsuhi ngɛ mi, nɛ o ngɔ amã kɛ kpa lɛ ɔ he kɛ e mi tsuo.
Bɔ nɛ o maa kpɛ lɛ ɔ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: lɛ ɔ kami nɛ pee gugue nyingmi kpaago kɛ enuɔ, e blimi nɛ pee gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, konɛ e mi kuɔmi nɛ pee gugue kpaago kɛ fa.
Mo bu lɛ ɔ yi, nɛ o si blɔ maa pee nine mi blimi enyɔ ngɛ gba a kɛ lɛ ɔ nitsɛ a kpɛti.
Moo kpɛ lɛ ɔ kaa hiɔwe tsu siaudo etɛ, nɛ o je sinya ngɛ kasa nya.
Ma ha nɛ nyu kpekpemi maa ba je ɔ mi nɛ e ma kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wami ngɛ e mi ɔ hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata, se moo lɛɛ i kɛ mo maa so.
O kɛ o yo, kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a yi ɔmɛ nɛ ba sɛ lɛ ɔ mi.
-Ngɔɔ lohwe tsuaa lohwe, eku kɛ eyo kɛ ba lɛ ɔ mi, konɛ a yi nɛ na wami: pɛlitsɛmɛ, nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si.
Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ, niye ní slɔɔtohi kɛ to, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ ye.” Nɛ Noa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ.
Nyu kpekpemi ɔ Yawɛ de Noa ke, “Yaa sɛ lɛ ɔ mi; mo, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ o we ɔ mi ɔ tsuo; ejakaa i na kaa mo pɛ ji nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Ngɔɔ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ, eku kpaago kɛ eyo kpaago, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we lɛɛ eku kɛ eyo kakaaka pɛ kɛ wo lɛ ɔ mi.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ hu, ngɔɔ eko tsuaa eko eku kpaago kɛ eyo kpaago kɛ wo lɛ ɔ mi.
Moo pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo a yi nɛ na wami, nɛ a fɔ kɛ wo je ɔ mi ekohu.
Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ otsi ɔ, ma ha nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ ma kpata níhi tsuo nɛ i bɔ nɛ wami ngɛ a mi ɔ a hɛ mi.” Noa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ. Noa ye jeha lafa ekpa benɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ ba je ɔ mi ɔ. E kɛ e yo, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a yi ɔmɛ ya sɛ lɛ ɔ mi nɛ a kɛ tu nyu kpekpemi ɔ nya fo.
-Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu fa Noa a, lohwe tsuaa lohwe ya sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, eku kɛ eyo eku kɛ eyo: lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we, pɛlitsɛmɛ, nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si tsuo.
Ligbi kpaago se ɔ, nyu kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ Noa ye jeha lafa ekpa a, jamɛ a jeha a we hlami enyɔne ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaago ɔ nɔ ɔ, zugba a nɔ nyu hɛngmɛhi babauu ɔ tsuo hia, nɛ hiɔwe saflɛ ɔmɛ tsuo bli, nɛ hiɔmi nɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Noa kɛ e yo ɔ, kɛ e binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ, Shem, Ham, kɛ Yafet, kɛ mɛ hu a yi ɔmɛ sɛ lɛ ɔ mi.
A kɛ lohwe slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi sɛ lɛ ɔ mi: we mi lohwehi, pu mi lohwehi, lohwe nguahi kɛ wawihi, kɛ pɛlitsɛmɛ.
-Kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu fa Noa a, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wami ngɛ e mi ɔ kɛ mɛ sɛ lɛ ɔ mi eku kɛ eyo eku kɛ eyo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ nga sinya a kɛ wo Noa yi.
Nyu kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ.
Benɛ nyu ɔ ba hiɛ saii ɔ, e wo lɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ je zugba.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nyu ɔ ba babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ lɛ ɔ hia nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae ngɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi.
-Jehanɛ, nyu ɔ ba babauu nitsɛ kɛ ya si e ha yo gagaaga amɛ tsuo a nɔ nɛ a yi laa maa pee gugue eywiɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ wami ngɛ e mi ɔ gbo: lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, we mi lohwehi, pu mi lohwehi, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Je mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ woɔ mumi ɔ gbo.
Yawɛ kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi: nimli adesahi, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si.
Noa kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ pɛ nɛ a piɛ.
Nyu kpekpemi ɔ ha zugba a nɔ ligbi lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Nyu kpekpemi ɔ se po Mawu kai Noa kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ; Mawu ha nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ko ba fia, nɛ nyu ɔ bɔni miimi.
A tsi nyu hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a a nya, nɛ a nga hiɔwe saflɛ ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔmi ɔ se po, nɛ nyu ɔ bɔni miimi bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ligbi lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ se ɔ, nyu ɔ nɔ gbɔ.
Hlami kpaagone ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaago ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ ɔ ba sa si ngɛ Ararat yo ɔ he.
Nyu ɔ mii hluu kɛ ya si hlami nɛ ji nyɔngma a. Hlami nɛ ji nyɔngma a kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, yo ɔmɛ a yi mi je kpo.
Ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ se ɔ, Noa bli saflɛ ɔ nɛ e je ngɔ wo lɛ ɔ nɛ e kpɛ ɔ he ɔ, nɛ e ngmɛɛ kuakualabite ko he.
Se kuakualabite ɔ kpale we kɛ bɛ; e te kɛ bɔle si hluu kɛ ya si be nɛ nyu ɔ mii ta zugba a nɔ.
Nɛ́ Noa na kaa kuakualabite ɔ bɛ ɔ, e ngmɛɛ okpo ko hu he nɛ e kɛ hyɛ kaa nyu ɔ mii ta lo.
Se okpo ɔ nɛ he ko nɛ e ma, ejakaa nyu ha zugba a tsuo nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale kɛ ba lɛ ɔ he.
Noa sɔle e nine nɛ e nu okpo ɔ kɛ wo lɛ ɔ mi.
E mlɛ otsi, nɛ e ngmɛɛ okpo ɔ he ekohu.
Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, okpo ɔ kpale kɛ ba Noa ngɔ kɛ e nya he oliv tso ba mumu; nɛ enɛ ɔ Noa kɛ le kaa nyu ɔ mii ta zugba a nɔ.
E mlɛ otsi ekohu, nɛ e ngmɛɛ okpo ɔ he.
Se jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ okpo ɔ kpale we kɛ bɛ hu.
Benɛ Noa ye jeha ɔ, jamɛ a jeha a we kekleekle hlami ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyu ɔ mii ta zugba a nɔ.
Noa jé lɛ ɔ yi bumi nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa zugba a gbli.
Hlami enyɔne ɔ, ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago ɔ nɔ ɔ, zugba a nɔ gbli ta.
Mawu de Noa ke, “O kɛ o yo ɔ, kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ a yi ɔmɛ nɛ je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi.
Je lohwe ɔmɛ kpo kɛ ba: pɛlitsɛmɛ, nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si, konɛ a fɔ nɛ a ha zugba a tsuo nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Noa kɛ e yo ɔ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ a yi ɔmɛ je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi.
Lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi, kɛ a henɔ kɛ a henɔ: pɛlitsɛmɛ, nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si.
Noa sã bɔ Noa ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e ngɔ we mi lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ eko tsuaa eko kɛ sã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ: pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ.
Yawɛ nu bɔ ɔ he via, nɛ e ná he bua jɔmi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e he ke, “I be níhi nɛ wami ngɛ a mi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi kpatae kikɛ nɛ ɔ hu kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ligbi abɔ nɛ je ɔ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ní dumi kɛ ní kpami be, fĩɛ be kɛ latsa be, gbo kɛ gbiɛ, nyɔ kɛ pia se be poe gblegbleegble.”
Mawu kɛ Noa so Mawu gbaa Noa kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ he nɛ hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ hyi je ɔ mi tsuo.
I ngɔ lohi kɛ je mi lohwehi: nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si tsuo ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ gbeye.
I ngɔ mɛ tsuo ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye, kaa bɔ nɛ i ha nyɛ pui ba a. Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ko ye ji lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ; i kplɛɛ we enɛ ɔ, ejakaa muɔ ɔ, wami ngɛ mi.
Ke nɔ ko pue nɔmlɔ adesa muɔ si ɔ, a maa gbla e tue.
Lohwe tsuaa lohwe nɛ maa gbe nɔmlɔ adesa a, ma gbe lɛ.
I pee nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ imi, Mawu ɔ nitsɛ i ngɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma pue nɔmlɔ adesa muɔ si ɔ, e nyɛmi nɔmlɔ adesa nɔuu ma pue lɛ hu e muɔ si.
“Nyɛ fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ he nɛ hiɛ, konɛ nyɛ hyi je ɔ.” Alale Mawu de Noa kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, -“I kɛ nyɛ, kɛ nyɛ nina, kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ soe: lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, we mi lohwehi, kɛ pu mi lohwehi.
I ngɛ si woe kaa kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, a kɛ nyu kpekpemi be níhi nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle a hɛ mi kpatae hu kɔkɔɔkɔ; nyu kpekpemi ba be je ɔ hɛ mi kpatae hu kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle ngɛ soe nɛ ɔ ji somi nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
E he okadi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ngɔ ye alale ngɔ to bɔku mi, nɛ e pee okadi kɛ ha somi nɛ i kɛ je ɔ so ɔ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ ma ngɔ bɔku kɛ ha hiɔwe nɛ alale maa ngmaa si ngɛ mi ɔ, ma kai si nɛ i wo nyɛɛ kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo kaa i kɛ nyu kpekpemi be níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle a hɛ mi kpatae hu kɔkɔɔkɔ ɔ. Ke alale ɔ ngmaa si ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ma na nɛ ma kai neneene somi ɔ nɛ ngɛ imi Mawu, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle ɔ wa kpɛti ɔ. Si nɛ i ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle woe ɔ, e he okadi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Noa kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ Noa binyumuhi nɛ je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ji Shem, Ham, kɛ Yafet.
Ham binyumu ji Kanaan.
Noa binyumu etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a mi lɛ nimli tsuo kulaa nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ je.
Noa a, ngmɔ hulɔ ji lɛ; lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ pee wai ngmɔ.
Be ko ɔ, e nu wai nɛ e de, nɛ e ho ya hwɔ si kɛ e he gu ngɛ e bo tsu ɔ mi.
Benɛ Ham, Kanaan tsɛ ɔ, na e tsɛ Noa nɛ hwɔɔ si kɛ e he gu ɔ, e je kpo nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha e wetsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Shem kɛ Yafet ngɔ bo ngɔ fɔ a konɔ, nɛ a nyɛɛ senyasenya nɛ a kɛ bo ɔ ya ha a tsɛ ɔ he; a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ fɔ he kpa, nɛ a nɛ a tsɛ ɔ he gu ɔ. Benɛ wai ɔ tsɔ ngɛ Noa hɛ mi, nɛ e na le nɔ́ nɛ e bi jokuɛyo ɔ pee lɛ ɔ, e de ke, “A gbiɛ Kanaan!
E maa pee e wetsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nyɔguɛ.
A je Yawɛ, Shem Mawu ɔ yi!
Kanaan maa pee Shem nyɔguɛ.
Mawu nɛ ha nɛ Yafet nɛ plɔke!
E nina kɛ Shem nina maa hi si!
Kanaan maa pee Yafet nyɔguɛ.” Nyu kpekpemi ɔ se ɔ, Noa hi si jeha , nɛ e gbo benɛ e ye jeha .
Noa bimɛ ɔmɛ a nina Noa binyumuhi, Shem, Ham, kɛ Yafet ɔ, a binyumuhi nɛ a fɔ ngɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ se ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yafet bimɛ ji Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yavan, Tubal, Meshek, kɛ Tiras bi.
Gomer nina ji Ashkenaz, Rifat, Togarma bi.
Yavan nina ji Elisha, Spania, Kipro, kɛ Rodo bi.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ wo nya zugba amɛ kɛ wo kpɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a nɛmɛ ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yafet nina ji mɛ tsuo.
A ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugbahi a nɔ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e ma mi gbi.
Ham bimɛ ji Kush, Egipt, Libia, kɛ Kanaan bi.
Kush nina ji Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raama, kɛ Sabteka bi.
Raama nina ji Sheba kɛ Dedan bi.
Kush binyumu ji Nimrod, nɛ Nimrod nɛ ɔ ji kekleekle tatsɛ kpanaa ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Yawɛ gbaa lɛ nɛ e ba pee detsɛ ngua.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a kɛ e biɛ buu abɛ ke, “Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ o ba pee detsɛ ngua kaa Nimrod!” Kekleekle ɔ, Nimrod nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ ji Babilon, Erek, kɛ Akad ngɛ Babilonia zugba a nɔ.
Se e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya Asiria, nɛ e ya po mahi ngɛ Nineve, Rehobot Ir, Kala, kɛ Resen nɛ ngɛ Nineve kɛ ma ngua a nɛ a tsɛɛ Kala a kpɛti ɔ. Egipt bi a nina ji Lidia, Anam, Lehab, Naftu, Patrus, Kaslu (he nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ je ɔ), kɛ Kaftor bi.
Kanaan bitɛte ji Sidon, kɛ e senɔ nyumu Het.
Kanaan nina ji Yebus bi, Amor bi, Girgash bi, Hiv bi, Ark bi, Sin bi, Arvad bi, Zemar bi, kɛ Hamat bi.
Pee se ɔ, Kanaan wɛtso slɔɔto ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa.
Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a zugba a ngɛ kɛ je Sidon kɛ gu Gera hluu kɛ ya pi Gaza.
Jehanɛ, zugba a ya gu Sodom, Gomora, Adma, kɛ Zeboiim blɔ, kɛ ya pi Lasha.
Ham nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e wɛtso, kɛ ma mi he nɛ e je, kɛ gbi nɛ e tuɔ.
Yafet wetsɛ Shem ji Hebri bi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɛ̃.
Shem binyumuhi ji Elam, Ashur, Arpakshad, Lud kɛ Aram.
Aram binyumuhi ji Uz, Hul, Geter, kɛ Meshek.
Arpakshad ji Shela tsɛ, nɛ Shela ji Eber tsɛ.
Eber ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ; a wo e bitɛte ɔ biɛ ke Peleg, ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a gba nyu dɔ ngɛ zugba a mi; Peleg senɔ ɔ biɛ ji Yoktan.
Yoktan nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Almodad bi, Shelef bi, Hazarmavet bi, Yera bi, Hadoram bi, Uzal bi, Dikla bi, Obal bi, Abimael bi, Sheba bi, Ofir bi, Havila bi, kɛ Yobab bi; Yoktan nina ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
A sihi he ngɛ kɛ je Mesha kɛ ya Sefar ngɛ yoku zugba a nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nɔ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji Shem nina; nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e wɛtso, kɛ ma mi he nɛ e je, kɛ gbi nɛ e tuɔ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa ji Noa nina, ngɛ mahi kɛ wekuhi a mi hehi nɛ a je ɔ. Nyu kpekpemi ɔ se ɔ, ni nɛ ɔmɛ a mi je ma amɛ tsuo je gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
Babilon mɔ ɔ Sisije ɔ, gbi kake pɛ lɛ a tuɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Benɛ nihi bɔni blɔ hiami kɛ je beleku je ɔ, a ba su nga kplanaa ko nɔ ngɛ Babilonia zugba a nɔ, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ.
A de a he ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa po bliikisi nɛ waa sã ngɛ la mi nɛ e he nɛ wa.” A po bliikisi ɔ, nɛ a hla zu nɛ ngɛ kaa amã nɛ a kɛ maa nu bliikisi ɔ kɛ bla kɛ ma tsu.
A de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa po ma ngua ko ngɔ ha wa he, nɛ waa ma mɔ nɛ e yi mi nɛ ya su hiɔwe.
Ke wa pee ja a, wa ma na biɛ, nɛ wa be gbɛe ngɔ fia zugba a nɔ tsuo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kple si nɛ e ba hyɛ ma a, kɛ mɔ ɔ nɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ ma a, nɛ e de ke, “Ɛhɛɛ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nimli kake ji mɛ, nɛ gbi kake a tuɔ; nɔ́ nɛ a nyɛ tsu momo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E be kɛe nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ ɔ, a maa pee.
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa kple si nɛ wa ya tsaka a gbi ɔ; konɛ ke nɔ ko tu munyu ɔ, e nyɛmi nɛ ko nu sisi hu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ a kpa ma a pomi.
A wo ma a biɛ ke Babilon, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ Yawɛ tsaka ni ɔmɛ a gbi ɔ ngɛ, nɛ e gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
Shem nina Shem nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Nyu kpekpemi ɔ se jeha enyɔ benɛ Shem ye jeha a, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Arpakshad.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hi si jeha , nɛ e fɔ bimɛ kpahi.
Benɛ Arpakshad ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Shela.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hi si jeha ; nɛ e fɔ bimɛ kpahi.
Benɛ Shela ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Eber.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hi si jeha ; nɛ e fɔ bimɛ kpahi.
Benɛ Eber ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Peleg.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hi si jeha ; nɛ e fɔ bimɛ kpahi.
Benɛ Peleg ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Reu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hi si jeha ; nɛ e fɔ bimɛ kpahi.
Benɛ Reu ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Serug.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hi si jeha ; nɛ e fɔ bimɛ kpahi.
Benɛ Serug ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Nahor.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hi si jeha ; nɛ e fɔ bimɛ kpahi.
Benɛ Nahor ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Tera.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hi si jeha ; nɛ e fɔ bimɛ kpahi.
Benɛ Tera ye jeha ɔ, e fɔ binyumuhi etɛ: Abram, Nahor, kɛ Haran.
Tera nina Tera nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Tera fɔ binyumuhi etɛ: Abram, Nahor, kɛ Haran.
Haran fɔ binyumu nɛ e biɛ ji Lot.
Haran gbo ngɛ Ur, ma mi he nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ Babilonia zugba a nɔ, be mi nɛ e tsɛ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Abram ngɔ Sarai, nɛ Nahor ngɔ Milka, Haran biyo ɔ. Haran ji Milka kɛ Iska tsuo a tsɛ.
Se Sarai lɛɛ yosa ji lɛ; e fɔ we.
Tera ngɔ e binyumu Abram, kɛ e bibi Lot, Haran binyumu ɔ, kɛ e nganyɛ Sarai, Abram yo ɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ je Ur ngɛ Babilonia kɛ yaa Kanaan.
Se benɛ a su ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Haran ɔ, a ya to lejɛ ɔ. Tera gbo ngɛ Haran benɛ e ye jeha lafa enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Mawu tsɛ Abram Yawɛ de Abram ke, “Jee o zugba a nɔ, kɛ o ma a mi, kɛ o weku li a ngɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ.
Ma ha mo nina babauu, nɛ a maa pee je ma agbo.
Ma gbaa mo, nɛ ma ha o ma he biɛ, nɛ a maa gu o nɔ kɛ gbaa nihi babauu.
Nihi nɛ gbaa mo ɔ, ma gbaa mɛ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbiɛɛ mo ɔ, imi hu ma gbiɛ mɛ.
O nɔ ma gu kɛ gbaa je ma amɛ tsuo.” Abram ye jeha nyingmi kpaago kɛ enuɔ benɛ e hia kɛ je Haran kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke e pee ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Lot ho.
Abram ngɔ e yo Sarai, kɛ e wɔfase Lot, kɛ weto ní, kɛ nyɔguɛhi nɛ a na ngɛ Haran ɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Kanaan zugba a nɔ ya.
Benɛ a ya su Kanaan ɔ, Abram nyɛɛ kɛ be ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ ya su tso ngua a nɛ ngɛ More ngɛ Shekem ɔ he.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Yawɛ je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Abram nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Zugba a nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ha o nina a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abram ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ ba je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho yoku zugba a nɛ ngɛ Betel beleku je ɔ nɔ ya.
E ya ma e bo tsu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ Betel kɛ Ai a kpɛti; Betel ngɛ bonyoku je, nɛ Ai ngɛ beleku je.
Lejɛ ɔ hu e ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ nɛ e ja lɛ.
Pee se ɔ, Abram je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e tsa e blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ kɛ gu Kanaan leneyi blɔ.
Ke e nyɛɛ bɔɔ e to si bɔɔ.
Abram ngɛ Egipt Jamɛ a be ɔ, hwɔ ba Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abram pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ be saii.
Benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa su Egipt ɔ, e de e yo Sarai ke, “Sarai, i le kaa yo nɛ he ngɛ fɛu ji mo.
Ke Egipt bi ɔmɛ na mo ɔ, a ma de ke, ‘E yo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ’; kɛkɛ a maa gbe mi, se moo lɛɛ a be mo nɔ́ ko pee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de mɛ ke ye nyɛmiyo ji mo.
Ke o de mɛ ja a, o he ɔ, a be mi nɔ́ ko pee, nɛ a maa hyɛ ye nɔ saminya.” Benɛ Abram ba su Egipt ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ na kaa e yo e he ngɛ fɛu saminya.
Egipt matsɛ ɔ he ni komɛ na yo ɔ, nɛ a ya je e yi kɛ ha Farao ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho matsɛ we ɔ mi ya.
Sarai he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ hyɛ Abram nɔ saminya; Abram na jijɔhi, nahi, tejihi, nyɔguɛhi nyumuhi kɛ yihi, kɛ afukpɔngɔhi babauu.
Abram yo Sarai he je ɔ, Yawɛ ha hiɔ nɛ nya wa ko ba sɛ Farao ɔ kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ tsɔ ya tsɛ Abram kɛ ba, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o pee mi nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o de we mi ke o yo ji yo ɔ?
Mɛni he je o de mi ke o nyɛmiyo ji lɛ, nɛ i ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee ye yo ɔ?
Hyɛ, o yo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ngɔɔ lɛ, nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ je hiɛ ɔ!” Matsɛ ɔ fa e we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ha nɛ Abram, kɛ e yo ɔ, kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ je ma a mi kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Abram kɛ Lot Abram kɛ e yo kɛ Lot hia kɛ gu Egipt omleyi je kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ a ba pa si ngɛ Kanaan leneyi je.
Abram na ní kpɔtɔɔ; e ngɛ jijɔ, apletsi, na, sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu.
Pee se ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Betel ya.
Ke e nyɛɛ bɔɔ, e to si bɔɔ.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ e pee hluu kɛ ya su Betel kɛ Ai a kpɛti he nɛ e to si ngɛ kekle ɔ nɛ e ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e ja Yawɛ ngɛ.
Lot, nɛ e kɛ Abram ho ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɛ jijɔ, apletsi, na, kɛ we bi babauu.
Se zugba a klee we bɔ nɛ maa kpe Abram kɛ Lot tsuo.
A lohwe ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ pe lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, pɛ ba sɛ Abram lohwe nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ Lot lohwe nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Periz bi ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Abram de Lot ke, “Nyɛmimɛ ji wɔ; wa ko pɛ, nɛ wa ko ha nɛ pɛ ba sɛ wa lohwe nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ hu a kpɛti.
Zugba a tsuo ji tilaa ngɛ o hɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Moo po zugba a he nɛ o suɔ, konɛ o hi o dɛ he; ke o ngɔ muɔ nɔ je ɔ, ma ngɔ hiɔ nɔ je.
Ke hiɔ nɔ je o suɔ jio, imi hu ma ngɔ muɔ nɔ je.” Lot hyɛ zugba a tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ e na kaa nyu ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi tsuo babauu kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Ngmɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ, aloo kaa bɔ nɛ Egipt zugba a ngɛ kɛ ma Zoar blɔ ɔ.
Sane nɛ ɔ ba loko Yawɛ kpata Sodom kɛ Gomora hɛ mi.
Lot ngɔ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ tsuo, nɛ e hia kɛ ho beleku je ya.
Bɔ nɛ ba nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi gba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Abram hi Kanaan zugba a nɔ, se Lot lɛɛ e hi ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ a mi, nɛ e ma e bo tsu ɔ ngɛ Sodom.
Sodom ma a, yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Abram hia kɛ ho Hebron ya Benɛ Lot je Abram he ɔ, Yawɛ de Abram ke, “Kɛ je he nɛ o daa si ngɛ ɔ, moo hyɛ kɛ bɔle si, kɛ je omleyi kɛ ya leneyi, kɛ je beleku kɛ ya bonyoku.
Zugba a nɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ɔ, ma ngɔ lɛ tsuo kɛ ha mo, kɛ o nina, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ma ha nɛ o nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa tabo zu, nɛ e be hie kanemi; ke nɔ ko nyɛ kane tabo zu ɔ, lɛɛ e ma nyɛ kane o nina.
Yaa nɛ o ya kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ, ejakaa ma ngɔ kɛ wo o dɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abram gbɛ e bo tsu ɔ, nɛ e ba hi tso ngua amɛ a kasa nya ngɛ Mamre, ngɛ Hebron.
Nɛ e ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e ja lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Abram he Lot yi wami Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Amrafel; Elasar matsɛ, Ariok; Elam matsɛ, Kedorlaomer; kɛ Goim matsɛ, Tidal gba ta wo matsɛmɛ enuɔ komɛ: mɛ ji Sodom matsɛ, Bera; Gomora matsɛ, Birsha; Adma matsɛ, Shina; Zeboiim matsɛ, Shemeber; kɛ Bela (aloo Zoar) matsɛ.
Matsɛmɛ enuɔ nɛ ɔmɛ pee kake, nɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Sidim Kɔ̃ ɔ mi, he nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Ngo Wo amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Jinɛ a sɔmɔ Kedorlaomer jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, se jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a tsɔ atuã.
Jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Kedorlaomer kɛ matsɛmɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ba nɛ a ba gbe Refa bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Ashterot Kiriataim, Zuz bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Ham, kɛ Em bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Kiriataim nga a nɔ.
Jehanɛ, a gbe Hor bi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ Edom yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a nyɛɛ a se hluu kɛ ya si Elparan ngɛ nga a nya.
A kpale a se kɛ ba Kadesh nɛ sa a a tsɛɛ Enmishpat ɔ.
A ye Amalek zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ a gbe Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Hazazon Tamar a. Kɛkɛ nɛ Sodom, Gomora, Adma, Zeboiim, kɛ Bela matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya bua a ta buli ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ Sidim Kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a gba ta wo Elam matsɛ, Kedorlaomer; Goim matsɛ, Tidal; Babilonia matsɛ, Amrafel; kɛ Elasar matsɛ, Ariok.
Matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛmɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ hwu ta.
Muɔhi nɛ amã ngɛ a mi babauu ngɛ Sidim Kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ Sodom kɛ Gomora matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ fo tue ngɛ ta a nya a, a nɔɔ muɔ ɔmɛ a mi; se matsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛ lɛɛ a tu fo kɛ ho yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ya.
Matsɛmɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛ niye ní tsuaa niye ní ngɛ Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ je.
Abram wɔfase Lot ngɛ Sodom jamɛ a be ɔ mi; nɛ a ngɔ lɛ hu kɛ e níhi tsuo kɛ je.
Se nyumu ko nɛ tu fo kɛ je ta a mi ba bɔ Abram, Hebri no ɔ amaniɛ ngɛ e sihi he ɔ, ngɛ Amor no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mamre ɔ e tso ngua amɛ a kasa nya.
Mamre kɛ e nyɛminyumuhi Eshkol kɛ Aner ɔ, huɛ bɔmi ko ngɛ a kɛ Abram a kpɛti.
Benɛ Abram nu kaa a ba nu e wɔfase Lot kɛ ho ɔ, e kɛ e tsɔli lafa etɛ kɛ nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ nɛ a le ta hwumi hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ matsɛmɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a se kɛ ya su Dan tɔɔ.
E dla e we bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo kuuhi a mi, nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, a ya tua a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe mɛ basabasa.
A fie mɛ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya si Hoba, ngɛ Damasko omleyi je.
Abram kpɔ ní ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ha a tsuo ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Jehanɛ, e wɔfase Lot, kɛ e ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e yi ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ nɛ a ba nuu ɔ hu, e nine su mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ.
Melkizedek gbaa Abram Benɛ Abram ya ye Kedorlaomer kɛ matsɛmɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ a nɔ kunimi nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ma a, Sodom matsɛ ba kpee lɛ ngɛ Shave Kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Matsɛ Kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Salem matsɛ, Melkizedek, nɛ lɛ kɛ̃ ji Mawu Hiɔwe No ɔ we osɔfo ɔ, ngɔ abolo kɛ wai ba ha Abram, nɛ e gbaa lɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu Hiɔwe No, Hiɔwe kɛ zugba bɔlɔ ɔ nɛ gbaa Abram!
Mawu Hiɔwe No nɛ ha o ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a je e yi!” Abram ha Melkizedek niha ní nɛ e ya kpɔ ɔ tsuo mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake.
Sodom matsɛ ɔ de Abram ke, “Ngɔɔ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ, se ye we bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ o kɛ mɛ tsuo ba ha mi.” Abram he nɔ ke, “I na Mawu Hiɔwe No ɔ, nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, kaa i be o nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɔe, kpa jio, tokota nya fimi nɔ́ jio; konɛ o ko ba de hwɔɔ se ko ke, ‘Imi lɛ i pee Abram niatsɛ.’ Imi nitsɛ i be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɔe; nɔ́ nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ye ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ.
Se nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ mi ya a, mɛɛ lɛɛ ha mɛ a blɔ fa mi ní.
Mɛ ji Aner, Eshkol, kɛ Mamre.”
Mawu kɛ Abram so Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Abram tu munyu ngɛ nina mi ke, “Abram, koo ye gbeye.
Ma bu o he, nɛ ma gbaa mo babauu.” Se Abram he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ Mawu, o gbaami ɔ, mɛni he se ma na, imi nɛ i be bi ɔ?
Nɔ pɛ nɛ yeɔ ye ní ji Eliezer nɛ je Damasko ɔ. O ha we mi bi; lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, ye nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ma ba ye ye gbosi ní.” Yawɛ de Abram ekohu ke, “Kikɛmɛ a nyɔguɛ Eliezer nɛ ɔ be o ní yee; mo nitsɛ o bi tutuutu ji nɔ nɛ ma ba ye o gbosi ní ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ Abram kɛ je kpo nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ hiɔwe nɛ o ka kaa o ma nyɛ maa kane dodoe ɔmɛ lo; bɔ nɛ dodoe ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ, ja o nina hu maa hiɛ.” Abram he Yawɛ ye; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ bu lɛ nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Jehanɛ Yawɛ de Abram ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ e kɛ mo je Ur ngɛ Babilonia kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, konɛ ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɛ.” Abram bi lɛ ke, “Oo Yawɛ Mawu, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma le kaa zugba nɛ ɔ ma ba pee ye nɔ́?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha mi: na yo nɛ ye jeha etɛ, apletsi yo nɛ ye jeha etɛ, agbosu nɛ ye jeha etɛ, beleku lahuɛ, kɛ okpo zaa.” Abram ngɔ lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Mawu.
E poo a mi fiee enyɔɔnyɔ; e to fa kake ngɛ zã kake mi ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ e to fa kaketsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ zã kake mi ngɛ a sibi a hanɔ.
Se lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e poo we a mi.
