Okpokuhi ba sɔ̃ lohwe gbogboe ɔmɛ a nɔ, se Abram fie mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ pu maa ho si nɔmi ya a, mahe vii ko ba nɔ Abram nɔ, nɛ gbeye kɛ sawale nu lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi kaa o nina ma ya pee nibwɔhi ngɛ zugba kpa nɔ; a maa pee nyɔguɛhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a maa wa mɛ yi mi jeha lafa eywiɛ.
Se jamɛ a je ma a nɛ maa wa mɛ yi mi ɔ, ma gbla a tue.
Nyagbe ɔ, a maa muɔ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ní babauu kɛ je.
Mo nitsɛ lɛɛ o maa hi si kɛ yaa si o maa bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ o ma gbo ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a maa pu mo.
Yi nɔ eywiɛ se ɔ, o nina maa kpale kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu; ejakaa i be Amor bi ɔmɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ kɛ yaa si jamɛ a be ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a yi mi wami ɔ nya maa wa, nɛ ma gbla a tue.” Benɛ pu nɔ si nɛ du bu ɔ, ngɛyu kɛ e mi la su ku, kɛ la lilɛ ba, nɛ e gu lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a poo a mi ɔ a kpɛti kɛ be.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Abram so, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha o nina, kɛ maa je Egipt pa a nya kɛ yaa si Yufrate pa a nya.
Ken bi, Keniz bi, Kadmon bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Refaim bi, Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Girgash bi, kɛ Yebus bi a zugba a i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.”
A fɔ Ishmael Abram yo Sarai ɔ fɔ we ha lɛ.
Se e ngɛ mawayo ko nɛ je Egipt.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Hagar.
Sarai de Abram ke, “Yawɛ tsi ye fɔmi nya.
Ngɔɔ ye mawayo nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ hwɔ; alini e ma fɔ bimɛ ha mi.” Abram kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Sarai ngɔ e mawayo Hagar, Egipt no ɔ ngɔ ha e huno Abram kaa e yo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Abram na jeha nyɔngma momo ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
Abram kɛ Hagar na bɔmi, nɛ e ngɔ hɔ.
Benɛ Hagar na kaa mi ba e he pɛ, e bɔni e he nɔ womi ngɛ Sarai nɔ, nɛ e bui lɛ hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Sarai de Abram ke, “Mo lɛ o pee loko Hagar ngɛ e he nɔ woe ngɛ ye nɔ, nɛ e pa bui mi hu ɔ nɛ.
Imi nitsɛ lɛ i ngɔ lɛ kɛ ha mo.
Se kɛ je benɛ e na kaa mi ba e he ɔ, e bɔni e he nɔ womi ngɛ ye nɔ, nɛ e bui mi hu.
Yawɛ nɛ kojo wɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da, mo jio, imi jio!” Abram he nɔ ke, “Saminya!
O mawayo ji lɛ; e ngɛ o dɛ mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ kaa o maa pee lɛ ɔ, pee lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Sarai doo Hagar nya wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ Hagar tu fo kɛ je e he.
Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ kɛ Hagar kpe ngɛ pa ko nya, ngɛ Shur blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Hagar, Sarai mawayo, jije o je, nɛ jije o yaa?” E he nɔ ke, “I tu fo kɛ je ye nyɛ Sarai he.” Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Kpale o se kɛ ya e ngɔ, nɛ o ya ba o he si ha lɛ.” Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de kɛ piɛ he ke, “Ma ha o nina maa hiɛ babauu nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane mɛ.
Hyɛ, mi ngɛ o he; o ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Ishmael, ejakaa Yawɛ nu o we amanehlu kue fami ɔ.
Se o binyumu ɔ lɛɛ e hɛ mi maa hi klamaklama kaa nga mi teji; e kɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be yee; nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ lɛ maa pɛ.
Lɛ nɔ kake too e maa hɛɛ e blɔ ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti.” Hagar bi e he ke, “Anɛ i na Mawu niinɛ, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ Yawɛ nɛ kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu ɔ ke, “Mawu nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a tsɛɛ vu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Kadesh kɛ Bered a kpɛti ɔ ke “Hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ mi ɔ vu” ɔ nɛ.
Hagar fɔ binyumu ha Abram, nɛ Abram wo lɛ biɛ ke Ishmael.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Abram ye jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ ekpa.
Pomi ji somi ɔ he okadi Benɛ Abram ye jeha nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔ, Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Imi ji Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ.
Moo bu mi, nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ da daa.
I kɛ mo maa so, nɛ ma ha o nina maa hiɛ babauu nitsɛ.” Abram kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si; nɛ Mawu de lɛ ke, “I kɛ mo ngɛ soe, nɛ i ngɛ mo si woe kaa o maa pee tsɛ kɛ ha je mahi babauu.
A be mo tsɛe ke Abram hu; jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ mo Abraham, ejakaa i pee mo je mahi babauu a tsɛ.
Ma ha nɛ o nina maa hiɛ babauu, nɛ a ma ba pee je mahi, nɛ matsɛmɛ po maa je a mi.
“Si nɛ i wo mo nɛ ɔ maa pee neneene somi; ma ye nɔ ha mo kɛ yaa si yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ o se ɔ a nɔ.
Ma pee o Mawu kɛ o nina hu a Mawu.
Zugba nɛ o ba to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ha mo, kɛ o nina.
Kanaan zugba a tsuo maa pee o nina nɔ́ kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ ma pee a Mawu.” Mawu de Abraham ekohu ke, “Moo lɛɛ o kɛ o nina nɛ maa ba ngɛ o se ɔ, nyɛɛ ye somi nɛ i kɛ mo so ɔ nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ o kɛ o nina maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, a po lɛ.
-Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, binyumuyo tsuaa binyumuyo nɛ ye ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, a po lɛ: nyɔguɛhi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ngɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi jio, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he mɛ ngɛ nibwɔhi a dɛ jio.
Enɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ kaa somi ko ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti.
Á po nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa neneene somi ko ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti.
Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ a pui lɛ ɔ, a je lɛ we nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ piɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he hu, ejakaa e yi ye somi ɔ nɔ.” Mawu de Abraham ekohu ke, “O yo ɔ, ko tsɛ lɛ Sarai hu; kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, e biɛ ji Sara, Ma gbaa lɛ, nɛ ma ha e ma fɔ binyumu ha mo.
Ma gbaa lɛ nɛ e maa pee je mahi a nyɛ, nɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ma ba pee matsɛmɛ.” Abraham kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si.
Se e muɔ nɛ e bi e he ke, “Anɛ nyumu nɛ ye jeha lafa a ma nyɛ fɔ lo?
Anɛ Sara hu nɛ e ye jeha nyingmi nɛɛ ɔ ma nyɛ fɔ lo?” Abraham de Mawu ke, “I na nɛ o ha Ishmael ba pee nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye ní!” Se Mawu he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, o yo Sara ma fɔ binyumu ha mo, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Isak.
Ma ye ye somi ɔ nɔ kɛ ha lɛ kɛ e nina kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nɔ́ nɛ o bi kɛ ha Ishmael ɔ hu i nu; ma gbaa lɛ, nɛ ma ha e ma fɔ bimɛ, nɛ e ma na nina babauu nitsɛ.
E maa pee matsɛbinyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ a tsɛ, nɛ ma ha e nina ma ba pee je ma agbo.
Se o binyumu Isak nɛ Sara ma fɔ ha mo hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha a, ma ma ye somi ɔ nɔ mi ha lɛ.” Benɛ Mawu kɛ Abraham tu munyu ta a, Mawu je e he.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Abraham bu Mawu tue, nɛ e po e binyumu Ishmael kɛ nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ: nyɔguɛhi nɛ a fɔ ngɛ we ɔ mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ e he tsuo.
Abraham ye jeha nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ benɛ a po lɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e binyumu Ishmael lɛɛ e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ etɛ nɛ a po lɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a po Abraham kɛ e binyumu Ishmael, kɛ nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ; nyɔguɛhi nɛ a fɔ ngɛ we ɔ mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he ngɛ nibwɔhi a dɛ tsuo a po mɛ tsuo kulaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.
A wo Abraham bi he si Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Abraham ngɛ Mamre tso ngua amɛ a he.
Bɔ nɛ e ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ligbi ko benɛ pu nya wa ngmangmaangma nɛ Abraham hii si ngɛ e bo tsu sinya a nya, nɛ e wo e yi nɔ ɔ, e na nyumu ni etɛ komɛ nɛ ma e ngɔ.
Benɛ e na mɛ ɔ, e tu fo kɛ je bo tsu sinya a nya nɛ e ya kpee mɛ.
E kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, -nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛmɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ko je lolo.
Nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ tso nɛ ɔ sisi nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ nyɛ he, nɛ ma ba ha nyɛ nyu bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ fɔ nyɛ nanehi a he.
I kɛ niye ní bɔbɔyoo ko hu ma ba ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye, konɛ nyɛ na he wami nɛ nyɛ kɛ tsa nyɛ nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami kaa nyɛ ba ye we ɔ mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha ma sɔmɔ nyɛ.” A he nɔ ke, “Saminya!
Pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ.” Abraham he sɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho bo tsu ɔ mi ya.
E ya de Sara ke, “Ngɔɔ o mamu kpakpa a; pɔtɔ lɛ nɛ o kɛ sã abolo ha ni etɛ esɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Abraham sa fo kɛ ya sɛ na amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e nu na bɔbɔyoo ko nɛ wo zɔ.
E kɛ lɛ ha e tsɔlɔ ko, nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ hu kɛ na a ya pee niye ní nɔuu.
Abraham ngɔ nyami, kɛ na nyɔ nyu kɛ piɛ niye ní nɛ e kɛ na bi ɔ pee ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ ya ma nyumu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ tso ɔ sisi; nɛ e da si ngɛ a kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ye.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyumu ɔmɛ bi Abraham ke, “Jije o yo Sara ngɛ?” E he nɔ ke, “E ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi.” Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha a, ma kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu; nɛ o yo Sara ma fɔ binyumu.” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Sara daa si ngɛ bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya ngɛ e huno ɔ se, ngɛ tue bue.
Abraham kɛ Sara tsuo bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ Sara nine kumi se po.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Sara muɔ nɛ e bi e he ke, “Be nɛ ɔ mi nɛ i bwɔ, nɛ ye huno hu bwɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma pa na ngɔɔmi ko ngɛ yo kɛ nyumu a buami mi lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi Abraham ke, “Mɛni he je Sara muɔ nɛ e bi ke, ‘Anɛ imi yomoyo nɛ ɔ, ma fɔ niinɛ lo?’ ɔ. Anɛ nɔ́ ko peemi wa ha Yawɛ lo?
Kaa bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha a, ma kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu; nɛ o yo Sara ma fɔ binyumu.” Akɛnɛ Sara ngɛ gbeye yee he je ɔ, e ye lakpa ke, “I muɛ”.
Se Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “O muɔ!” Abraham kpa pɛɛ ha Sodom Jehanɛ, nyumu ɔmɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ yaa Sodom blɔ.
Abraham kɛ mɛ ho konɛ e ya je mɛ blɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de e he ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i yaa pee nɛ ɔ, i kɛ be Abraham laae.
E nina ma ba pee je ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ a he maa wa, nɛ ma gu e nɔ kɛ gbaa je ma amɛ tsuo.
I hla Abraham, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e fa e bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ e nina a nɛ a bu mi tue, nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi.
Ke a pee ja a, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i wo lɛ si kaa ma pee ha lɛ ɔ, ma pee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Abraham ke, “I nu Sodom kɛ Gomora he sane yaya babauu nitsɛ, kaa a yayami ɔ nya wa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma ya hyɛ kaa níhi nɛ i nu ngɛ a he ɔ, e ngɛ mi ja, loo e be mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ je lejɛ ɔ nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ yaa Sodom, nɛ Abraham lɛɛ e kɛ Yawɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Abraham hɛ lɛ kɛ su Yawɛ he, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o ma kpata dali kɛ nimli yayamihi tsuo a hɛ mi kɛ bla niinɛ lo?
Alini, ke dali nyingmi enuɔ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, anɛ o ma kpata ma a tsuo hɛ mi lo?
Anɛ o be a he ngɔe kɛ pa mɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o he dali nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ a yi wami lo?
Dɛbi, e ko ba mi kaa o maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kaa o maa gbe dali kɛ nimli yayamihi kɛ bla.
Ke o pee ja a, kɛkɛ o gbla dali kɛ nimli yayamihi tsuo a tue kɛ bla.
Dɛbi, e ko ba mi ja; je ɔ tsuo kojolɔ ɔ, e sa kaa e yeɔ dami sane.” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ke i na dali nyingmi enuɔ ngɛ Sodom ma a mi ɔ, i kɛ ma a tsuo a he maa pa mɛ ngɛ dali nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ a he.” Abraham tu munyu ekohu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ pa mi kaa ma da o hɛ mi kɛ tu munyu.
Zu kɛ la zu kɛkɛ ji mi, nɛ i be he blɔ nɛ i deɔ nɔ́ ko.
Alini, eko piɔ a maa na dali nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enuɔ, se pi nyingmi enuɔ.
Anɛ o ma kpata ma a tsuo hɛ mi ngɛ nihi enuɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ a he lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “I be ma a hɛ mi kpatae ke i na dali nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Abraham tu munyu ekohu ke, “Alini, eko piɔ a maa na dali nyingmi eywiɛ pɛ.” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “I be ma a hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ dali nyingmi eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he.” Abraham de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, o mi mi nɛ ko fu, ha ma de ekohu.
Ke alini, dali nyingmi etɛ pɛ lɛ ngɛ ma a mi nɛɛ?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ke i na dali nyingmi etɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, i be ma a hɛ mi kpatae.” Abraham ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ pa mi kaa ma da o hɛ mi kɛ tu munyu.
Alini, ke dali nyingmi enyɔ pɛ lɛ ngɛ ma a mi nɛɛ?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ke i na dali nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, i be ma a hɛ mi kpatae.” Abraham de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, o mi mi nɛ ko fu, ha ma tu munyu si kake nɛ ɔ pɛ.
Alini, ke dali nyɔngma pɛ lɛ ngɛ ma a mi nɛɛ?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ke i na dali nyɔngma ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, i be ma a hɛ mi kpatae.” Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ Abraham tu munyu gbe nya a, Yawɛ je e he, nɛ Abraham hu kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.
Sodom he yayami ɔ Benɛ Yawɛ bɔfo enyɔ ɔmɛ ba su Sodom jamɛ a gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Lot hii si ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya.
Benɛ e na mɛ pɛ, e te si nɛ e ya kpee mɛ.
E kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛmɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ gba ye we ɔ mi nɛ nyɛ ba to mi.
Nyɛ ba fɔ nyɛ nanehi a he nɛ nyɛɛ hwɔ hiɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ te si makɛ nɛ nyɛ tsa nyɛ nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ.” Se a he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, wa maa hwɔ ma nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.” Lot kɛ mɛ tu munyu hluu kɛ ya si a kplɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho e we ɔ mi ya.
Lot ha a sã abolo kplolo nɛ a kɛ pee niye ní ha nibwɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ye.
Benɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ na we nɛ a hwɔ si lolo ɔ, Sodom nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, nihewi, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi ba bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe.
A tsɛ Lot nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba to mo gbɔkuɛ nɛ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?
Je mɛ kpo ha wɔ nɛ waa kɛ mɛ nɛ hwɔ!” Lot je kpo kɛ ba a ngɔ, nɛ e ngmɛ sinya a mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ yayami ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ!
I ngɛ biyihi enyɔ nɛ li nyumu.
Ma je mɛ kpo ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pee mɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ.
Nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ko pee mɛ nɔ́ ko; ye nibwɔhi ji mɛ, nɛ e sa kaa ma baa a yi.” Se a de ke, “Moo je lejɛ!
Mo nubwɔ ɔ, mo lɛ o maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ peemi lo?
Ke o ha we wɔ blɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa maa pee mo ɔ nya maa wa pe a nɔ́ ɔ po!” A tsitsɛɛ Lot kɛ ya se, nɛ a hɛ mɛ kɛ ba a hɛ mi, konɛ a ba ywia sinya a.
Se nyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ gbla Lot kɛ wo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ngmɛ sinya a mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya a tsuo a hɛ yu, nɛ a nɛ tsu ɔ nya blɔ hu.
Lot je Sodom Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ de Lot ke, “Anɛ o ngɛ ni komɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi kaa binyumuhi, aloo biyihi, aloo ngatsɛmɛ, aloo weku li kpa komɛ lo?
Ke ja a, je mɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, ejakaa wa yaa kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Yawɛ nu ma nɛ ɔ mi a he sane yayamihi babauu nitsɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ wɔ konɛ wa ba kpata Sodom hɛ mi.” Lot je kpo nɛ e ya de e ngatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba bi e biyi ɔmɛ a si ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ pee esɔ nɛ nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ; Yawɛ yaa kpata ma a hɛ mi.” Se e pee e ngatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe e kɛ mɛ ngɛ fiɛe.
Makɛ ɔ, bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ he hiami de Lot ke, “Tee si esɔ, nɛ o kɛ o yo ɔ, kɛ o biyihi enyɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ; ke nyɛ pee we ja, nɛ a gbla ma a tue ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.” Lot bɔni tsle tomi.
Se akɛnɛ Yawɛ na lɛ mɔbɔ he je ɔ, nyumu ɔmɛ ya nu e kɛ e yo ɔ, kɛ e biyi ɔmɛ a nine si pani nya, nɛ a gbla mɛ kɛ je ma a mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de ke, “Nyɛɛ tu fo esɔesɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ he nyɛ yi wami!
Nyɛ ko plɛ nyɛ se, nɛ nyɛ ko da si ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi he ko he ko.
Nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ho yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ko kpata.” Se Lot he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, dɛbi, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ko ha nɛ waa tu fo kɛ ya tsitsaa lejɛ ɔ. O na mi mɔbɔ agbo, nɛ o he ye yi wami.
Se yoku ɔmɛ a he kɛ tsɔ; sane yobu ma ya ye mi, nɛ ye yi maa ta ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ loko ma su lejɛ ɔ. O nɛ, ma bɔbɔyoo ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, e kɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ we kulaa.
Ha ma tu fo ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E ji ma bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ, nɛ ye yi ma na wami ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Bɔfo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Saminya, i kplɛɛ.
I be jamɛ a ma a hɛ mi kpatae.
Tuu fo kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ esɔ!
I be nɔ́ ko pee kaa ja o ya su lejɛ ɔ lolo.” Akɛnɛ Lot de ke ma bɔbɔyoo ji ma a he je ɔ, a wo ma a biɛ ke Zoar.
A kpata Sodom kɛ Gomora a hɛ mi Benɛ Lot su Zoar a, pu gba.
Tlukaa a, Yawɛ ha nɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege je hiɔwe pue Sodom kɛ Gomora a nɔ.
Nɛ Yawɛ kpata ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔ, kɛ nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ puɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a hɛ mi.
Se Lot yo ɔ plɛ hyɛ e se, nɛ e plɛ pee ngo kpɔ.
E nɔ jena mɔtu kpla a, Abraham kpale kɛ ho he nɛ e da si ngɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ ya.
E hyɛ Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ e na la su ku nɛ ngɛ zugba a jee kaa flɔɔnɔɔ nguaa ko mi la su ku.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Mawu kpata ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi ɔ, e kai Abraham, nɛ e ha nɛ Lot tu fo kɛ je ma amɛ a mi he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ he e yi wami.
Moab bi kɛ Amon bi a je he Lot ye gbeye kaa e maa hi Zoar, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ e biyi enyɔ ɔmɛ hia kɛ ho yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ya nɛ a ya hi tɛ puɔ ko mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi Dede ɔ de e senɔ ɔ ke, “Wa tsɛ bwɔ, nɛ nyumuhi be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ wɔ konɛ wa fɔ bimɛ.
Ba nɛ wa ha wa tsɛ dã nɛ e nu konɛ waa kɛ lɛ nɛ hwɔ nɛ wa fɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ weku kpa a se ko po.” Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, a ha a tsɛ ɔ wai nɛ e nu, nɛ Dede ɔ ho nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya hwɔ.
Se Lot tɔ dã saminya, nɛ e li nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ: e li be nɛ e biyo ɔ ba hwɔ e se, kɛ be nɛ e te si kɛ je.
E nɔ jena a, Dede ɔ de e senɔ ɔ ke, “Hiɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, i kɛ tsaatsɛ ya hwɔ.
Ha nɛ wa ha lɛ dã ekohu nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ mo hu o kɛ lɛ ya hwɔ, konɛ wɔ tsuo waa kɛ wa tsɛ nɛ fɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ weku kpa a se ko po.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, a ha a tsɛ ɔ wai ekohu, nɛ Kɔkɔ ɔ hu ho nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya hwɔ.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e ba mi kekle ɔ, Lot tɔ dã saminya, nɛ e li nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ: e li be nɛ e biyo ɔ ba hwɔ e se, kɛ be nɛ e te si kɛ je.
Bɔ nɛ e ba loko Lot biyi enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsɛ na mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Dede ɔ ba fɔ binyumu, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Moab.
Lɛ ji mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ Moab bi ɔmɛ a nɛ̃.
Kɔkɔ ɔ hu ba fɔ binyumu, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Benami.
Lɛ ji mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ Amon bi ɔmɛ a nɛ̃.
Abraham kɛ Abimelek Abraham hia kɛ je Mamre kɛ ho Kanaan zugba a leneyi je ya nɛ e ya hi Kadesh kɛ Shur a kpɛti.
Pee se ɔ, e klɛ kɛ ya hi Gerar a, nɛ lej ɔ, Abrahamde ke e nyɛmiyo ji e yo Sara a nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Gerar matsɛ, Abimelek tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ Sara ba ha lɛ.
Ligbi ko nyɔ mi ɔ, Mawu je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Abimelek ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ o ya ngɔ yo nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o ma gbo; nɔ ko yo ji lɛ.” Se jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Abimelek kɛ yo ɔ na we bɔmi lolo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i yi fɔ!
Anɛ o maa gbe i kɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ lo?
Abraham nitsɛ nɛ e de ke e nyɛmiyo ji yo ɔ. Yo ɔ nitsɛ hu de ke e nyɛminyumu ji Abraham.
Nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ je ye tsui mi faa, nɛ ye he nile bui mi fɔ.” Mawu ha lɛ heto ngɛ nlami ɔ mi ke, “Niinɛ, i le kaa nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ je o tsui mi faa, nɛ o he nile bui mo fɔ; enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ha we nɛ o ta yo ɔ he, konɛ o ko pee yayami kɛ si mi.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, ngɔɔ yo ɔ kɛ ya ha e huno.
E huno ɔ, gbalɔ ji lɛ; e ma kpa pɛɛ ha mo, konɛ o ko gbo.
Se ke o kpale we yo ɔ kɛ ya ha we e huno ɔ, lɛɛ i ngɛ mo dee ke, o kɛ o weku li tsuo nyɛ ma gbo!” Abimelek te si mɔtu kpla, nɛ e tsɔ ya kpee e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ.
E bɔ mɛ amaniɛ ngɛ e nlami ɔ he, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu sawale.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Abimelek tsɔ ya tsɛ Abraham kɛ ba, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o pee wɔ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni yayami i pee mo loko o ha amanehlu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba i kɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ wa nɔ ɔ?
Nɔ́ nɛ a pee we nɔ nɛ o pee mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mɛni o susu loko o pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?” Abraham he nɔ ke, “Jinɛ i susu kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye; i susu kaa ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa gbe mi, nɛ a ma kpɔ ye yo ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ye yo ɔ, imi nitsɛ ye nyɛmi ji lɛ.
Tsaatsɛ bi ji lɛ, se pi maa bi, nɛ e ba pee ye yo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Mawu je mi kɛ je ye weku li a he nɛ e ha nɛ i ba ngɛ lalaalo woe kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, i de ye yo ɔ ke, ‘Kpakpa nɛ o maa pee ha mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: he tsuaa he nɛ wa maa ya a, de ke o nyɛminyumu ji mi.’ ” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abimelek kpale Sara ya ha Abraham ekohu, nɛ e ke lɛ tohi, nahi, kɛ nyɔguɛhi nyumuhi kɛ yihi ngɔ piɛ he.
Abimelek de Abraham ke, “O nɛ, ye zugba nɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi tilaa a nɛ; he tsuaa he nɛ o suɔ ɔ, moo hi lejɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de Sara ke, “I kɛ sika hiɔ yi akpe kake ngɛ o nyɛminyumu ɔ hae kaa kpatami dã ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ i pee ɔ he.
I pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ mo nguɔ woe, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ, a ná nɛ a le kaa o pee we yayami ko.” -Nɔ́ nɛ Abimelek pee Abraham yo Sara a he je ɔ, Yawɛ tsi yihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ a fɔmi nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham kpa pɛɛ ha Abimelek, nɛ Mawu tsa lɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, Mawu tsa Abimelek yo ɔ kɛ nyɔguɛ yi ɔmɛ, nɛ a fɔ bimɛ.
A fɔ Isak Yawɛ gbaa Sara kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. Sara ba na mi, nɛ e fɔ binyumuyo ha Abraham benɛ Abraham bwɔ ɔ, ngɛ be nɛ Mawu de to ɔ mi.
Abraham wo lɛ biɛ ke Isak, nɛ benɛ Isak ye ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, Abraham po lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu fa lɛ ɔ. Abraham ye jeha lafa benɛ a fɔ e bi Isak ɔ. Sara de ke, “Mawu ha nɛ muɔ ba ye nya he jehanɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu he ɔ, e kɛ mi maa muɔ.
Mɛnɔ ma de Abraham, be ko nɛ be ɔ, ke Sara ma ba ha bi nyɔ?
Se i fɔ binyumu ha lɛ ngɛ e bwɔmi be mi.” Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa, nɛ a tsɔ lɛ nyɔ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ a tsɔ Isak nyɔ ɔ, Abraham ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngua ko.
Abraham wo Hagar kɛ Ishmael blɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, Sara na kaa Hagar, Egipt no ɔ binyumu Ishmael nɛ e kɛ Abraham fɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu Isak ngɛ fiɛe.
Sara de Abraham ke, “Fie nyɔguɛ yo nɛ ɔ kɛ e binyumu ɔ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ. Yo nɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ kɛ ye bi Isak be ní dlae.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao Abraham wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa Ishmael ɔ hu e bi ji lɛ.
Se Mawu de Abraham ke, “Koo hao o he ngɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ o nyɔguɛ yo Hagar a he.
Pee kaa bɔ nɛ Sara de mo ɔ, ejakaa Isak nɔ lɛ nina nɛ i wo mo si ke ma ha mo ɔ maa gu kɛ ba.
Nyɔguɛ yo ɔ binyumu ɔ, lɛ hu ma ha lɛ bimɛ babauu nɛ a ma ba pee ma; ejakaa lɛ hu o bi ji lɛ.” E nɔ jena mɔtu kpla a, Abraham ha Hagar niye ní, kɛ lohwe he womi tɔ nɛ nyu hyi lɛ.
E ngɔ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ wo Hagar se mi, nɛ e wo lɛ blɔ.
Hagar je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya wo lalaalo ngɛ Beersheba nga a nɔ.
Benɛ nyu ɔ ta tɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Hagar ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ ya fɔ tso ko sisi, nɛ e ho ya hi si ngɛ he ko banee, maa pee gugue nyingmi enuɔ loo nɔ kɛmi kɛ je he nɛ jokuɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. E de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “I be nyɛe nɛ ma hi jokuɛ ɔ hɛ mi hyɛe kɛ yaa si e ma gbo.” Benɛ e hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e bɔni ya fomi.
Mawu nu nɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ ngɛ ya foe, nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ kɛ Hagar tu munyu kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e de ke, “Hagar, mɛni sane?
Koo ye gbeye.
Mawu nu nɛ jokuɛyo ɔ ngɛ ya foe ngɛ he nɛ e hwɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ. Tee si nɛ o ya wo lɛ kɛ fɔ o gugue mi, ejakaa ma ha nɛ e nina ma ba pee ma agbo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bli Hagar hɛngmɛ nɛ e na vu ko.
E ho nɛ e ya yɛ nyu kɛ wo lohwe he womi tɔ ɔ mi nɛ e hyi, nɛ e ha e bi ɔ nyu ɔ eko nɛ e nu.
-Mawu gbaa jokuɛ ɔ nɛ e ba wa.
E hi Paran nga a nɔ, nɛ e ba pee detsɛ kpanaa.
E nyɛ hla yo ha lɛ kɛ je Egipt, nɛ e ngɔ.
Abraham kɛ Abimelek ka a he kita Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Abimelek kɛ e tatsɛ Fikol ba Abraham ngɔ.
Abimelek de Abraham ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, Mawu piɛɔ o he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ka mi kita ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa o be imi, aloo ye bimɛ, aloo ye nina sisie kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo hi si saminya a, mo hu o kɛ imi, kɛ zugba a nɛ o ba to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ hi si ja nɔuu.” Abraham he nɔ ke, “I ka kita kaa ma pee ja.” Abraham kɛ Abimelek tu munyu ngɛ vu ko nɛ lɛ Abimelek ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba kpɔ pani nya a he.
Abimelek de lɛ ke, “I li nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. O wui nɔ ta hyɛ nɛ ma nu; kekleekle nɛ i ngɛ nue ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abraham ke Abimelek to kɛ na, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ ka a he kita.
Abraham je jijɔ kpaago ngɛ e to ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to he kake.
Abimelek bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o je jijɔ kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to he kake ɔ?” Abraham he nɔ ke, “Mo he jijɔ kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ye dɛ, nɛ e pee odase kaa imi nɛ i je vu nɛ ɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Beersheba a nɛ, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ ka a he kita ngɛ.
Benɛ Abraham kɛ Abimelek ka a he kita ngɛ Beersheba gbe nya a, Abimelek kɛ e tatsɛ Fikol kpale a se kɛ ho Filistia ya.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abraham du tso ngua ko ngɛ Beersheba, nɛ e ja Yawɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ daa a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Abraham hi Filistia be babauu.
Mawu fa Abraham ke e ngɔ Isak kɛ sã bɔ Pee se ɔ, Mawu ka Abraham.
Mawu tsɛ Abraham ke, “Abraham!” Nɛ Abraham he nɔ ke, “Ne mi!” Mawu de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ o binyumu Isak, o bi kake too ɔ nɛ o suɔ lɛ saminya a, nɛ o ya Moria zugba a nɔ.
Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ya sã sami bɔ ha mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ yo ko nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ.” Abraham te si mɔtu kpla nɛ e poo lɛ́ nɛ e kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ. E wo e teji ɔ nɔ ní, nɛ e ngɔ Isak kɛ tsɔli enyɔ ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ e kɛ mɛ pue blɔ kɛ ho he nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ ya.
Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Abraham na lejɛ ɔ mane jee.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ teji ɔ nɛ mlɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. I kɛ jokuɛ ɔ yaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ wa ya ja Mawu, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wa maa kpale ba na nyɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ekohu.” Abraham ngɔ lɛ́ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ ngɔ tloo Isak, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e hɛɛ ha kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma slɛ la a. Benɛ a nyɛɛ kɛ yaa a, Isak tsɛ e tsɛ Abraham ke, “Tsaatsɛ!” Abraham he nɔ ke, “Ye bi!” Isak bi lɛ ke, “Wa ngɛ lɛ́ nɛ waa kɛ ma slɛ la, se jije jijɔ nɛ waa kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ ngɛ?” Abraham he nɔ ke, “Ye bi, Mawu nitsɛ ma je jijɔ ha wɔ nɛ wa kɛ sã sami bɔ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a tsa nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ kɛ ho.
Benɛ a su he nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ Abraham ɔ, Abraham ma bɔ sami la tɛ, nɛ e to lɛ́ ɔ ngɔ pue nɔ.
E fi e bi Isak, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ lɛ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ̃ ha a konɛ e kɛ gbe e bi ɔ.
Se Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ tsɛ lɛ kɛ je hiɔwe ke, “Abraham!
Abraham!” Abraham he nɔ ke, “Ne mi.” Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “O nine nɛ ko sa niheyo ɔ he; koo pee lɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i na kaa o yeɔ Mawu gbeye, ejakaa o bi kake too ɔ he nɔ́ dɔɛ mo kaa o kɛ lɛ ma ha Mawu.” Benɛ Abraham po e hɛ nɛ e hyɛ ɔ, agbosu ko ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ e se, nɛ e koli lata tso komɛ ngɛ pu ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya nu agbosu ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sã sami bɔ ngɛ e bi ɔ nane mi.
Abraham wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke, “Yawɛ ha.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nihi deɔ ke, “Yawɛ haa nɔ nɔ́ ngɛ e yo ɔ nɔ.” Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ tsɛ Abraham ekohu si enyɔne ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae kaa akɛnɛ o bu mi tue, nɛ o bi kake too ɔ he nɔ́ dɔɛ mo kaa o kɛ lɛ ma ha mi he je ɔ, imi hu ma gbaa mo, nɛ ma ha o nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe, loo wo nya zia.
O nina maa ye a he nyɛli a nɔ.
Je ma amɛ tsuo ma bi ke ma gbaa mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i gbaa o nina a, ejakaa o bu mi tue.” Abraham kpale e se kɛ ba e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a pue nɔ kɛ ho Beersheba ya.
Nɛ Abraham ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Nahor nina Pee se ɔ, Abraham nu kaa Milka kɛ lɛ Abraham ɔ nyɛminyumu Nahor fɔ binyumuhi.
A biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, kɛ je Tɛte nɔ kɛ yaa: Uz, Buz, Kemuel nɛ ji Aram tsɛ, Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Yidlaf, kɛ Betuel nɛ ji Rebeka tsɛ.
Milka kɛ Abraham nyɛminyumu Nahor fɔ binyumuhi kpaanyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ.
Nahor kɛ e plã ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Reuma hu fɔ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A biɛhi ji Teba, Gaham Tahash, kɛ Maaka.
Sara ba gbo nɛ Abraham he zugba nɛ e kɛ pee gɔ Sara ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago, nɛ e gbo ngɛ Kiriat Arba.
Kiriat Arba biɛ kpa ji Hebron, nɛ e ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
Abraham ye Sara kɔmɔ, nɛ e nyɛ ya ha lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je gbogboe ɔ he, nɛ e ya de Hit bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nubwɔ ji mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ ha mi nyɛ zugba a eko nɛ ma kɛ pee gɔ, konɛ ma pu ye yo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Hit bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Wa nyɔmtsɛ, moo bu wɔ tue!
Wa buu mo kaa hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ngua ko ngɛ wa kpɛti; yaa pu o yo ɔ ngɛ wa gɔ nɛ hi pe kulaa a mi.
Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa suɔ kaa e maa ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yɔkɔ kɛ ha mo nɛ o pu o yo ɔ ngɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Abraham kpla si ngɛ Hit bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ suɔ kaa ma pu ye yo ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Zohar binyumu Efron nɛ tu ha mi, konɛ e ngɔ Makpela tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ e zugba a nya a kɛ ha mi.
Nyɛ de lɛ nɛ e jua zugba a kɛ ha mi sisiisi ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ ma he nɛ ma kɛ pee gɔ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Efron nitsɛ hii si ngɛ Hit bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ kpe he ɔ, ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya.
E ha Abraham heto, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu ke, “Bu tue, ye nyɔmtsɛ!
I ngɔ zugba a tsuo, kɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ kɛ ke mo.
I ngɔ kɛ ha mo ngɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ o pu o yo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Se Abraham kpla si ngɛ Hit bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ Efron tu munyu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu mi tue.
Nɔ́ nɛ o de ɔ, i ngɔɛ.
Ha nɛ ma wo mo zugba a he hiɔ, konɛ ma pu ye yo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. O nɛ, sika a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Efron he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu mi tue!
Zugba a he jua ji sika hiɔ yi lafa eywiɛ.
Se imi kɛ mo wa kpɛti ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsapi nɔ́ ko kulaa.
Yaa nɛ o ya pu o yo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Abraham kplɛɛ nɔ, nɛ e ngmɛ sika hiɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Efron de nɛ Hit bi ɔmɛ nu ɔ: sika hiɔ yi lafa eywiɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ jua yeli ɔmɛ po ngɔ fɔ si ɔ. Bɔ nɛ ba loko Efron weto ní ɔ nɛ ngɛ Makpela ngɛ Mamre beleku je ɔ, ba plɛ pee Abraham nɔ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Weto ní nɛ ɔ ji zugba a, kɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ, kɛ tso ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi, hluu kɛ ya ta zugba a nyagbe ɔ.
Hit bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kpe ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya a ye odase kaa, niinɛ, zugba a ba plɛ pee Abraham nɔ́.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abraham ya pu e yo Sara ngɛ jamɛ a tɛ puɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
Hit bi ɔmɛ ngɔ zugba a kɛ e mi tɛ puɔ ɔ kɛ ha Abraham kaa e weto ní, nɛ e kɛ pee gɔ.
A hla yo ha Isak Jehanɛ lɛɛ Abraham bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ Yawɛ gbaa lɛ, nɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ya nɔ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e de e tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ hyɛɛ lɛ Abraham ɔ níhi tsuo a nɔ ɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ o nine ba wo ye fiɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛ, nɛ o ka mi kita ngɛ Yawɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba Mawu ɔ biɛ mi, kaa o be yo hlae kɛ ha ye binyumu Isak kɛ je Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ a kpɛti.
Mohu ɔ, o maa kpale o se kɛ ya zugba nɔ he nɛ a fɔ mi ngɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya hla yo ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ba ha ye bi Isak.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ bi ke, “Eko ɔ, yo ɔ be kplɛɛe kaa e maa nyɛɛ ye se kɛ ba zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ke e ba mi ja a, lɛɛ ma ngɔ o binyumu ɔ kɛ ya zugba a nɔ he nɛ o je ɔ lo?” Abraham he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
Koo ngɔ ye bi ɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!
Yawɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, ngɔ mi kɛ je tsaatsɛ we mi, kɛ ye weku li a zugba nɔ, nɛ e wo mi si ke e kɛ zugba nɛ ɔ ma ha ye nina.
Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ kɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi nɛ o ma ya hla yo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ba ha ye bi ɔ. Ke yo ɔ kplɛɛ we kaa e kɛ mo maa ba a, lɛɛ o tɔ we ye kita nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Se ye bi ɔ lɛɛ o kɛ lɛ ko ya lejɛ ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ e nine kɛ wo e nyɔmtsɛ Abraham fiɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛ, nɛ e ka kita kaa e maa pee bɔ nɛ Abraham de lɛ ɔ. Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ Abraham weto níhi a nɔ ɔ, ngɔ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we afukpɔngɔ nyɔngma, nɛ e mia mɛ kɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nike ní kpakpa, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Nahor e ma a mi ya, ngɛ Mesopotamia.
Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, e ha afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ bu si ngɛ vu ko he ngɛ ma a nya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi lɛ yihi jeɔ kpo kɛ ba yɛɔ nyu.
Tsɔlɔ ɔ fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham Mawu!
I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ ma ye manye mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ o je o suɔmi kpo ha ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham.
O nɛ, i daa si ngɛ vu nɛ ɔ he kɛ yaa si ma mi yihewi ɔmɛ maa je kpo kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ a ba yɛ nyu.
Ma de a ti nɔ kake ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ, moo ba o buɛ ɔ nya si nɛ o ha mi nyu ma nu’.
Ke e de mi ke ‘He nyu nɛ o nu, nɛ ma ya yɛ eko ba ha o we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a nu’ ɔ, ha jamɛ a yiheyo ɔ nɛ e pee nɔ nɛ o hla kɛ ha o tsɔlɔ Isak.
Ke e ba mi ja a, ma le kaa o suɔ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ nya na we nɛ e nɔ si tete nɛ Rebeka ba hia kpo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ buɛ ngɛ e konɔ.
Binyumu nɛ Abraham nyɛminyumu Nahor kɛ e yo Milka fɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Betuel ɔ, lɛɛ e biyo ji Rebeka a nɛ.
Rebeka he ngɛ fɛu saminya.
Yomiyo ji lɛ; e li nyumu.
E be kɛ ho vu ɔ nya ya ya yɛ nyu kɛ wo e buɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ma.
Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ tu fo nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi o buɛ ɔ mi nyu ɔ bɔɔ nɛ ma nu.” Rebeka he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, mo he nyu nɛ o nu.” Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e ba e buɛ ɔ nya si, nɛ e ha lɛ nyu ɔ eko nɛ e nu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Rebeka de Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “I yaa yɛ nyu ɔ eko kɛ ba ha o we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hulɔ kɛ yaa si mɛ tsuo a maa tɔ.” E he sɔ kɛ plɛ nyu nɛ ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi ɔ kɛ wo lohwe ɔmɛ a nyu numi nɔ́ ɔ mi, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ho vu ɔ he ya ya yɛ nyu kɛ ba ha afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a nu.
Nyumu ɔ pee dii kɛ ngɛ lɛ hyɛe kaa e maa na kaa Yawɛ gbaa e blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ye manye lo.
Benɛ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nu nyu ɔ ta a, nyumu ɔ je sika tsu ga ko nɛ he jua wa kpo, nɛ e kɛ wo Rebeka gugwɔ mi.
E kɛ sika tsu kɔni si ga agboagbo enyɔ hu wo Rebeka kɔni si.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛnɔ bi ji mo?
Anɛ i kɛ ye we bi ɔmɛ ma na blɔ ngɛ o tsɛ we ɔ mi nɛ waa to lejɛ ɔ lo?” Rebeka he nɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ biɛ ji Betuel; Nahor kɛ e yo Milka a bi ji lɛ.
Wa ngɛ nga kɛ lohwehi a niye ní babauu, nɛ he ko hu ngɛ nɛ nyɛ maa to.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ kpla si nɛ e ja Yawɛ.
E de ke, “A je Yawɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham Mawu ɔ yi, kaa e na ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ye si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ kpaka mi tɛɛ kɛ ba ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ weku li a ngɔ.” Yiheyo ɔ tu fo kɛ ho e nyɛ we mi ya nɛ e ya bɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ nɔ́ nɛ ba a.
-Rebeka ngɛ nyɛminyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Laban.
Benɛ Laban na gugwɔ mi ga a, kɛ kɔni si ga amɛ ngɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ kɔni si, nɛ e nu nɔ́ nɛ nyumu ɔ de lɛ ɔ, e gbɔ fo kɛ ya na nyumu ɔ ngɛ vu ɔ he.
Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ daa si ngɛ e we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Laban de lɛ ke, “Ba nɛ waa ho we mi ya, mo nyumu nɛ Yawɛ gbaa mo!
Mɛni he je o daa si ngɛ magbɛ nɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?
I dla tsu ko mi ha mo ngɛ we ɔ mi.
O we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu blɔ ngɛ kɛ ha mɛ.” Laban kɛ nyumu ɔ ba we ɔ mi; e je tlomi ɔmɛ ngɛ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a se mi, nɛ e ha mɛ nga kɛ niye ni kpa komɛ.
E ya yɛ nyu kɛ ba ha Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a fɔ a nanehi a he.
Jehanɛ, a kɛ niye ní ba ma Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi.
Se e de ke, “I be ní yee; ja i bɔ nyɛ ye nyɛɛmi mi amaniɛ loko ma ye ní.” Laban de lɛ ke, “Yoo, wa hiɛ jɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Abraham tsɔlɔ ji mi.
Yawɛ gbaa ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ saminya, nɛ e pee lɛ niatsɛ.
Yawɛ ha lɛ tohi, nahi, sika hiɔ, sika tsu, kɛ nyɔguɛhi nyumuhi kɛ yihi, afukpɔngɔhi, kɛ tejihi.
Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yo Sara fɔ binyumu ha lɛ benɛ lɛ Sara a bwɔ, nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham ngɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ kɛ ha bi nɛ ɔ. Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha nɛ i ka lɛ kita.
E de mi ke, ‘Ko hla yo ha ye bi ɔ kɛ je Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ a kpɛti.
Mohu ɔ, yaa tsaatsɛ weku li, kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ o ya hla yo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ha ye bi ɔ.’ I bi ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, ‘Ke yo ɔ kplɛɛ we kaa e maa nyɛɛ ye se kɛ ba a nɛɛ?’ E he nɔ ke, ‘Yawɛ nɛ i buɔ lɛ tue daa nɛ ɔ, maa tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ nɛ e kɛ mo maa ya, nɛ e ma ha o blɔ ɔ maa da mo.
O ma ya hla yo kɛ ba ha ye bi ɔ kɛ je ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tsaatsɛ weku li ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ kita nɛ o ka mi ɔ he ɔ, ke o ya ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ a he we mo ɔ, o tɔ we kita.’ “Benɛ i ba su vu ɔ he mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham Mawu, ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o ha nɛ ye blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ nɛ da mi ɔ, lɛɛ ha nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ i daa si ngɛ vu nɛ ɔ he ɔ, yiheyo ko nɛ ba yɛ nyu.
Ke yiheyo ɔ ba a, ma de lɛ ke e ha mi e buɛ ɔ mi nyu ɔ bɔɔ nɛ ma nu.
Ke e kplɛɛ, nɛ jehanɛ se hu e de mi ke e maa yɛ nyu ha ye afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a nu ɔ, ha nɛ e pee yo nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla kɛ ha ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ.’ Benɛ i na we nɛ ma gbe ye kue fami nɛ ɔ nya a, Rebeka ba hia kpo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ buɛ ngɛ e konɔ.
E be kɛ ho vu ɔ he ya ya yɛ nyu.
I de lɛ ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi nyu bɔɔ nɛ ma nu.’ Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, e ba e buɛ ɔ nya si nɛ e de ke, ‘Ba he nyu nɛ o nu konɛ ma yɛ eko ba ha o we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a nu.’ I nu nyu ɔ, nɛ e ya yɛ eko ba ha afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a nu.
I bi lɛ ke, ‘Mɛnɔ bi ji mo?’ Nɛ e he nɔ ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ biɛ ji Betuel, Nahor kɛ e yo Milka a bi ɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kɛ ga wo e gugwɔ mi nɛ i kɛ kɔni si gahi hu wo e kɔni si.
I kpla si nɛ i ja Yawɛ.
I je Yawɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Abraham Mawu ɔ yi kaa e kpaka mi tɛɛ kɛ ba ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ weku no ɔ ngɔ, nɛ i ba na e biyo ɔ nɛ ma ba pee ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ yo ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ bie ke, anɛ nyɛ ma je nyɛ suɔmi kpo kɛ ha ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo?
Ke nyɛ maa pee ja jio, nyɛ be ja pee jio, nyɛ de mi, konɛ ma na he nɛ ma gu.” Laban kɛ Betuel he nɔ ke, “Akɛnɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi sane nɛ ɔ je he je ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nyɛe ma de he nɔ́ ko.
O nɛ, Rebeka a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ho nɛ e ya pee o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ yo, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ de ɔ.” Benɛ Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ nu heto nɛ a ha lɛ ɔ, e kpla si nɛ e ja Yawɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je sika hiɔ, sika tsu, june níhi, kɛ tadehi kpo, nɛ e kɛ ha Rebeka.
Jehanɛ, e ha Rebeka nyɛminyumu ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ hu nike níhi nɛ a he jua wa.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ye ní nɛ a nu nɔ́ ko, nɛ a hwɔ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi.
Mɔtu benɛ a te si ɔ, e de ke, “Nyɛɛ wo mi blɔ nɛ ma kpale kɛ ho ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.” Se Rebeka nyɛminyumu ɔ kɛ e nyɛ de ke, “Ha nɛ yiheyo ɔ kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ, kaa ligbi nyɔngma, loko e ho.” Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ko tsi ye nya.
Yawɛ ha nɛ ye blɔ ɔ da mi; nyɛɛ wo mi blɔ nɛ ma kpale kɛ ho ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.” A de lɛ ke, “Wa ma tsɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ wa bi lɛ bɔ nɛ e ma de.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɛ Rebeka nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o suɔ kaa o kɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ maa ya lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Ee, i suɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a wo Rebeka, kɛ bimɛanyɛ ɔ nɛ hyɛ e nɔ kɛ je e jokuɛ mi ɔ, kɛ Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa blɔ.
A gbaa Rebeka, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Wa nyɛmiyo!
Mo fɔ bimɛ akpeakpe babauu; nɛ o nina ba kpɔ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ma amɛ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Rebeka kɛ e mawayi ɔmɛ dla, nɛ a kuɔ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ ho.
Bɔ nɛ Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ ba ngɔ Rebeka kɛ ho ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Isak ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ Kanaan leneyi je ngɛ he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ke, “Hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ naa mi ɔ vu ɔ.” Ligbi ko gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, e je kpo kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya konɛ e ya pue e yi mi bɔɔ, nɛ e na kaa afukpɔngɔ komɛ ma.
Benɛ Rebeka na Isak ɔ e kple si kɛ je afukpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e bi Abraham tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nga a nɔ jii kɛ ma wa ngɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ ji lɛ?” Tsɔlɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Rebeka ngɔ e hɛ mi hami bo ɔ kɛ ha e hɛ mi.
Tsɔlɔ ɔ bɔ Isak e blɔ hiami mi amaniɛ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Isak ngɔ Rebeka kɛ ho bo tsu ɔ nɛ e nyɛ Sara hi mi ɔ mi ya.
E kɛ lɛ hi si kaa e yo, nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya.
Rebeka ba pee bua womi nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ ko kɛ ha Isak ngɛ e nyɛ gbenɔ se.
Abraham nina kpa komɛ Abraham ngɔ yo ekohu.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Ketura.
Abraham kɛ lɛ fɔ Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, kɛ Shua.
Yokshan fɔ Sheba kɛ Dedan.
Dedan nina ji Ashur bi, Letush bi, kɛ Leum bi.
Midian bimɛ ji Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida, kɛ Eldaa.
Ketura nina ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Abraham ngɔ e weto ní tsuo kɛ ha Isak, se benɛ e na we nɛ e gbo lolo ɔ, binyumuhi nɛ e kɛ e yi kpa amɛ fɔ ɔ hu, e ha mɛ nike níhi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e wo bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ho beleku je zugba a nɔ ya, kɛ je e bi Isak he.
Abraham ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ -Abraham bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ e ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi kpaago kɛ enuɔ loko e gbo.
E bimɛ Isak kɛ Ishmael pu lɛ ngɛ Makpela tɛ puɔ ɔ mi ngɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Mamre beleku je ɔ nɔ.
Zugba nɛ ɔ, jinɛ Zohar binyumu Efron, Hit no ɔ nɔ́, se Abraham he zugba a ngɛ Hit bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a pu Abraham kɛ e yo Sara tsuo ngɛ.
Benɛ Abraham gbo se ɔ, Mawu gbaa e bi Isak.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Isak hia kɛ ho ma ko mi ya nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ.
A tsɛɛ ma nɛ ɔ ke “Hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ naa mi ɔ vu.” Ishmael nina Abraham bi Ismael nɛ e kɛ Sara mawayo Hagar nɛ je Egipt fɔ ɔ, e binyumuhi ngɛ a fɔmi nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Nebayot, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema, Yetur, Nafish, kɛ Kedema.
Ishmael bimɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ba pee wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ komɛ a nyatsɛmɛ, nɛ a kɛ a biɛ wo wɛtso ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ.
Ishmael ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaago nɛ e gbo.
Ishmael bi ɔmɛ hi Havila kɛ Shur a kpɛti ngɛ Egipt beleku je, kɛ yaa Asiria blɔ.
A kɛ Abraham nina kpa amɛ hi akã nɔ.
A fɔ Esau kɛ Yakob Abraham binyumu Isak he sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Isak ye jeha nyingmi eywiɛ nɛ e ngɔ Rebeka, Aram no ɔ nɛ je Mesopotamia nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Betuel ɔ biyo ɔ. Rebeka nyɛminyumu ji Laban.
Jinɛ Isak yo Rebeka a, yosa ji lɛ, se Isak kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ ha lɛ.
Yawɛ bu e kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ Rebeka ba na mi.
Rebeka ngɔ hawi hɔ, nɛ benɛ e na we nɛ e fɔ mɛ lolo ɔ, jokuɛwi ɔmɛ kɛ a he ngɛ kunɔ nɔe ngɛ a nyɛ ɔ muklii ɔ mi.
Rebeka bi e he ke, “Mɛni lɛ ngɛ mi pee nɛ ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ho ya bi Yawɛ ga womi.
Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Bimɛ nɛ ngɛ o mi mi ɔ ma ba pee je ma enyɔ hwɔɔ se, nɛ́ a kɛ a he be yee.
Kake he ma ba wa pe kake; nɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ma sɔmɔ jokuɛ ɔ.” Benɛ Rebeka fɔmi be su ɔ, e fɔ hawi, nyumuhi enyɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ba kekle ɔ tsuɔ papaapa, nɛ e he womi ngɛ kaa bo nɛ a kɛ bwɔmi lo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lɛ biɛ ke Esau.
Benɛ enyɔne ɔ ma a, e kɛ e nine fua e nyɛmi Esau nane se ja kpɛii; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lɛ biɛ ke Yakob.
Isak ye jeha nyingmi ekpa benɛ a fɔ hawi ɔmɛ ɔ. Esau jua e bitɛte blɔ nya Nyumuwi ɔmɛ ba wa.
Esau ba pee de dalɔ kpanaa, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e nyɛɛ nga mi kɛ bee.
Yakob lɛɛ nɔmlɔ kpoo ji lɛ, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ we mi.
Isak suɔ Esau sane, ejakaa Esau ya gbeɔ de lo ba haa lɛ nɛ e yeɔ; se Rebeka lɛɛ e suɔ Yakob.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Yakob ngɛ yɔ flɔɔ ko pee; kɛkɛ nɛ Esau je de nga mi kɛ ba nɛ hwɔ gbe lɛ.
E de Yakob ke, “Hwɔ ngɛ mi yee!
Ha mi kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ tsutsu nɛ ɔ eko ma ye.” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Edom ɔ nɛ.
Yakob he nɔ ke, “Yoo, ma ha mo.
Se loko ma ha mo ɔ, ja o ngɔ o blɔ nya kaa bitɛte ɔ ngɔ ha mi.” Esau de ke, “Saminya!
Pe i miɔ nɛ ma gbo nɛ ɔ nɛ; mɛni bitɛte blɔ nya nɛ ɔ maa pee ha mi?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Kekleekle ɔ, ka mi kita kaa o kɛ o blɔ nya a ma ha mi.” Esau ka lɛ kita, nɛ e jua e blɔ nya a kɛ ha Yakob.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob ha Esau abolo kɛ yɔ flɔɔ ɔ eko nɛ e ye, nɛ e nu nɔ́ ko ngɔ pue nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e te si, nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e bitɛte blɔ nya a nɛ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ he ɔ si we lɛ kpu.
Isak ya hi Gerar Hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ; slo hwɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Abraham yi nɔ ɔ; nɛ Isak ho Filisti bi ɔmɛ, a Matsɛ Abimelek ngɔ ya ngɛ Gerar.
Yawɛ je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Isak, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Koo ya Egipt, hii si ngɛ zugba a nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ.
Hii si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ; i kɛ mo maa hi si, nɛ ma gbaa mo.
Ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha mo, kɛ o nina; nɛ si nɛ i wo o tsɛ Abraham ɔ, ma ye nɔ.
Ma ha o nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ i kɛ zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo ma ha mɛ.
O nina nɔ a maa gu kɛ gbaa je ma amɛ tsuo.
Ma gbaa mo, ejakaa Abraham bu mi tue, nɛ e ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye fami ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Isak hi Gerar.
Benɛ nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ bi lɛ e yo ɔ he sane ɔ, e de mɛ ke e nyɛmiyo ji yo ɔ nɛ.
E ye gbeye kaa ke e de ke e yo ji Rebeka a, nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ maa gbe lɛ, konɛ a na Rebeka he blɔ; ejakaa Rebeka he ngɛ fɛu saminya.
Benɛ Isak hi lejɛ ɔ be saii ɔ, ligbi ko ɔ, Filisti matsɛ, Abimelek ya buu si ngɛ saflɛ tue ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e na Isak nɛ e ngɛ e yo Rebeka he fiɛe.
Abimelek tsɔ ya tsɛ Isak kɛ ba, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mamoo o yo ji yo ɔ!
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o de ke o nyɛmiyo ji lɛ ɔ?” Isak he nɔ ke, “I susu kaa ke i de ke ye yo ji lɛ ɔ, a maa gbe mi.” Abimelek ya nɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o pee wɔ nɛ ɔ?
Kaa ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko kɛ o yo ɔ ya na bɔmi jinɛ tse o kɛ musu ba wa nɔ?” Abimelek wo ma a tsuo mlaa ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee nyumu nɛ ɔ, aloo e yo ɔ yayami ko ɔ, a gbe lɛ.” Isak du ní ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ jamɛ a jeha a, e kpa nɔ́ nɛ e du ɔ yi totoe lafa, ejakaa Yawɛ gbaa lɛ.
E na ní, nɛ níhi a mi hi ha lɛ hluu kɛ ya si e pee niatsɛ.
E ngɛ to, kɛ na, kɛ tsɔli babauu; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a hɛ kɔ̃ e nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, vuhi tsuo nɛ e tsɛ Abraham tsɔli ɔmɛ tsua, benɛ Abraham ngɛ je mi ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ tsɛ̃ zu kɛ wo a mi, nɛ a tsi mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Jehanɛ, Abimelek de Isak ke, “Jee wa zugba a nɔ kɛ ho; o he ba wa tsɔ pe wɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Isak je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya ma e bo tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ Gerar kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ.
Vu ɔmɛ nɛ a tsua ngɛ Isak tsɛ Abraham yi nɔ, nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ tsi benɛ Abraham gbo se ɔ, Isak kpale tsua ekohu.
Isak wo vu ɔmɛ biɛhi nɛ e tsɛ wo mɛ ɔ kɛ̃.
Isak nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsua vu ko ngɛ Gerar kɔ̃ ɔ mi nɛ a ya na nyu.
Se Gerar to hyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ Isak to hyɛli ɔmɛ pɛ, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Nyu nɛ ɔ, wa nɔ́.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Isak wo vu ɔ biɛ ke Esek, ejakaa a kɛ lɛ pɛ ngɛ he.
Isak nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsua vu kpa, nɛ pɛ ba lɔ ɔ hu he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Isak wo vu ɔ biɛ ke Sitna.
Isak hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ya tsua vu kpa.
Lɔ ɔ lɛɛ pɛ ko ti si ngɛ he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo jamɛ a vu ɔ biɛ ke Rehobot, nɛ e de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ ha wɔ blɔ; wa maa hi zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ wa ma plɔke ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Isak je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Beersheba ya.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Imi ji o tsɛ Abraham Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Koo ye gbeye, ejakaa i kɛ mo ngɛ.
Ma gbaa mo, nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Abraham he je ɔ, ma ha mo nina babauu.” Isak ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ja Yawɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ma e bo tsu ɔ, nɛ e nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsua vu kpa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Isak kɛ Abimelek so Ligbi ko ɔ, Abimelek, kɛ e ga wolɔ Ahuzat, kɛ e tatsɛ Fikol je Gerar kɛ ba Isak ngɔ.
Isak bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ fie mi kɛ je nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ mɛni nyɛ ma peemi ngɛ ye ngɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa yɔse kaa Yawɛ kɛ mo ngɛ, nɛ wa susu kaa e sa kaa somi ko nɛ hi wa kpɛti.
Wa ngɛ hlae nɛ o wo wɔ si kaa o be wɔ yayami ko pee, kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa pee we mo yayami ko ɔ. Wa na mo mɔbɔ, nɛ benɛ o yaa hu wa wo mo blɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Nɔ́ jemi ko be kulaa kaa piɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ gbaa mo.” Isak tsɛ mɛ ní yemi nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu nɔ́ ko.
A te si mɔtu kpla, nɛ a ka a he kita.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Isak wo mɛ blɔ nɛ a mi gba ngɛ bua jɔmi mi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Isak nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ngɛ vu ɔ nɛ a tsua a he.
A de lɛ ke, “Wa na nyu.” Isak wo vu ɔ biɛ ke “Sheba.” Bɔ nɛ ba nɛ Beersheba ma a na e biɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Esau ma se yi ɔmɛ Benɛ Esau ye jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ, e ngɔ Hit yihewi enyɔ.
Mɛ ji Beeri biyo Yudit, kɛ Elon biyo Basemat.
Yi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ haomi nɛ nya wa ba Isak kɛ Rebeka a nɔ.
Isak gbaa Yakob Benɛ Isak ba bwɔ, nɛ e hɛngmɛ yu ɔ, e tsɛ e bi nɔkɔtɔma Esau ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye bi!” Esau he nɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ, i ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Isak de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ i bwɔ, nɛ ye gbenɔ be su ta.
Ngɔɔ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi nɛ o ya nga nɔ nɛ o ya gbe de lo kɛ ba.
Kɛ pee niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ ɔ. Ngɔɔ ba ha mi nɛ ma ye, nɛ ma gbaa mo loko ma gbo.” Benɛ Isak kɛ Esau ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, Rebeka ngɛ tue bue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Esau ho pu mi ya nɛ e ya da de ɔ, Rebeka de Yakob ke, “I nu nɛ o tsɛ ngɛ o nyɛmi Esau dee ke, ‘Yaa hla de lo kɛ ba nɛ o kɛ ba pee niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ ha mi nɛ ma ye nɛ ma gbaa mo ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi loko ma gbo.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, bu mi tue konɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo nɛ ɔ. Yaa to tsu ɔ mi, nɛ o ya nu apletsi saminyawiiwi enyɔ kɛ ba nɛ ma kɛ pee niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o tsɛ suɔ ɔ. O kɛ niye ní ɔ ma ya ha o tsɛ nɛ e ye, konɛ e gbaa mo loko e gbo.” Yakob de e nyɛ Rebeka ke, “Ye nyɛmi Esau ɔ, bwɔmitsɛ ji lɛ, se imi lɛɛ ye he womi nɔ ngɛ tlotlo.
Eko ɔ, tsaatsɛ maa pɛtɛ ye he, nɛ e maa na kaa i sisi lɛ; nɛ i kɛ gbiɛmi mohu, se pi gbaami maa ba imi nitsɛ ye nɔ.” E nyɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ye bi, ha nɛ o gbiɛmi ɔ nɛ ba ye nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i de mo ke o pee ɔ, moo lɛɛ moo pee kɛkɛ; yaa nɛ o ya nu apletsi ɔmɛ kɛ ba.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob ya nu apletsi ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e nyɛ kɛ mɛ pee niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ Isak suɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Rebeka ya ngɔ Esau tade kpakpa pe kulaa a nɛ ngɛ lɛ Rebeka a dɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ kɛ wo Yakob.
Jehanɛ, e ngɔ apletsi ɔmɛ a he womi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yakob ninehi a he, kɛ e kuɛ he nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ tlotlo ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Rebeka ngɔ niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ ɔ, kɛ abolo nɛ e sã a ha Yakob.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob ho e tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ!” Isak he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ye bi!
Mo mɛnɔ?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Imi Esau, o bitɛte ɔ; nɔ́ nɛ o de mi ke ma pee ɔ, i pee.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, tee si nɛ o hi si, nɛ o ye de lo nɛ i kɛ ba a eko, konɛ o gbaa mi.” Isak bi Yakob ke, “Kɛ e ba lɛ kɛɛ loko o he sɔ kɛ ná lo ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ je lɛ ha mi.” Isak de Yakob ke, “Ye bi, hɛɛ mo kɛ ba nɛ ma pɛtɛ o he ma hyɛ kaa ye bi Esau ji mo niinɛ lo.” Benɛ Yakob hɛ lɛ kɛ su e tsɛ Isak he ɔ, e tsɛ ɔ pɛtɛ e he nɛ e de ke, “Gbi ɔ, Yakob gbi, se nine ɔmɛ lɛɛ Esau níhi.” Isak li Yakob mi tso, ejakaa bwɔmi ngɛ e nine ɔmɛ a he kaa Esau ní ɔmɛ.
Loko e gbaa lɛ ɔ, e bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Anɛ ye bi Esau ji mo niinɛ lo?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Ee.” Isak de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ lo ɔ nɛ o ya gbe ɔ eko kɛ ba nɛ ma ye, konɛ ma gbaa mo.” Yakob ngɔ niye ní ɔ ba ha lɛ, nɛ e ye; jehanɛ se hu, e ha lɛ wai nɛ e nu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɛ Isak de lɛ ke, “Ye bi, hɛɛ mo kɛ ba nɛ o ba fiɔ ye nya he.” Benɛ Yakob hɛ lɛ kɛ ba konɛ e ba fiɔ Isak nya he ɔ, Isak nu e tade ɔ mi via; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e gbaa lɛ.
E de lɛ ke, “Ye bi ɔ he via kaa ngmɔ ko nɛ Yawɛ gbaa nɔ, nɛ baa ní ɔ nɔ via.
Mawu nɛ ha mo bɔ́ kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ o zugba a nɛ ba ní, nɛ o na blɛfo kɛ wai babauu.
Je ma amɛ ma sɔmɔ mo, nɛ nimli adesahi ma kpla si ha mo.
O maa ye o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o nyɛbimɛ ɔmɛ ma kpla si ha mo.
Nihi nɛ gbiɛɛ mo ɔ, a maa gbiɛ mɛ; ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbaa mo ɔ, a maa gbaa mɛ.” Esau kpa Isak pɛɛ ke e gbaa lɛ Benɛ Isak gbaa Yakob ta, nɛ Yakob je e tsɛ ɔ ngɔ pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e nyɛmi Esau hu je de dami kɛ ba.
Lɛ hu e ba pee niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ, nɛ e kɛ ba ha e tsɛ ɔ. E de lɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, tee si nɛ o hi si, nɛ o ye de lo nɛ i kɛ ba a eko, konɛ o gbaa mi.” Isak bi lɛ ke, “Mo mɛnɔ?” Esau he nɔ ke, “Imi o bi ɔ; o bitɛte Esau!” Isak he do blibliibli wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e bi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ ya gbe de lo ɔ nɛ e ngɔ ba ha mi ɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Loko o ba a, i ye ní ɔ tsuo nɛ i gbaa lɛ momo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, gbaami ɔ pee e nɔ́!” Benɛ Esau nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Oo Tsaatsɛ, moo gbaa imi hulɔ!” Se Isak he nɔ ke, “O nyɛmi ɔ ba sisi mi, nɛ e ba he o gbaami ɔ kɛ je.” Esau de ke, “E biɛ Yakob ɔ di e he, ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji si enyɔ sɔuu nɛ e sisi mi.
E he ye bitɛte blɔ nya a momo, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu e ba he ye gbaami ɔ!
Anɛ o si we gbaami ɔ eko ha we mi lo?” Isak he nɔ ke, “I pee lɛ o nyɔmtsɛ momo, nɛ i pee nyɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo e nyɔguɛhi.
I ha lɛ ngma kɛ wai.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, nɔ́ ko pa be nɛ ma pee ha mo!” Esau bi e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ, gbaami kake nɛ ɔ pɛ o ngɛ lo?
Tsaatsɛ, moo gbaa imi hulɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Esau wo ya.
Jehanɛ Isak de lɛ ke, “O maa hi zugba nɛ bɛ ní nɔ, Hiɔwe bɔ́ hu be nɛe ha mo.
O klaate nɛ o kɛ ma he o yi wami.
O ma sɔmɔ o nyɛminyumu ɔ.
Se ke o na blɔ ɔ, O ma tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã, Nɛ o maa ye o he.” Esau nyɛ Yakob ngɛ gbaami ɔ nɛ e tsɛ gbaa Yakob ɔ he.
E de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Tsaatsɛ gbenɔ be su ta.
Ke tsaatsɛ gbo nɛ a pee ya se ɔ, ma gbe ye nyɛmi Yakob.” Benɛ Rebeka nu kaa Esau to e yi mi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e tsɔ ya tsɛ Yakob kɛ ba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “O nyɛmi Esau to kaa e maa gbe mo nɛ e kɛ ye e he lue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, bu tue!
Tuu fo esɔ kɛ ya ye nyɛminyumu Laban ngɔ ngɛ Haran.
Yaa hi e ngɔ bɔɔ kɛ yaa si o nyɛmi ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ nya maa ba si, nɛ e hɛ maa je nɔ́ nɛ o pee lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma tsɔ nɛ a ba ngɔ mo kɛ ba.
Mɛni he je ye bimɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a yi maa ta ligbi kake too?” Isak wo Yakob blɔ kɛ ya ha Laban Rebeka de Isak ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma se yiwi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Esau ya ngɔ ɔ, a sane ba gbe ye nya.
Ke e maa ba mi kaa Yakob hu ma ya ngɔ Hit yihewi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko ɔ, lɛɛ afani nɛ ma gbo mohu.”
Isak tsɛ Yakob, nɛ e gbaa lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Koo ngɔ Kanaan yo.
Yaa Mesopotamia, esɔ.
Yaa o nɛ̃ Betuel we ɔ mi, nɛ o ya ngɔ o tsɛko Laban biyi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ gbaa mo, nɛ e ha mo bimɛ babauu, konɛ o ba pee je mahi babauu a tsɛ.
Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ gbaa mo, kɛ o nina kaa bɔ nɛ e gbaa Abraham ɔ, konɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɛ o ba to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, e ba pee o nɔ́, ejakaa Mawu kɛ zugba a ha Abraham.” Isak wo Yakob blɔ kɛ ho Mesopotamia ya, kɛ ya ha Aram no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Betuel ɔ binyumu Laban.
Laban nyɛmiyo ji Rebeka, Esau kɛ Yakob a nyɛ ɔ. Esau ngɔ yo he Esau na kaa Isak gbaa Yakob nɛ e wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ho Mesopotamia ya, konɛ e ya ngɔ yo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E na hu kaa benɛ Isak gbaa Yakob ɔ, e ka lɛ kita ke e ko ngɔ Kanaan yo.
Jehanɛ, e na kaa Yakob bu e nyɛ kɛ e tsɛ tue, nɛ e ho Mesopotamia ya.
Esau ba yɔse kaa e tsɛ Isak ɔ sume Kanaan yihi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Abraham binyumu Ishmael ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya ngɔ Ishmael biyo Mahalat, Nebayot nyɛmiyo ɔ kɛ piɛ e yi ɔmɛ a he.
Yakob nla ngɛ Betel Yakob je Beersheba, nɛ e pue blɔ kɛ yaa Haran.
Benɛ pu nɔ si ɔ, e ya su he ko, nɛ e to si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E ngɔ tɛ nɛ e tslɔ, nɛ e hwɔ lejɛ ɔ. E nla nɛ gba he tso ko maa si ngɛ zugba nɛ e yi mi ya pi hiɔwe, nɛ Mawu bɔfohi ngɛ gba he tso ɔ kuɔe nɛ a ngɛ kplee.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ba da si ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ e de ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ, o nɛ̃ Abraham kɛ o tsɛ Isak a Mawu ɔ. Zugba a nɛ o hwɔɔ si ngɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ha mo kɛ o nina.
O nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa tabo zu.
A maa ha zugba a nɔ tsuo kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa si bonyoku je, jehanɛ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa si leneyi je.
Mo, kɛ o nina a nɔ a maa gu kɛ gbaa je ma amɛ tsuo.
I kɛ mo maa hi si.
He tsuaa he nɛ o yaa a, ma bu o he, nɛ ma kpale mo kɛ ba zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.
I be o he jee; ma pee níhi nɛ i wo mo a he si ɔ ha mo kokooko.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob hɛ tsɛ̃, nɛ e de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Mamoo Yawɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ i li!” E tsui po, nɛ e de ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ gbeye!
Mawu we ji hiɛ ɔ nɛ, tsa pi he kpa ko; hiɔwe agbo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yakob te si mɔtu kpla, nɛ e ngɔ tɛ ɔ nɛ e tslɔ ɔ ngɔ ma si kaa kaimi titima.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e plɛ nu ngɔ pue nɔ, nɛ e kɛ pee tɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu ha Mawu.
E wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Betel, se sa a, a tsɛɛ ma nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke Luz.
Yakob ka Yawɛ kita ke, “Ke o kɛ mi maa hi si, nɛ o maa bu ye he ngɛ blɔ nɛ i ngɛ hiae nɛ ɔ nɔ, ke o ma ha mi ngma nɛ ma ye, kɛ tade nɛ ma wo; ke o maa kpale mi kɛ ba tsaatsɛ we ɔ mi fiafiaafia ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ mo Yawɛ, o maa pee ye Mawu.
Kaimi tɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɔ ma si kaa titima nɛ ɔ, maa pee he nɛ a ma ja mo ngɛ; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma ha mi ɔ, ma ngɔ e mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ ha mo.”
Yakob ya su Laban we ɔ mi Yakob tsa e blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si e ya su zugba a nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nɔ.
Tlukaa a, e ya pã vu ko nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ to kuu etɛ hwɔɔ si kɛ bɔle vu ɔ. Jamɛ a vu ɔ mi nɛ a yɛɛ nyu ngɛ kɛ haa tohi nɛ a nuɔ, nɛ tɛ agbo ko ngɛ vu ɔ nya.
Ke to ɔmɛ tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, to hyɛli ɔmɛ ma kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ je vu ɔ nya nɛ a ma ha to ɔmɛ nyu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ ya to e blɔ he ekohu.
Yakob bi to hyɛli ɔmɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ, jije nyɛ je?” A he nɔ ke, “Wa je Haran.” E bi mɛ ekohu ke, “Anɛ nyɛ le Nahor binyumu Laban lo?” A he nɔ ke, “Ee, wa le lɛ.” E pa bi mɛ ke, “E ngɛ saminya lo?” A he nɔ ke, “Ee, e ngɛ saminya.
Hyɛ, e biyo Rahel nɛ kpaka e to ɔmɛ kɛ ma a nɛ!” Yakob de mɛ ke, “Je jɔɛ lolo; e sui be nɛ a maa wo lohwe ɔmɛ tsu mi.
Nyɛ ha to ɔmɛ nyu nɛ a nu, nɛ nyɛɛ kpale mɛ kɛ ho nɛ a ya ye ní.” To hyɛli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, wa be nyɛe maa pee ja, ja to ɔmɛ tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ je vu ɔ nya, loko wa ma ha mɛ nyu.” Benɛ Yakob kɛ mɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Rahel ba su lejɛ ɔ kɛ e tsɛ to ɔmɛ; ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ to ɔmɛ.
Benɛ Yakob na Rahel kɛ e tsɛko Laban to ɔmɛ ɔ, e ya kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ je vu ɔ nya nɛ e ha to ɔmɛ nyu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fua Rahel atuu, nɛ e kɛ bua jɔmi fo ya pue e nɔ.
E de Rahel ke, “Ye nyɛmi ji mo; o tsɛ nyɛmiyo Rebeka a, e bi ji mi.” Rahel tu fo kɛ ho nɛ e ya bɔ e tsɛ amaniɛ.
Benɛ Laban nu e wɔfase Yakob he ɔ, e tu fo ya kpee lɛ, nɛ e pee lɛ atuu; e fiɔ e nya he, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba we mi.
Benɛ Yakob bɔ Laban nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba a, Laban de ke, “Niinɛ, imi nitsɛ ye nyɛmi tutuutu ji mo!” Yakob hi Laban ngɔ hlami kake.
Yakob sɔmɔ Laban Pee se ɔ, Laban de Yakob ke, “E ngɛ mi kaa o weku no ji mi lɛɛ, se e sɛ kaa o tsuɔ ní kɛ haa mi yaka.
Tsɔɔ mi hiɔwo nɛ o ngɛ hlae.” Laban ngɛ biyihi enyɔ; a tsɛɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ke Lea, nɛ e senɔ ɔ biɛ ji Rahel.
Lea hɛngmɛ ngɛ fɛu saminyayoo, se Rahel lɛɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hi kɛ pi si; e he ngɛ fɛu saminya.
Akɛnɛ Yakob suɔ Rahel he je ɔ, e de Laban ke, “Ma tsu ní ha mo jeha kpaago konɛ o kɛ Rahel, o bi wayo ɔ ha mi nɛ ma ngɔ.” Laban he nɔ ke, “Saminya!
I suɔ kaa i kɛ lɛ ma ha mo pe kaa i kɛ lɛ ma ha nɔ kpa ko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hi ye ngɔ.” Yakob tsu ní jeha kpaago konɛ e kɛ na he blɔ nɛ e ngɔ Rahel.
Se suɔmi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha Rahel he je ɔ, jeha kpaago ɔ be nɛ e pee lɛ kaa ligbi bɔɔ kɛkɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob de Laban ke, “Be ɔ nɛ wa to kaa ma tsu ní ha mo kɛ ya si ɔ, be ɔ su; ha mi o biyo ɔ nɛ ma ngɔ lɛ.” Laban ngmɛ okplɔɔ agbo, nɛ e kpee nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba ní yemi ɔ.
Se jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Laban kɛ e bi Lea mohu ba ha Yakob, nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ.
Laban ngɔ e nyɔguɛ yo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zilpa a ngɔ ha e bi Lea, nɛ e ba pee e mawayo.
Yakob li kaa mamoo Lea mohu e kɛ hwɔ si ɔ, kɛ ya si mɔtu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi Laban ke, “Mɛni o pee mi nɛ ɔ?
Anɛ i tsu we ní ha we mo konɛ ma ngɔ Rahel lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o sisi mi?” Laban he nɔ ke, “Wa hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kusumi ngmɛ́ blɔ ja; a ha we jokuɛyo gba be mi nɛ nɔkɔtɔma gba we lolo.
Mlɛ kɛ yaa si ayɛflo he nyami otsi ɔ maa be.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ke o maa wo si kaa o ma tsu ní ha mi jeha kpaago kpa kɛ piɛ he ɔ, i kɛ Rahel hu ma ha mo.” Yakob kplɛɛ, nɛ benɛ ayɛflo he nyami otsi ɔ be ɔ, Laban kɛ e bi Rahel hu ha lɛ.
Laban kɛ e nyɔguɛ yo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Bilha a ha Rahel, nɛ e ba pee e mawayo.
Yakob kɛ Rahel hu na bɔmi, nɛ e suɔ lɛ kulaa pe Lea.
Yakob tsu ní ha Laban jeha kpaago kɛ piɛ he.
Yakob bimɛ Benɛ Yawɛ na kaa Yakob sume Lea kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ Rahel ɔ, e ha Lea fɔ bimɛ; se Rahel pee yosa.
Lea ba na mi nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
E wo lɛ biɛ ke Ruben, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ na ye we amanehlu ɔ; jehanɛ lɛɛ ye huno ɔ maa suɔ mi.” Lea ba na mi ekohu, nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
E wo lɛ biɛ ke Simeon, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ nu kaa a sume mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha mi binyumu nɛ ɔ hulɔ.” Lea ba na mi ekohu, nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
E wo lɛ biɛ ke Levi, nɛ e de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ye huno ɔ kɛ e he maa mɛtɛ ye he kpɛii, ejakaa i fɔ binyumuhi etɛ ha lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ba na mi ekohu, nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
E wo lɛ biɛ ke Yuda, nɛ e de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma je Yawɛ yi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e po fɔmi.
Benɛ Rahel na kaa e fɔ we ha Yakob ɔ, e hɛ kɔ̃ e nyɛmiyo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de Yakob ke, “Ha mi bimɛ, ke pi ja a, ma gbo.” Yakob mi mi fu lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ Mawu ji mi lo?
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsi o fɔmi nya a nɛ.” Rahel he nɔ ke, “Hyɛ, ye mawayo Bilha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; o kɛ lɛ nɛ hwɔ, nɛ e fɔ ha mi, konɛ imi hu ma na bimɛ kɛ gu e nɔ.” Rahel kɛ e mawayo Bilha ha Yakob, nɛ Yakob kɛ lɛ na bɔmi.
Bilha ba na mi nɛ e fɔ binyumu ha Yakob.
Rahel wo lɛ biɛ ke Dan, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu wo mi nguɔ.
E nu ye kue fami ɔ, nɛ e ha mi binyumu.” Bilha ba na mi ekohu, nɛ e fɔ binyumu enyɔne ha Yakob.
Rahel wo lɛ biɛ ke Naftali, nɛ e de ke, “I kɛ wa wenyɛ ɔ hwu ta nɛ nya wa, nɛ i ye e nɔ.” Benɛ Lea na kaa e fɔmi se po ɔ, e kɛ e mawayo Zilpa ha Yakob kaa e yo, nɛ Yakob kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu.
Lea wo lɛ biɛ ke Gad, nɛ e de ke, “Ye he ba ní pɛ!” Zilpa fɔ binyumu enyɔne ha Yakob.
Lea wo lɛ biɛ ke Asher, nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye bua jɔ ha!
Yi kpa amɛ ma de ke a gbaa mi saminya.” Ligbi ko, benɛ a ngɛ ngma kpae ɔ, Ruben ya na suɔmi tso yiblii komɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha e nyɛ Lea.
Rahel de Lea ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi suɔmi tso yiblii nɛ o bi ɔ kɛ ba a eko.” Lea he nɔ ke, “Nɛ o kpɔ ye huno ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ pi ha mo lolo?
Ye bi ɔ suɔmi tso yiblii nɛ ɔ hu o ma kpɔ lo?” Rahel de lɛ ke, “Ha mi o bi ɔ suɔmi tso yiblii ɔ, konɛ Yakob kɛ mo nɛ hwɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi.” Gbɔkuɛ nya si benɛ Yakob je ngmɔ mi kɛ ma a, Lea je kpo ya kpee lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ma hwɔ o ngɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ejakaa i kɛ suɔmi tso yiblii ɔ nɛ ye bi ɔ kɛ ba a wo he hiɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yakob kɛ lɛ na bɔmi jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi.
Mawu bu Lea kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ e ba na mi, nɛ e kɛ Yakob fɔ binyumu enuɔne.
Lea wo lɛ biɛ ke Isakar, nɛ e de ke, “I kɛ ye mawayo ɔ ha ye huno, nɛ Mawu wo mi hiɔ.” Lea kɛ Yakob na bɔmi ekohu, nɛ Lea ba na mi, nɛ e fɔ binyumu ekpane.
E wo lɛ biɛ ke Zebulun, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu ke mi nɔ́ kpakpa ko.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ ye huno kɛ mi maa hi si saminya, ejakaa i kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumuhi ekpa.” Pee se ɔ, e fɔ biyo nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Dina.
Mawu kai Rahel hulɔ; Mawu bu e kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ e bli e muklii mi nya.
-Rahel ba na mi, nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
E wo lɛ biɛ ke Yosef, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu je ye hɛ mi zo.
Mawu nɛ e pa ha mi binyumu kpa.” Yakob kɛ Laban wo nɔ́ he jua Benɛ a fɔ Yosef se ɔ, Yakob de Laban ke, “Wo mi blɔ konɛ ma kpale kɛ ho ye je he, kɛ ye zugba nɔ ya.
Ye yi ɔmɛ kɛ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i tsu ní ha mo nɛ i kɛ na mɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ mɛ ngɔ ha mi nɛ ma ho.
Mo nitsɛ o le kaa i sɔmɔ mo saminya.” Laban he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de nɛ ɔ tue.
I ya bi ní, nɛ a de mi ke o he nɛ Yawɛ gbaa mi ngɛ.
Tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ o ma he, konɛ ma wo mo hiɔ.” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o le bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ mo, kɛ bɔ nɛ i hyɛ o lohwe ɔmɛ.
Benɛ i ba a, lohwe bɔɔ pɛ o ngɛ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lohwe ɔmɛ bɔ, nɛ a he hiɛ babauu; Yawɛ gu ye nɔ nɛ e kɛ gbaa mo babauu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e su be nɛ ma to blɔ nya kɛ ha imi nitsɛ ye we ɔ.” Laban bi lɛ ke, “Nyɛmɛ ma ha mo?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “I hla we hiɔwo ko.
Ke o maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ma bi mo nɛ ɔ ha mi ɔ, lɛɛ ma tsa nɔ ma hyɛ o to ɔmɛ ha mo.
Ngmɛɛ mi blɔ nɛ ma ya kpa o to ɔmɛ tsuo a mi mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ ma ngɔ jijɔ yumu tsuaa jijɔ yumu, kɛ apletsi bi tsuaa apletsi bi nɛ e he ngɛ huatahuata, loo a tsɔɔtsɔɔ e he.
Hiɔwo pɛ nɛ i ngɛ hlae ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Pee se, ke o ma ye hiɔwo ɔ bumi ɔ, o maa na kaa i ye mo anɔkuale, loo i sisi mo.
Ke o ba na akpakpo ko nɛ e he be huatahuata nɛ a tsɔɔtsɔɔ we e he hulɔ, aloo jijɔ ko nɛ yu we ɔ, lɛɛ o le kaa imi nɛ i ju lɛ.” Laban he nɔ ke, “Saminya!
Wa maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ.” Se jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Laban je akpakpohi nɛ a ngmaangmaa a he ɔ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a tsɔɔtsɔɔ a he ɔ, kɛ apletsi yihi tsuo nɛ a he ngɛ huatahuata, loo a tsɔɔtsɔɔ a he, loo a wo a he so futaa a kɛ je to tsu ɔ mi.
Jijɔ yumu ɔmɛ hu e je mɛ tsuo kulaa kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Laban kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ wo e binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ mɛ kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ je Yakob he, nɛ e nyɛɛ ligbi etɛ.
Yakob hyɛ Laban lohwe kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ. Yakob ya po tso kɔnihi kɛ je tso slɔɔto etɛ a he.
E ngmla tso toto ɔ ngɛ he komɛ, nɛ futaa je si ngɛ tso kɔni ɔmɛ a mi.
E ngɔ tso kɔnihi nɛ e ngmla a he ɔ ba pue to nyu numi ní ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ to ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
E ngɔ mɛ ba pue lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa ke to ɔmɛ ba nyu numi ɔ, a kuɔɔ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ akpakpo ɔmɛ kuɔ eyi ɔmɛ ngɛ tso kɔni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, a fɔ bimɛ nɛ a he ngmaangmaa.
Ekomɛ a he ngɛ huatahuata, nɛ ekomɛ hu a he tsɔɔtsɔɔ mi.
Yakob je jijɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je apletsi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e ha nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee Laban to huatahuata amɛ, kɛ yumuyumu ɔmɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Yakob pee nɛ e kɛ na lɛ nitsɛ e to tsu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e kɛ e to ɔmɛ futuu we Laban ní ɔmɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ tohi nɛ ngɛ he wami saminya a ma bɔni a he kuɔmi ɔ, Yakob maa ngɔ tso kɔni ɔmɛ kɛ ba wo lohwehi a nyu numi nɔ́ ɔ mi ngɛ to ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ke lohwe ɔmɛ be he wami kpakpa ko ɔ, lɛɛ Yakob kɛ tso kɔni ɔmɛ be a hɛ mi fɔe.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, lohwe wudɔwudɔ ɔmɛ ba pee Laban níhi, nɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ he wami saminya a ba pee Yakob níhi.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ Yakob gu nɛ e kɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E na tohi, nyɔguɛhi, afukpɔngɔhi, kɛ tejihi babauu.
Yakob tu fo kɛ je Laban he Yakob nu kaa Laban bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Yakob kpɔ wa tsɛ weto ní tsuo ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e kɛ na e he.” Jehanɛ, Yakob yɔse kaa Laban tsɔ we e hɛ mi ha we lɛ hu kaa sa a. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Yakob ke, “Kpale o se kɛ ho o weku li a ngɔ ya, ngɛ o tsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ.
I kɛ mo maa hi si.” Yakob tsɔ ya de Rahel kɛ Lea ke a kɛ lɛ ba kpe ngɛ nga a nɔ, he nɛ e to ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “I na kaa nyɛ tsɛ tsɔ we e hɛ mi ha we mi hu kaa sa a; se tsaatsɛ e Mawu ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ.
Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ le kaa i tsu ní ha nyɛ tsɛ kɛ ye he wami tsuo.
Nyɛ tsɛ sisi mi, nɛ e tsake ye hiɔwo ɔ si nyɔngma.
Se Mawu ngmɛ́ lɛ blɔ nɛ e pee mi yayami ko.
Be tsuaa be nɛ Laban ma de ke, ‘A kɛ lohwehi kɛ a he huatahuata maa wo mo hiɔ’ ɔ, kɛkɛ jijɔ ɔmɛ tsuo fɔ bimɛ kɛ a he huatahuata.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu pee nɛ e kɛ kpɔ nyɛ tsɛ lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ ha mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Benɛ e su be nɛ lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ a he naa bɔmi ɔ, i nla nɛ akpakpo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ yi ɔmɛ kuɔe ɔ ekomɛ a he ngmaangmaa, ekomɛ a he ngɛ huatahuata, nɛ ekomɛ a he tsɔɔtsɔɔ mi.
Mawu bɔfo ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu ngɛ nlami ɔ mi ke, ‘Yakob!’ Nɛ i he nɔ ke, ‘I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!’ E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, ‘Hyɛ, to akpakpo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ yi ɔmɛ kuɔe ɔ, ekomɛ a he ngmaangmaa, ekomɛ a he ngɛ huatahuata, nɛ ekomɛ a he tsɔɔtsɔɔ mi.
I ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi ja, ejakaa i na níhi tsuo nɛ Laban ngɛ mo pee ɔ. Imi ji Mawu ɔ nɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo ngɛ Betel ɔ nɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ o pɔ tɛ ko nu ngɛ; lejɛ ɔ nɔuu lɛ o ka mi kita ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, dla nɛ o kpale o se esɔ kɛ ya zugba a nɔ he nɛ a fɔ mo ngɛ ɔ.’ ” Rahel kɛ Lea he nɔ ke, “Gbosi ní ko be nɛ wa ma na kɛ je wa tsɛ dɛ hu.
E buu wɔ kaa ma se yihi.
E jua wɔ, nɛ wa yi ní ɔ hu e ye ta!
Níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu kpɔ ngɛ wa tsɛ dɛ ɔ ma ba pee waa kɛ wa bimɛ wa nɔ́.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de mo ke o pee ɔ, pee.” -Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob dla konɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho e tsɛ Isak ngɔ ya ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
E ngɔ e bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e yi ɔmɛ ngɔ hi afukpɔngɔhi a nɔ, nɛ e muɔ lohwehi, kɛ weto ní tsuo nɛ e ba na ngɛ Mesopotamia a, nɛ e pue blɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Laban ho e to ɔmɛ a he bwɔmi sami ya; nɛ benɛ e be we ɔ mi ɔ, Rahel ju e tsɛ wɔ ɔmɛ.
Yakob sisi Laban, Aram no ɔ; e ha we nɛ Laban nɛ le kaa e yaa.
Yakob ngɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ kɛ tu fo.
E po Yufrate pa a, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ yaa Gilead yo ɔ he.
Laban nyɛɛ Yakob se Ligbi etɛne ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko ya de Laban ke Yakob tu fo.
Laban ngɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ a nyɛɛ Yakob se ligbi kpaago kɛ ya si a ya na lɛ ngɛ Gilead yo ɔ he.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Laban, Aram no ɔ ngɛ nlami je, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ o kɛ Yakob ko tu munyu ko; yaya jio, kpakpa jio.” Benɛ Laban ya na Yakob ɔ, Yakob ma e bo tsu ɔ ngɛ yo ɔ he, nɛ lɛ, Laban ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ma a bo tsu ɔ ngɛ Gilead yo ɔ he.
Laban de Yakob ke, “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ o pee mi nɛ ɔ?
O ngɔ ye biyi ɔmɛ kɛ tu fo kɛ yaa kaa nyɔguɛhi nɛ a nuu mɛ ngɛ ta mi.
Mɛni he je o sisi mi, nɛ o ku kɛ je nigii nɛ o de we mi ɔ?
Kaa o de mi jinɛ tse i kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ la, kɛ miɛ, kɛ saku ba je mo blɔ!
O ha we po nɛ i kɛ ye bibi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye biyi ɔmɛ nɛ ye sɛ.
O ye kuasiahi a sane.
Jinɛ i ngɛ he wami nɛ ma nyɛ pee mo yayami, se hiɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, o tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ bɔ mi kɔkɔ ke i kɛ mo ko tu munyu yaya ko.
I le kaa o hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ we he, nɛ lɔ ɔ he o je ɔ nɛ.
Se mɛni he je o ju ye wɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “I ya ye gbeye; i susu kaa o ma kpɔ o biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ ye dɛ pani nya.
O wɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ke o na mɛ ngɛ wa ti nɔ ko dɛ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, ja a gbe lɛ.
Ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, tsɔɔ mi o nɔ́ ko nɛ ba je ye dɛ, konɛ o ngɔ.” Se Yakob li tete kaa Rahel ju Laban wɔ ɔmɛ.
Laban ya hla e wɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yakob, kɛ Lea, kɛ mawayi enyɔ ɔmɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi, se e nɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya sɛ Rahel bo tsu ɔ mi.
Rahel ji nɔ nɛ ju wɔ ɔmɛ; e kɛ wɔ ɔmɛ wo e we afukpɔngɔ ɔ se kotoku ɔ mi, nɛ e hi nɔ.
Laban hla wɔ ɔmɛ kɛ kpa bo tsu ɔ mi tsuo, se e nɛ.
Rahel de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ, o mi mi ko fu mi kaa i ti si ha we mo; i je mi.” Laban hla wɔ ɔmɛ kɛ kpa bo tsu ɔ mi, se e nɛ.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ Yakob tsui ba, nɛ e kɛ abofu de Laban ke, “Mɛni yayami i pee?
Mɛni mlaa i tɔ, loko o hɛ dɔ kɛ nyɛɛ ye se kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
O kpa ye níhi tsuo a mi.
Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ o na nɛ ji o nɔ́ ngɛ ní ɔmɛ a kpɛti?
Je lɛ kpo kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ mo hu o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a kojo i kɛ mo.
Jeha nyingmi enyɔ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i kɛ mo hi si.
O jijɔ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ apletsi yi ɔmɛ eko mi mi sane we hyɛ; o we agbosu ko hu i yi hyɛ.
Ke lohwe awi yeli ba tsɔtslɔɔ jijɔ ko mi ɔ, hiɔ ɔ peeɔ ye nɔ́ nɛ i woɔ; i kɛ lohwe gbogboe ko ba tsɔɔ we mo hyɛ.
Ke a ju nɔ́ ko, piani jio, nyɔ mi jio, o haa nɛ i woɔ mo hiɔ sisiisi.
Latsa tsaa mi piani, nɛ fĩɛ yee mi nyɔ mi; nɛ be komɛ ɔ, mahe jee ye hɛ mi.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ i pee nɛ i kɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ sɔuu ngɛ o ngɔ.
I tsu ní jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ, nɛ i kɛ ngɔ o biyi enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ, i hyɛ o to ɔmɛ jeha ekpa, se kɛ̃ o tsake ye hiɔwo ɔ si nyɔngma.
Ke pi nɛnɛ Abraham, kɛ tsaatsɛ Isak a Mawu ɔ nɛ e kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ, jinɛ o wo mi blɔ dɛ gu kɛ je momo.
Se Mawu na ye nɔ́ nami ɔ, kɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ i tsu ɔ; enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e ka o hɛ mi hiɛ nyɔ mi ɔ nɛ.” Yakob kɛ Laban so Laban he nɔ nɛ e de Yakob ke, “Yihewi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ye bimɛ ji mɛ; a bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ye bimɛ ji mɛ, nɛ to nɛ ɔmɛ hu ye níhi ji mɛ.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se akɛnɛ i be nyɛe ma tsi ye biyi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ a nya he je ɔ, ha nɛ i kɛ mo waa so.
Ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ pee odase ngɛ i kɛ mo wa kpɛti.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob ya wo tɛ ba ma si kaa kaimi nɔ́.
E fa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke a bua tɛhi a nya nɛ a to glekuglekuu.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a ye ní ngɛ tɛhi nɛ a to glekuglekuu ɔ a kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Laban wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Yegar Sahaduta; se Yakob lɛɛ e wo lɛ ke Galeed.
Laban de Yakob ke, “Kikɛmɛ a tɛ kuu nɛ ɔ maa pee odase nɔ́ ha wɔ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Galeed ɔ nɛ.
Laban hu de Yakob ke, “Be mi nɛ i kɛ mo wa mi gba a, Yawɛ nɛ bu wa he.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ kpa ke Mizpa.
Laban ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Ke o ya wa ye biyi ɔmɛ yi mi, aloo o ya ngɔ yi kpa komɛ ngɔ piɛ a he nɛ i li po ɔ, kai kaa Mawu ji imi kɛ mo wa we odase.
Tɛ kuu ɔ nɛ maa hi imi kɛ mo wa kpɛti ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; kaimi tɛ ɔ hu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Tɛ kuu nɛ ɔ, kɛ kaimi tɛ nɛ ɔ ji odasehi.
I be tɛ kuu nɛ ɔ he bee gblegbleegble kɛ ba tua mo.
Ja nɔuu, mo hu o ko be tɛ kuu nɛ ɔ, loo kaimi tɛ nɛ ɔ he kɔkɔɔkɔ kɛ ba tua mi.
Abraham kɛ Nahor a Mawu ɔ nɛ ji a tsɛ ɔ Mawu ɔ maa kojo imi kɛ mo wa kpɛti.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob ngɔ Mawu nɛ e tsɛ Isak jaa lɛ ɔ biɛ kɛ ka kita kaa e maa ye si womi nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Yakob gbe lohwe nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ.
E tsɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ní yemi; benɛ a ye ní ɔ gbe nya a, a hi yoku ɔ nɔ nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo.
Makɛ mla a, Laban fiɔ e bibimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e biyi ɔmɛ a nya he, nɛ e gbaa mɛ, nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
Yakob dla konɛ e kɛ Esau ya kpe Benɛ Yakob ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, e kɛ Mawu bɔfo komɛ kpe.
Benɛ Yakob na mɛ ɔ, e de ke, “Mawu hi he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ;” lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Mahanaim.
Yakob tsɔ nihi kɛ sɛ e hlami kɛ ho e nyɛmi Esau ngɔ ya ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ.
E fa mɛ ke a ya de Esau ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, imi o tsɔlɔ Yakob ɔ, i ngɛ hae nɛ o le kaa i ya to Laban nubwɔ, nɛ i kɛ lɛ hi si be babauu kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ. I ngɛ na, teji, to, kɛ nyɔguɛhi nyumuhi kɛ yihi.
Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i tsɔ tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ha nɛ o le kaa i ma we; i heɔ yeɔ kaa o ma he mi atuu.” Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba Yakob ngɔ ɔ, a de lɛ ke, “Wa ya na o nyɛmi Esau ɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ nihi lafa eywiɛ ma nɛ a ba kpee mo.” Yakob tsui po wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e hao.
E gba e we bi ɔmɛ a mi enyɔ, nɛ e gba to ɔmɛ, kɛ na amɛ, kɛ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a mi ngɔ wo kuu enyɔ mi ja nɔuu.
E de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Ke Esau ba tua kuu kake ɔ, kuu enyɔne ɔ maa tu fo kɛ je.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob fa kue ha Mawu ke, “Mawu lee!
Nɛnɛ Abraham Mawu, kɛ tsaatsɛ Isak Mawu!
Yawɛ, mo lɛ o de mi ke ma kpale ye se kɛ ba ye zugba nɔ, ngɛ ye weku li a ngɔ, nɛ o maa pee mi saminya.
Mɔbɔ nami nɛ se pui gblegbleegble nɛ o je kpo ngɔ ha mi ɔ, i sɛ.
Benɛ ma po Yordan pa a, dɛma tso pɛ i hɛɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi; se piɔ lɛɛ i kpale ba kɛ asafo kuu enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o je mi kɛ je ye nyɛmi Esau dɛ mi.
I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa e ma ba tua wɔ nɛ e ma kpata waa kɛ wa yi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo wa hɛ mi.
Kai kaa mo lɛ o wo mi si ke o maa pee mi saminya.
Kai kaa mo lɛ o de ke o ma ha mi nina babauu kaa wo nya zia, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane.” -Yakob hwɔ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi.
E nɔ jena a, e hla lohwehi nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ ekomɛ, konɛ e kɛ ya ke e nyɛmi Esau.
Lohwe ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: apletsi yo lafa enyɔ, kɛ akpakpo nyingmi enyɔ; jijɔ yo lafa enyɔ, kɛ agbosu nyingmi enyɔ; afukpɔngɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɔ hae nyingmi etɛ, kɛ a bimɛ; na yo nyingmi eywiɛ, kɛ na ku nyɔngma; teji eyo nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ teji ku nyɔngma.
E dla mɛ ngɔ wo kuukuu a mi; kuu tsuaa kuu kɛ e nyatsɛ.
E de tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kuu ɔmɛ a nya a ke, “Nyɛɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ho; nyɛ si blɔ ngɛ kuu kake kɛ kuu nɛ nyɛɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ a kpɛti.” E de tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ ke, “Ke o kɛ ye nyɛmi Esau kpe, nɛ e bi mo ke, ‘Mɛnɔ ji o nyɔmtsɛ?
Jije o yaa?
Lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi ɔ, mɛnɔ lohwehi?’ ɔ, de lɛ ke, ‘Lohwehi nɛ o tsɔlɔ Yakob tsɔ nɛ a kɛ ba ke mo, e nyɔmtsɛ Esau ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yakob nitsɛ ngɛ se kɛ ma.’ ” Yakob de tsɔlɔ enyɔne ɔ, etɛne ɔ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a nya a hu ke, “Ke nyɛɛ kɛ Esau kpe ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma de lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nɔ nɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke, ‘O tsɔlɔ Yakob ngɛ wa se kɛ ma’ ” Yakob de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “I kɛ nike ní nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ ma kpata lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ke i kɛ lɛ kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi ɔ, eko ɔ, e kɛ ye tɔmi maa ke mi.” Yakob kɛ nike ní ɔ mane, se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e hwɔ sito he ɔ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi.
Yakob kɛ nɔ ko fia atlibo ngɛ Peniel Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yakob te si, nɛ e kɛ e yihi enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e mawayi enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ po Yabok pa a. Benɛ e kɛ mɛ po pa a ta a, e ngɔ e níhi tsuo hu kɛ po pa a, nɛ e ba piɛ lɛ Yakob ɔ nɔ kake ngmelu ngɛ se.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ko kɛ lɛ ba fia atlibo kɛ ya si makɛ.
Benɛ nyumu ɔ na kaa e nyɛ we Yakob ɔ, e fia Yakob mlɛ mi nɔ́, nɛ Yakob gbongu huã.
Nyumu ɔ de Yakob ke, “Ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ ma ho; je ngɛ mi nae!” Yakob he nɔ ke, “I be hae nɛ o ya, ja o gbaa mi lolo!” Nyumu ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ a tsɛɛ mo kɛɛ?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Ye biɛ ji Yakob.” Nyumu ɔ de lɛ ke, “A be o biɛ tsɛe ke Yakob hu.
O kɛ Mawu kɛ nimlihi nɔ kunɔ, nɛ o ye kunimi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ a ma tsɛ mo ke Israel.” Yakob de nyumu ɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ moo tsɔɔ mi o biɛ.” Se nyumu ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ hlae nɛ o le ye biɛ ɔ?
Kɛkɛ nɛ e gbaa Yakob.” Yakob wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Peniel, nɛ e de ke, “I wo kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa i na Mawu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, se i gbo we.” Benɛ Yakob je Peniel ɔ, pu gba; nɛ e gbongu ɔ nɛ huã he je ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e nyɛɛ tutuutu.
Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, Israel bi yi lo nɛ ngɛ mlɛ mi tsami he ɔ, ejakaa Yakob mlɛ mi tsami he ɔ ji he nɛ nyumu ɔ fia nɔ́ ɔ nɛ.
Yakob kɛ Esau kpe Yakob na Esau nɛ e kɛ nihi lafa eywiɛ ma e ngɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e dla e bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Lea kɛ Rahel kɛ mawayi enyɔ ɔmɛ.
E ngɔ mawayi ɔmɛ kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to hɛ mi.
Lea kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ se, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, Rahel kɛ Yosef ba.
Yakob nitsɛ lɛɛ e sɛ hlami, nɛ benɛ e kɛ e nyɛmi ɔ maa ho buami ya a, e kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si si kpaago.
Se Esau tu fo ba kpee Yakob nɛ e fua lɛ atuu.
E kɛ e nine fɔ e kuɛ mi, nɛ e fiɔ e nya he, nɛ a fo ya.
Benɛ Esau na yi ɔmɛ kɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ ɔ, e bi ke, “Mɛnɔmɛ o kɛ nyɛɛ ɔ?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Bimɛ nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mawayi ɔmɛ kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a ba kpla si.
Lea kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ hu ba, nɛ a ba kpla si.
Nyagbe ɔ, Yosef kɛ Rahel hu ba, nɛ a ba kpla si ja nɔuu.
Esau bi ke, “Lohwe kuukuu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i kɛ kpe ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Nike ní nɛ i kɛ ma mo, ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpatami ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.” Se Esau de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmi, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ hiɛ; ha nɛ enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a hi si ha mo.” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
I kpa mo pɛɛ, ke o kɛ ye tɔmi pa mi ɔ, lɛɛ mo he ye nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, nɛ i na o hɛ mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ i na Mawu nitsɛ hɛ mi; ejakaa o ná ye he tsui, nɛ o he mi atuu.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o he nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɔ ba ha mo ɔ; Mawu nɛ na mi mɔbɔ, nɛ e ha mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia mi.” Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Yakob hao Esau hluu kɛ ya si Esau kplɛɛ nɛ e he nike ní ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ Esau de Yakob ke, “Ha waa ho; ma sɛ o hlami.” Yakob he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, mo nitsɛ o na kaa jokuɛwi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi fa we lolo.
Jehanɛ hu, tohi kɛ nahi nɛ a bimɛ ji nyɔ nya lolo ɔ hu a he ní tsumi fɔɔ si ngɛ ye kuɛ nɔ.
Ke a ha nɛ a nyɛɛ tsɔ pe nine ligbi kake po ɔ, lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ma gbo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o sɛ hlami; i kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ maa hi nyɛɛe blɛuublɛuu kɛ yaa si wa ma ba na mo ngɛ Edom.” Esau de lɛ ke, “Saminya!
Lɛɛ ma si ye we bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ.” Se Yakob he nɔ ke, “Oo!
E he hia we!
Ke ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na ye he tsui kɛkɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ hiɛ.” Esau kpale e se jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ ho Edom ya.
Se Yakob lɛɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Sukot ya.
E ya po we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma tsu ha e lohwe ɔmɛ hulɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Sukot.
Yakob kpale e se kɛ je Mesopotamia kɛ ba Shekem ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ fiafiaafia, nɛ e ba ma e bo tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba ko nɔ, ngɛ ma a nya.
E he jamɛ a zugba a ngɛ Shekem tsɛ Hamor dɛ kɛ sika hiɔ yi lafa.
Hamor ji nɔ nɛ to Shekem ma a sisi.
Yakob ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Israel Mawu ɔ biɛ wo lɛ.
Nɔ ko ya tua Dina Ligbi ko ɔ, Lea biyo ɔ nɛ e kɛ Yakob fɔ, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Dina a je kpo konɛ e ya slaa Kanaan yi ɔmɛ ekomɛ.
Benɛ Hamor binyumu Shekem na Dina a, e nu lɛ pani nya nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ.
Hamor nɛ ɔ, Hiv no ji lɛ, nɛ lɛ ji jamɛ a zugba a nɔ yelɔ.
Shekem na Dina he bua jɔmi; e suɔ lɛ saminya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ sɛɛ ni.
Pee se ɔ, Shekem de e tsɛ Hamor ke, “Yaa bi yiheyo nɛ ɔ si ha mi nɛ ma ngɔ lɛ.” Yakob nu kaa nɔ ko ya pee e biyo Dina basabasa; se akɛnɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ e lohwe ɔmɛ ho nga nɔ ya he je ɔ, e de we nɔ́ ko kɛ ya si a kpale kɛ ba.
Shekem tsɛ Hamor ba Yakob ngɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba sɛɛ ní.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ hu je nga nɔ kɛ ba.
Benɛ a nu sane nɛ ba a, a mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa Shekem tsu zo ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel; kaa e nu Yakob biyo pani nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Shekem pee nɛ ɔ, a hiɔ̃.
Hamor de Yakob ke, “Ye binyumu Shekem suɔ kaa e kɛ o biyo ɔ maa hi si.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ o biyo ɔ nɛ ha lɛ nɛ e ngɔ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa ha wa he gba; nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ ha wɔ, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ngɔ wa biyi ɔmɛ.
Ke nyɛ kplɛɛ ja a, waa kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
Wa zugba a fɔɔ si ha nyɛ; nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ maa hi si faa, nyɛ maa ye jua, nɛ nyɛ ma na nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ weto ní.” Shekem hu de Dina tsɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ ye tɔmi ɔ ngɔ pa mi; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bi mi ɔ, ma ha nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi nike ní nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae, konɛ yo se ní ɔ hu nyɛɛ wo he jua bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ yiheyo ɔ ngɔ ha mi nɛ ma ngɔ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma bi mi ɔ, ma ha nyɛ.” Se akɛnɛ Shekem ble Dina, Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a nyɛmiyo ɔ he je ɔ, mɛ hu a sisi Shekem kɛ e tsɛ Hamor ɔ.
A de mɛ ke, “Wa be nyɛe maa pee ja kaa waa kɛ wa nyɛmiyo ma ha mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ; ke wa pee ja kɛkɛ wa pue wa hɛ mi si.
Ke nyɛ maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa po nyɛ nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, lɛɛ wa maa kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ de ɔ nɔ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja lɛɛ waa kɛ wa biyi ɔmɛ ma ha nyɛ, nɛ wɔ hu wa maa ngɔ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ.
Waa kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, nɛ wa maa pee ma kake.
Se ke nyɛ kplɛɛ we kaa a po nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ wa maa ngɔ wa nyɛmiyo ɔ kɛ ho.” Hamor kɛ e bi Shekem kplɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ bi ɔ, a maa pee.
E yi be ko nɛ Shekem ya pee nɔ́ nɛ a de lɛ ke e sa kaa e pee ɔ; ejakaa e suɔ Yakob biyo ɔ saminya.
Jehanɛ se hu, a buu lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ weku li ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Hamor kɛ e bi Shekem ya kpe he ɔ, ngɛ maa agbo ɔ nya, nɛ a kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ya tu munyu, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ saminya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a hi zugba a nɔ nɛ a ye jua, ejakaa zugba a kle ha mɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ngɔ a biyi ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a ngɔ wa biyi ɔmɛ.
Ni ɔmɛ kplɛɛ kaa a kɛ wɔ maa hi si nɛ a kɛ wɔ maa pee ma kake, ke ji kaa wa maa po wa kpɛti nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, kaa bɔ nɛ a po mɛ ɔ. Ke wa pee ja a, a lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ma ba pee wa nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa kplɛɛ ha mɛ kɛkɛ, konɛ a kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si.” Ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya a, kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Hamor kɛ e bi Shekem de ɔ nɔ, nɛ a po nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ligbi etɛne ɔ nɔ, benɛ pa a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ yee wawɛɛ ɔ, Yakob binyumuhi enyɔ, Simeon kɛ Levi ngɔ a klaate ɔmɛ nɛ a ya tua ma a tlukaa, nɛ a gbe nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Simeon kɛ Levi nɛ ɔ, Dina nyɛbimɛ ji mɛ.
A gbe Hamor kɛ e bi Shekem hulɔ, nɛ a ya ngɔ Dina ngɛ Shekem we ɔ mi kɛ je.
Jehanɛ Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo ya sɛ ma a mi, nɛ a ha ní ngɛ a nyɛmiyo ɔ nɛ a pue e hɛ mi si ɔ he.
A nuu to, kɛ na, kɛ teji, nɛ a muɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nga nɔ kɛ je.
A ngɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa.
A nuu yihi kɛ jokuɛwi tsuo, nɛ a ha ní ngɛ wehi a mi.
Yakob de Simeon kɛ Levi ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ mi wo amanehlu mi pɛ; jehanɛ lɛɛ Kanaan, kɛ Periz bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa nyɛ mi.
I be we bi babauu; ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo bla ngɔ wo ye he, nɛ a ba tua mi ɔ, a ma kpata wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi.” Se a he nɔ ke, “Anɛ e sa kaa waa ngmɛ blɔ nɛ a pee wa nyɛmiyo ɔ kaa a peeɔ yo yaholɔ lo?”
Mawu gbaa Yakob ngɛ Betel Mawu de Yakob ke, “Yaa Betel esɔ, nɛ o ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Yaa ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ha imi, Mawu ɔ nɛ i je ye he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo, benɛ o tu o nyɛmi Esau nya fo ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob de e yi ɔmɛ, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ ke, “Nyɛ jé ma se mawu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ ɔ ngɔ pue he; nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛɛ wo tadehi nɛ a he tsɔ.
Wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jee kɛ yaa Betel.
Ma ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ha Mawu ɔ nɛ piɛ ye he ngɛ ye amanehlu be ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ mi ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ.” A ngɔ a ma se mawu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ a dɛ ɔ, kɛ a tue nya ní ɔmɛ ba ha Yakob; nɛ Yakob pu ngɛ tso ngua a sisi ngɛ Shekem kasa nya.
Benɛ Yakob kɛ e yi ɔmɛ, e bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ yaa a, sawale nu ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nyɛɛ we a se.
Yakob kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo ba su Luz, ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
Ma nɛ ɔ biɛ kpa ji Betel.
Yakob ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Betel Mawu ɔ biɛ wo lɛ; ejakaa lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ Mawu je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ, benɛ e tu e nyɛmi Esau nya fo ɔ. Bimɛanyɛ ɔ nɛ hyɛ Rebeka ngɛ e jokuɛ mi, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Debora a ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ tso ngua a sisi, ngɛ Betel leneyi je.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke, “Tso ngua he nɛ a woɔ ya ngɛ.” Benɛ Yakob je Mesopotamia kɛ ba a, Mawu je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ekohu, nɛ e gbaa lɛ.
Mawu de lɛ ke, “O biɛ ji Yakob; se kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, a be mo tsɛe ja hu; a ma tsɛ mo Israel.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu wo lɛ biɛ ke Israel.
Jehanɛ Mawu de lɛ ke, “Imi ji Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ; mo fɔ bimɛ babauu.
Niinɛ, je mahi kɛ matsɛmɛ maa je o mi.
Zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha Abraham kɛ Isak ɔ, i kɛ ma ha mo kɛ o nina.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu je e he ngɛ he nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ ɔ. Yakob kɛ kaimi tɛ ko ma si ngɛ he nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu ngɛ ɔ. E plɛ wai kɛ oliv nu ngɔ pue nɔ, nɛ e kɛ pee tɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Mawu.
E wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Betel; e sisi ji Mawu we.
Rahel gbenɔ Yakob kɛ e yi ɔmɛ, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Betel, nɛ a pue blɔ.
Benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa su Efrat ɔ, Rahel fɔmi be su, nɛ e nu kɔɔmi nɛ nya wa.
Benɛ e fɔmi ɔ he ba wa a, fɔlɔyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ hyɛe ɔ de lɛ ke, “Rahel, koo ye gbeye; o fɔ binyumu ekohu!” Se Rahel miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
Loko e ma e nya a, e wo bi ɔ nɛ e fɔ ɔ ke Benoni; se e tsɛ lɛɛ biɛ nɛ e wo lɛ ji Benyamin.
Benɛ Rahel gbo ɔ, a pu lɛ ngɛ blɔ nɛ yaa Efrat ɔ he.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ a tsɛɛ Efrat ma a ke Betlehem.
Yakob kɛ kaimi tɛ ma Rahel yɔkɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ tɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Yakob, nɛ e biɛ tsake pee Israel ɔ, tsa e nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ya ma e bo tsu ɔ ngɛ Eder mɔ ɔ se.
Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ Benɛ Yakob ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, Ruben kɛ Bilha, e tsɛ pla amɛ a ti nɔ kake ɔ ya na bɔmi; nɛ Yakob nu he.
Yakob ngɛ binyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Lea binyumuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ruben (Yakob bitɛte), Simeon, Levi, Yuda, Isakar, kɛ Zebulun.
Rahel binyumuhi ji Yosef kɛ Benyamin.
Rahel mawayo Bilha binyumuhi ji Dan kɛ Naftali.
Lea mawayo Zilpa binyumuhi ji Gad kɛ Asher.
A fɔ bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha Yakob ngɛ Mesopotamia.
Isak gbenɔ Yakob ba e tsɛ Isak ngɔ ngɛ Mamre, he nɛ Abraham kɛ Isak ba to nubwɔ ngɛ ɔ. Mamre biɛ kpa ji Kiriat Arba, aloo Hebron.
Isak ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ, nɛ e gbo benɛ e bwɔ kotokoto; nɛ e bimɛ Esau kɛ Yakob pu lɛ.
Esau nina Esau, nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Edom ɔ, e he sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Esau ngɔ Kanaan yihi.
Mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Hit no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Elon ɔ biyo Ada, kɛ Hiv no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zibeon ɔ bi Ana biyo Oholibama, kɛ Ishmael biyo Basemat, Nebayot nyɛmiyo ɔ. Ada kɛ Esau fɔ Elifaz; Basemat fɔ Reuel; nɛ Oholibama fɔ Yeush, Yalam, kɛ Kora.
Binyumuhi nɛ Esau fɔ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Esau ngɔ e yi ɔmɛ, e binyumu ɔmɛ, e biyi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, e lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e bua nya ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ ɔ, nɛ e je e nyɛmi Yakob he kɛ ho zugba kpa nɔ ya.
