Esau je e nyɛmi ɔ he, ejakaa e kɛ Yakob ɔ a weto ní hiɛ babauu pe bɔ nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a ma nyɛ hi he kake; a lohwe ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu, nɛ zugba a he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ kpi mɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Esau hia kɛ ya hi Edom yo ɔ nɔ.
Esau, Edom bi ɔmɛ a tsɛ ɔ nina ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
-Esau kɛ e yo Ada fɔ binyumu kake; e biɛ ji Elifaz.
Elifaz fɔ binyumuhi enuɔ.
Mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam, kɛ Kenaz.
Elifaz kɛ e yo kpa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Timna fɔ binyumu kake kɛ piɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a he; e biɛ ji Amalek.
Esau kɛ e yo Basemat fɔ binyumu kake; e biɛ ji Reuel.
Reuel fɔ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
Mɛ ji Nahat, Zera, Shama, kɛ Miza.
Esau kɛ e yo Oholibama, Zibeon bi Ana biyo ɔ, fɔ binyumuhi etɛ.
Mɛ ji Yeush, Yalam, kɛ Kora.
Wɛtsohi nɛ je Esau mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Esau bitɛte Elifaz ji wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a nɛ̃: Teman, Omar, Zefo, Kenaz, Kora, Gatam kɛ Amalek.
Esau yo Ada nina ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Esau binyumu Reuel ji wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a nɛ̃: Nahat, Zera, Shama, kɛ Miza.
Esau yo Basemat nina ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ je Esau yo Oholibama, Ana biyo ɔ mi: Yeush, Yalam, kɛ Kora.
Esau nina ji wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Seir nina -Hori no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Seir ɔ nina ji wɛtsohi nɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ je a mi ɔ nɛ.
Wɛtso ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Ana, Dishon, Ezer, kɛ Dishan.
Lotan binyumuhi ji Hori kɛ Heman.
Lotan ngɛ nyɛmiyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Timna.
Shobal binyumuhi ji Alvan, Manahat, Ebal, Shefo, kɛ Onam.
Zibeon binyumuhi ji Aya kɛ Ana.
Ana nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ya na nyu la vuhi ngɛ nga a nɔ, benɛ e ngɛ e tsɛ Zibeon teji ɔmɛ hyɛe ɔ nɛ.
-Ana ji Dishon tsɛ.
Dishon ji Hemdan, Eshban, Itran, kɛ Keran a nɛ̃.
Ana ngɛ biyo ko hu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ke Oholibama.
Ezer binyumuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Bilhan, Zaavan, kɛ Akan.
Dishan binyumuhi ji Uz kɛ Aran.
-Hor wɛtso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Ana, Dishon, Ezer, kɛ Dishan.
Edom matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ -Loko a wo matsɛ ngɛ Israel ɔ, nyumuhi nɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ a sibi a se ji nɛ ɔmɛ: Beor bi Bela nɛ je Dinhaba Zera bi Yobab nɛ je Bozra Husham nɛ je Teman zugba a nɔ Bedad bi Hadad nɛ je Avit (Hadad ji nɔ nɛ ye Midian bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi ngɛ ta mi, ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ) Samla nɛ je Masreka Shaul nɛ je Rehobot, ngɛ pa a he Akbor bi Baal Hanan Hadad nɛ je Pau (E yo biɛ ji Mehetabel, Mezahab biyo Matred bi ɔ) -Esau ji Edom wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a nɛ̃: Timna, Alva, Yetet, Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel, kɛ Iram.
A kɛ wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a biɛhi wo hehi nɛ a hi ɔ.
Yosef kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ Yakob hi Kanaan zugba a nɛ e tsɛ ba to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Yakob kɛ e yi ɔmɛ kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a he sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ niheyo wayoo Yosef ɔ ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaago ɔ, e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ji e tsɛ yi kpa amɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ, hyɛɛ a tsɛ to ɔmɛ.
Yi nɛ ɔmɛ ji Bilha kɛ Zilpa.
Ke pee ɔ, Yosef ba bɔɔ e tsɛ ní yayahi nɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ hii pee.
Yakob suɔ Yosef sane pe e bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; ejakaa benɛ a fɔ Yosef ɔ, lɛ Yakob ɔ bwɔ momo.
Yakob kpɛ tade klɔii saminyayoo ko ngɔ wo Yosef.
Benɛ Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ na kaa a tsɛ suɔ Yosef pe mɛ tsuo ɔ, a nyɛ lɛ, nɛ a ha we lɛ hɛ mi.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Yosef nla nlami ko; nɛ benɛ e bɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nlami ɔ, a nyɛ lɛ pe sa a. E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nlami nɛ i nla nɛ ɔ tue.
Wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ ngmɔ mi nɛ wa ngɛ ngma fie.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ye ngma a nɛ i fi ɔ te da si; nɛ nyɛ ngma amɛ ba bɔle ye ngma a, nɛ a kpla si ha lɛ.” E nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ tse o ma ba ye wa nɔ matsɛ, pi ja lo?” Nlami ɔ nɛ Yosef sɛɛ ha e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ha nɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ lɛ pe kekle ɔ. Pee se ɔ, Yosef nla nlami kpa, nɛ e bɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “I pa nla nlami kpa.
I nla nɛ pu kɛ hlami kɛ dodoe nyɔngma kɛ kake ba kpla si ngɛ ye hɛ mi.” E ya bɔ e tsɛ hu nlami nɛ ɔ, nɛ e tsɛ ka e hɛ mi ke, “Mɛni nlami ji nɛ ɔ?
Lɛɛ tse i kɛ o nyɛ kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ma ba kpla si ha mo lo?” Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a mi mi wo la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, se e tsɛ ɔ lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ sane ɔmɛ a he susue.
A jua Yosef kɛ ho Egipt ya Ligbi ko, benɛ Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ̃ a tsɛ to ɔmɛ kɛ ho Shekem ya nɛ a ya hyɛ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Yakob de Yosef ke, “O nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ ho Shekem ya nɛ a ya hyɛ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma suɔ nɛ ma tsɔ mo a ngɔ.” Yosef he nɔ ke, “Ma ya.” E tsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya slaa o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o hyɛ kaa to ɔmɛ hu nɔ́ ko be a he lo, nɛ o ba de mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ ɔ wo lɛ blɔ kɛ je Hebron kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Benɛ e ba su Shekem ɔ, nyumu ko na lɛ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae?” E he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ hlae.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o tsɔɔ mi he nɛ a ngɛ a to ɔmɛ hyɛe ngɛ ɔ.” Nyumu ɔ de lɛ ke, “A je hiɛ ɔ; i nu nɛ a ngɛ dee ke a yaa Dotan.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef fie e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a se, nɛ e ya na mɛ ngɛ Dotan.
A na lɛ nɛ e ma jee; nɛ benɛ e na we nɛ e su a ngɔ lolo ɔ, a so e yi nɔ kaa a maa gbe lɛ.
A de a sibi ke, “Nlalɔ ɔ lɛ ma a nɛ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa gbe lɛ, nɛ wa sake lɛ kɛ wo muɔ nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi.
Wa ma ya de ke lohwe awi yelɔ ko ye lɛ.
Kɛkɛ wa maa hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa je e nlami ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba.” Benɛ Ruben nu he ɔ, e hla kaa e ma kpɔ Yosef ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ.
E de e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Wa ko gbe lɛ.
Nyɛ sake lɛ kɛ wo muɔ nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ kɛkɛ; se nyɛ ko gbe lɛ.” Ruben de ja, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e kpɔ Yosef ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya ha e tsɛ.
Benɛ Yosef ba su e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, a je tade klɔii saminyayoo ɔ ngɛ e he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a nu lɛ nɛ a sake lɛ kɛ wo muɔ ɔ mi.
Se nyu be muɔ ɔ mi; e mi gbli.
Benɛ a hii si nɛ a ngɛ ní yee ɔ, a na Ishmael bi blɔ hiali komɛ ngɛ afukpɔngɔhi a nɔ nɛ a ma.
A je Gilead, nɛ a hɛɛ tsopahi kɛ a he via kɛ yaa Egipt.
Yuda de e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Ke wa gbe wa nyɛmi nɛ ɔ nɛ wa laa nɔ ɔ, mɛni se wa ma na?
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa jua lɛ ha Ishmael bi ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ ko ha wa nine nɛ kpa ngɛ e nɔ; ejakaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nyɛmi tutuutu ji lɛ.” E nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ, nɛ benɛ Midian jua yeli komɛ ba su a ngɔ ɔ, Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ je lɛ kɛ je muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a jua lɛ kɛ ha Ishmael bi ɔmɛ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enyɔ.
Nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho Egipt ya.
Benɛ Ruben kpale e se kɛ ba muɔ ɔ he, nɛ e na kaa Yosef be muɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho hía e he tade ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e hao lɛ.
E kpale kɛ ho e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya de mɛ ke, “Jokuɛ niheyo ɔ be lejɛ ɔ. Bubuubui!
Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a gbe apletsi ko, nɛ a ngɔ Yosef tade klɔii saminyayoo ɔ kɛ tsɔ muɔ ɔ mi.
A kɛ tade ɔ ya ha a tsɛ ɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Wa na tade nɛ ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ; hyɛ kaa o bi Yosef tade ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo.” Yakob le tade ɔ mi tso, nɛ e de ke, “Ye bi ɔ tade ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lohwe awi yelɔ ko ye lɛ; lohwe ko tsɔtslɔɔ ye bi Yosef mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob kɛ aywilɛho hía e he tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e bu kpekpe ya bo; nɛ e nyɛ ya ha e bi ɔ ligbi babauu.
Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e biyi ɔmɛ tsuo ba ba wo lɛ bua, se e kplɛɛ we.
E de ke, “Ma ye kɔmɔ hluu kɛ yaa si gbeje.” Nɛ e tsa nɔ nɛ e ye kɔmɔ ha e bi Yosef ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, jua yeli ɔmɛ ya jua Yosef ngɛ Egipt ngɔ ha Egipt matsɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Potifar.
Potifar ji matsɛ we buli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Yuda kɛ Tamar Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yuda je e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e ya hi nyumu ko nɛ je Adulam, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hira ngɔ.
Yuda ya na Kanaan yiheyo ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ e tsɛ biɛ ke Shua.
E ngɔ lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu, nɛ Yuda wo lɛ biɛ ke Er.
Yo ɔ na mi ekohu, nɛ e fɔ binyumu ekohu, nɛ e wo lɛ ke Onan.
E kpale fɔ binyumu ekohu, nɛ e wo lɛ Shela.
Benɛ a fɔ binyumuyo nɛ ɔ, Yuda ngɛ Akzib.
Yuda ya ngɔ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tamar ba ha Er, e bitɛte ɔ. Yuda bitɛte Er pee e he nɔmlɔ yayami.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ Yawɛ nya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ gbe lɛ.
Pee se ɔ, Yuda de Onan ke, “Yaa nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmi ɔ yalɔyo ɔ nɛ ya hwɔ.
E ji o blɔ nya ní tsumi kaa o ngɔ o nyɛmi ɔ yalɔyo ɔ, konɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ fɔ bimɛ ha o nyɛmi ɔ.” Se Onan le kaa bimɛ ɔmɛ ba be e nɔ pee.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmi ɔ yo ɔ ma na bɔmi ɔ, e haa nɛ nyu nɛ jeɔ e he ɔ pueɔ zugba, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ko fɔ bimɛ ha e nyɛmi ɔ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ e pee nɛ ɔ sɛ́ Yawɛ hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ gbe lɛ hulɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda de e nganyɛ Tamar ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya hi si ngɛ o tsɛ we ɔ mi kaa yalɔyo kɛ yaa si ye bi Shela maa wa.” E de enɛ ɔ, ejakaa e ye gbeye kaa lɛ hu e ma ba gbo kaa bɔ nɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ gbo ɔ. Lɔ he ɔ, Tamar je kɛ ho e tsɛ we mi ya.
Pee se ɔ, Yuda yo ɔ nɛ ji Shua biyo ɔ ba gbo.
Benɛ Yuda nyɛ ya ha lɛ ta a, e kɛ e huɛ Hira nɛ je Adulam ɔ ho Timna ya, ngɛ he nɛ e to ɔmɛ a he bwɔmi sali ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nɔ ko ya naa Tamar nane nɔ kaa e ngatsɛ ɔ yaa Timna nɛ e ya sã e to ɔmɛ a he bwɔmi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e je yalɔyo bo ɔ nɛ e bu ɔ ngɔ fɔ si.
E tsake e he; e kɛ hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ e ho ya hi si ngɛ Enaim ma a nya, ngɛ Timna blɔ ɔ nɔ.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e na kaa Shela wa, se a kɛ lɛ Tamar a ha we lɛ.
Benɛ Yuda na lɛ ɔ, e bu lɛ kaa yo yaholɔ ko; ejakaa e kɛ nɔ́ ha e hɛ mi.
Yuda ho ya na lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ tue, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kɛ mo maa hwɔ si.” Mamoo Yuda li tete kaa e nganyɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.
Tamar bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ma ha mi loko o kɛ mi maa hwɔ si ɔ?” Yuda he nɔ ke, “Ma ha nɛ a nu apletsi wayoo ko ngɛ ye to ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ba ha mo.” Tamar de lɛ ke, “Saminya!
Si nɔ́ ko ha mi nɛ o kɛ to mi awaba kɛ yaa si be nɛ o kɛ apletsi ɔ maa mane mi.” Yuda bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni ma si ha mo kɛ to mo awaba a?” Tamar he nɔ ke, “O womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ kɛ e he kpa, kɛ o dɛma tso ɔ.” Yuda ngɔ ní ɔmɛ ngɔ ha lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi, nɛ Tamar ngɔ hɔ.
Tamar je kɛ ho we mi ya, nɛ e ya je e hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ e bu e yalɔyo bo ɔ. Yuda tsɔ e huɛ Hira ke e ngɔ apletsi ɔ ya ha yo ɔ, konɛ e he ní ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ to lɛ awaba a ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ba.
Se Hira nɛ yo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E bi nyumu komɛ ngɛ Enaim ma a mi ke, “Yo yaholɔ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ?” Se a he nɔ ke, “Yo yaholɔ ko kaa ja be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.” Hira kpale e se kɛ ba Yuda ngɔ ekohu, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “I nɛ yo ɔ. Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu ke yo yaholɔ ko kaa ja be lejɛ ɔ.” Yuda de ke, “Ha ní ɔmɛ nɛ a hi e dɛ.
Wa be suɔe nɛ nihi nɛ a ba muɔ wɔ; i bɔ mɔde kaa ma wo lɛ hiɔ, se mo nɛ o nɛ lɛ.” Maa pee hlami etɛ se ɔ, nɔ ko ba de Yuda ke, “O nganyɛ Tamar ya nyɛɛ basabasa, nɛ hɔ ba e he nɛ a li hɔtsɛ.” Yuda fa ke, “A je lɛ kpo, nɛ a ya sã lɛ.” Benɛ a kɛ lɛ je kpo kɛ ba a, e tsɔ nɛ a ya de e ngatsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ níhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ wo mi hɔ ɔ nɛ.
Hyɛ kaa o maa le ní nɛ ɔmɛ a tsɛ lo; womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ kɛ e he kpa nɛ ɔ, kɛ tso nɛ ɔ.” Yuda le ní ɔmɛ a mi tso, nɛ e de ke, “E nɔ́ da; ye nɔ́ be mi.
Jinɛ e sa kaa i ko ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ye bi Shela nɛ e gba lɛ.” Nɛ́ pee ja a, Yuda kɛ Tamar na we bɔmi hu.
Benɛ Tamar fɔmi be su ɔ, a na kaa hawi lɛ ngɛ e muklii mi ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, benɛ e nu kɔɔmi ɔ, hayo ɔ kake je e nine kpo.
Fɔlɔyo ɔ nu e nine ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kpa tsu fi nine ɔ he, nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ba kekle.” Se hayo ɔ gbla e nine ɔ se, nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ kple kɛ sɛ e hlami.
Kɛkɛ nɛ fɔlɔyo ɔ de ke, “Bɔ nɛ o gba o blɔ kɛ ba ha ji nɛ ɔ!” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lɛ biɛ ke Perez.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ hu kple kɛ e nine kpa tsu ɔ, nɛ a wo lɛ Zera.
Yosef kɛ Potifar yo ɔ Ishmael bi ɔmɛ kɛ Yosef ba Egipt nɛ a ba jua lɛ ngɔ ha Egipt matsɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Potifar; lɛ ji matsɛ we buli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Yawɛ gbaa Yosef nɛ e ya nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi; nɛ e sɔmɔ ngɛ e we Egipt nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi.
Benɛ Yosef nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na kaa Yawɛ gbaa Yosef, nɛ e haa e yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, e na e he bua jɔmi.
Potifar wo lɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e we ɔ mi, nɛ e to e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɔ wo e dɛ.
Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, Yawɛ gbaa Potifar ngɛ Yosef he.
E gbaa e weto ní tsuo: e we mi níhi, kɛ e ngmɔ mi níhi tsuo.
Potifar to e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ wo Yosef dɛ, nɛ e gba we e he nya ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he kaa ja nɔ́ nɛ e maa ye kɛkɛ.
Yosef ɔ, nyumu nɛ he ngɛ fɛu saminya ji lɛ.
Saii mi ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yo ɔ bɔni e se nyɛɛmi nɛ e kɛ lɛ nɛ na bɔmi.
Yosef kplɛɛ we; nɛ e de e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yo ɔ ke, “Hyɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ gba we e he nya ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he ngɛ we nɛ ɔ mi, ejakaa i ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. E to e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɔ wo ye dɛ.
I ngɛ he wami ngɛ we nɛ ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ hu e ngɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je we he gbi ha mi, kaa ja mo pɛ; ejakaa moo lɛɛ e yo ji mo.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ ma tsu yi wu tso ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ ma pee yayami kɛ si Mawu?” Yo nɛ ɔ hao Yosef daa ligbi kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ; se Yosef kplɛɛ we kaa e kɛ lɛ ma na bɔmi, loo e maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su e he po.
Se ligbi ko benɛ Yosef ba we ɔ mi nɛ e ba tsu ní ɔ, tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko be we ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ nu Yosef tade ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ba nɛ o kɛ mi ba hwɔ si.” Se Yosef tu fo kɛ je kpo, nɛ e je e tade ɔ he ngɛ yo ɔ dɛ mi.
Benɛ yo ɔ na kaa Yosef tu fo kɛ je e tade ɔ he ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ, e tsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ!
Ye huno ya ngɔ kikɛmɛ a Hebri no nɛ ɔ kɛ ba futu wɔ, konɛ e ba ye wa he fɛu.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ ba ye ngɔ konɛ e ba tua mi, se i kpa bubuubui.
Benɛ e nu nɛ i ngɛ bubuubui ɔ kpae ɔ, e tu fo kɛ je kpo, nɛ e je e tade ɔ he.” Yo ɔ ngɔ Yosef tade ɔ ngɔ to kɛ ya si Yosef nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba we ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ bɔ lɛ kikɛmɛ a amaniɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu ke, “Hebri no tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ o ngɔ ba futu wɔ ɔ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ e hla kaa e ma tua mi.
Se benɛ i kpa bubuubui ɔ, e tu fo kɛ je kpo, nɛ e je e tade ɔ he.” Benɛ Yosef nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nu ní ɔmɛ nɛ e yo ɔ de ke Yosef pee lɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e ha a nu Yosef kɛ wo tsu ngɛ he nɛ a woɔ matsɛ pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsu ngɛ ɔ; nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ.
Se Yawɛ kɛ Yosef ngɛ; nɛ e na lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ na e he bua jɔmi.
Pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ to pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wo Yosef dɛ mi.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ a nɔ kɛ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ pa gba we e he nya hu kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ e to kɛ wo Yosef dɛ mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ma pa hyɛ nɔ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ kɛ Yosef ngɛ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e peeɔ ɔ, e yeɔ manye.
Yosef tsɔɔ pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nlamihi a sisi Saii mi ɔ, Egipt matsɛ ɔ dã nɔ hyɛlɔ, kɛ abolo salɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ya tɔ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɛ ji Egipt matsɛ ɔ nɔ.
Farao ɔ mi mi fu e tsɔli enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e wo mɛ tsu ngɛ matsɛ we buli a nyatsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ a wo Yosef hu tsu ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
A se kɛ saminya ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ matsɛ we buli a nyatsɛ ɔ tu mɛ ngɔ wo Yosef dɛ mi nɛ e sɔmɔ mɛ.
Nyɔ kake mi ɔ, Egipt matsɛ ɔ dã nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ kɛ abolo salɔ ɔ tsuo nla ngɛ he nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ngɛ ɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nlami, nɛ nlami tsuaa nlami kɛ e sisi.
Mɔtu, benɛ Yosef ba a ngɔ ɔ, e na kaa a hɛ mi pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
E bi mɛ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ lɛɛ mɛni he je nyɛ hɛ mi pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nla nlami ko, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa tsɔɔ wɔ sisi.” Yosef de mɛ ke, “Mawu lɛ tsɔɔ nlamihi a sisi; i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ sɛɛ nlami ɔmɛ ha mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ dã nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a de Yosef e nlami ɔ ke, “I nla nɛ wai tso ko maa si ngɛ ye hɛ mi, nɛ tso ɔ gba kɔni etɛ.
Benɛ ba amɛ je kpo pɛ nɛ mɔmɔ ɔmɛ gba, nɛ wai yiblii nɛ tsu je kpo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i hɛɛ Farao ɔ kplu ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i tsɔ wai yiblii ɔ, nɛ i nga kɛ wo mi, nɛ i kɛ kplu ɔ wo Farao ɔ dɛ mi.” Yosef de lɛ ke, “Nlami ɔ sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: tso kɔni etɛ ɔmɛ daa si ha ligbi etɛ.
Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, Farao ɔ ma je mo kɛ je tsu mi; e kɛ o he maa ke mo, nɛ e maa ngɔ mo ngɔ to o blɔ he ɔ ekohu.
O kɛ Farao ɔ kplu ɔ maa wo e dɛ mi ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ o peeɔ sa, benɛ o ji e dã nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a.
Se, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ke níhi a mi ya hi ha mo ɔ, mo kai mi nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ; moo tu ye he munyu kpakpa ha Farao ɔ, nɛ e ba je mi kɛ je tsu nɛ ɔ mi.
Pani nya nɛ a nu mi kɛ je Hebri bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ; nɛ Egipt hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hu i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa kaa a wo mi tsu.” Benɛ abolo salɔ nɔkɔtɔma a na kaa Yosef tsɔɔ nlami ɔ sisi saminya a, e de lɛ ke, “Imi hu i nla nɛ i tloo abolo kusii etɛ.
Niye ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a sã ha Farao ɔ ngɛ kusii nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe pe kulaa a mi; nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba ngɛ yee.” Yosef de lɛ ke, “Nlami ɔ sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: kusii etɛ ɔmɛ daa si ha ligbi etɛ.
Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, Farao ɔ ma je mo kɛ je tsu mi, nɛ e ma ha a sɛu mo ngɛ tso nɔ, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ma ba ye o he lo ɔ.” Ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Farao ɔ ye e fɔmi ligbi.
E tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo ní yemi, nɛ e ha a ya je e dã nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a, kɛ abolo salɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ngɛ tsu ɔ mi kɛ ba.
E kɛ e dã nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a blɔ he ɔ ha lɛ ekohu kaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ Farao ɔ kplu ɔ kɛ wo e dɛ mi.
Se abolo salɔ nɔkɔtɔma a lɛɛ Farao ɔ ha a sɛu lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yosef tsɔɔ a nlami ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se dã nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a kai we Yosef hu; e hɛ je e nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Yosef tsɔɔ matsɛ ɔ nlamihi a sisi Jeha enyɔ se ɔ, Farao ɔ nla nlami ko.
E nla nɛ e daa si ngɛ Nilo pa a nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ na yo kpaago nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ a plɔke, hia kpo kɛ je pa a mi, nɛ a ba bɔni ní yemi ngɛ nga a mi.
Na yo kpaago kpa hu hia kpo kɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ba; mɛɛ lɛɛ a flãã nɛ a ngɛ kanyakanya.
A ba da kekleekle na amɛ a kasa nya ngɛ pa a nya.
Nahi nɛ flãã, nɛ a ngɛ kanyakanya ye na amɛ nɛ a plɔke nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ hɛ tsɛ.
E sɛ mahe mi ekohu, nɛ e kpale nla nlami kpa ko.
E nla nɛ blɛfo kpaago, nɛ a wo ní saminya gbɔ ngɛ tso kake nɔ.
Blɛfo kpaago kpa hu ba tso ɔ nɔ; mɛɛ a wui ní, nɛ jehanɛ se hu, ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ ngla mɛ.
Blɛfo kpaago nɛ wui ní ɔ, mii blɛfo kpaago kpa amɛ nɛ wo ní ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ hɛ tsɛ, nɛ e na kaa e ngɛ nlae.
Benɛ je na a, e hao; nɛ e tsɔ ya tsɛ Egipt kunya yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ní leli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba.
E de mɛ e nlami ɔmɛ, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e tsɔɔ sisi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ dã nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a de lɛ ke, “I ngɛ jajee mwɔnɛ ɔ kaa i tɔ̃.
O mi mi fu imi, kɛ abolo salɔ nɔkɔtɔma a, nɛ o wo wɔ tsu ngɛ matsɛ we buli a nyatsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi.
Nyɔ kake mi ɔ, i kɛ abolo salɔ nɔkɔtɔma a tsuo wa nla nlami komɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nlami; nɛ nlami tsuaa nlami kɛ e sisi.
Hebri niheyo ko, nɛ ji matsɛ we buli a nyatsɛ ɔ nyɔguɛ ko hu ngɛ tsu ɔ mi kɛ wɔ.
Wa sɛɛ wa nlami ɔmɛ ha lɛ, nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ a sisi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Bɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ nlami ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ a ba mi; o ngɔ mi ngɔ to ye blɔ he ɔ ekohu, se abolo salɔ ɔ lɛɛ o sɛu lɛ.” Farao ɔ tsɔ nɛ a ya je Yosef kɛ je tsu ɔ mi amlɔ nɔuu.
E sɛ e kpɛni, nɛ e tsake e tade, nɛ e ba Farao ɔ ngɔ.
Farao ɔ de Yosef ke, “I nla nlami ko, se nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e tsɔɔ mi sisi.
I nu kaa a ke moo lɛɛ o nyɛɔ tsɔɔ nlamihi a sisi.” Yosef he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, pi imi.
Mawu ji nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ mo nlami ɔ sisi bɔ nɛ maa sa o hɛ mi.” Farao ɔ de Yosef ke, “I nla nɛ i daa si ngɛ Nilo pa a nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ na yo kpaago nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ a plɔke, hia kpo kɛ je pa a mi, nɛ a ba bɔni nga kpemi.
Na yo kpaago kpa hu hia kpo kɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ba; mɛɛ lɛɛ a flãã nɛ a ngɛ kanyakanya.
I nɛ nahi kɛ a he tai nɛ ɔmɛ a henɔ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nahi nɛ flãã nɛ a ngɛ kanyakanya a ye nahi nɛ plɔke nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu ɔ.
Se benɛ a mii mɛ ta a, nɔ ko nɛ kulaa kaa a ye nɔ́ ko; ejakaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ kanyakanya sa a, ja ko nɛ a ngɛ.
Jehanɛ, i nla ekohu nɛ blɛfo tso kpaago, nɛ a wo ní saminya gbɔ ngɛ tso kake nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ blɛfo tso kpaago kpa hu ba tso ɔ nɔ; mɛɛ a wui ní, nɛ jehanɛ se hu, ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ ngla mɛ.
Blɛfo tso kpaago nɛ wui ní ɔ mii blɛfo tso kpaago kpa amɛ nɛ wo ní ɔ. I de kunya yeli ɔmɛ nlami nɛ ɔmɛ, se a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e tsɔɔ mi sisi.” Yosef de matsɛ ɔ ke, “O nlami ɔmɛ tsuo, nlami kake; Mawu je nɔ́ ko nɛ e yaa pee ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo.
Na kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ plɔke ɔ, daa si ha jeha kpaago.
Blɛfo tso kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ wo ní ɔ, hu daa si ha jeha kpaago; a ngɛ sisi tsɔɔmi kake too.
Na kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ flãã, nɛ a pee kanyakanya, nɛ nyɛɛ se kɛ ba a, daa si ha hwɔ be jeha kpaago.
Jã kɛ̃ ji blɛfo tso kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ wui ní, nɛ ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ ngla mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ i de mo ɔ, Mawu je nɔ́ ko nɛ e yaa pee ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo.
Niye ní babauu maa ba Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ jeha kpaago.
Jeha kpaago nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ, hwɔ nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ maa ba.
Nihi a hɛ maa je kplɔkɔtɔ be ɔ nɔ, ejakaa hwɔ ɔ ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi.
Hwɔ ɔ nya maa wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ bɔ nɛ nihi a hɛ maa je kplɔkɔtɔ be ɔ nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a tĩ o nlami ɔ mi si enyɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu to e yi mi kaa e maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ niinɛ; nɛ e be kɛe kulaa.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo hla nɔ ko nɛ le ní, nɛ e hɛ mi ka si nɛ o ngɔ to Egipt ma a nya.
Jehanɛ, moo to nɔ hyɛli kpahi ngɛ ma a nya, nɛ o ngɔ niye ní nɛ maa ba kplɔkɔtɔ be jeha kpaago ɔ mi dlami enuɔ mi kake ngɔ to.
Niye ní tsuo nɛ maa ba ngɛ jeha kpakpa amɛ a mi ɔ, ha nɛ a bua nya.
Moo wo mlaa nɛ a to blɛfo ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi, nɛ a bu he.
A kɛ niye ní nɛ ɔ maa to kɛ yaa si hwɔ maa ba Egipt zugba a nɔ jeha kpaago nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ. Bɔ nɛ o maa pee nɛ hwɔ be zugba a hɛ mi kpatae ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” A wo Yosef ganɔ ngɛ Egipt Ga nɛ Yosef wo nɛ ɔ sa Farao ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
E bi e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ wa maa na nɔ kpa ko kaa Yosef, nɛ Mawu mumi ngɛ e mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ lo?” Farao ɔ de Yosef ke, “Akɛnɛ Mawu lɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa nɔ kpa ko be nɛ le ní, nɛ e hɛ mi ka si kaa ja mo pɛ.
Ma ngɔ mo ngɔ to ye ma a nya, nɛ ma a tsuo maa bu mo tue; ye se ɔ, lɛɛ mo.” Jehanɛ, Farao ɔ ngɔ Yosef blɔ he ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I ngɛ mo ganɔ woe ngɛ Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ.” Farao ɔ je e nguɛ ga kɛ e nɔ womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ wo Yosef nguɛ.
E wo lɛ kploba tade klɔii saminyayoo ko, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu kɔsɔkɔsɔ wo e kuɛ.
E kɛ lɛ wo matsɛ ta zugba lɛ enyɔne ɔ mi, nɛ matsɛ tsɔli nyɛɛ e hɛ mi kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nyɛ kpla si oo!
E ma oo!” Bɔ nɛ a pee kɛ wo Yosef ganɔ ngɛ Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Farao ɔ de Yosef ke, “Imi ji matsɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ mo dee ke nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee nɔ́ ko ngɛ Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ nɛ o li he nɔ́ ko.” -Farao ɔ wo Yosef Egipt biɛ ke Zafenat Panea, nɛ e ha lɛ yo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Asenat.
Osɔfo Potifera nɛ je Heliopolis ma a mi ɔ biyo ji Yosef yo ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ Yosef bɔni Egipt matsɛ ɔ sɔmɔmi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e ye jeha nyingmi etɛ.
E je matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ e ya kpa Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Kplɔkɔtɔ jeha kpaago ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, zugba a ba ní babauu nitsɛ, nɛ Yosef bua ní ɔ tsuo nya nɛ e to ngɛ ma amɛ a mi.
Blɛfo nɛ Yosef bua nya a hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia.
E kane blɛfo kɛ kotoku hluu kɛ ya si e kpa kanemi; ejakaa blɛfo ɔ hiɛ tsɔ.
Loko hwɔ ba jeha kpaago ɔ, Yosef kɛ osɔfo Potifera nɛ je Heliopolis ɔ biyo ɔ fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ.
E wo e bitɛte ɔ Manase, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu ha nɛ ye hɛ je ye haomi ɔ tsuo, kɛ ye weku li tsuo a nɔ.” E wo enyɔne ɔ Efraim, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu ha nɛ i wo ngmɛdu ngɛ zugba nɛ i na amanehlu ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.” Jeha kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ niye ní ba babauu ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ se ba po, nɛ jeha kpaago kɛ e mi hwɔ nɛ nya wa hu je sisi kaa bɔ nɛ Yosef de ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Hwɔ nɛ nya wa ye ngɛ zugba amɛ tsuo a nɔ; se Egipt zugba a nɔ tsuo lɛɛ niye ní ngɛ.
Benɛ hwɔ bɔni Egipt bi ɔmɛ yemi ɔ, ma a wo ya ngɔ pue Farao ɔ nɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke e ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye.
Farao ɔ de Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ ya Yosef ngɔ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ pee.” Benɛ hwɔ ɔ nya ba wa ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ, Yosef bli nito he ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ e jua blɛfo ha Egipt bi ɔmɛ.
Nihi je je ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ba Egipt nɛ a ba he blɛfo ngɛ Yosef dɛ; ejakaa hwɔ ɔ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba Egipt ba he blɛfo Benɛ Yakob nu kaa blɛfo ngɛ Egipt ɔ, e bi e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi hyɛe ngɛ pee?
I nu kaa blɛfo ngɛ Egipt.
Nyɛɛ ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ya he eko kɛ ba nɛ waa ye, nɛ hwɔ ko ba gbe wɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef tsɛbimɛ nyɔngma amɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya, konɛ a ya he blɛfo.
Se Yosef nyɛbi Benyamin lɛɛ Yakob ha we nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya; ejakaa Yakob ye gbeye kaa, alini, nɔ́ ko ma ya pee lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ piɛ nihi nɛ ba blɛfo hemi ɔ a he; ejakaa hwɔ ba Kanaan zugba a hu nɔ.
Yosef, ganɔ nɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ blɛfo ɔ juae ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba blɛfo hemi ɔ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si.
Benɛ Yosef na e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e le a mi tso, se e pee e he kaa e li mɛ.
E tu e hɛ mi ngɔ wo mɛ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Jije nyɛ je?” A he nɔ ke, “Wa je Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ wa ma niye ní hemi.” Yosef le e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a mi tso, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a yo we lɛ.
E kai nlami ɔmɛ nɛ e nla ngɛ a he ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Slaali ji nyɛ!
Nyɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba slaa wa zugba a, konɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ he nɛ wa huza amɛ a he wɛ ngɛ.” A he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
Wa nyɔmtsɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, niye ní wa ma hemi.
Nyumu kake bimɛ ji wɔ tsuo.
Anɔkualetsɛmɛ ji wɔ; pi slaali ji wɔ.” Yosef de mɛ ke, “Dɛbi!
Nyɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ he nɛ wa huza amɛ a he wɛ ngɛ.” A de Yosef ke, “Nyumu kake bimɛ ji wɔ; wa tsɛ je Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
Jinɛ nyɛmimɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ji wɔ; se wa ti nɔ kake be je mi, nɛ jokuɛyo ɔ hu ngɛ wa tsɛ ngɔ.” Yosef he nɔ ke, “Tse i de!
Nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; slaali ji nyɛ!
Nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ma kpa nyɛ si ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I na Farao ɔ kaa nyɛ be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jee; ja nyɛ nyɛmi jokuɛyo ɔ ba hiɛ ɔ loko nyɛ maa ho.
Nyɛ ti nɔ kake nɛ ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba.
Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ a maa wo nyɛ tsu kɛ yaa si nyɛ nyɛmi ɔ maa ba.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ wa maa gu kɛ hyɛ kaa anɔkuale munyu nɛ nyɛ tu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se ke e ba mi kaa lakpa munyu nyɛ ba tu mi ɔ, lɛɛ i na Farao ɔ kaa slaali ji nyɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo mɛ tsu ligbi etɛ.
Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, Yosef de mɛ ke, “Imi lɛɛ i yeɔ Mawu gbeye; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ he nyɛ yi wami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke anɔkualetsɛmɛ ji nyɛ niinɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha a wo nyɛ ti nɔ kake tsu ngɛ he nɛ a je nyɛ kɛ je ɔ. Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ piɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ blɛfo nɛ nyɛ he ɔ kɛ ya we ya ha nyɛ weku li nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nyɛmi jokuɛyo ɔ kɛ ba.
Enɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ kaa sane ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba gba mi ɔ, anɔkuale, nɛ i be nyɛ gbee.” A kplɛɛ, nɛ a de a sibi ke, “Niinɛ, nɔ́ nɛ wa pee wa nyɛmi ɔ be ko nɛ be ɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɔ́ wa ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wa na bɔ nɛ e hao, nɛ e kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke waa na lɛ mɔbɔ; se wa pui mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔ ba wa nɔ ɔ nɛ.” Ruben de mɛ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ko pee jokuɛ ɔ yayami ko nɛ nyɛ bui mi tue; e gbenɔ ɔ he tue gblami nɛ wa ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ nɛ.” A li tete kaa Yosef nu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ sisi; ejakaa benɛ a kɛ lɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, nɔ ko je gbi nya ha mɛ.
Yosef je a he, nɛ e ya fo ya.
Benɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba tu munyu ekohu ɔ, e je Simeon ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e ha a fi lɛ ngɛ a hɛ mi.
Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ho Kanaan ya Yosef fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke a wo e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a blɛfo kotoku ɔmɛ a mi blɛfo nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Jehanɛ se hu, e fa ke a kpale nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ba a kɛ wo e kotoku ɔ mi, nɛ a ha mɛ niye ní nɛ a ya ye ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Tsɔli ɔmɛ pee ja.
Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ fi blɛfo ɔ nɛ a he ɔ ngɔ fɔ a teji ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a pue blɔ.
Benɛ a ya su nibwɔhi a to he ɔ, nɛ a ti nɔ kake pɛne e kotoku ɔ nya konɛ e ha e teji ɔ ní ɔ, e na e sika a ngɛ kotoku ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “A kpale ye sika a kɛ wo ye kotoku ɔ mi!” A tsui po, nɛ a kɛ he domi bi a sibi ke, “Mɛni po Mawu pee wɔ nɛ ɔ?” Benɛ a ba su a tsɛ Yakob ngɔ ngɛ Kanaan ɔ, a bɔ lɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a pee mɛ ɔ.
A de lɛ ke, “Ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ tu e hɛ mi ngɔ wo wɔ.
E kɛ wɔ tu munyu basabasa, nɛ e po wa nya ke wa ba e zugba a slaami.
Wa de lɛ ke, ‘Tsa pi slaali ji wɔ; anɔkualetsɛmɛ ji wɔ.
Nyumu kake bimɛ ji wɔ.
Jinɛ nyɛmimɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ji wɔ; se wa ti nɔ kake be je mi, nɛ jokuɛyo ɔ hu ngɛ wa tsɛ ngɔ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.’ Nyumu ɔ nɛ ji ganɔ ɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ de wɔ ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ ma pee kɛ le kaa anɔkualetsɛmɛ ji nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛ si nyɛ ti nɔ kake ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ piɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ blɛfo nɛ nyɛ he ɔ kɛ ya we ya ha nyɛ weku li nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nyɛmi jokuɛyo ɔ kɛ ba.
Enɛ ɔ ma kɛ le kaa anɔkualetsɛmɛ ji nyɛ, se pi slaali ji nyɛ.
Ma kpale nyɛ nyɛmi ɔ kɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ hi hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ye jua faa.’ ” Benɛ a ngɛ kotoku ɔmɛ a nya pɛnee ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ na e sika kɛ kpɛɛ ɔ ngɛ e kotoku ɔ mi; benɛ a na sika a, a kɛ a tsɛ Yakob ɔ tsuo a tsui po.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɛ Yakob de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ma ha ye bimɛ ɔmɛ ma gbo ta ye he lo?
Yosef be; Simeon be; nɛ jehanɛ, nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Benyamin hu kɛ ho.
Nɔ yeyee maa hi mi pee kikɛ nɛ ɔ!” Ruben de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Ke i kpale we Benyamin ba ha we mo ɔ, lɛɛ gbee ye binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Moo to Benyamin ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi, nɛ ma kpale lɛ kɛ ba ha mo.” Se Yakob de ke, “Ye bi ɔ kɛ nyɛ be yae; e nyɛmi ɔ gbo, nɛ lɛ nɔ kake too e piɛ.
Ke i kɛ lɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko ma ya pee lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
I bwɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma ha nɛ i kɛ aywilɛho maa ya gbeje.”
Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ Benyamin ba Egipt Hwɔ ɔ nya ba wa ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ Yakob kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ ye blɛfo ɔ nɛ a kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba a tsuo ta a, Yakob de e bimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ya, nɛ nyɛ ya he niye ní bɔɔ kɛ ba.” Yuda de lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ je blɔ wo si kaa ke waa kɛ wa nyɛmi ɔ bɛ ɔ, wa be e hɛngmɛ mi nae.
Ke o ma ha nɛ wa nyɛmi ɔ maa piɛ wa he kɛ ya a, wa maa ya nɛ wa ya he niye ní ba ha mo.
Se ke o kplɛɛ we nɛ e kɛ wɔ nɛ ya a, wɔ hu wa be yae; ejakaa nyumu ɔ de wɔ ke ke waa kɛ wa nyɛmi ɔ bɛ ɔ, wa be e hɛngmɛ mi nae.” Yakob bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ haomi nɛ ɔ ba ye nɔ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ de nyumu ɔ ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɛmi kpa ko hulɔ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ ta wa nya mi saminya kɛ bi wɔ níhi nɛ kɔɔ wɔ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ wa weku li a he.
E bi wɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ tsɛ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ lo?
Nyɛ ngɛ nyɛmi kpa ko hu lo?’ Wɔɔ lɛɛ e munyu ɔmɛ a heto kɛkɛ wa ha lɛ.
Kɛ wa maa pee kɛ le kaa e ma de wɔ ke waa ngɔ wa nyɛmi ɔ kɛ ba kɛɛ?” Yuda de e tsɛ Yakob ke, “Ngɔɔ jokuɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi, nɛ́ wa pue blɔ nɔuu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ hwɔ ko ba gbe wɔ, kɛ mo, kɛ wa bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ.
Ma ngɔ ye wami kɛ da si ha lɛ; bi e si ngɛ ye dɛ.
Ke i kpale we lɛ ba ha we mo fiafiaafia a, lɛɛ i yeɔ fɔ ye wami be ɔ tsuo.
Kaa tsa pi tsle nɛ wa to ɔ, jinɛ be nɛ ɔ mi wa ya ba si enyɔ momo.” A tsɛ Yakob de mɛ ke, “Ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ní kpakpa amɛ ekomɛ kɛ wo nyɛ kotoku ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛ kɛ ya ke ganɔ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ tsopa nu bɔɔ, bila, hwo bɔɔ, kɛ tsopahi kɛ a he via bɔɔ, gigɛ bɔɔ, kɛ ngmɛ́ bɔɔ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ sika nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma he ní ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ a kpale ngɔ wo kotoku ɔmɛ a mi ha nyɛ ɔ kɛ ho; eko piɔ, e be a hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nyɛmi ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ho esɔesɔ.
Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ ha nɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ na nyɛ mɔbɔ, konɛ e ngmɛɛ Benyamin, kɛ nyɛ nyɛmi kaketsɛ ɔ he ha nyɛ.
Imi lɛɛ ke ji ye bimɛ ma gbo kɛ wo mi aywilɛho po, e ba mi ja.” Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ nike ní ɔmɛ, kɛ sika nɛ a kɛ yaa he ní ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kpale kɛ yaa a, nɛ a kɛ Benyamin tsuo pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya.
Benɛ a ya su ɔ, a kɛ a he ya tsɔɔ Yosef.
Benɛ Yosef na Benyamin ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, e de nyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ e we ɔ nɔ ɔ ke, “O kɛ nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ya ye we ɔ mi.
A kɛ mi maa ye ní piani nɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yaa gbe lohwe nɛ o pee niye ní ngɔ to.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yosef fa lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ nyumu ɔmɛ ho Yosef we ɔ mi ya.
Benɛ a kɛ mɛ yaa Yosef we ɔ mi ɔ, a tsui po, nɛ a de a sibi ke, “Sika a nɛ a kpale ngɔ wo wa kotoku ɔmɛ a mi benɛ wa ba hiɛ ɔ kekleekle ɔ, lɔ ɔ he je nɛ a ngɔ wɔ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A ma ba tua wɔ tlukaa; a ma kpɔ wa teji ɔmɛ ngɛ wa dɛ, nɛ a maa pee wɔ nyɔguɛhi.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ya na tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ Yosef we ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, wa nyɔmtsɛ, wa ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ eko momo ba he niye ní.
Benɛ wa kpale wa se kɛ yaa, nɛ wa ya to si ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa pɛne wa kotoku ɔmɛ a nya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ na sika nɛ e kɛ ba he ní ɔ susui ngɛ e kotoku nya.
Wa kpale sika a kɛ ba.
Jehanɛ, wa hɛɛ sika kpa kɛ ba nɛ waa kɛ ma he niye ní.
Wa li nɔ nɛ kpale wa sika a kɛ wo wa kotoku ɔmɛ a mi.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ ko ye kɔmɔ.
Nyɛ tsui nɛ ko po.
Nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ e Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɛ e kɛ sika a wo nyɛ kotoku ɔmɛ a mi ha nyɛ.
Ye nine su nyɛ sika a nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e je Simeon kɛ ba ha mɛ.
Tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba Yosef we ɔ mi.
E ha mɛ nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔ a nanehi a he, nɛ e ha a teji ɔmɛ ní.
A dla nike ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ma ha Yosef ɔ ngɔ to, konɛ ke e ba we ɔ mi piani nɛ a kɛ ha lɛ; ejakaa a nu kaa a maa ye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Yosef ba we ɔ mi ɔ, a ngɔ nike ní ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ ba a ngɔ ha lɛ, nɛ a kpla si nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
E bi mɛ ke a ngɛ saminya lo, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ sɛɛ nyɛ tsɛ nɔmoyo ɔ he ní; kɛ e ngɛ kɛɛ?
Anɛ e ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ lo?
E ngɛ saminya lo?” A he nɔ ke, “Wa tsɛ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ; e ngɛ saminya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpla si, nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si.
Benɛ Yosef na e nyɛmi Benyamin, e nyɛbi ɔ, e de ke, “Nyɛ nyɛmi jokuɛyo ɔ nɛ nyɛ wo e biɛ ta a ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Ye bi, Mawu nɛ gbaa mo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef si mɛ tlukaa, ejakaa benɛ e na e nyɛmi ɔ, e kuɛ si muɔ kpɔ.
E miɔ nɛ e ma fo ya ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e he sɔ kɛ ya sɛ e se tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya fo ya wawɛɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, e fɔ e hɛ mi, nɛ e je kpo kɛ ba.
E bɔ mɔde mia e hɛ mi, nɛ e fa ke a kɛ niye ní ɔ nɛ ba ma si.
A to okplɔɔ munomuno etɛ: Yosef nɔ́ kake, e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ kake, kɛ Egipt bi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a nɔ kake.
A pee ja, ejakaa Egipt bi kɛ Hebri bi ka we nine kɛ yi ní; a hiee Hebri bi ɔmɛ.
A ha Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ sɛ ngɛ a wami nya, kɛ je nɔkɔtɔma a nɔ kɛ ya si jokuɛyo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee Yosef.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee mɛ nyakpɛ nɛ a hyɛ a sibi a hɛ mi kɛ kpe.
A gba ní kɛ je Yosef okplɔɔ ɔ he ya ha e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ Benyamin nɔ́ ɔ hiɛ pe a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ́ si enuɔ.
A kɛ Yosef ye ní, nɛ a nu ní kɛ ya si mɛ tsuo a de dã.
Kplu nɛ laa a Jehanɛ, Yosef fa tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ e we ɔ nɔ ɔ ke, “Wo nyumu ɔmɛ a kotoku ɔmɛ a mi blɛfo nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ, bɔ nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma nyɛ tloo; nɛ o ngɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika kɛ wo e kotoku ɔ mi.
Ngɔɔ ye sika hiɔ kplu ɔ kɛ wo jokuɛyo ɔ kotoku ɔ mi kɛ piɛ sika nɛ e kɛ ba he blɛfo ɔ he.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yosef fa lɛ ɔ. E nɔ jena mɔtu kpla a, a wo nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ho kɛ a teji ɔmɛ.
Benɛ a je ma a mi, nɛ a sui he ko tsitsaa lolo ɔ, Yosef de tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ e we ɔ nɔ ɔ ke, “Tee si esɔ, nɛ o nyɛɛ nyumu ɔmɛ a se.
Ke o ya na mɛ ɔ, bi mɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ yayami to kpakpa nɛ a pee nyɛ ɔ nane mi ɔ?
Mɛni he je nyɛ ju ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sika hiɔ kplu ɔ?
Kplu pɛ nɛ e kɛ nuu nyu ji lɔ ɔ nɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ e kɛ klaa.
Nyɛ pee yayami agbo!’ ” Benɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ya na mɛ ɔ, e bi mɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.
A he nɔ ke, “Wa nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni he je o kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Wa be nyɛe maa pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Sika a nɛ wa ya na ngɛ wa kotoku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ pohu wa kpale kɛ je Kanaan zugba a nɔ tɔɔ kɛ ba ha mo.
Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ mɔ nɛ wa maa ju sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu ngɛ o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi?
Ke a na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ wa ti nɔ ko dɛ mi ɔ, a gbe lɛ, nɛ wɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, wa maa pee o nyɔguɛhi.” E de mɛ ke, “Saminya!
A pee kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ de ɔ.
Se mohu, nɔ nɛ dɛ mi nɛ a maa na kplu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa pee ye nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a he sɔ kɛ je kotoku ɔmɛ ngɛ a teji ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma si, nɛ a pɛne nya.
Yosef tsɔlɔ ɔ hyɛ kotoku ɔmɛ a mi fitsofitso, kɛ je nɔkɔtɔma a nɔ́ ɔ mi kɛ ya gbe nya ngɛ jokuɛyo ɔ nɔ́ ɔ mi.
Nɛ a ya na kplu ɔ ngɛ Benyamin kotoku ɔ mi.
Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ aywilɛho hia a he tade ɔmɛ.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ wo e teji nɔ ní ekohu, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
Benɛ Yuda kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba Yosef we ɔ mi ɔ, Yosef ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpla si, nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Yosef bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ pee nɛ ɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔmlɔ kaa imi ɔ, i klaa lo?” Yuda he nɔ ke, “Wa nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni ngɛ wa nya nɛ wa ma de mo?
Kɛ wa maa pee kɛ je wa nya kɛɛ?
Mawu nitsɛ je wɔ kpo kaa wa tɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, piɔ lɛɛ o nyɔguɛhi ji wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, se pi nɔ nɛ a na kplu ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ kɛkɛ.” Yosef he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
I be ja pee kɔkɔɔkɔ!
Nɔ nɛ a na kplu ɔ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa pee ye nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ho nyɛ tsɛ ngɔ ya fiafiaafia.” Yuda kpa pɛɛ ha Benyamin Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda hɛ lɛ kɛ su Yosef he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ ma kɛ hiami sane kake nɛ ɔ pɛ fɔ o hɛ mi.
O ngɛ kaa Farao ɔ kɛ̃.
O mi mi ko fu mi.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, o bi wɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ tsɛ ngɛ je mi lo?
Nyɛ ngɛ nyɛminyumu kpa ko hu lo?’ Wa de mo ke, ‘Wa tsɛ ngɛ je mi se e bwɔ.
Wa senɔ nɛ ji wa tsɛ nakutsomibi nɛ e fɔ ngɛ e bwɔmi si hu ngɛ.
Lɛ nɔ ɔ e nyɛminyumu ɔ gbo, nɛ lɛ pɛ ji e nyɛbi nɛ piɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɛ suɔ lɛ saminya.’ O fa wɔ ke waa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba nɛ o na lɛ kɛ o hɛngmɛ.
Wa de mo ke niheyo wayo ɔ be nyɛe maa je e tsɛ ɔ he; ke e pee ja a, e tsɛ ɔ ma gbo.
Se o kplɛɛ we.
O de wɔ ke, ‘Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmi wayo ɔ bɛ nɛ ma na lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ be ye hɛ mi nae.’ “Benɛ wa kpale kɛ ho wa tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya a, wa ya bɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ o de wɔ ɔ. Pee se ɔ, e de wɔ ke waa kpale kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ wa ba he niye ní kɛ ba.
Wa de lɛ ke, ‘Ja wa nyɛmi wayo ɔ piɛ wa he loko wa maa ya.
Ke wa nyɛmi wayo ɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ ɔ, a be wɔ blɔ ngmɛe nɛ waa na nyumu ɔ hɛ mi.’ Wa tsɛ de wɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa ye yo Rahel ɔ, binyumuhi enyɔ i kɛ lɛ fɔ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, a ti nɔ kake je kpo, nɛ i nɛ lɛ hu kɛ ba si piɔ; daa nɛ ɔ, i susuɔ kaa pu mi lohwehi nɛ a tsɔtslɔɔ e mi.
Ke nyɛ ngɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ hu kɛ je ye he, nɛ nɔ́ ko ya pee lɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma ha i kɛ aywilɛho maa ya gbeje; i bwɔ.’ ” -Yuda ya nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɔmtsɛ, ke i je niheyo wayo nɛ ɔ he, nɛ i kpale kɛ ho tsaatsɛ ngɔ ya, nɛ tsaatsɛ na kaa i kɛ lɛ bɛ ɔ, e ma gbo.
Tsaatsɛ kɛ jokuɛyo nɛ ɔ a klaa mi kpe wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a suɔ a he saminya.
Tsaatsɛ bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ aywilɛho nɛ waa kɛ maa ba e nɔ ɔ, maa gbe lɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, i ngɔ ye wami kɛ da si ha niheyo wayo ɔ. I ka tsaatsɛ kita, nɛ i de lɛ ke ke i kpale we Benyamin kɛ ba ha we lɛ fiafiaafia a, lɛɛ i yeɔ fɔ ye wami be ɔ tsuo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ye nyɔmtsɛ, ma hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kaa o nyɔguɛ ngɛ niheyo wayo ɔ nane mi; ha nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kpale kɛ ho.
Kɛ ma pee kɛ kpale kɛ ya tsaatsɛ ngɔ kɛɛ, nɛ niheyo wayo ɔ piɛ we ye he kɛ yɛ?
Aywilɛho nɛ maa pee tsaatsɛ ɔ, i be nyɛe ma hyɛ.”
Yosef je e he si kɛ tsɔɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ Jehanɛ lɛɛ Yosef nyɛ we nɛ e mia e hɛ mi hu ngɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ɔ a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa mɛ ke mɛ tsuo a je tsu ɔ mi.
Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo je lejɛ ɔ, Yosef je e he si ngɔ tsɔɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.
E fo ya boboobo.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ nu he, nɛ munyu ɔ ya pɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi hulɔ.
Yosef de e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Imi ji Yosef.
Anɛ tsaatsɛ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ lo?” Se benɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a tsui po wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ha lɛ heto.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef de e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ekohu ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ.” A pee ja, nɛ e ya nɔ de ke, “Imi ji nyɛ nyɛmi Yosef ɔ nɛ nyɛ jua kɛ ba Egipt ɔ nɛ.
E ko hao nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko pia nyɛ he hulɔ kaa nyɛ jua mi kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ. Mawu nitsɛ lɛ tsɔ mi kɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi, konɛ ma ba he nihi a yi wami.
Jeha enyɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Se e pa piɛ jeha enuɔ ngɛ wa hɛ mi nɛ a be ní gbae ɔ, a be ní kpae hulɔ.
Mawu tsɔ mi kɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi, konɛ ma ba he nyɛ yi wami ngɛ nyakpɛ blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ ma hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina nɛ wo ngmɛdu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Tsa pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ha i ba hiɛ ɔ; Mawu mohu lɛ ha nɛ i ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ.
E ngɔ mi ngɔ pee Farao ɔ ga wolɔ; imi lɛ i hyɛɛ e we ɔ nɔ, nɛ imi lɛ i yeɔ Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ho tsaatsɛ ngɔ ya esɔesɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya de lɛ ke bɔ nɛ e bi Yosef ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mawu ngɔ mi ngɔ pee Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ yelɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba nɔuu; koo to tsle.
O ma ba hi Goshen zugba a nɔ, ngɛ ye kasa nya.
O kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ, o bibimɛ ɔmɛ, o to ɔmɛ, o na amɛ, kɛ o weto ní tsuo nɛ ba.
Ke o ba je Goshen ɔ, ma hyɛ o nɔ.
E piɛ jeha enuɔ sɔuu ngɛ wa hɛ mi loko hwɔ ɔ se maa po; nɛ i be suɔe nɛ mo, loo o we mi bi ɔmɛ, loo o lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ ba ha hwɔ.’ ” Yosef ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ ye nyɛmi Benyamin tsuo nyɛ na kaa imi Yosef tutuutu lɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ya bɔ tsaatsɛ blɔ nya ngua nɛ i hɛɛ ngɛ Egipt, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ba na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.” Yosef kɛ e nine kpla e senɔ Benyamin kuɛ, nɛ e fo ya.
Benyamin hu pee ja nɔuu, nɛ lɛ hu e wo ya ngɔ pue e wetsɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jehanɛ, benɛ Yosef ngɛ ya foe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e fua e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kakaaka, nɛ e fiɔ a nya he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ bɔni ní sɛɛmi.
Benɛ munyu ɔ ya pɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi kaa Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba a, Farao ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a bua jɔ.
Farao ɔ de Yosef ke, “De o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke a wo a lohwe ɔmɛ a nɔ ní, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho Kanaan zugba a nɔ ya.
Ha nɛ a ya ngɔ a tsɛ, kɛ a we mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpale kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Ma ha mɛ Egipt zugba a he nɛ hi pe kulaa, nɛ a ma na ní kpakpa babauu maa ye.
Jehanɛ, de mɛ ke a ngɔ ta zugba lɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ho, nɛ a kɛ ya ngɔ a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ, kɛ a tsɛ ɔ kɛ ba.
E ko hao mɛ kaa a maa je a weto níhi a he; ejakaa Egipt zugba a nɔ ní kpakpahi tsuo maa pee a nɔ́.” Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ a de mɛ ɔ. Yosef ha mɛ ta zugba lɛhi kaa bɔ nɛ Farao ɔ fa ke a pee ɔ; nɛ e ha mɛ niye ní nɛ a maa ye ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ hulɔ.
Jehanɛ e ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ he dlami tade kakaaka; se Benyamin lɛɛ, e ha lɛ sika hiɔ yi lafa etɛ kɛ he dlami tade enuɔ.
Níhi nɛ e mane e tsɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: teji nyɔngma kɛ a se mi Egipt ní kpakpahi, kɛ teji yo nyɔngma kɛ a se mi blɛfo kɛ abolo, kɛ niye ní nɛ e tsɛ ɔ maa ye ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ba.
Jehanɛ, e wo e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ blɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nɛ nyɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko ya pɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.” Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ je Egipt, nɛ a kpale kɛ ba a tsɛ Yakob ngɔ ngɛ Kanaan.
A ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ke, “Yosef ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ yee!” Yakob he mi po, ejakaa e he we mɛ yi.
Se benɛ a bɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yosef de mɛ, nɛ e na zugba lɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Yosef ngɔ mane nɛ a kɛ ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba a, e nɔ gbagba te.
Yakob de ke, “Ye bi Yosef ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ!
Enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha mi!
Ma ya nɛ ma ya na e hɛ mi loko ma gbo.”
Yakob kɛ e we ɔ tsuo ho Egipt ya Yakob hia, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Benɛ e su Beersheba a, e sã bɔ kɛ ha e tsɛ Isak Mawu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɔ mi ɔ, Mawu kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ nina mi.
Mawu tsɛ lɛ ke, “Yakob, Yakob!” Yakob he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Mawu de lɛ ke, “Imi ji Mawu, o tsɛ Isak Mawu ɔ. Koo ye gbeye kaa o maa ya Egipt; ejakaa ma ha nɛ o nina maa pee ma agbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. I kɛ mo maa ya Egipt, nɛ o ma ya gbo ngɔ fɔ Yosef gugue mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; se o nina lɛɛ, ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu.” Yakob hia kɛ je Beersheba.
Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a tsɛ Yakob, kɛ a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ ngɔ wo zugba lɛ ɔ nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ngɔ mane mɛ ɔ mi.
A ngɔ a lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ weto ní nɛ a na ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ ɔ, nɛ a pue blɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya.
Yakob ngɔ e nina a tsuo kɛ ho; e binyumu ɔmɛ, e bibinyumu ɔmɛ, e biyi ɔmɛ, kɛ e bibiyi ɔmɛ.
Yakob nina nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ya Egipt ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ruben, Yakob bitɛte ɔ, kɛ Ruben binyumu ɔmɛ: Hanok, Palu, Hezron, kɛ Karmi.
Simeon kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Zohar, kɛ Shaul, Kanaan yo ɔ bi ɔ. Levi kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ: Gershon Kohat, kɛ Merari.
Yuda kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ: Shela, Perez, kɛ Zera.
(Yuda binyumu kpahi, Er kɛ Onan ɔ, mɛɛ a gbo ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.)
Perez binyumuhi ji: Hezron kɛ Hamul.
Isakar kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ: Tola, Pua, Yashub kɛ Shimron.
Zebulun kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ: Sered, Elon kɛ Yahleel.
Binyumuhi nɛ Yakob kɛ Lea, fɔ ngɛ Mesopotamia ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
A fɔ biyo kake hulɔ, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Dina.
Nina tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ Yakob na kɛ gu Lea nɔ ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ etɛ.
Gad kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ: Zefon, Hagi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arod, kɛ Areli.
Asher kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi, Beria, kɛ a nyɛmiyo Sera.
Beria binyumuhi ji Heber kɛ Malkiel.
Nimli nyɔngma kɛ ekpa nɛ ɔmɛ ji nina nɛ Yakob na kɛ gu Zilpa nɔ.
Zilpa ji nyɔguɛ yo ɔ nɛ Laban ha e biyo Lea a nɛ.
Yakob kɛ e yo Rahel fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ: Yosef kɛ Benyamin.
Yosef hu kɛ Asenat fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ ngɛ Egipt: mɛ ji Manase kɛ Efraim.
Asenat ɔ, osɔfo Potifera nɛ je Heliopolis ma a mi ɔ biyo ji lɛ.
Benyamin binyumuhi ji Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Mupim, Hupim, kɛ Ard.
Nimli nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji nina nɛ Yakob na kɛ gu Rahel nɔ.
Dan kɛ e binyumu Hushim.
Naftali kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ: Yazeel, Guni, Yezer, kɛ Shilem.
Nimli kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ ji nina nɛ Yakob na kɛ gu Bilha nɔ.
Bilha ji nyɔguɛ yo ɔ nɛ Laban ha e biyo Rahel ɔ nɛ.
Yakob nina tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ya Egipt ɔ, ke a je e binyumu ɔmɛ a yi ɔmɛ kɛ je mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nyingmi ekpa kɛ ekpa.
Ke a kɛ Yosef binyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a fɔ ngɛ Egipt ɔ piɛ he ɔ, Yakob we ɔ tsuo nɛ ya Egipt ɔ peeɔ nimli nyingmi kpaago.
Yakob kɛ e we mi bimɛ ngɛ Egipt Yakob tsɔ Yuda kɛ sɛ hlami, konɛ e ya de Yosef nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba kpe ngɛ Goshen.
E kɛ we nɛ a ya su Goshen.
Yosef hi e zugba ta lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e ho konɛ e ya kpee e tsɛ ngɛ Goshen.
Benɛ a kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi ɔ, Yosef kɛ e nine kpla e tsɛ kuɛ mi, nɛ e fo ya ngɔ pue e nɔ hluu.
Yakob de Yosef ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nɛ i na o hɛ mi, nɛ i na kaa o ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, ke i gbo hu, e pi nɔ́ ko.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef de e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɛ weku li ɔmɛ ke, “I yaa nɛ ma ya de Farao ɔ ke, ‘Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ tsaatsɛ weku ɔ tsuo je Kanaan kɛ ba ye ngɔ.’ Ma de lɛ ke to hyɛli kɛ na tsɔ̃li ji nyɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ to ɔmɛ, nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ nyɛ weto ní tsuo ba.
Ke Farao ɔ tsɔ ba tsɛ nyɛ, nɛ e bi nyɛ ke mɛni ní tsumi nyɛ tsuɔ ɔ, nyɛ de lɛ ke, ‘Kɛ je wa nihe mi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, lohwe wa lɛɛ; wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nɔuu a tsu.’ Ke nyɛ de lɛ ja a, e ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ hi Goshen zugba a nɔ; ejakaa Egipt bimɛ hiee lohwe lɛli.”
-Yosef hla e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nihi enuɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya tsɔɔ Farao ɔ. Yosef de Farao ɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ je Kanaan zugba a nɔ kɛ ba.
A kɛ a tohi, kɛ a nahi, kɛ a weto ní tsuo ba.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a pueɔ si ngɛ Goshen zugba a nɔ.” Farao ɔ bi Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni ní tsumi nyɛ tsuɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Lohwe lɛli ji wɔ; wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nɔuu a tsu.
Wa ba nɛ wa ba hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ bɔɔ.
Wa nɛ niye ní ha wa lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, ejakaa hwɔ ɔ nya wa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ha nɛ waa hi Goshen zugba a nɔ.” Farao ɔ de Yosef ke, “O tsɛ kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba mo tomi.
Egipt zugba a lɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi tilaa nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ha nɛ o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a hi Goshen zugba a nɔ; lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ hi pe zugba a tsuo.
Ke o na kaa a ti ni komɛ le lohwe lɛmi ní tsumi nɛ ɔ saminya a, ha nɛ a ya hyɛ imi nitsɛ ye lohwe ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Yosef ngɔ e tsɛ Yakob hu kɛ ba tsɔɔ Farao ɔ. Yakob gbaa Farao ɔ, nɛ Farao ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Jeha nyɛmɛ o ye?” Yakob he nɔ ke, “I ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi etɛ.
Ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ slo mɛ; mɛɛ lɛɛ a se kɛ ngɛ je mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob gbaa Farao ɔ ekohu, nɛ e je e ngɔ.
Jehanɛ, Yosef ha e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ sihi he ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Farao ɔ fa lɛ Yosef ɔ, e ha mɛ weto ní ngɛ Rameses kasa nya, nɛ ji zugba nɛ hi pe zugba a tsuo.
Yosef ha e tsɛ, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɛ weku li ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ tsuo niye ní, bɔ nɛ su nɔ tsuaa nɔ nya.
Hwɔ ɔ nya wa Jehanɛ lɛɛ hwɔ ɔ nya ba wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Niye ní be zugba a nɔ he ko he ko; nɛ hwɔ ɔ ha nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ tsuo gbɔjɔ.
Sika nɛ a kɛ je Egipt kɛ Kanaan zugba amɛ a nɔ kɛ ba he blɛfo ɔ, Yosef bua lɛ tsuo nya, nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ho matsɛ we ɔ mi ya.
Benɛ sika nɛ ngɛ Egipt kɛ Kanaan tsuo ba ta a, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ba de Yosef ke, “Ha wɔ ní nɛ waa ye!
Anɛ o maa hi wɔ hyɛe nɛ wa gbo lo?
Wa sika tsuo ta.” Yosef he nɔ ke, “Ke nyɛ sika ta a, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ ma ha nyɛ niye ní kɛ to nya.” A ya ngɔ a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, to ɔmɛ, na amɛ, kɛ teji ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Yosef; nɛ e ha mɛ niye ní kɛ to lohwe ɔmɛ a nya.
Jamɛ a jeha a tsuo ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɔ a lohwehi tsuo kɛ ba Yosef ngɔ kɛ ba tsake niye ní.
Jeha nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ba Yosef ngɔ ekohu, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Wa nyɔmtsɛ, wa be mo nɔ́ ko nɔ laae.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa sika tsuo ta; nɛ wa lohwe ɔmɛ hu ba pee o níhi.
Nɔ́ kpa ko pa be wa dɛ pe wɔ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ wa zugba a. Anɛ o maa hi wɔ hyɛe nɛ wa gbo, nɛ wa zugba a hɛ mi nɛ kpata lo?
Mo he wɔ kɛ wa zugba a tsuo, nɛ o ha wɔ niye ní ngɔ to nya.
Wa maa pee Farao ɔ nyɔguɛhi, konɛ e ngɔ wa zugba a hulɔ.
Ha wɔ blɛfo nɛ waa ye, nɛ wa ko ba gbo, kɛ ngmɛdu nɛ wa ma du ngɛ wa ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Yosef he Egipt zugba a tsuo kɛ ha Farao ɔ. Egipt no tsuaa Egipt no jua e zugba, ejakaa hwɔ ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ.
Nɛ zugba a tsuo ba pee Farao ɔ nɔ́.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo ba pee Farao ɔ nyɔguɛhi, ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi.
Zugba pɛ nɛ Yosef he we ji osɔfo ɔmɛ a zugba a. Osɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ e hia we kaa a jua a zugba a, ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a haa mɛ niye ní kɛ jeɔ Farao ɔ nitsɛ ngɔ.
Yosef de ma a ke, “I he nyɛ kɛ nyɛ zugba a mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha Farao ɔ. Blɛfo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ba ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ya du.
Ke nyɛ kpa ní ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ mi dlami enuɔ mi kake ba ha Farao ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ nɛ pee nyɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ we mi bimɛ nyɛ nɔ́; nyɛɛ ye eko, nɛ nyɛ du eko.” Ma a he nɔ ke, “O he wa yi wami!
Wa nyɔmtsɛ, ke e sa o hɛ mi ɔ, wa maa pee Farao ɔ nyɔguɛhi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yosef wo mlaa nɛ ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, kaa Egipt zugba a niba ní ɔ mi dlami enuɔ mi kake maa pee Farao ɔ nɔ́.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a zugba a pɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ be Farao ɔ nɔ́ pee.
Yakob nyagbe hiami nɔ́ Israel bi ɔmɛ hi Goshen zugba a nɔ ngɛ Egipt.
A na ní, nɛ a fɔ bimɛ, nɛ a he hiɛ babauu.
Yakob hi Egipt zugba a nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaago; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jeha tsuo nɛ Yakob ye ji jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kpaago.
Benɛ Yakob gbenɔ be su ɔ, e tsɛ e bi Yosef, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke o suɔ nɛ o sa ye hɛ mi ɔ, ngɔɔ o nine kɛ wo ye fiɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛ, nɛ o ka mi kita kaa o maa ye mi anɔkuale, nɛ o be mi pue ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Ma suɔ nɛ a pu mi ngɛ he nɛ a pu ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i gbo ɔ, ngɔɔ mi kɛ je Egipt, nɛ o ya pu mi ngɛ a kasa nya.” Yosef he nɔ ke, “Ma pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ.” Yakob de Yosef ke, “Ka mi kita kaa o maa pee ja.” Yosef ka lɛ kita kaa e maa pee ja.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob kpla si ngɛ e sa a yiti je, nɛ e na si.
Yakob gbaa Efraim kɛ Manase Pee se ɔ, a ba de Yosef ke e tsɛ be he wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɔ e binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ, Manase kɛ Efraim kɛ ho, konɛ e ya slaa e tsɛ ɔ. Benɛ a de Yakob ke e bi Yosef ma lɛ slaami ɔ, Yakob wlua lɛ, nɛ e te si, nɛ e hi si ngɛ sa a nɔ.
Yakob de Yosef ke, “Mawu Ope ɔ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ Luz, ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ e gbaa mi.
E de mi ke, ‘Ma ha mo bimɛ babauu, nɛ o nina ma ba pee mahi babauu.
Ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha o nina, nɛ e maa pee a weto ní kɛ maa ya neneene.’ ” Yakob ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Binyumuwi enyɔ nɛ o fɔ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ loko i ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee ye bimɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Ruben kɛ Simeon ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Bimɛ nɛ o ma fɔ ngɛ a se ɔ maa pee moo o níhi; se mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma na a weto ní kaa Efraim kɛ Manase a nina.
I ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee ngɛ o nyɛ Rahel he.
Benɛ i je Mesopotamia kɛ ma a, Rahel gbo fɔ ye nɔ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ ma su Efrat ɔ. I pu lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ Efrat blɔ ɔ nɔ.” (Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a tsɛɛ Efrat ke Betlehem.)
Benɛ Yakob na Yosef binyumuwi ɔmɛ ɔ, e bi ke, “Mɛnɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ?” Yosef he nɔ ke, “Bimɛ nɛ Mawu ha mi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.” Yakob de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba nɛ ma gbaa mɛ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yakob hɛngmɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ saminya; ejakaa e bwɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yosef ngɔ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ kɛ ba su Yakob he haa.
Yakob fua mɛ atuu, nɛ e fiɔ a nya he.
Yakob de Yosef ke, “Jinɛ i susuu we kaa ma na o hɛ mi ekohu; se hyɛ, o bimɛ pohu Mawu ha nɛ i ba na mɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef je jokuɛwi ɔmɛ kɛ je e tsɛ ɔ tɛ nɔ; nɛ e kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
Jehanɛ Yosef ngɔ Efraim ba da Yakob muɔ nine nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ Manase ba da e tsɛ ɔ hiɔ nine nɔ.
Se Yakob je blɔ tsake e nine ɔmɛ; e kɛ e hi ɔ nine fɔ Efraim, jokuɛyo ɔ yi mi, nɛ e kɛ e muɔ nine fɔ Manase, nɔkɔtɔma a mohu yi mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e gbaa Yosef, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu ɔ nɛ ye nɛ̃ Abraham kɛ tsaatsɛ Isak sɔmɔ lɛ ɔ, e gbaa nyumuwi nɛ ɔmɛ!
Mawu ɔ nɛ hyɛ mi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, e gbaa nyumuwi nɛ ɔmɛ!
Mawu bɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ ye nɔ, nɛ je mi kɛ je haomihi tsuo a mi ɔ, e gbaa nyumuwi nɛ ɔmɛ!
Nyumuwi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a wo imi, kɛ nɛnɛ Abraham, kɛ tsaatsɛ Isak wa biɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyami daa!
A fɔ, nɛ a he nɛ hiɛ babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ!” Benɛ Yosef na kaa e tsɛ ɔ ngɔ e hiɔ nine ngɔ fɔ Efraim yi mi ɔ, e ngɔɛ e nya.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e nu e tsɛ ɔ nine si, nɛ e je e nine ɔ kɛ je Efraim yi mi kɛ ya fɔ Manase yi mi.
E de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ, dɛbi, pi ja!
Nɔ nɛ ɔ mohu ji bitɛte; ngɔɔ o hiɔ nine ngɔ fɔ e yi mi.” Se e tsɛ ɔ kplɛɛ we.
E tsɛ ɔ de ke, “I le, ye bi, i le.
Manase ɔ, lɛ hu e nina ma ba pee ma agbo hwɔɔ se.
Se mohu ɔ, e senɔ ɔ ma ba pee nɔmlɔ agbo pe lɛ, nɛ e senɔ ɔ nina ma ba pee je ma nguanguahi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yakob gbaa nyumuwi ɔmɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ biɛ kɛ gbaa nihi.
A ma de ke, ‘Mawu nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ pee kaa Efraim kɛ Manase.’ ” Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Yakob pee kɛ ngɔ Manase nɔkɔtɔma blɔ nya a kɛ ha Efraim.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob de Yosef ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ɔ, i miɔ nɛ ma gbo.
Mawu kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, nɛ e maa kpale nyɛ kɛ ya nyɛ nɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ.
I ngɔ Shekem, zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a kɛ ngɛ mo hae, se pi o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.
Klaate kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ i kɛ kpɔ zugba nɛ ɔ ngɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.”
Yakob nyagbe munyuhi Jehanɛ Yakob tsɔ ya de e bimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya nɛ ma de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ hwɔɔ se.
“Yakob bimɛ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛɛ bu tue.
Nyɛɛ bu nyɛ tsɛ Israel tue.
“Ruben, mo ji ye bitɛte; mo ji ye he wami, kɛ ye nihe mi kekleekle bi.
Mo ji nɔ nɛ bu ngɛ o he, nɛ o ngɛ he wami pe ye bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
O ngɛ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, o kekleekle blɔ he ɔ ma bɔ mo.
Ejakaa o kɛ ye plã ya hwɔ si Nɛ o ble o tsɛ sa a.
“Simeon kɛ Levi ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ.
A kɛ a dɛ mi dade po tsuɔ yi wu tso ní tsumi.
I kɛ mɛ be soe kɔkɔɔkɔ, I kɛ mɛ be bɔe hulɔ, Ejakaa ke a mi mi fu ɔ, a gbeɔ nɔmlɔ, Nɛ a plaa nahi kɛ jeɔ a hɛja.
A gbiɛ a mi mi fumi ɔ, Ejakaa e nya wa, nɛ a kɛ peeɔ yi wu tso níhi.
Ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa Israel zugba a nɔ ngɛ a ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
“Yuda, o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ma je o yi.
O ma kpata o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
O nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ma kpla si ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Yuda ngɛ kaa jata nɛ ya ye de lo nɛ e kpale ba ba buu si, ngɛ e he jɔɔe; mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ?
Yuda maa hɛɛ matsɛ tso ɔ, E nina maa ye matsɛ daa.
Je ma amɛ ma tsu to ba ha lɛ, Nɛ a ma ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
E fiɔ e teji ngɔ woɔ wai tso he E fiɔ e teji bimɛ kɛ woɔ wai tso kpakpahi a he.
E fɔɔ e tadehi a he ngɛ wai nɛ tsuɔ kaa muɔ mi.
E hɛngmɛ tsuɔ kɔlukɔlu pe wai.
Jã kɛ̃ e lungu hiɛ futafuta pe na nyɔ nyu.
“Zebulun maa hi wo nya.
E hi he ɔ maa pee lɛsimuɔ he, nɛ e kɛ Sidon maa wo huzu.
“Isakar ngɛ kaa teji nɛ e wuhi a mi tsa; E buu si ngɛ lohwehi a tsuhi a mi.
E na kaa e na zugba kpakpa, nɛ e sihi he ɔ hu ngɔɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ba si nɛ e tloo tlomi, Nɛ e plɛɛ pee nyɔguɛ.
“Dan maa ye e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ.
Dan maa pee kaa sinɔ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ tue; kaa bleka ngɛ blɔ nɔ, Nɛ kɔɔ okpɔngɔ nane se ja, Nɛ e nɔ hilɔ tsɔɔ kɛ nɔɔ si ngɛ e se je.
“Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe nɛ o ba kpɔ mi.
“Gad lɛɛ, ojo fiali ma ba tua lɛ; Se e ma plɛ wo mɛ, nɛ e maa fie mɛ.
“Asher zugba a maa ba ní saminya; E ma ha niye ní nɛ sa matsɛmɛ.
“Naftali ngɛ kaa tso ko nɛ bɔ.
Nɛ e gba tso kɔni saminyawiiwi.
“Yosef ngɛ kaa nga mi teji ngɛ pa he.
E ngɛ kaa nga mi okpɔngɔ bi ngɛ yoku he.
E he nyɛli tuaa lɛ basabasa.
Nɛ a nyɛɛɔ e se kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi.
Se Yosef lɛɛ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ ji e dɛ gblegbleegble.
E he wami ɔ je Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ dɛ mi, To hyɛlɔ ɔ, nɛ ji Israel he bulɔ ɔ. O tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ nɛ gbaa mo, Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ gbaa mo.
E ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ ha mo kɛ je hiɔwe; E ha nɛ nyu nɛ ba ha mo kɛ je zugba a mi.
E ha mo lohwehi kɛ bimɛ babauu.
E ha mo ngma kɛ mɔmɔhi.
E ha mo ní kpakpahi kɛ je blema yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Mo Yosef, nɛ a hla mo ngɔ to kɛ je o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, Mawu nɛ gbaa mo ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
“Benyamin ngɛ kaa ogbetee nɛ tsɔtslɔɔ e he nyɛli a mi.
Mɔtu ɔ, e gbeɔ mɛ nɛ e yeɔ.
Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, e dlaa ta yibu ní.” Yakob bimɛ, Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Benɛ a tsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ ye nyagbe sɛ, nɛ e gbaa mɛ ɔ, munyuhi nɛ e tu mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ná e nɔ́.
Yakob gbo nɛ a pu lɛ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yakob ka e bimɛ ɔmɛ kita ke, “E be kɛe nɛ ma gbo, nɛ ma ya piɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Ke i gbo ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ mi kɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya pu mi ngɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kasa nya, ngɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Hit no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Efron ɔ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Tɛ puɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Makpela, ngɛ Mamre beleku je, ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
Abraham ji nɔ nɛ he tɛ puɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a zugba a ngɛ Efron, Hit no ɔ dɛ, nɛ e kɛ pee gɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ a pu Abraham kɛ e yo Sara ngɛ; lejɛ ɔ a pu Isak kɛ e yo Rebeka ngɛ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ imi hu i pu Lea ngɛ.
Zugba a kɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, Hit bi ɔmɛ a dɛ a he ngɛ.
Nyɛ ya pu mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Benɛ Yakob ka e bimɛ ɔmɛ kita a gbe nya a, e ya hwɔ si ekohu, nɛ e gbo.
Yosef wo ya ngɔ pue e tsɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e fiɔ e nya he.
E fa e tsɔli nɛ peeɔ tsopa a ke a wo e tsɛ ɔ tsopa konɛ e ko puɛ; nɛ a pee ja.
A ngɔ ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ wo lɛ tsopa kaa bɔ nɛ a pɔɔ peemi ɔ; nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ nyɛ ya ha lɛ ligbi nyingmi kpaago.
Benɛ a pee ya gbe nya a, Yosef de matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ya na Farao ɔ ha mi.
Nyɛ de lɛ ke, benɛ tsaatsɛ miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, e ha nɛ i ka lɛ kita kaa ke e gbo ɔ, ma ya pu lɛ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsua ngɔ fɔ si ɔ mi.
Nyɛ de lɛ ke, i kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e ha mi blɔ nɛ ma ya pu tsaatsɛ, nɛ ma kpale kɛ ba.” Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya pu o tsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o ka lɛ kita ke o maa pee ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef ho nɛ e ya pu e tsɛ ɔ. Matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ, matsɛ we mi nikɔtɔma amɛ, Egipt ma nimeli ɔmɛ, Yosef we mi bi ɔmɛ, e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɛ we mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ lɛ ho.
A bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ, kɛ a to ɔmɛ, kɛ a na amɛ pɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ Goshen zugba a nɔ.
Zugba lɛhi, kɛ okpɔngɔhi a nɔ hili hu kɛ lɛ ho.
Nihi babauu nitsɛ lɛ ho ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ a su ngma mi sami he ɔ ngɛ Atad, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ, a wo yana wawɛɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ be saii; nɛ Yosef pee kusumi kɛ nyɛ ya ligbi kpaago.
Benɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ na ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ ya pee ngɛ ngma mi sami he ɔ ngɛ Atad ɔ, a de ke, “Egipt bi tsa pee we ya mɔbɔmɔbɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Abel Egipt.
E ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je.
Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ e fa mɛ ɔ.
A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Kanaan nɛ a ya pu lɛ ngɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Makpela zugba a nɔ ɔ mi, ngɛ Mamre kasa nya.
Abraham ji nɔ nɛ he zugba nɛ ɔ ngɛ Hit no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Efron ɔ dɛ, nɛ e kɛ pee gɔ.
Benɛ Yosef pu e tsɛ gbe nya a, e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ lɛ ya e tsɛ pumi ɔ kpale kɛ ba Egipt ekohu.
Yosef wo e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ bua Benɛ Yakob gbo se ɔ, Yosef nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ de ke, “Eko piɔ, wa he dɔmi ngɛ Yosef mi kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ e maa to wɔ yayami tsuo nɛ wa pee lɛ ɔ nane mi.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngɔ sɛ gbi ngɔ mane Yosef ke, “Loko tsaatsɛ gbo ɔ, e ke wa de mo ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a yayami nɛ a pee mo ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ wa yayami ɔ ngɔ pa wɔ; ejakaa wɔ hu o tsɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ lɛ wa jaa.” Benɛ a ya bɔ Yosef amaniɛ nɛ ɔ, e wo ya.
Jehanɛ, e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ ba, nɛ a ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Wɔ o nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.” Se Yosef de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
Nyɛ susu kaa Mawu ji mi lo?
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ so kaa nyɛ maa pee mi yayami, se Mawu tsake nyɛ yi mi tomi ɔ kɛ pee nɔ́ kpakpa; bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e kɛ he nihi babauu a yi wami, kaa bɔ nɛ e ba mi mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
Ma lɛ nyɛ, kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ.” Bɔ nɛ Yosef pee nɛ e kɛ munyu ngɔngɔɛhi wo e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ bua ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yosef gbo Yosef kɛ e tsɛ we mi bi ɔmɛ hi Egipt.
E ye jeha lafa kɛ nyɔngma benɛ e gbo ɔ. E he bibimɛ kɛ gu Efraim nɔ.
Jehanɛ, Manase binyumu Makir hu fɔ bimɛ kɛ wo weku ɔ mi.
Yosef de e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “E be kɛe nɛ ma gbo.
Se Mawu maa hyɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ̃, nɛ e ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya zugba a nɛ e wo Abraham, kɛ Isak, kɛ Yakob he si ɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef ha nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ka lɛ kita.
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wo mi si kaa ke Mawu ba kpaka nyɛ kɛ yaa jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa ngɔ ye flɔ̃ ɔ kɛ ho.” Yosef gbo ngɛ Egipt benɛ e ye jeha lafa kɛ nyɔngma; nɛ a wo lɛ tsopa, nɛ a kɛ lɛ wo daka mi.
NYA TSƆƆMI Womi nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, ngɛ nyɔguɛ si himi mi, kɛ ya Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
E hɛɛ mi gbami etɛ: A jé Hebri bi ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi, nɛ a pue blɔ kɛ ho Sinai yo ɔ he ya.
Mawu kɛ e ma a so somi ngɛ Sinai, nɛ e wo mɛ mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ je mi babɛ, ma mi si himi, kɛ jami he.
Israel ma kpe he bo tsu nɛ́ a ma ja Mawu ngɛ mi, nɛ a dla mi saminyayoo.
A to blɔ nya kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ a ní tsumi, kɛ Mawu jami.
Titli ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu plɛ kɛ kpɔ Israel kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi, nɛ e ngɔ ma a ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
Nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ Mawu hla, nɛ́ e ya jé Israel ma a kɛ je Egipt ji Mose, nɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi munyuhi nɛ nihi le saminya ji mlaa nyɔngma amɛ.
Wa naa mlaa nyɔngma amɛ ngɛ yi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt .—.
a. Nyɔguɛhi ngɛ Egipt .- b. Mose fɔmi kɛ e jokuɛwi a si .—.
d. Mose kɛ Aaron doo Egipt matsɛ ɔ nya .—.
e. Hetsɔmi ɔ kɛ Egipt jemi .—.
A je Wo Tsu ɔ nya kɛ ya Sinai .—.
Mlaa a kɛ somi ɔ .—.
Somi kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ jami he .—.
A wa Israel bi ɔmɛ yi mi ngɛ Egipt - Yakob, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Israel ɔ binyumuhi nɛ e kɛ ba Egipt ɔ, a biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Yuda, Isakar, Zebulun, Benyamin, Dan, Naftali, Gad, kɛ Asher.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e yo kɛ e bimɛ ba.
Yakob nina tsuo a yibɔ ji nyingmi kpaago; Yosef lɛɛ e ngɛ Egipt momo.
Be ko se ɔ, Yosef kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo ba gbo.
Se a nina nɛ ji Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, bi ngɛ a he; a fɔ babauu nɛ a he hiɛ, nɛ a hyi zugba a nɔ tɔ.
A he hu wa saminya.
Jehanɛ ɔ, matsɛ he ko ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Egipt, nɛ lɛɛ e li Yosef.
E de e ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ na kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ, nɛ a he hu wa saminya.
Nyɛ ha waa to a he ga, ke pi ja a, a ma ba hiɛ tsɔ pe nine, nɛ ke ta ko ba a, a ma ya piɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a kɛ wɔ maa hwu, nɛ a maa tu fo kɛ je.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɔ nyɔguɛhi a nɔ yeli ngɔ to Israel bi ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ a wa mɛ yi mi kɛ ní tsumihi nɛ he wa.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ma Pitom kɛ Rameses, nɛ ji mahi nɛ a toɔ ní ngɛ a mi kɛ ha Farao ɔ.
Se si abɔ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, si abɔ nɛ a ngɛ hiɛe nɛ a ngɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ hae.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ ye Israel bi ɔmɛ gbeye.
A ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsu ní kaa nyɔguɛhi.
A hɛɛ zu, a peeɔ bliikisi, nɛ a tsuɔ ngmɔ ní tsumi slɔɔtohi; nɛ ní tsumi ɔ eko tsuaa eko mi ɔ, a waa mɛ yi mi wawɛɛ.
-Kɛkɛ nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɛ Hebri fɔliyi ɔmɛ tu, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɛ Hebri yi ɔmɛ fɔe ɔ, nyɛɛ to bi ɔ he hɛ.
Ke nyumu ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe lɛ, se ke yo ɔ, lɛɛ e hi je mi.” Hebri fɔliyi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake biɛ ji Shifra, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Pua.
Se fɔliyi ɔmɛ yee Mawu gbeye; a gbi binyumuwi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ fa mɛ ɔ; mohu ɔ, a baa a yi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Egipt matsɛ ɔ tsɛ fɔliyi ɔmɛ nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ jokuɛwi nyumuwi ɔmɛ tlɔ je mi, nɛ nyɛ gbi mɛ ɔ?” Fɔliyi ɔmɛ de Farao ɔ ke, “Hebri yi ɔmɛ be kaa Egipt yi ɔmɛ; mɛɛ lɛɛ a he wa saminya, nɛ a fɔmi ɔ sɔɔ.
Loko fɔlɔyo ko ke e suu a ngɔ ɔ, a fɔ momo.” -Akɛnɛ fɔliyi ɔmɛ yee Mawu gbeye he je ɔ, Mawu gbaa mɛ, nɛ e ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ bimɛ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ hu fɔ babauu, nɛ a he wa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ wo e ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo mlaa ke, “Binyumu tsuaa binyumu nɛ Hebri no ko ma fɔ ɔ, nyɛ ya sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ Nilo pa a mi; se biyo tsuaa biyo lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ e yi nɛ na wami.”
Mose fɔmi Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ je Levi weku ɔ mi ɔ ya ngɔ yo ko nɛ je jamɛ a weku ɔ nɔuu mi.
Yo ɔ ba na mi, nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
Benɛ e na kaa jokuɛ ɔ he ngɛ fɛu ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ laa nyɔhiɔ etɛ.
Se benɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ lɛ nɛ laa hu ɔ, e ngɔ kusii ko nɛ a kɛ ngɔwu lo, nɛ e kpa he amã.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ kɛ wo kusii ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya ma ngɔwu ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ pa a tue.
Bimwɔyo ɔ nyɛmiyo daa si ngɛ se banee ngɛ hyɛe kaa mɛni lɛ maa pee bimwɔyo ɔ lo.
E ba mi kaa Farao ɔ biyo ɔ ba nɛ e ba du ngɛ pa a mi, nɛ e mawa amɛ ngɛ si poe ngɛ pa a nya.
E na kusii ɔ ngɛ ngɔwu a mi, nɛ e tsɔ e mawa kake ke e ya wo kɛ ba.
Benɛ e bli nya a, e na bimwɔyo ɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ bimwɔyo ɔ hia ya.
E ní pee lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Hebri bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko bi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ bimwɔyo ɔ nyɛmiyo ɔ de Farao ɔ biyo ɔ ke, “Ma ya nɛ ma ya tsɛ bimɛanyɛ ko ngɛ Hebri yi ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ba nɛ e ba hyɛ jokuɛyo ɔ nɔ ha mo lo?” Farao ɔ biyo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ee, moo ya!” Kɛkɛ nɛ yiheyo ɔ ho nɛ e ya tsɛ bimwɔyo ɔ nyɛ nitsɛ kɛ ba.
Farao ɔ biyo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ jokuɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ho nɛ o ya hyɛ e nɔ ha mi nɛ ma wo mo hiɔ.” Yo ɔ ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ nɛ e ya hyɛ e nɔ.
Benɛ jokuɛ ɔ ba wa a, yo ɔ ngɔ lɛ ya ha Farao ɔ biyo ɔ, nɛ e ba pee e bi.
E wo lɛ biɛ ke Mose, nɛ e de ke, “I wo lɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyu mi i je lɛ kɛ je.” Mose ku kɛ ho Midian ya Benɛ Mose ba wa a, e je kpo ligbi ko kɛ ho e nyɛmimɛ Hebri bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya hyɛ pɔtɔ, kɛ dengme ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ a ngɛ tsue ɔ. E na Egipt no ko nɛ ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ Hebri bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake gbee.
Mose plɛ hyɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, nɛ e nɛ nɔ ko.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e fia Egipt no ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e gbe, nɛ e kɛ zia tsi e nɔ.
E nɔ jena a, benɛ Mose je kpo ekohu ɔ, e ya na Hebri bi enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ kunɔ nɔe.
E bi nɔ nɛ nɔ́ dɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ o nyɛmi ɔ nɔ fiae?” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ wo mo wa nyatsɛ kɛ kojolɔ?
Pe o ngɛ hlae nɛ o gbe mi kaa bɔ nɛ o gbe Egipt no ɔ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose tsui po, nɛ e de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Sane ɔ je kpo.” - Benɛ Farao ɔ nu he ɔ, e hla kaa e maa gbe Mose.
Se Mose tu fo kɛ ho Midian zugba a nɔ ya.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Mose ya hi si ngɛ vu ko he, nɛ e ba mi kaa Midian osɔfo ɔ biyiwi kpaago ba lejɛ ɔ nɛ́ a ba yɛ nyu kɛ wo nyu numi níhi a mi kɛ ha a tsɛ tohi.
Se to hyɛli kpa komɛ ba nɛ a ba fie Yetro biyi ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose te nɛ e fie to hyɛli kpa amɛ, nɛ e ha yihewi ɔmɛ a to ɔmɛ nyu.
Benɛ a kpale kɛ ba a tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ lɛɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ba mla kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” A de lɛ ke, “Egipt no ko lɛ je wɔ ngɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e sa nyu ha wɔ nɛ wa to ɔmɛ nu.” Yetro bi e biyi ɔmɛ ke, “Nɛ jije e ngɛ?
Mɛni he je nyɛ je nyumu ɔ he?
Nyɛ ya tsɛ lɛ kɛ ba nɛ e ba wo e nya mi nɔ́ ko.” Mose kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ osɔfo ɔ maa hi si.
Pee se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ ngɔ e biyo Zipora ngɔ ha Mose.
Zipora fɔ binyumu, nɛ Mose wo lɛ biɛ ke Gershon, nɛ e de ke, “I wo lɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa i ba to nubwɔ ngɛ ma se zugba nɔ.” Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, Egipt matsɛ ɔ ba gbo.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ kɛmɛmi kɛkɛ a ngɛ kɛmɛe ngɛ a nyɔguɛ yemi ɔ mi.
A fa kue ha Mawu, nɛ Mawu hu nu a gbi.
Benɛ Mawu nu a kɛmɛmi ɔ, e kai somi nɛ e kɛ a nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob so ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a si himi ɔ he; ejakaa e na kaa be su nɛ sa kaa e pee he nɔ́ ko.
Mawu tsɛ Mose Mose ngɛ e ngatsɛ Yetro, Midian osɔfo ɔ tohi hyɛe ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e tsɔ̃ to ɔmɛ kɛ ya gu nga a nɔ, kɛ ya pã si ngɛ Mawu yo, Horeb ɔ he.
Benɛ e ba lejɛ ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ko ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ kaa la lilɛ nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ mio tso ko mi.
Benɛ e ke e hyɛɛ ɔ, e na kaa mio tso ɔ ngɛ tsoe, se e sɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de ke, “Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ ma gba nɛ ma ya hyɛ nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɔ he je nɛ mio tso ɔ sɛ̃ ɔ.” Benɛ Yawɛ na kaa e gba kɛ ma hyɛmi ɔ, e tsɛ lɛ kɛ je mio tso ɔ mi ke, “Mose!
Mose!” Nɛ Mose he nɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ!
Imi ji nɛ!” Mawu de lɛ ke, “Koo hɛ mo kɛ su hiɛ ɔ!
Je o tokota a, ejakaa zugba klɔuklɔu nɔ o daa si ngɛ ɔ nɛ!” E ya nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Imi ji o nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu ɔ nɛ!” Mose ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi, ejakaa e ngɛ gbeye yee kaa e maa na Mawu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de ke, “Amanehlu nɛ ye ma a ngɛ nae ngɛ Egipt ɔ, i na; nɛ ya nɛ a ngɛ foe kɛ ngɛ balɔ tsɛe ɔ hu i nu.
Niinɛ, i le a nɔ́ nami ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kple si kɛ ba, konɛ ma ba kpɔ mɛ kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ ma je mɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya zugba kpakpa nɛ kle, nɛ baa ní nɔ.
Kanaan bi, Hit bi, Amor bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi a hi he ɔ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Niinɛ, i nu Israel bi ɔmɛ a ya fomi ɔ, nɛ i na bɔ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ha.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ ma tsɔ mo Farao ɔ ngɔ nɛ o ya je ye ma, nɛ ji Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt.” Se Mose bi Mawu ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mi, nɛ ma ya Farao ɔ ngɔ, nɛ ma ya je Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ?” Mawu ha lɛ heto ke, “Ma piɛ o he.
Ke o ya jé ma a kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba a, nyɛ ma ba ja mi ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ loko o maa le niinɛ kaa imi nɛ i tsɔ mo.” Mose bi Mawu ke, “Ke i ya Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ i ya de mɛ ke, ‘Mawu ɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ja lɛ ɔ tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ,’ nɛ a bi mi ke, ‘Kɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ kɛɛ?’ ɔ, kɛ ma de mɛ kɛɛ?” Mawu de Mose ke, “IMI JI NƆ NƐ I JI.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ o ma de Israel bi ɔmɛ ji, ‘Nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ IMI JI ɔ tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ.’ ” Mawu de Mose ekohu ke, “Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɛ e tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ.
Biɛ nɛ ɔ ji ye biɛ kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba a, mɛ hu a ma tsɛ mi jã.
Yaa nɛ o ya bua Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ o de mɛ ke, Yawɛ, Mawu ɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob ja lɛ ɔ je e he kpo tsɔɔ mi, nɛ e de mi ke, ‘I na nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ pee ngɛ Egipt ɔ, nɛ i ngɛ si woe kaa ma je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt nɔ́ nami ɔ mi, kɛ ya zugba nɛ kle, nɛ baa ní nɔ.
Kanaan bi, Hit bi, Amor bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi a hi he ɔ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.’ “A maa bu o gbi tue; nɛ o kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ maa ya Egipt matsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma ya de lɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ, Hebri bi ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ kɛ wɔ ba kpe; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha wɔ blɔ nɛ waa nyɛɛ ligbi etɛ blɔ kɛ ya nga a nɔ nɛ wa ya sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.’ I le kaa ke nyɛ doo Egipt matsɛ ɔ nya wawɛɛ tete po, e be nyɛ he ngmɛɛe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ ye nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ma pee ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ kɛ fia mɛ ní kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ye nine si wami.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e maa ngmɛɛ nyɛ he.
“Ma ha nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa na ye ma nɛ ɔ mɔbɔ; nɛ ke e su be nɛ nyɛ maa je ɔ, nyɛ be jee kɛ nyɛ dɛ gu.
Se mohu Hebri yo tsuaa Hebri yo ma ya ba june ní, sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ bo ngɛ e nɔle nɔ nɛ ji Egipt no, loo e we mi yo nɛ ji Egipt no ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ kɛ dla nyɛ binyumuhi, kɛ nyɛ biyihi a he ha mɛ.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa gu kɛ kpakpaa Egipt bi ɔmɛ a he níhi kɛ je ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Mawu ha Mose nyakpɛ he wami Mose de Mawu ke, “Se o na, a be mi hee maa ye, nɛ a be ye gbi hu tue bue; nɔ́ nɛ a ma de ji, ‘Yawɛ je we e he si ha mo.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni lɛ ngɛ o dɛ mi ɔ?” Mose he nɔ ke, “Tso.” Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Sake ngɔ fɔ zugba!” Mose sake tso ɔ ngɔ fɔ zugba, nɛ tso ɔ plɛ pee sinɔ, nɛ Mose tu fo kɛ je he.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Hɛɛ mo kɛ ya nɛ o nu e hlemi.
Se benɛ Mose hɛ lɛ kɛ ya, nɛ e nu sinɔ ɔ, e plɛ pee tso ngɛ e dɛ mi.” Yawɛ de ke, “Enɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ kaa Mawu ɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob ja lɛ ɔ je e he kpo tsɔɔ mo.” Yawɛ de lɛ ekohu ke, “Ngɔɔ o nine kɛ hɔ o tade ɔ mi ngɛ o tsui nya.” Nɛ e pee jã.
Se benɛ e je e nine ɔ, tsaoo, e nine ɔ he pee patapata kɛ hiɔ tsu, nɛ e hiɛ kaa snoo.
Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ o nine ɔ kɛ hɔ o tade ɔ mi ngɛ o tsui nya ekohu.” Nɛ e pee jã.
Se benɛ e je e nine ɔ, e tsake pee kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ sa a. Mawu tsɔɔ nya nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke e ba mi kaa a he we mo yi, loo a yi mi tɛ̃ mɛ ngɛ kekleekle okadi ɔ he ɔ, a ma he sekpɛ okadi ɔ ye.
Nɛ ke a he we okadi enyɔ ɔmɛ yi, nɛ jehanɛ hu a bui mo tue ɔ, lɛɛ o ma ya yɛ nyu ngɛ Nilo pa a mi, nɛ o ma plɛ pue zugba gbigbli nɔ, nɛ Nilo pa a mi nyu ɔ ma plɛ pee muɔ ngɛ zugba a.” Se Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, ye nya mi tsɔ we kɛ je sá, nɛ kɛ je be nɛ o kɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ bɔni munyu tumi nɛ ɔ hu tsakemi ko bɛ; ye munyu tumi ngɛ blɛuu, nɛ ye lilɛ hu jiɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ nɛ haa nɔmlɔ tuɔ munyu, loo e tui munyu?
Mɛnɔ nɛ haa nɔmlɔ hyɛɛ nɔ́, loo e hyɛ we nɔ́?
Mɛnɔ nɛ haa nɔmlɔ nuɔ nɔ, loo e nui nɔ́?
Anɛ pi imi, Yawɛ lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo ya.
Ma ha o nya mi ma tsɔ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ o de.” Se Mose ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o tsɔ nɔ kpa.” Jehanɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu Mose, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Anɛ o susu kaa i li kaa o nyɛmi Aaron, Levi no ɔ nya mi tsɔ lo?
Hyɛ, e ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ ma nɛ e kɛ mo ba kpe, nɛ ke e na mo ɔ, e bua maa jɔ e he saminya.
O kɛ lɛ nɛ tu munyu, nɛ́ o tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de.
Ma piɛ o kɛ lɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ pee.
Moo o maa pee kaa Mawu, nɛ o maa tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de, nɛ lɛɛ e maa pee o we otsiamɛ, nɛ e ma je o munyu ɔ nya ha ni ɔmɛ.
Moo hɛɛ o tso ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ maa pee nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.” Mose kpale e se kɛ ho Egipt ya Mose kpale kɛ ho e ngatsɛ Yetro ngɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi blɔ nɛ ma kpale kɛ ya Egipt, nɛ ma ya hyɛ kaa ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ lo.” Yetro de Mose ke, “Blɔ ngɛ faa; blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ jɔ ha mo.” Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Midian, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Moo kpale o se kɛ ho Egipt ya, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a tane o yi ɔ, mɛ tsuo a gbo.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ngɔ e yo ɔ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ hi teji nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt zugba a nɔ ya.
Mose kɛ̃ tso ɔ nɛ Mawu de lɛ ke e hɛɛ ɔ ngɔ ma e dɛ kɛ ho.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ke o kpale kɛ ya Egipt ɔ, nyakpɛ níhi tsuo kulaa nɛ i ngɔ kɛ wo o dɛ ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o pee lɛ tsuo ngɛ Farao ɔ hɛ mi; se imi lɛɛ ma kplii Farao ɔ tsui, nɛ e be hae nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ je.
Bɔ nɛ o ma de Farao ɔ ji, Yawɛ ke, ‘Israel ɔ, ye binyumu ji lɛ; ee ye bitɛte ji lɛ!
I de mo ke o ha nɛ ye bi ɔ nɛ ya nɛ e ya ja mi, se o kplɛɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbe o binyumu ɔ, o bitɛte ɔ!’ ” Benɛ Mose yaa a, Yawɛ ya je e he si ha lɛ ngɛ nibwɔhi a to he ko, nɛ e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ e tane e yi.
-Kɛkɛ nɛ Zipora ngɔ ha nɛ a kɛ tɛ pee, nɛ e kɛ po e binyumu ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ mɔmlɔtɔ ɔ kɛ sa Mose nanehi a he, nɛ e de ke, “Niinɛ, ye muɔ huno ji mo!” Nɛ Yawɛ ha Mose yi na wami.
Blɔɔ nɔ pomi kusumi ɔ he nɛ Zipora de ke, “Ye muɔ huno ji mo” ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ de Aaron ke, “Mose ma ngɛ nga a nɔ; yaa nɛ o ya kpee lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ho nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe ngɛ Mawu yo ɔ he; nɛ e fua lɛ atuu.
Mose bɔ Aaron munyu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ kɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ, kɛ okadihi nɛ e fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kɛ Aaron ho nɛ a ya bua Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.
Nɛ Aaron bɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ɔ, nɛ Mose pee okadi ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ.
Ma a he ye.
Benɛ a nu kaa Yawɛ ba na Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɔ́ nami ɔ, nɛ e ma nɛ e ba pee he nɔ́ ko ha mɛ ɔ, a kpla si nɛ a ja Mawu.
Mose kɛ Aaron ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi Pee se ɔ, Mose kɛ Aaron ho Farao ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ha ye ma a nɛ ho, nɛ a ya ye nyami ligbi nɛ a kɛ ja mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.’ ” Se Farao ɔ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji jamɛ a Yawɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ e sa kaa ma bu e gbi tue nɛ ma ha Israel nɛ ho ɔ?
I li Yawɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ pohu i be hae nɛ a ya.” A ha lɛ heto ke, “Hebri bi ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ ba je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, mo ha nɛ waa nyɛɛ ligbi etɛ blɔ kɛ ya nga a nɔ nɛ wa ya sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ. Ke wa pee we ja a, e kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe wɔ, loo e ma ha nɛ a gbe wɔ ngɛ ta mi.” Se Egipt matsɛ ɔ de ke, “Mo Mose, kɛ mo Aaron, mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ma a jee kɛ ngɛ a ní tsumi he jee ɔ?
Nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ ho nyɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ a he ya esɔ!” Farao ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, nyɛ bi ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ pe zugbatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma ha a kpa ní tsumi!” Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Farao ɔ fa nyɔguɛhi a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel bi nɛ hyɛɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ke, “Nyɛ ko ha ni ɔmɛ nga nɛ a kɛ pee bliikisi ɔ hu kaa sa a; nyɛ ha nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ya nɛ a ya fa nga a.
Se nyɛ ha nɛ a po bliikisi ɔ nɛ hiɛ kaa sa a nɔuu; nyɛ ko je nɔ, ejakaa a ngɛ hejɔ pee.
A ngɛ huhui kpae ke, ‘Nyɛ ha waa ho nɛ wa ya sã bɔ ha wa Mawu ɔ,’ ejakaa hejɔtsɛmɛ ji mɛ.
Nyɛ ko ha mɛ deka; nyɛ pue ní tsumi ɔ nɔ ha mɛ nɛ a tsu, konɛ a ko ya hi lakpa munyuhi tue bue hu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɔguɛhi a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya de ma a ke, “Farao ɔ ke e be nyɛ nga hae.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya fa nga ngɛ he saisaa nɛ nyɛ ma na nga ngɛ; se nyɛ ní tsumi ɔ lɛɛ e nɔ ko gbɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a gbɛ fĩa Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ nɛ a ya ngɛ go nya buae nɛ a kɛ pee nga kɛ ha bliikisi ɔ sami.
Nyɔguɛhi a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ nyɛ a nɔ ke a gbe a daa ligbi ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nya kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ be nɛ a haa mɛ nga a. Ke pee ɔ, Farao ɔ nyɔguɛhi a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ fiaa Israel ní tsuli ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a to ɔ ní, nɛ a biɔ mɛ ke, “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ gbi bliikisi peemi ní tsumi ɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ a to ha nyɛ ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ní tsuli a mɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ ba Farao ɔ ngɔ nɛ a ba fa kue ha lɛ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o kɛ wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ sane yee kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
A ha we wɔ nga, se a ke waa po bliikisi bami kaa bɔ nɛ wa poo daa ligbi ɔ. Jehanɛ hu a dɔ kpa to wa nɔ be mi nɛ tɔmi ɔ ji wɔ; se e je o ma mi bi ɔmɛ mohu.” Se matsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke, “Hejɔtsɛmɛ ji nyɛ!
Hejɔtsɛmɛ!
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ nyɛ ke ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.
Esɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya tsu ní!
A be nyɛ nga hae, se nyɛ maa po bliikisi abɔ nɛ nyɛ poo daa ligbi ɔ kɛ̃!” Israel ní tsuli ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ yɔse kaa sane yobu ye mɛ benɛ a de mɛ ke daa ligbi ɔ, a po bliikisi ɔ nɛ e hiɛ kaa kekle ɔ, nɛ a ko ha e nɔ nɛ gbɔ ɔ. Benɛ a si Farao ɔ, a ba na Mose kɛ Aaron nɛ a ngɛ mɛ mlɛe.
Nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ maa wo nyɛ hiɔ; ejakaa nyɛ ha wa he je fu wo Farao ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ klaate ngɔ wo a dɛ mi nɛ a kɛ gbe wɔ.” Mose ya ye kɔmɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kpale e se kɛ ho Yawɛ ngɔ ya ekohu, nɛ e ya bi lɛ ke, “Yawɛ, mɛni he je o pee o ma a yayami kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o tsɔ mi kulaa?
Kɛ je be nɛ i ba Farao ɔ ngɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu ngɛ o biɛ mi ɔ kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, yi mi sɔuu nɛ e ngɛ ma a wae.
Nɛ mo hu o pee we nɔ́ ko kulaa kaa o ma kpɔ o ma a.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Kpaako loko o maa na nɔ́ nɛ ma pee Farao ɔ, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ e he wami maa fie Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ maa je e zugba a nɔ.” Mawu tsɛ Mose Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.
I je ye he kpo tsɔɔ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob kaa Mawu Ope; se ye biɛ Yawɛ ɔ lɛɛ i ha we nɛ a le.
Jehanɛ se hu, i kɛ mɛ so kaa Kanaan zugba a nɛ a ya to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ha mɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ awe nyae ɔ, i nu, nɛ i kai ye somi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Imi ji Yawɛ; ma je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a tlomi ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je a nyɔguɛ yemi ɔ sisi.
Ma kpã ye nine mi kɛ he wami, nɛ ma ye dami sane ha nyɛ, nɛ ma kɛ kpɔ nyɛ.
Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ pee imi nitsɛ ye ma, nɛ ma pee nyɛ Mawu; nɛ nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ Mawu, nɔ nɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a tlomi ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ ɔ. Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya zugba nɛ i wo si kaa i kɛ ma ha Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob ɔ nɔ; ma ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ.
Imi Yawɛ nɛ i de.’ ” Mose ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, se a nyɔguɛ si himi ɔ, a nɔ yemi gbegbelii ɔ, kɛ a kɔmɔ yemi ɔ ha we nɛ a bu lɛ tue.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya de Egipt matsɛ ɔ ke e ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a je e zugba a nɔ nɛ a ho.” Se Mose de Yawɛ ke, “O nɛ, Israel bi ɔmɛ po bui mi tue; kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ Farao ɔ lɛɛ e maa bu mi tue; imi nɛ ye nya mi tsɔ we nɛ ɔ?” Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Nyɛ ya de Israel ma a, kɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ke i fa nyɛ ke nyɛ ba kpaka Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.” Mose kɛ Aaron a weku he sane Mose kɛ Aaron a weku he sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ruben, Israel bitɛte ɔ bimɛ ji Hanok, Palu, Hezron, kɛ Karmi.
Ruben weku ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Simeon bimɛ ji Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Zohar, kɛ Shaul, Kanaan yo ɔ bi ɔ. Simeon weku ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Levi binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ a fɔmi nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Gershon, Kohat, kɛ Merari.
Levi ye jeha .
Gershon binyumu ɔmɛ ji Libni kɛ Shimei, nɛ a nina hiɛ babauu.
Kohat binyumu ɔmɛ ji Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel.
Kohat wami ligbi tsuo ji jeha .
Merari binyumu ɔmɛ ji Mahli kɛ Mushi.
Levi weku ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Amram ngɔ e tsɛ nyɛmiyo Yokebed, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose.
Amram ye jeha .
Izhar binyumu ɔmɛ ji Kora, Nefeg, kɛ Zikri.
Uziel binyumu ɔmɛ ji Mishael, Elzafan, kɛ Sitri.
Aaron ngɔ Aminadab biyo Elisheba, Nahshon nyɛmiyo ɔ; nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar.
Kora binyumu ɔmɛ ji Asir, Elkana, kɛ Abiasaf.
Kora weku ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Aaron bi Eleazar ngɔ Putiel biyi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ Finehas.
Levi weku ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Aaron kɛ Mose nɛ ɔ ji nihi nɛ Yawɛ de mɛ ke a ya nɛ a ya kpaka Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba a nɛ.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ya tu Israel bi ɔmɛ a jemi kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ he munyu ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a Mose kɛ Aaron ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yawɛ fa Mose kɛ Aaron Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ.
Yaa nɛ o ya bɔ Egipt matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de mo ɔ.” Se Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Tse o le kaa ye nya mi tsɔ we.
Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ Farao ɔ maa bu mi tue?”
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “O nɛ, i pee mo kaa Mawu ha Farao ɔ, nɛ o nyɛmi Aaron maa pee o gbalɔ.
O maa bɔ Aaron nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ, nɛ o nyɛminyumu Aaron ma de Farao ɔ ke e ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a je e zugba a nɔ.
Se ma kplii Farao ɔ tsui.
Ma pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi babauu ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, se Farao ɔ be nyɛ tue bue.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ma nu Egipt kã nya, nɛ ma kpaka ye ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ji Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ; nɛ ma ye dami sane ha nyɛ.
Ke i pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ loko Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Mose kɛ Aaron bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ a pee kaa bɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Mose ye jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ, nɛ Aaron hu ye jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ etɛ benɛ a kɛ Farao ɔ ya tu munyu ɔ. Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Ke Farao ɔ de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛ kɛ ye nyɛ he odase ɔ, mo de Aaron nɛ e sake e tso ɔ kɛ fɔ zugba ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ tso ɔ ma plɛ pee sinɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron je kɛ ho Farao ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ. Aaron sake e tso ɔ ngɔ fɔ zugba ngɛ Farao ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ e plɛ pee sinɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ hu tsɛ e ní leli ɔmɛ, kɛ kunya yeli ɔmɛ nɛ ji Egipt wɔnɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ mɛ hu a gu a ga blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ pee ja nɔuu.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ sake e tso ngɔ fɔ zugba, nɛ tso ɔmɛ plɛ pee sinɔhi.
Se Aaron tso ɔ mii a tso ɔmɛ.
Se Farao ɔ kplii e tsui; nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ, e bui Mose kɛ Aaron tue.
Haomihi ba Egipt Nyu plɛ pee muɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Farao ɔ kplii e tsui; e kplɛɛ we nɛ e ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ho.
Moo bu tue!
Hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, Farao ɔ maa ya Nilo pa a nya.
Yaa nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya kpe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ ke o yaa a, moo hɛɛ o tso ɔ nɛ plɛ pee sinɔ ɔ ngɛ o dɛ mi, nɛ o de lɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ, Hebri bi ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ tsɔ mi o ngɔ ke ma ba de mo ke o ha ye ma a nɛ ho nɛ a ya ja mi ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o bui tue.’ Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Enɛ ɔ a kɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
