Ma wo tso nɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi ɔ kɛ fia Nilo pa a, nɛ nyu ɔ ma plɛ muɔ.
Lohi nɛ ngɛ pa a mi ɔ kulaa ma gbo.
Nilo pa a mi nyu ɔ maa sa; e maa je fu, nɛ e maa nyɛɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a he mi ha mɛ.’ ” Yawɛ kpale de Mose ke, “De Aaron ke, ‘Ngɔɔ o tso ɔ, nɛ o kpã o nine mi ngɛ Egipt pa amɛ, nyu dɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ taku ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, nɛ a mi nyu ɔ kulaa ma plɛ pee muɔ.
A maa na muɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he ngɛ Egipt, ngɛ tso buɛhi, kɛ tɛ buɛhi a mi.’ ” Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose kɛ Aaron ke a pee ɔ, Aaron wo tso ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ fia Nilo pa a hɛ mi ngɛ Farao ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Nyu ɔ tsuo plɛ pee muɔ.
Lohi nɛ ngɛ pa a mi ɔ kulaa gbo, nɛ Nilo pa a he fu tsɔ bɔ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a nu pa a mi nyu ɔ. Nɛ nyu nɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ tsuo plɛ pee muɔ.
Egipt kunya yeli ɔmɛ gu a ga blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a pee ja nɔuu.
Se Farao ɔ lɛɛ e kplii e tsui kaa sa a. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɔ to ɔ, e bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.
Farao ɔ plɛ e he nɛ e ho we mi ya; enɛ ɔ kulaa pue we e tsui nɔ.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsua vuhi ngɛ Nilo pa a tue nɛ́ a na nyu nɛ a nu; ejakaa Nilo pa a nitsɛ mi nyu ɔ lɛɛ e hi numi saasaa.
Benɛ Yawɛ fia pa a nɔ́ nɛ e plɛ pee muɔ se ɔ, ligbi kpaago ba po mi.
Ovɔnɔ ba zugba a nɔ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa Farao ɔ ngɔ nɛ o ya de lɛ ke Yawɛ ke, ‘Ha ye ma a nɛ ho nɛ a ya ja mi.
Ke o kplɛɛ we nɛ a ho ɔ, ma ha ovɔnɔhi maa ba o zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo nɔ kɛ gbla nyɛ tue.
Nilo pa a maa wo ovɔnɔhi fuu, nɛ ovɔnɔ ɔmɛ maa sɛ he tsuaa he.
A maa sɛ o we mi; a maa sɛ o se tsu mi, nɛ o sa nitsɛ po a maa kuɔ.
Jehanɛ a maa sɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a wehi a mi; a maa sɛ o flɔɔnɔɔhi kɛ o ní hoomi níhi a mi.
Ovɔnɔ ɔmɛ maa tuu kɛ mla mo nitsɛ, o we mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.’ ” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo de Aaron ke e wo e tso ɔ nɔ ngɛ pa amɛ, kɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ taku ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ́ e ha ovɔnɔhi nɛ ba Egipt zugba a nɔ.” Aaron wo e nine nɔ ngɛ Egipt pa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ha ovɔnɔhi ba nɛ a ba ha Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Se Egipt wɔnɔ ɔmɛ hu gu a ga blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ pee ja nɔuu, nɛ a ha ovɔnɔhi fuu ba Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ, tsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ nɛ e je ovɔnɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je i kɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ wa nɔ, konɛ ma ha nyɛ we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ho nɛ a ya sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.” Mose de Farao ɔ ke, “Moo lɛɛ e je o nya nɛ o de kɛkɛ kaa be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma kpa pɛɛ ha mo, kɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛkɛ a maa gbe ovɔnɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a be eko nae ngɛ he ko, ja Nilo pa a mi pɛ.” Farao ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ nɛ o sɔle ha mi.” Mose de lɛ ke, “Ma pee kaa bɔ nɛ o bi ɔ, konɛ o na nɛ o le kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ngɛ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ. Ovɔnɔ ɔmɛ maa ta zugba a nɔ he tsuaa he pɛsɛpɛsɛ, ja Nilo pa a mi pɛ.” Nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron je Farao ɔ ngɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose wo e gbi nɔ nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ ngɛ ovɔnɔ ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ Farao ɔ tu ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose bi ɔ; nɛ ovɔnɔhi nɛ ngɛ we ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ kpo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ nga a nɔ tsuo gbo.
Nɛ a bua a nya glekugleku ngɔ pue si, nɛ zugba a nɔ je fu.
Se benɛ Farao ɔ na mumi wo he bɔɔ ɔ, e kplii e tsui ekohu, nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ, e bui mɛ tue.
Pwɔmihi ba Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Aaron nɛ e ngɔ e tso ɔ kɛ fia tabo zu ɔ nɔ, nɛ tabo zu ɔ ma plɛ pee pwɔmi ngɛ Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ.” Aaron ngɔ e tso ɔ kɛ fia tabo zu ɔ nɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ tabo zu ɔ tsuo plɛ pee pwɔmi nɛ bɔni nimli, kɛ lohwehi tsuo bublemi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Pwɔmi ɔmɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Wɔnɔ ɔmɛ ka kaa mɛ hu a maa gu a ga blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ha pwɔmihi nɛ ba lo; se a nyɛ we.
Kɛkɛ nɛ wɔnɔ ɔmɛ de Farao ɔ ke, “Mawu nɔ́ peepee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Se kɛ̃ Farao ɔ kplii e tsui; nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ, e bui mɛ tue.
Pwɔlwɛhi ba Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo bu tue!
Hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, Farao ɔ maa ya Nilo pa a nya.
Yaa nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya kpe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ o de lɛ ke bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ha ye ma a nɛ ho nɛ a ya ja mi.
Se ke o ha we nɛ ye ma a nɛ ya a, ma ha nɛ pwɔlwɛhi maa bungɔ mo, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nɛ mo nitsɛ o we ɔ mi, Egipt bi ɔmɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo ma hyi kɛ pwɔlwɛhi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma je Goshen zugba a, he nɛ ye ma a ngɛ ɔ kɛ je mi, nɛ pwɔlwɛhi be lejɛ ɔ yae, konɛ o le kaa i ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ma gba ye we bi ɔmɛ, kɛ o we bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ma to okadi nɛ ɔ hwɔɔmɛ a je hwɔɔ.’ ” Yawɛ pee ja, nɛ pwɔlwɛhi wo fuu ngɛ Farao ɔ we ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi.
Nɛ pwɔlwɛ ɔmɛ kpata Egipt zugba a tsuo hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ tsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya sã bɔ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.” Se Mose de Farao ɔ ke, “E be dae kaa waa pee ja, ejakaa níhi nɛ waa kɛ maa sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ, Egipt bi hiɔ.
Ke wa ngɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a kɔ níhi kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ a hɛ mi ɔ nɛɛ, a be wɔ tɛ fiae lo?
Wa maa nyɛɛ ligbi etɛ blɔ kɛ ya nga a nɔ nɛ wa ya sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e maa tsɔɔ ke waa pee ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ de mɛ ke, “Yoo, ma ha nyɛ blɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ; se nyɛ ko ya tsitsaa.
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ha mi.” Mose de lɛ ke, “Ke i je o ngɔ pɛ i yaa nɛ ma ya kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ, konɛ hwɔɔmɛ a je hwɔɔ ɔ, pwɔlwɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a jɔɔ mo, o tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ bungɔmi.
Sisimi kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ ko sisi wɔ hu kaa e maa tsi ma a nya nɛ a ko ya nɛ a ya sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.” Mose je Farao ɔ ngɔ, nɛ e ho nɛ e ya sɔle ha Yawɛ.
Yawɛ hu pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose bi lɛ ɔ, nɛ e hwu pwɔlwɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Farao ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he; pwɔlwɛ kake ngmelu po píɛ.
Se Farao ɔ kplii e tsui ekohu, nɛ e ngmɛɛ we Israel bi ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ho.
Aja ba Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa Farao ɔ ngɔ nɛ o ya de lɛ ke bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Hebri bi ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ha ye ma a nɛ ho nɛ a ya ja mi.
Ke o kplɛɛ we nɛ a ho, nɛ o tsi a nya kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ imi Yawɛ, i kɛ ye he wami maa ta o lohwe ɔmɛ a he ngɛ a hi he ɔmɛ, nɛ ma ha nɛ aja nɛ nya wa maa sɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, teji ɔmɛ, afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ma gba Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a ní ɔmɛ lɛɛ ekoeko be gboe.
Nɛ imi, Yawɛ, be nɛ i to nɛ ma kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ji hwɔɔmɛ a je hwɔɔ.’ ” E nɔ jena a, Yawɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ e de ɔ. Egipt bi ɔmɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo gbo; se Israel bi ɔmɛ a ní ɔmɛ lɛɛ kake ngmelu po gbo we.
Nɛ benɛ Farao ɔ tsɔ nɛ a ya hyɛ ɔ, a na kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ a lohwe kake po gbo we.
Se Farao ɔ kplii e tsui, nɛ e ha we nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ya.
Tslɔɔ fuu ni ɔmɛ Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya je la zu dɛ mamɛ kakaaka ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi, nɛ Mose nɛ fɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe ngɛ Farao ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ e maa pee kaa ahlabata bunyuku ngɛ Egipt kɔɔhiɔ mi tsuo.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ ma plɛ tslɔɔ nɛ sa, nɛ e ngɛ pãe ngɛ nimli, kɛ we mi lohwehi tsuo a he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya je flɔɔnɔɔ mi la zu nɛ a kɛ ba Farao ɔ ngɔ.
Mose fia la zu ɔ kɛ mane hiɔwe, nɛ e plɛ pee tslɔɔ nɛ pã ngɛ nimli, kɛ we mi lohwehi a he.
Tslɔɔ ɔ he je ɔ, wɔnɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ we Mose hɛ mi nɛ a da; ejakaa tslɔɔ ɔ fuu wɔnɔ ɔmɛ kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.
Se Yawɛ ha nɛ Farao ɔ kplii e tsui, nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e de Mose ɔ, Farao ɔ bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.
Gbiɛ ngo ngu Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Hwɔɔ mɔtu mla a, yaa Farao ɔ ngɔ nɛ o ya de lɛ ke bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Hebri bi ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ha ye ma a nɛ ho konɛ a ya ja mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ i be o tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ o ma a kɛkɛ tue gblae; se mohu ma ha nɛ nɔ́ nami ɔ maa sa mo nitsɛ hu o he, konɛ o le kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ e kɛ mi sɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Jinɛ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ sa o kɛ o ma a he momo; nɛ jinɛ a je mo kɛ je je ɔ mi momo.
Se i ha nɛ o ngɛ je mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma je ye he wami kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo, konɛ a wo ye biɛ ta ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Akɛnɛ o ngɛ o he nɔ woe ngɛ ye ma a nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ o ngmɛɛ we a he nɛ a ya he je ɔ, hwɔɔ maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma ha gbiɛ ngo ngu maa nɛ bɔ nɛ a nɛ eko ngɛ Egipt hyɛ kɛ je be nɛ a to ma a sisi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɔ̃ o lohwehi tsuo ngɛ a lɛmi he ɔmɛ kɛ wo tsu mi; ejakaa gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ maa nɛ ngɔ pue nɔmlɔ tsuaa nɔmlɔ, kɛ lohwe tsuaa lohwe nɛ ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ a ma gbo.’ ” Farao ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya ye Yawɛ munyu ɔ gbeye ɔ ha nɛ a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ ba we mi.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ bui Yawɛ munyu ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a si a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ nga nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo wo o nine kɛ tsɔɔ hiɔwe, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ́ nɛ kɛ pue zugba a tsuo nɔ, kɛ pue nimli, lohwehi, kɛ nga nɔ tsohi a nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose wo e tso ɔ nɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ hiɔwe, nɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ hiɔwe si, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ, nɛ oslabai gba kɛ ba na zugba a. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ha gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ kɛ pue Egipt zugba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ ngɛ nɛe ɔ, oslabai hu ngɛ la pãe plamplam.
Gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ́ nɛ ɔ, a nɛ e nya wami ɔ eko hyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ tsuo kɛ je be nɛ a to ma a sisi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, nimli jio, tsohi jio, gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ kpata kulaa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Zugba a nɔ bahi kulaa gbo, nɛ tso ɔmɛ kulaa ku pue si.
Se Goshen zugba a nɔ he nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ lɛɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu kake po nɔɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ ba, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ i pee yayami; Yawɛ nɔ́ da, se i kɛ ye ma a, wa tɔ̃.
Nyɛ kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ!
Hiɔwe simi kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛmi nɛ ɔ ba hiɛ.
Ma ngmɛɛ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ ho; i be nyɛ nya tsie hu.” Mose de lɛ ke, “Ke i je ma a mi pɛ ma wo ye nine nɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ Yawɛ.
Hiɔwe simi ɔ se maa po, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ be nɛe hu, konɛ o na nɛ o le kaa Yawɛ nɔ́ ji je ɔ nɛ.
Se i le kaa o kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ na we nɛ nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye lolo.” Nɛ́ pee ja a, doti, kɛ ngma nɛ a du kɛ sɛ hlami ɔ kulaa hɛ mi kpata; ejakaa jamɛ a ngma a je deke, nɛ doti ɔ hu gba mɔmɔ.
Se ngma kpa a lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pee we lɛ; ejakaa a kpɛ se kɛ du lɔ ɔ. Jehanɛ ɔ, Mose si Farao ɔ, nɛ e je ma a mi, nɛ e wo e nine nɔ, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe simi ɔ, kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛmi ɔ se po, nɛ hiɔmi ɔ hu kpa.
Se benɛ Farao ɔ na kaa hiɔmi ɔ, gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ, kɛ hiɔwe simi ɔ se po ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee yayami; nɛ e kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ kplii a tsui.
Farao ɔ kplii e tsui, nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ gu Mose nɔ de to ɔ, e ha we nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ya.
Baalɛhi ba Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya na Farao ɔ. I kplii e kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a tsui, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma pee ye we okadi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a kpɛti, konɛ okadihi nɛ i pee ngɛ Egipt, kɛ bɔ nɛ i ha nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ pee a he kuasia ha a, nyɛɛ sɛɛ nɛ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ bibimɛ nɛ a nu, konɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Mose kɛ Aaron ho Farao ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Hebri bi ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mɛni be o ma kua o he si bami ha mi kɛ yaa si?
Ha ye ma a nɛ ya nɛ a ya ja mi.
Ke o kplɛɛ we nɛ ye ma a nɛ ya a, lɛɛ hwɔɔmɛ a je hwɔɔ ɔ, ma ha baalɛhi maa ba o zugba a nɔ.
A maa ha zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be zugba zu ɔ nae.
A maa ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ se; tso tsuaa tso nɛ puɛ po a maa ye.
O we ɔmɛ a mi, o tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ baalɛhi bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsɛmɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ nɛ eko gblee kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ ade kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ e plɛ e he nɛ e je.
Farao ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Mɛni be po nyumu nɛ ɔ maa jɔɔ wɔ haomi?
Ha nɛ e ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ho nɛ a ya ja Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ. Anɛ o nɛ kɛ mwɔɔ kaa Egipt hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya tsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ ba Farao ɔ ngɔ ekohu, nɛ Farao ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ.
Se mɛnɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ya a?” Mose ha lɛ heto ke, “Wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ wa maa ya a nɛ; jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi.
Waa kɛ wa binyumuhi, wa biyihi, kɛ wa lohwehi kulaa maa ya; ejakaa wa yaa nɛ wa ya ye nyami ligbi kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.” Nɛ Farao ɔ de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ nɛ gbaa nyɛ, ke i ngmɛ nyɛ blɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ ho fii!
Ɛhɛɛ, juɛmi yaya ko ngɛ nyɛ yi mi.
Dɛbi!
Nyɛ nyumu ɔmɛ, nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ja Yawɛ, ejakaa lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je Farao ɔ hɛ mi.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Wo o nine nɔ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ́ baalɛhi nɛ a pue Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ba ye zugba a nɔ tso kɛ nga, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ si ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose wo e tso ɔ nɔ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ bɔni fiami kɛ je beleku jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kulaa nyɔ kɛ pia; nɛ benɛ je na a, beleku kɔɔhiɔ ɔ muɔ baalɛhi kɛ ba.
Baalɛ ɔmɛ pue Egipt zugba a nɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ nɛ eko bɛ hyɛ, loo e maa ba.
A ha zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ lɔ ɔ ha zugba a nɔ yu tuu.
A ye tsohi tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ tso yibliihi nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ si ɔ; nɛ nɔ mumu ko kulaa píɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ tsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron nɔuu nɛ e de mɛ ke, “I pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nɛ nyɛ hu i tɔ̃ nyɛ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ ngɔ pa mi si kake nɛ ɔ pɛ, nɛ nyɛ kpa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ha mi nɛ e je gbenɔ tue gblami nɛ ɔ pɛ kɛ je ye nɔ.” Mose je Farao ɔ ngɔ, nɛ e ho nɛ e ya kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ.
Yawɛ tsake beleku kɔɔhiɔ ɔ kɛ pee bonyoku kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ muɔ baalɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya pue Wo Tsu ɔ mi; e píɛ kake ngmelu ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Se Yawɛ kplii Farao ɔ tsui ekohu nɛ e ha we nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ya.
Diblii wo Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Wo o nine nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ hiɔwe, konɛ diblii kpii nɛ wo ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.” Mose pee ja, nɛ diblii kpii wo ngɛ Egipt ligbi etɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ e nyɛmi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ti si kɛ ji he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ je mi tsɔ ha mɛ ngɛ a hi he ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ tsɛ Mose nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya ja Yawɛ ɔ; nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ ma nyɛ nɛ a kɛ nyɛ nɛ ya, se nyɛ to ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ lɛɛ nyɛ si mɛ.” Se Mose bi lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ mo nitsɛ o ma ha wɔ lohwehi nɛ wa kɛ ya sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ lo?
Dɛbi!
Wa maa ngɔ wa lohwe ɔmɛ hu kɛ ho; wa be lohwe nane kokloto kake po sie ngɛ se.
Lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ waa kɛ ma ja Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ; lohwe pɔtɛɛ nɛ waa kɛ maa sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, wa be lee, ja wa ya su lejɛ ɔ lolo.” Se Yawɛ kplii Farao ɔ tsui ekohu, nɛ e ha we nɛ a ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Farao ɔ de Mose ke, “Jee hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ho!
Hyɛ nɛ e hi nɛ o ko ha nɛ ma na o hɛ mi ekohu.
Ligbi nɛ o ma ba da ye hɛ mi ekohu ɔ, o ma gbo.” Mose de lɛ ke, “Saminya!
Kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ, o be imi hu ye hɛ mi nae hu gblegbleegble!”
Mose de ke bitɛtehi ma gbo Yawɛ de Mose ke, “E piɛ haomi kake nɛ i kɛ maa ba Farao ɔ kɛ Egipt nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ je.
Ke be ɔ su nɛ e ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ ho ɔ, pe e maa fie nyɛ, nɛ e maa bɛɛ nyɛ kaa a bɛɛɔ dwɔmi.
Jehanɛ ɔ, mo de nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nu kaa nyumu tsuaa nyumu, kɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ ya ba june ní, sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ngɛ e nɔle nɔ Egipt no dɛ.” Yawɛ dloomi nya a, Egipt bi ɔmɛ na Israel bi ɔmɛ a he bua jɔmi.
Niinɛ, Farao ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo buu Mose kaa nɔmlɔ ngua nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Mose de Farao ɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Maa pee nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ, ma je kpo nɛ ma ya kpa Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte ngɛ Egipt ɔ ma gbo, kɛ je Farao ɔ bitɛte nɛ ma ba ye e tsɛ se hwɔɔ se ɔ nɔ, kɛ yaa si nyɔguɛ yo nɛ ngɛ mamu wɛɛe ngɛ wɛ se ɔ bitɛte nɔ, kɛ lohwehi hu a kekleekle bihi tsuo.
Ya nɛ pɛ́ hyɛ, nɛ eko hu be pɛe ligbi ko maa pɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ gbe po be huãe kɛ wo nɔmlɔ ko, loo lohwe ko.
Nɛ enɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ ma kɛ le kaa imi Yawɛ, i kɛ mi gbami ba Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.’ O tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo ma ba kpla si ha mi, nɛ a ma kpa mi pɛɛ ma de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ ho, nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ se ɔ tsuo.’ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma je.” Nɛ Mose kɛ mi mi la nɛ nya wa je Farao ɔ hɛ mi.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Farao ɔ be mo tue bue bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ nɛ hiɛ babauu ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.” Mose kɛ Aaron pee nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Farao ɔ hɛ mi; se Yawɛ kplii Farao ɔ tsui, nɛ e ha we nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a je zugba a nɔ kɛ ho.
Hetsɔmi ɔ Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ke, “Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ maa pee kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ngɛ jeha a mi ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ de Israel ma a tsuo ke nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a, nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ hla to bi kake, jijɔ, loo apletsi kɛ ha e we.
Ke we ko mi bi a he pi nɛ a ma nyɛ to mluku kake maa ye ɔ, lɛɛ jamɛ a wetsɛ ɔ, kɛ wetsɛ nɛ we tsa e nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbe kake ngɛ a hiɛmi nya, kɛ bɔ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma nyɛ maa ye; a kane a yibɔ bɔ nɛ kake ɔ maa su mɛ.
To ɔ nɛ pee to ku nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko kulaa be e he.
E pee jijɔ, loo apletsi.
Nyɛɛ to lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ ya si nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a gbɔkuɛ ɔ ji be nɛ Israel ma a tsuo maa gbe to bi ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ diki we mi he nɛ a maa ye lo ɔ ngɛ ɔ sinya tso enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a yiti nɔ́ ɔ a he.
A sã lo ɔ, nɛ a ye lɛ kɛ agba pui, kɛ abolo kplolo jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu.
A ko ye lo ɔ mumu, nɛ a ko hoo lɛ ngɛ nyu mi hulɔ.
Se a sã lohwe ɔ mluku; e yi ɔ, e nane ɔmɛ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
A ko si eko nɛ je nɛ na yi.
Ke eko piɛ kɛ ya si mɔtu ɔ, a sã.
Nyɛɛ ye ní ɔ kaa blɔ hiali.
Nyɛɛ fi nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ tokota nɛ hi nyɛ nane; nyɛ dɛma tso nɛ hi nyɛ dɛ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ ye ní ɔ esɔesɔ; ejakaa Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi kɛ ha imi, Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, ma gu Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ be, nɛ ma gbe bitɛtehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ hu a kekleekle bi kuhi.
Egipt mawu ɔmɛ lɛɛ ma kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
Muɔ ɔ maa to nyɛ we ɔmɛ a he so, nɛ ke i na muɔ ɔ pɛ ma tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ be, nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a tue gblami ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ eko be nyɛ nɔ bae.
Ligbi nɛ ɔ maa pee kaimi ligbi nguaa ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ligbi ɔ kaa nyami be kɛ ha Yawɛ; nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina kɛ maa ya neneene.
Abolokplolo nyami be “Kɛ je kekleekle ligbi ɔ kɛ yaa si ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo.
Nyɛ kpa masa peemi ngɛ we ɔmɛ a mi kɛ je kekleekle ligbi ɔ. Mo nɔ nɛ o maa ye masa nɔ́ ko ɔ, a ma je mo we kɛ je Israel.
Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, kɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ gua nɛ nyɛ ja Yawɛ.
A ko tsu nɔ́ ko jamɛ a ligbi enyɔ ɔmɛ; ní nɛ nɔ maa ye pɛ nɛ nyɛ maa hoo.
Nyɛɛ ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ; ejakaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ nɔuu nɛ i je nyɛ ma a wɛtso nya wɛtso nya kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye ligbi nɛ ɔ, nɛ e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ fɔɔ si kaa mlaa ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nyɛ bɔni abolo kplolo yemi kɛ je kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ gbɔkuɛ kɛ yaa si nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kake ɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si.
Nɔ ko nɛ ko to masa ngɛ e we mi ligbi kpaago.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye masa nɔ́ ko ɔ, nubwɔ ji lɛ jio, we no ji lɛ jio, a je lɛ we.
Nyɛ ko ye masa nɔ́ ko; he tsuaa he nɛ ji nyɛ we nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo pɛ.” Kekleekle Hetsɔmi ɔ Mose tsɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ya hla jijɔhi nyɛɛ to we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ nyɛɛ gbe kɛ ha Hetsɔmi ɔ yemi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ wo kã mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ fi nga kɛ bla kaa bɛ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ kpa sinya tso enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ yiti nɔ́ ɔ a he.
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɛ ko gu sinya a nya kɛ je kpo kɛ yaa si mɔtu, ejakaa Yawɛ ma ba gu ma a mi kɛ be nɛ e ya gbe Egipt bi ɔmɛ.
Se ke e na muɔ ɔ ngɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e maa tsɔ sinya a he kɛ be, nɛ e be hae nɛ gbenɔ bɔfo ɔ nɛ ji nɔ hɛ mi kpatalɔ ɔ maa sɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi nɛ e ba gbe nyɛ.
Nyɛ maa ye blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Ke nyɛ ya su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo si kaa e kɛ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kusumi nɛ ɔ daa.
Nɛ ke nyɛ bimɛ bi nyɛ ke, ‘Kusumi nɛ ɔ sisi nɛɛ?’ ɔ, nyɛ de mɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ Hetsɔmi ɔ bɔ sami ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa e tsɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ Egipt.
E gbe Egipt bi ɔmɛ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ e ha wa yi na wami.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ ma a yi si nɛ a ja Mawu.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Bitɛte ɔmɛ a gbenɔ Nyɔ mi kɔ̃kɔ̃ɔ̃kɔ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ gbe Egipt zugba a nɔ kekleekle binyumuhi tsuo, kɛ je Farao ɔ bitɛte ɔ nɛ maa ye tsɛ ngɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si pã mi no bitɛte nɔ.
We mi lohwehi hu Yawɛ gbe a kekleekle bihi tsuo.
Nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Farao ɔ te si; e kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a wo yana nguaa ngɛ Egipt, ejakaa we ko we ko be nɛ a gbo we ngɛ mi.
Nɛ nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Farao ɔ tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ ba, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ te si nɛ nyɛɛ je ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nyɛɛ kɛ Israel ma a tsuo, nɛ nyɛ ya ja Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ de ɔ. Nyɛɛ ho kɛ nyɛ to ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ de ɔ. Nyɛɛ sɔle ha mi, konɛ Yawɛ nɛ gbaa imi hulɔ.” Jehanɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsitsɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a yi se ke a pee esɔ nɛ a je a zugba a nɔ; ejakaa a kɛ hɛdɔ de ke, “Wa yi ta oo!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ a ma nɛ sa we lolo ɔ, kɛ ma sowe ɔmɛ, nɛ a fi kpla a konɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de mɛ ɔ; a ya ba june ní, sika hiɔ, sika tsu, kɛ bohi ngɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Yawɛ ha Egipt bi ɔmɛ ná Israel bi ɔmɛ a he bua jɔmi, nɛ a ha mɛ níhi nɛ a ya ba ngɛ a dɛ ɔ. Blɔ nɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gu kɛ kpakpaa Egipt bi ɔmɛ a he níhi kɛ je ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ nane kɛ je Rameses kɛ ho Sukot ya.
Nyumu ɔmɛ kɛkɛ a hiɛmi maa pee akpe lafa ekpa; slo yihi kɛ jokuɛwi.
Futufutu nimli komɛ hu piɛ a he, kɛ tohi, kɛ nahi babauu.
Nɛ a ngɔ ma a nɛ a kɛ je Egipt ɔ kɛ sã abolo kplolo.
A na we be nɛ a kɛ gbe ma a; niye ní hu a hoo we, ejakaa pe a fie mɛ kpatakpata kɛ je Egipt.
Be nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ye ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ji jeha lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi etɛ.
Nɛ jeha lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔ nyagbe ligbi ɔ tutuutu ɔ, Yawɛ tabo ɔmɛ tsuo je Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ ji nyɔ nɛ Yawɛ huɔ nɛ e kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ pee nyɔ nɛ daa jeha a, Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ a nina tsuo huɔɔ nyɔ kɛ haa Yawɛ.
Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ he mlaahi Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: ma je no ko ma je no ko kó ye Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ.
Se nyɔguɛ nɛ a he ma nyɛ nɛ e ye eko ke a po lɛ se.
Nubwɔ, loo apaatsɛ nɛ ko ye eko.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye ní ɔ ngɛ we mi he nɛ a gbe to ɔ ngɛ ɔ; a kɛ lo ɔ eko ko je kpo kɛ je we ɔ mi, nɛ a ko ywia lohwe ɔ wu ko hulɔ.
Israel ma a tsuo nɛ ye nyami be nɛ ɔ.
Se ke nubwɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti suɔ nɛ e ye Yawɛ Hetsɔmi ɔ, moo po nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ; kɛkɛ e pee kaa we no.
Se mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ be he blɔ kaa e yeɔ.
Mlaa kake too nɛ ɔ maa fɔ si ha we no kɛ nubwɔ tsuo.” Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo bu tue, nɛ a pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron mlaa a. Nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yawɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya.
A ngɔ kekleekle bimɛ ngɔ to ha Yawɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo ngɔ kekleekle binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ to ha mi.
Binyumu tsuaa binyumu nɛ bliɔ fɔmi nya ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, nɔmlɔ bi jio, lohwe bi jio, ye nɔ ji lɛ.” Abolokplolo nyami be Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛ kai kikɛmɛ a ligbi nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ hia kɛ je Egipt, kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi sisi ɔ. Ligbi nɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ je nyɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ko ye masa ní ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ hiae kɛ ngɛ Egipt jee ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ, Abib ɔ mi.
Ke Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ ya su zugba kpakpa, zugba nɛ kle nɛ baa ní ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nyami be nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ mi daa jeha.
Kanaan bi, Hit bi, Amor bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi a zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ka nyɛ nɛmɛ kita ke e ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago, se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ nya kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Á ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo.
A ko na masa abolo ko ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi, nɛ a ko na masa ko ngɛ nyɛ huza a nɔ he ko he ko.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ ma de nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ha wɔ be nɛ wa hia kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ he je nɛ wa ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee kaa okadi ngɛ nyɛ nine he, kɛ nyɛ hɛ nya, konɛ Yawɛ mlaa a nɛ hi nyɛ nya daa; ejakaa he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kusumi nɛ ɔ daa jeha be nɛ a to ɔ. Bitɛte “Ke Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ ba Kanaan zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ka nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke e maa pee ɔ, nyɛɛ gbaa bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte nɛ bliɔ fɔmi nya a nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛ teji kekleekle bi ku lɛɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ jijɔ kɛ dani lɛ.
Nɛ ke nyɛ be suɔe nɛ nyɛ dani lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa ku e kuɛ.
Bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte ngɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, nyɛ dani lɛ.
Hwɔɔ se ke nɔ ko binyumu bi lɛ ke mɛni ji kusumi nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ, e de lɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ je wɔ kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi sisi ngɛ Egipt.
Benɛ Farao ɔ kplii e tsui nɛ e kplɛɛ we kaa waa ho ɔ, Yawɛ gbe Egipt kekleekle bimɛ tsuo; nimli a bitɛtehi, kɛ lohwehi a kekleekle bihi.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, lohwe ku tsuaa lohwe ku nɛ bliɔ fɔmi nya a, i kɛ sãã bɔ ngɔ haa Yawɛ; se ye bitɛte ɔmɛ lɛɛ i danii mɛ.
Kusumi nɛ ɔ maa pee okadi ngɛ o nine he, kɛ o hɛ nya, ejakaa he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt.’ ” Yawɛ nyɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Benɛ Farao ɔ ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je ɔ, Mawu kpakaa we mɛ kɛ gu blɔ kpiti ɔ nɛ gu Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a mi ɔ. Mawu de ke, “Ke ta ba na ma nɛ ɔ pɛ, ke o li peemi ɔ, a yi mi ma plɛ, nɛ a maa kpale kɛ ho Egipt ya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu kpaka mɛ kɛ ya lɔgɔ si kɛ gu nga nɔ blɔ ɔ ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ he.
Israel bi ɔmɛ dla a he kɛ ha ta, benɛ a hia kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ. Mose ngɔ Yosef wuhi kɛ ho; ejakaa Yosef ka Israel bi ɔmɛ kita, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, Mawu ma ba je nyɛ.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ ye wuhi kɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ to dɛ kɛ ho.” Nɛ a hia kɛ je Sukot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Etam ngɛ nga a nya.
Piani ɔ, Yawɛ nyɛɛɔ a hɛ mi ngɛ bɔku titima mi nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ.
Nyɔ mi lɛɛ e nyɛɛɔ a hɛ mi ngɛ la titima mi nɛ e kɛ haa a hyɛɛ nɔ́, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a nyɛɛ nyɔ kɛ pia.
Piani ɔ, bɔku titima a ngɛ ma a hɛ mi, nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, la titima a ngɛ ma a hɛ mi.
Wo Tsu ɔ pomi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a kpale a se nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Pi Hahirot hɛ mi, ngɛ Migdol kɛ wo ɔ a kpɛti.
A sito he ɔ nɛ kpee Baal Zefon hɛ mi ngɛ wo ɔ nya.
Farao ɔ ma susu kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ya tla blɔ, nɛ a ngɛ lalaalo woe ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ nga a sá a yi.
Ma kplii Farao ɔ tsui, nɛ e maa fie a se.
Nɛ manye nɛ ma ye ngɛ Farao ɔ, kɛ e ta a tsuo a nɔ ɔ ma ha ye hɛ mi maa ba nyami.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee ja.
Benɛ a ya bɔ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ke ni ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ je ɔ, Farao ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsake a juɛmi ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a de ke, “Mɛni wa pee nɛ ɔ, kaa wa ngmɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ho nɛ a be wɔ sɔmɔe hu nɛ ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ dla e ta zugba lɛ ɔ, kɛ e tabo ɔ, nɛ e hla ta zugba lɛ kpakpa lafa ekpa, kɛ Egipt ta zugba lɛ kpa amɛ tsuo, kɛ mɛ tsuo a tatsɛmɛ.
Yawɛ kplii Egipt matsɛ ɔ tsui, nɛ be nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ yaa kɛ gɛjɛmi ɔ, e fie a se.
Farao ɔ we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, e tabo ɔ, kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo hia kɛ nyɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a se, nɛ a ya na mɛ be nɛ a pueɔ si ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya, ngɛ Pi Hahirot kasa nya, ngɛ Baal Zefon hɛ mi ɔ. Benɛ Farao ɔ ná mɛ ta, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ wo a hɛ nɔ nɛ a na kaa Egipt bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ma a, sawale nu mɛ, nɛ a kpa bubuubui kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ.
A bi Mose ke, “Anɛ yɔkɔhi nɛ be Egipt he je nɛ o kpaka wɔ kɛ ba nɛ wa ba gbo tlɔ nga pa lo?
Mɛni he je o kɛ wɔ ye kikɛmɛ a sane, nɛ o ngɔ wɔ kɛ je Egipt ɔ?
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ wa de mo ngɛ Egipt ke o ngmɛɛ wa he nɛ wa sɔmɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa afani nɛ wa ma sɔmɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ pe kaa wa ma gbo tlɔ nga pa.” Se Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛ ko je fɔ̃, nyɛɛ da si kaa nyumuhi, nɛ nyɛ maa na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ maa pee kɛ he nyɛ yi wami mwɔnɛ ɔ. Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mɛ hyɛe mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ be mɛ nae hu gblegbleegble.
Yawɛ maa hwu ha nyɛ; nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ buɛ dii!” Yawɛ bi Mose ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ mi tsɛe ɔ?
De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ya a hɛ mi.
Wo o tso ɔ nɔ nɛ o kpã o nine mi ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ o dla e mi enyɔ, konɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ po wo ɔ. Ma kplii Egipt bi ɔmɛ a tsui, nɛ a maa nyɛɛ a se; kɛkɛ ɔ, ye hɛ mi maa ba nyami, ejakaa ma ye Farao ɔ kɛ e tabo ɔ, e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e we okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kunimi.
Nɛ ke i ye Farao ɔ kɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e we okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ nɔ ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ Israel tabo ɔ hɛ mi ɔ plɛ ya je a se.
Bɔku titima a je a hɛ mi, nɛ e ho ya je a se blɔ, ngɛ Egipt tabo ɔ, kɛ Israel tabo ɔ a kpɛti.
Bɔku ɔ ha diblii wo Egipt bi ɔmɛ, se Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a hyɛ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tabo enyɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a su a sibi a he nɛ je kɛ na.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose wo e nine nɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ nguaa ko fia kɛ je beleku jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo kɛ tsɛ̃ wo ɔ kɛ ya se.
Nɛ wo ɔ mi gba enyɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, nɛ e kpɛti ɔ plɛ pee zugba gbigbli.
Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ gu wo ɔ kpɛti, nɛ nyu ɔ pee kaa gbogbo ngɛ a hiɔ nɔ kɛ a muɔ nɔ.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ, Farao ɔ we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo hia kɛ nyɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ sɛ wo ɔ mi.
Mɔtu kpla a, Yawɛ hyɛ Egipt tabo ɔ kɛ gu la titima a, kɛ bɔku titima a a mi, nɛ e ha nɛ sawale nu mɛ.
Yawɛ ha nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a nanehi pu zu, nɛ a nyɛɛmi pee dengme.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ a nya hé gbi nɛ a de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa tu fo ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nya; ejakaa Yawɛ piɛ a he nɛ e kɛ wɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɛ fiae.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo wo o nine nɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, konɛ nyu ɔ nɛ kpale ku pue Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a we okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose wo e nine nɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ benɛ je maa na a, wo ɔ kpale tsa ekohu.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ tu fo nɛ a kɛ wo ɔ ba kpe, nɛ Yawɛ tsitsɛɛ mɛ kɛ pue wo ɔ mi.
Nyu ɔ kpale ba tsa, nɛ Farao ɔ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, e we okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ ya sɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ tlɔ mi nɛ a ti nɔ kake po píɛ.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ po wo ɔ, nɛ nyu ɔ wlua kaa gbogbo ngɛ a hiɔ nɔ kɛ a muɔ nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ pee kɛ kpɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ na Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ wo ɔ nya.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ na he wami nguaa nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ye Egipt bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a ye lɛ gbeye, nɛ a he lɛ, kɛ e tsɔlɔ Mose ɔ ye.
Mose la Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ la la nɛ ɔ kɛ je Yawɛ yi: “Ma la kɛ je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa e ye kunimi nguaa.
E tsɛ̃ okpɔngɔ kɛ e nɔ hilɔ ɔ kɛ wo wo ɔ mi.
Yawɛ ji ye he falɔ kpanaa; lɛ ji nɔ nɛ he ye yi wami.
Ma je e yi, ejakaa lɛ ji ye Mawu; ma wo e hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa Tsaatsɛ e Mawu ji lɛ.
Yawɛ ɔ, tatsɛ ji lɛ; e biɛ ji Yawɛ.
“E tsɛ̃ Farao ɔ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo wo ɔ mi bum!
Nɛ e tatsɛ ngua amɛ hu gbo tlɔ Wo Tsu ɔ mi.
Nyu kpekpemi ɔ ha a nɔ, nɛ a mu kɛ ho nyu ɔ sisi lokoo ya kaa tɛ.
“Yawɛ, o hiɔ nine he wami ɔ ngɛ gbeye; o hiɔ nine ɔ tsɔtslɔɔ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a mi.
O kɛ o we agboje tsɛ̃ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pue si.
Nɛ o mi mi la a tso gegeege nɛ e sã mɛ kaa dwɔmi.
O fli o gugwɔ mi ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyu ɔ bua e he nya da si kaa gbogbo; ohue mi nyu ɔ fi, nɛ e wlua gɛgɛnii.
He nyɛlɔ ɔ ke, ‘Ma nyɛɛ a se nɛ ma ya na mɛ; ma dla ta ní ɔmɛ ngɛ ye suɔmi nya.
Ma hia ye ha a, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi.’ Se o ha kɔɔhiɔ fia, nɛ wo ɔ ha a nɔ; Egipt bi ɔmɛ mu kaa sumue ngɛ nyu nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ mi.
“Yawɛ lee, mɛnɔ ngɛ kaa mo?
Mɛnɔ ngɛ kaa mo ngɛ mawu ɔmɛ a kpɛti?
O je agbo; o he ngɛ gbeye; mo, mo nyakpɛ ní peelɔ.
O je o he wami ɔ kpo, nɛ zugba a mii wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ.
O kɛ o suɔmi nɛ tsakee we ɔ kpaka ma nɛ o kpɔ ɔ; nɛ o kɛ o he wami tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ kɛ ba o zugba klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Je ma amɛ nu he, nɛ a tsui po; sawale nu Filisti bi ɔmɛ.
Edom matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he mi jɔ̃; sawale nu Moab nimeli ɔmɛ; Kanaan bi ɔmɛ tsuo a kã a laa.
Gbeye kɛ fɔ̃ nu mɛ; Yawɛ, o he wami ɔ ha a nya jɔ kɛ ya si be nɛ mo Yawɛ, o ma a nɛ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ ba be kɛ ho.
O ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ o ba to mɛ si ngɛ mo nitsɛ o yo ɔ nɔ he nɛ mo Yawɛ nitsɛ o dla kɛ ha o si himi, he klɔuklɔu nɛ mo Yawɛ nitsɛ o to sisi ɔ. Yawɛ maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.” Miriam la Benɛ Farao ɔ we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ sɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ nyu ɔ kpale e se ba ha a nɔ.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ po wo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Aaron nyɛmiyo Miriam, gbalɔyo ɔ ngɔ fao, nɛ yi ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛɛ e se kɛ fao fiami kɛ domi.
Nɛ Miriam la ha mɛ ke, “Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa e ye kunimi nguaa.
E tsɛ̃ okpɔngɔ kɛ e nɔ hilɔ ɔ kɛ wo wo ɔ mi bum!” Nyu doodooe ɔ Mose kpaka Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Wo Tsu ɔ he kɛ ho Shur nga a nɔ ya.
A nyɛɛ nga a nɔ ligbi etɛ nɛ a nɛ́ nyu.
Benɛ a su Mara a, a nyɛ we nɛ a nu nyu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e dooɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Mara, nɛ a de ke a wo lɛ jamɛ a biɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyu ɔ dooɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si Mose ke, “Mɛni wa maa nu?” Mose kɛ hɛdɔ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ tsɔɔ lɛ tso ko.
Mose sake tso ɔ ngɔ fɔ nyu ɔ mi, kɛkɛ nɛ nyu ɔ jɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ mlaa ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ka mɛ ngɛ.
E de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ maa bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue, nɛ nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e kita amɛ, kɛ e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ hiɔ ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ gbla Egipt bi ɔmɛ a tue ɔ, ekoeko be nyɛ nɔ bae.
Imi ji Yawɛ; imi ji nyɛ tsalɔ.” Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a ba to si ngɛ Elim.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ vu nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ zani tso nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mana kɛ hɔne Israel ma a tsuo hia kɛ je Elim, nɛ a ba su Sin nga a nɔ, ngɛ Elim kɛ Sinai a kpɛti.
Nɛ́ a je Egipt ɔ se nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ nɛ a hia a nɛ.
Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si Mose kɛ Aaron ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Wa ná nɛ Yawɛ gbe wɔ mohu ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, he nɛ wa hii si ngɛ pɔ buɛhi a he, nɛ wa yeɔ ní wa tɔɔ ɔ. Hyɛ kaa nyɛ ngɔ wɔ kɛ ba nga nɛ ɔ nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ba gbe asafo nɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ mi mi hwɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Hyɛ, ma ha abolo maa nɛ kɛ je hiɔwe pue si ha nyɛ.
Daa ligbi ɔ, ma a maa ya nɛ a ya bua nɔ́ nɛ maa su mɛ ligbi kake yemi nya, nɛ ma kɛ ka mɛ ma hyɛ kaa a maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ lo.
Ligbi nɛ ji ekpa a lɛɛ a bua ligbi enyɔ yeye nya, nɛ a dla kɛ to.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron de Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Gbɔkuɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na maa le kaa Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ jé nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Mɔtu ɔ, nyɛ maa na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ; ejakaa e nu nyɛ munyu huitihuiti nɛ nyɛ tu kɛ si lɛ ɔ. Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pi ni komɛ nɛ ke nyɛ hɔɔ nya si wo wa he nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ ko.” Mose de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ lo nɛ nyɛɛ ye gbɔkuɛ, kɛ abolo nɛ maa tɔ nyɛ mɔtu; ejakaa e nu nya si nɛ nyɛ hɔɔ kɛ wo e he ɔ. Nyɛ munyu huitihuiti ɔmɛ ɔ, pi wɔ nɛ nyɛ tu kɛ si, se Yawɛ mohu.” Mose de Aaron ke, “De Israel ma a kulaa ke a hɛ mɛ kɛ su Yawɛ he, ejakaa e nu a munyu huitihuiti ɔmɛ.” Benɛ Aaron kɛ Israel ma a ngɛ munyu ɔ tue nɛ a plɛ nɛ a maa hyɛ nga a nɔ blɔ ɔ, né Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ je kpo ngɛ bɔku ɔ mi.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “I nu Israel bi ɔmɛ a nya si hɔɔmi ɔ.
De mɛ ke gbɔkuɛ nya si nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na lo maa ye, nɛ mɔtu ɔ, nyɛ ma na abolo maa ye nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.” Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, hɔnehi fuu ba ba ha a sito he ɔ; nɛ mɔtu ɔ, bɔ́ nɛ kɛ bɔle ma a. Benɛ bɔ́ ɔ gbli ɔ, ní komɛ pue si ngɛ nga a nɔ pɛtɛpɛtɛ futafuta kaa ngo kpɔhi ngɛ zugba.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ na a, a li nɔ́ nɛ ji.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a de ngɛ a je gbi mi ke, “Mana.” E sisi ji, “Mɛni ji nɛ ɔ?” Mose de mɛ ke, “Abolo nɛ Yawɛ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mlaa nɛ e wo ngɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ muɔ bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye.
Nyɛɛ muɔ bɔ nɛ maa su nihi abɔ nɛ ngɛ we tsuaa we mi ɔ nya, bɔ nɛ nɔ kake ma na lita enyɔ hiɛmi.’ ” Israel bi ɔmɛ pee ja; ni komɛ muɔ fuu, nɛ ni komɛ hu muɔ bɔɔ pɛ.
Se benɛ a susu ɔ, a na kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ muɔ fuu ɔ, a nɔ́ ɔ, pi kaa e hiɛ tsɔ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ muɔ bɔɔ pɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ bɔ nɛ sa; lɔ ɔ ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ muɔ bɔ nɛ maa su lɛ yemi nya pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mose de mɛ ke, “Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó to eko nɛ je nɛ na yi.” Se a ti ni komɛ bui nɔ́ nɛ Mose de ɔ tue, nɛ a to.
Benɛ je na a, e sa nɛ e wo gɔgɔ kɛ e he fu gbii.
Nɛ eko kɛ ya si je na Mose mi mi fu mɛ.
Daa mɔtu ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ yaa nɛ e ya buaa bɔ nɛ maa su lɛ yemi nya; se ke pu nya wa pɛ e sile.
Ligbi nɛ ji ekpa a lɛɛ a bua ligbi enyɔ yemi hiɛmi nya, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ná lita eywiɛɛywiɛ.
Nɛ benɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba bɔ Mose amaniɛ ɔ, Mose de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Hwɔɔ ji he jɔɔmi ligbi, Yawɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi klɔuklɔu.
Nyɛɛ sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sami, nɛ nyɛɛ hoo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hoomi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ɔ, nyɛ ngɔ to si kɛ yaa si mɔtu.’ ” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa mɛ ɔ, a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ to si kɛ ya si mɔtu; nɛ e sa we, nɛ e wui gɔgɔ hulɔ.
Mose de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ye enɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ejakaa mwɔnɛ ɔ ji Yawɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi; mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ be eko nae ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Nyɛ ma bua nya ligbi ekpa; se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nɛ ji Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ be eko nae.” Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, a ti ni komɛ je kpo nɛ a ya bua niye ní nya, se a nɛ eko.
Nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Kɛ yaa si mɛni be nɛ nyɛ maa ya nɔ ma gbo mi tue nɛ nyɛ ma kua ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ, imi Yawɛ, i ha nyɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi nɛ ji ekpa a nɔ ɔ, i haa nyɛ ligbi enyɔ nya ní.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ he nɛ e ngɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko kó je kpo kɛ ya he ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a jɔɔ a he ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tsɛ niye ní ɔ ke mana.
E ngɛ kaa tso yiblii mi wu nyafii; e hiɛ futafuta, nɛ e ngɔɔmi ngɛ kaa akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ hwo ngɛ mi.
Mose de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘A susu mana lita enyɔ hiɛmi nya ngɔ to si ha nyɛ nina, konɛ a ba na niye ní nɛ i kɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ benɛ i je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ.’ ” Mose de Aaron ke, “Hla buɛ ko, nɛ o kɛ mana lita enyɔ hiɛmi nya nɛ wo mi, nɛ o kɛ ma Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ to si ha nyɛ nina.” Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, Aaron ngɔ kɛ ma somi daka a hɛ mi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ye mana a jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ya si a ya su zugba nɛ nihi ngɛ nɔ, nɛ ji Kanaan zugba a huzu nya.
(Ngɛ Hebri bi ɔmɛ a nɔ́ susumi mi ɔ, lita nyingmi enyɔ ji jua nɛ a po kɛ ha ní gbigbli).
Nyu je tɛ sa mi Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo hia kɛ je Sin nga a nɔ bɔɔ bɔɔ bɔɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Refidim; se nyu be lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma a maa nu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a pia Mose, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Ha wɔ nyu nɛ waa nu!” Mose de mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi piae?
Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yawɛ kae ɔ?” Se kuma ngɛ ma a yee, nɛ a tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si Mose, nɛ a de ke, “Mɛni he je o je wɔ kɛ je Egipt nɛ o ma ha nɛ kuma ba gbe wɔ, wa bimɛ, kɛ wa lohwehi tsuo nɛ ɔ?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose kɛ hɛdɔ fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Kɛ ma pee ma nɛ ɔ kɛɛ?
A miɔ nɛ a maa fia mi tɛ.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo nyɛɛ ma a hlami kɛ ho.
O kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ ya, nɛ o hɛɛ tso ɔ nɛ o kɛ fia Nilo pa a ngɛ o dɛ mi.
O nɛ, ma da o hɛ mi ngɛ tɛ sa a nɔ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ.
Ngɔɔ tso ɔ kɛ fia tɛ sa a, nɛ nyu maa je mi kɛ ba ha ma a nɛ a nu.” Nɛ Mose pee ja ngɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Mose wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Masa kɛ Meriba, nɛ e de ke, “I wo kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pia Yawɛ ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ka lɛ ngɛ benɛ a bi ke, ‘Anɛ Yawɛ ngɛ wa kpɛti, aloo e be?’ ɔ.” Israel kɛ Amalek hwu ta Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Refidim ɔ, Amalek bi ɔmɛ hia ta ba tua mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mose de Yoshua ke, “Moo hla nyumu ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ hwɔɔ a kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ ya hwu.
Imi lɛɛ ma ya da yoku ɔ yi mi kɛ Mawu tso ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ mi.” Yoshua pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho nɛ e kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ ya hwu.
Nɛ Mose, Aaron, kɛ Hur kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa ke Mose wo e nine nɔ pɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nine gu Amalek bi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ke e nine ba si pɛ kɛkɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ a nine bɔni Israel bi ɔmɛ a he ngɔmi.
Se Mose kɔni ba gbo, nɛ Aaron kɛ Hur ya hla tɛ ba wo sisi.
Nɔ kake da e kasa nya hiɛ, nɛ nɔ kake hu da e kasa nya hiɛ, nɛ a hɛɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ya si pu nɔ si.
Nɛ Yoshua ye Amalek bi ɔmɛ a nɔ butuu.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ngmaa nɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo womi mi nɛ e pee kaimi nɔ́.
Ha nɛ e su Yoshua kaa ma kpata Amalek bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a be mɛ kaie hu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.” Mose ma bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ e wo lɛ ke, “Yawɛ ji ye we aflangaa.” E de ngɔ piɛ he ke, “Yawɛ hɛɛ e we aflangaa a ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Yawɛ kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ maa hwu kɛ maa ya neneene!”
Yetro ba slaa Mose Mose ngatsɛ Yetro, Midian osɔfo ɔ nu níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu pee ha Mose kɛ e ma Israel ɔ he, kɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt.
Benɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ na we nɛ a ba a, Mose wo e yo Zipora blɔ kɛ ho e ngatsɛ Yetro ngɔ ya.
E kɛ e binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ ho.
A tsɛɛ nɔ kake ke Gershon; e sisi ji, “I ya to nubwɔ ngɛ ma se.” Nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Eliezer; e sisi ji “Tsaatsɛ e Mawu nɛ doo ha mi; lɛ nɛ je mi kɛ je Farao ɔ ta a nya.” Mose ngatsɛ Yetro kpaka Mose yo ɔ, kɛ e binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba nga a nɔ he nɛ Mose ba to si ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ Mawu yo ɔ he.
Nɛ e tsɔ ya de lɛ ke, “Imi, o ngatsɛ Yetro, kɛ o yo ɔ, kɛ o binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ wa ma o ngɔ.” Mose je kpo nɛ e kɛ e ngatsɛ ɔ ya kpe; e ba e he si nɛ e fua lɛ atuu.
Nɛ benɛ a nga a he ta a, a sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi.
Mose bɔ e ngatsɛ ɔ a blɔ hiami ɔ mi sanehi tsuo: níhi nɛ Yawɛ pee Farao ɔ kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ kpɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ, a blɔ hiami ɔ mi pɔtɔ kɛ dengme, kɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ je mɛ kɛ je kulaa mi.
Benɛ Yetro nu kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ pee Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e he a yi wami kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ, e bua jɔ e he nɛ e nya, nɛ e de ke, “A je Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Farao ɔ kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ yi.
Kpaako loko i ná le paa kaa Yawɛ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ kulaa; ejakaa e he ma a yi wami kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, benɛ a ngɛ mɛ nisɛ ní pee ɔ.” Mose ngatsɛ Yetro ngɔ sami bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpa komɛ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ Aaron kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba, nɛ a kɛ Mose ngatsɛ ɔ ba bla kɛ ye bɔ sami ní ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ ja Mawu.
A hla kojoli komɛ E nɔ jena a, Mose he sɛ, nɛ a kɛ ma sanehi ba e hɛ mi nɛ e kojo.
E kojo kɛ je mɔtu kɛ ya si du bubui nɛ ni ɔmɛ daa si.
Benɛ Mose ngatsɛ ɔ na níhi tsuo nɛ Mose ngɛ tsue ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ngɔ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ mo nɔ kake too o nɔ, nɛ ma a tsuo daa si ngɛ o kuɛ nɔ mɔtumɔtu kɛ ya si du bubui kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Mose he nɔ ke, “Ye ní tsumi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa ma a baa ye ngɔ ba biɔ Mawu ga womi.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi na sane ɔ, a kɛ baa ye ngɔ nɛ i hyɛɛ mi, nɛ i tsɔɔ mɛ Mawu kita amɛ, kɛ Mawu blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose ngatsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “O blɔ nya tomi ɔ piɛ bɔɔ.
Pɔ maa tɔ o kɛ ma a tsuo; ejakaa ma a tlomi ɔ jiɔ tsɔ, nɛ mo nɔ kake o be nyɛe tloomi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo bu mi tue nɛ ma wo mo ga; Mawu nɛ piɛ o he.
Moo lɛɛ moo da ma a nane mi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ o ngɔ a sane ɔmɛ kɛ ba fɔ Mawu hɛ mi.
Moo lɛɛ moo tsɔɔ mɛ Mawu mlaa amɛ, kɛ e suɔmi nya ní ɔmɛ.
Moo tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ a ba a je mi, kɛ níhi nɛ sa nɛ a peeɔ.
Se ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, o kɛ o hɛngmɛ nɛ wo ma a mi nɛ o hla nihi nɛ a nine si wa kɛ ní tsumi, nihi nɛ ye ɔ Mawu gbeye, nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ a sume nyɔ mi ní.
Ngɔɔ kikɛmɛ a nimli ngɔ to ma a nya.
Ni komɛ nɛ a hyɛ nimli nyɔngma nɔ; ni komɛ nɛ a hyɛ nimli nyingmi enuɔ nɔ; ni komɛ nɛ a hyɛ nimli lafa nɔ, konɛ ni komɛ hu nɛ a hyɛ nimli akpe nɔ.
Ha nɛ mɛɛ a pee kojoli ngɛ ma a mi.
Sanehi nɛ a he wa pe mɛ ɔ, ha a kɛ ba o hɛ mi; se sane tsɔwitsɔwihi lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ye.
Ke o pee jã a, lɛɛ a maa kpee mo kɛ tloo ma a tlomi ɔ, nɛ pɔ be mo tɔe tsɔ.
Ke o pee enɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu fa mo ɔ, lɛɛ pɔ be mo tɔe, nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya kɛ tue mi jɔmi.” Mose bu e ngatsɛ ɔ ga womi ɔ tue, nɛ e pee kaa bɔ nɛ e de lɛ ɔ. Mose hla nyumuhi nɛ a nine si wa kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e wo mɛ nikɔtɔmahi ngɛ ma a nya.
Ni komɛ hyɛɛ nimli nyɔngma nɔ, ni komɛ hyɛɛ nimli nyingmi enuɔ nɔ; ni komɛ hyɛɛ nimli lafa nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu hyɛɛ nimli akpe nɔ.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kojoɔ ma a sanehi daa be tsuaa be.
Mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a buá sane tsɔwitsɔwihi a he; se sanehi nɛ a he wa lɛɛ a kɛ baa Mose ngɔ.
Pee se ɔ, Mose wo e ngatsɛ ɔ blɔ, nɛ Yetro kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ -Nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt ɔ se nyɔhiɔ etɛne ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a je Refidim kɛ ho Sinai nga a nɔ ya, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ sisi.
Mose kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ho Mawu ngɔ ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɛ Mose ngɛ yo ɔ mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke e ya nɛ e ya de Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Yakob nina a ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ i pee Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ i kɛ he wami je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɔle pɛli nɔ nɛ nyɛ hii si ngɛ, nɛ i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba imi nitsɛ ye ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ maa bu ye gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa pee imi nitsɛ ye ma titli pe ma amɛ kulaa; ejakaa je ɔ tsuo ye nɔ́ ji mɛ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa pee ye ma klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.
Sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ, mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ.” Mose kple si kɛ ba nɛ e ba tsɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ.
Nɛ ma a tsuo he nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ, wa maa pee.” Mose kpale ya bɔ Yawɛ bɔ nɛ ma a de ɔ. Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Hyɛ, i ma o ngɔ ngɛ bɔku kpii mi, konɛ ke ma a nu nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, a he mo nɛ a ye kɛ ya neneene.” Mose ho nɛ e ya bɔ Yawɛ heto nɛ ma a ha lɛ ɔ. Nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya tsukɔ ma a he mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ hwɔɔ.
Ha nɛ a fɔ a tadehi a he, nɛ benɛ e maa su ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, a dla a he; ejakaa hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, imi Yawɛ, ma kple si kɛ ba Sinai yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na mi.
Poo piɛ kɛ bɔle yo ɔ, nɛ o wo ma a si nɛ a hyɛ saminya nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó kuɔ yo ɔ, loo e hɛ lɛ kɛ su he po.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta yo ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ!
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nine nɛ ko sa nɔ ɔ he, se mohu a fia lɛ tɛ, loo a tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃; lohwe ji lɛ jio, nɔmlɔ ji lɛ jio, e ko hi je mi.
Ke titimati ɔ pɛ wawɛɛ nɛ e se kɛ ɔ, loko ma a nɛ kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba.” Mose kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ba ma a ngɔ, nɛ e ha ni ɔmɛ tsukɔ a he, nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he.
E de ma a ke, “Nyɛ dla nyɛ he ha hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ta yo he.” Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mɔtu ɔ, a nu hiɔmi simi, oslabai gbami, kɛ titimati pɛmi wawɛɛ ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ; bɔku kpii hu wo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Sawale nu ma a tsuo ngɛ a sito he ɔ, nɛ a he kpokpo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ je sito he ɔ kɛ je kpo konɛ a kɛ Mawu nɛ ya kpe; nɛ a ho ya da si ngɛ yo ɔ sisi.
Sinai yo ɔ tsuo hyi kɛ la su ku; ejakaa Yawɛ kple si kɛ ba yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ la mi.
La su ku ɔ ngɛ si tee kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe yae kaa buɛsa he la su ku, nɛ yo ɔ tsuo mimiɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Benɛ bɛ pɛmi ɔ nya wa a, Mose tu munyu, nɛ Mawu ha lɛ heto kɛ hiɔwe simi.
Yawɛ kple si kɛ ba Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e tsɛ Mose, nɛ Mose kuɔ kɛ ho yo ɔ yi mi ya.
Nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Kple si nɛ o ya tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó de ke e ngɛ piɛ ɔ gbae kɛ ma mi hyɛmi, nɛ́ nihi babauu a hɛ mi ko ba kpata.
Jã kɛ̃, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a nyɛɔ suu ye he ɔ, mɛ hu hyɛ nɛ a tsukɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Yawɛ ko ba kpata a hɛ mi.” Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Ma a be nyɛe maa kuɔ Sinai yo ɔ; ejakaa mo nitsɛ nɛ o wo mlaa ke waa po piɛ kɛ wo he kɛ tsɔɔ kaa yo ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Kple si nɛ o ya ngɔ Aaron kɛ ba.
Se osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a lɛɛ ko ha nɛ a gba piɛ ɔ nɛ a kuɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ ma ko ba gbla a tue.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kple si nɛ e ya bɔ ma a nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ.
Mlaa nyɔngma amɛ Mawu tu munyu, nɛ e de ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ.
“Ko ja mawu ko kɛ piɛ ye he.
“Koo puɛ amaga, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ nyu mi ngɛ zugba a sisi.
Ko kpla si ha mɛ, nɛ ko ja mɛ hulɔ; ejakaa imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, a kɛ mi plee we nɔ́ he.
I gblaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ mi ɔ, kɛ a bimɛ, kɛ a bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ yaa si yi nɔ etɛne kɛ eywiɛne bimɛ a nɔ.
Se nihi akpe abɔ nɛ suɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ i naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
“Ko tsɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ biɛ yaka gu; ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he be lɛ kee.
“Mo kai Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ o ye lɛ ngɛ mumi mi he tsɔmi mi.
Ngɔɔ ligbi ekpa kɛ tsu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsumi.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ko tsu nɔ́ ko kulaa; mo nitsɛ jio, o binyumu jio, o biyo jio, o tsɔlɔ nyumu jio, o mawayo jio, o lohwe jio, nubwɔ nɛ ngɛ o ma a mi jio; ejakaa ligbi ekpa Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ pee hiɔwe, zugba, kɛ wo kɛ a mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e jɔɔ e he.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e gbaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
“Moo bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ.
“Koo gbe nɔmlɔ.
“Ko puɛ gba.
“Koo ju.
“Koo ye lakpa odase kɛ si o nyɛmi.
“O hɛ ko kɔ o nyɛmi we nɔ; o hɛ ko kɔ o nyɛmi e yo, aloo e tsɔlɔ nyumu, aloo e mawayo, aloo e na, aloo e teji, aloo e nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ.” Ma a ye gbeye Benɛ ma a tsuo nu hiɔwe simi ɔ, kɛ titimati pɛmi ɔ, nɛ a na oslabai la a, kɛ la su ku nɛ je ngɛ yo ɔ mi ɔ, a ye gbeye, nɛ a je ya da si ngɛ se banee.
Nɛ a de Mose ke, “Mo nitsɛ o kɛ wɔ nɛ tu munyu nɛ waa nu; ko ha nɛ Mawu kɛ wɔ nɛ tu munyu nɛ wa ba gbo.” Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye; kami kɛkɛ Mawu ma nyɛ kami konɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye nɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami.” Se ma a daa si ngɛ se lokoo, nɛ Mose pɛ nɛ e hɛ lɛ kɛ su diblii kpii ɔ he ngɛ he nɛ Mawu ngɛ ɔ. Bɔ sami la tɛhi a he mlaahi Yawɛ fa Mose ke e ya de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na kaa hiɔwe nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu kɛ pee mawuhi ha nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ ja kɛ piɛ ye he.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ zu kɛ puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ha mi, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ, kɛ na kɛ pee sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ngɛ nɔ.
He tsuaa he nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛ ja mi ngɛ ɔ, ma ba lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma ba gbaa nyɛ.
Ke nyɛ maa puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ha mi kɛ tɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ tɛ nɛ a gba kɛ pee; ejakaa ke nyɛ ngɔ ní tsumi dade kɛ ta tɛ ɔ he pɛ nyɛ ble tɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko pee kpoku kɛ kuɔ kɛ ya ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, konɛ a ko na nyɛ he nɛ fɔɔ si.”
Bɔ nɛ á hɛɛ nyɔguɛhi ha “Jehanɛ, mlaahi nɛ o maa wo Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ke mo nɔ ko o he Hebri no nyɔguɛ ɔ, e ma sɔmɔ mo jeha ekpa.
Jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e ye e he nɛ o ko he nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ.
Ke lɛ nɔ kake nɛ ba a, lɛ nɔ kake ɔ nɔuu nɛ kpale kɛ ho.
Se ke e kɛ e yo ba a, lɛɛ e kɛ e yo ɔ nɛ ho.
Ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha lɛ yo, nɛ e fɔ binyumuhi, loo biyihi ha lɛ ɔ, yo ɔ kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ maa pee e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ níhi; nɛ lɛ nɔ kake too e maa ho.
Se ke nyɔguɛ ɔ ha a nu sisi kaa e suɔ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, kɛ yo nɛ a ha lɛ ɔ, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be suɔe nɛ e ye e he ɔ, lɛɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba Mawu hɛ mi.
E kɛ lɛ ma ba da sinya a nya, loo sinya tso ɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ tue gbumi nɔ́ kɛ gbu e tue ha lɛ.
Kɛkɛ e ma tsa nɔ ma sɔmɔ kɛ yaa si lɛ, nyɔguɛ ɔ ma gbo.
“Ke nyumu ko jua e biyo kaa nyɔguɛ, nɛ he yemi be ɔ su ɔ, a ko ngmɛɛ e he kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ nyumu nyɔguɛhi.
Ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ to kaa e maa ngɔ lɛ ɔ sume lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e ha nɛ yo ɔ tsɛ nɛ fɔ lɛ ɔ ba kpɔ lɛ.
E be he blɔ nɛ e juaa yo ɔ kɛ haa ma se no, ejakaa e sisi lɛ.
Ke nyɔguɛtsɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha e binyumu ɔ, lɛɛ e hɛɛ lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e biyo.
Ke e binyumu nɛ ɔ ya ngɔ yo kpa kɛ piɛ nɔ kaketsɛ ɔ he ɔ, e ha kekle yo ɔ e tsu nya yo blɔ nya nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ; eko nɛ ko je nɔ.
E he bo, e nya mi ngma, kɛ e yogbayo blɔ nya nɛ ko bɔ lɛ.
Ke e pee we ní etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ yo ɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e jee faa nɛ hiɔ wowoe ko be mi.
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ awi yemi he “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa fia nɔ ko nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ɔ ma gbo ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
Ke e nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ tlukaa, se pi kaa e je blɔ pee ɔ, lɛɛ ma tsɔɔ mo he nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya.
Se ke nɔ ko mi mi fu nɛ e dɔ ya tua e nyɛmi nɛ e gbe lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ke e tu fo ya sa we ngɛ ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he po, a nu lɛ nɛ a gbe lɛ.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa fia e tsɛ, aloo e nyɛ nɔ́ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ju nɔmlɔ nɛ e maa jua, loo a maa na lɛ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
“Ke ni enyɔ pɛ, nɛ nɔ kake fia e nyɛmi tɛ, loo kɔ, nɛ nɔ ɔ tlɔ sa mi, se e gbo we ɔ, nɔ nɛ fia tɛ ɔ maa ye e he.
Ke nɔ ɔ na he wami nɛ e je kpo, nɛ e hɛɛ tso kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, nɔ nɛ fia lɛ tɛ ɔ nɛ wo nɔ ɔ be nɛ e puɛ ha lɛ ɔ kɛkɛ he hiɔ, nɛ e hyɛ nɛ e tsa lɛ kɛ pi si.
“Ke nɔ ko ngɔ tso kɛ fia e nyɔguɛ nyumu, loo yo, nɛ e gbo ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ, a gbla e tue.
Se ke e gbo we amlɔ, nɛ ligbi kake, loo ligbi enyɔ be loko e gbo ɔ, a ko gbla nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tue; ejakaa nyɔguɛ ɔ gbenɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛtsɛ ɔ sika nɛ laa.
“Ke nyumuhi ngɛ kunɔ nɔe nɛ a ya fia yohɔyo ko nɔ́ nɛ e muklii ɔ sane, se nɔ́ yobu kpa ko nyɛɛ we se ɔ, a bɔ nɔ nɛ plaa lɛ ɔ hiɔ.
Yo ɔ huno ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ hiɔ ɔ, konɛ kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ a buá he.
Se ke yo ɔ plaa a, tue gblami ɔ ji a plaa nɔ nɛ plaa lɛ ɔ kɛ to nane mi.
Ke e gbo, loo e hɛngmɛ pɛ, loo e lungu hia, loo e nine, loo e nane plaa, loo e he ko sã, loo pa ba e he, loo e he ko kpɔ ɔ, a pee nɔ ɔ ja nɔuu kɛ to nane mi.
“Ke nyumu ko fia e nyɔguɛ nyumu, loo nyɔguɛ yo hɛngmɛ nɔ́ nɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ pɛ ɔ, hɛngmɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e ngmɛɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ he nɛ e ho.
Ke e fia e nyɔguɛ nyumu, loo nyɔguɛ yo nɔ́, nɛ e lungu hia a, lungu ɔ he je ɔ, e ngmɛɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ he nɛ e ho.
Nɔtsɛmɛ a níhi a nɔ hyɛmi “Ke na si nɔ ko koli, nyumu jio, yo jio, nɛ nɔ ɔ gbo ɔ, a fia na a tɛ nɛ e gbo, se a ko ye lo ɔ; natsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛɛ e yi fɔ.
Se ke na a pɔɔ nihi koli simi, nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ natsɛ ɔ, se kɛ̃ e hyɛ we nɛ a wo na a tsu mi, nɛ e ba mi kaa e ya si nɔ ko koli nɛ e gbe nɔ ɔ, nyumu jio, yo jio, a fia na a tɛ nɛ e gbo, nɛ natsɛ ɔ hu a gbe lɛ.
Se ke a ngmɛ natsɛ ɔ blɔ kaa e kpɔ e he ɔ, lɛɛ e sa kaa e wo hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ nɛ a maa bu ha lɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ he e yi wami.
Ke na a ya gbe nɔ ko binyumu, loo biyo ɔ, a kɛ lɛ nɛ ye ngɛ kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔuu nya.
Ke na a ya gbe nyɔguɛ nyumu, loo nyɔguɛ yo ko ɔ, natsɛ ɔ nɛ wo nyɔguɛtsɛ ɔ hiɔ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ; na a nitsɛ lɛɛ a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.
“Ke nɔ ko si muɔ ngɔ fɔ si nɛ e hɛ́ nya, aloo e ya tsua muɔ nɛ e bu we nya, nɛ na, loo teji ya nɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsua muɔ ɔ nɛ wo lohwetsɛ ɔ hiɔ, konɛ e ngɔ lohwe gbogboe ɔ. Ke nɔ ko na ku ya gbe e nyɛmi na a, natsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a jua na hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, nɛ a gba sika a fiee; lohwe gbogboe ɔ hu a dla lɛ fiee.
Se ke a ná le kaa na a pɔɔ nɔ koli simi, se natsɛ ɔ hyɛ we nɛ a wo na a tsu mi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ e na nɛ ya si na koli ɔ nɛ ngɔ na hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ kɛ to na gbogboe ɔ nane mi ha e nyɛmi ɔ, konɛ lohwe gbogboe ɔ nɛ pee e nɔ.
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ nane mi tomi he -“Ke nɔ ko ya ju na nɛ e gbe, loo e jua a, a ma he lɛ na enuɔ kɛ to na kake ɔ nya; ke to ɔ, lɛɛ a ma he lɛ to eywiɛ kɛ to to kake ɔ nya.
Ke a na lohwe ɔ nɛ e ju ɔ ngɛ e dɛ hɛ ngmengmle ɔ, na jio, teji jio, to jio, lohwe kake he ɔ, e wo lohwe enyɔ nya hiɔ.
Ke nɔ́ ko be e dɛ ɔ, a jua lɛ kaa nyɔguɛ nɛ a kɛ wo nɔ́ nɛ e ju ɔ he hiɔ.
“Nyɔ mi ke a nu julɔ nɛ ngɛ we ko mi sɛe, nɛ a fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ a gbe ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbe lɛ ɔ yi fɔ kaa e gbe nɔmlɔ.
Se ke piani nɛ e ba mi ja a, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ gbe julɔ ɔ yeɔ fɔ kaa e gbe nɔmlɔ.
“Ke nɔ ko ngmɛɛ e lohwe he nɛ e ya ye ní ngɛ nɔ kpa e ngmɔ nɔ, aloo e wai abɔɔ mi ɔ, lohwetsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ e ngmɔ, loo abɔɔ mi ní nɛ hi pe kulaa kɛ to nane mi.
“Ke nɔ ko tsɔ la nɛ la a sã pú kɛ ya sɛ nɔ kpa ngmɔ mi, nɛ e sã níhi nɛ a du ɔ, kɛ ngmɔ gba a kɛ e mi níhi, kɛ ngmɔ ɔ tsuo ɔ, a maa bu ní abɔ nɛ la a puɛ ɔ nya ha nɔ nɛ tsɔ la a nɛ e wo.
“Ke nɔ ko ha e nyɛmi sika, loo ní titli komɛ si tomi nɛ a ba ju ɔ, ke a nu julɔ ɔ, hiɔ nɛ ba a, a ku kɛ bɔ he si enyɔ nɛ e wo.
Se ke a nɛ julɔ ɔ, lɛɛ a ngɔ nɔ nɛ a ha nɔ́ si tomi ɔ kɛ ba Mawu hɛ mi, loo kojoli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e ba ka kita kaa e nine tɛ e nyɛmi ɔ ní ɔmɛ a he.
“Ke na, loo teji, loo to, loo heha ní, loo nɔ́ kpa ko laa, nɛ nihi enyɔ ngɛ he plee ɔ, a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba Mawu hɛ mi.
A ti nɔ nɛ Mawu maa bu fɔ ɔ maa wo nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ he plee ɔ he hiɔ ngwɔhe enyɔ kɛ ha nɔtsɛ ɔ.
“Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e teji, loo na, loo to, loo lohwe kpa ko ngɔ ha e nyɛmi si tomi, nɛ lohwe ɔ gbo, aloo a plaa lɛ, aloo nihi ba po lohwe ɔ kɛ je nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ a ha lɛ nɔ́ si tomi ɔ nɛ ya ka Yawɛ kita ha e nyɛmi ɔ kaa e nine tɛ lohwe ɔ he.
Ke e pee ja a, kɛkɛ lɛɛ e sa nɛ lohwetsɛ ɔ nɛ kplɛɛ nɔ kaa e nyɛmi ɔ be nane mi ko nɛ e toɔ.
Se ke jumi a ju ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, lɛɛ é to nɔtsɛ ɔ nane mi.
Jehanɛ hu, ke nga mi lohwehi nɛ tsɔtslɔɔ e mi ɔ, e ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ ba ye odase.
Ke e ba ja a, kɛkɛ lɛɛ nane mi tomi ko be nɛ e maa to ha nɔtsɛ ɔ hu.
“Ke nɔ ko ya ba lohwe ngɛ e nyɛmi dɛ nɛ lohwe ɔ plaa, aloo e gbo, be mi nɛ nɔtsɛ ɔ be lejɛ ɔ, é to nɔtsɛ ɔ nane mi sisiisi.
Ke nɔtsɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a be ɔ, lɛɛ e ko to lɛ nane mi.
Ke apaa yemi lohwe ɔ, apaa hiɔwo ɔ woɔ lohwe ɔ he hiɔ.
Ní komɛ nɛ a hiɔ ɔ a he mlaahi “Ke nɔ ko mlɔɔ yomiyo ko nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ ɔ, e ya pee e he ní nɛ e ngɔ lɛ.
Se ke yomiyo ɔ tsɛ kua ke e kɛ lɛ be nyumu ɔ hae ɔ, lɛɛ bitsɛ ɔ nɛ he yo he ní peemi nya sika ngɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ puɛ e biyo ɔ dɛ.
“Yo tsuaa yo nɛ tsuɔ kunya a, a gbe lɛ.
“Nɔmlɔ nɛ e kɛ lohwe ma na yo kɛ nyumu bɔmi ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa sã bɔ kɛ ha mawu kpa ko, se pi imi Yawɛ ɔ, a kpata e hɛ mi.
“Koo pee nubwɔ yayami, nɛ koo wa lɛ yi mi; ejakaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya to nubwɔ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛ ko wa yalɔyo, aloo awusa yi mi.
Ke nyɛ wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a fo ya kɛ tsɛ mi ɔ, niinɛ, ma bu a ya fomi ɔ tue, nɛ ye mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ, nɛ ma gbe nyɛ ngɛ ta mi.
Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ maa pee yalɔyihi, nɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ maa pee awusahi.
“Ke o pa sika ha ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a ti ohiatsɛ ko nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ, mo ko he lɛ hekpa kaa sika palɔ peeɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e bo kɛ ba to mo awaba a, kpale ya ha lɛ loko pu nɛ nɔ si, ejakaa lɔ ɔ pɛ ji e heha nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ maa tsi fĩɛ; mɛni hu ngɛ e dɛ nɛ e maa ha kɛ hwɔ si?
Ke nyɛ pee we ja, nɛ e fo ya kɛ tsɛ mi ɔ, ma bu lɛ tue; ejakaa mɔbɔ nalɔ ji mi.
“Ko jɛ Mawu; nɛ koo gbiɛ o matsɛ.
“Ngɔɔ ngma, wai, kɛ oliv nu nɛ je o ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
“Ngɔɔ o bitɛte ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha mi.
Ngɔɔ o na amɛ, kɛ o to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ku ɔmɛ hu ba ha mi.
Ke a fɔ mɛ se ɔ, ha nɛ a hi a nyɛmɛ a kasa nya ligbi kpaago; ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi.
“Ye ni klɔuklɔuhi ji nyɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lohwe ko nɛ nga mi lohwehi tsɔtslɔɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; nyɛ sake ngɔ fɔ he ha gbehi.
Dami sane yemi kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da peemi “Nɔ́ nɛ o nɛ, loo o nui ɔ, ko de.
Koo piɛ dikalɔ he kɛ ye lakpa odase.
Koo nyɛɛ nihi fuu a se kɛ pee nɔ́ yaya; nɛ koo piɛ a he kɛ ye lakpa odase kɛ plɛ dami sane hɛ mi kɛ bu si.
Ko dla ohiatsɛ sane he ha lɛ ngɛ kojomi he.
“Ke o na o he nyɛlɔ e na, loo e teji nɛ laa blɔ ɔ, mo kpaka lohwe ɔ kɛ ya ha lɛ.
Ke o na o futsɛ teji nɛ tlɔ zugba kɛ e se mi tlomi nɛ jiɔ pe lɛ ɔ, koo be e he nɛ o je; mohu wa o futsɛ ɔ, konɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ te nɛ e da e nane nɔ ekohu.
“Ko plɛ ohiatsɛ sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ kojomi he.
Koo po sane ngɔ fɔ nɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ yaya ko ɔ, koo gbe lɛ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i kɛ e he be lɛ kee.
Ko he nyɔ mi ní; ejakaa nyɔ mi ní hemi yuɔ tsɔli a hɛngmɛ, nɛ a plɛɔ dali a sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si.
“Koo wa nubwɔ yi mi; nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nubwɔ si himi ngɛ ha, ejakaa nyɛ ya hi si kaa nibwɔhi ngɛ Egipt.
Jeha kpaagone ɔ kɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ “Du ní ngɛ o ngmɔ ɔ mi nɛ o kpa jeha ekpa.
Se jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ ngmɛɛ ngmɔ ɔ he nɛ e fɔ si gu nɛ e jɔɔ e he, nɛ o ko ya kpa e nɔ ní, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ma a mi ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye e nɔ ní, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, pu mi lohwehi hu nɛ a ye.
O wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ kɛ oliv abɔɔ ɔmɛ hu, mo tsu a mi ní jã kɛ̃.
“Ligbi ekpa o kɛ tsu ní ngɛ otsi mi, se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ mo ko tsu nɔ́ ko, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o na amɛ, o teji ɔmɛ, o nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ o nibwɔ ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní ha mo ɔ nɛ a jɔɔ a he.
“Nyɛɛ bu níhi tsuo nɛ imi Yawɛ, i de nyɛ ɔ tue saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ.
Nyɛ ko fa kue ha mawu kpa komɛ, nɛ a ko nu a biɛhi tete po ngɛ nyɛ nya.
Nyami ligbi ngua etɛ “Moo ye nyami be slɔɔto etɛ ha mi ngɛ jeha mi.
Kekleekle nɔ́ ji Abolokplolo nyami be.
Kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ, o maa ye nyami be nɛ ɔ daa jeha ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Abib ɔ mi; ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ o je Egipt ɔ nɛ.
O maa ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago, nɛ nɔ ko kó ba ye hɛ mi kɛ e dɛ gu.
“Nyami be enyɔne ɔ ji Ngmakpami nyami be.
Ngɔɔ níhi nɛ o du ngɛ o ngmɔ mi ɔ kekleekle yiblii kɛ ba sã bɔ kɛ ye Ngmakpami nyami be.
“Nyami be etɛne nɛ ɔ ji Gbasisihimi nyami be.
O maa ye nyami be nɛ ɔ jeha a nyagbe, benɛ o ngɛ o ngmɔ nɔ ní ɔmɛ a nya buae.
Daa jeha a, o ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba bua si etɛ ngɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ mi.
“Koo ngɔ masa nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ bɔ sami muɔ ko he kɛ ba ye hɛ mi; lohwe zɔ nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha mi nyami be ɔ, ko ha je nɛ na yi.
“Daa jeha a, ngɔɔ o zugba a nɔ kekleekle yiblii kɛ ba imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, ye we ɔ.
“Koo hoo apletsi bi ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nyu mi.
Siwohi kɛ slɔmihi “Hyɛ, i ngɛ bɔfo ko tsɔe kɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ e bu o he ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ hluu kɛ yaa si he nɛ i dla ngɔ to mo ɔ. Moo bu lɛ, nɛ o nu e gbi, nɛ o ko tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã; ejakaa imi nɛ i tsɔ lɛ, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ be nyɛ pae.
Se ke o bu lɛ tue kɛ pi si, nɛ o pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa mo ke o pee ɔ, lɛɛ i kɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ o futsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa to ní.
Ye bɔfo ɔ maa nyɛɛ o hɛ mi kɛ yaa su Amor bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Kanaan bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ tsuo a zugba a nɔ; nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Ko kpla si ha a mawu ɔmɛ; ko ja mɛ, nɛ a jami kusumi ní ɔmɛ hu koo pee.
Se mohu, o ywia a mawu ɔmɛ, nɛ o ku a wɔ titima amɛ dukuduku kɛ pue si.
O ma ja imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, nɛ ma gbaa mo kɛ nya mi ngma, kɛ nyu, nɛ o be hiɔ nue.
Yo ko mi be sanee, nɛ yo ko hu be yosa pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ma ha o wami se maa kɛ.
“Ma tsuaa ma nɛ o ma pã nɔ ɔ, ma ha sawale maa nu ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa te si kɛ wo mo ɔ, ma ha a kpɛti maa pee basabasa; nɛ ma ha o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo maa tu o nya fo.
Ma ha nɛ adodongmatsihi maa nyɛɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ a maa fie Hiv bi, Kanaan bi, kɛ Hit bi ɔmɛ kɛ je o blɔ ɔ nɔ.
I be mɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ ngɛ jeha kake mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ zugba a nɛ ko fɔ si gu, nɛ nga mi lohwehi ko ba hiɛ tsɔ ha mo.
I ma hi mɛ fie bɔɔ bɔɔ bɔɔ kɛ je o blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ nine maa su zugba a nɔ.
Ma bli o huzu ɔmɛ a mi kɛ je Wo Tsu ɔ nya kɛ ya su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya; jehanɛ hu, kɛ je nga a nɔ kɛ ya pi Yufrate pa a. Ma ngɔ zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi, nɛ o maa fie mɛ kɛ je o blɔ nɔ.
O kɛ mɛ, loo a mawu ɔmɛ ko so somi ko.
Ko ha nɛ a hi o zugba a nɔ; ke o pee ja a, a ma ha nɛ o maa pee yayami kɛ si mi; ejakaa ke o ya sɔmɔ a mawu ɔmɛ pɛ kɛkɛ lɔ ɔ plɛ pee klama nɛ a tsɔ mo.”
Somi ɔ nya sɔumi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “O kɛ Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni nyingmi kpaago nɛ kuɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ.
Be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo kɛ ma a, nyɛ kpla si nɛ nyɛ ja mi.
Mo Mose nɔ kake pɛ lɛ o hɛ mo kɛ su ye he; ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ko su ye he tsɔ.
Ma a hu nɛ ko kuɔ yo ɔ.” Mose ba nɛ e ba bɔ ma a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ, kɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ e wo ɔ. Ma a tsuo nya sɔ nɛ a de ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, wa maa pee.” Mose ngma níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ. E nɔ jena makɛ ɔ, e ya puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, nɛ e ma titima nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔ nihewi ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ a kɛ nahi ya sã sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Mose kɛ muɔ ɔ fa wo kahi a mi; nɛ fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ, e tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ somi womi ɔ, nɛ e kane kɛ ha ma a tsuo.
Ma a he nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Wa maa bu Yawɛ tue; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa wɔ ke wa pee ɔ, wa maa pee.” Jehanɛ Mose ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ fĩa ma a nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Somi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, e nya sɔumi muɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, kɛ Israel ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a na Israel Mawu ɔ. Ngɛ e nane si ɔ, a na nɔ́ ko kaa kpoku nɛ e mi tɛ̃ heii kaa hiɔwe, kaa nɔ́ nɛ tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ safiro ɔ nɛ a kɛ pee lɛ.
Israel ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ na Mawu, se mohu Mawu kpataa we a hɛ mi.
Nɛ a bla kɛ ye ní nɛ a nu ní.
Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ o ba mlɛ, nɛ ma ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a nɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngma nɛ a kɛ tsɔse ma a ngɔ ha mo.” Mose kɛ e tsɔlɔ Yoshua dla a he, konɛ a kuɔ Mawu yo ɔ. Mose de nikɔtɔma amɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ mlɛ wɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si wa maa kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.
Aaron kɛ Hur kɛ nyɛ maa hi hiɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ sane ko ɔ, e ya na mɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ bɔku ko ba ha yo ɔ nɔ.
- Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kple Sinai yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ bɔku ɔ ha yo ɔ nɔ ligbi ekpa.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, Yawɛ tsɛ Mose kɛ je bɔku ɔ mi.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, e pee mɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ yo ɔ yi mi.
Mose hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔ kɛ pia nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ.
Níhi a nya buami kɛ ha he klɔuklɔu ɔ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ba ke mi ní.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e tsui ma gbo nɔ kaa e maa ke nɔ́ ko ɔ, nyɛ he.
Nike ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pee sika tsu, sika hiɔ kɛ akɔblee; kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ, apletsi he bwɔmi, agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi, lohwe he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee, tso nɛ a tsɛɛ ke akasia, nu nɛ a kɛ woɔ kane mi, tsopa nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nɔ pɔmi nu kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via, tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ shoham, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ a kɛ maa wo tade nɛ a tsɛɛ efɔd ɔ kɛ gugue tade ɔ a he.
Ha nɛ a ma he klɔuklɔu ko ha mi, konɛ ma hi a kpɛti.
A pee sihi he nɛ ɔ kɛ e mi dlami ní ɔmɛ ngɛ henɔhi a nya pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ. Somi daka a “Ha nɛ a ngɔ akasia tso kɛ kpɛ daka mimi pɔtɛɛ ko nɛ e kami ji nine mi blimi enuɔ, e blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ, nɛ e mi kuɔmi ji nine mi blimi etɛ.
Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha daka a mi, kɛ e he tsuo, nɛ o kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko nɛ wo zã kɛ bɔle e he ɔ kulaa.
Moo pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ, nɛ o ka kɛ wo daka a nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he; ga enyɔ nɛ hi kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu nɛ hi kasa hiɛ.
Moo hlɔ akasia tsohi nɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.
Ngɔɔ tso ɔmɛ kɛ hɔ ga amɛ a mi ngɛ daka a he, nɛ́ a pɛtɛ a he kɛ hɛɛ daka a. Tso ɔmɛ nɛ a hi ga amɛ a mi daa; a ko je mɛ ngɛ a mi.
Somi womi ɔ nɛ ma ngɔ ha mo ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ wo daka a mi.
“Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee daka a nya nɔ́ nɛ e kami ji nine mi blimi enuɔ, nɛ e mi blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ.
Ngɔɔ sika tsu nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee bɔfohi nɛ a tsɛɛ kerub ɔ enyɔ kɛ ma nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ daka a kami mi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Kerub kake nɛ hi hiɛ, nɛ kake hu nɛ hi hiɛ.
Moo pee kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɛ tsa.
Kerub ɔmɛ nɛ a gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi kɛ ya hiɔwe nɛ a kɛ ha daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ he.
A plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee a sibi, nɛ a hi nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ hyɛe.
Ngɔɔ somi womi ɔ nɛ ma ha mo ɔ kɛ wo daka a mi, nɛ o ngɔ nya nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ bu nya.
Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ mo maa kpe ngɛ; nɛ mlaahi tsuo nɛ ma wo Israel ma a kɛ gu o nɔ ɔ, ma da kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛ kɛ de mo.
Okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu we abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ maa ma nɔ ɔ “Ngɔɔ akasia tso nɛ o kɛ kpɛ okplɔɔ; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi eywiɛ, e blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e si temi nɛ pee nine mi blimi etɛ.
Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha he, nɛ o ngɔ sika tsu ɔ eko kɛ wo e nya amɛ kɛ kpe.
Moo pee kla maa pee dɛ mi blimi kake kɛ wo okplɔɔ ɔ he kɛ kpe.
Ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle kla a. Moo pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ ngɔ mɛtɛ okplɔɔ ɔ nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ.
Ga amɛ nɛ a maa ngɔ tso ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ ngɔ hɔ a mi ɔ, a hi tso kla a kasa nya tutuutu.
Moo hlɔ akasia tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.
Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee plɛɛtehi kɛ kahi nɛ a kɛ maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ kpluhi, kɛ likɔkɔhi nɛ a kɛ maa sã wai bɔ.
Nɛ o ngɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa ma ye hɛ mi daa a kɛ ma okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ.
Kane tso ɔ “Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee kane tso.
Kane tso ɔ sisi je kɛ e kpɛti tso ɔ lɛɛ ngɔɔ sika tsu nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee.
Moo pee mɔmɔhi: ní nɛmɛ nɛ blɛkee we lolo, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ blɛke, nɛ a kɛ kane tso ɔ nɛ tsa mluguduu kake.
Kɔni ekpa nɛ hi kane tso ɔ he; etɛ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, kɛ etɛ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ.
Kane tso ɔ he kɔni ekpa amɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ etɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ nɛ hi eko tsuaa eko nɔ.
Kpɛti kane tso ɔ lɛɛ mɔmɔ eywiɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ nɛ hi nɔ.
Kane tso tso gblaa etɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ kpɔ nɛ hi kɔni enyɔɔnyɔ ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ a sisi tutuutu.
Kpɔ ɔmɛ, tso gblaa amɛ, kɛ kpɛti kane tso ɔ tsuo nɛ tsa; a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee lɛ tsuo.
Jehanɛ, moo pee kane kpaago kɛ ma kane tso ɔ nɔ, konɛ a la a nɛ kpɛ kɛ ya hlami.
Kane ɔ sumi kɛ e gbemi nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa muɔ la zu ɔ hu a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee.
A ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ e jiimi peeɔ kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ pee kane tso ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Hyɛ nɛ o pee mɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔhi nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔɔe ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.
Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ “Jehanɛ, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, ngɔɔ bo popoe nyɔngma kɛ pee; a ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo bo nɛ ɔ, nɛ a kadi kerub saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi.
Bo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a sɔ fiee; bo kake kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ekpa, nɛ e blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ.
Moo kpɛ bo ɔ enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ o kpɛ enuɔ kpa amɛ hu ja nɔuu.
Bo enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tsa a; ngɔɔ kpa bluu kɛ pee gahi kɛ wo a nyagbe nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake he; bo kaketsɛ ɔ hu o pee lɛ ja nɔuu.
Bo ga nyingmi enuɔ nɛ hi bo kake nɛ ɔ nya, nɛ nyingmi enuɔ nɛ hi bo kaketsɛ ɔ hu nya; ga amɛ tsuo nɛ a nyɛɛ a sibi a hanɔ.
Moo pee sika tsu gbowe nyingmi enuɔ, nɛ o kɛ gbowe ɔmɛ nɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ a mi, konɛ bo ɔ tsuo nɛ pee bo tsu mluku kake.
“Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ apletsi he bwɔmi kɛ lo bo nyɔngma kɛ kake, nɛ o kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ pee heha nɔ́ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ. Bo ɔ kake kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi ekpa; e blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ.
Bo nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ ɔ, eko tsuaa eko kɛ e nyɛmi nɛ sɔ fiee.
Moo kpɛ bo ɔ enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ o kpɛ ekpa nɛ piɛ ɔ hu kɛ tsa a sibi a nya.
Bo ekpane ɔ nɛ maa ha bo tsu ɔ nya a lɛɛ dɔɔ mi enyɔ.
Bo enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tsa a, moo pee ga nyingmi enuɔ kɛ wo nyagbe nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake he; ekpane ɔ hu o pee lɛ ja nɔuu.
Moo pee akɔblee gbowe nyingmi enuɔ, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ kɛ la ga amɛ a mi, konɛ bo enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee heha nɔ́ kake.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he hami bo fa a nɛ piɛ ngɛ se ɔ, ha nɛ e kpla si ngɛ bo tsu ɔ se je.
Jehanɛ, kpe he bo tsu ɔ he bo ɔ nine mi blimi enyɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ e kami mi kasa kake nɛ ɔ, kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ hu nɛ piɛ ngɛ kasa kpa a, e kpla si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛ e kɛ ha tsu ɔ nya.
“Jehanɛ, o maa kpɛ bo kpa enyɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ he; ngɔɔ agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi kɛ pee kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ pee enyɔne ɔ.
“Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee sima tso ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ. Sima tso kake kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ, e blimi hu nɛ pee nine mi blimi etɛ.
Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ he sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a pee nane enyɔ kɛ wo sima tso tsuaa sima tso he, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a kɛ sima tso ɔmɛ nɛ tsa a sibi a nya.
Moo ma sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ leneyi je, nɛ o pee sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ wo sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ a sisi; nɔ dami nɔ enyɔ nɛ hi sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi kɛ ha nane enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ we omleyi je ɔ, sima tso nyingmi enyɔ nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ, kɛ mɛ hu a sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ; nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ se ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, sima tso ekpa nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ, konɛ o ma sima tso kpa enyɔ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɔ nya amɛ nɛ ngɛ se je ɔ. Kɔ nya sima tso nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsa mɛ ngɛ yi kpɛti ɔ ngɛ kekleekle ga a he; sisi ɔ lɛɛ a ko ngɔ kɛ tsa.
A pee kɔ nya sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o maa pee sima tso kpaanyɔ kɛ sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyɔngma kɛ ekpa: sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ maa hi sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi.
“Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee mani womi tso nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ: enuɔ ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa hiɛ, enuɔ ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa hiɛ, kɛ enuɔ hu ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ se, ngɛ bonyoku je.
Mani ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sima tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ lɛɛ e fɔ si kɛ je kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa kake kɛ ya si kasa kake.
Ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ ha sima tso ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o pee sika tsu gahi kɛ wo a he, konɛ a kɛ mani ɔmɛ nɛ hɔɔ a mi.
Mani ɔmɛ nitsɛ hu, ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.
O pee kpe he bo tsu nɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.
“Tsu mi pomi bo ɔ, moo gbɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, nɛ a kɛ lo, nɛ á je blɔ nɛ a kadi kerub saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi.
Ngɔɔ kɛ kpla akasia tso eywiɛ a he; tso nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu gbowe nɛ kɔ a nya loko a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ma sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ngɔɔ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ kɛ bɛ gbowe ɔmɛ a nya kɛ kpla si, nɛ o ngɔ daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ ba ma e se blɔ, konɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ po he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a kpɛti ha nyɛ.
Daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, ngɔɔ e nya nɔ́ ɔ kɛ bu daka a nya ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. Ngɔɔ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ ma tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ we omleyi je, konɛ kane tso ɔ lɛɛ e ya je leneyi je, ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ hanɔ tutuutu.
“Kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ, ngɔɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo; nɛ a kɛ abui nɛ kadi ní kɛ wo mi.
Ngɔɔ akasia tso enuɔ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ha a he, kɛ a nya sika tsu gbowehi, nɛ o kɛ pee titimahi ha tsu nya bo ɔ. Jehanɛ hu, moo sɔ̃ akɔblee nɔ dami nɔ́ enuɔ ha tso ɔmɛ.
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ “Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee bɔ sami la tɛ.
E hi kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyɔngma, e blimi nine mi blimi nyɔngma, kɛ e si temi nine mi blimi ekpa.
Moo pee kolihi ngɛ e kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ tsa.
A ngɔ akɔblee kɛ ha he.
Moo pee e he ngɛyuhi nɛ a kɛ muɔ la zu, sofihi, kahi, gbowehi, kɛ la jemi ngɛyuhi.
Ngɔɔ akɔblee kɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ akɔblee nɛ o kɛ lo ya kɛ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Moo pee akɔblee ga eywiɛ kɛ wo ya a kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ.
Ngɔɔ ya a kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ e sisi je, konɛ e hiɔwe yami nɛ ya ta bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu.
Moo hlɔ akasia tso komɛ nɛ o kɛ akɔblee nɛ ha a he.
Á kɛ tso ɔmɛ nɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ a mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa enyɔ ɔmɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛ a kɛ hɛɛ lɛ.
Ngɔɔ gbegbeli kɛ kpɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ; nɛ o ha blɔ nɛ hi mi kaa bɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he piɛ ɔ “Jehanɛ moo po piɛ kɛ wo kpe he bo tsu ɔ he.
Bo nɛ a kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ lo nɛ hi piɛ ɔ leneyi je; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ.
Akɔblee titima nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ nɛ hi piɛ ɔ he; se e he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ pee mɛ.
Ja nɔuu bo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ we omleyi je ɔ, a kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ.
Mɛ hu a hi akɔblee titima nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ a nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ; nɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ hu a kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ pee mɛ.
Bo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ bonyoku je ɔ, a blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa, kɛ a he titima nyɔngma, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyɔngma.
Ja nɔuu piɛ ɔ he nɛ kpee beleku je ɔ, e blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa.
Tsu nya bohi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya kasa kake ɔ, a kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ, kɛ a he titima etɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ etɛ.
Kasa kake ɔ hu tsu nya bohi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ. Mɛ hu a kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ ɔ kɛ̃, kɛ a he titima etɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ etɛ.
Piɛ ɔ nya nitsɛ nya bo ɔ lɛɛ e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi eywiɛ.
Á ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo; nɛ a kɛ abui nɛ kadi ní saminyayoo ngɔ wo mi.
Titima eywiɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ nɛ hi he.
Titima amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle piɛ ɔ kɛ kpe ɔ, a pee akɔblee nɔ dami nɔ́ kɛ ha mɛ.
Jehanɛ, a kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ pee a mani womi tso ɔmɛ, nɛ a pee sika hiɔ gbowehi kɛ wo a he.
Piɛ ɔ kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ, e blimi nine mi blimi lafa, kɛ e si temi nine mi blimi nyɔngma.
Bo ɔmɛ nɛ a pee bo kpakpahi; nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ hu a kɛ akɔblee nɛ pee.
Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ piɛ ɔ hu he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, a ngɔ akɔblee kɛ pee.
Kane ɔ nɔ hyɛmi “Fa Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ha mo oliv nu kpakpa nɛ mi tsɔ ngleinglei nɛ o kɛ wo kane ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a su kane ɔ daa.
Aaron kɛ kane ɔ nɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ haa somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi.
Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a hyɛ kane ɔ nɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi daa kɛ je gbɔkuɛ kɛ yaa si mɔtu.
Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a nina tsuo.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tadehi “Moo tsɔ ya ngɔ o nyɛminyumu Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ji Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar kɛ ba.
Mo ha nɛ a tsɔ a he kɛ je Israel bi kpa amɛ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ba sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.
Moo kpɛ osɔfo tadehi ha o nyɛminyumu Aaron nɛ sa lɛ saminyayoo, nɛ bu nɛ ba e he.
Mo tsɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i kɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi dloo mɛ ɔ, nɛ o ha a kpɛ Aaron tade ɔmɛ kɛ pee lɛ klɔuklɔu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ye osɔfo kɛ sɔmɔ mi.
Tadehi nɛ á kpɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: gugue tade, efɔd, tade klɔii, hiɔwe tade nɛ a lo, pɛɛ, kɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́.
Á kpɛ tade klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha o nyɛminyumu Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.
Níhi nɛ a maa ngɔ kɛ kpɛ tade ɔmɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ.
“Efɔd ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ a maa ngɔ kɛ pee lɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ, nɛ a kadi ní wo mi.
A pee konɔ kpa enyɔ kɛ wo he, nɛ́ a nyɛ kɛ muɔ lɛ ngɛ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo.
Mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hu, a je blɔ nɛ a lo lɛ kɛ tsa efɔd ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a ga a, kɛ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ nɔuu nɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ ɔ. Yaa hla shoham tɛ enyɔ, nɛ o ngma Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ a nɔ ngɛ a fɔmi nya; biɛ ekpa ngɛ tɛ kake nɔ, kɛ ekpa nɛ piɛ ɔ hu ngɛ tɛ kpa nɔ.
Mo kpɛ́ Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june he ní tsulɔ peeɔ ɔ, nɛ o sile sika tsu kɛ bɔle tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ kpe.
Jehanɛ, moo fi tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he, konɛ a pee tɛhi nɛ a kɛ ma kai Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ; Aaron ma kpla biɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e konɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kai ye ma a daa.
Moo pee sika tsu he bɔlemi nɔ́ enyɔ, kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ nɛ a tslɔ mɛ kaa kpa.
Ngɔɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ kpa amɛ kɛ la he bɔlemi ní ɔmɛ a mi.
Gugue tade ɔ “Gugue tade ɔ nɛ a kɛ leɔ ye yi mi ɔ, moo pee lɛ ngɛ ga mi; bɔ nɛ o pee efɔd ɔ, ja nɔuu o pee lɛ.
Níhi nɛ ó ngɔ kɛ pee enɛ ɔ hu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ.
A dɔ gugue tade ɔ mi enyɔ, nɛ a pee lɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi kake, nɛ e blimi hu nɛ pee nine mi blimi kake.
Moo ma tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ wo zã eywiɛ mi; zã tsuaa zã a, tɛ etɛ nɛ hi mi.
Kekleekle zã a mi tɛ ɔmɛ ji sardio, topasion, kɛ smaragdo.
Zã nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji karfungkle, safiro, kɛ sardoniki.
Zã etɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji hiakinto, agate, kɛ ametisto.
Zã eywiɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji krisolito, shoham, kɛ yaspi.
A sile sika tsu kɛ bɔle tɛ ɔmɛ.
Tɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a pee nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ; nɛ Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi nɛ hi a nɔ kakaaka.
Wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, a kpɛ́ eko tsuaa eko biɛ ngɛ tɛ kake nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ ɔ. Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ a tslɔ kaa kpa kɛ wo gugue tade ɔ he.
Moo pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ wo gugue tade ɔ hiɔwe kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a he, konɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ hɔɔ sika tsu ga enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tslɔ kaa kpa a, mɛ hu a nya enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ la nɔ́ mi hɔmi nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ o fi kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he ngɛ hɛ mi.
Moo pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ wo gugue tade ɔ kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi mi je ngɛ efɔd ɔ kasa nya.
Jehanɛ, moo pee sika tsu ga kpa enyɔ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ kɔni enyɔ kpa amɛ a nya ngɛ sisi blɔ, kɛ yaa e hɛ mi ngɛ tsami he kake ɔ hanɔ, ngɛ efɔd mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a lo saminyayoo ɔ yi mi.
Ngɔɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi gugue tade ɔ he ga amɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he ga amɛ a he ngɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe je, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gugue tade ɔ nɛ ko kpɔ kɛ je efɔd ɔ he.
“Be tsuaa be nɛ Aaron ma ya sɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, e hɛɛ Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ kojomi gugue tade ɔ mi ngɛ e tsui nya; konɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kɛ kai ye ma a daa.
Ngɔɔ ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ leɔ ye yi mi, nɛ a tsɛɛ Urim kɛ Tumim ɔ kɛ wo gugue tade ɔ mi, nɛ Aaron nɛ hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ e gugue nya be tsuaa be nɛ e ma ye hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, daa be tsuaa be ke Aaron ma he klɔuklɔu ɔ, níhi nɛ ma gu nɔ kɛ je ye yi mi tomi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e hɛɛ mɛ momo ngɛ e gugue nya.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tade kpahi “Tade klɔii ɔ nɛ a woɔ ngɛ efɔd ɔ sisi ɔ, a lo lɛ kɛ kpa bluu sɔuu.
A je kuɛ mi puɔ ngɛ he, nɛ a fia nya nɛ e ti kɛ kpe, konɛ e ko hía.
-A ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo ní kloohi kaa tso yiblii nɛ a ma kɛ wo tade ɔ nya fiami ɔ mi, konɛ sika tsu ngmlɛhi nɛ hɔɔ tso yiblii ɔmɛ a mi kɛ kpe.
Ke sika tsu ngmlɛ kake ba, kɛkɛ nɔ́ kokloo kaa tso yiblii ɔ hu kake ba, ja sɔuu kɛ bɔle tade klɔii ɔ nya fiami ɔ mi.
Ke Aaron ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, e wo tade nɛ ɔ, konɛ a nu ngmlɛ ɔmɛ a pɛmi be mi nɛ e ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ sɛe kɛ ba ye hɛ mi, kɛ be mi nɛ e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ sie konɛ e ko gbo.
“Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee dade pɛtɛpɛtɛ, nɛ o ngma ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june he ní tsulɔ ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ ɔ ke, ‘Klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ.’ Ngɔɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi lɛ kɛ wo pɛɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
E hi Aaron hɛ nya daa, kɛkɛ ɔ, ke Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ a nike ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha mi, nɛ tɔmi ko ba ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi mi po ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i be nike ní ɔmɛ kuae, se mohu ma ngɔ.
“Hiɔwe tade ɔ, a ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ lo, nɛ a kadi ní kɛ wo mi.
Pɛɛ ɔ hu ngɔɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa a nɔuu kɛ kpɛ, konɛ a lo ní kɛ wo mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ mi.
“Jehanɛ, Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ hu o kpɛ hiɔwe tadehi, kɛ mi mi fimi níhi, kɛ pɛɛhi ha mɛ nɛ e sa mɛ, nɛ bu nɛ hi a he.
Ngɔɔ tade nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo o nyɛminyumu Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ o pɔ mɛ nu, nɛ o wo mɛ osɔfo, nɛ o tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.
Ngɔɔ bo nɛ a ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ lo kɛ kpɛ fiɔ mi tade ha mɛ, nɛ a wo kɛ ha a he kɛ je a mlɛ mi kɛ yaa si a fiɔ mi.
Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a wo fiɔ mi tade nɛ ɔmɛ be tsuaa be nɛ a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, aloo ke a ma sɔmɔmi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ke pi ja a, musu maa tloo mɛ nɛ a ma gbo.
Enɛ ɔ nɛ pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ ha Aaron kɛ e weku kɛ nina.
Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a we osɔfo womi “Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ó pee nɛ o kɛ tsukɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a he nɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa ye we osɔfohi.
Ngɔɔ na niheyo kake, kɛ agbosu enyɔ nɛ kpa be a he.
Ngɔɔ ngma mamu nɛ masa be mi kɛ pee nɔ́ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ: abolo kplolo nɛ zɔ ngɛ mi, abolo kplolo nɛ a wui mi zɔ, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ nu kpa hɛ mi, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo kusii mi nɛ o hɛɛ kɛ ba, kɛ na a, kɛ agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ.
“Ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ o ngɔ nyu kɛ du a he ha mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wo tade ɔmɛ ha Aaron; hiɔwe tade ɔ, tade klɔii ɔ nɛ ngɛ efɔd ɔ nɔ ɔ, efɔd ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ gugue tade ɔmɛ, konɛ o ngɔ efɔd ɔ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a je blɔ lo lɛ saminyayoo ɔ kɛ fi e mlɛ mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ, bu lɛ pɛɛ ɔ, nɛ o fi jlasi klɔuklɔu kɛ wo pɛɛ ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, plɛ nu nɛ a kɛ pɔɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ pue e yi mi, nɛ o kɛ pɔ lɛ nu.
“Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ o ba wo mɛ hiɔwe tadehi.
Fi mlɛ mi fimi níhi kɛ wo a mlɛ mi, nɛ o bu mɛ pɛɛ.
