Bɔ nɛ o maa wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ osɔfo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, osɔfo ní tsumi ɔ maa pee a nɔ́; nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene.
Osɔfo womi bɔ samihi “Ngɔɔ na ku ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo gbe na ku ɔ ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi, ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Ngɔɔ na muɔ ɔ eko nɛ o ngɔ o nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ mi nɛ o kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, mo plɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.
Jehanɛ, mo je zɔ nɛ ha mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ko ɔ, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ zɔ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ; nɛ o sã enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Se na lo ɔ, e he womi ɔ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ lɛɛ o sã ngɛ sito he ɔ se; ejakaa bɔ nɛ a sãã kɛ jeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a he yayami ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
“Jehanɛ, yaa nu agbosu ɔ kake, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo gbe to ɔ, nɛ o tsɛ̃ e muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Moo po to ɔ mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ o fɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e se nane ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o kɛ pue e yi ɔ, kɛ lo kpɔ nya kpɔ nya amɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo sã to ɔ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.
“Jehanɛ, yaa nu agbosu kaketsɛ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo gbe to ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo ɔmɛ, a hiɔ nine gɔleku ɔmɛ, kɛ a hiɔ nane gɔleku ɔmɛ a he.
Muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ mo kpa kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ngɔɔ muɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ eko, kɛ nu nɛ a kɛ pɔɔ nɔ ɔ hu eko, nɛ o fĩa kɛ pue Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ maa pee Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ tsuo klɔuklɔu ha mi.
“Akɛnɛ osɔfo womi bɔ sami to ji agbosu ɔ he je ɔ, mo je e he zɔ ɔ, e hlemi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ, kɛ zɔ nɛ ha e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ha e ko ɔ he ɔ, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ e hiɔ fiɔ ɔ. Yaa ngɔ abolo mamɛ kake nɛ a futu mi nu, abolo mamɛ kake nɛ a futuu we mi nu, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ kake ngɛ kusii ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ woɔ mi kɛ maa si ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi daa a mi.
Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ a fɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ ye hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsukɔ a he kɛ ha imi Yawɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, hé ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ o sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ piɛ sami bɔ ɔ he.
E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via, nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.
“Jehanɛ, agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ kɛ wo Aaron osɔfo ɔ, o je e gugue, nɛ o fɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsukɔ he kɛ ha mi.
Lohwe ɔ gugue ɔ maa pee mo hu o blɔ nya nɔ́.
“Ke a wo nɔ ko osɔfo ɔ, agbosu nɛ a kɛ tsu ní ɔ, a tsukɔ e gugue ɔ, kɛ e fiɔ ɔ he kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ ha mi, nɛ a kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ kaa a blɔ nya ní.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a blɔ nya ní; ejakaa e ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene kaa ke Israel bi ɔmɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ, lohwe ɔ gugue, kɛ e fiɔ ɔ nɛ pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́.
Enɛ ɔ ji nike ní nɛ ma a kɛ ba ke Yawɛ.
“Ke Aaron gbo ɔ, a pɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ nu nɛ a wo mɛ osɔfo, nɛ a ngɔ e tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mɛ nɛ a wo.
Aaron binyumu nɛ maa ye osɔfo ngɛ e tsɛ se, nɔ nɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ e ya sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, e wo tade ɔmɛ ligbi kpaago.
“Osɔfo womi bɔ sami agbosu ɔ, moo hoo lo ɔ ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ye lo ɔ, kɛ niye ní ɔ nɛ ngɛ kusii ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a. Mɛ pɛ lɛ á ye osɔfo womi kusumi kpatami ní nɛ ɔ; nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ ɔ, e ko ye eko, ejakaa e ji ní klɔuklɔu.
Ke osɔfo womi bɔ sami lo ɔ, aloo abolo ɔ eko piɛ nɛ je na yi ɔ, sãã; a ko ye ejakaa e ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu.
“Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a osɔfo womi kusumi ɔ, moo pee lɛ ligbi kpaago kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Daa ligbi ɔ, o maa ngɔ na ku kake kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ha yayami pami.
Enɛ ɔ maa tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ́ e pee klɔuklɔu.
Moo pee enɛ ɔ daa ligbi kɛ yaa su ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ, aloo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa sa he ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Daa ligbi bɔ sami “Jehanɛ ɔ, daa ligbi ɔ, o maa ngɔ jijɔ enyɔ nɛ ye jeha kakaaka kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ngɔɔ jijɔ kake kɛ sã bɔ mɔtu, nɛ o kɛ kake hu nɛ sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ.
Ngɔɔ ngma mamu tsimi kake nɛ o kɛ nu nɛ a si tɔ kake futu mi ɔ kɛ piɛ kekleekle jijɔ ɔ he nɛ o kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, konɛ o ngɔ wai tɔ kake kɛ sã wai bɔ.
Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ jijɔ enyɔne ɔ kɛ sã bɔ, konɛ o ngɔ mamu kɛ wai nɛ a kɛ maa sã wai bɔ ɔ hu kɛ piɛ he kaa mɔtu nɔ́ ɔ kɛ̃.
E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.
Kikɛmɛ a sami bɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ pee bɔ ko nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa sã daa ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.
Lejɛ ɔ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu ngɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a maa kpe ngɛ, nɛ ye hɛ mi nyami kpɛmi maa pee lejɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu.
Ma tsukɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ hu ma tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.
Ma hi Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ ma pee a Mawu.
A ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, konɛ ma hi a kpɛti.
Imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ “Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee bɔ sami la tɛ, nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ.
A pee la tɛ ɔ nɛ e hi kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi enyɔ, e blimi hu nine mi blimi enyɔ, kɛ e si temi nine mi blimi eywiɛ.
E kɛ e koli ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ tsa.
Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha e he tsuo: e yi mi, e kasa nya amɛ, kɛ e koli ɔmɛ, nɛ o kɛ sika tsu ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Moo pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ wo he ngɛ sika tsu zã a sisi.
Tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ la tɛ ɔ, a kɛ hɔɔ ga nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Ga enyɔ nɛ hi kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu nɛ hi kasa hiɛ ngɛ a sibi a hanɔ.
Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ hlɔ tso nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.
Ngɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ma tsu mi pomi bo ɔ se ngɛ daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi.
Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ngɛ.
Daa mɔtu ke Aaron ma kane ɔmɛ a he ní tsumi ɔ, e sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ.
Daa gbɔkuɛ hu ke e ma kane ɔmɛ sumi ɔ, e pee ja nɔuu.
A sã tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ daa ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ yi nɔ tsuaa yi nɔ.
Nyɛ ko sã tsopa kɛ e he via kpa ko, aloo sami bɔ, aloo niye ní bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ; nyɛ ko sã wai bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Daa jeha a, Aaron nɛ pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, e ngɔ e muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli eywiɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ daa jeha, yi nɔ tsuaa yi nɔ.
Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ.” Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he tó tsumi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ke o kane Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ o na a hiɛmi ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e klaa kɛ ba ha mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kó ba sɛ a kpɛti be mi nɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kanee.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a maa kane lɛ ɔ, e maa wo hiɔ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a po fɔ si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa wo hiɔ nɛ ɔ kaa nike ní ko nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha imi Yawɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa a, ke a kane lɛ pɛ e ngɔ nike ní nɛ ɔ ba ha mi.
Ke nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ klaa kpɔmi hiɔwo nike ní nɛ ɔ kɛ ma imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi ɔ, ohiatsɛ kɛ niatsɛ tsuo nɛ a wo kaa bɔ nɛ a po fɔ si ɔ; ohiatsɛ nɛ ko ha fa, nɛ niatsɛ hu nɛ ko ha kɛ be nɔ.
Mo he sika nɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ o kɛ wo kpe he bo tsu ɔ sɔmɔmi kpɛɛ ɔ mi.
Tó nɛ ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma kpɔ a klaa, konɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kai nɛ ma bu a he.” Akɔblee kã a Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo pee akɔblee kã kɛ e sisi akɔblee kla.
Ngɔɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ o yɛ nyu kɛ wo mi.
-Ke Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a ngɔ nyu ɔ kɛ fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he, konɛ a ko gbo.
Ja nɔuu a fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he loko a ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he nɛ a ya sã bɔ ha imi Yawɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko gbo.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha Aaron kɛ e nina kɛ yaa neneene.” Nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ Yawɛ de Mose ekohu ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya hla tsopa kɛ e he via kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ: mire nyu kilo ekpa, sinamon nɛ jeɔ via ja hiɛmi fa, nɛ ji kilo etɛ, kalamo nɛ jeɔ via kilo etɛ, kasia kilo ekpa, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngmɛɛ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ, kɛ oliv nu lita eywiɛ.
Ngɔɔ tsopa nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu, nɛ e hi kaa nɔ́ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via he ní tsulɔ nitsɛ pee.
E maa pee nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu.
Ngɔɔ nu nɛ ɔ kɛ pɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kane tso ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ, la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ, la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ nyu kã a kɛ e sisi kla a. Moo tsukɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa pee klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ, aloo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa sa a he ɔ hu maa pee klɔuklɔu.
Jehanɛ moo pɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nu, nɛ o tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.
Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Enɛ ɔ maa pee ye nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu nɛ a kɛ ma tsu kusumi ní yi nɔ tsuaa yi nɔ.
A ko ngɔ kɛ pɔ nɔ saisaa, nɛ a ko pee nu ɔ ekpa ko nɛ ngɛ kaa jã kɛ̃.
E ji nɔ klɔuklɔu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ e hi klɔuklɔu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee nu ɔ eko nɛ ngɛ kaa lɔ ɔ, aloo nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ nu nɛ ɔ eko kɛ pɔ nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ ɔ, á je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.’ ” Tsopa kɛ e he via a Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo ngmɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a jiimi nɛ pee fiee: stakte, onitsa, galbanum, kɛ mimɛ ngmingmiingmi.
Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee tsopa kɛ e he via kpakpa.
E hi kaa nɔ́ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via he ní tsulɔ nitsɛ pee, nɛ o ngɔ ngo kɛ wo mi, konɛ e mi nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e pee klɔuklɔu.
Moo wɛɛ eko nɛ e pee bukɔbukɔ kaa mamu, nɛ o ngɔ eko kɛ ya ma daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hɛɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ kaa nɔ́ ko klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ.
Tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ nyɛ maa pee nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko hyɛ bɔ nɛ a futu ní ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ pee eko ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kaa e ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee nu nɛ ɔ eko nɛ e ma kpa a, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.”
Ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Hyɛ, i je blɔ hla Uri binyumu Bezalel, Hur bibi ɔ kɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ i ngɔ mumi mi nike ní babauu ngɔ ha lɛ.
I dloo lɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi, kɛ nile ha ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo, bɔ nɛ e nyɛɔ nɛ e ngɔɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ akɔblee kɛ peeɔ ga níhi; nɛ e nine nya da kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa a he ní tsumi, tso hlɔmi, kɛ ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tsumi.
Nɛ hyɛ, i hla Ahisamak bi Oholiab kɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi, konɛ e piɛ e he kɛ tsu ní ɔ. Jehanɛ, gali kpa amɛ hu i dloo mɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi klɛdɛɛ, konɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i fa mo ke o pee ɔ, a nyɛ nɛ a pee: kpe he bo tsu ɔ, daka a nɛ a kɛ somi womi ɔ maa wo mi ɔ kɛ e nya nɔ́ ɔ, bo tsu ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ, kane tso ɔ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, nyu kã a kɛ e sisi kla a, osɔfo tade saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa wo be mi nɛ a ngɛ osɔfo ní tsumi tsue ɔ, nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha he klɔuklɔu ɔ.
A pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ.” Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he mlaahi Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e fa lɛ nɛ e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ye ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ; ejakaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ ji neneene somi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti ɔ he okadi, konɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi Yawɛ, lɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ pee ye ma.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, ejakaa e ji ligbi klɔuklɔu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ble Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a gbe lɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu ní Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a je jamɛ a nɔ ɔ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Ligbi ekpa a kɛ tsu ní; se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ e ji imi Yawɛ, ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ a nina tsuo kaa somi ɔ he okadi.
E ji okadi ngɛ i kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ wa kpɛti kɛ yaa neneene; ejakaa imi Yawɛ, i ngɔ ligbi ekpa kɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, i kpa ní tsumi, nɛ i jɔɔ ye he.” Benɛ Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu gbe nya ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ha Mose.
Sika tsu na bi ɔ Benɛ ma a na kaa Mose se ya fia si ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kple we si kɛ bɛ ɔ, ma a bua a he nya kɛ ba na Aaron, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa li sane nɛ ya ba e nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo pee mawu ha wɔ nɛ e nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi.” Aaron de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je sika tsu tue nya ní ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ a tue mi kɛ ba ha mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo je sika tsu tue nya ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a tue mi, nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba ha Aaron.
E he tue nya ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ nɛ e sile, nɛ e plɛ sika tsu nyu ɔ kɛ wo tso nɛ a kpɛ́ mi, nɛ e kɛ pee sika tsu na bi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a de ke, “Israel, o mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Benɛ Aaron na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ sika tsu na bi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e fiɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ ɔ, a maa ye nyami ligbi ha Yawɛ.” E nɔ jena makɛ mla a, ma a te si nɛ a sã sami bɔhi, nɛ a kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi hu ba.
Ma a pue si, nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu ní; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmihi.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo kple si esɔesɔ; ejakaa o ma nɛ ji ni ɔmɛ nɛ o kpaka kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba a, a ble a he.
Blɔ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a nyɛɛ nɔ ɔ, a gba kɛ je nɔ momo; a puɛ na bi amaga nɛ a ja lɛ, nɛ a sã bɔ ha lɛ nɛ a de ke, ‘Israel, o mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ ” Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e de Mose ke, “I kpa si nɛ i na kaa ma nɛ ɔ ji nimli komɛ nɛ a kuɛ wa saminya!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hɛ mo kɛ ya se; i kɛ mɛ maa to ní nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi; se moo lɛɛ ma ha o kɛ o weku kɛ nina maa bɔ kɛ pee ma kpetekpleenyɛ.” Se Mose kpa Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, mɛni he je o mi mi fu o ma a nɛ o kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ kɔni si wami kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ o ma ha nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma de ke, ‘E to yi mi yaya kaa e ma kpata e ma a hɛ mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he je nɛ e ya je mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ.’ Ha nɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ nya nɛ ba si, nɛ o kpale o nya se ngɛ yayami nɛ jinɛ o to kaa o maa pee o ma a he.
Mo kai o tsɔli Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob.
Mo kai mo nitsɛ o kita nɛ o ka ke, ‘Ma ha nɛ nyɛ nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa hiɔwe dodoehi, nɛ ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ e he si ɔ kɛ ha mɛ, nɛ e maa pee a nɔ kɛ ya neneene ɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kpale e nya se, nɛ yayami nɛ jinɛ e to kaa e maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ bɛ a nɔ hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose plɛ e he nɛ e kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ma, nɛ e hɛɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi; a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo.
Mawu nitsɛ nɛ kpɛ́ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ a nɔ ɔ hu, Mawu nitsɛ nɛ ngma.
Benɛ ma a hwɔ lele nɛ Yoshua nu he ɔ, e de Mose ke, “Moo bu tue!
A ngɛ ta hwue ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ.” Se Mose he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Dɛbi, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye manye ngɛ ta mi a lele hwɔmi, nɛ pohu pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ye a nɔ a bubuubui, kɛ ngmlaa ji nɛ ɔ; se mohu lali a gbi i ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Benɛ Mose miɔ nɛ e maa su ma a sito he ɔ, nɛ́ e na na bi ɔ, kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ doe ɔ, e mi mi fu; nɛ e kɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ fia si ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, nɛ e ywia mɛ.
E wo na bi ɔ nɛ a pee ɔ, nɛ e mɛ he la, nɛ e sile.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e wɛɛ lɛ nɛ e pee mamu bukɔbukɔ, nɛ e ngɔ fĩa nyu hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nu.
Mose bi Aaron ke, “Mɛni ma nɛ ɔ pee mo loko o ha nɛ a pee yayami agbo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Aaron he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, o mi mi nɛ ko fu mi.
Mo nitsɛ o le nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kaa nɔ́ yaya peemi he a nyaa.
Mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ba de mi ke, ‘Moo pee mawu ha wɔ nɛ e nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi; ejakaa kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa li nɔ́ nɛ ya ba e nɔ.’ I de mɛ ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu ɔ, e ngɔ kɛ ba.’ A ngɔ kɛ ba, nɛ i sake kɛ fɔ la mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba ji kikɛmɛ a na bi nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Benɛ Mose na kaa Aaron nine kpi ma a he, nɛ ma a ngɛ basabasa pee kɛ ngɛ a hɛ mi si puee ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya da si ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ se ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ ba ye ngɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo bua a he nya ngɛ he kake, nɛ a bu kɛ ba e ngɔ.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mia kɛ klaate, nɛ nyɛɛ kpa ma a sito he ɔ tsuo kɛ ya kɛ ba; kɛ je agbo kake nya kɛ yaa si agbo kpa nya, nɛ nyɛɛ gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na; nyɛmi jio, huɛ jio, nɔ lele jio!’ ” Levi bi ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa mɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a gbe nimli maa pee akpe etɛ.
Mose de mɛ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ je nyɛ he ngɔ to kaa Yawɛ sɔmɔli, ejakaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ gbe lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu, kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛminyumu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ hu maa gbaa nyɛ.” He piami E nɔ jena a, Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛ pee yayami agbo.
Se kɛ̃, ma kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ya Yawɛ ngɔ, kaa alini e maa nu ye gbi, nɛ e maa ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa nyɛ lo.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose kpale e se kɛ ho Yawɛ ngɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Anɔkuale, ma nɛ ɔ pee yayami agbo kaa a ngɔ sika tsu kɛ pee mawu kɛ ha a he.
Ke e maa hi ɔ, moo ngɔ a he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ.
Se ke o kɛ a he yayami ɔ be mɛ pae ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbe ye biɛ ngɛ womi ɔ nɛ o ngmaa o ni ɔmɛ a biɛ ngɛ mi ɔ mi mɔ.” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Nihi nɛ pee yayami kɛ si mi ɔ, mɛ pɛ a biɛ ma gbe ngɛ ye womi ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.
Moo lɛɛ yaa nɛ o ya kpaka ye ma a kɛ ya he nɛ i de mo ɔ. Ye bɔfo ɔ maa nyɛɛ o hɛ mi.
Se be ma nɛ ma wo ma a hiɔ ngɛ a he yayami ɔ he.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ gbla ma a tue; ejakaa a nyɛ Aaron nɔ nɛ e pee sika tsu na bi ha mɛ.
Yawɛ fa Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a si Sinai yo ɔ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ma a nɛ o kpaka kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ ho zugba a nɛ i wo Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke ma ngɔ kɛ ha a nina a nɔ ya.
Ma tsɔ bɔfo ko kɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ ma fie Kanaan bi, Amor bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ bɔfo ɔ ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya hulɔ ɔ nɔ.
Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i kɛ nyɛ be yae, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma ko ya kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ.” Benɛ ma a nu munyu yobu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ye kɔmɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko wui june ní hu.
Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de ma a ke, “Ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ; ke i kɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ hɛngmɛfia po, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ je nyɛ june ní ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he, konɛ ma hyɛ bɔ nɛ ma pee nyɛ ha.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kplɔ a he june ní ɔmɛ, nɛ kɛ je Horeb yo ɔ he kɛ yaa a, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko wui june ní hu.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ Be tsuaa be nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ma ya to si ngɛ he ko ɔ, Mose maa ngɔ bo tsu nɛ ɔ nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ ya ma ma sito he ɔ se tsitsaa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e ma ya bi ní ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ɔ maa ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ se tsitsaa a. Ke e ba mi kaa Mose yaa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa da si ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e bo tsu sinya nya, nɛ e maa hi Mose kuɛ se hyɛe kɛ yaa si e maa sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi.
Ke Mose sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi pɛ kɛkɛ bɔku titima a kple si kɛ ba da kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose maa tu munyu.
Ke ma a na bɔku titima a nɛ daa si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya pɛ mɛ tsuo a maa te si, nɛ a ma ja Mawu.
Yawɛ kɛ Mose maa tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ kɛ e huɛ tuɔ munyu ɔ. Ke Mose kpale e se kɛ ba ma a sito he ɔ, e tsɔlɔ niheyo wayoo nɛ ji Nun binyumu Yoshua lɛɛ e ji kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Yawɛ wo e ma a si Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Mo kai kaa o de mi ke ma kpaka ma a kɛ ho, se o tsɔɔ we mi nɔ nɛ o maa tsɔ kɛ piɛ ye he.
Mo nɔuu nɛ o de ke o le mi saminya, nɛ o bua jɔ ye he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ke niinɛ nɛ o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ moo tsɔɔ mi o blɔ ɔ, konɛ ma le mo saminya, nɛ ma pee o suɔmi nya ní.
Mo kai hu kaa kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ o ma ji mɛ.” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Imi nitsɛ i kɛ mo maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya fiafiaafia.” Mose de lɛ ke, “Ke mo nitsɛ o kɛ wɔ be yae ɔ, lɛɛ mo ko ha nɛ waa je hiɛ ɔ. Ke o kɛ wɔ yɛ ɔ nɛɛ, kɛ a maa pee kɛ na kaa o ngɛ i kɛ o ma a wa he suɔmi kɛɛ?
Ke o kɛ wɔ nyɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko i kɛ o ma a maa je muno ngɛ zugba a nɔ je ma amɛ tsuo a he.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o bi nɛ ɔ hu ma pee ha mo; ejakaa i le mo saminya, nɛ i ngɛ o he bua jɔmi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha ma na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ma ha ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo maa be ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ ye biɛ nɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ hu ma wo nɔ ta ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ sa dloomi ɔ, ma dloo mɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ sa mɔbɔ nami ɔ, ma na mɛ mɔbɔ.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Se ye hɛ mi lɛɛ i be hae nɛ o na; ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa ko be nyɛe nɛ e na ye hɛ mi nɛ e yi ma na wami.” Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, blɔ ngɛ ye kasa nya ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ o maa da tɛ sa nɔ.
Ke be nɛ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ bee ɔ, ma ngɔ mo ngɔ wo tɛ puɔ mi ngɛ tɛ sa nɛ ɔ mi.
I kɛ ye nine maa ha o nɔ kɛ yaa si ma be.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma je ye nine ngɛ o nɔ, nɛ o maa na ye kuɛ se, se pi ye hɛ mi.”
Mlaa tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔne ɔmɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ, konɛ ma ngma munyuhi nɛ ngɛ kekle tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o ywia a a nɔ ɔ kɛ fɔ nɔ.
Dla o he nɛ hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ o kuɔ Sinai yo ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ o kɛ mi ba kpe ngɛ yo ɔ yi mi.
“Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko piɛ o he kɛ ba; a ko na nɔ ko ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ he ko, nɛ to, loo na kó ba ye ní ngɛ yo ɔ sisi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ.
E te si mɔtu mla, nɛ e ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ ma e dɛ, nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ho Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Benɛ e yaa a, e hɛɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Yawɛ kple si kɛ ba ngɛ bɔku mi nɛ e ba da si ngɛ Mose kasa nya, nɛ e pale lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ nɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ ba be ngɛ Mose hɛ mi, nɛ e de kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Imi Yawɛ ɔ, Mawu mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ dloolɔ ji mi; ye mi mi fu we mla, nɛ ye suɔmi kɛ anɔkuale yemi hiɛ babauu.
I yeɔ ye si womi nɔ kɛ haa nimli akpeakpe, nɛ i ngɔɔ a he yayami kɛ tɔmi ngɔ paa mɛ.
Se kɛ̃ i gblaa bimɛ kɛ bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ ya siɔ yi nɔ etɛne kɛ eywiɛne bimɛ ngɛ a tsɛmɛ kɛ a nɛmɛ a yayamihi a he.” Mose kɛ he sɔmi kpla si nɛ e ja Mawu.
E de ke, “Yawɛ, ke niinɛ nɛ o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ wɔ nɛ ya.
E ngɛ mi kaa ma nɛ ɔ kuɛ wa mohu, se moo ngɔ wa tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa wɔ, nɛ o ngɔ wɔ kɛ pee mo nitsɛ o ma.” A pee somi ɔ ehe ekohu Yawɛ de Mose ke “Hyɛ i kɛ Israel ma a ngɛ soe.
Ma pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ a kpɛti nɛ eko bɛ hyɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi he ko he ko, aloo ngɛ ma ko ma ko mi.
Je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle mo ɔ maa na ní nguahi nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ tsue; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ i yaa pee ha mo ɔ he ngɛ gbeye.
Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ mo woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, moo ye nɔ.
Ma fie Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ kɛ je blɔ mi ha mo.
Hyɛ saminya nɛ o kɛ ma he nɛ nyɛ yaa a mi bi ɔmɛ kó so somi ko, nɛ lɔ ɔ ba plɛ klama nɛ a tsɔ mo.
Dɛbi, nyɛɛ hule a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ gbɛ a wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a yo wɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ashera a we amaga amɛ.
“Mo ko ja mawu kpa ko, ejakaa imi Yawɛ Mawu ɔ, a kɛ mi plee we nɔ́ he.
O kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ kó so somi ko.
Ke pi ja a, ke a ngɛ a mawu ɔmɛ jae nɛ a ngɛ bɔ sãe kɛ ngɛ mɛ hae ɔ, a ti nɔ ko kɛ̃ ma tsɛ mo ní yemi, nɛ o ma ya ye ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ eko.
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ma ya ngɔ a biyi ɔmɛ ekomɛ ba ha nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ.
Nɛ ke a biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ a mawu ɔmɛ jae ɔ, a maa gbla nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ya piɛ a he kɛ ja a mawu ɔmɛ.
“Mo ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ a sile kɛ pee mawu nɛ o ja.
“Moo ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ, moo ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago ngɛ Abib nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi be nɛ a to ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ejakaa Abib nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi o je Egipt kɛ ba a nɛ.
“Bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte, kɛ o we mi lohwehi a kpɛti kekleekle eku tsuaa eku ɔ, ye nɔ ji lɛ; na jio, to jio.
O teji kekleekle bi ɔ, o maa ngɔ jijɔ kɛ dani lɛ.
Ke o be suɔe nɛ o dani lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ o maa ku e kuɛ.
O ma dani o bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ba ye hɛ mi kɛ e dɛ gu.
“Mo tsu ní ligbi ekpa, se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ moo jɔɔ o he; ní gbami be tete jio, ní kpami be tete jio.
“Moo ye Ngmakpami be ɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ kpokploku kpɔe; nɛ o ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ jeha a nyagbe.
“Daa jeha a, o ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba bua si etɛ ngɛ imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ mi.
Ma fie je ma amɛ kɛ je o blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma bli o huzu ɔmɛ a mi.
Nɛ ke o ba Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ hɛ mi si etɛ ngɛ jeha mi ɔ, nɔ ko hɛ be o zugba a nɔ kɔe.
“Koo ngɔ abolo nɛ a kɛ masa sã a ngɔ piɛ lohwe nɛ o kɛ ngɛ bɔ sãe ha mi ɔ he.
Lohwe nɛ a gbe Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ hu, je nɛ ko na yi.
“Daa jeha a, ngɔɔ o zugba a nɔ kekleekle yiblii kɛ ba imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, ye we ɔ. Koo hoo apletsi bi ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nyu mi.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ngmaa munyu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ fɔ si; ejakaa somi nɛ i kɛ mo, kɛ Israel ngɛ soe ɔ daa si ngɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Mose kɛ Yawɛ hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ; e yi nɔ́ ko ɔ, nyu hu e nui.
Nɛ e ngma somi munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ji mlaa nyɔngma amɛ ngɔ fɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Mose kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ Benɛ Mose kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ma a, e hɛɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
E hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe, ejakaa e kɛ Yawɛ ya tu munyu; se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e li enɛ ɔ. Aaron kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo na kaa Mose hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe, nɛ a ye gbeye kaa a maa su e he.
Se Mose tsɛ mɛ, nɛ Aaron kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo ba e ngɔ, nɛ Mose kɛ mɛ tu munyu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo hɛ mɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e wo mɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ ha lɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ. Benɛ Mose kɛ mɛ tu munyu gbe nya a, e ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi.
Be tsuaa be nɛ Mose ma ya sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ e kɛ Yawɛ ma ya tu munyu ɔ, e jeɔ hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa je kpo.
Ke e je kpo kɛ ba nɛ e ba de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ke e de ɔ, a naa kaa e hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kpaleɔ ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ haa e hɛ mi kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ e maa ya nɛ e kɛ Yawɛ ma ya tu munyu ekohu.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he mlaahi Mose bua Israel ma a tsuo nya nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ligbi ekpa nyɛ kɛ tsu ní, se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ kaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi klɔuklɔu ha imi Yawɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu ní jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
Nyɛ ko slɛ la po ngɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ.” Bɔ sami ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi Mose de Israel ma a tsuo ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ba ke imi Yawɛ ní.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ he tsui kaa e maa ke nɔ́ ko ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ji sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ akɔblee; kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ; apletsi he bwɔmi, agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi; apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee; akasia tso; kane mi nu; tsopa nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nɔ pɔmi nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via; tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ shoham, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ a maa ma kɛ wo efɔd ɔ kɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ. Níhi nɛ a kɛ maa pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ “Ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ba nɛ a ba tsu ní tsumi nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ke nyɛ tsu ɔ. Kpe he bo tsu ɔ, e he hami ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e nɔ hami ní ɔmɛ, e gbowe ɔmɛ kɛ e sima tso ɔmɛ, e mani tso ɔmɛ, e titima amɛ kɛ e nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ; somi daka a, e he tso ɔmɛ, nya nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ a kɛ tsiɔ somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ; okplɔɔ ɔ, e he tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e he níhi tsuo, kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ; kane tso ɔ hu nɛ a suɔ la kɛ maa nɔ ɔ, kɛ e he níhi; kane ɔmɛ kɛ nu nɛ a kɛ woɔ a mi ɔ; bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ, kɛ e tso ɔmɛ; nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ, tsopa kɛ e he via a; kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, e he akɔblee piɛ ɔ, e tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e he níhi tsuo; nyu kã a kɛ e he kla a; bo ɔmɛ nɛ kplaa si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ piɛ ɔ he ɔ, e titima amɛ kɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ; piɛ ɔ nya bo ɔ; kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, piɛ ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ a tangme ɔmɛ; kɛ tade saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ nɛ osɔfo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa wo kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ.” Ma a kɛ bɔ sami ní ɔmɛ ba Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsuo je Mose he kɛ ho.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e nike ní ba ha Yawɛ, konɛ a kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ e mi sɔmɔmi ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ha kɛ je e tsui mi kaa bɔ nɛ mumi ɔ fa lɛ ɔ. Nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ he tsui ɔ ngɔ gugue nya gahi, tue nya ní, nguɛ ní, kuɛ ní, kɛ sika tsu june ní kpakpa babauu ba ke Yawɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ kpa bluu, aloo kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, aloo kpa tsu, aloo kpa hiɔ kpakpa, aloo apletsi he bwɔmi, aloo agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi, aloo apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ha sika hiɔ, loo akɔblee ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ akasia tsohi nɛ hi kɛ ha ní tsumi ɔ, mɛ hu a ngɔ kɛ ba.
Yihi tsuo nɛ ga ngɛ a hɛ mi ɔ tslɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ ba.
Mɛ kɛ̃ a ngɔ apletsi he bwɔmi kɛ tslɔ kpa kɛ ba.
Nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ shoham tɛhi, kɛ tɛ kpahi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ a maa ma kɛ wo efɔd ɔ, kɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ kɛ ba; kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via, kane mi nu, nɔ pɔmi nu, kɛ nu nɛ a kɛ peeɔ tsopa kɛ e he via.
Israel ma a tsuo, nyumuhi kɛ yihi, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ta e tsui mi kaa e ha nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ tsu ní tsumi slɔɔtohi nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a tsu ɔ je a tsui mi faa ngɔ a nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba ba ha Yawɛ.
Ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ na, Yawɛ je blɔ hla Uri binyumu Bezalel, Hur bibi ɔ kɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ mumi mi nike ní babauu ngɔ ha lɛ.
Yawɛ dloo lɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi, kɛ nile ha ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo.
E nyɛɔ nɛ e ngɔɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ akɔblee kɛ peeɔ ga níhi.
E nine nya da kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa a he ní tsumi, kɛ tso hlɔmi, kɛ ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tsumi.
Yawɛ ha e kɛ Oholiab, Ahisamak binyumu ɔ nɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ga ní tsumi slɔɔto ɔmɛ.
E dloo mɛ ga ní tsumi tsuaa ga ní tsumi he juɛmi, kɛ nile babauu kɛ ha tso, aloo tɛ, aloo dade mi kpɛmi, kɛ ga ní tɛnimi kɛ ní kadimi nɛ a ngɔɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ peeɔ ɔ.
A nyɛɔ nɛ a tsuɔ ga ní tsumi tsuaa ga ní tsumi, nɛ a peeɔ ga ní tɛnimi hulɔ.
“Bezalel, Oholiab, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Yawɛ dloo lɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi, kɛ nile nɛ a kɛ ma tsu he klɔuklɔu ɔ mami ní tsumi ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ba nɛ a ba tsu ní ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ.” Ma a kɛ nike ní babauu ba Mose tsɛ Bezalel, Oholiab, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Yawɛ dloo lɛ ga nile, nɛ jehanɛ e ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ he suɔmi ɔ kɛ ba ní tsumi ɔ he.
Mose ngɔ nike níhi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je a tsui mi kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ tsu he klɔuklɔu ɔ he ní ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo a dɛ.
Se loloolo ɔ, Israel ma a kɛ a nike ní ɔmɛ ngɛ bae ba ngɛ Mose hae daa mɔtu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ tsuo je ní tsumi ɔ he kɛ ba ba de Mose ke, “Ní ɔmɛ nɛ ma a kɛ ngɛ bae nɛ a kɛ tsu ní kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ hiɛ kulaa tsɔ pe ní tsumi ɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ha nɛ a fiɛ ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ tsuo ke, “Nyumu jio, yo jio, nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ngɔ nike ní ko kɛ ba kɛ ha he klɔuklɔu ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ hu!” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a jɔɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ bami.
Ní ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba momo ɔ hiɛ ha ní tsumi ɔ tsuo tsumi, nɛ tete po eko maa piɛ.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ mami Ní tsuli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ ga saminya a ngɔ bo popoe nyɔngma kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ.
A ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo bo ɔmɛ, nɛ a kadi kerub saminyawiiwi ngɔ wo a mi.
Bo ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ fiee; bo kake kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ekpa, nɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ.
A kpɛ bo enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ a kpɛ enuɔ kpa amɛ hu ja nɔuu.
A kɛ kpa bluu pee gahi kɛ wo bo kake nya ngɛ tsami he ɔ; bo kpa a hu ja nɔuu a pee lɛ.
A pee bo ga nyingmi enuɔ kɛ wo bo kake nya, nɛ a pee bo ga nyingmi enuɔ kɛ wo bo kaketsɛ ɔ hu nya; ga amɛ tsuo nyɛɛ a sibi a hanɔ.
A pee sika tsu gbowe nyingmi enuɔ nɛ a kɛ gbowe ɔmɛ tsa bo ɔmɛ kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu mluku kake.
Jehanɛ a kɛ apletsi he bwɔmi kpɛ bo popoe nyɔngma kɛ kake nɛ a kɛ lɛ tsuo pee heha nɔ́ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ. Bo popoe kakaaka nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ; bo kake kami ji nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ.
A kpɛ bo enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ a kpɛ ekpa hu kɛ tsa a sibi a nya.
Bo enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tsa a, a pee ga nyingmi enuɔ kɛ wo nyagbe nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake he; ekpa nɔ́ ɔ hu a pee lɛ ja nɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a pee akɔblee gbowe nyingmi enuɔ, nɛ a kɛ gbowe ɔmɛ la ga amɛ a mi; nɛ bo enyɔ ɔmɛ pee heha nɔ́ kake.
A kpɛ bo kpa enyɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ he; a kɛ agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi kpɛ kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kpɛ enyɔne ɔ. Jehanɛ, a kɛ akasia tso pee sima tso ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ. Sima tso kake kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ, nɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ.
Sima tso tsuaa sima tso ngɛ nane enyɔ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ tsa a sibi a nya; bɔ nɛ a pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ he sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A pee sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ leneyi je, nɛ a pee sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ wo sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ a sisi; nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi kɛ ha e nane enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa kake ɔ hu nɛ ji omleyi je ɔ, a ma sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ mɛ hu a sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ, nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ se ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, a ma sima tso ekpa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A ma sima tso kpa enyɔ hu ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ. Kɔ nya sima tso nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsa mɛ ngɛ yi kpɛti ɔ ngɛ kekleekle ga a he, se sisi ɔ lɛɛ a tsa we; a pee kɔ nya sima tso enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo a yibɔ ji kpaanyɔ, kɛ sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyɔngma kɛ ekpa; sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi.
A kɛ akasia tso pee mani womi tso nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ: enuɔ ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa hiɛ, enuɔ ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa hiɛ, kɛ enuɔ hu ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ se, ngɛ bonyoku je.
Mani ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sima tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ lɛɛ e fɔ si kɛ je kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa kake kɛ ya si kasa kake.
A ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha sima tso ɔmɛ a he.
Jehanɛ hu, a pee sika tsu gahi kɛ wo a he, nɛ a kɛ mani ɔmɛ hɔɔ a mi.
Mani ɔmɛ nitsɛ hu a ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.
A kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu lo tsu mi pomi bo ɔ.
A je blɔ kadi kerub saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi.
A kɛ akasia tso pee titima eywiɛ kɛ ha tsu mi pomi bo ɔ.
A ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu gbowehi hɔ a nya.
Jehanɛ, a pee sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ ha mɛ.
A kɛ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu lo kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ; nɛ a kadi ní kɛ wo mi.
A pee titima enuɔ kɛ ha tsu nya bo nɛ ɔ, kɛ mɛ hu a he gbowehi.
A kɛ sika tsu ha a yi mi, kɛ a kpɛti kla amɛ a he; se a nɔ dami nɔ́ enuɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ akɔblee a kɛ pee.
Somi daka a Bezalel ngɔ akasia tso kɛ kpɛ somi daka a. E kami ji nine mi blimi enuɔ, e blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ, nɛ e mi kuɔmi hu nine mi blimi etɛ.
E kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha daka a mi kɛ e he tsuo, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko kɛ̃ wo zã kɛ bɔle e he ɔ kulaa.
E pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ, nɛ e ka mɛ kɛ wo daka a nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he; ga enyɔ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ.
E hlɔ akasia tsohi, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ha a he.
E kɛ tso ɔmɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ nɛ ngɛ daka a he ɔ a mi, nɛ́ a pɛtɛ a he kɛ hɛɛ daka a. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee daka a nya nɔ́; e kami ji nine mi blimi enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ.
E ngɔ sika tsu nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee kerub enyɔ kɛ ma nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ daka a kami mi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Kerub kake ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ kerub kake hu ngɛ hiɛ.
E pee kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ tsa.
Kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi kɛ ya hiɔwe nɛ a kɛ ha nya nɔ́ ɔ he.
A plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee a sibi, nɛ a ngɛ nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ hyɛe.
Okplɔɔ ɔ kpɛmi Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ akasia tso kpɛ okplɔɔ ɔ; e kami ji nine mi blimi eywiɛ, e blimi ji nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e si temi ji nine mi blimi etɛ.
E ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha he, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko wo zã kɛ bɔle e he ɔ kulaa.
E hlɔ tso maa pee dɛ mi blimi, nɛ e kɛ pee kla kɛ wo okplɔɔ ɔ he kɛ kpe.
E kɛ sika tsu wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle kla a. E pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ kɛ mɛtɛ okplɔɔ ɔ nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ.
Ga amɛ nɛ a maa ngɔ tso ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a mi ɔ ngɛ tso kla a kasa nya tutuutu.
E ngɔ akasia tso kɛ hlɔ tso ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ; nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ha a he.
E ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa ma okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ: plɛɛtehi, kahi nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via maa wo a mi, kpluhi, kɛ likɔkɔhi nɛ a kɛ maa sã wai bɔ.
Kane tso ɔ peemi Jehanɛ, e kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee kane tso ɔ. Kane tso ɔ sisi je, kɛ e kpɛti tso ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ sika tsu nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ pee.
E pee mɔmɔhi: ní nɛmɛ nɛ blɛkee we lolo, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ blɛke, nɛ a kɛ kane tso ɔ tsa mluguduu kake.
Kɔni ekpa ngɛ kane tso ɔ he; etɛ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, nɛ etɛ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ.
Kane tso ɔ he kɔni ekpa amɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ etɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ ngɛ eko tsuaa eko nɔ.
Kpɛti kane tso ɔ lɛɛ mɔmɔ eywiɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ ngɛ nɔ.
Kane tso ɔ tso gblaa etɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ kpɔ ngɛ kɔni enyɔɔnyɔ ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ a sisi tutuutu.
Kpɔ ɔmɛ, tso gblaa amɛ, kɛ kpɛti kane tso ɔ tsuo tsa; a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee lɛ tsuo.
Jehanɛ, e pee kane kpaago kɛ ma kane tso ɔ nɔ; nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee kane ɔ sumi kɛ e gbemi nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa muɔ la zu.
E ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ pee kane tso ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ peemi Tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ, e ngɔ akasia tso kɛ pee.
E pee lɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami ji nine mi blimi enyɔ, e blimi ji nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e si temi ji nine mi blimi eywiɛ.
E kɛ e koli ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsa.
E ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha e he tsuo: e yi mi, e kasa nya amɛ, kɛ e koli ɔmɛ; nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
E pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ mɛtɛ la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ zã a sisi ngɛ kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ, konɛ a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ la tɛ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a mi.
Akasia tsohi ji tso ɔmɛ nɛ e hlɔ ɔ nɛ, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ha a he.
Nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a Jehanɛ, e pee nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu, ɔ kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngmingmiingmi ɔ hulɔ.
E futu tsopa amɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via he ní tsulɔ nitsɛ lɛ pee.
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ peemi E kɛ akasia tso pee bɔ sami la tɛ; e ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ.
E kami ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, e blimi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, nɛ e si temi ji nine mi blimi ekpa.
E pee kolihi ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e kɛ akɔblee ha a he; koli ɔmɛ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ tsa.
E pee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo: ngɛyuhi, sofihi, kahi, gbowehi, kɛ la jemi ngɛyuhi.
E ngɔ akɔblee kɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Jehanɛ, e ngɔ akɔblee kɛ lo ya ngɔ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ je e sisi blɔ kɛ ya ta e kpɛti tutuutu.
E sɔ̃ ga eywiɛ kɛ wo akɔblee ya a kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a kɛ tsohi nɛ wo a mi.
Akasia tsohi ji tso ɔmɛ nɛ e hlɔ ɔ nɛ, nɛ e ngɔ akɔblee kɛ ha a he.
E kɛ tso ɔmɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ a mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ hɛɛ lɛ.
E kɛ gbegbeli kpɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, nɛ blɔ ngɛ mi.
Akɔblee kã a E pee akɔblee kã kɛ e sisi kla; e ná akɔblee ahuhuɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ pee ɔ kɛ je yi ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a a dɛ.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he piɛ ɔ Jehanɛ, e po piɛ kɛ wo kpe he bo tsu ɔ he.
Bo nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ leneyi je ɔ, a lo kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ; e kami ji nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ.
E kɛ akɔblee pee titima nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ; se titima amɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee.
Bo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ hu a kami ji nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ.
Mɛ hu akɔblee a ngɔ kɛ pee a titima nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ; se titima amɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee.
Bo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ bonyoku je ɔ, a kami ji nine mi blimi lafa.
A ngɛ titima nyɔngma, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ hu nyɔngma; titima amɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ ɔ, sika hiɔ a kɛ pee.
Bo ɔmɛ nɛ kpee beleku je ɔ, a kami ji nine mi blimi lafa.
Tsu nya bohi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ sinya a nya kasa kake ɔ, a kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ, kɛ a he titima etɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ etɛ.
Kasa kaketsɛ ɔ hu ja nɔuu; tsu nya bohi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ, kɛ mɛ hu a he titima etɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ etɛ.
Bo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kplaa si ngɛ piɛ ɔ he ɔ, a lo mɛ kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ.
A kɛ akɔblee pee titima amɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ; se a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee.
A ngɔ sika hiɔ kɛ ha titima amɛ a yi mi.
Titima amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ sika hiɔ tsa mɛ ngɛ a kpɛti.
Piɛ ɔ nya bo ɔ, a ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ kadi ní saminyayoo ngɔ wo mi.
E kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, kaa piɛ ɔ he bo ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Titima eywiɛ hɛɛ piɛ ɔ nya bo ɔ, kɛ a nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ɔ, se a he gbowe ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee.
A kɛ sika hiɔ ha a yi mi, nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ nɔuu poo a kpɛti.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ piɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo akɔblee a kɛ pee.
Níhi nɛ a kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ Ní slɔɔtohi nɛ a kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ, he nɛ a ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ to ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Mose ji nɔ nɛ fa kaa a bua ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ osɔfo Aaron binyumu Itamar ji nɔ nɛ to blɔ nya ha Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ tsu ní ɔ. Uri bi Bezalel, nɛ peeɔ Hur nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ bibi ɔ, ji nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ɔ nɛ.
E he piɛlɔ ji Ahisamak nɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ bi Oholiab.
Oholiab nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ mi kpɛ́lɔ, galɔ, kɛ bo lolɔ ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɔɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ loɔ bo.
Sika tsu tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a kɛ tsu ní ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ ji sika tsu nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ, e jiimi ji kilo akpe ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ susumi nɔ́ ɔ nya.
Sika hiɔ nɛ a ná kɛ je ma a dɛ mi benɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kanee ɔ, e jiimi ji ngɛ kilo , he klɔuklɔu ɔauaumi nɔ́ ɔ nya.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ha ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ susumi nɔ́ ɔ nya.
Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ a kane lɛ ɔ, ha kikɛmɛ a sika nɛ ɔ. Nyumuhi abɔ nɛ a ngma a biɛ benɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kanee ɔ, a yibɔ ji nimli akpe lafa ekpa kɛ etɛ, kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
A ngɔ sika hiɔ nɛ ɔ mi kilo , kɛ sɔ̃ nɔ dami nɔ́ lafa kɛ ha he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ; kilo kɛ ha nɔ dami nɔ́ kake.
Sika hiɔ kilo nyingmi etɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, Bezalel ngɔ eko kɛ pee titima a he gbowehi.
E ngɔ eko hu kɛ ha titima amɛ a yi mi, nɛ e kɛ eko poo a mi.
Akɔblee ɔ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba ke Yawɛ ɔ, e nya ji kilo ,.
Lɔ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ nya sinya a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he akɔblee ya a, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle piɛ ɔ kɛ piɛ ɔ we agbo ɔ nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ piɛ nɛ bɔle kpe he bo tsu ɔ hu he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tade ɔmɛ a kpɛmi A ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu kɛ kpɛ tade saminyawiiwi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa wo kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ.
A kpɛ tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ ha Aaron kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. Efɔd ɔ peemi A ngɔ sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ pee efɔd ɔ.
A si sika tsu ɔ nɔ tɛtlɛɛ, nɛ a poo lɛ dlɛɛdlɛɛ kaa kpa loko a ngɔ kɛ futu kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ ɔ.
A pee konɔ kpa enyɔ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he, nɛ a kɛ fi lɛ ngɛ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo.
Mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a je blɔ lo kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he nɛ a kɛ fi lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu jamɛ a ga a, kɛ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ nɔuu a ngɔ kɛ pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. Mɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ.
A pee shoham tɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ hɔɔ sika tsu gahi a mi; nɛ a kpɛ́ Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june he ní tsulɔ ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, a fi mɛ kɛ wo efɔd konɔ kpa amɛ a he kaa kaimi tɛhi nɛ daa si kɛ ha Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ.
Gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ peemi Gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ, a pee lɛ kɛ ya; bɔ nɛ a pee efɔd ɔ, ja nɔuu a pee lɛ.
Níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ pee lɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ.
A dɔ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ mi enyɔ, nɛ a pee lɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami ji nine mi blimi kake, nɛ e blimi hu nine mi blimi kake.
A ma tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ wo zã eywiɛ mi.
Kekleekle zã a mi tɛ ɔmɛ ji sardio, topasion, kɛ smaragdo.
Zã nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji karfungkle, safiro, kɛ sardoniki.
Zã etɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji hiakinto, agate, kɛ ametisto.
Zã eywiɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji krisolito, shoham, kɛ yaspi.
A sile sika tsu kɛ bɔle tɛ ɔmɛ.
Tɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ a kpɛ́ Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ a nɔ kakaaka.
Wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, a kpɛ́ eko tsuaa eko biɛ ngɛ tɛ kake nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ ɔ.
A kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ a tslɔ kaa kpa kɛ wo gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ he.
A pee sika tsu nɔ́ mi hɔmi nɔ enyɔ, kɛ sika tsu ga hu enyɔ, nɛ a kɛ ga enyɔ ɔmɛ wo gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a he.
A kɛ sika tsu kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ hɔɔ ga enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
A ngɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nya enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ la nɔ́ mi hɔmi nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a fi kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he ngɛ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ wo gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi mi je ngɛ efɔd ɔ kasa nya.
Jehanɛ, a pee sika tsu ga kpa enyɔ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ kɔni enyɔ kpa amɛ a nya, ngɛ sisi blɔ kɛ yaa e hɛ mi, ngɛ tsami he kake ɔ hanɔ, ngɛ efɔd ɔ mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a lo saminyayoo ɔ yi mi.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, a ngɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ he ga amɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he ga amɛ a he ngɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe je, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ nɛ kó kpɔ kɛ je efɔd ɔ he.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tade kpa amɛ a kpɛmi Bo ɔ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ kpɛ efɔd ɔ he tade klɔii ɔ, kpa bluu sɔuu a kɛ lo.
A je kuɛ mi puɔ ngɛ he, nɛ a fia nya nɛ e ti kɛ kpe konɛ e ko hía.
-A ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu kɛ lo ní kokloohi kaa tso yiblii nɛ a ma kɛ wo tade ɔ nya fiami ɔ mi, nɛ sika tsu ngmlɛhi hɔɔ tso yiblii ɔmɛ a mi kɛ kpe.
Ke sika tsu ngmlɛ kake ba, kɛkɛ nɔ́ kokloo kaa tso yiblii ɔ hu kake ba ja sɔuu kɛ bɔle tade klɔii ɔ nya fiami ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
A ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ lo hiɔwe tadehi ha Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ; a kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ ɔ kɛ̃ kpɛ osɔfo pɛɛ nguaa a kɛ pɛɛ wawi ɔmɛ.
A kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kpɛ fiɔ mi tade ɔmɛ.
Mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hu, a ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu kɛ pee, nɛ a kadi ní wo mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
A kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee jlasi klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi plɛɛte pɛtɛpɛtɛ ɔ, nɛ a ngma ní ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june he ní tsulɔ ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ́ ɔ ke, “Klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ.” Nɛ a kɛ kpa bluu fi lɛ kɛ wo pɛɛ nguaa a he kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
A gbe ní tsumi ɔ nya Jehanɛ ɔ, a gbe kpe he bo tsu ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nya.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tsu ní ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. Nɛ a ngɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Mose ngɔ; e he gbowe ɔmɛ, sima tso ɔmɛ, mani tso ɔmɛ, titima amɛ, kɛ nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ; he hami bo ɔ nɛ a kɛ agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi kpɛ ɔ; he hami bo ɔ nɛ a kɛ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kpɛ ɔ; tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ a kɛ tsiɔ somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ; somi daka a nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, e he tso ɔmɛ kɛ e nya nɔ́ ɔ; okplɔɔ ɔ, e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ; kane tso ɔ nɛ a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee ɔ, kane ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ma nɔ ɔ, e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ kane mi nu ɔ; sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ; nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ; tsopa kɛ e he via a; kpe he bo tsu ɔ nya bo ɔ; akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, e he akɔblee ya a, e he tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo; nyu kã a kɛ e he kla a; bo ɔmɛ nɛ kplaa si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ piɛ ɔ he ɔ, e titima amɛ kɛ e nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, piɛ ɔ nya bo ɔ, e he tangme ɔmɛ kɛ e he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɔ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ; tade saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa wo kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ ji osɔfo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tsu ní tsumi ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mose ya nɛ e ya hyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e na kaa a tsu ní ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Nɛ Mose gbaa mɛ.
A tsukɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ ma si.
Ngɔɔ somi daka a nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ ma mi, konɛ o ngɔ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ kɛ tsi daka a hɛ mi.
Ngɔɔ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ ba ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ o to ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ma nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ kane tso ɔ hu kɛ ba mi, nɛ o ngɔ kane ɔmɛ kɛ ma nɔ.
Ngɔɔ sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via a kɛ ma somi daka a hɛ mi, nɛ o wo bo ngɔ kpla si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Ngɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Ngɔɔ nyu kã a kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ o yɛ nyu kɛ wo mi.
Moo po piɛ kɛ bɔle he klɔuklɔu, nɛ o wo bo ngɔ kpla si ngɛ piɛ ɔ sinya a nya.
“Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ kɛ pɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ o tsukɔ a he; kɛkɛ a maa pee klɔuklɔu.
Moo pɔ sami bɔ la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo nu nɛ o tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he; kɛkɛ e maa pee klɔuklɔu kɛ pi si.
Nyu kã a kɛ e sisi kla a hu o pɔ mɛ nu nɛ o kɛ tsukɔ a he ja nɔuu.
“Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ o ngɔ nyu kɛ fɔ a he.
Ngɔɔ tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ wo Aaron, nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ o julaa lɛ, nɛ e sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfo.
Ngɔɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba, nɛ o wo mɛ hiɔwe tade ɔmɛ.
Moo pɔ mɛ hu nu kaa bɔ nɛ o pɔ a tsɛ ɔ nu ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi.
Kikɛmɛ a nu pɔmi nɛ ɔ maa pee mɛ kɛ a nina tsuo osɔfohi kɛ maa ya neneene.” Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a we Egipt jemi jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ si.
Mose ji nɔ nɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ si.
E ka nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e kɛ sima tso ɔmɛ ma si.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fi mani ɔmɛ kɛ wo a he, nɛ e kɛ titima amɛ ma si.
E ma bo tsu ɔ si, nɛ e ngɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ heha nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ ha he kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. E ngɔ mlaa amɛ kɛ wo somi daka a mi.
E kɛ tso ɔmɛ hɔɔ daka a he ga amɛ a mi, nɛ e ngɔ daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ bu nya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ daka a ba ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ kpla si, nɛ e kɛ tsi somi daka a nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ, Mose ɔ. Mose kɛ okplɔɔ ɔ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ we omleyi je, ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e to abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ kɛ ma nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. E ngɔ kane tso ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ hanɔ, ngɛ leneyi je, nɛ e su kane ɔmɛ kɛ ma nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. E ngɔ sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Mose kɛ bo ɔ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
E ngɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. E kɛ nyu kã a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ e yɛ nyu kɛ wo mi.
-Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ lɛ, Mose ɔ, kɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, aloo a maa ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, a kɛ nyu ɔ ma fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he.
Mose po piɛ kɛ bɔle kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e wo bo ngɔ kpla piɛ ɔ sinya a nya.
Mose gbe ní tsumi ɔ tsuo nya.
Bɔku ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔku ɔ ba ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ nɔ, nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami hyi lejɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mose nyɛ we nɛ e sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, ke bɔku ɔ wo e he nɔ kɛ je kpe he bo tsu ɔ he pɛ kɛkɛ a pue blɔ.
Ke bɔku ɔ wo we e he nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ a hiɛ blɔ kɛ yaa si ligbi nɛ e ma wo e he nɔ.
Ngɛ Israel ma a blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, Yawɛ jeɔ e he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ yi mi; piani ɔ, a naa lɛ kaa bɔku, nɛ nyɔ mi lɛɛ a naa lɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe.
NYA TSƆƆMI Blema Israel bi ɔmɛ a Mawu jami, kɛ kusumihi a he mlaahi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a hyɛ nɛ a ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu titli ji Mawu ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Jehanɛ, womi ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ Israel ma a maa pee kɛ ja Mawu, kɛ bɔ nɛ a maa ba a je mi, konɛ a kɛ “Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu” ɔ nɛ hi si saminya be tsuaa be.
Munyuhi nɛ a le pe kulaa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ yi .
ɔ; nɛ lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yesu tsɛ ke mlaa enyɔne nɛ he hia, nɛ deɔ ke, “Moo suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ.” Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ nike ní, kɛ bɔ sami he .—.
A wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ osɔfo .—.
Mlaahi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa kusumi nya a, nɔ ko he tsɔ, loo e he tsɔ we .—.
Kpatami ligbi ɔ .- Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ klɔuklɔu peemi ngɛ wami si himi kɛ jami mi .—.
Bɔhi nɛ a sãã lohwe ɔ tsuo kulaa Yawɛ tsɛ Mose nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu kɛ je kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, a kpɛti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ kɛ maa sã bɔ ha lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ, e ngɔ na, loo to kɛ ba.
Ke na nɔ ɔ kɛ ma sami bɔ sami ɔ, é ngɔ na ku nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba.
E kɛ na a nɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, konɛ e sa Yawɛ hɛ mi nɛ e ngɔ.
Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi.
A maa ngɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nane mi kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ kpata Yawɛ.
Jehanɛ, e gbe na ku ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ ba; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a he kɛ kpe.
E saa lohwe ɔ, nɛ e poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a to lɛ́ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a slɛ la.
Jehanɛ, a ngɔ lo nɛ a saa a, e yi ɔ, kɛ e zɔ ɔ ngɔ pue lɛ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; se e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e nane ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ nɛ fɔ a he; nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa sami bɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
Se ke to nɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma sami bɔ sami ɔ, é pee agbosu, aloo akpakpo nɛ kpa ko be e he.
É gbe lɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ we omleyi je, konɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.
Nɔ ɔ nɛ poo lo ɔ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ to lo ɔ, kɛ yi ɔ, kɛ zɔ ɔ tsuo ngɔ pue la a nɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
E mi ní ɔ kɛ e nane ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ nɛ fɔ a he, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji sami bɔ, bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
Ke lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma sami bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, e pee lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ dɛ kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
É kika lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ kuɛ, nɛ e tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya; e sã yi ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e tsle muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
É je lohwe ɔ kã a kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ, nɛ́ e sake mɛ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ beleku je, he nɛ a ngɔɔ la zu ngɔ pueɔ ɔ. É pɛtɛ pɛli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ́ e fɛ lohwe ɔ mi, se e ko kplɔ pɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ he; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e sã lohwe ɔ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji sami bɔ, bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ.
Niye ní bɔhi Ke nɔ ko ngɔ niye ní kɛ ma bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, é wɛɛ lɛ bukɔbukɔ kɛ pee mamu.
E pue nɔ oliv nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via, nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ piti mamu bukɔbukɔ kɛ e nɔ nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a tsuo e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ daa si kaa okadi ngɛ bɔ ɔ nɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ba a tsuo nane mi kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
Mamu nɛ piɛ ngɛ niye ní bɔ sami ɔ se ɔ, peeɔ osɔfo Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́; ejakaa bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ke niye ní nɛ a sã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi nɔ ko ngɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, é pee keeki nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu sã, loo e pee akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a pɔ he nu.
Ke niye ní nɛ a sã ngɛ ngɛyu mi nɔ ko kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, é pee nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kplolo mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi lɛ pee.
É ku niye ní ɔ mi tsɔwitsɔwi, nɛ́ e plɛ nu ngɔ pue nɔ; niye ní bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, ke niye ní nɛ a hoo ngɛ buɛ mi nɔ ko ngɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, e pee mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu.
A sã jio, a si jio, e ngɔ kɛ ba kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ ma ha Yawɛ.
É ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, konɛ osɔfo ɔ hu nɛ ngɔ kɛ ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ bɔbɔyoo ko kɛkɛ kaa okadi ngɛ niye ní ɔ tsuo nane mi.
É sã nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ɔ peeɔ osɔfo Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́; ejakaa bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
A kɛ masa nɔ́ ko kó pee niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ eko; nyɛ ko sã masa nɔ́ ko loo hwo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ngɔ masa, loo hwo kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa ngmɔ nɔ kekleekle niba ní, se nyɛ ko sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jee via.
Nyɛɛ wo nyɛ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ngo; ejakaa ngo ji somi nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngo nɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e ngmɔ nɔ kekleekle niba ní kɛ ma bɔ sami ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa niye ní bɔ ɔ, é pee kpokploku nɛ a hluɛ, nɛ a sĩ, loo blɛfo nɛ a wɛɛ kplolo.
A wo mi nu, nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ pue nɔ.
Niye ní bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ ɔ bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ kaa okadi ngɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ tsuo nane mi.
É sã nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.
Tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami Ke nɔ ko ngɔ na kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, eku jio, eyo jio, e pee na nɛ kpa ko be e he.
Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, konɛ Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.
Á je lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ he ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ: zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ha mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, lohwe ɔ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a. Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ sami bɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ngɔ jijɔ, loo apletsi kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, eku jio, eyo jio, e pee lohwe nɛ kpa ko be e he.
Ke jijɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ ba a, é ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.
Jehanɛ, lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, a ngɔ e he ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ: zɔ ɔ kɛ e hlemi ɔ kulaa nɛ a je kɛ je e se tso ɔ he ɔ, zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ha e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e se tso mi ngmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a. Osɔfo nɛ ngɛ ní tsue jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ nɛ sã enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ apletsi ba bɔ sami ɔ, é ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.
Jehanɛ, á je lohwe ɔ he ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ á ngɔ kɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ: zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ha mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a. Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via.
Zɔ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nɔ́.
Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ kó ye zɔ, loo muɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene ha nyɛ yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ.
Yayami pami bɔ sami Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke a ti nɔ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ a nyɛ nɛ e kɛ tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ, nɛ pi kaa nɔ ɔ je blɔ tɔ̃ ɔ, a ye blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ke osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu nɛ tɔ̃, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e gbla musu kɛ ba ma a nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ na ku nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ha Yawɛ.
É ngɔ na ku ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ, osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ nɛ ngɔ na ku ɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
É ngɔ e nine nguɛ ngɔ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ é fĩa ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi si kpaago.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
É tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya nya a sisi.
Jehanɛ, na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, é je e mi zɔ ɔ, kɛ zɔ nɛ ha e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ tsuo.
É je e se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a hulɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Ke a gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu osɔfo ɔ jeɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ.
Se na ku ɔ he womi ɔ, e lo ɔ, e yi ɔ, e nane ɔmɛ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e fĩ ɔ tsuo lɛɛ é ngɔ lɛ tsuo kɛ je ma sito he ɔ kɛ ya he ko nɛ tsɔ, he nɛ a plɛɔ la zu ngɔ pueɔ ɔ. É ngɔ mɛ kɛ pue lɛ́ nɔ nɛ e sã ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke e ba mi kaa Israel ma a tsuo tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa a eko nɔ, nɛ pi kaa a je blɔ tɔ̃ ɔ, ke a na le kaa a tɔ̃ ɔ, ma a nɛ ngɔ na ku kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ.
Á ngɔ lohwe ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi.
Ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ á ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ á gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ nɛ ngɔ na ku nɛ ɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
É ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ, é ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Muɔ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, é tsɛ̃ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a sisi.
É je na ku ɔ mi zɔ ɔ tsuo, nɛ é sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
É pee na ku nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee nɛ e kɛ kpata Mawu ha ma a, nɛ a kɛ a he yayami maa pa mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, é ngɔ na ku nɛ ɔ hu kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ é ya sã lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ kaa a pee kaketsɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha ma a tsuo.
Ke nɔ yelɔ ko li e he be nɛ e tɔ̃ Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ, nɛ a ha nɛ e na e tɔmi ɔ, é ngɔ akpakpo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã bɔ.
É ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ akpakpo ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
E ji yayami pami bɔ.
Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he.
É tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.
Se e zɔ ɔ tsuo lɛɛ, é sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lohwehi nɛ a gbee nɛ a kɛ sãã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ a sãã a zɔ ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ yelɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke nyɛ kpɛti nɔ gu ko tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ, nɛ pi e yi mi nɛ e to kɛ pee yayami ɔ, ke a ha e na kaa e tɔ̃ ɔ, é ngɔ apletsi yo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ.
É ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ é gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ́ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.
É je zɔ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a jeɔ zɔ ngɛ lohwe nɛ a gbe kɛ ha tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ɔ mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ́ é je via ha Yawɛ.
Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke jijɔ nɔ ko kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ sami ɔ, e ngɔ jijɔ yo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba.
É ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ é gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.
É je e zɔ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a jeɔ zɔ ngɛ jijɔ nɛ a gbee kɛ sãã tue mi jɔmi bɔ he ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ ɔ kɛ piɛ bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ he.
Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Sanehi nɛ hia yayami pami bɔ sami Ke a tsɛ nɔ ko ke e ba ye odase ngɛ sane yemi he, nɛ nɔ ɔ de we nɔ́ nɛ e na, loo e le ngɛ munyu ɔ he ɔ, e pee yayami; a gbla e tue.
Ke nɔ ko li e he be, nɛ e ya ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he, we mi lohwe gbogboe jio, nga mi lohwe gbogboe jio, lohwe tsɔwi a gbogboe jio, nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ woɔ e he mu nɛ, e yeɔ fɔ.
Ke nɔ ko li e he be, nɛ e ya ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he, nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ nɔmlɔ mi jio, nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ e he jio, ke e ba na le nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ka kita nya mi gu kaa e maa pee nɔ́ ko, kpakpa jio, yaya jio, nɛ e li e he be ɔ, ke e ba na le ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ.
Ke nɔ ko na le kaa e ye fɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi ɔ, é jaje e tɔmi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ; nɛ é ngɔ jijɔ yo, loo apletsi yo kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã bɔ ɔ ha lɛ ngɛ e yayami ɔ he.
Ke nɔ ko be nyɛe ma ha jijɔ ɔ, é ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa e yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he bɔ.
Á ngɔ kake kɛ pee yayami pami bɔ, nɛ enyɔne ɔ, a kɛ pee sami bɔ.
Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ lahuɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ; nɛ lɛ hu e tsu yayami pami bɔ ɔ he ní kekle.
É ku lahuɛ ɔ kuɛ, se e ko tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya, nɛ é ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ fia bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
É tsle muɔ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.
Yayami pami bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, é ngɔ lohwe enyɔne ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a to ke a pee ɔ. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se ke nɔ ɔ be nyɛe ma ha lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ ɔ, lɛɛ é ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake kɛ ba kaa yayami pami bɔ.
E ko ngɔ nu, loo tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue nɔ, ejakaa e ji yayami pami bɔ.
E ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ mamu ɔ e dɛ kɔkɔ kake kaa bɔ ɔ tsuo nane mi dami okadi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã enɛ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Yayami pami bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mamu nɛ piɛ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔ nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ niye ní bɔ sami he ɔ. Fɔ yemi bɔ sami Yawɛ de Mose ke, ke nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Mawu, lɔ ɔ ji kaa e ha we Yawɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ sa nɛ e ha lɛ sisiisi ɔ, é ngɔ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba.
Lohwe ɔ jua nɛ pee bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Fɔ yemi bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ e ha we sisiisi, nɛ́ ba pee hiɔ nɛ ɔ, é wo.
Jehanɛ, é ngɔ hiɔ ɔ mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ bɔ he kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã fɔ yemi bɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami ɔ nɛ pa lɛ.
Ke nɔ ko li e he be, nɛ e pee yayami, nɛ e tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ, nɛ e sa nɛ a gbla e tue.
É ngɔ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be e he, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he jua kɛ lɛ sɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ kaa fɔ nɛ e ye ɔ he bɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kɛ sã bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ, nɛ a kɛ e he yayami ɔ maa pa lɛ.
E ji fɔ yemi bɔ, ejakaa e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko kɛ nɔ́ ko ba da e se, nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ kpale we nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ba ha we lɛ, loo e ju lɛ, loo e sisi lɛ ɔ, e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Jã kɛ̃, ke nɔ́ ko laa, nɛ nɔ ko na, se e to lakpa, nɛ e ka kita ke e nɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
-Ke nɔ ko pee yayami nɛ ɔmɛ eko ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ ji ɔ, e to nane mi sisiisi ha nɔ nɛ e tɔ̃ e nɔ ɔ. Ligbi nɛ a maa bu lɛ fɔ ɔ, e wo nɔ ɔ hiɔ ɔ sisiisi, nɛ e ngɔ nɔ́ ɔ jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ bɔ he ha nɔ ɔ. Jehanɛ hu, é ngɔ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be e he, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he jua kɛ lɛ sɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ kaa yayami nɛ e pee ɔ nane mi tomi nɔ́.
Osɔfo ɔ maa sã bɔ ɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ, nɛ a kɛ e he yayami tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ maa pa lɛ.
Bɔhi nɛ a sãã lohwe ɔ tsuo kulaa Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ke, mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ sami bɔ he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Sami bɔ ɔ nɛ hi bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si mɔtu; la a nɛ ko gbo ngɛ sisi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ wo e yi nɔ tade ɔ, kɛ e sisi tade ɔ nɛ a kɛ kploba kpɛ ɔ, konɛ e je la zu ɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je e tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e wo tade kpahi, konɛ e ngɔ la zu ɔ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ kɛ ya pue he ko nɛ tsɔ.
Á ha nɛ la a nɛ hi tsoe ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ko gbo.
Daa mɔtu ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ to lɛ́ kɛ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ mi.
É to sami bɔ ɔ ngɔ pue lɛ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sa zɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ɔ.
La nɛ hi bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ daa; e ko gbo gblegbleegble.
Niye ní bɔ sami Niye ní bɔ sami he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ ji osɔfo nɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
É piti mamu bukɔbukɔ, kɛ nu ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ngɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ tsuo e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, konɛ e je via liliili, nɛ e pee kaimi nɔ ha Yawɛ.
-Mamu nɛ piɛ ɔ peeɔ Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́.
A kɛ sã abolo kplolo nɛ a ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ mi.
Bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ haa Yawɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ fa nɛ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ kaa a blɔ fa mi nɔ́.
E ngɛ klɔuklɔu saminya kaa bɔ nɛ yayami pami, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, mɛɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ́.
Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose, nɛ kɔɔ bɔ nɛ a maa wo Aaron binyumu ko osɔfo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ a maa wo lɛ osɔfo ɔ, e ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake kaa daa ligbi niye ní bɔ kɛ ba.
É ngɔ fa kɛ sã bɔ mɔtu, nɛ é ngɔ fa hu kɛ sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ.
E kɛ nu nɛ si ngɛ ngɛyu mi, nɛ nu nɛ sɛ mi saminya, nɛ e ku mi tsɔwitsɔwi, konɛ e kɛ ba sã bɔ kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, Aaron nina tsuo nɛ ma ba sɔmɔ kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a, e sã bɔ nɛ ɔ. E sã lɛ tsuo kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Niye ní bɔ tsuaa niye ní bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa sã a, a ko ye ekoeko; a sã lɛ tsuo.
Yayami pami bɔhi Yawɛ fa Mose ke e wo Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɔɔ yayami pami bɔ he.
Lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, á gbe lɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ a gbeɔ lohwehi nɛ a kɛ sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. Bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa sã lohwe ɔ, e ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa sa lo nɛ ɔ he ɔ ma plɛ pee nɔ́ klɔuklɔu; ke e muɔ nɛ a fĩa a eko sɛ tade mi ɔ, a fɔ tade ɔ he ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Á ywia buɛ tsuaa buɛ nɛ a hoo lo nɛ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ; se ke akɔblee nɔ́ mi nɛ a hoo ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ a sa mi saminya, nɛ a kɛ nyu nɛ jale mi.
Nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ma nyɛ maa ye bɔ nɛ ɔ eko; e ji bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.
Se lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ e muɔ maa ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ba pee kpatami ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, a ko ye e lo ɔ; a sã.
Fɔ yemi bɔ Fɔ yemi bɔ sami he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
E ji bɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.
He nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ, á gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ̃.
A tsɛ̃ e muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsuo.
A ngɔ e zɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ sã bɔ ɔ: e hlemi ɔ, zɔ nɛ ngɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ nɛ ngɛ e mi si ɔ, kɛ e fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ha Yawɛ; fɔ yemi bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ma nyɛ maa ye.
Se a ye lɛ ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ejakaa e ji bɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.
Yayami pami bɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ kɛ̃.
Mlaa kake lɛ ngɛ ha mɛ tsuo; osɔfo nɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ kɛ pee kpatami ɔ, e nɔ́ ji lo ɔ nɛ.
Lohwe nɛ a kɛ sã sami bɔ ɔ he womi ɔ peeɔ osɔfo nɛ sã bɔ ɔ nɔ́.
Niye ní bɔ tsuaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a sã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi, aloo nɔ́ nɛ a si ngɛ kutu mi, loo ngɛ ngɛyu mi ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã bɔ ɔ nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Se niye ní bɔ saisaa nɛ a futu mi nu, loo a futuu we mi nu ɔ, osɔfo Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ; a dla lɛ fiee.
Tue mi jɔmi bɔhi Tue mi jɔmi bɔhi nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ a he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ma bɔ ɔ sami nɛ e kɛ na Yawɛ si ɔ, e ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ e lohwe nɛ e kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ he kɛ ba: abolo kplolo nɛ a wo mi nu, akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ kplolo sã nɛ a kpa he nu, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu saminya sã.
E ngɔ abolo nɛ a wo mi masa kɛ piɛ ní ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami kɛ na Yawɛ si ɔ a he kɛ ba.
Níhi nɛ a kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, e je mi kakaaka kɛ pee nike ní pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, enɛ ɔ maa pee e nɔ́.
A ye lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu; a ko si eko nɛ je nɛ e na yi.
Ke nɔ ko ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ; nɔ́ ko nɛ e wo he si jio, nɔ́ nɛ je e tsui mi faa jio, a ma nyɛ ye lo ɔ ligbi ɔ nɛ e kɛ ba a. Ke eko piɛ ɔ, a ye e nɔ jena.
Ligbi etɛne ɔ, ke lo ɔ eko piɛ ɔ, á sã.
Ke nɔ ko ye lo nɛ ye ligbi etɛ ɔ eko ɔ, Mawu be e bɔ sami ɔ he tsui nae, nɛ a be bue ha lɛ kaa e sã bɔ hulɔ.
A hiɔ; nɔ nɛ maa ye eko ɔ, e musu maa tloo lɛ.
Ke nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he sa lo nɛ ɔ he ɔ, á ko ye; á sã.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he tsɔ ngɛ he blɔ kaa e maa ye lo nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ eko.
Se nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we nɛ maa ye eko ɔ, á je lɛ we; á ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Jehanɛ hu, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he, nɔmlɔ jio, lohwe jio, bɔ nɔ́ ko jio, nɛ e maa ye lo nɛ a kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, á je lɛ we, á ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Yawɛ wo Mose mlaa nɛ ɔ ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, á ko ye zɔ, na zɔ jio, jijɔ zɔ jio, apletsi zɔ jio.
Ke lohwe ko gbo lɛ nitsɛ e gbenɔ, aloo lohwe awi yelɔ ko tsɔtslɔɔ e mi ɔ, a ko ye e zɔ ɔ; a ma nyɛ kɛ tsu nɔ́ kpa ko.
Ke a kɛ lohwe ko ba sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye e zɔ ɔ, á je lɛ we, nɛ á ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Jehanɛ hu, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ye lohwe pɛlitsɛ, loo nane eywiɛtsɛ ko muɔ ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye muɔ ɔ, á je lɛ we; a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ bɔ ɔmi eko kaa sina pɔtɛɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ.
Lɛ nitsɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ha Yawɛ.
É ngɔ zɔ ɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔ gugue ɔ he kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ á fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, se gugue ɔ lɛɛ, e maa pee Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́.
-Á ngɔ lohwe ɔ hiɔ fiɔ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ muɔ kɛ zɔ ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ kaa nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko.
E blɔ nya nɔ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lohwe ɔ gugue, kɛ e hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ji nike ní pɔtɛɛ nɛ Yawɛ he ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ.
Nike ní nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ be tsuaa be.
Bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ, Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha mɛ kɛ je be nɛ a wo mɛ osɔfo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ pɔ mɛ nu ɔ nɛ e fa Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ bɔ nɛ a sãã a mi fa nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ.
E ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ a nina tsuo kulaa yi nɔhi tsuo.
Mlaahi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha sami bɔ, niye ní bɔ, yayami pami bɔ, fɔ yemi bɔ, osɔfo womi bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yawɛ wo Mose mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ a nike ní kɛ ba ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a we osɔfo womi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, a tade ɔmɛ, nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ, na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kusii kɛ e mi abolo kplolo ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya; nɛ o kpee ma a tsuo kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ.” Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, nɛ benɛ ma a tsuo ba kpe ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Mose ngɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ e ba du a he ha mɛ.
E ngɔ yi nɔ tade ɔ ngɔ wo Aaron, nɛ e kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ fi e mlɛ mi, nɛ e wo lɛ tade klɔii ɔ. Jehanɛ e ngɔ tade nɛ a tsɛɛ efɔd ɔ ngɔ wo lɛ, nɛ e kɛ efɔd ɔ he kpa nɛ a lo lɛ saminyayoo ɔ fi efɔd ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ hiɔwe tade ɔ nɛ Urim kɛ Tumim ngɛ mi ɔ ngɔ wo lɛ.
E bu lɛ pɛɛ kɛ e hɛ mi sika tsu june nɛ ji jlasi klɔuklɔu kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ Mose ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ kɛ pɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ pee mɛ klɔuklɔu.
E kɛ nu ɔ eko fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ si kpaago kɛ pɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ kã a kɛ e sisi kla a nu, nɛ e kɛ tsukɔ a he.
E plɛ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ eko kɛ pue Aaron yi mi kɛ pɔ lɛ nu kɛ tsukɔ e he.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e ngɔ hiɔwe tadehi kɛ wo mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mlɛ mi fimi níhi fi a mlɛ mi ha mɛ, nɛ e bu mɛ pɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, Mose ngɔ na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine kɛ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi.
Mose gbe lohwe ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mose ngɔ zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a, kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a he zɔ ɔ tsuo, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Se lohwe ɔ he womi ɔ, e lo ɔ, kɛ e mi fĩ ɔmɛ lɛɛ, e ya sã ngɛ ma si tomi he ɔ se kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi.
Mose gbe lohwe ɔ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe.
-Jehanɛ, e saa agbosu ɔ, nɛ e poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ e fɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e nane ɔmɛ a he.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a, Mose sã e yi ɔ, zɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Niye ní bɔ nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ agbosu enyɔne ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ wo osɔfo ɔ hu kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue e yi mi.
Mose gbe lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ sa Aaron hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ eko sa e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku ɔ kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku ɔ he.
Jehanɛ Mose ngɔ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba nɛ e kɛ muɔ ɔ eko sa a hiɔ tue nya lo ɔmɛ, a hiɔ nine gɔleku ɔmɛ, kɛ a hiɔ nane gɔleku ɔmɛ hu a he; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe.
Jehanɛ, e ngɔ zɔ ɔ kɛ e hlemi ɔ, kɛ zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ. E je abolo kplolo kake, kɛ abolo nɛ a futu mi nu, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ kake kɛ je abolo kplolo nɛ ngɛ kusii nɛ maa si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ mi kɛ pue zɔ ɔ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ a nɔ.
E ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a wo nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Mose he ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ e sã mɛ kɛ piɛ sami bɔ ɔ he ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Osɔfo womi bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mose wo agbosu ɔ gugue ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ke a gbe agbosu kɛ pee kusumi kɛ wo osɔfo ɔ, Mose lɛɛ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ Mose ngɔ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ eko, kɛ muɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hu eko, nɛ e kɛ fĩa Aaron kɛ e tade ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a tade ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Mose pee enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsukɔ Aaron kɛ e tade ɔmɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a tade ɔmɛ a he.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose de Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ya hoo lo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ ngɔ abolo ɔ nɛ ngɛ kusii nɛ osɔfo womi bɔ sami ní ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ ye kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a ye ɔ.
Lo, loo abolo nɛ maa piɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ sã.
Nyɛɛ hi kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya ligbi kpaago.
Nyɛ ko je lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa su ligbi nɛ nyɛ maa gbe osɔfo womi kusumi ɔ nya.
Ejakaa ligbi kpaago nɛ a kɛ maa wo nyɛ osɔfo.
Nɔ́ nɛ a pee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, ja nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a pee, konɛ a kɛ je nyɛ he yayami.
Nyɛɛ hi kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi kpaago kɛ tsu ní tsumi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ ɔ; ke pi ja a, nyɛ ma gbo.
Bɔ nɛ a fa mi ke ma de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a pee ɔ.
Aaron sã bɔhi Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mose tsɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de Aaron ke, “Ngɔɔ na niheyo, kɛ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Ngɔɔ na niheyo ɔ kɛ sa yayami pami bɔ, nɛ o ngɔ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ.
De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ akpakpo kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a ngɔ na bi nɛ ye jeha kake, kɛ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sa sami bɔ.
Á ngɔ na ku, kɛ agbosu kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ nɛ a futu mi nu ɔ he.
Á pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ ma je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ.” A ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa mɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Mose de mɛ ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke nyɛɛ pee konɛ nyɛɛ na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose de Aaron ke, “Yaa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ o ya sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ sami bɔ kɛ je o kɛ ma a tsuo nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ.
Sãã bɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ je ma a he yayami ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a.” Aaron hɛ lɛ kɛ su bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e gbe na niheyo ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ. E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ya ha lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.
Jehanɛ, e sã zɔ ɔ kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se lohwe ɔ lo ɔ kɛ e he womi ɔ lɛɛ e ya sã mɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e gbe lohwe ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa sã sami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ. E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.
A ngɔ lohwe ɔ yi ɔ, kɛ lo ɔ nɛ a poo kpɔ nya kpɔ nya a kɛ ha lɛ, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fɔ mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ nane ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ pue sami bɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e sã mɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jehanɛ, e sã bɔ kɛ ha ma a. E nu akpakpo ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha ma a, nɛ e gbe lɛ, nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee lohwe ɔ nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he yayami pami ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ hu kɛ ba sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e sã niye ní bɔ ɔ. E piti ngma a e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ piɛ mɔtu sami bɔ ɔ he.
E gbe na ku ɔ, kɛ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ kɛ ha ma a. E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe.
Na ku ɔ zɔ ɔ, agbosu ɔ zɔ ɔ, kɛ hlemi ɔ, kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a, Aaron ngɔ mɛ ngɔ pue lohwe ɔmɛ a gugue ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ya sã mɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
