Kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa ke a pee ɔ, gugue ɔmɛ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ lɛɛ Aaron wo a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Benɛ Aaron sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ gbe nya a, e wo e nine nɔ ngɛ ma a nɔ nɛ e gbaa mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kple si kɛ je he nɛ e sã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, Mose kɛ Aaron sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ a je kpo ɔ, a gbaa ma a. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je kpo, nɛ ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ na.
Tlukaa a, Yawɛ ha nɛ la ba, nɛ e ba sã sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ zɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ. Benɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a he ose, nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si.
Nadab kɛ Abihu pee yayami Aaron binyumuhi, Nadab kɛ Abihu a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e ngɛyu, nɛ e je la ngɔ wo mi, nɛ e ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɔ pue nɔ, nɛ e kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi; se la nɛ ɔ he tsɔ we, ejakaa Yawɛ fa we mɛ ke a pee ja.
Tlukaa a, la je Yawɛ ngɔ ba sã mɛ, nɛ a gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de Aaron ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ nɛ.
E ke, ‘Nihi nɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ su ye he ɔ, ma tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha, nɛ a maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi.’ ” Se Aaron de we nɔ́ ko.
Mose tsɛ Aaron tsɛ nyɛminyumu Uziel bimɛ, Mishael kɛ Elzafan kɛ ba, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba muɔ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ho ma a sito he ɔ se ya.” A ba muɔ mɛ kɛ a he tade ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma sito he ɔ se ya kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de mɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose de Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, Eleazar kɛ Itamar ke, “Nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi he kɛ pue nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko hía nyɛ tadehi ngɛ nyɛ he hulɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo, nɛ Yawɛ mi mi ma fu ma a tsuo.
Se nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel we ɔ tsuo kulaa ma nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ nɛ a nyɛ ya ha gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ la sã a. Nyɛ ko je kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya kɛ ya he ko.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo; ejakaa a kɛ Yawɛ nu pɔ nyɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de ɔ. Mlaa nɛ a wo osɔfo ɔmɛ Yawɛ kɛ Aaron tu munyu, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “O kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó nu wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo.
Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Nyɛɛ le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu, kɛ nɔ́ gu a kpɛti, nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ́ imi Yawɛ, i wo mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ.” Jehanɛ, Mose de Aaron kɛ e binyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ, nɛ ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar ke, “Niye ní bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ; nyɛ ko wo mi masa nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya, ejakaa e he tsɔ saminya.
Nyɛɛ ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ haa Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛ blɔ fami nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ to ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Se lohwe ɔ gugue nɛ a fɔɔ, kɛ fiɔ ɔ nɛ a woɔ nɔ́ ɔ, o kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ nɛ ye ngɛ he ko nɛ tsɔ; ejakaa tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba sãã a, o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Fiɔ ɔ, kɛ gugue ɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, á ngɔ kɛ piɛ zɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã a he kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Fiɔ ɔ, kɛ gugue ɔ maa pee o kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ nyɛ nɔ́ kɛ yaa neneene kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a.” Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, Mose hla mi fitsofitso konɛ e le nɔ́ ko ngɛ apletsi ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ he.
Benɛ e na le kaa a sã lɛ momo ɔ, e mi mi fu Eleazar kɛ Itamar, Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ yi yayami pami bɔ ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ?
Nyɛ li kaa e ji nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ Mawu kɛ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ je ma a he yayami kɛ kpata Yawɛ kɛ ha mɛ lo?
Nɛ nyɛ ngɔɛ e muɔ ɔ kɛ yɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ ye bɔ sami ní ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛkɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa nyɛ ɔ.” Aaron he nɔ ke, “O nɛ, mwɔnɛ ɔ, ma a ngɔ a he yayami pami bɔ ɔ, kɛ a sami bɔ ɔ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba ye nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Kaa i ye yayami pami bɔ nɛ ɔ eko mwɔnɛ ɔ, e ko sa Yawɛ hɛ mi lo?” Benɛ Mose nu munyu nɛ ɔ, munyu ɔ da ha lɛ.
Lohwehi nɛ á ye Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gu Mose kɛ Aaron nɔ kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Lohwe tsuaa lohwe nɛ a gba e nane koklotohi a mi, nɛ e gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ye ɔ nɛ e kpaleɔ taa ekohu ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye.
-Se nyɛ ko ye enɛ ɔmɛ: afukpɔngɔ, tɛ sa nɔ kpi, kɛ alɔngɔ, ejakaa a gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ a ye ɔ nɛ a kpaleɔ taa ekohu lɛɛ, se a gba we a nane kokloto mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a he tsɔ we.
Nyɛ ko ye kpotoo, e he tsɔ we, ejakaa a gba e nane kokloto mi lɛɛ, se e gɔle we nɔ́ nɛ e ye ɔ nɛ e ta ekohu.
Nyɛ ko ye lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko ta a gbogboe he hulɔ; a he tsɔ we.
Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye lo nɛ ɔmɛ: lo tsuaa lo nɛ ngɛ se ngmo kɛ toto.
Se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wami ngɛ e mi ngɛ wo loo pa mi, nɛ e be se ngmo kɛ toto ɔ, nyɛ ko ye.
A he tsɔ we; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye, nɛ nyɛ ko ta a gbogboe he hulɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyu mi nɛ wami ngɛ e mi, se e be se ngmo kɛ toto ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we.
-Nyɛ ko ye lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ a henɔ nɛ ɔmɛ: kɔle, okpoku, pa nɔ kɔle, kayo, kɔɔkɔmite, duguma, anuma, nyɔ mi kayo, klomi, nga mi kpakpahe, pa nɔ kayo, omiɔhɔɔ, kpokukpoku, godo, kɔne, loo apani.
Nyɛ ko ye lohwe tsɔwi nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ tee, ja ní nɛmɛ nɛ tuu ɔ. Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye baalɛ, apã, adodo, kɛ a henɔ ɔmɛ.
Se lohwe tsɔwi nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ tee kpahi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we.
-Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu: lohwehi tsuo nɛ a gba we a nane kokloto mi, nɛ a gɔle we nɔ́ nɛ a ye ɔ nɛ a ta ekohu, kɛ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ be kokloto, se a nyɛɛ ngɛ a nine a nɔ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a he tsɔ we.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta eko gbogboe he ɔ bleɔ e he.
Ke nɔ ko ble e he ja a, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he; se kɛ ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Lohwehi nɛ sãã si ngɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ a he tsɔ we ha nyɛ ji kɔkɔbo, kɔkue, ve, kɛ e henɔ ɔmɛ, tsunyɛ, nyaka, akɔtɔku, angmlɔ, kɛ akpasi.
A he tsɔ we, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta eko gbogboe he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe maa sa he ɔ, e he be tsɔe; tso a kɛ pee nɔ ɔ jio, bo jio, lohwe he womi jio, kotoku jio, nɔ́ saisaa jio.
Á kɛ nyu nɛ fɔ he, se nɔ́ ɔ he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Ke lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe ko ya nɔ buɛ mi ɔ, e bleɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, á ywia buɛ ɔ. Ke buɛ nɛ ɔ mi nyu ɔ eko pue niye ní ko nɔ ɔ, niye ní ɔ he be tsɔe.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a nuu nɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a buɛ ɔ mi ɔ he be tsɔe.
Jehanɛ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kikɛmɛ a lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe maa nɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he be tsɔe, la tɛ jio, flɔɔnɔɔ jio, á ywia nɔ́ ɔ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.
Ke lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe ya nɔ nyu hɛngmɛ, loo nyu nɔ́ ko mi ɔ, nyu ɔ he tsɔ; se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa sa a gbogboe he ɔ he tsɔ we.
Ke lohwe gbogboe ɔ he ko nɔ wu nɛ a yaa du nɔ ɔ, e be wu ɔ blee, se ke a wo wu ɔ nyu nɛ lohwe gbogboe nɔ nɔ ɔ, e bleɔ lɛ.
Jehanɛ, ke lohwehi nɛ a yeɔ ɔ eko gbo ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa ta e gbogboe ɔ he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Ke nɔ ko ye lo nɛ ɔ eko ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he.
Se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa kɛ̃ e gbogboe ɔ bleɔ e he; ke nɔ ko ble e he ja a, nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, se e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Lohwehi nɛ sãã si ɔ, a he tsɔ we; nyɛ ko ye.
Ke a sãã si ngɛ a mi nɔ jio, a nane eywiɛ nɔ jio, a nane babauu nɔ jio, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we.
Nyɛ ko ta lohwehi nɛ sãã si ɔ eko he.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ bleɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ he tsɔ we.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; ejakaa Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ji mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lohwehi nɛ sãã si ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ ekoeko kɛ ble nyɛ he.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
Imi nɛ I je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma ba pee nyɛ Mawu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; ejakaa Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ji mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ adebɔ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyu mi, kɛ adebɔ níhi tsuo nɛ sãã si ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, mlaa nɛ kɔɔ a he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Mlaa nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ we a kpɛti, kɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lohwehi nɛ a yeɔ, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a yi a kpɛti.
Yihi a he tsukɔmi ngɛ fɔmi se Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ke yo ko ngɔ hɔ nɛ e fɔ binyumu ɔ, e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago, kaa bɔ nɛ e he be tsɔe, ke e ku nine ɔ. Ke binyumu ɔ ye ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, á po lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bi nyɛ ɔ he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si ligbi nyingmi etɛ kɛ etɛ se loko e he ma tsɔ.
Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, e ko ta nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu he, nɛ e ko ya he klɔuklɔu ɔ hulɔ, kɛ yaa si be nɛ e maa tsukɔ e he kɛ gbe nya, ngɛ muɔ nɛ be ngɛ e he ɔ he.
Se ke biyo e fɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e he be tsɔe otsi enyɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e he be tsɔe, ke e ku nine ɔ. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si ligbi nyingmi ekpa kɛ ekpa nɛ e maa tsukɔ e he kɛ gbe nya.
Ke yo ɔ gbe e he tsukɔmi ɔ nya ngɛ binyumu, loo biyo fɔmi se ɔ, e ngɔ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake, kɛ lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ kake kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ jijɔ ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ.
Lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ e pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ yo ɔ he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha yihi tsuo nɛ ma fɔ binyumu, loo biyo.
Ke yo ɔ be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ jijɔ bi ma ba sã bɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba.
E ngɔ kake kɛ ba sã sami bɔ, nɛ e ngɔ kake hu kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ yo ɔ he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.
He womi nɔ hiɔ yaya he mlaahi Yawɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ.
Ke nɔfu nɔ́ ko, aloo pa, loo loholoho ba nɔ ko he, nɛ́ ma nyɛ maa pee he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a, a ngɔ hiɔtsɛ ɔ kɛ ba osɔfo ɔ, nɛ ji Aaron nina a ngɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ e he womi ɔ he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ke bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsake pee futaa, nɛ lejɛ ɔ lo ɔ hu nɔ mi ɔ, lɛɛ e ji he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya.
Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ ta a, e ma ha nɛ a le kaa nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we.
Se ke he womi ɔ nɔ he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ ngɛ futaa, nɛ ke a hyɛ ɔ, e nɔɛ lo mi, nɛ pohu bwɔmi ɔ be futaa hulɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.
Ligbi kpaagone ɔ nɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu.
Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ nɛ e na kaa hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, se he kake ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, e tsi e nya ligbi kpaago ekohu.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e hyɛ lɛ ekohu.
Ke e na kaa he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ yu, nɛ hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si ngɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ he womi nɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a le kaa hiɔtsɛ ɔ he tsɔ; ejakaa e ji nɔfu nɔ́ kɛkɛ.
Hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ.
Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ nɛ e ha a le kaa e he tsɔ, nɛ pee se ɔ, nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ bɔni si hami ɔ, hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e he ba tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ ekohu.
Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ, nɛ e na kaa nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ha si ɔ, e ha nɛ a le kaa e he tsɔ we; he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ e hyɛ lɛ.
Ke e na nɔfu nɔ́ ko ngɛ e he womi nɔ, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee futaa, nɛ bua ba nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ, lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ se kɛ nɔ ɔ ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a nu sisi kaa e he tsɔ we.
A ko tsi e nya; ejakaa e fɔɔ si paa kaa e he tsɔ we.
Ke osɔfo ɔ na kaa hiɔ ɔ je kpo ngɛ e he womi nɔ, nɛ e ha hiɔtsɛ ɔ he womi nɔ kulaa kɛ je e yi je kɛ ya pue e nanewɛɛ ɔ, e hyɛ lɛ ekohu.
Ke e na nɔ́ ɔ kaa e ha e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo he ɔ, e ha nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ.
Ke e he womi ɔ tsuo pee futaa a, e he tsɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Se ke pa he je kpo ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e he tsɔ we.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ ɔ pa he ɔ, e ha nɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ we.
Pa he ɔ nɛ je kpo ɔ tsɔɔ kaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ; nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we.
Ke pa a gbo, nɛ e he womi lo ɔ pee futaa ekohu ɔ, hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ kpale ba na osɔfo ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu.
Ke e na kaa hiɔtsɛ ɔ he womi ɔ pee futaa a, e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ.
E he tsɔ niinɛ.
Ke tslɔɔ pa doku ngɛ nɔ ko he womi nɔ, nɛ nɔfu nɔ́ futaa, loo nɔ́ futaa nɛ tsutsuu su bɔɔ ngɛ mi je kpo ngɛ pa doku ɔ mi ɔ, e kɛ ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ. Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ, nɛ e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee futaa a, e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we; he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ́ je kpo ngɛ tslɔɔ mi nɔ ɔ ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ.
Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ, nɛ e na kaa bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee we futaa, nɛ e nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ, se nɔ́ ɔ fani ɔ, lɛɛ e tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.
Ke nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ hiɔ ɔ e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we.
Se ke nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ he kake, nɛ e hɛ́ si ɔ, lɛɛ e ji tslɔɔ pa doku kɛkɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ.
Ke la sã nɔ ko nɛ e pee pa, nɛ pa a pee loholoho futaa, loo futaa nɛ tsutsuu bɔɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ.
Ke e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ loholoho ɔ mi ɔ pee futaa a, lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ je e he kpo ngɛ la pa a mi ɔ nɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we.
Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ nɔ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee we futaa, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ, se e fani ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi e nya ligbi kpaago.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nɛ ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ si hae ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we; ejakaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ he kake, nɛ e hɛ́ si ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ, se e fani mohu ɔ, lɛɛ nɔfu nɔ́ nɛ je kpo ngɛ pa a mi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ, ejakaa e ji la pa doku kɛkɛ.
Ke nɔ́ ko pue nyumu ko, loo yo ko yi mi, loo e kpɛni he ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ.
Ke he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hɛɛ kungwɔ zɔ su, nɛ e pee dleledlele ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa yi mi, loo kpɛni mi he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ plɛɛ nɔ e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ; e he tsɔ we.
Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ hiɔ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔɛ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi yumu hu be mi ɔ, lɛɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e hyɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ ekohu.
Ke hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ hɛɛ kungwɔ zɔ su be mi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ hu nɔɛ lo mi ɔ, lɛɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ sɛ lejɛ ɔ bwɔmi ɔ pɛ kɛ bɔle nɔ́ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ plɛe ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago ekohu.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ hiɔ ɔ ekohu.
Ke hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, nɛ e nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ.
Hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.
Ke benɛ a ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ se nɛ hiɔ ɔ bɔni si hami ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu.
Ke e na kaa hiɔ ɔ ha si ɔ, osɔfo ɔ ko hao e he kaa e ma pa hla bwɔmi nɛ hɛɛ kungwɔ zɔ su nɛ e na; e fɔɔ si paa kaa hiɔtsɛ ɔ he tsɔ we.
Se ke osɔfo ɔ ma nɔ mi kaa hiɔ ɔ ta, nɛ bwɔmi yumu puɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ hiɔ ɔ jɔ niinɛ, nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ he tsɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ.
Ke ngmo pue nyumu ko, loo yo ko he, nɛ e he womi ɔ pee huataa a, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ.
Ke ngmo ɔ su ngɛ kaa la zu huataa a, lɛɛ e ji kó kɛkɛ nɛ je kpo ngɛ e he womi nɔ; nɔ ɔ he tsɔ.
Ke bwɔmi ta nyumu yi mi ɔ, e yi mi kɛkɛ lɛ kpa; se e he tsɔ.
Ke bwɔmi ta nyumu hɛ nya a, e hɛ nya kɛkɛ lɛ kpa; se e he tsɔ.
Ke nɔ́ ɔ tsuɔ, loo e hɛɛ ba mumu su ɔ, lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ pue e yi ɔ he nɛ kpa a nɛ.
Se ke nɔ́ ko futaa nɛ tsutsuu bɔɔ fia mi pue nɔ ɔ yi mi, loo e hɛ nya he nɛ kpa a, lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ je kpo ngɛ e yi ɔ mi, kɛ e hɛ nya he nɛ kpa a nɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ.
Ke e na kaa nɔ́ nɛ pue nɔ ɔ yi mi, loo e hɛ nya a ngɛ futaa nɛ tsutsuu bɔɔ fia mi ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we; ejakaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ ngɛ e yi mi ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, é wo tade gbagbɛ, é ngmɛɛ e yi bwɔmi he kɛ pue e nɔ, e ha e nya nɔ, nɛ e hi ngmlaa kpae ke, “Ye he tsɔ we oo, ye he tsɔ we!” E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si be nɛ e hiɔ ɔ maa ta; nɛ lɛ nɔ kake nɛ e maa hi si ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se.
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ fu ja he Ke he hami nɔ́ ko fu ja a, kuutu jio, kploba jio, bo nɛ a kɛ kuutu kpa, loo kploba kpa lo jio, lohwe he womi, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee jio, ke nɔ́ fu ja a tsuɔ, loo e hɛɛ ba mumu su ɔ, e maa pee kaa nɔ́ yaya lɛ ngɛ ja fue ngɛ he hami nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; a ngɔ kɛ ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e tsi heha nɔ́ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.
Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ ekohu.
Ke nɔ́ fu ja a ha si ngɛ he hami nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ e ji nɔ fu ja yaya, e he tsɔ we.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã he hami nɔ́ ɔ. Hiɔ yaya ji nɔ́ nɛ sɛ nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; e hia kaa a sã.
Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa nɔ́ fu ja a hɛ́ si ngɛ he hami nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ, e ha nɛ a fɔ he, nɛ e tsi nya ligbi kpaago ekohu.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ; ke nɔ́ fu ja a su tsakee we, nɛ e hɛ́ si hulɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ we; nyɛɛ sã.
Nɔ́ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ fu ja a jio, e se mi jio, á sã.
Se ke a fɔ nɔ́ ɔ he se, nɛ osɔfo ɔ hyɛ ekohu nɛ e na kaa nɔ́ nɛ sɛ mi ɔ ngɛ laae ɔ, e hia he nɛ fu ja a kɛ je nɔ́ ɔ he, he hami nɔ́ jio, lohwe he womi jio.
Jehanɛ, ke nɔtsɛ ɔ na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ ja fue kɛ ngɛ si hae ngɛ he hami nɔ́, loo lohwe he womi ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a sã nɔ́ ɔ. Ke e fɔ nɔ́ ɔ he, nɛ e na kaa nɔ́ yaya a je mi pɛsɛɛ ɔ, e fɔ he ekohu si enyɔne, kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he ma tsɔ kulaa.
Mlaa nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ́ fu ja ngɛ he hami ní nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: he hami nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kuutu, loo kploba pee jio, bo nɛ a kɛ kuutu, loo kploba kpa lo jio, lohwe he womi, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee jio.
Enɛ ɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ, loo e he tsɔ we.
He womi nɔ hiɔ yaya numi se he tsukɔmi - Yawɛ wo Mose mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ tsɔɔ kusumi nɛ a pee kɛ tsukɔ nɔ ko nɛ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ he.
Ligbi nɛ a ma ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ nɛ ba osɔfo ɔ ngɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ e ya hyɛ lɛ.
Ke e na kaa hiɔ ɔ ta ngɛ nɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa nɛ a kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ enyɔ, seda tso, kɔjai, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ nɛ ba.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fa nɛ a gbe lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ kake ngɛ zu buɛ nɛ nyu mua ngɛ mi nɔ, konɛ e ngɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, seda tso ɔ, kɔjai ɔ, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ ngɛ nyu mua nɔ ɔ muɔ ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ, é fĩa muɔ ɔ si kpaago kɛ pue nɔ nɛ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ nɔ, nɛ é ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, é ngmɛɛ lohwe hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ he nɛ é te kɛ ho nga mi ya.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é sɛ e he bwɔmi tsuo, nɛ é du e he; kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ.
E ma nyɛ maa ba ma sito he ɔ, se e be e bo tsu ɔ mi hwɔe; e maa hi e bo tsu ɔ se ligbi kpaago.
Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ sɛ e yi kpalokpalo; é sɛ e kpɛni kɛ e hɛngmɛ se bwɔmi, kɛ e he bwɔmi tsuo kulaa.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he, kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, é ngɔ agbosu enyɔ nɛ kpa ko be a he, kɛ jijɔ yo nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ lɛ hu kpa ko be e he, kɛ níye ní bɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi, kɛ nu lita fa kɛ ba.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa tsukɔ nɔ ɔ he ha lɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ, kɛ e ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake kɛ piɛ nu lita fa a he kɛ ba kaa fɔ yemi bɔ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
É gbe agbosu ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa yayami pami bɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ; e ngɛ klɔuklɔu saminya.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ a kɛ ba sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ e muɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he.
Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ plɛ nu ɔ eko kɛ wo lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ dɛ kɔkɔ mi.
É kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ kake nɛ sɔ nu ɔ mi, nɛ é fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
É ngɔ nu ɔ nɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ eko nɛ e kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he.
E ngɔ lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ hu muɔ kɛ pee ja nɔuu.
Nu ɔ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ osɔfo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, e kɛ pue nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ yi mi.
Ke nɔ ko nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a, kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, é gbe lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ e sã mɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.
Ke ohiatsɛ ji nɔ ɔ, nɛ e be ní ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛe ma ha a, e ngɔ agbosu kake pɛ kɛ pee fɔ yemi bɔ, nɛ a fɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Níhi nɛ e ngɔ kɛ piɛ he ji mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake, nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi ha niye ní bɔ, nu tɔ kake, kɛ lahuɛ enyɔ, aloo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ.
Kake maa pee yayami pami bɔ, nɛ kake hu maa pee sami bɔ.
E he tsukɔmi be ɔ, ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ, kɛ nu ɔ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ, é gbe agbosu ɔ, nɛ é ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ plɛ nu ɔ eko kɛ wo lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ nine dɛ kɔkɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ e hiɔ nine nguɛ kake kɛ sɔ nu ɔ mi nɛ e fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ nu nɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ muɔ ɔ pee ɔ. Nu nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ osɔfo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, e kɛ pue nɔ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ e he tsukɔe ɔ yi mi.
Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ e ngɔ lahuɛ ɔ kake, loo beleku lahuɛ ɔ kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kake ɔ hu nɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ he.
Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue, nɛ be nyɛe ma ha ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ e he ɔ, mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wehi nɛ a he fu ja Yawɛ ha Mose kɛ Aaron mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɔɔ wehi nɛ a he fu ja a he.
Ke Israel bi ɔmɛ ya su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ kaa a weto ní ɔ nɔ ɔ, mlaa nɛ sa kaa a ye nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na nɔ́ ko nɛ fu ja ngɛ e we he ɔ, e ha nɛ osɔfo nɛ le.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fa nɛ a je nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kpo, loko e ya hyɛ he nɛ fu ja a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ kaa e he tsɔ we.
Ke a je ní ɔmɛ kpo ta a, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ya we ɔ mi nɛ e ya hyɛ he nɛ fu ja a. Ke e na nɔ́ tsu, loo nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛ ba mumu su nɛ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ a nga we ɔ nya ligbi kpaago.
Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ kpale ya hyɛ ekohu.
Ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ, e fa nɛ a je tɛhi nɛ nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ a he ɔ kɛ je gli ɔ mi, nɛ a ya sake mɛ ngɔ pue kuku nɔ ngɛ ma a se.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a ngmla gli ɔ tsuo he ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a bua zu ɔ nya kɛ ya pue he ngɛ kuku nɔ ngɛ ma a se.
Jehanɛ, á ngɔ tɛ kpahi kɛ tsi puɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ́ a ngɔ zu kpa kɛ kã gli ɔmɛ a he.
Se ke a tsake tɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ngmla gli ɔ he, nɛ a kpale kã gli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ lɔ ɔ se a na kaa lejɛ ɔ fu ja ekohu ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ kpale ya hyɛ ekohu.
Ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ, lɛɛ e ji nɔ́ yaya nɛ maa ye awi; we ɔ he tsɔ we.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a ku we ɔ kɛ pue si nɛ a muɔ tɛ ɔmɛ, tso ɔmɛ, kɛ zu ɔ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya pue kuku nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa sɛ we ɔ mi, be mi nɛ a nga we ɔ nya a, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hwɔ we ɔ mi, loo e maa ye ní ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he.
Se ke a kɛ zu kpa kã gli ɔ he, nɛ lɔ ɔ se osɔfo ɔ ba hyɛ, nɛ e nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ he ɔ, e ha nɛ a le kaa we ɔ he tsɔ; ejakaa a je nɔ́ nɛ fu ja a tsuo kɛ je gli ɔ mi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ enyɔ, seda tso, kɔjai, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ kɛ ba, konɛ a kɛ julaa we ɔ. É gbe lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔmɛ a ti kake ngɛ zu buɛ nɛ nyu mua ngɛ mi nɔ.
Jehanɛ, é ngɔ seda tso ɔ, nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ ɔ, kɔjai ɔ, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ muɔ ɔ, kɛ nyu mua a mi, nɛ e kɛ fĩa we ɔ he si kpaago.
Bɔ nɛ e kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ muɔ, nyu mua a, lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, seda tso ɔ, nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ ɔ, kɛ kɔjai ɔ maa julaa we ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngmɛɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ he nɛ e te kɛ ya nga mi.
Kusumi nɛ e maa pee kɛ julaa we ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, we ɔ he ma tsɔ.
Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛ ha he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya, -sakpa, loo nɔfu nɔ́, loo tslɔɔ, he hami nɔ́ nɛ fu ja, loo we nɛ hiɔ yaya nɛ ɔ sɛ gli ɔ mi.
Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko he tsɔ we kɛ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ.
Nyu yaya nɛ bee ngɛ nɔmlɔ he Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ke nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ nyumu ko he ɔ, nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ bee ɔ ha nyumu ɔ he tsɔ we.
Ke nyu yaya a ngɛ bee jio, e ha e nyumu tso mi tsi jio, nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we.
Sa tsuaa sa nɛ nyumu nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ maa hwɔ nɔ, loo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa hi nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ we.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta sa a he ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hi nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔ nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e nyumu tso mi ɔ he ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Ke nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ la lada pue nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he.
E he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Lohwe se mi sɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ maa hi nɔ ɔ he be tsɔe.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔ ɔ hi nɔ he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tloo jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Ke nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ nɔ ko he, nɛ e fɔ we e dɛ, nɛ e ta nɔ ko he ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ e ta e he ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Zu buɛ saisaa nɛ nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ maa ta he ɔ, a ywia lɛ, se tso sowe nɛ e maa ta he lɛɛ a fɔ he.
Ke nɔ nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ hiɔ ɔ ta a, e mlɛ ligbi kpaago loko e tsukɔ e he, nɛ e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ya du e he ngɛ pa mi, kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, e ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ngɛ nyu yaya nɛ be ngɛ e he ɔ he.
Ke nyumu ko he nyu be ngɛ e he ɔ, e du e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Sa nɔ bo, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee, nɛ nyumu ɔ he nyu nɛ ɔ ma pue nɔ ɔ, á fɔ he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Ke nyumu kɛ yo na bɔmi nɛ nyumu ɔ he nyu be ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a du a he.
A he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Ke yo ko ku nine ɔ, e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta e he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa hi nɔ, loo e maa hwɔ nɔ be mi nɛ e ku nine ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he be tsɔe.
-Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta sa, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ yo nɛ ɔ hi nɔ ɔ he ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Ke nyumu ko kɛ yo nɛ ɔ na bɔmi be mi nɛ e ku nine ɔ, jamɛ a nyumu ɔ ble e he, nɛ e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago.
Sa tsuaa sa nɛ e maa hwɔ nɔ ɔ hu he be tsɔe.
Ke muɔ be ngɛ yo ko he be saii, be mi nɛ e nine kumi be sui lolo, aloo ke e be ɔ su, nɛ muɔ ɔ be kɛ be nɔ ɔ, e he be tsɔe ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ muɔ ɔ ngɛ bee ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e he be tsɔe, be mi nɛ e ku nine ɔ. Sa tsuaa sa nɛ e maa hwɔ nɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa hi nɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he be tsɔe.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e he be tsɔe.
Nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
Ke muɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ bee ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ he ɔ se po ɔ, e maa hi si ligbi kpaago loko e he ma tsɔ.
Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ, yo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake ɔ hu kɛ sã sami bɔ.
Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha yo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ de Mose ke e slɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he nɛ tsɔ we ɔ he, konɛ a ko ble Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ. Ke pi ja a, a ma gbo.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ji mlaahi nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nyumu nɛ nyu yaya, loo nyumu he nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e he, nɛ haa e he tsɔ we ɔ, kɛ yo hu nɛ ku nine, loo nyumu nɛ e kɛ yo na bɔmi be mi nɛ yo ɔ ku nine, nɛ e he tsɔ we ɔ.
Kpatami ligbi ɔ Benɛ Aaron binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ la nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ ya Yawɛ hɛ mi nɛ a gbo se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu.
E de lɛ ke, “De o nyɛminyumu Aaron ke e ko ya he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ se be saisaa, konɛ e ko gbo.
Ejakaa lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i jeɔ ye he kpo ngɛ ngɛ bɔku mi, ngɛ somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.
E ma nyɛ maa ya he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ke e hɛɛ na niheyo kɛ ha yayami pami bɔ sami, nɛ e hɛɛ agbosu hu kɛ ha sami bɔ.” Jehanɛ Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ Aaron maa sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, é du e he, nɛ é wo osɔfo tade klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ: kploba yi nɔ tade klɔuklɔu ɔ, sisi tade ɔmɛ, kɛ kploba mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ é bu kploba pɛɛ ɔ. Aaron nɛ he akpakpo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ agbosu kake nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo dɛ.
É sã na ku ɔ kaa yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ é kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ kɛ e we ɔ. Jehanɛ, é ngɔ akpakpo enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
É fɔ a nɔ sɔ.
Yawɛ nɔ́ kake, kɛ Azazel nɔ́ kake.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ sɔ ɔ je ɔ, a kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Azazel nɔ́ ɔ je ɔ, a kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ a kɛ ba kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a je lɛ we kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya kɛ ya ha Azazel.
Ke Aaron maa sã na ku ɔ kaa yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ e we ɔ, e ngɔ ngɛyu kɛ je la ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e piti tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a wɛɛ lɛ bukɔbukɔ dɛ kɔkɔ enyɔ, nɛ e kɛ sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. E ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via a ngɔ pue la a mi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e wo la su ku nɛ mi ti kɛ tsi somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Aaron ko na somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e ba gbo.
É ngɔ na ku ɔ muɔ eko, nɛ e kɛ e nine nguɛ nɛ sɔ mi nɛ e kɛ fĩa somi daka nya nɔ ɔ hɛ mi.
É kɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ fĩa somi daka nitsɛ hu hɛ mi si kpaago.
Jehanɛ, é gbe akpakpo ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ sami ha ma a. É ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, nɛ e ya fĩa kɛ pue somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, kɛ somi daka a he kɛ kpe kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ na ku ɔ muɔ ɔ pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
É pee kusumi nɛ ɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a musuhi nɛ a bɔ, mlaahi a nɔ nɛ a tɔ, kɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ tsuo kulaa he.
É pee kusumi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ hulɔ; ejakaa e ngɛ ma sito he ɔ he nɛ a ble ɔ. Kɛ je be nɛ Aaron maa sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a nɛ e ya pee kusumi nɛ ɔ, kɛ yaa si e maa je kpo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ya bo tsu ɔ mi.
Ke e pee kusumi nɛ e kɛ kpata Yawɛ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ e we ɔ, kɛ ma a tsuo gbe nya a, é je kpo kɛ ya bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ he, nɛ e ya kpata Yawɛ kɛ ha la tɛ ɔ. É ngɔ na ku ɔ muɔ ɔ eko, kɛ akpakpo ɔ hu muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he.
É ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ fĩa muɔ ɔ eko kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ si kpaago.
É tsukɔ he, nɛ é pee lɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ yayamihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee kɛ ble la tɛ ɔ he.
Musu kpami to Ke Aaron pee kusumi ɔ kɛ tsukɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he gbe nya a, é ngɔ akpakpo hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi.
É ngɔ e nine enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue akpakpo ɔ yi mi, nɛ e jaje kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ pee yayami, a tɔ mlaa, nɛ a gbo tue.
Aaron nɛ ngɔ yayami nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ pue akpakpo ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ akpakpo ɔ kɛ ha nɔ ko nɛ a hla kɛ to, nɛ e fie lɛ kɛ ho nga nɔ ya, nɛ e ya ngmɛɛ e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Akpakpo ɔ maa tloo Israel bi ɔmɛ a he musu tsuo kɛ maa ho zugba nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ ɔ nɔ ya.
Jehanɛ, Aaron nɛ sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ é je e we osɔfo tade ɔmɛ nɛ e wo kɛ ya sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa kɛ pue lejɛ ɔ. É du e he ngɛ he ko nɛ tsɔ, nɛ é wo lɛ nitsɛ e tade ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ, é je kpo nɛ e ya sã sami bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, kɛ ma a hulɔ.
Lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ ɔ sami ɔ, e sã e zɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ ɔ nɛ fie to ɔ kɛ ya ha Azazel ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ nɛ e wo ɔ a he, nɛ e du e he loko e ba ma sito he ɔ. Na ku ɔ, kɛ akpakpo ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ a muɔ ɔ ba kpata Yawɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, a ngɔ mɛ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya sã mɛ.
A sã lohwe he womi ɔmɛ, lo ɔ, kɛ a fĩ ɔ tsuo.
Nɔ nɛ maa sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he loko é ba ma sito he ɔ. Kpatami ligbi ɔ yemi Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene.
Nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a, Israel fɔfɔɛ, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti tsuo maa ha hwɔ, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko tsue.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha mɛ kɛ tsukɔ a he kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa mi, konɛ a he nɛ tsɔ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ maa pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko tsue; nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ha hwɔ.
Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ fɔɔ si ha mɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ a tsukɔ e he, nɛ a wo lɛ osɔfo ngɛ e tsɛ nane mi ɔ nɛ wo osɔfo tade ɔmɛ, nɛ é pee kpatami kusumi ɔmɛ.
E maa tsukɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a he.
Á ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya neneene.
Daa jeha a, a maa pee kusumi nɛ ɔ si kake kɛ kpata Mawu ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ muɔ he Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ke mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
-Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko gbe na, loo jijɔ, loo apletsi ngɛ he kpa ko nɛ pi kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e tɔ mlaa.
Jamɛatsɛ ɔ pue muɔ si.
Á je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Mlaa nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a gbee ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Á gbe lohwe ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fĩa muɔ ɔ kɛ pue Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, konɛ é sã zɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jee via ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ ma ha Israel bi ɔmɛ maa jɔɔ bɔ sami ha mumi yayamihi nɛ hɛɛ apletsi su nɛ a jee Mawu se nɛ a ya jaa a. Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha mɛ, kɛ a nina kɛ yaa neneene.
Jehanɛ hu, de mɛ ke, ke Israel fɔfɔɛ, aloo nɔ ko nɛ ba to mɛ nubwɔ maa sã sami bɔ, loo bɔ kpa ko kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e ngɔɛ kɛ bɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko, aloo nɔ ko nɛ ba to nyɛ nubwɔ ye muɔ ɔ, ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ. Ma je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa he lo tsuaa he lo wami.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a ngɔ muɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ kpa musu ɔ nɛ.
Muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kpaa musu, ejakaa wami ngɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ko ye muɔ ɔ nɛ; mɛ jio, nɔ ko nɛ ba to mɛ nubwɔ jio.
Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nɔ ko nɛ ba to mɛ nubwɔ ya da de nɛ e gbe lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ, loo pɛlitsɛ nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, é dɛ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue si, nɛ e ngɔ zu ngɔ pue nɔ.
Ejakaa muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa he lo tsuaa he lo wami.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ko ye muɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee ja a, á je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Israel no tsuaa Israel no, loo nubwɔ kó ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, aloo nɔ́ nɛ nga mi lohwe tsɔtslɔɔ e mi.
Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko tɔ mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he.
E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu; lɔ ɔ se loko e he ma tsɔ.
Ke e fɔ we e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ́ e du e he ɔ, e musu maa tloo lɛ.
Nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ a hĩɔ Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Imi ji, Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ hi a zugba a nɔ ɔ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa a zugba a a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee a kusumi níhi.
Nyɛɛ pee ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Mlaahi nɛ i wo nyɛ, kɛ blɔ nyahi nɛ i to ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ yi ma na wami.
Imi ji Yawɛ.” Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi tutuutu kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
Nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛ kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ e ba pue e tsɛ hɛ mi si.
Kó pue mo nitsɛ o nyɛ hɛ mi si.
O kɛ o tsɛ e yo kpa ko kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ o ba pue o tsɛ hɛ mi si.
O kɛ o nyɛmiyo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, o nyɛbi ji lɛ jio, o tsɛbi ji lɛ jio, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ we jio, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ ma se jio.
O kɛ o bibi kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, o binyumu bi ji lɛ jio, o biyo bi ji lɛ jio; e ji hɛ mi si puemi nɔ́ kɛ ha nyɛ tsuo.
O kɛ o tsɛ yo e biyo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa lɛ hu o nyɛmi ji lɛ.
O kɛ o nyɛko kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa o tsɛ nitsɛ nyɛmiyo ji lɛ.
O kɛ o nyɛwayo, loo o nyɛngua kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa lɛ hu e ngɛ kaa o nyɛ kɛ̃.
O kɛ o tsɛngua, loo o tsɛwayo e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa o nyɛnyua, loo o nyɛwayo ji lɛ.
O kɛ o binyumu e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa o nganyɛ ji lɛ.
O kɛ o nyɛminyumu e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa e ji hɛ mi si puemi ha o nyɛminyumu ɔ. O kɛ yo kɛ e biyo tsuo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi.
O kɛ yo ɔ e bibi hu kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, e binyumu biyo jio, e biyo ɔ biyo jio.
Ke o pee ja a, o bɔ musu, ejakaa nyɛmimɛ tutuutu ji mɛ.
Koo ngɔ nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi nɛ a ba pee huno yihi, be mi nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
“O kɛ yo nɛ ku nine kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa e he tsɔ we.
O kɛ o nyɛmi e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ o kó ba ble o he.
Koo ngɔ o bimɛ ɔmɛ eko kɛ ha nɛ a sã ha mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Molek ɔ. Ke o pee ja a, o gbe Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ he guɛ.
Nyumu kɛ nyumu kó na bɔmi kaa yo kɛ nyumu; a hĩɔ.
O kɛ lohwe kó na bɔmi nɛ o ba ble o he.
Yo hu kɛ lohwe kó hwɔ nɛ e ba ble e he ja nɔuu.
A hĩɔ.
“Je ma amɛ nɛ i ngɛ fiee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ blɔ mi jee ɔ, níhi nɛ a pee nɛ a kɛ ble a he, nɛ a kɛ ble zugba a hulɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ zugba a tue gblae, nɛ zugba a hu ngɛ ni ɔmɛ fiee ɔ nɛ.
Se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko pee níhi nɛ a hĩɔ nɛ ɔ eko.
Nihi nɛ hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ loko nyɛ ba a bɔ musu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ble zugba a. Ke nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ble zugba a, zugba a maa fie nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e fie nihi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ loko nyɛ ba a. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee níhi nɛ a hĩɔ nɛ ɔ eko ɔ, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.” Yawɛ de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Musu bɔmi níhi nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hi zugba a nɔ kekle ɔ pee ɔ, nyɛ ko pee nɛ nyɛ ba ble nyɛ he.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.”
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ klɔuklɔu peemi kɛ dami sane yemi he Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bu e nyɛ kɛ e tsɛ; nɛ e ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa nyɛ ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Nyɛ ko je ye se nɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi; nɛ nyɛ ko pee dade mawuhi ha nyɛ he.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Ke nyɛ gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, mlaahi nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ e sa ye hɛ mi.
Á ye lo ɔ ligbi nɛ a maa gbe lohwe ɔ, aloo e nɔ jena.
Ke eko piɛ nɛ ye ligbi etɛ ɔ, á sã, Ke kaa nɔ ko ye eko ligbi etɛne ɔ, i be e bɔ ngɔe, ejakaa a hĩɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye eko ɔ, a gbla e tue, ejakaa e ble Yawɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu ɔ.
A ma je lɛ we, nɛ a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
“Ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ní kpae ɔ, nyɛ ko kpa ní ɔ kɛ ya su ngmɔ ɔ tue haa.
Nyɛ ko muɔ nɔ́ nɛ ma pue si ngɛ ní kpami ɔ se hulɔ.
Wai ngmɔtsɛ kó kpa wai yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ e wai tso ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Wai yiblii nɛ maa nɔɔ si ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ hu e ko ya kukuɔ.
E si ha ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nibwɔhi.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Nyɛ ko ju; nyɛ ko sisi nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa.
“Nyɛ ko ngɔ ye biɛ kɛ ka lakpa kita kɛ wo ye biɛ he mu.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Koo fia o nyɛmi ojo, nɛ koo ju e nɔ́ ko hulɔ.
Ke o ya bɔ nɔ ko apaa ke e ba tsu ní ha mo ɔ, wo lɛ hiɔ loko je nɛ na nɔ.
Koo gbiɛ tue kpokutsɛ, nɛ koo fɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ mi tso.
Ye o Mawu ɔ gbeye.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
“Nyɛɛ ye dami sane ngɛ kojomi mi; nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ ko hɛ mi, ohiatsɛ ji lɛ jio, niatsɛ ji lɛ jio.
Koo pee o he sieku yelɔ kɛ hi yae kɛ hi bae ngɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Koo ye lakpa odase kɛ si o nyɛmi, nɛ́ a pue e muɔ si yaka gu.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
“Koo nyɛ o nyɛmi ngɛ o tsui mi.
Ke sane ko ba a, o kɛ lɛ nɛ hla mi, konɛ e he ɔ, mo mohu o ko ba pee yayami.
Koo ye mo nitsɛ o he lue, nɛ koo nyɛ o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko; se mohu, moo suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.
“Nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi nɛ kuɔ henɔ kpahi nɛ a kɛ mɛ nɛ fɔ.
Nyɛ ko du wu munomuno enyɔ ngɛ ngmɔ kake mi; nɛ nyɛ ko wo tade nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ slɔɔto enyɔ lo bo ɔ.
“Ke nyumu ko kɛ nyɔguɛ yo ko nɛ a bi e si ha nyumu kpa na bɔmi be mi nɛ a kpɔ̃ we lɛ, loo e yi e he lolo ɔ, a hla munyu ɔ mi.
A ko gbe mɛ, ejakaa nyɔguɛ ɔ yi e he lolo.
Se nyumu ɔ lɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ agbosu kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ a kɛ ba sã fɔ yemi bɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ sami ɔ kɛ ya Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ ya pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ngɛ yayami nɛ nɔ ɔ pee ɔ he, nɛ Mawu kɛ maa pa lɛ.
“Ke nyɛ ya su Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ du tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ woɔ yiblii slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu a yiblii ɔmɛ kaa níhi nɛ a tsi nya kekleekle jeha etɛ ɔmɛ; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye eko.
Jeha eywiɛne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pee sina bɔ klɛdɛɛ ha imi Yawɛ.
Jeha enuɔne ɔ mi lɛɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye a yiblii ɔmɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii babauu ha nyɛ.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Nyɛ ko ye lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Nyɛ ko klaa, nɛ nyɛ ko ye kunya hulɔ.
Nyɛ ko po huɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ ko sua nyɛ kpɛni hulɔ.
Ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, nyɛ ko po nyɛ he ha, nɛ nyɛ ko ngmaangmaa nyɛ he kɛ ye kɔmɔ.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
“Ko ha nɛ o biyo nɛ pee e he yaholɔ, nɛ e ba puɛ.
Ke e pee ja a, yahomi kɛ musu bɔmi ma ba hiɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ bu kɛ ha ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ; imi ji Yawɛ.
“Nyɛ ko ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ kunya yeli a ngɔ; ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma ble nyɛ he.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Buu nɔkɔtɔma, nɛ o wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Ye mi gbeye.
Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Ke nɔ ko ba to nyɛ nubwɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee lɛ yayami.
Ke nɔ ko ba to nyɛ nubwɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ kaa ma a mi no nɔuu.
Moo suɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ; ejakaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya to nubwɔ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Nyɛ ko sisi nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko kami, e jiimi, loo e hiɛmi kalemi mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ sɛnihi, sɛni tɛhi, kɛ susumi níhi nɛ da kɛ tsu ní.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.
Imi ji Yawɛ.”
Tue gbomi he tue gblami Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko, loo nubwɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɔ e bi kɛ ha nɛ a kɛ ja mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Molek ɔ, ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.
Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e bi kɛ ha Molek, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble ye bo tsu klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ e kɛ puɛ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, nɛ ma je lɛ we; a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e bi ha Molek, nɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ku a hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ a gbi lɛ ɔ, imi nitsɛ ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ e weku li, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ piɛ e he kɛ ya sɔmɔ Molek ɔ. Ma je mɛ we, nɛ a be mɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
“Ke nɔ ko je ye se nɛ e ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ kunya yeli a ngɔ ɔ, imi Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo lɛ, nɛ ma je lɛ we; a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.
Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ peeɔ nyɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.” Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ; e gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.
Ke Israel no ko kɛ e nyɛmi Israel no e yo na bɔmi ɔ, a puɛ gba; á gbe nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ e tsɛ e yo na bɔmi ɔ, e pue e tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi si.
Á gbe nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo.
A gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Ke nyumu ko kɛ e binyumu e yo na bɔmi ɔ, á gbe mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.
A bɔ musu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ a gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Ke nyumu kɛ nyumu na bɔmi kaa nyumu kɛ yo bɔɔ ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a bɔ musu.
Á gbe mɛ; a gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Ke nyumu ko ngɔ nɔ kɛ e bi tsuo ɔ, e bɔ musu; a sã mɛ ni etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko kó tsu musu ní nɛ ɔ eko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti hu.
Ke nyumu ko kɛ lohwe na bɔmi ɔ, á gbe e kɛ lohwe ɔ tsuo.
Ke yo ko ngɔ e he ngɔ ha lohwe ko, nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi ɔ, á gbe yo ɔ kɛ lohwe ɔ tsuo.
A gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Ke nyumu ko kɛ e nyɛmiyo na bɔmi ɔ, e tsɛbi ji lɛ jio, e nyɛbi ji lɛ jio, a tsu zo ní.
A je mɛ we; a ko bu mɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
E nyɛmiyo e kɛ na bɔmi ɔ nɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyumu ɔ musu tloo lɛ nitsɛ.
Ke nyumu ko kɛ yo ko na bɔmi be mi nɛ yo ɔ ku nine ɔ, a je mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo we; a ko bu mɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu; a tɔ mlaa nɛ kɔɔ he tsɔmi ngɛ nine kumi be mi ɔ nɔ.
Ke nyumu ko kɛ e nyɛ nyɛmiyo, loo e tsɛ nyɛmiyo na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi ɔ, musu tloo mɛ, ejakaa nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ.
Ke nyumu ko kɛ e tsɛ nyɛminyumu e yo na bɔmi ɔ, e pue e tsɛ nyɛminyumu ɔ hɛ mi si.
E kɛ yo ɔ tsuo a musu tloo mɛ; a be fɔe kɛ yaa si a gbenɔ be.
Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e nyɛminyumu e yo ɔ, a be fɔe kɛ yaa si a gbenɔ be.
Nyumu ɔ bɔ musu, nɛ e pue e nyɛminyumu ɔ hɛ mi si.
Yawɛ de ke, “Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ hi Kanaan zugba a nɛ i kɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ ɔ nɔ; ke pi ja a, zugba a maa fie nyɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko pee nihi nɛ i ngɛ mɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ a kusumi níhi.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a pee musu níhi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ a he mlaa woe nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i hla we mɛ saasaa.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i wo nyɛ si ke, ma ngɔ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛ e pee nyɛ weto ní.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ; imi nɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi kɛ to ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, níhi nɛ sãã si nɛ a he tsɔ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we ɔ a kpɛti.
Nyɛ ko ye lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ we.
Ke nyɛ ye níhi nɛ i de ke a he tsɔ we ɔ, nyɛ ble nyɛ he.
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi Yawɛ ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
I hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ pee ye ma.
“Nyumu tsuaa nyumu, loo yo tsuaa yo nɛ hiaa, loo a biɔ ní ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo; e gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.”
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a he tsɔmi Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ma a mi bi ko gbo ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ya gbogboe ɔ he nɛ́ e ba ble e he, ja e he nɔ kɔklɔɔ kaa e nyɛ, e tsɛ, e binyumu, e biyo, loo e nyɛminyumu, loo e nyɛmiyo nɛ li nyumu.
Akɛnɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ be huno ɔ, e ma nyɛ ble e he ngɛ e he.
Osɔfo ko kó ble e he ngɛ e yo weku no ko nɛ gbo ɔ he.
“Osɔfo ko po huɛ ngɛ e yi kpɛti, loo e sua e kpɛni he.
E ko po e he ha, loo e ngmaa e he kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ pee e he klɔuklɔu, nɛ e ko pue ye hɛ mi si; ejakaa lɛ nɛ sãã niye ní bɔ ɔ haa imi Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu.
Osɔfo ko kó ngɔ yo yaholɔ, aloo yo nɛ nɔ ko puɛ lɛ.
E ko ngɔ yo nɛ e kɛ e huno be hu, ejakaa lɛ osɔfo ɔ, nɔ klɔuklɔu ji lɛ.
Ma a nɛ bu osɔfo kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba haa mi ɔ nɛ.
Imi ji Yawɛ; i ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ i peeɔ ye ma a klɔuklɔu.
Ke osɔfo ko biyo pee e he yaholɔ ɔ, e pue e tsɛ hɛ mi si.
A sã lɛ nɛ e gbo.
“Nɔ nɛ ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ a pee lɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ke e wo osɔfo tade ɔ, e ko ha nɛ e yi bwɔmi nɛ gbɛ kɛ pue e yi nɔ, nɛ e ko hía e he tade ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
-Osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, e ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha mi.
E ko si ye bo tsu he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ya he nɛ gbogboe ko ngɛ, nɛ e ba ble e he, kɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ko ya gbogboe ko he, e tsɛ nɛ gbo jio, e nyɛ nɛ gbo jio.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
Osɔfo nɛ ngɔ yo nɛ li nyumu.
E ko ngɔ yalɔyo, aloo yo nɛ e kɛ e huno be hu, loo yo nɛ nɔ ko puɛ lɛ, loo yaholɔ.
É ngɔ yo nɛ li nyumu kɛ je lɛ nitsɛ e weku mi.
Ke pi ja a, e bimɛ nɛ sa kaa a peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ, a he be tsɔe.
Imi ji Yawɛ; imi nɛ i hla lɛ ngɔ to kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a nɛ.” Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e fa Mose ke e de Aaron ke, “Ngɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, o nina ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he ko hla kaa e maa ngɔ Yawɛ niye ní bɔ kɛ ba ha mi.
Nɔ ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he be he blɔ kaa e baa e Mawu ɔ hɛ mi haa, hɛ yuyuilɔ ji lɛ jio, libɔɔ ji lɛ jio, nɔ nɛ hɛ mi plaa hyɛ jio, nɔ nɛ kpa ko ngɛ e nane he jio, nɔ ko nɛ e nine, loo e nane ku jio, kpotsɛ jio, akɔtia jio, nɔ nɛ hɛngmɛ hiɔ ngɛ e he jio, nɔ nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ e he jio, nɔ nɛ sungmɛ mi wu ywia jio.
Osɔfo Aaron nina ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he be he blɔ kaa e ngɔɔ niye ní bɔ kɛ ba haa Yawɛ.
E ma nyɛ maa ye bɔ sami nike ní nɛ a kɛ ba haa mi ɔ eko, niye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ jio, klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a eko jio.
Se akɛnɛ kpa ngɛ e he he je ɔ, e ko hɛ lɛ kɛ su tsu mi pomi bo ɔ, loo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
E ko ba ble ní klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ.
Imi ji Yawɛ; imi nɛ i peeɔ mɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.” Níhi nɛ Mose de Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Bɔ ɔmɛ a he tsɔmi Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Ní klɔuklɔuhi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsukɔ he kɛ ha mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ saminya, konɛ nyɛ ko pue ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi si.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e he tsɔ we, nɛ e maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsukɔ he kɛ ha imi Yawɛ ɔ a he ɔ, a je lɛ we; e ko sɔmɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ ye hɛ mi hu.
Mlaa nɛ ɔ fɔɔ si kɛ ha yi nɔhi tsuo nɛ maa ba a. Imi ji Yawɛ.
“Aaron nina ko nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue, aloo nɔ ko nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ, e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko kɛ yaa si be nɛ e he ma tsɔ.
Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he ɔ, nɔ gbogboe he jio, nyumu nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he he jio, nɔ́ ko nɛ sãã si nɛ he tsɔ we he jio, loo nɔmlɔ nɛ he tsɔ we he jio, e he be tsɔe.
Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ maa ta ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
E ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko, ja e du e he.
Ke pu nɔ si kɛkɛ e he tsɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko, ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ.
E ko ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, loo lohwe ko nɛ lohwe kpa ko tsɔtslɔɔ e mi; ke e ye ɔ, e ble e he.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
“Osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ye ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ko ble a he.
Ke a pee ja a, a pee yayami, nɛ a ma gbo.
Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ tsukɔɔ a he ɔ nɛ.
“Nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo weku mi ɔ, e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko.
Osɔfo we nubwɔ, loo e we apaatsɛ po e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko.
Se nyɔguɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔ he kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e sika a ma nyɛ maa ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko.
Nyɔguɛhi a bimɛ nɛ a fɔ ngɛ osɔfo ɔ we mi hu ma nyɛ maa ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko.
Ke osɔfo biyo ya gba nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ ɔ, biyo nɛ ɔ ko ye bɔ sami ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko.
Se ke osɔfo ɔ biyo ya pee yalɔyo, loo e gba puɛ nɛ e be bi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba e tsɛ we mi, nɛ e tsɛ ɔ ngɛ e nɔ hyɛe kaa sa a, e ma nyɛ maa ye e tsɛ ní ɔ eko.
Nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo weku mi be he blɔ nɛ e yeɔ eko.
“Ke nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko ɔ, é wo nɔ́ ɔ he hiɔ sisiisi, nɛ e ngɔ nɔ́ ɔ jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake ngɔ piɛ he kɛ to nane mi kɛ ha osɔfo ɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko ko ble ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ; a ko ha nɔ ko nɛ sɛ́ nɛ ye eko.
Ke a pee ja a, nɔ ɔ tɔ, nɛ a maa gbla e tue.
Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ tsukɔɔ bɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ nɛ.” Jehanɛ, Yawɛ fa Mose ke, e de Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ke, “Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nubwɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti maa sã sami bɔ ha imi Yawɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e wo he si jio, bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa jio, lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ nɛ pee lohwe ku nɛ kpa ko be e he, na ku, loo agbosu, loo akpakpo.
A ko ngɔ lohwe ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he kɛ ba, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, i be ngɔe.
Ke nɔ ko maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha imi Yawɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e wo he si jio, bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa jio, lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ, e pee lohwe nɛ kpa ko be e he, na jio, to jio.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ lohwehi kaa enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ha Yawɛ: nɔ́ nɛ hɛngmɛ yu, nɔ́ nɛ nane ku, nɔ́ nɛ plaa, nɔ́ nɛ pa nyu ngɛ fofoe ngɛ e he, loo nɔ́ nɛ je sakpa.
Na ku, loo jijɔ bi nɛ e nine, loo e nane ka tsɔ ɔ, a ma nyɛ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa.
Se ke a kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a wo he si ɔ, lɛɛ a be ngɔe.
Lohwe tsuaa lohwe nɛ e sungmɛ plaa, loo e sungmɛ mi wu ywia, loo a ta lɛ ɔ, a ko ngɔ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ; a ko pee ja ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ.
“Nyɛ ko he kikɛmɛ a lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ; akɛnɛ kpa ngɛ a he ɔ, a be mɛ ngɔe.
-“Ke a fɔ na, loo jijɔ, loo apletsi ɔ, e hi e nyɛ ɔ ngɔ ligbi kpaago.
Kɛ je ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ kɛ yaa a, a ma nyɛ kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛ ko gbe na kɛ e bi, loo to kɛ e bi tsuo ligbi kake.
Nyɛɛ sã sina bɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ mlaa a nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he nyɛ bɔ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ye ní ɔ ligbi ɔ kɛ̃; je nɛ ko na yi.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
“Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.
Imi ji Yawɛ.
Nyɛ ko ble ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, se mohu Israel ma a tsuo nɛ yɔse kaa i ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ tsukɔɔ nyɛ he ɔ nɛ.
I je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma pee nyɛ Mawu.
Imi ji Yawɛ.”
Jami mi nyami be ɔmɛ -Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, nyami behi nɛ a maa ye kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Nyɛ tsu ní ligbi ekpa, se ligbi kpaagone ɔ ji Hejɔɔmi ligbi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ maa jɔɔ nyɛ he.
Nyɛ ma bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ma ja Mawu.
Nɔ ko nɛ ko tsu ní jamɛ a ligbi ɔ; ejakaa e ji he jɔɔmi ligbi ha Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.
Nyɛɛ fiɛ nyami ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ha ma a. Hetsɔmi kɛ Abolokplolo nyami be ɔmɛ Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ gbɔkuɛ ji Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ a kɛ woɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ sisije.
Jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ ɔ nɔuu we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ ji Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ sisije ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago.
Nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ. Nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ligbi kpaago.
Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ekohu nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko.
-Ke nyɛ ba su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ kpa ní ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ niba ní ɔ kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bua nya kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ. Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ jena a, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa, konɛ Mawu nɛ he nyɛ sina a. Ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bua nya a kɛ ha Yawɛ kaa nike ní ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu kilo enyɔ hu kɛ piɛ he kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Á ngɔ wai lita kake ngɔ piɛ he.
Nyɛ ko ye blɛfo kpokploku, loo blɛfo nɛ a sã, loo abolo kɛ yaa si be nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ Mawu ɔ bɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ ha nyɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ yaa neneene.
Ngmakpami nyami be ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ we jena a nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa a kɛ ba a we otsi kpaago, aloo ligbi nyingmi enuɔne nɛ ji Hejɔɔjmi ligbi kpaagone ɔ we jena a, nyɛɛ ngɔ kpokploku kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ ha Yawɛ.
We puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya nɛ ngɔ abolo bɔbɔɛ enyɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa.
Abolo bɔbɔɛ tsuaa abolo bɔbɔɛ ɔ, a ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a wo mi masa kɛ pee.
A ngɔ enɛ ɔ kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ kaa kekleekle niba ní bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, kɛ na niheyo kake, kɛ agbosu enyɔ nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ piɛ abolo ɔ he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ hu kɛ piɛ he.
Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ abolo ɔ, kɛ jijɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa.
Bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko, se nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu.
Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ maa ya neneene ha nyɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ke nyɛ kpa nyɛ zugba a nɔ ní ɔ, nyɛ ko kpa ngmɔ ɔ mi kɛ ngmɔ ɔ nya ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pi si; nɔ́ nɛ ma pue si, loo e maa piɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ ko kpale nyɛ se kɛ ya kpɛte.
Nyɛ si ha ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ nibwɔhi.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Jehahe nyami be -Nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kpoo, nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ nyɛ he.
Ke nyɛ nu nɛ titimati ɔmɛ pɛ ɔ, nyɛ bua nya he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu.
Nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ.
Kpatami ligbi ɔ Yawɛ de Mose ke, nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a ji kpatami ligbi ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu.
Nyɛɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛ ko tsu nɔ́ ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa e ji ligbi nɛ a maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ.
Nɔ nɛ be hwɔ hae ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Nyɛ ko tsu nɔ́ ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ yaa neneene.
Kɛ je nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ we gbɔkuɛ ke pu nɔ si, kɛ yaa si ligbi nyɔngmane ɔ we gbɔkuɛ ke pu nɔ si ekohu ɔ nɛ pee he jɔɔmi be pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha nyɛ; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ha hwɔ.
Gbasisihimi nyami be - Nyɛɛ ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago.
Nyɛɛ je sisi ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ nɔ.
Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu.
Nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ sã niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã.
Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ekohu nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ.
E ji jami ligbi; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Nyami behi nɛ a kɛ jaa Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Níhi nɛ nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ: nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ la sãã a, sami bɔ ɔmɛ, ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a he wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a to ha ligbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ.
Nyami be nɛ ɔmɛ piɛ Yawɛ daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he.
Nike ní, kɛ bɔhi nɛ a maa sã kɛ piɛ nyɛ bɔhi nɛ nyɛ wo he si ɔ, kɛ bɔhi nɛ je tsui mi faa a a he ɔ, nyɛɛ sã mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Ke nyɛ kpa nyɛ ngmɔ ní ɔmɛ gbe nya a, nyɛɛ ye nyami be ha Yawɛ ligbi kpaago, kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ. Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, kɛ ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɛ a pee he jɔɔmi ligbihi ha nyɛ.
Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tso yiblii kpakpahi, tã bahi, kɛ tso kusuuhi a kɔnihi kɛ a he ba nɛ nyɛ kɛ nya ligbi kpaago kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɛ nya ligbi kpaago ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ mi; enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nyɛ nina kɛ yaa neneene.
Israel fɔfɔɛ tsuo nɛ hi gbahi a sisi ligbi kpaago, konɛ nyɛ nina nɛ na nɛ a le kaa gbahi a sisi nɛ Yawɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hi, benɛ i kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Mose wo Israel ma a mlaa kaa a ye nyami behi kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kane ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛmi Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ oliv nu nɛ a si mi nɛ e mi tsɔ ngleinglei kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ ba wo kane ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ la nɛ hi tsoe be tsuaa be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Aaron nɛ ya su kane ɔmɛ daa gbɔkuɛ, nɛ a hi tsoe ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ yaa si mɔtu.
E kɛ ma tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ tsi somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ se, ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ ha nyɛ yi nɔhi tsuo kulaa kɛ yaa neneene.
Aaron nɛ to kane ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ kane tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he ɔ nɔ, nɛ e hyɛ nɛ a hi tsoe daa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Abolo nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ Ngɔɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ sã abolo bɔbɔɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Nyɛɛ to abolo ɔmɛ ngɛ za enyɔ mi kɛ pue okplɔɔ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Abolo ɔ ekpa nɛ hi za kake mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɔ pue abolo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ za enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, konɛ e pee abolo ɔ nane mi okadi kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.
Daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, Aaron nɛ da Israel bi ɔmɛ a nane mi, nɛ e ngɔ abolo ɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ maa pee Israel bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi kɛ yaa neneene.
Abolo nɛ ɔ maa pee Aaron kɛ e nina a nɔ́.
A ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa niye ní nɛ a kɛ ba sãã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́; e ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu.
Tue gblami nɛ da -Nyumu ko hi si nɛ e tsɛ ɔ Egipt no, se e nyɛ lɛɛ Israel no.
E nyɛ ɔ, Dibri nɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ biyo ji lɛ; nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shelomit.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ Israel no ko pɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ. Benɛ a ngɛ pɛe ɔ, nyumu ɔ gbiɛ Mawu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nu lɛ kɛ ya ha Mose.
Mose ha a tsi e nya kɛ yaa si be nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee lɛ.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Jé nyumu ɔ nɛ bɔ musu ɔ kpo kɛ je ma sito he ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu e musu bɔmi munyu ɔ, é ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue nyumu ɔ yi mi, konɛ ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ.
Jehanɛ, de Israel ma a tsuo ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ Mawu ɔ, e musu tloo lɛ; e sa nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nubwɔ nɛ maa bɔ musu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, lɛ hu a gbe lɛ.
Ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ ko lohwe ɔ, e to nane mi.
A ngɔ wami kɛ to wami nane mi.
“Ke nɔ ko plaa nɔ ko ɔ, a pee lɛ ja kɛ to nane mi.
Ke nɔ ko ku nɔ ko wu ɔ, lɛ hu a ku e wu; ke e pɛ nɔ ko hɛngmɛ ɔ, lɛ hu a pɛ e hɛngmɛ; ke e hia nɔ ko lungu ɔ, lɛ hu a hia e lungu; bɔ nɛ e maa plaa nɔ ko ha a, lɛ hu a plaa lɛ ja kɛ to nane mi.
Ke nɔ ko gbe lohwe ko ɔ, e to nane mi.
Se ke e gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, lɛ hu a gbe lɛ.
Nubwɔ jio, ma a mi no jio, mlaa kake nɛ ngɛ ha nyɛ tsuo.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.” Benɛ Mose kɛ Israel ma a tu munyu nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, a ngɔ nyumu ɔ nɛ bɔ musu ɔ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel ma a pee ɔ nɛ.
Jeha kpaagone ɔ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e fa lɛ ke e wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ.
Ke nyɛ su zugba nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ zugba a nɛ jɔɔ e he kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Jeha ekpa nyɛ du ní nɛ nyɛ sua wai tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ a he, nɛ nyɛ bua wai yiblii ɔmɛ a nya.
Se jeha kpaagone ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ zugba a nɛ jɔɔ e he kulaa; e pee jeha nɛ a kɛ maa wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko du ní; nɛ nyɛ ko sua nyɛ wai tso ɔmɛ a he.
Blɛfo nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e puɛ ngɛ ní kpami se po, nyɛ ko kpɔ; nɛ wai yiblii nɛ wo ngɛ wai tso nɛ a sua we e he ɔ nɔ ɔ hu nyɛ ko bua nya; jamɛ a jeha kulaa a, zugba a maa jɔɔ e he.
E ngɛ mi kaa jamɛ a jeha a, a hu we zugba a lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ e maa ba ní ha nyɛ, nyɛ nyɔguɛ nyumuhi, nyɛ nyɔguɛ yihi, apaa yeli nɛ tsuɔ ní ha nyɛ, nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ we mi lohwehi kɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo.
Zugba a mi niba ní tsuo maa pee niye ní ha nyɛ.
Ngwɔhe tomi jeha Nyɛɛ kane jeha kpaago totoe kpaago; lɛ tsuo peeɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ nɛɛ.
Jehanɛ, nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ nɔ ligbi nyɔngma a nɛ ji kpatami ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ tsɔ nɛ a ya kpa titimati wawɛɛ kɛ kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enuɔ ɔ klɔuklɔu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ fiɛ kɛ ha zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke Heyemi be ɔ su oo.
E maa pee nyami jeha ha nyɛ.
Jamɛ a jeha a, weto ní tsuaa weto ní nɛ nɔ ko kɛ to awaba a, a kpale kɛ ha nɔtsɛ ɔ, loo e nina.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya to awaba a, e kpale e se kɛ ya e nɔ́ mi, kɛ e weku li a ngɔ ekohu.
Nyɛ ko du ní, nɛ nyɛ ko kpa ní; nɔ́ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e puɛ hu nyɛ ko kpa.
Jã kɛ̃ wai yiblii nɛ wo ngɛ wai tso nɛ nyɛ sua we e he ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko bua nya.
Jeha a tsuo maa pee klɔuklɔu ha nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye niba ní nɛ nyɛ ma na ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ pɛ.
Heyemi jeha nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, weto ní tsuo nɛ a jua a, a kpale kɛ ha nɔtsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o jua zugba ko kɛ ha o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo o he zugba ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ sibi.
Ke o maa wo zugba ko he jua ha o nyɛmi ɔ, moo kane jeha abɔ nɛ piɛ nɛ a ma du ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ loko a maa ye Heyemi jeha a. Ke jeha nɛ piɛ ɔ hiɛ fuu ɔ, lɛɛ jua a maa ya hiɔwe, se ke jeha nɛ piɛ ɔ pi ɔ, lɛɛ jua a maa ba si; ejakaa niba ní nɛ a ma na kɛ maa je ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ngɛ juae ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ sibi Israel fɔfɔɛhi, se mohu nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye.
Jeha kpaagone ɔ mi haomi komɛ Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi Yawɛ mlaa amɛ, kɛ e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ hi zugba a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Zugba a maa ba ní, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ní nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ; nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Nɔ ko ma bi ke, “Jeha kpaagone ɔ nɛ wa du we ní, nɛ wa kpa we ní hulɔ ɔ, mɛni wa maa ye mɔ.” Yawɛ maa gbaa zugba a, nɛ niye ní babauu maa ba ngɛ jeha ekpane ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ ma na jeha etɛ nya niye ní jamɛ a jeha a.
Be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní due ngɛ jeha kpaanyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa hi ngmɔ niba ní momo ɔ yee kɛ yaa si nyɛ ma kpa ní nɛ nyɛ du jamɛ a jeha a. Weto ní se kpalemi Zugba a, nyɛ ko jua nɛ e ba plɛ pee nɔ ko nɔ́ kulaa.
Zugba a, Mawu nɔ́, pi nyɛ nɔ́.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu nibwɔhi nɛ ba ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛkɛ ji nyɛ.
Zugba a nɔ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa hi ɔ, ke a jua zugba a, a to blɔ nya kɛ ha zugba a kpɔmi hwɔɔ se.
Ke e fi Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ e jua e zugba ko ɔ, e nyɛmi tutuutu nɛ yeɔ e ní ɔ nɛ kpɔ zugba a. Ke e be nɔ ko nɛ ma kpɔ zugba nɛ a jua nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ke pee se nɛ níhi a mi hi ha lɛ ekohu ɔ, e ma nyɛ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kpɔ e ní.
Ke e ba mi ja a, e bu akɔtaa; jeha abɔ nɛ e jua zugba a, kɛ jeha nɛ piɛ loko jeha a nɛ a maa kpale weto ní se kɛ ha nɔtsɛmɛ ɔ maa su, konɛ e wo jeha abɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ he hiɔ nɛ e ya ngɔ e ní.
Se ke nɔ nɛ jua zugba a be nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e weto ní nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ he zugba a maa pee nɔtsɛ kɛ yaa si weto ní se kpalemi jeha kpa maa su.
Jamɛ a jeha a loko a maa kpale zugba a kɛ ha zugbatsɛ ɔ. Ke nɔ ko jua e we ngɛ ma ko nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he mi ɔ, e ma nyɛ ma kpɔ we ɔ nɛ e jua a ngɛ kekleekle jeha a mi; e ngɛ jeha kake sɔuu nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e we nɛ e jua nɛ ɔ. Ke e nyɛ we nɛ e kpɔ ngɛ jeha kake mi ɔ, we ɔ maa pee nɔ nɛ he ɔ, kɛ e nina a nɔ́ kulaa.
Weto ní se kpalemi jeha a mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ he we ɔ be he ngmɛɛe.
Se wehi nɛ ngɛ kɔpehi nɛ gbogbo be a he ɔ a mi ɔ lɛɛ a bu mɛ kaa ngmɔ kɛkɛ.
A ma nyɛ ma kpɔ mɛ; ke weto ní se kpalemi jeha a su ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ a he ha nitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a wehi nɛ ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi ɔ, a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a kpɔɔ mɛ be tsuaa be.
Ke Levi no ko jua e we ngɛ ma ko mi, nɛ e kpɔ we e we ɔ kɛ ya su weto ní se kpalemi jeha a mi po ɔ, a kpale e we ɔ kɛ ha lɛ; ejakaa Levi bi ɔmɛ a we ɔmɛ peeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a weto ní kulaa ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Lohwe lɛmi zugbahi nɛ bɔle Levi bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ hu peeɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a weto ní; a ko jua eko.
Sika nɛ a paa ha ohiatsɛmɛ Ke e fi o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ, nɛ e dɛ mi ta, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e hyɛ e he nɔ hu ɔ, moo hyɛ e nɔ.
O kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si kaa nubwɔ nɛ ba to mo, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e hi o ngɔ.
Ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha o nyɛmi ɔ, ko he nɔ́ ko kɛ bɔ he; ye o Mawu ɔ gbeye, konɛ o ha nɛ o nyɛmi ɔ nɛ hi o kasa nya.
Ke o pa lɛ sika a, ko he hekpa.
Ke niye ní nɛ o jua ha lɛ ɔ, jua a nɛ ko pe niye ní ɔ jua.
Mlaa nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ e ngɔ Kanaan zugba a ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e pee nyɛ Mawu.
Nyɔguɛhi a he ngmɛɛmi Ke e fi o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e jua e he ha mo ɔ, ko ha nɛ e sɔmɔ mo kaa nyɔguɛ.
Ha nɛ e hi o ngɔ kaa apaa yelɔ, loo nubwɔ, nɛ e tsu ní ha mo kɛ yaa si Heyemi jeha a maa su.
Ke Heyemi jeha a su ɔ, lɛ, kɛ e bimɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɛ o ngɔ ɔ ma nyɛ ma si mo kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a weku li a ngɔ ya ngɛ a nɛmɛ a nɔ́ mi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔli ji mɛ.
Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ko jua mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi.
Nyɛ ko wa mɛ yi mi, se mohu nyɛɛ ye nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye.
Ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ nyumuhi kɛ nyɔguɛ yihi hlae ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ ma he mɛ kɛ je mahi nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ a mi.
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ma nyɛ ma he nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a bimɛ nɛ a fɔ ngɔ wo nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, nɛ a maa pee nyɛ weto ní.
Nyɛ ma nyɛ ma si mɛ kaa gbosi ní ha nyɛ bimɛ, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ mɛ a wami be ɔ tsuo.
Se nyɛ sɔuu nyɛ kpɛti kaa Israel fɔfɔɛhi ɔ, nyɛ ko wa nyɛ sibi yi mi.
Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nubwɔ ko nɛ ba to mo ɔ ná ní, be mi nɛ o nyɛmi Israel no ko nɛ ngɛ o kasa nya a pee ohiatsɛ, nɛ e jua e he kɛ ha jamɛ a nubwɔ niatsɛ ɔ, aloo e nyɛmi ko.
Ke e jua e he se ɔ, he blɔ ngɛ kaa e kpɔ e he ekohu.
E nyɛminyumu ko, loo e tsɛ nyɛminyumu, loo e tsɛ nyɛminyumu bi, loo e weku no pɔtɛɛ ko ma nyɛ ma kpɔ lɛ.
Ke lɛ nitsɛ po e he ba hi ekohu ɔ, e ma nyɛ ma kpɔ e he.
E kɛ nɔ nɛ he lɛ ɔ nɛ bu akɔtaa kɛ je be nɛ e jua e he ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, kɛ ya si be nɛ Heyemi jeha a maa su, konɛ e na jeha abɔ nɛ ngɛ mi, nɛ e da nɔ nɛ e kɛ na sika nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e he ɔ. Á bu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a buu apaa yelɔ hiɔwo.
Ke jeha nɛ piɛ loko Heyemi jeha a maa su ɔ hiɛ ɔ, sika nɛ a kɛ ma kpɔ lɛ ɔ maa hiɛ jã kɛ̃, se ke jeha nɛ piɛ loko Heyemi jeha maa su ɔ pi ɔ, e kɛ nɔ nɛ he lɛ ɔ nɛ bu akɔtaa.
Á hyɛ jeha abɔ nɛ e kɛ ma tsu ní ha e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, konɛ a je hiɔwo ɔ kɛ je sika nɛ a ma ha lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e wo hiɔ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ. E kɛ hiɔ̃tsɛ ɔ si himi ɔ nɛ pee kaa nyɔmtsɛ kɛ apaa yelɔ si himi; nɛ e wo lɛ hiɔ daa jeha.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ko wa lɛ yi mi.
Ke a nyɛ we nɛ a kpɔ lɛ kɛ gu blɔ nɛ ɔmɛ eko nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ja Heyemi jeha kpa su loko a maa ngmɛɛ e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Israel fɔfɔɛ be nyɛe maa pee nɔ ko nyɔguɛ daa, ejakaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ.
Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Lɛ ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Gbaamihi nɛ tue bumi kɛ maa ba Yawɛ de ke, “Nyɛ ko puɛ amagahi, nɛ nyɛ ko pee tɛ amagahi, loo titimahi kɛ ma si; nyɛ ko ja mɛ hulɔ; ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ a jaa mi ngɛ ɔ; imi ji Yawɛ.
“Ke nyɛ bu ye gbi tue nɛ nyɛ ye ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ e be mi; zugba a maa ba ní babauu, nɛ tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii.
Nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ maa ba ní saminya; nyɛ maa hi blɛfo kpɔe hluu kɛ yaa si wai yiblii nya buami be; nɛ nyɛ maa hi wai yiblii nya buae hluu kɛ maa su blɛfo dumi be ekohu.
Nyɛ maa ye ní, nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ; nyɛ maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
“Ma ha nyɛ tue mi maa jɔ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛ maa hwɔ mahe fuaa, nɛ nyɛ be nɔ ko gbeye yee.
Ma je lohwe dikali kɛ je zugba a nɔ, nɛ a be ta hwue ngɛ zugba a nɔ hu.
Nyɛ maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa gbe mɛ.
Nyɛ ti ni enuɔ maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli lafa, nɛ nihi lafa maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli akpe nyɔngma; nyɛ maa ye mɛ tsuo a nɔ kunimi.
Ma gbaa nyɛ, nɛ ma ha nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu.
Somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, ma ye nɔ.
Nyɛ ma kpa ní babauu nɛ́ maa hi si hluu kɛ yaa su ní kpami be ekohu; nyɛ ma je niba ní momo nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue he, konɛ nyɛ na blɔ ha ehe nɛ nyɛ ma kpa a. Ma pee ye sihi he ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; i be nyɛ siee.
I kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
Ma pee nyɛ Mawu, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa pee ye ma.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ko pee nyɔguɛhi hu ɔ nɛ.
I je nyɛ kɛ je yi mi wami sisi, nɛ i ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he.” Tue gbomi he tue gblami Yawɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ be mi tue bue, nɛ nyɛ be ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ yee, ke nyɛ be ye mlaa amɛ, blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ a nɔ yee ɔ, lɛɛ ma ngɔ amanehlu gbeyegbeye nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gbla nyɛ tue: hiɔ nɛ be tsa ba, kɛ asla nɛ puɛɔ nɔ hɛngmɛ, nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ hiɔtsɛ kulaa.
Nyɛ ma du ní, se nɔ́ kpakpa ko be mi jee; ejakaa nyɛ he nyɛli maa ye nyɛ nɔ, nɛ mɛ mohu a ma ba ye ní ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ du ɔ. Ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa fia nyɛ ní nɛ a gbe; a maa ye nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nyɛ se po nyɛ maa hi fo nɔ pulɛpulɛ.
“Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo na ba mi, se nyɛ bui ye munyu ɔ kɛ sa a, ma gbla nyɛ tue kɛ bɔ he si kpaago ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Ma ku nyɛ he nɔ womi, kɛ kuɛ mi timi ɔ nya; hiɔmi be nɛe; nyɛ zugba a ma gbli, nɛ e he maa wa kaa dade.
Nyɛ ma gbo yaka dengme; ejakaa nyɛ zugba a be ní bae, nɛ e nɔ tso ɔmɛ hu be yiblii woe.
“Ke nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã, nɛ nyɛ bui mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, ma kpale gbla nyɛ tue totoe kpaago ekohu.
Ma ngmɛɛ pu mi lohwe dikali a he ngɔ pue nyɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa gbe nyɛ bimɛ; a ma kpata nyɛ we mi lohwehi a hɛ mi, nɛ ma ha nyɛ nɔ ma gbɔ, nɛ nimli be hiɛe ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
“Ke tue gblami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, nyɛ bui mi tue, se mohu nyɛ ya nɔ tsɔ atuã kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ imi Yawɛ hu i kɛ nyɛ maa to ní; imi nitsɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue kɛ bɔ he totoe kpaago ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Ma ha ta ma ba tua nyɛ; ma ngɔ ta a kɛ gbla nyɛ tue.
Ke nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ laa nyɛ he ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, ma ha hiɔ nɛ be tsa ba maa sɛ nyɛ kpɛti; ma ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Ma ha nɛ nyɛ niye ní se maa po kulaa.
Niye ní he maa hia bɔ nɛ abolo tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa ye ɔ, yihi nyɔngma pɛ maa sã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ kake mi.
A maa ngmɛ abolo ɔ ngɛ sɛni tɛ nɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ ye ɔ nyɛ be tɔe.
“Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se, nɛ nyɛ be mi tue bue, se nyɛ maa ya nɔ ma tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã a, lɛɛ ye mi mi ma fu nyɛ, nɛ ma je nyɛ se.
Imi nitsɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue kɛ bɔ he totoe kpaago ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Hwɔ maa ye nyɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ e maa ba mi kaa nyɛ maa ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ bimɛ.
Ma puɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ ma ywia nyɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; ma ngɔ nyɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɔ pue nyɛ we amaga amɛ nɛ i ywia a a nɔ.
Nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ a hiee ha mi.
Ma kpata nyɛ ma nguangua amɛ a hɛ mi kɛ yaa si a ma plɛ pee ma dokuhi.
Nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ hu ma puɛ mɛ, nɛ i be nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ hee hu.
Ma kpata nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi bɔ nɛ ke nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ na a, a he mi maa po.
Ma ha ta maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se, nɛ ma gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ tsuo a mi.
Nyɛ maa je zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma amɛ ma plɛ ma dokuhi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, jeha abɔ nɛ sa kaa zugba a nɛ jɔɔ e he nɛ nyɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ e ma na.
Zugba a maa fɔ si gu, nɛ e maa jɔɔ e he, be mi nɛ nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya je nyɛ he nyɛli a zugba nɔ.
“Nyɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ, nɛ a maa nuu kɛ ya ma se ɔ, ma ha sawale maa nu nyɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke kɔɔhiɔ sɛ ba mi huu nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ po maa wo nyɛ fo.
Nyɛ maa tu fo pulɛpulɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ta nyɛɛ nyɛ se.
Nyɛ maa hi si nɔe, be mi nɛ nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nyɛ se.
Nyɛ maa nɔɔ nyɛ sibi a nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ta nya fo nyɛ ngɛ tue, pohu nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nyɛ se.
Nyɛ be nyɛe maa da nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nya.
Nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba a maa mii nyɛ.
Nyɛ nihi bɔɔ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ maa ta he lo ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.
“Se nyɛ nina maa jaje a he yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ a nɛmɛ a he yayami kaa a pee yi wu tso níhi kɛ si mi, nɛ jehanɛ a ya nɔ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã; nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ imi hu i je a se, nɛ i ngmɛɛ a he kɛ ha a he nyɛli, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ho ma se ya a nɛ.
Se ke jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nina tsake a tsui, nɛ a ba a he si, nɛ a kpa yayami peemi ɔ, lɛɛ imi hu ma kai somi ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ Yakob, Isak, kɛ Abraham so ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, si nɛ i wo kaa ma ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha ye ma a, ma ti mi ekohu.
Kekleekle ɔ, ja a je zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a jɔɔ e he kulaa.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ja a kplɛ, nɛ a gbla a tue saminya kaa a kua ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, be mi nɛ a ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ po, i be mɛ kuae, nɛ i be a hɛ mi kpatae pɛsɛpɛsɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ se ko po.
Imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.
A he ɔ, ma kai somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so, benɛ i je ye he wami kpo kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ, benɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma pee a Mawu ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.” Mlaahi, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ ha Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Níhi nɛ a kɛ maa ke Yawɛ a he mlaahi Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nɔ ko wo si kaa e maa ngɔ nɔ ko ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, blɔ nɔ nɛ a maa gu kɛ kpɔ nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
-Kaa bɔ nɛ jua a ngɛ ɔ, nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa si nyingmi ekpa a, e he jua ji sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enuɔ.
Yo hu nɔ́ ji sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ.
Niheyo nɛ ye kɛ je jeha enuɔ kɛ ya si nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, e he jua ji sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enyɔ.
Yiheyo he jua ji sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma.
Bimwɔyo nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa si jeha enuɔ ɔ, nyumuyo jua ji sika hiɔ yi enuɔ, yoyo nɔ́ ji sika hiɔ yi etɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi ekpa kɛ se ɔ, nyumu he jua ji sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, nɛ yo nɔ ji sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma.
Ke nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ ya pee ohiatsɛ nɛ be nyɛe nɛ e ma ha sika a kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ wo jua bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ ma nyɛ ma ha.
Ke lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ɔ wo si kaa e ma ha Yawɛ ɔ, lɛɛ lohwe tsuaa lohwe kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a wo si ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu.
Nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ kó kpale e nya se.
Jehanɛ se hu, e ko tsake lɛ kɛ lohwe kpa.
E ko ngɔ lohwe kpakpa kɛ tsake lohwe yaya, nɛ e ko ngɔ lohwe yaya hu kɛ tsake lohwe kpakpa.
Ke e pee ja a, kekle lohwe ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ tsuo maa pee Yawɛ níhi.
Ke lohwe ɔ he tsɔ we kaa lohwe nɛ a ngmɛ blɔ kaa a kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ kɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ ba osɔfo ɔ ngɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lohwe ɔ kaa e hi, loo e hí, konɛ e wo e he jua; bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ ma de ɔ, ja a maa ngɔ lɛ.
Se ke nɔ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e kpɔ lohwe ɔ, lɛɛ e wo hiɔ sisiisi nɛ e ngɔ e he jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ piɛ sika a he.
Ke nɔ ko gbaa e we nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ kaa we ɔ hi, loo e hí, konɛ e wo he jua.
Jua nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa tsɔɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a maa ngɔ.
Jehanɛ, ke nɔ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e kpɔ e we ɔ, e ngɔ e we ɔ he jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ piɛ jua a he, kɛkɛ ɔ, we ɔ maa pee e nɔ́ ekohu.
Ke nɔ ko gbaa e zugba mi fa ko nɛ ji e weto ní nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, a da ní abɔ nɛ a duɔ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ hiɛmi nɔ, konɛ a kɛ wo he jua.
Ngma nɛ maa su kilo nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, a he sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma ngɛ he.
Ke Heyemi jeha a se pɛ nɛ nɔ ko gbaa e zugba nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ e wo jua nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ sisiisi.
Se ke e ngɔ e zugba a kɛ ha pee se ɔ, lɛɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ bu be nɛ piɛ loko Heyemi jeha kpa a maa su, konɛ e je nɔ.
Ke nɔ nɛ ngɔ e zugba ngɔ ha a suɔ kaa e ma kpɔ e zugba a, lɛɛ e ngɔ zugba a he jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ piɛ jua a he, kɛkɛ zugba a maa pee e nɔ ekohu.
Ke e kpɔ we zugba a kɛ ji Yawɛ dɛ, nɛ e jua zugba a kɛ ha nɔ kpa a, lɛɛ e be nyɛe ma kpɔ hu.
Se ke a ngmɛɛ zugba a he ngɛ Heyemi jeha kpa a mi ɔ, e peeɔ klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ kaa zugba nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ke; zugba nɛ ɔ maa pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ kulaa.
Ke nɔ ko he zugba, se pi lɛ nitsɛ e weto ní, nɛ e gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ bu e he jua a kɛ ya si Heyemi jeha a, konɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ wo hiɔ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu; sika a peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́.
Ke Heyemi jeha a su ɔ, a kpale zugba a ngɔ ha nɔtsɛ ɔ, loo e nina.
Jua amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a maa wo ɔ, a pee kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Lohwe tsuaa lohwe ɔ, e kekleekle bi ɔ, e ji Yawɛ nɔ́ momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko kó ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ je nɔ tsui mi faa, na jio, jijɔ jio.
Se ke lohwe ɔ he tsɔ we lɛɛ; a wo he jua ha nɔtsɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ e jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake nɛ piɛ he.
Ke a be lohwe ɔ kpɔe ɔ, lɛɛ e jua lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a wo he jua a. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ, nɛ a je he gbi kaa a kpata e hɛ mi kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ jio, lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ jio, aloo gbosi ní kaa zugba a peeɔ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ; a ko jua, nɛ a ko kpɔ hulɔ.
Ke a je nɔmlɔ adesa he gbi kaa á kpata e hɛ mi ɔ, á ko kpɔ lɛ, á gbe lɛ.
Zugba a nɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake, wu nɛ a ma du jio, tso yiblii jio, peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́; e ngɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e ma kpɔ eko ɔ, é wo hiɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ, nɛ é ngɔ jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake ngɔ piɛ he.
Na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a peeɔ Yawɛ níhi.
Ke a ngɛ lohwe ɔmɛ kanee ɔ, kake ngɛ nyɔngma tsuaa nyɔngma mi peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́.
Nɔ ko kó bi kaa lohwe ɔ hi, loo e hí; nɛ a ko tsake eko hulɔ.
Ke a ma tsake eko ɔ, lohwe nɛ a tsake ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ngɛ tsakee ɔ tsuo maa pee klɔuklɔu; a be kpɔe.
Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ ha Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Womi nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hia blɔ kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he, kɛ nyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ maa pee jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, kɛ ya su zugba nɛ Mawu wo si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nya.
Sane titli nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji bɔ nɛ Mose kane Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he loko a je lejɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e kane mɛ ekohu pee se ngɛ Moab, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je.
Israel bi ɔmɛ a kanemi ɔ nɔ a da kɛ ha womi nɛ ɔ biɛ Numeri ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ya su Kadesh Barnea ngɛ Kanaan zugba a leneyi je huzu ɔ nya; se a nyɛ we nɛ a gu lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya zugba a nɛ a wo mɛ si ke a ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.
A hi lejɛ ɔ jeha babauu loko a hia kɛ ho zugba nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ nɔ ya.
Benɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ mia, nɛ a po pa a kɛ ho Kanaan zugba a nɔ ya; se ni komɛ hu tlɔ lejɛ ɔ. Mose Womi Eywiɛne ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ ke haomi ba Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛkɛ nɛ sawale nuɔ mɛ nɛ a kɔni mi jeɔ wu, bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ atuã kɛ woɔ Mawu, kɛ Mose, nɔmlɔ nɛ Mawu hla ke e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi ɔ.
Sane nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu hyɛ e ma Israel ɔ nɔ saminya, be mi nɛ mɛɛ a bui lɛ tue fɛɛ, nɛ a peeɔ yayami slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi mohu kɛ siɔ lɛ.
Nyagbe ɔ, wa naa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi kaa be komɛ Mose tsui fiaa lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, e fi si kɛ sɔmɔ Mawu, kɛ e ma Israel ɔ anɔkuale mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Israel bi ɔmɛ mia nɛ a maa hia kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he .—.
a.
A kane ma a kekleekle nɔ́ .—.
b. Mlaa slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi .—.
d. Hetsɔmi enyɔne ɔ .- Kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he kɛ ya Moab .—.
Sanehi nɛ ba ngɛ Moab .—.
Kɛ je Egipt kɛ ya Moab .- Mlaahi nɛ a wo loko a po Yordan pa a .—.
A kane Israel ma a kekleekle nɔ́ Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ se jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “O kɛ Aaron nɛ kane Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ya ta a, nyɛɛ ngma e biɛ, nɛ nyɛ gba mɛ tabo nya tabo nya.
Wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso nɛ hla nɔ kake kɛ ba piɛ nyɛ he.” -Kikɛmɛ a nikɔtɔma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wɛtsohi nɛ a je a mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA Ruben Elizur, Shedeur bi ɔ Simeon Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi ɔ Yuda Nashon, Aminadab bi ɔ Isakar Netanel, Zuar bi ɔ Zebulun Eliab, Helon bi ɔ Efraim Elishama, Amihud bi ɔ Manase Gamaliel, Pedazur bi ɔ Benyamin Abidan, Gideoni bi ɔ Dan Ahiezer, Amishadai bi ɔ Asher Pagiel, Okran bi ɔ Gad Eliasaf, Deuel bi ɔ Naftali Ahira, Enan bi ɔ.
-Mose kɛ Aaron fɔ̃ nihi nɛ a tsɔɔ a biɛ nɛ ɔ nine.
Nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a bua Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nya nɛ a kane mɛ kakaaka, weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
A kane nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye pe ja kakaaka, nɛ Mose ngma a biɛ ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
