-A ngma nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye pe ja, nɛ a su ta yami ɔ a biɛ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
A ngma biɛ ɔ kɛ je Yakob bitɛte Ruben nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ e ba lɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: WƐTSO NI ƆMƐ A HIƐMI Ruben , Simeon , Gad , Yuda , Isakar , Zebulun , Efraim , Manase , Benyamin , Dan , Asher , Naftali , Lɛ tsuo peeɔ ,.
Se Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kane we mɛ ngɔ piɛ we a bi ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ a kane wɛtso kpa amɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Levi wɛtso ɔ pɛ lɛɛ koo kane mɛ, nɛ koo bu a hiɛmi ngɔ piɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he.
Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ ngɔɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ hyɛmi ní tsumi ɔ kɛ wo a dɛ.
Mɛ nɛ a maa hɛɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ.
Mɛ nɛ a maa hyɛ nɔ; nɛ bo tsu ɔ he ji he nɛ a maa hi.
Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa hia a, Levi bi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa gbɛ bo tsu ɔ. Nɛ ke a maa ma lɛ ekohu ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ nɔuu lɛ a maa ma.
Ke nɔ kpa ko hɛ lɛ kɛ su he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo maa to si ngɛ a tabo ɔmɛ a nya, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e wɛtso aflaangaa sisi.
Se Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ma pue si kɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ, nɛ a maa bu he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ imi Yawɛ, ye we abofu nɛ ko kple Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɔ.” Israel ma a pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ɔ.
Wɛtso ɔmɛ a si puemi Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Be tsuaa be nɛ Israel ma a maa to si ngɛ he ko ɔ, á pue si weku nya weku nya ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ weku aflaangaa sisi kɛ bɔle kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kpe he ɔ.
-“Yuda wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa beleku je tabo nya tabo nya.
A nyatsɛ ji Aminadab bi Nashon, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi kpaago kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.
-“Isakar wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Yuda nɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Zuar bi Netanel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.
-“Zebulun wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Isakar nɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Helon bi Eliab, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kpaago kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.
Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma pue si tabo nya tabo nya, ngɛ Yuda ta a mi ɔ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ ekpa kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.
Mɛ lɛ a maa hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi.
-“Ruben wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa leneyi je, tabo nya tabo nya.
A nyatsɛ ji Shedeur bi Elizur, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ekpa kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
-“Simeon wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Ruben nɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Zurishadai bi Shelumiel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ nɛɛ kɛ e nya lafa etɛ.
-“Gad wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Simeon nɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Deuel bi Eliasaf, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma pue si tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ Ruben ta a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kake kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Mɛ ji tabo enyɔne nɛ maa hia ta.
“Jehanɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa tloo kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ maa hia; mɛ ji Israel ta a tsuo a kpɛti tabo.
Bɔ nɛ ma a to si ɔ, ja a maa nyɛɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e ngwɔhe, kɛ e we aflaangaa sisi.
-“Efraim wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa bonyoku je, tabo nya tabo nya.
A nyatsɛ ji Amihud bi Elishama, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
-“Manase wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Efraim nɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Pedazur bi Gamaliel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ.
-“Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Manase nɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Gideoni bi Abidan, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.
Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma pue si tabo nya tabo nya, ngɛ Efraim ta a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ e nya lafa kake.
Mɛ ji tabo etɛne nɛ maa hia ta.
-“Dan wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa omleyi je, tabo nya tabo nya.
A nyatsɛ ji Amishadai bi Ahiezer, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi ekpa kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa kpaago.
-“Asher wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Dan nɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Okran bi Pagiel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kake kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
-“Naftali wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Asher nɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Enan bi Ahira, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.
Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma pue si tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ Dan ta a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kpaago kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hia ta nyagbe ngɛ a we aflaangaa amɛ a sisi.” Israel ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a kane mɛ weku nya weku nya kɛ tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ ta amɛ a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa ekpa kɛ etɛ kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kane we mɛ kɛ piɛ we Israel bi ɔmɛ a he.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee.
Ke ma a to si ɔ, a pueɔ si tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya; nɛ ke a hia a, a nyɛɔ ja nɔuu.
Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ Be mi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mose kɛ Aaron powu mi bimɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Aaron ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
Tɛte ɔ biɛ ji Nadab, nɛ e senihi ji Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar.
A pɔ mɛ nu, nɛ Aaron ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo osɔfo yemi ní tsumi ɔ mi.
Se Nadab, kɛ Abihu lɛɛ a gbo benɛ a ngɔ la nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ɔ. Akɛnɛ mɛɛ a be bimɛ he je ɔ, Eleazar kɛ Itamar pɛ lɛ a sɔmɔ kaa osɔfohi ngɛ a tsɛ Aaron wami be mi.
A hla Levi bi ɔmɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo kpee Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha osɔfo Aaron nɛ a piɛ e he kɛ tsu ní.
A ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he, nɛ a ma tsu Aaron, kɛ ma a tsuo a ní tsumi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mɛ lɛ a maa hyɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he, kɛ e mi tsuo a nɔ, nɛ mɛ lɛ a ma tsu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo a nane mi.
A je blɔ hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Israel ma a kpɛti, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ha Aaron nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ.
Ngɔɔ osɔfo ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pɛ a dɛ mi; nɔ kpa ko nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní tsumi nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, - “Jehanɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa pee ye níhi.
Benɛ i gbe Egipt bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, i tsukɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte, kɛ a lohwehi hu a kekleekle bihi a he kɛ pee ye níhi.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i hla Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ to Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ a nane mi; a maa pee ye níhi.
Imi ji Yawɛ.” Levi bi ɔmɛ a kanemi Yawɛ de Mose ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ke, “Moo kane Levi bi ɔmɛ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ o ngma nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a e biɛ.” Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
-Levi ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Gershon, Kohat, kɛ Merari.
Mɛ ji a we puɔ nyatsɛmɛ.
Gershon ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Libni, kɛ Shimei.
Kohat ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel.
Merari ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Mahli, kɛ Mushi.
Mɛ ji a weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ.
Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Gershon we puɔ nya ji Libni kɛ Shimei.
Nyumuhi nɛ a ngma a biɛ, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe kpaago kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
Gershon we puɔ nya a maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ se, kɛ yaa bonyoku je.
A nyatsɛ ji Lael bi Eliasaf.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he níhi nɛ a tu kɛ wo a dɛ mi ji: kpe he ɔ, bo tsu ɔ kɛ e nɔ hami nɔ́ ɔ, bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ, kue ɔ nɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he bo ɔmɛ, kɛ kue ɔ nitsɛ nya bo ɔ kɛ e he tangme kpa amɛ.
Ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ kɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, mɛ lɛ a ma tsu.
Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Kohat we puɔ nya ji Amram, Izhar, kɛ Hebron, kɛ Uziel.
Nyumuhi nɛ a ngma a biɛ, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye hlami kake kɛ yaa a, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe kpaanyɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa; mɛ ji nimli nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. Kohat we puɔ nya a maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ leneyi je.
A nyatsɛ ji Uziel bi Elizafan.
Ní tsumi nɛ a tu kɛ wo a dɛ mi ji: ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ kɔɔ somi daka a he, okplɔɔ ɔ, kane tso ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, níhi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ. Levi bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ a nɔ.
Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Merari we puɔ nya a ji Mahli, kɛ Mushi.
Nyumuhi nɛ a ngma a biɛ, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe ekpa kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ.
A nyatsɛ ji Abihail bi Zuriel.
Mɛɛ a maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ we omleyi je.
Ní tsumi nɛ a tu kɛ wo Merari binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ji ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ kɔɔ kpe he ɔ he plai ɔmɛ, mani ɔmɛ, titima amɛ kɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
Mɛ kɛ̃ a ní tsumi ji kue ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ, a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ tangme kpa amɛ a nɔ hyɛmi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ hɛ mi kɛ yaa beleku je ji Mose, Aaron, kɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ.
Mɛ ji nihi nɛ ma tsu kusumi ní tsumihi tsuo ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a nɛ.
Nɔ kpa ko nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní tsumi nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye kɛ je hlami kake kɛ yaa, nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron ngma a biɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ ba da bitɛte ɔmɛ a nane mi -Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo kane Israel bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a, nɛ o ngma e biɛ.
Se i ngɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ to Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ a nane mi.
Imi ji Yawɛ!
Jehanɛ se, i ngɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a we mi lohwehi a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ hu ngɔ to Israel bi ɔmɛ a we mi lohwehi a nane mi.” Mose kane Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Benɛ a ngma bitɛtehi nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a a biɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi kpaago kɛ etɛ.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Jehanɛ, moo hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ to ha mi ngɛ Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo a nane mi, kɛ a we mi lohwehi hu ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a we mi lohwehi tsuo a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ a nane mi.
Imi ji Yawɛ!
Akɛnɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ hiɛ pe Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ nimli lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi kpaago kɛ etɛ he je ɔ, á kpɔ bimɛ nɛ be nɔ ɔ. Bi tsuaa bi ɔ, á ngɔ sika hiɔ yi enuɔ kɛ kpɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu jua nɛ a po ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ngɔɔ sika nɛ a kɛ ba kpɔ nihi nɛ be nɔ ɔ kɛ ha Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ.” Mose he kpɔmi sika a nɛ a ha ngɛ Israel bitɛte abɔ nɛ a kɛ hiɛ pe Levi bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ. Sika nɛ a ha ngɛ Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e nine su nɔ ji sika hiɔ yi akpe, kɛ e nya lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi ekpa kɛ enuɔ kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ jua nɛ a po ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Mose ngɔ kpɔmi sika a kɛ ha Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
Kohat bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Nyɛɛ kane Kohat bi nɛ ngɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ nyɛɛ ngma nyumu ɔmɛ a biɛ, kɛ je nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi etɛ nɔ, kɛ yaa si nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ nɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Kohat bi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma tsu níhi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ a he ní.
“Ke be nɛ ma a maa hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a je tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ ngɛ somi daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi ɔ kɛ ha daka a he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha he, nɛ a ngɔ bo bluu hu kɛ ha lɔ ɔ nɔ, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ daka a kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.
“Okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ maa nɔ ɔ, á ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha nɔ loko a ngɔ plɛɛtehi, kahi nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ bɔhi woɔ a mi ɔ, kɛ kpluhi nɛ a kɛ wai bɔhi woɔ a mi ɔ kɛ ma nɔ.
A ngɔ bo tsu kɛ ha ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee hu kɛ ha he, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.
“Kane tso ɔ kɛ e he kane ɔmɛ, abɛɛle ɔmɛ, kɛ nu tɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ nu woɔ a mi ɔ, a ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha a he.
A ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha kane tso ɔ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he, nɛ a ngɔ kɛ wo tlɔɔke mi.
“Sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hu a ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha he, nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha lɔ ɔ hu nɔ, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ lɛ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.
Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, a je mɛ nɛ a fi kɛ wo bo bluu mi, nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha a he, loko a kɛ wo tlɔɔke ɔ mi.
A muɔ la zu ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ ha he.
Jehanɛ, a ngɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ma nɔ: ngɛyuhi, sofihi, gbowehi, kɛ kahi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha he, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ lɛ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.
Ke be nɛ ma a maa hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ha ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he, loko Kohat bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba nɛ a ba tloo kɛ ho.
Kohat bi ɔmɛ kó ta ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a ko gbo.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he níhi nɛ Kohat bi ɔmɛ maa tloo be tsuaa be nɛ ma a maa hia ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
“Osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar lɛɛ e ní tsumi ji kaa e hyɛ kane mi nu ɔ, tsopa kɛ e he via a, daa niye ní bɔ sami ɔ, kɛ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ a nɔ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ kpe he ɔ, e mi ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.” Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Kohat bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ba kpata ngɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke a ba su níhi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a he nɛ a ko gbo, se mohu a yi nɛ na wami he je ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ pee ha mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya nɛ a ya tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ e ní tsumi, kɛ e tlomi nɛ e maa tloo.
Kohat bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ ke a sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a ko hyɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hɛngmɛfia po.
Ke a pee ja a, a ma gbo.” Gershon bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo kane Gershon bi nɛ ngɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ hu weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ o ngma nyumu ɔmɛ a biɛ, kɛ je nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi etɛ nɔ kɛ yaa si nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ nɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Gershon bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji a maa tloo kpe he ɔ he bo ɔmɛ, bo tsu ɔ kɛ e he hami nɔ́ ɔ, e yi bumi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ kpɛ ɔ, kpe he bo tsu sinya a nya bo ɔ, kue ɔ nɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ he bo ɔmɛ, kue ɔ nya bo ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ a he tangme kpa amɛ, kɛ a he ní tsumi ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ní tsumi tsuo nɛ sa tsumi ɔ, a tsu.
Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ maa hyɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a ma tsu, kɛ níhi nɛ a maa tloo.
Nyɛɛ dla tlomihi nɛ a maa tloo ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ kakaaka.
Ní tsumihi nɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ ma tsu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, nɛ nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.
Merari bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi “Merari bi ɔmɛ hu o kane mɛ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ o ngma nyumu ɔmɛ a biɛ, kɛ je nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi etɛ nɔ, kɛ yaa si nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ nɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Ní tsumi nɛ mɛɛ a ma tsu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ji a maa muɔ kpe he ɔ he plai ɔmɛ, mani ɔmɛ, titima amɛ kɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kue ɔ nɛ bɔle si ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ, a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kɛ plɛɛko ɔmɛ kɛ a he tangme kpa amɛ, kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Moo dla tlomihi nɛ a maa tloo ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ kakaaka.
Ní tsumihi nɛ Merari bi ɔmɛ ma tsu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.” A kane Levi bi ɔmɛ -Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a, Mose kɛ Aaron, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya kane nihi ngɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ we puɔ nya etɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Mɛ ji Kohat, Gershon, kɛ Merari.
A ngma nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ ya si ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ, nɛ a ma nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ a biɛ.
Bɔ nɛ e ba lɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: WE PUƆ NYA NI ƆMƐ A HIƐMI Kohat , Gershon , Merari , Lɛ tsuo peeɔ , A ngma nɔ tsuaa nɔ biɛ kakaaka kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, nɛ a dla ní tsumi slɔɔto ɔmɛ, kɛ tlomi ɔmɛ a tloomi ngɔ ha mɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nɔ́.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa, nɛ a fie nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je ma sito he ɔ: nihi nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ a he; nihi nɛ a he nyu ngɛ bee, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya ta nɔ gbogboe he kɛ ble a he.
Nyɛ je nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti, nyumuhi jio, yihi jio, konɛ a ko ble ma sito he ɔ, he nɛ i hii ngɛ ye ma a a kpɛti ɔ.” Israel bi ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, nɛ a fie jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ. Yayami nane mi tomi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko, loo yo ko pee nɔ ko yayami nɛ e kɛ tɔ Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ ɔ, e jaje yayami nɛ e pee ɔ, nɛ e to e yayami ɔ nane mi sisiisi.
Jehanɛ, e ngɔ nane mi tomi nɔ́ ɔ mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ bɔ he ha nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ e tɔ ɔ.
Se ke nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ be je mi, nɛ e be weku no pɔtɛɛ ko nɛ a kɛ nane mi tomi ní ɔmɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nane mi tomi ní ɔmɛ maa pee Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ ma ha osɔfo ɔ. Slo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ peeɔ kusumi kɛ tsukɔɔ nɔ ko nɛ tɔ ɔ he ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, nike ní klɛdɛɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, e maa pee osɔfo ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko maa ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ko ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ maa pee osɔfo ɔ nɔ.” Nyumuhi nɛ a yi mi tɛ̃ mɛ ngɛ a yihi a he Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko yo je e se, nɛ e ya tɔ e nɔ, nɛ e ya hwɔ nyumu kpa se kɛ ble e he, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ laa e huno ɔ, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ ji kpo, ejakaa odase ko be he, nɛ a nui yo ɔ hulɔ, aloo ke hunga jemi mumi te si ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e yi mi tɛ̃ lɛ ngɛ e yo nɛ ya ble e he niinɛ, aloo nɔ nɛ ya pee we ja po he ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e yo ɔ kɛ ba osɔfo ɔ ngɔ.
Nyumu ɔ nɛ hɛɛ ngma mamu kilo kake, nɛ ji bɔ ɔ nɛ e maa sã ngɛ yo ɔ he ɔ kɛ ba.
E ko plɛ oliv nu kɛ pue nɔ, nɛ e ko ngɔ mimɛ hu kɛ fɔ nɔ; ejakaa hunga niye ní bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; bɔ nɛ nyumu nɛ yi mi tɛ̃ e yo he ba sã, konɛ a kɛ hla anɔkuale ɔ.
“Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ yɛ nyu klɔuklɔu ɔ eko kɛ wo buɛ mi, nɛ e piti tabo zu ngɛ kpe he ɔ kɛ wo nyu ɔ mi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ pɛne yo ɔ yi bwɔmi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ ji hunga niye ní bɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ hlaa anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ wo yo ɔ dɛ mi.
Osɔfo ɔ nitsɛ lɛɛ e hɛɛ nyu nɛ dooɔ, nɛ kɛ gbiɛmi baa nɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ka kita ngɔ pue yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de ke, ‘Ke o ya hwɔ we nyumu ko se, aloo ke o ji o huno ɔ se ya wui o he mu ɔ, lɛɛ gbiɛmi nɛ nyu nɛ dooɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ baa nɔ nɔ ɔ, o he nɛ je mi.’ Se ke o je o huno ɔ se ya hwɔ nyumu kpa se, nɛ o ya ble o he ɔ, lɛɛ…!
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ka kita nɛ e kɛ gbiɛ yo ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ o plɛ pee gbiɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma ka kita ngɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ o mi nɛ fu nɛ o mi si nɛ nɔ mi.
Nyu nɛ ɔ nɛ kɛ gbiɛmi baa nɔ nɔ ɔ, e sɛ o mi mi, nɛ e ha nɛ o mi nɛ fu, nɛ o mi si nɛ nɔ mi.’ Kɛkɛ, yo ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘E ba mi!
E ba mi!’ “Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngma gbiɛmi ɔ kɛ wo womi mi, nɛ e fɔ kɛ wo nyu nɛ dooɔ ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ nyu nɛ dooɔ ɔ kɛ ha yo ɔ nɛ e nu.
Ke nyu nɛ ɔ sɛ yo ɔ mi mi ɔ, e maa hao e mi mi ɔ.
Se loko osɔfo ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e he ngma niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ ji hunga bɔ ɔ ngɛ yo ɔ dɛ.
E fɔ̃ ngma niye ní bɔ ɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ti niye ní bɔ ɔ dɛ mamɛ kake kɛkɛ kaa okadi, nɛ e sã lɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ke yo ɔ tɔ e huno ɔ nɔ niinɛ, nɛ e ya ble e he ɔ, lɛɛ ke a kɛ nyu ɔ ha lɛ nɛ e nu ɔ, nyu nɛ kɛ gbiɛmi baa nɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e mi mi maa kɔɔ lɛ.
E mi maa fu nɛ e mi si maa nɔ mi, nɛ e ma plɛ pee gbiɛmi ngɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Se ke yo ɔ ya ble we e he, nɛ e he tsɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa ye e he, nɛ e ma nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ.
“Mlaa nɛ kɔɔ hunga jemi he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke yogbayo ko je e huno se ya ble e he, aloo ke hunga jemi mumi te si ngɛ nyumu ko mi, nɛ e yi mi tɛ̃ lɛ ngɛ e yo he ɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ ngɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi, konɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ pee kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔ he kusumi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha lɛ.
A be nyumu ɔ fɔ ko bue; se ke yo ɔ ye fɔ ɔ, sɔ̃ ɔ maa tloo lɛ yo ɔ.”
Mlaahi kɛ ha Nazir no peemi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko, loo yo ko je blɔ ka Nazir no peemi kita, nɛ e wo si kaa e maa ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e yu e he kɛ je wai, kɛ dã nɛ nya wa a he.
E ko nu wai, aloo dã kpa ko nɛ kuã.
E ko nu nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ wai yiblii pee; wai yiblii mumu, loo gbigbli hu e ko ye.
Ligbi abɔ nɛ Nazir no ji lɛ ɔ, e ko ye nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ wai tso he nɔ́ ko pee; wai tso yiblii ɔ mi wu ɔ jio, e he toto jio, e ko ye.
“Ligbi abɔ nɛ e ngɛ Nazir no si womi nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ, e ko sã e yi nɔ.
E ngmɛɛ e yi bwɔmi he nɛ e ka gagaaga; nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu.
-E yi bwɔmi ji okadi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, e ko ya nɔ gbogboe ɔ he nɛ e ko ba ble e he, e tsɛ jio, e nyɛ jio, e nyɛminyumu jio, e nyɛmiyo jio.
Ligbi abɔ nɛ Nazir no ji lɛ ɔ, a tsukɔ e he kɛ ha Yawɛ.
“Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko gbo tlukaa ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ble e yi bwɔmi ɔ nɛ a tsukɔ he kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e sɛ e yi ɔ kpalokpalo ngɛ e he tsukɔmi ligbi ɔ we ligbi kpaago se.
Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ, e ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, aloo beleku lahuɛ tsɔwi enyɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ tsukɔ nɔ ɔ he; ejakaa e pee yayami kaa e hyɛ nɔ gbogboe hɛ mi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔ maa tsukɔ e yi bwɔmi ɔ he ekohu, nɛ e maa kpale je sisi maa ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ ekohu kaa Nazir no.
Be nɛ be ɔ pee yaka, ejakaa e ble e yi bwɔmi nɛ a tsukɔ he ɔ. E maa ngɔ jijɔ bi kake nɛ ye jeha kake kɛ ba sã bɔ kaa e tɔ.
“Ke Nazir no ko si womi ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta a, á ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. É ngɔ jijɔ ku kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ.
É ngɔ jijɔ yo kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ; nɛ e ngɔ agbosu kake hu nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ.
Jehanɛ se hu, e ngɔ abolo kplolo kusii kake, kɛ keeki nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu pee, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a wui mi masa, se a ngɔ nu kɛ kpa hɛ mi kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, kɛ dã nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ a he kɛ ba.
“Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ́ e sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, kɛ sami bɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e ngɔ abolo kɛ kusii ɔ ngɔ piɛ he.
E ngɔ niye ní bɔ ɔ, kɛ dã nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ hu kɛ ba.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Nazir no ɔ nɛ sɛ e yi ɔ kpalokpalo ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
E muɔ e yi bwɔmi ɔ kɛ wo la a nɛ a kɛ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ sãe ɔ mi.
“Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ je keeki nɛ a wui mi masa kake, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a wui mi masa kake ngɛ kusii ɔ mi kɛ piɛ agbosu ɔ nɛ a hoo ɔ kɔni kake he, nɛ e kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ha Nazir no ɔ. Nyagbe ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ fɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa.
Mlaa nya a, ní nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ agbosu ɔ gugue, kɛ fiɔ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔ nike ní klɔuklɔu.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Nazir no ɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e nuɔ dã faa.
“Mlaahi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha Nazir no nɛ wo Yawɛ si ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Bɔ hu nɛ e maa sã ha Yawɛ ngɛ e Nazir no peemi si womi ɔ nya a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; slo nɔ́ nɛ e ma nyɛ ha ngɛ enɛ ɔ se.
Ke Nazir no ko wo si ɔ, e pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ mlaa a nya, be mi nɛ e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ.” Osɔfo ɔ nɛ gbaa ma a Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ gbaa Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ de ke, Yawɛ nɛ gbaa nyɛ, nɛ e hyɛ nyɛ; Yawɛ nɛ ha e hɛ mi nɛ kpɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ e dloo nyɛ; Yawɛ nɛ wo e hɛ mi nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛ he jɔmi.
“Ke a tsɛ ye biɛ ngɔ pue Israel ma a nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma gbaa mɛ.”
Ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba sã bɔ Ligbi ɔ nɛ Mose gbe kpe he ɔ mami nya a, e pɔ kpe he ɔ nu, nɛ e tsukɔ he kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel wɛtso nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ da wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya, be mi nɛ a kane ni ɔmɛ ɔ, ngɔ a nike ní ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ. Ní ɔmɛ ji tlɔɔkehi nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ ha a he ekpa, kɛ na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Ni enyɔ tsuaa ni enyɔ kɛ tlɔɔke kake ba, se na amɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ kakaaka kɛ ba.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo he nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a kɛ tsu kpe he bo tsu ɔ he ní; moo dla ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi nya.” Mose he ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɔ tlɔɔke ɔmɛ, kɛ na ku ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ.
E ha Gershon bi ɔmɛ tlɔɔke enyɔ, kɛ na eywiɛ ngɛ a ní tsumi nya, nɛ e ha Merari bi ɔmɛ tlɔɔke eywiɛ, kɛ na kpaanyɔ ngɛ mɛ hu a ní tsumi nya.
Mɛ tsuo a nɔ hyɛlɔ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.
Se Kohat bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ Mose ha we mɛ nɔ́ ko; ejakaa ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ha mɛ nɛ a hyɛ nɔ ɔ, a konɔ a kɛ maa fɔ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ a pɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nu, nɛ a tsukɔ he ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ekohu.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ha nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba kakaaka, nɛ a kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Daa ligbi ɔ, nɔ kake nɛ ngɔ e nɔ́ kɛ ba.” -Bɔ nɛ a ngɔ nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: LIGBI WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA Kekleekle Yuda Nashon, Aminadab bi ɔ Enyɔne Isakar Netanel, Zuar bi ɔ Etɛne Zebulun Eliab, Helon bi ɔ Eywiɛne Ruben Elizur, Shedeur bi ɔ Enuɔne Simeon Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi ɔ Ekpane Gad Eliasaf, Deuel bi ɔ Kpaagone Efraim Elishama, Amihud bi ɔ Kpaanyɔne Manase Gamaliel, Pedazur bi ɔ Nɛɛne Benyamin Abidan, Gideoni bi ɔ Nyɔngmane Dan Ahiezer, Amishadai bi ɔ Nyɔngma kɛ Asher Pagiel, Okran bi ɔ kakene Nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne Naftali Ahira, Enan bi ɔ. Nike ní mi mi kake too nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ kɛ ba.
Nike ní ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sika hiɔ plɛɛte kake nɛ e jiimi ji kilo kake kɛ fa, kɛ sika hiɔ kã kake nɛ e jiimi ji gram lafa kpaanyɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ jiimi nya.
Ní enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a ngɔ nu kɛ futu mi kɛ ha niye ní bɔ sami.
Enɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he: sika tsu kã kake nɛ e jiimi ji gram lafa kɛ nyɔngma nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a sãã hyi lɛ tɔ, na niheyo kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ, kɛ akpakpo kake nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ: na ku enyɔ, agbosu enyɔ, akpakpo enuɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku enuɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka.
-Ligbi ɔ nɛ a pɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nu ɔ, nike ní nɛ Israel wɛtso nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ kɛ ba a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: - Sika hiɔ plɛɛte nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ sika hiɔ kã nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ a jiimi ji kilo nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago kɛ se.
- Sika tsu kã nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via hyi mɛ tɔ ɔ tsuo a jiimi ji kilo kɛ se.
- Na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, agbosu nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ nɛ piɛ he nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ.
- Akpakpo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ.
- Na ku nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ, agbosu nyingmi ekpa, akpakpo nyingmi ekpa, kɛ jijɔ ku nyingmi ekpa nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ. Benɛ Mose ya sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ e kɛ Yawɛ nɛ ya tu munyu ɔ, e nu Yawɛ gbi nɛ e kɛ lɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ yi mi, ngɛ kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Kane ɔmɛ a si mamɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo de Aaron ke, ke e ngɔ kane kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ma si mami ɔ, e hyɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a tso kɛ ya kane tso ɔ hɛ mi.” Aaron pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. E ngɔ kane ɔmɛ kɛ ma si, konɛ a tso kɛ ya kane tso ɔ hɛ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a pee kane tso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a ngɔ sika tsu nɛ a fia nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee kane tso ɔ kɛ je e nane kɛ ya si e mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he, kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Mose ɔ ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ to Yawɛ de Mose ekohu ke, “Je Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ o tsukɔ a he.
Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kɛ tsukɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ngɔɔ nyu ɔ nɛ a kɛ jeɔ yayami ɔ ngɔ fĩa a nɔ.
Ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ asoyi kɛ sɛ bwɔmi tsuo ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he.
Ke a pee ja a, a he ma tsɔ.
Jehanɛ, ha nɛ a ngɔ na niheyo kake, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ ji mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu ɔ kɛ ba.
Ngɔɔ na niheyo kpa nɛ o kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o maa kpee Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ o kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ma ba da si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Ke o ngɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a nine kɛ pue Levi bi ɔmɛ a yi mi.
Kɛkɛ Aaron maa pee kusumi klɛdɛɛ ko kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a hla Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ, kaa Israel ma mluku ɔ a nike ní klɛdɛɛ, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a nine kɛ pue na ku enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi mi.
O kɛ kake maa sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ o maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ, nɛ o kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ.
“Ngɔɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mi kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ, konɛ a hi Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nine nɔ.
O maa pee enɛ ɔ kɛ je Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel ma a he nɛ a ba pee ye níhi.
Ke o tsukɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o hla mɛ ngɔ to ɔ, lɔ ɔ se loko a ma nyɛ maa ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ a ya sɔmɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to bitɛtehi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Israel ɔ a nane mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ i kpata Egipt bi ɔmɛ a kekleekle bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, i tsukɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ hu a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ i kɛ mɛ pee imi nitsɛ ye níhi.
I hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Israel bitɛtehi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nane mi.
I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kaa Israel ma a tsuo a nike ní.
A ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ma kpata Yawɛ ha ma a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke alini ma a hɛ mɛ kɛ su he klɔuklɔu ɔ he tsɔ ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ kó sɛ a kpɛti.” Mose kɛ Aaron, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsukɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a hla mɛ ngɔ to kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. Benɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsukɔ a he kɛ je a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he ta a, Aaron ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ.
E pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha mɛ nɛ e kɛ tsukɔ a he.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ ya sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a sisi.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a pee ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a pee ha mɛ.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mlaa nɛ kɔɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Levi no tsuaa Levi no nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ kɛ yaa a, e ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enuɔ kɛ yaa a, mɛɛ a ma kpa ní tsumi.
Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, a ní tsumi ji kaa a maa piɛ a nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a be ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ ko tsue.
Bɔ nɛ o maa to ní tsumi ɔ he blɔ nya kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Hetsɔmi enyɔne ɔ Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ se jeha enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ be nɛ a to ɔ mi.
Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ we gbɔkuɛ nya si ji be nɛ a to ke nyɛɛ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye lɛ ngɛ mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ. Nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se ni komɛ ngɛ a kpɛti nɛ a ble a he, ejakaa a ta nɔ gbogboe he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba Mose kɛ Aaron a ngɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a ba de ke, “E ngɛ mi kaa wa ya ta nɔ gbogboe he nɛ wa he tsɔ we, se mɛni he je nɛ a tsiɔ wa nya kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ko piɛ Israel bi kpa amɛ a he, nɛ́ waa ngɔ wa nike ní kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ be nɛ a to ɔ mi?” Mose de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si ma nu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma fa mi ke ma de nyɛ.” Yawɛ de Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko, aloo nyɛ nina ko ya ta nɔ gbogboe he nɛ e kɛ ble e he, aloo e hia blɔ kɛ ho ma se lokoo ya a, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ma nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ Hetsɔmi ɔ faa.
Se mohu ɔ, e ye lɛ gbɔkuɛ nya si nyɔhiɔ kake se, ngɛ nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ.
A ngɔ abolo kplolo, kɛ pui doodooe kɛ ye.
A ko si eko nɛ je nɛ na yi, nɛ á ko ywia lohwe ɔ wu ko hulɔ; a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.
Se nɔmlɔ nɛ he tsɔ, nɛ e hiɛ blɔ hulɔ, nɛ e kua Hetsɔmi ɔ yemi ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ lɛɛ a je lɛ we kɛ je e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti; ejakaa e kɛ Yawɛ nike ní ɔ bɛ be nɛ a to ɔ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e musu maa tloo lɛ.
“Ke nubwɔ ko ba ngɛ nyɛ ma a mi nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, e ye ngɛ Yawɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔ nya.
Mlaa kake nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nubwɔ jio, zugba a nɔ bi fɔfɔɛ jio.” La bɔku ɔ -Ligbi ɔ nɛ a ma kpe he ɔ, bɔku ɔ ba ha he.
Kɛ je gbɔkuɛ kɛ ya si je na a, bɔku ɔ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la.
Be tsuaa be nɛ bɔku ɔ ma wo e he nɔ kɛ je bo tsu ɔ he pɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hia nyɛɛmi.
He tsuaa he nɛ bɔku ɔ maa da si ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu ji he nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu maa to si ngɛ.
Ke Yawɛ fa Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛkɛ a hia; ke e fa mɛ ekohu kɛkɛ a to si.
Ligbi abɔ nɛ bɔku ɔ daa si ngɛ kpe he ɔ yi mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hu hii si ngɛ sito he ɔ. Ke e ba mi kaa bɔku ɔ se kɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ yi mi ligbi babauu po ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ buɔ Yawɛ tue, nɛ a hiɛ blɔ.
Be komɛ hu bɔku ɔ hii kpe he ɔ yi mi ligbi bɔɔ pɛ.
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ke Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hi sito he ɔ jio, aloo a maa hia blɔ jio, ja Yawɛ fa mɛ.
Be komɛ po bɔku ɔ hii lejɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ gbɔkuɛ kɛ ya siɔ mɔtu; nɛ ke e wo e he nɔ pɛ a hia blɔ; piani jio, nyɔ mi jio, be tsuaa be nɛ bɔku ɔ ma wo e he nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ a hia blɔ.
Ke ligbi enyɔ, aloo nyɔhiɔ kake, aloo be nɛ kɛ pe ja po nɛ bɔku ɔ daa si ngɛ kpe he ɔ yi mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hii sito he ɔ nɛ a hiɛ blɔ; ja bɔku ɔ wo e he nɔ loko a maa hia blɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ buɔ Yawɛ tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke a maa to si jio, a maa hia nyɛɛmi jio, ja Yawɛ fa mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ.
Sika hiɔ titimati ɔmɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ngɔɔ sika hiɔ nɛ a fia nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee titimati enyɔ, konɛ ke a ma bua ma kpekpemi ɔ nya, aloo ke ma a maa hia blɔ ɔ, a kpa.
Ke a kpa titimati enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo kɛ mo ma ba kpe ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Se ke a kpa kake pɛ lɛɛ Israel ma nimeli, nɛ ji wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a kɛ mo ma ba kpe.
Ke titimati ɔ pɛ, nɛ a he ose ɔ, ma a nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ beleku je ɔ maa hia.
Ke titimati ɔ pɛ, nɛ a he ose si enyɔne ɔ, ma a nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ maa hia.
Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa hia blɔ ɔ, a kpa titimati ɔ, nɛ a he ose.
Ke a ma bua ma kpekpemi ɔ nya a, lɛɛ a kpa titimati ɔ kɛkɛ, se a ko he ose.
Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma kpa titimati ɔmɛ.
“Mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ ha yi nɔhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ yaa neneene ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke he nyɛli ba tua nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ, nɛ e ba mi kaa nyɛ gba ta kɛ fa nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ he ose.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kai nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Jehanɛ, ngɛ nyɛ nyami ligbihi, kɛ ligbi kpahi nɛ a to ɔ, kɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ hu nyɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ sãe.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kai nyɛ.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.” Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Sinai Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt ɔ se jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, bɔku ɔ wo e he nɔ kɛ je kpe he ɔ he nɛ mlaa womi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ a tsa a nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ hluu kɛ ya si bɔku ɔ ya da si ngɛ Paran nga a nɔ.
Benɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ, nɛ a maa hia nyɛɛmi kekleekle ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa a hia kekle tabo nya tabo nya.
A nyatsɛ ji Aminadab bi Nashon.
Zuar bi Netanel ji Isakar bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Zebulun bi ɔmɛ hu a nyatsɛ ji Helon bi Eliab.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a gbɛ bo tsu ɔ; nɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Merari bi ɔmɛ nɛ tloo bo tsu ɔ hia nyɛɛmi.
Ruben bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa.
A nyatsɛ ji Shedeur bi Elizur.
Zurishadai bi Shelumiel ji Simeon bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Deuel bi Eliasaf hu ji Gad bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Jehanɛ, Kohat bi ɔmɛ nɛ tloo ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hu hia; nɛ benɛ a ke a suu sito he kpa a, a na kaa a kɛ bo tsu ɔ ma si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo.
Efraim bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ Kohat bi ɔmɛ a se tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa.
A nyatsɛ ji Amihud bi Elishama.
Pedazur bi Gamaliel ji Manase bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Gideoni bi Abidan hu ji Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Nyagbe ɔ, Dan bi ɔmɛ hia tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa.
Mɛ ji Israel ta a tsuo a se tabo, nɛ a nyatsɛ ji Amishadai bi Ahiezer.
Okran bi Pagiel ji Asher bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Enan bi Ahira hu ji Naftali bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Ke Israel ma a maa hia blɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a plɛɔ kɛ nyɛɛɔ tabo nya tabo nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de e ngatsɛ Yetro, Midian no ɔ bi Hobab ke, “Wa ngɛ hiae kɛ yaa he nɛ Yawɛ de to ke e ma ha wɔ ɔ. Yawɛ nitsɛ wo Israel ní kpakpahi a he si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha waa ho nɛ waa kɛ mo ya ye wa kplɔkɔtɔ ɔ.” Se Hobab de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi; i be yae; ma kpale kɛ ya imi nitsɛ ye ma mi, kɛ imi nitsɛ ye nyɛmimɛ a ngɔ mohu.” Mose ya nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ko si wɔ.
Mo lɛ o le nga a nɔ hehi nɛ hi nɛ wa maa to si ngɛ; mo ji nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ.
Ke o kɛ wɔ ya a, nɔ́ kpakpa tsuaa nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ kɛ maa gbaa wɔ ɔ, waa kɛ mo maa dla.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a hia kɛ je Yawɛ yo ɔ he, nɛ a nyɛɛ ligbi etɛ.
Yawɛ somi daka a nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ hla sito he ha mɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, Yawɛ bɔku ɔ ma ba da a yi mi piani.
Be tsuaa be nɛ somi daka a maa hia a, Mose ma de ke, “Yawɛ, tee si!
Gbɛɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa; nɛ o ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume mo ɔ nɛ a tu fo ngɛ o hɛ mi!” Be tsuaa be nɛ somi daka a maa da si ɔ, e ma de ke, “Yawɛ, kpale o se!
Kpale kɛ ba Israel bi akpeakpe abɔ ɔ a ngɔ!”
Tabera Ma a tu munyu huitihuiti ngɛ a haomihi a he.
Benɛ Yawɛ nu ɔ, e mi mi fu, nɛ e ha la tso ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ la a kpata níhi a hɛ mi ngɛ a sito he ɔ kasa fa kake.
Ma a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Mose, nɛ Mose hu kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ la a gbo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Tabera, nɛ a de ke, “Wa wo kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ la sã ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Mose hla nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi kpaago E ba mi kaa de lo ba bɔni futufututsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ jlomi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ nitsɛ hu wo yana ekohu nɛ a bi ke, “Ao, wa be de lo nae maa ye lo?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ lo pueɔ si ngɛ Egipt nɛ a pee we he nɔ́ ko, nɛ wa yeɔ bɔ nɛ wa suɔ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ jamatlɛ ɔmɛ, atlɛ ɔmɛ, pui ɔ, kɛ sabola amɛ!
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ wa he wami nɔ gbɔ, nɛ wa na we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa kaa ja mana nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.” Mana ngɛ kaa nya mi saalɔ, nɛ e su ngɛ kaa hlɔɔba nyu nɛ je tso he toto mi pue si.
Ke ni ɔmɛ ya bua mana nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a wɛɛɔ ngɛ wɛ nɔ, aloo a gbeeɔ ngɛ fufui tso mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a hooɔ ngɛ buɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ peeɔ keeki; e ngɔɔ kaa keeki nɛ a ngɔ nu kɛ sã.
Ke bɔ́ nɛ ngɛ sito he ɔ nyɔ mi kɛkɛ mana a hu pue si.
Mose nu nɛ ma a tsuo wo yana ngɛ a we puɔ nya ngɛ a bo tsu sinya amɛ a nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ Mose nya kulaa.
Mose bi Yawɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o ye imi, o tsɔlɔ sane yayami kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ o ná ye he abofu, nɛ o ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ tsuo yi tlomi ngɔ tloo mi ɔ?
Imi lɛ i ngɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɔ?
Imi lɛ i fɔ mɛ, loko o deɔ mi ke ma hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ ye mi si kaa bimɛanyɛ hɛɛɔ bimwɔyo, kɛ ya zugba nɛ o ka kita ke o maa ngɔ kɛ ha a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ?
Jije ma ná de lo ngɛ kɛ ha ma nɛ ɔ tsuo?
Ejakaa a wo yana kɛ wo mi, nɛ a ngɛ mi dee ke ma ha mɛ de lo nɛ a ye.
Imi nɔ kake too pɛ i be nyɛe ma hɛɛ ma nɛ ɔ; tlomi ɔ jiɔ tsɔ ha mi.
Ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ o kɛ mi maa ye ɔ, lɛɛ ke o ngɛ ye he suɔmi ɔ, gbee mi amlɔ mohu, konɛ ma ko na nɔ́ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ o dɛ mi ekohu.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya hla nikɔtɔmahi nɛ bu ngɛ a he nyingmi kpaago kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
A pee nikɔtɔmahi nɛ mo nitsɛ o le kaa a hɛɛ blɔ nya ngɛ ma a mi.
Ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ba da si ngɛ o kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma kple si, nɛ i kɛ mo ma ba tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma je mumi nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ eko kɛ ha mɛ.
A maa kpee mo kɛ tloo ma a tlomi ɔ, nɛ mo nɔ kake too pɛ o be tlooe hu.
Jehanɛ, mo de ma a ke, ‘Nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha hwɔɔ; ejakaa nyɛ maa ye de lo.
Benɛ de lo jlo nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ fo he ya, nɛ nyɛ de ke nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ mohu ɔ, Yawɛ nu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ de lo nɛ nyɛɛ ye.
Pi ligbi kake, loo ligbi enyɔ, loo ligbi enuɔ, loo ligbi nyɔngma, loo ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ maa ye.
Se mohu, nyɛ maa ye de lo nyɔhiɔ mluku kɛ yaa si be nɛ e maa je kpo ngɛ nyɛ gugwɔ puɔ mi, nɛ e maa gbe nyɛ nya.
Ejakaa nyɛ kua Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ bi ke mɛni he je nɛ a ha nyɛ je Egipt mɔ?’ ” Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Ma a nɛ i hɛɛ ɔ, a kpɛti nyumuhi kɛkɛ a hiɛmi ji akpe lafa ekpa.
Nɛ o deɔ ke o ma ha mɛ de lo nɛ a ye nyɔhiɔ mluku!
Anɛ a ma na tohi kɛ nahi maa gbe nɛ maa su mɛ?
Aloo ke a bua wo mi lohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nya a, e maa su mɛ?” Yawɛ bi Mose ke, “Anɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pe Yawɛ, nɛ e be nyɛe maa pee lo?
Si nɛ i wo ɔ, e maa ba mi jio, e be mi bae jio, o maa na piɔ.” Mose je kpo, nɛ e ya bɔ ma a nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ. E ya bua ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago a nya, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ba da si kɛ bɔle bo tsu ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kple si kɛ je bɔku mi kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ Mose ba tu munyu.
E je mumi nɛ ngɛ Mose mi ɔ eko kɛ ha ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ.
Benɛ mumi ɔ ba a nɔ ɔ, a bɔni ngmlaa kpami kaa gbali; se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se kɛ we.
Ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ ɔ, a ti ni enyɔ tlɔ sito he ɔ, nɛ mɛɛ a na we nɛ a ya bo tsu ɔ mi.
Nɔ kake biɛ ji Eldad, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Medad.
Benɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, mumi ɔ ba a nɔ, nɛ mɛ hu a bɔni ngmlaa kpami kaa gbali.
Kɛkɛ nɛ niheyo ko gbɔ fo ya de Mose ke, “Eldad kɛ Medad ngɛ gbae ngɛ sito he ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Nun binyumu Yoshua, nɛ ji Mose sɔmɔlɔ kɛ je e nihe mi ɔ tu munyu nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ Mose, ha nɛ a kpa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ!” Se Mose he nɔ ke, “Imi lɛ o ngɛ hunga jee ha nɛ ɔ?
I na jinɛ Yawɛ ngɔ e mumi ɔ ngɔ ha e ma a tsuo, nɛ mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa kaa gbali!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kɛ Israel ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo kpale a se kɛ ho sito he ɔ ya.
Bebeehi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ fia, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ muɔ bebeehi kɛ je wo ɔ mi ba pue si maa pee ligbi kake blɔ nyɛɛmi kɛ bɔle sito he ɔ tsuo kɛ kpe.
Bebee ɔmɛ te kɛ mimla sito he ɔ haa maa pee kaa nine mi blimi eywiɛ kɛ je zugba.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ tsuo, piani, nyɔ mi, kɛ jena nɔ ɔ, ma a tsuo ho nɛ a ya bua bebeehi a nya; nɔ nɛ na we pe kulaa po na kilo akpe.
A ka bebee ɔmɛ tsɛtsɛ kɛ bɔle sito he ɔ kɛ kpe.
Benɛ a ngɛ lo ɔ yee, nɛ e na we nɛ e ta a, Yawɛ mi mi fu ma a, nɛ e ha gbenɔ hiɔ ba sɛ a kpɛti.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke, “Jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ a Yɔkɔhi.” Ejakaa nihi nɛ pee de lo he jiklɔɔ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ a pu mɛ ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma a hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Hazerot ya, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A gbla Miriam tue Mose ya ngɔ Kush yo ko, nɛ Miriam kɛ Aaron tu munyu kɛ si Mose ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he.
A bi ke, “Anɛ Mose nɔ kake too nɔ Yawɛ gu kɛ tu munyu lo?
Anɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ e gui wa nɔ kɛ tu we munyu lo?” Yawɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ a de ɔ. Mose nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ he jɔ ji lɛ; niinɛ e he jɔ pe nimli adesahi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Tlukaa a, Yawɛ de Mose, Miriam, kɛ Aaron ke, “Nyɛ ni etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.” A ho, nɛ Yawɛ kple si ngɛ bɔku titima ko mi ba da bo tsu sinya a nya.
E tsɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam, nɛ a je kpo kɛ ba.
Yawɛ de mɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Ke gbalɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, ní nami mi nɛ imi Yawɛ, i jeɔ ye he si kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ.
Nlami mi nɛ i kɛ lɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ.
Ye tsɔlɔ Mose lɛɛ e slo lɛ!
Lɛɛ i ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to ye ma Israel tsuo nya.
Lɛɛ i kɛ lɛ tuɔ munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi paa; se pi ngɛ abɛ gbi mi.
Ye su nitsɛ po lɛɛ e na hyɛ.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ yi gbeye, nɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ si ye tsɔlɔ Mose?” Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɛ benɛ e si mɛ, nɛ bɔku ɔ je bo tsu ɔ yi mi ɔ, he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya pue Miriam he, nɛ e pee sakoo kaa snoo.
Benɛ Aaron plɛ hyɛ Miriam nɛ e na kaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, e de Mose ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, koo gbla wa tue ngɛ kuasia nɛ wa je, kɛ yayami nɛ wa pee nɛ ɔ he.
Ko ha nɛ Miriam nɛ pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ gbo ngɛ e nyɛ muklii mi, nɛ benɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ, e he womi ɔ fa pɔtɔ momo.” Mose kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o tsa lɛ!” Se Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ke Miriam tsɛ su lada pue e hɛ mi ɔ, anɛ e kɛ zo be e he lae ligbi kpaago lo?
A je lɛ kɛ je sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya tsi e nya ligbi kpaago loko a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ekohu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je Miriam kɛ je sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya tsi e nya otsi.
Ma a hiɛ blɔ kɛ ya si a kpale ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma a hia kɛ je Hazerot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Paran nga a nɔ.
Slaali nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo hla nyumu nɔkɔtɔma kake kɛ je wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi, nɛ o tsɔ mɛ nɛ a ya slaa Kanaan zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hae ɔ.” -Mose tsɔ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ je Paran nga a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
A biɛhi, kɛ wɛtsohi nɛ a je mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA Ruben Shamua, Zakur bi ɔ Simeon Shafat, Hori bi ɔ Yuda Kaleb, Yefune bi ɔ Isakar Igal, Yosef bi ɔ Efraim Hoshea, Nun bi ɔ Benyamin Palti, Rafu bi ɔ Zebulun Gadiel, Sodi bi ɔ Manase Gadi, Susi bi ɔ Dan Amiel, Gemali bi ɔ Asher Setur, Mikael bi ɔ Naftali Nabi, Vofsi bi ɔ Gad Geuel, Maki bi ɔ. Nyumuhi nɛ Mose tsɔ ke a ya slaa zugba a, a biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Se Nun bi Hoshea lɛɛ Mose tsake e biɛ kɛ pee Yoshua.
Benɛ Mose tsɔ mɛ ke a ya slaa Kanaan zugba a, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ gu omleyi je kɛ ya kuɔ yoku ɔmɛ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ zugba a ngɛ ha, kɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, kaa nimli ɔmɛ a he wa, loo a he wɛ, kaa a hiɛ, loo a he pi.
Zugba a nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa e hi, loo e hí.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa mahi nɛ a ngɛ mi ɔ, ma tsɔwitsɔwihi, loo mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa zugba a baa ní, loo e bɛ ní, kaa tsohi ngɛ nɔ, loo tsohi be nɔ.
Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ zugba a nɔ tso yiblii komɛ kɛ ba.” Jamɛ a be ɔ ji kekleekle wai yiblii fumi be.
Nyumu ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya slaa zugba a, kɛ je Zin nga a nɔ kɛ ya si Rehob, he nɛ a guu kɛ yaa Hamat ɔ.
A nyɛɛ kɛ gu leneyi je hluu kɛ ya si Hebron.
Lejɛ ɔ ji Ahiman, Sheshai, kɛ Talmai nɛ ji Anak bi ɔmɛ a hi he.
(A po Hebron ma a jeha kpaago loko a po Zoan ngɛ Egipt).
Benɛ a su Eskol kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, a po wai tso kɔni kake kɛ e nɔ wai yiblii sau kake ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpɛti ni enyɔ wo lɛ tso nɛ a kpla ngɛ a konɔ.
A kɛ tso yiblii ko kaa akutu kɛ ngmɔkɔ hu ba.
Nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Eskol kɔ̃, ngɛ wai yiblii sau ɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ po ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he.
A slaa zugba a ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ba na Mose, kɛ Aaron, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ngɛ Paran nga a nɔ, ngɛ Kadesh.
A gba mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ya na ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ngɔ zugba a nɔ tso yiblii komɛ hu ba tsɔɔ mɛ.
A de Mose ke, “Wa ya slaa zugba a nɛ o tsɔ wɔ e nɔ ɔ; niinɛ, wa na kaa e ji zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní.
Zugba a nɔ tso yiblii komɛ po ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Se mohu, nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛkɛ lɛ a he wa.
A ma amɛ hu kle agboagbo nitsɛ, nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wo wa he gbeye pe kulaa ji oblai komɛ nɛ wa na ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Amalek bi ngɛ zugba a leneyi je; Hit bi, Yebus bi, kɛ Amor bi ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ Kanaan bi ngɛ wo ɔ nya, kɛ Yordan pa a he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Kaleb kuɛ wo ma a ngɛ Mose hɛ mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ya esɔesɔ nɛ wa ya ngɔ zugba a; ejakaa wa ma nyɛ ngɔ faa.” Se nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ lɛ ya slaa zugba a de ke, “Wa be nyɛe maa da nimli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, ejakaa a he wa pe wɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gba Israel bi ɔmɛ zugba a nɛ a ya slaa a he sane yaya, nɛ a de ke, “Zugba a nɛ wa ya slaa a, e ji zugba nɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ bi a yi tanee, ejakaa zugba a hí.
Jehanɛ, nimli nɛ wa ya na ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ hu, nyumu oblaihi sɔuu ji mɛ.
Benɛ wa na oblai agboagbo ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Anak bi ɔmɛ, nɛ wa ngɔ wa he ngɔ to a he ɔ, wa pee tsɔwitsɔwi kaa adodohi; nɛ jã kɛ̃ wa ngɛ ngɛ mɛ hu a hɛ mi.”
Ma a tu munyu huitihuiti Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, ma a tsuo wo yana, nɛ a kɛ aywilɛho kpa huhui.
Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo hɔɔ nya si ngɔ wo Mose kɛ Aaron a he, nɛ a de ke, “Wa ná nɛ jinɛ wa gbo ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, loo ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ po!
Mɛni he je Yawɛ kpaka wɔ kɛ yaa zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ wa ya gbo ngɛ klaate nya, nɛ a ngɔ wa yihi, kɛ wa bimɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ?
Anɛ e be hie mohu kaa waa kpale wa se kɛ ho Egipt ya lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a de a he ke, “Nyɛ ha waa hla wa nyatsɛ nɛ waa kpale kɛ ho Egipt ya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ Yefune bi Kaleb, nɛ ji slaali ɔmɛ a ti nihi enyɔ hía a he tadehi, nɛ a de Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo ke, “Zugba a nɛ wa ya kpa nɔ nɛ wa slaa lɛ ɔ, e ji zugba nɛ hi saminya.
Ke Yawɛ ngɛ wa he tsui ɔ, e ma kpaka wɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ; nɛ e maa ngɔ zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ.
Se, nyɛ ko tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã.
Nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ hu, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye; wa maa ye a nɔ kunimi hɛngmɛfia.
A he wami nya ba si, se wɔɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma mluku ɔ tsuo de ke a fia mɛ tɛ.
Se tlukaa a, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ba je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a tsuo ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he.
Mose fa kue ha ma a Yawɛ bi Mose ke, “Kɛ yaa si mɛni be ma nɛ ɔ ma kua mi?
Kɛ yaa si mɛni be loko a ma he mi maa ye ngɛ okadihi babauu nɛ i pee ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ he?
Ma ngɔ gbenɔ hiɔ kɛ fɔ a nɔ, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Se moo lɛɛ ma pee mo ma nguaa; ma nɛ kle pe mɛ, nɛ he wa pe mɛ hulɔ.” Se Mose de Yawɛ ke, “O ngɔ o kɔni si wami kɛ je ma nɛ ɔ kɛ je Egipt.
Ke Egipt bi ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ o pee o ma a, a maa sɛɛ ha zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nu momo kaa mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ wa kpɛti.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nu momo kaa mo Yawɛ, o bɔku ɔ ba daa si ngɛ wa yi mi, nɛ a naa mo paa hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.
A nu momo kaa piani ɔ, o nyɛɛɔ wa hɛ mi ngɛ bɔku titima mi, nɛ nyɔ mi lɛɛ o nyɛɛɔ wa hɛ mi ngɛ la titima mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o gbe o ma nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, je ma amɛ nɛ nu o biɛ ɔ he ɔ ma de ke, ‘Yawɛ kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ, ejakaa e nyɛ we nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ ya su zugba a nɛ e wo si ke e maa ngɔ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.’ Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, Yawɛ, mo je o he wami kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ, nɛ o ye o si womi ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o de wɔ ɔ ke ‘Imi, Yawɛ, ye mi mi fu we mla, nɛ ye mɔbɔ nami hiɛ babauu; i ngɔɔ tɔmi kɛ yayami ngɔ paa.
Se kɛ̃, i ha we nɛ yayami peeli yeɔ a he; mohu i kɛ tsɛmɛ a tɔmihi a he hiɔwo ɔ gblaa bimɛ kɛ bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ ya siɔ yi nɔ etɛne, kɛ eywiɛne bi a nɔ.’ I kpa mo pɛɛ, ngɔɔ ma nɛ ɔ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ ngɛ o mɔbɔ nami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya, kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ kɛ je Egipt hluu kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ.” Yawɛ he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I ngɔ kɛ pa mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o bi ɔ.
Se anɔkuale, ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ, nɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi nyami ma hyi zugba a tsuo tɔ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ na ye hɛ mi nyami, kɛ okadihi nɛ i pee ngɛ Egipt kɛ nga a nɔ, se kɛ̃ a ka mi si nyɔngma sɔuu, nɛ a bui ye gbi tue ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake po be zugba a nɛ i ka kita ke ma ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nae.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ kua mi ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be zugba a nae.
Se ye tsɔlɔ Kaleb lɛɛ slo e mumi; lɛɛ e bu mi tue kɛ ya si nyagbe.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kɛ lɛ maa su zugba a nɛ a ya slaa a nɔ, nɛ e se bimɛ a nine maa su nɔ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi he je ɔ, hwɔɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ ya gu blɔ nɛ ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ he ɔ kɛ ya nga a nɔ.” Yawɛ gbla ma a tue Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Mɛni be ma yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ maa hɔɔ nya si kɛ wo mi kɛ yaa si?
Munyu huitihuiti nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ tue kɛ ngɛ mi sie ɔ, i nu.
Nyɛ de mɛ ke imi Yawɛ, i ke, ‘Ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ma pee ha nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ bi ɔ. Nyɛ ma gbo pue si ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ a ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ a ngma a biɛ, nɛ a hɔɔ nya si kɛ wo mi ɔ, a ti nɔ kake be zugba a nɛ i ka kita ke i kɛ ma ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nae, ja Yefune bi Kaleb, kɛ Nun bi Yoshua pɛ.
Nyɛ bi tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ de ke a maa ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, i kɛ mɛ maa su zugba a nɛ nyɛ kua a nɔ, nɛ e maa pee a nɔ.
Se nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma gbo tlɔ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ bimɛ maa wo lalaalo ngɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ a maa na nɔ́ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ be ɔ he, kɛ yaa si be nɛ nyɛ nyagbe nɔ ɔ ma gbo fɔ si ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Nyɛ slaa zugba a ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ, se nyɛ ma na nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he tue gblami jeha nyingmi eywiɛ; ligbi kake ma plɛ pee jeha ha nyɛ.
Nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa i je nyɛ se.
I ngɛ kita kae kaa nyɛ nimli kpekpemi yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã wo mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ma pee nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma gbo tlɔ nga a nɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ ” Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ Mose tsɔ ya slaa zugba a, nɛ a ba gba Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ zugba a he sane yayami, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a hɔɔ nya si kɛ wo Mose ɔ, Yawɛ ha gbenɔ hiɔ ba fia mɛ nɛ a gbo.
Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ya slaa zugba a, Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ Yefune bi Kaleb pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi na wami.
A ka zugba a ngɔmi Benɛ Mose ya bɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo sane nɛ ɔ, a ye kɔmɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
A te si mɔtu kpla, nɛ a kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya tɔɔ, nɛ a de ke “Jehanɛ wa dla wa he; wa maa ya he nɛ Yawɛ wo wɔ si ɔ. Kpaako wa na kaa wa pee yayami.” Se Mose de ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ pa ngɛ Yawɛ fami ɔ nɔ tue gboe ɔ?
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be hie.
Nyɛ ko ya, ejakaa Yawɛ be nyɛ se.
Ke nyɛ ya a, nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa fia nyɛ ní kɛ pue si.
Ke nyɛɛ kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ya bua a, nyɛ maa nɔ ngɛ klaate nya.
Yawɛ be nyɛ he piɛe, ejakaa nyɛ kua lɛ.” Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a si a gugue, nɛ a kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya, be mi nɛ Yawɛ somi daka a, kɛ Mose na we nɛ a je sito he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Amalek bi, kɛ Kanaan bi nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a yoku ɔ nɔ ɔ ba tua mɛ, nɛ a ye a nɔ; nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ ya si Horma tɔɔ.
Bɔ sami he mlaahi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyɛ ya su zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛɛ kɛ na, loo to maa sã bɔ nɛ je via ha mi ɔ, sami bɔ jio, si womi nɔ yemi bɔ jio, bɔ nɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa jio, aloo bɔ nɛ a sãã ngɛ ligbi nguahi nɛ a to ɔ eko nɔ jio, -nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba sã kikɛmɛ a bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e ngɔ niye ní bɔ ngɔ piɛ he.
Lɔ ɔ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu lita kake.
Se ke agbosu lɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu lita kake kɛ fa kɛ pee niye ní bɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ wai lita kake kɛ fa ngɔ piɛ he kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, konɛ e je via kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Ke nyɛɛ kɛ na ku ma sami bɔ, loo si womi nɔ yemi bɔ, loo tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, niye ní bɔ nɛ á kɛ piɛ na ku ɔ he kɛ ba ji, ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu lita enyɔ, kɛ wai lita enyɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via kɛ haa Yawɛ.
“Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ na ku, aloo agbosu, aloo jijɔ bi, aloo apletsi bi kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ kɛ piɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke lohwe ɔ hiɛ pe kake ɔ, bɔ ɔ nɛ maa piɛ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu e hiɛ ja nɔuu.
Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ke e kɛ e niye ní bɔ ɔ ba; e ji bɔ nɛ jeɔ via kɛ haa Yawɛ.
Ke nubwɔ ko ba to nyɛ be kuku, aloo ke e ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti daa, nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ jeɔ via haa Yawɛ kɛ ba a, lɛ hu e pee kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ɔ nɔuu.
Mlaa kake too maa pee mlaa ha ma a, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ kɛ yaa neneene.
Ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye mlaa kake, kɛ blɔ nya tomi kake nɔ.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyɛ ya su zugba a nɛ i kɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ bɔni zugba a nɔ ní yemi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ eko ba ha Yawɛ kaa nyɛ nike ní klɛdɛɛ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ kekleekle ma a kɛ sã abolo, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ blɛfo he nɛ nyɛ kpɔ ba haa Yawɛ kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Ngɛ nyɛ yi nɔhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ kekleekle ma nɛ ɔ mi eko kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa nyɛ nike ní klɛdɛɛ.
“Alini mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha Mose ɔ, nyɛ ma ya tɔ ekomɛ a nɔ.
Alini mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ, yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ nyɛ se ɔ be mlaa amɛ a nɔ yee.
Ke e ba mi kaa ma mluku nɛ ɔ li a he be nɛ a ya tɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ma a tsuo maa ngɔ na niheyo kake kɛ ba sã sami bɔ nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
A ngɔ niye ní bɔ, kɛ dã nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ kusumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, a kɛ akpakpo kake hu ba sã yayami pami bɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ maa da Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nane mi, nɛ e maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ.
A maa ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ; ejakaa a li nɛ a pee.
Enɛ ɔ he hu lɛ a ngɔ yayami pami bɔ ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa a li nɛ a pee.
A kɛ Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to mɛ ɔ a he yayamihi maa pa mɛ; ejakaa mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tɔ.
“Ke nɔ kake ko li be nɛ e ya tɔ ɔ, e ngɔ apletsi yo kake nɛ ye jeha kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ.
Osɔfo ɔ maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ; nɛ a kɛ e he yayami ɔ maa pa lɛ.
Mlaa kake ɔ nɔuu ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ li e he be nɛ e ya pee yayami ko, Israel fɔmi bi jio, nɔ kpa ko nɛ ba to nyɛ nubwɔ jio.
“Se ke nɔ ko je blɔ pee yayami ko ɔ, zugba a nɔ fɔmi bi ji lɛ jio, nubwɔ ji lɛ jio, nɔ ɔ bɔ Yawɛ ahlua; a je lɛ kɛ je e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Akɛnɛ e bui Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue, nɛ e ya tɔ e mlaa a nɔ he je ɔ, a je lɛ we pɛsɛpɛsɛ; e musu nɛ tloo lɛ.” Nyumu ɔ nɛ ble Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, e ba mi kaa a ya na nyumu ko nɛ ngɛ lɛ́ lɛe Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya na nyumu ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ́ ɔ lɛe ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba Mose, kɛ Aaron, kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi.
A tsi e nya ngɛ tsu mi, ejakaa a na we nɛ a tsɔɔ nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ sa kaa a pee lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “A gbe nyumu ɔ; ma a tsuo nɛ ya fia lɛ tɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a tsuo gbla lɛ kɛ ho ma sito he ɔ se ya, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si e gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. Tadehi a he dekehi Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a kpɛ deke ngɔ wo a tade ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ yi nɔhi tsuo; nɛ a ngɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi deke ɔmɛ kɛ wo tade ɔmɛ a nya.
Deke nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee kaimi nɔ́ kɛ ha nyɛ.
Ke nyɛ hyɛ mɛ pɛ nyɛ ma kai Yawɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ko je ye se kɛ ya nyɛɛ basabasa kɛ pee nyɛ suɔmi nya ní.
Deke ɔmɛ ma ha nyɛ ma kai ye mlaa amɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu kɛ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ; i je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma ba pee nyɛ Mawu.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.”
Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram tsɔ atuã - Ligbi ko ɔ, Izhar binyumu Kora, nɛ je Kohat we puɔ nya ngɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, ya dɔ nihi ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ a te si ngɔ wo Mose.
Ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyumuhi etɛ je Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi.
Mɛ ji Eliab binyumuhi Datan, kɛ Abiram, kɛ Pelet binyumu On.
Israel bi kpahi lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ piɛ a he.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ma nimeli nɛ a le mɛ saminya, nɛ ma a hla mɛ.
A kpe kɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron a he, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee tsɔ.
Ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nimli klɔuklɔuhi ji mɛ; nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ a kpɛti.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ woe ngɛ Yawɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ nɔ ɔ?” Benɛ Mose nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e de Kora kɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ji e nɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ji e nɔ nɛ e maa hla a, Yawɛ ma ha nɛ e hɛ lɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: mo Kora, kɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ya hla ngɛyuhi.
Hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, nyɛɛ je la kɛ wo ngɛyu ɔmɛ a mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue la a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa hla a, lɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ Levi bi, nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ woe tsɔ!” Mose ya nɔ nɛ e de Kora ke, “Nyɛɛ bu mi tue, nyɛ Levi bi; anɛ e pi ha nyɛ kaa Israel Mawu ɔ hla nyɛ kɛ je Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ mi konɛ nyɛɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba tsu ní ngɛ Yawɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ da ma kpekpemi ɔ nya kaa a sɔmɔli lo?
Mawu ha mo, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo kikɛmɛ a blɔ nya nɛ ɔ. Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ pa ngɛ osɔfo yemi ɔ hu hlae lo.
Hyɛ, Yawɛ yi nɔ nɛ o kɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ soe ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, Aaron ɔ lɛɛ mɛni e pee nyɛ loko nyɛ ngɛ nya si hɔɔe kɛ ngɛ lɛ woe ɔ?” Mose tsɔ ke a ya tsɛ Datan, kɛ Abiram, Eliab bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba.
Se a de ke, “Wa be bae!
O kpaka wɔ kɛ je zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní nɔ, nɛ́ o ba gbe wɔ ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Anɛ enɛ ɔ pi ha mo, nɛ o pa ngɛ hlae nɛ o ye ganɔ ngɛ wa nɔ?
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, o kɛ wɔ yɛ zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní ko nɔ; ngmɔhi, kɛ wai abɔɔhi hu o ha we wɔ.
Anɛ e peeɔ mo kaa o ma nyɛ nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ maa sisi lo?
Dɛbi, wa be bae!” Mose mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e de Yawɛ ke, “Ko he bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ba sã a!
I he we teji kake po ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ i yi a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko sane yayami ko hulɔ.” Mose de Kora ke, “Hwɔɔ ɔ, o kɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa nyɛɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi; Aaron hu maa ba lejɛ ɔ. O se nyɛɛli lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛyu, nɛ e kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via wo mi, nɛ e kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho ya ngɔ ngɛyu, nɛ e je la kɛ wo mi, nɛ e ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue nɔ, nɛ e ba da si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu sinya a nya ngɛ Mose kɛ Aaron a kasa nya.
Kora ya kpee ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu sinya a nya, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee Mose kɛ Aaron.
Tlukaa a, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ba je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo.
Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je ma nɛ ɔ he kɛ ya se, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi hɛngmɛfia.” Se Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ a de ke, “Mawu lee, mo nɛ o ji adesahi tsuo a mumi.
Anɛ ke nɔ kake pee yayami ɔ, o mi mi ma fu ma a tsuo lo?” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De ma a ke a hɛ mɛ kɛ je Kora, kɛ Datan, kɛ Abiram a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose te si, nɛ e kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Datan, kɛ Abiram a ngɔ ya.
E de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je nimli yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he.
Ke pi ja a, a ma kpata nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hɛ mɛ kɛ je Kora, kɛ Datan, kɛ Abiram a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he.
Datan kɛ Abiram je kpo ba da si ngɛ a bo tsu sinya amɛ a nya; a kɛ a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ.
Mose de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa le kaa Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ, se pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi tomi nya ji ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ gbo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbenɔ, aloo a gbo ngɛ oslaa nya kaa bɔ nɛ nimli adesahi tsuo gboɔ ɔ, lɛɛ tsa pi Yawɛ nɛ tsɔ mi.
Se ke Yawɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ bɛ hyɛ, nɛ zugba bli e nya mi nɛ e mii mɛ kɛ ho yɔkɔ mi ya hɛ ngmengmle, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa le kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kua Yawɛ niinɛ.” Mose nya nɛ e ke e nɔɔ si kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ zugba a mi gba enyɔ ngɛ a sisi, nɛ e mii mɛ kɛ a we mi bimɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ Kora se ɔ, kɛ mɛ hu a níhi tsuo.
Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ho gbeje ya hɛ ngmengmle, kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Zugba a sa a yi, nɛ a hɛ mi kpata.
Israel bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tu fo benɛ a nu ni ɔmɛ a ngmlaa kpami ɔ.
A de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa tu fo, ke pi ja a wɔ hu zugba a maa mii wɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ la je Yawɛ ngɔ ba sã nimli lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via a kɛ ba a. Ngɛyu ɔmɛ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar nɛ e ya je ngɛyu ɔmɛ kɛ je la a mi, nɛ e gbɛ la a kɛ ya se lokoo; ejakaa ngɛyu ɔmɛ a he tsɔ.
Benɛ a ngɔ ngɛyu ɔmɛ kɛ ya Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ a pee ní klɔuklɔuhi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ a he yayami he ɔ, mo de Eleazar nɛ e ya je a ngɛyu ɔmɛ nɛ a fiaa nɔ tɛtlɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ ha bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ kɛ ha Israel ma a.” Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo Eleazar ya kukuɔ akɔblee ngɛyu ɔmɛ, nɛ e ha a fia a nɔ tɛtlɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ pee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he hami nɔ́, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Eleazar kɛ gu Mose nɔ ke e pee ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba pee kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ ko kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, kaa nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ, nɛ e pi Aaron weku ɔ mi no hulɔ ɔ, e be he blɔ nɛ e sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ haa Yawɛ.
Ke nɔ ko pee ja a, a ma kpata e hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a pee Kora kɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ɔ. Aaron he ma a yi wami E nɔ jena a, Israel ma a tsuo hɔɔ nya si kɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron, nɛ a de ke, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ gbe Yawɛ ni ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.” Se benɛ ma a tsuo nya bua ngɔ wo Mose kɛ Aaron he ɔ, a plɛ kɛ kpee kpe he bo tsu ɔ, nɛ a na kaa bɔku ɔ ba ma lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je e he kpo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron ho ya da si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je ma nɛ ɔ he kɛ ya se nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi!” Se Mose kɛ Aaron kpla si nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ bu si, nɛ Mose de Aaron ke, “Ngɔɔ ngɛyu ɔ, nɛ o je la ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ wo mi.
Ngɔɔ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue nɔ, nɛ o hɛɛ kɛ ya ma a ngɔ esɔesɔ, nɛ o ya kpata Yawɛ ha mɛ.
Yawɛ mi mi fu, nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ je sisi.” Kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de lɛ ɔ, Aaron ngɔ e ngɛyu ɔ, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya sɛ ma a kpɛti benɛ a bua a he nya.
Benɛ e na kaa gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ bɔni ní puɛmi momo ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, e kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a pue la a nɔ, nɛ e pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. E ya da si ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ a kpɛti, kɛkɛ nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po.
Nimli nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ gbe ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa kpaago; slo ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ngɛ Kora sane ɔ nɛ ba a mi.
Benɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po ɔ, Aaron kpale e se kɛ ba Mose ngɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Aaron dɛma tso ɔ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ dɛma tso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ba; wɛtsoyi tsuaa wɛtsoyi nɛ ngɔ dɛma tso kake kɛ ba.
Ngmaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ biɛ ngɛ e tso he.
Ngmaa Aaron biɛ ngɛ Levi tso ɔ he; ejakaa wɛtsoyi tsuaa wɛtsoyi ma na tso kake.
Muɔ tso ɔmɛ ya pue somi daka a hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi he nɛ i kɛ mo kpee ngɛ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ ma hla a, e tso ɔ ma tsɛ̃ mɔmɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ munyu huitihuiti nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tuɔ kɛ siɔ nyɛ ngɛ ye he ɔ se maa po.” Mose kɛ Israel ma a ya tu, nɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ dɛma tso kakaaka kɛ ba; lɛ tsuo peeɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ Aaron tso ɔ hu piɛ he.
Mose muɔ tso ɔmɛ tsuo ya pue Yawɛ somi daka a hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
E nɔ jena a benɛ Mose ya bo tsu ɔ mi he nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, e na kaa Aaron tso ɔ nɛ daa si ha Levi wɛtso ɔ tsɛ̃ tso hɛngmɛ he, e pɛ mɔmɔ, nɛ e wo ngmɛ́hi nɛ fu.
Mose muɔ tso ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ je kpo ya tsɔɔ Israel ma a tsuo.
Benɛ a na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo ho ya ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tso ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Kpale Aaron dɛma tso ɔ ya fɔ daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi ekohu, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ kaa kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ kɛ ha atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a munyu huitihuiti ɔmɛ nɛ a tuɔ kɛ siɔ mi ɔ se nɛ po.
Ke pi ja a, a ma gbo.” Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ de Mose ke, “Wa yi ta!
Wa gbe nya!
Wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa yi ta!
Ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su Yawɛ kpe he ɔ he ma gbo ɔ, lɛɛ tse wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa hɛ mi ma kpata mɔ!”
Osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi Yawɛ de Aaron ke, “O kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ o tsɛ we ɔ, nyɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ he sɔ tloo, se nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ osɔfo yemi ní tsumi ɔ he ɔ lɛɛ o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ nyɛ sane ji lɔ ɔ. O nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji o tsɛ weku li ɔmɛ ɔ, ha nɛ mɛ hu a ba piɛ o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ a he, be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi.
A ma sɔmɔ mo, nɛ a ma tsu bo tsu ɔ he ní tsumihi tsuo.
Se mohu, á hyɛ nɛ a ko ta bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, loo ní ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ko gbo.
A maa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ tsu ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi; nɔ kpa ko nɛ ko ba nyɛ kasa nya.
He klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ pɛ nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ ye mi mi nɛ ko fu Israel bi ɔmɛ ekohu.
Imi nitsɛ lɛ i hla nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ i ngɔ mɛ kɛ ha nyɛ kaa nike ní.
A hla mɛ ngɔ to ha mi, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Se o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa nyɛ tsuɔ osɔfo ní tsumihi nɛ kɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a a he.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ji nyɛ ní tsumi; ejakaa imi lɛ i kɛ osɔfo yemi ní tsumi ɔ ke nyɛ.
Nɔ kpa ko nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.” Osɔfo ɔmɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ Yawɛ de Aaron ke, “O nɛ, imi nitsɛ i ngɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nike ní klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba ha mi ɔ kɛ ngɛ o dɛ woe.
I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ngɛ mo, kɛ o bimɛ tsuo hae kaa nyɛ blɔ nya nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene.
Ní klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ a sɛ̃ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpɛti enɛ ɔmɛ maa pee o níhi: niye ní bɔ, yayami pami bɔ, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ.
Nike ní klɔuklɔu tsuaa nike ní klɔuklɔu nɛ a kɛ ba ha mi ɔ maa pee o kɛ o bimɛ nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu; nyumuhi pɛ lɛ a ye.
E ji niye ní klɔuklɔu ha nyɛ.
“Jehanɛ, nike ní klɛdɛɛ kpa komɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ baa a, lɔ ɔmɛ hu maa pee o nɔ.
I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ha mo, kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ, kaa nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́ kɛ yaa neneene.
O we mi bimɛ tsuo nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, a ye eko.
“Jehanɛ, nu, wai he, kɛ blɛfo kpokploku, nɛ ji kekleekle yiblii nɛ a kɛ ba haa imi Yawɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ hu i ngɔ kɛ ha mo.
Jã kɛ̃, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ ngɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, a kekleekle yiblii nɛ a kɛ ba haa mi ɔ maa pee o nɔ.
O we mi bimɛ tsuo nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, a ye eko.
“Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ Israel nɛ a hla ngɔ to ha mi ɔ maa pee o nɔ.
“Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ bliɔ muklii nya, nɛ a kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ maa pee o nɔ, nɔmlɔ jio, we mi lohwe jio.
Se nɔmlɔ adesa e kekleekle bi, kɛ lohwe nɛ he tsɔ we e kekleekle bi lɛɛ o ha nɛ a kpɔ mɛ.
Níhi nɛ a ma kpɔ ɔ, ke a ye nyɔhiɔ kake pɛ a kpɔ mɛ.
Jua nɛ a po fɔ si kɛ ha a kpɔmi ji sika hiɔ yi enuɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ jua nɛ a po ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Na, loo jijɔ, loo apletsi kekleekle bi lɛɛ a ko kpɔ; ejakaa mɛɛ a he tsɔ.
Ngɔɔ a muɔ ɔ kɛ fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ o sã a zɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ.
A lo ɔ maa pee o nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa a gugue ɔ, kɛ e hiɔ fiɔ ɔ peeɔ o nɔ ɔ.
“Nike ní klɔuklɔu nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ, i ngɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ha mo, kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ kaa nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ nɛ fɔɔ si daa.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ji somi ko nɛ i kɛ mo, kɛ o nina so, nɛ a be mi poe gblegbleegble.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Aaron ke, “O be weto ní ko nae ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ, nɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ ko hu o be nae.
Imi ji o blɔ fa mi nɔ, kɛ o weto ní ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.” Levi bi ɔmɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ Yawɛ de ke, “Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ i ngɔ Israel níhi tsuo a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka kɛ ngɛ mɛ hae kaa a weto ní, ngɛ ní nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ he.
Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, Israel bi kpa amɛ ko hɛ mɛ kɛ su kpe he bo tsu ɔ he hu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko ba pee yayami nɛ a ba gbo.
Levi bi ɔmɛ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ; ke sane ko ba a, mɛ lɛ a ma bi.
Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si daa kɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ; se weto ní ko lɛɛ a be nae ngɛ Israel, ejakaa Israel bi ɔmɛ a níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ, i ngɔ mɛ tsuo ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ kaa a weto ní.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i de mɛ ke a be weto ní kpa ko nae ngɛ Israel ɔ nɛ.” Mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Levi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ nine su Israel bi ɔmɛ a níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ha nyɛ kaa nyɛ weto ní ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ngɔ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake nɛ ɔ hu mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ ba ha mi kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ.
Yawɛ maa ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kaa ngma nɛ je nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngma mi sami he, loo wai he nɛ je nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ wai muɔ mi.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa gu nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nike ni klɛdɛɛ ma ba ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ ji Yawɛ nike ní klɛdɛɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ha osɔfo Aaron.
Nike níhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nyɛ na a, nyɛɛ ngɔ e mi nɔ́ nɛ hi pe kulaa, nɛ ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ.
Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ hi pe kulaa a ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ to, kaa bɔ nɛ ke ngmɔ hulɔ ya sã bɔ nɛ e ngɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ toɔ ɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ we mi bimɛ nɛ ye nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he; ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ tsuɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, e he hiɔwo ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ke nyɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi pe lɛ tsuo ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, tue gblami ko be nyɛ nɔ bae.
Se nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ ko ble Israel bi ɔmɛ a nike ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ a ko gbe nyɛ.”
Na yo tsu la zu ɔ Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Mlaa nɛ Yawɛ wo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ na yo tsu nɛ nye, loo kpa ko be e he, nɛ a kɛ kuɛpã hu wui lɛ hyɛ kɛ ba osɔfo Eleazar ngɔ.
A kpaka na a kɛ ya sito he ɔ se, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ osɔfo ɔ hɛ mi.
Osɔfo Eleazar nɛ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e fĩa muɔ ɔ eko kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi si kpaago.
A sã na yo ɔ, e he womi ɔ, e lo ɔ, e muɔ ɔ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ osɔfo Eleazar hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hla seda tso, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kaa bɛ, kɛ kpa tsu, nɛ e sake mɛ ngɔ pue la a nɛ a ngɛ na yo ɔ sãe ngɛ nɔ ɔ mi.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he loko e kpale kɛ ba sito he ɔ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ.
Nɔ nɛ sã na yo ɔ, lɛ hu e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he ja nɔuu; lɛ hu e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ.
Nyagbe ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ya muɔ na yo ɔ la zu ɔ kɛ ya pue he ko nɛ tsɔ ngɛ sito he ɔ se.
A ngɔ la zu nɛ ɔ ngɔ to lejɛ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ futu nyu mi, nɛ a ngɔ nyu nɛ ɔ kɛ du Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ a he, nɛ a kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ.
Nɔ nɛ muɔ na yo ɔ la zu ɔ, lɛ hu e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he; se kɛ̃ ɔ, e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si daa kɛ ha Israel bi, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to mɛ ɔ. Nɔ gbogboe he kɔhi “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ gbogboe he ɔ, e ble e he; nɛ e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago.
Loko e he ma tsɔ ɔ, e ngɔ nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ nɔ he yayami ɔ kɛ julaa e he ngɛ ligbi etɛne ɔ, kɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ a nɔ.
Ke e kɛ nyu ɔ fɔ we e he ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ kɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ a nɔ ɔ, e he be tsɔe.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ gbogboe he, nɛ e kɛ nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ nɔ he yayami nɛ ɔ be e he julaae ɔ, e he tsɔ we; mu ngɛ e he.
Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔ ɔ ble Yawɛ kpe he ɔ.
A ma je lɛ we, nɛ a be lɛ bue ngɔ si Mawu ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
“Ke nɔ ko gbo ngɛ bo tsu mi ɔ, mlaa nɛ ngɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi jamɛ a be ɔ mi, aloo nihi tsuo nɛ ma ba sɛ mi ɔ, a he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago.
Jehanɛ, buɛ tsuaa buɛ nɛ nya fɔɔ si gu, aloo buɛ nɛ nya nɔ be nya a, jamɛ a buɛ ɔ hu he tsɔ we.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ gbogboe he ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ, e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago, nɔ nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ jio, nɔ nɛ gbo lɛ nitsɛ e gbenɔ jio.
Jã kɛ̃ nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ gbogboe wu, aloo yɔkɔ ko he ɔ, lɛ hu e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago.
“Ke nɔ ko ble e he kikɛ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ tsu e he ní ji na yo ɔ nɛ a sã kɛ je yayami ɔ, a ngɔ e la zu ɔ eko kɛ wo buɛ mi, nɛ a yɛ nyu mua kɛ pue nɔ.
Kekleekle ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ngɔ nga nɛ a fi kaa bɛ kɛ sɔ nyu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ fĩa bo tsu ɔ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Jehanɛ, nɔ nɛ ya ta nɔ gbogboe wu, loo yɔkɔ, loo nɔ ko nɛ a gbe lɛ, loo nɔ ko nɛ gbo lɛ nitsɛ e gbenɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ he tsɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ nyu ɔ kɛ fĩa e nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ fĩa nyu ɔ kɛ pue nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we ɔ nɔ, ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji etɛne ɔ kɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaagone ɔ a nɔ.
Ke a julaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ se ɔ, e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e yɛ nyu nɛ e du e he; kɛkɛ ɔ, ke pu nɔ si ɔ, e he ma tsɔ ekohu.
“Nɔmlɔ nɛ ble e he, se e julaa we e he ɔ, mu ngɛ e he, nɛ e he tsɔ we; ejakaa a kɛ nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ nɔ he yayami ɔ pue we e nɔ.
Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔ ɔ ble Yawɛ kpe he ɔ.
A ma je lɛ we, nɛ a be lɛ bue ngɔ si Mawu ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
Mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si daa kɛ ha mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ fĩaa nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ nɔ he yayami ɔ ngɔ pueɔ nihi a nɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyu nɛ ɔ eko ma pue e nɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ we maa ta he ɔ, e ble nɔ́ ɔ; ke nɔ ko ta jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ.”
Níhi nɛ ya nɔ ngɛ Kadesh Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ba Zin nga a nɔ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ, nɛ a ba to si ngɛ Kadesh.
Benɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Miriam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ.
Nyu hwɔ Nyu be he nɛ ma a ya to si ngɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ tsɛ kpe ngɔ wo Mose kɛ Aaron a he, nɛ a kɛ Mose pɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Wa ná nɛ wa piɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ gbo ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɔ wɔ, Yawɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ wa lohwehi tsuo kɛ ba nga nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ wa ba gbo ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ o kpaka wɔ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba zugba yaya nɛ bɛ ní nɛ ɔ nɔ?
Blɛfo be ɔ, ngmɔkɔ be; wai be ɔ, akutu hu be.
Nyu nunui kpamakpa hu be hiɛ ɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron hɛ mɛ kɛ je gua a he kɛ ya da kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si; nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa ngɔ tso ɔ nɛ ngɛ somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ, nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmi Aaron ya bua ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nya.
Mo fa tɛ sa a ngɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, kɛkɛ nyu maa je mi kɛ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a nu.” Mose ya ngɔ tso ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kɛ Aaron ho nɛ a ya bua ma mluku ɔ nya ngɛ tɛ sa a hɛ mi; nɛ Mose de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ atuã tsɔli, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Anɛ e he hia kaa wa je nyu ngɛ tɛ sa nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ha nyɛ lo?” Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ Mose de pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e wo e nine nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e tso ɔ fia tɛ sa a si enyɔ, nɛ nyu babauu je mi babaaba ha ma kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a nu.
Se Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Akɛnɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha mi ɔ pi, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ye he wami klɔuklɔu ɔ he odase kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ be ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyɛɛe kɛ ya su zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.” Sane nɛ ɔ ba ngɛ Meriba.
Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ Yawɛ pɛ ngɛ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu.
Israel kɛ Edom Mose tsɔ nihi kɛ je Kadesh ke a ngɔ sɛ gbi ya ha Edom matsɛ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ o nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: mo nitsɛ o le amanehluhi nɛ wa na; bɔ nɛ wa nɛmɛ ya Egipt, nɛ e ba mi kaa wɔ hu wa ya hi lejɛ ɔ be babauu; bɔ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ wa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ yi mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a wa wɔ hu yi mi; bɔ nɛ wa kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e nu wa gbi, nɛ e tsɔ bɔfo kɛ ba kpaka wɔ kɛ je Egipt.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa ba su Kadesh, nɛ ji ma nɛ kɛ o zugba a wo huzu ɔ nɔ.
Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa gu o zugba a nɔ kɛ be.
Wa be ngmɔ, loo wai abɔɔ ko mi gue; wa be vu ko vu ko mi nyu nue.
Matsɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ wa maa nyɛɛ tɛɛ kɛ yaa si wa maa po mi ngɛ o zugba a nɔ.” Se Edom bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, nyɛ be wa zugba a nɔ gue!
Ke nyɛ li peemi nɛ nyɛ ba wa zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa maa hia ta kɛ ba tua nyɛ.” Israel bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ wa maa nyɛɛ; nɛ ke e ba mi kaa wɔ, loo wa lohwe ɔmɛ nu nyɛ nyu ɔ eko ɔ, wa maa wo he hiɔ.
Moo lɛɛ moo ngmɛ wɔ blɔ nɛ waa gu o zugba a nɔ kɛ be kɛkɛ; enɛ ɔ pɛ wa ngɛ bie.” Se Edom bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke “Dɛbi!
Nyɛ be wa zugba a nɔ gue.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Edom ta buli babauu je kpo kɛ ba, konɛ a ba tua Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ gu a zugba a nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu a kpale a se ya gu he kpa.
Aaron gbenɔ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hia kɛ je Kadesh kɛ ba Hor yo ɔ he, ngɛ Edom huzu ɔ nya.
Lejɛ ɔ Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Aaron ma gbo, nɛ e nane enyɔ be zugba a nɛ i ngɔ ha Israel ma a nɔ mae; ejakaa nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã wo mi ngɛ Meriba nyu ɔ he.
Ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e bi Eleazar kɛ ba Hor yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ o je Aaron tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he kɛ wo e bi Eleazar.
Aaron ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
A kuɔ Hor yo ɔ ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ Mose je Aaron he tade ɔmɛ kɛ wo e bi Eleazar.
Nɛ Aaron gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ yo ɔ yi mi, nɛ Mose kɛ Eleazar kple si kɛ ba.
Benɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ná le kaa Aaron gbo ɔ, a nyɛ ya ha lɛ ligbi nyingmi etɛ.
A ye Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi Benɛ Kanaan matsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Arad, ngɛ Kanaan leneyi je ɔ nu kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ gu Atarim blɔ kɛ ma a, e kɛ mɛ ya hwu ta; nɛ e ngɔ a ti ni komɛ nyɔguɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ wo Yawɛ si, nɛ a de ke, “Ke o maa ngɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo wa dɛ mi ɔ, wa maa pee a ma amɛ butuu.” Yawɛ bu Israel bi ɔmɛ a gbi tue, nɛ e ngɔ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo a dɛ mi; nɛ a kpata a kɛ a ma amɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Horma.
Akɔblee sinɔ ɔ Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ si Hor yo ɔ, a ya gu Wo Tsu ɔ nya blɔ, konɛ a kɛ tsɔ Edom zugba a he.
Se a tsui si tomi ya ta ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a tu munyu kɛ si Mawu kɛ Mose ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ kpaka wɔ kɛ je Egipt nɛ wa ba gbo ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ, he nɛ niye ní, loo nyu ko be ɔ?
Kikɛmɛ a niye ní gbogboe nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa sume oo, wa sume!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha sinɔhi nɛ a duɔ nya wa ba sɛ ma a kpɛti; nɛ a kɔɔ mɛ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu gbo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a ba Mose ngɔ, nɛ a ba de ke, “Wa pee yayami kaa wa tu munyu kɛ si Yawɛ, kɛ mo hulɔ.
Mo kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ nɛ e ba je sinɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je wa kpɛti.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kpa pɛɛ ha ma a, nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo pee akɔblee sinɔ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ kpla tso he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sinɔ maa kɔ lɛ, nɛ e maa hyɛ akɔblee sinɔ nɛ ɔ, e yi ma na wami.” Mose pee akɔblee sinɔ, nɛ e kɛ kpla tso he; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sinɔ kɔ lɛ, nɛ e hyɛ akɔblee sinɔ ɔ, e yi na wami niinɛ.
A ba Moab kɔ̃ ɔ mi Israel bi ɔmɛ tsa a blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Obot.
Nɛ́ a je Obot ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Abarim, ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ Moab hanɔ, kɛ yaa beleku je.
Nɛ́ a hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Zered kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Arnon pa a omleyi je ngɛ nga a nɔ kɛ yaa Amor bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya.
(Arnon pa a ji huzu nɛ ngɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti).
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a deɔ ngɛ Yawɛ Tahi Womi ɔ mi ke, “Wa ya be ngɛ Waheb ngɛ Sufa, kɛ Arnon nyu dɔ ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ a si kplemi he ɔ nɛ maa e yi si kɛ yaa he nɛ Ar fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ Moab huza amɛ a nɔ.” Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho Beer ya.
Beer ji vu nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ngɛ he ke, “Bua ma a nya nɛ a ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu” ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ la la nɛ ɔ: “Vu, ha o nyu ɔ nɛ ba, konɛ wa la kɛ kpee lɛ.
Vu nɛ ganɔhi tsua, nɛ ma nimeli ngɔ matsɛ tso, kɛ dɛma tso kɛ je mi.” Benɛ a hia kɛ je nga a nɔ ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho Matana ya.
Nɛ́ a je Matana a, a ho Nahaliel ya; nɛ́ a je Nahaliel ɔ, a ho Bamot ya.
Nɛ́ a je Bamot ɔ, a ya gu kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, kɛ ho Pisga yo ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ yi mi ya.
A ye Matsɛ Sihon kɛ Matsɛ Og a nɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsɔ nihi ke a ya de Amor matsɛ, Sihon ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa gu o zugba a nɔ kɛ be.
Wa be ngmɔ, loo wai abɔɔ ko mi gue; wa be vu ko vu ko mi nyu nue.
Matsɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ wa maa nyɛɛ tɛɛ kɛ yaa si wa maa po mi ngɛ o zugba a nɔ.” Se Sihon ha we nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ gu e zugba a nɔ.
Mohu ɔ, e bua e ta a tsuo nya kɛ ho Yahaz ya, nɛ e kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ klaate tane a yi, nɛ a ngɔ a zugba a kɛ je Arnon pa a nya kɛ ya pue Yabok pa a nɛ ji Amon bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya, ejakaa Amon bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ, a fia gbogbo ngɛ nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ Amor bi ɔmɛ a ma ngua amɛ tsuo, kaa Heshbon kikɛ nɛ ɔ; nɛ a hi Amor bi ɔmɛ a ma ngua amɛ, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.
Heshbon ji Amor matsɛ, Sihon matsɛ ma.
Sihon nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ e kɛ kekle Moab matsɛ ɔ hwu ta nɛ e ngɔ e zugba a tsuo ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ba si Arnon pa a nya a nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ asilɛte ɔmɛ laa nɛ a deɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba Matsɛ Sihon ma Heshbon!
Nyɛ ha nɛ a fia ma a, nɛ a dla lɛ ekohu.
Heshbon ma nɛ ɔ mi Sihon tabo ɔ je, nɛ a ya kpata Ar nɛ ngɛ Moab, kɛ Arnon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Moab bi, due ha nyɛ!
Nyɛ Kemosh jali, nyɛ hɛ mi kpata!
Nyɛ mawu ɔ ha nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ pee ko bɔli; nɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ hu pee Amor matsɛ, Sihon nyɔguɛhi.
Se piɔ lɛɛ a kpata a nina hɛ mi kɛ je Heshbon kɛ ya si Dibon tɔɔ, kɛ je Nashim kɛ ya si Nofa, ngɛ Medeba kasa nya.” Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya to si ngɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mose tsɔ nihi ya slaa Yazer ma a. Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma a, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ tsuo; nɛ a fie Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale a se ya gu Bashan blɔ ɔ nɔ.
