Bashan matsɛ, Og kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo hia ta, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba bua ngɛ Edrei, nɛ a hwu ta.
Se Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Koo ye lɛ gbeye; ejakaa i ngɔ lɛ kɛ e ma a, kɛ e zugba a tsuo ngɔ wo o dɛ mi.
Bɔ nɛ o pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a Matsɛ Sihon nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ Heshbon ɔ, ja nɔuu o pee lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe Og, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo; nɔ kake ngmelu po píɛ.
Nɛ a ngɔ zugba a.
Balak kɛ Balaam Israel bi ɔmɛ pue nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Moab nga kpataa a nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ.
Benɛ Moab matsɛ, Balak, Zipor binyumu ɔ na Israel bi ɔmɛ a hiɛmi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a pee Amor bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e kɛ e ma a tsuo ye Israel bi ɔmɛ gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Moab bi ɔmɛ ya de Midian ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “E be kɛe nɛ ta nɛ ɔ ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ na ku kpeɔ nga ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Matsɛ Balak tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Petor ya, ngɛ Yufrate pa a kasa nya, ngɛ Amaw bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ́ a ya kpee Beor binyumu Balaam kɛ ba.
E sɛ gbi ji, “I ngɛ hae nɛ o le kaa ma ko je Egipt kɛ ba, nɛ a ha zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po a su ye ngɔ ta.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ba nɛ o ba gbiɛ ma nɛ ɔ ha wɔ kaa, alini wa maa ye a nɔ, nɛ wa maa fie mɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ lo; ejakaa a hiɛ pe wɔ.
I le kaa ke o gbaa nɔ ko ɔ, kɛkɛ a gbaa lɛ; nɛ ke o gbiɛ nɔ ko ɔ, kɛkɛ a gbiɛ lɛ.” Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ Midian ma nimeli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Balaam ngɔ ya.
A hɛɛ sika nɛ a kɛ maa wo nɔ gbiɛmi ɔ he hiɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ benɛ a ya su ɔ, a ngɔ Balak sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha Balaam.
Balaam de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hwɔ hiɛ ɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mi ɔ, ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ le.” Nɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ hwɔ Balaam ngɔ.
Mawu ba Balaam ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba to mo ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ?” Balaam ha heto ke, “Moab matsɛ, Balak, Zipor binyumu ɔ, lɛ nɛ e tsɔ mɛ ke a ba de mi ke ma a nɛ je Egipt kɛ ba a, ha zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ hlae nɛ ma ba gbiɛ mɛ ha lɛ, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ hwu ta, nɛ e fie mɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ.” Mawu de Balaam ke, “O kɛ mɛ ko ya, nɛ koo gbiɛ Israel ma a hulɔ; ejakaa a gbaa mɛ.” Balaam te si mɔtu nɛ e ya de Balak nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ho nyɛ ma mi ya; ejakaa Yawɛ kplɛɛ we kaa i kɛ nyɛ nɛ ya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho Balak ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, “Balaam kplɛɛ we kaa e kɛ wɔ maa ba.” Balak kpale tsɔ ma nimeli kpahi kɛ ho; ni nɛ ɔmɛ hiɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi hu ngɛ nyami pe mɛ.
A ya Balaam ngɔ nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Balak, Zipor binyumu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: i kpa mo pɛɛ, ko ha nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ tsi mo ye ngɔ bami blɔ!
Ma wo o hɛ mi nyami babauu, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma de mi ɔ, ma pee.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, ba nɛ o ba gbiɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ ha mi.” Se Balaam he nɔ nɛ e de Balak tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke Balak ha mi sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi po, i be nyɛe nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko agbo, loo nyafii kɛ si nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ de mi ɔ.
Se kɛ̃, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ hwɔ hiɛ ɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi, konɛ ma hyɛ kaa Yawɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpa ko nɛ e ma de mi lo.” Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu ba Balaam ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba nɛ́ a ba kpee mo kɛ ho ɔ, tee si nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ ya.
Se mohu, nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ, lɔ ɔ o pee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Balaam te si mɔtu, nɛ e wo e teji yo ɔ nɔ ní; nɛ e kɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Balaam kɛ e teji yo ɔ Se Mawu mi mi fu kaa Balaam ho.
Benɛ Balaam hi e teji yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ e tsɔli enyɔ ɔmɛ yaa a, Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ya po lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Benɛ teji yo ɔ na bɔfo ɔ nɛ e hia klaate kɛ daa si ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e gba kɛ je blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ho nga a mi ya.
Balaam fia teji yo ɔ nɔ́, konɛ e kɛ dɔ e yi kɛ ba blɔ ɔ nɔ ekohu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ya da si ngɛ nane blɔ ko mi ngɛ wai ngmɔ enyɔ komɛ a kpɛti; nɛ gbogbo ngɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Benɛ teji yo ɔ na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ, e ngɔ e he ya kpasa gbogbo ɔ, nɛ e mia Balaam nane kɛ wo gbogbo ɔ he.
Balaam fia lɛ nɔ́ ekohu.
Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ya e hɛ mi ekohu, nɛ e ya da si ngɛ he ko tokofii, he nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko be nɛ a kɛ plɛɔ he kɛ yaa nɔ hiɔ nɔ, loo nɔ muɔ nɔ.
Benɛ teji yo ɔ na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ekohu ɔ, e kpla si ngɛ Balaam sisi.
Balaam mi mi fu, nɛ e ngɔ e dɛma tso ɔ kɛ fia teji yo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bli teji yo ɔ nya, nɛ e bi Balaam ke, “Mɛni i pee mo loko o fia mi nɔ́ si etɛ sɔuu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Balaam he nɔ nɛ e de teji yo ɔ ke, “Ejakaa o pee mi kuasia.
I hɛɛ klaate jinɛ i gbe mo momo.” Teji yo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e bi Balaam ke, “Anɛ pi mo nitsɛ o teji yo ji mi, nɛ o hii ye nɔ daa nɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ lo?
Anɛ i pee mo nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ lo?” Balaam ha lɛ heto ke, “Dɛbi.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yawɛ bli Balaam hɛngmɛ, nɛ e na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ klaate kɛ daa si ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Balaam ma e yi si, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si.
Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ bi Balaam ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o fia o teji yo ɔ nɔ́ si etɛ sɔuu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
O nɛ, pe i ba nɛ ma ba tsi mo blɔ; ejakaa blɔ nɛ o hia nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ ye nya.
Teji yo ɔ na mi nɛ e yu e he kɛ je ye hɛ mi si etɛ sɔuu.
Niinɛ, kaa e pee we ja jinɛ i gbe mo, nɛ i he teji yo ɔ yi wami.” Balaam de Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ke, “I pee yayami; i li kaa mo lɛ o ba po mi ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke blɔ nɛ i hia nɛ ɔ dɛ ha mo ɔ, lɛɛ ma kpale ye se mɔ.” Se Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de Balaam ke, “O kɛ nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ya kɛkɛ; se mohu, munyu nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ wo o nya ke o tu ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ o de.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Balaam kɛ Balak tsɔli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Balak ba kpee Balaam Benɛ Balak nu kaa Balaam ma a, e ho nɛ e ya kpee lɛ ngɛ Ar tɔɔ.
Ma nɛ ɔ ji ma ko nɛ ngɛ Arnon pa a nya, ngɛ Moab huzu ɔ nyagbe.
Balak bi Balaam ke, “Anɛ i sɛ́ ke a ba de mo ke o ba nɛ o ba na mi dãã lo?
Mɛni he je o bɛ nɛ o ba na mi ɔ?
Anɛ o susuɔ kaa i be nyɛe ma wo o hɛ mi nyami lo?” Balaam de lɛ ke, “O nɛ mi; i ba!
Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i be he wami nɛ ma kɛ de nɔ́ ko.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke ma de ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Balak kɛ Balaam pue nɔ kɛ ho Kiriat Huzot ya.
Balak ngɔ nahi, kɛ tohi kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ lo ɔ eko ha Balaam, kɛ ma nimeli nɛ piɛ e he ɔ. Balaam kekleekle gbami E nɔ jena a, Balak ngɔ Balaam kɛ ho Bamot Baal ya, nɛ Balaam na Israel ma a fa ko kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.
Balaam de Balak ke, “Moo puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kpaago ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya hla na ku kpaago, kɛ agbosu kpaago kɛ ba.” Balak pee bɔ nɛ Balaam de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Balaam sã na ku kake, kɛ agbosu kake ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ.
Balaam de Balak ke, “Da si ngɛ o sami bɔ ɔ he, nɛ imi nɔ kake ma ya, kaa alini Yawɛ kɛ mi ma ba kpe lo.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma je tsɔɔ mi ɔ, ma ba de mo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho yoku kpataa ko nɔ ya, nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ ya kpe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Balaam de Mawu ke, “I puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kpaago ɔmɛ, nɛ i sã na ku kake, kɛ agbosu kake ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ.” Yawɛ tsɔɔ Balaam nɔ́ nɛ e de Balak, ne e ha nɛ e kpale e se, konɛ e ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Balak.
Benɛ e kpale kɛ ho ɔ, e na kaa Balak daa si ngɛ e sami bɔ ɔ he kɛ mwɔɔ; lɛ, kɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ je Balaam nya, nɛ e de ke, “Moab matsɛ, Balak ya kpee mi kɛ je Aram tɔɔ.
E kpee mi kɛ je beleku yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, ‘Ba nɛ o ba gbiɛ Yakob ha mi, nɛ o tu munyu kɛ si Israel!’ Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma gbiɛ nihi nɛ Mawu lɛɛ e gbíɛ mɛ; loo ma tu munyu kɛ si nihi nɛ Mawu lɛɛ e mi mi fu we mɛ?
I da tɛ sa amɛ a nɔ kɛ hyɛ mɛ; i na mɛ kɛ je yoku ɔmɛ a yi mi.
O nɛ, ma kake mi bi ji mɛ; a kɛ a he bɔɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a he!
Yakob nina ngɛ kaa bunyuku; a he hiɛ babauu, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane mɛ.
Ha nɛ ye nyagbe nɛ pee kaa Mawu bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
Ha nɛ ma gbo ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi kaa dalɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Balak de Balaam ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Mɛni o pee mi nɛ ɔ?
I ngɔ mo kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ba gbiɛ ye he nyɛli ha mi, se gbaami mohu o ba gbaa mɛ.” E he nɔ ke, “Anɛ ma nyɛ ma de nɔ́ kpa ko pe nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ke ma de ɔ lo?” Balaam gbami nɛ ji enyɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Balak de Balaam ke “Ha waa ya he kpa, he nɛ o maa na ma a fa ko kɛkɛ ngɛ, se pi mɛ tsuo, konɛ o gbiɛ mɛ ha mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” E ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Zofim nga a nɔ ya, ngɛ Pisga yo ɔ yi mi.
Lejɛ ɔ hu e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kpaago, nɛ e sã na ku kake, kɛ agbosu kake ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ.
Balaam de Balak ke, “Da si ngɛ o sami bɔ ɔ he ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, konɛ i kɛ Yawɛ ya kpe ngɛ hɛ mi ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Balaam ba kpe.
E tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de Balak, nɛ e ha nɛ e kpale e se, konɛ e ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Balak.
Benɛ e kpale kɛ ho ɔ, e na kaa Balak daa si ngɛ e sami bɔ ɔ he kɛ mwɔɔ; lɛ, kɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo.
Balak bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ Yawɛ de kɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ je Balaam nya ke, “Zipor bi Balak, moo bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue!
Mawu ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ ji lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ nya, pi nɔmlɔ ji lɛ nɛ e tsakeɔ e yi mi tomi.
Anɛ ke e de nɔ́ ko ɔ, e pee we lo?
Aloo e woɔ si nɛ e yi nɔ lo?
Hyɛ, gbaami a fa mi ke ma ba gbaa.
Lɛɛ e gbaa momo; imi lɛɛ i be nyɛe ma kpale se.
Mawu nɛ́ Yakob he yayami ko; Mawu nɛ́ Israel he hiami ko.
Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kɛ mɛ ngɛ; Yawɛ ji a matsɛ.
Mawu ji nɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt.
Israel he wami ngɛ kaa na ku he wami.
Kunya ko kunya ko be Yakob nyɛe, Israel ɔ, klaami he wami ko be lɛ nyɛe.
Lɛɛ a ma de ngɛ Yakob, loo Israel he ke, ‘Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu tsu ha mɛ!’ Israel ma a ngɛ kaa jata katsɛ; e bu we si, nɛ e jɔɔ we e he, ja e ye de lo ɔ tsuatsuaatsua, nɛ e nu lohwe nɛ e gbe ɔ muɔ lolo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Balak de Balaam ke, “Ke o be mɛ gbiɛe ɔ, lɛɛ koo gbaa mɛ mɔ.” Balaam he nɔ ke, “Anɛ i de we mo ke nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke ma pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ ma pee lo?” Balaam gbami nɛ ji etɛ Balak ya nɔ nɛ e de Balaam ke, “Ha nɛ wa pa ya he kpa, kaa alini jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu maa kplɛɛ kaa o gbiɛ mɛ ha mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ lo.” Nɛ Balak ngɔ Balaam kɛ ho Peor yo ɔ nɔ ya, he nɛ ke o ngɛ nɛ o hyɛɛ nga a nɔ ɔ. Balaam de Balak ke, “Moo puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kpaago ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya hla na ku kpaago kɛ agbosu hu kpaago kɛ ba.” Balak pee kaa bɔ nɛ Balaam de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e sã na ku kake, kɛ agbosu kake ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ.
Benɛ Balaam na kaa Yawɛ suɔ kaa e gbaa Israel ma a, e yɛ nɛ e ya bi Yawɛ ní kaa bɔ nɛ e pee sa a. Mohu, e plɛ e hɛ mi kɛ kpee nga a nɔ blɔ, nɛ e na Israel ma a nɛ a pueɔ si wɛtso nya wɛtso nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ba e nɔ, nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ je e nya ke, “Beor binyumu Balaam sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́ saminya a sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ nuɔ Mawu gbi, Nɔ nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ jeɔ ninahi kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ, Nɔ nɛ ke e hɛli po ɔ, e hɛngmɛhi fɔɔ si paa.
Yakob lee, o bo tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ fɛu; Israel lee, o sito he ɔmɛ ngɛ fɛu.
A ngɛ kaa dɔhi nɛ a gba kɛ yaa tsitsaa, aloo abɔɔhi ngɛ pa tue.
A ngɛ kaa tso kɛ e he via nɛ Yawɛ du; A ngɛ kaa seda tsohi ngɛ pa tue.
Bɔ́ maa nɛ kɛ je e tso kɔni ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ngmɛdu maa hi zugba kpakpa nɔ.
E matsɛ yemi ɔ maa kle pe Agag nɔ ɔ; E nɔ yemi he ɔ yi ma bli.
Benɛ Mawu je lɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a, e he wami ngɛ kaa pu mi na ku he wami.
Ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ ji e he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, e maa ye mɛ tsuatsuaatsua; e maa ywia a wu ɔmɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, nɛ e kɛ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ maa gbɔ a mi mi kɛ ya pa si.
E bua e he nya, nɛ e buu si kaa jata ku; Ee e buu si kaa jata yo.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsɛɛ lɛ?
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbaa mo ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ; Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbiɛɛ mo ɔ, a maa gbiɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Balak mi mi fu Balaam wawɛɛ, nɛ e gba e dɛ mi ma, nɛ e de Balaam ke, “I kpee mo kɛ ba nɛ o ba gbiɛ ye he nyɛli ha mi; se si etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ o ngɛ mɛ gbaae mohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo je hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ho esɔesɔ!
I wo mo si kaa ma wo o hɛ mi nyami, se Yawɛ tsi o hɛ mi nyami womi ɔ nya.” Balaam ha Balak heto ke, “Anɛ i de we tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ o tsɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ɔ ke, Ke Balak ngɔ sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi kɛ ha mi po ɔ, i be nyɛe nɛ ma to ye yi mi nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko nɛ kɛ fami nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ɔ yɛ, kpakpa jio, yayami jio, kaa ja nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ke ma de ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ ma de ɔ lo?” Balaam gbami nɛ ji eywiɛ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, piɔ lɛɛ i kpale kɛ yaa imi nitsɛ ye ma mi.
Se loko ma je ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma wo o tue nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ maa pee mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ ba e nya, nɛ e de ke, “Beor binyumu Balaam sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́ saminya a sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛ nɛ e nuɔ Mawu gbi; Lɛ nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ jeɔ ninahi kɛ tsɔɔ; Lɛ nɛ ke e hɛli po e hɛngmɛhi fɔɔ si paa.
I na lɛ, se e he kɛ; I ngɛ lɛ hyɛe, se e sui hiɛ ɔ lolo.
Dodoe ko maa je Yakob mi kɛ ba; Matsɛ tso ko maa je Israel; E maa fia Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ ní, nɛ e ma kpata Set bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
E maa ye e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Edom; nɛ e maa ngɔ a zugba a; Israel maa ye kunimi daa.
Yakob maa ye matsɛ, nɛ e ma kpata ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ a hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Balaam na Amalek bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nina mi, nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ ba e nya, nɛ e de ke, “Sa a, Amalek ji ma nɛ a he wa pe je ma amɛ tsuo.
Se nyagbenyagbe ɔ, a ma kpata a hɛ mi.” Jehanɛ, e na Ken bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nina mi, nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ ba e nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ ngɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ tɛ sahi a nɔ.
Se kɛ̃, Ken bi!
Asiria bi ma ba ngɔ nyɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ hu ba Balaam nya, nɛ e de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Mɛnɔ maa hi hɛ ngmengmle benɛ Mawu ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee ɔ?
Lɛhi maa je Kipro wo nya kɛ ba, nɛ a maa hao Asiria, kɛ Eber.
Nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Balaam dla e he nɛ e kpale kɛ ho e je he ya; nɛ Balak hu wo e blɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Peor Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Shitim ɔ, a kɛ Moab yi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ bɔni nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi fiɛmi.
Yi nɛ ɔmɛ kpeeɔ mɛ kɛ yaa niye ní nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ha a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ a he.
A yeɔ ní ɔ, nɛ a jaa mawu ɔmɛ hulɔ.
Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ peemi mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ a he ya wo Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor ɔ jami sisi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Yawɛ mi mi fu ma a, nɛ e de Mose ke, “Ngɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ya nɛ o ya sɛu mɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi piani katakata; kɛkɛ ɔ, ye mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a maa je Israel nɔ.” Mose de Israel ma kojoli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbe lɛ nitsɛ e he nihi nɛ a kɛ a he ya mɛtɛ Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor he ɔ.” Benɛ Mose kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ bua a he nya, nɛ a wo yana ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a, Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyumu ko ya wo Midian yo ko kɛ ba sɛ e bo tsu mi, ngɛ Mose kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi paa.
Benɛ Eleazar bi Finehas, nɛ ji osɔfo Aaron bibi ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e te si kɛ je gua a mi.
E ya kɛ̃ akplɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛ Israel no ɔ se kɛ ya sɛ e se tsu mi; nɛ e kɛ akplɔ nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ gbɔ nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo kɛ ya pa si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Se kɛ̃ nimli nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ gbe ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Eleazar binyumu Finehas, osɔfo Aaron bibi ɔ pee nɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye mi mi nɛ fu Israel ma a nya ba si.
E je hunga ha mi, nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i be ye ma a hɛ mi kpatae hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo de lɛ ke, i kɛ lɛ ngɛ he jɔmi somi soe.
E maa pee lɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo a nɔ́, nɛ a maa da nɔ kɛ ye osɔfo kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ejakaa e kplɛɛ we nɛ nihi kɛ mi nɛ plee nɔ́ he, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ a kɛ Israel ma a he yayami pa mɛ.” Israel no ɔ nɛ a gbe e kɛ Midian yo ɔ, lɛ ji Salu binyumu Zimri.
Wɛtsoyi ji lɛ ngɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi.
Moab yo ɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ, lɛ hu e biɛ ji Kozbi.
E tsɛ Zur ɔ, lɛ hu Midian bi a wɛtso kake nyatsɛ ji lɛ.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tua Midian bi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi, ejakaa a gu sisimi blɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ nyɛ wo haomi mi.
A ha nɛ nyɛ ya ja Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ tɔtɔ nyɛ nane.
Midian wɛtsoyi ɔ biyo Kozbi, nɔ nɛ a gbe benɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, e sane ɔ yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he odase.”
Nihi a kanemi enyɔne ɔ Gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose kɛ osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar ke, “Nyɛɛ kane Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ a ma nyɛ ya ta a nɔ.” Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar ya nɛ a kɛ ma a ya tu munyu ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a nya, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ; nɛ a ngma ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa a a biɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. Israel ma a nɛ je Egipt kɛ ba a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ruben wɛtso ɔ (Ruben ji Yakob kekleekle binyumu): wekuhi nɛ ngɛ Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi ji Hanok weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hanok; Palu weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Palu; Hezron weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hezron; Karmi weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Karmi.
A hiɛmi ji ,.
Palu bi ji Eliab, nɛ Eliab bimɛ ji Nemuel, Datan, kɛ Abiram.
Simeon wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Nemuel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Nemuel; Yamin weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yamin; Yakin weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yakin; Zera weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Zera; Shaul weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shaul.
A hiɛmi ji ,.
Gad wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Zefon weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Zefon; Hagi weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hagi, Shuni weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shuni; Ozni weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Ozni; Eri weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Eri; Arod weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Arod; Areli weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Areli.
A hiɛmi ji ,.
-Yuda wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Shela weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shela; Perez weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Perez; Zera weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Zera; Hezron weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hezron; Hamul weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hamul (Yuda binyumuhi ji Er kɛ Onan, se mɛɛ a gbo ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.)
A hiɛmi ji ,.
Isakar wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Tola weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Tola; Puva weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Puva.
Yashub weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yashub; Shimron weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shimron.
A hiɛmi ji ,.
Zebulun wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Sered weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Sered; Elon weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Elon; Yahleel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yahleel.
A hiɛmi ji ,.
Yosef ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Manase kɛ Efraim.
Manase wɛtso ɔ: Manase binyumu Makir ɔ, e bi ji Gilead, nɛ weku nɛ ɔmɛ je Gilead mi: Yazer weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yazer; Helek weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Helek; Asriel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Asriel; Shekem weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shekem; Shemida weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shemida; Hefer weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hefer.
Hefer binyumu Zelofehad lɛɛ e be binyumu; biyihi pɛ lɛ a fɔ ha lɛ.
Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka, kɛ Tirza.
Manase wɛtso ɔ mi bimɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji ,.
Efraim wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Shutela weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shutela; Beker weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Beker; Tahan weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Tahan.
Shutela bimɛ ji Eran weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Eran.
Efraim wɛtso ɔ mi bi tsuo a hiɛmi ji ,.
Wekuhi nɛ je Yosef mi ji lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Benyamin wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Bela weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Bela; Ashbel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Ashbel; Ahiram weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Ahiram; Shefufam weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shefufam; Hufam weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hufam.
Ard kɛ Naaman weku ɔmɛ je Bela weku ɔ mi.
Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi bi tsuo a hiɛmi ji ,.
Dan wɛtso ɔ: weku nɛ ngɛ Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ji Shuham weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shuham, nɛ a hiɛmi ji ,.
Asher wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Imna weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Imna; Ishvi weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Ishvi; Beria weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Beria; Heber weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Heber; Malkiel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Malkiel.
Asher ngɛ biyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sera.
Asher wɛtso ɔ mi bi a hiɛmi ji ,.
Naftali wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Yazeel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yazeel; Guni weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Guni; Yezer weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yezer; Shilem weku ɔ kɛ a nyatsɛ Shilem.
Naftali wɛtso ɔ mi bi ahiɛmi ji ,.
Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyumuhi nɛ a ngma a biɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji ,.
Zugba a dlami Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Dla zugba a kɛ ha wɛtso ɔmɛ ngɛ a hiɛmi nya, konɛ e pee a nɔ.
-Wɛtso nya dali ɔmɛ nɛ a fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba a. Wɛtso nɛ mi bimɛ hiɛ ɔ, a na zugba agbo; se wɛtso nɛ mi bimɛ a he pi lɛɛ a na zugba bɔbɔyoo.” Levi wɛtso ɔ, wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Gershon weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Gershon; Kohat weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Kohat; Merari weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Merari.
Levi wɛtso ɔ mi weku komɛ hu ji Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi, kɛ Kora.
Kohat bi ji Amram.
Amram yo ji Yokebed, Levi biyo ɔ nɛ e fɔ ngɛ Egipt ɔ. Amram kɛ lɛ fɔ Aaron, Mose, kɛ a nyɛmiyo Miriam.
Aaron bimɛ ji Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar.
Se Nadab, kɛ Abihu gbo benɛ a ngɔ la nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ. Nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ a ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa, nɛ a ngma a biɛ ɔ, a hiɛmi ji ,.
A kane we mɛ kɛ piɛ we Israel bi kpa amɛ a he; ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a ha we mɛ weto ní ko ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ji nihi nɛ Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar ngma a biɛ, benɛ a kane Israel ma a ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ ɔ.
Se nihi nɛ Mose kɛ osɔfo Aaron ngma a biɛ, benɛ a kane Israel ma a ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ɔ, jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu be ni nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Yawɛ de to kaa mɛ tsuo kulaa a ma gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Nɛ niinɛ, Yefune binyumu Kaleb, kɛ Nun binyumu Yoshua pɛ ji a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ.
Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ -Ligbi ko ɔ, Zelofehad biyi enuɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ a hiami sane ko kɛ ba fɔ Mose, osɔfo Eleazar, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Yi nɛ ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka kɛ Tirza, nɛ a je Yosef binyumu Manase wɛtso fa a mi.
A nɛ̃ biɛ ji Hefer, nɛ a nɛnɛkasowa ji Gilead, Makir binyumu ɔ.
A we amaniɛ ji, “Wa tsɛ gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Lɛɛ e piɛ we Kora se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ te si ngɔ wo Yawɛ ɔ a he; lɛ nitsɛ e yayami nɛ gbe lɛ.
Se e be binyumu.
Ke wa tsɛ be binyumu ɔ, kɛkɛ e sa kaa e biɛ nɛ laa ngɛ Israel lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wɔ hu weto ní ɔ eko kaa wa tsɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.” Mose ngɔ a sane ɔ kɛ ya fɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ a sane ɔ da.
Ha mɛ hu weto ní ɔ eko kaa a tsɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ; ngɔɔ a tsɛ zugba a kɛ ha mɛ.
Jehanɛ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko gbo nɛ e be binyumu ɔ, e biyo nɛ ye e ní.
Ke e be biyo ɔ, a ngɔ gbosi ní ɔ kɛ ha e nyɛminyumuhi.
Ke e be nyɛminyumuhi ɔ, a ngɔ gbosi ní ɔ kɛ ha e tsɛ nyɛminyumuhi.
Ke e tsɛ ɔ hu be nyɛminyumuhi ɔ, lɛɛ a ngɔ gbosi ní ɔ kɛ ha e he nɔ pɔtɛɛ ko ngɛ weku ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i fa mo ɔ.” A hla Yoshua ke e ye Mose se Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya kuɔ Abarim yo ɔ, nɛ o kɛ o hɛngmɛ nɛ hyɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a. Ke o hyɛ ta a, mo hu o ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ o nyɛminyumu Aaron gbo ɔ; ejakaa nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã ngɛ Zin nga a nɔ.
Benɛ Israel ma a te si ngɔ wo mi ngɛ Meriba a, nyɛ je we ye he wami klɔuklɔu ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa nyɛ ɔ.” (Meriba ji taku ko ngɛ Kadesh ngɛ Zin nga a nɔ.)
Mose fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, mo nimli adesahi tsuo a Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla nyumu ko kɛ da ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ nya, nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ mo Yawɛ, o ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ko pee kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ.” Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa ngɔ Nun binyumu Yoshua, nɛ o kɛ o nine pue e yi mi.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi, nɛ e ma nyɛ ma tsu ní ɔ. Ha nɛ e ba da si ngɛ osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ o to lɛ si kaa o se yelɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ mo nitsɛ o he wami ɔ eko ngɔ wo e dɛ, konɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nɛ bu lɛ.
É ba e he si ha osɔfo Eleazar, konɛ osɔfo Eleazar hu nɛ ngɔ Urim kɛ Tumim kɛ bi Yawɛ ga womi ha lɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de Eleazar a, lɔ ɔ Yoshua, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo maa pee.” Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. E ngɔ Yoshua ba da si ngɛ osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, Mose ngɔ e nine kɛ pue Yoshua yi mi; nɛ e ngɔ he wami ɔ ngɔ wo e dɛ kaa e se yelɔ.
Bɔhi nɛ sa kaa a sã Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo fa Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ye nike ní nɛ ji ye niye ní bɔ nɛ o kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha mi ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ba ha mi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.’ “Mo de mɛ ke, sami bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sã kɛ ha Yawɛ ji, daa ligbi ɔ, jijɔ ku enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he.
O kɛ jijɔ ku kake nɛ sã bɔ mɔtu, nɛ o kɛ kake hu nɛ sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ.
Ngɔɔ ngma bɔ ngɔ piɛ he; lɔ ɔ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu kpakpa lita kake futu mi.
Enɛ ɔ ji daa sami bɔ nɛ a to sisi ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he; bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ.
A ngɔ wai lita kake kɛ piɛ kekleekle lohwe ɔ he, nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Jijɔ ku kake ɔ hu nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, lɛ hu a ngɔ ngma bɔ, kɛ wai bɔ kɛ piɛ he kaa mɔtu nɔ́ ɔ kɛ̃, konɛ e pee bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi bɔ sami “Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ ku enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ sã bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi kɛ pee ngma bɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔ he.
Daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a sã sami bɔ nɛ ɔ; slo daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ. Nyɔhiɔhe bɔ sami “Daa nyɔhiɔ sisije ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na niheyo enyɔ, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu, nɛ a kɛ pee ngma bɔ kɛ piɛ na ku fɛɛ na ku he.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu, nɛ a kɛ pee ngma bɔ kɛ piɛ agbosu kake ɔ he.
Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu, nɛ a kɛ pee ngma bɔ kɛ piɛ jijɔ ku ɔmɛ eko fɛɛ eko he.
Enɛ ɔ ji sami bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ.
Wai bɔ nɛ a kɛ maa piɛ he ji wai kilo enyɔ kɛ ha na ku kake, wai lita kake kɛ fa kɛ ha agbosu ɔ, kɛ wai lita kake kɛ ha jijɔ ku kake ɔ. Sami bɔ he mlaa kɛ ha nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ ngɛ jeha kake mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, ngɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ apletsi ku kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Abolokplolo nyami be bɔ sami “Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ ji Yawɛ Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ nɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa je nyami be nguaa ko yemi sisi; nɛ a maa ye lɛ otsi sɔuu.
A ye abolo kplolo pɛ jamɛ a otsi ɔ. Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a bua he nya nɛ a ja Mawu; se a ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa.
A ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ: na ku enyɔ, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he.
Ngma bɔ nɛ a kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: na ku kake nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Agbosu ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jijɔ ku kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jehanɛ, a ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha ma a.
A sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ mɔtu sami bɔ ɔ he.
Ja nɔuu, a sã niye ní bɔ ligbi kpaago kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via saminya ha Yawɛ; slo enɛ ɔ ngɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa.
Ngmakpami nyami be bɔ sami “Ngmakpami nyami be kekleekle ligbi ɔ, benɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ ngma he kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku niheyo enyɔ, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka.
Ngma bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: na ku kake ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Agbosu ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jijɔ ku kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he wai bɔ ɔ kɛ piɛ daa ligbi sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ a he.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ kpa ko kpa ko kó hi bɔ sami lohwe ɔmɛ a he.”
Jehahe nyami be bɔhi Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he.
Ngma bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: na ku ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Agbosu ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jijɔ ku kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ daa Nyɔhiɔhe kekleekle ligbi sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ ngma bɔ ɔ a he; slo daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ ngɛ a blɔ nya blɔ nya.
Enɛ ɔmɛ maa pee bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Kpatami ligbi bɔ sami “Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu.
Nyɛɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he.
Ngma bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: na ku kake ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Agbosu ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jijɔ ku kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ.
Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ yayami pami bɔ nɛ a kɛ kpataa a, kɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ a he wai bɔ ɔmɛ a he.
Gbasisihimi nyami be bɔ sami “Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa, se mohu nyɛɛ ye nyami be nɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago nɛ nyɛ kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku nyɔngma kɛ etɛ, agbosu enyɔ, jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he.
Ngma bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: na ku nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
“Ligbi nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na niheyo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ a he wai bɔ ɔmɛ a he.
“Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku nyɔngma kɛ kake, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
“Ligbi nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku nyɔngma, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
“Ligbi nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku nɛɛ, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔ hi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
“Ligbi nɛ ji ekpa a, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku kpaanyɔ, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he, kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
“Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku kpaago, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
“Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ jeɔ via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔ mɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
“Mlaahi nɛ a wo nɛ kɔɔ sami bɔ, ngma bɔ, wai bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sã ha Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ nyami be ɔmɛ a mi he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Slo enɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ si womi bɔhi, kɛ bɔhi nɛ nyɛ sãã kɛ jeɔ nyɛ tsui mi faa a a he.” Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Si womi he mlaahi Mose de Israel wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ ke, “Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ke nyumu ko wo Yawɛ si, aloo e ka e he kita kaa e maa nyɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, e ko kpale e nya se; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ e nya de ɔ, e pee.
“Ke yo ko wo Yawɛ si, aloo ke e ka e he kita kaa e maa nyɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ e yihe mi be mi nɛ e ngɛ e tsɛ we ɔ, ke e tsɛ ɔ nu he, se e de we lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, lɛɛ yiheyo nɛ ɔ nɛ ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e wo he si, loo e ka he kita a nɔ.
Se ke ligbi nɛ e tsɛ ɔ nu he, nɛ e de ke e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e si womi ɔ, kɛ kita nɛ e ka e he ɔ tsuo maa pee yaka.
Ke e ba mi ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he maa ke lɛ; ejakaa e tsɛ lɛ kplɛɛ we nɔ.
“Se ke pi yogbayo ji lɛ be mi nɛ e wo si ɔ, aloo e kɛ nya blɛblɛ tu munyu kɛ fi e he ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se e ba gba nɛ e huno ɔ nu he, se e de we lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, lɛɛ e si womi ɔ, kɛ kitahi nɛ e ka kɛ fi e he ɔ, e ye lɛ tsuo nɔ.
Ke ligbi nɛ e huno ɔ nu he, nɛ e de ke e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e si womi ɔ, kɛ munyu nɛ e kɛ e nya blɛblɛ tu kɛ fi e he ɔ tsuo maa pee yaka.
Ke e ba mi ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he maa ke lɛ.
“Yalɔyo, aloo yo nɛ e huno fie lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e sa kaa e yeɔ e si womi, aloo nɔ́ ko nɛ e pee nɛ e kɛ fi e he ɔ nɔ.
“Ke yogbayo ko wo si, aloo e ka e he kita kaa e maa nyɛ nɔ́ ko be mi nɛ e ngɛ gba we, nɛ e huno ɔ nu he, se e de we lɛ nɔ́ ko, nɛ e kua we hulɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e si womi ɔ, kɛ kitahi nɛ e ka nɛ e kɛ fi e he ɔ, e ye lɛ tsuo nɔ.
Se ke ligbi nɛ e huno ɔ nu he ɔ, e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ e nya de, nɛ kɔɔ e si womi ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ fi lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ maa pee yaka.
Akɛnɛ e huno ɔ ji nɔ nɛ kplɛɛ we nɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ e he maa ke lɛ.
Si womi, aloo kita ko nɛ e ma ka e he, nɛ́ e kɛ hi ngma kɛ pi e he ɔ, e huno ɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e kplɛɛɔ nɔ, loo e kuaa.
Se ke ligbi kake be, nɛ e huno ɔ de we lɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa a, lɛɛ e kplɛɛ e si womi ɔmɛ, kɛ kita amɛ tsuo nɛ e ka e he ɔ a nɔ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ e nu ní ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e de we e yo ɔ nɔ́ ko pɛ, e tsɔɔ kaa e kplɛɛ nɔ.
Se ke e nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ be ko se loko e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ yo ɔ musu maa tloo nyumu ɔ.” Enɛ ɔmɛ ji si womi he mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose, nɛ kɔɔ nyumu kɛ e yo, aloo e bi yiheyo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ a he.
Midian bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpatami Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya gbla Midian bi ɔmɛ a tue ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o ma gbo.” Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ mia kɛ nyɛ ta yami ní ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya tua Midian kɛ ye Yawɛ he lue.
Nyɛɛ hla nyumuhi akpe kɛ je Israel wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi kɛ ya ta a.” Nyumuhi tsuo nɛ a hla kɛ je Israel nimli akpeakpe abɔ a kpɛti, nɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ mia kɛ ha ta yami ɔ ji akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ; wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso ha nimli akpe kake.
Mose wo mɛ blɔ, nɛ osɔfo Eleazar bi Finehas kɛ mɛ ho ta a ya.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hɛɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ titimati ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ma hwɔ lele ɔ. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, a ya tua Midian bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a gbe nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, kɛ Midian matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ.
Mɛ ji Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, kɛ Reba.
A gbe Beor binyumu Balaam ɔ hulɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ nuu Midian yi ɔmɛ, kɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ.
A ha a na amɛ, a to ɔmɛ, kɛ a he níhi tsuo, nɛ a kɛ la sã a ma amɛ, kɛ a hi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nɛ a ngɔ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ ji nimli, lohwehi, kɛ níhi nɛ a ha a tsuo.
A ngɔ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ tsuo, nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a ha a kɛ ba Mose, osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ a ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ, ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se ngɛ Yeriko.
Ta buli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba Benɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ma a, Mose, osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ho ya kpee mɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se.
Mose mi mi fu asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji akpe akpe kɛ lafa lafa a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je ta a kɛ ba a. Mose bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ he yi ɔmɛ tsuo a yi wami ɔ?
Nyɛ kai kaa yi nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu lɛ a ya bu Balaam ga womi tue, nɛ a puɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a juɛmi, nɛ a kɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ngɛ Peor jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba Yawɛ ma a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe nyumuyo tsuaa nyumuyo, kɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ le nyumu.
Se yihewi nɛ li nyumu ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a yi nɛ na wami, konɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ maa hi ma sito he ɔ se ligbi kpaago.
Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbe nɔ ko, aloo e ta nɔ ko nɛ gbo ngɛ ta a mi he ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ tsukɔ e he ligbi etɛne ɔ, kɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ tsukɔ heha ní tsuo a he, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɔ lohwe he womi, aloo to akpakpo he bwɔmi kɛ pee, aloo níhi nɛ a kɛ tso kpɛ.” Osɔfo Eleazar de ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ je ta kɛ ba a ke, “Mlaa nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
-Níhi tsuo nɛ la be nyɛe maa sã, kaa sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, sanyla, loo sumui ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ wo la mi, konɛ a he nɛ tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ yayami fɔmi nyu ɔ kɛ fɔ a he.
Se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kɛ la yi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ yayami fɔmi nyu ɔ nɛ fɔ he.
Nyɛ fɔ nyɛ tade ɔmɛ a he ngɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ nɔ, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ se loko nyɛɛ ba ma sito he ɔ.” Ta yibu ní ɔ dlami Yawɛ de Mose ke, “O kɛ osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ we wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ nɛ kane ta yibu níhi nɛ a ha, nɛ ji nyɔguɛhi, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a nuu ɔ tsuo.
Dla ta yibu ní ɔmɛ a mi fiee enyɔ; ngɔɔ fa kɛ ha tabo ɔmɛ nɛ ya hwu ta a, nɛ o ngɔ fa hu kɛ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo.
-Ta yibu ní ɔ nɛ ji tabo ɔmɛ nɛ ya hwu ta a a blɔ fa mi nɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ eko kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Nimli adesahi jio, nahi jio, tejihi jio, tohi jio, Yawɛ nɔ ji lafa enuɔ tsuaa lafa enuɔ mi kake.
Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha osɔfo Eleazar kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ ha Yawɛ.
Fa a nɛ ji Israel ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, nimli, nahi, tejihi tohi, kɛ we mi lohwehi tsuo ɔ, ngɔɔ kakaaka ngɛ nyingmi enuɔ tsuaa nyingmi enuɔ mi kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ Yawɛ kpe he ɔ he ní ɔ.” Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar pee bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
-Ta yibu ní ɔ nɛ tabo ɔmɛ ha, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a si kɛ ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ tsuo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: to ,, na ,, teji ,, yihewi nɛ a li nyumu ,.
-Fa a nɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya hwu ta a a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji to ,, nɛ tohi nɛ a tsu kɛ ha Yawɛ ji ; na ,, nɛ nahi nɛ a tsu kɛ ha Yawɛ ji ; teji ,, nɛ tejihi nɛ a tsu kɛ ha Yawɛ ji ; yihewi nɛ li nyumu ,; nɛ yihewi nɛ a tsu kɛ ha Yawɛ ji .
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, Mose ngɔ nimli ɔmɛ, kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a tsu ɔ ngɔ ha osɔfo Eleazar kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ ko ha Yawɛ.
-Fa a nɛ ji Israel ma a nɔ nɛ Mose he ngɛ ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ ya hwu ta a a dɛ kɛ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ, ji to ,, na ,, teji ,, kɛ yihewi ,.
Mose ngɔ nimli, kɛ lohwe nyingmi enuɔ tsuaa nyingmi enuɔ mi kakaaka kɛ je fa a nɛ ji Israel ma a nɔ ɔ mi kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ Yawɛ kpe he ɔ he ní ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nimli akpehi, kɛ lafahi a nya a ba Mose ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, wa kane ta buli nɛ wa hɛɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake po laa we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ e dɛ mi nɔ́ ko kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha wɔ.
Ní ɔmɛ ji sika tsu junehi, kɔni si gahi, nine si gahi, nguɛ gahi, tue nya níhi, kɛ muɛhi.” Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar he sika june ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ a dɛ.
Sika tsu tsuo nɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, e jiimi maa pee kilo lafa enyɔ.
Se ta buli gu ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ e na a kɛ to.
Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar he sika tsu ɔ ngɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ nihi akpehi, kɛ lafahi a nya a a dɛ; nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi kaa Israel ma a kaimi nɔ́ ko ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Wɛtso ɔmɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je Ruben bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Gad bi ɔmɛ ngɛ lohwehi babauu nitsɛ.
Benɛ a na kaa Yazer zugba a, kɛ Gilead zugba a hi ha lohwe lɛmi ɔ, a ya de Mose, osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Atarot, Dibon, Yazer, Nimra, Heshbon, Eleale, Sibma, Nebo, kɛ Beon, nɛ ji mahi nɛ Yawɛ piɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ he kɛ kpɔ ɔ, zugba a hi ha lohwe lɛmi; nɛ wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ hu, wa ngɛ lohwehi babauu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ, nɛ e pee wa nɔ; koo ngɔ wɔ kɛ po Yordan pa a.” Mose de Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya nɛ a ya hwu ta, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hi hiɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ a kɔni mi nyu, nɛ a ko po pa a kɛ ya zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ?
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee, benɛ i tsɔ mɛ kɛ je Kadesh Barnea nɛ a ya slaa zugba a nɛ.
A nyɛɛ hluu kɛ ya su Eskol kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya na zugba a.
Se mohu a se kpalemi mi ɔ, a ba wo Israel bi ɔmɛ a kɔni mi nyu nɛ a ko ya zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jamɛ ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi wo la; nɛ e de ke, ‘Nyumuhi nɛ a je Egipt kɛ ba, nɛ a ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa a, akɛnɛ a nyɛɛ we ye se kɛ pi si he je ɔ, i ngɛ kita kae kaa ke a ti nɔ ko na zugba a nɛ i wo si ke ma ngɔ kɛ ha Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob ɔ fii!
Ja Yefune bi Kaleb, Ken no ɔ, kɛ Nun bi Yoshua pɛ; ejakaa mɛɛ a nyɛɛ Yawɛ se kɛ pi si.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel, nɛ e ha a wo lalaalo ngɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, kɛ ya si be mi nɛ jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ gbo ta.
Nɛ hyɛ, yayami peeli a nina, nyɛ hu nyɛ ba wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee, konɛ Yawɛ mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a nɛ pa ba Israel nɔ ekohu!
Nyɛ Ruben bi, kɛ Gad bi, ke nyɛ je Yawɛ se ɔ, lɛ hu e maa ngmɛɛ ma nɛ ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ ekohu; nɛ ke ma a hɛ mi kpata a, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ pee.” Se a hɛ mɛ kɛ su Mose he, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ ji waa ma lohwe tsuhi kɛ ha wa lohwe ɔmɛ, nɛ waa po mahi kɛ ha wa bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ.
Wɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ wa maa mia kɛ nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya su a su he.
Se zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, wa bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ maa hi mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ a mi.
Wa be wa se kpalee kɛ ba wa we ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ yaa si Israel bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nine maa su e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ nɔ.
Jehanɛ, ke wɔɔ wa nine su wa blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yordan beleku je ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, waa kɛ mɛ be weto ní ko he plee hu ngɛ Yordan pa a se.” Mose ha mɛ heto ke, “Ke nyɛ maa ye nyɛ si womi ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa mia kɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ ya ta a, nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ maa po Yordan pa a kɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ yaa si e maa fie he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ e ma kpɔ zugba a, lɛɛ ke nyɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ ba a, nyɛ maa ye bemi ngɛ Yawɛ kɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi; nɛ zugba nɛ ɔ maa pee nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Se ke nyɛ yi nyɛ si womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ; nɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ ma na nyɛ yayami ɔ he tue gblami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ po mahi kɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ma lohwe tsuhi kɛ ha nyɛ lohwe ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ si womi ɔ hu nɔ.” Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ de Mose ke, “Wa nyɔmtsɛ, wa maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ o fa wɔ ɔ. Wa bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ, wa yi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa to ɔmɛ, kɛ wa lohwe kpa amɛ maa hi Gilead ma amɛ a mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; se wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ lɛɛ wa maa mia kɛ po pa a kɛ ya hwu ta ha Yawɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ mo, wa nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, o fa wɔ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose wo osɔfo Eleazar, Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ mlaa ngɛ a he, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ mia kɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ po Yordan pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a, nyɛɛ kɛ Gilead zugba a ma ha mɛ kaa a blɔ fa mi nɔ́.
Se ke a mia we nɛ a kɛ nyɛ nɛ po pa a kɛ ya a, lɛɛ a ma na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ kaa nyɛ kɛ̃.” Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Wa maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ. Wa maa mia kpɛii kɛ po pa a kɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ ya Kanaan zugba a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ weto ní ɔ nɛ wa na ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ nɛ tlɔ wa dɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ngɔ Amor matsɛ, Sihon nɔ yemi he ɔ, Bashan matsɛ, Og nɔ yemi he ɔ, mahi nɛ ngɛ huza amɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ zugbahi tsuo nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ ngɔ ha Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yosef bi Manase wɛtso fa a. Gad bi ɔmɛ kpale po Dibon, Atarot, Aroer, Atrot Shofan, Yazer, Yogbeha, Bet Nimra, kɛ Bet Haran, nɛ ji mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ ehe ekohu; nɛ a ma lohwe tsuhi hulɔ.
Ruben bi ɔmɛ hu kpale po Heshbon, Eleale, Kiriataim, Nebo, Baal Meon (a tsake biɛ nɛ ɔ), kɛ Sibma.
Nɛ a wo mahi nɛ a po ɔ biɛ kpahi.
Manase binyumu Makir bimɛ ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Gilead ya nɛ a ya ngɔ zugba a, nɛ a fie Amor bi ɔmɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ngɔ Gilead ngɔ ha Manase binyumu Makir bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ. Yair nɛ je Manase wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ hu ya tua kɔpe komɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ, nɛ e wo mɛ biɛ ke Havot Yair (e sisi ji Yair kɔpehi).
Noba hu ya tua Kenat kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ Noba a wo ma a.
Kɛ je Egipt kɛ ya Moab Sane nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ he slɔɔtohi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ to si ngɛ benɛ Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ mɛ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya kɛ je Egipt ɔ. Mose ngma hehi nɛ a hia kɛ je ɔ, kɛ hehi nɛ a to si ngɛ ɔ tsuo a biɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne nɛ ji kekleekle Hetsɔmi ligbi ɔ we jena nɔ.
A kɛ manye hia kɛ je ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Rameses ɔ, ngɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi paa.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ gbe kɛ pueɔ si ɔ pue.
Yawɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e he wa kulaa pe Egipt mawu ɔmɛ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Rameses, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Sukot.
A hia kɛ je Sukot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Etam, ngɛ nga a nya.
Benɛ a hia kɛ je Etam ɔ, a dɔ a yi kɛ ho Pi Hahirot ya, ngɛ Baal Zefon beleku je, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Migdol kasa nya.
Jehanɛ, a hia kɛ je Pi Hahirot kɛ ya po Wo Tsu ɔ, kɛ ho Shur nga a nɔ ya.
A nyɛɛ Etam nga a nɔ ligbi etɛ blɔ nyɛɛmi, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Mara.
Nɛ́ a hia kɛ je Mara a, a ya to si ngɛ Elim.
Elim nɛ ɔ, vu nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ tã nyingmi kpaago ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A hia kɛ je Elim, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya.
A hia kɛ je Wo Tsu ɔ nya, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Sin nga a nɔ.
Nɛ́ a je Sin nga a nɔ ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Dofka.
A hia kɛ je Dofka, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Alus.
Nɛ́ a hia kɛ je Alus ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Refidim, he nɛ ma a nɛ́ nyu nɛ a nu ngɛ ɔ.
A hia kɛ je Refidim, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ.
A hia kɛ je Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Kibrot Hataawa.
A hia kɛ je Kibrot Hataawa, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Hazerot.
A hia kɛ je Hazerot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Ritma.
A hia kɛ je Ritma, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Rimon Perez.
A hia kɛ je Rimon Perez, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Libna.
A hia kɛ je Libna, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Risa.
A hia kɛ je Risa, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Kehelata.
A hia kɛ je Kehelata, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Shefer yo ɔ nɔ.
A hia kɛ je Shefer yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Harada.
A hia kɛ je Harada, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Makelot.
A hia kɛ je Makelot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Tahat.
A hia kɛ je Tahat, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Tera.
A hia kɛ je Tera, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Mitka.
A hia kɛ je Mitka, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Hashmona.
A hia kɛ je Hashmona, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Moserot.
A hia kɛ je Moserot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Bene Yaakan.
A hia kɛ je Bene Yaakan, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Hor Hagidgad.
A hia kɛ je Hor Hagidgad, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Yotbata.
A hia kɛ je Yotbata, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Abrona.
A hia kɛ je Abrona, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Ezeon Geber.
A hia kɛ je Ezeon Geber, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Zin nga a nɔ (nɛ ji Kadesh).
A hia kɛ je Kadesh, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Hor yo ɔ he, ngɛ Edom zugba a huzu ɔ nya.
- Osɔfo Aaron kuɔ Hor yo ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt se ɔ, jeha nyingmi eywiɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɛ Aaron gbo ngɛ Hor yo ɔ nɔ.
Arad matsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a leneyi je ɔ nu kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ma.
Jehanɛ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Hor yo ɔ he, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Zalmona.
A hia kɛ je Zalmona, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Punon.
A hia kɛ je Punon, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Obot.
A hia kɛ je Obot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Abarim ma doku ɔ mi, ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ.
A hia kɛ je ma doku nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Dibon Gad.
A hia kɛ je Dibon Gad, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Almon Diblataim.
A hia kɛ je Almon Diblataim, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Abarim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, ngɛ Nebo yo ɔ kasa nya.
A hia kɛ je Abarim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ.
A to si ngɛ Moab nga a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a tue, kɛ je Bet Yesimot kɛ ya si Abel Shitim.
Mlaahi nɛ a wo Israel loko a po Yordan pa a Jehanɛ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyɛ po Yordan pa a kɛ ho Kanaan zugba a nɔ ya a, nyɛɛ fie zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ywia a we amaga amɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɔ tɛ, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a sile kɛ pee ɔ; a jami he ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛ gbɛ mɛ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ zugba a, nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ; ejakaa i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛ e pee nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba a wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, kɛ weku nya weku nya.
Wɛtso nɛ a he hiɛ ɔ, a ha mɛ zugba agbo; wɛtso nɛ a he pi ɔ, a ha mɛ bɔɔ pɛ.
Se ke nyɛ fie we zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ kɛ ji zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa tlɔ si ɔ maa pee kaa zezle mio nɛ gbɔ nyɛ hɛngmɛ mi, loo ha tso mio nɛ gbɔ nyɛ kasa nya; a maa hao nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, lɛɛ bɔ nɛ i to ke ma pee mɛ ɔ, ma pee nyɛ hu ja nɔuu.”
Zugba a huzu ɔmɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke e wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ, “Ke nyɛ su Kanaan zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ huzu ɔmɛ maa pee enɛ ɔmɛ.
Leneyi je zugba a maa je Zin nga a nɔ, kɛ nyɛɛ Edom huzu ɔ nya; nɛ nyɛ huzu ɔ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ maa je Ngo wo ɔ nya, ngɛ beleku je.
E maa lɔgɔ si kɛ gu Akrabim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ leneyi je, nɛ e maa po mi kɛ be ngɛ Zin, hluu kɛ ya gu Kadesh Barnea leneyi je.
E ma tsa nɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya Hazar Adar, nɛ e maa po mi kɛ ya Azmon.
Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ maa dɔ e yi kɛ je Azmon kɛ ba Egipt pa a he, nɛ e nya maa sɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ mi.
“Nyɛ huzu ɔ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ maa pee Mediterenia wo ɔ.
“Jehanɛ, ke nyɛ wo za kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya si Hor yo ɔ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ maa pee nyɛ huzu ɔ ngɛ omleyi je.
Nyɛ ma tsa nɔ kɛ je Hor yo ɔ he, kɛ ya be ngɛ Hamat kasa nya, kɛ ya si Zedad.
Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, huzu ɔ ma tsa nɔ kɛ ya Zifron, nɛ e maa gbe nya ngɛ Hazar Enan.
“Nyɛ maa wo nyɛ huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ kɛ maa je Hazar Enan, kɛ ya si Shefam.
Kɛ je Shefam ɔ, huzu ɔ ma kple si kɛ ya Ribla, ngɛ Ain beleku je, nɛ e maa nyɛɛ ja hluu kɛ ya pi Kineret wo ɔ nya, ngɛ beleku je.
Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, huzu ɔ ma tsa nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ Yordan pa a he, kɛ yaa si e nya maa pi Ngo wo ɔ.
“Enɛ ɔ maa pee nyɛ zugba a, kɛ huzu ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ.” Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Zugba a nɛ nyɛ maa fɔ sɔ kɛ dla ha nyɛ he ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; enɛ ɔ ji zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo si kaa e maa ngɔ kɛ ha wɛtso nɛɛ kɛ fa amɛ ɔ a nɛ.
Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya momo.
Wɛtso enyɔ kɛ fa amɛ na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ, ngɛ beleku je.” Nikɔtɔmahi nɛ maa dla zugba a Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ Nun binyumu Yoshua ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa dla zugba a kɛ ha ma a nɛ.
Moo hla nikɔtɔmahi kakaaka kɛ je wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi ngɔ piɛ a he nɛ a kɛ dla zugba a.” -Nihi nɛ Yawɛ hla, kɛ wɛtsohi nɛ a je a mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA Yuda Kaleb, Yefune bi ɔ Simeon Shelumiel, Amihud bi ɔ Benyamin Elidad, Kislon bi ɔ Dan Buki, Yogli bi ɔ Manase Haniel, Efod bi ɔ Efraim Kemuel, Shiftan bi ɔ Zebulun Elizafan, Parnak bi ɔ Isakar Paltiel, Azan bi ɔ Asher Ahihud, Shelomi bi ɔ Naftali Pedahel, Amihud bi ɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a dla Kanaan zugba a kɛ ha Israel ma a nɛ.
Mahi nɛ a dla kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, weto ní ɔ nɛ a nine su nɔ ɔ, a ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ma amɛ ekomɛ, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi hehi nɛ mɛ hu a hi lejɛ ɔ. Ma nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee Levi bi ɔmɛ a sihi he; nɛ zugbahi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ hu maa pee a we mi lohwehi, kɛ a lohwe kpahi a ní yemi he.
Lohwe lɛmi zugba a nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e maa je gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ he, kɛ ya se gugue kɛ bɔle si.
Kɛ je ma a nya a, nyɛ ma susu gugue kɛ ya beleku je, gugue kɛ ya leneyi je, gugue kɛ ya bonyoku je, kɛ gugue kɛ ya omleyi je, nɛ ma a maa hi kpɛti.
Enɛ ɔ maa pee lohwehi a lɛmi he kɛ ha ma amɛ.
Nyɛ ma ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ma ekpa nɛ a ngɔ to kaa wesa hehi nɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ tu fo kɛ ya laa e he ngɛ, ke e li e he be nɛ e nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ tlukaa a. Jehanɛ, nyɛ ma ha mɛ ma kpa nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mahi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ma ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e pee nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugba amɛ tsuo.
Mahi nɛ o maa ngɔ ngɛ Israel wɛtso slɔɔto ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ o maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: wɛtsohi nɛ a he hiɛ ɔ, o he fuu ngɛ a dɛ, se wɛtsohi nɛ a he pi ɔ, o he bɔɔ pɛ ngɛ a dɛ.” Wesa he mahi kɛ nɔ gbemi he sane Yawɛ de Mose ke, “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyɛ po Yordan pa a kɛ ya Kanaan zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hla ma komɛ kɛ to kaa wesa hehi nɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ tu fo kɛ ya laa e he ngɛ, ke e ba mi kaa e li e he be nɛ e nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ tlukaa a. Ma nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee wesa hehi ha nyɛ kɛ maa je muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi.
Ke nɔ ko nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ tlukaa a, a ko gbe lɛ kɛ yaa si a kɛ lɛ ma ba da ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a maa kojo lɛ lolo.
Nyɛɛ hla ma ekpa kɛ pee wesa he nɛ ɔmɛ, ma etɛ ngɛ Yordan se, kɛ etɛ hu ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
Ma ekpa nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee wesa hehi kɛ ha Israel bi, nibwɔhi, kɛ blɔ nyɛɛli tsuo.
Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ tlukaa a, e ma nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi.
-“Se ke nɔ ko ngɔ awi yemi nɔ́ ko kaa dade, loo tɛ, loo tso kɛ fia nɔ, nɛ nɔ ɔ gbo ɔ, e gbe nɔmlɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu ja a gbe lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ nyɛmi tutuutu ji muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ nɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ e maa na nɔ nɛ gbe e nyɛmi ɔ, e gbe lɛ.
“Ke nɔ ko nyɛ nɔ ko, nɛ e gbɔ lɛ ha, aloo e ya wo lɛ ka, nɛ e fɔ̃ nɔ́ ko kɛ ya na lɛ nɛ e gbo, aloo ke e ngɔ abofu kɛ gba lɛ ma, nɛ e nɔ si, nɛ e gbo ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu ja a gbe lɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔmlɔ gbelɔ nɛ ɔ maa kpe ɔ, e gbe lɛ.
“Se ke nɔ ko li e he be, nɛ e ya gbɔ nɔ ko ha, nɛ pi kaa nyɛmi nya, aloo e fɔ̃ nɔ́ ko kɛ ya na lɛ, nɛ pi kaa e wo lɛ ka, aloo e fɔ̃ tɛ nɛ ma nyɛ gbe nɔmlɔ kɛ ya na lɛ, nɛ e gbo, be mi nɛ e hyɛ we lɛ, be mi nɛ pi e he nyɛlɔ ji lɛ; nɛ pohu pi kaa e ngɛ lɛ yayami hlae ɔ, lɛɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ kojo nɔ nɛ fia nɔ nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nya.
Ke e ba mi ja a, ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ kpɔ nɔ nɛ gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ kɛ je muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ a kpale lɛ kɛ ya ma a mi he nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ɔ. E ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si be mi nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a (nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu klɔuklɔu ɔ) ma gbo.
Se ke nɔmlɔ nɛ ya gbe nɔ ɔ ya hane huzu ɔ ngɛ ma mi he nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e ba mi kaa muɔ he lue yelɔ nɛ ɔ ya na lɛ ngɛ e wesa he ma a huzu ɔ se, nɛ e gbe lɛ ɔ, a be lɛ gbenɔ fɔ bue.
E sa kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ hi ma nɛ e ya sa we ngɛ mi ɔ mi kɛ yaa si osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ma gbo.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a gbenɔ se loko e ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e kpaleɔ kɛ yaa lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ekohu.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ji mlaahi, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛ, ngɛ yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
“Ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ ko ɔ, a da odase yeli enyɔ, loo nɔ́ a nya mi munyu nɔ nɛ a kɛ kojo lɛ loko a gbe lɛ; a ko da odase yelɔ kake pɛ nya mi munyu nɔ kɛ gbe nɔ ko.
Jehanɛ, nyɛ ko he wami kpɔmi nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ je blɔ gbe nɔ ɔ dɛ; ja a gbe lɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, ke nɔ ko tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ma ko mi ɔ, nyɛ ko he wami kpɔmi nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ; konɛ e ko kpale kɛ ba hi lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ, be mi nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a na we nɛ e gbo lolo ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ble zugba a nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ. Muɔ bleɔ zugba, nɛ kpatami nɔ́ ko be kɛ ha zugba nɛ a pue muɔ si ngɛ nɔ kaa ja nɔ nɛ pue muɔ si ɔ nɔuu e muɔ.
Nyɛ ko ble zugba nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, he nɛ imi hu i hii ɔ; ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti lɛ i hii.”
Yigbayihi a gbosi ní he blɔ nya tomi Nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ Makir binyumu Gilead, nɛ ji Yosef binyumu Manase bibi ɔ weku ɔ mi ɔ ba Mose, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ; nɛ a ba de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ fa mo, wa nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, ke o fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba a ha Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, Yawɛ fa mo ke o ngɔ wa nyɛminyumu Zelofehad gbosi ní ɔ ngɔ ha e biyi ɔmɛ.
Se mohu, ke a ya gba nyumuhi ngɛ Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ a mi ɔ, tse a weto ní ɔ nɛ ji wɔɔ wa nɛmɛ a gbosi ní ɔ ma ya pee wɛtso nɛ a ya dumɔ ɔ a nɔ lo?
Ke e ba ja a, lɛɛ tse wɔɔ wa gbosi ní ɔ nɔ ma gbɔ mɔ!
Ke Heyemi jeha a su, nɛ a kpale gbosi níhi tsuo ngɔ ha nɔtsɛmɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ a gbosi ní ɔ ngɔ piɛ wɛtso nɛ a ya dumɔ ɔ a nɔ ɔ he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nɛmɛ a weto ní ɔ nɔ ma gbɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ ke, “Sane nɛ Yosef binyumu Manase wɛtso ɔ kɛ ba a, sane ɔ da.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ke, Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a suɔ; se mohu a gba ngɛ a tsɛmɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi pɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a gbosi ní nɛ ko je wɛtso kake mi kɛ ya wɛtso kpa mi; se mohu, Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ ye gbosi ní ngɛ e tsɛ wɛtso mi.
Biyo tsuaa biyo nɛ yeɔ gbosi ní ngɛ Israel wɛtso ko mi ɔ, e gba e we puɔ nya no ko ngɛ e wɛtso ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ ye e tsɛ gbosi ní, nɛ gbosi ní kó je wɛtso kake mi kɛ ya wɛtso kpa mi, se mohu Israel wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso nɛ pɛtɛ lɛ nitsɛ e weto ní he.” -Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ, Mahla, Tirza, Hogla, Milka, kɛ Noa pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, nɛ a gba a tsɛ nyɛminyumuhi a binyumuhi ngɛ Yosef binyumu Manase weku ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbosi ní ɔmɛ tlɔ a tsɛ wɛtso ɔ mi.
Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ e ha mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ, ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Mose kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ hluu kɛ ya su blɔ ɔ nyagbe he ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ, kɛ yaa ngɔ Kanaan zugba a. Munyuhi nɛ Mose tu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a to nya pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a ngma kɛ wo Mose Womi Enuɔne ɔ mi.
Sanehi nɛ a he hia wawɛɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a kai ní nguanguahi nɛ Mawu pee ha mɛ ngɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ nɛ be ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ, konɛ a bu Mawu tue, nɛ a ye lɛ anɔkuale.
Mose ti mlaa nyɔngma amɛ a mi, nɛ e tsɔɔ kekleekle mlaa a sisi saminya, konɛ ma a nɛ kpá a yi mi kɛ ja Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ kake pɛ.
Jehanɛ, mlaa slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ maa hɛɛ Israel ma a ngɛ zugba nɛ a wo mɛ he si ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mose ti mi ha mɛ ekohu.
Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ e ma a so ɔ, Mose kpale tsɔɔ mɛ sisi ekohu.
E de kɛ piɛ he ke, níhi nɛ mlaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee ɔ, ma a nɛ hyɛ nɛ a pee pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A ha Yoshua blɔ nya kaa Mose se ɔ, e nyɛɛ Mawu ma a hɛ mi.
Mose la kɛ je Mawu yi kaa e ye mɛ anɔkuale.
Mose gbaa Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e gbo ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je.
Munyu tso nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji kaa Mawu he e ma a yi wami; lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e hla mɛ; e gbaa mɛ, nɛ e suɔ mɛ saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ma a nɛ kai anɔkuale nɛ ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a suɔ Mawu, nɛ a bu lɛ tue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a yi nɛ na wami, nɛ Mawu nɛ gbaa mɛ daa.
Womi ɔ mi munyu komɛ nɛ a he hia saminya ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ .-.
Munyu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ́ pee se ɔ, Yesu ba tsɔɔ kaa lɔ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ he hia pe kulaa a ji, “Suɔ Nyɔmtsɛ o Mawu ɔ kɛ o tsui tsuo, kɛ o klaa tsuo, kɛ o he wami tsuo.” Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Mose kɛ ma a kekleekle ní sɛɛmi .—.
Mose kɛ ma a ní sɛɛmi enyɔne .—.
a. Mlaa nyɔngma amɛ .—.
b. Mlaahi, blɔ nya tomihi, kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmihi .—.
Blɔ nyahi nɛ a to kɛ ha Kanaan zugba a mi sɛmi .—.
A pee somi ɔ ehe .—.
Nyagbe munyuhi nɛ Mose tu .—.
Mose gbo .-
Munyuhi nɛ Mose tu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel ma a ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Suf hanɔ ngɛ Paran, kɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, Tafel, Laban, Hazerat, kɛ Dizahab a kpɛti.
Kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he kɛ gu Edom yo ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa Kadesh Barnea a peeɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ kake blɔ nyɛɛmi.
Se jeha nyingmi eywiɛne ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ loko Mose tu munyuhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ke e de Israel ma a kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ gbe Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ hi Heshbon ɔ, kɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og nɛ hi Ashtarot ngɛ Edrei ɔ momo.
Benɛ ma a ba su Yordan pa a beleku je ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ, Mose bɔni mɛ mlaa amɛ a sisi tsɔɔmi.
Nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ nɛ nyɛ hi yo nɛ ɔ he ɔ hiɛ; nyɛɛ hia nɛ nyɛɛ ya nyɛ hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ ya Amor bi ɔmɛ a yo zugba amɛ, kɛ zugbahi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ tsuo a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ya Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi, yo nɔ zugba amɛ, zugba kpataa amɛ, kɛ leneyi je zugba a nɔ, kɛ ya su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya.
Nyɛɛ ya Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, kɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ ya su pa ngua a nɛ a tsɛɛ Yufrate ɔ nya.
Zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ imi Yawɛ, i wo nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke ma ngɔ ha mɛ, kɛ a nina a nɛ.
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a tsuo kulaa.” Mose wo ma nya dali komɛ Mose de Israel ma a ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi, benɛ wa ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ɔ, i de nyɛ ke, ‘Imi nɔ kake, i be nyɛ nɔ nyɛe ma hyɛ hu; Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ nyɛ he hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe.
Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa hiɛ pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ si akpe abɔ; nɛ e maa gbaa nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ imi nɔ kake too ma tloo ma tlomi nɛ jiɔ nɛ ɔ?
Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ imi nɔ kake ma nyɛ hyɛ nyɛ munyu tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ a mi ha nyɛ?
Nyɛɛ hla nyumuhi nɛ le ní, nɛ a ngɛ juɛmi, nɛ a ngɛ biɛ kpakpa hulɔ ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ to ma a nya.’ Nyɛ ha heto ke bɔ nɛ i de ɔ hi, nɛ nyɛ maa pee ja.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ wɛtsoyihi nɛ ji nyumuhi nɛ le ní, nɛ a ngɛ juɛmi, nɛ a ngɛ biɛ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ hla a ngɔ to ma a nya.
Ni komɛ hyɛ nimli nyɔngma nɔ, ni komɛ hyɛ nimli nyingmi enuɔ nɔ, ni komɛ hyɛ nimli lafa nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu hyɛ nimli akpe nɔ.
Jehanɛ i hla nɔ hyɛli kpa komɛ kɛ je nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.” “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i wo ma nya dali ɔmɛ mlaa ke, ‘Sanehi nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ maa ba nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ a mi.
Nyɛɛ kojo ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ, nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi sɔuu a kpɛti sane jio, a ti nɔ ko kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ a kpɛti sane jio.
Nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ sane yemi mi; nyɛɛ bu nɔ tsuaa nɔ tue pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛ ko ye nɔmlɔ adesa hɛ mi gbeye; ejakaa Mawu ji nɔ nɛ buáá sane he.
Se ke sane ko pa nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ye hɛ mi, konɛ imi nitsɛ ma hyɛ mi.’ Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, i wo nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ a he mlaa.
A tsɔ slaali kɛ je Kadesh Barnea “Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ɔ, wa hia kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he, kɛ gu nga kplanaa nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeye ɔ nɔ, kɛ ya be ngɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a yo zugba amɛ a nɔ.
-Benɛ wa ba su Kadesh Barnea a, i de nyɛ ke, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ su Amor bi ɔmɛ a yo zugba nɛ Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ wɔ hae ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ. Nyɛ ko to tsle, nɛ nyɛ ko ye gbeye.’ “Se nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba de mi ke, ‘Waa tsɔ nyumuhi kɛ sɛ hlami kɛ ya slaa zugba a, nɛ́ a ba tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ nɛ wa maa gu nɔ ɔ, nɛ́ a de wɔ mahi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a he nɔ́ ko.’ “Ga nɛ nyɛ wo ɔ, i na kaa e hi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i hla nyɛ kpɛti nihi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɔ kakaaka ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya.
I wo mɛ blɔ, nɛ a gu yo nɔ je kɛ ya su Eshkol kɔ̃ ɔ mi tɔɔ; nɛ a slaa lejɛ ɔ.
A ngɔ zugba a nɔ tso yiblii ɔ eko kɛ kple si kɛ ba bɔ wɔ amaniɛ ke, ‘Zugba nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɛ wɔ hae nɛ ɔ, e ji zugba kpakpa.’ “Se nyɛ tsɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã; nyɛ bui e fami ɔ fɛɛ; nyɛ kua yo ɔ kuɔmi; nɛ nyɛ tu munyu huitihuiti ke, ‘Akɛnɛ Yawɛ sume wa sane he je ɔ, e je wɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba ha Amor bi ɔmɛ, konɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi.
Jije wa maa ya?
Wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ha wa tsui po.
A ke nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ je oblai; a he wa, nɛ a ka pe wɔ.
A ke mahi nɛ a ngɛ mi ɔ, ma nguanguahi nɛ a fia gbogbohi nɛ ya hiɔwe ploplooplo ngɔ wo a he.
Jehanɛ hu, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a na oblai nɛ ɔmɛ paa kɛ a hɛngmɛ!’ “Se i de nyɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ ko nu sawale, nɛ nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e maa hwu ha nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ngɛ Egipt, kɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ. Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛɛ nyɛ fiafiaafia hluu kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ hɛɛɔ e bi ɔ.’ Se nɛ i de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se po, nyɛ he we Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ yi, be mi nɛ lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ e nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ ngɛ sito he hlae ha nyɛ.
Nyɔ mi ɔ, e nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ la titima, nɛ piani ɔ, e nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ bɔku titima mi kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ.
Yawɛ gbla Israel tue “Benɛ Yawɛ nu nyɛ munyu ɔmɛ ɔ, e mi mi wo la, nɛ e ka kita ke, ‘Ke kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ yaya bi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko na zugba kpakpa nɛ i ka he kita ke ma ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ fii!
Yefune bi Kaleb pɛ lɛ maa na zugba a. Lɛɛ e ye mi anɔkuale, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ zugba nɛ e ya slaa a ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ e nina.’ Nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu imi hulɔ, nɛ e de ke, ‘Mo Mose po, o be lejɛ ɔ sue.
Nun bi Yoshua, o sɔmɔlɔ ɔ lɛɛ e ma ya su lejɛ ɔ. Wo lɛ he wami, ejakaa lɛ nɛ e maa nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a.’ “Jehanɛ Yawɛ de wɔ tsuo ke, ‘Nyɛ bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ nɛ na we nɛ a le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti lolo, nɛ́ nyɛ de ngɛ a he ke he nyɛli ma ba nuu mɛ ɔ, mɛ ma ngɔ zugba a kɛ ha nɛ a hi nɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ho Wo Tsu ɔ he ya.’ “Nyɛ he nɔ ke, ‘Wa tɔ̃ Yawɛ nɔ.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa maa ya nɛ wa ya hwu ta a kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ɔ.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ wo e ta hwumi ní; nyɛ ngɔ lɛ kaa plasee nɔ́ ko kaa nyɛ ma ya tua yo nɔ ma a.
“Se Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘De mɛ ke a ko hia ta, nɛ a ko hwu ta; ejakaa i be a he piɛe.
Ke a hia ta a, a he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa ye a nɔ.’ Bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; se nyɛ bui tue.
Nyɛ tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã; nyɛ si nyɛ gugue, nɛ nyɛ kuɔ kɛ ho yo ɔ nɔ ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Edom yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ je kpo kɛ ba kaa hwo bihi, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ ba kpe.
A fie nyɛ hluu kɛ ya su Horma, nɛ a ye nyɛ nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ Edom yo zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛ kpale kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba wo yana ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; se Yawɛ bui nyɛ tue, nɛ e he we nyɛ nɔ hulɔ.
Jehahi nɛ a ye ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa hi Kadesh be babauu.
“Nyagbe ɔ, wa kpale hia kɛ gu Wo Tsu ɔ nya blɔ kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ. Wa wo lalaalo be babauu ngɛ Edom yo zugba a nɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ nyɛ wo lalaalo ngɛ yo zugba a nɔ ɔ, e hiɛ; nyɛ plɛ kɛ ya omleyi je.
De ma a tsuo ke nyɛ yaa be ngɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Esau bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ho.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ Edom yo ɔ he a hii.
A maa ye nyɛ gbeye.
Se nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko hwu ta.
I be nyɛ a zugba a ekoeko hae; nane mami he kake po be nyɛ nɔ́ pee; ejakaa i ngɔ Edom yo ɔ ngɔ ha Esau nina kaa a weto ní.
Nyɛ ma he niye ní nɛ nyɛ maa wo he hiɔ kɛ nyu ngɛ a dɛ.’ “Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, nɛ e baa nyɛ yi ngɛ nga kplanaa tilaa nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hyɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we nyɛ.
“Kɛkɛ nɛ wa pue nɔ; wa si blɔ nɛ yaa Elat kɛ Eziongeber ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nɛ wa gu Ngo wo ɔ nya blɔ.
Jehanɛ, wa plɛ kɛ gu omleyi je, kɛ beleku je a kpɛti blɔ kɛ yaa Moab nga a nɔ.
Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Koo hao Moab bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji Lot nina a. I ngɔ Ar ma a ngɔ ha mɛ.
I be mo a zugba a eko hae.’ ” Oblai komɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Emim bi hu hi Ar sa a; nɛ e mi nihi hiɛ.
Oblai nɛ ɔmɛ ka kaa Anak bi ɔmɛ.
A tsɛɛ mɛ ke Refaim hulɔ; se Moab bi ɔmɛ tsɛɛ mɛ Emim bi.
Hor bi ɔmɛ hu hi Edom sa a; se Esau nina a ba fie mɛ, nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu ba fie a he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ ji weto ní nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
“Jehanɛ, wa ya po Zered pa a kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ.
Be nɛ e ngɔ wɔ kɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je Kadesh Barnea kɛ ba su be nɛ wa po Zered pa a pee jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ka mɛ kita a. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mɛ to ní kɛ ya si mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata.
“Benɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata se ɔ, Yawɛ de wɔ ke, ‘Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ yaa gu Moab huzu nya ngɛ Ar kasa nya.
Ke nyɛ ya su Amon bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji Lot nina a a zugba a huzu nya a, nyɛ ko hao mɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko hwu ta hulɔ; ejakaa i be nyɛ a zugba a ekoeko hae.’ ” “Benɛ wa nyɛɛ Moab zugba a nɔ kɛ be se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Nyɛ pue blɔ nɛ nyɛ ya po Arnon pa a. I ngɔ Amor matsɛ, Sihon nɛ je Heshbon kɛ e zugba a ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ.
Nyɛ ya tua lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ e zugba a. Kɛ je mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, ma ha nihi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo maa ye nyɛ gbeye.
Ke a wo nyɛ ta a, sawale maa nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ.’ Israel ye Matsɛ Sihon nɔ “Jehanɛ, i tsɔ nihi kɛ je Kedemot nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ho Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon ngɔ ya kɛ he jɔmi munyu ke, ‘Mo ha nɛ waa gu o huzu ɔ nya kɛ be; wa maa nyɛɛ blɔ tɛɛ kɛ ho.
Wa be blɔ ɔ nɔ jee.
Niye ní nɛ wa maa ye, kɛ nyu hu nɛ wa maa nu ɔ, wa ma he kɛ sika.
Ha nɛ waa nyɛɛ kɛ be kɛkɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Esau nina a nɛ ngɛ Edom yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ hu nɛ ngɛ Ar ɔ pee ha wɔ ɔ, mo hu ngmɛɛ wɔ blɔ kɛ ya si wa ma ya po Yordan pa a, kɛ ya zugba nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ha wɔ ɔ nɔ.’ “Se Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon kplɛɛ we nɛ waa gu e zugba a mi kɛ be.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kplii e tsui, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ye e nɔ, nɛ́ wa kpɔ e zugba a ngɛ e dɛ.
Jamɛ a zugba a nɔ wa ngɛ kɛ sá.
“Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Hyɛ, i jɔɔ Matsɛ Sihon kɛ e zugba a he ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ ya ngɔ e zugba a, nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Sihon kɛ e ma a tsuo je kpo nɛ a kɛ wɔ ba hwu ta ngɛ Yahaz.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ lɛ wo wa dɛ, nɛ wa gbe e kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ wa ngɔ e ma amɛ tsuo, nɛ wa kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi.
Wa gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nyumuhi, yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi tsuo; wa si we nɔ kake po.
Wa ngɔ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, nɛ wa ha níhi ngɛ ma amɛ a mi.
Kɛ je Aroer nɛ ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya kɛ ya su Gilead ɔ, ma ko ma ko be nɛ wa nyɛ we lɛ; Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ mɛ tsuo wo wa dɛ.
Hehi nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke wa ko ya a pɛ nɛ wa yɛ; mɛ ji Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a, Yabok pa a nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, kɛ a ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ yo nɔ ɔ, kɛ he kpa komɛ hulɔ.
Israel ye Matsɛ Og nɔ “Jehanɛ, wa dɔ wa yi kɛ gu Bashan blɔ, nɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og kɛ e ma a tsuo je kpo konɛ a kɛ wɔ ba hwu ta ngɛ Edrei.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Koo ye lɛ gbeye, ejakaa i ngɔ e kɛ e ma a, kɛ e zugba a tsuo ngɔ wo o dɛ nɛ o pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ hi Heshbon ɔ.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ Bashan matsɛ, Og hu kɛ e ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo wa dɛ; wa gbe mɛ tsuo kulaa; nɔ ko nɔ ko píɛ.
Wa kpɔ a ma amɛ tsuo ngɛ be kake nɔuu mi; e píɛ ekoeko nɛ wa kpɔ we.
Mahi tsuo nɛ wa kpɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji nyingmi ekpa, nɛ ji Argob zugba a tsuo, he nɛ Matsɛ Og nɛ je Bashan ɔ yeɔ tsɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ji mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo gojogojoo ngɔ wo a he, kɛ a nya agbohi kɛ a se lami dade níhi.
E slo kɔpehi babauu nɛ a fiɛ gbogbo ngɔ wui a he.
Wa kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi.
Bɔ nɛ wa pee Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon ɔ, ja nɔuu wa pee ma tsuaa ma kɛ e mi nyumu ɔmɛ, yi ɔmɛ, kɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ.
Se lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo lɛɛ wa ngɔ, nɛ wa ha níhi ngɛ ma amɛ a mi.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃ ɔ, wa kpɔ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ kɛ je matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ, kɛ je Arnon pa a nya kɛ ya si Hermon yo ɔ he.
(Sidon bi ɔmɛ tsɛɔ Hermon yo ɔ ke Sirion, se Amor bi ɔmɛ tsɛɔ lɛ Senir.)
Wa ngɔ Matsɛ Og nɛ je Bashan ɔ e zugba a tsuo, mahi nɛ ngɛ yo nɔ zugba kpataa a, kɛ Gilead, kɛ Bashan zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ, hluu kɛ ya su Saleka kɛ Edrei nɛ ji mahi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ.” Bashan matsɛ, Og pɛ ji oblaihi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Refaim ɔ a ti nɔ nɛ piɛ.
E dade sa tso ngɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma nɛ a tsɛɔ Raba a kɛ mwɔɔ.
Sa tso ɔ kami ji gugue enyɔ kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue kake kaa bɔ nɛ níhi a susumi mlaa a ngɛ ɔ. Wɛtsohi nɛ hi Yordan pa a beleku je “Benɛ wa ngɔ zugba a, i ha Ruben kɛ Gad wɛtso ɔmɛ zugba nɛ ngɛ Aroer ma a omleyi je ngɛ Arnon pa a kasa nya, kɛ Gilead yo zugba a fa, kɛ e nɔ ma amɛ.
Manase wɛtso fa a hu, i ha mɛ Gilead zugba nɛ piɛ ɔ, kɛ Bashan tsuo, he nɛ Og ye tsɛ ngɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ ji Argob zugba a tsuo.” Sa a, a tsɛɛ Bashan ke oblaihi a zugba.
Yair nɛ je Manase wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ ngɔ Argob zugba nɛ a tsɛɛ Bashan ɔ tsuo kɛ ya su Geshur bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Maaka bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya.
E ngɔ e biɛ ngɔ wo kɔpe ɔmɛ; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, a tsɛɛ mɛ ke Yair kɔpehi.
“I ngɔ Gilead ngɔ ha Makir nɛ je Manase wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ. I ngɔ zugba a nɛ ngɛ kɛ je Gilead kɛ ya na Arnon pa a ngɔ ha Ruben kɛ Gad wɛtso ɔmɛ.
Pa a kpɛti pee a huzu ngɛ leneyi je; nɛ a huzu nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ji Yabok pa a nɛ e fa peeɔ Amon bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ. Jehanɛ, ngɛ beleku je ɔ, a zugba a huzu ya su Yordan pa a nya.
E je Galilea wo ɔ nya ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya na Ngo wo ɔ ngɛ leneyi je, ngɛ Pisga yo ɔ he ngɛ beleku je.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, i fa nyɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ kaa nyɛ weto ní.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ su ta yami ɔ, nyɛɛ mia kɛ ta hwumi ní kɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya po Yordan pa a, nɛ nyɛɛ piɛ a he nɛ ngɔ a zugba a. Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nyɛ bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ lɛɛ a hi ma amɛ nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a mi.
I le kaa nyɛ ngɛ lohwehi babauu.
Nyɛɛ piɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya si a maa ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ hae ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ɔ; nɛ Yawɛ ma ha mɛ hu a maa hi nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se loko nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.’ “Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i fa Yoshua ke, ‘Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ; jã kɛ̃ Yawɛ maa pee matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ nyɛ ma ya gu a zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ. Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa hwu ha nyɛ.’ ” A ngmɛ́ Mose blɔ nɛ e ya Kanaan Mose tsa nɔ ke, “I kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lee, i le kaa ní nguanguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o maa pee ɔ a sisije kɛkɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa mawu ko mawu ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba a nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ o tsu nɛ ɔ ma tsu!
Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ ma po Yordan pa a, nɛ ma ya na zugba kpakpa nɛ ngɛ pa a se ɔ, yo zugba nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ, kɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ!’ “Nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu mi, nɛ e bui mi tue.
Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘E hiɛ!
Koo wo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ ta hu!
Kuɔ ɔ kɛ ya Pisga yo ɔ yi mi, konɛ o hyɛ kɛ o hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ, kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya bonyoku je, jehanɛ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya leneyi je.
Hyɛ he tsuaa he saminya; ejakaa o be Yordan pa nɛ ɔ poe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Wo Yoshua mlaa, nɛ o wo lɛ kã kɛ he wami; ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ɔ.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tlɔ kɔ̃ nɛ ngɛ Betpeor ma a hanɔ ɔ mi.”
Mose de Israel ma a ke a ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ Jehanɛ Mose de Israel ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu mlaa amɛ nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami, nɛ́ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ. Nyɛ ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ he; nɛ nyɛ ko je nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi; nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ngɛ Peor yo ɔ he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛ Baal se ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kpata e hɛ mi.
Se nyɛ nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nyɛ mɛtɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
“I tsɔɔ nyɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ fa mi ke ma pee ɔ; nyɛɛ ye a nɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ maa nu blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ, a de ke, ‘Niinɛ, ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ le ní, nɛ ngɛ juɛmi saminya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ “Ma kpetekpleenyɛ te nɛ ngɛ nɛ e mawuhi baa e kasa nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ baa wa ngɔ be tsuaa be nɛ wa tsɛ lɛ ɔ?
Jehanɛ hu, ma kpetekpleenyɛ te nɛ ngɛ nɛ e mlaahi da kaa ní nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya!
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ a he.
Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ ligbi ko ligbi ko nyɛ wami be tsuo.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ bibimɛ nɛ a le, kaa ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ da si ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Bua ma a nya.
Ha nɛ a bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mɛ ɔ tue, konɛ a ye mi gbeye a wami be tsuo; nɛ a tsɔɔ a bimɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a ye mi gbeye.’ “Nyɛ de nyɛ bimɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ba da si ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, kɛ bɔ nɛ yo ɔ ngɛ tsoe, nɛ la a ya hiɔwe ploplooplo, nɛ bɔku wo diblii kpii kɛ bɔle yo ɔ. Jehanɛ, nyɛ de mɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je la a mi.
Nyɛ nu munyu ɔmɛ, se nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ nitsɛ e su ko kulaa; gbi ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔmɛ tue.
E tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ ye somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ; lɔ ɔ ji kaa nyɛ maa ye mlaa nyɔngma amɛ nɛ e ngma ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ a nɔ.
Yawɛ de mi jamɛ a be ɔ mi ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
A bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ngɛ amaga jami he “Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je la a mi ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ nɛ́ su ko su ko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya, konɛ nyɛ ko ya ye sane yaya, nɛ nyɛ ya pee amaga ko ha nyɛ he, nɛ ngɛ kaa nyumu, loo yo, loo lohwe ko nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ tee ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ waa, loo lo.
Nyɛ ko pee ekoeko henɔ ko kulaa.
Nyɛ ko ha níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi babauu nɛ ha si ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ ɔ nɛ gbla nyɛ juɛmi kɛ ya ja mɛ, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, Yawɛ kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ je Egipt yi mi wami wawɛɛ ɔ sisi.
E je nyɛ konɛ e pee nyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma kulaa, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ji mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi fu mi, nɛ e ka kita ke i be Yordan pa a poe kɛ ya zugba kpakpa a nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ.
Imi lɛɛ ma gbo ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ i be Yordan pa a poe; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba kpakpa a. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je somi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ.
Mlaa nɛ e wo nyɛ ke nyɛ ko pee amaga ko ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam; a kɛ lɛ plee we nɔ́ he.
“Ke nyɛ se kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ná bimɛ, kɛ bibimɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee yayami kaa nyɛ maa puɛ amaga ko nɛ ngɛ su ko kulaa ha nyɛ he.
E ji yayami agbo ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nɛ ma ha e mi mi maa wo la.
I tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba odase kaa ke nyɛ bui mi tue ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Lɛɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ, nyɛ se be kɛe ngɛ nɔ.
A ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Yawɛ maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma kpa amɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami.
Nyɛ ma ya sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nine pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso pee, mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tɛ pee, mawuhi nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, nɛ a nui nɔ́, kɛ mawuhi nɛ a yi ní, nɛ a nui nɔ́ he fu.
Nyɛ ma hla Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ hla lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo ɔ, nyɛ maa na lɛ.
Ke nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu mi, nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa bu lɛ tue.
Akɛnɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, e be nyɛ kuae, nɛ e be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae; e hɛ be somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ nɔ jee.
“Jehanɛ, nyɛ bi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo kulaa kaa kɛ je blema lokoo loko a fɔ nyɛ, kɛ je be nɛ Mawu bɔ nɔmlɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, anɛ sane nguaa ko kaa enɛ ɔ eko ba hyɛ, loo a nu eko hyɛ lo?
Anɛ ma ko nu mawu ko gbi hyɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu kɛ je la mi nɛ a gbo we, se a ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ lo?
Anɛ mawu ko ka hyɛ kaa e ma ya je je ma ko kɛ je je ma kpa ko mi kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee ha nyɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ lo?
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ, bɔ nɛ e je e he wami, kɛ e nyɛmi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kpo; e kɛ gbenɔ hiɔhi, kɛ ta ba; e pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi; nɛ e ha gbeye ní nguanguahi ba.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ ha nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa Yawɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji Mawu; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be hu, ja lɛ pɛ.
E ha nyɛ nu e gbi kɛ je hiɔwe, konɛ e kɛ tsɔse nyɛ; nyɛ na e la klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je mi.
Akɛnɛ e suɔ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ he je ɔ, e hla nyɛ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt.
E fie je mahi nɛ a he wa kɛ je nyɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ na nyɛɛ le, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ gblegbleegble kaa Yawɛ ji Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba; e se ɔ, nɔ ko be.
Nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, konɛ e hi ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina.
Ke nyɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi zugba nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ daa.” A to wesa he mahi ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose hla ma etɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ngɔ to, konɛ ke nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e nine ya kpa ngɛ e nyɛmi nɔ tlukaa nɛ pi ninyɛ nya a, e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke e tu fo kɛ ho ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi ya a, e yi ma na wami; nɛ a be lɛ gbee.
E hla Bezer nɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ zugba kpataa a nɔ ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Ramot ngɛ Gilead ha Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Golan nɛ ngɛ Bashan ɔ ha Manase wɛtso ɔ. Munyuhi nɛ sɛ mlaa hami ɔ hɛ mi Mawu mlaa amɛ nɛ Mose ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
-Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt, nɛ a ba su kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ngɛ Betpeor hanɔ ɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Sa a, Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ je Heshbon ɔ nɛ ye zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Se Mose kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba ye e nɔ, benɛ a je Egipt kɛ ma a.
A ngɔ e zugba a, kɛ Amor matsɛ kpa ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Og nɛ hi Bashan nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ hu e zugba a. Zugba nɛ ɔ huzu ji kɛ je Aroer ma a mi kɛ ya su Arnon pa a nya, kɛ ya na Sirion yo ɔ ngɛ leneyi je; lɔ ɔ ji Hermon yo ɔ nɛ.
Zugba tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je kɛ ya su Ngo wo ɔ nya, kɛ Pisga yo ɔ sisi hu piɛ he.
Mlaa nyɔngma amɛ Mose bua Israel ma a tsuo nya, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ tue.
Nyɛɛ kase mɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ kɛ wɔ so ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he.
Pi e kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, se wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ wa ngɛ je mi mwɔnɛ ɔ. Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi kɛ je la mi, ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ.
I da si ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Yawɛ nyɛ kpɛti jamɛ a be ɔ, konɛ ma de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ la a gbeye yee.
