“Nɛ nyɛ kuɛ yo ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ.
“ ‘Ko ja mawu ko kɛ piɛ ye he.
“ ‘Koo puɛ amaga ko, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyu mi ngɛ zugba a sisi.
Ko kpla si ha mɛ, nɛ ko ja mɛ hulɔ; ejakaa imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, a kɛ mi plee we nɔ́ he.
I gblaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛɔ mi ɔ, kɛ a bimɛ, kɛ a bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ ya siɔ yi nɔ etɛne kɛ eywiɛne bimɛ a nɔ; se nihi akpe abɔ nɛ suɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ i naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
“ ‘Ko tsɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ biɛ yaka gu, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he be lɛ kee.
“ ‘Mo kai Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ o ye lɛ ngɛ mumi mi he tsɔmi mi, kaa bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ fa mo ɔ. Ngɔɔ ligbi ekpa kɛ tsu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsumi.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ko tsu nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa, mo nitsɛ jio, o binyumu jio, o biyo jio, o tsɔlɔ nyumu jio, o mawayo jio, o lohwe jio, nubwɔ nɛ ngɛ o ma a mi jio.
Ha o tsɔlɔ nyumu, kɛ o mawayo hu nɛ a jɔɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mo hu o maa jɔɔ o he ɔ. Kai kaa mo hu o ya ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ kɔni si wami, kɛ nyɛmi kpɔ mo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i wo mo mlaa ke o ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɛ.
“ ‘Moo bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ fa mo ɔ, konɛ e hi ha mo, nɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.
“ ‘Koo gbe nɔmlɔ.
“ ‘Ko puɛ gba.
“ ‘Koo ju.
“ ‘Koo ye lakpa odase kɛ si o nyɛmi.
“ ‘O hɛ ko kɔ̃ o nyɛmi e yo nɔ; o hɛ ko kɔ̃ o nyɛmi e we, aloo e zugba, aloo e tsɔlɔ nyumu, aloo e mawayo, aloo e na, aloo e teji, aloo e nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ.’ “Benɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔ he ɔ, mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Benɛ e wo gbi kɛ je la, kɛ bɔku kpii ɔ mi ɔ, jamɛ be ɔ mi nɛ e ha nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ekpa ko piɛ we he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngma mɛ ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha mi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye “Benɛ yo ɔ tsuo ngɛ tsoe kɛ la, nɛ nyɛ nu gbi ɔ kɛ je diblii ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ nyɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba ye ngɔ, ba de ke, ‘Hyɛ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ha nɛ wa na e we agboje, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, benɛ wa nu e gbi nɛ e tu munyu kɛ je la a mi ɔ!
Mwɔnɛ ɔ, wa na kaa ke Mawu kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tu munyu po nɔmlɔ adesa ma nyɛ maa hi je mi hɛ ngmengmle.
Mɛni he je e sa nɛ wa wo wa he kɛ wo gbenɔ mi ekohu?
La gegeege ɔ ma ngla wɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ke wa nu Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ gbi ekohu ɔ, wa ma gbo.
Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko kɛ Mawu tu munyu kɛ je la mi nɛ e hi je mi hɛ ngmengmle hyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wa na nɛ ɔ lo?
Mose, moo kpale kɛ ho nɛ o ya bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mo ɔ tue, konɛ o ba de wɔ nɔ́ nɛ e de mo ɔ. Wa maa bu mo tue, nɛ wa maa ye nɔ.’ “Yawɛ nu munyu ɔmɛ, benɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi ngɛ munyu ɔmɛ tsuo tue ɔ; nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘I nu munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ma a de mo ɔ; anɔkuale ɔ sisiisi a de ɔ nɛ.
I ná nɛ ma a na juɛmi daa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a wo ye hɛ mi nyami be tsuaa be, nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hi ha mɛ kɛ a nina kɛ ya neneene!’ Yaa nɛ o ya de mɛ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ho nyɛ bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi ya.
Se mo Mose lɛɛ, hii hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye ngɔ, nɛ ma ha mo mlaa amɛ, kɛ fami ɔmɛ tsuo.
O tsɔɔ ma a, nɛ a ye nɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ i ngɛ mɛ hae ɔ nɔ.’ “Israel ma, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ fae ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ ko gbo e mlaa amɛ ekoeko tue.
Nyɛɛ ye nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ɔ tsuo nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ hi je mi, nɛ níhi a mi nɛ hi ha nyɛ; lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.
Mlaa ngua a “Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fa mi ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe, kɛ e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ a nɔ.
A ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ, nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ nina nyɛ wami be tsuo.
Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Israel ma, nyɛɛ bu tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ loko níhi a mi maa hi ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee ma ngua, nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní ɔ nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ wo si ɔ.
“Israel ma, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji Mawu.
Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, kɛ nyɛ klaa tsuo, kɛ nyɛ he wami tsuo.
Mlaahi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ.
Nyɛɛ sɛɛ he ní be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ we mi, be nɛ nyɛ hia blɔ, be nɛ nyɛ hwɔɔ si, kɛ be nɛ nyɛ te si.
Nyɛɛ fi kɛ wo nyɛ kɔni si, kɛ nyɛ hɛ nya kaa kaimi nɔ́.
Nyɛɛ ngma ngɔ wo nyɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nyɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya.
Tue gbomi he kɔkɔ bɔmi “Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke e ma ha nyɛ zugba ko kɛ e nɔ mahi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ po, wehi kɛ a mi ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ wo a mi ní ɔmɛ, nyu vuhi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsua, wai ngmɔhi, kɛ oliv tsohi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ du ɔ, ke nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ye, nɛ nyɛ tɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Yawɛ nɔ.
Ejakaa lɛ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, he nɛ a ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye; nyɛ ja lɛ pɛ; nɛ e biɛ nyɛ kɛ ka kita.
Nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ a mawu ɔmɛ a se.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ plee we nɔ́ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se ɔ, e mi mi ma fu nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã nɔ́ ɔ.
“Nyɛ ko ka Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee ngɛ Masa a. Mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ a ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ke e da, loo e hi ɔ, nyɛɛ pee.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, e maa hi ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba kpakpa a nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ; e maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je nyɛ blɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ.
“Hwɔɔ se ko ke nyɛ bimɛ bi nyɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke waa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ?’ nyɛ de mɛ ke, ‘Sa a, Egipt matsɛ nyɔguɛhi ji wɔ, nɛ Yawɛ kɛ kɔni si wami je wɔ kɛ je Egipt.
Yawɛ ha okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ gbeye ba Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e we ɔ tsuo nɔ ngɛ wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ e je wɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ zugba nɛ e ka wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ngɛ he ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ fa wɔ ke waa ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, nɛ waa ye lɛ gbeye, konɛ e hi ha wɔ nitsɛmɛ, nɛ wa yi nɛ na wami daa kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ. Ke wa ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, e bua maa jɔ wa he.’
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ e ma “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya su zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa fie je mahi babauu kɛ je zugba a nɔ ha nyɛ.
Je ma kpaago nɛ a he hiɛ, nɛ a he wa kulaa pe nyɛ Yawɛ maa fie ngɛ nyɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ: Hit bi, Girgash bi, Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi.
Ke be ɔ su nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ je mɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nyɛɛ kɛ ma ko ma ko kó so nɛ nyɛɛ pee kake; nyɛ ko na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a binyumu ɔmɛ gba; nɛ nyɛ ko ha nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ hu ya ngɔ a biyi ɔmɛ.
Ejakaa a ma kpaka nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi.
Ke e ba mi ja a, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi amlɔ.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee mohu ji kaa nyɛɛ ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ ywia mɛ dukuduku, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a yo mawu nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a we amaga a, nɛ nyɛɛ sã wɔ ɔmɛ.
Nyɛɛ pee ja, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hla nyɛ kɛ je nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a kpɛti, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma pɔtɛɛ.
“Pi hiɛmi nɛ nyɛ he hiɛ pe ma kpa amɛ he je nɛ Yawɛ suɔ nyɛ nɛ e hla nyɛ ɔ; nyɛ mohu ji nihi nɛ a he pi pe kulaa ngɛ ma amɛ a kpɛti.
Suɔmi mohu Yawɛ suɔ nyɛ; nɛ kita nɛ e ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e suɔ kaa e maa ye nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Yawɛ kɛ kɔni si wami je nyɛ, nɛ e kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛ je Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji Mawu, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale.
E maa ye e somi nɔ, nɛ e ma je e suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔhi akpe abɔ nɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ a yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, se ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume lɛ ɔ, e maa gbla a tue amlɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye níhi nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ a nɔ; nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Gbaami jeɔ tue bumi mi “Ke nyɛ bu mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ye somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ma je e suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ; e maa suɔ nyɛ, nɛ e maa gbaa nyɛ.
E ma ha nyɛ he maa hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu.
E maa gbaa nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma na blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu.
E maa gbaa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ na amɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ maa bɔ.
Gbaami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo e kɛ maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ e ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ma ko ma ko be je ɔ mi nɛ a maa gbaa mɛ babauu kaa nyɛ.
A be nyumu ko, loo yo ko nae ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ be fɔe; nɛ nyɛ lohwe ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu.
Yawɛ be hae nɛ hiɔ nɛ nu nyɛ; nɛ Egipt hiɔ yaya amɛ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ ekoeko be nyɛ he sae; nyɛ he nyɛli mohu lɛ a maa nu hiɔ yaya nɛ ɔmɛ.
Ma tsuaa ma nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma je ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi; nyɛ ko na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Nyɛ ko ja a mawu ɔmɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
“Nyɛ ko de nyɛ he ke, ‘Ni ɔmɛ a he hiɛ pe wɔ, nɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛ fie mɛ kɛɛ?’ Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye; nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ. Nyɛ kai gbenɔ hiɔhi nɛ a nya wa nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ. Nyɛ kai okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ kɔni si wami pee kɛ kpɔ̃ nyɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kpata Egipt bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e maa pee je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mɛ gbeye yee ɔ. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha sawale maa nu mɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tu fo ngɛ nyɛ nya ya laa a he ɔ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbeye.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ; e ji Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye.
Nyɛ maa na kaa bɔɔbɔɔ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa fie je ma amɛ kɛ maa je nyɛ blɔ nɔ ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ be mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nyɛe ma kpata si kake too; ke nyɛ pee ja a, nga mi lohwe awi yeli ɔmɛ maa hiɛ tsɔ, nɛ a maa hao nyɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ngɔ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ; sawale maa nu mɛ, nɛ a ma jija kɛ yaa si be nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
E maa ngɔ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ.
Nyɛɛ gbe mɛ nɛ a biɛ nɛ laa kulaa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛe maa da; nyɛ ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ sã a we amaga amɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ ko kɔ̃ a sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu nɔ; nyɛ ko ngɔ ekoeko.
Ke nyɛ ngɔ eko ɔ, e maa pee gbenɔ ha nyɛ; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ sume amaga jami.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ amaga nɛ ɔ eko kɛ ba nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi; ke nyɛ pee ja a, gbiɛmi nɛ ngɛ amaga amɛ a nɔ ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ hie amaga amɛ, ejakaa Yawɛ gbiɛmi ngɛ a nɔ.
Zugba kpakpa a “Nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ. Nyɛ kai kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kpaka nyɛ ngɛ blɔ gagaa nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
E ha hɛdo níhi kɛ nyɛ kpe kɛ ka nyɛ hyɛ, konɛ e kɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, kaa nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, loo nyɛ be a nɔ yee.
E ha hwɔ ye nyɛ, nɛ e ha nyɛ abolo nɛ je hiɔwe nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ nɛ hyɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ye.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa pi abolo pɛ nɛ haa nɔmlɔ yi naa wami, se mohu munyu tsuaa munyu nɛ jeɔ Yawɛ nya mi ɔ nɛ haa nɔ yi naa wami.
Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ nɛ ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, nyɛ tade gba we ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ nanehi hu fuu we.
Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ tsɔseɔ e bi ɔ, ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔsee ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fa nyɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ yaa zugba nɛ baa ní saminya ko nɔ.
Pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi ngɛ nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ nyu pãã si kɛ jee zu mi nɛ e suɔ kɛ pueɔ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
E ji zugba nɛ ngma, blɛfo, wai yiblii, ngmɔkɔ, tso nɛ yiblii ngɔɔ, oliv tso, kɛ hwo ngɛ nɔ.
Hwɔ be nyɛ yee, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛ hiae.
Tɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ, dade ngɛ mi.
Yo ɔmɛ a mi hu akɔblee ngɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa tsua.
Nyɛ ma na ní maa ye maa tɔ; nɛ nyɛ maa na Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ si ngɛ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ e ha nyɛ ɔ he.
A bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ke a hɛ ko je Mawu nɔ “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.
Ke nyɛ ná ngma nɛ nyɛ ye nɛ nyɛ tɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma tsuhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi; jehanɛ, ke nyɛ na amɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ, nyɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu, kɛ ní kpa amɛ tsuo ba hiɛ babauu ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ba je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ.
Lɛ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt, he nɛ a ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ kpaka nyɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa gbajaa nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeye ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ a naa sinɔhi nɛ a duɔ nya wa, kɛ nyingmogblakotohi ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ he nɛ nyu be ɔ, e je nyu kɛ je tslɛbo tɛ sa mi ha nyɛ.
Ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, e ha nyɛ mana, niye ní nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ yi hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye.
E ha nyɛ na hɛdo ní, nɛ e kɛ ka nyɛ hyɛ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e gbaa nyɛ kɛ ní kpakpahi.
E pee ja, konɛ nyɛ ko susu kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he wami nya nɛ nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nyɛ kai kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ haa nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ kɛ naa ní.
E ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ pee, ejakaa e ngɛ anɔkuale yee kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ he.
Nyɛ hɛ ko je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ; nyɛ ko nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se; nyɛ ko ya ja mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko sɔmɔ mɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kɔkɔ bɔe mwɔnɛ ɔ kaa a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
Ke nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue ɔ, lɛɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ nyɛ blɔ nɔ ɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ gbo tue “Nyɛɛ bu tue, Israel bi; mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a, konɛ nyɛ ya fie je ma amɛ nɛ kle, nɛ a he wa pe nyɛ ɔ.
A fia gbogbo nɛ ya hiɔwe ploplooplo ngɔ wo a ma amɛ a he.
Oblaihi gojogojoo nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we mɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na maa le kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ yaa kaa bɔ nɛ la tsoɔ gegeege kɛ sãã nɔ́ ɔ nɛ.
E maa ye a nɔ ha nyɛ; e ma ha nyɛ maa fie mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi amlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo nyɛ si ɔ.
“Ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fie mɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko susu nɛ nyɛ de nyɛ he ke, ‘Wa dami nɛ wa da he je nɛ Yawɛ kɛ wɔ ba nɛ wa ba ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ.’ Pi ja, se mohu je ma nɛ ɔmɛ a yi mi nɛ wa a he je nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ fiee ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Pi kaa nyɛ hi, loo nyɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da he je nɛ Yawɛ ha nyɛ yaa ngɔ a zugba a. Mohu ɔ, a yi mi nɛ wa a he je nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ mɛ fiee ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, Yawɛ pee ja, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ye si nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ, Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi nyɛ dami nɛ nyɛ da he je nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae.
Dɛbi, ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ.
“Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi la ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.
Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba si be nɛ nyɛ ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã sɔuu nyɛ ngɛ tsɔe.
Ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he po nyɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la; nɛ bɔ nɛ e mi mi fu ha a, e sa nɛ e kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
Imi nɛ i kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ i ya he tɛ tɛtlɛɛhi nɛ a ngma somi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ kɛ ba.
I hi yo ɔ nɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ; nɛ́ i yi ní ɔ, i nui nyu hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mi.
Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ ngma munyu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e kɛ nyɛ tu kɛ je la a mi ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔ sisi ɔ ngɔ fɔ tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ se loko Yawɛ ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ e ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ ha mi.
“Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ esɔ; o ma a nɛ o ya je kɛ je Egipt ɔ tla blɔ momo, nɛ a pee yayami.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, a gba kɛ je nɔ́ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ he; a puɛ amaga, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ jae.’ “Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘I le kaa ma nɛ ɔ kuɛ wa.
Ha mi blɔ nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó kai mɛ gblegbleegble hu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma pee mo tsɛ ha ma ko nɛ kle, nɛ e he wa pe mɛ.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye he sɔ kɛ kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ye somi dɛ mi tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ ngma somi munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, la ngɛ tsoe plamplam kɛ ngɛ yo ɔ mi jee.
I na kaa mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ tɔ̃ nɔ mo.
Nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Nyɛ ngɔ dade kɛ ya sɔ̃ amaga nɛ ngɛ kaa na bi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi nɔuu nɛ i ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ i hɛɛ ɔ ngɔ fia si nɛ a ywia wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.
Jehanɛ, i ho ya kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ekohu nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ; nɛ́ i yi ní ɔ, i nui nyu hulɔ.
I pee ja ngɛ yayami nɛ nyɛ pee kɛ si Yawɛ kɛ wo e mi mi la a he.
I ye Yawɛ mi mi la a gbeye, ejakaa e gli wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e ko kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
Se Yawɛ bu mi tue ekohu.
Aaron hu Yawɛ mi mi fu lɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ e ko gbe lɛ; se i kpa pɛɛ ha Aaron hu jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃.
Jehanɛ, jamɛ a nɔ́ yaya a nɛ nyɛ sɔ̃, nɛ ji na bi ɔ, i ngɔ, nɛ i sã ngɛ la mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ywia lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ nɛ i wɛɛ lɛ bɔdɔbɔdɔ; e pee kaa tabo zu, nɛ i ya hɛ lɛ ngɔ pue pa a nɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ngɛ bee ɔ mi.
“Nyɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi la ngɛ Tabera, Masa, kɛ Kibrot hulɔ.
Jehanɛ, benɛ e wo nyɛ blɔ kɛ je Kadesh Barnea, nɛ e fa nyɛ ke nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba nɛ e kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae kaa nyɛ weto ní ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi po, nyɛ tsɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã: nyɛ he we lɛ yi, nɛ nyɛ bui lɛ tue.
Kɛ je be nɛ i le nyɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã sɔuu nyɛ ngɛ tsɔe.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ya kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu kɛ kpa pɛɛ ha nyɛ; ejakaa i le kaa Yawɛ to kaa e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
I kpa pɛɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, mo ko kpata mo nitsɛ o ma a hɛ mi; ma nɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o kpɔ̃ mɛ, nɛ o je mɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ o kɔni si wami.
Mo kai Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob, o sɔmɔli ɔmɛ; nɛ o ko di ma nɛ ɔ tue wami, a yi mi wami, kɛ yayami ɔmɛ.’ Ke pi ja a, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ hyɛ, a Mawu ɔ nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya su zugba nɛ e wo si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.
A ma de ke o je o ma a kɛ ho nga kplanaa a nɔ ya, nɛ o ya gbe mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa o sume a sane.
O le kaa ma nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla ha o he, nɛ o kɛ kɔni si wami kpetekpleenyɛ je kɛ je Egipt ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’
Mose ya ngɔ mlaa amɛ ekohu “Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ, nɛ o kpɛ tso daka nɛ a kɛ tɛ ɔmɛ maa wo mi.
Ngɔɔ kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ, konɛ ma ngma munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kekle tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o ywia a a nɔ ɔ kɛ wo tɛ tɛtlɛɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo daka a mi.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ akasia tso kɛ kpɛ daka, nɛ i kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ, nɛ i hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ. Jehanɛ, Yawɛ ngma munyu ɔmɛ nɛ e ngma ngɛ kekle tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ wo tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ehe nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ji mlaa nyɔngma amɛ nɛ a ngma ha nyɛ, benɛ e tu munyu kɛ je la a mi ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔ he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mi; nɛ i kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ.
Jehanɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ɔ, i ngɔ tɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo daka nɛ i kpɛ ɔ mi; tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ daka a mi kɛ mwɔɔ.” “I hi yo ɔ nɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee kekle ɔ. Yawɛ bu mi tue ekohu; e kplɛɛ kaa e be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Yaa nɛ o ya nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ i ka a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ngɛ he ke ma ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ.’ Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke Israel ma a nɛ pee “Jehanɛ, Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ tue.
Nyɛ ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, kɛ nyɛ klaa tsuo.
Nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, konɛ e hi ha nyɛ.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ́ ji hiɔwe ploplooplo ɔ tsuo, zugba a, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.
Se akɛnɛ suɔmi nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nya wa wawɛɛ he je ɔ, e hla nyɛ nɛ ji a nina a mohu ngɛ je ma kpa amɛ a mi; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ ji e ma nɛ e hla.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ ko wa tue hu.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji Mawu nɛ pe mawuhi tsuo kulaa, nɛ e he wami se be.
E ji Mawu nɛ kle, nɛ e he wa; nɛ e sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye.
E hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e he we nyɔ mi ní.
E hyɛɛ kaa a ye awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi a sane pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mɛ.
E suɔ nihi nɛ ba to wɔ nibwɔ ɔ, nɛ e haa mɛ a niye ní, kɛ a heha ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ nibwɔ ɔmɛ a sane; ejakaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya to nubwɔ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt.
Nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue, nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ nɔ kake pɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale, nɛ nyɛɛ wo si ngɛ e biɛ mi pɛ.
Nyɛ je e yi; lɛ ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsu ní nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ yaa Egipt ɔ, mɛ nimli nyingmi kpaago pɛ nɛ a ho, se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ he hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe.
Yawɛ ji ngua “Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ daa.
Nyɛ kai mwɔnɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ nyɛ kase ngɛ Yawɛ he, bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpa lɛ si ha.
Tsa pi nyɛ bimɛ, se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a si ɔ lɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ na kaa Yawɛ kle, e kɔni si wa; e nyɛɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi hulɔ.
Nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ e pee Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e zugba a tsuo kulaa a. Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kpata Egipt ta a, kɛ a okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ɔ. E ha Wo Tsu ɔ mi nyu ɔ mii Egipt ta a tsuo, benɛ a nyɛɛ nyɛ se ɔ. Nyɛ le níhi nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ e pee Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi no Eliab binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Datan kɛ Abiram ɔ. Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ zugba a mi gba nɛ e mii mɛ kɛ a weku li, kɛ a lohwehi tsuo.
Niinɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na ní nguanguahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ tsu ɔ kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ.
Gbaamihi nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ a wo he si ɔ nɔ “Nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ ma nyɛ maa po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa sɛ mi ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ Yawɛ wo si ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a nina a nɔ.
Zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ ɔ be kaa Egipt zugba a, he nɛ nyɛ je ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ, ke o du ní ɔ, ja o gbo dengme kɛ pue ní ɔmɛ a nɔ nyu ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi; se zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ nɛ ɔ, e ji yo nɔ zugba kɛ e mi kɔ̃hi.
Hiɔmi nɛɛ saminya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ baa zugba nɛ ɔ yi, nɛ e buu he jeha a mi tsuo.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, e ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ e be mi gbo kɛ gbiɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ ma na blɛfo, wai, kɛ nu.
Nyɛ ma na nga hu kɛ ha nyɛ na amɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ní nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi kɛkɛ, konɛ a ko mlɔɔ nyɛ kɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu nyɛ.
E be hae nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ hu, nɛ zugba a ma gbli, nɛ e be ní bae hu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ hwɔ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ nɔ.
“Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ susu a he saminya.
Nyɛɛ fi kɛ wo nyɛ kɔni si, kɛ nyɛ hɛ nya kaa kaimi nɔ́.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ.
Nyɛɛ sɛɛ he ní be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ we mi, be nɛ nyɛ hia blɔ, be nɛ nyɛ hwɔɔ si, kɛ be nɛ nyɛ te si.
Nyɛɛ ngma ngɔ wo nyɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nyɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ wo si ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ daa kɛ yaa si je mi nyagbe.
“Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa fie jamɛ a je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a he wa pe nyɛ ɔ kɛ je zugba amɛ a nɔ ha nyɛ.
Zugba a he nɛ nyɛ maa nyɛɛ kɛ gu ɔ tsuo maa pee nyɛ nɔ́.
Nyɛ huzu maa je nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ leneyi je kɛ yaa su Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ omleyi je; jehanɛ e maa je Yufrate a pa nya ngɛ beleku je kɛ yaa su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya ngɛ bonyoku je.
He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa ya ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha ni ɔmɛ maa ye nyɛ gbeye kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ nyɛe.
“Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ngɔ gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe konɛ nyɛɛ hla nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ.
E maa pee gbaami ha nyɛ, ke nyɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ; se e maa pee gbiɛmi, ke nyɛ yi mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpale kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja we mɛ hyɛ ɔ. Ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ya su zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ de gbaami munyu ɔmɛ kɛ je Gerizim yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ gbiɛmi munyu ɔmɛ hu kɛ je Ebal yo ɔ nɔ.
(Yo enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ngɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
A ngɛ bonyoku je, nɛ a kɛ tso ngua amɛ nɛ ngɛ More kɛ Gilgal ɔ a he kɛ we kulaa.)
E su be nɛ nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a, nɛ nyɛ ma ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ.
Ke nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya konɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mawu to he kake nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ “Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ nyɛ wami be tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Hehi nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ nyɛ yaa fie ɔ jaa a mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ, ngɛ yo gaga amɛ a nɔ, yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ tso kusuu ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ, nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a wɔ titima amɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.
Nyɛɛ sã a yo wɔ Ashera a, nɛ nyɛɛ poo a mawu ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ pue he.
Nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, konɛ a ko ja mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ hu.
“Nyɛ ko ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ he saisaa kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ɔ. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa hla he kake ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ e maa ngɔ e biɛ kɛ wo lejɛ ɔ kaa e si himi he nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ.
Nyɛ ya sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, bɔ kpa amɛ, nyɛ níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ, kɛ nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nike ní nɛ nyɛ wo si ke nyɛ ma ha Yawɛ, kɛ nike ní nɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa, nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ nyɛ to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ niba ní kpakpahi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ gbaa nyɛ dengme gbomi nɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a he.
“Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛ ko pee kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ Mawu jae bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ suɔ, ejakaa zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ nyɛ maa hi si ngɛ nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ɔ, nyɛ sui nɔ lolo.
Ke nyɛ po Yordan pa a, Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ maa ngɔ zugba a nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ.
E ma ha nyɛ tue mi maa jɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli tsuo nɛ bɔle nyɛ kɛ kpe ɔ a dɛ mi.
Yawɛ maa hla he ko pɔtɛɛ nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ bɔ sami ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ a he mlaa woe nɛ ɔ kɛ ya sã bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ: nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, nike ní ɔmɛ, nyɛ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ, kɛ bɔ pɔtɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ wo si ke nyɛ ma ha Yawɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ tsɔli nyumu ɔmɛ, nyɛ mawayi ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ tsuo nyɛ nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi; nyɛ kai kaa Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be zugba ko nae kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ́.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko ya sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ he saisaa nɛ nyɛ suɔ.
Nyɛɛ sã bɔ ɔmɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ he kake nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa to ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake zugba mi ɔ pɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ pɛ nyɛɛ sã nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ maa sã a, nɛ nyɛɛ pee ní kpa amɛ tsuo nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ ngɛ.
“Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa gbe nyɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu dloo nyɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye; ke ngɛ kɔ nya a, nɔ ɔ he tsɔ jio, e he tsɔ we jio, e ye kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ bayelɔ, loo avugbɛ lo ɔ.
Se muɔ lɛɛ, kaa niye ní ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ pue zugba kaa nyu.
Nyɛ ko ye níhi nɛ nyɛ kɛ ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ekoeko ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ, nyɛ blɛfo mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a jio, nyɛ wai jio, nyɛ oliv nu jio, loo nyɛ na amɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ eko jio, nike níhi nɛ nyɛ wo si kaa nyɛɛ kɛ ma ha Yawɛ ɔ eko jio, nɔ́ nɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa jio, loo bɔ kpa komɛ jio.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye bɔ sami ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi pɛ, ngɛ he kake ɔ nɛ e to nɛ a ja lɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ hu, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Levi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ be abɔ nɛ nyɛ maa hi nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.
“Ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ bli nyɛ huzu ɔmɛ a mi kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye de lo be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ suɔ.
Se ke he nɛ a to kaa a ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa gbe nyɛ na, loo to nɛ Yawɛ kɛ dloo nyɛ ɔ eko, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɔ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ we mi kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e yeɔ lo ɔ eko; nɔ ɔ he tsɔ jio, nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we jio, e ye kaa bɔ nɛ e maa ye bayelɔ, loo avugbɛ lo ɔ.
Lo kɛ e mi muɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko ye kɔkɔɔkɔ; ejakaa wami ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e sɛ kaa nyɛ yeɔ lo kɛ e mi wami ɔ tsuo.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ muɔ kɛ pee niye ní; mohu nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ pue zugba kaa nyu.
Ke nyɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ bua maa jɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hi ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina tsuo.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã a, kɛ nike ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ wo si ɔ kɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ to ke a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, lo kɛ muɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ bɔ kpa amɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kpa muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lo ɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee, nɛ i wo nyɛ mlaa ngɛ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ fitsofitso; kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi a mi maa hi ha nyɛ kɛ nyɛ nia tsuo kɛ maa ya neneene; ejakaa ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ saa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi pee.
Amaga jami he kɔkɔ bɔmi “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kpata je ma amɛ nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ a zugba a a hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ kulaa.
Ke Yawɛ kpata jamɛ a je ma amɛ a hɛ mi se ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ a we amaga jami ní peemi ní ɔmɛ a se, ejakaa e maa pee gbenɔ ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ ko hla a mawu ɔmɛ a se blɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko bi ke, ‘Kɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ jaa a mawu ɔmɛ kɛɛ, konɛ wɔ hu waa pee ja!’ Nyɛ ko ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa a jaa a mawu ɔmɛ; ejakaa ngɛ a mawu ɔmɛ a jami mi ɔ, a peeɔ níhi nɛ a hĩɔ, nɛ́ Yawɛ sume ɔ tsuo.
A bimɛ po a sãã ngɛ la mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
“Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ a nɔ fitsofitso.
Nyɛ ko je nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ he hulɔ.
“Ke gbalɔ ko, loo nlami sisi tsɔɔlɔ ko wo si ke e maa pee okadi ko, loo nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya ja Mawu kpahi, nɛ pohu nyɛ ja we mɛ hyɛ ɔ, ke kaa níhi nɛ e wo a he si ɔ ba mi tete po ɔ, nyɛ ko bu lɛ tue fɛɛ.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae nɛ e hyɛ kaa nyɛ suɔ lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ saminya ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi lo.
Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ se, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ pɛ gbeye; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ; nyɛ ja lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale.
Se gbalɔ, loo nlami sisi tsɔɔlɔ ko nɛ maa wo nyɛ yi mi ke nyɛɛ te si kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, he nɛ nyɛ ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe lɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ, e ji nɔmlɔ yayami nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae kaa e maa mlɔɔ nyɛ kɛ je si himi kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ hi ɔ he.
Nyɛɛ gbe lɛ, konɛ nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ ko hi nyɛ kpɛti hu.
“O nyɛminyumu nɛ ji o nyɛ muklii mi bi, loo o binyumu, loo o biyo, loo o yo nɛ o suɔ lɛ, loo o huɛ nɛ nyu bi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti po ma nyɛ maa mlɔɔ mo nɛ o ma ya ja mawu kpahi nɛ mo, loo o nɛmɛ ja we hyɛ.
A ti nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa mlɔɔ mo nɛ o ma ya ja nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kasa nya, aloo nihi nɛ ngɛ tsitsaa a mawu ɔmɛ ekomɛ.
Koo kplɛɛ, nɛ koo bu lɛ tue tete po.
Koo na lɛ mɔbɔ; koo baa e yi; koo laa e nɔ.
Gbee lɛ!
Mo kekle o fia lɛ tɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fiaa lɛ tɛ ɔ eko.
Á fiaa lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo!
E hla kaa e ma puɛ o tue ngɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ kpɔ̃ mo kɛ je Egipt, he nɛ o ya ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ he.
Ke e ba mi ja a, Israel ma a tsuo maa nu sane ɔ he; a maa ye gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ́ yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ pee hu.
“Ke nyɛ ngɛ ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a mi, nɛ nyɛ nu kaa yakayaka nimli komɛ nɛ ji Israel fɔfɔɛhi puɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a tue nɛ a ya ja mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja we hyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bi nɛ nyɛɛ na nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ mi fitsofitso.
Ke sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa a pee nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ gbe jamɛ a ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ klaate kɛ kpata ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nyɛ bua ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a níhi nɛ a ngɛ ɔ tsuo a nya glekugleku ngɛ ma nɔ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ sã ma a, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kaa sami bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Ma a nɛ pee ma doku, nɛ e ko bɔ hu gblegbleegble.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ níhi nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ eko kɛ to ha nyɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi nɛ fu nyɛ wawɛɛ ɔ nya maa ba si, nɛ e maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ.
E maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ he maa hiɛ babauu kaa bɔ nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ. Ke nyɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, Yawɛ maa pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ ha nyɛ.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ a hiɔ ngɛ ya peemi mi “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ji nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko gbo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ya nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ ko poo nyɛ he ha, nɛ nyɛ ko je nyɛ hɛ nya kaa bɔ nɛ je ma kpa amɛ peeɔ ɔ. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ níhi ji nyɛ.
E hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a mi kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
Lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we “Nɔ́ ko nɛ Yawɛ ke e he tsɔ we ɔ, nyɛ ko ye.
Lohwehi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ji na, jijɔ, apletsi, odabɔ, anagla, bayelɔ, kɛ nga mi gbe, loo asisã.
Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye lohwe tsuaa lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ nɛ a gba e nane kokloto mi, nɛ e gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ, nɛ e kpale taa ekohu.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, lohwehi nɛ gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ, nɛ a kpale taa ekohu, nɛ́ ngɛ nane kokloto nɛ nyɛ ko ye ji afukpɔngɔ, alɔngɔ, kɛ tɛ sa nɔ kpi.
A gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ nɛ a kpale taa ekohu lɛɛ, se a gba we a nane kokloto mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a he tsɔ we.
Nyɛ ko ye kpotoo.
E he tsɔ we; ejakaa a gba e nane kokloto mi lɛɛ, se e gɔle we nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ nɛ e taa ekohu.
Nyɛ ko ye lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ a lo, nɛ nyɛ ko ta a gbogboe he hulɔ.
“Nyɛɛ ye nyu mi lo nɛ ngɛ se mi mio, nɛ toto ha e he, se nyu mi lo nɛ be se mi mio, nɛ toto hɛ e he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; e he tsɔ we.
“Nyɛɛ ye lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ tsuo.
-Se nyɛ ko ye lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a henɔ ɔmɛ: kɔle, klomi, kayo, osansa, alɔɔ, okpoku, kɔɔkɔmite, duguma, anuma, nyɔ mi kayo, nga mi kpakpahe, omiɔhɔɔ, pa nɔ kayo, kpokukpoku, godo, kɔne, kɛ apani.
“Lohwe tsɔwi nɛ tee ɔ tsuo a he tsɔ we; nyɛ ko ye.
Nyɛɛ ye lohwe tsɔwi nɛ a he tsɔ.
“Nyɛ ko ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo.
Nyɛ kɛ ha nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ nɛ a ye, loo nyɛɛ jua ha ni kpahi.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nihi ji nyɛ; nyɛ ji e ma.
Nyɛ ko hoo jijɔ bi, loo apletsi bi ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nyu mi.
Mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake he mlaa “Nyɛ je nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ to daa jeha.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ye nyɛ blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ kase bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye nyɛ wami be tsuo.
Ke nyɛ we mi kɛ jami he ɔ kɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa tloo ní ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a kɛ ya a, lɛɛ nyɛɛ jua ní ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sika a nɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ sika a kɛ he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ, na, wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ weku li nɛ ye ní, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he saminya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
“Nyɛ ko si Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ se; mɛɛ lɛɛ a be weto ní ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Jeha etɛ tsuaa jeha etɛ nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a tsuo nya kɛ ba to ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi.
Levi bi ɔmɛ a niye ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a be weto ní ko.
Nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi hu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a ye eko nɛ a tɔ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ mi.
Jeha kpaagone ɔ “Jeha kpaagone tsuaa jeha kpaagone se ɔ, ke nɔ ko hɛɛ mo hiɔ ɔ, kɛ ke lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ o maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pa Israel fɔfɔɛ ko sika a, e kɛ ke lɛ; e ko je hiɔ ɔ hu.
Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ de ke a kɛ hiɔ ɔ nɛ ke.
Ke nubwɔ ɔ, lɛɛ jee lɛ hiɔ; se mo nitsɛ o ma mi no lɛɛ koo je lɛ hiɔ ɔ. Ohiatsɛ be nyɛ kpɛti hie; ejakaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa gbaa mo ngɛ zugba a nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae kaa o weto ní ɔ nɔ.
Ke o maa bu Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ o maa ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo he mlaa woe mwɔnɛ ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, o be ohia yee.
Yawɛ maa gbaa mo kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. O maa pa sika kɛ ha mahi babauu, se moo lɛɛ o be sika pae ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɛ; o maa ye je mahi babauu a nɔ, se moo lɛɛ je ma ko je ma ko be o nɔ yee.
“Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko dɛ mi ba ta ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, koo pee kpɛle nɛ o nyɛ lɛ nɔ́ he.
Bli o dɛ mi ha nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ, nɛ o pa lɛ bɔ nɛ maa su lɛ.
Ke jeha nɛ a kɛ hiɔ kee nɔ ɔ su ta po, ko kua kaa o maa pa lɛ nɔ́ ko.
Ko ha susumi yaya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba o yi mi.
Ke o kua lɛ nɔ́ nɛ hia lɛ ɔ hami, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ si mo ɔ, a maa bu mo fɔ.
Ha lɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ hiae ɔ faa nɛ kpɛle peemi be mi.
Ke o pee ja a, Yawɛ maa gbaa mo ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ mi.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, ohiatsɛmɛ komɛ maa hi nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ e fi mɛ kɛ̃; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo fae ke o bli o dɛ mi ha mɛ.
Bɔ nɛ á hɛɛ nyɔguɛhi ha “Ke o nyɛmi Hebri no, nyumu jio, yo jio, jua e he kɛ ha mo kaa nyɔguɛ ɔ, ha nɛ e sɔmɔ mo jeha ekpa; nɛ jeha kpaagone ɔ, é ye e he.
Se ke o ngmɛɛ e he ɔ, ko ha nɛ e ya dɛ gu.
Ngɔɔ níhi nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ gbaa mo ɔ, to, blɛfo, kɛ wai ɔ eko kɛ ha lɛ faa, nɛ o kɛ wo lɛ blɔ.
Kai kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya ye nyɔguɛ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he; lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Se ke nyɔguɛ ɔ sume nɛ e si mo, akɛnɛ e suɔ o kɛ o we ɔ nyɛ sane ngɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ lɛ hi si saminya a he je ɔ, lɛɛ ngɔɔ tue gbumi nɔ́ kɛ gbu e tue ngɛ o we ɔ sinya a he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee o nyɔguɛ e wami be tsuo.
Ke yo ji lɛ hu, o pee lɛ jã kɛ̃.
E ko wa ha mo kaa o maa ngmɛɛ nyɔguɛ ko he nɛ e ye e he.
Ke o maa bu nya a, e sɔmɔ mo jeha ekpa sɔuu, nɛ apaatsɛ hiɔwo fa pɛ o puɛ ngɛ e he.
Pee bɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ, nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa gbaa o nine nya ní tsumi tsuo nɔ.
Na, loo to kekleekle bi “Moo hla o na amɛ, kɛ o to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ku ɔmɛ nɛ a ma fɔ ɔ ngɔ to ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ; koo ngɔ na nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsu nɔ́ ko, nɛ jijɔ bi ɔmɛ hu ko sã a he bwɔmi.
Daa jeha a, o kɛ o weku li nɛ ye mɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ e to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ke lohwe ɔmɛ a nane kplɔ ngɛ a sisi, loo a hɛngmɛ yu, loo sakpa ko ngɛ a he ɔ, koo ngɔ mɛ kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ. O ma nyɛ maa ye mɛ ngɛ we mi.
Nyɛ tsuo, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we ma nyɛ maa ye kaa bɔ nɛ a yeɔ batslɔɔ, loo nga mi gbe ɔ.
Se a muɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko ye; nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue si kaa nyu.
Hetsɔmi ɔ “Nyɛɛ ye Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Abib ɔ mi kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɔ ko mi ngɛ jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi nɛ e kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ ya he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ Mawu ngɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya gbe nyɛ to, loo na amɛ eko kɛ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɛ ko ye masa nɔ́ ko ligbi kpaago, se mohu nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo, nɛ ji nɔ́ nami niye ní nɛ nyɛ ye benɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he hiami tu fo kɛ je Egipt ɔ. Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ wami be mi tsuo ɔ, nyɛ kɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ je Egipt, he nɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ ngɛ ɔ. Ligbi kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a ko na masa nɔ́ ko ngɛ we ko we ko mi ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ.
Lohwe nɛ a gbe kekleekle ligbi ɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si hu, á ye lo ɔ tsuo ligbi ɔ kɛ̃; je ko na yi.
-“Nyɛɛ gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ pɛ; nyɛ ko gbe ngɛ he saisaa ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si be nɛ pu yaa nɔ si ejakaa jamɛ a be mi nɛ nyɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ hoo lo ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ; e nɔ jena mɔtu loko nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ya we mi.
Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo ligbi ekpa, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Ngmakpami nyami be ɔ “Nyɛɛ kane otsi kpaago kɛ je be nɛ nyɛ ma bɔni ngma kpami, nɛ nyɛɛ ye Ngmakpami nyami be ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ suɔmi nya nike ní, ngɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu gbaa nyɛ nɛ nyɛ na a nya kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ mawa amɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛ nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ ngɛ he kake nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt.
Gbasisihimi nyami be “Ke nyɛ hluɛ nyɛ blɛfo tsuo ta, nɛ nyɛ nga nyɛ wai yiblii tsuo gbe nya a, nyɛɛ ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, nibwɔ ɔmɛ, awusa amɛ, kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ tsuo nyɛɛ ye nyami be nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ligbi kpaago ngɛ he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ saminya, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbaa nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní, kɛ nyɛ nine nya ní tsumi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɔ.
“Israel ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ a bua a he nya si etɛ ngɛ jeha mi ngɛ he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ.
Be ɔmɛ ji Hetsɔmi nyami be, Ngmakpami nyami be, kɛ Gbasisihimi nyami be.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ba nyami nɛ ɔ kɛ e dɛ gu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbaa lɛ ɔ. Dami sane yemi “Nyɛɛ wo kojoli kɛ tsɔli ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ a mi.
Mɛɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a maa hyɛ nɛ dami sane yemi nɛ ma si.
A ko ye tue kpɛkpɛɛ sane; nɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi.
A ko he nyɔ mi ní; ejakaa nyɔ mi ní hemi yuɔ ní leli po a hɛngmɛ, nɛ e haa a plɛɔ munyu hɛ mi buɔ si.
Nyɛɛ pee nɔ nɛ sa, nɛ nyɛɛ ye dami sane daa.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ maa su zugba nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ daa.
“Ke nyɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ yo Ashera a mawu we amaga nɛ a kɛ tso kpɛ kɛ ma e kasa nya.
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ko ngɔ tɛ kɛ ma si nɛ nyɛ ja; Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hiɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
“Nyɛ ko ngɔ na, loo to nɛ kpa, loo nɔ́ ko yayami ngɛ e he kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; Yawɛ hiɔ jamɛ a bɔ.
“Alini, nyɛ maa nu ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ ekomɛ a mi kaa nyumu ko, loo yo ko pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; e ya yi Yawɛ somi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tɔ̃; lɔ ɔ ji kaa e ya ja mawu kpahi, pu, nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi, nɛ e sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ e kɛ tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ba sɛɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bi nɛ nyɛ hla mi fitsofitso kaa sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ lo.
Ke e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa a tsu nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ nyɛ ya fiaa lɛ tɛ, nɛ e gbo, nyumu jio, yo jio.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, odase yeli enyɔ, loo nihi nɛ hiɛ pe jã a we odase nɔ a maa da kɛ bu lɛ fɔ, loko a gbe lɛ; a ko nu odase yelɔ kake pɛ nya mi munyu.
Odase yeli ɔmɛ nɛ a fiaa lɛ tɛ ɔ kekle, konɛ ma a tsuo nɛ fiaa nɔ ɔ tɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ pee ja kɛ je nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
“E ma nyɛ maa ba mi kaa sane komɛ a yemi kɛ he buámi nya maa wa tsɔ ha ma amɛ eko mi kojoli, kaa weto ní blɔ nya he pleemi sane komɛ kikɛ, loo kaa a plaa nɔ ko, loo sane komɛ nɛ a ngɛ mi hlae, konɛ a na kaa pe a je blɔ gbe nɔ ko nɛ e gbo ɔ, loo a li be nɛ a fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbo.
Ke e ba lɛ ja a, nyɛɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ sane ɔ kɛ ya pue osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ kojolɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi, konɛ a buá he.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ma munyu ɔ nya si.
Nyɛɛ pee bɔ nɛ a ma de nyɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛɛ kplɛɛ bɔ nɛ a maa ma munyu ɔ nya si ɔ; nɛ nyɛɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ nɛ a maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ a nɔ fitsofitso.
Se nɔ nɛ ma tsɔ atuã kɛ si kojolɔ, loo osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe lɛ; kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ nyɛɛ gu kɛ je yayami kɛ je Israel ma a mi.
Enɛ ɔ ma ha ma a tsuo maa nu sane nɛ ɔ he, nɛ a maa ye gbeye; kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nlae kaa e maa pee ja hu.
Blɔ nya tomi nɛ kɔɔ matsɛ he “Ke nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ, nɛ e ba pee nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma de ke nyɛ maa wo matsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ tsuo pee ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa e ye matsɛ ɔ, e pee nɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla.
E pee nyɛ ma mi no; nyɛ ko ngɔ nubwɔ kɛ to matsɛ nɛ e ye nyɛ nɔ.
Matsɛ ɔ ko hi ta okpɔngɔhi babauu; nɛ e ko tsɔ kɛ ya he okpɔngɔhi ngɛ Egipt; ejakaa Yawɛ de ke e ma a ko kpale kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ gblegbleegble.
Matsɛ ɔ ko ngɔ yihi fuu; ejakaa ke e pee ja a, e tsui maa je Yawɛ he.
E ko bua sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu babauu nya ha e he.
Ke matsɛ ɔ ba hi sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ é pee mohu ji e ha nɛ a ngma Mawu mlaa amɛ, kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ je mlaa womi ɔ nitsɛ mi kɛ wo womi mi.
Mlaa womi ɔ nitsɛ ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ a dɛ e hii.
Womi nɛ ɔ nɛ hi matsɛ ɔ kasa nya.
E kane be tsuaa be e wami be tsuo, konɛ e ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ e ye mlaa amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e be susue kaa e hi pe e nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ e maa ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɔ ɔ loko e matsɛ yemi ɔ se maa kɛ, nɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e nina maa ye Israel nɔ be babauu.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a blɔ nya ní “Osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku, nɛ ji Levi weku ɔ, a ko ná zugba nɛ a dla kɛ ha Israel ma a eko.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa lɛ a he ji nike níhi, kɛ bɔhi nɛ a sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ.
A be zugba nae kaa a weto ní kaa bɔ nɛ wɛtso kpa amɛ na a; a blɔ nya ji kaa a pee Yawɛ we osɔfohi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ɔ.
“Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa gbe na, loo to kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, a je lohwe ɔ gugue, e tsitsa, kɛ e mi mi kotoku ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ bɔni bami ɔ, kekleekle ní ɔmɛ maa pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́: blɛfo, wai, oliv nu, kɛ to he bwɔmi.
Levi bi ɔmɛ a wɛtso ɔ lɛ Yawɛ hla ngɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ daa kaa osɔfohi.
“Levi no saisaa ma nyɛ maa je Israel ma amɛ eko fɛɛ eko mi kɛ ba he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. E ma nyɛ ma ba ja nɛ e sɔmɔ Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Levi bi kpa amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ peeɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E kɛ osɔfo kpa amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a na niye ní blɔ nya sɔsɔɛ; se nɔ́ nɛ e weku li maa mane lɛ ɔ lɛɛ e pee lɛ nɔ kake e nɔ́.
Wɔ jami kusumi he kɔkɔ bɔmi “Ke o ya su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, mo ko pee je ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a ní hiɔmi ní ɔmɛ.
Mo ko sã o bimɛ ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ; jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó klaa, e ko pee nyakpɛ ní, e ko nu wɔ, e ko tsu kunya, e ko fi kablɛ, e ko tsɛ kpade, nɛ e ko bi ní hulɔ.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ sume nihi nɛ tsuɔ níhi nɛ a hiɔ nɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he nɛ e ngɛ je ma amɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ ngɛ o blɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Moo ye Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ anɔkuale kɛ pi si.” A wo si kaa gbalɔ ko maa ba Jehanɛ, Mose de ke, “Je ma amɛ nɛ o yaa ngɔ a zugba a buɔ nihi nɛ klaa, kɛ kunya tsuli tue; nyɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kplɛɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ pee ja.
Se mohu, Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma je gbalɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa imi kɛ je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ha nyɛ, nɛ lɛ tue nyɛɛ bu.
“Ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ke ma ko ha nɛ nyɛɛ nu Yawɛ munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ hu, loo nɛ nyɛɛ na bɔ nɛ e je e he kpo ngɛ la hleei ɔ mi ɔ; ejakaa nyɛ ye gbeye kaa nyɛ ma gbo.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ a bi ɔ da saminya.
Ma je gbalɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa mo kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti; ma tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de, nɛ lɛɛ e ma de ma a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa lɛ ɔ. E maa tu munyu ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ ke nɔ ko bui lɛ ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma gbla nɔ ɔ tue.
Se ke gbalɔ ko te si nɛ e gba ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ pi imi nɛ i fa lɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ; á gbe gbalɔ saisaa nɛ gbaa ngɛ mawu kpahi a biɛ mi ɔ jã kɛ̃.’ “O ma bi o he ke, ‘Kɛ ma pee kɛ le kaa gbalɔ ko sɛ gbi ji Yawɛ ngɔ kɛɛ?’ Ke gbalɔ ko gba ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ bɛ mi ɔ, sɛ gbi ɔ ji Yawɛ ngɔ.
Jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ nitsɛ e nya mi munyu ji lɔ ɔ nɛ; koo ye lɛ gbeye.
Wesa he ma amɛ kɛ nɔ gbemi he sane “Ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kpata je ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a kɛ ha mo, nɛ o ba ye a nane mi ngɛ a ma amɛ, kɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, -moo dla zugba a mi etɛ, eko fɛɛ eko kɛ e mi ma ngua ko nɛ blɔ kpiti ngɛ kɛ yaa mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke nyɛmi ko nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ eko mi.
Ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ tlukaa nɛ pi e he nyɛlɔ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi nɛ e ya sa we.
Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nihi enyɔ ho pu mi ya nɛ a ya po tso.
Benɛ nɔ kake ngɛ tso ɔ poe ɔ, e gbiɛ nɛ e wo nɔ ɔ dade ɔ hia kɛ je tso ɔ nya ya fia e nyɛmi ɔ, nɛ e gbo.
Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔ ɔ nɛ tu fo kɛ ya ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi nɛ e ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke wesa he ma kake pɛ nɛ a to ɔ, eko ɔ, lejɛ ɔ maa kɛ tsɔ, nɛ lue yelɔ ɔ nine maa su nɔ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e kɛ mi mi la maa gbe nɔ ko nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko yaka gu.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, e nine nɛ ya kpa ngɛ e nyɛmi ɔ nɔ tlukaa, se pi kaa e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee lɛ yayami ko.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i fa mo ke o to wesa he ma etɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ha nɛ o zugba a ba kle kaa bɔ nɛ e de o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke e maa pee ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ zugba a tsuo ngɔ ha mo ɔ, to wesa he ma etɛ kɛ piɛ kekle ní ɔmɛ a he.
Niinɛ, ke o maa ye mlaa a tsuo nɛ i ngɛ mo woe mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ o maa suɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, nɛ o maa ba o je mi ngɛ e tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ a nya a, e maa ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ kɛ ha mo.
Pee bɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ, konɛ a ko pue nihi a muɔ si yaka, nɛ́ a ko bu mo fɔ kaa o tane nihi a yi yaka ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.
“Se ke nɔ ko ngɛ e nyɛmi nyɛe, nɛ e ya wo lɛ ka, nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ nɛ e gbe, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ wesa he ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e ma a mi nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ha e nyɛmi lue yelɔ ɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ.
Koo na lɛ mɔbɔ kulaa.
Koo ngmɛ blɔ nɛ nɔ gbelɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ hi hɛ ngmengmle ngɛ Israel hu; kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi a mi maa hi ha mo.
Blema huzu ɔmɛ “Koo hia o nyɛmi e huzu nɛ nimeli wo blema a kɛ je he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ odase yeli a he “Nɔ kake pɛ ko ye odase kɛ si nɔ ko nɛ pee yayami ko.
Loko a maa bu nɔ ko fɔ ɔ, a nu odase yeli enyɔ, loo nihi nɛ hiɛ pe ja a nya mi munyu.
Ke nɔ ko ya po nɔ ko nya yaka gu nɛ e kɛ puɛ nɔ ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɔ a sane ɔ kɛ ya he nɛ a jaa Mawu ngɛ ɔ, kɛ ya ha osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ ní tsue jamɛ a be ɔ. Kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ a hyɛ munyu ɔ mi fitsofitso.
Ke a na kaa lakpa odase nɔ ɔ ba ye kɛ si e nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔ, a gbla e tue sisiisi kaa bɔ nɛ e susu kaa a ko pee e nyɛmi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛɛ pee jã kɛ je nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
Ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu sane ɔ, konɛ a ye gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó pee yayami nɛ ɔ eko hu gblegbleegble.
Koo na mɔbɔ kulaa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sanehi a mi; to nane mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Tue gblami ɔ ji kaa ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ ko ɔ, a gbe lɛ kɛ to nya; ke nɔ ko pɛ́ nɔ ko hɛngmɛ, loo e ku e lungu, loo e po nɔ ɔ nine, loo e nane ɔ, a pee lɛ jã nɔuu kɛ to nane mi.
Níhi nɛ kɔɔ ta hwumi he “Ke o hia ta, nɛ o kɛ o he nyɛli yaa hwu, nɛ o na kaa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba ta lɛhi, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta buli babauu pe mo ɔ, koo ye mɛ gbeye.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ kpɔ mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ.
Loko o ma bɔni ta a hwumi ɔ, osɔfo nɛ ba da ma a hɛ mi, nɛ e de tabo ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ bu tue, Israel bi!
Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ su ta nya.
Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbeye, nyɛ kã nɛ ko ta, nɛ nyɛ ko nu sawale.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ kɛ nyɛ yaa, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ maa ye kunimi.’ “Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a de ta buli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ po we he, se e gbaa we nɔ lolo kɛ ha Yawɛ lo?
Ke nɔ ko kaa ja ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.
Ke pi ja a, ke e ba mi kaa e ya nɔ ta a, nɔ kpa ma ba gbaa we ɔ nɔ.
Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ pee wai ngmɔ he, se e na we nɛ e kpa wai yiblii ɔ lolo lo?
Ke nɔ ko kaa ja ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.
Ke pi ja a, ke e ba mi kaa e ya nɔ ta a, nɔ kpa ma ba ye ngmɔ ɔ mi wai yiblii ɔ. Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ya bi yo si, se e na we nɛ ngɔ lɛ lolo lo?
Ke nɔ ko kaa ja ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.
Ke pi ja a, ke e ba mi kaa e ya nɔ ta a, nɔ kpa maa ngɔ yo nɛ e ya bi si ɔ.’ “Jehanɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a de ta buli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ sawale nu lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ gbeye yee lo?
Ke nɔ ko kaa ja ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.
Ke pi ja a, e ma ha fɔ̃ maa sɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a mi.’ Ke asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ gbe nya a, á to tatsɛmɛ nɛ maa da kuu tsuaa kuu nya.
“Ke o yaa tua ma ko ɔ, moo ngmɛ jamɛ a ma a mi bi ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a ha yi.
Ke ni ɔmɛ bli ma agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ha yi ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ma ba pee o nyɔguɛhi nɛ o maa nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a ma tsu ní kpakpataa ha mo.
Ke jamɛ a ma a mi bi ɔmɛ sume nɛ a ha yi, se a suɔ ta mohu ɔ, ha nɛ o tabo ɔ nɛ sa a yi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ma ha o maa ngɔ ma a, nɛ o maa gbe nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yi ɔmɛ, jokuɛwi ɔmɛ, we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ kɛ pee o nɔ.
O he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tabo ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee o nɔ́.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ ngɔ ha mo.
Ma amɛ nɛ a kɛ zugba a, he nɛ o yaa hi ɔ a kpɛti kɛ saminya a, jã ji bɔ nɛ o maa pee mɛ.
“Se ke o ngɔ ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, gbee a mi nimli ɔmɛ tsuo.
Mo kpata ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ fa mo ke o pee ɔ; mɛ ji Hit bi, Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi.
Gbee mɛ, konɛ a ko ba tsɔɔ mo a musu ní ɔmɛ nɛ a peeɔ nɛ a kɛ jaa mawu kpahi ɔ, nɛ o kɛ enɛ ɔ ba pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ.
“Ke o hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ ma ko tuae ɔ, koo poo tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii nɛ a yeɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɔ pue he.
Ke be nɛ o kɛ sá ma a yi kɛ kaa mɛni po, koo pee ja.
Moo ye tso yiblii ɔmɛ, se o ko kpata tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Tsa pi tso ɔmɛ ji o he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ o kɛ ná a.
Se tsohi nɛ o le kaa a yi a yiblii ɔ, o ma nyɛ ma kɛ pee níhi nɛ a maa da nɔ kɛ sá ma a yi kɛ ya si be nɛ o maa ngɔ ma a.
Nɔ ko nɛ a gbe, se a nɛ́ e gbelɔ ɔ “Ke a na nɔ ko nɛ a gbe lɛ fɔ si ngɛ nga mi ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ma ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a li nɔ nɛ gbe lɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ a je kpo nɛ a ya susu kɛ je he nɛ a na nɔ gbogboe ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ ya su ma amɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ a mi.
Jehanɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma nɛ kɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ we pe kulaa mi ɔ nɛ a hla na zangmayo nɛ a kɛ lɛ tsu we nɔ́ ko hyɛ.
Nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a kpaka lohwe ɔ kɛ ya kɔ̃ ko nya, he nɛ nyu bee ngɛ daa, he ko nɛ a hu we, nɛ a du we ní ngɛ hyɛ.
Á ku lohwe ɔ kuɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E hia kaa Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ hu nɛ a ya lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa mɛ lɛ a hyɛɛ mlaa sane tsuaa mlaa sane nɛ kɔɔ pɛ nɛ gbenɔ jeɔ mi ɔ mi, nɛ a buá he.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nitsɛ nɛ hla mɛ, nɛ́ a sɔmɔ lɛ, nɛ́ a ngɔ e biɛ kɛ gbaa.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ je ma nɛ kɛ he nɛ a na nɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ ngɛ ɔ kɛ we pe kulaa a nɛ á fɔ a dɛ kɛ pue na a nɔ, nɛ a de ke, ‘Pi wɔ nɛ wa gbe nyumu nɛ ɔ; wa li nɔ nɛ gbe lɛ.
Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, moo na o ma, Israel nɛ o kpɔ kɛ je Egipt ɔ mɔbɔ.
Moo na wɔ mɔbɔ; nɛ koo ngɔ nɔ nɛ a gbe yaka nɛ ɔ musu kɛ tloo wɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ hlae kaa o pee ɔ, nɛ a be gbenɔ nɛ ɔ he musu woe kɛ tloo mo.
Yihi nɛ a nuu ngɛ ta mi “Ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ha o ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ o nuu nihi ɔ, eko ɔ, o maa na yo nɛ he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ o maa suɔ nɛ o ngɔ lɛ nɛ e pee o yo.
Ke e ba mi ja a, mo kpaka lɛ kɛ ya o we mi, nɛ o ha nɛ e sɛ e yi bwɔmi, nɛ e je e nine nguɛ nya, nɛ é tsake e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he.
É hi o we ɔ mi, nɛ é ye kɔmɔ nyɔhiɔ kake ha e fɔli.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ lɛ nɛ e pee o yo.
Pee se, ke o sume lɛ hu ɔ, lɛɛ ha nɛ e ye e he kulaa.
Akɛnɛ pi e suɔmi nya nɛ o ta e he ɔ, o be he blɔ nɛ o peeɔ lɛ kaa nyɔguɛ nɛ o juaa lɛ.
Bitɛte weto ní blɔ nya “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ngɛ yihi enyɔ, nɛ e suɔ nɔ kake saminya, se e sume nɔ kake sane tsɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo fɔ binyumuhi, se yo ɔ nɛ e sume lɛ tsɔ ɔ bi ji bi nɔkɔtɔma.
Lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke be su nɛ e maa dla weto ní ha e binyumu ɔmɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ be he blɔ kaa e ngɔɔ yo nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a bi ɔ ngɔ peeɔ bi nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ yo nɛ e sume lɛ ɔ bi ɔ nane mi.
E ha e bi nɔkɔtɔma ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ma ha e bi kaketsɛ ɔ totoe enyɔ.
Ejakaa bi nɔkɔtɔma nɛ ɔ ji nyumu ɔ kekleekle binyumu nɛ a fɔ ha lɛ.
Binyumu tue gbolɔ “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ngɛ binyumu atuã tsɔlɔ nɛ e tue wa, bi nɛ bui e fɔli, nɛ ke a gbla e tue po e bui.
“Ke bi ko ngɛ kaa ja a, e fɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya ha ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a mi he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a kojo lɛ.
A de ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Tue gbolɔ kɛ atuã tsɔlɔ ji wa bi nɛ ɔ; e bui wa gbi tue; ní puɛlɔ kɛ dã delɔ ji lɛ.’ Jehanɛ, ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a fiaa lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo; kɛkɛ ɔ, o ma je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Israel maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ba a, nɛ a maa ye gbeye.
Mlaa munomunohi “Ke a gbe nɔ ko nɛ pee yayami ko, nɛ a kɛ e gbogboe ɔ bɛle si ngɛ tso nɔ ɔ, ko ha nɛ e hi tso ɔ nɔ nɛ je nɛ na yi.
A pu lɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ̃; ejakaa nɔ gbogboe nɛ bɛle si ngɛ tso nɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu gbiɛmi baa zugba a nɔ.
Moo pu gbogboe ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ko ble zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ.
“Ke o na o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ e na, loo to nɛ laa blɔ ɔ, koo be e he, se mohu mo kpaka lɛ kɛ ya ha o nyɛmi ɔ. Ke o kɛ o nyɛmi ɔ he kɛ, loo o li lohwetsɛ ɔ, lɛɛ mo kpaka lɛ kɛ ya mo nitsɛ o we mi.
Ke nɔtsɛ ɔ ba bi si ɔ, ngɔɔ e ní kɛ ha lɛ.
Jã kɛ̃ o pee, ke o na o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ e teji, loo e tade, loo e nɔ́ kpa ko nɛ laa a.
“Ke o na o nyɛmi Israel no teji, loo na nɛ nɔ si ɔ, koo je e he, se mohu wa o nyɛmi ɔ, konɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ te nɛ e da e nane nɔ ekohu.
“Yo kó wo nyumu tade, nɛ nyumu hu kó wo yo tade; Yawɛ o Mawu ɔ sume nihi nɛ peeɔ jamɛ a níhi.
“Ke o na lohwe pɛlitsɛ tsu ngɛ tso nɔ, loo ngɛ zugba, nɛ lohwe nyɛ ɔ buu si ngɛ e hlui ɔmɛ, aloo e bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, koo nu lohwe nyɛ ɔ. Moo nu bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o ngmɛɛ a nyɛ ɔ he, konɛ níhi a mi nɛ hi ha mo, nɛ o wami se nɛ kɛ, nɛ o plɔke.
“Ke o po we he ɔ, moo hyɛ nɛ o wo o tsu yi bumi ɔ he aklabatsa kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Ke o pee ja a, lɛɛ ke nɔ ko sane kɛ je tsu ɔ yi mi kɛ ba nɔ si nɛ e gbo ɔ, tɔmi ɔ ji mo.
“Ko du nɔ́ kpa ko ngɛ ngmɔ mi he nɛ o du wai ngɛ ɔ; ke o pee ja a, o be he blɔ kaa o yeɔ wai yiblii ɔ, loo nɔ́ kpa a nɛ o du ɔ.
“Ko bla na kɛ teji kɛ wo kuɛpã kake he kɛ hu.
“Koo wo tade nɛ a bla to he bwɔmi, kɛ doti kɛ lo.
“Moo kpɛ deke kɛ wo bo nɛ o haa a nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ he tsɔ we he mlaahi “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ya ngɔ yiheyo ko, nɛ benɛ e kɛ lɛ ya hwɔ ɔ, e sume lɛ hu.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e po sanehi nɛ be mi kɛ fɔ yiheyo ɔ nɔ ke pi yomiyo ji lɛ, ejakaa e nɛ lɛ ngɛ we benɛ e kɛ lɛ ya hwɔ ɔ.
“Ke nɔ́ ko kaa ja ba mi ɔ, yiheyo ɔ fɔli nɛ a ngɔ sa nɔ bo hiɔ kɛ e mi muɔ nɛ ayɛflo ɔ kɛ e huno ɔ hwɔ nɔ kpeemi ligbi ɔ kɛ ya tsɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ kojomi he ɔ. Enɛ ɔ a kɛ maa na anɔkuale ɔ, kaa niinɛ yomiyo ji a bi ɔ nɛ.
Yiheyo ɔ tsɛ ma de nimeli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyumu nɛ ɔ ba bi ye biyo si, nɛ e kɛ lɛ sɛ gba si himi mi; se jehanɛ e sume lɛ hu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e po he guɛ gbemi munyu kɛ fɔ e nɔ ke biyo ɔ pi yomiyo benɛ e ngɔ lɛ ɔ.
Se okadi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa ye biyo ɔ yomiyo ji lɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ Bitsɛ ɔ nɛ bli sa nɔ bo ɔ mi kɛ tsɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a nu yiheyo ɔ huno ɔ, nɛ a fiaa lɛ kpa.
A ma he lɛ sika hiɔ yi lafa, aloo susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ kilo ɔ kake kɛ piɛ he kɛ ha yiheyo ɔ tsɛ ɔ; ejakaa nyumu ɔ wo Israel yomiyo he ní.
Jehanɛ hu a ha nɛ e ngɔ yo ɔ; e be he blɔ kaa e fieɔ lɛ kɛ yaa si e ma gbo.
“Se ke sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ, nɛ okadi nɔ́ ko be nɛ tsɔɔ kaa e huno ɔ na lɛ ngɛ we ɔ, lɛɛ a kɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ ba e tsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ́ e ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a fiaa lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.
E tsu zo ní ngɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kaa e le nyumu be mi nɛ e ngɛ e tsɛ we mi loko a ba ngɔ lɛ.
Pee jã kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
“Ke a nu nyumu ko nɛ e kɛ nɔ kpa e yo ngɛ hwɔe ɔ, á gbe mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Pee jã kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
“Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa a nu nyumu ko nɛ e kɛ yiheyo nɛ a bi e si ha nɔ ko ya na bɔmi ngɛ ma a mi.
A kɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a ya fiaa mɛ tɛ nɛ a gbo.
A gbe yiheyo ɔ, ejakaa ma a mi he nɛ a tsu zo ní nɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kaa e kpa ngmlaa jinɛ ni komɛ maa nu, nɛ a ma ba je ngmlaa ha lɛ.
Nyumu ɔ hu, á gbe lɛ, ejakaa e kɛ yiheyo nɛ nɔ ko bi e si ya na bɔmi.
Pee jã kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
“Se ke nga mi nɛ nyumu ko ya nu yiheyo ko nɛ a bi e si ngɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ á gbe nyumu ɔ pɛ, a ko pee yiheyo ɔ nɔ́ ko, ejakaa e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ.
Munyu nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ko woɔ nɔ ká nɛ e ya gbee lɛ ɔ pɛ.
Nyumu ɔ ya nu yiheyo nɛ a bi e si ɔ ngɛ nga mi, nɛ eko ɔ e kpa ngmlaa lɛɛ, se nɔ ko be nɛ ma ba je ngmlaa ha lɛ.
“Ke nyumu ko na yomiyo nɛ a bi we e si, nɛ e nu lɛ kã nya nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi, nɛ a nu mɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ wo yomiyo ɔ tsɛ ɔ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enuɔ nɛ ji yo se ní ɔ; nɛ a ha nɛ e ngɔ yo ɔ, ejakaa e puɛ lɛ.
E ko ngmɛɛ yo ɔ he kɛ yaa si e ma gbo.
“Nɔ ko kó pue e tsɛ hɛ mi si kaa e kɛ e tsɛ ɔ yo ma na bɔmi.
Nihi nɛ a ko futu Yawɛ ma a “Nyumu nɛ a ta lɛ, loo e sungmɛ ywia, loo a po e nyumu tso ngɛ e he ɔ, e ko futu Yawɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a kpe mi.
“Ke nyumu kɛ yo tsu we gba si himi kusumi, nɛ a fɔ bi ɔ, bi nɛ ɔ be he blɔ nɛ e futuu Yawɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a kpe mi kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ e se kɛ yaa si nyɔngmane ɔ po be he blɔ.
“Amon no, loo Moab no kó futu Yawɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpe mi kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ a se kɛ yaa si nyɔngmane ɔ po be he blɔ.
Benɛ o je Egipt kɛ ma a, mɛ nɛ a kua mo niye ní kɛ nyu hami ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se hu, a ya bɔ Beor bi, Balaam nɛ je Petor ma a mi ngɛ Mesopotamia a apaa ke e ba gbiɛ mo.
Se akɛnɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ suɔ mo he je ɔ, e bui Balaam tue; mohu e plɛ gbiɛmi ɔ kɛ pee gbaami ha mo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi abɔ nɛ o ngɛ je mi nɛ ɔ, koo piɛ a he kɛ tsu nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha nɛ a ma na a he, loo a ma plɔke.
“Koo hie Edom no; ejakaa o nyɛmi ji lɛ.
Koo hie Egipt no; ejakaa o ya hi e zugba a nɔ hyɛ.
Bimɛ nɛ a ma fɔ ha mɛ, kɛ je yi nɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma nyɛ ma futu Yawɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ.
Ta nga nɔ he tsɔmi “Ke o hia ta nɛ o kɛ o he nyɛli yaa kpe ɔ, moo hyɛ saminya nɛ o ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ble mo.
Ke nyumu ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ e he nyu be ngɛ e he nyɔ mi ngɛ e sa mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e he tsɔ we ɔ, é ya ta sito he ɔ se, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. Kɛ yaa gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, e du e he; nɛ ke pu nɔ si ɔ, e kpale kɛ ba ta sito he ɔ.
“Tó he ko ngɛ ta sito he ɔ se, nɛ e pee he nɛ o maa ya nane nɔ ngɛ.
Moo hɛɛ tso kɛ piɛ o ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a he, konɛ ke o mi mi sá mo ɔ, o kɛ tso ɔ nɛ tsua si, nɛ o kɛ tso ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ tsi muɔ ɔ. Ha nɛ o ta sito he ɔ nɛ pee klɔuklɔu; ejakaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ e baa o yi, nɛ o ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
Koo pee afa nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha nɛ Yawɛ maa je o he.
Mlaa munomunohi “Ke nyɔguɛ ko kú kɛ je e nyɔmtsɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ba po mo ɔ, koo kpale lɛ kɛ ya ha e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. É hi o ngɔ ngɛ ma amɛ eko nɛ e suɔ mi kɛkɛ; koo wa lɛ yi mi.
“Ke nyɛ ngɛ Mawu jae ɔ, Israel no ko kó pee e he yaholɔ; nyumu jio, yo jio.
Jehanɛ hu, hiɔ nɛ a woɔ yaholɔ, loo nyumu nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmi nyumu hwɔɔ ɔ, a ko ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa siwo nɔ yemi bɔ.
Yawɛ hiee nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
“Ke o pa sika, loo niye ní, loo nɔ́ kpa ko ngɔ ha o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔ, ko he lɛ hekpa.
Se ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ nɛ pi Israel no ji lɛ ɔ, o ma nyɛ ma he lɛ hekpa.
Ke o ye mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma tsu ngɛ zugba a nɛ o yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ha mo.
“Ke o wo Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ si ɔ, ye nɔ; koo to tsle.
Yawɛ hyɛɛ blɔ kaa o ye o siwo ɔ nɔ; nɛ ke o pee we ja a, e ji tɔmi.
Ke o wui Yawɛ si kulaa a, e pi tɔmi.
Se ke o je mo nitsɛ o tsui mi nɛ o wo si ɔ, ye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
“Ke o ya sɛ o nyɛmi wai ngmɔ mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ye wai yiblii ɔ bɔ nɛ o suɔ nɛ o tɔ; se koo ngɔ eko kɛ wo o níhi a mi kɛ je.
Ke o ya sɛ o nyɛmi ngma ngmɔ mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ku eko nɛ o kpe; se koo dɔ ngma kpami ha ngɔ fɔ o nyɛmi ɔ ngma a nɔ.
Gba mi pomi, kɛ gba mi sɛmi ekohu “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ngɔ yo, nɛ pee se ɔ, e sume lɛ hu; ejakaa e na nɔ́ yayami ko ngɛ yo ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngma gba mi pomi womi nɛ e ngɔ wo e dɛ; nɛ e ha e je e we ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ, waa ngɔ lɛ ekohu kaa yo ɔ ya gba nyumu kpa, nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ hu sume lɛ, nɛ e ngma gba mi pomi womi nɛ e ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ e ha e je e we ɔ mi.
Aloo waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu nɛ e ya gba sekpɛ nɛ ɔ gbo.
Ke e ba mi ja a, nyumu nɛ e kɛ hi si kekleekle ɔ ko kpale ngɔ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ; ejakaa yo ɔ ble e he.
Yawɛ hiɔ kaa e maa kpale ngɔ lɛ ekohu.
Ko tsu musu ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.
Mlaa munomunohi “Ke nyumu ko kpee yo he ɔ, a ko ha nɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ ya ta, nɛ a ko ha lɛ ma ní tsumi ko hu nɛ e tsu.
A ha nɛ e hi si gu jeha kake, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e hi we mi, nɛ e kɛ e yo ɔ tsuo a bua nɛ jɔ a he.
“Ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ ko ɔ, koo ngɔ e wɛ, kɛ e wɛ mi bi nɛ e kɛ gblɛɔ blɛfo ɔ kɛ to awaba.
Ke o pee ja a, níhi nɛ e kɛ ma na e nya mi ngma nɛ o kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ju e nyɛmi Israel no, nɛ e maa pee lɛ nyɔguɛ, aloo e maa jua lɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Ke o ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ko nue ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o pee bɔ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ma de mo ke o pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ. Kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ pee Miriam ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, benɛ nyɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a.
“Ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ ko ɔ, koo nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya e we mi ke e ha mo e bo nɛ e ma kɛ to awaba ha mo ɔ. Dá si ngɛ e we ɔ se, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha mo.
Ke ohiatsɛ ji nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ ba to awaba a, je ko jɔ yi ngɛ o ngɔ.
Daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, kpale kɛ ha lɛ, konɛ e kɛ hwɔ si.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa na mo si, nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ bua maa jɔ o he.
“Koo sisi apaatsɛ ohiatsɛ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ, o nyɛmi Israel no jio, nubwɔ nɛ ngɛ o ma amɛ eko mi jio.
Daa ligbi, loko pu maa nɔ si ɔ, wo lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ he hiɔ.
Sika a he ngɛ lɛ hiae, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ.
Ke o wui lɛ hiɔ ɔ, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a maa bu mo fɔ kaa o pee yayami.
“A ko gbe fɔli ngɛ a bimɛ a tɔmihi a he; nɛ á ko gbe bimɛ hu ngɛ a fɔli a tɔmihi a he.
A gbe nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tɔmi he pɛ.
“Ko plɛ nubwɔ nɛ ba ngɛ o ma a mi, kɛ awusa a sane hɛ mi kɛ bu si; nɛ ko he yalɔyo he ha nɔ́ kaa awaba tomi nɔ́.
Mo kai kaa o ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ha o ye o he, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ mo mlaa nɛ ɔ woe ɔ nɛ.
“Ke o bua o ngmɔ niba ní nya, nɛ e piɛ blɛfo nɛ o kpɔ pue si ɔ eko nɛ o ngɔɛ kɛ bɛ we mi ɔ, koo kpale ya kukuɔ; mo si ha nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi, konɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ gbaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue nɔ ha mo.
Ke o ya kplɔ o we oliv tso ɔmɛ a yiblii ɔ, koo kpale o se kɛ ya tso kɔni ɔmɛ nɛ o kpa ni ngɛ a nɔ mo ɔ a he ekohu.
Ha nɛ nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ hi si ha nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi.
Ke o bua o wai yiblii ɔmɛ a nya si kake ɔ, koo kpale o se nɛ o ya bua nya si enyɔne ngɛ he kake ɔ kɛ̃; si wai yiblii nɛ piɛ ɔ ha nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi.
O hɛ ko je nɔ gblegbleegble kaa o ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i wo mo mlaa nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa Israel bi enyɔ ngɛ pɛe, nɛ a ba kojomi he ɔ, konɛ a hyɛ a sane ɔ mi ha mɛ.
Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ dɛ ɔ, á bu lɛ fɔ; nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da a, á wo lɛ nguɔ.
Ke nɔ nɛ ye fɔ ɔ sa kpa a, kojolɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɛ a bu lɛ si, nɛ á fia lɛ kpa.
Kpa abɔ nɛ a maa fia lɛ ɔ maa je bɔ nɛ e tɔmi ɔ kle ha.
A ko fia nɔ kpa nɛ pe si nyingmi eywiɛ; ke e pe ja a, lɛɛ o pue o nyɛmi ɔ hɛ mi si ngɛ ma hɛ mi.
“Na nɛ ngɛ ngma gblɛe ha mo ɔ, koo fi e nya.
Nyɛminyumu nɛ gbo e yalɔyo ngɔmi “Ke nyɛminyumuhi enyɔ hi si, nɛ a ti nɔ kake gbo nɛ e be bi nyumu ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ yo ɔ ko ya gba nɔ ko ngɛ weku kpa mi; e ji e huno ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔ blɔ nya kaa e ngɔ lɛ.
Kekleekle binyumu nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ, é ye nyɛminyumu nɛ gbo ɔ nane mi, konɛ e biɛ ko laa ngɛ Israel.
Se ke nyumu ɔ sume kaa e maa ngɔ e nyɛminyumu ɔ yalɔyo ɔ, lɛɛ yo ɔ nɛ e ya ma agbo ɔ nya, nɛ ya de ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ye huno ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔ kplɛɛ we kaa e ma tsu e blɔ nya ní: e sume kaa e ma ha e nyɛminyumu ɔ ma na ngmɛdu ngɛ Israel.’ Ke e ba mi ja a, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ nyumu ɔ, nɛ á tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ.
Ke e ma nɔ mi kaa e be yo ɔ ngɔe ɔ, lɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ yalɔyo ɔ nɛ ya nyumu ɔ ngɔ ngɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
A je nyumu ɔ tokota kake ngɛ e nane, nɛ e su lada kɛ pue nyumu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ é de ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ nɔ nɛ sume nɛ e wo nina ha e nyɛminyumu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ Biɛ nɛ a ma kɛ tsɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ weku ngɛ Israel ji, ‘Nɔ nɛ a je e tokota ngɛ e nane ɔ weku.’ Mlaa kpahi “Ke nyumuhi enyɔ ngɛ kunɔ nɔe, nɛ nɔ kake e yo ba piɛ e huno ɔ he, nɛ e nu nɔ kpa a nyumu tso kɛ e sungmɛ ɔ, poo yo ɔ nine; koo na lɛ mɔbɔ kulaa.
- “Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ jiimi ngmɛe, loo o ngɛ nɔ́ kami susue ɔ, koo sisi nɔ.
O sɛni tɛhi, kɛ susumi kpa tsuo nɛ su pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ sume nihi nɛ sisiɔ nɔ.
A fa ke á gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ “Mo kai nɔ́ nɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ pee mo ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, benɛ o je Egipt kɛ ma a. Akɛnɛ a yi Mawu gbeye he je ɔ, a tua o se ta a, benɛ pɔ tɔ ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ peepee ta a he ɔ; nɛ a gbe ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ didaae ngɛ se ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha mo, nɛ e je mo kɛ je o he nyɛli tsuo nɛ bɔle mo kɛ kpe ɔ a dɛ mi ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko kó kai mɛ hu.
O hɛ ko je nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!
Ngmakpami be bɔ sami “Ke e ba mi kaa o ya su zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e pee o nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ kekleekle niba ní nɛ e kpa ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ eko kɛ wo kusii mi, nɛ é ngɔ kɛ ya he nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ngɔɔ kɛ ya osɔfo nɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe jamɛ a be ɔ ngɔ, nɛ o de lɛ ke, ‘Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i ngɛ odase yee ngɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi kaa i ba su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo wa nɛmɛ si ke e kɛ ma ha wɔ ɔ nɔ.’ “Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ he kusii ɔ ngɛ o dɛ kɛ ma Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Mo de ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ke, ‘Aram no si kpalɔ ji ye nɛ̃.
E kɛ nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ ho Egipt ya; e ya to nubwɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se a ba pee ma agbo nɛ he wa saminya.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ pee wɔ yayami; a wa wɔ yi mi, nɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ wa fa kue kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, nɛ e bu wa gbi tue.
E na wa haomi kɛ dengme gbomi, kɛ yi mi nɛ a ngɛ wɔ wae ɔ. Yawɛ ngɔ e he wami kɛ kɔni si wami nɛ ngɛ gbeye kɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt.
E pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi babauu.
Jehanɛ, e kɛ wɔ ba su hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha wɔ zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ zugba nɛ mo, Yawɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ mi kekleekle niba ní ɔ eko kɛ ba.’ “Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ kusii ɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ o ja Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mo nya ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ Yawɛ ha o kɛ o we ɔ he.
Ha nɛ Levi no, kɛ nubwɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ nɛ a piɛ o he kɛ nya.
“Jeha etɛ tsuaa jeha etɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ o niba ní mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ ha Levi bi, nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi, konɛ mɛ tsuo a na niye ní nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ ngɛ ma a mi he tsuaa he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, de Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ke, ‘I je ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je ye we ɔ mi, nɛ i ngɔ ha Levi bi, nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi ngɛ mlaa nɛ o wo mi ɔ nya; i tɔ̃ we ekoeko, nɛ ye hɛ ji eko nɔ hulɔ.
Benɛ i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ, i yi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ eko; benɛ ye he tsɔ we ɔ, i ngɔɛ eko kɛ ji ye we ɔ mi; jehanɛ hu, i kɛ eko sɛ̃ bɔ ha gbogboe ko.
Niinɛ, Yawɛ, ye Mawu, i bu mo tue.
Mlaahi tsuo nɛ o wo mi nɛ kɔɔ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ he ɔ, i ye nɔ.
Moo je o hi he klɔuklɔu ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ o hyɛ, nɛ o gbaa o ma Israel.
Moo gbaa zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ o ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ.’ Yawɛ nitsɛ e ma “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo fae ke o ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ o tsui tsuo.
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, e je o nya mi nɛ o de ke Yawɛ ji o Mawu.
O wo si kaa o maa bu lɛ tue; o wo si kaa o maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ; nɛ o wo si hu kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa mo ke o pee ɔ, o maa pee.
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hu he mo atuu kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. E ngɛ mo fae ke o ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ.
E ma ha nɛ o pee ma ngua a pe ma amɛ tsuo.
O ma je e yi, nɛ o maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Nɛ o maa pee lɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nitsɛ, e ma kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ.”
A ngma Mawu mlaa amɛ ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ Jehanɛ, Mose kɛ Israel ma a tu munyu, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo fi e se.
Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu níhi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ tue.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a kɛ ya su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛ agboagbohi kɛ ma si, nɛ nyɛ kpa a he kalo.
Ke nyɛ po pa a pɛ, nyɛɛ ngma mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Zugba nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ wo si ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ pa a se ɔ, zugba a hi, nɛ e baa ní saminya.
Ke nyɛ su zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si ngɛ Ebal yo ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ fae mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa a he kalo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kó we nɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ maa ma bɔ sami la tɛ ko ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kó we nɛ ma.
Nyɛɛ sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ hu, nyɛɛ sã nyɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ bla nyɛɛ ye ní.
Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ngma mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ kalo kpa a he ɔ a nɔ; nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ ningma a nɛ je si paa.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ pee dii nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Israel bi, mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ pee Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ.” Tue gbomi kɛ e he gbiɛmi Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Mose de Israel ma a ke, “Ke nyɛ po Yordan pa a, wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a da si ngɛ Gerizim yo ɔ nɔ benɛ a ngɛ ma a gbaae: Simeon, Levi, Yuda, Isakar, Yosef, kɛ Benyamin.
Wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a da si ngɛ Ebal yo ɔ nɔ benɛ a ngɛ gbiɛmi munyu ɔmɛ dee: Ruben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, kɛ Naftali.
Levi bi ɔmɛ ma wo a gbi nɔ, nɛ a ma de Israel ma a tsuo ke, “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ tɛ, loo tso, loo dade kɛ peeɔ amaga ko, nɛ e jaa lɛ ngɛ laami mi.
Yawɛ hiɔ wɔ jami.’ Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pueɔ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ hɛ mi si.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛ̃ɛ̃ e nyɛmi buna kɛ yaa se.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ yayami.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ plɛɔ nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi a sane hɛ mi buɔ si.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ e tsɛ yo naa bɔmi nɛ e kɛ pueɔ e tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi si.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ lohwe naa bɔmi.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmiyo, e tsɛbiyo jio, e nyɛbiyo jio naa bɔmi.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ e nganyɛ naa bɔmi.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbee e nyɛmi ngɛ laami mi.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní, nɛ e kɛ pueɔ nɔ ko nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko muɔ si.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’ “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui Mawu mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e yi a nɔ hulɔ.’ “Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
Tue bumi kɛ e he gbaami “Ke nyɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ma wo nyɛ nɔ gojoo pe je ma amɛ tsuo.
Nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, konɛ gbaami nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nyɛ nɔ́.
“Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ ma amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ.
“Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu; nyɛ zugba a maa ba ní, nɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi, nɛ ji nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ nyɛ to ɔmɛ hu maa bɔ.
“Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ niba ní, kɛ niye ní nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kɛ jeɔ mi ɔ.
“Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ, nyɛ ba we mi jio, nyɛ hia blɔ jio.
“Yawɛ maa ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ maa te si kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Ke a gu he kake kɛ ba tua nyɛ ɔ, a maa gu he slɔɔto kpaago kɛ gbɛ fĩa.
“Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nyɛ ní tsumi nɔ, nɛ nyɛ gba amɛ ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
E maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ e kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ.
“Ke nyɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛ woe ɔ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, e maa pee nyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. Lɔ ɔ loko je ma amɛ tsuo maa na kaa Yawɛ hla nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ gbeye.
Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ bimɛ, we mi lohwehi, kɛ ngmɔ niba ní babauu ngɛ zugba nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e maa ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ e be mi; e maa gbaa nyɛ ní tsumi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mahi babauu ma ba pa ní ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e be nyɛ hiae kaa nyɛ ya pa nɔ́ ko ngɛ ma ko ma ko dɛ.
Yawɛ maa pee nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ; ma amɛ maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se; pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ maa hi se.
Ke nyɛ maa bu Mawu mlaa amɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ fae mwɔnɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ maa ya nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, nɛ nyɛ be se yae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Nyɛ ko kpale kɛ je mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a he kɔkɔɔkɔ; nyɛ ko ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ nyɛ ko sɔmɔ mɛ hulɔ.
Tue gbomi kɛ e se sane “Se ke nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ yi e fami ɔmɛ, kɛ e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ nɔ.
“Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ ma amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ.
“Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ niba ní, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa pee niye ní kɛ je mi.
“Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ bimɛ, nɛ a he be hiɛe.
E maa gbiɛ nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ; a be bɔe, nɛ nyɛ zugba a hu ma gbo; nyɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nae ngɛ mi.
“Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ, nyɛ ba we mi jio, nyɛ hia blɔ jio.
“Ke nyɛ kua Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya pee yayami ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ: nyɛ ma didaa; nyɛ maa pee basaa, nɛ nyɛ maa bɔ ahlua ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma tsu mi.
E ma tsa nɔ ja kɛ yaa si nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa.
Yawɛ ma ha hiɔ nɛ gbee nɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ nɔtonɔto kɛ yaa si e ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ ma ha hiɔ nɛ sãã nɔ kaa gugue hiɔ maa ba; e ma ha nɛ aslã kɛ fuumi hiɔ maa ba.
Jehanɛ, nyu hwɔ maa ye, pu maa tso, nɛ je mi maa dɔ la wawɛɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngmɔ mi níhi a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Haomi nɛ ɔmɛ be tae kɛ yaa si nyɛ gbenɔ be.
Hiɔmi be nɛe, nɛ zugba a he maa wa kaa dade.
Yawɛ ma ha bunyuku, kɛ zia maa je hiɔwe kɛ ba pue nyɛ nɔ kɛ yaa si nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
“Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa ye nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ maa gu he kake kɛ ya tua mɛ, se a maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa basaa, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye gbeye ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ he.
Ke nyɛ gbo ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ma ba ye nyɛ, nɛ a be nɔ ko nae nɛ maa fie mɛ ngɛ nyɛ gbogboe ɔ he.
Yawɛ ma ha tslɔɔ maa fuu nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Egipt bi ɔmɛ ɔ. Nyɛ maa hia pa, nɛ sakpa kɛ ngmo nɛ be tsa ba ma pue nyɛ nɔ.
Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ maa fo godo, nyɛ hɛngmɛhi ma yu, nɛ nyɛ juɛmi maa pee basaa.
Nyɛ maa hi si tataae piani katakata kaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, nɛ nyɛ be blɔ nae.
Nyɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɔ yae?
A maa wa nyɛ yi mi, nɛ a maa fia nyɛ ojo be tsuaa be; se nyɛ be nɔ ko nae nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha nyɛ.
“Nyɛ ma bi yo si, se nyumu kpa maa ngɔ lɛ; nyɛ maa ma tsu, se nyɛ be mi hie; nyɛ ma hu wai ngmɔ, se nyɛ be e mi wai yiblii ɔ eko yee.
A maa gbe nyɛ na ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi paa, se nyɛ be e lo ɔ eko nae maa ye.
Nyɛ hɛ mi paa nɛ a ma kpɔ̃ nyɛ tejihi pani nya kɛ je kɛ ho, nɛ a be kpalee kɛ ba ha nyɛ hu.
A maa ngɔ nyɛ tohi kɛ ha nyɛ he nyɛli, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ngmlaa jee ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ mi paa nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ kɛ ha ma je li.
Daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛ maa hi nyɛ bimɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ kaa a maa kpale kɛ ba lo, se lɛ tsuo maa pee yaka.
Nyɛ zugba a nɔ niba ní nɛ nyɛ gbo he dengme ɔ hu, je ma ko nɛ nyɛ li ma ba ye lɛ tsuo; nyɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nae, se a maa wa nyɛ yi mi, nɛ a maa pee nyɛ posoo kaa zugba zu.
Hɛdo ní nɛ nyɛ maa na a, ma ha nyɛ maa fo godo.
Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ maa hia pa yeyee nɛ be tsa ba ngɛ nyɛ nane he.
Tslɔɔ maa fuu nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ yi mi kɛ ya si nyɛ nane si.
“Yawɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ, kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ya ma se he nɛ nyɛ li, he nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ tete hí hyɛ; nyɛ ma ya sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso kɛ tɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma amɛ, he nɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya a, a mi bi ɔmɛ maa ye gbeye ngɛ nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ he; a maa muɔ nyɛ, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu.
“Nyɛ ma du ní babauu ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ mi, se ní bɔɔ pɛ nyɛ ma kpa; ejakaa baalɛ maa ye nyɛ niba ní ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma gbo dengme kɛ hyɛ nɔ saminya, se nyɛ be wai yiblii ɔ kpae, nɛ nyɛ be wai ɔ hu eko nae maa nu; ejakaa gɔgɔ maa ye wai tso ɔmɛ.
Oliv tsohi maa puɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ he tsuaa he, se nyɛ be nu ɔ eko nae; ejakaa oliv tso ɔmɛ a yiblii ɔ ma kplɔ pue si.
Nyɛ ma fɔ binyumuhi kɛ yihi lɛɛ, se a be nyɛ bimɛ pee; ejakaa a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ta mi kɛ je.
Baalɛ maa sɛ nyɛ tso ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a ma puɛ niba ní ɔmɛ.
“Jehanɛ, nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa ya nɔ ma plɔke; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ si kɛkɛ nyɛ maa hi gbee.
A ma na ní, nɛ a maa pa nyɛ eko, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be ní nae nɛ nyɛ maa pa mɛ eko.
Nyagbe mi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa ye nyɛ nɔ.
“Haomi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ e ma tsa nɔ jã kɛ̃ kɛ yaa su be nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ; ejakaa nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ yi e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Haomi ɔmɛ maa pee okadi, kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yawɛ gbaa nyɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ, se nyɛ sume nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami nɛ je tsui mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ma sɔmɔ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ a te si kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ. Hwɔ kɛ kuma maa ye nyɛ; nyɛ maa hɛɛ nyɛ he gu, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hia nyɛ.
Nyɛ he nyɛli maa wa nyɛ yi mi wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Yawɛ ma ha je ma ko nɛ nyɛ nui a gbi maa je zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ nyɛ ba hwu.
A ma ba tua nyɛ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ kɔle gblɔɔ nɔ́ ɔ. Ma nɛ ɔ yi mi maa wa; a be nɔkɔtɔma bue, nɛ jokuɛyo hu a be lɛ mɔbɔ nae.
A maa ye nyɛ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ tsuo; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma gbo kɛ hwɔ.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ be ngma, loo wai, loo nu, loo na, loo to piɛe ha nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ ma gbo.
A ma ba tua nyɛ ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ, hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ gbogbo gojogojoo ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ tsuo maa hule pue si.
“Ke nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a yi sae, nɛ nyɛ yi fi, nɛ hwɔ bɔni nyɛ yemi wawɛɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ye nyɛ nitsɛ nyɛ mi mi bimɛ nɛ ji nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a lo.
-Ke a ba sá ma a yi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyumu nɛ ji odehe mi odehe nɛ mi mi jɔ po yi ma fi, nɛ e maa ye lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ; ejakaa e nɛ niye ní kpa ko.
E be e nyɛminyumu, loo lɛ nitsɛ e yo nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya, loo e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lo ɔ eko hae.
- Yo odehe mi odehe nɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ e hia we lɛ kaa e nyɛɛ kɛ ya he ko po maa pee jã kɛ̃.
