Ke he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba sá ma a yi ɔ, lɛ hu e yi ma fi ngɛ niye ní blɔ fa mi; e maa ye bimwɔyo he nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e fɔ ɔ ngɛ laami mi, nɛ e maa ye fɔmi se ɔ hulɔ.
Lɛ nɔ kake e maa laa maa ye, nɛ e be e huno nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a, loo e bimɛ ɔmɛ eko hae.
“Ke nyɛ bui Mawu tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ́ nyɛ pee bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ wui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ biɛ nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ kɛ gbeye ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, e ma ha hiɔhi nɛ be tsa ba, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nya nyɛe maa tsi maa nu nyɛɛ, kɛ nyɛ nina tsuo.
E ma ha haomihi nɛ ngɛ gbeye nɛ ba ngɛ Egipt ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛ zu nɔ bae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Jehanɛ, e ma ha hiɔ munomunohi, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ yayamihi nɛ a wui a nɔ ta ngɛ Mawu womi ɔ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ, kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ ma ba fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe lɛɛ, se nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami; ejakaa nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ bua jɔ nyɛ he, nɛ e ha nyɛ plɔke, nɛ nyɛ he hiɛ babauu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e bua maa jɔ e he, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
A maa fie nyɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.
“Yawɛ maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ tsuo a mi, kɛ maa je je ɔ nyagbe he kake kɛ maa ya nyagbe he kake, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso kɛ tɛ pee, mawuhi nɛ nyɛ, loo nyɛ nɛmɛ ja we hyɛ.
Nyɛ be tue mi jɔmi nae ngɛ he ko he ko; he ko be nɛ nyɛ ma tsɛ ke nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ́; Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ tsui maa hi poe; nyɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi maa ta, nɛ nyɛ nine mi maa je wu.
Daa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi gbenɔ muɔ nya.
Nyɛ tsui maa hi poe nyɔ kɛ pia; e maa pee nyɛ kaa nyɛ ma gbo tlukaa.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ maa na a maa wo nyɛ he gbeye, nɛ nyɛ tsui maa po.
E ngɛ mi kaa Yawɛ de ke nyɛ be kpalee kɛ ya Egipt gblegbleegble lɛɛ, se e maa wo nyɛ lɛ, nɛ e maa kpale nyɛ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ma hla kaa nyɛ maa jua nyɛ he kaa nyɔguɛ ha nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se a be nɔ ko nae nɛ ma he nyɛ.”
Yawɛ kɛ Israel so ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ Somi nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a so ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ mi munyu komɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
E slo somi nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ kɛ Israel ma a so ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ɔ. Mose tsɛ Israel ma a tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee Egipt matsɛ ɔ, e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ e zugba a tsuo.
Nyɛ na gbenɔ hiɔ gbeyegbeye ɔmɛ, okadi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyakpɛ ní nguangua amɛ nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ.
Se kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, e ha we nɛ nyɛɛ nu níhi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kpe ɔ a sisi lolo.
Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu Yawɛ kpaka nyɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ; nyɛ heha ní gba we ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ tokota amɛ hu tsɔ we.
Nyɛ na we abolo nɛ nyɛɛ ye, nɛ nyɛ na we wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa ko nɛ nyɛɛ nu; se Yawɛ ha nyɛ nyɛ hiami ní ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa lɛ ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, benɛ wa ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon, kɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og hia ta kɛ kpee wɔ.
Se wa ye a nɔ, nɛ wa ngɔ a zugba a, nɛ wa dla mi ngɔ ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye somi ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ ye manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa pee mi.
“Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
Nyɛ, nyɛ ma nimeli, tsɔli, nyumuhi, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ nyɛ nibwɔhi nɛ gbaa lɛ́, nɛ a yaa pa ha nyɛ ɔ tsuo ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ fua ngɔ fɔ somi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ soe ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pɛtɛ níhi nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ tsu ngɛ mi ɔ a he.
Nyɛ ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee konɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛ da si kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma, nɛ e pee nyɛ Mawu, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ɔ. Somi nɛ ɔ, pi nyɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ soe, nɛ e mi ní tsumi ɔmɛ hu, pi nyɛ kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɛ kɛ ha.
Se e kɛ wɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ soe ɔ nɛ; wɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi mwɔnɛ ɔ, kɛ wa nina nɛ a fɔ we mɛ lolo ɔ tsuo.
“Nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ wa hi Egipt zugba a nɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ wa nyɛɛ kɛ gu je ma amɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛ na a musu ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ, amagahi nɛ a kɛ tso, kɛ tɛ, kɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ. Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ se kɛ ya ja ma je li a mawu ɔmɛ, nyumu jio, yo jio, weku jio, wɛtso jio.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa tso sipoku nɛ maa wa, nɛ maa ngɔ e duɔ kɛ gbla haomi kɛ ba nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ somi munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nue mwɔnɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó mlɔɔ e he kaa ke e pee lɛ nitsɛ e tsui wami nya ní ɔ, e maa hi ha lɛ ligbi ko.
Ke nɔ ko pee ja a, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata, nɔ kpakpa, kɛ nɔ yayami tsuo nɛ slɔɔto ko be mi.
Yawɛ be nɔ nɛ tue wa nɛ ɔ he yayami ngɔe kɛ pa lɛ.
Niinɛ, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ kɛ wo lɛ, nɛ gbiɛmihi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ maa ba e nɔ kɛ yaa si Yawɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi kulaa kɛ pi si.
Yawɛ ma je e hɛ kɛ pi lɛ, nɛ e maa gbla e tue.
Gbiɛmihi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ Yawɛ mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a to kɛ ha nihi nɛ ma tɔ̃ somi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ maa ba e nɔ.
“Hwɔɔ se yi nɔ bi nɛ ji nyɛ nina, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ je ma se zugbahi a nɔ tsuo maa na haomihi, kɛ amanehluhi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ba nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.
La zu, kɛ ngo maa ha ngmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hie dumi ngɛ nɔ hu, nɛ nga po be puɛe ngɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ zugba a maa pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ Adma kɛ Zeboiim nɛ Yawɛ kpata a hɛ mi benɛ e mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, je ɔ tsuo ma bi si ke, ‘Mɛni he je nɛ Yawɛ pee e zugba a kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je e mi mi fu wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?’ Heto nɛ a ma na ji, ‘Nɔ́ he je nɛ e ba ja a ji kaa Yawɛ ma a yi somi nɛ a kɛ lɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ so ɔ nɔ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ.
A ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi nɛ a ja we hyɛ, mawuhi nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ mlaa ke a ko ja kɔkɔɔkɔ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu e ma a, nɛ e kɛ haomi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ mi mi wo la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e kɛ mi mi la nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ hia mɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e sake mɛ ngɔ pue ma se zugba ko nɔ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.’ “Laami ní komɛ ngɛ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ je we kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ, se e je e mlaa a kpo ngɔ ha wɔ kɛ wa nina, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ye nɔ kɛ ya neneene.
Wami, loo gbenɔ “Jehanɛ, i ngɔ gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi ngɔ pue nyɛ hɛ mi, nɛ́ nyɛɛ hla mi nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ.
Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya je ma je li a kpɛti, he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, nyɛ ma kai níhi nɛ i ngɔ pue nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ. Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa je nyɛ tsui mi tsuo kɛ bu e gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ.
E maa kpale nyɛ kɛ je ma je li ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, he nɛ e gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a; nɛ e ma ha nyɛ ma na ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu.
Ke kaa je ɔ nyagbe he tɔɔ po nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, e ma bua nyɛ nya, nɛ e maa kpale nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛ ba ngɔ zugba a he nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi ɔ, nɛ e pee nyɛ nɔ́ ekohu.
Jehanɛ, e ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma na ní, nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ babauu pe nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ po.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina tsui kpakpa nɛ buɔ tue, konɛ nyɛɛ suɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, nɛ nyɛɛ hi jamɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ he nyɛli nɛ sume nyɛ, nɛ a waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ a nɔ.
Nyɛ maa bu Yawɛ tue ekohu, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ye manye ngɛ nyɛ nine nya ní tsumihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ mi.
Nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi maa hiɛ babauu, nɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ maa ba ní saminya.
Yawɛ bua maa jɔ nyɛ he, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ ma plɔke kaa bɔ nɛ e pee nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ hia ji kaa nyɛ maa bu e gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ.
E hia kaa nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.
“Mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, a he wɛ tsɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e be tsitsaa he ko hulɔ.
E be hiɔwe, nɛ́ nyɛ ma bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ maa kuɔ kɛ ya nɛ e ya ngɔ kɛ ba ha wɔ, konɛ waa nu nɛ waa ye nɔ?’ E be wo se hulɔ nɛ nyɛ ma bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ maa po wo, nɛ e ya ngɔ kɛ ba, konɛ waa nu, nɛ waa ye nɔ?’ Dɛbi, e ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ le, nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ma de, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, ye nɔ.
“Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i ngɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami ngɔ fɔ nyɛ hɛ mi; nyɛɛ ngɔ wami, aloo gbenɔ.
Ke nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ maa nyɛɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ yi ma na wami, nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ; Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.
Se, ke nyɛ gbo tue, nɛ nyɛ ha a mlɔɔ nyɛ kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi ɔ, lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee mwɔnɛ ɔ ke ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
Zugba nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a se nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ se be kɛe ngɛ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ wami kɛ gbenɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe; i ngɔ Mawu gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi hu kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe; nɛ i ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba odase tsɛe ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa hla a he.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ wami.
Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ pee e suɔmi nya ní pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, zugba a nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke e kɛ ma ha mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa hi nɔ.”
Yoshua ba ye Mose se Mose tsa e munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de Israel ma a ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ, nɛ i be nyɛe ma pee nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ hu.
Jehanɛ hu, Yawɛ de mi ke, i be Yordan pa a poe.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kpaka nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpata ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a hɛ mi, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ zugba a; nɛ Yoshua maa pee nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ. Yawɛ maa pee je ma amɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Amor matsɛmɛ, Sihon kɛ Og, kɛ a zugba a; e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Yawɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ́ nyɛɛ pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛ he nɛ wa nɛ nyɛɛ pee kã.
Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
E be nyɛ sie, nɛ e be nyɛ kuae hulɔ.” Jehanɛ, Mose tsɛ Yoshua nɛ e de lɛ ngɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi ke, “O he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã; mo ji nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo a nɛmɛ si ke e kɛ ma ha mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kpaka mo, nɛ e kɛ mo maa hi si.
E be mo sie, nɛ e be mo kuae hulɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo nu sawale; nɛ koo ye gbeye.” A kane mlaa a daa jeha kpaago Mose ngma Mawu mlaa a ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ somi daka a nɔ ɔ, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo.
E fa mɛ ke, “Daa jeha kpaagone ɔ, ke e su be nɛ a kɛ hiɔhi maa ke ɔ, nyɛɛ kane mlaa nɛ ɔ wawɛɛ nɛ a nu ngɛ Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ. Ke Israel ma a tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ a to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kane mlaa nɛ ɔ nɛ a nu.
Moo kpee Israel ma a tsuo kɛ ba: nyumuhi, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba nu, nɛ e wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami; nɛ a ye mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ke e pee ja a, nyɛ bimɛ nɛ nui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa a hyɛ ɔ maa nu, nɛ a maa bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nɛ a maa ye lɛ gbeye a wami ligbi tsuo nɛ́ a maa hi zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ nɔ.” Nyagbe munyu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “O gbenɔ be su ta.
Mo tsɛ Yoshua nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ ma tsɔɔ lɛ bɔ nɛ e pee.” Mose kɛ Yoshua ya bo tsu ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ bɔku titima nɛ ba da bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a mi.
Yawɛ de Mose ke, “E be kɛe nɛ o ma gbo; nɛ o gbenɔ se ɔ, Israel ma a be mi anɔkuale yee hu; a be somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ nɔ yee.
A maa je ye se ya ja ma se mawuhi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ he nɛ a yaa a. Ke e ba mi ja a, ye mi mi ma fu.
I ma kua mɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Haomihi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye maa ba a nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko a ma kpa si kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a nɔ bae, ejakaa imi a Mawu ɔ, i kua mɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i be a he piɛe hu; ejakaa a pee yayami kaa a ya ja mawu kpahi.
“Jehanɛ, ngmaa la nɛ ɔ, nɛ o tsɔɔ Israel ma a, konɛ e pee odase kɛ si mɛ.
I ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ya zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ.
A ma na niye ní bɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A maa ye ní nɛ a maa tɔ, nɛ a ma na bua jɔmi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a maa je ye se kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi.
A ma kua mi, nɛ a be somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ nɔ yee, nɛ haomi gbeyegbeye babauu maa ba a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a maa hi la nɛ ɔ lae, nɛ e maa pee odase kɛ si mɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po nɛ i kɛ mɛ sui zugba nɛ i wo si ke ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ lolo ɔ, i le a yi mi.” Mose ngma la a, nɛ e tsɔɔ Israel ma a jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ to Nun bi Yoshua si, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Pee kã, nɛ o he nɛ wa.
Mo nɛ o ma kpaka Israel ma a kɛ ya zugba a nɛ i wo mɛ e he si ɔ nɔ.
I kɛ mo maa hi si.” Mose ngma Mawu mlaa a fitsofitso kɛ wo womi ko mi; e si we nɔ́ ko.
Benɛ e gbe nya a, e de Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ Yawɛ somi daka a nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu mlaa womi nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ to Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ somi daka a kasa nya, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ye odase kɛ si ma a. I le kaa a kuɛ wa, nɛ a tsɔɔ atuã.
Be mi nɛ i ngɛ je mi ɔ, a tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã, nɛ ke i gbo lɛɛ kɛ e ma ba hi kɛɛ?
Nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ ba, konɛ ma de mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
I ma tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba nɛ a ye odase kɛ si mɛ.
I le paa kaa ye gbenɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ma puɛ nyɛ he kulaa, nɛ nyɛ maa je blɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ nyɛ maa na amanehlu; ejakaa nyɛ maa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Nyɛ ní peepee maa wo e mi mi la.” Mose la a Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kane la a mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo a bu tue kɛ ya si nyagbe:
“Hiɔwe kɛ zugba lee, nyɛ ba bu mi tue; nyɛ ba bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue saminya.
Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ní kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ blɛuu kɛ pueɔ zugba nɔ nɛ e peeɔ kaa bɔ́ ɔ. Ma tu nyɛ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi fĩaa kɛ pueɔ tso bihi a nɔ, aloo kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ blɛuu kɛ pueɔ nga nɔ ɔ. Ma wo Yawɛ biɛ ta kɛ je e yi, nɛ e ma a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
“Yawɛ ji nyɛ yi baalɔ nɛ se be; e hi kɛ pi si, nɛ e da ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ Mawu ɔ yeɔ e siwo nɔ; yayami ko be e he; nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa pɛ e peeɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ yi nyɛ siwo nɔ, nɛ nyɛ sɛ kulaa kaa nyɛ peeɔ e ma.
Ma nɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ sisiɔ nɔ ji nyɛ.
Bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ peeɔ Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo, ma kuasia nɛ be juɛmi?
Lɛ ji nyɛ tsɛ kɛ nyɛ bɔlɔ; lɛ nɛ e ha nyɛ pee e ma.
“Nyɛ susu blema lokoo ɔ he; nyɛ bi nyɛ nɛmɛ, kɛ nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a gba nyɛ blema sane.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ, nɔ nɛ dla zugba a ha je ma amɛ, nɛ e to ma tsuaa ma hi he ɔ, lɛ nɛ e ha je ma tsuaa je ma e mawu.
Se Yakob nina lɛɛ, Yawɛ hla lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
“E na lɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ, he nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be.
E bu e he, nɛ e hyɛ e nɔ saminya kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ hyɛɛ e bi kpakpa nɛ e suɔ lɛ nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ kɔle buu e tsu he, nɛ e tee kɛ bɔleɔ e bimɛ, nɛ e bliɔ e pɛli mi, nɛ e ngɔɔ e bimɛ ngɔ fɔɔ nɔ kɛ tee kɛ yaa hiɔwe ɔ, ja Yawɛ hɛɛ Israel.
Yawɛ, lɛ nɔ kake lɛ e kpaka e ma a; ma se mawu ko piɛ we e he.
“E ha e ma a ye yo nɔ zugba amɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ye ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi niba ní.
E ma a ná hwo kɛ je tɛ sa mi; nɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ hu plɔke ngɛ zugba nɛ tɛ ngɛ mi ɔ nɔ.
Na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ ha nyɔ nyu babauu; e ha ma a jijɔ, apletsi, kɛ na kpakpahi; a ye ní kpakpa, nɛ a nu dã kpakpa.
“Yawɛ ma a na ní kpɔtɔɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɔ atuã; a ye ní kpakpa nɛ a tɔ saminya.
Se a je Mawu nɛ ji a bɔlɔ ɔ he, nɛ a kua a yi wami helɔ nɛ se be ɔ.
A kɛ mawuhi nɛ a li ye e tsui, nɛ a ngɔ ní hiemi nihi kɛ wo e mi mi la.
Ma a sã bɔ kɛ ha mumi yayamihi, kɛ mawuhi nɛ a he be se nami, mawuhi nɛ a nɛmɛ po li, mawuhi nɛ Israel sɔmɔ we hyɛ.
A Mawu ɔ nɛ baa a yi, nɛ́ he a yi wami ɔ, a hɛ je a nɔ.
“Benɛ Yawɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e mi mi wo la, nɛ e kua e ma a; ejakaa a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ wo e mi mi la.
E de ke, ‘Jehanɛ, i be a he piɛe hu; ma hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ; nihi nɛ a tue mi ti, nɛ a yi a siwo nɔ.
A kɛ a we amagahi wo ye mi mi la.
A kɛ a yaka mawu ɔmɛ ye ye tsui.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ ma gu ko kɛ wo a mi mi la; ma ngɔ ma kɛ e mi kuasiahi sɔuu kɛ ye a tsui.
Ye mi mi fumi nya maa wa wawɛɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe; e maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je ɔ mi kɛ ya su gbeje tɔɔ; e maa sã yo ɔmɛ a sisi tomi ɔmɛ hulɔ.
“ ‘Ma ha haomihi maa ba a nɔ nɔtonɔto; ma tsɛ̃ mɛ ye kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Hwɔ kɛ aslã maa gbe mɛ, nɛ hiɔhi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Ma ha nga mi lohwe awi yeli ma ba tua mɛ, nɛ sinɔ duɔtsɛmɛ maa kɔɔ mɛ.
Ta ma kpata nihi a hɛ mi ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ sawale maa nu nihi ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi.
Nihewi kɛ yihewi ma gbo; bimwɔwi kɛ nyumu nikɔtɔmahi hu be a he yee.
Jinɛ i ko kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ kaie hu.
Se i be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a fĩa ke mɛ lɛ a ye ye ma a nɔ, be mi nɛ imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ i kpata a hɛ mi.’ “Ma ko nɛ be juɛmi ji Israel; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
A nyɛ we nɛ a na nɔ́ he je nɛ a ye a nɔ ɔ; a nui nɔ́ nɛ ba a sisi.
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nɔ kake maa fie nihi akpe?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nihi enyɔ pɛ maa wo nihi akpe nyɔngma fo?
Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kua mɛ; a Mawu ngua a ngmɛɛ a he.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ le kaa a mawu ɔmɛ be he wami ko kaa Israel Mawu ɔ.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ puɛ kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora; a ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ woɔ yiblii doodooe nɛ gbee nɔ, aloo wai nɛ a wo mi sinɔ duɔ.
“Ke he nyɛli ɔmɛ pee Israel nɔ́ ko ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ ji nɔ; e mlɛɛ blɛuu kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ sa loko e gblaa a tue.
Yawɛ maa ye lue kokooko.
E maa gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.
A maa sane nɔ si amlɔ nɔuu.
E be kɛe kulaa nɛ e ma kpata a hɛ mi.
A nyagbe ma tlukaa.
Yawɛ ma kpɔ e ma a kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi be mi nɛ e na kaa a he wami tsuo ta.
Nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ lɛɛ ke e na bɔ nɛ peepee ta a he ha a, e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ma bi e ma a ke, ‘Mawu ngua amɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?
Nyɛ lɛ mɛ kɛ lohwehi nɛ wo zɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ dã kɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ.
Lɛɛ, nyɛ ha nɛ a je ngmlaa ha nyɛ; nyɛ ha nɛ a he nɛ sɔ kɛ ba kpɔ nyɛ koo!’ “Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa, ‘Imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu; ye se ɔ, mawu ko mawu ko be!
Imi nɛ i gbee nɔ, imi kɛ̃ nɛ i haa nɔ wami; imi nɛ i plaa nɔ, nɛ imi nɛ i tsaa nɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa tsi ye nya.
Be abɔ nɛ imi ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene nɛ ɔ, i wo ye nine nɔ, nɛ i ngɛ kita kae kaa ma duɔ ye klaate nɛ kpɛɔ nylamnylam ɔ nya, nɛ ma hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane.
Ma ye lue ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ; nihi nɛ sume mi ɔ, ma gbla a tue.
Muɔ ma tsle ngɛ ye kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ pue si; nɛ ye klaate ɔ maa gbe nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ mi ɔ. Nihi nɛ kɛ mi na ta a, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be e he yee; nihi nɛ plaa, kɛ nihi nɛ a nuu ngɛ ta mi po, ma gbe mɛ!’ “Je mahi lee, nyɛ je Yawɛ ma a yi; nihi tsuo nɛ gbee e ma a, Yawɛ gblaa a tue.
E yeɔ lue ngɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e ma a he yayami paa mɛ.” Mose kɛ Nun bi, Yoshua kane la nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ saminya kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu.
Mose nyagbe slɔmi Benɛ Mose kane Mawu mlaa amɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a gbe nya a, e slɔ mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ a ye Mawu mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ pi munyu guhi; nyɛ wami daa si ngɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan se nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.” Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ̃, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa Abarim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Moab zugba a mi, ngɛ Yeriko ma a hanɔ; kuɔɔ Nebo yo ɔ, nɛ o hyɛ Kanaan zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ Israel ma a hae ɔ. O ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o nyɛminyumu Aaron hu gbo ngɛ Hor yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ bui mi tue; nyɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ngɛ Meriba pa a nya, ngɛ Kadesh ma a kasa nya, ngɛ Zin nga kplanaa a nɔ.
Nyɛ bui mi kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ngɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi.
O maa na zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ Israel ma a hae ɔ ngɛ se lokoo; se zugba a nitsɛ lɛɛ o be nɔ yae.”
Mose gbaa Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ Gbaami munyuhi nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ, Mose kɛ gbaa Israel bi ɔmɛ loko e gbo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yawɛ kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ kaa pu nɛ gba ngɛ Edom yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tso ha e ma a kɛ je Paran yo ɔ he.
Mawu bɔfohi akpe nyɔngma piɛ e he; a ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ suɔ e ma a; nihi nɛ ji e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ, e baa a yi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kplaa si ngɛ e nane nya; wa jaa lɛ, nɛ wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Wa yeɔ mlaa nɛ Mose wo wɔ ɔ nɔ; ejakaa wa ma a weto ní nitsɛnitsɛ ji Mawu mlaa a nɛ.
Benɛ Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo ba bua a he nya a, Yawɛ ba pee a matsɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Ruben wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “E ngɛ mi kaa Ruben bi ɔmɛ a he pi lɛɛ, se a yi nɛ na wami nɛ a ko gbo.” Bɔ nɛ e gbaa Yuda wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yawɛ, moo bu Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kue fami tue.
Mo bua a kɛ wɛtso kpa amɛ a nya, nɛ o pee mɛ kake.
Yawɛ, moo hwu a ta a ha mɛ, nɛ a ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Jehanɛ, Mose gbaa Levi wɛtso ɔ hulɔ ke, “Yawɛ, mo je o suɔmi kpo kɛ gu Tumim kɛ Urim a nɔ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji sɔmɔli nɛ yeɔ mo anɔkuale ɔ kɛ biɔ mo gbi ɔ nɛ.
O ka Levi wɛtso ɔ ngɛ Masa, nɛ o kɛ mɛ pɛ ngɛ Meriba pa a nya.
A ngmɛɛ we o he, se mohu a kua a fɔli, kɛ a nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ.
A bu o gbi tue, nɛ a ye o somi ɔ nɔ.
A maa tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ o mlaa a, konɛ a ye nɔ.
A maa sã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, moo gbaa Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a he nɛ wa.
Ha nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ maa sa o hɛ mi.
Moo ku a he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kɛ pue si, nɛ a ko te si gblegbleegble.” Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yawɛ suɔ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a sane, nɛ e baa a yi.
E buu a he daa ligbi, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ.” Bɔ nɛ e gbaa Yosef wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Mawu nɛ gbaa a zugba a; hiɔmi nɛ nɛ kɛ pue nɔ, nɛ a ná nyu kɛ je zugba a mi hulɔ.
A gbaa zugba a; tso yiblii nɛ fu ngɛ nɔ; tso yiblii kpakpahi babauu nɛ ba ngɛ a be mi.
Tso yiblii ngɔngɔɛhi nɛ ha blema yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A na ní kpakpahi ngɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Yawɛ nɛ gbaa ní ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɛ nɔ nɛ e tu munyu kɛ je mio tso nɛ ngɛ tsoe mi ɔ, é gbaa Yosef wɛtso ɔ kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ejakaa lɛ ji e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛngmɛ.
Yosef he wa kaa na ku; se e tsuɔ ní kaa na yo nɛ hɛ mi wo la.
E he wami ɔ bɔbɔyoo pɛ lɛ ngɛ Manase; se hiɛhiɛɛ ɔ ngɛ Efraim.
Yosef buaa a nya kɛ fieɔ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ yaa se lokoo kaa bɔ nɛ na kɛ e kolihi siɔ nɔ ɔ.” Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Zebulun kɛ Isakar wɛtso ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Zebulun nɛ ya nɔ saminya ngɛ wo nɔ jua yemi mi.
Isakar nɛ na ní, nɛ e pee kplɔkɔtɔtsɛ ngɛ we.
A maa kpee nibwɔhi kɛ ba a yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a maa sã bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A ma na ní kɛ je wo mi, nɛ a ma na ní kɛ je wo nya zia hu mi.” Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Gad wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Á je Mawu yi; lɛ nɛ bli Gad zugba a huzu mi.
Gad woɔ ká kaa jata nɛ kplɔ lohwe ko kɔni, loo e tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya.
Benɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya a, Gad bi ɔmɛ ngɔ zugba a he nɛ hi pe kulaa a ngɔ ha a he.
A ná nɔkɔtɔma blɔ nya.
A bu Yawɛ gbi tue, nɛ a ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.” Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Dan wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Dan ngɛ kaa jata bi; e hii tuue ngɛ Bashan yo ɔ nɔ.” Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Naftali wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yawɛ mi mi jɔ ha Naftali bi ɔmɛ; e ha mɛ ní kpakpahi; e ha mɛ zugba kɛ je wo ɔ nya kɛ ya su leneyi je.” Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Asher wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Asher ji wɛtso nɛ a gbaa pe kulaa ngɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Asher nɛ ba pee kaa bi nɛ a suɔ lɛ pe bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ́ oliv tso babauu nɛ ba a zugba a nɔ.
Á ma a ma amɛ a nya dade agbohi, konɛ a na he wami daa.” Nyagbe ɔ, bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Israel ma a tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Israel ma, mawu ko mawu ko be kaa nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ agboje kɛ jee hiɔwe kɛ ba jee ngmlaa ha nyɛ ɔ. Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ ji nyɛ wesa he.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ baa nyɛ yi daa.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e de nyɛ ke nyɛ kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yakob nina maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi; a nine maa su zugba kpakpa nɔ, he nɛ bɔ́ nɛɔ ngɛ, nɛ́ blɛfo kɛ wai baa saminya ngɛ.
A gbaa nyɛ, Israel ma.
Ma ko ma ko be kaa nyɛ ma nɛ Yawɛ he nyɛ yi wami.
Yawɛ ji nyɛ tsɛ̃i kɛ klaate.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ faa nyɛ he.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa nyɛ yeɔ kunimi.
Nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba kpa nyɛ pɛɛ ke nyɛɛ na mɛ mɔbɔ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa naa a nɔ.”
Mose gbenɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose je Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, nɛ e ya kuɔ Nebo yo ɔ kɛ ho Pisga yo ɔ yi mi ya, ngɛ Yordan beleku je.
Yawɛ kɛ zugba a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ: Gilead zugba muza a tsuo, kɛ ya muɔ Dan ma a ngɛ omleyi je, Naftali zugba muza a tsuo, Efraim kɛ Manase zugba amɛ, Yuda zugba a tsuo, kɛ ya su bonyoku je ngɛ Mediterenia wo nya tɔɔ, Yuda zugba a leneyi je, kɛ nga kplanaa a nɛ ngɛ kɛ je Zoar kɛ ya su ma ngua a nɛ tã ngɛ mi, nɛ e biɛ ji Yeriko ɔ. Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Zugba a nɛ i wo Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke ma ngɔ ha a nina a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ha nɛ o na zugba a kɛ o hɛngmɛ lɛɛ, se be o lejɛ ɔ yae.” Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ. Yawɛ pu lɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ko mi, ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Betpeor ma a hanɔ; se nɔ ko nɔ ko li he tutuutu nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Mose ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ benɛ e gbo ɔ. E ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso he wami saminya, nɛ e hɛngmɛ hu hyɛɛ nɔ́ bɔ nɛ sa.
Israel ma a nyɛ ya ha lɛ ligbi nyingmi etɛ ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ.
Nun bi, Yoshua nile nya ba bli, ejakaa Mose to lɛ si kaa nɔ nɛ ma ba ye e se.
Israel ma a bu Yoshua tue, nɛ a ye mlaa amɛ nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ a nɔ.
Gbalɔ ko ti si hu ngɛ Israel kaa Mose, nɛ́ e kɛ Mawu tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.
Gbalɔ kpa ko hu tsu we nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ Mose tsu ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ e zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ kaa lɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, gbalɔ kpa ko pee we ní nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ gbeye kaa níhi nɛ Mose pee ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo hɛ mi ɔ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Sane nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mose se yelɔ Yoshua nyɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya tua Kanaan zugba a. Níhi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ekomɛ ji bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ po Yordan pa a, bɔ nɛ a ywia Yeriko ma a pue si, bɔ nɛ a hwu ta ngɛ Ai; kɛ jehanɛ, bɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ e ma a so ekohu.
Munyuhi nɛ a le pe kulaa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ kake ji, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ; se imi kɛ ye we ɔ lɛɛ, wa ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ.” Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha A ye Kanaan zugba a nɔ .—.
A dla zugba a .—.
a. Zugba nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ .- b. Zugba nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ɔ .—.
d. Wesa he ma amɛ .- e. Levi bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ .- Wɛtsohi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ kpale kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ya .- Yoshua sɛ yemi munyu .- A pee somi ɔ ehe ngɛ Shekem .-
Mawu fa Yoshua ke e ya ngɔ Kanaan zugba a Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose gbenɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Nun bi Yoshua, nɛ ji Mose sɔmɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ Mose gbo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o kɛ Israel ma a tsuo nyɛ dla nɛ nyɛ ya po Yordan pa a kɛ ya zugba a nɛ i ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ i wo Mose si ɔ, i kɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ nane maa ma a ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ huzu maa je nga a nɔ ngɛ leneyi je, kɛ ya su Lebanon ngɛ omleyi je; jehanɛ, kɛ je Yufrate pa a nya ngɛ beleku je, kɛ gu Hit bi ɔmɛ a zugba a mi, kɛ ya ta Mediterenia wo ɔ nya ngɛ bonyoku je tɔɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo nyɛe o wami be ɔ tsuo.
Bɔ nɛ i kɛ Mose hi si ɔ, jã kɛ̃ i kɛ mo, Yoshua hu maa hi si.
I be mo sie, nɛ i be mo kuae hulɔ.
O he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã; ejakaa mo nɛ o maa nyɛɛ ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ i ka a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke i kɛ ma ha mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, moo lɛɛ o he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã kɛkɛ; lɔ ɔ ji kaa, o maa ye mlaa a tsuo nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Mose wo mo ɔ nɔ sisiisi.
Kó si ekoeko, nɛ he tsuaa he nɛ o maa ya a, o maa ye manye.
Moo kane mlaa womi nɛ ɔ daa.
Mo susu he nyɔ kɛ pia; nɛ o ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ɔ nɔ; ja jã loko níhi a mi maa hi ha mo, nɛ o maa ye manye.
Ná nɛ o le kaa imi nitsɛ nɛ i ngɛ mo fae ke o he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã a nɛ.
Koo nu sawale, nɛ o nine mi ko je wu.
He tsuaa he nɛ o maa ya a, imi, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, ma piɛ o he kɛ ya.” Yoshua fa ma a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ Jehanɛ, Yoshua fa ma a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ ke a ya kpa ma sito he ɔ, nɛ a de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ hla blɔ hiami niye ní kɛ to; ejakaa hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ke nyɛ nɔ́ ɔ.” Yoshua de Ruben kɛ Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a ke, “Nyɛ kai kaa Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose de nyɛ ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ zugba nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yordan beleku je, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ hi he.
Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nyɛ bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ maa hi hiɛ ɔ, se nyɛ kpɛti nyumuhi nɛ su ta yami nya a tsuo maa mia kɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a maa piɛ a he kɛ yaa su be nɛ mɛ hu a nine maa su zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan bonyoku je ɔ nɔ.
Zugba nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hi he nɛ ji zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan beleku je, nɛ́ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.” A ha Yoshua heto ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, wa maa pee, nɛ he tsuaa he nɛ o tsɔ wɔ ɔ, wa maa ya.
Bɔ nɛ wa bu Mose tue ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, jã kɛ̃ wa maa bu mo hu tue.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ mo nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ Mose hi si ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã, nɛ e be mo tue bue ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
Moo lɛɛ o he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã saminya kɛkɛ.”
Yoshua tsɔ slaali kɛ ya Yeriko Nun bi Yoshua tsɔ slaali enyɔ kɛ je Shitim nigii; nɛ e fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ya slaa Kanaan zugba a saminya, titli ɔ Yeriko.” Benɛ slaali ɔmɛ ya su ma a mi ɔ, a ya to yo ajuama ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rahab ɔ we mi.
Yeriko matsɛ ɔ nu kaa Israel bi komɛ ba jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɛ́ a ba slaa zugba a, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ kɛ ya de Rahab ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba to o we ɔ mi ɔ, zugba a tsuo slaami a ba a nɛ!
Je mɛ kpo kɛ ba!” -Rahab de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɔkuale mi ɔ, nyumu komɛ ba ye ngɔ, se i li he nɛ a je.
Be nɛ du bu, nɛ a ma nga agbo ɔ, a je kpo.
I li he nɛ a gu; se ke nyɛ nyɛɛ a se mlamlaamla a, nyɛ ma ya ná mɛ.” (Loko tsɔli ɔmɛ ba a, yo ɔ ngɔ slaali enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho tsu ɔ yi mi ya, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ya laa momo ngɛ go nɛ e ka ngɛ lejɛ ɔ sisi).
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ je ma a mi pɛ nɛ a nga agbo ɔ.
A ya hla slaali ɔmɛ kɛ ya gu Yordan pa a nya blɔ kɛ ya su pa pomi he ɔ tɔɔ.
Benɛ slaali ɔmɛ na we nɛ a hwɔ si ɔ, yo ɔ ya na mɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi.
E de mɛ ke, “I le kaa Yawɛ ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ he sawale nu wɔ, nɛ zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo a tsui ngɛ poe.
Wa nu bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ha Wo Tsu ɔ mii ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi be nɛ nyɛ je Egipt ɔ. Jehanɛ hu wa nu nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yordan ɔ se ɔ. Wa nu bɔ nɛ nyɛ kpata Sihon kɛ Og a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ha.
Benɛ wa nu sane nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa tsui po, nɛ nyumu ɔmɛ a kã nya ta; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pɛ ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ka mi kita ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nyɛ kpakpa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ maa pee ye weku li kpakpa ja nɔuu, nɛ nyɛ maa to mi okadi ko.
Nyɛɛ wo mi si kaa nyɛ ma he ye tsɛ kɛ ye nyɛ, ye nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, ye nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ, kɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a weku kɛ nina a yi wami, nɛ nyɛ be hae nɛ a gbe wɔ!” Slaali ɔmɛ de yo ɔ ke, “Wa ngɛ mo kita kae kaa ke o ya tsɔɔ we wa se blɔ, nɛ Yawɛ ha wa nine su zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa maa na mo mɔbɔ, nɛ wa maa ye wa si womi ɔ nɔ.” Gbogbo nɛ bɔle ma a, e mi nɛ Rahab we ɔ ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ kpa ko kple slaali ɔmɛ si kɛ gu saflɛ mi.
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kó na nyɛ.
Nyɛ ya laa nyɛ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ a maa kpale a se kɛ ba, loko nyɛ pue blɔ.” Slaali ɔmɛ de yo ɔ ke, “Wa maa ye kita nɛ o ha wa ka mo nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ke wa ba su zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, fí kpa tsu nɛ ɔ kɛ kpla saflɛ nɛ o kɛ wɔ gu mi kɛ kple si ɔ he.
Ha o tsɛ, kɛ o nyɛ, o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ o tsɛ weku li ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba bua a he nya ngɛ o we ɔ mi hiɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je kpo kɛ je o we ɔ mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko maa pee lɛ ɔ, e gbenɔ ɔ je lɛ nitsɛ e tue gbomi, pi wɔ.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hi o ngɔ ngɛ o we ɔ mi ɔ, ke nɔ ko nine ta e he ɔ, e gbenɔ ɔ maa pee wa sane.
Se ke o ya tsɔɔ wa se blɔ ɔ, lɛɛ wa he je kita nɛ o ha wa ka mo ɔ mi.” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ma pee bɔ nɛ nyɛ de ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo slaali ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a ho.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ kpa tsu ɔ nɛ e fi kɛ wo saflɛ ɔ he.
Slaali ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ya ya laa a he.
Matsɛ ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ ya hla mɛ kɛ kpa yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ligbi etɛ, se a nɛ mɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpale kɛ ba Yeriko ekohu.
A hla slaali ɔmɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ tsuo, se a nɛ mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, slaali ɔmɛ kple si kɛ je yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a po pa a kɛ ho Nun bi Yoshua ngɔ ya.
A ya bɔ lɛ níhi nɛ ya ba a nɔ ɔ tsuo.
A de Yoshua ke, “Niinɛ, Yawɛ ngɔ zugba a tsuo ngɔ ha wɔ.
Wa he ɔ, sawale nu zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ.”
Israel ma a po Yordan pa a Mɔtu mla a, Yoshua kɛ Israel ma a te si, nɛ a hia kɛ je Shitim kɛ ba Yordan pa a nya.
A to si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a mlɛ loko a po pa a. Ligbi etɛ se ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya kpa ma a sito he ɔ, nɛ a de ma a ke, “Ke nyɛ na Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ somi daka a nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ tloo ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ hia kɛ je he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛɛ e se.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, blɔ maa pee gugue lafa enuɔ loo nɔ nɛ hi nyɛɛ kɛ daka a nyɛ kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ na he nɛ nyɛ maa gu; ejakaa nyɛ gui hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ.” Yoshua de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he; ejakaa hwɔɔ ɔ, Yawɛ maa pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.” Jehanɛ, e de osɔfo ɔmɛ ke a tloo somi daka a kɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi.
A pee bɔ nɛ Yoshua de mɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, ma bɔni o hɛ mi nyami womi ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo a hɛ mi, konɛ a na nɛ a le kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ Mose hi si ɔ, jã kɛ̃ i kɛ mo hu maa hi si.
Mo fa osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo somi daka a ke, ke a su Yordan pa a nya a, a sɛ pa a mi nɛ a da si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Yoshua de Israel ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ munyu tue.
Enɛ ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ maa le kaa Mawu hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Yawɛ maa fie Kanaan bi ɔmɛ, Hit bi ɔmɛ, Hiv bi ɔmɛ, Periz bi ɔmɛ, Girgash bi ɔmɛ, Amor bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ maa je nyɛ blɔ mi.
Je ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ somi daka a maa sɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ ya po Yordan pa a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hla nyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi: wɛtso kake, nyumu kake.
Ke osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo Yawɛ, nɛ ji je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ daka a sɛ Yordan pa a mi pɛ pa a ma kpa bemi, nɛ nyu nɛ je yiti je ɔ ma ti kɛ da si ngɛ he kake.” -(Ke ní kpami be su ɔ, Yordan pa a hyiɔ nɛ e ywiaa nga).
Jehanɛ ɔ, ma a tsuo hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, nɛ́ a ya po Yordan pa a. Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo somi daka a nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi.
Benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nane ma nyu ɔ mi pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ nyu nɛ je yiti je ɔ bua e he nya da si ngɛ tsitsaa ngɛ Adam, nɛ ji ma ko nɛ ngɛ Zaretan kasa nya a. Nyu nɛ kpleɔ si kɛ yaa Araba, loo Ngo wo ɔ mi ɔ se po, nɛ Israel ma a po Yordan pa a ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ tutuutu.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo Yawɛ somi daka a da si ngɛ Yordan ɔ kpɛti, ngɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ Israel ma a tsuo nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ po Yordan pa a ta.
Kaimi tɛhi Benɛ ma a tsuo po Yordan pa a ta a, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Moo hla nyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ je ma a mi; wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi ɔ, nɔ kake; nɛ o ha nɛ a ya wo tɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ je Yordan pa a mi, he nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ da si ngɛ ɔ. Ha nɛ a tloo tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya ma si ngɛ he nɛ nyɛ maa to si ngɛ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua tsɛ nyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ́ e hla kɛ je Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ be kɛ ya je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ somi daka a hɛ mi ngɛ Yordan ɔ kpɛti.
Nyɛɛ da Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya kakaaka, nɛ nyɛ wo tɛ kakaaka ngɔ fɔ nyɛ konɔ.
Tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee kaimi nɔ́ ha nyɛ.
Ke nyɛ bimɛ bi nyɛ hwɔɔ se ko ke, ‘Mɛni tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ,’ nyɛ de mɛ ke, ‘Benɛ a kɛ Yawɛ somi daka a po Yordan pa a, nyu ɔ se po.’ Tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ma kai Israel ma a daa nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsu ha mɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Yoshua a, Israel bi ɔmɛ tloo tɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso nɔ́ kake, kɛ je Yordan pa a mi kɛ ba he nɛ ma a to si ngɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, Yoshua hu kɛ tɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ma si ngɛ Yordan pa a mi, he nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo somi daka a da si ngɛ ɔ.
(Tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ pa a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.)
Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo somi daka a da si ngɛ Yordan pa a kpɛti kɛ ya si be nɛ a gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Yoshua kɛ gu Mose nɔ ke e ha nɛ ma a nɛ a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ma a po pa a mlamlaamla.
Benɛ a po pa a ta a, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo somi daka a hu po, nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ya je ma a hɛ mi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de mɛ momo ɔ, nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ Ruben, Gad, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a a mi ɔ, mia kɛ nyɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ po pa a. Nihi maa pee akpe nyingmi eywiɛ nɛ́ dla a he kɛ ha ta hwumi nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ ho Yeriko nga kplanaa a nɔ ya.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ wo Yoshua hɛ mi nyami ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa a hɛ mi; nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye e wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo, kaa bɔ nɛ a ye Mose gbeye ɔ. Pee se ɔ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Fa osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo somi daka a ke a je Yordan pa a mi.” Yoshua pee ja.
Benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tloo Yawɛ somi daka a je Yordan pa a mi, nɛ a nane ma zugba gbigbli nɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ nɛ Yordan nyu ɔ kpale kɛ ba e blɔ he, nɛ pa a hyi nɛ e ywia nga kaa sa a. Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, ma a po Yordan pa a, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Gilgal, ngɛ Yeriko ma a beleku je.
Yoshua ngɔ tɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tloo kɛ je Yordan pa a mi ɔ ngɔ ma si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de Israel ma a ke, “Hwɔɔ se ko ke nyɛ bimɛ bi nyɛ ke kɛ ji tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi tsɔɔmi kɛɛ ɔ, nyɛ de mɛ ke zugba gbigbli nɔ Israel nyɛɛ kɛ po Yordan pa a nɛ, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, ha Yordan nyu ɔ mii kɛ ya su be nɛ nyɛ po pa a ta, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nɛ Wo Tsu ɔ hu mii kɛ ya su be nɛ nyɛ po ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ma ha je ɔ tsuo maa na Yawɛ he wami ɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye daa.”
Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ nya a nu kaa Yawɛ ha Yordan nyu ɔ mii ha Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya su be nɛ mɛ tsuo a po pa a ta.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ a tsui po, nɛ mɛ tsuo a ka nya ta ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he.
A po Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Gilgal Pee se ɔ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Ngɔɔ tɛ nɛ o kɛ pee ha, nɛ o po Israel bi ɔmɛ si enyɔne.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua pee tɛ hahi, nɛ e kɛ po Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Gibeat Haaralot nɛ sisi ji “Nɔ Pomi Yoku ɔ”.
- Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt ɔ, a po nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo momo.
Se jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ nɛ ma a nyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ, binyumuwi nɛ a fɔ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, mɛɛ a pui mɛ lolo.
Jehanɛ hu, ta buli nɛ a kɛ je Egipt ɔ, mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ; ejakaa a bui Yawɛ gbi tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ka kita a, e ha we nɛ a na zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní ɔ nɛ e wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a pui mɛ, nɛ mɛ ji yi nɔ he nɛ Yoshua po mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ a po ni ɔmɛ tsuo ta a, ma a tsuo hi a sito he ɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ pa amɛ gbo ta.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i jé Egipt nyɔguɛ peemi zo ɔ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Gilgal, nɛ jã nɛ a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Benɛ Israel ma a pueɔ si ngɛ Gilgal ngɛ Yeriko nga a nɔ ɔ, a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ.
E nɔ jena a ji kekleekle ligbi nɛ a ye zugba a nɔ niba ní: abolo kplolo kɛ ngma nɛ a si.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, niye ní nɛ nɛɛ kɛ jee hiɔwe ɔ se po, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ́ eko hu.
Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, zugba a nɔ niba ní ji nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ.
Yoshua kɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ hɛɛ klaate ɔ Benɛ Yoshua su Yeriko haa nɛ e wo e yi nɔ ɔ, e na nyumu ko nɛ hɛɛ klaate kɛ daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Yoshua ya e ngɔ nɛ e ya bi lɛ ke, “Wa nɔ ji mo, loo wa he nyɛlɔ ji mo?” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, mohu ɔ, i ba kaa Yawɛ tabo ɔ nyatsɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ bu zugba nɛ e ja lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, o tsɔlɔ ji mi.
Mɛni o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha mo?” Yawɛ tabo ɔ nyatsɛ ɔ de Yoshua ke, “Je o tokota a; zugba klɔuklɔu nɔ o daa si ngɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ Yoshua pee ja.
Yeriko hɛ mi kpatami A ngmɛ Yeriko agbo ɔmɛ a mi kpɛii, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ko na blɔ kɛ sɛ ma a mi.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko ji kpo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ mi.
Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “I ngɔ Yeriko, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ, kɛ a ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo o dɛ.
O kɛ o ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle ma a si kake daa ligbi.
Nyɛɛ pee ja ligbi ekpa.
Osɔfohi kpaago nɛ a hɛɛ titimati kpaago nɛ a kɛ agbosu koli pee kɛ nyɛɛ somi daka a hɛ mi.
Ligbi kpaagone ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔle ma a si kpaago, nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a hi titimati ɔmɛ kpae.
Ke nyɛ nu nɛ a kpa bɛ ɔ nɛ e se kɛ ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo nɛ he ose wawɛɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yeriko gbogbo ɔmɛ maa hule pue si tɛtlɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma bu kɛ sɛ ma a mi.” Jehanɛ, Nun bi Yoshua tsɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ wo somi daka a, nɛ nyɛ ti nihi kpaago nɛ a hɛɛ titimati kɛ nyɛɛ daka a hɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nyɛ hɛ mi!
Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bɔle Yeriko ma a. Nyɛ ha nɛ hlami ta a nɛ sɛ Yawɛ somi daka a hɛ mi.” -Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yoshua fa ma a, hlami ta a hia kɛ́ nyɛɛ osɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ titimati ɔmɛ kpae ɔ a hɛ mi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ somi daka a nyɛɛ a se, nɛ se ta a gbe nya.
Benɛ a yaa a tsuo, titimati ɔmɛ ngɛ pɛe.
Yoshua fa ma a ke, “Nyɛ ko kpa ngmlaa, nɛ nyɛ ko ha nɛ a nu nyɛ he; nyɛ ko tu munyu kulaa kɛ yaa su ligbi ɔ nɛ ma de nyɛ ke nyɛ he ose.” E ha a kɛ Yawɛ daka a ya bɔle ma a si kake pɛ nɛ a kpale kɛ ba ma sito he ɔ ekohu nɛ a ba hwɔ lejɛ ɔ.
-E nɔ jena makɛ mla a, Yoshua te si nɛ e kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo ɔ tsuo ya bɔle ma a kaa bɔ nɛ a pee kekleekle ligbi ɔ: hlami ta a hia, nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ kpaa titimati ɔmɛ ɔ nyɛɛ se; jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ Yawɛ somi daka a ba, nɛ se ta a gbe nya.
Benɛ a ngɛ ma a bɔlee ɔ tsuo titimati ɔmɛ ngɛ pɛe.
Ligbi enyɔne ɔ hu a bɔle ma a si kake, nɛ a kpale kɛ ba a sito he ɔ.
A pee ja ligbi ekpa.
Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, a te si makɛ mla, nɛ a bɔle ma a jã kɛ̃ si kpaago sɔuu.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ pɛ nɛ a bɔle ma a si kpaago.
Si kpaagone ɔ, benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ma bɔni titimati ɔmɛ kpami pɛ nɛ Yoshua fa ma a ke, “Nyɛ he ose, ejakaa Yawɛ ngɔ ma a ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ!
Nyɛ kpata ma a kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ha Yawɛ; Rahab, yo ajuama a, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, mɛ pɛ a yi nɛ na wami; ejakaa e ngɔ slaali ɔmɛ nɛ wa tsɔ ɔ kɛ laa.
Nyɛɛ yu nyɛ he kɛ je níhi nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko ba kɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba ngɔ eko.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛɛ kɛ haomi, kɛ hɛ mi kpatami maa ba Israel tsuo nɔ.
Sika hiɔ, sika tsu, akɔblee, kɛ dade níhi tsuo lɛɛ a hla kɛ to ha Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ nito he ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ bɔni titimati ɔmɛ kpami.
Benɛ ma a nu titimati pɛmi ɔ, a he ose wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yeriko gbogbo ɔ hule pue si.
Tabo ɔ tsuo bu kɛ sɛ ma a mi; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ya e hɛ mi tɛɛ; nɛ a ya ngɔ ma a.
A kɛ klaate kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ ma a mi: nyumuhi, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi.
A kpata nahi, tohi, kɛ tejihi hu a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua de nihewi enyɔ nɛ ya slaa zugba a ke, “Nyɛɛ ya yo ajuama a we ɔ mi nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ lɛ, kɛ e weku li nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ka lɛ kita a.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya ngɔ Rahab kɛ e tsɛ, kɛ e nyɛ, e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e weku li kpa amɛ tsuo kɛ ba.
A ha nɛ a kɛ a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ya hi Israel bi ɔmɛ a ma sito he ɔ se.
Jehanɛ, a kɛ la sa ma a, kɛ e mi níhi tsuo; se sika hiɔ, sika tsu, akɔblee, kɛ dade níhi lɛɛ a kɛ to Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ. Yoshua baa Rahab, yo ajuama a, kɛ e weku li ɔmɛ tsuo a yi; ejakaa e ngɔ slaali enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ Yoshua tsɔ Yeriko ɔ kɛ laa.
Rahab nina kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yoshua ka kita ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ka kaa e maa ma Yeriko ekohu ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ gbiɛ lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ maa to sisi ɔ, e bitɛte nɛ gbo, nɔ nɛ maa gbe nya nɛ a maa ma nya agbo ɔ, e binakutso nɛ gbo.” Yawɛ piɛ Yoshua he, nɛ e he biɛ kpakpa ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Akan pee yayami Yawɛ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa ke níhi nɛ a ma ya na ngɛ Yeriko, nɛ ji níhi nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ, a ti nɔ ko kó ta eko he, se a tɔ mlaa a. Nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Akan ɔ ya ngɔ ní ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel bi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ.
Akan tsɛ ji Karmi, nɛ e nɛ̃ ji Zabdi.
E je Zera we puɔ nya, ngɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi.
Yoshua tsɔ nihi kɛ je Yeriko ke a ya slaa Ai nɛ ngɛ Betaven kasa nya, ngɛ Betel beleku je ɔ. Benɛ a kpale kɛ ba a, a de Yoshua ke, “Ko ha nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ ya.
Ha nihi maa pee akpe enyɔ, loo akpe etɛ kɛkɛ ya tua Ai.
Ko ha nɛ ma a tsuo gba a he nya nɛ a ya lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa ma wayoo kɛkɛ ji Ai.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi maa pee akpe etɛ ho ya tua Ai ma a; se a nyɛ we nya nɛ a da.
Ai bi ɔmɛ wo mɛ fo kɛ je ma a agbo ɔ nya kɛ ya su he nɛ a gbaa tɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a gbe Israel bi ɔmɛ maa pee nihi nyingmi etɛ kɛ ekpa benɛ a ngɛ si kplee ɔ. Nɛ e pee ja a, Israel ma a tsui po, nɛ a he jɔ kaa nyu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ aywilɛho hía a tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ a ya bu si ngɛ Yawɛ somi daka a hɛ mi kɛ a yi mi zu kɛ ye kɔmɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ.
Yoshua de ke, “Aa, Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, mɛni he je o kɛ ma a po Yordan pa a kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ kulaa lɛɛ?
O kɛ wɔ ba ha Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi lo?
Mɛni he je wa hí Yordan pa a se kɛkɛ?
Nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ Israel ngɛ fo tue ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ ɔ, kɛ ma de kɛɛ?
Kanaan bi ɔmɛ, kɛ zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa nu he.
A ma ba sa wa yi, nɛ a ma kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
O biɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, o maa hi hyɛe nɛ e puɛ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Tee si koo!
Mɛni he je o kɛ o hɛ mi bu zugba kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Israel pee yayami!
A yi somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ nɔ; a ngɔ ní ɔmɛ nɛ i ke a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ ekomɛ kɛ piɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a níhi a he; a ju, nɛ a to lakpa.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ; a ngɛ fo tue ngɛ a nya, ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a plɛ pee níhi nɛ sa nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi!
I kɛ nyɛ be si hie hu; ja nyɛ kpata níhi nɛ i wo nyɛ mlaa ke nyɛ ko ta he ɔ a hɛ mi!
Tee si, nɛ o tsukɔ ma a he, nɛ o ha a pee a he klɔuklɔu ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
De mɛ ke hwɔɔ je nɛ maa na a, a dla a he; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Níhi nɛ i wo nyɛ mlaa ke nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi ɔ ekomɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ!
Nyɛ be he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nya nyɛe maa da, ja nyɛ je musu ní ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti!’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de ma a ke hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, a kɛ mɛ maa ba hiɛ ɔ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya.
Wɛtso nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma tsɔɔ ɔ, a maa ba we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
We puɔ nya nɛ ma tsɔɔ ɔ, a maa ba weku nya weku nya.
Weku nɛ ma tsɔɔ ɔ mi nyumu ɔmɛ maa ba kakaaka.
Nɔ nɛ a maa na musu ní ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, a kɛ la maa sã lɛ, kɛ e weku li, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Ejakaa e tsu zo ní ngɛ Israel, nɛ imi Yawɛ, ye somi ɔ hu e yi nɔ.” Yoshua te si makɛ mla, nɛ e ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ba wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, nɛ a nu Yuda wɛtso ɔ. E ha Yuda wɛtso ɔ ba we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ a nu Zera we puɔ nya.
Jehanɛ, e ha Zera we puɔ nya a ba weku nya weku nya, nɛ a nu Zabdi weku ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ha Zabdi we ɔ mi nyumu ɔmɛ ba kakaaka, nɛ a nu Karmi bi Akan, Zabdi bibi ɔ. Yoshua de Akan ke, “Ye bi, tu mi anɔkuale, nɛ o de mi nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
Mo de mi koo; mɛni o pee?
Koo laa mi ba.” Akan he nɔ nɛ e de Yoshua ke, “Niinɛ, i pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ; nɔ́ nɛ i pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: i na Babilonia bo kpakpa ko, kɛ sika hiɔ kilo enyɔ, kɛ sika tsu kpɔ kake nɛ ngmɛɛ kilo fa ngɛ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ a mi; ye hɛ kɔ ní ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ i muɔ mɛ.
I pu mɛ ngɛ ye bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ sika hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ní ɔmɛ a sisi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua tsɔ ni komɛ esɔesɔ kɛ ho Akan bo tsu ɔ mi ya.
Benɛ a ya a, a ya na ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pu, nɛ sika hiɔ ɔ ngɛ sisi niinɛ.
A muɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ je bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ba Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo a ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ ba pue si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo nu Akan, Zera bi ɔ, e binyumu ɔmɛ, e biyi ɔmɛ, kɛ e we mi lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo: na, teji, kɛ to.
Jehanɛ, a muɔ e bo tsu ɔ, kɛ musu ní ɔmɛ nɛ ji sika hiɔ ɔ, bo ɔ, sika tsu kpɔ kake ɔ, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
A kɛ nimli ɔmɛ, lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo ho Haomi Kɔ̃ ɔ mi ya.
Jehanɛ Yoshua bi Akan ke, “Mɛni he je o hao wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hu maa hao mo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsuo fia Akan tɛ nɛ e gbo; a fia e weku li ɔmɛ hu tɛ, nɛ a kɛ la sã lɛ, kɛ e weku li, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
A bua tɛ ɔmɛ a nya glekuu ngɔ pue e nɔ, nɛ tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Haomi Kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se po.
A tua Ai nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “O kɛ tabo ɔ tsuo nyɛɛ kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ya Ai.
Sawale kó nu mo, nɛ o tsui kó po hulɔ.
Ma ha o maa ye Ai matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ma a a nɔ, nɛ zugba a tsuo maa pee nyɛ nɔ.
Ó pee Ai kɛ e matsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Yeriko kɛ e matsɛ ɔ; se ta yibu ní ɔmɛ, kɛ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ha ha nyɛ he.
Nyɛ ya wo ma a he ka, nɛ nyɛ tua lɛ kɛ je e se je.” Yoshua kɛ tabo ɔ tsuo dla a he konɛ a ya tua Ai.
E hla katsɛmɛ akpe nyingmi etɛ sɔuu, nɛ e wo mɛ blɔ nyɔ mi.
E fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ya wo ma a he ka ngɛ e se je; nyɛɛ kɛ ma a he kó kɛ kulaa; nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ pee klaalo.
Imi lɛɛ i kɛ ye we bi ɔmɛ maa su ma a he haa.
Ke Ai bi ɔmɛ je kpo kɛ ba na wɔ ɔ, wa maa tu fo kaa bɔ nɛ wa pee kekle ɔ.
A ma susu kaa wa ngɛ a nya fo tue kaa kekle ɔ, nɛ a maa nyɛɛ wa se saii kɛ je ma a he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ka woli ɔmɛ nyɛ maa je se je ɔ kɛ ba tua ma a; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ngɔ ma a ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ.
Ke nyɛ ngɔ ma a, nyɛɛ mɛ he la kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua wo mɛ blɔ; nɛ a ya wo Ai ma a he ka.
A laa a he ngɛ Betel kɛ Ai a kpɛti, ngɛ Ai bonyoku je, nɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ hwɔ ma sito he ɔ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi.
Makɛ mla a, Yoshua te si nɛ e bua ma a nya.
E kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ ho Ai ya.
Tabo ɔ tsuo nɛ piɛ e he ɔ hu kuɔ kɛ ho ma a nya ya ya gba ta ngɛ Ai omleyi je; nɛ kɔ̃ ngɛ ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ Ai a kpɛti.
Yoshua ngɔ nihi maa pee akpe enuɔ kɛ ya wo ka ngɛ Betel kɛ Ai a kpɛti, ngɛ Ai bonyoku je.
A gba ta a: ta ngua a ya je Ai omleyi je, nɛ se ta a ya je bonyoku je.
Yoshua hwɔ kɔ̃ ɔ mi jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi.
Benɛ Ai matsɛ ɔ na Yoshua ta a, e kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo te si mɔtu kpla nɛ a ya tua Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi, he nɛ a kɛ mɛ kpe ngɛ kekle ɔ.
Se matsɛ ɔ li tete kaa a wo lɛ ka ngɛ ma a se je.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel ta a tsuo kulaa pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ fiee, nɛ a tu fo kɛ pule nga a nɔ blɔ.
A tsɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a nyɛɛ Yoshua kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ fo kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya se saii.
Nyumu ko nyumu ko píɛ ngɛ Ai nɛ ji kpo kɛ nyɛɛ we Israel se kɛ ta; a si ma a ngɔ fɔ si gu.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Wo akplɔ nɛ o hɛɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ Ai; ejakaa ma ngɔ ma a ngɔ wo o dɛ.” Yoshua pee kaa bɔ nɛ a de lɛ ɔ. Benɛ ka woli ɔmɛ na okadi nɛ ɔ, a te si esɔesɔ kɛ je a laami he ɔ, nɛ a kɛ fo sɛ ma a mi.
A ngɔ ma a, nɛ a mɛ he la nɔuu.
Benɛ Ai bi ɔmɛ hyɛ a se ɔ, ne la su ku nɛ ngɛ jee ngɛ ma a mi kɛ yaa hiɔwe.
A nɛ he nɛ a maa ma fo kɛ gu.
Ejakaa Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ fo tue kɛ gu nga a nɔ blɔ ɔ plɛ a hɛ mi kɛ kpee mɛ jehanɛ.
Benɛ Yoshua kɛ ma a kulaa na kaa ka woli ɔmɛ a nine su ma a nɔ, nɛ ma a mle kɛ la a, a kpale a se, nɛ a ba gbe Ai bi ɔmɛ.
Israel bi kpa amɛ nɛ sɛ Ai ma a mi ɔ hu ba piɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ sá Ai bi ɔmɛ a yi.
A gbe Ai bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A ti nɔ kake po na we blɔ nɛ e tu fo kɛ je; nɔ ko nɔ ko yi na we wami.
Se Ai matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, a nu lɛ kɛ ba ha Yoshua.
Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe Ai bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Ai ma a mi, nɛ a gbe nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
-Yoshua hɛɛ akplɔ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ Ai hluu kɛ ya si a kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ ma a mi, loko e ba lɛ si.
Nihi abɔ nɛ a gbe jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji nyumuhi kɛ yihi akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Lohwehi kɛ ta yibu níhi pɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ha ha a he.
Yoshua sã Ai ma a, nɛ e ha e plɛ pee ma doku kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
Se Ai matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ Yoshua sɛu lɛ ngɛ tso nɔ, nɛ e si e gbogboe ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ nya si.
Benɛ pu nɔ si ɔ, Yoshua fa nɛ a ya je gbogboe ɔ kɛ je tso ɔ nɔ.
A sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ ma agbo ɔ nya, nɛ a to tɛhi glekuu ngɔ pue e nɔ; nɛ tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
A kane mlaa a ngɛ Ebal yo ɔ nɔ Pee se ɔ, Yoshua ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ Ebal yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ. E ma lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose fa Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a pee ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ tɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kó we ma.” A sã sami bɔhi ngɛ nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ a sã tue mi jɔmi bɔhi hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua hyɛ Mose mlaa a nɔ, nɛ e ngma mlaa amɛ ja pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ fɔ tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ Israel tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, ma nimeli, ma nɔ hyɛli, kojoli, nibwɔhi, kɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ya da si ngɛ somi daka a kasa nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, ngɛ Levi bi osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ Yawɛ somi daka a a hɛ mi.
Nihi fa plɛ a se ngɔ wo Gerizim yo ɔ, nɛ nihi fa hu plɛ a se ngɔ wo Ebal yo ɔ. Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose nɛ wo mɛ mlaa kaa a pee enɛ ɔ, ke a maa gbaa Israel ma a. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kane mlaa a mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo, gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yoshua kane Mose mlaa amɛ tsuo fitsofitso nɛ e si we ekoeko ha Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ; yihi, jokuɛwi kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti tsuo piɛ he.
Gibeon bi ɔmɛ sisi Yoshua Kunimihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ye ɔ, ha a he sanehi gbɛ fĩa zugba a tsuo kulaa nɔ kɛ ya su ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ bonyoku je, ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi, Mediterenia wo ɔ nya tsuo, kɛ Lebanon ngɛ omleyi je.
Matsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ji Hit bi, Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo bua a he nya, nɛ a so konɛ a kɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel nɛ hwu ta.
Se benɛ Gibeon bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji Hiv bi ɔmɛ nu bɔ nɛ Yoshua pee Yeriko kɛ Ai ma amɛ ɔ, a to ga kaa a maa sisi Yoshua.
A ya hla niye ní, nɛ a muɔ kotoku momohi, kɛ lohwe he womi tɔ momohi nɛ gba nɛ a kpɛ, nɛ a to ngɔ pue a teji ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A wo tade gbagbɛhi, kɛ tokota momohi nɛ́ a tsla; abolo nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ to a dɛ ɔ gbli nɛ e fu ja.
A ba na Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Gilgal, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Wa je he kɛ.
Wa suɔ nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ nɛ so.” Se Israel bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Mɛni he je waa kɛ nyɛ maa so ɔ?
Eko piɔ, kpo nya hiɛ ɔ he ko nyɛ je.” A de Yoshua ke, “Wa ma sɔmɔ mo.” E bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔmɛ ji nyɛ?
Jije nyɛ je?” A de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, wa je ma se tsitsaa he ko; nɛ wa nu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ he.
Níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ngɛ Egipt ɔ, wa nu he, kɛ bɔ nɛ e pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Yordan beleku je ɔ: Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon, kɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og nɛ hi Ashtarot ɔ. Wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ wa zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo de wɔ ke wa hla niye ní kɛ to wa dɛ, nɛ waa hia blɔ kɛ ba nɛ wa ba na nyɛ.
A de wɔ ke, ke wa ba a, wa ba de nyɛ ke wa ma sɔmɔ nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, waa kɛ nyɛ maa so.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ wa niye ní ɔ ha!
Benɛ waa kɛ maa hia blɔ ɔ, la ngɛ he.
Se piɔ lɛɛ, e gbli nɛ e fu ja.
Lohwe he womi tɔ ɔmɛ nɛ wa wo a mi dã kɛ hia blɔ ɔ, ní hehi, se piɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ, a gba.
Wa tade ɔmɛ, kɛ wa tokota amɛ hu wo momo ngɛ blɔ ɔ kɛmi sɔuu he.” Israel bi ɔmɛ bi we Yawɛ ga womi kulaa, kɛkɛ nɛ a he ni ɔmɛ a dɛ mi niye ní ɔ. Yoshua he Gibeon bi ɔmɛ atuu, nɛ e kɛ mɛ so kaa a be mɛ gbee.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu ka kita ngɔ fɔ nɔ.
Benɛ a kɛ mɛ so se ligbi etɛ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ na le kaa ni ɔmɛ je a kasa nya haa.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, a ba su ma amɛ a mi he nɛ ni ɔmɛ je kɛ ba na mɛ ɔ. Ma amɛ ji Gibeon, Kefira, Beerot, kɛ Kiriat Yearim.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ gbi ni ɔmɛ; ejakaa Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ka mɛ kita ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi kaa a be mɛ gbee.
Enɛ ɔ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si ma nimeli ɔmɛ.
Se ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu de mɛ ke, “Wa ná ka mɛ kita momo ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sɛ kaa wa peeɔ mɛ yayami ko.
Wa ma ha nɛ a yi nɛ na wami ngɛ somi ɔ nya; ke pi ja a, Mawu maa gbla wa tue.
A kó gbe mɛ, se a pee lɛ́ lɛli, kɛ pa yali kɛ ha wɔ.” Ga nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ wo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yoshua fa nɛ a kɛ Gibeon bi ɔmɛ ba e hɛ mi, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ sisi wɔ ke nyɛ je he kɛ, be mi nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nyɛ je ɔ?
Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu gbiɛ nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa pee nyɔguɛhi; nyɛ ma gba lɛ́, nɛ nyɛ maa ya pa kɛ ba ye Mawu ɔ we ɔ.” Ni ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, wa pee ja niinɛ.
Wa na le kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fa e tsɔlɔ Mose ke e ngɔ zugba a tsuo ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e kpata ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ blɔ mi.
Wa ye gbeye wawɛɛ kaa nyɛ ma ba gbe wɔ; lɔ ɔ he nɛ wa to ga nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wa ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ sa o hɛ mi kaa o pee wɔ ɔ, moo pee wɔ.” Nɔ́ nɛ Yoshua pee ji: e baa ni ɔmɛ a yi.
E ha we Israel bi ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a kpata ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e pee mɛ nyɔguɛhi, nɛ a lɛɔ lɛ́, nɛ a yaa pa kɛ haa Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ. Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, mɛ nɛ a tsuɔ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ngɛ he nɛ Yawɛ hla ke a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ.
A ye Amor bi ɔmɛ a nɔ Yerusalem matsɛ, Adonizedek nu kaa Yoshua ngɔ Ai ma a, nɛ e kpata ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
E nu kaa Yoshua gbe matsɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Yeriko ma a, kɛ matsɛ ɔ. E nu hu kaa Gibeon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba pee huɛmɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ.
Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye wawɛɛ, ejakaa ma ngua ji Gibeon.
Gibeon ngɛ kaa matsɛ ma; e kle pe Ai, nɛ nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, katsɛmɛ sɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem matsɛ, Adonizedek tsɔ kɛ ya de Hebron matsɛ, Hoham; Yarmut matsɛ, Piram, Lakish matsɛ, Yafia; kɛ Eglon matsɛ, Debir ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba piɛ ye he, konɛ wa ya kpata Gibeon bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; ejakaa a kɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya tsɔ huɛ.” Amor matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ pee kake kɛ ya sá Gibeon ma a yi, nɛ a tua ma a. Matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji: Yerusalem matsɛ, Hebron matsɛ, Yarmut matsɛ, Lakish matsɛ, kɛ Eglon matsɛ.
Gibeon bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Gilgal, ba de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, koo ngmɛɛ wa he; ba esɔesɔ nɛ o ba piɛ wa he.
Ba kpɔ wɔ!
Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ bua a ta amɛ a nya kɛ je yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ba tua wɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo, kɛ e katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Gilgal.
Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Koo ye mɛ gbeye.
I ha o ye a nɔ momo.
A ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo nyɛe.” Yoshua kɛ e tabo ɔ nyɛɛ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ je Gilgal kɛ ho Gibeon ya ya tua Amor bi ɔmɛ, be mi nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ.
Yawɛ ha sawale nu Amor bi ɔmɛ benɛ a na Israel ta a. Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe mɛ ngɔ pue si ngɛ Gibeon, nɛ a nyɛɛ a se kɛ fo kɛ ya gu yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ ngɛ Bet Horon, kɛ ya su Azeka kɛ Makeda tɔɔ ngɛ leneyi je.
Be mi nɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ ngɛ fo tue ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a ta a nya kɛ gu yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ kɛ yaa a, Yawɛ ha gbiɛ ngo ngu nguahi je hiɔwe ba nɔɔ a nɔ.
Nihi nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔ gbe ɔ hiɛ kulaa pe nihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ klaate gbe.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ́ Yawɛ ha Israel ye Amor bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi ɔ, Yoshua kɛ Yawɛ tu munyu ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Pu, da si ngɛ Gibeon, nɛ mo nyɔhiɔ hu, da si ngɛ Aiyalon kɔ̃ ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ pu ɔ da si, nɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔ hu mimiɛ we e he kɛ ya su be nɛ Israel ma a ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yashar Womi ɔ mi.
Pu ɔ da si ngɛ hiɔwe ligbi mluku kake, nɛ e ya nɔɛ si.
Nɔ́ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ, kaa Yawɛ bu nɔmlɔ kake kue fami tue, nɛ e ha pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ nyɛ da si nɛ a nyɛɛ we ɔ, eko bɛ hyɛ.
Yawɛ hwu ta ha Israel!
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo kpale a se kɛ ba ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Gilgal.
Yoshua nuu Amor matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ Matsɛmɛ enuɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ma fo nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ Makeda tɛ puɔ ɔ mi.
Nɔ ko ya na mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ba bɔ Yoshua he nɛ matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ ya laa a he ngɛ ɔ. Yoshua fa ke, “Nyɛ ya kpɛne tɛ agbo komɛ kɛ tsi tɛ puɔ ɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ nihi nɛ bu he; nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ko tlɔ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a se, nɛ nyɛ tua mɛ kɛ je a se je; nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sɛ a ma amɛ a mi; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi.” Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe nihi babauu nitsɛ; nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ ná blɔ ya sɛ a ma amɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ mi.
Pee se ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo kpale kɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Makeda; nɔ kake po nɔɛ ngɛ ta a mi.
Kɛ je enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko hla we munyu ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he hu.
Jehanɛ, Yoshua de ke, “Nyɛ bli tɛ puɔ ɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ je jamɛ a matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ kpo kɛ ba ha mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bli tɛ puɔ ɔ nya, nɛ a je matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Yoshua.
Mɛ ji: Yerusalem matsɛ, Hebron matsɛ, Yarmut matsɛ, Lakish matsɛ, kɛ Eglon matsɛ.
Benɛ a kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ɔ, Yoshua kpee Israel ma a tsuo kɛ ba; nɛ e de asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ta a ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nanehi ba ma matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a kuɛhi a nɔ!” Asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ja.
Jehanɛ, Yoshua de ma a ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ko nu sawale hulɔ.
Nyɛ he nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛɛ pee kã; ejakaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ Yawɛ maa pee nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo!” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua gbe matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ kpla si ngɛ tsohi a nɔ.
A hi tso ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ nya si.
Benɛ pu yaa nɔ si ɔ, Yoshua fa nɛ a ya je mɛ kɛ je tso ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ya hɛɛ mɛ ngɔ pue tɛ puɔ ɔ nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ̃ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ tɛ agboagbohi kɛ tsi tɛ puɔ ɔ nya; nɛ tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Yoshua kpɔ Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba kpahi Yoshua ye Makeda nɔ kunimi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. E gbe ma a mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ; e kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ.
Bɔ nɛ e pee Yeriko matsɛ ɔ, jã pɛpɛɛpɛ e pee Makeda matsɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo hia kɛ je Makeda kɛ ho Libna ya, nɛ e ya tua Libna.
Yawɛ ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɔ wo a dɛ nɛ a gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ; a kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Yoshua pee Yeriko matsɛ ɔ, jã pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ e pee Libna matsɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ je Libna kɛ ho Lakish ya.
A ya sá ma a yi, nɛ a tua ma a. Yawɛ ngɔ Lakish ngɔ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ ligbi enyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ngɔ ma a. Kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ Libna a, ja nɔuu a gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ ngɛ Lakish ma a mi.
Gezer matsɛ, Horam, kɛ e ta a ba konɛ a ba piɛ Lakish he.
Se Yoshua gbe matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ta a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ; nɔ kake po píɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo je Lakish kɛ ho Eglon ya.
A ya sá ma a yi, nɛ a tua ma a.
A ngɔ ma a jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ Lakish ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo je Eglon, nɛ a kuɔ Hebron yo ɔ.
A ya tua Hebron, nɛ a ngɔ ma a.
A gbe matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ nɛ bɔle Hebron ɔ mi hu, a gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yoshua kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ngɛ Eglon ɔ; nɔ kake po píɛ.
Jehanɛ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo kpale a se kɛ ba Debir, nɛ a ba tua ma a. E ngɔ ma a, matsɛ ɔ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma a.
A gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Yoshua pee Hebron, kɛ Libna, kɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu e pee Debir, kɛ Debir matsɛ ɔ. Yoshua ye zugba a tsuo nɔ: yo nɔ zugba a, leneyi je zugba a, nga nɔ zugba a, kɛ kɔ̃ mi zugba a, kɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ fa ke a pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yoshua ye zugba a tsuo nɔ, kɛ je Kadesh Barnea kɛ ya su Gaza tɔɔ, kɛ Goshen zugba a, kɛ ya su Gibeon tɔɔ.
Yoshua ye matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a zugba amɛ tsuo a nɔ ngɛ ta nɛ e gba si kake too ɔ mi; ejakaa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hwu ta ha Israel.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo kpale a se kɛ ba ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Gilgal.
Yoshua ye Yabin kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ Benɛ Hazor matsɛ, Yabin nu Israel kunimi yemi ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ ya de Madon matsɛ, Yobab; Shimron matsɛ, Akshaf matsɛ, kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ Galilea wo ɔ leneyi je, kɛ nga kpataa a nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nya ngɛ Dor kasa nya a. Jehanɛ, e tsɔ ya de Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a kpo he hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, kɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ, Hit bi ɔmɛ, Periz bi ɔmɛ, Yebus bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ Hiv bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ sisi ngɛ Mizpa zugba a nɔ ɔ. Matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ hia ta kɛ a tabo ɔmɛ, kɛ a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia.
Matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo bua a tabo ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ he kake, nɛ a gba ta ngɔ wo Israel he ngɛ Merom pa a nya.
Yawɛ de Yoshua ke, “Koo ye mɛ gbeye.
Hwɔɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ha Israel momo.
O maa poo a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane se pani, nɛ o maa sã a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo ya tua Yabin ta a ngɛ Merom pa a nya, be mi nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ.
Yawɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ye a nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tua mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ a se kɛ ya su Sidon Ngua, kɛ Misrefot Maim ngɛ omleyi je; jehanɛ, a nyɛɛ a se kɛ gu beleku je kɛ ya su Mizpa kɔ̃ ɔ mi tɔɔ.
A hwu ta a kɛ ya si be nɛ a gbe he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nɔ kake po píɛ.
Yoshua pee bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ; e poo a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane se pani, nɛ e sã a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ.
Yoshua kpale e se jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu, nɛ e ya ngɔ Hazor, nɛ e gbe matsɛ ɔ.
(Sa a, Hazor ji lejɛ ɔ nɔ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo a yi.)
A kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɔ kake po píɛ.
Nɛ a sã Hazor ma a. Yoshua ngɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e kpata a kɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ sɛ̃ ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ekoeko, ja Hazor pɛ nɛ Yoshua sã.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ha ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ní, kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo, se nimli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi; nɔ kake po píɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa e tsɔlɔ Mose ɔ, jã kɛ̃ Mose fa Yoshua, nɛ ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Yoshua pee ɔ nɛ.
E si we níhi nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a pee ɔ ekoeko nɛ e pee we.
Zugba nɛ Yoshua ngɔ ɔ Yoshua ngɔ zugba a tsuo: yo nɔ kɛ kɔ̃ mi zugba a ngɛ leneyi je kɛ omleyi je tsuo, Goshen zugba a, Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ, kɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ kɛ a he nga kplanaa a.
-Zugba a fia si kɛ je Halak yo ɔ he ngɛ leneyi je ngɛ Edom kasa nya, kɛ kuɔ kɛ ya si Baalgad ngɛ omleyi je, ngɛ Lebanon kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ leneyi je.
Yoshua kɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hwu ta be saii.
Nyagbe ɔ, e nuu mɛ nɛ e kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi.
Gibeon ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Hiv bi ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba so, nɛ a pee huɛmɛ.
Se ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hwu ta nɛ a ye a nɔ.
Yawɛ ha a kplii a tsui kaa a kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hwu ta, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a ko na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yoshua ya kpata oblaihi a nina komɛ a hɛ mi.
A tsɛɛ mɛ ke Anak bi.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hii Hebron, Debir, Anab, Yuda, kɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Yoshua kpata ni ɔmɛ kɛ a ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Anak bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake po píɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ; ja Gaza, Gat, kɛ Ashdod pɛ nɛ ni komɛ ngɛ.
Yoshua ngɔ zugba mluku ɔ tsuo, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yoshua dla zugba a ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya kaa a weto ní.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ta a se po, nɛ zugba a nɔ jɔ.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Mose ye a nɔ ɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ye matsɛmɛ enyɔ komɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ a zugba a ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je.
Zugba a ngɛ kɛ je Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ya su Hermon yo ɔ he tɔɔ.
Matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji Amor bi ɔmɛ a Matsɛ Sihon nɛ hi Heshbon ɔ. E nɔ yemi hehi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Gilead fa a, kɛ je Aroer ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya kɛ gu kɔ̃ ɔ mi, kɛ ya su Yabok pa a nya ngɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya.
E nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ, kɛ je Galilea wo ɔ nya ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya su Bet Yeshimot ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ beleku je hluu kɛ ya su Pisga yo ɔ sisi.
Matsɛ enyɔne ɔ ji Bashan matsɛ, Og.
Lɛ ji Refaim nina nɛ piɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake nɛ hi Ashtarot kɛ Edrei.
Matsɛ Og nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: kɛ je Hermon yo ɔ nɔ, Saleka, kɛ Bashan tsuo, kɛ ya su Geshur bi ɔmɛ kɛ Maaka bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔmɛ a nya.
Jehanɛ, kɛ je Gilead bi ɔmɛ a zugba a fa kɛ ya ta Heshbon huzu ɔ nya.
Mose kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kpata matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose ngɔ a zugba a ngɔ ha Ruben kɛ Gad, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a kaa a weto ní.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Yoshua ye a nɔ ɔ Yoshua kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kpata matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ɔ a hɛ mi, kɛ je Baal Gad ngɛ Lebanon kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ya su Halak yo ɔ he ngɛ leneyi je ngɛ Edom kasa nya.
Yoshua dla zugba nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, nɛ e pee a weto ní.
Zugba a ngɛ yo nɔ kɛ kɔ̃ mi; Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ kɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ, kɛ yo ɔmɛ a kuɛ si, kɛ nga a nɔ, kɛ leneyi je tsuo.
Nihi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ hyɛ ji Hit bi, Amor bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: Yeriko, Ai nɛ ngɛ Betel kasa nya a, Yerusalem, Hebron, Yarmut, Lakish, Eglon, Gezer, Debir, Geder, Horma, Arad, Libna, Adulam, Makeda, Betel, Tapua, Hefer, Afek, Lasharon, Madon, Hazor, Shimron Meron, Akshaf, Taanak, Megido, Kedesh, Yokneam ngɛ Karmel, Dor ngɛ wo ɔ nya, Goyim ngɛ Galilea, kɛ Tirza; matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ kake.
Zugba nɛ Israel ngɔɛ lolo Jehanɛ, benɛ Yoshua ba bwɔ kotokoto ɔ, Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “O bwɔ lɛɛ, se zugba nɛ piɛ nɛ o maa ngɔ ɔ hiɛ babauu.
Zugba nɛ piɛ ɔ ji Filistia kɛ Geshur zugba a, kɛ Avim zugba a tsuo nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ. Zugba a nɛ ngɛ kɛ je Shihor pa a he ngɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya a, kɛ ba be kɛ ho Ekron ya ngɛ omleyi je ɔ, a buu jamɛ a zugba a kaa Kanaan bi a zugba.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gat, kɛ Ekron.
Enɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he: Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a zugba a tsuo, kɛ Meara nɛ ji Sidon bi ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ ya su Afek ngɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya, kɛ Gebal bi ɔmɛ a zugba a, kɛ Lebanon tsuo ngɛ beleku je, kɛ je Baalgad ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ sisi kɛ ya su Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ. Sidon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a tsuo nɛ ngɛ kɛ je Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya su Misrefot Maim pa a nya a hu piɛ he.
Imi nitsɛ ma fie nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ ɔ mi.
Moo lɛɛ moo dla zugba a ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ e pee a weto ní, kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, dla zugba a ha wɛtso nɛɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a, nɛ e pee a nɔ.” Yordan pa a beleku je zugba a dlami Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose ha Manase wɛtso fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ, Ruben wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Gad wɛtso ɔ a weto ní ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je momo.
A zugba a fɔ si kɛ je Aroer, ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya, kɛ be ma nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ he, kɛ muɔ zugba kpataa a nɛ ngɛ Medeba kɛ Dibon a kpɛti ɔ.
A kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ wo huzu.
Amor bi a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ Heshbon ɔ, e ma amɛ tsuo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ mi.
Gilead, Geshur, Maaka, Hermon yo ɔ, Bashan, kɛ Saleka tsuo piɛ a zugba a he.
Bashan matsɛ, Og nɔ yemi he ɔ hu piɛ zugba nɛ ɔ he.
Og ye matsɛ ngɛ Ashtarot kɛ Edrei; nɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ oblaihi a nina nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Refaim ɔ a kpɛti; ejakaa Mose ya tua mɛ, nɛ e fie mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Israel bi ɔmɛ fie we Geshur bi ɔmɛ kɛ Maaka bi ɔmɛ; mohu ɔ, a kɛ mɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ pɛ ji wɛtso nɛ Mose ha we mɛ zugba a eko.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a blɔ nya ní ji bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ haa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ. Zugba nɛ a ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ Mose ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ zugba kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
Zugba nɛ ɔ huzu je Aroer pa a nya ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya, kɛ ma nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ kpɛti ɔ, kɛ zugba kpataa a tsuo nɛ bɔle Medeba a. Mahi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ji Heshbon, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba kpataa a nɔ, nɛ ji Dibon, Bamot Baal, Bet Baalmeon, Yahaz, Kedemot, Mefaat, Kiriataim, Sibma, Zeretshahar ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ nya, Betpeor, Pisga yo ɔ kuɛ si, kɛ Bet Yeshimot.
Lɔ ɔ ji ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba kpataa a nɔ, kɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ Heshbon ɔ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
Mose ye e nɔ kunimi, kɛ Midian ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, kɛ Reba.
Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon ganɔhi ji mɛ tsuo.
Nihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe ɔ, a ti nɔ kake ji klamɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Balaam ɔ. Beor binyumu ji lɛ.
Ruben bi ɔmɛ a huzu ngɛ bonyoku je ji Yordan pa a. Mahi kɛ a he kɔpehi nɛ a ha Ruben bi ɔmɛ kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Zugba nɛ a ha Gad wɛtso ɔ Mose ha Gad wɛtso ɔ hu zugba a eko kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
A zugba ji Yazer kɛ Gilead ma amɛ tsuo, kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a fa, kɛ ya su Aroer ngɛ Raba beleku je.
Jehanɛ, a zugba a tsa nɔ kɛ je Heshbon kɛ ya su Ramat Mizpa kɛ Betonim, nɛ e je Mahanaim kɛ ya su Lodebar huzu ɔ nya.
Ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, mahi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji Bet Haram, Betnimra, Sukot, Safon, kɛ Heshbon nɛ ji Matsɛ Sihon nɔ yemi he nɛ piɛ ɔ. Bonyoku je huzu ɔ je Yordan pa a nya kɛ ya su Galilea wo ɔ nya tɔɔ ngɛ omleyi je.
Mahi kɛ a he kɔpehi nɛ a ha Gad wɛtso ɔ kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Zugba nɛ a ha Manase wɛtso fa a Manase wɛtso fa a hu Mose ha mɛ zugba kaa a weto ní, we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
A zugba a je Mahanaim kɛ muɔ Bashan.
Lɔ ɔ ji Bashan matsɛ, Og nɔ ye mi he ɔ tsuo, kɛ Yair kɔpehi nyingmi ekpa ngɛ Bashan, Gilead ma a fa, kɛ Ashtarot kɛ Adrei ngɛ zugba nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ha Manase wɛtso fa a mi.
Ma nguahi nɛ ngɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og nɔ yemi he ɔ ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ.
A ngɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ ha Manase binyumu Makir nina fa a we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
Bɔ nɛ Mose dla zugba a nɛ ngɛ Moab nga a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan se pa a ngɛ Yeriko beleku je ɔ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Levi wɛtso ɔ lɛɛ Mose ha we mɛ zugba a eko.
E de mɛ ke mɛɛ a weto ní ji Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ.
Yordan pa a bonyoku je zugba a dlami Bɔ nɛ a dla Kanaan zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan bonyoku je ɔ ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ kaa a weto ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Osɔfo Eleazar, Nun binyumu Yoshua, kɛ Israel wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ dla zugba a ngɔ ha ma a.
A fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ɔ ngɔ ha wɛtso nɛɛ kɛ fa amɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a pee ɔ.
- Mose dla zugba nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ ngɔ ha wɛtso enyɔ kɛ fa momo.
(Yosef nina ya pee wɛtso enyɔ: Manase kɛ Efraim.)
Levi wɛtso ɔ lɛɛ Mose ha we mɛ zugba a eko.
Se a ha mɛ mahi nɛ a maa hi mi, kɛ lohwe lɛmi hehi kɛ ha a na amɛ, kɛ a we mi lohwehi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ dla zugba a kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
A ngɔ Hebron kɛ ha Kaleb Ligbi ko ɔ, Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi ni komɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ngɛ Gilgal.
A ti nɔ kake ji Yefune nɛ je Keniz ɔ binyumu Kaleb.
E ba bɔ Yoshua amaniɛ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o le munyu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ Mose tu nɛ kɔɔ i kɛ mo wa he ngɛ Kadesh Barnea.
Benɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose tsɔ mi kɛ je Kadesh Barnea ke ma ya slaa zugba nɛ ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, i ye jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
I ba bɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa ya na a pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ mi ya a ha ma a tsui po; se imi lɛɛ i bu Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ tue kɛ pi si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ka mi kita jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ke, zugba a he nɛ i ya nyɛɛ ɔ ma ba pee i kɛ ye nina wa weto ní daa; ejakaa i bu Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ tue kɛ pi si.
Se nyɛɛ hyɛ, jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enuɔ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu nɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ nyɛɛe ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ɔ, e baa ye yi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ mi ha!
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ye jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ enuɔ, se i ngɛ he wami saminya.
Bɔ nɛ i ngɛ be nɛ Mose tsɔ mi ɔ, jã kɛ̃ i ngɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ. I ngɛ he wami kɛ mwɔɔ nɛ ma nyɛ kɛ ya ta, loo ma kɛ tsu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo mi he si jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ngɔɔ ha mi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, wa ba bɔ nyɛ amaniɛ ke oblai komɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ ke Anak bi ɔ ngɛ ma ngua komɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se i de ke, eko ɔ, Yawɛ maa piɛ ye he nɛ ma fie mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ.” Yoshua gbaa Yefune binyumu Kaleb, nɛ e ngɔ Hebron ma a ngɔ ha lɛ kaa e weto ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hebron ba pee Yefune nɛ je Keniz ɔ binyumu Kaleb weto ní kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ; ejakaa e bu Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ tue kɛ pi si.
Sa a, Hebron biɛ ji Kiriat Arba (e sisi ji Arba ma).
Arba nɛ ɔ ji Anak bi ɔmɛ a nɔmlɔ agbo pe kulaa.
Jehanɛ ɔ, ta a se po, nɛ zugba a nɔ jɔ.
Zugba nɛ a ha Yuda wɛtso ɔ Zugba nɛ a ha Yuda wɛtso ɔ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya a, bɔ nɛ e fɔ si ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Zugba a leneyi je ngɛ Zin nga kplanaa a nyagbe tɔɔ, ngɛ Edom huzu ɔ nya.
Huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je nɛ ɔ je Ngo wo ɔ leneyi je, nɛ e tsa nɔ ja kɛ kuɔ Akrabim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ, kɛ ya su Zin.
E kuɔ kɛ ya je Kadesh Barnea leneyi je, kɛ ya gu Hezron kasa nya, kɛ ya su Adar, nɛ e lɔgɔ kɛ ya gu Karka.
E tsa nɔ kɛ ho Azmon ya, kɛ ya gu Egipt pa a nya, hluu kɛ ya pi Mediterenia wo ɔ, nɛ e nya ya ta ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ je Ngo wo ɔ nya kɛ ya su Yordan pa a nya.
Huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ, je wo kɔ̃tɔ̃ ɔ mi he nɛ Yordan pa a kɛ e nya wo Ngo wo ɔ mi ngɛ ɔ. Huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ ya su Bet Hogla, nɛ e ya be ngɛ kpongu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ he ɔ omleyi je.
E kuɔ kɛ ya gu Bohan tɛ ɔ he.
(Bohan ji Ruben binyumu ko.)
Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, huzu ɔ ya gu Haomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ya su Debir, nɛ e lɔgɔ kɛ gu Gilgal ngɛ Adumim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ leneyi je.
Huzu ɔ tsa nɔ kɛ ya gu Enshemesh pa a nya kɛ ya su Enrogel.
Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ nyɛɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ ngɛ leneyi je, he nɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ ma Yerusalem ngɛ ɔ. Huzu ɔ kuɔ yo ɔ ngɛ bonyoku je, kɛ ya gu Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ we omleyi je.
Huzu ɔ kple si kɛ ba Neftoa pa a nya, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ya na ma nɛ ngɛ Efron yo ɔ kasa nya a, nɛ e lɔgɔ kɛ ho Baala ya.
(Baala biɛ kpa ji Kiriat Yearim.)
Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ lɔgɔ Baala bonyoku je kɛ ho Seir yo ɔ he ya, nɛ e bɔle Yearim yo ɔ, (Yearim yo ɔ biɛ kpa ji Kesalon).
Huzu ɔ kple si kɛ ya su Bet Shemesh, kɛ ya gu Timna.
Huzu ɔ gba ngɛ yoku ɔ nɛ ngɛ Ekron ɔ we omleyi je ɔ, nɛ e lɔgɔ kɛ ho Shikeron ya; e gu Baala yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ya je Yamnia, nɛ e nya ya pi Mediterenia wo ɔ. Wo nɛ ɔ ji huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ nɛ.
Yuda wɛtso ɔ huzu ɔmɛ a nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A dla zugba a ngɔ ha mɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
Kaleb ngɔ Hebron kɛ Debir Yoshua ha Yefune binyumu Kaleb zugba a eko ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
A ha lɛ Kiriat Arba nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hebron, ma nɛ a kɛ Anak binyumu Arba biɛ wo lɛ ɔ. Kaleb fie Anak binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je ma a mi.
Mɛ ji Sheshai, Ahiman, kɛ Talmai.
Benɛ Kaleb je lejɛ ɔ, e ya tua Debir, nɛ sa a, a tsɛɛ lɛ Kiriat Sefer ɔ. Kaleb de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ma tua Kiriat Sefer nɛ e maa ngɔ ma a, ma ha lɛ ye biyo Aksa nɛ e ngɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Otniel nɛ ji Kaleb nyɛminyumu Kenaz bi ɔ, ya ngɔ ma a, nɛ Kaleb kɛ e biyo Aksa ha lɛ.
Benɛ a kpee Aksa a, e wo e huno ɔ yi mi ke e bi e ngatsɛ ɔ ngmɔ zugba ko; Aksa kple si kɛ je e teji ɔ nɔ, nɛ Kaleb bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha mo?” E de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Moo ke mi nɔ́ ko.
O ha mi zugba ngɛ leneyi je he nɛ nyu be momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, nɛ o ha mi he ko nɛ nyu ngɛ hu ngɔ piɛ he.” Kaleb ha lɛ hehi nɛ nyu ngɛ, ngɛ yo nɔ kɛ kɔ̃ mi.
Yuda ma amɛ Zugba nɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ ná kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ a wɛtso ɔ na ma nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ leneyi je tsitsaa ngɛ Edom huzu ɔ kasa nya.
Ma amɛ ji: Kabzeel, Eder, Yagur, Kina, Dimona, Adada, Kedesh, Hazor, Itnan, Zif, Telem, Bealot, Hazor Hadata, Keriot Hezron (nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hazor ɔ), Amam, Shema, Molada, Hazar Gada, Heshmon, Betpelet, Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziotia, Baala, Iyim, Ezem, Eltolad, Kesil, Horma, Ziklag, Madmana, Sansana, Lebaot, Shilhim, Ain, Rimon.
Ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a yibɔ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ nɛɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Nga kplanaa a nɔ ma amɛ ji: Eshtaol, Zora, Ashna, Zanoa, Enganim, Tapua, Enam, Yarmut, Adulam, Soko, Azeka, Shaaraim, Aditaim, Gedera, Gederotaim.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ma nɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he: Zenan, Hadasha, Migdalgad, Dilean, Mizpa, Yokteel, Lakish, Bozkat, Eglon, Kabon, Lamam, Kitlish, Gederot, Betdagon, Naama, Makeda.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ ekpa kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ma nɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he: Libna, Eter, Ashan, Ifta, Ashna, Nezib, Keila, Akzib, Maresha.
E peeɔ ma nɛɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ma kpahi hu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji Ekron, kɛ e he mahi kɛ kɔpehi, kɛ mahi kɛ kɔpehi nɛ ngɛ Ashdod kasa nya a, kɛ je Ekron kɛ ya su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya.
Ekomɛ ji Ashdod, kɛ Gaza, kɛ a he mahi kɛ kɔpehi, hluu kɛ ya su pa a he ngɛ Egipt huzu ɔ nya, kɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ hu nya.
Ma nɛ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ: Shamir, Yatir, Soko, Dana, Kiriat Sefer (nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Debir ɔ), Anab, Eshtemoa, Anim, Goshen, Holon, kɛ Gilo.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ kake kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ekomɛ hu ji Arab, Duma, Eshan, Yanim, Bet Tapua, Afeka, Humta, Kiriat Arba (nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hebron ɔ), kɛ Zior.
E peeɔ ma nɛɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ekomɛ hu ji Maon, Karmel, Zif, Yuta, Yezreel, Yokdeam, Zanoa, Kain, Gibea, kɛ Timna.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ekomɛ hu ji Halhul, Betzur, Gedor, Maarat, Betanot, kɛ Eltekon.
E peeɔ ma ekpa kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ekomɛ hu ji Kiriat Baal (nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kiriat Yearim ɔ), kɛ Raba.
E peeɔ ma enyɔ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Mahi nɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ji Bet Araba, Midin, Sekaka, Nibshan, Ngo ma a, kɛ Engedi.
E peeɔ ma ekpa kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a fie Yebus bi ɔmɛ nɛ hi Yerusalem ɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yebus bi ɔmɛ kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ mwɔɔ.
Zugba nɛ a ha Efraim kɛ Manase fa a Zugba nɛ a ha Yosef nina a, e huzu ɔ je Yordan pa a nya ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ, kɛ Yeriko pa a beleku je, kɛ ya gu nga kplanaa a nɔ, kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ be Yeriko he, kɛ ya su Betel tɔɔ.
E tsa nɔ kɛ ya gu Luz; nɛ e po mi kɛ ho Atarot Adar, he nɛ Ark bi ɔmɛ hi ɔ ya.
Huzu ɔ ma e yi si kɛ gu bonyoku je kɛ ya na Yaflet bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ya su Bet Horon sisi ɔ tɔɔ; e ya su Gezer hulɔ, nɛ e nya ya pi Mediterenia wo ɔ. Zugba nɛ Yosef nina, nɛ ji Manase fa a, kɛ Efraim na kaa a weto ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Efraim Bɔ nɛ a dla zugba a ngɔ ha Efraim bi ɔmɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ngɛ beleku je ɔ, a zugba a huzu ɔ je Atarot Adar kɛ ya su Bet Horon ngɛ yiti je ɔ tɔɔ.
Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ ya pi Mediterenia wo ɔ. Mikmetat ya je omleyi je.
Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ ngɛ beleku je ɔ, huzu ɔ bɔle si kɛ ya gu Tanat Shilo, kɛ ya su Yanoa beleku je.
Kɛ je Yanoa a, huzu ɔ ya gu Atarot, Naara, kɛ Yeriko, nɛ e kɛ e nya ya pi Yordan pa a. Jehanɛ huzu ɔ je Tapua, kɛ gu bonyoku je kɛ ya na Kana pa a, nɛ e ya gbe nya ngɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ nya.
Zugba nɛ a ha Efraim wɛtso ɔ kaa a weto ní nɛ a dla ngɔ ha mɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se hu, a ha Efraim bi ɔmɛ ma komɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi ngɛ Manase bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ mi.
Efraim bi ɔmɛ fie we Kanaan bi ɔmɛ kɛ ji Gezer; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Efraim bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ; se a plɛ pee Efraim bi ɔmɛ a nyɔguɛhi, nɛ a sɔmɔɔ mɛ.
Manase fa a A ngɔ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ɔ fa ko ngɔ ha we puɔ nya amɛ ekomɛ nɛ ji Yosef binyumu nɔkɔtɔma Manase nina.
Akɛnɛ Gilead tsɛ Makir, Manase bitɛte ɔ, tatsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ he je ɔ, a ha lɛ Gilead kɛ Bashan ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je.
Manase wɛtso ɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ha mɛ a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ngɛ Yordan bonyoku je.
Yosef bi Manase binyumuhi ji nihi nɛ daa si ha Manase we puɔ nya nɛ ɔmɛ.
Mɛ ji Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shekem, Hefer, kɛ Shemida.
Manase bi Makir bi ji Gilead, nɛ Gilead bi Hefer bi ji Zelofehad.
Zelofehad nɛ ɔ be binyumu; biyihi pɛ e fɔ.
A biɛhi ji Mala, Noa, Hogla, Milka, kɛ Tirza.
Yi nɛ ɔmɛ ba osɔfo Eleazar, Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, ba de ke, “Yawɛ fa Mose ke e ha wɔ weto ní kaa bɔ nɛ a ha wa tsɛ nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a, a ha mɛ weto ní kaa bɔ nɛ a ha a tsɛ nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Manase na ngwɔhe nyɔngma kɛ piɛ Gilead kɛ Bashan a he ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa a ha mɛ zugba ngɛ a nyɛ se kɛ a tsɛ se tsuo.
A ngɔ Gilead zugba a ngɔ ha Manase nina nɛ piɛ ɔ. Manase huzu ɔ je Asher kɛ gu Mikmetat ngɛ Shekem beleku je.
Huzu ɔ tsa nɔ kɛ gu leneyi je kɛ ya ná Entapua bi ɔmɛ.
Tapua zugba a peeɔ Manase nɔ́; se Tapua ma nɛ ngɛ Manase huzu ɔ nya a lɛɛ e peeɔ Efraim nina a a nɔ́.
Jehanɛ ɔ, huzu ɔ ma e yi si kɛ ya su Kana pa a nya.
