Mahi nɛ ngɛ pa a leneyi je ɔ, Manase zugba a nɔ a ngɛ lɛɛ, se Efraim níhi ji mɛ.
Manase huzu ɔ nyɛɛ pa a omleyi je hluu kɛ ya su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya.
Efraim zugba a ya je leneyi je; nɛ Manase nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ omleyi je; Mediterenia wo ɔ ji a huzu ngɛ bonyoku je.
A kɛ Asher wo huzu ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ a kɛ Isakar wo huzu ngɛ beleku je.
A ha Manase ma nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ kaa a weto ní ngɛ Isakar bi ɔmɛ kɛ Asher bi ɔmɛ a zugba a mi.
Mɛ ji Bet Shan, Ibleam, Dor, Endor, Taanak, Megido, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ. Manase bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a fie ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ hi lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he ba wa pe kekle ɔ po, a fie we Kanaan bi ɔmɛ tsuo, se mohu a nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a tsu ní ha mɛ.
Efraim kɛ Manase fa a bi zugba nɛ kle Yosef nina a ba de Yoshua ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o ha wɔ zugba a mi dlami kake pɛ kaa wa weto ní ɔ?
O le kaa Yawɛ gbaa wɔ, nɛ wa he hiɛ babauu.” Yoshua he nɔ ke, “Ke nyɛ he hiɛ babauu nɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ be nyɛ kpee ɔ, nyɛ ya gba hue ɔ ngɛ Periz bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Refaim bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ hi lejɛ ɔ.” A je nya ke, “Yo nɔ zugba a klee we ha wɔ.
Jehanɛ hu, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ Bet Shan kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yezreel kɔ̃ ɔ mi tsuo ngɛ dade ta zugba lɛhi.” Yoshua de Yosef we ɔ nɛ ji Efraim kɛ Manase fa a ke, “Niinɛ, nyɛ he hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ he wa saminya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, pi zugba a mi dlami kake pɛ nɛ nyɛ ma na.
Yo nɔ zugba a maa pee nyɛ nɔ́.
Akɛnɛ hue ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ gba hue ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ, kɛ zugba nɛ tsa nɔ kɛ yaa a tsuo.
E ngɛ mi kaa Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ngɛ dade ta zugba lɛhi nɛ a he wa mohu, se nyɛ maa fie mɛ kɛ̃.”
Zugba nɛ piɛ ɔ dlami Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ zugba a ta a, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Shilo, nɛ a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e piɛ Israel wɛtso kpaago nɛ a ha we mɛ zugba a eko lolo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yoshua de Israel ma a ke, “Mɛni be po nyɛ maa to tsle kɛ yaa si loko nyɛ ma ba ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ?
Nyɛɛ hla nyumuhi etɛ kɛ je wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi.
Ma tsɔ mɛ nɛ a ya kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Zugba a he nɛ a maa suɔ nɛ e pee a weto ní ɔ, a pee e he womi kɛ ba ha mi.
A ma gba zugba a mi kpaago; Yuda nɛ hi e huzu ɔ nɔ ngɛ leneyi je, nɛ Yosef we ɔ hu nɛ hi e huzu ɔ nɔ ngɛ omleyi je.
Zugba a nɛ a gba mi kpaago ɔ, nyɛɛ kale mi gbami ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko, nɛ nyɛɛ ngma kɛ ba ha mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma fɔ sɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
Levi bi ɔmɛ be zugba a eko nae; mɛɛ lɛɛ a blɔ nya ni ji kaa a maa ye osɔfo kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Gad, Ruben, kɛ Manase fa a, mɛ hu Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose ha mɛ a weto ní momo ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je.” Ni ɔmɛ nɛ a hla a pue nɔ kɛ ho, konɛ a ya kpa zugba a nɔ, nɛ a pee zugba a he womi kaa bɔ nɛ Yoshua fa mɛ ɔ. Yoshua de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee e he womi, konɛ nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma fɔ sɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ Shilo hiɛ ɔ, ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.” Ni ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya kpa zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ a pee zugba a he womi, nɛ a tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a gba mi kpaago ha, kɛ mahi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Yoshua ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ ngɛ Shilo.
Yoshua fɔ sɔ kɛ bi Yawɛ ga womi ha mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e dla zugba a ngɔ ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ. Zugba nɛ a ha Benyamin wɛtso ɔ Sɔ nɛ a fɔ ɔ je Benyamin bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a we puɔ nya amɛ ji kekleekle nihi nɛ a ha mɛ zugba.
A zugba a ngɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ kɛ Yosef wɛtso ɔ a kpɛti.
A huzu nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ je Yordan pa a nya, nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ya gu Yeriko kasa nya, ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ nyɛɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ho bonyoku je ya; nɛ e ya gbe nya ngɛ Betaven zugba kplanaa a nɔ.
Huzu ɔ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛɛ leneyi je kɛ gu Luz nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Betel ɔ, kɛ kple si kɛ ho Atarot Adar ya, ngɛ yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Bet Horon sisi ɔ leneyi je.
Kɛ je yo ɔ beleku je ɔ, huzu ɔ gba kɛ gu he kpa.
E ka e yi si kɛ ya gu leneyi je hluu kɛ ya su Kiriat Baal ngɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ nɔ́ ɔ mi.
Kiriat Baal biɛ kpa ji Kiriat Yearim.
Bonyoku je huzu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Leneyi je huzu ɔ je Kiriat Yearim ma a nya, nɛ e ma e yi si kɛ ho Neftoa pa a nya ya.
Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ kple si kɛ ho yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ kuɔ si ya, ngɛ Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ omleyi je.
E gu Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ a yoku ɔ leneyi je, kɛ ho Enrogel ya.
Huzu ɔ gba kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya Enshemesh, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ya su Gelilot ngɛ Adumim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ hanɔ.
Jehanɛ e kple si kɛ ya su Bohan tɛ ɔ he.
(Bohan ji Ruben binyumu ko).
Huzu ɔ ya be ngɛ kpongu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ he ɔ we omleyi je, nɛ e kple si kɛ sɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.
Huzu ɔ plɛ kɛ ya gu Bet Hogla kasa nya ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ e ya gbe nya ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ kɔ̃tɔ̃ ɔ mi, he nɛ Yordan pa a ya sɛ Ngo wo ɔ mi ngɛ ɔ. Huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yordan pa a ji huzu ɔ ngɛ beleku je.
Huzuhi nɛ bɔle zugba a nɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ná kaa a weto ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mahi nɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ná we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Yeriko, Bet Hogla, Emek Keziz, Bet Araba, Zemaraim, Betel, Avim, Para, Ofra, Kefaramoni, Ofni, kɛ Geba.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ekomɛ hu ji Gibeon, Rama, Beerot, Mizpa, Kefira, Moza, Rekem, Irpeel, Tarala, Zela, Haelef, Yebus (loo Yerusalem), Gibea, kɛ Kiriat Yearim.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Zugba nɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ná kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Zugba nɛ a ha Simeon wɛtso ɔ Sɔ enyɔne ɔ je Simeon wɛtso ɔ, nɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ ná a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
A zugba a ya je Yuda wɛtso ɔ nɔ́ ɔ mi.
Mahi nɛ ngɛ a zugba a mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Beersheba, Sheba, Molada, Hazar Shual, Bala, Ezem, Eltolad, Betul, Horma, Ziklag, Bet Markabot, Hazar Susa, Bet Lebaot, Sharuhen.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ etɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Ekpahi ji Ain, Rimon, Eter, Ashan.
E peeɔ ma eywiɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
A kɛ kɔpehi tsuo nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya si Baalat Beer (loo Rama) ngɛ leneyi je tɔɔ ɔ piɛ he.
Zugba nɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ ná kaa a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Akɛnɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ zugba a kle tsɔ ha mɛ he je ɔ, a po fa ngɔ ha Simeon wɛtso ɔ. Zugba nɛ a ha Zebulun wɛtso ɔ Sɔ etɛne ɔ je Zebulun wɛtso ɔ, nɛ Zebulun bi ɔmɛ ná a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
A huzu ɔ nya ya su Sarid tɔɔ.
E kuɔ kɛ gu bonyoku je kɛ ho Mareal ya, kɛ ya be ngɛ Dabeshet, kɛ pa a nɛ ngɛ Yokneam beleku je ɔ nya.
Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ dɔ e yi kɛ je Sarid kɛ gu beleku je kɛ ya na Kislot Tabor huzu ɔ, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ho Daberat kɛ Yafia ya.
E tsa nɔ kɛ gu beleku je kɛ ho Gat Hefer kɛ Etkazin ya, nɛ e dɔ e yi kɛ ya su Nea, ngɛ Rimon blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Huzu ɔ lɔgɔ si ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya Hanaton, nɛ e ya gbe nya ngɛ Iftahel kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Mahi nɛ ngɛ a huzu ɔ mi ji Kata, kɛ Nahalal, Shimron, Idala, kɛ Betlehem.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Weto ní nɛ Zebulun wɛtso ɔ ná we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Zugba nɛ a ha Isakar wɛtso ɔ Sɔ eywiɛne ɔ je Isakar wɛtso ɔ, nɛ Isakar bi ɔmɛ ná a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
Mahi nɛ ngɛ huzu ɔ mi ji Yezreel, Kesulot, Shunem, Hafaraim, Shion, Anaharat, Rabit, Kishion, Ebez, Remet, Enganim, Enhada, Betpazez.
Huzu ɔ ya su Tabor, Shahazuma, Bet Shemesh, kɛ ya pi Yordan pa a. E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ ekpa kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Weto ní nɛ Isakar bi ɔmɛ na we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Zugba nɛ a ha Asher wɛtso ɔ Sɔ enuɔne ɔ je Asher wɛtso ɔ, nɛ Asher bi ɔmɛ ná a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
Mahi nɛ ngɛ a zugba a mi ji Helkat, Hali, Beten, Akshaf, Alam Melek, Amad, kɛ Mishal.
A huzu ɔ nya su Karmel, kɛ Shihor Libnat ngɛ bonyoku je.
Jehanɛ, e lɔgɔ kɛ ho beleku je ya, kɛ ya su Betdagon, ya be ngɛ Zebulun, kɛ Iftahel kɔ̃ ɔ mi, kɛ gu omleyi je, kɛ ho Betemek, kɛ Neyel ya, nɛ e tsa nɔ ja kɛ ya gu Kabul, Ebron, Rehob, Hamon, kɛ Kana kɛ ya su Sidon tɔɔ.
Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ lɔgɔ kɛ gu Rama, nɛ e ya su Tiro, ma nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he ɔ. Huzu ɔ dɔ kɛ ho Hosa ya, nɛ e nya ya ta ngɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ nya.
Ma nɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he: Mahalab, Akzib, Uma, Afek, kɛ Rehob.
E peeɔ ma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Weto ní nɛ Asher bi ɔmɛ ná we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Zugba nɛ a ha Naftali wɛtso ɔ Sɔ ekpane ɔ je Naftali wɛtso ɔ, nɛ Naftali bi ɔmɛ ná a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
A zugba a huzu ɔ je Helef kɛ ya na tso ngua a nɛ ngɛ Zaananim ɔ, kɛ ya su Adaminekeb kɛ Yamnia, kɛ ho Lakum ya, nɛ e nya ya ta ngɛ Yordan pa a nya.
Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ plɛ tsɔɔ bonyoku je kɛ ya gu Aznot Tabor kɛ ho Hukok ya.
Naftali kɛ Zebulun wo huzu ngɛ leneyi je; a kɛ Asher wo huzu ngɛ bonyoku je, nɛ Yordan pa a peeɔ a huzu ngɛ beleku je.
Naftali bi ɔmɛ a mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Zidim, Zer, Hamat, Rakat, Kineret, Adama, Rama, Hazor, Kedesh, Edrei, Enhazor, Yiron, Migdalel, Horem, Betanat, Bet Shemesh.
E peeɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ nɛɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Weto ní nɛ Naftali wɛtso ɔ ná we puɔ we puɔ nya nya ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
Zugba nɛ a ha Dan wɛtso ɔ Sɔ kpaagone ɔ je Dan wɛtso ɔ, nɛ Dan bi ɔmɛ ná a weto ní we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
Mahi nɛ ngɛ a zugba a mi ji Zora, Eshtaol, Irshemesh, Shaalbim, Aiyalon, Itla, Elon, Timna, Ekron, Elteke, Gibeton, Baalat, Yehud, Beneberak, Gatrimon, Meyarkon, Rakon, kɛ zugba a nɛ bɔle Yopa a. Benɛ Dan bi ɔmɛ a zugba je a dɛ ɔ, a kuɔ yo ɔ nɛ a ya tua Laish ma a.
A gbe ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a ngɔ ma a ngɔ pee a nɔ́.
A tsake ma a biɛ Laish ɔ, nɛ a ngɔ a nɛ̃, Dan biɛ ngɔ wo ma a. Weto ní nɛ Dan wɛtso ɔ ná we puɔ nya we we puɔ nya ji ma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he kɔpehi.
A dla zugba a gbe nya Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ dla zugba a ta a, a ngɔ zugba a fa ko ngɔ ha Nun bi Yoshua kaa lɛ nitsɛ e weto ní.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ, a ha Yoshua Timnat Sera ngɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ.
Ma nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e bi ke a ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E dla po ma a ehe, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. Weto ní nɛ osɔfo Eleazar, Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ Israel wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ dla kɛ ha ma a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
A fɔ sɔ kɛ bi Yawɛ ga womi, nɛ a dla weto ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Shilo kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Bɔ nɛ a dla zugba a ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wesa he mahi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Yoshua ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hla wesa he mahi nyɛɛ to kaa bɔ nɛ i fa Mose ke e de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ. Ke nɔ ko nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ, nɛ pi kaa e je blɔ nɛ e gbe nɔ ɔ, e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ lue yelɔ ɔ nine ko su e nɔ.
E tu fo kɛ ya ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi, nɛ e ya da si ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e jaje bɔ nɛ e ba lɛ ha ngɔ tsɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ maa ba ma a mi, nɛ a ma ha lɛ he ko nɛ e hi.
Ke lue yelɔ ɔ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ kó ngmɛɛ e he kɛ ha lɛ.
A baa e yi, ejakaa pi abofu nya nɛ e gbe nɔ ɔ, se mohu e nine nɛ ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ.
É hi ma nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya su be nɛ a maa kojo lɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi; jehanɛ hu, kɛ ya su be nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ ma gbo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ ɔ ma nyɛ kpale kɛ ya lɛ nitsɛ e ma a mi, he nɛ e tu fo kɛ je ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ɔ, mahi nɛ a hla kaa wesa hehi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Kedesh ngɛ Galilea, ngɛ Naftali yo ɔ nɔ; Shekem ngɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Kiriat Arba ngɛ Yuda yo ɔ nɔ.
Kiriat Arba biɛ kpa ji Hebron.
Yordan pa a beleku je, ngɛ yo zugba kpataa a nɔ, ngɛ Yeriko beleku je ɔ, a hla ma nɛ ɔmɛ: Bezer, ngɛ Ruben zugba a mi, Ramot Gilead ngɛ Gad zugba a mi, kɛ Golan ngɛ Bashan, ngɛ Manase zugba a mi.
Wesa he mahi nɛ a hla kɛ ha Israel ma a tsuo, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to mɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi kɛ he e yi wami kɛ je lue yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi.
A be nɔ nɛ ya sa we nɛ ɔ gbee, ja a kojo lɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi lolo.
Levi bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ Levi nikɔtɔma amɛ ba osɔfo Eleazar, Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ a mi ɔ a ngɔ ngɛ Shilo, ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.
A kɛ hiami nɛ ɔ ba fɔ a hɛ mi ke, “Yawɛ fa kɛ gu Mose nɔ ke a ha wɔ mahi nɛ waa hi mi, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi hehi kɛ ha wa we mi lohwehi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a, Israel bi ɔmɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ma komɛ, kɛ lohwe lɛmi hehi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba amɛ a mi.
Jinɛ a ngɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ nyɔngma kɛ etɛ kɛ ha Yuda, Simeon, kɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔmɛ momo.
Se a fɔ sɔ, nɛ a he ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ je Kohat we puɔ nya ngɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ mi.
Osɔfo Aaron nina ji nimli nɛ ɔmɛ.
A ha Kohat bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ma nyɔngma ngɛ Efraim, Dan, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ a zugba amɛ a mi.
A ha Gershon we puɔ nya ma nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ngɛ Isakar, Asher Naftali, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ a zugba amɛ a mi.
A ha Merari bi ɔmɛ ma nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ Ruben, Gad, kɛ Zebulun a zugba amɛ a mi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ fɔ sɔ kɛ dla ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugba amɛ ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa kɛ gu Mose nɔ ke a pee ɔ.
-Yuda kɛ Simeon a zugba amɛ a mi ɔ, mahi nɛ a ha Aaron nina nɛ ji Kohat bi nɛ je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kekleekle sɔ ɔ je.
A ha mɛ Arba kɛ e he lohwe lɛmi zugba.
(Anak tsɛ ji Arba a nɛ).
Ma nɛ ɔ biɛ kpa ji Hebron, nɛ e ngɛ Yuda yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ma nɛ ɔ he zugba amɛ, kɛ e he kɔpe ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ kɛ ha Yefune binyumu Kaleb kaa e weto ní momo.
A ngɔ ma kpa komɛ hu ngɔ piɛ Hebron kɛ e he lohwe lɛmi zugba amɛ a he ngɔ ha osɔfo Aaron nina.
(Hebron ji wesa he ma amɛ a kpɛti kake).
Ma kpa amɛ ji Libna, Yatir, Eshtemoa, Holon, Debir, Ain, Yuta, Bet Shemesh, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
E peeɔ ma nɛɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Simeon wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi.
Jehanɛ, a ha osɔfo Aaron nina a ma eywiɛ ngɛ Benyamin zugba a mi: Gibeon, Geba, Anatot, kɛ Almon, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugba amɛ.
Mahi, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi tsuo nɛ a ha osɔfo Aaron nina a peeɔ nyɔngma kɛ etɛ.
A ha Kohat bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ ma komɛ ngɛ Efraim zugba a mi.
A ha mɛ ma eywiɛ: Shekem (nɛ ji wesa he ma) ngɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ, Gezer, Kibzaim, Bet Horon, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
Jehanɛ, a ha mɛ ma eywiɛ ngɛ Dan zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Elteke, Gibeton, Aiyalon, Gatrimon, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
A ha mɛ ma enyɔ ngɛ Manase fa a nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ a zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Taanak, Gatrimon, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
Mahi tsuo, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi nɛ Kohat bi nɛ piɛ ɔ na ji nyɔngma.
Levi bi ɔmɛ a we puɔ nya kake nɛ a tsɛɛ Gershon ɔ na ma enyɔ ngɛ Manase fa a nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Golan ngɛ Bashan (wesa he ma amɛ a kpɛti kake), kɛ Beeshtera, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
A ná ma eywiɛ ngɛ Isakar zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Kishion, Daberat, Yarmut, Enganim, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
A ná ma eywiɛ ngɛ Asher zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Mishal, Abdon, Helkat, Rehob, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
A ná ma etɛ ngɛ Naftali zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji wesa he ma Kedesh nɛ ngɛ Galilea a, Hamot Dor, Kartan, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
Mahi kɛ lohwe lɛmi zugbahi nɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ na we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ, nɛ ji Merari we puɔ nya a, ná ma eywiɛ ngɛ Zebulun zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Yokneam, Karta, Dimna, Nahalal, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
A ná ma eywiɛ ngɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ a zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Bezer, Yahaz, Kedemot, Mefaat, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
Jehanɛ, a ná ma eywiɛ ngɛ Gad zugba a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Ramot ngɛ Gilead (wesa he ma amɛ a kpɛti kake), Mahanaim, Heshbon, Yazer, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugbahi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mahi tsuo nɛ a ha Merari bi ɔmɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
-Zugba nɛ Israel ma a ná kaa a weto ní ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ji ma nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi hehi.
Israel ngɔ zugba a Yawɛ ngɔ zugba a tsuo ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e ka a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ. Benɛ a nine su zugba a nɔ ɔ, a hi lejɛ ɔ. Yawɛ ha mɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ e ka a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke e maa pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we mɛ; ejakaa Yawɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ye mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ wo Israel ma a si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ, ekoeko tlɔɛ si; a ná lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yoshua wo Ruben, Gad kɛ Manase fa a blɔ Jehanɛ, Yoshua tsɛ Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ pee; nɛ nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ si we nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, se mohu nyɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ sisiisi.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tue mi jɔmi kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ho zugba a nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ná kaa nyɛ weto ní ɔ nɔ ya.
Zugba nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose ngɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nyɛɛ pee e suɔmi nya ní; nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, kɛ nyɛ klaa tsuo.” -Yoshua gbaa mɛ, nɛ e wo mɛ blɔ.
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ pee kplɔkɔtɔtsɛmɛ kɛ yaa we; nyɛ ngɛ nahi babauu, sika hiɔ, sika tsu, akɔblee, dade, kɛ heha ní babauu.
Ke nyɛ ya su ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ dla ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ kpɔ ngɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a pue blɔ kɛ ho we ya.
Mose ha Manase wɛtso fa kake zugba ngɛ Yordan beleku je momo.
Wɛtso fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ Yoshua ha mɛ zugba ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a kpale kɛ ho a zugba amɛ a nɔ ya.
A je Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ a he ngɛ Shilo, ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ya, ngɛ Gilead, he nɛ a ngɔ ha mɛ momo ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ gu Mose nɔ fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a nya a Benɛ Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a ba su Gelilot, ngɛ Yordan pa a he ɔ, a ma bɔ sami la tɛ agbo ko ngɛ pa a nya.
Israel bi kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ nu kaa Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a ya ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a he ngɛ Gelilot, ngɛ a zugba a mi.
Benɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ ba nu sane nɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Shilo, konɛ a kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ, Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a ya hwu ta.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tsɔ osɔfo Eleazar binyumu Finehas kɛ ho Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a a ngɔ ya ngɛ Gilead zugba a nɔ.
Ma nimeli nyɔngma, kɛ Finehas ho.
Israel wɛtso nyɔngma amɛ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ, a wɛtsoyihi ji ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ.
A ba Gilead nɛ a ba na Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a.
A bi mɛ ngɛ Yawɛ ma a tsuo nane mi ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ pee yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ si Israel Mawu ɔ?
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ kua Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã!
Anɛ nyɛ kaii we yayami nɛ wa pee ngɛ Peor, benɛ Yawɛ kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ gbla lɛ nitsɛ e ma a tue ɔ lo?
Wa ngɛ nɔ́ nae kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ jamɛ a yayami ɔ he.
Anɛ jamɛ a yayami ɔ pi ha wɔ lo?
Mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma kua Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ be lɛ sɔmɔe hu lo?
Ke nyɛ kua Yawɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ma na Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo he abofu hwɔɔ!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ zugba a nɔ hí nɛ́ a ja Mawu ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ zugba a nɔ, he nɛ e bo tsu ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ha nɛ a ha nyɛ zugba ko ngɛ wa ngɔ.
Nyɛ ko tsɔ atuã kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko pee wɔ hu atuã tsɔli kaa nyɛ maa ma bɔ sami la tɛ kpa ko kɛ piɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Anɛ nyɛ kaii we Zera binyumu Akan lo?
Benɛ Akan tɔ mlaa nɛ kɔɔ níhi nɛ sa kaa a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ he ɔ, a gbla Israel ma a tsuo tue; pi Akan nɔ kake pɛ nɛ gbo ngɛ yayami nɛ ɔ he.” Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a ha wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ nɛ je bonyoku je ɔ heto ke, “Yawɛ, Mawu Ope!
Yawɛ Mawu Ope!
Lɛ pɛ nɛ e le nɔ́ he je nɛ wa pee enɛ ɔ, nɛ wa suɔ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛɛ le!
Ke wa tsɔ atuã, nɛ wa yi Yawɛ anɔkuale ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ gbe wɔ!
Ke wa bui Yawɛ tue, nɛ wa ma wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa bɔ sami la tɛ, nɛ́ waa sã sami bɔhi, loo ngma bɔhi, loo tue mi jɔmi bɔhi ngɛ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ gbla wa tue!
Dɛbi!
Wa pee enɛ ɔ, ejakaa wa ye gbeye kaa hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, nyɛ nina ma de wa nina ke, ‘Mɛni blɔ fa mi nɔ́ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɔ?
Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ Yordan pa a ngɔ wo huzu ngɛ waa kɛ nyɛ, Ruben bi, kɛ Gad bi wa kpɛti.
Nyɛɛ kɛ Yawɛ be nɔ́ ko peemi.’ Ke e ba mi ja a, nyɛ nina ma ha wa nina maa jɔɔ Yawɛ jami.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wa ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ; pi kaa a sã sami bɔ, loo bɔ kpa komɛ ngɛ nɔ; se mohu kaa okadi ko kɛ ha waa kɛ nyɛ, kɛ yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ wa se ɔ, kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa jaa Yawɛ ngɛ bo tsu klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ wa sãã sami bɔhi, tue mi jɔmi bɔhi, kɛ bɔ kpahi.
Wa pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, nyɛ nina kó ba de wa nina ke a be blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ko ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ.
Wa juɛmi ji, ke e maa ba mi ja a, wa nina ma nyɛ ma de ke, ‘Nyɛ nɛ́ kaa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ lo?
A ma bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ, pi nɛ a sã sami bɔ, loo bɔ kpa komɛ ngɛ nɔ; se mohu kaa e pee okadi ha nyɛ nina, kɛ wa nina.’ Wa be Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã tsɔe kɔkɔɔkɔ, nɛ wa be e se jee gblegbleegble kɛ ya ma bɔ sami la tɛ kpa ko nɛ waa sã sami bɔ, loo niye ní bɔ, loo bɔ kpa ko ngɛ nɔ.
Wa be bɔ sami la tɛ kpa ko mae kɛ piɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi ɔ he.” Benɛ osɔfo Finehas, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ ji wɛtsoyi nyɔngma amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ nu munyuhi nɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ, Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a tu ɔ, a bua jɔ a he saminya.
Osɔfo Eleazar bi Finehas de mɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa na kaa Yawɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ.
Nyɛ tsɔ we e hɛ mi atuã; mohu ɔ, nyɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je tue gblami nɛ Yawɛ kɛ maa ba a nɔ ɔ mi.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Finehas kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ je Ruben bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Gad bi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ Gilead; nɛ a kpale kɛ ba Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, ba bɔ mɛ amaniɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a je Mawu yi.
A de we hu ke a maa hwu ta nɛ a kpata zugba a nɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Gad bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ hɛ mi.
Ruben bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Gad bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ ji odase ha wɔ, kɛ nyɛ tsuo, kaa Yawɛ ji Mawu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ biɛ ke “Odase”.
Yoshua sɛ yemi munyu Be saii se ɔ, Yawɛ ha Israel tue mi jɔmi, nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ doo we a nya hu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yoshua bwɔ kotokoto.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ Israel ma a tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ: ma nimeli, asafoatsɛmɛ, kojoli, kɛ tsɔli.
E de mɛ ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i bwɔ.
Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee je ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɛ he.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ hwu ta ha nyɛ.
I dla weto ní ngɔ ha nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ momo.
Lɔ ɔ ji je ma amɛ nɛ a yi a nɔ lolo ɔ, kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ i ye a nɔ momo ɔ a zugba amɛ, kɛ je Yordan pa a nya ngɛ beleku je, kɛ ya su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya ngɛ bonyoku je.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa gbee senyasenya; nɛ e maa fie mɛ kɛ je nyɛ blɔ mi.
Nyɛ maa ngɔ a zugba a kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo nyɛ si ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ sisiisi.
Nyɛ ko si eko, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ ko bɔ.
Nyɛ ko wo a mawu ɔmɛ a ta, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ a biɛhi kó ka kita; nyɛ ko ja mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko kpla si ha mɛ.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ anɔkuale, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ. Yawɛ fie je ma nguahi nɛ a he wa kɛ je nyɛ blɔ mi, nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nyɛ.
Nyɛ ti nɔ kake ma nyɛ wo nihi akpe fo, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ta hwue ha nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Ke nyɛ kpale ngɛ e se, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je ma amɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ ya bɔ, nɛ nyɛ ha nyɛ yi ɔmɛ gba mɛ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɔ a yi ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa, ke nyɛ hia kɛ yaa a, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ be je ma nɛ ɔmɛ fiee kɛ je nyɛ blɔ mi hu.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa pee kaa klama ko nɛ a tsɔ nyɛ, loo muɔ nɛ a tsua ngɛ nyɛ sisi.
A maa pee kaa kpa nɛ a kɛ ngɛ nyɛ se mi fiae, nɛ maa sãã nyɛ, loo mio nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ mi gbɔɔe.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma tsa nɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be piɛe ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.
“Jehanɛ, ye gbenɔ be su.
Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ le ngɛ e tsui mi, kɛ e klaa mi kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ ní kpakpa amɛ tsuo nɛ e wo si ke e ma ha nyɛ ɔ. E ye e si womi ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa nɔ; e si we eko.
Se, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ e wo nyɛ a he si ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e maa gbla nyɛ tue kɛ yaa si nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɔ, ke nyɛ bui lɛ tue ɔ. Ke nyɛ yi somi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi, nɛ nyɛ ja mɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ abofu maa gbla nyɛ tue, nɛ e be kɛe kulaa nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be piɛe ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.”
Yoshua tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Shekem Yoshua bua Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya kɛ ba kpe ngɛ Shekem.
E tsɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kojoli ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ ba Mawu hɛ mi.
Yoshua de ma a tsuo ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Blema lokoo ɔ, nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi Yufrate pa a se, nɛ a ja mawu kpahi.
Nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tera a ji Abraham kɛ Nahor a tsɛ.
I ngɔ nyɛ nɛ̃, Abraham kɛ je zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ nɔ, nɛ i kpaka lɛ kɛ gu Kanaan zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ i ha lɛ nina babauu.
I ha lɛ Isak.
I ha Isak fɔ Yakob kɛ Esau.
I ngɔ Edom yo nɔ zugba a ngɔ ha Esau kaa e weto ní; se nyɛ nɛ̃, Yakob kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ya hi Egipt.
Pee se ɔ, i tsɔ Mose kɛ Aaron Egipt, nɛ i ha haomi nɛ nya wa ba Egipt nɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i kpaka nyɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ; i je nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt, nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ ta okpɔngɔ nɔ hili.
Benɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya su Wo Tsu ɔ he ɔ, a fa kue ha mi, nɛ i ha diblii wo ngɛ a kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Nyagbe ɔ, i ha wo ɔ ba ha Egipt bi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ i pee Egipt ɔ.
“ ‘Nyɛ hi nga kplanaa a nɔ be babauu.
Pee se ɔ, i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je.
A kɛ nyɛ hwu ta; se i ha nyɛ ye a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ a zugba a. I kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ i ha nyɛ blɔ mi tɛ̃ ha nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Zipor bi Balak, Moab matsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ ba hwu ta.
E tsɔ ya de Beor binyumu Balaam ke e gbiɛ nyɛ.
Se i bui Balaam tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e gbaa nyɛ mohu.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ i gu kɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Balak dɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ po Yordan pa a, nɛ nyɛ ba Yeriko.
Yeriko bi ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ hwu ta kaa bɔ nɛ Amor, Periz, Kanaan, Hit, Girgash, Hiv, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ tsuo hu kɛ nyɛ hwu ta a.
Se i ha nyɛ ye mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ma a, i ha sawale nu mɛ.
I pee enɛ ɔ kɛ fie Amor matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ blɔ mi.
Pi nyɛ klaate, nɛ pi nyɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ ye kunimi nɛ ɔ. I ha nyɛ zugba nɛ́ nyɛ gbo we he dengme ko, kɛ mahi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ po.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ oliv ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsu a he ní ɔ a mi ní yee.’ ” Yoshua ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ saminya ngɛ anɔkuale mi.
Nyɛ je mawu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ja ngɛ Mesopotamia kɛ Egipt ɔ ngɔ pue he, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ Yawɛ pɛ.
Ke nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ ma sɔmɔ lɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ; ke mawu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ja ngɛ Mesopotamia a jio, loo Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ a mawu ɔmɛ jio.
Se imi kɛ ye we ɔ lɛɛ, wa ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ.” Ma a he nɔ ke, “Wa be Yawɛ sie nɛ wa ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi!
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ lɛ je wɔ, kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi ngɛ Egipt, nɛ wa na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ. E baa wa yi, nɛ e je wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ wa gu ɔ. Yawɛ fie je ma amɛ, kɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛ je wa blɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ hu Yawɛ lɛ wa ma sɔmɔ; lɛ ji wa Mawu.” Yoshua ya nɔ, nɛ e de ma a ke, “E ngɛ mi ja; se eko ɔ, nyɛ be Yawɛ nyɛe ma sɔmɔ.
Mawu klɔuklɔu ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ yayami ɔmɛ be nyɛ pae.
A kɛ lɛ plee we nɔ́ he, nɛ ke nyɛ si lɛ nɛ nyɛ ya sɔmɔ ma se mawuhi ɔ, e mi mi maa wo la, nɛ e maa gbla nyɛ tue.
E ngɛ mi kaa e pee nyɛ kpakpa hyɛ lɛɛ, se e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.” Ma a de Yoshua ke, “Dɛbi!
Wa ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ.” Jehanɛ, Yoshua de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ji odase yeli kaa nyɛ de ke nyɛ ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ.” Ma a he nɔ ke, “Ee, wɔ lɛ wa de ja; odase yeli ji wɔ.” Yoshua kɛ fɔ a hɛ mi ke, “Ke jã a, lɛɛ nyɛ je ma se mawu ɔmɛ ngɔ hɛ pue he, nɛ nyɛɛ wo si kaa nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ anɔkuale.” Ma a de Yoshua ke, “Wa ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ. Wa maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yoshua kɛ ma a so somi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ngɛ Shekem, nɛ e wo mɛ mlaahi, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ́ a ye nɔ.
Yoshua ngma mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo Mawu mlaa womi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ tɛ agbo ko ngɔ ma tso ngua a sisi ngɛ Yawɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. E de ma a tsuo ke, “Tɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee odase ha wɔ.
E nu munyu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ kɛ wɔ tu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e ba mi kaa nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã a, e maa ye odase kɛ si nyɛ.” Jehanɛ, Yoshua wo ma a blɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpale kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e tita nɔ ya.
Yoshua kɛ Eleazar gbo Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Yoshua, Nun bi ɔ ba gbo.
E ye jeha lafa kɛ nyɔngma.
A pu lɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ, ngɛ Timnat Sera, ngɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ, ngɛ Gaash yo ɔ omleyi je.
Yoshua wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, ma a sɔmɔ Yawɛ.
Yoshua gbenɔ se, be mi nɛ ma nimeli nɛ na ní nguanguahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ tsu ha Israel ɔ na we nɛ a gbo lolo ɔ, a ya nɔ nɛ a sɔmɔ Yawɛ ja nɔuu.
A pu Yosef wuhi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba a ngɛ Shekem, ngɛ zugba ko nɛ Yakob he ɔ mi.
E he zugba nɛ ɔ kɛ sika hiɔ kpɔ lafa ngɛ Shekem tsɛ, Hamor bimɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Zugba nɛ ɔ ba pee Yosef nina a weto ní.
Aaron bi Eleazar hu ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Gibea ngɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ, he nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ha e binyumu Finehas ɔ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Womi nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ Israel blema sane komɛ, kɛ je be nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ Kanaan zugba a kɛ ya si be nɛ a to matsɛ yemi sisi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, blɔ nya tomi kpakpa ko be, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ.
Manyadali nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni komɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ je mɛ, nɛ a ba da Israel ma a nya, nɛ a tsu ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ komɛ kɛ he ma a yi wami.
A ti nihi fuu tsu ní kaa tatsɛmɛ, se pi sane kojoli.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a le e he sane wawɛɛ ji Samson nɛ wa naa e he sane ngɛ yi - ɔ. Ní kasemi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji kaa Israel ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ e ma ji lɛ.
Ke Israel kua Mawu ɔ, Mawu ngɔɔ ma a kɛ woɔ a he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nɛ a naa amanehlu babauu.
Ke Israel na a he yayami, nɛ a pia a he, nɛ a fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, Mawu hu naa mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ a haomi slɔɔto ɔmɛ a mi.

Yuda kɛ Simeon nu Adonibezek Yoshua gbenɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ bi Yawɛ ke, “Wa kpɛti mɛnɔmɛ ma ya tua Kanaan bi ɔmɛ kekleekle?” Yawɛ de mɛ ke, “Yuda wɛtso ɔ maa sɛ hlami; i ngɔ zugba a ngɔ wo a dɛ mi.” Yuda bi ɔmɛ de a nyɛmimɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ho zugba a nɛ a ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ nɔ ya, nɛ waa kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ya hwu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, waa kɛ nyɛ maa ya nyɛ hu nyɛ zugba a nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ ho.
Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ hia nɛ a gba ta a, Yawɛ ngɔ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Periz bi ɔmɛ ngɔ wo a dɛ mi, nɛ a gbe a kpɛti nihi akpe nyɔngma ngɛ Bezek.
A ya na Adonibezek ngɛ Bezek, nɛ a kɛ lɛ hwu ta.
Adonibezek tu fo, se a nyɛɛ e se, nɛ a ya nu lɛ, nɛ a po e nine gɔleku, kɛ e nane gɔleku.
Adonibezek de ke, “I po matsɛmɛ nyingmi kpaago a nine gɔlekuhi, kɛ a nane gɔlekuhi nɛ i ha a kukuɔ ní ngɛ ye okplɔɔ sisi hyɛ; nɔ́ nɛ i pee be ko ɔ, lɔ ɔ he hiɔ pɛ Mawu wo mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.” A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Yerusalem ya, nɛ e ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda ye Yerusalem kɛ Hebron nɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya tua Yerusalem, nɛ a ngɔ ma a.
A kɛ klaate gbe ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a mɛ ma a he la.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ya tua Kanaan bi nɛ ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nga nɔ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Jehanɛ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya tua Kanaan bi nɛ ngɛ Hebron nɛ sa a, e biɛ ji Kiriat Arba a, nɛ a gbe Sheshai, Ahiman, kɛ Talmai bi ɔmɛ.
Otniel ye Debir ma a nɔ kunimi Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a ya tua Debir nɛ sa a, a tsɛɛ lɛ Kiriat Sefer ɔ. Kaleb de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ma tua Kiriat Sefer nɛ e maa ngɔ ma a, ma ha lɛ ye biyo Aksa nɛ e ngɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Otniel, Kaleb senɔ nyumu Kenaz binyumu ɔ ya ngɔ ma a; nɛ Kaleb kɛ e biyo Aksa a ha lɛ.
Benɛ a kpee Aksa a, e wo e huno ɔ yi mi ke e bi e ngatsɛ ɔ ngmɔ zugba ko.
Aksa kple si kɛ je e teji ɔ nɔ, nɛ Kaleb bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o suɔ nɛ ma pee ha mo?” Aksa he nɔ ke, “Moo ke mi nɔ́ ko.
O ha mi zugba ngɛ leneyi je he nɛ nyu be momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ha mi he ko nɛ nyu ngɛ kɛ piɛ he!” Nɛ Kaleb ha lɛ hehi nɛ nyu ngɛ, ngɛ yo nɔ kɛ kɔ̃ mi.
Yuda kɛ Benyamin ye kunimi Mose ngatsɛ, Ken no ɔ nina nɛ ji Ken bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ je Yeriko, tã ma a mi kɛ ba Yuda nga a nɔ, ngɛ Arad leneyi je, nɛ a kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ ba hi si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ ho ya tua Kanaan bi nɛ ngɛ Zefat ɔ.
A gbe mɛ basabasa, nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; nɛ a wo ma a biɛ ke Horma.
Jehanɛ, Yuda ngɔ Gaza, Ashkelon, Ekron, kɛ a he zugba amɛ.
Yawɛ piɛ Yuda he nɛ a kɛ ngɔ yoku nɔ zugba amɛ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a fie mɛ; ejakaa dade ta zugba lɛhi ngɛ a dɛ.
A kɛ Hebron ha Kaleb kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa mɛ ɔ; nɛ e fie Anak binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.
Se Yebus bi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ lɛɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ fie we mɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Efraim kɛ Manase ye Betel nɔ -Yosef bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Efraim kɛ Manase wɛtso ɔmɛ hu ya tua Betel nɛ sa a, e biɛ ji Luz ɔ; nɛ Yawɛ piɛ a he.
Kekleekle ɔ, a tsɔ nihi ya slaa ma a lolo.
Slaali ɔmɛ na nyumu ko nɛ je ma a mi kɛ ma, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa ma a mi.
Ke o tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ ɔ, wa maa na mo mɔbɔ.” Nyumu ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa ma a mi ɔ, nɛ benɛ a sɛ ma a mi ɔ, a kɛ klaate gbe ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Se nyumu ɔ kɛ e weku li lɛɛ a tɛ a he.
Pee se ɔ, nyumu ɔ je kɛ ho Hit bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ya, nɛ e ya po ma ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E wo ma a biɛ ke Luz; nɛ jã ji e biɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ fie we mɛ Manase bi ɔmɛ fie we nihi nɛ ngɛ Bet Shan, Taanak, Dor, Ibleam, kɛ Megido ma amɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ ngɛ a kasa nya a a mi ɔ. Kanaan bi nɛ ɔmɛ fi si nɛ a tlɔ zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he ba wa a, a fie we Kanaan bi ɔmɛ kɛ ji zugba a nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ; se mohu a nyɛ a nɔ, nɛ a tsu ní ha mɛ.
Efraim bi ɔmɛ hu fie we Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Gezer ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kanaan bi ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hi lejɛ ɔ. Zebulun bi ɔmɛ fie we Kitron, kɛ Nahala bi ɔmɛ.
Kanaan bi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hi si; se mohu Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a tsu ní ha mɛ.
Ako, Sidon, Ahlab, Akzib, Helba, Afek, kɛ Rehob bi ɔmɛ hu Asher bi ɔmɛ fie we mɛ.
Asher bi nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Kanaan bi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ hi si; ejakaa a fie we mɛ.
Naftali bi ɔmɛ fie we Bet Shemesh, kɛ Bet Anat bi ɔmɛ.
Naftali bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Kanaan bi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ hi si; se mohu a nyɛ Bet Shemesh, kɛ Bet Anat bi ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a tsu ní ha mɛ.
Amor bi ɔmɛ sá Dan bi ɔmɛ a yi ngɔ wo yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ a ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a kple si kɛ ba nga a nɔ.
Amor bi ɔmɛ hi Heres yo ɔ nɔ, Aiyalon, kɛ Shaalbim; se Yosef nina nɛ ji Efraim kɛ Manase ɔ, a nine si wa ngɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a tsu ní ha mɛ.
Amor bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ ngɛ kɛ je Akrabim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ he kɛ ya gu Sela, kɛ po mi kɛ ho yiti je ya.
Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ba Bokim Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ je Gilgal kɛ ba Bokim, nɛ e ba de Israel ma a ke, “I je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ba zugba nɛ i wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.
I de ke, ‘Somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, i be se jee gblegbleegble.
Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi ɔmɛ nɛ ko so somi ko; se mohu nyɛɛ ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ.’ Se nyɛ bui mi tue.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ nɛ nyɛ ya pee!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke i be ni ɔmɛ fiee kɛ je nyɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
A ma plɛ pee nyɛ he nyɛli, nɛ a mawu ɔmɛ hu ma plɛ pee klama nɛ a tsɔ nyɛ.” Benɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ tu Israel bi ɔmɛ munyu nɛ ɔ, ma a tsuo wo yana.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Bokim; e sisi ji ya foli.
Nɛ a sã bɔhi ha Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yoshua gbenɔ Jehanɛ, Yoshua wo ma a blɔ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho konɛ e ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e weto ní ɔ. Yoshua wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, ma a sɔmɔ Yawɛ.
Yoshua gbenɔ se, be mi nɛ ma nimeli nɛ na ní nguanguahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ tsu ha Israel ɔ na we nɛ a gbo ɔ, a ya nɔ nɛ a sɔmɔ Yawɛ ja nɔuu.
Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Yoshua, Nun binyumu ɔ gbo benɛ e ye jeha lafa kɛ nyɔngma.
A pu lɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ngɛ Timnat Heres, ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, ngɛ Gaas yo ɔ we omleyi je.
Jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa hu ba gbo.
Nɛ yi nɔ kpa bimɛ nɛ ba ngɛ a se ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a li Yawɛ, kɛ ní tsumi nɛ e tsu ha Israel ɔ. Israel kpa Yawɛ sɔmɔmi Israel bi ɔmɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ nɛ a ya sɔmɔ Baalhi.
A kua Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ; nɛ a ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi nɛ ji nihi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a mawu ɔmɛ a se.
A ja mɛ, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo Yawɛ mi mi la.
Akɛnɛ a je Yawɛ se, nɛ a ya sɔmɔ Baal kɛ Ashtarot he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel; nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he ngɔ ha ní hali, nɛ a ha a níhi.
E je a he gbi ngɔ ha a he nyɛli nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ; nɛ a nyɛ we a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a da hu.
He tsuaa he nɛ a gba ta kɛ gu kɛkɛ Yawɛ ha matahu ba po mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e ka kita ke e maa pee mɛ ɔ. Nɛ a yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ je manyadali komɛ ha Israel, nɛ a ba kpɔ ma a kɛ je ní hali ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Se manyadali ɔmɛ po a bui mɛ; nɛ Yawɛ hu a yi lɛ anɔkuale.
Mohu ɔ, a ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se, nɛ a ja mɛ; nɛ a je blɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.
A nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ; se mɛɛ lɛɛ a pee we ja.
Be tsuaa be nɛ Yawɛ ma ha Israel manyadalɔ ko ɔ, e piɛɔ e he kɛ kpɔɔ ma a kɛ jeɔ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi e wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ejakaa kɛmɛmi nɛ a hii kɛmɛe ngɛ a yi mi wali, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ haoɔ mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi ɔ peeɔ Yawɛ mɔbɔ.
Se ke manyadalɔ ɔ gbo pɛ, ma a kpaleɔ a se kɛ ya nyɛɛɔ a blɔ momo ɔmɛ a nɔ ekohu; nɛ a peeɔ yayami nɛ nya wa pe a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ po.
A ya nyɛɛɔ mawu kpahi a se; a sɔmɔɔ mɛ, nɛ a jaa mɛ.
Nɛ a ngmɛɛ we a yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ a kuɛ mi timi ɔ he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu Israel, nɛ e ma de ke, “Akɛnɛ ma nɛ ɔ yi somi ɔ nɛ i wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ mlaa ngɛ he ɔ nɔ, nɛ imi nitsɛ hu a bui mi he je ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, je ma amɛ nɛ piɛ benɛ Yoshua gbo ɔ, i be mɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ.
Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ka Israel nɛ ma hyɛ kaa a maa nyɛɛ ye blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, loo a be ja pee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ si jamɛ a je ma amɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ; e ngɔɛ mɛ ngɔ wui Yoshua dɛ mi, nɛ Yoshua gbenɔ se hu e fie we mɛ nɔuu kɛ ji zugba a nɔ.
Je ma amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ Yawɛ si je ma komɛ, konɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ka Israel bi nɛ a hwui ta hyɛ ngɛ Kanaan ɔ. Yawɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel yi nɔ bimɛ nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ, a tsɔɔ mɛ ta hwumi; titli ɔ, a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ yɛ ta hyɛ ɔ. Je ma amɛ ji Filisti bi a matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ, Sidon bi, kɛ Hiv bi nɛ ngɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ je Baal Hermon yo ɔ he kɛ ya si Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nya.
A si mɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ka Israel, nɛ a hyɛ kaa a maa ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ e wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ a nɔ lo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hi Kanaan, Hit, Amor, Periz, Hiv, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
A ngɔ ma je li ɔmɛ a biyihi, nɛ mɛ hu a kɛ a biyihi ha ma je li ɔmɛ a binyumuhi; nɛ a sɔmɔ a mawu ɔmɛ.
Otniel Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ je Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɔ; a pee yayami kɛ si lɛ, nɛ a ya sɔmɔ Baalhi kɛ Ashera.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Mesopotamia matsɛ, Kushan Rishataim dɛ mi; nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ sɔmɔ Kushan Rishataim jeha kpaanyɔ.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ je nyumu ko ha mɛ, nɛ e ba kpɔ mɛ.
Lɛ ji Otniel, Kaleb senɔ nyumu Kenaz binyumu ɔ. Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba e nɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi.
E gba ta, nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ Mesopotamia matsɛ, Kushan Rishataim ngɔ wo e dɛ mi nɛ e ye e nɔ.
Zugba a nɔ jɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Nɛ Kenaz binyumu Otniel ba gbo.
Ehud Israel bi ɔmɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ekohu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ya piɛ Moab matsɛ, Eglon he, nɛ e kɛ Israel to ní.
Matsɛ Eglon, kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ pee kake kɛ ya tua Israel bi ɔmɛ.
A ye a nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ ma a nɛ tãhi ngɛ mi ɔ. Nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ sɔmɔ Moab matsɛ, Eglon jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ je kpɔlɔ ko ha mɛ.
Lɛ ji Ehud, Benyamin no Gera binyumu ɔ; muɔtsɛ ji lɛ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tsɔ lɛ Moab matsɛ, Eglon ngɔ kɛ nike níhi.
Ehud sɔ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ, nɛ e kami ji nine mi blimi enyɔ.
E fi klaate ɔ kɛ wo e hiɔ nɔ fiɔ he, ngɛ e tade ɔ sisi, nɛ e ngɔ nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ya ha Moab matsɛ, Eglon.
Eglon ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ wo lo saminya ji lɛ.
Benɛ Ehud ngɔ nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ya ha lɛ se ɔ, e wo nihi nɛ tloo nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ya a blɔ.
Se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ benɛ e su amaga amɛ a he ngɛ Gilgal ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ba Eglon ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i ngɛ laami sane ko nɛ ma de mo.” Matsɛ ɔ fa ke lejɛ ɔ nɛ e jɔ dii; kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo je lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, benɛ lɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ kake too e hii si ngɛ e hiɔwe tsu nɛ e mi jɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Ehud ba e ngɔ nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “I hɛɛ sɛ ko kɛ je Mawu ngɔ kɛ ma mo hami.” Matsɛ ɔ te si pam!
Kɛkɛ nɛ Ehud ngɔ e muɔ nine kɛ hia klaate ɔ ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ fiɔ he, nɛ e kɛ klaate ɔ gbɔ matsɛ ɔ muklii mi.
Klaate ɔ kɛ e yi ɔ tsuo sɛ e muklii ɔ mi, nɛ zɔ ha he.
Ehud si klaate ɔ ngɛ matsɛ ɔ muklii ɔ mi; nɛ fĩ je mi pue si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Ehud gu asa a nɔ kɛ je kpo.
E nga hiɔwe tsu ɔ sinya amɛ, nɛ e ngmɛ a mi ngɛ se.
Benɛ Ehud je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Matsɛ Eglon tsɔli ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba na kaa a ngmɛ hiɔwe tsu ɔ sinya amɛ a mi ɔ, a de ngɛ a yi mi ke, “Be nɛ ɔ mi e ho nane nɔ ya ngɛ tsu nɛ mi jɔ ɔ mi.” A mlɛ lɛ hluu kɛ ya si a pa li bɔ nɛ a maa pee ha.
Se nɛ a na kaa loloolo ɔ, e bli we hiɔwe tsu ɔ sinya a, a ya ngɔ safe nɛ a kɛ ba bli lɛ.
Nɛ́ a ke a hyɛɔ ɔ, a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ e gbo kɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ zugba.
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ mlɛe ɔ, Ehud je momo; e ya be ngɛ he nɛ amaga amɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ho Seira ya.
Benɛ e ya su Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, e kpa titimati, nɛ e nyɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ kple yoku ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ye se!
Yawɛ ngɔ nyɛ he nyɛli, Moab bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ mi.” Nɛ a nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya ngɔ he nɛ a poo Yordan pa a ngɛ kɛ yaa Moab ɔ; a ha we nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ po pa a. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a gbe Moab bi a ta buli kpanakpanaa, kɛ katsɛmɛ maa pee akpe nyɔngma; nɔ kake ngmelu po ji mi.
Israel ye Moab nɔ kunimi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Nɛ zugba a nɔ jɔ jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ.
Shamgar Ehud se ɔ, Anat binyumu Shamgar ba.
Lɛ hu e kɛ na tsɔmi tso gbe Filisti bi lafa ekpa, nɛ e kɛ he Israel yi wami.
Debora kɛ Barak Ehud gbenɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Kanaan matsɛ, Yabin nɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Hazor ma a mi ɔ dɛ mi.
E tatsɛ ji Sisera, nɛ lɛɛ e hi Haroshet ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Yabin ngɛ dade ta zugba lɛ lafa nɛɛ, nɛ e wa Israel bi ɔmɛ yi mi jeha nyingmi enyɔ sɔuu.
Nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ fa kue ha Yawɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, gbalɔyo ko ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nya.
Lɛ ji Lapidot yo Debora.
E pɔɔ si himi ngɛ tã ko sisi ngɛ Rama kɛ Betel a kpɛti, ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ a sane yaa e ngɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e hyɛɛ mi ha mɛ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e tsɔ ya tsɛ Abinoam binyumu Barak ngɛ Kedesh nɛ ngɛ Naftali ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo fae ke, ‘Yaa nɛ o ya hla nyumuhi akpe nyɔngma kɛ je Naftali kɛ Zebulun wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ ba Tabor yo ɔ nɔ.
Ma ha Yabin tatsɛ Sisera kɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ mo ma ba kpe ngɛ Kishon pa a nya; nɛ ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo o dɛ mi.’ ” Barak de lɛ ke, “Ke o kɛ mi maa ya a, ma ya.
Se ke o kɛ mi be yae ɔ, lɛɛ imi hu i be yae.” Debora he nɔ ke, “I kɛ mo maa ya tsɔ.
Se mohu blɔ nɛ o ngɛ hiae nɛ ɔ, hɛ mi nyami nɛ maa ba a be o nɔ́ pee; ejakaa Yawɛ maa ngɔ Sisera kɛ wo yo dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Debora te si nɛ e kɛ Barak je kɛ ho Kedesh ya.
Barak ya kpee Zebulun kɛ Naftali wɛtso ɔmɛ kɛ ho Kedesh ya; nɛ nyumuhi akpe nyɔngma nyɛɛ e se.
Debora hu kɛ lɛ ho.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Ken no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Heber ɔ tsɔ e he kɛ je Ken bi, nɛ ji Mose ngatsɛ Hobab nina a a he; nɛ e ya ma e bo tsu ɔ ngɛ tso ngua a nɛ ngɛ Zaananim ɔ he, ngɛ Kedesh kasa nya tɔɔ.
Benɛ a ya bɔ Sisera amaniɛ kaa Abinoam binyumu Barak hia ta kɛ ho Tabor yo ɔ nɔ ya a, Sisera bua e dade ta zugba lɛ lafa nɛɛ ɔ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ a hia kɛ je Haroshet ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ho Kishon pa a nya ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Debora de Barak ke, “Tee si!
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ Sisera kɛ wo o dɛ mi.
Anɛ pi Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ hia kɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi kɛ yaa a lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Barak kple Tabor yo ɔ, kɛ e we bi akpe nyɔngma amɛ ngɛ e se.
Benɛ Barak gba ta a, Yawɛ ha nɛ Sisera kɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tabo ɔmɛ tsuo jija, nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe mɛ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Sisera nitsɛ lɛɛ e kple si kɛ je e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ e nane to he.
Barak nyɛɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo ɔ a se kɛ ya su Haroshet ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ tɔɔ.
Sisera ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo nɔ ngɛ klaate nya; e píɛ nɔ kake po.
Sisera tu fo kɛ ya sɛ Ken no, Heber e yo Yael bo tsu mi; ejakaa tue mi jɔmi ngɛ Hazor matsɛ, Yabin we ɔ, kɛ Ken no, Heber we ɔ a kpɛti.
Yael je kpo nɛ e kɛ Sisera ya kpe; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, moo ba!
Moo sɛ ye bo tsu ɔ mi!
Koo ye gbeye!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ Yael ngɔ sa nɔ bo kɛ ha e nɔ.
Sisera de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi nyu bɔɔ nɛ ma nu; kuma ngɛ mi yee.” Yael bli lohwehi a he womi kotoku ko nɛ nyɔ nyu ngɛ mi nya, nɛ e ha lɛ eko nɛ e nu; nɛ e ngɔ sa nɔ bo kɛ ha e nɔ ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Sisera de lɛ ke, “Yaa da si ngɛ bo tsu sinya a nya.
Ke nɔ ko ba bi mo ke nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ lo ɔ, de lɛ ke, ‘Dɛbi.’ ” Sisera kɛ pɔ tɔtɔɛ hwɔ mahe vii.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Heber e yo Yael ngɔ bo tsu plɛɛko kɛ hamle, nɛ e nyɛɛ blɛuu kɛ ho e ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya ka plɛɛko ɔ kɛ wo e tue si kɛ sɛ zu mi.
Nɛ Sisera gbo.
Benɛ Barak nyɛɛ Sisera se kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, Yael je kpo kɛ lɛ ba kpe; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nyumu ɔ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ.” Barak kɛ lɛ sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e na Sisera nɛ e gbo kɛ hwɔɔ si kɛ bo tsu tso plɛɛko ɔ nɛ a ka kɛ wo e tue si ɔ. Mawu ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ye Kanaan matsɛ, Yabin nɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ kɔni si wami nyɛɛ Kanaan matsɛ, Yabin se kɛ ya si a kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Debora kɛ Barak a la a Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Debora kɛ Abinoam binyumu Barak la la nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Israel nikɔtɔma amɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi, nɛ ma a ngɔ a he ha kɛ bua jɔmi.
Nyɛ matsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Ganɔhi nyɛ ta tue!
Ma la; i kɛ gbi ngɔngɔɛ ma je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi.
Yawɛ, benɛ o je Seir, nɛ o hia kɛ je Edom kɛ ma a, zugba mimiɛ, nɛ hiɔmi nɛ.
Niinɛ, nyu je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi pue si.
Yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ ngɛ Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ je e he si ngɛ Sinai ɔ hɛ mi.
Ee!
A mimiɛ ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nitsɛ hɛ mi.
Anat binyumu Shamgar, kɛ Yael a be ɔ mi ɔ, gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ fɔɔ si gu, nɛ blɔ nyɛɛli guu nane blɔ.
Israel kɔpe ɔmɛ pee ma dokuhi; nɔ ko be a mi loko mo, Debora, o ba kaa Israel ma a a nyɛ.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya hla mawu hehi ɔ, ta te si ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Se Israel nyumuhi akpe nyingmi eywiɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a nɛ tsɛ̃i, loo akplɔ ngɛ nɔ kake po dɛ mi.
Israel tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ke ɔ, i ná a he bua jɔmi.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hii teji yo futafutahi a nɔ!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hii tsu mi hami zugba bo kpakpahi a nɔ, kɛ nyɛ nane nyɛɛli tsuo, nyɛɛ fiɛ nɛ a nu!
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nimli asafo ɔ nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ nyɛ nyu yɛmi he ɔmɛ ɔ, a ngɛ lae, nɛ a ngɛ gbae bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ye manye ha Israel.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ma a kɛ gɛjɛmi nyɛɛ kɛ ba agbo ɔmɛ a nya.
Wo o he nɔ, Debora, wo o he nɔ!
Wo o he nɔ, wo o he nɔ nɛ o la!
Abinoam binyumu Barak, tee si nɛ o kpaka o nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ho!
Kɛkɛ nɛ odehehi nɛ piɛ ɔ kple si kɛ ba.
Yawɛ ma a kple si kɛ ba na he nyɛli ɔmɛ.
A je Efraim kɛ ba kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
A nyɛɛ mo Benyamin, kɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a se.
Tatsɛmɛ je Makir kɛ ba, nɛ tatsɛ tso hɛɛli hu je Zebulun kɛ ba.
Isakar ganɔ ɔmɛ ya piɛ Debora he; Isakar mɛtɛ Barak he kpɛii.
A nyɛɛ e se kɛ fo kɛ ho kɔ̃ ɔ mi ya.
Se Ruben wɛtso ɔ lɛɛ mi gbami ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a nya be kake.
Mɛni he je o hii si ngɛ to ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ o ngɛ to ɔmɛ a tsɛmi bɛ ɔmɛ tue bue ɔ?
Niinɛ, Ruben wɛtso ɔ lɛɛ mi gbami ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a nya be kake.
Gilead tlɔ Yordan pa a se; Dan hu, mɛni he je e tlɔ lɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ?
Asher hii si kpoo ngɛ wo ɔ nya he nɛ lɛ ɔmɛ ba saa si ngɛ ɔ.
Se Zebulun, kɛ Naftali lɛɛ a ngɔ a wami ngɔ ke gbenɔ ngɛ ta nga nɔ.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba Taanak ba hwu ta ngɛ Megido pa a nya; Kanaan matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba hwu ta, se a nɛ sika hiɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ha.
Dodoehi po hwu ta ngɛ hiɔwe; a je a blɔ hehi nɛ a kɛ Sisera ba hwu ta.
Kishon pa a muɔ mɛ kɛ ho; niinɛ, Kishon nyu dɔ ɔ muɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
Imi lɛɛ ma nyɛɛ kɛ he wami!
Kɛkɛ nɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ tuu kɛ ba; a si a nane kokloto si.
Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Nyɛɛ gbiɛ Meroz; nyɛɛ gbiɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ!
Ejakaa a bɛ nɛ a ba piɛ Yawɛ he benɛ e kɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ hwue ɔ.” Ken no Heber e yo Yael ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ pe yihi tsuo nɛ hii bo tsu mi.
Sisera bi lɛ nyu, se Yael ha lɛ nyɔ nyu.
E kɛ nyami wo tsimi saminyayoo ko mi kɛ ba.
E hɛɛ bo tsu plɛɛko ngɛ e muɔ nine mi.
Ní tsuli a hamle ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi.
E ka tso plɛɛko ɔ kɛ wo Sisera tue si; e kɛ gbɔ lɛ, nɛ e ywia e yi.
Sisera nɔ si ngɛ Yael nane nya, nɛ e gbo dii ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
He nɛ e nɔ si ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu e gbo ngɛ.
Sisera nyɛ ya hyɛ saflɛ mi; e kpa huhui kɛ je saflɛ puɔ ɔmɛ a se nɛ e bi ke, “Mɛni he je e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ bɛ lolo ɔ?
Mɛni he je wa nui okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane kokloto he lolo ɔ?” Yihi ní leli ɔmɛ ha lɛ heto.
Lɛ nitsɛ hu e de e he si abɔ ke, “Anɛ pi ní nɛ a ngɛ hae ngɛ gbae lo?
Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɔ́ ji zangmayo kake, loo enyɔ.
Sisera lɛɛ e ma na bohi nɛ a ngɔ tsopa kɛ fi; bohi nɛ a lo ní kɛ wo mi.
E maa ngɔ bo ɔ kpo enyɔ ba ha mi nɛ ma kɛ ha ye kuɛ mi!” Yawɛ, ha o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ kpata kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
Se o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ha nɛ a pee kaa pu nɛ ngɛ si tee kɛ he wami!
Nɛ zugba a nɔ jɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Gideon Israel bi ɔmɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ hu ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Midian bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi jeha kpaago.
Midian bi ɔmɛ wa Israel bi ɔmɛ yi mi.
Midian bi ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ya tsua muɔhi, tɛ puɔhi, kɛ laami he kpahi kɛ ha a he ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ma du ní ɔ, Midian, kɛ Amalek bi, kɛ ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ ma ba tua mɛ.
Ke a ba kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a ma kpata zugba a nɔ niba ní tsuo hɛ mi hluu kɛ yaa si Gaza tɔɔ.
A maa nuu to ɔmɛ, na amɛ, kɛ teji ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho; nɛ a be nɔ́ ko sie ha Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye.
Ke a ma a, a hɛɛɔ a lohwehi, kɛ a bo tsuhi kɛ baa, nɛ a he hiɛɛ babauu kaa baalɛhi.
A kɛ a we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we mɛ kanemi; nɛ ke a ba a, a kpataa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Midian bi ɔmɛ pee Israel bi ɔmɛ posoposo; nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ fa kue ha Yawɛ.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ bi yemi kɛ buami ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔ gbalɔ ko kɛ ba a ngɔ, nɛ e ba de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Imi lɛ i kpaka nyɛ kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi ngɛ Egipt kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Imi lɛ i je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa nyɛ yi mi ɔ tsuo a dɛ mi.
Imi lɛ i fie mɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ, nɛ i ngɔ zugba a kɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ i de nyɛ ke, ‘Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ja Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ a mawu ɔmɛ.’ Se nyɛ bui mi tue.” Gideon tsɛmi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ba Ofra, nɛ e ba hi si ngɛ Yoash, Abiezer no ɔ tso ngua a sisi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e binyumu Gideon ya laa e he, nɛ e ngɛ ngma gbee ngɛ wai muɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ ko na lɛ.
Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ je e he si tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo nyumu katsɛ, Yawɛ kɛ mo ngɛ!” Gideon de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ke Yawɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ niinɛ ɔ, mɛni he je lɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba wa nɔ mɔ?
Nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ gba wɔ ke Yawɛ pee ha mɛ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?
Pi lɛ nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba a?
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ sake wɔ ngɔ fɔ he; e ngɔ wɔ kɛ wo Midian bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ hyɛ lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa, nɛ o kɛ o he wami nɛ ɔ ya kpɔ Israel kɛ je Midian dɛ mi.
Imi nitsɛ lɛ i tsɔ mo!” Gideon de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ Yawɛ, kɛ ma pee kɛ kpɔ Israel kɛɛ?
Weku nɛ i je mi ɔ ji weku nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ Manase wɛtso ɔ mi.
Tsaatsɛ we ɔ mi hu imi ji jokuɛyo pe kulaa.” Se Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Ma piɛ o he; o maa fia Midian bi ɔmɛ nɔ nɛ o maa gbe mɛ kaa a gbeɔ nɔ kake.” Gideon de lɛ ke, “Ke o ngɛ ye he suɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ moo to mi okadi ko nɛ ma kɛ na kaa mo, Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ o kɛ mi ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, koo ya lolo; ha ma ngɔ ye nike ní kɛ ba ma o hɛ mi loko o je.” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ma mlɛ kɛ yaa si o maa kpale kɛ ba.” Gideon ho nɛ e ya gbe apletsi bɔbɔyoo ko, nɛ e kɛ mamu kilo nyɔngma pee abolo kplolo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ lo ɔ wo kusii mi, nɛ e plɛ e he nyu ɔ kɛ wo kutu mi; nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɛ tso ngua a sisi.
Se Mawu bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ lo ɔ, kɛ abolo kplolo ɔ kɛ pue tɛ sa nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ o plɛ lo ɔ he nyu ɔ kɛ pue nɔ.” Gideon pee ja.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ kpã e nine mi, nɛ e kɛ tso ɔ nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ nya sa lo ɔ kɛ abolo kplolo ɔ he.
La je tɛ sa a mi sã lo ɔ, kɛ abolo kplolo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ laa.
Benɛ Gideon na kaa Yawɛ bɔfo nɛ e na a, e de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Yawɛ Mawu!
Yawɛ bɔfo pam lɛ i na hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi paa kikɛ nɛ ɔ!” Se Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “He jɔmi ha mo.
Koo ye gbeye; o be gboe!” Gideon pee bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke, “Yawɛ ji he jɔmi.” Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ maa si ngɛ Abiezer bi ɔmɛ a ma a mi ngɛ Ofra kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yawɛ de Gideon ke, “Yaa nu o tsɛ na ku ɔ, kɛ na ku kpa nɛ ye jeha kpaago; nɛ o ya ku bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ o tsɛ pee kɛ ha Baal ɔ, kɛ yo wɔ Ashera nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a, nɛ o ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ tɛ sa nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ Ashera he tso ɔmɛ nɛ o ku pue si ɔ kɛ pee lɛ́, nɛ o ngɔ na ku enyɔne ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ.” Gideon hla e tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni nyɔngma, nɛ e pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ e ngɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ gbeye yee he je ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e tsu ní tsumi nɛ ɔ piani, se nyɔ mi.
Mɔtu kpla benɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ te si ɔ, a na kaa a ywia Baal bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ yo wɔ Ashera nɔ́ ɔ nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a.
A na hu kaa a sã na ku enyɔne ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a ma a nɔ; nɛ a bi a sibi ke, “Mɛnɔ po pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?” Se benɛ a hla mi, nɛ a bi si, nɛ a ná le kaa Gideon, Yoash binyumu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ye jamɛ a sane ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ de Yoash ke, “Ngɔɔ o bi ɔ kɛ ba nɛ a gbe lɛ; ejakaa e ywia Baal bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ yo wɔ Ashera hu nɔ́ ɔ.” Se Yoash de ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ba bɔle lɛ ɔ ke, “Baal he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pɛe nɛ ɔ?
Baal he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ fae nɛ ɔ?
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Baal he pɛe ɔ, a maa gbe lɛ loko je maa na.
Baal ɔ, ke mawu ji lɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha e fa lɛ nitsɛ e he; e bɔ sami la tɛ lɛ a ywia a nɛ!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, biɛ nɛ a tsɛɔ Gideon ji Yerubaal.
E sisi ji, “Ha nɛ Baal kɛ lɛ ya to ní,” ejakaa e ywia Baal bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ. E kɛ we kulaa nɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ba bua a he nya.
A po Yordan pa a, nɛ a ya bua a he nya ekohu ngɛ Yezreel kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba Gideon nɔ, nɛ e kpa titimati kɛ tsɛ Abiezer bi ɔmɛ ke a ba piɛ e he.
E tsɔ ya kpee Manase bi ɔmɛ; nɛ mɛ hu a ba piɛ e he.
Jehanɛ, e tsɔ ya kpee Asher, Zebulun, kɛ Naftali wɛtso ɔmɛ; nɛ mɛ hu a ba piɛ e he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Gideon de Mawu ke, “Ke o ma he Israel yi wami niinɛ kɛ gu ye nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ o nɛ, i kɛ jijɔ he womi maa fɔ si ngɛ ngma mi sami he ɔ. Ke bɔ́ nɛ, nɛ to he womi ɔ pɛ pɔ, se zugba a tsuo lɛɛ e gbli ɔ, lɔ ɔ i kɛ maa le kaa o maa gu ye nɔ kɛ he Israel yi wami niinɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ.” Nɛ e ba mi ja niinɛ.
E nɔ jena mɔtu kpla be nɛ Gideon te si nɛ e nga to he womi ɔ mi ɔ, nyu nɛ je mi ɔ hyi tsimi kake.
Gideon de Mawu ke, “O mi mi nɛ ko fu mi; ha ma tu munyu si kake nɛ ɔ pɛ!
I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha ma ngɔ to he womi nɛ ɔ kɛ kpa nɔ́ si si kake nɛ ɔ pɛ!
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ bɔ́ nɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ, konɛ to he womi ɔ pɛ lɛɛ e gbli.” Nɛ Mawu ha e ba mi ja; jamɛ a nyɔ mi ɔ, bɔ́ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, se to he womi ɔ pɛ nɛ lɛɛ e gbli.
Gideon ye Midian bi ɔmɛ a nɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, Yerubaal nɛ ji Gideon, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo te si mɔtu kpla, nɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Harod nyu vu ɔ nya.
Midian ta a ngɛ omleyi je ha mɛ ngɛ More yo ɔ kasa nya, ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Yawɛ de Gideon ke, “Ta nɛ nyɛɛ o se ɔ, a he hiɛ tsɔ.
Ke i ngɔ Midian ngɔ wo a dɛ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ma wo a he nɔ, nɛ a ma de ke mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɔni si wami lɛ a kɛ he a yi wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ nu kaa, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ gbeye yee nɛ e he ngɛ doe ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.’ ” Benɛ Gideon ka mɛ ɔ, nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kpale a se; nɛ e piɛ nimli akpe nyɔngma.
Yawɛ de Gideon ke, “Ma nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a he hiɛ tsɔ.
Ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ kple si kɛ ya pa a nya, nɛ imi nitsɛ ma ka mɛ ha mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke i de mo ke, ‘O kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ ya’ a, o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya; se ke i de mo ke, ‘O kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ko ya’ a, o kɛ lɛ ko ya.” Gideon kɛ ma a kple si kɛ ho pa a nya ya; nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Nihi tsuo nɛ a kɛ a lilɛ maa nu nyu ɔ kaa gbe nuɔ nyu ɔ, ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ da he kake, konɛ o ngɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a kpla si ngɛ a nakutso nya kɛ nu nyu ɔ hu ngɔ da he kake.” Nihi tsuo nɛ a kɛ a nine to a nya he, nɛ a nu nyu ɔ kɛ je a dɛ mi ɔ, a yibɔ ji nimli lafa etɛ; se ma nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a kpla si ngɛ a nakutso nya kɛ nu nyu ɔ. Yawɛ de Gideon ke, “Ma ngɔ nyumuhi lafa etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nu nyu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ gbe nuɔ nyu ɔ kɛ he nyɛ yi wami, nɛ ma ngɔ Midian bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo a dɛ mi.
Ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ, ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ho e we mi ya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Gideon he niye ní nɛ a kɛ maa to dɛ ɔ, kɛ titimati ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a dɛ.
E wo mɛ tsuo blɔ kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya, nɛ e si nimli lafa etɛ ɔmɛ pɛ.
Midian bi ɔmɛ a ta a ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ a sisi blɔ.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yawɛ de Gideon ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya tua he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a esɔesɔ; ejakaa i ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi!
Ke o ngɛ gbeye yee kaa mo nɔ kake too o maa ya a, lɛɛ o kɛ o tsɔlɔ Pura nɛ ya, nɛ o ya bu a ní sɛɛmi ɔ tue.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o ma na kã ko kɛ kple si kɛ ya tua ta a.” Gideon kɛ e tsɔlɔ Pura kple si kɛ ho he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a nya ya haa.
Midian bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ pueɔ si ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi babauu kaa baalɛhi.
A we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ ko li a nya; a he hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia.
Benɛ Gideon ya su lejɛ ɔ, nɔ ko ngɛ e nyɛmi nlami ko nɛ e nla a sɛɛe ke, “I nla nlami ko; nɛ hyɛ, abolo bɔbɔɛ ko kpɛne kɛ ba sɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ a ta a mi.
Abolo nɛ ɔ ba si bo tsu ɔ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ lɛ ko si; nɛ bo tsu ɔ tsɛli ngɛ e se mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ he nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, pi nɔ́ kpa ko; Yoash binyumu Gideon, Israel no ɔ klaate ɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ!
Mawu ngɔ Midian bi ɔmɛ kɛ a tabo ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo e dɛ mi!” Benɛ Gideon nu nlami ɔ nɛ a sɛɛ ɔ kɛ e sisi tsɔɔmi ɔ, e kpla si nɛ e sɔle.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ho Israel ta a mi ya, nɛ e ya de ke, “Nyɛɛ te si!
Yawɛ ngɔ Midian tabo ɔ kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ mi!” E dla nyumuhi lafa etɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo kuu etɛ mi, nɛ e ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ titimati, kɛ kplu mi gu nɛ jatɛ hɔɔ si ngɛ mi.
Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ mi!
Ke i ya su he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a he ɔ, bɔ nɛ ma pee ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja nɔuu.
Ke i kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ piɛ ye he ɔ kpa titimati ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ kpa nyɛ titimati ɔmɛ kɛ bɔle ta a tsuo; nɛ nyɛ kpa ngmlaa ke, ‘Yawɛ kɛ Gideon ta ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ ” Gideon kɛ nyumuhi lafa nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ya su ta a he nyɔ mi bumi be ɔ sisi jemi, benɛ a tsake buli ɔmɛ se pɛ.
A kpa titimati ɔmɛ, nɛ a ywia kplu ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛɛ ngɛ a dɛ mi ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ kuu etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kpa titimati ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a ywia kplu ɔmɛ.
Mɛ tsuo a hɛɛ jatɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a muɔ nine, nɛ a kɛ a hiɔ nine hɛɛ titimati ɔmɛ.
A kpa titimati ɔmɛ kɛ he ose nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ kɛ Gideon ta hwumi klaate ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Nɔ tsuaa nɔ daa si ngɛ e blɔ he kɛ bɔle ta a kɛ kpe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tabo ɔ tsuo gbɛ, nɛ a kɛ bubuubui tu fo.
Benɛ Gideon we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ titimati lafa etɛ ɔmɛ kpae ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yawɛ ha he nyɛli ɔmɛ hia klaate kɛ wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a sibi a he.
Nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo kɛ ho tsitsaa Bet Shita ya ngɛ Zerera kasa nya, kɛ ya su Abel Mehola huzu ɔ nya, ngɛ Tabat kasa nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya kpee nyumuhi kɛ je Israel wɛtsohi nɛ ji Naftali, Asher, kɛ Manase nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ba; nɛ a wo fo kɛ nyɛɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ a se.
Gideon tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Efraim yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo ya, nɛ a ya de ke, “Nyɛ kple si nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ ba hwu ta.
Nyɛɛ tsi mɛ blɔ ngɛ Yordan pa pomi he ɔmɛ hluu kɛ yaa si Betbara kɛ Yordan pa a nya!” A ya kpee Efraim nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ a ba ngɔ Yordan pa a, kɛ pa tsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ ya si Betbara.
A nu Oreb kɛ Zeeb, Midian ganɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ.
A gbe Oreb ngɛ Oreb tɛ sa a he; se Zeeb lɛɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ Zeeb wai muɔ ɔ he, be mi nɛ a nyɛɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ mwɔɔ.
Pee se ɔ, a po Oreb kɛ Zeeb a yi, nɛ a ngɔ ba ha Gideon ngɛ Yordan pa a se.
A ye Midian bi ɔmɛ a nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ Kɛkɛ nɛ Efraim bi ɔmɛ bi Gideon ke, “Mɛni o pee wɔ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ba kpee we wɔ benɛ o yaa nɛ o kɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta a?” Nɛ a ka e hɛ mi saminya.
Se e de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i tsu ɔ, ke a ngɔ kɛ to nyɛ nɔ́ ɔ he ɔ, e pi nɔ ko kulaa!
Ní tsumi bɔbɔyoo ɔ nɛ nyɛ Efraim bi nyɛ tsu ɔ, e hiɛ hluu pe nɔ́ nɛ Abiezer bi nɛ ji ye weku li ɔmɛ tsuo tsu.
Mawu nitsɛ lɛ ngɔ Oreb kɛ Zeeb, Midian ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ mi.
Imi lɛɛ mɛni i nyɛ pee nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɔ́ ɔ sɔ?” Benɛ e de ja kɛkɛ nɛ a mi mi fumi ɔ nya ba si.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Gideon kɛ nyumuhi lafa etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ya su Yordan pa a nya, nɛ a po pa a. Jamɛ a be ɔ, pɔ tɔ mɛ, nɛ hwɔ gbe mɛ.
Benɛ a ya su Sukot ɔ, Gideon de nyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a mi ke, “I kɛ ye we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna, Midian matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a se nyɛɛe; nɛ pɔ tɔ wɔ.
I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ hla nɔ́ ko ha ye we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye.” Se Sukot ma tsɔli ɔmɛ de ke, “Anɛ o nine su Zeba kɛ Zalmuna a nɔ momo loko o deɔ wɔ ke wa ha o ta buli ɔmɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye ɔ?” Gideon de mɛ ke, “Saminya!
Ke Yawɛ ngɔ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna kɛ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, ma ngɔ mio tso, kɛ ha tso kɛ maa je nga a nɔ kɛ ba ngmlã nyɛ he womi nɔ ha nyɛ.” Benɛ e je lejɛ ɔ, e ho Penuel ya, nɛ e kɛ mɛ hu ya tu munyu ja nɔuu.
Penuel nyumu ɔmɛ hu ha lɛ heto kaa bɔ nɛ Sukot nyumu ɔmɛ de ɔ nɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Penuel nyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Ke i ya ye kunimi nɛ i ba ekohu ɔ, ma ku kikɛmɛ a mɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ pue si!” Zeba kɛ Zalmuna kɛ a tabo ɔ ngɛ Karkor.
A hiɛmi maa pee kaa nyumuhi akpe nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ a tabo ɔmɛ a mi nimli nɛ piɛ; ejakaa ta buli akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ sɔuu nɔ ngɛ ta nga a nɔ.
Gideon gu jua yeli ɔmɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Noba kɛ Yogbeha a beleku je kɛ ya tua tabo ɔ, benɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ.
Midian matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Zeba kɛ Zalmuna tu fo, se Gideon nyɛɛ a se kɛ ya si e nine su a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbeye nu tabo ɔ tsuo.
Benɛ Yoash binyumu Gideon kpale e se kɛ je ta nga a nɔ kɛ ma a, e ya gu Heres yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
E nu Sukot niheyo ko nɛ e ta e nya mi.
Nɛ niheyo ɔ ngma Sukot ma tsɔli, kɛ nimeli nyingmi kpaago kɛ kpaago ɔmɛ a biɛ kɛ ha Gideon.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Gideon ho nɛ e ya de Sukot bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ nɛ!
Zeba kɛ Zalmuna a, mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ bɔ mi ahlua ngɛ, nɛ nyɛ bi mi ke, ‘Anɛ o nine su Zeba kɛ Zalmuna a nɔ momo loko o deɔ wɔ ke wa ha o ta buli ɔmɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye, ejakaa pɔ tɔ mɛ?’ ɔ nɛ.” Nɛ́ e de ja kɛkɛ nɛ e nuu Sukot ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ e kɛ mio tso, kɛ ha tso ngmlã a he womi nɔ ha mɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, e ku Penuel mɔ ɔ, nɛ e gbe nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Gideon bi Zeba kɛ Zalmuna ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ gbe ngɛ Tabor ɔ, kɛ a ngɛ kɛɛ?” A ha lɛ heto ke, “A ngɛ kaa mo; mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ngɛ kaa matsɛbimɛ.” Gideon de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ; imi nitsɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi bimɛ ji mɛ.
I na Mawu kaa nyɛ he a yi wami jinɛ imi hu i be nyɛ gbee!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de Yeter, e bitɛte ɔ ke, “Tee si nɛ o gbe mɛ!” Se niheyo ɔ híɛ e klaate ɔ. E ngɛ gbeye yee, ejakaa niheyo kɛkɛ ji lɛ.
Zeba kɛ Zalmuna de ke, “Mo nitsɛ moo te si nɛ o gbe wɔ; ejakaa bɔ nɛ nyumu ngɛ ɔ, ja e he wami ngɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Gideon te si nɛ e gbe Zeba kɛ Zalmuna, nɛ e je sika ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a kuɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Israel ma a de Gideon ke, “Moo ye wa nɔ, o kɛ o bi ɔ, kɛ o bibi ɔ tsuo; ejakaa o je wɔ kɛ je Midian bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Gideon de mɛ ke, “I be nyɛ nɔ yee, nɛ ye binyumu ko hu be nyɛ nɔ yee; Yawɛ nitsɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ye nyɛ nɔ.” Gideon ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ ko.
Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ tue nya ní nɛ e ha ngɛ ta a mi ɔ kɛ ba.” (Midian bi ɔmɛ woɔ sika tsu tue nya ní; ejakaa Ishmael bi ji mɛ.)
A he nɔ ke, “Wa ma ha kɛ bua jɔmi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngmɛ bo ngɛ zugba, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ sake tue nya ní nɛ e ha a kɛ fɔ bo ɔ mi.
Sika tsu tue nya ní nɛ Gideon nine su nɔ ɔ tsuo jiimi ji kilo nyingmi enyɔ, slo sika ní kpahi, kuɛ gahi, tadehi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su nɛ Midian matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ woɔ ɔ, kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔhi nɛ ngɛ a we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a kuɛ ɔ. Gideon ngɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ pee amaga, nɛ e kɛ to Ofra nɛ ji e ma a mi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo je Mawu se, nɛ a ya ja amaga nɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ plɛ pee klama kɛ ha Gideon kɛ e we ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee nɛ a kɛ ye Midian bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ kɛ je lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Midian bi ɔmɛ doo we a nya hu.
Gideon be ɔ mi ɔ, zugba a nɔ jɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
Gideon gbenɔ Yoash binyumu Gideon, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yerubaal hulɔ ɔ, je kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e we mi ya, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Gideon fɔ binyumuhi nyingmi kpaago, nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ, ejakaa e ngɔ yihi babauu.
E plã a nɛ ngɛ Shekem ɔ, e kɛ lɛ hu fɔ binyumu kake; nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Abimelek.
Gideon, Yoash binyumu ɔ bwɔ kotokoto loko e gbo; nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ e tsɛ Yoash yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Ofra, Abiezer bi ɔmɛ a ma a mi.
Benɛ Gideon gbo ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ kua Mawu ekohu, nɛ a ngɔ Baal Berit ngɔ pee a mawu.
Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ je Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je a he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi ɔ nɔ.
Ngɛ kpakpa babauu nɛ Yerubaal (nɛ ji Gideon) pee Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ nane mi ɔ, Israel pee otlumu ngɛ Gideon we mi bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Abimelek Yerubaal binyumu Abimelek pue nɔ kɛ ho e nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya ngɛ Shekem, nɛ e ya de e nyɛ weku ɔ, kɛ a we puɔ nya a tsuo ke a bi Shekem bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Te nɔ́ nɛ da ha nyɛ nɛɛ?
Kaa Yerubaal binyumuhi nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye nyɛ nɔ, aloo nɔ kake pɛ nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ?
Nyɛ kai hu kaa imi lɛɛ i kɛ nyɛ je langmɔ kpa kake nya.” E nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ya sɛɛ e munyu ɔ ha Shekem bi ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ a yi mi plɛ kɛ ya nyɛɛ Abimelek se.
A de ke, “Wa nyɛmi ji lɛ.” A ha lɛ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi kpaago kɛ je Baal Berit jami he ɔ, nɛ Abimelek ngɔ sika a kɛ ya bɔ yakayaka nimli komɛ apaa kɛ ba nyɛɛ e se.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho e tsɛ we ɔ mi ya ngɛ Ofra, nɛ e ya gbe e nyɛminyumu nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ ji Yerubaal bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ tɛ kake nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se Yotam, Yerubaal binyumu wayoo pe kulaa a lɛɛ e laa e he, nɛ Abimelek nine sui e nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Shekem kɛ Bet Milo bi ɔmɛ tsuo bua a he nya, nɛ a ya wo Abimelek matsɛ ngɛ Shekem, ngɛ tso ngua a kasa nya.
Benɛ Yotam nu he ɔ, e ho ya da si ngɛ Gerizim yo ɔ yi mi, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de ke.
“Nyɛɛ bu mi tue, nyɛ Shekem bi, konɛ Yawɛ hu nɛ bu nyɛ tue!
Ligbi ko ɔ, tsohi ho konɛ a ya pɔ nɔ ko nu nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ nɛ e ye a nɔ.
A de oliv tso ke, ‘Moo ye wa nɔ matsɛ!’ Se oliv tso de mɛ ke, ‘Anɛ ma si ye nu nɛ he jua wa, nɛ a kɛ woɔ mawuhi, kɛ nimli adesahi a hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nɛ ma ya ye tsohi a nɔ matsɛ lo?’ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, tso ɔmɛ ya de ngmɔkɔ tso ke, ‘Ba nɛ o ba ye wa nɔ matsɛ!’ Se ngmɔkɔ tso de mɛ ke, ‘Anɛ ma si ye ngɔɔmi, kɛ ye yiblii kpakpa amɛ, nɛ ma ya ye tsohi a nɔ matsɛ lo?’ Kɛkɛ nɛ tso ɔmɛ ya de wai tso ke, ‘Moo lɛɛ moo ba nɛ o ba ye wa nɔ matsɛ!’ Se wai tso de mɛ ke, ‘Anɛ ma si ye wai nɛ haa mawuhi, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo bua jɔmi ɔ, nɛ ma ya ye tsohi a nɔ matsɛ lo?’ Nyagbenyagbe ɔ, tso ɔmɛ tsuo ya de mio tso ke, ‘Moo lɛɛ moo ba nɛ o ba ye wa nɔ matsɛ!’ Mio tso de tso ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ke nyɛ maa pɔ mi nu nɛ nyɛ maa wo mi tsɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba sa we ngɛ ye hɔ̃ mi.
Se ke pi ja ji nɔ́ ɔ, lɛɛ la nɛ je mio tso ɔ mi nɛ e ya sã Lebanon seda tso ɔmɛ!’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ nɛ nyɛ wo Abimelek nɛ ɔ, anɛ nyɛ ye anɔkuale kɛ dami sane lo?
Anɛ nyɛ pee Yerubaal kɛ e we ɔ kpakpa, nɛ nyɛ to lɛ nane mi bɔ nɛ sa e ní tsumi ɔmɛ lo?
Nyɛ kai kaa tsaatsɛ ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ e hwu ta ha nyɛ, nɛ e je nyɛ kɛ je Midian bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Se mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ te si wo tsaatsɛ we ɔ. Nyɛ gbe e binyumuhi nyingmi kpaago ngɛ tɛ kake nɔ, nɛ nyɛ wo e binyumu Abimelek nɛ e kɛ e mawayo fɔ ɔ matsɛ ngɛ Shekem, ejakaa nyɛ nyɛmi ji lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sane nɛ nyɛ ye Yerubaal kɛ e we ɔ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, ke anɔkuale kɛ dami sane nyɛ ye ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ nya Abimelek he, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ nyɛ nɛ na bua jɔmi.
Se ke pi ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ la nɛ je Abimelek mi ya sã Shekem bi ɔmɛ kɛ Bet Milo bi ɔmɛ; jehanɛ, e je Shekem bi ɔmɛ kɛ Bet Milo bi ɔmɛ a mi ya sã Abimelek.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yotam tu fo kɛ ho Beer ya, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e ngɛ e nyɛminyumu Abimelek gbeye yee.
Abimelek ye Israel nɔ matsɛ jeha etɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu ha mumi yayami ko ba puɛ Abimelek kɛ Shekem bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ Shekem bi ɔmɛ tsɔ atuã wo Abimelek.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ konɛ a kɛ ye Yerubaal binyumu nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ a he lue; bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a muɔ ɔ nɛ tloo a nyɛminyumu Abimelek kɛ Shekem bi ɔmɛ nɛ wo lɛ he wami loko e gbe e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ. Shekem bi ɔmɛ ha ni komɛ ya wo Abimelek ka ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a yi mi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba gu jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ be ɔ, kɛkɛ a kpɔ e níhi ngɛ e dɛ.
A ya sɛɛ munyu nɛ ɔ ha Abimelek.
Pee se ɔ, Ebed binyumu Gaal, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba Shekem; nɛ Shekem bi ɔmɛ he lɛ atuu.
A ya nga a nɔ nɛ a ya kplɔ wai yiblii ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba pee dã; nɛ a fiɛ nɛ a na bua jɔmi saminya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ya ye ní nɛ a nu dã ngɛ a mawu ɔ we ɔ; nɛ a jɛ Abimelek saminya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ebed binyumu Gaal de ke, “Mɛni nimli po ngɛ Shekem ɔ?
Mɛni he je lɛ wa ngɛ Abimelek sɔmɔe?
Mɛnɔ ji jamɛ a Abimelek ɔ?
Anɛ pi Yerubaal bi ji lɛ?
Nɛ pi e we asafoatsɛ ji Zebul lo?
Anɛ a sɔmɔ we Shekem tsɛ Hamor we bi ɔmɛ hyɛ lo?
Mɛni he je nɛ wa ngɛ lɛ sɔmɔe mɔ?
I na nɛ ma nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye sisi, jinɛ i kɛ Abimelek gbe nya momo.
I ko de Abimelek ke, ‘Ngɔɔ nihi babauu ngɔ piɛ o ta buli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ ba.’ ” Benɛ Zebul, ma a nɔ yelɔ ɔ nu Ebed binyumu Gaal munyu ɔ nɛ e tu ɔ, e mi mi fu, nɛ e tsɔ nihi nigii ke a ya de Abimelek ngɛ Aruma ke, “O nɛ, Ebed binyumu Gaal kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba Shekem, nɛ a ba ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a yi mi woe nɛ a te si kɛ wo mo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o kɛ o we bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ te si nyɔ mi nɛ nyɛ ya wo ka ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Mɔtu, pu si temi be ɔ, nyɛɛ te si nɛ nyɛ ya tua ma a tlukaa.
Ke Gaal kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ je kpo kɛ ba na nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ.” Abimelek kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo te si nyɔ mi nɛ a ya wo Shekem ma a he ka, ngɛ kuu eywiɛ mi.
Ebed binyumu Gaal je kpo nɛ e ya da si ngɛ ma agbo ɔ nya.
Benɛ Abimelek kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ wo a he nɔ kɛ je a ka womi he ɔ, Gaal na mɛ, nɛ e de Zebul ke, “Hyɛ!
Ni komɛ kple si kɛ je yo ɔmɛ a yi mi kɛ ma.” Zebul de lɛ ke, “Yo ɔmɛ a nini o ngɛ hyɛe ɔ nɛ; se pi nimli!” Gaal tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ!
Nimli je zugba a kpɛti tutuutu kɛ ma, nɛ kuu kake hu ngɛ klaali a tso ngua blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ma.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Zebul bi lɛ ke, “Nya puu ɔ nɛ o pee, nɛ o bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ ji Abimelek nɛ wa sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ?’ jije e kɛ mo su?
Anɛ pi ma nɛ o gbe a he guɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Jehanɛ, jee kpo konɛ o kɛ mɛ ya hwu ta.” Nɛ Gaal je kpo kɛ nyɛɛ Shekem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ Abimelek ya hwu ta.
E tu fo, se Abimelek nyɛɛ e se.
Nihi babauu plaa kɛ pue si hluu kɛ ya su ma a agbo ɔ nya tɔɔ.
Abimelek hi Aruma; se Zebul fie Gaal kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Shekem, nɛ a ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ. E nɔ jena benɛ a ya bɔ Abimelek amaniɛ ke Shekem bi ɔmɛ je kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya a, e dla e we bi ɔmɛ a mi kuu etɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ya wo ka ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Benɛ e na kaa ni ɔmɛ je ma a mi kɛ ma a, e je kpo ya tua mɛ.
Abimelek kɛ asafo kuu nɛ piɛ e he ɔ pee esɔ nɛ a ya da si ngɛ ma agbo ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ asafo kuu kpa enyɔ ɔmɛ ya tua ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ; nɛ a gbe mɛ tsuo.
Abimelek kɛ ma a hwu ta jamɛ a ligbi ɔ tsuo kɛ ya si e ngɔ ma a. E gbe nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ e kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fĩa ngo kɛ pue zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Shekem mɔ ɔ mi ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a ya laa a he ngɛ mɔ ɔ mi ngɛ El Berit jami he ɔ. Benɛ a ya gba Abimelek ke ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Shekem mɔ ɔ mi ɔ ya bua a he nya a, Abimelek kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo kuɔ Zalmon yo ɔ. Abimelek ya ngɔ gbiɛ nɛ e kɛ po tso kɔni, nɛ e kɛ fɔ e konɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ na nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ, nyɛ he nɛ sɔ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja nɔuu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ya po tso kɔni kake nɛ a kɛ nyɛɛ Abimelek se.
A to tso ɔmɛ kɛ kpasa mɔ ɔ, nɛ a mɛ mɔ ɔ he la.
Nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Shekem mɔ ɔ mi, maa pee nyumuhi kɛ yihi akpe kake ɔ gbo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Abimelek pue nɔ kɛ ho Tebez ya.
E ya sa ma a yi, nɛ e ngɔ ma a.
Se mɔ ko nɛ ngɛ he wami saminya ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tu fo kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
A nga a yi kɛ wo mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a kuɔ mɔ ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya.
Abimelek ba nɛ e ba tua mɔ ɔ.
Se be nɛ e maa ho mɔ ɔ sinya a he sumi ya konɛ e mɛ he la a, yo ko fɔ wɛ tɛ mi bi kɛ fia Abimelek yi; nɛ e yi ɔ ywia.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ niheyo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ esɔesɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Moo hia o klaate ɔ nɛ o kɛ gbe mi, nɛ a ko ba de ngɛ ye he ke, ‘Yo kpamakpa nɛ gbe lɛ.’ ” Nɛ niheyo ɔ gbɔ lɛ klaate ɔ nɛ e gbo.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ na kaa Abimelek gbo ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a je kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya.
Yayami nɛ Abimelek pee e tsɛ, nɛ e gbe e nyɛminyumuhi nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Mawu wo lɛ hiɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, yi wu tso níhi nɛ Shekem bi ɔmɛ pee ɔ, Mawu ha lɛ tsuo kpale bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi mi; nɛ Yerubaal binyumu Yotam gbiɛmi ɔ ba a nɔ.
Tola Abimelek gbenɔ se ɔ, Pua binyumu Tola, Dodo bibi ɔ ba he Israel yi wami.
Tola je Isakar wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ e hi Shamir ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
E da Israel ma a nya jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ.
Nɛ e gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Shamir.
Yair Tola se ɔ, Yair, Gilead no ɔ ba.
Lɛɛ e da Israel ma a nya jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
E ngɛ binyumuhi nyingmi etɛ nɛ a hii teji nyingmi etɛ a nɔ.
Jehanɛ, a ngɛ ma nyingmi etɛ ngɛ Gilead zugba a nɔ; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ ma amɛ ji Yair kɔpehi.
Yair ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Kamon.
Yefta Israel ma a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ekohu.
A ya sɔmɔ Baalhi, Ashtarot, kɛ Siria, Sidon, Moab, Amon, kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a mawu ɔmɛ.
Se Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ a kua lɛ, nɛ a kpa lɛ sɔmɔmi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Filisti bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
A hao Israel bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Amor bi a zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Gilead ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔuu.
Jehanɛ se hu, Amon bi ɔmɛ po Yordan pa a, nɛ a kɛ Yuda, Benyamin, kɛ Efraim wɛtso ɔmɛ ya hwu ta.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ Israel yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Wa pee mo yayami; ejakaa wa si mo, wa Mawu ɔ, nɛ wa ya sɔmɔ Baalhi.” Yawɛ de Israel ma a ke, “Egipt, Amor, Amon, Filisti, Sidon, Amalek, kɛ Maon bi ɔmɛ wa nyɛ yi mi be ko nɛ be ɔ, nɛ nyɛ fa kue ha mi.
Anɛ i je we nyɛ kɛ ji a dɛ mi lo?
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kua mi, nɛ nyɛ ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi hu i be nyɛ yi wami hee hu.
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ mawu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ hla kɛ ha nyɛ he ɔ; nyɛ ha nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami ngɛ nyɛ we amanehlu be nɛ ɔ mi!” Se Israel ma a de Yawɛ ke, “Wa pee yayami!
Moo lɛɛ moo pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ; wa kpa mo pɛɛ, mo he wa yi wami mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je mawu kpa amɛ kɛ je a kpɛti, nɛ a sɔmɔ Yawɛ.
Amanehlu nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nae ɔ hao Yawɛ.
Jehanɛ, Amon bi ɔmɛ dla a he kɛ ha ta hwumi, nɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Gilead.
Israel bi ɔmɛ hu ya bua a he nya ngɛ Mizpa.
Lejɛ ɔ lɛ Israel ma a, kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ bi a he ngɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ maa da ta a nya kɛ kpee Amon bi ɔmɛ?” A ya nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Nyumu nɛ ma nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma ba da Gilead ma a tsuo nya.”
Nyumu katsɛ ɔ nɛ je Gilead, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yefta a, yo ajuama ko bi ji lɛ.
E tsɛ biɛ ji Gilead.
Gilead kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yo ɔ hu fɔ binyumuhi.
Benɛ Gilead yo ɔ binyumu ɔmɛ ba wa a, a fie Yefta kɛ je we ɔ mi; nɛ a de lɛ ke, “O be gbosi ní yee ngɛ wa tsɛ we ɔ; ejakaa moo lɛɛ yo kpa bi ji mo.” Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yefta tu fo kɛ je e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e ya hi Tob zugba a nɔ.
Yakayaka nimli komɛ ho nɛ a ya piɛ e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ ke pee ɔ, e kɛ mɛ yaa nɛ a ya fiaa nihi ojo.
Be bɔɔ se ɔ, Amon bi ɔmɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba hwu ta.
Benɛ a ngɛ ta a hwue ɔ, Gilead ma nimeli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya ngɔ Yefta kɛ je Tob zugba a nɔ kɛ ba; nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Ba nɛ o ba nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi nɛ waa kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta.” Se Yefta de Gilead ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ pi imi nɛ ye he pee nyɛ tãi, nɛ nyɛ fie mi kɛ je tsaatsɛ we ɔ?
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ lɛɛ tse nyɛ ba ye ngɔ!” Gilead ma nimeli ɔmɛ de Yefta ke, “Wa kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ, ejakaa wa suɔ kaa o kɛ wɔ nɛ ya, nɛ waa kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta, nɛ o da Gilead ma a tsuo nya.” Yefta de Gilead ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ kpale mi kɛ ho, nɛ i kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta, nɛ e ba mi kaa Yawɛ ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ ma pee nyɛ nyatsɛ.” Gilead ma nimeli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Wa maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; Yawɛ ji wa we odase.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yefta kɛ Gilead ma nimeli ɔmɛ ho, nɛ a wo lɛ tsɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛngua.
Nɛ Yefta ma e munyu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ Mizpa.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yefta tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Amon matsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ a ya bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni sane i kɛ mo ngɛ loko o ba tua mi ngɛ ye zugba a nɔ ɔ?” Amon matsɛ ɔ ha Yefta tsɔli ɔmɛ heto ke, “Benɛ Israel ma a je Egipt kɛ ma a, a ngɔ ye zugba a, kɛ je Arnon pa a he kɛ ya si Yabok kɛ Yordan pa amɛ a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo kpale ye zugba a kɛ ha mi kpoo!” Yefta kpale tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Amon matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ekohu, nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yefta de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Israel ngɔɛ Moab zugba, loo Amon zugba ko.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a, a gu nga a nɔ kɛ ya na Wo Tsu ɔ loko a ba Kadesh.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tsɔ nihi Edom matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya de lɛ ke, ‘Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa gu o zugba a nɔ kɛ be’; se Edom matsɛ ɔ ha we mɛ hɛ mi.
A tsɔ kɛ ya Moab matsɛ ɔ hu ngɔ; se lɛ hu e kplɛɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hi Kadesh.
Pee se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gu nga a nɔ, nɛ a ya lɔgɔ Edom zugba a, kɛ Moab zugba a, hluu kɛ ya pa si ngɛ Moab zugba a beleku je.
A to si ngɛ Arnon pa a se, se a pui mi kɛ yɛ Moab zugba a nɔ; ejakaa Arnon pa a ji Moab huzu ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Amor bi a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ ngɛ Heshbon ɔ ngɔ, nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, ‘Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa gu o zugba a nɔ kɛ ya wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa zugba nɔ.’ Se Sihon ngmɛ́ Israel bi ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a gu e zugba a nɔ kɛ be.
Mohu, Sihon bua e ma a tsuo nya ngɛ Yahaz, nɛ a ya tua Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Se Israel Mawu ɔ ngɔ Sihon kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a ye a nɔ kunimi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba a tsuo ngɔ pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
A ngɔ Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba a tsuo, kɛ je Arnon kɛ ya si Yabok, kɛ je nga a nɔ kɛ ya si Yordan tɔɔ.
Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nitsɛ lɛ fie Amor bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha e ma Israel.
Nɛ moo o ngɛ hlae nɛ o ngɔ lo?
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ mawu Kemosh ɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ.
Wɔ hu, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ kpɔ kɛ fɔ si ha wɔ ɔ, wa maa ngɔ.
Kɛ o susuɔ kɛɛ?
Mo lɛ o hi pe Moab matsɛ, Balak, Zipor binyumu ɔ lo?
Anɛ e kɛ Israel pɛ́ hyɛ, aloo e kɛ mɛ hwui ta hyɛ lo?
Jeha lafa etɛ sɔuu nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hi Heshbon, Aroer, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Arnon pa a tue ɔ a mi ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ kpɔ we nyɛ ní jamɛ a be ɔ mi?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi lɛɛ i pee we mo yayami ko; mo mohu lɛ o tɔ ye nɔ kaa o kɛ ta ba tua mi.
Yawɛ ji kojolɔ; lɛ nɛ e maa kojo Israel ma a, kɛ Amon ma a kpɛti mwɔnɛ ɔ.” Se Amon matsɛ ɔ bui sɛ gbi nɛ Yefta kɛ mane lɛ ɔ fɛɛ!
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba Yefta nɔ; nɛ e ya kpa Gilead kɛ Manase, nɛ e po mi kɛ ho Gilead Mizpa ya.
Nɛ́ e je lejɛ ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Amon bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya.
Yefta wo Yawɛ si ke, “Ke o ngɔ Amon bi ɔmɛ ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi, nɛ i ya ye kunimi nɛ i kpale ba a, nɔmlɔ saisaa nɛ maa je kpo kɛ je ye we ɔ mi ba kpee mi ɔ, e maa pee mo, Yawɛ o nɔ; nɛ ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ.” Yefta po pa a kɛ ya na Amon bi ɔmɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ hwu ta; nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo e dɛ mi.
E fia mɛ ní kɛ je Aroer kɛ ya si Minit, ma nguangua nyingmi enyɔ sɔuu, hluu kɛ ya si Abel Keramim; nɛ e gbe mɛ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee nɛ a kɛ jɔɔ Amon bi ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yefta biyo ɔ Benɛ Yefta kpale kɛ ma e we ɔ mi ngɛ Mizpa, nɛ e maa hyɛ ɔ, e biyo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo kɛ ma lɛ kpee mi kɛ fao fiami, kɛ domi.
Lɛ pɛ ji e bi; e be binyumu, loo biyo kpa ko ngɛ e se.
Benɛ Yefta na lɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho hía e tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Ye biyo, o tsɔ ye tsui kpa!
Hyɛ amanehlu nɛ o kɛ ba ye nɔ!
I wo Yawɛ si, nɛ i be nyɛe ma kpale ye nya se.” E biyo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ, ke o wo Yawɛ si niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nya de ke o maa pee mi ɔ, pee; ejakaa Yawɛ ye o he nyɛli, nɛ ji Amon bi ɔmɛ a he lue ha mo.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ nɛ o pee ha mi kɛkɛ ji kaa o ha mi blɔ kɛ yaa si hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nyɔhiɔ enyɔ, nɛ i kɛ ye huɛmɛ waa ya yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ wa ya ye kɔmɔ kaa i li nyumu nɛ i kɛ gbo.” E tsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa.” Nɛ e ha lɛ blɔ nɛ e kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya ye nyɔhiɔ enyɔ ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ a wo yana, nɛ a ye kɔmɔ kaa Yefta biyo ɔ li nyumu nɛ e kɛ gbo.
Nyɔhiɔ enyɔ se ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ba e tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ekohu; nɛ e tsɛ ɔ pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo Yawɛ si ke e maa pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yefta biyo ɔ li nyumu nɛ e kɛ gbo.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba plɛ pee kusumi ngɛ Israel nɛ daa jeha a, zangmawi ɔmɛ yaa nɛ a ya yeɔ kɔmɔ ligbi eywiɛ kɛ kaiɔ Gilead no Yefta biyo ɔ.
Yefta kɛ Efraim bi ɔmɛ Efraim bi ɔmɛ dla a he kɛ ha ta.
A po pa a kɛ ya Zafon, nɛ a ya de Yefta ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta, nɛ o tsɛ we wɔ nɛ wa ba piɛ o he ɔ?
Wa maa mɛ o we ɔ he la kɛ pue o nɔ.” Se Yefta de mɛ ke, “I kɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, waa kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ na pɛ wawɛɛ ko, nɛ benɛ i tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bɛ nɛ nyɛ ba je ngmlaa ha mi.
Nɛ́ i na kaa nyɛ be bae ɔ, i ngɔ ye wami kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ i hia kɛ ya na Amon bi ɔmɛ; nɛ Yawɛ hu ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo ye dɛ mi.
Lɛɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ hia kɛ ba na mi mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi ba hwu mɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yefta bua Gilead nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ a kɛ Efraim bi ɔmɛ hwu ta nɛ e ye a nɔ.
Ejakaa Efraim bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Nyɛ Gilead bi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Efraim kɛ Manase ɔ, ta nɛ fie nyɛ kɛ je Efraim kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.” Gilead bi ɔmɛ ya tsi blɔ ha Efraim bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yordan pa pomi he ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Efraim bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ fo tue ɔ, ke a ti nɔ ko ke a ha lɛ blɔ nɛ e po pa a, Gilead bi ɔmɛ ma bi lɛ ke, “Efraim no ji mo lo?” Ke e he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!” ɔ, a ma de lɛ ke e de ke, “Shibolet.” Ke e lilɛ ya dɛ nɔ nɛ e ya de ke, “Sibolet” mohu ɔ, a maa nu lɛ nɛ a maa gbe lɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a pomi he ɔmɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a gbe Efraim bi akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Yefta, Gilead no ɔ da Israel ma a nya jeha ekpa.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ba gbo; nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ e ma mi, ngɛ Gilead.
Ibzan kɛ Elon kɛ Abdon Yefta se ɔ, Ibzan nɛ je Betlehem ɔ ba da Israel ma a nya.
E ngɛ binyumuhi nyingmi etɛ, kɛ biyihi nyingmi etɛ.
