E ngɔ e biyi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha gba ngɛ weku kpahi a mi, nɛ e ya hla yihewi nyingmi etɛ kɛ je weku kpahi a mi kɛ ba ha e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ.
Ibzan da Israel ma a nya jeha kpaago.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ba gbo; nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Betlehem.
Ibzan se ɔ, Elon, Zebulun no ɔ ba da Israel ma a nya jeha nyɔngma.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ba gbo; nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Aiyalon, ngɛ Zebulun zugba a nɔ.
Elon se ɔ, Abdon, Hilel binyumu ɔ nɛ je Piraton ɔ ba da Israel ma a nya.
E ngɛ binyumuhi nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ bibinyumuhi nyingmi etɛ nɛ hii teji nyingmi kpaago a nɔ.
Abdon da Israel ma a nya jeha kpaanyɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ba gbo; nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Piraton, ngɛ Efraim zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ a yoku ɔ nɔ.
Samson fɔmi Israel bi ɔmɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ekohu; nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumu ko ngɛ Zora nɛ je Dan weku ɔ mi; e biɛ ji Manoa.
E yo ɔ lɛɛ yosa ji lɛ; e fɔ we hyɛ.
Yawɛ bɔfo je e he kpo tsɔɔ yo ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, yosa ji mo, nɛ o fɔ we lɛɛ, se jehanɛ, o ma na mi, nɛ o ma fɔ binyumu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hyɛ o he nɔ saminya.
Koo nu wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa; nɛ koo ye nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hulɔ.
Ke o fɔ binyumuyo nɛ ɔ, asoyi kó ya e yi mi; ejakaa kɛ je e fɔmi be ɔ, a maa tsukɔ e he kɛ ha Mawu, nɛ e maa hi si kaa Nazir no.
Israel kpɔmi kɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ, lɛ nɛ e ma ba je sisi.” Yo ɔ ba nɛ e ba de e huno ɔ ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ ko ba ye ngɔ; e hɛ mi ngɛ gbeye kaa Mawu bɔfo hɛ mi.
I bi we lɛ he nɛ e je, nɛ lɛ hu e tsɔɔ we mi e biɛ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ e de mi ji, ‘O nɛ, o ma na mi, nɛ o ma fɔ binyumu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo nu wai, loo dã ko nɛ nya wa.
Koo ye nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hulɔ; ejakaa kɛ je jokuɛ nyumuyo nɛ ɔ fɔmi be ɔ, a maa tsukɔ e he kɛ ha Mawu, nɛ e maa pee Nazir no e wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo.’ ” Manoa fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ o tsɔ ɔ, ha nɛ e kpale ba wa ngɔ ekohu nɛ e ba tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ wa maa hɛɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ nɛ a ma fɔ ɔ ha.” Mawu bu Manoa gbi tue, nɛ Mawu bɔfo kpale ba yo ɔ ngɔ ekohu benɛ e hii si ngɛ ngmɔ mi; se e huno Manoa lɛɛ e be lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yo ɔ tu fo esɔesɔ nɛ e ya de e huno ɔ ke, “O nɛ, nyumu ɔ nɛ ba ye ngɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kpale kɛ ba ekohu.” Manoa te si nɛ e nyɛɛ yo ɔ se.
Benɛ e na nyumu ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “Mo lɛ o kɛ ye yo ɔ ba tu munyu ligbi ko ɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Ee, imi.” Manoa bi lɛ ke, “Ke o munyu ɔmɛ ba mi ɔ, kɛ jokuɛ ɔ je mi bami ma ba hi kɛɛ?
Mɛni e ma ba tsu?” Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de Manoa ke, “O yo ɔ hɛ nɛ hi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ wai tso mi ɔ, e ko ye eko kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Jehanɛ, e ko nu wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa; nɛ e ko ye nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hulɔ.
Mlaa amɛ nɛ i wo lɛ ɔ, e ye kulaa nɔ.” -Manoa li tete kaa Yawɛ bɔfo lɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha waa tsi o nya bɔɔ nɛ waa gbe apletsi bɔbɔyoo ko ha mo nɛ o ye.” Se Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ke o tsi ye nya po i be o niye ní ɔ yee.
Ke o suɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ lohwe ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ mohu ha Yawɛ.” Manoa de Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ke, “Moo tsɔɔ wɔ o biɛ, konɛ ke o munyu ɔmɛ ba mi nɛ waa wo o hɛ mi nyami.” Se Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ hlae nɛ o le ye biɛ?
Ye biɛ ɔ, e ji nyakpɛ biɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Manoa ngɔ apletsi bɔbɔyoo ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ tɛ sa a nɔ ha Yawɛ nɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní ɔ.
-Benɛ la lilɛ ɔ te si kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Manoa kɛ e yo ɔ na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɛ la lilɛ ɔ mi nɛ e yaa hiɔwe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, ejakaa kpaako Manoa yɔse kaa mamoo Yawɛ bɔfo lɛ je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛ je lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ je we e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ we Manoa kɛ e yo ɔ hu.
Manoa de e yo ɔ ke, “Pe wa gbo ɔ nɛ; ejakaa wa na Mawu.” Se e yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ to kaa e maa gbe wɔ jinɛ e ko he we sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ ngɛ wa dɛ.
Jinɛ e ko tsɔɔ we wɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ e ko ha we nɛ waa nu sanehi nɛ wa nu nɛ ɔ hulɔ.” Yo ɔ ba fɔ binyumu, nɛ e wo lɛ Samson.
Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa, nɛ Yawɛ gbaa lɛ.
Yawɛ mumi ɔ bɔni e he ní tsumi ngɛ Mahane Dan, ngɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol a kpɛti.
Samson kɛ Timna yiheyo ɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, Samson ya Timna, nɛ e ya na Filisti yiheyo ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba a, e ba de e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ ke, “I ya na Filisti yiheyo ko ngɛ Timna; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ya bi e si ha mi nɛ ma ngɔ lɛ.” Se e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ yo ko yo ko be o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a biyi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti, loko o yaa ngɔ yo ngɛ Filisti bi mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ?” Samson de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya bi e si ha mi, ejakaa i suɔ lɛ.” E tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ li tete kaa Yawɛ nitsɛ yi mi tomi ji kaa Samson nɛ gu yo nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ná Filisti bi ɔmɛ a he blɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Filisti bi nɛ a ngɛ Israel nɔ yee.
Samson kɛ e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Timna ya.
Benɛ a su Timna wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Samson na jata bɔbɔyoo ko nɛ ngɛ huãe kɛ ma e ngɔ.
Si kake too ɔ, Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba e nɔ; nɛ e kɛ e nine gu tsɔtslɔɔ jata a mi kaa a tsɔtslɔɔ apletsi bɔbɔyoo mi.
Se e de we e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho nɛ e kɛ e yo ɔ ya sɛɛ ní; Samson ná yo ɔ he bua jɔmi saminya.
Pee se ɔ, Samson kpale kɛ ho nɛ e ya ngɔ yo ɔ. Benɛ e yaa a, e gba ya hyɛ jata gbogboe ɔ; nɛ e na hwo bihi a kuu nɛ a to hwo ngɛ jata a muklii mi.
Samson nyla hwo ɔ kɛ wo e dɛ mi, nɛ e ngɛ yee kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe.
Benɛ e ya na e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, e ha mɛ eko nɛ a ye; se e de we mɛ ke jata gbogboe ɔ mi mi nɛ e je hwo ɔ kɛ je.
E tsɛ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho yo ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ Samson ya ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa ja ji kusumi nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ pɔɔ peemi.
Benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ na lɛ ɔ, a ya ngɔ a huɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ kɛ ba okplɔɔ ɔ he.
Samson de mɛ ke, “Ma sia nyɛ ajo ko.
Ke nyɛ tsɔɔ mi sisi ngɛ okplɔɔ ngmɛmi ligbi kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ma ha nyɛ bo nyingmi etɛ, kɛ he dlami tade nyingmi etɛ.
Se ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi sisi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ mohu nyɛ ma ha mi bo nyingmi etɛ, kɛ he dlami tade nyingmi etɛ.” A de lɛ ke, “Ajo ɔ nɛ ba nɛ waa nu.” Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ ko nɛ a yeɔ je nɔ́ yelɔ ɔ mi; nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɔɔ je nɔ́ nɛ he wa a mi.” Se ligbi etɛ sɔuu be, nɛ a nyɛ we ajo ɔ sisi nɛ a tsɔɔ.
Ligbi nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, a ya nɛ a ya de Samson yo ɔ ke, “Moo gbe o huno ɔ yi mi nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ ajo ɔ sisi; ke pi ja a, wa maa mɛ o tsɛ we ɔ he la, nɛ wa maa sã mo, kɛ o we ɔ tsuo.
Pe nyɛ je blɔ kpee wɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba pee wɔ posoposo?” Samson yo ɔ hia ya kɛ ya na e huno ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mamoo o sume mi, nɛ o buá peeɔ o ní kaa o suɔ mi!
O sia ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ajo, se o tsɔɔ we mi sisi!” Samson de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, tsaatsɛ kɛ maa po i de we mɛ, nɛ moo lɛɛ ma de mo?” Yo ɔ fo ya kɛ wo lɛ ligbi kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ. Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ ɔ, Samson tsɔɔ e yo ɔ ajo ɔ sisi, ejakaa e ngɛ lɛ haoe tsɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ lɛ hu e ya de Filisti bi ɔmɛ.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, loko pu nɔ si ɔ, ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ ba de Samson ke, “Ajo ɔ sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mɛni ngɔɔ pe hwo?
Nɛ mɛni he wa pe jata?’ ” Samson de mɛ ke, “Kaa nyɛ ya ngɔɛ ye na zangmayo ɔ kɛ hu we jinɛ nyɛ ko li ye ajo ɔ sisi.” Tlukaa a, Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba e nɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Ashkelon ya; nɛ e ya gbe nyumuhi nyingmi etɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E kpa a he níhi, nɛ e ngɔ he dlami tade ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ tsɔɔ ajo ɔ sisi ɔ. Nɛ e kɛ mi mi fumi je kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ Samson yo ɔ ha Samson huɛ ɔ nɛ ya sɛ lɛ yo kpeemi ɔ.
Pee se benɛ ngma kpami be su ɔ, Samson ya nɛ e ya slaa e yo ɔ. E hɛɛ apletsi bɔbɔyoo ko kɛ to e dɛ kaa nike ní.
E de e ngatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma ya ye yo ɔ ngɔ ngɛ se tsu ɔ mi.” Se e ngatsɛ ɔ ngmɛ́ lɛ blɔ nɛ e sɛ tsu ɔ mi.
E de Samson ke, “Jinɛ i susu kaa o sume yo ɔ hu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha o huɛ ɔ. O yo ɔ senɔ ɔ po he ngɛ fɛu pe lɛ.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to nɔkɔtɔma a nane mi.” Samson de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ke i pee Filisti bi ɔmɛ yayami ko ɔ, a musu be mi tlooe.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Samson ho nɛ e ya nuu kɔkɔbo lafa etɛ.
E tsa enyɔ tsuaa enyɔ hlemi kɛ bla, nɛ e kɛ jatɛ hɔɔ kpɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e su jatɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngmɛɛ kɔkɔbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ wo Filisti bi ɔmɛ a ngma ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi; nɛ ngma nɛ a bua nya kuu, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ daa si, kɛ oliv tso abɔɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa sã.
Benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ bi si ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?” a de ke, “Samson lɛ pee; ejakaa e ngatsɛ, Timna no ɔ ngɔ Samson yo ɔ ngɔ ha Samson huɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya sã yo ɔ kɛ e tsɛ ɔ tsuo.
Samson de mɛ ke, “Ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ peeɔ nyɛ níhi ɔ, lɛɛ i na Mawu kaa imi hu ja i pee nyɛ ngɔ to nya loko ma kpa.” Samson ya tua mɛ, nɛ e gbe mɛ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya hi Etam tɛ sa puɔ ɔ mi.
Samson ye Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nɔ Pee se ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ Yuda, nɛ a je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya tua Lehi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ba tua wɔ ɔ?” Nɛ a he nɔ ke, “Wa ba Samson fimi nɛ wa ya pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ hu e pee wɔ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda nyumuhi akpe etɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Etam tɛ sa puɔ ɔ he ya nɛ a ya bi Samson ke, “Anɛ o li kaa Filisti bi ɔmɛ lɛ a ngɛ wa nɔ yee lo?
Mɛni o pee wɔ nɛ ɔ?” E de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ a pee mi ɔ, ja imi hu i pee mɛ ɔ nɛ.” A de lɛ ke, “Wa ma mo fimi nɛ waa ngɔ mo ya wo Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Samson de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ka mi kita kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ be mi nɔ́ ko pee.” A de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, wa be mo gbee.
Pe wa maa fi mo kɛkɛ nɛ waa ngɔ mo ya wo a dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ tangme he enyɔ kɛ fi lɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ je tɛ sa a mi kɛ ba.
Benɛ e ba su Lehi ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ he ose kɛ ba na lɛ.
Tlukaa a, Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba e nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e tsɔ tangme ɔmɛ nɛ blaa e nine ɔ pue si kaa doti nɛ la sɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e na teji ko nɛ gbo kɛ we tsitsa mi wu.
E ba si nɛ e kɛ̃, nɛ e kɛ gbe nyumuhi akpe.
Nɛ Samson de ke, “I ngɔ teji tsitsa wu kɛ gbe nyumuhi akpe; i ngɔ teji tsitsa wu kɛ tsɔtslɔɔ a mi pue si.” Benɛ e tu munyu ɔ ta a, e sake tsitsa wu ɔ ngɔ fɔ he.
Nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Ramat Lehi.
Jehanɛ, kuma ba ye Samson wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ e de ke, “O tsu manye ní tsumi nguaa nɛ ɔ kɛ gu o tsɔlɔ ɔ nine nɔ.
Anɛ kuma nɛ gbe mi, nɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a nine nɛ su ye nɔ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bli muɔ nyafii ko nɛ ngɛ Lehi ɔ nya, nɛ nyu je mi kɛ ba.
Benɛ Samson nu nyu ɔ, e hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ; nɛ e na he wami ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Hakore, nɛ e ngɛ Lehi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Samson da Israel ma a nya jeha nyingmi enyɔ be mi nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ yee ɔ.
Samson ngɛ Gaza Ligbi ko ɔ, Samson ya Gaza, nɛ e ya na yo yaholɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi.
Benɛ Gaza bi ɔmɛ nu kaa Samson ba lejɛ ɔ, a ya sa ma a yi, nɛ a wo ka ha Samson ngɛ agbo ɔ nya nyɔ mi tsuo.
A pee dii nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ a de a sibi ke, “Nyɛ ha waa mlɛ kɛ yaa si mɔtu loko waa gbe lɛ.” Se Samson hwɔ si kɛ ya si nyɔ mi kpɛti pɛ.
Benɛ e te si ɔ, e hia ma a agbo ɔ sinya amɛ, sinya tso enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ dade ɔ nɛ a kɛ bile agbo ɔ se ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E ngɔ mɛ fɔ e konɔ kɛ ho yoku ɔ nɛ ngɛ Hebron hɛ mi ɔ yi mi ya.
Samson kɛ Delila Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Samson ya su yo ko ngɛ Sorek kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Delila.
Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba yo ɔ ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Moo gbe Samson yi mi nɛ e tsɔɔ mo he nɛ e naa e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ wa maa pee nɛ wa nine maa su e nɔ, konɛ waa fi lɛ, nɛ waa jɔɔ e he.
Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ha mo sika hiɔ akpe kɛ e nya lafa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Delila de Samson ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o tsɔɔ mi he nɛ o naa o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ.
Ke a ngɛ hlae nɛ a jɔɔ o he ɔ, mɛni a kɛ maa fi mo?” Samson de lɛ ke, “Ke a ngɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi kpa he kpaago nɛ gbli we kɛ fi mi ɔ, ma gbɔjɔ, nɛ ma hi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsuaa nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ ɔ.” Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi kpa he nɛ gbli we kpaago kɛ ba ha Delila, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ fi Samson.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e ha nɛ nyumu komɛ ya wo ka ngɛ se tsu ko mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Samson!
Filisti bi ɔmɛ ma mo numi!” Se Samson tsɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi kpa amɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ke la sa bo lomi kpa he nɛ e tsɔɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, laami sane nɛ ngɛ he nɛ e naa e he wami ɔ kɛ jeɔ ɔ, a li.
Delila de Samson ke, “Hyɛ kaa o pee mi kuasia, nɛ o mlɔɔ mi!
I kpa mo pɛɛ, moo tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ a ma plɛ kɛ fi mo ha.” Samson de lɛ ke, “Ke a ngɔ tangme hehi nɛ a kɛ tsu we nɔ́ ko hyɛ kɛ fi mi ɔ, ma gbɔjɔ, nɛ ma hi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsuaa nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Delila ya hla tangme hehi nɛ e kɛ ba fi Samson; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Samson!
Filisti bi ɔmɛ ma mo numi!” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumu ɔmɛ ya wo ka ngɛ se tsu ko mi.
Samson tsɔ tangme ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ fi e kɔni ɔmɛ kaa a tsɔɔ nazee.
Delila de Samson ke, “Kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kuasia sɔuu kɛkɛ o ngɛ mi pee; nɛ o ngɛ mi mlɔɔe hulɔ.
Moo tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ a ma plɛ kɛ fi mo ha.” Samson de lɛ ke, “Ke o ngɔ ya kɛ lo ye yi bwɔmi kuukuu kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ bla pee kake, nɛ o kɛ plɛɛko ka lɛ kɛ wo bo lomi klama he ɔ, ma gbɔjɔ, nɛ ma hi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsuaa nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Samson hwɔ mahe ɔ, Delila ya hɔɔ Samson yi bwɔmi kuukuu kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ bla pee kake, nɛ e fi kɛ wo plɛɛko he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Samson!
Filisti bi ɔmɛ ma mo numi!” Samson hɛ tsɛ̃, nɛ e gbla e yi bwɔmi ɔ kɛ je plɛɛko kɛ bo lomi klama kɛ ya a mi.
Delila de lɛ ke, “Ke o ke o suɔ mi, se imi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ lɛɛ o tsui be ye he ɔ, kɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?
Si etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ o pee mi kuasia; se he nɛ o naa o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ o tsɔɔ we mi.” Bɔ nɛ Delila ngɛ Samson tsui yee nɛ e ngɛ lɛ haoe daa ligbi kɛ e munyu ɔmɛ ɔ, be ko ba su nɛ Samson nyɛ we hu.
Nyagbenyagbe ɔ, e gba Delila e laami sane ɔmɛ tsuo.
E de lɛ ke, “Kɛ je benɛ i ngɛ ye nyɛ mi mi lokoo ɔ, a tsukɔ ye he ngɔ ha Mawu kaa Nazir no; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, asoyi nya yɛ ye yi mi hyɛ.
Ke a sã ye yi nɔ pɛ ye he wami ɔ maa je ye mi.
Kɛkɛ ma gbɔjɔ, nɛ ma hi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsuaa nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ ɔ.” Benɛ Delila na kaa e de lɛ anɔkuale ɔ tsuo ɔ, e tsɔ ya de Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba si kake nɛ ɔ pɛ; ejakaa jehanɛ lɛɛ e gba mi e yi mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba, nɛ benɛ a ma a, a hɛɛ sika a kɛ ba.
Delila fiɛ Samson he kɛ ya si e hwɔ mahe ngɛ e tɛ nɔ.
Benɛ Samson hwɔ mahe ɔ, Delila tsɛ nyumu ko nɛ e ba sã Samson yi bwɔmi kuukuu kpaago ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Delila bɔni lɛ kongomi, ejakaa Samson he wami ɔ si lɛ.
Delila de lɛ ke, “Samson!
Filisti bi ɔmɛ ma mo numi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Samson hɛ tsɛ̃, nɛ e de ke, “Ma je kpo kaa bɔ nɛ i peeɔ daa a, nɛ ma ya hoso ye he.” Se e li tete kaa Yawɛ je e se.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ nu lɛ, nɛ a ta e hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Gaza ya, nɛ a ya bɔ lɛ akɔblee pãhi; nɛ a ha nɛ e wɛɛɔ blɛfo ngɛ he nɛ a wo lɛ tsu ngɛ ɔ.
Se e yi bwɔmi ɔ bɔni tsɛ̃mi ekohu.
Samson gbenɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya, konɛ a nya nɛ a sã bɔ nguaa ko kɛ ha a mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Dagon ɔ.
A de ke, “Wa mawu ɔ ngɔ wa he nyɛlɔ Samson ngɔ wo wa dɛ mi.” -Benɛ ni ɔmɛ a bua jɔ a he ɔ, a de ke, “Nyɛ tsɛ Samson kɛ ba nɛ e ba wo wa nya muɔ bɔɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya ngɔ Samson kɛ je tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba da titima enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ́ e je ni ɔmɛ a hɛja.
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ na lɛ ɔ, a je a mawu ɔ yi, nɛ a de ke, “Wa mawu ɔ ngɔ wa he nyɛlɔ, kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ kpata wa zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ́ e gbe wa ti nihi babauu ɔ kɛ wo wa dɛ mi!” Samson de niheyo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ e nine si ɔ ke, “Ha ma pɛtɛ titima amɛ nɛ hɛɛ tsu ɔ a he nɛ ma hyɛ; i suɔ kaa ma kpasa mɛ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumuhi, kɛ yihi hyi tsu ɔ mi gbagbaagba.
Filisti matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi ngɛ Samson hyɛe nɛ e ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a nya muɔ woe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Samson fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, mo kai mi jehanɛ.
Mawu lee, mo ha mi ye he wami ɔ si kake nɛ ɔ pɛ, konɛ ma ye ye he lue ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nɔ, ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Samson ngɔ e nine hiɔ kɛ muɔ kɛ fua kpɛti titima enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ tsu ɔ kpɛkpɛtɛɛ; nɛ e de ke, “Ha nɛ i kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ nɛ gbo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Samson ngɔ e he wami tsuo kɛ tsɛ̃ titima amɛ; nɛ tsu ɔ hule pue matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Nɛ nimli nɛ Samson gbe ligbi ɔ nɛ e gbo ɔ, a hiɛ kulaa pe nimli nɛ e gbe ngɛ e wami be mi.
Pee se ɔ, Samson nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɛ we ɔ tsuo ho nɛ a ya ngɔ e gbogboe ɔ, nɛ a ya pu ngɛ e tsɛ Manoa yɔkɔ ɔ mi, ngɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol a kpɛti.
Samson da Israel ma a nya jeha nyingmi enyɔ.
Mika we amaga amɛ Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mika a hi Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ be ko.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e de e nyɛ ke, “Benɛ a ju o sika hiɔ yi akpe kɛ e nya lafa nɛ o gbiɛ julɔ ɔ, i nu he.
O nɛ, jamɛ a sika hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ; imi lɛ i ngɔ.” E nyɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ye bi, Yawɛ nɛ gbaa mo!” E kpale sika hiɔ yi akpe kɛ e nya lafa a kɛ ha e nyɛ ɔ; nɛ e nyɛ ɔ de ke, “I ngɛ sika hiɔ nɛ ɔ he tsukɔe ha Yawɛ ngɛ ye binyumu ɔ he, konɛ a ngɔ kɛ pee amaga nɛ a hlɔ, nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ ha he.” Benɛ e kpale sika a kɛ ha e nyɛ ɔ, e nyɛ ɔ je e mi lafa enyɔ kɛ ha sika hiɔ galɔ, nɛ e kɛ pee amaga nɛ a hlɔ nɛ kɛ sika hiɔ ha he; nɛ a ngɔ amaga a kɛ ma Mika we ɔ mi.
Kikɛmɛ a Mika nɛ ɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e jami he kɛ e mi amagahi nɛ a kpɛ́.
E pee efɔd, nɛ e wo e binyumu ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake osɔfo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, matsɛ ko be Israel, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Levi no niheyo ko ba to nubwɔ ngɛ Betlehem Yuda.
E ba mi kaa nyumu ɔ hia kɛ je Betlehem Yuda, konɛ e ya hla he kpa ko nɛ e hi.
Benɛ e yaa a, e ya pã si ngɛ Mika we ɔ mi, ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Mika bi lɛ ke, “Jije o je?” Nɛ e ha lɛ heto ke, “Levi no ji mi; i je Betlehem Yuda, nɛ i ngɛ he ko hlae nɛ ma hi.” Mika de lɛ ke, “Ba hi ye ngɔ, nɛ o ba pee ye tsɛ kɛ ye osɔfo.
Ma ha mo niye ní, tade, kɛ sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma daa jeha.” Levi no niheyo ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ Mika maa hi si, nɛ e ba pee kaa e bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
Mika wo Levi no niheyo ɔ osɔfo, nɛ e hi Mika we ɔ mi.
Mika de ke, “Kpaako i na kaa Yawɛ maa gbaa mi; ejakaa i ná Levi no osɔfo.”
Mika kɛ Dan wɛtso ɔ Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, matsɛ ko be Israel.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi hu Dan wɛtso ɔ ngɛ he ko hlae nɛ a hi; ejakaa ngɛ Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, mɛɛ a nine sui mɛ nitsɛmɛ a weto ní ko nɔ lolo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Dan bi ɔmɛ hla nyumuhi katsɛmɛ enuɔ kɛ je a wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ a tsɔ mɛ kɛ je Zora kɛ Eshtaol nɛ a ya slaa zugba a. Benɛ a su Efraim yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ya to Mika we ɔ mi.
Benɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a yɔse Levi no niheyo ɔ munyu tutui, nɛ a ya bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ngɔ mo kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ?” E de mɛ ke, “I kɛ Mika so somi ko; e bɔ mi apaa, nɛ i ngɛ osɔfo yee ha lɛ.” A de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, mo bi Mawu ha wɔ kaa blɔ nɛ wa hia nɛ ɔ maa pee jɔjɔɛ ha wɔ lo.” Osɔfo ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya kɛ manye!
Yawɛ maa bu nyɛ he ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ni enuɔ ɔmɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Laish ya.
A na kaa lejɛ ɔ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ kaa Sidon bi ɔmɛ.
A ngɛ kpoo nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pue we a tsui nɔ; a ngɛ níhi babauu, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, a kɛ Sidon bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ, nɛ a kɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɔɛ.
Benɛ a kpale kɛ ba a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ngɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol ɔ, a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ nyɛ ya na lejɛ ɔ kɛɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ho nɛ wa ya tua mɛ!
Wa ya hyɛ zugba a, nɛ e hi saminya.
Anɛ nyɛ maa hi si gu, nɛ nyɛ be nɔ́ ko pee ngɛ he lo?
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɔuu!
Ke nyɛ ya a, nyɛ maa na zugba agbo ko kɛ e mi nimli nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pee we mɛ kɔmɔ.
Niinɛ, zugba, he nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we ngɛ ɔ, jamɛ a zugba a ji zugba nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumuhi lafa ekpa nɛ je Dan bi ɔmɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ kpla gbaja, nɛ a dla a he kɛ ta hwumi níhi.
A hia kɛ je Zora kɛ Eshtaol, nɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Kiriat Yearim, ngɛ Yuda.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ ji Mahane Dan.
E ngɛ Kiriat Yearim bonyoku je.
Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a nyɛɛ kɛ ya si a ya pã si ngɛ Mika we ɔ mi, ngɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ni enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ya slaa Laish zugba a de a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ le kaa efɔd, kɛ amaga nɛ a kpɛ́, kɛ amaga nɛ a hlɔ nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ ha he ngɛ we ɔ kake mi lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee ha!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a gba Mika we ɔ mi, he nɛ Levi no niheyo ɔ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a ya fɔ lɛ.
Dan bi lafa ekpa amɛ nɛ mia kɛ ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ɔ daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya.
Se nyumu ni enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ya slaa zugba a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ a ya ngɔ amaga nɛ a hlɔ nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ ha he ɔ, kɛ efɔd ɔ, kɛ amaga nɛ a kpɛ́ ɔ, be mi nɛ osɔfo ɔ, kɛ nyumuhi lafa ekpa amɛ nɛ mia kɛ ta hwumi ní ɔ daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya a. Benɛ ni ɔmɛ ya sɛ Mika we ɔ mi, nɛ a ya ngɔ tso amaga nɛ a hlɔ nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ ha he ɔ, kɛ efɔd ɔ, kɛ amaga nɛ a kpɛ́ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?” A de lɛ ke, “Ma o nya, nɛ o pee dii!
Ba nɛ waa ho, nɛ o ya pee wa tsɛ kɛ wa osɔfo.
Anɛ o suɔ kaa o maa ye osɔfo ngɛ nɔmlɔ kake we mi, pe kaa o maa ye osɔfo ha wɛtso mluku ngɛ Israel lo?” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔ osɔfo ɔ nya saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɔ efɔd ɔ, kɛ amaga nɛ a kpɛ́ ɔ, kɛ amaga nɛ a hlɔ nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ ha he ɔ; nɛ e kɛ ni ɔmɛ ho.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsa a blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ; a ngɔ a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ, a we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ a tlomi ɔmɛ kɛ sɛ hlami.
Benɛ Dan bi ɔmɛ je, nɛ a kɛ Mika we ɔ he kɛ saii ɔ, Mika ya bua e huza nɔ bi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ Dan bi ɔmɛ a se.
Benɛ a ya na mɛ ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Dan bi ɔmɛ a yi se.
Nɛ mɛ hu a plɛ, nɛ a bi Mika ke, “Mɛni ngɛ mo pee?
Jije o kɛ nimli kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ yaa?” E he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ba ngɔ ye osɔfo ɔ, kɛ amagahi nɛ i pee ɔ, nɛ nyɛ je kɛ yaa!
Mɛni piɛ ha mi?
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔ nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛ kpale ngɛ mi bie ke, ‘Mɛni ngɛ mo pee?’ ” Dan bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Ke o hla we nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a muklii mi nɛ fu, nɛ a kpata o kɛ o we bi ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ moo pee kɔ̃.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Dan bi ɔmɛ tsa a nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ.
Benɛ Mika na kaa a he wa pe lɛ ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ho we mi ya.
-Benɛ Dan bi ɔmɛ a nine su ní ɔmɛ nɛ Mika pee ɔ, kɛ e osɔfo ɔ a nɔ ɔ, a ho nɛ a ya tua Laish ma kɛ e mi bi kpoo nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pue we a tsui nɔ ɔ ngɛ Bet Rehob bi ɔmɛ a kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
A kɛ klaate gbe ma a mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a mɛ ma a he la.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko ji ngmlaa ha mɛ, ejakaa Laish kɛ Sidon he kɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, a kɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be bɔmi.
Dan bi ɔmɛ dla po ma a, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ.
A kɛ a tsɛ Dan, Yakob binyumu ɔ biɛ wo ma a; jinɛ sa a, a tsɛɛ ma a ke Laish.
Dan bi ɔmɛ ngɔ amaga a kɛ ma si, nɛ a bɔni lɛ jami.
Gershom binyumu Yonatan, Mose bibi ɔ, kɛ e bimɛ nɛ ba ngɛ e se ɔ, ye osɔfo ha Dan wɛtso ɔ kɛ ya si ligbi ɔ nɛ a nuu zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ amaga a nɛ Mika pee ɔ kɛ ma si, nɛ a ja lɛ ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Shilo ɔ.
Levi no ɔ kɛ e plã a Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ Israel na we matsɛ lolo ɔ, Levi no ko ya to nubwɔ ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsitsaa lokoo; nɛ e ya su yo ko ngɛ Betlehem Yuda.
E ba mi kaa e plã yo ɔ mi mi fu lɛ, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ho e tsɛ we ya ngɛ Betlehem Yuda, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔhiɔ eywiɛ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e huno ɔ bu e nɔ konɛ e kɛ lɛ ya tu ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba.
E kɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ teji enyɔ ho.
Benɛ e ba su yo ɔ tsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, yo ɔ tsɛ ɔ na lɛ, nɛ e kɛ bua jɔmi ba kpee lɛ.
E ngatsɛ ɔ tsi e nya, nɛ e ye ligbi etɛ ngɛ e ngɔ.
A ye ní, nɛ a nu dã, nɛ a hwɔ lejɛ ɔ. Ligbi nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, a te si mɔtu kpla nɛ a dla konɛ a pue blɔ, se yo ɔ tsɛ ɔ de e ngatsɛ ɔ ke, “Moo mlɛ nɛ o wo o nya mi nɔ́ ko loko o ho.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ni enyɔ ɔmɛ hi si nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu dã; nɛ yo ɔ tsɛ ɔ de nyumu ɔ ke, “Moo hwɔ hiɛ ɔ gbɔkuɛ nɛ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ o na bua jɔmi.” Benɛ Levi no ɔ te si nɛ e maa je ɔ, e ngatsɛ ɔ hɛɛ mi hluu nɛ e tsi e nya nɛ e hwɔ lejɛ ɔ ekohu.
Ligbi nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ, e te si mɔtu kpla konɛ e hia blɔ ɔ.
Se yo ɔ tsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Moo wo o nya mi nɔ́ ko, nɛ o mlɛ kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ.” Nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a ye ní.
Benɛ nyumu ɔ, kɛ e plã a, kɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ dla nɛ a maa ho ɔ, e ngatsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, du bu ta; nyɛɛ hwɔ hiɛ ɔ!
O nɛ, je jɔ; nyɛɛ hwɔ hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si je maa na, nɛ o bua nɛ jɔ o he; konɛ nyɛɛ te si hwɔɔ mɔtu mla, nɛ nyɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho o ma a mi ya.” Se nyumu ɔ kplɛɛ we kaa e maa hwɔ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. E kɛ e plã a, e tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ teji enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a wo a nɔ ní ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ya si a ya su Yebus (nɛ ji Yerusalem) hanɔ.
Benɛ a su Yebus ta a, du bu, nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ de e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Ha wa gba Yebus bi ɔmɛ a ma a mi, nɛ wa ya hwɔ lejɛ ɔ.” Se e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Wa be ni komɛ nɛ pi Israel bi ji mɛ a ma mi gbae, se mohu wa maa po mi kɛ ya Gibea.
Ha waa nyɛɛ kɛ ya wa hɛ mi bɔɔ, nɛ wa ya hwɔ Gibea, loo Rama.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsa nɔ kɛ ho.
Benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa su Gibea ngɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ ɔ, pu nɔ si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gba konɛ a ya hwɔ Gibea.
A ya to si ngɛ magbɛ nɔ; ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko ba ngɔɛ mɛ kɛ yɛ e we mi nɛ a ya to lɛ.
Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, nɔmoyo ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ je ngmɔ nɔ kɛ ma.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ e je kɛ ba to nubwɔ ngɛ Gibea, ngɛ Benyamin bi a kpɛti.
Benɛ nɔmoyo ɔ na blɔ hialɔ ɔ ngɛ magbɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “Jije o je?
Nɛ jije o yaa?” Levi no ɔ de lɛ ke, “Wa ba be kɛ ho Betlehem Yuda ya, nɛ wa kpale kɛ yaa we ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsitsaa lokoo, se nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔɛ wɔ kɛ yɛ e we mi.
Wa ngɛ nga, kɛ niye ní ha wa teji ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, wa hɛɛ niye ní, kɛ wai kɛ ha imi nitsɛ kɛ o mawayo ɔ, kɛ niheyo ɔ nɛ kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ɔ; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we wɔ.” Nɔmoyo ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ hee!
Mawu nɛ gbaa nyɛ!
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa hia nyɛ ɔ, ma pee ha nyɛ; se magbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ko hwɔ.” E ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho e we mi ya, nɛ e ya ha teji ɔmɛ ní.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a fɔ a nanehi a he, nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu dã.
Benɛ a bua jɔ a he ɔ, yakayaka nyumu komɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ ba bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe.
A si sinya a kɛ he wami, nɛ a de nɔmoyo ɔ nɛ ji wetsɛ ɔ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ ba o we ɔ mi ɔ, je lɛ ha wɔ nɛ waa kɛ lɛ nɛ hwɔ.” Se wetsɛ ɔ je kpo kɛ ya na mɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Dɛbi!
Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko pee yayami ko nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ!
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, ye nubwɔ ji lɛ; nyɛ ko tsu kikɛmɛ a zo ní nɛ ɔ!
Ye bi zangmayo nɛ li nyumu, kɛ nyumu ɔ hu plã ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ma je mɛ kpo ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho, nɛ nyɛ ya pee mɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ.
Se nyumu nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ ko pee lɛ zo nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ.” Se nyumu ɔmɛ bui lɛ tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Levi no ɔ ya nu e plã a nɛ e tsitsɛɛ e yi se mane mɛ.
A kɛ lɛ hwɔ, nɛ a pee lɛ basabasa nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo kɛ ya si mɔtu.
Benɛ je mi maa ho tsɔmi ya a, a ngmɛɛ e he.
Makɛ futɛfutɛ mi ɔ, yo ɔ ba nɛ e ba tsɔ fia si ngɛ nɔmoyo ɔ sinya a nya, ngɛ we mi he nɛ e huno ɔ ngɛ ɔ; nɛ e tlɔ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si je mi tsɔ.
Benɛ e huno ɔ te si mɔtu nɛ e bli sinya a konɛ e je kpo nɛ e pue blɔ ɔ, e plã a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ sinya a nya, nɛ e ninehi pueɔ si ngɛ kpoku ɔ nɔ.
E de lɛ ke, “Tee si nɛ waa ho!” Se yo ɔ he we nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ fɔ e teji ɔ nɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
Benɛ e ya su e we ɔ mi ɔ, e ngɔ ha nɛ e poo e plã a mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ ya ha Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ de ke, “Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ hluu kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko bɛ hyɛ; nɛ a nɛ eko hu hyɛ.
Nyɛ susu he; nyɛɛ wo he ga, nɛ nyɛ de nɔ́ ko!”
Israel dla kɛ ha ta hwumi Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hia, nɛ a ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ Mizpa.
A je Dan kɛ ya si Beersheba, kɛ Gilead zugba a hu nɔ.
Ma nimeli, kɛ Israel wɛtsoyihi, kɛ ta buli akpe lafa eywiɛ nɛ nyɛɛɔ nane ji nihi nɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Mawu ma ngua a mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Benyamin bi ɔmɛ nu he kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ ho Mizpa ya.
Israel bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Nyɛɛ gba wɔ bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ ye sane yaya nɛ ɔ ha.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Levi no ɔ, nɛ ji yo nɛ a gbe ɔ e huno ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I kɛ ye plã a ya Gibea ngɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ nɛ wa ya hwɔ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɔ mi ɔ, Gibea bi ɔmɛ ba tua mi, a ba bɔle we ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a hla kaa a maa gbe mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya nu ye plã a nɛ a kɛ lɛ hwɔ basabasa kɛ ya si e gbo.
Benɛ ye plã a gbo ɔ, i poo e mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ i tsɔ kɛ ya ha Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka; ejakaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ bɔ musu, nɛ a tsu zo ní ngɛ Israel.
Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel bi, kɛ nyɛ susu kɛɛ?
Mɛni wa ngɛ pee ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he?” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo te da si nɛ a de ke, “Wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be e se kpalee kɛ ya e bo tsu, loo e we mi.
Bɔ nɛ wa maa pee Gibea ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; wa maa fɔ sɔ kɛ hla ni komɛ nɛ a ya tua Gibea.
Wa maa hla nyumuhi nyɔngma ngɛ nyumuhi lafa mi kɛ maa je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi; nyumuhi lafa ngɛ nyumuhi akpe mi, kɛ nyumuhi akpe ngɛ nyumuhi akpe nyɔngma mi.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ma ya hla niye ní kɛ ba, nɛ ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ, kɛ Gibea Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ma ya to ní saminya ngɛ zo ní nɛ a tsu ngɛ Israel ɔ he.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo a nya sɔ nɛ a te si kɛ wo ma a he.
Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Benyamin wɛtso ɔ tsuo ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya de mɛ kɛ, “Mɛni musu nyɛ bɔ nɛ ɔ?
Nyɛ je Gibea nyumuhi yakayaka nimli ɔmɛ ha wɔ nɛ waa gbe mɛ kɛ kpa musu ngɛ Israel.” Se Benyamin bi ɔmɛ bui a nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tue.
Mohu ɔ, Benyamin bi ɔmɛ je a ma amɛ a mi kɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Gibea konɛ a kɛ Israel bi kpa amɛ nɛ hwu.
Benyamin bi nɛ je ma amɛ a mi kɛ ba nɛ a kane mɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji ta buli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ ekpa; a je blɔ hla ta buli lafa kpaago hu kɛ je Gibea ma a nitsɛ mi.
Ta buli lafa kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ a je blɔ hla nɛ ɔ, muɔtsɛmɛ ji mɛ; a nine nya da bɔ nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma nyɛ fɔ amlami tɛ kɛ ya na yi bwɔmi nɛ e be e he bee kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ hu bua ta buli akpe lafa eywiɛ nya.
Israel gba ta kɛ wo Benyamin Israel bi ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Betel ya, nɛ a ya bi Mawu ga womi ke, “Wa ti mɛnɔmɛ maa nyɛɛ tabo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ya tua Benyamin bi ɔmɛ?” Nɛ Yawɛ de mɛ ke, “Yuda wɛtso ɔ maa hia kekle.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ te si mɔtu, nɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Gibea kasa nya.
A wo za, nɛ a gba ta kɛ wo Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ Gibea.
Benyamin bi ɔmɛ je Gibea ma a mi ba na mɛ, nɛ a gbe Israel ta buli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.
-Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya wo yana ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ; nɛ a bi Yawɛ ke, “Anɛ waa ya nɛ waa kɛ wa nyɛmimɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta ekohu lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ya kpe!” Enɛ ɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ na he wami he.
A wo za nɛ a gba ta ekohu ngɛ he nɛ a gba ta ngɛ kekleekle ligbi ɔ. Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ya bua ekohu ligbi nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, Benyamin bi ɔmɛ je Gibea ma a mi ekohu ba na Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a gbe Israel ta buli akpe nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel tabo ɔ, kɛ ma a tsuo pue nɔ kɛ ho Betel ya, nɛ a ya wo yana.
A ya hi si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ a ha hwɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ.
A sã sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu somi daka a ngɛ Betel; nɛ Finehas, Aaron binyumu Eleazar bi ɔ ji osɔfo nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ya bi Yawɛ ga womi ke, “Anɛ waa ya nɛ waa kɛ wa nyɛmimɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ekohu, aloo wa ko ya?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya, ejakaa hwɔɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ni komɛ kɛ wo ka kɛ bɔle Gibea kɛ kpe.
Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ ya na Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ekohu; nɛ a gba ta kɛ wo Gibea kaa bɔ nɛ a pee kekle ɔ. Benyamin bi ɔmɛ je kpo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba kpe; nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbla mɛ kɛ je ma a mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee kekle ɔ, a bɔni Israel bi ɔmɛ gbemi ngɛ nga a nɔ, ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɛ yaa Betel, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ yaa Gibea a nɔ.
A gbe Israel bi maa pee nyingmi etɛ.
Benyamin bi ɔmɛ susu kaa a nine ngɛ mɛ nyɛe kaa bɔ nɛ a pee mɛ kekle ɔ.
Se a li tete kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ je blɔ tu fo ngɛ a hɛ mi konɛ a kɛ gbla mɛ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Benɛ Israel tabo ɔ gbee senyasenya nɛ a ya bua a he nya ekohu ngɛ Baal Tamar a, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya wo ka a hia kpo si kake kɛ je a laami he ɔ ngɛ Gibea bonyoku je.
Ta buli akpe nyɔngma amɛ nɛ a je blɔ hla kɛ je Israel tsuo ɔ, ya tua Gibea ma a. Ta a mi wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ, se Benyamin bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a li tete kaa a hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ su ta.
Yawɛ ha Israel ye Benyamin nɔ, nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ kpata Benyamin ta buli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ kɛ e nya lafa a hɛ mi; nɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ yɔse kaa peepee ko be mɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a he hu.
Bɔ nɛ Israel plɛ kɛ ye kunimi ɔ Akɛnɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ka woli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ ya to Gibea a nɔ he je ɔ, a bɔni senyasenya gbeemi ngɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ka woli ɔmɛ hu gbɔ fo esɔesɔ kɛ sɛ Gibea, nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi.
Blɔɔ okadi nɛ a to ngɛ Israel tabo ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya wo ka a a kpɛti ji kaa ke a na nɛ la su ku nɛ nya tsa te si kɛ je ma a mi kɛ yaa hiɔwe ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ kpale a se nɛ a ya tua Benyamin bi ɔmɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Benyamin bi ɔmɛ gbe Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi maa pee nyingmi etɛ momo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo a bua nɛ a de ke, “Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa nine gbe mɛ momo kaa bɔ nɛ wa pee ngɛ kekleekle ta a mi ɔ.” Se benɛ okadi ɔ je kpo, nɛ la su ku nɛ nya tsa kpii ɔ bɔni si temi kɛ yaa hiɔwe ɔ, Benyamin bi ɔmɛ plɛ a se nɛ a na kaa ma a tsuo ngɛ sãe, nɛ la su ku ngɛ si tee kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe yae.
Israel bi ɔmɛ hu plɛ a se, kɛkɛ nɛ sawale nu Benyamin bi ɔmɛ; ejakaa a na kaa sane ye mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbee senyasenya ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a tu fo kɛ gu nga a nɔ blɔ.
Se ta a nyɛɛ a se, nɛ ka woli ɔmɛ nɛ je ma a mi hu kɛ mɛ ba bua; nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi.
A sa Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a yi kɛ kpe; nɛ a nyɛɛ a se hlididiidi kɛ mɛ gbemi nɛ he jɔmi be mi, kɛ je Noha kɛ ya si Gibea hanɔ, ngɛ beleku je.
Benyamin ta buli katsɛmɛ sɔuu nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta a mi ji akpe nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ a plɛ a se nɛ a tu fo kɛ gu nga a nɔ blɔ kɛ ho Rimon tɛ sa a he ya.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe a kpɛti ni akpe enuɔ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ya si Gidom, nɛ a gbe ni akpe enyɔ kɛ piɛ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Benyamin bi nɛ a gbe jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ; ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyumuhi lafa ekpa pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ na blɔ tu fo kɛ ho Rimon tɛ sa a he ya; a ya hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔhiɔ eywiɛ.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ gu Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ma a, a kɛ klaate gbe nimli, lohwehi, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a nine su nɔ.
Jehanɛ hu, ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a ba gu mi ɔ, a mɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a he la.
Yihi kɛ ha Benyamin wɛtso ɔ Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ Mizpa a, a ka kita ke, “Wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ e biyo be gba hae ngɛ Benyamin.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a ba Betel nɛ a ba hi si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ.
A wo yana boboobo, nɛ a bi ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu, mɛni he je nɛ e ba mi kaa mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, wɛtso kake ngɛ laae ngɛ Israel ɔ?” E nɔ jena a, ma a te si makɛ mla nɛ a ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a sã sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ bi ke, “Anɛ Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ nɛ mɛɛ a bɛ gua a mi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi lo?” A ka kita agbo ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ Mizpa a, a gbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a ní pee a nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, a po Israel wɛtso kake ngɔ fɔ he.
Wa ka Yawɛ kita kaa waa kɛ wa biyihi be gba hae ngɛ Benyamin.
Lɛɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛ na yihi ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɔ?” Benɛ a bi si ke Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ yɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ Mizpa a, a na kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko ji Yabesh Gilead kɛ yɛ kpe ɔ, ejakaa benɛ a kane ma a, a na kaa Yabesh Gilead bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsɔ a katsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa akpe nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, nɛ a fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya gbe Yabesh Gilead bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ klaate, nyumuhi, yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi.
Nyɛ kpata nyumu tsuaa nyumu, kɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ le nyumu a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.” A ya na zangmawi lafa eywiɛ nɛ a li nyumu ngɛ Yabesh Gilead bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba ma a sito he ɔ ngɛ Shilo nɛ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ ɔ. Ma kpekpemi ɔ tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya ngɛ Rimon tɛ sa a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ya kpata.
Benyamin bi ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ yihi nɛ a he a yi wami ngɛ Yabesh Gilead yi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ; se yi ɔmɛ sui nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a ní pee ma a mɔbɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ kɛ mi gbami ba Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimeli nɛ ngɛ gua a mi ɔ de ke, “Nɛ a kpata Benyamin yi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɛɛ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa ma na yihi ha nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɔ?” A ya nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Benyamin bi ɔmɛ nɛ a yi na wami ɔ, e sa kaa mɛ hu a wo ngmɛdu; ke pi ja a, lɛɛ Israel wɛtso ɔ kake maa gu kulaa.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nyɛe nɛ waa kɛ wa biyihi ma ha mɛ gba; ejakaa Israel ma a ka kita nɛ a de ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ yo ko kɛ ha gba ngɛ Benyamin ɔ, a maa gbiɛ lɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ a kai kaa daa jeha a, a yeɔ Yawɛ nyami ligbi ko ngɛ Shilo nɛ ngɛ Lebona kɛ Betel a kpɛti ɔ, ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɛ je Betel kɛ yaa Shekem ɔ beleku je ɔ. Nɛ a de Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya wo ka ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ huɔ.
Ke nyami ligbi ɔ su, nɛ Shilo zangmawi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba ngɛ doe ɔ, nyɛɛ je wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba.
Ke nyɛ ba a, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu Shilo zangmayo kake pani nya, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Benyamin zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ya pee e yo.
Ke a tsɛmɛ, loo a nyɛminyumuhi ba nɛ a ba bi wɔ sane ko ɔ, wa ma de mɛ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ na wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ a he ha wɔ kɛkɛ; ejakaa wa na we yihi kɛ ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ benɛ wa kpata Yabesh Gilead hɛ mi ngɛ ta a mi ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, akɛnɛ pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ zangmawi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ yi fɔ.’ ” Benyamin bi ɔmɛ pee ja.
A nuu yiwi ɔmɛ nɛ ba ngɛ doe ɔ kakaaka, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ya; nɛ a ya dla po ma amɛ, nɛ a hi a mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Israel bi kpa amɛ hu a mi gbɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ je kɛ ho e zugba nɔ ya, nɛ a ya hi si ngɛ a wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi weku nya weku nya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, matsɛ ko matsɛ ko be Israel, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Benɛ Israel ma a na we matsɛ lolo, nɛ manyadali kaa Gideon kɛ Samson ngɛ ma a nɔ hyɛe ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ lɛ Rut sane nɛ ɔ ba.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, basabasa hiɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ.
Rut ji Moab yo ko nɛ ya gba Israel no.
Benɛ e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, e mɛtɛ e nganyɛ ɔ he kpɛii, nɛ jã kɛ̃ lɛ e sɔmɔ Israel Mawu ɔ hulɔ.
Nyagbe ɔ, Rut ba na huno he ngɛ e huno nɛ be je mi ɔ weku li a kpɛti.
Kɛ gu gba si himi enyɔne nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Rut ba pee Israel matsɛ ngua a nɛ a tsɛɛ David ɔ nanakasowa.
Sanehi nɛ ngɛ “Manyadali a Womi” ɔ mi ɔ, tsɔɔ haomi nɛ ba be mi nɛ Mawu ma a kua lɛ Mawu ɔ.
“Rut he sane” ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu gbaa ma se no ko nɛ ngɔ e he ngɔ ha lɛ Mawu ɔ. Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ma se no nɛ ɔ ba pee Mawu ma mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Rut nyɛɛ Naomi se kɛ ba Betlehem .- Rut kɛ Boaz ba bua .—.
Boaz ngɔ Rut .-
Elimelek kɛ e yo kɛ a bimɛ hia kɛ ho Moab ya -Manyadali ɔmɛ a yi nɔ, benɛ matsɛmɛ na we nɛ a bɔni Israel ma a nɔ yemi lolo ɔ, hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Elimelek, nɛ je Efrat weku ɔ mi, kɛ e yo Naomi, kɛ a bimɛ nihewi enyɔ, Malon kɛ Kilion, hia kɛ je Betlehem ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ kɛ ya to nubwɔ ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Elimelek ba gbo, nɛ e piɛ e yo Naomi kɛ e binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Elimelek binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ Moab yihi: nɔ kake biɛ ji Orpa, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Rut.
Benɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ maa pee jeha nyɔngma se ɔ, Malon kɛ Kilion hu ba gbo, nɛ e ba piɛ Naomi nɔ kake too nɛ e be huno, loo binyumu ko.
Rut nyɛɛ Naomi se kɛ ba Betlehem Pee se ɔ, Naomi nu kaa Yawɛ ba gbaa e ma a, nɛ e ha a ngmɔ ɔmɛ ba ní saminya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e dla konɛ e kɛ e nganyɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ hia kɛ je Moab zugba a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ yaa Yuda.
Benɛ a yaa ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Naomi de e nganyɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ho e nyɛ ngɔ ya.
I kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ nɛ e na nyɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ si himi kpakpa nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi, kɛ nihi nɛ si wɔ ɔ hi ɔ he.
Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ gba ekohu, konɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na he ko nɛ e hi.” Benɛ e fua mɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ ye sɛ ɔ, a wo yana, nɛ a de ke, “Dɛbi!
Waa kɛ mo maa ya o weku li ɔmɛ a ngɔ.” Se Naomi de mɛ ke, “Ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se!
Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ mi maa yaa?
Nyɛ susu kaa ma nyɛ ma fɔ binyumuhi ekohu ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si lo?
Nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se, ejakaa i be gba si himi nya.
Nɛ ke kaa i kɛ nyumu ko bua nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi nɛ i fɔ binyumuwi po, anɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ maa tsi nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ be gbae; nɛ nyɛ maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ a maa wa lo?
Dɛbi, ye bimɛ, nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be mi bae; ejakaa sane nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi ye ɔ nya wa; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ní peeɔ mi mɔbɔ.” Se a wo yana ekohu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Orpa fua e nganyɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ye sɛ, nɛ e kpale e se; se Rut lɛɛ e mɛtɛ e nganyɛ ɔ he kpɛii nɛ e hi kpɔmi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Naomi de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, o hunongua yo ɔ kpale e se kɛ ho e weku li kɛ e mawu ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya.
Mo hu, kpale o se nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ho!” Se Rut ha lɛ heto ke, “Mo ko nyɛ ye nɔ doo ke ma si mo; ha nɛ waa ho kɛkɛ.
He tsuaa he nɛ o yaa a, ma ya; nɛ he tsuaa he nɛ o maa hi ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ma hi.
O je kɛ wɛ maa pee imi hu ye je kɛ wɛ, nɛ o Mawu maa pee ye Mawu.
He nɛ o ma gbo ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ma gbo ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a maa pu mi ngɛ.
Ja gbenɔ pɛ lɛ ma ha nɛ ma si mo; ke pi ja lɛɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi nɛ ye sisiisi.” Benɛ Naomi na kaa Rut muɔ e yi mi kpɔ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa ya a, e de we nɔ́ ko hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a tsa nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si a ya su Betlehem.
Benɛ a su Betlehem ɔ, ma a tsuo hoso, nɛ yi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ gbafa bi ke, “Naomi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?” Nɛ e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko tsɛ mi Naomi hu, se mohu nyɛ tsɛ mi Mara, ejakaa Ope ɔ kɛ mi ye sane nɛ dooɔ tsɔ.
Ye he su kɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ ho, se Yawɛ kpale mi kɛ ba dɛ gu.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ mi Naomi, be mi nɛ Ope ɔ te si wo mi, nɛ e ha i na nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Bɔ nɛ Naomi kpale e se kɛ je Moab zugba a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e nganyɛ Rut, Moab yo ɔ, ba Betlehem ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Be mi nɛ a ba su Betlehem ɔ, a bɔni ngma kpami.
Rut ya tsu ní ngɛ Boaz ngmɔ nɔ Naomi ngɛ weku no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Boaz nɛ je e huno Elimelek weku ɔ mi.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ biɛ saminya, nɛ niatsɛ ji lɛ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Rut, Moab yo ɔ, de Naomi ke, “Ha ma ya nyɛɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi nɛ ma ya kukuɔ ngma bibliwi ngɛ ní kpali ɔmɛ a se.
Nɔ ko kɛ̃ maa ngmɛ mi blɔ nɛ ma kukuɔ ní ngɛ e se.” Naomi de lɛ ke, “Ye bi, moo ya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Rut ho ngma ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi ya nɛ e ya nyɛɛ ní kpali ɔmɛ a se kɛ kukuɔ bibliwi ɔmɛ.
He ní a nya a, e ya je Boaz, nɛ je Elimelek weku ɔ mi ɔ e ngmɔ mi.
Saii mi ɔ, Boaz nitsɛ je ma a mi kɛ ba.
E ha ní kpali ɔmɛ ayekoo, nɛ mɛ hu a he nɔ ke, “Aayee.” Boaz bi e tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ji ní kpali ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ɔ ke, “Jije zangmayo nɛ ɔ je?” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Lɛ ji Moab yo nubwɔ ɔ nɛ e kɛ Naomi je Moab zugba a nɔ kɛ ba a nɛ.
E bi ke ma ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e kukuɔ ngma bibliwi ngɛ ní kpali ɔmɛ a se.
E bɔni ní tsumi kɛ je mɔtu kpla nɛ he jɔɔmi be mi, nɛ kpaako e kpa nɛ e yaa jɔɔ e he bɔɔ ngɛ gba a sisi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Boaz de Rut ke, “Ye bi, o ngɛ tue bue?
Ko ya kukuɔ ngma bibliwi ngɛ nɔ kpa ko ngmɔ mi pe hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ pɛ.
Moo nyɛɛ yihewi ní tsuli ɔmɛ a se bɛbɛɛbɛ; moo hyɛ he nɛ nyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ ngma a poe ngɛ ɔ, konɛ o nyɛɛ yihewi ní kpali ɔmɛ a se.
I wo nihewi ɔmɛ si ke a ko doo o nya.
Ke kuma ngɛ mo yee ɔ, yaa buɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ o ya nu nyu nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ yɛ ɔ eko.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Rut kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e bi Boaz ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛni he je o ngɛ o he haoe ngɛ ye he, nɛ o tsɔ o hɛ mi ha mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Imi ma se no ɔ!” Boaz he nɔ ke, “Níhi nɛ o pee ha o nganyɛ ngɛ o huno gbenɔ se ɔ, a bɔ mi lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ; nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, o si o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ, kɛ o ma kɛ ba je nihi nɛ o li mɛ a kpɛti.
Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ, nɔ ngɔ nɛ o ba sa we ngɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e wo mo níhi nɛ o pee ɔ kulaa he hiɔ.” Rut he nɔ ke, “I naa mo si, ye nyɔmtsɛ.
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ o munyu ngɔngɔɛ ɔmɛ wo mi gɛjɛmi, nɛ ye nɔ gbagba te ha, pohu tsa pi o mawayi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji mi.” Benɛ ní yemi be su ɔ, Boaz de Rut ke, “Hɛɛ mo kɛ ba nɛ o ba ngɔ abolo ɔ eko nɛ o kɛ sɔ flɔɔ ɔ mi.” Nɛ e ba nɛ e ba hi si ngɛ ní kpali ɔmɛ a kasa nya.
Boaz ha lɛ ngma a nɛ a sí ɔ eko nɛ e ye kɛ ya si eko piɛ nɛ́ e nyɛ we yemi hu.
-Benɛ Rut ho nɛ e ya ngɛ ngma bibliwi ɔmɛ kukuɔe ekohu ɔ, Boaz fa ní tsuli ɔmɛ ke a ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e kukuɔ ní ngɛ ngma nɛ a fi, se a bua we nya lolo ɔ mi, nɛ a ko nyafi lɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, e de mɛ ke a je blɔ nɛ a hia ngma a eko ngɛ fifii ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a si ha lɛ nɛ e kukuɔ, nɛ a ko tsi lɛ blɔ.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Rut pee kɛ kukuɔ ngma bibliwi ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si du bu.
Nɛ benɛ e kɛ tso gbee nɔ́ nɛ e kukuɔ ɔ, e ná ngma maa pee kilo nyɔngma.
Rut tloo ngma a kɛ ho ma a mi ya, nɛ e kɛ ya tsɔɔ e nganyɛ ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e nyɛ bua nya ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
E kɛ ní ɔ nɛ e ye piɛ ɔ hu ha lɛ.
Naomi bi Rut ke, “Jije o ya bua ngma fuu nɛ ɔ nya ngɛ?
Mawu maa gbaa nɔmlɔ nɛ tsɔ e hɛ mi ha mo kikɛ nɛ ɔ.” Rut de e nganyɛ ɔ ke ngmɔ si he nɛ e ya tsu ní ngɛ ɔ, a tsɛɛ ngmɔtsɛ ɔ ke Boaz.
Naomi de ke, “Yawɛ nɛ yeɔ e siwo nɔ kɛ haa hɛ kali, kɛ nihi nɛ gbo tsuo ɔ maa gbaa lɛ.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Boaz nɛ ɔ, wa weku no pɔtɛɛ ji lɛ, nɛ kusumi nya hu e peeɔ wa nɔ hyɛlɔ.” Rut, Moab yo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de e nganyɛ ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ kake hu nɛ nyumu ɔ de ji kaa ma hi ní ɔ kukuɔe ngɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ a se kɛ yaa si a ma kpa e ngma a tsuo gbe nya.” Naomi de e nganyɛ Rut ke, “Ye bi, e hi kaa o kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ Boaz ngmɔ mi pe kaa o maa ya nɔ kpa ko ngmɔ mi nɛ a ya doo o nya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Rut pee ja, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e ya kukuɔɔ ngma bibliwi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si be nɛ a poo ngma slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ gbe nya.
Nɛ e tsa nɔ nɛ e kɛ e nganyɛ ɔ hi si.
Rut ya na huno Be ko se ɔ, Naomi de Rut ke, “Ye bi, tse i ko hla gba ha mo konɛ níhi a mi nɛ e hi ha mo?
Kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, Boaz nɛ o kɛ e mawayi ɔmɛya kukuɔ ní ɔ, wa weku no ji lɛ.
Gbɔkuɛ nɛ ɔ, e ma ya sa e ngma a mi.
Moo bu tue!
Moo du o he, nɛ o kpa nu, nɛ o bu bo, nɛ o pue nɔ kɛ ya ngma mi sami he ɔ. Mo ko je o he si ha lɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ e maa ye ní gbe nya nɛ e maa hwɔ si.
Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o to he nɛ e maa hwɔ ɔ he hɛ, konɛ ke e ya hwɔ si ɔ, o ya nɛ o ya kpa bo ngɛ e nane he ngɛ kusumi nya, nɛ o hwɔ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ o pee.” Rut he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Yoo, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o de mi ɔ, ma pee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Rut pue nɔ kɛ ho ngma mi sami he ɔ ya, nɛ e ya pee bɔ nɛ e nganyɛ ɔ de lɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Benɛ Boaz ye ní nɛ e nu nɔ́ ko, nɛ e bua jɔ e he ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya hwɔ si ngɛ ngma nɛ a bua nya a kasa nya.
Rut pee blɛuu nɛ e ya kpa bo ngɛ e nane he, nɛ e hwɔ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛ yaa nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ, Boaz hɛli si, nɛ benɛ e plɛ e he ɔ, e pee lɛ nyakpɛ kaa yo ko hwɔɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E bi ke, “Mo mɛnɔ?” Nɛ Rut he nɔ ke, “Imi Rut, o mawayo ɔ. Akɛnɛ o weku no yalɔyo ji mi he je ɔ, e ji o blɔ nya kaa o kɛ o bo ɔ haa ye nɔ ngɛ kusumi nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o maa ngɔ mi.” Nɛ Boaz de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ maa gbaa mo, ye bi, kaa o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ weku no kpakpa peemi he okadi pe níhi kulaa nɛ o pee ha o nganyɛ ɔ po, kaa o ya nyɛɛ we nihewi ohiatsɛmɛ, loo niatsɛmɛ a se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, mo ko ye gbeye!
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o de ɔ, ma pee ha mo; ejakaa ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo le kaa yo kpakpa ji mo.
E ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa ngɛ kusumi nya a, i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i ngɔɔ mo nɛ i hyɛɛ o nɔ lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ nɔ ko pa ngɛ blɔ nya pe imi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hi hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si mɔtu; nɛ ke nyumu nɛ ɔ kplɛɛ nɛ e pee kusumi ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ mo ɔ, kɛkɛ lɛɛ saminya.
Se ke e kplɛɛ we ɔ, lɛɛ i ngɛ si woe ngɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ biɛ mi kaa ma ngɔ mo.
Moo hwɔ si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si je maa na.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hwɔ Boaz nane si blɔ kɛ ya si mɔtu.
Nɛ́ nɔ ko kó le kaa yo ko ba lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Rut te si loko je mi tsɔ.
Boaz de lɛ ke, “Mo je o nɔ hami bo ɔ nɛ o bli mi.” Nɛ benɛ e pee ja a, Boaz ka ngma kilo nyingmi enyɔ nya kɛ wo mi, nɛ e ngɔ tloo lɛ, nɛ e kɛ tlomi ɔ kpale e se kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
Benɛ e ya su we mi ɔ, e nganyɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ, ye bi?” Rut gba lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Boaz pee ha lɛ ɔ. E ya nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “E ke ma ko kpale dɛ gu kɛ ba ye nganyɛ ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hyɛ ngma sɔuu nɛ e ha mi!” Naomi de lɛ ke, “Moo to o tsui si, ye bi, kɛ yaa si o maa na sane nɛ ɔ nya; ejakaa ja Boaz gbe sane nɛ ɔ nya mwɔnɛ ɔ loko e maa jɔɔ e he.”
Boaz ngɔ Rut Boaz ho ya hi si ngɛ kpe he ɔ ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e na Elimelek weku no ɔ nɛ e tu e he munyu ɔ nɛ bee.
Boaz tsɛ lɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye huɛ, ba nɛ o ba hi si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” E ba nɛ e ba hi si.
Jehanɛ Boaz tsɛ ma a mi nimeli ɔmɛ a ti nihi nyɔngma ke a ba hi si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ mɛ hu a ba hi si.
Boaz de Elimelek weku no ɔ ke, “Nɛ Naomi kpale e se kɛ je Moab kɛ ba nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ hlae nɛ e jua zugba kpɔ ɔ nɛ ji wa nyɛmi Elimelek zugba a, nɛ i susu kaa ma wo o tue nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o suɔ ɔ, kpɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ a hɛ mi.
Se ke o sume ɔ, de mi; ejakaa nɔ ko be he blɔ nɛ e kpɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kaa ja mo, nɛ o se loko imi.” Nyumu ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ma kpɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Boaz de lɛ ke, “Saminya!
Ke o he zugba a ngɛ Naomi dɛ ɔ, ja o ngɔ Rut, Moab yo yalɔyo ɔ hulɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ fɔ bimɛ, konɛ nɔ nɛ be je mi ɔ biɛ nɛ hi e gbosi ní ɔ he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Elimelek weku no ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ke ja a lɛɛ i be zugba a kpɔe mɔ; ejakaa ke i pee ja a, imi nitsɛ ye nina a maa je mi dɛ gu.
Lɛɛ mo kpɔ zugba a mɔ, ejakaa imi nitsɛ i be suɔe.” Blema a, kusumi ko nɛ Israel bi peeɔ kɛ maa weto ní kpɔmi kɛ tsakemi nɔ mi ji kaa nɔtsɛ ɔ ma je e tokota kɛ ha helɔ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ a kɛ yeɔ odase ngɛ Israel.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Elimelek weku no ɔ de lɛ ke, “Mo nitsɛ mo he” ɔ, e je e tokota a kɛ ha Boaz.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Boaz de ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kpe ɔ ke, “I tsɛ nyɛ odase kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Elimelek nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ Naomi dɛ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ji Kilion kɛ Malon a níhi ɔ, i he lɛ tsuo ngɛ Naomi dɛ.
Jehanɛ se ɔ, Rut, Moab yo ɔ, nɛ ji Malon yalɔyo ɔ, ba peeɔ ye yo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, gbosi ní ɔ hu maa hi Malon weku ɔ dɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Elimelek biɛ ko laa ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ e ma a mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ na mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye he odase hwɔɔ se.” Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ de ke, “Wa kplɛɛ nɔ, Yawɛ nɛ ha yo nɛ ɔ ba pee kaa Rahel kɛ Lea nɛ a fɔ bimɛ fuu kɛ ha Yakob ɔ. Yawɛ nɛ pee mo niatsɛ ngɛ Efrat, nɛ o biɛ nɛ pɛ ngɛ Betlehem.
Ngmɛduhi nɛ Yawɛ ma ha mo kɛ gu yo nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ha nɛ o we ɔ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami kaa Yuda kɛ Tamar a bi Perez we ɔ.” Boaz nina Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Boaz kɛ Rut ho we mi ya, nɛ e ya pee e yo.
Yawɛ gbaa Rut, nɛ e ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
Nɛ huza a nɔ yi ɔmɛ de Naomi ke, “Nyɛ ha wa je Yawɛ yi kaa e ha mo bibi mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ e ba ye o se.
Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ e na biɛ kpakpa ngɛ Israel.
O nganyɛ ɔ suɔ mo, nɛ e he jua wa ha mo pe binyumuwi kpaago.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ e ha mo bibi, nɔ nɛ ma ha mo he wami he, nɛ e maa hyɛ o nɔ ngɛ o bwɔmi si.” Naomi wo jokuɛ ɔ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e bi nɛ e hyɛ lɛ.
Nɛ huza a nɔ yi ɔmɛ de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ Naomi na binyumu.” A wo jokuɛyo ɔ biɛ ke Obed.
Pee se ɔ, Obed fɔ binyumu, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Ishai.
Ishai nɛ ɔ ji David tsɛ.
David weku kpa -Bɔ nɛ David weku kpa ngɛ kɛ je Perez nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Perez fɔ Hezron, nɛ Hezron fɔ Ram, nɛ Ram fɔ Aminadab, nɛ Aminadab fɔ Naashon, nɛ Naashon fɔ Salmon, nɛ Salmon fɔ Boaz, nɛ Boaz fɔ Obed, nɛ Obed fɔ Ishai, nɛ Ishai fɔ David.
NYA TSƆƆMI Samuel Kekleekle Womi ɔ gbaa wɔ Israel blema sanehi, kɛ je Israel manyadali ɔmɛ a se kɛ ya si a bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel.
Kikɛmɛ a tsakemi nɛ ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ hyɛmi blɔ nya tomi he ɔ kɔɔ nyumuhi etɛ komɛ a he titli.
Kekleekle nɔ ɔ ji Samuel nɛ ji Israel manyadali kpanaa komɛ nɛ hi si ɔ a nyagbe nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ji Saul, Israel kekleekle matsɛ ɔ; nɛ etɛne ɔ ji David.
Kã nɛ David pee kɛ sɛ hlami be mi nɛ a na we nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ lolo ɔ, a naa ní tsumi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Samuel kɛ Saul a he sane ɔmɛ a mi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ blema sane womi kpa amɛ nɛ ngɛ Somi Momo ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ hu oti nɛ ngɛ mi ji, “Mawu anɔkuale yemi haa ma yaa nɔ, se tue gbomi kɛ haomi baa ma nɔ.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ jeɔ kpo paa ngɛ munyu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Eli tu ɔ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Samuel I, .
ɔ ke, “Nihi nɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, ma wo a hɛ mi nyami; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ hiee mi ɔ, imi hu ma hie mɛ.” Gbaami, aloo haomi nɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ ba Israel ma a nɔ ɔ, wa naa ngɛ Samuel Kekleekle Womi ɔ mi.
Jinɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ji Israel matsɛ kɛ je teteete.
Se akɛnɛ ma a bi ke a ha mɛ matsɛ he je ɔ, Yawɛ hla matsɛ ha mɛ.
Israel ná matsɛ lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ma a tsuo le kaa Mawu ji a tsɛ kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Mawu mlaa amɛ a mi nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa dami sane yemi ngɛ, niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsuo.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Samuel da Israel ma a nya .—.
A wo Saul matsɛ .—.
Saul tsɛ yemi kekleekle jeha amɛ .—.
David kɛ Saul .—.
Saul kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a gbenɔ .-
Elkana kɛ e yihi kɛ e bimɛ ngɛ Shilo Nyumu ko hi Rama, ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
E je Efraim wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ e biɛ ji Elkana.
E tsɛ biɛ ji Yeroham; e nɛ̃ ji Elihu; e nɛnɛkasowa ji Tohu, nɛ Tohu tsɛ ji Zuf.
Elkana ngɛ yihi enyɔ; nɔ kake biɛ ji Hana, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Penina.
Penina ngɛ bimɛ, se Hana lɛɛ e fɔ we.
Daa jeha a, Elkana jeɔ Rama kɛ yaa Shilo ya jaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, nɛ e sãã bɔ kɛ haa lɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ Hofni kɛ Finehas, Eli binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ osɔfo yee ngɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ Elkana maa sã bɔ ɔ, e ma gba lo ɔ kɛ ha e yo Penina kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ e biyi ɔmɛ tsuo nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nɔ́.
Se Hana lɛɛ, e jeɔ blɔ haa lɛ e nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ; ejakaa Yawɛ tsi e fɔmi nya mohu, se e huno ɔ suɔ lɛ saminya.
E hunoyo Penina yeɔ e he fɛu nɛ e yeɔ e tsui ngɛ fɔmi nɛ e fɔ we ɔ he.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ yaa nɔ daa jeha; be tsuaa be nɛ a ya Yawɛ we ɔ, Penina maa ye Hana tsui kɛ yaa si e ma fo ya nɛ e ma kua ní yemi.
Kɛkɛ e huno Elkana ma bi lɛ ke, “Hana, mɛni he je o ngɛ ya foe?
Mɛni he je o yi ní?
Mɛni he je o pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Anɛ i pi binyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ ha mo lo?” Hana kɛ Eli -Ligbi ko, benɛ a ye ní gbe nya ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Shilo ɔ, Hana te si.
Aywilɛho nu lɛ, nɛ be mi nɛ e ngɛ kue fae ha Yawɛ ɔ, e fo ya gbogboogbo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, osɔfo Eli hii si ngɛ sinya a nya ngɛ Yawɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Hana wo si nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ Ope, ke o maa hyɛ o mawayo haomi, nɛ o ma kai mi, nɛ o hɛ be ye nɔ jee, nɛ o ma ha o mawayo binyumu ɔ, i kɛ lɛ ma ha mo e wami ligbi tsuo, nɛ asoyi nya be e yi he sae.” Benɛ e ngɛ sɔlee kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, Eli to e nya he hɛ.
Hana ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ e tsui mi; e gbi lɛɛ a nui, se e nya mi kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɛ pae nɛ e ngɛ mae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Eli susu kaa e de dã, nɛ e de ke, “Mɛni be o maa de dã kɛ yaa si?
Ha dã nɛ je o hɛ mi!” Se Hana he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, ye nyɔmtsɛ, i nui wai, loo dã ko nɛ nya wa.
Yo nɛ e haomi kle ji mi, nɛ i kɛ ye haomi ɔ ba pue Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ kue fami.
Koo bu mi kaa yaka nɔ ko, ejakaa ye haomi, kɛ nɔ nami ɔmɛ a he i ngɛ kue fae ngɛ.” Eli de lɛ ke, “O kɛ he jɔmi nɛ ya; Israel Mawu ɔ ma ha mo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o bi lɛ ɔ.” Lɛ hu e he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o susu o mawayo he daa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ho nɛ e ya ye ní, nɛ aywilɛho ɔ je e hɛ mi.
Samuel fɔmi E nɔ jena a, Elkana kɛ e yi ɔmɛ, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ te si mla, nɛ benɛ a ja Yawɛ ta a, a kpale a se kɛ ho a we mi ya ngɛ Rama.
Elkana kɛ e yo Hana na bɔmi, nɛ Yawɛ bu Hana kue fami ɔ tue.
Hana ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e fɔ binyumu, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Samuel; nɛ e de ke, “I wo lɛ kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa i bi Yawɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ ha mi.” Jeha ba su ekohu, nɛ Elkana kɛ e we ɔ tsuo ho Shilo ya, konɛ a ya sã daa jeha bɔ ɔ, kɛ bɔ titli ko hu nɛ e wo Yawɛ he si ɔ.
Se Hana lɛɛ e yɛ, ejakaa e de e huno ɔ ke, “Ke i tsɔ jokuɛ ɔ nyɔ pɛ ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Yawɛ we ɔ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ e maa hi e wami be tsuo.” E huno Elkana de lɛ ke, “E da; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o susu kaa e hi ɔ, moo pee; hii si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si o ma tsɔ lɛ nyɔ.
Yawɛ nɛ e ha nɛ o pee kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hana hi si nɛ e hyɛ e bi ɔ kɛ ya si e tsɔ lɛ nyɔ.
Benɛ e tsɔ lɛ nyɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya ngɛ Shilo.
E ngɔ na ku kake nɛ ye jeha etɛ, ngma mamu kilo nyɔngma, kɛ wai lohwe he womi tɔ kake kɛ ho.
Benɛ a gbe na ku ɔ se ɔ, a kɛ jokuɛ ɔ ba Eli ngɔ.
Hana de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ, o kai mi lo?
Imi ji yo ɔ nɛ o na be ko nɛ i daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ kue fae ha Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.
I bi Yawɛ bi nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha mi nɔ́ nɛ i bi lɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngɔ lɛ ba ha Yawɛ.
E maa pee Yawɛ nɔ́ e wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ja Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Hana sɔlemi Hana sɔle nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ ha ye tsui mi hyi kɛ bua jɔmi; hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye bua jɔ ha ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ he!
I muɔ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ; ye bua jɔ ye he, ejakaa Mawu ye bua mi!
Nɔ ko be nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu kaa Yawɛ.
E se ɔ, nɔ ko be.
Ee, Mawu se ɔ, wesa he kpa ko be.
Nyɛ kpa fiami munyu puu tumi; he nɔ womi munyu nɛ ko je nyɛ nya mi.
Yawɛ ji Mawu nɛ le níhi tsuo, nɛ e kojoɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nimli peeɔ.
Katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ ku, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he wɛ ɔ na he wami he.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ tɔ hyɛ ɔ, a bɔni apaa yemi nɛ a kɛ na a nya mi ngma; ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ye mɛ ɔ, a hwɔ ɔ se po.
Yosa a ba fɔ bimɛ kpaago, nɛ bimɛ a nyɛ ɔ ba pee kaa yo nɛ fɔ we hyɛ.
Yawɛ gbeɔ nɔ, nɛ e haa nɔ wami ekohu; e kɛ nɔ yaa gbeje, nɛ e kpaleɔ lɛ kɛ baa wami mi ekohu.
Yawɛ lɛ peeɔ nɔ ohiatsɛ, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ niatsɛ.
E baa nɔ si, nɛ e woɔ nɔ nɔ.
E woɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a nɔ kɛ jeɔ tabo zu mi, nɛ e jeɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ kɛ jeɔ a haomihi a mi.
E haa a kɛ ganɔhi hii si, nɛ e kɛ mɛ toɔ hɛ mi nyami blɔ hehi.
Yawɛ níhi ji je ɔ titima amɛ; a nɔ nɛ e fia je ɔ kɛ fɔ.
“E baa ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ a yi.
Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a hɛ mi kpataa ngɛ diblii mi; tsa pi adesa nitsɛ he wami nya nɛ e yeɔ manye.
A ma kpata Yawɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; hiɔwe ma si wo mɛ.
Yawɛ maa kojo je ɔ tsuo; e kɛ he wami ma ha e matsɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma ha matsɛ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ maa ye kunimi.” Pee se ɔ, Elkana kpale e se kɛ ho we mi ya ngɛ Rama, se jokuɛyo Samuel ɔ hi osɔfo Eli ngɔ nɛ e sɔmɔ Yawɛ.
Eli binyumu ɔmɛ Eli binyumu ɔmɛ ɔ, yakayaka nimli ji mɛ; a bui Yawɛ, loo blɔ nya tomi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ a blɔ fa mi ní nɛ sa kaa a he ngɛ ma a dɛ ɔ. Mohu ɔ, ke nɔ ko ba ngɛ bɔ sãe ɔ, osɔfo ɔ tsɔlɔ ɔ maa ba kɛ e dɛ mi gbowe kɛ e nya gbla etɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a ngɛ lo ɔ hooe ɔ, e kɛ gbowe ɔ maa wo dadesɛ, loo ngɛyu, loo kutu ɔ mi, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ gbowe ɔ maa bɛ ɔ, maa pee osɔfo ɔ nɔ́.
Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ Israel bi tsuo nɛ baa Shilo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, be mi nɛ a na we nɛ a sã zɔ ɔ tete ɔ, osɔfo ɔ tsɔlɔ ɔ maa ba nɛ e ma ba de nɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ ɔ sãe ɔ ke, “Ha mi lo ɔ eko nɛ ma kɛ ya ha osɔfo ɔ nɛ e si; ejakaa e be lo nɛ a hoo momo hee ngɛ o dɛ, ja lo mumu.” Ke nɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ha nɛ a sã zɔ ɔ kekle kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se nɛ o ngɔ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ” ɔ, e ma de ke, “Dɛbi!
Ha mi nɔuu!
Ke pi ja a, ma ngɔ pani nya!” Eli binyumu ɔmɛ pee yayami agbo ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, ejakaa a bui Yawɛ bɔ sami ɔ. Samuel ngɛ Shilo Jamɛ a be ɔ, jokuɛyo Samuel ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ Yawɛ sɔmɔe, nɛ a kɛ kploba efɔd fi e kpɛti.
Daa jeha a, e nyɛ kpɛɔ tade bɔbɔyoo ko kɛ ya haa lɛ, ke e kɛ e huno ɔ ya nɛ a ya sã jeha bɔ ɔ. Kɛkɛ Eli maa gbaa Elkana kɛ e yo ɔ, nɛ e ma de Elkana ke, “Yawɛ nɛ e ha nɛ o kɛ o yo ɔ nɛ na bimɛ kpahi, nɛ a ba ye nɔ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ ɔ nane mi.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa kpale a se kɛ ho a ma mi ya.
Yawɛ gbaa Hana niinɛ, nɛ e fɔ binyumu kpahi etɛ kɛ yihi enyɔ.
Jokuɛyo Samuel ɔ ba wa, nɛ e ya nɔ nɛ e sɔmɔ Yawɛ.
Eli kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ Jehanɛ lɛɛ Eli ba bwɔ; níhi nɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee ɔ, e nu lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E nu hulɔ kaa a kɛ yi ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ nya a ngɛ si hwɔe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nyɛ he munyu tue ɔ?
Dɛbi, ye bimɛ, nyɛ kpa!
Níhi nɛ i ngɛ nue nɛ Yawɛ ma a ngɛ dee ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ, pi ní kpakpahi.
Ke nɔ ko pee e nyɛmi adesa yayami ɔ, Mawu maa da mi ha lɛ; se ke nɔ ko pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ maa da mi ha lɛ?” Se a bui a tsɛ ɔ munyu ɔmɛ tue; ejakaa Yawɛ to momo kaa e maa gbe mɛ.
Jokuɛyo Samuel ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ wae ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi; nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo na e he bua jɔmi.
Eli we ɔ hɛ mi kpatami Ligbi ko ɔ, gbalɔ ko ngɔ sɛ gbi kɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ ba ha Eli ke, “Benɛ o nɛ̃ Aaron, kɛ e weku li ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ si himi mi ngɛ Egipt ɔ, i je ye he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Aaron.
Imi lɛ i hla Aaron kɛ e weku ɔ kɛ je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ke a ba pee ye osɔfohi, nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a wo efɔd nɛ a kɛ bi ye yi mi tomi.
I ha mɛ he blɔ kaa bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ Israel ma a ba sãã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ngɔ eko ha a he.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ jiklɔɔ ngɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ i fa ke a kɛ ba ha mi ɔ he?
Eli, mɛni he je o buu o binyumu ɔmɛ pe mi ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ngmɛ blɔ nɛ a ngɔ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ye ma Israel kɛ ba haa mi ɔ e mi kpakpa amɛ kɛ ngɛ a he lɛe, nɛ a ngɛ plɔkee kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i wo si be ko ke o kɛ o weku li ma sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi kɛ maa ya neneene.
Se jehanɛ ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke i kpale ye nya se!
Mohu ɔ, nihi nɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, ma wo a hɛ mi nyami; nɛ nihi nɛ hiee mi ɔ, imi hu ma hie mɛ.
Bu tue, be ma nɛ ma kpata nihewi nɛ ngɛ o we ɔ, kɛ o weku ɔ mi tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔmoyo ko be o we ɔ mi hie hu.
O maa hao, nɛ o kɛ hɛkɔ maa hyɛ gbaamihi nɛ i kɛ ma ha Israel bi kpa amɛ, se o we ɔ mi lɛɛ nɔmoyo ko nɔmoyo ko be mi hie hu.
Se kɛ̃, ma ha o nina ko yi ma na wami, nɛ e ma sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfo.
Lɛɛ e hɛ ma yu nɛ e maa hao, se ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ a kɛ klaate maa gbe mɛ tsuo.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ maa le kaa nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ tsuo maa ba mi ji lss ma ha o binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ji Hofni kɛ Finehas tsuo ma gbo ligbi kake too.
Ma hla osɔfo ko nɛ maa ye mi anɔkuale; nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa pee níhi nɛ ngɛ ye tsui nɔ, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ ye juɛmi mi ɔ ha mi.
Ma bɔ we saminya ha lɛ, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ ngɛ ye matsɛ ɔ nɛ i pɔ lɛ nu ɔ e hɛ mi daa.
Nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ o we ɔ mi ɔ, ja a ya jamɛ a osɔfo ɔ ngɔ nɛ a ya ba sika, loo niye ní; aloo ja a ya kpa pɛɛ kaa a ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a piɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a he kɛ tsu ní, loko a ma na a nya mi ngma!”
Yawɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ Samuel Be mi nɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo Samuel ɔ ngɛ Eli ngɔ nɛ e ngɛ Yawɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, Yawɛ nya mi sɛ gbi pɔɛ he; nɛ ní nami hu pɔɛ he.
Ligbi ko nyɔ mi, benɛ Eli, nɛ lɔ ɔ ji e hɛngmɛ yu ta, hwɔɔ si ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsu ɔ mi ɔ, Samuel lɛɛ e hwɔɔ si ngɛ Yawɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he nɛ Mawu somi daka a ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ je mi tsɔ we lolo, nɛ kane ɔ hu na we nɛ e gbo ɔ, Yawɛ tsɛ Samuel; nɛ Samuel tu fo kɛ ho Eli ngɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, i ba; i nu nɛ o tsɛ mi.” Se Eli de lɛ ke, “I tsɛ we mo; yaa nɛ o ya hwɔ si ekohu.” Nɛ Samuel ho nɛ e ya hwɔ si.
Yawɛ tsɛ Samuel ekohu, nɛ Samuel te si kɛ ho Eli ngɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, i ba; i nu nɛ o tsɛ mi.” Se Eli de lɛ ke, “I tsɛ we mo, ye bi; yaa nɛ o ya hwɔ si ekohu.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, Samuel li Yawɛ lolo; ejakaa Yawɛ kɛ lɛ tui munyu hyɛ.
Yawɛ tsɛ Samuel ekohu si etɛne, nɛ Samuel te si kɛ ho Eli ngɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, i ba; i nu nɛ o tsɛ mi.” Jehanɛ Eli yɔse kaa Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ tsɛe ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Samuel ke, “Yaa hwɔ si, nɛ ke e tsɛ mo ekohu ɔ, de ke, ‘Moo tu munyu, Yawɛ; o tsɔlɔ ngɛ mo tue bue.’ ” Nɛ Samuel ho nɛ e ya hwɔ si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ba da si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e tsɛ lɛ kaa kekle ɔ ke, “Samuel!
Samuel!” Nɛ Samuel he nɔ ke, “Moo tu munyu, o tsɔlɔ ngɛ mo tue bue.” Yawɛ de Samuel ke, “I miɔ nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko ngɛ Israel, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu he ɔ, e tue mi maa pee lɛ heii.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de kɛ si Eli we ɔ maa ba mi kɛ maa je sisije kɛ yaa si nyagbe.
I de lɛ momo ke ma gbla e we ɔ tue kɛ maa ya neneene, ejakaa e le kaa e bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ musu bɔe kɛ ngɛ Mawu sie, se e kua we nɔ́ ha mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ Eli kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ kita kae kaa yayami agbo nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ, a kɛ sami bɔ, loo niye ní bɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpata mi kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Samuel ho ya hwɔ si kɛ ya si mɔtu; nɛ e te si nɛ e bli Yawɛ we ɔ sinya amɛ.
Samuel ye gbeye kaa e ma de Eli nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ.
Se Eli tsɛ lɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye bi Samuel!” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛ!” Eli bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni Yawɛ de mo ɔ?
De mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Ke o laa mi ba a, Mawu maa gbla o tue!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Samuel de lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; e si we nɔ́ ko nɛ e de we lɛ.
Eli de ke, “Lɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ sa e hɛ mi ɔ, e pee!” Nɛ́ Samuel ngɛ wae ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Samuel de ɔ, Yawɛ haa e baa mi ja pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo, kɛ je Dan kɛ ya si Beersheba ba na le kaa Samuel ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ.
Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e je e he kpo ngɛ Shilo, he nɛ e kɛ Samuel tu munyu ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ ke Samuel tu munyu ɔ, Israel tsuo buɔ lɛ tue.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ kpɔ somi daka a Jamɛ a be ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ Afek, konɛ a ya tua Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ hu ya bua a he nya ngɛ Ebenezer, konɛ a kɛ mɛ nɛ hwu.
Ta a mi wa saminya.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ ye Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a gbe a ta buli maa pee akpe eywiɛ.
Benɛ ta buli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba ma sito he ɔ, Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ bi ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ Yawɛ ha Filisti bi ɔmɛ gbe wɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Nyɛ ha wa ya ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a ngɛ Shilo kɛ ba konɛ Yawɛ ba hi wa ngɔ, nɛ e ba kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ ya ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a ngɛ Shilo kɛ ba.
Somi daka a daa si ha Yawɛ Ope ɔ matsɛ sɛ.
Eli binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ, Hofni kɛ Finehas piɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ba a a he.
Benɛ Yawɛ somi daka a ba su ma sito he ɔ, Israel tsuo hwɔ lele wawɛɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ ha zugba mimiɛ.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ nu lele hwɔmi ɔ, nɛ a bi ke, “Lele nɛ a hwɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a sito he ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ?” Benɛ a na le kaa Yawɛ somi daka a ba su Hebri bi ɔmɛ a sito he ɔ, sawale nu Filisti bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Mawu komɛ ba ni ɔmɛ a sito he ɔ!
Akuanyɛ!
Nɔ nɛ ɔ eko tsa bɛ hyɛ.
Wa yi ta!
Mɛnɔ ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je kikɛmɛ a mawu kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi?
Mɛ ji mawuhi nɛ kɛ haomi slɔɔtohi gba Egipt bi ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ nɛ!
Nyɛ wlua nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee kã kaa nyumuhi; ke pi ja a, nyɛ ma ba plɛ pee Hebri bi ɔmɛ a nyɔguɛhi kaa bɔ nɛ mɛ hu a sɔmɔ nyɛ be ko mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hwu ta kaa nyumuhi!” Filisti bi ɔmɛ hwu ta wawɛɛ, nɛ a ye Israel nɔ.
Israel ta a gbɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ tu fo kɛ ho e we mi ya.
A gbe nihi babauu nitsɛ, nɛ Israel ta buli akpe nyingmi etɛ sɔuu gbo.
A kpɔ Mawu somi daka a, nɛ Hofni kɛ Finehas, Eli binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ hu gbo.
Eli gbenɔ Nyumu ko nɛ je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi gbɔ fo kɛ je ta nga a nɔ kɛ ba Shilo jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu kɛ e he tade nɛ hía, kɛ e yi mi zu.
Benɛ e ba a, Eli hii si ngɛ sɛ nɔ ngɛ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi hyɛe; ejakaa e ngɛ e tsui yee ngɛ somi daka a he.
Benɛ nyumu ɔ ba su ma a mi, nɛ e ba gba sane nɛ ba a, ma a tsuo kpa bubuubui.
Benɛ Eli nu ngmlaa a, e bi ke, “Kɛ ji bubuubui nɛ a ngɛ kpae nɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?” Nɛ nyumu ɔ nyɛɛ esɔesɔ kɛ ho ya bɔ Eli amaniɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Eli ye jeha nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ; e hɛngmɛ nɔ ha, nɛ e hyɛ we nɔ́ kpakpa ko hu.
Nyumu ɔ de Eli ke, “Ta nga a nɔ i je kɛ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ; mwɔnɛ ɔ nɔuu i tu fo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.” Eli bi lɛ ke, “Ye bi, kɛ níhi ya nɔ kɛɛ?” Tsɔlɔ ɔ ha lɛ heto ke, “Israel tu fo ngɛ ta a nya, nɛ a gbe a ti nihi babauu.
Hofni kɛ Finehas, o binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ gbo; nɛ a kpɔ Mawu somi daka a hu kɛ je!” Nɛ́ nyumu ɔ wo somi daka a nɔ ta kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Eli kpa kɛ je e sɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya nɔ e se ngɛ agbo ɔ kasa nya.
Nɛ akɛnɛ nɔmlɔ ɔ bwɔ nɛ e jiɔ he je ɔ, e kuɛ ku nɛ e gbo.
Eli hi Israel ma a nya jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Finehas yo ɔ gbenɔ Eli nganyɛ nɛ ji Finehas yo ɔ mi wa, nɛ e fɔmi be su ta.
Benɛ e nu kaa a kpɔ Mawu somi daka a, nɛ e ngatsɛ ɔ, kɛ e huno ɔ tsuo gbo ɔ, e kpatu nu kɔɔmi, nɛ e fɔ.
Benɛ e maa ho gbomi ya a, yi ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ e he ɔ de lɛ ke, “Koo ye gbeye!
O fɔ binyumu!” Se e pui a nya mi, nɛ e ha we mɛ heto hulɔ.
E wo jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ biɛ ke Ikabod ngɛ Mawu somi daka a nɛ a kpɔ ɔ, kɛ e ngatsɛ ɔ, kɛ e huno ɔ nɛ a gbo ɔ he.
Ikabod sisi ji, “Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ je.” E de ke, “Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ je, ejakaa a kpɔ Mawu somi daka a.”
Somi daka a ya je Filistia Benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ kpɔ somi daka a, a wo lɛ kɛ je Ebenezer kɛ ho Ashdod ya, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ma a wɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Dagon ɔ kasa nya ngɛ piɛ ɔ mi.
E nɔ jena mɔtu mla benɛ Ashdod bi ɔmɛ te si ɔ, o nɛ Dagon nɛ kuɛli nɔ si, nɛ e hɛ mi bu si ngɛ Yawɛ somi daka a hɛ mi.
A wo e nɔ kɛ ma e ma he ɔ ekohu.
E nɔ jena kpa mɔtu mla benɛ a ke a teɔ si ekohu ɔ, o nɛ Dagon nɛ kuɛli nɔ si ekohu, nɛ e hɛ mi bu si ngɛ Yawɛ somi daka a hɛ mi.
Dagon yi, kɛ e nine enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kplɔ pue si ngɛ kpoku ɔ nya; e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ pɛ lɛ piɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, Dagon wɔnɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ yaa wɔ piɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Ashdod ɔ kɛ nane mɛ kpoku ɔ nɔ; pe a haneɔ lɛ.
Yawɛ gbla Ashdod bi ɔmɛ a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e kɛ tslɔɔ kpata a kɛ a huza a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Benɛ Ashdod bi ɔmɛ na bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ nɔ yae ha a, a de ke, “Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ waa kɛ wa wɔ Dagon ɔ tsuo tue gblae.
Wa ko ha nɛ somi daka a nɛ hi wa ngɔ hu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛ Filisti matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kpe, nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee Israel Mawu ɔ somi daka a kɛɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ Israel Mawu ɔ somi daka a kɛ ya Gat.” Nɛ a wo daka a kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
Se benɛ daka a ya su Gat ɔ, Yawɛ gbla ma a tue.
E ha tslɔɔ fuu ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo, jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi; nɛ sawale nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo Yawɛ somi daka a kɛ ho Ekron ya.
Se benɛ Mawu somi daka a ya su Ekron ɔ, Ekron bi ɔmɛ kpa bubuubui, nɛ a de ke, “A wo Israel Mawu ɔ somi daka a kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, konɛ e ba gbe wɔ, kɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ hu a tsɛ Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kpe, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ wo Israel Mawu ɔ somi daka a kɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha nɔtsɛmɛ, konɛ e ko ba gbe wɔ, kɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ.” Sawale nu ma a tsuo, ejakaa gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ bɔni ní puɛmi momo.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo we ɔ po, tslɔɔ fuu mɛ; nɛ ma a kpa bubuubui kɛ ba yemi kɛ buami ngɛ a wɔ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
A kpale somi daka a kɛ ba Benɛ Yawɛ somi daka a na nyɔhiɔ kpaago ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ya tsɛ wɔnɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kunya yeli ɔmɛ, nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee Yawɛ somi daka a kɛɛ?
Mɛni waa kɛ maa piɛ he kɛ ho e je he ya?” A he nɔ ke, “Ke nyɛɛ kɛ Israel Mawu ɔ somi daka a maa ya a, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko ya dɛ gu; e hia doo kaa nyɛɛ ngɔ fɔ yemi bɔ kɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kpata lɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja loko nyɛ ma na he wami, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ Mawu ngɛ nyɛ tue gblae ɔ.” Ma a bi ke, “Mɛni fɔ yemi bɔ waa kɛ maa ya a?” Nɛ a ha heto ke, “Sika tsu tslɔɔ enuɔ, kɛ sika tsu kɔkue enuɔ, ngɛ Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hiɛmi nya; ejakaa haomi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ ba nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee sika tsu tslɔɔ nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ sika tsu kɔkue nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ha kɔkuehi nɛ ba ngɛ nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi kpatae ɔ, konɛ nyɛ ya wo Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami kaa, alini e maa jɔɔ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ wɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ zugba a tue gblami lo.
Mɛni he je nyɛ maa kplii nyɛ tsui kaa bɔ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Farao ɔ kplii a tsui ɔ?
Nyɛ kai kaa Mawu kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ to ní wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ya si be nɛ a ngmɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ho.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kpɛ tlɔɔke he kake, nɛ nyɛɛ fi na nyɔ hali enyɔ nɛ a wui mɛ kuɛ pã tso hyɛ kɛ wo he; na bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ po mɛ ya wo tsu mi.
Nyɛ wo Yawɛ somi daka a kɛ ma tlɔɔke ɔ mi, nɛ sika tsu ní ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma ha Yawɛ kaa fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo daka ko mi kɛ ma somi daka a kasa nya.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ tlɔɔke ɔ ngɔ ma blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ho.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ hi lɛ hyɛe; ke e ba mi kaa tlɔɔke ɔ nyɛɛ tɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ ya su lɛ nitsɛ e zugba a nɔ ngɛ Bet Shemesh ɔ, lɛɛ Israel Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ kɛ amanehlu nguaa nɛ ɔ ba wa nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Se ke e pee we ja a, lɛɛ wa maa na kaa tsa pi lɛ nɛ e gbla wa tue, se mohu matahu kɛkɛ nɛ ba po wɔ.” Somi daka a ya su Bet Shemesh Ni ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ a de mɛ ɔ; a ya nu na nyɔ hali enyɔ, nɛ a fi mɛ kɛ wo tlɔɔke ɔ he.
Se na bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a nga a yi wo tsu mi.
A kɛ somi daka a, kɛ daka nɛ sika tsu kɔkue ɔmɛ, kɛ sika tsu tslɔɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ wo tlɔɔke ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ na amɛ ma Bet Shemesh blɔ ɔ nɔ tɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ ho; a gba we a hiɔ nɔ, loo a muɔ nɔ; nɛ benɛ a yaa a tsuo a ngɛ pɛe muu muu ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Filisti matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ya si Bet Shemesh huzu ɔ nya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Bet Shemesh bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ngma pooe ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi; nɛ benɛ a na somi daka a, a nya saminya.
Tlɔɔke ɔ ba su Bet Shemesh no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yoshua a ngmɔ si; nɛ e da si ngɛ tɛ sa agbo ko kasa nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ kplɔ tlɔɔke ɔ he tso ɔ, nɛ a kɛ na amɛ sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ je Yawɛ somi daka a, kɛ daka nɛ maa si ngɛ e kasa nya nɛ sika ní ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ ngɔ ma tɛ sa agbo ɔ nɔ.
Bet Shemesh bi ɔmɛ sã sami bɔhi, kɛ bɔ kpahi kɛ ha Yawɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Filisti matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ bɔɔ, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ho Ekron ya jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɔ sika tsu tslɔɔ enuɔ ɔmɛ ya ha Yawɛ kaa fɔ yemi bɔ kɛ ha a ma nguaa enuɔ ɔmɛ.
Ma amɛ ji Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gat, kɛ Ekron.
Sika tsu kɔkue ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kɛ mɛ kpata Mawu kɛ ha Filisti ma nguaa amɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, kɛ ma wawihi nɛ a fiɛ gbogbo ngɔ wui a he, nɛ ji mahi nɛ Filisti matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ yeɔ a nɔ ɔ tsuo.
Tɛ sa agbo ɔ nɛ a kɛ Yawɛ somi daka a ma nɔ ngɛ Yoshua ngmɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Bet Shemesh ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba a he odase.
Yawɛ gbe Bet Shemesh bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi nyingmi kpaago, ejakaa mɛɛ a ya hyɛ somi daka a mi.
Nɛ ni ɔmɛ ye kɔmɔ kaa Yawɛ kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi.
Somi daka a ngɛ Kiriat Yearim Kɛkɛ nɛ Bet Shemesh bi ɔmɛ bi ke, “Mɛnɔ po ma nyɛ Yawɛ, Mawu klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ hɛ mi maa da?
Nɛ jije wa ma je lɛ kɛ je wa ngɔ kɛ ya?” A tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Kiriat Yearim bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ ya ya de mɛ ke, “Filisti bi ɔmɛ kpale Yawɛ somi daka a kɛ ba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ngɔ kɛ ho.”
Kiriat Yearim bi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a kɛ ho nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abinadab ɔ we mi ya, ngɛ yoku ko nɔ.
A wo e binyumu Eleazar osɔfo, konɛ e hyɛ Yawɛ somi daka a nɔ.
Samuel hyɛ Israel ma a nɔ Yawɛ somi daka a hi Kiriat Yearim be babauu, maa pee jeha nyingmi enyɔ sɔuu.
Nɛ Israel tsuo fa kue kɛ bi yemi kɛ buami ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ.
Samuel de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ maa kpale ba nyɛɛ Yawɛ se niinɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ je ma se mawu ɔmɛ, kɛ yo wɔ Ashtarot ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
Nyɛ dla nyɛ tsui mi kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ nɔ kake too, nɛ e ma je nyɛ kɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ngmɛɛ a Baal ɔmɛ, kɛ Ashtarot ɔ he, nɛ a sɔmɔ Yawɛ pɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Samuel de ke, “Nyɛ bua Israel ma a tsuo nya ngɛ Mizpa, nɛ ma kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ ha mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Mizpa.
A yɛ nyu kɛ pue si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ a ha hwɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ tsuo, nɛ a de ke, “Wa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.” Mizpa ji he nɛ Samuel hyɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti sanehi a mi haa mɛ ngɛ.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ nu kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ Mizpa, nɛ Filisti matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ hia konɛ a ya tua mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a ye gbeye, nɛ a de Samuel ke, “Moo hi kue fae kɛ hi Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ hae, konɛ e je wɔ kɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Samuel nu jijɔ bi nɛ ji nyɔ nya lolo nɛ e sã lɛ mluku ɔ tsuo kaa sami bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Samuel kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ kɛ ha Israel, nɛ Yawɛ bu e kue fami ɔ tue.
Benɛ Samuel ngɛ sami bɔ ɔ sãe ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ ba, konɛ a ba tua Israel.
Se Yawɛ ha hiɔwe si wawɛɛ kɛ wo Filisti bi ɔmɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ; nɛ e ha basabasa sɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a kɛ sawale tu fo.
Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Mizpa kɛ nyɛɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a se, nɛ a gbe mɛ hluu kɛ ya si e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ a maa su Bet Kar.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Samuel ngɔ tɛ kɛ ma Mizpa kɛ Shen a kpɛti, nɛ e wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ Ebenezer; nɛ e de ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ Yawɛ ye bua wɔ kɛ ba si.” Bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ ye Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Samuel yi nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya tua Israel ngɛ a zugba a nɔ hu.
Jehanɛ, ma amɛ nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ kpɔ ngɛ Israel dɛ kɛ je Ekron kɛ ya si Gat kɛ a he zugba amɛ ɔ, a kpale mɛ tsuo ngɔ ha Israel ekohu.
Nɛ tue mi jɔmi ba Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Samuel hyɛ Israel ma a nɔ e wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Daa jeha a, e kpaa si kɛ yaa Betel, Gilgal, kɛ Mizpa ya hyɛɛ sanehi a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kpaleɔ kɛ baa e ma mi Rama, nɛ e ba kojoɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hulɔ.
E ma bɔ sami la tɛ hu ha Yawɛ ngɛ Rama.
Israel ngɛ matsɛ hlae Benɛ Samuel ba bwɔ ɔ, e pee e binyumu ɔmɛ kojoli ngɛ Israel, nɛ a kojo ngɛ Beersheba.
E bitɛte ɔ biɛ ji Yoel, nɛ e binyumu enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji Abiya.
Mɛɛ a be kaa a tsɛ ɔ; mɛɛ a ya di sika se, nɛ a heɔ nyɔ mi ní, nɛ a plɛɔ sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba Rama, nɛ a kɛ Samuel ba pee kpe, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, o bwɔ, nɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ ya wo we o nane; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo wo matsɛ ha wɔ nɛ e ye wa nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ je ma kpa amɛ ngɛ ɔ.” Se e ngɔɛ Samuel nya kaa ni ɔmɛ bi ke a ha mɛ matsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Samuel fa kue ha Yawɛ; nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma a bi mo ɔ, moo pee ha mɛ.
Pi mo nɛ a kua a; imi mohu nɛ a kua ke ma ko ye a nɔ matsɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛ je be mi nɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ, a je ye se ya ngɛ mawu kpahi jae.
Nɔ́ nɛ a pee mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ngɛ mo hu pee ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo pee ha mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ, se mohu o ka a hɛ mi saminya, nɛ o tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a le bɔ nɛ matsɛ nɛ maa ye a nɔ ɔ, kɛ ma a maa hi si ha.” Samuel ya bɔ ma a nɛ bi ke a ha mɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “Matsɛ ɔ nɛ ma ba ye nyɛ nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e maa pee nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E maa ngɔ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ pee e ta buli; ni komɛ maa hi e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a mi, ni komɛ maa hi e ta okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu maa hi fo tue ngɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
E maa to tatsɛmɛ ngɛ ta buli akpehi, kɛ nyingmi enuɔɔnuɔ a nya.
Ni komɛ ma hu ngmɔ nɛ a ma kpa ní ha lɛ, nɛ ni komɛ hu maa sɔ̃ ta hwumi níhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a he níhi.
Nyɛ bi yi ɔmɛ hu e maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ pee e nu via peeli, ní hooli, kɛ abolo sali.
E maa ngɔ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ oliv abɔɔ kpakpa amɛ kɛ ha e mɔ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ.
E maa ngɔ nyɛ ngma, kɛ nyɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka kɛ ha e mɔ mi ní tsuli, kɛ e tsɔli.
Nyɛ nyɔguɛ nyumuhi kɛ yihi, nyɛ nahi, kɛ nyɛ teji kpakpa amɛ ɔ, e maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ ya tsu lɛ nitsɛ e ní tsumi.
E maa ngɔ nyɛ to ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake, nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma plɛ pee e nyɔguɛhi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ maa wo yana ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hla a e ní peepee he, se Yawɛ be nyɛ nya mi poe.” Se ma a bui Samuel tue; mohu ɔ, a de ke, “Dɛbi, ja wa ná matsɛ nɛ ye wa nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo ngɛ ɔ. Wa matsɛ ɔ maa kojo wɔ, nɛ e maa nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi kɛ hwu ta amɛ ha wɔ.” Benɛ Samuel nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma a de ɔ, e ho ya bɔ Yawɛ.
Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Moo bu mɛ tue nɛ o wo matsɛ ha mɛ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Samuel ha Israel bi ɔmɛ nane, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
Saul kɛ Samuel ya bua Benyamin no niatsɛ ko hi si.
E biɛ ji Kish; e tsɛ biɛ ji Abiel; e nɛ̃ ji Zeror; e nɛnɛkasowa ji Bekorat, nɛ Bekorat hu e tsɛ biɛ ji Afia.
Kish ngɛ binyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Saul.
E ji niheyo nɛ he ngɛ fɛu saminya, nɛ nyumu ko nyumu ko be Israel nɛ ka, nɛ e he hu ngɛ fɛu kɛ lɛ sɔ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Saul tsɛ Kish teji komɛ laa; nɛ Kish de e bi ɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake kɛ piɛ o he nɛ o ya hla teji ɔmɛ.” A ya kpa Efraim yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Shalisha zugba a nɔ, se a nɛ teji ɔmɛ.
A tsa nɔ kɛ ya gu Shaalim zugba a nɔ, se teji ɔmɛ be lejɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Jehanɛ, a ya gu Benyamin zugba a nɔ, se a nɛ mɛ.
Benɛ a su Zuf zugba a nɔ ɔ, Saul de tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ ke, “Ha waa kpale wa se, ke pi ja a, tsaatsɛ hɛ maa je teji ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ma bɔni e tsui yemi ngɛ wɔ mohu wa he.” Se tsɔlɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, ní nalɔ ko ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi nɛ a buu lɛ saminya; ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e deɔ ɔ, baa mi.
Ha wa ya na lɛ; eko piɔ e maa tsɔɔ wɔ he nɛ wa maa na lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ.” Saul bi tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Ke wa ya a, mɛni wa ma ha nyumu ɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Abolo ɔ nɛ ngɛ wa kotoku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ta, nɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ wa ma ha ní nalɔ ɔ.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ de Saul ekohu ke, “I hɛɛ sika hiɔ nyafii ko.
I kɛ lɔ ɔ ma ha ní nalɔ ɔ, konɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ he nɛ wa maa na lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ.” -Saul de ke, “Mo!
O le demi; ha nɛ waa ho.” Nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho ma a mi he nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ ya.
Benɛ a ngɛ yoku ɔ kuɔe kɛ yaa a, a kɛ yihewi komɛ kpe nɛ a yaa yɛ nyu.
A bi yihewi ɔmɛ ke, “Ní nalɔ ɔ ngɛ ma a mi lo?” (Jamɛ a be ɔ, bɔ nɛ a tsɛɔ gbalɔ ji ní nalɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko yaa bi ní ngɛ Israel ɔ, bɔ nɛ e deɔ ji, “Nyɛ ha waa ho ní nalɔ ɔ ngɔ ya.”) -Yiwi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, e ngɛ; lɛ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ yaa a nɛ.
Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ esɔesɔ; ke nyɛ sɛ ma a mi pɛ nyɛ maa na lɛ.
Piɔ pɛ nɛ e ba ma a mi, ejakaa ni ɔmɛ ba konɛ a ba sã bɔ ngɛ jami he ɔ; nɛ ja e su lejɛ ɔ nɛ e gbaa bɔ ɔ nɔ loko ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kpee ɔ maa ye ní ɔ. Ke nyɛ he sɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma ya ná lɛ loko e maa ya jami he ɔ nɛ e ya ye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Saul kɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
Benɛ a sɛ ma a mi ɔ, a na Samuel nɛ lɛɛ e je ma a mi kɛ yaa jami he ɔ. Loko je na nɛ Saul ba Samuel ngɔ ɔ, Yawɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ Samuel, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ, maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma tsɔ nyumu ko nɛ je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi kɛ ba o ngɔ.
Moo pɔ lɛ nu nɛ e ba ye ganɔ ngɛ ye ma, Israel ɔ nya, nɛ e kpɔ mɛ kɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, ejakaa i na a nɔ nami ɔ, nɛ i nu a kue fami ɔ hulɔ.” Benɛ Samuel na Saul ɔ, Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ i gba mo e he sane ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma ba ye ye ma a nɔ.” Jehanɛ, Saul hɛ lɛ kɛ su Samuel he ngɛ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, jije ní nalɔ ɔ we mi ngɛ?” Samuel de Saul ke, “Imi ji ní nalɔ ɔ nɛ; moo nyɛɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ waa ho jami he ɔ ya; ejakaa mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mi maa ye ní, nɛ hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, ma de mo níhi nɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o le ɔ tsuo, loko ma wo mo blɔ nɛ o ho.
Teji ɔmɛ nɛ laa mwɔnɛ ɔ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ, koo ye o tsui ngɛ a he; a na mɛ.
Se mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ hlae wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mo tutuutu; o kɛ o tsɛ we ɔ.” Saul he nɔ ke, “I je Benyamin, Israel wɛtso nɛ ji nyafii pe kulaa a mi; nɛ ye weku ɔ hu ji weku nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ wɛtso ɔ mi.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o kɛ mi ngɛ munyu tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Samuel ngɔ Saul, kɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ho asa a nɔ ya, nɛ e ya ha mɛ sɛ ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ yi, he nɛ nihi nɛ a kpee kɛ ba a hii si ngɛ ɔ. Mɛ tsuo a hiɛmi maa pee kaa nihi nyingmi etɛ.
Samuel de ní hoolɔ ɔ ke, “Lo kpɔ ɔ nɛ i kɛ ha mo si tomi ɔ, yaa ngɔ kɛ ba.” Ní hoolɔ ɔ ngɔ lo fiɔ ɔ, kɛ bo mi fiɔ ɔ ba ma Saul hɛ mi.
Nɛ Samuel de ke, “O nɛ, lo nɛ a kɛ to ha mo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Moo ye, ejakaa i je blɔ ngɔ to ha mo nɛ o ba ye kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔ kɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ nɛ i kpee ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul kɛ Samuel ye ní jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Benɛ a kple si kɛ je jami he ɔ kɛ ba ma a mi ɔ, a pee sa ha Saul ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi, nɛ e hwɔ lejɛ ɔ. Samuel pɔ Saul nu Makɛ ɔ, Samuel tsɛ Saul ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tee si nɛ ma wo mo blɔ nɛ o ho.” Saul te si, nɛ e kɛ Samuel tsuo je kpo.
Benɛ a maa ho ma a nya sumi ya a, Samuel de Saul ke, “De o tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ e be kɛ sɛ wa hlami.
Mo nitsɛ lɛɛ moo mlɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ bɔɔ nɛ ma de mo sɛ ko nɛ je Mawu ngɔ.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ Samuel plɛ nu ngɛ tɔ ko mi kɛ pue Saul yi mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fua lɛ atuu, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ hla mo kaa e ma Israel ganɔ.
O maa ye e ma a nɔ, nɛ o ma kpɔ mɛ kɛ je he nyɛli nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi.
Okadi nɛ o kɛ maa na kaa Yawɛ nɛ hla mo ke o ba pee e ma, Israel ganɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke o je ye ngɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ, o kɛ nyumuhi enyɔ maa kpe ngɛ Rahel yɔkɔ ɔ kasa nya ngɛ Zelza, ngɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ.
