A ma de mo ke teji ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ho hlami ya a, a na mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o tsɛ jɔɔ a he susumi, se o he mohu e ngɛ tsui yee ngɛ, nɛ e ngɛ bie kpami ke, ‘Jije ma na ye bi ɔ ngɛ?’ Ke nyɛ ya nyɛ hɛ mi saii nɛ nyɛ ya su Tabor tso ngua a he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyumuhi etɛ maa kpe nɛ a yaa sã bɔ ha Mawu ngɛ Betel.
Nɔ kake hɛɛ apletsi ku etɛ, nɔ kake hɛɛ abolo bɔbɔɛ etɛ, nɛ nɔ kake hu hɛɛ wai lohwe he womi tɔ kake.
Ke nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ kpe ɔ, a ma fɔ mo, nɛ a ma ha mo abolo bɔbɔɛ enyɔ.
Ke a ha mo ɔ, he ngɛ a dɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa ya Mawu yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Gibea, he nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a ta a pueɔ si ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ma a mi sɛmi pɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbali a kuu ko maa kpe nɛ a kple si kɛ je yoku ɔ nɔ kɛ ma kɛ a dɛ mi kpa saku, miɛ, kɛ bɛ.
Nyɛ maa na kaa a ngɛ doe, nɛ a ngɛ huhui kpae.
Yawɛ mumi ɔ maa ba o nɔ; o maa do, nɛ o ma kpa huhui kaa mɛ, nɛ o ma plɛ pee nɔmlɔ kpa.
Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ma de mo ke o pee ɔ, moo pee; ejakaa e kɛ mo ngɛ.
O maa sɛ ye hlami kɛ ho Gilgal ya.
Ma ba na mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ma sã sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ.
O maa mlɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago kɛ yaa si ma ba nɛ ma ba tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ o pee.” Benɛ Saul kɛ Samuel ye sɛ nɛ a mi gba a, Mawu ha Saul tsui he; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Samuel de lɛ ɔ ba mi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Benɛ Saul kɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ ya su Gibea a, e kɛ gbali a kuu ko kpe; nɛ tlukaa a, Mawu mumi ɔ ba e nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ bɔni domi, kɛ huhui kpami.
Benɛ nihi nɛ le lɛ saminya a na e ní peepee ngɛ gbali ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, a bi a he ke, “Mɛni lɛ ba Kish binyumu ɔ nɔ?
Anɛ Saul hu ba plɛ pee gbalɔ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko nɛ je lejɛ ɔ bi ke, “Gbali kpa amɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ bimɛ ji mɛ?” Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba pee nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ tuɔ munyu ke, “Anɛ Saul hu ba plɛ pee gbalɔ lo?” Benɛ Saul do nɛ e kpa huhui ɔ se ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho we mi ya.
Saul tsɛ nyɛminyumu ɔ bi Saul kɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Jije nyɛ je?” Saul he nɔ ke, “Wa ho ya hla teji ɔmɛ, nɛ nɛ́ wa nɛ mɛ ɔ, wa ya Samuel ngɔ.” Saul tsɛ nyɛminyumu ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ Samuel de nyɛ kɛɛ?” Saul he nɔ ke, “E de wɔ ke a na teji ɔmɛ.” Se Saul de we e tsɛ nyɛminyumu ɔ ke Samuel de lɛ ke e ma ba ye matsɛ.
A wo Saul matsɛ Jehanɛ Samuel ha Israel ma a tsuo ba bɔ gua ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ Mizpa, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Imi lɛ i kpaka nyɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba.
Imi lɛ i kpɔ nyɛ ngɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma kpa amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi.
Imi ji nyɛ Mawu nɛ jeɔ nyɛ kɛ jeɔ haomi, kɛ nɔ́ nami tsuo mi.
Se mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ kua mi, nɛ nyɛ bi ke ma ha nyɛ matsɛ.
Yoo, nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, kɛ weku nya weku nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.’ ” Samuel tsɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ a fɔ sɔ kɛ hla Benyamin wɛtso ɔ. Jehanɛ Samuel ha Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ba weku nya weku nya, nɛ a fɔ sɔ kɛ hla Matri weku ɔ. Nyagbe ɔ, nyumuhi nɛ je Matri weku ɔ mi hu ba kakaaka, nɛ a fɔ sɔ kɛ hla Saul, Kish binyumu ɔ.
Se benɛ a ngɛ lɛ hlae ɔ, a nɛ lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya bi Yawɛ ke, “Jije nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɛ?” Nɛ Yawɛ de mɛ ke, “Saul ya laa e he ngɛ nito he ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tu fo nɛ a ya nu lɛ kɛ ba.
Benɛ e daa si ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, a na kaa e ka pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Samuel de ma a tsuo ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be kaa lɛ ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo hwɔ lele nɛ a de ke, “Matsɛ yi nɛ e na wa!” Jehanɛ Samuel tsɔɔ ma a bɔ nɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ blɔ nya tomi ngɛ ha, matsɛ ɔ blɔ nya nɛ e hɛɛ, kɛ e ní tsumi.
E ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo womi mi, nɛ e ngɔ ya fɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Samuel ha ma a nane, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho e we mi ya.
Saul hu kpale e se kɛ ho e ma mi, Gibea ya.
Benɛ e yaa a, Mawu je nyumuhi oblai komɛ ha lɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho.
Se yaka nimli komɛ bi ke, “Kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ maa pee kɛ he wa yi wami kɛɛ?” A gbe e he guɛ, nɛ mɛɛ a ya ki lɛ ní.
Se Saul pui a nya mi.
Saul ye Amon bi ɔmɛ a nɔ Maa pee hlami kake se ɔ, Matsɛ Nahash nɛ je Amon, kɛ e ta buli ya sa Yabesh Gilead yi.
Nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Yabesh ɔ de Nahash ke, “Ha waa kɛ mo nɛ so, konɛ wa sɔmɔ mo.” Se Nahash de mɛ ke, “Loko i kɛ nyɛ maa so ɔ, ma ta nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ hɛngmɛ, nɛ i kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma pue Israel tsuo hɛ mi si.” Yabesh ma nimeli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Ha wɔ ligbi kpaago nɛ waa tsɔ kɛ ya Israel ma amɛ tsuo a mi.
Ke wa nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ma kpɔ wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ wa ma ha yi.” Tsɔli ɔmɛ ba su Gibea, he nɛ Saul ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ a bɔ ma a amaniɛ ɔ, ma a wo yana yuuyuuyuu.
Se benɛ a maa hyɛ ɔ, Saul ji nɛ ɔ nɛ e nyɛɛ e nahi a se kɛ je ngmɔ mi kɛ ma.
Saul bi ke, “Mɛni ba loko ma a tsuo wo yana kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” A de lɛ sɛ gbi nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ hɛɛ kɛ je Yabesh kɛ ba a. Benɛ Saul nu munyu nɛ ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ ba e nɔ, nɛ e mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E nu na enyɔ nɛ e poo a mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ e ngɔ ha tsɔli ke a ya kpa Israel ma amɛ tsuo a mi nɛ a de ke, “Nɔ nɛ be bae nɛ e ba nyɛɛ Saul kɛ Samuel a se ɔ, jamɛatsɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a maa pee e nahi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Yawɛ ha sawale nu ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo kulaa a je kpo kɛ ba; e píɛ nɔ ko.
Saul bua ma a nya ngɛ Bezek, nɛ a ná nyumuhi akpe lafa etɛ nɛ je Israel, kɛ akpe nyingmi etɛ nɛ je Yuda.
A de tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ je Yabesh Gilead kɛ ba a ke, “Nyɛ ya de nyɛ bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Hwɔɔ, loko pu maa da a, a ma he nyɛ yi wami!’ ” Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ya bɔ Yabesh bi ɔmɛ amaniɛ ɔ, a bua jɔ, nɛ a de Nahash ke, “Hwɔɔ ɔ, wa ma ha yi, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee wɔ.” E nɔ jena a, Saul gba ma a mi kɛ wo tabo etɛ a mi.
Makɛ ɔ, a ya sɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a mi, nɛ a tua Amon bi ɔmɛ.
A gbe Amon hluu kɛ ya si be nɛ pu da.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ gbɛ fĩa, nɛ o be a ti nihi enyɔ po nae ngɛ he kake.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma a de Samuel ke, “Mɛnɔmɛ lɛ a de ke, ‘Anɛ Saul hu ma nyɛ wa nɔ matsɛ maa ye’ ɔ?
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ni ɔmɛ ha wɔ nɛ waa gbe mɛ!” Se Saul de ke, “Dɛbi, a be nɔ ko nɔ ko gbee mwɔnɛ ɔ, ejakaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ he Israel yi wami.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Samuel de ma a ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ya Gilgal nɛ wa ya ma matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Ma a tsuo ho nɛ a ya wo Saul matsɛ ngɛ Gilgal ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
A sã tue mi jɔmi bɔhi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Saul kɛ Israel ma a tsuo nyá babauu.
Samuel sɛ yemi munyu Jehanɛ Samuel de Israel tsuo ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bi mi ɔ, i pee ha nyɛ; i wo matsɛ ha nyɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e maa nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.
Imi lɛɛ i bwɔ, nɛ ye yi bwɔmi hiɛ futaa, nɛ ye binyumuhi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
I nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ je ye nihe mi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke i pee nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ po ye nya ngɛ Yawɛ, kɛ nɔ nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ a hɛ mi.
Anɛ i kpɔ nɔ ko na, loo nɔ ko teji?
Anɛ i ye nɔ ko amimi, aloo i wa nɔ ko yi mi?
Anɛ i he nyɔ mi ní ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma ye e sane ɔ ha lɛ lo?
Nyɛ de, konɛ ma to nyɛ nane mi.” Ma a he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, o yi wɔ amimi; o wɛ wɔ yi mi, nɛ o kpɔ we nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ.” Samuel de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ, kɛ nɔ nɛ e wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ ji ye we odasehi mwɔnɛ ɔ, kaa nyɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ ye he.” A he nɔ ke, “Ee, Yawɛ ji wa we odase.” Samuel ya nɔ nɛ e de ma a ke, “Yawɛ lɛ hla Mose kɛ Aaron, nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ kpaka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ da si dii, konɛ ma po nyɛ nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ ma kai nyɛ ní nguahi nɛ Yawɛ pee kɛ he nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi wami.
Benɛ Yakob kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ya Egipt, nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ e tsɔ Mose kɛ Aaron nɛ a ya je mɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.
Se a hɛ je Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo Hazor tatsɛ Sisera, kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Moab matsɛ ɔ a dɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ mɛ hwu ta.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ a de ke, ‘Wa pee yayami, ejakaa wa je Yawɛ se nɛ wa ya ja Baal amaga amɛ, kɛ yo wɔ Ashtarot ɔ hu e we amaga amɛ.
Mo kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ wa ma sɔmɔ mo!’ Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔ Gideon; Gideon se ɔ, e tsɔ Barak; Barak se ɔ, e tsɔ Yefta; nɛ pee se ɔ, e tsɔ imi Samuel.
Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ je nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ a dɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Se benɛ nyɛ na kaa Amon matsɛ, Nahash ma nyɛ tuami ɔ, nyɛ de mi ke, ‘Dɛbi, ja wa ná matsɛ nɛ e ye wa nɔ,’ be mi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji nyɛ matsɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ne matsɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ hla a; nyɛ bi ke a ha nyɛ matsɛ, nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Ke nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ lɛ, nɛ nyɛ be e hɛ mi atuã tsɔe, se nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ maa nyɛɛ e se ɔ, lɛɛ e maa hi ha nyɛ.
Se ke nyɛ bui Yawɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã kɛ si e mlaa amɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ, kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ tsuoyawɛ kɛ nyɛ maa ye saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ da si dii, nɛ nyɛ maa na nyakpɛ ní nguaa nɛ Yawɛ ma tsu.
Anɛ pi ngma kpami be ji nɛ ɔ?
Se ma tsɛ Yawɛ nɛ e ma ha hiɔwe ma si, nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ konɛ nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ pee Yawɛ yayami agbo kaa nyɛ bi ke a ha nyɛ matsɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Samuel fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ ha hiɔwe si, nɛ hiɔmi nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Nɛ ma a tsuo ye Yawɛ kɛ Samuel gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ a de Samuel ke, “Kpa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ha wɔ, konɛ wa ko gbo; ejakaa wa na jehanɛ kaa ngɛ wa yayami kpa amɛ a se ɔ, wa pee yayami kaa wa bi ke a ha wɔ matsɛ.” Se Samuel de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ ná pee kikɛmɛ a yayami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo lɛɛ, se kɛ̃, nyɛ ko je Yawɛ se; mohu nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.
Nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ yaka níhi nɛ a he be se nami, nɛ a be nyɛ yi wami nyɛe ma he ɔ a se; ejakaa yaka níhi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Yawɛ be e ma nɛ e hla a he ngmɛɛe.
Ke e pee ja pɛ kɛkɛ e biɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ puɛ; ejakaa e sa e hɛ mi kaa e kɛ nyɛ maa pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
Imi lɛɛ ma kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ ha nyɛ daa, nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ hi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da, konɛ ma ko pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ sa nyɛ peemi kɛkɛ ji nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ kai ní nguahi nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ɔ.
Se ke nyɛ tsa nɔ pee yayami ɔ, lɛɛ e ma kpata nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi.”
Saul tue gbomi Benɛ Saul ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ɔ, e hla nyumuhi akpe etɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti; e kɛ akpe enyɔ hi Mikmash kɛ Betel yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e binyumu Yonatan hu kɛ akpe hi Gibea ngɛ Benyamin.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, Saul wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya.
Yonatan ya gbe Filisti bi a nyatsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Geba a, nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ tsuo nu he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul ha nɛ a kpa titimati kɛ kpa zugba a nɔ tsuo kɛ tsɛ Hebri bi ɔmɛ kɛ ha ta hwumi.
Israel tsuo nu kaa Saul gbe Filisti bi a nyatsɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Filisti bi ɔmɛ a hɛ dɔ wo mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a bua a he nya, nɛ a bu Saul nɔ kɛ ho Gilgal ya.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ bua a he nya, konɛ a kɛ Israel nɛ hwu; a hɛɛ ta zugba lɛ akpe nyingmi etɛ, okpɔngɔ ta buli akpe ekpa, kɛ tabohi babauu nɛ a li nya.
A ya bua a he nya ngɛ Mikmash ngɛ Bet Aven beleku je.
A ya tua Israel bi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ na kaa a yi fi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi, muɔhi, yɔkɔhi, vuhi, kɛ tɛ sahi a mi; ni komɛ hu po Yordan pa a kɛ ho Gad kɛ Gilead zugba amɛ a nɔ ya.
Se Saul lɛɛ e ngɛ Gilgal jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ sawale nu nihi nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ tsuo.
E mlɛ ligbi kpaago kaa bɔ nɛ Samuel to lɛ ɔ, se Samuel bɛ Gilgal, nɛ ma a bɔni gbɛmi ngɛ e he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba.” Nɛ e sã sami bɔ ɔ. Benɛ e sã sami bɔ ɔ ta pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Samuel ba hia si.
Saul je kpo ya kpee lɛ, nɛ e fɔ lɛ.
Se Samuel bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o pee nɛ ɔ?” Saul he nɔ ke, “Ma a ngɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ fĩae ngɛ ye he, nɛ mo hu o bɛ be nɛ o to mi ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he nya buae ngɛ Mikmash.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i de ke, ‘Filisti bi ɔmɛ ma mi tuami ngɛ Gilgal be mi nɛ i bi we Yawɛ yemi kɛ buami.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ he hiami sã sami bɔ ɔ.” Samuel de Saul ke, “O je kuasia; o yi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ mlaa nɛ e wo mo ɔ nɔ; kaa o ye nɔ jinɛ o matsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha nɛ e da si kɛ ya neneene.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ be si dae.
Yawɛ hla lɛ nitsɛ e tsui nya nɔmlɔ, nɛ e wo lɛ ganɔ ngɛ e ma a nya; ejakaa o yi mlaa nɛ e wo mo ɔ nɔ.” Samuel je Gilgal nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Gibea ya ngɛ Benyamin.
Benɛ Saul kane nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e ná maa pee nyumuhi lafa ekpa.
Saul kɛ e binyumu Yonatan, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ a he ɔ ya bua a he nya ngɛ Geba ngɛ Benyamin; se Filisti bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Mikmash.
Ní hali a kuu etɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a sito he ɔ kɛ ya ha ní.
Kuu kake ya Ofra ngɛ Shual zugba a nɔ; kuu enyɔne ɔ gu Bet Horon blɔ, nɛ kuu nɛ ji etɛ ɔ hu gu Geba blɔ, ngɛ huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa Zeboim kɔ̃ ɔ mi blɔ ɔ kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya.
Sɔlɔ ko sɔlɔ ko be Israel zugba a nɔ tsuo; ejakaa Filisti bi ɔmɛ fia pɛɛ si kaa a be hae nɛ Hebri bi ɔmɛ nɛ a sɔ klaatehi, loo akplɔhi kɛ ha a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ lɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo ya duɔɔ a na kpakplaahi, sɔsɔhi, gbiɛhi, kɛ hahi a nya ngɛ.
Ke a duɔ gbiɛ nya, loo a dla a na tsɔmi dade ɔ, a heɔ kaplɛ nyafii kake.
Se na kpakplaa, loo kpakplaa nitsɛ lɛɛ a heɔ kaplɛ nyafii enyɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ta hwumi ligbi ɔ, a nɛ klaate, loo akplɔ ngɛ ta bulɔ ko dɛ; blɔɔ Saul kɛ e binyumu Yonatan pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ klaate, loo akplɔ.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ a tabo ɔmɛ ekomɛ hia kɛ ho Mikmash yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ya, nɛ a ya bu lejɛ ɔ.
Yonatan kã peemi Ligbi ko ɔ, Saul binyumu Yonatan de niheyo ɔ nɛ hɛɛɔ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ke, “Ha waa po mi kɛ ho Filisti bi ɔmɛ a sito he ɔ ya.” Se e sɛ́ e tsɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Saul ngɛ tso ko nɛ yiblii ngɔɔ sisi ngɛ Migron ngɛ Gibea ma a nya, nɛ ta buli maa pee nyumuhi lafa ekpa piɛ e he.
Osɔfo Ahiya hɛɛ efɔd ɔ. Ahiya ji Ikabod nyɛminyumu Ahitub binyumu.
Ahitub ji Finehas bibi, kɛ Eli nɛ ji Yawɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ hi Shilo ɔ bibimibi.
Se ma a li kaa Yonatan je a he.
Yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nɛ Yonatan maa gu nɔ kɛ ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ ɔ, tɛ sa enyɔ nɛ a nya ba maa si ngɛ blɔ ɔ he ngɛ hiɔ mi kɛ muɔ mi; kake biɛ ji Bozez, nɛ kake hu biɛ ji Sene.
Tɛ sa a kake ngɛ omleyi je ngɛ Mikmash hanɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ leneyi je ngɛ Geba hanɔ.
Yonatan de niheyo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ke, “Ha waa ho mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a sito he ɔ ya.
Eko piɔ, Yawɛ ma tsu nyakpɛ ní ha wɔ; ejakaa nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko tsi Yawɛ nya kaa e kɛ nihi fuu, loo bɔɔ ma he nihi a yi wami.” E ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ kaa o maa pee ɔ, moo pee.
I fi o se kpɛii.” Yonatan de lɛ ke, “Yoo, waa ho nɛ wa ya je wa he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Filisti bi ɔmɛ.
Ke a de wɔ ke waa mlɛ kɛ yaa si a maa ba wa ngɔ ɔ, wa maa da si dii ngɛ he nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ.
Se ke a ke waa kuɔ kɛ ba a ngɔ ɔ, lɛɛ wa maa ya; ejakaa lɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ wɔ kaa Yawɛ je mɛ kɛ wo wa dɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ya je a he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Filisti bi ɔmɛ.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ!
Hebri bi komɛ hia kpo kɛ je muɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ mi ɔ a mi kɛ ma.” Jehanɛ, a de Yonatan kɛ e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ kuɔ kɛ ba wa ngɔ; wa ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ wa ma de nyɛ.” Yonatan de e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ ke, “Moo kuɔ kɛ nyɛɛ ye se, ejakaa Yawɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Israel dɛ mi.” Yonatan waa ngɛ e nine kɛ e nakutso nya kɛ kuɔ, nɛ e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ nyɛɛ e se.
Yonatan ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ nɛ e tsɛ̃ mɛ ko si; nɛ e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ gbe mɛ ngɛ e se.
Ngɛ a kekleekle buami nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Yonatan kɛ e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ gbe nihi maa pee nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ zugba susumi kpa fa kami mi.
Sawale nu Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ní hali ɔmɛ tsuo a tsui po.
Jehanɛ hu zugba mimiɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha sawale nɛ nu mɛ ɔ nya ba wa pe kekle ɔ.
A gbe Filisti bi ɔmɛ Saul e buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Gibea ngɛ Benyamin ɔ na Filisti bi ɔmɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa, nɛ́ a ngɛ fo tue nɛ a li he nɛ a yaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kane ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ waa le nɔ nɛ be hiɛ ɔ.” Benɛ a kane mɛ ɔ, a na kaa Yonatan kɛ e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ be lejɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, osɔfo Ahiya ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu somi daka a nɔ hyɛe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul de lɛ ke, “Yaa ngɔ Mawu somi daka a kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.” Se benɛ Saul kɛ osɔfo ɔ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, basabasa nɛ te si ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ nya wa pe nine.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul de lɛ ke, “Koo ya hu; deka ko be kulaa!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo bua a he nya kɛ ya sɛ ta a mi; se basabasa a ha Filisti bi ɔmɛ wo klaate nɔ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a sibi a nɔ.
Hebri bi komɛ nɛ ya piɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a he ngɛ a sito he ɔ, a yi mi tsake nɛ a ba piɛ Saul kɛ Yonatan a he.
Jehanɛ hu, Israel bi tsuo nɛ ya laa a he ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, benɛ a nu kaa Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ fo tue ɔ, mɛ hu a ba piɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ a kɛ nyɛɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ ya po mi ngɛ Bet Aven tɔɔ.
Yawɛ he Israel yi wami jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Ta a se sanehi Israel bi ɔmɛ na nɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ejakaa Saul ka kita pue ma a nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ li peemi nɛ e maa ye nɔ́ ko loko je maa jɔ, be mi nɛ i na we ma ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he lue lolo ɔ, a gbiɛ jamɛatsɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko sɛ e nya nɔ́ ko ligbi ɔ tsuo.
Ma a tsuo ba su hue ko mi, nɛ a na hwo nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ zugba.
Lejɛ ɔ tsuo pee kɛ hwo sɔuu, se nɔ ko nɔ ko yi; ejakaa ma a tsuo ngɛ kita nɛ Saul ka a gbeye yee.
Se Yonatan lɛɛ kita a nɛ e tsɛ ka fɔ ma a nɔ ɔ, e nui he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ tso nɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ nya sɔ hwo gbaku ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ sa e nya; nɛ e na he wami he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de lɛ ke, “Wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa pee gbedee kɛ hwɔ; se o tsɛ ka kita ngɔ fɔ ma a nɔ ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye nɔ́ ko mwɔnɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ.’ ” Yonatan he nɔ ke, “Mɛni haomi tsaatsɛ kɛ ba ma a nɔ nɛ ɔ. Nɛ i sa ye nya hwo bɔbɔyoo nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ i ba nɔmlɔ mi ha!
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, kaa ma a ye ní nɛ a kpɔ ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ ɔ saminya a, jinɛ tse a ko gbe Filisti bi babauu pe kikɛ nɛ ɔ.” Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Mikmash hluu kɛ ya su Aiyalon tɔɔ; nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee gbedee kɛ hwɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sa fo kɛ ho ta yibu ní ɔmɛ nɛ a ha a he ya.
A ya nuu tohi kɛ nahi nɛ a gbe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a ye lo ɔ kɛ muɔ ɔ tsuo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko ya de Saul ke, “Hyɛ, ma a ngɛ yayami pee kɛ ngɛ Yawɛ sie kaa a ngɛ lo kɛ muɔ tsuo yee.” Saul de ke, “Nyɛ tɔ̃!
Nyɛ kpɛne tɛ agbo ko ba ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ gbɛ fĩa nɛ nyɛ ya de ma a ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ e na, loo e to kɛ ba nɛ e ba gbe ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ e ye, konɛ nyɛ ko ye lo kɛ muɔ nɛ nyɛ ba pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.’ ” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ e na kɛ ba jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ba gbe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Saul puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ ji kekleekle bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ e puɛ.
Jehanɛ Saul de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ho nɛ wa ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ nyɔ mi; waa ha a níhi kɛ yaa si mɔtu, nɛ waa gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Ma a he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ kaa o maa pee ɔ, mo pee.” Se osɔfo ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ ha wa bi Mawu ga womi lolo.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul bi Mawu ke, “Ma ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ lo?
Anɛ o maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Israel dɛ mi lo?” Se Mawu ha we lɛ heto jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul de ma nikɔtɔma amɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ kaa nɔ ko pee yayami mwɔnɛ ɔ lo.
I na Yawɛ Israel yi wami helɔ ɔ, kaa ke ji ye bi Yonatan po nɛ pee yayami nɛ ɔ, ja a gbe lɛ.” Se nɔ ko nɔ ko de we nɔ́ ko.
Jehanɛ Saul de Israel ma a tsuo ke, “Nyɛ ya da he kake, konɛ imi hu i kɛ ye bi Yonatan wa ya da he kake.” Ma a he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ kaa o maa pee ɔ, moo pee.” Saul de ke, “Yawɛ Israel Mawu lee, mɛni he je o pui ye nya mi mwɔnɛ ɔ?
Ha mi heto kɛ tɛ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Yawɛ Israel Mawu lee, ke imi, loo ye bi Yonatan le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko ɔ, moo tsɔɔ Urim; se ke o ma, Israel nɛ pee yayami ɔ, lɛɛ moo tsɔɔ Tumim.” Sɔ ɔ ya nɔ Saul kɛ e bi Yonatan a nɔ, nɛ Israel he je mi.
Jehanɛ Saul de ke, “Nyɛɛ fɔ sɔ ngɛ i kɛ ye bi Yonatan wa nɔ.” Nɛ sɔ ɔ nɔ Yonatan nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul de Yonatan ke, “De mi nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ.” Yonatan de lɛ ke, “I ngɔ tso ɔ nɛ i hɛɛ ɔ nya kɛ sɔ hwo mi nɛ i lɔ.
Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i dla ye he kɛ ha gbenɔ.” Saul de lɛ ke, “Yonatan, ja o gbo; ke a gbi mo fii, Mawu kɛ mi nɛ e ye!” Se ma a de Saul ke, “Anɛ e sa kaa Yonatan nɛ́ ye kunimi nguaa nɛ ɔ kɛ ha Israel ɔ nɛ gbo lo?
Dɛbi, e ko ba mi ja!
Wa na Yawɛ hɛ kalɔ ɔ kaa Yonatan yi bwɔmi kake po be jee kɛ nɔ zugba; ejakaa ní nɛ e tsu mwɔnɛ ɔ, Mawu nine ngɛ mi.” Nɛ ma a he Yonatan yi wami, nɛ a gbi lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Saul jɔɔ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a se nyɛɛmi, nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ya.
Benɛ Saul ye Israel nɔ matsɛ ɔ, e kɛ he nyɛli tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ hwu ta: mɛ ji Moab bi, Amon bi, Edom bi, Zoba matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Filisti bi.
Nɛ he tsuaa he nɛ e ma gba ta kɛ gu ɔ, e yeɔ kunimi.
E pee ka saminya, nɛ e ye Amalek bi ɔmɛ po a nɔ, nɛ e kpɔ Israel kɛ je nihi nɛ ye a nɔ ɔ tsuo a dɛ mi.
Saul binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Yonatan, Ishvi, kɛ Malkishua.
E ngɛ biyihi enyɔ; a tsɛɛ nɔkɔtɔma a Merab, nɛ e senɔ ɔ biɛ ji Mikal.
E yo ji Ahinoam, Ahimaaz biyo ɔ. E tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a biɛ ji Abner, Saul tsɛ nyɛminyumu Ner binyumu ɔ. Saul tsɛ Kish kɛ Abner tsɛ Ner ɔ, Abiel bimɛ ji mɛ.
Saul be ɔ mi ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ta nɛ nya wa hwue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ Saul na nyumu oblai, loo katsɛ ko pɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ piɛ e he.
Saul kɛ Amalek bi hwu ta Samuel de Saul ke, “Imi lɛ Yawɛ tsɔ nɛ i ba pɔ mo nu kɛ wo mo tsɛ ngɛ Israel ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ maa gbla Amalek bi ɔmɛ a tue, ejakaa a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya po Israel bi ɔmɛ blɔ benɛ a je Egipt kɛ ma a. Yaa nɛ o ya tua Amalek bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o kpata a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi.
Ko si nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; se mohu o gbe nyumuhi kɛ yihi, jokuɛwi kɛ bimwɔwi, nahi kɛ tohi, kɛ afukpɔngɔhi kɛ tejihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Saul bua e ta buli ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ Telem, nɛ benɛ a kane mɛ ɔ, a ná nihi akpe lafa enyɔ nɛ je Israel, kɛ akpe nyɔngma nɛ je Yuda.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul ba Amalek ma a mi, nɛ e ba wo ka ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Saul tsɔ ya de Ken bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji ni komɛ nɛ a nɛmɛ na Israel bi ɔmɛ mɔbɔ benɛ a je Egipt kɛ ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ je Amalek bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, konɛ ma ko kpata nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Ken bi ɔmɛ je Amalek bi ɔmɛ a he.
Saul gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Havila kɛ ya si Shur ngɛ Egipt beleku je.
Saul nu Amalek matsɛ, Agag hɛ ngmengmle; se ma a lɛɛ e kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi.
Saul kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ baa Agag yi, nɛ na kɛ na bi, jijɔ kɛ jijɔ bi kpakpa amɛ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, a kpataa we a hɛ mi; se níhi nɛ a hiee, kɛ níhi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ lɛɛ a kpata lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ hɛ mi.
Mawu kua Saul Yawɛ de Samuel ke, “I pia ye he kaa i wo Saul matsɛ; ejakaa e je ye se nɛ e yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ dɔ Samuel, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo.
E nɔ jena mɔtu mla a, Samuel te si, konɛ e ya hla Saul.
Se a de lɛ ke Saul ho Karmel, he nɛ e ma manye yemi kaimi nɔ́ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɛ ɔ ya, nɛ e se kpalemi mi ɔ, e po mi kɛ ho Gilgal ya.
Benɛ Samuel ba su Saul ngɔ ɔ, Saul fɔ lɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ nɛ e gbaa mo!
I ye Yawɛ fami ɔ nɔ.” Samuel bi ke, “Kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ i ngɛ jijɔhi, kɛ nahi a pɛmi he nue nɛ ɔ mɔ?” Saul he nɔ ke, “Ye we bi ɔmɛ kpɔ mɛ kɛ je Amalek bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.
A baa jijɔ, kɛ na kpakpa amɛ a yi, konɛ a kɛ mɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ; se ní nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Samuel de Saul ke, “Da si nɛ ma bɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de mi nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi.” Saul de lɛ ke, “Yaa o nya nɔ.” Samuel de lɛ ke, “E ngɛ mi kaa o peeɔ o he humi mohu, se Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji mo.
Yawɛ wo mo matsɛ ngɛ Israel.
E tsɔ mo, nɛ e de mo ke, ‘Yaa nɛ o kɛ Amalek yayami peeli ɔmɛ ya hwu nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ e ko piɛ a ti nɔ kake po.’ Mɛni he je nɛ o bui Yawɛ tue?
Mɛni he je nɛ o he ya sɔ kɛ ha ta yibu ní, nɛ o pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ɔ?” Saul de Samuel ke, “I bu Yawɛ tue; tsɔmi nɛ e tsɔ mi ɔ, i ya.
I kɛ Amalek matsɛ, Agag ɔ ba, nɛ i gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Se ta yibu ní ɔmɛ a kpɛti jijɔ, kɛ na kpakpa amɛ nɛ a ke a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ ma a muɔ mɛ kɛ ba Gilgal, konɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ.” Samuel bi ke, “Anɛ Yawɛ nyaa sami bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpahi a he pe e munyu ɔ tue bumi lo?
O nɛ, tue bumi hi pe bɔ sami, nɛ munyu ngɔmi hi pe jijɔhi a zɔ.
Atuã tsɔmi ɔ, e ji yayami; e ngɛ kaa klaami, nɛ tue wami hu ngɛ kaa wɔ jami.
Akɛnɛ o bui Yawɛ fami ɔ tue he je ɔ, lɛ hu e kua mo kaa matsɛ.” Saul de Samuel ke, “Niinɛ, i pee yayami; ejakaa i bui Yawɛ fami ɔ, kɛ mo hu o munyu ɔmɛ tue.
I ya ye ma a gbeye, nɛ i bu mɛ tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ngɔɔ ye he yayami kɛ pa mi, nɛ o kɛ mi nɛ kpale kɛ ya Gilgal nɛ ma ya ja Yawɛ.” Se Samuel de Saul ke, “I kɛ mo be yae; o bui Yawɛ fami ɔ tue, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu e kua mo kaa matsɛ ngɛ Israel.” Benɛ Samuel plɛ nɛ e yaa a, Saul nu e bo ɔ nya; nɛ bo ɔ hía.
Nɛ Samuel de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ hía Israel matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ je o he mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ha o nyɛmi ko nɛ hi pe mo.
Mawu nɛ ji Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ, e yi lakpa, nɛ e tsakee we e yi mi tomi hulɔ; ejakaa tsa pi nɔmlɔ ji lɛ nɛ e ma tsake e yi mi tomi.” Saul de ke, “I pee yayami; se kɛ̃, moo wo ye hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ye ma nimeli, kɛ Israel tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ o kɛ mi nɛ ya nɛ ma ya ja Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Samuel kpale e se nɛ e kɛ lɛ ho Gilgal ya, nɛ Saul ya ja Yawɛ.
Jehanɛ Samuel de ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ Amalek matsɛ, Agag ɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.” Agag ba kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ e de ke, “Niinɛ, gbenɔ doomi ɔ be.” Se Samuel de lɛ ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ o klaate ɔ ha binyɛmɛ kpatu plɛ pee nihi nɛ be bimɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu o nyɛ hu ma plɛ pee yosa ngɛ yihi a kpɛti.” Nɛ Samuel poo Agag mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya ngɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ Gilgal.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Samuel pue nɔ kɛ ho Rama ya, nɛ Matsɛ Saul hu kpale kɛ ho e we mi ya ngɛ Gibea.
Samuel nɛ́ Saul hu kɛ ya si e gbenɔ ligbi; se daa nɛ ɔ, e yeɔ e he kɔmɔ.
Nɛ Yawɛ pia e he kaa e wo Saul matsɛ ngɛ Israel.
A wo David matsɛ Yawɛ bi Samuel ke, “Mɛni be o maa ye Saul he kɔmɔ kɛ yaa si?
O nɛ kaa i kua lɛ kaa matsɛ ngɛ Israel lo?
Wo o koli ɔ mi nu nɛ e hyi tɔ, nɛ ma tsɔ mo Betlehem no, Ishai ɔ ngɔ; ejakaa i hla ye matsɛ ɔ kɛ je e binyumu ɔmɛ a kpɛti.” Se Samuel de ke, “Kɛ ma plɛ kɛ ya kɛɛ?
Ke Saul nu he ɔ, e maa gbe mi.” Yawɛ ha heto ke, “Moo hɛɛ na bi kɛ to dɛ, nɛ o de ke, ‘I ba nɛ ma ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.’ Moo kpee Ishai kɛ ba bɔ sami ɔ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ o pee.
O maa pɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nu, nɛ o wo lɛ matsɛ ha mi.” Samuel pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ. E ya Betlehem, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ ba kpe kɛ he domi, nɛ a bi ke, “O ba ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Ee, i ba nɛ ma ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he nɛ waa ho bɔ sami he ɔ ya.” E tsukɔ Ishai kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e kpee mɛ hu kɛ ya bɔ sami he ɔ. Benɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ, Samuel na Eliab, nɛ e de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Niinɛ, nɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla a nɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.” Se Yawɛ de Samuel ke, “Koo hyɛ e kami, loo e he fɛu; i sume lɛ, ejakaa i hyɛ we nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ hyɛɛ nɔ́ ɔ. Nɔmlɔ lɛɛ nɔ hɛ mi e hyɛɛ; se imi Yawɛ lɛɛ tsui mi i hyɛɛ.” Jehanɛ Ishai tsɛ e binyumu Abinadab, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba be ngɛ Samuel hɛ mi.
Se Samuel de ke, “Dɛbi, nɔ nɛ ɔ hu Yawɛ hlɛ lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Ishai ha Shama ba.
Se Samuel de ke, “Dɛbi, nɔ nɛ ɔ hu Yawɛ hlɛ lɛ.” Ishai tsa nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ya si e ngɔ e binyumuhi kpaago kɛ ba Samuel hɛ mi.
Se Samuel de Ishai ke, “Yawɛ hlɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Samuel bi Ishai ke, “O binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ lo?” E he nɔ ke, “E piɛ a kpɛti nɔ wayoo pe kulaa a, se lɛɛ e ngɛ tohi hyɛe.” Samuel de Ishai ke, “Tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba; ejakaa wa be si hie, ja e ba hiɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Ishai tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba.
Ke o hyɛ lɛ ɔ, e tsuɔ papaapa; e hɛngmɛ nɔ tsɔ, nɛ e he hu ngɛ fɛu.
Yawɛ de Samuel ke, “Tee si nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu, ejakaa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Samuel wo nu kɛ koli ɔ, nɛ e pɔ David nu ngɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba David nɔ kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Samuel kpale e se kɛ ho Rama ya.
David ba sɔmɔ Saul Jehanɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ je Saul nɔ, nɛ Yawɛ ha mumi yayami ko ba hao lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, mumi yayami ko lɛ Mawu kɛ ngɛ mo haoe nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wa nyɔmtsɛ, mo fa wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ mɔ, nɛ wa ya hla nɔ ko nɛ le saku fiami saminya kɛ ba, konɛ ke Mawu ha mumi yayami ɔ ba o nɔ ɔ, nɛ e fia saku ɔ, nɛ o na he wami ekohu.” Saul de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hla nɔ ko nɛ le saku fiami saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ.” Nihewi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, i le Ishai, Betlehem no ɔ binyumuyo ko nɛ le saku fiami saminya.
Nyumu katsɛ kɛ ta hwulɔ ji lɛ.
E nya mi tsɔ, nɛ e he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ Yawɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul tsɔ ya de Ishai ke, “Ha nɛ o bi David, to hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ ba.” Ishai fi abolo, kɛ wai lohwe he womi tɔ kake, kɛ apletsi bi ngɔ fɔ teji se mi, nɛ e kɛ ha e binyumu David ke e ngɔ kɛ ya ha Saul.
David ba Saul ngɔ nɛ e ba bɔni lɛ sɔmɔmi.
Saul suɔ David sane saminya, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ pee e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ.
Saul tsɔ ya de Ishai ke, “I suɔ David sane; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ e hi hiɛ ɔ nɛ e sɔmɔ mi.” Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, be tsuaa be nɛ Mawu ma ha mumi yayami ɔ maa ba Saul nɔ ɔ, David ma wo saku ɔ nɛ e maa fia.
Kɛkɛ mumi yayami ɔ maa je Saul nɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi ma tsɔ, nɛ e ma na he wami ekohu.
Goliat bɔ Israel ahlua Jehanɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ bua a tabo ɔmɛ a nya kɛ ha ta hwumi ngɛ Yuda ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Soko ɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Efes Damim, ngɛ Soko kɛ Azeka a kpɛti.
Saul kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu bua a he nya ngɛ Ela kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a dla a he, konɛ a kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya hwu.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ wo zã ngɛ yoku kake nɔ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu wo zã ngɛ yoku kake nɔ; nɛ kɔ̃ ngɛ a kpɛti.
Kɛkɛ nɛ tatsɛ kpanaa ko je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a ta a mi kɛ ba.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Goliat; e je Gat, nɛ e kami ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma kɛ etɛ.
E bu akɔblee pɛɛ, nɛ e wo akɔblee dama nɛ jiimi ji kilo nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kpaago.
E wo akɔblee dama ngɛ e nane hulɔ, nɛ akɔblee tsɛ̃i ngɛ e konɔ.
E we akplɔ ɔ nya tso ngɛ kaa bo lolɔ gba tso, nɛ e we akplɔ ɔ yi dade jiimi ji kilo kpaago; nɛ e tsɛ̃i hɛɛlɔ ɔ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi.
Goliat ba da si ngɛ Israel tabo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kpa huhui ke, “Mɛni he nyɛ gba ta ngɛ?
Pi Filisti no ji mi?
Nɛ nyɛ hu pi Saul tsɔli ji nyɛ?
Nyɛɛ hla nyɛ kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ e kɛ mi ba kpe.
Ke e nyɛ nɛ e kɛ mi nɔ kunɔ nɛ e gbe mi ɔ, wa maa pee nyɛ nyɔguɛhi; se ke i ye e nɔ, nɛ i gbe lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa pee wa nyɔguɛhi, nɛ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ wɔ.” Filisti no ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I ngɛ Israel tabo ɔmɛ ahlua bɔe mwɔnɛ ɔ; nyɛ je nɔ ha mi, konɛ i kɛ lɛ waa kpe.” Benɛ Saul kɛ Israel tsuo nu munyuhi nɛ Filisti no ɔ ngɛ tue ɔ, a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
David ngɛ Saul ta a mi Efraim no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ishai ɔ binyumu ji David.
E je Betlehem ngɛ Yuda.
Ishai ngɛ binyumuhi kpaanyɔ; nɛ benɛ Saul ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, lɛɛ e bwɔ momo.
Ishai binyumu nikɔtɔma etɛ ɔmɛ kɛ Saul ho ta ya.
Kekleekle bi ɔ biɛ ji Eliab, enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji Abinadab, nɛ nɔ etɛne ɔ biɛ ji Shama.
David ji Ishai binakutso.
E wetsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ kɛ Saul ngɛ ta a nya.
Se David lɛɛ ke e sɔmɔ Saul bɔɔ kɛkɛ e je kɛ ho Betlehem ya ya hyɛ e tsɛ to ɔmɛ hu bɔɔ.
Daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Goliat maa ba nɛ e ma ba tsɔ̃ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nya; e pee ja ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Ishai de e binyumu David ke, “Ngɔɔ ngma nɛ a si nɛ ɔ kilo nyɔngma, kɛ abolo bɔbɔɛ nyɔngma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya ha o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ta nga a nɔ esɔesɔ.
Jehanɛ, moo hɛɛ wagasi nyɔngma nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya ha tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ ngɛ a nya a. Slaa o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ, nɛ o kɛ okadi ko nɛ je a ngɔ kɛ ba.
Matsɛ Saul, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel tsuo ngɛ Ela kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ta hwue ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” David te si mɔtu mla, nɛ e si to ɔmɛ ha to hyɛlɔ kpa, nɛ e ngɔ niye ní ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho kaa bɔ nɛ Ishai fa lɛ ɔ. E ya su ta nga a nɔ be mi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ he ose kɛ je kpo kɛ yaa ta a nya.
Kɛkɛ pe Israel tabo ɔ kɛ Filisti tabo ɔ kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
David si ní ɔmɛ ha tlomi nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, nɛ e gbɔ fo kɛ ho ta a nya ya ya fɔ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ́ e kɛ hyɛ a hwɔhwɔɛ.
Benɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, Filisti bi a tatsɛ kpanaa a nɛ je Gat, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Goliat ɔ hia kpo kɛ ba nɛ e ba tu munyu kaa kekle ɔ. Nɛ David nu nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ. Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ na nyumu ɔ, sawale nu mɛ, nɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tu fo.
Israel bi ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Tse nyɛ na nyumu nɛ ɔ?
Hyɛ, Israel ahlua nɛ e ma bɔmi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛ Saul wo si kaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ maa gbe lɛ ɔ, e maa wo lɛ ní babauu.
Jehanɛ hu e kɛ e biyo ma ha lɛ, nɛ e tsɛ weku li maa ye a he kɛ je ma tó tsumi kɛ sɔmɔmi mi.” David bi nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a ke, “Nɔ nɛ maa gbe Filisti no nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ e ma je Israel kɛ je ahlua bɔmi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛni a maa pee ha lɛ?
Mɛnɔ ji kikɛmɛ a Filisti no mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ tabo ɔmɛ ahlua bɔe kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Nyumu ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ a maa pee kɛ ha nɔ nɛ maa gbe Goliat ɔ. Benɛ Davidmɛ awetsɛ Eliab nu nɛ David kɛ nyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, e mi mi fu David, nɛ e de ke, “Mɛni o ma hlami ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?
Nɛ mɛnɔ o si to ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ kɛ ha?
I le o nɔ buimi, kɛ o tsui wami kaa ta hwumi ɔ nɛ o ma hyɛmi nɛ ɔ nɛ!” David bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni i pee?
Pi munyu kɛkɛ nɛ i bi nɔ!” David je e he, nɛ e ya na ni kpa komɛ.
E bi mɛ jamɛ a munyu ɔ nɔuu, nɛ mɛ hu a ha lɛ heto kaa bɔ nɛ kekle ni ɔmɛ de lɛ ɔ. Benɛ nyumu ɔmɛ na David juɛmi ɔ, a ya bɔ Saul amaniɛ, nɛ lɛ hu e tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba.
David de Saul ke, “Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ye tsui ngɛ Filisti no nɛ ɔ he; i yaa nɛ i kɛ lɛ ya kpe.” Se Saul de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, o be Filisti no nɛ ɔ nyɛe, ejakaa niheyo kɛkɛ ji mo; lɛɛ ta hwulɔ ji lɛ kɛ je e nihe mi.” Se David de Saul ke, “I hyɛɛ tsaatsɛ tohi; nɛ ke e ba mi kaa jata, loo osisiblisi ko ba nu to bi ko ngɛ to ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, i nyɛɛɔ e se nɛ i ya fiaa lɛ nɔ, nɛ i jeɔ to bi ɔ ngɛ e nya mi.
Ke e plɛ kɛ wo mi ɔ, i nuɔ e tsitsa nɛ i fiaa lɛ nɔ́ kɛ ya siɔ e gboɔ.
I gbe jatahi kɛ osisiblisihi hyɛ, nɛ ja nɔuu ma pee kikɛmɛ a Filisti no mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e bɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ tabo ɔmɛ ahlua.” David ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ nɛ́ je mi kɛ je jatahi kɛ osisiblisihi a dɛ mi ɔ ma je mi kɛ je Filisti no nɛ ɔ dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul de David ke, “Yaa, Yawɛ maa piɛ o he.” Saul ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ngɔ ha David; e bu lɛ akɔblee pɛɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ dama.
David fi Saul klaate ɔ kɛ wo dama a he, nɛ e ka nyɛɛmi, se e yɛ nya; ejakaa e kpla we jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ eko hyɛ.
David de Saul ke, “I be nyɛe ma kpla ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya, ejakaa a dɛ́ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David je ní ɔmɛ pue si.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ e dɛma tso kɛ ma e dɛ, nɛ e ho ya kukuɔ dongo tɛ enuɔ ngɛ pa a mi, nɛ e kɛ wo e to hyɛlɔ kotoku ɔ mi.
E hɛɛ e we amlami ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e hɛ lɛ kɛ su Filisti no ɔ he.
David gbe Goliat Filisti no ɔ hu bɔni nyɛɛmi kɛ ma David ngɔ, nɛ e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Benɛ e hyɛ David nɛ e na kaa niheyo tsutsuutsu papaapa nɛ he ngɛ fɛu kɛkɛ ji lɛ ɔ, e bui lɛ fɛɛ.
E bi David ke, “Anɛ gbe ji mi nɛ o ma ye ngɔ kɛ tso ɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e tsɛ wɔ pue David nɔ, nɛ e gbiɛ lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ba hiɛ ɔ, nɛ ma ngɔ o he lo ɔ ngɔ ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi.” David de Filisti no ɔ ke, “Moo lɛɛ o kɛ klaate, akplɔ, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ma ye ngɔ; se imi lɛɛ i ma ngɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel tabo ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ nɛ o ngɛ lɛ ahlua bɔe ɔ biɛ mi.
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ma je mo ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi; ma gbe mo, nɛ ma po o yi.
Nɛ ma ngɔ Filisti ta buli ɔmɛ a gbogboehi kɛ ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi nɛ a ye.
Nɛ je ɔ tsuo maa le kaa Mawu ko ngɛ Israel, nɛ ma a nɛ bua ngɛ hiɛ ɔ hu maa le kaa pi klaate kɛ akplɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami.
Yawɛ ye kunimi momo ngɛ ta a nya, nɛ e ma je nyɛ kɛ wo wa dɛ mi.” Goliat hia nyɛɛmi kɛ yaa David ngɔ ekohu, nɛ David sa fo nɛ́ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe ngɛ ta gbami he ɔ. David kɛ e nine wo kotoku ɔ mi, nɛ e je tɛ kake kɛ wo amlami ɔ mi, nɛ e fɔ.
Tɛ ɔ ya na Filisti no ɔ hɛ nya, nɛ e sɛ lo ɔ mi; nɛ Goliat nɔ si bum, nɛ e hɛ mi ya bu si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David hɛɛ we klaate lɛɛ, se e kɛ amlami kɛ amlami tɛ gbe Filisti no ɔ. David sa fo ya da Goliat nɔ.
E hia Goliat klaate ɔ kɛ je kpo ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ po e yi nɛ e gbe lɛ.
Benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ na kaa a tatsɛ kpanaa a gbo ɔ, a tu fo.
Israel kɛ Yuda tabo ɔmɛ hwɔ lele kɛ nyɛɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ ya si Gat kɛ Ekron agbo ɔ nya tɔɔ.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ plaa pue si ngɛ Sharaim blɔ ɔ he hluu kɛ ya si Gat kɛ Ekron tɔɔ.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ ba a, a ba ha ní ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a ta a mi.
David ngɔ Goliat yi ɔ kɛ ho Yerusalem ya; se Goliat ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ lɛɛ e ngɔ ya to lɛ nitsɛ e bo tsu mi.
A kɛ David ya tsɔɔ Saul Benɛ David yaa nɛ e kɛ Filisti no ɔ ya kpe ɔ, Saul bi e tatsɛ, Abner ke, “Abner, mɛnɔ bi ji kikɛmɛ a niheyo nɛ ɔ?” Abner he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i na o nane kaa i li.” Matsɛ Saul fa lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ, yaa nɛ o ya hla nɔ nɛ bi ji niheyo ɔ mɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ David gbe Goliat nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba ta a mi ɔ, Abner kpaka lɛ ya ha Saul; nɛ David hɛɛ Filisti no ɔ yi tɔ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Saul bi lɛ ke, “Niheyo, mɛnɔ bi ji mo?” Nɛ David ha heto ke, “O tsɔlɔ Ishai, Betlehem no ɔ bi ji mi.”
David kɛ Yonatan Benɛ Saul kɛ David gbe a ní sɛɛmi ɔ nya a, Saul binyumu Yonatan kɛ David nu huɛ; nɛ Yonatan suɔ David kaa lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Saul tsi David nya kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɛ e ngmɛ́ lɛ blɔ nɛ e kpale kɛ ho e tsɛ we ya hu.
Yonatan ka David kita kaa e kɛ lɛ maa bɔ kɛ yaa si gbenɔ mi, ejakaa e suɔ David kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Yonatan kpa e he bo kɛ ha David.
E kɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ, e klaate ɔ, e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ, kɛ e mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hu piɛ he ha lɛ.
He tsuaa he nɛ Saul tsɔ David ɔ, e ya yeɔ manye.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Saul wo lɛ asafoatsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sa Saul tsɔli, kɛ nihi tsuo a hɛ mi.
Saul hɛ kɔ David nɔ Benɛ David gbe Goliat nɛ e kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ma a, Israel yi ɔmɛ je a ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi la, kɛ do, kɛ kpa saku ba kpee Matsɛ Saul.
Benɛ yi ɔmɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ, a je la nɛ a he nɔ ke, “Saul gbe akpehi, se David lɛɛ e gbe akpe nyɔngmahi.” Munyu nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ Saul nya.
E mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e de ke, “A ngɔ akpe nyɔngmahi ngɔ ha David; se imi lɛɛ a ha mi akpehi pɛ.
Mɛni pa piɛ mɔ nɛ e ma na pe matsɛ yemi ɔ?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ yaa a, Saul je e hɛ ngɔ pi David.
E nɔ jena a, mumi yayami ko nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ba Saul nɔ, nɛ e bɔni munyu tumi basabasa ngɛ e we ɔ mi kaa godotsɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, David ngɛ kpa saku ɔ fiae kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ daa ligbi ɔ. Saul hɛɛ e we akplɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi, nɛ e de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Ma hɛ David akplɔ kɛ pi gbogbo ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e hɛ lɛ akplɔ ɔ si enyɔ; se David yu e he nɛ e je mi slɔkee.
Saul ye David gbeye, ejakaa Yawɛ kɛ David ngɛ; se lɛ Saul ɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ je e se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul je lɛ ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ e pee lɛ ta buli akpe a nyatsɛ.
David nyɛɛɔ ma a hɛ mi kɛ yaa kɛ baa, nɛ e yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi; ejakaa Yawɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ.
Benɛ Saul na bɔ nɛ David ngɛ nɔ yae ha a, e ye lɛ gbeye pe kekle ɔ po.
Se Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo suɔ lɛ saminya, ejakaa ma hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ.
David ngɔ Saul biyo Ligbi ko ɔ, Saul de David ke, “O nɛ, ye biyo nɔkɔtɔma Merab ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke o maa pee kã, nɛ o maa hwu Yawɛ ta amɛ ha mi ɔ, i kɛ lɛ ma ha mo.” Saul susu kaa ke e pee ja a, Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nine maa su David nɔ nɛ a maa gbe lɛ, nɛ lɛɛ e nine be e he sae.
David he nɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mi, nɛ ye tsɛ we ɔ hu mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ ngɛ Israel, nɛ́ imi nɛ ɔ i ba peeɔ matsɛ lɛɛ e ngatsɛ?” Se benɛ e su be nɛ a kɛ Saul biyo Merab ma ha David ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha Adriel, Mehola no ɔ mohu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul biyo Mikal ba suɔ David sane; benɛ Saul nu he ɔ, e na he bua jɔmi.
Saul susumi ji e kɛ e biyo Mikal ma ha David nɛ e kɛ tsɔ lɛ klama, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nine nɛ su e nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul de David si enyɔne ɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ o maa pee ye ngatsɛ.” Saul fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke a ya nɛ a kɛ David ya tu munyu ngɛ dami mi ke, “Matsɛ ɔ ngɛ o he bua jɔmi, nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo suɔ mo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hyɛ nɛ o ngɔ e biyo ɔ, konɛ o ba pee e ngatsɛ.” Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ ya sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔ ha David, nɛ David de ke, “Matsɛ e ngatsɛ peemi ɔ, e ji hɛ mi nyami agbo!
Imi ohiatsɛ nɛ i be blɔ nya ko ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kle pe mi.” Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ ya bɔ Saul nɔ́ nɛ David de ɔ. Saul fa mɛ ke a ya de David ke, “Matsɛ ɔ hla we yo se ní kpa ko pe Filisti bi a mɔmlɔtɔ lafa kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he lue.” Saul to kikɛmɛ a ga nɛ ɔ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nine nɛ su David nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Benɛ Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ ya bɔ David amaniɛ nɛ ɔ, e ngɔ David nya saminya kaa e maa pee matsɛ ɔ ngatsɛ.
Loko be nɛ a to ɔ su ɔ, David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ya gbe Filisti bi lafa enyɔ.
David ngɔ a mɔmlɔtɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho nɛ e ya kane mɛ sisiisi kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ, konɛ e na he blɔ nɛ e pee e ngatsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul kɛ e biyo Mikal ha David.
Saul ba yɔse faii kaa Yawɛ kɛ David ngɛ, nɛ e biyo Mikal ɔ hu suɔ lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ye David gbeye pe kekle ɔ po, nɛ David ba plɛ pee e he nyɛlɔ e wami ligbi tsuo.
Ke pee ɔ, Filisti ganɔ ɔmɛ ba tuaa Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Se be tsuaa be nɛ ta ko maa te si ɔ, David yeɔ kunimi pe Saul tsɔli kpa amɛ tsuo.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha David na biɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Saul wa David yi mi Saul de e binyumu Yonatan kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ kulaa ke a gbe David.
Se suɔmi babauu nɛ Yonatan ngɛ kɛ ha David he je ɔ, e ya de David ke, “Tsaatsɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ e gbe mo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ saminya hwɔɔ mɔtu.
Ya hla laami he ko nɛ o laa o he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Imi lɛɛ ma ya nɛ ma ya da tsaatsɛ kasa nya ngɛ nga a nɔ he nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, nɛ i kɛ lɛ maa tu munyu ngɛ o he; nɛ bɔ nɛ e ma ya ba ha a, ma ha nɛ o le.” Yonatan ya je David yi ha e tsɛ Saul, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ, koo pee o tsɔlɔ David yayami, ejakaa e pee we mo yayami ko.
Jehanɛ se hu, ní tsumihi nɛ e tsu ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ji dloomi agbo kɛ ha mo.
E ngɔ e wami ngɔ ke, benɛ e gbe Filisti no ɔ, nɛ Yawɛ ye kunimi nguaa kɛ ha Israel tsuo.
O na, nɛ o bua jɔ he.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o gbe David yaka gu nɛ e pee we mo yayami ko ɔ?” Saul bu Yonatan munyu ɔ tue; nɛ e kɛ Yawɛ biɛ ka kita ke e be David gbee.
Yonatan ya tsɛ David nɛ e bɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ lɛ ba Saul ngɔ, nɛ David sɔmɔ Matsɛ Saul kaa kekle ɔ.
Se ta te si ekohu, nɛ David ya nɛ e kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya hwu, nɛ e gbe mɛ basabasa; nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ je ta a nya.
Ligbi ko ɔ, mumi yayami ko nɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ ba Saul nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e hii si ngɛ e we ɔ mi, nɛ e hɛɛ akplɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi, nɛ David hu ngɛ kpa saku fiae.
Saul ka kaa e maa hɛ David akplɔ ɔ kɛ wo gbogbo ɔ he, se David yu e he nɛ akplɔ ɔ ya pi gbogbo ɔ. Nɛ David tu fo kɛ je.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Saul tsɔ nihi kɛ ho David we ɔ mi ya nɛ́ a ya huɔ lɛ, konɛ mɔtu nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Se David yo Mikal de lɛ ke, “Ke o ji hiɛ ɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi nɛ o he o yi wami ɔ, hwɔɔ ɔ, a maa gbe mo.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mikal ngɔ David kɛ gu saflɛ mi kɛ kple si; nɛ e tu fo kɛ je.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mikal ngɔ amaga ko kɛ fɔ sa a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ sɔnue nɛ a kɛ apletsi he bwɔmi pee fɔ e yi je, nɛ e ngɔ bo ha he.
Benɛ Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ ba konɛ a ba nu David kɛ ho ɔ, Mikal de mɛ ke e be he wami.
Saul de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke a kpale nɛ a ya hyɛ kaa a maa na David ɔ lo.
E fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ sa a tsuo ba ha mi nɛ ma gbe lɛ.” Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba a, a ba na amaga a ngɛ sa a nɔ nɛ sɔnue nɛ a kɛ apletsi he bwɔmi pee fɔɔ si ngɛ e yi je.
Saul bi Mikal ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o sisi mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ o ha ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ tu fo kɛ je ɔ?” Mikal he nɔ ke, “E de mi ke ke i ha we lɛ blɔ nɛ e ho ɔ, e maa gbe mi.” David kɛ Samuel ngɛ Rama David tu fo kɛ ho Samuel ngɔ ya ngɛ Rama, nɛ e ya bɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ Saul pee lɛ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
David kɛ Samuel ho Nayot ya, nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Saul nu kaa David ngɛ Nayot ngɛ Rama a, e tsɔ nihi ke a ya nu lɛ kɛ ba.
Se benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ na gbali a kuu ɔ nɛ a ngɛ doe, nɛ a ngɛ huhui kpae, nɛ Samuel hu ngɛ a kpɛti kaa a nyatsɛ ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ ba Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ mɛ hu a bɔni domi kɛ huhui kpami.
Benɛ Saul nu he ɔ, e tsɔ ni kpahi kɛ ho; se mɛ hu a do nɛ a kpa huhui ja nɔuu.
Saul kpale tsɔ nihi kɛ ho si etɛne; nɛ mɛ hu a pee ja nɔuu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul nitsɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Rama ya, nɛ benɛ e ya su vu nguaa a he ngɛ Seku ɔ, e bi ke, “Jije Samuel kɛ David ngɛ?” Nɛ nɔ ko ha lɛ heto ke, “A ngɛ Nayot ngɛ Rama.” Benɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa Nayot ngɛ Rama a, Mawu mumi ɔ ba lɛ hu e nɔ; nɛ e do nɛ e kpa huhui kɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya su Nayot.
E jé e he tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e do nɛ e kpa huhui ngɛ Samuel hɛ mi, nɛ e hɛɛ e he gu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ piani kɛ nyɔ mi tsuo.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba pee nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ tuɔ munyu “Anɛ Saul hu ba plɛ pee gbalɔ lo?”
Yonatan ye bua David Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, David tu fo kɛ je Nayot ngɛ Rama kɛ ba Yonatan ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni i pee?
Mɛni ji ye tɔmi?
Mɛni yayami i pee o tsɛ loko e ngɛ mi hlae nɛ e gbe ɔ?” Yonatan he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
O be gboe.
Hyɛ, tsaatsɛ pee we nɔ́ ko nguaa, loo bɔbɔyoo nɛ e wo we ye tue nɔ ngɛ he.
E be mi!” Se David he nɔ ke, “O tsɛ le saminya kaa o suɔ ye sane; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee e juɛmi kaa e be hae nɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ko hao mo.
Se anɔkuale, i na Yawɛ hɛ kalɔ ɔ kaa nane hiami kake pɛ lɛ ngɛ i kɛ gbenɔ wa kpɛti.” Yonatan de David ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ, de mi nɛ ma pee ha mo.” David de Yonatan ke, “Hyɛ, hwɔɔ ji Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ nɛ, nɛ jinɛ e sa kaa i kɛ matsɛ ya ye ní.
Se ha nɛ ma ya laa ye he ngɛ nga a nɔ kɛ yaa si ligbi etɛne ɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si.
Ke o tsɛ bi ye si ɔ, de lɛ ke, ‘David bi mi blɔ wawɛɛ ke e maa po e he bɔɔ kɛ ya e ma mi ngɛ Betlehem nɛ e ba; ejakaa a ngɛ jeha bɔ sãe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ha weku ɔ tsuo.’ Ke e de ke, ‘Yoo!’ ɔ, o tsɔlɔ yi ma na wami; se ke e mi mi fu ɔ, lɛɛ o na nɛ o le kaa e muɔ e yi mi kpɔ kaa e maa pee mi yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o ye somi nɛ o kɛ mi so ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ nɔ.
Se ke i yeɔ fɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mo nitsɛ moo gbe mi.
Mɛni he je o maa ngɔ mi kɛ ya ha o tsɛ?” Se Yonatan de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ ko ba o juɛmi mi kulaa!
Ke i le kaa tsaatsɛ to kaa e maa pee mo yayami ko ɔ, i ko de we mo lo?” Jehanɛ, David bi Yonatan ke, “Ke o tsɛ kɛ mo ya tu munyu basabasa a, mɛnɔ ma ba de mi?” Yonatan he nɔ ke, “Ha nɛ waa ho nga a nɔ ya.” Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya.
Yonatan de David ke, “I ngɛ mo si woe ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ biɛ mi kaa hwɔɔ, loo hwɔɔ se maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma hla juɛmi nɛ tsaatsɛ ngɛ ngɛ o he.
Ke e ngɛ o he juɛmi kpakpa a, ma tsɔ ba de mo.
Se ke tsaatsɛ to kaa e maa pee mo yayami, nɛ i wo we o tue nɔ nɛ ma wo mo blɔ nɛ ó ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi ɔ, lɛɛ Yawɛ kɛ imi, Yonatan nɛ e ye sisiisi.
Yawɛ kɛ mo nɛ e hi si kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ tsaatsɛ hi si ɔ. Ke i gbo we, nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, mo je Yawɛ suɔmi, kɛ e mɔbɔ nami ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi.
Ke i gbo ɔ, ko ha o mi mi himi ɔ se nɛ e po ngɛ ye weku li a nɔ ligbi ko ligbi ko.
Ke Yawɛ kpata o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, ko ha Yonatan biɛ nɛ e laa ngɛ David weku ɔ mi.
Ke o pee ja a, Yawɛ kɛ mo maa ye.” Yonatan ha David kpale ka lɛ kita ekohu kaa e suɔ lɛ, ejakaa lɛ, Yonatan ɔ nitsɛ e suɔ David kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Yonatan de David ke, “Hwɔɔ ji Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ nɛ.
A ma bi o si, ejakaa o sɛ ɔ maa fɔ si gu.
Hwɔɔ se lɛɛ a ma pa bi o si tsɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yaa he nɛ o ya laa o he ngɛ ligbi ɔ benɛ sane ɔ ba a, nɛ o ya laa o he ngɛ tɛhi nɛ a bua nya a a se.
Ma tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi etɛ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ye dɛ nya dami kae.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma ha nɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ ya kukuɔ mɛ kɛ ba.
Ke i de ke, ‘Hyɛ, kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ hiɛ blɔ; yaa nɛ o ya kukuɔ mɛ’ ɔ; e tsɔɔ kaa o ma nyɛ maa ba, ejakaa gbeye ko be.
I na Yawɛ, hɛ kalɔ ɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mo pee.
Se ke i de niheyo ɔ ke, ‘Hyɛ, kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi’ ɔ, lɛɛ yaa; ejakaa Yawɛ nɛ e ke o je hiɛ ɔ. Si nɛ wa wo wa sibi ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ e ha waa ye nɔ daa.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David ho ya laa e he ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ, Matsɛ Saul ba ní yemi he ɔ, nɛ e hi e sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he he nɛ e hii daa a. Yonatan hi e hɛ mi, nɛ Abner hi e kasa nya.
Se David lɛɛ e blɔ he ɔ fɔɔ si.
Saul de we nɔ́ ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ejakaa e de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Be nɛ ɔ mi matahu ko ya po lɛ, nɛ e he tsɔ we.” E nɔ jena nɛ ji ligbi nɛ nyɛɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ se ɔ, David blɔ he ɔ fɔɔ si ekohu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul bi Yonatan ke, “Mɛni he je Ishai binyumu ɔ ba yi ní hiɛ kɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ?” Yonatan he nɔ ke, “David bi mi blɔ wawɛɛ ke ma ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ya Betlehem.
E ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ha ma ya, ejakaa wa weku ɔ ngɛ bɔ sãe ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ ye nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ sɛ ba de mi ke ma ba dãã.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o suɔ mi ɔ, ha ma ya nɛ ma ya na ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.’ Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ e bɛ matsɛ ɔ okplɔɔ he ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Jehanɛ Saul mi mi fu Yonatan wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo, yo ajuama kɛ atuã tsɔlɔ mi bi!
O bu kaa i li kaa o ngɔ Ishai binyumu ɔ ngɔ pee o huɛ, nɛ o kɛ pue mo nitsɛ kɛ o nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi si!
Anɛ o li kaa ligbi abɔ nɛ David ngɛ je mi ɔ, o be matsɛ yee gblegbleegble ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ lo?
Yaa nɛ o ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ; ja e gbo!” Yonatan bi e tsɛ Saul ke, “Mɛni he je a maa gbe lɛ?
Mɛni e pee?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul fɔ e we akplɔ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ gbe Yonatan.
Nɛ Yonatan kɛ yɔse kaa e tsɛ muɔ e yi mi kpɔ kaa e maa gbe David.
Yonatan kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa te si kɛ je okplɔɔ ɔ he, nɛ e yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ we ligbi enyɔne ɔ nɔ.
David he pee lɛ mɔbɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa Saul pue e hɛ mi si.
E nɔ jena mɔtu ɔ, Yonatan ho nga a nɔ ya, konɛ e kɛ David ya kpe kaa bɔ nɛ a de to momo ɔ. E kɛ niheyo wayoo ko ho, nɛ e de niheyo ɔ ke, “Tuu fo nɛ o ya kukuɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi nɛ ma tsɛ̃ ɔ kɛ ba!” Benɛ niheyo ɔ wo fo pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Yonatan tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kake kɛ be e he.
-Benɛ niheyo ɔ ya su kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ nɛ Yonatan tsɛ̃ ɔ he ɔ, Yonatan kpa huhui kɛ tsɛ e yi se nɛ e de ke, “Pi kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ nɛ be o he nɛ ɔ!
O he nɛ sɔ!
Mlamlaamla!
Koo da si!” Niheyo ɔ ho ya ngɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ kɛ ba ha e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.
Se niheyo ɔ li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae; blɔɔ Yonatan kɛ David pɛ nɛ a le.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yonatan kɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ha niheyo ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke e ngɔ kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
Benɛ niheyo ɔ je ɔ, David te si kɛ je tɛ nɛ a bua nya a se.
E ba kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si si etɛ; nɛ e kɛ Yonatan fua a sibi, nɛ a fo ya ngɔ pue a sibi a nɔ.
Se David aywilɛho ɔ nya wa pe Yonatan nɔ́ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yonatan de David ke, “Yaa ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Kita a nɛ i kɛ mo tsuo wa ka wa he ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha nɛ i kɛ mo, kɛ o nina, kɛ imi hu ye nina wa maa ye nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, David je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Yonatan hu kpale e se kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
David tu fo kɛ je Saul he David ba Nob ngɛ osɔfo Ahimelek ngɔ.
Ahimelek kɛ he domi ba kpee David, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ mo nɔ kake too o nyɛɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko piɛ we o he ɔ?” David de osɔfo Ahimelek ke, “Matsɛ tsɔ mi, nɛ e de mi ke ma ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ le nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ e tsɔ mi ngɛ ɔ. Ye we bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ i kɛ mɛ so kaa a kɛ mi nɛ e kpe ngɛ he ko.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛni ngɛ o dɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?
Ha mi abolo enuɔ, loo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ.” Osɔfo ɔ de David ke, “I be abolo gu ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ; abolo klɔuklɔu lɛ ngɛ.
Ke o we bi ɔmɛ ya tɛ yihi a he ɔ, lɛɛ ma nyɛ ma ha nyɛ.” David de osɔfo ɔ ke, “Niinɛ, be nɛ wa ngɛ ní tsumi ko nɔ ɔ, wa tɛ yihi a he.
Nihewi ɔmɛ hyɛɛ a he nɔ saminya ke wa nyɛɛ nyɛɛmi gu po.
Anɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ ko nɔ ɔ, a be a he pee klɔuklɔu lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo ɔ ngɔ abolo klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ; ejakaa abolo kpa ko be lejɛ ɔ, pe abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a je kɛ je Yawɛ hɛ mi ligbi ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo kala a tsake ɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsi e nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
E biɛ ji Doeg; e je Edom, nɛ Saul lohwehi a hyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma ji lɛ.
David bi Ahimelek ke, “O be akplɔ, loo klaate ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ lo?
Matsɛ tsɔmi ɔ he esɔ nɛ i ngɛ yee ɔ ha nɛ i je ye klaate kɛ ta hwumi ní kpa amɛ a he.” Osɔfo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Goliat, Filisti no ɔ nɛ o gbe ngɛ Ela kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, e klaate ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ efɔd ɔ se nɛ a ha he bo.
Ke o suɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ; ejakaa klaate kpa ko be hiɛ ɔ hu.” David de ke, “Ngɔɔ lɛ ha mi; klaate ko be nɛ hi kɛ lɛ sɔ.” Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, David tu fo kɛ je Saul he kɛ ho Gat matsɛ, Akish ngɔ ya.
Akish tsɔli ɔmɛ ya de Akish ke, “Anɛ pi David, zugba a nɔ matsɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Anɛ yihi la we nɛ a do, nɛ a de ngɛ e he ke, ‘Saul gbe akpehi, se David gbe akpe nyɔngmahi lo?’ ” David susu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a he saminya, nɛ e ye Gat matsɛ, Akish gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsake e ní peepee, nɛ e buá pee e he godotsɛ ngɛ a kpɛti.
E maa ngma ní ngɛ matsɛ we agbo ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e maa la lada kɛ kpa e kpɛni he kpɔtɔɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Akish bi e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nɛ nyɛ na kaa nɔ ɔ nu godo ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ba ye ngɔ mɔ?
Anɛ godotsɛmɛ a he hia mi loko nyɛ kpaka nɔ nɛ ɔ hu kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba pee kuasiahi a ní kɛ wo ye mi mi la a?
Nɔ nɛ sa kaa e baa ye we mi ji nɛ ɔ?”
A gbe osɔfo ɔmɛ David tu fo kɛ je Gat kɛ ho Adulam tɛ puɔ ɔ mi ya.
Benɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e weku li tsuo nu e he ɔ, a bu e nɔ kɛ ya na lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ni kpa komɛ hu ba piɛ David he.
Mɛ ji nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae, nihi nɛ hɛɛ hiɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a pee mɛ nidɔ níhi, nɛ David pee a nyatsɛ.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ a yibɔ maa pee lafa eywiɛ.
David je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Mizpa ya ngɛ Moab, nɛ e ya de Moab matsɛ ɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ tsaatsɛ kɛ maa nɛ a ba hi nyɛ ngɔ kɛ yaa si ma le nɔ́ nɛ Mawu maa pee ha mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David si e fɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Moab matsɛ ɔ, nɛ a hi e ngɔ be mi nɛ e ngɛ e he lae ngɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ mi ɔ tsuo.
Gbalɔ Gad ba de David ke, “Koo hi tɛ puɔ nɛ ɔ mi; moo je hiɛ ɔ esɔ kɛ ho Yuda zugba a nɔ ya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David je kɛ ho Heret hue ɔ mi ya.
Saul ba nu kaa a ya na David kɛ nyumuhi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Saul hii si ngɛ tso nguaa ko sisi ngɛ yoku ko nɔ ngɛ Gibea.
E hɛɛ e we akplɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo daa si kɛ bɔle lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ Benyamin bi, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Pe nyɛ susu kaa Ishai binyumu ɔ ma ha nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ zugba kɛ wai ngmɔ, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ tsuo kulaa asafoatsɛmɛ ngɛ nihi akpehi kɛ lafahi a nya, loko nyɛ tsuo nyɛ so kɛ wo ye he kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Nɔ ko nɔ ko wo we ye tue nɔ kaa ye binyumu ɔ kɛ David so somi ko.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ye sane dɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e ma wo ye tue nɔ kaa imi nitsɛ ye binyumu ha nɛ ye tsɔlɔ te si wo mi, nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, e ngɛ ye he blɔ hlae nɛ e gbe mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Doeg, Edom no ɔ nɛ lɛ hu e daa si ngɛ Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ a kasa nya a, he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I na Ishai binyumu ɔ benɛ e ba Ahitub binyumu Ahimelek ngɔ ngɛ Nob.
Ahimelek bi Yawɛ ga womi ha David.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ha lɛ ní, nɛ e ngɔ Goliat, Filisti no ɔ klaate ɔ hu ngɔ ha lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Matsɛ Saul tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ osɔfo Ahimelek, Ahitub binyumu ɔ, kɛ e weku li nɛ ji osɔfohi nɛ ngɛ Nob ɔ tsuo kulaa kɛ ba.
Saul de Ahimelek ke, “Ahitub binyumu, bu tue!” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ tue bue, ye nyɔmtsɛ.” Saul bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o kɛ Ishai binyumu ɔ nyɛ so wo ye he ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ha lɛ niye ní, kɛ klaate, nɛ jehanɛ hu o bi Mawu ga womi ha lɛ ɔ?
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e te si wo mi, nɛ e ngɛ ye he blɔ hlae nɛ e gbe mi!” Ahimelek he nɔ ke, “O tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale kɛ o ngatsɛ David sɔ?
O he buli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ a buu lɛ saminya ngɛ o we ɔ mi.
Anɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ i bɔni Mawu ga womi bimi kɛ lɛ hami lo?
Dɛbi!
Nɛnɛ, koo po sane ngɔ fɔ o tsɔlɔ, loo o tsɔlɔ weku li a nɔ; ejakaa i li nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he nɔ ko kulaa.” Matsɛ ɔ de ke, “Mo Ahimelek, ja o gbo; mo, kɛ o weku li tsuo.” Nɛ matsɛ ɔ de e he buli nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a ke, “Nyɛɛ gbe Yawɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, ejakaa a kɛ David so; a le e fo tumi ɔ he nɔ́ ko, se a wo we ye tue nɔ.” Se matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we kaa a ma wo a nine nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a gbe mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ de Doeg ke, “Moo gbe mɛ!” Nɛ Doeg, Edom no ɔ gbe osɔfohi nɛ a woɔ efɔd ɔ nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ enuɔ sɔuu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Jehanɛ, Saul ha a kɛ klaate kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ngɛ Nob nɛ ji osɔfohi a ma a mi.
A gbe nyumuhi kɛ yihi, jokuɛwi kɛ bimwɔwi, nahi kɛ tejihi, kɛ tohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Abiatar tu fo Se Abiatar nɛ ji Ahimelek binyumu ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake lɛɛ a nine sui e nɔ; nɛ e tu fo kɛ ho David ngɔ ya ya bɔ lɛ amaniɛ kaa Saul gbe Yawɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ.
David de lɛ ke, “Benɛ i na Doeg, Edom no ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, i le kaa bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e ma ya de Saul.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi lɛ i kɛ gbenɔ ba o weku li ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Moo hi ye ngɔ; koo ye gbeye, ejakaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ e gbe mi ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e gbe mo hulɔ.
Ke o ngɛ ye ngɔ ɔ, o yi ma na wami.”
David he Keila ma a yi wami David nu kaa Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya tua Keila bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a ngɛ Keila bi ɔmɛ a blɛfo he nɛ a kpɔ ɔ hae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David bi Yawɛ ke, “Ma ya nɛ ma ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, yaa nɛ o ya tua mɛ nɛ o kɛ he Keila yi wami.” Se David we bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, wa ngɛ Yuda ma a mi hiɛ ɔ po wa ngɛ gbeye yee; lɛɛ ke wa ya Keila nɛ waa kɛ Filisti bi a tabo ɔmɛ ya kpe ɔ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David kpale bi Yawɛ ga womi ekohu.
Nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya tua Keila; ejakaa ma ngɔ Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Keila ya, nɛ a ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ.
A gbe Filisti bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu nitsɛ, nɛ a nuu a nahi hu kɛ je.
Bɔ nɛ David pee kɛ he Keila bi ɔmɛ a yi wami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ Ahimelek binyumu Abiatar tu fo kɛ bu David nɔ kɛ ya Keila a, e hɛɛ efɔd ɔ kɛ ho.
A ya bɔ Saul amaniɛ ke David ho Keila ya.
Nɛ Saul de ke, “Mawu je lɛ ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi pɛ; ejakaa nɛ e ná ba sɛ ma nɛ a wo nya agbo kɛ e se dade mi nɛ ɔ, e sá lɛ nitsɛ e yi.” Saul ha a bua ma a tsuo nya nɛ a gba ta.
Nɛ e fa mɛ ke a ya nɛ a ya sá David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a yi ngɔ wo ma a mi.
Benɛ David na le kaa Saul ngɛ nɔ́ yayami soe kɛ wo e he ɔ, e de osɔfo Abiatar ke, “Ngɔɔ efɔd ɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David de ke, “Yawɛ Israel Mawu lee, i nu kaa Saul ngɛ hlae nɛ e ba Keila nɛ e ba kpata ma a hɛ mi ngɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ye he.
Anɛ Keila bi ɔmɛ ma je mi kɛ wo e dɛ mi lo?
Anɛ Saul maa ba niinɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o tsɔlɔ nu ɔ lo?
Yawɛ Israel Mawu lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ha mi heto.” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, Saul maa ba.” David kpale bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ Keila bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ imi, kɛ ye we bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo Saul dɛ mi lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, a maa pee ja.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David kɛ e we bi maa pee lafa ekpa a je Keila nɔuu, nɛ a bɔni lalaalo womi kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ ngɛ bee.
Benɛ Saul nu kaa David tu fo kɛ je Keila a, e yɛ lejɛ ɔ hu.
David ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ David ya laa e he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi ngɛ yoku ko nɔ, ngɛ Zif nga a nɔ.
Daa ligbi ɔ, Saul hlaa David he blɔ; se Mawu je we lɛ ngɔ wui e dɛ mi.
David tsui po, ejakaa e na kaa Saul ma lɛ gbemi.
David ngɛ Horesh ngɛ Zif nga a nɔ.
Saul binyumu Yonatan ba e ngɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ba wo e hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ Mawu mi he wami.
E de David ke, “Koo ye gbeye, ejakaa tsaatsɛ Saul nine be o nɔ sue.
E le kaa mo lɛ o ma ba ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel, nɛ ma pee o se yelɔ.” Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ ka a he kita ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yonatan je kɛ ho we mi ya; se David lɛɛ e tlɔ Horesh.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Zif bi komɛ ya Saul ngɔ ngɛ Gibea nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, “David ba laa e he ngɛ wa zugba a nɔ ngɛ Horesh, ngɛ Hakila yo ɔ nɔ, ngɛ Yudea nga kplanaa a leneyi je.
Nɛnɛ, be tsuaa be nɛ o suɔ ɔ, ba nɛ wa je lɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi.” Saul de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ kaa nyɛ na mi mɔbɔ.
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hla mi saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ le he tutuutu nɛ e ngɛ, kɛ nɔ nɛ na lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa a de mi ke e hɛ mi tɛ̃ saminya.
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hyɛ e laami he ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nyɛɛ to a he hɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bɔ mi amaniɛ, konɛ i kɛ nyɛ waa ho.
Ke ji kaa e ngɛ huza a nɔ niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ke e hia kaa ma hla lɛ kɛ kpa Yuda zugba a tsuo nɔ po, ma pee ja.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sɛ Saul hlami, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ho Zif ya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Maon nga a nɔ ngɛ kɔ̃ ko mi, ngɛ Yudea nga kplanaa a leneyi je.
Benɛ Saul kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba ngɛ David hlae ɔ, nɔ ko ba wo David tue nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e je lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ya hi tɛ sa yoku nɛ ngɛ Maon nga a nɔ ɔ mi.
Benɛ Saul nu he ɔ, e nyɛɛ David se kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
Saul kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ yoku ɔ kasa kake, nɛ David hu kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ yoku ɔ kasa kake.
A ngɛ esɔ yee nɛ a je Saul kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, ejakaa Saul kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a ma sá David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ a nuu mɛ.
Tlukaa a, tsɔlɔ ko ba Saul ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Moo kpale kɛ ba esɔesɔ, ejakaa Filisti bi ɔmɛ ba tua ma a.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul jɔɔ David se nyɛɛmi, nɛ e ho nɛ e kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya kpe.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Mi gbami yoku.
David je lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ya hi tɛ puɔ mi ngɛ Engedi.
David ngɔ Saul wami ngɔ ke lɛ Benɛ Saul kpale kɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a se nyɛɛmi kɛ ba a, a de lɛ ke David ngɛ Engedi nga a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hla ta buli kpakpahi akpe etɛ kɛ je Israel tsuo nɛ e kɛ mɛ ho, konɛ a ya hla David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nga mi apletsihi a tɛ sa amɛ a nɔ.
Benɛ Saul su to tsu komɛ a he ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e gba ya sɛ tɛ puɔ ko mi, nɛ e ya nane nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hu laa a he ngɛ jamɛ a tɛ puɔ ɔ nɔuu mi ngɛ se blɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David we bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ de mo ke, ‘Ma je o he nyɛlɔ ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ mi nɛ o pee lɛ nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ.’ O nɛ, be ɔ su.” David pee blɛuu nɛ e ya po Saul bo ɔ nya nigii.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David he nile bɔni lɛ haomi, nɛ e de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Yawɛ kó ha ma pee ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ hla, nɛ e wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. I be lɛ awi yee; ejakaa nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla, nɛ e wo matsɛ ji lɛ.” David kɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ jɔɔ e we bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a pee Saul nɔ́ ko.
Pee se ɔ, Saul je tɛ puɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e ma e blɔ ɔ nɔ.
David hu je kpo kɛ je tɛ puɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kpa huhui kɛ tsɛ Saul yi se, nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ!” Nɛ benɛ Saul plɛ nɛ e hyɛ e se ɔ, David kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si ngɛ zugba kɛ tsɔɔ bumi.
David de Saul ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nihi ngɛ mo dee ke i ngɛ hlae ma ye mo awi, nɛ o ngɛ mɛ tue bue ɔ?
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ o na kɛ o hɛngmɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ je mo kɛ wo ye dɛ mi ngɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ ni komɛ de mi ke ma gbe mo, se i kɛ o wami ke mo, nɛ i de ke, ‘I be ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ awi yee, ejakaa Yawɛ nɛ hla lɛ kaa e ba ye matsɛ!’ Jehanɛ tsaatsɛ hyɛ, o bo ɔ nya nɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa i nyɛ po o bo ɔ nya, se i gbi mo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo kaa nɔ́ yayami, loo atuã tsɔmi ko be ye mi.
Yawɛ maa kojo i kɛ mo wa kpɛti, nɛ e maa wo mo hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ mi pee nɛ ɔ he; imi lɛɛ ye nine be o he sae.
Nimeli bu abɛ ke, ‘Nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi nɛ nɔ́ yayami jeɔ.’ Se imi lɛɛ ye nine be o he sae.
Mɛni se lɛ Israel matsɛ nyɛɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni o ngɛ fiee?
Gbe gbogboe, aloo malɛɛ?
Yawɛ maa kojo i kɛ mo wa kpɛti.
E maa hyɛ, nɛ e maa ye ye sane ɔ ha mi.
E maa wo mi nguɔ, nɛ e ma je mi kɛ je o dɛ mi.” Benɛ David tu munyu ta a, Saul bi lɛ ke, “Ye bi David, mo ji nɛ ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul wo ya, nɛ e de David ke, “O da pe mi; ejakaa benɛ i pee mo yayami ɔ, moo o pee mi kpakpa kɛ to nane mi.
Mwɔnɛ ɔ, o na mi mɔbɔ agbo; ejakaa be mi nɛ Yawɛ je mi kɛ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, o gbi mi.
Ke nɔ ko nine su e he nyɛlɔ nɔ ɔ, anɛ e ngmɛɛɔ e he nɛ e yaa slɔkee lo?
Yawɛ nɛ e gbaa mo ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ha mi mwɔnɛ ɔ he.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i le kaa bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, o ma ba ye matsɛ, nɛ a maa ngɔ Israel matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo ka mi kita ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi kaa ke i gbo ɔ, o be ye nina hɛ mi kpatae, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye biɛ, kɛ ye weku li a biɛ ko laa.” David ka Saul kita kaa bɔ nɛ Saul ngɛ hlae ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Saul je kɛ ho we mi ya; nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hu kpale a se kɛ ho tɛ puɔ ɔ mi ya.
Samuel gbenɔ Samuel ba gbo, nɛ Israel ma a tsuo ba bua a he nya nɛ a nyɛ ya ha lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se e, a ya pu lɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ngɛ Rama.
David kɛ Abigail Pee se ɔ, David pue nɔ kɛ ho Paran nga a nɔ ya.
-Nyumu ko hi si nɛ je Kaleb weku ɔ mi.
E biɛ ji Nabal, nɛ e je Maon, se e ngɛ zugba ngɛ Karmel.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, niatsɛ nguaa ji lɛ; e ngɛ jijɔ akpe etɛ, kɛ apletsi hu akpe.
E yo, Abigail ɔ he ngɛ fɛu saminya, nɛ e ngɛ juɛmi hulɔ.
Se lɛ nyumu ɔ nitsɛ lɛɛ amimitsɛ kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ be subai ji lɛ.
David nu ngɛ nga a nɔ kaa Nabal ngɛ e to ɔmɛ a he bwɔmi sãe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ nihewi nyɔngma ke a ya Nabal ngɔ ngɛ Karmel nɛ a kɛ e biɛ ya fɔ lɛ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “He manye, ye nyɛmi.
He jɔmi nɛ ba o we ɔ, kɛ o nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ.
I nu kaa o ngɛ o to ɔmɛ a he bwɔmi sãe.
I ngɛ hae nɛ o le kaa o to hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ wɔ ba hi si, nɛ wa pee we mɛ yayami ko.
Jehanɛ hu, ligbi abɔ nɛ a ye ngɛ Karmel ɔ, a nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko laa we.
Bi o nihewi ɔmɛ, nɛ a ma de mo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ nyami ligbi nɔ wa ba ngɛ he je ɔ, mo he wɔ atuu.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, mo ha o tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ o binyumu David hu eko.” David we bi ɔmɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi ɔ ya ha Nabal ngɛ David biɛ mi; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a mlɛ.
Se Nabal he nɔ nɛ e de David tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji jamɛ a David ɔ?
Nɛ mɛnɔ hu ji Ishai binyumu nɛ ɔ?
Ligbi etɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, tsɔli nɛ tsɔ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ a hɛ mi atuã ba ngɛ hiɛe tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ ye abolo, ye nyu, kɛ lohwehi nɛ i gbe ha ye to he bwɔmi sali ɔ ngɔ ha nihi nɛ i li he nɛ a je ɔ lo?” David we bi ɔmɛ kpale a se nɛ a ya gba David nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Nabal de ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ David de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fi e klaate!” Nɛ a pee ja.
David hu fi e klaate ɔ, nɛ e kɛ nyumuhi maa pee lafa eywiɛ hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a si nihi lafa enyɔ ngɛ tlomi ɔmɛ a he.
Nabal tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ya de Nabal yo, Abigail ke, “David tsɔ nihi kɛ je nga a nɔ kɛ ba ke a ba ha wa nyɔmtsɛ ɔ manye; se Nabal kuɛ wo mɛ.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wɔ hi si saminya, nɛ a pee we wɔ yayami ko.
Jehanɛ hu ligbi abɔ nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hi nga a nɔ ɔ, wa nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko laa we.
A bu wa he nyɔ kɛ pia be tsuo nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hi si nɛ wa ngɛ to ɔmɛ hyɛe ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo susu he, konɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa peemi; ejakaa sane yobu lɛ ma wa nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e weku li a nɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔmlɔ ɔ tsui wa, nɛ a wui lɛ ga.” Abigail he sɔ ya ngɔ abolo lafa enyɔ, wai lohwe he womi tɔ enyɔ, jijɔ enuɔ nɛ a sã, ngma nɛ a si kilo nyɔngma kɛ kpaago, wai yiblii nɛ gbli sau lafa, kɛ ngmɔkɔ gbigbli lafa enyɔ, nɛ e ngɔ pue tejihi a se mi.
E de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ waa ho; i ngɛ nyɛ se kɛ ma.” Se e sɛ́ e huno Nabal.
Abigail hi e teji ɔ nɔ kɛ ngɛ yo ɔ kplee nɛ e kɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ya bua tlukaa nɛ mɛ hu a ma e ngɔ blɔ.
David de e he ke, “I tsu yaka ní pɛ kaa i bu nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ níhi a he ha lɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ nɛ e nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko laa we.
Yayami mohu e kɛ to kpakpa nɛ i pee lɛ ɔ nane mi.
I na Mawu, benɛ je ke e naa a, ke nyumu kake ngmelu piɛ ngɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti fii!” Benɛ Abigail na David ɔ, e kple si kɛ je teji ɔ nɔ esɔesɔ, nɛ e ya kpla si ngɛ David hɛ mi nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si ngɛ zugba ngɛ David nane nya; nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, o kɛ tɔmi ɔ nɛ fɔ imi nɔ kake too ye nɔ.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu munyu nɛ o mawayo maa tu ɔ tue.
Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, mo ko di Nabal yaka nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ; ejakaa bɔ nɛ e biɛ ngɛ ɔ, ja nɛ lɛ nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɛ.
E biɛ Nabal ɔ sisi ji kuasia; nɛ kuasiahi a sane nɛ e yeɔ.
Se imi, o mawayo ɔ, nihewi ɔmɛ nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔ kɛ ba a, i nɛ mɛ.
Yawɛ lɛ tsi o nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ko pue muɔ si kɛ ye mo nitsɛ o he lue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na Mawu kaa o he nyɛli, kɛ nihi nɛ hlaa mo yayami ɔ, a maa gbla a tue kaa Nabal.
Jehanɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, o nɛ nike ní nɛ o mawayo kɛ ba ha mo nɛ o kɛ ha o we bi ɔmɛ.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, ke i pee mo yayami ko ɔ, kɛ pa mi.
Yawɛ maa wo mo matsɛ, nɛ e maa pee o we ɔ matsɛ we kɛ maa ya neneene; ejakaa Yawɛ tahi lɛ o ngɛ hwue ɔ nɛ; nɛ yayami ko yayami ko be o he sae kɛ yaa si o gbenɔ ligbi.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko maa te si kɛ wo mo, nɛ e ma hla kaa e gbe mo ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa bu o he kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa buu june nɛ he jua wa he ɔ.
Se o he nyɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ e ma sake mɛ ngɔ fɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ amlami tɛ ɔ. Ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ wo mo a he si ɔ, ke e na pee ha mo nɛ e wo mo ganɔ ngɛ Israel ɔ, ko pia o he, nɛ ko ha nɛ o he nile hu nɛ hao mo kaa o pue muɔ si yaka gu, aloo kaa o ye mo nitsɛ o he lue.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, ke Yawɛ gbaa mo ɔ, mo kai imi, o mawayo ɔ.” David de Abigail ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mo mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ ke o kɛ mi nɛ ba kpe ɔ, a je e yi.
I naa Mawu si kaa e ha mo juɛmi.
A maa gbaa mo kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, o tsi ye nya nɛ ma ko pue muɔ si, nɛ ma ko ye imi nitsɛ ye he lue!
Niinɛ, Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ tsi ye nya ke ma ko pee mo yayami ko.
Se i na Mawu, kaa o pee we esɔ nɛ o kɛ mi ba kpe, jinɛ hwɔɔ benɛ je ke e naa a, nɔ kake ngmelu be piɛe ha Nabal.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David he nike ní ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Koo ye gbeye; moo kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.
Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ, ma pee ha mo.” Benɛ Abigail kpale e se kɛ ba we ɔ mi ɔ, o nɛ Nabal nɛ ngmɛ okplɔɔ kaa matsɛ.
Nabal de dã kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ e bua jɔ e he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abigail bɔɛ lɛ amaniɛ ko kɛ ya si je na.
Mɔtu benɛ dã a je Nabal hɛ mi ɔ, e yo ɔ gba lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Nabal tsui kpa tsɔ, nɛ e hule pue si.
Maa pee ligbi nyɔngma se ɔ, Yawɛ fia Nabal nɔ nɛ e gbo.
Benɛ David nu kaa Nabal gbo ɔ, e de ke, “A je Yawɛ yi!
E wo Nabal hiɔ ngɛ jɛmi nɛ e jɛ mi ɔ he.
Jehanɛ hu e tsi ye nya konɛ ma ko pee yayami.
Yawɛ wo Nabal nitsɛ e yayami ɔ he hiɔ.” Pee se ɔ, David tsɔ ke a ya su Abigail ha lɛ.
David tsɔli ɔmɛ ba Abigail ngɔ ngɛ Karmel, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “David tsɔ wɔ ke wa ba kpaka mo kɛ ba nɛ o ba pee e yo.” Abigail kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu zugba nɛ e de ke, “O nɛ, imi ji ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mawayo ɔ nɛ ma fɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a nane he ɔ nɛ.” Abigail te si esɔesɔ nɛ e ya hi e teji ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e mawayi enuɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ David tsɔli ɔmɛ a se kɛ ho, nɛ e ya pee e yo.
David ngɔ Ahinoam nɛ je Yezreel ɔ hu kɛ piɛ e yo Abigail ɔ he.
David yo Mikal lɛɛ e tsɛ Saul ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha Laish binyumu Palti nɛ je Galim ɔ.
David ngɔ Saul wami ngɔ ke lɛ ekohu Zif bi ɔmɛ ba Saul ngɔ ngɛ Gibea ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ke David ba laa e he ngɛ Hakila yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yuda nga a nya.
Amlɔ ɔ, Saul ngɔ Israel ta buli kpanakpanaa akpe etɛ ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ a ho, konɛ a ya hla David ngɛ Zif nga a nɔ.
Saul kɛ e tabo ɔ ya bua a he nya ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɛ gu Hakila yoku ɔ nɔ ɔ he, ngɛ Yeshimon hanɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, David ngɛ laami tso mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Benɛ David nu kaa Saul ba lɛ hlami ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, e tsɔ slaali ngɛ laami mi nɛ e kɛ ná le kaa Saul ngɛ lejɛ ɔ niinɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David be kɛ ho he nɛ Saul ta buli ɔmɛ bua a he nya ngɛ ɔ ya.
David ya na he nɛ Saul kɛ e tatsɛ nguaa Abner, Ner bi ɔ hwɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ. Saul hwɔɔ si ngɛ ta a mi, nɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ pue si kɛ bɔle lɛ.
David bi Ahimelek, Hit no ɔ, kɛ Yoab nyɛminyumu Abishai, Zeruya binyumu ɔ ke, “Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ kɛ mi maa ya Saul ta a mi?” Abishai he nɔ ke, “I kɛ mo maa ya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David kɛ Abishai ho ta a mi ya jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya na Saul nɛ hwɔ mahe kɛ e we akplɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ gbɔ si ngɛ e yi tetle mi.
Abner kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ hwɔɔ si kɛ bɔle lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Abishai de David ke, “Mawu je o he nyɛlɔ ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ mi mwɔnɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ ma hɛ lɛ akplɔ ɔ si kake pɛ kɛ ya pi zugba, nɛ e be hiae kaa a hɛ lɛ enyɔne.” Se David de Abishai ke, “Mo ko kpata e hɛ mi; ejakaa tue gblami fɔɔ si ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pueɔ nɔ nɛ Yawɛ pɔ lɛ nu ke e ye matsɛ ɔ e muɔ si.” David ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I na Yawɛ, hɛ kalɔ ɔ kaa lɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ e maa fia Saul nɔ, loo Saul gbenɔ be maa su nɛ e ma gbo, loo e ma gbo ngɛ ta nya.
Yawɛ hiɔ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ lɛ, Yawɛ nitsɛ e wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ, ma pue e muɔ si.
Ha waa kɛ̃ akplɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ e yi tetle mi ɔ, kɛ nyu kɛ kplu ɔ, nɛ waa ho.” David kɛ̃ akplɔ ɔ, kɛ nyu kɛ kplu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Saul yi tetle mi ɔ, nɛ a je lejɛ ɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ mɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ ba, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ tsɛ̃ hulɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ hwɔ mahe; ejakaa Yawɛ ha mahe vii ko ba nɔ mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Jehanɛ, David po mi kɛ ho, nɛ e ya da yoku ɔ yi mi tsitsaa lokoo, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ Ner binyumu Abner, nɛ e de ke, “Abner!
Mo he nɔ koo!” Abner bi ke, “Mo mɛnɔ lɛ o ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ matsɛ ɔ woe ɔ?” David he nɔ ke, “Pi nyumu ji mo?
Mɛnɔ kɛ mo sɔ ngɛ Israel?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o bui o nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ɔ he?
Nɔ ko ba ta a mi piɔ, nɛ jinɛ e ko kpata o nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Nyɛ pee we nɛ hi kulaa.
I na Mawu, ja a gbe nyɛ tsuo kulaa; ejakaa nyɛ bui nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ Yawɛ pɔ lɛ nu ɔ he.
Jehanɛ, hyɛ he nɛ matsɛ ɔ akplɔ ɔ ngɛ!
Nyu kɛ kplu ɔ hu nɛ ngɛ matsɛ ɔ yi tetle mi ɔ, hyɛ he nɛ e ba je!” Saul yɔse David gbi, nɛ e bi ke, “Ye bi David, mo ji nɛ ɔ?” David he nɔ ke, “Ee, ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, imi!” David ya nɔ nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni he je o ngɛ ye se nyɛɛe kɛ mwɔɔ?
Mɛni i pee mo?
Mɛni yayami i pee?
Ye nyɔmtsɛ, moo bu nɔ́ nɛ o tsɔlɔ ma de mo nɛ ɔ tue.
Ke Yawɛ lɛ pee loko o ngɛ ye se blɔ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ e ngmɛ mi blɔ nɛ ma sã bɔ kɛ kpata lɛ.
Se ke nimli adesahi a ní tsumi ɔ, lɛɛ Yawɛ nɛ e gbiɛ mɛ; ejakaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a fie mi kɛ je Yawɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ ho ma kpa nɔ ya nɛ ma ya ja mawu kpahi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mo ko ha nɛ ma gbo nɛ ye muɔ nɛ pue si ngɛ zugba kpa nɔ kɛ je Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Mɛni he je Israel matsɛ hia ta kɛ ma mi tuami, imi nɛ i ngɛ kaa malɛɛ kɛkɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je e ngɛ mi dae kaa a daa hɔne ngɛ yoku nɔ ɔ?” Saul he nɔ ke, “I tɔ̃!
Ye bi David, moo kpale kɛ ba; i be mo nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pee hu, ejakaa o kɛ ye wami ke mi mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. I je kuasia nɛ i tɔ̃ babauu.” David he nɔ ke, “Matsɛ, o we akplɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Ha nɛ o we bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ e ba nɛ e ba ngɔ.
Yawɛ gbaa nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ da.
Yawɛ je mo kɛ wo ye dɛ mi mwɔnɛ ɔ, se mo nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ pɔ mo nu ɔ, i tɛ o he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ o wami ke mo mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ e ngɔ ye wami kɛ ke mi, nɛ e je mi kɛ je amanehlu tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ mi.” Saul de David ke, “Mawu nɛ e gbaa mo, ye bi David!
O maa ye manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Saul hu kpale e se kɛ ho we mi ya.
David ngɛ Filisti bi a kpɛti David de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Saul maa gbe mi tlukaa ligbi kake, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ sa mi peemi ji ma tu fo kɛ ho Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ya.
Saul nine mi maa je wu, nɛ e maa jɔɔ ye se nyɛɛmi ngɛ Israel huza amɛ a nɔ, nɛ ye yi ma na wami.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David kɛ e ta buli lafa ekpa amɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Maok binyumu Akish nɛ ji Gat matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.
David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ, a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ hi Akish ngɔ ngɛ Gat.
David kɛ e yi enyɔ ɔmɛ ho.
Mɛ ji Ahinoam nɛ je Yezreel ɔ, kɛ Abigail, Nabal yalɔyo ɔ nɛ je Karmel ɔ. Benɛ a ya bɔ Saul ke David tu fo kɛ ho Gat ya a, e jɔɔ e se nyɛɛmi.
David de Akish ke, “Ke o suɔ mi ɔ, lɛɛ ha nɛ a ha mi he ko ngɛ kɔpe ɔ kake mi nɛ ma hi lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e sɛ kaa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, i kɛ mo hii matsɛ ma a mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Akish ngɔ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Ziklag ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Ziklag ma a ba pee Yuda matsɛmɛ a nɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ.
David ye jeha kake kɛ hlami eywiɛ ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Ke pee ɔ, David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ maa hia ya tua nihi nɛ ngɛ Geshur, Girzi, kɛ Amalek.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji zugbatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ hi zugba a nɔ kɛ je Shur kɛ ya si Egipt kɛ je teteete.
David ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nyumu, loo yo kake po be piɛe hɛ ngmengmle.
E maa muɔ tohi, nahi, tejihi, afukpɔngɔhi, kɛ tadehi po.
Kɛkɛ e maa kpale e se kɛ ba Akish ngɔ.
Ke Akish bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔmɛ o ya tua mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ?” David ma de lɛ ke e ya tua Yuda leneyi je, aloo Yerameel bi ɔmɛ a zugba a, aloo Ken bi ɔmɛ a zugba a. Ke David ya tua ni ɔmɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e maa gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko be kɛ ya Gat nɛ e ya bɔ ni ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ puɛ ní ha.
Ligbi abɔ nɛ David ye ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, ní tsumi nɛ e tsu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Akish he David ye saminya, nɛ e deɔ ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ sume lɛ pɛsɛpɛsɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hiɛ ɔ kɛkɛ e maa hi nɛ e ma sɔmɔ mi daa.”
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ bua a tabo ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ a kɛ Israel nɛ ya hwu.
Akish de David ke, “Na nɛ o le kaa o kɛ o we bi ɔmɛ ma ba piɛ ye he kɛ hwu ta a.” David de Akish ke, “E da!
Mo nitsɛ o maa na nɔ́ nɛ o tsɔlɔ ma nyɛ tsu.” Akish de David ke, “Saminya!
Ma pee mo ye he bulɔ kɛ yaa si gbenɔ mi.” Saul ya bi ní Samuel ba gbo, nɛ Israel tsuo nyɛ ya ha lɛ nɛ a ya pu lɛ ngɛ Rama nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e ma a mi.
Nɛ Saul fie ní peeli, kɛ klamɔhi tsuo kɛ je zugba a nɔ.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ bua a he nya ngɛ Shunem, nɛ Saul hu bua Israel tsuo nya ngɛ Gilboa.
Benɛ Saul na Filisti bi ɔmɛ a tabo ɔ, e ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ya bi Yawɛ ga womi.
Se Yawɛ pui e nya mi.
E na we sɛ gbi ko kɛ gui nlami mi.
Urim kɛ Tumim de we lɛ nɔ́ ko, nɛ e nui nɔ́ ko kɛ ji gbalɔ ko gbalɔ ko nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ hla yo ko nɛ peeɔ ní ha mi nɛ ma ya e ngɔ ya bi ní.” E tsɔli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, yo ní peelɔ ko ngɛ Endor.” Endor yo ní peelɔ ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul tsake e he nɛ e wo tade kpa, nɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, e kɛ nyumuhi enyɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho yo ɔ ngɔ ya.
E de yo ɔ ke, “Moo pee ní ha mi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsɛ e biɛ ɔ, o ha nɛ nɔ ɔ susuma nɛ ba.” Se yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Tse mo nitsɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ Matsɛ Saul pee ɔ, kaa e kpata ní peeli, kɛ klamɔhi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a hɛ mi.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o ngɛ mi klama tsɔe nɛ o ha nɛ a gbe mi ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul kɛ Yawɛ biɛ ka yo ɔ kita ke, “I na Yawɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be o tue gblae ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he.” Yo ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ma tsɛ ha mo?” Nɛ Saul he nɔ ke, “Tsɛ Samuel ha mi.” Samuel kpade Benɛ yo ɔ na Samuel ɔ, e kpa bubuubui nɛ e de Saul ke, “Mɛni he je o sisi mi ɔ?
Matsɛ Saul ji mo!” Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Koo ye gbeye!
Mɛni o na?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I na kpade ko nɛ hia kɛ je zu ɔ mi kɛ ma.” Saul kpale bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ e ngɛ kɛɛ?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nɔmoyo ko ma, nɛ e wo tade klɔii.” Saul yɔse kaa Samuel lɛ e na a nɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si kɛ tsɔɔ bumi.
Samuel bi Saul ke, “Mɛni he je o hao mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ba tsɛ mi?” Saul he nɔ ke, “Ye yi fi.
Lɔ ɔ ji Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ta hwue, nɛ Mawu je ye se.
Ke i tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e he we nɔ; jehanɛ hu i nui e he kɛ gui gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ, loo nlami mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ba tsɛ mo, konɛ o tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ ma pee.” Samuel bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ba ngɛ mi tsɛe be mi nɛ Yawɛ je o se, nɛ e plɛ pee o he nyɛlɔ ɔ?
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ gu ye nɔ de mo ɔ, lɔ ɔ e pee nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ o dɛ nɛ e kɛ ha o he nɔ David.
Akɛnɛ o bui Yawɛ tue, nɛ fami nɛ e kɛ mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa fa mo ngɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ hu o yi nɔ ɔ, enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Yawɛ pee mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, Yawɛ maa ngɔ mo, kɛ Israel tsuo kɛ wo Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi; nɛ hwɔɔmɛ a je hwɔɔ ɔ, o kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ ma ba piɛ ye he.
Israel tabo ɔ hu Yawɛ maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul kuɛli nɔ zugba amlɔ; ejakaa Samuel munyu ɔmɛ wo e he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɛ akɛnɛ e yi nɔ́ ko piani kɛ nyɔ mi tsuo he je ɔ, e gbɔjɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ ba Saul ngɔ, nɛ e na kaa e tsui po, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, o mawayo bu mo tue; i ngɔ ye wami ngɔ ke, nɛ i pee nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ ha mo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ mo hu o bu o mawayo ɔ tue.
Ha ma pee nɔ́ ko ha mo nɛ o ye, konɛ o na he wami nɛ o kɛ hia blɔ.” Saul kplɛɛ we, nɛ e ke, “Dɛbi, i be ní yee.” Se e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ yo ɔ nyɛ e nɔ kɛ ya si e bu mɛ tue.
E te si ngɛ zugba, nɛ e hi sa a nɔ.
Yo ɔ ngɛ na bi ko nɛ wo zɔ ngɛ we ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee esɔ nɛ e ya gbe lɛ.
E pɔtɔ mamu nɛ e kɛ sã abolo kplolo, nɛ e ngɔ niye ní ɔ ya ma Saul kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a ye.
Nɛ a je lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ hla we David Filisti bi ɔmɛ bua a tabo ɔmɛ tsuo a nya ngɛ Afek, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu ya bua ngɛ nyu vu ko nɛ ngɛ Yezreel ɔ kasa nya.
Filisti matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ je kpo kɛ a tabo ɔmɛ ngɛ lafahi kɛ akpehi a nya.
David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hu ya piɛ Akish he ngɛ se tabo ɔ mi.
Benɛ Filisti tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na mɛ ɔ, a bi ke, “Mɛni Hebri bi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?” Akish he nɔ ke, “Israel matsɛ, Saul tsɔlɔ David ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E kɛ mi ba hi si jeha saii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛ je be mi nɛ e bɔ ko ba dumɔ mi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i nɛ yayami ko yayami ko ngɛ e he.” Se Filisti tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a mi mi fu Akish, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Ha nɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ kpale e se kɛ ya he nɛ o ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ. Waa kɛ lɛ be ta yae nɛ e ba plɛ wo wɔ ngɛ ta a mi nɛ e fia wɔ senya kɔ.
Mɛni nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ ma kpata e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɛ maa sa e hɛ mi pe nimli nɛ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ a yi koklodohi?
David ɔ, nɔ nɛ he nɛ yi ɔmɛ do, nɛ a la ke, ‘Saul gbe akpehi, se David gbe akpe nyɔngmahi’ ɔ, pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ?” Akish tsɛ David, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I na Israel Mawu, hɛ kalɔ ɔ kaa o yeɔ mi anɔkuale, nɛ jinɛ imi lɛɛ i ko suɔ kaa o kɛ mi nɛ ya ta nɛ ɔ; ejakaa kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ o ba ye ngɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, i nɛ nɔ́ yayami ko ngɛ o he.
Se matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ sume kaa o kɛ wɔ nɛ ya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo kpale kɛ ho we mi ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ́ o ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ sɛ Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.” David bi Akish ke, “Mɛni i pee?
Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ i ba bɔni mo sɔmɔmi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, mɛni o na ngɛ o tsɔlɔ ɔ he loko e sɛ kaa i yaa nɛ i kɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ɔ he nyɛli ya hwuɔ ta a?” Akish ha David heto ke, “Imi lɛɛ i le kaa nɔ́ ko be o he; o ngɛ kaa Mawu bɔfo.
Filisti tatsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ a de ke, ‘Waa kɛ lɛ be ta yae’ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David, hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, o kɛ Saul tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ o he ɔ maa te si mla; nɛ benɛ je mi ke e tsɔɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ je hiɛ ɔ.” David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ te si mɔtu mla nɛ a kpale kɛ ho Filistia ya; nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hu pue nɔ kɛ ho Yezreel ya.
David kɛ Amalek bi hwu ta Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, be nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ke a suu Ziklag ɔ, Amalek bi ɔmɛ ba ha ní ngɛ Yuda leneyi je, nɛ a tua Ziklag.
A kɛ la sã Ziklag, nɛ a nuu yi ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi tsuo.
A gbi nɔ ko nɔ ko; se mohu benɛ a yaa a, a muɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho.
Benɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ba su ma a mi ɔ, a na kaa a sã ma a, nɛ jehanɛ hu a nuu a yi ɔmɛ, a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ kɛ je.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ wo yana hluu kɛ ya si a he wami ta.
A nuu David yi enyɔ ɔmɛ hu kɛ ho.
Mɛ ji Ahinoam, Yezreel no ɔ, kɛ Abigail, Nabal nɛ je Karmel yalɔyo ɔ. David hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ; ejakaa e we bi ɔmɛ a hɛ dɔ ngɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a be ɔ a he.
Jehanɛ hu a de ke a maa fia lɛ tɛ.
Se Yawɛ, David Mawu ɔ wo lɛ he wami.
David de osɔfo Abiatar, Ahimelek binyumu ɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ efɔd ɔ kɛ ba ha mi.” Nɛ Abiatar ngɔ efɔd ɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ.
David bi Yawɛ ke, “Ma nyɛɛ ní hali ɔmɛ a se lo?
Anɛ ye nine maa su a nɔ lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, moo nyɛɛ a se; ejakaa o ma ya na mɛ, nɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, o ma kpɔ ni ɔmɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David kɛ e we bi nɛ ji nyumuhi lafa ekpa amɛ pue blɔ.
Benɛ a su Besor pa a nya a, ni komɛ tlɔ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a je a he.
David kɛ nyumuhi lafa eywiɛ tsa nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ.
Nyumuhi lafa enyɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ, pɔ tɔ mɛ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a po Besor pa a; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛɛ a tlɔ pa a se.
David we bi ɔmɛ ya na Egipt niheyo ko ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba David ngɔ.
A ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye, nɛ a ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ha lɛ ngmɔkɔ kɛ wai yiblii sau enyɔ nɛ e ye, kɛkɛ nɛ e hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ; ejakaa e yi ní, nɛ e nui nyu ligbi etɛ sɔuu.
David bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ngɔ bi ji mo?
Nɛ jije o je?” Niheyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Egipt no ji mi, se ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛɛ Amalek no ji lɛ.
Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je ye he ngɛ hiɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ ji ligbi etɛ; ejakaa i be he wami.
Wa ya tua Keret bi a zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yuda leneyi je ɔ, kɛ Kaleb bi a zugba a, nɛ wa sã Ziklag ma a.” David bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mi he nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lo?” Niheyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ke o maa wo si ngɛ Mawu biɛ mi kaa o be mi gbee, nɛ jehanɛ hu, o be mi jee kɛ wo ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ i kɛ mo maa ya.” Nɛ e kɛ David ho.
Benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ, a na ni ɔmɛ nɛ a pueɔ si babauu ngɛ zugba.
