Blɔɔ a ngɛ ní yee, a ngɛ ní nue, nɛ a ngɛ doe; ejakaa ta yibu ní nɛ a nine su nɔ ngɛ Filistia kɛ Yuda a, tsa pi fiɛmi.
E nɔ jena makɛ ɔ, David ya tua mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ hwu kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko he ji mi, kaa ja nihewi lafa eywiɛ nɛ mɛɛ a hi afukpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ tu fo pɛ.
David kpɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ ba ha kɛ ho ɔ. E nine su e yihi enyɔ ɔmɛ hu a nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko laa we.
David kpɔ e we bi ɔmɛ a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ, kɛ ta yibu ní nɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ muɔ ɔ tsuo.
Jehanɛ David muɔ to ɔmɛ, kɛ na amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E we bi ɔmɛ kpaka lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛɛ a hɛ mi be mi nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “David ta yibu ní ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ!” Ta yibu ní dlami David ba su nyumuhi lafa enyɔ ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a kɛ David nɛ ya nɛ a je a he ngɛ Besor pa a nya a nɛ.
Benɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ba su ɔ, ni ɔmɛ nya a he, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ bua jɔmi fɔ mɛ, nɛ e bi mɛ se amaniɛ.
Se amimitsɛmɛ kɛ yaka nimli nɛ nyɛɛ David se ɔ de ke, “Akɛnɛ a kɛ wɔ yɛ he je ɔ, wa be mɛ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ nɛ wa ya kpɔ ɔ eko hae.
A ba ngɔ a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ nɛ a ho.” Se David de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ha wɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee lɛ ja.
Yawɛ baa wa yi nɛ e je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba tua wɔ ɔ kɛ wo wa dɛ mi.
Mɛnɔ maa kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ de nɛ ɔ nɔ?
Bɔ nɛ ta yalɔ ko ma na a, ja nɔuu nɔ nɛ buu ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ ma na; mɛ tsuo a ma na sɔsɔɛ.” David pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ mlaa, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ yee ngɛ Israel kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Benɛ David kpale kɛ ba Ziklag ɔ, e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ ta yibu ní ɔ eko ya ha e huɛmɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nike ní nɛ wa ngɔ kɛ ba ha nyɛ nɛ ɔ ji ta yibu ní nɛ wa ngɔ kɛ je Yawɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ eko.” David kɛ ta yibu ní ɔ eko mane nihi nɛ ngɛ Betel, nihi nɛ ngɛ Rama ngɛ Yuda leneyi je ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yatir, nihi nɛ ngɛ Aroer, nihi nɛ ngɛ Sifmot, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Eshtemoa, nihi nɛ ngɛ Rakal, Yerameel bi ɔmɛ, Ken bi ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Horma, Borashan, Atak, kɛ Hebron ma amɛ a mi.
He tsuaa he nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ya kpa a, e mane nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ta yibu ní ɔ eko.
Saul kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a gbenɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hwu ta ngɛ Gilboa yo ɔ nɔ.
A gbe Israel bi ɔmɛ babauu nitsɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Saul, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ tu fo.
Se Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya na mɛ, nɛ a gbe Saul binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ, Yonatan, Abinadab, kɛ Malkishua.
Ta nɛ nyɛɛ Saul se ɔ mi wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛli ɔmɛ a nine su e nɔ, nɛ a plaa lɛ wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul de e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ ke, “Moo hia o klaate ɔ nɛ o kɛ gbe mi, nɛ́ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ko ba gbe mi nɛ a bɔ mi ahlua.” Se niheyo ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e pee ja.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul nitsɛ kɛ̃ e klaate ɔ, nɛ e kɛ gbe e he.
Benɛ Saul ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ na kaa Saul gbo ɔ, lɛ hu e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e klaate ɔ gbe e he.
Nɛ Saul kɛ e binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ, e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ, kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo gbo ligbi kake too.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yezreel kɔ̃ ɔ se je, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ nu kaa Israel ta a gbɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, Saul kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ gbo ɔ, a tu fo kɛ je a ma amɛ a mi; nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba hi lejɛ ɔmɛ.
E nɔ jena benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba ha ní ngɛ ni gbogboe ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a na Saul kɛ e binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbo fɔɔ si ngɛ Gilboa yo ɔ nɔ.
A po Saul yi, nɛ a je ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ a kɛ tsɔ nihi ke a kɛ ya kpa Filistia tsuo, nɛ a ngɔ manye munyu ɔ ya ha amaga amɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ya to yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashtarot ɔ we ɔ, nɛ a kɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ya kpla Bet Shan gbogbo ɔ he.
Benɛ Yabesh Gilead bi ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ pee Saul ɔ, nyumuhi katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛɛ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ ya Bet Shan ya je Saul gbogboe ɔ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a ní ɔmɛ kɛ je gbogbo ɔ he, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba Yabesh, nɛ a ba sã mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a muɔ wu ɔmɛ ya pu ngɛ tso nguaa ko sisi ngɛ Yabesh ma a mi, nɛ a ha hwɔ ligbi kpaago.
NYA TSƆƆMI Samuel Womi Enyɔne ɔ ji Samuel Kekleekle Womi ɔ nɔ tsami.
Womi nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ David matsɛ yemi he sane kɛ je be nɛ e ye tsɛ ha Yuda , kɛ ba si be nɛ e ye tsɛ ha ma a tsuo, nɛ ji Yuda ngɛ leneyi je, kɛ Israel ngɛ omleyi je .
Daa nɛ ɔ, David kɛ he nyɛli slɔɔtohi ngɛ ta hwue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ e da si, nɛ e mi nɛ blɛke.
He nyɛli nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ je ma a mi, nɛ ekomɛ hu je ma se.
David heɔ Mawu yeɔ saminya, nɛ e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha lɛ kulaa.
E ma mi bi ɔmɛ hu suɔ lɛ saminya.
Se be komɛ ɔ, e peeɔ basabasa; e ya dii e we akɔnɔ se, nɛ e peeɔ yayami komɛ nɛ a nya wa.
Ke David pee yayami nɛ Yawɛ gbalɔ Natan kã e hɛ mi ɔ, e jajeɔ e he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ e piaa e he.
Ke Mawu gbla e tue ɔ, e nuɔ tue gblami ɔ sisi, nɛ e de we nɔ́ ko.
David wami he sane, kɛ e ní tsumi sa Israel ma a hɛ mi saminya.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, yi nɔhi nɛ ba ngɛ e se ɔ kaiɔ lɛ.
Ke amanehlu ko ba ma a nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ hɛja hyɛɛ blɔ kaa matsɛ he ko maa ba nɛ ji “David bi”.
A hyɛɛ blɔ kaa David nina nɛ ɔ maa hi kaa David nitsɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha David ye tsɛ ha Yuda .—.
David ye tsɛ ha Israel ma a tsuo .—.
a. Kekleekle jeha amɛ .—.
b. David kɛ Batsheba .—.
d. Amanehluhi kɛ haomihi .—.
e. Nyagbe jeha amɛ .—.
David nu Saul gbenɔ he Benɛ Saul gbo, nɛ David ye Amalek bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi se ɔ, e kpale kɛ ba Ziklag, nɛ e ba ye ligbi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ligbi etɛne ɔ, nyumu ko je Saul ta a mi kɛ ba.
E hía e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e ngɔ zu ngɔ pue e yi mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
E ba David ngɔ, nɛ e kɛ bumi ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
David bi lɛ ke, “Jije o je?” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “I ku kɛ je Israel ta a mi.” David de lɛ ke, “Moo bɔ mi bɔ nɛ níhi ya nɔ ha.” Nyumu ɔ de David ke, “Wa ta buli ɔmɛ tu fo ngɛ ta a nya, nɛ a gbe a ti nihi babauu.
Saul kɛ e bi Yonatan hu gbo.” David bi niheyo ɔ nɛ ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ɔ ke, “Kɛ o pee kɛ le kaa Saul kɛ e bi Yonatan gbo kɛɛ?” Niheyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I ya je Gilboa yo ɔ nɔ tlukaa, nɛ i na Saul nɛ e buu si ngɛ e we akplɔ ɔ nɔ.
E he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a we okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ su e he haa.
Saul plɛ hyɛ e se, nɛ e na mi.
E tsɛ mi, nɛ i he nɔ ke, ‘Nɛnɛ!’ E bi mi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ ji mo?’ Nɛ i ha lɛ heto ke, ‘Amalek no ji mi.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, ‘Hɛɛ mo kɛ su ye he nɛ o gbe mi, ejakaa i ngɛ gbenɔ muɔ nya, se i na we ma gbo lolo.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i hɛ kɛ su e he nɛ i gbe lɛ; ejakaa i le sa kaa si nɛ e nɔ ɔ, e be je mi tlɔe.
I je matsɛ pɛɛ ɔ nɛ e bu ɔ, kɛ ga nɛ ngɛ e kɔni si ɔ, nɛ i hɛɛ kɛ ma mo, ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔ ngɛ e he, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo pee ja nɔuu.
A wo yana, nɛ a ye kɔmɔ, nɛ a ha hwɔ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ.
A wo yana kɛ ha Saul kɛ e bi Yonatan, kɛ Israel, Yawɛ ma a; ejakaa nimli babauu gbo ngɛ ta a mi.
David bi niheyo ɔ nɛ ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ɔ ke, “Jije o je?” E he nɔ ke, “Amalek no ko nɛ ba to nubwɔ ngɛ Israel bi ji mi.” David bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Mɛni he je o yi gbeye kaa o kɛ o nine ma kpata nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ pɔ lɛ nu ɔ hɛ mi ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ David tsɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya gbe lɛ!” Nɛ niheyo ɔ fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbe.
David de Amalek no ɔ ke, “O musu tloo mo; ejakaa mo nitsɛ o kɛ o nya ye odase ke, ‘I gbe nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.’ ” David kɔmɔ yemi la kɛ ha Saul kɛ Yonatan David la aywilɛho la nɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ ya ha Saul kɛ e bi Yonatan, nɛ e fa kaa a tsɔɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
A ngma la nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yashar Womi ɔ mi.
E la ke, “A gbe wa ta hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ pue Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Wa ta buli kpanaa amɛ gbo!
Nyɛ ko tu munyu nɛ ɔ nɛ Gat bi ba nu.
Nyɛ ko sɛɛ ngɛ Ashkelon gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ke pi ja a, Filisti yi ɔmɛ ma na bua jɔmi.
Ke pi ja a, wɔ jali a biyi ɔmɛ ma nya.
Nyɛ Gilboa yohi, bɔ́, loo hiɔmi nɛ ko nɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ; nyɛ ngmɔ ko ngmɔ ko nɛ kó ba ní.
Ejakaa lejɛ ɔ nyɛ katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pue si ngɛ; Saul tsɛ̃i ɔ fɔɔ si nɛ a pɔɛ he nu hu!
Jinɛ Yonatan kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ, duɔ ngɛ nya; jinɛ Saul klaate ɔ nya ba.
A kɛ gbe a he nyɛli kpanakuhi ngɛ ta mi kɛ be.
“Saul kɛ Yonatan a he ngɛ bua jɔmi; a suɔ mɛ saminya.
Wami mi jio, gbenɔ mi jio, a mi gba we.
A he sɔɔ pe kɔle; nɛ a he wa pe jata.
“Nyɛ Israel yihi, nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ha Saul!
Lɛ nɛ e bu nyɛ bo tsu kpakpahi, nɛ e ha nyɛ bua jɔmi.
Lɛ nɛ e kɛ sika tsu, kɛ june dla nyɛ he!
“Oo, hyɛ bɔ nɛ katsɛmɛ kpanaa amɛ gbo kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ ta mi ha!
Oo, hyɛ bɔ nɛ Yonatan gbo kɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ha!
“Ye nyɛmi Yonatan, i ngɛ mo kɔmɔ yee; o suɔ mi saminya!
Suɔmi nɛ o je kpo ngɔ ha mi ɔ, e nya wa pe yihi a suɔmi po!
“Oo, hyɛ bɔ nɛ katsɛmɛ kpanaa amɛ gbo kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ ta mi ha!
Oo, hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ fɔɔ si gu ha!”
A wo David Yuda matsɛ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, David bi Yawɛ ke, “Ma kpale kɛ ya Yuda ma amɛ eko mi lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, moo ya.” David bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Jije ma ya?” Nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Yaa Hebron.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David kɛ e yi enyɔ ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Hebron ya.
Mɛ ji Ahinoam nɛ je Yezreel ɔ, kɛ Abigail nɛ ji Karmel no, Nabal yalɔyo ɔ. Jehanɛ hu David ngɔ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, kɛ a yihi, kɛ a bimɛ kɛ ho; nɛ a ya hi Hebron ma amɛ a mi.
Pee se ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba Hebron ba pɔ David nu nɛ a wo lɛ Yuda matsɛ.
Benɛ David nu kaa Yabesh Gilead bi ɔmɛ ya pu Saul ɔ, e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ sɛ gbi ya ha mɛ ke, “Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ kaa nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kpo ngɔ ha Saul, nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ pu lɛ!
Yawɛ nɛ e na nyɛ mɔbɔ nɛ e je e mi mi himi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ!
Imi hu ma pee nyɛ kpakpa ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee nɛ ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ wlua nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee kã.
Nyɛ matsɛ Saul ɔ gbo, nɛ Yuda ma a pɔ mi nu nɛ a wo mi a nɔ matsɛ.” A wo Ishboshet Israel matsɛ Se Saul tatsɛ Abner, Ner binyumu ɔ ku Saul binyumu Ishboshet kɛ tu fo kɛ po Yordan pa a kɛ ho Mahanaim ya.
Abner ya wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ha Gilead, Asher, Yezreel, Efraim, Benyamin, kɛ Israel ma amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo.
Saul bi Ishboshet ye jeha nyingmi eywiɛ benɛ e bɔni Israel nɔ matsɛ yemi, nɛ e ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.
Se Yuda wɛtso ɔ lɛɛ a nyɛɛ David se.
Nɛ David ye matsɛ ngɛ Hebron kɛ ha Yuda wɛtso ɔ jeha kpaago kɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa.
Israel kɛ Yuda ta a Ligbi ko ɔ, Ner bi Abner, kɛ Saul bi Ishboshet tsɔli ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Mahanaim kɛ ho Gibeon ya.
Zeruya binyumu Yoab kɛ David tsɔli ɔmɛ hu hia kɛ je kpo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ya kpe ngɛ Gibeon taku ɔ nya.
Kuu kake bua a he nya ngɛ taku ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ kuu kake hu bua a he nya ngɛ taku ɔ se.
Abner de Yoab ke, “Ha nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ nɛ a te si nɛ a ka a he mi kɛ je wa hɛja.” Yoab he nɔ ke, “Yoo, i kplɛɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a te si nɛ a kane a he.
Saul bi Ishboshet, kɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ nɛ a hiɛmi ji nyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ ya da he kake, nɛ a kɛ David tsɔli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ya kpe.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nu e nyɛmi yi, nɛ e kɛ e klaate ɔ gbɔ e kasa, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ si nɛ a gbo si kake too.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ a wo Gibeon lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke, “Klaate nga nɔ” ɔ nɛ.
Asahel gbenɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a hwu ta nguaa ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɛ David kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ye Abner kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Zeruya binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mɛ ji Yoab, Abishai, kɛ Asahel.
Asahel nane nya sɔɔ kaa alɔngɔ.
Asahel kɛ hɛdɔ tu fo kɛ nyɛɛ Abner se.
Benɛ e nyɛɛ e se ɔ tsuo e gba we hiɔ nɔ, loo muɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Abner plɛ kɛ hyɛ e se nɛ e bi ke, “Asahel, mo lo?” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “Ee, imi.” Abner de lɛ ke, “Jɔɔ ye se nyɛɛmi!
Tuu fo ya na nihewi ɔmɛ, nɛ o nu a ti nɔ kake, nɛ o kpɔ e ta yibu ní ɔ ngɛ e dɛ.” Se loloolo ɔ, Asahel nyɛɛ e se.
Abner de lɛ ekohu ke, “Kpale ngɛ ye se nɛ o ko ha ma fia mo nɔ́ nɛ ma gbe.
Ke i pee ja a, kɛ ma plɛ kɛ hyɛ o nyɛmi Yoab hɛ mi kɛɛ?” Se loloolo ɔ, Asahel kplɛɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abner kɛ e we akplɔ ɔ se je ɔ gbɔ Asahel muklii mi, nɛ akplɔ ɔ nya ya hia kpo ngɛ Asahel se mi.
Asahel nɔ si nɛ e gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba su he nɛ e fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ, ba da si dii.
Jehanɛ, Yoab kɛ Abishai nyɛɛ Abner se, nɛ benɛ pu maa ho si nɔmi ya a, a ya su Ama yoku ɔ he, ngɛ Giya kasa nya, kɛ yaa Gibeon nga a nɔ.
Abner kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ nɛ je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ ya bua a he nya ekohu ngɛ yoku ko yi mi.
Abner kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yoab nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Anɛ waa ya nɔ waa hi wa he gbee kɛ mwɔɔ lo?
Anɛ o li kaa nyagbenyagbe ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi ma kpata lo?
Mɛni be o ngɛ mlɛe loko o fa o we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a jɔɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɛmimɛ a se nyɛɛmi lo?” Yoab he nɔ ke, “I na Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, jinɛ kaa o tu we munyu po ɔ, kɛ yaa si hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, ye we bi ɔmɛ ma kpa nyɛ se nyɛɛmi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoab kpa titimati nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo jɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a se nyɛɛmi; nɛ ta a se po.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Abner kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ya gu Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
A po Yordan pa a, nɛ e nɔ jena a, a nyɛɛ mɔtu ɔ tsuo kɛ ya si a su Mahanaim.
Benɛ Yoab jɔɔ Abner se nyɛɛmi ɔ, e bua e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ e na kaa David tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nimli nyɔngma kɛ nɛɛ be a kpɛti kɛ piɛ Asahel he.
Se David tsɔli ɔmɛ gbe Abner we bi ɔmɛ nɛ je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ a kpɛti nimli lafa kɛ nyingmi ekpa.
Yoab kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ngɔ Asahel nɛ a ya pu lɛ ngɛ e tsɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Betlehem.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a nyɛɛ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nɛ je ba na mɛ heii ngɛ Hebron.
Ta nɛ Saul we ɔ, kɛ David we ɔ hwu ɔ, ta a se kɛ saminya.
Be mi nɛ David he wami ngɛ nɔ puee ɔ, Saul we ɔ lɛɛ a he wami nɔ ngɛ gbɔe kulaa.
David binyumuhi A fɔ binyumuhi ha David ngɛ Hebron.
David kekleekle binyumu ji Amnon nɛ e kɛ Ahinoam, Yezreel no ɔ fɔ ɔ; enyɔne ɔ ji Kileab nɛ David kɛ Nabal nɛ je Karmel e yalɔyo Abigail fɔ ɔ; etɛne ɔ ji Absalom, Geshur matsɛ, Talmai biyo Maaka bi ɔ; eywiɛne ɔ ji Adoniya, Hagit bi ɔ; enuɔne ɔ ji Shefatia, Abital bi ɔ; ekpane ɔ ji Itream, nɛ ji David yo Egla bi ɔ.
A fɔ bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha David ngɛ Hebron.
Abner ba piɛ David he Benɛ Saul we ɔ, kɛ David we ɔ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ, Abner ba na blɔ nya ngɛ Saul we ɔ. Saul ngɛ plã ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rizpa, nɛ ji Aya biyo.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Saul bi Ishboshet ya bi Abner ke, “Mɛni he je o kɛ tsaatsɛ plã a ya na bɔmi ɔ?” Abner muklii mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ nɛ Ishboshet bi lɛ ɔ he, nɛ e de ke, “Anɛ e peeɔ mo kaa kuasia ji mi lo?
Hyɛ, i kɛ o tsɛ, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi si saminya.
I je we mo kɛ wui David dɛ mi.
Mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, moo o ngɛ sane poe kɛ ngɛ ye nɔ fɔe ke i kɛ nɔ ko yo ya na bɔmi!
- Yawɛ wo David si kaa e ma kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ Saul kɛ e weku kɛ nina a dɛ, nɛ e maa to David matsɛ sɛ ɔ si, konɛ e ye Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo a nɔ kɛ maa je Dan kɛ yaa si Beersheba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i ha we nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba mi ɔ, lɛɛ Mawu nɛ fia mi nɔ́ nɛ e gbe!” Ishboshet nyɛ we nɛ e de Abner nɔ kpa ko hu; ejakaa e ye lɛ gbeye.
Abner tsɔ kɛ ya Hebron he nɛ David ngɛ ɔ ke a ya bi lɛ ke, “Zugba a, mɛnɔ lɛ yeɔ nɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Mo ha nɛ waa so somi ko, nɛ ma piɛ o he kɛ gbla Israel tsuo kɛ ba o ngɔ.” Heto nɛ David ha kɛ mane ji, “Saminya!
I kɛ mo maa so somi nɛ ɔ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae nɛ o pee ha mi ji kaa ke o ma a, o kpaka Saul biyo Mikal ba ha mi.
Ke pi ja a, lɛɛ i hla we nɛ ma na o hɛ mi.” David tsɔ ke a ya de Saul bi Ishboshet hu ke, “Moo kpale ye yo Mikal ɔ ba ha mi; Filisti bi a mɔmlɔtɔ lafa kake nɛ i kɛ pee e he ní.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Ishboshet tsɔ ya kpaka yo ɔ kɛ je e huno Paltiel, Laish bi ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba.
Paltiel fo ya kɛ nyɛɛ yo ɔ se hluu kɛ ya su Bahurim tɔɔ.
Se Abner de lɛ ke, “Kpale o se esɔesɔ!” Nɛ e kpale e se.
Abner tsɛ Israel nimeli ɔmɛ kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Be saii ji nɛ ɔ, jinɛ nyɛ ngɛ David se blɔ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ wo lɛ matsɛ.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su; nyɛ tsu he ní.
Nyɛ kai kaa Yawɛ wo David si ke, ‘Ma gu ye tsɔlɔ David nine nɔ kɛ kpɔ ye ma, Israel kɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a dɛ mi.’ ” Abner kɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔ hu ya na ní sɛɛmi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ya Hebron nɛ e ya bɔ David nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Israel kɛ Benyamin we ɔ wo si ke a maa pee ɔ. Benɛ Abner ba David ngɔ ngɛ Hebron ɔ, nyumuhi nyingmi enyɔ piɛ e he kɛ ba; nɛ David tsɛ mɛ ní yemi.
Abner de David ke, “Jehanɛ, i yaa nɛ ma ya bua Israel ma a tsuo nya kɛ ba mo, ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ o ngɔ.
A maa kplɛɛ nɛ o ye a nɔ matsɛ; kɛkɛ o nine maa su nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ nɔ, nɛ o maa ye zugba a tsuo nɔ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, David wo Abner blɔ; nɛ e ho ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
A gbe Abner E kɛ we nɛ Yoab kɛ David tsɔli kpa komɛ ba lejɛ ɔ.
A ya tua ni komɛ nɛ a kpɔ a níhi babauu kɛ ba.
Se a ba na we Abner ngɛ David ngɔ ngɛ Hebron, ejakaa David wo lɛ blɔ momo, nɛ e je ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Yoab kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a lejɛ ɔ sumi pɛ nɛ a bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ke Ner binyumu Abner ba Matsɛ David ngɔ, nɛ David wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ho ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yoab ya nɛ e ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni o pee nɛ ɔ?
Hyɛ kaa Abner ba o ngɔ!
Mɛni he je o ngmɛɛ e he nɛ e ho ɔ?
Ná nɛ o le kaa Ner bi Abner ɔ, sisimi e ba sisi mo nɛ e kɛ le o yami kɛ bami, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee.” Benɛ Yoab je David ngɔ ɔ, e tsɔ nihi kɛ nyɛɛ Abner se.
Ni ɔmɛ ya ná lɛ ngɛ Sira nyu vu ɔ he, nɛ a kpale lɛ kɛ ba.
Se David li he nɔ́ ko.
Benɛ Abner kpale kɛ ba Hebron ɔ, Yoab nu e nine si nɛ e kɛ lɛ ho ma a agbo ɔ nya ya kaa nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ lɛ yaa dami.
Yoab gbɔ Abner muklii mi nɔ́ nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ e nyɛmi Asahel muɔ nɛ Abner pue si ɔ he.
Pee se benɛ David ba nu sane ɔ he ɔ, e de ke, “Yawɛ le kaa Ner bi Abner muɔ si nɛ a pue nɛ ɔ he musu ko musu ko tloo we i kɛ ye nɔ yemi sisi bi ɔmɛ.
Musu ɔ nɛ tloo Yoab kɛ e tsɛ we ɔ tsuo.
Se tso mi hiɔtsɛ, loo nɔ ko nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ e he, loo nyumu nɛ peeɔ e ní kaa yo, loo nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ ta mi, loo hwɔ yeyeetsɛ kó ta Yoab kɛ e nina a we mi gblegbleegble.” Yoab kɛ e nyɛminyumu Abishai gbe Abner, ejakaa lɛ hu e gbe a nyɛminyumu Asahel ngɛ Gibeon ta a mi.
A pu Abner David fa Yoab kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ bu kpekpe ya bo kɛ nyɛ ya, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana ha Abner.” Matsɛ David nitsɛ nyɛɛ gbogboe ɔ se.
Benɛ a ya pu Abner ngɛ Hebron ɔ, matsɛ ɔ fo ya yuuyuuyuu ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ he; nɛ ma a tsuo wo yana kɛ piɛ e he.
Matsɛ David la aywilɛho la nɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ ya ha Abner: “Anɛ e sa kaa o gbo kaa kuasia gboɔ lo?
O nine ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsa fi we mɛ; o nane ɔmɛ hu, a wui mɛ pã.
Bɔ nɛ dikali taneɔ nɔ yi ɔ, ja pɛ a gbe mo nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Ma a tsuo wo yana ha Abner ekohu.
Ma a nyɛ David nɔ ligbi ɔ tsuo ke e ye nɔ́ ko.
Se David ka kita nɛ e de ke, “Ke i wo ye nya mi nɔ́ ko loko pu nɔ si ɔ, Mawu nɛ fia mi nɔ́ nɛ e gbe!” Ma a yɔse nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e sa a hɛ mi.
Niinɛ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ɔ pee ɔ sa ma a hɛ mi saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David we bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel tsuo na le jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kaa David li Ner bi Abner gbenɔ ɔ he nɔ́ ko.
Jehanɛ, matsɛ ɔ de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa ganɔ kɛ nɔmlɔ nguaa ko nɔ ngɛ Israel mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Imi lɛɛ a pɔ mi nu nɛ a wo mi matsɛ mohu, se mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i pee kaa nɔ nɛ be he wami.
Kikɛmɛ a Zeruya binyumu nɛ ɔmɛ a sane wa pe mi.
Yawɛ nɛ wo yayami peelɔ ɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa lɛ!”
A gbe Ishboshet Benɛ Saul bi Ishboshet nu kaa a gbe Abner ngɛ Hebron ɔ, e nine mi je wu; nɛ Israel tsuo dɛ yaa.
Ishboshet ngɛ asafoatsɛmɛ enyɔ; nɔ kake biɛ ji Baana, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Rekab.
Beerot no Rimon nɛ je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ bimɛ ji mɛ.
Saul bi Yonatan ngɛ bi akpaketsɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mefiboshet.
Benɛ Saul kɛ Yonatan gbenɔ sane ɔ pɛ ngɛ Yezreel ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, Mefiboshet ye jeha enuɔ.
A tsɔɔ kaa benɛ sane ɔ ba a, bimɛanyɛ nɛ ngɛ e nɔ hyɛe ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ tu fo.
Se nɛ e ngɛ esɔ yee ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ je e dɛ nɔ si nɛ e hule.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Beerot no Rimon bimɛ Rekab kɛ Baana ya Ishboshet we ɔ mi piani katakata benɛ Ishboshet kpasa si bɔɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, yo agbo nya bulɔ ɔ ngɛ ngma mi sae; se lɛ hu mahe ba wo lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Rekab kɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔ pee blɛuu nɛ a sɛ we ɔ mi.
Benɛ a sɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, a na Ishboshet nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ sa nɔ ngɛ e se tsu ɔ mi.
Nɛ a fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ a gbe ngɔ wo sa mi.
A po e yi nɛ a kɛ yi ɔ nyɛɛ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ ya gu Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
A kɛ Ishboshet yi ɔ ba ha Matsɛ David ngɛ Hebron, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “O he nyɛlɔ Saul nɛ hla kaa e ma kpata o hɛ mi ɔ, e bi Ishboshet yi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ wa nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ye lue ngɛ Saul kɛ e nina a nɔ.” Se David ha mɛ heto ke, “I na Yawɛ, hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ he ye yi wami kɛ je amanehluhi tsuo a mi ɔ!
Benɛ nɔ ko ba bɔ mi amaniɛ ngɛ Ziklag ke Saul gbo, nɛ e pee lɛ kaa manye munyu nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ba a, i nu lɛ nɛ i gbe lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ ji sina nɛ e na kɛ je ye dɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ nɛ e kɛ ba a he.
Lɛɛ ke nyɛ dikali nyɛ ya gbe nɔ ko nɛ pee we yayami ko kɛ wo sa mi ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we mi ɔ, anɛ e sɛ kaa i yeɔ e gbenɔ ɔ he lue, nɛ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ je zugba a nɔ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ David fa e we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe Rekab kɛ Baana; a poo a ninehi kɛ a nanehi, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ kpla si ngɛ Hebron taku ɔ kasa nya.
Se Ishboshet yi ɔ lɛɛ a ya pu ngɛ Abner yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Hebron.
David ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo Jehanɛ, Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo ba David ngɔ ngɛ Hebron nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, wa nyɛmi tutuutu ji mo.
Be ko nɛ be benɛ Saul ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ wa nɔ po ɔ, mo lɛ o nyɛɛɔ Israel hɛ mi kɛ yaa kɛ baa.
Yawɛ wo mo si kaa mo lɛ o ma ba nyɛɛ e ma Israel ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ o maa ye ganɔ ha mɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba Matsɛ David ngɔ ngɛ Hebron, nɛ e kɛ mɛ so somi ko ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
A pɔ David nu nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ Israel.
David ye jeha nyingmi etɛ benɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi, nɛ e ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
E hi Hebron kɛ ye Yuda nɔ matsɛ jeha kpaago kɛ fa; nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo a nɔ matsɛ jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ etɛ.
David pee Yerusalem e matsɛ ma Matsɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ho ya tua Yerusalem.
Yebus bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji zugba a nɔ bi ɔ, de David ke, “O be nyɛe maa ba hiɛ ɔ; hɛ yuyuili kɛ akpaketsɛmɛ po maa fie mo kɛ je hiɛ ɔ.” Blɔɔ a susumi ji David be nyɛe nɛ e ya lejɛ ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ David ya ngɔ Zion mɔ nguaa a nɛ ba plɛ pee David ma a. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, David de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa suɔ nɛ e gbe Yebus bi ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ e su nyu dɔ ɔ he, nɛ e ya tua jamɛ a akpaketsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ li bɔ nɛ i sume mɛ ha po!” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a deɔ ke, “E sɛ kaa hɛ yuyuili kɛ akpaketsɛmɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ” nɛ.
David hi mɔ nguaa a mi, nɛ e wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke “David ma.” David po ma kɛ bɔle si; e to ma a sisi kɛ je he nɛ a tloo zu ngɔ pue ɔ, kɛ ba mi blɔ.
David ya nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; ejakaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ lɛ ngɛ.
Tiro matsɛ, Hiram wo tsɔli blɔ kɛ ba David ngɔ.
A kɛ seda tsohi ba.
Kapitɛhi, kɛ tɛ tsu fiali hu piɛ a he; nɛ a ba po we ha David.
David yɔse kaa Yawɛ to lɛ si kaa Israel matsɛ, nɛ e ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ ya nɔ ngɛ e ma Israel ɔ he.
Benɛ David hia kɛ je Hebron kɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ, e ba ngɔ yihi babauu, nɛ e su plahi fuu; nɛ a fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyihi ha David kɛ piɛ kekle ni ɔmɛ a he.
Bimɛ nɛ e ba fɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ji Shamua, Shobab, Natan, Salomo, Ibhar, Elishua, Nefeg, Yafia, Elishama, Elyada, kɛ Elifelet.
A ye Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nɔ Benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ nu kaa a pɔ David nu nɛ a wo lɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ba nɛ a ba hla lɛ nɛ a nu lɛ.
Se David nu he nɛ e ya sɛ e mɔ nguaa a mi.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba gba wo Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
David bi Yawɛ ke, “Ma ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ lo?
O ma je mɛ kɛ wo ye dɛ mi lo?” Yawɛ ha David heto ke, “Ee, moo ya!
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ma je Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi.” David pue nɔ kɛ ho Baal Perazim ya nɛ e ya ye Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ gba blɔ kɛ gblee ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a mi ngɛ ye hɛ mi kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala kɛ bee.” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Baal Perazim ɔ nɛ.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ je a wɔ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ba muɔ kɛ ho.
Se Filisti bi ɔmɛ kpale a se nɛ a ya pue si ngɛ Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ mi ekohu.
Benɛ David ya bi Yawɛ ga womi ekohu ɔ, Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, ko tua mɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ; yaa lɔgɔ kɛ gu a se je, nɛ o ya tua mɛ ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke o nu nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a yi mi kaa tabohi a nyɛɛmi ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ; ejakaa Yawɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi kɛ yaa nɛ e ya gbe Filisti ta buli ɔmɛ.” David pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ; nɛ e kpata Filisti bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ je Geba kɛ ya si Gezer tɔɔ.
David ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a kɛ ba Yerusalem David bua Israel ta buli kpakpa amɛ tsuo a nya ekohu; a hiɛmi ji akpe nyingmi etɛ.
E kɛ mɛ tsuo ho Baala ya ngɛ Yuda, konɛ a ya ngɔ Mawu somi daka a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba.
Somi daka nɛ ɔ, a kɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ biɛ tsɛɔ lɛ.
A ya ngɔ somi daka a ngɛ Abinadab we ɔ mi ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ ma tlɔɔke he mi.
Abinadab binyumuhi Uza, kɛ Ahio ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ nɛ Mawu daka a ngɛ mi ɔ blɔ tsɔɔe; nɛ Ahio nyɛɛ daka a hɛ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, David kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ lae nɛ a ngɛ doe kɛ a he wami tsuo kɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami woe.
A fiɛ do, nɛ a fia kpa saku slɔɔtohi, kɛ ngmlɛhi, kɛ gɔgɔhi.
Benɛ a su Nakon ngma gbeemi he ɔ, na amɛ nɛ ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ gblae ɔ a nanehi tɛ si, nɛ daka a mimiɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Uza nu daka a ngɔ da si.
Se Yawɛ Mawu mi mi fu Uza, nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e nine ta daka a he.
E dɔ David kaa Yawɛ ngɔ abofu kɛ gbla Uza tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Perez Uza, nɛ jã a tsɛɛ lɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. David ye Yawɛ gbeye jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɛ e bi ke, “Lɛɛ kɛ ma pee kɛ ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ya we mi kɛɛ?” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, David to e yi mi kaa e kɛ Yawɛ daka a be Yerusalem yae hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e gba kɛ je blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ daka a ho Obed Edom nɛ je Gat ɔ we mi ya.
Yawɛ daka a hi Obed Edom we ɔ mi nyɔhiɔ etɛ; nɛ Yawɛ gbaa Obed Edom, kɛ e we ɔ tsuo.
Benɛ Matsɛ David nu kaa Mawu daka a he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbaa Obed Edom kɛ e we ɔ, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, David ho nɛ e ya ngɔ Mawu daka a ngɛ Obed Edom we ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ daka a ba Yerusalem kɛ nyami.
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ Yawɛ daka a hia nane ekpa a, David ha nɛ a wa, nɛ e gbe na kɛ to nɛ wo zɔ nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.
David wo kploba efɔd, nɛ e do kɛ e he wami tsuo kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
David kɛ Israel tsuo ngɔ Yawɛ daka a kɛ ba kɛ lele hwɔmi kɛ koli kpami.
Benɛ daka a ba su David ma a mi ɔ, Mikal, Saul biyo ɔ je e hɛ mi kpo ngɛ saflɛ mi nɛ e na Matsɛ David nɛ e ngɛ tuue nɛ e ngɛ doe kɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami woe; nɛ David he pee lɛ tai.
A ngɔ Yawɛ daka a ya ma e ma he ngɛ bo tsu nɛ David pee kɛ ha lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ David sã sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Benɛ David sã bɔ ɔmɛ gbe nya a, e gbaa ma a ngɛ Yawɛ Ope ɔ biɛ mi.
David dla niye ní ha Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ná abolo bɔbɔɛ kake, kɛ lo nɛ a sã kpɔ kake, kɛ wai yiblii gbigbli nɛ a kɛ si tatale.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a je kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya.
Benɛ David ba su we mi, nɛ e ba fɔ e yi ɔmɛ, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Saul biyo Mikal je kpo ba kpee lɛ; nɛ e de David ke, “Lɔ ɔ ji Israel matsɛ wo lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi nyami mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ!
Matsɛ hɛɛ e he gu ngɛ e tsɔli a mawayi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kaa kuasia peeɔ nɔ!” David he nɔ ke, “I do kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Lɛ nɛ e hla mi ngɛ o tsɛ kɛ e weku kɛ nina nane mi, nɛ e wo mi ganɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a. Ee, ma do kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami daa, nɛ ye hɛ mi ma pue si pe kikɛ nɛ ɔ po.
E maa pee mo kaa pi nɔ ko ji mi; se mawayi ɔmɛ nɛ o tu a he munyu ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu mi saminya.” Saul biyo Mikal fɔ we kɛ ya si e gbenɔ ligbi.
Natan kɛ sɛ gbi ba ha David Benɛ Matsɛ David ba ngɛ e we ɔ mi, nɛ Yawɛ ha he jɔmi ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ David kɛ e he nyɛli nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ jɔɔ ta hwumi ɔ, David de gbalɔ Natan ke, “Hyɛ kaa imi lɛɛ i ngɛ we nɛ a ma kɛ seda mi, be mi nɛ Mawu somi daka a lɛɛ bo tsu mi lɛ e ngɛ!” Natan de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o to kaa o maa pee ɔ, moo pee; ejakaa Yawɛ kɛ mo ngɛ.” Se jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ de Natan ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya de ye tsɔlɔ David ke Yawɛ ke, ‘Pi mo nɛ o maa po we ha mi nɛ ma hi mi.
Kɛ je ligbi nɛ i ya kpɔ Israel ma a kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i hí we ko mi hyɛ; bo tsu ji we nɛ i hii mi.
Ngɛ hehi tsuo nɛ i kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya gu ɔ, Israel hɛ mi nyɛɛli nɛ i hia ke a hɛɛ ye ma Israel kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ hyɛɛ e tohi ɔ, anɛ i bi a ti nɔ ko hyɛ ke mɛni he je e kɛ seda ma we tsu ha mi lo?’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo de ye tsɔlɔ David ke, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ lɛ dee ke, ‘Imi nɛ i ya ngɔ mo kɛ je lohwe lɛmi he, kɛ je tohi a se, konɛ o ba ye ganɔ ngɛ ye ma, Israel nɔ.
Imi lɛ i kɛ mo nyɛɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba; nɛ imi nɔuu lɛ i kpata o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ o blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Ma ha nɛ o ma na biɛ kaa nimli nguahi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a ti nɔ ko.
-I hla hi he ko ha ye ma Israel, nɛ i to mɛ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, he nɛ nɔ ko be a nya dooe ngɛ hu.
Kɛ je benɛ a ba zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, be nɛ manyadali lɛ ngɛ a nɔ yee ɔ, nɔ́ sɔuu nɛ ye ma a ngɛ nae ngɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi.
Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se maa po.
I ngɛ si woe kaa ma ha o maa ye o he kɛ je o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a dɛ mi; nɛ o bimɛ ma ba ye zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ke o gbo, nɛ a ya dla mo ngɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hwɔ he ɔ, ma tle nɔ ko si ngɛ o se, nɛ ji mo nitsɛ o mi mi bi; nɛ ma to e matsɛ yemi ɔ sisi.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma ba po we kɛ wo ye biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami; nɛ ma ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ma pee e tsɛ, nɛ e maa pee ye bi.
Ke e pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ, ma gbla e tue kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ gblaa e bi tue ɔ.
Se ye suɔmi kɛ mɔbɔ nami ɔ lɛɛ i be jee ngɛ e nɔ gblegbleegble.
I be lɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Saul, nɔ nɛ i je kɛ je o blɔ mi nɛ o ba ye matsɛ ɔ. O nina maa hiɛ, nɛ ma ha o matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene; o matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.’ ” Natan ya bɔ David nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu je ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ. David sina sɔlemi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ David ya sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, mɛnɔ ji mi, nɛ ye we ɔ hu mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ loko o hɛɛ mi kɛ ba su he nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ?
Se Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, enɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ji nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi.
O wo si hu kaa o tsɔlɔ ɔ nina maa hiɛ babauu hwɔɔ se.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, o je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔmlɔ adesa!
Lɛɛ mɛni pa ngɛ imi David, ye nya nɛ ma de mo?
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, o le imi o tsɔlɔ ɔ saminya!
O ngɛ ní nguangua nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pee nɛ ma kɛ le kaa o wo si ko, nɛ o suɔ kaa o maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Yawɛ Mawu lee, o kle agbo!
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ngɛ kaa mo; níhi nɛ wa nu ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mo pɛ ji Mawu.
Ma kpa ko be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ pe o ma Israel nɛ mo Mawu o ya kpɔ kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi kɛ ba pee mo nitsɛ o ma a. Ní nguangua, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu ha o ma a, ha o biɛ pɛ kɛ kpe je ɔ mi tsuo.
Benɛ o ma a nɛ o kpɔ kɛ je Egipt ɔ hia kɛ ma a, o fie je ma kpa amɛ, kɛ a mawu ɔmɛ kɛ je a blɔ mi.
O to o ma Israel sisi, nɛ o ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee mo nitsɛ o ma kɛ yaa neneene.
Nɛ mo, Yawɛ o ba pee a Mawu.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ Mawu, si nɛ o wo nɛ kɔɔ o tsɔlɔ, kɛ e nina a he ɔ, moo ye nɔ daa, nɛ o pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ. O biɛ maa jije kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ nihi ma de ke, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ji Israel Mawu.
Nɛ o ma ha imi, o tsɔlɔ David, ye matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Israel Mawu!
O je tsɔɔ o tsɔlɔ ɔ kaa e matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble; lɔ ɔ he nɛ o tsɔlɔ ɔ nɔ gbagba te, nɛ e ngɛ kue nɛ ɔ fae ha mo ɔ nɛ.
“Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, mo ji Mawu, nɛ o yeɔ o siwohi a nɔ daa.
Mo ji nɔ nɛ wo mi si kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ya nɔ nɛ o gbaa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ye nina daa.
Mo Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ o wo si; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o gbaami maa hi imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ye nina nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.”
David ye kunimi ngɛ ta mi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, David ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ ekohu, nɛ e ye a nɔ.
E ngɔ a ma nguaa pe kulaa nɛ a tsɛɛ Gat ɔ. E ya tua Moab bi ɔmɛ hulɔ nɛ e ye a nɔ.
E ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ hwɔ si ngɛ zugba, nɛ e gba a mi etɛɛtɛ.
Ni etɛ tsuaa ni etɛ mi ɔ, e gbe ni enyɔ, nɛ e kɛ nɔ kake he ke lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Moab bi ɔmɛ ba pee David sɔmɔli, nɛ a tsuɔ tó kɛ haa lɛ.
Jehanɛ se, David ya ye Rehob binyumu Hadadezer, nɛ ji Zoba matsɛ ɔ nɔ kunimi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Hadadezer ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa, konɛ e ya kpɔ e zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a he ɔ ekohu.
David nuu Hadadezer okpɔngɔ ta buli akpe kɛ e nya lafa kpaago, kɛ ta buli nɛ nyɛɛɔ nane akpe nyingmi enyɔ.
David poo okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nane se pani, nɛ e si ta zugba lɛ lafa nya okpɔngɔhi pɛ.
Benɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ ya konɛ a ya je ngmlaa ha Zoba matsɛ, Hadadezer ɔ, David gbe a kpɛti nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
David to tabohi a hi hehi ngɛ Damasko; nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ ba plɛ pee David sɔmɔli, nɛ a tsuɔ tó kɛ haa lɛ.
Yawɛ ha nɛ David ye kunimi ngɛ he tsuaa he.
David kpɔ sika tsu tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ nɛ Hadadezer tsɔli ɔmɛ hɛɛ ɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ e kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Jehanɛ hu, David ya muɔ akɔblee babauu nitsɛ ngɛ Beta kɛ Berotai nɛ ji mahi nɛ matsɛ Hadadezer yeɔ a nɔ ɔ. Benɛ Hamat matsɛ, Toi nu kaa David ye Hadadezer tabo ɔ tsuo nɔ ɔ, e tsɔ e binyumu Yoram ya nga David, nɛ e ha lɛ ayekoo kaa e kɛ Hadadezer hwu ta nɛ e ye e nɔ kunimi; ejakaa lɛ Toi ɔ nitsɛ e kɛ Hadadezer hwu ta hluu.
Yoram hɛɛ sika hiɔ, sika tsu, kɛ akɔblee nike níhi kɛ ho.
Matsɛ David gbaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ kɛ piɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu nɛ e kpɔ ngɛ je ma amɛ nɛ e ye a nɔ ɔ a dɛ ɔ he.
Ma amɛ ji Edom, Moab, Amon, Filistia, kɛ Amalek.
Ta yibu ní nɛ e kpɔ ngɛ matsɛ Hadadezer dɛ ɔ hu e gbaa nɔ.
David gbe Edom bi akpe nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ngɛ Ngo kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Nɛ benɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba a, e biɛ pɛ pe kekle ɔ po.
David to tabohi a hi hehi ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ tsuo; nɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ ba plɛ pee e sɔmɔli.
Yawɛ ha David ye kunimi ngɛ he tsuaa he.
David ye Israel ma a tsuo nɔ matsɛ; e ye dami sane kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Yoab, nɛ e nyɛ biɛ ji Zeruya a, ji tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma; Ahilud binyumu Yehoshafat ji sanehi ngmalɔ; Ahitub binyumu Zadok, kɛ Abiatar binyumu Ahimelek ji osɔfohi; nɛ Seraya ji David nitsɛ e pɛdiyo.
Yehoyada binyumu Benaya ji Keret kɛ Pelet bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Keret kɛ Pelet bi ɔmɛ ji David we bi a tabo.
David binyumu ɔmɛ ji osɔfohi.
David kɛ Mefiboshet Ligbi ko ɔ, David bi si ke, “Anɛ Saul nina ko piɛ lo?
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma na lɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ Yonatan he.” Tsɔlɔ ko ngɛ Saul we ɔ mi nɛ e biɛ ji Ziba; nɛ a tsɛ lɛ kɛ ba David hɛ mi.
Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Ziba a lo?” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “Ee imi, ye nyɔmtsɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Anɛ Saul nina ko be, nɛ ma na lɛ mɔbɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i wo Mawu si ɔ lo?” Ziba de matsɛ ɔ ke, “E piɛ Yonatan binyumu kake; se lɛɛ akpaketsɛ ji lɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Jije e ngɛ?” Ziba he nɔ ke, “E ngɛ Amiel binyumu Makir we ɔ mi ngɛ Lodebar ma a mi.” Matsɛ David tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba.
Benɛ Saul bibi Mefiboshet, nɛ ji Yonatan bi ɔ ba David ngɔ ɔ, e kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si kɛ tsɔɔ bumi.
David tsɛ e biɛ ke, “Mefiboshet!” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ.” David ya nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Koo ye gbeye; ejakaa o tsɛ Yonatan he ɔ, ma na mo mɔbɔ.
Ma kpale o nɛ̃, Saul zugba amɛ tsuo kɛ ha mo, nɛ ye okplɔɔ he o maa ye ní ngɛ daa.” Mefiboshet kpla si ngɛ David hɛ mi ekohu, nɛ e de ke, “Mɛnɔ po ji mi nɛ o naa mi mɔbɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Imi, o tsɔlɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa gbe gbogboe ɔ!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɛ Saul tsɔlɔ Ziba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I ngɔ Saul gbosi ní tsuo kɛ ngɛ o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bibi Mefiboshet hae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ maa pee ngmɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma kpa ní, konɛ o nyɔmtsɛ Saul we ɔ nɛ a ná nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye.
Se o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bibi Mefiboshet lɛɛ e maa ye ní ngɛ ye okplɔɔ he daa.” Ziba ngɛ binyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, kɛ tsɔli nyingmi enyɔ.
Ziba he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ fa mi ke ma pee ɔ, ma pee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mefiboshet ya yeɔ ní ngɛ Matsɛ David okplɔɔ ɔ he kaa matsɛbi.
Mefiboshet ngɛ binyumu wayoo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mika.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Ziba we ɔ mi ɔ ba plɛ pee Mefiboshet tsɔlɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mefiboshet nɛ e nane enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kplɔ ngɛ e sisi ɔ, lɛɛ e hi Yerusalem; nɛ e yeɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ okplɔɔ he daa ligbi.
David ye Amon bi kɛ Siria bi a nɔ -Pee se ɔ, Amon bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nahash ɔ ba gbo; nɛ e binyumu Hanun ba ye e se.
David de ke, “I kɛ Hanun maa hi si saminya kaa nɔ kɛ e huɛ, ejakaa e tsɛ Nahash kɛ mi hi si saminya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David tsɔ nihi nɛ a ya ha Hanun lakpoo benɛ Nahash gbo ɔ.
Se benɛ David tsɔli ɔmɛ ba su Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, Amon ganɔ ɔmɛ bi a matsɛ Hanun ɔ ke, “O susu kaa David tsɔ nihi ba ha mo lakpoo, konɛ e kɛ wo o tsɛ hɛ mi nyami lo?
Dɛbi!
Ni ɔmɛ nɛ David tsɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, pe a ba nɛ a ba slaa ma a, nɛ a kɛ kpa níhi si loko a ba tua wɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Hanun nuu David tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ e sɛ a kpɛni kasa fa kake, nɛ e hía a tade ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ kpɛti tutuutu kɛ ba su a mlɛ mi, nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a ho.
Benɛ David nu nɔ́ nɛ ba a; e tsɔ ya de mɛ ke a mlɛ ngɛ Yeriko kɛ yaa si a kpɛni ɔmɛ maa hɛ loko a ba, ejakaa e ngɛ mɛ zo pee kaa a maa kpale kɛ ba bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ na kaa a ya hla munyu ngɛ David he ɔ, a tsɔ ya bɔ Siria ta buli akpe nyingmi enyɔ apaa kɛ je Bet Rehob kɛ Zoba.
Jehanɛ hu, a ya bɔ Maaka matsɛ, kɛ e we bi akpe apaa kɛ piɛ Tob bi akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ a he.
Benɛ David nu he ɔ, e wo Yoab kɛ Israel tabo ɔ blɔ nɛ a kɛ mɛ ya kpe.
Amon bi ɔmɛ hia nɛ a ya gba ta ngɛ a ma nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Raba a agbo ɔ nya.
Se ni kpa amɛ nɛ ji Siria bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Tob kɛ Maaka a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a tsɔ a he kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya.
Yoab na bɔ nɛ a gba ta a ha, kaa a ma lɛ tuami kɛ je hɛ mi kɛ se blɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hla Israel ta buli komɛ nɛ a kɔni si wa, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ kpee Siria bi ɔmɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo e nyɛminyumu Abishai dɛ mi, konɛ mɛ hu a kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ ya kpe.
Yoab de lɛ ke, “Ke e ba mi kaa i ya nyɛ we Siria bi ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ o ba nɛ o ba piɛ ye he.
Se ke Amon bi ɔmɛ ngɛ mo gbee ɔ, lɛɛ imi ma ba piɛ o he.
Moo pee kã, nɛ o ha nɛ waa da si kaa nyumuhi kɛ ha wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa Mawu ɔ ma amɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, e pee.” Yoab kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ ba na Siria bi ɔmɛ, konɛ a kɛ mɛ nɛ ba hwu; se Siria bi ɔmɛ tu fo.
Benɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ na kaa Siria bi ɔmɛ tu fo ɔ, mɛ hu a tu fo ngɛ ta nɛ a kɛ Abishai ngɛ hwue ɔ nya kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yoab jɔɔ Amon bi ɔmɛ a se nyɛɛmi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Benɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ na kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, a ya bua a he nya.
Matsɛ Hadadezer tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ Siria bi nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ Hadadezer we asafoatsɛ Shobak nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ba Helam.
Benɛ David nu he ɔ, e bua Israel tsuo nya, nɛ e kɛ mɛ po Yordan pa a kɛ ho Helam ya.
Siria bi ɔmɛ gba ta wo David, nɛ a kɛ lɛ hwu.
Se Israel bi ɔmɛ wo Siria bi ɔmɛ fo; nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ gbe Siria bi ɔmɛ a ta zugba lɛ ta buli lafa kpaago, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ.
A he nyɛli ɔmɛ a we asafoatsɛ Shobak ɔ lɛɛ a plaa lɛ, nɛ e gbo ngɛ ta nga a nɔ.
Benɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Hadadezer sɔmɔe ɔ ná le kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, a kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya kpata, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Siria bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye kaa a ma ya piɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a he ekohu.
David kɛ Batsheba Gbo be mi nɛ́ matsɛmɛ pɔɔ ta gbami ɔ, David tsɔ Yoab kɛ e we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo kɛ ho nɛ a ya kpata Amon bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a sa Raba ma a yi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, David nitsɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ Yerusalem.
Ligbi ko gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, David te si kɛ je e sa mi nɛ e ya ngɛ si slaae ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e na yo ko nɛ ngɛ due ngɛ sisi ɔ. Yo ɔ he ngɛ fɛu saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David tsɔ ya bi yo ɔ he sane.
Nɛ a ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ke a tsɛɛ yo ɔ Batsheba; Eliam biyo ji lɛ, nɛ e huno ji Uria, Hit no ɔ. David tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ yo ɔ kɛ ba; nɛ benɛ e ba a, David kɛ lɛ hwɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Batsheba je we mi se, nɛ e ngɛ e he tsukɔe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.
Pee se ɔ, yo ɔ na kaa e hɛɛ mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ ya de David.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David tsɔ nɛ a kɛ sɛ gbi ya ha Yoab ke, “Ha nɛ Uria, Hit no ɔ nɛ ba.” Nɛ Yoab wo Uria blɔ kɛ ba David ngɔ.
Benɛ Uria ba a, David bi lɛ Yoab kɛ tabo ɔmɛ a hwɔhwɔɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ ta a ngɛ nɔ yae ha.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, David de Uria ke, “Yaa o we ɔ mi nɛ o ya jɔɔ o he bɔɔ.” Benɛ Uria je matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɔ nɛ a kɛ nike ní nyɛɛ e se.
Se Uria yɛ we mi; mohu e kɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo ya hwɔ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya.
Benɛ David nu kaa Uria yɛ we mi ɔ, e de Uria ke, “O hia blɔ be saii ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ piɔ pɛ o kpale kɛ ba.
Mɛni he je nɛ o yɛ we mi ɔ?” Uria he nɔ ke, “Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo ngɛ ta hwue, nɛ somi daka a ngɛ a ngɔ.
Jehanɛ, ye nyɔmtsɛ Yoab kɛ e we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu pueɔ si ngɛ nga a nɔ; nɛ imi lɛɛ ma ya we mi nɛ ma ya ye ní, nɛ ma nu dã, nɛ i kɛ ye yo ya hwɔ si lo?
I na o nane kaa i be nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee!” David de Uria ke, “Lɛɛ moo hi hiɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ hulɔ, konɛ ma wo mo blɔ hwɔɔ nɛ o ho.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Uria hi si ngɛ Yerusalem jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. E nɔ jena a, David tsɛ lɛ ní yemi; nɛ e ha e ye ní nɛ e nu dã saminya kɛ ya si e de.
Se e yɛ we mi; gbɔkuɛ ɔ, e ho ya hwɔ e sa a nɔ ngɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
E nɔ jena mɔtu ɔ, David ngma Yoab womi, nɛ e ngɔ ha Uria kɛ ho.
Nɔ́ nɛ e ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji, “Moo ngɔ Uria kɛ ya da ta a nya he nɛ mi he wa pe kulaa.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ gbla nyɛ he si kɛ je e he, nɛ a fia lɛ ní nɛ e gbo.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, benɛ Yoab ngɛ ma a yi sae ɔ, e ngɔ Uria ya da he nɛ e le kaa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a mi wa ngɛ ɔ.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ je kpo nɛ a kɛ Yoab we bi ɔmɛ ba hwu ta.
David asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ gbo; nɛ Uria, Hit no ɔ hu a gbe lɛ.
Jehanɛ Yoab tsɔ nɛ a ya bɔ David nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ ngɛ ta a mi.
E je blɔ de tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Ke o bɔ matsɛ ɔ ta a mi sane ɔ tsuo gbe nya, nɛ e ba mi kaa e mi mi fu nɛ e bi mo ke, ‘Mɛni he je nyɛ ya su ma a he haa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ hwu ta a?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa a ma tsɛ̃ nyɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ je gbogbo ɔ nɔ lo?
Nyɛ kaii we bɔ nɛ a gbe Gideon binyumu Abimelek ɔ?
Anɛ pi Tebez nɛ yo ko ngɔ wɛ tɛ kɛ gu gbogbo nɔ kɛ ko e yi mi ngɛ nɛ e gbo lo?
Mɛni he je nyɛ ya su gbogbo ɔ he haa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?’ Ke matsɛ ɔ bi mo kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, mo de lɛ ke, ‘O tsɔlɔ Uria, Hit no ɔ hu gbo.’ ” Tsɔlɔ ɔ ya bɔ David nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yoab fa lɛ ke e ya de ɔ. E de David ke, “Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he wa pe wɔ.
A je ma a mi ba tua wɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ; se wa fie mɛ kɛ ho ma agbo ɔ nya ya.
A tsɛ̃ wɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ je gbogbo ɔ nɔ.
Nɛnɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ gbo, nɛ o tsɔlɔ Uria, Hit no ɔ hu a gbe lɛ.” David de tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya wo Yoab he wami, nɛ o de lɛ ke e ko ha nɛ sane nɛ ɔ nɛ hao lɛ; ejakaa klaate ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e hlɛ nɔ mi nɛ e gbee.
De lɛ ke e ngɔ e he wami tsuo kɛ tua ma a, nɛ e ngɔ ma a.” Benɛ Uria yo ɔ nu kaa e huno Uria gbo ɔ, e nyɛ ya ha lɛ.
Benɛ e nyɛ ya ha lɛ gbe nya a, David tsɔ ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ba pee e yo; nɛ e fɔ binyumu ha lɛ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ David pee nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ Yawɛ nya.
Natan sɛ gbi, kɛ David he piami Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔ Natan ya de David ligbi ko ke, “Nyumuhi enyɔ hi ma ko mi; nɔ kake ɔ, niatsɛ ji lɛ, se nɔ kake ɔ lɛɛ ohiatsɛ ji lɛ.
Niatsɛ ɔ ngɛ tohi kɛ nahi babauu nitsɛ; se ohiatsɛ ɔ lɛɛ e be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pe jijɔ yo kake nɛ e ya he.
E hyɛ lohwe ɔ nɔ saminya, nɛ e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a bɛbɛ mi lohwe nɛ ɔ hii be tsuaa be kɛ ya si e wa.
Niye ní nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, eko nɔuu e kɛ haa lohwe nɛ ɔ; e kɛ lɛ nuɔ ní ngɛ kplu kake nya, nɛ e mi si lohwe nɛ ɔ hwɔɔ.
E hɛɛ lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e biyo pɛ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, nubwɔ ko ba to niatsɛ ɔ. Niatsɛ nɛ ɔ sume kaa e maa nu lɛ nitsɛ e to, loo na nɛ e gbe kɛ pee niye ní ha nubwɔ ɔ; se mohu e ya nu ohiatsɛ ɔ jijɔ bi ɔ nɛ e gbe kɛ ha e nubwɔ ɔ.” David mi mi fu jamɛ a niatsɛ ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e de Natan ke, “I na Yawɛ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ja e gbo!
Jehanɛ se hu, kaa e nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko be e mi ɔ, e sa kaa e to jijɔ bi ɔ nane mi totoe eywiɛ.” David tue gblami Natan de David ke, “Mo tutuutu ji jamɛ a nyumu ɔ nɛ!
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Imi nɛ i pɔ mo nu nɛ i wo mo Israel matsɛ, nɛ i je mo kɛ je Saul dɛ mi.
Imi nɛ i ngɔ o nyɔmtsɛ Saul matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ e yi ɔmɛ ngɔ wo o dɛ mi; imi nɛ i wo mo Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo matsɛ.
Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ pi ha mo ɔ, jinɛ ma ngɔ totoe enyɔ ngɔ piɛ he ha mo.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o tɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ, nɛ o pee yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi?
O ha Amon bi ɔmɛ gbe Uria, Hit no ɔ ngɛ ta nga a nɔ, nɛ o ngɔ e yo ɔ kɛ ba pee o yo!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ o bui mi, nɛ o ya ngɔ Uria yo ɔ kɛ ba pee o yo he je ɔ, klaate nya gbenɔ fɔɔ si ha o weku kɛ nina kɛ yaa neneene.’ Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ma ha mo nitsɛ o we ɔ mi no ko ma tsɔ atuã kɛ wo mo.
Ma kpɔ o yi ɔmɛ ngɛ o dɛ hɛ mi paa, nɛ ma ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha o nyɛmi ko; nɛ e kɛ mɛ maa hwɔ piani katakata.
Moo o pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ laami mi; se imi lɛɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ i de nɛ ɔ piani katakata, konɛ Israel tsuo nɛ na.’ ” David pia e he David de Natan ke, “I pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.” Natan de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ ngɔ o he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa mo; o be gboe!
Se akɛnɛ o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ pue Yawɛ hɛ mi si he je ɔ, bi nɛ a fɔ ha mo ɔ ma gbo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Natan je kɛ ho we mi ya.
David binyumu ɔ gbo Yawɛ ha nɛ binyumu ɔ nɛ Uria yo ɔ kɛ David fɔ ɔ wo hiɔ.
David kpa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ́ e ha nɛ jokuɛ ɔ nɛ na he wami.
David kua ní yemi; nɛ daa nyɔ mi ɔ, e hwɔɔ zugba kɛ ya siɔ je nami.
David we ɔ mi nimeli ɔmɛ maa ya e ngɔ, nɛ a ma ya fa kue ha lɛ kaa e maa te si ngɛ zugba a lo; se e kplɛɛ we, nɛ e kɛ mɛ yi ní hulɔ.
Otsi se ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ gbo, nɛ David tsɔli nikɔtɔma amɛ ye gbeye kaa a ma de lɛ ke jokuɛ ɔ gbo.
A de ke, “Benɛ jokuɛ ɔ na we nɛ e gbo lolo ɔ, ke wa de lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, e pui wa nya mi; lɛɛ ke wa de lɛ ke jokuɛ ɔ gbo ɔ, tse e maa ye e he awi ngɔ fɔ wa nɔ!” Benɛ David na kaa e tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ a he ngɛ ablɛgbi tue ɔ, e yɔse kaa jokuɛ ɔ gbo, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Jokuɛ ɔ gbo lo?” Nɛ a he nɔ ke, “Ee, e gbo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David te si ngɛ zugba, nɛ e ya du e he, nɛ e kpa nu, nɛ e tsake e tade ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya, nɛ e ya ja Mawu.
Benɛ e kpale kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, e ha nɛ a pee niye ní ha lɛ, nɛ e ye.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?
Benɛ jokuɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ wami mi ɔ, o ha hwɔ nɛ o fo ya ha lɛ.
Se benɛ jokuɛ ɔ gbo mohu ɔ, o te si nɛ o ye ní.” David ha mɛ heto ke, “Benɛ jokuɛ ɔ na we nɛ e gbo lolo ɔ, i ha hwɔ nɛ i fo ya; ejakaa i susu kaa, alini Yawɛ maa na mi mɔbɔ nɛ jokuɛ ɔ yi ma na wami.
Se piɔ nɛ e gbo ɔ, mɛni he je e sa kaa ma ha hwɔ ekohu?
Anɛ ma nyɛ ma kpale lɛ kɛ ba wami mi ekohu lo?
Imi mohu nɛ ma bu e nɔ ligbi ko; se lɛɛ e be kpalee kɛ ba ye ngɔ hu gblegbleegble.” A fɔ Salomo Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, David ba to e yo Batsheba tsui nɔ nine.
E kɛ lɛ na bɔmi, nɛ e fɔ binyumu; nɛ David wo lɛ biɛ ke Salomo.
Yawɛ suɔ jokuɛ ɔ saminya, nɛ e fa gbalɔ Natan ke e ya wo jokuɛ ɔ biɛ ke Yedidia; e sisi ji, “Nɔ nɛ Yawɛ suɔ lɛ.” David ye Raba bi a nɔ Yoab gba ta wo Raba, Amon bi a ma nguaa a he, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ngɔ ma a. Yoab tsɔ ya de David ke, “I kɛ Raba bi hwu ta nɛ i kpɔ a nyu yɛmi he ɔ ngɛ a dɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo bua ta nɛ piɛ ɔ nya nɛ o ya tua ma a, konɛ mo nitsɛ o nine nɛ su ma a tsuo nɔ.
Ke o pee we ja, nɛ i ya ye ma a nɔ ɔ, a maa ngɔ ye biɛ kɛ wo ma a.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David ya bua e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ e ya tua Raba, nɛ e ngɔ ma a. David je jlasi ɔ nɛ ngɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a we amaga Milkon ɔ yi, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e bu.
Jlasi ɔ jiimi maa pee sika tsu kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ jiimi; nɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa ngɛ mi.
David ngɔ ta yibu ní babauu nitsɛ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ba.
Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ e muɔ mɛ kɛ ba nɛ e ba ha mɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa komɛ nɛ a kɛ sauhi kɛ dade gbiɛ slɔɔtohi tsuɔ.
Jehanɛ se hu, e nyɛ ni ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a sã bliikisi.
David pee Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma kpa amɛ tsuo kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, David kɛ ma a tsuo kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Amnon kɛ Tamar David binyumu Absalom ngɛ nyɛmiyo ko nɛ he ngɛ fɛu saminya.
E biɛ ji Tamar.
E ba mi kaa Tamar tsɛbi Amnon ba na suɔmi wawɛɛ kɛ ha e nyɛmiyo nɛ ɔ. Suɔmi nɛ Amnon ngɛ kɛ ha e nyɛmiyo ɔ nya wa saminya, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba wo lɛ hiɔ.
Amnon le kaa bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e be e nyɛmiyo ɔ he blɔ nae; ejakaa yomiyo ji lɛ, nɛ a ngmɛ́ lɛ blɔ nɛ e kɛ nyumu nɛ na bɔmi.
Se Amnon ngɛ huɛ ko nɛ le nɔ́ he ga tomi saminya.
E biɛ ji Yonadab, nɛ e kɛ Amnon peeɔ tsɛngua kɛ tsɛwayo bimɛ; ejakaa Yonadab tsɛ Shimea kɛ David peeɔ nɔ kɛ e senɔ.
Yonadab bi Amnon ke, “Mo matsɛbi mluku ɔ, mɛni ba loko o ngɛ flaae jenajena kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Amnon he nɔ ke, “I suɔ Tamar, ye tsɛbi Absalom nyɛmiyo ɔ sane saminya.” Yonadab de lɛ ke, “Yaa hwɔ si nɛ o buá nɛ o pee kaa o be he wami.
Ke o tsɛ ba slaa mo ɔ, de lɛ ke, ‘Mo ha nɛ ye nyɛmiyo Tamar ba ha mi niye ní nɛ ma ye.
Ha nɛ e ba pee niye ní ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ma na; konɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi nɛ ma ye.’ ” Amnon ho ya hwɔ si nɛ e buá pee kaa nɔ nɛ e be he wami.
Matsɛ David ya slaa lɛ, nɛ Amnon de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngmɛ ye nyɛmiyo Tamar blɔ nɛ e ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ e ba si tatale enyɔ ko ha mi, konɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi nɛ ma ye.” David tsɔ ya de Tamar ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ke, “Yaa o nyɛminyumu Amnon we ɔ mi, nɛ o ya pee niye ní ha lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Tamar ba Amnon we ɔ mi, nɛ e ba na lɛ nɛ e hwɔɔ si.
Tamar pɔtɔ ma ngɛ Amnon hɛ mi nɛ e kɛ pee tatale nɛ e si.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e plɛ tatale ɔ ngɛ nisi kã a mi, nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ya ma Amnon hɛ mi; se e kua yemi.
Amnon de ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e je hiɛ ɔ!” Nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo je lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ Amnon de Tamar ke, “Moo hɛɛ niye ní ɔ ngɛ o dɛ mi nɛ o kɛ ba ha mi ngɛ se tsu ɔ mi nɛ ma ye.” Tamar ngɔ tatale nɛ e si ɔ ya ha e nyɛminyumu Amnon ngɛ se tsu ɔ mi.
Benɛ e kɛ niye ní ɔ su Amnon ngɔ pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Amnon nu lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmiyo, ba nɛ o kɛ mi ba hwɔ!” Se Tamar de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, ye nyɛminyumu, ko pue ye hɛ mi si; ejakaa a pee we nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel.
Ko tsu zo ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Zo nɛ ɔ, jije ma kɛ gu?
Se moo lɛɛ o maa pee kaa Israel yakayaka nimli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, yaa nɛ o ya na matsɛ ɔ; ejakaa i heɔ yeɔ kaa e maa kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ mi ma ha mo.” Se Amnon bui nɔ́ nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ ngɛ de ɔ tue; nɛ akɛnɛ e he wa pe lɛ he je ɔ, e nu lɛ pani nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Tamar he tai bɔni Amnon peemi; nɛ ninyɛ nɛ Amnon na kɛ ha lɛ ɔ nya wa kulaa pe suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ lɛ kekle ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Amnon de lɛ ke, “Tee si nɛ o ho!” Se Tamar de lɛ ke, “Mo ko de mi ja!
Fiemi nɛ o ngɛ mi fiee nɛ ɔ, e ji yayami nɛ kle pe kekle nɔ́ nɛ o pee mi ɔ po.” Se Amnon bui nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ de ɔ tue.
E tsɛ niheyo ɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Je yo nɛ ɔ kpo; fie lɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o la sinya a se!” Tsɔlɔ ɔ pee ja, nɛ e la sinya a se.
Tamar wo tade klɔii saminyayoo; ejakaa blema a, ja ji bɔ nɛ matsɛmɛ a biyihi nɛ a gbɛ lolo ɔ dlaa a he.
Tamar muɔ la zu kɛ pue e yi mi, nɛ e hía tade klɔii saminyayoo ɔ nɛ e wo ɔ. E kɛ e nine kpla e yi, nɛ e ma blɔ; nɛ e ngɛ ya foe boboobo kɛ ho.
Benɛ e nyɛminyumu Absalom na lɛ ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o nyɛminyumu Amnon ta o he lo?
Ye nyɛmiyo, mo ma o nya kɛkɛ; mo ko ye o tsui, ejakaa o nyɛminyumu ji lɛ.” Tamar hi si mɔbɔmɔbɔ ngɛ e nyɛminyumu Absalom we ɔ mi.
Benɛ Matsɛ David nu sane nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ, e muklii mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Absalom hu na ninyɛ agbo kɛ ha Amnon, nɛ e kɛ lɛ hiɔ nya kaa e nyɛ e nyɛmiyo Tamar nɔ pani nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ.
Absalom lue yemi Jeha enyɔ se ɔ, e ba mi kaa a ya ngɛ Absalom tohi a he bwɔmi sãe ngɛ Baal Hazor, ngɛ Efraim kasa nya; nɛ Absalom fɔ matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nine.
Absalom ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “A ma o tsɔlɔ ɔ to ɔmɛ a he bwɔmi sami.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ba, nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ ye kuɛ se mi.” Se matsɛ ɔ de Absalom ke, “Dɛbi, ye bi, ke wɔ tsuo wa ba a, wa ma ba pee tlomi ngɛ o kuɛ nɔ.” Absalom nyɛ e nɔ hluu, se e kplɛɛ we; se kɛ̃, matsɛ ɔ gbaa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Absalom de ke, “Ke o kplɛɛ we ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ha nɛ ye nyɛminyumu Amnon ba sɛ wɔ mɔ.” Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ Amnon hlae ɔ?” Se Absalom nyɛ e nɔ hluu kɛ ya si e kplɛɛ kaa Amnon kɛ matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ya.
Absalom ngmɛ okplɔɔ gbidii kaa a ngmɛɛ okplɔɔ ha matsɛ.
Absalom fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke Amnon nu wai nɛ e bua jɔ e he ɔ, nyɛɛ hi lɛ huɔe konɛ ke i de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ fia Amnon nɔ́,’ pɛ nɛ nyɛɛ gbe lɛ.
Imi nɛ i fa nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ko ye gbeye!
Nyɛɛ pee kã; nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a na kaa nyumuhi ji nyɛ.” Absalom tsɔli ɔmɛ tsu Amnon he ní kaa bɔ nɛ Absalom fa mɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ tsuo te si, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ya kuɔ e teji okpɔngɔ; nɛ a tu fo.
Benɛ a ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, nɔ ko ya bɔ David amaniɛ ke, “Absalom gbe matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a ti nɔ kake po píɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ te si nɛ e kɛ aywilɛho hía e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e hwɔ si ngɛ zugba; nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a hu hía a tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he.
Se Yonadab, nɛ ji David nyɛminyumu Shimea bi ɔ de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ nɛ e ko susu kaa a gbe matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ tsuo; Amnon nɔ kake too pɛ ji nɔ nɛ a gbe ngɛ Absalom fami nya.
Kɛ je be nɛ Amnon nu Absalom nyɛmiyo Tamar pani nya nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ ɔ, kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ tɔɔ Absalom to ga nɛ ɔ ngɛ Amnon he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ nɛ e ko ye e tsui kaa matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ gbo; ejakaa Amnon nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ nɛ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, Absalom tu fo kɛ je momo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bulɔ ɔ na nimli babauu ngɛ Horonaim blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ a ngɛ yo ɔ kplee kɛ ma.
Yonadab de matsɛ ɔ ke, “O nɛ, matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ma a nɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ o tsɔlɔ de ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ e ba mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Benɛ e gbe e munyu ɔ nya pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ ba hia si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A hɛ dɔ, nɛ a wo yana.
Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo wo yana kɛ piɛ a he.
- Absalom tu fo kɛ ho Geshur matsɛ Talmai, nɛ ji Amihud binyumu ɔ ngɔ ya; nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ jeha etɛ.
David ye e binyumu Amnon he kɔmɔ be babauu.
Se benɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia Amnon gbenɔ ɔ mi bɔɔ ɔ, David hɛ ja ngɛ Absalom he; nɛ e ná nɛ e na lɛ ekohu.
Yoab to ga Zeruya binyumu Yoab ba yɔse kaa Matsɛ David ngɛ e tsui yee ngɛ Absalom he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ kɛ ho Tekoa ya nɛ a ya ngɔ yo ní lelɔ ko kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba.
Benɛ yo ɔ ba a, Yoab de lɛ ke, “Mo bu ya bo, nɛ o buá nɛ o pee o ní kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ ya nyɛe.
Mo ko kpa nu, se mohu o pee o ní kaa yo nɛ nɔ gbo lɛ nɛ e ngɛ ya nyɛe ligbi babauu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, yaa matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ o ya de lɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo nɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoab de yo ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ya de matsɛ ɔ. Benɛ Tekoa yo ɔ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, e kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e de ke, “Nɛnɛ lee!
Moo ye bua mi!” Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni ji o sane ɔ?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Taflaatsɛ, yalɔyo ji mi; ye huno gbo.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, i ngɛ binyumuwi enyɔ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, pɛ ba sɛ a kpɛti ngɛ nga nɔ.
Akɛnɛ nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma kpata mɛ he je ɔ, nɔ kake fia e nyɛmi ɔ nɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, weku ɔ tsuo te si wo mi nɛ a ngɛ ye nɔ nyɛe ke ma ngɔ ye bi ɔ nɛ tane e nyɛmi ɔ yi ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ nɛ a gbe lɛ kɛ ye e nyɛmi ɔ nɛ e gbe ɔ he lue.
Ke a pee ja kɛkɛ a kpata gbosi ní yelɔ ɔ hu hɛ mi; kɛkɛ pe a gbe ye la tso ku nɛ piɛ ngɛ la mi ɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛɛ tse ye huno biɛ maa laa gbidigbidi; nɛ e nina ko hu be piɛe ngɛ zugba a nɔ.” Matsɛ ɔ de yo ɔ ke, “Moo kpale kɛ ho we mi ya; ma ye o sane ɔ ha mo.” Tekoa yo ɔ de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, ke fɔ yemi ko ba a, e pee imi kɛ ye tsɛ we ɔ wa nɔ; nɛnɛ kɛ e sɛ ɔ lɛɛ e sɛ́ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko piaa mɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ke nɔ ko wo o susuma he gbeye ɔ, ngɔɔ lɛ ba ha mi; nɛ e be o he tae hu gblegbleegble.” Jehanɛ, yo ɔ de ke, “Nɛnɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o fa kue ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, konɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa e yeɔ ye bi nɛ be je mi ɔ he lue ɔ, e ko ba pee yayami agbo pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ, kaa e maa gbe ye bi kaketsɛ ɔ hulɔ.” Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “I na Mawu, o bi ɔ yi bwɔmi kake po be e yi kpɛti jee kɛ nɔ si.” Yo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nɛnɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngmɛ mi blɔ nɛ ma bi nɔ kake pɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa o nya nɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ e ba moo o yi mi kaa o pee kikɛmɛ a yayami nɛ ɔ nɔuu kɛ si Mawu ma a?
Si abɔ nɛ nɛnɛ nyɛ we nɛ e kpale lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu nɛ a je lɛ we ɔ kɛ ba nɛ ɔ, nɛnɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de nɛ ɔ bu lɛ nitsɛ e he fɔ.
Gbenɔ fɔɔ si kɛ ha wɔ tsuo; wa ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a kpa pue si nɛ be hie muɔmi hu.
Mawu lɛɛ e kpataa we susuma hɛ mi; se mohu e toɔ ga, konɛ nɔ ko nɛ a je lɛ we ɔ, e ko ba pee nɔmlɔ nɛ tlɔ nga pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛnɛ, nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ i ba nɛ i kɛ mo ba ngɛ munyu nɛ ɔ tue ɔ ji kaa ma a wo ye susuma he gbeye, nɛ i de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, ke i ba nɛ i ba bɔ nɛnɛ amaniɛ nɛ ɔ, alini nɛnɛ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae ɔ ha mi.
I le sa kaa nɛnɛ maa bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue, nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ hlae kaa e kpata i kɛ ye bi tsuo wa hɛ mi, konɛ Mawu weto ní nɛ e laa wɔ ɔ, e ma kpɔ mi kɛ je e dɛ mi.
I heɔ yeɔ kaa munyu nɛ nɛnɛ maa tu ɔ maa jɔɔ ye bua; ejakaa mo nɛnɛ ɔ, o ngɛ kaa Mawu bɔfo; o le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ e gbaa mo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de yo ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ma bi mo nɛ ɔ, moo tu mi anɔkuale.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, mo de.” Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ Yoab le ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he nɔ́ ko lo?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I na nɛnɛ, kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa je nɔ́ nɛ o de nɛ ɔ he nɔ́.
O tsɔlɔ Yoab tutuutu ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi; nɛ lɛ nɔuu nɛ e tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ ma ba de mo ɔ nɛ.
O tsɔlɔ Yoab to ga nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ e dla sane ɔ he.
Se nɛnɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa Mawu bɔfo; e le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je ɔ mi.” Pee se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ de Yoab ke, “Yoo, i kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ o bi ɔ nɔ.
Jehanɛ, yaa nɛ o ya hla niheyo Absalom ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba.” Yoab ba kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si kɛ tsɔɔ bumi, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu nɛ e gbaa mo!
Nɛnɛ, i yɔse kaa o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ i bi mo ɔ, o pee ha mi.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoab ba pue nɔ kɛ ho Geshur ya nɛ e ya ngɔ Absalom kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Se matsɛ ɔ de ke, “É ho nɛ e ya hi lɛ nitsɛ e we ɔ mi banee; i hla we nɛ ma na e hɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Absalom ho ya hi lɛ nitsɛ e we ɔ mi; nɛ e yɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Absalom kɛ David tsa ekohu Ngɛ Israel tsuo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ he ngɛ fɛu kɛ Absalom sɔ; kɛ je e nane sisi hluu kɛ ya si e yi gbɛtɛ mi ɔ, sé ko be e he.
E yi hɛɔ saminya, nɛ e yi bwɔmi ɔ hii lɛ gbee loko e sãã nɔ; daa jeha nyagbe loko e sãã e yi nɔ.
Ke e sã e yi nɔ ɔ, e yi bwɔmi nɛ pueɔ si ɔ jiimi maa su kilo enyɔ, loo nɔ́ ngɛ matsɛ sɛni tɛ ɔ nya.
Absalom fɔ binyumuhi etɛ kɛ biyo kake.
Yoyo ɔ biɛ ji Tamar, nɛ e he ngɛ fɛu saminya.
Absalom hi Yerusalem jeha enyɔ sɔuu nɛ e nɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Pee se ɔ, Absalom tsɔ ke a tsɛ Yoab ha lɛ nɛ e tsɔ lɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɔ; se Yoab bɛ.
E tsɔ si enyɔne; se Yoab bɛ.
Jehanɛ Absalom de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ le sane ko!
Yoab ngmɔ ɔ tsa ye nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e du ngma ngɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya mɛ e ngmɔ ɔ he la.” Nɛ a ya nɛ a ya sã ngmɔ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoab ba Absalom ngɔ ngɛ e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he nɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ ya sã ye ngmɔ ɔ?” Absalom he nɔ ke, “Ejakaa i tsɔ ba tsɛ mo, nɛ o bɛ.
Jinɛ i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma tsɔ mo matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ o ya bi lɛ ha mi ke, ‘Mɛni he je i je Geshur kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ?
Kaa i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ mohu kɛ ba si piɔ jinɛ i ko suɔ.’ ” Absalom ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I suɔ nɛ o ya sɛ mi matsɛ ɔ ngɔ; nɛ ke e ba mi kaa i ye fɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e gbe mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yoab ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ e ya bɔ lɛ amaniɛ.
Matsɛ ɔ tsɔ ya tsɛ Absalom; nɛ benɛ e ba a, e kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si.
Nɛ matsɛ ɔ fua lɛ atuu.
Absalom tsɔ atuã Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Absalom ba na lɛ nitsɛ e ta zugba lɛ kɛ e he okpɔngɔhi, kɛ nyumuhi nyingmi enuɔ nɛ maa hi fo tue ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Daa ligbi ɔ, Absalom maa te si mla, kɛkɛ e ho ya da si ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi ngɛ ma agbo ɔ nya.
Ke nɔ ko hɛɛ munyu ko kɛ ma matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ a ye ha lɛ ɔ, Absalom ma tsɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ e ma bi lɛ ke, “Jije ma mi o je?” Ke nɔ ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ Israel wɛtso nɔ́ nɛ mi nɛ e je ɔ, Absalom ma de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, o sane ɔ da, se matsɛ ɔ nane mi dalɔ ko be hiɛ ɔ nɛ maa ye o sane ɔ ha mo.” Absalom deɔ hu ke, “I ná nɛ a wo mi kojolɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ!
Jinɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ munyu, loo pɛ sane ko maa ba ye ngɔ ɔ, ma ye ha lɛ ngɛ dami nya.” Be tsuaa be nɛ nɔ ko ma ya su e kasa nya nɛ e ma kpla si ha lɛ ɔ, Absalom ma sɔle e nine nɛ e maa fua lɛ atuu.
Bɔ nɛ Absalom peeɔ Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ kɛ munyu ko ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ a ye ha lɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ peemi mi ɔ, Absalom dɔ Israel ma a tsuo a tsui kɛ ba e he.
Jeha eywiɛ se ɔ, Absalom de matsɛ ɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ ma ya Hebron konɛ si ko nɛ i wo Yawɛ ɔ, ma ya ye nɔ.
Benɛ i ngɛ Geshur ngɛ Siria a, i wo Yawɛ si kaa ke e maa kpale mi kɛ ba Yerusalem ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ ma ya ja lɛ ngɛ Hebron.” Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa ngɛ he jɔmi mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Absalom pue nɔ kɛ ho Hebron ya.
Se Absalom tsɔ nihi ngɛ laami mi kɛ ho nɛ a ya de Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Ke nyɛ nu titimati pɛmi ɔ, amlɔ nɔuu nyɛ hwɔ lele nɛ nyɛ de ke, ‘Absalom ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Hebron!’ ” A kpee nihi lafa enyɔ kɛ je Yerusalem, nɛ mɛ hu a piɛ Absalom he kɛ ho.
Se mɛɛ diblii mi a ngɛ; a li nɔ́ nɛ a to kaa a maa pee ɔ he nɔ́ ko.
Benɛ Absalom ngɛ bɔ ɔmɛ sãe ɔ, e tsɔ ya kpee Ahitofel kɛ je Gilo kɛ ba.
Ahitofel nɛ ɔ, David ga wolɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ma mi ji Gilo.
Enɛ ɔ wo matsɛ ɔ yi nɔ nɛ a ngɛ soe ɔ mi he wami; nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ Absalom se ɔ, a he ba bɔni hiɛmi.
David tu fo kɛ je Yerusalem Tsɔlɔ ko ba David ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Absalom ya dɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je o se ya piɛ e he, nɛ a ngɛ o yi nɔ soe.” David de e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ te si nɛ waa tu fo; ke pi ja lɛɛ Absalom nine maa su wa nɔ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ho esɔ nɛ e ko ba na wɔ tlukaa.
Ke e ba mi ja lɛɛ sane yobu maa ye wɔ, nɛ e kɛ klaate ma kpata ma a hɛ mi.” Matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ de ke, “Wa dla wa he momo; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, wa maa pee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ te, nɛ e kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo pue blɔ.
E si e plahi nyɔngma pɛ ngɛ se nɛ a hi we ɔ nɔ hyɛe.
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo ya su nyagbe we ɔ he ɔ, mɛ tsuo a da si.
Matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba da si ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ matsɛ we bi a tabo, nɛ ji Keret bi ɔmɛ kɛ Pelet bi ɔmɛ ba be kɛ sɛ hlami.
Gat ta buli lafa ekpa nɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ je Gat ɔ hu ba be kɛ sɛ hlami.
David bi Itai, Gat no ɔ ke, “Mɛni he je mo hu o kɛ wɔ yaa a?
Moo kpale o se nɛ o kɛ matsɛ he ɔ nɛ e ya hi si.
Nubwɔ ji mo; jehanɛ se hu, pe a fie mo kɛ je o ma mi.
Mo nɛ hiɛ pɛ o ba a, mɛni he je ma ngɔ mo kɛ ya wo lalaalo be mi nɛ imi nitsɛ i li he nɛ i yaa a?
Moo kpale o se nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ho.
Yawɛ nɛ na mo mɔbɔ nɛ e kɛ mo nɛ hi si.” Se Itai he nɔ ke, “I na Yawɛ, nɛ i na nɛnɛ kaa he tsuaa he nɛ o yaa a, i kɛ mo maa ya, gbenɔ mi jio, wami mi jio.” David de Itai ke, “Saminya, ba be kɛ ho!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Itai, Gat no ɔ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ jokuɛwi tsɔwi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ba be.
Ma a tsuo wo yana benɛ David we bi ɔmɛ je kɛ yaa a. Matsɛ ɔ ya po Kidron pa a, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ e se; nɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a pue nga a nɔ blɔ.
Abiatar, Zadok, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ Mawu somi daka a kɛ ba ma si kɛ ya si nɔ tsuaa nɔ je ma a mi.
Jehanɛ, matsɛ ɔ de Zadok ke, “Moo kpale Mawu somi daka a kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
Ke Yawɛ suɔ ɔ, e maa kpale mi kɛ ba nɛ ma ba na daka a kɛ e hi he ɔ ekohu.
Se ke Yawɛ sume ɔ, lɛɛ imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, e pee mi.” Matsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de osɔfo Zadok ke, “Hyɛ, moo kpale o se kɛ ho ma a mi ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi; mo kɛ Abiatar, kɛ o binyumu Ahimaaz, kɛ Abiatar binyumu Yonatan.
Imi lɛɛ ma mlɛ ngɛ pa pomi he ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ kɛ yaa si ma nu sɛ gbi ko kɛ je nyɛ ngɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Zadok kɛ Abiatar kpale Mawu somi daka a kɛ ho Yerusalem ya; nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ. David ha e yi nɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛ nane gu kɛ ya kuɔ Oliv yo ɔ. Benɛ e yaa a tsuo e ngɛ ya foe.
Nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ tsuo ha a yi nɔ; nɛ benɛ a ngɛ yo ɔ kuɔe ɔ, mɛ hu a wo yana.
Benɛ a ya bɔ David amaniɛ ke Ahitofel hu ya piɛ Absalom atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e sɔle ke, “Yawɛ lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o plɛ Ahitofel ga womi ɔ kɛ pee kuasiahi a sane.” Benɛ David ya su yo ɔ yi mi he nɛ a dla kɛ ha Mawu jami ɔ, Hushai, Arki no ɔ ba kpee lɛ kɛ e hiɔwe tade nɛ hía, kɛ e yi mi zu.
David de lɛ ke, “Ke o nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, o maa pee tlomi ha mi.
Moo kpale kɛ ho ma a mi ya nɛ o ya de Absalom ke, ‘Matsɛ, ma sɔmɔ mo kaa bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ o tsɛ be ko nɛ be ɔ.’ Enɛ ɔ peemi mohu nɛ o kɛ ma puɛ Ahitofel ga womi ɔ ha mi.
Osɔfo Zadok, kɛ osɔfo Abiatar ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa nu kɛ je matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, mo de mɛ.
A binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; mɛ ji Zadok bi Ahimaaz, kɛ Abiatar bi Yonatan.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa nu ɔ, moo tsɔ mɛ nɛ a ba de mi.” David huɛ Hushai ba su Yerusalem be mi nɛ Absalom hu maa ho ma a mi sɛmi ya.
David kɛ Ziba Benɛ David po mi ngɛ yo ɔ yi mi bɔɔ ɔ, Mefiboshet tsɔlɔ Ziba kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
E hɛɛ teji enyɔ kɛ a se tlomi: abolo bɔbɔɛ lafa enyɔ, wai yiblii gbigbli sau lafa, tso yiblii lafa, kɛ wai lohwe he womi tɔ kake.
Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Jije o kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ yaa?” Ziba he nɔ ke, “I ngɔ teji ɔmɛ kɛ ba, konɛ o we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a hi a nɔ.
I ngɔ abolo ɔ kɛ tso yiblii ɔmɛ kɛ ba konɛ nihewi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye.
Jehanɛ, i kɛ wai hu ba, konɛ ke pɔ tɔ nihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ nɛ a nu.” Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “O nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bibi Mefiboshet ɔ, jije e ngɛ?” Ziba he nɔ ke, “E ngɛ Yerusalem, ejakaa e susu kaa be su nɛ Israel ma a maa kpale e nɛ̃ matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ ha lɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ de Ziba ke, “O nɛ, Mefiboshet nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ba peeɔ o nɔ jehanɛ.” Ziba de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, i kɛ he si bami ngɛ mo tsumi haae; moo pɛtɛ ye he daa.” David kɛ Shimei Benɛ David ba su Bahurim ɔ, Gara binyumu Shimei, Saul weku no ɔ kɛ lɛ ba kpe; benɛ e ma a tsuo, e ngɛ David gbiɛe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e muɔ tɛ nɛ e kɛ fiaa Matsɛ David, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ e we bi a tabo ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ. Benɛ Shimei ngɛ David gbiɛe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ji, “Jee hiɛ ɔ!
Jee hiɛ ɔ!
Mo muɔ si puelɔ, kɛ yakayaka nɔmlɔ!
O kpɔ Saul matsɛ yemi ɔ, se piɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ ngɛ o tue gblae ngɛ Saul we mi bimɛ babauu a muɔ si nɛ o pue ɔ he.
Yawɛ ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ wo o binyumu Absalom dɛ.
Hyɛ, o hɛ mi kpata pɛ, ejakaa muɔ si puelɔ ji mo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Abishai nɛ e nyɛ biɛ ji Zeruya a, bi matsɛ ɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, mɛni he je nɛ o ngmɛ blɔ nɛ gbe gbogboe nɛ ɔ ngɛ mo gbiɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Ha nɛ ma ya nɛ ma ya po e yi.” Se matsɛ ɔ de Abishai, kɛ e nyɛminyumu Yoab ke, “Nyɛ Zeruya bimɛ, mɛni sane nɛ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ he?
Ke Yawɛ nɛ de lɛ ke e gbiɛ mi, nɛ e ngɛ mi gbiɛe ɔ, mɛnɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e biɔ ke mɛni he je e ngɛ ja pee lo?” Jehanɛ, David de Abishai, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, ke imi nitsɛ ye bi fɔfɔɛ ngɛ ye wami se blɔ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ Benyamin no nɛ ɔ, mɛni tsiɔ lɛ blɔ?
Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ e he nɛ e gbiɛ mi faa, ejakaa Yawɛ nɛ de lɛ ke e pee ja a nɛ.
Eko ɔ, Yawɛ maa hyɛ ye nɔ́ nami ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kpakpa maa to ahlua nɛ a ngɛ mi bɔe mwɔnɛ ɔ nane mi ha mi.” Benɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, Shimei hu nyɛɛ yoku ɔ nɔ ngɛ a hanɔ kɛ yaa.
Nɛ benɛ e yaa a tsuo, e ngɛ David gbiɛe nɛ e ngɛ lɛ tɛ fiae, nɛ e ngɛ zu muɔe kɛ ngɛ e nɔ puee.
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ su Yordan pa a he ɔ, pɔ tɔ mɛ nyanyaanya; nɛ a jɔɔ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Absalom ba su Yerusalem Absalom kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ba Yerusalem, nɛ Ahitofel hu piɛ a he.
Benɛ David huɛ Hushai, Arki no ɔ ba su Absalom ngɔ ɔ, e hwɔ lele, nɛ e de ke, “Manye oo, manye!
Manye oo, manye!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Absalom bi Hushai ke, “Bɔ nɛ o jeɔ o suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ o huɛ David ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Mɛni he je o kɛ lɛ yɛ ɔ?” Hushai he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, imi lɛɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ Israel tsuo hla lɛ ɔ, e nɔ ji mi; nɛ lɛ i kɛ maa hi si.
Jehanɛ se hu, ke i sɔmɔ we ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ nɛɛ, mɛnɔ ma sɔmɔ mɔ?” Jehanɛ, Absalom de Ahitofel ke, “Moo wo ga koo; kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?” Ahitofel de Absalom ke, “Yaa nɛ o kɛ o tsɛ plã amɛ nɛ e si ke a hi we ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ ya hwɔ.
Ke o pee ja a, Israel tsuo maa na kaa o kɛ o tsɛ ɔ, nyɛ plɛ he nyɛli.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa fɔ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a kɔni nɔ kpa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a pee bo tsu ha Absalom ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi, nɛ Absalom ya tsɛ e tsɛ plã amɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ga tsuaa ga nɛ Ahitofel wo Absalom ɔ, e buɔ tue pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ David hu pee ɔ; ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, ke Ahitofel tu munyu ko ɔ, a ngɔɔ munyu ɔ kaa Mawu nitsɛ nya mi munyu.
Hushai wo Absalom ga yaya Be bɔɔ se ɔ, Ahitofel de Absalom ke, “Ha nɛ ma hla nyumuhi akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ ma ya tua David nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi.
Ma ya ná lɛ be mi nɛ pɔ tɔ lɛ, nɛ e nine mi je wu.
Ma wo e he gbeye, kɛkɛ ma a tsuo nɛ piɛ e he ɔ maa tu fo.
Ma gbe matsɛ ɔ pɛ, nɛ ma kpaka e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba ha mo kaa ayɛflo nɛ ma e huno we mi.
Nɔmlɔ kake too pɛ wami se blɔ o ngɛ hlae; ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa ye a he.” Ga nɛ a wo nɛ ɔ sa Absalom, kɛ Israel nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Absalom de ke, “Nyɛ ya tsɛ Hushai, Arki no ɔ hu kɛ ba nɛ waa bu tue nɔ́ nɛ lɛ hu e ma de.” Benɛ Hushai ba a, Absalom de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Ahitofel de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; waa ye e ga womi ɔ nɔ lo?
Ke e hí ɔ, lɛɛ mo hu mo de wɔ nɔ́ ko.” Hushai he nɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ga nɛ Ahitofel wo ɔ, ga a hí.” Hushai ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Mo nitsɛ o le kaa o tsɛ kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ɔ, katsɛmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi pee klamaklama kaa osisiblisi nɛ nɔ ko ya muɔ e bimɛ ngɛ nga nɔ.
Jehanɛ se hu, o tsɛ ɔ, ta bulɔ kpanaa ji lɛ; e hí e we bi a kpɛti nyɔ mi.
Hyɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ po, ke o li peemi, be nɛ ɔ mi e ya laa ngɛ tɛ puɔ ko mi, aloo ngɛ he kpa ko.
Ke e ba mi kaa mɛɛ a tua wɔ kekle, nɛ wa we bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɔ ngɛ ta a mi, nɛ nihi nu he ɔ, a ma de ke, ‘A kpata Absalom we bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.’ Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔmlɔ nɛ lɛɛ e tsui wa kaa jata po sawale maa nu lɛ, ejakaa Israel tsuo le kaa o tsɛ ɔ, tatsɛ nguaa ji lɛ, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hu katsɛmɛ ji mɛ.
Imi lɛɛ, ga nɛ ma wo mo ji kaa o ha nɛ a bua Israel tsuo nya ha mo kɛ je Dan kɛ yaa si Beersheba.
A he nɛ hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia, nɛ mo nitsɛ o nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya ta a. Wa ma ya hla David ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ wa ma tua lɛ benɛ e li e he be kaa bɔ nɛ bɔ́ nɛɔ kɛ pueɔ zugba a. E kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po be piɛe.
Ke e ba mi kaa e tu fo kɛ ho ma ko mi ya a, Israel tsuo maa ngɔ kpahi, nɛ wa maa gbla ma a kɛ ya wo kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ yaa si a be tɛ kake po nae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Absalom kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo de ke, “Ga nɛ Hushai, Arki no ɔ wo ɔ hi pe Ahitofel nɔ́ ɔ.” Blɔɔ Yawɛ to momo kaa ga kpakpa a nɛ Ahitofel wo ɔ, a ko ye nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ e kɛ amanehlu nɛ ba Absalom nɔ.
Nɔ ko ya naa David nane nɔ, nɛ e tu fo Ga nɛ Ahitofel wo Absalom kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ɔ, Hushai ho nɛ e ya bɔ osɔfo Zadok kɛ osɔfo Abiatar.
E de mɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e ga nɛ e wo ɔ. Hushai ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ tsɔ esɔ, nɛ a ya de David ke, nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e ko hwɔ pa pomi he ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ; se mohu, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e po Yordan pa a nɔuu.
Ke pi ja a, a ma kpata lɛ matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yonatan kɛ Ahimaaz ngɛ mlɛe ngɛ Enrogel pa a he ngɛ Yerusalem kasa nya.
Nɛ́ nɔ ko kó na mɛ he je ɔ, a yɛ ma a mi.
Ke pee ɔ, mawayo ko kɛ sɛ gbi ya haa mɛ, kɛkɛ mɛ hu a ya de David.
Se ligbi ko ɔ, niheyo ko na mɛ, nɛ e ya de Absalom.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a je lejɛ ɔ mla kɛ ho nyumu ko we mi ya ngɛ Bahurim.
Nyumu ɔ ngɛ vu ko ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya sɛ mi.
Nyumu ɔ yo ɔ ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha vu ɔ nya, nɛ e fĩa ngma kɛ pue nɔ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko le kaa ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Absalom tsɔli ɔmɛ ba su we ɔ mi ɔ, a bi yo ɔ ke, “Jije Ahimaaz kɛ Yonatan ngɛ?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “A po pa a kɛ ho.” Ni ɔmɛ hla mɛ hluu, se a nɛ mɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Benɛ a je ɔ, Ahimaaz kɛ Yonatan je kpo kɛ je vu ɔ mi, nɛ a ho nɛ a ya bɔ Matsɛ David amaniɛ.
A de lɛ ke, “Tee si esɔ nɛ o po pa a.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo bɔni Yordan pa a pomi hluu kɛ ya si je nanɛɛ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ po pa a ta.
Benɛ Ahitofel na kaa a yi ga nɛ e wo ɔ nɔ ɔ, e wo e teji nɔ ní, nɛ e je kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya.
Benɛ e to e níhi a blɔ nya gbe nya a, e ho nɛ e ya wo e kuɛ kpa; nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ e tsɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi.
Benɛ Absalom kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke a poɔ Yordan pa a, David su Mahanaim momo.
Absalom pee Amasa tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ Yoab nane mi.
Amasa nɛ ɔ, Israel no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Itra a bi ji lɛ.
E nyɛ Abigail, nɛ ji Yoab nyɛ Zeruya nyɛmiyo ɔ, Nahash biyo ji lɛ.
Jehanɛ Absalom kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ya pue si ngɛ Gilead zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ David ba su Mahanaim ɔ, Nahash binyumu Shobi nɛ je Amon bi a ma, Raba a, kɛ Amiel bi Makir nɛ je Lodebar a, kɛ Barzilai nɛ je Rogelim ngɛ Gilead ɔ kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
Níhi nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ ba ji nɛ ɔmɛ: sa, sowe, buɛ, kã, ngma, akoko, ngma ma, blɛfo nɛ a si, amɔtlamɔ, yɔ, hwo, nyami, wagasi, kɛ jijɔhi.
A de ke, “Be nɛ ɔ mi pɔ tɔ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ; be nɛ ɔ mi hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee, nɛ kuma hu ngɛ mɛ yee.”
A ye Absalom nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ Matsɛ David bua e we bi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e gba a mi kɛ wo kuuhi a mi, akpehi kɛ lafahi; nɛ e to tatsɛmɛ ngɛ a nya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, David gba tabo ɔ tsuo mi etɛ, nɛ e ngɔ Yoab ngɔ to kekleekle nɔ́ nya.
Yoab senɔ Abishai, Zeruya bi ɔ ji kuu enyɔne ɔ nyatsɛ; nɛ etɛne ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ wo Itai, Gat no ɔ dɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Imi nitsɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa ya.” Se ni ɔmɛ de ke, “Dɛbi, mo ko ya!
Ke wɔɔ wa tu fo ngɛ ta a nya a, nɔ ko be wa he akɔtaa bue.
Jã kɛ̃ ke a dla wa mi enyɔ nɛ fa kake nɔ ngɛ ta a mi po, pi nɔ ko kɔmɔ.
Se moo lɛɛ o he jua wa kaa wa ti nihi akpe nyɔngma.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hi kaa o hi si ngɛ ma a mi mohu konɛ ke nɔ́ ko he hia wɔ ɔ, nɛ o pee ha wɔ.” Matsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ susu kaa e hi ɔ, ma pee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya da si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ tabo ɔ tsuo nyɛɛ kɛ je kpo ngɛ a kuu ɔmɛ a nya, lafahi kɛ akpehi.
Matsɛ ɔ ka Yoab kɛ Abishai kɛ Itai kita ke, “Ye he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ niheyo Absalom ɔ nɛ ye blɛuu.” Benɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ e tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita kae ngɛ Absalom he ɔ, tabo ɔmɛ tsuo nu.
David tabo ɔ, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta ngɛ Efraim hue ɔ mi, nɛ a ye Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nimli a bimɛ a yi nɛ a tane jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, tsa pi fiɛmi; nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ sɔuu gbo.
Ta a gbɛ fĩa lejɛ ɔ zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ nimli babauu a hɛ mi kpata ngɛ hue ɔ mi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ngɛ klaate nya po.
Absalom kɛ David tsɔli ɔmɛ ya kpe tlukaa.
Absalom hi e teji okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya gu tso ngua a ko sisi.
E yi ya bɛ tso kɔni kusuu ɔmɛ, nɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kplaa si ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi be mi nɛ teji okpɔngɔ ɔ lɛɛ e je e sisi kɛ ho.
Nyumu ko ya na lɛ, nɛ e ba bɔ Yoab amaniɛ ke, “O nɛ, i ya na Absalom nɛ kplaa si ngɛ tso ngua a ko he.” Yoab bi nɔ nɛ ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛ́ o na lɛ ɔ, mɛni he je o fiɛ lɛ nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e nɔ si?
Jinɛ ye blɔ nya ji ma ha mo sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma, kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ko.” Se nyumu ɔ de Yoab ke, “Kpaoo!
Ke o ha mi sika hiɔ yi akpe po, i be ye nine nɔ woe ngɛ matsɛbi ɔ nɔ; ejakaa wa hɛ mi nɛ matsɛ ɔ ka mo, kɛ Abishai, kɛ Itai kita ngɛ ke, ‘Ye he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye niheyo Absalom ɔ awi.’ Kaa i ya pee lɛ nɔ́ yayami ko, nɛ munyu nɛ ɔ ba su matsɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ matsɛ tue kle he je ɔ, mo nitsɛ po o ko fa we ye he.” Yoab de lɛ ke, “I pa be be ko puɛe ngɛ o he hu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya ngɔ akplɔ etɛ, nɛ e fɔ kɛ gbɔ Absalom gugue mi, be mi nɛ e kplaa si ngɛ tso ɔ mi nɛ e gbo we lolo ɔ. Jehanɛ nihewi nyɔngma, nɛ ji Yoab ta hwumi ní hɛɛli ba bɔle Absalom; nɛ a fia lɛ ní, nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yoab kpa titimati ɔ, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ jɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a se nyɛɛmi, nɛ a kpale kɛ ba.
A je Absalom nɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ muɔ agbo ko mi ngɛ hue ɔ mi, nɛ a muɔ tɛ babauu ngɔ pue e nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ pue lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi blɔ.
Benɛ Absalom ngɛ je mi ɔ, e ma kaimi titima ko kɛ ha e he ngɛ Matsɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi; ejakaa e de ke, “I be binyumu ko nɛ a kɛ ma kai ye biɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ wo titima a; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, a tsɛɛ lɛ Absalom kaimi nɔ́.
A ya bɔ David Absalom gbenɔ ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Zadok bi Ahimaaz de Yoab ke, “Ha nɛ ma tu fo nɛ ma ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ kaa Yawɛ wo lɛ nguɔ, nɛ e je lɛ kɛ je e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Se Yoab de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi!
Ko ya bɔ lɛ amaniɛ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Ligbi kpa konɛ o ya bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ɔ, se pi mwɔnɛ ɔ; ejakaa matsɛbi ɔ yi ta.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoab de nyumu ko nɛ je Kush ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ nɛ o na kɛ o hɛngmɛ.” Kush no ɔ kpla si ngɛ Yoab hɛ mi, kɛkɛ nɛ e sa fo kɛ je.
Ahimaaz, Zadok bi ɔ kpale de Yoab ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nɛ e ba!
Ha nɛ imi hu ma gbɔ fo kɛ nyɛɛ Kush no ɔ se.” Yoab de lɛ ke, “Ye bi, mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ hlae doo kaa mo hu o maa ya a?
O be hiɔwo ko nae ngɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ maa ya a he oo!” Se Ahimaaz de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nɛ e ba!
Ma gbɔ fo kɛ ya!” Yoab de lɛ ke, “Moo ya koo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Ahimaaz wo fo kɛ gu nga a nɔ blɔ, nɛ e ya be Kush no ɔ nya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, David hii si ngɛ he ko ngɛ ma agbo enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bulɔ ɔ kuɔ gbogbo ɔ nɛ e ya da si ngɛ agbo ɔ yi mi.
Benɛ e maa hyɛ ɔ, nyumu ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ lɛ nɔ kake too e ngɛ fo tue kɛ ma.
Bulɔ ɔ kpa ngmlaa nɛ e kɛ de matsɛ ɔ. Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ke nɔ kake ɔ, lɛɛ e hɛɛ amaniɛ kɛ ma.” Benɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ su a ngɔ ta a, Bulɔ ɔ na nɔ kpa ko nɛ lɛ hu e ngɛ fo tue kɛ ma.
Bulɔ ɔ kpa ngmlaa kɛ je agbo ɔ yi mi he nɛ e daa si ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, nɔ kpa ko hu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ lɛ nɔ kake too e ngɛ fo tue kɛ ma!” Matsɛ ɔ de ke, “Lɛ hu e hɛɛ amaniɛ kɛ ma.” Bulɔ ɔ de ke, “E peeɔ mi kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ hɛ mi ɔ ngɛ fo tue kaa Zadok bi Ahimaaz.” Matsɛ ɔ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ manye munyu kɛ ma.” Ahimaaz kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Manye oo, manye!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e de ke, “Nɛnɛ!
A je Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ yi.
Nihi nɛ te si ngɔ wo mo ɔ, Yawɛ ha o ye a nɔ.” Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Niheyo Absalom ɔ ngɛ saminya lo?” Ahimaaz he nɔ ke, “Benɛ o tsɔlɔ Yoab tsɔ mi ɔ, i na kaa lejɛ ɔ pee gidigidi wawɛɛ nitsɛ; se i li nɔ́ nɛ ba.” Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ba be nɛ o ya da si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!” Nɛ e ho ya da si dii.
E kɛ we nɛ Kush no ɔ hu ba nɛ e ba de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, mo he manye!
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ je mo kɛ je nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ te si ngɔ wo mo ɔ a dɛ mi.” Matsɛ ɔ bi Kush no ɔ ke, “Niheyo Absalom ɔ ngɛ saminya lo?” Kush no ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i ná nɛ a pee o he nyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ te si ngɔ wo mo, ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee jamɛ a niheyo ɔ pɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ dɔ, nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ho e se tsu ɔ mi ya ngɛ agbo ɔ yi mi nɛ e ya fo ya.
Benɛ e yaa a, e ngɛ ya foe nɛ e ngɛ dee ke, “Ao, ye bi ɔ!
Ye bi Absalom!
Ye bi Absalom!
I na nɛ imi mohu i gbo ngɛ o nane mi.
Absalom, ye bi, ye bi!”
Yoab ka David hɛ mi A ya bɔ Yoab amaniɛ ke matsɛ ɔ ngɛ ya foe, nɛ e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ha Absalom.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ manye yemi ɔ plɛ pee kɔmɔ yemi kɛ ha ma a tsuo; ejakaa ma a nu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kaa matsɛ ɔ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ha e bi ɔ. Tabo ɔmɛ nyɛɛ blɛuu blɛuu kɛ ba sɛ ma a mi kaa nihi nɛ tu fo ngɛ ta nya, nɛ́ zo ngɛ mɛ pee.
Matsɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ́ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ e fo ya boboobo, nɛ e de ke, “Ao ye bi ɔ!
Ye bi Absalom!
Ye bi Absalom!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoab ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ he mo, kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, o biyi ɔmɛ, o yi ɔmɛ, kɛ o plã amɛ a yi wami ɔ, o pue mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi si, ejakaa o suɔ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ mo, nɛ o nyɛɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ mo mohu.
O tsɔɔ paa mwɔnɛ ɔ kaa o tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ o tabo ɔmɛ ɔ, a pi ni komɛ kulaa ha mo; ejakaa i kpa si mwɔnɛ ɔ kaa e ji Absalom yi na wami, nɛ wɔ tsuo wa gbo jinɛ e ko ngɔ o nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si esɔ, nɛ o ya nɛ o ya jɔɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ a bua.
I na Yawɛ kaa ke o yɛ ɔ, nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ke e piɛ nyumu kake ngmelu ngɛ o he fii!
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee haomi agbo kɛ ha mo pe haomi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ba o nɔ kɛ je o nihe mi kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ te si nɛ e ho ya hi si ngɛ ma agbo ɔ nya.
Nɛ benɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo nu kaa matsɛ ɔ hii si ngɛ ma agbo ɔ nya a, mɛ tsuo a ya na lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. David kpale e se kɛ yaa Yerusalem Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ tu fo kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya.
Ngɛ Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, ni ɔmɛ kɛ a he bɔni pɛmi nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “Matsɛ David je wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ e kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Absalom fie lɛ kɛ je ma a mi.
Absalom ɔ nɛ wa pɔ lɛ nu nɛ wa wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e gbo ngɛ ta mi.
Mɛni he je nɔ ko yɛ nɛ e ya ngɔ Matsɛ David ɔ kɛ ba mɔ?” Benɛ Matsɛ David nu nɔ́ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ɔ, e tsɔ osɔfo Zadok kɛ osɔfo Abiatar ke a ya nɛ a ya bi Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ mohu nyɛ de we kekle ke nyɛ yaa ngɔ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ba we ɔ?
Ye nyɛmimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ji nyɛ; mɛni he je nyɛ mohu nyɛ de we kekle ke nyɛ ma ba ngɔ mi kɛ ba we ɔ?” David sɛ mɛ ke a ya de Amasa hu ke, “Ye nyɛmi tutuutu ji mo.
Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, i pee mo ye tabo ɔ nyatsɛ ngɛ Yoab nane mi.
Mawu nɛ fia mi nɔ nɛ e gbe ke i pee we nɔ́ nɛ ɔ!” Sɛ nɛ David kɛ mane Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ ha a yi mi plɛ, nɛ a pee kake.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ kɛ ba de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Moo kpale o se kɛ ba kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo.” Benɛ matsɛ ɔ kpale kɛ ma a, Yuda bi ɔmɛ ba kpee lɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a he.
A sɛ hlami kɛ ba Gilgal momo, konɛ a ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ po pa a. Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Benyamin no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shimei, nɛ ji Gera nɛ je Bahurim binyumu ɔ he sɔ nɛ e kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ho, nɛ lɛ hu e ya kpee Matsɛ David.
Nyumuhi akpe nɛ je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ piɛ e he kɛ ho.
Ziba nɛ ji tsɔlɔ ngɛ Saul we ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ hu e kɛ e bimɛ nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɔli nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ ho Yordan pa a nya ya loko matsɛ ɔ ya su lejɛ ɔ.
A ngɔ matsɛ ɔ we mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ po pa a; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae ɔ, a pee ha lɛ.
David na Shimei mɔbɔ Benɛ matsɛ ɔ maa ho pa a pomi ya a, Gera binyumu Shimei ya kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e nu matsɛ ɔ nane, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, yayami nɛ i pee mo ligbi ɔ nɛ o je Yerusalem ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ pa mi.
Mo ko ngɔ kɛ to ha mi, nɛ mo ko kai hu gblegbleegble.
I le kaa i pee yayami; nɛ enɛ ɔ he je nɛ imi ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ je omleyi je wɛtso ɔmɛ nɛ ji Yosef we ɔ mi kɛ ma mo nɛnɛ kpeemi mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Zeruya bi Abishai de ke, “E sa kaa a gbe Shimei, ejakaa e gbiɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ Mawu pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.” Se David de ke, “Nyɛ Zeruya bimɛ, mɛni sane nɛ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ he, loko nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ doo ye nya mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ?
Anɛ e sa kaa a gbe nɔ ko ngɛ Israel mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ lo?
Anɛ i li kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, imi ji matsɛ ngɛ Israel lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de Shimei ke, “I ngɛ mo kita kae kaa a be mo gbee!” David na Mefiboshet mɔbɔ Mefiboshet, Saul bibi ɔ hu ba nɛ e ba kpee matsɛ ɔ. Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ je Yerusalem ɔ hluu kɛ ba si ligbi nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba fiafiaafia a, Mefiboshet fɔ we e nanehi a he, e sɛ we e kpɛni; nɛ e tadehi hu e fɔ we a he.
Benɛ e je Yerusalem kɛ ba nɛ e kɛ matsɛ ɔ ba kpe ɔ, matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mefiboshet, mɛni he je nɛ o kɛ mi yɛ ɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, akpaketsɛ ji mi.
I fa ye tsɔlɔ ɔ ke e wo ye teji ɔ nɔ ní ha mi nɛ ma hi nɔ nɛ i kɛ mo nɛ ya.
Se ye tsɔlɔ ɔ sisi mi, nɛ e ba po ye nya ha mo.
Mo nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ɔ, moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kaa Mawu bɔfo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ da ha mo ɔ, moo pee.
Jinɛ tsaatsɛ we ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ sa gbenɔ; se kɛ̃ o ngɔ o tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ ní ngɛ o we okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ a he.
Lɛɛ mɛni he blɔ i ngɛ kaa ma bi nɛnɛ ekohu ke e na mi mɔbɔ?” Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “E hia we kaa o pa deɔ nɔ́ ko hu.
I to ye yi mi kaa o kɛ Ziba maa dla Saul zugba a fiee.” Se Mefiboshet de ke, “Oo, ha nɛ e ngɔ lɛ tsuo kɛkɛ; nɛ́ ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ná ba su we fiafiaafia nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ e hiɛ ha mi.” David na Barzilai mɔbɔ Jehanɛ Barzilai, Gilead no ɔ hu je Rogelim kɛ ba Yordan pa a nya, konɛ lɛ hu e ba po David pa. Barzilai ye jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ, nɛ e bwɔ kotokoto; nɛ niatsɛ ji lɛ.
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Mahanaim ɔ tsuo, lɛ nɛ e hyɛ e nɔ ngɛ niye ní blɔ fa mi.
