Matsɛ ɔ de Barzilai ke, “Ha nɛ waa ho Yerusalem ya nɛ ma ya hyɛ o nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Se Barzilai de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Dɛbi, be bɔɔ pɛ nɛ piɛ ha mi nɛ ma hi je mi; mɛni he je i kɛ mo maa ya Yerusalem mɔ?
Jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ nɛ i ye nɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ́ ko ha we mi bua jɔmi hu.
Anɛ i ngɛ lilɛ nɛ ma kɛ le nɔ́ nɛ i yeɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nuɔ a ngɔmi lo?
Aloo i ngɛ tue nɛ a kɛ buɔ lali a gbi tue lo?
Mɛni he je nɛ e sa kaa ma ba pee tlomi kɛ fɔ ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ?
Mɛni he je matsɛ maa pee nɔ́ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ to nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo nɛ i pee ha lɛ ɔ nane mi?
Oo, ma je mo blɔ kɛ po Yordan pa a kɛkɛ.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngmɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ blɔ nɛ ma kpale ye se kɛ ho, nɛ ma ya gbo ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye ma mi he nɛ a pu maa, kɛ tsaatsɛ ngɛ ɔ. O nɛ, ye binyumu Kimham ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, e ma sɔmɔ mo; o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ sa o hɛ mi ɔ, o pee ha lɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yoo, i kɛ Kimham maa ya, nɛ ma pee ha lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma bi mi ɔ, ma ha mo.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ma a, kɛ matsɛ ɔ tsuo po Yordan pa a. Matsɛ ɔ fiɔ Barzilai nya he, nɛ e gbaa lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ye sɛ, nɛ Barzilai kpaale kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya.
Israel kɛ Yuda na nya sami ngɛ matsɛ ɔ he Benɛ matsɛ ɔ po pa a ta a, Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ fa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Gilgal ya.
Kimham hu piɛ a he.
Pee se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je wa nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya ju mo, nɛ a ngɔ mo, kɛ o we ɔ ltsuo, kɛ o we bi ɔmɛ kɛ po Yordan pa a?” Yuda bi ɔmɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Matsɛ ɔ, wa weku no tutuutu ji lɛ.
Mɛni he je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ dɔɔ nyɛ?
Anɛ matsɛ ɔ jé lɛ nitsɛ e sika ko kɛ pee niye ní ha wɔ nɛ wa ye lo?
Anɛ e ha wɔ nike ní ko lo?” Israel bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Wɛtso nyɔngma lɛ ngɛ Israel; nɛ matsɛ blɔ fa mi hu wa blɔ nya hiɛ pe nyɛ.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ wɔ?
Anɛ pi wɔ nɛ wa sɛ hlami kɛ de ke a ya ngɔ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ba lo?” A hɛɛ sane nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya kɛ ba; se Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya wa pe Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Sheba tsɔ atuã E ba mi kaa yakayaka nɔmlɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sheba ba je Gilgal.
Benyamin no, Bikri bi ji lɛ.
Sheba kpa titimati nɛ e de ke, “Wa be blɔ nya ko ngɛ David ngɔ; Ishai binyumu ɔ, pi e ní yeli ji wɔ.
Israel bi, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e we mi ya!” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ gbla a he si kɛ je David he nɛ a ya nyɛɛ Bikri bi Sheba se; se Yuda bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a mɛtɛ a matsɛ ɔ he kpɛii, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se kɛ je Yordan ɔ he kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Benɛ Matsɛ David ba su e we ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, e kɛ yihi nyɔngma amɛ, nɛ ji e plahi nɛ e si nɛ a hi we ɔ nɔ hyɛe ngɛ e se ɔ ya wo tsu mi.
E hyɛɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, se e kɛ mɛ na we nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi.
A tsi a nya nɛ a hi si kaa yalɔyihi kɛ ya si a gbenɔ ligbi.
Matsɛ ɔ de Amasa ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya bua Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.” Amasa ho, konɛ e ya kpee Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba; se e se ya fia si bɔɔ, nɛ e bɛ be nɛ a to lɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de Abishai ke, “Sheba ma ba hao wɔ kulaa pe Absalom tete.
Ngɔɔ ye tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ́ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se; ke pi ja a, e ma ya sɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ ekomɛ a mi, nɛ e maa hao wɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abishai kɛ Yoab we bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Keret bi ɔmɛ kɛ Pelet bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo hia kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ nyɛɛ Sheba se.
Benɛ a su Gibeon tɛ agbo ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ Amasa ya bua.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yoab lɛɛ e wo ta hwumi tade kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ nɛ a fi e klaate nɛ ngɛ kpo mi ɔ kɛ wo he.
Benɛ e yaa a, klaate ɔ pɛne nɔ si.
Yoab de Amasa ke, “Ye nyɛmi, kɛ o ngɛ kɛɛ?” Yoab kɛ e hiɔ nine nu Amasa kpɛni, konɛ e fiɔ e nya he.
Nɛ pee ja a, Amasa nɛ́ klaate ɔ nɛ Yoab hɛɛ ngɛ e muɔ nine mi ɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ Yoab kɛ klaate ɔ gbɔ e muklii mi, nɛ e pã e mi ní kɛ pue zugba.
E gbo amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e he hia we kaa Yoab nɛ fia lɛ nɔ́ si enyɔne hu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yoab kɛ e nyɛmi Abishai pue nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ Bikri bi Sheba a se.
Yoab we bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ho ya da si ngɛ Amasa he, nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Yoab, kɛ David blɔ fa mi ɔ, e ba nɛ e ba nyɛɛ Yoab se.” Amasa hwɔɔ si ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba be nɛ na lɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ e da si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ niheyo ɔ na kaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo ba ngɛ si dae ɔ, e gbla Amasa kɛ je gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ sɛ nga a mi, nɛ e ngɔ bo ngɔ ha e nɔ.
Benɛ e je lɛ kɛ je gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ tsuo ya piɛ Yoab he nɛ a kɛ nyɛɛ Sheba se.
Sheba ya kpa Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ ya si Abel ngɛ Bet Maaka, nɛ Bikri bi ɔmɛ tsuo bua a he nya nɛ a nyɛɛ e se kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
Benɛ Yoab we bi ɔmɛ nu kaa Sheba ngɛ Abel ngɛ Bet Maaka a, a ya sa ma a yi.
A kɛ zu fia kpoku wo ma a he kɛ ya su gbogbo nɛ bɔle ma a yi mi tɔɔ, nɛ a bɔni gbogbo ɔ nɔ́ fiami, konɛ a hule lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ní lelɔ ko kpa bubuubui kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ ya de Yoab ke e ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ waa tu munyu.” Benɛ Yoab ba a, yo ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Yoab ɔ lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Ee, imi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Moo bu imi, o mawayo ɔ munyu ɔmɛ tue.” Nɛ lɛ hu e he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo tue bue.” Yo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “A pɔɔ demi blema be ɔ mi ke, ‘Ha nɛ a ya Abel nɛ a ya bi ga womi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ’; ke a pee ja kɛkɛ sane ɔ he jɔ.
Wa ma nɛ ɔ, ma nguaa ji lɛ; tue mi jɔmi ngɛ mi, nɛ e ji mahi nɛ yeɔ Israel anɔkuale ɔ a kpɛti kake.
Nɛ moo o ngɛ hlae nɛ o kpata ma a hɛ mi!
Mɛni he je o ngɛ hlae nɛ o puɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ?” Yoab he nɔ ke, “Kpaoo!
Kpaoo!
I bɛ nyɛ ma a puɛmi, aloo e hɛ mi kpatami.
Tsa pi ja ji sane ɔ. Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ke Sheba, nɛ ji Bikri binyumu ɔ nɛ je Efraim yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e te si ngɔ wo Matsɛ David.
Nyɛ je nyumu nɛ ɔ pɛ ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi, kɛkɛ ma kpale ye se!” Yo ɔ de Yoab ke, “Hyɛ, wa maa fɔ e yi kɛ gu gbogbo ɔ nɔ kɛ mane mo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ ho nɛ e ya wo ma mi bi ɔmɛ ga; nɛ a po Sheba yi nɛ a fɔ ngɔ mane Yoab.
Yoab kpa titimati, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ gbɛ kɛ je ma a he; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho e ma mi ya.
Yoab kpale kɛ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
David ma ní tsuli Yoab ji Israel tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma; Yehoyada bi Benaya ji Keret bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Pelet bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nyɛɔ a nɔ nɛ a tsuɔ ní kɛ haa ma nɛ a wui mɛ hiɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a nyatsɛ ji Adoniram.
Ahilud bi Yehoshafat ji sanehi ngmalɔ; Sheva ji pɛdiyo; Zadok kɛ Abiatar ji osɔfohi, nɛ Ira, Yair no ɔ, lɛ hu David osɔfo ji lɛ.
A gbe Saul weku kɛ nina David yi nɔ ɔ, hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ sɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David ya bi Yawɛ ga womi, nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Saul kɛ e we ɔ ye fɔ kaa a pue muɔ si; ejakaa Saul gbe Gibeon bi ɔmɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɛ Gibeon bi ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu.
Gibeon bi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, pi Israel bi ji mɛ; Amor bi nɛ piɛ ɔ ekomɛ ji mɛ.
Jinɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ka Gibeon bi kita kaa a maa baa a yi; se be mi nɛ Saul hɛ dɔ ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda he ɔ, e hla kaa e ma kpata a hɛ mi.
David bi Gibeon bi ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni ma pee ha nyɛ?
Mɛni ma ngɔ kɛ kpata nyɛ konɛ nyɛɛ gbaa Yawɛ ma a?” Gibeon bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Sane nɛ ngɛ waa kɛ Saul, kɛ e we ɔ wa kpɛti ɔ, tsa pi sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu nɛ a kɛ maa ye; jehanɛ se hu, e pi wa blɔ nya kaa wa gbeɔ nɔ ko ngɛ Israel.” David ya nɔ nɛ e bi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛni nyɛ suɔ kaa ma pee ha nyɛ mɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Saul to kaa e ma kpata wa hɛ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko nu wa he ngɛ Israel zugba amɛ ekoeko nɔ hu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, á ngɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ binyumuhi kpaago ba ha wɔ nɛ waa sɛu mɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ Gibeon, ngɛ Yawɛ yo ɔ nɔ.” Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yoo, ma ngɔ mɛ ba ha nyɛ.” Ngɛ kita nɛ David kɛ Saul bi Yonatan ka a he he je ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tɛ Yonatan bi Mefiboshet nɛ ji Saul bibi ɔ he.
Se e ngɔ Armoni, kɛ Mefiboshet nɛ ji Aya biyo Rizpa binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ Saul fɔ ɔ. Jehanɛ hu e ngɔ Saul biyo Merab binyumuwi enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ Adriel, Barzilai binyumu ɔ nɛ je Mehola fɔ ɔ. David ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Gibeon bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a ya sɛu mɛ ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ, ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Mɛ ni kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo a gbo si kake too.
Benɛ ní kpami be su, nɛ́ a bɔni ngma poomi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ nɛ a gbe ni ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Rizpa, Aya biyo ɔ ngɔ kpekpe kɛ pee bo tsu ngɛ tɛ sa a nɔ.
Nɛ kɛ je be mi nɛ a bɔni ní kpami kɛ ya si hiɔmi bɔni nɛmi ɔ, e huɔ gbogboe ɔmɛ nyɔ kɛ pia; e ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba maa a nɔ piani; nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, e fieɔ lohwe awi yeli kɛ jeɔ a he.
Benɛ a ya bɔ David nɔ́ nɛ Aya biyo Rizpa, Saul plã a pee ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya ngɔ Saul kɛ e bi Yonatan a wuhi ngɛ Yabesh Gilead bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ gbe Saul ngɛ Gilboa, nɛ a ngɔ e kɛ Yonatan kpla si ngɛ a kpe he ɔ ngɛ Bet Shan ɔ, Yabesh Gilead bi ɔmɛ ya ju mɛ.
David ya ngɔ Saul kɛ e bi Yonatan a wuhi kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ a sɛu ɔ hu a wuhi a nya.
A ya pu Saul kɛ e bi Yonatan a wu ɔmɛ ngɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ ngɛ Zela, ngɛ e tsɛ Kish yɔkɔ ɔ mi; nɛ a pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa mɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mawu bu a kue nɛ a fa kɛ ha ma a tue.
Tahi nɛ a kɛ Filisti oblai komɛ hwu Filisti bi ɔmɛ gba ta kɛ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ ekohu; nɛ David kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya hwu; se pɔ tɔ David.
Kɛkɛ nɛ oblai ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ishbibenob ɔ susu kaa e nine gbe David ta.
Ishbibenob hɛɛ akɔblee akplɔ ko nɛ e jiimi maa pee kilo etɛ kɛ fa, nɛ e fi klaate ehe hu ngɛ e mlɛ mi.
Se Zeruya bi Abishai ba piɛ David he; e tua Filisti no ɔ, nɛ e gbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David we bi ɔmɛ ka David kita ke, “O kɛ wɔ be ta yae hu gblegbleegble.
Israel hɛngmɛ ji mo; koo pee nɛ wa hɛngmɛ ɔ ba pɛ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hwu ta ekohu ngɛ Gob, nɛ Sibekai nɛ je Husha a gbe oblai ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Saf.
Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ pa hwu ta ekohu ngɛ Gob; nɛ Yair binyumu Elhanan nɛ je Betlehem ɔ gbe Goliat, Gat no ɔ nɛ e akplɔ nya tso ngɛ kaa bo lolɔ gba tso ɔ. Jehanɛ, a hwu ta ekohu ngɛ Gat, he nɛ nyumu oblai kpanaa ko ngɛ ɔ. E ngɛ nine nguɛ ekpa kɛ nane nguɛ ekpa; nɛ lɛ tsuo peeɔ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ bɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ahlua, nɛ Yonatan nɛ ji David nyɛminyumu Shama binyumu ɔ gbe lɛ.
Ni eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Gat oblaihi a nina ji mɛ; nɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ ngɛ David kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a klaate nya.
David manye la Benɛ Yawɛ je David kɛ je Saul kɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a dɛ mi ɔ, David la la nɛ ɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ: Yawɛ ji ye tɛ sa nɛ baa ye yi.
Ye Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ baa ye yi; e ngɔ nɛ i saa we ngɛ.
Ye Mawu ɔ ji ye tsɛ̃i, ye wesa he, kɛ ye mɔ; lɛ nɛ e heɔ ye yi wami.
Ma fa kue ha Yawɛ; e ma kpɔ mi ngɛ ye he nyɛli a dɛ mi.
A je Yawɛ yi.
Gbenɔ oslɔke ɔmɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe; pa yayamihi hia kɛ wo mi.
Gbenɔ oslaa amɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe, nɛ yɔkɔ hu tsɔ̃ mi klama.
Benɛ e fi mi ɔ, i fa kue ha Yawɛ; ee, i tsɛ ye Mawu ɔ. E nu ye gbi kɛ je e sɔlemi we ɔ; nɛ e bu ye kue fami ɔ tue.
Kɛkɛ nɛ zugba a mimiɛ nɛ e hoso; hiɔwe sisi tomi ɔmɛ hɛ a he, nɛ a mimiɛ; ejakaa Mawu mi mi fu!
La su ku je kpo kɛ je e gugwɔ mi; la nɛ ngɛ tsoe je e nya mi, nɛ e sã níhi.
E gba hiɔwe mi enyɔ; nɛ e nyɛɛ bɔku kpii ko nɔ kɛ ba zugba.
E hi kerub nɔ kɛ fli kɛ je; e hi kɔɔhiɔ pɛlihi a nɔ kɛ te.
E ngɔ diblii ngɔ ha e he; bɔku nɛ nyu hyi lɛ tɔ bɔle lɛ.
La nɛ pã kɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ ha je ɔ mi tsɔ heii.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ si si ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ wo gbi.
E tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ, nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa; oslabai pã la, nɛ a tu fo.
Benɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu nɛ e kuɛ wo e he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, wo nyu dɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ je kpo.
Yawɛ juale e nine kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e pɛtɛ ye he; e gbla mi kɛ je pa nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ mi.
E je mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ a dɛ mi; ejakaa a he wa tsɔ pe mi.
Benɛ i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ, a tua mi; se Yawɛ he ye yi wami.
E je mi kɛ je amanehlu mi.
E he ye yi wami, ejakaa e suɔ mi.
Ní kpakpahi nɛ i peeɔ ɔ, Yawɛ woɔ mi a he hiɔ; e gbaa mi, ejakaa i pee we nɔ ko yayami.
I ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ; i ji ye Mawu ɔ se.
I le e mlaa amɛ tsuo kulaa; i ye mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ.
E le kaa i da kɛ pi si; e le kaa i pee we yayami ko.
Yawɛ gbaa mi; ejakaa e le kaa i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; ejakaa e le kaa yayami ko be ye he.
Nihi nɛ yeɔ mo anɔkuale ɔ, mo hu o yeɔ mɛ anɔkuale; ni nɛmɛ nɛ da a, o naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, o tsɔɔ mɛ kaa o he tsɔ; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi wa lɛɛ o kɛ mɛ toɔ ní.
Nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, o heɔ a yi wami.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, o baa mɛ si.
Yawɛ, mo ji ye kane.
Ye Mawu, mo nɛ o fieɔ diblii ngɛ ye blɔ nɔ.
Mo lɛ o haa mi nɔmlɔ tso he wami nɛ i kɛ fiaa ye he nyɛli nɔ́ nɛ i gbee mɛ; kɛ mumi mi he wami nɛ i kɛ yeɔ a nɔ kunimi.
Mawu nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo da; e siwo ɔmɛ hu anɔkuale sɔuu!
E ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba saa we ngɛ e ngɔ.
Yawɛ pɛ ji wa Mawu; lɛ pɛ ji wa he bulɔ.
Mawu nɛ ɔ ji ye mɔ ngua nɛ baa ye yi.
E bli blɔ gbajaa ha mi.
E haa nɛ i nyɛɛɔ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ gɛjɛmi kaa yo nɔ apletsi, nɛ i sane we nɔɛ si.
E haa mi ta hwumi he nile, kɛ he wami nɛ ma kɛ tsɛ̃ akɔblee kɛ̃ɛ̃ po.
Yawɛ lee, o baa ye yi, nɛ o kpɔ mi; o yemi kɛ buami ɔ pee mi nɔmlɔ agbo.
O ha we nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nine nɛ su ye nɔ; i sane we nɔɛ si hyɛ.
I nyɛɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a se, nɛ i kpata a hɛ mi; i kpale we ye se kɛ ya si mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a gbo.
I fia mɛ ni, nɛ i gbe mɛ pue si ngɛ ye nane nya, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a te si hu.
Mo lɛ o ha mi he wami nɛ i kɛ hwu ta; mo lɛ o ha nɛ i ye ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
Mo lɛ o ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ je ye he; ni nɛmɛ nɛ te si ngɔ wo mi ɔ, mo lɛ o ha nɛ i kpata a hɛ mi.
A hyɛ yemi kɛ buami blɔ, se kpɔlɔ ko bɛ.
A fa kue ha Yawɛ, se e pui a nya mi.
I wɛɛ mɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ nɛ a pee kaa tabo zu; i naa a nɔ, nɛ i gbɛ mɛ fĩa kaa gbɛjegbɛ nɔ mɔsɔ.
O je mi kɛ je ye ma mi bi atuã tsɔli a dɛ mi; o baa ye yi, nɛ i ba pee je ma amɛ a nyatsɛ.
Mahi nɛ i li mɛ po ba plɛ pee ye sɔmɔli.
Ma je li maa ba ba kpla si ha mi; ke a nu ye he pɛ, a maa bu mi tue.
Sawale maa nu ma je li ɔmɛ; a kɛ he kpokpomi maa hia kɛ maa je a laami he ɔmɛ kɛ ba.
Yawɛ hɛ ngɛ!
Tɛ sa a nɛ baa ye yi ɔ, a je e yi.
Ye Mawu ɔ nɛ he ye yi wami ɔ, a wo e biɛ ta kaa e kle, nɛ e he wa.
Lɛ nɛ e ha i ye ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ e ngɔ ma amɛ ngɔ wo ye sisi, nɛ e kpɔ mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Yawɛ lee, o ha nɛ i ye ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi; o je mi kɛ je yi mi wali a dɛ mi.
Yawɛ, enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma je o yi ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti; ma la kɛ je o biɛ ɔ yi.
Mawu haa nɛ e matsɛ ɔ yeɔ kunimi nguahi.
E jeɔ e suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ David, nɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, kɛ e nina kɛ yaa neneene.
David nyagbe munyuhi Ishai binyumu David, nɔmlɔ nɛ Mawu wó e nɔ gojoo, nɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ pɔ lɛ nu; nɔ nɛ po la ngɔngɔɛhi kɛ ha Israel ɔ, e nyagbe munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yawɛ mumi ɔ tuɔ munyu kɛ guu ye nɔ, nɛ e sɛ gbi ɔ ngɛ ye nya he.
Israel Mawu ɔ tu munyu, Tɛ sa a nɛ heɔ Israel yi wami ɔ de mi ke, “Nɔ nɛ kɛ dami sane yemi yeɔ nihi a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ Mawu gbeye yemi yeɔ ma nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa pu nɛ ngɛ tsoe mɔtu be mi nɛ bɔku be hiɔwe; aloo hiɔmi nɛ haa nga tsɛ̃ɔ kɛ jeɔ zu mi.” Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Mawu maa gbaa ye weku kɛ nina.
Mawu kɛ mi so neneene somi, somi nɛ a be mi poe gblegbleegble.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae ɔ pɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e maa pee ye kunimi yemi, nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ e ba mi.
Se yakayaka nimli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ kaa mio nɛ a sake ngɔ fɔ he, nɛ nɔ ko kɛ e nine be nyɛe maa ta he.
Nɔ nɛ maa ta he ɔ, ja e hɛɛ dade, loo akplɔ.
A kɛ la maa sã mɛ.
David ta buli kpanaa amɛ David ta buli kpanaa amɛ a biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ: Kekleekle nɔ ɔ ji Yosheb Bashebet, Takemon no ɔ; lɛ ji “Ni etɛ ɔmɛ” a nyatsɛ.
E kɛ nimli lafa kpaanyɔ ya bua si kake, nɛ e kɛ e we akplɔ ɔ gbe mɛ tsuo.
Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e se ngɛ katsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ji Eleazar, Ahohi bi Dodo bi ɔ. Ligbi ko benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya nɛ a gba ta a, Eleazar kɛ David ya tsɔ a nya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a gbla a he si kɛ je lejɛ ɔ momo.
Lɛ nɛ e da si nɛ e kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hwu ta hluu kɛ ya si e kɔni gbo; se kɛ̃ e hɛɛ e klaate ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Yawɛ ye kunimi nguaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Pee se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba he nɛ Eleazar ngɛ ɔ; nɛ a ba ha ní ngɛ ni gbogboe ɔmɛ a he.
Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ lɛ hu e se ji Shama, Harar no Agee bi ɔ. Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ Lehi, ngɛ zugba ko nɛ yɔ puɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tu fo, se Shama da si ngɛ zugba a kpɛti tutuutu, nɛ e fa zugba a he, nɛ e gbe Filisti bi ɔmɛ.
Yawɛ ye kunimi nguaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Benɛ ní kpami be su ta a, katsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni etɛ pue nɔ kɛ ya na David ngɛ Adulam tɛ puɔ ɔ mi, be mi nɛ Filisti ojo fiali a kuu ɔ hu ya bua a he nya ngɛ Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, David ngɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ mi, nɛ Filisti ta buli ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ Betlehem.
David kɛ he hiami bi ke, “Mɛnɔ po ma ya yɛ nyu ngɛ vu ɔ nɛ ngɛ agbo ɔ kasa nya ngɛ Betlehem ma a mi ɔ ba ha mi nɛ ma nu?” Katsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ pee nyumu ka; a ya gu Filisti bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a ya yɛ nyu ngɛ vu ɔ mi kɛ ba ha David.
Se e kua numi; e plɛ nyu ɔ pue si ha Yawɛ mohu, nɛ e de ke, “Kpaoo Yawɛ, kaa ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ!
Anɛ pi nihi nɛ ngɔ a wami ngɔ fɔ si ɔ a muɔ ji nɛ ɔ?” Nɛ e kua nyu ɔ numi.
Níhi nɛ katsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yoab nyɛminyumu Abishai, Zeruya binyumu ɔ ji “Ni nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ” a nyatsɛ.
Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ e we akplɔ kɛ gbe nimli lafa etɛ, nɛ e kɛ ná biɛ ngɛ katsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Katsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe mɛ tsuo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ba pee a nyatsɛ.
Se kɛ̃ e na we kekleekle ni etɛ ɔmɛ.
Yehoyada bi Benaya, Kabzeel no ɔ, lɛ hu katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji lɛ; nɛ e tsu ní tsumi nguahi.
Lɛ nɛ e gbe Ariel nɛ je Moab ɔ binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ lɛ nɔuu nɛ e ya sɛ muɔ ko mi nɛ e gbe jata ligbi ko nɛ snoo ngɛ nɛe ɔ nɛ.
Benaya nɛ ɔ nɔuu gbe Egipt no kpanaa ko.
Egipt no ɔ hɛɛ akplɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi, se Benaya ho nɛ e ya na lɛ kɛ e dɛma tso ɔ kɛkɛ.
E kpɔ akplɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e ngɔ Egipt no ɔ nitsɛ e akplɔ ɔ kɛ gbe lɛ.
Kã peemi níhi nɛ Yehoyada bi Benaya tsu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Lɛ hu e na biɛ kɛ piɛ katsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ a he.
E hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe mɛ, se kekleekle ni etɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e na we mɛ.
David kɛ lɛ pee e we bi a tabo ɔ nyatsɛ.
-Katsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ji: Asahel, Yoab nyɛminyumu ɔ; Elhanan, Dodo nɛ je Betlehem ɔ bi ɔ; Shama kɛ Elika nɛ a je Harod ɔ; Helez nɛ je Pelet ɔ; Tekoa no, Ikesh bi Ira; Abiezer, Anatot no ɔ; Mebunai, Husha no ɔ; Zalmon, Aho no ɔ; Maharai, Netofa no ɔ; Netofa no, Baana binyumu Heleb; Ribai nɛ je Gibea ngɛ Benyamin ɔ binyumu Itai; Benaya, Piraton no ɔ; Hidai nɛ je kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Gaash kasa nya a; Abialbon, Araba no ɔ; Azmavet, Bahurim no ɔ; Eliaba, Shaalbon no ɔ; Yashen binyumu ɔmɛ; Yonatan; Shama, Harar no ɔ; Sharar nɛ je Harar a binyumu Ahiam; Ahasbai nɛ je Maaka a binyumu Elifelet; Ahitofel nɛ je Gilo ɔ binyumu Eliam; Hezro, Karmel no ɔ; Paarai, Arab no ɔ; Natan nɛ je Zoba a binyumu Igal; Bani, Gad no ɔ; Zelek, Amon no ɔ; Naharai, Beerot no ɔ nɛ lɛ ji Zeruya bi Yoab ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ; Ira kɛ Gareb nɛ a je Yatir ɔ; Uria, Hit no ɔ. Katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a yibɔ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaago.
David kane ma a Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel ekohu, nɛ e ha David kɛ haomi ba ma a nɔ.
Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya kane Israel kɛ Yuda!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ de e tatsɛ Yoab, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kpa Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ je Dan hluu kɛ yaa si Beersheba, nɛ nyɛɛ kane ni ɔmɛ, konɛ ma le ma a yibɔ.” Yoab bi matsɛ ɔ ke, “Ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa ngɔ nimli kaa ma a hiɛmi totoe lafa ngɔ piɛ ma a he, nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hɛngmɛ po, mɛni bua jɔmi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha mo?” Se matsɛ ɔ gbi ye Yoab kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ Yoab kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ je matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ho, konɛ a ya kane Israel ma a.
A po Yordan pa a, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Aroer leneyi je, nɛ ji ma nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Gad zugba a nɔ ɔ. Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho Yazer ya, nɛ a ya su Gilead kɛ Kadesh ngɛ Hit bi a zugba a nɔ.
A je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Dan ya; nɛ́ a je Dan ɔ, a lɔgɔ si kɛ ho Sidon ya.
A nyɛɛ hluu kɛ ya su Tiro ma a nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ, kɛ Hiv bi, kɛ Kanaan bi a ma amɛ tsuo a mi.
Nyagbe ɔ, a ya su Beersheba, ngɛ Yuda leneyi je.
Benɛ a ya kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem nyɔhiɔ nɛɛ kɛ ligbi nyingmi enyɔ se.
A ba bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ke a kane nyumuhi nɛ a he wa, nɛ a su ta yami akpe lafa kpaanyɔ ngɛ Israel, kɛ akpe lafa enuɔ ngɛ Yuda.
Benɛ David kane ni ɔmɛ se ɔ, e he nile hao lɛ; nɛ e de Yawɛ ke, “I pee yayami agbo kaa i tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ pa mi.” Benɛ David te si mɔtu ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi ngɔ ha gbalɔ Gad, David ní nalɔ ɔ ke e ya de David ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘I ngɔ nɔ́ etɛ kɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi fɔe.
Moo hla kake nɛ ma pee ha mo.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ Gad ba David ngɔ nɛ e ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ, nɛ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o suɔ kaa hwɔ nɛ ba o zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ, aloo o he nyɛli nɛ a nyɛɛ o se, nɛ o hi fo tue ngɛ a hɛ mi nyɔhiɔ etɛ, aloo gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ ba zugba a nɔ ligbi etɛ?
Mo susu he, konɛ o tsɔɔ mi heto nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ya ha nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ.” David de Gad ke, “Sane nɛ ɔ he wa ha mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ!
Se kɛ̃ i be suɔe nɛ nimli adesahi nɛ a gbla ye tue.
Ha nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ gbla wa tue, ejakaa mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ha gbenɔ hiɔ ba Israel kɛ je mɔtu kɛ ya si be nɛ a to ɔ; nɛ kɛ je Dan hluu kɛ ya si Beersheba a, nimli akpe nyingmi kpaago sɔuu gbo.
Benɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ maa ho Yerusalem hɛ mi kpatami ya a, Yawɛ tsake e yi mi nɛ e to kaa e maa gbla ni ɔmɛ a tue ɔ, nɛ e de bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a hɛ mi kpatae ɔ ke, “E hiɛ.
Mo kpa!” Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɛ Yebus no, Arauna ngma gbeemi he ɔ kasa nya.
David na bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ́ fiae, nɛ e de Yawɛ ke, “O nɛ, imi lɛ i pee yayami ɔ nɛ; imi lɛ i tɔ̃.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kpoo kaa jijɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ mɛni a pee?
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbla i kɛ ye weku li kɛkɛ wa tue.” Gad ba David ngɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ Yebus no, Arauna ngma gbeemi he ɔ.” David bu Yawɛ fami ɔ tue, nɛ e ho kaa bɔ nɛ Gad de lɛ ɔ. Benɛ Arauna ke e hyɛɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ji nɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ma.
Arauna je kpo nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu zugba, nɛ e bi ke, “Mɛni ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ma peemi ngɛ e tsɔlɔ ngɔ?” David he nɔ ke, “I ma o ngma gbeemi he ɔ hemi, nɛ ma ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ nɔ ha Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se nɛ po.” Arauna de David ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ muɔ o hɛ ɔ, moo ngɔ nɛ o kɛ sã bɔ ɔ. Nahi nɛ o kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; jehanɛ, na kuɛpã tso, kɛ ngma gbeemi tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa pee lɛ́ ɔ hu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.” Arauna ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ he o bɔ sami ɔ.” Se matsɛ ɔ de Arauna ke, “Dɛbi, ma wo mo hiɔ; i kɛ níhi nɛ i na yaka be sami bɔ sãe ha Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ David ngɔ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enuɔ kɛ he ngma gbeemi he ɔ, kɛ na amɛ.
E puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ e sã sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi.
Yawɛ bu e kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po ngɛ Israel.
NYA TSƆƆMI Níhi nɛ ngɛ Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Kekleekle Womi ɔ mi ji Israel ma a blema sanehi nɛ kɔɔ matsɛ yemi he.
Wa naa sane nɛ ɔmɛ a sisije ngɛ Samuel womi ɔmɛ a mi.
A dla Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Kekleekle Womi ɔ mi etɛ: Salomo matsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda ma amɛ a nɔ, kɛ e tsɛ David gbenɔ.
Salomo matsɛ yemi kɛ e ni tsumihi, titli ɔ, Yawɛ we ɔ mami ngɛ Yerusalem.
Bɔ nɛ ma a mi gba enyɔ, nɛ e pee omleyi je ma, kɛ leneyi je ma, kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba ye ma amɛ a nɔ hluu kɛ ya si jeha lafa nɛɛ loko a fɔ Kristo ɔ. Ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a womi enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ matsɛ ko yeɔ Mawu anɔkuale ha a, nɛ a kɛ naa kaa matsɛ kpakpa, aloo matsɛ yaya ji lɛ; ma a nɔ yami daa si ngɛ kikɛmɛ anɔkuale yemi nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jã nɔuu ji bɔ nɛ wɔ jami, kɛ atuã tsɔmi haa haomi baa ma a nɔ.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba ye omleyi je zugba a nɔ ɔ, nimli yayamihi ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba ye leneyi je zugba a nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ ekomɛ hi, nɛ ekomɛ hu hí.
Nihi nɛ a ní tsumi jeɔ kpo ngɛ Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Kekleekle Womi ɔ mi ji Yawɛ gbali ɔmɛ.
Mɛ ji katsɛmɛ nɛ Mawu tuɔ munyu kɛ guɔ a nɔ kɛ bɔɔ ma a kɔkɔ ke a ko ja wɔ, nɛ́ a ko tsɔ Mawu hɛ mi atuã hulɔ.
Eliya kɛ Baal gbali ɔmɛ a he sane ɔ ji sane titlii ko nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
A naa sane nɛ ɔ ngɛ yi .
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha David matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe .—.
A wo Salomo matsɛ .- Salomo matsɛ yemi .—.
a. Sisije be ɔmɛ .—.

A ma Yawɛ we ɔ .—.
d. Nyagbe be ɔmɛ .—.
Matsɛ yemi ɔ mi gba .—.
a. Omleyi je wɛtso ɔmɛ tsɔ atuã .—.
b. Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ .—.
d. Gbalɔ Eliya .—.

ɛ. Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Ahazia .-
Matsɛ David bwɔbwɔɛ si Jehanɛ Matsɛ David ba bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ a kɛ kuutuhi haa e he; se kɛ̃ ɔ, fĩɛ yee lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e tsɔli ɔmɛ ba de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, ha nɛ wa ya hla yiheyo ko kɛ ba ha mo, nɛ e ba hyɛ mo.
E ma ba hwɔ o kasa nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o he nɛ dɔ la.” A ya kpa Israel zugba a nɔ tsuo kaa a maa na yiheyo ko nɛ he ngɛ fɛu lo, kɛ ya si a ya na Abishag ngɛ Shunem; nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ha matsɛ ɔ. Yiheyo nɛ ɔ he ngɛ fɛu saminya.
E ba hi matsɛ ɔ he, nɛ e hyɛ lɛ, se matsɛ ɔ tɛ e he.
David se yelɔ - Absalom senɔ Adoniya, nɛ ji David yo, Hagit binyumu ɔ ba bɔni e he nɔ womi, nɛ e fia pɛɛ si kaa ja e ye matsɛ kokooko.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e dla e he kɛ ta zugba lɛhi, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ nyumuhi nyingmi enuɔ nɛ a maa hi fo tue kɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi.
Adoniya he ngɛ fɛu saminya; e wami be mi tsuo e tsɛ kã we e hɛ mi hyɛ.
E kɛ Zeruya binyumu Yoab, kɛ osɔfo Abiatar sɛɛ e yi mi tomi ɔ he ní, nɛ a kplɛɛ kaa a maa piɛ e he.
Se osɔfo Zadok, Yehoyada binyumu Benaya, gbalɔ Natan, Shimei, Rei, kɛ nyumuhi katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ David ngɛ ɔ, mɛɛ a piɛ we Adoniya he.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Adoniya ya gbe to, na, kɛ lohwehi nɛ wo zɔ ngɛ tɛ sa ko nɛ a tsɛɛ sinɔ tɛ sa a nɔ, ngɛ Enrogel kasa nya; nɛ e kpee e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ji Matsɛ David binyumu kpa amɛ, kɛ matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ je Yuda a.
Se e tsɛbinyumu Salomo, gbalɔ Natan, Benaya, kɛ nyumuhi katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e kpee we mɛ.
A wo Salomo matsɛ Kɛkɛ nɛ Natan ya de Salomo nyɛ Batsheba ke, “Anɛ o le kaa Hagit binyumu Adoniya ngɛ matsɛ yee be mi nɛ wa nyɔmtsɛ David li he nɔ́ ko lo?
Ha ma wo mo ga nɛ o kɛ he mo nitsɛ o yi wami, kɛ o bi Salomo hu yi wami.
Yaa Matsɛ David ngɔ esɔ, nɛ o ya de lɛ ke, ‘Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ!
Anɛ o ka we mi kita kaa ye bi Salomo ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ o se lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ Adoniya ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ?’ ” Natan ya nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Be mi nɛ o kɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, ma nyɛɛ o se kɛ ba, nɛ ma ba ma nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma de ɔ nɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Batsheba ho ya na matsɛ ɔ ngɛ e se tsu mi.
Matsɛ ɔ bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ Shunem yiheyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Abishag ɔ ngɛ lɛ hyɛe.
Batsheba kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ Matsɛ David bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae?” E he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ!
O wo mi si veveeve ngɛ o Mawu ɔ biɛ mi kaa ye bi Salomo ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ o se.
Se Adoniya ba bɔni tsɛ yemi momo be mi nɛ o li he nɔ́ ko.
E gbe to, na, kɛ lohwehi nɛ wo zɔ babauu, nɛ e kpee o binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, osɔfo Abiatar, kɛ o tatsɛ Yoab; se o bi Salomo lɛɛ e kpee we lɛ.
Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, Israel ma a tsuo ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe nɛ o tsɔɔ mɛ nɔ nɛ maa ye tsɛ ngɛ o se.
Ke o pee we ja, nɛ hwɔɔ se o ba gbo ɔ, a kɛ imi, kɛ ye bi Salomo maa ye kaa nɔ se blɔ tsɔɔli.” Benɛ Batsheba kɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, gbalɔ Natan ba matsɛ we ɔ mi.
A ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ke gbalɔ ɔ ba lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Natan sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya kpla si ngɛ Matsɛ David hɛ mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, anɛ o de ke Adoniya ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ o se lo?
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, e ya gbe to, na, kɛ lohwehi nɛ wo zɔ babauu.
E kpee o binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ o tatsɛ Yoab, kɛ osɔfo Abiatar; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní yee, nɛ a ngɛ ní nue, nɛ a ngɛ ose hee kɛ ngɛ dee ke, ‘Matsɛ Adoniya yi nɛ na wami oo!’ Se imi o tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ osɔfo Zadok kɛ Benaya, kɛ o bi Salomo lɛɛ e kpee we wɔ.
Anɛ nɛnɛ le sane nɛ ɔ, nɛ o ha we nɛ imi o tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ le nɔ nɛ ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ o se lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ David de ke, “Nyɛ tsɛ Batsheba ha mi!” Nɛ e ba ba da si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Matsɛ ɔ ka kita ke, “I na Yawɛ, hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ je mi kɛ je ye haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ kaa si ko nɛ i wo mo ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ke o bi Salomo maa ye tsɛ ngɛ ye se ɔ, ma ye jamɛ a si womi ɔ nɔ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ.” Batsheba kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ David tsɔ ke a ya tsɛ osɔfo Zadok, gbalɔ Natan, kɛ Yehoyada bi Benaya kɛ ba.
Benɛ a ba a, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ Salomo, kɛ ye tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ ya Gihon.
Salomo nɛ hi imi nitsɛ ye teji okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ osɔfo Zadok, kɛ gbalɔ Natan nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ, nɛ e ye Israel nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛ kpa titimati, nɛ nyɛ he ose ke, ‘Matsɛ Salomo yi nɛ na wami!’ Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e ba hi ye matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ; ejakaa i hla lɛ kaa e ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda ngɛ ye se.” Yehoyada bi Benaya he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wa maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mo, ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ hi si ɔ, e kɛ Salomo nɛ hi si ja nɔuu; nɛ e ha e yi nɔ nɛ jɔ po pe o nɔ́ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo Zadok, kɛ gbalɔ Natan, kɛ Yehoyada binyumu Benaya, kɛ matsɛ we bi a tabo ɔ ho nɛ a ya ngɔ Salomo ngɔ hi Matsɛ David teji okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya Gihon.
Benɛ a su Gihon ɔ, osɔfo Zadok ya ngɔ nu kɛ koli ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e pɔ Salomo nu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpa titimati; nɛ ma a tsuo he ose ke, “Matsɛ Salomo yi nɛ na wami oo!” Jehanɛ, ma a tsuo hwɔ lele kɛ nyɛɛ e se nɛ a kpale kɛ ba.
Benɛ a ma a tsuo, a ngɛ bɛ kpae, nɛ a ngɛ nyae hoo; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha zugba a huanya.
Adoniya kɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e kpee kɛ ya e ní yemi ɔ nu ngmlaa a, benɛ a ye ní ɔ ta pɛ.
Benɛ Yoab nu titimati ɔ pɛmi ɔ, e bi ke, “Ngmlaa nɛ ngɛ pɛe hoo ngɛ ma a mi nɛ ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ?” E nya na we nɛ e nɔ si nɛ osɔfo Abiatar bi Yonatan ba hia kpo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Adoniya de lɛ ke, “O le bami!
Ma mi nɔkɔtɔma ji mo; be nɛ ɔ mi piɔ ɔ, o hɛɛ manye munyu kɛ ba.” Yonatan he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
Pi ja ji sane ɔ. Nɛnɛ David wo Salomo matsɛ!
Nɛnɛ tsɔ osɔfo Zadok, gbalɔ Natan, Yehoyada binyumu Benaya, kɛ matsɛ we bi a tabo ɔ, nɛ a ya kpee Salomo.
A ngɔ lɛ ngɔ hi Matsɛ David nitsɛ teji okpɔngɔ nɔ, nɛ osɔfo Zadok, kɛ gbalɔ Natan ya pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ Gihon.
Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a hwɔ lele kɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ba sɛ ma a mi; nɛ ma a mi pee hoo.
Lɔ ɔ ji ngmlaa nɛ o nu ɔ nɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Salomo ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jehanɛ se hu, matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ya nɛ a ya ha Matsɛ David manye, nɛ a de lɛ ke, ‘O Mawu ɔ nɛ ha nɛ Salomo nɛ na biɛ pe mo, nɛ e yi nɔ hu nɛ jɔ pe o be ɔ mi.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ David ma e yi si ngɛ e sa a nɔ, nɛ e sɔle ke, ‘A je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi kaa e hla ye binyumu ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake kɛ ba hi ye sɛ ɔ nɔ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ; nɛ i na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ imi nitsɛ ye hɛngmɛ.’ ” Sawale nu ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Adoniya kpee kɛ ya ní yemi ɔ; nɛ a te nɛ mɛ tsuo a gbɛ fĩa.
Adoniya ye Salomo gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e ya sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya fua bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he koli ɔmɛ.
A ya bɔ Salomo amaniɛ ke Adoniya ngɛ lɛ gbeye yee, nɛ e ya sa we ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ a de lɛ ke Adoniya ke, “Kekleekle ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ Salomo nɛ ka mi kita kaa e be mi gbee.” Salomo he nɔ ke, “Ke e pee e he nɔmlɔ kpakpa a, a be e yi bwɔmi kake po he tae; ke a na nɔ́ yayami ko ngɛ e he ɔ, lɛɛ a maa gbe lɛ.” Matsɛ Salomo tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ Adoniya kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ ba.
Adoniya ba nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ Salomo de lɛ ke, “Yaa o we mi.”
David kɛ Salomo ye sɛ Benɛ David gbenɔ be su ɔ, e tsɛ e binyumu Salomo, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye gbenɔ be su ta.
O he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ fa mo ke o pee ɔ, o pee.
Ye e mlaa amɛ, kɛ e fami ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ he tsuaa he nɛ o maa gu ɔ, o nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ke o bu Yawɛ tue ɔ, si ko nɛ e wo benɛ e de mi ke, ke ye binyumu ɔmɛ maa hyɛ a he nɔ saminya, nɛ a maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ anɔkuale mi kɛ a tsui tsuo, kɛ a klaa tsuo ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ maa hi Israel matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ be mi bɔe ɔ, Yawɛ hu maa ye jamɛ a e siwo ɔ nɔ.
“Jehanɛ se hu, o kai nɔ́ nɛ Yoab pee mi ɔ; bɔ nɛ e gbe Israel tatsɛmɛ enyɔ, nɛ ji Ner binyumu Abner, kɛ Yeter binyumu Amasa.
O kai bɔ nɛ e gbe mɛ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi be mi kɛ to nihi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a gbe ngɛ ta be mi ɔ a nya a. E pue nihi nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ a muɔ si, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba pee tlomi kɛ ha imi mohu, nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ he.
Ní lelɔ ji mo, nɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ o pee; ko ha nɛ e gbo lɛ nitsɛ e gbenɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
“Gilead no Bazilai binyumu ɔmɛ lɛɛ, naa mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ ní ngɛ o we okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ a he; ejakaa benɛ i ngɛ o wetsɛ Absalom nya fo tue ɔ, mɛ lɛ a na mi mɔbɔ.
“Jehanɛ, Gera binyumu Shimei nɛ je Bahurim ma a mi ngɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ hu ngɛ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ gbiɛ mi kadikadi ligbi ɔ nɛ i ya Mahanaim ɔ nɛ.
Se benɛ e kɛ mi ba kpe ngɛ Yordan pa a nya a, i ka lɛ kita ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ke i be lɛ gbee.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ko ha nɛ e ye e he.
Ní lelɔ ji mo, nɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ o pee; hyɛ nɛ a gbe lɛ.” David gbenɔ David ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi.
E ye Israel nɔ matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ; e hi Hebron jeha kpaago, nɛ e hi Yerusalem hu jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ etɛ.
Salomo ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ David se, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ma si saminya.
Adoniya gbenɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, Adoniya nɛ a tsɛɛ e nyɛ ke Hagit ɔ, ba Salomo nyɛ Batsheba ngɔ.
Batsheba bi lɛ ke, “O ba kɛ tue mi jɔmi lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Ee!
Se i ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ma de mo.” Batsheba de lɛ ke, “Mo de!” Adoniya de lɛ ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, jinɛ imi lɛ i yeɔ matsɛ; Israel ma a tsuo hyɛ blɔ kaa imi lɛ ma ba ye matsɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se e ya bɛ lɛ ja, nɛ ye senɔ mohu ba ye matsɛ; ejakaa Yawɛ lɛ ha nɛ e ba mi ja.
Se i ngɛ nɔ́ kake nɛ ma bi mo; mo ko kua.” Batsheba de lɛ ke, “Mo bi mi faa.” Adoniya de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o de Matsɛ Salomo nɛ e kɛ Shunem yiheyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abishag ɔ ha mi nɛ ma ngɔ.
I le kaa ke moo o bi lɛ ɔ, e be kuae.” Batsheba de lɛ ke, “Saminya, i kɛ o hiami nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ya fɔ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Batsheba ho matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ́ e kɛ lɛ ya sɛɛ Adoniya hiami nɔ́ ɔ he ní.
Matsɛ ɔ te si nɛ e kɛ e nyɛ ɔ ya kpe, nɛ e kpla si ngɛ e nyɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho ya hi e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ha a kɛ sɛ kpa ba ha e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ e hi nɔ ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Batsheba de ke, “I kɛ hiami nɔ́ nyafii ko ma o hɛ mi fɔmi nɛ o pee ha mi; mo ko kua.” Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Maa, mo bi mi faa; i be kuae.” Batsheba de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ Shunem yiheyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abishag ɔ kɛ ha o nyɛminyumu Adoniya nɛ e ngɔ.” Matsɛ Salomo bi e nyɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni he je o bi mi ke ma ngɔ Abishag kɛ ha Adoniya a?
Bi nɛ ma ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ hu ngɔ ha lɛ mɔ.
Wa wetsɛ ji lɛ!
Pi kɛ ha lɛ pɛ; se mohu bi kɛ ha osɔfo Abiatar, kɛ Zeruya binyumu Yoab hulɔ!” Jehanɛ Matsɛ Salomo ka Yawɛ kita nɛ e de ke, “I na Mawu kaa ke Adoniya kɛ e wami ha we ngɛ munyu nɛ e tu nɛ ɔ he fii, Mawu nɛ gbe mi!
Yawɛ ngɔ mi ngɔ hi tsaatsɛ David sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ ye e siwo nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha imi, kɛ ye nina.
I na Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ kaa ja Adoniya gbo mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔuu!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Salomo tsɔ Yehoyada binyumu Benaya, nɛ e ya fia Adoniya nɔ́ nɛ e gbe lɛ.
A je Abiatar we Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Salomo de osɔfo Abiatar ke, “Moo ho mo nitsɛ o ma mi ya ngɛ Anatot.
Jinɛ e sa kaa a gbe mo, se i be hae nɛ a gbe mo piɔ; ejakaa benɛ o kɛ tsaatsɛ David ngɛ ɔ, mo lɛ o hyɛɛ Yawɛ Mawu somi daka a nɔ.
Jehanɛ se hu, amanehlu slɔɔtohi tsuo nɛ tsaatsɛ na a, o kɛ lɛ nɛ na.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Salomo kpa Abiatar osɔfo yemi, nɛ e yi osɔfo ha Yawɛ hu; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Shilo ngɛ osɔfo Eli, kɛ e nina a he ɔ ba mi.
Yoab nu sane nɛ ba a.
(Lɛɛ e fi Adoniya se, se pi Absalom).
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tu fo ya sɛ Yawɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ya fua bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he koli ɔmɛ.
Benɛ a ya bɔ Matsɛ Salomo amaniɛ ke Yoab tu fo ya sɛ Yawɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya sa we ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, Salomo tsɔ Yehoyada binyumu Benaya ke e ya fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbe.
Benaya ya Yawɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya de Yoab ke, “Matsɛ ɔ fa ke, o je kpo nɛ o ba!” Yoab he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, ma gbo ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Benaya kpale kɛ ho matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya ya de lɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yoab de ɔ. Salomo de lɛ ke, “Moo pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yoab de ɔ. Yaa fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ o gbe, nɛ o pu lɛ nɛ o kɛ je muɔ ɔ nɛ Yoab pue si yaka a he sɔ̃ ɔ kɛ je i kɛ tsaatsɛ we ɔ wa nɔ.
Yawɛ maa wo Yoab hiɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ e gbe nɛ tsaatsɛ David li he nɔ́ ko ɔ a he.
Yoab gbe nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ a da pe lɛ yaka gu.
Mɛ ji Israel tatsɛ Abner, Ner binyumu ɔ, kɛ Yuda tatsɛ Amasa, Yeter binyumu ɔ.
A muɔ yi sɔ̃ ɔ maa ba Yoab kɛ e nina a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Se David kɛ e nina nɛ ma ba hi e sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ Yawɛ ma ha mɛ tue mi jɔmi kɛ maa ya neneene.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehoyada binyumu Benaya ya sɛ Yawɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e fia Yoab nɔ́ nɛ e gbe, nɛ e ya pu lɛ ngɛ e we mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Matsɛ ɔ wo Yehoyada binyumu Benaya tatsɛ ngɛ Yoab nane mi, nɛ e ngɔ osɔfo Zadok hu ngɔ to osɔfo Abiatar blɔ he ɔ. Shimei gbenɔ Pee se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɔ ya tsɛ Shimei kɛ ba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ba ma tsu ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ o hi mi.
Koo je hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ya he ko he ko.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ o maa je hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o maa po Kidron pa a, ná nɛ o le kaa ja o gbo, nɛ sɔ̃ ɔ maa tloo mo nitsɛ.” Shimei he nɔ ke, “Saminya!
Ma pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ.” Nɛ Shimei hi Yerusalem be babauu.
Se jeha etɛ se ɔ, Shimei nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni enyɔ tu fo kɛ ho Gat matsɛ, Akish, Maaka binyumu ɔ ngɔ ya.
Benɛ Shimei nu kaa e nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Gat ɔ, e mia e teji ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Akish ngɔ ya ngɛ Gat, nɛ́ e ya hla mɛ.
E ya na mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ kpale kɛ ba we.
Benɛ Salomo nu nɔ́ nɛ Shimei pee ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ i ha we nɛ o ka Yawɛ kita kaa o be Yerusalem jee gblegbleegble lo?
Anɛ i ha we nɛ o nu sisi faii kaa ligbi nɛ o maa je Yerusalem ɔ, ja o gbo lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o tɔ kita nɛ o ka Yawɛ ɔ, nɛ o yi mlaa a nɛ i wo mo ɔ hu nɔ ɔ?
Mo nitsɛ o le yayamihi tsuo nɛ o je blɔ pee tsaatsɛ David.
Yawɛ maa wo mo he hiɔ.
Se imi Matsɛ Salomo lɛɛ Yawɛ maa gbaa mi, nɛ e ma ha David matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ma si kpɛii kɛ maa ya neneene.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ fa Yehoyada binyumu Benaya, nɛ e je kpo nɛ e ya fia Shimei nɔ́ nɛ e gbe.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ Salomo matsɛ yemi ɔ ma si kpɛii.
Salomo bi nile Salomo ya to Egipt matsɛ ɔ ngatsɛ.
E ngɔ Farao ɔ biyo, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba hi David ma a mi kɛ ya si be nɛ e ma matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ gbe nya, nɛ́ e fia gbogbo ngɔ wo Yerusalem he.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, a na we nɛ a ma we ha Yawɛ lolo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a ya nɔ nɛ a sã bɔ ngɛ wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Salomo suɔ Yawɛ, nɛ e ye e tsɛ David mlaa amɛ a nɔ; se e gbe lohwe, nɛ e sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Salomo ya Gibeon, nɛ́ e ya sã bɔ.
Gibeon ji he nɛ wɔ piɛ nguaa a ngɛ; nɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e nɔ Salomo sã sami bɔ akpe abɔ ngɛ ba be.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Salomo ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o suɔ nɛ ma ha mo?” Salomo he nɔ ke, “O na tsaatsɛ David, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ babauu; ejakaa e ye mo anɔkuale, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e kɛ mo hi si saminya kɛ tsui mi faa.
O mɔbɔ nami nɛ se pui nɛ ɔ tsa nɔ kɛ ba si o ha lɛ binyumu nɛ ba ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ e se mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. Yawɛ ye Mawu lee, o ha nɛ i ba ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ tsaatsɛ David se, be mi nɛ jokuɛ bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ji mi, nɛ́ i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Ne mi ngɛ nimli nɛ o je blɔ hla mɛ kɛ pee mo nitsɛ o ma, nimli kpekpemi nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane mɛɔ a kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi nile nɛ ma kɛ ye o ma a nɔ ngɛ dami sane yemi mi; nɛ ma le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ a kpɛti.
Ke pi ja a, lɛɛ kɛ ma pee kɛ ye o ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛɛ?” Nɔ́ nɛ Salomo bi nɛ ɔ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu de lɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ o bi nile nɛ o kɛ ye dami sane, se o bi we ke o wami se nɛ kɛ, aloo o ma na ní, aloo a gbe o he nyɛli ha mo he je ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o bi ɔ, ma pee ha mo.
Ma ha mo nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi babauu bɔ nɛ nɔ ko hí si hyɛ nɛ e kɛ mo sɔ, nɛ o se hu nɔ ko nɔ ko ba be nae nɛ e kɛ mo maa sɔ.
Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o bi we tete hu ma ha mo; o wami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, ma ha o ma na ní, nɛ o hɛ mi maa ba nyami bɔ nɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ mo be sɔe.
Nɛ ke o maa bu mi tue, nɛ o maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o tsɛ David pee ɔ, ma ha o wami se maa kɛ.” Salomo hɛ tsɛ, nɛ e na kaa nlami lɛ e nla.
E ya Yerusalem, nɛ e ya da si ngɛ Yawɛ somi daka a hɛ mi, nɛ e sã sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngmɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo okplɔɔ.
Salomo kojo sane ko nɛ he wa Ligbi ko ɔ, yi ajuamahi enyɔ ba Matsɛ Salomo ngɔ kɛ sane ko.
Nɔ kake de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i kɛ yo nɛ ɔ tsuo ngɛ we kake mi; nɛ i ba fɔ binyumu ngɛ we ɔ mi ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Nɛ́ i fɔ se ɔ, ligbi etɛne ɔ, yo nɛ ɔ hu ba fɔ binyumu.
Wɔ ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ wa ngɛ we ɔ mi lejɛ ɔ; nɔ kpa ko piɛ we wa he.
Ligbi ko nyɔ mi ɔ, yo nɛ ɔ hwɔ e binyumu ɔ nɔ, nɛ jokuɛ ɔ gbo.
Nyɔ mi kɔ̃kɔ̃ɔ̃kɔ̃ benɛ i hwɔ mahe ɔ, yo nɛ ɔ te si nɛ e ba wo ye binyumuyo ngɛ ye kasa nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya hɔ e mi si; nɛ e wo lɛɛ e binyumuyo ɔ nɛ gbo ɔ kɛ ba hɔ ye mi si.
Mɔtu benɛ i te si nɛ ma ha ye bi ɔ nyɔ ɔ, i na kaa e gbo.
Se benɛ i hyɛ lɛ saminya a, i na kaa pi ye bi ɔ.” Se yo kaketsɛ ɔ de ke, “Dɛbi!
Ye bi ji nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ; o bi ji nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ nɛ!” Nɔ kake ɔ hu de ke, “Dɛbi!
O bi ji nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ, nɛ ye bi ji nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ!” Bɔ nɛ a hua sane ɔ he kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Salomo de ke, “Nɔ kake ke, ‘Ye bi ji nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ moo o bi ji nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ nɛ;’ nɛ nɔ kake hu ke, ‘Dɛbi, mo mohu o bi ji nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ, nɛ ye nɔ́ ji nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.’ ” Matsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Saminya, nyɛ ha mi klaate!” Benɛ a kɛ klaate ɔ ba a, e de ke, “Nyɛɛ dla bi nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ mi enyɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ fa ngɔ ha nɔ kake, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ fa hu ngɔ ha nɔ kake.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ tutuutu nɛ ji bi nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ nyɛ ɔ tsui mi sã lɛ ngɛ e bi ɔ he, nɛ e de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, koo gbe jokuɛ ɔ. Ngɔɔ lɛ ngɔ ha yo ɔ kɛkɛ.” Se yo kaketsɛ ɔ de ke, “Dɛbi!
E be ye nɔ́ pee, nɛ e be mo hu o nɔ́ pee; a dla e mi enyɔ.” Jehanɛ Salomo de ke, “Koo gbe jokuɛ ɔ!
Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ha kekleekle yo ɔ; ejakaa lɛ ji bi ɔ nyɛ nitsɛnitsɛ.” Benɛ Israel ma a tsuo nu bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Salomo buá sane ɔ he ha a, a bu lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; ejakaa a yɔse kaa Mawu ha lɛ nile nɛ e kɛ kojo ngɛ dami sane yemi nya.
Salomo tsɔli nikɔtɔma amɛ Salomo ye tsɛ kɛ ha Israel tsuo, nɛ e tsɔli nikɔtɔmahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Zadok binyumu Azaria ji osɔfo.
Matsɛ Pɛdiyohi ji Shisha binyumuhi Elihoref, kɛ Ahiya.
Sanehi ngmalɔ ji Ahilud binyumu Yehoshafat.
Tatsɛ ji Yehoyada binyumu Benaya.
Osɔfohi ji Zadok kɛ Abiatar.
Tsɔli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji Natan binyumu Azaria.
Matsɛ ga wolɔ ji osɔfo Zabud, Natan binyumu ɔ. Matsɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ji Ahishar.
Nihi nɛ a nyɛ ɔ a nɔ kɛ tsuɔ ma ní tsumi kpakpataa a a nɔ hyɛlɔ ji Abda binyumu Adoniram.
Jehanɛ, Salomo pee nyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ amlaalohi ngɛ Israel zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Mɛ lɛ a ba haa matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e we ɔ niye ní; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ba haa niye ní hlami kake ngɛ jeha mi.
Amlaalo ɔmɛ a biɛ, kɛ hehi nɛ a hyɛɛ nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Benhur nɔ́ mi ji Efraim yo ɔ nɔ.
Bendeker nɔ́ mi ji Makaz, Shaalbim, Bet Shemesh, Elon, kɛ Bet Hanan.
Benhesad nɔ́ mi ji Arubot, Soko, kɛ Hefer zugba a tsuo.
Benabinadab nɛ ngɔ Salomo biyo nɛ a tsɛɛ Tafat ɔ, e nɔ́ mi ji Dor tsuo.
Ahilud binyumu Baana nɔ́ mi ji Taanak, Megido, kɛ Bet Shan tsuo, ngɛ Zaretan kasa nya, ngɛ Yezreel leneyi je, kɛ ya pue Abel Mehola, kɛ Yokmeam.
Bengeber nɔ́ mi ji Ramot ngɛ Gilead, kɛ Manase binyumu Yair kɔpehi nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ. Lɛ kɛ̃ e nɔ́ mi ji Argob zugba a nɛ ngɛ Bashan ɔ nɛ.
Ma nguangua nyingmi ekpa ngɛ zugba a nɔ; a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he, kɛ a nya agbohi nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee.
Ido binyumu Ahinadab nɔ́ mi ji Mahanaim.
Ahimaaz nɛ ngɔ Salomo biyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Basemat ɔ, e nɔ́ mi ji Naftali.
Hushai binyumu Baana nɔ́ mi ji Asher kɛ Bealot.
Parua binyumu Yehoshafat nɔ́ mi ji Isakar.
Ela binyumu Shimei nɔ́ mi ji Benyamin.
Uri binyumu Geber nɔ́ mi ji Gilead, nɛ ji Amor Matsɛ Sihon, kɛ Bashan Matsɛ Og a zugba a. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, amlaalo kake ngɛ nɛ hyɛɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Salomo ye tsɛ ngɛ kplɔkɔtɔ mi Nimli nɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Israel ɔ hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia; a yeɔ ní, nɛ a nuɔ ní, nɛ a náá bua jɔmi.
Nɛ Salomo ye tsɛ ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ, kɛ je Yufrate pa a nya kɛ ya si Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a, kɛ ya pue Egipt bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya tɔɔ.
Je ma nɛ ɔmɛ wo tó ha lɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ e wami be ɔ tsuo.
Daa ligbi ɔ, niye ní nɛ a ngɔɔ kɛ baa matsɛ we ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ lita akpe enuɔ, kɛ blɛfo mamu lita akpe nyɔngma, nahi nɛ wo zɔ nyɔngma, kɛ nahi nɛ a lɛ mɛ ngɛ nga nɔ nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ to lafa; slo odabɔhi, adowahi, kɛ kungwɔhi nɛ wo zɔ.
Salomo ye tsɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a bonyoku je ɔ tsuo nɔ, kɛ je Tifsa hluu kɛ ya pue Gaza.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a bonyoku je ɔ sɔmɔ lɛ; nɛ e kɛ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Salomo yi nɔ ɔ, Yuda kɛ Israel tsuo hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi kɛ je Dan kɛ ya si Beersheba; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e wai tso kɛ ngmɔkɔ tso.
Salomo ngɛ okpɔngɔ tsu akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ha e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli hu akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Matsɛ Salomo ganɔhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔɔ niye ní ba haa matsɛ ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a yeɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nɔ́ baa ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ a to lɛ ɔ nɔ; nɔ ko pui mi.
Jehanɛ, ngma, kɛ nga nɛ a kɛ haa okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a he sɔɔ ɔ, ganɔ tsuaa ganɔ kɛ e nɔ́ baa be mi nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ. Mawu ha Salomo nile, nɔ́ sisi numi, kɛ juɛmi nɛ nya wa babauu nitsɛ bɔ nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale.
Salomo le ní pe ní leli nɛ ngɛ beleku je kɛ Egipt tsuo.
E le ní pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ; e le ní pe Etan, Ezrahi no ɔ; e le ní pe Mahol binyumuhi, Heman, Kalkol, kɛ Darda; nɛ e he biɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ a mi.
Salomo bu abɛ akpe etɛ, nɛ e po la akpe kɛ e nya enuɔ.
E tu tsohi a he munyu kɛ je Lebanon seda tso ɔmɛ a nɔ hluu kɛ ya si nga tsɔwi nɛ puɛɔ ngɛ gbogbohi a nɔ ɔ a nɔ.
E tu lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ, pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ sãã si, kɛ lohi a he munyu.
Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nu e nile ɔ he, nɛ a woɔ nihi blɔ kɛ yaa ya buɔ lɛ tue.
Salomo dla ní kɛ ha Yawɛ we ɔ mami Tiro matsɛ, Hiram kɛ David ɔ, huɛmɛ ji mɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, benɛ e nu kaa a pɔ Salomo nu nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ David se ɔ, e tsɔ kɛ ya ha lɛ manye.
Salomo kɛ sɛ gbi mane Hiram ke, “Mo nitsɛ o le kaa akɛnɛ tsaatsɛ David kɛ e he nyɛli nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ ngɛ ta hwue he je ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e ma tsu nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ ngɛ mi kɛ ya si be mi nɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ e ye e he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ ha mi tue mi jɔmi ngɛ ye huza amɛ a mi he tsuaa he; i be he nyɛli, nɛ nɔ ko hu ti si kɛ wui mi.
Yawɛ wo tsaatsɛ David si ke, ‘O binyumu, nɔ nɛ ma ha nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ o se ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ma tsu nɛ a ma ja mi ngɛ mi.’ I to ye yi mi kaa ma ma jamɛ a tsu ɔ ha Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ, nɛ́ a ja lɛ ngɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ a hɛ seda tsohi ngɛ Lebanon ha mi.
Ye tsɔli ɔmɛ ma ba piɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ ma wo o tsɔli ɔmɛ hiɔ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ o maa tsɔɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o le ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be Israel nɛ le tso hɛmi kɛ nyɛ Sidon bi ɔmɛ sɔ.” Benɛ Hiram nu Salomo sɛ gbi ɔ, e ná bua jɔmi babauu, nɛ e de ke, “A gbaa Yawɛ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, kaa e ha David binyumu ní lelɔ nɛ maa ye ma nguaa nɛ ɔ nɔ!” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Hiram ngɔ sɛ gbi ngɔ mane Salomo ke, “O sɛ gbi ɔ ba su mi; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ, ma pee ha mo.
Ma ha mo seda tsohi, kɛ sɛsɛo tsohi.
Ye tsɔli ɔmɛ maa muɔ tso ɔmɛ kɛ je Lebanon kɛ ba wo ɔ nya, nɛ ma ha a fi mɛ kɛ bla kɛ gu wo nɔ kɛ ya pue he nɛ o maa tsɔɔ mi.
Ma ha nɛ a pɛne kpa a ngɛ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ o ha nɛ a ba muɔ kɛ ho.
Ngɛ moo o blɔ fa mi ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ o ha ye we bi ɔmɛ niye ní.” Hiram ha Salomo seda tsohi, kɛ sɛsɛo tsohi nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ tsuo; nɛ Salomo hu ha Hiram ngma tɔni akpe enyɔ, kɛ nu nɛ a si lita akpe afa eywiɛ daa jeha kɛ ha e we bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛmi.
Yawɛ ye e siwo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ha Salomo nile.
Hiram kɛ Salomo hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi; mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a so somi.
Matsɛ Salomo hla nihi akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ je Israel tsuo kɛ ha ma ní tsumi nɛ a nyɛɔ nɔ nɔ kɛ tsuɔ kpakpataa a, nɛ e ngɔ Adoniram ngɔ pee a nyatsɛ.
E dla mɛ ngɔ wo kuu etɛ a mi.
Ke kuu kake mi bi akpe nyɔngma a ya tsu ní ngɛ Lebanon nyɔhiɔ kake ɔ, a maa kpale kɛ ba hi we nyɔhiɔ enyɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ kɛkɛ kuu enyɔne ɔ ho Lebanon ya.
Ke mɛ hu a ba pɛ kɛkɛ kuu etɛne ɔ hu ho.
Ja sɔuu a hii a sibi tsakee.
Jehanɛ hu, Salomo ngɛ tɛ gbali akpe nyingmi kpaanyɔ, kɛ tɛ tlooli akpe nyingmi kpaago ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ nihi akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa etɛ ngɔ to a nya, nɛ a hyɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ngɛ Matsɛ Salomo fami nya a, a gba tɛ kpakpa nguanguahi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ ba fia sisi tomi ha Mawu we ɔ. Matsɛ Salomo tsu mali, Matsɛ Hiram tsu mali, kɛ Gebal bi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kó tɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ́ a dla tso ɔmɛ a he kɛ ha Mawu we ɔ mami ɔ nɛ.
Salomo ma Yawɛ we ɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a we Egipt jemi se jeha lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ, nɛ ji Israel matsɛ, Salomo tsɛ yemi jeha eywiɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ziv ɔ mi ɔ, Salomo je Yawɛ we ɔ mami sisi.
We ɔ nɛ Matsɛ Salomo ma ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, e blimi gugue enuɔ, kɛ e hiɔwe yami gugue kpaago kɛ fa.
Kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi eywiɛ, kaa we ɔ blimi ɔ nɔuu; lɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ.
Salomo pee saflɛhi nɛ blɔ ngɛ a mi ngɔ wo Yawɛ we ɔ he.
E ma tsu wawihi kɛ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kpo nɔ je, ngɛ we ɔ kasa hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, kɛ se ɔ tsuo.
E ma tsu nɛ ɔmɛ siaudo etɛ; zugba tsu ɔ blimi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, kpɛti nɔ́ ɔ blimi nine mi blimi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ hiɔwe nɔ́ ɔ blimi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ.
E pee kpokuhi kɛ wo we ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e kɛ plai ɔmɛ fɔ nɔ; se e kɛ wui gbogbo ɔ mi.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Salomo pee nɛ e kɛ tsa tsu ɔmɛ kɛ wo gbogbo ɔ he.
Tɛ nɛ a kó momo ngɛ tɛ gbami he nɛ a kɛ ma tsu ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a ngɛ tsu ɔ mae ɔ, a nui hamle, loo gbiɛ, loo dade kpa ko nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Tsu tsɔwi siaudo etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ma ngɔ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ɔ, zugba nɔ́ ɔ sinya a nya fɔɔ si kɛ yaa we ɔ leneyi je; nɛ gba he tso ngɛ nɛ a kuɔɔ kɛ yaa siaudo enyɔne ɔ, kɛ etɛne ɔ a nɔ.
Benɛ Matsɛ Salomo ma we ɔ gbe nya a, e sɛu nɔ kɛ seda plai, kɛ gbegbeli.
E ma tsu tsɔwihi siaudo etɛ, nɛ e kɛ seda plai tsa mɛ kɛ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe.
Siaudo tsuaa siaudo hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma.
Yawɛ de Salomo ke, “We nɛ o ngɛ mae nɛ ɔ, ke o maa ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye fami ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ma pee ha mo kaa bɔ nɛ i wo o tsɛ David si ɔ. I kɛ ye ma Israel maa hi si, nɛ i be a he jee.” Jehanɛ Salomo ma Yawɛ we ɔ gbe nya.
Yawɛ we ɔ mi dlami Salomo ka seda gbegbeli ngɔ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ we ɔ mi je, kɛ je zugba kɛ ya ta siaudo ɔ nya; zugba a nitsɛ lɛɛ e kɛ sɛsɛo ka mi.
E ma se tsu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ we ɔ se je.
E kami ji gugue enuɔ, nɛ a kɛ seda gbegbeli po mi kɛ je siaudo ɔ nya kɛ ba ma zugba.
Tsu nɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a hɛ mi ɔ kami ji gugue nyɔngma.
Seda gbegbeli nɛ a ka ngɔ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ we ɔ mi je ɔ ha tɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; a je blɔ hlɔ tɔhi kɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ blɛke saminyawiiwi kɛ mɛtɛ he.
Salomo pee tsu ko ngɛ we ɔ kpɛti tutuutu, he nɛ a kɛ Yawɛ somi daka a maa ma.
Kpɛti tsu nɛ ɔ kami ji gugue enuɔ, e blimi gugue enuɔ, kɛ e hiɔwe yami hu gugue enuɔ; nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he.
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, a kɛ seda gbegbeli ha he.
Salomo kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha tsu ɔ mi.
E kɛ sika tsu kɔsɔkɔsɔ po piɛ ngɛ kpɛti tsu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ha lejɛ ɔ hulɔ.
E kɛ sika tsu ha we mluku ɔ tsuo he; bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a hu e kɛ sika tsu ha he.
Salomo kɛ oliv tso pee kerub enyɔ ngɔ ma he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a; kerub kake kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ.
-Kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ sɔ fiee.
Eko tsuaa eko hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ.
A ngɛ pɛli enyɔɔnyɔ; pɛli kake mi blimi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, pɛli enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tsa kɛ je hiɛ kɛ ya si hiɛ ɔ peeɔ nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ.
Salomo kɛ kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ ma a sibi a kasa nya ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a.
A gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi; kerub kake pɛli kɛ e nyɛmi nɔ́ nya ya kpe ngɛ tsu ɔ kpɛti.
Pɛli enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɔ kake nɔ́ nya sa gbogbo he ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ nɔ kake hu nɔ́ nya sa gbogbo he ngɛ hiɛ.
Salomo kɛ sika tsu ha kerub ɔmɛ a he.
A je blɔ kpɛ níhi kaa kerubhi, tã, kɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ a blɛke saminyawiiwi ngɔ mɛtɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe ngɛ we ɔ mi blɔ, kɛ kpo nɔ blɔ tsuo.
Zugba a nitsɛ po a kɛ sika tsu ha hɛ mi.
Salomo kɛ oliv tso kpɛ sinya enyɔ nɛ a bla ngɔ ma he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a we agbo ɔ nya.
Sinya yi mi tso ɔ, kɛ kasa nya ní ɔmɛ peeɔ kɔ nya enuɔ.
A je blɔ hlɔ kerubhi, tãhi, kɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ a blɛke ngɔ mɛtɛ sinya amɛ a he; a kɛ sika tsu ha sinya amɛ, tã amɛ, kɛ mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he.
Salomo ngɔ oliv tso kɛ kpɛ sinya tso kɔ nya eywiɛtsɛ kɛ ma we ɔ agbo ɔ nitsɛ nya.
E kɛ sɛsɛo kpɛ sinya blablɛ enyɔ nɛ kuɔ fɔɔ nɔ.
A je blɔ hlɔ kerubhi, tãhi, kɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ a blɛke ngɔ mɛtɛ he, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ha he.
Kue ɔ nɛ Salomo ma ngɛ we ɔ kpɛti ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ ɔ, tɛ nɛ a kó gbaka etɛ, kɛ seda plai gbaka kake nɛ a kɛ pee lɛ.
A to Yawɛ we ɔ sisi ngɛ Salomo yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ we nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ziv ɔ mi.
Salomo yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ we nyɔhiɔ kpaanyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Bul ɔ mi ɔ, a gbe Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ e he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ kaa a ma lɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jeha kpaago ji be tsuo nɛ Salomo ngɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ.
Matsɛ Salomo nitsɛ e we ɔ Salomo po lɛ nitsɛ e we hulɔ; e ngɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ etɛ kɛ gbe we ɔ nya.
-Tsuhi nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, a tsɛɛ kake ke Lebanon hue tsu.
E kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, e blimi gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, kɛ e hiɔwe yami gugue kpaago kɛ fa.
Lebanon hue tsu nɛ ɔ ngɛ seda titimahi zã etɛ nɛ a kɛ seda plaihi ma a nɔ; seda titima nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ngɛ zã tsuaa zã mi.
A kɛ seda sɛu tsu ɔ nɔ kɛ be ngɛ nito he ɔmɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ titima amɛ a nɔ ɔ. Kasa nya gbogbo enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ ɔ, saflɛhi zã etɛ ngɛ eko tsuaa eko he.
Sinya tso ɔmɛ, kɛ saflɛ tso ɔmɛ tsuo hɛɛ kɔ nya eywiɛɛywiɛ, nɛ saflɛhi zã etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo enyɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a pee mɛ hanɔhanɔ kɛ kpee a sibi.
Tsu ɔ kpa biɛ ji titimahi a kue.
E kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, e blimi gugue kpaago kɛ fa.
Kue wayoo ko kɛ e yi mi gba, kɛ titimahi ngɛ he.
Matsɛ Salomo je tsu ha matsɛ sɛ ɔ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ e hii kɛ buaa sanehi a he.
Tsu nɛ ɔ, a tsɛɛ lɛ kojomi kue; nɛ a kɛ seda ka mi kɛ je zugba kɛ ya si akpale ɔmɛ a he.
Salomo hi he ɔ nitsɛ nɛ ngɛ kue kpa ko mi ngɛ kojomi kue ɔ se ɔ, e pee lɛ kaa tsu kpa amɛ nɔuu; nɛ e po jamɛ a we ɔ eko kɛ ha e yo nɛ ji Egipt matsɛ ɔ biyo ɔ. Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ kue nguaa a, tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ a kɛ pee mɛ kɛ je sisi tomi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si siaudo ɔ he.
A susu tɛ ɔmɛ loko a kó, nɛ a kɛ sau dla a hɛ mi, kɛ a se.
Tɛ nguanguahi, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa saminya nɛ a kɛ to tsu ɔ sisi; tɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ a kami ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma kɛ ekpa, nɛ ekomɛ hu a kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ.
E nɔ nɛ a fia a, lɔ ɔ hu tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, nɛ a susu nɛ a kó, kɛ seda a kɛ pee.
Matsɛ we mi kue nguaa a, kpɛti kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ wayoo ɔ nɛ ngɛ agbo ɔ nya a, tɛ nɛ a kó gbaka etɛ, kɛ seda plai gbaka kake nɛ a kɛ pee gbogbo ɔmɛ.
Huram ní tsumi Matsɛ Salomo tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Huram kɛ je Tiro kɛ ba.
Yalɔyo ko nɛ je Naftali wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ bi ji lɛ; e tsɛ lɛɛ e je Tiro, nɛ akɔblee ga ní tsulɔ ji lɛ.
Huram hu akɔblee ga ní tsulɔ kpanaa ji lɛ; nɛ e ba Salomo ngɔ nɛ e ba tsu akɔblee ní tsumi ɔ tsuo.
Akɔblee titima enyɔ ɔmɛ Huram pee akɔblee titima enyɔ; kake hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ kɛ ekpa nɛ kpa nɛ kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ maa kpe he.
Puɔ ngɛ a mi, nɛ eko tsuaa eko timi ji nine nguɛ mi eywiɛ.
Jehanɛ, e pee akɔblee kpɔ enyɔ kɛ ma titima amɛ a yi mi; kake hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma.
E pee ya enyɔ nɛ a lo, kɛ mɔmɔ jlasi nɛ a pee kaa kɔsɔkɔsɔ ngɔ ma titima enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi mi.
E pee kpɔ kokloohi kaa tso yiblii gbaka enyɔ ngɔ wo ya a eko tsuaa eko he kɛ kpe, nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ha titima amɛ a yi mi kpɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Kpɔ ɔmɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ titima amɛ a yi mi ɔ, a pee mɛ kaa mɔmɔ, nɛ eko tsuaa eko hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ.
A pee nɔ́ kokloo ko ngɛ ya a nɛ ngɛ titima a yi mi ɔ kasa nya, nɛ lɔ ɔ mi kpɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
A pee kpɔ kokloo lafa enyɔ ngɛ gbaka enyɔɔnyɔ mi kɛ bɔle kpɔ tsuaa kpɔ.
Huram ngɔ akɔblee titima enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ma Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya; e wo nɔ́ nɛ maa si ngɛ leneyi je ɔ biɛ ke Yakin, nɛ e wo omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ biɛ ke Boaz.
Akɔblee kpɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee kaa mɔmɔ ɔ maa si ngɛ titima amɛ a yi mi.
Bɔ nɛ a pee nɛ a kɛ gbe titima amɛ a he ní tsumi nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Akɔblee nyu nɔ́ ɔ Huram pee akɔblee nyu nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kokloo, nɛ e mi kuɔmi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma.
Kɛ je e nya hiɛ kɛ ya si hiɛ ɔ, e peeɔ nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ nɛ kpa nɛ kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi ekpa maa kpe he.
A pee akɔblee tɔhi gbaka enyɔ kɛ bɔle nyu nɔ́ ɔ kuɔ si kɛ kpe; a sile akɔblee kɛ pee mɛ kɛ nyu nɔ́ ɔ tsuo kake.
Nyu nɔ́ ɔ maa si ngɛ akɔblee na nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ a nɔ; etɛ plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee omleyi je; etɛ plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee bonyoku je; etɛ plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee leneyi je, nɛ etɛ hu plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee beleku je.
Mɛ tsuo a plɛ a se ngɔ wo nyu nɔ́ ɔ. Nyu nɔ́ ɔ timi ngɛ kaa dɛ mi blimi.
A pee e nya kaa bɔ nɛ kplu nya ngɛ ɔ, kaa mɔmɔ nɛ blɛke, nɛ nyu maa pee buɛ akpe enyɔ lɛ yaa mi.
Akɔblee tlɔɔke ɔmɛ Huram pee akɔblee tlɔɔke nyɔngma; tlɔɔke kake kami ji nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ, e blimi nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ, kɛ e hiɔwe yami nine mi blimi ekpa.
Bɔ nɛ e pee mɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: e pee akɔblee ní komɛ kɔ nya eywiɛɛywiɛ nɛ a kɛ hɔɔ akɔblee sinya tsohi a mi.
E pee jatahi, na kuhi, kɛ kerubhi ngɛ akɔblee ní kɔ nya eywiɛɛywiɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ e pee mɔmɔ jlasi saminyawiiwi ngɛ jata amɛ, kɛ na ku ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ hɛ mi, kɛ se tsuo.
Tlɔɔke tsuaa tlɔɔke ngɛ nane eywiɛ kɛ a mi tsohi nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee.
E sile akɔblee ngɔ mɛtɛ tlɔɔke tsuaa tlɔɔke kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ́ a kɛ kã maa ma nɔ; e pee mɔmɔ jlasi ngɔ wo eko tsuaa eko he.
E pee kla lokotoo ko nɛ maa hɛɛ kã a ngɔ ma nɔ.
E nya je kpo ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ yi mi nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e sɛ mi nine mi blimi etɛ; nɛ e pee afɛu níhi kɛ bɔle kla a kɛ kpe.
Nane eywiɛ ngɛ tlɔɔke kake sisi, nɛ a pee tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nane ɔmɛ a he ɔ kɛ tsa tlɔɔke ɔ; nane kake hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi etɛ.
A pee tlɔɔke ɔ nane ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ta zugba lɛ ní ɔmɛ; a sile akɔblee kɛ sɔ̃ nane ɔmɛ a he tso ɔmɛ, kɛ dade ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ tsuo.
A pee ninehi ngɔ mɛtɛ tlɔɔke tsuaa tlɔɔke kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nine ɔmɛ, kɛ tlɔɔke ɔ tsa.
Nɔ́ lokotoo ko bu tlɔɔke tsuaa tlɔɔke nya kɛ kpe; e blimi ji nine mi blimi kake.
A pee nya bumi nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ e he nine ɔmɛ, kɛ tlɔɔke ɔ ngɔ tsa.
A hlɔ kerubhi, jatahi, kɛ tã ngɔ wo nine ɔmɛ, kɛ akɔblee ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ hɔɔ níhi a mi ɔ a he ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ a na blɔ ngɛ; nɛ mɔmɔ jlasi bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe.
Bɔ nɛ a pee tlɔɔke nyɔngma amɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A sɔ̃ mɛ tsuo fiee; a hɛɛ susumi kake kɛ henɔ kake.
Jehanɛ, Huram pee akɔblee kã nyɔngma, tlɔɔke tsuaa tlɔɔke kɛ e he kã.
Kã tsuaa kã a, kpa nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ maa kpe he, nɛ nyu lita lafa kpaanyɔ maa ya mi.
E kɛ tlɔɔke enuɔ ma Yawɛ we ɔ leneyi je, nɛ e kɛ enuɔ ma omleyi je; e ngɔ nyu nɔ́ ɔ lɛɛ ngɔ ma we ɔ leneyi je kɛ beleku je a kpɛti kɔ nya he ko.
Yawɛ we ɔ mi dlami níhi -Jehanɛ, Huram pee buɛhi, sofihi, kɛ kãhi.
Yawɛ we ɔ he ní tsumi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo ha lɛ tsumi ɔ, e gbe lɛ tsuo nya.
Níhi nɛ e pee ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Akɔblee titima enyɔ.
Akɔblee kpɔ enyɔ nɛ ma titima amɛ a yi mi.
Ya enyɔ nɛ a lo, kɛ mɔmɔ jlasi nɛ a pee kaa kɔsɔkɔsɔ ngɔ ma titima enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi mi.
Akɔblee kpɔ kokloohi kaa tso yiblii lafa eywiɛ nɛ a pee ngɔ wo gbaka enyɔɔnyɔ a mi kɛ bɔle kpɔ ɔmɛ.
Tlɔɔke nyɔngma.
Kã nyɔngma.
Nyu nɔ́.
Akɔblee na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ nyu nɔ́ ɔ maa si ngɛ a nɔ.
Buɛ ɔmɛ, sofi ɔmɛ, kɛ kã amɛ.
Yawɛ we ɔ he ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Huram pee ha Matsɛ Salomo ɔ, akɔblee nɛ a sa he a kɛ pee.
Matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ a sɔ̃ ní ɔmɛ ngɛ akɔblee galɔ ní tsumi he nɛ ngɛ Sukot kɛ Zaretan a kpɛti, ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ. Salomo ha we nɛ a ngmɛ akɔblee ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pee ɔ, ejakaa a hiɛ tsɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li akɔblee ɔ nya.
Salomo ha a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ mi: bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kane tso nyɔngma amɛ nɛ maa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a hɛ mi ɔ, enuɔ ngɛ leneyi je, kɛ enuɔ hu ngɛ omleyi je; mɔmɔ ɔmɛ, kane ɔmɛ, abɛɛle ɔmɛ, kplu ɔmɛ, la gbemi ní ɔmɛ, kã amɛ, kɛ ngɛyu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ jeɔ la a; he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a sinya amɛ a se asa amɛ, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kpo nɔ je sinya amɛ a se asa amɛ.
Benɛ Matsɛ Salomo gbe Yawɛ we ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ tsuo nya a, e ngɔ níhi tsuo nɛ e tsɛ David gbaa nɔ ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ ngɔ to nito hehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ní ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sika hiɔ, sika tsu, kɛ ni kpa komɛ.
A ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ mi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Salomo ya kpee Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, konɛ a ya ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a kɛ je Zion, nɛ ji David ma a mi kɛ ba ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Israel ma a tsuo ba bua a he nya Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ, ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Etanim ɔ mi.
Benɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba bua a he nya a, osɔfo ɔmɛ wo somi daka a nɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ ho Yawɛ we ɔ mi ya.
Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ hɛɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ hu kɛ ho Yawɛ we ɔ mi ya.
Jehanɛ, Matsɛ Salomo, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ya bua a he nya ngɛ somi daka a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbe to, kɛ na babauu nɛ a li nya kɛ sã bɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ somi daka a ya ma e blɔ he ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi.
Kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi kɛ ha daka a, kɛ tsohi nɛ hɛɛ daka a tsuo a he.
Tso ɔmɛ ka gagaa bɔ nɛ ke nɔ ko daa si ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a hɛ mi ɔ, e maa na a nya amɛ nɛ je kpo; se a nya ji kpo nɛ a maa na ngɛ kpo nɔ.
Tso ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be somi daka a mi kaa ja tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ Mose ngɔ wo mi kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ. Yawɛ kɛ Israel ma a so ngɛ lejɛ ɔ be mi nɛ a je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ma a. Benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, bɔku ba ha lejɛ ɔ. Bɔku nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe kaa Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a kpale kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ya tsu ní.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Salomo sɔle ke, “Mo Yawɛ, o ngɔ pu ngɔ to hiɔwe, se kɛ̃ ɔ, o ke o maa hi bɔku kɛ diblii kpii mi.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, i po we saminyayoo ko ha mo nɛ o hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya neneene.” Salomo kɛ ma a tu munyu Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Salomo plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ kpee mɛ nɛ e gbaa mɛ.
E de ke, “A je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi; ejakaa si ko nɛ e wo tsaatsɛ David ɔ, e ye nɔ.
Yawɛ de David ke, ‘Kɛ je be nɛ i je ye ma Israel kɛ je Egipt ɔ, i hla we ma ko ma ko kɛ ji Israel wɛtso ko mi nɛ a po we ha mi nɛ a ja mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se i hla mo David, nɛ o ye ye ma, Israel ɔ nɔ.’ ” Salomo ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Jinɛ tsaatsɛ David to kaa e maa po we nɛ a ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ mi, se Yawɛ de lɛ ke, ‘O pee saminya kaa o to o yi mi kaa o maa po we ha mi, se kɛ̃ ɔ, tsa pi mo nɛ o maa po we ɔ; mo nitsɛ o bi lɛ ma ba po we ɔ ha mi.’ “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ye e siwo ɔ nɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ e de to ɔ, i ba ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Israel ngɛ tsaatsɛ David se, nɛ we ɔ he nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, i po.
Jehanɛ se hu, i hla he ko ngɔ to ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, he nɛ a kɛ somi daka a maa to.
Benɛ Yawɛ jé wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, somi nɛ e kɛ mɛ so ɔ ngɛ daka nɛ ɔ mi.” Salomo fa kue ha Yawɛ Jehanɛ Salomo ya da bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hɛ mi; nɛ e wo e nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e sɔle ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu lee, mawu ko mawu ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba nɛ ngɛ kaa mo!
Somi nɛ o kɛ o ma a so ɔ, o yeɔ nɔ; nɛ ke a bu mo tue kɛ a tsui tsuo ɔ, o jeɔ o suɔmi nɛ se pui ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Si ko nɛ o wo tsaatsɛ David ɔ, o ye nɔ; nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o de to ɔ ba mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, Israel Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ, si nɛ o wo tsaatsɛ benɛ o de lɛ ke ke e binyumu ɔmɛ maa bu mo tue kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ɔ, a maa ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, ha jamɛ a siwo ɔ hu nɛ ba mi.
Israel Mawu lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ, níhi tsuo nɛ o de tsaatsɛ David ɔ, ha nɛ a ba mi.
“Se anɛ mo Mawu, o ma nyɛ maa hi zugba a nɔ niinɛ lo?
Mo nɛ hiɔwe, kɛ hiɔwe se lokoo po kpi mo ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ we nɛ i po nɛ ɔ maa kpe mo?
Yawɛ, ye Mawu lee, o tsɔlɔ ji mi.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu ye kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ níhi nɛ i ngɛ mo bie mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, o pee ha mi.
We nɛ ɔ, he nɛ o hla ngɔ to kaa a ja mo ngɛ ɔ, moo bu he nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ ke i ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ba sɔle ɔ, o nu.
Ke o tsɔlɔ, aloo o ma, Israel ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ba kpa pɛɛ ɔ, o nu ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o ngɔ pa wɔ.
“Ke a po nɔ ko nya kaa e tɔ e nyɛmi nɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba da o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ we nɛ ɔ mi ke e ka kita nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e pee we yayami ko ɔ, Yawɛ, moo bu tue ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ o kojo o tsɔli ɔmɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ye fɔ ɔ, gbla e tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ lɛɛ o wo lɛ nguɔ.
“Ke o ma, Israel a he nyɛli ba ye a nɔ ngɛ yayami ko nɛ a pee kɛ si mo he, nɛ a pia a he, nɛ a ba we nɛ ɔ mi ba kpa mo pɛɛ kɛ he si bami ɔ, moo bu mɛ tue ngɛ hiɔwe.
Ngɔɔ yayami nɛ o ma a pee ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ o kpale mɛ kɛ ba zugba a nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.
“Ke o tsi hiɔmi nya ngɛ yayami ko nɛ o ma, Israel pee kɛ si mo he, nɛ pee se ɔ, a tsake a tsui nɛ a ba we nɛ ɔ mi ba kpa mo pɛɛ kɛ he si bami ɔ, moo bu mɛ tue ngɛ hiɔwe.
Ngɔɔ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Israel ma a a he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ.
Tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ, ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ ngɛ o zugba a nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ha o ma a kaa a weto ní kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɔ.
“Ke hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ, loo tsohi a he hiɔ, loo baalɛ ba zugba a nɔ, aloo ke he nyɛli ba sa o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a yi ngɔ wo a ma amɛ eko mi ɔ, haomi tsuaa haomi, aloo hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ nɛ ji ɔ, ke o ma, Israel bi ɔmɛ ba we nɛ ɔ mi kakaaka, loo kutuu, nɛ a ba wo a nine nɔ nɛ a fa kue ha mo kɛ je a tsui mi ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a hiami ní ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, moo nu a pɛɛ kpami ɔ. Moo bu mɛ tue ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe; ngɔɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ o ye kɛ bua mɛ.
Mo pɛ lɛ o le nɔmlɔ adesa tsui mi.
Moo pee nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiami ní ha lɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a bu mo ligbi abɔ nɛ a ngɛ zugba a nɛ o ngɔ ha wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
-“Jã kɛ̃, ke nubwɔ ko nɛ je ma se lokoo nu o biɛ, kɛ ní nguahi nɛ o pee ha o ma, Israel ɔ, nɛ e ba we nɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ba ja mo, nɛ e sɔle ɔ, moo bu e pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue.
Moo nu ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ ha lɛ; bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, a le mo, nɛ a bu mo kaa bɔ nɛ o ma, Israel bi ɔmɛ buu mo ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa we nɛ ɔ nɛ i po ɔ ji he nɛ sa nɛ a ja mo ngɛ.
“Ke o fa o ma a ke a kɛ a he nyɛli ya hwu, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee ma nɛ ɔ nɛ o hla ngɔ to, kɛ we nɛ ɔ nɛ i po ha mo ɔ, nɛ a fa kue ha mo ɔ, moo bu mɛ tue.
Moo nu ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o ha nɛ a ye kunimi.
“Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ pee we yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e ba mi kaa o ma a pee yayami kɛ si mo, nɛ o mi mi fu mɛ, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo a he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho zugba kpa nɔ ya, lejɛ ɔ kɛ jio, e kɛ we jio, moo bu o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ tue.
Ke benɛ a ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, a pia a he, nɛ a tsake a tsui, nɛ a jaje a he yayami ngɔ ha mo ɔ, moo bu a kue fami ɔ tue.
Ke a tsake a tsui niinɛ ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee zugba nɛ ɔ nɛ o ngɔ ha wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nɛ ɔ nɛ o hla ngɔ to, kɛ we nɛ ɔ nɛ i po ngɔ ha mo ɔ, nɛ a fa kue ha mo ɔ, moo bu a kue fami ɔ tue.
Moo nu ngɛ o hi he ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, nɛ o na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Ngɔɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ o hɛ mi atuã nɛ a tsɔ ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ o ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ a na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Mo nitsɛ o ma ji mɛ; mo lɛ o je mɛ kɛ je Egipt, jamɛ a zugba a nɛ a hi mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ dade flɔɔnɔɔ mi lɛ a kɛ mɛ wo ɔ.
“Yawɛ Mawu lee, moo hyɛ o ma Israel, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ, nɛ o na mɛ mɔbɔ; be tsuaa be nɛ a maa fa kue ha mo ɔ, moo bu mɛ tue.
Mo lɛ o hla mɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti, nɛ o kɛ mɛ ba pee mo nitsɛ o ma kaa bɔ nɛ o gu o tsɔlɔ, Mose nɔ de mɛ, benɛ o je wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ.” Salomo gbaa ma a Benɛ Salomo fa kue ha Yawɛ gbe nya a, e te da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi he nɛ e kpla si ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e wo e nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe.
E wo gbi wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e gbaa Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “A je Yawɛ yi; ejakaa e ha e ma a tue mi jɔmi kaa bɔ nɛ e de to ke e maa pee ɔ. Ní kpakpahi nɛ e wo si kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ, Mose nɔ kaa e maa pee ɔ, e pee mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi si ɔ; e ko si wɔ, nɛ e ko kua wɔ hulɔ.
Yawɛ nɛ ha waa bu lɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ba wa je mi saminya kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ waa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ e wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ kai kue nɛ i fa ha lɛ, kɛ pɛɛ nɛ i kpa lɛ nɛ ɔ be tsuaa be.
É na e ma, Israel, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ e pee a hiami níhi ha mɛ daa ligbi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a le kaa Yawɛ pɛ ji Mawu; e se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu.
Nyɛ, e ma a, nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ anɔkuale daa, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ.” Yawɛ we ɔ nya blimi -Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Salomo kɛ Israel ma a tsuo sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, nɛ a pee kusumi kɛ bli Yawɛ we ɔ nya.
Salomo ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ: na ,, kɛ to ,.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Salomo pee kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we kpɛti ɔ klɔuklɔu, nɛ e sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; e ngɔ lohwe ɔmɛ a zɔ ɔ hu kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ klee we bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nɔ.
Salomo kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ otsi.
Nimli babauu nitsɛ ba nyami be nɛ ɔ; a je tsitsaa Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ ya si Egipt huzu ɔ he ngɛ leneyi je.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, Salomo ha ma a nane.
Mɛ tsuo a je e yi saminya, nɛ a ho a wehi a mi ya kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ pee ha e tsɔlɔ, David, kɛ e ma, Israel ɔ he.
Mawu je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Salomo ekohu Benɛ Salomo gbe Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ kɛ we kpahi nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa ma a tsuo a nya a, Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ngɛ Gibeon ɔ. Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “I nu o kue fami ɔ. I pee we nɛ o po nɛ a ja mi ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu kɛ yaa neneene.
Ma hyɛ we ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma bu he daa.
Ke o ma sɔmɔ mi kɛ o tsui tsuo, nɛ o maa ye mi anɔkuale kaa bɔ nɛ o tsɛ David pee ɔ; nɛ o maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa mo ke o pee ɔ; lɛɛ si ko nɛ i wo o tsɛ David ɔ, ma ye nɔ.
Imi lɛ i de lɛ ke ma ha e nina maa ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ nɛ.
Se ke mo, loo o nina jɔɔ ye se nyɛɛmi, ke nyɛ yi mlaa amɛ nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja mɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ma je ye ma, Israel kɛ je zugba a nɛ i ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.
We nɛ ɔ hu nɛ i pee klɔuklɔu nɛ a ja mi ngɛ mi ɔ, ma je ye nine ngɛ he.
Je ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ maa wo Israel la, nɛ a maa ye e he fɛu.
We nɛ ɔ maa pee we doku, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bee ɔ he mi ma jɔ̃, nɛ e nya maa kpɛ e he; nɛ e ma bi ke, ‘Mɛni he je nɛ Yawɛ pee zugba nɛ ɔ, kɛ we nɛ ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?’ Nɛ nihi ma he nɔ ke, ‘Ejakaa a kua Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ.
A kɛ a he ya mɛtɛ mawu kpahi a he; a ja mɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Yawɛ kɛ haomi nɛ ɔ ba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.’ ” Salomo kɛ Hiram so Salomo kɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ ma Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Tiro matsɛ, Hiram ji nɔ nɛ ha Salomo seda, sɛsɛo, kɛ sika tsu tsuo nɛ hia lɛ kɛ ha ní tsumi ɔ. Benɛ a gbe ní tsumi ɔ nya a, Matsɛ Salomo ha Hiram ma nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ Galilea zugba a nɔ.
Se benɛ Hiram je Tiro kɛ ba hyɛ ma amɛ nɛ Salomo ha lɛ ɔ, e sume.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi Salomo ke, “Ye nyɛmi, mahi nɛ o ha mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ lo?” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ ma amɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ ji Kabul.
Blɔɔ Hiram ngɔ sika tsu kilo akpe eywiɛ ngɔ mane Salomo momo.
Salomo ní tsumi kpa komɛ Matsɛ Salomo nyɛ nihi a nɔ kɛ tsu ma ní tsumi kpakpataa, nɛ e kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ, Milo mɔ ɔ, Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ, Hazor, Megido, kɛ Gezer ma amɛ.
Jehanɛ, Salomo po ma nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ: Bet Horon nɛ ngɛ sisi je ɔ, Baalat, Tamar ngɛ Yuda nga a nɔ ɔ, mahi nɛ a toɔ Salomo níhi ngɛ a mi ɔ, mahi he nɛmɛ nɛ e we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ hɛja jemi mahi ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ Lebanon, kɛ e nɔ yemi he kpa amɛ tsuo.
-Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ Kanaan zugba a, Kanaan bi nɛ piɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbi mɛ ɔ, mɛ ji nihi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo nyɛ a nɔ kɛ tsu nyɔguɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ. Mɛ ji Amor bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi nɛ a nina ngɛ nyɔguɛ yee we kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Israel bi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ Salomo ngɔɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ pee we nyɔguɛ; mɛɛ a tsu ní kaa e ta buli, tsɔli, asafoatsɛmɛ, ta zugba lɛ nyatsɛmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli.
Tsɔli nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ Salomo ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a hyɛɛ ní tsuli slɔɔto ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a hiɛmi ji .
Benɛ Farao ɔ biyo, nɛ ji Salomo yo ɔ klɛ kɛ je David ma a mi kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e we nɛ Salomo po ha lɛ ɔ mi ya a, jamɛ a be ɔ nɛ Salomo ma Milo mɔ ɔ nɛ.
Si etɛ ngɛ jeha mi ɔ, Salomo sãã sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ e puɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ nɔ.
E sãã tsopa kɛ e he via hulɔ kɛ haa Yawɛ.
Jehanɛ, Salomo gbe Yawɛ we ɔ nya.
Matsɛ Salomo kpɛ lɛhi babauu hulɔ ngɛ Eziongeber nɛ ngɛ Elat kasa nya a, ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ.
Matsɛ Hiram wo e we akua hluili komɛ nɛ a nine si wa kɛ ní tsumi blɔ kɛ ya piɛ Salomo tsɔli ɔmɛ a he.
A hlui lɛ kɛ ya Ofir zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ya ngɔ sika tsu kilo akpe nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba ha Matsɛ Salomo.
Sheba manyɛ ba slaa Salomo Benɛ Sheba manyɛ nu bɔ nɛ Salomo he biɛ ha a, e hia blɔ kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ e ba ka lɛ kɛ sane bimihi nɛ a he wa.
Benɛ e ma a, nihi babauu nitsɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ba.
E kɛ afukpɔngɔhi nɛ a wo a se mi ní babauu hu ba.
Ní ɔmɛ ji tsopa kɛ e he via, sika tsu, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa.
Benɛ manyɛ ɔ ba na Salomo ɔ, e bi Salomo munyuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e yi mi, nɛ Salomo ha lɛ munyu ɔmɛ tsuo a heto; ekoeko be nɛ he wa tsɔ nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e ha heto.
Sheba manyɛ ɔ nu Salomo nile munyu ɔmɛ, nɛ e na matsɛ we ɔ nɛ e po ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, manyɛ ɔ na niye ní nɛ a kɛ to okplɔɔ ha matsɛ ɔ; e na matsɛ tsɔli nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ a hii si kɛ bɔle matsɛ ɔ; e na matsɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a pueɔ si kɛ a he tadehi; e na matsɛ ɔ dã woli, kɛ sami bɔhi nɛ e sãã ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Benɛ Sheba manyɛ ɔ na ní ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, e he mi po, nɛ e de Matsɛ Salomo ke, “O he sane, kɛ o nile nɛ i nu he ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye zugba a nɔ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu.
Se i he we yi kɛ ya si i ba na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
Mamoo, i nui e mi fa po tete; o nile kɛ o kplɔkɔtɔ hiɛ babauu pe bɔ nɛ a gba mi ɔ. O yi ɔmɛ a he ba ní pɛ!
O tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mo daa, nɛ a nuɔ o nile munyu ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a he ba ní pɛ!
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ ná o he bua jɔmi, nɛ e wo mo Israel nɔ matsɛ ɔ, a je e yi.
Akɛnɛ suɔmi nɛ Yawɛ suɔ Israel ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene he je ɔ, e wo mo tsɛ, konɛ o kojo, nɛ o ye dami sane.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Sheba manyɛ ɔ ke Matsɛ Salomo ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ba a: sika tsu kilo akpe eywiɛ, tsopa kɛ e he via babauu, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa.
Tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ Sheba manyɛ ɔ ba ke Matsɛ Salomo ɔ, Salomo na we eko nɛ hiɛ kaa ja hyɛ.
Hiram lɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ sika tsu kɛ je Ofir kɛ ba a, a ngɔ tsohi, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa hu babauu kɛ ba.
Salomo kɛ tso nɛ ɔmɛ eko kpɛ piɛ ngɔ wo Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ a he, nɛ e kɛ eko hu pee kpa sakuhi, kɛ bɛhi ha e lali ɔmɛ.
Tso ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ba a, a nɛ a henɔ ko hyɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Sheba manyɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e bi matsɛ Salomo ɔ, e ha lɛ; slo níhi nɛ je Salomo nitsɛ tsui mi nɛ e ha lɛ.
Pee se ɔ, manyɛ ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho Sheba zugba a nɔ ya.
Matsɛ Salomo ní Sika tsu nɛ baa Matsɛ Salomo dɛ mi daa jeha ji sika tsu kilo akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ; slo nɔ́ nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ jua yeli a dɛ, kɛ se nami nɛ jeɔ jua yemi ní tsumi ɔ mi, kɛ tó nɛ Arabia matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel zugba a nɔ amlaalo ɔmɛ tsuɔ ha lɛ ɔ. Matsɛ Salomo pee tsɛ̃i agbo lafa enyɔ, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu nɛ a fia nɔ, nɛ jiimi ji kilo kpaago ha tsɛ̃i tsuaa tsɛ̃i he.
E pee tsɛ̃i wawi hu lafa etɛ, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu nɛ a fia nɔ, nɛ jiimi ji kilo enyɔ ha tsɛ̃i tsuaa tsɛ̃i he.
E ngɔ tsɛ̃i nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ya to ngɛ Lebanon hue tsu ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ, Salomo kɛ suɔ wu pee matsɛ sɛ agbo ko, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he.
-Matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ kpoku ekpa nɛ a kuɔɔ kɛ yaa he, nɛ jata daa si ngɛ kpoku tsuaa kpoku nya; jata amɛ tsuo peeɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
A pee na ku yi kɛ fɔ sɛ ɔ se mi, nɛ jata kake daa si ngɛ sɛ ɔ nine enyɔ ɔmɛ a se hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
A pee we matsɛ sɛ nɛ ɔ henɔ ko hyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yemi he kpa ko.
Sika tsu a kɛ pee Matsɛ Salomo nyu numi kpluhi tsuo.
Níhi nɛ ngɛ Lebanon hue tsu ɔ mi hu sika tsu ngmingmiingmi sɔuu lɛ a kɛ pee mɛ; sika hiɔ be mi, ejakaa a bui sika hiɔ he akɔtaa ngɛ Salomo be ɔ mi.
Matsɛ Salomo jua yemi lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Hiram ní ɔmɛ bla kɛ tsu ní ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ.
Daa jeha etɛ ɔ, Salomo lɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, suɔ wu, siato, kɛ anguɛ kɛ baa we.
Matsɛ Salomo na ní, nɛ e le ní pe je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ je ɔ tsuo hlaa kaa a maa ba nɛ a ba bu nile nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ tue.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko baa: sika hiɔ, sika tsu níhi, tade, ta hwumi níhi, tsopa kɛ e he via, okpɔngɔ, kɛ teji okpɔngɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ daa jeha.
Salomo bua ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ ta okpɔngɔhi a nya; e na ta zugba lɛ akpe kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ, kɛ ta okpɔngɔ akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Ta okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ e ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e ngɔ ekomɛ hu ya to ma kpa komɛ a mi.
Salomo yi nɔ ɔ, a pee we sika hiɔ, kɛ seda he nɔ́ ko ngɛ Yerusalem; sika hiɔ ngɛ kaa tɛ, nɛ seda tso hu pɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ sikamore tso pɔ he ngɛ Yuda kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
Matsɛ Salomo jua yeli ɔmɛ ya heɔ Salomo okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ jeɔ Musri, kɛ Kilikia, nɛ a ya heɔ ta zugba lɛhi ngɛ Egipt.
Mɛ kɛ̃ nɛ a ya heɔ okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛhi nɛ a ya juaa kɛ haa Hit, kɛ Siria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
A juaa ta zugba lɛ kake sika hiɔ yi lafa ekpa, kɛ okpɔngɔ kake sika hiɔ yi lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Salomo je Mawu se Matsɛ Salomo su ma se yihi babauu.
Ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ biyo ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ Hit yihi, Moab yihi, Amon yihi, Edom yihi, kɛ Sidon yihi.
E ngɔ yi nɛ ɔmɛ, pohu Yawɛ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa ke Israel nyumuhi kó ngɔ ma se yihi, nɛ́ Israel yihi hu kó gba ma se nyumuhi; ejakaa ke a pee ja a, a yi mi ma plɛ, nɛ a ma ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se.
Salomo ngɔ matsɛmɛ a biyihi lafa kpaago, nɛ e su plãhi hu lafa etɛ.
E yi ɔmɛ ha e yi mi plɛ kɛ je Mawu he, nɛ benɛ e ba bwɔ ɔ, a ha nɛ e bɔni mawu kpahi jami.
Salomo yi Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ anɔkuale kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ David pee ɔ. E ya ja Sidon bi ɔmɛ a yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Astarte ɔ, kɛ Amon bi a wɔ yaya a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Milkom ɔ. Salomo pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ e nyɛɛ we e se kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ David pee ɔ. Salomo po piɛ ha Kemosh nɛ ji Moab bi ɔmɛ a wɔ yaya a, kɛ Milkom nɛ ji Amon bi ɔmɛ a wɔ yaya a ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem beleku je.
E po piɛ kpa komɛ hulɔ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ma se yi ɔmɛ ya sãã tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ bɔ ngɛ kɛ haa a mawu ɔmɛ.
-Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Salomo si enyɔ, nɛ e wo lɛ mlaa ke e ko ja mawu kpahi; se Salomo bui Yawɛ tue, nɛ e je e se.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Salomo, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ o to o yi mi, nɛ o yi somi nɛ i kɛ mo so ɔ, kɛ mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ a nɔ he je ɔ, i ngɛ mo dee ke, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ma kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ o dɛ, nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ha o tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
Se o tsɛ, David he je ɔ, i be nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee ngɛ o yi nɔ; mohu ma pee ngɛ o binyumu yi nɔ.
I be matsɛ yemi ɔ tsuo kpɔe ngɛ e dɛ.
Ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ David he, kɛ Yerusalem nɛ i ngɔ kɛ pee imi nitsɛ ye ma a he je ɔ, ma ha lɛ wɛtso kake.” Salomo he nyɛli Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha Hadad nɛ je matsɛ we mi ngɛ Edom ɔ te si ngɔ wo Salomo.
-Be ko nɛ be ɔ, benɛ David ya ye Edom nɔ kunimi ɔ, e tatsɛ Yoab ho, konɛ e ya pu nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta a mi.
Yoab kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hi Edom nyɔhiɔ ekpa; nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a gbe nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ ma a mi.
Hadad, kɛ Edom bi komɛ nɛ ji e tsɛ tsɔli pɛ ji nihi nɛ tu fo kɛ ho Egipt ya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, jokuɛ bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ji Hadad.
A je Midian kɛ ho Paran ya; nɛ benɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ, nyumuhi kpa komɛ ba piɛ a he.
Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya, nɛ a ya na Egipt matsɛ ɔ. Farao ɔ ha Hadad zugba, kɛ we, kɛ niye ní.
Hadad kɛ Farao ɔ ba pee huɛ; nɛ Farao ɔ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yo nɛ ji Manyɛ Tapenes ɔ nyɛmiyo ngɔ ha Hadad.
Hadad kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Genubat.
Tapenes hyɛ jokuɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ e kɛ matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ hi si.
Se benɛ Hadad nu ngɛ Egipt kaa Matsɛ David kpa sɛ, nɛ tatsɛ Yoab hu gbo ɔ, Hadad de Farao ɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi blɔ nɛ ma kpale kɛ ya imi nitsɛ ye ma mi.” Farao ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ hlae nɛ o kpale kɛ ya mo nitsɛ o ma mi ɔ?
Mɛni ngɛ mo hiae?” Hadad he nɔ ke, “Oo, nɔ́ ko hia we mi; ha nɛ ma ya kɛkɛ.” Yawɛ ha nɛ Eliada binyumu Rezon hu te si ngɔ wo Salomo.
Rezon tu fo kɛ je e nyɔmtsɛ Hadadezer, Zoba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ e ba pee ojo fiali a nyatsɛ.
Benɛ David ye Hadadezer nɔ kunimi, nɛ e kpata Zoba hɛ mi ɔ, Rezon kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ ho Damasko ya nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ; nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ wo lɛ Siria matsɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Salomo yi nɔ tsuo ɔ, Rezon kɛ Hadad ji e he nyɛli kpanakuhi; Rezon kɛ Hadad sume Israel bi ɔmɛ saasaa, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní.
Mawu wo Yeroboam si Nɔ kpa ko hu nɛ te si ngɔ wo Matsɛ Salomo ji e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ ji Nebat binyumu Yeroboam nɛ je Zereda ngɛ Efraim ɔ. Yalɔyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Zerua a bi ji lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Yeroboam atuã tsɔmi sane ɔ ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Salomo ngɛ Milo mɔ ɔ mae, nɛ e ngɛ e tsɛ David ma a he gbogbo ɔmɛ nɛ hule ɔ fiae ekohu.
Yeroboam ji niheyo ko nɛ kɔni si wa, nɛ benɛ Salomo na kaa e tsuɔ ní saminya a, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nyɛɛ a nɔ kɛ tsuɔ ma ní tsumi kpakpataa a a nɔ hyɛlɔ ngɛ Manase, kɛ Efraim wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Yeroboam hia blɔ kɛ je Yerusalem.
Benɛ e ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, gbalɔ Ahiya nɛ je Shilo ɔ ya na lɛ; nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ pɛ a ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Ahiya wo tade he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Ahiya hía tade he ɔ nɛ e wo ɔ, nɛ e dla mi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ e de Yeroboam ke, “Tade nɛ i hía nɛ ɔ, mo he e mi dlami nyɔngma, ejakaa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘Ma kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ Salomo dɛ, nɛ ma ngɔ wɛtso nyɔngma ngɔ ha mo.
Ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ David he, kɛ Yerusalem, ma nɛ i hla kɛ je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ngɔ pee imi nitsɛ ye ma a he je ɔ, ma ha Salomo wɛtso kake.
I ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Salomo kua mi, nɛ e ya ja Astarte, Sidon yo mawu ɔ; Kemosh, Moab mawu ɔ; kɛ Milkom, Amon mawu ɔ.
