Salomo gbo tue; e pee yayami, nɛ e yi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ David pee ɔ. I be matsɛ yemi ɔ tsuo kpɔe ngɛ Salomo dɛ; ma ha nɛ e ye tsɛ kɛ yaa si e gbenɔ be.
Ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ David nɛ i hla, nɛ e ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ he.
Ma kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ Salomo binyumu dɛ, nɛ ma ngɔ wɛtso nyɔngma ngɔ ha mo.
Se Salomo binyumu ɔ lɛɛ ma ngɔ wɛtso kake ngɔ ha lɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, ye tsɔlɔ David nina ko nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, ma he nɛ i hla, nɛ a jaa mi ngɛ ɔ. Yeroboam, ma wo mo tsɛ ngɛ Israel, nɛ o maa ye zugba a tsuo nɔ bɔ nɛ o suɔ.
Ke o maa bu mi tue kɛ pi si, nɛ o maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o maa pee ye suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ ye tsɔlɔ David pee ɔ, lɛɛ i kɛ mo maa hi si daa.
Ma wo mo tsɛ ngɛ Israel, nɛ ma ha nɛ o nina maa ye tsɛ ngɛ o se kaa bɔ nɛ i pee ha David ɔ. Ma gbla David nina a tue ngɛ yayami nɛ Salomo pee ɔ he; se i be a tue gblae kɛ ya neneene.’ ” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Salomo hla kaa e maa gbe Yeroboam, se Yeroboam tu fo kɛ ho Matsɛ Shishak ngɔ ya ngɛ Egipt, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si Salomo gbo.
Salomo gbenɔ Salomo he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, e nile, kɛ ní kpahi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Salomo he Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Salomo hi Yerusalem, nɛ e kɛ ye Israel tsuo nɔ matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Salomo ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ e tsɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Rehoboam ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Omleyi je wɛtso ɔmɛ tsɔ atuã Rehoboam pue nɔ kɛ ho Shekem ya, ejakaa Israel omleyi je ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ya bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ.
Benɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam nɛ tu fo kɛ je Matsɛ Salomo nya, nɛ e ya laa e he ngɛ Egipt ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale kɛ ba we.
Ma a tsɔ ya kpee lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tsuo ho ya na Rehoboam, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “O tsɛ Salomo wa wɔ yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ; tlomi nɛ e ngɔ kɛ tloo wɔ ɔ jiɔ tsɔ.
Ke o ma ha nɛ wa tlomi ɔ nɔ ma gbɔ bɔɔ, nɛ́ wa he mi maa jɔ wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ wa ma sɔmɔ mo.” Rehoboam he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya lolo, nɛ́ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Rehoboam ya bi nikɔtɔma komɛ ga womi; nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ e tsɛ Salomo hi si, nɛ a woɔ lɛ ga benɛ e ngɛ je mi ɔ. Rehoboam bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni heto po ma ya ha ma nɛ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Ke o ma ha ma nɛ ɔ a ní bimi ɔ heto kɛ gbi nɛ he jɔ, nɛ o maa kplɛɛ kaa o maa hɛɛ mɛ saminya a, a ma sɔmɔ mo daa.” Se Rehoboam ngɔɛ ga nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ wo lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho ya bi e juã nihewi nɛ e kɛ mɛ je nɔ ɔ mohu ga womi ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba de mi ke ma ha nɛ a tlomi ɔ nɔ nɛ gbɔ bɔɔ ha mɛ ɔ, mɛni heto ma ya ha mɛ?” Nihewi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ o ma de mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ye sekpɛ nguɛ kle pe tsaatsɛ mlɛ mi.
Tsaatsɛ ngɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ tloo nyɛ; imi lɛɛ i kɛ tlomi ɔ eko maa piɛ he ha nyɛ.
Tsaatsɛ ngɔ kpa gu kɛ fia nyɛ; imi lɛɛ i kɛ okpɔngɔ kpa maa fia nyɛ!’ ” Ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Yeroboam kɛ ma a tsuo kpale ba matsɛ Rehoboam ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Rehoboam kua nikɔtɔma amɛ a ga womi ɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma a tu munyu basabasa kaa bɔ nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ wo lɛ ga ke e pee ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ ngɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ tloo nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i kɛ tlomi ɔ eko maa piɛ he ha nyɛ.
Tsaatsɛ kɛ kpa gu fia nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i kɛ okpɔngɔ kpa maa fia nyɛ!” Matsɛ Rehoboam bui ma a tue fɛɛ!
Se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ he ngɛ mi; Yawɛ lɛ ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ pee ja, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ si nɛ lɛ Yawɛ, ɔ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam kɛ gu gbalɔ Ahiya nɛ je Shilo ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Benɛ Israel ma a tsuo na kaa matsɛ ɔ bui mɛ tue ɔ, a de ke, “Mɛni blɔ nya wa ngɛ ngɛ David ngɔ?
Wa be gbosi ní ngɛ Ishai binyumu ɔ ngɔ.
Israel ma!
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pue lɛ nitsɛ e we mi blɔ!
Nyɛ ha Rehoboam nɛ ya ye tsɛ ngɛ David we ɔ nɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsɔ atuã, nɛ Rehoboam ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel bi nɛ ngɛ Yuda zugba a mi pɛ a nɔ.
Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Rehoboam tsɔ Adoniram Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Adoniram ji nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nihi nɛ a nyɛɔ a nɔ kɛ tsuɔ ma ní tsumi kpakpataa a a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Se Israel ma a tsuo fia lɛ tɛ nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Rehoboam he esɔ kɛ ya sɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi nɛ e tu fo kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Israel omleyi je ma a tsɔ atuã kɛ je David we ɔ he kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. Benɛ Israel tsuo nu kaa Yeroboam je Egipt kɛ ba a, a tsɔ ya kpee lɛ kɛ ba ma a hɛ mi, nɛ a wo lɛ Israel matsɛ.
Yuda wɛtso ɔ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ David we ɔ nɔ kaa loloolo ɔ, mɛ ji matsɛmɛ.
Gbalɔ Shemaya Benɛ Rehoboam ya su Yerusalem ɔ, e hla ta buli nɛ a kɔni si wa , kɛ je Yuda, kɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi.
E to kaa e kɛ Israel we ɔ ma ya hwu, konɛ e kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ ba je e sisi ekohu.
Se Mawu ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha gbalɔ Shemaya ke, “De Yuda matsɛ, Rehoboam, Salomo binyumu ɔ, Yuda wɛtso ɔ, Benyamin wɛtso ɔ, kɛ ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ko hwu ta.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ho e we mi ya; ejakaa nɔ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ, ye he ngɛ mi.’ ” A bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ. Yeroboam je Yawɛ se Matsɛ Yeroboam ya po ma ngɛ Shekem ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. Pee se ɔ, e je ya po ma ngɛ Penuel.
-Yeroboam de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ke e ba mi kaa ma nɛ ɔ ho ya sã bɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, a yi mi ma plɛ; a maa kpale ya sɔmɔ a nyɔmtsɛ nɛ ji Yuda matsɛ, Rehoboam ekohu, nɛ a maa gbe mi.” Matsɛ Yeroboam susu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he saminya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ sika tsu puɛ na bi enyɔ, nɛ e de ma a ke, “Bɔ nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ya Yerusalem ɔ ba hiɛ!
Israel ma, nyɛ mawu ɔmɛ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ!” Yeroboam ngɔ sika tsu na bi kake ya ma Betel, nɛ e ngɔ kake hu ya ma Dan.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ ma a pee yayami; ejakaa a yaa Betel kɛ Dan ya jaa sika tsu na bi ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ, Yeroboam ma jami hehi ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.
E hla ma a mi nimli saisaa nɛ e wo mɛ osɔfo; nihi nɛ ji Levi wɛtso ɔ mi po, e wo mɛ osɔfo.
Jehanɛ, Yeroboam ngɔ nyɔhiɔ kpaanyɔne ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ ngɔ pee nyami ligbi kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ Yuda a. E ya sãã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Betel kɛ haa sika tsu na bi ɔmɛ nɛ e puɛ ɔ. E ngɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ hu ya to jami he ɔmɛ nɛ e ma ngɛ Betel ɔ. Nyɔhiɔ kpaanyɔne ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ, Yeroboam yaa Betel ya sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ e puɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kikɛmɛ a ligbi nɛ ɔ ji ligbi nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ kɛ pee nyami ligbi ha Israel ma a.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔ gbalɔ ko kɛ je Yuda kɛ ho Betel ya.
Benɛ e ya su lejɛ ɔ, Yeroboam daa si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he nɛ e yaa sã tsopa kɛ e he via.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ fa gbalɔ ɔ, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ngɔ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ke, “Bɔ sami la tɛ!
Bɔ sami la tɛ!
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a ma fɔ binyumu ko ngɛ David we ɔ mi, nɛ a ma tsɛ e biɛ ke Yosia.
E ma ba gbe osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sãe ngɛ o nɔ ɔ, nɛ e maa sã nimlihi a wuhi ngɛ o nɔ.” Gbalɔ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ mi ma gba enyɔ, nɛ e mi la zu ɔ ma kpa pue si.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi nɛ o kɛ maa na kaa Yawɛ lɛ tu munyu kɛ gu ye nɔ.” Benɛ Yeroboam nu ngmlaa a nɛ gbalɔ ɔ kpa ngɔ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, e wo e nine nɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e fa ke, “Nyɛɛ nu lɛ!” Amlɔ ɔ, nine ɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ gbalɔ ɔ wlua, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e ba lɛ si hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ mi gba enyɔ, nɛ e mi la zu ɔ kpa pue si kaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ de ke e maa ba mi ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji okadi nɛ gbalɔ ɔ to nɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yawɛ lɛ tu munyu kɛ gu e nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛ Yeroboam de gbalɔ ɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, moo fa kue ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, nɛ e tsa ye nine ɔ ha mi.” Gbalɔ ɔ fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ tsa matsɛ ɔ nine ɔ; nɛ nine ɔ pee kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ sa a. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ de gbalɔ ɔ ke, “Ha waa ho we mi ya nɛ o ya wo o nya mi nɔ́ ko.
Ma wo mo nɔ́ nɛ o pee ha mi nɛ ɔ he hiɔ.” Gbalɔ ɔ de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Ke o ha mi o we ɔ fa tete po, i kɛ mo be yae; i be nɔ́ ko yee, nɛ nyu tete po i be nue ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. Yawɛ wo mi mlaa ke ma ko ye ní, nɛ ma ko nu nyu.
Jehanɛ se hu, blɔ nɛ i gu nɔ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, e ke ma ko kpale ya gu nɔ kɛ ho.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, blɔ ɔ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ gu nɔ kɛ ba Betel ɔ, e kpale we ya gui nɔ; mohu ɔ, e ya gu blɔ kpa kɛ ho.
Gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ nɛ je Betel ɔ Jamɛ a be ɔ, gbalɔ nɔmoyo ko ngɛ Betel.
E binyumu ɔmɛ ya bɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ nɛ je Yuda a ba pee ngɛ Betel jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, kɛ munyuhi nɛ e kɛ Matsɛ Yeroboam ba tu ɔ.
A tsɛ ɔ bi mɛ ke, “Jije e gu kɛ ho?” A tsɔɔ lɛ blɔ ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke a mia e teji ɔ ha lɛ.
A pee ja, nɛ e kuɔ teji ɔ kɛ nyɛɛ gbalɔ ɔ nɛ je Yuda a se kɛ ya si e ya na lɛ nɛ e hii si ngɛ tso agbo ko sisi.
Gbalɔ nɛ je Betel ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ mo ji gbalɔ ɔ nɛ je Yuda a lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Ee, imi.” Gbalɔ nɛ je Betel ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ha waa ho we mi ya nɛ o ya wo o nya mi nɔ́ ko.” Se gbalɔ nɛ je Yuda a he nɔ ke, “I be nyɛe ma kpale ye se nɛ i kɛ mo nɛ ya.
I kɛ mo be ní yee, nɛ nyu hu i be nue ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ wo mi mlaa ke ma ko ye nɔ́ ko, nɛ ma ko nu nyu hulɔ.
Jehanɛ se hu, blɔ nɛ i gu nɔ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ke ma ko kpale ya gu nɔ kɛ ho.” Gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ nɛ je Betel ɔ de lɛ ke, “Imi hu gbalɔ ji mi kaa mo.
Yawɛ fa bɔfo ko ke e ba de mi ke ma ba ngɔ mo kɛ ba we mi nɛ o ba ye ní, nɛ o nu nyu.” Se gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ sisi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ nɛ je Yuda a, kɛ gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ kpale kɛ ho we mi ya, nɛ e ya ye ní, nɛ e nu nyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ a hii si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ tu munyu, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de gbalɔ nɛ je Yuda a ke, “Yawɛ ke ma de mo ke o gbo tue, nɛ o yi mlaa nɛ e wo mo ɔ nɔ.
He nɛ Yawɛ de mo ke o ko ya ye ní, nɛ o nu nyu hu ngɛ ɔ, o kpale o se ya ye ní, nɛ o nu nyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o ma gbo, nɛ a be mo pue ngɛ o weku li a yɔkɔ mi.” Benɛ a ye ní ɔ ta a, gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ mia teji ɔ ha gbalɔ nɛ je Yuda a, nɛ e kuɔ.
Benɛ e ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, e kɛ jata ya kpe, nɛ jata a gbe lɛ.
E gbogboe ɔ tlɔ blɔ ɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ teji ɔ kɛ jata a daa si ngɛ he.
Ni komɛ ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a na gbogboe ɔ ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi nɛ jata a daa si ngɛ he.
Nɛ a ho ya sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔ ngɛ Betel, he nɛ gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ nu sane nɛ ɔ, e de ke, “Gbalɔ ɔ nɛ gbo Yawɛ fami ɔ tue ɔ, lɛ!
Lɛɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ je lɛ ngɔ wo jata a dɛ mi, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ e mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ke e maa pee ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ mia ye teji ɔ ha mi.” A pee ja, nɛ e kuɔ teji ɔ kɛ ho.
E ya na gbalɔ kaketsɛ ɔ gbogboe ɔ nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ teji ɔ kɛ jata a daa si ngɛ he kɛ mwɔɔ.
Jata a yi nɔ gbogboe ɔ, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ we teji ɔ mi hulɔ.
Gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ wo nɔ gbogboe ɔ ngɔ fɔ teji ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ kpale kɛ ba Betel ba nyɛ ya ha lɛ; nɛ e pu lɛ.
E pu lɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yɔkɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ye lɛ kɔmɔ ke, “Ye nyɛmi, due!
Ye nyɛmi, due!” Benɛ a dla lɛ se ɔ, gbalɔ nɔmoyo ɔ de e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Ke i gbo ɔ, nyɛɛ pu mi ngɛ yɔkɔ nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ gbalɔ nɛ ɔ kasa nya.
Munyuhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ nɛ e tu kɛ si bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ Betel ɔ, kɛ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Samaria ma amɛ a mi ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, munyu ɔmɛ maa ba mi.” Yeroboam he yayami ɔ wo wu Ní nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa a se ɔ, Matsɛ Yeroboam kpale we kɛ ji e blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ; se mohu e hlaa nihi kɛ jeɔ ma a mi he tsuaa he, nɛ e woɔ mɛ osɔfohi kɛ haa ní tsumi ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa ye osɔfo ɔ, kɛkɛ Yeroboam wo lɛ osɔfo.
Yayami nɛ ɔ nɛ Yeroboam pee ɔ, ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ e we ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata.
Yeroboam binyumu ɔ gbenɔ Jamɛ a be ɔ, Matsɛ Yeroboam binyumu Abiya ba nu hiɔ.
Yeroboam de e yo ɔ ke, “Mo tsake o he, nɛ nɔ ko kó le kaa ye yo ji mo, nɛ o ya Shilo, he nɛ gbalɔ Ahiya ngɛ ɔ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ de mi be ko ke i ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel ɔ nɛ.
Ngɔɔ abolo mamɛ nyɔngma, kɛ keeki, kɛ hwo tɔ kake kɛ ya ha lɛ, nɛ e ma de mo nɔ nɛ maa pee wa binyumu.” Yeroboam yo ɔ pee kaa bɔ nɛ e huno ɔ de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho Abiya we ɔ mi ya ngɛ Shilo.
Abiya bwɔ, nɛ e hɛngmɛ yu.
Se Yawɛ de lɛ to momo kaa Yeroboam yo ɔ ma nɛ e ba bi lɛ ga womi ngɛ e binyumu ɔ nɛ be he wami ɔ he.
Nɛ Yawɛ tsɔɔ Abiya bɔ nɛ e de yo ɔ. Benɛ Yeroboam yo ɔ ba su we ɔ mi ɔ, e buá pee e he kaa nɔ kpa ko.
Se benɛ Abiya nu e nane si pɛmi ngɛ sinya a nya kɛ ma a, e de lɛ ke, “Yeroboam yo, moo ba!
Mɛni he je o tsake o he kaa nɔ kpa nɛ ɔ?
I ngɛ sane yobu ko nɛ ma de mo.
Yaa nɛ o ya de Yeroboam ke bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Imi lɛ i hla mo kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ i wo mo ye ma, Israel nɔ matsɛ.
I kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ David nina dɛ ngɔ ha mo.
Se o be kaa ye tsɔlɔ David.
Lɛɛ e nyɛɛ ye se kɛ e tsui tsuo; e ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e pee ye suɔmi nya ní.
O pee yayami kulaa pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye tsɛ kɛ sɛ o hlami ɔ. O kua mi; O ya pee mawu kpa komɛ, nɛ o puɛ amagahi, nɛ o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo ye mi mi la.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kɛ haomi maa ba o we ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma gbe nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ we ɔ mi, nyɔguɛ jio, odehe jio.
Ma kpata o we ɔ hɛ mi; a maa bɛɛ mɛ kɛ ho kaa a bɛɛɔ na fi.
Ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, gbehi maa ye lɛ; nɛ ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye lɛ.
Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ ” Abiya ya nɔ nɛ e de Yeroboam yo ɔ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si nɛ o ho we mi ya.
Ke o su ma a mi pɛ jokuɛ ɔ ma gbo.
Israel ma a tsuo maa nyɛ ya ha lɛ, nɛ a maa pu lɛ.
Lɛ pɛ ji Yeroboam we ɔ mi bi nɛ a maa pu lɛ saminya, ejakaa lɛ pɛ ji nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ná e he tsui ngɛ Yeroboam we ɔ mi.
Yawɛ maa wo matsɛ ko ngɛ Israel, nɛ e ma kpata Yeroboam we ɔ hɛ mi.
Yawɛ maa gbla Israel tue, nɛ Israel ma mimiɛ kaa ngɔwu ngɛ pa mi.
Yawɛ maa hia Israel ma a kɛ je zugba kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa kɛ yaa si Yufrate pa a se.
Yawɛ maa pee enɛ ɔ, ejakaa a ya puɛ amagahi ngɔ ha a yo mawu Ashera a, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ mi mi la.
Yawɛ ma je e nine ngɛ Israel he, ejakaa Yeroboam pee yayami, nɛ e ha nɛ Israel hu ya pee yayami.” Yeroboam yo ɔ kpale e se kɛ ho Tirza ya.
Benɛ e sɛ we ɔ mi pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ jokuɛ ɔ gbo.
Israel ma a nyɛ ya ha lɛ, nɛ a pu lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ, gbalɔ Ahiya nɔ ɔ. Yeroboam gbenɔ Yeroboam he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, tahi nɛ e hwu, kɛ bɔ nɛ e ye tsɛ ha a, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yeroboam ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
E ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ, nɛ e binyumu Nadab ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Rehoboam Salomo binyumu Rehoboam ye jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kake benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaago.
Yerusalem ji ma nɛ Yawɛ hla kɛ je Israel zugba a mi tsuo nɛ e ngɔ kɛ pee he nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ.
Rehoboam nyɛ biɛ ji Naama, nɛ Amon no ji lɛ.
Yuda ma a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ a pee níhi babauu kɛ wo e mi mi la pe bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pee ɔ po.
Mɛ hu a po piɛhi, nɛ a puɛ amagahi ngɛ ma a mi, ngɛ yokuhi a nɔ, kɛ tsohi nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi; amaga amɛ ekomɛ daa si ha a yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ashera a. Jehanɛ se hu, ngɛ a jami kusumi komɛ a mi ɔ, nyumu komɛ kɛ a sibi nyumuhi na bɔmi kaa nyumu kɛ yo.
Yuda ma a pee zo níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee po pe níhi nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ nɔ ɔ pee ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Matsɛ Rehoboam yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ, Egipt matsɛ, Shishak ba tua Yerusalem, nɛ e muɔ june níhi nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ sika tsu tsɛ̃ihi nɛ Salomo pee ɔ kɛ ho.
Matsɛ Rehoboam pee akɔblee tsɛ̃ihi kɛ to a nane mi, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo matsɛ we agbo nya buli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ ɔ maa ya Yawɛ we ɔ, buli ɔmɛ maa hɛɛ tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa kpale mɛ ya to buli ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi ekohu.
Matsɛ Rehoboam he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Rehoboam kɛ Yeroboam kpɛti jɔɛ; daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ta nɔ.
Rehoboam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Abiya ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Abiya Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ, Abiya ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha etɛ.
E nyɛ ji Maaka, Absalom biyo ɔ. E ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e pee yayami nɛ e tsɛ pee ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E ya nyɛɛ we Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ se kaa bɔ nɛ e nɛnɛkasowa David pee ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, David he ɔ, Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ ha lɛ binyumu, nɛ bi nɛ ɔ ba ye e se ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e ha nɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ da si.
Yawɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa David wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, e pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní.
Mlaa amɛ nɛ Yawɛ wo lɛ ɔ, e tɔ we ekoeko pe sane ɔ nɛ ya ba ngɛ e kɛ Hit no Uria a kpɛti ɔ pɛ.
Abiya yi nɔ ɔ, Israel kɛ Yuda a kpɛti jɔɛ; daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ta nɔ.
Abiya he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Abiya ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Asa ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Asa Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam yi nɔ jeha nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, Asa ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kake.
E na ji Maaka, Absalom biyo ɔ. Asa pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ e nɛ, David pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E fie nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha ajuama bɔmi ngɛ jami kusumi ko nya a kɛ je zugba a nɔ, nɛ e je amaga amɛ tsuo nɛ e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ puɛ ɔ. E na, Maaka po e kpa lɛ manyɛ yemi, ejakaa e puɛ amaga ko nɛ a hiee kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. Asa ywia amaga nɛ ɔ, nɛ e sã lɛ ngɛ Kidron pa a nya.
E ngɛ mi kaa Asa puɛ we wɔ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo lɛɛ, se e nyɛɛ Yawɛ se kɛ pi si e wami be ɔ tsuo.
E ya ngɔ níhi nɛ e tsɛ pee klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, kɛ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ níhi; nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ba ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Yuda matsɛ, Asa, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Baasha a kpɛti jɔɛ a wami be ɔ tsuo; daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ta nɔ.
Israel matsɛ, Baasha ba tua Yuda, nɛ e dla po Rama, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó nyɛ nɛ e je Israel kɛ ya Yuda, loo Yuda kɛ ba Israel.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Matsɛ Asa ya muɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu tsuo nɛ piɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ, nɛ e tsɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ekomɛ Damasko, nɛ e kɛ ní ɔmɛ ya ha Siria matsɛ, Benhadad, Hezio binyumu Tabrimon bi ɔ. Sɛ gbi nɛ piɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ha nɛ i kɛ mo waa so kaa bɔ nɛ tsaatsɛ kɛ o tsɛ so ɔ. I ngɛ mo sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu nike ní manee.
Yaa nɛ o kɛ Israel matsɛ, Baasha ya po somi nɛ o kɛ lɛ so ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e je e ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ je ye zugba a nɔ kɛ ho.” Benhadad kplɛɛ Asa munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tsɔ e tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya tua Israel ma amɛ.
A ngɔ Iyon, Dan, Abel Bet Maaka, Kinerot, kɛ Naftali zugba amɛ tsuo.
Benɛ Matsɛ Baasha nu sane nɛ ba a, e jɔɔ Rama ma a dlami, nɛ e je kɛ ho Tirza ya.
Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Asa ha a fiɛ ngɛ Yuda tsuo ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba, konɛ ma a tsuo ba bua kɛ muɔ tɛhi, kɛ tsohi nɛ Baasha kɛ ba ngɛ Rama mae ɔ kɛ ho.
Matsɛ Asa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ po Geba ma a ngɛ Benyamin, kɛ Mizpa ma a hulɔ.
Asa he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ; kã nɛ e pee, kɛ mahi nɛ e po ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Se e bwɔbwɔɛ si ɔ, e nu nane hiɔ.
Asa ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Yehoshafat ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Nadab Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, Matsɛ Yeroboam binyumu Nadab ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.
E ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ e ha Israel hu pee yayami.
Ahiya binyumu Baasha nɛ je Isakar wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ so Nadab yi nɔ, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ Filisti bi a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Gibeton ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Nadab kɛ e tabo ɔ ho ya sa Gibeton ma a yi.
Sane nɛ ɔ ba ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi; nɛ Baasha ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel ngɛ Nadab se.
Benɛ Baasha bɔni matsɛ yemi pɛ nɛ e gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Yeroboam we ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ, gbalɔ Ahiya, Shilo no ɔ nɔ ɔ.
A gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Yeroboam we ɔ mi; nɔ kake po piɛ.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yeroboam wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la; Yeroboam pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, e ha nɛ Israel hu pee yayami.
Nadab he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yuda matsɛ, Asa, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Baasha a kpɛti jɔɛ a wami be ɔ tsuo; daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ta nɔ.
Israel matsɛ, Baasha Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, Ahiya binyumu Baasha ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo nɔ.
E hi Tirza kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ.
E ya wo e nɛ Yeroboam nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ e ha Israel hu pee yayami.
Yawɛ kɛ gbalɔ Yehu, Hanani binyumu ɔ tu munyu, nɛ e kɛ sɛ gbi ha lɛ nɛ e ya de Baasha ke, “Jinɛ pi nɔ ko kulaa ji mo, nɛ i wo o nɔ, nɛ i pee mo ye ma, Israel nyatsɛ.
Se o ya wo Yeroboam nane, nɛ o ha ye ma, Israel pee yayami nɛ a kɛ wo ye mi mi la.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma kpata o kɛ o we ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ɔ. Ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, gbehi maa ye lɛ; nɛ ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye lɛ.” Baasha he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ kã nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Baasha ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Tirza, nɛ e binyumu Ela ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yawɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ gu gbalɔ Yehu, Hanani binyumu ɔ nɔ ya ha Baasha kɛ e we ɔ, ejakaa Baasha pee yayami kɛ si lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ. Pi yayami nɛ Baasha pee kɛ si Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Yeroboam hu pee be ko ɔ kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la a, gbemi nɛ Baasha gbe Yeroboam we mi bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ hu piɛ he.
Israel matsɛ, Ela Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ ekpa a, Baasha binyumu Ela ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Tirza kɛ ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.
Ela tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zimri ɔ so e yi nɔ.
Zimri nɛ ɔ ji Matsɛ Ela ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ fa a nyatsɛ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Ela ya Tirza, nɛ e ya nu dã nɛ e de kpɔtɔɔ ngɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ngɛ Tirza a we mi.
Tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ biɛ ji Arza.
Zimri ya sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ e fia Ela nɔ́ nɛ e gbe, nɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ e nane mi.
Sane nɛ ɔ ba ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago ɔ mi.
Benɛ Zimri bɔni matsɛ yemi pɛ nɛ e gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Baasha we ɔ mi; nyumu kake too po píɛ.
E gbe Baasha weku li, kɛ e huɛmɛ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu gbalɔ Yehu nɔ ɔ, Zimri kpata Baasha we ɔ tsuo hɛ mi.
Baasha, kɛ e binyumu Ela pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
A ha nɛ Israel ya ja amagahi, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la.
Ela he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Israel matsɛ, Zimri Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago ɔ, Zimri ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Tirza kɛ ye matsɛ ligbi kpaago.
Israel ta buli ɔmɛ ya sa Filisti bi a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Gibeton ɔ yi, nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Zimri so matsɛ ɔ yi nɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ ɔ, Israel tsuo wo Omri, nɛ ji tabo ɔ nyatsɛ ɔ matsɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ngɛ a sito he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Omri kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ je Gibeton kɛ ho nɛ a ya sa Tirza yi.
Benɛ Zimri na kaa a ngɔ ma a, e ho ya sɛ mɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi.
E mɛ matsɛ we ɔ he la, nɛ la a sã lɛ nɛ e gbo.
Nɔ́ nɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba ji kaa Zimri pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ e nɛ̃ Yeroboam pee ɔ, Zimri pee yayami, nɛ e ha Israel hu pee yayami; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo Yawɛ mi mi la.
Zimri he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ Ela yi nɔ nɛ e so ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Israel matsɛ, Omri Jehanɛ, Israel ma a mi ba gba enyɔ; fa ya nyɛɛ Ginat binyumu Tibni se, nɛ a hla kaa a maa wo lɛ matsɛ; nɛ fa hu ya nyɛɛ Omri se.
Se Omri se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ye ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya nyɛɛ Ginat binyumu Tibni se ɔ a nɔ, nɛ benɛ Tibni gbo ɔ, Omri ba ye matsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ kake ɔ, Omri ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel.
E ye matsɛ ɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ; e hi Tirza kɛ ye matsɛ jeha ekpa.
E he Samaria yoku ɔ ngɛ nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shemer ɔ dɛ sika hiɔ yi akpe ekpa.
Omri po ma ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ, nɛ e fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he.
E kɛ yoku ɔ tsɛ biɛ Shemer ɔ wo ma a, nɛ ma a biɛ ba pee Samaria.
Omri pee yayami babauu kɛ si Yawɛ pe ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ. E ya wo Nebat binyumu Yeroboam nane, nɛ e pee yayami.
E ja amaga, nɛ e ha Israel hu ya pee yayami nɛ ɔ; nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la.
Omri he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ kã nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Omri ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Samaria, nɛ e binyumu Ahab ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Ahab Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ, Omri binyumu Ahab ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ tsuo.
E pi ha Ahab kaa e maa pee yayami kaa bɔ nɛ Yeroboam pee ɔ kɛkɛ, se e ya nɔ pee yayami kɛ be nɔ.
E ya ngɔ Sidon matsɛ, Etbaal biyo Yezebel, nɛ e ya ja Baal.
E po piɛ ha Baal ngɛ Samaria, nɛ e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɔ ma mi.
Jehanɛ, e puɛ amaga kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. Ahab pee yayami kɛ wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la pe Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ. E yi nɔ ɔ, Hiel nɛ je Betel ɔ ya kpale ma Yeriko ma a ekohu.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ gu Nun binyumu Yoshua nɔ de to ɔ, benɛ Hiel to Yeriko ma a sisi pɛ nɛ e bitɛte nɛ a tsɛɛ Abiram ɔ gbo, nɛ benɛ e ma agbo ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ e sekpɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Segub ɔ hu gbo.
Gbalɔ Eliya Gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Eliya, nɛ je Tishbe ngɛ Gilead ɔ de Matsɛ Ahab ke, “Ina Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ i jaa lɛ ɔ kaa bɔ́, aloo hiɔmi be nɛe ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha enyɔ, loo etɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma tsɔɔ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Eliya ke, “Jee hiɛ ɔ nɛ o gu beleku blɔ, nɛ o ya laa o he ngɛ Kerit pa a nya ngɛ Yordan beleku je.
O maa nu pa a mi nyu, nɛ niye ní nɛ kuakualabitehi kɛ maa ba a, o maa ye; ejakaa i fa mɛ ke a ngɔ niye ní ba ha mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Eliya bu Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue, nɛ e ho ya hi Kerit pa a nya.
E nuɔ pa a mi nyu ɔ, nɛ kuakualabitehi ba haa lɛ abolo, kɛ lo daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ.
Be bɔɔ se ɔ, nyu ɔ ta pa a mi, ejakaa hiɔmi kpa nɛmi.
Eliya kɛ yalɔyo ɔ nɛ je Zarefat ɔ Pee se ɔ, Yawɛ de Eliya ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ, yaa Zarefat nɛ ngɛ Sidon kasa nya a, nɛ o ya hi lejɛ ɔ. I fa yalɔyo ko nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke e hyɛ o nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliya pue nɔ kɛ ho Zarefat ya, nɛ benɛ e ya su ma a we agbo ɔ nya a, e na yalɔyo ko nɛ ngɛ lɛ́ nya buae.
Eliya de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, yaa yɛ nyu bɔɔ ba ha mi nɛ ma nu.” Benɛ yo ɔ yaa nɛ e ya yɛ nyu ɔ, Eliya tsɛ e yi se, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ abolo bɔɔ ko ngɔ piɛ he kɛ ba ha mi.” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I na Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kaa i be abolo.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pɛ ji mamu dɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ buɛ mi, kɛ nu bɔbɔyoo ko ngɛ tɔ mi.
I ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ma ba bua lɛ́ bɔɔ ko nya kɛ ya we mi, nɛ ma kɛ ya sã abolo, nɛ i kɛ ye binyumu waa ye.
Lɔ ɔ se lɛɛ wa ma gbo kɛ hwɔ.” Se Eliya de lɛ ke, “Koo ye tsui!
Yaa nɛ o ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ. Ngɔɔ mamu ɔ eko kɛ pee abolo nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ba ha mi kekle; lɔ ɔ se loko o pee o kɛ o binyumu ɔ nyɛ nɔ́.
Ejakaa, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mamu ɔ be buɛ ɔ mi tae, nɛ nu ɔ hu be tɔ ɔ mi tae kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma ha nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ.’ ” Yalɔyo ɔ ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ Eliya de lɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a ye ní nɛ a tɔ ligbi babauu.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu Eliya nɔ ɔ, mamu ɔ tɛ buɛ ɔ mi, nɛ nu ɔ hu tɛ tɔ ɔ mi.
Pee se ɔ, yalɔyo ɔ binyumu ɔ ba nu hiɔ wawɛɛ kɛ ya si e gbo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ de Eliya ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ, mɛni he je o pee mi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?
Pe o ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ba kai Mawu ye he yayami ɔmɛ, konɛ ye binyumu ɔ nɛ gbo lo?” Eliya de lɛ ke, “Wo o bi ɔ kɛ ba!” E he jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ ngɛ yo ɔ dɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ ya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya fɔ lɛ nitsɛ e sa a nɔ.
Eliya fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, ye Mawu lee!
Mɛni he je nɛ o kɛ yalɔyo nɛ i ba to lɛ nɛ ɔ ye sane yaya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ o gbe e binyumu ɔ?” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Eliya kpã e mi, nɛ e bu si ngɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ nɔ si etɛ, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, ye Mawu lee!
Ha nɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo nɛ ɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ba wami mi ekohu!” Yawɛ bu Eliya kue fami ɔ tue; jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ bɔni mumi womi ekohu, nɛ e hɛ tsɛ̃.
Eliya wo jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ kple si, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya ha e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, o binyumu ɔ yi na wami!” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Kpaako loko i na kaa Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mo, nɛ Yawɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ guɔ o nɔ niinɛ!”
Eliya kɛ Baal gbali ɔmɛ Pee se ngɛ jeha etɛne ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ de Eliya ke, “Yaa nɛ o kɛ o he ya tsɔɔ Matsɛ Ahab, nɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ.” Nɛ Eliya pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, hwɔ ɔ nya wa wawɛɛ ngɛ Samaria, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Ahab tsɛ Obadia, matsɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ. .
Ahab de Obadia ke, “Ha nɛ wa ya kpa zugba a nɔ nɛ waa hyɛ kaa wa ma na nga ngɛ pa amɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi ba ha wa okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ teji okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kpe, konɛ wa ko ba gbe wa lohwe ɔmɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a dla zugba a he nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ya kpa; Ahab gu he kake, nɛ Obadia hu gu he kake.
Benɛ Obadia ngɛ e blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, e kɛ Eliya ya kpe tlukaa.
Obadia le Eliya mi tso, nɛ e kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e bi ke, “Anɛ mo tutuutu lo, ye nyɔmtsɛ Eliya?” E he nɔ ke, “Ee, imi Eliya.
Yaa nɛ o ya de o nyɔmtsɛ Ahab ɔ ke i ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Obadia he nɔ ke, “Mɛni yayami i pee loko o ngɛ hlae nɛ o ngɔ mi kɛ wo Matsɛ Ahab dɛ mi nɛ e gbe mi ɔ?
I na Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kaa e píɛ ma ko, loo zugba ko nɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɔɛ kɛ yɛ nɛ a ya hla mo.
Be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ, aloo zugba a nɔ yelɔ ngɛ he nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya a ha a nu sisi kaa o be lejɛ ɔ, Ahab ha nɛ jamɛ a matsɛ ɔ, aloo zugba a nɔ yelɔ ɔ ka kita ke o be lejɛ ɔ niinɛ.
Nɛ moo o deɔ mi ke ma ya nɛ ma ya de ye nyɔmtsɛ Ahab ke o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!
Ke i je o ngɔ kɛ ho piɔ ɔ, Yawɛ mumi ɔ ma ba ngɔ mo kɛ ho he ko ya nɛ i li.
Nɛ e maa ba mi kaa ke i ya de Ahab ke o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e ba, nɛ e ba nɛ mo ɔ, e maa gbe mi.
Mo kai kaa kɛ je ye jokuɛ mi tɔɔ ɔ, i yee Yawɛ gbeye.
Anɛ o nui kaa benɛ Yezebel ngɛ Yawɛ gbali ɔmɛ gbee ɔ, i ngɔ a ti nihi lafa ngɔ laa ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, nɛ i ha mɛ niye ní kɛ nyu lo?
I ngɔ gbali nyingmi enuɔ ngɔ to he kake, nɛ i ngɔ nyingmi enuɔ hu ngɔ to he kake.
Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o deɔ mi ke ma ya de ye nyɔmtsɛ Ahab ke o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?
Pe o ngɛ hlae nɛ e gbe mi?” Eliya he nɔ ke, “I na Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ, kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ ye he kɛ tsɔɔ matsɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Obadia ho nɛ e ya bɔ Ahab amaniɛ, nɛ Ahab hu ho ya na Eliya.
Benɛ Ahab na lɛ ɔ, e bi ke, “Mo, Israel nya doolɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?” Eliya he nɔ ke, “O kɛ o tsɛ we ɔ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ Israel haoe, se pi imi.
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tɔ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya ja Baalhi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo tsɔ nɛ a ya bua Israel ma a tsuo nya nɛ a kɛ mi ba kpe ngɛ Karmel yo ɔ nɔ.
Ngɔɔ Baal gbali lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ yo mawu Ashera gbali lafa eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a nyɛɛɔ Manyɛ Yezebel se ɔ hu kɛ ba.” Ahab tsɔ ya kpee Israel ma a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Karmel yo ɔ nɔ.
Eliya hɛ lɛ kɛ su ma a he, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ yaa si mɛni be loko nyɛ maa pee nyɛ juɛmi ngɛ nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a he?
Ke Yawɛ ji Mawu ɔ, nyɛ ja lɛ; ke Baal ji Mawu ɔ, nyɛ ja lɛ.” Se ma a ha we lɛ heto.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Eliya de ke, “Imi nɔ kake too ji Yawɛ gbalɔ nɛ piɛ, se Baal gbali ɔmɛ lɛɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ a ba ha wɔ na ku enyɔ.
Baal gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a hla kake ha a he nɛ a gbe.
A poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ a to ngɔ pue lɛ́ nɔ, se a ko wo sisi la.
Imi hu ma ngɔ na ku kake ɔ, nɛ ma pee ja nɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Baal gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a fa kue ha a mawu ɔ, konɛ imi hu ma fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ mawu nɛ ma ha la maa ba a, lɛ ji Mawu.” Ma a tsuo he nɔ ke, “Saminya!” Jehanɛ Eliya de Baal gbali ɔmɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ nyɛ he hiɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ kekle nyɛɛ hla na ku ɔ kake nyɛɛ gbe, nɛ nyɛɛ poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ nyɛɛ to ngɔ pue lɛ́ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ fa kue ha nyɛ mawu ɔ, se nyɛ ko wo sisi la.” A nu na ku ɔ nɛ a ha mɛ ɔ, nɛ a pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Eliya de mɛ ɔ; a fa kue ha Baal kɛ je mɔtu kɛ ya si piani.
A kpa huhui ke, “Baal lee, moo bu wɔ tue oo!” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a ngɛ hlue kɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a puɛ ɔ bɔlee.
Se nɔ ko he we nɔ.
Piani ɔ, Eliya ye a he fɛu nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ kpa wawɛɛ, ejakaa mawu ji lɛ!
Eko piɔ, e ngɛ e yi mi susue, aloo e te si bɔɔ, aloo e hia blɔ, aloo be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e hwɔ mahe, konɛ nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ!” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Baal gbali ɔmɛ kpa huhui wawɛɛ pe kekle ɔ. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a kusumi ngɛ ɔ, a ngɔ ha kɛ klaate kɛ poo a he kɛ ya si muɔ bɔni bemi.
A hɛɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ munyu tumi basabasa hluu kɛ ya si pu plɛplɛ; se heto ko bɛ, nɛ gbi ko hu pɛ́.
Jehanɛ, Eliya de ma a tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ.” Nɛ mɛ tsuo a ba bɔle lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e dla nɛ e puɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a ku pue si ɔ. E ngɔ tɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ Yakob nɛ Yawɛ wo lɛ biɛ ke Israel ɔ binyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya.
E kɛ tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ dla puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
E tsua muɔ kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, nɛ e mi kuɔ bɔ nɛ nyu lita nyɔnyma kɛ eywiɛ, loo nɔ maa ya mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e to lɛ́ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e poo na ku ɔ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ e to ngɔ pue lɛ́ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ ya yɛ nyu buɛ eywiɛ ba pue sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛ́ ɔ nɔ.” A pee ja, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ pee ja ekohu si enyɔne”, nɛ a pee ja.
E kpale de ke, “Nyɛɛ pee ja ekohu si etɛne”; nɛ a pee.
Nyu ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ ya pue muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ muɔ ɔ hyi.
Gbɔkuɛ bɔ sami be ɔ, gbalɔ Eliya hɛ lɛ kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e sɔle ke, “Yawɛ, Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu lee, ha nɛ a le mwɔnɛ ɔ kaa mo ji Israel Mawu, nɛ o tsɔlɔ ji mi, nɛ i pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o fami nya.
Moo bu mi tue, Yawɛ; moo bu mi tue, konɛ ma nɛ ɔ nɛ ná nɛ a le kaa mo, Yawɛ ji Mawu, nɛ o kpale ngɔ mɛ kɛ ma o ngɔ ekohu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha la je hiɔwe ba sã sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛ́ ɔ, kɛ tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo zu ɔ, nɛ e mii nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ.
Benɛ ma a tsuo na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ ji Mawu!
Yawɛ ji Mawu!” Eliya fa ke, “Nyɛɛ nuu Baal gbali ɔmɛ; nyɛ ko ha nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu nɛ tu fo!” Ma a nuu mɛ tsuo, nɛ Eliya nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ kple yoku ɔ kɛ ho Kishon pa a nya ya, nɛ e ya gbe mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyu hwɔ ɔ se po Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Eliya de Matsɛ Ahab ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ, yaa nɛ o ya ye ní nɛ o nu ní, ejakaa i nu nɛ hiɔmi ngɛ sie kɛ ma.” Benɛ Ahab ho nɛ́ e ya ye ní ɔ, Eliya kuɔ Karmel yo ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya ya kpla si ngɛ zugba, nɛ e kɛ e yi wo e nakutso kpɛ.
E de e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya hyɛ wo mi blɔ ha.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ ya, nɛ e kpale ba de ke, “I nɛ nɔ́ ko”.
Eliya de tsɔlɔ ɔ si kpaago sɔuu ke e ya nɛ e ya hyɛ.
Benɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ya hyɛ si kpaagone ɔ, e ba ba de Eliya ke, “I na bɔku nyafii kaa nɔmlɔ nine nɛ te si kɛ je wo ɔ mi kɛ ma.” Eliya fa e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Yaa Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ nɛ o ya de lɛ ke e sɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya esɔ; ke pi ja a, hiɔmi ɔ maa tsi e nya.” E kɛ we kulaa nɛ bɔku yumuu ko ba ha hiɔwe ɔ; kɔɔhiɔ ba bɔni fiami, nɛ hiɔmi ba bɔni nɛmi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ahab ya sɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e je kɛ ho Yezreel ya.
Yawɛ ha Eliya he wami; e fi e tade ɔ ngɔ wo e mlɛ mi, nɛ e gbɔ fo kɛ ya be Ahab he kɛ ho Yezreel ya tɔɔ.
Eliya ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ Matsɛ Ahab ya bɔ e yo Yezebel níhi tsuo nɛ Eliya pee ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e gbe Baal gbali ɔmɛ tsuo.
Yezebel tsɔ ya de Eliya ke, “Hwɔɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ke i pee we mo kaa bɔ nɛ o pee ye gbali ɔmɛ fii, lɛɛ mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a fia mi nɔ́ nɛ a gbe.” Eliya tsui po, nɛ e kɛ gbenɔ kɛ kã tu fo kɛ ho Beersheba ya ngɛ Yuda.
E kɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ ho.
E ya si e tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e nyɛɛ ligbi mluku kake kɛ ya nga a nɔ, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ tso ko sisi, nɛ e ná nɛ e gbo.
E sɔle ke, “Yawɛ, e hiɛ; moo gbe mi jehanɛ.
E hi kaa ma gbo mohu; ejakaa ye nɛmɛ nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ, i hí pi mɛ.” Eliya hwɔ si ngɛ tso ɔ sisi, nɛ e hwɔ mahe.
Tlukaa a, hiɔwe bɔfo ko ba ta e he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Wlua mo nɛ o ye ní!” Benɛ e hyɛ e he kɛ be ɔ, e na abolo, kɛ kplu kɛ e mi nyu nɛ maa si ngɛ e yi tetle mi.
E ye ní, nɛ e nu nyu, nɛ e hwɔ si ekohu.
Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ kpale ba ba tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ si enyɔne, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Wlua mo nɛ o ye ní, ejakaa blɔ nɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi ɔ he wa saminya.” Eliya te si, nɛ e ye ní, nɛ e nu nyu; nɛ niye ní ɔ ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ nyɛɛ nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ya Sinai, yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
E ya sɛ tɛ puɔ ko mi, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. Tlukaa a, Yawɛ kɛ lɛ tu munyu, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Eliya, mɛni o ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu, i sɔmɔɔ mo daa be tsuaa bekɛ hɛdɔ.
Se Israel ma a lɛɛ somi nɛ o kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ; a hule o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ pue si, nɛ a gbe o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Imi nɔ kake too pɛ nɛ i piɛ, nɛ a ngɛ mi hlae nɛ a gbe!” Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Jee kpo nɛ o ya da si ngɛ ye hɛ mi ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ba be kɛ ho, nɛ e ha kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ba fia yo ɔ, nɛ e ywia tɛ sa amɛ, se Yawɛ be kɔɔhiɔ ɔ mi.
Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ kpa fiami, nɛ zugba mimiɛ; se Yawɛ be zugba mimiɛmi ɔ mi.
Zugba mimiɛmi ɔ se ɔ, la ba, se Yawɛ be la a mi.
La a se ɔ, gbi ko nɛ he jɔ pɛ blɛuu.
Benɛ Eliya nu gbi nɛ ɔ, e kɛ e tade klɔii ɔ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ e je kpo ya da si ngɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko bi lɛ ke, “Eliya, mɛni o ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ Mawu Ope, i sɔmɔɔ mo daa be tsuaa be kɛ hɛdɔ.
Se Israel ma a lɛɛ somi nɛ o kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ; a hule o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ pue si, nɛ a gbe o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Imi nɔ kake too pɛ nɛ i piɛ, nɛ a ngɛ mi hlae nɛ a gbe.” Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Kpale o se kɛ ya nga a nɔ ngɛ Damasko kasa nya.
Yaa ma a mi, nɛ o ya pɔ Hazael nu, nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ Siria; pɔɔ Nimshi binyumu Yehu nu, nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel, nɛ o pɔ Shafat binyumu Elisha nɛ je Abel Mehola hu nu, nɛ e ye gbalɔ ngɛ o se.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tu fo kɛ je Hazael klaate nya a, Yehu maa gbe lɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ maa tu fo kɛ maa je Yehu klaate nya a, Elisha maa gbe lɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i si gbali akpe kpaago hɛ ngmengmle ngɛ Israel nɛ mɛɛ a kpla we si kɛ ha we Baal, nɛ a fiɔ we e nya he hulɔ.” A tsɛ Elisha Eliya je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya na Elisha nɛ e kɛ na blablɛhi ngɛ hue; na blablɛ nyɔngma kɛ kake ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ na blablɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ngɛ hue.
Eliya je tade klɔii ɔ ngɛ e he, nɛ e ngɔ wo Elisha.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha je e na amɛ a he, nɛ e tu fo kɛ nyɛɛ Eliya se; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ i kɛ tsaatsɛ, kɛ maa ya ye sɛ, konɛ ma ba nyɛɛ o se.” Eliya he nɔ ke, “Yoo, moo ya.
I tsi we o nya!” Elisha kpale e se kɛ ho e na blablɛ ɔmɛ a he ya, nɛ e ya gbe mɛ, nɛ e ngɔ tso nɛ a kɛ fi na amɛ kɛ bla a ngɔ pee lɛ́, nɛ e kɛ hoo lo ɔ. E ngɔ lo ɔ ngɔ ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya nyɛɛ Eliya se, nɛ e sɔmɔ lɛ.
Siria kɛ Israel hwu ta Siria matsɛ, Benhadad bua e tabo ɔ tsuo nya.
E kɛ matsɛmɛ kpahi nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ hia ta kɛ a we okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛhi, nɛ a ya sa Samaria yi, nɛ a tua ma a. E tsɔ ya de Israel matsɛ, Ahab ngɛ ma a mi ke, “Imi Matsɛ Benhadad, i fa ke o ngɔ o sika hiɔ, o sika tsu, o yi ɔmɛ, kɛ o bimɛ kpakpa amɛ kɛ ba ha mi.” Ahab he nɔ ke, “Mo ya de ye nyɔmtsɛ, Matsɛ Benhadad ke i kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e bi mi ɔ nɔ; imi nitsɛ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, e níhi ji wɔ.” Pee se ɔ, tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi kpa kɛ je Benhadad ngɔ ba ha Ahab ke, “I tsɔ ba de mo ke o ngɔ o sika hiɔ, o sika tsu, o yi ɔmɛ, kɛ o bimɛ kpakpa amɛ kɛ ba ha mi lɛɛ, se hwɔɔ maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma tsɔ nihi o ngɔ.
Tsɔli ɔmɛ ma ba kpa o we ɔ mi, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ a wehi a mi, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa muɔ a hɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ kɛ je.” Matsɛ Ahab tsɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ na kaa nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e ye wɔ sane yaya?
E tsɔ ba de mi ke ma ngɔ ye yi ɔmɛ, ye bimɛ ɔmɛ, ye sika hiɔ, kɛ ye sika tsu kɛ ba ha lɛ, nɛ i kua we.” Ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo de lɛ ke, “Koo po e nya mi; koo kplɛɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Ahab de Benhadad tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ya de ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ ɔ ke ní ɔmɛ nɛ e bi mi kekle ɔ, i kplɛɛ kaa ma pee; se enɛ ɔ lɛɛ i be nyɛe ma pee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ho.
Pee se ɔ, Benhadad kpale tsɔ mɛ Ahab ngɔ ekohu nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Ma ngɔ nimli nɛ a he hiɛ babauu pe Samaria tabo zu kɛ ba kpata o ma a hɛ mi.
Ke i nyɛ we ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a fia mi nɔ nɛ a gbe!” Israel matsɛ, Ahab he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ya de Matsɛ Benhadad ke, ta bulɔ kpakpa a, ta nyagbe e fĩaa ngɛ, se pi ta sisije.” Benhadad kɛ matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ngɛ dã nue ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi benɛ a ngɔ Ahab sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ɔ. E fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ gba ngɔ wo ma a he!” Nɛ a pee ja.
Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, gbalɔ ko ba Israel matsɛ Ahab ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ ke, ‘Koo ye tabo agbo nɛ ɔ gbeye!
Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi, konɛ o na nɛ o le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.’ ” Ahab bi ke, “Mɛnɔmɛ maa nyɛɛ ta a hɛ mi?” Gbalɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Amlaalo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a nya a a ta buli nihewi ɔmɛ maa nyɛɛ ta a hɛ mi.” Jehanɛ, matsɛ ɔ bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ ma gba ta a?” Gbalɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Mo.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ a bua amlaalo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a nya a a tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ji ta buli nihewi ɔmɛ a nya.
A hiɛmi ji lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a bua Israel tabo ɔ tsuo nya, nɛ a na nimli akpe kpaago.
Piani ɔ, a hia ta.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Benhadad, kɛ matsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ kpa amɛ nu dã nɛ a tɔ kpɔtɔɔ ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi.
Ta buli nihewi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ hia kekle.
Slaali nɛ Benhadad tsɔ ɔ ya bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ke ta buli komɛ je Samaria kɛ ma.
Benhadad fa ke, “Ke a ma nɛ a ba ha yi jio, ta hwumi nɛ a ma jio, nyɛɛ nuu mɛ hɛ ngmengmle!” Ta buli nihewi ɔmɛ hia kɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi, nɛ Israel tabo ɔ nyɛɛ a se, nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ gbe nɔ nɛ e kɛ kpe ɔ. Siria bi ɔmɛ tu fo, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se.
Se Siria matsɛ, Benhadad kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli komɛ hi okpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ tu fo kɛ je.
Matsɛ Ahab nyɛɛ a se nɛ e kpata okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e pee Siria bi ɔmɛ butuu.
Pee se ɔ, gbalɔ ɔ ba Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Kpale o se nɛ o ya dla o he saminya, nɛ o hyɛ bɔ nɛ o maa pee ha; ejakaa hwɔɔ se jeha be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ba tua mo ekohu.” Siria ba tua Israel ekohu Siria matsɛ, Benhadad tsɔli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Israel bi ɔmɛ a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ, mawuhi nɛ hii yokuhi a nɔ ji mɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔ he je nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ye wa nɔ kunimi ɔ nɛ.
Se ke waa kɛ mɛ hwu ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, wa maa ye a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jé matsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ a blɔ he ɔmɛ, nɛ o ngɔ asafoatsɛmɛ ngɔ to a nane mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bua tabo agbo ko nya kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ tu fo kɛ je o he ɔ. Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a hiɛ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ kɛ̃.
Waa kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hwu ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ wa maa ye a nɔ kunimi.” Matsɛ Benhadad bu a ga womi ɔ tue, nɛ e pee kaa bɔ nɛ a de ɔ. Jeha kake se ɔ, e bua Siria bi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ mɛ hia kɛ ba Afek, konɛ e kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba hwu ta.
Israel bi ɔmɛ hu bua a he nya, nɛ a dla a he kɛ niye ní, nɛ a hia ya pue si ngɛ kuu enyɔ a mi ngɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ a hanɔ.
Ke o hyɛ bɔ nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ ha zugba a tsuo hɛ mi kɛ kpe, nɛ o kɛ mɛ to Israel bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ pee kaa apletsi kuu nyafinyafi enyɔ pɛ.
Gbalɔ ko ba Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Akɛnɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ de ke Yawɛ ɔ, mawu nɛ hii yokuhi a nɔ ji lɛ, se pi mawu nɛ hii nga nɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, ma ngɔ nimli kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wo o dɛ mi, nɛ o kɛ o ma a ma ná maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.’ ” Siria ta a, kɛ Israel ta a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee a sibi ligbi kpaago.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, a bɔni ta hwumi, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe Siria bi akpe lafa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo we ɔ tu fo kɛ ho Afek ya, nɛ gbogbo ɔ nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ hule pue a ti nihi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago a nɔ.
Benhadad hu tu fo kɛ ho ma a mi ya, nɛ e ya laa e he ngɛ se tsu ko mi.
E tsɔli ɔmɛ ya de lɛ ke, “Wa nu kaa Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ naa mɔbɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ waa ngɔ kpekpe ya bo kɛ muɔ wa mlɛ mi, nɛ waa ngɔ tangme ngɔ wo wa kuɛ, nɛ waa ya Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa, alini e ma he o yi wami lo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ kpekpe ya bo muɔ a mlɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ tangme hu wo a kuɛ, nɛ a ya Ahab ngɔ ya de lɛ ke, “O tsɔlɔ, Benhadad ke e kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ e he ngɔ ke lɛ.” Ahab bi ke, “Benhadad ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ lo?
Ye nyɛmi ji lɛ!” Benhadad tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ hyɛe kaa a maa na manye okadi ko lo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Ahab de ja a, a nya sɔ nɛ a de ke, “Ee, o nyɛmi ji Benhadad!” Ahab fa ke, “Nyɛ ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba!” Benɛ Benhadad ba a, Ahab de lɛ ke e kuɔ ta zugba lɛ ɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ.
Benhadad de lɛ ke, “Mahi nɛ tsaatsɛ kpɔ ngɛ o tsɛ dɛ ɔ, ma kpale ngɔ ha mo ekohu.
O ma nyɛ maa ma jua yemi hehi ngɛ Damasko kaa bɔ nɛ tsaatsɛ hu pee ngɛ Samaria a.” Ahab he nɔ ke, “Ngɛ o siwo nɛ ɔ nya a, ma ha o ye o he.” Nɛ Ahab kɛ lɛ so, nɛ e ngmɛɛ e he.
Gbalɔ ko bu Ahab fɔ Ngɛ Yawɛ fami nya a, gbali a kuu ɔ mi no ko de e nyɛmi gbalɔ ko ke e fia lɛ nɔ.
Se e nyɛmi ɔ kua.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbalɔ ɔ de e nyɛmi ɔ ke, “Akɛnɛ o bui Yawɛ fami ɔ tue he je ɔ, ke o je ye ngɔ pɛ kɛkɛ jata ko maa gbe mo.” Nɛ benɛ e je e ngɔ pɛ jata ko ya na lɛ nɛ jata a gbe lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, gbalɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ̃ ya na nyumu kpa ko, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, moo fia mi nɔ́!” Nyumu nɛ ɔ fia lɛ nɔ́, nɛ e plaa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ ngɔ bo ngɔ fi e hɛ mi kɛ tsake e he, nɛ e ho ya da blɔ ɔ tue kɛ ngɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ mlɛe nɛ e ba be.
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ bee ɔ, gbalɔ ɔ tsɛ lɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Nɛnɛ, i ngɛ ta nga nɔ, nɛ ta bulɔ ko ngɔ nyumu ko nɛ a nu lɛ ba ha mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘Ngɔɔ nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ to; ke e tu fo ɔ, o kɛ o wami ma dani lɛ, aloo a ma he mo sika hiɔ yi akpe etɛ.’ Se benɛ ye hɛ dɔ, nɛ i ngɛ ní kpahi pee ɔ, nyumu ɔ tu fo.” Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o bu o he fɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ja a gbla o tue.” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ je bo ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ amlɔ nɔuu matsɛ ɔ yo lɛ kaa gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
Gbalɔ ɔ de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Akɛnɛ o ngmɛɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ i fa mo ke o gbe lɛ ɔ he he je ɔ, o maa ngɔ o he kɛ dani lɛ.
Jehanɛ, a ma kpata o ta buli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, ejakaa mɛ hu a ngmɛ blɔ nɛ Benhadad ta buli ɔmɛ tu fo.’ ” Israel matsɛ ɔ kpale kɛ ho e we mi ya ngɛ Samaria kɛ mi mi la, kɛ aywilɛho.
Nabot wain ngmɔ ɔ Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nabot ngɛ wai ngmɔ ko ngɛ Matsɛ Ahab we ɔ kasa nya haa ngɛ Yezreel.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Ahab de lɛ ke, “O wai ngmɔ ɔ ngɛ ye we ɔ kasa nya haa.
Ngɔɔ kɛ ha mi nɛ ma kɛ pee pui ngmɔ.
I kɛ wai ngmɔ kpa nɛ hi pe o nɔ́ ɔ ma tsake ha mo; aloo ke o suɔ ɔ, ma wo mo e he hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa.” Se Nabot de Ahab ke, “Yawɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa ma ngɔ ye nɛmɛ a gbosi ní ɔ ngɔ ha mo.” Ahab je kɛ ho we mi ya kɛ mi mi la, kɛ aywilɛho; ejakaa Nabot de lɛ ke e nɛmɛ a gbosi ní ɔ, e be ngɔe kɛ ha lɛ.
E ho ya hwɔ si ngɛ e sa nɔ, nɛ e plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ kpee gbogbo, nɛ e kua ní yemi.
E yo Yezebel ba e ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o mi mi fu, nɛaywilɛho nu mo kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o sume nɛ o maa ye ní ɔ?” Ahab he nɔ ke, “Munyu nɛ Yezreel no, Nabot kɛ mi tu ɔ he je.
I de lɛ ke e ngɔ e wai ngmɔ ɔ ngɔ ha mi nɛ ma wo lɛ hiɔ, aloo ke e suɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ wai ngmɔ kpa ngɔ tsake ha lɛ; se e de mi ke e kɛ e wai ngmɔ ɔ be mi hae.” Ahab yo Yezebel bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Israel matsɛ ɔ, aloo pi mo?” E ya nɔ de lɛ ke, “Tee si nɛ o ye ní, nɛ o ná bua jɔmi; ma ngɔ Yezreel no, Nabot wai ngmɔ ɔ kɛ ha mo!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yezebel ngma womi komɛ ngɛ Ahab biɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ Ahab womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kɛ sɔu a nya, nɛ e kɛ womi ɔmɛ mane Ahab tsɔli, kɛ ma nimeli nɛ ngɛ Yezreel ɔ. E ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ke, “Nyɛɛ fiɛ nɛ a ha hwɔ ligbi mluku, nɛ a bua ma a nya, nɛ a ha Nabot blɔ he nguaa ko.
Nyɛ ha yaka nimli enyɔ nɛ a da e hɛ mi paa nɛ a ye odase ngɔ si lɛ ke e jɛ Mawu, kɛ matsɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ nyɛ ya fia lɛ tɛ nɛ nyɛɛ gbe.” Tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Yezreel ma nimeli ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yezebel fa mɛ ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ mane mɛ ɔ a mi ɔ, a fiɛ ke a ha hwɔ ligbi mluku, nɛ a bua ma a nya, nɛ a ha Nabot blɔ he nguaa ko.
Yaka nimli enyɔ ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba po Nabot nya ngɛ ma a hɛ mi ke e jɛ Mawu, kɛ matsɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ nɛ a gbe.
Nɛ a tsɔ ya de Yezebel ke, “A gbe Nabot.” Benɛ Yezebel nu kaa Nabot gbo ɔ, e de Ahab ke, “Nabot gbo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si nɛ o ya ngɔ e wai ngmɔ ɔ nɛ e kua juami ha mo ɔ.” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Ahab ho nɛ e ya ngɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de gbalɔ Eliya nɛ je Tishbe ɔ ke, “Tee si nɛ o ya Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ ngɛ Samaria.
O maa na lɛ ngɛ Nabot wai ngmɔ ɔ mi; e ho lejɛ ɔ ya, konɛ e ya ngɔ ngmɔ ɔ.
De lɛ ke imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ lɛ bie ke, ‘Nɛ o gbe nyumu ɔ, o ma pa ngɔ e weto ní ɔ kɛ pee o nɔ lo?’ De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ i de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘He nɛ gbe ɔmɛ lɔ Nabot muɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma lɔ mo hu o muɔ ngɛ!’ ” Benɛ Ahab na Eliya a, e bi lɛ ke, “Ye he nyɛlɔ, pe o nuu mi nɛ ɔ?” Eliya he nɔ ke, “Ee, i nuu mo.
O ngɔ o he ngɔ ha yayami peemi, nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘I kɛ haomi maa ba o nɔ.
Ma kpata o hɛ mi, nɛ ma gbe nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ o we ɔ mi, nyɔguɛ jio, odehe jio.
Ma pee o we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Nebat binyumu Yeroboam, kɛ Abiya binyumu Baasha a we ɔmɛ ɔ, ejakaa o wo ye mi mi la kaa o ha Israel ya pee yayami.’ Jehanɛ Yezebel hu, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Gbehi maa ye Yezebel ngɛ Yezreel ma a mi.’ Ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, gbehi maa ye lɛ; nɛ ke o he nɔ ko gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye lɛ.” Benɛ Ahab nu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hía e tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e bu kpekpe ya bo.
E ha hwɔ, nɛ e kɛ kpekpe ya bo ɔ hwɔɔ si; nɛ ke e ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, e peeɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e nini je e nɔ.
Yawɛ de gbalɔ Eliya ke, “O na bɔ nɛ Ahab ba e he si ha mi ɔ?
Akɛnɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i be hae nɛ haomi ɔ nɛ ba e nɔ ngɛ e wami be mi; e binyumu ɔ yi nɔ nɛ ma ngɔ haomi kɛ ba Ahab we ɔ nɔ!”
Gbalɔ Mikaya bɔ Ahab kɔkɔ Israel kɛ Siria hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi jeha enyɔ.
Se jeha etɛ ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat ba slaa Israel matsɛ, Ahab.
Ahab de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ le kaa wa ma ji Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ!
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ wa bɔɛ mɔde nɛ wa ya kpɔ lɛ ngɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ dɛ ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Ahab bi Yehoshafat ke, “Anɛ o kɛ mi maa ya nɛ wa ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ lo?” Yehoshafat he nɔ ke, “Imi kɛ mo ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ji wɔ; ye ma a, o ma, nɛ ye okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu o níhi.
Se kekleekle ɔ, ha nɛ wa bi Yawɛ ga womi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Ahab ya kpee gbali ɔmɛ kɛ ba, maa pee nimli lafa eywiɛ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Ma ya nɛ ma ya tua Ramot Gilead, loo ma ko ya?” A he nɔ ke, “Yaa, Yawɛ maa ngɔ ma a kɛ wo o dɛ mi.” Se Yehoshafat bi ke, “Anɛ gbalɔ kpa ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ wa ma bi lɛ Yawɛ ga womi lo?” Ahab he nɔ ke, “Nɔ kake ngɛ; lɛ ji Imla binyumu Mikaya.
Se i sume lɛ, ejakaa e gbɛ manye nɔ́ ko ha we mi hyɛ gblee, ja nɔ́ yayami pɛ.” Yehoshafat de lɛ ke, “Mo ko de ja!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Ahab tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ e de lɛ ke e ya nɛ e ya ngɔ Imla binyumu Mikaya kɛ ba nɔuu.
Matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ wo ablade tade kɛ hii si ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ngma mi sami he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Samaria ma agbo ɔ nya a, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ gbae ngɛ a hɛ mi.
Gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zedekia, Kenaana binyumu ɔ, pee dade kolihi, nɛ e de Ahab ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Enɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ o kɛ ma tsitsɛɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya se kɛ yaa si o ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’ ” Gbali kpa amɛ tsuo gba kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ maa ngɔ Ramot Gilead kɛ wo o dɛ mi; yaa nɛ o ya tua ma a, nɛ o maa ye kunimi.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ho Mikaya tsɛmi ya a de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a nya sɔ nɛ a gba ke matsɛ ɔ maa ye kunimi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo hu gbaa ja nɔuu.” Se Mikaya he nɔ ke, “I na Yawɛ hɛ kalɔ ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ ma de ɔ nɛ!” Benɛ Mikaya ba su Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mikaya, anɛ i kɛ Matsɛ Yehoshafat waa ya nɛ wa ya tua Ramot Gilead, aloo wa ko ya?” Mikaya he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ ngɔ ma a kɛ wo o dɛ mi; yaa nɛ o ya tua ma a, nɛ o maa ye kunimi.” Se Ahab de lɛ ke, “Ke o kɛ mi ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ, tuu anɔkuale!
Si enyɛmɛ ma de mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?” Mikaya he nɔ ke, “I na Israel tabo ɔ tsuo nɛ a gbɛ fĩa ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ.
Nɛ Yawɛ de ke, ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ be tsɛ; ha nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.’ ” Ahab de Yehoshafat ke, “Anɛ i de we mo ke Mikaya gbɛ manye nɔ́ ko ha we mi hyɛ gblee, kaa nɔ́ yayami pɛ e gbaa lo?” Mikaya ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ tue!
I na Yawɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo daa si kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Yawɛ bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ ma ya mlɔɔ Ahab, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ya tua Ramot Gilead, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ?’ Hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ ekomɛ de kikɛ, nɛ ekomɛ hu de kikɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, mumi ko je kpo ba da Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘Ma mlɔɔ lɛ.’ Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, ‘Kɛ o maa pee kɛ mlɔɔ lɛ kɛɛ?’ Mumi ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Ma ya nɛ ma ya ha nɛ Ahab gbali ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye lakpa.’ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, ‘Yaa nɛ o ya mlɔɔ lɛ; o maa ye manye.’ ” Nyagbe ɔ, Mikaya de ke, “Bɔ nɛ níhi ya ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ ha nɛ o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ye mo lakpa.
Se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e de to kaa sane yaya maa ye mo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Zedekia, Kenaana binyumu ɔ ho nɛ e ya gba Mikaya hɛ mi ma, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni be Yawɛ mumi ɔ je ye nɔ nɛ e kɛ mo ba tu munyu?” Mikaya he nɔ ke, “Ke be nɛ o ya sɛ se tsu mi nɛ o laa o he ɔ, kɛkɛ o maa na mo.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Ahab fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ke, “Nuu Mikaya nɛ o ngɔ lɛ ya ha Amon, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, kɛ ye binyumu Yoash.
De mɛ ke i ke a wo lɛ tsu, nɛ a ha lɛ abolo, kɛ nyu bɔbɔyoo pɛ kɛ yaa si ma kpale kɛ ba kɛ manye.” Mikaya he nɔ ke, “Ke o kpale kɛ ba kɛ manye ɔ, lɛɛ tsa pi Yawɛ nɛ tu munyu kɛ gu ye nɔ mɔ!” E ya nɔ de ke, “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ!” Ahab gbenɔ Pee se ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Ahab, kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat ho ya tua Ramot Gilead.
Ahab de Yehoshafat ke, “Ma tsake ye he kɛ ya ta nga a nɔ, se moo lɛɛ moo wo o we ablade tade ɔmɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ tsake e he kɛ ho ta nga a nɔ ya.
Siria matsɛ ɔ wo e ta zugba lɛ asafoatsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ mlaa ke a kɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó hwu ta, kaa ja Israel matsɛ ɔ pɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a na Yehoshafat ɔ, a susu kaa Israel matsɛ ɔ ji lɛ, nɛ a plɛ ngɔ kpee lɛ.
Se benɛ a kpa ngmlaa a, a na kaa tsa pi Israel matsɛ ɔ ji lɛ, nɛ a kpale ngɛ e se.
Se e ba mi kaa Siria ta buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ tlukaa nɛ e hɛ be nɔ.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ ya gbɔ Ahab ngɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a tsami he ɔ. Ahab de e ta zugba lɛ kudɔlɔ ɔ ke, “I plaa!
Plɛ o he nɛ o kɛ mi nɛ je ta a nya!” Benɛ a ngɛ ta a hwue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a hɛɛ Matsɛ Ahab kɛ daa si ngɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi kɛ kpee Siria bi ɔmɛ.
Muɔ dɛ kɛ je e pa a mi ngɔ pue ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi takaa; nɛ gbɔkuɛ he ɔ, e gbo.
Pu si nɔmi be ɔ, a fiɛ ngɛ Israel ta a mi ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ho e zugba nɔ, kɛ e ma mi ya!” Bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Ahab pee kɛ gbo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ e gbo ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ba Samaria nɛ a ba pu lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A ya fɔ ta zugba lɛ ɔ he ngɛ Samaria taku ɔ mi; nɛ yaholi ya du ngɛ mi, nɛ gbehi ya lɔ Ahab muɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ. Ahab he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, we ɔ nɛ e kɛ suɔ wu ma a, kɛ ma kpahi nɛ e po ɔ, a ngma tsuo ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Benɛ Ahab gbo ɔ, e binyumu Ahazia ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat Israel matsɛ Ahab yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, Asa binyumu Yehoshafat ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
Yehoshafat ye jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Azuba, Shilhi biyo ɔ. Yehoshafat ya wo e tsɛ Asa nane, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e hule we wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ma a ya nɔ sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Yehoshafat kɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Yehoshafat he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, e kã nɛ e pee, kɛ tahi nɛ e hwu ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Nyumuhi nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha ajuama bɔmi, nɛ a sɔmɔɔ ngɛ wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Matsɛ Asa yi nɔ ɔ, Yehoshafat fie a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, matsɛ ko be Edom; matsɛ se yelɔ lɛ ngɛ.
Matsɛ Yehoshafat kpɛ lɛ nguanguahi nɛ woɔ tlomi, konɛ a hlui mɛ kɛ ya Ofir zugba a nɔ ya ngɔ sika tsu ba ha lɛ; se lɛ ɔmɛ ya ywia ngɛ Eziongeber, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ya.
Israel matsɛ Ahazia, Ahab binyumu ɔ de Yehoshafat ke, “Ha nɛ ye tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a bla kɛ hlui lɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ho.” Se Yehoshafat kua.
Yehoshafat ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ a gɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Yehoram ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Ahazia Matsɛ Yehoshafat yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaago ɔ, Ahab binyumu Ahazia ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.
Ahazia ya wo e tsɛ, kɛ e nyɛ, kɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam nɛ ha Israel pee yayami ɔ a nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
E sɔmɔ Baal, e ja lɛ; nɛ e wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mi mi la kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he sane nɛ a ngma ngɛ Matsɛmɛ a Kekleekle Womi ɔ mi ɔ nɔ tsami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Womi Enyɔne ɔ ngɛ mi dlami pɔtɛɛ enyɔ.
Kekleekle mi dlami ɔ kɔɔ matsɛ yemi enyɔ ɔmɛ a he, kɛ je maa pee jeha loko a fɔ Kristo kɛ ya si be nɛ a ye Samaria ma a nɔ kunimi, kɛ be nɛ omleyi je matsɛ yemi ɔ nya ya hɛ si, jeha loko a fɔ Kristo.
Mi dlami enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ Yuda matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane kɛ je be nɛ Israel matsɛ yemi ɔ nya hɛ si, kɛ ya si Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba kpata Yerusalem ma a hɛ mi, jeha loko a fɔ Kristo nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi.
Sane enyɔ nɛ a ngma kɛ gbe womi nɛ ɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a. Gedalia ye amlaalo ngɛ Yuda, ngɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a nɔ yemi be ɔ mi.
b.
A je Matsɛ Yehoyakin ngɛ tsu mi, ngɛ Babilon.
Nɔ́ nɛ kɛ haomi nɛ ɔmɛ ba ma a nɔ ji, Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ yi Yawɛ anɔkuale.
Yerusalem hɛ mi kpatami, kɛ bɔ nɛ a nuu Yuda bi babauu nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ma se ya a, ji ní yaya komɛ nɛ jeɔ kpo ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a blema sanehi a mi.
Gbalɔ nɛ e biɛ pɛɛ pe kulaa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji Elisha nɛ ba ye Eliya se ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi Matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ mi gba a .—.
a. Gbalɔ Elisha .—.
b. Yuda kɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ .—.
d. A ye Samaria nɔ kunimi .- Yuda matsɛ yemi ɔ .—.
a. Kɛ je Hezekia nɔ kɛ ya si Yosia nɔ .—.
b. Yosia matsɛ yemi .—.
d. Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba ngɛ nyagbe ɔ .—.
e. A ye Yerusalem ma a nɔ kunimi .-
Eliya kɛ Matsɛ Ahazia Israel matsɛ, Ahab gbenɔ se ɔ, Moab ma a tsɔ Israel hɛ mi atuã.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Ahazia tsɔ́ kɛ je e hiɔwe tsu nɛ ngɛ Samaria a saflɛ mi kɛ ba nɔ si, nɛ e plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ nihi ke a ya bi ní ngɛ Baalzebub ngɔ ha lɛ kaa e yi ma na wami lo.
Baalzebub ji mawu nɛ ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Ekron ɔ nɛ.
Se Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de gbalɔ Eliya nɛ je Tishbe ɔ ke e ya nɛ e kɛ Matsɛ Ahazia tsɔli ɔmɛ ya kpe, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ yaa bi ní ngɛ Ekron mawu Baalzebub ɔ ngɔ ɔ?
Anɛ Mawu be Israel lo?
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, Yawɛ ke, ‘Plaami ɔ nɛ o plaa a, o yi be wami nae; o ma gbo!’ ” Eliya pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ, nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.
Matsɛ Ahazia bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ kpale kɛ ba a?” A he nɔ ke, “Nyumu ko kɛ wɔ ba kpe ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de wɔ ke waa kpale wa se nɛ wa ba de mo ke, Yawɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je o tsɔ ke a ya bi ní ngɛ Ekron mawu Baalzebub ɔ ngɔ ɔ?
Anɛ Mawu be Israel lo?
Plaami ɔ nɛ o plaa a, o yi be wami nae; o ma gbo!’ ” Matsɛ ɔ bi mɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ kpe nɛ e de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, kɛ e ngɛ kɛɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Bwɔmitsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee fi e mlɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de ke, “Lɛ ji Eliya, Tishbe no ɔ!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɔ asafoatsɛ kake kɛ e we bihi nyingmi enuɔ ke a ya ngɔ Eliya kɛ ba.
Asafoatsɛ ɔ ya na lɛ nɛ e hii si ngɛ yoku ko yi mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ, matsɛ ɔ ke o kple si nɛ o ba!” Eliya he nɔ ke, “Ke Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mi ɔ, lɛɛ la nɛ e je hiɔwe ba sã mo kɛ o we bihi nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ la je hiɔwe ba sã asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ e we bi nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ.
Matsɛ ɔ tsɔ asafoatsɛ kpa, kɛ lɛ hu e we bihi nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya de Eliya ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ, matsɛ ɔ ke o kple si kɛ ba esɔ!” Eliya he nɔ ke, “Ke Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mi ɔ, lɛɛ la nɛ e je hiɔwe ba sã mo kɛ o we bihi nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu la a je hiɔwe ba sã asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ e we bihi nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ.
Matsɛ Ahazia tsɔ asafoatsɛ etɛne, kɛ lɛ hu e we bihi nyingmi enuɔ.
Benɛ asafoatsɛ etɛne nɛ ɔ ya su yoku ɔ nɔ ɔ, e kpla si ngɛ Eliya hɛ mi nɛ e fa kue ha lɛ ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ i kɛ o tsɔli nyingmi enuɔ nɛ ɔmɛ wa wami he nɔ́ nɛ dɔ mo.
Hyɛ, la je hiɔwe ba sã asafoatsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a we bihi nyingmi enuɔɔnuɔ nɛ a sɛ hlami ɔ; i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o na imi lɛɛ mɔbɔ.” Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de Eliya ke, “Kple si nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya; koo ye gbeye.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliya kɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ ho matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ ke, ‘Akɛnɛ o tsɔ ya bi ní ngɛ Ekron mawu Baalzebub ɔ ngɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu be Israel nɛ a ma bi lɛ ga womi he je ɔ, o yi be wami nae; o ma gbo!’ ” Ahazia gbo niinɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ gu Eliya nɔ de to ɔ. Nɛ akɛnɛ Ahazia be binyumu he je ɔ, e nyɛminyumu Yoram ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoram nɛ ji Yehoshafat binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha enyɔne ɔ mi.
Ni kpahi tsuo nɛ Matsɛ Ahazia pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
A ngɔ Eliya kɛ ho hiɔwe ya Benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ Eliya kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ lasiogblee mi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, Eliya kɛ Elisha ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ je Gilgal.
Ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Eliya de Elisha ke, “Yawɛ tsɔ mi Betel; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o mlɛ mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Se Elisha de lɛ ke, “I na Mawu, nɛ i na mo nitsɛ o nane kaa i be o he jee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Betel ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbali a kuu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Betel ɔ ba Elisha ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o le kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ je o he lo?” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Ee, i le; nyɛ ma nyɛ nya!” Eliya de Elisha ke, “Yawɛ tsɔ mi Yeriko; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o mlɛ mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Se Elisha de lɛ ke, “I na Mawu, nɛ i na mo nitsɛ o nane kaa i be o he jee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Yeriko ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbali a kuu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yeriko ɔ ba Elisha ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o le kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ je o he lo?” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Ee, i le; nyɛ ma nyɛ nya!” Eliya de Elisha ekohu ke, “Yawɛ tsɔ mi Yordan pa a nya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o mlɛ mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Se Elisha de lɛ ke, “I na Mawu, nɛ i na mo nitsɛ o nane kaa i be o he jee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a pue nɔ kɛ ho Yordan pa a nya ya, nɛ gbali a kuu ɔ mi nihi nyingmi enuɔ nyɛɛ a se.
Eliya kɛ Elisha ya da si ngɛ Yordan pa a nya, nɛ gbali nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ hu ho ya da si ngɛ a se, nɛ blɔ bɔɔ ngɛ a kpɛti.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliya je e tade ɔ, nɛ e koklo lɛ, nɛ e kɛ fia nyu ɔ mi.
Nyu ɔ mi gba kɛ ya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ be.
Benɛ a po pa a, Eliya bi Elisha ke, “Mɛni o suɔ nɛ ma pee ha mo loko a ba ngɔ mi kɛ je o he?” Elisha he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha mi o mumi he wami ɔ totoe enyɔ.” Eliya de lɛ ke, “O bi nɔ ko nɛ he wa; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ke o na nɛ a ngɔ mi kɛ je o ngɔ kɛ yaa a, nɔ́ nɛ o bi ɔ maa ba mi ha mo.
Se ke o nɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ e be mi bae.” Benɛ a ngɛ ní sɛɛe kɛ yaa a, ta zugba lɛ nɛ la okpɔngɔhi ngɛ gblae ba gba mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ lasiogblee sá Eliya kɛ ho hiɔwe ya.
Benɛ Elisha na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de ke, “Tsaatsɛ!
Tsaatsɛ!
Israel ta zugba lɛhi kɛ a we okpɔngɔ ta buli!” Nɛ e nɛ lɛ hu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Elisha gba lɛ nitsɛ e tade ɔmɛ a mi enyɔ.
E ngɔ Eliya tade ɔ nɛ je e he nɔ si ɔ, nɛ e kpale ya da si ngɛ Yordan pa a tue.
E kɛ Eliya tade ɔ fia nyu ɔ mi, nɛ e bi ke, “Jije Yawɛ, Eliya Mawu ɔ ngɛ?” E ngɔ tade ɔ kɛ fia nyu ɔ mi ekohu, nɛ nyu ɔ mi gba kɛ ya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; nɛ e nyɛɛ kɛ be.
Benɛ gbali a kuu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yeriko ɔ na lɛ ɔ, a de ke, “Eliya mumi ɔ ba Elisha nɔ.” A ya nɛ a ya kpee lɛ, nɛ a kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi; nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, nyumuhi katsɛmɛ nyingmi enuɔ sɔuu ji wɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa ya nɛ wa ya hla o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, kaa alini Yawɛ mumi ɔ nu lɛ nɛ e ya sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ yo ko nɔ, aloo kɔ́ ko mi lo.” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, nyɛ ko ya!” Se a hao lɛ hluu kɛ ya si nɔ́ ɔ ba pee lɛ ahuto, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Yoo, nyɛɛ tsɔ kɛ ya!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ nyumuhi nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ a ho ya hla Eliya ligbi etɛ sɔuu; se a nɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ba Elisha ngɔ ngɛ Yeriko, he nɛ e hii si ngɛ mɛ mlɛe ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Anɛ i de we nyɛ ke nyɛ ko ya lo?” Nyakpɛ ní komɛ nɛ Elisha pee Ligbi ko ɔ, Yeriko ma mi bi ɔmɛ ba de Elisha ke, “Wa nyɔmtsɛ!
Kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, wa ma nɛ ɔ ngɛ fɛu saminya.
Se mohu ɔ, wa nyu ɔ hí; e haa yihi a mi saneɔ.” Elisha de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngo kɛ wo ka ehe mi nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ha mi.” A ngɔ ba ha lɛ, nɛ e je kpo kɛ ho he nɛ nyu ɔ jeɔ kɛ baa a ya, nɛ e ya plɛ ngo ɔ ngɔ pue pa a mi.
E de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘I tsukɔ nyu nɛ ɔ he; kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, gbenɔ, aloo mi sanemi ko be mi jee kɛ ba hu.’ ” Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyu ɔ tsake pee kaa bɔ nɛ Elisha de ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Elisha je Yeriko kɛ ho Betel ya.
Benɛ e ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, jokuɛwi nyumuwi komɛ je ma a mi ba ye e he fɛu.
A ye e he fɛu, nɛ a de ke, “Yi kpɛti kpalokpalotsɛ, moo kuɔ kɛ ba!” Elisha plɛ hyɛ mɛ, nɛ e tsɛ Yawɛ biɛ kɛ gbiɛ mɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ osisiblisi eyo enyɔ je nga mi kɛ ba, nɛ a ba tsɔtslɔɔ jokuɛwi nyumuwi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nimli nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ a mi.
Benɛ Elisha je lejɛ ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Karmel yo ɔ nɔ ya.
Pee se ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ba Samaria.
Israel kɛ Moab hwu ta Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Ahab binyumu Yehoram ba ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
E ngɛ mi kaa e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ lɛɛ, se e hi kulaa pe e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ; ejakaa Baal amaga amɛ nɛ e tsɛ puɛ ɔ, e ku mɛ kɛ pue he.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat binyumu ɔ pee ɔ, Yehoram hu nyɛɛ Israel hɛ mi kɛ pee yayami nɛ e kpa we.
Moab matsɛ, Mesha a, to lɛlɔ ji lɛ; nɛ daa jeha a, e ya haa Israel matsɛ jijɔ akpe lafa, kɛ agbosuhi a he bwɔmi akpe lafa.
Se benɛ Israel matsɛ, Ahab gbo ɔ, Mesha tsɔ Israel hɛ mi atuã.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Matsɛ Yehoram je Samaria nɔuu, nɛ e ho ya bua Israel tsuo nya.
E tsɔ ya de Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat ke, “Moab matsɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã.
Anɛ o maa piɛ ye he nɛ i kɛ lɛ ya hwu ta lo?” Yehoshafat he nɔ ke, “I ma ya!
Ye nɔ́ ko ɔ, mo hu o nɔ́; imi nɔmlɔ ɔ nitsɛ jio, ye ma a jio, ye okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ jio.” E ya nɔ nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Jije wa maa gu kɛ ya?” Yehoram he nɔ ke, “Wa maa gu Edom nga a nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel, Yuda, kɛ Edom matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Benɛ a ya wo lalaalo kɛ nyɛɛ ligbi kpaago ɔ, a nɛ nyu ha ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Yawɛ ngɔ wɔ matsɛmɛ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo Moab dɛ mi!” Yehoshafat bi ke, “Anɛ Yawɛ gbalɔ ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ wa ma bi Yawɛ ga womi ngɛ e ngɔ lo?” Israel matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake he nɔ ke, “Shafat binyumu Elisha, Eliya tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Yehoshafat de ke, “Gbalɔ kpakpa ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Elisha ngɔ ya.
Elisha de Israel matsɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni sane i kɛ mo ngɛ?
Yaa o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ a gbali ɔmɛ a ngɔ.” Israel matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɔ wɔ matsɛmɛ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo Moab matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ nɛ.” Elisha de lɛ ke, “I na Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ, kaa ke pi Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat hɛ mi zo nɛ i gbo ɔ, jinɛ i be mo kpɛe, nɛ ma ba de ke ma hyɛ o hɛ mi po.
Se kɛ̃ nyɛ hla saku fialɔ ko ha mi.” Benɛ saku fialɔ ɔ ngɛ e saku ɔ fiae ɔ, Yawɛ he wami ɔ ba Elisha nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ma ha nyu ma hyi nyu dɔ nɛ gbli nɛ ɔ. Kɔɔhiɔ be fiae, nɛ hiɔmi hu be nɛe; se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyu dɔ nɛ ɔ ma hyi tɔ kɛ nyu.
Nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwehi nɛ tlooɔ tlomi ma na nyu maa nu.’ ” Elisha ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi pi nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ he wa ha Yawɛ.
Yawɛ maa ngɔ Moab bi ɔmɛ hu kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ mi.
Nyɛ maa ngɔ a ma kpakpa amɛ, kɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ tsuo.
Nyɛ maa poo tso kpakpa tsuaa tso kpakpa; nyɛ maa tsi nyu vu ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ tɛ kɛ ha a zugba kpakpa amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.” E nɔ jena mɔtu, maa pee bɔ sami be ɔ, nyu je Edom blɔ kɛ ba; nɛ zugba a nɔ hyi tɔ kɛ nyu.
Benɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ tsuo nu kaa matsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ma nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba hwu ta a, a ya kpee nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ su ta yami nya kɛ je jokuɛyo pe kulaa nɔ kɛ ya si nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɔ kɛ ba da ma a huzu nya.
Benɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ te si mɔtu kpla a, pu ngɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kpɛe; nɛ a na kaa nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ a hanɔ ɔ pee tsutsuutsu kaa muɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a de ke, “Muɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he hwu ta nɛ a gbe a he.
Moab bi, nyɛ ha waa ho nɛ wa ya ha ní!” Benɛ a ba su Israel bi ɔmɛ a sito he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ te si nɛ a tua mɛ.
Moab bi ɔmɛ tu fo, se Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɔ pue si ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a kpata a ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
Zugba kpakpa amɛ lɛɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ fɔ tɛ kɛ pue a nɔ, kɛ ya si tɛ ɔmɛ ha zugba amɛ a nɔ A tsi nyu vu ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a poo tso kpakpa amɛ hulɔ.
Kir Heres nɛ ji ma ngua a pɛ nɛ a si; se amlami tɛ fiali ɔmɛ ya sa jamɛ a ma a po yi nɛ a tua lɛ.
Benɛ Moab matsɛ ɔ na kaa e nine kpi ta a he ɔ, e hla klaate hɛɛli lafa kpaago nɛ e ka kaa e kɛ mɛ maa gu he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a mi pani nya kɛ ya Edom matsɛ ɔ ngɔ; se a nyɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e nu e bitɛte, nɔ nɛ jinɛ lɛ nɛ e ma ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ sã sami bɔ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je ma a mi, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ya.
Elisha pee yalɔyo ohiatsɛ ko kpakpa Gbali ɔmɛ a kuu ɔ mi no ko e yo ya fa kue ha Elisha, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “O tsɔlɔ, nɛ ji imi lɛɛ ye huno ɔ, e gbo.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, o tsɔlɔ ɔ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye.
Se nyumu ko nɛ e ya pa sika ngɛ e dɛ ɔ ba nu ye binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pee e nyɔguɛhi.” Elisha bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni ma pee ha mo?
Mo de mi.
Mɛni ngɛ o dɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, i be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ we ɔ mi, ja nu tɔ kake pɛ.” Elisha de lɛ ke, “Jee kpo nɛ o ya ba buɛ mi guhi abɔ nɛ o ma na ngɛ o huza nɔ bi ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ba.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo sɛ tsu mi nɛ o nga sinya kɛ wo o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ yi.
Nyɛ plɛ nu ɔ kɛ wo buɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Ke eko hyi ɔ, a hɛ lɛ kɛ ya se.” Yo ɔ ho nɛ e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ya sɛ tsu mi nɛ a nga sinya kɛ wo a yi.
Be mi nɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ buɛ ɔmɛ muɔe kɛ ngɛ bae ɔ, yo ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ buɛ ɔmɛ a mi nu woe.
Benɛ buɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyi ɔ, yo ɔ tsɛ e binyumu, nɛ e de lɛ ke e ngɔ buɛ ɔ eko kɛ ba.
Se e binyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Buɛ kpa ko be hu!” Kɛkɛ nɛ nu ɔ se po.
Yo ɔ ho nɛ e ya bɔ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ amaniɛ.
Nɛ gbalɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya jua nu ɔ nɛ o kɛ wo o he hiɔ ɔmɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ɔ, o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ.” Elisha kɛ Shunem yo niatsɛ ɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, Elisha ya Shunem, nɛ e ya na yo niatsɛ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yo ɔ fa kue ha lɛ ke e ye nɔ́ ko doo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ e maa be ngɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ma gba yo ɔ we ɔ mi ya ye ní.
Yo ɔ de e huno ke, “Jehanɛ i yɔse kaa nyumu ɔ nɛ pɔɔ wa ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ gumi ɔ, Mawu nɔmlɔ klɔuklɔu ji lɛ.
Ha nɛ waa pee tsu nyafii ko ha lɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi, nɛ waa wo mi sa tso, okplɔɔ, sɛ, kɛ kane, konɛ be tsuaa be nɛ e maa ba wa ngɔ ɔ, e ba hi lejɛ ɔ.” Ligbi ko ɔ, Elisha ba Shunem, nɛ e be kɛ ho e tsu ɔ mi ya nɛ́ e ya jɔɔ e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E tsɔ e tsɔlɔ Gehazi ke e ya tsɛ Shunem yo ɔ kɛ ba.
Nɛ yo ɔ ba da si ngɛ Elisha hɛ mi.
Elisha de Gehazi ke, “Mo bi yo ɔ ke dengme nɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ e ngɛ gboe ngɛ wa he ɔ, mɛni e suɔ kaa ma pee ha lɛ?
Anɛ e ngɛ sane ko nɛ e maa suɔ nɛ ma kɛ ya fɔ matsɛ, loo asafoatsɛ hɛ mi ha lɛ lo?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he hia we mi; imi nitsɛ ye ma mi bi a kpɛti nɛ i ngɛ.” Elisha bi Gehazi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛni ma pee ha lɛ mɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Anɔkuale mi ɔ, e be binyumu; nɛ e huno ɔ hu bwɔ.” Elisha de Gehazi ke, “De yo ɔ ke e ba.” Yo ɔ ba nɛ e ba da si ngɛ sinya a nya, nɛ Elisha de lɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ se jeha be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, o maa hɛɛ binyumu ngɛ o kɔni bɔkɔ mi.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi!
Ye nyɔmtsɛ, koo mlɔɔ mi; Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mo!” Se yo ɔ na mi, nɛ benɛ jeha ke e suu ɔ, e fɔ binyumu kaa bɔ nɛ Elisha de lɛ ɔ. Jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ ba wa.
Ligbi ko benɛ e tsɛ kɛ ngma kpali ɔmɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ ho e tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Ye yi!
Ye yi!” E tsɛ ɔ de e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ke, “Wo lɛ kɛ ya ha e nyɛ!” Tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ ya ha e nyɛ, nɛ e nyɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ e tɛ nɔ hluu kɛ ya si piani, kɛkɛ nɛ e gbo.
E nyɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ ya fɔ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ sa a nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi.
E ngmɛ sinya a mi kɛ wo e yi, nɛ e je kpo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔ ya de e huno ɔ ke, “Ha nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ ngɔ teji yo kake kɛ ba ha mi nɛ ma sa fo kɛ ya Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɔ nɛ ma ba.” E huno ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o yaa Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ?
Tsa pi Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, aloo Hejɔɔmi ligbi ji mwɔnɛ ɔ.” E he nɔ ke, “E pee we nɔ́ ko!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e mia teji yo ɔ, nɛ e de e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Moo wo lohwe ɔ fo mlamlaamla nɛ waa ho; ko gbɔjɔ mi kɛ yaa si ma de mo loko o pee ja!” Yo ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho Karmel yo ɔ nɔ he nɛ Elisha ngɛ ɔ ya.
Benɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ na yo ɔ nɛ ma ngɛ tsitsaa a, e de e tsɔlɔ Gehazi ke, “Hyɛ, Shunem yo ɔ lɛ ma a nɛ!
Tuu fo nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya kpe, nɛ o bi lɛ ke e ngɛ saminya lo.
Bi lɛ ke e huno ɔ kɛ e binyumuyo ɔ hu ngɛ saminya lo.” Yo ɔ de Gehazi ke mɛ tsuo a ngɛ saminya, se benɛ e ba su Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, e nu Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ nane.
Nɛ jinɛ Gehazi ka kaa e ma tsitsɛɛ lɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, se Elisha de lɛ ke, “Moo ngmɛɛ e he; o nɛ kaa nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ haoe lo?
Nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ laa mi, nɛ e de we mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, anɛ i bi mo ke o ha mi binyumu lo?
Anɛ i de we mo ke o ko mlɔɔ mi lo?” Elisha de Gehazi ke, “Esɔ!
Moo mia!
Ngɔɔ ye dɛma tso ɔ nɛ o ho!
Ke o kɛ nɔ ko kpe ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ko nga lɛ; ke nɔ ko nga mo ɔ, ko he nɔ.
Yaa tɛɛ, nɛ o ya wo ye dɛma tso ɔ nɔ ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ hɛ mi.” Yo ɔ de Elisha ke, “I na Mawu, nɛ i na mo nitsɛ hu o nane kaa i be o he jee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Elisha te si nɛ e kɛ yo ɔ ho.
Gehazi sɛ a hlami, nɛ e ya wo Elisha dɛma tso ɔ nɔ ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Se gbi ko pɛ́, nɛ okadi ko hu be nɛ tsɔɔ kaa jokuɛ ɔ ngɛ wami mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale e se nɛ e kɛ Elisha ba kpe, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Jokuɛ ɔ ti si.” Benɛ Elisha ya su we ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake e ya sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e na jokuɛ ɔ nɛ gbo kɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ e sa a nɔ.
E nga sinya a kɛ wo mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Elisha ya bu jokuɛ ɔ nɔ; e kɛ e nya to jokuɛ ɔ nya he, e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ e hɛngmɛhi a nɔ, nɛ e ninehi pueɔ si ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ hu e ninehi a nɔ.
Benɛ e kpã e mi ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, jokuɛ ɔ he bɔni la dɔmi.
Elisha te si nɛ e nyɛɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ho ya bu jokuɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ jokuɛ ɔ tsile si kpaago; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e bli e hɛngmɛ.
Elisha tsɛ Gehazi nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya tsɛ Shunem yo ɔ kɛ ba!” Benɛ yo ɔ ba a, e de lɛ ke, “Ba he o binyumu ɔ!” Yo ɔ kpla si ngɛ Elisha nane nya, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e ngɔ e binyumu ɔ kɛ je kpo.
Nyakpɛ nɔ́ enyɔ kpa komɛ Benɛ Elisha kpale e se kɛ ba Gilgal ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ.
Ligbi ko, benɛ gbali a kuu ɔ hii si ngɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e ngɛ mɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, e de e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ pɔ buɛ agbo ɔ kɛ ma la nɔ, nɛ o pee ní ha gbali a kuu ɔ nɛ a ye.” A ti nɔ kake ho nga a nɔ ya nɛ e ya tsɔ pui ba kɛ ba; se e ya tsɔ nga mi atlɛ mohu babauu.
Benɛ e ba a, e poo a mi tsɔwitsɔwi kɛ wo pɔ buɛ ɔ mi; se e li nɔ́ nɛ ji.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a plɛ flɔɔ ɔ kɛ ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye.
Se benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ, duɔ ngɛ ní ɔ mi!” Nɛ a jɔɔ ní ɔ yemi.
Elisha de ke a ha lɛ mamu; nɛ e kɛ mamu ɔ wo buɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Plɛ flɔɔ ɔ ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye!” Jehanɛ, nɔ́ yobu ko be mi hu.
Be kpa mi ɔ, nyumu ko je Baal Shalisha kɛ ba, nɛ e ba ke Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ abolo bɔbɔɛ nyingmi enyɔ nɛ a kɛ akoko kpokploku pee, kɛ blɛfo tso mumu ngɛ kotoku mi.
Elisha de e tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ ya ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye.” Se e tsɔlɔ ɔ de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tsa be nimli lafa sue!” Elisha ti mi nɛ e de lɛ ekohu ke, “Ngɔɔ ya ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye; ejakaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘A maa ye hluu nɛ eko maa piɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ ní ɔ ya ha mɛ.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ye; se kɛ̃ ɔ, eko piɛ.
A tsa Naeman Siria matsɛ ɔ tatsɛ Naeman ji nɔ ko nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ buu lɛ saminya kaa nɔmlɔ agbo; ejakaa Yawɛ gu Naeman nɔ kɛ ha Siria ye kunimi.
Katsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ; se he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ e he.
Be ko mi nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ ba tua Israel ɔ, a nu Israel yiheyo wayoo ko nyɔguɛ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya sɔmɔ Naeman yo ɔ. Ligbi ko ɔ, e de e nyɛ ɔ ke, “I ná nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ya gbalɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Samaria a ngɔ, jinɛ e ma tsa e hiɔ ɔ ha lɛ.” Benɛ Naeman nu he ɔ, e ho ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ nɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ je Israel ɔ de ɔ. Siria matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya na Israel matsɛ ɔ; ma ha mo womi nɛ o hɛɛ kɛ ya ha lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Naeman pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Benɛ e yaa a, e hɛɛ sika hiɔ yi akpe nyingmi etɛ, sika tsu yi akpe ekpa, kɛ he dlami tade saminyawiiwi nyɔngma kɛ ho.
Womi ɔ nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ya ha Israel matsɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ji, “Ke womi nɛ ɔ su o dɛ ɔ, na nɛ o le kaa i ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ Naeman o ngɔ tsɔe, nɛ o tsa e he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a ha lɛ.” Benɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ kane womi ɔ, e hao wawɛɛ nɛ e hia e tade ɔ nɛ e de ke, “Anɛ Mawu ji mi?
Anɛ i ngɛ gbenɔ kɛ wami nɔ he wami loko nyumu nɛ ɔ maa tsɔ nɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ ma tsa e he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a ha lɛ lo?
E fɔɔ si paa kaa munyu kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ hlae ngɛ ye he!” Benɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ Elisha nu sane nɛ ba a, e tsɔ ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni he je o hao kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Ha nɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ e maa na kaa gbalɔ ko ngɛ Israel.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Naeman kɛ e we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ zugba lɛ ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya da si ngɛ Elisha we ɔ agbo ɔ nya.
Elisha tsɔ ya de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya du o he ngɛ Yordan pa a mi si kpaago, kɛkɛ o he womi maa hi ekohu, nɛ o he ma tsɔ!” Se Naeman mi mi fu, nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e yaa a, e de ke, “Hyɛ, i susu kaa e ma ba da si ngɛ ye kasa nya nɛ e ma tsɛ Yawɛ e Mawu ɔ biɛ; nɛ e maa fɔ̃ e nine ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba, nɛ e ma tsa mi.
Damasko pahi, Abana kɛ Farpar a, anɛ a hí pi pa amɛ tsuo ngɛ Israel lo?
Anɛ i ko du we ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a mi nɛ ye he nɛ tsɔ lo?” E tsɔli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ!
Nɔ́ nguaa ko nɛ gbalɔ ɔ fa mo ke o pee jinɛ o ko pee we lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o be nyɛe nɛ o ya du o he kɛkɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e de ɔ, konɛ a tsa mo ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Naeman pue nɔ kɛ ho Yordan pa a mi ya, nɛ e mu kɛ ya nyu ɔ sisi si kpaago kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ fa lɛ ɔ. Nɛ a tsa lɛ.
E he womi tsake nɛ e pee kaa jokuɛyo he womi ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo kpale kɛ ho Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Kpaako loko i na kaa Mawu ko Mawu ko be je ɔ mi he ko he ko kaa ja Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, nike ní bɔɔ ko nɛ i hɛɛ kɛ ba ha mo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Elisha he nɔ ke, “I na Mawu nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ kaa i be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hee!” Naeman nyɛ e nɔ ke e he kɛkɛ; se e kplɛɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Naeman de ke, “Lɛɛ ke ja a, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ a ha mi tabo zu teji okpɔngɔ enyɔ a yi tlomi nɛ ma kɛ ya.
Ejakaa kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, i be sami bɔ, loo bɔ kpa ko sãe ha mawu kpa komɛ hu kaa ja Yawɛ kɛkɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa ke i nyɛɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ se kɛ ya Siria mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Rimon ɔ we ɔ, nɛ i ya ja lɛ ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pa mi.
Niinɛ, Yawɛ kɛ maa pa mi.” Elisha de lɛ ke, “Yaa ngɛ he jɔmi mi.” Benɛ Naeman je ɔ, e kɛ we kulaa nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ Elisha tsɔlɔ Gehazi de ke, “Hyɛ kaa ye nyɔmtsɛ ngɔ Naeman, Siria no nɛ ɔ he ngɔ ke lɛ; nɔ́ nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ba a hu, e he we ngɛ e dɛ.
I na Mawu, ma tu fo kɛ fie e se nɛ ma ya he nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Gehazi nyɛɛ Naeman se.
Benɛ Naeman na kaa nɔ ko ma ngɛ e se kɛ fo ɔ, e kple si kɛ je zugba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
E bi lɛ ke, “Sane ko he je lo?” Gehazi he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
I hɛɛ we sane yobu ko.
Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba de mo ke amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ gbali a kuu ɔ mi nihewi enyɔ je Efraim yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ha mɛ sika hiɔ yi akpe etɛ, kɛ he dlami tade saminyawiiwi enyɔ.” Naeman de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mo he sika hiɔ yi akpe ekpa.” E nyɛ e nɔ, nɛ e fi sika hiɔ yi akpe ekpa a kɛ wo kotoku enyɔ a mi; nɛ e ngɔ he dlami tade saminyawiiwi enyɔ ngɔ piɛ he ngɔ tloo e tsɔli enyɔ kɛ nyɛɛ Gehazi hɛ mi.
Benɛ a ya su yoku ɔ he ɔ, Gehazi he ní ɔmɛ ngɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ya to we ɔ mi; nɛ e wo mɛ blɔ.
Benɛ Gehazi kpale kɛ ba we ɔ mi ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Jije o je?” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, i yɛ he ko he ko.” Se Elisha de lɛ ke, “Anɛ benɛ nyumu ɔ kple si kɛ je e zugba lɛ ɔ mi nɛ e kɛ mo ba kpe ɔ, i be lejɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi mi lo?
Anɛ be nɛ a kɛ heɔ sika, loo tadehi, loo oliv abɔɔhi, loo wai ngmɔhi, loo tohi, loo nahi, loo mawahi ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Naeman he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a ma ba pue o he, nɛ o kɛ o nina maa nu hiɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.” Benɛ Gehazi je lejɛ ɔ, he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya pue e he, nɛ e he womi pee patapata kaa ngo.
Gbiɛ ɔ nɛ Elisha je ngɛ pa mi ɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, gbali a kuu ɔ nɛ Elisha ngɛ a nɔ hyɛe ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, he nɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ klee we ha wɔ hu.
Ha nɛ waa ya Yordan pa a nya nɛ wa ya poo tso kakaaka nɛ wa kɛ pee sihi he ha wa he.” E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya!” A ti nɔ kake kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e kɛ mɛ nɛ ya; nɛ e kplɛɛ nɔ nɛ e kɛ mɛ ho.
Benɛ a ya su Yordan pa a nya a, a bɔni tso ɔmɛ hɛɛmi pue si.
Se benɛ a ti nɔ kake ngɛ tso ko poe ɔ, e gbiɛ yi ɔ kpɔ nɔ pa a mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de ke, “Ao, ye nyɔmtsɛ!
Gbiɛ ɔ; gbiɛ nɛ a ya ba!” Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Jije e nɔ?” Nyumu ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ he nɛ gbiɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha po tso nɛ e sake kɛ fɔ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha dade ɔ ba je nyu hɛ.
Elisha de nyumu ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya kɛ̃!” Nɛ e juale e nine nɛ e kɛ̃ dade ɔ.
A ye Siria tabo ɔ nɔ kunimi Be ko ɔ, Siria matsɛ kɛ Israel na ta, nɛ e kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ so kaa a ma ya bua a he nya ngɛ he ko.
Se Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ tsɔ ya naa Israel matsɛ ɔ nane nɔ ke e ko ya lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa Siria bi ɔmɛ ma ya wo ka ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel matsɛ ɔ hu tsɔ ya de ni ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke a hɛ nɛ hi a he nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ si abɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao Siria matsɛ ɔ juɛmi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ se?
Anɛ nyɛ be mi dee lo?” E tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ!
Pi nɔ ko nɔ ko!
Gbalɔ Elisha nɛ ngɛ Israel ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ke o tu munyu ngɛ o se tsu mi po nɛ e deɔ Israel matsɛ ɔ nɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ fa ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hla e hi he, konɛ ma tsɔ nɛ a ya nu lɛ kɛ ba!” Benɛ a ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ kaa Elisha ngɛ Dotan ɔ, e wo ta buli babauu blɔ, kɛ okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛhi kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
A ya su lejɛ ɔ nyɔ mi, nɛ a sa ma a yi.
Makɛ mla a, Mawu nɔmlɔ Elisha tsɔlɔ ɔ te si momo.
Benɛ e je kpo ɔ, e na kaa ta buli, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛhi bɔle ma a kɛ kpe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Ye nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?” Elisha de lɛ ke, “Koo ye gbeye!
Nimli nɛ ngɛ wa se ɔ, a hiɛ babauu pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mɛɛ a se ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha sɔle nɛ e de ke “Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, bli e hɛngmɛ nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́.” Yawɛ bli niheyo ɔ hɛngmɛ; nɛ benɛ e ke e hyɛɛ ɔ, la okpɔngɔhi, kɛ la ta zugba lɛhi babauu ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ nɛ bɔle Elisha kɛ kpe.
Benɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ ba tua Elisha a, e fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ nɛ yu!” Yawɛ bu e kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ e ha a hɛ yu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha de mɛ ke, “Ma a nɛ nyɛ yaa mi ɔ, pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ; nyɛ tla blɔ.
