Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ye se, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa ya nyumu ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ ngɔ!” Nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ ho Samaria ya.
Benɛ a su Samaria a, Elisha sɔle nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, bli nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛngmɛ, nɛ a hyɛ nɔ́!” Yawɛ bli a hɛngmɛ nɛ a na kaa a ngɛ Samaria ma a mi.
Benɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ na mɛ ɔ, e bi Elisha ke, “Tsaatsɛ, ma gbe mɛ lo?
Ma gbe mɛ lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
Koo gbe mɛ!
Nimli nɛ o ya nuu nyɔguɛ kɛ o klaate kɛ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ po, anɛ o maa gbe mɛ lo?
Ha mɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye, nɛ o ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ ngmɛ mɛ okplɔɔ agbo.
Benɛ a ye ní nɛ a nu nɔ́ ko ɔ, e wo mɛ blɔ; nɛ a kpale kɛ ho Siria matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.
Kɛ je lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Siria bi ɔmɛ ya tua we Israel zugba a hu.
A sa Samaria yi Pee se ɔ, Siria matsɛ, Benhadad bua e tabo ɔ nya, nɛ e ya sa Samaria yi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, hwɔ nɛ nya wa ba Samaria hluu kɛ ya si a jua teji yi tɔ kake sika hiɔ yi nyingmi kpaanyɔ.
Lahuɛ fĩ hu he jua ji sika hiɔ yi enuɔ.
Ligbi ko, benɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle ma a nɔ ɔ, yo ko kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, mo wa mi!” Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ wa we mo ɔ, kɛ imi lɛɛ ma pee kɛ wa mo kɛɛ?
Anɛ i ngɛ ngma, aloo wai?
Mɛni ji o sane ɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Ligbi ko ɔ, yo nɛ ɔ de mi ke ma ngɔ ye binyumuyo ɔ kɛ ba nɛ waa ye, konɛ e nɔ jena nɛ waa ye lɛ hu e binyumuyo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ wa hoo ye binyumuyo ɔ nɛ wa ye.
E nɔ jena a, i de lɛ ke e ngɔ e binyumuyo ɔ kɛ ba nɛ waa ye; se e ngɔ lɛ kɛ laa.” Benɛ matsɛ ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ yo ɔ de ɔ, e hao nɛ e hía e tade ɔmɛ.
Nɛ benɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ, ma a na lɛ; nɛ a yɔse kaa e bu kpekpe ngɛ e tade ɔmɛ a sisi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de ke, “Ke i ha we nɛ a po Shafat binyumu Elisha yi mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ fii, Mawu nɛ gbe mi!” Nɛ e tsɔ nyumu ko ke e ya tsɛ Elisha kɛ ba.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Elisha kɛ ma nimeli komɛ nɛ ma lɛ slaami ɔ hii si ngɛ e we ɔ mi.
Benɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ na we nɛ e su we ɔ mi ɔ, Elisha de ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ na kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ nɛ ɔ tsɔ nɛ́ a ba po ye yi!
Nyɛ le piɔ, ke tsɔlɔ ɔ ba a, nyɛ nga sinya a, nɛ nyɛ ko ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e sɛ tsu ɔ mi.
Matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ma.” Benɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ munyu tue, nɛ e nya na we nɛ e nɔ si ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ba hia kpo; nɛ e de ke, “Haomi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ e je!
Lɛɛ mɛni he i pa ngɛ Yawɛ mlɛe ma pee mɔ?”
Se Elisha de ke, “Nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ munyu tue!
Yawɛ ke, hwɔɔ maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a maa jua ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ, sika hiɔ yi kake; nɛ a ma he blɛfo kilo ekpa hu sika hiɔ yi kake ngɛ Samaria ma a agbo ɔ nya.” Matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛngua a de Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ke, “Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ tlukaa po, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be mi bae.” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ o hɛngmɛ, se o be ní ɔ eko yee!” Siria tabo ɔ je Samaria Nyumuhi eywiɛ komɛ nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ a he hi Samaria ma a agbo ɔ nya.
Ligbi ko ɔ, a de a he ke, “Mɛni he je wa maa hi si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si wa ma gbo ɔ?
Ke wa ke wa maa sɛ ma a mi ɔ, hwɔ maa gbe wɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke wa hii si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ hu, wa ma gbo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa je kɛ ho Siria bi ɔmɛ a ma sito he ɔ ya.
Ke a he wa yi wami ɔ, wa maa tlɔ je mi; ke a gbe wɔ hu gbenɔ kake ɔ kɛ̃.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbɔkuɛ nya si benɛ du maa ho bumi ya a, a te si nɛ a pue blɔ kɛ yaa Siria ta a mi.
Se benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ, a nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Yawɛ ha nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ nububuubui ko he kaa nɔ́ nɛ tabo agbo ko hia kɛ ma, kɛ okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛhi; nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ susu kaa Israel matsɛ ɔ ya bɔ Hit bi a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ apaa nɛ a ba tua mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ du maa ho bumi ya a, Siria bi ɔmɛ ngɔ gbenɔ kɛ kã kɛ tu fo kɛ je a bo tsu ɔmɛ, okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ teji yi ɔmɛ a he; nɛ a si a ma sito he ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nuli ɔmɛ ba su ma sito he ɔ nya a, a sɛ bo tsu kake mi, nɛ a ya ye ní nɛ a nu ní.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a muɔ sika hiɔ, sika tsu, kɛ bohi kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya to he ko.
A kpale a se kɛ ba ekohu ba sɛ bo tsu kpa mi, nɛ a muɔ níhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hulɔ kɛ ya to.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a de a sibi ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ hí!
Wa ye manye mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Ke wa pee dii nɛ wa mlɛ kɛ ya si mɔtu loko wa ya de ɔ, a maa gbla wa tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ho nɛ wa ya bɔ matsɛ we ɔ amaniɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ho nɛ a ya tsɛ ma agbo nya buli ɔmɛ nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Wa ya Siria bi ɔmɛ a ma sito he ɔ, se wa nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; wa nui nɔ ko nɔ ko nya hulɔ.
A fi okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ teji ɔmɛ kɛ muɔ si, nɛ bo tsu ɔmɛ fɔɔ si kaa bɔ nɛ a si mɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ agbo nya buli ɔmɛ he ose; nɛ a ho ya bɔ matsɛ we ɔ amaniɛ.
Matsɛ ɔ te si nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu, nɛ e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ga nɛ Siria bi nɛ ɔmɛ to ngɔ wo wa he ɔ.
A le kaa hwɔ ngɛ wɔ yee; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je a ma sito he ɔ nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ nga a nɔ.
A susu kaa ke a pee ja a, wa maa je ma a mi, kɛkɛ a ma ba sɛ ma a mi nɛ a nuu wɔ hɛ ngmengmle.” E tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake wo ga ke, “Nimli nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ko be ha mɛ; a ngɛ kaa Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ mɛɛ a gbo momo ɔ kɛ̃.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa tsɔ ni komɛ nɛ a ngɔ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a piɛ ɔ enuɔ kɛ ya, nɛ a ya hyɛ kaa mɛni tutuutu lɛ ba Siria ta buli ɔmɛ a nɔ lo.” A hla ni komɛ, nɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɔ mɛ kɛ ta zugba lɛ enyɔ kɛ a nya okpɔngɔhi.
E de mɛ ke a ya nɛ a ya hyɛ kaa mɛni lɛ ba Siria bi ɔmɛ a ta buli ɔmɛ a nɔ lo.
Tsɔli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ ya su Yordan pa a nya tɔɔ.
Benɛ a yaa a, a na tadehi, kɛ ní kpa komɛ nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ sake ngɔ pue blɔ ɔ tue benɛ a ngɛ fo tue esɔesɔ ɔ. Tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba nɛ a ba bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya ha ní ngɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ a ma sito he ɔ. Nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ, a jua mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ sika hiɔ yi kake, kɛ blɛfo kilo ekpa hu sika hiɔ yi kake.
E ba mi kaa Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɔ e we asafoatsɛngua a kɛ to ma a agbo ɔ nya.
Se ma a naa e nɔ ngɛ agbo ɔ nya nɛ e gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ de benɛ matsɛ ɔ ba e ngɔ ɔ. Benɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Hwɔɔ, maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a maa jua blɛfo kilo ekpa, aloo ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ sika hiɔ yi kake ngɛ Samaria” a, asafoatsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ tlukaa po, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be mi bae.” Elisha de lɛ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ o hɛngmɛ, se o be ní ɔ eko yee!” Jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ ba mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma a naa e nɔ nɛ e gbo ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya.
Shunem yo ɔ kpale kɛ ba Elisha de Shunem yo ɔ nɛ e binyumu ɔ gbo, nɛ lɛ, Elisha a tle lɛ si ɔ ke, “Moo mia nɛ o kɛ o we mi bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya to nubwɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ ma na; ejakaa Yawɛ ma ha nɛ hwɔ maa ba zugba a nɔ jeha kpaago.” Yo ɔ dla, nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ de lɛ ɔ, e kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ya; nɛ a ya to nubwɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jeha kpaago.
Jeha kpaago ɔ se, benɛ yo ɔ kpale e se kɛ je Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ba a, e ya nɛ́ e ya kpa matsɛ ɔ pɛɛ konɛ e kpale e we ɔ, kɛ e zugba a nɛ a kpɔ ɔ kɛ ha lɛ.
E ya na Mawu nɔmlɔ Elisha tsɔlɔ Gehazi nɛ e kɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ ní sɛɛe.
Matsɛ ɔ de Gehazi ke, “Moo gba mi nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Elisha pee ɔ.” Benɛ Gehazi ngɛ matsɛ ɔ gbae bɔ nɛ Elisha tle gbogboe ko si ɔ, yo ɔ nɛ e binyumu ɔ gbo nɛ a tle lɛ si ɔ, ba fa kue ha matsɛ ɔ ngɛ e we ɔ, kɛ e zugba a he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Gehazi de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ matsɛ, yo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ e binyumu ɔ nɛ Elisha tle si ɔ hu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ bi yo ɔ e nya mi gbi, nɛ e gba lɛ e sane ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɛ e tsɔlɔ ko nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Moo kpale yo ɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ ha lɛ.
Jehanɛ, jeha kpaago ɔ nɛ e be hiɛ ɔ, niba ní tsuo nɛ ba ngɛ e zugba a nɔ ɔ, a bu nya nɛ a wo lɛ he hiɔ.” Elisha kɛ Siria matsɛ, Benhadad Elisha ya Damasko; nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ, Siria matsɛ, Benhadad be he wami.
Benɛ a ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ke Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ ba lejɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ de e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ Hazael ke, “Moo ngɔ nike ní kɛ ya ha Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ, nɛ o bi Yawɛ ní ngɛ e ngɔ ha mi kaa hiɔ nɛ i ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ, ma na he wami lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Hazael pue nɔ kɛ ho Elisha ngɔ ya.
E hɛɛ nike níhi nɛ ji Damasko ní kpakpa amɛ tsuo eko tsuaa eko afukpɔngɔ nyingmi eywiɛ yi tlomi kɛ ho.
Benɛ e ya na Elisha a, e de lɛ ke, “O binyumu Benhadad, Siria matsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi ke ma ba bi mo ke hiɔ nɛ e ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ, e ma na he wami lo?” Elisha de lɛ ke, “Yawɛ je tsɔɔ mi kaa e ma gbo; se kɛ̃ ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya de lɛ ke e ma na he wami.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha dɔ e hɛngmɛ ngɔ fɔ Hazael nɔ, nɛ e hyɛ lɛ gaa, hluu kɛ ya si Hazael hao.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ fo ya.
Hazael bi lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni he je o ngɛ ya foe ɔ?” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Ejakaa i le ní yayamihi nɛ o maa pee Israel ma a. O maa mɛ a mɔ ɔmɛ a he la; o kɛ klaate maa gbe a nihewi ɔmɛ; o maa ngɔ a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ fia si, nɛ a maa ku dukuduku.
Yihɔyi ɔmɛ lɛɛ o ma gba a muklii ɔmɛ.” Hazael bi lɛ ke, “Imi o tsɔlɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa gbe kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ ji mi nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nguaa kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Elisha he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ lɛ je tsɔɔ mi kaa mo lɛ o ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Siria ma a nɔ.” Hazael kpale e se kɛ ho e nyɔmtsɛ Benhadad ngɔ ya.
E nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ Elisha de mo kɛɛ?” Hazael he nɔ ke, “E ke o ma na he wami.” Se e nɔ jena a, Hazael ngɔ sa nɔ bo kɛ wo nyu mi nɛ e kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ya si e mumi nya ta nɛ e gbo.
Nɛ Hazael ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoram Israel matsɛ, Yoram, Ahab binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yehoshafat binyumu Yehoram ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda.
E ye jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ nɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi; nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha kpaanyɔ.
E ngɔ Ahab biyo; nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Ahab we ɔ pee ɔ, lɛ hu e ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Se Yawɛ sume kaa e ma kpata Yuda hɛ mi, ejakaa e wo e tsɔlɔ David si kaa e nina maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yehoram yi nɔ ɔ, Edom tsɔ Yuda hɛ mi atuã, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ya wo matsɛ kɛ ha a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yehoram kɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pue nɔ kɛ ho Zair ya; se Edom bi ɔmɛ sa a yi.
Nyɔ mi ɔ, e kɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a nya asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ te si konɛ a fia Edom bi ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ ní; se e ta buli ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa, nɛ a tu fo kɛ ya sɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi.
Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Edom tsɔ e he kɛ je Yuda nɔ yemi ɔ sisi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu lɛ Libna ma a hu tsɔ atuã.
Yehoram he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yehoram ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Ahazia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia Israel matsɛ, Yoram, Ahab binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yehoram binyumu Ahazia bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda.
Ahazia ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ benɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi; nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha kake.
E nyɛ, nɛ ji Israel matsɛ Omri bibi ɔ, e biɛ ji Atalia.
Ahazia ngatsɛ ji matsɛ Ahab.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Ahab we ɔ pee ɔ, Ahazia hu ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Matsɛ Ahazia ya piɛ Israel matsɛ, Yoram, Ahab binyumu ɔ he nɛ a kɛ Siria matsɛ, Hazael ya hwu ta ngɛ Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ. Nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ plaa Yoram.
Matsɛ Yoram kpale e se kɛ ba Yezreel konɛ e ba tsa e he, nɛ Yuda matsɛ Ahazia, Yehoram binyumu ɔ bu e nɔ nɛ e ya slaa lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A pɔ Yehu nu nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ Israel Gbalɔ Elisha tsɛ gbali a kuu ɔ mi no kake, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo dla o he nɛ o hɛɛ nu kɛ tɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ ya Ramot ngɛ Gilead.
Ke o su lejɛ ɔ, yaa hla Yehoshafat binyumu Yehu, Nimshi bibi ɔ se blɔ.
Ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ je e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ya se tsu mi.
Plɛ nu ɔ nɛ ngɛ tɔ ɔ mi ɔ ngɔ pue e yi mi, nɛ o de ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ mo nu pɔe kɛ ngɛ mo matsɛ woe ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bli sinya a nɛ o je lejɛ ɔ esɔesɔ; koo to tsle.” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ niheyo ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho Ramot Gilead ya.
Benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe; nɛ e de ke, “Asafoatsɛ, i hɛɛ sɛ kɛ ha mo.” Yehu bi lɛ ke, “Wa ti mɛnɔ?” Nɛ e he nɔ ke, “Mo asafoatsɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehu be kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ niheyo ɔ plɛ nu ɔ kɛ pue e yi mi, nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘I ngɛ mo nu pɔe kɛ ngɛ mo Yawɛ ma nɛ ji Israel ɔ nɔ matsɛ woe.
O ma kpata o nyɔmtsɛ Ahab we ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ i kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ye ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ imi Yawɛ, ye tsɔli kpa amɛ tsuo a muɔ nɛ Yezebel pue si ɔ he lue.
Ahab weku kɛ nina tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata; nɛ ma gbe binyumuyo tsuaa binyumuyo ngɛ Ahab we ɔ mi ngɛ Israel, odehe jio, nyɔguɛ jio.
Ma pee Ahab we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Nebat binyumu Yeroboam, kɛ Ahija binyumu Baasha a we ɔmɛ ɔ. Yezebel lɛɛ nɔ ko be lɛ pue; gbehi maa ye lɛ ngɛ Yezreel zugba a nɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ niheyo ɔ bli sinya a, nɛ e tu fo kɛ je.
Benɛ Yehu kpale e se kɛ ba e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni kikɛmɛ a godotsɛ nɛ ɔ ba hlami ngɛ o ngɔ?
Manye munyu e hɛɛ kɛ ba lo?” E he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le nɔmlɔ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e munyu tumi ngɛ ha.” A de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi!
Mo de wɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ niheyo ɔ ba de lɛ ɔ. E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘I ngɛ mo nu pɔe kɛ ngɛ mo matsɛ woe ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.’ ” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yehu nyɛmimɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ je a he tade ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ ha kpoku ɔ nɔ ha lɛ nɛ e da nɔ.
A kpa titimati nɛ a de ke, “Yehu ji matsɛ!” A gbe Israel matsɛ, Yoram Yehoshafat binyumu Yehu, Nimshi bibi ɔ so Yoram yi nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yoram kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ya sa Siria matsɛ, Hazael yi kɛ wo Ramot Gilead.
Se Matsɛ Yoram kpale e se kɛ ba Yezreel, konɛ plaami nɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ plaa lɛ ngɛ ta a nɛ e kɛ Siria matsɛ, Hazael hwu ɔ mi ɔ, e ba tsa e he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehu de e nyɛmimɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɛ ye se niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko tu fo kɛ je ma a mi nɛ e ya bɔ amaniɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yezreel.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehu ya sɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e pue Yezreel blɔ.
Yoram hwɔɔ si ngɛ hiɔ sa nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia ba lɛ slaami.
Bulɔ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Yezreel mɔ ɔ yi mi ɔ na Yehu kɛ tabo nɛ a ma; nɛ e de ke, “I na tabo ko nɛ ma.” Yoram de lɛ ke, “Moo tsɔ okpɔngɔ ta bulɔ ko nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya kpe, nɛ e bi mɛ ke manye nyɛɛmi nɛ a nyɛɛ lo.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ hi okpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e kɛ Yehu ya kpe; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Matsɛ ɔ ke ma bi nyɛ ke manye nyɛɛmi nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ ɔ lo?” Yehu he nɔ ke, “Mɛni manye munyu kɔɔ ngɛ o he?
Bee nɛ o ya nyɛɛ ye se!” Bulɔ ɔ ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ ke, “Tsɔlɔ ɔ ya su a ngɔ, se e kpale we e se kɛ bɛ hu.” Yoram tsɔ okpɔngɔ ta bulɔ enyɔne kɛ ho.
Benɛ e ya su a ngɔ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Matsɛ ɔ ke ma bi nyɛ ke, ‘Manye nyɛɛmi nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ ɔ lo?’ ” Yehu he nɔ ke, “Pi o he sane ko ji lɔ ɔ; bee nɛ o ya nyɛɛ ye se!” Bulɔ ɔ ya bɔ matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ekohu ke, “Tsɔlɔ ɔ ya su a ngɔ, se e kpale we e se kɛ bɛ hu.
Jehanɛ hu, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔ ngɛ e ní pee gidigidi kaa Nimshi bibi Yehu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoram fa ke, “Nyɛɛ mia ye ta zugba lɛ ɔ!” A pee ja; nɛ Israel matsɛ, Yoram kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia je kpo, nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ya hi lɛ nitsɛ e ta zugba lɛ mi, nɛ a ho nɛ a kɛ Yehu ya kpe.
A ya na lɛ ngɛ Nabot, Yezreel no ɔ zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ Yoram na Yehu ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “Yehu, o ba kɛ tue mi jɔmi lo?” Yehu he nɔ ke, “Tue mi jɔmi?
Yayami babauu nɛ o nyɛ Yezebel pee, nyuami kɛ amaga jami nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, mɛni tue mi jɔmi ma pa hi si?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoram dɔ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ yi, nɛ e tu fo.
Benɛ e yaa ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ tsuo ɔ, e ngɛ ngmlaa kpae nɛ e ngɛ Ahazia dee ke, “Ahazia lee, Yehu tsɔ matsɛ hɛ mi atuã!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehu kɛ e he wami tsuo tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ kɛ gu Yoram kotimi.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ ya gbɔ e tsui mi; nɛ e gbo kɛ fɔ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi.
Yehu de e tsɔlɔ Bidkar ke, “Ngɔɔ lɛ nɛ o ya sake ngɔ fɔ Nabot, Yezreel no ɔ zugba a nɔ!
O kai kaa be ko nɛ i kɛ mo wa hi ta zugba lɛ mi kɛ nyɛɛ e tsɛ Ahab se ɔ, munyuhi nɛ Yawɛ tu kɛ si Ahab ji, ‘Niinɛ, hiɛ benɛ i na Nabot kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a muɔ ɔ nɛ pueɔ si ɔ, i wo si kaa ja i gbla o tue ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɔ.
Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de!’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɔɔ Yoram gbogboe ɔ nɛ o ya sake ngɔ fɔ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ!” A gbe Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia Benɛ Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, e tu fo kɛ gu Bet Hagan blɔ.
Yehu nyɛɛ e se, nɛ e de ke, “Lɛ hu nyɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ eko!” Nɛ a tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ngɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Gur blɔ ɔ nɔ, ngɛ Ibleam kasa nya.
E tu fo kɛ ho Megido ya, nɛ e ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ wo ta zugba lɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho David ma, Yerusalem ya, nɛ a ya pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ahab binyumu Yoram yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ mi nɛ Ahazia ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
A gbe Manyɛ Yezebel Benɛ Yezebel nu kaa Yehu ba Yezreel ɔ, e kɛ tsopa kpa e hɛngmɛ se, nɛ e hɔɔ e yi saminyayoo, nɛ e ya bu si ngɛ saflɛ nya ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe.
Benɛ Yehu sɛ agbo ɔ mi ɔ, Yezebel bi lɛ ke, “Mo Zimri!
Mo nɛ o gbe o nyɔmtsɛ ɔ!
O ba kɛ tue mi jɔmi lo?” Yehu wo e yi nɔ nɛ e hyɛ saflɛ ɔ nya, nɛ e bi ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ ye se?
Mɛnɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ manyɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛli, maa pee enyɔ, loo etɛ hyɛ lɛ kɛ gu saflɛ ɔ mi.
Yehu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsitsɛɛ lɛ ngɔ fia si!” A pee ja, nɛ Yezebel muɔ fĩa pue gbogbo ɔmɛ a he, kɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ a naa e nɔ kɛ be.
Yehu sɛ we ɔ mi nɛ e ya ye ní nɛ e nu ní.
Benɛ e ye ní ta a, e de ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pu yo musutsɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa matsɛ biyo ji lɛ.” Se benɛ a ho nɛ́ a ya pu lɛ ɔ, a nɛ e he nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; e yi koklodo, kɛ e nanehi, kɛ e ninehi pɛ nɛ a na.
A kpale a se kɛ ba nɛ a ba bɔ Yehu amaniɛ ɔ. Yehu de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de to kaa e maa ba mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ tu munyu kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ Eliya, Tishbe no ɔ nɔ ke, ‘Yezreel zugba a nɔ nɔuu nɛ gbehi maa ye Yezebel lo ngɛ.
A ma sake Yezebel gbogboe ɔ ngɔ fɔ nga nɔ ngɛ Yezreel zugba a nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be e mi tso lee hu.’ ”
A gbe Ahab bimɛ ɔmɛ Ahab ngɛ binyumuhi nyingmi kpaago ngɛ Samaria.
Yehu ngma womi nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ ya ha Samaria ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ Ahab binyumu ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ e ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji, “Nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ji nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ta zugba lɛhi, okpɔngɔhi, ta hwumi níhi, kɛ ma nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ nine su womi nɛ ɔ nɔ pɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ nɛ hi, nɛ e hɛ mi hu wa pe mɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ hi e tsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ hwu ta kɛ fa nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we ɔ he.” Samaria ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a tsui po wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ!
Matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ po nyɛ we Yehu hɛ mi nɛ a da; kɛ wɔɔ wa maa pee kɛ da e hɛ mi kɛɛ?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ binyumu ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ tsɔ ya de Yehu ke, “O tsɔli ji wɔ; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma de wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, wa maa pee.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nɔ ko nɔ ko matsɛ woe; nɔ́ nɛ sa o hɛ mi ɔ, moo pee.” Yehu ngma mɛ womi enyɔne ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɛ ye se, nɛ nyɛ maa bu mi tue ɔ, lɛɛ hwɔɔ maa pee be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔmɛ a yi koklodohi kɛ ba ha mi ngɛ Yezreel.” Matsɛ Ahab binyumu ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ji nyingmi kpaago, nɛ ma nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ a nɔ hyɛe.
Benɛ Yehu womi ɔ ba su Samaria ma nimeli ɔmɛ a dɛ ɔ, a nuu matsɛ binyumu nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ a yi koklodo ɔmɛ kɛ wo kusiihi a mi; nɛ a tsɔ nɛ a kɛ ya ha Yehu ngɛ Yezreel.
Benɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ya de Yehu ke a ngɔ matsɛ binyumu ɔmɛ a yi koklodo ɔmɛ kɛ ba a, Yehu fa ke a to mɛ kuukuu enyɔ ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ nya kɛ yaa si mɔtu.
E nɔ jena mɔtu ɔ, Yehu ho ya da ma a agbo ɔ nya; nɛ e de ma a tsuo ke, “Imi ji nɔmlɔ nɛ so matsɛ Yoram yi nɔ, nɛ imi nɔuu lɛ i gbe lɛ; nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ yi fɔ.
Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ gbe mɛ tsuo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Ahab we ɔ he ɔ, ekoeko be yaka pee.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ Eliya nɔ ke e maa pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ e pee nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yehu gbe nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ Ahab we ɔ mi ngɛ Yezreel, nimli ngua amɛ, e huɛmɛ kpakpa amɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo; e píɛ a ti nɔ kake po.
A gbe matsɛ Ahazia nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ Jehanɛ Yehu je Yezreel kɛ ho Samaria ya.
Benɛ e ya su he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ “To hyɛli a hwɔ he” ɔ, e kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kpe.
E bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔmɛ ji nyɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Ahazia nyɛmimɛ ji wɔ.
Wa yaa nɛ wa ya slaa matsɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ manyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ.” Yehu de e we bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ nuu mɛ hɛ ngmengmle!” A nuu mɛ hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ muɔ ko kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A gbe nimli nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ sɔuu; nɔ kake po píɛ.
A gbe Ahab nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ɔ Benɛ Yehu je lejɛ ɔ, e kɛ Rekab binyumu Yehonadab ya kpe ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Yehu nga lɛ, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ ye tsui mi ngɛ faa ngɛ o he ɔ, ja mo hu o nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ lo?” Yehonadab he nɔ ke, “Ee, ye tsui mi ngɛ faa.” Yehu de lɛ ke, “Ke ja a, lɛɛ moo ta ye dɛ mi.” A ta a sibi a dɛ mi, nɛ Yehu ngɔ lɛ kɛ wo e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ha waa ho nɛ o ya hyɛ kɛ o hɛngmɛ níhi nɛ i pee ha Yawɛ.” Nɛ e kɛ lɛ hi ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi kɛ ho Samaria ya.
Benɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ, Yehu gbe Ahab nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi; nɔ kake ngmelu po píɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de Eliya ke e maa ba mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A gbe Baal jali ɔmɛ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yehu bua ma a tsuo nya nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ahab ja Baal bɔɔ pɛ; se imi Yehu lɛɛ ma ja lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kpee Baal gbali ɔmɛ, Baal jali ɔmɛ, kɛ Baal wɔnɔ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ba ha mi; a ko si nɔ ko nɔ ko.
I ma nɛ ma ba sã bɔ ngua ko ha Baal; nɔ nɛ bɛ ɔ, a maa gbe lɛ.” (Blɔɔ ga nɛ Yehu to nɛ e kɛ ma kpata Baal jali ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.)
Jehanɛ, Yehu fa ke a fiɛ nɛ a kɛ kpee ma a kɛ ba ye nyami ligbi pɔtɛɛ ko kɛ wo Baal hɛ mi nyami; nɛ a pee ja.
Yehu tsɔ nɛ a ya kpee Israel ma a, kɛ Baal jali ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Baal piɛ ɔ mi.
Baal piɛ ɔ mi hyi tɔ kɛ nimli; e piɛ nɔ ko nɛ bɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehu de nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ tade ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ke, “Je tade ɔmɛ kpo, nɛ o dla kɛ ha Baal jali ɔmɛ tsuo!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yehu kɛ Rekab binyumu Yehonadab sɛ Baal piɛ ɔ mi; nɛ Yehu de Baal jali ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ko nɛ ko ba futu nyɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, kaa ja Baal jali ɔmɛ pɛ.” Jehanɛ e kɛ Yehonadab ya bɔni bɔhi, kɛ sami bɔhi sami.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yehu ngɔ nimli nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ to kpo ɔ nya, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ke a ti nɔ ko ma fo ɔ, a maa gbe nɔ nɛ ha nɛ e je ɔ ngɔ to nya.” Benɛ a dla bɔ sami ní ɔmɛ ta a, Yehu de buli ɔmɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya gbe mɛ tsuo; nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ je kpo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ buli ɔmɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ klaate gbe ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a sake mɛ kɛ pue kpo ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ya sɛ Baal wɔ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ya muɔ amagahi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a sã mɛ.
A ku Baal amaga a ngɔ pue si, nɛ a gbɛ piɛ ɔ; nɛ a ngɔ lejɛ ɔ kɛ pee agbotso kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Yehu pee nɛ e gu Baal jami ngɛ Israel ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se lɛ hu e ya wo Matsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat binyumu ɔ nane; nɛ e pee yayami.
Lɔ ɔ ji sika tsu na bi ɔmɛ nɛ Yeroboam pee kɛ ma Betel kɛ Dan nɛ e ha Israel ja mɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ plɛ yayami ha mɛ ɔ, Yehu hu ya nɔ nɛ e ja mɛ ja nɔuu.
Yawɛ de Yehu ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ sa ye hɛ mi; bɔ nɛ i to nɛ ma pee Ahab we ɔ, ja o pee ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, o bimɛ maa hi Israel matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa si yi nɔ eywiɛne ɔ.” Se Yehu yi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ mlaa a nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo.
Mohu ɔ, e ya wo Yeroboam, nɔ nɛ ha Israel pee yayami ɔ nane.
Yehu gbenɔ Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ bɔni Israel zugba a he pomi.
Siria matsɛ, Hazael ye Israel zugba a tsuo nɔ, kɛ je Yordan pa a beleku je kɛ ya si Aroer, ngɛ Arnon pa a nya, ngɛ omleyi je tɔɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji Gilead bi, kɛ Bashan bi a zugba a hehi nɛ Gad wɛtso ɔ, Ruben wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase nɔ́ fa a hi ɔ nɛ.
Yehu he sane kpahi, e kã, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yehu ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Samaria; nɛ e binyumu Yehoahaz ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yehu ye Israel nɔ matsɛ ngɛ Samaria jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Yuda manyɛ, Atalia Benɛ Matsɛ Ahazia nyɛ Atalia na le kaa a gbe e binyumu ɔ, e ha nɛ a kpata matsɛ we mi bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ahazia binyumu Yoash pɛ ji nɔ nɛ nine sui e nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ e ba ji, Matsɛ Yehoram biyo Yehosheba, Ahazia nyɛmiyo ɔ, kú Yoash kɛ je matsɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ma mɛ gbemi ɔ a kpɛti.
E ngɔ lɛ kɛ e bimɛanyɛ ɔ ya to se tsu ko mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ laa Atalia; nɛ a gbi lɛ.
Yehosheba ngɔ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ laa ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ jeha ekpa, be mi nɛ Atalia ngɛ manyɛ yee ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, osɔfo Yehoyada tsɔ nɛ a ya kpee asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ he buli ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ we bi a tabo ɔ nya a kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ. E kɛ mɛ so nɛ e ha a ka lɛ kita ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ; nɛ e kɛ matsɛ binyumu ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fa mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ma tsu ní Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake ma ya bu ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, mi dlami etɛ mi kake maa bu Sur agbo ɔ nya; nɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake hu maa bu agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ buli ɔmɛ a se ɔ hu nya.
Asafo kuu enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ji nihi tsuo nɛ a be ní tsumi yae Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu matsɛ ɔ he ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Nyɛɛ po klaangma kɛ bɔle Matsɛ Yoash, nɛ́ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛɛ e ta hwumi níhi ngɛ e dɛ mi.
He tsuaa he nɛ matsɛ ɔ yaa a, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ ya.
Ke nɔ ko hɛ lɛ kɛ su nyɛ he haa a, a gbe lɛ.” Asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ osɔfo Yehoyada fa mɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e we bihi kɛ ba osɔfo Yehoyada ngɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ba ní tsumi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba tsu ní momo nɛ a kpa.
Osɔfo Yehoyada dla Matsɛ David akplɔhi nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ ha asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ e ta hwumi níhi, nɛ a ya da a blɔ hehi, kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ omleyi je kɛ ya si leneyi je ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ we ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ a bɔle matsɛ ɔ kɛ kpe.
Jehanɛ, Yehoyada je matsɛbi ɔ kpo, nɛ e fi lɛ jlasi, nɛ e ngɔ mlaa womi ɔ kɛ wo e dɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a pɔ Yoash nu, nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ.
Ni ɔmɛ fia a dɛ, nɛ a hwɔ lele, nɛ a de ke, “Matsɛ yi nɛ na wa!” Benɛ manyɛ Atalia nu ngmlaa a nɛ buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kpae ɔ, e ba Yawɛ we ɔ he nɛ ma a bua a he nya ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ e maa hyɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ titima a he kaa bɔ nɛ kusumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ titimati kpali ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyae nɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Atalia hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ tsɔ atuã!
Nyɛ tsɔ atuã!” Osɔfo Yehoyada sume kaa a gbe Atalia ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa tabo ɔ nya asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ je lɛ kpo kɛ gu buli ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɔ nɛ maa ka kaa e ma kpɔ lɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ!” A nu Atalia, nɛ a hɛɛ lɛ kɛ ya gu blɔ ɔ nɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ guu nɔ kɛ yaa matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Tsakemihi nɛ Yehoyada kɛ ba Yehoyada ha Matsɛ Yoash, kɛ ma a kɛ Yawɛ so kaa a maa pee Yawɛ ma.
Jehanɛ, e ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ma a hu so.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ya sɛ Baal jami he ɔ, nɛ a gbɛ lɛ kɛ pue si.
A ku bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ amaga amɛ dukuduku, nɛ a gbe Baal osɔfo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Matan ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Osɔfo Yehoyada ngɔ buli ya to Yawɛ we ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, matsɛ we ɔ buli ɔmɛ, matsɛ he buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo kpaka matsɛ ɔ kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ ya gu buli agbo ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi.
Nɛ Yoash ya hi matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ na bua jɔmi; nɛ kɛ je be nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe Atalia ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi se ɔ, ma a mi jɔ.
Yoash ye jeha kpaago benɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
Yuda matsɛ, Yoash Israel matsɛ, Yehu yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, Yoash ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Zibia, nɛ e je Beersheba ma a mi.
Yoash pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní e wami be ɔ tsuo, ejakaa osɔfo Yehoyada ji nɔ nɛ tsɔse lɛ.
Se wɔ jami he ɔmɛ ɔ, e puɛ we mɛ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma a sãã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Yoash de osɔfo ɔmɛ ke sika tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma a kɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ kaa nike ní klɔuklɔu ɔ, a ngɔ kɛ to.
Lɔ ɔ ji sika nɛ nyumu tsuaa nyumu haa be mi nɛ a kane lɛ, sika nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ haa kɛ kpɔɔ e susuma, kɛ sika nɛ nɔ ko haa kɛ jeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui mi.
Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ e he sika a ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we asafo bi a dɛ, konɛ be tsuaa be nɛ e maa hia kaa a dla Yawɛ we ɔ, a ngɔ sika a kɛ dla lɛ.
Se kɛ ba si Matsɛ Yoash tsɛ yemi jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ dla we Yawɛ we ɔ he ko he ko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Matsɛ Yoash tsɛ osɔfo Yehoyada, kɛ osɔfo kpa amɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ dla we Yawɛ we ɔ?
Jehanɛ, nyɛ ko ngɔ sika ko ngɛ nyɛ asafo bi ɔmɛ a dɛ hu; sika tsuaa sika nɛ nyɛ nine maa su nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ dla Yawɛ we ɔ.” Osɔfo ɔmɛ kplɛɛ kaa a be sika ko ngɔe ngɛ ma a dɛ hu; mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a be Yawɛ we ɔ dlae.
Osɔfo Yehoyada ngɔ daka ko ya ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya, nɛ e gu puɔ ngɛ nya nɔ́ ɔ yi mi.
Ke o yaa Yawɛ we ɔ, daka a ngɛ o hiɔ nɔ.
Osɔfohi nɛ buɔ agbo ɔ nya a ngɔɔ sika tsuo nɛ ma a kɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ woɔ daka nɛ ɔ mi.
Ke a na kaa sika a hiɛ ngɛ daka a mi ɔ, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a maa ya Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ a ma ya kane sika nɛ a na ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ a fi kɛ wo kotokuhi a mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa tu sika a kɛ wo Yawɛ we ɔ ní tsuli ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ.
Mɛ hu a kɛ sika a maa wo tso he ní tsuli, tsu mali, gbogbo fiali, kɛ tɛ koli nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hiɔ.
A kɛ sika nɛ ɔ eko ma he tso kɛ tɛ nɛ a kó, nɛ a kɛ ma dla Yawɛ we ɔ.
A kɛ eko hu maa wo Yawɛ we ɔ dlami hiɔ kpahi.
Sika nɛ a kɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ, a ngɔɛ eko kɛ pee we sika hiɔ kpluhi, la gbemi níhi, kahi kɛ titimatihi, aloo sika tsu níhi, aloo sika hiɔ ní kpa komɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ we ɔ.
Se mohu, a kɛ haa ní tsuli ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a kɛ dlaa Yawɛ we ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ sika a woɔ a dɛ loko mɛ hu a ngɔɔ kɛ haa ní tsuli ɔmɛ ɔ, a kɛ mɛ pee we sika a he akɔtaa; ejakaa a yeɔ anɔkuale saminya.
Fɔ yemi bɔ sika a, kɛ yayami pami bɔ sika a lɛɛ a ngɔɛ kɛ bɛ Yawɛ we ɔ; osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Siria matsɛ, Hazael ya tua Gat, nɛ e ngɔ ma a; nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e ma ya tua Yerusalem hulɔ.
Nike ní klɔuklɔuhi tsuo nɛ Yehoshafat, Yehoram, kɛ Ahazia, nɛ ji Yuda matsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ Yoash hɛ mi ɔ gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, Matsɛ Yoash ngɔ.
E kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ sika tsuo nɛ a na ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ nito he ɔmɛ piɛ he, nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a ngɔ ya ha Siria matsɛ, Hazael.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Hazael kpale e se kɛ je Yerusalem.
Matsɛ Yoash he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
-Matsɛ Yoash tsɔli ɔmɛ so e yi nɔ nɛ a ti nihi enyɔ gbe lɛ ngɛ Milo we ɔ, ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɛ a guu kɛ yaa Sila a nɔ.
Shimeat binyumu Yozakar, kɛ Shomer binyumu Yehozabad ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbe lɛ ɔ nɛ.
A pu Yoash ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Amazia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Yehoahaz Yuda matsɛ, Yoash, Ahazia binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Yehu binyumu Yehoahaz bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaago.
Yehoahaz pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Yayamihi nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he; se e tsa nɔ mohu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Siria matsɛ, Hazael kɛ e binyumu Benhadad a dɛ mi si abɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yehoahaz fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ bu lɛ tue; ejakaa e na haomi nɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ haoe ɔ. Yawɛ je kpɔlɔ ko ha Israel, nɛ e ba kpɔ mɛ kɛ je Siria bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ na he jɔmi, nɛ a hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wehi a mi ekohu kaa sa a.
Se yayamihi nɛ Matsɛ Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, a ngmɛɛ we he; a tsa nɔ mohu.
Jehanɛ, yo mawu Ashera amaga a hu maa si ngɛ Samaria kɛ mwɔɔ.
Siria matsɛ ɔ kpata Matsɛ Yehoahaz tabo ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ a he wami nɔ gbɔ.
Matsɛ Yehoahaz ta buli tsuo nɛ piɛ ha lɛ ji okpɔngɔ ta buli nyingmi enuɔ, ta zugba lɛ nyɔngma, kɛ nane nyɛɛli akpe nyɔngma.
Yehoahaz he sane kpahi, kã, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yehoahaz ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Samaria, nɛ e binyumu Yehoash ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Yehoash Yuda matsɛ, Yoash yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaago ɔ, Yehoahaz binyumu Yehoash bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
Lɛ hu e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Yayamihi tsuo nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, Yehoash ngmɛɛ we he; se mohu e tsa nɔ.
Yehoash he sane kpahi, kã nɛ e pee benɛ e kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Amazia hwu ta, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yehoash ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Samaria, nɛ Yeroboam ba ye e se.
Elisha gbenɔ Ligbi ko, benɛ gbalɔ Elisha fɔɔ si kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Yehoash ba slaa lɛ, nɛ e fo ya pue e nɔ; nɛ e de ke, “Tsaatsɛ!
Tsaatsɛ!
Mo ji Israel he falɔ kpanaa!” Elisha de lɛ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya ngɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kɛ ba!” Benɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba a, Elisha de lɛ ke e pee kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ klaalo; nɛ e pee ja.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha nu matsɛ ɔ nine enyɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Bli saflɛ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ beleku je ɔ!” Nɛ e pee ja.
Jehanɛ Elisha de lɛ ke, “Tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ!” Benɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Elisha de ke, “Yawɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ e kɛ maa ye Siria nɔ kunimi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
O kɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ maa hwu ta ngɛ Afek hluu kɛ yaa si o ma kpata a hɛ mi butuu!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Elisha de Israel matsɛ ɔ ke e kukuɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kpa amɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ mɛ kɛ wo zu mi.
Matsɛ ɔ tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ kɛ wo zu mi si etɛ, nɛ e kpa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ mi mi fu lɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Kaa o tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ si enuɔ, loo si ekpa jinɛ o maa fia Siria bi ɔmɛ ní hluu kɛ yaa si o ma kpata a hɛ mi butuu.
Bɔ nɛ e ba nɛ ɔ lɛɛ si etɛ pɛ o maa ye Siria nɔ kunimi.” Elisha ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ.
Daa jeha sisije ɔ, Moab ojo fiali baa nɛ a ba tuaa Israel zugba a. Ligbi ko, benɛ a yaa nɛ a ya pu nyumu ko ɔ, a na ojo fiali a kuu nɛ ɔ nɛ ma.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a sake gbogboe ɔ ngɔ fɔ Elisha yɔkɔ ɔ mi.
Benɛ gbogboe ɔ he ya sa Elisha wuhi a he pɛ, nɔ ɔ hɛ tsɛ, nɛ e te da si.
Israel kɛ Siria hwu ta Siria matsɛ, Hazael wa Israel bi ɔmɛ yi mi Yehoahaz matsɛ yemi be ɔ tsuo; se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ dloomi kɛ e mɔbɔ nami ngɛ a nɔ.
Somi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Abraham, kɛ Isak, kɛ Yakob so ɔ he je ɔ, e piɛ a he, nɛ e ha we nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ hu e hɛ ji e ma a nɔ.
Benɛ Siria matsɛ, Hazael gbo ɔ, e binyumu Benhadad ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Yehoash ye Benhadad nɔ kunimi si etɛ, nɛ e kpɔ mahi nɛ Benhadad ngɔ benɛ lɛ, Yehoash ɔ tsɛ, Yehoahaz ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Israel ɔ.
Yuda matsɛ, Amazia Israel matsɛ, Yehoash, Yehoahaz binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, Amazia, Yoash binyumu ɔ ba ye matsɛ ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ nɛɛ.
E nyɛ je Yerusalem, nɛ e biɛ ji Yehoadin.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi, se e be kaa e nɛ̃ David; e ya wo e tsɛ Yoash nane.
Wɔ jami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ e puɛ we mɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a ya nɔ sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Benɛ Amazia matsɛ yemi ɔ ba da si ɔ, e gbe e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ gbe matsɛ ɔ nɛ ji e tsɛ ɔ.
Se a bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e gbi mɛ ngɛ mlaa nɛ Yawɛ wo ɔ nya, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose womi ɔ mi ɔ.
A ngma ke, “A ko gbe fɔli ngɛ yayami nɛ a bimɛ pee ɔ he, nɛ a ko gbe bimɛ hu ngɛ yayami nɛ a fɔli pee ɔ he; yayami nɛ nɔ nitsɛ e pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ he a gbe lɛ ngɛ.” Amazia gbe Edom ta buli akpe nyɔngma ngɛ Ngo kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
E kpɔ Sela ma a ngɛ ta mi, nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Yokteel; nɛ ja a tsɛɛ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Ligbi ko ɔ, Amazia tsɔ ya de Israel matsɛ, Yehoash, Yehu bi Yehoahaz bi ɔ ke e ba nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba kpe ngɛ ta nga nɔ.
Israel matsɛ, Yehoash hu tsɔ ya de Yuda matsɛ, Amazia ke, “Be ko ɔ, Lebanon mio tso tsɔ ke a ya de Lebanon seda ke, ‘Ngɔɔ o biyo ɔ ngɔ ha ye binyumu ɔ nɛ e ngɔ.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ Lebanon pu mi lohwe ko ba be, nɛ e naa mio tso ɔ nɔ.
Amazia, o gbe Edom bi ɔmɛ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o ngɛ o he nɔ woe.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o he biɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ o bua nɛ jɔ o he nɛ o hi si ngɛ o we mi.
Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ sane yee kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Anɛ o li kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ haomi maa ba o kɛ Yuda tsuo nyɛ nɔ lo?” Se Amazia tsi e tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Yehoash hia nɛ e kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Amazia ya kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi ngɛ ta nga nɔ, ngɛ Yuda ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Bet Shemesh ɔ. Israel ye Yuda nɔ kunimi, nɛ Yuda ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya.
Israel matsɛ, Yehoash nu Yuda matsɛ, Amazia nyɔguɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho Yerusalem ya nɛ e ya ku Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ gugue lafa, kɛ je Efraim agbo ɔ nya kɛ ya si kɔ nya agbo ɔ nya.
E muɔ níhi tsuo nɛ e na ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ junehi kɛ je.
E muɔ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ tsuo, nɛ e nuu ta nyɔguɛhi hulɔ kɛ ho Samaria ya.
Yehoash he sane kpahi, kã nɛ e pee benɛ e kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Amazia hwu ta, kɛ ní kpahi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yehoash ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Samaria; nɛ e binyumu Yeroboam ba ye e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Amazia gbenɔ Israel matsɛ, Yehoash gbenɔ se ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Amazia hi si jeha nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ loko e gbo.
Ni kpahi nɛ Amazia pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
E ba mi kaa a so Amazia yi nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kaa a maa gbe lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tu fo kɛ ho Lakish ya; se a tsɔ nihi kɛ nyɛɛ e se, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A kɛ e gbogboe ɔ fɔ okpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ ba Yerusalem nɛ a ba pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi, ngɛ David ma a mi.
Yuda ma a tsuo wo Uzia matsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ Amazia se.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
Benɛ Uzia tsɛ gbo se ɔ, Uzia kpɔ Elat kɛ ha Yuda ekohu, nɛ e dla po ma a. Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam nɛ ji enyɔ Yuda matsɛ, Amazia, Yoash binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Yehoash binyumu Yeroboam bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kake.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Yayamihi tsuo nɛ Yeroboam, Nebat binyumu ɔ ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he.
Yeroboam kpɔ Israel zugba amɛ nɛ je a dɛ ɔ ekohu, kɛ je Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nya, ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ ya si Ngo wo ɔ nya, ngɛ leneyi je.
Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ wo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he si kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ, gbalɔ Yona, Amitai binyumu ɔ nɛ je Gat Hefer ɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ ba na kaa amanehlu nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nae ɔ nya wa tsɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko na we he jɔmi, nɛ balɔ ko hu be.
Se akɛnɛ Yawɛ to we kaa e ma kpata Israel hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ he je ɔ, e gu Yehoash binyumu Yeroboam nɔ nɛ e kɛ he a yi wami.
Yeroboam he sane kpahi, kã nɛ e pee, ta nɛ e hwu, bɔ nɛ e kpɔ Damasko kɛ Hamat kɛ je Yuda dɛ ngɔ ha Israel, kɛ ní kpahi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yeroboam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi; nɛ e binyumu Zakaria ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Uzia Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Uzia, Amazia binyumu ɔ bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enuɔ kɛ enyɔ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Yekolia, nɛ e je Yerusalem.
E pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ Amazia pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se mohu wɔ jami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ e puɛ we mɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Yawɛ ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya; nɛ hiɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ e he kɛ ya si e gbenɔ ligbi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e klɛ̃ kɛ ya hi we kpa mi, nɛ e binyumu Yotam ba hi matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ e kɛ hyɛ ma a nɔ.
Uzia he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Uzia ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi; nɛ e binyumu Yotam ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Zakaria Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ, jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Yeroboam binyumu Zakaria ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yayamihi nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he.
Yabesh binyumu Shalum so Matsɛ Zakaria yi nɔ, nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbe ngɛ Ibleam; nɛ e ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Ní kpahi tsuo nɛ Zakaria pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, si nɛ Yawɛ wo Matsɛ Yehu ɔ ba mi.
Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “O bimɛ maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ yaa si yi nɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ.” Israel matsɛ, Shalum Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Yabesh binyumu Shalum ba ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ nyɔhiɔ kake.
Menahem, Gadi binyumu ɔ je Tirza kɛ ya Samaria nɛ e ya fia Yabesh binyumu Shalum nɔ́ nɛ e gbe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ e ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Ní kpahi tsuo nɛ Shalum pee, kɛ bɔ nɛ e so Zakaria yi nɔ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Benɛ Menahem je Tirza kɛ yaa a, e kpata Tapua ma a, ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ zugbahi nɛ bɔle Tapua ma a a hɛ mi.
Yihɔyihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi po, e ta bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a mi mi.
Menahem pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa ma a he we lɛ atuu.
Israel matsɛ, Menahem Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Gadi binyumu Menahem bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
E wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, yayamihi nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we a he.
Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ba tua Israel; nɛ Menahem ha lɛ sika hiɔ kilo akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Tiglat Pileser nɛ e piɛ e he, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ da si.
Menahem he sika nɛ ɔ kɛ je Israel niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ; e tsu niatsɛ tsuaa niatsɛ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enuɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
Menahem he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Menahem ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ, nɛ e binyumu Pekahia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Pekahia Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Menahem binyumu Pekahia ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Yayamihi nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he.
Pekahia we asafoatsɛ Peka, Remalia binyumu ɔ, kɛ Gilead bi nyingmi enuɔ so Pekahia yi nɔ, nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Samaria; nɛ Peka ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Pekahia he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Israel matsɛ, Peka Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enuɔ kɛ enyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Remalia binyumu Peka bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Yayamihi tsuo nɛ Yeroboam, Nebat binyumu ɔ ha nɛ Israel pee ɔ, e ngmɛɛ we he.
Israel matsɛ, Peka yi nɔ ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ba ngɔ Iyon, Abel Bet Maaka, Yanoa, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, kɛ Galilea-Naftali zugba a tsuo; nɛ e ngɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Asiria ya.
Yuda matsɛ, Yotam, Uzia binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Ela binyumu Hoshea so Matsɛ Peka yi nɔ nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbe; nɛ e ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Peka he sanehi kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yuda matsɛ, Yotam Israel matsɛ, Peka, Remalia binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, Uzia binyumu Yotam ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
E nyɛ ji Zadok biyo Yerusha.
E ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní.
Se jami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ e puɛ we mɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a ya nɔ sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Yotam ji nɔ nɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ omleyi je agbo ɔ nɛ.
Yotam he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Benɛ Yotam ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ ji be nɛ Yawɛ bɔni Siria matsɛ, Rezin, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Peka tsɔmi ke a ya tua Yuda.
Yotam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi; nɛ e binyumu Ahaz ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Ahaz Israel matsɛ Peka, Remalia binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Yotam binyumu Ahaz ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
E pee we Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ e nɛ̃ David pee ɔ; se mohu e ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane.
E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu po kɛ sã sami bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ a kusumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ahaz sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ, ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ tsohi nɛ bɔ kusuu ɔ a sisi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Siria matsɛ, Rezin, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Peka, Remalia binyumu ɔ ya tua Yerusalem, nɛ a sa Ahaz yi kɛ wo ma a mi; se a nyɛ we lɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Edom matsɛ ɔ ya kpɔ Elat kɛ ha Edom, nɛ e fie Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Elat ma a mi.
Edom bi ɔmɛ ba dumɔ Elat, nɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Ahaz tsɔ ya de Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ke, “O tsɔlɔ kɛ o binyumu ji mi.
Siria matsɛ, kɛ Israel matsɛ ba tua mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba nɛ o ba je ngmlaa ha mi.” Ahaz ya ngɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we nito he ɔmɛ; nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ ya ke Asiria matsɛ ɔ. Asiria matsɛ ɔ bu lɛ tue, nɛ e hia kɛ ya tua Damasko.
E ngɔ ma a, nɛ e gbe Matsɛ Rezin; se ma a mi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ e nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Kir ya.
Benɛ Matsɛ Ahaz, kɛ Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ya kpe ngɛ Damasko ɔ, e na bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Matsɛ Ahaz ngɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ henɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ mane osɔfo Uria.
Nɛ loko Matsɛ Ahaz je Damasko kɛ ba a, osɔfo Uria puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ henɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz ngɔ kɛ mane lɛ kɛ je Damasko ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Benɛ Matsɛ Ahaz je Damasko kɛ ba a, e na kaa a puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ta.
E sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ngɛ nɔ.
E sã wai bɔ, nɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ e kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, e fĩa e muɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ momo ɔ nɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ kɛ je e ma he ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ e bɔ sami la tɛ he ɔ a kpɛti ɔ, nɛ e kɛ ya ma e bɔ sami la tɛ he ɔ we omleyi je.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz fa osɔfo Uria ke, “Moo sã mɔtu sami bɔ, gbɔkuɛ niye ní bɔ, matsɛ sami bɔ, e niye ní bɔ, kɛ zugba a nɔ bimɛ tsuo a sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngua nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Moo sã wai bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sã sami bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpa amɛ a muɔ kɛ fĩa nɔ.
Se akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ lɛɛ mo si ha mi nɛ ma bi ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Osɔfo Uria pee kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Matsɛ Ahaz pee sisi daka amɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e je tsesi ɔmɛ ngɛ a nɔ.
Jehanɛ, e je akɔblee nyu nɔ́ ngua a kɛ je akɔblee na ku ɔmɛ a se mi kɛ ma tɛ nɔ ngɛ zugba.
Ahaz je nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a kɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa nɔ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hulɔ.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ sa Asiria matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Ahaz he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Ahaz ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi; nɛ e binyumu Hezekia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Israel matsɛ, Hoshea Yuda matsɛ, Ahaz yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, Ela binyumu Hoshea ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
E hi Samaria kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nɛɛ.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, se e yayami ɔ sui Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ a nɔ́ ɔ. E ba mi kaa Asiria matsɛ, Shalmaneser ba tua lɛ, nɛ Hoshea ba pee e sɔmɔlɔ, nɛ e tsuɔ tó kɛ haa lɛ.
Jeha ko mi ɔ, Hoshea tsu we tó kɛ ha Asiria matsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ daa jeha a; mohu ɔ, e tsɔ ya bi yemi kɛ buami ngɛ Egipt matsɛ, So ngɔ.
Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kaa atuã tsɔmi, nɛ e nu Hoshea ngɔ wo tsu.
A ye Samaria nɔ kunimi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ ya tua Israel zugba a tsuo; nɛ benɛ e su Samaria a, e sa ma a yi jeha etɛ.
Hoshea yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɔ Samaria, nɛ e muɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho Asiria ya.
E ngɔ ni komɛ ya to Hala, e ngɔ ni komɛ ya to Habor pa a nya ngɛ Gozan zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ni komɛ hu ya to Media bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ a mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba ji, Israel ma a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ kpɔ mɛ ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ.
A ya ja mawu kpahi.
Jehanɛ, je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ bɔni a kusumi níhi peemi; slo ma se kusumi kpahi nɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ ba a hulɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ pee níhi nɛ dɛ blɔ ngɛ laami mi kɛ si Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ.
A ma jami hehi ngɔ ha a he ngɛ kɔpekɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ ma ngua amɛ tsuo a mi.
A puɛ amagahi kɛ ha yo mawu Ashera a ngɛ yokuhi tsuo a nɔ, kɛ tsohi nɛ bɔ kusuu tsuo a sisi; nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo, kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A pee ní yayamihi kɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la.
A ja amagahi nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ mlaa ke a ko ja mɛ ɔ. Yawɛ gu gbali, kɛ ní nali a nɔ nɛ e kɛ slɔ Israel kɛ Yuda ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
I ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ kɛ gu ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Se a bui tete; a kuɛ wa kaa a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ he we Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ yi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A kua e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ somi nɛ e kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ, kɛ slɔmihi nɛ e slɔ mɛ ɔ.
A ya nyɛɛ yakayaka amagahi a se, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a plɛ pee yakayaka nimli.
Je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ mlaa ngɛ a he ke a ko pee a níhi kaa mɛ ɔ, a ya nyɛɛ jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ mohu a se.
Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ wo mɛ ɔ, a yi ekoeko nɔ; se mohu a ngɔ dade nɛ a sle kɛ pee na bi enyɔ kɛ ha a he.
A pee Ashera, nɛ a ja hiɔwe níhi tsuo; a ja Baal hulɔ.
A ngɔ a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi kɛ sã sami bɔhi, kɛ ha wɔhi.
A kla, a ye kunya, nɛ a je blɔ pee yayami nɛ a kɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e je e hɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ, ja Yuda wɛtso ɔ pɛ.
Yuda wɛtso ɔ nitsɛ po yi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Ma se kusumihi nɛ Israel kɛ ba a, lɔ ɔmɛ a he ní mɛ hu a tsuɔ.
Yawɛ kua Israel nina amɛ tsuo.
E ha nɛ a na amanehlu, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo ní hali a dɛ mi kɛ ya si e je e hɛ ngɛ a nɔ kulaa.
Benɛ Yawɛ tsɔ́ Israel kɛ je David we ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ wo Nebat binyumu Yeroboam matsɛ.
Yeroboam ha nɛ Israel kpa Yawɛ se nyɛɛmi, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ya wo yayami agbo mi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ya nyɛɛ Yeroboam se, nɛ a pee yayami tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ hluu kɛ ya si Yawɛ je e hɛ ngɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ e de to kɛ gu e tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ho Asiria ya; nɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Asiria bi ɔmɛ ba hi Israel Asiria matsɛ ɔ ya ngɔ nihi kɛ je Babilon, Kut, Ava, Hamat, kɛ Sefarvaim kɛ ba wo Samaria ma amɛ a mi ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nane mi.
Mɛ hu a ngɔ Samaria ngɔ pee a nɔ, nɛ a hi ma amɛ a mi.
Benɛ a ba lejɛ ɔ kekleekle ɔ, a ja we Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ jatahi ba sɛ a kpɛti, nɛ jata amɛ gbe a ti ni komɛ.
A ya bɔ Asiria matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ke, “Je ma amɛ nɛ o ya ngɔ kɛ ba wo Samaria ma amɛ a mi ɔ, a li zugba a nɔ mawu ɔ kɔhi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, zugba a nɔ mawu ɔ hu ha nɛ jatahi ba sɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a ngɛ mɛ gbee.” Asiria matsɛ ɔ fa ke, “Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ya nuu kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba a, nyɛ ha nɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ e kpale kɛ ho, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ zugba a nɔ mawu ɔ kɔhi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a wo Israel osɔfo kake blɔ kɛ je Samaria kɛ ho Betel ya, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ ha.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, je ma tsuaa je ma pee mawu ha a he, nɛ a ngɔ ya to jami hehi nɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ to ngɛ ma amɛ a mi he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. Je ma amɛ tsuo to a we amaga amɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. Babilon bi ɔmɛ puɛ amaga kɛ ha mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sukot Benot ɔ; Kut bi ɔmɛ puɛ amaga kɛ ha Nergal; Hamat bi ɔmɛ puɛ amaga kɛ ha Ashima; Ava bi ɔmɛ puɛ amaga kɛ ha Nibhaz, kɛ Tartak.
Sefarvaim bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ a bimɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ ha mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Adramelek kɛ Anamelek ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ jaa Yawɛ hulɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a hla ni komɛ kɛ je a kpɛti, nɛ a wo mɛ osɔfohi, konɛ a sã bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ha mɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ, nɛ a jaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a mawu ɔmɛ hulɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ hehi nɛ a je kɛ ba a.
A hɛɛ a blema kusumi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
A ja we Yawɛ, nɛ mlaa slɔɔtohi nɛ e wo Yakob nɛ e tsake e biɛ kɛ pee Israel ɔ nina a hu, a yi nɔ.
Yawɛ kɛ mɛ so, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ja mawu kpahi, nyɛ ko sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko sã bɔ ha mɛ!
Nyɛɛ ye imi Yawɛ mohu gbeye; ejakaa imi nɛ i kɛ he wami kɛ kɔni si wami je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛ ja mi, nɛ nyɛɛ sã bɔ kɛ ha mi.
Mlaa slɔɔtohi nɛ i ngma ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a nɔ daa.
Nyɛ ko ja mawu kpahi; somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ hu nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye; nɛ ma je nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a dɛ mi.” Se ni ɔmɛ bui Mawu tue, nɛ a ya nɔ kɛ a blema kusumi ní ɔmɛ a peemi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je ma nɛ ɔmɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ, nɛ a jaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a we amaga amɛ hulɔ.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee blema a, ja nɔuu nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ bibimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ pee kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia Israel matsɛ, Hoshea, Ela binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Ahaz binyumu Hezekia ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ nɛɛ.
E nyɛ ji Zakaria biyo Abiya.
Hezekia ya wo e nɛ̃ David nane, nɛ e ní peepee sa Yawɛ hɛ mi.
E gbɛ jami he ɔmɛ, nɛ e ywia amaga a nɛ a puɛ kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a, kɛ amaga kpa amɛ tsuo.
Akɔblee sinɔ ɔ nɛ Mose pee, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nehushtan ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu e ywia lɛ tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ; ejakaa kɛ ba si jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ jɔɔ we tsopa kɛ e he via sami kɛ ha akɔblee sinɔ ɔ. Hezekia ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nɔ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ lɛ sɔɛ.
E ngɔ e he ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ; e ye lɛ anɔkuale, nɛ mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose ɔ, e ye lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ hu piɛ e he, nɛ e yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
E tsɔ́ Asiria matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi atuã, nɛ e kua lɛ sɔmɔmi.
E gbe Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya pue Gaza kɛ e huza amɛ a nɔ tɔɔ, nɛ e kpata ma wawihi, kɛ ma nguahi tsuo a hɛ mi.
Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne nɛ ji Israel matsɛ, Hoshea, Ela binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Shalmaneser ba tua Samaria, nɛ e sa ma a yi.
Jeha etɛ se ɔ, e ngɔ ma a. Benɛ a ngɔ Samaria a, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Hezekia ná jeha ekpa momo ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ Israel matsɛ, Hoshea hu na jeha nɛɛ.
Asiria matsɛ ɔ nuu Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Asiria ya.
E ngɔ ni komɛ ya to Hala, e ngɔ ni komɛ ya to Habor pa a nya ngɛ Gozan zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ni komɛ hu ya to Media bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ a mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ha nɛ a ngɔ Samaria ji, Israel bi ɔmɛ bui Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ tue.
Somi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mɛ so, kɛ mlaahi nɛ e tsɔlɔ Mose wo mɛ ɔ, a tɔ lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A bui Mawu tue, nɛ e mlaa amɛ hu a yi nɔ.
Asiria wo Yerusalem he gbeye Matsɛ Hezekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib ba tua Yuda mahi tsuo nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ma amɛ.
Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia tsɔ ya de Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Lakish ke, “I tɔ o nɔ.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o je ye zugba a nɔ; tue gblami saisaa nɛ o ma ha mi ɔ, ma pee.” Asiria matsɛ ɔ sɛ ke a ya de Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia ke e ba ha lɛ sika hiɔ kilo akpe nyɔngma, kɛ sika tsu kilo akpe.
Hezekia ngɔ sika hiɔ nɛ e na ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e na ngɛ matsɛ we nito he ɔ tsuo kɛ mane lɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, Hezekia kplɔ sika tsu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ sinya amɛ a he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ lɛ Matsɛ Hezekia nitsɛ ngɔ kɛ ha sinya tso ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ mane Asiria matsɛ ɔ. Asiria matsɛ ɔ wo ta buli babauu blɔ kɛ je Lakish kɛ ya tua Hezekia ngɛ Yerusalem.
Senakerib we asafoatsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa etɛ ji a nyatsɛmɛ.
Benɛ a su Yerusalem ɔ, a ya da si ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ he nɛ bo loli ɔmɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ ɔ. Nyu dɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e mi lɛ nyu nɛ jee taku ɔ mi ngɛ yiti je ɔ guɔ.
Benɛ a bi Matsɛ Hezekia si ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɔli etɛ je kpo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba kpe.
Mɛ ji Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf binyumu ɔ nɛ ngmaa sanehi kɛ too ɔ. Asiria asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de mɛ ke matsɛ ngua nɛ ji Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e le nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ Matsɛ Hezekia heɔ e he yeɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. E bi ke, “O susu kaa nya puu nɛ a kɛ peeɔ ga kɛ hwuu ta lo?
Mɛnɔ nɔ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ loko o tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã a?
Ke o ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa Egipt ma ba piɛ o he ɔ, o ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ gla pee e dɛma tso; gla a maa ku nɛ e maa gbɔ e dɛ mi.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ngɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ baa e nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Asiria asafoatsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Aloo o ma de mi ke o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɔ?
Anɛ pi Yawɛ jami he ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Hezekia ywia, benɛ e de Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ke a ya ja Mawu ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ pɛ e hɛ mi ɔ lo?
I kɛ mo maa po nga ngɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ biɛ mi.
Ma ha mo okpɔngɔ akpe enyɔ kaa o ma na mo nitsɛ o nihi nɛ a hi a nɔ lo.
O ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ Egipt ba ha mo ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ tatsɛmɛ, be mi nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ nyafii pe kulaa a po o be lɛ nyɛe.
O susu kaa loko ma ba tua ma nɛ ɔ nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi ɔ, Yawɛ li he nɔ́ ko lo?
Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ e de mi ke ma ba tua ma a, nɛ ma kpata ma a hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ, kɛ Shebna, kɛ Yoa de Asiria matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ tu Aram gbi, ejakaa wa nuɔ.
O kɛ wɔ ko tu Hebri gbi, ejakaa ma a nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ yi mi ɔ ngɛ wɔ tue bue.” Se asafoatsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔɛ mi nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ munyu nɛ ɔ. Nimli nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu munyu nɛ ɔ kɔɔ a he; ejakaa a maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a fĩ, nɛ a maa nu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zami kaa nyɛ nɔuu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ te da si, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ, nɛ ji Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ɔ tue!
E ke, nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia nɛ sisi nyɛ; ejakaa Hezekia be nyɛe ma kpɔ nyɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia nɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ ko susu kaa Yawɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami, nɛ e be hae nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ nyɛ ma a. Nyɛ ko bu Hezekia tue.
Asiria matsɛ ngua a ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ba kpata.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye lɛ nitsɛ e wai kɛ ngmɔkɔ yiblii, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa nu lɛ nitsɛ e vu mi nyu kɛ yaa si be nɛ matsɛ ngua a ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya zugba ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ.
Wai ngmɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee wai; blɛfo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee abolo; oliv tsohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee nu; hwo gbakuhi hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee hwo.
Ke Hezekia mlɔɔ nyɛ nɛ e de nyɛ ke Yawɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami ɔ, nyɛ ko bu lɛ tue.
Anɛ je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ eko nyɛ kpɔ e ma kɛ je Asiria dɛ mi hyɛ lo?
Jije Hamat kɛ Arpad mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Jije Sefarvaim, Hena, kɛ Iva mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Anɛ a nyɛ kpɔ Samaria lo?
Je ma amɛ tsuo a mawu ɔmɛ eko nyɛ kpɔ e ma kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi hyɛ lo?
Lɛɛ mɛni haa nɛ o susuɔ kaa Yawɛ ma nyɛ ma kpɔ Yerusalem mɔ?” Se ma a pee dii, nɛ a de we nɔ́ ko, kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Hezekia fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, kɛ Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf binyumu ɔ nɛ ji sanehi ngmalɔ ɔ kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he; nɛ a ho ya bɔ Matsɛ Hezekia níhi tsuo nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ de ɔ.
Matsɛ Hezekia ya bi Yesaya ga womi Benɛ Matsɛ Hezekia nu amaniɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho hía e tade ɔmɛ.
E bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e ho Yawɛ we ɔ mi ya.
E tsɔ Eliakim, matsɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, kɛ Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ya gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ ngɔ.
Mɛ hu a bu kpekpe ya bo.
Sɛ gbi nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ ke a ya ha Yesaya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, wa yi fi; a jɛ wɔ, nɛ a pue wa hɛ mi si.
Wa pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi, se e be he wami nɛ e kɛ maa kɛ̃ bi ɔ kɛ je kpo.
Asiria matsɛ ɔ tsɔ e we asafoatsɛngua a kɛ ba jɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ. Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nu jɛmi munyu ɔmɛ, nɛ e maa gbla nihi nɛ tu munyu ɔmɛ a tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ ha wa ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Benɛ Matsɛ Hezekia tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ sɛ ɔ ya ha Yesaya a, lɛ hu e sɛ mɛ ke a ya de a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Yawɛ ke o ko ha nɛ munyu ɔ nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba tu kɛ si mi ɔ nɛ wo o he gbeye.
Yawɛ ma ha nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ maa nu akeake munyu ko, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya, nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Asiria bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba ekohu Asiria asafoatsɛngua a nu kaa Asiria matsɛ ɔ hia kɛ je Lakish nɛ e kɛ Libna bi ya ngɛ ta hwue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya ná lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko ba su Asiria matsɛ ɔ kaa Sudan matsɛ, Tirhaka hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ Egipt tabo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma nɛ e ba tua lɛ.
Benɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ nu sane nɛ ɔ, e ngma womi nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia.
Bɔ nɛ e ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ko ha nɛ o Mawu ɔ nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ nɛ mlɔɔ mo ke i be nyɛe ma ngɔ Yerusalem.
Mo nitsɛ o nu níhi nɛ Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee zugba amɛ, bɔ nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi butuu.
Nɛ moo lɛɛ o susuɔ kaa o maa ye o he lo?
Benɛ nɛnɛmɛ kpata Gozan, Haran, kɛ Rezef ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbe Beteden bi nɛ ngɛ Telasar a, anɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nyɛ a yi wami he lo?
Jije Hamat, Arpad, Sefarvaim, Hena, kɛ Iva matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ?” Hezekia he womi ɔ ngɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ nɛ e kane.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho Yawɛ we ɔ mi ya nɛ e ya bli womi ɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu lee, mo nɛ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a yi mi lokoo.
Mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o sisi.
Mo lɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba.
Yawɛ, mo bli o hɛngmɛ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ wɔ pee!
Yawɛ, mo ta tue nɛ o nu munyuhi nɛ Senakerib ngɛ tue kɛ ngɛ mo Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, o he guɛ gbee!
Yawɛ, wɔ tsuo wa le kaa Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpata je mahi, kɛ a zugbahi babauu a hɛ mi, nɛ a sã a mawu ɔmɛ.
A kpata a hɛ mi, ejakaa tsa pi mawu nitsɛnitsɛhi ji mɛ; nimlihi a nine nya ní tsumihi, kɛ tsohi kɛ tɛhi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, wa Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, konɛ je ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a le kaa mo Yawɛ, mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu.” Yesaya kɛ sɛ gbi mane Matsɛ Hezekia Kɛkɛ nɛ Amoz binyumu Yesaya tsɔ ke a ya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, kue nɛ o fa ha lɛ ngɛ Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib he ɔ, e nu.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Asiria matsɛ, Zion biyo yomiyo ɔ ngɛ mo muɔe oo!
E ngɛ o he fɛu yee.
Yerusalem biyo ɔ ngɛ e yi mimiɛe ngɛ o se.
Mɛnɔ he fɛu o ye ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ahlua o bɔ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ nɔ nɛ o wo nya nɔ ngɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ o bui ɔ?
Pi Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ lo?
O tsɔ o tsɔli kɛ ba ye Yawɛ he fɛu nɛ o de ke, ‘I ngɔ ye ta zugba lɛhi babauu kɛ kuɔ yoku ɔmɛ kɛ ya su Lebanon tɔɔ.
I poo Lebanon seda tso gagaá amɛ, kɛ sɛsɛo saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
I sɛ Lebanon hue kusuu ɔ mi kɛ ya tsitsaa lokoo.
I tsua vuhi, nɛ i nu ma se zugba nɔ nyu; i ngɔ ye nane sisi kɛ hlui Egipt pa amɛ tsuo a mi nyu ngɔ pue he.’ Anɛ o nui kaa i bɔni nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ní tsumi kɛ je kɛ lo?
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, i to he ga kɛ je blema lokoo, konɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mɛ ma dokuhi.
Nimli nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ lɛɛ a he wami nɔ gbɔ.
A tsui po, nɛ gbigbi gbe mɛ; a pee kaa nga mumu; a pee kaa nga nɔ tsohi, loo nga nɛ pu sãã lɛ nɛ e ngla ngɛ tsu yi kpɛti.
I le o he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; o kpo jemi kɛ o mi bami, kɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa.
Akɛnɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa, nɛ i nu o he nɔ womi hu he he je ɔ, ma ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo o gugwɔ mi, ma wo o nya mi dade; nɛ ma kpale mo kɛ maa gu blɔ nɛ o gu nɔ kɛ ba a nɔ.” Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Matsɛ Hezekia ke, “Enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi ha mo: jeha nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a puɛ, níhi nɛ nɔ ko du we.
Jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ puɛ ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a se.
Jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ma du ní nɛ nyɛ ma kpa ní; nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔhi nɛ nyɛ maa ye a yiblii ɔmɛ.
Yuda we ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a ma plɔke kaa tsohi; a ma tsɛ̃ sipoku kɛ ya zu mi ekohu, nɛ a maa wo yiblii.
Ni komɛ maa piɛ kɛ̃, nɛ a maa je Yerusalem kɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ba; ejakaa Yawɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘E be ma nɛ ɔ mi sɛe, nɛ e be kɛ̃ɛ̃ ko hu tsɛ̃e kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ. Ta buli nɛ hɛɛ tsɛi be ma a he sue, nɛ a be kpoku ko fiae kɛ wo ma a he.
Blɔ nɛ e gu kɛ ba a, jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ e maa gu kɛ kpale kɛ ho; se ma nɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ e be sɛe.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he, kɛ si nɛ i wo ye tsɔlɔ David he je ɔ, ma bu ma nɛ ɔ he; nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be a he sae.’ ” Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ko ya gbe ta buli akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ Asiria ta a mi.
E nɔ jena makɛ ɔ, ne mɛ nɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho Nineve ya.
Ligbi ko ɔ, benɛ e ngɛ e mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Nisrok ɔ jae ngɛ e mawu ɔ we ɔ, e binyumuhi enyɔ, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer ya gbe lɛ kɛ klaate, nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho Ararat zugba a nɔ ya.
E binyumu kpa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Esarhadon ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Matsɛ Hezekia ba nu hiɔ Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Hezekia ba nu hiɔ, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Moo to o níhi blɔ nya ngɛ o we ɔ, ejakaa o yi be wami nae; o ma gbo.’ ” Hezekia plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ wo gbogbo nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kai bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi ngɛ o hɛ mi, bɔ nɛ i ye mo anɔkuale, bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ mo kɛ ye tsui tsuo, kɛ bɔ nɛ i pee o suɔmi nya ní.” Nɛ Hezekia fo ya kɛ he hiami.
Yesaya je matsɛ ɔ he.
Se benɛ e na we nɛ e je kpo ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ kpɛti kue ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ de lɛ ke e kpale e se nɛ e ya de Hezekia, Yawɛ ma a ganɔ ɔ ke, “Imi Yawɛ, o nɛ̃ David Mawu ɔ, i nu o kue fami ɔ, nɛ i na o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ. Hyɛ, ma tsa mo, nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, o maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya Yawɛ we ɔ. Ma ngɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ kɛ piɛ o wami ligbi ɔmɛ a he ha mo.
Ma je o kɛ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi.
Jehanɛ, ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he, kɛ si nɛ i wo ye tsɔlɔ David he je ɔ, ma bu ma nɛ ɔ he.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesaya de matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wɛɛ ngmɔkɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya to e tslɔ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ e ma na he wami.” Hezekia bi Yesaya ke, “Mɛni okadi ma kɛ na kaa Yawɛ ma tsa mi niinɛ, nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ ma nyɛɛ kɛ ya Yawɛ we ɔ?” Yesaya he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ ma ha mo okadi nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ kaa si nɛ e wo mo ɔ, e maa ye nɔ.
Anɛ o suɔ kaa nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ ya e hɛ mi nane hiami nyɔngma, aloo e ba se nane hiami nyɔngma lo?” Hezekia he nɔ ke, “E wɛ kulaa kaa o ma ha nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ya e hɛ mi nane hiami nyɔngma; ha nɛ e ba se nane hiami nyɔngma.” Gbalɔ Yesaya fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ ɔ nɛ Matsɛ Ahab pee ɔ nɔ ɔ kpale kɛ ba se nane hiami nyɔngma.
Tsɔli nɛ je Babilonia Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Merodak Baladan, Baladan binyumu ɔ nu kaa Hezekia be he wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngma womi ngɔ piɛ nike ní he nɛ e tsɔ ke a ngɔ ya ha lɛ.
Hezekia he tsɔli ɔmɛ atuu, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a he jua wa ngɛ e nito he ɔmɛ, sika hiɔ, sika tsu, tsopa kɛ e he via, nu nɛ he jua wa, kɛ e ta hwumi níhi a tsu ɔ. Nɔ́ ko be e we ɔ mi, aloo e nɔ yemi he ɔ tsuo nɛ e tsɔɔ we mɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya ba Matsɛ Hezekia ngɔ nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, jije a je, nɛ mɛni a ba de mo?” Hezekia he nɔ ke, “A je Babilonia zugba a nɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.” Yesaya bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Mɛni a ba na ngɛ o we ɔ mi?” Hezekia he nɔ ke, “A ba na ye we ɔ mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; nɔ́ ko be ye nito he ɔmɛ nɛ i tsɔɔ we mɛ.” Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ ke, be ma nɛ a ma ba muɔ o we ɔ mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o nɛmɛ bua nya ngɔ to kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya; a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sie.
Yawɛ lɛ de.
A maa nuu mo nitsɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ po kɛ ya Babilonia; a maa puɛ mɛ, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ ngɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi.
Yawɛ lɛ de.” Se Matsɛ Hezekia susu kaa munyu nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa he jɔmi kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba ngɛ lɛɛ e yi nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Yesaya ke, “Yawɛ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ o ngɔ ba ha mi ɔ hi.” Hezekia matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe Hezekia he sane kpahi, kã nɛ e pee, kɛ taku nɛ e tsua, kɛ e he nyu dɔ nɛ e gba nɛ e kɛ tsɛ nyu kɛ ba ma a mi ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi womi ɔ mi.
Hezekia ba gbo, nɛ e binyumu Manase ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Manase Manase ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enuɔ kɛ enuɔ.
A tsɛɛ e nyɛ biɛ ke Hefziba.
Je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi ɔ, Manase ya nyɛɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a se, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Jami hehi nɛ e tsɛ Hezekia gbɛ ɔ, e kpale dla mɛ ekohu.
E ma bɔ sami la tɛhi kɛ ha Baal, nɛ e puɛ amaga kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a kaa bɔ nɛ Israel matsɛ, Ahab pee ɔ. E ja dodoehi hulɔ.
Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, he nɛ Yawɛ ke a ja lɛ pɛ ngɛ ɔ, Manase puɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi ngɔ ma kue enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a mi, konɛ a ja dodoehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
E ngɔ e binyumu kɛ sã sami bɔ; e kla, nɛ e tsu kunya, nɛ e kɛ kpade tsɛli, kɛ azetsɛmɛ bɔ.
E pee yayamihi babauu kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ e kɛ wo e mi mi la.
Ashera amaga a nɛ e pee ɔ, e ngɔ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Yawɛ kɛ David, kɛ e binyumu Salomo tu we nɛ ɔ he munyu hyɛ, nɛ e de ke, “I hla we nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ngɔ to kaa he nɛ sa nɛ a ja mi ngɛ daa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Israel bi ɔmɛ maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ, nɛ a maa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Mose wo mɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, i be hae nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ́ a kpale ya wo lalaalo hu.” Se Yuda ma a bui Yawɛ tue, nɛ Manase mlɔɔ mɛ nɛ a ya pee yayami nɛ kle kulaa pe yayami nɛ je ma amɛ pee loko Yawɛ kpata a hɛ mi kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi ɔ po.
Yawɛ tu munyu kɛ gu e tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Yuda matsɛ, Manase tsu musu ní; e pee yayami nɛ nya wa kulaa pe níhi tsuo nɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ pee ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, e ha nɛ Yuda ya ja amaga, nɛ a pee yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i kɛ amanehlu agbo ko maa ba Yerusalem kɛ Yuda a nɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu he ɔ, e he mi maa po.
Bɔ nɛ i gbla Samaria, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Ahab kɛ e we ɔ a tue ɔ, ja nɔuu ma pee Yerusalem.
Ma ha nɛ a maa muɔ nimli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je Yerusalem, nɛ Yerusalem ma a maa pee falifali kaa kã nɛ a fɔ mi nɛ a plɛ ngɔ bu si.
Ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ, ma kua mɛ, nɛ ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo a he nyɛli a dɛ mi.
A maa ye a nɔ nɛ a maa ha a níhi; ejakaa a pee yayami kɛ si mi, nɛ a wo ye mi mi la kɛ je be mi nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je Egipt ɔ hluu kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.” Ngɛ yayamihi nɛ Manase ha nɛ Yuda pee kɛ si Yawɛ ɔ se ɔ, e pue nihi babauu nitsɛ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko a muɔ si; nɛ Yerusalem he tsuaa he hyi kɛ muɔ.
Manase he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, níhi tsuo nɛ e tsu, kɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Manase ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Uza abɔɔ ɔ mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ; nɛ e binyumu Amon ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Amon Amon ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.
E nyɛ ji Meshulemet, Haruz nɛ je Yotba biyo ɔ. Amon pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ Manase pee ɔ. E ya wo e tsɛ nane ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, nɛ e ja amagahi nɛ e tsɛ ja a. E kua Yawɛ, e nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, nɛ e yi Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Matsɛ Amon tsɔli ɔmɛ so e yi nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi.
Se nihi nɛ so Matsɛ Amon yi nɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbe mɛ tsuo, nɛ a wo e binyumu Yosia matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Ní kpahi tsuo nɛ Amon pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
A pu Amon ngɛ e yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Uza abɔɔ ɔ mi; nɛ e binyumu Yosia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Yosia Yosia ye jeha kpaanyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kake.
E nyɛ ji Yedida, Adaya nɛ je Bozkat biyo ɔ. Yosia ní peemi níhi sa Yawɛ hɛ mi.
E ya wo e nɛ̃ David nane ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi mi, nɛ e ye Mawu mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ sisiisi.
A na mlaa womi ɔ Matsɛ Yosia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e tsɔ e womi ngmalɔ Shafan, Meshulam bi Azalia binyumu ɔ Yawɛ we ɔ; nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Hilkia ngɔ, nɛ e bu sika nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya a bua nya ngɛ ma a dɛ ɔ he akɔtaa ha mo.
De lɛ ke e ngɔ sika a kɛ ha ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a kɛ ha ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ dlae ɔ; mɛ ji tso he ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ tsu mali ɔmɛ.
A ngɔ sika nɛ ɔ eko kɛ he tso kɛ tɛ nɛ a kpɛ́, nɛ a kɛ dla Yawɛ we ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tu sika a ngɔ wo a dɛ mi ɔ, a kɛ mɛ ko pee akɔtaa; ejakaa a yeɔ anɔkuale.” Benɛ matsɛ pɛdiyo Shafan ngɔ matsɛ sɛ gbi ɔ ya ha Hilkia a, Hilkia de lɛ ke, “I na mlaa womi ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.” Hilkia ngɔ womi ɔ kɛ ha Shafan nɛ e kane.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Shafan, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ ho nɛ e ya bɔ Matsɛ Yosia amaniɛ ke, “O tsɔli ɔmɛ ya muɔ sika nɛ a na ngɛ we ɔ, nɛ a tu ngɔ wo ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ a dɛ mi.” Shafan ya nɔ nɛ e de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Osɔfo Hilkia kɛ womi nɛ ɔ ha mi.” Nɛ Shafan kane womi ɔ kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ. Benɛ Matsɛ Yosia nu mlaa womi ɔ mi munyuhi nɛ a ngɛ kanee ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho hía e tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e fa osɔfo Hilkia, kɛ Ahikam, Shafan binyumu ɔ, Akbor, Mikaya binyumu ɔ, Shafan, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ Asaya, matsɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya bi Yawɛ ga womi ha imi, kɛ Yuda ma a tsuo ngɛ kikɛmɛ a womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ a he.
Yawɛ mi mi fu wɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bui womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tue; nɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a ngma nɛ kɔɔ wa he ɔ hu a pee we.” Osɔfo Hilkia, Ahikam, Akbor, Shafan, kɛ Asaya pue nɔ kɛ ho Yerusalem ma he ɔ mi ya ya bi ní ngɛ gbalɔyo Hulda ngɔ.
(Hulda nɛ ɔ, sɔlemi we ɔ tadehi a nɔ hyɛlɔ Harhas binyumu Tikva hu binyumu Shalum yo ji lɛ.)
Benɛ a ya bɔ gbalɔyo ɔ nɔ́ nɛ ba a, e de mɛ ke a kpale kɛ ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ a ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ nɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ ɔ ya ha lɛ: “Ma gbla Yerusalem, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a tue kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ matsɛ ɔ kane ɔ mi ɔ.
A kua mi, nɛ a ya sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha mawu kpahi.
A kɛ níhi nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ tsuo wo ye mi mi la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e nya be si bae.
Yuda matsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ nyɛ ke nyɛ ya bi Yawɛ ga womi ha lɛ ɔ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ lɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: o nu sane nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ o pia o he, nɛ o ba o he si ha mi.
Benɛ o nu bɔ nɛ i to nɛ ma gbla Yerusalem, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tue, kɛ bɔ nɛ i to nɛ ma pee ma a ma doku, nɛ a ma tsɛ ma a biɛ kɛ gbiɛ nɔ ɔ, o kɛ aywilɛho hía o tade ɔmɛ, nɛ o fo ya.
Kue nɛ o fa ha mi ɔ, i nu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tue gblami nɛ i kɛ maa ba Yerusalem nɔ ɔ, moo lɛɛ o be nae kɛ o hɛngmɛ; ma ha nɛ o ma gbo, nɛ a maa pu mo ngɛ he jɔmi mi loko tue gblami nɛ ɔ maa ba.” Tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se, nɛ a kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Matsɛ Yosia.
Yosia gu amaga jami Matsɛ Yosia tsɔ ya kpee Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba; nɛ a kɛ mɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo, nimli wawihi kɛ nimli nguahi ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya.
Matsɛ ɔ ya kane mlaa womi ɔ nɛ a na a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E ya da titima a kasa nya, nɛ e kɛ Yawɛ so.
E ka lɛ kita ke e maa bu lɛ tue, nɛ e maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, kɛ e klaa tsuo; nɛ níhi nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ, e maa pee lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo wo si kaa a maa ye somi ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Yosia fa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Hilkia, kɛ osɔfo wawi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ agbo nya buli ɔmɛ ke a ya je níhi tsuo nɛ a kɛ jaa Baal, kɛ yo mawu Ashera, kɛ dodoehi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ ba.
Matsɛ ɔ ya sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Yerusalem ma a nya ngɛ Kidron kɔ̃ ɔ kasa nya, nɛ e ha a muɔ la zu ɔ kɛ ho Betel ya.
Osɔfohi nɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ wo nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ, ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ hehi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem kɛ kpe ɔ, Yosia kpa mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa Baal, pu, hlami, huɛhi, kɛ dodoehi hu e pee mɛ ja nɔuu.
E je amaga a nɛ a puɛ ngɔ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ e ya sã lɛ ngɛ Kidron kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem ma a nya.
E wɛɛ jakati ɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ bukɔbukɔ kaa la zu, nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ya fĩa gɔ ɔ mi.
E ywia ajuama amɛ a hi he ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Tade klɔii ɔmɛ nɛ a woɔ kɛ jaa Ashera a, lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ yi ɔmɛ loɔ ngɛ.
E ya ngɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je Yuda ma amɛ a mi kɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ a ba ble jami he ɔmɛ, hehi nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ ɔ, kɛ je Geba kɛ ya si Beersheba.
Jehanɛ, e gbɛ jami hehi nɛ ngɛ Yoshua nɛ ye amlaalo ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ e we ɔ agbo ɔ nya a. Jamɛ a osɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ba sɔmɔ we ngɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ Yerusalem, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a kɛ a nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ yeɔ abolo kplolo ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, Matsɛ Yosia ya ble Tofet, nɛ ji jami he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko ya sã e binyumu, loo e biyo bɔ kɛ ha Molek ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu.
Jehanɛ, okpɔngɔhi nɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hla ngɔ to kɛ ha pu jami ɔ, e je mɛ kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya; nɛ e sã zugba lɛhi nɛ a kɛ jaa kikɛmɛ a jami nɛ ɔ.
A toɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya, ngɛ tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma Natan Melek we ɔ kasa nya.
Bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ puɛ ngɔ ma Ahaz hiɔwe tsu ɔ yi mi, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ Manase puɛ ngɔ ma kue enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, Matsɛ Yosia ku mɛ dukuduku ngɔ pue si; nɛ e muɔ zu ɔ ya wo Kidron kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Yosia ble bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo puɛ ngɛ Yerusalem beleku je kɛ yaa Oliv yo ɔ leneyi je kɛ ha yakayaka amaga nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ: Sidon bi ɔmɛ a yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Astarte ɔ, Moab bi ɔmɛ a mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Kemosh ɔ, kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Milkom ɔ. Matsɛ Yosia ywia tɛ titimahi, kɛ amagahi nɛ a puɛ ha yo mawu Ashera a dukuduku; nɛ e ya muɔ nimli a wuhi kɛ ba pue a ma he ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Betel ɔ, kɛ jami he ɔ nɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam nɛ ha Israel pee yayami ɔ ma a, Yosia ku jamɛ a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ; e mɛ jami he ɔ he la, nɛ e ywia tɛ ɔmɛ dukuduku.
Amaga a nɛ a puɛ kɛ ha Ashera a hu e mɛ he la.
Jehanɛ, Yosia plɛ e he, nɛ e na yɔkɔ komɛ ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E ha a ya muɔ wuhi ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a ba sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ ble bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ munyu ɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ gba kɛ to benɛ Matsɛ Yeroboam daa si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he jamɛ a nyami ligbi ɔ. Benɛ Matsɛ Yosia hɛ gba Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ gba ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ to ɔ e yɔkɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e bi ke, “Mɛnɔ yɔkɔ i ngɛ hyɛe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ?” Betel ma mi bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ je Yuda a e yɔkɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ gba ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o pee bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ ngɔ to ɔ nɛ.” Yosia fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ e hi si; nɔ ko nɛ ko ta e wu ɔmɛ a he.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a si e kɛ gbalɔ ɔ nɛ je Samaria a a wu ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Janu gegu nɛ Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma ngɛ Samaria ma amɛ a mi nɛ a kɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la a, Yosia gbɛ mɛ tsuo, nɛ e pee bɔ sami la tɛhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Betel nɔ́ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E gbe osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ he nɛ a jaa ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e sã nimli a wuhi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Yosia ye Hetsɔmi ɔ Matsɛ Yosia fa ma a tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ.” A yi Hetsɔmi nyami be ko nɛ sɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ kɛ je be nɛ ma nya dali ɔmɛ ba hyɛ Israel ma a nɔ ɔ. Jehanɛ, Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi hu, a yi Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ko hyɛ nɛ sɔ kaa enɛ ɔ.
Se Matsɛ Yosia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, a ye Hetsɔmi nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Tsakemi kpahi nɛ Yosia pee Jehanɛ se hu, Matsɛ Yosia gu kpade tsɛmi, klaami, amagahi nɛ a kpɛ́, wɔhi, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee tsuo a jami ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda ma kpa amɛ a mi.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔ nɛ osɔfo Hilkia ya na ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, ma a nɛ a ye nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ Yosia sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ e tsui tsuo, kɛ e klaa tsuo, kɛ e he wami tsuo, nɛ e ye Mose mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ sɛ e hlami, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ, a ti nɔ ko kɛ lɛ sɔɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Yuda wawɛɛ nitsɛ ngɛ níhi nɛ Manase pee ɔ a he; nɛ kɛ ba si jamɛ a be ɔ, e mi mi fumi ɔ nya bɛ si.
Yawɛ de ke, “Ma kpata Yuda hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Israel ɔ; nɛ ma kua Yerusalem, ma nɛ i hla a, kɛ we ɔ nɛ i de ke lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i to nɛ a ja mi ngɛ ɔ.” Yosia matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe Yosia he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Benɛ Yosia ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, Egipt matsɛ, Neko hia ta ya je ngmlaa ha Asiria matsɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a nya.
Matsɛ Yosia hia ta nɛ e kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ya bua ngɛ Megido; nɛ e ba mi kaa Matsɛ Neko gbe lɛ ngɛ ta mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ e gbogboe ɔ wo ta zugba lɛ mi, nɛ a ya pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yuda ma a hla Yosia binyumu Yoahaz, nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ ɔ se.
Yuda matsɛ, Yoahaz Yoahaz ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ nyɔhiɔ etɛ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Hamutal.
Yeremia nɛ je Libna a biyo ji lɛ.
E ya wo e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Egipt matsɛ, Neko wo lɛ tsu ngɛ Ribla, ngɛ Hamat zugba a nɔ, nɛ e tsu tó sika hiɔ kilo akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ, kɛ sika tsu kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ ngɛ Yuda dɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ Yoahaz matsɛ yemi ɔ se po.
Matsɛ Neko wo Yosia binyumu Eliakim matsɛ ngɛ Yosia nane mi, nɛ e tsake e biɛ kɛ pee Yehoyakim.
Matsɛ Neko ngɔ Yoahaz kɛ ho Egipt ya, nɛ e ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim Matsɛ Yehoyakim tsu sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu ngɛ ma a dɛ kɛ ha Egipt matsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e fa lɛ ɔ. E gba tó nɛ ɔ tsumi kɛ ha ma a tsuo, nɛ e he sika a ngɛ a dɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a po ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ ke e wo ɔ. Yehoyakim ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kake.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Zebida.
Pedaya nɛ je Ruma a biyo ji lɛ.
Yehoyakim ya wo e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Benɛ Yehoyakim ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar hia ta ba tua Yuda.
Yehoyakim sɔmɔ lɛ jeha etɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔ atuã.
Yawɛ tsɔ Babilonia, Siria, Moab, kɛ Amon ta buli kɛ ho Yehoyakim ngɔ ya, konɛ a ya kpata Yuda zugba a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ gu e tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ de to ke e maa pee ɔ. Yawɛ lɛ ha nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e je Yuda ma a we ngɛ yayamihi nɛ Manase pee ɔ a he, titli ɔ, kaa e pue nihi babauu nɛ pee we nɔ́ yayami ko a muɔ si ngɛ Yerusalem.
Yawɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ Manase pee nɛ ɔ pɛ́ lɛ.
Yehoyakim he sane kpahi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Yi nɔ Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yehoyakim ba gbo, nɛ e binyumu Yehoyakin ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Jehanɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ pa nyɛ we nɛ e hia ta kɛ je Egipt hu, ejakaa Babilonia matsɛ ɔ kpɔ zugba amɛ tsuo ngɛ e dɛ, kɛ je Egipt Taku ɔ nya hluu kɛ ya si Yufrate pa a nya.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin Yehoyakin ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
