E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ nyɔhiɔ etɛ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Nehushta.
Elnatan nɛ je Yerusalem ɔ biyo ji lɛ.
Yehoyakin ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
E yi nɔ ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar tsɔli ɔmɛ hia ta kɛ ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya sa ma a yi.
Benɛ a sa ma a yi ɔ, Nebukadnezar nitsɛ ya Yerusalem, nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin nyɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he, e tsɔli ɔmɛ, e ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ ní tsuli ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ. Nebukadnezar yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e nu Yehoyakin nyɔguɛ, nɛ e muɔ junehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ kɛ ho Babilon ya.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to momo ɔ, sika tsu kãhi nɛ Israel matsɛ, Salomo pee nɛ a kɛ tsu ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, Nebukadnezar ywia mɛ dukuduku.
Nebukadnezar ngɔ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ, ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ kɛ je; mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a yibɔ ji akpe nyɔngma.
E nuu ga ní tsuli, kɛ sɔli tsuo kɛ je; nimli gu ɔmɛ nɛ be nɔ́ ko mi ɔ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ Yuda.
Nebukadnezar ngɔ Yehoyakin, kɛ e nyɛ, e yi ɔmɛ, e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya.
Jehanɛ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ta buli kpakpahi akpe kpaago, kɛ ga ní tsuli, kɛ sɔli hu akpe kɛ ho.
Katsɛmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ su ta yami nya ji nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.
Nebukadnezar wo Yehoyakin tsɛko Matania matsɛ ngɛ Yehoyakin nane mi; nɛ e tsake e biɛ ngɔ pee Zedekia.
Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia Zedekia ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kake benɛ e ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kake.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Hamutal.
Yeremia nɛ je Libna a biyo ji lɛ.
Matsɛ Zedekia pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yehoyakin pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yawɛ mi mi fu Yuda ma a, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ya si e je e hɛ ngɛ a nɔ.
Yerusalem hɛ mi kpatami Zedekia tsɔ atuã kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji nyɔngma a we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, Nebukadnezar kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo ba tua Yerusalem.
A sa ma a yi, nɛ a fia kpokuhi kɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe.
A sa ma a yi hluu kɛ ya si Matsɛ Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ. Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ, benɛ hwɔ ɔ nya ba wa nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ na we ní nɛ a ye ɔ, a ywia gbogbo ɔ nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia bi ɔmɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe mohu, se matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo nyɔ ɔ mi.
A gu matsɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi kɛ ya be ngɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ nya; nɛ a ngɔ a yi ngɔ ka Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi blɔ.
Babilonia tabo ɔ nyɛɛ Zedekia se nɛ a ya nu lɛ ngɛ Yeriko nga a nɔ; e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa kɛ je e he.
A ngɔ Zedekia ya ha Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ Ribla; nɛ lejɛ ɔ Nebukadnezar kojo lɛ nɛ e bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ.
A gbe Zedekia binyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ a ta e hɛngmɛhi, nɛ a bɔ lɛ pã; nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya.
A sã Yawɛ we ɔ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ ɔ, Nebukadnezar tatsɛ kɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nebuzaradan ya Yerusalem.
E ya sã Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a wehi, nɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ hule gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kú nigii kɛ ho Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya a, Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho Babilonia ya.
Se e si nimli gu komɛ nɛ be nɔ́ ko mi ɔ ngɛ Yuda, konɛ a hu ngmɔ, nɛ a tsu ní ngɛ wai abɔɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ywia akɔblee titima amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ akɔblee nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ kɛ e sisi daka amɛ; nɛ a muɔ akɔblee ɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya.
A muɔ buɛ ɔmɛ, sofi ɔmɛ, la gbemi ní ɔmɛ, tsopa kɛ e he via kã amɛ, kɛ akɔblee ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hu kɛ ho.
A muɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ pee ɔ, ngɛyu ɔmɛ, kɛ kã wawi ɔmɛ.
Akɔblee níhi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo pee kɛ wo Yawɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ ji titima enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ kɛ e sisi daka amɛ lɛɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ngmɛ, ejakaa akɔblee ɔ jiɔ tsɔ.
Titima enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ fiee; kake kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ kɛ ekpa, nɛ akɔblee kpɔ ngɛ eko tsuaa eko yi mi.
Kpɔ kake hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi ekpa, nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ya kɛ e mi nɔ́ ko kaa tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ tsɔwitsɔwihi kɛ mimlaa akɔblee kpɔ ɔmɛ.
A nuu Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya Tatsɛ ɔ ngɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Seraya kɛ e setsɔ, nɛ ji osɔfo Zefania, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ buli etɛ ɔmɛ hu nyɔguɛ.
Jehanɛ, nimli nɛ e ngɔ kɛ je ma a mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, matsɛ ga woli enuɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, asafoatsɛ ɔ setsɔ ɔ nɛ ji womi ngmalɔ nɛ buaa ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ yaa ta a, kɛ ma mi bi kpahi nyingmi ekpa.
Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Ribla.
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ fia mɛ ní nɛ e gbe ngɛ Ribla, ngɛ Hamat zugba a nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a pee kɛ ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yuda amlaalo, Gedalia Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar wo Ahikam binyumu Gedalia, Shafan bibi ɔ amlaalo ngɛ Yuda; nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to nihi nɛ a si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ngɔɛ mɛ kɛ yɛ Babilonia a a nya.
Benɛ Yuda asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a ngɔɛ a he ngɔ ha we ɔ nu kaa Babilonia matsɛ ɔ wo Gedalia amlaalo ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ba nɛ a ba piɛ Gedalia he ngɛ Mizpa.
Mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Netania binyumu Ishmael, Karea binyumu Yohanan, Tanhumet binyumu Seraya nɛ je Netofa a, kɛ Yezania nɛ je Maaka a. Gedalia ka asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a we bi ɔmɛ kita, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye Babilonia bi ɔmɛ gbeye.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ba hi zugba a nɔ nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hi ha nyɛ.” Se nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, Netania binyumu Ishmael, Elishama bibi ɔ nɛ je matsɛ weku ɔ mi ɔ, ngɔ nyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ ho ya tua Gedalia ngɛ Mizpa; nɛ a gbe lɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Israel bi, kɛ Babilonia bi tsuo.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo, ohiatsɛmɛ, niatsɛmɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ je kɛ ho Egipt ya; ejakaa a ngɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ gbeye yee.
A je Yehoyakin Jeha mi nɛ Evilmerodak ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Babilonia ma a nɔ ɔ, e na Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin mɔbɔ, nɛ e je lɛ ngɛ tsu mi.
Nɛ́ a nu Yehoyakin kɛ ya wo tsu ngɛ ma se ɔ, jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaagone ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago ɔ nɔ nɛ a je lɛ.
Evilmerodak kɛ Yehoyakin hi si saminya, nɛ e ha lɛ blɔ nya nɛ pe bɔ nɛ e pee matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ a ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ piɛ e he ngɛ Babilonia a. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngmɛ Yehoyakin blɔ nɛ e je pã mi tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he ngɔ pue si, nɛ e ya yeɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he daa ligbi kɛ ya si benɛ e gbo.
Jehanɛ se hu, matsɛ ɔ haa lɛ yemi kɛ buami sika ko daa ligbi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ be.
NYA TSƆƆMI Sanehi nɛ a ngma ngɛ Samuel womi ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, jamɛ a sane ɔmɛ nɔuu lɛ a plɛ mi nɛ a kpale ngma ngɛ Kronika womi ɔmɛ a mi.
Israel matsɛ yemi ɔ he sanehi nɛ a ngma ngɛ kronika womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nɔ́ enyɔ pɔtɛɛ komɛ a he lɛ a ngma ngɛ.
.
Kekleekle nɔ́ ji kaa amanehlu babauu ba Israel kɛ Yuda matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ a nɔ mohu, se si ko nɛ Mawu wo ma a, e ngɛ jamɛ a siwo ɔ nɔ yee kɛ mwɔɔ.
Yi mi nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha ma a, e ngɛ he ní tsue kɛ gu ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yuda a a nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ngma womi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ e kɛ yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he odase ji ní tsumi nguanguahi nɛ Matsɛ David kɛ e bi Salomo tsu, tsakemihi nɛ Yehoshafat, Hezekia, kɛ Yosia ngɔ kɛ ba, kɛ nihi nɛ ye Mawu anɔkuale kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ. .
Enyɔne ɔ, womi ngmalɔ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu jami je sisi ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, titli ɔ, bɔ nɛ a to blɔ nya kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ jami ɔ he.
Womi ngmalɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa Salomo ji nɔ nɛ ma Mawu we ɔ, se ngɛ blɔ komɛ a nɔ ɔ, David mohu ji nɔ nɛ to we ɔ sisi.
David ɔ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ to blɔ nya kɛ ha kusumi tsumi ngɛ we ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Weku kpahi kɛ biɛhi .—.
Saul gbenɔ .- David matsɛ yemi .—.
a. Haomihi nɛ ba David nɔ, kɛ níhi nɛ e tsu .—.
b. David dla kɛ ha Mawu we ɔ mami .—.
Kɛ je Adam nɔ kɛ ya si Abraham nɔ Adam bi ji Set, Set bi ji Enosh, Enosh bi ji Kenan, Kenan bi ji Mahalalel, nɛ Mahalalel bi ji Yared.
Yared bi ji Enok, Enok bi ji Metusela, Metusela bi ji Lamek, nɛ Lamek bi ji Noa.
Noa bimɛ ji Shem, Ham, kɛ Yafet.
Yafet bimɛ ji Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yavan, Tubal, Meshek, kɛ Tiras.
Gomer nina ji Ashkenaz bi, Rifat bi, kɛ Togarma bi.
Yavan nina ji Elisha bi, Spania bi, Kipro bi, kɛ Roda bi.
Ham bimɛ ji Kush, Egipt, Libia, kɛ Kanaan.
Kush nina ji Seba bi, Havila bi, Sabta bi, Raama bi, kɛ Sabteka bi.
Raama nina ji Sheba bi, kɛ Dedan bi.
Kush bi ji Nimrod; lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ he biɛ kaa nɔmlɔ ngua ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Egipt nina ji Lidia bi, Anam bi, Lehab bi, Naftu bi, Patrus bi, Kaslu bi, kɛ Kret bi (ni nɛmɛ a mi nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ je ɔ).
Kanaan bimɛ ji Sidon (e kekleekle bi ɔ), kɛ Het, nɛ e nina ji Yebus bi, Amor bi, Girgash bi, Hiv bi, Ark bi, Sin bi, Arvad bi, Zemar bi, kɛ Hamat bi.
Shem bimɛ ji Elam, Ashur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Geter, kɛ Meshek.
Arpakshad bi ji Shela, nɛ Shela bi ji Eber.
Eber ngɛ bimɛ enyɔ; a tsɛɛ nɔ kake ke Peleg, ejakaa e yi nɔ nɛ a gba nimli nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a mi kɛ wo gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ a mi.
Nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Yoktan.
Yoktan bimɛ ji Almodad bi, Shelef bi, Hazarmavet bi, Yera bi, Hadoram bi, Uzal bi, Dikla bi, Ebal bi, Abimael bi, Sheba bi, Ofir bi, Havila bi, kɛ Yobab bi.
Weku kpa nɛ ngɛ kɛ je Shem nɔ kɛ ya si Abraham nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Shem, Arpakshad, Shela, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Tera, kɛ Abram nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abraham hulɔ ɔ. Ishmael nina Abraham bimɛ ji Isak kɛ Ishmael.
Ishmael bimɛ ngɛ a wami nya ji Nebayot (Ishmael kekleekle bi ɔ), Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema, Yetur, Nafish, kɛ Kedema.
Abraham ngɛ plã ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ketura.
E kɛ lɛ fɔ bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ: Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, kɛ Shua.
Yoshan bimɛ ji Sheba kɛ Dedan.
Midian hu bimɛ ji Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida, kɛ Eldaa.
Esau nina Abraham bi ji Isak, nɛ Isak bimɛ ji Esau kɛ Yakob.
Esau bimɛ ji Elifaz, Reuel, Yeush, Yalam, kɛ Kora.
Elifaz bimɛ ji Teman, Omar, Zefi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, kɛ Amalek, nɛ Reuel bimɛ ji Nahat, Zera, Shama, kɛ Miza.
Edom zugba a nɔ kekleekle bi -Nihi nɛ hi Edom zugba a nɔ kekleekle ɔ a nɛmɛ ji Seir bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ: Lotan nɛ ji Hori kɛ Homam weku ɔmɛ a nɛ̃.
Lotan ngɛ nyɛmiyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Timna.
Shobal nɛ ji Alvan, Manahat, Ebal, Shefi, kɛ Onam a nɛ̃.
Zibeon nɛ ji Aya kɛ Ana a tsɛ.
Ana bi ji Dishon, nɛ Dishon ji weku nɛ ɔmɛ a nɛ̃: Hamran, Eshban, Itran, kɛ Keran.
Ezer nɛ ji weku nɛ ɔmɛ a nɛ̃: Bilhan, Zaavan, kɛ Yaakan.
Dishan nɛ ji Uz kɛ Aran weku ɔmɛ a nɛ̃.
Edom matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ -Loko a to matsɛ yemi sisi ngɛ Israel ɔ, nihi nɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ setsɔsetsɔ ji Bela, Beor bi ɔ nɛ je Dinhaba a Yohab, Zera bi ɔ nɛ je Bozra a Husham nɛ je Teman zugba a nɔ ɔ Hadad, Bedad bi ɔ nɛ je Avit ɔ (Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ye Midian bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ta nɛ a hwu ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ mi).
Samla nɛ je Masreka a Shaul nɛ je Rehobot ngɛ pa a he ɔ Baal Hanan, Akbor bi ɔ Hadad nɛ je Pau ɔ (E yo biɛ ji Mehetabel, Mezahab biyo Matred bi ɔ) -Benɛ Hadad gbo ɔ, wɛtsohi nɛ ngɛ Edom ji Timna, Alva, Yetet, Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel, kɛ Iram.
Yuda nina -Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Yuda, Isakar, Zebulun, Dan, Yosef, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad, kɛ Asher.
Yuda bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, mɛ ni enuɔ.
E kɛ e yo Batshua, Kanaan no ɔ fɔ binyumuhi etɛ.
Mɛ ji Er, Onan, kɛ Shela.
Er bitɛte ɔ, nɔmlɔ yayami ji lɛ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbe lɛ.
Yuda kɛ e nganyɛ Tamar hu fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ, Perez, kɛ Zera.
Perez bimɛ ji Hezron, kɛ Hamul.
E nyɛminyumu Zera ngɛ bimɛ enuɔ.
Mɛ ji Zimri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol, kɛ Darda.
Karmi bi Akan, Zera nina a kake ya ngɔ níhi nɛ a tsu he ngɔ ha Mawu ɔ eko; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ amanehlu ba Israel ma a nɔ.
Etan ngɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Azaria.
Matsɛ David weku kpa Hezron bimɛ ji Yerameel, Ram, kɛ Kaleb.
Bɔ nɛ weku kpa a ngɛ ha kɛ je Ram nɔ kɛ ya si Ishai nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ram, Aminadab, Nashon (Nashon nɛ ɔ, ganɔ ji lɛ ngɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi) Salmon, Boaz, Obed, kɛ Ishai.
-Ishai ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago.
A biɛhi ngɛ a wami nya ji Eliab, Abinadab, Shama, Netanel, Radai, Ozem, kɛ David.
A nyɛmimɛ yihi ji Zeruya, kɛ Abigail.
Ishai biyo Zeruya ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Abishai, Yoab, kɛ Asahel.
Abigail gba Yeter nɛ ji Ishmael nina a, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Amasa.
Hezron nina Hezron binyumu Kaleb ngɔ Azuba.
E kɛ lɛ fɔ biyo, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Yeriot.
Binyumuhi nɛ Azuba fɔ ji Yesher, Shobab, kɛ Ardon.
Benɛ Azuba gbo ɔ, Kaleb ngɔ Efrat, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hur.
Hur bi ji Uri, nɛ e bibi ji Bezalel.
Benɛ Hezron ye jeha nyingmi ekpa a, e ngɔ Makir biyo ɔ nɛ ji Gilead nyɛmiyo ɔ. E kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Segub.
Segub bi ji Yair.
Yair ngɛ ma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ngɛ Gilead zugba a nɔ.
Se Geshur kɛ Aram ya ngɔ ma nyingmi ekpa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; Yair kɛ Kenat kɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ hu piɛ he.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Makir nina ji mɛ.
Makir ji nɔ nɛ po Gilead ma a. Benɛ Hezron gbo ɔ, e binyumu Kaleb ngɔ e tsɛ Hezron yalɔyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Efrat ɔ. E kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Ashur.
Ashur ji nɔ nɛ po Tekoa ma a. Yerameel nina Yerameel, Hezron bitɛte ɔ ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Ram, e kekleekle bi ɔ, Buna, Oren, Ozem, kɛ Ahiya.
-Ram binyumuhi ji Maaz, Yamin, kɛ Eker.
Yerameel ngɛ yo kpa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Atara.
E kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumu, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Onam.
Onam binyumuhi ji Shamai, kɛ Yuda.
Shamai hu ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Nadab kɛ Abishur.
Abishur ngɔ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abihail, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Aban, kɛ Molid.
Abishur nyɛminyumu Nadab ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Seled, kɛ Apaim; se Seled na we bi nɛ e kɛ gbo.
Apaim bi ji Ishi, Ishi bi ji Sheshan, nɛ Sheshan bi ji Ahlai.
Yada, Shamai nyɛminyumu ɔ, e binyumuhi ji Yeter, kɛ Yonatan; se Yeter na we bi nɛ e kɛ gbo.
Yonatan ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ, Pelet kɛ Zaza.
Yerameel nina ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Sheshan be binyumu; biyihi pɛ lɛ ngɛ e dɛ.
E ngɛ tsɔlɔ ko nɛ je Egipt, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yarha; nɛ e kɛ e biyo kake ha lɛ.
Yarha kɛ Sheshan biyo nɛ ɔ fɔ binyumu, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Atai.
Bɔ nɛ weku kpa a ngɛ ha kɛ je Atai nɔ kɛ ya si Elishama nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Atai, Natan, Zabad, Eflal, Obed, Yehu, Azaria, Helez, Eleasa, Sismai, Shalum, Yekamia, kɛ Elishama.
Kaleb nina kpahi Yerameel nyɛminyumu Kaleb bitɛte ji Mesha.
Mesha bi ji Zif, Zif bi ji Maresha, nɛ Maresha bi ji Hebron.
Hebron ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Kora, Tapua, Rekem, kɛ Shema.
Shema bi ji Raham, nɛ Raham bi ji Yorkeam.
Shema nyɛminyumu Rekem bi ji Shamai.
Shamai bi ji Maon, nɛ Maon bi ji Betzur.
Kaleb ngɛ plã ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Efa.
Binyumuhi nɛ Efa fɔ ha lɛ ji Haran, Moza, kɛ Gazez.
Haran hu ngɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gazez.
(Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yadai ɔ hu ngɛ binyumuhi.
A biɛhi ji Regem, Yotam, Geshan, Pelet, Efa, kɛ Shaaf.)
Kaleb ngɛ plã kpa ko hu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Maaka.
Binyumuhi nɛ e kɛ lɛ hu fɔ ɔ, a biɛhi ji Sheber kɛ Tirhana.
Pee se ɔ, Maaka fɔ binyumu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ a he: Shaaf kɛ Sheva.
Shaaf ji nɔ nɛ to Madmana ma a sisi, nɛ Sheva hu to Makbena kɛ Gibea ma amɛ sisi.
Kaleb ngɛ biyo hulɔ; a tsɛɛ lɛ Aksa.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu Kaleb nina ji mɛ.
Kaleb kɛ e yo Efrat ɔ, a bitɛte ji Hur.
Hur bi Shobal ji nɔ nɛ to Kiriat Yearim ma a sisi.
E bi Salma ji nɔ nɛ to Betlehem ma a sisi.
E bi hu ji Haref, nɔ nɛ to Betgader ma a sisi ɔ. Shobal nɛ to Kiriat Yearim ma a sisi ɔ, e nina ji Haroe bi, kɛ Menuhot ma a fa.
E nina hu ji Kiriat Yearim weku nɛ ɔmɛ: Itri, Put, Shumat, kɛ Mishrait.
(Zora kɛ Eshtaol weku ɔmɛ piɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ a he.)
Salma nɛ to Betlehem ma a sisi ɔ, e nina ji Netofat bi, Atrot Bet Yoab bi, kɛ Zori bi.
Zori bi nɛ ɔmɛ ji Manahat weku ɔ fa.
Womi ngmali a nina nɛ hi Yabez ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Tirat bi, Shimeat bi, kɛ Sukat bi.
Mɛ ji Ken bi nɛ a kɛ Rekab bi ha a sibi gba.
Matsɛ David bimɛ -David binyumuhi nɛ a fɔ ha lɛ ngɛ Hebron ɔ, a biɛhi ngɛ a wami nya ji, Amnon, Yezreel yo Ahinoam bi ɔ Daniel, Karmel yo Abigail bi ɔ Absalom, Geshur matsɛ, Talmai biyo Maaka bi ɔ Adoniya, Hagit bi ɔ Shefatia, Abital bi ɔ Itream, Egla bi ɔ. Jeha kpaago kɛ fa a nɛ David ye matsɛ ngɛ Hebron ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi a fɔ bimɛ ekpa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
E ye matsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ etɛ, nɛ a fɔ binyumuhi babauu ha lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E kɛ e yo Batsheba, Amiel biyo ɔ fɔ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A biɛhi ji Shimea, Shobab, Natan, kɛ Salomo.
David ngɛ binyumu kpahi nɛɛ.
Mɛ ji Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Noga, Nefeg, Yafia, Elishama, Eliada, kɛ Elifelet.
David binyumuhi ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; slo e plã amɛ hu a bimɛ.
A ngɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tamar.
Matsɛ Salomo nina Matsɛ Salomo nina ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kɛ je tsɛ nɔ kɛ ya si bi nɔ: Salomo, Rehoboam, Abiya, Asa, Yehoshafat, Yehoram, Ahazia, Yoash, Amazia, Uzia, Yotam, Ahaz, Hezekia, Manase, Amon, kɛ Yosia.
Yosia ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A biɛhi ngɛ a wami nya ji Yohonam, Yehoyakim, Zedekia, Yoahaz.
Yehoyakim ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Yehoyakin kɛ Zedekia.
Matsɛ Yehoyakin nina Matsɛ Yehoyakin nɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ɔ, e nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yehoyakin ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Shealtiel, Malkiram, Pedaya, Shenazar, Yekamia, Hoshama, kɛ Nedabia.
Pedaya binyumuhi ji Zerubabel kɛ Shimei.
Zerubabel ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Meshulam kɛ Hanania.
A ngɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shelomit.
Zerubabel ngɛ binyumu kpahi enuɔ.
A biɛhi ji Hashuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia, kɛ Yushab Hesed.
Hanania ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Pelatia kɛ Yeshaya.
Yeshaya bi ji Refaya, Refaya bi ji Arnan, Arnan bi ji Obadia, Obadia bi ji Shekania.
Shekania ngɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shemaya, kɛ bibimɛ nɛ a biɛhi ji Hatush, Igal, Baria, Nearia, kɛ Shafat.
Nearia ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Elioenai, Hizkia, kɛ Azrikam.
Elioenai ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago.
A biɛhi ji Hodavia, Eliashib, Pelaya, Akub, Yohanan, Delaya, kɛ Anani.
Yuda nina Yuda binyumuhi ji Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur, kɛ Shobal.
Shobal bi ji Reaya, Reaya bi ji Yahat, Yahat bimɛ ji Ahumai, kɛ Lahad.
Zorat bi a nɛmɛ ji mɛ.
-Kaleb yo Efrat bitɛte ji Hur.
Hur nina ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ to Betlehem ma a sisi.
Hur ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Etam, Penuel, kɛ Ezer.
Etam binyumuhi a biɛhi ji Yezreel, Ishma, kɛ Idbash.
A ngɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hazelelponi.
Penuel to Gedor ma a sisi, nɛ Ezer hu to Husha ma a sisi.
Ashur nɛ to Tekoa ma a sisi ɔ ngɛ yihi enyɔ; nɔ kake biɛ ji Hela, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Naara.
Ashur kɛ Naara fɔ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Ahuzam, Hefer, Temeni, kɛ Haahashtari.
Ashur kɛ Hela hu fɔ binyumuhi.
A biɛhi ji Zeret, Izhar, kɛ Etnan.
Koz bimɛ ji Anub kɛ Zobeba; nɛ e nina ji weku ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ Harum binyumu Aharhel biɛ wo mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yabez ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ a buu pe e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
E nyɛ wo lɛ biɛ Yabez nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e fɔmi he ya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Se Yabez fa kue ha Israel Mawu ɔ ke, “Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbaa mi, nɛ o ha mi zugba nɛ kle.
O kɛ mi nɛ hi si, nɛ o je ní yayamihi nɛ maa pee haomi kɛ je ye blɔ mi.” Nɛ Mawu ha lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e bi lɛ ɔ. Wɛtso kpa komɛ Shuha nyɛminyumu Kaleb bi ji Mehir, nɛ Mehir hu bi ji Eshton.
Eshton ngɛ binyumuhi.
A biɛhi ji Betrafa, Pasea, kɛ Tehina.
Tehina ji nɔ nɛ to Nahash ma a sisi.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nina hi Reka.
Kenaz ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Otniel, kɛ Seraya.
Otniel bimɛ ji Hatat, kɛ Meonotai, nɛ Meonotai bi ji Ofra.
Seraya bi ji Yoab.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ to ga ní tsuli a kɔ̃ ɔ sisi; ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ga ní tsuli kpanakpanaa ji mɛ.
Yefune bi Kaleb ngɛ binyumuhi.
A biɛhi ji Iru, Ela, kɛ Naam.
Ela bi ji Kenaz.
Yehalelel ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A tsɛɛ mɛ Zif, Zifa, Tiria, kɛ Asarel.
-Ezra binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Yeter, Mered, Efer, kɛ Yalon.
Mered ngɔ Egipt matsɛ biyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Bitia, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ Miriam.
Mered kɛ Bitia fɔ binyumuhi hulɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Shamai, kɛ Ishba.
Ishba ji nɔ nɛ to Eshtemoa ma a sisi.
Jehanɛ, Mered ngɔ yo ko hu nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Yered, Heber, kɛ Yekutiel.
Yered ji nɔ nɛ to Gedor ma a sisi.
Heber lɛɛ e to Soko ma a sisi, nɛ Yekutiel to Zanoa ma a sisi.
Hodia ngɔ Naham nyɛmiyo.
A nina ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ to Garm kɛ Maakat weku ɔmɛ sisi.
Garm weku ɔ hi Keila ma a mi, nɛ Maakat weku ɔ hi Eshtemoa ma a mi.
Shimon ngɛ binyumuhi.
A biɛhi ji Amnon, Rina, Benhanan, kɛ Tilon.
Ishi hu ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Zohet, kɛ Benzohet.
Shela nina -Shela ji Yuda binyumu ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
E nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Er, nɔ nɛ to Leka ma a sisi ɔ, Laada, nɔ nɛ to Meresha ma a sisi ɔ, kploba loli a weku ɔ nɛ hi Bet Ashbea a, Yokim, Kozeba weku ɔmɛ, Yoash kɛ Saraf, nɔ nɛ ngɔ Moab yihi nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ Moab, nɛ lɔ ɔ se loko e ba hi Betlehem ɔ.
(Blema lokoo sanehi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.)
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, buɛ puɛli ji mɛ, nɛ a tsuɔ ní ha matsɛ ɔ.
A hi Netaim kɛ Gedera ma amɛ a mi.
Simeon nina Simeon ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Nemuel, Yamin, Yarib, Zera, kɛ Shaul.
Shaul bi ji Shalum, e bibi ji Mibsam, nɛ e bibimibi ji Mishma.
Mishma nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: e bi Hamuel, e bibi Zakur, kɛ e bibimibi Shimei.
Shimei ngɛ binyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ ekpa, kɛ biyihi ekpa.
Se e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a bimɛ pi, nɛ Simeon wɛtso ɔ hu bɔɛ kaa Yuda wɛtso ɔ. Kɛ ba si Matsɛ David be ɔ mi ɔ, mahi nɛ Simeon nina amɛ hi a mi ji Beersheba, Molada, Hazarshaul, Bilha, Ezem, Tolad, Betuel, Horma, Ziklag, Bet Markabot, Hazarsusim, Betbiri, kɛ Shaaraim.
-A hi ma kpa enuɔ komɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ hu a mi.
Ma amɛ ji Etam, Ain, Rimon, Token, kɛ Ashan.
Ni komɛ hu hi Baalat tɔɔ.
Sanehi nɛ a ngma kɛ to nɛ kɔɔ a weku ɔmɛ a he, kɛ he slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a hi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
-A weku nikɔtɔmahi ji: Meshobab, Yamlek, Amazia bi Yosha, Yoel, Yehu (Asiel bi Seraya bi Yoshibia bi ɔ), Elioenai, Yaakoba, Yeshohaya, Asaya, Adiel, Yesimiel, Benaya, kɛ Ziza (Shemaya bi Shimri bi Yedaya bi Alon bi Shifi bi ɔ).
Akɛnɛ a weku ɔmɛ a he ba bɔni hiɛmi he je ɔ, a hia nyɛɛmi kɛ gu bonyoku je kɛ ya si Gerar, nɛ a ya hla niye ní kɛ ha a lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ beleku je.
A ya ná zugba ko nɛ fɔɔ si gbajaa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Zugba a hi saminya kɛ ha lohwe lɛmi; e nɔ jɔ, nɛ tue mi jɔmi hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ham nina ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ sa a. Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia yi nɔ ɔ, nihi nɛ a wo a biɛ ta nɛ ɔ ya Gerar nɛ a ya gbɛ lejɛ ɔ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a bo tsuhi, nɛ a kpata Meun bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
A fie ni ɔmɛ kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa niye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ha a lohwe ɔmɛ.
Simeon wɛtso mi bi lafa enuɔ hu pue nɔ kɛ ho Edom ma a beleku je ya.
Ishi binyumu ɔmɛ ji nikɔtɔmahi nɛ nyɛɛ a hɛ mi.
A biɛhi ji Pelatia, Nearia, Refaya, kɛ Uziel.
Benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ, a gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
Ruben nina - Ruben ji Yakob kekleekle bi.
Se akɛnɛ e ble e tsɛ sa kaa e kɛ e tsɛ plã ya hwɔ si he je ɔ, a kpɔ e bitɛte blɔ nya a ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ a kɛ ha Yosef bimɛ ɔmɛ.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e biɛ be weku kɛ nina a womi ɔ mi kaa lɛ ji Yakob kekleekle bi.
Se Yuda wɛtso ɔ mohu lɛ ba bɔ wawɛɛ pe wɛtso kpa amɛ tsuo, nɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ hu mi nɛ ganɔ je kɛ ye tsɛ kɛ ha Israel ma a tsuo.
Ruben, Yakob bitɛte ɔ ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Hanok, Palu, Hezron, kɛ Karmi.
- Yoel nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yoel bi ji Shemaya.
Shemaya bi ji Gog, Gog bi ji Shimei, Shimei bi ji Mika, Mika bi ji Reaya, Reaya bi ji Baal, nɛ Baal bi ji Beera.
Asiria tatsɛ kpanaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tiglat Pileser ɔ ba nɛ e ba nu Beera kɛ ho.
Beera nɛ ɔ, nɔkɔtɔma ji lɛ ngɛ Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi.
Beera nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
A nyatsɛmɛ ji Yeyel, Zakaria, kɛ Bela (Yoel bi Shema bi Aza bi ɔ).
A hi Aroer, nɛ a zugba a fɔ si kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si Nebo kɛ Baal Meon tɔɔ.
A ngɛ lohwe babauu ngɛ Gilead zugba a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hi Gilead beleku je ɔ kɛ ya si nga a nɔ, kɛ Yufrate pa a nya.
Matsɛ Saul yi nɔ ɔ, Ruben bi ɔmɛ ya tua Hagri bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ hwu ta.
A gbe Hagri bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpɔ a zugba a nɛ ngɛ Gilead beleku je ɔ, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ. Gad nina Gad wɛtso ɔ hi Ruben wɛtso ɔ we omleyi je, kɛ je Bashan zugba a nɔ kɛ ya si Saleka ngɛ beleku je.
Yoel ji weku nɛ a buu pe kulaa a nyatsɛ.
Shafan ji weku nɛ nyɛɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ a nyatsɛ.
Bashan weku kpa komɛ hu a nyatsɛmɛ ji Yanai kɛ Shafat.
Wɛtso ɔ mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a je weku kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: Mikael weku, Meshulam weku, Sheba weku, Yorai weku, Yakan weku, Zia weku, kɛ Eber weku.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji Huri bi Abihail nina, nɛ a nɛmɛ ji Abihail, Huri, Yaroa, Gilead, Mikael, Yeshishai, Yaroa, kɛ Buz.
Abdiel binyumu Ahi, Guni bibi ɔ ji weku nɛ ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
A hi Bashan zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Gilead, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle Gilead, kɛ kɔpehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Sharon.
A bua sane nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nya ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yotam, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam a be ɔmɛ a mi.
Beleku je wɛtso ɔmɛ a tabo Ta buli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa kpaago kɛ nyingmi ekpa ngɛ Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a a mi.
A je blɔ tsɔse mɛ, nɛ a le tsɛ̃i, klaate, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ a he ní tsumi saminya.
A kɛ Hagri bi, nɛ ji Yetur, Nafish, kɛ Nodab wɛtso ɔmɛ ya hwu ta.
A ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ a fa kue ha lɛ ke e piɛ a he.
Mawu bu a kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ e ha nɛ a ye Hagri bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a he piɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A nuu a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a we afukpɔngɔ akpe nyingmi enuɔ, jijɔ akpe lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ, teji akpe enyɔ, kɛ ta buli akpe lafa kɛ ho.
A gbe he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu, ejakaa ta a, Mawu nine ngɛ mi.
Nɛ a hi jamɛ a zugba a nɔ hluu kɛ ya si be nɛ a je Asiria nɛ a ba nuu mɛ kɛ ho.
Manase wɛtso fa a Manase wɛtso fa a hi zugba a nɔ, kɛ je Bashan kɛ ya si Baal Hermon, Senir, kɛ Hermon yo ɔ he tɔɔ ngɛ omleyi je.
A he hiɛ babauu.
A weku ɔmɛ a nya dali ji Efer, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Yeremia, Hodavia, kɛ Yadiel.
Ta buli katsɛmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi nɛ a le mɛ saminya ngɛ weku ɔmɛ a mi ji mɛ tsuo.
A nuu beleku je wɛtso ɔmɛ Se Manase wɛtso fa a ya yi a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ anɔkuale.
A je a Mawu ɔ se, nɛ a ya ja je ma amɛ nɛ Mawu fie kɛ je a blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ mohu a mawu ɔmɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Israel Mawu ɔ ha nɛ Asiria matsɛ, Pul (nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Tiglat Pileser a) ba tua a ma a. Tiglat Pileser nuu Ruben, Gad, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya to Hala, Habor, Hara, kɛ Gozan pa a nya.
Nɛ lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma pe kulaa amɛ a weku kpa Levi ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Gershon, Kohat, kɛ Merari.
Kohat binyumuhi ji Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel.
Amram binyumuhi ji Aaron kɛ Mose.
E ngɛ biyo hu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Miriam.
Aaron binyumuhi ji Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar.
Eleazar nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Finehas, Abishua, Buki, Uzi, Zerahia, Merayot, Amaria, Ahitub, Zadok, Ahimaaz, Azaria, Yohanan, Azaria (nɔ nɛ ye osɔfo ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ Matsɛ Salomo ma ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ), Amaria, Ahitub, Zadok, Shalum, Hilkia, Azaria, Seraya, kɛ Yehozadak.
Benɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ Nebukadnezar ba nuu nihi nɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem kɛ ho ɔ, Yehozadak hu piɛ a he.
Levi nina kpahi Levi binyumuhi ji Gershon, Kohat, kɛ Merari.
Gershon bimɛ ji Libni kɛ Shimei.
Kohat bimɛ ji Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel.
Merari bimɛ ji Mahli kɛ Mushi.
Gershon nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Libni, Yahat, Zima, Yoa, Ido, Zera, kɛ Yeaterai.
Kohat nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Aminadab, Kora, Asir, Elkana, Ebiasaf, Asir, Tahat, Uriel, Uzia, kɛ Shaul.
Elkana ngɛ bimɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Amasai kɛ Ahimot.
Ahimot nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Elkana, Zofai, Nahat, Eliab, Yeroham, kɛ Elkana.
Samuel bimɛ ji Yoel, e bitɛte ɔ, kɛ e senɔ Abiya.
Merari nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uza, Shimea, Hagai, kɛ Asaya.
Yawɛ we ɔ mi lali Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ David ngɔ la he blɔ nya tomi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ngɔ wo a dɛ, benɛ a kɛ somi daka a ya su lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ a tsu lami ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a to blɔ nya ha mɛ ke a pee ɔ, kɛ ya si be nɛ Matsɛ Salomo ma Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a nina ji nihi nɛ tsu ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kekleekle lali a kuu ɔ, a nya dalɔ ji Heman.
Heman je Kohat weku ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɛ ji Yoel.
Bɔ nɛ Heman weku kpa a nyɛɛ senyasenya kɛ ya si Yakob nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Heman, Yoel, Samuel, Elkana, Yeroham, Eliel, Toa, Zuf, Elkana, Mahat, Amasai, Elkana, Yoel, Azaria, Zefania, Tahat, Asir, Ebiasaf, Kora, Izhar, Kohat, Levi, kɛ Yakob.
Lali a kuu enyɔne ɔ, a nya dalɔ ji Asaf.
Asaf je Gershon weku ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɛ ji Berekia.
Bɔ nɛ Asaf weku kpa a nyɛɛ senyasenya kɛ ya si Levi nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Asaf, Berekia, Shimea, Mikael, Baaseya, Malkiya, Etni, Zera, Adaya, Etan, Zima, Shimei, Yahat, Gershon, kɛ Levi.
Lali a kuu etɛne ɔ, a nya dalɔ ji Etan.
Etan je Merari weku ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɛ ji Kishi.
Bɔ nɛ Etan weku kpa a nyɛɛ senyasenya kɛ ya si Levi nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Etan, Kishi, Abdi, Maluk, Hashabia, Amazia, Hilkia, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, kɛ Levi.
A nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a dla ní tsumi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ ha.
Aaron nina Aaron kɛ e nina lɛɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a sã sami bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a to blɔ nya kɛ ha jami ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. Mɛ nɔuu ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ daa Israel ma a tsuo nane mi kɛ sãã kpatami bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔlɔ Mose fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Aaron nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Eleazar, Finehas, Abishua, Buki, Uzi, Zerahia, Merayot, Amaria, Ahitub, Zadok, kɛ Ahimaaz.
He nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ hi Aaron nina nɛ ji Kohat weku ɔ, zugba nɛ a ha mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ a fɔ sɔ ngɛ zugba a nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Kohat weku ɔ ji kekleekle weku nɛ a na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́.
A ha mɛ Hebron ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ ji lohwe lɛmi hehi nɛ bɔle ma a.
Se ngmɔhi, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ ngɛ Hebron ɔ, a kɛ lɔ ɔmɛ ha Yefune bi Kaleb.
-Mahi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ha Aaron nina kɛ piɛ Hebron he ji wesa he ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ: Libna, Yatir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, kɛ Bet Shemesh.
A ha Kohat weku ɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ kɛ je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ zugba mi: Geba, Alemet, kɛ Anatot.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mahi tsuo nɛ a ha Kohat weku ɔ nɛ a hi mi ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ.
Jehanɛ, a fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba kɛ ha Kohat bi nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɛ a na ma nyɔngma kɛ je Manase wɛtso fa a zugba mi.
A ha Gershon weku ɔ ma nyɔngma kɛ etɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ngɛ Bashan zugba a nɔ kɛ je wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a zugba mi: Isakar, Asher, Naftali, kɛ Manase fa a. Merari weku ɔ hu, a ha mɛ ma nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya kɛ je wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a zugba mi: Ruben, Gad, kɛ Zebulun.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gu kɛ dla mahi, kɛ a he kɔpehi kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a hi mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
(Mahi nɛ a ha Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ, Simeon wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Benyamin wɛtso fa a mi ɔ, a fɔ sɔ kɛ hla jamɛ a ma amɛ.)
-Efraim wɛtso ɔ ha Kohat bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ wesa he ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ: Shekem ngɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ, Gezer, Yokmeam, Bet Horon, Aiyalon, kɛ Gat Rimon.
Jehanɛ, Manase wɛtso fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ hu ha Kohat bi ɔmɛ Aner, Bileam kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ.
Wesa he mahi, kɛ a he kɔpehi nɛ Manase wɛtso fa a ha Gershon weku ɔ ji Golan ngɛ Bashan, kɛ Ashtarot.
Isakar wɛtso ɔ ha mɛ Kedesh, Daberat, Ramot, Anbem, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ.
Asher wɛtso ɔ ha mɛ Abdom, Mashal, Hukok, Rehob, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ.
Naftali wɛtso ɔ ha mɛ Kedesh ngɛ Galilea, Hamon, Kiriataim, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ.
Zebulun wɛtso ɔ ha Merari bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ: Rimono, kɛ Tabor.
-Ruben wɛtso ɔ ha mɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a he kɔpehi ngɛ Yordan pa a se ngɛ Yeriko Bezer ngɛ nga a nɔ: Yaza, Kedemot, kɛ Mefaat.
Gad wɛtso ɔ ha mɛ Ramot ngɛ Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, Yazer, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ.
Isakar nina Isakar ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A biɛhi ji Tola, Pua, Yashub, kɛ Shimron.
Tola ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Uzi, Refaya, Yeriel, Yamai, Ibsam, kɛ Shemuel.
Ta buli katsɛmɛ, kɛ we puɔ nya dali ji mɛ ngɛ Tola weku ɔ mi.
Matsɛ David yi nɔ ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.
Uzi binyumu ji Izrahia.
Izrahia binyumuhi ji Mikael, Obadia, Yoel, kɛ Ishia.
We puɔ nya dali ji mɛ ni enuɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
A ngɔ yihi fuu nɛ a fɔ bimɛ hu babauu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a na ta buli akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ ekpa kɛ je a kpɛti kɛ ha ta yami.
Nyumuhi nɛ a kane mɛ ngɛ Isakar weku ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ kpaago; ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo.
Benyamin kɛ Dan a nina Benyamin ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ.
A biɛhi ji Bela, Beker, kɛ Yediael.
Bela ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Ezbon, Uzi, Uziel, Yerimot, kɛ Iri.
We puɔ nya dali, kɛ ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo ngɛ weku ɔ mi.
A nina nɛ a kane ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ.
Beker ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Zemira, Yoash, Eliezer, Eleoenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abiya, Anatot, kɛ Alemet.
Beker bimɛ ji mɛ tsuo.
Benɛ a kane a nina weku nya weku nya a, a hiɛmi ji katsɛmɛ akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ.
Yediael bi ji Bilhan.
Bilhan ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago.
A biɛhi ji Yeush, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Zetan kɛ Tarshish, kɛ Ahishahar.
We puɔ nya dali, kɛ ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo ngɛ weku ɔ mi.
Benɛ a kane a nina weku nya weku nya a, a hiɛmi ji ta buli katsɛmɛ akpe nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ.
Ir bimɛ ji Shupim kɛ Hupim.
Dan ngɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hushim.
Naftali nina Naftali ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Yaziel, Guni, Yezer, kɛ Shalum.
Bilha nina ji mɛ.
Manase nina Manase kɛ e plã a nɛ je Aram ɔ fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ; nɔ kake biɛ ji Asriel, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Makir.
Makir bi ji Gilead.
Makir ngɔ yo kɛ ha Hupim, nɛ e ngɔ kake hu kɛ ha Shupim.
Makir nyɛmiyo ji Maaka.
Makir binyumu enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji Zelofehad.
Zelofehad lɛɛ biyihi sɔuu e fɔ.
Makir kɛ e yo, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Maaka a fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ.
A wo nɔ kake biɛ ke Peresh, nɛ a wo nɔ kake hu biɛ ke Sheresh.
Peresh ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Ulam kɛ Rakem, nɛ Ulam binyumu ji Bedan.
Makir bi Gilead, Manase bibi ɔ, e nina ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Gilead nyɛmiyo Hamoleket fɔ binyumuhi etɛ.
A biɛhi ji Ishod, Abiezer, kɛ Mahla.
(Shemida binyumuhi ji Ahian, Shekem, Likhi, kɛ Aniam.)
Efraim nina Efraim bi Shutela fɔ Bered, nɛ Bered fɔ Tahat, Tahat fɔ Eleada, Eleada fɔ Tahat, Tahat fɔ Zabad, nɛ Zabad fɔ Shutela.
Efraim ngɛ binyumu kpahi kɛ piɛ Shutela he; nɔ kake biɛ ji Ezer, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Elead.
Be ko mi ɔ, Ezer kɛ Elead ka kaa a maa ju Gat bi a na, nɛ Gat bi ɔmɛ gbe mɛ.
A tsɛ Efraim nyɛ ya ha mɛ ligbi babauu, nɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba jɔɔ e bua.
Pee se ɔ, e kɛ e yo ɔ na bɔmi ekohu; yo ɔ ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
A wo lɛ biɛ ke Beria, ngɛ haomi nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ he.
Efraim ngɛ biyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sheera.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ to ma nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi: yiti je Bet Horon, dɔ si je Bet Horon, kɛ Uzen Sheera.
Efraim ngɛ binyumu hulɔ; a tsɛɛ lɛ Refa.
Refa fɔ Reshef, Reshef fɔ Tela, Tela fɔ Tahan, Tahan fɔ Ladan, Ladan fɔ Emihud, Amihud fɔ Elishama, Elishama fɔ Nun, Nun fɔ Yoshua.
Zugba nɛ a nine su nɔ nɛ a hi nɔ ji Betel, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma a, kɛ ya si Naaran ngɛ beleku je, kɛ Gezer, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma a ngɛ bonyoku je.
Shekem kɛ Aya, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ zugba a mi.
Mahi, kɛ a he kɔpehi nɛ Manase nina a na ji Bet Shan, Taanak, Megido, kɛ Dor.
Yakob binyumu Yosef nina ji nihi nɛ hi ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.
Asher nina Asher nina ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Asher ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi, kɛ Beria.
E ngɛ biyo kake hulɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sera.
Beria ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Heber, kɛ Malkiel.
Malkiel ji nɔ nɛ to Birzait ma a sisi.
Heber ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Yaflet, Shomer, kɛ Hotam; a ngɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shua.
Yaflet hu ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Pasak, Bimhal, kɛ Ashvat.
Yaflet nyɛminyumu Shomer binyumuhi ji Roga, Yehuba, kɛ Aram.
Shomer nyɛminyumu Hotam hu ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Zofa, Imna, Shelesh, kɛ Amal.
Zofa nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Sua, Harnefer, Shual, Beri, Imra, Bezer, Hod, Shama, Shilsha, Itran, kɛ Beera.
Yeter nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Yefune, Pispa, kɛ Ara.
Ula nina ji Ara, Haniel, kɛ Rizia.
Asher nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
We puɔ nya dali, ta buli katsɛmɛ, kɛ ganɔhi nɛ ngɛ biɛ ji mɛ tsuo.
Nyumuhi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ ekpa nɛ le ta hwumi piɛ Asher nina a he.
Benyamin nina Benyamin ngɛ binyumuhi enuɔ.
E bitɛte ɔ biɛ ji Bela.
Bela senihi ngɛ a wami nya ji Ashbel, Ahara, Noha, kɛ Rafa.
Bela nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Adar, Gera, Abihud, Abishua, Naaman, Ahoa, Gera, Shefufan, kɛ Huram.
-Ehud nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Naaman, Ahiya, kɛ Gera.
We puɔ nya dali ji mɛ ngɛ Geba.
Se a nuu mɛ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho Manahat ya.
Gera ji nɔ nɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
E binyumuhi ji Uza kɛ Ahihud.
-Shaharaim ngmɛɛ e yihi enyɔ a he; a tsɛɛ nɔ kake ke Hushim, nɛ a tsɛɛ nɔ kake hu ke Baara.
Pee se ɔ, benɛ e ya hi Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hodesh ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Binyumuhi nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ ji Yobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam, Yeuz, Sakia, kɛ Mirma.
E bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba pee we puɔ nya dali.
Shaharaim kɛ e yo Hushim hu fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ: Abitub kɛ Elpaal.
Elpaal ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Eber, Misham, kɛ Shemed.
Shemed ji nɔ nɛ to Ono kɛ Lod ma amɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ ɔ sisi.
Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Gat kɛ Aiyalon Beria kɛ Shema ji we puɔ nya dali komɛ.
A hi Aiyalon, nɛ a fie Gat bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a ma a mi.
Beria nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ahio, Shashak, Yeremot, Zebadia, Arad, Eder, Mikael, Ishpa kɛ Yoha.
Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yerusalem Elpaal nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Zebadia, Meshulam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izlia, kɛ Yobab.
Shimei nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Yakim, Zikri, Zabdi, Elienai, Ziletai, Eliel, Adaya, Beraya, Shimrat.
Shashak nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zikri, Hanan, Hanania, Elam, Antotiya, Ifdeya, kɛ Penuel.
Yeroham nina ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Shamsherai, Sheharia, Atalia, Yaareshia, Eliya, kɛ Zikri.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji we puɔ nya dali kɛ a nina, nɛ a hi Yerusalem.
Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Gibeon kɛ Yerusalem Yeyel ji nɔ nɛ to Gibeon ma a sisi, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. E yo biɛ ji Maaka, nɛ a tsɛɛ e bitɛte ɔ ke Abdon.
E bimɛ kpa amɛ a biɛhi ji Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Zeker, kɛ Miklot nɛ ji Shimea tsɛ.
A nina hi Yerusalem ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ kpa amɛ a kasa nya.
Matsɛ Saul weku kpa Ner bi ji Kish, nɛ Kish bi ji Matsɛ Saul.
Saul ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Yonatan, Malkishua, Abinadab, kɛ Eshbaal.
Yonatan bi ji Meribaal, nɛ Meribaal bi ji Mika.
Mika ngɛ binyumuhi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Piton, Melek, Tarea, kɛ Ahaz.
Ahaz bi ji Yehoada.
Yehoada ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Alemet, Azmavet, kɛ Zimri.
Zimri bi ji Moza.
Moza bi ji Binea, Binea bi ji Rafa, Rafa bi ji Eleasa, nɛ Eleasa bi ji Azel.
Azel ngɛ binyumuhi ekpa.
A biɛhi ji Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Shearia, Obadia, kɛ Hanan.
Azel nyɛminyumu Eshek ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Ulam, Yeush, kɛ Elifelet.
Ulam binyumu ɔmɛ ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a nine nya da kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃mi.
E bimɛ kɛ e bibimɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Mɛ tsuo a je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi.
Nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nɛ a kpale mɛ kɛ ba ekohu A kane Israel ma a tsuo weku nya weku nya, nɛ a ngma kɛ wo Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Womi ɔ mi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ, a ba nuu mɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya, ejakaa a yi Mawu anɔkuale.
Kekleekle nihi nɛ kpale kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ, kɛ a ma amɛ a mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ: Israel bi komɛ nɛ pi osɔfohi ji mɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ní tsuli.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ, Benyamin bi ɔmɛ, Efraim bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Manase bi ɔmɛ ya hi Yerusalem.
-Yuda wɛtso ɔ nɛ ba hi Yerusalem ɔ, e mi bi a hiɛmi ji lafa kɛ nyingmi nɛɛ.
Yuda binyumu Perez nina a nya dalɔ ji Utai.
Utai tsɛ ji Amihud, nɛ e nɛ̃ ji Omri.
Utai nɛmɛ kpahi ji Imri kɛ Bani.
Yuda binyumu Shela nina a nya dalɔ ji Asaya; lɛ ji a we puɔ nya dalɔ.
Yuda binyumu Zera nina a nya dalɔ ji Yeuel.
-Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi bi nɛ ba hi Yerusalem ji Salu, Hasenua bi Hodavia bi Meshulam bi ɔ. Ibneya, Yeroham bi ɔ. Ela, Mikri bi Uzi bi ɔ. Meshulam, Ibneya bi Reuel bi Shefatia bi ɔ. Benyamin wɛtso ɔ nɛ ba hi Yerusalem ɔ, e mi bi a hiɛmi ji ; nɛ mɛ tsuo we puɔ nya dali ji mɛ.
Osɔfohi nɛ ba hi Yerusalem -Osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ ba hi Yerusalem: Yedaya, Yehoyarib, Yakin, kɛ Azaria, Hilkia bi ɔ (Lɛ ji tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ) E nɛmɛ ji Meshulam, Zadok, Merayot, kɛ Ahitub Adaya, Yeroham bi ɔ E nɛmɛ ji Pashur, kɛ Malkiya Maasai, Adiel bi ɔ E nɛmɛ ji Yazera, Meshulam, Meshilemit, kɛ Imer.
We puɔ nya dali ji osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ; a hiɛmi ji ,, nɛ a le Yawɛ we ɔ he ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo tsumi saminya.
Levi bi nɛ ba hi Yerusalem -Levi bi nɛ ba hi Yerusalem ji: Shemaya, Hashub bi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Azrikam kɛ Hashabia nɛ a je Merari weku ɔ mi ɔ Bakbakar, Heresh, ke Galal Matania, Mika bi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Zikri kɛ Asaf Obadia, Shemaya bi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Galal kɛ Yedutun Berekia, Elkana bi Asa bi ɔ nɛ hi Netofa bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ. Yawɛ we ɔ he buli nɛ hi Yerusalem Yawɛ we ɔ he buli nɛ ba hi Yerusalem ji Shalum, Akub, Talmon, kɛ Ahiman.
Shalum ji a nya dalɔ.
Kɛ ba si jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ buɔ Matsɛ agbo ɔ nya ngɛ beleku je.
Kekle ɔ lɛɛ mɛ nɛ a buɔ agbo ɔ nya kɛ yaa Levi bi ɔmɛ a si tomi he ɔ. Kore bi Shalum, Ebiasaf bibi ɔ, e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ Kora bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji a bu Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee benɛ a hyɛ Yawɛ ma sito he ɔ nɔ ɔ. Eleazar bi Finehas hyɛ a nɔ be ko mi.
Yawɛ kɛ lɛ hi si!
Meshelemia bi Zakaria hu bu Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.
Nyumuhi tsuo nɛ a hla nɛ a bu sinya amɛ a nya a, a hiɛmi ji .
A kane mɛ weku nya weku nya ngɛ a kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.
Matsɛ David kɛ gbalɔ Samuel ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ to ní tsumi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ.
A kɛ a nina ji nihi nɛ a buu Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ agbo ɔmɛ a nya.
Kpe he bo tsu agbo ɔmɛ peeɔ eywiɛ; agbo ɔ kake ngɛ beleku je, kake ngɛ bonyoku je, kake ngɛ omleyi je, kake hu ngɛ leneyi je; nɛ bulɔ nɔkɔtɔma kake ngɛ eko tsuaa eko nya.
Agbo nya buli nɛ ɔmɛ a nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ba kpeeɔ mɛ kɛ tsuɔ bumi ní tsumi nɛ ɔ otsiotsi.
Ke kuu kake ba bu otsi, kɛkɛ kuu kake ba tsake mɛ.
Agbo nya buli nikɔtɔma eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Levi bi ji mɛ, nɛ a dɛ mi nɛ a to ní tsumi ɔ kɛ wo.
Mɛ nɔuu nɛ a hyɛɛ tsuhi kɛ níhi nɛ a to ngɛ a mi ɔ a nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Blɔ nya nɛ a hɛɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ we ɔ kasa nya a hii, ejakaa a ní tsumi ji a bu lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a bli agbo ɔmɛ daa mɔtu.
Levi bi kpa amɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ hu a ní tsumi ji a hyɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ɔ a nɔ.
Ke a maa ngɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ je kpo ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa kane; ke a kpale ní ɔmɛ kɛ ma si tomi hu, mɛ nɔuu jinihi nɛ maa kane ní ɔmɛ.
Ni komɛ hu a ní tsumi ji a hyɛ tsu mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ ní klɔuklɔu kpa amɛ, mamu ɔ, wai ɔ, oliv nu ɔ, tsopahi kɛ a he via a nɔ.
Se tsopa kɛ e he via a futumi lɛɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji lɔ ɔ. Levi no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Matitia, nɛ ji Shalum nɛ je Kora weku ɔ mi ɔ bitɛte ɔ, e ní tsumi ji e sã keeki nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ. Kohat weku ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ lɛɛ a ní tsumi ji a sã abolo klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ya Yawɛ we ɔ daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi.
Levi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ a ní tsumi ji a la ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.
A nya dali ɔmɛ hii tsuhi nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ekomɛ a mi.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a ha we mɛ ní tsumi kpa ko, ejakaa a tsuɔ ní nyɔ kɛ pia.
Nyumuhi nɛ a wo a ta nɛ ɔ ji Levi we puɔ nya dali, kɛ ma nikɔtɔmahi; nɛ a hi Yerusalem.
Matsɛ Saul nɛmɛ kɛ e nina Yeyel ji nɔ nɛ to Gibeon ma a sisi, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. E yo biɛ ji Maaka, nɛ a tsɛɛ e bitɛte ɔ ke Abdon.
E bimɛ kpa amɛ a biɛhi ji Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Zakaria, kɛ Miklot nɛ ji Shima tsɛ.
A nina hi Yerusalem ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ kpa amɛ a kasa nya.
Ner bi ji Kish, nɛ Kish bi ji Matsɛ Saul.
Saul ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A biɛhi ji Yonatan, Malkishua, Abinadab, kɛ Eshbaal.
Yonatan bi ji Meribaal, nɛ Meribaal bi ji Mika.
Mika ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A biɛhi ji Piton, Melek, Tarea, kɛ Ahaz.
Ahaz bi ji Yara.
Yara ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Alemet, Azmavet, kɛ Zimri.
Zimri bi ji Moza.
Moza bi ji Binea, Binea bi ji Refaya, Refaya bi ji Eleasa, nɛ Eleasa bi ji Azel.
Azel ngɛ binyumuhi ekpa.
A biɛhi ji Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Shearia, Obadia, kɛ Hanan.
Matsɛ Saul gbenɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hwu ta ngɛ Gilboa yo ɔ nɔ.
A gbe Israel bi ɔmɛ babauu nitsɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ tu fo.
Se Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya na mɛ, nɛ a gbe Saul binyumuhi etɛ: Yonatan, Abinadab, kɛ Malkishua.
Ta a ba na Saul, nɛ e yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ɔmɛ a nine su e nɔ, nɛ a plaa lɛ wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Saul de e ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ ke, “Moo hia o klaate ɔ nɛ o kɛ gbe mi, nɛ́ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ko ba gbe mi nɛ a bɔ mi ahlua.” Se niheyo ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ e sume kaa e maa pee ja.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Saul nitsɛ ngɔ e klaate ɔ nɛ e kɛ gbe e he.
Benɛ Saul ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ na kaa Saul gbo ɔ, lɛ hu e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e klaate ɔ gbe e he.
Bɔ nɛ Saul kɛ e binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gbo si kake too, nɛ e we ɔ hɛ mi kpata ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yezreel kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ nu kaa Israel ta a gbɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, Saul kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ gbo ɔ, a tu fo kɛ je a ma amɛ a mi; nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba hi lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Enɔ jena benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba ha ni gbogboe ɔmɛ a he níhi ɔ, a na Saul kɛ e binyumu etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ Gilboa yo ɔ nɔ.
A po Saul yi, nɛ a je ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ a kɛ tsɔ nihi ke a ya kpa Filistia tsuo, nɛ́ a sɛɛ manye munyu nɛ ɔ ha amaga amɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo.
A ngɔ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ya to a mawu ɔmɛ a jami he ɔ, nɛ a kɛ e yi koklodo ɔ ya bɛle si ngɛ Dagon jami he ɔ. Benɛ Yabesh Gilead bi ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ pee Saul ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ya nɛ a ya ngɔ Saul gbogboe ɔ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba Yabesh ba pu ngɛ tso ngua a sisi.
Nɛ a ha hwɔ ligbi kpaago.
Saul gbo, ejakaa e yi Yawɛ anɔkuale.
E tɔ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ; jehanɛ hu, e ya ní peelɔ ngɔ nɛ e ya tsɛ kpade nɛ e bi lɛ ga womi, se Yawɛ mohu lɛɛ e bi we lɛ ga womi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbe lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha Ishai bi David.
David ye Israel kɛ Yuda nɔ matsɛ Israel ma a tsuo ba David ngɔ ngɛ Hebron nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “O nɛ, wa nyɛmi tutuutu ji mo.
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, benɛ Saul ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ wa nɔ ɔ, mo lɛ o nyɛɛɔ Israel hɛ mi kɛ yaa kɛ baa.
Yawɛ wo mo si kaa mo lɛ o ma ba nyɛɛ e ma Israel ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ o maa ye ganɔ ha mɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba Matsɛ David ngɔ ngɛ Hebron, nɛ e kɛ mɛ so somi ko ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
A pɔ David nu nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ Israel kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si kɛ gu Samuel nɔ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ David kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ho nɛ a ya tua Yerusalem.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ ma nɛ ɔ ji Yebus; nɛ Yebus bi nɛ ji zugbatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Yebus bi ɔmɛ de David ke e be nyɛe maa ba ma a mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, David ya ngɔ Zion mɔ ngua a nɛ ba plɛ pee David ma a. David de ke, “Nɔ nɛ maa sɛ hlami kɛ gbe Yebus no ko ɔ, jamɛatsɛ ɔ ma ba pee tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yoab, nɛ a tsɛɛ e nyɛ ke Zeruya a, ya pee ja; nɛ a wo lɛ tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma.
David ya hi mɔ ngua a mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke David ma.
David po ma a kɛ bɔle si; e to ma a sisi kɛ je he nɛ a tloo zu ngɔ pue ɔ ngɛ kpo ɔ beleku je.
Yoab dla ma a he nɛ piɛ ɔ. David ya nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ lɛ ngɛ.
David ta buli kpanaa amɛ David ta buli kpanaa amɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ta buli kpanaa nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo pee kake nɛ a wo David matsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ɔ. Mɛ lɛ a piɛ David he nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ da si.
Kekleekle nɔ ɔ ji Yashobeam nɛ je Hakmon weku ɔ mi ɔ. Lɛ ji “Ni etɛ ɔmɛ” a nya dalɔ.
E kɛ nimli lafa etɛ ya bua si kake, nɛ e kɛ e we akplɔ ɔ gbe mɛ tsuo.
Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e se ngɛ katsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ji Dodo bi Eleazar nɛ je Aho weku ɔ mi ɔ. Ligbi ko ɔ, e piɛ David he nɛ a kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta ngɛ Pas Damim.
Eleazar ngɛ akoko ngmɔ ko mi, nɛ e na kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ bɔni fo tumi ngɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ David ya da ta a nya ngɛ akoko ngmɔ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu, nɛ a kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hwu.
Yawɛ ha nɛ a ye kunimi nguaa.
Ligbi ko ɔ, benɛ Filisti ta a ba bua a he nya ngɛ Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, katsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni etɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho tɛ sa ko nɔ ya ngɛ he nɛ David ngɛ ngɛ Adulam tɛ puɔ ɔ kasa nya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, David ngɛ tɛ puɔ ɔ mi, nɛ Filisti tabo ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu ngɛ Betlehem.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David kɛ he hiami bi ke, “Mɛnɔ po ma ya yɛ nyu ngɛ vu ɔ nɛ ngɛ agbo ɔ kasa nya ngɛ Betlehem ma a mi ɔ mi ba ha mi nɛ ma nu?” Katsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ pee nyumu; a ya gu Filisti bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a ya yɛ nyu ngɛ vu ɔ mi kɛ ba ha David.
Se e kua numi; e plɛ nyu ɔ pue si ha Yawɛ mohu, nɛ e de ke, “Kpaoo, ye Mawu, kaa ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ!
Ke i pee ja a, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ i nu nihi nɛ ngɔ a wami ngɔ ke nɛ ɔ a muɔ!” Nɛ e kua nyu ɔ numi.
Níhi nɛ katsɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yoab nyɛminyumu Abishai ji “Ni nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ” a nyatsɛ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e kɛ e we akplɔ ɔ gbe nimli lafa etɛ, nɛ e kɛ na biɛ ngɛ katsɛmɛ “Nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ” a kpɛti.
Katsɛmɛ “Nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ” a kpɛti ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe mɛ tsuo.
E ba pee a hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ, se e kɛ “Ni etɛ ɔmɛ” sɔɛ.
Yehoyada bi Benaya, Kabzeel no ɔ, lɛ hu katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji lɛ; nɛ e pee ní nguahi.
Lɛ nɛ e gbe Ariel nɛ je Moab ɔ binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, ligbi ko benɛ snoo ngɛ nɛe ɔ, e ya sɛ muɔ ko mi nɛ e gbe jata ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benaya nɛ ɔ nɔuu gbe Egipt no oblai ko.
Egipt no ɔ hɛɛ akplɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa bo lolɔ gba tso ngɛ e dɛ mi, se Benaya ho nɛ e ya na lɛ kɛ e dɛma tso kɛkɛ.
E kpɔ akplɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e ngɔ Egipt no ɔ nitsɛ e we akplɔ ɔ kɛ gbe lɛ.
Kã peemi níhi nɛ Yehoyada bi Benaya tsu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Katsɛmɛ “Nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ” a ti nɔ kake ji lɛ.
E hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe katsɛmɛ “Nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ”, se katsɛmɛ “Etɛ ɔmɛ” lɛɛ e na we mɛ.
David pee lɛ e we bi a tabo ɔ nyatsɛ.
-Ta buli katsɛmɛ kpahi hu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Asahel, Yoab nyɛminyumu ɔ Elhanan, Dodo nɛ je Betlehem ɔ bi ɔ Shamot nɛ je Harod ɔ Helez nɛ je Pelet ɔ Ira, Ikesh nɛ je Tekoa a bi ɔ Abiezer nɛ je Anatot ɔ Sibekai nɛ je Husha a Ilai nɛ je Aho ɔ Maharai nɛ je Netofa a Heled, Baana nɛ je Netofa a bi ɔ Itai, Ribai nɛ je Gibea ngɛ Benyamin ɔ bi ɔ Benaya nɛ je Piraton ɔ Hurai nɛ je Gaash pa amɛ a nya a Abiel nɛ je Arba a Azmavet nɛ je Bahurum ɔ Eliaba nɛ je Shaalbon ɔ Hashem nɛ je Gizon ɔ Yonatan, Shagee nɛ je Harar a bi ɔ Ahiam, Saka nɛ je Harar a bi ɔ Elifal, Hur bi ɔ Hefer nɛ je Mekera a Ahiya nɛ je Pelon ɔ Hezro nɛ je Karmel ɔ Naarai, Ezbai bi ɔ Yoel, Natan nyɛminyumu ɔ Mibhar, Hagri bi ɔ Zelek nɛ je Amon ɔ Naharai, Yoab ta hwumi ní hɛɛlɔ ɔ nɛ je Beerot ɔ Ira kɛ Gareb nɛ a je Yatir ɔ Uria, Hit no ɔ Zabad, Ahlai bi ɔ Adina, Shiza bi ɔ.
(Adina ji Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ e ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ta buli nyingmi etɛ) Hanan, Maaka bi ɔ Yoshafat nɛ je Mitan ɔ Uzia nɛ je Ashtera a Shama kɛ Yeyel, Hotham nɛ je Aroer ɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ Yediael kɛ Yoha, Shimri nɛ je Tiz ɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ Eliel nɛ je Mahava a Yeribai kɛ Yoshavia, Elnaam bimɛ ɔmɛ Itma nɛ je Moab ɔ Eliel, Obed, kɛ Yaasiel nɛ a je Zoba a.
Benyamin bi komɛ ba nyɛɛ David se Benɛ David na we he jɔmi ngɛ Kish binyumu Saul dɛ mi, nɛ e ho ya laa e he ngɛ Ziklag ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa babauu ba piɛ e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ hwu ta.
Ta buli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Saul nitsɛ nyɛmimɛ Benyamin bi ji mɛ.
A nine nya da saminya; a nyɛɔ nɛ a kɛ a hiɔ nine, loo a muɔ nine tsɛ̃ɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃, aloo a fɔɔ amlami tɛ.
-A nya dali ji Ahiezer kɛ Yoash; Shemaa nɛ je Gibea a bimɛ ji mɛ.
Ta buli nɛ ɔmɛ ji Yeziel, kɛ Pelet, Azmavet binyumu ɔmɛ Beraka kɛ Yehu nɛ a je Anatot ɔ Ishmaya nɛ je Gibeon ɔ Nyumu nɛ ɔ, ta bulɔ nɛ peeɔ kã wawɛɛ ji lɛ, nɛ e peeɔ nimli “Nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ” a hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ.
Yeremia, Yahaziel, Yohanan, kɛ Yozabad nɛ a je Gedera a. Eluzai, Yerimot, Bealia, Shemaria, kɛ Shefatia nɛ je Harif ɔ Elkana, Ishia, Azarel, Yoezer, kɛ Yashobeam nɛ a je Kora weku ɔ mi ɔ Yoela, kɛ Zebadia, Yehoram nɛ je Gedor ɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ.
Gad bi nɛ ba nyɛɛ David se Gad ta buli komɛ nɛ he biɛ hu ba piɛ David he ngɛ e laami he ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
A ji nihi nɛ a le tsɛ̃i kɛ aklɔ he ní tsumi saminya.
A hɛ mi ngɛ gbeyegbeye kaa jata hɛ mi, nɛ a he sɔɔ kaa odabɔ.
-A nya dalɔ ji Ezer, nɛ nihi nɛ ba ngɛ e se ji Obadia, Eliab, Mishmana, Yeremia, Atai, Eliel, Yohanan, Elzabad, Yeremia, kɛ Makbanai.
Gad bi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, asafoatsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ji asafoatsɛngua amɛ ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ ta buli akpe ngɛ e sisi.
Se asafoatsɛwawi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ ta buli lafa ngɛ e sisi.
Jeha ko nɛ be ɔ, kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi benɛ Yordan pa a hyi tɔ, Gad asafoatsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ po pa a nɛ a ya tua nihi ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je tsuo, nɛ a gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.
David se nyɛɛli kpa komɛ nɛ je Benyamin kɛ Yuda Ligbi ko ɔ, Benyamin bi kpa komɛ kɛ Yuda bi komɛ ba David ngɔ ngɛ e tɛ puɔ ɔ mi.
David kɛ mɛ ba kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ba ye ngɔ kaa huɛmɛ nɛ ma ye he piɛmi ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ baba hee hae kɛ je ye tsui mi.
Se ke nyɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ ye sihi he, nɛ lɔ ɔ se nyɛ ya tsɔɔ ye se blɔ ngɔ ha ye he nyɛli, be mi nɛ i pee we yayami ko ɔ, lɛɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɛ e wo nyɛ hiɔ.” Tlukaa a, Mawu mumi ɔ ba a ti nɔ kake nɔ.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Amasai, nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ba pee ta buli “Nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ” a nyatsɛ.
Amasai kpa ngmlaa, nɛ e de ke, “Ishai binyumu David lee!
Wa ngɛ o se oo, wa ngɛ o se!
David lee, mo he manye, mo he manye!
David he piɛli, nyɛ he manye, nyɛ he manye!
Ejakaa, o Mawu ɔ piɛɔ o he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David he mɛ, nɛ e pee mɛ e we asafoatsɛmɛ.
Se nyɛɛli nɛ je Manase Benɛ David kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hia nɛ a kɛ Matsɛ Saul yaa hwu ta a, ta buli komɛ ku kɛ je Manase wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ a ba piɛ David he.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, David ya piɛ we Filisti bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ hwui ta a. Filisti matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ ba na kaa ke a hyɛ we nɛ e hi ɔ, David maa je a se, nɛ e ma ya piɛ e nyɔmtsɛ Saul ɔ he, nɛ a maa fia mɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ se nya kɔ̃.
E nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ha nɛ e kpale e se.
Benɛ David kpale kɛ yaa Ziklag ɔ, ta buli nɛ je Manase nɛ ku ya nyɛɛ e se ji Adna, Yozabad, Yediael, Mikael, Yozabad, Elihu, kɛ Ziletai.
Ta buli akpehi a nyatsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo ngɛ Manase wɛtso ɔ mi.
A ba piɛ David he nɛ e pee mɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ngɛ e tabo ɔmɛ a nya, ejakaa ta buli katsɛmɛ nɛ he biɛ ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Daa ligbi ɔ, ni hehi ba piɛɔ David tabo ɔmɛ a he.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e we bi ɔmɛ a he ba hiɛ babauu nitsɛnitsɛ kaa Mawu tabo.
David tabo ɔmɛ a hiɛmi -Benɛ David ngɛ Hebron ɔ, ta buli nɛ a je blɔ tsɔse mɛ babauu ya piɛ e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ a kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ Saul dɛ kɛ ha lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a hiɛmi ngɛ ha ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Yuda: ta buli ,.
A mia saminya, nɛ a hɛɛ tsɛ̃i kɛ akplɔ; Simeon: ta buli , nɛ a je blɔ tsɔse mɛ; Levi: ta buli ,; Yehoyada se nyɛɛli nɛ ji Aaron nina: ta buli ,; Niheyo katsɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zadok ɔ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ: asafoatsɛmɛ ; Benyamin (Saul nitsɛ e wɛtso ɔ): ta buli , (Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu ngɛ Saul se kɛ mwɔɔ); Efraim: ta buli katsɛmɛ nɛ he biɛ ngɛ a weku ɔmɛ a mi ,; Manase wɛtso fa a: ta buli , nɛ a je blɔ hla mɛ ke a ya nɛ a ya wo David matsɛ ɔ; Isakar: asafoatsɛmɛ kɛ a we bi ngɛ a sisi, (Kikɛmɛ a asafoatsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ le nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa Israel nɛ a pee, kɛ be tutuutu nɛ sa nɛ a pee); Zebulun: ta buli , nɛ le ta hwumi saminya, kɛ ta hwumi níhi saisaa a he ní tsumi.
A le ta gbami saminya, nɛ a yi mi pee we mɛ enyɔɔnyɔ; Naftali: asafoatsɛmɛ , kɛ a we bi , nɛ hɛɛ tsɛ̃i kɛ akplɔ; Dan: ta buli , nɛ a je blɔ tsɔse mɛ; Asher: ta buli , nɛ a le ta gbami saminya; Wɛtsohi nɛ je Yordan pa a se, nɛ ji Ruben, Gad, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a: ta buli , nɛ le ta hwumi ní slɔɔtohi a he ní tsumi.
Ta buli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ mia, nɛ a pee a nya kake, nɛ a ho Hebron ya, konɛ a ya wo David Israel nɔ matsɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo fi a se.
Ta buli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ David ya hi si ligbi etɛ; a kɛ lɛ ye ní nɛ a nu ní, ejakaa a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ dla a se saminya.
Nihi nɛ a kɛ lɛ a he kɛ́ we, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Isakar, Zebulun, kɛ Naftali tɔɔ ngɔ niye ní slɔɔtoslɔɔto kɛ wo tejihi, afukpɔngɔhi, teji okpɔngɔhi, kɛ nahi a se kɛ ba.
Níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba ji mamu, ngmɔkɔ, keeki, wai, kɛ nu.
A ngɔ nahi kɛ tohi hu kɛ ba, nɛ a ba gbe nɛ a ye, ejakaa bua jɔmi ba Israel.
A ya ngɔ somi daka a kɛ je Kiriat Yearim Matsɛ David kɛ e we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji ta buli akpehi kɛ lafahi a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpe.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de Israel ma a tsuo ke, “Ke nyɛ kplɛɛ nɔ, nɛ e sa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ hu hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ ha waa tsɔ ya de wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a mi ɔ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi, nɛ a kɛ wɔ ba kpe ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, wa ma ya ngɔ Mawu somi daka a kɛ ba; ejakaa kɛ je be nɛ Saul ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ɔ, wa ya bi we si.” Ga nɛ David wo nɛ ɔ sa ma a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kplɛɛ kaa a pee ja.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David kpee Israel ma a tsuo, konɛ a ya ngɔ Mawu somi daka a kɛ je Kiriat Yearim kɛ ba.
E bua ma a nya kɛ je zugba a tsuo nɔ; kɛ je Egipt huzu ɔ nya ngɛ leneyi je, hluu kɛ ya si Hamat tɔɔ ngɛ omleyi je.
David kɛ Israel ma a ho Yuda zugba a nɔ ya konɛ a ya ngɔ Mawu somi daka a ngɛ Baala nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Kiriat Yearim ɔ. Somi daka nɛ ɔ, a kɛ Yawɛ nɛ hii kerub ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ biɛ tsɛɔ lɛ.
A ya ngɔ Mawu somi daka a ngɛ Abinadab we ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ ma tlɔɔke he mi.
Uza kɛ Ahio ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ blɔ tsɔɔe.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, David kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ngɛ lae nɛ a ngɛ doe kɛ a he wami tsuo kɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami woe.
A la, nɛ a fiɛ do, nɛ a fia saku slɔɔtohi, kpa sakuhi, ngmlɛhi, kɛ gɔgɔhi; nɛ a kpa titimatihi.
Benɛ a su Kidon ngma mi sami he ɔ, na amɛ nɛ ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ gblae ɔ a nane tɛ si, nɛ daka a mimiɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Uza nu daka a kɛ da si.
Se Yawɛ mi mi fu Uza, nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ nɛ e gbe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e nine ta daka a he.
Uza gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Perez Uza, nɛ ja a tsɛɔ lɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. E dɔ David kaa Yawɛ ngɔ abofu kɛ gbla Uza tue.
David ye Mawu gbeye jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɛ e bi ke, “Lɛɛ kɛ ma pee kɛ ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ya we mi kɛɛ?” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, David kɛ somi daka a yɛ Yerusalem.
Mohu ɔ, e kɛ somi daka a ya ma Obed Edom nɛ je Gat ɔ we mi.
Mawu somi daka a hi Obed Edom we ɔ mi nyɔhiɔ etɛ; nɛ Yawɛ gbaa Obed Edom kɛ e we ɔ, kɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
David ngɛ Yerusalem Tiro matsɛ, Hiram wo tsɔli blɔ kɛ ba David ngɔ.
A kɛ seda tsohi ba.
Kapitɛhi, kɛ tɛ gbogbo tsu mali hu piɛ a he; a ba konɛ a ba po we ha David.
David yɔse kaa Yawɛ to lɛ si kaa Israel matsɛ, nɛ e ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ ya nɔ ngɛ e ma, Israel ɔ he.
Benɛ David ba Yerusalem ɔ, e ngɔ yihi babauu, nɛ a fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyihi ha lɛ.
Bimɛ nɛ a fɔ ha lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ji Shamua, Shobab, Natan, Salomo, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Noga, Nefeg, Yafia, Elishama, Beeliada, kɛ Elifelet.
David ye Filisti bi ɔmɛ a nɔ Benɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ nu kaa a pɔ David nu nɛ a wo lɛ Israel nɔ matsɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ba nɛ a ba hla nɛ a nu lɛ.
David nu he, nɛ e hia konɛ e kɛ mɛ ya kpe.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ ba su Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a bɔni ní hami ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. David bi Mawu ke, “Ma ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ lo?
O ma je mɛ kɛ wo ye dɛ mi lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, moo ya!
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ma je Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Baal Perazim, nɛ e ye a nɔ kunimi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E de ke, “Mawu ngɔ mi kɛ gba blɔ kɛ gblee he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a mi kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala kɛ bee.” Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Baal Perazim ɔ nɛ.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ je a mawu ɔmɛ a he, nɛ David ha nɛ a sã mɛ.
E kɛ we kulaa nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba kɔ̃ ɔ mi ekohu ba bɔni ní hami ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. David ya bi Mawu ga womi ekohu, nɛ Mawu de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, ko tua mɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ; yaa lɔgɔ kɛ gu a se je, nɛ o ya tua mɛ ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke o nu nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a yi mi kaa ta buli nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ; ejakaa imi Mawu i nyɛɛ o hɛ mi kɛ yaa nɛ ma ya gbe Filisti ta buli ɔmɛ.” David pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu fa lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpata Filisti bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ je Gibeon hluu kɛ ya si Gezer tɔɔ.
David biɛ pɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he, nɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo ye lɛ gbeye.
A dla konɛ a ya ngɔ somi daka a David po wehi ngɛ David ma a mi kɛ ha e he.
Jehanɛ, e dla he ko kɛ ha Mawu somi daka a, nɛ e ma bo tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ha lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de ke, “Levi bi ɔmɛ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hɛɛ somi daka a nɛ, ejakaa mɛ Yawɛ hla ke a hɛɛ somi daka a, nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ daa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David kpee Israel ma a tsuo kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ a ya ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a kɛ ba ma he nɛ e dla kɛ to lɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e bua Aaron nina, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ he kake.
-Osɔfohi, kɛ Levi bi nɛ ba lejɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Kohat weku ɔ: nihi , kɛ a nya dalɔ Uriel; Merari weku ɔ: nihi , kɛ a nyatsɛ Asaya; Gershon weku ɔ: nihi , kɛ a nyatsɛ Yoel; Elizafan weku ɔ: nihi , kɛ a nyatsɛ Shemaya; Hebron weku ɔ: nihi , kɛ a nyatsɛ Eliel; Uziel weku ɔ: nihi , kɛ a nyatsɛ Aminadab.
David tsɛ osɔfo Zadok, kɛ osɔfo Abiatar.
E tsɛ Levi bi hu ekpa.
Mɛ ji Uriel, Asaya, Yoel, Shemaya, Eliel, kɛ Aminadab.
David de Levi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ji Levi weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ.
Nyɛɛ tsu nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛɛ tsu nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Levi bi kpa amɛ hu a he, konɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ somi daka a kɛ ba he nɛ i dla to lɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ kekle ɔ, pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ daka a he je ɔ, Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ gbla wa tue; ejakaa wa hyɛ we daka a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e to kaa a pee ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ya tsu a he, konɛ a ya ngɔ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ somi daka a kɛ ba.
Levi bi ɔmɛ wo somi daka a tso nɛ a kɛ fɔ a konɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ gu Mose nɔ fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. David fa Levi bi ɔmɛ a nya dali ɔmɛ ke a ha nɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ a fia saku, kɛ ngmlɛ, gegeege.
-Nihi nɛ a hla kɛ je lali a weku ɔmɛ a mi nɛ a fia akɔblee ngmlɛhi ji Heman, Yoel bi ɔ e nyɛmi Asaf, Berekia bi ɔ, kɛ Etan, Kushaya bi ɔ nɛ je Merari weku ɔ mi ɔ.
A he piɛli nɛ a hla nɛ a fia kpa saku nɛ gbi ya hiɔwe ɔ ji Levi bi nɛ ɔmɛ: Zakaria, Yaaziel, Shemiramot, Yehiel, Uni, Eliab, Maaseya, kɛ Benaya.
Jehanɛ, a hla Levi bi nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ nɛ mɛɛ a fia kpa saku nɛ gbi ba si ɔ: Matitia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, kɛ Azazia.
A hla Yawɛ we buli enyɔ hu kɛ piɛ a he; a tsɛɛ nɔ kake ke Obed Edom, nɛ a tsɛɛ nɔ kake hu ke Yeyel.
La jelɔ ɔ ji Kenania nɛ nyɛɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ la a.
A je blɔ hla lɛ ejakaa e le lami he blɔ nya tomi saminya.
-Somi daka a he buli nɛ a hla ji Berekia, Elkana, Obed Edom, kɛ Yehia.
A hia osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kpa titimati kɛ nyɛɛ somi daka a hɛ mi: Shebania, Yoshafat, Netanel, Amasai, Zakaria, Benaya, kɛ Eliezer.
A ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ba Yerusalem Kɛkɛ nɛ David kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ta buli akpeakpe a nya a, pue nɔ kɛ ho Obed Edom we ɔ mi ya, nɛ a kɛ nyami ya ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a.
A gbe na ku kpaago, kɛ jijɔ kpaago kɛ sã bɔ, ejakaa Mawu piɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ somi daka a a he.
David, Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ daka a, lali ɔmɛ, kɛ la jelɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kenania a tsuo wo kploba tade klɔii saminyawiiwi.
David wo efɔd nɛ a kɛ kploba kpɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsuo ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Benɛ a ma a tsuo a ngɛ titimati kɛ koli kpae, nɛ a ngɛ ngmlɛ kɛ kpa saku hu fiae kɛ ngmlaa.
Benɛ daka a ba su David ma a mi ɔ, Mikal, Saul biyo ɔ je e hɛ mi kpo ngɛ saflɛ mi, nɛ e na Matsɛ David nɛ ngɛ tuue nɛ e ngɛ doe, nɛ David he pee lɛ tai.
A ngɔ Yawɛ daka a ya ma bo tsu ɔ nɛ David pee kɛ ha lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a sã sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi kɛ ha Mawu.
Benɛ David sã bɔ ɔmɛ gbe nya a, e gbaa ma a ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi, nɛ e dla ní ha ma kpekpemi ɔ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ná abolo bɔbɔɛ kake, lo nɛ a sã kpɔ kake, kɛ wai yiblii gbigbli nɛ a kɛ si tatale.
David hla Levi bi komɛ nɛ a da ma a nya kɛ ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ somi daka a hɛ mi; a ní tsumi ji a tsɛ Mawu, a na Mawu si, nɛ a je Mawu yi daa.
Asaf ji a nyatsɛ, nɛ e he piɛlɔ ji Zakaria.
Yeyel, Shemiramot, Yehiel, Metitia, Eliab, Benaya, Obed Edom, kɛ Yeyel maa fia kpa saku.
Asaf maa fia ngmlɛ, nɛ osɔfohi enyɔ ma kpa titimati ngɛ somi daka a hɛ mi daa.
Nɔ kake biɛ ji Benaya, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Yahaziel.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji kekleekle be nɛ David ngɔ he blɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha Asaf, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ kaa a la nɛ a kɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Yi jemi la Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, nyɛɛ wo e biɛ ta; nyɛ ha je ma amɛ nɛ a le e ní peemi ní ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi; nyɛɛ sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ. Nyɛɛ wo Yawɛ biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hlaa e se blɔ ɔ, nyɛ nya kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo!
Nyɛɛ ya Yawɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ya bi yemi kɛ buami; nyɛ ja lɛ daa.
-Nyɛ Mawu tsɔlɔ Yakob nina, Israel nina, nyɛ nɛ Mawu hla; nyɛ kai nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu pee ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e kojo je ma amɛ ha.
Yawɛ ji wa Mawu; e mlaa amɛ ngɛ kɛ ha je ɔ tsuo.
Nyɛ hɛ ko je Mawu somi ɔ nɔ gblegbleegble, somi nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ, somi nɛ e kɛ Abraham so, kɛ si nɛ e wo Isak ɔ. Yawɛ ma somi nɛ ɔ nɔ mi kɛ ha Yakob kaa mlaa; nɛ e pee somi nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene kɛ ha Israel.
Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “I kɛ Kanaan zugba a ma ha mo; e maa pee o weto ní.” Yawɛ ma a, a he pi, nibwɔhi ji mɛ ngɛ Kanaan.
A wo lalaalo kɛ je zugba kake nɔ kɛ ya zugba kpa nɔ, kɛ je nɔ yemi he kake, kɛ ya nɔ yemi he kpa.
Se Yawɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɛ wa mɛ yi mi; e bɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ a he.
E ke, “Ye tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ i hla a, nyɛ ko pee mɛ yayami ko; nyɛ ko ta ye gbali ɔmɛ hu a he.” Nyɛ la ha Yawɛ, nyɛ je ɔ tsuo!
Nyɛɛ fiɛ manye sane ɔ daa ligbi kaa Yawɛ he wa yi wami.
Nyɛɛ sɛɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ he ní ha je ma amɛ.
E nyakpɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ hu, nyɛ de nɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a nu.
Yawɛ kle, nɛ e sa yi jemi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E sa nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Je ma kpa amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ, amagahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Se Yawɛ lɛɛ, lɛ nɛ e bɔ hiɔwe.
Hɛ mi nyami, kɛ agboje bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe; he wami kɛ bua jɔmi hyi e we ɔ. Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi; nyɛ je e hɛ mi nyami, kɛ e he wami ɔ yi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ hɛ mi nyami nɛ sa Yawɛ biɛ ɔ kɛ ha lɛ; nyɛɛ hɛɛ nɔke nɔ́ ko kɛ ba e hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Yawɛ.
Nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ he nɛ do ngɛ e hɛ mi!
A ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma si ngɛ e hi he, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma mimiɛ lɛ.
Hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nyɛ nya!
Nyɛ de je ma amɛ ke Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee.
Wo, kɛ o mi níhi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo gbi; ngmɔhi, kɛ nyɛ nɔ ní tsuo, nyɛ nya!
Ke Yawɛ ma nɛ e ba kojo je ɔ, pu mi tsohi ma hwɔ lele ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e hi; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Nyɛ de hu ke, “Mawu, wa yi wami helɔ lee, he wa yi wami.
Bua wa nya ngɛ he kake; kpɔ wɔ ngɛ je ma amɛ a dɛ mi, konɛ waa na mo si nɛ wa je o biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi.” Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi; nyɛ je Israel Mawu ɔ yi!
Nyɛ je e yi mwɔnɛ ɔ, kɛ daa!
Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo he nɔ ke, “Amen”, nɛ a je Yawɛ yi.
Jami ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Gibeon David ngɔ Asaf kɛ e nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ to jami ní tsumi ɔ nya ngɛ he nɛ a ngɔ somi daka a ya ma a. Daa ligbi ɔ, ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ hia kaa a tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a tsuɔ.
A he piɛli ji Yedutun binyumu Obed Edom, kɛ nyumuhi nyingmi ekpa kɛ kpaanyɔ nɛ je e weku ɔ mi.
Hosa kɛ Obed Edom ji agbo nya buli.
Osɔfo Zadok, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ e ha mɛ ní tsumi ngɛ Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Gibeon ɔ mi.
Daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a ní tsumi ji a sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha Israel ɔ mi ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛɔ a he kɛ tsuɔ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji Heman, Yedutun, kɛ ni komɛ nɛ a je blɔ hla mɛ ke a la kɛ je Yawɛ yi ngɛ e suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he.
Heman kɛ Yedutun a ní tsumi kpa hu ji a hyɛ titimati kpami, kɛ ngmlɛ kɛ saku fiami ɔ nɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ yi jemi la amɛ lae ɔ. Agbo nya bumi ní tsumi ɔ, a kɛ ha Yedutun weku ɔ. Pee se ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ je kɛ ho e we mi ya.
David hu ho lɛ nitsɛ e we mi ya, nɛ e kɛ e we mi bimɛ ya hi si kɛ bua jɔmi.
Natan kɛ sɛ gbi ba ha David Jehanɛ lɛɛ David ba je matsɛ we ɔ mi.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e tsɔ ya tsɛ gbalɔ Natan kɛ ba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ kaa imi i ngɛ we nɛ a ma kɛ seda mi, be mi nɛ Yawɛ somi daka a lɛɛ e ngɛ bo tsu mi!” Natan de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o to kaa o maa pee ɔ, moo pee; ejakaa Mawu kɛ mo ngɛ.” Se jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu de Natan ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya de ye tsɔlɔ David ke, Yawɛ ke, ‘Pi mo ji nɔ nɛ maa po we ha mi nɛ ma hi mi.’ Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ i ya kpɔ Israel ma a kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i hí we ko mi hyɛ; bo tsu ji we nɛ i hii mi ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ i yaa.
Kɛ je be nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a bɔni si kpami nɛ ɔ, i bi we ma nya dali nɛ i hla nɛ a hyɛ ye ma a nɔ ɔ a ti nɔ ko hyɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je o kɛ seda ma we tsu ha mi?’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo de ye tsɔlɔ David ke, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ lɛ dee ke, ‘Imi nɛ i ya ngɔ mo kɛ je to lɛmi he ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ i ba pee mo ye ma, Israel ganɔ.
Imi lɛ i kɛ mo nyɛɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba, nɛ imi nɔuu lɛ i kpata o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ o blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Ma ha nɛ o ma na biɛ kaa nimli nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a ti nɔ ko.
-Ma hla hi he ko ha ye ma Israel, nɛ ma to mɛ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, he nɛ nɔ ko be a nya dooe ngɛ hu.
Kɛ je be nɛ i hla ma nya dali nɛ a hyɛ ye ma Israel nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ sɔuu a ngɛ nae ngɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi.
Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se maa po.
Ma kpata o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ i ngɛ si woe kaa imi Yawɛ, ma bɔ we ha mo.
Ke o gbo, nɛ a ya dla mo ngɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hwɔ he ɔ, ma wo mo nitsɛ o mi mi bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake matsɛ ngɛ o se, nɛ ma ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ya nɔ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma ba po we ha mi, nɛ ma ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ma pee e tsɛ, nɛ e maa pee ye bi.
Ye suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a, i be hae nɛ jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ se nɛ po ngɛ e nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi ɔ. Ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to ye ma a nya, nɛ e maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
E matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.’ ” Natan ya bɔ David níhi nɛ a de lɛ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a je ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ. David sina sɔlemi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ David ya sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e sɔle ke, “Yawɛ Mawu, mɛnɔ ji mi, nɛ ye we ɔ hu mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ, loko o hɛɛ mi kɛ ba su he nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ?
Se Mawu lee, enɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ji nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi.
O wo si kaa o tsɔlɔ ɔ nina maa hiɛ babauu hwɔɔ se, nɛ mo Yawɛ Mawu, o je sisi bɔni mi hɛɛmi momo kaa nɔmlɔ ngua.
Lɛɛ mɛni pa ngɛ imi David, ye nya nɛ ma de mo?
O le imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ saminya, se kɛ̃ ɔ, o wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
Yawɛ, imi o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ye he lɛ o je o tsui mi nɛ o tsu ní tsumi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa o ha nɛ i le ní nguangua nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yawɛ, nɔ ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ; wa le kɛ je blema, kaa mo pɛ ji Mawu.
Ma ko be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ pe o ma Israel nɛ mo Mawu o ya kpɔ kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi kɛ ba pee mo nitsɛ o ma a. Ní nguanguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu ha o ma a, ha o biɛ pɛ kɛ kpe je ɔ mi tsuo.
Benɛ o ma a nɛ o kpɔ kɛ je Egipt ɔ hia kɛ ma a, o fie je ma kpa amɛ kɛ je a blɔ mi.
O ngɔ o ma, Israel ngɔ pee mo nitsɛ o ma kɛ yaa neneene.
Nɛ mo, Yawɛ o ba pee a Mawu.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, si nɛ o wo nɛ kɔɔ o tsɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ e nina a he ɔ, moo ye nɔ daa, nɛ o pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ. O biɛ maa jije kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ nihi ma de ke, ‘Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ji Israel Mawu’.
Nɛ o ma ha imi, o tsɔlɔ David, ye matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ye Mawu, o je ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ o de mi ke o maa bɔ we ha mi; lɔ ɔ he nɛ ye nɔ gbagba te, nɛ i ngɛ kue nɛ ɔ fae ha mo ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ lee, Mawu ji mo; mo ji nɔ nɛ o wo mi nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ ɔ he si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ya nɔ nɛ o gbaa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ye nina daa.
Yawɛ lee, o gbaa mɛ momo, nɛ o gbaami ɔ maa hi a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.”
David ye kunimi ngɛ tahi a mi Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ David ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ ekohu, nɛ e ye a nɔ.
E ngɔ a ma nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Gat ɔ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma a. E ye Moab bi ɔmɛ hu a nɔ; Moab bi ɔmɛ ba pee e sɔmɔli, nɛ a tsuɔ to kɛ haa lɛ.
Jehanɛ, David ye Zoba matsɛ, Hadadezer nɔ kunimi ngɛ Hamat zugba a kasa nya; ejakaa Hadadezer ngɛ hlae nɛ e ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a he ɔ. David nuu Hadadezer ta zugba lɛ akpe, okpɔngɔ ta buli akpe kpaago, kɛ ta buli nɛ nyɛɛɔ nane akpe nyingmi enyɔ.
David poo okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nane se pani, nɛ e si ta zugba lɛ lafa nya okpɔngɔhi pɛ.
Benɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ ya, konɛ a ya je ngmlaa ha Zoba matsɛ, Hadadezer ɔ, David ya tua mɛ, nɛ e gbe a ti nihi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
David to ta buli a hi hehi ngɛ Damasko.
Siria bi ɔmɛ ba plɛ pee e sɔmɔli, nɛ a tsuɔ tó kɛ haa lɛ.
Yawɛ haa nɛ David yeɔ kunimi ngɛ he tsuaa he.
David kpɔ sika tsu tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ nɛ Hadadezer tsɔli ɔmɛ hɛɛ ɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ e kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Jehanɛ hu, David ya muɔ akɔblee babauu nitsɛ ngɛ Tibhat kɛ Kun nɛ ji mahi nɛ Hadadezer yeɔ a nɔ ɔ.
(Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Salomo sile akɔblee nɛ ɔ kɛ pee akɔblee nyu nɔ́ ɔ, titima amɛ, kɛ akɔblee ní kpa amɛ).
Benɛ Hamat matsɛ, Toi nu kaa David ye Hadadezer tabo ɔ tsuo nɔ ɔ, e tsɔ e binyumu Yoram ya nga David, nɛ e ha lɛ ayekoo kaa e kɛ Hadadezer hwu ta nɛ e ye e nɔ kunimi, ejakaa lɛ Toi ɔ nitsɛ e kɛ Hadadezer hwu ta hluu.
Yoram hɛɛ nike ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ akɔblee pee kɛ ya ha David.
Matsɛ David gbaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu nɛ e kpɔ ngɛ je mahi nɛ e ye a nɔ ɔ a dɛ ɔ. Je ma nɛ ɔmɛ ji Edom, Moab, Amon, Filistia, kɛ Amalek.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Abishai, nɛ a tsɛɛ e nyɛ biɛ ke Zeruya a, ya tua Moab bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Ngo kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ e gbe a ti nihi akpe nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Abishai to ta buli a hi hehi ngɛ Edom, nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ba plɛ pee Matsɛ David sɔmɔli.
Yawɛ haa nɛ David yeɔ kunimi ngɛ he tsuaa he.
David ye Israel ma a tsuo nɔ matsɛ; e ye dami sane kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Mawu mlaa a nya.
Zeruya binyumu Yoab ji tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma; Ahilud binyumu Yehoshafat ji sanehi ngmalɔ; Ahitub binyumu Zadok kɛ Abiatar binyumu Ahimelek ji osɔfohi, nɛ Seraya ji David nitsɛ e pɛdiyo.
Yehoyada binyumu Benaya ji Keret kɛ Pelet bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji David we bi a tabo.
David binyumu ɔmɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya nguanguahi ngɛ matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
David ye Amon bi ɔmɛ kɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ a nɔ -Pee se ɔ, Amon bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nahash ɔ ba gbo; nɛ e binyumu Hanun ba ye e se.
David de ke, “I kɛ Hanun maa hi si saminya kaa nɔ kɛ e huɛ, ejakaa e tsɛ Nahash kɛ mi hi si saminya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David tsɔ ya ha Hanun lakpoo, benɛ Nahash gbo ɔ.
Se benɛ David tsɔli ɔmɛ ya su Amon nɛ a ya nga matsɛ ɔ, Amon ganɔ ɔmɛ bi a matsɛ ɔ ke, “O susu kaa David tsɔ nihi ba ha mo lakpoo konɛ e kɛ wo o tsɛ hɛ mi nyami lo?
Dɛbida!
Ni ɔmɛ nɛ David tsɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, pe a ba nɛ a ba slaa ma a, nɛ a kɛ kpa níhi si loko a ba tua wɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Hanun nuu David tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ e sɛ a kpɛni nɛ e hia a tade ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ kpɛti kɛ ba su a mlɛ mi, nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a ho.
Benɛ David nu nɔ́ nɛ ba a, e tsɔ ya de mɛ ke a mlɛ ngɛ Yeriko kɛ yaa si a kpɛni ɔmɛ maa hɛ loko a ba, ejakaa e ngɛ mɛ zo pee kaa a maa kpale kɛ ba bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ Matsɛ Hanun kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ na kaa a ya hla munyu ngɛ David he ɔ, a tsɔ nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ kilo nyingmi akpe etɛ kɛ eywiɛya bɔ ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ ta buli apaa kɛ je Mesopotamia yiti je, kɛ Maaka kɛ Zoba ngɛ Siria.
Ta zugba lɛ akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya bɔ apaa a, kɛ Maaka matsɛ tabo ɔ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Medeba kasa nya.
Amon bi ɔmɛ hu je a ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ba, nɛ a mia kɛ ha ta hwumi.
Benɛ David nu he ɔ, e wo Yoab kɛ Israel tabo ɔ tsuo blɔ nɛ a kɛ mɛ ya kpe.
Amon bi ɔmɛ hia nɛ a ya gba ta ngɛ a ma nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Raba a we agbo ɔ nya.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je ngmlaa ha mɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a gba ta kɛ gu nga a nɔ je.
Yoab na bɔ nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ gba ta a ha, kaa a ma lɛ tuami kɛ je hɛ mi kɛ se blɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hla Israel ta buli komɛ nɛ a kɔni si wa, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ kpee Siria bi ɔmɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo e nyɛminyumu Abishai dɛ mi, konɛ mɛ hu a kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ nɛ ya kpe.
Yoab de lɛ ke, “Ke e ba mi kaa i ya nyɛ we Siria bi ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ o ba nɛ o ba piɛ ye he.
Se ke Amon bi ɔmɛ ngɛ mo gbee ɔ, lɛɛ imi hu ma ba piɛ o he.
Moo pee kã, nɛ o ha nɛ waa da si kaa nyumuhi kɛ ha wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa Mawu ɔ ma amɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, e pee.” Yoab kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ ba na Siria bi ɔmɛ konɛ a kɛ mɛ ba hwu, se Siria bi ɔmɛ tu fo.
Benɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ na kaa Siria bi ɔmɛ tu fo ɔ, mɛ hu a tu fo kɛ je ta nɛ a kɛ Abishai ngɛ hwue ɔ nya kɛ ho ma a mi ya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yoab kpa Amon bi ɔmɛ a se nyɛɛmi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Siria bi ɔmɛ na kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ye a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya ngɔ Siria tabohi nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a beleku je ɔ kɛ ba.
A kɛ tabo nɛ ɔmɛ ba ha Zoba matsɛ, Hadadezer we asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shobak ɔ; nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ hwu ta.
Benɛ David nu he ɔ, e bua Israel tabo ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.
E kɛ mɛ po Yordan pa a, nɛ e kɛ mɛ gba ta kɛ kpee Siria bi ɔmɛ.
Benɛ a bɔni ta a hwumi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ wo Siria bi ɔmɛ fo, nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ gbe Siria bi ɔmɛ a ta zugba lɛ ta buli lafa kpaago, kɛ ta buli nane nyɛɛli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ.
Siria asafoatsɛ Shobak ɔ hu a gbe lɛ.
Benɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Hadadezer sɔmɔe ɔ ná le kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, a kɛ David ya kpata, nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Siria bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye, nɛ a ya ji ngmlaa ha we Amon bi ɔmɛ hu.
David ye Raba bi a nɔ Gbo, be mi nɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pɔɔ ta gbami ɔ, Yoab ngɔ tabo ɔ tsuo kɛ ya tua Amon zugba a. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Matsɛ David lɛɛ e ngɛ Yerusalem.
A ya sa ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Raba a yi; a tua ma a, nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Amon bi ɔmɛ a we amaga a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Milkon ɔ ngɛ sika tsu jlasi ko; jlasi ɔ jiimi maa pee sika tsu kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ, nɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa ngɛ mi.
David je tɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo lɛ nitsɛ e jlasi ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ, e ngɔ ta yibu ní babauu nitsɛ hulɔ kɛ je ma a mi.
Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ David muɔ mɛ kɛ ba nɛ e ba ha mɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa komɛ nɛ a kɛ sau, dade kpakplaa kɛ gbiɛ slɔɔtohi tsuɔ.
David pee Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma kpa amɛ tsuo kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Tahi nɛ a kɛ Filisti oblai komɛ hwu Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hwu ta ekohu ngɛ Gezer.
Benɛ a ngɛ ta nɛ ɔ hwue ɔ, Israel no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sibekai gbe Filisti oblai ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sipai.
Nɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ha yi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ hwu ta ekohu.
Ngɛ ta nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Yair binyumu Elhanan gbe Goliat nɛ je Gat ɔ nyɛminyumu Lami.
Lami we akplɔ ɔ nya tso ti kaa bo lolɔ gba tso.
Jehanɛ, a hwu ta ekohu ngɛ Gat, he nɛ nyumu oblai ko ngɛ ɔ. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, nine nguɛ ekpatsɛ kɛ nane nguɛ ekpatsɛ ji lɛ.
Blema oblai ɔmɛ a nina ji lɛ.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ bɔ Israel ma a ahlua, nɛ Yonatan nɛ ji David nyɛminyumu Shama binyumu ɔ gbe lɛ.
Ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ David kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ gbe ɔ, Gat oblai ɔmɛ a nina ji mɛ.
David kane ma a Abosiami ba te si ngɔ wo Israel, nɛ e wo David ga yaya ke e kane Israel ma a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David fa Yoab, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kane Israel ma a, kɛ je Beersheba kɛ yaa si Dan, nɛ nyɛ ba de mi.
Ma suɔ nɛ ma le ma a hiɛmi.” Yoab de matsɛ ɔ ke, “I ná nɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ ma a hiɛmi ba pee nimli nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ a yibɔ totoe lafa!
Nɛ ke e ba ja a, pi mo nɛnɛ, o tsɔli ji mɛ tsuo lo?
Mɛni he je o ngɛ hlae nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?
O li kaa o kɛ haomi maa ba ma a tsuo nɔ lo?” Se matsɛ ɔ nyɛ Yoab nɔ nɛ e bu e fami ɔ tue.
Yoab ho, nɛ e ya kpa Israel zugba a tsuo nɔ; nɛ e kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.
E ba bɔ Matsɛ David amaniɛ ke a ya kane nyumuhi nɛ a he wa, nɛ a su ta yami ayɔ kɛ e nya akpe lafa, ngɛ Israel, kɛ akpe lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi kpaago ngɛ Yuda.
Se akɛnɛ matsɛ ɔ fami ɔ ngɔɛ Yoab nya he je ɔ, e kane we Levi, kɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔmɛ.
Sane nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ Mawu nya; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e gbla Israel ma a tue.
David de Mawu ke, “I pee yayami agbo kaa i tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ. I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ pa mi.
I je kuasia.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Gad, David gbalɔ ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya de David ke i ngɔ nɔ́ etɛ kɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi fɔe.
E hla kake, nɛ lɔ ɔ maa pee e tue gblami.” Gad ba David ngɔ nɛ e ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Te nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ nɛɛ?
Hwɔ nɛ ba o zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ?
Aloo o hi fo tue ngɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tabo ɔmɛ a nya hlami etɛ?
Aloo Yawɛ nɛ ngɔ e klaate ɔ kɛ fia mo ní, nɛ e tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ nɛ e kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ ba Israel zugba a nɔ tsuo ligbi etɛ?
Mɛni heto ma ngɔ kɛ ya ha nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ?” David de Gad ke, “Sane nɛ ɔ he wa ha mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ!
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i be suɔe nɛ nimli adesahi nɛ a gbla ye tue.
Ha nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ gbla ye tue, ejakaa e mɔbɔ nami ɔ hiɛ babauu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ha gbenɔ hiɔ ba Israel ma a nɔ, nɛ nihi akpe nyingmi kpaago gbo.
Jehanɛ, e tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ, konɛ e ya kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi.
Se benɛ bɔfo ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma puɛ ní ɔ, Yawɛ tsake e yi mi tomi ɔ, nɛ e de bɔfo ɔ ke, “Mo kpa!
E hiɛ!” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ daa si ngɛ Yebus no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Arauna a ngma mi sami he ɔ. David na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti.
E hɛɛ e klaate ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo kpla si, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
Mɛ tsuo a bu kpekpe.
David sɔle ke, “Mawu lee, imi lɛ i pee yayami ɔ nɛ; imi lɛ i tɔ̃.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ fa ke a kane ma a nɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kaa jijɔhi ɔ lɛɛ mɛni a pee?
Yawɛ, ye Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbla i kɛ ye tsɛ we ɔ kɛkɛ wa tue; o ma a lɛɛ ha nɛ a ye a he.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de Gad ke e fa David nɛ e ya ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ Arauna ngma mi sami he ɔ. David bu Yawɛ fami ɔ tue, nɛ e ho kaa bɔ nɛ Gad de lɛ ɔ. Arauna kɛ e binyumu eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ngma mi sae ngɛ ngma mi sami he ɔ jamɛ a be ɔ. Benɛ a na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ, Arauna bimɛ ɔmɛ tu fo ya laa a he, se Arauna nitsɛ lɛɛ e ya nɔ nɛ e sa ngma a mi.
Benɛ Arauna na Matsɛ David nɛ ma ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e je ngma mi sami he ɔ nɛ e ya kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si.
David de lɛ ke, “Moo jua o ngma mi sami he ɔ ha mi nɛ ma ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ konɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se nɛ po.
Ma wo mo hiɔ sisiisi.” Arauna de David ke, “Nɛnɛ, ngɔɔ nɛ o kɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ.
Nahi nɛ o kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, tsohi nɛ a saa ngma mi ngɛ a nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o kɛ pee lɛ́.
Ngma hu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ pee niye ní bɔ.
I ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ke mo.” Se matsɛ ɔ de Arauna ke, “Dɛbi, ma wo mo hiɔ sisiisi.
I be níhi ngɔe ngɛ o dɛ gu kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, i kɛ níhi nɛ i ná yaka be sami bɔ sãe ha Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, David ngɔ sika tsu yi lafa ekpa kɛ he ngma mi sami he ɔ. E ma bɔ sami la tɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e sã sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi.
E fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ bu e kue fami ɔ tue.
Yawɛ ha nɛ la je hiɔwe ba sã ní ɔmɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ fa e bɔfo ɔ ke e ngɔ e klaate ɔ kɛ wo kpo ɔ mi; nɛ e pee ja.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, David na faii kaa Yawɛ bu kue nɛ e fa ha lɛ ɔ tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sã bɔhi ha lɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Arauna ngma mi sami he ɔ. Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ nɛ Mose pee ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ jami he ɔ ngɛ Gibeon jamɛ be ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Se David nyɛ we nɛ e ya bi Mawu ga womi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e ngɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ klaate ɔ gbeye yee.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David de ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu we ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ Israel ma a maa sã sami bɔhi ngɛ nɔ ɔ maa hi ɔ nɛ.” A dla ní kɛ ha Yawɛ we ɔ mami Matsɛ David fa, nɛ a kpee nibwɔhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e ha mɛ ní tsumi.
