Ni komɛ kó tɛ nɛ a kɛ maa ma Yawɛ we ɔ. David bua dade babauu nya nɛ a kɛ maa pee plɛɛko kɛ sá kɛ ha agbo ɔmɛ, kɛ akɔblee hu babauu nɛ a li nya.
E ha nɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon bi hu ba ha lɛ seda tsohi babauu nitsɛ.
David de e he ke, “We ɔ nɛ ye bi Salomo ma ba ma ha Yawɛ ɔ, e sa nɛ e kle agbo, nɛ́ e he biɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Se ye bi ɔ, jokuɛyo ji lɛ, nɛ e hɛ mi fa we lolo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa imi nitsɛ ma bɔni níhi a nya buami kɛ to nyɔngloo.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, David bua tsu mami níhi babauu nya loko e gbo.
E tsɛ e bi Salomo, nɛ e fa lɛ ke e po we ha Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ. David de lɛ ke, “Ye bi, jinɛ imi nitsɛ i hla kaa ma po we kɛ wo Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Se Yawɛ de mi ke i pue muɔ si tsɔ, nɛ jehanɛ se hu, i hwu ta babauu tsɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ke e be hae nɛ ma po we ha lɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e ha mi si womi ko.
E de mi ke, ‘A ma fɔ binyumu ko ha mo, nɛ e maa ye matsɛ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi; ejakaa ma ha e kɛ e he nyɛli tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
A ma tsɛ e biɛ ke Salomo, ejakaa e yi nɔ ɔ, ma ha Israel he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma ba po we ha mi.
E maa pee ye bi, nɛ imi hu ma pee e tsɛ.
E nina maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ maa ya neneene.’ ” David ya nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ mo nɛ hi si.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ ye e si womi ɔ nɔ, konɛ o nyɛ nɛ o po we ha lɛ.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ ha mo nile kɛ juɛmi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ye Israel nɔ ngɛ e mlaa a nya.
Mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ wo Israel ma a kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ, ke o ye a nɔ ɔ, e maa hi ha mo.
O he nɛ wa nɛ o pee kã; koo ye nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye!
I gbo dengme bua ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nya kɛ to, konɛ a kɛ po Yawɛ we ɔ: sika tsu nɛ jiɔmi ji tɔn akpe etɛ kɛ lafa eywiɛ, sika hiɔ nɛ jiɔmi ji tɔn akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ, akɔblee kɛ dade babauu nɛ a li nya, tso, kɛ tɛ.
Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ mo hu o na eko kɛ piɛ he.
O ngɛ ní tsuli babauu, tɛ gbali, tso kɛ tɛ a he ni tsuli, ga ní tsuli slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu nɛ tsuɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, kɛ dade a he ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hyɛ nɛ o je ní tsumi ɔ sisi; nɛ Yawɛ nɛ piɛ o he.” David fa Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ke a piɛ Salomo he.
E de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si, nɛ e ha nyɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ loko wa ba hiɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ mɛ tsuo ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi.
I ye a nɔ kunimi, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba pee nyɛɛ kɛ Yawɛ nyɛ sɔmɔli.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ sɔmɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, kɛ nyɛ juɛmi tsuo.
Nyɛɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ mami sisi, konɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a, kɛ ní klɔuklɔu kpa amɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ kɛ ba ma mi.”
Benɛ David ba bwɔ kotokoto ɔ, e wo e binyumu Salomo matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi Matsɛ David ya kpee Israel ma nikɔtɔma amɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba.
David ha nɛ a kane nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ yaa a, nɛ a ná nihi akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
David dla ní tsumi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mɛ: nihi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ maa hyɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mami ní tsumi ɔ nɔ, akpe ekpa ma tsu ma ní nɛ a maa kojo, akpe eywiɛ maa bu agbo nya, nɛ akpe eywiɛ hu maa fia saku ɔmɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ pee ɔ kɛ je Yawɛ yi.
David dla Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo kuu etɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ we puɔ nya amɛ ngɛ ɔ: Gershon bi, Kohat bi, kɛ Merari bi.
Gershon binyumuhi ji Ladan kɛ Shimei.
Ladan ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ.
A biɛhi ji Yehiel, Zetam, kɛ Yoel.
A nɛ̃ ji Ladan, nɛ weku nya dali ji mɛ.
Shimei ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ.
Mɛ ji Shelomot, Haziel, kɛ Haran.
-Shimei ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
Nɔkɔtɔma a ji Yahat.
Enyɔne ɔ ji Zina, etɛne ɔ ji Yeush, nɛ eywiɛne ɔ ji Beria.
Yeush kɛ Beria a bimɛ pi; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a kane mɛ kaa weku kake.
Kohat ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A biɛhi ji Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel.
Kohat bitɛte nɛ ji Amram ɔ lɛɛ e binyumuhi ji Aaron kɛ Mose.
Aaron kɛ e nina lɛɛ a hla mɛ ngɔ to, nɛ a ngɔ Yawɛ we ɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɔ wo a dɛ.
A ní tsumi ji a sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha Yawɛ, á sɔmɔ Yawɛ, nɛ á kɛ Yawɛ biɛ nɛ gbaa ma a. Mawu nɔmlɔ Mose binyumu ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bu mɛ ngɔ piɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he.
Mose binyumuhi ji Gershom kɛ Eliezer.
Gershom binyumu ɔmɛ a nya dalɔ ji Shebuel.
Eliezer ngɛ binyumu kake pɛ; a tsɛɛ lɛ Rehabia.
Se Rehabia lɛɛ e ngɛ nina babauu.
Kohat binyumu enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Izhar a ngɛ binyumu kake.
E biɛ ji Shelomit, nɛ lɛ ji we puɔ nya dalɔ.
Kohat binyumu etɛne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hebron ɔ, ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ.
A biɛhi ji Yeria, Amaria, Yehaziel, kɛ Yekameam.
Kohat binyumu eywiɛne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Uziel ɔ ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: a tsɛɛ nɔ kake ke Mika, nɛ a tsɛɛ nɔ kake hu ke Ishia.
Merari binyumuhi ji Mahli kɛ Mushi.
Mahli hu binyumuhi ji Eleazar kɛ Kish.
Se Eleazar lɛɛ e na we binyumu nɛ e kɛ gbo; biyihi sɔuu nɛ e fɔ.
E biyi ɔmɛ gba a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji Kish binyumu ɔmɛ.
Merari binyumu enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mushi ɔ ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Mahli, Eder, kɛ Yeremot.
Levi nina nɛ a kane nɛ a ngma a biɛ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa a, ya tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. David de ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ha e ma a tue mi jɔmi, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa hi Yerusalem daa.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pa hia we hu kaa Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ jaa Mawu ɔ.” Kaa bɔ nɛ David de ngɛ e nyagbe munyu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Levi no tsuaa Levi no nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa pɛ, a kane lɛ.
Ke a ngma a biɛ se ɔ, a ní tsumi ji a wa osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Aaron nina a nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.
A blɔ nya ji kaa a hyɛ kue ɔmɛ, kɛ tsu ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a tsukɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
A ní tsumi hu ji kaa a hyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ: abolo ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, ma nɛ a kɛ sãã niye ní bɔ ɔ, abolo kplolo ɔ, keeki nɛ a sã a, kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ ɔ nɛ a futu mi nu ɔ. Jehanɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa sɛnihi, kɛ ní kpahi nɛ a kɛ ngmɛɛ, loo a kɛ susuu níhi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã bɔ ɔ, a hyɛ kaa jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ lo.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ma la kɛ je Yawɛ yi, nɛ a maa wo e biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ, kɛ be tsuaa be nɛ a maa sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi jio, Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be jio, nyami be kpa amɛ jio.
Ke be su kɛ ha ní tsumi nɛ ɔmɛ a tsumi ɔ, Levi bi abɔ nɛ hia kaa a ya tsu ní ɔ, yaa nɛ a ya tsuɔ ngɛ mlaa a nya.
A ní tsumi hu ji kaa a hyɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a nɔ, nɛ a piɛ a nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a ní tsumi Kuuhi a mi nɛ a gba Aaron nina kɛ wo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Aaron binyumuhi ji Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar.
Nadab kɛ Abihu gbo loko a tsɛ gbo, nɛ a si we bimɛ ngɛ a se.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a nyɛmimɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar ba pee osɔfohi.
Matsɛ David gba Aaron nina mi kɛ wo kuuhi a mi, ngɛ ní tsumihi nɛ a tsuɔ ɔ nya.
Nihi nɛ piɛ e he kɛ to blɔ nya nɛ ɔ ji Zadok, Eleazar nina a, kɛ Ahimelek, Itamar nina a.
A gba Eleazar nina a mi kɛ wo kuu nyɔngma kɛ ekpa mi, nɛ a gba Itamar nina a mi kɛ wo kuu kpaanyɔ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ha nɛ e ba lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji nyumuhi nikɔtɔmahi hiɛ ngɛ Eleazar nina a a kpɛti pe Itamar nina a.
A fɔ sɔ kɛ gba ní tsumi ha kuu slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ e ko pee kaa a hyɛ nɔ ko hɛ mi; ejakaa Yawɛ we ɔ ní tsuli, kɛ Mawu ní tsuli ngɛ Eleazar nina a, kɛ Itamar nina a tsuo a kpɛti.
Womi ngmalɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shemaya, Netanel binyumu ɔ nɛ je Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ngma a biɛ.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi: osɔfo Zadok, Abiatar binyumu Ahimelek, osɔfo weku ɔmɛ a nya dali ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi weku ɔmɛ a nya dali ɔmɛ.
Ke a hla kuu kake kɛ je Eleazar nina a a kpɛti, kɛkɛ a hla kake hu kɛ je Itamar nina a a kpɛti.
-Benɛ a fɔ sɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ba ha kɛ je kekleekle blɔ he ɔ kɛ ya si nyagbe nɔ́ nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Enɛ ɔ ji ní tsumi nɛ a ha mɛ ɔ he blɔ nya tomi nɛ fɔɔ si, nɛ e nɔ a daa kɛ ya sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.
A nɛ̃, Aaron ji nɔ nɛ to blɔ nya nɛ ɔ kɛ fɔ si kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ fa lɛ ɔ. Levi bi ɔmɛ a biɛhi Levi nina nɛ piɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Amram nina ji Shebuel, nɛ Shebuel nina ji Yedeya; Rehabia nina ji Ishia; Izhar nina ji Shelomit, nɛ Shelomit nina ji Yahat; Hebron binyumuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a fɔmi nya: Yeria, Amaria, Yehaziel, kɛ Yekameam; Uziel nina ji Mika, nɛ Mika nina ji Shamir; Mika nyɛminyumu ji Ishia; Ishia nina ji Zakaria; Merari nina ji Mahli, Mushi, kɛ Yaazia.
Yaazia ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ.
A biɛhi ji Shoham, Zakur, kɛ Ibri.
-Mahli binyumuhi ji Eleazar, kɛ Kish.
Eleazar be bi, se Kish lɛɛ e ngɛ binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yerameel.
Mushi ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ.
A biɛhi ji Mahli, Eder, kɛ Yeremot.
Levi bi ɔmɛ a wekuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Aaron nina a pee ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ hu fɔ sɔ kɛ dla ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a he.
Weku ɔmɛ a nya dali, kɛ a senihi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ fɔ sɔ ɔ.
A fɔ sɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Matsɛ David, Zadok, Ahimelek, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ a hɛ mi.
Yawɛ we ɔ lali Matsɛ David kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ komɛ ngɔ ha Levi weku nɛ ɔmɛ: Asaf, Heman, kɛ Yedutun.
A ní tsumi ji a gba, nɛ a fia saku kɛ ngmlɛ ngɔ to he.
Nihi nɛ a hla a, kɛ ní tsumihi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a ngɔ wo a dɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Asaf binyumu eywiɛ ɔmɛ: Mɛ ji Zakur, Yosef, Netania, kɛ Asharela.
A nyatsɛ ji Asaf, nɛ be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ ɔ ma fa lɛ ɔ, e gbaa.
Yedutun binyumu ekpa amɛ: Mɛ ji Gedalia, Zeri, Yeshaya, Shimei, Hashabia, kɛ Matitia.
A tsɛ ji a nya dalɔ.
Ke e fa mɛ ɔ, a gbaa nɛ a fiaa saku kɛ toɔ he.
A laa kɛ jeɔ Yawɛ yi, nɛ a naa lɛ si.
Heman binyumu ɔmɛ: Mɛ ji Bukia, Matania, Uziel, Shebuel, Yerimot, Hanania, Hanani, Eliata, Gidalti, Romamti Ezer, Yoshbekasha, Maloti, Hotir, kɛ Mahaziot.
Mawu ha Heman, matsɛ gbalɔ ɔ binyumuhi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ, kɛ biyihi etɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ, konɛ e kɛ wo Heman hɛ mi nyami.
Heman binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo fiaa ngmlɛ, kɛ saku kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɛ ɔ faa mɛ ɔ. Asaf, Yedutun, kɛ Heman lɛɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ faa mɛ loko a tsuɔ ní.
Nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ le ní tsumi saminya; a nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ hu lali kpanakpanaa ji mɛ.
Mɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji .
A fɔ sɔ nɛ a kɛ dla ní tsumi ɔ.
A hyɛ we nɔ ko hɛ mi, jokuɛ jio, nɔkɔtɔma jio, tsɔɔlɔ jio, kaselɔ jio.
-A dla nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ weku nya kɛ wo kuu nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ mi.
Nihi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ kuu tsuaa kuu mi, kɛ a nya dalɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a to blɔ nya kɛ ha kuu ɔmɛ a ní tsumi kɛ je kekleekle kuu ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si nyagbe nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: .
Yosef ngɛ Asaf weku ɔ mi .
Gedalia .
Zakur .
Zeri .
Netania .
Bukia .
Asharela .
Yeshaya .
Matania .
Shimei .
Uziel .
Hashabia .
Shebuel .
Matitia .
Yerimot .
Hanania .
Yoshbekasha .
Hanani .
Maloti .
Eliata .
Hotir .
Gidalti .
Mahaziot .
Romamti Ezer.
Yawɛ we ɔ buli Levi bi nɛ buu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, bɔ nɛ a dla ní tsumi ngɔ ha mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ngɛ Kora weku ɔ mi ɔ, a hla Kore binyumu Meshelemia kɛ je Asaf we ɔ mi.
Meshelemia ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago.
A biɛhi ngɛ a fɔmi nya ji Zakaria, Yediael, Zebadia, Yatniel, Elam, Yehohanan, kɛ Eliehoenai.
A hla Obed Edom binyumuhi kpaanyɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo lɛ ɔ hulɔ.
A biɛhi ngɛ a fɔmi nya ji Shemaya, Yehozabad, Yoa, Sakar, Netanel, Amiel, Isakar, kɛ Peuletai.
-Obed Edom bitɛte ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shemaya a, ngɛ binyumuhi ekpa.
A biɛhi ji Otni, Refael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, kɛ Semakia.
A ngɛ blɔ nya ngɛ a weku ɔ mi, ejakaa nyumuhi katsɛmɛ ji mɛ, titli nyagbe ni enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Nihi nɛ a hla kɛ je Obed Edom we ɔ mi kɛ ha ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ji nyumuhi nyingmi ekpa kɛ enyɔ.
Obed Edom bimɛ, kɛ bibimɛ ji mɛ tsuo.
Katsɛmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a ngɛ he blɔ kaa a tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Meshelemia we ɔ ha nyumuhi katsɛmɛ nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
-Nyumu ko ngɛ Merari weku ɔ mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hosa.
E ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ; a biɛhi ji Shimri, Hilkia, Tebalia, kɛ Zakaria.
Hosa wo e bi Shimri nɔkɔtɔma, pohu pi lɛ ji bitɛte.
Hosa weku li tsuo nɛ buu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ.
A dla Yawɛ we ɔ buli ɔmɛ kɛ wo kuuhi a mi ngɛ a weku ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Levi bi kpa amɛ peeɔ ɔ.
A fɔ sɔ kɛ dla agbo ɔmɛ nɛ a maa bu a he ɔ kɛ ha we puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya; a hyɛ we we puɔ nya ko klemi kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nɛ́ a fɔ sɔ ɔ, a kɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ ha Shelamia, nɛ a kɛ omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ ha e bi Zakaria.
Zakaria nɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ kaa e woɔ ga kpakpa.
A kɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ ha Obed Edom, nɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ nito he ɔmɛ ngɔ wo a dɛ nɛ a bu he.
Shupim kɛ Hosa nɔ́ ji agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ, kɛ Shaleket agbo ɔ, ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɛ ngɛ yiti je ɔ he.
Daa ligbi ɔ, buli ekpa ya buu agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nya; ni eywiɛ ya buu omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ nya, nɛ ni eywiɛ hu ya buu leneyi je nɔ́ ɔ nya.
Buli eywiɛ ya buu nito he ɔmɛ daa ligbi; ni enyɔ buu kake he, nɛ ni enyɔ hu buu kake he.
Tsu nguaa a nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, buli eywiɛ buu gbɛjegbɛ ɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ni enyɔ buu tsu nguaa a nitsɛ he.
Bɔ nɛ a dla bumi ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ ha Kora kɛ Merari weku ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ we ɔ he ní tsumi kpa komɛ Ahiya nɛ je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ hyɛɛ Mawu we ɔ nito he ɔmɛ, kɛ nito hehi he nɛ a toɔ nike níhi nɛ a gbaa nɔ ngɔ to ha Yawɛ ngɛ ɔ hu a nɔ.
Ladan nɛ ji Gershon bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ɔ, e bi ji Yahiel.
Yahiel we puɔ nya amɛ, kɛ we puɔ nya kpahi babauu a nɛ̃ ji lɛ.
Ladan bimɛ kpahi nɛ ji Zetam, kɛ Yoel ɔ, mɛɛ a ní tsumi ji a hyɛ Yawɛ nito he ɔ, kɛ nito he kpa amɛ a nɔ.
A dla ní tsumi ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɔ ha Amram, Izhar, Hebron kɛ Uziel nina a hulɔ.
Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji Shebuel.
E je Mose bi Gershom weku ɔ mi.
Kɛ gu Gershom nyɛminyumu Eliezer nɔ ɔ, Shebuel peeɔ Shelomit nyɛmi.
Eliezer bi ji Rehabia; Rehabia bi ji Yeshia; Yeshia bi ji Yoram; Yoram bi ji Zikri, nɛ Zikri bi ji Shelomit.
Nike ní tsuo nɛ Matsɛ David, we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ, wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, kɛ tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbaa nɔ kɛ to ha Mawu ɔ, Shelomit kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ lɛ a hyɛɛ nɔ.
Ta yibu ní nɛ a ha ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a hla ekomɛ ngɔ to nɛ a gbaa nɔ, konɛ a ngɔ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ to konɛ a kɛ tsu ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, Shelomit kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hyɛɛ nɔ.
Ní ɔmɛ ekomɛ ji nike ní nɛ gbalɔ Samuel, Matsɛ Saul, Kish bi ɔ, Ner bi Abner, kɛ Zeruya bi Yoab ngɔ kɛ ba.
Levi bi kpa komɛ a ní tsumi A hla Kenania kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Izhar nina a kpɛti, nɛ a pee mɛ Israel ma a nɔ hyɛli kɛ kojoli.
A hla Hashabia kɛ e nyɛminyumuhi akpe kɛ e nya lafa kpaago kɛ je Hebron bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti; katsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo.
A ní tsumi ji a hyɛ jami, kɛ ma ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Israel, ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je.
Hebron nina a, a nya dalɔ ji Yeria.
Matsɛ David yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a ya hyɛ Hebron nina a weku kpa a mi, nɛ a na ta buli katsɛmɛ komɛ nɛ je weku nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ Yazer, ngɛ Gilead zugba a nɔ.
Matsɛ David hla katsɛmɛ nɛ ji we puɔ nya dali akpe enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa kpaago kɛ je Yeria nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Mɛ ji ní nɛmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ jami, kɛ ma ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Israel, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je, ngɛ Ruben, Gad, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a a mi.
Ta kɛ ma ní tsumihi a he blɔ nya tomihi A dla Israel tabo ɔ kɛ wo asafo kuu nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi.
Asafo kuu tsuaa asafo kuu mi ɔ, nyumuhi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ngɛ mi, kɛ a nya asafoatsɛmɛ, kɛ ma ní tsuli nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ a we bi.
Daa jeha a, asafo kuu kake kɛ a we asafoatsɛ ya tsuɔ ní nyɔhiɔ kake.
Asafo kuu ɔmɛ, kɛ a we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: -Kekleekle asafo kuu ɔ nyatsɛ ji Zabdiel bi Yashobeam.
E je Yuda wɛtso fa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Perez ɔ mi.
E kɛ e we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi daa jeha.
Asafo kuu enyɔne ɔ nyatsɛ ji Dodai; Ahohi nina ji lɛ, nɛ e setsɔ ji Miklot.
Dodai ngɛ nyumuhi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ngɛ e sisi, nɛ a tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ mi daa jeha.
-Asafo kuu etɛne ɔ nya dalɔ ji Benaya.
E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ etɛne ɔ mi daa jeha.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Yehoyada bi ji lɛ, nɛ David ta buli katsɛmɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji lɛ.
E bi Amizabad ba ye e se kaa e we asafo kuu ɔ nyatsɛ.
Asafo kuu eywiɛne ɔ nyatsɛ ji Yoab nyɛmi Asahel.
E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ eywiɛne ɔ mi daa jeha.
Pee se ɔ, e bi Zabadia ba ye e se.
Asafo kuu enuɔne ɔ nyatsɛ ji Izhar nina Shamhut.
E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ enuɔne ɔ mi daa jeha.
Asafo kuu ekpane ɔ nyatsɛ ji Ikesh nɛ je Tekoa a e bi Ira.
E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpane ɔ mi daa jeha.
Asafo kuu kpaagone ɔ nyatsɛ ji Helez nɛ je Pelon ngɛ Efraim ɔ. E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ mi daa jeha.
Asafo kuu kpaanyɔne ɔ nyatsɛ ji Sibekai; Husha no ji lɛ, nɛ e je Yuda wɛtso fa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Zera a mi.
Sibekai we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaanyɔne ɔ mi daa jeha.
Asafo kuu nɛɛne ɔ nyatsɛ ji Abiezer.
E je Anatot ngɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ.
E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne ɔ mi daa jeha.
Asafo kuu nyɔngmane ɔ nyatsɛ ji Maharai.
E je Netofa ngɛ Zera.
E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nyɔngmane ɔ mi daa jeha.
Asafo kuu nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ nyatsɛ ji Benaya.
E je Piraton ngɛ Efraim zugba a nɔ.
E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ mi daa jeha.
Asafo kuu nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ nyatsɛ ji Heldai.
E je Netofa, nɛ Otniel nina ji lɛ.
E we bi akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ mi daa jeha.
Israel wɛtsoyihi -Israel wɛtsoyihi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Wɛtso Wɛtsoyi Ruben Eliezer, Zikri bi ɔ Simeon Shefatia, Maaka bi ɔ Levi Hashabia, Kemuel bi ɔ Aaron Zadok Yuda Elihu, Matsɛ David nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake Isakar Omri, Mikael bi ɔ Zebulun Ishmaya, Obadia bi ɔ Naftali Yeremot, Azriel bi ɔ Efraim Hoshea, Azazia bi ɔ Manase fa a (Bonyoku je) Yoel, Pedaya bi ɔ Manase fa a (Beleku je) Ido, Zakaria bi ɔ Benyamin Yaasiel, Abner bi ɔ Dan Azarel, Yeroham bi ɔ. Matsɛ David kane we nihi nɛ a jeha sui nyingmi enyɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ wo si kaa e ma ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he maa hiɛ kaa hiɔwe dodoehi.
Yoab nɛ a tsɛɛ e nyɛ ke Zeruya a ba bɔni ma a kanemi, se e gbi nya.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu gbla Israel ma a tue, nɛ e ngmɛ́ nihi nɛ a kane mɛ ɔ a hiɛmi kɛ wui David yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔ mi.
Matsɛ weto níhi a nɔ hyɛli -Matsɛ weto níhi a nɔ hyɛli ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Matsɛ nito hehi: Azmavet, Adiel bi ɔ Nito he kpahi ngɛ zugba a nɔ, ma amɛ, kɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a mi: Yonatan, Uzia bi ɔ Ngmɔ nɔ ní tsuli kɛ huli: Ezri, Kelub bi ɔ Wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ: Shimei nɛ je Rama a Wai to he ɔmɛ: Zabdi nɛ je Shefam ɔ Oliv, kɛ tso kpahi nɛ ngɛ kpo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ: Baal Hanan nɛ je Geder ɔ Nu to he ɔmɛ: Yoash Nahi nɛ a ngɛ lɛe ngɛ Sharon nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ: Shirtai nɛ je Sharon ɔ Nahi nɛ a ngɛ lɛe ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ: Shafat, Adlai bi ɔ Afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ: Obil, Ishmael no ɔ Teji ɔmɛ: Yedeya nɛ je Meronot ɔ Jijɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ apletsi ɔmɛ: Yaziz, Hagri no ɔ. David nitsɛ ga woli Matsɛ David tsɛko Yonatan ji ga wolɔ.
E ngɛ juɛmi saminya, nɛ e le womi mi hulɔ.
E kɛ Hakmoni bi Yehiel ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hyɛɛ matsɛbimɛ ɔmɛ a ní kasemi nɔ.
Ahitofel ji matsɛ ɔ ga wolɔ, nɛ Ark no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hushai ɔ ji matsɛ ɔ huɛ.
Benɛ Ahitofel gbo ɔ, Benaya bi Yehoyada, kɛ Abiatar ba pee ga woli.
Yoab ji matsɛ tabo ɔ nyatsɛ.
David nyagbe munyuhi Matsɛ David kpee Israel ma ní tsuli nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yerusalem: wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, asafo kuu ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a weto ní, kɛ a lohwehi a nɔ.
Jehanɛ hu, matsɛ we mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ, ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo ɔ tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem.
Kɛkɛ nɛ David ba da si ngɛ ma a hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ ye ma, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Jinɛ i to nɛ ma po we nitsɛ nɛ a to somi daka a, he nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ hii ɔ ngɛ mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa hia kɛ ha we nɛ ɔ pomi ɔ, i bua nya.
Se Mawu de mi ke, ‘Pi mo nɛ o maa po we kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami; ejakaa ta bulɔ ji mo, nɛ o pue muɔ si.’ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hla imi, kɛ ye nina kaa waa ye Israel nɔ matsɛ kɛ ya neneene.
Yawɛ hla Yuda wɛtso ɔ, nɛ e pee mɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli.
Jehanɛ, e hla tsaatsɛ we ɔ, nɛ ngɛ tsaatsɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, e ná ye he bua jɔmi, nɛ e wo mi Israel tsuo nɔ matsɛ.
E ha mi bimɛ babauu, nɛ e hla Salomo kɛ je ye binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ke e ba hi matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ e ye Yawɛ nitsɛ ma, Israel ɔ nɔ.
“Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘O bi Salomo ji nɔ nɛ maa ma ye we ɔ; ejakaa i hla lɛ kɛ pee ye bi, nɛ imi hu ma pee e tsɛ.
Ke e ma tsa nɔ maa ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye fami ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ pee amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ma ha nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si daa.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ nɛ ji Yawɛ ma a hɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ wo wɔ ɔ a nɔ fitsofitso.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, zugba kpakpa nɛ ɔ maa pee nyɛ nɔ daa, nɛ nyɛ ma si kɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ nɛ maa ba ngɛ nyɛ se ɔ kaa gbosi ní kɛ maa ya neneene.” Jehanɛ, David de Salomo ke, “Ye bi Salomo, i ngɛ mo dee ke ó le o tsɛ e Mawu ɔ, nɛ o sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ o tsui tsuo, kɛ o juɛmi tsuo; ejakaa Yawɛ le wa susumi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa suɔmi nya ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ke o hla e se blɔ ɔ, e ma he mo; se ke o kua lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e maa je o se kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ná nɛ o le kaa Yawɛ hla mo konɛ o ma e we klɔuklɔu ɔ. Pee kã nɛ o kɛ tsu ní tsumi nɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ David ngɔ foni ɔ nɛ a maa hyɛ nɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ e mi tsu ɔmɛ ɔ, nito he ɔmɛ, hiɔwe tsu ɔmɛ, se tsu ɔmɛ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, he nɛ a kɛ yayami paa ngɛ ɔ ngɔ ha Salomo.
David ha Salomo fonihi nɛ a maa hyɛ a nɔ kɛ ma níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e juɛmi mi, Yawɛ we ɔ he kue ɔmɛ, tsuhi nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, níhi nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ nike níhi nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ a to hehi.
Jehanɛ, David ha Salomo fonihi nɛ a maa hyɛ nɔ kɛ dla ní tsumi ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ a maa hyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a nɔ ha.
E tsɔɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu hiɛmi nɛ á ngmɛ kɛ pee níhi nɛ a kɛ ma sɔmɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kane tso ɔmɛ kɛ a he kane ɔmɛ, sika hiɔ okplɔɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ sika tsu okplɔɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔɔ abolo kɛ maa nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ. Jehanɛ, David tsɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi hiɛmi nɛ a kɛ pee faka amɛ, ka amɛ, kɛ kplu ɔmɛ.
E tsɔɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu hiɛmi nɛ a kɛ pee likɔkɔ ɔmɛ.
E tsɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi hiɛmi nɛ a kɛ pee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa pee zugba lɛ ɔ kɛ ha kerub ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi kɛ ha Yawɛ somi daka a he ɔ. Matsɛ David de Salomo ke, “Foni ɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ha nɛ a pee, nɛ e ngɔ ha mi nɛ ma hyɛ nɔ kɛ tsu ní ɔ, a ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wo mi.” Nyagbe ɔ, Matsɛ David de e bi Salomo ke, “Wlua mo, nɛ o pee kã, nɛ o tsu ní ɔ. Koo ye gbeye, nɛ o tsui ko po; ejakaa Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ.
E be mo kuae, nɛ e be mo sie kɛ yaa si o maa gbe e we ɔ he ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo nya.
A dla ní tsumi ngɔ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ma tsu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Ní tsuli nɛ le ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi pee klaalo nɛ a maa piɛ o he.
Jehanɛ se hu, ma a, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ mlɛe nɛ o wo gbi, konɛ a ba piɛ o he.”
Nike ní kɛ ha Yawɛ we ɔ mami Matsɛ David de ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke, “Ye bi Salomo nɔ kake too nɛ Mawu hla a, jokuɛyo ji lɛ; e kpa we níhi a si lolo.
Ní tsumi ɔ yi gbo; ejakaa pi nimli a mɔ nɛ a yaa mami ɔ, se Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ e we.
Níhi nɛ a kɛ maa ma ye Mawu ɔ we ɔ, i bɔ mɔde bua nya: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, tso, tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, tɛhi nɛ kpɛɔ, tɛhi nɛ a kɛ maa níhi a mi, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kpa komɛ.
Ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa a se ɔ, i ngɔ imi nitsɛ ye sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ngɔ ha, ejakaa i suɔ Mawu we ɔ. I ha sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ jiimi pe tɔn lafa, kɛ sika hiɔ ngmingmiingmi nɛ jiimi maa su tɔn lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi eywiɛ nɛ a kɛ ha gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ a kɛ pee níhi tsuo nɛ ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ maa pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ bie ke nyɛ ti mɛnɔ suɔ kaa e maa je e tsui mi faa nɛ e ke Yawɛ nɔ́ ko lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ, wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ ní tsumihi nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ si a gugue ke a ma ha ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ: sika tsu nɛ jiimi pe tɔn lafa kɛ nyingmi kpaago, sika hiɔ nɛ jiimi pe tɔn lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi eywiɛ, akɔblee nɛ jiimi maa su tɔn lafa ekpa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ dade nɛ jiimi pe tɔn akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.
Nihi nɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɛ a dɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ. Nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔ ji Yehiel nɛ je Levi we puɔ nya nɛ a tsɛɛ Gershon ɔ. Ma a ke Yawɛ ní kɛ je a tsui mi faa, nɛ a nya nɛ a bua jɔ a he kaa a nyɛ pee nɔ́ ko kaa ja.
Matsɛ David hu bua jɔ e he saminya, nɛ e nya.
David je Mawu yi Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ David je Yawɛ yi ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, wa nɛ̃ Yakob Mawu, a je o yi kɛ ya neneene!
O kle, o ngɛ he wami, kɛ hɛ mi nyami; o yeɔ kunimi, nɛ o yeɔ matsɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, o nɔ́.
Matsɛ ji mo, nɛ o yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ.
Ní nami, kɛ hɛ mi nyami tsuo jee o dɛ mi.
O kɛ o he wami yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ; mo lɛ o haa nɔ biɛ, kɛ he wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa Mawu, wa ngɛ mo si nae, nɛ wa ngɛ o biɛ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ yi jee.
“I kɛ ye ma a, mɛnɔmɛ ji wɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ je wa tsui mi faa kɛ ke mo ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, mo lɛ o ke wɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo nitsɛ o níhi wa ngɔ ba ha mo nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ lee, o le kaa wa ngɛ kaa nibwɔhi, kɛ blɔ nyɛɛli kaa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pɛ.
Wa wami ligbi ɔmɛ bee kɛ yaa kaa hɔ̃, nɛ wa be nyɛe maa tu gbenɔ nya fo.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu lee, níhi babauu nɛ wa ngɔ kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ po we ha mo, konɛ a kɛ wo o biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, o dɛ mi a je, o níhi ji tsuo kulaa.
Ye Mawu, i le kaa moo lɛɛ o hyɛɛ nɔ tsui mi nɛ o kɛ leɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hi, ejakaa o naa ni kpakpahi a he bua jɔmi.
I ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ ke mo kɛ je ye tsui mi faa, nɛ i na kaa o ma nɛ ba pue si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a je a tsui mi faa ba ke mo ní.
Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu lee, ha nɛ suɔmi nɛ o ma a ngɛ kɛ ha mo ɔ nɛ tsa nɔ; ha nɛ a bu mo tue kɛ ya neneene.
Ha nɛ ye bi Salomo nɛ ye o mlaa amɛ, o fami ɔmɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ, konɛ e po we ɔ nɛ i dla e he níhi kɛ to ɔ ha mo.” A wo Salomo matsɛ Jehanɛ, David de ma kpekpemi ɔ ke, “Nyɛ je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ yi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo je Yawɛ a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ yi.
A kpla si nɛ a ja Yawɛ, nɛ a wo matsɛ ɔ hu hɛ mi nyami.
E nɔ jena a, a ngɔ na ku akpe, agbosu akpe, kɛ jijɔ akpe kɛ sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ.
A sã bɔ kpahi babauu hulɔ, nɛ a sã wai bɔ kɛ ha Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma a bua jɔ a he wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa a ye ní, nɛ a nu ní ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a wo Salomo matsɛ si enyɔne.
A pɔ lɛ nu ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi kaa ganɔ, nɛ a pɔ Zadok hu nu kaa osɔfo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Salomo ba hi matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ to sisi ɔ nɔ ngɛ e tsɛ David nane mi.
E matsɛ yemi ɔ ya nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ Israel ma a tsuo buɔ lɛ tue.
Ma nikɔtɔma a mɛ, ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ Matsɛ David nitsɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo wo si kaa a kɛ Matsɛ Salomo maa hi si saminya.
Yawɛ wo Salomo nɔ gojoo; e ha nɛ e na biɛ ngɛ Israel tsuo, nɛ e hɛ mi ba nyami pe Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ sɛ e hlami ɔ. David matsɛ yemi he sane kpiti David, Ishai bi ɔ ye Israel tsuo nɔ matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
E hi Hebron kɛ ye matsɛ jeha kpaago, nɛ e hi Yerusalem hu kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ etɛ.
E na ní babauu, nɛ a buu lɛ hulɔ.
E bwɔ kotokoto loko e gbo, nɛ e bi Salomo ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Matsɛ David he sane kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma ngɛ gbali etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a blema sanehi a mi: Samuel, Natan, kɛ Gad.
Níhi nɛ ngɛ sane nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ji Matsɛ David tsɛ yemi, e he wami, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ba lɛ David ɔ, Israel ma a, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a nɔ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Kronika Kekleekle Womi ɔ nɔ tsami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kronika Womi Enyɔne nɛ ɔ jeɔ sisi kɛ Matsɛ Salomo tsɛ yemi he sane, hluu kɛ ya si e gbenɔ.
Salomo gbenɔ se, benɛ e bi Rehoboam ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ɔ, Yeroboam kɛ omleyi je ma amɛ tsɔ atuã.
Kɛ je atuã tsɔmi nɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yuda, aloo leneyi je matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si be nɛ a kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi jeha loko a fɔ Kristo ɔ titli ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Kronika Womi Enyɔne ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Salomo matsɛ yemi .—.
a. Sisije jeha amɛ .- b.
A ma Yawɛ we ɔ .—.
d. Nyagbe jeha amɛ .—.
Omleyi je wɛtso ɔmɛ tsɔ atuã .- Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ .—.
A kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi .-
Matsɛ Salomo bi nile Matsɛ David bi Salomo tsɛ yemi ɔ ya nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ gbaa lɛ, nɛ e pee lɛ nɔmlɔ ngua.
Matsɛ Salomo kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo tu munyu: asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nihi akpehi kɛ lafahi a nya a, kojoli, ma nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nɛ Salomo kɛ ma a tsuo pue nɔ kɛ ho jami he ɔ ya ngɛ Gibeon.
A ya lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa kpe he bo tsu ɔ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose pee ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, Gibeon ji he nɛ e ngɛ.
(Somi daka a lɛɛ benɛ David ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ je Kiriat Yearim kɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ, e pee bo tsu ha lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ma mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.)
Akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ Uri bi Bezalel, Hur bibi ɔ pee ɔ hu maa si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ Gibeon.
Matsɛ Salomo kɛ ma a tsuo ya ja Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Salomo gbe lohwe akpe nɛ e kɛ sã sami bɔ ngɛ he nɛ a jaa Yawɛ ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Salomo, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o suɔ nɛ ma ha mo?” Salomo he nɔ ke, “O je suɔmi agbo kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ tsaatsɛ David; nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, o ha nɛ i ba ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ e se.
Yawɛ Mawu lee, si nɛ o wo tsaatsɛ ɔ, moo ye nɔ koo.
O wo mi matsɛ ngɛ ma nɛ a he hiɛ babauu kaa zugba zu nɛ ɔ a nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha mi nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi nɛ ma kɛ ye ma nɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Ke pi ja a, lɛɛ kɛ ma pee kɛ ye o ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛɛ?” Mawu he nɔ nɛ e de Salomo ke, “O bi nɔ́ nɛ sa pɛ.
O bi we ní nami, aloo june, aloo biɛ.
O bi we ke a gbe o he nyɛli ha mo, aloo a ha nɛ o wami se nɛ kɛ.
Mohu ɔ, o bi nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi nɛ o kɛ ye ye ma a nɛ i wo mo matsɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ha mo nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.
Jehanɛ, ma wo mo ní, nɛ ma ha mo june, kɛ biɛ nɛ matsɛ ko matsɛ ko na we hyɛ.
O se hu matsɛ ko matsɛ ko be nae kɛ mo maa sɔ.” Matsɛ Salomo he wami kɛ e ní nami Kɛkɛ nɛ Salomo je jami he ɔ ngɛ Gibeon, he nɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.
E hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
Salomo bua ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ ta okpɔngɔhi a nya, nɛ e na ta zugba lɛ akpe kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ, kɛ ta okpɔngɔ akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ e ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e ngɔ ekomɛ hu ya to ma kpa komɛ a mi.
Salomo yi nɔ ɔ, sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu hiɛ babauu ngɛ Yerusalem kaa tɛ; seda tso hu pɔ he kaa sikamore tso.
Matsɛ Salomo tsɔli ya heɔ okpɔngɔ ngɛ Musri kɛ Kilikia kɛ ba haa lɛ.
A ya heɔ ta zugba lɛhi hu ngɛ Egipt.
Mɛ kɛ̃ a ya heɔ okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta zugba lɛhi, nɛ a ya juaa kɛ haa Hit, kɛ Siria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
A juaa ta zugba lɛ kake sika hiɔ yi lafa ekpa, kɛ okpɔngɔ kake sika hiɔ yi lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Salomo dla ní kɛ ha Yawɛ we ɔ mami Jehanɛ, Matsɛ Salomo to e yi mi kaa e maa po we kɛ ha Yawɛ nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ e ma matsɛ we kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he.
E hla nihi akpe nyingmi kpaago nɛ a maa tloo tlomi, kɛ nihi akpe nyingmi kpaanyɔ nɛ a ma gba tɛ.
Nihi nɛ maa hyɛ ní tsumi ɔ nɔ ji akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.
Salomo tsɔ nɛ a kɛ sɛ gbi ya ha Tiro matsɛ, Hiram ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ tsaatsɛ David hi si, nɛ o ha lɛ seda tsohi nɛ e kɛ po we nɛ e hi mi ɔ, o kɛ mi nɛ hi si ja nɔuu.
I yaa po we kɛ wo Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
We nɛ ɔ maa pee he klɔuklɔu nɛ a hla kɛ to ha Yawɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ i kɛ ye ma a ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ ngɛ.
Wa maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via, nɛ waa kɛ abolo klɔuklɔu ɔ maa ma Yawɛ hɛ mi daa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, wa maa sã sami bɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Wa maa sã sami bɔhi Hejɔɔmi ligbi, Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, kɛ nyami be kpahi hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Blɔ nya nɛ Yawɛ to kɛ ha Israel kɛ yaa neneene ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
We nɛ ma po nɛ ɔ maa kle agbo; ejakaa wa Mawu ɔ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Se mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa po we nɛ sa ha Mawu?
Hiɔwe lokoo ɔ nitsɛ po klee we ha lɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mi mɔ nɛ ma po we ha Yawɛ, kaa ja he nɛ a maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha lɛ ngɛ kɛkɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo wo nyumu ko nɛ ga ngɛ e hɛ mi blɔ kɛ ba ha mi.
E pee nɔ ko nɛ le sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, kɛ dade he ga ní tsumi, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ngma ní ngɛ nɔ hulɔ.
Jehanɛ, e pee nɔ ko nɛ le bo bluu, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ bo tsu lomi.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ ma ba piɛ ga ní tsuli nɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem nɛ tsaatsɛ David hla mɛ kɛ to ɔ a he kɛ tsu ní.
I le kaa o tsɔli nɛ ngɛ Lebanon ɔ le tso hɛmi saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ a hɛ seda, sɛsɛo, kɛ algum tsohi ha mi.
Ye tsɔli ɔmɛ ma ba piɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ a he kɛ gba tso babauu ha mi; ejakaa we nɛ i to nɛ ma po nɛ ɔ maa kle agbo, nɛ e maa hi fɛu saminya.
Ma mane o ní tsuli ɔmɛ ngma nɛ jiɔmi ji tɔn akpe enyɔ, akoko nɛ jiɔmi ji tɔn akpe enyɔ, wai lita akpe lafa eywiɛ, kɛ oliv nu hu lita akpe lafa eywiɛ.” Matsɛ Hiram ngma womi kɛ mane Salomo ke, “Akɛnɛ Yawɛ suɔ e ma a he je ɔ, e wo mo matsɛ ngɛ a nɔ.
Á je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a yi!
E ha Matsɛ David bi ní lelɔ; nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka si, nɛ e ngɛ juɛmi; nɔ nɛ ma ba po we ha Yawɛ, nɛ e maa ma lɛ nitsɛ hu e we.
I ngɛ ga ní tsulɔ ko nɛ hɛ mi ka si saminya tsɔe kɛ ma o ngɔ; e biɛ ji Huram.
E nyɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi, se e tsɛ lɛɛ Tiro no ji lɛ.
E le sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, tɛ, kɛ tso a he ní tsumi.
E tsuɔ bo bluu, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ bo tsu he ní.
E nyɛɔ nɛ e ngmaa ní kɛ woɔ níhi a mi, nɛ níhi a he foni tsuaa foni nɛ a kɛ maa tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ, e nyɛɔ tsuɔ he ní.
Ha nɛ e piɛ o ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ o tsɛ David ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ a he kɛ tsu ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngma a, akoko ɔ, wai ɔ, kɛ oliv nu ɔ nɛ o wo ta a, kɛ mane wɔ jehanɛ.
Wa maa hɛ seda tsuo nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ ngɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Wa maa fi mɛ kɛ bla, nɛ waa kɛ maa gu wo nɔ kɛ ya pue Yopa, konɛ o ha nɛ a ya muɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya Yerusalem.” A je Yawɛ we ɔ pomi sisi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Salomo ha a kane nibwɔhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ David pee ɔ; nɛ a na nibwɔhi akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ etɛ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.
E dla ní tsumi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha mɛ: nihi akpe nyingmi kpaago maa tloo tlomi, akpe nyingmi kpaanyɔ ma gba tɛ, nɛ akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa maa hyɛ ni ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ a tsu ní ɔ saminya.
Jehanɛ, Salomo je Yawɛ we ɔ mami sisi ngɛ Yerusalem, ngɛ Moria yo ɔ nɔ, he nɛ Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ e tsɛ David ngɛ ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ ji Yebus no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Arauna a ngma mi sami he.
Matsɛ David ji nɔ nɛ hla lejɛ ɔ kɛ to kɛ ha we ɔ pomi.
Benɛ Salomo ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, jeha eywiɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi lɛ e bɔni we ɔ mami.
Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ Matsɛ Salomo ma a, e kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue enuɔ.
Kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ kami ji gugue enuɔ, kaa we ɔ mi blimi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E hiɔwe yami ji gugue nyingmi etɛ.
A kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha gbogbo ɔ he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi blɔ.
A ka seda tso kɛ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ tsu nguaa a mi; a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he, nɛ a tɛni tãhi kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔhi kɛ wo mi.
Matsɛ ɔ kɛ tɛ saminyawiiwi nɛ he jua wa dla Yawɛ we ɔ he.
Sika tsu ɔ lɛɛ Parvaim zugba a nɔ a ná kɛ je.
E kɛ sika tsu ha Yawɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ, plai ɔmɛ, sinya tso ɔmɛ, kɛ sinya amɛ a he.
Ní tsuli ɔmɛ tɛni bɔfohi nɛ a tsɛɛ kerub kɛ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ a he.
Kpɛti tsu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a kami ji gugue enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue enuɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ we ɔ blimi ɔ ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ jiɔmi pe tɔn nyingmi enyɔ ha gbogbo ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ngmɛ sika tsu kilo fa kɛ se kɛ pee plɛɛko.
Hiɔwe tsu ɔmɛ hu e kɛ sika tsu ha gbogbo ɔmɛ a he.
Jehanɛ, matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ e ní tsuli ɔmɛ hlɔ kerub enyɔ nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ha a he, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ya ma he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a.
-Kerub ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ a sibi a kasa nya, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee sinya a nya.
Kerub kake ngɛ pɛli enyɔ; pɛli kake kami ji gugue kake kɛ bɔɔ ngɛ se.
Kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a mi.
Kerub kake pɛli nya ya pi gbogbo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ kake hu pɛli nya ya pi gbogbo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ ní enyɔ ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a nya ya kpe ngɛ tsu ɔ kpɛti tutuutu.
Kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a gbɛ a mi ɔ tsuo kami ji gugue enuɔ.
A kɛ kpa bluu, kpa he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kploba kpɛ tsu mi pomi bo nɛ a lo kerubhi kɛ wo mi ha he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. Akɔblee titima enyɔ ɔmɛ Matsɛ ɔ pee titima enyɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi; titima kake hiɔwe yami ji gugue kpaanyɔ kɛ fa.
E pee akɔblee kpɔ enyɔ kɛ ma titima amɛ a yi mi; kake hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma.
E pee mɔmɔ jlasi nɛ a lo kaa kɔsɔkɔsɔ, kɛ akɔblee kpɔ kokloo lafa kɛ ma titima enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi mi.
A ngɔ akɔblee titima enyɔ ɔmɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya; a wo nɔ́ nɛ maa si ngɛ leneyi je ɔ biɛ ke Yakin, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ lɛɛ a wo lɛ biɛ ke Boaz.
Yawɛ we ɔ mi níhi Matsɛ Salomo ha nɛ a pee akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ; e kami ji gugue enuɔ, e blimi ji gugue enuɔ, nɛ e hiɔwe yami ji gugue enyɔ kɛ fa.
Jehanɛ, e pee akɔblee nyu nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kokloo, nɛ e mi kuɔmi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma.
Kɛ je e nya hiɛ kɛ ya si hiɛ ɔ, e peeɔ gugue enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ kpa nɛ kami ji gugue kpaago kɛ fa maa kpe he.
A pee akɔblee tɔhi gbaka enyɔ kɛ bɔle nyu nɔ́ ɔ kuɔ si kɛ kpe; a sile akɔblee kɛ pee a kɛ nyu nɔ́ ɔ tsuo kake.
Nyu nɔ́ ɔ maa si ngɛ akɔblee na nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ a nɔ; etɛ plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee omleyi je, etɛ plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee bonyoku je, etɛ plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee leneyi je, nɛ etɛ hu plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee beleku je.
Mɛ tsuo a plɛ a se ngɔ wo nyu nɔ́ ɔ. Nyu nɔ́ ɔ timi ngɛ kaa dɛ mi blimi.
A pee e nya kaa bɔ nɛ kplu nya ngɛ ɔ, kaa mɔmɔ nɛ blɛke; nɛ nyu maa pee buɛ akpe etɛ lɛ yaa mi.
Jehanɛ, a pee akɔblee kã nyɔngma; a kɛ enuɔ ma Yawɛ we ɔ leneyi je, nɛ a kɛ enuɔ ma omleyi je.
A pee akɔblee kã nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ́ a fɔ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ɔ a he, nɛ a jale a he ngɛ a mi.
Nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ma fɔ a he.
Jehanɛ, a pee sika tsu kane tso nyɔngma kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ke a pee ɔ, nɛ a kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ; enuɔ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ enuɔ ngɛ muɔ nɔ.
A kpɛ okplɔɔ nyɔngma kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ mi; enuɔ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ enuɔ ngɛ muɔ nɔ.
A pee sika tsu kã lafa hulɔ.
A pee kue kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ kue ngua a.
A kpɛ sinya kɛ wo kue ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a kɛ akɔblee ha sinya amɛ a he.
A kɛ nyu nɔ́ ɔ ma Yawɛ we ɔ leneyi je kɛ beleku je a kpɛti kɔ nya he ko.
-Jehanɛ, Huram pee buɛhi, sofihi, kɛ kãhi.
Mawu we ɔ he ní tsumi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo ha lɛ tsumi ɔ, e gbe lɛ tsuo nya.
Níhi nɛ e pee ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Akɔblee titima enyɔ ɔmɛ Akɔblee kpɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ma titima amɛ a yi mi ɔ Ya enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a lo kɛ mɔmɔ nɛ a pee kaa kɔsɔkɔsɔ ngɔ ma titima enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi mi ɔ Akɔblee kpɔ kokloohi kaa tso yiblii lafa eywiɛ nɛ a pee ngɔ wo kla enyɔɔnyɔ a mi kɛ bɔle kpɔ ɔmɛ ɔ Tlɔɔke nyɔngma amɛ Kã nyɔngma amɛ Nyu nɔ́ ɔ Akɔblee na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nyu nɔ́ ɔ maa si ngɛ a nɔ ɔ Buɛ ɔmɛ, sofi ɔmɛ, kɛ faka amɛ.
Yawɛ we ɔ he ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Huram pee ha Matsɛ Salomo ɔ, akɔblee nɛ a sa he lɛ a kɛ pee.
Matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ a sɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ akɔblee galɔ ní tsumi he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Sukot kɛ Zereda a kpɛti ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ. Ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pee ɔ hiɛ babauu nitsɛ nɛ nɔ ko li akɔblee nɛ a kɛ pee mɛ ɔ nya.
Matsɛ Salomo ha a kɛ sika tsu pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ mi: bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ; kane tso ɔmɛ, kɛ kane ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee, nɛ a maa su kɛ ma he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ, mɔmɔ ɔmɛ, kane ɔmɛ, abɛɛle ɔmɛ, la gbemi ní ɔmɛ, kã amɛ, ngɛyu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via woɔ a mi ɔ, kɛ ngɛyu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ jeɔ la a.
A kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
A kɛ sika tsu ha Yawɛ we ɔ kpo nɔ je sinya amɛ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a sinya amɛ a he.
Benɛ Matsɛ Salomo gbe Yawɛ we ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ tsuo nya a, e ngɔ níhi tsuo nɛ e tsɛ David gbaa nɔ ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ ngɔ to nito hehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ní ɔmɛ ji sika hiɔ, sika tsu, kɛ ní kpa komɛ.
A ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ mi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Salomo ya kpee Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, konɛ a ya ngɔ Yawɛ somi daka a kɛ je Zion, David ma a mi kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ mi.
Mɛ tsuo a ba bua a he nya ngɛ Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ nɔ.
Benɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba bua a he nya a, osɔfo ɔmɛ ba wo somi daka a nɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ ho Yawɛ we ɔ mi ya.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ hɛɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ hulɔ kɛ ho Yawɛ we ɔ mi ya.
Jehanɛ, Matsɛ Salomo kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ya bua a he nya ngɛ somi daka a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbe to kɛ na babauu nɛ a li nya kɛ sã bɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ somi daka a ya ma e blɔ he ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi.
Kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi kɛ ha daka a, kɛ tsohi nɛ a kɛ hɛɛ daka a a he.
Tso ɔmɛ ka gagaa bɔ nɛ ke nɔ ko daa si ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a hɛ mi ɔ, e maa na a nya amɛ nɛ je kpo; se a nya amɛ ji kpo ngɛ kpo nɔ je.
Tso ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be somi daka a mi, kaa ja tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ Mose ngɔ to lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ. Yawɛ kɛ Israel ma a so somi ngɛ Sinai, be mi nɛ a je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ma a. Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ - Osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ba bua a he nya a tsu a he, tsa pi ngɛ a kuu ɔmɛ a mi kɛkɛ.
Levi bi, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ji lali ɔmɛ tsuo bu kploba saminyawiiwi.
Mɛ ji Asaf, Heman, kɛ Yedutun, kɛ a bimɛ, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ ya da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ beleku je kɛ a dɛ mi ngmlɛhi, bɛhi, kɛ sakuhi.
Osɔfohi lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ piɛ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae.
Titimati kpali ɔmɛ, ngmlɛ fiali ɔmɛ, kɛ saku fiali ɔmɛ piɛ lali ɔmɛ a he, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nya sɔ kɛ wo la a nɔ.
A la kɛ je Yawɛ yi ke, “A je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa e hi, ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, bɔku ba ha lejɛ ɔ tlukaa.
Bɔku nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe kaa Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a kpale kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ya tsu ní.
Salomo kɛ ma a tu munyu Kɛkɛ nɛ Salomo sɔle ke, “Yawɛ, o ke o maa hi diblii kpii mi.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i po we saminyayoo ko ha mo nɛ o hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya neneene.” Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Salomo plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ kpee mɛ, nɛ e gbaa mɛ.
E de ke, “A je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi; ejakaa si ko nɛ e wo tsaatsɛ David ɔ, e ye nɔ.
Yawɛ de David ke, ‘Kɛ je be nɛ i jé ye ma Israel kɛ je Egipt ɔ, i hla we ma ko ma ko kɛ ji Israel wɛtso ko mi nɛ a po we ha mi, nɛ a ja mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ i hla we nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ba ye ganɔ ngɛ ye ma Israel ɔ nɔ.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ i hla Yerusalem, konɛ a ja mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; i hla mo David hulɔ, nɛ o ye ye ma Israel ɔ nɔ.’ ” Salomo ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Jinɛ tsaatsɛ David to kaa e maa po we nɛ a ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ mi, se Yawɛ de lɛ ke, ‘O pee saminya kaa o to o yi mi kaa o maa po we ha mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, tsa pi mo nɛ o maa po we ɔ; mo nitsɛ o bi lɛ ma ba po we ɔ ha mi.’ “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ye e siwo ɔ nɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ e de to ɔ, i ba ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ tsaatsɛ David se, nɛ we ɔ, he nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, i po.
I ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ mi.
Somi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ e ma Israel so ɔ ngɛ daka nɛ ɔ mi.” Salomo fa kue ha Yawɛ Jehanɛ benɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ngɛ Salomo hyɛe ɔ, e ho ya da bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e wo e nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e sɔle.
(Salomo pee akɔblee kpoku ko nɛ a maa da nɔ kɛ ma kue ɔ kpɛti tutuutu.
E kami ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, e blimi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, nɛ e hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi ekpa.
Salomo kuɔ kpoku nɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpla si ngɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ e wo e nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe.)
E sɔle ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu lee, mawu ko mawu ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba nɛ ngɛ kaa mo!
Somi nɛ o kɛ o ma a so ɔ, o yeɔ nɔ; nɛ ke a bu mo tue kɛ a tsui tsuo ɔ, o jeɔ o suɔmi nɛ se pui ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Si ko nɛ o wo tsaatsɛ David ɔ, o ye nɔ; nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o de to ɔ ba mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, Israel Mawu lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ, si nɛ o wo tsaatsɛ, benɛ o de lɛ ke, ke e binyumu ɔmɛ maa ye o mlaa a nɔ sisiisi kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ɔ, a maa ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, ha jamɛ a siwo ɔ hu nɛ ba mi.
Yawɛ, Israel Mawu lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ, níhi tsuo nɛ o de o tsɔlɔ David ɔ, ha nɛ a ba mi.
“Se anɛ mo Mawu, o kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ma nyɛ maa hi zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ niinɛ lo?
Mo, nɛ hiɔwe kɛ hiɔwe se lokoo po kpi mo ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ we nɛ i po nɛ ɔ maa kpe mo?
Yawɛ, ye Mawu lee, o tsɔlɔ ji mi.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu ye kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ níhi nɛ i ngɛ mo bie mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, o pee ha mi.
Bu we nɛ ɔ he nyɔ kɛ pia.
O wo si kaa hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a ma ja mo ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i plɛ ye hɛ mi ngɔ kpee we nɛ ɔ nɛ i fa kue ha mo ɔ, moo bu mi tue.
Ke imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, aloo o ma Israel ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ba fa kue ha mo ɔ, o nu ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o ngɔ wa he yayami ngɔ pa wɔ.
“Ke a po nɔ ko nya kaa e tɔ e nyɛmi nɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba da o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ we nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a ke e ka kita kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e pee we yayami ko ɔ, Yawɛ lee, moo bu tue ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o kojo o tsɔli ɔmɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ye fɔ ɔ, gbla e tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ lɛɛ o wo lɛ nguɔ.
“Ke o ma Israel he nyɛli ba ye a nɔ ngɛ yayami ko nɛ a pee kɛ si mo ɔ he, nɛ a pia a he, nɛ a ba we nɛ ɔ mi nɛ a ba kpa mo pɛɛ kɛ he si bami ɔ, moo bu tue ngɛ hiɔwe.
Ngɔɔ yayami nɛ o ma a pee ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ o kpale mɛ kɛ ba zugba a nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.
“Ke o tsi hiɔmi nya ngɛ yayami ko nɛ o ma Israel pee kɛ si mo ɔ he, nɛ pee se ɔ, a tsake a tsui nɛ a ba we nɛ ɔ mi ba kpa mo pɛɛ kɛ he si bami ɔ, Yawɛ lee, moo bu mɛ tue ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o ngɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Israel ma a a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ.
Tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ lee, ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ ngɛ o zugba a nɛ o ngɔ ha o ma a kaa a weto ní kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɔ.
“Ke hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ, loo tsohi a he hiɔ, loo baalɛ ba zugba a nɔ, aloo ke he nyɛli ba sa o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a yi ngɔ wo a ma amɛ eko mi, haomi tsuaa haomi, aloo hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ nɛ ji ɔ, bu a kue fami ɔ tue.
Ke o ma Israel bi ɔmɛ ba we nɛ ɔ mi kakaaka, loo kutuu, nɛ a ba wo a nine nɔ nɛ a fa kue ha mo kɛ je a tsui mi ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a hiami ní ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, moo nu a kue fami ɔ. Bu mɛ tue ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ.
Mo pɛ lɛ o le nɔmlɔ adesa tsui mi.
Moo pee nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiami ní ha lɛ, konɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye mo gbeye nɛ a bu mo, ligbi abɔ nɛ a ngɛ zugba a nɛ o ngɔ kɛ ha wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
“Ja kɛ̃, ke nubwɔ ko nɛ je ma se lokoo nu o biɛ, o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, kɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ o peeɔ kɛ haa o ma Israel ɔ he, nɛ e ba konɛ e ba fa kue ha mo ngɛ we nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, moo nu e pɛɛ kpami ɔ ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ ha lɛ, konɛ nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ nɛ a le mo, nɛ a bu mo kaa bɔ nɛ o ma, Israel buu mo ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa we nɛ ɔ nɛ i po ɔ, o biɛ ngɛ he.
“Ke o fa o ma a ke a kɛ a he nyɛli ya hwu, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee ma nɛ o hla ngɔ to nɛ ɔ, kɛ we nɛ i po ngɔ ha mo nɛ ɔ, nɛ a fa kue ha mo ɔ, bu mɛ tue.
Moo nu ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o ha nɛ a ye kunimi.
“Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ pee we yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ lee, ke e ba mi kaa o ma a pee yayami kɛ si mo, nɛ o mi mi fu mɛ nɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo a he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho a zugba nɔ ya, lejɛ ɔ kɛ jio, e kɛ we jio, bu o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ tue.
Ke benɛ a ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, a pia a he, nɛ a tsake a tsui, nɛ a jaje kaa a pee yayami, kɛ yi wu tso níhi ɔ, bu a kue fami ɔ tue.
Ke a tsake a tsui niinɛ ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee zugba nɛ ɔ nɛ o ngɔ ha wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nɛ ɔ nɛ o hla ngɔ to, kɛ we nɛ ɔ nɛ i po ngɔ ha mo ɔ, nɛ a fa kue ha mo ɔ, bu a kue fami ɔ tue.
Moo nu ngɛ o hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ o ngɔ o ma a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ.
“Ye Mawu lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ba o tue si ha wɔ nɛ o hyɛ wɔ, konɛ ke nɔ ko ba fa kue ha mo ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, o bu tue.
Yawɛ Mawu, jehanɛ lɛɛ moo te si nɛ o ba sɛ o we ɔ mi, he nɛ somi daka a nɛ tsɔɔ o he wami ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Moo gbaa o we osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ yi wami hemi, konɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ mo anɔkuale ɔ nɛ a na bua jɔmi ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ o peeɔ kɛ haa mɛ ɔ a he.
Yawɛ Mawu, matsɛ ɔ nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, koo je e se.
Mo kai suɔmi nɛ o ngɛ kɛ ha o tsɔlɔ David ɔ.”
Yawɛ we ɔ nya blimi Benɛ Matsɛ Salomo gbe e kue fami ɔ nya a, la je hiɔwe ba sã sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ bɔ kpa amɛ, nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ba hyi we ɔ tɔ.
Akɛnɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ba hyi we ɔ mi tɔ he je ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a sɛ mi.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo na la nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ, kɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ ba hyi we ɔ tɔ ɔ, a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si ngɛ he nɛ a ka tɛ ngɛ ɔ.
A ja Yawɛ, nɛ a na lɛ si, nɛ a de ke, “A je Yawɛ yi!
Ejakaa e hi, Ejakaa e mɔbɔ nami ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Salomo, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo sã bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Salomo ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã bɔ: na akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ, kɛ to akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ.
Kusumi nɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ma a tsuo pee kɛ bli Mawu we ɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ ya da a blɔ he ɔmɛ, nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ya da si nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi kɛ kpee osɔfo ɔmɛ.
A fia sakuhi nɛ Matsɛ David kpɛ ɔ kɛ je Yawɛ yi, nɛ a la ke, “Yawɛ suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa kɛ daa!” Blɔ nya nɛ David to kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ Israel ma a tsuo daa si ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ kpa titimatihi.
Salomo tsukɔ kue ɔ kpɛti je ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ he.
Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e sã sami bɔ ɔmɛ, niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ e zɔ ɔ ngɛ; ejakaa akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ klee we nɛ a maa sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nɔ.
Salomo kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ngɔ otsi kɛ ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Nimli babauu nitsɛ ba nyami be nɛ ɔ; a je tsitsaa Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ ya si Egipt huzu ɔ he ngɛ leneyi je.
A ye ligbi kpaago kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ hu a ye ligbi kpaago.
Nyagbe ligbi ɔ, a bɔ gua klɛdɛɛ ko, nɛ a kɛ mu nyami be ɔ nya.
E nɔ jena nɛ ji nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ɔ, Salomo wo ma a blɔ, nɛ a je kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya.
A bua jɔ a he, ejakaa Yawɛ gbaa e ma Israel, kɛ David, kɛ Salomo tsuo.
Mawu je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Salomo ekohu Jehanɛ lɛɛ Salomo ma Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ gbe nya; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e to ke e maa pee ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, e pee lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Salomo nyɔ mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I nu o kue fami ɔ, nɛ i ngɔ we nɛ ɔ kaa he nɛ a maa sã bɔhi ngɛ kɛ ha mi.
Ke e ba mi kaa i tsi hiɔmi nya, aloo i ha nɛ baalɛ ba ye ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ, aloo i ha nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba sɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a pia a he, nɛ a fa kue ha mi, nɛ a kpa yayami ɔ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, ma nu a kue fami ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ a yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ ma ha kplɔkɔtɔ maa ba a zugba a nɔ ekohu.
Ma bu we nɛ ɔ he daa, nɛ kue nɛ a maa fa ha mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, ma nu, ejakaa imi lɛ i hla we nɛ ɔ, nɛ i tsukɔ he, konɛ a ja mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ ya neneene.
Ma hyɛ we ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma bu he daa.
Ke o ma sɔmɔ mi kɛ o tsui tsuo, nɛ o maa ye mi anɔkuale kaa bɔ nɛ o tsɛ David pee ɔ, ke o maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa mo ke o pee ɔ, lɛɛ si ko nɛ i wo o tsɛ David ɔ, ma ye nɔ.
Imi lɛ i de lɛ ke ma ha e nina maa ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ nɛ.
Se ke mo, loo o nina jɔɔ ye se nyɛɛmi; ke nyɛ yi mlaa amɛ nɛ i wo nyɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi ɔ, lɛɛ ma je ye ma, Israel kɛ maa je zugba a nɛ i ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.
We nɛ ɔ nɛ i pee lɛ klɔuklɔu nɛ a ja mi ngɛ mi ɔ, ma je ye nine ngɛ he.
Je ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ maa ye e he fɛu, nɛ a maa hie lɛ.
“Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, bu ngɛ we nɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Se jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, we nɛ ɔ maa pee we doku, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bee ɔ, e he mi ma jɔ̃, nɛ e nya maa kpɛ e he, nɛ e ma bi ke, ‘Mɛni he je nɛ Yawɛ pee zugba nɛ ɔ, kɛ we nɛ ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?’ Nɛ nihi ma he nɔ ke, ‘Ejakaa Israel ma a kua Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ.
A ngɔ a he ya mɛtɛ mawu kpahi a he; a ja mɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Yawɛ kɛ haomi nɛ ɔ ba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.’ ”
Níhi nɛ Salomo tsu Salomo kɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ ma Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Jehanɛ, e dla mahi nɛ Matsɛ Hiram ha lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha Israel bi komɛ ya hi a mi.
Salomo ya ngɔ Hamat kɛ Zoba zugba a pani nya, nɛ e fia gbogbo ngɔ wo ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Palmira a he ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Mahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Hamat nɛ a toɔ ní ngɛ a mi ɔ, Salomo dla po jamɛ a ma amɛ ehe.
E po ma nɛ ɔmɛ hu ehe: Bet Horon nɛ ngɛ yiti je ɔ, kɛ Bet Horon nɛ ngɛ sisi je ɔ. E fia gbogbo ngɔ wo ma nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e wo a nya agbohi kɛ a se lami dade.
Ma kpahi nɛ Salomo dla po ji Baalat, mahi tsuo nɛ e toɔ ní ngɛ a mi ɔ, kɛ mahi he nɛmɛ nɛ e we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. E po mahi bɔ nɛ e suɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ Lebanon, kɛ e nɔ yemi he kpa amɛ.
-Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ Kanaan zugba a, Kanaan bi nɛ piɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ gbi mɛ ɔ ji nihi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo nyɛ a nɔ kɛ tsu ní tsumi kpakpataahi.
Mɛ ji Hit bi, Amor bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi; nɛ a nina ngɛ nyɔguɛ yee kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Israel bi ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ Salomo ngɔɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ pee we nyɔguɛ; mɛɛ a tsu ní kaa e ta buli tsɔli, asafoatsɛmɛ, ta zugba lɛ nyatsɛmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ nɔ hili.
Matsɛ Salomo tsɔli nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a hyɛɛ ní tsumi slɔɔto ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a hiɛmi ji lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ.
Salomo klɛ̃ e yo, Egipt matsɛ biyo ɔ kɛ je David ma a mi kɛ ho we ko nɛ e po ha lɛ ɔ mi ya.
Salomo de ke, “E sɛ́ kaa ye yo ɔ hii Israel matsɛ, David we ɔ mi; ejakaa he tsuaa he nɛ Yawɛ somi daka a ba a, lejɛ ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Salomo sã bɔhi kɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ e ma ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɔ.
E sã sami bɔhi, kaa bɔ nɛ Mose mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa a pee nyami be ɔmɛ, Hejɔɔmi ligbihi, Nyɔhiɔhe nyami behi, kɛ nyami be etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a yeɔ ngɛ jeha mi ɔ. Mɛ ji Abolokplolo nyami be, Ngmakpami nyami be, kɛ Gbasisihimi nyami be.
Blɔ nya nɛ Salomo tsɛ, David to kɛ fɔ si ɔ, Salomo hyɛ jamɛ a blɔ nya tomi ɔ nɔ kɛ dla ní tsumi kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ.
E ngɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi hu ngɔ wo a dɛ; mɛɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a la kɛ je Yawɛ yi, nɛ a piɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a he kɛ tsu a daa ligbi ní tsumi ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ we ɔ agbo nya buli ɔmɛ hu Salomo dla mɛ ngɔ wo kuuhi a mi kɛ ha agbo slɔɔto ɔmɛ a nya bumi kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ, David fa ke a pee ɔ. Mlaahi nɛ David wo osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ kɔɔ nito hehi, kɛ ní kpa komɛ a he ɔ, a ye a nɔ sisiisi.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ Salomo gbe e ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, kɛ je be nɛ a to Yawɛ we ɔ sisi kɛ ya si a ma lɛ kɛ gbe nya.
A gbe ní tsumi ɔ tsuo nya kɛ manye.
Pee se ɔ, Salomo pue nɔ kɛ ho wo nya ma enyɔ komɛ a mi ya ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ.
Ma kake biɛ ji Eziongeber, nɛ kake hu biɛ ji Elat.
Matsɛ Hiram wo lɛ komɛ blɔ kɛ mane Salomo.
Hiram nitsɛ we akua hluili nɛ a kɔni si wa hlui lɛ ɔmɛ; lɛ nɔuu e tsɔli ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ hyɛ a nɔ kɛ ya.
A kɛ Salomo tsɔli ɔmɛ hlui lɛ kɛ ya Ofir zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ya ngɔ sika tsu kilo akpe nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ kɛ se ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba ha Matsɛ Salomo.
Sheba manyɛ ba slaa Salomo Sheba manyɛ ɔ ba nu Salomo he sane, nɛ e hia blɔ kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ e ba ka lɛ kɛ sane bimihi nɛ a he wa.
Benɛ e ma a, nihi babauu nitsɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ba.
E kɛ afukpɔngɔhi nɛ a wo a se mi ní babauu hu ba.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji tsopa kɛ e he via, sika tsu, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa.
Benɛ manyɛ ɔ kɛ Salomo ba bua a, e bi Salomo munyuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e yi mi.
Salomo ha lɛ munyu ɔmɛ tsuo a heto; ekoeko be nɛ wa tsɔ ha lɛ nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e ha heto.
Sheba manyɛ ɔ nu Salomo nile munyu ɔmɛ, nɛ e na matsɛ we ɔ nɛ e po ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, manyɛ ɔ na niye ní nɛ a kɛ to okplɔɔ ha matsɛ ɔ; e na matsɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a pueɔ si kɛ a he tadehi; e na matsɛ ɔ dã woli, kɛ sami bɔhi nɛ a sãã ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Benɛ Sheba manyɛ ɔ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, e he mi po.
E de Matsɛ Salomo ke, “O he sane, kɛ o nile nɛ i nu he ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye zugba a nɔ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu.
Se i he we yi kɛ ba si i ba na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
Mamoo o nile ɔ, pi e mi fa tete po he nɛ i nu ɔ. O we agboje ɔ pe bɔ nɛ a gba mi ɔ kulaa.
O tsɔli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ ní pɛ.
O tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mo daa, nɛ a nuɔ o nile munyu ɔmɛ ɔ, a he ngɛ ní pɛ!
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ na o he bua jɔmi nɛ e ngɔ mo ngɔ hi e sɛ ɔ nɔ, konɛ o ye matsɛ ngɛ e biɛ mi ɔ, a je e yi.
Akɛnɛ o Mawu ɔ suɔ Israel, nɛ e suɔ kaa ma a nɛ hi si kɛ ya neneene he je ɔ, e wo mo tsɛ ngɛ a nɔ, konɛ o kojo, nɛ o ye dami sane.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Sheba manyɛ ɔ ke Matsɛ Salomo ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ba a: sika tsu nɛ jiɔmi ji kilo akpe eywiɛ kɛ se, tsopa kɛ e he via babauu, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa.
Tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ Sheba manyɛ ɔ ba ke Salomo ɔ, a nɛ eko hyɛ nɛ kɛ lɛ sɔ.
Hiram tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Salomo tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ sika tsu kɛ je Ofir kɛ ba a, ngɔ tsohi, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa hu kɛ ba.
Salomo kɛ tso ɔ eko pee kpokuhi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ eko hu pee kpa sakuhi, kɛ bɛhi kɛ ha lali ɔmɛ.
Tso ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba a, a nɛ a henɔ ko hyɛ ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ.
Matsɛ Salomo ha Sheba manyɛ ɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e bi lɛ ɔ; slo níhi tsuo nɛ e kɛ to nike ní nɛ manyɛ ɔ ba ha lɛ ɔ nane mi.
Pee se ɔ, manyɛ ɔ kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho Sheba zugba a nɔ ya.
Matsɛ Salomo ní Sika tsu nɛ baa Matsɛ Salomo dɛ mi daa jeha a, e jiɔmi maa pee kilo nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ; slo sika nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ jua yeli a dɛ, kɛ se nami nɛ jeɔ jua yemi ní tsumi mi.
Arabia matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel zugba a nɔ amlaalo ɔmɛ hu ngɔɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu kɛ ba haa Salomo.
Matsɛ Salomo pee tsɛ̃i agboagbo lafa enyɔ, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu nɛ a fia nɔ, nɛ e jiɔmi maa pee kilo kpaago ha tsɛ̃i tsuaa tsɛ̃i he.
E ngɔ tsɛ̃i nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ya to ngɛ Lebanon hue tsu ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ, Salomo kɛ suɔ wu pee matsɛ sɛ agbo ko, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he.
Matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ kpoku ekpa nɛ a kuɔɔ kɛ yaa he.
A kpɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ nane maa nɔ kɛ wo kpoku ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ha he.
A pee kɔni enyɔ ngɔ wo matsɛ sɛ ɔ he hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, nɛ jata enyɔ daa si ngɛ a he; jata kake ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ jata kake hu ngɛ hiɛ.
A puɛ jatahi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ ma si ngɛ kpoku ekpa amɛ a nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; jata kake ngɛ kpoku kake nya hiɛ, nɛ jata kake hu ngɛ kpoku kake nya hiɛ.
A pee we matsɛ sɛ nɛ ɔ eko hyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yemi he kpa ko.
Matsɛ Salomo nyu numi kpluhi tsuo ɔ, sika tsu a kɛ pee mɛ.
Níhi nɛ ngɛ Lebanon hue tsu ɔ mi hu sika tsu ngmingmiingmi sɔuu lɛ a kɛ pee mɛ; sika hiɔ be mi, ejakaa a bui sika hiɔ he akɔtaa ngɛ Salomo be ɔ mi.
Matsɛ Salomo ngɛ jua yemi lɛhi nɛ yaa Spania.
Hiram tsɔli ji nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ lɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Daa jeha etɛ ɔ, Salomo lɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, suɔ wu, siato, kɛ anguɛ kɛ baa we.
Matsɛ Salomo na ní, nɛ e le ní pe je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hlaa kaa a maa ba Salomo ngɔ nɛ a ba bu nile nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo lɛ ɔ tue.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ba haa Salomo: sika hiɔ, sika tsu níhi, tade, ta hwumi níhi, tsopa kɛ e he via, okpɔngɔ, kɛ teji okpɔngɔ.
A peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ daa jeha.
Jehanɛ, Matsɛ Salomo ngɛ okpɔngɔhi a tsu akpe eywiɛ kɛ ha e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ.
E ngɛ ta okpɔngɔhi hu akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Ta okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ e ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e ngɔ ekomɛ hu ya to ma kpa komɛ a mi.
Salomo ye matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, kɛ je Yufrate pa a nya kɛ ya si Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, kɛ Egipt huzu ɔ nya.
Salomo yi nɔ ɔ, a pee we sika hiɔ, kɛ seda a he nɔ́ ko ngɛ Yerusalem; sika hiɔ ngɛ kaa tɛ, nɛ seda tso hu pɔ he kaa sikamore tso.
A kɛ okpɔngɔhi jeɔ Egipt kɛ zugbahi tsuo a nɔ ba haa Salomo.
Salomo matsɛ yemi he sane kuku Salomo he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma ngɛ blema sanehi womi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: gbalɔ Natan he sane, Ahiya nɛ je Shilo ɔ gbami ɔ, kɛ gbalɔ Ido nina amɛ nɛ kɔɔ Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam hu tsɛ yemi he.
Salomo hi Yerusalem nɛ e kɛ ye Israel tsuo nɔ matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Salomo ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Rehoboam ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Omleyi je wɛtso ɔmɛ tsɔ atuã Rehoboam pue nɔ kɛ ho Shekem ya, ejakaa Israel omleyi je ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ya bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ konɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ.
Benɛ Nebat binyumu Yeroboam nɛ tu fo kɛ je Matsɛ Salomo nya nɛ e ya laa a he ngɛ Egipt ɔ, nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale kɛ ba we.
Ma a tsɔ ya kpee lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tsuo ba Rehoboam ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “O tsɛ Salomo wa wɔ yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ; tlomi nɛ e ngɔ kɛ tloo wɔ ɔ, tlomi ɔ jiɔ tsɔ.
Ke o ma ha nɛ wa tlomi ɔ nɔ ma gbɔ bɔɔ, nɛ wa he mi maa jɔ wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ wa ma sɔmɔ mo.” Rehoboam he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ha mi ligbi etɛ nɛ ma kɛ susu sane nɛ ɔ he, konɛ nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Rehoboam ya bi nikɔtɔma komɛ ga womi; ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kɛ e tsɛ Salomo hi si, nɛ a woɔ lɛ ga benɛ e ngɛ je mi ɔ. Rehoboam bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni heto po ma ya ha ma nɛ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Ke o ma ha ma nɛ ɔ a ní bimi ɔ heto kɛ gbi nɛ he jɔ, nɛ o maa kplɛɛ kaa o maa hɛɛ mɛ saminya a, a ma sɔmɔ mo daa.” Se Rehoboam kua ga nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ wo lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho ya bi e juã nihewi nɛ e kɛ mɛ je nɔ ɔ mohu ga womi ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba de mi ke ma ha nɛ a tlomi ɔ nɔ nɛ gbɔ bɔɔ ha mɛ.
Mɛni ga nyɛ ngɛ mi woe?
Kɛ ma ya de mɛ kɛɛ?” Nihewi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ o ma de mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ye sekpɛ nguɛ kle pe tsaatsɛ mlɛ mi.
Tsaatsɛ ngɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ tloo nyɛ; imi lɛɛ i kɛ tlomi ɔ eko ma pa piɛ he ha nyɛ.
Tsaatsɛ ngɔ kpa gu kɛ fia nyɛ; imi lɛɛ i kɛ okpɔngɔ kpa maa fia nyɛ!’ ” Ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Yeroboam kɛ ma a tsuo kpale kɛ ba Matsɛ Rehoboam ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Rehoboam kua nikɔtɔma amɛ a ga womi ɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma a tu munyu basabasa kaa bɔ nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ wo lɛ ga ke e pee ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ ngɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ tloo nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i kɛ tlomi ɔ eko ma pa piɛ he ha nyɛ.
Tsaatsɛ kɛ kpa gu fia nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i kɛ okpɔngɔ kpa maa fia nyɛ!” Matsɛ Rehoboam bui ma a tue fɛɛ!
Se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ he ngɛ mi.
Yawɛ lɛ ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ pee ja a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ si ko nɛ lɛ Yawɛ ɔ wo Nebat binyumu Yeroboam kɛ gu gbalɔ Ahiya nɛ je Shilo ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Benɛ Israel ma a tsuo na kaa matsɛ ɔ bui mɛ tue ɔ, a he ose, nɛ a de ke, “Mɛni blɔ nya wa ngɛ ngɛ David ngɔ?
Wa be gbosi ní ngɛ Ishai binyumu ɔ ngɔ!
Israel ma, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pue lɛ nitsɛ e we mi blɔ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ Rehoboam nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ David we ɔ mi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsɔ atuã, nɛ Rehoboam ye tsɛ ngɛ Israel bi nɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi ɔ pɛ a nɔ.
Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Rehoboam tsɔ Adoniram Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Adoniram ji nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nihi nɛ a nyɛɔ a nɔ kɛ tsuɔ ma ní tsumi kpakpataa a a nɔ.
Se Israel ma a tsuo fia lɛ tɛ nɛ a gbe.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Rehoboam he sɔ nɛ e ya sɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel omleyi je ma a tsɔ atuã kɛ je David we ɔ he kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
Gbalɔ Shemaya Benɛ Rehoboam ya su Yerusalem ɔ, e hla ta buli nɛ a kɔni si wa akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ je Yuda kɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi.
E to kaa e kɛ Israel omleyi je wɛtso ɔmɛ ma ya hwu, konɛ e kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ ba je e sisi ekohu.
Se Yawɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha gbalɔ Shemaya ke, “De Yuda matsɛ, Rehoboam, Salomo binyumu ɔ, kɛ Yuda wɛtso ɔ, Benyamin wɛtso ɔ, kɛ ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ko hwu ta.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ho e we mi ya; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ, ye he ngɛ mi.’ ” A bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ. Rehoboam fia gbogbo ngɔ wo ma amɛ a he Rehoboam hi Yerusalem, nɛ e fia gbogbo ngɔ wo Yuda kɛ Benyamin ma nɛ ɔmɛ a he: Betlehem, Etam, Tekoa, Betzur, Soko, Adulam, Gat, Maresha, Zif, Adoraim, Lakish, Azeka, Zora, Aiyalon, kɛ Hebron.
Rehoboam fia gbogbo ngɔ wo ma nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e hla asafoatsɛmɛ kɛ to ma amɛ a nya.
E to niye ní, oliv nu, kɛ wai ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi.
E to tsɛ̃ihi, kɛ akplɔhi hu ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi.
Bɔ nɛ e pee nɛ e kɛ ye Yuda kɛ Benyamin nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Osɔfohi kɛ Levi bi ba Yuda Osɔfohi kɛ Levi bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ je a hi he ɔmɛ kɛ ba Rehoboam ngɔ ngɛ Yuda.
Levi bi ɔmɛ je a kɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ a zugba kpa amɛ a he, nɛ a ba Yuda kɛ Yerusalem, ejakaa Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam kɛ e se yeli ɔmɛ ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a tsu ní kaa Yawɛ we osɔfohi.
Yeroboam wo osɔfohi nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ; a ja wɔhi, kɛ amagahi nɛ ngɛ kaa na bi nɛ lɛ Yeroboam ɔ puɛ.
Kɛ je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, nihi nɛ suɔ kaa a ma ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo ɔ, nyɛɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a se kɛ ba Yerusalem.
A ba Yerusalem konɛ a ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo Yuda matsɛ yemi ɔ mi he wami, nɛ ma a piɛ Salomo bi Rehoboam he jeha etɛ sɔuu; a kɛ lɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ Matsɛ David, kɛ Matsɛ Salomo hi si ɔ. Rehoboam weku Rehoboam ngɔ Mahalat.
Yo nɛ ɔ tsɛ ji David binyumu Yerimot, nɛ e nyɛ ji Eliab biyo Abihail, Ishai bibi ɔ. Rehoboam kɛ e yo ɔ fɔ binyumuhi etɛ: Yeush, Shemaria, kɛ Zaham.
Pee se ɔ, Rehoboam ngɔ Maaka, Absalom biyo ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ binyumuhi eywiɛ: Abiya, Atai, Ziza, kɛ Shelomit.
Yihi tsuo nɛ Rehoboam ngɔ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ, kɛ plãhi hu nyingmi ekpa.
E ngɛ binyumuhi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ, kɛ biyihi nyingmi ekpa.
Nɔ nɛ e suɔ pe kulaa ngɛ e yi ɔmɛ kɛ e plã amɛ a kpɛti ji Absalom biyo Maaka.
Rehoboam ngɔ Maaka binyumu Abiya kɛ to ganɔ ngɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, ejakaa e hla lɛ ngɔ to kaa nɔ nɛ ma ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Rehoboam to blɔ nya kpakpa; e ha e binyumu ɔmɛ blɔ nya ngɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ tsuo a mi ngɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin.
E ha mɛ niye ní babauu, nɛ e hla yihi fuu ha mɛ nɛ a ngɔ.
Egipt bi ba tua Yuda Benɛ Rehoboam matsɛ yemi ɔ ba da si ɔ, e kɛ e ma a tsuo kua Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ yemi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbla e tue.
Matsɛ Rehoboam yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Egipt matsɛ, Shishak ba tua Yerusalem.
E kɛ ta zugba lɛ akpe kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli akpe nyingmi ekpa, kɛ ta buli babauu nɛ a li a nya ba.
Ta buli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ji Libia bi, Suk bi, kɛ Sudan bi.
Shishak ngɔ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ngɛ Yuda a, nɛ e ba su Yerusalem tɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Shemaya ba Rehoboam, kɛ Yuda ganɔ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
Blɔɔ Yuda ganɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ya ye Shishak gbeye, nɛ a tu fo kɛ je a ma amɛ a mi ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem.
Shemaya de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛ kua mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngmɛɛ nyɛ he kɛ wo Shishak dɛ mi.’ ” Matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Israel ganɔ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ kaa a pee yayami, nɛ a kɛ he si bami de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ da.” Benɛ Yawɛ na kaa a pia a he ɔ, e de Shemaya ekohu ke, “Akɛnɛ a pia a he he je ɔ, i be a hɛ mi kpatae; ma he a yi wami ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ.
Ye mi mi fu Yerusalem, se i be Shishak nɔ gue kɛ gbla ma a tue.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ma ba sɔmɔ Shishak, konɛ a na slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ ye sɔmɔmi, kɛ je ma amɛ a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a sɔmɔmi ɔ mi.” Egipt matsɛ, Shishak ba tua Yerusalem niinɛ, nɛ e ngɔ ma a. E muɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ je, june nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, june nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ sika tsu tsɛ̃ihi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo pee ɔ. Matsɛ Rehoboam ha nɛ a pee akɔblee tsɛ̃ihi kɛ to sika tsu tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ a nane mi, nɛ e to mɛ ngɔ wo tsɔli nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo nya buli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ a dɛ mi.
Be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ ɔ maa ya Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, buli ɔmɛ hu maa hɛɛ tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ kɛ ba sɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa kpale mɛ ya to ngɛ buli ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi ekohu.
Akɛnɛ Rehoboam ba e he si he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ tsuo bɛ e nɔ, nɛ a kpataa we e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Niinɛ, pee se ɔ, níhi a mi ba hi ha Yuda ekohu.
Rehoboam matsɛ yemi he sane kuku Rehoboam matsɛ yemi ɔ ba he si ngɛ Yerusalem.
E ye jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kake benɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaago.
Yerusalem ji ma nɛ Yawɛ hla kɛ je Israel zugba a tsuo nɔ kaa he nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ.
Rehoboam nyɛ biɛ ji Naama; e je Amon zugba a nɔ.
Rehoboam pee yayami, ejakaa e pee we Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní.
Rehoboam he sane kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma lɛ tsuo ngɛ gbalɔ Shemaya blema sanehi womi ɔ, kɛ gbalɔ Ido blema sanehi womi ɔ a mi.
Daa nɛ ɔ, Rehoboam kɛ Yeroboam ngɛ ta nɔ.
Rehoboam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi; nɛ e binyumu Abiya ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Abiya kɛ Yeroboam hwu ta Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam yi nɔ, jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ, Abiya ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha etɛ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Mikaya.
Uriel nɛ je Gibea a bi ji lɛ.
Ta ba te si ngɛ Abiya kɛ Yeroboam a kpɛti.
Abiya kɛ ta buli nɛ a kɔni si wa akpe lafa eywiɛ gba ta kɛ wo Yeroboam, nɛ Yeroboam kɛ lɛ hu e ta buli akpe lafa kpaanyɔ nɛ mɛ hu a kɔni si wa ya na lɛ.
Tabo ɔmɛ ya bua ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Matsɛ Abiya ya kuɔ Zemaraim yo ɔ, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa de ke, “Yeroboam kɛ Israel ma a tsuo, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, kɛ David so somi ko nɛ a be se kpalee gblegbleegble, kaa David kɛ e nina maa ye Israel nɔ matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene lo?
Nebat binyumu Yeroboam te si ngɔ wo Salomo, e matsɛ ɔ. Pee se ɔ, e bua yaka nimli komɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya na Salomo binyumu Rehoboam.
A nyɛ e nɔ nɛ e pee a suɔmi nya ní.
Rehoboam nyɛ we mɛ, ejakaa e wɛ, nɛ e kpa we je mi si lolo.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, he wami ɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha David nina kaa mɛ lɛ a yeɔ matsɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ te si kɛ si jamɛ a he wami ɔ. Nyɛ he hiɛ babauu, nɛ sika tsu na bihi, nɛ ji mawuhi nɛ Yeroboam pee kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ hu ngɛ nyɛ dɛ.
Nyɛ fie Yawɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Aaron nina a; nyɛ fie Levi bi ɔmɛ hulɔ.
A nane mi ɔ, nyɛ wo osɔfohi kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ peeɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛɛ na ku kake, loo agbosu kpaago kɛ ba tsukɔ e he ɔ, kɛkɛ e plɛ pee osɔfo kɛ ha nyɛ yaka mawu ɔmɛ.
“Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ ji wa Mawu; wa kua we lɛ.
Wa ngɛ osɔfohi nɛ ji Aaron nina nɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ, kɛ Levi bi nɛ piɛɔ a he kɛ tsuɔ ní.
Daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a sãã sami bɔhi, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa Yawɛ.
A toɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔɔ okplɔɔ nɛ he tsɔ ko nɔ kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a suɔ kane ɔmɛ ngɛ sika tsu kane tso ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa peeɔ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kua lɛ.
Mawu nitsɛ ji wa hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ.
E we osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ a titimati ɔmɛ.
Ke a kpa titimati ɔmɛ pɛ kɛkɛ pe wa he ose kɛ gba ta kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ ko gba ta kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ!
Nyɛ be kunimi yee!” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yeroboam tsɔ e ta buli ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ a ya wo ka ngɛ Yuda tabo ɔmɛ a se je.
Tabo ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee Yuda tabo ɔmɛ.
Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ maa hyɛ ɔ, a na kaa a sa a yi; he nyɛli ngɛ a hɛ mi kɛ a se tsuo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ he ose, nɛ Abiya nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya tua Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Mawu ye Yeroboam kɛ Israel ma a tsuo a nɔ kunimi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ tu fo ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya, se Mawu ha nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nine su a nɔ.
Abiya kɛ e tabo ɔmɛ gbe Israel bi ɔmɛ basabasa; Israel ta buli nɛ a kɔni si wa akpe lafa enuɔ sɔuu nɔ ngɛ ta a mi.
Bɔ nɛ ba nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ye Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A ye kunimi, ejakaa a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ nɔ.
Abiya nyɛɛ Yeroboam se, nɛ e ya kpɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ: Betel, Yeshana, Efron, kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ.
Yeroboam pa na we he wami ko hu ngɛ Abiya be ɔ mi.
Nyagbenyagbe ɔ, Yawɛ fia lɛ nɔ nɛ e gbo.
Abiya lɛɛ e he wami ɔ ba pue nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E ngɔ yihi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ fɔ binyumuhi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ, kɛ biyihi nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
Abiya he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, níhi nɛ e de, kɛ níhi nɛ e pee tsuo ɔ, a ngma ngɛ gbalɔ Ido blema sanehi womi ɔ mi.
Matsɛ Asa ye Sudan bi ɔmɛ a nɔ Matsɛ Abiya ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e bi Asa ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Asa yi nɔ ɔ, tue mi jɔmi ba zugba a nɔ jeha nyɔngma.
E ní peepee sa Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ hɛ mi; e pee nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ hi.
E jé ma se bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ.
E gbɛ jami he ɔmɛ; e ku amaga amɛ, kɛ amaga a nɛ a puɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. E fa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke a pee Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ye e tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Akɛnɛ e gbɛ jami he ɔmɛ, nɛ e je tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi he je ɔ, e yi nɔ jɔ.
E fia gbogbo kɛ wo Yuda ma amɛ a he jamɛ a be ɔ mi.
E kɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hwui ta jehahi babauu, ejakaa Yawɛ ha lɛ tue mi jɔmi.
Asa de e ma Yuda ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa fia gbogbo kɛ wo ma nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ma mɔhi, kɛ a nya agbohi kɛ a se lami dade.
Zugba a fɔɔ si ha wɔ, ejakaa wa pee Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ suɔmi nya ní.
Yawɛ ha wɔ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he tsuaa he kɛ bɔle si.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a po ma amɛ, nɛ níhi a mi hi ha mɛ saminya.
Matsɛ Asa ngɛ ta buli nɛ je Yuda.
A hiɛmi ji akpe lafa etɛ; nɛ a hɛɛɔ tsɛ̃i kɛ akplɔ.
E ngɛ ta buli nɛ je Benyamin hulɔ.
A hiɛmi ji akpe lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ; nɛ mɛɛ a hɛɛɔ tsɛ̃i kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃.
Ta buli katsɛmɛ ji kulaa mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Sudan no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zera ba tua Yuda.
E kɛ ta buli ayɔ, kɛ ta zugba lɛ lafa etɛ ba tua ma a, nɛ a ba su Maresha tɔɔ.
Asa hia nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe, nɛ tabo enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ya bua ngɛ Zefata kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Maresha kasa nya.
Asa fa kue ha Yawɛ e Mawu ɔ ke, “Yawɛ lee, mo nɛ o piɛɔ nihi nɛ a he wa, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he wɛ tsuo a he!
Yawɛ, wa Mawu, moo piɛ wa he koo!
Ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ.
Wa ba ngɛ o biɛ mi, konɛ waa kɛ asafo babauu nɛ ɔ ba kpe.
Yawɛ, mo ji wa Mawu; ko ha nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ye o nɔ kunimi.” Benɛ Asa kɛ Yuda tabo ɔ ya tua Sudan tabo ɔ, Yawɛ ye Sudan tabo ɔ nɔ kunimi.
A tu fo, nɛ Asa kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ ya su Gerar tɔɔ.
A gbe Sudan bi ɔmɛ basabasa nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po piɛ.
Yawɛ kɛ e tabo ɔ pee mɛ butuu, nɛ Yuda tabo ɔ ha ta yibu ní babauu.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a kpata mahi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ bɔle Gerar kɛ kpe ɔ a hɛ mi, ejakaa ni ɔmɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye.
A ha ta yibu ní babauu ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.
A ya tua lohwehi a lɛmi he komɛ hulɔ, nɛ a ha tohi kɛ afukpɔngɔhi babauu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Asa tsake níhi Be ko ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ ba Oded binyumu Azaria nɔ, nɛ e ho nɛ e kɛ Asa ya kpe, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Matsɛ Asa, kɛ Yuda, kɛ Benyamin bi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Be abɔ nɛ nyɛ pɛtɛ Yawɛ he nɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Ke nyɛ hla e se blɔ ɔ, e ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ.
Se ke nyɛ kpale ngɛ e se ɔ, lɛ hu e ma kua nyɛ.
Be saii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ kɛkɛ, nɛ a ja we anɔkuale Mawu ɔ; osɔfohi be nɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ ní ɔ, mlaa ko hu be.
Se benɛ haomi ba a nɔ ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ ngɔ.
A hla lɛ, nɛ a na lɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e jeɔ kpo nɛ e yaa nɛ e baa ngɛ he jɔmi mi, ejakaa haomi kɛ basabasa ngɛ zugba amɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Je ma kɛ je ma ngɛ ta nɔ; ma kɛ ma hu ja nɔuu, ejakaa Mawu kɛ haomi slɔɔtohi ba a nɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ wlua nyɛ!
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nyɛ nine mi nɛ je wu, ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ, nyɛ ma na he hiɔwo.” Benɛ Matsɛ Asa nu gba gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ je Oded binyumu Azaria nya a, e nɔ gbagba te.
E je amagahi tsuo kɛ je Yuda kɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ.
E je amagahi tsuo kɛ je mahi nɛ e ya kpɔ ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ hu a mi, nɛ e dla Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ. Nihi babauu ku kɛ je Efraim, Manase, kɛ Simeon ngɛ Israel kɛ ba Asa ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba hi si; ejakaa a nu kaa Yawɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ.
Asa kpee mɛ tsuo kulaa kɛ piɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin he.
A ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem, ngɛ Asa matsɛ yemi jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ we nyɔhiɔ etɛne ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a ngɔ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ba a eko kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ.
Ní ɔmɛ ji na lafa kpaago, kɛ to akpe kpaago.
A so, nɛ a kplɛɛ kaa a ma ja Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo, kɛ a klaa tsuo.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ jae ɔ, a maa gbe lɛ, jokuɛ jio, nɔkɔtɔma jio, nyumu jio, yo jio.
A kɛ ngmlaa ka kita ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ke a maa ye somi ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a he ose, nɛ a kpa titimatihi, kɛ kolihi.
Yuda ma a tsuo nya, ejakaa a so somi nɛ ɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo.
A bua jɔ Yawɛ jami ɔ he, nɛ Yawɛ hu he mɛ, nɛ e ha mɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Matsɛ Asa kpa e nyɛ Maaka tete po manyɛ yemi, ejakaa e pee amaga ko nɛ a hiee kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. Asa ku amaga a ngɔ pue si.
E wɛɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, nɛ e ya sã lɛ ngɛ Kidron kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
E ngɛ mi kaa Asa gbɛ́ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Israel zugba a mi lɛɛ, se e ye Yawɛ anɔkuale e wami be ɔ tsuo.
Asa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ma Yawɛ we ɔ mi: níhi tsuo nɛ e tsɛ Abiya pee mɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Mawu, kɛ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ níhi nɛ lɛ Asa nitsɛ e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Mawu ɔ. Ta ko ta ko ti si hu ngɛ Asa be ɔ mi kɛ ya si e matsɛ yemi mi jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ ɔ.
Yuda kɛ Israel ná Yuda matsɛ, Asa yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyingmi etɛ kɛ ekpa a mi ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Baasha ba tua Yuda, nɛ e bɔni gbogbo fiami kɛ ngɛ Rama ma a he woe.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó nyɛ nɛ e je Israel kɛ ya Yuda, loo Yuda kɛ ba Israel.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Matsɛ Asa ya muɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ nito he ɔ. E tsɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ekomɛ Damasko nɛ a kɛ ní ɔmɛ ya ha Siria matsɛ, Benhadad.
Sɛ gbi nɛ piɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ha nɛ i kɛ mo waa so kaa bɔ nɛ tsaatsɛ kɛ o tsɛ so ɔ. I ngɛ mo sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu nike ní manee.
Yaa nɛ o kɛ Israel matsɛ, Baasha ya po somi nɛ o kɛ lɛ so ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e je e ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ je ye zugba a nɔ kɛ ho.” Benhadad kplɛɛ Asa munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tsɔ e tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya tua Israel ma amɛ.
A ngɔ Iyon, Dan, Abel Bet Maaka, kɛ Naftali nito he ma amɛ tsuo.
Benɛ Matsɛ Baasha nu sane nɛ ba a, e kpa Rama ma a dlami, nɛ e je ní tsumi ɔ he.
Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Asa bua nihi a nya kɛ je Yuda tsuo, nɛ a ya muɔ tɛhi, kɛ tsohi nɛ Baasha kɛ ba ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ Rama a. Asa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya po Geba kɛ Mizpa ma amɛ.
Gbalɔ Hanani Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, gbalɔ Hanani ba Yuda matsɛ, Asa ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Siria matsɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ o ngɔɛ o hɛ ngɔ fɔɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɔ he je ɔ, Siria matsɛ tabo ɔ tu fo kɛ je o he.
Tse Sudan bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Libia bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ta buli, ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli babauu?
Se akɛnɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ he je ɔ, e ha nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ kunimi.
Yawɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ je ɔ tsuo he; nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ, e woɔ mɛ he wami.
O je kuasia.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, ta maa nyɛɛ o se daa nɛ.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Asa mi mi fu gbalɔ ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ tsu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Asa bɔni ma mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ yi mi wami.
Asa matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe Asa he sanehi kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Yuda kɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Benɛ Asa ye jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ nɛɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nane hiɔ nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ ko ba bu lɛ si.
Se e kɛ e kɔmɔ ɔ yɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; tsopa peeli mohu a ngɔ lɛ e ya.
Jeha enyɔ se ɔ, benɛ Asa ná jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kake ngɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi, ngɛ tɛ sa yɔkɔ ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kpɛ ngɔ to ɔ mi.
A ngɔ lɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ gbogboe sa ko nɔ.
A kɛ tsopahi kɛ a he via nɛ a je blɔ futu slɔɔtoslɔɔto dla sa nɛ ɔ, nɛ a slɛ la ko nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Yehoshafat ba ye matsɛ ngɛ Yuda Yehoshafat ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ Asa se, nɛ e dla konɛ e kɛ Israel nɛ kpe.
E ngɔ ta buli ngɔ to Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ Efraim mahi nɛ e tsɛ Asa kpɔ ɔ a mi.
Yawɛ gbaa Yehoshafat, ejakaa e ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e ba e je mi kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ pee ngɛ e nihe be mi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; e ja we Baal.
E sɔmɔ e tsɛ Mawu ɔ; e ye Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e pee we e ní kaa Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ da si, nɛ Yuda ma a tsuo wo tó ha lɛ.
E na ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi ba nyami.
E sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ e he wami tsuo.
E gbɛ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ amaga a nɛ a puɛ kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yuda nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a hu e ku lɛ pue si.
Benɛ e ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, jeha etɛne ɔ, e tsɔ ganɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ho Yuda ma amɛ a mi ya, konɛ a ya tsɔɔ ní.
Mɛ ji Benhail, Obadia, Zakaria, Netanel, kɛ Mikaya.
Levi bi nɛɛ, kɛ osɔfohi enyɔ piɛ a he kɛ ho.
Levi bi nɛ ya a ji Shemaya, Netania, Zebadia, Asahel, Shemiramot, Yehonatan, Adoniya, Tobiya, kɛ Tobadoniya; nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ji Elishama, kɛ Yehoram.
A hɛɛ Yawɛ mlaa womi ɔ kɛ ya kpa Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ a tsɔɔ ma a mlaa a. Yehoshafat ba pee nɔmlɔ agbo Yawɛ ha nɛ sawale nu matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle Yuda a, nɛ a ti nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ Matsɛ Yehoshafat nɛ hwu ta.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ba ke Yehoshafat ní, nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ babauu wo tó ha lɛ.
Arabia bi ɔmɛ hu ba ha lɛ agbosu akpe kpaago kɛ e nya lafa kpaago, kɛ akpakpo akpe kpaago kɛ e nya lafa kpaago.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yehoshafat na he wami pe sa a, nɛ e ma mɔhi, kɛ mahi ngɛ Yuda zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ a to niye ní babauu nitsɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
E ngɔ ma ní tsuli nɛ a kɔni si wa ngɔ to Yerusalem we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
Ta buli nɛ je Yuda a, a nyatsɛ ji Adna.
E we bi ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ji akpe lafa etɛ.
Asafoatsɛ nɛ ba ngɛ e se ji Yehohanan, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ji akpe lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ.
Asafoatsɛ nɛ ba ngɛ lɛ hu e se ji Zikri binyumu Amasia nɛ ngɔ e he ngɔ ha kaa e ma tsu ní ha Yawɛ.
E we bi ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ji akpe lafa enyɔ.
Ta buli nɛ je Benyamin ɔ, a nyatsɛ ji Eliada; tatsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ.
E we bi ɔmɛ a hiɛmi ji akpe lafa enyɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ tsɛ̃ihi kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi.
Nɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Eliada se ji asafoatsɛ Yehozabad, kɛ e we bihi akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ nɛ a dla a he saminya kɛ ha ta hwumi.
Ta buli nɛ sɔmɔ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; slo ni nɛmɛ nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to Yuda ma kpahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi.
Gbalɔ Mikaya bɔ Ahab kɔkɔ Benɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat ba na ní nɛ e he biɛ hulɔ ɔ, e kɛ Israel matsɛ, Ahab ba pee ngatsɛ.
Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, Yehoshafat ya Samaria ma a mi ya slaa Ahab.
Ahab gbe tohi kɛ nahi babauu kɛ nya Yehoshafat, kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ ɔ a he; nɛ e wo Yehoshafat yi mi ke e piɛ e he nɛ a kɛ Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ ya hwu ta.
Ahab bi Yehoshafat ke, “Anɛ o kɛ mi maa ya nɛ wa ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ lo?” Yehoshafat he nɔ ke, “Imi kɛ mo ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ji wɔ; ye ma a, mo hu o nɔ.
Waa kɛ mo maa ya ta a.
Se mohu ɔ, ha nɛ wa bi Yawɛ ga womi lolo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Ahab ya kpee gbali maa pee nimli lafa eywiɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Anɛ ma ya nɛ ma ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ, aloo ma ko ya?” A he nɔ ke, “Yaa, Yawɛ maa ngɔ ma a kɛ wo o dɛ mi.” Se Yehoshafat bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ gbalɔ kpa ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ wa ma bi lɛ Yawɛ ga womi lo?” Ahab he nɔ ke, “Nɔ kake ngɛ; lɛ ji Imla binyumu Mikaya.
Se i sume lɛ, ejakaa e gbɛ manye nɔ́ ko ha we mi hyɛ gblee, kaa ja nɔ́ yaya pɛ lɛ e gbaa.” Yehoshafat de lɛ ke, “Mo ko de ja!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Ahab tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ e de lɛ ke e ya nɛ e ya ngɔ Imla binyumu Mikaya kɛ ba nɔuu.
Matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ wo ablade tade kɛ hii si ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ngma mi sami he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Samaria ma agbo ɔ nya a, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ gbae ngɛ a hɛ mi.
