Gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zedekia, Kenaana binyumu ɔ pee dade kolihi, nɛ e de Ahab ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ o kɛ maa gbe Siria bi ɔmɛ kɛ yaa si o ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’ ” Gbali kpa amɛ tsuo gba kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ maa ngɔ Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ mi.
Yaa nɛ o ya tua ma a; o maa ye kunimi.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ho Mikaya tsɛmi ya a de Mikaya ke, “O nɛ, gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a nya sɔ nɛ a gba ke matsɛ ɔ maa ye kunimi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo hu moo gba ja nɔuu.” Se Mikaya he nɔ ke, “I na Yawɛ hɛ kalɔ ɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ma de mi ke ma de ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ ma de ɔ nɛ!” Benɛ Mikaya ba su Matsɛ Ahab ngɔ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mikaya, anɛ i kɛ Matsɛ Yehoshafat waa ya nɛ wa ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ, aloo wa ko ya?” Mikaya he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ maa ngɔ ma a kɛ wo o dɛ mi.
Yaa nɛ o ya tua ma a, nɛ o maa ye kunimi.” Se Ahab de lɛ ke, “Ke o kɛ mi ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ, tu anɔkuale!
Si enyɛmɛ ma de mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?” Mikaya he nɔ ke, “I na Israel tabo ɔ tsuo nɛ a gbɛ ngɔ fĩa ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ.
Nɛ Yawɛ de ke, ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ be nyatsɛ; ha nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.’ ” Ahab de Yehoshafat ke, “Anɛ i de we mo ke Mikaya gbɛ manye nɔ́ ko ha we mi hyɛ gblee, kaa nɔ́ yaya pɛ e gbaa lo?” Mikaya ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ tue!
I na Yawɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo daa si kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Yawɛ bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ ma ya mlɔɔ Ahab ha mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ?’ Bɔfo ɔmɛ ekomɛ de kikɛ, nɛ ekomɛ hu de kikɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, mumi ko je kpo ba da si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘Ma mlɔɔ lɛ.’ Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, ‘Kɛ o maa pee kɛ mlɔɔ lɛ kɛɛ?’ Mumi ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Ke i ya a, ma ha nɛ Ahab gbali ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye lakpa.’ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, ‘Yaa nɛ o ya mlɔɔ lɛ; o maa ye manye.’ ” Nyagbe ɔ, Mikaya de Ahab ke, “Bɔ nɛ níhi ya ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ ha nɛ o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ye mo lakpa.
Se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e de to momo kaa sane yobu maa ye mo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Zedekia, Kenaana binyumu ɔ ho nɛ e ya gba Mikaya hɛ mi ma, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni be nɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ je ye nɔ nɛ e kɛ mo ba tu munyu?” Mikaya he nɔ ke, “Ke be nɛ o ya sɛ se tsu mi nɛ o laa o he ɔ, kɛkɛ o maa le mo.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Matsɛ Ahab fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ke, “Nuu Mikaya nɛ o ngɔ lɛ ya ha Amon, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, kɛ ye binyumu Yoash.
De mɛ ke, i ke a wo lɛ tsu nɛ a ha lɛ abolo kɛ nyu bɔbɔyoo pɛ kɛ yaa si ma kpale kɛ ba kɛ manye.” Mikaya he nɔ ke, “Ke o kpale ba kɛ manye ɔ, lɛɛ tsa pi Yawɛ nɛ tu munyu kɛ gu ye nɔ mɔ!” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue!” Ahab gbenɔ Pee se ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Ahab kɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat ho ya tua Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ. Ahab de Yehoshafat ke, “Ma tsake ye he kɛ ya ta nga a nɔ, se moo lɛɛ moo wo o we ablade tade ɔmɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel matsɛ ɔ tsake e he kɛ ho ta nga a nɔ ya.
Siria matsɛ ɔ wo e ta zugba lɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ mlaa ke a kɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko hwu ta kaa ja Israel matsɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a na Yehoshafat ɔ, a susu kaa Israel matsɛ ɔ ji lɛ, nɛ a plɛ ngɔ kpee lɛ.
Se Yehoshafat kpa huhui, nɛ Yawɛ Mawu he e yi wami, nɛ e ha nɛ ta a kpale ngɛ e se.
Ta zugba lɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na kaa tsa pi Israel matsɛ ɔ ji lɛ, kɛkɛ nɛ a jɔɔ e se nyɛɛmi.
Se tlukaa a, Siria ta buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ nɛ e li e he be.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ ya gbɔ Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a tsami he ɔ. Ahab de e ta zugba lɛ kudɔlɔ ɔ ke, “I plaa!
Plɛ o he nɛ o kɛ mi nɛ je ta a nya!” Benɛ a ngɛ ta a hwue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a hɛɛ Matsɛ Ahab kɛ daa si ngɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi kɛ kpee Siria bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ.
Benɛ pu ke e nɔɔ si ɔ, e gbo.
Gbalɔ ko ba ka Yehoshafat hɛ mi Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat kpale kɛ ba e we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem fiafiaafia.
Gbalɔ Yehu, Hanani binyumu ɔ ba kpee matsɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Anɛ e da ha mo kaa o ya piɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a he, nɛ o kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a sume Yawɛ nɛ bɔ lo?
Nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ ha nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu mo.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, su kpakpa komɛ ngɛ o mi; o je yo mawu Ashera amaga amɛ tsuo kɛ je zugba a nɔ, nɛ o bɔ mɔde kaa o maa pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní.” Yehoshafat tsake níhi Matsɛ Yehoshafat hi Yerusalem, se e pɔɔ blɔ hiami kɛ ya slaa e ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ je Beersheba ngɛ leneyi je kɛ ya si Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ omleyi je.
Ke e ya a, e kɛ ni ɔmɛ tuɔ munyu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpale ba nyɛɛ Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ se ekohu.
E to kojoli ngɛ Yuda mahi tsuo nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya loko nyɛɛ bu nɔ ko fɔ, loo bemi.
Tsa pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní ɔ tsue ha, se mohu Mawu.
Ke nyɛ maa buá sane ko he ɔ, Yawɛ maa piɛ nyɛ he.
Nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ níhi ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ; ejakaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ sume kaa a plɛ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, aloo a hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi, aloo a he nyɔ mi ní.” Yehoshafat wo Levi bi ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kojoli ngɛ Yerusalem hulɔ.
Mɛɛ a ní tsumi ji a kojo sanehi nɛ kɔɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ tɔmi he, nɛ a hyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti sanehi a mi.
Yerusalem ji he nɛ a kojoɔ ngɛ.
E wo mɛ mlaa ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu gbeye yemi, anɔkuale yemi, kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo nɛ tsu ní.
Ke nyɛ nyɛmimɛ kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ ngɔ sane ba ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ mi ɔ, muɔ si puemi sane jio, Mawu mlaa amɛ, aloo blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ eko nɔ tɔmi sane jio, nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ a ma plɛ kɛ ye sane ɔ ha, nɛ nyɛɛ piɛ a he kɛ ye sane ɔ ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, a be fɔ yee ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; Yawɛ mi mi fumi be nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ bae.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee nɛ sɔ̃ be nyɛ tlooe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Sanehi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ Yawɛ jami he ɔ, ke Amaria, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ngɔ e nya ngɔ wo mi pɛ, a po sisi; nɔ kpa ko be he blɔ nɛ e deɔ nɔ́ ko hu.
Ma mi sanehi lɛɛ, nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ maa to blɔ nya ji Ishmael binyumu Zebadia, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yuda a. Ke lɛɛ e tu munyu ɔ, nɔ kpa ko be he blɔ nɛ e deɔ nɔ́ ko hu.
Ke a ye sane ko gbe nya nɛ a buá he ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ a blɔ nya ní tsumi ji kaa a hyɛ konɛ blɔ nya nɛ kojomi he ɔ to ɔ, a ye nɔ.
Nyɛɛ pee kã, nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Yawɛ nɛ piɛ nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a he!”
Edom bi ba tua Yuda Pee se ɔ, Moab bi kɛ, Amon bi, kɛ a huɛmɛ nɛ ji Meun bi ɔmɛ ba tua Yuda ma a. Kɛkɛ nɛ ni komɛ ba bɔ Yehoshafat amaniɛ ke, “Ta babauu je Edom, ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ se kɛ ba tua mo.
Niinɛ, a ngɔ Hazazon Tamar nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Engedi ɔ momo.” Yehoshafat tsui po, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ e bi lɛ ga womi.
Yehoshafat ha nɛ a fiɛ ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha hwɔ ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Nihi je Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ a ba bi Yawɛ ga womi.
A kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ tsuo ya bua a he nya ngɛ kue he ɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Yehoshafat ho ya da si ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e fa kue ke, “Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu lee, mo pɛ ji Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o yeɔ je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ.
O kle agbo; o ngɛ he wami, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa da o hɛ mi.
Anɛ pi mo, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ o fie zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi ɔmɛ kɛ je hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ benɛ o ma, Israel ma a lo?
Anɛ pi mo nɛ o ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ kɛ ha o huɛ Abraham nina, konɛ e pee a nɔ́ kɛ ya neneene lo?
O ma a ba hi zugba a nɔ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ a po we kɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami.
A le kaa ke amanehlu ko ba a nɔ ɔ, ta jio, gbenɔ hiɔ jio, hwɔ jio, a ma ba da si ngɛ we nɛ ɔ hɛ mi, he nɛ a jaa mo ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke a fa kue ha mo ngɛ a haomi ɔ mi ɔ, o maa nu, nɛ o ma he a yi wami.
“Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Amon bi, Moab bi, kɛ Edom bi ba tua wɔ.
Benɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a, o kplɛɛ we nɛ a ya gu jamɛ a zugba amɛ a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya lɔgɔ mɛ, nɛ a kpataa we a hɛ mi.
Wa sina ji kaa a ba nɛ a ba fie wɔ kɛ je zugba nɛ o ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa hi nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Mo ji wa Mawu!
Moo gbla a tue ha wɔ, ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ ta babauu nɛ ba tua wɔ nɛ ɔ, wa be nyɛe maa da nya.
Wa li bɔ nɛ wa maa pee ha; mo lɛ wa ngɛ hyɛe.” Yuda nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ba Levi no ko nɔ ngɛ gua a mi.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Yahaziel; Zakaria binyumu ji lɛ.
E je Asaf weku ɔ mi, nɛ e nɛmɛ ji Matania, Yeyel, kɛ Benaya.
Yahaziel de ke, “Nɛnɛ Yehoshafat, nyɛ Yuda bi, kɛ Yerusalem bi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Yawɛ ke nyɛ tsui nɛ ko po, nɛ nyɛ ko ye gbeye kaa nyɛɛ kɛ ta babauu nɛ ɔ ma ya kpe, ejakaa ta a, tsa pi nyɛ nɔ́; Mawu nitsɛ ta ji ta a!
Hwɔɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hia nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ya kpe; a gu Ziz yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ma; nyɛ ma ya na mɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ nya ngɛ Yeruel nga a hɛ mi.
Pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ maa hwu ta nɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya da nyɛ blɔ hehi ngɛ nyɛ ta a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ mlɛ; nyɛ maa na kunimi nɛ Yawɛ maa ye ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ tsui ko po.
Hwɔɔmɛ a je hwɔɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ya kpe, ejakaa Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Yehoshafat kpla si nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ ma a tsuo pee ja, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ja Yawɛ.
Levi bi nɛ je Kohat, kɛ Kora we puɔ nya amɛ ɔ te da si, nɛ a he ose kɛ je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi.
E nɔ jena mɔtu kpla a, ma a hia kɛ ho Tekoa nga a nɔ ya.
Benɛ a yaa a, Yehoshafat de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem bi!
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye manye.
Nyɛ he nɔ́ nɛ e gbali ɔmɛ deɔ nyɛ ɔ nyɛɛ ye, nɛ nyɛ maa ye kunimi.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ kɛ ma a kpe yi, nɛ e fa lali ɔmɛ ke a wo a tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ tabo ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a hi lae ke, “Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa!” Benɛ a hia la a nɛ a bɔni Yawɛ yi jemi pɛ Yawɛ ha nɛ basabasa te si ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ba tua Yuda a a kpɛti, nɛ a fia a he ní.
Mɛ ji Amon, Moab kɛ Edom bihi.
Amon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ ya tua Edom bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi.
Benɛ a gbe Edom bi ɔmɛ se ɔ, a plɛ ngɔ kpee a he kɛ ya si a kpata a sibi a hɛ mi.
Benɛ Yuda ta buli ɔmɛ ba su buli a mɔ ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, a plɛ hyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ a na kaa mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si.
Nɔ kake ngmelu ji mi.
Yehoshafat kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba ha ní ngɛ ni gbogboe ɔmɛ a he.
Ta yibu ní nɛ a ha ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: na babauu, niye ní, tade, kɛ ní kpa komɛ nɛ a he jua wa.
A ngɔ ligbi etɛ kɛ bua ta yibu ní ɔmɛ a nya.
Se a je fuu he, ejakaa ní ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ.
Ligbi nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, a ya bua a he nya ngɛ Beraka kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a je Yawɛ yi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ha mɛ ɔ he.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a tsɛɛ jamɛ a kɔ̃ ɔ ke “Beraka” a nɛ.
Yehoshafat nyɛɛ e tabo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem kɛ manye, ejakaa Yawɛ ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
Benɛ a ba su ma a mi ɔ, a fia saku, nɛ a kpa bɛ, kɛ titimati kɛ ya sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi.
Je ma amɛ tsuo nu kaa Yawɛ ye Israel he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Yehoshafat ye matsɛ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, ejakaa e Mawu ɔ ha lɛ he jɔmi ngɛ he tsuaa he kɛ bɔle si.
Yehoshafat matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe Yehoshafat ye jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Azuba, Shilhi biyo ɔ. Yehoshafat ya wo e tsɛ Asa nane, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e hule we jami he ɔmɛ, nɛ ma a kpale we nɛ a ba nyɛɛ Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ se kɛ a tsui tsuo.
Ní kpahi tsuo nɛ Yehoshafat pee kɛ je e matsɛ yemi ɔ sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Hanani binyumu Yehu Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi fa ji womi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Be ko ɔ, Yuda matsɛ, Yehoshafat, kɛ Israel matsɛ, Ahazia ya pee huɛ.
Ahazia nɛ ɔ, yiwutsotsɛ ji lɛ.
Yehoshafat kɛ Ahazia kpɛ jua yemi lɛhi ngɛ Eziongeber.
Se Dodavahu nɛ je Maresha ma a mi ɔ binyumu Eliezer gba kɛ si Yehoshafat ke, “Akɛnɛ o kɛ Ahazia ya pee huɛ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha nɛ o ní tsumi ɔ maa pee yaka.” Lɛ ɔmɛ ya ywia, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ya su Tarshish.
Yehoshafat ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gɔ ɔ mi ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Yehoram ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoram Matsɛ Yehoshafat binyumu Yehoram ngɛ nyɛminyumuhi ekpa.
Mɛ ji Azaria, Yehiel, Zakaria, Azariahu, Mikael kɛ Shefatia.
A tsɛ ha mɛ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ ní kpa komɛ nɛ a he jua wa babauu nitsɛ; nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi kakaaka.
Se Yehoram lɛɛ akɛnɛ lɛ ji bitɛte he je ɔ, Yehoshafat ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee nɔ nɛ maa ye tsɛ ngɛ e se.
Benɛ Yehoram ba hi sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ e tsɛ se, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ba da si ɔ, e gbe e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ Israel ganɔ komɛ hulɔ.
Yehoram ye jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ benɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha kpaanyɔ.
Lɛ hu e ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane kaa bɔ nɛ Ahab pee ɔ, ejakaa e ngɔ Ahab biyo.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Se Yawɛ sume kaa e ma kpata David we ɔ hɛ mi, ejakaa e kɛ David so, nɛ e wo si ke e kɛ e nina maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yehoram yi nɔ ɔ, Edom tsɔ Yuda hɛ mi atuã, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ya wo matsɛ kɛ ha a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yehoram kɛ e we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ho ya tua Edom.
Edom bi ɔmɛ sa a yi.
Se nyɔ mi ɔ, a bɔ mɔde fia Edom bi ɔmɛ ní, nɛ a ma fo.
Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Edom tsɔ e he kɛ je Yuda nɔ yemi ɔ sisi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Libna ma a hu tsɔ atuã, ejakaa Yehoram je Yawɛ, e nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ se.
Jehanɛ se hu, Yehoram po jami hehi ngɛ Yuda yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem tsuo pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Gbalɔ Eliya ngma Yehoram womi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yawɛ, o nɛ̃ David Mawu ɔ bu mo fɔ; ejakaa o ya nyɛɛ we o tsɛ Yehoshafat, aloo Yuda matsɛ, Asa blɔ kpakpa amɛ a nɔ.
Mohu ɔ, o ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ o ha nɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem tsuo ja amagahi kaa bɔ nɛ Ahab, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ ha nɛ Israel ma a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
O nyɛminyumuhi nɛ a hi pe mo ɔ hu, o gbe mɛ.
Níhi nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ a he je ɔ, Yawɛ maa gbla o ma a, kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ o yi ɔmɛ a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ e ma kpata o níhi nɛ o ngɛ ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Mo nitsɛ lɛɛ o maa nu mi mi hiɔ nɛ nya wa; hiɔ nɛ ɔ maa hi o he daa kɛ yaa si o mi ní maa je pue si.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ sú Filisti bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Arabia bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Sudan bi ɔmɛ a kasa nya a kɛ wo Yehoram he.
A ba tua Yuda, nɛ a ha ní ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ.
A nuu matsɛ ɔ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ kɛ je.
Matsɛ ɔ binyumu sekpɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ahazia a pɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ se.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ Yehoram ba nu mi mi hiɔ nɛ be tsa ba; hiɔ nɛ ɔ hao matsɛ ɔ hluu.
Jeha enyɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ mi ní je pue si, nɛ e gbo kɛ he hiami nɛ nya wa.
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ gbo ɔ, e ma mi bi ɔmɛ slɛ we la ko nɛ tsoo gegeege ɔ kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami kaa bɔ nɛ a pee kɛ ha e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ. Yehoram ye jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha kpaanyɔ.
Benɛ e gbo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko yi lɛ kɔmɔ.
A pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi mohu, se a pu we lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gɔ ɔ mi.
Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia Arabia bi komɛ ya gbe Matsɛ Yehoram binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a si jokuɛyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ahazia a pɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ wo Ahazia matsɛ konɛ e ye e tsɛ ɔ se.
Ahazia ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ benɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi; nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha kake.
E nyɛ Atalia a, Omri bibi ji lɛ.
Atalia tsɛ ji Ahab.
Ahazia hu ya wo Ahab nane nɛ e kɛ pee yayami; ejakaa e nyɛ ji nɔ nɛ woɔ lɛ ga. Ahazia pee yayami, ejakaa e tsɛ gbenɔ se ɔ, Ahab weku li ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ lɛ ga; nɛ mɛ lɛ a kpata e nane.
Mɛ nɔuu lɛ a wo lɛ ga nɛ e ya piɛ Israel matsɛ, Yoram, Ahab binyumu ɔ he nɛ a kɛ Siria matsɛ, Hazael ya hwu ta ngɛ Ramot nɛ ngɛ Gilead ɔ. Siria bi ɔmɛ plaa Yoram ngɛ ta a mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ho Yezreel ma a mi ya konɛ e ya tsa e he.
Yuda matsɛ, Ahazia, Yehoram binyumu ɔ hu bú e nɔ nɛ e ya slaa lɛ.
Se Mawu gu slaami nɛ Ahazia ya slaa Yoram ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ kpata Ahazia hɛ mi.
Benɛ Ahazia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e kɛ Yoram je kpo ya na Nimshi binyumu nɛ a tsɛɛ Yehu ɔ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla kɛ to nɛ e ba kpata Ahab we ɔ hɛ mi.
Benɛ Yehu nyɛɛ Ahab weku li ɔmɛ, kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a se nɛ e ngɛ mɛ gbee ɔ, e ya na Yuda ganɔ komɛ, kɛ Ahazia nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a bimɛ nɛ nyɛɛ Ahazia se kɛ ya slaa Yoram ɔ. Yehu gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A hla Ahazia kɛ kpa si kɛ ya si a ya nu lɛ ngɛ Samaria, he nɛ e ya laa e he ngɛ ɔ.
A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba Yehu ngɔ, nɛ a ba gbe lɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, bumi nɛ a ngɛ kɛ ha e nɛ̃, Matsɛ Yehoshafat he je ɔ, a pu lɛ; ejakaa Yehoshafat sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ e tsui tsuo.
Nɛ e pee ja a, nɔ ko pa be Ahazia weku ɔ mi hu nɛ ma nyɛ maa ye matsɛ.
Yuda manyɛ, Atalia Benɛ Matsɛ Ahazia nyɛ, Atalia na le kaa a gbe e binyumu ɔ, e ha nɛ a kpata Yuda matsɛ we mi bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Se Ahazia ngɛ nyɛmiyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yehosheba, nɛ gba osɔfo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yehoyada.
Yehosheba ku Ahazia binyumu ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yoash ɔ kɛ je matsɛbinyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a yaa gbe ɔ a kpɛti.
E ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ jokuɛ ɔ bimɛanyɛ ɔ ya laa ngɛ se tsu ko mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Yehosheba pee kɛ he Yoash yi wami, nɛ Atalia nine sui e nɔ.
Yoash hi lejɛ ɔ ngɛ laami tso mi jeha ekpa sɔuu, be mi nɛ Atalia ngɛ manyɛ yee ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
A te si ngɔ wo Atalia Manyɛ Atalia yi nɔ, jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, osɔfo Yehoyada ba na kaa e su be nɛ sa kaa e pee nɔ́ ko.
E kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ enuɔ so.
Mɛ ji Yeroham bi Azaria, Yehohanan bi Ishmael, Obed bi Azaria, Adaya bi Maaseya, kɛ Zikri bi Elishafat.
Asafoatsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ya kpa Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ a ya kpee Levi bi, kɛ Israel we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Mɛ tsuo a ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ a kɛ Yoash, matsɛbi ɔ ba so ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yehoyada de mɛ ke, “Matsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ sa nɛ e ye matsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ke David nina maa pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ wa maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ba ní tsumi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a mi dlami etɛ mi kake ma ya bu Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔmɛ a nya, mi dlami etɛ mi kake ma ya bu ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ maa hi sisi tomi agbo ɔ nya.
Ma a tsuo ma bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kue ɔ mi.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ya Yawɛ we ɔ kaa ja osɔfohi, kɛ Levi bi nɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ pɛ; mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma nyɛ maa ya lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa a ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ a ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ; a ko ya lejɛ ɔ. Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a bɔle matsɛ ɔ, nɛ a hɛɛ a ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ mi; he tsuaa he nɛ matsɛ ɔ maa ya a, a kɛ lɛ nɛ ya.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma hla kaa e maa sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, a gbe lɛ.” Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ma a pee kaa bɔ nɛ osɔfo Yehoyada fa mɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nihi nɛ ba tsu ní Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɛ sa kaa a ya we mi ɔ, osɔfo Yehoyada ha we nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ná we bi babauu, nihi nɛ ma ní tsumi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kpa.
Osɔfo Yehoyada dla Matsɛ David akplɔhi, kɛ tsɛ̃ihi nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ ha asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
E ngɔ nihi nɛ hɛɛ ta hwumi níhi ngɛ a dɛ mi ɔ ngɔ to Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi, kɛ je kɔ nya kake kɛ ya si kɔ nya kake, konɛ a bu matsɛ ɔ he.
Jehanɛ, Yehoyada je matsɛbi ɔ kpo, nɛ e fi lɛ jlasi, nɛ e ngɔ mlaa womi ɔ ngɔ wo e dɛ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a pee kɛ wo lɛ matsɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yehoyada kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pɔ Yoash nu, nɛ ma a he ose ke, “Matsɛ yi nɛ na wa oo!” Benɛ Atalia nu lele ɔ nɛ ma a hwɔ kɛ ngɛ matsɛ ɔ he nyae, nɛ e na bɔ nɛ a hɛɛ fo kɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ, e he esɔ kɛ ya Yawɛ we ɔ, he nɛ ma a bua a he nya ngɛ ɔ. E maa hyɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ titima a he kaa bɔ nɛ kusumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ titimati kpali ɔmɛ daa si kɛ bɔle lɛ, nɛ ma a tsuo ngɛ lele hwɔe, nɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae.
Lali ɔmɛ hu ngɛ lae, nɛ a ngɛ saku fiae kɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ ngɛ nyami ɔ he sɔ woe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Atalia hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e kpa bubuubui, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ tsɔ atuã!
Nyɛ tsɔ atuã!” Osɔfo Yehoyada sume kaa a gbe Atalia ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ je lɛ kpo kɛ gu buli ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ka kaa e ma kpɔ lɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a nu Atalia pani nya kɛ ho matsɛ we ɔ mi ya, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ ngɛ okpɔngɔ agbo ɔ nya.
Yehoyada tsake níhi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ, kɛ ma a, kɛ matsɛ ɔ tsuo so kaa a maa pee Yawɛ ma.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ya sɛ Baal jami he ɔ, nɛ a gbɛ lɛ kɛ pue si.
A ku bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ amaga amɛ dukuduku, nɛ a gbe Baal osɔfo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Matan ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Yehoyada ngɔ Yawɛ we ɔ ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, konɛ a tsu ní ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ David dla ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ. Mɛ lɛ a maa sã bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi ɔ. Mɛ kɛ̃ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hyɛ lami, kɛ nyami blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Yehoyada ngɔ buli hu ngɔ to Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔmɛ a nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hla kaa e maa sɛ mi ɔ, a ko ngmɛ lɛ blɔ.
Nyagbe ɔ, osɔfo Yehoyada, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo kpaka matsɛ ɔ kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ ba matsɛ we ɔ mi.
A gu agbo ngua a mi kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ matsɛ ɔ ya hi matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ na bua jɔmi; nɛ kɛ je be nɛ a gbe Atalia se ɔ, ma a mi jɔ.
Yuda matsɛ, Yoash Yoash ba bɔni Yuda ma a nɔ yemi, benɛ e ye jeha kpaago, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Zibia, nɛ e je Beersheba ma a mi.
Yoash pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní, be mi nɛ osɔfo Yehoyada ngɛ je mi ɔ. Yehoyada hla yihi enyɔ kɛ ha Matsɛ Yoash, nɛ Yoash kɛ mɛ fɔ binyumuhi, kɛ biyihi.
Benɛ Yoash ye matsɛ ɔ be saii ɔ, e to e yi mi kaa e ma dla Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ ehe.
E fa osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ke a ya Yuda ma amɛ a mi, nɛ a ya tsu sika ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a dɛ kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ dla Yawɛ we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ daa jeha a. E de mɛ ke a pee esɔ, se Levi bi ɔmɛ to tsle.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɛ Yehoyada, a nyatsɛ ɔ, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Tó ɔ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose de ke ma a nɛ tsu konɛ a kɛ tsu Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he ní ɔ, mɛni he je o hyɛ we nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ya tsu ngɛ Yuda ma a amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem ɔ?” (Jamɛ a yo yiwutsotsɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Atalia a, e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ya ku Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ a muɔ ní klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Baal piɛ ɔ mi ya.)
Matsɛ ɔ fa Levi bi ɔmɛ ke a kpɛ daka nɛ a kɛ ma tsu tó ɔ, nɛ a kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya.
A fiɛ kɛ kpa Yerusalem, kɛ Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi ke, tó ɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔlɔ Mose tsu ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ e nɔ́ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ.
Sane nɛ ɔ ngɔ ma a, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ a nya saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ a tó ɔ kɛ ba ba wo daka a mi hluu kɛ ya si e hyi tɔ.
Daa ligbi ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ ma wo daka a kɛ ya ha matsɛ ní tsulɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ ɔ. Ke daka a hyi ɔ, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a tsɔlɔ ko ma je sika a, kɛkɛ a kpale daka a ya ma e ma he ɔ ekohu.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ a pee nɛ a kɛ bua sika babauu nya.
Matsɛ ɔ kɛ Yehoyada ngɔ sika a kɛ ha nihi nɛ a tu Yawɛ we ɔ dlami ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo a dɛ ɔ. Mɛ hu a ya bɔ tɛ gbali, kapitɛhi, dade ga ní tsuli, kɛ akɔblee ga ní tsuli apaa konɛ a ba dla Yawɛ we ɔ. Ní tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo tsu ní wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ya si a dla Yawɛ we ɔ gbe nya, nɛ a pee lɛ ehe kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ sa a. Benɛ a gbe ní tsumi ɔ nya a, a kɛ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ha matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Yehoyada, nɛ mɛ hu a kɛ pee kpluhi, kɛ ní kpa komɛ kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ mi.
A tsake Yehoyada blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ Yehoyada wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, a sãã bɔhi daa ligbi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Jehanɛ, Yehoyada ba bwɔ kotokoto, nɛ benɛ e ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi etɛ ɔ, e gbo.
A pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a pu he ɔ ngɛ David ma a mi.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ e tsu kɛ ha Israel ma a, kɛ Mawu we ɔ he.
Se benɛ Yehoyada gbo se ɔ, Yuda ganɔ ɔmɛ ba a he si ha Matsɛ Yoash, nɛ lɛ hu e nu a munyu.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ a jɔɔ Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ we ɔ yami, nɛ a ya ja amagahi, kɛ yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. Yayami nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ ha nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem.
Yawɛ tsɔ gbali kɛ ba a ngɔ, konɛ a ba kpale mɛ kɛ ba lɛ Yawɛ ɔ ngɔ ekohu; se ma a bui mɛ tue.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ba osɔfo Yehoyada binyumu Zakaria nɔ.
E ho ya da si ngɛ he nɛ ma a maa na lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ bie ke, mɛni he je nyɛ kua e mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ haomi ba nyɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ!
Nyɛ kua Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu e kua nyɛ!” Matsɛ Yoash kɛ ma a so ngɔ wo Zakaria he, nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa mɛ nɛ a ya fia Zakaria tɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kue ɔ mi.
Matsɛ Yoash hɛ je si himi kpakpa nɛ Zakaria tsɛ Yehoyada kɛ lɛ hi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e gbe e binyumu Zakaria.
Benɛ Zakaria miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, e de ke “Yawɛ nɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ e gbla nyɛ tue!” Yoash matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe Jamɛ a jeha a nyagbe ɔ, Siria tabo ɔ ba tua Yuda kɛ Yerusalem; a gbe ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a ngɔ ta yibu ní babauu kɛ ho Damasko ya.
Siria tabo ɔ, a he pi kulaa.
Se Yawɛ ngɔ Yuda ta buli babauu ɔ ngɔ wo a dɛ mi; ejakaa ma a kua Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ. Blɔ nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ gbla Yoash tue ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A plaa Yoash wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Benɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpale a se ɔ, e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nihi enyɔ so ngɔ wo e he, nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɔ wo sa mi.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ ye osɔfo Yehoyada binyumu ɔ nɛ e gbe ɔ he lue.
A pu Yoash ngɛ David ma a mi mohu, se a pu we lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a pu he ɔ. Nihi nɛ so ngɔ wo e he ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Zabad, Amon yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shimeat ɔ binyumu, kɛ Yehozabad, Moab yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shimrit ɔ binyumu.
Yoash binyumu ɔmɛ a he sanehi, gbamihi nɛ a gba kɛ si lɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e dla Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ e pee lɛ ehe ekohu ɔ, a ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Womi ɔ sisi tsɔɔmi womi ɔ mi.
Yoash binyumu Amazia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ ɔ se.
Yuda matsɛ, Amazia Amazia ba bɔni tsɛ yemi benɛ e ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ nɛɛ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Yehoadin, nɛ e je Yerusalem ma a mi.
Amazia pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní, se pi kɛ e tsui tsuo.
Benɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ba da si ɔ, e gbe e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ gbe matsɛ ɔ nɛ ji e tsɛ ɔ.
Se a bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ngɛ mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ wo ɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose womi ɔ mi ke, “A ko gbe fɔli ngɛ yayami nɛ a bimɛ pee ɔ he, nɛ a ko gbe bimɛ hu ngɛ yayami nɛ a fɔli pee ɔ he, se ke nɔ ko pee yayami ɔ, a gbe nɔ ɔ nitsɛ ngɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he ɔ, e gbi mɛ.” Amazia kɛ Edom bi hwu ta Matsɛ Amazia dla nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yuda, kɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi ɔ kɛ wo tabohi a mi we puɔ nya we puɔ nya.
E ngɔ asafoatsɛmɛ ngɔ to nihi akpehi kɛ lafahi a nya, nɛ a na ta buli akpe lafa etɛ nɛ ji nyumuhi nɛ a ye jeha nyingmi enyɔɔnyɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye pe ja.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ta buli nɛ a kɔni si wa ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ; a le bɔ nɛ a kɛ akplɔ kɛ tsɛ̃i hwuɔ ta ha.
Amazia kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ jiɔmi ji kilo akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ ya bɔ ta buli akpe lafa hu apaa ngɛ Israel ba piɛ ni ɔmɛ a he.
Se gbalɔ ko ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, o kɛ Israel tabo ɔ ko ya ta, ejakaa Yawɛ je a se; Yawɛ je Efraim bi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se.
Ke o susu kaa ke a ba piɛ o he nɛ o he maa wa a, o sisi o he pɛ.
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko maa ye kunimi ngɛ ta mi, loo a maa ye e nɔ ɔ, e je Mawu; Mawu ma ha nɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa ye o nɔ.” Amazia bi gbalɔ ɔ ke, “Lɛɛ sika hiɔ nɛ jiɔmi ji kilo akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha Israel tabo ɔ, mɛni wa maa pee ngɛ he?” Gbalɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ ma nyɛ ma ha mo nɔ́ nɛ hiɛ pe ja!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Amazia wo tabo ɔ nɛ e ya bɔ apaa a blɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke a kpale kɛ ho Efraim ya.
A mi mi fu Yuda ma a wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho a je he ya.
Jehanɛ, Amazia ba na he wami he, nɛ e nyɛɛ e ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya Ngo kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
A kɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a gbe Edom ta buli akpe nyɔngma, nɛ a nuu a ti nihi akpe nyɔngma hu hɛ ngmengmle.
A ngɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nuu hɛ ngmengmle ɔ kɛ ya tɛ sa ko yi mi ngɛ Sela ma a mi, nɛ a tsitsɛɛ a yi se kɛ wo kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ tɛ sa amɛ tsɔtslɔɔ a mi dukuduku.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ Amazia ha we nɛ a piɛ a he kɛ ya ta a ho ya tua Yuda ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Samaria kɛ Bet Horon a kpɛti ɔ, nɛ a gbe nyumuhi akpe etɛ, nɛ a ha níhi babauu.
Benɛ Amazia ya ye Edom bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi nɛ e kpale kɛ ma a, e ngɔ a we amaga amɛ kɛ ba.
E kɛ mɛ ba ma si, nɛ e ja mɛ, nɛ e sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha mɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu Amazia, nɛ e tsɔ gbalɔ ko kɛ ba e ngɔ.
Gbalɔ ɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Ma se mawuhi nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma mi bi kɛ je o dɛ mi ɔ, mɛni he je o ngɛ mɛ jae?” Se benɛ gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Amazia po munyu ngɛ e nya, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ je mɛni be lɛ wa wo mo matsɛ ga wolɔ?
Jɔɔ mo; ke pi ja a, ma ha a gbe mo piɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ kpa.
Se loko e maa pee dii ɔ, e de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ i le kaa Mawu to e yi mi kaa e ma kpata o hɛ mi; ejakaa o bui ye ga womi ɔ tue, nɛ o ya tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.” Amazia kɛ Israel bi hwu ta Yuda matsɛ, Amazia kɛ e ga woli ɔmɛ so kɛ wo Israel he.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e tsɔ ya de Israel matsɛ, Yehoash, Yehu bi Yehoahaz bi ɔ ke, “Ba nɛ o kɛ mi ba kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi!” Israel matsɛ, Yehoash hu tsɔ ya de Yuda matsɛ, Amazia ke, “Be ko ɔ, Lebanon mio tso tsɔ ke a ya de Lebanon seda ke, ‘Ngɔɔ o biyo ɔ ngɔ ha ye binyumu ɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si!’ Kɛkɛ nɛ Lebanon pu mi lohwe ko ba be, nɛ e naa mio tso ɔ nɔ.
Mo Amazia, nɛ o gbe Edom bi ɔmɛ he je ɔ, o ngɛ o he nɔ woe.
I ngɛ mo ga woe ke o hi si ngɛ o we mi.
Mɛni sane o ngɛ hlae nɛ o je ɔ?
Anɛ o li kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ haomi maa ba o kɛ o ma Yuda tsuo nyɛ nɔ lo?” Se Amazia tsi e tue.
Mamoo Mawu suɔmi nya ji kaa a ye Amazia nɔ kunimi, ejakaa e ya ja Edom amaga amɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Yehoash hia nɛ e kɛ Yuda matsɛ Amazia ya bua ngɛ ta nga nɔ, ngɛ Yuda ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Bet Shemesh ɔ. Israel ye Yuda nɔ kunimi, nɛ Yuda ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya.
Israel matsɛ, Yehoash nu Yuda matsɛ Amazia, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem.
Benɛ a ba su Yerusalem ɔ, Yehoash ha nɛ a ku Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ gugue lafa ngɔ pue si kɛ je Efraim agbo ɔ nya, kɛ ya si kɔ nya agbo ɔ nya.
Benɛ e kpale e se kɛ yaa Samaria a, e muɔ ta yibu ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ho: sika tsu, sika hiɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, ní kpahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ Obed Edom nina a hyɛɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ june ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Yehoash nuu ni komɛ hu kaa ta nyɔguɛhi kɛ je.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Israel matsɛ, Yehoash gbo kekle, nɛ e gbenɔ se jeha nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ loko Yuda matsɛ, Amazia ba gbo.
Amazia he sane kpahi kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si e matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe ɔ, a ngma lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Kɛ je be mi nɛ Amazia je Yawɛ se ɔ, e ma mi bi ɔmɛ so ngɔ wo e he ngɛ Yerusalem.
Nyagbenyagbe ɔ, e tu fo kɛ ho Lakish ma a mi ya; se e he nyɛli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ e se, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A kɛ e flɔ̃ ɔ fɔ okpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ a ba pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a pu he ɔ ngɛ David ma a mi.
Yuda matsɛ, Uzia Yuda ma a tsuo wo Uzia matsɛ ngɛ e tsɛ Amazia se.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
Benɛ Amazia gbo se ɔ, Uzia kpɔ Elat kɛ ha Yuda ekohu, nɛ e fia gbogbo kɛ wo ma a he.
Uzia ba bɔni tsɛ yemi benɛ e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enuɔ kɛ enyɔ.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Yekolia, nɛ e je Yerusalem.
Uzia ya wo e tsɛ nane, nɛ e pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní.
Be mi nɛ Zakaria ngɛ je mi ɔ, Uzia sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ e tsui tsuo; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ hu gbaa lɛ.
Zakaria ji nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ Uzia Mawu gbeye yemi.
Uzia kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta.
E ku Gat, Yamnia, kɛ Ashdod gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ pue si; nɛ e po mahi ngɛ Ashdod kasa nya, kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo nɔ.
Mawu piɛ e he nɛ e kɛ ye Filisti bi, Arabia bi nɛ ngɛ Gurbaal ɔ, kɛ Meun bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
Amon bi ɔmɛ tsuɔ tó kɛ haa Uzia.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ba he si, nɛ e biɛ pɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ya su Egipt tɔɔ.
Uzia fia gbogbo ngɔ wo Yerusalem he, nɛ e ma mɔ gagaagahi ngɛ kɔ̃ nya agbo ɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ agbo ɔ a nɔ, kɛ he nɛ gbogbo ɔ lɔgɔ si ngɛ ɔ. E ma mɔhi ngɛ nga a nɔ hulɔ, nɛ e tsua vuhi fuu, ejakaa e ngɛ lohwehi babauu ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi, kɛ nga a nɔ.
Akɛnɛ e suɔ humi he je ɔ, e wo e ma mi bi ɔmɛ he wami, nɛ a hu wai ngmɔhi ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
Uzia ngɛ ta buli babauu nɛ a tsɔse mɛ, nɛ a mia kɛ ha ta hwumi.
A dla ta buli ɔmɛ ngɔ wo kuuhi a mi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ji matsɛ pɛdiyo Yeyel, e setsɔ Maaseya, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hanania, matsɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
We puɔ nya dali katsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ tabo ɔ nya a, a hiɛmi ji akpe enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.
Ta buli nɛ ngɛ a sisi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe lafa etɛ kɛ kpaago kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
A je blɔ tsɔse ta buli nɛ ɔmɛ saminya, nɛ ke a kɛ matsɛ ɔ he nyɛli ya bua a, a nine nyɛɔ mɛ.
Uzia ha e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo ta hwumi ní nɛ ɔmɛ: tsɛ̃i, akplɔ, dade pɛɛ, dade dama, kɛ̃ɛ̃, kɛ amlami tɛ.
E ha nɛ e ga ní tsuli kpanaa amɛ pee klama komɛ ngɛ Yerusalem.
A kɛ klama amɛ ma mɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ gbogbo kɔ̃ nya amɛ a nɔ, konɛ a kɛ tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃, nɛ a kɛ kpɛne tɛ agboagbohi kɛ je lejɛ ɔmɛ.
E matsɛ yemi ɔ he si, nɛ e biɛ pɛ kɛ ya lokoo, ejakaa Mawu piɛ e he.
A gbla Uzia tue Se benɛ Uzia tsɛ yemi ɔ ba he si ɔ, e wo e he nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ e hɛ mi kpata.
E ya sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tɔ̃ Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ nɔ.
Se osɔfo Azaria, kɛ osɔfohi katsɛmɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ nyɛɛ matsɛ ɔ se, nɛ a ya tsi e nya.
A de lɛ ke, “Uzia, o be he blɔ nɛ o sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa Yawɛ.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Aaron nina a, mɛ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hla ngɔ to nɛ a tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Jee he klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ. O tɔ̃ Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e gbaami be o nɔ hu.” Uzia daa si ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ e dɛ mi ngɛyu.
E mi mi fu osɔfo ɔmɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ba pue e hɛ nya amlɔ nɔuu.
Benɛ Azaria, kɛ osɔfo kpa amɛ na hiɔ ɔ ngɛ e hɛ nya a, a tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ. Lɛ nitsɛ hu e he sɔ kɛ je kpo, ejakaa Yawɛ gbla e tue.
He womi nɔ hiɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Matsɛ Uzia he hluu kɛ ya si e gbenɔ ligbi.
E ho ya hi lɛ nitsɛ e we ɔ mi, ejakaa a tsi e nya ke e ko ya Yawɛ we ɔ hu.
A he e ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e binyumu Yotam ba ye e nane mi kɛ hyɛ ma a nɔ.
Matsɛ Uzia he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ ngma lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Uzia ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a pu he ɔ; se e hiɔ ɔ he je ɔ, a pu we lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ eko mi.
E binyumu Yotam ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Yotam Yotam bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ benɛ e ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
E nyɛ ji Zadok biyo Yerusha.
Yotam pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ Uzia pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; se lɛɛ e ya sɛ̃ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma a ya nɔ pee yayami.
Yotam ji nɔ nɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ omleyi je agbo ɔ nɛ.
Yerusalem ma a he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Ofel ɔ, Yotam nɔuu lɛ fia lejɛ ɔ gbogbo ɔ saminya.
E po mahi ngɛ Yuda yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ma mɔhi ngɛ hue ɔmɛ a mi.
E kɛ Amon matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e tabo ɔ ya hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ kunimi.
E nyɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a tsu tó nɛ ɔmɛ ha lɛ jeha etɛ: sika hiɔ nɛ jiimi ji, kilo akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ, ngma nɛ jiimi ji tɔn akpe kɛ akoko hu kilo akpe.
Yotam matsɛ yemi ɔ ba he si, ejakaa e bu Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ tue ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
Yotam he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, tahi nɛ e hwu, kɛ bɔ nɛ e to níhi a blɔ nya ha a, a ngma lɛ tsuo ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yotam ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ benɛ e bɔni matsɛ yemi, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
Yotam ba gbo nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ David ma a mi, nɛ e binyumu Ahaz ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Ahaz Ahaz bɔni tsɛ yemi benɛ e ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ ekpa.
E pee we Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ e nɛ̃ David lɛɛ e pee ɔ. Mohu ɔ, e ya wo Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane.
E ha nɛ a puɛ dade amagahi po kɛ ha Baal ɔmɛ.
E sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ.
E kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ po sã sami bɔhi kɛ ha amagahi kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi ɔ pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ahaz sã bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ, yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ tsohi nɛ a bɔ kusuu ɔ a sisi.
Ahaz kɛ Siria kɛ Israel hwu ta - Akɛnɛ Matsɛ Ahaz pee yayami he je ɔ, Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ ha nɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ ba ye e nɔ kunimi, nɛ e nuu Yuda bi babauu nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Damasko ya.
Jehanɛ hu, Yawɛ ha nɛ Israel matsɛ, Peka, Remalia binyumu ɔ ba ye Ahaz nɔ, nɛ e gbe Yuda ta buli kpakpahi akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ ligbi kake.
Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ngmɛ blɔ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yuda ma a kua lɛ.
Israel ta bulɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zikri ɔ gbe Matsɛ Ahaz binyumu Maaseya, matsɛ we nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Azrikam ɔ, kɛ Elkana, matsɛ se yelɔ ɔ. Israel bi ɔmɛ nuu a nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi akpe lafa enyɔ nɛ ji yihi kɛ jokuɛwi sɔuu nyɔguɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ho Samaria ya.
A muɔ ta yibu ní babauu hu kɛ ho.
Gbalɔ Oded Yawɛ gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Oded ngɛ Samaria jamɛ a be ɔ mi.
Benɛ Israel tabo ɔ kpale a se kɛ ma Samaria a, Oded ya kpee mɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ mi mi fu Yuda, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi.
Se nyɛ gbe mɛ basabasa nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko be mi; nɛ Yawɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ to kaa nyɛ maa pee nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda a nyɛ nyɔguɛhi.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ pee yayamihi kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ lo?
Tse nyɛ ngɛ tue bue!
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ya nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ.
Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a ho; ke pi ja a, Yawɛ kɛ mi mi la maa gbla nyɛ tue.” Efraim nikɔtɔma eywiɛ komɛ hu nɔ́ nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ pee ɔ ngɔɛ a nya.
Mɛ ji Yehohanan binyumu Azaria, Meshilemot binyumu Berekia, Shalum binyumu Yehizkia, kɛ Hadlai binyumu Amasa.
A de ta buli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ngɔ ta nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ!
Wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ; wa wo e mi mi la, nɛ tue gblami fɔɔ si ha wɔ momo.
Jehanɛ, nyɛ pa ngɛ pee konɛ wa yayami ɔ nɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ngɔ ta nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ ngɔ wo ma a, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
A hla ni eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a wo a biɛ ta a ke a hyɛ ta nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ hɛɛ a he gu, nɛ e hia kaa a ha mɛ bo nɛ a bu ɔ, a ha mɛ bo; ni nɛmɛ nɛ e hia kaa a ha mɛ tade nɛ a wo hu, a ha mɛ tade.
Ta yibu ní ɔmɛ nɛ a ha a ekomɛ ji bo ɔmɛ, kɛ tade ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, a ha mɛ tokota nɛ a wo; a ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye; a ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu, nɛ a to a pa amɛ a nɔ nu.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ, nɛ he wami be a he ɔ, a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ hi tejihi a nɔ, nɛ a kpale mɛ tsuo kɛ ho Yuda zugba a nɔ ya ngɛ Yeriko, ma nɛ tã ngɛ mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ho Samaria ya.
Ahaz ya bi Asiria yemi kɛ buami -Pee se ɔ, Edom bi ɔmɛ ba tua Yuda ekohu, nɛ a nuu ta nyɔguɛhi babauu kɛ ho.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Matsɛ Ahaz tsɔ ya de Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ke e ba je ngmlaa ha lɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Filisti bi ɔmɛ hu ba tua mahi nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, kɛ mahi nɛ ngɛ Yuda leneyi je ɔ. Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a hi a mi: Bet Shemesh, Aiyalon, kɛ Gederot.
A ngɔ Soko kɛ Timna, kɛ Gimzo, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma nɛ ɔmɛ.
Yuda matsɛ, Ahaz he ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ haomi ba Yuda ma a tsuo nɔ; ejakaa Ahaz ngmɛɛ ma a he kɛ fɔ si, nɛ e pee yayami babauu hu kɛ si Yawɛ.
Se benɛ Asiria matsɛ, Tiglat Pileser ba a, e ba piɛ we Matsɛ Ahaz he; e ba hao lɛ mohu.
Ahaz ya muɔ sika tsu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e kɛ ha Asiria matsɛ ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Tiglat Pileser piɛ we e he.
Ahaz he yayamihi Kikɛmɛ a Matsɛ Ahaz nɛ ɔ, benɛ e yi ba fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ po, e pee yayami babauu kɛ si Yawɛ pe kekle ɔ. E sãã bɔhi kɛ haa Siria mawu ɔmɛ nɛ ba ye e nɔ kunimi ɔ. E deɔ ke, “Siria mawu ɔmɛ piɛɔ Siria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i sã bɔ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ, a maa piɛ imi hu ye he.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ haomi ba e kɛ e ma a tsuo nɔ.
Ahaz bua Yawɛ we ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ e ywia mɛ dukuduku.
E ngmɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nya; nɛ e ma bɔ sami la tɛhi ngɛ he tsuaa he ngɛ Yerusalem.
E po jami hehi ngɛ Yuda mahi, kɛ kɔpehi tsuo a mi, konɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha ma se mawuhi.
Bɔ nɛ e pee kɛ wo Yawɛ, e nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ mi mi la ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛ Ahaz he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ je e matsɛ yemi ɔ sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Matsɛ Ahaz ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem; se a pu we lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a pu he ɔ. E bi Hezekia ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia Hezekia ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ benɛ e ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ nɛɛ.
E nyɛ ji Abiya, Zakaria biyo ɔ. Hezekia ya wo e nɛ̃ David nane, nɛ e pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní.
A tsukɔ Yawɛ we ɔ he Benɛ Hezekia bɔni matsɛ yemi ɔ, jamɛ a jeha a we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e bli Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔmɛ ekohu, nɛ e ha nɛ a dla mɛ.
E kpee osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba kue ɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ Levi bi, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛɛ tsukɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ we ɔ hu he.
Nyɛ je nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ bleɔ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ. Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ yi Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ anɔkuale; a pee yayami kɛ si lɛ.
A kua Yawɛ, nɛ e we ɔ hu a yɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ya ja lɛ.
A nga Yawɛ we ɔ sinya amɛ, nɛ a gbe kane ɔmɛ.
Tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ sami bɔ pohu a kpa sami ngɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ we ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Yuda kɛ Yerusalem, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee mɛ ɔ ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ he mi po, nɛ a ye gbeye.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ.
Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ wa yi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je.
“Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i to ye yi mi kaa i kɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ maa so, konɛ e mi mi nɛ fu wɔ wawɛɛ ɔ se nɛ po.
Ye bimɛ!
Nyɛ ko puɛ be ko hu.
Nyɛ ji nihi nɛ Yawɛ hla nɛ nyɛɛ sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha lɛ.
Yawɛ hla nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ sɔmɔ lɛ.” -Levi bi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a be ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Kohat weku: Amasai binyumu Mahat, kɛ Azaria binyumu Yoel.
Merari weku: Abdi binyumu Kish, kɛ Yehalelel binyumu Azaria.
Gershon weku: Zimna binyumu Yoa, kɛ Yoa binyumu Eden.
Elizafan weku: Shimri kɛ Yeuel.
Asaf weku: Zakaria kɛ Matania.
Heman weku: Yehuel kɛ Shimei.
Yedutun weku: Shemaya kɛ Uziel.
Nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ ya bua a nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ mɛ tsuo a tsukɔ a he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa mɛ ke a pee ngɛ Yawɛ munyu ɔ nya a, a bɔni Yawɛ we ɔ he tsukɔmi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ ya sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi nɛ a tsukɔ lejɛ ɔ.
A muɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba kue ɔ mi.
Levi bi ɔmɛ hu muɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ je kpo nɛ a ya sake ngɔ pue Kidron pa a mi.
A je ní tsumi ɔ sisi ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ, a ya su kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ he.
A tsu ní ligbi kpaanyɔ kɛ piɛ he.
Nɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ ekpa a, a tsukɔ Yawɛ we ɔ tsuo he gbe nya.
A bli Yawɛ we ɔ nya ekohu Kɛkɛ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ba Matsɛ Hezekia ngɔ, nɛ a ba bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ke, “Wa pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ Yawɛ we ɔ tsuo gbe nya.
La tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, kɛ okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo klɔuklɔu ɔ maa nɔ ɔ, kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, wa tsukɔ a he.
Jehanɛ, ní klɔuklɔuhi tsuo nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz hɛ ngɔ fɔ he benɛ e kpa Yawɛ se nyɛɛmi ɔ, wa bua tsuo nya nɛ wa pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ekohu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ní ɔmɛ pueɔ si ngɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Hezekia pee esɔ ya kpee ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tsuo ya sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi.
A ngɔ na ku kpaago, agbosu kpaago, jijɔ kpaago, kɛ to akpakpo kpaago kɛ ya sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ, Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ Yuda ma a. Matsɛ ɔ fa osɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Aaron nina a ke a gbe lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kekleekle ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ gbe na ku ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ muɔ ɔ fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a gbe agbosu ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ a muɔ ɔ fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Jehanɛ, a gbe jijɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ a muɔ ɔ fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Nyagbe ɔ, a ngɔ to akpakpo ɔmɛ kɛ ba matsɛ ɔ kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ a ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ gbe to akpakpo ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ a muɔ ɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a tsuo; ejakaa matsɛ ɔ fa ke a sã sami bɔ, kɛ yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha Israel tsuo.
Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Matsɛ David kɛ gu lɛ David ɔ gbalɔ Gad, kɛ gbalɔ Natan a nɔ ɔ, Matsɛ Hezekia ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E ngɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ ya da si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ a dɛ mi gɔgɔhi, bɛhi, kɛ sakuhi nɛ ngɛ kaa matsɛ David ní ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ hu daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ a titimati ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Hezekia fa ke a sã sami bɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Benɛ a bɔni bɔ ɔ sami pɛ, ma a la kɛ je Yawɛ yi; titimati kpali ɔmɛ kpa titimati, nɛ saku fiali ɔmɛ hu fia saku.
Ma a tsuo kpla si nɛ a ja Mawu; lali ɔmɛ la, nɛ titimati kpali ɔmɛ kpa titimati hluu kɛ ya si a sã sami bɔ ɔ gbe nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Hezekia kɛ ma a tsuo kpla si nɛ a ja Mawu.
Matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ fa Levi bi ɔmɛ ke, yi jemi lahi nɛ David, kɛ gbalɔ Asaf po ɔ, a la jamɛ a la amɛ kɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ a kpla si nɛ a ngɛ Mawu jae ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ la kɛ bua jɔmi.
Hezekia de ma a ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ bɔhi, kɛ sina bɔ ba ha Yawɛ.” A pee ja, nɛ a ti ni komɛ je a tsui mi faa nɛ a ngɔ lohwehi kɛ ba konɛ a kɛ sã sami bɔhi.
Lohwehi nɛ ma a kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: na ku nyingmi kpaago, agbosu lafa, kɛ jijɔ lafa enyɔ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, a ngɔ na ku lafa ekpa, kɛ jijɔ akpe etɛ kɛ ba kaa bɔhi nɛ a gbaa a nɔ ha ma a nɛ a ye.
Akɛnɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a he pi bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ maa gbe lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo he je ɔ, a nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ba piɛ a he kɛ tsu ní ɔ kɛ ya si a gbe nya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ babauu pee a he klɔuklɔu.
(Levi bi ɔmɛ bɔɔ mɔde kaa a maa pee a he klɔuklɔu pe osɔfo ɔmɛ po).
Ngɛ lohwehi babauu nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, a kɛ zɔ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ, nɛ a ngɔ wai bɔhi hu kɛ piɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ a he.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a bɔni Yawɛ jami ngɛ e we ɔ mi ekohu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛ Hezekia kɛ ma a tsuo na bua jɔmi, ejakaa Mawu piɛ a he kɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ be kuku mi.
A dla kɛ ha Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ɔ - Ma a nyɛ we nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ ngɛ e be mi ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi, ejakaa osɔfo ɔmɛ babauu na we nɛ a pee a he klɔuklɔu jamɛ a be ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ hu, nihi babauu na we nɛ a ba Yerusalem.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Matsɛ Hezekia, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ kplɛɛ kaa a maa ye Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi; nɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɔ ya bɔ Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo amaniɛ.
E je blɔ ngma womi ya kpee Efraim kɛ Manase wɛtso ɔmɛ ke a ba Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a ba ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔ sa matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a to kaa á ya kpee Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ a ba ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Á je Dan ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ Beersheba ngɛ leneyi je kɛ ba, nɛ a he nɛ hiɛ babauu pe bɔ nɛ a baa daa a. Tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ kɛ ya kpa Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo, nɛ a de ke, “Israel ma!
Asiria bi ba tua nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ je a dɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu ɔ ngɔ, konɛ lɛ hu e kpale nɛ e he nyɛ.
Nyɛ ko pee kaa nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ na a, Mawu gbla a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nyɛ ko wa tue kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ; mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ tue.
Nyɛɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, we nɛ e pee klɔuklɔu kɛ yaa neneene ɔ. Nyɛ ba ja lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ e mi mi nɛ fu nyɛ wawɛɛ ɔ se nɛ po.
Ke nyɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a ní maa pee nihi nɛ ba nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ɔ mɔbɔ.
A maa ngmɛɛ a he, nɛ a maa kpale kɛ ba we ekohu.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ.
Ke nyɛ kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ ɔ, e ma he nyɛ atuu.” Tsɔli ɔmɛ ya kpa ma amɛ tsuo a mi ngɛ Efraim kɛ Manase zugba amɛ a nɔ kɛ ya si Zebulun tɔɔ ngɛ omleyi je.
Nihi muɔ mɛ nɛ a ye a he fɛu.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Asher, Manase, kɛ Zebulun bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi bɔɔ ba a he si, nɛ a kplɛɛ kaa a maa ba Yerusalem.
Yuda hu, Mawu ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; Mawu ha nɛ Yuda ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a nya sɔ.
A to a yi mi kaa a maa bu Yawɛ tue; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ, a maa pee.
A ye Hetsɔmi ɔ Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nihi babauu nitsɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem konɛ a ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ.
A ya je bɔ sami la tɛhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a sãã bɔhi kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, nɛ a muɔ mɛ kɛ ya pue Kidron pa a mi.
Nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ, a gbe jijɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa sã Hetsɔmi bɔ ɔ. Osɔfohi kɛ Levi bi nɛ a he tsɔ we ɔ, zo gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a pee a he klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ a bɔni sami bɔ sami ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.
A ya da a blɔ he ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ Mose mlaa a mi ɔ. Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ a muɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ muɔ ɔ fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Akɛnɛ ni ɔmɛ babauu a he tsɔ we he je ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a gbe Hetsɔmi jijɔ ɔmɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ gbe lohwe ɔmɛ ha mɛ, nɛ a pee lohwe ɔmɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, nihi nɛ je Efraim, Manase, Isakar, kɛ Zebulun wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba a, a ti nihi babauu ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ na we nɛ a tsukɔ a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ a ye ɔ, mɛɛ a yi lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a to ke a ye ɔ. Hezekia sɔle kɛ ha jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu nɛ o naa mɔbɔ lee!
Nihi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ mo jae kɛ a tsui tsuo, se kɛ̃ ɔ a he tsɔ we ɔ, ngɔɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ.” Yawɛ bu Hezekia kue fami ɔ tue; e ngɔ ni ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ, nɛ e gbla we a tue.
Israel bi nɛ bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago sɔuu kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ nya wa.
Daa ligbi ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ fiaa kpa saku, nɛ a laa kɛ jeɔ Yawɛ yi kɛ a tsui tsuo.
Hezekia je Levi bi ɔmɛ a yi wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa a je a he kpo kaa nihi nɛ le Yawɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔ saminya.
A ye Hetsɔmi ɔ si enyɔne Ma a ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago sɔuu; a sã tue mi jɔmi bɔhi, nɛ a na Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ si.
Ligbi kpaago ɔmɛ a se ɔ, ma a tsuo kplɛɛ kaa a ma pa ye ligbi kpaago kɛ piɛ he.
Nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ nya wa ye ligbi kpaago kɛ piɛ he.
Matsɛ Hezekia ha ma a na ku akpe, kɛ jijɔ akpe kpaago ke a gbe nɛ a ye; nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ hu ha mɛ na ku akpe, kɛ jijɔ akpe nyɔngma.
Osɔfohi babauu pee a he klɔuklɔu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ bua jɔ e he; Yuda bi ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ je omleyi je kɛ ba a, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda a. Yerusalem ma a mi pee hoo kɛ nyami sɔuu, ejakaa kɛ je Matsɛ Salomo, David binyumu ɔ yi nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ bɛ hyɛ.
Nyagbe ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ te si nɛ a ba Yawɛ gbaami kɛ pue ma a nɔ.
Mawu nu a kue fami ɔmɛ ngɛ e hi he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e bu mɛ tue.
Hezekia tsake jami blɔ nya tomi ɔ hɛ mi Benɛ a ye nyami be ɔmɛ ta a, Israel bi tsuo nɛ ba lejɛ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho Yuda ma amɛ a mi ya.
A gbɛ jami he ɔmɛ; a ku amagahi nɛ a puɛ kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a ngɔ pue si, nɛ a ywia bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ jami he ɔmɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi.
A tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ nɔuu ngɛ Benyamin, Efraim, kɛ Manase zugba amɛ a nɔ, loko a kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya ngɛ a mahi a mi.
Matsɛ Hezekia kpale dla ní tsumi kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ.
Ní tsumi slɔɔto ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sami bɔ sami, tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami, sɔmɔmi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ Yawɛ yi jemi kɛ si nami.
Matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ha lohwehi nɛ a kɛ sã sami bɔhi daa mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ.
E ha lohwehi nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi, Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, kɛ nyami be kpahi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Jehanɛ, matsɛ ɔ fa Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a blɔ nya ní ɔmɛ ba ha mɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ngɔ a juɛmi tsuo kɛ fɔ a ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Benɛ a fa kikɛ nɛ ɔ pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ba babauu nitsɛ: blɛfo kpokploku, wai, oliv nu, hwo, kɛ ngmɔ niba ní kpahi.
Jehanɛ, níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a dɛ ɔ, a ngɔ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka hu kɛ ba.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi ɔ, ngɔ a na amɛ, kɛ a jijɔ ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka kɛ ba.
A ngɔ nike níhi hu babauu kɛ ba, nɛ a ba pee mɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ. Nyɔhiɔ etɛne ɔ mi ɔ, a bɔni nike ní ɔmɛ tomi kuukuu kɛ pue si; nɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, a gbe nya.
Benɛ Matsɛ Hezekia, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ ba na nike ní babauu nɛ a kɛ ba a, a je Yawɛ kɛ e ma Israel ɔ a yi.
Matsɛ ɔ bi osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nike ní ɔmɛ a he sane, nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Azaria, Zadok nina a de lɛ ke, “Kɛ je be nɛ ma a kɛ nike ní ɔmɛ bɔni Yawɛ we ɔ mi bami ɔ, wa yeɔ ní nɛ wa tɔɔ, nɛ babauu piɛɔ ngɛ se.
Niinɛ, Yawɛ gbaa e ma a babauu nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ye nɛ piɛ ɔ ji níhi nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Hezekia fa ke a dla nito hehi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Benɛ a pee ja a, ma a muɔ nike ní ɔmɛ, kɛ níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba a kɛ ya to lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Levi no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Konania a ji ní ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma; e setsɔ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛminyumu Shimei.
A he piɛli ji ni nyɔngma nɛ ɔmɛ: Yehiel, Azazia, Nahat, Asahel, Yerimot, Yozabad, Eliel, Ismakia, Mahat, kɛ Benaya.
Matsɛ Hezekia, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Azaria ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ to kikɛmɛ a blɔ nya nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nike ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ ji bɔhi nɛ je tsui mi faa a, nɔ nɛ a to nɛ ma he ngɛ ma a dɛ, nɛ lɛ nɔuu e maa dla ji Imna binyumu Kore, Levi no ɔ. Kore ji Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je agbo ɔ nya buli ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma.
Ngɛ ma kpa amɛ a mi hehi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ piɛ Kore he kɛ dla ní ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Eden, Miniamin, Yeshua, Shemaya, Amaria, kɛ Shekania.
A dla niye ní ɔ fiee kɛ ha a nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a ní tsumi nya, se pi ngɛ weku nya.
Nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye jeha nyingmi etɛɛtɛ, loo nɔ́ nɛ pe ja, nɛ a ya sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi daa ligbi ɔ, a dla niye ní ha mɛ hulɔ kaa bɔ nɛ blɔ nya nɛ a hɛɛ ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ.
A dla ní tsumi ɔ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ weku nya weku nya.
Se Levi bi nɛ a ye jeha nyingmi enyɔɔnyɔ, loo nihi nɛ a ye pe ja a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a dla ní tsumi ɔ ha mɛ ngɛ a ní tsumi kuuhi a nya.
A kane osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ, a yi ɔmɛ, a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ; ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ be tsuaa be ɔ, e sa kaa a dla a he kɛ ha a ní tsumi klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a tsumi.
Osɔfohi nɛ ngɛ mahi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ha Aaron nina a, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle jamɛ a ma amɛ a mi ɔ, a hla a ti ni komɛ nɛ a hɛ mi ka si.
Mɛ lɛ a dlaa niye ní kɛ haa nyumuhi tsuo ngɛ osɔfohi a weku ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ Levi no tsuaa Levi no nɛ a ngma e biɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Hezekia dla niye ní ngɛ Yuda tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E ye anɔkuale kɛ dami sane, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
Hezekia ya nɔ saminya, ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ, e peeɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, kɛ Mawu gbeye yemi, Yawɛ we ɔ he ní tsumi jio, mlaa a nɔ yemi jio.
Asiria bi ɔmɛ ba tua Yerusalem Matsɛ Hezekia ye Yawɛ anɔkuale, nɛ e sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ e tsui tsuo.
Pee se ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib ba tua Yuda.
E sa mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a yi, nɛ e hla kaa e maa ku gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
Benɛ Hezekia na kaa Senakerib to e yi mi kaa e ma tua Yerusalem hulɔ ɔ, -e kɛ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ na kpe, nɛ a to kaa a maa tsi vuhi nɛ ngɛ ma a nya a.
A juɛmi ji, ke a tsi vu ɔmɛ nɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ ba sɛ ma a mi ɔ, a be nyu nae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya bua nihi babauu a nya nɛ a kɛ mɛ ya tsi vu ɔmɛ tsuo; pa nɛ bee ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ hu a tsi lɛ, nɛ nyu bi ngɛ mi hu.
Matsɛ ɔ dla Yerusalem ma a he fami ní ɔmɛ; gbogbohi nɛ ku ɔ, e kpale fia mɛ ekohu, nɛ e ma mɔhi ngɛ a nɔ; e fia gbogbo enyɔne hulɔ kɛ wo ma a he.
Jehanɛ se hu, e dla Milo mɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ David ma a mi ɔ, nɛ e sɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi kɛ tsɛ̃ihi babauu.
E ngɔ tatsɛmɛ ngɔ to ma a nya, nɛ e bua a nya ngɛ ma agbo ɔ nya.
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ wlua nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee kã.
Nyɛ ko ye Asiria matsɛ ɔ kɛ e ta babauu ɔ gbeye; ejakaa nɔ nɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ ɔ, e he wa kulaa pe nɔ nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ. Niinɛ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ ta buli babauu, se mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ maa piɛ wa he; lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa hwu ta amɛ ha wɔ!” Munyu nɛ ɔ nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia tu ɔ, wo ma a he wami.
Pee se ɔ, benɛ Senakerib kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo ngɛ Lakish kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Hezekia, kɛ Yuda ma a ngɛ Yerusalem ke, “Imi Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib, i ngɛ nyɛ bie ke mɛni nɔ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ loko nyɛ hii si ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ mwɔɔ be mi nɛ a sa ma a yi ɔ?
Hezekia deɔ nyɛ ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je wa dɛ mi.
Se anɛ nyɛ li kaa Hezekia ngɛ nyɛ mlɔɔe, nɛ e ma ha nɛ mi mi hwɔ, kɛ kuma maa gbe nyɛ lo?
Anɛ pi Hezekia nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ ku Yawɛ jami he ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ pee se ɔ, e de Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke a ja Yawɛ, nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via ha lɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kake pɛ nɔ lo?
Anɛ nɔ́ nɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ imi nitsɛ wa pee je ma kpa amɛ ɔ, nyɛ li lo?
Anɛ jamɛ a je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nyɛ́ kpɔ mɛ kɛ je imi, Asiria matsɛ, ye dɛ mi lo?
Mɛni be lɛ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mawu ɔmɛ eko nyɛ́ kpɔ a zugba kɛ je wa dɛ mi hyɛ?
Lɛɛ mɛni haa nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma nyɛ he nyɛ yi wami ɔ?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia nɛ sisi nyɛ, loo e mlɔɔ nyɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko he lɛ nyɛɛ ye!
Je ma ko je ma ko mawu kpɔ we e ma hyɛ kɛ ji Asiria matsɛ ko matsɛ ko dɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ Mawu nɛ ɔ be nyɛe ma he nyɛ yi wami!” Senakerib tsɔli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ hu tu munyuhi babauu kɛ si Yawɛ Mawu, kɛ e tsɔlɔ Hezekia.
Asiria matsɛ ɔ bɔ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ahlua ngɛ womi ɔ nɛ e ngma ba ha Hezekia a mi ke, “Je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a je a ma amɛ kɛ je ye dɛ mi.
Hezekia Mawu ɔ hu be nyɛe ma je e ma a kɛ je ye dɛ mi.” Tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ womi ɔmɛ kɛ ba a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Hebri gbi mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kɛ wo Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ a he gbeye, nɛ sawale nu mɛ.
A pee ja konɛ ma a ngɔmi nɛ ko wa ha mɛ.
Tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ tu Yerusalem Mawu ɔ he munyu kaa nɔ́ nɛ je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nɛ nimli kɛ a nine pee ɔ eko ji lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Hezekia kɛ gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ fa kue ha Mawu.
Yawɛ tsɔ bɔfo ko nɛ e ba gbe Asiria ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ a sito he ɔ, nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ kɛ zo kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
Ligbi ko, benɛ a ngɛ e jami he ɔ, e binyumu ɔmɛ ekomɛ ya gbe lɛ kɛ klaate.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ pee kɛ kpɔ Matsɛ Hezekia, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib, kɛ a he nyɛli kpa amɛ a dɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ ha nɛ Hezekia kɛ e ma a, kɛ ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Nihi babauu ba Yerusalem, ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, nɛ a ke Matsɛ Hezekia hu níhi nɛ a he jua wa.
Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, je ma amɛ tsuo buɔ Hezekia saminya.
Hezekia hiɔ kɛ e he nɔ womi Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Matsɛ Hezekia ba nu hiɔ, nɛ e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ e gbo.
E fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ Yawɛ ha lɛ okadi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ma na he wami.
Se kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ a pee Hezekia a, e nɛ Yawɛ si, nɛ e je we Yawɛ yi kɛ to nane mi; mohu ɔ, e wo e he nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu lɛ, kɛ Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem.
Se nyagbe ɔ, Hezekia kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ba a he si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ gbla we ma a tue kɛ ya si Hezekia gbenɔ se.
Hezekia ní kɛ agboje Hezekia ba na ní babauu nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ buɔ lɛ.
E pee nito hehi, nɛ e to ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, tsopahi kɛ a he via, tsɛ̃ihi, kɛ ní kpa komɛ nɛ a he jua wa.
Jehanɛ hu, e pee nito hehi kɛ ha e blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu; nɛ e po piɛ kɛ ha e nahi kɛ tohi.
Mawu ha Hezekia to, na, kɛ ní kpahi babauu nitsɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, e po mahi babauu.
Matsɛ Hezekia nɛ ɔ nɔuu tsi Gihon pa a ngɛ yiti je nɛ e ha nɛ nyu ɔ ba be ngɛ David ma a bonyoku je.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Hezekia pee ɔ, e ye manye ngɛ mi.
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ Babilonia ganɔ ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba Hezekia ngɔ ba bi lɛ sane ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ ba zugba a nɔ ɔ a he pohu ɔ, Mawu ngmɛɛ Hezekia jemi he ngɔ ha lɛ.
Mawu pee kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ konɛ e kɛ ka lɛ, nɛ e kɛ na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e tsui mi.
Hezekia matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe Matsɛ Hezekia he sane kpahi, kɛ ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ nina a nɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi mi ɔ mi.
Hezekia ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gɔ ɔ mi, ngɛ yiti je ɔ. Benɛ e gbo ɔ, Yuda kɛ Yerusalem tsuo wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Hezekia bi Manase ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Manase Manase ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi enuɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi ɔ, Manase ya nyɛɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a se, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Jami hehi nɛ e tsɛ Hezekia gbɛ ɔ, e kpale po mɛ ekohu.
E ma bɔ sami la tɛhi kɛ ha Baal, nɛ e pee amagahi kɛ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a. E ja dodoehi hulɔ.
Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, he nɛ Yawɛ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ daa a, Manase puɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ha Baal ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi ngɔ ma kue enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a mi, konɛ a ja dodoehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
E ngɔ e binyumuhi kɛ sã sami bɔhi ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
E kla, e tsu kunya, nɛ e kɛ kpade tsɛli, kɛ azetsɛmɛ bɔ.
E pee yayamihi babauu kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ e kɛ wo e mi mi la.
E puɛ amaga ko ya ma Yawɛ ɔ we.
Mawu, kɛ David, kɛ e binyumu Salomo tu we nɛ ɔ he munyu hyɛ, nɛ e de ke, “I hla we nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ je Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ngɔ to kaa he nɛ sa nɛ a ja mi ngɛ daa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Israel bi ɔmɛ maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ, nɛ a maa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Mose wo mɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, i be hae nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ hu.” Se Manase mlɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a ya pee yayami nɛ kle kulaa pe yayami nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ fie kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi ɔ pee ɔ po.
Manase tsake e tsui Yawɛ bɔ Manase kɛ e ma a kɔkɔ, se a bui tue.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ Asiria tabo ɔ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba tua Yuda.
A kɛ gbowehi nu Manase nɛ a wo lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ, nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya.
Benɛ e ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, e ba e he si, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ, e nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ. Mawu bu Manase kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ e ha nɛ e kpale kɛ ya Yerusalem ya ye matsɛ ekohu.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ Manase na kaa Yawɛ ɔ, Mawu ji lɛ niinɛ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Manase fia gbogbo enyɔne ɔ ngɛ David ma a we beleku je ɔ nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe.
E fia nɔ kɛ je kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ Gihon pa a kasa nya ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya si lo agbo ɔ nya, hluu kɛ ya bɔle ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Ofel ɔ. Jehanɛ hu, e ngɔ tatsɛmɛ ngɔ to Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ tsuo a mi.
E je ma se mawu ɔmɛ, kɛ amaga a nɛ e ngɔ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ a pee ha mawuhi nɛ ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ, he nɛ Yawɛ ɔ we ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ he kpahi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, e je mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E muɔ mɛ kɛ ho ya sake ngɔ pue ma a nya.
E dla bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ he nɛ a jaa Yawɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e sã tue mi jɔmi bɔhi, kɛ sina bɔhi ngɛ nɔ.
E fa Yuda ma a tsuo ke a sɔmɔ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ. E ngɛ mi kaa ma a ya nɔ sã bɔhi ngɛ jami he kpahi mohu, se bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a sã a, Yawɛ pɛ a sã kɛ ha.
Manase matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe Manase he sane kpahi nɛ piɛ, kɛ kue nɛ e fa ha e Mawu, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu ngɛ Israel Mawu ɔ biɛ mi ɔ a sɛ gbi ɔmɛ ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
A ngma Manase he ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ Gbali ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi: kue nɛ Manase fa, kɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu bu lɛ tue ha, yayamihi nɛ e pee loko e ba tsake e tsui, jami hehi nɛ e po, yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a we amagahi nɛ e puɛ, kɛ amagahi nɛ e ja.
Manase ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ e bi Amon ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Amon Amon ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha enyɔ.
E ya wo e tsɛ Manase nane, nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ; amaga amɛ nɛ e tsɛ puɛ ɔ, e sɔmɔ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se Amon bɛ e he si, nɛ e kpale we kɛ bɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɛ pee ɔ; lɛɛ e pee yayamihi babauu pe e tsɛ ɔ po.
Amon tsɔli ɔmɛ so ngɔ wo e he, nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ.
Se Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbe nihi tsuo nɛ so ngɔ wo e he ɔ, nɛ a wo e bi Yosia matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Yosia Yosia ye jeha kpaanyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ, nɛ e hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kake.
E pee Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní; e ya wo e nɛ̃ David nane, nɛ e ye Mawu mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ sisiisi.
Yosia te si kɛ wo amaga jami Yosia matsɛ yemi be ɔ jeha nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, be mi nɛ e wɛ saasaa a, e bɔni e nɛ̃ David Mawu ɔ jami.
Jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e bɔni jami he ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda a gbɛmi; e ywia yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a we amaga amɛ, kɛ amaga kpa amɛ tsuo.
Bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ ngɛ Baal jami he ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛhi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Yosia ha nɛ a ku mɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Ashera amaga amɛ, kɛ amaga kpa amɛ tsuo lɛɛ a wɛɛ mɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ kaa la zu, nɛ a ngɔ kɛ fĩa nihi nɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ ɔ a yɔkɔhi a nɔ.
Yosia sã osɔfo ɔmɛ a wuhi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
E pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ tsukɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem a he ekohu.
Yosia tsu kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ngɛ Manase, Efraim, kɛ Simeon ma amɛ, kɛ ma doku ɔmɛ tsuo a mi hulɔ hluu kɛ ya su Naftali, ngɛ omleyi je tɔɔ.
Yosia ywia bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Ashera amaga amɛ.
E wɛɛ amaga amɛ nɛ a pee mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ kaa la zu, nɛ e ywia tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ tsuo loko e kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.
A na mlaa womi ɔ Matsɛ Yosia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ, e julaa zugba a, nɛ e tsukɔ Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ we ɔ he.
Be nɛ e gbe nya a, e tsɔ nihi etɛ konɛ a ya dla Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ we ɔ. Ni ɔmɛ ji Azalia bi Shafan, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Maaseya a, kɛ Yoahaz bi Yoa, ma ní tsulɔ nɔkɔtɔma kake.
Shafan, Maaseya, kɛ Yoa ngɔ sika nɛ nihi kɛ ba Mawu we ɔ ya ha osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Hilkia a. Sika nɛ ɔ ji sika nɛ Levi bi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya a bua nya ngɛ wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ a dɛ: Manase, Efraim, Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ, Yuda, Benyamin, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ.
A tu sika a ngɔ wo ni etɛ komɛ a dɛ.
Mɛ ji nihi nɛ hyɛɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ dlae ɔ a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Mɛ hu a ngɔ sika a kɛ ha kapitɛhi, kɛ tsu mali, konɛ a kɛ he tɛ, kɛ tso nɛ a kɛ dla tsuhi nɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a puɛ ɔ. Ní tsuli nɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ anɔkuale saminya.
Levi bi eywiɛ lɛ hyɛɛ a nɔ.
Mɛ ji Yahat, kɛ Obadia nɛ a je Merari weku ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ Zakaria kɛ Meshulam nɛ a je Kohat weku ɔ mi ɔ. Saku fiali kpakpahi ji Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Levi bi kpa komɛ hu hyɛɛ tlomi tlooli, kɛ ní tsuli kpahi a nɔ.
A ti ni komɛ hu ji womi ngmali, ma ní tsuli, kɛ agbo nya buli.
Benɛ a ngɛ sika a nɛ a kɛ ba to Yawɛ we ɔ jee ɔ, osɔfo Hilkia ya na Yawɛ mlaa womi ɔ nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ ha Mose ɔ. Hilkia de womi ngmalɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shafan ɔ ke, “I na mlaa womi ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.” Nɛ́ e de ja kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ womi ɔ ha Shafan.
Shafan hu ngɔ womi ɔ kɛ ba ha matsɛ ɔ, nɛ e bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, wa pee.
Sika a nɛ a kɛ ya to Yawɛ we ɔ, wa ya ngɔ nɛ waa kɛ wo ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ.” Shafan ya nɔ nɛ e de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Osɔfo Hilkia ha mi womi ko; womi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Shafan kane womi ɔ kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ. Benɛ matsɛ ɔ nu mlaa womi ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kanee ɔ, e hía e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e fa Hilkia, Shafan bi Ahikan, Mikaya bi Abdon, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shafan ɔ, kɛ matsɛ tsɔlɔ Asaya ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya bi Yawɛ ga womi ha imi, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ piɛ ngɛ Israel, kɛ Yuda a. Nyɛ ya bi lɛ womi nɛ a ya na nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ a he sane.
Yawɛ mi mi fu wɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ yi Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ; níhi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ke a pee ɔ, a pee we fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Hilkia, kɛ nihi nɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɔ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya bi gbalɔyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hulda a ní ngɛ Yerusalem ma he ɔ mi he nɛ e hii ɔ. Hulda huno ji Tikva bi Shalum, Harhas bibi ɔ; nɛ Shalum nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ tadehi a nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Osɔfo Hilkia kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ matsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ ya ha gbalɔyo ɔ. Gbalɔyo ɔ hu de mɛ ke a kpale kɛ ho matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya nɛ a ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “I kɛ gbiɛmi munyuhi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔ nɛ a kane ha lɛ matsɛ ɔ maa gbla Yerusalem, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a tue.
A kua mi, nɛ a sã bɔhi kɛ ha mawu kpahi, nɛ a kɛ níhi nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ tsuo wo ye mi mi la.
Ye mi mi fu Yerusalem wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ ko be hie peemi ngɛ he.
Se Yuda matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ nyɛ ke nyɛ ba bi imi Yawɛ, ye ga womi ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ lɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: o nu munyuhi nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ o tsake o tsui, nɛ o ba o he si ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
Benɛ o nu bɔ nɛ i to nɛ ma gbla Yerusalem, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tue ha a, o hía o he tade ɔmɛ, nɛ o wo ya.
I nu o kue fami ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, tue gblami nɛ i to nɛ e ba ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, i be hae nɛ o na kɛ o hɛngmɛ.
O ma ba gbo nɛ a maa pu mo ngɛ he jɔmi mi loko ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ kpale a se nɛ a kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ba ha Matsɛ Yosia.
Yosia wo si veveeve kaa e maa bu Yawɛ tue Matsɛ Yosia tsɔ ya kpee Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ mɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo, nimli nguahi, kɛ nimli wawihi tsuo ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya.
Matsɛ ɔ ya kane mlaa womi ɔ nɛ a na ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ho ya da kpoku ko nɔ nɛ e ka Yawɛ kita ke e maa bu lɛ tue, nɛ e maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, kɛ e klaa tsuo.
E ka kita ke níhi nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ, e maa pee mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E ha nɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ba bua ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ wo si kaa a maa ye somi nɛ a kɛ a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ so ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a pee ja.
Matsɛ Yosia je amagahi tsuo kɛ je zugba a nɔ he nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ ma a tsuo sɔmɔ Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ e wami be ɔ tsuo.
Yosia ye Hetsɔmi ɔ Matsɛ Yosia ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami; a gbe lohwehi nɛ a kɛ maa ye nyami be ɔ ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ.
Yosia dla ní tsumi ngɔ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ e wo mɛ he wami konɛ a tsu ní ɔ saminya.
Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a pee a he klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ mɛ lɛ a tsɔɔ Israel ma a ní ɔ, Yosia de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ wo somi daka klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ Israel matsɛ, David bi Salomo po ɔ. Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be somi daka a hɛɛe kɛ ya kɛ ba hu; nyɛ ní tsumi ji nyɛ sɔmɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ e ma Israel.
Nyɛ ya hi nyɛ blɔ hehi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ Israel matsɛ, David kɛ e bi Salomo dla ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hi he klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a we puɔ nya amɛ a nya dali; Levi bi a kuu kake maa da si ha we puɔ nya kake.
Nyɛɛ gbe jijɔhi, kɛ to akpakpohi nɛ a kɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛ dla kɛ ha bɔ ɔmɛ a sami.
Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye mlaa amɛ nɛ Yawɛ wo kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ a nɔ.” Matsɛ Yosia ke ma a nɛ ba bua ngɛ lejɛ ɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ bɔ nɛ sa: jijɔ kɛ akpakpo akpe nyingmi etɛ, kɛ na ku akpe etɛ.
Matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lohwehi ji enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ganɔ ɔmɛ hu ke ma a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ níhi babauu kɛ je a tsui mi faa.
Tsɔli nikɔtɔmahi nɛ hyɛɛ Mawu we ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu a ha osɔfo ɔmɛ to akpe enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa, kɛ na lafa etɛ, nɛ a kɛ sã bɔhi Hetsɔmi be ɔ. Tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Hilkia, Zakaria, kɛ Yehiel.
Nikɔtɔma komɛ nɛ je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi hu ha Levi bi ɔmɛ to akpe enuɔ, kɛ na lafa enuɔ, nɛ a kɛ sã bɔhi.
A biɛhi ji Konania, Shemaya kɛ e nyɛminyumu Netanel, Hashabia, Yeyel, kɛ Yozabad.
Benɛ a to blɔ nya kɛ ha Hetsɔmi ɔ gbe nya a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ho ya da a blɔ hehi kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Benɛ a gbe to ɔmɛ ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ kpɔ lohwe ɔmɛ a he womi ɔmɛ, nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a dla lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ ngɔ ha ma a we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, konɛ a sã bɔ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi ɔ. Levi bi ɔmɛ sã lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ la nɔ.
A hoo bɔ sami ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɛ buɛhi, dadesɛhi, kɛ kãhi a mi, nɛ a dla lo ɔ mlamlaamla ngɔ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Pee se ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ dla lo ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Aaron nina a. Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ a pee ja ji, ligbi mluku ɔ tsuo ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ zɔ ɔ sãe hluu kɛ ya si nyɔ mi nɛ́ deka be mi.
Lali ɔmɛ nɛ ji Asaf bimɛ ɔmɛ ya hi a blɔ hehi kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ David wo mlaa ke a pee ɔ. Mɛ ji Asaf, Heman, kɛ Yedutun, matsɛ ɔ gbalɔ ɔ. Agbo nya buli ɔmɛ ho ya da a blɔ hehi kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ daa a; mɛɛ lɛɛ e hia we kaa a si a ní tsumi ɔ, ejakaa a nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ba ha mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Yosia fa ma a, a to nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ blɔ nya jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ sɔmɔmi, Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ yemi, kɛ sami bɔ sami ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Israel bi tsuo nɛ ba bua ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, kɛ Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago sɔuu.
Kɛ je gbalɔ Samuel be ɔ mi ɔ, a yi Hetsɔmi ko hyɛ nɛ sɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a ye nɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko yi Hetsɔmi ko hyɛ nɛ sɔ kaa Hetsɔmi nɛ Matsɛ Yosia, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, Yuda ma a tsuo, Israel bi nɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ye nɛ ɔ. Yosia yi nɔ, jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔ mi lɛ a ye kikɛmɛ a Hetsɔmi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yosia matsɛ yemi ɔ nyagbe Pee se benɛ Matsɛ Yosia to sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔ blɔ nya ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ gbe nya a, Egipt matsɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Neko ɔ ya tua Karkemish, ngɛ Yufrate pa a nya.
Yosia ya nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe.
Se Neko ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ mane Yosia ke, “Ta nɛ i gba nɛ ɔ kɔ we mo, Yuda matsɛ, o he.
Tsa pi mo nɛ i kɛ na; pe i ba nɛ i kɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ba hwu, nɛ Mawu de mi ke ma pee esɔ.
Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo te si ngɔ wo mi nɛ e ko ba kpata o hɛ mi.” Se Yosia to e yi mi momo kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hwu.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɛ lɛ dee kɛ gu Matsɛ Neko nɔ ɔ, e bui fɛɛ; mohu ɔ, e tsake e he nɛ e ya gba ta kɛ ho Megido nga kplanaa a nɔ ya.
Benɛ a ngɛ ta a hwue ɔ, Egipt kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ɔmɛ tsɛ̃ Matsɛ Yosia kɛ̃ɛ̃.
Yosia fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ mi kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, ejakaa i plaa yayaa!” E tsɔli ɔmɛ je lɛ ngɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔ mi kɛ wo ta zugba lɛ enyɔne ɔ nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ ba a mi, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem.
Lejɛ ɔ e ba gbo ngɛ, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ eko mi.
Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ya ha lɛ.
Gbalɔ Yeremia hu po kɔmɔ yemi la ko ngɛ Matsɛ Yosia he.
Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, lali ɔmɛ tsuo, nyumuhi kɛ yihi laa la nɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ kaiɔ e gbenɔ ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba plɛ pee kusumi ngɛ Israel.
La nɛ ɔ piɛ kɔmɔ yemi asilɛhi nɛ a bua nya a a he.
Níhi tsuo nɛ Yosia pee, bɔ nɛ e sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ e tsui tsuo, bɔ nɛ e ye mlaa a nɔ, kɛ e wami he sane kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, a ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoahaz Yuda ma a hla Yosia binyumu Yehoahaz, nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem.
Yehoahaz ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ nyɔhiɔ etɛ.
Egipt matsɛ, Neko kpa lɛ matsɛ yemi ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e tsu tó sika hiɔ nɛ jiimi ji kilo akpe etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ, kɛ sika tsu nɛ jiimi ji kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ ngɛ Yuda ma a dɛ.
Neko wo Yehoahaz nyɛminyumu Eliakim matsɛ ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ, nɛ e tsake e biɛ Eliakim ɔ kɛ pee Yehoyakim.
Se e nyɛmi Yehoahaz ɔ lɛɛ Neko ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Egipt ya.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim Yehoyakim ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kake.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ. Benɛ Yehoyakim ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar hia ta ba tua Yuda, nɛ e nu Yehoyakim kɛ ho Babilonia ya, ngɛ pã mi.
Nebukadnezar muɔ june nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ eko kɛ ho, nɛ e kɛ ya to e we mi ngɛ Babilon.
Yehoyakim he sane kpahi, musu nɛ e bɔ, kɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ, a ngma ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi.
Yehoyakim bi Yehoyakin ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin Yehoyakin ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ nyɔhiɔ etɛ kɛ ligbi nyɔngma.
Lɛ hu e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Benɛ jeha su ɔ, Matsɛ Nebukadnezar tsɔ nɛ a ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya; a muɔ Yawɛ we ɔ mi june ɔmɛ hu kɛ je.
Nebukadnezar wo Yehoyakin nyɛminyumu Zedekia matsɛ ngɛ Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem a nɔ.
Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia Zedekia ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kake benɛ e bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kake.
E pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ, nɛ e bɛ e he si ngɔ ha gbalɔ Yeremia, nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi ba haa lɛ ɔ. Yerusalem hɛ mi kpatami Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar nɛ ha Zedekia kɛ Mawu biɛ ka lɛ kita ke e maa bu lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu Zedekia tsɔ atuã kɛ wo lɛ.
Zedekia wa tue; e tsakee we e tsui, nɛ e kpale we kɛ ba nyɛɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ se.
Jehanɛ se hu, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
A ya sɔmɔ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a mawu ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ lɛ Yawɛ ɔ nitsɛ pee klɔuklɔu ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ngmɛɛ we e ma a he.
Daa nɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ e gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a ya bɔɔ mɛ kɔkɔ, ejakaa e sume kaa e ma a, loo Yerusalem hɛ mi nɛ kpata.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ, Mawu tsɔli ɔmɛ a he fɛu mohu a yeɔ; a bui Mawu munyu ɔ tue, nɛ e gbali ɔmɛ hu muɔ sɔuu a hii mɛ muɔe hluu kɛ ya si be nɛ Yawɛ mi mi ba fu e ma a wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko hi peemi ngɛ he hu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ kɛ ba tua mɛ.
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ kɛ klaate gbe Yuda nihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi po.
E nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko mɔbɔ, jokuɛyo jio, nɔkɔtɔma jio, yo jio, nyumu jio, hiɔtsɛ jio, nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami jio.
Mawu ngɔ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɔ wo e dɛ mi.
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ha ní ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ; e muɔ june ngɛ nito he ɔ, kɛ Matsɛ Zedekia, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ hu a june kɛ ho Babilon ya.
E sã Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ma a kɛ e mi mɔ ɔmɛ; e kpata ní kpakpahi tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ e ku Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ ngɔ pue si.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi na wami ɔ, e muɔ mɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya, nɛ a ya sɔmɔ lɛ, kɛ e nina hluu kɛ ya si be nɛ a to Persia matsɛ yemi ɔ sisi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de to kɛ gu gbalɔ Yeremia nɔ ɔ ba mi.
Yawɛ lɛ de ke, “Zugba a maa fɔ si jeha nyingmi kpaago, konɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ nɛ a yi ɔ, a kɛ tsɔ.” Sirus fa Yuda ma a ke a kpale kɛ ba Benɛ Sirus ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Persia a, jamɛ a kekleekle jeha a mi ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e de to kɛ gu gbalɔ Yeremia nɔ ɔ ba mi.
Yawɛ ha nɛ Sirus wo mlaa nɛ ɔ, nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ e tsɔ ke a ya kane ngɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu.
E ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ imi Persia matsɛ, Sirus, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Yawɛ, hiɔwe Mawu ɔ tu je ma amɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi; nɛ e fa mi ke ma ya po we ngɔ ha lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ Yuda.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu blɔ fa mi ɔ, e ba be kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ piɛ nyɛ he.’ ”
NYA TSƆƆMI Sanehi nɛ ngɛ Kronika womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a nɔ tsami nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Womi ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Yuda bi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, a ti ni komɛ kpale kɛ je Babilon kɛ ba, kɛ bɔ nɛ a ba to ma a, kɛ Mawu jami sisi ekohu ngɛ Yerusalem.
Bɔ nɛ sane ɔmɛ ba setsɔsetsɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Persia matsɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sirus ɔ fami nya a, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kekleekle kuu ɔ kpale kɛ je Babilonia zugba a nɔ kɛ ba.
A ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu ngɛ Yerusalem.
Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kuu kpa ko hu kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem.
A hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ Ezra a, ji nɔ ko nɛ le Mawu mlaa a fitsofitso.
E to Mawu jami, kɛ ma a mi si himi blɔ nya pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel bi a jami blɔ nya tomi nɛ ya nɔ saminya.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Kekleekle nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba .—.
A ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu, nɛ a bli nya .—.
Ezra kɛ ni kpahi hu je ma se kɛ ba .—.
Sirus fa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke a kpale kɛ ho a je ya Benɛ Persia matsɛ, Sirus ba ye tsɛ ɔ, kekleekle jeha a mi ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ de kɛ gu gbalɔ Yeremia nɔ ɔ ba mi.
Yawɛ ngɔ juɛmi ko kɛ wo Matsɛ Sirus yi mi kaa e fa nɛ a ngma munyu nɛ ɔ, konɛ a kane nɛ a fiɛ ngɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔ he tsuaa he.
“Bɔ nɛ Persia matsɛ, Sirus de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Yawɛ, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ wo mi nɔ yelɔ ngɛ je ɔ tsuo nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ tsumi nɛ he hia nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi.
E ke ma ma we ha lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ.
Mawu ma, nyɛ ti nihi nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa kpale ɔ, Mawu nɛ piɛ nyɛ he!
Nyɛɛ ya Yerusalem ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛ ya ma Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ we ɔ ekohu.
Lɛ ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nɛ.
Mawu ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, he tsuaa he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ha mɛ yemi kɛ buami nɛ a ngɛ hlae.
A ha mɛ sika hiɔ, sika tsu, tlomi, lohwe, kɛ jehanɛ níhi nɛ a je tsui mi faa ba ke kɛ ha Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.” Kɛkɛ nɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ta a he ɔ dla a he, konɛ a ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ ekohu.
Nihi tsuo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ tsuo wo mɛ blɔ kɛ níhi babauu; sika hiɔ ní, sika tsu, tlomi, lohwehi, nike ní kpahi nɛ a he jua wa, kɛ nike níhi nɛ je tsui mi faa kɛ ba Mawu we ɔ. Kãhi kɛ kpluhi nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezer ya muɔ kɛ je Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e kɛ ya wo e mawu ɔmɛ a we ɔ mi ɔ, Matsɛ Sirus kpale mɛ tsuo ngɔ ha.
E ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Mitredat, matsɛ we ɔ sika tolɔ ɔ. Nɛ lɛ hu e kane lɛ tsuo nɛ e tu ngɔ wo Sheshbazar, ganɔ nɛ yeɔ Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ dɛ.
-Ní ɔmɛ ji: Sika tsu kãhi nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ Sika hiɔ kãhi nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ , Kã kpahi Sika tsu kã tsɔwihi Sika hiɔ kã tsɔwihi Kã kɛ kplu kpa komɛ , Sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ kã, kɛ kplu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a yibɔ ji ,.
Benɛ Sheshbazar kɛ nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho Babilonia ya a kpale kɛ ma Yerusalem ɔ, e ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba.
Nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a biɛhi Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a babauu kpale kɛ je Babilon kɛ ba Yerusalem kɛ Yuda; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya.
A weku li lɛɛ kɛ je be nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezer ba nuu mɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, a tlɔ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ kɛ mɛ ba ji Zerubabel, Yoshua, Nehemia, Seraya, Reelaya, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, kɛ Baana.
Israel bi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: -Parosh nina , Shefatia nina Ara nina Pahat Moab (Yeshua kɛ Yoab a) nina , Elam nina , Zatu nina Zakai nina Bani nina Bebai nina Azgad nina , Adonikan nina Bagvai nina , Adin nina Ater (e biɛ kpa ji Hezekia) nina Bizai nina Yora nina Hasham nina Gibar nina -Nihi nɛ a nɛmɛ hi ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi hu kpale kɛ ba: Betlehem Netofa Anatot Azmavet Kiriat Yearim, Kefira, kɛ Beerot Rama kɛ Geba Mikmash Betel kɛ Ai Nebo Magbish Elam kaketsɛ ɔ , Harim Lod, Hadid, kɛ Ono Yeriko Senaa , -Osɔfo ɔmɛ: Yedaya nina Imer nina , Pashur nina , Harim nina , -Levi bi: Yeshua kɛ Kadmiel a nina (Hodavia bimɛ ɔmɛ) Mawu we ɔ lali (Asaf bimɛ ɔmɛ) Mawu we ɔ he buli (Shalum, Ater, Talmon, Akub, Hatita, kɛ Shobai a bimɛ ɔmɛ) -Mawu we ɔ ní tsuli: Ziha, Hasufa, Tabaot, Keros, Siaha, Padon, Lebana, Hagaba, Akub, Hagab, Shamlai, Hanan, Gidel, Gahar, Reaya, Rezin, Nekoda, Gazam, Uza, Pasea, Besai, Asna, Meunim, Nefisim, Bakbuk, Hakufa, Hahur, Bazlut, Mehida, Hasha, Bakos, Sisera, Tema, Nezia kɛ Hatifa.
-Salomo tsɔli ɔmɛ a nina: Sotai, Hasoferet, Peruda, Yaala, Darkon, Gidel, Shefatia, Hatil, Pokeret Hazebaim, kɛ Ami.
