I fa ke a sá tsu ɔmɛ a mi saminya, nɛ a ngɔ níhi nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Mawu we ɔ, kɛ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ mimɛ ɔ kɛ ya to a hi hehi.
I na le hu kaa Mawu we ɔ lali ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi kpa amɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho a ngmɔhi a mi ya; ejakaa niye ní nɛ a to kaa a ha mɛ ɔ, a ha we mɛ.
I ka ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi wawɛɛ kaa a hyɛ we Mawu we ɔ nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Jehanɛ, i kpale Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ lali ɔmɛ kɛ ba to a ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo ngɔ a blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ kɛ ba nito he ɔmɛ ekohu.
I ngɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to nito he tsu ɔmɛ a nya: osɔfo Shelemia, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ Zadok, kɛ Levi no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Pedaya a.
A he piɛlɔ ji Zakur bi Hanan, Matania bibi ɔ. I le mɛ kaa anɔkuale yeli nɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a maa dla niye ní ɔ ha a sibi ní tsuli ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ, mo kai ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i pee ɔ. Ni kpakpahi tsuo nɛ i pee kɛ ha o we ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, i na ni komɛ ngɛ Yuda nɛ a ngɛ wai yiblii ngae ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Ni komɛ hu ngɛ tlomi fie kɛ ngɛ a tejihi a nɔ woe kɛ yaa Yerusalem.
Tlomi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: blɛfo, wai, wai yiblii, ngmɔkɔ, kɛ ní kpa komɛ.
I bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a ko jua ní.
Tiro bi komɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, mɛ hu a ngɔɔ pa mi lo, kɛ nijua ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu kɛ baa ma a mi, nɛ a ba juaa kɛ haa wa nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ.
I ka Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ yayami nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Nyɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ blee.
Pi níhi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee, nɛ Mawu gbla nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Yerusalem ma a tue ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ blee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ Mawu mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa maa ba Israel nɔ lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i fa ke ke pu yaa nɔ si nɛ a maa je Hejɔɔmi ligbi tsuaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi yemi sisi ɔ, a nga ma agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ko bli kɛ yaa si Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ maa be.
I ngɔ ye tsɔli ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɔ to agbo ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ a hyɛ nɛ a ko ngɔ tlomi ko kɛ ba ma a mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Jua yeli nɛ juaa ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ba hwɔ ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ a se Soha nyɔ mi si kake loo si enyɔ.
I bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ, nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ba hwɔ gbogbo ɔ se kɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si je maa na hu.
Ke nyɛ pee ja ekohu ɔ, ma ha a maa nuu nyɛ!” Kɛ je lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a bɛ lejɛ ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i fa Levi bi ɔmɛ ke a tsukɔ a he, nɛ a ya bu agbo ɔmɛ a nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ klɔuklɔu.
Ye Mawu lee, mo kai mi ngɛ enɛ ɔ hu he, nɛ o baa ye yi ngɛ o suɔmi agbo nɛ ngɛ daa a he.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃ nɛ i ná le kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ babauu ya ngɔ yihi ngɛ Ashdod, Amon, kɛ Moab.
A bimɛ ɔmɛ fa tuɔ Ashdod gbi, loo gbi kpa ko, nɛ a tu we Yuda gbi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ka nyumu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ i gbiɛ mɛ; i fia ni komɛ ní, nɛ i hiaa a yi bwɔmi.
Jehanɛ, i ha a kɛ Mawu biɛ ka kita ke mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a binyumu ɔmɛ be nibwɔhi a biyi ɔmɛ ngɔe, nɛ a biyi ɔmɛ hu be nibwɔhi gbae kɔkɔɔkɔ hu.
I de ke, “Pi ma se yihi nɛ ha nɛ Matsɛ Salomo pee yayami ɔ?
Matsɛ Salomo ji matsɛ nguaa pe je ma amɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Mawu suɔ e sane, nɛ e wo lɛ Israel tsuo nɔ matsɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma se yi ɔmɛ ha nɛ lɛ po e pee yayami.
Anɛ waa nyɛɛ nyɛ se, nɛ wa ya ngɔ ma se yihi, nɛ wa tɔ Mawu nɔ lo?” Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Eliashib bi ji Yoyada; se Yoyada bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ya ngɔ Sanbalat nɛ je Bet Horon ɔ biyo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i fie Yoyada kɛ je Yerusalem.
Ye Mawu, mo kai bɔ nɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ ble osɔfo yemi, kɛ somi nɛ o kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ so ɔ hulɔ.
Bɔ nɛ i pee kɛ tsukɔ ma a he kɛ je ma se níhi a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i to osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ɔ hanɔhanɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ e ní tsumi nɛ e ngɛ tsue.
I to blɔ nya, konɛ a ngɔ lɛ́ nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ngɛ be nɔ.
I to be hu nɛ a maa ngɔ a kekleekle ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba.
Ye Mawu, mo kai ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ o ha nɛ e hi ha mi.
NYA TSƆƆMI Sane nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ba mi ngɛ he nɛ Persia matsɛ ɔ ya yeɔ fĩɛ be ngɛ ɔ.
Sane ɔ kɔɔ Yuda yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ester he.
Yo nɛ ɔ kɛ e ma he dɔmi pee kã wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ he e ma a yi wami kɛ je a he nyɛli a dɛ mi.
Ke pi ma he dɔlɔ, kɛ kã peelɔ Ester nɛ ɔ he ɔ, jinɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpata Yuda ma a hɛ mi butuu.
Womi ɔ tsɔɔ Yuda bi a nyami be nɛ a tsɛɛ Purim ɔ sisi, kɛ nɔ́ he je nɛ a yeɔ jamɛ a nyami be ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Ester ba pee manyɛ .—.
Ga yayahi nɛ Haman to .—.
A gbe Haman .—.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ .—.
Manyɛ Vashti wo e he ha Matsɛ Ahasuerus - Be ko ɔ, Persia matsɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ahasuerus ɔ ba ye tsɛ.
E matsɛ ma biɛ ji Susa.
Matsɛ nɛ ɔ ye ma sɔuu a nɔ kɛ je India kɛ ya su Sudan tɔɔ.
Benɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, jeha etɛne ɔ, e tsɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo ní yemi.
E kpee Persia kɛ Media tabo ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ odehe ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba.
E jé e matsɛ we ɔ mi afɛu níhi, kɛ hɛ mi nyami, kɛ agboje babauu kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa sɔuu.
Pee se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɛ Susa ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ní yemi, niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsuo.
A ye ní nɛ a nu ní ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi otsi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla lejɛ ɔ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a kɛ bo bluu, kɛ bo futaa kpla lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ kpa hiɔ nɛ ngɛ fɛu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ kɔbɛi su fi sika hiɔ gahi ngɔ wo titimahi nɛ a kɛ tɛ hiɔ pee ɔ a he.
Sɛhi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee mɛ.
Zugba a nɛ sɛ ɔmɛ maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ hu, a kɛ tɛ kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ ka: tɛ hiɔ, tɛ tsu, tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ ngɛ kpɛe, kɛ tɛ bluu.
A wo dã ha ni ɔmɛ ngɛ sika tsu kplu slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi a mi; nɛ matsɛ ɔ dã a hiɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
Dã nɛ a nu ɔ hiɛ babauu nitsɛ; ejakaa matsɛ ɔ wo e tsɔli ɔmɛ mlaa ke a ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu dã a bɔ nɛ e suɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Manyɛ Vashti hu tsɛ yi ɔmɛ ní yemi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi.
Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, benɛ matsɛ ɔ nu dã nɛ e bua jɔ saminya a, e tsɛ e he buli kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ. Mɛ ji Mehunan, Bizta, Habona, Bigta, Abagta, Zeta, kɛ Kakas.
E fa mɛ ke a ya ngɔ Manyɛ Vashti kɛ ba kɛ e yi jlasi ɔ. Manyɛ Vashti he ngɛ fɛu saminya; nɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ e kpee kɛ ba a tsuo nɛ a na bɔ nɛ manyɛ ɔ he ngɛ fɛu ha.
Se benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ya de Manyɛ Vashti ke matsɛ ɔ ke a ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba a, e kua bami.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha matsɛ ɔ mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ke sane kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba a, matsɛ ɔ tsɛɔ ga woli nɛ a woɔ lɛ ga. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ e ga woli nɛ le a mlaa amɛ, kɛ kusumi ɔmɛ saminya a, konɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ e pee.
E he nihi nɛ e pɔɔ tsɛmi ji Kashena, Shetar, Admata, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, kɛ Memukan.
Nimli kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ ji Persia kɛ Media nɔ yemi ɔ mi ganɔhi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya nguaa pe kulaa.
E de mɛ ke, “Imi Matsɛ Ahasuerus, i tsɔ nihi ke a ya ngɔ Manyɛ Vashti kɛ ba a, e kua bami.
Wa mlaa a nya a, kɛ wa maa pee lɛ kɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Memukan de matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ nɛ pueɔ si ɔ ke, “Pi mo matsɛ ɔ kɛkɛ o nɔ nɛ Manyɛ Vashti tɔ̃, se mohu e tɔ̃ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, e tɔ̃ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ ngɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔ!
Yihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔ ma ba nu nɔ́ nɛ Manyɛ Vashti pee nɛ ɔ, nɛ a be a hunomɛ bue hu.
A ma de ke, ‘Matsɛ Ahasuerus nitsɛ po fa ke a ya ngɔ Manyɛ Vashti kɛ ba, nɛ e kua bami’.
Ke matsɛ ɔ ganɔhi nɛ ngɛ Persia kɛ Media a a yi ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ manyɛ ɔ pee nɛ ɔ, a ma ya sɛɛ ha a hunomɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ loko du ma bu.
Jehanɛ, yigbayihi ngɛ he tsuaa he be a hunomɛ bue hu; nɛ nyumu ɔmɛ hu a mi mi ma fu a yi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛnɛ, ke e sa o hɛ mi ɔ, wo mlaa ngɛ o he wami ɔ nya ke Vashti kó ba matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi gblegbleegble hu.
Fa nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo Persia kɛ Media mlaa amɛ a mi, konɛ a ko tsake mlaa nɛ ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ e blɔ nya kaa manyɛ ɔ ngɔ ha yo kpa nɛ ngɛ subai kpakpa pe lɛ.
Ke o wo mlaa nɛ ɔ, nɛ a fiɛ kɛ kpa o nɔ yemi he nguaa nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, yigbayihi tsuo maa bu a hunomɛ, nimli nguahi jio, nimli wawi jio.” Ga nɛ Memukan wo nɛ ɔ sa matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ matsɛ ɔ pee ja.
E tsɔ nɛ a kɛ womihi ya matsɛ ɔ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo; a ngma munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba tsuaa zugba e ningma kɛ e gbi mi ke nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ pee wetsɛ, nɛ ke e de nɔ́ ko ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó de nɔ́ kpa ko hu.
Ester ba ye manyɛ Pee se, benɛ matsɛ ɔ tsui jɔ ɔ, e kai nɔ́ nɛ Vashti pee ɔ, kɛ mlaa nɛ e wo ngɛ e he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ga woli kpakpa amɛ a ti ni komɛ de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, ha nɛ a hla yihewi komɛ nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu ba ha mo.
Ha nɛ a to nihi ngɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a bua yihewi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ ɔ a nya kɛ ba matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ, ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ ngɛ Susa.
Ha nɛ Hegai, nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ, nɛ hyɛɛ o yi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛ a nɔ.
Ha nɛ a pɔ mɛ nu kɛ dla mɛ saminya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ yiheyo nɛ o suɔ pe kulaa ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ o wo lɛ manyɛ ngɛ Vashti nane mi.” Ga nɛ a wo nɛ ɔ sa matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e pee ja.
Yuda no ko hi Susa ma a mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mordekai.
E je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi.
E tsɛ biɛ ji Yair, e nɛ̃ ji Simei, nɛ e nɛnɛkasowa ji Kish.
Benɛ Babilon matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba nuu Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin, kɛ ni komɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ ho ɔ, Mordekai hu piɛ he.
Mordekai tsɛ nyɛminyumu ngɛ bi yiheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ester; e Hebri biɛ ji Hadasa.
E ji yiheyo nɛ he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ zangma pue e nɔ.
Benɛ e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ gbo ɔ, Mordekai ngɔ lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e bi nɛ e hyɛ lɛ.
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ mlaa a je kpo ɔ, a ngɔ yihewi babauu kɛ ba Susa; nɛ Ester hu piɛ a he kɛ ba matsɛ we ɔ.
A kɛ lɛ wo Hegai nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ dɛ, nɛ́ e hyɛ e nɔ.
Hegai suɔ Ester sane, nɛ e na e he bua jɔmi.
E yi be ko nɛ e ha a bɔni lɛ nu pɔmi nɛ a kɛ dla lɛ; a ha lɛ niye ní kpakpa hulɔ.
Hegai ngɔ Ester ya to he ko nɛ hi pe kulaa ngɛ matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ, nɛ e je blɔ hla yihewi kpaago kɛ je matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ́ a sɔmɔ lɛ.
Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mordekai wo lɛ ga a, Ester ha we nɛ a le kaa Yuda no ji lɛ.
Daa ligbi ɔ, Mordekai ya slaa si ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ hyɛɔ kaa Ester ngɛ saminya, aloo sane ko ba e nɔ lo.
Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ kɛ dlaa yi ɔmɛ a he nɛ a he peeɔ fɛu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a pɔɔ mɛ nu, nɛ a kpaa mɛ mimɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa; nɛ a pɔɔ mɛ nu kɛ e he via nyɔhiɔ ekpa ekohu; lɛ tsuo peeɔ jeha kake.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a toɔ be ha yihewi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ yaa Matsɛ Ahasuerus ngɔ kakaaka.
Ke e su be nɛ yiheyo ko maa je yi ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ kɛ ya matsɛ we ɔ, a ma ha lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ nɛ e kɛ dla e he.
E maa ya matsɛ we ɔ gbɔkuɛ, nɛ ke je na mɔtu ɔ, a kɛ lɛ maa ya matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a hi he kpa, ya ha Shaashgaz.
Shaashgaz nɛ ɔ ji nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ plã amɛ a nɔ.
Yiheyo nɛ ɔ be matsɛ ɔ ngɔ yae hu, ja matsɛ ɔ ná e he bua jɔmi, nɛ e wo e biɛ ta, nɛ e tsɔ ke a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ekohu.
E ba su Ester nɔ kaa e ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Mordekai tsɛ nyɛminyumu Abihail biyo ji Ester.
Mordekai nɛ hyɛ Ester nɔ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e biyo.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na Ester a suɔ e sane.
Benɛ e maa ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, Ester dla e he kɛ nɔ́ nɛ Hegai wo lɛ ga ke e kɛ dla e he ɔ pɛ; e bi we nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ we he.
Hegai nɛ ɔ ji nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Benɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ we jeha kpaagone ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngmane ɔ nɛ a kɛ Ester ba e ngɔ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɛ.
Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ biɛ ji Tebet.
Matsɛ ɔ suɔ Ester pe yihewi kpa amɛ tsuo, nɛ e bua jɔ Ester he pe mɛ tsuo.
Matsɛ Ahasuerus ngɔ jlasi ɔ ngɔ bu Ester, nɛ e wo lɛ manyɛ ngɛ Vashti nane mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ní yemi ko nɛ sɔ saminya, nɛ e kɛ wo Manyɛ Ester hɛ mi nyami.
E ha a fiɛ ngɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo ke a jɔɔ a he; nɛ e dla nike ní bɔ nɛ sa matsɛ ngɔ ha mɛ.
Mordekai he matsɛ ɔ yi wami Benɛ a ma bua yihewi ɔmɛ a nya si enyɔne ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ha Mordekai ba pee tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma.
Mordekai wo Ester ga ke e ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ le kaa Yuda no ji lɛ.
Ester hu bu lɛ tue kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ benɛ e ji jokuɛyo nɛ Mordekai ngɛ e nɔ hyɛe ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li kaa Yuda no ji lɛ.
Benɛ Mordekai ba pee nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, ligbi ko ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ agbo nya buli enyɔ komɛ a mi mi fu matsɛ ɔ, nɛ a so ke a maa gbe lɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nyumuhi nɛ a puɛ, nɛ a tsuɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Nɔ kake biɛ ji Bigtana, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Teresh.
Mordekai nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he, nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha Manyɛ Ester, nɛ lɛ hu e ya de matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai ba de lɛ ɔ. Benɛ a hla sane ɔ mi ɔ, a na kaa sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sɛu ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ.
Matsɛ Ahasuerus fa nɛ a ngma sane nɛ ɔ ngɔ wo e yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔ mi.
Haman to ga nɛ a kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Matsɛ Ahasuerus wó nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Haman nɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma.
Hamedata bi Haman ɔ, Agag nina ji lɛ.
Matsɛ ɔ fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ e sisi ɔ ke a bu Haman, nɛ a kpla si kɛ ha lɛ.
Ni ɔmɛ tsuo peeɔ ja, se Mordekai kpla we si ha lɛ fɛɛ!
Tsɔli kpa amɛ nɛ a ngɛ matsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ mi ɔ bi Mordekai nɔ́ he je nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa ke a pee ɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ, a nyɛɛ e nɔ ke e ye mlaa nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ, se nɔ́ nɛ e deɔ ji, “Yuda no ji mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i be nyɛe ma kpla si ha Haman.” A ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai de ɔ ha Haman, nɛ a ngɛ hyɛe nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee Mordekai.
Benɛ Haman kpá si kaa Mordekai bui lɛ, nɛ e kpla we si ha we lɛ ɔ, e hɛ dɔ; nɛ benɛ e na le kaa Yuda no ji Mordekai ɔ, e to ga kaa e be Mordekai nɔ kake pɛ e tue gblae, se mohu e ma kpata Yuda bi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ Ahasuerus nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
Matsɛ Ahasuerus tsɛ yemi be ɔ mi jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Nisan ɔ, Haman fa ke a fɔ sɔ, konɛ a kɛ na ligbi nɔ, kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi nɛ sa kaa a tsu nɔ́ nɛ e to ga kaa a pee ɔ. Sɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ɔ ji be nɛ sa; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.
(A tsɛɛ sɔ fɔmi ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke “Purim”.)
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Haman ya de Matsɛ Ahasuerus ke, “Nɛnɛ, ma ko ngɛ nɛ e mi bi gbɛ fĩa ma amɛ tsuo a mi ngɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ e slo a kusumihi ngɛ je ma kpa amɛ tsuo a ní ɔmɛ a he.
Jehanɛ hu, nɛnɛ, a yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e he be se nami ko ha mo kaa o maa pee kɔ maa hi mɛ hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Nɛnɛ, ke e sa o hɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ fa nɛ a ngma, nɛ a fiɛ ke a kpata a hɛ mi.
Ke o pee ja a, i ngɛ si woe ke ma ha sika hiɔ nɛ jiimi pe kilo ,, nɛ a kɛ to matsɛ sika tomi he ɔ, konɛ a kɛ tsu ma ní.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ je e nine nguɛ ga, nɛ e kɛ ha Agag nina, Hamedata bi Haman, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛlɔ ɔ. Ga nɛ ɔ a kɛ sɔuɔ matsɛ ɔ mlaahi nɛ a wo ɔ a nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa matsɛ ɔ kplɛɛ níhi nɛ a ngma a nɔ.
Matsɛ ɔ de Haman ke, “O sika a nɛ hi si.
Jamɛ a ma a kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ o dɛ mi; pee mɛ bɔ nɛ sa o hɛ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ nɔ ɔ, Haman tsɛ matsɛ womi ngmali ɔmɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma.
A ngma ngɛ zugba tsuaa zugba e ningma, kɛ e gbi mi; nɛ a kɛ mane nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.
A ngma ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus biɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ matsɛ ɔ nguɛ ga a sɔu nya.
Tsɔli nɛ a he sɔɔ saminya ngɔ womi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya he tsuaa he ngɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔmɛ a mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ tutuutu ɔ, á kpata Yuda bi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi; jokuɛwi, nikɔtɔmahi, nyumuhi, kɛ yihi.
Á kɛ yi mi wami nɛ kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ́ a ha a níhi.
Á fiɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Ke a nu mlaa nɛ ɔ, ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a dla a he kɛ to jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ a fiɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ ngɛ matsɛ ma Susa a mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ha tsɔli nɛ a he sɔɔ saminya pue nɔ oya kɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ kɛ ho e nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ ya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Haman hii si nɛ a ngɛ dã nue, se Susa ma a mi lɛɛ e pee basabasa.
Mordekai bi Ester ke e piɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he Benɛ Mordekai na le níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ, e kɛ hía e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he.
E ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e muɔ la zu ngɔ pue e yi mi; kɛkɛ nɛ e je kpo kɛ nyɛɛ ma a mi kɛ ya boboobo, hluu kɛ ya su matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya tɔɔ.
E sɛ́ we ɔ mi; ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be he blɔ kaa e haa kpekpe kɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ.
He tsuaa he nɛ a fiɛ matsɛ ɔ mlaa a kɛ ya su ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ nyaa awe, nɛ a yeɔ kɔmɔ.
A haa hwɔ, nɛ a woɔ yana kɛ ngmlaa.
Nihi babauu nitsɛ ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ a hwɔ la zu mi.
Benɛ Ester mawayi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ ba sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai ngɛ pee ɔ ha lɛ ɔ, Ester hao wawɛɛ.
E tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ tadehi kɛ ba, konɛ a kɛ ya wo Mordekai, nɛ́ e je kpekpe ɔ ngɛ e he.
Se Mordekai he we tade ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ Hatak.
Hatak nɛ ɔ ji nihi nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a to nɛ sɔmɔɔ Ester ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Ester tsɔ lɛ Mordekai ngɔ, konɛ e ya bi lɛ sane nɛ ba, kɛ nɔ́ he je loko e ngɛ e ní pee kaa jã a. Kɛkɛ nɛ Hatak ho ya na Mordekai ngɛ ma a kpe he ɔ, ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya.
Mordekai de lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba e nɔ, kɛ sika bɔ nɛ Haman wo si ke e ma ha nɛ a kɛ ya to matsɛ sika tomi he ɔ, ke a kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ. Jehanɛ, e ha Hatak womi ɔ nɛ a ngma mlaa a ngɔ wo mi, nɛ́ je kpo ngɛ Susa ma a mi ke a kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ eko.
Mordekai de lɛ ke e ngɔ womi ɔ kɛ ya ha Ester, nɛ́ e tsɔɔ lɛ sane ɔ mi fitsofitso; nɛ e de lɛ ke e ya fa kue ha matsɛ ɔ, nɛ́ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e na e ma mi bi ɔmɛ mɔbɔ.
Hatak ba bɔ Ester nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai de lɛ ɔ. Nɛ Ester ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ ke e kɛ ya ha Mordekai ke, “Ke nɔ ko, nyumu jio, yo jio ba na matsɛ ɔ ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ we ɔ kpɛti ɔ mi, nɛ pi kaa a tsɛ lɛ ke e ba a, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, a maa gbe lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ, kɛ je matsɛ ɔ ga woli ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya si ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Ja matsɛ ɔ wo e matsɛ tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ ɔ, loko nɔ ɔ yi ma na wami.
Kɛ je be nɛ i ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ba nɛ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ kake ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ e na we nɛ e tsɛ mi lolo.” Benɛ Mordekai nine su Ester sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e tsɔ kɛ ya bɔ lɛ kɔkɔ ke, “Mo ko susu kaa nɛ o ngɛ matsɛ ɔ we mi he je ɔ, o ye o he.
O ngɛ kaa Yuda bi kpa amɛ kɛ̃.
Ke o de we nɔ́ ko ngɛ be kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, yi wami hemi maa je he kpa ko kɛ ba ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ; se moo lɛɛ, o ma gbo, nɛ o tsɛ we ɔ biɛ maa laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Se mɛnɔ maa le?
Eko ɔ, be nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mo manyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ!” Ester hu tsɔ kɛ ya ha Mordekai heto ke, “Yaa bua Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Susa ma a mi ɔ a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ ha hwɔ ha mi.
Nyɛ ko ye ní, nɛ nyɛ ko nu nyu hulɔ nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ.
Imi nitsɛ, kɛ ye mawa amɛ hu wa maa pee ja.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
E ngɛ mi kaa mlaa a nya a, i be jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ lɛɛ, se ke e hia kaa ma gbo ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma gbo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mordekai ho nɛ e ya pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Ester de lɛ ke e pee ɔ.
Ester tsɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ Haman ní yemi Ester nitsɛ ha hwɔ.
Ligbi etɛne ɔ, Ester wo e manyɛ tade ɔ, nɛ e be kɛ ho matsɛ we ɔ ya.
E ya da si ngɛ kue nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ kpɛti ɔ mi.
Kue nɛ ɔ ngɛ tsu nɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hanɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, matsɛ ɔ hii si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi kpee sinya a nya blɔ.
Benɛ e na Manyɛ Ester nɛ daa si ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ ɔ, e na e he bua jɔmi, nɛ e wo e matsɛ tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ manyɛ ɔ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ e kɛ e nine ba ta matsɛ tso ɔ he ngɛ e yi je.
Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Manyɛ Ester, mɛni sane?
Mɛni o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha mo?
Ke ye nɔ yemi he ɔ mi fa po o ngɛ hlae ɔ, de mi, nɛ ma ha mo.” Ester he nɔ ke, “I dla niye ní kɛ to nɛnɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ. I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa ke e sa nɛnɛ hɛ mi ɔ, ma suɔ kaa nɛnɛ kɛ Haman nɛ ba, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi ba ye ní.” Matsɛ ɔ fa ke a tsɛ Haman kɛ ba esɔesɔ, konɛ a ya nɛ a kɛ Manyɛ Ester ya ye ní.
Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ Haman ho nɛ á ya ye ní.
Benɛ a ngɛ dã nue ɔ, matsɛ ɔ bi manyɛ ɔ ke, “Manyɛ Ester, mɛni ji o sane ɔ?
Mɛni o ngɛ hlae?
Ke ye nɔ yemi he ɔ mi fa po o ngɛ hlae ɔ, de mi, nɛ ma ha mo.” Ester he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ bie ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke e sa nɛnɛ hɛ mi kaa nɛnɛ ma ha mi nɔ́ nɛ ma bi lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɛnɛ kɛ Haman kɛ mi nɛ ba ye ní ekohu hwɔɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma tsɔɔ nɛnɛ nɔ nɛ i ngɛ hlae.” Haman to ga nɛ e kɛ maa gbe Mordekai Benɛ Haman je ní yemi he ɔ, e bua jɔ e he saminya.
Se benɛ e na Mordekai ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ Mordekai bui lɛ, nɛ e ti si ha lɛ ɔ, Haman mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Se e nu e tsui, nɛ e ho e we mi ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya tsɛ e huɛmɛ kɛ ba e we ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɛ e yo Zeresh kɛ piɛ a he.
E fĩa kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ e na ní kpɔtɔɔ ha, binyumuhi abɔ nɛ e ngɛ, bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ wó e nɔ gojoo ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e he hia pe matsɛ ɔ ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli kpa amɛ tsuo.
Haman ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, nɛ́ Manyɛ Ester ma tsɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus ní yemi ɔ, e tsɛ we nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ piɛ we e he, pe imi Haman pɛ.
Hwɔɔ hu, Manyɛ Ester kpale tsɛ imi kɛ̃ kɛ matsɛ ɔ ní yemi ekohu.
Se ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko ha we mi bua jɔmi, be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ jamɛ a Yuda no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mordekai ɔ hyɛe nɛ e hii si ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya a.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e yo Zeresh kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo de lɛ ke, “Ha nɛ a pee tso nɛ a maa sɛu nɔ ngɛ nɔ: e hiɔwe yami nɛ pee gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa.
Hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, de matsɛ ɔ nɛ e ha nɛ a sɛu Mordekai ngɛ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o kɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ ya ní yemi nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi.” Ga nɛ a wo Haman ɔ sa e hɛ mi saminya; nɛ e ha a pee tso nɛ a maa sɛu nɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ.
Matsɛ ɔ wo Mordekai hɛ mi nyami Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, matsɛ ɔ nyɛ we nɛ e hwɔ mahe; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa ke a ya ngɔ yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a ba kane ha lɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ a kane ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ be ko ɔ, Bigtana kɛ Teresh so wo matsɛ ɔ he, konɛ a gbe lɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ Mordekai je a sisi kpo.
Bigtana kɛ Teresh ji matsɛ we ɔ he buli enyɔ komɛ nɛ a puɛ mɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus bi ke, “Nɛ́ Mordekai tsu kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ ɔ, anɛ wa wo e hɛ mi nyami, aloo wa ha lɛ blɔ nya ko lo?” E tsɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “A pee we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ha we lɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ bi si ke, “Anɛ ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi lo?” Jamɛ a be ɔ, Haman ba matsɛ we ɔ agbo nya kue ɔ mi.
E ba nɛ e ba de matsɛ ɔ nɛ e ha a ya sɛu Mordekai ngɛ tso nɛ lɛ, Haman ɔ pee kɛ ha Mordekai ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Haman ba hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa na mo.” Matsɛ ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ e ba.” Benɛ Haman ba e ngɔ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nyumu ko ngɛ nɛ i suɔ wawɛɛ kaa ma wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Mɛni sa kaa ma pee ha lɛ?” Haman bi e he ke, “Mɛnɔ po matsɛ ɔ maa suɔ kaa e maa wo e hɛ mi nyami kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Nɔ́ jemi ko kulaa be he kaa imi ji jamɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ.” -Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, heto nɛ e ha matsɛ ɔ ji, “Nɛnɛ, fa nɛ a ngɔ ablade tade, tade nɛ mo nɛnɛ nitsɛ o woɔ, kɛ ba ha nyumu nɛ ɔ. Ha nɛ a ya ngɔ okpɔngɔ nɛ nɛnɛ nitsɛ hii nɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ nɛnɛ jlasi nɛ fɔ nɔ.
Jehanɛ, ha nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami babauu nɛ ngɔ ablade tade ɔ kɛ wo nyumu ɔ, nɛ a ha e hi okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ po si ngɛ ma nɔ.
Ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ hi fiɛe kɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ suɔ kaa e maa wo nɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de Haman ke, “Ngɔɔ ablade tade ɔ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ esɔ, nɛ o ya pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo Yuda no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mordekai ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ha lɛ.
O maa na lɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya.” Haman ya ngɔ ablade tade ɔ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tade ɔ ya wo Mordekai.
Mordekai hi okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ Haman nyɛɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e kɛ lɛ po si ngɛ ma nɔ.
Benɛ a yaa a tsuo, Haman ngɛ fiɛe ke, “Bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ suɔ kaa e maa wo nɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Jehanɛ, Mordekai kpale kɛ ba matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya ekohu, se Haman lɛɛ e ha e yi nɔ, nɛ e ho e we mi ya mlamlaamla kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ.
E de e yo, Zeresh, kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo níhi nɛ ba e nɔ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e yo ɔ, kɛ e huɛmɛ ní leli ɔmɛ de Haman ke, “Mordekai bɔni o he wami kpɔmi.
Yuda no ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o be lɛ nyɛe.
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e maa ye o nɔ.” A gbe Haman Benɛ a ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ ba kplakplaakpla, nɛ a ba ngɔ Haman kɛ ho, konɛ e kɛ Manyɛ Ester ya ye ní.
Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Haman ho konɛ a kɛ Manyɛ Ester ya ye ní si enyɔne.
Benɛ a ngɛ dã nue ɔ, matsɛ ɔ bi Ester ekohu ke, “Manyɛ Ester, jehanɛ, mo de mi koo.
Mɛni o ngɛ hlae?
Ke ye nɔ yemi ɔ mi fa po o ngɛ hlae ɔ, ma ha mo.” Manyɛ Ester he nɔ ke, “I kpa nɛnɛ pɛɛ, ke e sa nɛnɛ hɛ mi kaa e ma ha mi nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ he si bami ngɛ lɛ bie ɔ, lɛɛ nɛnɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ji kaa ye yi nɛ na wami, nɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ hu a yi nɛ na wami.
A jua i kɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha, konɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi.
Kaa nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛkɛ nɛ a jua wɔ kɛ ho ɔ, i ko de we nɔ́ ko, nɛ i ko gba we nɛnɛ nya; se a miɔ nɛ a ma kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus bi Manyɛ Ester ke, “Mɛnɔ po nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Jije jamɛatsɛ ɔ ngɛ?” Manyɛ Ester he nɔ ke, “Wa he nyɛlɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ ji yiwutsotsɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Haman ɔ!” Haman kɛ sawale hyɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ manyɛ ɔ a hɛ mi gaa.
Matsɛ ɔ hɛ dɔ, nɛ e je kpo kɛ ho abɔɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ya.
Haman na kaa matsɛ ɔ to e yi mi kaa e ma kpata e hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ Haman ɔ lɛɛ e mlɛ ngɛ se, konɛ e kpa Manyɛ Ester pɛɛ nɛ a ngɔ e wami kɛ ke lɛ.
Benɛ e ya bu si ngɛ Manyɛ Ester sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ kpale e se kɛ je abɔɔ ɔ mi kɛ ba tsu ɔ mi.
Benɛ matsɛ ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kpa ngmlaa ke, “Anɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e tua manyɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ngɛ ye hɛ mi, ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye we mi lo?” Matsɛ ɔ nya nɔɛ si tete nɛ nihi nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ́ ko ba ha Haman hɛ mi.
A kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɔ lɛ Habona a de ke, “Nɛnɛ, Haman pee sɛumi tso gagaaga ko po ngɛ e we ɔ mi, konɛ e sɛu Mordekai, nɔ nɛ he o yi wami ɔ ngɛ nɔ.
Sɛumi tso ɔ hiɔwe yami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa!” Matsɛ ɔ fa ke, “Nyɛ ya sɛu Haman ngɛ nɔ!” Nɛ a ya sɛu Haman ngɛ tso nɛ e pee kɛ ha Mordekai ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ se po.
A de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke a fa a he Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Matsɛ Ahasuerus ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛlɔ, Haman weto ní tsuo ngɔ ha Manyɛ Ester.
Akɛnɛ Ester de matsɛ ɔ ke e weku no ji Mordekai he je ɔ, kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, a ngmɛɔ Mordekai blɔ nɛ e baa matsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Matsɛ ɔ ngɔ e nine nguɛ ga nɛ womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ngɛ nɔ ɔ ngɔ ha Mordekai, (Jinɛ Haman nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ).
Ester ngɔ Mordekai ngɔ to Haman ní ɔmɛ a nya.
Ester kɛ matsɛ ɔ tu munyu.
E kpla si kɛ e hɛ mi vo nyu ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nane nya, nɛ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e pee nɔ́ ko kɛ tsi yi mi tomi yaya nɛ Agag nina Haman to ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ nya.
Matsɛ ɔ kɛ matsɛ tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ tsɔɔ manyɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e te da si, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke nɛnɛ suɔ ye sane, nɛ e sa nɛnɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e da ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa nɛnɛ pɛɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ a fiɛ kɛ tsi mlaa yaya nɛ Agag nina, Hamedata bi Haman wo ɔ nya.
Mlaa a ke a kpata Yuda bi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ nɛnɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ke amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba ma a nɔ, nɛ́ a ma kpata imi nitsɛ ye nyɛmimɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus de Manyɛ Ester kɛ Mordekai, Yuda no ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, i ha a sɛu Haman ngɛ yi mi yaya nɛ e to ngɔ wo Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ he, nɛ i ngɔ e weto ní ngɔ ha Manyɛ Ester.
Se ke a ngma fiɛmi ko ngɛ matsɛ ɔ biɛ mi, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ matsɛ ɔ womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ, a kpale we se, ja a ye nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ suɔ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ngma Yuda bi ɔmɛ womi ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ de nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, konɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ ye womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kɛ sɔu nya.” Nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Sivan, nɛ ji nyɔhiɔ etɛne ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ɔ nɔ sane nɛ ɔ ba a nɛ.
Mordekai tsɛ matsɛ womi ngmali ɔmɛ, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma; nɛ a ngma ja pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A ngma womi ɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, ma nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ e nɔ yemi he lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago ɔmɛ, kɛ je India kɛ ya su Sudan ɔ.
A ngma womi ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba tsuaa zugba e gbi, kɛ e ningma mi.
Mordekai hyɛ nɛ a ngma womi ɔmɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus biɛ mi, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ matsɛ ɔ womi nya sɔumi ga a. Tsɔli nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi nɛ le fo tumi saminya a nɔ ya dla womi ɔmɛ kɛ fo.
A hla okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ we okpɔngɔ tsu ɔmɛ a mi.
A ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ke matsɛ ɔ ngmɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ blɔ ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi kaa á to blɔ nya kɛ plee a wami he.
Ke ta buli ba tua mɛ ɔ, á da si nɛ a kɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ hwu, nɛ́ a kpata a hɛ mi.
Á kpata a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi, nɛ́ e ko piɛ nɔ kake po; nɛ́ a ha a níhi.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ a to nɛ a kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu mlaa nɛ ɔ ma bɔni ní tsumi.
Ligbi nɛ ɔ ji nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ɔ. Mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa á fiɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a dla a he kɛ to, konɛ ke be ɔ su ɔ, a kɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ hwu, nɛ a kɛ ye a he lue.
Kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa a, tsɔli nɛ a he sɔɔ kuɔ okpɔngɔhi esɔesɔ kɛ ho ma amɛ a nɔ ya.
A fiɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ ngɛ matsɛ ma Susa a hulɔ.
Benɛ Mordekai je matsɛ we ɔ kɛ ma a, e wo ablade tade bluu kɛ futaa, nɛ sika tsu jlasi ngɛ e yi.
E wo ablade tade wuyaa nɛ a kɛ kɔbɛi kpa kpakpa lo hulɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a he ose ngɛ Susa ma a mi; nɛ blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ pee hoo kɛ bua jɔmi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ a bua jɔ kaa a je haomi mi, nɛ a nya ejakaa a hɛ mi ba nyami.
Ma tsuaa ma mi, ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, he nɛ a maa kane matsɛ ɔ fiɛmi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo a bua jɔɔ a he, nɛ a yeɔ nyami ligbi; a tsɛɔ ní yemi, nɛ a nyaa wawɛɛ.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ni kpahi babauu ba pee a he Yuda bi, ejakaa jehanɛ lɛɛ, a ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbeye yee.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpata a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ ba su.
Kikɛmɛ a ligbi nɛ ɔ ji be nɛ a to nɛ a kɛ mlaa nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo nɛ a fiɛ ha ma a ma bɔni ní tsumi.
Ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ̃ ji ligbi nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ to kaa a ma kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ ba mohu ji kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ bua a he nya ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔ he tsuaa he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a dla a he, konɛ a kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ka kaa e maa ta a he, aloo e maa pee mɛ yayami ko ɔ nɛ to ní.
Se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e te si kɛ wo mɛ, ejakaa a he sawale nu ma amɛ tsuo.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo, amlaalo ɔmɛ, ma nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli nɛ ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ piɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he; ejakaa Mordekai he sawale nu mɛ tsuo.
Mordekai ba pee nɔmlɔ ngua ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ e biɛ pɛ ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo; ejakaa blɔ nya nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ ngɛ nɔ kuɔe, nɛ e nɔ gbɔ we gblee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee a he nyɛli ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ a suɔ.
A ya tua mɛ, nɛ a kɛ klaate kpata a hɛ mi.
Ngɛ matsɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Susa a kɛkɛ mi ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbe nihi lafa enuɔ.
-Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛlɔ nɛ ji Hamedata bi Haman ɔ, bimɛ nyɔngma amɛ piɛ nihi nɛ a gbe ɔ a he.
A biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Parshandata, Dalfon, Aspata, Porata, Adalia, Aridata, Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, kɛ Vaizata.
A kpata ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi mohu, se a hɛ ní.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, benɛ matsɛ ɔ na le nihi abɔ nɛ a gbe ngɛ matsɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Susa a mi ɔ, e de Manyɛ Ester ke, “Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbe nihi lafa enuɔ ngɛ Susa nɛ ji ma ngua a kɛkɛ mi; a gbe Haman binyumu nyɔngma amɛ hulɔ.
Ke a nyɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ ngɛ Susa ma nɛ ɔ pɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ ye nɔ yemi he kpa amɛ lɛɛ kɛ níhi maa hi kɛɛ?” Matsɛ Ahasuerus ya nɔ nɛ e bi manyɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae ekohu?
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ngɛ enɛ ɔ se ɔ, de mi, nɛ ma ha mo.” Ester he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, nɔ́ nɛ a ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee mwɔnɛ ɔ, ha nɛ a pee ja ekohu hwɔɔ.
Jehanɛ, fa nɛ a sɛu Haman binyumu nyɔngma amɛ ngɛ sɛumi tsohi a nɔ.” Matsɛ ɔ fa ke a pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo mlaa nɛ a fiɛ ngɛ Susa ma a mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a sɛu Haman bimɛ nyɔngma amɛ ngɛ sɛumi tsohi a nɔ.
Nyɔhiɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Susa a bua a he nya ekohu, nɛ a gbe ma a mi bi lafa etɛ kɛ piɛ nihi nɛ a gbe kekle ɔ a he.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ a pee kekle ɔ, hɛ ní.
Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ hu to blɔ nya kɛ plee a wami he.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a je a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a he nɛ jɔ mɛ ɔ, a gbe nihi nɛ sume mɛ ɔ akpe nyingmi kpaago kɛ enuɔ.
Se a hɛ ní.
Nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ nɔ nɛ a tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E nɔ jena nɛ ji nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpataa we nɔ ko hɛ mi, se mohu a tsɛ ní yemi; a ye ní nɛ a nu ní, nɛ a nya jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Susa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a kɛ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ pee a nyami ligbi, nɛ a jɔɔ a he.
Ejakaa ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ, kɛ nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, a hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpatae.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ ma wawi a mi ɔ yeɔ nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ kaa a nyami ligbi, nɛ a bua jɔɔ a he.
A yeɔ ní nɛ a nuɔ ní, nɛ a kee a sibi niye ní.
Nyami be nɛ a tsɛɛ Purim ɔ Mordekai ha nɛ a ngma sane nɛ ɔ nɛ ba a ngɔ fɔ si; nɛ e ngma womi kɛ mane Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, nihi nɛ a he kɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nya a tsuo.
E de mɛ ke, daa jeha a, á ye ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, kɛ nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ Adar a mi kaa he jɔɔmi ligbihi.
Ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpata a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Jinɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ maa pee aywilɛho kɛ kɔmɔ yemi be, se e ba plɛ pee bua jɔmi kɛ nyami be mohu.
Bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mɛ ke a ye nyami ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ ji a tsɛ nihi ní yemi, nɛ a nya; a ke a sibi, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ niye ní, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ hu ní kpakpahi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee bɔ nɛ Mordekai tsɔɔ mɛ kaa a pee ɔ, nɛ nyami be nɛ ɔ ba plɛ pee kusumi ko nɛ a peeɔ daa jeha.
Hamedata bi Haman, Agag nina a ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo a he nyɛlɔ.
E so Yuda bi ɔmɛ a yi nɔ nɛ e ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
E fɔ sɔ konɛ e na ligbi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a ma tsu yi wu tso ní nɛ ɔ.
(A tsɛɔ sɔ fɔmi ke Purim ngɛ Hebri gbi mi.)
Se Ester ba na matsɛ ɔ, nɛ matsɛ ɔ ngma womi kɛ tsi ga yaya nɛ Haman to kɛ ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ nya.
Bɔ nɛ e ya ba ha ji kaa nɔ́ nɛ e hla kaa e maa pee Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, a kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ mohu.
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa a sɛu lɛ kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a tsɛɔ nyami ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ ke Purim ɔ nɛ.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ wo mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si daa kɛ ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a nina, kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ma ba pee Yuda no ɔ tsuo, kaa daa jeha, ngɛ be nɛ a to ɔ mi tutuutu ɔ, a ye ligbi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mordekai ngma a pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A fua fɔ nɔ kaa Yuda bi a weku tsuo, ngɛ yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba a a mi, ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, a kai nɛ a ye Purim ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ daa.
Jehanɛ, Manyɛ Ester, Abihail biyo ɔ hu ngma womi, nɛ e kɛ e he wami tsuo pi nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai ngma momo nɛ kɔɔ Purim he ɔ se kpɛii.
A ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nɔ yemi he lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago nɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus nɔ yemi ɔ mi ɔ. Womi ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ na tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi.
E tsɔɔ hu kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a nina tsuo a ye Purim ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ a be ɔ mi tutuutu kaa bɔ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wo mlaahi kɛ ha hwɔ hami, nɛ a to behi nɛ a kɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Mordekai kɛ Manyɛ Ester tsuo fa ke a pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mlaa nɛ Manyɛ Ester wo nɛ ɔ ma Purim blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ mi.
Nɛ a ngma kɛ wo womi mi.
Matsɛ Ahasuerus kɛ Mordekai Matsɛ Ahasuerus ha nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔ ngɛ wo nya je, kɛ hue mi je tsuo tsu ní kpakpataa.
Ní nguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee, kɛ sanehi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ bɔ nɛ e wo Mordekai nɔ nɛ e pee lɛ nɔkɔtɔma a, a ngma ngɛ Persia kɛ Media matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔmɛ a mi.
Yuda no, Mordekai ji Matsɛ Ahasuerus nitsɛ e se yelɔ.
E hɛɛ blɔ nya nguaa ngɛ ma, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a suɔ lɛ saminya.
E hlaa kaa e ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ya nɔ, nɛ e daa mi ha mɛ konɛ níhi a mi nɛ hi ha mɛ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Sane nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ nyumu ko nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi na amanehlu babauu.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ bimɛ tsuo ba gbo si kake too; e weto ní tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ hɛ mi kpata, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e ba nu hiɔ yaya ko.
Nɔ nɛ ngma womi ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Hiob kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ komɛ sɛɛ Hiob haomi ɔ he ní si etɛ sɔuu.
(A ngma ní sɛɛmi nɛ ɔ ngɛ asilɛ gbi mi).
Ní sɛɛmi ɔ nyagbe ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ ba je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Hiob.
Hiob kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ní sɛɛmi ɔ mi oti pɔtɛɛ ji bɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa si himi ngɛ.
Hiob huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ kaa yayami nɛ Hiob pee, nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɔ́ lɛ e ngɛ nae ɔ nɛ.
A ngɔ jami nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nya kaa Mawu gblaa yayami peelɔ tue, se nɔmlɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e woɔ lɛ nguɔ.
Hiob kplɛɛ we nɔ kaa yayami ko nɛ e pee ɔ he nɛ a ngɛ e tue gblae.
E susu kaa e da kɛ pi si, nɛ sé ko be e he.
E nui sisi kaa lɛ nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu maa ngmɛ blɔ nɛ tue gblami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba e nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Hiob kɛ hɛdɔ bi Mawu munyuhi babauu.
Pi kaa Hiob hemi kɛ yemi ta, se pe e suɔ kaa a wo lɛ nguɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, konɛ e kpale na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ekohu.
Munyuhi nɛ Hiob bi Mawu ɔ, Mawu ha we lɛ heto, se e buaa he ha lɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ji kaa e je e he kpo tsɔɔ Hiob kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ, e he wami kle, nɛ e nile hu mi kuɔ.
Hiob ba kpa si kaa niinɛ, Mawu kle, nɛ e nile hu mi kuɔ.
E kɛ he si bami pia e he; e ye pɔpu kaa abofu ha nɛ e kɛ Mawu tu munyu basabasa.
Nyagbe ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ deɔ wɔ ke Hiob kpale na e he ekohu; a gbaa lɛ kɛ níhi babauu pe kekle ɔ po.
Mawu ka Hiob huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa a nyɛ we nɛ a nu Hiob we amanehlu ɔ sisi.
Hiob pɛ lɛ nu sisi saminya kaa Mawu kle pe bɔ nɛ jami nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije munyuhi .—.
Hiob kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ .—.
a. Hiob po Mawu nya .- b. Kekleekle ní sɛɛmi .—.
d. Ní sɛɛmi enyɔne .—.
e. Ní sɛɛmi etɛne .—.
ɛ. Nile yi jemi la .- f. Hiob nyagbe munyuhi .—.
Elihu tu munyu .—.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha Hiob heto .—.
Nyagbe munyuhi .-
Satan ba ka Hiob Nyumu ko hi si ngɛ Uz zugba a nɔ; e biɛ ji Hiob.
E jaa Mawu, nɛ e yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ; e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Hiob ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago, biyihi etɛ, kɛ tsɔli babauu.
E ngɛ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ: to akpe kpaago, afukpɔngɔ akpe etɛ, na akpe, kɛ teji yo lafa enuɔ.
Lɛ ji nɔmlɔ ngua pe kulaa ngɛ beleku je ma amɛ a mi.
Ke pee ɔ, Hiob binyumu ɔmɛ tsɛɔ ní yemi kakaaka ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e be, nɛ a kpeeɔ a nyɛmimɛ yi etɛ ɔmɛ kɛ baa ní yemi ɔ. Ke a gbe ní yemi ɔ tsuo nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, jena mɔtu ɔ, Hiob maa te si mla nɛ e maa sã sami bɔ kɛ ha e bimɛ ɔmɛ kakaaka, nɛ e kɛ maa pee mɛ klɔuklɔu.
Hiob peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ daa, ejakaa e susuɔ kaa eko ɔ, e bimɛ ɔmɛ pee yayami kaa a jɛ Mawu nɛ a li a he be.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ Satan hu piɛ a he kɛ ba.
Yawɛ bi Satan ke, “Jije o je?” Satan he nɔ ke, “I ya kpa je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ ya kɛ ba.” Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o to ye tsɔlɔ Hiob he hɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be je ɔ mi nɛ da, nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale kɛ lɛ sɔ lo?
E jaa mi, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Satan he nɔ ke, “O susuɔ kaa yaka gu lɛ Hiob yeɔ mo gbeye ɔ?
O baa Hiob yi, kɛ e we mi bimɛ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ, nɛ nɔ́ ko hia we lɛ.
O gbaa e ní tsumi, nɛ o wo lɛ ní babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Moo lɛɛ mo he ní ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ kaa e be mo gbiɛe ngɛ o hɛ mi lo!” Yawɛ de Satan ke, “Saminya!
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ Hiob dɛ ɔ, i ngɔ kɛ wo o dɛ.
Se lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ lɛɛ o nine ko ta he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Satan je Mawu he.
Hiob bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ e níhi tsuo a hɛ mi kpata Ligbi ko benɛ Hiob binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ ní yee nɛ a ngɛ ní nue ngɛ a nyɛminyumu nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi ɔ, tsɔlɔ ko gbɔ fo kɛ ba Hiob ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Na amɛ ngɛ hue, nɛ teji yi ɔmɛ ngɛ ní yee ngɛ a kasa nya.
Tlukaa a, Sabea bi ɔmɛ ba yu a nɔ, nɛ a muɔ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho.
A gbe o tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo; imi nɔ kake too lɛ i je mi, nɛ i ba konɛ ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.” Benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tsɔlɔ kpa ba nɛ e ba de ke, “Oslabai gba pue to ɔmɛ kɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e gbe mɛ tsuo.
Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i je mi, nɛ i ba konɛ ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.” E nya na we nɛ e nɔ si nɛ tsɔlɔ kpa ba nɛ e ba de ke, “Kaldea ní hali a kuu etɛ ba tua wɔ.
A gbe o tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a ngɔ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je.
Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i je mi, nɛ i ba konɛ ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.” Benɛ lɛ hu e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tsɔlɔ kpa ba nɛ e ba de ke, “O binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ ní yee nɛ a ngɛ ní nue ngɛ a nyɛminyumu nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi.
Tlukaa a, kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa hia kɛ je nga a nɔ blɔ kɛ ba na tsu ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ tsu ɔ hule ngɔ pue nihewi ɔmɛ, kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a gbo.
Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i je mi, nɛ i ba konɛ ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Hiob te da si, nɛ e kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e sã e yi nɔ.
E kpla si, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ e ja Mawu.
Hiob de ke, “Maa fɔ mi kɛ ba he gu, nɛ ma kpale kɛ ya he gu.
Yawɛ lɛ ha, nɛ Yawɛ lɛ ba ngɔ kɛ ho.
A je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi!” Enɛ ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, Hiob pee we yayami ko; e pia we Mawu.
Satan ba ka Hiob ekohu Ligbi ko benɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ekohu ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, Satan piɛ a he kɛ ba.
Yawɛ bi Satan ke, “Jije o je?” Satan he nɔ ke, “I ya kpa je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ ya kɛ ba.” Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o to ye tsɔlɔ Hiob he hɛ kaa nɔ ko be je ɔ mi nɛ da, nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale kɛ lɛ sɔ lo?
E jaa mi, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
O ba nyɛ ye nɔ ke ma ha mo blɔ nɛ o ya hao lɛ, be mi nɛ e pee we yayami ko kulaa.
Se kɛ ba si piɔ ɔ, Hiob ngɛ anɔkuale yee kɛ mwɔɔ.” Satan he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ ɔ, e ma nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ha, ke e yi ma na wami kɛkɛ ɔ. Moo lɛɛ moo ye e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ awi kaa e be mo gbiɛe ngɛ o hɛ mi lo!” Yawɛ de Satan ke, “Saminya!
E ngɛ o dɛ mi; e hɛ mi kɛkɛ nɛ o ko kpata.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Satan si Yawɛ, nɛ e ya ha nɛ tslɔɔ fuu Hiob nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo, kɛ je e nane sisi kɛ ya si e yi mi.
Hiob ho ya hi la zu mi, nɛ e ngɔ ngɛyu kɛ ngɛ e he hluae.
Jehanɛ, e yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Tse o ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ yee kɛ mwɔɔ!
Gbiɛ Mawu, nɛ o gbo!” Hiob he nɔ ke, “O ngɛ munyu tue kaa bɔ nɛ yihi kuasia amɛ a ti nɔ ko maa tu munyu pɛ.
Ke Mawu ha wɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, tse wa heɔ.
Lɛ ke e ha wɔ nɔ́ yaya a, wa ko ngɔ lo?” Enɛ ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, Hiob pee we yayami; e de we nɔ́ ko kɛ si we Mawu.
Hiob huɛmɛ ɔmɛ Amanehlu nɛ ba Hiob nɔ ɔ, e huɛmɛ etɛ komɛ nu he, nɛ a je he slɔɔtohi kɛ ba konɛ a ba ye lɛ kɔmɔ nɛ a wo lɛ bua.
Huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ji Elifaz nɛ je Teman ma a mi, Bildad nɛ je Shua zugba a nɔ, kɛ Zofar nɛ je Naama zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ a ma ngɛ tsitsaa a, a na Hiob, se a yo we lɛ.
Benɛ a ba yo lɛ ɔ, a wo yana nɛ a nya awe.
A kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ a fĩa bunyuku kɛ ho hiɔwe ya kɛ pue a yi mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ba hi si ngɛ e kasa nya ngɛ zugba nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi kpaago sɔuu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ lɛ tu we munyu jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo, ejakaa a na kaa e ngɛ nɔ́ nae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Hiob kɛ Mawu tu munyu kɛ hɛdɔ Jehanɛ, Hiob wo e nya nɔ nɛ e gbiɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ. Hiob -Á gbiɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ; á gbiɛ nyɔ ɔ nɛ a wo ye hɔ ɔ. Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, ko kai jamɛ a ligbi ɔ hu gblegbleegble.
Ha nɛ je ɔ mi nɛ wo diblii, nɛ pu ko tso hu.
Ha nɛ e pee mɔbɔ ligbi, nɛ je ɔ mi nɛ wo diblii kpii.
Ha nɛ bɔku tuu ba ha pu ɔ hɛ mi.
Gbee jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ kɛ je jeha a mi; nɛ ke a ngɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔmɛ kanee ɔ, a ko kane jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ. Ha nɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ nɛ pee nyɔ ku; bua jɔmi la ko nɛ ko pɛ.
Nyɛ de nɔ gbiɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ wo mi lohwe ngua a hɛ mi la woli ɔmɛ ke a gbiɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Ha nɛ nɔkɔ ɔ nɛ wo diblii; je mi nɛ ko tsɔ, nɛ je hu ko na.
Á gbiɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ, kaa e kɛ mi wo haomi kɛ aywilɛho mi.
Mɛni he je i gbo we ngɛ maa mi mi?
Mɛni he je i gbo we be nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ pɛ?
Mɛni he je maa ngɔ mi kɛ fɔ e tɛ nɔ?
Mɛni he je lɛ e ha mi nyɔ?
I gbo kpoo jamɛ a be ɔ mi, jinɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye he mi jɔ mi.
Jinɛ i kɛ matsɛmɛ, kɛ nɔ yeli nɛ ma mɔhi blema ko ɔ hwɔɔ si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Jinɛ i kɛ ganɔhi nɛ bua sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ nya tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ a wehi a mi ɔ hwɔɔ si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Mɛni he je i gbo we ngɛ muɔ nɔ, nɛ i ko nɛ́ pu la a?
Ngɛ gbeje ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ jɔɔ nɔ haomi, nɛ nihi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, jɔɔ a he.
Lejɛ ɔ, pamitsɛmɛ po naa he jɔmi; nɔ ko tu we mɛ munyu basabasa hu; nɔ ko ke we a yi hulɔ.
Nimli wawi kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɔguɛ hu ye e he.
Mɛni he je nimli adesahi maa hi haomi mi kɛ mwɔɔ?
Mɛni he je e sa kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ aywilɛho yee ɔ a yi nɛ na wami?
A hyɛɛ gbenɔ blɔ, se gbenɔ bɛ; a hlaa yɔkɔ mohu se blɔ pe juetli.
Ja a gbo nɛ a pu mɛ, loko a naa bua jɔmi.
Mɛni he je e sa kaa a fɔ nɔ ko nɛ e ba na nɔ́ yaka, be mi nɛ níhi nɛ maa ba e nɔ hwɔɔ se ɔ, Mawu ngɔ kɛ laa lɛ?
I haoɔ loko i yeɔ ní, nɛ ke i ngɛ kɛmɛe ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a kpa pue si.
Níhi nɛ i yee gbeye ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ i kɛ kpee; níhi nɛ i hla we ma na a, lɔ ɔmɛ i naa.
I be tue mi jɔmi; i be he jɔmi; ye haomi ɔmɛ a se pui gblegbleegble.
Kekleekle ní sɛɛmi Elifaz -Hiob, anɛ ke i bi mo munyu ɔ, o mi mi ma fu lo?
I nyɛ we nɛ ma ma ye nya nɛ ma pee dii hu.
O tsɔɔ nihi babauu ní.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nine mi je wu hu, o wo mɛ he wami.
Nɔ nɛ miɔ nɛ e maa nɔ si ɔ, o munyu ɔ nuɔ lɛ kɛ daa si ekohu.
Nakutsohi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, o woɔ mɛ he wami, nɛ a teɔ si ekohu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, haomi ba o nɔ nɛ o jija, nɛ o nyɛ we nya nɛ o da.
Tse o jaa Mawu!
Anɛ lɔ ɔ wui mo bua lo?
O peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ!
Anɛ lɔ ɔ ha we mo hɛ nɔ kami lo?
Susu o yi mi!
Anɛ o le nɔ ko nɛ pee we yayami nɛ e hɛ mi kpata lo?
Anɛ o le dalɔ ko nɛ a gbe lɛ yaka gu lo?
Nɔ́ nɛ imi i le ji kaa nihi nɛ huɔ yayami ngmɔ, nɛ a duɔ yayami wu ɔ, yayami yiblii lɛ a kpaa.
Mawu ngɔɔ abofu kɛ kpataa a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ ahumi puɛɔ ní ɔ. Yiwutsotsɛmɛ huãã, nɛ a pɛɛ kaa jata, se Mawu jɔɔ a he nɛ e kũɔ a lunguhi.
A gboɔ kaa jata nɛ nɛ lohwe nɛ e gbe nɛ e ye, nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛɛ kɛ fĩaa.
Nɔ ko ju si ba tu mi munyu ko zaa ngɛ ablɛgbi mi be ko.
Munyu nɛ ɔ he susumi ha nɛ dekla nu mi, nɛ i hwɔ we mahe nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo.
I ye gbeye, nɛ i kpokpo, nɛ ye kpɔhi a nya tsuo do blibliibli.
Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi ko ba po ye hɛ mi fli, nɛ gbeye sɔuu ha nɛ fĩɛ ngmangu pue ye nɔ.
I na kaa nɔ́ ko daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; i hyɛ, se i li nɔ́ nɛ ji.
Lejɛ ɔ pee dii; kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ ke, “Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa maa da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi lo?
Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa he ma tsɔ ngɛ e bɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi lo?
Mawu tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ hiɔwe tete po Mawu he we mɛ yi.
E bɔfo ɔmɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ po, e naa tɔmi ngɛ a he.
Nɛ mo nɛ tabo zu lɛ a kɛ puɛ mo, nɛ o ngɛ kaa bunyuku kɛkɛ!
Mo nɛ a ma nyɛ maa naa o nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a naa wɔyewɔye nɔ ɔ, moo lɛɛ o susu kaa Mawu ma he mo maa ye lo?
Mɔtu ɔ, nɔ ko maa hi hɛ ngmengmle.
Se loko du ma bu ɔ, e gbo momo nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li.
Ke a he e he wami tsuo ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e gbo be mi nɛ e li nɔ́ ko.”
Hiob, mo kpa kuu kaa nɔ ko ma he nɔ lo!
Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ ngɔ o maa ya?
Niinɛ, mi mi la gbeɔ kuasia.
Nɔ nɛ hɛ mi tɛ̃ ɔ, hunga gbeɔ lɛ.
I na kuasiahi nɛ a pee kaa a na a he; kɛkɛ nɛ i gbiɛ a hi he amlɔ nɔuu.
A bimɛ ɔmɛ be he jɔmi nae.
Ke a kɛ mɛ ya kojomi he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be a he fae.
Kuasiahi a ngmɔ ní ɔ, ke mio mi e ngɛ po, nihi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee ma ya ye.
A juetli he kuma maa ye nihi.
Amanehlu ɔ, pi bunyuku mi nɛ e jeɔ; haomi hu pi zu mi nɛ e puɛɔ kɛ jeɔ.
Nɔmlɔ adesa nitsɛ lɛ hlaa haomi kɛ haa e he kaa bɔ nɛ la lilɛ tee kɛ yaa hiɔwe ɔ. Imi ji mo jinɛ i ko hla Mawu se blɔ, nɛ ma tu ye sane ɔ kɛ wo e dɛ mi.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ peeɔ ní nguanguahi nɛ wa juɛmi sui he, kɛ nyakpɛ ní hu babauu.
Lɛ nɛ e haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛɔ kɛ pueɔ zugba; nɛ e haa nɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ naa nyu.
Ee, nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, Mawu woɔ a nɔ; lɛ nɛ e woɔ kɔmɔ yeli a bua.
Lɛ nɛ e tsakeɔ nɔ sisili a yi mi tomi, nɛ níhi nɛ a so kaa a maa pee ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a peeɔ.
Ke ní leli tsɔ nihi klama a, lɛ nɛ e haa klama amɛ fɛɔ yaka nɛ a puɛ we ní.
Piani nɛ la ngɛ po, a hii si tataae kaa nɔ́ nɛ diblii mi lɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.
Se Mawu heɔ ohiatsɛ yi wami kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi.
E jeɔ nɔ nɛ e fí lɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ yiwutsotsɛ dɛ mi.
E haa ohiatsɛ hɛ nɔ kami, nɛ yiwutsotsɛ maa e nya.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ Mawu kaa e hɛ mi ɔ. Ke Mawu Ope ɔ ngɛ o hɛ mi kae ɔ, koo ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ́ ko nyafii.
Ke Mawu plaa mo ɔ, e fiɔ pa a nɔ; ke e fia mo nɔ́ ɔ, e tsaa mo.
E ma je mo kɛ je haomihi tsuo a mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko be o he sae.
Hwɔ be mi, kɛ ta be mi tsuo e ma he o yi wami.
Mawu ma je mo kɛ je he guɛ gbeli a dɛ mi; ke hɛ mi kpatami ma a, e ma he o yi wami.
Hɛ mi kpatami kɛ hwɔ a he maa pee mo muɔ, nɛ o be pu mi lohwehi hu gbeye yee.
Ejakaa ngmɔhi nɛ o ma hu ɔ, tɛ be a nɔ hie; pu mi lohwehi hu be mo haoe.
O maa hi si ngɛ o bo tsu ɔ mi ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Ke o hyɛ o to tsu ɔ mi ɔ, o maa na kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
O bimɛ maa hiɛ babauu kaa nga ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
O maa bwɔ kotokoto loko o ma gbo, kaa bɔ nɛ ngma waa saminya loko a kpaa a. Hiob, nɔ nɛ wa kpa si nɛ wa na ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
E ji anɔkuale.
Mo hu moo bu tue nɛ o le, konɛ e hi ha mo.
Hiob -I ná nɛ a ngmɛ ye haomi ɔ, kɛ ye aywilɛho ɔ ngɛ sɛni nɔ, jinɛ a ko jiɔ pe wo nya zia.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ munyu tue basabasa a nɛ.
Mawu Ope ɔ tsɛ̃ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃, nɛ duɔ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ ye he womi mi tsuo.
Mawu ní gbeyegbeye ɔmɛ gba ta kɛ wo mi.
Ke nga mi teji ngɛ nga kpee ɔ, anɛ e pa hii pɛe lo?
Ke na ngɛ ní yee ɔ, anɛ e hii pɛe kɛ mwɔɔ lo?
Anɛ a yeɔ ní muɛtɛ nɛ a nɛ ngo lo?
Kungwɔ hlui mi ehiɔ ɔ, mɛni ngɔmi lɛ ngɛ mi?
Niye ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ jlo we mi; ke i ye kɛkɛ e peeɔ mi kaa ma vie.
Mɛni he je Mawu ha we mi nɔ́ nɛ i bi lɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je e bui ye kue fami ɔ tue ɔ?
Lɛɛ tse e ko ngɔ e nine kɛ fia mi nɔ́ nɛ e gbe nyɔngloo!
Jinɛ ma hlu kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ i be haomi ɔ nitsɛ po he nue.
Mawu Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa amɛ ɔ, i tɔ̃ we a nɔ hyɛ.
Mɛni he wami i ngɛ nɛ ma kɛ hi je mi kɛ mwɔɔ?
Mɛni he je ma hi je mi kɛ mwɔɔ, be mi nɛ i be hɛ nɔ kami ko?
Anɛ tɛ ji mi nɛ i nui nɔ́ he lo?
Ye he womi ɔ, akɔblee lo?
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ye he wami ta!
He ko he ko be nɛ ma na yemi kɛ buami kɛ je.
I kua Mawu jio, i kua we lɛ jio, ngɛ haomi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e hia mi huɛmɛ nɛ ma he mɛ ma ye.
Se nyɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ sisiɔ mi kaa pa nɛ gbli, be mi nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́.
Snoo kɛ nyu tɛ hyiɔ pa tɔtɔɔtɔ, se ke je mi dɔ, kɛkɛ a laa, be mi nɛ nyu dɔ ɔ fɔɔ si gu nɛ e gbli.
Blɔ nyɛɛli gbaa kɛ jeɔ a blɔ nɔ kaa a ma na nyu maa nu lo.
Se a nɛ nyu nɛ a nu, nɛ a gboɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Blɔ nyɛɛli nɛ je Sheba kɛ Tema ba hlaa nyu nɛ a nu.
Se ke a ba su pa nɛ e mi nyu mii ta a he kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a kɔni mi jɔɔ, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɔ a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ.
Nyɛ ngɛ kaa jamɛ a pa a nɛ e mi nyu mii ta a pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛ ba na mi ngɛ haomi si himi mi, kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ye gbeye.
Anɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ba ke mi ní, aloo nyɛ ya ha nɔ ko nyɔ mi ní ha mi lo?
Anɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ba je mi kɛ je he nyɛlɔ, loo yiwutsotsɛ ko dɛ mi lo?
Yoo, nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ tu munyu.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ dɛ; ma pee dii nɛ ma bu nyɛ tue.
Anɔkuale munyuhi gbɔɔ nɔ tsui mi; se ye hɛ mi nɛ nyɛ ba ngɛ kae nɛ ɔ lɛɛ yaka kɛkɛ.
Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ juɛmi munyuhi tue, se imi nɛ ye nine mi je wu ɔ, ye munyu ɔmɛ peeɔ kɔɔhiɔ; pi ja?
Anɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa fɔ awusa bi nɔ sɔ lo?
Anɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa wo nyɛ huɛ he jua lo?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ ye hɛ mi saminya!
Anɛ ma nyɛ ma ye nyɛ lakpa lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ ko susu nɔ́ yayami ha mi kɛ ya tsitsaa.
Nyɛ ko bu mi fɔ; i yeɔ nguɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ susuu kaa i ngɛ lakpa yee.
Nyɛ susuu kaa i li kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti slɔɔto lo?
Nɔmlɔ adesa wami si himi ngɛ kaa ta; nɔmlɔ ngɛ kaa apaa yelɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi.
Nɔmlɔ ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛ nɛ ngɛ hɔ̃ hlae nɛ e hi mi.
E ngɛ kaa apaa yelɔ nɛ ngɛ e hiɔwo blɔ hyɛe.
Bɔ nɛ ye sane ɔ ngɛ pɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɔhiɔhi babauu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i hii si kɛkɛ; daa nyɔ mi ɔ, dekla sɔuu.
Ke i ya hwɔ si ɔ, i biɔ ye he ke, “Mɛni be je maa na nɛ ma te si?” Ke nyɔ ɔ se kɛ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ i hii plɛe ngɛ sa mi hluu kɛ ya siɔ mɔtu.
Ye he womi pɔtɔ, nɛ e wo gɔgɔ.
Ye he tsuo pee pa, nɛ e foɔ nyu.
Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee mlamlaamla; a he ngɛ sɔe kulaa pe bo lolɔ kplɛ.
Ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ tae, se i be hɛ nɔ kami ko.
Nyɛ kai kaa ye wami ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ; ye bua jɔmi ɔ se po.
Nɛ́ nyɛ ngɛ mi hyɛe nɛ ɔ, nyɛ be mi nae hu.
Nyɛ maa hi mi hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ i si nyɛ.
Ke nɔ ko gbo nɛ e ho gbeje ya a, e kpale we kɛ bɛ hu kaa bɔ nɛ bɔku laa nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu ɔ. Nɔ ɔ kpale we kɛ bɛ e we mi hu, nɛ nihi nɛ le lɛ ɔ, a hɛ jee e nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i be ye nya mae.
I hao, nɛ aywilɛho nu mi.
Ja i tu munyu kɛ̃!
Mɛni he je nyɛ ba ngɛ ye he bue?
Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa wo mi lohwe ngua a ji mi lo?
Ke i susu kaa ke i hwɔ si nɛ ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ ke i hwɔ mahe nɛ ye kɔmɔ yemi se maa po ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nlamihi, kɛ ninahi woɔ ye he gbeye.
I na nɛ a mia ye kuɔ si nɛ i gbo mohu, pe nɔ́ nɛ ma hi je mi wuhiwuhi kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Je mi si himi pee we mi akɔnɔ hu; i be si hie kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ nyɛɛ ho; ye wami ɔ ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.
Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ adesa, loko e he hia mo kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ji lɛ, loko o susuɔ e he kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
O ba slaa lɛ daa mɔtu, nɛ o kaa lɛ kpitikpiti.
O be o hɛ jee kɛ je ye he bɔɔ nɛ ma mi ye kuɔ mi nyu po lo?
Ke i pee yayami ɔ, i plaa mo lo?
Mo nɛ o hyɛɛ nimli adesahi a tsui mi ɔ, mɛni he je o je hɛ ngɔ pi mi ɔ?
Anɛ i plɛ pee tlomi nɛ jiɔ tsɔ ha mo lo?
Mɛni he je o kɛ ye he yayami ɔmɛ pɛ mi ɔ?
Mɛni he je o je we ye he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ji o hɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?
Jehanɛ lɛɛ tabo zu mi lɛ ma hwɔ; ke o ngɛ mi hlae ɔ, o be mi nae hu.
Bildad -O maa hi munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Munyu nɛ ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ o nya mi kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ngɛ fiae vuguvugu nɛ ɔ, mɛni be o ma kpa tumi?
Anɛ Mawu plɛɔ sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si lo?
Mawu Ope ɔ, anɛ e tsakeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ lo?
O bimɛ ɔmɛ pee yayami kɛ si Mawu, nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ e gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa mɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛɛ mo nitsɛ mo hla Mawu Ope ɔ se blɔ nɛ o fa kue ha lɛ.
Ke o he tsɔ, nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu ma tsɔ e hɛ mi ha mo, nɛ e ma ha mo sihi he kpakpa.
Hwɔɔ se ɔ, Mawu ma ha mo ní babauu nɛ maa hiɛ kulaa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, hla blema nile se blɔ, nɛ o hyɛ anɔkuale nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kase ɔ. Wa wami be ɔ ngɛ kpiti; wa li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; wa ngɛ kaa nini kɛkɛ nɛ bee ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Nyɛ ha nɛ blema ní leli nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ní; nyɛɛ bu a nya mi munyu ɔmɛ tue: “Anɛ ngɔwu puɛɔ ngɛ he nɛ mɔsɔ be lo?
Anɛ ke ngɔwu nɛ nyu ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa wa lo?
Ke nyu ta a he pɛ mɛ ji kekleekle tsohi nɛ a gboɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, a wɛ lolo nɛ a maa po mɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ ko.
Nimlihi nɛ a hɛ je Mawu nɔ ɔ, a ngɛ kaa ngɔwu nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ.
Ke o li Mawu ɔ, o be hɛ nɔ kami ko.
Nimli nɛ li Mawu ɔ, a hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ kaa anani ya; a yi mi tomi ɔmɛ tsuo maa laa.
A maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ weku kɛ nina nɔ, se e be hie ha mɛ.
A maa ngɔ a he kɛ mɛtɛ mɛ kpɛii, se nɔ́ kpakpa ko be mi jee.” Nimli yayamihi bɔɔ kaa nga ngɛ pu nɔ; a bɔɔ kaa nga nɛ ha ngmɔ nɔ.
A sipoku ɔmɛ ngɔɔ a he ya blaa tɛ sahi, nɛ a mɛtɛɛ tɛ sa amɛ a he.
Se ke a hɛ mi kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be lee kaa a hi lejɛ ɔ hyɛ po.
Niinɛ, bua jɔmi tsuo nɛ nimli yayamihi naa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, ni kpahi baa ba ngɔɔ a blɔ he ɔmɛ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu be lɛ kuae.
Mawu be nimli yayamihi a he piɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Mawu ma ha nɛ o maa muɔ, nɛ o ma hwɔ lele ekohu.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ mo ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ; yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a wehi maa laa.
Hiob - Niinɛ, i le kaa e ngɛ mi ja.
Se kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e maa ye nguɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ Mawu maa hua nɔ́ he?
Ke Mawu bi lɛ munyu akpe ɔ, anɛ e ma nyɛ kake po heto ma ha lo?
Mawu ɔ, e le ní, nɛ e he wa.
Mɛnɔ lɛ te si kɛ si Mawu hyɛ nɛ e hi ha lɛ?
E hiaa yohi tlukaa nɛ e wui nɔ ko si; nɛ ke e mi mi fu ɔ, e kpataa a hɛ mi.
E haa nɛ zugba mimiɛɔ, nɛ titimahi nɛ hɛɛ zugba a mimiɛɔ.
E nyɛɔ faa nɛ pu ti si, nɛ dodoehi hu kpɛ we.
Benɛ Mawu maa gbla hiɔwe mi, nɛ e maa naa wo mi lohwe ngua a nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko piɛ we e he.
Dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe: Je kpaago, Huɛ etɛ, Kungwɔ kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ leneyi je dodoe ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu lɛ pee mɛ tsuo.
E peeɔ ní nguahi nɛ nimli adesahi a juɛmi sui he.
E nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu nɛ a li nya.
Hyɛ, Mawu bee ngɛ ye hɛ mi kɛ yaa kɛ baa, se i nɛ lɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ e gblɔ kɛ je.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsi e nya?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?” Mawu mi mi fumi se pui.
E he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ te si wo lɛ ɔ, e kpata a hɛ mi.
Mɛ lɛ a ya piɛ wo mi lohwe ngua a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rahab ɔ he ɔ nɛ.
Lɛɛ jije ma na munyu ngɛ kɛ ha Mawu heto nɛ sa?
E ngɛ mi kaa i pee we yayami ko lɛɛ, se i be nyɛe nɛ ma ha Mawu heto.
Pɛɛ kɛkɛ lɛ ma kpa Mawu, ye kojolɔ ɔ, konɛ e na mi mɔbɔ.
Ke i tsɛ lɛ nɛ e he nɔ pohu, i he we yi kaa ke i tu munyu nɛ e maa bu mi tue.
E haa nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa fiaa mi basabasa yaka gu, nɛ i plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E ha we nɛ ma wo mumi kulaa; ye wami si himi ɔ, doomi sɔuu.
Ke a ngɛ nɔ nɛ he wa hlae ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke e ba lɛ dami sane yemi hu, mɛnɔ kɛ lɛ maa ba kojomi he ɔ?
Ke i ke dalɔ ji mi ɔ, imi nitsɛ ye nya mi munyu maa bu mi fɔ.
Ke i ke tɔmi ko be ye he ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ mi kaa i yeɔ fɔ.
Ke i yeɔ nguɔ kulaa po, e hia we kaa ma susu lɔ ɔ he; ye wami si himi pee we mi akɔnɔ hu.
O yeɔ fɔ jio, o yeɔ nguɔ jio, lɛ tsuo nɔ́ kake too.
Mawu ma kpata wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi.
Ke nɔ nɛ pee we yayami gbo tlukaa a, Mawu muɔɔ.
Mawu ngɔ je ɔ kɛ wo nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi.
E ngɔ nɔ́ ngɔ ha kojoli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ke pi Mawu nɛ pee ɔ, lɛɛ mɛnɔ lɛ pee?
Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee mlamlaamla; a he ngɛ sɔe kulaa pe nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ fo tue.
Se nɔ́ kpakpa ko be a mi.
Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee kɛ fo kaa lɛ nɛ he sɔɔ saminya; aloo kaa kɔle nɛ maa ho lohwe sami ya.
-Ke i ke ma muɔ nɛ ye hɛ nɛ je ye haomi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, haomi ɔmɛ tsuo kpaleɔ kɛ baa nɛ a ba woɔ ye he gbeye.
I le kaa Mawu be mi nguɔ woe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
A maa bu mi fɔ kɛ̃; mɛni he je mɔ lɛ ma gbo dengme yaka?
Jale ko jale ko be nɛ ma nyɛ ma fɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ.
Mawu ma sake mi kɛ wo muɔ mi, nɛ ye he zo maa pee imi nitsɛ ye tadehi.
Nɔmlɔ adesa ji Mawu kaa imi jinɛ i ko ha lɛ heto, jinɛ i kɛ lɛ ko ya kojomi he ɔ nɛ wa ya hla munyu ɔ mi.
Se sane he buálɔ ko be; nɔ ko be nɛ maa kojo Mawu kɛ nɔmlɔ a kpɛti.
Mawu nɛ jɔɔ ye tue gblami; e kpa ye he gbeye womi.
I yi lɛ gbeye.
Ma tu munyu, ejakaa i le bɔ nɛ ye tsui mi ngɛ.
Je mi himi ba gbe ye nya; jehanɛ, bu ye sane ɔ tue.
Mawu, koo bu mi fɔ.
Mɛni i pee, loko o kɛ mi ngɛ sane yee kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Imi nɔmlɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o bɔ ɔ, anɛ e da ha mo kaa o wa mi yi mi, nɛ o hie mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi mi tomi yayami ɔmɛ lɛɛ o bua nɛ jɔ he lo?
Anɛ nimli adesahi a hɛngmɛ lɛ ngɛ o dɛ?
Anɛ o hyɛɛ nɔ́ kaa nɔmlɔ lo?
Anɛ o wami be ɔ ngɛ kpiti kaa nɔmlɔ nɔ́ lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o ngɛ ye tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ a se die kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
O le kaa i yi fɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hu be nɛ ma kpɔ mi kɛ je o dɛ mi.
O ninehi nɛ o kɛ bɔ mi ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o ngɔ jamɛ a nine ɔmɛ nɔuu kɛ ngɛ ye hɛ mi kpatae.
Kai kaa tabo zu lɛ o kɛ bɔ mi.
Anɛ o ma ha nɛ ma plɛ pee zu ekohu lo?
O ha tsaatsɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ fɔ mi; o ha nɛ i wa ngɛ maa mi mi.
O kɛ wu kɛ pani pee ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ lo, kɛ he womi kɛ ha he.
O dloo mi wami, o hyɛɛ ye nɔ daa, nɛ o suɔmi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i le kaa o ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ to o yi mi; nɛ daa nɛ ɔ o ngɛ ga toe nɛ o kɛ ye mi awi.
Ke i pee yayami ko ɔ, kɛkɛ o ngma kɛ to, nɛ o kɛ be mi pae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ke i pee yayami ɔ, musu tloo mi.
Ke i pee nɔ́ nɛ da tete po, haomi kɛ zo ha we nɛ ma nyɛ ma wo ye yi nɔ.
Ke níhi a mi hi ha mi bɔɔ ɔ, o nyɛɛɔ ye se kaa jata.
O guu nyakpɛ blɔhi a nɔ, nɛ o kɛ yeɔ mi awi.
Daa nɛ ɔ, o yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mi.
Daa nɛ ɔ, o mi mi fuɔ mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, o toɔ ga he nɛ o kɛ ye mi awi.
Mawu, mɛni he je kulaa lɛ o ha nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ?
I na nɛ i plɛ ye se ngɛ muɔ nɔ.
Kaa a ngɔ mi kɛ je maa mi mi ya wo yɔkɔ mi amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, jinɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a fɔ we mi kɛ̃.
Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ɔ, pi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ piɛ lo?
Ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ ma na bua jɔmi bɔɔ!
Ma hia blɔ be kpiti mi kɛ ya he ko nɛ i be kpalee kɛ ba hu.
I yaa ma ko nɔ; lejɛ ɔ wo diblii kpii, nɛ e ngɛ gbeyegbeye.
Lejɛ ɔ ngɛ gbeyegbeye, kɛ basabasa; nɛ piani po woɔ diblii kaa nyɔ mi.
Zofar -Nɔ ko be munyuhi babauu nɛ ɔmɛ a heto hae lo?
Anɛ munyu tumi babauu woɔ nɔ nguɔ lo?
Hiob, munyuhi nɛ o ngɛ tue putɛputɛɛ ɔ, o susu kaa jamɛ munyu ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ wa ma wa nya lo?
Ke o ngɛ nihi a he fɛu yee ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ ko pue o hɛ mi si lo?
O deɔ ke anɔkuale munyuhi o ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ; o deɔ ke dalɔ ji mo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
I na nɛ Mawu pa e nya mi nɛ e ha mo heto.
Jinɛ Mawu maa tu mo nile mi laami munyuhi; e ma de mo ke níhi babauu ngɛ je mi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa juɛmi sui he.
Na nɛ o le kaa Mawu gbla we o tue bɔ nɛ sa mo; o yayami ɔmɛ hiɛ kulaa pe tue gblami ɔ. Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa na Mawu níhi nɛ a mi kuɔ a nya kɛ pi si lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa na Mawu Ope ɔ nya tami he lo?
Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe se lokoo, se moo lɛɛ hiɔwe ɔ po o juɛmi sui he.
Mawu le gbogboehi a je, se moo lɛɛ o li lejɛ ɔ. Ke a susu Mawu he wami kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ kpa susuɔ nɔ́ ɔ, Mawu he wami ka pe je ɔ, nɛ e bli pe wo.
Ke Mawu ba nu mo nɛ e kɛ mo ba kojomi he ɔ, mɛnɔ maa tsi e nya?
Mawu le yaka nimli.
Ke e na ní yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, anɛ e be a tue gblae lo?
Ke nga mi tejihi a hɛ mi ba si ɔ, kuasiahi maa le nɔ.
Hiob, tsake o tsui, nɛ o bua o nine nya nɛ o fa kue ha Mawu.
Mo nitsɛ mo kpa yayami peemi, nɛ o hyɛ nɛ a ko pee yi wu tso ní ngɛ o we ɔ mi.
Ke yayami ko be o he nɛ ma ble mo ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko o maa pi si ngɛ Mawu mi, nɛ o be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye yee.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a se maa po kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ ba be be ko; nɛ o be mɛ kaie hu.
O wami he ma tsɔ heii pe piani; diblii be po maa hi kaa mɔtu.
O maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ hɛ nɔ kami mi; Mawu maa baa o yi, nɛ e ma ha mo he jɔmi.
Ke o hwɔ si ɔ, o be gbeye yee; nihi babauu ma ba bi yemi kɛ buami ngɛ o dɛ.
Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a maa na kaa a yi ta pɛ; he ko he ko be nɛ a maa tu fo kɛ ya.
Nɔ́ nɛ blɔ nɛ a maa hyɛ kɛkɛ ji gbenɔ.
Hiob -Niinɛ, nyɛ ji ma a nɛ.
Ke nyɛ gbo kɛkɛ nile hu gbo.
Se imi hu i ngɛ juɛmi kaa nyɛ nɔuu; nyɛ pi mi kɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ li?
I plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha ye huɛmɛ; a ngɛ mi muɔe, pohu dalɔ ji mi; tɔmi be ye he.
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, ke i fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, e buɔ mi tue.
Nyɛ ngɛ ye he fɛu yee, ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ miɔ nɛ maa nɔ si ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ lɛ nɔ́ fiae.
Ojo fiali, kɛ nihi nɛ woɔ Mawu mi mi la a, a ngɛ tue mi jɔmi si himi mi; mɛ po nɛ a he wami ji a mawu ɔ. Nyɛɛ ya lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ a ngɔ; nyɛɛ ya lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ní.
Adebɔ níhi nɛ ngɛ wo mi kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya bi mɛ nile.
Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ti mɛnɔ lɛ li kaa Mawu lɛ pee enɛ ɔ lo?
Níhi nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle tsuo, Mawu lɛ ha mɛ wami; nimli adesahi tsuo a wami ngɛ Mawu dɛ mi.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ tue hyɛɛ munyu mi, nɛ lilɛ hu saa niye ní nya hyɛɛ ɔ, nimeli ngɛ nile; nihi nɛ a wami se kɛ ɔ, a ngɛ juɛmi.
Se Mawu lɛɛ e nɔ́ ji nile, kɛ he wami; e ngɛ juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.
Ke Mawu ku nɔ́ ko kɛ pue si ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa ma ekohu?
Ke e nga nɔ ko yi kɛ wo tsu mi ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma bli lɛ?
Ke Mawu tsi hiɔmi nya, kɛkɛ zugba gbli; ke e bli nyu nya, kɛkɛ pa hia lalaala ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Mawu he wa, nɛ e le ní; nɔ sisilɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ a sisi lɛ tsuo e níhi ji mɛ.
E kpɔɔ nile ngɛ ga woli a dɛ, nɛ e haa kojoli plɛɔ peeɔ kuasiahi.
E kpaa matsɛmɛ, nɛ e haa nɛ a plɛɔ peeɔ pamitsɛmɛ.
E baa osɔfohi si, nɛ e butuu ni nɛmɛ nɛ he wami ngɛ a dɛ.
Nihi nɛ a buu ɔ, e kpɔɔ munyu tumi he wami ngɛ a dɛ; nimeli hu e kpɔɔ a nile ɔ ngɛ a dɛ.
E pueɔ ganɔhi a hɛ mi si, nɛ e haa a he wami ɔ se poɔ.
E jeɔ nyakpɛ níhi kpo kɛ jeɔ laami hehi, nɛ e haa la tsoɔ ngɛ hehi nɛ wo diblii kpii.
E haa je mahi he wami, nɛ e kpaleɔ kpataa a hɛ mi.
E haa nɛ mahi bɔɔ, nɛ e kpaleɔ gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩaa.
E haa je ma amɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli jeɔ kuasia, nɛ a ya woɔ lalaalo ngɛ nga nɔ he nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko be.
A hii dedee, nɛ a hii si tataae ngɛ diblii mi kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.
-Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ, i na, nɛ i nu hyɛ; i nu lɛ tsuo sisi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, imi hu i le; nyɛ pi mi.
Imi lɛɛ Mawu Ope ɔ lɛ i kɛ na, se pi nyɛ; ma suɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ wa hla níhi a nya.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ pe nyɛ poɔ sane deɔ; nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ kaa tsopatsɛmɛ nɛ a he be se nami.
I na nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ nya mohu, jinɛ a ko tsɛ nyɛ ní leli.
Nyɛɛ bu ye sane ɔ tue, konɛ nyɛɛ na bɔ nɛ ma je ye nya ha.
Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lakpa yee?
Nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ lakpa a he maa ba se nami ha Mawu lo?
Mawu he lɛ nyɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ?
Nyɛ maa ye e sane ɔ ha lɛ lo?
Ke Mawu ke e ma hla nyɛ níhi a mi fitsofitso ɔ, anɛ e maa hi ha nyɛ lo?
Anɛ nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ maa sisi Mawu kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ sisiɔ nimli adesahi lo?
Ke nyɛ hyɛɛ nimli a hɛ mi ngɛ laami mi ɔ, e ma ka nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ̃.
E he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ maa wo nyɛ he gbeye, nɛ sawale maa nu nyɛ.
Abɛhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bue ɔ, a he be se nami ko; munyuhi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ Mawu he fae ɔ ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.
Nyɛɛ pee dii nɛ ma tu munyu, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ye nɔ nɛ ba.
E wɛ ha mi kaa ma ngɔ ye wami kɛ ha ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e maa gbe mi sa; i be hɛ nɔ kami ko.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma fa ye he ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ nɔuu ma he ye yi wami, ejakaa yayami peelɔ ko be nyɛe maa ba Mawu hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ bu mi tue saminya, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ nɛ sɛ nyɛ tue mi.
Jehanɛ, i dla ye he konɛ ma jaje ye sane ɔ, ejakaa i le kaa i yeɔ nguɔ.
Mɛnɔ lɛ ma ye nya pomi ɔ?
Mo Mawu lo?
Ke ja a, lɛɛ ma pee dii nɛ ma gbo mohu.
Ha nɛ ma bi mo nɔ́ enyɔ pɛ, nɛ o ha mi, kɛkɛ i be ye he laae ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Kpa ye tue gblami, kɛ ye he gbeye womi.
Mawu, moo tu munyu kekle, konɛ ma he nɔ; aloo ke o suɔ ɔ, imi ma de kekle, konɛ moo o he nɔ.
Mɛni ji ye he yayami ɔmɛ?
Mɛni tɔmihi nɛ i pee?
Tsɔɔ mi ye yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ ye tɔmi ɔmɛ.
Mɛni he je o kɛ o hɛ mi laa mi ɔ?
Mɛni he je o kɛ mi ngɛ ní toe kaa o he nyɛlɔ ɔ?
O ngɛ hlae nɛ o wo ye he gbeye lo?
Imi lɛɛ i ngɛ kaa ba kɛkɛ; tsakati gbigbli se lɛ o ngɛ nyɛe ɔ nɛ.
O po ye nya wawɛɛ nitsɛ; yayamihi nɛ i pee ye nihe be mi hu o ngɔ kɛ piɛ he.
O ngɔ ye nanehi kɛ wo pã mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ, o ngɛ hyɛe; ye nane nya po o hyɛɛ fitsofitso.
I pee kaa tso nɛ sa, nɛ hule nɔ si, aloo bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye.
Nɔmlɔ adesa wami be ngɛ kpiti kɛkɛ, se e mi haomi hiɛ babauu.
Nɔmlɔ waa esɔesɔ, nɛ e gboɔ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ mɔmɔ hu puɛɔ nɛ e nglaa a. E ngɛ kaa nini; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e laa nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu.
Anɛ o kɛ imi, nɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ maa ye sane lo?
Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko ngɛ nɛ he tsɔ kɛ pi si lo?
Dɛbi!
Nɔ ko be.
Nɔmlɔ adesa wami se kɛmi, kɛ hlami abɔ nɛ e maa ye ngɛ je mi ɔ, a to ngɔ fɔ si momo.
Mo nitsɛ o ma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nya si momo, nɛ e be hie tsakemi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je o hɛ ngɛ e he nɛ e na he jɔmi.
Ha nɛ e na bua jɔmi bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ ngɛ e si himi nɛ he wa nɛ ɔ mi.
Ke a po tso ngɔ fɔ si ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ kaa e ma tsɛ̃ ekohu; ejakaa e hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a gbo we.
Ke sipoku ɔmɛ a se kɛ ngɛ zu mi, nɛ tso ku ɔ sa tete po, ke tso ɔ na nyu ɔ, e ma tsɛ̃ ekohu, nɛ e ma gba kɔni kaa tso nɛ a du ehe.
Se nɔmlɔ lɛɛ ke e gbo ɔ, e nyagbe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔmlɔ adesa gbo ɔ, jije o maa na lɛ ngɛ ekohu?
Kaa bɔ nɛ taku mi nyu taa, nɛ pa mi nyu miiɔ nɛ e gbliɔ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ nɔmlɔ adesa hwɔɔ mahe, nɛ e ti si hu.
E be si tee hu, nɛ kɛ yaa si be mi nɛ hiɔwe be hu ɔ, a be lɛ tsɛ̃ɛ̃e hu kɔkɔɔkɔ.
I na nɛ o ngɔ mi ya laa ngɛ gbeje kɛ yaa si o mi mi fumi ɔ se maa po; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o maa to be nɛ a kɛ ma kai mi.
Ke nɔmlɔ gbo ɔ, e kpaleɔ kɛ baa ekohu jinɛ i ko mlɛ kɛ yaa si ye haomi be nɛ ɔ se maa po, nɛ be kpakpa ma ba na mi.
Jinɛ o ma tsɛ mi, nɛ ma he nɔ, nɛ o ma na imi, nɔmlɔ nɛ o bɔ ɔ, ye he bua jɔmi.
Jinɛ o maa hyɛ ye nyɛɛmi, nɛ o be ye he yayami ɔmɛ a se die.
O kɛ ye he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa mi, nɛ o maa ngmɛɛ he kulaa.
Tɔmihi babauu nɛ i pee ɔ, o maa gbe lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se, kaa bɔ nɛ yohi tete po huleɔ kɛ nɔɔ si, nɛ tɛ sahi jeɔ a blɔ hehi; kaa bɔ nɛ nyu haa tɛ yeɔ, nɛ pa nɛ hia muɔɔ tabo zu kɛ yaa a, jã nɛ o haa nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa hɛ nɔ kami peeɔ yaka.
Ke o fia lɛ nɔ́, kɛkɛ e hɛ mi tsake; kɛkɛ a wo lɛ blɔ, nɛ e be bae hu gblegbleegble.
Ke e gbo ɔ, e bimɛ a hɛ mi ba nyami jio, e bimɛ a hɛ mi pue si jio, e li.
Lɛ nitsɛ e he lo ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e nuu he kaa e ngɛ lɛ yee; nɛ e yeɔ kɔmɔ.
Ní sɛɛmi enyɔne Elifaz -Ní lelɔ pee we nya puu!
Ní lelɔ ha we sane heto kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ní lelɔ tu we munyu kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ munyu tue ɔ. Ní lelɔ fa we e he kɛ munyu nɛ he be se nami.
E je mo nɔ kake o he jinɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be Mawu gbeye yee hu; jinɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be kue fae ha lɛ hu.
Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ yeɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ a he odase; lakpa sɔuu lɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ nɛ.
Mo nitsɛ o nya mi munyu ngɛ mo fɔ bue; mo nitsɛ o lilɛ ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ mo sie, se pi imi.
Mo ji kekleekle nɔmlɔ nɛ a fɔ lo?
A fɔ mo loko Mawu pee yoku ɔmɛ lo?
O nu Mawu laami sanehi hyɛ lo?
Mo pɛ ji ní lelɔ lo?
Mɛni o le nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa li?
Mɛni o kpa si nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa juɛmi sui he?
Nihi nɛ a yi mi je mua, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi ngɛ wa kpɛti nɛ a wa kulaa pe o tsɛ.
Bua jɔmi nɛ Mawu ha mo ɔ, e pi ha mo lo?
Bɔ nɛ e kɛ mo tuɔ munyu blɛuu ɔ, lɔ ɔ sɛ́ o hɛ mi lo?
Mɛni he je o mi mi fu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o hɛ dɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o mi mi fu Mawu, nɛ o ha nɛ munyuhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ je o nya mi?
Anɛ nɔmlɔ ko ngɛ nɛ e he tsɔ lo?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ yo fɔ lɛ ɔ, anɛ dalɔ ji lɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi lo?
Hyɛ, Mawu bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ po e kɛ e hɛ fɔ we a nɔ; mɛ nitsɛmɛ tete po a he tsɔ we ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Nɛ mo, nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ o sa, nɛ se nami be o he ɔ!
Mo nɛ o peeɔ yayami kaa bɔ nɛ a nuu nyu kumakuma a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ moo o he ma tsɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hiob, bu tue nɛ ma sɛɛ mo nɔ́ nɛ i le.
Ha ma tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ i kase kɛ je ní leli a ngɔ.
I kase anɔkuale nɛ ɔ kɛ je ní leli a ngɔ.
Mɛ hu a kase kɛ je a tsɛmɛ a ngɔ; a laa we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɔ.
Mɛ pɛ lɛ a ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha; nubwɔ ko nubwɔ ko be a kpɛti.
Yiwutsotsɛ, nɔ nɛ waa nihi yi mi ɔ, e maa na nɔ́ e wami be ɔ tsuo.
E tue mi maa hi ngmlɛ fiae kɛ wo e he gbeye.
Be mi nɛ e susu kaa e ngɛ he jɔmi mi ɔ, ojo fiali ma ba tua lɛ tlukaa.
Hɛ nɔ kami ko be ha lɛ kaa e maa tu fo kɛ je diblii ɔ mi; ejakaa klaate ji nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ mlɛe nɛ e gbe lɛ, nɛ okpokuhi hu ngɛ mlɛe nɛ a ye lɛ.
Nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ le kaa e hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ su ta.
Fimi kɛ amanehlu woɔ e he gbeye.
E le kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba e nɔ tlukaa kaa matsɛ ngua ko nɛ mia kɛ ha ta.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ Ope ɔ, nɛ hiaa kɔ̃ kɛ woɔ Mawu he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
-Jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ, he nɔ wolɔ, kɛ atuã tsɔlɔ ji lɛ; e kɛ he nɔ womi woɔ e tsɛ̃i nɔ, nɛ e he sɔɔ nɛ e kɛ Mawu ya hwu ta.
Jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ ya ngɔ mahi, kɛ wehi nɛ nɔtsɛmɛ tu fo kɛ je a mi.
Se a de to kaa ta ma kpata jamɛ a ma amɛ, kɛ we ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
E ní nami ɔ se be kɛe; e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Lɛ nitsɛ e nini tete po maa laa, nɛ diblii maa wo lɛ.
E maa pee kaa tso nɛ la sã e kɔnihi, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ e mɔmɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho.
Ke e ya sisi e he, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ níhi nɛ a he be se nami a nɔ ɔ, e maa je mi dɛ gu.
Loko e nyagbe ɔ maa su ɔ, e ma na e hiɔwo sisiisi; e maa pee kaa tso nɛ ba mumu be e yi mi.
E maa pee kaa wai tso nɛ e yi mi wai yiblii ngmlikiti kplɔ pue si, aloo oliv tso nɛ e mɔmɔhi kplɔ pue si.
Nimli nɛ li Mawu ɔ, a be ngmɛdu woe.
Wehi nɛ a he nyɔ mi ní nɛ a kɛ ma mɛ ɔ, la maa sã mɛ pue si.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ toɔ ga yaya, nɛ a peeɔ yayami; sisimi hyi a tsui mi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Hiob -I nu munyuhi babauu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ; ye bua nɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ma womi ɔ, haomi mohu lɛ nyɛ ba ngɛ mi haoe.
Nyɛ maa hi yaka munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue nɛ nyɛ be kpae lo?
Mɛni hiɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ nyɛ maa hi munyu tue kpamisa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, imi hu i ko de ja nɔuu.
I ko mimiɛ ye yi, nɛ ma ha nyɛ munyu nguahi.
Jinɛ ma wo nyɛ ga, nɛ ma tu munyu kɛ wo nyɛ bua.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i tu munyu jio, i ma ye nya jio, haomi kake too ɔ mi lɛ i ngɛ kpamisa.
Mawu, jehanɛ lɛɛ o ha nɛ pɔ tɔ mi; o gbe ye he nihi tsuo ta.
O ha nɛ ye he womi tsuo hlũɛ, nɛ i ta he lo, nɛ enɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mi.
Mawu mi mi fu mi, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ ye mi.
E kpɔ lungu ngɔ wo mi, nɛ e muɔ e hɛngmɛ ngɔ pue ye nɔ kaa a peeɔ nɔ he nyɛlɔ.
Nihi yeɔ ye he fɛu.
A buaa kɛ woɔ ye he, nɛ a gbaa ye tue mi ma.
Nɛ a bɔɔ mi ahlua.
Mawu ngɔ mi ngɔ ha nihi nɛ li Mawu; e ngɔ mi ngɔ wo yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
Jinɛ i ngɛ he mi jɔmi, se Mawu tsɔtslɔɔ ye mi.
Mawu nu ye kuɛ, nɛ e ku mi dukuduku.
E je hɛ pi mi kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ maa kase dɛ nya dami.
E tsɛ̃ɔ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ jeɔ he tsuaa he.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ sɛɛ ye he womi mi, nɛ a plaa mi; se Mawu nɛ mi mɔbɔ.
E he sɔɔ kɛ ba tuaa mi nɔtonɔto, nɛ e plaa mi kaa tatsɛ nɛ hɛ dɔ.
I kpɛ kpekpe ngɔ ha ye he, nɛ i hii si ngɛ zugba kɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
I fo ya hluu kɛ ya si ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ fuu nɛ a pee kɔu kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ́ ko ha a nɔ.
Se i yi nɔ ko amimi; i faa kue haa Mawu kɛ jeɔ ye tsui mi.
Zugba, yayamihi nɛ a pee mi ɔ, koo ha a nɔ!
Ngmlaa nɛ i ngɛ kpae kaa a ye dami sane ha mi ɔ, ko ha nɛ ngmlaa a nya nɛ ba si!
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po, ye we odase ngɛ hiɔwe; nɔ nɛ ma fa ye he ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.
Ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu, se i faa kue haa Mawu kɛ vo nyu.
I na nɛ nɔ ko ma fa ye he ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa faa e nyɛmi he ɔ. Jehahi bɔɔ komɛ a se ɔ, ma hia blɔ kɛ ya he ko nɛ i be kpalee kɛ ba hu.
Ye wami be ɔ ta; i nyɛ we nɛ i ngɛ mumi woe.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi mlɛe ji yɔkɔ.
He fɛu yeli bɔle mi kɛ kpe; niinɛ, i naa mɛ nɛ a hii ye he fɛu yee.
Mawu, anɔkualetsɛ ji mi; mo he mi nɛ o ye.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, nɔ kpa ko be nɛ ma fi se.
O ha nɛ nimli adesahi biɛ, nɛ a susuu we a yi mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko ha nɛ a ye ye nɔ.
Nimeli ke, “Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ e huɛmɛ a se blɔ, nɛ e nine suu a weto ní nɔ ɔ, e bimɛ a hɛngmɛ ma yu.” Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i plɛ pee abɛ bumi nɔ́ ha nihi, nɛ a laa lada kɛ pueɔ ye hɛ mi.
Aywilɛho sɔuu ha nɛ ye hɛngmɛ nɔ pee kɔu, nɛ ye kɔnihi, kɛ ye nanehi pee legelege kaa nini.
Ke dali na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a he mi jɔ̃ɔ̃, nɛ a tuɔ a hɛ mi kɛ woɔ nihi nɛ li Mawu.
Se bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, dalɔ hii e blɔ nɔ kɛ̃.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ yayami ko be e he ɔ, e naa he wami he ekohu.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, i nɛ ní lelɔ kake ngmelu ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ kpɛti.
Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ta; ye yi mi tomi ɔmɛ puɛ; ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ ta.
Se ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ nyɔ kɛ peeɔ piani.
La a nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ hu ngɛ kaa diblii.
Ye hɛ nɔ kami kɛkɛ ji gbeje; lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ ma hwɔ ngɛ diblii mi.
Ma tsɛ yɔkɔ ɔ ke tsaatsɛ; gɔgɔhi nɛ maa ye mi ɔ, ma tsɛ mɛ maa, kɛ ye nyɛmiyihi.
Jije hɛ nɔ kami pa ngɛ ha mi?
Mɛnɔ lɛ maa na jamɛ a hɛ nɔ kami ɔ?
Anɛ hɛ nɔ kami kɛ mi maa ya gbeje lo?
Anɛ e kɛ mi maa ya zu mi lo?
Bildad -Hiob, mɛni be lɛ o maa hi munyu tue kɛ yaa si?
Ke o pee dii ɔ, waa kɛ mo maa tu munyu.
Mɛni he je a buɔ wɔ kaa lohwehi ɔ?
Mɛni he je o susuɔ kaa wa be juɛmi ɔ?
Nɛ o ngɔ abofu kɛ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he tsɔtslɔɔe ɔ nɛɛ!
Ke o mi mi fu ɔ, enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ a je je ɔ mi lo?
Aloo o ngɛ hlae nɛ a hia tɛ sahi kɛ je a blɔ hehi lo?
Ee, yayami peelɔ kane ɔ ma gbo, nɛ e la a be kpɛe hu gblegbleegble.
E kane ɔ ma gbo ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ e bo tsu ɔ mi maa wo diblii.
Bɔ nɛ e hiaa nane kam, kam, kam be ko nɛ be ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e hii si tɛe; lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi maa tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ nɔ si.
Lɛ nitsɛ e maa ngɔ e nane kɛ ya du ya; lɛ nitsɛ e maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya nɔ muɔ mi.
E nane se ja ma ya sɛ klama mi, nɛ klama a maa nu lɛ.
A maa tsɔ̃ lɛ klama kɛ laa ngɛ zugba; a maa tsɔ̃ lɛ klama ngɛ e blɔ mi.
Gbeye níhi maa bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e maa hi fo nɔ kpla, kpla, kpla!
Hwɔ maa ye lɛ hluu kɛ yaa si e he wami maa ta.
Amanehlu maa tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ fɔ si bum!
Hiɔ yaya maa ha e he womi tsuo nɔ, nɛ e kɔnihi, kɛ e nanehi maa sa ngɛ e he.
E bo tsu ɔ nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, a maa gbla lɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba he ko nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be piɛe ngɛ e sihi he ɔ.
La nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam maa sã e bo tsu ɔ. E sipoku ma gbli ngɛ e sisi, nɛ e kɔnihi maa ylɔ.
E biɛ maa laa ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ ma se tsuo, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lɛ kaie hu.
A maa fie lɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi, kɛ je la he kɛ ya diblii mi.
E be bi, loo nina ngɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti; he nɛ e hi be ko ɔ, e nina ko be lejɛ ɔ. Kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa si bonyoku je ɔ; nihi nɛ maa nu e haomi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a he mi maa po.
Yayami peelɔ, aloo nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Hiob -Mɛni be nyɛ maa ngɔ munyuhi kɛ hao mi kɛ yaa si?
Kpamisa nɛ ɔ, jɛmi kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi jɛe.
Anɛ e pee we nyɛ zo kaa nyɛ ngɛ mi nisɛ ní pee lo?
Ke e ngɛ mi tete po kaa i pee yayami ɔ, mɛni enɛ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ he?
Nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ hi pe mi.
Nyɛ deɔ ke ye yayami ɔmɛ a he hiɔ lɛ a ngɛ mi woe ɔ nɛ.
Se nyɛ li kaa Mawu lɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ lo?
Lɛ nɛ tsɔ klama kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe.
Hyɛ, i kpaa ngmlaa nɛ i deɔ ke Mawu ngɛ mi awi yee, se nɔ ko nɔ ko he we nɔ.
Ngmlaa nɛ i ngɛ kpae ke a ye dami sane ha mi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nui.
Mawu tsi mi blɔ nɛ i nyɛ we ma be; e ha nɛ diblii wo ngɛ ye blɔ nɔ.
E je ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ ye he, nɛ e kpɔ ye jlasi ɔ ngɛ ye yi mi.
E kpata ye hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ mi gbe nya pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
I pee kaa tso nɛ a hia lɛ kɛ e sipoku tsuo; ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ta.
Mawu mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e buɔ mi e he nyɛlɔ.
E ta buli babauu ba tua mi; a bɔle mi kɛ kpe, nɛ a sa ye yi kɛ wo ye sihi he ɔ. Mawu ha nɛ ye nyɛmimɛ kua mi; i plɛ pee nubwɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ i le mɛ ɔ a kpɛti.
Ye weku li je ye he, nɛ ye huɛ kpakpahi a hɛ je ye nɔ.
Nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ ye we mi ɔ, a hɛ je ye nɔ; i plɛ pee nubwɔ, loo ma se no ngɛ ye mawayihi a hɛ mi.
Ke i tsɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ, e he we nɔ; ke i kpa lɛ pɛɛ tete po, e bui.
Ye nya mi mumi jeɔ fu kɛ haa ye yo; imi nitsɛ ye nyɛ mi mi bimɛ bɛ ye kasa nya.
Jokuɛwi tete po hiee mi; ke a na mi pɛ, kɛkɛ a bɔni ye he munyu tumi.
Ye huɛmɛ kpakpahi tsuo ngɛ mi hiee; ni nɛmɛ nɛ i suɔ mɛ saminya po te si wo mi.
I ta he lo nɛ i pee kanyakanya; i kɛ gbenɔ wa kpɛti kɛ we kulaa.
Nyɛɛ na mi mɔbɔ; ye huɛmɛ nyɛɛ na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa Mawu nine sa ye he.
Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu peeɔ mi ɔ?
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ hao mi ɔ, e pi ha nyɛ lo?
Níhi nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, i na nɛ nɔ ko kai nɛ e ngma kɛ wo womi mi!
I ná nɛ a kɛ dade kpɛ́ ye munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ tɛ sa mi, nɛ a kɛ sumui wo mi, konɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ daa.
Ejakaa i le kaa nɔ ko ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ nyagbenyagbe ɔ, e ma ba kpɔ mi.
Ke ye he womi hɛ mi kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ he lo ko be ye he po, ma na Mawu.
Imi nitsɛ na lɛ paa kɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
Imi nitsɛnitsɛ, se pi nɔ kpa ko.
Ye tsui ta!
Benɛ nyɛ bi ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ kɛ wa lɛ yi mi?” ɔ, nyɛ hla nɔ ko nyɛ da nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba tua mi.
Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa tue gblami fɔɔ si ha nyɛ.
A maa gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a he, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa kojolɔ ko ngɛ.
Zofar -Hiob, o ha nɛ ye yi mi pee basaa, enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma ha mo heto nɔuu.
Jɛmi munyuhi lɛ o tu ɔ nɛ, se mumi ɔ tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ ma ha mo heto ha.
I heɔ yeɔ kaa o le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kaa kɛ je blema lokoo nɛ a bɔ nɔmlɔ kɛ wo je ɔ mi ɔ, yiwutsotsɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, e se kɛ we; nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ, e bua jɔmi peeɔ kuku kɛkɛ.
Ke e nɔ kuɔ kɛ ya su hiɔwe, nɛ e yi ya pi bɔku po, e hɛ mi ma kpata kɛ maa ya neneene kaa lɛ nitsɛ e fĩ.
Nihi nɛ le lɛ ɔ ma bi ke, “Jije e ngɛ?” E maa laa kaa nlami, aloo nina nɛ a na nyɔ mi; nɛ nɔ ko be lɛ nae hu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lɛ nae hu; e sihi he ɔ maa fɔ si gu.
Níhi nɛ e ju ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a dɛ ɔ, e bimɛ maa kpale kɛ ha mɛ ekohu.
Nɔmlɔ tso kɛ e he nihe nyu tsuaa a ma plɛ pee zu.
-Yayami ngɔɔ e nya.
E ngɛ kaa dɔkɔdɔkɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ngɔ kɛ laa ngɛ e lilɛ kuɔ si.
E hii he gbugbɔe, nɛ e sume kaa e ma je ngɛ e nya mi.
Se niye ní nɛ ɔ plɛɔ peeɔ sinɔ duɔ nɛ nya wa ngɛ e mi mi.
Ní kpakpahi nɛ yayami peelɔ mi ɔ, e vieɔ kɛ pueɔ si ekohu.
Mawu nitsɛ jeɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ jeɔ e mi mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ yayami peelɔ gbugbɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔ; e maa gbe lɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ sinɔ duɔtsɛ nɛ kɔ lɛ.
E be je mi hie nɛ́ e maa na nyɔ nyu, kɛ hwo nɛ ngɛ bee kaa paa.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e gbo he dengme nɛ e na a maa je e dɛ, nɛ e be e mi ngɔɔmi ko yee.
E be bua jɔmi ko nae kɛ je e ní nɛ e na a mi.
Ejakaa e wa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi, nɛ e kua mɛ; wehi nɛ nihi ma a, e kpɔ ngɛ a dɛ pani nya.
Akɛnɛ e li tɔ biɛ he je ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e na a, e yeɔ tsuatsuaatsua.
Ke e ye ní ɔ, eko kulaa píɛ ngɛ se.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ní nami ɔ se maa po.
Be mi nɛ e na e he ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, haomi nɛ nya wa maa ba e nɔ tlukaa.
Mawu ma ha e mi mi la nɛ nya wa a ma kple e nɔ kaa niye ní nɛ e ye nɛ e tɔ.
Ke e ka kaa e maa tu fo kɛ je dade nya a, a ma tsɛ̃ lɛ akɔblee kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ fɔ si.
A maa gbla kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kɛ je e nɔmlɔ tso mi.
Muɔ maa dɛ kɛ je kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ nya piɔpiɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ he kɛ pue si, nɛ gbeye maa nu lɛ.
E juetli tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata.
La, nɛ pi nɔmlɔ nɛ slɛ maa sã lɛ, nɛ e we mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Hiɔwe ma je nyumu nɛ ɔ yayami ɔ kpo, nɛ zugba maa ye odase kɛ si lɛ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu mi mi ma fu ɔ, a ma kpata nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ weto ní tsuo hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ pa muɔɔ níhi kɛ yaa a. Enɛ ɔ ji yayami peelɔ blɔ fa mi nɔ́; gbosi ní nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha yayami peelɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Hiob -Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de nɛ ɔ tue saminya; ke nyɛ pee ja a, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ba jɔɔ ye bua.
Nyɛɛ ngmɛ mi blɔ nɛ imi hu ma tu munyu; ke i de nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ ta a, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ye he fɛu faa.
Imi ɔ, tsa pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ i kɛ na; i kɛ Mawu lɛ na.
Mɛni he je e sɛ kaa ye susuma haoɔ mɔ?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ mi ha!
Anɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ ha we nɛ nyɛ he mi nɛ po, nɛ nyɛɛ pee dii lo?
Nɔ́ nɛ ba ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, ke i susu he ɔ, ye he mi poɔ, nɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ doɔ blibliibli.
Mɛni he je yayami peeli a se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi?
Mɛni he je a peeɔ nimli nguahi, nɛ a bwɔɔ kotokoto loko a gboɔ ɔ?
A hii je mi kɛ ya siɔ a bimɛ, kɛ a bibimɛ waa ba naa mɛ.
Mawu ngɔɛ haomi ko kɛ bɛ a wehi a mi; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko wui a he gbeye.
Niinɛ, a na ku ɔmɛ, kɛ na yi ɔmɛ naa bɔmi pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ na yi ɔmɛ fɔɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko pee we mɛ.
A bi tsɔwitsɔwihi jeɔ kpo babauu nɛ a hii hlue kaa to bihi.
A fiɛɔ do, a fiaa saku, nɛ a laa kɛ toɔ he; nɛ a naa bua jɔmi bɔ nɛ sa.
A yeɔ a be ɔ ngɛ kplɔkɔtɔ mi, nɛ a gboɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Yayami peeli deɔ Mawu ke e je a nɔ, ejakaa a hla we e blɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a le.
A biɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji Ope ɔ nɛ saa kaa wa sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ?
Ke wa fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, mɛni se wa ma na?” A deɔ ke, “Tsa pi nɔ ko nɛ wo wɔ ní; wɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛ wa tsu nɛ wa na.” Se a susumi nɛ ɔ, imi i ngɔɛ.
Anɛ yayami peelɔ ko kane gbo hyɛ lo?
Anɛ haomi ba a ti nɔ ko nɔ hyɛ lo?
Anɛ Mawu kɛ abofu gbla yayami peelɔ ko tue hyɛ lo?
Anɛ Mawu muɔ yayami peeli kɛ ho hyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ bunyuku, aloo bɔ nɛ ahumi muɔɔ tsakati kɛ yaa a lo?
Nyɛ deɔ ke Mawu gblaa bimɛ a tue ngɛ a tsɛmɛ a he yayamihi a he.
Dɛbi!
Ha nɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ gbla yayami peeli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ a tue, konɛ a na kaa a he yayami ɔmɛ a he lɛ a ngɛ a tue gblae ɔ nɛ.
Ha nɛ yayami peeli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ná a tue gblami ɔ. Ha nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we abofu ɔ nɛ kple mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, anɛ e pa susuɔ bimɛ nɛ e si ngɛ se ɔ a he lo?
Mawu nɛ tsɔɔ nimli nguahi po nile ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa kojo lɛ lo?
-Ni komɛ hii nɔmlɔ tso he wami hluu kɛ ya siɔ a gbenɔ be.
A plɔkeɔ nɛ a peeɔ tɔfutɔfu, nɛ a gboɔ kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Ni komɛ hu gboɔ kɛ aywilɛho nɛ a na we bua jɔmi ko hyɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gboɔ, nɛ a puɔ mɛ ngɛ zu mi, nɛ gɔgɔ ba haa mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Hyɛ, i le nyɛ juɛmi ɔmɛ!
Ga nɛ nyɛ to nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa wa mi yi mi ɔ, i le.
Nyɛ biɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ jije ganɔ ɔ we ɔ ngɛ?
Jije yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a sihi he ɔmɛ ngɛ?” Anɛ nyɛɛ kɛ blɔ hiali sɛɛ we ní lo?
Níhi nɛ a ba deɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɔɛ lo?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke amanehlu ba a, yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ a jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ a he lo?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ma ka yiwutsotsɛ hɛ mi?
Níhi nɛ e peeɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ maa pee lɛ kɛ to nane mi?
Benɛ a hɛɛ lɛ kɛ yaa gɔ ɔ mi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi daa si nɛ a ngɛ e yɔkɔ ɔ he bue.
Nimli babauu nyɛɛɔ e hɛ mi, nɛ babauu hu nyɛɛɔ e se; tabo zu ɔ po peeɔ huyɛhuyɛ ngɛ e nɔ.
Nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ munyu gu ba ngɛ ye bua jɔɔe!
