Hetohi nɛ nyɛ ha mi ɔ, lakpa sɔuu; anɔkuale kake ngmelu be mi.
Ní sɛɛmi etɛne Elifaz - Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko he ngɛ se nami ha Mawu lo?
Ní lelɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nile ɔ he se lɛ e naa.
Ke o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, anɛ Ope ɔ naa bua jɔmi ko ngɛ lɔ ɔ he lo?
Ke sé ko be o he ɔ, anɛ Mawu naa nɔ́ ko ngɛ mi lo?
O susu kaa Mawu gbeye nɛ o yeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he lɛ e ngɛ o hɛ mi kae, nɛ e ngɛ o tue gblae ɔ lo?
Dɛbi, a ngɛ o tue gblae, ejakaa o he yayami ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ; o he yayami ɔ, a li nya.
Ke o nyɛmi hɛɛ mo hiɔ nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e wo mo ɔ, o kpaa bo ngɛ e he, nɛ o haa nɛ e hɛɛɔ e he gu.
Nihi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, o ha we mɛ nyu nɛ a nu; ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ, o ha we mɛ ní nɛ a ye.
Pohu o ngɔ o he wami, kɛ bu nɛ a buu mo ɔ kɛ kpɔ zugba a tsuo.
O fieɔ yalɔyihi kɛ jeɔ o ngɔ kɛ a dɛ mi gu, nɛ awusahi hu o waa mɛ yi mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a tsɔ mo klama kɛ bɔle si, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, sawale nu mo.
Diblii kpii wo mo, nɛ o hyɛ we nɔ́ hu; nyu kpekpemi bɔle mo kɛ kpe.
Niinɛ, Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!
Se dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ, anɛ Mawu lɛɛ e hyɛ we mɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba lɛ a ngɛ lo?
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o biɔ ke, “Mawu ɔ, mɛni e le?
Nɔ nɛ bɔku kpii ha e hɛ mi ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ kojo wɔ kɛɛ?” O susuɔ kaa ke Mawu ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ je ɔ, kɛ hiɔwe a kpe he ɔ, e hyɛ we nɔ́ ngɛ bɔku kpii ɔ mi lo?
Blɔ nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ, o maa nyɛɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ lo?
Loko jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a be maa su ɔ, pa nɛ hia kɛ bee ba sa mɛ kɛ a sipoku tsuo kɛ ho momo.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ kua Mawu, nɛ a biɔ a he ke, “Mɛni Ope ɔ ma nyɛ maa pee wɔ?” Se Mawu ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa a wehi hyi ɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ, imi lɛɛ i sume saasaa!
Ke a ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a tue gblae ɔ, nimli kpakpahi a bua jɔɔ, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ yeɔ a he fɛu.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ a níhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi kpataa, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ, la ba sãã.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hiob, yaa nɛ o kɛ Mawu ya pee kake nɛ o na tue mi jɔmi.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ o maa gu nɛ e maa hi ha mo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Moo kplɛɛ nɛ Mawu nɛ tsɔɔ mo ní, nɛ o ngɔ e munyu ɔmɛ kɛ to o tsui mi.
Ee, ba o he si nɛ o kpale kɛ ya Mawu ngɔ.
Yayamihi tsuo nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ o we ɔ mi ɔ, a kpa peemi.
Mo sake o sika tsu ngɔ fɔ he; o sika tsu kpakpa a, hɛɛ ngɔ pue pa mi, ngɛ tɛhi a kpɛ.
Ha nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ pee o sika tsu; ha nɛ e pee o sika hiɔ kpakpa.
Ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu Ope ɔ nɔ daa, nɛ o maa na kaa e ma ha mo bua jɔmi.
Ke o fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e ma he nɔ, nɛ o maa ye o siwo ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o to o yi mi ke o maa pee ɔ, e maa ba mi ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mo, nɛ la ma kpɛ ngɛ o blɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, Mawu baa lɛ si, se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, Mawu heɔ e yi wami.
Nihi nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ, Mawu heɔ a yi wami.
Mo hu ke o he tsɔ ɔ, Mawu ma he o yi wami ja nɔuu.
Hiob -Mwɔnɛ ɔ hu i kɛ Mawu na ekohu; i ngɛ kɛmɛe, se e ngɛ ye tue gblae kɛ mwɔɔ.
I na nɛ i le he nɛ ma na lɛ ngɛ; i na nɛ i le bɔ nɛ ma pee kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Jinɛ ma ngɔ ye sane ɔ kɛ ya fɔ e hɛ mi, nɛ ma je ye nya bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ.
Ma suɔ nɛ ma le nɔ́ nɛ e ma de, kɛ bɔ nɛ e ma ha mi heto ha.
Anɛ Mawu kɛ mi maa to ní ngɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya lo?
Dɛbi, e maa bu mi tue kɛ̃.
Anɔkualetsɛ ji mi; i kɛ Mawu ma hla níhi a nya; nyagbe ɔ, e maa wo mi nguɔ kɛ̃.
I hla Mawu ngɛ beleku je, se e be lejɛ ɔ; i ba bonyoku je hu, i nɛ lɛ.
I hla lɛ ngɛ omleyi je, se i nɛ lɛ; i kpale kɛ ba leneyi je hu, i nɛ lɛ ja nɔuu.
Se Mawu le blɔ nɛ i nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ; ke e ka mi ɔ, e maa na kaa ye he tsɔ kaa sika tsu.
Mawu blɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔ i nyɛɛɔ daa nɛ; i gba we kɛ yɛ muɔ nɔ, loo hiɔ nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu fa mi ke ma pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ i peeɔ.
I pee we imi nitsɛ ye suɔmi nya ní; Mawu suɔmi nya ní lɛ i peeɔ.
Mawu ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e ngɛ; e tsakee we.
Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma tsake e yi mi tomi?
Nɔ́ nɛ e to ha mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ e ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ; níhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ babauu hu ngɛ e yi mi.
Ke i susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, i yeɔ Mawu gbeye, nɛ ye he doɔ blibliibli ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Mawu ha nɛ ye nine mi jɔ̃; Ope ɔ wo ye he gbeye.
Ejakaa diblii bɔle mi kɛ kpe; diblii kpii ha ye hɛ mi.
Mɛni he je lɛ Ope ɔ to we be nɛ a kɛ maa kojo nihi?
Mɛni he je lɛ e ngɔ be ɔ kɛ laa nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ po?
Nihi hiaa ni komɛ a bunahi kɛ yaa se, konɛ mɛɛ a zugba a nɛ e kle.
A juɔ nihi a tohi nɛ a lɛɛ.
A kpɔɔ awusahi a tejihi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ yalɔyihi lɛɛ a ngɔɔ a na amɛ kɛ toɔ awaba.
A fieɔ ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ jeɔ a blɔ nɔ, nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya buaa a he nya nɛ a laa a he.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya hlaa niye ní ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ haa a bimɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nga mi tejihi ya nuɔ lohwe ngɛ pu mi ba haa a bimɛ ɔ. Ke nihi kpa ní ta a, ohiatsɛmɛ ya kukuɔɔ bibliwi ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ya kukuɔɔ wai yiblii ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ po a wai ngmɔhi a nɔ.
Nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo a hwɔɔ si kɛ a he gu nɛ bo be a he; fĩɛ be hu nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ maa ha a he.
Hiɔmi nɛɛ mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a pɔɔ kpanyaa.
Akɛnɛ a be hi he ko he je ɔ, a hɔɔ tɛ sahi a kpɛ.
Nimli yayami komɛ kpɔɔ bimwɔwi nɛ be tsɛmɛ pani nya ngɛ a nyɛmɛ a nyɔ nya.
A kɛ bimwɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ toɔ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hiɔhi a nya.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ haa nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛɔ a he gu nɛ bo be a he; a haa nɛ a kɛ mi mi hwɔ tsuɔ ní ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ.
A naa nu kɛ jeɔ oliv tso mi, nɛ a ngaa wai kɛ jeɔ wai yiblii mi.
Se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ kuma yeɔ mɛ.
O maa nu nɛ nihi ngɛ kɛmɛe ngɛ ma a mi; o maa nu nɛ nihi nɛ plaa a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae, nɛ a ngɛ yemi kɛ buami hlae.
Se Mawu bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.
Nimli yayamihi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kua la a nɛ; a nui la a sisi, nɛ he nɛ la a ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ hu, a be lejɛ ɔ. Awi yelɔ teɔ si mɔtu kpla konɛ e gbe ohiatsɛ, aloo nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko.
Nyɔ mi kɛkɛ e pee e he julɔ.
Gba puɛlɔ hu hii mlɛe konɛ du nɛ bu.
E deɔ e he ke, “Nɔ ko be mi nae,” kɛkɛ e ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi.
Ke diblii wo ɔ, juli ya sɛɛ nihi a wehi a mi ya juɔ.
Piani lɛɛ a laa a he, nɛ a sume nɛ a baa la hɛ mi.
Ejakaa a yeɔ piani la a gbeye; diblii kpii ɔ mohu wui a he gbeye.
Zofar Yiwutsotsɛ ɔ, pa nɛ hia ba ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ yaa.
A gbiɛ e weto ní nɛ ji e zugba a, nɛ e be ní tsue ngɛ e wai ngmɔ ɔ mi hu.
Gbeje ngɔɔ yayami peelɔ kɛ yaa kaa bɔ nɛ sapu kɛ latsa miiɔ nyu ɔ. E nyɛ po hɛ maa je e nɔ.
Gɔgɔ maa ye lɛ, nɛ e hɛ mi ma kpata kaa tso nɛ ku pue si.
Nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lɛ kaie hu.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba e nɔ, ejakaa e wa yosahi yi mi; yalɔyihi hu e nɛ́ mɛ mɔbɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Mawu kɛ e he wami haa nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ he wa a yaa nɔ.
E tee si be mi nɛ e hɛ be wami ko nɔ hu.
Mawu ma ha nɛ e maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, se daa nɛ ɔ, e hɛngmɛ ngɛ e he.
Yayami peelɔ yaa nɔ nɛ e plɔkeɔ; se be bɔɔ se ɔ, e be hu.
E hɛ mi kpataa kaa bɔ nɛ nimlihi tsuo a hɛ mi kpataa a, nɛ e peeɔ kaa blɛfo tso nɛ a po.
Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ be mi ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa i ngɛ lakpa yee?
Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa munyu gu lɛ i ngɛ tue ɔ lo?
Bildad -Mawu kle, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye.
E hiɔwe ma a lɛɛ tue mi jɔmi sɔuu ji lejɛ ɔ. Bɔfohi nɛ sɔmɔɔ Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa kane mɛ lo?
E la a nɛ́, ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ e tsui ha mɛ lo?
Lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee kɛ bu nɔmlɔ dalɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kɛɛ?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ yo fɔ lɛ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e he ma tsɔ?
Nyɔhiɔ tete kpɛ we ha Mawu, nɛ dodoehi po a hɛ mi tsɔ we ha lɛ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa aklɔku, aloo gɔgɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛɛ e maa pee kɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi kɛɛ?
Hiob -Balɔ kpakpa!
Mo lɛ o piɛ ye he.
Imi nɛ i gbɔjɔ!
Imi nɛ ye he wami ta!
Imi kuasia nɛ i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ, o wo mi ga, nɛ o tu nile munyu kpakpahi kɛ tsɔɔ mi!
Mɛnɔ lɛ piɛ o he nɛ o kɛ tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ?
Mɛnɔ mumi lɛ je o mi ɔ?
Bildad Kpade ɔmɛ a he mi ngɛ mɛ hiae ngɛ zu mi ngɛ nyu ɔ sisi.
Gbeje fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
He hami nɔ́ be he nɛ maa tsi lɛ blɔ.
Mawu gbla omleyi je hiɔwe ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ kpla si nɛ nɔ́ ko hɛɛ we lɛ.
Mawu lɛ e kɛ nyu woɔ bɔku kpii ɔmɛ a mi; lɛ nɛ e fii bɔku ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e ha we nɛ a pɛ́.
Mawu lɛ e ngɔɔ nyɔhiɔ kɛ laa ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a se.
E po huzu ngɛ wo hɛ mi kɛ gba piani kɛ nyɔ a kpɛti.
Ke e kuɛ́ ɔ, titimahi nɛ hɛɛ hiɔwe ɔ hosoɔ, nɛ a he wami taa.
E kɛ e he wami jɔɔ wo ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ juɛmi kpata wo mi lohwe ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Rahab ɔ hɛ mi.
E mumi ɔ lɛ ha nɛ hiɔwe tsɔ, nɛ e pee saminyayoo.
E nine lɛ e kɛ tsɔtslɔɔ wo mi lohwe ngua a mi.
Mawu blɔ ɔmɛ a he níhi bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ́ wa nu kɛ wa tue ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
E he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ lɛɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa le?
Hiob -I na Mawu Ope nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ kua dami sane yemi ha mi, nɛ e ha nɛ i na amanehlu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ wami mi, nɛ Mawu mumi ngɛ ye mi nɛ ɔ, lakpa munyu be ye nya mi jee gblegbleegble; i kɛ ye lilɛ hu be nɔ ko sisie kɔkɔɔkɔ.
I be kplɛɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ ngɛ mi; kɛ yaa si ye gbenɔ ligbi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji i yi fɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ke i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔ, jamɛ a munyu kake too ɔ i ngɛ tue; ye he nile bui mi fɔ ligbi ko ligbi ko.
Ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ, á gbla e tue kaa yiwutsotsɛ; nɔ nɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ mi ɔ, á gbla e tue kaa yayami peelɔ.
Ke yayami peelɔ be su, nɛ Mawu ba ngɔ lɛ ɔ, mɛni hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi pa ngɛ ha lɛ?
Ke haomi ba e nɔ, nɛ e fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, anɛ Mawu maa nu e kue fami ɔ lo?
Anɛ e náá Ope ɔ he bua jɔmi lo?
Anɛ e faa kue kɛ haa lɛ daa lo?
Nyɛ ha nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu kle ha; nɔ́ nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ to ke e maa pee ɔ, i be nyɛ ba laae ngɛ he.
Se tse nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ momo kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ munyuhi nɛ a he be se nami tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ mɔ?
Zofar Bɔ nɛ Mawu gblaa yayami peelɔ tue ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Hiɔwo nɛ yiwutsotsɛ naa kɛ jeɔ Ope ɔ dɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E ma fɔ bimɛ babauu, se mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ma gbo ngɛ ta mi; e bimɛ na we niye ní nɛ suu a nya gblegbleegble.
Nihi nɛ a he maa je mi ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe mɛ, nɛ a yalɔyi ɔmɛ be ya nyɛe ha mɛ.
Yayami peelɔ ma bua sika hiɔ babauu nya kaa bunyuku nɛ be hie kanemi; e ma bua he hami níhi babauu nya kaa tabo zu.
Se nɔmlɔ kpakpa ko lɛ ma ba ha bo ɔmɛ; nɔ kpakpa ko lɛ ma ba wo tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e maa ngɔ sika hiɔ ɔ. Yayami peelɔ we nɛ e po ɔ ngɛ kaa anani ya, aloo tsu wayoo nɛ bulɔ pee.
E ma ya hwɔ si kaa niatsɛ; se ke e te si ɔ, e maa na kaa e sika a tsuo ta.
Sawale maa nu lɛ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa maa fia lɛ kɛ ho nyɔ mi.
Beleku kɔɔhiɔ maa fia lɛ kɛ ho; e maa bɛɛ lɛ kɛ je he nɛ e hii ɔ. Mawu ma ha nɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ maa fia lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ e be lɛ mɔbɔ nae kulaa, be mi nɛ e ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tu fo kɛ je nya.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ ma kpa fiifii kɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ fo kɛ wo e he gbeye.
E maa pee lɛ kaa nihi lɛ a ngɛ a dɛ fiae kɛ ngɛ lɛ fiee kɛ je he nɛ e hii ɔ.
Nile yi jemi la Niinɛ, muɔhi ngɛ nɛ a tsuaa sika hiɔ ngɛ a mi.
Sika tsu he tsumi hehi hu ngɛ.
A tsuaa dade ngɛ zu mi, nɛ a sileɔ tɛ, nɛ a jeɔ akɔblee kɛ jeɔ mi.
Nihi suɔ kane ngɛ diblii mi, nɛ a kɛ hlaa tɛ kpakpahi ngɛ zugba a sisi hehi nɛ wo diblii kpii, kɛ hehi nɛ ngɛ gbeye.
Kɔ̃ mi hehi nɛ nimli be, hehi nɛ blɔ hiali nyɛɛ we ɔ, lejɛ ɔ sika tsuali ya tsuaa muɔ ngɛ.
O maa na mɛ nɛ a kplaa si ngɛ kpahi a he, nɛ a ngɛ asɛkɛ wue kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.
Niye ní jeɔ zu mi, se zu ɔ sisi lɛɛ e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ la sã.
Tɛhi nɛ ngɛ zu ɔ mi ɔ, safiro ngɛ mi.
Bibliwi ɔmɛ hu, sika tsu sɔuu.
Blɔ nɛ yaa sika muɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, kayo ko hɛngmɛ nɛ hyɛ; okpoku ko hu ti kɛ ya bi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hyɛ.
Jata, loo lohwe awi yelɔ ko bi ngɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nimli adesahi tsuaa tɛ sahi nɛ a he wa, a hiaa yokuhi kɛ jeɔ a hi hehi.
Ke a ngɛ tɛ sa amɛ a mi kpɛe ɔ, a naa tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa.
A tsuaa pa mi kɛ yaa pa a je he tɔɔ, nɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ laa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ kɛ baa la hɛ mi.
Se nile lɛɛ jije a maa na lɛ ngɛ?
Juɛmi ɔ, jije e hii?
A nɛ nile ngɛ nimli a kpɛti.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko li bɔ nɛ e he jua wa ha.
Muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ ke nile be a ngɔ; wo hu ja nɔuu lɛ e ngɛ dee.
Nile ɔ, a ngɔɛ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ kɛ he we.
E he jua a, sika tsu, loo juetli kpakpa po sui nya.
E he jua wa pe sika tsu, e he jua wa pe sika tsu kplu, aloo ahuhuɛ kpakpa.
Nile he jua wa pe huazi, loo kɔli, loo adiagba.
Etiopia topasion tɛ, aloo sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ nile sɔɛ.
Lɛɛ jije a naa nile ngɛ mɔ?
Jije ji juɛmi hi he?
A ngɔ kɛ laa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ngɛ hiɔwe po, a li he nɛ nile ngɛ.
Gbenɔ kɛ hɛ mi kpatami po de ke, “Oo, e biɛ kɛkɛ lɛ wa nu kɛ wa tue.” He nɛ nile ngɛ, kɛ blɔ nɛ a maa gu kɛ ya na lɛ ɔ, Mawu pɛ lɛ le.
Ejakaa lɛɛ e hɛngmɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́ kɛ yaa je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ tɔɔ; e naa níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe sisi.
Benɛ Mawu susu kɔɔhiɔ jiimi, kɛ he nɛ wo ɔ yi ma bli kɛ ya su ɔ, benɛ Mawu to he nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ, kɛ he nɛ hiɔwe ma si kɛ ya be ngɛ ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ e na nile, nɛ e wo nɔ ta.
E hla mi fitsofitso, nɛ e to lɛ sisi.
Mawu de nɔmlɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye yemi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nile; yayami he jemi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji juɛmi.”
Hiob je e nya nyagbe nɔ́ Hiob tsa e munyu ɔ nɔ nɛ e de ke, I na nɛ i ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ sa a nɛ Mawu buɔ ye he ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ saminya, nɛ ke i ngɛ diblii mi nyɛɛe ɔ, e haa mi la.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, ye he hi, nɛ Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ kaa nɔ kɛ e huɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Ope ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ, nɛ ye bimɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, ye na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ haa mi nyɔ nyu babauu; nɛ hehi nɛ tɛ sa hiɛ ngɛ po, i naa oliv tsohi babauu nɛ haa mi nu bɔ nɛ sa.
Be tsuaa be nɛ ma nimeli ma bua a he nya ngɛ ma agbo ɔ nya, nɛ ma ho ya hi ye blɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ke nihewi na mi pɛ kɛkɛ a gba ha mi; nikɔtɔmahi maa te nɛ a maa da si ha mi.
Ganɔ ɔmɛ maa jɔɔ munyu tumi, nɛ a kɛ a nine maa wo a nya mi.
Odehehi tete a lilɛ maa mɛtɛ a nya mi, nɛ a maa pee dii.
Ke nihi nu ye he ɔ, a jeɔ ye yi, nɛ ke a na mi ɔ, a tuɔ ye he munyu kpakpa.
Ejakaa ke ohiatsɛmɛ kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ balɔ ɔ, i jeɔ mɛ; awusahi hu i piɛɔ a he ja nɔuu.
I je nihi kɛ je haomi mi, nɛ a gbaa mi; nɛ i ha nɛ yalɔyihi na bua jɔmi.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, i yeɔ dami sane, nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
I plɛ pee hɛngmɛ ha hɛ yuyuili, kɛ nane ha glɔtsɛmɛ.
I pee kaa tsɛ kɛ ha dɛgutsɛmɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ i li mɛ po, i ye a sane ha mɛ.
I ku yiwutsotsɛmɛ a tsitsa, nɛ i kpɔ nihi nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae ɔ kɛ je a nya mi.
I hyɛ blɔ kaa ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ maa hiɛ babauu kaa zia, nɛ ma gbo ngɛ we, ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
I ngɛ kaa tso nɛ sipoku naa nyu be tsuaa be, nɛ bɔ́ pɔɔ e kɔnihi a he daa.
Nihi tuɔ ye he munyu kpakpa daa, nɛ be tsuaa be ɔ, i naa he wami he.
Ke i ngɛ nihi ga woe ɔ, a peeɔ dii nɛ a buɔ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
Ke i tu munyu gbe nya a, nɔ ko de we nɔ́ ko hu; ejakaa a nuɔ ye munyu ɔmɛ a sisi saminya.
Ke pee ɔ, a hyɛɛ mi blɔ nɛ ma ba tu mɛ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ nyu he hia mɛ hyɛɛ gbo hiɔmi nɛmi blɔ ɔ. Ke a ngɛ a tsui yee ɔ, kɛkɛ i muɔ hɛlii ha mɛ.
Ke i tsɔ ye hɛ mi ha mɛ ja kɛkɛ a nɔ gbagba te.
I kɛ mɛ hi si kaa a hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia kaa a pee ɔ, i tsɔɔ mɛ.
I kɛ mɛ hi si kaa matsɛ ngɛ e ta buli a kpɛti, aloo bua wolɔ ngɛ kɔmɔ yeli a kpɛti.
Se mwɔnɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ i wa pe mɛ po ngɛ mi muɔe.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsɛmɛ nɛ fɔ mɛ ɔ, i bui mɛ fɛɛ; gbehi nɛ buu ye tohi a he pohu i kɛ mɛ be gbe ɔmɛ futue.
Nimli nɛ a he wami tsuo ta nɛ ɔ, mɛni se ma na ngɛ a he?
Ohia kɛ hwɔ ha nɛ a ta he lo, nɛ a pee kanyakanya; sa a, tso sipoku gbigbli lɛ a kpeɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ.
Tso sipoku, kɛ ba ji a niye ní.
A fie mɛ kɛ je nimli a kpɛti; a huɔ mɛ kaa a huɔɔ julɔ.
A hi hehi ji muɔhi, tɛ sahi, kɛ dɔhi a mi.
A ya buaa a he nya ngɛ mio tsohi a sisi ngɛ pu mi, nɛ a hii huãe kaa lohwe awi yeli.
Yakayaka nimli, kɛ ni guhi ji mɛ tsuo, nihi nɛ a fia a nane si tu kɛ je ma a mi.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba konɛ a ba muɔ mi; i plɛ pee a nya mi la.
A hɛ mɛ kɛ je ye kasa nya; a hiee mi.
Ke a hyɛ mi kɛkɛ a la lada pue ye nɔ.
Akɛnɛ Mawu gbla ye tue nɛ i gbɔjɔ he je ɔ, a bui mi fɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ lɛ a peeɔ mi.
Yakayaka nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba tuaa mi basabasa, nɛ a hlaa kaa a ma kpata ye hɛ mi.
A tsi mi blɔ nɛ ma ko ma fo; a bɔ mɔde kaa a ma kpata ye hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko tsi we a nya.
A hiɛ babauu kɛ ba tua mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ puɔ agbo ko mi lɛ a gu kɛ ba.
Sawale nu mi; ye hɛ mi nyami laa mi kaa kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ ní kɛ yaa.
Ye ní nami ɔ se po kaa bɔku.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye gbenɔ be su ta; jehanɛ lɛɛ, ye haomi ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ.
Nyɔ mi ɔ, ye wuhi a mi kpeɔ mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ he jɔmi be mi.
E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu mia ye yi nɔ tade ɔ kɛ wo ye kuɛ kpɛii nɛ mumi womi he be mi.
Mawu tsitsɛɛ mi kɛ wo mɔsɔ mi, nɛ i pee kaa tabo zu, aloo la zu.
Mawu, ke i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he we nɔ; ke i fa kue ha mo ɔ, o bui mi tue.
O ngɛ mi yi mi wae; o kɛ nine si wami ngɛ mi yi mi wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
O wo ye nɔ nɛ o fɔ mi kɛ ya kɔɔhiɔ mi.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a fia mi kɛ ya kɛ ba.
Niinɛ, i le kaa o ngɔ mi kɛ yaa gbeje, he nɛ a to kɛ ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, imi nɛ ye he wami ta, imi nɛ i nyɛ we nɔ́ ko peemi, nɛ pɛɛ kɛkɛ i ngɛ mo kpae ke o na mi mɔbɔ ɔ, mɛni he je lɛ o kɛ mi ye sane kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Anɛ i fo we ya ha nihi nɛ ngɛ haomi mi lo?
Anɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane pee we mi mɔbɔ lo?
Se benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa blɔ hyɛe ɔ, nɔ́ yayami mohu lɛ ba na mi.
Benɛ i ngɛ la blɔ hyɛe ɔ, diblii mohu lɛ ba.
Ye tsui ngɛ fiae wawɛɛ ngɛ ye mi mi; ye haomi ligbi ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ.
I ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ diblii mi nyɛɛe nɛ e nɛ pu hɛ mi.
I teɔ si ngɛ gua mi, nɛ i biɔ yemi kɛ buami.
I plɛ pee nga mi gbehi a nyɛmi, kɛ klomihi a huɛ.
Ye he womi pee tuu, nɛ ye wuhi a he dɔ la.
Ye gbi nɛ jijeɔ kaa saku, aloo bɛ ɔ, mwɔnɛ ɔ, e pɛɛ kaa nihi nɛ a wo yana kɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
I ka kita kaa i kɛ akɔnɔ hɛngmɛ be zangmayo ko hyɛe gblegbleegble.
Mɛni hiɔwo lɛ ma na kɛ je Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ dɛ mi?
Mɛni weto ní lɛ ma na kɛ je Ope ɔ dɛ mi?
Anɛ e kpataa we yiwutsotsɛmɛ a hɛ mi lo?
Anɛ e gbla we yayami peeli a tue lo?
Mawu le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i peeɔ; e le ye blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.
I ngɛ kita kae kaa i yi nɔ ko lakpa; i sisi we nɔ ko hulɔ.
Mawu nɛ́ ngmɛ mi ngɛ sɛni nɛ da nɔ, nɛ e maa na kaa i pee we yayami ko.
Ke i je blɔ kpakpa a nɔ kɛ ya nyɛɛ níhi nɛ ye tsui suɔ a se, nɛ i kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi ble ye he ɔ, lɛɛ níhi nɛ i du ɔ, ni kpahi nɛ a ba ye; aloo ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata.
Ke ye nyɛmi ko e yo he pee mi akɔnɔ hyɛ, nɛ i ya wo lɛ ka ngɛ ye nyɛmi nɛ ɔ sinya se ɔ, lɛɛ ye yo nɛ e hoo gba ní ha nɔ kpa, nɛ nyumu kpa kɛ lɛ nɛ hwɔ.
Yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e ji zo; e sa kaa kojoli nɛ a gbla nɔ tue ngɛ he.
E ngɛ kaa la nɛ sãã nɔ́ kɛ yaa tsitsaa; e ma kpata ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi.
Ke ye tsɔlɔ nyumu, aloo ye mawayo ko kɛ mi na sane ɔ, i yeɔ sane ɔ ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ.
Ke i pee we ja a, kɛ ma pee kɛ da Mawu hɛ mi kɛɛ?
Ke Mawu ba nɛ́ e ba kojo mi ɔ, kɛ ma de kɛɛ?
Mawu ɔ nɛ bɔ mi ɔ, lɛ kɛ̃ lɛ e bɔ ye tsɔli nyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ ye mawayi ɔmɛ.
Ke nɔ́ ko hia ohiatsɛ ɔ, i haa lɛ; yalɔyihi hu, i ha we nɛ a hɛngmɛ nɔ daa nyu.
Ke i ngɛ ní yee ɔ, i ha we nɛ hwɔ yeɔ awusahi.
I hyɛɔ awusahi a nɔ kaa a tsɛ ye wami be ɔ tsuo.
I ye bua yalɔyihi kɛ je ye nihe mi.
Ke i na nɔ ko nɛ yi fi, nɛ nɔ́ ko be e dɛ nɛ e kɛ ma he bo nɛ e ha, ke i na dɛgutsɛ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i haa lɛ he hami nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ imi nitsɛ ye to he bwɔmi pee.
Ke e he dɔ la a, kɛkɛ e maa na mi si babauu.
Ke i ya ye awusa ko amimi, ejakaa i le kaa bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, a maa wo mi nguɔ ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, lɛɛ ye nine nɛ ku; ye kɔni nɛ kplɔ kɛ je kɔni wu ɔ he.
Se akɛnɛ i yeɔ Mawu Hewamitsɛ ɔ tue gblami ɔ gbeye he je ɔ, i be nyɛe ma pee nɔ́ ko kaa ja.
I ngɔɛ ye hɛ fɔ we sika nɔ.
Ní babauu nɛ i na a, i fĩa we ngɔ fɔ nɔ.
Pu nɛ tsoɔ saminyayoo, kɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ kpɛɔ saminyayoo nɛ ɔ, i ja we mɛ hyɛ.
Nɔ́ ko mlɔɔ we mi hyɛ kaa ma fiɔ ye nine he kɛ wo a hɛ mi nyami.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu maa pee yayami nɛ sa kaa kojoli nɛ a gbla nɔ tue ngɛ he.
Ke i pee ja a, kɛkɛ i kua Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. Ke haomi ba ye he nyɛlɔ nɔ, aloo ye he nyɛlɔ hɛ mi kpata a, i nya we.
I sɔle we hyɛ ke ye he nyɛli nɛ a gbo, nɛ́ enɛ ɔ ba pee yayami ha mi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ tsuɔ ní ha mi ɔ le kaa hwɔ yi a ti nɔ ko hyɛ.
I ha we nɛ nibwɔhi hwɔɔ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ; mohu ɔ, i ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ baa we mi.
I laa we ye yayamihi a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Adam pee ɔ. I yi nihi babauu a hɛ mi gbeye.
Ke ye weku li muɔ mi ɔ, e pee we mi nɔ́ ko nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma pee dii nɛ ma ko je kpo.
Anɛ nɔ ko be nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue bue lo?
I ngɛ kita kae kaa anɔkuale sisiisi lɛ i ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ ha mi heto.
Sanehi nɛ ye nya polɔ ɔ kɛ fɔ ye nɔ ɔ, a ngma sane nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo womi mi jinɛ i kɛ maa fɔ ye konɔ, nɛ ma fi kɛ wo ye yi kaa jlasi.
Jinɛ ma nyɛɛ kam kam kaa ganɔ kɛ ya Mawu ngɔ, nɛ ma ya bɔ lɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i pee ɔ. Ke ye zugba a, aloo ngmɔ nɛ i pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa po ye nya kaa i ye zugba a nɔ niba ní yaka nɛ i wui he hiɔ, aloo kaa i gbe zugbatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ ye nine nɛ su a zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ngma nane mi ɔ, mio nɛ puɛ; akoko nane mi ɔ, nga nɛ puɛ.
Hiob munyu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Elihu tu munyu Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyumuhi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha we Hiob e munyu ɔmɛ a heto hu, ejakaa a na kaa e buu e he kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ da.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Elihu mi mi fu Hiob wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa e pia Mawu, nɛ e wo lɛ nitsɛ e he nguɔ.
(Elihu nɛ ɔ, Buz no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barakel ɔ binyumu ji lɛ.
E je Ram weku ɔ mi, nɛ lɛɛ e bee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.)
Elihu mi mi fu Hiob huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ, ejakaa a bu Hiob fɔ, be mi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɛ heto kpakpa ko nɛ a ha lɛ.
E mlɛ kɛ ya si ni ɔmɛ tsuo tu munyu gbe nya loko e kɛ Hiob tu munyu, ejakaa lɛ ji a kpɛti nɔ wayoo pe kulaa.
Benɛ Elihu na kaa nyumuhi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ pa nyɛ we nɛ a ha Hiob e sane ɔmɛ a heto hu ɔ, e mi mi wo la, nɛ e tu munyu.
Elihu Niheyo kɛkɛ ji mi; nyɛɛ lɛɛ nikɔtɔmahi ji nyɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ya ye gbeye, nɛ i nyɛ we nɛ ma de nyɛ bɔ nɛ imi hu i susu ha.
I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, nyɛ lɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ tu munyu; nyɛ nimeli ɔmɛ lɛ e sa kaa nyɛ je nyɛ juɛmi kpo.
Se, Mawu Ope mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa mi ɔ, lɛ nɛ e haa nɔmlɔ nile.
Pi wami nɛ peeɔ nɔ ní lelɔ; pi bwɔmi nɛ haa nɛ nɔ leɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue, konɛ imi hu ma je ye juɛmi kpo.
Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní sɛɛe, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tu nile munyu ɔ, i ngmɛ dii, nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tue bue.
Nɛ́ i bu nyɛ tue hluu ɔ, i na kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ha Hiob munyu ɔmɛ a heto bɔ nɛ sa.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ e ko pee nyɛ kaa nyɛ le ní.
Mawu lɛ maa bu Hiob fɔ, se pi nɔmlɔ adesa.
Hiob ɔ, pi imi nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue.
Kaa imi lɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, jinɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ heto ɔ, imi lɛɛ pi ja nɛ ma de lɛ.
Hiob hyɛ, ní leli ɔmɛ pee yaa; a pee dii, a pa be nɔ́ ko nɛ a ma de hu.
I mlɛ hluu kaa a ma pa de nɔ́ ko lo; i mlɛ kaa a ma ha mo heto kpa ko lo.
Se a daa si dii kɛkɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu ma de ye nɔ́; ma je imi hu ye juɛmi kpo.
I ngɛ níhi babauu nɛ ma de.
Mumi nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ ngɛ ye yi se tsitsɛɛe.
Ke i na we he blɔ nɛ ma tu munyu ɔ, lɛɛ ma pɛ́ kaa wai tɔ nɛ wai he hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Ma tu munyu, konɛ ma na he jɔmi; ma pa ye nya mi, nɛ ma ha mo o munyu ɔmɛ a heto.
I be nɔ ko hɛ mi hyɛe kɛ tu munyu; nɛ i be munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ tue ngɛ nɔ ko he.
I li munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ tumi.
Ke i pee ja a, ye bɔlɔ ɔ maa gbla ye tue amlɔ.
Jehanɛ Hiob, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue saminya.
I pee klaalo nɛ i kɛ mo maa tu munyu, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ye nya mi ɔ, ma de mo.
Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i le ɔ, lɔ ɔ ma de mo kɛ je ye tsui mi faa.
Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ pee mi; Ope ɔ mumi ɔ lɛ ha mi wami.
Ke o ma nyɛ ɔ, ha mi heto.
Moo pee klaalo kɛ o munyu ɔmɛ, konɛ o kɛ mi nɛ kpe.
Bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Imi hu tabo zu ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ a kɛ puɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo ye mi gbeye; pi nɔmlɔ nɛ ke e daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi nɛ o tsui maa po ji mi.
Munyu nɛ o tu nɛ i nu kɛ ye tue ji, “Ye he tsɔ; i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ blɔ.
I yeɔ nguɔ; yayami ko be ye he.
Se kɛ̃, Mawu bu mi kaa e he nyɛlɔ, nɛ e ngɛ tɔmihi hlae ngɛ ye he.
E bɔ ye nane pã, nɛ e hɛ ngɛ ye he be tsuaa be.” Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ji o nɔ́ be mi; Mawu kle pe nɔmlɔ adesa.
Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ pɛe kaa e bui níhi nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ ekoeko he akɔtaa kɛ tsɔɔ we nɔ ko?
Mawu ngɛ munyu tue daa be tsuaa be, se nɔmlɔ adesa bui nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
Nyɔ mi benɛ nimli adesahi hwɔ mahe vii ngɛ sa nɔ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ guu nlamihi, kɛ ninahi a mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e bliɔ nimli adesahi a tue, konɛ a nu nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ. Ke e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, a yeɔ gbeye.
Mawu kɛ nimli adesahi tuɔ munyu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpa yayami peemi, nɛ a ko wo a he nɔ.
E hla we kaa a hɛ mi nɛ kpata; e heɔ a yi wami kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi tete.
Nɔmlɔ kaseɔ ní ngɛ hiɔ sa nɔ, be mi nɛ e wuhi a mi ngɛ lɛ kpee nɛ he jɔmi be mi.
Ke e ba lɛ ja kɛkɛ e nya mi gbo, nɛ e pee we lɛ kaa e ye nɔ́ ko hu; niye ní ngɔngɔɛ tete po jlo we lɛ.
E tãã he lo kanyakanya nɛ hi hyɛmi; nɛ e wuhi nɛ a nɛ be ko nɛ be ɔ jeɔ kpo.
Lɔ ɔ ji e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ nɛ.
Alini, Mawu bɔfo akpe ɔmɛ nɛ tsɔɔ nimli adesahi nɔ́ nɛ da a, a ti nɔ kake ma ba je lɛ.
Mawu bɔfo ɔ maa na lɛ mɔbɔ.
E ma de ke, “Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ e he; e be gbeje yae!
Nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma kpɔ lɛ konɛ e ye e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” E ma tsake maa pee niheyo ekohu, nɛ e he womi maa pee tlotlootlo kaa jokuɛyo he womi.
Ke e fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, Mawu ma he nɔ.
E ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ Mawu ma ha nɛ níhi a mi maa hi ha lɛ ekohu.
E kɛ bua jɔmi ma de ngɛ ma hɛ mi ke, “I pee yayami.
I pee we nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, Mawu na mi mɔbɔ.
Mawu kplɛɛ we nɛ ma ya gbeje, nɛ i ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ.” Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu peeɔ ha nɔmlɔ si abɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: e heɔ nɔmlɔ yi wami, nɛ e haa lɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ je mi.
Hiob, jehanɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ɔ tue; pee dii konɛ ma tu munyu.
Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ o ma de ɔ, de nɛ ma nu; ma suɔ kaa ma wo mo nguɔ.
Se ke o be nɔ́ ko nɛ o ma de ɔ, lɛɛ pee dii, nɛ o bu mi tue, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nile.
-Nyɛ ní leli, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Munyu kpakpa, loo munyu yaya a, tue nɛ leɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ lilɛ hu leɔ niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ sane ɔ mi, nɛ waa na anɔkuale ɔ. Hiob ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa dalɔ ji lɛ, se Mawu mohu lɛ yi dami sane ha lɛ.
E ke e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ blɔ, se a bu lɛ lakpatsɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa a plaa lɛ yeyee mohu, se e le kaa e pee we yayami ko.
Anɛ nyɛ na nyumu ko hyɛ kaa Hiob lo?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ bɔɔ musu bɔ nɛ e suɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a nuu nyu ɔ. E kɛ nimli yayamihi lɛ bɔɔ.
E deɔ ke e he be se nami kaa nɔ ko nɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue, nyɛ juɛmitsɛmɛ!
Anɛ Mawu maa pee yi wu tso ní lo?
Anɛ Ope ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ lo?
Mawu lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ o tsu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he hiɔ lɛ e woɔ mo; Mawu woɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa lɛ.
Niinɛ, Mawu pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ; Ope ɔ plɛ we nɔ ko sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
Mɛnɔ nɛ ha Mawu e he wami ɔ?
Mɛnɔ nɛ tu je ɔ tsuo kɛ wo e dɛ mi?
Ke Mawu kpɔ mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami ngɛ nɔmlɔ dɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi tsuo ma gbo, nɛ a ma plɛ pee tabo zu ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ní leli ji nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Nɔ nɛ he wa nɛ e yeɔ dami sane ɔ, o maa bu lɛ fɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ sume dami sane yemi ɔ mohu nɛ ye tsɛ lo?
Mɛnɔ lɛ deɔ matsɛ ke, “Yaka nɔmlɔ ji mo!” Mɛnɔ lɛ deɔ odehehi ke, “Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji nyɛ!” Mawu hyɛ we ganɔhi a hɛ mi.
E bui niatsɛmɛ pe ohiatsɛmɛ; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e bɔ mɛ tsuo.
Nɔmlɔ gboɔ tlukaa, Mawu fiaa nimli adesahi nɔ́ nyɔ mi kɛkɛ a hɛ mi kpata.
Nimli nguahi po Mawu gbeɔ mɛ nɛ adesa nine be mi.
E hɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ he be tsuaa be.
E náá e ní peemi níhi tsuo.
Diblii ko be nɛ nya tsa bɔ nɛ yayami peeli maa laa a he ngɛ mi.
E hia we kaa Mawu nɛ to be ha nimli adesahi nɛ a ba e ngɔ loko e kojo mɛ.
E jeɔ nimli nguahi kɛ jeɔ a blɔ hehi, nɛ e ngɔɔ ni kpahi kɛ daa a nane mi; e hia we kaa e hla a sane ɔmɛ a mi.
Akɛnɛ Mawu le nɔ́ nɛ a tsuɔ he je ɔ, e ba tuaa mɛ nyɔ mi, nɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi.
Mawu gblaa yayami peeli a tue ngɛ ma hɛ mi, ejakaa a kpa e se nyɛɛmi, nɛ e mlaa amɛ hu a yi ekoeko nɔ.
A ha nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ kpa ngmlaa kɛ ba Mawu yemi kɛ buami, nɛ Mawu nu nɔ́ nali ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ. Ke Mawu pee dii ɔ, mɛnɔ maa pa e nya mi?
Ke e ngɔ e hɛ mi kɛ laa a, mɛnɔ maa na lɛ; ma ko loo, aloo nɔmlɔ adesa ko?
Lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ma ko be nyɛe maa pee nɔ ko, konɛ nɔmlɔ yayami ko ye tsɛ nɛ e ba kpata e ma a hɛ mi.
Hiob, anɛ o jaje o yayami ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Mawu lo?
Anɛ o wo lɛ si kaa o be yayami pee hu lo?
Anɛ o fa kue ha Mawu ke e tsɔɔ mo o tɔmi ɔmɛ lo?
Anɛ o kplɛɛ kaa o ma kpa yayami peemi lo?
Nɛ́ o kua Mawu ɔ, o ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e pee moo o suɔmi nya ní ha mo lo?
Mo lɛ o ma ha munyu nɛ ɔ heto; pi imi.
Kɛ o susuɔ kɛɛ?
Nihi nɛ ngɛ juɛmi, kɛ ní leli tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi tue bue ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a ma de ji, “Munyuhi nɛ Hiob ngɛ tue ɔ, juɛmi be mi; e li nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ.” E je imi nɔ kake ye he jinɛ a ko gbla Hiob tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ ngɛ munyu yayahi nɛ e tu kɛ si Mawu ɔ he.
Hiob tsɔ atuã kɛ piɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tu munyuhi babauu ngɛ wa hɛ mi kɛ si Mawu.
-Hiob, e sɛ kaa o deɔ ke o pee we yayami ko ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
E sɛ po kaa o biɔ Mawu ke, “Ke i pee yayami ɔ, mɛni lɔ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ o he?
Mɛni se i naa kaa i pee we yayami ko?” Ma ha mo heto, mo kɛ o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Hyɛ hiɔwe; hyɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a he kɛ ha!
Ke o pee yayami ɔ, kɛ lɔ ɔ saa Mawu he kɛɛ?
Aloo ke o pee yayami nɔtonɔto ɔ, mɛni lɔ ɔ peeɔ ha Mawu?
Ke o pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ o pee kɛ ha Mawu?
Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ma na ngɛ o dɛ?
Ke o pee yayami ɔ, o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ adesa lɛ naa nɔ́; ke o pee kpakpa a, o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ adesa lɛ naa he se.
Ke a ngɛ nimli adesahi yi mi wae ɔ, a kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ balɔ.
Se Mawu nɛ bɔ mɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ baa a yi nyɔ mi tete po ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ ko hla we e se blɔ.
Mawu ɔ nɛ pee wɔ ní leli pe lohwehi tsuo ɔ, a hla we e se blɔ.
A kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ balɔ, se Mawu bui mɛ tue; ejakaa he nɔ woli, kɛ yayami peeli ji mɛ.
Niinɛ, Mawu bui yaka ngmlaa tue; Mawu Ope ɔ bui he akɔtaa.
Hiob, mo lɛ o ke o be Mawu nae ɔ?
O sane ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi; moo hyɛ lɛ blɔ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o susuɔ kaa Mawu gbla we nɔ tue, nɛ ke nɔ pee yayami hu e di se tsɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mo Hiob, o paa o nya mi nɛ o tuɔ munyu bɔ nɛ o suɔ.
O tuɔ munyuhi babauu nɛ juɛmi be mi.
-Moo to o tsui si nɛ o bu mi tue!
Níhi nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ngɛ Mawu nane mi ɔ, i gbi nya lolo.
Ma ngɔ ye nile nɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mo kaa Mawu nɛ bɔ mi ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ.
Anɔkuale i ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ, pi lakpa; ní lelɔ kpanaa lɛ daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Mawu kle!
E nyɛ́ nɔ.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ e juɛmi sui he.
E ha we nɛ yayami peeli a se kɛɛ ngɛ je mi; e yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.
Mawu hɛngmɛ ngɛ dali a he be tsuaa be.
E hyɛɛ a nɔ kaa matsɛmɛ, nɛ e woɔ a hɛ mi nyami daa.
Se ke a bɔ nihi pã, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a pee he ɔ, Mawu tsɔɔ mɛ a nɔ́ nami ɔ sisi, kaa a wo a he nɔ, nɛ a pee yayami.
E kaa a hɛ mi saminya, nɛ e deɔ mɛ ke a kpa yayami peemi.
Ke a bu Mawu tue nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ ɔ, a ma na tue mi jɔmi, kɛ kplɔkɔtɔ.
Se ke a bui tue ɔ, lɛɛ a ma gbo ngɛ klaate nya kaa nihi nɛ li nɔ́.
Nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a woɔ a mi mi la kɛ yaa nɔ.
Ke a gbla a tue po, a fa we kue kɛ tsɛ balɔ.
A gboɔ ngɛ a nihe mi, ejakaa a hyɛ we a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɔ saminya.
A gbenɔ peeɔ hɛ mi si puemi.
Mawu tsɔɔ nihi ní kɛ guu nɔ́ nami mi; e ngɔɔ amanehlu kɛ bliɔ nihi a hɛngmɛ.
Mawu je mo kɛ je amanehlu mi, nɛ e ha mo tue mi jɔmi, kɛ niye ní kpakpa.
Se, jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ o tue gblae bɔ nɛ sa mo.
Hyɛ saminya nɛ o mi mi nɛ fu ɔ kó ha nɛ o ya gbe Mawu he guɛ.
Ko ha ní nami nɛ je o juɛmi kɛ je Mawu he.
Ke o fa kue kɛ tsɛ balɔ hu, yaka gu; o he wami tsuo be nyɛe ma tsu nɔ́ ko.
Ko de ke o na nɛ e su nyɔ mi, be mi nɛ nihi a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Hyɛ saminya nɛ o ko ya nyɛɛ yayami se.
A kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba o nɔ, konɛ o ko pee yayami.
Na nɛ o le kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami; e kle pe tsɔɔli tsuo.
Mɛnɔ lɛ maa tsɔɔ Mawu nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ e pee?
Mɛnɔ lɛ maa po e nya ke e pee yayami?
Nihi ngɛ Mawu yi jee ngɛ e ní tsumi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔmɛ a he; mo hu mo je e yi koo.
Níhi nɛ Mawu tsuɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi.
Hyɛ, Mawu kle!
Wa li lɛ kulaa; jeha nɛ e ye hu wa juɛmi sui he.
Mawu lɛ gblaa nyu kɛ jeɔ zugba, nɛ e haa nɛ e plɛɔ peeɔ hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ.
E haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ babauu kɛ jeɔ bɔku mi kɛ pueɔ si ha nimli adesahi tsuo.
Bɔ nɛ bɔku haa si, kɛ bɔ nɛ hiɔwe siɔ ngɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ e hi he ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ le?
E haa nɛ oslabai gbaa ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo, se wo ɔ sisi lɛɛ e ngɛ diblii mi.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu peeɔ kɛ hyɛɛ e ma a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: e haa mɛ niye ní babauu.
E kɛ e nine nuɔ oslabai, nɛ he tsuaa he nɛ e fa lɛ ke e ya a, kɛkɛ e gba kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Ke hiɔwe si ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ma ngɛ se.
Lohwehi tete po le enɛ ɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha ye tsui po, nɛ e ngɛ fiae kplakplaakpla.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Mawu wo gbi, nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛɛ bu hoo nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ je e nya mi ɔ tue.
E haa oslabai gbaa ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e kpɛɔ ngɛ je ɔ kɔ nya he tsuaa he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, hiɔwe siɔ wawɛɛ kɛ nyɛɛɔ se.
Jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo oslabai ɔ ngɛ la pae plamplam.
Ke Mawu wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e peeɔ ní nguahi nɛ wa juɛmi sui he.
E faa ke snoo nɛ nɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ e haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nya wa hu nɛɔ ja nɔuu.
Ke e ba kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi kpaa ní tsumi, konɛ nimli adesahi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo nɛ a na e he wami ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nga mi lohwehi beɔ kɛ yaa a hi hehi.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa fiaa kɛ jeɔ leneyi je, nɛ fĩɛ nɛ nya wa jeɔ omleyi je kɛ baa.
Mumi nɛ jeɔ Mawu gugwɔ mi ɔ haa nɛ nyu babauu ɔ wluaa gaganii kaa tɛ.
Mawu haa bɔku ɔmɛ hyi ɔ kɛ nyu.
Oslabai hii la pae ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi, be mi nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe nɛ a ngɛ Mawu ní tsue ɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu fa mɛ ke a pee ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si ɔ, a peeɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mawu haa hiɔmi nɛɛ, konɛ nyu nɛ ba zugba a nɔ; e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ nɛ e kɛ gblaa nimli adesahi a tue, aloo nɛ e kɛ naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
Hiob, bu tue!
Da si dii nɛ o susu Mawu nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ a he.
Anɛ o le bɔ nɛ Mawu faa, nɛ e haa oslabai gbaa kɛ jeɔ bɔku mi lo?
Bɔ nɛ bɔkuhi plɛɔ kɛ beɔ kɛ a he sɔmi ngɛ nyakpɛ blɔ nɔ ɔ, anɛ o le lo?
Ee, ní lelɔ kpanaa a, e ní tsumi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ke leneyi je kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ fiae, nɛ je mi ngmɛ dii ɔ, anɛ o le bɔ nɛ peeɔ loko moo o he mi dɔɔ la lo?
Hiɔwe ɔ nɛ he wa kpakpataa kaa ahuhuɛ nɛ a sile, nɛ a puɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ, anɛ o ma nyɛ maa gbla mi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ, e pee ɔ lo?
Hiob, moo tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ wa ma de Mawu.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa juɛmi mi wo diblii, nɛ nɔ́ ko be wa nya mi nɛ wa ma de.
I be suɔe nɛ i kɛ Mawu nɛ tu munyu.
Ke i pee ja a, ye hɛ mi ma kpata.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, la nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam nɛ e hi hyɛmi, ejakaa kɔɔhiɔ muɔ bɔku ɔmɛ kɛ ho.
Je mi tsɔ hleii kaa sika tsu ngɛ omleyi je; Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ gbeye.
Mawu Ope ɔ loo, wa be nyɛe maa su e he.
E ngɛ he wami, e yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nihi tsuo yeɔ lɛ gbeye; ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a buɔ a he ní leli ɔ, Mawu lɛɛ e bui mɛ fɛɛ.
Yawɛ ha Hiob heto Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu kɛ je kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi.
Yawɛ Mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kɛ munyu puu nɛ juɛmi be mi biɔ mi ye nile he sane?
Da si kaa nyumu, nɛ o ha mi sanehi nɛ ma bi mo ɔ a heto.
Benɛ i to je ɔ sisi ɔ, jije o ngɛ?
Ke o le ɔ, ha mi heto.
Je ɔ kami kɛ e blimi ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ tsɔɔ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ kpa kɛ susu?
Tse o ma nyɛ ma ha heto!
Mɛni nɔ a fia e sisi tomi ɔmɛ kɛ ma?
Mɛnɔ lɛ to kɔ nya tɛ ɔ?
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ mɔtu ɔ, dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo la, nɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hwɔ lele.
Benɛ wo ɔ hia kɛ ma babaaba kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba a nitsɛ mi mi lɛ e je ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ nga sinya a kɛ tsi wo ɔ nya?
Imi lɛ i ngɔ bɔku kɛ ha wo ɔ he; imi lɛ i ngɔ diblii kpii kɛ blaa lɛ.
Imi lɛ i po huzu kɛ wo wo ɔ he, nɛ i ma nya agbo kɛ e se dade.
I de wo ɔ ke, “Moo fia kɛ ba su hiɛ ɔ pɛ; koo be he!
O we oslɔke ngua amɛ ɔ, he nɛ a ma ba ta ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Hiob, o wami be ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, anɛ o fa hyɛ ke je nɛ na, nɛ je na lo?
Anɛ o fa hyɛ ke mɔtu la a nɛ nu je ɔ kɛ yaa si a ma huanya yiwutsotsɛmɛ kɛ je a laami hehi lo?
Piani la haa nɛ a naa yoku ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ saminya kaa bɔ nɛ a naa zahi ngɛ bo mi, aloo nya sɔumi nɔ́ ngɛ tabo zu mi ɔ. Piani la nya wa tsɔ ha yayami peeli.
E tsiɔ mɛ blɔ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a tsuɔ yi wu tso ní.
Pahi nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ sisi ɔ, anɛ o ya a kasa nya hyɛ lo?
O nyɛɛ ngɛ muɔ voo ɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ mi hyɛ lo?
Agbohi nɛ ngɛ ni gbogboehi a je, he nɛ wo diblii kpii ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko bli nya kɛ tsɔɔ mo hyɛ lo?
Anɛ o le je ɔ blimi lo?
Ke o le ɔ, ha mi heto.
Jije a guu kɛ yaa la hi he?
Diblii hu jije e hi he ngɛ?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ a huzu nya, nɛ o kpale mɛ kɛ ba a hi he ekohu lo?
Ee, o ma nyɛ; nɔkɔtɔma ji mo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, tse a fɔ mo!
Hehi nɛ i toɔ snoo, kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ngɛ ɔ, o ya lejɛ ɔmɛ hyɛ lo?
I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to lejɛ ɔ ngɛ haomi, loo ta nɛ maa ba he.
Jije a guu kɛ yaa he nɛ pu jeɔ kɛ baa, aloo he nɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ jeɔ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ gba nyu dɔ kɛ ha hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ piapiaapia a?
Mɛnɔ lɛ je blɔ ha hiɔwe simi, kɛ oslabai gbami?
Mɛnɔ lɛ haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ ngɛ zugba nɔ he nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko be kaa nga kplanaa nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Zugba nɛ gbo, aloo zugba nɛ pee nga kplanaa a, mɛnɔ lɛ haa lɛ nyu loko nga puɛɔ ngɛ nɔ?
Hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ ɔ, e ngɛ tsɛ lo?
Bɔ́ hu, mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ lɛ?
Mɛnɔ muklii mi nyu tɛ je?
Hiɔwe bɔ́ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ lɛ?
Nyu ɔ wluaa gaganii, nɛ e he waa kaa tɛ.
Dodoehi nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Kungwɔ kɛ e bimɛ ɔ, anɛ o ma nyɛ maa fi mɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ lo?
Huɛ etɛ ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa pɛne e mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ dodoehi blɔ ngɛ a be mi lo?
O ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ Je kpaago kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ blɔ lo?
Anɛ o le mlaahi nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ hiɔwe lo?
O ma nyɛ ma ha jamɛ a mlaa amɛ nɛ tsu ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa wo gbi nɛ nyu babauu maa je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi ba pɔ mo lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma fa oslabai ke e gba, nɛ e ma he nɔ ke, “Ma pee kaa bɔ nɛ o fa mi ɔ” lo?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ha nɔmlɔ adesa nile?
Mɛnɔ kɛ juɛmi wo nɔmlɔ yi mi?
Mɛnɔ lɛ le ní bɔ nɛ sa nɛ e ma nyɛ maa kane bɔkuhi ngɛ hiɔwe?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma plɛ nyu buɛ mi bɔku ɔmɛ a nya ngɔ ka si, nɛ tabo zu ɔ ma pɔtɔ maa pee mɔsɔ; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e maa pee zu kpɔ longolongohi?
Mo lɛ o haa jata niye ní nɛ e yeɔ lo?
Mo lɛ o haa jata bimɛ ní nɛ a yeɔ nɛ a tɔɔ, be mi nɛ a buu si ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, loo a wo ka ngɛ a muɔhi a mi?
Mɛnɔ lɛ haa kuakualabite niye ní?
Ke hwɔ ngɛ kuakualabite bimɛ yee, nɛ a ngɛ niye ní hlae kɛ bee, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa tsɛ mi ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ haa mɛ niye ní?
Anɛ o le be nɛ pu mi apletsihi fɔɔ lo?
O na odabɔ nɛ ngɛ fɔe hyɛ lo?
Anɛ o le nyɔhiɔ abɔ nɛ a hɛɛɔ mi lo?
O le be nɛ a fɔɔ lo?
O le bɔ nɛ a buɔ si, nɛ a fɔɔ, nɛ a haomi ɔmɛ jeɔ a nɔ lo?
A bimɛ ɔmɛ waa saminya ngɛ nga a nɔ; a jeɔ a nyɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a kpale we kɛ bɛ hu.
Nga mi teji ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ ha nɛ a ye a he?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngmɛɛ a he loko a ngɛ kpae ɔ?
Imi lɛ i ha mɛ nga kplanaa a, nɛ a kɛ pee a hi he, kɛ ngo zugba a hulɔ, konɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ.
A sume ma nguahi a mi he nɛ huhui ngɛ; a hla we nɛ nɔ ko nɛ jɔɔ a kã he nɛ a tsu ní ha lɛ.
Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ji a ní yemi he; a yeɔ ba mumu tsuaa ba mumu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Anɛ pu mi okpɔngɔ maa suɔ nɛ e tsu ní ha mo lo?
Anɛ e maa suɔ nɛ e hwɔ o lohwehi a ní yemi he lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa wo pu mi okpɔngɔ kpa nɛ e hu ha mo lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma ha nɛ e gbla dade kpakplaa kɛ hu o ngmɔ mi lo?
Anɛ o maa ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ e he wami ɔ nɔ, konɛ e tsu o ní tsumi kpakpataa a ha mo lo?
Anɛ o heɔ yeɔ kaa e ma kpa ní ha mo, nɛ e kɛ o blɛfo ɔ ma ba wo blɛfo gba mi ha mo lo?
Mo lɛ o ha pu mi klakumi e pɛli saminyayoo ɔ lo?
Duguma tsɛli, kɛ e pɛli ɔmɛ nɛɛ, mo lɛ o ha lɛ?
Duguma siɔ e hluihi ngɛ zugba, konɛ la nɛ jeɔ zu mi ɔ nɛ ha a he nɛ dɔ la.
E hɛ jeɔ nɔ kaa nane ko ma nyɛ maa ywia mɛ, loo pu mi lohwe ko ma ba naa nɔ.
E waa e bimɛ ɔmɛ yi mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ pi e bimɛ ji mɛ.
E hia we lɛ tete kaa e gbo yaka dengme.
Imi Mawu lɛ i pee lɛ kuasia, nɛ i ha nɛ nile bɔ lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se ke e bɔni fo tumi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e muɔɔ okpɔngɔ kɛ e nɔ hilɔ.
Mo Hiob lɛ o ha okpɔngɔ e he wami ɔ lo?
Mo lɛ o ha lɛ bwɔmi gagaa ngɛ e kuɛ he ɔ lo?
Mo lɛ o haa nɛ e tuɔ kaa baalɛ ɔ lo?
Mo lɛ o haa nɛ e fliɔ e gugwɔ mi wawɛɛ kɛ woɔ nɔ he gbeye ɔ lo?
E kɛ bua jɔmi siɔ si glɛi glɛi glɛi ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ e he wami tsuo gbɔɔ fo kɛ yaa ta.
E li nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke fɔ̃; e tui klaate nya fo.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi hii a sibi a he hae ngɛ e se mi; akplɔ kɛ tsɛ̃i hii kpɛe nylamnylam.
Ke titimati ɔ pɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e dɛ si dii; e kɛ hɛdɔ kɛ mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa gbɔɔ fo kɛ yaa ta.
Ke titimati ɔ pɛ kɛkɛ e fli e gugwɔ mi wawɛɛ.
E nuɔ ta he fu ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.
E nuɔ nɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ gbi woe, nɛ ose ngɛ pɛe ngɛ ta a mi.
Mo lɛ o tsɔɔ kayo temi loko e gbɛɛ e pɛlihi a mi, nɛ e teɔ kɛ yaa leneyi je ɔ lo?
Mo lɛ o deɔ kɔle loko e ya peeɔ e tsu ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ lo?
Tɛ sa mi e hiiɔ; lejɛ ɔ ji e we; tɛ sa kɛ e nya piɔpiɔɔpiɔ ɔ ji e mɔ.
Ke e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e hɛngmɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́ kɛ yaa tsitsaa kaa e maa na lohwe ko nɛ e ye lo.
Ke e na lohwe gbogboe ko kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e ya maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nuɔ muɔ.
-Hiob, o ke o kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ maa hua munyu he.
Anɛ o ma ha yi, aloo o maa ya nɔ?
Ha mi heto!
Hiob -I kpa mo pɛɛ, pi nɔ ko kulaa ji mi.
Mɛni heto ma ha mo?
I be munyu tue hu.
I tu munyu pe bɔ nɛ sa nɛ ma tu; i pa be nɔ́ ko dee hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu ekohu kɛ je kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi.
Yawɛ Jehanɛ, da si kaa nyumu!
Ma bi mo sane, nɛ o ha mi heto.
Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o bu mi fɔ kaa i yi dami sane, konɛ moo lɛɛ o wo o he nguɔ kaa o nɔ́ da lo?
Anɛ o ngɛ he wami kaa imi Mawu ɔ lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa wo gbi kaa imi lo?
Ke ja a, dla o he, nɛ o he nɛ pee fɛu.
Wo ablade tade saminyayoo, konɛ o hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami.
Hyɛ he woli!
O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ nɛ o ba mɛ si.
Ee, hyɛ mɛ nɛ o ba mɛ si.
Moo naa yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ ngɛ a hi he ɔmɛ.
Moo pu mɛ tsuo ngɛ tabo zu mi, nɛ o fi a hɛ mi ngɛ gbeje.
Ke o pee ja a, lɛɛ imi hu ma je o yi, nɛ ma de ke o ma nyɛ ma he mo nitsɛ o yi wami.
Hyɛ pa mi suɔ!
I bɔ lɛ, kɛ mo tsuo.
E kpeɔ nga kaa na.
Se hyɛ bɔ nɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he wa ha; hyɛ bɔ nɛ e pani ɔmɛ ti ha!
E hlemi ngɛ tlɔmɔɔ kaa seda tso.
Panihi nɛ hɛɛ e fiɔ ɔmɛ ɔ a he wa saminya.
E wuhi a he wa kaa akɔblee, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa dade.
Lɛ ji ye nibɔ ní ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ pe mɛ tsuo.
E bɔlɔ ɔ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ maa ye e nɔ.
E naa niye ní ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; lejɛ ɔ lɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo ya fiɛɔ ngɛ.
E buɔ si ngɛ mio tsohi a sisi, nɛ e laa e he ngɛ ngɔwuhi a kpɛti ngɛ pa mi.
Mio tso ɔmɛ peeɔ hɔ̃ kɛ haa lɛ, nɛ ngɔwu ɔmɛ bɔleɔ lɛ kɛ kpeɔ ngɛ nyu ɔ mi.
Ke pa a he wa tete po, e yi gbeye.
Ke Yordan pa a nitsɛ fia kɛ ba pue e hɛ mi pohu, e bui tete.
Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa nu lɛ kɛ gbowe lo?
Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa wo e gugwɔ mi ga lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma sá nyaka kɛ gbowe lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ kpa kɛ fi e lilɛ kɛ muɔ si lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ tangme kɛ wo e gugwɔ mi lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo e tsitsa mi lo?
Anɛ e ma kpa mo pɛɛ ke o ngmɛɛ e he lo?
Anɛ e maa fa kue ha mo ke o na lɛ mɔbɔ lo?
Anɛ e kɛ mo maa so kaa e ma sɔmɔ mo daa lo?
Anɛ o kɛ lɛ ma fiɛ kaa a kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ fiɛɔ, aloo o maa fi lɛ ha o mawayi ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ fiɛ lo?
Anɛ jua yeli ma nyɛ maa wo e he jua lo?
Anɛ a maa poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya nɛ a jua ha jua yeli lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi babauu kɛ wo e he womi mi lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ akplɔ kɛ gbɔ e yi mi lo?
Moo ta e he si kake nɛ o hyɛ, nɛ e be mo jloe kaa o ta e he si enyɔne; o hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na nyaka kikɛ nɛ ɔ, sawale maa nu lɛ, nɛ e maa nɔ si bum ngɛ zugba.
Katsɛ ko katsɛ ko be nɛ ma nyɛ maa wo e hɛ mi la.
Ke ja a, lɛɛ mɛnɔ lɛ ma nyɛ maa da imi ye hɛ mi?
Mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ nyaka ya kpe kunɔ hyɛ nɛ e he je mi?
Dɛbi!
Je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be!
Nyaka a, tsa pi fiɛmi lohwe ji lɛ; a je blɔ bɔ lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ he wami saminya.
E nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi, e nanehi, kɛ e kpɔhi yeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma kpɔ e he toto ɔ?
E he womi ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa gbaja nɛ e kpla a, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa hɛ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa gbu lɛ kɛ je kpo?
E nya kɛ e mi lunguhi gbeyegbeye ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma bli?
E he toto saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃ihi nɛ a fi ngɔ bla, nɛ a to mɛ za nɔ za nɔ.
A he wa pe tɛ.
A tsa a sibi a nya pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ po be nyɛe maa gu a kpɛti.
A tsa, nɛ a mɛtɛ a sibi a he saminya, bɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma gba mi.
Ke e tsile kɛkɛ la kpɛ; e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ hleii kaa mɔtu pu la.
La hii tsoe ngɛ e nya mi, nɛ la lilɛhi tuɔ kɛ jeɔ mi pueɔ si.
La su ku jeɔ e gugwɔ puɔhi a mi kaa lamuɔ nɛ jeɔ buɛ, loo kutu nɛ ngɛ fiae mi.
Ke e wo mumi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e haa nɛ hã tsɛ̃ɔ, nɛ la lilɛhi tuɔ kɛ jeɔ e nya mi.
E kuɛ ngɛ kpakpataa; ke o kɛ lɛ kpe ɔ, ja sawale nu mo.
E he womi he wa kpɛkpɛtɛɛ; e be bɔdɔbɔdɔ, nɛ e be tsuãã hulɔ.
E tsui he wa kaa tɛ!
Ee, e tsui he wa kaa wɛ.
Ke e wó e he nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, katsɛmɛ tete po yeɔ gbeye; sawale nuɔ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Klaate ko klaate ko be nɛ maa plaa lɛ.
Akplɔ, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃ ko be nɛ maa ye lɛ awi.
Dade ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ; akɔblee hu ngɛ kaa tso nɛ sa kɛkɛ.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ko be nyɛe maa wo lɛ fo; amlami tɛ ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ.
Tsokpoti ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ, nɛ ke akplɔ ngɛ pɛe kɛ ma a, e muɔɔ.
Totohi nɛ ngɛ e mi si ɔ ngɛ kaa buɛ kokoehi nɛ a nya ba.
E ngmlãã si ngɛ mɔsɔ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ blɛfo lɛ e ngɛ gblɛe.
E haa nɛ wo fiaa kaa nyu ngɛ buɛ mi, nɛ e fiaa hwɔli kaa nu ngɛ tɔ mi.
Ke e be kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e jeɔ blɔ ngɛ e se futaa.
Bɔ nɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ hii kpɛe ha a, o ma de ke wo ɔ puɛ mua.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ngɛ kaa lɛ; e li nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke fɔ̃.
E bui lohwe ko lohwe ko; lohwe nɛ kle kaa mɛni po, e bui.
Lohwehi nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye tsuo a matsɛ ji lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Hiob he nɔ nɛ e kɛ Yawɛ tu munyu.
Hiob Yawɛ, i le kaa he walɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ji mo; o nyɛɔ nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ.
O bi ke kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ i biɔ sane nɛ kɔɔ mo o nile he, be mi nɛ imi lɛɛ i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ?
I tu níhi nɛ i nui sisi a he munyu; nyakpɛ níhi nɛ ye juɛmi sui a he.
O de mi ke ma bu mo tue nɛ o tu munyu, konɛ ma ha mo sanehi nɛ o ma bi mi ɔ a heto.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, níhi nɛ nihi de mi ngɛ o he kɛkɛ lɛ i le, se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ i na mo paa kɛ imi nitsɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i pee ɔ dɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ tabo zu kɛ la zu to okadi kaa i pia ye he niinɛ.
Nyagbe Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu ta a, Yawɛ de Elifaz, Teman no ɔ ke, “Ye mi mi fu o kɛ o huɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo; ejakaa nyɛ tu we ye he anɔkuale munyu kaa bɔ nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Hiob pee ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku kpaago, kɛ agbosu kpaago kɛ ya ye tsɔlɔ Hiob ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya sã sami bɔ ha nyɛ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Hiob maa fa kue ha nyɛ.
Ma bu e kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ i be nyɛ tue gblae bɔ nɛ sa nyɛ kaa nyɛ je kuasia.
Ee, nyɛ tu we ye he anɔkuale munyu kaa bɔ nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Hiob pee ɔ.” Elifaz, Teman no ɔ, Bildad, Shua no ɔ, kɛ Zofar, Naamat no ɔ ho nɛ a ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Nɛ Yawɛ bu Hiob kue fami ɔ tue.
Jehanɛ, benɛ Hiob fa kue ha Yawɛ ngɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ a he se ɔ, Yawɛ wo lɛ ní ekohu.
Níhi tsuo nɛ Hiob hi sa a, Yawɛ bɔ he totoe enyɔɔnyɔ kɛ ha lɛ.
Hiob nyɛminyumuhi, e nyɛmiyihi, kɛ nihi nɛ le lɛ sa a tsuo ba slaa lɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba ye ní ngɛ e we ɔ mi.
A ye lɛ kɔmɔ nɛ a jɔɔ e bua ngɛ haomihi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ba e nɔ ɔ a he.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ke lɛ sika, kɛ sika tsu ga. Yawɛ gbaa Hiob ngɛ nyagbe be nɛ ɔ mi kulaa pe bɔ nɛ e gbaa lɛ kekle ɔ. Hiob ba na to akpe nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ, afukpɔngɔ akpe ekpa, na blablɛ akpe kɛ teji akpe.
Jehanɛ e kpale fɔ binyumuhi kpaago kɛ biyihi etɛ.
E wo e biyo nɔkɔtɔma a biɛ ke Yemima.
Enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji Kezia, nɛ etɛne ɔ biɛ ji Keren Hapuk.
Ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a nɛ yihi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu kaa Hiob biyi ɔmɛ.
A tsɛ ɔ ha mɛ weto ní kaa bɔ nɛ e ha a nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ ɔ. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Hiob kpale ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi eywiɛ ekohu.
E na bimɛ, kɛ bibimɛ hluu kɛ ya si yi nɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ loko e gbo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e bwɔ kotokoto.
NYA TSƆƆMI Baiblo ɔ mi lahi, kɛ sɔlemihi lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Ni munomunohi lɛ a ngma la amɛ, kɛ sɔlemi ɔmɛ ngɛ be slɔɔtohi a mi.
Israel bi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ bua la amɛ, kɛ sɔlemi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ ha a Mawu jami.
Pee se ɔ, a ngɔ la amɛ kɛ piɛ a ngmami ɔmɛ a he.
Mawu jami asilɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɔɔ ní munomunohi a he: Mawu yi jemi, kɛ Mawu jami lahi, kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami, yi baami, kɛ yi wami hemi.
Ní komɛ hu nɛ asilɛ ɔmɛ kɔɔ a he ji yayami he pɛɛ kpami, sina ngɛ Mawu gbaami he, kɛ kue fami kɛ ha he nyɛli a tue gblami.
Kue fami nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛ ha ni kakaaka, kɛ ma a tsuo.
Ekomɛ jeɔ ni kakaaka a tsui mi sanehi kpo, nɛ ekomɛ hu daa si ha Mawu ma a tsuo a hiami níhi, kɛ a tsui mi sanehi.
Yesu ngɔ la amɛ kɛ tsu ní.
Somi He ɔ ngmali ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu wo la amɛ a ta.
Nɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ, La Womi ɔ ba pee jami womi pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha Kristo asafo ɔ. Ngmami ɔ sisi tsɔɔmi komɛ ngma munyunyu “Sela” ngɛ La amɛ ekomɛ a mi.
A li munyunyu nɛ ɔ sisi tutuutu.
Se nya tsɔɔmi ko deɔ ke e maa pee kaa la gbi he blɔ nya tomi ko kɛ ha la tsɔɔlɔ ɔ.
A tsu we munyunyu nɛ ɔ he ní ngɛ Dangme Baiblo ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha A dla la lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo kuu, aloo womi enuɔ mi.
La — La — La — La — La —
KEKLEEKLE WOMI Bua jɔmi kpakpa A gbaa nɔ nɛ bui nimli yayamihi a ga womi tue, nɔ nɛ kɛ yayami peeli bɔɛ, nɛ e hí he fɛu yeli a hi he; se mohu e bua jɔɔ Yawɛ mlaa a he, nɛ e susuɔ he nyɔ kɛ pia.
E ngɛ kaa tso nɛ a du ngɛ pa tue, nɛ woɔ yiblii ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
E bahi gbli we gblegbleegble.
E yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
Se yayami peeli lɛɛ pi ja nɛ a ngɛ; mɛɛ a ngɛ kaa jakati nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ kɛ yaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa gbla yayami peeli a tue, nɛ a kɛ mɛ be dali futue.
Ejakaa Yawɛ buu dali a he, se yayami peeli lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Matsɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu hla a Mɛni ba nɛ je ma amɛ ngɛ basabasa pee?
Mɛni he je lɛ a ngɛ soe yaka gu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee kake.
Nɔ yeli ɔmɛ so ngɔ wo Yawɛ, kɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ e hla a a he.
A ke, “Nyɛ ha wa kpɔ wa he kɛ je a dɛ mi nɛ waa ye wa he.” Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ ngɛ mɛ muɔe.
Ee, Yawɛ ngɛ a he fɛu yee.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ kɛ abofu ma kple a nɔ.
E hɛ maa dɔ; nɛ e ma de mɛ ke, “Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ i ngɔ ye matsɛ ɔ ngɔ to Zion, ye yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.” Matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ɔ, ma sɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ nu.
Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Ye bi ji mo; mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.
Bi mi, nɛ ma ha mo je ma amɛ tsuo; zugba a tsuo ma ba pee o weto ní.
O kɛ dade tso maa gbla a tue.
O maa ywia mɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ kaa a ywiaa buɛ?’ ” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ matsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ kase ní; nyɛ, zugba a nɔ yeli, nyɛɛ bu ga womi tue.
Nyɛ sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ gbeye yemi.
Nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli, nɛ nyɛ kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Ke pi jã a, e mi mi ma fu nyɛ si kake too, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ba saa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ɔ ma na bua jɔmi.
Mɔtu kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye he nyɛli hiɛ ha!
Hyɛ kaa nihi babauu te si kɛ wo mi!
Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji, “Oo, Mawu be e he piɛe fɛɛ!” Se mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i nɛ buɔ ye he daa.
O woɔ mi mumi mi he wami, nɛ o woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami.
Ke i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ɔ, e heɔ nɔ ngɛ e yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
I hwɔɔ si nɛ i hwɔɔ mahe, nɛ i teɔ si ekohu, ejakaa Yawɛ buɔ ye he.
Ke nimli akpeakpe abɔ ba sa ye yi kɛ kpe po, i yi mɛ gbeye.
Yawɛ, ye Mawu, ba he ye yi wami koo!
Ejakaa mo lɛ o ma nyɛ maa fia ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ní.
Mo lɛ o ma nyɛ maa gbla a tue nɛ a be nyɛe maa pee mi nɔ́ ko.
Yawɛ, mo ji wa yi wami helɔ; moo gbaa o ma a koo!
Gbɔkuɛ kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Ye Mawu nɛ faa ye he, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo!
Be ko nɛ ye yi fi ɔ, mo lɛ o ba je mi.
Naa mi mɔbɔ koo, nɛ o bu ye pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue.
Nyɛ nimli adesahi, mɛni be nyɛ ma pue ye hɛ mi si kɛ yaa si?
Nyɛ suɔ níhi nɛ a he be se nami, nɛ lakpa munyuhi a se nyɛ dii.
Kɛ yaa si mɛni be nɛ nyɛ maa hi enɛ ɔ pee?
Se nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Yawɛ hla nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da kɛ ha e he; nɛ ke i tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ.
Ke nyɛ mi mi fu ɔ, nyɛ ko pee yayami.
Ke nyɛ hwɔɔ si ɔ, nyɛɛ pee dii, nɛ nyɛɛ ya nyɛ yi mi.
Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ sa ha Yawɛ; nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.
Nihi babauu biɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ po maa dloo wɔ nɔ́ ko?
Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ koo!” Se imi lɛɛ o ha mi bua jɔmi babauu.
Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a blɛfo kɛ wai ba saminya po, a na we bua jɔmi kaa imi.
Ma hwɔ si nɛ ma hwɔ mahe ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Ejakaa mo, Yawɛ pɛ lɛ o haa nɛ ye he mi jɔɔ mi.
Yawɛ, moo bu ye he Yawɛ, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ huu nɛ i ngɛ faeɔ, o pee he nɔ́ ko ha mi.
Ye matsɛ kɛ ye Mawu!
I ngɛ mo tsɛe!
Bu mi tue koo!
Yawɛ, mɔtu ɔ, o nuɔ ye gbi.
Ee, mɔtu ɔ, i faa kue kɛ haa mo, nɛ i mlɛɔ, konɛ o he nɔ.
Ejakaa pi Mawu nɛ náa nɔ́ yayami he tsui ji mo; yayami kɛ mo hí si.
He nɔ woli be nyɛe maa ba o hɛ mi; o sume nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami.
Mo Yawɛ, o kpataa lakpatsɛmɛ a hɛ mi.
Muɔ si pueli, kɛ nɔ sisili lɛɛ o hiee mɛ kulaa.
Se imi lɛɛ, o mɔbɔ nami, kɛ o dloomi ɔ he je ɔ, ma nyɛ ma ba o we klɔuklɔu ɔ; ma ja mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ gbeye yemi.
Yawɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, piɛ ye he, konɛ ma pee nɔ nɛ da.
Tsɔɔ mi o blɔ ɔ saminya nɛ ma nyɛɛ nɔ.
Ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tu we anɔkuale; yayami hyi a tsui mi tɔ.
A tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ, se lɛ tsuo kɛ gbenɔ ba a. Mawu, buu mɛ fɔ, nɛ o gbla a tue.
Ha nɛ a yi mi tomi yayami ɔmɛ nɛ kpa kɛ bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
Fie mɛ kɛ je o hɛ mi, ejakaa a pee yayamihi gbegbeegbe kɛ si mo, nɛ a tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã.
Se nihi tsuo nɛ ba saa we ngɛ o ngɔ ɔ, ha nɛ a nya, nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi daa.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ mo ɔ, buu a he, konɛ a na bua jɔmi ngɛ o mi.
Yawɛ, o gbaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ o kɛ o suɔmi ɔ buu a he kaa tsɛ̃i.
Yemi kɛ buami ngɛ amanehlu mi Yawɛ, koo ngɔ abofu kɛ ka ye hɛ mi; koo ngɔ mi mi la kɛ gbla ye tue.
Yawɛ naa mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa ye he wami ta.
Yawɛ, tsa mi koo, ejakaa i be he wami, nɛ imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo i hao.
Yawɛ, mɛni be o maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si loko o ma ba he mi?
Yawɛ, ba he ye yi wami koo!
Naa mi mɔbɔ nɛ o kpɔ mi, ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe.
Nɔ ko kaii we mo ngɛ gbeje; mɛnɔ lɛ ma je o yi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ?
Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu ha nɛ i gbɔjɔ; daa nyɔ mi ɔ, ye sa pɔɔ kɛ vo nyu sɔuu; daa nyɔ mi ɔ, i foɔ ya kɛ pɔɔ ye sɔne.
Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ haoɔ mi.
Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu puɛ ye hɛngmɛ, nɛ i hyɛ we nɔ́ kpakpa ko hu.
Nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛɛ je ye nɔ kɛ ya se, ejakaa Yawɛ nu ye ya fomi ɔ. Yawɛ nu ye kue fami ɔ; Yawɛ maa pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ha nɛ a kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ho esɔ!
Dami sane yemi he kue fami Yawɛ, ye Mawu!
I ba sa we ngɛ o ngɔ.
Mo kpɔ mi kɛ je nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi, nɛ o he ye yi wami.
Ke pi ja a, a maa gbla mi kɛ ya he nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi.
Lejɛ ɔ lɛ a ma ya tsɔtslɔɔ mi ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ jata peeɔ ɔ.
-Yawɛ, ye Mawu!
Ke i pee nɔ ko yayami, aloo i wa ye he nyɛlɔ yi mi yaka gu, ke i pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a nyɛɛ ye se nɛ a nu mi.
Ha nɛ a fia mi nɔ nɛ a gbe mi, nɛ a si mi ngɛ zugba.
Yawɛ, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ te si kɛ wo mi; tee si nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ kpe ha mi.
O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ; ejakaa dami sane yemi ji nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ a bua je ma amɛ tsuo a nya kɛ bɔle mo, nɛ o je hiɔwe kɛ ye a nɔ.
Yawɛ, mo ji je ɔ tsuo kojolɔ.
Moo ye ye sane ha mi; o le kaa i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ.
Mawu nɛ yeɔ dami sane ji mo; o le nimli a tsui mi, kɛ a juɛmi mi.
Ha nɛ nimli yayamihi nɛ jɔɔ yayami peemi, konɛ nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ o pee mɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
Mawu ji ye he bulɔ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e heɔ a yi wami.
Mawu ji kojolɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane; daa nɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu yayami peeli.
Ke a tsakee we a tsui ɔ, Mawu maa duɔ e klaate ɔ nya.
E pee e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ klaalo momo, nɛ e kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ nya ba hɔ nya.
E dla awi yemi ní kpahi hu ngɔ to.
Ke yiwutsotsɛ ngɛ nɔ́ yayami susue ɔ, e hii nɔ́ ɔ plɛe ngɛ e yi mi kpamisa kaa bɔ nɛ bimwɔyo hii plɛe ngɛ yohɔyo mi mi ɔ. Nyagbe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ kpo ji lakpa.
E tsuaa muɔ kɛ haa ni kpahi; se muɔ ɔ nɛ e tsua a, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e maa nɔ mi.
E musu maa tloo lɛ nitsɛ; lɛ nitsɛ e yayami ɔ maa ye lɛ awi.
Ma na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e yeɔ dami sane.
Ma la kɛ je Yawɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ yi.
David la Yawɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ!
Hyɛ kaa o biɛ pɛɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ a woɔ o hɛ mi nyami ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!
O haa jokuɛwi, kɛ bimwɔwi he wami nɛ a laa kɛ jeɔ o yi.
O he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa a nya, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ ko.
Ke i susu níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe a he, nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi, ke i hyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o kɛ o nine pee ɔ, i biɔ ke, “Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ adesa, nɛ o susuɔ e he?
Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ bi, nɛ o hyɛɛ e nɔ?” Nɛ́ o bɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ lɛ mo, Mawu ɔ o ngɔ kɛ pe lɛ.
Se o wo e hɛ mi nyami babauu.
O pee lɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o bɔ ɔ a nɔ yelɔ.
O ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo e dɛ mi: tohi, nahi, pu mi lohwehi, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, lohi, kɛ nibɔ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo mi.
Yawɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ!
Hyɛ kaa o biɛ pɛɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Mawu sina la Yawɛ, ma na mo si kɛ ye tsui tsuo; ma sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ. Mawu Ope, o he ɔ, ma la kɛ bua jɔmi; ma la kɛ je o yi.
Benɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpale a se ɔ, a nɔɔ si nɛ a gbo ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Ejakaa o kojoɔ ngɛ dami kɛ anɔkuale nya; o ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, nɛ o wo mi nguɔ.
O ka je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
O kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi, nɛ a biɛ laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata; a ma amɛ hu a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ ma kai mɛ hu.
Se Yawɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ daa; e hii si ngɛ e kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ e kɛ anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane yemi maa kojo je ɔ, kɛ e mi nimli ɔmɛ.
Yawɛ ji wesa he kɛ ha nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi.
Haomi be mi ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ a naa he jɔmi ngɛ.
Yawɛ, nihi nɛ le mo ɔ, a ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ.
Ejakaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ hla o se blɔ ɔ, mo Yawɛ, o kua we mɛ.
Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi; Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ Zion ɔ, nyɛ je e yi.
Nyɛɛ sɛɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ kɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo.
Mawu kaiɔ nɔ́ nali, nɛ e yeɔ a he lue.
Ke nɔ́ nali fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, e nuɔ; e hɛ ji a nɔ.
Yawɛ, mo nɛ o jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ dɛ mi.
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye he nyɛli ngɛ mi haoe ha nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ, konɛ ma na bua jɔmi nɛ ma je o yi ngɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ ma nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o he ye yi wami.
Muɔ ɔ nɛ je ma amɛ tsua a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ mi.
Klama a nɛ a tsɔ kɛ laa a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nane ya du lɛ.
Yawɛ je e he kpo; e ye dami sane, nɛ yayami peeli a nane ya du klama a nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsɔ ɔ. Nimli yayamihi, kɛ mahi tsuo nɛ a hɛ je Mawu nɔ ɔ, a nyagbe ji gbenɔ.
Ejakaa pi daa nɛ hɛ maa je dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ; ohiatsɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi be yaka pee.
Yawɛ, tee si; ko ha nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ye o nɔ!
Ha nɛ a kojo je ma amɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Yawɛ, wo je ma amɛ a he gbeye, konɛ a le kaa nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Dami sane yemi he kue fami Yawɛ, mɛni hɛ mo kɛ ya se tsitsaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ya laa o he ngɛ wa haomi be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ?
Yayami peeli ngɛ a he nɔ woe, nɛ a ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi wae.
Ha nɛ ga yayamihi nɛ a to ɔ nɛ kpa bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
Yayami peelɔ fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ níhi nɛ e tsui suɔ a nɔ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ nɔ ɔ, e gbiɛɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e kuaa lɛ.
Yayami peelɔ ɔ he nɔ womi ha we nɛ e hlaa Mawu se blɔ.
E susumi tsuo ji “Mawu ko be.” Yayami peelɔ yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
E nɛ kaa Mawu tue gblami ko ngɛ ha lɛ.
E he nyɛli lɛɛ, pe e yeɔ a he fɛu.
E deɔ ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi pee; haomi ko be ye nɔ bae gblegbleegble.” Munyuhi nɛ jeɔ e nya ji gbiɛmi kɛ sisimi, kɛ níhi nɛ woɔ nɔ susuma he gbeye.
E he sɔɔ kɛ tuɔ yakayaka munyuhi, kɛ munyuhi nɛ kɛ nɔ woɔ haomi mi.
E woɔ ka ngɛ laami hehi ngɛ kɔpehi a mi, nɛ e gbee nihi nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko yaka gu.
Daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ dae.
E buɔ si ngɛ e laami he ɔ kaa jata ngɛ e muɔ mi.
E woɔ ka nɛ e nuu nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ.
Ke e nine su a nɔ kɛkɛ e gbla mɛ kɛ ho.
E kɛ e he wami tsuo fiaa nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ si.
Nɔ́ nɛ yiwutsotsɛ nɛ ɔ deɔ ngɛ e yi mi ji, “Oo, Mawu hɛ je nɔ; Mawu má e hɛngmɛ; e hyɛ we mi tete po!” Yawɛ Mawu, gbla yayami peeli a tue, nɛ o hɛ ko je nɔ́ nali a nɔ.
Mɛni he je yayami peelɔ ma kua Mawu?
Mɛni he je lɛ e ma de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Oo, e tsa be mi nɔ́ ko pee” ɔ?
Se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hyɛe.
Niinɛ, o ngɛ haomi ɔ, kɛ aywilɛho ɔ hyɛe, nɛ o maa pee he nɔ́ ko kɛ̃.
Nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ, o nɔ lɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.
Mo ji awusahi a he piɛlɔ.
Moo ku yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli a he wami nya, nɛ o gbla a tue kɛ yaa si yayami peemi se maa po.
Yawɛ ji matsɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene.
Je ma amɛ gbo ta e zugba a nɔ.
Yawɛ, hiami níhi nɛ nɔ́ nali kɛ ba fɔ o hɛ mi ɔ, o le.
Moo pee a hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mɛ, konɛ a ná he wami he.
Moo ye awusahi, kɛ nɔ́ nali a sane ha mɛ, konɛ nɔmlɔ adesa kó wo a he gbeye hu.
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ I ba sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ.
Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ deɔ mi ke, “Tee kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Hyɛ, yayami peeli dɔ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ; a pee a kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ klaalo nɛ́ a ma tsɛ̃ dali ngɛ diblii mi.
Be mi nɛ mlaa gbo, nɛ blɔ nya tomi kpakpa be hu ɔ, mɛni dalɔ ma nyɛ maa pee?” Yawɛ ngɛ e we klɔuklɔu ɔ; e matsɛ sɛ ɔ, hiɔwe lɛ e ngɛ.
E hɛngmɛ ngɛ nimli adesahi hyɛe ngɛ he tsuaa he; e le níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee.
Yawɛ kaa dali.
Se yayami peeli, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e sume mɛ kulaa.
Yawɛ ma ha la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege maa je hiɔwe ba pue yayami peeli a nɔ; nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi dɔ la maa fia kɛ wo mɛ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ; e suɔ kaa a pee níhi nɛ da.
Dali maa na e hɛ mi.
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ, moo piɛ wa he, ejakaa nɔmlɔ kpakpa be hu; anɔkualetsɛmɛ ta zugba a nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e nyɛmi lakpa yee.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ munyu ngɔngɔɛ ngɛ e nyɛmi sisie.
Yawɛ, nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ fĩaa a, mo kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
A deɔ ke, “Wa ngɔɔ wa nya mi munyu kɛ naa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ hlae.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa suɔ kaa wa ma de ɔ, wa ma de.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsi wa nya?” Se Yawɛ ke, “Akɛnɛ a ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi wae, nɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe he je ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ ma te si, nɛ ma ha mɛ he jɔmi nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ.” Yawɛ siwo ɔmɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu.
A ngɛ kaa sika hiɔ nɛ a tsu he si kpaago ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi.
-Nimli yayamihi ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ yayami yi jee.
Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ!
Mo je wɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli a dɛ mi.
Nɛ o bu wa he kɛ je yi nɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ ya neneene.
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ, kɛ yaa si mɛni be nɛ o hɛ maa je ye nɔ?
Kɛ yaa neneene lo?
Mɛni be o maa laa mi kɛ yaa si?
Mɛni be ma na nɔ́ kɛ yaa si?
Aywilɛho ma hyi ye tsui mi daa ligbi kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Ye he nyɛli ma ná ye he blɔ daa nɛ kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Yawɛ, ye Mawu!
Moo hyɛ mi, nɛ o ha mi heto.
Ha mi nɔmlɔ tso he wami, konɛ ma ko gbo.
Ke pi ja a, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma de ke, “Wa ye e nɔ.” A ma nya kaa a nine su ye nɔ.
Se imi lɛɛ, o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a, lɔ ɔ nɔ lɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
Ma ná bua jɔmi, ejakaa o ma he ye yi wami.
Ma la kɛ je mo Yawɛ o yi, ejakaa o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
Nɔmlɔ adesa yi mi wa Kuasiahi a susumi ji, “Mawu ko be.” Mɛ tsuo a puɛ; ní yayamihi sɔuu lɛ a peeɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Yawɛ hyɛɛ nimli adesahi ngɛ zugba kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe.
E hyɛɛ kaa e maa na nɔ ko nɛ le nɔ́, nɛ hlaa lɛ Mawu ɔ se blɔ lo.
Se mɛ tsuo a laa blɔ; mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a puɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; dɛbi, nɔ kake ngmelu po be.
Yawɛ ngɛ bie ke, “Yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, anɛ a be juɛmi lo?
A ní tsumi kɛkɛ ji kaa a fia ye ma a ojo, se imi, Yawɛ lɛɛ a tsɛ we ye biɛ.” Sawale nɛ nya wa maa nu mɛ; ejakaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu kɛ mɛ ngɛ.
Ke yayami peeli ha nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a yi mi tomi pee basaa a, a ma ya sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ̃.
Mɛnɔ maa je Zion ba he Israel yi wami?
Yawɛ ma a nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ, ke lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ kpale mɛ kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, Israel ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ Yakob ma nya.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ Yawɛ, mɛnɔ maa hi o bo tsu ɔ mi?
O yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ maa hi lejɛ ɔ?
Nɔ nɛ piami ko be e he, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ anɔkuale sisiisi, nɛ e yi nɔ he sieku.
Nɔ nɛ tu we nɔ he munyu, nɛ e pee we e nyɛmi yayami.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ yayami peeli, nɛ e woɔ nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ a hɛ mi nyami.
Nɔ nɛ ke e ka kita, nɛ e kpale we e nya se, ke ji kaa lɔ ɔ maa pee haomi ha lɛ po.
Nɔ nɛ ke e pa sika ha nihi ɔ, e he we hekpa.
Nɔ nɛ he we nyɔ mi ní nɛ e kɛ ye odase ngɔ si nihi nɛ yi fɔ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he sae.
Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ Mawu, moo bu ye he, ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.
I de Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, ye Nyɔmtsɛ ji mo; o se ɔ, i pa be nɔ́ kpakpa ko hu.” Hyɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ e ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ha!
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ i naa a he bua jɔmi.
Nihi nɛ a he sɔɔ kɛ ya nyɛɛɔ mawu kpahi a se ɔ, a haomi maa hiɛ babauu.
I be mɛ futue kɛ pee a tɛlimi kusumi ɔmɛ; i be a biɛ ta woe tete.
Yawɛ ji ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; lɛ nɛ e haa mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ye nɔ hwɔɔ se hu, Yawɛ dɛ mi lɛ e ngɛ.
O ke mi ní kpakpahi babauu; niinɛ, i ngɛ weto ní kpakpahi.
Ma je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa e ha mi juɛmi.
Nyɔ mi po, ye he nile kɛ mi tuɔ munyu.
I susuɔ Yawɛ he daa.
Nɛ́ Yawɛ ngɛ ye kasa nya nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi pee.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo, i na bua jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi.
Ejakaa o maa bu ye he, nɛ gbenɔ he wami be ye he blɔ nae.
Nɔ nɛ o suɔ lɛ ɔ, o be e he ngmɛɛe nɛ e hɛ mi nɛ kpata.
O maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ ɔ nɛ yaa wami mi ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ o hɛ mi ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi nitsɛnitsɛ, bua jɔmi nɛ se be poe kɛ maa ya neneene.
David fa kue ha Mawu Yawɛ, moo piɛ ye he koo!
Hyɛ kaa i yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ i sisi we nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu kue nɛ i ngɛ fae kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ ɔ tue.
Mo nɛ́ o yeɔ dami sane, moo wo mi nguɔ koo!
Ke o hyɛ ye tsui mi, ke o ba slaa mi nyɔ mi nɛ o ka mi ɔ, o be yayami ko nae ngɛ ye he.
Ye munyu peeɔ anɔkuale; nɔ́ ko piɛ we he.
I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ i kɛ basabasa peeli bɔɛ.
O blɔ ɔ nɔ lɛ i nyɛɛɔ daa; i sane we kɛ ji nɔ hyɛ gblegbleegble.
Mawu, i ngɛ kue fae kɛ ngɛ mo hae, ejakaa i le kaa o maa pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
Lɛɛ mo plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee mi mɔ, konɛ o nu ye munyu ɔmɛ.
Mo je o nyakpɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ ɔ; nɛ o kpɔ mɛ kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi.
Moo baa ye yi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ baa lɛ nitsɛ e hɛngmɛ yi ɔ. Ngɔɔ mi kɛ laa ngɛ o pɛli hɔ̃ ɔ sisi, kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi, kɛ je ye he nyɛli nɛ bɔle mi ɔ a dɛ mi.
Mɔbɔ nami ko be a mi; he nɔ womi munyuhi lɛ jeɔ a nya.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ a sa ye yi; a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ ká mi, konɛ a tsɛ̃ mi kɛ fɔ si.
A ngɛ kaa jatahi nɛ ya wo mi ká; a ngɛ mlɛe nɛ a tsɔtslɔɔ mi.
Yawɛ, yaa nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya kpe nɛ o ye a nɔ.
Ngɔɔ o klaate ɔ kɛ kpɔ mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛi.
Jé mi kɛ je nihi nɛ ná je nɛ ɔ mi níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ a dɛ mi.
Ngɔɔ haomihi nɛ o ngɔ to ha mɛ ɔ kɛ gbla a tue.
Ha nɛ a bimɛ ba na haomi ɔ bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ eko nɛ piɛ ha a bibimɛ.
Se imi lɛɛ ma na o hɛ mi, ejakaa i pee we yayami ko.
Nɛ ke ye hɛ tsɛ ɔ, ma ná bua jɔmi babauu kaa i na mo hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.
David manye la Yawɛ, i suɔ mo!
Mo ji ye yi baalɔ.
Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ ye yi wami; ye tɛ sa, kɛ ye mɔ nguaa.
Lɛ ji ye Mawu, kɛ ye wesa he.
Yawɛ ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i kɛ ha mi; e buɔ ye he, nɛ e haa nɛ i yeɔ ye he.
Ma tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e ma je mi kɛ maa je ye he nyɛli a dɛ mi.
A je Yawɛ yi!
Gbenɔ oslaa bɔle mi kɛ kpe; niinɛ, nimli yayamihi babauu bɔle mi kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
Gbeje kpa amɛ fi mi, nɛ gbenɔ tsɔ mi klama.
Ngɛ ye haomi be ɔ mi ɔ, i tsɛ Yawɛ.
I tsɛ ye Mawu, nɛ i de lɛ ke e piɛ ye he.
E nu ye gbi ngɛ e we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ e bu ye kue fami ɔ tue.
Kɛkɛ nɛ zugba mimiɛ, nɛ yo ɔmɛ a sisi tomi ɔmɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ je a blɔ hehi, nɛ a mimiɛ, ejakaa Yawɛ mi mi fu.
La su ku hia kɛ je e gugwɔ puɔhi a mi; la nɛ ngɛ tsoe je e nya mi, nɛ hã nɛ tsɛ̃ je e mi.
E ha nɛ hiɔwe nya ba si, nɛ e kple si; nɛ diblii kpii ngɛ e nane sisi.
E hi kerub nɔ kɛ te; e he sɔ kɛ nyɛɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ ba.
E ngɔ diblii kɛ ha e he kaa bo, nɛ bɔku kpii kɛ e mi nyu gbagbaagba ha e yi nɔ.
Gbiɛ ngo ngu, kɛ la je oslabai mi ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ gblee bɔku kpii ɔ mi kɛ be.
Jehanɛ Yawɛ ha hiɔwe si; Hiɔwe No ɔ wo gbi; gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ, nɛ oslabai gba.
Ee, e tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa.
E ha nɛ oslabai gba, nɛ a pee basaa.
Yawɛ, benɛ o ké o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ o kɛ abofu wo gbi ɔ, nyu dɔ ɔmɛ je kpo, nɛ je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ fɔɔ si paa.
Yawɛ sɔ́le e nine kɛ je hiɔwe; e nu mi, nɛ e gbla mi kɛ je nyu babauu ɔ mi.
E kpɔ mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi; e je mi kɛ je nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ mi ɔ a dɛ mi.
Niinɛ, a he wa pe mi.
A ba tua mi ngɛ ye haomi ligbi ɔ nɔ, se Yawɛ hede ha mi.
E ngɔ mi kɛ ba he nɛ he jɔmi ngɛ.
E he ye yi wami, ejakaa e suɔ mi.
Yawɛ wo mi hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa, ejakaa i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Yawɛ gbaa mi, ejakaa ye he tsɔ.
I ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ i pee we yayami ko kɛ puɛ i kɛ ye Mawu ɔ wa kpɛti.
I ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ; i tɔ̃ we ekoeko.
Yayami ko yayami ko be ye he; i yi fɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbaa mi; ejakaa ye he tsɔ, nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Yawɛ, nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, o jeɔ o he si kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa anɔkualetsɛ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, o jeɔ o he si kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa dalɔ.
Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, o jeɔ o he si kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa o he tsɔ.
Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ o ha we mɛ hɛ mi kulaa.
Nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, o heɔ a yi wami.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ a he nɔ lɛɛ o baa mɛ si.
Ejakaa mo Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ, mo lɛ o haa mi la.
Mo lɛ o fieɔ diblii kɛ jeɔ ye he.
Mo Mawu, o he wami nya a, ma nyɛ ma tu gbogbo kɛ ya tua ye he nyɛli, nɛ ma ye a nɔ.
Mawu nɛ ɔ loo!
E ní peemi níhi hi kɛ pi si.
Ke e wo si ɔ, e baa mi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ya saa we ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, e buu a he.
Se mɛnɔ ji Mawu ngɛ Yawɛ se?
Mɛnɔ ji tɛ sa?
Pi wa Mawu ɔ lo?
Lɛ ji Mawu nɛ haa mi he wami; lɛ nɛ haa ye blɔ daa mi.
Lɛ nɛ haa nɛ ye nane nya sɔɔ kaa odabɔ nane nya.
E ngɔ mi ngɔ to yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
E tsɔɔ mi ta hwumi níhi a he ní tsumi; akɔblee kɛ̃ɛ̃ po ma nyɛ ma tsɛ̃.
Yawɛ, o bu ye he, nɛ o he ye yi wami; o hyɛ ye nɔ saminya, nɛ i pee nɔmlɔ.
O pɛtɛ ye he wawɛɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ ha nɛ i ye ye he.
