WOMI ETƐNE Mawu yeɔ dami sane Niinɛ, Mawu hi ha Israel; e hi ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsui mi tsɔ.
Se imi lɛɛ, e piɛ bɔɔ jinɛ i laa blɔ; e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ ye hemi kɛ yemi ta.
Ejakaa ye hɛ kɔ he nɔ woli, kɛ yayami peeli a nɔ benɛ i na kaa a ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ je mi ɔ.
A he ko he ko yi mɛ ɔ, a ngɛ he wami; a ngɛ kpakpataa.
Haomi bɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e baa ni kpahi a nɔ ɔ.
A nɛ nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ ni kpahi naa nɔ́ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, he womi ji kuɛ ní nɛ a kɛ fɔ a kuɛ.
Yi mi wami ji bo nɛ mɛɛ a haa.
Yayami hyi a tsui mi; daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ga yaya toe.
A yeɔ nɔ he fɛu, nɛ a tuɔ nɔ he munyu yaya.
A woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a toɔ gahi nɛ a kɛ waa nihi yi mi.
A tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe.
A sibi nimli adesahi lɛɛ a kɛ mɛ tuɔ munyu basabasa bɔ nɛ a suɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a ya nyɛɛ a se, ejakaa a nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ngɛ a he.
Nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ ji, “Oo, Mawu be lee!
Hiɔwe No ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ le kɛɛ?” Hyɛ, bɔ nɛ yayami peeli ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a ngɛ ní nae kɛ ngɛ he bɔe.
Hyɛ kaa i tsu ye he nɛ mu ko be ye he!
Hyɛ kaa i pee ye he klɔuklɔu!
Lɛɛ tse enɛ ɔ tsuo peeɔ yaka?
Mawu, o haa nɛ i naa nɔ́ ligbi ɔ tsuo; o gblaa ye tue daa mɔtu.
Se ke i de nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i tɔ, nɛ i pee we ye ní kaa o ma mi no.
I hla bɔ nɛ ma pee nɛ ma kɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi, se ye juɛmi sui he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i ya mo Mawu ɔ, o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ i ya na bɔ nɛ yayami peeli a nyagbe maa ba ha ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ee, o maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ to hehi nɛ saneɔ; o maa tsɛ̃ mɛ kɛ fia si nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Ee, a hɛ mi ma kpata si kake too; a nyagbe maa pee gbeye.
A ngɛ kaa nlami nɛ nɔ ko nla; mɔtu kɛkɛ e se po.
Nyɔmtsɛ, ke o te si ɔ, a maa laa.
Benɛ i hao, nɛ i ngɛ tsui yee ɔ, i je kuasia; i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; i pee kaa lohwe ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma hi o kasa nya daa; o maa pɛtɛ ye he.
O maa wo mi ga, nɛ o maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ.
Nyagbe ɔ, o ma he mi atuu, nɛ o maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
Mɛnɔ i pa ngɛ ngɛ hiɔwe pe mo?
O se ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ hu.
Ke ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbɔjɔ, nɛ ye tsui ta a, Yawɛ maa wo mi he wami, ejakaa lɛ ji ye nɔ́ fɛɛ nɔ́, nɛ e kɛ mi maa hi si daa.
Nihi nɛ kua mo ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ yi mo anɔkuale ɔ, o ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Se imi lɛɛ e hi kaa ma hɛ mi kɛ su Mawu he.
Ma ya sa we ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɔ, nɛ ma sɛɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo.
Ma a fa kue ha Mawu Mawu, mɛni he je lɛ o hɛ wɔ ngɔ fɔ he ɔ?
Anɛ o mi mi ma fu mo nitsɛ o ma a daa kikɛ nɛ ɔ lo?
Mo kai mo nitsɛ o ma nɛ o he kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ. Mo kai nihi nɛ o je kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi, nɛ o pee mɛ mo nitsɛ o ma a. Mo kai Zion yo ɔ, he nɛ o hi sa a. Moo nyɛɛ kɛ ya he nɛ plɛ pee we doku ɔ; he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpata níhi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ o we ɔ. O he nyɛli ɔmɛ ya he ose ngɛ o he klɔuklɔu ɔ.
A ngɔ a we aflangaa amɛ ya to lejɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye kunimi.
A ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ ngɔ gbiɛ kɛ ngɛ tso hɛɛe ngɛ pu mi.
A ngɔ gbiɛ kɛ hamle kɛ ku tsohi nɛ a kpɛ ɔ tsuo a mi dukuduku.
A hule o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ a mɛ he la.
He nɛ a jaa mo ngɛ ɔ, a ble lejɛ ɔ.
A to kaa a ma kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Zugba a nɔ hehi nɛ a kpee ngɛ nɛ a jaa Mawu ɔ, a mɛ lɛ tsuo he la.
Wa pa nɛ okadi ko hu; gbalɔ ko gbalɔ ko be hu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko hu li be nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se maa po.
Mawu, kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa muɔ mo?
Anɛ a maa gbe o biɛ ɔ he guɛ kɛ maa ya neneene lo?
Mɛni he je lɛ o bɛ nɛ o ba piɛ wa he?
Mɛni he je lɛ o bua o nine nya?
Se Mawu, kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, mo ji wa matsɛ; o he wa yi wami be babauu.
O kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ gba wo ɔ mi, nɛ o ywia wo mi lohwe gbeyegbeye ɔmɛ a yi.
Lohwe ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Leviatan ɔ, mo lɛ o ywia e yi, nɛ o ngɔ e he lo ɔ ngɔ ha nga nɔ lohwehi nɛ a ye.
O ha nɛ pa tsɔwitsɔwihi hia kɛ be, nɛ pa nguahi lɛɛ a mi nyu mii ta.
Mo lɛ o bɔ nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ o ngɔ pu kɛ hlami ngɔ to a blɔ hehi.
Mo lɛ o to huzu kɛ ha je ɔ; o pee latsa be kɛ fĩɛ be.
Se Yawɛ mo kai kaa o he nyɛli ɔmɛ muɔɔ mo; nimli nɛ li Mawu ngɛ o biɛ he guɛ gbee.
Koo ngmɛɛ o ma nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ he kɛ ha a he nyɛli yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
O ma nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ.
Mo kai somi nɛ o kɛ wɔ so ɔ. Zugba a nɔ hehi nɛ wo diblii ɔ, yi wu tso níhi lɛ a peeɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, ko ha zo nɛ gbe mɛ.
Ha nɛ nɔ́ nali, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ a je o yi.
Mawu, wo o he nɔ nɛ o kɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ to ní.
Mo kai kaa nihi nɛ li mo Mawu ɔ, a yeɔ o he fɛu daa nɛ.
Munyuhi nɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tuɔ kɛ siɔ mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je nɔ.
Nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ mo ɔ, ngmlaa nɛ a kpaa kɛ woɔ o yi ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, pe ngmlaa a ngɛ nɔ yae.
Mawu ji kojolɔ Mawu lee, wa naa mo si.
Wa naa mo si!
Wa ngɛ o biɛ ta woe, nɛ wa ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ jajee.
Mawu ke, “I to be nɛ ma kojo je ɔ; ke be ɔ su ɔ, ma ye dami sane.
Je ɔ kɛ e mi níhi tsuo ma mimiɛ; se imi ma ha je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ maa ma si kpɛii.
I ngɛ he nɔ woli dee ke, ‘Nyɛ ko fĩa!’ I ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ dee ke, ‘Nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ!’ Nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ kɛ si Hiɔwe No ɔ; nyɛ ko wo nyɛ kuɛ nɔ kɛ tu he nɔ womi munyu.” Ejakaa, ke a ma ha nɔ ko blɔ nya, aloo a ma wo e nɔ ɔ, he wami nɛ ɔ, pi beleku je, loo bonyoku je, loo omleyi je nɛ e je.
Mawu ji kojolɔ; e woɔ ni komɛ a nɔ, nɛ e baa ni komɛ si.
Yawɛ hɛɛ kplu ko ngɛ e dɛ mi, nɛ dã kpakpa nɛ nya wa hyi lɛ tɔ.
E maa po dã nɛ ɔ ha nimli yayamihi tsuo, nɛ a maa hi nue hluu kɛ yaa si dã a sisi tɔɔ.
Se imi lɛɛ ma ye Yakob Mawu ɔ he odase kɛ maa ya neneene; ma la kɛ je e yi daa.
E maa ba nimli yayamihi a he wami ɔ si; se nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ e ma ha nɛ a na he wami kɛ bɔ he.
Mawu ye kunimi A le Mawu ngɛ Yuda, a woɔ e biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ Israel.
E we ngɛ Yerusalem, Zion ji he nɛ e hii.
Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e ku he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta hwumi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ: kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi, kɛ tsɛ̃i, kɛ klaate.
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ o hɛ mi ba nyami; hyɛ bɔ nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye benɛ o gbe he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ o je yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma a.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a da ta a nya kulaa.
A gbo kɛ pueɔ si kaa nihi nɛ hwɔ mahe nɛ a kpakpaa a he níhi tsuo.
Benɛ mo Yakob Mawu ɔ wo gbi ɔ, okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ tsuo gbo kɛ pue si.
Niinɛ, o he ngɛ gbeye!
Ke o mi mi fu ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ o hɛ mi maa da?
O kojo, nɛ a nu he kɛ je hiɔwe tɔɔ; je ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ e pee dii.
Mo Mawu ɔ, o gbla yayami peeli a tue, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ o fa a he.
Edom bi nɛ a mi mi fu ɔ, niinɛ, a ma je o yi kɛ̃.
Nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Harmat ɔ maa ye o nyami be ɔmɛ.
Nyɛɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ si, nɛ nyɛɛ ye siwo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ bɔle Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nike ní ba ha lɛ.
Ganɔhi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, e baa mɛ si; e woɔ matsɛmɛ nguanguahi hu a he gbeye.
Bua womi ngɛ haomi be mi I fa kue boboobo ha Mawu; i fa kue ha Mawu, nɛ e nu ye gbi.
Benɛ i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, i hla Nyɔmtsɛ se blɔ.
Nyɔ mi ɔ, i wo ye nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ i sɔle nɛ ye kɔni gbo we.
I na we bua jɔmi ko kulaa.
Benɛ ye hɛ ba Mawu nɔ, nɛ i bɔni ye yi mi susumi ɔ, ye susuma hao, nɛ i fa huu.
Nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo i hwɔ we mahe, kikɛ nɛ ɔ ye hɛngmɛ fɔɔ si paa.
I hao tsɔ, nɛ i nyɛ we ma tu munyu.
Ye juɛmi ya su blema lokoo, nɛ i kai jehahi nɛ be kɛ ho.
Nyɔ mi tsuo i susu ye yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ ye susuma pee vii.
I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “Anɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kua wɔ daa nɛ lo?
Anɛ e pa be wa he bua jɔmi nae hu lo?
Anɛ e mɔbɔ nami ɔ se po jehanɛ lo?
Anɛ e pa be e si womi ɔmɛ a nɔ yee hu lo?
Anɛ Mawu hɛ je nɔ kaa e maa na mɔbɔ lo?
Anɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ abofu ba da mɔbɔ nami nane mi lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ hɛdɔ bi ke, “Anɛ Mawu hiɔ nine ɔ tsu we ní hu lo?
Anɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ pa be he wami ko hu lo?” Se kɛ̃, Yawɛ, i kai níhi nɛ o tsu blema a; ee, i kai nyakpɛ ní nguahi nɛ o pee ɔ. Ma susu níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ a he; nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee blema a, ma kai.
Mawu, o níhi tsuo ngɛ klɔuklɔu!
Te Mawu nɔ́ nɛ pa kle kaa mo, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ?
Mawu nɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní ji mo; o je o he wami kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ je ɔ tsuo.
O ngɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ he o ma a yi wami; ee, o he Yakob kɛ Yosef a bimɛ ɔmɛ a yi wami.
Mawu, benɛ pa a na mo ɔ, e ye gbeye, nɛ wo ɔ sisi mimiɛ.
Hiɔmi nɛ kɛ je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi pue si.
Hiɔwe si, nɛ oslabai gba kɛ bɔle si.
Hiɔwe si kplala-la-la kɛ po si kaa lasiogblee nɛ bee.
Oslabai la a ha nɛ je ɔ mi pee heii, nɛ zugba a mimiɛ.
O nyɛɛ kɛ gu wo ɔ mi; o po wo nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ kɛ be, se o nane mami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li.
O ngɔ Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ to o ma a nya, nɛ o kpaka mɛ kaa to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to.
Mawu kɛ e ma a Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ ɔ tue; nyɛɛ bu ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ tue.
Ma tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi; ma gba nyɛ blema nyakpɛ sanehi: níhi nɛ wa le, nɛ wa nu, níhi nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ de wɔ.
Wa be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔe kɛ laa wa bimɛ.
Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ, ní nguanguahi nɛ Yawɛ tsu, nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee, kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, wa maa gba mɛ.
E ha Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa; ee, e ngɔ e munyu ɔ kɛ ha Yakob nina a. E fa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke a tsɔɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ mlaa a, konɛ yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ nɛ kase, nɛ mɛ hu a tsɔɔ a bimɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ.
Níhi nɛ e tsu ha mɛ ɔ, a hɛ be nɔ jee, nɛ a maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ daa; konɛ a ko ba wa tue, nɛ a ko ba tsɔ atuã kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ. Mɛɛ a ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ kɛ pi si; anɔkuale hu a yi lɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
Efraim bi ɔmɛ mia, nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃, se benɛ ta hwumi be ɔ su ɔ, a ma fo kɛ je ta a nya.
Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ; e mlaa a hu a kua nɔ yemi.
Níhi nɛ e tsu ha mɛ, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee nɛ a na a, a hɛ je lɛ tsuo nɔ.
Mawu pee nyakpɛ ní babauu ngɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, ngɛ Zoan nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Egipt zugba a mi.
E gba wo ɔ mi, nɛ nyu ɔ da si glekugleku ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ; nɛ e ha nɛ e ma a gu mi kɛ be.
Piani ɔ, e kɛ bɔku tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nyɔ mi lɛɛ e haa mɛ la nɛ hii kpɛe.
E gba tɛ sahi a mi ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ nyu babauu nɛ a nu.
E ha nɛ nyu je tɛ sa mi babaaba kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
Se kɛ̃, a ya nɔ pee yayami kɛ si Mawu; a tsɔ atuã kɛ si Hiɔwe No ɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.
A bi Mawu ke e ha mɛ niye ní nɛ mɛɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi ka Mawu.
A tu munyu kɛ si Mawu, nɛ a bi ke, “Anɛ Mawu ma nyɛ ma ha wɔ niye ní ngɛ nga a nɔ lo?
Niinɛ, e fia tɛ sa a nɔ́ nɛ nyu je mi kɛ be babaaba kaa pa nɛ hia.
Se anɛ e ma nyɛ ma ha e ma a abolo, kɛ lo hu lo?” Benɛ Yawɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E ngɔ la kɛ gbla e ma a tue; e mi mi fumi ɔ nya bɛ si kulaa.
Ejakaa a ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ; a he we yi kaa e ma he a yi wami.
Se kɛ̃, e fa, nɛ hiɔwe sinya amɛ bli.
E ha mɛ ngma kɛ je hiɔwe; ee, e ha mɛ mana nɛ a ye.
Mawu ha mɛ niye ní babauu; ee, adesahi na Mawu bɔfohi a niye ní lɛ a ye.
E ha nɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ fia ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ e he wami kpaka leneyi kɔɔhiɔ kɛ ba.
E ha nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ je hiɔwe ba, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia.
Lohwe ɔmɛ ba nɔɔ si ngɛ ma sito he ɔ, ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he kɛ bɔle lejɛ ɔ tsuo.
Mawu ha ma a niye ní nɛ a tsui suɔ, nɛ a ye, nɛ a tɔ saminya.
Se benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, nɛ a na we nɛ a gbe nya a, Mawu mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e gbe a kpɛti katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji Israel nihewi kpakpa amɛ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, ma a ya nɔ pee yayami.
Nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ a se ɔ, a he we lɛ yi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e po a wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti, nɛ dengme, kɛ nɔ́ nami sɔuu lɛ ngɛ mi.
Be tsuaa be nɛ e maa gbe a ti ni komɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ma hla e se blɔ.
A ma pia a he, nɛ a maa fa kue ha lɛ.
A ma kai kaa Mawu ji a he bulɔ; a ma kai kaa Mawu, Hiɔwe No ɔ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ a yi wami.
Se munyuhi nɛ jeɔ a nya a, lakpa sɔuu; a de we nɔ́ ko kɛ ji a tsui mi.
A yi lɛ anɔkuale ɔ, somi nɛ e kɛ mɛ so ɔ hu a yi nɔ.
Se akɛnɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji Mawu he je ɔ, e ngɔ a he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ e kpataa we a hɛ mi.
Behi fuu ke e mi mi miɔ nɛ e ma fu, kɛkɛ e tsi nya amlɔ.
E kaiɔ kaa adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ; a ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ fia kɛ be nɛ kpale we e se kɛ bɛ hu.
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ a tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã si abɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ!
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ a pee lɛ nidɔ ní si abɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ!
A ka Mawu nɔtonɔto; a wo Israel nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ mi mi la.
A kaii we e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hu; ligbi ɔ nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ hu a hɛ je nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ Zoan nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ Egipt.
E ha nɛ pa amɛ plɛ pee muɔ, nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyu nɛ a nu.
E ha nɛ pwɔlwɔɛ ba babauu, nɛ a ba hao ma mi bi ɔmɛ.
Ovɔnɔhi babauu hu ba jã kɛ̃, nɛ a ba puɛ ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
E ngɔ a ngmɔ ní ɔmɛ ngɔ ha baalɛhi; a tsu ní ha baalɛhi nɛ a ye.
E kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu gbe a wai tso ɔmɛ; a ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ lɛɛ, e kɛ fiɛ nɛ nya wa gbe mɛ.
E kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu gbe a na amɛ; a to ɔmɛ lɛɛ e kɛ oslabai gbe mɛ.
E mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ abofu nɛ ɔ ngɔ haomi babauu kɛ ba a nɔ kaa Mawu bɔfohi kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.
E mi mi la a nya bɛ si; e ngɔɛ a he kɛ ki mɛ hulɔ.
Se mohu e kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kpata a hɛ mi.
E gbe bitɛtehi tsuo ngɛ we tsuaa we mi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Se lɛ nitsɛ e ma a lɛɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ kaa to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to.
E hɛɛ mɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ nɛ a yi gbeye.
Se a he nyɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ wo ɔ ku kɛ pue a nɔ.
E ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba e yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
E kɛ mɛ ba yo ɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ e he wami kɛ kpɔ ɔ nɔ.
E fie ma je li ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi.
E dla a zugba a ngɔ ha e ma a, nɛ lejɛ ɔ ba pee a weto ní, kɛ a hi he.
Se a ka Mawu, Hiɔwe No ɔ; a tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã, nɛ a yi e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
A je Mawu se; a yi lɛ anɔkuale kɛ pi si kaa a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.
A gba kɛ je e blɔ ɔ nɔ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ mi dɔ nɛ nyɛ we nɛ e ya e hɛ mi tɛɛ.
A kɛ a jami he ɔmɛ wo e mi mi la, nɛ a we amaga amɛ ha nɛ e pee kaa hunga jelɔ.
Benɛ Mawu na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu, nɛ e kua e ma a pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
E si e sihi he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Shilo ɔ, bo tsu ɔ nɛ e hi mi ngɛ e ma a kpɛti ɔ. E ngmɛ blɔ nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ho ma se ya.
E he wami ɔ, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ we okadi ji kikɛmɛ a somi daka nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E mi mi fu lɛ nitsɛ e ma a wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha a he nyɛli nɛ a gbe mɛ kɛ klaate.
La kpata nihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ nyumuhi nɛ a gba.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ gbo ngɛ klaate nya, nɛ a yalɔyi ɔmɛ yi kɔmɔ ha mɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ te si pam kaa nɔ ko nɛ je mahe mi, aloo oblai nɛ nu dã, nɛ ngɛ huhui kpae.
E wo e he nyɛli ɔmɛ fo kɛ ho kɛ zo; e bɔ mɛ ahlua kɛ yaa neneene.
E kua Yosef nina a; e hlɛ Efraim wɛtso ɔ. Mohu ɔ, e hla Yuda wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Zion yo ɔ nɛ e suɔ saminya a. Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e ma e we klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ.
We nɛ ɔ ngɛ he wami, nɛ e maa hi si daa kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba ngɛ ɔ pɛ.
E hla e tsɔlɔ David hulɔ; e je lɛ kɛ je to lɛmi he ɔ. E je lɛ kɛ je to yihi, kɛ a bi tsɔwitsɔwihi a se.
E wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ Israel, konɛ e hyɛ lɛ, Mawu ɔ e ma a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to ɔ. David hyɛ ma a nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
E nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kpaka mɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
Ga, kɛ anɔkuale yemi lɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.
Kue fami kɛ ha ma a yi wami hemi Mawu, ma je li ɔmɛ ba tua o zugba a.
A ble o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ a pee Yerusalem ma doku.
A ngɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a ye.
A ngɔ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he lo kɛ ha pu mi lohwehi.
A pue o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a muɔ si babauu; muɔ be ngɛ Yerusalem kaa nyu, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa pu gbogboe ɔmɛ.
Je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ bɔ wɔ ahlua; a muɔ wɔ, nɛ a ye wa he fɛu.
Yawɛ, mɛni be o mi mi ma fu wɔ kɛ yaa si?
O mi mi ma fu wɔ kɛ maa ya neneene lo?
Anɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ ma tsa nɔ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ gbo we lo?
Je mahi nɛ li mo, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ja we mo ɔ, o mi mi nɛ fu mɛ.
Ejakaa a gbe o ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpata o zugba a hɛ mi.
Koo ngɔ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ gbla wa tue.
Pee esɔ nɛ o na wɔ mɔbɔ, ejakaa wa kɔni mi jɔ̃.
Mawu, piɛ wa he nɛ o he wa yi wami.
Mo he wɔ, nɛ o ngɔ wa he yayami kɛ pa wɔ kɛ wo mo nitsɛ o biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Mɛni he je lɛ je ma amɛ ma bi wɔ ke, “Jije nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ?” Je mahi nɛ pue o tsɔli ɔmɛ a muɔ si ɔ, gbla a tue nɛ waa na kɛ wa hɛngmɛ.
Yawɛ, pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe; bu tue!
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi ɔ, ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ kpɔ mɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ, je mahi tsuo nɛ ye o he fɛu ɔ, gbla a tue si kpaago kɛ to nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ nya.
Ke o pee ja a, wɔ, o ma a, o to kuu ɔ, wa maa na mo si, nɛ wa ma je o yi daa.
Kue fami kɛ ha ma a si tomi ekohu Israel to hyɛlɔ, mo nɛ o nyɛɛɔ Israel hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to ɔ, moo bu wɔ tue koo!
Mo nɛ o hii si ngɛ hɛ kali a nɔ ɔ, je o he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Efraim, Benyamin, kɛ Manase wɛtso ɔmɛ.
Je o he wami ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ; ba nɛ o ba he wa yi wami!
Mawu, kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu!
O ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ maa wo o mi mi la kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Ngma nɛ o haa wɔ nɛ wa yeɔ wa tɔɔ, kɛ nyu hu nɛ wa nuɔ kɛkɛ ji vo nyu.
Je mahi nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ, o haa nɛ a kɛ wɔ ba pleeɔ wa zugba a he, nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ muɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ a suɔ.
Mawu Tabohiatsɛ, kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami.
O ngɔ wai tso kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba.
O fie je ma amɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ, nɛ o ma wai tso ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. O dla zugba a saminyayoo; o ha nɛ tso ɔ tsɛ̃ sipoku kɛ ya zu mi tsitsaa, nɛ wai tso ɔ ha zugba a nɔ tsuo.
E hɔ̃ ɔ ha yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ hu ha seda tso nguangua amɛ a nɔ.
E gba kɔni kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ, ee, kɛ ya su Yufrate pa a he tɔɔ.
Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o gbɛ piɛ ɔ ngɛ e he?
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ gbaa ya tsɔɔ wai yiblii ɔ eko.
Nga mi kpotoohi ngɛ wai yiblii ɔ hɛ mi kpatae, nɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo ngɛ yee.
Mawu Tabohiatsɛ!
Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kpale kɛ ba wa ngɔ ekohu.
Moo ma o yi si ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o hyɛ!
Moo hyɛ wai tso bɔbɔyoo nɛ ɔ. Wai tso bɔbɔyoo ɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o ma, nɛ o hyɛ nɔ saminya kɛ ya si e bɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ba nɛ o ba he e yi wami.
Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ mɛ wai tso ɔ he la nɛ a po lɛ ngɔ fɔ si.
O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ, nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi.
Ma nɛ mo nitsɛ o je blɔ hla mɛ, nɛ o ha nɛ a he wa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, moo bu a he, nɛ o baa a yi.
Wa be o se jee hu kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ha nɛ wa yi nɛ na wami, nɛ wa ma je o yi daa.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu!
Moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami!
Nyami la Nyɛ wo nyɛ gbi nɔ kɛ la ha Mawu, wa he bulɔ ɔ. Nyɛ hwɔ lele kɛ je Yakob Mawu ɔ yi.
Nyɛ je la, nɛ nyɛɛ fia gɔgɔ.
Nyɛɛ fia saku nɛ gbi ngɔɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ fia miɛ kɛ piɛ he.
Nyɛ kpa titimati wa nyami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo, be mi nɛ nyɔhiɔ da, kɛ be mi nɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔ wa.
Mlaa nɛ ngɛ Israel ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; Yakob Mawu ɔ lɛ wo.
Mawu wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ, benɛ e ya puɛ ní ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ. I nu nɛ nɔ ko nɛ i li lɛ ngɛ dee ke, “I je nyɛ tlomi ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ; i ha nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɛ nyɛ kusii ɔmɛ a he.
Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ mi.
I he nɔ kɛ je ye laami he ɔ, he nɛ hiɔwe siɔ kɛ jee ɔ, nɛ i he nyɛ yi wami.
Jehanɛ se hu, i ka nyɛ ngɛ Meriba nyu ɔ he.
Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma wo nyɛ ga. Israel bi, i na nɛ nyɛ bu mi tue!
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a na mawu kpahi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ ko ja ma se mawuhi.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ pa nyɛ nya mi hatoo, nɛ ma lɛ nyɛ.
“Se ye ma a bui mi tue; Israel bi ɔmɛ bui mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ngmɛɛ a je mi he ngɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsui suɔ.
I na nɛ ye ma a bu mi tue; i na nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ye se!
Jinɛ i ba a he nyɛli ɔmɛ si momoomo; jinɛ i kpata a hɛ mi kɛ.
Jinɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume imi, Yawɛ ɔ, a kpla si ngɛ ye hɛ mi, nɛ a ngɛ a tue gblae kɛ yaa neneene.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma lɛ nyɛ kɛ ngma kpakpa.
Ma ha nyɛ hwo babauu kɛ je tɛ sa mi nɛ nyɛ maa ye.”
Mawu, matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ Mawu daa si ngɛ hiɔwe gua nguaa a mi.
E ngɛ kojoli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kae ke, “Kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ nyɛ maa hyɛ nimli a hɛ mi kɛ kojo?
Kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ nyɛ ma fi nimli yayamihi a se?
Nyɛɛ ye ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ awusahi a sane ha mɛ.
Nyɛɛ tu munyu ha nɔ́ nali, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ be nɔ́ ko.
Nyɛ je ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ kɛ je nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi.
“Nyɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ!
Nyɛ be juɛmi!
Diblii mi kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe.
Dami sane yemi se po ngɛ je ɔ mi.
I ke, ‘Mawuhi ji nyɛ; nyɛ tsuo Hiɔwe No ɔ bimɛ ji nyɛ.’ Se nyɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ nimili adesahi tsuo gboɔ ɔ. Nyɛ wami se maa po kaa bɔ nɛ ganɔhi hu a wami se poɔ ɔ.” Mawu, ba nɛ o ba kojo je ɔ, ejakaa je ma amɛ tsuo o níhi ji mɛ.
Kue fami ngɛ ma a he hiami be mi Mawu, ko ma o nya; koo pee dii, koo pee kɔ̃!
Hyɛ, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ basabasa pee; nihi nɛ sume mo ɔ tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã.
A ngɛ ga yaya toe kɛ ngɛ o ma a he woe; nihi nɛ o ngɛ a he bue ɔ, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ a yi nɔ soe.
A ngɛ dee ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ wa kpata ma a hɛ mi, konɛ biɛ Israel ɔ, nɔ ko kó kai hu.” Ee, a pee kake kɛ wo o he; mɛ tsuo a so kɛ wo o he: Edom bi, kɛ Ishmael bi; Moab bi, kɛ Hagrit bi; Gebal bi, Amon bi, Amalek bi, Filistia bi, kɛ Tiro bi.
Asiria hu ba piɛ a he.
Lot bimɛ ɔmɛ a kɔni nguaa kake ji mɛ.
Pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Midian bi ɔmɛ.
Pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Sisera kɛ Yabin ngɛ Kishon pa a nya a. O kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ Endor, nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ sa ngɛ zugba.
Pee a we odehe ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Oreb kɛ Zeeb ɔ.
A ganɔ ɔmɛ hu, pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Zeba kɛ Zalmuna a. Mɛ lɛ a de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ngɔ Mawu zugba a kɛ pee wa nɔ.” Ye Mawu, gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa kaa bunyuku nɛ lasiogblee muɔ kɛ bee, aloo jakati nɛ kɔɔhiɔ sɛ mi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã hue, nɛ la lilɛ haa yokuhi sãã a, nyɛɛ a se ja nɔuu kɛ o we ahumi ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ o kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a kɛ wo a he gbeye.
Yawɛ, ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ kɛ yaa si a maa na o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ. Ha nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pue si nɛ a ye gbeye daa.
Ha nɛ a hao, nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata, konɛ a le kaa mo Yawɛ, mo nɔ kake too lɛ o ngɛ he wami pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Mawu we ɔ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, i suɔ o we ɔ saminya!
I na nɛ i ba lejɛ ɔ!
Ye hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ mo Yawɛ o we ɔ he.
Imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo i ngɛ lae kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ ngɛ Yawɛ yi jee.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, ye matsɛ, kɛ ye Mawu!
Otokliihi, kɛ mawubitɛtehi po maa tsu ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya, nɛ a lɛɛ a bimɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ hii o we ɔ mi, nɛ laa daa kɛ jeɔ o yi ɔ, a gbaa mɛ.
Nihi nɛ naa a he wami kɛ jeɔ o mi, nɛ a hlaa kaa a maa hia blɔ kɛ ya Zion yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbaa mɛ.
Ke a ya gu ya fomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ be kɛkɛ lejɛ ɔ plɛ pee pa nɛ gbiɛ nyu hyi lɛ tɔ.
Pɔ tɔɛ mɛ; mohu ɔ, a naa he wami he, nɛ a nyɛɛɔ kɛ ya suu Mawu hɛ mi tɔɔ ngɛ Zion.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu, bu ye kue fami ɔ tue!
Yakob Mawu, moo bu mi tue koo!
Mawu, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbaa wa matsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ. Ligbi kake nɛ nɔ ko maa ye ngɛ o we ɔ hi pe ligbi akpe nɛ e maa ye ngɛ he kpa ko.
Ma suɔ nɛ ma pee agbo nya bulɔ ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ we ɔ mohu, pe kaa ma hi yayami peeli a we mi.
Yawɛ Mawu ji wa pu kɛ wa tsɛ̃i.
E naa wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ e woɔ wa hɛ mi nyami.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e ha we nɛ nɔ́ ko hiaa mɛ.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ lee, nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ ɔ, a gbaa mɛ!
Kue fami kɛ ha ma a nɔ yami Yawɛ, o na wa zugba a mɔbɔ, nɛ o ha nɛ Israel ná e he ekohu.
O ngɔ o ma a tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pa mɛ.
O mi mi la nɛ nya wa a se po, nɛ o mi mi fu we wɔ hu.
Mawu, wa yi wami helɔ, kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu.
O mi mi ko fu wɔ hu!
Anɛ o mi mi ma fu wɔ daa lo?
Anɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ ma tsa nɔ kɛ ya yi nɔhi tsuo lo?
Ha nɛ waa ba nɔ ekohu, konɛ wɔ, o ma a, wa je o yi.
Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ nɛ o he wa yi wami.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu ngɛ dee ɔ, i nu.
E ngɛ wɔ, e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ dee ke e ma ha wɔ tue mi jɔmi, se wa ko kpale ya je kuasia hu.
Niinɛ, Mawu pee klaalo kɛ ma he nihi nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ a yi wami; konɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ hi wa zugba a mi.
Mɔbɔ nami, kɛ anɔkuale kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi; dami kɛ tue mi jɔmi fua a sibi atuu.
Adesa we anɔkuale ɔ maa je zugba kɛ ya hiɔwe; nɛ Mawu dami ɔ maa hyɛ zugba a kɛ je hiɔwe.
Niinɛ, Yawɛ ma ha wɔ ní kpakpahi, nɛ wa zugba a maa ba ní bɔ nɛ sa.
Dami maa nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e ma dla blɔ ngɔ to lɛ.
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi; ejakaa ye yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Mo he ye yi wami, ejakaa i yeɔ mo anɔkuale.
Ye Mawu, mo he mi; ejakaa o tsɔlɔ ji mi, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ; ejakaa mo lɛ i faa kue kɛ haa daa ligbi.
Nyɔmtsɛ, ha nɛ o tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ na bua jɔmi, ejakaa mo lɛ i faa kue kɛ haa.
Nyɔmtsɛ, o hi, nɛ o kɛ yayami paa nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ faa kue kɛ haa mo ɔ, o naa lɛ mɔbɔ.
Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue.
Pɛɛ nɛ i ngɛ mo kpae ɔ, moo nu ha mi koo!
Ligbi ɔ nɛ e ma fi mi ɔ, ma tsɛ mo; ejakaa i le kaa o maa pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ, mawu ko mawu ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ; níhi nɛ o pee ɔ hu, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ maa to a he.
Nyɔmtsɛ, je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ o bɔ ɔ ma ba kpla si ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ a ma je o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi.
Ejakaa o kle, nɛ o tsuɔ nyakpɛ níhi.
Mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu.
Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ kaa ma pee, nɛ ma ye mo anɔkuale sisiisi.
Ha nɛ ma ngɔ ye he wami tsuo kɛ sɔmɔ mo.
Nyɔmtsɛ, ye Mawu, ma je o yi kɛ ye tsui tsuo, nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, ma wo ta daa.
O na mi mɔbɔ be babauu; gbeje tete po lɛ o je mi kɛ je.
Mawu, he woli, yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ li mo te si wo mi, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe mi.
Se mo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, Mawu mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ Mawu nɛ suɔ nɔ ji mo.
O toɔ o tsui si ha wɔ; o dlooɔ nɔ, nɛ o yeɔ nɔ anɔkuale daa.
Plɛ o hɛ mi ha mi, nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ.
Wo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ he wami, nɛ o kpɔ mi.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ maa, o mawayo ɔ sɔmɔ mo ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ i ngɛ mo sɔmɔe ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi o mɔbɔ nami ɔ he okadi ko, konɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a na, nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kaa o piɛ ye he, nɛ o jɔɔ ye bua.
Yerusalem yi jemi la Yawɛ to e ma a sisi kɛ ma e yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
E suɔ Yerusalem pe hehi tsuo ngɛ Israel.
Mawu ma, bu tue!
Yawɛ ngɛ ní kpakpahi dee ngɛ o he: “Ma tsɛ Egipt, kɛ Babilonia kɛ piɛ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ hu ma tsɛ Filistia, Tiro, kɛ Sudan kɛ piɛ a he.” A ma tsɛ Zion ke je ma amɛ tsuo a nyɛ, ejakaa Hiɔwe No ɔ nitsɛ maa to lɛ si.
Yawɛ maa ngma ni ɔmɛ tsuo a biɛ, nɛ a ma tsɛ mɛ ke Yerusalem ma a mi bi.
A maa do, nɛ a ma la ke, “Zion lɛ wa gbaami ɔmɛ tsuo jeɔ.”
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ Mawu, ye yi wami helɔ!
Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo i foɔ ya ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo, nɛ o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
Haomi babauu ba ye nɔ, nɛ i kɛ gbenɔ he kɛ we saasaa.
A bu mi ngɔ piɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a miɔ nɛ a ma gbo ɔ a he.
Ye he wami ta.
I pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ a hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ ni gbogboehi a kpɛti, nihi nɛ nɔ ta, nɛ a hwɔɔ si ngɛ yɔkɔ mi, nihi nɛ o kaii we mɛ hu, nɛ yemi kɛ buami ko be ha mɛ.
O sake mi kɛ fɔ yɔkɔ ɔ mi he nɛ kuɔ pe kulaa a. O sake mi kɛ fɔ muɔ voo kɛ e mi diblii kpii ɔ mi.
O we abofu ɔ nya wa tsɔ ha mi; e ngɛ kaa oslɔke nɛ ngɛ kue kɛ ngɛ ye nɔ puee kpamisa.
O ha nɛ ye huɛmɛ kua mi; o ha nɛ ye he tsɛ̃ mɛ.
I pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ a sa e yi, nɛ e li he nɛ e maa ya.
Aywilɛho sɔuu ha nɛ ye hɛngmɛ nɔ ha.
Yawɛ, i tsɛɔ mo daa nɛ; i woɔ ye nine nɔ, nɛ i faa kue kɛ haa mo daa.
Anɛ ni gbogboehi lɛ o peeɔ nyakpɛ ni kɛ haa lo?
Anɛ gbogboehi maa te si, nɛ a ma je o yi lo?
O suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ, anɛ yɔkɔ mi lɛ a maa wo nɔ ta ngɛ lo?
O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ, hɛ mi kpatami he ɔ a maa sɛɛ ngɛ lo?
O nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ ɔ, anɛ diblii mi lɛ a maa na ngɛ lo?
Zugba a, he nɛ nihi a hɛ jee níhi a nɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ lɛ a maa na o dami ɔ ngɛ lo?
Se Yawɛ, imi lɛɛ mo i ngɛ tsɛe!
Daa mɔtu ɔ, i faa kue kɛ haa mo.
Yawɛ, mɛni he je lɛ o kua mi?
Mɛni he je lɛ o ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa mi?
Kɛ je ye nihe mi hluu kɛ ba si piɔ ɔ, amanehlu sɔuu lɛ i ngɛ nae, nɛ i miɔ nɛ ma gbo.
O gbla ye tue nɛ ye he wami ta.
O mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ; o wo ye he gbeye hluu kɛ ya si ye hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata.
Daa ligbi ɔ, gbeye níhi bɔle mi kɛ kpe kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee; a po klaangma kɛ wo ye he.
O ha nɛ ye huɛmɛ kpakpahi tsuo kua mi, nɛ diblii ba pee ye huɛ.
Ma a we amanehlu be la Yawɛ, ma la daa kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe.
Ma sɛɛ ha yi nɔhi tsuo ke anɔkuale yelɔ ji mo.
I le kaa o suɔmi ɔ maa hi si daa.
O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ hu be nyagbe; e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe ngɛ ɔ. O de ke, “I kɛ nɔ nɛ i hla lɛ ɔ so somi ko.
I ka ye tsɔlɔ David kita ke, ‘Ma ha nɛ o nina maa ye matsɛ daa; o matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.’ ” Yawɛ, hiɔwe ma je nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ a yi; a ma la kɛ je o yi kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale.
Yawɛ, mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ kaa mo?
Hiɔwe nibɔ ní ɔmɛ te nɔ́ nɛ kɛ mo sɔ?
A buu mo ngɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi a kpe ɔ mi; mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a yeɔ mo gbeye.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu!
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ he wami kaa mo Yawɛ?
O yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
Ke wo gli, nɛ oslɔke ngɛ fiae ɔ, mo lɛ o jɔɔ he.
Rahab, wo mi lohwe ɔ nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ, mo lɛ o kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
O kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
O níhi ji hiɔwe ɔ kɛ zugba a tsuo; mo lɛ o bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi níhi tsuo.
O bɔ omleyi je, kɛ leneyi je.
Tabor yo ɔ, kɛ Hermon yo ɔ ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ o yi jee.
He walɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ji mo; o he wami ɔ kle!
O matsɛ yemi ɔ, dami sane yemi nɔ a to lɛ sisi kɛ fɔ.
Suɔmi kɛ anɔkuale yemi jeɔ kpo ngɛ o nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi mi.
A gbaa nihi nɛ le bɔ nɛ a laa kɛ jaa mo.
Mo Yawɛ, o maa na mɛ mɔbɔ daa.
Mo o he ɔ, a bua jɔɔ a he daa nɛ; a jeɔ o yi, ejakaa o hi.
Mo lɛ o haa nɛ a yeɔ kunimi nguahi.
Mo lɛ o naa wɔ mɔbɔ loko wa yeɔ manye.
Yawɛ, mo lɛ o hla wa he falɔ ɔ kɛ ha wɔ; mo, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, mo lɛ o ha wɔ wa matsɛ.
Mawu wo David si Be ko ɔ, o kɛ o tsɔli klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tu munyu ngɛ nina mi, nɛ o de mɛ ke, “I fi katsɛ ko jlasi.
I ngɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ ha nɔ ko nɛ i hla kɛ je ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
I ngɔ ye nu klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ pɔ ye tsɔlɔ David, nɛ i wo lɛ matsɛ.
Ye nine maa hi e he be tsuaa be, nɛ ma wo lɛ he wami.
E he nyɛli a nine be e nɔ sue; yayami peeli be nyɛe maa ye e nɔ.
Ma kpata e he nyɛli a hɛ mi; ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɔ lɛ ɔ, ma gbe mɛ tsuo.
Ma suɔ lɛ, ma ye lɛ anɔkuale, nɛ ma ha e maa ye kunimi daa.
Ma ha nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ma blɛke kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya su Yufrate pa a he.
E ma tsɛ mi ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ, ye Mawu, ye he bulɔ, kɛ ye yi wami helɔ.’ Imi hu ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ pee ye bitɛte; ma pee lɛ matsɛ nɛ kle pe je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ma suɔ lɛ, nɛ ma na lɛ mɔbɔ daa; somi nɛ i kɛ lɛ so ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.
E weku kpa se be poe gblegbleegble; e maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, e nina ko maa hi sɛ ɔ nɔ.
“Se ke e nina ya yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ́ a bɛ a je mi kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ, ke a kua ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ a yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ lɛɛ ma gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ ma ha a maa na nɔ́.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ, jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ be tae gblegbleegble; si ko nɛ i wo David ɔ hu, i be ye nya se kpalee.
Somi ɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ so ɔ, i be se jee; si nɛ i wo lɛ ɔ, i be tsakee.
“I kɛ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ wo si kaa i be David lakpa yee gblegbleegble.
E nina maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ma bu e matsɛ yemi ɔ he be abɔ nɛ pu ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. E matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si daa kaa nyɔhiɔ, jamɛ a anɔkuale odase ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.” Aywilɛho la, benɛ a ye matsɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ Se nɔ nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, o mi mi fu lɛ; o kua lɛ, nɛ o hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ he.
Somi nɛ o kɛ o tsɔlɔ ɔ so ɔ, o je se; o sake e matsɛ pɛɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ zugba, nɛ o ble lɛ.
Gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ, o ku lɛ tsuo pue si, nɛ mɔ ɔmɛ plɛ pee ní kokoehi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ guu lejɛ ɔ, juɔ e níhi; e plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ ha e he nihi po.
O ha nɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi, nɛ mɛ tsuo a na bua jɔmi.
Ee, o ha nɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ pee yaka, nɛ e nyɛ we ta a nya nɛ e da.
O he e hiɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ o sake e matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ zugba.
O po e nihe mi be ɔ nɔ kpiti, nɛ o ha nɛ e hɛ mi pue si.
Kue fami Yawɛ, mɛni be o maa laa o he kɛ ya si?
O maa laa o he kɛ maa ya neneene lo?
O mi mi fumi nɛ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ɔ, mɛni be lɛ e se maa po?
Mo kai kaa ye wami be ɔ ngɛ kuku.
Mɛni he je lɛ o bɔ nɔmlɔ adesa yaka gu ɔ?
Te nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ je mi, nɛ lɛɛ e be gboe?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma je e he kɛ je gbenɔ dɛ mi?
Nyɔmtsɛ, suɔmi nɛ o je kpo blema a, jije jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ ngɛ?
Níhi nɛ o wo David si ke o maa pee ɔ, jije ní ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Nyɔmtsɛ, ahlua nɛ a ngɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ bɔe ɔ, o hɛ ko je nɔ.
Jɛmihi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ mi jɛe ɔ, i ma ye nya ngɔ to nɔ.
Yawɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, hyɛ kaa o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ ahlua bɔe!
He tsuaa he nɛ e gu, kɛkɛ jɛmi nyɛɛ e se.

WOMI EYWIƐNE Mawu kɛ adesa Nyɔmtsɛ, mo ji wa wesa he ngɛ yi nɔhi tsuo a mi.
Benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ yo ɔmɛ; benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ je ɔ, mo ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa si neneene.
O deɔ adesa ke, “Kpale kɛ ya o je he!” Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ plɛɔ peeɔ tabo zu.
Moo lɛɛ jeha akpe ngɛ kaa ligbi kake ha mo; e ngɛ kaa hiɛmɛ a je hiɛ nɛ be momo, aloo be bɔɔ kɛkɛ ngɛ nyɔ mi.
O ngɔɔ wɔ kɛ yaa kaa bɔ nɛ pa muɔɔ níhi kɛ yaa a; wa wami be ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa mahe nɛ a hwɔ.
Wa ngɛ kaa hu nɛ puɛɔ flɔflɔɔflɔ mɔtu.
Mɔtu ɔ, e blɛkeɔ saminyayoo, se gbɔkuɛ ɔ, e nglaa, nɛ e gboɔ.
O mi mi la a kpataa wa hɛ mi; o mi mi la a woɔ wa he gbeye.
O ngɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pue o hɛ mi; wa diblii mi yayami ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o hɛ mi paa.
Ke o mi mi fu wɔ ɔ, o poɔ wa wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti kaa a woɔ mumi.
Wa wami be ɔ tsuo ji jeha nyingmi kpaago.
Ke wa ngɛ he wami ɔ, wa naa nyingmi kpaanyɔ, se lɛ tsuo peeɔ haomi kɛ aywilɛho sɔuu.
Wa wami se poɔ tlukaa; nɛ wa bee kɛ yaa kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ te kɛ bee.
Mɛnɔ lɛ le bɔ nɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ nya wa ha?
Bɔ nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye ɔ, ja lɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ.
Ha nɛ waa na kaa wa wami se kɛ we kulaa, konɛ waa le ní.
Mɛni be o mi mi fumi ɔ se maa po?
Yawɛ, naa wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ mɔbɔ!
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ daa mɔtu, konɛ wa na bua jɔmi wa wami be ɔ tsuo.
Bɔ nɛ o ha nɛ wa na amanehlu wawɛɛ jeha komɛ nɛ be ɔ, ha nɛ wa na bua jɔmi, nɛ wa nya ja nɔuu ngɛ be nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ mi.
Ha nɛ wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ, waa na o ní tsumi ɔmɛ.
Ha nɛ wa bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ. Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!
Ha nɛ wa ní tsumi nɛ ya nɔ!
Ee, ha nɛ wa ní tsumi nɛ ya nɔ!
Mawu ji wa he bulɔ Nɔ nɛ hii Hiɔwe No ɔ laami he ɔ, Ope ɔ nitsɛ maa baa e yi.
E ma de Yawɛ ke, “Mo ji ye wesa he, kɛ ye he bulɔ.
Mo ji ye Mawu; i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.” E ma je mo kɛ je klamahi nɛ a tsɔ mo ɔ tsuo mi.
E ma je mo kɛ je gbenɔ hiɔ hu mi ja nɔuu.
E maa bu o he, nɛ o yi ma na wami kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ bi ngɛ e nyɛ pɛli sisi.
Si nɛ e wo ke e maa ye mo anɔkuale ɔ maa pee kaa tsɛ̃i, kɛ dama nɛ ma fa o he.
O be nyɔ mi ní yayamihi, loo piani oslaa kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kikɛ nɛ ɔ gbeye yee.
Gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ puɛɔ ní ngɛ diblii mi ɔ, o be lɛ gbeye yee.
Piani hu o be hiɔ nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi gbeye yee.
Nimli akpe ma gbo ngɛ o kasa nya; akpe nyɔngma ma gbo kɛ bɔle mo kɛ kpe, se moo lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be o he sae.
O hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ lɛ o kɛ maa hyɛ bɔ nɛ a maa gbla yayami peeli a tue ha.
Akɛnɛ o ngɔ Yawɛ, Hiɔwe No ɔ kɛ pee o he bulɔ, kɛ o wesa he he je ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be o he sae; o we ɔ mi hu, haomi ko be lejɛ ɔ bae.
Mawu ma ha nɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ maa bu o he ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ o maa ya.
A maa hɛɛ mo ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ko tɛ nɔ.
O maa naa jata, kɛ sanga nɔ; o maa naa jata bi kɛ sinɔ nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nɔ nɛ suɔ mi, nɛ e le ye biɛ Yawɛ ɔ, ma he e yi wami, nɛ ma bu e he.
Ke e tsɛ mi ɔ, ma he nɔ; ke haomi ba e nɔ ɔ, ma piɛ e he.
Ma je lɛ, nɛ ma wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Kpakpa nɛ ma pee lɛ ji, ma ha nɛ e wami se maa kɛ, nɛ ma he e yi wami.”
Yi jemi la kɛ ha Hejɔɔmi ligbi Yawɛ, e hi kaa a na mo si.
E hi kaa a la kɛ je mo, Hiɔwe No ɔ o yi.
Daa mɔtu ɔ, á tu o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he munyu; daa nyɔ mi hu, á fiɛ kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale.
A fia kpa saku, kɛ saku kpahi nɛ a la kɛ to he.
Yawɛ, o ní tsumi ɔmɛ haa mi bua jɔmi; Ma la kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ o nine nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ a he.
Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ o ní tsumi ɔmɛ kle ɔ, ja nɔuu o juɛmi hu mi kuɔ.
Nɔ nɛ biɛ be enɛ ɔ lee; kuasia hu be sisi nue.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ maa bɔ flɔflɔɔflɔ kaa nga; yayami peeli ma plɔke, nɛ a ma na a he, se nyagbe ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata kɛ̃.
Se mo Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ o maa ye tsɛ daa.
Hyɛ, mo Yawɛ, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
A maa gbɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo ngɔ fĩa.
O ha nɛ i na he wami kaa pu mi na.
O gbaa mi kɛ bua jɔmi babauu.
Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ i na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
I nu hulɔ kɛ ye tue kaa nihi nɛ te si wo mi ɔ nɔ si.
Dali ma plɔke kaa tã; a maa wa kaa seda tso ngɛ Lebanon.
A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ a du ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, tsohi nɛ bɔ ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ kue ɔmɛ a mi.
A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii ngɛ a bwɔmi be mi tete po, tsohi nɛ ngɛ flɔflɔɔflɔ, nɛ́ nyu tɛ a mi gblegbleegble.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Yawɛ da.
Nɔ nɛ buɔ ye he ɔ, yayami ko be e he.
Mawu ji matsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee.
E mia kɛ agboje, kɛ he wami.
Ee, e ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma si kpɛii, nɛ a be nyɛe ma je kɛ je e blɔ he.
Yawɛ, o matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ je blema lokoo; mo nitsɛ hu o ngɛ kɛ je neneene.
Yawɛ, wo ɔ ngɛ gbi woe; ee, wo ɔ ngɛ pɛe; oslɔke ɔmɛ ngɛ kue kɛ ngmlaa.
Se Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ he wa kulaa pe wo ɔ nɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ; Yawɛ he wa kulaa pe wo nɔ oslɔke ɔmɛ.
Yawɛ, o mlaa amɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene; klɔuklɔu peemi sa o we ɔ daa.
Mawu ji adesahi tsuo a kojolɔ Yawɛ, mo Mawu nɛ o yeɔ lue, mo je o he kpo koo!
Mo je ɔ tsuo kojolɔ, tee si nɛ o wo he nɔ woli hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa mɛ.
Yawɛ, kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ yayami peeli maa hi nyae?
A maa hi mle yee kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Yayami peeli maa hi munyu tue puu kɛkɛ, nɛ a maa hi fĩae kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Yawɛ, a ngɛ o ma a yi mi wae.
Mo nitsɛ o nihi nɛ o suɔ ɔ, a ngɛ mɛ awi yee.
A ngɛ yalɔyihi, kɛ awusahi gbee; nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ wa zugba a nɔ hu, a ngɛ a muɔ si puee ja nɔuu.
Nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ ji, “Oo, Yawɛ tsa nɛ wɔ!
Israel Mawu ɔ hyɛ we!” Ye ma, mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ biɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Kuasiahi, mɛni be nyɛ maa le nɔ́?
Nɔ nɛ pee wa tue ɔmɛ ɔ, e nui nɔ́ lo?
Nɔ nɛ pee hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hyɛ we nɔ́ lo?
Nɔ nɛ tsɔseɔ je ma amɛ ɔ, anɛ e be a tue gblae lo?
Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ adesahi tsuo ní ɔ, anɛ e be juɛmi lo?
Yawɛ le bɔ nɛ adesa susuɔ e yi mi.
E le kaa nɔmlɔ juɛmi sui he ko kulaa.
Yawɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ o tsɔseɔ lɛ, nɛ o tsɔɔ lɛ o mlaa a, a gbaa lɛ.
Haomi be mi tete po, o haa lɛ he jɔmi hluu kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ o tsuaa muɔ ha yayami peelɔ nɛ e ba nɔ mi.
Yawɛ be e ma a he ngmɛɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ; nihi nɛ e je blɔ hla mɛ ɔ, e be mɛ kuae.
A maa ye dami sane ngɛ kojomi he ɔmɛ ekohu; nɛ dali tsuo ma nya he.
Mɛnɔ maa piɛ ye he nɛ waa te si kɛ wo yiwutsotsɛmɛ?
Mɛnɔ maa piɛ ye he, nɛ waa kɛ yayami peeli ya to ní?
Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ ye he ɔ, jinɛ be nɛ ɔ mi i su gbeje momo.
Benɛ i de ke, “I miɔ nɛ ma sane nɔ si ɔ,” mo Yawɛ, o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ wo ye nɔ.
Ke yi mi susumi tsɔ ha nɛ i pee basaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, mo lɛ o haa mi bua jɔmi, nɛ ye nɔ gbagba tee ekohu.
Kojoli nɛ yi dami sane, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ mlaa yaya a, anɛ o kɛ mɛ maa bɔ lo?
A soɔ dali a yi nɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ɔ, a buu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ.
Se Yawɛ faa ye he; ee, ye Mawu ɔ buu ye he.
Yawɛ ma ha nɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ ma bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
E ma kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he; Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Yi jemi la Nyɛɛ ba nɛ wa la kɛ je Yawɛ yi; nyɛ ha nɛ wa he ose kɛ ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ buu wa he ɔ. Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ba e hɛ mi kɛ sina, nɛ wa he ose, nɛ wa la yi jemi lahi.
Ejakaa Yawɛ ɔ, Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ji lɛ; lɛ ji mawu ɔmɛ tsuo a matsɛ nguaa.
E yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ, kɛ je je ɔ sisi he nɛ kuɔ pe kulaa kɛ ya siɔ yohi a yi mi piɔpiɔɔpiɔ.
E níhi ji wo ɔ, kɛ zugba a tsuo; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ lɛ e pee mɛ.
Nyɛɛ ba nɛ waa ngɔ wa hɛ mi kɛ bu si, nɛ wa ja lɛ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ, wa bɔlɔ ɔ nane nya.
Ejakaa wa Mawu ji lɛ!
Wɔ ji e ma a nɛ; lɛ nɛ hyɛɛ wa nɔ; wa ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ e ngɛ tsɔe.
Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu e gbi ɔ tue: “Nyɛ ko kplii nyɛ tsui kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ligbi ko ngɛ Masa nga a nɔ ngɛ Meriba a. Nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ na níhi nɛ i pee ha mɛ.
Se kɛ̃ a tsɔ̃ ye nya, nɛ a ka mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. I ná yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ a he abofu jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
I de ke, ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je ye se; a kua ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi’ Ye mi mi wo la, nɛ i ka kita ke, ‘He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!’ ”
Mawu, matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ!
Nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ la ha Yawɛ!
Nyɛ la ha Yawɛ; nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a daa ligbi ke Yawɛ he wa yi wami.
Nyɛɛ fiɛ nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a nu kaa Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, kaa e tsuɔ ní nguanguahi.
Yawɛ kle agbo; e sa nɛ a je e yi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E sa nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Je ma kpa amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ, amagahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Yawɛ lɛɛ lɛ nɛ e bɔ hiɔwe.
Hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe; he wami, kɛ afɛu ní hyi e we ɔ. Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Nyɛ je e hɛ mi nyami, kɛ e he wami ɔ yi.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi; nyɛɛ ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba e we ɔ. Nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu nɛ nyɛ ja Yawɛ; nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Nyɛ de je ma amɛ tsuo ke, “Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee!
A ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma si ngɛ e hi he, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma mimiɛ lɛ.
E maa kojo je ma amɛ ngɛ dami nya.” Hiɔwe, kɛ zugba, nyɛ nya!
Wo, kɛ o mi níhi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo gbi.
Ngmɔhi, kɛ nyɛ a nɔ níhi tsuo, nyɛ nya!
Pu mi tsohi tsuo ma hwɔ lele ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, ejakaa e ma!
Ee, Yawɛ ma nɛ e ba kojo je ɔ. Yawɛ maa kojo je ɔ ngɛ dami kɛ anɔkuale nya.
Mawu, ma nɔ yelɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee!
Mo je, mo nya koo!
Nyɛ zugbahi tsuo nɛ wo bɔle nyɛ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛ nya!
Bɔku kɛ diblii kpii bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Matsɛ ji lɛ; anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane e yeɔ.
La jeɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e sãã e he nyɛli nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ. E we oslabai ɔ haa nɛ je mi tsɔɔ.
Je ɔ naa, nɛ e hosoɔ.
Yohi sileɔ kaa wo gbaku ngɛ Yawɛ, je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Hiɔwe ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Yawɛ ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ!” Je ma amɛ tsuo na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Amaga jali, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ yakayaka wɔhi a nɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi pue si pɛ!
Nyɛ mawuhi tsuo, nyɛ kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Mawu, Zion ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ma amɛ nu o dami sane yemi ɔ he, nɛ a bua jɔ a he, nɛ a nya.
Yawɛ, je ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ ji mo; o kle; mawu ko mawu ko kɛ mo sɔɛ.
Yawɛ suɔ nihi tsuo nɛ hiee yayami.
E baa e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ e jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
La kpɛɔ kɛ haa dali; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a naa bua jɔmi.
Nyɛ dali, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ he.
Nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ pee ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ si.
Mawu ji je ɔ nɔ yelɔ Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ, ejakaa e pee nyakpɛ níhi.
E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ye kunimi ha e he.
Yawɛ je e he kpo kaa Mawu nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami.
E ha nɛ je ma amɛ le faii kaa dami sane yelɔ ji lɛ.
Si ko nɛ e wo Israel ma a, e ye nɔ; e ye mɛ anɔkuale, nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ babauu.
Nihi ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he na kaa wa Mawu ɔ ye kunimi.
Je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ hwɔ lele kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛ he ose, nɛ nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ je e yi.
Nyɛ la, nɛ nyɛɛ fia kpa saku kɛ to he nɛ nyɛ kɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Nyɛ kpa titimati, kɛ koli, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi hwɔ lele kɛ ha Yawɛ, wa matsɛ ɔ. Wo, kɛ o mi níhi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo gbi!
Je ɔ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi, nyɛ la!
Nyɛ pahi, nyɛɛ fia nyɛ dɛ!
Nyɛ yokuhi tsuo, nyɛ nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, ejakaa e ma nɛ e ba kojo je ɔ. Yawɛ maa kojo je ɔ ngɛ dami, kɛ anɔkuale nya.
Mawu, matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee; je ma amɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli.
E hii si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ zugba ngɛ mimiɛe.
Yawɛ he biɛ ngɛ Zion wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e kle pe je ma amɛ tsuo.
Nihi tsuo ma je e biɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi; a ma je e biɛ nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ yi.
E ngɛ klɔuklɔu!
Matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ, mo nɛ o suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da!
O to anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane yemi si ngɛ Israel.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ yi!
Nyɛ kpla si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ.
Mawu klɔuklɔu ji lɛ!
E we osɔfohi ji Mose, kɛ Aaron.
Nihi nɛ fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, Samuel piɛ a he.
Mɛ tsuo a fa kue ha lɛ, nɛ e bu mɛ tue.
E kɛ mɛ tu munyu ngɛ bɔku titima mi.
A ye mlaahi nɛ e wo mɛ, kɛ famihi nɛ e fa mɛ ɔ tsuo nɔ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu!
O ma a fa kue ha mo, nɛ o bu mɛ tue.
O kɛ mɛ hi si kaa Mawu nɛ ngɔɔ a he yayami kɛ paa mɛ; se ke a tɔ̃ ɔ, o gblaa a tue kɛ̃.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ yi; nyɛ ja lɛ ngɛ e yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Yi jemi la Nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ hwɔ lele ha Yawɛ!
Nyɛ sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ bua jɔmi; nyɛɛ ba e hɛ mi kɛ bua jɔmi lahi!
Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa Yawɛ ji Mawu.
Lɛ nɛ e bɔ wɔ; e níhi ji wɔ.
E ma ji wɔ; wa ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ e ngɛ lɛe.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ sina ba ha lɛ ngɛ e we ɔ; nyɛ je e yi ngɛ e kue ɔmɛ a mi.
Nyɛɛ na lɛ si, nɛ nyɛ je e yi.
Yawɛ hi; e naa wɔ mɔbɔ daa, nɛ e we anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Matsɛ siwo Yawɛ, ma la kɛ je o yi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ dami sane yelɔ ji mo.
Ma ba ye je mi saminya, konɛ a ko na piami ko ngɛ ye he.
Mɛni be po lɛ o maa ba ye ngɔ?
Ma hi si ngɛ mumi mi he tsɔmi mi ngɛ ye we ɔ mi.
I be yi wu tso níhi a he susue.
Nihi nɛ kua Mawu ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be bɔe.
A ní peemi níhi muɛ ye hɛ.
I be amimi yee, nɛ i kɛ yayami peeli hu be bɔe.
Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi he guɛ ngɛ laami mi ɔ, ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ gegeege, nɛ e woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, i kɛ lɛ be bɔe.
Nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ, ma ná a he bua jɔmi, nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa hi si.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛ lɛ a ma sɔmɔ mi.
Nɔ sisilɔ ko be ye we mi hie; lakpatsɛ ko hu be ye hɛ mi bae.
I kɛ yayami peeli be bɔe kɔkɔɔkɔ kɛ yaa si ma fie mɛ tsuo kɛ je Yawɛ ma a mi.
Niheyo nɔ́ nalɔ ko kue fami Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo tsɛe nɛ o ba piɛ ye he.
Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo!
Ke i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, koo je ye he.
Ke i tsɛ mo ɔ, he nɔ esɔ, nɛ o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee kaa la su ku, nɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ dɔ la hɛii kaa flɔɔnɔɔ ɔ mi.
I pee kaa nga gbigbli nɛ a gbee nɔ, nɛ niye ní pa jlo we mi hu.
Daa nɛ ɔ, kɛmɛmi kɛkɛ lɛ i ngɛ kɛmɛe.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye wuhi tsuo je kpo, nɛ i pee kanyakanya.
I pee kaa okpoku ngɛ nga nɔ, loo klomi ngɛ we doku mi.
I hwɔ we mahe; i pee kaa ohwe pɛlitsɛ kake too nɛ maa si ngɛ tsu yi mi.
Daa ligbi ɔ, jɛmi kɛkɛ ye he nyɛli hii mi jɛe.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu ɔ ngɔɔ ye biɛ kɛ gbiɛɛ ni kpahi.
Ye niye ní ɔ, la zu sɔuu; nɔ nɛ i nuɔ ɔ, vo nyu futu mi, ejakaa o mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
O wo ye nɔ, nɛ o sake mi kɛ fɔ he.
Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa hɔhɔmi nɛ bee kɛ yaa.
I pee kaa nga gbigbli.
Se mo Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ matsɛ ji mo kɛ yaa neneene; yi nɔhi tsuo ma kai mo.
O maa te si, nɛ o maa na Zion mɔbɔ.
Be ɔ su nɛ o maa na lɛ mɔbɔ; be ɔ nɛ a to ɔ su.
Ejakaa o tsɔli ɔmɛ suɔ Zion tɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ zu ɔ po, a mi mi sãã mɛ ngɛ he.
Je ma amɛ tsuo maa ye Yawɛ gbeye.
Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye e hɛ mi nyami ɔ gbeye.
Yawɛ kpale ma Zion ekohu; e ma je e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ.
E maa bu e nihi nɛ e kua mɛ ɔ a kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ e maa pee a hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mɛ.
A maa ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ to ha yi nɔ bi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se, konɛ nihi nɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mɛ lolo ɔ nɛ a ba je Yawɛ yi.
Yawɛ hyɛ zugba a kɛ je e he klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.
E hyɛ zugba a kɛ je hiɔwe, konɛ e nu pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kɛmɛmi ɔ he, nɛ nihi nɛ a bu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ ɔ, e ha nɛ a ye a he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa wo Yawɛ biɛ ta ngɛ Zion; a ma je e yi ngɛ Yerusalem.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, je ma amɛ, kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ma ba bua a he nya nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ.
Yawɛ ha nɛ i gbɔjɔ be mi nɛ i ngɛ he wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
E po ye wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti.
Ye Mawu, mo nɛ o ngɛ daa!
Koo ngɔ mi kɛ ho amlɔ nɛ ɔ, be mi nɛ i wɛ lolo.
Blema lokoo nɛ o bɔ je ɔ; mo nitsɛ o nine o kɛ pee hiɔwe ɔ. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata; se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Ee, mɛ tsuo a ma ba pee momo kaa bɔ nɛ bo he ba peeɔ bo momo ɔ. O ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a sakeɔ bo momo kɛ fɔɔ he ɔ. Nɛ a maa laa kulaa.
Se moo lɛɛ, bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, ja ko lɛ o ngɛ.
O wami be ɔ be nyagbe.
Wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ, wa bimɛ ɔmɛ a yi ma na wami, nɛ a nina kɛ mo maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Mawu suɔmi Ma je Yawɛ yi!
Ma je e biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
Ma je Yawɛ yi!
Ní kpakpahi nɛ e peeɔ ha mi ɔ, ye hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
E kɛ ye he yayamihi tsuo paa mi, nɛ e tsaa ye he hiɔhi tsuo.
E heɔ ye yi wami, konɛ ye hɛ mi ko kpata.
E jeɔ e suɔmi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi, nɛ e naa mi mɔbɔ daa.
E haa mi ní kpakpahi babauu, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, i naa he wami he kaa kɔle.
Nihi tsuo nɛ a yeɔ mɛ amimi ɔ, Yawɛ yeɔ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.
E tsɔɔ Mose e blɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu na ní nguanguahi nɛ e pee ɔ. Yawɛ naa mɔbɔ; e mi mi hi.
E muklii mi fu we mla, se e mɔbɔ nami ɔ mohu hiɛ babauu.
E hɛɛ we pɛ munyu kake mi kpamisa.
Ke e mi mi fu ɔ, e kɛ we kulaa kɛkɛ e tsui he jɔ ekohu.
E gbla we wa tue bɔ nɛ sa wɔ; wa yayami ɔmɛ hu e wui wɔ a he hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa wɔ.
Se mohu ɔ, nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ, e naa mɛ mɔbɔ babauu nɛ hi kalemi kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti blɔ ɔ hí kalemi ɔ. E jeɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ yaa tsitsaa lokoo kaa bɔ nɛ beleku kɛ bonyoku a kpɛti blɔ ɔ kɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ tsɛ mi mi sãã lɛ ngɛ e bimɛ a he ɔ, ja lɛ Yawɛ hu mi mi sãã lɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ a he.
Ejakaa e le wa bɔ su; e le kaa zu kɛkɛ ji wɔ.
Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa nga pɛ; e bɔɔ saminyayoo kaa nga nɔ mɔmɔ.
Ke kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ e hɛ mi kpata nɛ nɔ ko pa li lɛ hu.
Se Yawɛ suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye.
A weku kɛ nina hu Yawɛ maa pee mɛ kpakpa daa, kɛ jehanɛ hu nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ e somi ɔ nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ sisiisi ɔ. Yawɛ ngɔ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ ma si ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ je ɔ tsuo nɔ.
Nyɛ, Yawɛ Mawu bɔfohi, nyɛ katsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ, nɛ nyɛ yaa tsɔmi ha lɛ; nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ, Yawɛ tabo ɔ tsuo, nyɛ, e sɔmɔli tsuo nɛ nyɛ peeɔ e suɔmi nya ní, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ, Yawɛ nibɔ níhi ngɛ hehi nɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ ɔ tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Imi nitsɛ hu ma je Yawɛ yi!
A je bɔlɔ ɔ yi Ma je Yawɛ yi!
Yawɛ ye Mawu, o kle!
O hɛ mi nyami, kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa bo nɛ o kɛ ha o he.
O ngɔ la kɛ ha o he kaa bo; o blɛke hiɔwe mi kaa bo tsu.
O ma o we ɔ ngɔ fɔ nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɔ.
O ngɔ bɔku kɛ pee o lɛ, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi o nyɛɛɔ.
O ngɔ kɔɔhiɔ kɛ pee o tsɔlɔ, nɛ oslabai la a pee o sɔmɔlɔ.
O ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma e sisi tomi ɔ nɔ kpɛii, nɛ a be jee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ gblegbleegble.
O ngɔ nyu kɛ ha je ɔ he kaa bo; nyu ha yo ɔmɛ a yi mi tsuo.
Benɛ o wo gbi, nɛ hiɔwe si ɔ, a he sɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Nyu ɔ hia kɛ be ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya pue kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi he nɛ o to ha mɛ ɔ. O to huzu ha nyu ɔ nɛ e ko be he, konɛ e ko kpale ba ha je ɔ nɔ hu.
O haa nɛ pahi hiaa ngɛ kɔ̃hi a mi, nɛ a mi nyu ɔ ya guu yohi a kpɛ.
Pu mi lohwehi tsuo náa nyu nɛ a nuɔ.
Nga mi tejihi nuɔ nyu hluu kɛ ya siɔ kuma yi mɛ hu.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ peeɔ a tsuhi ngɛ tso kɔnihi a nɔ ngɛ pa tue, nɛ a hii lae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. O haa nɛ nyu nɛɛ kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ pueɔ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ je ɔ mi hyi tɔ kɛ o gbaami sɔuu.
O haa nɛ nga puɛɔ ha lohwehi; o haa nɔmlɔ adesa tsohi nɛ e du, konɛ e ná niye ní kɛ je zu mi.
O haa lɛ dã nɛ ma ha lɛ bua jɔmi, nu nɛ ma ha nɛ e he womi nɔ ma tsɔ, kɛ niye ní nɛ maa wo lɛ he wami.
Lebanon seda tso ɔmɛ naa nyu babaaba.
Yawɛ nitsɛ e tsohi nɛ e du ji lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ lɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ peeɔ a tsuhi ngɛ; sɛsɛo ɔ mi lɛ aklawa peeɔ e tsu ngɛ.
Yo gaga amɛ a nɔ lɛ pu mi apletsihi hiɔ; nyu mi kpihi lɛɛ a hi he ji tɛ sahi a kpɛ.
O pee nyɔhiɔ, nɛ o kɛ tsɔɔ be slɔɔtohi; pu hu le be nɛ e kɛ nɔɔ si.
O haa nɛ je jɔɔ, kɛkɛ ke diblii wo ɔ, pu mi lohwehi tsuo jeɔ kpo.
Jata bimɛ huãã nɛ a daa de ke a ngɛ niye ní hlae kɛ je mo Mawu o dɛ mi.
Ke pu te si ɔ, a kpaleɔ a se ya buɔ si ngɛ a laami he ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nimlihi jeɔ kpo kɛ yaa a ní tsumi hehi ya tsuɔ ní kɛ ya siɔ gbɔkuɛ.
Yawɛ, hyɛ kaa o pee níhi babauu!
Nile o kɛ pee lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
O nibɔ níhi hyi je ɔ mi tɔ.
Wo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e kle nɛ e bli, kɛ e mi lohwe nguanguahi kɛ wawi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kane.
Lɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ wo nɛ ɔ mi nɛ lohwe kɛ e he gbeyegbeye nɛ o bɔ ɔ fiɛɔ ngɛ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyɛɛ mo blɔ kaa o ma ha mɛ a niye ní ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Ke o ha mɛ niye ní ɔ, a yeɔ; o lɛɔ mɛ nɛ a tɔɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi sɔuu.
Ke o kua mɛ ɔ, a haoɔ.
Ke o ngɔ a mumi ɔ, a gboɔ nɛ a kpaleɔ kɛ yaa zu mi he nɛ a je ɔ. O ngɔɔ o mumi ngɔ woɔ a mi, nɛ a peeɔ nibɔ níhi.
Kɛkɛ o haa je ɔ peeɔ ehe ekohu.
Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa hi si daa!
Níhi nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ, e ma na a he bua jɔmi.
Ke Yawɛ hyɛ je ɔ, kɛkɛ je ɔ mimiɛ.
Ke e ta yo ɔmɛ a he kɛkɛ a je la su ku.
Ma la kɛ je Yawɛ yi ye wami be ɔ tsuo.
Be mi nɛ i ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, ma la kɛ je ye Mawu ɔ yi.
Susumi kpakpa nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, i na nɛ lɛ tsuo sa e hɛ mi, ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi.
Yayami peeli tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ kpata, konɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ ko hi je ɔ mi hu.
Ma je Yawɛ yi.
Ee, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Mawu kɛ e ma a Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si; nyɛɛ wo e biɛ ta; nyɛ ha je ma amɛ nɛ a le e ní peemi ní ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi, nyɛɛ sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ. Nyɛ ha nɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ wa he kaa Yawɛ níhi ji wɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, e nya!
Nyɛ hla Yawɛ se blɔ, konɛ e ha nyɛ he wami; nyɛ ja lɛ daa.
-Nyɛ, Mawu tsɔlɔ Abraham nina!
Yakob nina, nyɛ nɛ Mawu hla!
Nyɛ kai nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu pee, kɛ bɔ nɛ e kojo je ma amɛ.
Yawɛ ji wa Mawu; e woɔ e mlaa kɛ haa je ɔ tsuo.
E kaiɔ e somi ɔ daa.
Si ko nɛ e wo ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ yi nɔhi tsuo.
Somi nɛ e kɛ Abraham so ɔ, e kaiɔ; kita nɛ e ka Isak hu e maa ye nɔ.
Yawɛ kɛ Yakob so, nɛ somi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
E ke, “Ma ngɔ Kanaan zugba a kɛ ha mo, nɛ zugba a ma ba pee o weto ní.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ a he pi; a be blɔ nya ko kulaa, nɛ nibwɔhi ji mɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
A nyɛɛɔ kɛ jeɔ ma kake mi kɛ yaa ma kake mi.
A woɔ lalaalo kɛ jeɔ nɔ yemi he kake kɛ yaa nɔ yemi he kake.
Se Mawu ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɛ hao mɛ; a he ɔ, e je blɔ de matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Ye nihi nɛ i pɔ mɛ nu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; nyɛ ko ye mɛ awi!
Ye gbali ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, nyɛ ko ta a he.” Jehanɛ, Yawɛ ha nɛ hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a niye ní tsuo ta.
Se e tsɔ nɔ ko kɛ nyɛɛ a hɛ mi momo; lɛ ji Yosef nɛ a jua lɛ kaa nyɔguɛ ɔ.
A wo e nane kɔsɔkɔsɔ, nɛ a kɛ e kuɛ wo dade pã mi kɛ ya si nɔ́ nɛ e de to ɔ ba mi.
Yawɛ munyu ɔ wo lɛ nguɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ tsɔ nɛ a ya je lɛ; je ma amɛ a nɔ yelɔ ɔ ha e ye e he.
Matsɛ ɔ pee lɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e we ɔ, kɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ, konɛ e tsɔse e ganɔ ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ e tsɔɔ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ nile.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya ya to nubwɔ ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Yawɛ ha nɛ e ma a bɔ, nɛ a he hiɛ babauu.
E ha a he hu wa kulaa pe a he nyɛli ɔmɛ.
E puɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a juɛmi ngɛ Israel he; a nyɛ mɛ, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ níhi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔ e tsɔlɔ Mose, kɛ Aaron nɛ e hla mɛ ɔ. Mawu ha nɛ a pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Mawu ha nɛ diblii wo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ e fa Egipt bi ɔmɛ ke a pee ɔ, a bui fɛɛ.
E ha nɛ a pa amɛ tsuo plɛ pee muɔ, nɛ a mi lo ɔmɛ tsuo gbo.
Ovɔnɔhi babauu ba zugba a nɔ; matsɛ we ɔ mi pohu ovɔnɔhi hyi lejɛ ɔ tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Mawu tu munyu, nɛ pwɔlwɔɛ munomunohi babauu ba zugba a tsuo nɔ.
E ha nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ ngɛ hiɔmi nane mi, nɛ oslabai gba ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
E kpata wai tsohi, ngmɔkɔ tsohi, kɛ tso kpahi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
E tu munyu, nɛ baalɛhi ba babauu, baalɛ nguahi kɛ wawi nɛ hí kanemi.
Baalɛ ɔmɛ ye ngmɔ si níhi, kɛ ba mumu tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Jehanɛ, e gbe bitɛtehi nɛ ji Egipt nyumuhi a kekleekle ngmɛduhi tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpaka Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je; nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti nɛ ji hiɔtsɛ; mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ngɛ kpakpataa.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ na bua jɔmi wawɛɛ nitsɛ; ejakaa a ye Israel bi ɔmɛ gbeye.
Mawu ha nɛ bɔku ba ha Israel bi ɔmɛ a he; e ha mɛ la, nɛ a kɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nyɔ mi.
A bi lɛ niye ní, nɛ e ha mɛ hɔne.
E ha mɛ niye ní kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ.
E bli tɛ sa nya, nɛ nyu je mi pue si; nyu ɔ be lalaala ngɛ nga a nɔ kaa pa. E kai e tsɔlɔ Abraham, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpaka e ma nɛ e hla a kɛ je; a la, nɛ a hwɔ lele.
Mawu ngɔ ma je li ɔmɛ a zugba a kɛ ha mɛ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ni kpahi gbo he dengme ɔ ba plɛ pee a nɔ́.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ a kai e mlaa amɛ, nɛ a ye nɔ.
A je Yawɛ yi!
Yawɛ hi Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e hi; e naa mɔbɔ kɛ yaa neneene!
Ní nguanguahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma je e yi bɔ nɛ sa?
A gbaa nihi nɛ yeɔ dami sane, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da be tsuaa be.
Yawɛ, ke o ngɛ o ma a mɔbɔ nae ɔ, mo kai imi hulɔ; ke o ngɛ a yi wami hee ɔ, ngɔɔ imi hu ngɔ piɛ a he.
Ha nɛ ma na bɔ nɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ ha, konɛ bua jɔmi nɛ ba ma a mi ɔ, imi hu ma piɛ a he kɛ nya.
Wa pee yayami kaa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.
Wa pee níhi nɛ sɛ; wa wa nihi yi mi.
Nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ pee ngɛ Egipt ɔ, wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nui sisi.
Suɔmi babauu nɛ e je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ, a kaii we.
Mohu ɔ, a te si wo lɛ ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e he a yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ; nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ. E nga Wo Tsu ɔ yi, nɛ nyu ɔ mii, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ kɛ be kaa nɔ́ nɛ nga nɔ lɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.
E kpɔ mɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi; e je mɛ kɛ je a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Se nyu ɔ ba ha a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po ji mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ma a he e munyu ɔmɛ ye, nɛ a la kɛ je e yi.
Se e kɛ we kulaa nɛ a hɛ je níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ha mɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ a bui e ga womi tue hu.
A ya di jiklɔɔ níhi a se ngɛ nga a nɔ; a pee enɛ ɔ kɛ ka Mawu.
Mawu ha mɛ níhi nɛ a bi lɛ ɔ tsuo; se e ngɔ hiɔ nɛ haa nɛ nɔ flaa kɛ gbla a tue.
Ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ a hɛ kɔ̃ Mose nɔ, kɛ jehanɛ Aaron, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ zugba a gba, nɛ e mii Datan; e mii Abiram, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ hulɔ.
La je ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e sã yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
A pee na bi ngɛ Horeb, nɛ a sɔmɔ jamɛ a amaga a nɛ a puɛ ɔ.
A ngɔ amaga nɛ a pee kaa na nɛ yeɔ nga a kɛ tsake Mawu nitsɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Mawu, a kpɔlɔ ɔ nɛ tsu ní tsumi nguanguahi ngɛ Egipt ɔ, a hɛ je e nɔ.
Hyɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!
Hyɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ e pee ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya!
Benɛ Mawu de ke e ma kpata e ma a hɛ mi ɔ, e tsɔlɔ Mose nɛ e hla a nɛ da mi ha ma a. Mose lɛ jɔɔ Mawu abofu ɔ he, loko e kpataa we ma a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu we zugba saminyayoo ɔ he munyu kpakpa, ejakaa si nɛ Mawu wo mɛ ɔ, a he we yi.
A tu munyu huitihuiti ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi; nɛ a bui Yawɛ tue.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e wo e nine nɔ nɛ e ka mɛ kita kaa e ma kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ e ma ha a nina maa gbɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ a mi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Jehanɛ, Mawu ma a ya piɛ je ma amɛ a he nɛ a kɛ mɛ ja Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor ɔ. Bɔhi nɛ a sã ha a ni gbogboe ɔmɛ hu a kɛ mɛ ye.
A kɛ a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la, nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba sɛ a kpɛti.
Se Finehas te si, nɛ e gbla yayami peeli ɔmɛ a tue, kɛkɛ nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po.
Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ, a kaiɔ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ e pee nɛ ɔ; nɛ a maa ya nɔ ma kai daa.
Ma a wo Yawɛ mi mi la ngɛ Meriba pa a nya.
A kɛ Mose wo haomi mi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ he.
Mose mi mi fu ma a wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e tu munyu basabasa.
A kpataa we je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Mohu ɔ, a ya futu je ma amɛ, nɛ a kase a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ.
A sɔmɔ a we amaga amɛ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a kpa Mawu se nyɛɛmi.
A kɛ a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi sã bɔ ha wɔhi.
A pue nihi nɛ pee we yayami a muɔ si; mɛ nitsɛmɛ a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi po a ngɔ mɛ kɛ sã bɔ ha Kanaan wɔhi; nɛ a kɛ muɔ ble zugba a.
A kɛ a ní peemi ble mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, nɛ Mawu hu a yi lɛ anɔkuale.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu lɛ nitsɛ e ma a, nɛ e kua mɛ.
E ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo je mahi a dɛ mi; nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye a nɔ.
A he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye a nɔ kɛ kɔni si wami; a wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a ha nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ.
Yawɛ je e ma a kɛ je a haomihi a mi si abɔ.
Se pee se ɔ, a tsɔɔ e hɛ mi atuã nɛ a ya peeɔ yayamihi nɛ pe kekle ní ɔmɛ po.
Se kɛ̃, benɛ e nu nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ɔ a ní pee lɛ mɔbɔ.
E kai somi nɛ e kɛ mɛ so ɔ, nɛ e suɔmi babauu ɔ he je ɔ, e ngɔ a he kɛ ke mɛ.
E ha nɛ a ní pee nihi tsuo nɛ nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ mɔbɔ.
Yawɛ wa Mawu!
Mo kpɔ wɔ kɛ je je ma amɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ o kpale wɔ kɛ ba ekohu, konɛ waa na mo si, nɛ wa je o biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi; nyɛ je e yi kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene.
Nyɛ ha nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ de ke, “Amen!” Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.
WOMI ENUƆNE A je Mawu yi, ejakaa e hi “Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!” Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ he nyɛ yi wami, nɛ e kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli a dɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hi enɛ ɔ dee kpamisa, nɛ nyɛ kɛ je e yi.
E ngɔ nyɛ kɛ je ma se kɛ ba kɛ je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je, kɛ je omleyi je, kɛ leneyi je.
Ni komɛ wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ; a nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɛ a kɛ ya ma a mi nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Hwɔ ye mɛ, nɛ kuma ye mɛ hluu kɛ ya si a mumu nya ta.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.
E ngɔ mɛ kɛ gu blɔ tlɔmɔɔ nɔ hluu kɛ ya su ma ko mi he nɛ a maa hi.
E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
Nihi nɛ kuma ye mɛ ɔ, e ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu; ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ye mɛ ɔ, e ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ.
Ni komɛ hi si ngɛ diblii, kɛ mɔbɔ si himi mi; a wo mɛ tsu; a kpla mɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ, nɛ a na nɔ́; ejakaa a tsɔ Hiɔwe No Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã, nɛ a bui e munyu, kɛ e ga womi ɔmɛ fɛɛ.
A tsu ní kpakpataa hluu kɛ ya si pɔ tɔ mɛ.
Ke a nɔ si ɔ, nɔ ko be nɛ woɔ a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.
E je mɛ kɛ je diblii, kɛ mɔbɔ si himi ɔ mi, nɛ e kplɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ a he ngɔ pue si.
E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
E ku akɔblee agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ e poo agbo se lami dade ɔmɛ a mi.
Ni komɛ ya je kuasia, nɛ a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ ha nɛ a na nɔ́.
Niye ní ko niye ní ko pee we mɛ akɔnɔ; a su gbenɔ muɔ nya haa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.
E ngɔ e munyu ɔ kɛ tsa mɛ.
E je mɛ kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami nɛ ko ba a nɔ ɔ mi.
E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
E sa kaa a sã bɔhi kɛ na lɛ si; a kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ la nyami la kɛ gba níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ. Nihi kɛ lɛ ye jua ngɛ wo hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ na a nya mi ngma.
A na níhi nɛ Yawɛ tsu; a na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ ɔ. E fa nɛ ahumi fia, nɛ wo oslɔkehi te si.
Oslɔke ɔmɛ wo lɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe kɛ ba si, kɛ ya wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
Haomi nɛ ba a nɔ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ha a kã nya ta.
Nɛ e pee ja a, a ngɛ kpae, nɛ a ngɛ si tɛe kaa dã deli, nɛ a pa li bɔ nɛ a maa pee hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.
E tsi ahumi ɔ nya nɛ e kpa fiami; oslɔke ɔmɛ a he jɔ, nɛ wo ɔ ngmɛ dii.
Ni ɔmɛ a bua jɔ a he jehanɛ, ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya ba si.
Yawɛ kɛ mɛ ba su lɛsimuɔ he ɔ nɛ a yaa a fiafiaafia.
E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ; e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
A je e yi; ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nɛ je e yi; á je e yi ngɛ ma nimeli a kpe ɔ mi hulɔ.
Yawɛ ha pahi mii kulaa, nɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi tsi, nɛ a bɛ hu.
Zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a plɛ pee ngo zɔ zugba; ejakaa nihi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ, yayami sɔuu a pee.
Yawɛ ha nga kplanaa plɛ pee taku kɛ e mi nyu babaaba; nɛ zugba gbigbli plɛ pee he nɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi hia si ngɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ye mɛ ɔ, e ha a to si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a po ma, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ.
A hu zugba a, nɛ a du wai yiblii ngɛ nɔ; nɛ a kpa ní babauu.
Yawɛ gbaa e ma a; e ha nɛ a he ba hiɛ babauu nitsɛ; a lohwehi hu e ha we nɛ a nɔ nɛ gbɔ́.
Benɛ a he nyɛli ba ye Mawu ma a nɔ, nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní babauu ɔ, Mawu hu kɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ to ní saminya, nɛ e ha nɛ a ya wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ he nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko be.
Se nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, e je mɛ kɛ je a haomihi a mi; nɛ e ha a ngmɛdu he ba hiɛ babauu kaa tohi.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a naa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a bua jɔɔ he; se yayami peeli lɛɛ a maa a nya.
Nɔ nɛ ji ní lelɔ ɔ, e susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Nihi tsuo nɛ a susu Yawɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he.
Mawu, jé mi kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi Mawu, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ mo pɛ o nɔ; ma la kɛ je ye tsui mi kɛ je o yi.
Makɛ mla a, ma te si nɛ ma fia saku kɛ je o yi.
Nyɔmtsɛ, ma na mo si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi; ma la kɛ je o yi ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
Ejakaa o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kle kɛ su hiɔwe lokoo, nɛ o we anɔkuale yemi ya su bɔku mi tɔɔ.
Mawu, ha nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ, konɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ he wa yi wami.
Bu wa kue fami ɔ tue, ejakaa mo nitsɛ o ma nɛ o suɔ lɛ ji wɔ.
Mawu de ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ ke, “Ma hwɔ lele kɛ gba Shekem mi, nɛ ma dla Sukot kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ha ye ma a. Ye mahi ji Gilead kɛ Manase.
Efraim ji ye dade pɛɛ, nɛ Yuda ji ye matsɛ tso.
Moab ji ye hedu buɛ.
Ma sake ye tokota kɛ pue Edom nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye e nɔ.
Ma he ose kɛ ye Filistia nɔ kunimi.” Mɛnɔ maa ngɔ mi kɛ ya ma nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he ɔ mi?
Mɛnɔ ma ya sɛ mi Edom?
Mawu, anɛ pi mo nɛ o kua wɔ ɔ lo?
Mawu, o kɛ wa tabo ɔ tsa yɛ ta!
Piɛ wa he, konɛ waa kɛ he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ to ní.
Ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa he wami pi nɔ́ ko!
Nɛ́ Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, wa maa ye kunimi.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ye wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ha wɔ.
Nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ haomi mi e kue fami Mawu, i ngɛ o yi jee; koo pee dii.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ lakpatsɛmɛ te si kɛ wo mi; lakpa munyu sɔuu a ngɛ tue ngɛ ye he.
A te si kɛ wo mi, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ yayami dee ngɛ ye he kɛkɛ.
I suɔ mɛ, nɛ i faa kue kɛ haa mɛ, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a poɔ ye nya yaka gu.
A ngɔɔ yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nɛ i peeɔ mɛ ɔ nane mi.
A nyɛɛ mi ngɛ suɔmi nɛ i suɔ mɛ ɔ nane mi.
A deɔ ke, ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛ ko kɛ lɛ nɛ to ní; lɛ nitsɛ e he nyɛlɔ nɛ ya po e nya ngɛ sane yemi he.
Ke a kojo lɛ ɔ, ha nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ; e kue fami ɔ hu, a bu kaa yayami.
E wami se ko kɛ; e blɔ nya nɛ ba pee nɔ kpa nɔ́!
E bimɛ nɛ a ye awusa, nɛ́ e yo ba pee yalɔyo!
E bimɛ nɛ a kpa si, nɛ a ba ní, nɛ a we doku nɛ a ngɛ mi po, a fie mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ!
E hiɔtsɛmɛ nɛ a ba kpɔ e níhi tsuo ngɛ e dɛ; nɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e gbo dengme kɛ na a, nibwɔhi nɛ a ba ha.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó na lɛ mɔbɔ; awusa bimɛ nɛ e ma si ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó hyɛ a nɔ.
E ngmɛdu hɛ mi nɛ kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ; nɛ yi nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ se ɔ ko le e biɛ tete po.
Yawɛ mo kai yayamihi nɛ e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, nɛ e nyɛ he yayami po a ko ngɔ kɛ pa lɛ.
Yawɛ nɛ kai a he yayami ɔmɛ daa nɛ, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ko kai mɛ gblegbleegble ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ nlɛ hyɛ kaa e maa na nɔ ko mɔbɔ, se ohiatɛmɛ, dɛgutsɛmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e wa mɛ yi mi hluu kɛ ya si a gbenɔ mi po.
E suɔ nɔ gbiɛmi, lɛ hu á gbiɛ lɛ ja nɔuu.
E sume gbaami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó gbaa lɛ.
Gbiɛmi pee e he nɔ́ kaa tade nɛ e woɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e gbiɛmi ɔ nɛ sɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi kaa nyu, kɛ e wuhi a mi kaa nu!
Gbiɛmi nɛ pee kaa bo nɛ e kɛ haa e he, kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ fii e mlɛ mi daa nɛ.
Yawɛ, ye he nyɛli, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ mi ɔ, wo mɛ hiɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.
Se mo Yawɛ, ye Nyɔmtsɛ, pee ha mi kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ; he ye yi wami, ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ hi, nɛ e ngɛ daa.
Ohiatsɛ ji mi; ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ ye tsui ngɛ mi yee ngɛ ye mi mi tɔɔ.
I laa kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ nini laa gbɔkuɛ nya si; a hu mi ngɔ fɔ he kaa a fieɔ baalɛ.
I ha hwɔ hluu kɛ ya si ye nakutsohi a mi gbɔjɔ, nɛ i ta he lo kanakana.
I pee ahlua bɔmi nɔ́ ha ye nya poli ɔmɛ.
Ke a na mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a mimiɛɔ a yi kɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu.
Yawɛ ye Mawu, ba piɛ ye he koo!
He ye yi wami ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he!
Ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a le kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, o nine ngɛ mi; mo Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ o tsu.
Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a gbiɛ mi faa; moo lɛɛ o maa gbaa mi sa.
Nihi nɛ te si kɛ wo mi ɔ, zo nɛ gbe mɛ, konɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi.
Zo nɛ gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
Zo nɛ ha a he kaa bo.
Ma pa ye nya mi ma la kɛ na Yawɛ si saminya.
Ma je e yi ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi.
Ejakaa e yeɔ dɛgutsɛ sane ha lɛ.
Nihi nɛ buɔ dɛgutsɛ gbenɔ fɔ ɔ, e jeɔ lɛ kɛ jee a dɛ mi.
Yawɛ kɛ matsɛ nɛ e hla a Yawɛ de ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Hii si ngɛ ye hiɔ nɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.” Yawɛ ma ha mo he wami kpetekpleenyɛ kɛ je Zion.
E ma de mo ke, “Ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Ligbi ɔ nɛ o maa hia ta kɛ wo o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, o ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a he kɛ ha ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya.
Nihewi babauu ma ba pue si ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa makɛ bɔ́.
Yawɛ ka kita nɛ ɔ, nɛ e be e nya se kpalee, “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ o hiɔ nɔ; ligbi ɔ nɛ e mi mi maa wo la a, e ma kpata matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
E maa gbla je ma amɛ a tue; nɛ ma amɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ ni gbogboehi.
E ma kpata matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Matsɛ ɔ maa nu pa nɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ he ɔ mi nyu, lɔ ɔ maa wo lɛ he wami, nɛ e maa ye kunimi.
A je Yawɛ yi A je Yawɛ yi!
Ma na Yawɛ si kɛ ye tsui tsuo ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a gua a mi.
Yawɛ tsuɔ ní nguanguahi.
Nihi nɛ nyaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ hlaa kaa a maa nu a sisi saminya.
E tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje.
E yeɔ dami sane daa.
Yawɛ haa nɛ a kaiɔ e nyakpɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ.
E mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ.
Nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ, e lɛɔ mɛ.
E hɛ ngɛ e somi ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa neneene.
E ngɔ ma je li a zugba a kɛ ha e ma a kɛ tsɔɔ e ma a kaa e ngɛ he wami.
E yeɔ anɔkuale kɛ dami sane ngɛ níhi tsuo a mi; nɛ e mlaa amɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu.
Mlaa amɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene; anɔkuale kɛ dami mi a pee mɛ ngɛ.
E ha e ma a ye a he, nɛ e kɛ mɛ so somi nɛ ngɛ daa.
E he tsɔ, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye!
Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o na nile ɔ, ye Yawɛ gbeye.
Nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ ja a, a nuɔ nɔ́ sisi saminya.
A je Yawɛ yi daa!
Bua jɔmi nɛ nɔmlɔ kpakpa naa A je Yawɛ yi!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ e naa e mlaa amɛ a he bua jɔmi saminya a. E nina maa pee ni nguanguahi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa gbaa e ngmɛdu.
E we ɔ maa pee niatsɛ we he nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ ngɛ, nɛ e maa bɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
La kpɛɔ ngɛ diblii mi kɛ haa nimli kpakpahi, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da, nihi nɛ naa mɔbɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ a mi mi jɔ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ e mi mi jɔ, nɔ nɛ paa nɔ nɔ́, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ e ní tsumi mi ɔ, á gbaa lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be lɛ pee; a ma kai lɛ daa.
E yi sane yobu ko nɛ maa ba a gbeye; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pue we e tsui nɔ, ejakaa e ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.
E yi tsui, nɛ e yi gbeye hulɔ.
E hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e maa ye e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi kɛ̃.
E keɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ní kɛ jeɔ e tsui mi faa.
E naa mɔbɔ daa.
E hɛ mi maa ba nyami, nɛ a maa bu lɛ.
Ke yiwutsotsɛ na kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e dɔɔ lɛ; e kpeɔ e lungu nya, nɛ e jeɔ lejɛ ɔ dii.
Yiwutsotsɛ yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.
Mawu yi jemi la A je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli, nyɛ je e yi; nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi!
A je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je tsuo, e sa kaa nyɛ je e yi.
Yawɛ lɛ yeɔ je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kle kɛ be hiɔwe po he.
Nɔ ko be nɛ ngɛ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ma e yi si kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba tsuo hyɛe ɔ. E woɔ humi bi nɔ kɛ jeɔ zu mi; e woɔ ohiatsɛ nɔ kɛ jeɔ kuku nɔ, nɛ e haa nɛ a kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma a mi ganɔ ɔmɛ hii si.
E haa yosa fɔɔ bi; e plɛɔ peeɔ bimɛ a nyɛ, nɛ e bua jɔɔ e he saminya.
A je Yawɛ yi.
Hetsɔmi nyami be la Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt, ee, benɛ Yakob nina a je ma se zugba a nɔ ɔ, Yuda ba pee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma klɔuklɔu, nɛ Israel ba pee e nɔ yemi he.
Wo Tsu ɔ na mɛ, nɛ e tu fo; Yordan pa a hu se po.
Yo ɔmɛ tuu kaa agbosuhi, yoku ɔmɛ tuu kaa jijɔhi.
Mo wo, mɛni ba nɛ o tu fo ɔ?
Yordan, mɛni ha o se po ɔ?
Nyɛ yohi, mɛni ba nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tuue kaa agbosuhi ɔ?
Nyɛ yokuhi, mɛni ha nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tuue kaa jijɔhi ɔ?
Zugba lee, mo mimiɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi; mimiɛ ngɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ hɛ mi koo; lɛ nɛ haa tɛ sa plɛɔ peeɔ taku kɛ e mi nyu buɛii, nɛ nyu paa si kɛ jeɔ tslɛbo mi.
Anɔkuale Mawu kake too ɔ Yawɛ, pi wɔ oo, pi wɔ, se mo nɛ o sa hɛ mi nyami; ejakaa o suɔmi ngɛ daa, nɛ o we anɔkuale yemi hu be nyagbe.
Mɛni he je je ma amɛ ma bi ke, “Jije a Mawu ɔ ngɛ” ɔ?
Wa Mawu ɔ, hiɔwe e ngɛ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.
Se ni ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ji mɛ, níhi nɛ nimli adesahi ngɔ a nine kɛ pee kɛkɛ.
A ngɛ nya, se a tu we munyu; a ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́.
A ngɛ tue, se a nui nɔ́; a ngɛ gugwɔ, se a fu we nɔ́.
A ngɛ nine, se a pɛtɛ we nɔ́ he; a ngɛ nane, se a nyɛɛ we; a kuɛ si po a kpɛ we.
Nihi nɛ pee mɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa amaga amɛ nɔuu.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ a nɔ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ a ngɛ.
Israel ma, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.

Lɛ ji nyɛ he piɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ yi baalɔ.

Lɛ ji nyɛ he piɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ yi baalɔ.
Yawɛ hɛ ngɛ wa nɔ, nɛ e maa gbaa wɔ; ee, e maa gbaa Israel ma a; e maa gbaa Israel osɔfo ɔmɛ a nina a. E maa gbaa nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ lɛ Yawɛ ɔ gbeye, ni wawihi kɛ ni nguahi tsuo.
Yawɛ nɛ ha nyɛɛ bɔ saminya, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ tsuo.
Yawɛ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, é gbaa nyɛ.
Hiɔwe ɔ tsuo e nɔ́, se zugba a lɛɛ e ngɔ kɛ ha nimli adesahi.

Nɔ ko nɛ a he e yi wami je Yawɛ yi I suɔ Yawɛ, ejakaa e nuɔ ye kue fami ɔ, nɛ e buɔ mi tue.
Akɛnɛ e buɔ mi tue he je ɔ, ma tsɛ lɛ ye wami be tsuo.
Gbenɔ klama amɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe, gbeje nɔ́ nami ɔmɛ wo ye he gbeye; ye ní pee mɔbɔ, nɛ i hao wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, he ye yi wami!” Dloolɔ, kɛ dalɔ ji Yawɛ; ee, wa Mawu ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ.
Nihi nɛ peepee ta a he ɔ, Yawɛ baa a yi; benɛ i gbɔjɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e he ye yi wami.
Ye nɔ gbagba maa te, nɛ ye bua maa jɔ ekohu; ejakaa Yawɛ dloo mi babauu.
Gbenɔ mi nitsɛ nɛ Yawɛ je mi kɛ je; ye hɛngmɛhi loloo we kɛ vo nyu hu, nɛ ye nanehi tɛ we si hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ba ye je mi bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, ngɛ hɛ kali a zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ i de ke, “Ye hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ” ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi po, i hɛɛ ye hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Benɛ ye tsui po hu i de ke, “E sɛ kaa a ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔɔ nɔmlɔ adesa ko kulaa nɔ.” Mɛni ma kɛ na Yawɛ si ngɛ kpakpa tsuo nɛ e pee mi ɔ he?
Ma ngɔ wai kɛ sã bɔ kɛ na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e he ye yi wami.
Ma ye ye siwo nɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hɛ mi.
Yawɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a gbenɔ dɔɔ lɛ wawɛɛ.

Kunimi yemi he sina Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Israel ma a nɛ de ke, “E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Israel osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a de ke, “E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, a de ke, “E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Benɛ i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ, i tsɛ Yawɛ; Yawɛ he mi nɔ, nɛ e je mi.
Nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi ngɛ nɛ ɔ, i yi gbeye; mɛni adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi.
Yawɛ kɛ mi ngɛ.
Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e maa piɛ ye he.
Nihi nɛ sume mi ɔ, ye hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ ma kɛ na kaa i ye a nɔ kunimi momo.
E hi kaa o sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ o maa ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔmlɔ nɔ.
E hi kaa o sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ o maa ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ ganɔhi a nɔ.
He nyɛli babauu ba bɔle mi kɛ kpe; se ngɛ Yawɛ he wami nya a, i kpata a hɛ mi!
A bɔle mi kɛ kpe; a sa ye yi, se ngɛ Yawɛ he wami nya a, i kpata a hɛ mi!
A buble mi kaa hwo; se a ngla kaa mio tso mi la.
Yawɛ he wami nya a, i kpata a hɛ mi!
A ba tua mi kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ a miɔ nɛ a maa ye ye nɔ, se Yawɛ piɛ ye he.
Yawɛ lɛ woɔ mi he wami; ma la kɛ je e yi, ejakaa e he ye yi wami.
Nyɛɛ bu tue, kunimi la ngɛ pɛe ngɛ dali ɔmɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi ke, “Yawɛ kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ tsu ní nguanguahi!
Yawɛ nine ho hiɔwe ya; Yawɛ kɛ e hɛ mi nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ tsu ní nguanguahi!” I be gboe, se mohu ma hi je mi, nɛ ma jaje níhi nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ.
Yawɛ gbla ye tue wawɛɛ mohu, se e ha we nɛ ma gbo.
Nyɛ bli Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔmɛ ha mi; ma sɛ mi nɛ ma ya na Yawɛ si!
Yawɛ we agbo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛ pɛ nɛ a maa sɛ mi.

Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa ye kunimi koo!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ!
Wa ngɛ mo gbae kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ. Yawɛ ji Mawu; e ha wɔ la.

Mo ji ye Mawu; ma na mo si.
Mo ji ye Mawu; ma wo o hɛ mi nyami.

Yawɛ mlaa a A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ piami ko be a he ngɛ a si himi mi, nihi nɛ baa a je mi ngɛ Yawɛ mlaa a nya.
A gbaa nihi nɛ yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ kɛ a tsui tsuo hlaa e se blɔ, nihi nɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, se mohu a baa a je mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ suɔ ɔ. Yawɛ, o wo o mlaa amɛ, konɛ a ye nɔ sisiisi.
I na nɛ i nyɛ ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ sisiisi.

Ke i kase o mlaa kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ma je o yi kɛ tsui nɛ mi tsɔ.
Ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ; ko kua mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ!

Bɔ nɛ e maa pee ji e maa ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

Yawɛ, ma je o yi; tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

Yé Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ I tlɔ zugba mɔbɔmɔbɔ; ha nɛ ma na he wami ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ. I jaje níhi nɛ i pee ɔ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ mo, nɛ o he mi nɔ; tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.

Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu ha nɛ i pee vii.

Yawɛ, i pɛtɛ o mlaa amɛ a he wawɛɛ; ko ha zo nɛ gbe mi.

Ha nɛ ma ye mlaa a nɔ; ejakaa e haa mi bua jɔmi.
Ha nɛ ma suɔ o mlaa amɛ mohu pe kaa ma na ní kpɔtɔɔ.
Níhi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ, ko ha ma hyɛ.

Ahlua nɛ i ngɛ gbeye yee kaa a maa bɔ mi ɔ, ha nɛ e tsɔ ye he kɛ ho, ejakaa o mlaa amɛ hi.
Hyɛ kaa i suɔ o mlaa amɛ; ha mi wami he, ejakaa o peeɔ nɔ nɛ da.
Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ Yawɛ, je o we anɔkuale suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi, nɛ o he ye yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma na heto ma ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe ɔ, ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o munyu ɔ nɔ.
Ha nɛ ma nyɛ ma tu anɔkuale be tsuaa be; ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Ma ye o mlaa a nɔ daa; ma ye nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene; nɛ ma hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi; ejakaa o mlaa nɔ i hlaa kaa ma ye.
Matsɛmɛ a hɛ mi tete po ma fiɛ o mlaa a, nɛ e be mi zo pee.
I naa o mlaa amɛ a he bua jɔmi, ejakaa i suɔ o mlaa amɛ.
I buu o mlaa amɛ, nɛ i suɔ mɛ hulɔ; o mlaa amɛ a he ma susu.
Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ Mo kai si nɛ o wo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ; ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ.
Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ nae pohu ye bua jɔ, ejakaa o wo mi si ke o ma he ye yi wami.
