I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o siwo ɔ nɔ.
Nyɔ mi tsuo i hwɔ we mahe; o siwo ɔ he i hii susue.
Bu ye gbi tue koo; ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe.
Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ o peeɔ; naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o baa ye yi.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae nɛ bui o mlaa a, a ngɛ hɛe kɛ ngɛ ye he sue.
Se Yawɛ, o ngɛ ye kasa nya haa, nɛ o mlaa amɛ tsuo maa si kpɛii.
I le kɛ je blema lokoo kaa o wo mlaa amɛ nɛ a hi si kɛ ya neneene.
Ba piɛ ye he Hyɛ amanehlu nɛ i ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ, nɛ o ba je mi kɛ je mi, ejakaa ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.
Ba ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, nɛ o kpɔ mi.
He ye yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
A be yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi wami hee; ejakaa a bui o mlaa amɛ.
Se Yawɛ, mo nɛ o naa mɔbɔ babauu, nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; mo he ye yi wami.
Nihi nɛ waa mi yi mi, kɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu, se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.
Ke i na nihi nɛ yi mo anɔkuale kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a he peeɔ mi tãi; ejakaa a yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Yawɛ, i suɔ o mlaa amɛ kaa nɔ́ ko!
O suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he ɔ, mo he ye yi wami.
O munyu ɔ tsuo, anɔkuale sisiisi; o mlaa amɛ da, nɛ eko tsuaa eko maa si kpɛii kɛ yaa neneene.
I suɔ Yawɛ mlaa a kɛ ye tsui tsuo Ganɔhi waa mi yi mi yaka, se kɛ̃ ɔ, i buɔ o mlaa amɛ.
O munyu ɔ ngɔɔ ye nya.
Ye bua jɔɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e nine ya su ta yibu ní nɛ he jua wa nɔ.
I sume lakpa kulaa, i hiee lɛ; se o mlaa lɛɛ i suɔ.
I jeɔ o yi si kpaago daa ligbi, ejakaa o mlaa amɛ da.
Nihi nɛ suɔ o mlaa amɛ ɔ, a naa he jɔmi nitsɛnitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hae nɛ a maa tla blɔ.
Yawɛ, mo o nɔ ye hɛ ngɛ, ba he ye yi wami; i peeɔ níhi nɛ o mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; i suɔ o mlaa amɛ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ; o le ye yami kɛ bami mi fitsofitso.
Ba piɛ ye he Yawɛ, ngmlaa nɛ i ngɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe ɔ, bu tue koo!
Ha nɛ ma nu nɔ́ sisi kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ!
Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue nɛ o ba kpɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ!
Ma je o yi daa; ejakaa o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
Ma la o mlaa a he la; ejakaa o mlaa amɛ tsuo da saminya.
Pee klaalo nɛ o ba piɛ ye he; ejakaa i yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe; ba he ye yi wami koo!
O mlaa a pɛ lɛ haa ye bua jɔɔ ye he.
Ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami, konɛ ma je o yi; ha nɛ o mlaa amɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ mi blɔ.
I ngɛ lalaalo woe kaa to nɛ laa; mo hla imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ koo!
Ejakaa i je we ye hɛ ngɛ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Ba piɛ ye he Benɛ i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e bu mi tue.
Yawɛ, je mi kɛ je lakpatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ sisiɔ a sibi a dɛ mi.
Nyɛ lakpatsɛmɛ, mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a ha nyɛ?
Mɛni po nɛ nyɛ pa ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee ha nyɛ?
Nyɛ hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi nɛ a nya ba, kɛ la ngu hɛuu kɛ ma kaa ta buli.
Ye yi fi pɛ!
Hyɛ kaa i ba to nubwɔ ngɛ Meshek; nɛ i ngɛ Kedar bi a ma mi!
Ye se ba kɛ tsɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ sume tue mi jɔmi ɔ a kpɛti.
Imi lɛɛ he jɔmi nɔmlɔ ji mi, se ke i tu munyu kɛkɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a hia ta!
Yawɛ ji wa he bulɔ Ke i wo ye yi nɔ nɛ i hyɛ yoku ɔmɛ ɔ, i biɔ ke jije balɔ maa je kɛ ba?
Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ ye he.
E be hae nɛ o sane kɛ nɔ si.
O he bulɔ ɔ, e de we kɔnɔɛ gblegbleegble.
O nɛ, Israel he bulɔ ɔ de we kɔnɔɛ, nɛ e hwɔ we mahe hulɔ.
Yawɛ ji o yi baalɔ.
E ngɛ o kasa nya, konɛ e bu o he.
Piani ɔ, pu be mo sããe, nɛ nyɔ mi hu nyɔhiɔ be mo nɔ́ ko pee.
Yawɛ maa bu o he kɛ je yayami tsuo mi; e maa baa o yi.
Ke o je kpo jio; o kpale kɛ ma we mi jio, Yawɛ maa bu o he.
E maa bu o he kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yerusalem yi jemi la Ye bua jɔ ye he wawɛɛ nitsɛ benɛ a de mi ke, “Waa ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya.” Yerusalem, jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ba sɛ o we agbo ɔmɛ a mi!
Yerusalem ji ma nguaa saminyayoo nɛ a to lɛ si kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ hanɔhanɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ yaa ya naa Yawɛ si kaa bɔ nɛ a fa Israel ma a ke a pee ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Israel matsɛmɛ nɛ ji David nina a hi kɛ kojo ma a. Nyɛɛ fa kue nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba Yerusalem.
Nyɛ de ke, “Nihi nɛ suɔ mo Yerusalem ɔ, níhi a mi nɛ hi ha mɛ oo!
Tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba ma a mi; he jɔmi nɛ hi mɔ ɔmɛ a mi.” Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ma de Yerusalem ke, “Tue mi jɔmi nɛ hi o mi!” Yawɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ he je ɔ, ma hla o nɔ yami.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ Yawɛ mo i wo ye yi nɔ kɛ ngɛ hyɛe; mo nɛ́ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, mo i ngɛ hyɛe ɔ nɛ!
O nɛ, bɔ nɛ tsɔli hyɛɛ a nyɔmtsɛ blɔ, nɛ mawayo hu hyɛɛ e wenyɛ blɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu wɔ hu wa ngɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ blɔ hyɛe kɛ yaa su be nɛ e maa na wɔ mɔbɔ.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ; Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ; ejakaa a pee wɔ nisɛ ní babauu tsɔ.
Nihi nɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ ɔ ye wa he fɛu babauu, nɛ he nɔ woli hu gbe wa he guɛ hluu kɛ ya si wa mumu nya ta.
Mawu ji e ma a he bulɔ Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ wa he ɔ nɛɛ?
Israel ha heto koo!
“Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ wa he be mi nɛ wa he nyɛli te si kɛ wo wɔ ɔ, jinɛ bɔ nɛ a mi mi fu wɔ wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ, a ko mii wɔ hɛ ngmengmle; jinɛ nyu babauu ɔ ko sá wɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ha wa nɔ; nɛ nyu hamahama a ko kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.” Nyɛ ha waa na Yawɛ si; ejakaa e ha we nɛ wa plɛ pee wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a lungu nya lo!
Wa je a dɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ jee ya mi; ya a gba, nɛ wa je mi slɔkee.
Yawɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba bɔlɔ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ wa he.
Mawu ma a naa tue mi jɔmi Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, a ngɛ kaa Zion yo ɔ. E maa si kpɛii kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma mimiɛ lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ yohi bɔle Yerusalem kɛ kpe ɔ, ja Yawɛ he wami ɔ bɔle e ma a kɛ kpe kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa neneene tsuo.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a a zugba nɔ yee daa, ke pi ja a, dali po maa pee yayami.
Yawɛ, nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa, kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ je a tsui mi ɔ, ha nɛ e hi ha mɛ.
Nihi nɛ a blɔ ɔmɛ dɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa gbla a kɛ yayami peeli tsuo a tue.
He jɔmi nɛ hi Israel.
Ba kpɔ mi Benɛ Yawɛ kpale wɔ kɛ je ma se kɛ ba Zion ekohu ɔ, e pee wɔ kaa pe wa ngɛ nlae.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, wa muɔ jɛɛ, nɛ wa la bua jɔmi la boboobo.
Je ma amɛ hu de a sibi ke, “Yawɛ tsu ní nguanguahi ha mɛ.” Niinɛ, Yawɛ tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha wɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ wa bua jɔ wa he nɛ wa ngɛ nyae ɔ nɛ!
Yawɛ, moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa zugba nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ nɛ zugba gbigbli naa nyu babaaba ekohu ɔ. Nihi nɛ du ní kɛ vo nyu ɔ ma kpa ní kɛ bua jɔmi.
Nɔ nɛ vo nyu hii e hɛ mi kɛ ya duɔ ní ɔ, e maa tloo niba ní kɛ ba we mi kɛ bua jɔmi.
A je Mawu yi, ejakaa e hi Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ maa tsu ɔ, tsu mali gboɔ yaka dengme.
Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ buɔ ma he ɔ, bulɔ fɔɔ nyɔ yaka gu kɛ buɔ ma he.
Yaka gu nyɛ teɔ si makɛ mla, nɛ gbɔkuɛ hu nyɛ ya hwɔ we si mla.
Nyɛ gboɔ dengme loko nyɛ naa nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ nyɛ yeɔ, se nɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ e sane ɔ, e haa e hwɔɔ mahe bɔ nɛ sa.
Bimɛ ji weto ní nɛ Yawɛ haa nɔ; bimɛ ji nike ní nɛ e kɛ dlooɔ nɔ.
Nihe mi bimɛ nɛ a fɔɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa ta bulɔ dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi.
Nɔ nɛ kotoku ɔ hyi kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.
Ke e kɛ e he nyɛli kpe ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee.
Hiɔwo kpakpa jeɔ Yawɛ tue bumi mi A gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yee Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ́ e yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
O ma na o nya mi ngma bɔ nɛ sa kɛ je ní nɛ o tsuɔ ɔ mi; o bua maa jɔ, nɛ e maa hi ha mo.
O yo maa pee kaa wai tso nɛ woɔ yiblii saminyayoo ngɛ o we ɔ mi; nɛ o bimɛ maa bɔle o we okplɔɔ ɔ afɛu mi kaa oliv tsohi nɛ tsɛ̃ kɛ ma.
Nyumu nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, niinɛ, bɔ nɛ a maa gbaa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ nɛ gbaa mo kɛ je Zion.
O wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, o na bɔ nɛ Yerusalem ma plɔke ha.
O wa, nɛ o na o bibimɛ.
Tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba Israel ma a mi!
A fa kue kɛ si Israel he nyɛli Israel, jehanɛ de, “Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si tɔɔ ɔ, ye he nyɛli wa mi yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ!” “Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si tɔɔ ɔ, ye he nyɛli wa mi yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nyɛ we mi.
A plaa ye se mi wawɛɛ, ye se mi pee kaa ngmɔ nɛ a kɛ kpakplaa hu.
Yawɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ e peeɔ; e je mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.” Nihi tsuo nɛ sume Zion ɔ, zo nɛ gbe mɛ nɛ a kpale a se!
A pee kaa nga nɛ ngɛ puɛe ngɛ tsu yi mi; benɛ e na we nɛ e wa, kɛkɛ e gbli momo.
Nga nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko fa we, nɛ a fi we nɛ a tloo kɛ je.
Nihi nɛ bee ɔ kó de ke, “Yawɛ nɛ gbaa nyɛ!
Wa ngɛ nyɛ gbaae ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi!”
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ, i ngɛ kue fae ha mo, ejakaa ye yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ, bu mi tue; bu ye pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue.
Ke mo Mawu o ke o maa kane yayamihi ɔ, Yawɛ, mɛnɔ maa ye e he.
Se o ngɔɔ yayami kɛ paa, konɛ a ye mo gbeye.
I ngɛ Yawɛ blɔ hyɛe; e munyu ɔ nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
Ee, Yawɛ blɔ pɛ i ngɛ hyɛe.
I ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe pe bɔ nɛ ma he buli huɔɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ ya suu mɔtu ɔ. Israel, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe; lɛ nɛ e heɔ wa yi wami.
Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ma kpɔ Israel kɛ je a he yayamihi tsuo a mi.
Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ kulaa Yawɛ, i wo we ye he nɔ, konɛ ye hɛngmɛhi nɛ hi hiɔwe níhi pɛ hyɛe; pohu ní nguanguahi, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ ha mi ɔ, i nyɛɛ we a se.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, i ba ye he si, nɛ i pee kpoo kaa bi nɛ a tsɔ lɛ nyɔ ngɛ e nyɛ kasa nya; ye klaa pee kpoo ngɛ ye mi kaa bi nɛ a tsɔ lɛ nyɔ.
Israel, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene.
Yawɛ we ɔ yi jemi la Yawɛ, mo kai amanehlu tsuo nɛ David na a. E ka mo Yawɛ kita, nɛ e wo mo Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ si ke, “I be ye we mi yae, nɛ i ya be si hwɔe hulɔ.
I be ye hɛ se jee, nɛ i be kɔnɔɛ tete dee kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma na he ko ha mo Yawɛ, Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ, konɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ pee o hi he!” Wa nu somi daka a he ngɛ Betlehem, nɛ wa ya na ngɛ Yearim ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Wa de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ya Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ wa ya kpla si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi!” Yawɛ, mo wo o he nɔ, nɛ o ba o he jɔɔmi he ɔ; ngɔɔ somi daka a nɛ ji o he wami okadi ɔ hu kɛ ba.
Ha nɛ o we osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da be tsuaa be, nɛ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a hwɔ lele!
Yawɛ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o wo o tsɔlɔ David si, nɛ o wo lɛ matsɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko kua lɛ.
Yawɛ, kita nɛ o ka David nɛ o be o nya se kpalee ji, “Ma wo o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake matsɛ, nɛ e maa ye tsɛ ngɛ o se.
Ke o bimɛ ɔmɛ maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ ma wo mɛ ɔ hu a maa ye a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ a bimɛ hu ma ba hi o sɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.” Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ suɔ nɛ e hla Zion kaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa hi.
E de ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ma hi kɛ maa ya neneene; hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ma jɔɔ ye he ngɛ; ejakaa i suɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Ma ha Zion ma na niye ní babauu, ma a mi ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa ye ní maa tɔ.
Ma gbaa osɔfo ɔmɛ a ní tsumi nɔ, nɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ma hwɔ lele!
Ma pee David nina kake matsɛ agbo ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; ma to lɛ si kaa nɔ nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla, nɛ i wo lɛ matsɛ.
Ma ha zo maa gbe e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpɔtɔɔ, se e tsɛ yemi ɔ maa bɔ, nɛ e ma he biɛ saminya.”
Nyɛmi suɔmi la Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e hi, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ fɛu, ke nyɛmimɛ pee kake kɛ hi si!
Nyɛmimɛ a kake peemi ngɛ kaa nu nɛ he jua wa nɛ a kɛ pɔ Aaron yi mi, nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɛ ngɛ e kpɛni mi puee hluu kɛ ba su e tade klɔii ɔ nya tɔɔ!
Nyɛmimɛ a kake peemi ngɛ kaa bɔ́ ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ nɔ; e ngɛ kaa bɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɛe ngɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ngɛ ke e maa gbaa e ma a kɛ maa ya neneene.
A je Mawu yi Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli tsuo, nyɛɛ ba; nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ ngɛ e we ɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nyɛ je e yi Nyɛ wo nyɛ nine nɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, é gbaa nyɛ kɛ je Zion.
Yi jemi la Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi!
Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa Yawɛ hi; nyɛ la kɛ je e biɛ ɔ yi, ejakaa e mi mi hi.
Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ hla Yakob kɛ ha e he; e hla Israel kɛ pee e ma.
Imi lɛɛ i le kaa Yawɛ kle; Yawɛ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.
Hiɔwe ɔ jio, zugba a nɔ jio, wo ɔ mi jio, muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ a mi jio, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ́ Yawɛ suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.
Lɛ nɛ e haa bɔku teɔ si ngɛ je ɔ nyagbe he; e pee oslabai kɛ ha hiɔmi, nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jee e to he ɔmɛ.
Lɛ nɛ e gbe kekleekle bimɛ tsuo ngɛ Egipt, nimli adesahi a bimɛ, kɛ lohwehi a bimɛ.
Lɛ nɛ tsu nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi kɛ gbla Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a tue.
Lɛ nɛ kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi, nɛ e gbe matsɛmɛ nguangua nɛ ɔmɛ: Sihon, Amor bi a matsɛ ɔ, Og, Bashan matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Kanaan matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a kɛ ha e ma, Israel kaa a weto ní.
Yawɛ, o biɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene; Yawɛ, yi nɔhi tsuo ma kai mo.
Yawɛ ma fa e ma a he; e maa na e tsɔli ɔmɛ mɔbɔ.
Je ma amɛ a we amaga amɛ ɔ, sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu sɔuu, nimli adesahi a nine nya ní tsumi ji mɛ.
A ngɛ nya, se a tu we munyu; a ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́.
A ngɛ tue, se a nui nɔ́; mumi ko hu be a gugwɔ mi nɛ a woɔ.
I ná nɛ nihi nɛ pee mɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ tsuo pee kaa amaga amɛ nɛ a pee ɔ nɔuu!
Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ Mawu we osɔfohi, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ Levi bi, nyɛ je e yi; nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ yee Yawɛ gbeye, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi ngɛ Zion; nyɛ je e yi ngɛ e we ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Sina la Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si; ejakaa Yawɛ hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Nyɛɛ na mawu ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ si; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Nyɛɛ na nyɔmtsɛmɛ a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ e peeɔ nyakpɛ ní; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ nile kɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ zugba a kɛ ha nyu ɔ hɛ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e pee kane nguanguahi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e haa nɛ pu tsoɔ piani; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e haa nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi kpɛɔ nyɔ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e gbe Egipt bi ɔmɛ a kekleekle bimɛ; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Nɛ e je Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e gba Wo Tsu ɔ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Nɛ e ha e ma, Israel nyɛɛ wo ɔ mi kɛ be; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Se Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɛ e ta a lɛɛ e kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e hɛɛ e ma a kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Nɛ e gbe matsɛmɛ nguanguahi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e gbe matsɛmɛ nɛ he biɛ nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ, ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Amor matsɛ, Sihon; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Bashan matsɛ, Og; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ a zugba amɛ kɛ ha e ma a kaa a weto ní; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ zugba amɛ kɛ ha e tsɔlɔ, Israel kaa e weto ní; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Benɛ wa yi fi wawɛɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e kai wɔ; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e je wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli a dɛ mi; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Lɛ nɛ e haa nibɔ ní tsuo niye ní; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Nyɛɛ na Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ si; ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Israel bi ɔmɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ma se.
Babilon pa amɛ a tue wa hi si ngɛ nɛ wa wo yana, benɛ wa kai Zion ɔ. Wa ngɔ wa kpa saku ɔmɛ ngɔ kpla tsohi a he ngɛ pa a tue.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a de wɔ ke wa la ha mɛ.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ wɔ haoe ɔ suɔ kaa wa je a hɛja; a de wɔ ke, “Nyɛ la Zion la amɛ eko ha wɔ!” Mɛni he je wa ma la Yawɛ la ngɛ ma se?
Ke ye hɛ je mo Yerusalem, o nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ye hiɔ nine nɛ gbo.
Ke i kaii we mo Yerusalem, nɛ ke i bui mo kaa nɔ nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi pe kulaa a, lɛɛ ye lilɛ nɛ mɛtɛ ye nya mi.
Yawɛ, mo kai nɔ́ nɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ pee Yerusalem ligbi ko ɔ. Edom bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Nyɛɛ ku ma a kɛ pue si; nyɛɛ ku lɛ pue si kɛ ya su e sisi tomi ɔmɛ tɔɔ!” Mo Babilon, ja a kpata o hɛ mi kokooko!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ maa pee mo kɛ to nane mi kaa bɔ nɛ o pee wɔ ɔ.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ o bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ fiaa tɛ sa.
Sina Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo si nae kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
I ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ o yi jee ngɛ Mawu kpa amɛ a hɛ mi po.
I ngɔ ye hɛ mi kɛ bu si kɛ kpee sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ; nɛ i ngɛ mo si nae kaa o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa, nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale jã kɛ̃.
Jehanɛ hu o ha nɛ a na kaa o biɛ kle pe biɛ tsuaa biɛ, nɛ o munyu hu he jua wa pe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he nɔ.
O wo mi kã, nɛ ye nɔ gbagba te.
Yawɛ, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ ma je o yi, ejakaa munyu nɛ je o nya a, a nu.
A ma la kɛ gba nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ; a ma la ma de ke o hɛ mi nyami ɔ kle.
Yawɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo mohu, se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, e hɛ hii e nɔ; nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ lɛɛ e he sane ko pi Yawɛ sane.
Ke i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ, mo lɛ o jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ mi.
Ke ye he nyɛli kɛ abofu ba na mi ɔ, o kɛ mɛ kpee, nɛ o kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ heɔ ye yi wami.
Yawɛ, yi mi nɛ o to ha mi ɔ, o maa ye nɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ, o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Ní tsumi nɛ o je sisi ɔ, koo ngmɛɛ he.
Mawu le nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ e baa wa yi Yawɛ, o hyɛ ye mi tsuo, nɛ o le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ.
Ye si himi, kɛ ye si temi tsuo o le, ye yi mi tomi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, o le momo.
Ke i ma blɔ ɔ, o le nɛ ke i hwɔ si hu o le; ee, ye ní peemi níhi tsuo o le.
Loko ma pa ye nya mi ke ma de nɔ́ ko ɔ, mo Yawɛ, o le lɛ tsuo momo.
O ngɔ o he wami kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe, nɛ o buɔ ye he.
Bɔ nɛ o le mi fitsofitso ɔ ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ.
Nile nɛ ɔ mi kuɔ pe bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ma nu sisi.
Jije ma je o mumi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ maa ya?
Jije ma ya laa ye he ngɛ nɛ o be mi nae?
Ke i kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ, ne mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ ke i ya hwɔ si ngɛ gbeje hu ne mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ ji mi, nɛ i te papaapa kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya ma bonyoku je se lokoo; lejɛ ɔ tete po mo lɛ o maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ, nɛ o hiɔ nine maa su ye nɔ.
Ke i de ke diblii ba ha ye nɔ, loo pu la nɛ bɔle mi ɔ nɛ plɛ pee diblii ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ yaka gu, ejakaa diblii pee we diblii ha mo, nɛ nyɔ mi tsɔɔ heii kaa piani nɔuu; diblii jio, la jio, lɛ tsuo kake ha mo.
Ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi níhi tsuo ɔ, mo lɛ o pee.
O puɛ mi ngɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi tɔɔ.
I ngɛ o yi jee, ejakaa bɔ nɛ o plɛ kɛ bɔ mi ɔ, e ngɛ gbeye, nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ hulɔ.
Níhi nɛ o pee ɔ ngɛ nyakpɛ loo!
O le mi fitsofitso.
Benɛ a ngɛ mi puɛe ngɛ laami mi, nɛ wu ɔmɛ ngɛ wae ngɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi tɔɔ ɔ, i fɔɔ si paa ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Benɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mi lolo po ɔ, a ngma ye wami be ɔ tsuo ngɛ o womi ɔ mi momo.
Mawu, yi mi tomi nɛ o ngɛ ha mi ɔ he jua wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ní kpakpahi nɛ o susuɔ ha mi ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu.
Ke i ke ma kane mɛ ɔ, i be nyɛe, ejakaa a he hiɛ babauu pe zia.
Loko ye hɛ maa tsɛ po o ngɛ ye he susue momo.
Mawu, i na nɛ o gbe yiwusotsɛmɛ, konɛ ma ye ye he kɛ je muɔ si pueli nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tuɔ musu bɔmi munyu, nɛ a teɔ si kɛ woɔ mo.
Nihi nɛ bui mo ɔ, anɛ imi lɛɛ i buɔ mɛ lo?
Nihi nɛ tsɔɔ o hɛ mi atuã a, anɛ i suɔ mɛ lo?
Dɛbi, i sume mɛ saasaa; i buɔ mɛ ye he nyɛli.
Mawu, hyɛ ye tsui mi nɛ o le mi.
Kaa mi nɛ o hyɛ, nɛ o na níhi nɛ ngɛ ye juɛmi mi.
Hyɛ kaa yayami ko pa ngɛ ye mi lo, nɛ o ngɔ mi kɛ fɔ blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa neneene wami mi ɔ nɔ.
Kue fami kɛ ha yi baami Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami; jé mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ yayami he pɛ a susuɔ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, pɛ kɛkɛ a ngɛ woe.
A lilɛ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔtsɛ nɔ́.
A munyu ngɛ kaa sanga duɔ.
Yawɛ, bu ye he; jé mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi; ejakaa a to a yi mi kaa a maa tsɛ̃ mi kɛ fia si.
He nɔ woli tsɔ klamahi ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a tue.
A tsɔ mi klama, konɛ a du mi.
I deɔ Yawɛ ke, “Mo ji ye Mawu!” Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue!
Ye Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ye yi wami helɔ kpanaa, ta be mi ɔ, mo nɔuu lɛ o baa ye yi.
Yawɛ, koo ngmɛ yayami peeli blɔ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ; ko ha nɛ a yi mi tomi yaya amɛ nɛ ba mi.
Nihi nɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe ɔ ngɛ ye he gbeye woe.
Ha nɛ ga yaya nɛ a ngɛ toe ngɛ ye he ɔ nɛ kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ha nɛ la ngu hɛuu ba pue a nɔ!
A ya nɔ muɔ mi nɛ a ko nyɛ kpo nɛ a je gblegbleegble.
Ko ha lakpatsɛmɛ nɛ gbeɔ nɔ he guɛ nɛ a plɔke ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ha nɛ yayami peeli a hɛ mi nɛ kpata amlɔ nɔuu.
Yawɛ, i le kaa nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, mo lɛ o hyɛɛ a nɔ, nɛ o yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane ha mɛ.
Niinɛ, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a maa na mo si; kpakpa peeli kɛ mo maa hi si daa.
Kue nɛ a faa gbɔkuɛ Yawɛ, mo i ngɛ tsɛe; o he nɛ sɔ ha mi; mo i ngɛ tsɛe boboobo ɔ nɛ, bu mi tue koo!
Ha nɛ ye kue fami ɔ nɛ je via kaa tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ o hɛ mi; nɛ ye nine nɛ i wo nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ, e pee kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ sãe gbɔkuɛ nya si ha mo.
Yawɛ, moo to bulɔ nɛ hyɛ ye nya nɔ, konɛ e hyɛ ye munyu tumi nɔ.
Piɛ ye he, konɛ ma ko na yayami peemi he bua jɔmi; piɛ ye he, konɛ i kɛ yayami peeli ko bɔ; nɛ ko ha ma ya ye a niye ní ngɔngɔɛ ɔ eko.
Ha nɛ dalɔ nɛ gba mi ma, nɛ e ngɔ e mi mi himi ɔ kɛ ka ye hɛ mi; se ko ha nɛ yayami peeli nɛ a je ye yi; ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, i faa kue kɛ siɔ a yayami ɔmɛ.
Ke a ngɔ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo nihi nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi a dɛ mi ɔ, ma a ma na maa le kaa Yawɛ munyu ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi.
Ke a ngɛ tɛ sa gbae ɔ, bɔ nɛ tɛ ɔ gbɛɛ kɛ fĩaa zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ, ja a ma sake a wuhi kɛ pue gbeje agbo ɔ nya.
Se mo Yawɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ i ngɛ hyɛe; mo ji ye wesa he; koo ngmɛɛ ye he kulaa kɛ fɔ si; bu ye he.
Je mi kɛ je klama nɛ he nyɛli tsɔ mi ɔ mi.
Je mi kɛ je yayami peeli a klama mi.
Ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ a ya nɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a klamahi a mi, se imi lɛɛ ha ma je a mi slɔkee.
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ i ngɛ tsɛe wawɛɛ ke e ba piɛ ye he ɔ nɛ.
I wo ye gbi nɔ wawɛɛ kɛ ngɛ lɛ pɛɛ kpae.
I ngɔ ye kɔmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e hɛ mi; i de lɛ ye haomi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Benɛ ye nine mi miɔ nɛ e wo nyu ɔ, moo lɛɛ o le ye hiami ɔ mo.
Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsɔ mi klama ngɛ ye blɔ ɔ mi.
Ke i hyɛ ye hiɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi; wesa he ko kulaa be ha mi, nɔ ko nɔ ko bui ye he akɔtaa.
Yawɛ, mo i ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ dee ke mo pɛ ji ye wesa he ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo, ejakaa peepee ta ye he kulaa.
Kpɔ mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
Ye yi fi; ejakaa a he wa pe mi.
Je mi, konɛ ma na mo si ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a hɛ mi; ejakaa kpakpa nitsɛnitsɛ o maa pee mi ɔ nɛ.
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ bu ye kue fami ɔ tue; mo ta tue ha pɛɛ nɛ i ngɛ mo kpae ɔ. Akɛnɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, bu mi tue nɛ o he nɔ ha mi koo!
O kɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ kó ye sane; ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa ko adesa ko be nguɔ yee ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ nyɛɛ ye se nɛ e ma kpata ye hɛ mi.
E fia mi nɔ́ wawɛɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ ye yi se ngɔ wo diblii kpii mi; i pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ gbo momoomo.
Ye mumu nya ta jehanɛ, nɛ peepee ta ye he!
I kaii sa blema a, nɛ i susuɔ níhi tsuo nɛ o tsu ɔ a he; i susuɔ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he.
I woɔ ye nine nɔ kɛ yaa hiɔwe kɛ faa kue.
Bɔ nɛ zugba gbigbli hlaa nyu kɛ jɔɔ e he ɔ, ja o he kuma ngɛ mi yee.
Yawɛ, he mi nɔ esɔ koo!
Ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo miɔ nɛ e ta.
Koo ngɔ o he kɛ laa mi; ke pi ja a, i kɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeje maa sɔ.
Mɔtu ɔ, ha ma kai bɔ nɛ o mi mi hi ha; ejakaa o nɔ i ngɔɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.
Ha nɛ ma le he nɛ ma gu; ejakaa mo pɛ o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
Yawɛ, jé mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
O ngɔ i ba sa we ngɛ.
Moo tsɔɔ mi nɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ; ejakaa mo ji ye Mawu.
Ha nɛ o mumi kpakpa a nɛ tsɔɔ mi blɔ nɛ hi, nɛ e nɔ jɔ.
Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ. O peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo je mi kɛ je haomi mi.
O suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he je ɔ, moo gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi haoe ɔ, mo kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; ejakaa o tsɔlɔ ji mi.
Matsɛ ko ye kunimi nɛ e na Mawu si Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi, lɛ ji ye yi baalɔ.
E tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ a gbaa ta, kɛ bɔ nɛ a miaa kɛ hwuu ta.
Lɛ ji ye yi baalɔ, ye wesa he nitsɛnitsɛ, kɛ ye kpɔlɔ; lɛ ji ye tsɛ̃i, nɛ e ngɔ i ya saa we ngɛ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ baa ma a si kɛ woɔ ye sisi.
Yawɛ, mɛnɔ kulaa ji nɔmlɔ nɛ o peeɔ e he akɔtaa, loo nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ o susuɔ e he ɔ?
Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa mumu nɛ a woɔ ɔ; e ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa hɔ̃ nɛ bee kɛ yaa.
Yawɛ, ha nɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ ba si, nɛ o kple si kɛ ba.
Moo ta yo ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a je la su ku.
Ha nɛ oslabai nɛ gba, nɛ o gbɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa; tsɛ̃ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ fo.
Kpa o nine mi kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ o sá mi; jé mi kɛ je nyu babauu ɔ mi; jé mi kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ mi; a nya mi munyu ɔ, lakpa sɔuu, nɛ a yeɔ lakpa kɛ kaa kita po.
Mawu, ma la la he ha mo, ma fia kpa saku nɛ hɛɛ kpa nyɔngma kɛ je o yi.
Mo lɛ o haa matsɛmɛ yeɔ kunimi, nɛ o heɔ o tsɔlɔ David yi wami.
He mi kɛ je klaate nɛ yeɔ awi ɔ nya, mo kpɔ mi kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ mi, nihi nɛ a nya mi munyu ɔ, lakpa sɔuu, nɛ kita po a yeɔ lakpa kɛ kaa a. Ha nɛ wa binyumuhi nɛ ngɛ nihe mi ɔ, a he nɛ wa kaa tso nɛ maa si saminya.
Ha nɛ wa biyihi nɛ a pee kaa tɛ titima kɛ ha matsɛ mɔ fiami.
Wa blɛfo gba amɛ nɛ a hyi tɔ kɛ ngma, nɛ a na niye ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; wa to ɔmɛ hu nɛ a fɔ babauu akpeakpe abɔ ngɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.
Wa na amɛ hu nɛ a fɔ babauu ja nɔuu; a mi ko sane; nɛ a ko nu bubuubui ko ngɛ wa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nihi nɛ a gbaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.
Nihi nɛ Yawɛ ji a Mawu ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.
Yi jemi la Ye Mawu kɛ ye matsɛ, ma wo o hɛ mi nyami, nɛ ma na mo si daa.
Ma na mo si daa ligbi, nɛ ma je o yi kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yawɛ kle, nɛ e sa kaa a je e yi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E kle pe bɔ nɛ adesa juɛmi ma nyɛ maa su he.
Yi nɔ kake ma je níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ a yi kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ; nɛ he wami níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ, a maa sɛɛ kɛ ha mɛ.
O hɛ mi nyami, o we agboje, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ, ma susu a he saminya.
Nihi maa fiɛ nyakpɛ ní, kɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ o pee ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma fiɛ ke o kle niinɛ.
A ma de ke o mi mi hi saminya.
A ma la boboobo ke daa nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ o peeɔ.
Dloolɔ kɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji Yawɛ; e mi mi fu we mla, nɛ e suɔmi hiɛ babauu.
Yawɛ peeɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpakpa, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ he ha níhi tsuo nɛ e bɔ ɔ. Yawɛ, níhi nɛ o pee ɔ tsuo maa na mo si, nɛ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ma je o yi!
A maa sɛɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ he ní, nɛ a ma de ke o kle saminya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa le ní nguanguahi nɛ o pee, kɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ we agboje.
O matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ daa, nɛ o nɔ yemi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Yawɛ yeɔ e siwo nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e peeɔ ɔ hi saminya.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, e piɛɔ a he, nɛ nihi nɛ nɔ si ɔ, e woɔ a nɔ kɛ daa si ekohu.
Bɔ níhi tsuo nɛ wami ngɛ a mi ɔ, mo pɛ nɛ a ngɛ blɔ hyɛe; ejakaa mo lɛ o haa mɛ a niye ní ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
O bliɔ o dɛ mi, nɛ o haa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle tɔɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ peeɔ ɔ da; e naa mɔbɔ be tsuaa be.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛɔ Yawɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yawɛ hɛɛ lɛ kɛ suu e he.
Nihi nɛ yee lɛ gbeye ɔ, e peeɔ a hiami ní kɛ haa mɛ.
E buu a kue fami ɔmɛ hu tue, nɛ e heɔ a yi wami.
Nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ Yawɛ ɔ, e baa a yi; se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Ma je Yawɛ yi, nɛ ma ha nimli adesahi tsuo ma je e yi kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nyɛ je Mawu, yi wami helɔ ɔ yi Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Imi hu ma je Yawɛ yi!
Be abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ma je Yawɛ yi!
Ligbi abɔ nɛ i ngɛ wami mi nɛ ɔ, ma la kɛ je ye Mawu ɔ yi!
Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ ganɔ ko, loo nɔmlɔ adesa ko nɔ, ejakaa e be he wami nɛ e ma he nyɛ yi wami.
Ke nɔmlɔ gbo ɔ, e kpaleɔ kɛ yaa zu mi ekohu, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu e yi mi tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a se poɔ.
Nɔ nɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ ji e he piɛlɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ e Mawu ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.
Mawu nɛ pee hiɔwe, zugba, wo, kɛ a mi níhi tsuo, nɛ e yeɔ e siwo nɔ daa.
Nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi ɔ, e yeɔ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.
Nihi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ, e haa mɛ niye ní.
Nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ, e jeɔ mɛ.
Yawɛ bliɔ hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ; Yawɛ woɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ si a nɔ; Yawɛ suɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Yawɛ baa nibwɔhi a yi; e yeɔ yalɔyihi, kɛ awusahi a sane kɛ haa mɛ; se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e haa a yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.
Yawɛ maa ye tsɛ daa.
Zion, o Mawu ɔ maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.

Nyɛ je Mawu Ope ɔ yi Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem sisi toe ekohu; e ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa a a nya buae kɛ ba.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsui ku ɔ, e ngɛ mɛ tsae, nɛ e ngɛ a pa amɛ a nɔ fie.
E le dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a yibɔ, nɛ e kɛ a biɛhi tsɛɔ mɛ kakaaka.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kle; e ngɛ he wami babauu, nɛ e nile hu a li nya.
Yawɛ piɛɔ nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi a he; se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e sakee mɛ ngɔ fiaa si.
Nyɛ la sina la ha Yawɛ; nyɛɛ fia saku nɛ nyɛ la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi!
Lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ bɔku kɛ haa hiɔwe, nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ kɛ pueɔ zugba a nɔ, nɛ nga mumu puɛɔ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɛ nɛ e haa nga mi lohwehi niye ní, nɛ ke kuakualabite bihi ngɛ pɛe hu, lɛ nɛ e haa mɛ ní.
Okpɔngɔ nɛ he wa tete po e bui; fo tulɔ kpanaa hu pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Se nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye, nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ kaa e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ daa a, mɛɛ e naa a he bua jɔmi.
Yerusalem, mo je Yawɛ yi!
Zion, mo je o Mawu ɔ yi!
Ejakaa e peeɔ o we agbo ɔmɛ a se lami ní ɔmɛ kpɛii, nɛ e gbaa o bimɛ ɔmɛ.
E haa tue mi jɔmi baa o zugba a nɔ, nɛ niye ní buu tɔ.
Ke e wo gbi ɔ, a nuɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ a yeɔ nɔ nɔuu.
E haa nɛ snoo nɛɔ kaa doti, nɛ e gbɛɔ bɔ́ nɛ fi ɔ kɛ fĩaa kaa la zu.
E haa gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛɔ kaa dongo tɛ.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa da e fĩɛ ɔ nya?
Ke e fa a, gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔmɛ sileɔ; e haa kɔɔhiɔ fiaa, kɛkɛ nyu ɔ bɔni nyɛɛmi.
E wo Israel mlaa, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ a ja Mawu ha.
E pee we kikɛ nɛ ɔ ha we ma ko ma ko hyɛ, nɛ e mlaa amɛ hu, ma kpa ko li.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Je ɔ tsuo nɛ je Mawu yi Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi kɛ je hiɔwe.
Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!
Nyɛ Mawu bɔfohi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ e ta a tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
Pu, kɛ nyɔhiɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ dodoehi tsuo nɛ kpɛɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe yi mi, mo je e yi!
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je Yawɛ yi; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e fa nɛ a bɔ mɛ.
E ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ma si kɛ yaa neneene.
E wo huzu ha mɛ, nɛ a be hanee.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ wo mi lo nguanguahi, kɛ muɔ voovoohi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
La, gbiɛ ngo ngu, snoo, bɔ nɛ fi, kɛ ahumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yawɛ tsɔmi nɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
Yo nguanguahi, kɛ yo wawi tsuo, tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii, kɛ seda tsohi tsuo, nga mi lohwehi, kɛ we mi lohwehi tsuo, lohwehi nɛ sãã si, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, nyɛ je e yi!
Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo, ganɔhi, kɛ ma nɔ yeli tsuo, nihewi kɛ yihewi tsuo, nikɔtɔmahi kɛ jokuɛwi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nyɛ je e yi!
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ ngɛ biɛ nɛ kle agbo; e hɛ mi nyami ha zugba a nɔ tsuo kɛ be hiɔwe tete he.

lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ma a tsuo ngɛ e yi jee; e ma a ji Israel, nɛ e he jua wa ha lɛ kaa nɔ́ ko.

Á la kɛ he wami kɛ je Mawu yi.

Á wo a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ, nɛ a we ablade ɔmɛ ɔ, a bɔ mɛ dade pã; a gbla je ma amɛ a tue kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma kɛ to ɔ. Mawu ma a tsuo ye kunimi!

Nyɛ kpa titimati kɛ je e yi, nyɛ je e yi kɛ saku, kɛ kpa saku!

Nyɛ je e yi kɛ gɔgɔ nɛ nya wa; nyɛ je e yi kɛ gɔgɔ nɛ jijeɔ!

NYA TSƆƆMI Munyuhi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji tsɔɔmihi nɛ kɔɔ je mi bami kpakpa, kɛ Mawu jami he.
A ngma munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ abɛbu mi, nɛ babauu kɔɔ níhi nɛ yaa nɔ daa ligbi a he.
Kekleekle ɔ, munyu ɔmɛ deɔ wɔ ke, “Ke o suɔ nɛ o na nile ɔ, ja o ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, pi kaa Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi sisiisi kɛkɛ nɛ he hia nɔmlɔ adesa.
Se á na ngɛ e ní peepee mi kaa e juɛmi mi kuɔ, nɛ e baa e je mi bɔ nɛ sa.
Juɛmi, kɛ ga nɛ blema Israel tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ tsu ní ɔ, jeɔ kpo ngɛ abɛ munomuno kpitikpiti nɛ ɔmɛ fuu a mi.
Ke sane ko ba je ní lelɔ blɔ mi tlukaa a, bɔ nɛ e plɛɔ kɛ tsuɔ he ní ɔ, yeɔ munyu nɛ ɔ he odase.
E ma nyɛ pee weku sane, ní tsumi blɔ nya tomi sane, bu nɛ sa nɛ e hi nyɛmi kɛ nyɛmi a kpɛti, loo he nɔ yemi.
Abɛ ɔmɛ deɔ wɔ níhi babauu ngɛ subai kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ a he: humi si himi, tsui si tomi, bu nɛ sa kaa waa ngɔ kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ anɔkuale yemi ngɛ huɛmɛ a kpɛti.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha A je nile yi .—.
Salomo abɛhi .—.
Agur munyuhi .- Munyu kpa komɛ .-
Abɛhi a he se nami Israel matsɛ, Salomo, David bi ɔ abɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ o maa le ní; a maa wo mo ga kpakpa, nɛ a ma ha nɛ o maa nu sanehi nɛ a mi kuɔ a sisi.
Abɛ ɔmɛ maa tsɔɔ mo anɔkuale yemi, dami sane yemi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da peemi.
Nɔ nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, abɛ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ e nɔ bɔ ma tsɔ; se niheyo lɛɛ e ma na juɛmi, kɛ hɛ mi si kami.
Ke ní lelɔ nu abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e nile ɔ maa hiɛ kɛ pue nɔ; juɛmitsɛ hu e juɛmi ɔ mi ma blɛke pe kekle ɔ, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a nu abɛhi, kɛ ní leli a munyuhi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ a sisi saminya.
A wo nihewi ga Loko o ma na nile ɔ, ja o ye Yawɛ gbeye.
Kuasiahi bui nile, nɛ slɔmi gbi hu a sume.
Ye bi, ke o tsɛ ngɛ mo tsɔsee ɔ, bu tue!
Ke o nyɛ hu ngɛ mo ní tsɔɔe ɔ, ko kua!
Ejakaa lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ma dla mo nɛ o ba o je mi saminya, kaa bɔ nɛ duku kpakpa, loo kuɛ ní haa nɔ he peeɔ fɛu ɔ. Ye bi, ke yayami peeli ngɛ mo mlɔɔe ɔ, koo nyɛɛ a se.
Ke a de mo ke, “Ha nɛ waa ho nɛ wa ya hla nɔ ko waa gbe!
Ha wa ya wo nɔ ko nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ka, nɛ waa gbe lɛ yaka gu!
Waa mii mɛ hɛ ngmengmle kaa a yaa gbeje; waa ngɔ mɛ kaa yɔkɔ ngɔɔ gbogboe, be mi nɛ a ngɛ kpakpataa!
Wa ma na ní kpakpahi nɛ a he jua wa babauu, nɛ wa we ɔmɛ ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ níhi nɛ wa ha.
Ba piɛ wa he.
Ke wa ná nɔ́ ko ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa maa dla lɛ fiee!” Ye bi, o kɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli ko bɔ.
Koo nyɛɛ a se.
A he sɔɔ kɛ yayami peemi; a he sɔɔ kɛ pueɔ muɔ si.
Ke lohwe pɛlitsɛ ngɛ mo hyɛe nɛ o tsɔ lɛ klama a, o tsu yaka ní.
Se nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he klama a tsɔ ɔ nɛ; mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛ a maa du klama a, nɛ a ma gbo.
Nihi tsuo nɛ guu awi yemi mi kɛ naa ní ɔ, bɔ nɛ a nyagbe ya baa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; awi yemi mi nɔuu a gboɔ ngɛ.
Nile wo gbi Nile ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ, kɛ jua mi.
E ngɛ kpae boboobo ngɛ ma agbo ɔmɛ a nya, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ nihi buaa a he nya ngɛ.
E ngɛ dee ke, “Kuasiahi!
Mɛni be nyɛ maa biɛ kɛ yaa si?
Fɛu yeli!
Mɛni be nyɛ maa ye fɛu kɛ yaa si?
Anɛ nyɛ be ní kasee?
Nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma ka nyɛ hɛ mi.
Ma wo nyɛ ga kpakpa, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu nile munyu.
I hla nyɛ se blɔ, nɛ i tsɛ nyɛ si abɔ ke nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ.
Se nyɛ bui fɛɛ.
Ga tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɔɛ, nɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ we kaa ma kua nɔ́ ha nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, imi hu ma muɔ nyɛ.
Ke nyɛ hɛ dɔ ɔ, ma ye nyɛ he fɛu.
Ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa lɛ ngɛ fiae, nɛ amanehlu ba na nyɛ kaa lasiogblee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui yee ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ma tsɛ mi, se i be nɔ hee.
Nyɛ ma hla ye se blɔ kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ nyɛ be mi nae.
Ejakaa nyɛ bui nile he akɔtaa; Yawɛ hu, nyɛ yi lɛ gbeye.
Nyɛ sume ga womi; nɛ ke i ka nyɛ hɛ mi hu, nyɛ kplɛɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he hiɔwo nyɛ ma na; nyɛ ní yaya amɛ nɔuu maa hao nyɛ.
Kuasiahi gboɔ, ejakaa a bui nile; a heɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he yeɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kpataa a hɛ mi.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buɔ mi tue ɔ, e maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ e be gbeye yee kaa haomi ko maa ba e nɔ.”
Nile he se namihi Ye bi, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ o pɛtɛ ye mlaa amɛ a he saminya.
Bu nile munyu tue, nɛ o bɔ mɔde kaa o maa nu sisi lo.
Ee, moo fa kue nɛ a ha mo nile; kpa pɛɛ nɛ a ha mo nɔ́ sisi numi.
Hla e se blɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a hlaa sika hiɔ, loo juetli nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa.
Ke o pee ja loko o maa nu Yawɛ gbeye yemi sisi, nɛ o maa kase Mawu he nile.
Yawɛ lɛ haa nɔ nile; lɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ nɔ nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, Yawɛ piɛɔ a he, nɛ e baa a yi.
Yawɛ buu dami sane yeli a he, nɛ e baa e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a yi.
Ke o bu mi tue ɔ, o maa le nɔ́ nɛ hi, kɛ blɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
O maa le nɔ́ nɛ sa mo peemi.
O maa le ní, nɛ nile ɔ ma ha mo bua jɔmi.
O he nile, kɛ o nɔ́ sisi numi maa bu o he, nɛ a be hae nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ.
A ma je mo kɛ je nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi: nihi nɛ a kɛ a lilɛ puɛɔ nɔ, nihi nɛ gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da nɔ kɛ ya ngɛ diblii blɔhi a nɔ nyɛɛe, nihi nɛ nyaa yayami peemi he, nɛ a naa bua jɔmi ke a ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ pee, kɛ nihi nɛ a blɔhi dɛ, nɛ a kɛ hɛ fɔ we a nɔ.
Ke o bu mi tue ɔ, lɛɛ yo yaholɔ ko nɛ ma hla kaa e kɛ e nya mi munyu ngɔngɔɛ ma puɛ o tue ɔ, ma je mo kɛ je e dɛ mi: yo nɛ kua e yihe mi huno, nɛ si nɛ e wo e Mawu ɔ hu e yi nɔ.
Ke o ya e we mi ɔ, gbenɔ blɔ nɔ o ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ nɛ.
Ke o ya lejɛ ɔ lɛɛ o su gbeje ta.
Nɔ ko ya slaa we lɛ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba hyɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ya su lejɛ ɔ, e kpale we e se kɛ bɛ wami blɔ ɔ nɔ hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo kase nimli kpakpahi a ní peepee, konɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
Dali, kɛ nimli kpakpahi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli lɛɛ Mawu ma kpata a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a hiaa tso ngɛ zu mi kɛ fɔɔ si ɔ.
A wo nihewi kɛ yihewi ga Ye bi, níhi nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ; o hɛ nɛ hi mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ a nɔ be tsuaa be.
Ke o pee ja a, o wami se maa kɛ, nɛ o ma na he jɔmi, kɛ kplɔkɔtɔ.
Koo ngmɛɛ si himi kpakpa, kɛ anɔkuale yemi he.
Fi kɛ wo o kuɛ, nɛ o ngma kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ.
Ke o pee ja a, o hɛ mi maa ba nyami, nɛ Mawu, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo ma na o he bua jɔmi.
Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ kulaa.
Koo ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ nɛ moo o susu kaa o le ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, mo kai Yawɛ, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ nɛ da.
Koo bu o he ní lelɔ; moo ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ o tu yayami nya fo.
Ke o pee ja a, e ngɛ kaa tsopa kpakpa nɛ ma tsa mo, nɛ ma ha o he mi maa jɔ mo.
Ngɔɔ o ní babauu ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami; ngɔɔ o niba ní tsuo mi kekleekle nɔ́ kɛ sã bɔ ha lɛ.
Ke o pee ja a, o blɛfo gba a ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ blɛfo; o wai hu maa ba babauu nɛ o nine be he kpee.
Ye bi, ke Yawɛ ngɛ mo tsɔsee ɔ, e ko pee mo tai; ke e ngɛ o hɛ mi kae ɔ, o ko de ke e ngɛ mo haoe.
Nihi nɛ Yawɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi e kaa, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ peeɔ e bi nɛ e suɔ ɔ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ le ní, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, a gbaa lɛ saminya.
Ejakaa e he ngɛ se nami pe sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ.
Nile he ngɛ se nami kulaa pe june; nɔ́ ko be nɛ o suɔ saminya nɛ a kɛ maa to nile he.
Nile haa nɔ wami se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi; e haa nɔ naa ní, nɛ e haa nɔ hɛ mi baa nyami.
Nile haa nɔ bua jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi.
Nihi nɛ le ní ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi; nile haa mɛ wami.
Nile Yawɛ kɛ bɔ je ɔ. Ga lɛ e kɛ ngɔ hiɔwe ngɔ to e blɔ he.
E nile ɔ nɛ ha nɛ pa amɛ hia; lɛ nɛ ha nyu je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi pue zugba.
Ye bi, ngɔɔ nile nitsɛnitsɛ, kɛ juɛmi ngɔ to saminya; ko ha nɛ a je o dɛ.
A ma ha mo he wami, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa nyɛɛ tɛɛ ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ o be nɔ́ tɛe.
Ke o hwɔ si ɔ, o be gbeye yee; o maa hwɔ mahe vii nyɔ mi tsuo.
Haomihi nɛ baa yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ tlukaa kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a, lɔ ɔmɛ be o he gbeye woe.
Yawɛ maa bu o he.
E be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ o ya du klama.
Be tsuaa be nɛ o ma nyɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ e hia kaa a pee mɛ kpakpa a, pee mɛ kpakpa.
Ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ o dɛ nɛ o ma nyɛ kɛ pee o nyɛmi kpakpa a, ko de lɛ ke e ya nɛ e ba hwɔɔ loko o ha lɛ.
O nyɛmi nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ ɔ, koo to ga yayami kɛ wo e he.
O kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko pɛ yaka gu be mi nɛ e pee we mo nɔ́ yaya ko.
O hɛ ko kɔ̃ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ; níhi nɛ a peeɔ hu, ko hla kaa o maa pee.
Ejakaa Yawɛ sume nimli yayamihi; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ e kɛ bɔɔ.
Yawɛ gbiɛmi ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a wehi a nɔ, se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ a hi he ɔ, gbaami sɔuu.
Yawɛ kɛ he nɔ woli bɔɛ; se nihi nɛ baa a he si lɛɛ e naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
Ní leli a hɛ mi maa ba nyami, se kuasiahi lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si.
Nile he se namihi Ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue saminya, konɛ nyɛɛ le ní.
Nɔ́ kpakpa lɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ he.
Tsaatsɛ kɛ maa a bi kake too ji mi.
Benɛ jokuɛyo bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ji mi ɔ, tsaatsɛ tsɔɔ mi ní.
Nɔ́ nɛ e pɔɔ mi demi ji, “Mo kai níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ, nɛ o hɛ ko je a nɔ gblegbleegble.
Moo ye mlaa nɛ i wo mo ɔ nɔ, konɛ o yi nɛ na wami.
Moo le ní, nɛ o nu ní a sisi.
Níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ.
Ko si nile se kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Suɔ nile, konɛ e baa o yi, nɛ e bu o he.
Nile ji nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hla nile se blɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma ná a, kɛ hla ní a sisi numi.
Bu nile, nɛ e maa pee mo nɔmlɔ ngua; fua lɛ atuu, nɛ e maa wo o hɛ mi nyami.
E maa pee kunimi yemi jlasi nɛ a kɛ fi o yi.” Ye bi, bu mi tue.
Munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ, moo ngɔ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi.
I tsɔɔ mo nile, kɛ blɔ nɛ da nɛ sa nɛ o nyɛɛ nɔ.
Ke o ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, o be nɔ́ tɛe; ke o ngɛ fo tue ɔ, o be si nɔe.
Kai slɔmi gbi nɛ a ha mo ɔ daa; koo ngmɛɛ he.
Lɔ ɔ ji o wami.
Koo ya he nɛ yayami peeli ngɛ.
Ko ya nyɛɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a se.
Ee, moo yu o he; koo ya lejɛ ɔ!
Gba blɔ nɛ o be kɛ ho.
Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ pee we nɔ́ yayami ko ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a hwɔɔ mahe.
Mahe jeɔ a hɛ mi kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ko awi loko a hwɔɔ mahe.
Yayami peemi ji abolo nɛ a yeɔ, nɛ basabasa ji wai nɛ a nuɔ.
Blɔ nɛ dali nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa mɔtu pu la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hluu kɛ yaa si piani.
Yayami peeli lɛɛ a blɔ nɔ woɔ diblii kpii kaa nyɔ mi.
A tɛɔ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ si, se a li nɔ́ nɛ ji.
Ye bi, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ o nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ɔ saminya.
O hɛ ko je munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ngɔɔ kɛ to o tsui mi tɔɔ.
Nɔ nɛ nuɔ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ, e naa wami nɛ e hii nɔmlɔ tso he wami saminya be tsuaa be.
Susu o yi mi saminya loko o pee nɔ́ ko, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɔ o wami daa si ngɛ.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ pi anɔkuale ɔ, ko de.
Lakpa munyu, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ kaa ja kó je o nya mi.
Hyɛ o hɛ mi tɛɛ.
Ko plɛ o yi kɛ ya hiɛ, loo hiɛ.
Ke o maa pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, susu he saminya.
Ja o pee ja loko o blɔhi maa da mo.
Koo pee yayami.
Ko gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da nɔ; yaa o hɛ mi tɛɛ.
Ko puɛ gba Ye bi, i kɛ mo maa tu munyu nɛ mi kuɔ; i kɛ mo maa tu juɛmi munyu sɔuu.
Bu tue, konɛ o hyɛ o he nɔ saminya, nɛ o munyu tumi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa ní lelɔ ji mo.
Ke yo yaholɔ fiɔ o nya he ɔ, e lilɛ ngɔɔ pe hwo; e nya mi munyu hu ngɛ ngleinglei kaa nu.
Nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ mi kɛ baa a dooɔ pe agba, nɛ e puɛɔ nɔ́ pe klaate nya enyɔtsɛ.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ kɛ nɔ yaa gbeje.
E maa ngɔ mo kɛ ya tɔɔ.
Blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi ɔ, e susuu we he; e ya nyɛɛɔ blɔ gɔdɔgɔdɔhi a nɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e li tete.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue ɔ a nɔ.
Hɛɛ mo kɛ je yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he; e tsu nya tete po koo ya.
Ke pi ja a, o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma ba pee ni kpahi a nɔ, nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ ma kpata o hɛ mi ngɛ nihe mi.
Niinɛ, nibwɔhi ma ba ngɔ ní nɛ o na a tsuo, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ o gbo he dengme ɔ ma ba pee nɔ kpa nɔ́.
Nyagbe ɔ, be mi nɛ o hwɔɔ si ngɛ gbenɔ sa nɔ, nɛ o he lo, kɛ o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae ɔ, o maa hi kɛmɛe, nɛ o maa hi dee ke, “Mɛni he je i kplɛɛ we nɛ a tsɔse mi ɔ?
Mɛni he je i ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ a ka ye hɛ mi ɔ?
I bui ye tsɔɔli fɛɛ, nɛ ma de ke i ngɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ mi slɔmi munyuhi tue bue po.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, pe ye hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma pue si ngɛ ma hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Ye mo nitsɛ o yo anɔkuale, nɛ o kɛ o suɔmi tsuo ha lɛ pɛ.
Anɛ e sa kaa o wo ngmɛdu ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si lo?
Ha o bimɛ nɛ pee mo nɔ kake too o níhi, se pi o kɛ nibwɔhi a bimɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha o yo bua jɔmi.
O nihe mi yo kpeekpee ɔ, na e he bua jɔmi.
E he ngɛ fɛu saminyayoo kaa odabɔ.
Ha e he nɛ pee mo akɔnɔ, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ nɛ fi mo kɛ mɛtɛ e he daa.
Ye bi, mɛni he je lɛ yo ajuama haa o yi mi plɛɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni ha o fua nɔ kpa e yo kɛ wo o gugwe mi ɔ?
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
He tsuaa he nɛ o gu ɔ, e ngɛ mo hyɛe.
Yiwutsotsɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he yayamihi nɔuu lɛ maa du lɛ klama; e he yayami kpa amɛ nɔuu a kɛ maa fi lɛ.
Akɛnɛ e kplɛɛ we tsɔsemi he je ɔ, e ma gbo; e kuasia jemi ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Kɔkɔ bɔmi kpahi Ye bi, anɛ o ya da nɔ ko se lo?
Anɛ o wo si kaa o maa da nɔ ko nɛ o li lɛ e hiɔ nya ha lɛ lo?
Anɛ o kɛ o nya mi munyu fi mo nitsɛ o he lo?
Anɛ o ya yi o siwo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e plɛ pee klama ha mo nɛ o du lo?
Ye bi, ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ o nyɛmi ɔ nine su o nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ o maa pee nɛ o maa ye o he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yaa o nyɛmi ɔ ngɔ esɔ.
Yaa ba o he si ha lɛ, nɛ o kpa lɛ pɛɛ.
Koo hwɔ mahe; ko de ke o ngɛ o he jɔɔe hulɔ.
Je o he kɛ je sane nɛ ɔ mi esɔ kaa bɔ nɛ odabɔ, aloo lohwe pɛlitsɛ tuɔ detsɛ nya fo ɔ. Hejɔtsɛ, yaa tatu ngɔ.
Yaa kase bɔ nɛ e toɔ e níhi a blɔ nya ha, nɛ o le ní.
Lɛ, nɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ, loo matsɛ, loo nɔ yelɔ ko be lɛ ɔ, latsa be mi ɔ, e hlaa niye ní nɛ e buaa nya kɛ toɔ ha fĩɛ be.
Mɛni be mo hejɔtsɛ o maa hwɔ si kɛ yaa si?
Mɛni be po o maa te si?
Nɔ́ nɛ o deɔ ji, “Oo, ma hwɔ mahe bɔɔ pɛ; ma je ye hɛ se bɔɔ; ma bua ye nine nya nɛ ma jɔɔ ye he bɔɔ.” Se benɛ o hwɔɔ si ɔ, ohia ma ba na mo tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ ojo fialɔ ba tuaa nɔ, nɛ o yi ma fi kaa nɔ nɛ ta bulɔ mia kɛ ba tua lɛ.
Yakayaka nɔmlɔ, loo yiwutsotsɛ hii lakpa yee kɛ hii nyɛɛe.
E kɛ e hɛngmɛ, kɛ e nane, kɛ e nine nguɛ tuɔ munyu, nɛ e peeɔ okadi kɛ sisiɔ nɔ.
Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, ní yaya sɔuu lɛ e hii susue; e hii pɛ woe ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, haomi maa ba e nɔ tlukaa.
Be mi nɛ e li e he be ɔ, e hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
-Ní kpaago komɛ nɛ Yawɛ hiee, nɛ e sume saasaa ji: Hewo, Lakpa yemi, Nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko e muɔ si puemi, Ga yayami tomi, He sɔmi kɛ yayami peemi, Lakpa odase yelɔ, kɛ Nɔ nɛ woɔ e nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti pɛ.
Gba puɛmi he kɔkɔ bɔmi Ye bi, mlaa nɛ o tsɛ wo mo ɔ, ye nɔ; nɔ́ nɛ o nyɛ tsɔɔ mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je nɔ gblegbleegble.
Ngmaa kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ; nɛ o fi kɛ wo o kuɛ.
Ke o hia blɔ ɔ, munyuhi nɛ o fɔli tuɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mo ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ; nyɔ mi ke o hwɔɔ si ɔ, a maa bu o he, nɛ ke o te si ɔ, a maa wo mo ga. Mlaahi nɛ a wo mo, kɛ nihi nɛ a tsɔɔ mo ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa la ha mo.
O hɛ mi nɛ a ka, aloo o tue nɛ a gbla a, lɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ o maa hi si ngɛ je mi ha.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ma je mo kɛ je yo yaholɔ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ yo gba puɛlɔ be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ munyu ngɔngɔɛ ma puɛ o tue.
Ko ya di e he fɛu ɔ se; ko ha nɛ e we ajuama hɛngmɛ ɔ nɛ nu mo.
Nyumu ma nyɛ ma ya su yo yaholɔ, nɛ e ma ha lɛ abolo bɔbɔyoo ko kɛkɛ.
Se ke e ya ta yogbayo he ɔ, lɛɛ pe e hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Anɛ nɔ ko maa je la kɛ pue e gugue mi, nɛ e tadehi be sãe ngɛ e he lo?
Anɛ nɔ ko maa naa la ngu nɔ, nɛ e nane be sãe lo?
Nɔ nɛ kɛ e nyɛmi e yo ya hwɔɔ si ɔ, e sane ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ, e be e he yee ligbi ko ligbi ko.
Ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee, nɛ e ya ju niye ní nɛ e ye ɔ, a gbi e he guɛ.
Ke a nu lɛ ɔ, e maa ngɔ e weto ní tsuo tete kɛ to nane mi ha nɔtsɛ ɔ totoe kpaago kɛ bɔ he.
Se nyumu nɛ puɛɔ gba a, e be juɛmi; lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi lɛ e ngɛ kpatae.
A maa plaa lɛ; a ma pue e hɛ mi si, nɛ zo maa gbe lɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
Ke nyumu ngɛ hunga jee ɔ, e mi mi fuɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, ke e yaa ye e he lue ɔ, e nɛ mɔbɔ.
E be kpatami nɔ́ ko hee ngɛ o dɛ; ke o ke lɛ ní babauu po, e bua be jɔe.
Ye bi, kai munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ; mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ, o hɛ nɛ hi a nɔ.
Mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ, ye a nɔ, konɛ o yi nɛ na wami.
Moo ye ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ fitsofitso kaa bɔ nɛ o baa mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ yi ɔ. Munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ, moo fi kɛ wo o nine nguɛ he; nɛ o ngma kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ.
O kɛ nile nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmiyo maa hi si ɔ; ha nɛ o juɛmi nɛ pee o huɛ kpakpa.
Ke o pee ja a, a ma je mo kɛ je yo yaholɔ dɛ mi, nɛ yo gba puɛlɔ kɛ e nya mi dɔkɔɔ be o he blɔ nae.
Yo yaholɔ Ligbi ko be nɛ i ngɛ saflɛ mi hyɛe ngɛ ye we ɔ mi ɔ, i na nihewi babauu nɛ a be juɛmi.
Nɔ kake nɛ i to e he hɛ saminya a, lɛɛ e pa biɛ pe mɛ tsuo.
E nyɛɛ kɛ ya be ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ kɔ nya he ko, he nɛ yo ko hii ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, je jɔ, nɛ du bu.
Tlukaa a, yo ko kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
Yo ɔ dla e he kaa yaholɔ nɛ ngɛ nyumu hlae.
Yo nɛ ɔ, jamɛatsɛ ji lɛ; e ngɛ gegeege, zo ko zo ko be e hɛ mi, nɛ e hí we mi hulɔ.
Ke o ke o hyɛɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ; ke o ke o hyɛɔ ɔ, e su jua nɔ momo.
Ngɛ kɔ nya tsuaa kɔ nya a, o maa na lɛ nɛ e wo ka kɛ daa si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ nu niheyo ɔ, nɛ e fua lɛ atuu.
E hyɛ niheyo ɔ hɛ mi gaa nɛ́ zo pee we lɛ, nɛ e de ke, “I wo si ke ma sã bɔ ko; nɛ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i je kpo, konɛ ma ba hla mo nɛ ma na mo, nɛ i kɛ mo ba bua nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ngɔ Egipt kploba kpakpa kɛ ha ye sa a nɔ saminyayoo.
I kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔmɛ wo sa a mi: mimɛ, aloe, kɛ sinamon.
Ha waa ho nɛ wa ya hwɔ.
Ha nɛ wa ya fiɛ nɛ wa na bua jɔmi nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo kɛ yaa si mɔtu.
Hyɛ, ye huno be; e hia blɔ kɛ ho tsitsaa ya.
E hɛɛ sika fuu kɛ to dɛ, nɛ e maa ye otsi enyɔ loko e maa kpale kɛ ba.” Yo nɛ ɔ kɛ e nya mi munyu ngɔngɔɛ ɔ gbe niheyo ɔ yi mi hluu kɛ ya si e nine su niheyo ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ niheyo ɔ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ho kaa na nɛ a yaa gbe, aloo odabɔ nɛ hlu kɛ yaa sɛ klama mi, he nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ma ya gbɔ e tsui mi ngɛ.
Ee, niheyo nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ yo ɔ se kɛ ho kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ he sɔ kɛ yaa sɛ klama mi; e li tete kaa e hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ ta tue nɛ nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ. Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba gbe nyɛ yi mi nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ e se.
Nyɛ ko tla kɛ ya be ngɛ e blɔ mi tete po.
Ejakaa nimli babauu ji nihi nɛ e ye mɛ awi; nimli kpekpemi nitsɛnitsɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ e kpata a hɛ mi.
Ke o su e we ɔ mi ɔ, lɛɛ blɔ kpiti nɛ a guu kɛ yaa gbeje ɔ, e nɔ lɛ o ngɛ kɛ yaa a nɛ.
Nile yi jemi la Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nile ngɛ ngmlaa kpae.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Juɛmi gbi ngɛ pɛe.
Nile daa si ngɛ blɔ gbla amɛ a nya, ngɛ blɔ he, kɛ yokuhi a yi mi.
E ngɛ ngmlaa kpae gegeege ngɛ ma a nya; e ngɛ kpae ngɛ ma a agbo ɔmɛ a nya ke, “Nyɛ nimli adesahi lee!
I ngɛ nyɛ tsɛe oo!
Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ be juɛmi ko juɛmi ko, nyɛɛ le ní; nyɛ kuasiahi, nyɛ na juɛmi.
Nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma tu nyɛ munyuhi nɛ a he hia.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu; i be nyɛ munyu kpa ko tue pe anɔkuale.
Lakpa lɛɛ i hiee.
Ye nya mi munyuhi tsuo da; ekoeko be nɛ kpɛ̃; ekoeko be nɛ ji lakpa.
Ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ fɔɔ si paa kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi.
Munyu ɔmɛ a mi tsɔ heii kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ le ní.
Nyɛ hla ye tsɔsemi ɔ se blɔ pe sika hiɔ; nyɛ hla nile pe sika tsu kpakpa.
“Nile hi pe june; níhi nɛ adesa suɔ pe kulaa a, ekoeko be nɛ a kɛ maa to nile he.
Imi nile, i ngɛ hɛ mi si kami.
I ngɛ juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi hulɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ke e yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e sa kaa e kua yayami.
Hewo, he tsɔɔmi, je mi bami yaya, kɛ lakpa a, i sume.
I le ní saminya, nɛ i woɔ nɔ ga; i nuɔ nɔ́ sisi, nɛ i ngɛ he wami hulɔ.
I piɛɔ matsɛmɛ a he kɛ hyɛɛ ma nɔ; i piɛɔ nɔ yeli a he kɛ woɔ mlaa kpakpahi.
Ganɔhi kɛ odehehi tsuo, imi lɛ i piɛɔ a he kɛ tsuɔ ní.
Nihi nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, imi hu i suɔ mɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa ye se blɔ ɔ, e maa na mi.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ye dɛ nɛ ma dla; sika, hɛ mi nyami, kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ nɔ yami.
Nɔ́ nɛ o ma na kɛ je ye dɛ mi ɔ, e hi pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi; e hi pe sika hiɔ ngmingmiingmi hulɔ.
Dami blɔ nɔ lɛ i nyɛɛɔ; dami sane lɛ i yeɔ.
Nihi nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, i peeɔ mɛ niatsɛmɛ; i haa a wehi a mi hyiɔ tɔ kɛ june.
“Imi nile lɛ Yawɛ bɔ kekleekle; e bɔ mi loko e je e ní tsumi ɔmɛ a sisi blema lokoo.
Blema lokoo, benɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ je ɔ, imi lɛ a bɔ kekleekle.
Benɛ wo be, nɛ nyu vuhi hu be ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi momo.
Benɛ a na we nɛ a ngɔ yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ kɛ ma a blɔ hehi lolo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi momo.
Benɛ Mawu na we nɛ e pee je ɔ, kɛ nga, kɛ tabo zu ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi momo.
Benɛ e ngɔ hiɔwe kɛ to e blɔ he, nɛ e pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpe he ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e ngɔ bɔku ɔmɛ ngɔ to hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ nyu vu ɔmɛ hu to a blɔ hehi ngɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e fa wo ɔ ke wo nyu ɔ ko be e huzu ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e to je ɔ sisi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. I ngɛ e kasa nya kaa ga ní tsulɔ kpanaa, nɛ e bua jɔɔ ye he daa nɛ; i fiɛɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi be tsuaa be.
I náá je ɔ nɛ e bɔ ɔ, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo a he bua jɔmi.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihewi, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Nyɛɛ pee bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi.
Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue nɛ nyɛɛ le ní.
Nyɛ ko kua tsɔsemi.
Nɔ nɛ buɔ mi tue, nɛ e hii si ngɛ ye sinya nya daa ligbi, nɛ e hii mlɛe ngɛ ye agbo nya a, e naa bua jɔmi.
Nɔ nɛ hlaa mi ɔ, e yi ma na wami; nɛ Yawɛ ma na e he bua jɔmi.
Se nɔ nɛ hla we mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he awi lɛ e ngɛ yee.
Nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ, a suɔ gbenɔ.”
Nile kɛ biɛmi Nile ma tsu, nɛ e ma titima kpaago kɛ ha tsu ɔ. E gbe lohwe; e futu wai, nɛ e ngmɛ okplɔɔ.
E tsɔ e mawayi ɔmɛ ke a ya da ma a mi he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe kulaa a, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ be juɛmi ɔ, nyɛ gba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!” Nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ kuasia hu dee ji, “Ba nɛ o ba ye ye ní ɔ eko, nɛ o nu wai nɛ i futu ɔ hu eko!
Kpa bɔmi kɛ nihi nɛ be juɛmi, nɛ o yi nɛ na wami.
Hla nile se blɔ!” Ke o ka he fɛu yelɔ hɛ mi ɔ, mo lɛ a ma jɛ; ke o ka yiwutsotsɛ hɛ mi ɔ, mo mohu o he lɛ o plaa.
Ko ka he fɛu yelɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ba nyɛ mo; ka ní lelɔ mohu hɛ mi nɛ e maa suɔ mo.
Tsɔɔ ní lelɔ ní, nɛ e nile ɔ mi ma blɛke kɛ ya nɔ; tsɔɔ dalɔ ní, nɛ e maa kase nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi kɛ piɛ nɔ́ nɛ e le momo ɔ he.
Loko o ma na nile ɔ, ja o ye Yawɛ gbeye; ke o na le Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ pɛ o na juɛmi.
Ejakaa nile ma ha nɛ a fɔ o ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o wami se maa kɛ.
Ke o le ní ɔ, o le ha o he.
Nɛ ke o sake nile ngɔ fɔ he ɔ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o maa na nɔ́.
Yo kuasia ngɛ gegeege; zo ko zo ko be e hɛ mi, nɛ e li nɔ́ ko hulɔ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, e hii si ngɛ e sinya nya, loo ma a mi he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe lɛ tsuo.
Ke nihi ngɛ a nyɛɛmi nɔ kɛ bee, nɛ a ngɛ yi mi kpakpa susue ɔ, e ma kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, e ba hiɛ ɔ!” Nyumu kuasia hu, nɔ́ nɛ e deɔ lɛ ji, “Nyu jujui ngɔɔ.
Niye ní nɛ a ye ngɛ laami mi ɔ, e ngɔɔ.” Nihi nɛ yo nɛ ɔ naa a he blɔ ɔ, a li tete kaa ke o na ya sɛ e we ɔ mi pɛ o plɛ pee nɔ gbogboe.
A li tete kaa nihi tsuo nɛ ya sɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, a wuhi a he je momo ngɛ gbeje.
Salomo abɛhi Salomo abɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Bi ní lelɔ haa e tsɛ bua jɔmi; bi kuasia yeɔ e nyɛ tsui.
Ke o gu blɔ yaya nɔ kɛ na ní ɔ, e he be se nami bae ha mo.
Se ke o ye anɔkuale ɔ, o yi ma na wami.
Yawɛ be hae nɛ hwɔ nɛ ye nimli kpakpahi; nimli yayamihi lɛɛ e maa tsi mɛ blɔ, konɛ a nine ko su nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ hejɔ ɔ, e yeɔ ohia; se nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní lɛɛ e naa ní.
Bi nɛ buaa nɔ́ nya latsa be ɔ, bi ní lelɔ ji lɛ; bi nɛ hwɔɔ si ní kpami be ɔ, bi nɛ woɔ nɔ zo ji lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa gbaa lɛ babauu.
Se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ nɔ́.
E ji gbaami kaa a ma kai nimli kpakpahi daa; yayami peeli lɛɛ e kɛ we nɛ hɛ jeɔ a nɔ.
Ní lelɔ yeɔ mlaa nɔ; se kuasia nɛ tuɔ munyu puu ɔ, lɛɛ e hɛ mi ma kpata.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e he mi jɔɔ lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ yi anɔkuale lɛɛ nine maa gbe lɛ.
Ke nɔ ko na nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, nɛ e ku e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, haomi lɛ e kɛ baa.
Se nɔ nɛ kaa nɔ hɛ mi nɛ e yi gbeye ɔ, tue mi jɔmi lɛ e kɛ baa.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa nya mi munyu ngɛ kaa nyu vu nɛ haa nɔ wami; nɔmlɔ yayami lɛɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ nɔ́.
Ninyɛ woɔ pɛ; se suɔmi haa tɔmihi tsuo a nɔ.
Ní leli tuɔ juɛmi munyu; kuasiahi lɛɛ e sa nɛ a gbla a tue.
Ní leli tu we munyu fuu.
Kuasiahi lɛɛ a tuɔ munyu puu, nɛ lɔ ɔ kɛ mɛ woɔ haomi mi.
Niatsɛmɛ a ní nɛ a na a buɔ a he; se ohiatsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ohia a kpataa a hɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a, e yi ma na wami.
Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ kɛ̃ a kɛ maa wo lɛ hiɔ.
Nihi nɛ ke a tu mɛ munyu nɛ a nuɔ ɔ, a yi ma na wami.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ kplɛɛ we nɛ a kaa a hɛ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a laa blɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ nihi a he munyu kɛ puɛɔ mɛ ɔ, kuasia ji lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu babauu ɔ, e kɛ we nɛ e peeɔ yayami.
Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e hyɛɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa nya mi munyu he jua wa kaa sika hiɔ ngmingmiingmi; se yiwutsotsɛ juɛmi lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi.
Nimli kpakpahi a nya mi munyu he baa se nami ha nihi babauu.
Kuasiahi lɛɛ a hɛ mi kpataa, ejakaa a be juɛmi.
Mawu gbaami lɛ peeɔ nɔ niatsɛ; dengme gbomi kɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko piɛ we he ha nɔ.
Kuasia ngɛ nɛ ɔ, yayami peemi peeɔ lɛ bua jɔmi; juɛmitsɛ lɛɛ nile ji nɔ́ nɛ haa lɛ bua jɔmi.
Nɔ́ nɛ yayami peelɔ ngɛ gbeye yee ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ma ha lɛ.
Ke kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa te ɔ, e fiaa yayami peeli kɛ nɔɔ si nɛ a gboɔ.
Se nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sɛ a he.
Koo tsɔ hejɔtsɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ke o tsɔ lɛ ɔ, o he mi maa hia mo wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e maa pee mo kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe o ye kpɛte nɛ o lungu fĩa, aloo la su ku sɛ o hɛngmɛ mi.
Yawɛ gbeye yemi haa nɔ wami se kɛɔ; se yayami peeli lɛɛ a wami se kɛ we kulaa.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a, a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ya peeɔ bua jɔmi.
Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi maa pee yaka.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Yawɛ buu a he; yayami peeli lɛɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa ye a he daa, se yayami peeli lɛɛ a yi be wami nae ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a tuɔ juɛmi munyu.
Se lilɛ nɛ yeɔ lakpa a, a maa po lɛ kɛ fɔ he.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a le nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a de.
Se yayami peeli lɛɛ munyu nɛ puɛɔ nɔ́ lɛ a tuɔ.
Susumi ní yayahi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ sume.
Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ji nɔ́ susumi ní kpakpahi.
Hɛ mi si puemi nyɛɛɔ he nɔ womi se.
Nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, e le nɔ́.
Nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛɔ nimli kpakpahi, nɛ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ ngɛ je mi ji anɔkuale nɛ a yeɔ ɔ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ yi anɔkuale lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ní peemi ní yayamihi lɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.
Ní babauu nɛ nɔ ko na a be nyɛe ma he e yi wami ngɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ma nyɛ he e yi wami ji anɔkuale nɛ e yeɔ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ɔ, anɔkuale nɛ e yeɔ he je ɔ, e je mi si himi daa lɛ.
Se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní yayamihi lɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, anɔkuale nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ níhi a mi.
Se nihi nɛ yi anɔkuale ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a jiklɔɔ lɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.
Ke nɔmlɔ yayami gbo pɛ kɛkɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ hu laa.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ, ke e ngɛ nɔ kpakpa ko blɔ hyɛe ɔ, e peeɔ yaka.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, a jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ haomi mi, nɛ haomi ɔ baa nɔmlɔ yayami mohu nɔ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ, e kɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ e nyɛmi.
Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e juɛmi ma he e yi wami.
Ke níhi a mi hi ha nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, bua jɔmi baa ma a mi.
Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ a hɛ mi kpata a, ma a hwɔɔ lele.
Nimli kpakpahi a ní peemi ní kpakpahi haa ma yaa nɔ.
Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nya mi munyu haa ma hɛ mi kpataa.
Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi he guɛ ɔ, e be juɛmi; ní lelɔ ɔ, pe e maa e nya.
Nɔ nɛ hii sieku yee kɛ hii bee ɔ, e jeɔ laami sanehi kpo.
Se nɔ nɛ heɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ laa nɔ́ nɔ.
Ma nɛ na we ga woli kpakpa a, e ywiaa.
Se ma, he nɛ ga woli kpakpa hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, tue mi jɔmi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ daa nubwɔ se ɔ, e piaa e he.
Se nɔ nɛ pee we ja lɛɛ e yeɔ e he.
Yo nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ, a buu lɛ, se yo nɛ be subai ɔ lɛɛ hɛ mi si puemi e kɛ baa.
Nɔ nɛ naa mɔbɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he kpakpa lɛ e ngɛ pee.
Se nɔ nɛ yi mi wa a, e ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he plaae.
Nɔmlɔ yayami ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ e naa kɛ jeɔ e yi wu tso ní peemi níhi a mi.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ e nine suu hiɔwo kpakpa nɔ kɛ̃.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kpamisa nɛ e kpa we ɔ, e yi ma na wami.
Se nɔ nɛ dii yayami se ɔ, e ma gbo.
Nihi nɛ a juɛmi mi hyi tɔ kɛ yayami ɔ, Yawɛ sume mɛ saasaa; nihi nɛ e suɔ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Anɔkuale sane ji kaa yayami peelɔ ɔ, ja a gbla e tue kokooko.
Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa ye a he.
Yo nɛ e he ngɛ fɛu, se e juɛmi mi kuɔ we ɔ, e ngɛ kaa sika tsu ga ngɛ kpotoo gugwɔ mi.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ ji kaa nɔ́ ko tsuaa nɔ́ ko ɔ, kpakpa pɛ nɛ je mi.
Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ abofu kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ a hii blɔ hyɛe.
Ni komɛ haa nɔ nɔ́, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a naa ní babauu.
Ni komɛ hu, nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa a ha nɔ ɔ, a peeɔ he kpɛle, se a yeɔ ohia.
Nɔ nɛ haa nɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e bɔɔ; nɔ nɛ haa nɛ nihi tɔɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu e tɔɔ.
Nɔ nɛ tsiɔ blɛfo nya a, ma a maa gbiɛ lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ juaa blɛfo lɛɛ a maa gbaa lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hlaa nɔ́ kpakpa se blɔ ɔ, e hɛ mi baa nyami.
Nɔ nɛ dii yayami se ɔ, e kɛ yayami kpeɔ.
Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ ní nami nɔ ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bɔ kaa ba mumu.
Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ haomi kɛ baa e weku li a nɔ ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, e jeɔ mi dɛ gu.
Kuasia ma sɔmɔ ní lelɔ daa.
Nɔ́ nɛ da peemi haa nɔ wami; basabasa lɛɛ gbenɔ e kɛ baa.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e naa e hiɔwo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ tete po.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli hu ja a gbla a tue kɛ̃.
Nɔ nɛ le ní ɔ, e suɔ nɛ ke e ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee nɛ dɛ ɔ, a de lɛ.
Se kuasia lɛɛ e sume nɛ a kaa e hɛ mi.
Yawɛ náá nɔmlɔ kpakpa he bua jɔmi.
Se nɔ nɛ toɔ ga yaya lɛɛ e buɔ lɛ fɔ.
Yayami peemi ha we nɛ nɔ yaa nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e daa si kpɛii.
Yo kpakpa ngɛ kaa jlasi ngɛ e huno yi mi.
Yo nɛ pueɔ e huno hɛ mi si lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa hiɔ ngɛ e huno wuhi a mi.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, ní kpakpahi a he a susuɔ.
Se ga nɛ yayami peeli toɔ ɔ, sisimi sɔuu.
Yayami peeli a nya mi munyu kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.
Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ a nya mi munyu heɔ nɔ yi wami.
A ma kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi, nɛ a be mɛ nae hu.
Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ a nina maa hi si daa.
Ke o ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, a ma je o yi.
Se ke o biɛ lɛɛ a maa gbe o he guɛ.
Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko be e dɛ, se e tsuɔ ní nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, e hi kulaa pe nɔ nɛ peeɔ e he agbo, nɛ e nya mi ngma po bɔɔ lɛ.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa hyɛɛ e lohwehi a nɔ saminya.
Se nimli yayamihi lɛɛ mɔbɔ nɛ a naa a lohwehi po, yi mi wami sɔuu.
Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ ɔ ma na niye ní babauu.
Se nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ yakayaka níhi a se lɛɛ kuasia ji lɛ.
Yayami peeli a suɔmi nya ní ji kaa a hi yayami pee kpamisa.
Nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ a daa si kpɛii.
Nɔmlɔ yayami nya mi munyuhi peeɔ klama ha lɛ nɛ e duɔ.
Se nɔmlɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e he jee sane mi.
Munyu kpakpahi nɛ jeɔ nɔ ko nya mi, kɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he hiɔwo e naa.
Kuasia susuɔ kaa be tsuaa be ɔ, e nɔ́ da.
Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e buɔ ga womi tue.
Ke kuasia mi mi fu ɔ, e kɛ́ we nɛ a naa.
Ní lelɔ lɛɛ ke o jɛ lɛ tete po, e bui.

Blɔ nɛ moo o susu kaa e da a, nyagbe ɔ, e kɛ mo yaa gbenɔ mi.
Mi mi hwɔ nɛ yeɔ ní tsulɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ haa e tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, konɛ e nya mi ngma ko bɔ lɛ.
Yakayaka nimli toɔ ga nɛ a kɛ maa ye a nyɛmimɛ awi; a nya mi munyu tete po ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ sãe.
Nimli yayamihi woɔ pɛ; siekutsɛmɛ puɛɔ huɛmɛ kpakpahi a kpɛti.
Yiwutsotsɛ sisiɔ e nyɛmi, nɛ e ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ya woɔ haomi mi.
Nihi nɛ muɔɔ nɛ a jeɔ a lungu kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo, nɛ a hii a hɛngmɛ fiae kɛ ha mo ɔ, ga yayami a ngɛ toe ɔ nɛ.
Moo hyɛ mɛ saminya.
Yi mi mua ngɛ kaa jlasi nɛ woɔ nɔ hɛ mi nyami; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ a naa lɔ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ mi mi fu we mla a, e hi pe katsɛ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ e he nɔ ɔ, e hi pe tatsɛ nɛ ya ye ma ko nɔ kunimi.
Nimli adesahi fɔɔ sɔ nɛ a kɛ le Mawu yi mi tomi.
Se bɔ nɛ níhi ma ya ba ha a, Yawɛ pɛ lɛ e tsɔɔ.
Niye ní nya mi bɔ kake nɛ o maa ye ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ɔ, e hi kulaa pe okplɔɔ nguaa nɛ a tsɛ ngɛ we nɛ pɛ sɔuu lɛ ngɛ mi.
Sɔmɔlɔ nɛ le ní maa ye bi nɛ peeɔ zo ní nɔ; nɛ e kɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ maa dla gbosi ní fiee.
La a kɛ tsuɔ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ he, se Yawɛ lɛ kaa adesa tsui hyɛɔ.
Yayami peelɔ buɔ yi wu tso níhi tue, nɛ lakpatsɛ hu buɔ lakpa munyuhi nɛ puɛɔ nɔ biɛ tue.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ohiatsɛ he fɛu ɔ, ohiatsɛ ɔ bɔlɔ e ngɛ jɛe ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ bua jɔɔ nɔ ko amanehlu he ɔ, e be e he yee.
Bibimɛ ji nimowi a hɛ mi nyami, kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛ ngɛ ha fɔli ɔ. Munyu kpakpa sɛ́ kuasia, kaa bɔ nɛ lakpa sɛ́ ganɔ ɔ. Nyɔ mi ní halɔ susuɔ kaa e ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ nyɔ mi ní ma tsu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ bɔ nɛ e suɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ tɛ nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní lɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ kɛ tɔmi nɛ a tɔ̃ e nɔ paa a, a suɔ e sane; se nɔ nɛ hɛɛɔ yayami nɛ a pee lɛ mi kpamisa a, e kɛ e huɛmɛ a kpɛti puɛɔ.
Ke a ka nɔ nɛ kɔɔ sane se hɛ mi ɔ, e naa he se babauu pe kuasia nɛ a fia e se mi kpa si lafa sɔuu.
Nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ yayami tsuɔ kɛkɛ ji kaa e tsɔ atuã.
E kɛ tsɔlɔ yiwutsotsɛ lɛ ma ya kpe.
Afani nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ osisiblisi nɛ a nuu e bimɛ maa kpe, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ kuasia nɛ ngɛ biɛe maa kpe.
Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nane mi ɔ, yayami be e we mi tae gblegbleegble.
Pɛ sisi jemi ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a bli nya nɛ́ e be; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ nya sami ɔ mi wɛ lolo ɔ, moo ngmɛɛ he.
Nɔ nɛ woɔ yayami peelɔ nguɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ buɔ dalɔ fɔ ɔ, Yawɛ hiɔ mɛ tsuo.
Mɛni se kuasia ma na ke e maa hɛɛ sika kɛ ya he nile, be mi nɛ e be juɛmi?
Huɛmɛ suɔ a he be tsuaa be, se nyɛmimɛ lɛɛ haomi be mi tete po a si we a sibi.
Nɔ nɛ be juɛmi lɛ woɔ si nɛ e daa nɔ se kaa e maa wo e hiɔhi ha lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ nɛ e tɔ̃ nɔ nɔ be tsuaa be ɔ, pɛ wolɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ fĩaa hu, hɛ mi kpatami e ngɛ hlae ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ yayami lɛ e susuɔ ɔ, e yɛ nɔ; nɔ nɛ munyu yaya jeɔ e nya mi ɔ, haomi lɛ baa e nɔ.
Bi nɛ biɛ haa e tsɛ yeɔ e tsui; tsɛ nɛ fɔ bi kuasia a, e na we bua jɔmi.
Ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e he be tsuaa be ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tsopa nɛ haa nɔ he wami.
Se daa nɛ ke nɔ pee vii ɔ, e ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he gbee.
Yiwutsotsɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní ngɛ laami mi nɛ́ e kɛ plɛ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
Ní lelɔ ngɔɔ níhi nɛ a he ngɛ se nami kɛ fɔɔ e hɛ mi; kuasia lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ je ɔ tsuo nɔ kɔe.
Bi kuasia haa e tsɛ yeɔ tsui, nɛ e haa e nyɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ.
Nɔ nɛ sane da a, e sɛ kaa a bɔɔ lɛ hiɔ.
Odehehi hu e sɛ kaa a fiaa mɛ ní yaka.
Nɔ nɛ tu we munyu puu ɔ, juɛmitsɛ ji lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka si ɔ, e le ní.
Kuasia tete, ke e ma e nya nɛ e tu we munyu ɔ, a buɔ lɛ ní lelɔ.
Nihi nɛ suɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ, a kɛ nɔ kpa pee we nɔ́ ko.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ nihi tsuo le kaa e hi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a deɔ ke e hí.
E he hia we kuasia kaa ke e kɛ nihi ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, e bɔ mɔde kaa e maa nu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ sisi.
Kuasia lɛɛ nɔ́ kake too ɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ngɛ e tue mi.
Yayami peemi kɛ he guɛ gbemi lɛ nyɛɛɔ; ke o hɛ mi pue si pɛ zo maa nyɛɛ se.
Nile ma nyɛ je nɔmlɔ nya mi munyu mi; e mi kuɔ kaa wo, nɛ e he tsɔ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
Nɔ nɛ sane be mi ɔ, e sɛ kaa a hyɛɔ e hɛ mi nɛ a plɛɔ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da mohu sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si ngɛ kojomi he.
Kuasia nya mi munyu woɔ pɛ, kunɔ lɛ nyɛɛɔ se.
Kuasia nya mi munyu ngɛ kaa klama nɛ e tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he; lɔ ɔ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ kpataa e hɛ mi.
Sieku yelɔ munyu ngɛ kaa niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ.
Nimli adesahi suɔ kaa a maa mi kɛ ya a muklii mi tɔɔ.
Hejɔtsɛ kɛ nɔ́ puɛlɔ ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ.
Yawɛ ngɛ kaa mɔ nguaa, he nɛ nimli kpakpahi tuu fo kɛ ya saa we ngɛ nɛ a yi naa wami.
Niatsɛmɛ susuɔ kaa ke a na ní ɔ, e haa mɛ bua jɔmi, kaa bɔ nɛ ke a fia gbogbo kɛ wo ma he nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ naa he jɔmi ɔ. Nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami; ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ hɛ mi kpatami blɔ nɔ a ngɛ.
Ke a ngɛ mo munyu tue ɔ, bu tue loko o ha heto.
Ke o pee we ja a, a ma tsɛ mo kuasia, nɛ o hɛ mi ma pue si.
Ke o be he wami, nɛ o na tsui to he ɔ, e maa hi ha mo.
Se ke o ngɛ o tsui yee ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ pee mo.
Ní lelɔ ɔ, daa nɛ e pee e juɛmi, kɛ e tue klaalo kɛ ngɛ ní kasee.
Nike ní bliɔ blɔ ha nɔ kɛ ya suu nimli nguahi a hɛ mi tɔɔ.
Ke nɔ ko sɛ hlami kɛ jaje e sane ɔ, e peeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e sane da kɛ yaa si e nyɛmi ɔ ma bɔni lɛ munyu bimi, loko anɔkuale ɔ maa je kpo.
Ke ni nguahi enyɔ ngɛ nɔ́ he huae ɔ, ja a fɔ sɔ kɛ buá sane ɔ he, loko pɛ ɔ maa jɔ.
Ke o kɛ o nyɛmi pɛ ɔ, e ma plɛ e se kɛ wo mo kaa bɔ nɛ ke a kɛ dade la agbo se ngɛ mɔ mi nɛ nɔ ko nyɛ we mi sɛmi ɔ. Ke o tu munyu ko ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ, e sa kaa o pɛtɛ he; e hi jio, e hí jio.
Munyu nɛ jeɔ nɔ nya mi ɔ, gbenɔ, loo wami lɛ e kɛ baa.
Nihi nɛ suɔ munyu tumi ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa, loo nɔ́ yaya ko nɛ maa je mi kɛ ba a, e sa mɛ.
Ke o ngɔ yo kɛkɛ o ná nɔ́ kpakpa, nɛ Yawɛ maa gbaa mo.
Ke ohiatsɛ maa tu munyu ɔ, e deɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ.” Se ke niatsɛ ma ha munyu heto ɔ, e kuɛɔ kɛ woɔ nɔ.
Huɛ bɔmi komɛ a se kɛ we kulaa.
Se huɛmɛ komɛ hu mɛtɛɛ a sibi a he kpɛii pe nyɛmimɛ tete po.
Ohiatsɛ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e hi pe kuasia nɛ yeɔ lakpa.
Nɔ nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, e ní ngɛ mɔbɔ.
Nɔ nɛ nane nya sɔɔ ɔ, e laa blɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ya biɛ nɛ haomi ba e nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ e ngɔ abofu ɔ ya kple Yawɛ mohu nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko na ní ɔ, e naa huɛmɛ babauu; ohiatsɛ lɛɛ e huɛ kake ɔ po kuaa lɛ.
Lakpa odase yelɔ be e he yee kɔkɔɔkɔ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa a, e he be sane mi jee.
Nɔ nɛ mi mi jɔ ɔ, nihi fuu kɛ lɛ bɔɔ; nɔ nɛ bɔleɔ e nine ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ huɛ ji lɛ.
Ohiatsɛ lɛɛ e nyɛmimɛ tete po sume lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be nyakpɛ kaa e huɛmɛ tsɛ̃ɔ a he kɛ jeɔ e he.
Ke e hla a se blɔ kaa mɛni po, e nine sui a nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ hlaa nile se blɔ ɔ, e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he; nɔ nɛ pɛtɛɔ nile he ɔ, e yaa nɔ.
Lakpa odase yelɔ be e he yee kɔkɔɔkɔ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa a, e hɛ mi ma kpata.
Si himi ngɔngɔɛ sɛ́ kuasia, hluu nɛ a ba de ke nyɔguɛ nɛ ye ganɔhi a nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e mi mi fu we mla.
Ke nɔ ko tɔ̃ e nɔ nɛ e pui mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ woɔ e hɛ mi nyami.
Ke matsɛ mi mi wo la a, e ngɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae; se ke e ná nɔ he bua jɔmi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa bɔ́ ngɛ nga nɔ.
Bi kuasia kɛ e tsɛ woɔ haomi mi.
Yo nɛ suɔ pɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tsu nya nyu nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɛ ngɛ si puee kɔ, kɔ, kɔ nɛ nyagbe be he.
We kɛ sika a, tsɛmɛ a dɛ mi nɛ a naa kɛ jeɔ kaa gbosi ní, se yo nɛ le ní ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ haa nɔ.
Pee hejɔ faa, nɛ o wɔ mahe vii bɔ nɛ o suɔ; se hwɔ maa ye mo.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa a nɔ ɔ, e se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi; se nɔ nɛ bui mlaa a, e ma gbo.
Ke o na ohiatsɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa o pa nɔ́ ko ha Yawɛ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ, e maa to nane mi ha mo.
Tsɔse o bi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi, nɛ́ o ko ba ha nɛ e hɛ mi nɛ kpata.
Ngmɛɛ mi mi latsɛ he nɛ e ná e tue gblami; ejakaa ke o je lɛ kɛ je haomi mi si kake ɔ, e maa hia kaa o ya je lɛ ngɛ mi ekohu.
Bu ga womi tue, nɛ o ha a tu mo slɔmi munyu, konɛ o na nile nɛ o kɛ bu o he hwɔɔ se.
Nɔmlɔ adesa peeɔ e juɛmi ngɛ níhi babauu a he, se Yawɛ yi mi tomi ɔ pɛ lɛ baa mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ dɛ ji kaa e ye anɔkuale; dɛgutsɛ hi pe lakpatsɛ.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e wami se kɛɔ; e naa bua jɔmi, nɛ haomi ko haomi ko bɛ e nɔ.
Hejɔtsɛ nine tlɔɔ kã mi; dengme loko e kpaleɔ e nine ɔ kɛ baa e nya he ekohu.
Gbla he nɔ wolɔ tue, nɛ ni guhi maa kase nile.
Ka ní lelɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e maa kase ní kɛ piɛ he.
Bi nɛ waa e tsɛ yi mi, nɛ e fieɔ e nyɛ kɛ jeɔ e we mi ɔ, zo, kɛ ahlua e kɛ baa.
Ye bi, ke o sume nɛ a slɔ mo ɔ, nile munyuhi ma bɔ mo.
Lakpa odase yelɔ ɔ, dami sane yemi he fɛu e ngɛ yeɔ nɛ.
Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ munyu yaya sɔuu lɛ jeɔ e nya mi.
Tue gblami fɔɔ si ha he nɔ woli.
Kuasiahi lɛɛ a maa fia a se mi kpa.
Wai sisiɔ nɔ; dã nɛ nya wa haa nɛ nɔ peeɔ basabasa.
Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e he kɛ haa dã a, e li nɔ́.
Ke matsɛ mi mi fu ɔ, ye lɛ gbeye kaa bɔ nɛ o maa ye jata nɛ ngɛ huae gbeye.
Nɔ nɛ woɔ matsɛ mi mi la a, lɛ nitsɛ e wami e kɛ ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ bu ngɛ e he ɔ, e yuu e he kɛ jee pɛ he.
Kuasiahi lɛ a hii pɛe kpamisa.
Hejɔtsɛ nɛ sume kaa e maa gba ní ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, ke ní kpami be su ɔ, e be nɔ́ ko nae.
Juɛmi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa yi mi ɔ, e mi kuɔ kaa nyu ngɛ vu mi tsitsaa lokoo.
Se ní lelɔ jeɔ juɛmi nɛ ɔ kpo ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Nihi babauu maa tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ a mi mi jɔ ha.
Se mo hla anɔkualetsɛ kake too ngɛ a kpɛti kaa o maa na lo.
Bimɛ nɛ a tsɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a gbaa mɛ.
Ke matsɛ ngɛ kojoe ɔ, e hɛngmɛ e kɛ dlaa nɔ́ yaya.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de anɔkuale mi ke, “Ye tsui mi tsɔ, nɛ yayami ko pa be ye he hu”?
Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ sɛni, kɛ sɛni tɛhi nɛ dɛ kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, Yawɛ sume mɛ.
Jokuɛyo tete po e ní peemi níhi a kɛ yoɔ lɛ kaa e yeɔ anɔkuale, loo e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Tue nɛ waa kɛ nuɔ nɔ́, kɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ waa kɛ hyɛɔ nɔ́ ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ pee mɛ tsuo ha wɔ.
Koo suɔ mahe hwɔmi nɛ o ba ye ohia.
Moo hi hɛ ngmengmle nɛ o hi o he mɔde bɔe, kɛkɛ o ma na ní babauu maa ye.
Ke nɔ ko yaa he nɔ́ ɔ, e deɔ ke e he jua wa tsɔ.
Se ke e je kɛ yaa a, e fĩaa nɛ e deɔ ke, “Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ i ná lɛ he jua jɔjɔɛ.” Sika tsu, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɛ babauu.
Se ní lelɔ nya mi munyu ngɛ kaa june kpakpa.
Ke nɔ ko wo si ke e maa da nubwɔ nɛ e li lɛ e se ɔ, a ngɔ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ tade kɛ to awaba.
Nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko na kɛ gu sisimi blɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔɔ kaa bɔ nɛ niye ní kpakpa ngɔɔ ɔ.
Se pee se ɔ, e ba peeɔ kaa tɛ ngmlitsa ngɛ nɔ ɔ nya mi.
Ke o maa pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, bi ga womi, kɛkɛ e maa hi ha mo.
Too ga kpakpa loko o ya hwu ta.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ e lilɛ hwɔ we si, nɛ e hii nihi a he munyu tue kɛ hii nyɛɛe ɔ, jeɔ laami sanehi kpo.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu puu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, o kɛ lɛ ko bɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbiɛɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, e nyagbe baa tlukaa kaa kane nɛ a gbe ngɛ diblii kpii mi.
Gbosi ní nɛ o he sɔ kɛ na a, nyagbe ɔ, e pee we gbaami.
Ke nɔ ko pee mo yayami ɔ, ko de ke mo hu o maa pee lɛ kɛ to nane mi.
Ngɔɔ o sane ɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e maa piɛ o he.
Yawɛ hiɔ ní ngmɛmi ní munomunohi; sɛni kɛ e mi tɛ nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, e hí.
Blɔ nɛ nɔ maa nyɛɛ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ tsɔɔ.
Lɛɛ kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ maa le lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ kɛɛ?
Mo susu o yi mi saminya loko o wo Mawu si, konɛ e ko ba pee klama nɛ maa du mo pee se.
Matsɛ nɛ le ní ɔ, e hlaa yayami peeli ngɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ a saa blɛfo mi, nɛ e gblaa a tue wawɛɛ.
Nɔmlɔ he nile ngɛ kaa kane nɛ Yawɛ kɛ hyɛɛ nɔmlɔ tsui mi níhi tsuo fitsofitso.
Matsɛ nɛ naa mɔbɔ, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e naa tue mi jɔmi, nɛ e tsɛ yemi ɔ hu yaa nɔ saminya.
Nihewi a hɛ mi nyami ji a he wami; nimowi a he fɛu ji a yi mi mua.
Tue gblami nɛ nya wa tsakeɔ wa ní peemi ní yayamihi.
Matsɛ juɛmi ngɛ kaa nyu dɔ ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi.
He nɛ lɛɛ e suɔ nɛ e haa e guɔ.
Nɔmlɔ adesa blɔ tsuo da ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi; se Yawɛ lɛ hyɛɔ nɔ tsui mi.
Pee nɔ́ nɛ sa, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da; lɔ ɔ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi pe nɔ nɛ a maa sã bɔ ha lɛ.
He nɔ womi, kɛ he womi nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nyaa he ɔ, yayami ji lɔ ɔmɛ.
Nɔ nɛ bɔɔ mɔde kɛ toɔ níhi a blɔ nya saminya a, e naa ní babauu; se nɔ nɛ esɔ kɛkɛ e heɔ ɔ, e be nɔ́ kpakpa ko náe pe ohia.
Ní nɛ o gu sisimi blɔ nɔ kɛ na a, e se kɛ we kulaa; kaa bɔ nɛ la muɔ se poɔ be kuku kɛkɛ ɔ, gbenɔ lɛ nyɛɛɔ se.
Basabasa nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi; ejakaa a sume nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ fɔ ɔ, e blɔ ngɛ gɔdɔgɔdɔ, se nɔ nɛ tsui mi tsɔ ɔ, e subai hi.
E hi kaa o ma ya hi tsu yi mi banee, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ maa hi we kake mi.
Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ yayami peemi pɛ e suɔ; e nyɛmi ní pee we lɛ mɔbɔ.
Ke a gbla he nɔ wolɔ tue ɔ, kuasia po kaseɔ ní kɛ jeɔ mi.
Nɛ ke a tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ní ɔ, e leɔ.
Mawu ngɛ yayami peeli tsuo hyɛe ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nɔ nɛ tsiɔ e tue, konɛ e ko nu ohiatsɛ ngmlaa a, lɛ hu ke e kpa ngmlaa a, a be lɛ tue bue.
Nike ní nɛ a haa ngɛ laami mi jɔɔ abofu he kaa bɔ nɛ nyɔ mi ní haa mi mi la se poɔ ɔ. Ke a ye dami sane ɔ, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a bua jɔɔ saminya; se yayami peeli lɛɛ sawale nuɔ mɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka we si ngɛ je mi, se nɔ́ nɛ e tsui suɔ lɛ e peeɔ ɔ, gbenɔ ji nɔ nɛ fɔɔ si ha lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ fiɛmi maa ye ohia; nɔ nɛ dã, kɛ he dlami e suɔ ɔ, e be ní nae.
Klama nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, nyagbe ɔ, e duɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu.
Afani nɔ́ nɛ o ma ya hi nga kplanaa nɔ pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɔ maa hi si.
Ní lelɔ buaa níhi nɛ a he jua wa nya ngɔ toɔ; kuasia lɛɛ e kpataa ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi mohu.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ ɔ, e se kɛɛ ngɛ je mi, nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Gbogbo nɛ katsɛmɛ fiaa kɛ bɔleɔ a mɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ nɔ a ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ɔ, ní lelɔ kuɔɔ nɛ e kpataa ma a hɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ e nya, kɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya ngɛ munyu tumi mi ɔ, e yeɔ e he kɛ jeɔ amanehlu mi.
Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ e he, nɛ e peeɔ pupuupu ɔ, e bui nɔ́.
Nɔ́ hiaa hejɔtsɛ hluu kɛ ya siɔ e gboɔ, ejakaa e sume nɛ e kɛ e nine tsuɔ ní.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e haa nɔ nɔ́, nɛ e nyɛ́ nɔ nɔ́ he; se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɔ kɔe.
Yayami peelɔ bɔ ɔ, Yawɛ sume kulaa, hluu nɛ a de ke yi mi tomi yayami piɛ bɔ ɔ he.
Lakpa odase yelɔ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Nɔ nɛ susuɔ munyu he loko e tuɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e munyu ɔ, a ngɔɔ.
Yiwutsotsɛ toɔ e hɛ mi liliili kɛ peeɔ yayami; nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ e susuɔ níhi a he saminya.
Adesa nile, loo nɔ́ sisi numi, loo ga be nyɛe maa da Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Adesa dlaa e we okpɔngɔ he kɛ ha ta hwumi; se kunimi yemi ɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi e ngɛ.
Biɛ kpakpa hi pe ní nami babauu.
Bu hu hi pe sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu.
Niatsɛ, kɛ ohiatsɛ ɔ, nimli kake too ji mɛ; Yawɛ lɛ pee mɛ tsuo.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ le nɔ́ ɔ, ke e na haomi nɛ ma a, e tuu nya fo, nɛ e ya laa e he.
Nɔ nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, lɛɛ e kɛ e he ya woɔ haomi mi, nɛ e naa nɔ́.
Nɔ nɛ baa e he si, nɛ e yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e naa ní, e hɛ mi baa nyami, nɛ e wami se kɛɔ.
Mio, kɛ klama ngɛ yayami peelɔ blɔ mi.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ hyɛɔ e he nɔ saminya a, e maa yu e he kɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Tsɔse jokuɛyo nɛ e le bɔ nɛ e maa ba e je mi ha, nɛ ke e wa a, e hɛ be nɔ jee.
Niatsɛ nyɔguɛ ji ohiatsɛ.
Ke o pa sika ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ kɛkɛ o plɛ pee e nyɔguɛ.
Nɔ nɛ yi dami sane ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ji amanehlu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, yi mi nɛ e waa nihi ɔ tsuo se maa po.
Nɔ nɛ mi mi jɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ, ejakaa e ngɔɔ e niye ní kɛ haa ohiatsɛmɛ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ he fɛu ɔ, fie lɛ kɛ je o kasa nya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, huhui, pɛ, kɛ nɔ jɛmi se maa po.
Nɔ nɛ tsui mi tsɔ, nɛ e munyu ngɛ blɛuu ɔ, e kɛ matsɛ maa bɔ.
Yawɛ haa anɔkuale daa si, nɛ yayami peelɔ munyuhi peeɔ yaka.
Nɔ́ nɛ hejɔtsɛ deɔ ji, “Jata ngɛ blɔ mi; ke i je kpo ɔ, e maa gbe mi.” Yo yaholɔ nya mi ngɛ kaa muɔ voo nɛ a tsua kɛ fɔ si.
Nihi nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ lɛ a nɔɔ muɔ nɛ ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ jokuɛyo suɔ peemi ji kuasia jemi.
Se tsɔsemi tso fieɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ e he.
Nɔ nɛ waa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi nɛ e kɛ naa ní, aloo nɔ nɛ keɔ niatsɛmɛ ní ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ma ba ye ohia.
Nile munyu nyingmi etɛ Bu tue, nɛ o nu munyuhi nɛ ní leli tuɔ, nɛ o kase ní kɛ je mi.
Ke o pee ja a, e maa hi ha mo, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi.
O ma kai munyu nɛ ɔmɛ daa, nɛ mo hu o ma nyɛ maa tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ be tsuaa be nɛ o suɔ.
I suɔ kaa o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ mo ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ngma nile, kɛ ga womi munyu nyingmi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha mo, konɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ ji anɔkuale tutuutu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke a tsɔ mo ɔ, o ma na heto kpakpa ba ha nɔ nɛ tsɔ mo ɔ.
-- Ko de ke ohiatsɛ pi nɔ ko he je ɔ, o maa sisi lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ e yi fi ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, koo wa lɛ yi mi.
Yawɛ nitsɛ maa ye jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a sane ha mɛ.
Ke nɔ ko wo a susuma he gbeye ɔ, Yawɛ maa wo lɛ hu e susuma he gbeye ja nɔuu.
-- Nɔmlɔ nɛ be tsui ɔ, o kɛ lɛ ko bɔ.
Nɔ nɛ mi mi fuɔ mla a, o kɛ lɛ ko nyɛɛ.
Ke o kɛ lɛ bɔ ɔ, o maa kase e ní peemi níhi, nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee klama nɛ du mo.
-- Koo pee o he nɔmlɔ nɛ daa hiɔ nya ha nihi.
Ke o nyɛ we nɛ o wo hiɔ ɔ, o sa tete po a ma kpɔ ngɛ o dɛ.
-- Blema buna nɛ o nɛmɛ kɛ kadi zugba a, koo hɛ.
-- Anɛ o le nɔ ko nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya lo?
Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, matsɛmɛ nɛ e ma sɔmɔ; pi ni guhi.
-- Ke o kɛ ma nɔ yelɔ yaa ye ní ɔ, susu nɔ nɛ hɛ mi nɛ o hii si ngɛ ɔ he saminya.
Ke ngma yelɔ ji mo ɔ, ye o he nɔ, nɛ o ye bɔbɔyoo pɛ.
Ko ha nɛ ma nɔ yelɔ ɔ ní ngɔngɔɛ ɔ nɛ jlo mo; ejakaa pe e kɛ ngɛ mo kae.
-- Ko gbo dengme ke doo ja o na ní.
Ka kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, o hɛ mi nɛ ka si, nɛ o ye nɔ.
Hɛngmɛfia pɛ sika a ma nyɛ laa mo; e maa pee kɔɔhiɔ nɛ e maa laa tlukaa kaa kɔle tee kɛ yaa hiɔwe.
-- Ke kpɛletsɛ ha mo abolo ɔ, koo ye; ko ha nɛ e niye ní ngɔngɔɛ ɔ nɛ jlo mo.
Jamɛatsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ buɔ akɔtaa ngɛ e yi mi; e deɔ mo ke, “Ye ní, nuu ní”; se anɔkuale mi ɔ, e tsui be o he.
E niye ní bɔbɔyoo nɛ o ye ɔ, o maa vie lɛ tsuo, nɛ o munyu ngɔngɔɛ nɛ o tu kɛ je e yi ɔ maa pee yaka.
-- Koo tu munyu kɛ wo kuasia ga; ejakaa nile nɛ ngɛ o munyu ɔ mi ɔ, e maa gbe he guɛ.
-- Koo hɛ blema buna kɛ ya se; nɛ ko ya sɛ awusahi a ngmɔ mi.
Ejakaa a kpɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ mo ma na, nɛ e maa ye sane ɔ ha mɛ.
-- Ke a ngɛ mo nile munyu tue ɔ, bu tue nɛ o kase ní kɛ je mi.
-- Ke e hia kaa a tsɔse jokuɛ ɔ, tsɔse lɛ; ejakaa ke o fia lɛ kpa a, e be gboe.
Ke o fia lɛ kpa a, e ma he e yi wami, nɛ e hɛ mi be kpatae.
-- Ye bi, ke o le ní ɔ, imi hu ye bua maa jɔ.
Ke i nu nɛ munyu kpakpa ngɛ o nya mi jee ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi.
-- Hyɛ nɛ o hɛ ko kɔ yayami peeli a nɔ, mohu ɔ, ye Yawɛ gbeye daa.
Niinɛ, hwɔɔ se o hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ be yaka pee.
-- Ye bi, bu tue, nɛ o le ní; hyɛ o je mi bami nɔ saminya.
Ko ya piɛ nihi nɛ nuu wai fuu tsɔ, loo nihi nɛ peeɔ de lo he jiklɔɔ a he.
Dã deli, kɛ jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ maa ye ohia; nihi nɛ deɔ kɔnɛɛ be tsuaa be ɔ ma bu bo gbagbɛ.
-- Bu o tsɛ nɛ fɔ mo ɔ tue; nɛ ke o nyɛ bwɔ ɔ, koo gbe e he guɛ.
Anɔkuale yemi, nile, tsɔsemi, kɛ sane se kɔmi a he jua wa saminya; e sa kaa a di se nɛ a ko ngmɛɛ he.
Bi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, e haa e tsɛ nyaa babauu; nɔ nɛ fɔ bi ní lelɔ ɔ, e bua jɔɔ e bi ɔ he.
Ha nɛ o tsɛ, kɛ o nyɛ a bua nɛ jɔ; ha nɛ o nyɛ nɛ fɔ mo ɔ nɛ nya.
-- Ye bi, bu mi tue saminya; ha nɛ ye je mi bami nɛ pee nɔhyɛ nɔ́ ha mo!
Yo yaholɔ, loo yo nɛ puɛɔ gba ngɛ kaa klama nɛ a tsɔ; e kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi.
E woɔ ka kaa ojo fialɔ, nɛ e haa nyumuhi babauu puɛɔ gba.
-- Mɛnɔ naa nɔ́?
Mɛnɔ haoɔ?
Mɛnɔ kɛ nihi naa pɛ?
Mɛnɔ hii kɔmɔ yee?
Mɛnɔ naa pá ngɛ e he yaka gu?
Mɛnɔ hɛngmɛhi peeɔ tsutsuutsu kɔlukɔlu?
Jamɛatsɛmɛ ji nihi nɛ a se kɛɔ ngɛ wai numi he, nihi nɛ a ya kaa dã slɔɔtoslɔɔto nɛ a futu mi hyɛɔ ɔ!
Koo hyɛ wai, bɔ nɛ e tsuɔ paa, bɔ nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ fɛu ngɛ kplu mi, bɔ nɛ e bee miaa ngɛ kuɔ si, nɛ e ko ba ka mo.
Ke pi ja a, nɔ́ nɛ maa nyɛɛ se ji o he mi tsuo maa hi mo tsɛ̃e kaa nɔ́ nɛ sinɔ duɔtsɛ lɛ kɔ mo.
O hɛngmɛ maa na nyakpɛ níhi; o yi mi maa pee mo basaa, nɛ o maa hi ní tsuae kɛkɛ.
O maa pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ tlɔ wo mi, aloo nɔ ko nɛ kplaa si ngɛ abalaa tso he ngɛ lɛ mi.

Basabasa peemi kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ; nɛ munyu yaya nɛ jeɔ a nya mi.
-- Nile a kɛ poɔ we; e nɔ nɛ a maa we ɔ kɛ fɔɔ.
Juɛmi nɛ a kɛ dlaa tsu mi, nɛ a woɔ mi ní kpakpahi, kɛ afɛu níhi.

Ní lelɔ he wami hiɛ babauu.

Ke o ngɛ ga woli babauu ɔ, o yeɔ kunimi.

Ga tsuaa ga nɛ kuasia toɔ ɔ, e peeɔ yayami.

Ko de ke o li he nɔ́ ko, ejakaa Mawu nɛ naa nɔmlɔ tsui mi ɔ lɛɛ e na, nɛ e le hulɔ.
Nɛ e maa wo mo hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he.
-- Ye bi, moo ye hwo, ejakaa e hi.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ hwo nɛ je hwo gbaku mi ngɔɔ ngɛ o lilɛ nɔ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ ji bɔ nɛ nile ngɛ kɛ ha o susuma.

-- Koo pee o ní kaa yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ woɔ nimli kpakpahi ka nɛ a ngɔɔ a níhi, aloo a kpɔɔ a wehi ngɛ a dɛ pani nya.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa a, ke e nɔ si nɔtonɔto si kpaago po, e maa te si ekohu.

-- Ke o he nyɛlɔ tɛ nɔ́, loo e nɔ si ɔ, ko nya.

-- Ye bi, ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ o bu matsɛ.
