Moo lɛɛ moo hwɔ mahe koo!
Se be mi nɛ o hwɔɔ si ɔ, ohia ma ba na mo tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ ojo fialɔ ba tuaa nɔ ɔ. Nɛ o yi ma fi kaa nɔ nɛ ta bulɔ mia kɛ ba tua lɛ.
Salomo Abɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsami Salomo abɛ kpahi nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia we bi ɔmɛ bua nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Hɛ mi nyami sa Mawu kaa e ngɔɔ níhi kɛ laa wɔ; matsɛmɛ lɛɛ bu sa mɛ, ejakaa a hyɛɔ níhi a mi fitsofitso.
Bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti kɛ ha a, ja lɛ nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ngɛ susue ngɛ e yi mi ɔ ngɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa le.
Ke sika hiɔ galɔ je sika fĩ kɛ je sika hiɔ mi loko e naa june nɛ e kɛ tsuɔ nɔ́ ko kpakpa.
Ke a je nimli yayamihi kɛ je matsɛ ga woli a kpɛti ɔ, dami sane yemi yaa nɔ saminya ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ yemi he ɔ. Koo pee o he nɔ agbo ngɛ matsɛ hɛ mi; nɛ ko ya da si ngɛ nimli nguahi a da he.
E hi kaa a ma tsɛ mo kɛ ya yimɛ a je pe nɔ́ nɛ a maa tsɛ̃ mo kɛ ya sisimɛ a je ngɛ ganɔ ɔ hɛ mi.
Nɔ bi nya sɔɛ ngɛ sane yemi he kɛ de nɔ́ nɛ e na.
Ke o nya sɔ kɛ tu munyu, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, o nyɛmi ba pue o hɛ mi si ɔ, kɛ o maa pee kɛɛ?
Ke o kɛ o nyɛmi ngɛ pɛ ko ɔ, o kɛ lɛ pɛ nyɛ hla nya.
Koo wo nɔ kpa laami sane nɔ ta.
Ke o pee ja, nɛ nɔ ko nu he ɔ, e ma pue o hɛ mi si, nɛ o biɛ yaya a maa tlɔ o he daa.
Munyu nɛ a tu pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa sika tsu akutuhi nɛ a to ngɔ wo sika hiɔ nɔ́ mi.
Ke ní lelɔ ka o hɛ mi nɛ o bu tue ɔ, e ngɛ kaa june kpakpa nɛ e ke mo.
Tsɔlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e haa e nyɔmtsɛmɛ a tsui nɔɔ a mi kaa bɔ nɛ nyu nganii jɔɔ nɔ tsui he latsa be mi ke a ngɛ ní kpae ɔ. Nɔ nɛ fĩaa ke e maa ke nɔ nɔ́, se e yi nɔ gblee ɔ, e ngɛ kaa bɔku kɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nyu be mi.
Ke o to o tsui si nɛ o kɛ matsɛ tu munyu ɔ, o ma nyɛ tsake e yi mi tomi.
Ke sane ɔ he wa kaa tɛ po, munyu blɛuu nyɛɔ jɔɔ he.
Ke o na hwo ɔ, ye bɔ nɛ maa su o nya pɛ, konɛ e ko de mo nɛ o ba vie ngɔ pue si.
O nane ko pɔ o huɛ we mi fiɛmi, konɛ o sane ko ba ti lɛ, nɛ́ e ba nyɛ mo.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa odase ngɛ e nyɛmi he ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tsokpoti, loo klaate, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ nya ba.
Ke hɛdɔ ba, nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔmlɔ yayami nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ lungu yaya ngɛ nɔ́ tae, loo o kɛ nane nɛ tɔ̃ ngɛ nyɛɛe.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ kɔmɔ yee, nɛ moo o ngɛ bua jɔmi la lae ngɛ e kasa nya a, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ kɔmɔ yelɔ ɔ bo kpae ngɛ e he fĩɛ be mi, aloo o kɛ ngo ngɛ e pá nɔ puee.
Ke hwɔ ngɛ o he nyɛlɔ yee ɔ, ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye; nɛ ke kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu.
Ke o pee ja a, zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ Yawɛ maa gbaa mo.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ jeɔ omleyi ɔ, hiɔmi e kɛ baa kaa bɔ nɛ sieku yemi kɛ hɛ mi tumi baa a. E hi kaa o ma ya hi tsu yi mi banee, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ maa hi we kake mi.
Ke o nu manye munyu kɛ je ma se ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o ná nyu nɛ mi jɔ nɛ o kɛ maa gbe kuma.
Dalɔ nɛ ngmɛɛɔ nɔ́ he ha yayami peelɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a gbidi mi, loo vu nɛ e mi nyu ɔ puɛ.
Hwo babauu yemi hí; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko hla yi jemi kɛ be nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ nyɛ we e he nɔ nɛ e ye ɔ, e ngɛ kaa ma nɛ a ba tua lɛ, nɛ a ku e gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ pue si.
Hɛ mi nyami sɛ kuasia, kaa snoo ngɛ latsa be mi, aloo hiɔmi ngɛ ní kpami be mi.
Gbiɛmi nɛ a gbiɛɛ nɔ yaka gu ɔ, e tsu we nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa otoklii, aloo ngmlebitɛɛnyɛ nɛ ngɛ tee kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae kɛkɛ nɛ si mami be mi.
Okpɔngɔ ɔ, kpa a fiaa lɛ; teji ɔ, a woɔ e nya mi dade, nɛ kuasia lɛɛ e nɔ́ ji tso.
Ke o ma ha kuasia e munyu heto ɔ, koo tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ lɛɛ e tuɔ munyu ɔ. Ke o pee ja a, mo hu o maa je kuasia kaa lɛ nɔuu.
Ke kuasia tu biɛmi munyu ɔ, ha lɛ heto bɔ nɛ sa lɛ pɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa na kaa mamoo e li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ.
Ke o tsɔ kuasia a, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o poo mo nitsɛ o nanehi ngɔ fɔ he, aloo o nu duɔ nɔ́ nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.
Kuasia nya mi abɛ he be se nami, kaa bɔ nɛ glɔtsɛ nanehi kplaa si gu ngɛ e he ɔ. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ kuasia hɛ mi nyami woe ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ tɛ fie kɛ ngɛ amlami mi woe.
Ke kuasia ngɛ abɛ bue ɔ, e ngɛ kaa dã delɔ nɛ ngɛ mio hiae ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ bɔɔ dã delɔ, aloo kuasia nɛ bee kɛkɛ apaa a, e ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃lɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ plaae.
Kuasia nɛ kpaleɔ ya jeɔ kuasia si enyɔne ɔ, e ngɛ kaa gbe nɛ kpaleɔ ya yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e vie ekohu.
Ke nɔ ko buu e he ní lelɔ, nɛ pohu e li nɔ́ ko ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha kuasia po pe lɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ hejɔtsɛ deɔ ji, “Jata ngɛ blɔ mi!
Jata ngɛ blɔ kpɛ!” Hejɔtsɛ hii plɛe ngɛ sa mi kaa bɔ nɛ sinya plɛɔ e he ngɛ e se asahi a nɔ ɔ. Hejɔtsɛ nine tlɔɔ ka mi; dengme loko e kpaleɔ e nine ɔ kɛ baa e nya he ekohu.
Hejɔtsɛ buu e he ní lelɔ kulaa pe juɛmitsɛmɛ kpaago.
Nɔ nɛ kɛ e he woɔ pɛ nɛ kɔ we e he mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ na gbe nɛ bee nɛ e nu gbe ɔ tue.
-Nɔmlɔ nɛ sisiɔ e nyɛmi, nɛ pee se ɔ, e deɔ lɛ ke, “Oo, pe i kɛ mo ngɛ fiɛe” ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa godotsɛ nɛ e kɛ la tso, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃, loo gbenɔ nitsɛ ngɛ fiɛe.
Ke lɛ́ be la tɛ mi ɔ, la gboɔ; he nɛ siekutsɛ be ɔ, pɛ se poɔ.
Pɛ wolɔ he sɔɔ kɛ woɔ pɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la haa nɛ hã tsɛ̃ɔ ɔ. Siekutsɛ munyu ngɛ kaa niye ní ngɔngɔɛ nɛ ke o ye ɔ, e yaa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Ke nɔ ko nya mi munyu ngɔɔ, se e tsui mi lɛɛ e hí ɔ, e ngɛ kaa zu buɛ nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ ha he.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ nyɛɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ mo maa tu munyu ngɔngɔɛ, se e tsui mi lɛɛ e sume mo saasaa.
Ke e kɛ mo tu munyu dɔkɔbii ɔ, ko he lɛ nɛ o ye, ejakaa e tsui mi hyi tɔ kɛ ninyɛ sɔuu.
Ke e ngɔ sisimi kɛ laa e ninyɛ ɔ nɔ kaa mɛni po, e yi wu tso ní peemi ɔmɛ maa je kpo kokooko ngɛ ma hɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ tsuaa muɔ kɛ fɔɔ si ha nɔ ko ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e maa nɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ kpɛneɔ tɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e nɔ tɛ ɔ maa nɔ.
Lakpatsɛ nyɛɔ nihi nɛ e ye a he lakpa a. Munyu dɔkɔbii tulɔ puɛɔ nɔ́.
Koo fĩa kɛ fɔ hwɔɔ nɔ, ejakaa kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si hwɔɔ ɔ, o li nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ mi.
Ha nɛ nɔ kpa nɛ je o yi.
Ha nɛ nubwɔ mohu nɛ kɔ mo; pi mo nitsɛ.
Tɛ jiɔ, nɛ zia hu jiɔ; se haomi nɛ kuasia we abofu kɛ baa a nya wa.
Ke a ke a maa ngmɛ ɔ, tɛ kɛ zia a jiimi ɔ po pi nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ a kɛ maa to he.
Mi mi la puɛɔ ní wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ muklii mi fumi hu nɔ́ pe, se hunga jemi lɛɛ e nɔ nya hi dami.
Ke nɔ ko ka o hɛ mi ngɛ gua mi ɔ, e hi pe nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ mo ngɛ laami tso mi.
Ke o huɛ plaa mo ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa ko e ngɛ hlae ha mo; se o he nyɛlɔ lɛɛ pe e maa fua mo babauu kɛkɛ.
Nɔ nɛ tɔ ɔ, ke a ha lɛ hwo po e sume; se nɔ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, lɛɛ níhi nɛ dooɔ tete po ngɔɔ e nya.
Nyumu nɛ jeɔ e we mi nɛ e ya hii kpae ɔ, e ngɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ e tsu nya blɔ laa lɛ.
Ke haomi ba nɔ nɔ nɛ e ná bua wolɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nu je via nɛ e kpa; nɛ e naa bua jɔmi.
O hɛ ko je mo nitsɛ o huɛ, loo o tsɛ e huɛ nɔ; ke e fi mo ɔ, ko de ke doo o maa ya o nyɛmi ngɔ; o huɛ nɛ ngɛ o kasa nya a hi pe o nyɛmi nɛ ngɛ ma se lokoo.
Ye bi, pee o he ní lelɔ, nɛ ma na bua jɔmi, konɛ ma na nɔ́ kpakpa ko ma de nɔ nɛ ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe ɔ. Nɔ nɛ le ní naa yayami nɛ ma, nɛ e ya laa e he; se kuasia lɛɛ e kɛ yayami ɔ ya kpee, nɛ e naa e mi nɔ́.
Ke nɔ ko wo si kaa e maa da nubwɔ nɛ e li lɛ se ɔ, a ngɔ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ tade kɛ to awaba.
Nɔ nɛ teɔ si makɛ mla nɛ e ngaa e nyɛmi kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ɔ, a buɔ lɛ kaa pe e ngɛ nɔ ɔ gbiɛe mohu.
Yo nɛ woɔ pɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa hiɔmi nyu nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɔ, kɔ, kɔ kpamisa.
O be kikɛmɛ a yo nyɛe ma kpata gblegbleegble, kaa bɔ nɛ o be nyɛe maa tsi kɔɔhiɔ nya, loo o maa yɛ nyu kɛ wo kusii mi ɔ. Nɔmlɔ kaseɔ nile kɛ jeɔ e nyɛmi ngɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ dade duɔɔ dade nya a. Nɔ nɛ hyɛɔ ngmɔkɔ tso nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e yeɔ ngmɔkɔ yiblii ɔ eko; nɔ nɛ buɔ e nyɔmtsɛ he ɔ, a woɔ e hɛ mi nyami.
Nɔmlɔ adesa nitsɛ lɛ leɔ e tsui mi níhi, kaa bɔ nɛ e naa e hɛ mi foni paa ngɛ nyu hɛ mi ɔ. Nɔmlɔ adesa hɛngmɛ tɔɛ gblee kɛ nɔ́ hyɛmi, kaa bɔ nɛ gbenɔ hii nɔ hɛ mi kpatae kpamisa nɛ e kpa we ɔ. Ní kpakpahi nɛ a deɔ ngɛ nɔ ko he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ yoɔ lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la kaa sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu ɔ. Ke a kongo kuasia kaa bɔ nɛ a gbeeɔ blɛfo ngɛ tso mi po, e biɛmi ɔ be tae.
Hyɛ o to, kɛ o na nɔ saminya; ejakaa ní nami hí si kɛ yɛ neneene.
Anɛ matsɛ yemi ko ngɛ nɛ be nyagbe lo?
Ke nga gbli, nɛ nga mumu kpale puɛ, nɛ a bua lohwehi a niye ní nya ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, jijɔ ɔmɛ a bwɔmi ɔ maa pee bo, nɛ o maa jua apletsi ɔmɛ kɛ he zugba; o ma na apletsi nyɔ nyu bɔ nɛ maa su o kɛ o we ɔ, kɛ o mawayi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.
Yayami peelɔ tuɔ fo be mi nɛ nɔ ko nyɛɛ we e se.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a peeɔ kã kaa jata.
Ma nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, pe a hii ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ tsakee nɔtonɔto kpamisa.
Se ma nɛ ní leli, kɛ nɔ́ sisi nuli hiɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, e maa si kpɛii.
Ohiatsɛ nɛ waa e nyɛmi ohiatsɛ yi mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa hiɔmi nɛ nɛɔ kpatakpata tlukaa kɛ kpataa niye ní hɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ bui mlaa a, e kɛ nimli yayamihi lɛ bɔɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e kɛ mɛ toɔ ní.
Yayami peeli nui dami sane yemi sisi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nuɔ sisi saminya.
Ohiatsɛ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e hi pe niatsɛ nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ dɛ.
Bi nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ kɛ jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ bɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e woɔ e fɔli zo.
Nɔ nɛ paa sika ha nɔ nɛ e heɔ hekpa babauu ɔ, pe e ngɛ e juetli ɔ nya buae kɛ ha nɔ nɛ naa ohiatsɛmɛ mɔbɔ.
Nɔ nɛ sume kaa e yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, ke e fa kue ha Mawu po, e bɔ musu.
Ke o sisi nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e ya pee yayami ɔ, muɔ nɛ o tsua ngɔ to ha lɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ o maa nɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ lɛɛ e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ɔ, e ma na hiɔwo kpakpa.
Niatsɛ buɔ e he ní lelɔ.
Se ohiatsɛ nɛ juɛmi ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e le bɔ nɛ niatsɛ ɔ ngɛ ha.
Ke nimli kpakpahi ye manye ɔ, nihi tsuo a bua jɔɔ a he.
Se ke nimli yayamihi a nine ya hiɔwe ɔ, nihi tsuo laa a he.
Nɔ nɛ laa e yayamihi a nɔ ɔ, e yɛ nɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ jajeɔ e he yayami, nɛ e kpaa yayami peemi ɔ, a maa na lɛ mɔbɔ.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye daa.
Se nɔmlɔ nɛ tue wa a, lɛɛ haomi maa ba e nɔ.
Matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ a nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae, aloo osisiblisi nɛ e hɛ mi wo la.
Nɔ yelɔ nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, yiwutsotsɛ kpanaku ji lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ sume níhi nɛ a naa kɛ guu sisimi blɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e se maa kɛ ngɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko pue nɔ ko muɔ si ɔ, e maa bɔ ko, nɛ e maa hi kpae hluu kɛ yaa si e hɛ mi ma kpata.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko na lɛ mɔbɔ.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a ma he e yi wami.
Se nɔ nɛ ní peemi níhi dɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa nɔ muɔ mi tlukaa.
Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ kɔni si wa a ma na niye ní babauu.
Se nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ yakayaka níhi a se ɔ, e we ohia maa kle.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ babauu.
Se nɔ nɛ he sɔɔ kɛ naa ní ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, ja a gbla e tue kɛ̃.
Nɔ hɛ mi hyɛmi hí.
Abolo bɔbɔyoo ko nɛ o kɛ maa wo nɔ ko nya mi ɔ ma ha nɛ nɔ ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ amlɔ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ mi sãã lɛ hlaa kaa e he maa sɔ kɛ na ní.
Se e li tete kaa hwɔɔ se ɔ, e ma ba ye ohia.
Nɔ nɛ kaa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ, pee se ɔ, e naa yi jemi kulaa pe nɔ nɛ kɛ munyu ngɔngɔɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi yi mi.
Nɔ nɛ juɔ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ, nɛ e deɔ ke tsa pi yayami ji lɔ ɔ, e kɛ ojo fialɔ ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti.
Nɔ nɛ hɛ tsuɔ ɔ, pɛ wolɔ ji lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e he kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, níhi a mi hii ha lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ heɔ e he yeɔ ɔ, kuasia ji lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ buɔ ní leli a munyu tue ɔ, e maa hi ha lɛ.
Nɔ nɛ kee ohiatsɛmɛ ní ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be lɛ hiae.
Nɔ nɛ naa ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ e maa e hɛngmɛ ɔ, nihi babauu maa gbiɛ lɛ.
Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, nihi laa a he.
Ke a kpa mɛ ɔ, ni kpakpahi ba yeɔ tsɛ ekohu.
Nɔ nɛ ke a ka e hɛ mi, nɛ e waa tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e maa ku kɛ pue si tlukaa, nɛ e be hie tsami.
Ke nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da ngɛ ma nɔ ye ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ a bua jɔɔ saminya; se ke nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ya pee yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔ, ma a yeɔ kɔmɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Bi nɛ nyaa nile he ɔ, e haa e fɔli bua jɔmi; se nɔ nɛ kɛ yaholi ya bɔɔ ɔ, e kpataa e weto ní hɛ mi.
Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ, e ma a yaa nɔ saminya; se nɔ nɛ heɔ nike ní pani nya ngɛ e ma mi bi a dɛ ɔ, e ywiaa ma a. Nɔ nɛ kɛ e nyɛmi tuɔ munyu dɔkɔbii ɔ, klama e ngɛ lɛ tsɔe ɔ nɛ.
Nɔmlɔ yaya a, lɛ nitsɛ e ní yayamihi lɛ peeɔ klama ha lɛ nɛ e duɔ; se nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛɛ pe e laa, nɛ e nyaa.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e le ohiatsɛmɛ a hiami níhi, se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ e juɛmi sui ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he kulaa.
Nihi nɛ yeɔ nɔ he fɛu woɔ pɛ ngɛ ma mi; se ní leli haa ma mi jɔɔ.
Ke ní lelɔ kɛ kuasia na sane ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kuasia peeɔ kɛkɛ ji kaa e hii kuɛe, nɛ e hii muɔe, nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo peeɔ hoo.
Muɔ si pueli sume nihi nɛ pee we yayami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hlaa kaa a ma kpata nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ da a hɛ mi.
Kuasia jeɔ e we abofu tsuo kpo; se ní lelɔ lɛɛ e toɔ e tsui si kɛ tsiɔ abofu nya.
Nɔ yelɔ nɛ lakpa munyu tue e buɔ ɔ, e tsɔli tsuo peeɔ yiwutsotsɛmɛ.
Ohiatsɛ kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ, a sɔ pɛ; mɛ tsuo ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ ha mɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ a kɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́.
Matsɛ nɛ ngɔɔ anɔkuale yemi kɛ yeɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ a sane ɔ, e tsɛ yemi ɔ se kɛɔ.
Ke a kɛ kpa tsɔse nɔ ɔ, e leɔ ní; se ke a ngmɛɛ jokuɛ je mi he ha lɛ ɔ, e pueɔ e nyɛ hɛ mi si.
Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ nɔ yee ɔ, a peeɔ yi wu tso níhi babauu ngɛ ma a mi.
Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da maa na yayami peeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si puemi ɔ. Tsɔse o bi saminya, nɛ o ma na yi jemi; nɛ o bua maa jɔ o he.
Ma nɛ kɛ e hɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ ɔ, e níhi peeɔ basaa.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.
Munyu babauu kɛkɛ tsɔse we tsɔlɔ; ejakaa e maa nu lɛɛ, se e be he ní tsue.
Hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha kuasia pe nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu puu.
Nɔ nɛ haa e tsɔlɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e biɔ lɛ be tsuaa be ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, tsɔlɔ ɔ mohu ba peeɔ wetsɛ.
Nɔ nɛ woɔ e mi mi la a, e woɔ pɛ.
Nɔ nɛ naa abofu peeɔ tɔmi babauu.
Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Nɔ nɛ kɛ julɔ ya dlaa ju ní ɔ, e he mi jɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ; e nuɔ kita nɛ a ka ngɛ nɔ́ ɔ he, se e peeɔ kɔ̃, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́ ko kɛ je e nya.
Ke o ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa gbeye yee ɔ, o naa haomi; se ke o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be o he sae.
Nihi babauu buɔ kaa a maa sa nɔ yelɔ hɛ mi; se Yawɛ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ha nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ yiwutsotsɛ sume nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da sane ɔ, jã kɛ̃ nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da hu sume yiwutsotsɛ sane.
Agur munyuhi Yake nɛ je Masa a, e binyumu Agur sɛ gbi nɛ e ngɔ ha Itiel kɛ Ukal ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Nyumu ɔ ke, “Mawu lee!
Peepee ta ye he oo, peepee ta ye he!
Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, i be nimlihi a kpɛti; i pe lohwe tete po.
Juɛmi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa yi mi ɔ, i be eko.
I kase we nile; Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu i li e he nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Mɛnɔ lɛ ya hiɔwe nɛ e kpale kɛ ba zugba hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ bua kɔɔhiɔ nya kɛ wo e dɛ mi hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ yɛ wo mi nyu ɔ tsuo kɛ wo bo mi, nɛ e fi nya hyɛ?
Aloo mɛnɔ lɛ ma buna ngɛ je ɔ mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ?
Kɛ a tsɛɔ lɛ kɛɛ?
E bi ɔ hu, mɛni ji e biɛ?
Tse o le?
“Ke Mawu wo si ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ.
Mawu ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ hlaa e se blɔ.
Koo ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ Mawu munyu ɔmɛ a he.
Ke o pee ja a, Mawu ma ka o hɛ mi, nɛ nihi tsuo maa na kaa lakpatsɛ ji mo.” Abɛ kpa komɛ Mawu, nɔ enyɔ i ngɛ mo bie nɛ o ha mi loko ma gbo.
Hyɛ nɛ ma ko ye lakpa.
Ko ha nɛ ma ná ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ ko ha nɛ ma ye ohia hulɔ; niye ní nɛ maa su mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ o ha mi.
Ke i na ní kpɔtɔɔ ɔ, ma kua mo, nɛ ma de ke, “Mɛnɔ kulaa ji Yawɛ nɛ ɔ?” Jã kɛ̃, ke i ye ohia a, ma ju, nɛ ma wo ye Mawu ɔ he mu.
Koo gbe tsɔlɔ he guɛ ha e nyɔmtsɛ.
Ke o pee ja a, tsɔlɔ ɔ maa gbiɛ mo, nɛ o hɛ mi ma pue si.
Ni komɛ gbiɛɔ a tsɛmɛ, nɛ a gbaa we a nyɛmɛ.
Ni komɛ buɔ a he kaa a he tsɔ, be mi nɛ a sɛ mu kpɔtɔɔ.
Ni komɛ woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a susuɔ kaa a hi tsɔ.
Ni komɛ sisiɔ ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ a kpɔɔ níhi ngɛ a dɛ.
Bɔ nɛ jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ kɛ yeɔ ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Malɛɛ ngɛ biyiwi enyɔ; a foɔ ya nɛ a deɔ ke, “Ha mi enɛ, ha mi enɛ!” E peeɔ nɔ́ etɛ nɛ a tɔɛ gblegbleegble.
Nɔ́ eywiɛ komɛ ngɛ nɛ mɛ hu a tɔɛ gblegbleegble: Ni gbogboehi a je, yo nɛ be bi, zugba nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́ ngɛ nɔ, kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ nine kpi he.
Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e tsɛ he guɛ, nɛ e bui e nyɛ ɔ, kuakualabitehi nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ma ta e hɛngmɛ, nɛ okpokuhi maa ye lɛ.
Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ komɛ peeɔ mi nyakpɛ nɛ ye juɛmi sui he: Kɔle nɛ ngɛ tee ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ bee; sinɔ nɛ ngɛ si sããe ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ, lɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ wo nɔ, kɛ nyumu kɛ yo a bɔmi.
Bɔ nɛ yo gba puɛlɔ ngɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e yeɔ ní nɛ e tsuɔ e nya he saminyayoo, nɛ e deɔ ke, “Oo, i tsa pee we yayami ko.” Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ je ɔ sume saasaa, nɛ e peeɔ je ɔ kaa e mimiɛ: Nyɔguɛ nɛ ba ngɛ matsɛ yee, kuasia nɛ ye ngma nɛ e tɔ, yo nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko sume lɛ, nɛ ba na gba, kɛ mawayo nɛ ba kpɔ gba ngɛ e nyɛ dɛ.
Nɔ́ eywiɛ komɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ a klee we saasaa, se a le ní saminya: Tatuhi; a he wɛ saasaa, se a buaa niye ní nya kɛ toɔ ngɛ latsa be mi.
Nyu mi kpihi; mɛ hu a be he wami ko, se a peeɔ a tsu ngɛ tɛ sahi a kpɛ.
Baalɛhi; a be matsɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nyɛɛɔ ngɛ kuuhi a mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Akɔtɔkuhi: o ma nyɛ nu akɔtɔku kɛ o nine, se kɛ̃ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a mɔhi a mi a naa mɛ ngɛ.
Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ komɛ ngɛ nɛ a nyɛɛmi ngɛ fɛu kɛ akɔnɔ: Jata: e he wa pe lohwehi tsuo, nɛ e yi lohwe ko lohwe ko gbeye.
Kungwɔ ku nɛ ngɛ si sie kɛ bee; to akpakpo, kɛ matsɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e ma hɛ mi kɛ ma.
Ke o ya je kuasia, nɛ o ya wo o he nɔ, aloo o ya to ga yayami ɔ, pee dii nɛ o susu o yi mi.
Ejakaa ke o fia nyɔ nyu ɔ, e peeɔ bɔta.
Ke o fia nɔ ko gugwɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e jeɔ muɔ.
Ke o wo nɔ ko mi mi la a, pɛ lɛ nyɛɛɔ se.
Munyuhi nɛ a kɛ slɔ matsɛ Munyuhi nɛ Matsɛ Lemuel, Masa matsɛ ɔ nyɛ kɛ tsɔse lɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: “Ye bi, i suɔ mo saminya.
I kpa o he pɛɛ ngɛ sɔlemi mi loko i ná mo nɛ i fɔ.
Mɛni munyu kpakpa sa mo pe enɛ ɔ?
Koo ngɔ o he wami kɛ ha yihi.
Matsɛmɛ tete po nɛ nyɛɛɔ yihi a se ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa.
Lemuel lee, anɔkuale mi ɔ, e sɛ matsɛmɛ, kɛ ma nɔ yeli kaa a nu wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa.
Ke a nu dã a, a hɛ maa je mlaa a nɔ, nɛ a ma plɛ nɔ́ nali a sane hɛ mi kɛ bu si.
Nyɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata a dã nɛ nya wa nɛ a nu; nɛ nyɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ aywilɛho nu mɛ ɔ hu wai.
Ke a nu ɔ, a hɛ maa je ohia nɔ, nɛ a be kɔmɔ yee hu.
“Tu munyu kɛ fa mumui he; ye awusahi tsuo a sane ha mɛ.
Tu munyu kɛ fa a he; ye dami sane.
Hyɛ nɔ́ nali, kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ saminya.” Yo kpakpa Yo kpakpa a, mɛnɔ ma na?
E he jua wa kulaa pe june!
E huno ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, nɛ e huno ɔ be ohia yee gblegbleegble.
Yo ɔ peeɔ e huno ɔ suɔmi nya ní; daa nɛ ɔ, e peeɔ lɛ kpakpa, pi yayami.
E hlaa to he bwɔmi kɛ doti kpa, nɛ e bua jɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ loɔ ɔ he.
E ya ngɔɔ niye ní kɛ jee tsitsaa kɛ baa kaa bɔ nɛ jua yelɔ ya ngɔɔ tlomi kɛ jee ma se lokoo kɛ baa a. E teɔ si makɛ mla, nɛ e hlaa niye ní ha e we mi bimɛ, nɛ e gbaa ní tsumi ha e mawayihi.
E hlaa zugba nɛ e heɔ.
E bɔɔ apaa nɛ a peeɔ wai ngmɔ ha lɛ.
E tsuɔ ní kpakpataa; e nine si wa kɛ ní tsumi.
E tsuɔ ní nyɔ mi tsuo; ejakaa e le kaa e ma na he se kokooko.
Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e tsɛ̃ɔ doti kpa, nɛ e kɛ loɔ bo.
E naa ohiatsɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e bɔleɔ nine kɛ haa nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ.
Ke fĩɛ be su ɔ, e yi tsui kaa fĩɛ maa ye e we mi bimɛ, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ kuutu tade.
Lɛ nitsɛ e loɔ e sa nɔ bo; nɛ e buɔ kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, kɛ bo nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su.
Ke ma nimeli kpe ɔ, a toɔ e huno ɔ he hɛ saminya ngɛ a kpɛti.
Yo ɔ kpɛɔ kploba tade nɛ e juaa; e juaa mi mi fimi níhi hu kɛ haa je juali.
Ke o na e he wami, kɛ e he fɛu ɔ, lɛɛ ja bo kpakpa nɛ nɔ kɛ dla e he.
E yi nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se gbeye.
Nile munyu sɔuu e tuɔ, nɛ a naa ngɛ e lilɛ nɔ kaa e mi mi jɔ.
E hyɛɔ nɛ e we mi bimɛ nɛ ba a je mi saminya; nɛ e sume hejɔ.
E huno, kɛ e bimɛ tsuo buɔ lɛ, nɛ a gbaa lɛ.
E huno ɔ jeɔ e yi ke, “Yihi babauu ngɛ nɛ bɔɔ mɔde mohu, se moo lɛɛ, o pe mɛ tsuo!” Hɛ mi nyami sisiɔ nɔ, nɛ he fɛu hu taa; se yo nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e sa kaa a je e yi.
Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ a he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je e yi ngɛ e ní tsumi ɔmɛ a he.
NYA TSƆƆMI Fiɛlɔ nguaa ko susumihi nɛ a bua nya lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Fiɛlɔ nɛ ɔ susuɔ e yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ e kpa si ji nɔmlɔ adesa wami ɔ, pi kaa e se kɛ we kɛkɛ, se ní komɛ baa nɛ ke o hyɛ ɔ, a kɛ adebɔ mlaa yɛ.
Hehi nɛ fiɛlɔ ɔ hyɛ blɔ kaa a maa ye dami sane ngɛ ɔ, e ya bɛ lɛ ja kulaa; e ya peeɔ nine mi wu jemi mohu.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ fiɛlɔ ɔ na a, nɔ́ nɛ e de kɛkɛ ji, “Wami he be se nami.” Mawu ɔ, nɛ lɛ e dɛ mi nimli adesahi tsuo a wami ngɛ ɔ, fiɛlɔ ɔ juɛmi sui e ní peemi níhi a he.
Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, ga nɛ fiɛlɔ ɔ woɔ ji kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ, konɛ níhi nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ, e ye, aloo e na a he bua jɔmi bɔ nɛ sa kɛ yaa si be nɛ e suɔ.
Ke o hyɛ ɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ fiɛlɔ ɔ munyu ɔmɛ ekomɛ piɛ bɔɔ; munyu ɔmɛ ekomɛ haa nɛ nɔ nine mi jeɔ wu.
Se e hi kaa womi nɛ ɔ hu ngɛ Baiblo ɔ mi; ejakaa e deɔ wɔ níhi babauu ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa wami si himi he, kpakpa kɛ yayami tsuo.
Nihi babauu ngɔɔ womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ kɛ toɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wami si himi he kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ hyɛɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi ɔ. Ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, Mawu haa wɔ hɛ nɔ kami ko.
E haa nɛ wa nuɔ wami nɛ ɔ sisi saminya pe bɔ nɛ wa susu kaa wa le ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Anɛ se nami ko ngɛ wami he lo?

Wami he be se nami David bi, fiɛlɔ nguaa a nɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke, wami nɛ ɔ, se nami ko be he; wami he be se nami.
Lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka!
Dengme tsuo nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa gboɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛni se e naa?
Yi nɔhi baa, nɛ a beɔ kɛ yaa.
Se je ɔ lɛɛ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e ngɛ; jã kɛ̃ lɛ e maa hi kɛ maa ya neneene.
Pu teɔ si nɛ e nɔɔ si, nɛ e he sɔɔ kɛ yaa he nɛ e te si kɛ je ɔ ekohu.
Kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ yaa leneyi je, nɛ e lɔgɔɔ si kɛ yaa omleyi je.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɔɔhiɔ hii si bɔlee hluu kɛ ya suu be nɛ e kpaleɔ kɛ baa he nɛ e fia kɛ je ɔ ekohu.
Pahi tsuo bee kɛ ya sɛɛ wo mi, se wo hyi we gblegbleegble.
Pa amɛ kpaleɔ a se kɛ yaa he nɛ a je ɔ, nɛ a bee kɛ yaa wo ɔ mi ekohu.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ peeɔ pɔtɔ kɛ yaka nɛ hi kalemi; nɔ́ hyɛmi kɛ munyu tumi gbi nɔ nya.
Nɔ́ he ko be je ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ba hyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ maa ba ekohu.
Nɔ́ nɛ a pee hyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu a maa pee ekohu.
Anɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ nɔ́ he lo?
Dɛbi!
Jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ kɛ je blema, loko a fɔ wɔ tete po.
Níhi nɛ be ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kaii we hu.
Jã kɛ̃, níhi nɛ maa ba kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ, mɛ hu a be kaie.
Fiɛlɔ nguaa a kpa je mi níhi si Imi fiɛlɔ ɔ, i hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ.
I bɔ mɔde kaa níhi tsuo nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma ngɔ ye nile ɔ kɛ hla mi fitsofitso.
Ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha nɔmlɔ adesa ke e tsu ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, haomi sɔuu; pi ní tsumi nɛ ngɔɔ.
Níhi tsuo nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i na; nɛ i ngɛ dee ke lɛ tsuo yaka.
E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ kpɛ̃ ɔ, e hí dami; nɔ́ nɛ bé ɔ, e hí kanemi.
I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “I pee nɔmlɔ nguaa.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ye Yerusalem ma a nɔ kɛ sɛ ye hlami ɔ, i le ní kulaa pe mɛ.
Ee, nile ɔ, i kpa lɛ si saminya.” I bɔ mɔde kaa ma hla slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nile kɛ godo, aloo nile kɛ kuasia jemi a kpɛti.
Se i na kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
Ní lemi fuu ɔ, haomi sɔuu lɛ ngɛ mi.
Ke nɔ ko le ní babauu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ e haomi hu hiɛ babauu.
I to kaa ma fiɛ ye yi nɔ saminya, nɛ ma hyɛ kaa nɔ́ ko ngɛ bua jɔmi mi lo.
Se i na kaa enɛ ɔ hu peeɔ yaka gu.
I kpa si kaa muɔmi ɔ, godo, nɛ bua jɔmi hu se nami be he.
Ngɛ ye ní lemi ɔ kulaa se ɔ, i pee ye yi mi kaa ma nu dã, nɛ ma fiɛ, konɛ ye nɔ gbagba nɛ te.
I susu kaa nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɛ sa nɔmlɔ adesa peemi ngɛ je mi e wami be ɔ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I pee ní nguanguahi.
I ma tsuhi, nɛ i pee wai ngmɔhi.
I pee ngmɔhi kɛ abɔɔhi, nɛ i du tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii slɔɔtohi ngɛ mi.
I gba nyu dɔhi nɛ i kɛ haa tso ɔmɛ nyu.
I he nyɔguɛhi babauu, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo; nɛ a fɔ nyɔguɛhi babauu kɛ wo ye we ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ se hu, i ngɛ nahi kɛ tohi babauu pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
I bua sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu nya, nɛ i tsu tó ngɛ matsɛmɛ a dɛ, kɛ ye nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ.
Nyumuhi kɛ yihi babauu la kɛ jɔɔ ye bua, nɛ i ngɔ yihi babauu bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ.
Niinɛ, i pee nɔmlɔ nguaa, nɛ i he biɛ kulaa pe nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami ngɛ Yerusalem; ye nile ɔ hu se pui gblegbleegble.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae ɔ, i naa.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee ɔ, i peeɔ; i tsi we ye nya kɛ ji bua jɔmi ko he.
Ní tsumi nɛ he wa po, i naa he bua jɔmi.
Niinɛ, kikɛmɛ a bua jɔmi nɛ ɔ pɛ ji ye se nami ngɛ dengme tsuo nɛ i gbo ɔ he.
Jehanɛ, i susu ye nine nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo a he, kɛ dengme nɛ i gbo ngɛ a he ɔ, nɛ i na kaa lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka.
E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ; se nami ko be he.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nihi nɛ sɛ e hlami pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛ hu e maa pee.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i bɔni nile, godo, kɛ kuasia jemi a he susumi saminya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i na kaa nile hi pe kuasia jemi kaa bɔ nɛ la hi pe diblii ɔ. Ní lelɔ le he nɛ e yaa; kuasia lɛɛ e li.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, amanehlu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ baa mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “Haomi nɛ maa ba kuasia nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ maa ba imi hu ye nɔ.
Lɛɛ ye nile babauu ɔ, mɛni se i na ngɛ he mɔ?” I he nɔ ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e he be se nami.” Ní lelɔ ɔ, nɔ ko kaii we lɛ daa; kuasia hu, jã kɛ̃.
Be bɔɔ kɛkɛ nihi a hɛ je mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Ní lelɔ gboɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kuasia gboɔ; slɔɔto be mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, je mi si himi ba gbe ye nya, ejakaa níhi nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, ekoeko sɛ́ ye hɛ mi.
Lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka, kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
Dengme babauu nɛ i gbo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i pa sume hu; ejakaa i le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ i bua nya a, ma si kɛ ha nɔ nɛ ma ba ye ye ní ɔ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee ní lelɔ oo, e ma ba pee kuasia oo, mɛnɔ lɛ le?
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, níhi tsuo nɛ i ngɔ nile kɛ gbo a he dengme ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nɛ ma ba ye.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ba pia ye he kaa i tsu ní wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa be komɛ ɔ, nɔ ko maa ngɔ nile, kɛ ga kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma si ha nɔ ko nɛ gbo we nɔ́ ɔ he dengme ko kulaa nɛ e ba ye.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka dengme, kɛ yayami agbo.
Haomi nɛ baa nɔmlɔ nɔ, kɛ dengme babauu nɛ e gboɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛni se lɛ e naa?
Níhi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsuɔ e wami be ɔ tsuo peeɔ haomi kɛ kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu.
Nyɔ mi po e juɛmi ha we lɛ he jɔmi.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.
Lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa adesa peemi ji kaa e ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi kɛ je e dengme gbomi ɔ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i na kaa enɛ ɔ hu je Mawu ngɔ.
Ke pi Mawu he ɔ, mɛnɔ maa ye ní, nɛ mɛnɔ ma na bua jɔmi?
Nihi nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu haa mɛ nile, ga, kɛ bua jɔmi.
Se yayami peeli lɛɛ, e haa a tsuɔ ní, nɛ a buaa níhi a nya, konɛ e ngɔ ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ lɛ, Mawu ɔ suɔmi nya ní.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ e be Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ e be.
Fɔmi be ngɛ, nɛ gbenɔ be ngɛ; ní dumi be ngɛ, nɛ ní kpami be ngɛ.
Be ngɛ nɛ a gbee; nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a tsaa.
Be ngɛ nɛ a kuɔ nɔ́ pueɔ si, nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a maa.
Ya fomi be ngɛ, nɛ muɔmi be ngɛ.
Kɔmɔ yemi be ngɛ, nɛ domi be ngɛ.
Be ngɛ nɛ a sakee tɛhi ngɔ pueɔ he, nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a buaa tɛhi a nya.
Be ngɛ nɛ a fuaa nɔ atuu, nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a fua we nɔ atuu.
Be ngɛ nɛ a hlaa nɔ́, nɛ be ngɛ nɛ nɔ́ laa.
Be ngɛ nɛ a baa nɔ́ yi, nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a sakee nɔ́ kɛ fɔɔ he.
Be ngɛ nɛ a híaa nɔ́, nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a kpɛɔ nɔ́.
Dii peemi be ngɛ, nɛ munyu tumi be ngɛ.
Suɔmi be ngɛ, nɛ nɔ nyɛmi be ngɛ.
Ta be ngɛ, nɛ tue mi jɔmi be ngɛ.
Ní tsulɔ ɔ, mɛni se e naa kɛ jee e dengme gbomi ɔ mi?
Ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ Mawu ha nɔmlɔ ke e tsu ɔ, i na.
E peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ saminyayoo ngɛ e be mi.
E ha nɔmlɔ juɛmi nɛ e kɛ leɔ níhi nɛ be momo, kɛ níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, lɛ Mawu ɔ ní tsumi kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ juɛmi sui he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na kaa be abɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ sa lɛ peemi pɛ ji kaa e nya, nɛ e na bua jɔmi.
E sa kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye ní, nɛ e nu ní; nɛ e na bua jɔmi kɛ je níhi nɛ e gbo a he dengme ɔ mi.
Mawu nike ní ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
I le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ɔ maa hi si kɛ ya neneene; a be nyɛe nɛ a ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ he, loo a je nɔ́ ko ngɛ mi.
Mawu lɛ pee jã, konɛ a ye lɛ gbeye.
Nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ba hyɛ; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ, e ba hyɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ be momo ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu ngɔɔ kɛ baa ekohu.
Amimi yemi ngɛ je mi Jehanɛ hu, i kpa si kaa ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, he nɛ sa kaa a ye dami sane, nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ ɔ, yi wu tso níhi mohu lɛ a peeɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “Mawu maa kojo dalɔ kɛ yayami peelɔ tsuo, ejakaa a to be kɛ ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi.” Nɔ́ nɛ i de ngɛ ye yi mi ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ji kaa Mawu ngɛ nimli adesahi kae nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa slɔɔto be a kɛ lohwehi a kpɛti.
Nɔ́ nɛ peeɔ nɔmlɔ adesa a, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ peeɔ lohwe; nɔmlɔ gboɔ, nɛ lohwe hu gboɔ.
Mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ mɛ tsuo a muɔ.
Nɔmlɔ pi lohwe ngɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɔ; ejakaa nɔmlɔ wami jio, lohwe wami jio, lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka.
Mɛ tsuo he kake ɔ lɛ a yaa; mɛ tsuo zu mi lɛ a je, nɛ zu mi lɛ mɛ tsuo a maa kpale kɛ ya.
Mɛnɔ lɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ adesa mumi ɔ yaa hiɔwe, se lohwe lɛɛ e mumi ɔ, zu mi lɛ e yaa?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na kaa nɔ́ pɛ nɛ sa nɔmlɔ peemi ji kaa níhi nɛ e gbo a he dengme ɔ, e na a he bua jɔmi; e blɔ fa mi níhi ji lɔ ɔmɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ nɔ ko gbenɔ se ɔ, blɔ ko be nɛ e kɛ maa le.
Jehanɛ se hu, i na kaa yi mi sɔuu lɛ a ngɛ wae ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ nali ngɛ ya foe, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa jɔɔ a bua.
Bua wolɔ ko be mɛ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, he wami ngɛ a dɛ.
I susu kaa nihi nɛ gbo ɔ, a nɔ́ hi pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ.
Se ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ po a se ɔ, nihi nɛ a nɔ́ hi pe kulaa ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a fɔ we mɛ lolo, nɛ mɛɛ a nɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ. Jehanɛ, i na kaa nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ nihi gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ konɛ a ya nɔ ɔ ji kaa a hɛ kɔɔ a nyɛmimɛ a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
Kuasia buaa e ninehi a nya kɛ woɔ e gblɛɛ mi, nɛ e gboɔ kɛ hwɔ.
Se afani nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo nɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he pe nɛ o kɛ o nine enyɔ ma gbo yaka dengme kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
I na nɔ́ kpa ko hu ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ji yaka dengme gbomi.
Hyɛ kaa nɔ ko lɛ ngɛ.
E be bi; e be nyɛmi ko; lɛ nɔ kake ngmelu pɛ lɛ ngɛ.
Se daa nɛ ɔ, dengme nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ; e ní nɛ e na a pi ha lɛ.
E bi we e he hyɛ ke dengme babauu nɛ e ngɛ gboe nɛ e yi e mi ngɔɔmi ko ɔ, mɛnɔ kulaa lɛ e ngɛ jamɛ a dengme ɔ gboe ha.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ ko; dengme gbomi gu nɛ bua jɔmi be mi.
Ke ni enyɔ bua kɛ tsu ní ɔ, e hi pe nɔ kake nɛ ma tsu ní; ejakaa a náá a dengme gbomi ɔ he se.
Ke nɔ kake nɔ si ɔ, nɔ kake ma wo e nɔ.
Se ke nɔ kake ngmelu lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e nɔ si ɔ, kɛkɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ pee lɛ; ejakaa nɔ ko be nɛ ma wo e nɔ.
Jehanɛ, fĩɛ be, ke ni enyɔ hwɔ si ɔ, a he mi dɔɔ la.
Se nɔ kake ngmelu ɔ, kɛ lɛɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e he mi maa dɔ la?
Ke nɔ ko ba tua ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ma bla kɛ wo e he, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ.
Se ke nɔ kake a ba tua ja a, e be nyɛe ma fa e he.
Kpa nɛ a tslɔ hɛ si etɛ ɔ, e tsɔ we mla.
-Niheyo ohiatsɛ nɛ le ní ɔ, e hi hluu pe nɔkɔtɔma kuasia nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee, nɛ́ jehanɛ hu e bui ga womi tue.
I ba bɔni nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a he susumi, nɛ i ba na niheyo ko ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti nɛ ma ba ye matsɛ ɔ se.
Nihi nɛ matsɛ ɔ yeɔ a nɔ ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu; a hí kanemi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nihi nɛ maa ba ngɛ e se ɔ, a be e yi jee.
Niinɛ, enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
O he ko sɔ kɛ wo Mawu si Ke o yaa Mawu we ɔ, hyɛ o he nɔ saminya.
E hi kaa o ma ya kase ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ o ma ya sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kuasiahi peeɔ ɔ; ejakaa a li kaa a ngɛ yayami pee.
Ke o maa tu munyu ko ɔ, mo susu he; o he ko sɔ kɛ wo Mawu si.
Mawu ɔ, hiɔwe lɛ e ngɛ; moo lɛɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ o ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo tu munyu fuu.
Haomi babauu kɛ dekla, aloo nlami basabasa baa; nɛ munyu fuu a kɛ yoɔ kuasia gbi.
Ke o wo Mawu si ɔ, ko ha nɛ e kɛ loko o ye nɔ; ejakaa Mawu na we kuasiahi a he bua jɔmi.
Ye o siwo ɔ nɔ.
Afani nɛ o wui si kulaa, pe kaa o maa wo si, nɛ o be nɔ yee.
Ko ha nɛ mo nitsɛ o nya mi munyu nɛ bu mo fɔ, nɛ o ba ye pɔpu, nɛ o de Mawu we osɔfo ɔ ke o nɔ́ be mi.
Mɛni he je lɛ o ma ha nɛ Mawu mi mi nɛ fu mo?
Níhi nɛ o gbo a he dengme ɔ, mɛni he je o ma ha nɛ Mawu nɛ kpata a hɛ mi?
Nlami babauu kɛ munyu fuu ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi; lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka.
Moo lɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye.
Wami he be se nami Ke o na nɛ a ngɛ ohiatsɛ yi mi wae, aloo a plɛ sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ a kojo we ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ ngɛ zugba ko nɔ ɔ, e ko pee mo nyakpɛ kulaa.
Tsɔli nɛ ngɛ ma a nya, kɛ je nɔ wayoo pe kulaa nɔ kɛ ya si nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɔ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ he nɔ́ ko.
Zugba a he se nami ɔ tsuo ba peeɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́.
Jehanɛ se hu, ngmɔ ko ngmɔ ko be nɛ a tsu we tó ngɛ he.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ sika a, sika tɔɛ lɛ; nɔ nɛ suɔ nɛ e na ní ɔ, ní babauu gbi e nya.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.
He nɛ ní babauu ngɛ ɔ, ní yeli hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɛɛ se nami nɛ niatsɛ ɔ naa pɛ ji kaa e le kaa nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ.
Apaatsɛ ɔ, e ye ní bɔɔ jio, e ye fuu jio, e hwɔɔ mahe bɔ nɛ sa.
Se niatsɛ lɛɛ e ní babauu ɔ ha we nɛ e hwɔɔ mahe.
Nɔ́ yayami ko hu nɛ i na ngɛ je ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nihi buaa sika babauu nya, nɛ e ba peeɔ haomi ha mɛ.
Tlukaa a, matahu ba poɔ mɛ, nɛ sika a tsuo hɛ mi kpataa.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko pa píɛ nɛ a ma si ha a bimɛ.
Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko je e nyɛ muklii mi kɛ ba dɛ gu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ e maa kpale kɛ ya.
Dengme tsuo nɛ e ba gbo ɔ, e be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hɛɛe ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ya.
Sane nɛ ɔ he wa!
Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ba a, jã e maa kpale kɛ ya.
Lɛɛ mɛni se e na mɔ, kaa e ba gbo yaka dengme?
Nɔmlɔ wami be ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa diblii mi nyɛɛmi; kɔmɔ yemi, mi mi fumi, nine mi wu jemi, kɛ hiɔ sɔuu.
Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i na kaa e hi, nɛ e sa kɛkɛ ji kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi.
Wami be bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha nɔmlɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, dengme tsuo nɛ e gbo ɔ, e ye e mi ngɔɔmi; e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ sika, ní babauu, he wami, kɛ bua jɔmi ɔ, e na Mawu si; e na bua jɔmi ngɛ dengme nɛ e ngɛ gboe ɔ he.
Mawu nike ní ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Akɛnɛ Mawu haa lɛ bua jɔmi daa he je ɔ, e pa be e he haoe kɛ kane e wami ligbi ɔmɛ hu.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ i na nɛ hí, nɛ haoɔ nimli ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mawu ma ha nɔ ko sika, kɛ ní babauu, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ɔ tsui suɔ.
Se e ha we lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ye ngɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nɔ kpa mohu ma ba ye.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ji yaka dengme gbomi, kɛ he hiami.
Ke nɔ ko fɔ bimɛ lafa, nɛ e ye jeha babauu, se e yi je mi ngɔɔmi, nɛ jehanɛ se hu, benɛ e gbo ɔ, a pu we lɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, lɛɛ afani bi nɛ gbo loko a fɔ lɛ ngɛ jamɛatsɛ ɔ he.
Bimwɔyo nɛ ɔ fɔmi peeɔ yaka dengme; e laa ngɛ diblii mi, nɛ nihi a hɛ jeɔ e nɔ.
E nɛ́ pu hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko hu e li.
Se e ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi kulaa pe nɔ nɛ ye jeha akpe enyɔ, se je mi ngɔɔmi lɛɛ e yi eko ɔ. Mɛ tsuo pi he kake ɔ ko nɛ a yaa lo?
Dengme tsuo nɛ nɔmlɔ ngɛ gboe ɔ, e nya mi ngma kɛkɛ he lɛ e ngɛ gboe ngɛ.
Se kɛ̃, e tɔɛ gblegbleegble.
Mɛni ní lelɔ kɛ pe kuasia?
Ohiatsɛ nɛ le e he nɔ hyɛmi ngɛ je mi ɔ, mɛni se lɛ e naa?
E hi kaa o bua nɛ jɔ nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ he, pe kaa daa nɛ ɔ, o ko suɔ nɛ o na nɔ́ kpa mohu.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.
E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba a, a de to momo.
Wɔ tsuo wa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ he wa pe lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ nɔɛ kunɔ.
Munyu fuu ɔ, se nami be he.
Mɛnɔ lɛ le nɔ́ nɛ hi ha nɔmlɔ ngɛ e wami be bɔɔ nɛ ɔ mi?
Nɔmlɔ wami pi nɔ́ ko kulaa; e ngɛ kaa nini nɛ bee kɛ yaa.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de nɔ ko nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ je ɔ mi ngɛ e gbenɔ se?
Susumi komɛ nɛ kɔɔ wami he Biɛ kpakpa hi pe nu je via nɛ he jua wa.
Ligbi nɛ o gbo ɔ hi pe ligbi nɛ a fɔ mo.
E hi kaa o maa ya we mi he nɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ngɛ, pe kaa o maa ya he nɛ a tsɛ ní yemi ngɛ.
Ejakaa e hia kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a kai be tsuaa be kaa gbenɔ ji wɔ tsuo wa nyagbe.
Kɔmɔ yemi hi pe muɔmi.
Ke o hɛ mi pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ ɔ, o leɔ ní.
Daa nɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ ngɛ gbenɔ he susue, se kuasia lɛɛ e susumi pɛ ji bua jɔmi.
E hi kaa ní lelɔ ma ka o hɛ mi, pe kaa kuasia ma je o yi.
Ke kuasia ngɛ muɔe ɔ, e ngɛ kaa mio nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ la mi.
Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.
Amimi yemi haa ní lelɔ peeɔ kuasia, nɛ nyɔ mi ní hemi puɛɔ nɔ je mi bami.
Nyagbe hi pe sisije.
Tsui si tomi hi pe he nɔ womi.
Hyɛ nɛ o mi mi ko fu mlamlaamla, ejakaa kuasia lɛ ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ toɔ e tsui mi.
Ko bi ke, “Mɛni he je blema ngɔɔ pe mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ?” Tsa pi nile gbi ji lɔ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e sa kaa e le ní.
Ejakaa nile ngɛ kaa weto ní; e he ngɛ se nami kaa bɔ nɛ sika ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nile faa nɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ sika faa nɔ he ɔ. Nile haa nɛ nɔ yeɔ e he.
Hyɛ Mawu nine nya ní tsumi!
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ha nɛ e kpɛ̃ ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa pee lɛ nɛ e da?
Ke níhi a mi hi ha mo ɔ, nya.
Ke haomi ba hu, kai kaa Mawu lɛ pee bua jɔmi ɔ kɛ haomi ɔ tsuo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ko le nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.
Ye wami be ɔ he be se nami ko lɛɛ, se níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, i le.
E pɔɔ mi bami kaa dalɔ hɛ mi kpataa, be mi nɛ yayami peelɔ mohu wami se kɛɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo pee o he dalɔ, aloo ní lelɔ tsɔ.
Mɛni he je lɛ o ma kpata mo nitsɛ o hɛ mi?
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o yi mi ko wa tsɔ, nɛ o ko je kuasia hulɔ.
Mɛni he je o ma gbo nɛ́ o be sui lolo ɔ?
E hi kaa o maa pɛtɛ ga womi nɛ ɔ he nɛ o be he ngmɛɛe.
Nɔ nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ɔ, e maa ye manye kɛ̃.
Nile woɔ ní lelɔ he wami kulaa pe ma nɔ yeli nyɔngma nɛ ngɛ ma ko mi.
Niinɛ, dalɔ ko dalɔ ko be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ kpakpa daa nɛ ɔ, nɛ lɛɛ e pee we yayami gblegbleegble.
Koo bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nihi ngɛ dee ɔ tue, nɛ́ o ko ba nu kaa o tsɔlɔ ngɛ mo gbiɛe.
Mo nitsɛ o le ngɛ o tsui mi kaa behi fuu ɔ, mo hu o gbiɛɛ ni komɛ.
Nile lɛ i kɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo si.
I to ye yi mi kaa ma kase ní, nɛ ma le ní.
Se e ya yɛ nya.
Kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ le bɔ nɛ wami ngɛ ha kɛɛ?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ?
Wa juɛmi sui he.
Jehanɛ, i ba bɔni ní kasemi, kɛ níhi a si kpami.
I pee ye yi mi kaa ma na nile, nɛ ma na ye ní bimi ɔmɛ a heto.
Nɔ́ nɛ i na ji kaa yi mi wami ɔ, e ji kuasia jemi, nɛ biɛmi hu godo.
Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ i na nɛ dooɔ pe gbenɔ ji yo nɛ e tsui mi ngɛ kaa klama nɛ a tsɔ, aloo ya nɛ a wo nɛ a kɛ maa du nɔ.
E nine ngɛ kaa kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ a kɛ maa wo nɔ.
Nyumu nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ maa je e dɛ mi.
Se yayami peelɔ lɛɛ yo ɔ nine maa su e nɔ.
-Fiɛlɔ ɔ ke, benɛ i kpa níhi a si hluu nɛ e yɛ nya a, i ba bɔni níhi a he susumi kakaaka; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i na ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ngɛ nyumuhi akpe a kpɛti ɔ, i na nɔ kake nɛ bu ngɛ e he, se yihi akpe a kpɛti lɛɛ i nɛ nɔ ko kaa jã.
Nɔ́ nɛ i na kɛkɛ ji kaa Mawu bɔ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e hi si saminya, se nɔmlɔ ba kase gɔdɔgɔdɔ si himi.
Mɛnɔ kɛ ní lelɔ sɔ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ le níhi a sisi tsɔɔmi kɛ lɛ sɔ?
Nile haa nɛ nɔ muɔɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ e hɛ mi kɛ haa nɔ.
Bu matsɛ tue Ye matsɛ mlaa a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o ka Mawu kita ke o maa pee ɔ. Matsɛ ma nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e mi mi fu ɔ, jee e hɛ mi esɔ!
Ke matsɛ tu munyu ɔ, he wami ngɛ se.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de matsɛ ke, “Mɛni lɛ o pee nɛ ɔ?” Nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, haomi bɛ e nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ le ní ɔ, e le be nɛ sa, kɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ e maa gu kɛ bu tue.
Ejakaa be nɛ sa, kɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nɔ́ ngɛ.
Se akɛnɛ nɔmlɔ adesa li he je ɔ, e ba peeɔ haomi ha lɛ.
Wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.
Mɛnɔ lɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko maa ba?
Nɔmlɔ adesa be he wami ngɛ e mumi nɔ; nɛ e be he wami ngɛ e gbenɔ be nɔ.
Gbenɔ ngɛ kaa ta; nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tu nya fo.
Yi wu tso ní peemi be nyɛe ma he nɔ ko yi wami.
Yayami peeli kɛ dali I na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, be mi nɛ i ngɛ níhi nɛ nimli adesahi peeɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a he susue.
Ni komɛ ngɔɔ blɔ nya nɛ a na a kɛ yeɔ a nyɛmimɛ awi.
Jehanɛ, i na yayami peeli komɛ nɛ ke pee ɔ, a baa he klɔuklɔu ɔ. Benɛ a gbo nɛ a ya pu mɛ ɔ, a huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ je a yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a bɔni a yi jemi mohu ngɛ ma mi he nɛ a pee yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu dɛ.
Mɛni he je lɛ nihi a he sɔɔ kɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ?
Ejakaa a gbla we a tue ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Yayami peelɔ peeɔ yayami si lafa, nɛ e gbo we.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i le kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye anɔkuale mi ɔ, e hii ha mɛ.
Yayami peeli lɛɛ e be hie ha mɛ gblegbleegble.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a wami ngɛ kaa nini.
A se kɛ we ngɛ je mi, ejakaa a yi Mawu gbeye.
Nɔ́ yayami ko nɛ yaa nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Be komɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ yayami peeli a tue gblami kɛ haa dali, nɛ a kɛ dali a ní kpakpahi a he hiɔwo mohu haa yayami peeli.
I ngɛ dee ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu dɛ blɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na kaa e sa kaa nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ na bua jɔmi; ejakaa nɔ́ ko pa be je nɛ ɔ mi ha lɛ, pe kaa e ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi.
Ke nɔmlɔ ngɛ dengme gboe ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, ngɛ wami bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e ma nyɛ maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ i hla kaa ma le ní, nɛ ma na níhi nɛ yaa nɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i naa kaa o ma nyɛ maa hi si nyɔ kɛ pia nɛ mahe hwɔmi be mi.
Se ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɛ tsue ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ be nya nae gblegbleegble.
Ke o gbo dengme hluu po, o be nya nae.
Ní leli nɛ e peeɔ mɛ kaa mɛɛ a le ɔ, mɛ po a nɛ nya.
I ba susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he saminya, nɛ i na kaa níhi nɛ dali, kɛ ní leli peeɔ ɔ, Mawu le he nɔ́ ko; suɔmi kɛ nyɛmi po, nɔmlɔ adesa be a nɔ he wami.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ ma.
Sane nɛ maa ba nɔ kake nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ maa ba nɔ kpa hu nɔ; dalɔ jio, yayami peelɔ jio; nɔmlɔ kpakpa jio, nɔmlɔ yayami jio; nɔ nɛ he tsɔ jio, nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we jio; nɔ nɛ sãã bɔ jio, nɔ nɛ sɛ̃ bɔ jio; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nɔ kake nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ maa ba nɔ kpa hu nɔ.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami peelɔ ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti; kita kalɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ sume kaa e ma ka kita hu, jã nɔuu.
Níhi nɛ dɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a kpɛti kake ji kaa haomi baa nihi tsuo a nɔ fiee nɛ slɔɔto be mi; dali jio, yayami peeli jio.
Daa nɛ ɔ, yayami kɛ godo hyi nimli adesahi a tsui mi ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ a gbo tlukaa.
Se nɔ nɛ piɛɔ hɛ kali a he ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha lɛ.
Ejakaa gbe hɛ ngmengmle hi pe jata gbogboe.
Niinɛ, nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ le kaa a ma ba gbo; ni gbogboe ɔmɛ lɛɛ a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Hiɔwo kpa ko hu a be; ejakaa nihi a hɛ je a nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
A gbo kɛ a suɔmi, ninyɛ, kɛ hɛkɔ ɔ tsuo.
Níhi nɛ yaa nɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a pa be mi nɛ a peeɔ hu.
Yaa nɛ o ya ye ní, nɛ o na bua jɔmi.
Yaa nu wai, nɛ o tsui nɛ nɔ o mi; o ní tsumi ɔ sa Mawu hɛ mi momo.
Wo tade hiɔ be tsuaa be, nɛ o ko ha nɛ nu nɛ ta o yi mi.
Be bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha mo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, o kɛ o yo nɛ o suɔ lɛ saminya a, nyɛɛ ye e mi ngɔɔmi.
Daa ligbi nɛ nɔ́ ko be mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mle.
Ejakaa dengme tsuo nɛ o ngɛ gboe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o ma na kɛ je mi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ, tsu kɛ o he wami tsuo.
Ejakaa gbeje, he nɛ o maa ya hwɔɔ se ɔ, ní tsumi, loo yi mi susumi, loo nile, loo ga be lejɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ kake hu nɛ i na ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ji: tsa pi nihi nɛ le fo tumi wawɛɛ ji nihi nɛ yeɔ kekleekle blɔ he be tsuaa be; pi katsɛmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ngɛ ta mi daa.
Pi ní leli tsuo a dɛ nɛ niye ní ngɛ; pi juɛmitsɛmɛ tsuo ji matsɛmɛ, nɛ gali hu, pi mɛ tsuo nɛ a hɛ mi baa nyami.
Haomi baa mɛ tsuo a nɔ fiee.
Nɔmlɔ adesa li e be.
Be yayami ba naa nɔ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ lo duɔ ya, aloo kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ duɔ klama a. Nile kɛ kuasia jemi Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ i na ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a buu nile ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma wayoo ko hi si kɛ e mi nimli bɔɔ pɛ.
Be ko ɔ, matsɛ nguaa ko ba tua ma a. E sa ma a yi, nɛ e fia kpoku kɛ bɔle ma a. Nyumu ko ngɛ ma a mi.
Nɔ́ ko be e dɛ lɛɛ, se e le ní bɔ nɛ e kɛ e nile ɔ he ma a yi wami.
Se nɔ ko nɔ ko susuu we e he.
I deɔ daa ke nile hi pe he wami.
Se nɔ ko bui ohiatsɛ ní lelɔ; e nya mi munyu po a bui tue.
Ní lelɔ munyu blɛuu ngɔɔ ngɛ tue mi pe ngmlaa nɛ nɔ yelɔ ko kpaa ngɛ kuasiahi a kpɛti.
Nile hi pe ta hwumi níhi.
Se yayami peelɔ kake kpataa ní kpakpahi babauu a hɛ mi.
Anunu gbogboe haa nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via jeɔ fu.
Jã kɛ̃ kuasia jemi bɔɔ gbeɔ nile kɛ hɛ mi nyami a he guɛ.
Ní lelɔ suɔmi nya ní ji kaa e pee kpakpa daa; se kuasia lɛɛ e suɔ kaa e pee nɔ́ yayami.
Ke kuasia ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ɔ, e ní peepee yeɔ e he odase kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kaa kuasia ji lɛ.
Ke o nɔ yelɔ mi mi fu mo ɔ, koo je o ní tsumi he ɔ; he si bami gbeɔ sanehi nɛ he wa a nya la.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ i na ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ dɛ, nɛ matsɛmɛ kɛ nɔ yeli pɔɔ peemi ji kaa a haa kuasiahi blɔ he nguanguahi, nɛ niatsɛmɛ mohu hii sisi je.
I naa tsɔli ngɛ okpɔngɔhi a nɔ, be mi nɛ ganɔhi mohu ngɛ zugba nyɛɛe.
Nɔ nɛ tsuaa muɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ maa nɔ mi; nɔ nɛ gbaa piɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ sinɔ maa kɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ywiaa tɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ tɛ plaa; nɔ nɛ gbaa lɛ́ ɔ, lɛ nɛ lɛ́ plaa.
Ke o dade nya gbo, nɛ o duɔ we nya a, ja o kɛ o he wami tsu ní wawɛɛ.
Se nile haa nɛ nɔ toɔ ga kpakpa.
Ke sinɔ maa kɔ kunya yelɔ kekle loko e maa wo sinɔ ɔ hɛ mi kunya a, mɛni e ma na?
Ní lelɔ nya mi munyu haa nɛ e hɛ mi baa nyami.
Se kuasia kɛ e munyu kpataa lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi.
E jeɔ sisi kɛ kuasia munyu tumi, nɛ e gbeɔ nya kɛ godo.
Kuasia tuɔ munyu babauu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko li hwɔɔ se sane; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ wa gbenɔ se ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de?
Kuasia gboɔ yaka dengme kɛ woɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he pɔtɔ; ejakaa e li blɔ nɛ a guu nɔ kɛ yaa ma mi.
Ma nɛ jokuɛyo ngɛ a nɔ matsɛ yee, nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ yeɔ ní, nɛ a nuɔ ní kpɔtɔɔ daa mɔtu ɔ, musu tloo mɛ.
A gbaa ma nɛ a matsɛ ɔ ngɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e juɛmi kɛ tsuɔ ní, nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ yeɔ ní bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ be nɔ, konɛ a nimli tso ɔmɛ nɛ a na he wami; se pi kaa a maa tɔ dã.
Hejɔtsɛ tsu yi mi kuɔ kɛ woɔ mi, nɛ tsu ɔ dungɔɔ.
A tsɛɔ ní yemi konɛ a fiɛ nɛ a muɔ; dã haa nɔ bua jɔmi, se sika lɛ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Koo gbiɛ matsɛ ngɛ o yi mi po; niatsɛ hu koo gbiɛ lɛ ngɛ o se tsu mi.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛ ko maa ngɔ o munyu ɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya de.
Ní lelɔ ní tsumi Mo sake o nɔ́ kpakpa ko ngɔ fɔ nyu hɛ, nɛ hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, o ma ba ná he se.
Ngɔɔ o ní kpakpahi ngɔ to hehi munomuno; ejakaa o li matahu ko nɛ ma ba po mo ngɛ je mi.
Ke hiɔwe yu bluublu kɛ bɔku ɔ, hiɔmi nɛɛ.
He nɛ tso ku fɔ si ngɛ ɔ, leneyi je jio, omleyi je jio, lejɛ ɔ e hii.
Nɔ nɛ slaa kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, e du we ní; nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ bɔku mi ɔ, e kpa we ní.
Níhi nɛ Mawu pee ɔ, o juɛmi su a he lo?
Ke o juɛmi sui a he ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ o maa pee kɛ le bɔ nɛ wami he jeɔ sisi ngɛ yohɔyo mi mi kɛɛ?
Du ní mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ tsuo.
O li a kpɛti nɔ́ nɛ maa ba; mɔtu nɔ́ ɔ jio, gbɔkuɛ nɔ́ ɔ jio.
Enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa hi jio, o li.
La ngɔɔ; ke hɛngmɛ na pu la a, e suɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ye jeha babauu ngɛ je mi ɔ, e ná bua jɔmi daa ligbi.
Se mohu, e kai kaa ke e gbo ɔ, be nɛ e maa ye ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hiɛ kulaa pe be nɛ e maa ye ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi.
Níhi nɛ maa ba a tsuo ji yaka níhi.
Nihewi a slɔmi Nihewi, nyɛ fiɛ nyɛ yi nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nihe mi; nyɛɛ pee nyɛ suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi.
Se nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Mawu maa kojo nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye tsui, nɛ nyɛ ko hao; ejakaa jokuɛwi a si, kɛ nihe be ɔ tsuo yaka.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo kai o bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ o nihe mi, be mi nɛ ligbi yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ jeha yayami ɔmɛ na we nɛ a ba, nɛ o ma de ke, “I be bua jɔmi ngɛ je mi.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi maa pee sulii ngɛ o hɛngmɛ mi.
Daa nɛ ɔ, bɔku ɔmɛ maa pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔmi yaa nɛ.
O ninehi nɛ o kɛ buɔ o he ɔ ma bɔni kpokpomi, nɛ o nane kpakpataa amɛ a mi maa jɔ.
O lunguhi be nyɛe maa ta nɔ́ hu, ejakaa a he pi.
O hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ maa ha, nɛ o be nɔ́ hyɛe saminya hu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, huhui nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ blɔ mi ɔ, o tue be nue hu.
Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ tae ɔ, o tsitsa be pɛe hu.
Ke la ngɛ pɛe ɔ, pe o maa nu fã kɛ fã kɛkɛ.
Makɛ, loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ́ ɔ, moo o te si momo.
Nɔ́ kuɔmi maa wo o he gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛmi maa pee mo ahuto.
O yi bwɔmi ma hiɛ futafuta.
O maa nyɛɛ blɛuu blɛuu kaa angmɛɛtɛ nɛ ngɛ si sãe, nɛ o he mi akɔnɔ tsuo se maa po.
Wa yaa wa nyagbe he jɔɔmi he ɔ, nɛ a maa wo yana ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, sika hiɔ kpa a ma tsɔ.
Sika tsu kplu ɔ maa ywia.

Nyagbe Fiɛlɔ ɔ, pi kaa e juɛmi mi kuɔ kɛkɛ; e tsɔɔ ma a nile hulɔ.
E bua abɛhi a nya.
E kase abɛ ɔmɛ saminya, nɛ e hla a mi.
E bɔ mɔde kaa e maa ngma munyuhi nɛ ngɔɔ.
Nɛ níhi nɛ e ngma a, anɔkuale sɔuu.
Ní leli a munyuhi ngɛ kaa tso kɛ e nya piɔpiɔ nɛ lohwe hyɛli kɛ tsɔ́ɔ́ a lohwehi.
Abɛhi nɛ a bua nya a, a he ngɛ se nami wawɛɛ kaa plɛɛkohi nɛ a je blɔ ka kɛ wo tso mi.
Wɔ tsuo wa hyɛlɔ kake too nɛ ji Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɛ e ha wɔ kikɛmɛ a abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ.
Ye bi, ha nɛ ma wo mo ga nɛ ɔ hulɔ.

Ní tsumi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nimli adesahi tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

NYA TSƆƆMI Lahi nɛ a po ngɛ asilɛ munyu tumi blɔ nɔ nɛ a bua nya ngɔ wo womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Munyu ɔmɛ hiɛhiɛɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyumu nɛ ngɛ yo munyu tue, nɛ yo ɔ ngɛ nɔ hee.
Ni komɛ tsɛɛ womi nɛ ɔ ke Salomo Lahi, ejakaa ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ɔ, a ngɔɔ lɛ kaa Salomo lɛ ngma.
Yuda bi ngɔɔ lɛ kaa Mawu kɛ e ma a a huɛ bɔmi ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ e ngɛ; nɛ Kristo we bi hu tsɔɔ kaa la amɛ kaleɔ huɛ bɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo kɛ e we asafo ɔ a kpɛti.

Jinɛ ke i kɛ mo kpe ngɛ ma nɔ ɔ, i ko fiɔ o nya he faa, nɛ nɔ ko be nɔ́ ko dee.
Jinɛ i ko ngɔ mo kɛ ya maa we ɔ mi, konɛ o ya je suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. I ko ha mo wai nɛ a futu mi; ye tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ ɔ wai nɛ o nu.
I ná nɛ ye yi fɔɔ si ngɛ o muɔ kɔni nɔ, nɛ o ngɔ o hiɔ nine kɛ fua mi.
Yerusalem yihi, nyɛɛ wo mi si kaa nyɛ be ye suɔlɔ ɔ tsɛe kɛ yaa si be nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa te si.
La ekpane Yi ɔmɛ Mɛnɔ nɛ je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ma, nɛ e kɛ e nine la e suɔlɔ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Yo ɔ Imi nɛ i ba tsɛ̃ɛ̃ mo ngɛ tso nɛ yiblii ngɔɔ saminya a sisi, he nɛ o nyɛ nu kɔɔmi nɛ e fɔ mo ngɛ ɔ. Koo suɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ja imi pɛ; koo la yo ko yo ko nine mi, ja imi pɛ.
Suɔmi ngɛ he wami kaa gbenɔ; akɔnɔ hu nya wa kaa gbeje.
E mleɔ kaa la, nɛ e tsoɔ gegeege.
Nyu babauu be nyɛe maa gbe suɔmi; pa nɛ hyi be nyɛe maa ha e nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ka kaa e kɛ e weto ní tsuo ma he suɔmi ɔ, muɔ nɛ a maa muɔ lɛ.
Yo ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ Wa ngɛ nyɛmi yoyo ko; e tui nyɔ lolo.
Ligbi nɛ nyumu ko ma ba bi e si ɔ, mɛni wa maa pee ha lɛ?
Gbogbo ji lɛ jinɛ waa kɛ sika hiɔ maa ma mɔ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.
Agbo ji lɛ jinɛ wa maa ngɔ seda tso kɛ tsi e he kɛ kpe.
Yo ɔ Gbogbo ji mi, ye nyɔ ɔmɛ ji mɔhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ.
Ye suɔlɔ ɔ le kaa ye bua jɔɔ ye he, nɛ ye tue mi jɔɔ mi ngɛ e ngɔ.
Nyumu ɔ Salomo ngɛ wai abɔɔ ko ngɛ he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Baal Hamon.
E ngɔ kɛ ha ni komɛ apaa yemi.
Ke a kpa ní ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ba ha lɛ sika hiɔ yi akpe.
Se imi nitsɛ ye wai abɔɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke a kpa ní ɔ, mo Salomo, o ma na sika hiɔ yi akpe, nɛ apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma na lafa enyɔɔnyɔ.
Ye suɔlɔ, ha nɛ ma nu o gbi ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi koo!
Ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mo tue bue!
Yo ɔ Ye suɔlɔ, ba ye ngɔ esɔ; tuu kaa batslɔɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ; tuu kɛ ba kaa odabɔ niheyo tuɔ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ he nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via tsohi ngɛ ɔ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Jeha - loko a fɔ Kristo ɔ, gbalɔ nguaa ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesaya hi Yerusalem.
A ngɔ gbalɔ ɔ biɛ ngɔ wo womi nɛ ɔ. Sanehi nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi ɔ, a dla a mi etɛ.
Yi -: Sanehi nɛ ba, be mi nɛ nɔ yemi nɛ ngɛ leneyi je nɛ a tsɛɛ Yuda a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e kpata.
Nɔ yemi kpa ko nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya nɛ biɛ ji Asiria a ngɛ lɛ haoe.
Gbalɔ Yesaya na kaa tsa pi Asiria he wami ɔ nya kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda be nyɛe maa da, se mohu nɔ́ tutuutu nɛ miɔ nɛ kpata Yuda hɛ mi ji ma a nitsɛ pee yayami; a bui Mawu tue, nɛ a ngɔɛ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɛ e nɔ.
Gbalɔ ɔ gu ninahi nɛ a se ti, kɛ ní peemi ní komɛ a nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ ma a, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ kaa e hia kaa a pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a ye dami sane ngɛ a wami si himi mi.
E bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke á bu Mawu tue, ke pi ja lɛɛ musu tloo mɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Yesaya gba ke, be ko ma nɛ je ɔ tsuo ma na tue mi jɔmi; nɛ David nina ko ma ba pee matsɛ agbo.
Yi -: Sanehi nɛ ba, be mi nɛ a nuu Yuda ma a mi nihi babauu kɛ ho ma se ya ngɛ Babilon, nɛ a ya ye mɛ nyɔguɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo ta.
Gbalɔ ɔ fiɛ ke e be kɛe kulaa nɛ Mawu ma ha a maa ngmɛɛ a he kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ maa ya we ngɛ Yerusalem, konɛ a ya je wami he sisi ekohu.
Womi ɔ mi dlami fa nɛ ɔ mi oti pɔtɛɛ ji Mawu ji je ɔ mi sanehi tsuo a Nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ eko ji kaa e ngɛ e ma a tsɔe kɛ yaa je ma amɛ tsuo a ngɔ.
Israel mi nɛ a maa je kɛ gbaa je ma amɛ.
Munyuhi nɛ a le pe kulaa ngɛ Somi Momo womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ kɔɔ “Nyɔmtsɛ Tsɔlɔ ɔ” he.
Yi -: Munyuhi nɛ a tu kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba Yerusalem.
A ha nɛ a nu sisi kaa Mawu wo e ma a si, nɛ e maa ye siwo ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se e hia kaa ma a nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a ye dami sane.
E hia hu kaa a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ a sã bɔ, nɛ a sɔle.
Munyu nɛ a ngma ngɛ yi .- ɔ he hia saminya.
Lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yesu kɛ je e ní tsumi sisi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu nitsɛ nɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛ ha e ní tsumi ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ si womi .—.
Je ma amɛ a tue gblami .—.
Mawu maa kojo je ɔ .—.
Kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ si womi nɔ tsami .—.
Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia kɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ .—.
Sɛ gbihi nɛ tsɔɔ si womi kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi .—.
Kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ si womi .—.
Sɛ gbihi nɛ kɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem a he nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Mawu je nina nɛ ɔmɛ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ, ngɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ, Uzia, Yotam, Ahaz, kɛ Hezekia a yi nɔ.
Mawu ka e ma a hɛ mi Yawɛ ke, “Hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue!
Jokuɛwi nɛ i tsɔse nɛ a wa a te si ngɔ si mi.
Nahi le a tsɛ, nɛ tejihi hu le he nɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ haa mɛ ní ngɛ.
Se imi nitsɛ ye ma Israel ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; a juɛmi bɛ he.” Musu tloo nyɛ, nyɛ ma nɛ yayami sɔuu nyɛ peeɔ; nyɛ puɛ kulaa kɛ yayami peemi!
Nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ pee tlomi ha nyɛ!
Nyɛ kua Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ je e he kɛ ho se ya.
Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ atuã tsɔe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?
Nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbla nyɛ tue fuu lo?
Israel, o yi tsuo pee pa, nɛ o tsui gbɔjɔ.
Kɛ je o yi mi kɛ ya su o nane si ɔ, pa sɔuu; he ko he ko be saminya.
He komɛ kpɔ, he komɛ pee pa, pa momohi kɛ pa hehi.
Pa amɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ we; a fi we a nɔ, nɛ a to we a nɔ hulɔ.
Nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi kpata; a sã nyɛ ma amɛ.
Nibwɔhi ngɛ nyɛ zugba a ngɔe ngɛ nyɛ dɛ pani nya, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatae.
A si Yerusalem kɛ fɔ si mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa ma nɛ ta sá e yi.
E ngɛ kaa bulɔ tsu bi ko ngɛ wai ngmɔ mi, loo gba nɛ a ma ngɛ atlɛ ngmɔ mi.
Kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ha we nɛ wa ti ni komɛ a yi nɛ na wami ɔ, wa ko pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora.
Yerusalem, nyɛ nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora bi pɛ.
Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue saminya.
Yawɛ ke, “Bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ kɛ ba haa mi ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa i suɔ lo?
To ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba sãã bɔ, kɛ lohwe kpakpa amɛ a zɔ ɔ hiɛ tsɔ ha mi.
Na kuhi, kɛ jijɔhi, kɛ akpakpohi a muɔ ba ti mi.
Mɛnɔ de nyɛ ke ke nyɛ ma mi jami ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi?
Mɛnɔ de nyɛ ke nyɛ ba nyɛɛ ye sɔlemi we ɔ kpo ɔ nɔ?
Se nami ko be he kaa nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba hu.
Nyɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sãe ɔ ngɛ fu jee kɛ ngɛ mi woe.
I hla we nyɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ, nyɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ, kɛ behi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kpe kɛ jaa imi, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hu; yayamihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ puɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
I sume nyɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ; enɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ haomi kɛ pɔtɔ ha mi.
“Ke nyɛ wo nyɛ nine nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i be nyɛ hyɛe; nyɛ nine he pee kɛ muɔ.
Nyɛɛ du nyɛ he, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ.
Nyɛ kpa yayami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ nɛ ma jɔɔ hyɛmi.
Ee, nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ nyɛɛ kase kpakpa peemi.
Nyɛɛ ye dami sane; nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a sane ha mɛ; nyɛ ha awusahi a blɔ nya níhi, nɛ nyɛɛ ye yalɔyihi a sane ha mɛ.” Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ba nɛ wɔ tsuo wa susu he.
Ke nyɛ he yayami ɔ tsu kaa mɛni po, ma ha e ma hiɛ futaa kaa snoo, loo jijɔ he bwɔmi.
Ke nyɛ maa bu mi tue ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa ye zugba a mi niba ní kpakpa.
Se ke nyɛ kpale we, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã a, lɛɛ nyɛ ma gbo ngɛ klaate nya.
Imi, Yawɛ, lɛ i de.” Ma nɛ mi hyi kɛ yayami peemi Ma nɛ sa a, e yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ hyɛ, e ngɛ e ní pee kaa yaholɔ!
Sa be ko ɔ, nimli nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da nɛ a hyi ma a mi tɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ awi yeli sɔuu lɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi.
Yerusalem, mo nɛ be ko ɔ, o he jua wa kaa sika hiɔ ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ, o he be se nami ko kulaa; sa a, o ngɛ kaa dã kpakpa; se jehanɛ lɛɛ, o ngɛ kaa dã nɛ a tsa mi nyu.
Atuã tsɔli ji o ganɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ juli ji o huɛmɛ; be tsuaa be ɔ, nike ní, kɛ nyɔ mi ní a ngɛ hee.
A yi awusahi a sane ha we mɛ ngɛ sane yemi he, nɛ a bui yalɔyihi hu a sane tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu, hewamitsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ɔ: “Ma ye ye he lue ngɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ko ba gba ye nya hu.
I kɛ nyɛ maa to ní.
Ma tsu nyɛ he kaa a tsuɔ dade he, nɛ ma je nyɛ he mu ɔ tsuo.
Ma ha nyɛ ma nimeli, kɛ ga woli kpakpahi kaa nihi nɛ hi si blema a. Ke enɛ ɔ ba mi ɔ, a ma tsɛ Yerusalem ke ma nɛ a yeɔ dami sane kɛ anɔkuale ngɛ mi.” Akɛnɛ dalɔ ji Yawɛ he je ɔ, e ma he Yerusalem yi wami, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsake e tsui hu, a ma he e yi wami.
Se nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ tsɔɔ e hɛ mi atuã a, e ma kpata a hɛ mi; e maa gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuaa lɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ma pia nyɛ he kaa nyɛ ya ja tso ngua amɛ, nɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe nyɛ ngɛ abɔɔhi nɛ nyɛ po ɔ a he.
Nyɛ ma gbo kaa tso nɛ e nɔ ba amɛ ylɔ, nɛ miɔ nɛ e gbo, loo kaa abɔɔ ko nɛ a pue we e mi ní ɔmɛ a nɔ nyu.
Nihi nɛ a he wa a, a he yayami ɔmɛ ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ la nɛ sɛ sulii sãã nga a. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tsi nya.
Tue mi jɔmi nɛ maa hi si daa Sɛ gbi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ, nɛ kɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, Yawɛ we ɔ maa ma yo gagaa ko yi mi; yo nɛ ya hiɔwe gojoo pe yo ɔmɛ tsuo yi mi e maa ma.
Je ma amɛ tsuo ma bu yuu kɛ ba e he, nɛ a ma de ke, “Nyɛ ha wa ya kuɔ Yawɛ yo ɔ kɛ ya Israel Mawu ɔ sɔlemi we ɔ. E maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ kaa waa pee; nɛ wa maa pee bɔ nɛ e maa tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ ní tsɔɔmi ɔ, Yerusalem e jee; e kɛ e ma a tuɔ munyu kɛ jeɔ Zion yo ɔ nɔ.” Yawɛ maa hyɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti sanehi a mi ha mɛ.
E ma dla nihi babauu a kpɛti.
A kɛ a ta hwumi klaate ɔmɛ maa sɔ kpakplaahi, nɛ a kɛ a we akplɔ ɔmɛ maa pee tso he suami hahi.
Je ma ko je ma ko be ta hwue kɔkɔɔkɔ; a be a he dlae kɛ ha ta gblegbleegble hu.
Jehanɛ, nyɛ Yakob nina, nyɛ ha waa nyɛɛ ngɛ la nɛ Yawɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi!
A ma kpata he nɔ woli a hɛ mi Mawu lee, o kua o ma, Yakob nina a, ejakaa klaali babauu nɛ je beleku je kɛ Filistia ba futu mɛ.
Ma se bi a kusumi níhi o ma a ngɛ pee.
A zugba a nɔ hyi kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu; a li a juetli ɔ nya.
A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu hiɛ babauu, nɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ hu a li nya.
Amagahi hyi a zugba a nɔ; nɛ níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a jaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo ba a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ si, nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ.
Yawɛ koo ngɔ kɛ pa mɛ!
A ma ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, aloo a maa tsua muɔhi, konɛ a laa a he kɛ je Yawɛ we abofu nɛ he wa a, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ nya!
Be ma nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa he tsɔɔmi, kɛ e he nɔ womi tsuo a se maa po.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma wo Yawɛ pɛ nɔ gojoo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ba he walɔ tsuaa he walɔ si; e maa ba he wolɔ kɛ he nɔ wolɔ, tsuo si.
E ma kpata Lebanon seda tso gagaa amɛ, kɛ Bashan tso ngua amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
E maa ba yo gagaa amɛ, kɛ yoku tsɔwi ɔmɛ tsuo si; jã kɛ̃ mɔ tsuaa mɔ, kɛ gbogbo tsuaa gbogbo nɛ ngɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e maa ba mɛ si.
Spania lɛ nguaa amɛ kɛ a he fɛu ɔ tsuo e ma ha a ma mu.
-Nɔmlɔ adesa he tsɔɔmi, kɛ e he nɔ womi tsuo se maa po.
Amagahi a se maa po kulaa; nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ pɛ nɔ a ma wo gojoo.
Nihi ma ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, aloo a maa tsua muɔhi, konɛ a laa a he ngɛ mi kɛ je Yawɛ we abofu nɛ he wa a, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ nya, ke e ba nɛ e ba mimiɛ zugba a. Jamɛ a be ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ma sake amaga amɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ pee nɛ a ma ja a ngɔ hɛ fɔ he ha jesihi kɛ apanihi.
Ke Yawɛ ba nɛ e ba mimiɛ je ɔ, nimli maa laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi kɛ muɔhi a mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ je e abofu nɛ he wa a, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ nya.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔmlɔ adesa nɔ.
Tlukaa kɛkɛ e mumi je e mi, nɛ e he be se nami hu.
Haomi maa ba Yerusalem Bu tue!
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ nihi nɛ a ba ye bua Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem hu.
E ma ha a niye ní, kɛ nyu maa ta.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata: katsɛmɛ, ta buli, kojoli, gbali, klaali, ma nimeli, asafoatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, ma ní tsuli, kɛ kunya yeli kpanakuhi.
Ma wo jokuɛwi nyumuwi ganɔhi ha mɛ, nɛ bimwɔwi maa ye a nɔ.
A maa wa a sibi yi mi.
Nihewi maa hyɛ nikɔtɔma hɛ mi, nɛ nihi nɛ bu be a he maa wo a he ha nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami.
Be ma, nɛ we puɔ nya ko bi maa hla a ti nɔ ko, nɛ a ma de lɛ ke, “Wa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpata, se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ he ha nɔ́ ko, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba pee wa tsɛ, nɛ o ye wa nɔ.” E ma he nɔ ke, “Kpaoo!
I be nyɛe ma pee ja ha nyɛ.
Imi hu, i be niye ní, nɛ i be heha ní hulɔ.
Nyɛ ko wo mi nyɛ nyatsɛ!” Niinɛ, musu tloo Yerusalem!
Yuda hɛ mi kpata!
Ejakaa a deɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ siɔ Yawɛ; a jee blɔ pueɔ Mawu nitsɛ hɛ mi si.
A ní peepee yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ; ejakaa a jeɔ a hɛ mi paa kɛ peeɔ yayami kaa Sodom bi; a kɛ laa we.
Musu tloo mɛ!
Mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ye a he awi ɔ nɛ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a bua maa jɔ, nɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa ya nɔ saminya.
A maa ye a dengme gbomi mi ngɔɔmi.
Se yayami peeli lɛɛ musu tloo mɛ; yayami nɛ a pee ní kpahi ɔ, jehanɛ, a ma ngɔ pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Jokuɛwi lɛ ngɛ ye ma a haoe, nɛ yihi lɛ ngɛ a nɔ yee.
Ye ma, o nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ haa o tlaa blɔ, nɛ a tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ̃ o nane.
Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a kojoe Yawɛ pee klaalo kaa e maa jaje e sane ɔ; e pee klaalo kaa e maa kojo e ma a. Yawɛ kɛ ma nimeli, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ lɛ na sane ɔ nɛ.
Munyu nɛ e kɛ ba po a nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ kpata wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ kpɔ ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a dɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɔ kɛ to nyɛ wehi a mi.
Nyɛ be he blɔ kulaa kaa nyɛ waa ye ma a yi mi, loo nyɛ yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ amimi.
Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ i de.” A bɔ Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ kɔkɔ Yawɛ ke, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he tsɔɔe ha!
Ke a ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, a woɔ a hɛ mi nɔ kɛ hii kɔɔhiɔ mi fue.
Basabasa peemi pɛ a suɔ be tsuaa be.
A hiaa a nane bitibiti kɛ kɔsɔɔ, nɛ a nane si ga amɛ hii pɛe ngmleingmlei.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbla a tue.
Ma ha sakpa ma pue a yi mi, nɛ a maa sɛ a yi ɔ kpalokpalo.” Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, afɛu níhi tsuo nɛ Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ kɛ dlaa a he: nane si ga amɛ, níhi nɛ a kɛ hɔɔ a yi mi, a kuɛ ga amɛ, a nine si ga amɛ, hɛ mi hami ní ɔmɛ, a pɛɛ ɔmɛ, sɛbɛhi nɛ a woɔ ngɛ a kɔni si kɛ a mlɛ mi ɔ, nine nguɛ ga amɛ, gugwɔ mi ga amɛ, he dlami tade ɔmɛ, tade klɔii ɔmɛ, tade gagaa amɛ, nɔha tade ɔmɛ, sika kpɛɛ ɔmɛ, kploba heha ní ɔmɛ, mele duku ɔmɛ, yi duku ɔmɛ, kɛ hɛ mi hami nɔ́ gagaa amɛ tsuo ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je ngɛ a he.
Nu je via be hae nɛ a he maa je via hu, a he maa je fu mohu; tangme kpa titlii a kɛ maa fi a mlɛ mi, pi mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ hu; yi nɛ a hɔɔ saminyayoo ɔ maa pee kpalokpalo; a heha ní kpakpa amɛ ma plɛ pee tako piɛ; a he fɛu ɔ ma plɛ pee zo ha mɛ!
A kɛ klaate maa gbe ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ; a ti nihi nɛ ji katsɛmɛ tete po maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi.
Ma a agbo ɔmɛ a nya maa pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kɛ ya; nɛ ma a nitsɛ lɛɛ e maa pee kaa yo nɛ hɛɛ e he gu kɛ hii si ngɛ zugba.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, yihi kpaago ma ya nu nyumu kake nɛ a ma de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa lɛ wa he, nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa bɔ wa heha ní he mɔde, se ngmɛɛ wɔ blɔ nɛ wa tsɛ mo ke wa huno kɛkɛ, konɛ a ko ba bɔ wɔ ahlua hu.” A maa fia Yerusalem ma a kɛ ma si ekohu Be ma, nɛ Yawɛ ma ha tso tsuaa tso ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa bɔ, nɛ e maa pee fɛu.
Israel bi tsuo nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a bua maa jɔ, nɛ a ma na gɛjɛmi ngɛ niba ní nɛ a ma na ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ Mawu ma ha e yi ma na wami ɔ, a ma tsɛ lɛ nɔ klɔuklɔu.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e he wami maa kojo Zion biyi ɔmɛ, nɛ e maa tsu ma a he.
E ma fɔ mu níhi, kɛ muɔ nɛ pue si ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ tsuo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ bɔku kɛ ba ha Zion yo ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ba kpe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a nɔ; piani ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha bɔku maa wo, nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, la su ku, kɛ la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe plamplam maa ba.
Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa ha ma a tsuo nɔ.
E hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa pee hɔ̃ ha ma a piani kɛ tsi pu la a nya, nɛ e maa pee wesa he ngɛ hiɔmi kɛ ahumi be mi.
Wai ngmɔ he abɛ ɔ Bu la nɛ i ngɛ lae ha mo nɛ ɔ tue; la a kɔɔ ye huɛ ko kɛ e wai ngmɔ he.
Ye huɛ ɔ ngɛ wai ngmɔ ko ngɛ yo zugba ko nɛ baa ní saminya nɔ.
E hu zugba a nɔ, e je tɛhi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ tsuo, nɛ e du wai tso kpakpahi ngɛ mi.
E ma mɔ ko nɛ a maa hi mi kɛ bu ngmɔ ɔ he, e tsua muɔ nɛ a maa nga wai yiblii kɛ wo mi.
E mlɛ kɛ ya si be nɛ wai yiblii ɔ fu; se wai yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo dooɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye huɛ ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda, nyɛɛ hyɛ sane nɛ ngɛ i kɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ wa kpɛti ɔ mi ha wɔ.
Anɛ nɔ́ ko pa ngɛ nɛ i tsu we ngɛ e he lo?
Lɛɛ mɛni he je mɔ nɛ e wo yiblii nɛ dooɔ, se pi wai yiblii kpakpa nɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e maa wo ɔ?
“Bɔ nɛ ma pee ye wai ngmɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ma je piɛ ɔ, nɛ́ nga mi lohwehi nɛ ba ye wai yiblii ɔ; ma ku gbogbo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba naa nɔ.
Ma ha nɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi nɛ hɛ.
I be wai tso ɔmɛ a he sãe, nɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi hu i be hue.
Nɔ́ nɛ ma pee mohu ji, ma ngmɛ blɔ nɛ mio tso, kɛ mio maa puɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ.
Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu i be hae nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ ngɔ pue ngmɔ ɔ nɔ hu.” Israel ma a ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ nɛ; Yuda bi ɔmɛ ji wai tso kpakpa amɛ nɛ e du ɔ nɛ.
E hyɛ blɔ kaa a maa ye dami sane, se muɔ si mohu a ngɛ puee.
E hyɛ blɔ kaa a maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, se amimi mohu a ngɛ ma a yee, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae.
Yayamihi nɛ nimli adesahi peeɔ Musu tloo nyɛ!
Wehi babauu, kɛ zugbahi nyɛ ngɛ hee kɛ ngɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ momo ɔ a he piɛe.
E be kɛe kulaa nɛ nɔ kpa ko be he ko nae maa hi hu, nɛ e maa piɛ nyɛ pɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
I nu nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ke, “Wehi nɛ kle, nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ ɔ tsuo ma ba pee we dokuhi.
Wai ngmɔ nɛ na nyɔngma ma hu ligbi kake ɔ ma ha wai yiblii bɔbɔyoo pɛ; nɛ wuhi nɛ a du ngɛ ngmɔ kpa nyɔngma mi ɔ, kpa kake pɛ nɔ yiblii a ma na ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ tsuo mi.
A ma hu gbajaa nɛ a ma du ní fuu, se yiblii bɔbɔyoo pɛ a ma na kɛ maa je a dengme gbomi ɔ mi.” Musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ tee si makɛ mla, kɛkɛ nyɛ bɔni dã numi, nɛ gbɔkuɛ hu nyɛ hii si be fuu kɛ tɔɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ.
Nyɛ tsɛɔ ní yemi nɛ nyɛ nuɔ dã; nyɛ fiaa saku, nɛ nyɛ nyaa; nyɛ kpaa bɛ, nɛ nyɛ hii miɛ.
Se akɛnɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ pee ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ susuu we he kulaa he je ɔ, a maa nuu nyɛ nɛ a maa bɔ nyɛ pã kɛ ho ma se ya.
Mi mi hwɔ maa gbe nyɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ kuma maa ye ni gu ɔmɛ kɛ yaa si a ma gbo.
Hwɔ ngɛ gbeje yee, nɛ e gbɛ e nya mi hatoo nɛ e maa mii mɛ.
E ngɛ Yerusalem odehe ɔmɛ, kɛ ni gu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ hoo pee ɔ tsuo miie si kake too.
Zo maa gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a maa ba he woli tsuo si.
Se Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ kɛ tsɔɔ e we agbo jemi; nɛ e gblaa e ma a tue kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu ji lɛ.
Ke be ɔ su ɔ, jijɔhi ma kpe nga ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ to akpakpo bihi hu ma na niye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ fi nyɛ kaa kpa nɛ nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ pɛne ngɛ nyɛ he.
Nyɛ deɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ke e maa pee ɔ, ha nɛ e pee esɔ, konɛ waa na.
Ha nɛ Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ tsu níhi nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e ma tsu ɔ; nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e juɛmi mi.” Musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ tsɛɔ yayami ke kpakpa, nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ kpakpa ke yayami.
Nyɛ plɛɔ diblii kɛ peeɔ la, nɛ la hu peeɔ diblii.
Nyɛ plɛɔ doomi kɛ peeɔ ngɔɔmi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dooɔ.
Musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ hɛ mi tɛ, nɛ nyɛ le ní saminya.
Musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kã ngɛ dã tɔmi he!
Ke e su dã nɛ nya wa futumi nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ he mi wa nyɛ.
Nyɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní ngɛ nihi nɛ ye fɔ a dɛ nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɔ a he; se nihi nɛ yi fɔ mohu lɛɛ nyɛ yi a sane ha we mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel hɛ mi ma ba kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã hu kɛ nga gbigbli ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba a nɔ, ejakaa a kua Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mlaa amɛ.
A yi Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Yawɛ mi mi fu e ma a, nɛ e wo e nine nɔ, konɛ e gbla a tue.
Yo ɔmɛ ma mimiɛ, nɛ ni gbogboehi ma pue si ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa dwɔmi.
Ke e ba ja po, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe, se e nine nɛ e wo nɔ ɔ, ja e kɛ gbla a tue kokooko.
Yawɛ pee okadi ko kɛ tsɛ ma ko kɛ je ma se lokoo.
E kpa bɛ kɛ tsɛ mɛ kɛ je je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ.
O nɛ mɛ nɛ a ma kɛ fo esɔesɔ.
Pɔ tɔɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu tɛ we si.
A di kɔnɛɛ, nɛ a hwɔ we mahe.
A mlɛ mi fimi níhi gbɔle we, nɛ a nane tokota kpa amɛ hu tsɔ we.
A kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a nya ba, nɛ a dɔ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ a mi, konɛ a tsɛ̃.
A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane kokloto ɔmɛ a he wa kaa tslɛbo, nɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a nane kla amɛ ngɛ a he poe kɛ fo kaa lasiogblee.
Ta buli ɔmɛ hwɔ hoo kaa jatahi nɛ a gbe lohwe ko nɛ a ngɛ huãe ngɛ he, nɛ a kɛ yaa he nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ngɛ a dɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a ma hwɔ hoo kɛ wo Israel kaa wo nɛ gli.
Ke nɔ ko hyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, e maa na kaa e nɔ wo diblii.
E pee gbeye kɛ aywilɛho.
E nɔ wo diblii kpii; la ko be.
Mawu tsɛ Yesaya ke e ba pee gbalɔ Jeha a nɛ Matsɛ Uzia gbo ɔ, i na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ gojoo ko nɔ.
E tade klɔii ɔ nya wuyaa a hyi Yawɛ we ɔ tsuo.
Serafhi bɔle lɛ.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ pɛli ekpa.
Eko tsuaa eko ngɔ pɛli enyɔ ngɔ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ enyɔ hu ngɔ ha e he, nɛ enyɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ, e kɛ te.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e sibi dee boboobo ke, “Klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu!
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu!
E hɛ mi nyami ɔ hyi je ɔ tsuo.” A gbi ɔ ha nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ mimiɛ, nɛ la su ku hyi Yawɛ we ɔ nitsɛ tɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Ye yi ta pɛ!
Ejakaa i na matsɛ ɔ nɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ!
Ye nya mi munyu he tsɔ we; nɛ nimli nɛ i ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, mɛ hu a nya mi munyu he tsɔ we ja nɔuu!” Tlukaa a, seraf ɔ kake te kɛ ba ye ngɔ kɛ e dɛ mi la ngu hɛuu nɛ e kɛ abɛɛle ya kɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
E ngɔ la ngu hɛuu ɔ ngɔ sa ye nya he nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sa o nya he nɛ ɔ, a ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo, nɛ piami ko be o he hu.” Jehanɛ, i nu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ma tsɔ?
Mɛnɔ maa ya?” I he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, Moo tsɔ mi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke ma ya nɛ ma ya de ma a ke, “Nyɛ maa bu tue, se nyɛ be sisi nue; nyɛ maa hyɛ, se nyɛ be se kɔe.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Ha nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsui nɛ ti; a tue nɛ wa, nɛ a hɛngmɛ hu nɛ ma, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a hɛngmɛ ko hyɛ nɔ́, nɛ a tue hu ko nu nɔ́, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́ sisi, nɛ a ba kpale kɛ ba nɛ a tsa mɛ.” I bi ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ kɛ yaa si mɛni be?” E he nɔ ke, “Kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma amɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ a maa pee ma dokuhi nɛ a be nɔ ko nɔ ko nae ngɛ we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ zugba a nitsɛ hu nɔ maa je gu.
Ma ha a maa je zugba a nɔ kɛ ya tsitsaa he ko, nɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ maa je gu.
Ke nɔ kake pɛ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ ni nyɔngma mi po, lɛ hu a ma kpata e hɛ mi; e maa pee kaa tso ngua ko nɛ a po, nɛ e piɛ tso kpɔ ɔ kɛkɛ.” (Tso kpɔ nɛ ɔ daa si ha Mawu ma he ɔ sisi jemi.)
Sɛ gbi nɛ a kɛ ya ha Matsɛ Ahaz Ta ba te si benɛ Uzia bibi Ahaz, Yotam bi ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Yuda a. Lɔ ɔ ji kaa Siria matsɛ, Rezin kɛ Remalia bi Peka, Israel matsɛ ɔ, ba tua Yerusalem; se a nyɛ we nɛ a ngɔ ma a. Benɛ Yuda matsɛ ɔ nu kaa Siria ta a ba sɛ Israel zugba a mi momo ɔ, e kɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a he do blibliibli kaa tsohi nɛ ngɛ mimiɛe ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nya.
Yawɛ de Yesaya ke, “Yaa nɛ o kɛ Matsɛ Ahaz ya kpe; ngɔɔ o bi Shear Yashub ngɔ piɛ o he kɛ ya.
O maa na lɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ bo loli a ní tsumi he ɔ, he nɛ nyu dɔ nɛ gblaa nyu kɛ jee pa a nɛ ngɛ yiti je ɔ nya ya ta ngɛ ɔ.
De lɛ ke e ko ye Matsɛ Rezin, kɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Matsɛ Peka gbeye.
A mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ kaa la tso enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ tsoe tikɔɔ kɛkɛ.
Siria, Israel, kɛ Remalia bi ɔ ya so ngɔ wo o he.
A to a yi mi kaa a ma ba tua Yuda, nɛ a maa wo ni ɔmɛ a he gbeye, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kɛ mɛ nɛ pee kake.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa wo Tabeel bi ɔ matsɛ.
“Se imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa enɛ ɔ be mi bae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Mɛni he je?
Ejakaa Siria he wɛ pi Damasko nɛ ji e matsɛ ma a, nɛ Damasko he wɛ pi Rezin.
Israel lɛɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha nyingmi ekpa kɛ enuɔ ɔ, a ma kpata e hɛ mi butuu, bɔ nɛ e be nyɛe maa da si kaa ma hu.
Israel he wɛ pi Samaria nɛ ji e matsɛ ma a, nɛ Samaria hu he wɛ pi Matsɛ Peka.
“Ke nyɛ he we yi ɔ, nyɛ yi be wami nae.” Yimanuel he okadi ɔ Yawɛ kɛ sɛ gbi kpa mane Ahaz ke, “Bi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ke e ha mo okadi ko.
E ma nyɛ maa je gbeje lokoo, loo hiɔwe tsitsaa kɛ ba.” Se Ahaz he nɔ ke, “I be okadi ko bie.
I be Yawɛ kae.” Yesaya he nɔ ke, “Matsɛ David nina, jehanɛ bu tue.
E ji nɔ́ yayami kaa o maa hao nimli adesahi hluu kɛ yaa si a tsui si tomi maa ta.
Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o hao wa Mawu ɔ hu ja kɛ yaa si e tsui si tomi maa ta lo?
Yoo, i nu.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma ha nyɛ okadi ko; yiheyo ko maa ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ e maa wo lɛ biɛ ke, ‘Yimanuel’.
Loko e hɛ ma fã nɛ e maa le kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti slɔɔto ɔ, ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ma ná na nyɔ nyu maa nu, nɛ a ma na hwo maa ye ekohu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ be sue tete po nɛ matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ he gbeye woe ɔ a zugba amɛ a nɔ maa je gu.
“Yawɛ ma ha haomi be ko ma ba na mo, kɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ weku ɔ tsuo.
Kɛ je be nɛ Israel kɛ Yuda mi gba nɛ ɔ, be yaya kaa enɛ ɔ eko bɛ hyɛ.
Asiria matsɛ ɔ ji haomi nɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ba a nɛ.
“Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, Yawɛ ma kpa bɛ kɛ tsɛ Egipt kɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma bu kɛ je pa amɛ a nya kɛ ba babauu kaa anunuhi, nɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ hu maa je a zugba a nɔ ja nɔuu kaa hwo bihi.
A ma ba pue si ngɛ kɔ̃ voovoo ɔmɛ, kɛ tɛ puɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a maa ha si ngɛ mio tso ɔmɛ a sisi, kɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ya ba asoyi ngɛ Yufrate pa a se kɛ ba.
E kɛ ma ba sɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi, kɛ nyɛ nane he bwɔmi, nɛ a maa sɛ nyɛ kpɛni hulɔ.
Asiria matsɛ ɔ ji asoyi ɔ nɛ.
“Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, ke ngmɔ hulɔ ko ngɛ na yo kake, kɛ to enyɔ pɛ ɔ, e ma ná nyɔ nyu fuu nɛ maa su e hiami ní tsuo nya.
Niinɛ, nihi bɔɔ nɛ a yi ma na wami, nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ma ná na nyɔ nyu maa nu, kɛ hwo nɛ a maa ye.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ, hehi tsuo nɛ wai tso akpe hi sa a, nɛ a he jua peeɔ sika hiɔ yi akpe ɔ, lejɛ ɔ tsuo ma plɛ pee pú, kɛ mio tsohi sɔuu.
Nihi maa hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kɛ ya da de ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Niinɛ, zugba a nɔ tsuo ma hyi kɛ pú, kɛ mio tsohi sɔuu.
Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hehi nɛ a huɔ sa a lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ yae, ejakaa hu, kɛ mio maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ.
Zugba a maa pee tohi, kɛ nahi a niye he.”
Yesaya binyumu maa da si kaa okadi ha ma a Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa hla nɔ́ nɛ a ngmaa ní ngɛ nɔ agbo ko, nɛ o ngma ní agbohi ngɛ nɔ.
Ngmaa ke, ‘Puɛ ní esɔ; haa ní kɛ fo.’ Ngɔɔ nihi enyɔ nɛ a buu mɛ saminya kɛ pee odase yeli.
Mɛ ji Uria, kɛ Zakaria, Yeberekia bi ɔ.” Pee se ɔ, i kɛ ye yo, gbalɔyo ɔ na bɔmi.
E ngɔ hɔ nɛ e fɔ binyumu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Wo lɛ biɛ ke, ‘Puɛ ní esɔ, haa ní kɛ fo.’ Loko bi nɛ ɔ maa le ‘Maa’ loo ‘Tsaatsɛ’ demi ɔ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ ma ba muɔ Damasko sika tsuo, kɛ Samaria ta yibu ní tsuo kɛ ho.” Asiria matsɛ ɔ ma Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Akɛnɛ ma nɛ ɔ sume Shiloa pa a nɛ mi nyu ɔ bee dii ɔ, se Matsɛ Rezin kɛ Matsɛ Peka mohu he a he ngɛ doe ngɛ ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ, ma ngɔ Asiria matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ta a tsuo kɛ ba tua Yuda.
Ta a ma ba tua mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yufrate pa a hyiɔ ywiaa nga nɛ e haa zugba a nɔ ɔ.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba gu Yuda zugba a nɔ kaa pa nɛ hyi ywia nga kɛ su nɔ konɔ tɔɔ, nɛ e ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ.” Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ!
E bli e pɛlihi a mi kɛ ngɛ zugba a he bue.
Nyɛ je ma amɛ, nyɛɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsitsaa hu, nyɛɛ bu tue.
Nyɛɛ mia kɛ ha ta, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye gbeye!
Ee, nyɛɛ mia, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye gbeye!
Nyɛɛ to nyɛ ga amɛ!
Se a maa pee yaka.
Nyɛ de nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ!
Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee yaka, ejakaa Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ.
Yawɛ bɔ gbalɔ ɔ kɔkɔ Yawɛ kɛ hɛdɔ bɔ mi kɔkɔ ke ma ko nyɛɛ ni ɔmɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ.
E ke, “Koo piɛ ni ɔmɛ a he kɛ to a ga amɛ, nɛ níhi nɛ mɛɛ a yee gbeye ɔ, koo ye gbeye.
O hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu; imi ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa o ye gbeye.
Ma plɛ pee he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu; ma pee tɛ nɛ maa tsi mo blɔ.
Se Israel kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ma pee tɛ sa nɛ maa tsɛ̃ mɛ kɛ ko si; nɛ ma pee klama nɛ maa du nihi nɛ a ngɛ Yerusalem.
Nihi babauu ma tɛ nɔ nɛ a maa nɔɔ si, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
A maa tsɔ mɛ klama, nɛ a maa du.” A bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ke a ko tsɛ kpade Sɛ gbihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ɔ, nyɛ, ye kaseli ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ saminya, konɛ a hi si daa.
Yawɛ ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ laa e ma a, se imi lɛɛ i heɔ yeɔ, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.
Nyɛ nɛ mi, kɛ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ ke mi ɔ. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ e matsɛ sɛ ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ ɔ tsɔ wɔ ke waa ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Israel ma a.
Se ni komɛ de nyɛ ke nyɛ ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ ní peeli nɛ kpaa nyagba, nɛ a tuɔ gugwɔ mi gbi ɔ a ngɔ.
A ma de ke, “E pee we nɔ́ ko; e sa kaa a ya bi ní ngɛ mumihi a ngɔ, nɛ a nu nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ a he kɛ je kpadehi a ngɔ.” Ke a de nyɛ ja a, nyɛ he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue!
Nyɛ ko bu ní peeli tue.
Níhi nɛ a deɔ nyɛ ɔ, a he be se nami.” Haomi be ko ma Ni komɛ maa wo lalaalo ngɛ zugba a nɔ; hwɔ maa ye mɛ, nɛ a ní maa pee mɔbɔ.
Mi mi fumi, kɛ hwɔ nɛ ngɛ mɛ yee he je ɔ, a maa gbiɛ a matsɛ ɔ, kɛ a mawu ɔmɛ.
A ma wo a yi nɔ kɛ hyɛ hiɔwe, aloo a ma kɔkɔ a yi si kɛ hyɛ zugba mi gaa, se a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nae kaa ja haomi kɛ diblii kpii nɛ woɔ nɔ he gbeye nɛ a ngɛ mɛ fiee kɛ ngɛ mi woe.
He ko he ko be nɛ a maa gu kɛ je haomi nɛ ɔ mi.
Matsɛ nɛ ma hwɔɔ se ɔ Zebulun kɛ Naftali wɛtso ɔmɛ a zugba nɛ be ko mi a pue e hɛ mi si ɔ, hwɔɔ se ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ: kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ beleku je kɛ yaa su Yordan pa a se, kɛ yaa su Galilea nitsɛ, he nɛ nibwɔhi hii ɔ. Ma nɛ hi diblii kpii mi ɔ na la kpetekpleenyɛ ko.
A hi zugba ko nɛ nɔ wo diblii kpii nɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ la ngɛ kpɛe ha mɛ.
Yawɛ, o ha nɛ ma a bɔ, nɛ o ha mɛ bua jɔmi babauu.
A ngɛ nyae ngɛ o hɛ mi kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ní kpae, loo nihi nɛ ngɛ ta yibu ní dlae ha a he.
Ejakaa lohwe kuɛpã tso nɛ jiɔ kaa tlomi ngɛ a nɔ, kɛ to tsɔ̃mi tso nɛ a kɛ fiaa a konɔ kɛ wa mɛ yi mi ɔ, o ku a mi kaa bɔ nɛ blema a o pee Midian bi ɔmɛ ɔ. Ta buli nɛ ma wɔ tuami ɔ, a tokota amɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ nɛ muɔ sɛ mi ɔ, a kɛ la maa sã lɛ tsuo, kaa lɛ́ ngɛ la mi.
Ejakaa a fɔ bi ha wɔ!
A ha wɔ binyumuyo!
Lɛ nɛ e ma ba ye wa nɔ.
A ma tsɛ lɛ ke, “Nyakpɛ ga wolɔ,” “Mawu he walɔ,” “Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene,” “Ganɔ nɛ yi nɔ jɔ.” E nɔ yemi ɔ ma he si, nɛ e maa bɔ; ma a ma na tue mi jɔmi daa, ejakaa e maa ye tsɛ kaa Matsɛ David nitsɛ se yelɔ.
E maa pee kpakpa, nɛ e maa ye dami sane, kɛ maa je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa su je mi nyagbe.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ ma tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Yawɛ maa gbla Israel tue Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bu Yakob nina, Israel ma a fɔ.
Israel bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Samaria ma a mi ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na maa le kaa lɛ nɛ e tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, a ngɛ a he nɔ woe; a ngɛ pupuupu pee.
A ngɛ dee ke, “Bliikisi we ɔmɛ ku pue si; wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa ngɔ tɛ nɛ a kó kɛ maa ma ekohu.
A poo sikamore tsohi ngɔ pueɔ si; se wɔɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ seda tso kpakpahi ma tsake mɛ.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ sú a he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ wo mɛ.
Siria ngɛ beleku je, nɛ Filistia ngɛ bonyoku je.
A pa a nya mi hatoo, konɛ a mii Israel.
Enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
E ngɛ mi kaa e gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi kake too ɔ, Yawɛ gbla Israel ma a tue.
E po mɛ ngɔ hɛɛ fɔ, yi kɛ hlemi tsuo.
Nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ji yi ɔ nɛ; nɛ lakpa gbali ɔmɛ ji hlemi ɔ nɛ.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi ɔ ha ma a laa blɔ, nɛ a pee basaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na we nihewi ɔmɛ a he bua jɔmi.
Yalɔyi ɔmɛ, kɛ awusa amɛ hu e mɛ nɛ mɔbɔ; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo li Mawu; a pee a he yiwutsotsɛmɛ, nɛ munyu yaya pɛ a tuɔ.
Enɛ ɔ tsuo he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ma a yi wu tso ní peemi ɔ nya wa kaa la nɛ ngɛ mio tso hue, kɛ miohi sãe.
E ngɛ tsoe kaa hue nɛ ngɛ sãe, nɛ la su ku ngɛ jee titiiti kɛ yaa hiɔwe.
Akɛnɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mi mi fu he je ɔ, e tue gblami ɔ nya wa kaa la nɛ ngɛ nimli tsuo a hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e wami he plee.
O maa na nɛ nihi ngɛ ní gblɔe hiɔ kɛ muɔ, nɛ a ngɛ yee tsuatsuaatsua, se a tɔɛ gblee.
Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ po, a ngɛ yee!
Manase bi, kɛ Efraim bi maa hwu ta, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ma bua kɛ wo Yuda he.
Enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ woɔ mlaahi nɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngmaa mlaahi nɛ nyɛ kɛ waa ye ma a yi mi.
Jã nyɛ peeɔ kɛ kpɔɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a blɔ nya níhi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ nyɛ yi dami sane ha we mɛ.
Jã nyɛ peeɔ kɛ kpɔɔ yalɔyihi kɛ awusahi a weto ní ngɛ a dɛ.
Ke Mawu bɔni nyɛ tue gblami ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ?
Ke e ngɔ haomi kɛ je ma se kɛ ba na nyɛ ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ?
Mɛnɔ ngɔ nyɛ ma sa fo kɛ ya ya hla yemi kɛ buami?
Jije nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ juetli kɛ to?
Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ji, nyɛ maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi, aloo a maa nuu nyɛ kɛ ho kaa pamitsɛmɛ.
Enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Mawu maa ngɔ Asiria matsɛ ɔ kɛ gbla e ma a tue Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Asiria, o ngɛ kaa to tsɔmi tso ko nɛ i kɛ gblaa nihi nɛ woɔ ye mi mi la a a tue.
I tsɔ Asiria bi ɔmɛ ke a ya tua ma ko nɛ li Mawu, ma nɛ wo ye mi mi la a. I tsɔ mɛ ke a ya ha ní, nɛ a kpɔ níhi pani nya; nɛ a naa ni ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa mɔsɔ ngɛ blɔ mi.” Se Asiria matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ e to yi mi kpa mohu.
E to kaa e ma kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi.
E fĩaa nɛ e deɔ ke, “Anɛ ye tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, pi matsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo lo?
Kalno ma a, kɛ Karkemish ma a nɛɛ, mɛni slɔɔto ngɛ a kpɛti?
Anɛ Hamat ma a be kaa Arpad ma a lo?
Samaria kɛ Damasko ɔ nɛɛ, slɔɔto ko ngɛ a kpɛti lo?
Jamɛ a nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ kɛ a mi amagahi nɛ hiɛ kulaa pe amagahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Samaria a, pi imi nɛ i gbla mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tue lo?
Bɔ nɛ i kpata Samaria, kɛ e we amaga amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, anɛ i be nyɛe ma pee Yerusalem, kɛ amaga amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu jã lo?” Se Yawɛ ke, “Ke i gbe nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsue ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ɔ nya a, ma gbla Asiria matsɛ ɔ tue ngɛ e he nɔ womi, kɛ e fiami babauu ɔ he.” Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ fĩae nɛ e ngɛ dee ke, “Imi nitsɛ lɛ i tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ye he wa, i le ní, nɛ i to ga saminya.
I ye zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ i gbɛ ma amɛ a huzu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti; nɛ níhi nɛ a bua nya ngɔ to ɔ, i ngɔ.
I ngɔ ye he wami nɛ i kɛ ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Je ma amɛ a juetli ɔ pee kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ tsu nɛ ye nine ya su nɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ a muɔɔ hlui nɛ a je he ɔ, ja i bua je ɔ tsuo nya.
Lohwe ko fiɛ pɛli mi ɔ, i nui eko kuɛ si, loo pɛmi po.” Se nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ bie ji, “Anɛ gbiɛ ma nyɛ maa fĩa ke e kle pe nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ lo?
Anɛ sau ma nyɛ maa wo e he ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ gblae ɔ lo?
Tsa pi dɛma tso nɛ hɛɛɔ nɔmlɔ; nɔmlɔ mohu nɛ hɛɛɔ dɛma tso.
To tsɔmi tso ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e fɔ we e he; nɔ ko nɛ fɔɔ lɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ hiɔ kɛ gbla ta buli nɛ je oblai ɔ tsuo a tue.
A maa ta he lo.
La ko ma mle ngɛ a nɔmlɔ tso mi, nɛ la nɛ ɔ maa tso wawɛɛ.
Mawu nɛ ji la kɛ ha Israel ɔ ma mle.
Mawu klɔuklɔu ha Israel ɔ ma mle kɛ la, nɛ ligbi kake too mi ɔ, e maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; e maa sã mio ɔmɛ, kɛ mio tso ɔmɛ tsuo.
