Hue kpakpa amɛ, kɛ ngmɔhi nɛ baa ní saminya a, a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kpataa nɔmlɔ adesa hɛ mi ɔ. Tsohi bɔɔ pɛ maa piɛ ngɛ hue ɔ mi, nɛ jokuɛ nɛ wɛ po ma nyɛ maa kane mɛ.
Nihi bɔbɔyoo pɛ maa kpale kɛ ba Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ be a hɛ ngɔe kɛ fɔ ma a nɛ ka a hɛ mi kpatami ɔ nɔ hu.
A maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ kulaa.
Israel ma a mi nihi bɔbɔyoo pɛ maa kpale kɛ ba a Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɔ ekohu.
E ngɛ mi kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Israel ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia lɛɛ, se nihi bɔbɔyoo pɛ nɛ maa kpale kɛ ba.
A fa nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi, nɛ jã pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ e sa mɛ.
Nɔ́ jemi ko be he kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e de ke e maa pee ɔ. Yawɛ maa gbla Asiria tue Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ e ma nɛ ngɛ Zion ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ ko ye Asiria bi ɔmɛ gbeye; ke kaa a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae kaa bɔ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ pee be ko ɔ po, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.
Ma gbla nyɛ tue be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma fia mɛ kpa kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Midian bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Oreb tɛ sa a he ɔ. Ma gbla Asiria tue kaa bɔ nɛ i gbla Egipt tue ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma je Asiria tlomi ɔ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ma ku kuɛpã tso ɔ nɛ e kɛ wo nyɛ kuɛ ɔ.” He nyɛlɔ ɔ ba tua ma amɛ He nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a je Rimon ba ngɔ Ai ma a!
Ta a ya gu Migron!
A kɛ a tlomi ɔmɛ ya to si ngɛ Mikmash!
A gu yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ kɛ ya hwɔ Geba nyɔ mi!
Nihi nɛ a ngɛ Rama ma a mi ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ Matsɛ Saul ma, Gibea bi ɔmɛ ma fo.
Galim bi, nyɛ kpa ngmlaa!
Laisha bi, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ he nɔ koo, nyɛ Anatot bi!
Nihi nɛ ngɛ Madmena, kɛ Gebim ma amɛ a mi ɔ ma fo kɛ je gbenɔ nya.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ Nob ma a mi mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma kɔ̃ kɛ ngɛ Zion yo ɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ma a tsɔɔe.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ koo si kaa bɔ nɛ tso kɔnihi nɛ a poo ngɛ tso ɔ he nɔɔ si ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ wo a he nɔ gojoo pe kulaa a, a maa poo mɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ a hɛ mi hu ma pue si.
Yawɛ maa poo mɛ pue si kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ gbiɛ poo tsohi ngɛ hue mi ɔ; a maa nɔɔ si haa bum kaa bɔ nɛ Lebanon tso kpakpahi nɔɔ si ɔ!
Matsɛ yemi nɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ mi Ishai, Matsɛ David tsɛ ɔ weku kpa ngɛ kaa tso ko nɛ a po ngɔ fɔ si.
Se matsɛ he maa te si ngɛ David nina a mi kaa bɔ nɛ tso kpɔ nɛ ngɛ zu mi tsɛ̃ɔ kɔni ɔ. Yawɛ mumi ɔ maa ba e nɔ.
E ma ha lɛ sane se kɔmi, nile, kɛ ga nɛ e kɛ maa ye e ma a nɔ.
E maa le Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní, nɛ e maa bu lɛ.
E maa ye Yawɛ gbeye.
Pi nɔ́ nɛ e hɛngmɛ na, loo e tue nu ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa kojo.
Se e kɛ dami sane yemi maa kojo ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ e maa bu nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ a he.
Ke e fa ke a gbla nɔ ko tue ɔ, kɛkɛ a maa gbla e tue.
Ke e fa ke a gbe yayami peelɔ ko ɔ, kɛkɛ pe a gbe lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Dami sane yemi, kɛ anɔkuale yemi ji níhi nɛ e kɛ maa ye ma a nɔ.
Ogbetee kɛ jijɔ maa hi si ngɛ he kake, nɛ ngatsɛ kɛ apletsi bɔbɔyoo maa bu si ngɛ he kake.
Na bi kɛ jata bi ma bla kɛ ye ní, nɛ jokuɛ wayoo pɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ.
Na yo kɛ osisiblisi ma bla kɛ ye ní; a bimɛ maa bu si ngɛ he kake, nɛ jata ma kpe nga kaa na.
Bimwɔyo po ma fiɛ ngɛ sinɔ muɔ nya, nɛ bi nɛ je nyɔ nya kɛ e nine maa wo sinɔ duɔtsɛ muɔ mi.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be e nyɛmi awi yee ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hɛ mi kpatae.
Ejakaa zugba a tsuo maa le Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wo hyi tɔ kɛ nyu ɔ. Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a maa kpale kɛ ba Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, matsɛ he nɛ je Ishai powu ɔ mi ɔ maa da si kaa okadi ko ha je ma amɛ.
A ma bua a he nya kɛ maa ba e matsɛ ma a mi, nɛ a ma ba wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tsu ní kɛ he wami; e maa kpale e ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ kɛ maa ba we ekohu.
A maa je Asiria, Egipt, Patros, Sudan, Elam, Babilonia, Hamat, kɛ mahi nɛ ngɛ wo nya a kɛ ba.
Yawɛ maa si aflangaa kɛ pee okadi kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ kaa Israel, kɛ Yuda ma amɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, e ngɛ a nya buae ekohu, konɛ e kpale mɛ kɛ ba we.
Israel, Efraim nina a kɛ Yuda be nɔ́ he plee hu; nɛ Yuda be Israel nya dooe hu.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, a maa pee kake kɛ ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ bonyoku je; nɛ a maa ha nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ a níhi.
A maa ye Edom kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ hu maa ba a he si ha mɛ.
Yawɛ ma kpata Egipt pa kɔni nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Suez ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
E ma ha nɛ ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ maa fia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ pa a ma gba maa pee pa tsɔwi kpaago, bɔ nɛ ke nɔ wo tokota po e ma nyɛ kɛ po.
Gbɛjegbɛ ko maa je Asiria kɛ ha Israel ma a mi bi nɛ a ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, konɛ a nyɛɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ, benɛ a je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ma a.
Sina la Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ ma la ke, “Yawɛ i ngɛ o yi jee!
Be ko ɔ, o mi mi fu mi, se jehanɛ lɛɛ mo nitsɛ o ngɛ mi bua woe, ejakaa o mi mi fumi ɔ se po.
Mawu ji ye yi wami helɔ; ma ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ i be gbeye yee.
Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi he wami kɛ nyɛmi, lɛ nɔuu ji ye yi wami helɔ.
Ke Mawu he e ma a yi wami ɔ, a bua maa jɔ kaa bɔ nɛ ke nɔ nu nyu mua nɛ e tsui he jɔɔ ɔ.” Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma a ma la nɛ a ma de ke, “Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si!
Nyɛɛ wo e biɛ ta!
Nyɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ le níhi nɛ e pee ɔ!
Nyɛ ha nɛ a le kaa Yawɛ kle!
Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa e tsu ní nguanguahi.
Nyɛ ha je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Zion, nyɛ hwɔ lele nɛ nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi.
Ejakaa Mawu kle, Mawu klɔuklɔu ji Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Mawu maa gbla Babilon tue Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Babilon tue gblami he nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ, ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ si aflangaa ngɛ yo kpataa ko nɔ.
Nyɛ kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ ta buli ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ fɔ mɛ nine kɛ pee okadi ha mɛ ke a ya tua odehe ɔmɛ a ma a, nɛ a sɛ agbo ɔmɛ a mi.
Yawɛ tsɛ e ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, konɛ a gbla ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ a he nɔ woe kɛ ngɛ e mi mi la woe ɔ a tue.
Nyɛɛ bu tue, a ngɛ hoo pee ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nihi babauu lɛ a ngɛ hoo pee nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Niinɛ, je mahi, kɛ nɔ yemihi ngɛ a he nya buae.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ e tabo ɔmɛ miae kɛ ha ta.
A je tsitsaa je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ma.
Yawɛ kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ ma kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi.
Nyɛ kpa bubuubui!
Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su jehanɛ.
Ligbi nɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma kpata níhi a hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ he mi maa po, nɛ sawale maa nu lɛ.
A maa ye gbeye; nɛ a he mi maa hia mɛ kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi.
Gbeye ma ha a maa hi a sibi a hɛ mi hyɛe gaa kɛkɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi maa tsu paa kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ.
Yawɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbeye ɔ ma; a maa na e mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a, kɛ e hɛdɔ ɔ. Je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata; a ma kpata yayami peelɔ tsuaa yayami peelɔ hɛ mi.
Dodoe tsuaa dodoe, kɛ dodoe kuu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ be kpɛe hu.
Ke pu je po, diblii maa wo, nɛ nyɔhiɔ hu be kpɛe.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha amanehlu maa ba je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ ma gbla yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, ma ba lɛ si; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ pupuupu, aloo e yi mi wa a, ma gbla e tue.
Nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a he be hiɛe kulaa; nimli adesahi a he maa hia pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma je ye mi mi fumi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ɔ, ma ha hiɔwe tsuo ma mimiɛ, nɛ zugba a maa je e blɔ he.
“Nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ Babilon ɔ maa ma fo kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugbahi a nɔ ya; a maa gbɛ fĩa kaa odabɔhi nɛ ngɛ fo tue kɛ je de dali a blɔ mi, loo kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a maa nu ɔ, a kɛ dade maa gbe lɛ.
A maa ngɔ a bimwɔwi ngɔ fiaa si, nɛ a ma gbo; a maa ha a we mi níhi, nɛ a maa pee a yi ɔmɛ basabasa ngɛ a hɛ mi paa.” Yawɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Ma ha nɛ Media bi ɔmɛ ma ba tua Babilon.
Media bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bui sika hiɔ, nɛ a hɛ kɔɛ sika tsu nɔ.
A kɛ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ maa gbe nihewi.
Bimwɔwi ngɛ a nyɛmɛ a mi mi po, a be mɛ mɔbɔ nae, nɛ jokuɛwi hu, a be a he bee.
Babilonia nɔ yemi ɔ ji nɔ yemi ko nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe kulaa; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e mi bi ɔmɛ fĩaa.
Se imi Yawɛ, ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Sodom kɛ Gomora a!
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie hu.
Arabia no nɛ ngɛ lalaalo woe po be e bo tsu mae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ gblegbleegble; nɛ to hyɛlɔ ko hu be e to ɔmɛ tsɔ̃e kɛ ya ye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se nga mi lohwehi maa bu si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ lohwehi nɛ ngɛ pɛe hoo.
Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ dugumahi maa bu si ngɛ, nɛ nibɔ níhi kɛ a he gbeyegbeye: yi je kaa nɔmlɔ, kɛ a nane kaa lohwe maa do ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ogbeteehi maa hi pɛe ngɛ a mɔ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ nga mi gbehi hu ngɛ a tsu saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ a mi.
Babilon be ɔ su jehanɛ.
Be bɔbɔyoo pɛ nɛ piɛ ha lɛ; e ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta.”
Ma a maa kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba we Yawɛ maa na e ma Israel mɔbɔ ekohu, nɛ e ma ná a he tsui kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
E maa to mɛ si ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ.
Nibwɔhi ma ba to mɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ maa hi si.
Je ma amɛ maa ngɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ Yawɛ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu, nɛ a ma ba sɔmɔ mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi.
Nihi nɛ nuu Israel nyɔguɛ sa a, jehanɛ lɛɛ Israel hu maa ye a nɔ.
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɛ gbeje Be ma nɛ aywilɛho, haomi, kɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ a nyɛ o nɔ nɛ o tsu ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha lɛ tsuo se maa po.
Ke Yawɛ pee enɛ ɔ, nyɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ maa ye Babilonia matsɛ ɔ he fɛu ke, “Matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ ɔ nɔ si!
E be nɔ ko nɔ ko yi mi wae hu.
Yawɛ ku nɔ yeli yaya amɛ a he wami nya la.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa fiaa je ma amɛ ní, nɛ a nɛ mɛ mɔbɔ kulaa; je mahi nɛ a ye a nɔ ɔ hu, a wa mɛ yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ he jɔɔmi ko be mi.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ je ɔ tsuo na he jɔmi kɛ tue mi jɔmi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lae kɛ bua jɔmi.
Tso nguaa amɛ, kɛ seda tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Lebanon ɔ po ngɛ nyae ke, ‘Matsɛ ɔ kpa sɛ; nɛ nɛ́ e be nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko be nɛ ma ha nɛ a poo wɔ hu!’ “Babilonia matsɛ, gbeje pee klaalo nɛ e ma he mo atuu.
Ni nguahi nɛ hi je mi hyɛ ɔ a kpade ɔmɛ ngɛ si poe.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kpade ɔmɛ ngɛ si tee ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Mɛ tsuo a ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ mo hu o gbɔjɔ kaa wɔ!
Waa kɛ mo sɔ!
Sa a, kpa sakuhi a kɛ laa kɛ woɔ o hɛ mi nyami; se jehanɛ lɛɛ o su gbeje.
Wɔyewɔyehi ji sa nɛ o hwɔɔ si ngɛ nɔ, nɛ gɔgɔhi ji kuutu nɛ ha o nɔ.’ “Babilonia matsɛ, mo nɛ́ o ngɛ kaa nɔkɔ nɛ kpɛɔ hleii makɛ ɔ, o je hiɔwe ba nɔ si bum!
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, o ye mahi a nɔ kunimi, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a tsɛ̃ mo ko si.
O to o yi mi kaa o maa kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe lokoo nɛ o kɛ o matsɛ sɛ ɔ ya ma Mawu dodoe ɔmɛ nɛ ya hiɔwe pe kulaa a a se tɔɔ.
O susu kaa o maa hi si kaa matsɛ ngɛ jamɛ a yo ɔ nɔ, ngɛ omleyi je he nɛ a kpee ngɛ ɔ. O de hu ke o maa kuɔ kɛ ya bɔku ɔmɛ a yi mi tɔɔ; nɛ o maa pee o he kaa Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ.
Se mohu ɔ, a ba mo si kɛ ho gbeje he nɛ mi kuɔ pe kulaa a ya.
“Ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pa a nya mi hatoo maa hi mo hyɛe gaa.
A ma bi ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ mimiɛ je ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ nɔ yemihi a he do blibliibli ɔ, anɛ pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo?
Nɔ nɛ kpata mahi a hɛ mi, nɛ e ha je ɔ he tsuaa he plɛ pee nga kplanaa nɔ ɔ, pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo?’ Je ma amɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hwɔɔ si kɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ yɔkɔ agbohi a mi, se moo lɛɛ o be yɔkɔ ɔ eko kulaa; a sake o gbogboe ɔ ngɔ fɔ he, konɛ e sa.
Nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a gbogboe ɔmɛ ha o nɔ; a sake o kɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ pue tɛ muɔ ko mi kaa gbogboe nɛ a naa nɔ.
Akɛnɛ o kpata o zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ o gbe mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ he je ɔ, a be mo pue kaa matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nimli, yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ a nina ko yi nɛ na wami.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ gbe a bimɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛ bɔni a hɛ mi kpatami koo!
Matsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔmɛ ma gbo ngɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Ke pi ja a, a ma ba te si ekohu; a maa ye je ɔ nɔ, nɛ a maa po mahi ha a he.” Mawu ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma ya tua Babilon ma a, nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi.
E biɛ maa laa.
E ngmɛdu kɛ e nina tsuo a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko yi be wami nae.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Ma ha Babilon ma plɛ pee zugba nɛ tɔ nyu, kɛ ablɛgogoehi a hi he.
Ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Babilon maa pee kaa ma nɛ a bɛɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi hie hu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Mawu ma kpata Asiria bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ka kita ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i to kaa ma pee ɔ maa ba mi ja.
Nɔ́ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma tsu ɔ, ma tsu kokooko.
Ma kpata Asiria bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ ye ma Israel zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma naa a nɔ ngɛ ye yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ma je ye ma a kuɛ kɛ je kuɛpã tso nɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo lɛ ɔ mi; nɛ tlomi nɛ a ha ye ma a tloo ɔ hu, ma je ngɛ a nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi ha je ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ i wo ye kɔni nɔ konɛ ma gbla ma amɛ a tue.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ pee e yi mi kaa e ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ; e wo e kɔni nɔ momo ke e maa gbla a tue, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tsi e nya.
Mawu ma kpata Filisti bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Jeha nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz gbo ɔ nɛ a fiɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ. Filistia bi, nyɛ bua ko jɔ kulaa kaa tso nɛ a kɛ fiaa nyɛ ɔ mi ku.
Ke sinɔ kake gbo ɔ, ekpa nɛ e duɔ nya wa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ ba yeɔ e nane mi.
Sinɔ hlui ko ma pɛ, nɛ sinɔ pɛlitsɛ maa je mi.
Yawɛ ma ha ohiatsɛmɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ niye ní, nɛ e ma ha nɛ nɔ́ nali maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Se nyɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ e ma ha hwɔ nɛ nya wa maa ye nyɛ; hwɔ nɛ ɔ maa gbe nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ e be nɔ kake ngmelu po piɛe.
Nyɛ Filisti ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ kpa ngmlaa!
Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tsui nɛ po!
Ejakaa la su ku ko je omleyi je kɛ ma.
Tabo ko nɛ fɔ̃lɔ ko fɔ̃lɔ ko be mi nɛ ma a nɛ.
Mɛni heto wa ma ha tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ je Filistia kɛ ba a?
Wa ma de mɛ ke Yawɛ to Zion sisi saminya, nɛ e ma a nɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, a tue mi maa jɔ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Mawu ma kpata Moab hɛ mi Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Moab he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɔ kake too mi ɔ, a kpata Ar kɛ Kir a hɛ mi, kɛkɛ nɛ Moab zugba a nɔ tsuo jɔ.
Dibon bi ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a ya wo yana ngɛ a jami he ɔmɛ.
Moab bi ɔmɛ wo yana kɛ nyɛ ya ha Nebo kɛ Medeba.
A sɛ a yi, kɛ a kpɛni tsuo kɛ ye kɔmɔ.
A bu kpekpe ya bo kɛ nyɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a wo yana ngɛ ma kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ a tsu ɔmɛ a yi mi.
Heshbon kɛ Eleale bi ɔmɛ wo yana nɛ a fo boboobo.
A nu huhui ɔ ngɛ Yahaz tɔɔ.
Sawale nu Moab ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli.
Ye tsui ngɛ yee ngɛ Moab he!
Ma mi bi ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ ho Zoar, kɛ Eglat Shelishiya ma amɛ a mi ya.
Ni komɛ kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho Luhit ya, nɛ ni komɛ hu tu fo kɛ ho Horonaim ya kɛ ya boboobo, kɛ kɔmɔ yemi babauu.
Nimrim pa a mii ta, nɛ nga nɛ ngɛ pa a nya a gbli; nɔ́ mumu ko kulaa be lejɛ ɔ hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ngɔ a weto ní tsuo kɛ tu fo kɛ gu Pamploo kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ho kɔ̃ ɔ se ya.
A nu yana a boboobo ngɛ Moab huzu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
A nu ngɛ Eglaim kɛ Beerelim ma amɛ a mi hulɔ.
Dibon pa a pee tsutsuu kɛ muɔ sɔuu.
Se Mawu to yayami nɛ pe enɛ ɔ po ha nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ a he maa je mi, nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ, haomi maa ba a nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ jata lɛ ba tua mɛ.
Moab ní pee mɔbɔ Moab bi ɔmɛ tsɔ nihi kɛ je Sela nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ a dɛ mi to ke a kɛ ya ha nɔ yelɔ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
Moab bi yi ɔmɛ ya pue si ngɛ Arnon pa a pomi he ɔmɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a tsuhi a mi.
A de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, “Wa ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi; nyɛɛ wo wɔ ga koo.
Wa maa hi nyɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛɛ baa wa yi kaa bɔ nɛ tso woɔ hɔ kudɔɔ ngɛ e sisi piani katakata a. Pe a fie wɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ wɔ ngɔ to; nyɛ ko tsɔɔ wa se blɔ.
Nyɛɛ baa wa yi, nyɛ ha waa hi nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ wɔ kɛ wo nihi nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi ɔ a dɛ mi.” Yi mi wami, kɛ hɛ mi kpatami se maa po, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ zugba a hɛ mi kpatae ɔ be si hie hu.
Jehanɛ David nina ko ma ba ye matsɛ.
Anɔkuale yemi kɛ suɔmi e kɛ maa ye ma a nɔ.
E maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da; nɛ e maa ye dami sane.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma he nɔ ke, “Wa nu kaa Moab bi ɔmɛ woɔ a he nɔ wawɛɛ; a peeɔ pupuupu, nɛ a bui nɔ, se a fiami ɔ ya peeɔ nya mi gu fiami.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Moab bi ɔmɛ maa wo yana ngɛ amanehlu nɛ a maa na a he.
Mɛ tsuo a maa wo yana, ke a kai niye ní kpakpa amɛ nɛ a ye be ko nɛ be ngɛ Kir Heres ɔ. Nɛ a maa pee yeyeeye.
Ejakaa a kpata Heshbon ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ Sibma wai tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Je ma amɛ a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ku tso kɔni ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ya su Yazer, kɛ ya kpa nga kplanaa a nɔ tsuo; kɔni ɔmɛ gba kɛ ya su Ngo wo ɔ se tɔɔ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, i ngɛ ya foe ha Sibma wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fo ha Yazer ɔ. Ye vo nyu ɔmɛ ngɛ si puee ngɛ Heshbon kɛ Eleale ma amɛ a he; ejakaa ngmɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ ní kpali a ngmlaa hoo hu se po.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bua jɔɛ e he ngɛ ngmɔhi nɛ baa ní saminya a a nɔ hu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko kpa we ngmlaa; nɔ ko nɔ ko la we ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ̃ wai kɛ ji wai yiblii mi hu.
Lele hwɔmi ngɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ tsuo se po.
I ngɛ ya foe kɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ha Moab; nɛ ye tsui ngɛ yee ngɛ Kir Heres he.
Moab bi ɔmɛ ngɛ dengme gboe kɛ ngɛ a jami he ɔmɛ yae ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; a ngɛ a gba tsu ɔmɛ a mi yae ya ngɛ kue fae, se lɛ tsuo maa pee yaka.
Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha momo nɛ kɔɔ Moab he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha etɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Moab ná, kɛ ma a mi nimli babauu ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sue; pohu a ma gbɔjɔ.”
Mawu maa gbla Siria kɛ Israel tue Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Damasko be ma nitsɛ pee hu; e ma ba pee ma doku kulaa.
Nimli be Siria ma amɛ a mi hie gblegbleegble hu.
Lejɛ ɔmɛ maa pee tohi kɛ nahi a ní yemi he; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ fiee.
Israel be lɛ nitsɛ e he nyɛe ma fa hu, nɛ Damasko nɔ yemi ɔ se maa po.
Siria bi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ nɔuu.
Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ lɛ i de.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Be ma nɛ Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo maa ta; sa a, a ná ní kpɔtɔɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a maa ye ohia.
Israel zugba a maa pee kaa ngmɔ nɛ a kpɔ e nɔ blɛfo tsuo ta, loo kaa bɔ nɛ Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ mi peeɔ falifali ke a kpɛte ní ta lejɛ ɔ. Nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami.
Israel maa pee kaa oliv tso nɛ a kplɔ e nɔ yiblii tsuo: yiti je ɔ, yiblii enyɔ loo etɛ kɛkɛ lɛ maa hi tso kɔni ɔmɛ a he; sisi ɔ hu eywiɛ, loo enuɔ kɛkɛ.
Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ lɛ i de.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi maa kpale kɛ ba a bɔlɔ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba hla yemi kɛ buami.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a puɛ ɔ, a be mɛ bue hu.
Níhi nɛ a kɛ a nine pee, amagahi nɛ a puɛ ha yo mawu nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a, kɛ la tɛhi nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, a be mɛ hu bue.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi nɛ a ngɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi po ma si a ma amɛ ngɔ fɔ si.
Ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, kaa bɔ nɛ Hiv bi kɛ Amon bi tu fo kɛ je a ma amɛ a mi, benɛ a na Israel ta a nɛ ma mɛ tuami ɔ. Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ kpɔ mo kɛ je o he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nɛ e pee kaa tɛ sa nguaa ko ha mo ɔ, o hɛ je e nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o ngɛ ngmɔhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu pee, nɛ o ngɛ ma se tsohi due ngɛ a mi.
Se ke tso ɔmɛ ma tsɛ̃, nɛ a ma gba mɔmɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ mɔtu ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ o du mɛ ɔ po, o be yiblii ko kulaa náe.
Haomi kɛ he hiami nɛ be tsa ba mohu o ma ná.
A ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ Je mahi nɛ a he wa ngɛ hoo pee kaa wo nɛ gli, nɛ oslɔke nguaa amɛ ngɛ kue bum bum kɛ ngɛ si puee.
Je ma amɛ hia kɛ ma kaa wo oslɔke; se Mawu ku a nya la, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ yaa kaa bunyuku nɛ ngɛ tee puu ngɛ yoku he, loo kaa dwɔmi nɛ ahumi ngɔ kɛ yaa.
Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, a woɔ wa he gbeye, se benɛ mɔtu ke e suu ɔ, a be.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba fiaa wɔ ojo, nɛ a kpakpaa wa he ní kɛ yaa a, bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mawu maa gbla Sudan tue Zugba ko ngɛ Sudan pa amɛ a se kɛ e nɔ abalaa lɛhi babauu.
A tsɔ nihi kɛ je jamɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ma.
A hi lɛhi nɛ a kɛ ngɔwu pee a mi kɛ gu Nilo pa a nɔ kɛ ma.
Nyɛ tsɔli nɛ nyɛ he sɔɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya nyɛ zugba kɛ e mi pahi babauu ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya ha nyɛ ma kɛ e mi katsɛmɛ, nimli gagaagahi kɛ a he womi nɔ tlotlootlo nɛ je ɔ tsuo yee mɛ gbeye ɔ. Nyɛ, nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ maa na aflangaa ko nɛ a si ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ!
Nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛ maa nu nɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae!
Ejakaa Yawɛ de mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ ngma kpami be mi je mi dɔɔ la nyɔ mi nɛ bɔ́ nɛɛ ɔ, loo bɔ nɛ ke pu tso ngmangmaangma nɛ je mi dɔɔ la, nɛ́ kɔɔhiɔ mi peeɔ kom ɔ, ja ma pee dii ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ hyɛ.
Loko wai yiblii nya buami be maa su, be mi nɛ mɔmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ma kplɔ pue si, nɛ wai yiblii ɔmɛ maa pee kaa a ngɛ fue ɔ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma kpata Sudan bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngɔɔ tso he suami dade kɛ poɔ wai tso kɔnihi.
Ta buli nɛ maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a ma si a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ ha hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ nga mi lohwehi.
Latsa be ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye, nɛ fĩɛ be ɔ, nga mi lohwehi hu maa ye.” Be ma nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma na nike ní kɛ je zugba kɛ e nɔ pahi babauu ɔ nɔ.
E ma na nike ní kɛ je nimli gagaagahi kɛ a he tlotlootlo nɛ je ɔ tsuo yee mɛ gbeye ɔ a dɛ mi.
A maa ba Zion yo ɔ nɔ, he nɛ a jaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ.
Mawu maa gbla Egipt tue Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Egipt he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ hi bɔku nɔ kɛ fo kɛ ma Egipt.
Egipt amaga amɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli kaa Yawɛ ma, nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ hu sawale nu mɛ.
Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma gba ta kɛ wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he; nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi, nɔ kɛ e piɛ nine nɔ no, zugba kɛ zugba, ma kɛ ma, matsɛ kɛ matsɛ.
Ma ha ga amɛ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ to ɔ maa pee yaka, nɛ a mumu nya maa ta.
A ma de amaga amɛ ke a ba piɛ a he; a ma ya bi ní ngɛ ní peeli a ngɔ, nɛ a ma bi ga womi kɛ je klamɔhi, kɛ kpade tsɛli a ngɔ.
Ma ngɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɔ wo matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ ko dɛ mi; e maa ye a nɔ, nɛ a ma tsu ní kpakpataa ha lɛ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.” Nilo pa a maa fã hluu kɛ yaa si nyu ɔ maa ta pa a mi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ ma gbli.
Be mi nɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ tae ɔ, a ma bɔni fu jemi.
Ngɔwu kɛ go ma gbli; niba ní tsuo nɛ a du ngɛ Nilo pa a tue ɔ ma ngla, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Hɛli kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ fɔɔ gbowe ngɛ Nilo pa a mi ɔ maa ye kɔmɔ, nɛ a maa wo yana.
Ya fɔli tsuo a ni maa pee mɔbɔ.
Kpa tslɔli, kɛ kploba loli tsuo a nine mi maa je wu.
A ma kpata ma a mi nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ apaa yeli ɔmɛ maa ye kɔmɔ.
Ganɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Zoan ɔ, kuasiahi sɔuu ji mɛ!
Ga woli nɛ a buu mɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ, ga yaya mohu a woɔ!
Kɛ ba kɛɛ nɛ a deɔ matsɛ ɔ ke blema womi mi leli, kɛ matsɛmɛ a bimɛ ji mɛ kɛɛ?
Egipt matsɛ, jije o ga woli nɛ le ní saminya a ngɛ?
Eko ɔ, a ma nyɛ ma de mo yi mi nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ to ngɛ Egipt he.
Zoan kɛ Memfis ganɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, kuasiahi sɔuu ji mɛ.
Mɛ nɛ́ a ko tsɔɔ ma a blɔ ɔ, mɛ mohu a ha ma a laa blɔ.
Yawɛ ha a juɛmi tsaka, nɛ a woɔ ga yaya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami sɔuu Egipt ngɛ pee.
Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ si tataae kaa dã tɔlɔ ko nɛ ngɛ si nɔe ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e vie mi.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be Egipt nɛ ma nyɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko maa pee ha mɛ, niatsɛ jio, dɛgulɔ jio, nɔ nɛ ngɛ biɛ jio, nɔ gu jio.
Egipt ma ja Yawɛ Be ma nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa pee a he fɔ̃li kaa yihi.
Ke a na kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ miɔ nɛ e kɛ e he wami ɔ maa gbla a tue ɔ, a he ma bɔni domi blibliibli.
Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa wo Yuda ta a, sawale maa nu Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ to nɛ maa ba Egipt nɔ ɔ he.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, Hebri gbi ji gbi nɛ a maa tu ngɛ Egipt ma ngua enuɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ biɛ a kɛ ma ka kita.
Nɛ a maa wo ma amɛ eko biɛ ke, “Pu ma.” Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a maa ma Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ; nɛ a maa to tɛ titima ko nɛ a gbaa nɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ Egipt huzu ɔ nya.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa da si kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ he okadihi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ yi mi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ wae ɔ he ɔ, e maa tsɔ nɔ ko nɛ e ba kpɔ mɛ.
Yawɛ ma je e he si kɛ tsɔɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa le lɛ; a ma ja lɛ, nɛ a kɛ sami bɔhi, kɛ nike ní ma ba ha lɛ.
A ma ka Yawɛ kita nɛ a maa ye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yawɛ maa fiaa Egipt bi ɔmɛ ní, se lɛ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ ma tsa mɛ.
A maa kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ; e maa bu a kue fami ɔmɛ tue, nɛ e ma tsa mɛ.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a maa je gbɛjegbɛ ko kɛ je Egipt kɛ ya Asiria.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa ya Asiria bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ hu maa ya Egipt bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a maa pee kake kɛ ja Mawu.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, Israel maa pee ma nɔ́ nɛ ji etɛ kɛ piɛ Egipt kɛ Asiria he, nɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ ma ba pee gbaami ha je ɔ tsuo.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa gbaa mɛ ke, “A gbaa mo, ye ma, Egipt, kɛ Asiria nɛ i ngɔ ye nine kɛ bɔ, kɛ Israel, ma nɛ i hla ngɔ to kaa ye weto ní.”
Gbalɔ he gu hɛɛlɔ ɔ we okadi Asiria matsɛ, Sargon fa Asiria asafoatsɛngua a ke e ya tua Filisti bi a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashdod ɔ. Jeha etɛ loko sane nɛ ɔ maa ba a, Yawɛ de Amoz bi Yesaya ke, “Je kpekpe ɔ ngɛ o mlɛ mi, kɛ tokota nɛ ngɛ o nane ɔ.” E bu tue, nɛ e pee ja; e hɛɛ e he gu, kɛ e nane gu.
Benɛ a ngɔ Ashdod ma a, Yawɛ de ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ Yesaya hɛɛ e he gu, nɛ e nyɛɛ e nane gu jeha etɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba Egipt kɛ Sudan a nɔ ɔ he okadi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Asiria matsɛ maa nuu nihi ngɛ ma enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ho kɛ a he gu.
Jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi tsuo maa nyɛɛ a nane gu, nɛ a maa hɛɛ a he gu; a supa nya tsuo maa fɔ si gu, nɛ zo maa gbe Egipt.
Nihi nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Sudan nɔ, nɛ a fĩa fɔ Egipt nɔ ɔ, a hɛ mi maa pee mɛ yaa, nɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo maa ta.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Filistia wo ɔ nya a ma de ke, ‘Nihi nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ kaa a ma je wɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba!
Wɔɔ lɛɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa yi ma na wami?’ ”
Babilon hɛ mi kpatami he nina Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Babilonia he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ lasiogblee bee huu ngɛ leneyi je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ puɛɔ ní ɔ, jã kɛ̃ hɛ mi kpatami maa je zugba ko nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeye nɔ kɛ ba.
I na nina ko nɛ kɔɔ yi wu tso níhi nɛ maa ba a a he; a maa ngɔ nihi kɛ wo amanehlu mi, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Elam tabo, tee si nɛ o tua mɛ!
Media tabo, wo ma amɛ a he ka!
Amanehlu nɛ Babilon kɛ ba a, Mawu ma ha e se maa po.
Nɔ́ nɛ i na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nu nɛ ɔ wo ye he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ ye he mi hia mi kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi.
E pee mi kaa ye hɛ mi ngɛ mi tsitsɛɛe, nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli kɛ sawale.
Jinɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa du nɛ bu mla, se gbeye níhi mohu nɛ je mi kɛ ba.
I na ngɛ nina a mi kaa a tsɛ ní yemi ko; nihi hii si ngɛ kuutuhi a nɔ kɛ ngɛ ní yee, nɛ a ngɛ ní nue.
Tlukaa a, a nu nɛ a fa ke, “Ganɔhi!
Nyɛɛ te si, nɛ nyɛɛ pɔ nyɛ tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ a he nu!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de mi ke, “Ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ya da si nɛ e hi huɔe, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa na a, e de.
Ke e na okpɔngɔhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli nɛ a to enyɔɔnyɔ, loo nihi nɛ a hi tejihi, kɛ afukpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ma a, e pee klaalo.” Bulɔ ɔ kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i daa si ngɛ ye blɔ he ɔ kɛ ngɛ bue nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo.” Tlukaa a, ta zugba lɛ kɛ e mi nimli, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli nɛ to enyɔɔnyɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ba hia kpo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bulɔ ɔ kpa ngmlaa ekohu ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata oo, e hɛ mi kpata!
Amaga amɛ nɛ a ngɛ jae ɔ tsuo ku pueɔ si!” Ye ma Israel, mo nɛ́ be ko ɔ, a hao mo, nɛ a wa mo yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa ngma nɛ a gbee, nɛ a sa mi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ bu manye munyu tue.
Manye munyu nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ, i nu kɛ je Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɔ.
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Edom he Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Edom he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ ko ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ je Edom kɛ ngɛ bie ke, “Bulɔ, nyɔ mi mɛni be ji nɛ ɔ?
Bulɔ, ngmlɛ nyɛmɛ a fia?” I he nɔ ke, “Je na ta, se nyɔ maa kpale ba ekohu.
Ke o suɔ kaa o ma ba bi si ekohu ɔ, kpale kɛ ba nɛ o ba bi.” Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Arabia he Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Arabia he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ Dedan blɔ hiali a kuu nɛ nyɛ ba pueɔ si ngɛ Arabia nga kplanaa a nɔ, nibwɔhi nɛ kuma gbe mɛ nɛ a ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu.
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Tema zugba a nɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ha mɛ nɔ ko nɛ a ye.
Ta kɛ e mi amanehlu babauu nya ni ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ je ɔ nɛ; a hia klaate kɛ wo a he, nɛ a dɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi kɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ fo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha kake pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, Kedar weku ɔmɛ a he wami ɔ se maa po.
Kedar kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ji kã peeli pe kulaa nɛ a le, se a ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ maa piɛ.
Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ lɛ i de.”
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Yerusalem he Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ nina kɔ̃ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mɛni ba?
Mɛni o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo kuɔ kɛ ho a tsuhi a yi mi ya ya ngɛ pee?
Ma a mi tsuo pee hoo kɛ ngmlaa kɛ gidigidi sɔuu.
O nihi nɛ gbo nɛ ɔ, pi ta nya nɛ a nɔ ngɛ.
O we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo kɛ je; a nyɛ we nɛ a tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kake po, nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nuu mɛ nine nya.
Nihi nɛ nine su a nɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ fo tue kɛ yaa tsitsaa loko a nuu mɛ.
Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ ma nyɛ ya wawɛɛ ha nihi nɛ gbo ɔ. Nyɛ ko gba nyɛ he nya kaa nyɛ maa jɔɔ ye bua.
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ ba wa nɔ ngɛ nina kɔ̃ ɔ mi ji haomi, basabasa peemi, kɛ gidigidi peemi sɔuu.
A ku ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
Ngmlaa ngɛ pɛe ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo kɛ ngɛ balɔ tsɛe.
Ta buli hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ je Elam kɛ ba kɛ a dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃.
Ta buli nɛ je Kir hu mia kɛ tsɛ̃i ja nɔuu.
Yuda kɔ̃ zugbahi nɛ baa ní saminya a, a mi hyi tɔ kɛ ta zugba lɛhi; ta buli nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ daa si ngɛ Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a nya.
Yuda nyɛ we he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nya nɛ e da ngɛ he ko he ko.
Benɛ e ba lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ya sɛ nyɛ ta nito he, nɛ nyɛ je ta hwumi níhi kpo.
-Nyɛ hyɛ Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ hehi nɛ hia kaa a dla.
Nyɛ hyɛ wehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ku ekomɛ kɛ pue si, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ dla fia gbogbo ɔmɛ.
Jehanɛ, nyɛ susu nyu he, nɛ nyɛ pee nyu nɔ́ agbo ko ngɛ ma a mi, konɛ nyu nɛ jee taku momo ɔ mi ɔ nɛ sɛ mi.
Nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ, se Mawu ɔ nɛ to ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a blɔ nya blema lokoo ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hla we e se blɔ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tsɛ ke nyɛ fo ya nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ; nyɛɛ sɛ nyɛ yi kpalokpalo, nɛ nyɛɛ ha kpekpe ya bo, se nyɛ pee we ja; nyɛ muɔ nɛ nyɛ nya mohu.
Nyɛ gbe to kɛ na nɛ nyɛ ye ní, nɛ nyɛ nu ní.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ de ji, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ye ní nɛ waa nu ní, ejakaa hwɔɔ pɛ wa ma gbo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ de mi ke, “A kɛ yayami nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ be mɛ pae a wami be ɔ tsuo.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.” A bɔ Shebna kɔkɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi Shebna, tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɔ ke ma ya de lɛ ke, “Kɛ o susuu ngɛ o he kɛɛ?
Mɛnɔ ji mo?
Mɛnɔ ha mo he blɔ kaa o kpɛ yɔkɔ ha o he ngɛ tɛ sa mi ngɛ yoku nɛ ɔ he?
O susuu kaa nɔ ko nɛ he hia tsɔ ji mo, se bu tue, Yawɛ maa hɛ mo kɛ fɔ he.
E ma koklo mo lokotoo kaa bɔɔlu, nɛ e maa hɛ mo ngɔ fɔ zugba agbo gbajaa ko nɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ o ma gbo ngɛ ngɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ ɔ a kasa nya.
O pue o nyɔmtsɛ we ɔ hɛ mi si, mo zotsɛ!
Yawɛ maa ba mo si; a kpɔ o blɔ nya ngɛ o dɛ.” Yawɛ de Shebna ke, “Ke e ba mi ja a, ma tsɛ ye tsɔlɔ Eliakim, Hilkia bi ɔ kɛ ba.
Ma ngɔ o ní tsumi tade wuyaa a ngɔ wo lɛ, nɛ ma mia lɛ kɛ o mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ. Nɛ blɔ nya tsuo nɛ o hɛɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ e maa pee kaa tsɛ kɛ ha Yerusalem ma a, kɛ Yuda zugba a tsuo.
He wami blɔ nya nɛ Matsɛ David sɛ ɔ hɛɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ.
He wami blɔ nya nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa safe ko.
Ke e bli ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma nga, nɛ ke e nga a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma bli.
Ma to lɛ si saminya, nɛ e he maa wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa tso plɛɛko nɛ e ma ba pee kaa jlasi ko kɛ wo e tsɛ we ɔ tsuo hɛ mi nyami.
“Se e tsɛ we ɔ, e bimɛ, e nyɛmimɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo ma ba pee tlomi ngɛ e nɔ kaa kutuhi kɛ kãhi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ tso plɛɛko he!
Ke e ba mi ja a, tso plɛɛko ɔ ma gbɔjɔ, nɛ e maa hia kɛ nɔ si.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kplaa si ngɛ he ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Fonisia he Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Tiro he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ akua hluili ngɛ wo nɔ, nyɛ nya awe nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ.
Ejakaa nyɛ lɛsimuɔ he ngɛ Tiro ɔ, a kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; we ɔmɛ, kɛ lɛ dami he ɔ tsuo hɛ mi kpata.
Benɛ nyɛ lɛ ɔmɛ kpale kɛ je Kipro kɛ ma a nɛ nyɛ nu sane nɛ ɔ. Sidon jua yeli, nyɛ ma nyɛ nya!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ nihi kɛ poo wo kɛ ya heɔ blɛfo ngɛ Egipt, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo yeɔ jua a ji nɛ ɔ!
Sidon ma, zo gbe mo!
Bɔ nɛ wo kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I fɔ we hyɛ, nɛ i lɛ́ binyumuwi kɛ biyiwi hyɛ.” E maa pee Egipt bi po nyakpɛ, nɛ a maa hao, ke a nu kaa a kpata Tiro hɛ mi ɔ. Nyɛ Fonisia bi, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ya Spania!
Tiro, ma nɛ a po blema lokoo, nɛ bua jɔmi hyi lɛ tɔ ɔ, lɛ tete ji nɛ ɔ?
Ma nɛ mi bi po wo kɛ ya to mahi a sisi ngɛ wo se tɔɔ ɔ, lɛ kɛ̃ ji nɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ nɛ to ga kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ba Tiro nɔ ɔ?
Tiro, matsɛ ma nguaa kɛ e mi jua yeli kpanakpanaa nɛ ji ganɔhi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami saminya ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, mɛnɔ ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba e nɔ ɔ?
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ pee.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ a he nɔ womi ɔ se nɛ po, nɛ nimli nguangua amɛ hu a he guɛ nɛ gbo.
Nyɛ Spania bi, nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya hu.
Ejakaa lɛsimuɔ he ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hu.
Yawɛ kɛ e he wami kpata nɔ yemi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ wo se tsitsaa lokoo.
Yawɛ nɛ ku Sidon mɔ ɔmɛ.
Sidon ma, o bua jɔmi ɔ se po, nɛ a ngɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ yi mi wae.
Ke a tu fo kɛ ho Kipro ya tete po, lejɛ ɔ hu, a be he jɔmi nae.
Tsa pi Asiria bi nɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ; Babilonia bi mohu nɛ ha lohwe dikali ba tua Tiro ma a; mɛ nɛ a fia kpoku kɛ wo Tiro ma a he, nɛ a ku mɔ nguangua amɛ kɛ pee lɛ ma doku.
Nyɛ Spania akua hluili ngɛ wo nɔ, nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ!
Ma nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Be ma nɛ nihi a hɛ maa je Tiro nɔ jeha nyingmi kpaago sɔuu, nɛ ji matsɛ kake wami be tsuo.
Jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, Tiro maa pee kaa yo ajuama nɛ a wo lɛ la.
Mo, yaholɔ nɛ nihi a hɛ je o nɔ, ngɔɔ o kpa saku ɔ kɛ ya kpa ma a mi!
Fiaa saku ɔ, nɛ o la kɛ to he kaa sa be ko ɔ, konɛ nyumuhi nɛ a ba o ngɔ ekohu!
Jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ maa na Tiro mɔbɔ, nɛ e ma ha nɛ Tiro, kɛ je ma amɛ ma ya tsu ní ekohu kaa sa a; e kɛ ma amɛ tsuo ma ya ye jua.
Sika nɛ e ma na kɛ je e jua yemi ɔ mi ɔ, e maa gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
E be nya buae kɛ to, se mohu nihi nɛ ma ba ja Yawɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ sika nɛ ɔ kɛ he niye ní, kɛ heha ní nɛ hia mɛ.
Yawɛ maa gbla je ɔ tue Yawɛ ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ zugba a maa fɔ si gu.
E ma plɛ zugba a hɛ mi bu si, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, e maa gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.
Tue gblami kake lɛ ngɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ, osɔfo jio, ma a jio, nyɔguɛ jio, nyɔmtsɛ jio, ní helɔ jio, ní jualɔ jio, nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ pae ha nɔ jio, nɔ nɛ ya ngɛ nɔ pae jio, niatsɛ jio, dɛgulɔ jio.
Zugba a kɛ e nɔ níhi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Yawɛ lɛ de.
Zugba a gbli, nɛ e pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee; je ɔ tsuo pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ pɔ tɔ lɛ; nimli ɔmɛ tsuo gbɔjɔ.
Ni ɔmɛ ble zugba a; nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi tɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
A tsake blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ somi nɛ ngɛ daa a hu a yi nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu gbiɛ zugba a. Ni ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee ɔ he.
Nihi babauu a hɛ mi kpata; nihi bɔɔ pɛ lɛ piɛ.
Wai he be hu; ejakaa wai tso ɔmɛ gbli.
Nihi tsuo nɛ a bua jɔ be ko ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
Saku kɛ miɛ, la kɛ do nɛ a kɛ nyaa a tsuo se po.
Nihi pa nui wai nɛ a la kɛ to he hu; dã nɛ nya wa dooɔ ngɛ a nya mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pee basaa ngɛ ma a mi; nɛ a nga agbo ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko sɛ we ɔmɛ a mi.
Nihi ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; ejakaa wai ta.
Bua jɔmi ta kulaa; bua jɔmi laa kaa nɔ ko nɛ a je lɛ we.
A ku gbogbo ɔmɛ dukuduku ngɔ pue si, nɛ ma a tsuo plɛ pee ma doku.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa ta kaa bɔ nɛ ke a kpa ngmɔ nɔ ní ta, nɛ a kplɔɔ wai yiblii tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ taa tso ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ wai yiblii kake po piɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ ma la kɛ bua jɔmi.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ ma de ke Yawɛ kle, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ma je e yi.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ wo nya je ɔ hu ma je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi.
Wa nu yi jemi lahi nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ je je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ dalɔ ɔ hɛ mi nyami woe.
Se imi lɛɛ, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko kulaa be ha mi!
He lo kɛkɛ i ngɛ tae.
Ye yi ta pɛ!
Yi mi sɔuu nɛ nihi ngɛ a sibi wae kpamisa.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi, gbeye níhi ngɛ blɔ nɔ ha nyɛ; a tsua muɔ voovoohi ha nyɛ, nɛ a tsɔ nyɛ klamahi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ma fo kɛ je gbeye ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ maa nɔ muɔ voo mi, nɛ nɔ nɛ be muɔ voo ɔ mi nɔe ɔ maa du klama.
Hiɔmi maa nɛ piapiaapia, nɛ je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ ma mimiɛ.
Je ɔ mi ma gba; e maa ku, nɛ e maa gbɛ fĩa.
E maa hi kpae kɛ hi yae kɛ hi bae kaa dã tɔlɔ, aloo ngmɔ si tsu nɛ kɔɔhiɔ sɛ mi.
Yayamihi nɛ je ɔ tloo ɔ ngɛ lɛ gbee; ke e hule pue si ɔ, e be si tee gblegbleegble hu.
Be ma nɛ Yawɛ maa gbla hiɔwe ta a, kɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a tue.
Mawu ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya kɛ wo muɔ voo mi kaa pamitsɛmɛ.
E maa wo mɛ tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa gbla a tue.
Nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii, nɛ pu be tsoe hu, ejakaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ye matsɛ.
E maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ maa na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ.
Yi jemi la Yawɛ, mo ji ye Mawu; ma wo o hɛ mi nyami, nɛ ma je o biɛ ɔ yi; ejakaa o tsu nyakpɛ níhi.
O yi mi tomi ɔmɛ nɛ o to blema lokoo ɔ, o ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
O ha mahi plɛ pee ma dokuhi, gbogbohi nɛ a fia wo a he ɔ, lɛ tsuo ku kɛ pueɔ si.
Matsɛmɛ a mɔhi nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ ma a, a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, a be ekoeko nae hu gblegbleegble.
Mahi nɛ a he wa saminya a ma je o yi; Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi tsuo maa ye mo gbeye.
O ngɛ kaa mɔ kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ.
O ngɛ kaa mɔ kɛ ha nɔ́ nali.
Mo ji a wesa he ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi, kɛ hɔ̃ ngɛ pu ngmangmaangma nya.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi wa kaa ahumi ngɛ fĩɛ be mi po, o jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ a dɛ mi.
Ose nɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ hee ɔ, o ku nya la kaa bɔ nɛ ke je mi dɔ la nɛ bɔku haa zugba jɔɔ ɔ. Nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ kpa a lami ɔ si kake too.
Yawɛ maa ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngua Yawɛ maa ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ ha je ma amɛ tsuo.
A maa ye ní kpakpa: lo nɛ tu zɔ saminya, kɛ zɔ nɛ a je kɛ je wu mi tɔɔ; nɛ a maa nu wai kpakpa.
Haomi nɛ ba je ma amɛ a nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ bo lɛ a kɛ ha a nɔ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nɛ lɛ tsuo se maa po ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu maa ye gbenɔ nɔ kunimi; e ma tsu nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi vo nyu, nɛ e ma je zo nɛ gbe e ma a ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ kɛ je.
Yawɛ lɛ de.
Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma de ke, “Wa Mawu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ e kpɔ wɔ.
Lɛ ji Yawɛ.
Akɛnɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ nɛ́ e he wa yi wami he je ɔ, wa bua jɔ wa he, nɛ wa ngɛ nyae.” Mawu maa gbla Moab tue Yawɛ maa bu Zion yo ɔ he, se Moab bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ, a maa naa a nɔ kaa a naa nga nɔ kɛ woɔ dwɔmi mi kɛ ya pueɔ kuku nɔ.
A ma wo a kɔnihi a nɔ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa a maa sile ngɛ nyu mi; se Mawu maa ba a he nɔ womi ɔ si, nɛ a kɔni ɔmɛ a mi ma gbɔjɔ kulaa.
Moab mɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo gojogojoohi ngɔ wo a he ɔ, e maa ku mɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.
Mawu ma ha e ma a maa ye kunimi Be ma nɛ ma a ma la la nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ: Wa ngɛ ma nɛ he wa!
Mawu nitsɛ lɛ buu ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ a he!
Nyɛ bli agbo ɔmɛ, konɛ je ma amɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a sɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ, nɛ e heɔ mo yeɔ ɔ, o haa lɛ tue mi jɔmi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ daa; ejakaa Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ kaa tɛ sa ko nɛ ngɛ daa.
Nihi nɛ wo a he nɔ gojoo ɔ, e ba mɛ si; ma nɛ he wa, nɛ he nɔ woli hi mi ɔ, e kpata e hɛ mi; e ku gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue bunyuku mi.
Nihi nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi be ko ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ mɛ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ a ngɛ si sie ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, a blɔ da tlɔmɔɔ; mo lɛ o ha a blɔ da ja a nɛ.
Yawɛ, wa maa pee o suɔmi nya ní, nɛ wa maa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ; mo pɛ wa suɔ kɛ wa tsui tsuo.
Nyɔ mi ɔ, i hla o se blɔ kɛ ye tsui tsuo; ke o kojo je ɔ kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, loko a maa le nɔ́ nɛ ji dami sane yemi.
E ngɛ mi kaa o naa yiwutsotsɛmɛ mɔbɔ lɛɛ, se a kase we nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
E ngɛ mi kaa a ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a zugba nɔ lɛɛ, se yayami mohu a ngɛ pee kpamisa; a yɔse we kaa Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ji mo.
Yawɛ, o to kaa o maa gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue, se a li tete.
Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a na nɔ́.
Gbla a tue kaa bɔ nɛ o to ha mɛ ɔ. Ha nɛ a na kaa o suɔ o ma a sane saminya.
Yawɛ, mo lɛ o haa wɔ tue mi jɔmi; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee ɔ, mo lɛ o peeɔ ha wɔ.
Yawɛ, o se ɔ, nyɔmtsɛmɛ kpahi ba ye wa nɔ lɛɛ, se mo pɛ nɛ wa le.
O ha a gbo pɛsɛɛ, a be je mi hu; a kpadehi tete be si tee, ejakaa o gbla a tue; o kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kaii we mɛ hu.
Yawɛ, mo lɛ o ha wa ma a he hiɛ babauu; o bli wa huzu ɔmɛ a mi kɛ kpe, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha o hɛ mi ba nyami.
Yawɛ, o gbla o ma a tue; nɛ benɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, a fa kue kɛ tsɛ mo.
Yawɛ, o ha nɛ waa kɛ he hiami kpa ngmlaa kaa bɔ nɛ yo nɛ hɛɛ mi nɛ e miɔ nɛ ma fɔ peeɔ ɔ. Wɔ hu wa sɛ he hiami, kɛ gbenɔ mi ja, se nɔ́ ko ji mi kɛ bɛ.
Wa nyɛ we nɛ wa he wa zugba a yi wami; wa nyɛ we nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ waa pee.
Wa ma mi nihi nɛ gbo ɔ ma na wami ekohu!
A gbogboe ɔmɛ maa te si.
Nihi nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ zu mi ɔ, mɛ tsuo a maa te si, nɛ a ma la kɛ bua jɔmi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ bɔ́ nyu ngleinglei haa zugba a peeɔ ehe ekohu ɔ, ja Yawɛ maa ngɔ wami he ngɔ wo nihi nɛ gbo momo ɔ a mi.
Tue gblami kɛ yi wami hemi Ye ma, nyɛ ya sɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛ sinya amɛ a mi ngɔ wo nyɛ yi.
Nyɛɛ laa nyɛ he be kpiti ko kɛ yaa si Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ nya maa be.
Ejakaa Yawɛ je e hi he ɔ kɛ ma je ɔ mi nɛ e ba gbla nimli adesahi a tue ngɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Nihi nɛ a gbe ngɛ laami mi ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, a ma je mɛ tsuo kpo nɛ a na mɛ; zugba a be jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ a nɔ laae hu.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ e klaate kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ maa gbe wo mi sinɔ agbo langalanga a. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma de ngɛ e wai ngmɔ saminyayoo ɔ he jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ i hyɛɛ e nɔ; i pueɔ nɔ nyu be tsuaa be.
I buu e he nyɔ kɛ pia, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko ba kpata e hɛ mi.
Ye wai ngmɔ ɔ he mi mi la ko be ye mi hu.
Ke kaa miohi, kɛ mio pu kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ gba ta a, jinɛ ma ya mɛ a he la, nɛ ma sã mɛ tsuo.
Se ke ye ma a a he nyɛli ngɛ hlae kaa ma bu a he ɔ, lɛɛ a kɛ mi nɛ ba kpata lolo.
Niinɛ, e hia kaa a kɛ mi nɛ ba kpata.” Hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, Israel ma nɛ ji Yakob nina a maa ma si kpɛii kaa tso nɛ sipoku sɛ zu mi; a ma gba mɔmɔ, nɛ a ma plɔke.
A yiblii ma hyi je ɔ tɔ.
Yawɛ gbla we Israel tue wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e gbla a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue ɔ; nɛ Israel bi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ hu, a he híɛ kulaa kaa he nyɛli ɔmɛ.
Tue gblami nɛ Yawɛ ha e ma a ji, e ha a nuu mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.
E ha beleku kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko ba muɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
Se bɔ nɛ Israel maa pee kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ konɛ a kɛ pa mɛ ji, a maa wɛɛ je ma amɛ a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ bukɔbukɔ kaa ayilɔ, nɛ yo mawu Ashera a tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, loo e we amaga amɛ ekoeko be si hie hu.
Ma nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he ɔ ku kɛ pueɔ si.
E plɛ pee ma doku kaa nga kplanaa nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ plɛ pee lohwe lɛmi he, he nɛ nahi maa ye ní, nɛ a maa jɔɔ a he ngɛ.
Tso kɔni ɔmɛ gbli, nɛ a ku kɛ pueɔ si; yi ɔmɛ ya buaa nya kaa lɛ́ nɛ a ma slɛ, ejakaa ma a nui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sisi.
Mawu, a bɔlɔ ɔ mi mi be lɛ sãe ngɛ a he, nɛ e be mɛ mɔbɔ nae hulɔ.
Israel bi, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, kɛ je Yufrate pa a nya kɛ yaa si Egipt huzu ɔ nya a, Yawɛ ma bua e ma a nya kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi kakaaka kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ ngma mi sae, nɛ e ngɛ ngma nitsɛ ɔ hlae kɛ je tsakati ɔ mi.
Ke jamɛ a ligbi ɔ su ɔ, a ma kpa titimati nguaa ko kɛ tsɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a kɛ je Asiria kɛ Egipt.
A maa ba, nɛ a ma ba ja Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
A bɔ omleyi je nɔ yemi ɔ kɔkɔ Musu tloo Efraim nina, Israel nɔ yemi ɔ. E hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ tae kaa mɔmɔ jlasi nɛ ma nimeli dã tɔli ngɔ fi a yi.
A wo a yi mi nu je via saminya lɛɛ, se hyɛ mɛ nɛ a tɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ kɛ pueɔ si.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ he walɔ katsɛ ko nɛ ma ba tua mɛ.
E maa ba kaa gbiɛ ngo ngu; e maa fo dɔ kaa hiɔmi nyu nɛ bee lalaala, nɛ haa pa hyiɔ kɛ ywiaa nga kɛ haa zugba a nɔ.
Jamɛ a ma nimeli dã tɔli he nɔ woli ɔmɛ ɔ, a maa ba mɛ si kulaa.
Bɔ nɛ ke nɔ ko na ngmɔkɔ nɛ fu loko e fumi be su, nɛ e tsɔɔ nɛ e yeɔ tsuatsuaatsua a, ja ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa laa si kake too.
Be ma nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa pee kaa mɔmɔ jlasi saminyayoo kɛ ha e ma mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ. E ma ha kojoli maa ye dami sane, nɛ ma a agbo nya buli ɔmɛ ma na he wami, nɛ a kɛ he nyɛli nɛ ma ba tua mɛ ɔ maa kpe.
Yesaya bɔ Yuda gbali dã tɔli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ Gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ pohu tɔɔ dã, nɛ a tataa si.
Wai kɛ dã nɛ nya wa fuu tsɔ nɛ a nuu ɔ, haa a hii si tɛe basabasa.
Gbali ɔmɛ tɔɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ninahi nɛ Mawu haa mɛ ɔ, a nui sisi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ hu tɔɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ ja nɔuu; mɛ hu sanehi nɛ a kɛ ba haa mɛ ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a hyɛɛ mi.
Okplɔɔhi nɛ a hii a he ɔ tsuo peeɔ kpɔtɔɔ kɛ vie sɔuu; he ko he ko be nɛ tsɔ.
A ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ mi sie ke, “Mɛnɔ ní jamɛatsɛ ɔ susu kaa e ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ?
E sɛ gbi ɔ, mɛnɔ ngɛ hlae?
E sɛ gbi ɔ hi ha bimwɔwi nɛ kpaako a je nyɔ nya!
E ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tsɔɔ wɔ ní nyaa, ngmami okadi kakaaka, zã kakaaka, kɛ munyu tso ɔ hu kakaaka.” Ke nyɛ be mi tue bue ɔ, lɛɛ Mawu maa gu nibwɔhi nɛ tuɔ ma se gbi nɛ nyɛ nui kulaa nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ní.
Mawu de nyɛ ke e ma ha nyɛ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi, se nyɛ bui lɛ tue fɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he je nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ní nyaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ: ngmami okadi kakaaka, zã kakaaka, kɛ munyu tso ɔ hu kakaaka; kɛkɛ ɔ, nane tsuaa nane nɛ nyɛ maa hia a, nyɛ ma tɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nɔ si.
A maa plaa nyɛ; nyɛ maa du klama, nɛ a maa nuu nyɛ kɛ ho.
Zion kɔ nya tɛ ko Jehanɛ, nyɛ he nɔ woli nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ nɔ yee ngɛ Yerusalem hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
Nyɛ ngɛ fĩae ke nyɛɛ kɛ gbenɔ so, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbeje pee kake.
Nyɛ hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa ke haomi ba a, e be nyɛ he sae kulaa; ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ lakpa, kɛ sisimi nɔ kaa nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I ngɛ sisi tomi ko nɛ he wa nɛ maa si kpɛii fiae ngɛ Zion; nɛ i ngɔ kɔ nya tɛ agbo ko kɛ ma mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e toɔ e tsui si.’ Ma ngɔ dami sane yemi kɛ pee susumi kpa.” Ahumi kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu maa bɛɛ lakpa amɛ tsuo kɛ ho, nɛ pahi maa je a hi he ɔmɛ.
Ke e ba mi ja a, somi ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbenɔ so ɔ, a maa po mi; nɛ a maa gbɛ kake peemi nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbeje nyɛ kpɛti ɔ. Haomi nɛ maa ba a, nyɛ be nya nyɛe maa da.
E maa ba nyɛ nɔ nɔtonɔto daa mɔtu.
Nyɛ maa na amanehlu nyɔ kɛ pia.
Sɛ gbi he tsuaa sɛ gbi he nɛ maa je Mawu ngɔ kɛ ba a maa wo nyɛ he gbeye wawɛɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ a buu abɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa pee kaa nyumu ko nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ e hwɔ si ngɛ sa tso kpiti ko nɔ.
Sa tso ɔ ka we bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ kpã e mi ngɛ nɔ, nɛ e nɔ hami bo ɔ hu bli we bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ kɛ ha e he tsuo.
Yawɛ ma je e he wami ɔ kpo kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ngɛ Perazim yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Gibeon kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, konɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ e to kaa e ma tsu ɔ; níhi nɛ e ma tsu ɔ maa pee nyakpɛ níhi nɛ eko bɛ hyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, e ko pee nyɛ muɔ hu!
Ke nyɛ kɛ pee fiɛmi ɔ, nyɛ be nɔ́ nɛ ma a nya fo nyɛe maa tu.
I nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke e ma kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi.
Mawu nile Nyɛɛ bu mi tue; nyɛ ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ. Ngmɔ hulɔ ɔ, anɛ humi kɛkɛ e hii hue daa nɛ, nɛ e du we ní lo?
Pe e hii zugba a tsuae kpamisa, nɛ e hii hɛ mi dlae kɛkɛ lo?
Ke e dla zugba a hɛ mi gbe nya a, anɛ e fĩa we pui wu, kɛ kowɛ lo?
Anɛ e du we ngma zã nɔ zã nɔ, kɛ akoko hu ngɛ e blɔ he lo?
Anɛ e du we ní kpahi kɛ wui huzu lo?
E Mawu ɔ lɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ke e pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ nɛ.
Pui wu, kɛ kowɛ ɔ, pi tso kpoti nɛ a kɛ gbeeɔ, se tso zaayo kɛkɛ.
Ngma nɛ a kɛ sãã abolo ɔ, a fɛ we mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ngma mi salɔ ɔ peeɔ ji e kɛ ngma mi sami nɔ́ hii ngma a mi sae hluu kɛ ya siɔ e naa ngma a bɔ nɛ sa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ e je; e woɔ ga nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ e nile hiɛ babauu.
Haomi nɛ maa ba Yerusalem nɔ Musu tloo Yerusalem!
Yerusalem, Mawu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ musu tloo lɛ!
David ma nɛ e hi mi ɔ, musu tloo lɛ.
Jeha kake, loo enyɔ komɛ kɛ a mi ní yemi, kɛ nyami ɔmɛ a se ɔ, ma nɛ a tsɛɛ “Mawu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ”, Mawu ma ha e maa na amanehlu.
Ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, nɛ a maa wo yana.
Ma a tsuo maa pee kaa bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ a kpa muɔ ngɔ pue nɔ.
Mawu ma ba tua ma a, nɛ e ma sa ma a yi; a maa fia kpoku gojogojoohi kɛ wo e he ka.
Yerusalem maa pee kaa kpade ko nɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tu munyu kɛ je zu mi lokoo; e gbi ɔ maa pee kaa gugwɔ mi gbi.
Yerusalem, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ je ma se kɛ ba tua mo ɔ, a maa bɛɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho kaa bunyuku, nɛ a ta buli babauu kɛ a he gbeyegbeye ɔ maa pee kaa jakati ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nya.
Tlukaa, ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma he o yi wami.
E ma ha hiɔmi ma si, zugba ma mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo maa pee hoo.
Lasiogblee, ahumi, kɛ la gegeege maa ba; kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ a tabo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ba ngɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Mawu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ tuae ɔ, mɛ tsuo a maa laa kaa nina ko nɛ je kpo nyɔ mi ngɛ nlami mi kɛkɛ.
Je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ma ba tua Zion yo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A sane maa pee kaa nyumuhi enyɔ komɛ a sane pɛ.
Kekleekle nɔ ɔ ya hwɔ si kɛ e mi mi hwɔ; nɛ e nla nɛ e ngɛ ní yee.
Se benɛ e hɛ tsɛ ɔ, hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee kɛ mwɔɔ.
Enyɔne ɔ hu ya hwɔ si benɛ kuma miɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ.
Lɛ hu e nla nɛ e ngɛ nyu nue.
Se benɛ e hɛ maa tsɛ ɔ, kuma ngɛ lɛ yee kɛ mwɔɔ.
A bui munyu ɔmɛ Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi biɛe, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he nihi nɛ li nɔ́!
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he hɛ yuyuili!
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he dã tɔli, be mi nɛ nyɛ nui wai ko!
Nyɛ tataa si kaa dã tɔli, be mi nɛ nyɛ nui dã nɛ nya wa ko!
Yawɛ ha mahe vii nɔ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ hwɔ mahe kulaa.
Nyɛ gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ nɔ́ bu a hɛ mi, nɛ e ha a yi nɔ.
Gbali ɔmɛ nui a nina amɛ a sisi, konɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ; nina amɛ pee kaa womi kpo ko nɛ a sɔu nya.
Ke a ngɔ kɛ ya ha nɔ nɛ le womi kanemi ke e kane ha nyɛ ɔ, e ma de ke e be nyɛe, ejakaa a sɔu nya.
Ke nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ya ha nɔ nɛ li womi mi ke e kane ha nyɛ ɔ, e ma de ke e li womi kanemi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ke a ngɛ mi jae, se sisi numi ko be munyu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ tue ɔ mi, ejakaa a tsui ngɛ he kpa kulaa.
Nimli adesahi a mlaahi, kɛ blema sanehi nɛ a kase ngɔ wo a yi mi nɛ a deɔ kɛ a nya kɛkɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke jami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma pee nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ekohu.
A ní leli ɔmɛ a nile ɔ, kɛ a ga a maa pee yaka.” Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha hwɔɔ se Musu tloo nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa ngɔ ga nɛ a to ngɛ a yi mi ɔ kɛ laa Yawɛ.
A toɔ a ga amɛ ngɛ laami mi, nɛ a susuu kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ nae, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ hu nɔ ko nɔ ko be lee.
A plɛɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ yi ngɔ kaa si.
Te nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe e nyɛmi nɛ; buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ, loo zu ɔ?
Anɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔmlɔ pee ɔ ma nyɛ ma de lɛ ke, “Tsa pi mo nɛ o puɛ mi!” loo e ma nyɛ de lɛ ke, “O li nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ lo?” Kaa bɔ nɛ a deɔ ɔ, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ Lebanon hue tso ɔ ma plɛ pee ngmɔ kpakpa, nɛ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a ma plɛ pee hue tso ekohu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, tuekpokutsɛ maa nu nɛ a ngɛ womi kanee, nɛ hɛ yuyuili nɛ ngɛ diblii kpii mi ɔ, a hɛngmɛ maa hyɛ nɔ ekohu.
Nihi nɛ a he jɔ, dɛgutsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, Yawɛ Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ma ha mɛ bua jɔmi ekohu.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ bui Mawu, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Mawu ma kpata nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi: nihi nɛ a kɛ a nya mi munyu poɔ nihi a nya kaa a tɔ mlaa, kɛ nihi nɛ tsɔɔ klama ha kojoli ngɛ kojomi he, nɛ a kɛ lakpa yemi haa nɛ a plɛɔ nɔ nɛ sane da a e sane hɛ mi kɛ buɔ si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ he Abraham yi wami kɛ je amanehlu mi ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ye ma, zo be nyɛ gbee hu; a be nyɛ hɛ mi si puee hu.
Ke o na bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ma ha mo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi o ma de ke niinɛ, imi ji Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
Kuasiahi maa le ní, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tuɔ munyu huitihuiti ɔ maa kase ní.”
Yuda ma nimeli kɛ Egipt so somi nɛ he be se nami Yawɛ ke, “Musu tloo Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ejakaa a kua mi.
A toɔ gahi, nɛ a peeɔ níhi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a dɛ he.
A kɛ nihi soɔ nɛ pi ye suɔmi nya.
Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tĩaa yayami ngɔ haa a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A yaa Egipt nɛ a ya biɔ yemi kɛ buami kɛ jeɔ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, be nɛ imi lɛɛ a bi we mi ga womi.
Se yemi kɛ buami nɛ nyɛ ya biɔ ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ma plɛ pee zo, kɛ hɛ mi si puemi mohu ha nyɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ya su Egipt mahi nɛ a tsɛɛ Zoan kɛ Hanes momo mohu, se Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma pia a he; benɛ a ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa Egipt ma ba piɛ a he ɔ, zo kɛ hɛ mi si puemi mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ maa je mi kɛ ba.” Mawu sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɔɔ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ a he.
“Ma tsɔli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ya gu zugba nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeyegbeye ɔ nɔ.
Jatahi, sinɔ duɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nyakahi nɛ tee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A ngɔ nike níhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɔ pue tejihi, kɛ yomahi a nɔ ya ke ma ko nɛ be nyɛe maa piɛ a he.
Egipt be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nyɛe maa pee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i wo lɛ se mi biɛ ke, ‘Nyaka nɛ tee, se e he be gbeye.’ ” Ma tue gboli Jehanɛ Mawu de mi ke ma ya ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ nɔ ngɛ ma a hɛ mi.
Ee, ma ngma kɛ wo womi mi, konɛ e pee odase nɛ maa hi si daa kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ejakaa ma atuã tsɔli ji mɛ; lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ bui Yawɛ mlaa a ji mɛ.
A deɔ gbali ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko na ní; nyɛɛ gba ní kpakpahi mohu ha wɔ.
Nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ nɛ tu munyu nɛ maa ngɔ ngɛ wa tue mi; ke sisimi munyuhi pohu wa suɔ.
Nyɛ ko nyɛɛ Yawɛ se; nyɛɛ gu he kpa!
Wa hla we nɛ waa nu nyɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ he sane ko!” Se bɔ nɛ Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ bui nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ basabasa peemi, kɛ sisimi nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ yeɔ fɔ.
Nyɛ ngɛ kaa gbogbo gojoo ko nɛ e mi gba kɛ je e yi mi kɛ ba ma si, nɛ kpa kasa, nɛ miɔ nɛ e ku kɛ pue si; tlukaa ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi ɔ, e maa ku kɛ pue si bum!
E maa gbɛ tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ kaa zu buɛ; e maa ywia yayaa, bɔ nɛ a be ngɛyu bɔbɔyoo po nae ngɛ mi nɛ a kɛ je la, loo nɛ a kɛ yɛ nyu ngɛ nɔ́ mi.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ ma a dee ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ kpoo.
Ja jã loko nyɛ he maa wa, nɛ nyɛ ma na wami.” Se nyɛ kplɛɛ we kaa nyɛ maa pee ja!
Mohu, nyɛ to nyɛ yi mi kaa nyɛ maa hi okpɔngɔhi nɛ a he sɔɔ a nɔ kɛ tu fo kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he.
Nɛ nyɛ nɔ́ da niinɛ; e sa kaa nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli a dɛ mi!
Nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he sɔɔ saminya, se nihi nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ se ɔ, a he sɔɔ kulaa pe nyɛ!
Nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta bulɔ kake too maa wo nyɛ ta buli akpe fo; nɛ a nihi enuɔ pɛ maa wo nyɛ tsuo fo.
Nyɛ tabo ɔ tsuo ma wo fo, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ji aflangaa tso nɛ maa si ngɛ yoku yi mi!
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɛ mlɛe kaa e maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ daa.
Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi.
Mawu maa gbaa e ma a Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛ be ya foe hu!
Yawɛ ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ; ke nyɛ fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e ma he nɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha níhi a mi maa wa ha nyɛ lɛɛ, se lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ní.
E be hiae kaa nyɛ ma de ke nyɛ ma hla lɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa na lɛ hu.
Ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ nyɛ gba kɛ je blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya hiɔ nɔ, loo muɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa nu e gbi ngɛ nyɛ se nɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Blɔ ɔ ji nɛ oo!
Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.” Nyɛ ma ble nyɛ we amaga amɛ; amagahi nɛ a ngɔ sika hiɔ kɛ ha a he, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he ɔ tsuo.
Nyɛ maa hɛ mɛ kɛ fɔ he kaa ní komɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we; nyɛ ma de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ho!” Ke nyɛ du ní ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ kɛ pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ niye ní babauu maa ba; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ na amɛ ma na zugba agbo nɛ a maa ye ní ngɛ nɔ.
Nahi kɛ tejihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a ma na niye ní kpakpa; nga nɛ a je blɔ poo nɛ a kɛ ngo futu lɛ nɛ a maa ye.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a maa ku a mɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pue si ɔ, nyu maa je yo gaga amɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ be babaaba.
Nyɔhiɔ ma kpɛ kaa pu, nɛ pu la a nya maa wa wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e nya waa daa a totoe si kpaago; e maa pee kaa ligbi kpaago pu tsotsoe tsuo nɛ a bua nya ngɔ ha ligbi kake.
Plaami nɛ Yawɛ plaa e ma a, e maa fi pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ, nɛ pa amɛ ma gbo.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi jamɛ a be ɔ mi.
Mawu maa gbla Asiria tue Yawɛ biɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ tsitsaa kɛ ma.
E mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa la su ku kpii nɛ ngɛ si tee.
Munyuhi nɛ ngɛ e nya mi jee ɔ, abofu sɔuu kaa la nɛ puɛɔ ní.
Ke e wo mumi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala kɛ bee nɛ hyiɔ kɛ ya taa nɔ kuɛ si tɔɔ, konɛ e sa je ma amɛ a mi nɛ e gbla a tue.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, yi mi yaya nɛ a to ɔ tsuo maa pee yaka.
Se nyɛ, Mawu ma a lɛɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma la kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ laa kɛ ngɔɔmi ke nyɛ ngɛ nyami be klɔuklɔu yee ɔ. Nyɛ bua maa jɔ kaa nihi nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ yaa Yawɛ yo ɔ nɛ ji Israel tɛ sa a nɔ kɛ a dɛ mi bɛhi nɛ a ngɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ he toe.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue, kɛ bɔ nɛ e mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ; la nɛ puɛɔ ní maa tso plamplam, nɛ ahumi maa fia; hiɔmi maa nɛ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ma pue si.
Ke Yawɛ wo gbi ɔ, e maa gbla Asiria bi ɔmɛ a tue, nɛ sawale maa nu mɛ.
Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ ngɛ mɛ ní fiae ɔ, tue gblami tsuaa tue gblami nɛ e ma ha mɛ ɔ, e ma a maa hi miɛ, nɛ a maa fia saku kɛ to he.
Blema lokoo ɔ, a tsua muɔ ko nɛ a maa sã Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ mi.
Muɔ ɔ mi kuɔ, nɛ e bli, nɛ a to lɛ́ babauu kɛ wo mi.
Yawɛ mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam ɔ maa sã lɛ.
Mawu maa bu Yerusalem he Musu tloo nihi nɛ yaa Egipt ya biɔ yemi kɛ buami ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Musu tloo mɛ, ejakaa a ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Egipt ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli a nɔ; ejakaa a hiɛ babauu, nɛ a he wa hulɔ.
Se a ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔ we Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mohu nɔ; ga womi hu a bi we lɛ.
Yawɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e gblaa nɔ tue.
Ke e de nɔ ko ɔ, e kpale we e nya se.
E gblaa yayami peeli kɛ a he piɛli tsuo a tue.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ; tsa pi Mawu ji mɛ.
A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, lohwehi kɛkɛ ji mɛ, tsa pi Mawu mumi nɛ ngɛ a mi.
Ke Yawɛ gba ta a, je ma ko je ma ko be nya nyɛe maa da; je ma nɛ he wa jio, je ma nɛ a ya je ngmlaa ha lɛ jio, mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Yawɛ de mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ to hyɛli kɛ a ngmlaa babauu nyɛ we nɛ a fieɔ jata kɛ jee e de lo he ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa tsi imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ye nya kaa ma bu Zion yo ɔ he.
Bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ tee kɛ bɔleɔ e tsu kɛ buu e bimɛ a he ɔ, ja imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma bu Yerusalem he, nɛ ma fa e he.” Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma, nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si mi, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ!
Be ma nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma sake amaga amɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ pee yayami ɔ ngɔ pue he.
Amaga nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɔ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ pee.
A kɛ ta ma kpata Asiria hɛ mi; se pi nɔmlɔ adesa he wami nya.
Asiria bi ɔmɛ maa tu fo ngɛ ta nya, nɛ a nihewi ɔmɛ ma plɛ pee nihi nɛ a nyɛɔ a nɔ kɛ tsuɔ ní tsumi nɛ nya wa.
A matsɛ ɔ kɛ sawale maa tu fo kɛ je, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu maa ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a maa ma fo kɛ je a ta aflangaa amɛ a he.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Lɛ ji Yawɛ nɛ a jaa lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a kɛ la sãã bɔ haa lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ dami sane Be ma nɛ matsɛ ko ma ba ye tsɛ.
E maa ye ma a nɔ saminya, nɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye dami sane.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee kaa wesa he ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kɛ ahumi nya, kaa pa nɛ ywia nga ngɛ zugba kpataa nɔ, aloo kaa zugba kplanaa nɔ tɛ sa sisi hɔ̃.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛngmɛ maa hyɛ nɔ́ paa, nɛ e tue hu maa nu nɔ́ saminya.
Tsui hahaahatsɛmɛ maa to a tsui si, nɛ a kɛ juɛmi kpakpa ma tsu ní, nɛ mumu hali a nya mi ma tsɔ.
A be kuasia hɛ mi nyami woe hu, nɛ nɔ sisilɔ ɔ, a be lɛ tsɛe ke anɔkualetsɛ hu.
Ejakaa kuasia tuɔ munyu basabasa, nɛ e toɔ ga kaa e maa pee yayami.
E tuɔ munyu, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ basabasa kɛ siɔ Yawɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ha we lɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e yeɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee hu e ha we lɛ nyu tete po nɛ e nuɔ.
Nɔ sisilɔ ɔ, ní yayahi a he ga pɛ e toɔ.
E yeɔ lakpa konɛ e kɛ kpata dɛgutsɛmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ke a sane da po, bɔ nɛ e peeɔ mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ lɛɛ ní kpakpahi a he e susuɔ, nɛ e yeɔ dami sane.
Tue gblami kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mle yee, nɛ haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kpɔtɔɔ mi; se nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa jeha kake kɛ ligbi bɔɔ komɛ a se ɔ, nyɛ maa hao; ejakaa nyɛ be wai yiblii nae ma kpa hu.
Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ, nɛ haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli!
Nyɛ kpa bo ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ he gu.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ kpekpe ya bo kɛ fi nyɛ mlɛ mi.
Nyɛ gba nyɛ gugue ma, nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ngmɔ kpakpa amɛ, kɛ wai nɛ baa saminya a he.
Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ha ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a zugba nɛ pú, kɛ mio tso hyi nɔ tɔ ɔ. Nyɛɛ wo yana ha ma a, kɛ we ɔmɛ nɛ bua jɔmi hi a mi sa be ko ɔ. Mɔ ɔ po, nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi hie hu; nɛ ma nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ nimli babauu ɔ maa pee ma doku.
Wehi, kɛ mɔhi nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nga mi tejihi ma na bua jɔmi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ tohi hu, lejɛ ɔ a maa ye ní ngɛ.
Se wɔ lɛɛ, Mawu ma ha wɔ e mumi ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ekohu, nɛ wa ma na niye ní babauu kɛ je ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
A maa ye dami sane ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Dami sane nɛ ɔ kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba, nɛ a ma na he jɔmi kɛ maa ya neneene.
Haomi ko haomi ko be ye ma a nya gbae, nɛ tue mi jɔmi kɛ he jɔmi maa hi a we ɔmɛ a mi.
(Se gbiɛ ngo ngu maa nɛ pue a ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a ma a hɛ mi ma kpata.)
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi nɛ duɔ ní ngɛ pa nɛ nyu mi tɛ gblee tue ɔ, a bua maa jɔ a he.
Jã kɛ̃ nihi nɛ tsí a nahi, kɛ a teji okpɔngɔhi a nya, se a ngmɛɔ a he nɛ a ya yeɔ ní faa a, a bua maa jɔ a he.
A fa kue kɛ bi yemi kɛ buami Musu tloo he nyɛli ɔmɛ!
A fia ojo nɛ a sisi nihi; se mɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko fiɛ mɛ ojo, nɛ nɔ ko sisi we mɛ hulɔ.
A we ojo fiami, kɛ nɔ sisimi ɔ se maa po kɛ̃, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a maa fia mɛ ojo, nɛ a maa sisi mɛ.
Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ.
Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ.
Buu wa he be tsuaa be; nɛ ke wa ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, kpɔ wɔ.
Ke o hia ta, nɛ o wo gbi kaa hiɔmi simi kikɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ gbɛɛ fĩaa kɛ fo.
A níhi plɛɔ peeɔ ta yibu ní nɛ a haa gidigidi kaa baalɛhi peeɔ a ní.
Yawɛ kle!
E ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ.
E ma ha a maa ye dami sane sɔuu; anɔkuale pɛ a maa tu ngɛ Yerusalem be tsuaa be, nɛ ma a maa ya nɔ saminya.
E buu e ma a he be tsuaa be; nɛ e haa ma mi bi ɔmɛ juɛmi kɛ nile.
Yawɛ gbeye yemi ji nɔ́ ko nɛ he jua wa saminya kaa juetli agbo ha mɛ.
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ha.
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba a wo yana boboobo ha.
Gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ba gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛɛ we a nɔ hu.
A yi somihi a nɔ hu, ma kɛ ma jio, nɔ kɛ nɔ jio.
Nɔmlɔ adesa pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ a hɛ mi.
Zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kɛ fɔɔ si.
Lebanon hue ɔmɛ ta kulaa; Sharon zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a pee kaa nga kplanaa nɔ; tsohi nɛ ngɛ Bashan kɛ Karmel yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, a yi mi ba tsuo kplɔ kɛ pueɔ si.
Yawɛ bɔ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ Yawɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ dee ke, “Jehanɛ e su be nɛ ma tsu ní.
Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa ye he wa.
Nyɛ toɔ ga yayahi nɛ a he be se nami.
Mumi nɛ nyɛ woɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.
Nyɛ ta buli babauu ɔ maa sã ngɛ ta nga nɔ.
A maa pee kaa la zu, loo mio tso nɛ a po kɛ pue si nɛ a mɛ he la.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lokoo, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nya tsuo, nyɛ ta tue nɛ nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ i pee ɔ he, konɛ nyɛɛ na kaa ye he wa.” Yayami peeli nɛ ngɛ Zion ɔ nu sawale, nɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli.
Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ a he bie ji, “La nɛ ngɛ ní puɛe nɛ ɔ, wa ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da?
La nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ gbo we gblegbleegble nɛ ɔ nɛ, wa ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da?” Ee, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e tuɔ anɔkuale, nɔ nɛ sume kaa e maa ye nɔ ko awi nɛ e kɛ na ní, nɛ e he we nyɔ mi ní hulɔ, nɔ nɛ tsiɔ e tue nɛ e ko nu muɔ si puemi sane ko, nɛ e kɛ e hɛngmɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ yaya a, e yi ma na wami.
Jamɛatsɛ ɔ ma ná he jɔmi kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ mɔ nɛ he wa saminya mi.
E ma na ní maa ye, nɛ e ma na nyu maa nu.
Be kpakpa maa ba hwɔɔ se Nyɛ ma ná matsɛ ko nɛ maa ye tsɛ saminyayoo ngɛ zugba a gbo tɛtlɛɛ ko nɔ ekohu.
Nyɛ ma kai gbeye nɛ nyɛ ye blema a ngɛ tó nɛ ma se nɔ yeli tsu ngɛ nyɛ dɛ ɔ he; nɛ nyɛ ma kai nihi nɛ juɔ si ba slaa ma a hulɔ.
Ma nɛ peeɔ nya puu, nɛ a tuɔ munyu nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi ɔ, nyɛ be mɛ nae hu.
Hyɛ, Zion, ma nɛ wa yeɔ wa nyami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Yerusalem, ma nɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Yerusalem ngɛ kaa bo tsu nɛ maa si nɛ be si nɔe gblegbleegble.
Tso plɛɛkohi nɛ a ka kɛ wo zu mi ɔ ekoeko be hiae; tangme kpa amɛ hu be tsɔe.
Yawɛ ma je e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Pa nguahi, kɛ pa wawihi a tue wa maa hi; se wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a lɛ wawihi nɛ a hluiɔ kɛ akɔfa be nyɛe maa ba lejɛ ɔ, lɛ nguahi hu ja nɔuu.
-Jamɛ a lɛ ɔmɛ a mi tso ɔmɛ a he be se nami; a be hie kɛ abalaa womi.
Wa ma kpɔ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ní kpakpa amɛ tsuo ngɛ a dɛ.
Ta yibu ní babauu nɛ a ma na a, a maa dla, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na eko; glɔtsɛmɛ po ma na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́.
Yawɛ nitsɛ maa pee wa matsɛ.
E maa ye wa nɔ, nɛ e maa bu wa he.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be dee hu ke, “I be he wami.” A maa ngɔ ma a tsuo a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.
Mawu maa gbla e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue Nyɛ, je ma amɛ tsuo nyɛɛ ba!
Nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bu tue.
Zugba a tsuo, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bu tue.
Yawɛ mi mi fu je ma amɛ tsuo, nɛ e hɛ dɔ kɛ wo ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo.
E gbiɛ mɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha ke a gbe mɛ.
A be ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ɔ pue; a ma sake a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ pue he kɛ a he fu gbɛ̃ɛ̃; nɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ maa pee tsutsuutsu kɛ a muɔ ɔ sɔuu.
Pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ma puplee maa pee kaa bunyuku.
Hiɔwe ma koklo kaa womi kpo; nɛ dodoehi maa hɔle kɛ pue si kaa bɔ nɛ wai, loo ngmɔkɔ tso hɔleɔ ba kɛ pueɔ si ɔ. Yawɛ pee e klaate ɔ klaalo ngɛ hiɔwe, konɛ jehanɛ e kɛ gbe Edom bi ɔmɛ nɛ e de ke a ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ. E klaate ɔ he maa pee kɛ muɔ kɛ zɔ kaa jijɔhi, kɛ akpakpohi a muɔ kɛ zɔ nɛ a kɛ ngɛ bɔ sãe.
Yawɛ maa sã bɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Bozra ma a mi; e ma pue a muɔ si nyamaa ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ.
Nimli ɔmɛ ma gbo kaa pu mi nahi, kɛ na ku katsɛmɛ.
Zugba zu ɔ maa pee tsutsuutsu kɛ muɔ, nɛ zɔ ɔ ma futu zu ɔ tsɔfii.
Yawɛ to be ko nɛ e ma he Zion yi wami, nɛ e maa gbla a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.
Edom pa amɛ ma plɛ pee ama, nɛ zugba a maa pee ama kala.
Zugba a tsuo ma mle kɛ la kaa ama nɛ ngɛ tsoe.
E maa tso nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ e be gboe.
Zugba a nɔ maa je gu yi nɔhi babauu, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ nyɛɛe hu.
Se kayo, kɛ kɔtɔkɔ maa ngɔ lejɛ ɔ ngɔ pee a nɔ́; nɛ klomi kɛ kuakualabite maa hi lejɛ ɔ. Yawɛ ma ha zugba a nɔ maa je gu kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ be nɛ a bɔ je ɔ. Matsɛ ko be si hie nɛ maa ye ma a nɔ, nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ta.
Mɔhi tsuo nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, pú kɛ mio tso maa puɛ ngɛ a mi, nɛ nga mi gbehi, kɛ dugumahi maa hi lejɛ ɔ. Nga mi lohwehi, kɛ ogbeteehi ma ba kpe, nɛ nibɔ níhi kɛ a he gbeyegbeye (a yi je kaa nɔmlɔ, a nane kaa lohwe) ma ba fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɔ mi kpadehi hu lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma ba jɔɔ a he ngɛ.
Klomi ma ba pee tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ e maa ngmɛ hlui ngɛ, nɛ e ma pɛ bimɛ; nɛ e maa lɛ mɛ.
Niinɛ, kayohi hu ma ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ eku kɛ eyo, eku kɛ eyo.
Nyɛ hla ngɛ Yawɛ womi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ kane.
Nyɛ maa na kaa nibɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ekoeko be laae, nɛ e he piɛlɔ be lɛ bɔe.
Yawɛ lɛ fa, nɛ e mumi ɔ ha e ba mi ja.
Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ fɔ sɔ nɛ e dla zugba a pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ná eko.
Zugba a maa pee a nɔ́ kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a maa hi daa.
Blɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ Nga zugba kpataa nɛ gbli ɔ ma na bua jɔmi; zia zugba a ma nya, nɛ mɔmɔhi maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ.
Niinɛ mɔmɔ babauu maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ bua jɔmi ma he ose ngɛ mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he; e maa pee fɛu kaa Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; e maa ba ní kaa Karmel kɛ Sharon zugba a. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami, kɛ wa Mawu ɔ we agboje, kɛ e he wami ɔ. Ninehi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ wo mɛ he wami; nɛ nakutsohi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a da si kpɛii.
Nyɛ de nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e tsui ngɛ poe ɔ ke, “Wlua mo, koo ye gbeye!
Hyɛ, o Mawu ɔ ma nɛ e ba kpɔ mo!
E ma nɛ e ba gbla o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.” Hɛ yuyuili maa hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu, nɛ tuekpokutsɛmɛ maa nu nɔ́.
Glɔtsɛmɛ ma hlu kaa odabɔ, nɛ amuɛtihi ma la kɛ bua jɔmi.
Pahi maa hia ngɛ nga kplanaa zugba a nɔ.
Blesiblesi ma plɛ pee taku, nɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi ma ha zugba gbigbli ɔ maa tɔ nyu.
He nɛ nga mi gbehi hi sa a ngɛ nga mlɔmlɔɔmlɔ mi ɔ, ngɔwu, kɛ go maa puɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A maa je gbɛjegbɛ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ ke “Blɔ klɔuklɔu.” Yayami peelɔ ko yayami peelɔ ko be nyɛe ngɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ gblegbleegble; nɛ blɔ hialɔ kuasia ko be tlae kɛ ba blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jata ko be lejɛ ɔ hie, lohwe awi yelɔ ko hu be jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ nyɛɛe.
Nihi nɛ Yawɛ he a yi wami ɔ, mɛ a maa nyɛɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ.
A maa kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem; a ma la nɛ a ma hwɔ lele.
A be kɔmɔ kɛ aywilɛho yee gblegbleegble hu.
A bua maa jɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Asiria wo Yerusalem he gbeye Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib ba tua Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ma amɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fa e we asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma kɛ e ta buli babauu kɛ je Lakish ke a ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya de Matsɛ Hezekia ke e ha yi.
Asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ e ta a ba da si ngɛ yiti je taku ɔ nyu dɔ ɔ he, ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa ní a he fɔli ɔmɛ a ní tsumi he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ je kpo nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba kpe: Hilkia bi Eliakim nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ; Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ; kɛ Asaf bi Yoa nɛ ngmaa sanehi kɛ toɔ ɔ. Asiria asafoatsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke Asiria matsɛ nguaa a tsɔ mɛ ke a ba bi Matsɛ Hezekia nɔ́ nɛ ha nɛ e yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye ɔ. E bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o susuu kaa nya puu peemi ji ga kɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ hwuɔ ta lo?
Mɛnɔ nɔ po o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ loko o tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã a?
Tse o ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa Egipt ma ba piɛ o he?
O ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ gla pee dɛma tso; gla a maa ku nɛ e maa gbɔ o dɛ mi.
Egipt matsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa gla.
E gbɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e he kɛ kpasaa lɛ.” Asiria asafoatsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Aloo o ma de mi ke o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɔ!
Anɛ pi Yawɛ jami he ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Hezekia ywia a?
Pi lɛ nɛ e de Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem ke a ya ja Mawu ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ pɛ hɛ mi lo?
I kɛ mo maa po nga ngɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ biɛ mi.
Ma ha mo okpɔngɔ akpe enyɔ kaa o ma na mo nitsɛ o nihi nɛ maa hi a nɔ lo.
O ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ Egipt ba ha mo ta zugba lɛhi kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli, be mi nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ nyafii pe kulaa a po o be lɛ nyɛe.
O susu kaa loko ma ba tua ma nɛ ɔ nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi ɔ, Yawɛ li he nɔ́ ko lo?
Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ de mi ke ma ba tua ma a, nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Shebna, kɛ Yoa de asafoatsɛ ɔ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, kɛ wɔ nɛ tu Aram gbi.
Wa nuɔ Aram gbi ɔ. Koo tu Hebri gbi; nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ wɔ tue bue.” Se asafoatsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ susuu kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛkɛ matsɛ nguaa tsɔ mi ke ma ba de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ lo?
Nihi nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu munyu nɛ ɔ kɔɔ a he; a maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a fĩ, nɛ a maa nu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zami kaa nyɛ nɔuu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ te da si nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Hebri gbi ɔ mi ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Asiria matsɛ nguaa ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue.
E ke, ‘Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia nɛ sisi nyɛ; ejakaa Hezekia be nyɛe ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je e dɛ mi.’ Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia munyu nɛ e tu ke nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ nyɛ nya.
Nyɛ ko susu kaa Yawɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami, nɛ e be hae nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ nyɛ ma a. Nyɛ ko bu Hezekia tue tete!
Ejakaa Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ fae ke nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ba kpata.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye lɛ nitsɛ e wai, kɛ ngmɔkɔ yiblii, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa nu lɛ nitsɛ e vu mi nyu, hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ matsɛ nguaa a ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya zugba ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ.
Wai ngmɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee wai; blɛfo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee abolo.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia nɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ ke Yawɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami.
Anɛ je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ eko nyɛ kpɔ e zugba kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi hyɛ lo?
Jije Hamat, kɛ Arpad mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Nɛ jije Sefarvaim mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ.
Anɛ a nyɛ kpɔ Samaria kɛ je ye dɛ mi lo?
Je ma amɛ tsuo a mawu ɔmɛ a ti eko nyɛ kpɔ e ma kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi hyɛ lo?
Lɛɛ mɛni haa nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa Yawɛ ma nyɛ kpɔ Yerusalem ngɛ ye dɛ mɔ?” Se ma a pee dii, nɛ a de we nɔ́ ko kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Hezekia fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf binyumu ɔ nɛ ji sanehi ngmalɔ ɔ kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he; nɛ a ho ya bɔ Matsɛ Hezekia níhi tsuo nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ de ɔ.
Matsɛ Hezekia ya bi Yesaya ga womi Benɛ Matsɛ Hezekia nu amaniɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho hía e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he.
E ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya.
E tsɔ Eliakim, matsɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ya na gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ. Tsɔli ɔmɛ hu ha kpekpe ya bo.
Sɛ gbi nɛ e ha mɛ kɛ ya ha Yesaya a ji, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, wa yi fi; a jɛ wɔ, nɛ a pue wa hɛ mi si.
Wa pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi, se e be he wami nɛ e kɛ maa kɛ̃ bi ɔ kɛ je kpo.
Asiria matsɛ tsɔ e we asafoatsɛngua a kɛ ba jɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ. Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nu kikɛmɛ a jɛmi ɔ, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bɔ musu nɛ ɔ, e maa gbla a tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ ha wa ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Benɛ Yesaya nine su Matsɛ Hezekia sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ mane lɛ ke, “Munyuhi nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ Asiria matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba tu kɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye ngɛ he.
Hyɛ!
Ma ha mumi ko maa ba e nɔ, nɛ e maa nu akeake munyu ko nɛ ma ha e maa kpale kɛ ya lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ, nɛ ma ha e maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Asiria bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba ekohu Asiria asafoatsɛngua a nu kaa Asiria matsɛ ɔ hia kɛ je Lakish, nɛ e kɛ Libna bi ya ngɛ ta hwue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya na lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko ba su Asiria matsɛ ɔ, kaa Sudan matsɛ, Tirhaka hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ Egipt tabo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma nɛ e ba tua lɛ.
Benɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ nu sane nɛ ɔ, e ngma womi, nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia.
Bɔ nɛ e ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ko ha nɛ o Mawu ɔ nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ nɛ mlɔɔ mo ke i be nyɛe ma ngɔ Yerusalem.
Mo nitsɛ o nu níhi nɛ Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee zugba amɛ; bɔ nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi butuu.
Nɛ moo lɛɛ o susu kaa o maa ye o he lo?
Benɛ nɛnɛmɛ kpata Gozan, Haran, kɛ Rezef ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbe Beteden bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Telasa zugba a nɔ ɔ, anɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nyɛ a yi wami he lo?
Hamat matsɛ, Arpad matsɛ, Sefarvaim matsɛ, Hena matsɛ, kɛ Iva matsɛ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?” Matsɛ Hezekia he womi ɔ ngɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ e kane.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya, nɛ e ya bli womi ɔ mi gbajaa ngɔ pue si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e fa kue ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Israel Mawu lee, mo nɛ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a yi mi lokoo; mo nɔ kake too pɛ ji Mawu, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o sisi.
Mo lɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba!
Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ jehanɛ, mo bli o hɛngmɛ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ wɔ pee!
Yawɛ, mo ta tue nɛ o nu munyuhi nɛ Senakerib ngɛ tue kɛ ngɛ mo, Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, o he guɛ gbee!
Yawɛ, wɔ tsuo wa le kaa Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpata je mahi, kɛ a zugbahi babauu a hɛ mi, nɛ a sã a mawu ɔmɛ.
A kpata a hɛ mi, ejakaa tsa pi mawu nitsɛnitsɛhi ji mɛ; nimli a nine nya ní tsumihi, kɛ tsohi, kɛ tɛhi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, wa Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, konɛ je ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a le kaa mo Yawɛ, mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu.” Yesaya kɛ sɛ gbi mane Hezekia Kɛkɛ nɛ Amoz binyumu Yesaya tsɔ ke a ya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, kue nɛ o fa ha lɛ ngɛ Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib he ɔ, e nu.” Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Asiria matsɛ, Zion biyo, yomiyo ɔ ngɛ mo muɔe oo!
Mɛnɔ he fɛu o ye ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ahlua o bɔ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ nɔ o wo o nya nɔ ngɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ o bui ɔ?
Pi imi, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ lo?
O tsɔ o tsɔli kɛ ba ye imi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye he fɛu, nɛ o de ke, ‘I ngɔ ye ta zugba lɛhi kɛ kuɔ yo ɔmɛ kɛ ya su Lebanon tɔɔ.
I poo Lebanon seda tso gagaa amɛ, kɛ sɛsɛo saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
I sɛ Lebanon hue kusuu ɔ mi kɛ ya tsitsaa lokoo.
I tsua vuhi nɛ i nu ma se zugba nɔ nyu; i ngɔ ye nane sisi kɛ naa Egipt pa amɛ tsuo a mi nɛ nyu ɔ ta!’ “Anɛ o nui kaa i bɔni nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ní tsumi kɛ je kɛ lo?
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, i to he ga kɛ je blema lokoo, konɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mɛ ma dokuhi.
Nimli nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi lɛɛ a he wami nɔ gbɔ.
A tsui po, nɛ bibi gbe mɛ.
A pee kaa nga mi tsohi.
A pee kaa nga mumu, loo nga nɛ pu sã lɛ, nɛ e ngla ngɛ tsu yi mi.
“I le o he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɔ́ nɛ o peeɔ, he nɛ o yaa, kɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa a. Akɛnɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa, nɛ i nu o he nɔ womi hu he he je ɔ, ma ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo o gugwɔ mi; ma wo o nya mi dade, nɛ ma kpale mo kɛ gu blɔ nɛ o gu kɛ ba a nɔ.” Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Matsɛ Hezekia ke, “Enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi ha mo; jeha nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a puɛ, níhi nɛ nɔ ko du we.
Jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ puɛ ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a se.
Jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ nyɛ ma du ní, nɛ nyɛ ma kpa ní; nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔhi nɛ nyɛ maa ye a yiblii.
Yuda we ɔ mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a ma plɔke kaa tsohi; a ma tsɛ̃ sipoku kɛ ya zu mi ekohu, nɛ a maa wo yiblii.
Ni komɛ maa piɛ kɛ̃, nɛ a maa je Yerusalem kɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya; ejakaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘E be ma nɛ ɔ mi sɛe, nɛ e be kɛ̃ɛ̃ kake po tsɛ̃e kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ. Ta buli nɛ hɛɛ tsɛ̃i be ma a he sue, nɛ a be kpoku ko fiae kɛ wo ma a he.
Blɔ nɛ e gu nɔ kɛ ba a, jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ nɔuu e maa gu kɛ kpale kɛ ho; se ma nɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ e be sɛe.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Ejakaa ma bu ma nɛ ɔ he; nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be a he sae.
Ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ David he kɛ wo imi nitsɛ ye hɛ mi nyami.’ ” Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ko ya gbe ta buli , ngɛ Asiria ta a mi.
E nɔ jena makɛ ɔ, ne mɛ nɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Asiria matsɛ Senakerib hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho Nineve ya.
Ligbi ko, benɛ e ngɛ e mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Nisrok ɔ jae ngɛ e mawu ɔ we ɔ mi ɔ, e binyumuhi enyɔ, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer kɛ klaate ya gbe lɛ, nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho Ararat zugba a nɔ ya.
E bi nyumu kpa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Esarhadon ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.
Matsɛ Hezekia ba nu hiɔ Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Matsɛ Hezekia ba nu hiɔ, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Moo to o níhi blɔ nya ngɛ o we ɔ mi, ejakaa o yi be wami nae; o ma gbo!’ ” Hezekia plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ wo gbogbo, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kai bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi ngɛ o hɛ mi, bɔ nɛ i ye mo anɔkuale, bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ mo kɛ ye tsui tsuo, kɛ bɔ nɛ i pee o suɔmi nya ní.” Nɛ Hezekia fo ya kɛ he hiami.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Yesaya ke e ya nɛ e ya de Hezekia ke, “Imi Yawɛ, o nɛ̃ David Mawu ɔ, i nu o kue fami ɔ, nɛ i na o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ. Ma ngɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ngɔ piɛ o wami ligbi ɔmɛ a he ha mo.
Ma he o kɛ Yerusalem yi wami kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ ma bu ma a he.” Yesaya de matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wɛɛ ngmɔkɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya to e tslɔɔ ɔ nɔ, kɛkɛ e ma na he wami.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Hezekia hu bi Yesaya ke, “Mɛni okadi o maa to mi kaa niinɛ ma nyɛ ma ya Yawɛ we ɔ?” Yesaya he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ ma ha mo okadi nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa si nɛ e wo mo ɔ, e maa ye nɔ.
Ma ha nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz pee ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ba se nane hiami nyɔngma.” E ba mi ja; niinɛ Yawɛ ha pu ɔ kpale e se, nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ kpale e se nane hiami nyɔngma nɛ e nyɛɛ momo ɔ. Benɛ Yuda matsɛ Hezekia na he wami ɔ, e ngma yi jemi la nɛ ɔ. I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke ye nihe be mi ma gbo ngɛ.
Ee, ye wami be nɛ piɛ ɔ, gbeje ma ye lɛ tsuo ngɛ.
I susu kaa i be Yawɛ nae gblegbleegble ngɛ hɛ kali a zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.
I susu hu kaa i be ye nyɛmimɛ adesahi nae ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi hu.
A po ye wami nɔ kpiti kulaa; ye wami ɔ nya ta.
E pee kaa to hyɛlɔ bo tsu nɛ a kpa ngɔ fɔ si, loo kaa bo nɛ bo lolɔ po nɔ ngɛ e bo lomi tso ɔ he.
I susu kaa Mawu ha ye wami nyagbe ma amlɔ nɔuu.
Nyɔ mi tsuo i ngɛ kɛmɛe kaa nɔ́ nɛ jata lɛ ngɛ ye mi wuhi kue.
I susu kaa Mawu ha ye wami nyagbe ma amlɔ nɔuu.
Ye gbi mia, he wami ko be hu.
I ngɛ kɛmɛe kaa beleku lahuɛ.
I hyɛ hiɔwe hluu kɛ ya si pɔ tɔ ye hɛngmɛ he.
Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, e fi mi; jé mi kɛ je haomi nɛ ɔ mi.
Kɛ ma de kɛɛ?
Bɔ nɛ e de ɔ, jã e pee ɔ nɛ.
Ye tsui ngɛ yee sɔuu, i nyɛ we ma hwɔ mahe.
Nyɔmtsɛ, o nɔ ji mi.
Ee, mo pɛ o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
Ha ma na he wami ekohu, nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami.
Niinɛ, kpakpa nɛ o ngɛ hlae ha mi he je nɛ haomi nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ ba ye nɔ ɔ nɛ; se o je mi kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami mi; ejakaa o kɛ ye he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo pa mi.
Ni gbogboehi be nyɛe ma je o yi.
Ee, ni gbogboehi be nyɛe maa na mo si.
Ni gbogboehi be nyɛe maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale be tsuaa be.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle!
Ee, hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ nɛ a jeɔ o yi kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ o yi jee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. Tsɛmɛ tsɔɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ke o yeɔ anɔkuale be tsuaa be.
Yawɛ, o he ye yi wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa wami ligbihi tsuo ɔ, wa ma la, nɛ wa maa fia kpa saku kɛ to he kɛ je mo, Yawɛ o yi, ngɛ o we ɔ.
Tsɔli nɛ je Babilonia Jamɛ a be ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Merodak Baladan, Baladan bi nyumu ɔ, nu kaa Matsɛ Hezekia ba na we he wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngma womi, nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ nike ní piɛ he ya ha lɛ.
Matsɛ Hezekia he tsɔli ɔmɛ atuu, nɛ e ngɔ matsɛ mɔ ɔ mi ní kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, tsopa kɛ e he via, nu kpakpa, e ta níhi tsuo, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ nito he ɔmɛ.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e we ɔ mi, loo e nɔ yemi he nito he tsu ɔmɛ a mi nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya ba Matsɛ Hezekia ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, jije a je, nɛ mɛni a ba de mo?” Hezekia he nɔ ke, “A je Babilonia zugba a nɔ, ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.” Yesaya bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Mɛni a ba na ngɛ o we ɔ mi?” Hezekia he nɔ ke, “A ba na ye we ɔ mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be ye nito he ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ.” Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke be ma nɛ a ma ba muɔ o we ɔ mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛ níhi nɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bua nya ngɔ to kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya; a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sie.
Yawɛ lɛ de.
A maa nuu mo nitsɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ po kɛ ya Babilonia; a maa puɛ mɛ, nɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ ngɛ Babilonia matsɛ we ɔ mi.” Se Matsɛ Hezekia susu kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba ngɛ lɛɛ e yi nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Yesaya ke, “Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ o ngɔ ba ha mi ɔ hi.”
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fami munyuhi Bɔ nɛ wa Mawu ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛɛ jɔɔ ye ma a bua!
Ee, nyɛɛ jɔɔ ye ma a bua!
Nyɛɛ wo Yerusalem ma a bua.
Nyɛ de nɛ a nu kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ a nɔ́ nami babauu ɔ se po, nɛ a ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ.
I gbla a tue saminya ngɛ a tɔmi ɔmɛ tsuo a he.” Gbi ko ngɛ pɛe ke, “Nyɛ dla blɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ha Yawɛ!
Nyɛɛ je gbɛjegbɛ tlɔmɔɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ha wa Mawu ɔ!
Nyɛɛ tsi kɔ̃ tsuaa kɔ̃, nyɛ ha yo tsuaa yo, kɛ yoku tsuaa yoku nɛ ba si.
Zugba nɛ nɔ ngɛ tsakatsaka, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ngɛ googagooga tsuo a nɔ nɛ sɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa je kpo paa nɛ nimli adesahi tsuo maa na.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Gbi ko ngɛ pɛe ke, “Moo fiɛ!” I bi ke, “Kɛ ma fiɛ kɛɛ?” Moo fiɛ ke, “Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ kaa nga, nɛ a he fɛu tsuo ngɛ kaa mɔmɔ ngɛ nga nɔ.
Ke Yawɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ gu a nɔ pɛ nga a gbli, kɛkɛ mɔmɔ ɔ hu ngla.
Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa nga kɛkɛ!
Nga gbliɔ, nɛ mɔmɔ hu nglaa; se wa Mawu ɔ munyu ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Ne nyɛ Mawu ɔ Zion, mo manye munyu fiɛlɔ!
Kuɔɔ kɛ ya yo gagaa ko nɔ, nɛ o ya fiɛ manye munyu ɔ kɛ he wami.
Yerusalem, mo manye munyu fiɛlɔ, wo o gbi nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ o fiɛ; koo ye gbeye!
