De Yuda ma amɛ ke, “Ne nyɛ Mawu ɔ!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ma kɛ he wami; e ngɛ tsɛ yee; e hɛɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a hiɔwo kɛ ma; e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu he.
E maa lɛ e to kuu ɔ kaa to hyɛlɔ kpakpa; e ma bua e to bi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ e maa hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ e bɔkɔ mi; to nyɛ ɔmɛ hu e ma tsɔ̃ mɛ blɛuu.
Israel Mawu ɔ se be Mɛnɔ lɛ hɛɛ nyu tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo mi ɔ ngɛ e dɛ kɔkɔ mi hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ e nine mi blimi kɛ susu hiɔwe hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ je nɛ ɔ mi tabo zu tsuo kɛ wo kplu mi hyɛ?
Loo e ngmɛ yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ ngɛ sɛni nɔ hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɔɔ Yawɛ mumi ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e pee?
Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ní, loo e wo lɛ ga hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ toɔ ga, nɛ e tsɔɔ Mawu nile, nɔ́ sisi numi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ da?
Je ma amɛ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
A ngɛ kaa nyu kɔyi kake kɛkɛ nɛ dɛ kɛ je goga mi.
Zugba kpɔ ɔmɛ nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ hu ngɛ wojowojo ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi kaa bunyuku nɛ pue sɛni nɔ.
Lebanon tso ɔmɛ tsuo a he pi nɛ a kɛ ma slɛ la.
Lohwehi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu a he pi nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ.
Je ma amɛ pi nɔ́ ko ngɛ e hɛ mi; e buu mɛ kaa ní guhi nɛ a he be se nami.
Mɛnɔ he nyɛ maa ngɔ Mawu kɛ to mɔ?
Nɛ mɛni subai nyɛɛ kɛ maa to e he?
Amaga lo?
Amaga nɛ tso galɔ kpɛ, nɛ sika galɔ ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha he, nɛ e ngɔ sika hiɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ngɔ kpla lɛ ɔ!
Dɛgutsɛ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ e peeɔ ji, e ngɔɔ tso kpakpa kɛ haa tso galɔ nɛ le ní tsumi saminya.
Tso galɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔɔ tso ɔ kɛ peeɔ amaga ha lɛ, amaga nɛ mimiɛ we e he.
Bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ to je ɔ sisi ɔ, anɛ nyɛ li lo?
Anɛ nyɛ nui hyɛ lo?
Anɛ a de we nyɛ enɛ ɔ kɛ je blema lokoo lo?
Mawu ji nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ nɛ; e hii si ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo, nɛ je ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ e sisi.
Nimli adesahi ngɛ kaa angmɛɛtɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Mawu bli hiɔwe mi kaa bo, nɛ e pee lɛ kaa bo tsu nɛ a hiɔ mi.
Ganɔhi po e baa mɛ tsuo si, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ yeli posoposo.
A ngɛ kaa tso tsɔwi nɛ a du kɛ we, nɛ́ a sipokuhi mɛ si kpakpa ko lolo.
Ke Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ gu a nɔ kɛkɛ a gbliɔ, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ bɛɛɔ mɛ kɛ yaa kaa nga.
Mɛnɔ he nyɛ maa ngɔ Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ to?
Mɛnɔ kɛ lɛ sɔ?
Nyɛ wo nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ hiɔwe!
Mɛnɔ lɛ bɔ dodoe ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ?
Nɔ nɛ jeɔ mɛ kpo kaa ta buli babauu, nɛ e kɛ eko tsuaa eko biɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ɔ!
E he wami, kɛ nyɛmi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya a, kake ngmelu po laa we.
Israel, lɛɛ mɛni he je o ngɛ dee ke Yawɛ li kaa o ngɛ nɔ́ nae, nɛ e bui kaa a ngɛ mo amimi yee ɔ?
Anɛ o li lo?
Anɛ o nui lolo lo?
Yawɛ ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ daa kɛ daa; lɛ ji nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ tsuo.
Pɔ tɔɛ lɛ, nɛ e gbɔjɔɔ we.
Bɔ nɛ e juɛmi mi kuɔ ha a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa nu sisi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ, nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, e haa mɛ he wami.
Nihewi kpakpataa po gbɔjɔɔ, nɛ pɔ tɔɔ mɛ; nihewi a he wami taa, nɛ a nɔɔ si.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, a naa he wami he kaa kɔle nɛ ngɛ tee; a tuɔ fo, nɛ pɔ tɔɛ mɛ, a nyɛɛɔ, nɛ a gbɔjɔɔ we.
Mawu ma e munyu nɔ mi ha Israel Mawu ke, “Nyɛ, wo nya mahi, nyɛɛ pee dii, nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Nyɛ dla nyɛ he saminya, konɛ waa hyɛ sane ɔ mi!
Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛ ba je nyɛ nya, nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da.
“Jamɛ a kunimi yelɔ ɔ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ je beleku je kɛ ba?
Mɛnɔ haa nɛ e yeɔ matsɛmɛ, kɛ je ma amɛ a nɔ ɔ?
E kɛ e klaate peeɔ mɛ butuu kaa bunyuku, nɛ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ gbɛɛ mɛ fĩaa kaa nga nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ yaa.
E nyɛɛɔ a se kɛ fo wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e nane ma we zugba, nɛ e nine ya suu a nɔ kɛ̃.
Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ pee enɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je sisije?
Sisije ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ nyagbe ɔ hu, imi Yawɛ nɔuu ma hi lejɛ ɔ.
“Nihi nɛ a ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ i tsu ɔ, nɛ a ye gbeye; je ɔ tsuo mimiɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ tsuo a bua a he nya nɛ a ba.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ piɛɔ e nyɛmi ní tsulɔ he.
A woɔ a sibi bua, nɛ a deɔ ke, ‘Na tsui!’ Tso galɔ deɔ sika tsu galɔ ke, ‘O bɔ mɔde, e hi!’ Nɔ nɛ kɛ hamle ngɛ amaga a he dlae ɔ hu woɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ sɔ̃ tɛ nɔ ɔ he wami jã kɛ̃; e deɔ nɔ́ sɔ̃lɔ ɔ ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ o sɔu ɔ hi.’ Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ plɛɛko bihi kɛ kaa, konɛ e ko kpɔ.
“Se mo, ye tsɔlɔ Israel, mo ji ma nɛ i hla, ye huɛ Abraham nina.
I ngɔ mo kɛ je je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ kɛ ba; i tsɛ mo kɛ je ma se lokoo, nɛ i de mo ke, ‘Ye tsɔlɔ ji mo.’ I kua we mo, se mohu, i hla mo.
Koo ye gbeye.
I kɛ mo ngɛ!
Ko ha nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ wo o he gbeye.
Imi ji o Mawu ɔ nɛ!
Ma wo mo he wami; ma piɛ o he; Ma bu o he, nɛ ma baa o yi.
“Hyɛ, nihi tsuo nɛ a mi mi fu mo ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si.
Nihi nɛ kɛ mo ná a, a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ mo ná a, o be mɛ nae hu; nihi nɛ hia ta wo mo ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ; imi lɛ i ngɛ mo he wami woe ɔ nɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘Koo ye gbeye!
Ma piɛ o he!’ ” Yawɛ ke, “Yakob, o ngɛ kaa gɔgɔ kɛkɛ; o Israel, ma nɛ o he wɛ, koo ye gbeye; ma piɛ o he.
Imi, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, imi ji o yi wami helɔ.
Hyɛ, ma pee mo kaa ngma mi sami he klama kɛ e lunguhi nɛ a nya ba.
O maa ywia yo ɔmɛ, nɛ o maa pee mɛ butuu; o maa pee yoku ɔmɛ kaa jakati.
O maa fɔ̃ mɛ kɛ ya kɔɔhiɔ mi; nɛ kɔɔhiɔ maa muɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
Ahumi maa gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa; se moo lɛɛ, o bua maa jɔ saminya; ejakaa imi ji o Mawu ɔ nɛ.
O ma je imi!
Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ, ye yi.
“Ke ye ma a ní pee mɔbɔ, nɛ a nɛ nyu nɛ a nu, a kuɔ si tsuo gbli, nɛ kuma ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ, ke a fa kue kɛ tsɛ imi Yawɛ ɔ, ma bu mɛ tue.
Imi Israel Mawu ɔ, i be mɛ kuae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ma ha pahi maa hia ngɛ yo kpataa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyu maa fo dɔ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
Ma ha nga kplanaa a nɔ ma plɛ pee taku, nɛ nyu maa ba babaaba ngɛ zugba gbigbli ɔ nɔ.
Ma ha seda tso, akasia tso, mɔmɔ tso, kɛ oliv tso maa bɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.
Ma ha zugba nɛ nɔ́ ko be nɔ ɔ ma plɛ pee hue nɛ sɛsɛo, papao, kɛ nga mi tsohi ngɛ mi.
Mahi tsuo maa na nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a maa le kaa imi Yawɛ, Israel Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ i tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yawɛ pue lakpa mawu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si Yawɛ, Israel matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nyɛ je ma amɛ, nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ sane ɔ nɛ waa nu.
Nyɛ je nyɛ we odase ɔmɛ kpo.
Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba gba níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se, konɛ ke a ba mi ɔ, waa le kaa ja nyɛ de ɔ nɛ.
Níhi nɛ ba momo ɔ, nyɛ gba mi kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ wɔ a sisi.
Nyɛɛ gba níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se, kɛkɛ wa maa na kaa mawuhi ji nyɛ niinɛ!
Nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ hi saminya, aloo nyɛ ha nɛ haomi ko nɛ ba; nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ maa wo wa he gbeye, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ maa pee wɔ nyakpɛ nɛ waa hyɛ!
Nyɛɛ hyɛ, nyɛ pi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa, nɛ nyɛ ní tsumi hu nɔ ko bui fɛɛ; nihi nɛ jaa nyɛ ɔ, nimli guhi ji mɛ; a ngɛ kaa nyɛ kɛ̃.
“I ha nɛ nɔ ko je beleku je kɛ ma nɛ e kɛ nyɛ ba kpe.
E maa ba ngɛ ye biɛ mi.
E ma ba tua nyɛ kɛ je omleyi je.
E maa naa nɔ yeli a nɔ kaa a naa zu, loo kaa buɛ puɛlɔ pɔtɔɔ zu.
Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ gba enɛ ɔ kɛ to momo ke bɔ nɛ e maa ba ji nɛ ɔ, konɛ wa de ke, ‘Ja tutuutu o gba a nɛ.’ Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko de we nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko wui nɔ ta, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nui hulɔ.
Imi Yawɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ bɔ Zion amaniɛ nɛ ɔ. Imi nɛ i tsɔ nɔ Yerusalem kɛ manye munyu ke, ‘O ma mi bi ɔmɛ ma oo!
A ma we!’ Benɛ i hyɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mawu ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ nyɛ́ de nɔ́ ko kulaa.
Ke i bi mɛ munyu hu, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ha mi heto.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ, mawu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa; a nyɛ we nɔ́ ko kpakpa nɛ a tsu.
Amaga amɛ nɛ a puɛ ɔ, a he be se nami; a ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.”
Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ, nɔ nɛ i kplɛɛ we nɔ́ ngɛ e he ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ i hla nɛ i suɔ e sane ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo e mi, nɛ e maa ye dami sane kɛ kojo je ma amɛ tsuo.
E be ngmlaa kpae, nɛ e be munyu tue boboobo nɛ a nu ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hulɔ.
Ngɔwu nɛ mi dɔ momo ɔ, e be mi kue, nɛ kane nɛ ngɛ tsoe sulii ɔ, e be gbee.
E maa ye dami sane kɛ maa ya neneene.
E kɔni mi be jɔ̃e, nɛ pɔ be lɛ tɔe kɛ yaa si dami sane yemi ma he si ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Zugbahi nɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ɔ po maa hyɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ba wo mɛ ga.” Yawɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe, nɛ e bli mi gbajaa.
Lɛ nɛ bɔ zugba a, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. Lɛ nɔ nɛ ha nimli adesahi tsuo wami kɛ mumi ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Imi Yawɛ lɛ i tsɛ mo; i baa o yi, nɛ i ha mo he wami, konɛ o hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Ma gu o nɔ nɛ i kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa so, nɛ a ma na la.
O ma bli hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu, nɛ a hii si ngɛ diblii mi ɔ, o ma ha a maa ye a he.
“Ye biɛ ji Yawɛ; imi pɛ ji Mawu.
I be ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɔe kɛ ha mawu kpahi, nɛ ye yi jemi ɔ hu i be ngɔe kɛ ha amagahi.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ koo!
Níhi nɛ i de to blema a ba mi.
Jehanɛ, ma gba nyɛ níhi nɛ maa ba.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee loko a ba mi.” Yi jemi la Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ; nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ la kɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ wo hɛ mi, nyɛ je e yi!
Nibɔ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi, nyɛ je e yi!
Zugbahi ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a nɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ ha nga kplanaa a kɛ e nɔ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a je Mawu yi.
Nyɛ ha Kedar bi ɔmɛ nɛ a je e yi!
Nyɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ Sela ma a mi nɛ a hwɔ lele ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ!
Nyɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ zugbahi a nɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ɔ nɛ a wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami!
Yawɛ hia kpo kaa ta bulɔ; e hia kpo kaa ta bulɔ nɛ hɛ dɔ.
E ngɛ ngmlaa kpae.
E ngɛ ose hee kɛ ngɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ woe kaa e kɛ mɛ maa to ní.
Mawu wo si kaa e maa piɛ e ma a he Mawu ke, “I pee kpoo hluu; i ma ye nya, nɛ i ye ye he nɔ.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su; ma kpa ngmlaa kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi, ma kɛmɛ kaa nɔ nɛ mumi nya ngɛ tae.
Ma kpata yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ ma ha a nɔ nga kɛ tsohi tsuo ma gbli.
Ma ha pa amɛ a mi nyu ɔ maa mii, nɛ pa amɛ ma plɛ pee zugba gbigbli.
“Ma ngɔ ye hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ kɛ gu hehi nɛ a nyɛɛ we hyɛ.
Ma ha a diblii ɔ ma plɛ pee la; nɛ ma ha zugba nɛ nɔ ngɛ googagooga a nɔ maa sɔ tɛtlɛɛ ha mɛ.
Níhi nɛ i ngɛ si woe kaa ma pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; ma ha a maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ amagahi a nɔ, amagahi nɛ a kpɛ́, loo a puɛ, nɛ a kpale deɔ ke a mawuhi ji mɛ ɔ, a maa ba mɛ si, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ.” Israel kase we ní Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ tuekpokutsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ hɛ yuyuili, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ na ní!
Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ e hɛ yu pe ye tsɔlɔ ɔ, loo nɛ e tue tsi pe nɔ nɛ i tsɔ kɛ sɛ pɔtɛɛ ɔ lo?
Israel, o naa níhi babauu, se o kɔ se lo?
O ngɛ tue hu nɛ o kɛ nuɔ nɔ́, se mɛni tutuutu o nu?” Yawɛ ji Mawu nɛ suɔ kaa e ma he o yi wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo mlaa kpakpahi, e to blɔ nya nɛ hi saminya, nɛ e suɔ kaa e ma a nɛ ye a nɔ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a fia e ma a ojo, nɛ a nuu ni ɔmɛ kɛ ya wo tsu.
A kpɔ a níhi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a ha a níhi; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha mɛ.
Nyɛ kpɛti mɛnɔ maa bu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tue?
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, mɛnɔ ma ta tue, konɛ e nu níhi nɛ maa ba a?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ Yakob kɛ ha nɛ a ha e níhi, nɛ mɛnɔ ha nɛ a fia lɛ ojo ɔ?
Yawɛ nitsɛ, nɔ nɛ wa pee yayami kɛ si ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ha enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba!
Wa bɛ wa je mi bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hlae, nɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ e wo wɔ ɔ hu wa yi a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha wa nu e mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a he, nɛ ta nɛ nya wa ba tua wɔ.
E mi mi la a mle kɛ wo Israel he kɛ kpe, se a li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ; wa kase we nɔ́ ko kulaa kɛ ji mi.
Mawu wo si ke e ma he e ma a yi wami Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Israel, Yawɛ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ ngɛ mo dee ke, “Koo ye gbeye.
Imi nitsɛ ma he o yi wami.
O biɛ i ngɔ kɛ tsɛ mo ɔ nɛ; ye nɔ́ ji mo.
Ke o haomi ɔmɛ pee kaa pa nɛ o ngɛ poe po, ma piɛ o he; o haomi ɔmɛ be nyɛe maa ye o nɔ.
Ke o nyɛɛ la mi po, la a be mo sãe.
Haomihi tsuo nɛ maa ba o nɔ ɔ, o maa ye a nɔ.
Ejakaa imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, imi Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ he o yi wami ɔ nɛ.
Ma ngɔ Egipt ngɔ ha ngɛ o nane mi, konɛ o ye o he.
Ma ngmɛɛ Sudan kɛ Seba hu a he.
Akɛnɛ o he jua wa ha mi, akɛnɛ o hɛ mi ba nyami, nɛ i suɔ mo he je ɔ, ma ngmɛɛ je mahi kɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ a he ngɔ ha, konɛ ma he o yi wami.
Koo ye gbeye, imi nitsɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ!
“Ma bua o nina nya kɛ maa je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je kɛ maa ba we.
Ma de omleyi je ke, ‘Ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a ho,’ nɛ ma de leneyi je hu ke, ‘Koo tsi a nya.
Nyɛ ha nɛ ye ma a nɛ kpale kɛ ba, kɛ je zugba amɛ a nɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Imi nitsɛ ye ma ji mɛ; nɛ i bɔ mɛ, konɛ a wo ye hɛ mi nyami.’ ” Israel ji Yawɛ we odase Mawu ke, “Tsɛ ye ma a kɛ ba nɛ waa kpe.
A ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́, a ngɛ tue hulɔ, se a nui nɔ́!
Tsɛ je ma amɛ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ a ba bua a he nya.
A ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa sɛɛ wɔ blema níhi.
Ha nɛ a we odase yeli ɔmɛ nɛ a ba, nɛ a ba nu, konɛ a de ke e ngɛ mi, loo e be mi.
“Israel ma, mo ji ye we odase.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ hla mo, konɛ o pee ye tsɔlɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o le mi, o he ye nɔ nɛ o ye, nɛ o na nɛ o le kaa imi pɛ ji Mawu.
Ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu, mawu kpa ko hi si hyɛ, nɛ eko be bae gblegbleegble.
“Imi nɔ kake pɛ ji Yawɛ, imi pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ma he o yi wami.
Níhi nɛ ba a, imi Yawɛ nɔuu lɛ i de to, nɛ i ba piɛ o he.
Ma se mawu ko pee we nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko hyɛ; mo ji ye we odase.
Imi ji Mawu, nɛ i ngɛ daa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma je e he kɛ je ye dɛ mi.
Ke i pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, mɛnɔ ma tsake?” Israel ma a je Babilon Yawɛ, yi wami helɔ, Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ, bɔ nɛ e de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Babilon tɔɔ kɛ he o yi wami.
Ma ku agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ lele nɛ a ngɛ hwɔe ɔ ma plɛ pee kɔmɔ yemi.
Imi ji Yawɛ Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
Israel, imi ji o bɔlɔ, kɛ o matsɛ.” Blema lokoo ɔ, Yawɛ je blɔ ko kɛ gu wo ɔ mi.
Blɔ ɔ gu nyu glegleegle ɔ mi.
Ta nguaa nɛ ngɛ he wami, nɛ je kpo kɛ e ta zugba lɛhi kɛ okpɔngɔhi babauu ɔ, e ha mɛ tsuo a nɔ si nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a te si hu; a la a gbo kaa kane mi tako, loo kaa kane nɛ nu ta mi.
Se Yawɛ ke, “Blema sanehi, kɛ blema níhi nɛ be momo ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ juɛmi ngɔ fɔ a nɔ hu.
Nɔ́ he nɛ ma pee ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ lɔ ɔ mohu blɔ; nɔ́ he ɔ je sisi momo; nyɛ bli nyɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ!
Ma je gbɛjegbɛ ko kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ, nɛ ma ha pahi maa hia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nga mi lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ pohu maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami; nga mi gbehi, kɛ dugumahi ma je ye yi.
Ejakaa ma ha pahi maa hia kɛ be ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ, nɛ ye ma nɛ i hla a ma na nyu maa nu.
Mɛ ji ye ma nɛ imi nitsɛ i bɔ ha ye he, konɛ a la kɛ je ye yi!” Yayami nɛ Israel pee Yawɛ ke, “Se mo Israel, ye he sane ba ti mo; o ja we mi hu.
O ngɔɛ jijɔ kɛ ba sã we sami bɔ ha mi; nɛ o ngɔɛ bɔhi kɛ ba wui ye hɛ mi nyami hulɔ.
I gba we o nya ke o ba sã bɔ ha mi, loo o ba ha mi tsopa kɛ e he via.
O he we tsopa kɛ e he via ha mi, nɛ o ngɔɛ lohwehi a zɔ hu kɛ ba sã we bɔ kɛ sa ye hɛ mi, se mohu, o ngɔ o he yayami kɛ ngɛ mi haoe sɔuu, nɛ pɔ tɔ mi kɛ o tɔmi ɔmɛ.
Se imi nɔuu ji Mawu nɛ ngɔɔ o he yayami ngɔ paa mo.
I be o he yayami ɔmɛ kaie hu.
“Mo kai mi, konɛ waa hla mi.
Moo jaje o sane ɔ koo, konɛ waa hyɛ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da!
O nɛ̃ pee yayami, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu tɔ ye nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ hu ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ha a kpata Israel hɛ mi; i ha a pue ye ma a hɛ mi si.”
Yawɛ nɔ kake too pɛ ji Mawu Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, mo Israel, ye tsɔlɔ, ye ma nɛ i hla, Yakob nina, bu tue.
Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ nɛ; kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ mo kɛ ba su amlɔ nɛ ɔ, imi lɛ i baa o yi.
Koo ye gbeye, ye tsɔlɔ ji mo, ye ma nɛ i hla nɛ i suɔ mo.
“Nihi nɛ kuma ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ, ma ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu.
Ma ha zugba gbigbli ɔ nyu, nɛ pahi maa hia.
Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo o bimɛ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ ma gbaa o nina a.
A ma plɔke kaa nga nɛ na nyu saminya, loo tsohi ngɛ pa tue.
“Nɔ kake ma de ke ‘Imi lɛɛ Mawu nɔ́ ji mi;’ nɔ kake ma tsɛ e he ke Yakob.
Nɔ kake hu ma kadi kɛ wo e kɔni nɔ ke, ‘Yawɛ nɔ́,’ nɛ e ma tsɛ e he ke Israel.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel matsɛ, kɛ e kpɔlɔ, nɛ lɛ ji Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ji, “Imi ji kekleekle no, kɛ nyagbe no.
Ye se ɔ, Mawu kpa ko be hu.
Mɛnɔ kɛ mi sɔ?
Ha nɛ a ha heto.
Ha nɛ a je nya nɛ a de ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
Níhi nɛ ba blema a, mɛnɔ lɛ de to?
Ha nɛ a gba níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.
Ye ma, koo nu sawale!
Koo ye gbeye!
Ye we odase ji mo.
Anɛ i de we enɛ ɔ blema lokoo lo?
Anɛ ye se ɔ, Mawu ko pa ngɛ lo?
Dɛbi, i li he wami kpa ko ngɛ ye se hu?” A gbe amaga jami he guɛ Amaga puɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ji nimli guhi, nɛ amaga amɛ nɛ a buu kaa nɔ́ ko ɔ, a he be se nami ko kulaa.
Nihi nɛ jaa kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a hɛngmɛ yu; a li nɔ́ ko fɛɛ; zo maa gbe mɛ.
Mɛnɔ lɛ puɛɔ amaga nɛ he be se nami, nɛ e jaa lɛ?
Nihi tsuo nɛ jaa kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ.
Nihi nɛ puɛɔ amaga amɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ kaa nihi nɛ jaa mɛ ɔ kɛ̃.
Nyɛ ha amaga puɛli ɔmɛ kɛ e jali ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba.
Mɛ tsuo a tsui maa po, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
Sɔ̃lɔ ngɔɔ dade kɛ woɔ la mi, nɛ e dɔɔ la.
E kɛ e he wami woɔ hamle nɔ kɛ fiaa dade ɔ nɛ e kɛ sɔ̃ɔ̃ nɔ́ ko.
Ke e ngɛ nɔ́ ɔ sɔ̃e ɔ, hwɔ kɛ kuma yee lɛ, nɛ pɔ tɔɔ lɛ.
Tso galɔ ngɔɔ kpa kɛ susuu tso, e ngɔɔ kadimi nɔ́ kɛ kadiɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ ga dade kɛ hlɔɔ tso ɔ he kɛ peeɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ je nɔmlɔ; e ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ e he fɛu nɛ ɔ kɛ ya maa we mi.
E ma nyɛ maa po seda kɛ pee amaga nɛ ɔ, aloo e ma hla odum, loo nga mi tso kpa ko.
Ke e suɔ po, e ma du sɛsɛo, nɛ e maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si hiɔmi maa nɛ, nɛ tso ɔ maa wa saminya.
Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɔɔ tso nɛ ɔ fa ko kɛ peeɔ lɛ́ kɛ slɛɔ la nɛ e hluiɔ; nɛ e kɛ sãã abolo hulɔ.
E ngɔɔ tso ɔ fa ko hu kɛ peeɔ amaga.
E kplaa si ha lɛ, nɛ e jaa lɛ.
E ngɔɔ tso ɔ fa kɛ slɛɔ la; e kɛ la a sãã de lo, nɛ e yeɔ nɛ e tɔɔ.
E hluiɔ la, nɛ e deɔ ke, “Yɛɛ, ye he dɔ la.
La nɛ ɔ ngɔɔ loo!” Tso ɔ fa nɛ piɛ ɔ, e ngɔɔ kɛ peeɔ amaga, nɛ e kplaa si nɛ e jaa lɛ.
E faa kue ha lɛ, nɛ e deɔ ke, “Mo ji ye mawu!
He ye yi wami!” Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, a li, nɛ a nui sisi hulɔ.
A nga a hɛngmɛ, konɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́, a tsi a juɛmi nya, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́ sisi.
Amaga peelɔ ɔ be juɛmi, loo e kɔ we nɔ́ se nɛ e ma de ke, “Hyɛ kaa i sã tso ɔ fa kaa lɛ́; i sã abolo ngɛ la a mi; i ngɔ la a kɛ sã de lo, nɛ i ye.
Anɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ, ma kɛ puɛ amaga lo?
Anɛ ma kpla si ha tso kpoku lo?” E ní pee mɔbɔ kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ la zu yee; a mlɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e laa blɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be nyɛe ma he lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami, loo nɛ e ma de ke, “Anɛ pi yaka nɔ́ nɔ nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɛ ɔ?” Yawɛ, bɔlɔ kɛ yi wami helɔ ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Israel, o hɛ ko je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ!
Kai kaa ye tsɔlɔ ji mo.
Imi lɛ i bɔ mo, konɛ o pee ye tsɔlɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye hɛ be o nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
I je o tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ je o he kɛ ho kaa bɔku.
O yayami ɔmɛ laa kaa mɔtu afua.
Kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ, imi lɛ i he o yi wami ɔ nɛ.” Nyɛ hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ la nɛ nyɛ nya; nyɛ zugba a sisi hehi nɛ kuɔ, nyɛ he ose!
Nyɛ yo ɔmɛ, kɛ hue ɔmɛ kɛ a mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo, nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ he ose.
A je Yawɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi; ejakaa e he e ma Israel yi wami.
Yawɛ, o yi wami helɔ, kɛ o bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ, nihi tsuo kulaa a bɔlɔ ɔ nɛ.
Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i bli hiɔwe mi, nɛ i ha zugba a fɔɔ si gbajaa.
Mɛnɔ ke e nine ngɛ mi?
Imi ji nɔ nɛ haa lakpa gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ dodoe mi hyɛli a we okadi ɔmɛ peeɔ yaka.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ kuɔ ní leli a nya la, nɛ i haa a nile plɛɔ peeɔ kuasia jemi.
Ke i tsɔ ye tsɔlɔ ke e ya je ye yi mi tomi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ɔ, munyu nɛ e tuɔ ɔ, i maa nɔ mi, nɛ gbami ɔmɛ tsuo baa mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
I ngɛ Yerusalem dee ke, nihi ma ba hi ma a mi ekohu; a maa ma Yuda ma amɛ ekohu, nɛ nimli ma ba hi a mi.
A maa to jamɛ a ma amɛ si ekohu ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a nane mi.
I faa, kɛkɛ wo miiɔ, nɛ nyu taa pa amɛ a mi.
I deɔ Sirus ke, ‘Mo ji nɔ nɛ maa ye ye ma a nɔ ha mi; nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ sɔuu o maa pee.
O ma fa ke a ma Yerusalem ekohu, nɛ́ a to Yawɛ we ɔ sisi.’ ”
Yawɛ hla Sirus Yawɛ hla Sirus ke e ye matsɛ!
E hla lɛ ke e ye je mahi a nɔ; e tsɔ lɛ, konɛ e ya kpɔ ma amɛ a he wami tsuo ngɛ a dɛ.
Yawɛ ma bli ma a we agbo ɔmɛ a nya ha lɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Sirus dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Imi nitsɛ ma nyɛɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ ma ba yo ɔmɛ tsuo si.
Ma ku akɔblee agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ ma poo a se lami ní ɔmɛ a mi ngɔ pue he.
Ma je juetli kpo ha mo kɛ je diblii mi, kɛ je hehi nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ laa ngɛ ɔ, konɛ o na nɛ o le kaa imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i le mo, nɛ i kɛ o biɛ tsɛɔ mo.
I tsɛ mo, konɛ o piɛ Israel he.
Israel nɛ ɔ ji ma nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla.
E ngɛ mi kaa o li mi lɛɛ, se i wo o hɛ mi nyami wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
“Imi ji Yawɛ; ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu.
O li mi lɛɛ, se he wami nɛ hia mo ɔ, i ngɔ ha mo.
I ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee, konɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi, kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya si bonyoku je nɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, nɛ ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ bɔ la kɛ diblii tsuo.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ haa he jɔmi baa, haomi hu imi nɔuu.
Imi Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ ha nɛ dami sane yemi nɛ kple si kɛ ba; é nɛ kɛ pue si kaa bɔ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ dami sane yemi nɛ pue si kɛ je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi; é nɛ kɛ pue si kaa hiɔmi.
Zugba a hu nɛ bli e nya, konɛ yi wami hemi nɛ bɔni kpo jemi; enɛ ɔ kɛ dami sane yemi tsuo maa je kpo paa si kake.
Imi Yawɛ lɛ i ha enɛ ɔ ba mi.” Yawɛ nɛ bɔ je ɔ, le sanehi tsuo nɛ baa Musu tloo nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e kɛ e bɔlɔ ɔ sãã nya.
Adesa ngɛ kaa zu buɛ ngɛ buɛ puɛlɔ dɛ mi.
Anɛ zu biɔ buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ ke, “Mɛni lɛ o ngɛ puɛe ɔ?” aloo “Nɔ́ nɛ o puɛ ɔ be nine lo?” Musu tloo bi muɔloku nɛ deɔ e tsɛ ke, “Mɛni bi a ma fɔ ha mo?” aloo e nyɛ ke, “Kɔɔmi nɛ o nu ɔ, mɛni bi o ma fɔ?” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ je ɔ bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ he blɔ kaa e deɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ siɔ mi lo, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ a he jio, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ ye nine nya ní tsumi he jio?
Imi nɛ i bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi nimli adesahi.
I ngɔ ye he wami kɛ bli hiɔwe mi, nɛ i yeɔ pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Imi nitsɛ nɛ i hla Sirus nɛ i wo lɛ he wami, konɛ e pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ma ha e blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa da tlɔmɔɔ.
E maa ma ye ma Yerusalem ɔ ekohu, nɛ e maa ngmɛɛ ye nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ye a he.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɔɛ lɛ apaa, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu ha we lɛ nyɔ mi ní ke e tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.” Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Yawɛ de Israel ke, “Egipt juetli, kɛ Sudan nijua ní ma ba pee o nɔ́, nɛ Seba bi, nimli gagahi ma ba pee o nyɔguɛhi; a maa bɔ mɛ pã kɛ ba o ngɔ; a ma ba kpla si ha mo, nɛ a ma kpa mo pɛɛ ngɛ he si bami mi ke, ‘Niinɛ, Mawu nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake too ji Mawu; ekpa ko be hu.
Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ, e ji Mawu nɛ laa e he.
Amaga puɛli a hɛ mi ma pue si; zo maa gbe mɛ tsuo kpɔtɔɔ.
Se Israel ma a lɛɛ Yawɛ ma he a yi wami kɛ maa ya neneene; e be hae nɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ” Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, lɛ nɔ kake too ji Mawu!
E bɔ je ɔ, nɛ e kɛ zugba a ma si saminya.
E bɔɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔɛ si gu nɛ e pee yaka; se e pee lɛ konɛ nimli nɛ hi nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Imi ji Yawɛ; mawu kpa ko be hu.
I tu we munyu ngɛ laami mi; ye yi mi tomi fɔɔ si paa.
I de we Israel ma a ke a ya hla mi ngɛ nga pã.
Imi ji Yawɛ, anɔkuale pɛ i tuɔ; nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɔ ɔ pɛ i deɔ.” Yawɛ, je ɔ tsɛ ɔ kɛ Babilon amaga amɛ ná Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yi na wami ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ ba!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛɔ tso amagahi kɛ hii nyɛɛe, nɛ nyɛ hii sɔlee ha mawuhi nɛ be yi wami nyɛe ma he, nyɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ!
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sane ɔ nɛ ba nɛ waa hyɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ ma je a sane ɔ nya a, nyɛ ha nɛ a ya kpe yi!
Nyɛ mawu ɔmɛ a kpɛti mɛnɔ nyɛ́ de nɔ́ ko kɛ to blema lokoo?
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be.
Anɛ pi imi Yawɛ lo?
Anɛ pi imi Mawu nɛ da, nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ lo?
Ye se ɔ, Mawu kpa ko be hu.
“Nyɛ nimli tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ jehanɛ, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami!
Ejakaa imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu; Mawu kpa ko be.
I ngɛ kita kae, nɛ i be ye nya se kpalee.
I ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye he kita kae ke je ma amɛ tsuo maa ba; a ma ba kpla si ha mi, nɛ a ma ka mi kita.
“A ma de ke, ‘Yawɛ pɛ lɛ yeɔ dami sane; lɛ pɛ lɛ e ngɛ he wami.’ Se nihi tsuo nɛ sume mi ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ.
Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha Israel nina tsuo maa ye kunimi, nɛ a maa fĩa kɛ fɔ ye nɔ.
“Babilon mawu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Be ko ɔ, a ja Bel kɛ Nebo.
A hɛɛɔ mɛ kɛ hii si poe.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ a plɛ pee tlomi ngɛ tejihi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ a se mi.
Amaga amɛ nyɛ we nɛ a he mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami; a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
Babilon mawu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
“Nyɛ ye ma a mi nihi tsuo, Yakob nina nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ baa nyɛ yi kɛ je nyɛ fɔmi be tɔɔ.
Imi nɔuu ji nyɛ Mawu nɛ maa hyɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ nyɛ maa wa nɛ nyɛ maa puɛ mua.
Imi lɛ i bɔ nyɛ; ma baa nyɛ yi; ma piɛ nyɛ he, nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami.
“Yawɛ ngɛ bie ke, ‘Mɛnɔ he nyɛ maa ngɔ mi kɛ to?
Nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ kɛ mi sɔ lo?’ Nihi jeɔ sika tsu babauu kɛ jee a kotoku mi, nɛ a ngmɛɛ sika hiɔ ngɛ sɛni tɛ nɔ.
A bɔɔ sika tsu galɔ apaa, nɛ e kɛ peeɔ amaga ha mɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, a kplaa si nɛ a jaa amaga a!
A ngɔɔ amaga a ngɔ fɔɔ a konɔ; a kɛ ya maa si ngɛ he ko, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e mimiɛɔ e he po kɛ je he nɛ e maa si ngɛ ɔ!
Ke nɔ ko fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e haa lɛ heto, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e jeɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ jeɔ haomi mi hulɔ.
“Nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ susu he.
Nyɛ kai níhi nɛ i pee blema lokoo ɔ; ejakaa Mawu kpa ko be nɛ kɛ mi sɔ.
Níhi tsuo nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ, imi ji nɔ nɛ gba kɛ to kɛ je blema lokoo; níhi nɛ na we nɛ a ba lolo ɔ hu, imi lɛ i gba kɛ to.
I de ke ye yi mi tomi maa ba mi, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ma pee.
I ngɛ nɔ ko tsɛe kɛ je beleku je; e he maa sɔ kaa kayo kɛ ba kple si, nɛ e ma ba tsu níhi nɛ i to nɛ ma pee ɔ. Bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ e maa ba mi.
“Nyɛ ma nɛ nyɛ tue mi ti, nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa kunimi yemi ngɛ se lokoo, nyɛɛ bu tue.
I ha ye kunimi yemi ligbi ɔ na nyɛ haa; e be tsitsaa lokoo kulaa.
Ye kunimi yemi ɔ be se kpɛe.
Ma he Yerusalem yi wami, nɛ ma wo Israel hɛ mi nyami.”
Babilon hɛ mi kpatami Yawɛ ke, “Babilon, mo kple si kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ!
Ba hi si ngɛ zugba, ngɛ bunyuku mi!
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, o ngɛ kaa yomiyo, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a be mo hɛɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ hu!
Ngɔɔ wɛ tɛ kɛ ba!
Moo wɛɛ blɛfo nɛ a kɛ pee ma!
Je o hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ esɔ!
Kpa bo saminyayoo ɔ ngɛ o he, nɛ́ o nane nɛ je kpo.
Poo pa amɛ kɛ ya!
Nihi maa na o he gu ɔ; a maa na o zo kpɔtɔɔ ɔ. Ma ha tue gblami maa ba, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ye nya tsie.” Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ha wa ye wa he.
E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
Yawɛ ngɛ Babilon dee ke, “Hii si dii ngɛ diblii mi; a be mo tsɛe ke je ma amɛ a manyɛ hu.
Ye ma a wo ye mi mi la; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i bui mɛ kaa ye ma hu.
I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo o sisi, nɛ o nɛ́ mɛ mɔbɔ ko kulaa; nihi nɛ bwɔ po, o wa mɛ yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E pee mo kaa o maa ye manyɛ daa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o susuu we ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ha hu, o bui.
“Jehanɛ lɛɛ, bu tue; mo nɛ o suɔ je mi ngɔɔmi yemi, nɛ o hii si gbɔjɔɔ kaa nɔ nɛ he mi jɔ lɛ, mo nɛ o fĩaa ke o kle kaa Mawu, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ mo sɔɛ.
O susuu hu kaa o be yalɔyo pee gblee, nɛ o bimɛ hu be gboe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Se tlukaa, ligbi kake mi ɔ, nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba o nɔ; o maa ye kunya, nɛ o maa fi kablɛ babauu, se o huno, kɛ o bimɛ tsuo maa laa mo.
“Yayami nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ peeɔ mo kaa o he mi jɔ mo.
O susu kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo nae.
O ga, kɛ o nile ɔ ha o laa blɔ, nɛ o de o he ke, ‘Imi ji imi, nɛ ye se ɔ nɔ ko be hu.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, haomi maa ba o nɔ, nɛ o be nya nyɛe maa da.
Oslaa ma ba na mo, se o be e nya nyɛe maa tsi.
O hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa be nɛ o li o he be.
Kunya nɛ o ye, kɛ kablɛ nɛ o fi kɛ je o jokuɛwi a si ɔ, pɛtɛ he.
Eko piɔ, a ma ha nɛ nihi a mi maa hi ha mo, nɛ o he nyɛli maa ye mo gbeye.
Nihi nɛ le hiɔwe níhi a mi, nihi nɛ kase dodoe ɔmɛ a he ní, kɛ nihi nɛ pee hiɔwe mi dlami ɔmɛ a he foni, nɛ a deɔ mo níhi nɛ maa ba o nɔ nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ mi ɔ, ha nɛ a ba nɛ a ba he o yi wami koo!
Se pɔ tɔ mo kɛ a ga womi ɔmɛ!
“A maa pee kaa nga gbigbli, nɛ la maa sã mɛ!
A be nyɛe ma he mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami; la lilɛ ɔmɛ maa sã mɛ.
Pi la kulɔɔ nɛ a hluiɔ ji nɛ ɔ; pi la nɛ a hii he.
Nihi tsuo nɛ o gbo a he dengme ɔ, se nɛ o ma na ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nihi nɛ kɛ mo ye jua kɛ je o jokuɛwi a si ɔ, mɛ tsuo a maa ngmɛɛ o he; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma wo lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be piɛe nɛ ma he o yi wami.”
Israel kuɛ wa Israel ma, Yuda nina, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tue; nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ Yawɛ biɛ kɛ kaa kita, nɛ nyɛ tsiɔ Israel Mawu ɔ ta ke nyɛ ngɛ lɛ jae, pi anɔkuale mi, se nya mi gu.
Nyɛ siɔ nyɛ gugue, nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ; nyɛ deɔ hu ke Israel Mawu nɛ e biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɔ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ.
Yawɛ ngɛ Israel dee ke, “Níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ, i gba ngɔ to blema lokoo, nɛ tlukaa, i ha a ba mi.
Israel bi, i le kaa nyɛ kuɛ wa; e ngɛ kpakpataa kaa dade, nɛ nyɛ yi wu tso ngɛ kpɛkpɛtɛɛ kaa akɔblee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i gba nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ ngɔ to blema lokoo; i gba ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to loko á ba mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko de ke nyɛ we amaga amɛ, níhi nɛ a kpɛ́, kɛ níhi nɛ a sɔ̃ ɔ nɛ a ha ní ɔmɛ ba mi.
“Jehanɛ, níhi nɛ i gba ngɔ to ɔ tsuo ba mi.
Anɛ e sɛ kaa nyɛ kplɛɛɔ nɔ kaa ja i de ɔ lo?
Jehanɛ ma gba nyɛ ní hehi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se, laami mi sanehi nɛ maa ba, nɛ i je we kpo kɛ tsɔɔ we hyɛ.
Kpaako i ha ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi bae; nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ bɛ hyɛ.
Ke pi ja a, nyɛ ma de ke nyɛ le enɛ ɔ tsuo momo.
Nyɛ nui hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ li lolo; kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, nyɛ tue bli we lolo!
Ejakaa i le kaa yi wu tso níhi nyɛ peeɔ; kɛ je nyɛ fɔmi be mi tɔɔ ɔ, atuã tsɔli a tsɛɔ nyɛ.
“Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a je ye biɛ yi he je ɔ, i tsi ye mi mi la a nya; i tsi nya, konɛ ma ko kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
I ngɔ amanehlu kɛ ka nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika hiɔ he ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi; se i na kaa nyɛ he be se nami ko kulaa.
Imi nitsɛ ye he i pee ha; ee, imi nitsɛ ye he ma pee ha.
Ejakaa mɛni he je e sa kaa a puɛ ye biɛ?
I be ye hɛ mi nyami ngɔe kɛ ha nɔ kpa ko.” Yawɛ hla Sirus kaa hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ Yawɛ ke, “Israel, ma nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Imi ji Mawu, kekleekle nɔ, kɛ nyagbe nɔ; imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu!
Imi nitsɛ lɛ i to zugba a sisi, nɛ i bli hiɔwe mluguduu ɔ mi.
Benɛ i tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, mɛ tsuo a he sɔ kɛ ba.
“Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ mawu ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ gba enɛ ɔ kɛ to?
Nɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i suɔ lɛ ɔ, ma ba pee nɔ́ nɛ sa imi Yawɛ ye hɛ mi, nɛ e ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi butuu.
Imi nitsɛ nɛ i hla lɛ.
Imi nɛ i ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ ní tsumi nɛ i ha lɛ ɔ, e maa ye manye ngɛ mi.
“Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ba bu mi tue.
Kɛ je sisije ɔ tsuo lakpa ko be ye munyu mi, nɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ baa mi sisiisi.” Hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla a he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɔ e mumi ɔ ngɔ wo ye mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi.” Yawɛ to yi mi ha e ma a Yawɛ, Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɔ nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
I suɔ kaa ma tsɔse nyɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi ha, konɛ e hi ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ.
“I na nɛ nyɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ!
Jinɛ a maa gbaa nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ maa pee kaa pa nɛ nyu tɛ̃ mi gblegbleegble.
Nyɛ maa ye kunimi nɔtonɔto kaa bɔ nɛ oslɔke kuɔ kɛ pueɔ wo dɔ mi.
Nyɛ ngmɛdu ko hiɛ babauu kaa zia, nɛ i ko hyɛ a nɔ saminya, konɛ a hɛ mi ko kpata gblegbleegble.” Nyɛɛ je Babilon esɔesɔ; nyɛ wo fo!
Nyɛ hwɔ lele nɛ a nu ngɛ he tsuaa he ke, “Yawɛ he e tsɔlɔ Israel yi wami!” Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ e ma a nyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ, kuma yi mɛ; ejakaa e ha nyu je tɛ sa mi ha mɛ; tɛ sa a mi gba, kɛkɛ nɛ nyu je mi kaa pa. Yawɛ ke, “Yayami peeli be he jɔmi nae gblegbleegble.”
Israel ji kane kɛ ha je ma amɛ Nyɛ wo nya mahi, nyɛɛ bu tue, Nyɛ je mahi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ se lokoo, nyɛ ta tue!
Yawɛ hla mi loko a fɔ mi.
Benɛ i ngɛ ye nyɛ mi mi lokoo nɛ e wo ye biɛ ta.
E ha ye nya mi munyu pee kaa klaate nɛ nya ba.
E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nine kɛ bu ye he.
E pee mi kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ nya ba, nɛ hɔɔ si ngɛ kotoku mi.
E de mi ke, “Israel, ye tsɔlɔ ji mo.
O he ɔ, nihi maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami.” Se imi lɛɛ, i de ke, “I gbo dengme yaka gu; i puɛ ye he wami tsuo yaka; i na we se ko.” Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ maa ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, e maa pee mi kpakpa.
Loko a fɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ hla mi, nɛ e pee mi e tsɔlɔ, konɛ ma ya kpale e ma a kɛ ba e ngɔ; ma kpale Israel ma a nɛ gbɛ fĩa a kɛ ba ha lɛ.
Yawɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi he wami.
Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ, i ngɛ ní tsumi agbo ko ha mo; pi kaa o ma bua Israel bi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ a nya kɛ pee ma ekohu kaa sa a kɛkɛ, se mohu kaa o maa pee la kɛ ha je ma amɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he je ɔ tsuo yi wami.” Nɔ nɛ a gbe e he guɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ je ma amɛ sume e sane saasaa a, nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Israel yi wami helɔ, kɛ Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ dee ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Matsɛmɛ maa na mo, nɛ a maa te si ha mo; ganɔhi maa na, nɛ a ma kpla si ha mo kɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi, ejakaa Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ hla e tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ; Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ yeɔ e siwo nɔ sisiisi.
A maa ma Yerusalem ekohu Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, “Ke be su nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami ɔ, ma na nyɛ mɔbɔ; ngmlaa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kpae ke ma ba piɛ nyɛ he ɔ, ma bu tue.
Ma bu nyɛ he, nɛ ma baa nyɛ yi, nɛ ma gu nyɛ nɔ nɛ i kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa so.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɛ hɛ mi kpata a, ma ha nyɛ ma ba hi nɔ ekohu.
Ma de nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ je kpo!’ nɛ ma de nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ je kpo kɛ ba la hɛ mi!’ A maa pee kaa tohi nɛ ngɛ ní yee ngɛ blɔ tue.
Yo nɔ he nɛ hue be ɔ maa pee a ní yemi he.
Hwɔ be mɛ yee, nɛ kuma be mɛ yee gblegbleegble.
Pu la, kɛ nga kplanaa nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi dɔ la be mɛ awi yee; ejakaa nɔ nɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ maa piɛ a he.
E maa tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ kɛ ya nyu hɛngmɛhi a he.
“Ma je blɔ kɛ nyɛɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ ma pee gbɛjegbɛ ha ye ma a. Ee, ye ma a maa je tsitsaa kɛ maa ba, a maa je omleyi je kɛ bonyoku je, nɛ a maa je Aswan tɔɔ ngɛ leneyi je kɛ maa ba.” Nyɛ hiɔwe níhi, nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi!
Zugba, hwɔ lele!
Nyɛ yo ɔmɛ hu nyɛ la!
Yawɛ maa jɔɔ e ma a bua; nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Se bɔ nɛ Yerusalem ngɛ dee ji, “Yawɛ ngmɛɛ ye he ngɔ fɔ si!
E hɛ po je ye nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Anɛ binyɛ hɛ maa je lɛ nitsɛ e bi nɛ ngɛ nyɔ nya nɔ lo?
Anɛ e be suɔmi kpo jee kɛ tsɔɔ e bi ɔ lo?
Ke binyɛ hɛ maa je e bi nɔ po, imi lɛɛ ye hɛ be o nɔ jee kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Yerusalem, hyɛ, i ngma o biɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi, ye hɛ be o nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
“Nihi nɛ maa fia gbogbo ɔmɛ ɔ ma amlɔ nɔuu, nɛ nihi nɛ ba kpata o hɛ mi ɔ maa je kɛ ho.
Hyɛ o he kɛ kpe, nɛ o maa na nɔ́ ko!
O ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he nya buae kɛ ma we!
Ligbi abɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ma ha o bua maa jɔ o ma a he kaa bɔ nɛ ayɛflo bua jɔɔ june nɛ e wo he ɔ.
“A kpata o zugba a hɛ mi; a pee o ma a butuu; se jehanɛ lɛɛ, nihi nɛ ma lejɛ ɔ himi ɔ, zugba a be mɛ sue hu.
Nihi nɛ ba pee mo butuu ɔ maa je o he kɛ ya se lokoo.
Jehanɛ hu, o bimɛ nɛ o fɔ ngɛ ma se ɔ, hwɔɔ se ɔ, a ma de mo ke, ‘Zugba nɛ ɔ klee we ha wɔ; e hia wɔ zugba nɛ kle nɛ waa hi nɔ.’ Kɛkɛ ɔ, o ma bi o he ke, ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha mi?
Nihi gbo ta ye he; i plɛ pee nɔ ko nɛ fɔ we, a nu mi kɛ ho ma se ya.
Hyɛ, a si imi nɔ kake too, lɛɛ jije lɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je mɔ?
Mɛnɔ nɛ lɛ mɛ?’ ” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma fɔ̃ je ma amɛ nine; ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa na okadi ɔ, nɛ a maa hɛɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ a gugue mi, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ maa fɔ a konɔ kɛ ba.
Matsɛmɛ ma plɛ pee tsɛmɛ kɛ ha mo, nɛ manyɛmɛ ma plɛ pee nyɛmɛ kɛ ha mo.
A ma kpla si ha mo, nɛ a maa wo o hɛ mi nyami.
A maa ba a he si ha mo, nɛ a maa bu mo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ niinɛ.
Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ye nɔ ɔ, zo be mɛ gbee.” Katsɛ ta yibu ní ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ lo?
Ke yiwutsotsɛ nu nɔ ko ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ kpɔ lɛ ngɛ e dɛ?
Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Niinɛ, katsɛ ta yibu ní ɔ, a ma nyɛ kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ.
Ke yiwutsotsɛ nu nɔ ko po, a ma nyɛ kpɔ lɛ ngɛ e dɛ.
I kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ pɛe ɔ ma ná, nɛ ma he o bimɛ ɔmɛ a yi wami.
Ma ha nihi nɛ ngɛ mo haoe ɔ maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he lo awi; mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muɔ maa de mɛ kaa wai.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi tsuo maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ heɔ o yi wami, nɛ haa nɛ o yeɔ o he.
A ma na le kaa imi ji Israel Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Yawɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa i ha ye ma a je ye he kɛ ho kaa bɔ nɛ nyumu kɛ e yo poɔ gba mi, nɛ e haa yo ɔ gba mi pomi womi ɔ lo?
Ke ja nyɛ susu ɔ, jije gba mi pomi womi ɔ ngɛ mɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa i jua nyɛ kɛ ho ma se ya kaa bɔ nɛ a juaa bimɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi lo?
Dɛbi, nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he nɛ a jua nyɛ ɔ nɛ; nyɛ mlaa tɔmi ɔmɛ a he a fie nyɛ kɛ ho ɔ nɛ.
“Mɛni he je lɛ benɛ i ba a, nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ?
Benɛ i tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, mɛni he je nɔ ko pui mi ɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa ye nine ngɛ kuku nɛ i be nyɛe ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je he nyɛlɔ ɔ dɛ mi lo?
Ke i wo gbi ɔ, wo miiɔ, nɛ pahi plɛɔ peeɔ nga kplanaa.
Ke nyu ɔ mii ta a, lo gboɔ nɛ e saa.
Imi lɛ i haa hiɔwe woɔ diblii kpii kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kpekpe ya bo ha he.” Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ bu lɛ tue Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ ma de, konɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, ma nyɛ ma wo nɔ nɛ pɔ tɔ lɛ ɔ he wami.
Daa mɔtu ɔ, e haa i hlaa kaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mi ɔ, ma bu tue kaa ní kaselɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ bli ye tue; i tsɔ we atuã, i kua we lɛ.
I ngmɛ blɔ nɛ a fia ye se mi kpa; a jɛ mi; a hia ye kpɛni si bwɔmi, nɛ a su lada ngɔ pue ye hɛ mi kɛ pue ye hɛ mi si.
Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pee we mi nɔ́ ko, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ piɛ ye he, nɛ zo gbi mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i nu ye tsui, nɛ i wlua mi, ejakaa i le kaa zo be mi gbee.
Nɔ nɛ maa wo mi nguɔ ɔ ngɛ ye kasa nya.
Mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ mi ná a?
É ba konɛ waa kpe!
Mɛnɔ ji ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ?
É hɛ lɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ngɛ ye kasa nya, mɛnɔ maa bu mi fɔ mɔ?
Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo maa laa, a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye.
Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ e buɔ e tsɔlɔ ɔ gbi tue?
E tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ, ke e nyɛɛ ngɛ diblii kpii mi po, e ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ e he kɛ kpasaa e Mawu ɔ. Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kpe kɛ soɔ nihi a yi nɔ, konɛ nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi, nyɛ yi mi tomi yaya amɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.
Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi; nyɛ nyagbe maa pee mɔbɔ.
A wo Yerusalem bua Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami, nɛ nyɛ ba ye ngɔ, konɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Nyɛ susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he: tɛ sa nɛ a gba nyɛ kɛ je mi ɔ, kɛ tɛ muɔ nɛ a tsua nyɛ kɛ je mi ɔ. Nyɛ susu nyɛ nɛ̃, Abraham, kɛ Sara hu nɛ fɔ nyɛ ɔ a he.
Benɛ i tsɛ Abraham ɔ, e be bi ko kulaa, se i gbaa lɛ, nɛ i ha lɛ bimɛ; nɛ i ha e nina hiɛ babauu.
“Ma jɔɔ Yerusalem bua; nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem we doku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ma jɔɔ a bua.
E zugba a pee nga kplanaa lɛɛ, se ma ha e ma plɛ pee ngmɔ kaa ngmɔ ɔ nɛ i pee ngɛ Eden ɔ. Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a bua maa jɔ saminya, a ma nya nɛ a ma la yi jemi, kɛ sina lahi.
“Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu mi tue, nyɛ ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ. Ma ngɔ ye mlaa kɛ ha je ma amɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔ maa pee kaa la ha mɛ.
Ma ba esɔesɔ, konɛ ma ba he a yi wami.
Ye kunimi yemi be ɔ su ta.
Imi nitsɛ ma ye je ma amɛ a nɔ.
Wo nya zugba amɛ ngɛ mi mlɛe, a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ kɛ ngɛ mi blɔ hyɛe kaa ma ba he a yi wami.
Nyɛ wo nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nyɛɛ kpale hyɛ zugba mi.
Hiɔwe maa laa kaa la su ku nɛ se po; zugba ma puplee kaa tako piɛ, nɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ ma gbo kaa anunuhi.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami daa; ma ye kunimi ha nyɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.
“Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ nyɛ suɔ ye mlaa a saminya, nyɛ ko ye gbeye kaa nimli adesahi maa ye nyɛ he fɛu, loo a ma jɛ nyɛ.
Ke a ngɛ nyɛ he fɛu yee ɔ, nyɛ ko ye tsui!
Ejakaa a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye, loo kuutu nɛ gɔgɔ ye.
Ma ye dami sane ha nyɛ daa, nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami be tsuaa be; ma ye kunimi ha nyɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.” Yawɛ, moo te si nɛ o piɛ wa he!
Ngɔɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ he wa yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o pee blema a. Pi mo nɛ o gbɔ Rahab, wo mi lo nguaa a nɔ́, nɛ o poo e mi kpokukpoku ɔ lo?
Mo nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ ha wo ɔ mii; o je blɔ kɛ gu nyu ɔ mi, konɛ nihi nɛ o he a yi wami ɔ nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a po wo ɔ. Nihi nɛ mo Yawɛ, o kpɔ mɛ ɔ, a kɛ bua jɔmi ma la kɛ ba Yerusalem.
A bua maa jɔ kɛ maa ya neneene; aywilɛho kɛ kɔmɔ yemi tsuo se maa po.
Yawɛ ke, “Imi ji nɔ nɛ woɔ mo he wami.
Nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ gboɔ, nɛ e wami se kɛmi pi kaa nga nɔ́ po ɔ, mɛni he je o yeɔ lɛ gbeye?
Anɛ Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ mo, nɛ e pee hiɔwe ploplooplo, nɛ e ngɔ zugba a sisi tomi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ, o hɛ je e nɔ lo?
Nihi nɛ ngɛ mo yi mi wae, nɛ a pee klaalo kaa a ma kpata o hɛ mi ɔ, mɛni he je o ngɛ mɛ mohu gbeye yee ɔ?
A be nyɛe maa pee mo nɔ ko hu.
E be kɛe kulaa nɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ maa ye a he.
A ma na a nya mi ngma bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ a se maa kɛ ngɛ je mi.
“Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Imi nɛ i haa wo gliɔ, nɛ oslɔke ɔmɛ peeɔ hoo.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ji ye biɛ!
Imi ji nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe ploplooplo ɔ, nɛ i ngɔ zugba a sisi tomi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si.
Bɔ nɛ i ngɛ Yerusalem dee ji, ‘Ye ma ji mo!
I wo mo mlaa, nɛ i ngɔ ye he wami kɛ ngɛ o he bue.’ ” Yerusalem amanehlu ɔ se po Yerusalem, tee si!
O hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ o te si nɛ o da si!
Amanehlu nɛ ngɛ kaa kplu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ abofu ngɔ ha mo ke o nu, konɛ e kɛ gbla o tue ɔ, o nu kɛ e sisi ɔ tsuo; nɛ enɛ ɔ ha o ngɛ si tataae.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be o bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o tsɔse ɔ a kpɛti nɛ maa ta o dɛ mi kɛ nyɛɛ.
Haomi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ba o nɔ; ta ba kpata o zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ hwɔ nɛ nya wa ngɛ ni ɔmɛ yee.
Mɛnɔ maa jɔɔ o bua?
O bimɛ ɔmɛ gbɔjɔ, nɛ a hɛli kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bayelɔ nɛ du klama.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ gbla o tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem, o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ní pee mɔbɔ, nɛ a ngɛ si tataae kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ faa e ma a he ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Kplu nɛ i ngɔ ha mo ngɛ abofu nya a, i ngɛ hee ngɛ o dɛ.
O be dã a nue hu konɛ o ko tataa si kaa dã tɔlɔ hu.
O he nyɛli nɛ haoɔ mo, nihi nɛ ha o hwɔɔ si ngɛ zugba mi, nɛ a naa o nɔ kaa a naa gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ɔ, mɛ a dɛ mi ma ngɔ kplu ɔ kɛ wo.”
Mawu ma he Yerusalem yi wami Yerusalem, tee si nɛ o pee ma nguaa ekohu!
Mawu ma klɔuklɔu, o hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami, nɛ́ a bu mo saminya!
Ma je li be hiɛ ɔ bae hu gblegbleegble.
Yerusalem nɛ a pee mo nyɔguɛ, tee si nɛ o huanya bunyuku ɔ ngɔ pue si, nɛ o hi o matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ!
Zion biyo nɛ a nu mo nɛ a bɔ mo pã, je pã a ngɛ o kuɛ!
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Tsa pi sika nɛ a kɛ he nyɛ kɛ pee nyɛ nyɔguɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ sika be nyɛ kpɔe.
Kekle ɔ, nyɛ ya Egipt, nɛ nyɛ ya to nubwɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; pee se ɔ, Asiria bi ɔmɛ wa nyɛ yi mi yaka gu.
Jehanɛ, ngɛ Babilonia hu, jamɛ a amimi ɔ nɔuu a ye nyɛ; a pee nyɛ nyɔguɛhi nɛ a wui hiɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ he.
Nihi nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ ɔ fĩa, nɛ a jɛ nyɛ saminya kɛ gbe ye he guɛ.
Be ma nɛ nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Mawu; nyɛ maa le kaa imi lɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu ɔ nɛ.” Mɛni ji afɛu!
Nyɛɛ hyɛ manye munyu fiɛlɔ ko nyɛɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma; e hɛɛ manye munyu sɔuu; manye munyu ɔ kɔɔ tue mi jɔmi he!
E ngɛ fiɛe ke a ye kunimi, nɛ e ngɛ Zion dee ke, “O Mawu ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee!” Ma a he buli ɔmɛ a nya nɛ a ngɛ nue boboobo ɔ nɛ; mɛ tsuo a kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ lae kɛ ngmlaa!
Ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɛ a hɛngmɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kpale e ma, Zion kɛ ma ekohu!
Nyɛ Yerusalem tsu kokoehi, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛ hwɔ lele!
Ejakaa Yawɛ ma he e ma a yi wami, nɛ e maa jɔɔ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a bua.
Yawɛ ma je e he wami klɔuklɔu ɔ kpo; e ma he e ma a yi wami, nɛ je ɔ tsuo maa na.
Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ba be kɛ ho; nyɛɛ je Babilonia!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ Mawu we ɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; nyɛ ko ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ e hia we kaa nyɛ maa ye esɔ kɛ hia blɔ; nyɛ be fo tue kɛ je.
Ejakaa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ maa nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ yaa a, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he.
Tsɔlɔ nɔ́ nalɔ ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ ɔ maa ye manye ngɛ e ní tsumi mi; a ma wo e nɔ gojoo, nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami babauu!
Nihi babauu nɛ na lɛ ɔ, a he mi po; ejakaa a puɛ e nɔmlɔ tso subai ɔ kulaa; ke o hyɛ lɛ ɔ, e slo lɛ kulaa ngɛ adesa he!
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ e he maa pee je mahi babauu nyakpɛ; nɛ matsɛmɛ pohu a nya maa kpɛ a he wawɛɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a de we mɛ hyɛ ɔ, a maa na, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui hyɛ ɔ, a maa nu sisi jehanɛ.”
Ni ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ ma he wa munyu nɛ ɔ maa ye?
Mɛnɔ maa le kaa Yawɛ he ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ mi?
Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa tso wayoo ko nɛ puɛ kɛ je zugba gbigbli mi.
Agboje ko be e he ɔ, he fɛu hu bɔ lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa bui lɛ.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he nɛ maa pee wɔ akɔnɔ.
Wa gbe e he guɛ, nɛ wa kua lɛ.
E na nɔ́, nɛ e pi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko plɛ we nɛ e hyɛ lɛ; wa gbe e he guɛ, nɛ wa bui lɛ saasaa.
“Haomi kɛ pimi nɛ ko ba wa nɔ ɔ, lɛ mohu e ya da nya ha wɔ.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, wa susu kaa Mawu lɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ngɛ e tue gblae.
A plaa lɛ ngɛ wa yayami ɔmɛ a he, a fiaa lɛ ní ngɛ wa tɔmi ɔmɛ a he, a gbla e tue, konɛ wa na he jɔmi, a wo e he pa, konɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa na tsami.
Wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ laa blɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ.
Se tue gblami nɛ sa wɔ tsuo ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ.
“A wa lɛ yi mi, nɛ a pi lɛ; se e kpɛ we e kuɔ si!
A kpaka lɛ kɛ ho kaa to bi nɛ a yaa gbe.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ jijɔ peeɔ kpoo ngɛ e he bwɔmi salɔ hɛ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu e kpɛ we e kuɔ si.
A ye sane yaya kɛ bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ a nu le kɛ ho.
Ejakaa a ngɔ e wami kɛ je zugba a nɔ.
Tɔmihi nɛ ye ma a tɔ ɔ, a he a gbe lɛ ngɛ.
E gbo ngɛ yayami peeli a kpɛti, nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ niatsɛ ko yɔkɔ mi; se anɔkuale mi ɔ, e yi nɔ ko awi hyɛ, nɛ lakpa ko hu ji e nya hyɛ.” “Se e sa Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa a fiaa lɛ ní; e ha a pi lɛ.
Ke e ngɔ e wami kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ yayami he ɔ, e se maa kɛ ngɛ je mi, nɛ e ma na nina babauu.
Nɛ Yawɛ maa gu e nɔ kɛ ye manye.
Ke e na nɔ́ se ɔ, e ma na bua jɔmi ekohu, nɛ e maa na kaa e nɔ́ nami pee we yaka.
Ye tsɔlɔ nɛ i suɔ lɛ ɔ, a maa gbla e tue ngɛ nihi babauu a nane mi, se e he ɔ, ma ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma ha lɛ blɔ nya nguaa ko ngɛ ni nguanguahi a kpɛti.
E kɛ mɛ maa dla ta yibu ní ɔ. Ejakaa e ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ yayami peeli babauu a nane mi; nɛ e kpa pɛɛ nɛ a ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.”
Yawɛ suɔ Israel sane Yerusalem, jinɛ o ngɛ kaa yosa, se jehanɛ lɛɛ o ma nyɛ ma la nɛ o ma hwɔ lele.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ o ma fɔ bimɛ babauu pe yo nɛ e kɛ e huno ngɛ tsu nya daa!
Bli o bo tsu ɔ mi; bli bo tsu ɔ mi gbajaa, tsa kpa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o ka tso plɛɛko ɔmɛ kɛ wo zu mi nɛ a he nɛ wa!
Ejakaa o he maa hiɛ ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ; zugba a nɛ je ma kpa amɛ ngɛ nɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o nina ma ba kpɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ nimli.
Koo ye gbeye, ejakaa zo be mo gbee!
O tsui ko po, ejakaa a be o hɛ mi si puee hu.
Zo ní nɛ o tsu ngɛ o yihe be mi ɔ, o hɛ maa je nɔ, nɛ si nɛ o hi mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa yalɔyo ɔ, o be kaie hu.
O bɔlɔ ɔ ma ba pee o huno.
E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ ma he o yi wami; lɛ ji je ɔ tsuo Mawu.
Israel, o ngɛ kaa yo nɛ e huno je e he, yo nɛ a je he ngɛ yihe mi, nɛ e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee wawɛɛ.
Se Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ ba e ngɔ ekohu, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke, “Be kpiti ko kɛkɛ nɛ i je o he, se ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe wawɛɛ ngɛ o he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ mo kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu.
Ye mi mi fu mo wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i je hɛ ngɛ o he be kuku, se jehanɛ lɛɛ ma je ye suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo kɛ maa ya neneene.” Imi Yawɛ yi wami helɔ ɔ, nɛ i de.
“Noa be ɔ mi ɔ, i wo si ko; i de ke i be hae nɛ nyu babauu ma ba ha zugba a nɔ hu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ mo si woe kaa ye mi mi be mo fue hu gblegbleegble.
Yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ maa ywia pue si, se suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha mo ɔ se be poe.
Somi nɛ i kɛ mo so kaa ma ha o tue mi nɛ jɔ mo ɔ, ma ye nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.” Imi Yawɛ, o mɔbɔ nalɔ ɔ nɛ i de.
Yerusalem he ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Yerusalem, ma nɛ na amanehlu, mo nɛ nɔ ko piɛ we o he nɛ e wo mo bua.
Ma ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ fia o sisi tomi ɔ ekohu.
Ma ngɔ tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ a tsɛɛ rubi tɛ kɛ ma gbogbo ɔmɛ a yi mi ngɛ saflɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ma ngɔ tɛ nɛ kpɛɔ kaa la, nɛ a tsɛɛ karbunkle tɛ ɔ kɛ pee agbo ɔmɛ.
Gbogbo nɛ bɔle mo ɔ, tɛ nɛ he jua wa sɔuu ma ngɔ kɛ fia.
“Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma tsɔɔ ye ma a ní, nɛ ma ha a ma na ní babauu.
Dami sane yemi, kɛ kpakpa peemi ma ha o ma a he maa wa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo yi mi wae, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be o he gbeye woe.
Ke nɔ ko ba tua mo ɔ, pi imi nɛ i tsɔ lɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba tua mo ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ be mo nyɛe.
“Imi ji nɔ nɛ bɔ sɔ̃lɔ nɛ huu la mi, nɛ e sɔ̃ɔ̃ ta hwumi níhi.
Imi nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ bɔ ta hwulɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ta hwumi dade kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.
Se ta hwumi níhi nɛ a sɔ̃ nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko be nyɛe maa pee mo nɔ́ ko; jehanɛ hu, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ mo ma na sane ɔ, a maa bu lɛ fɔ.
Ma bu ye tsɔli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ ma ha a maa ye kunimi.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Mawu naa mɔbɔ Yawɛ ke, “Kuuwi, nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kuma ngɛ nyɛ yee, nyu babaaba ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ha nyɛ!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ be sika hu, nyɛɛ ba; nyɛ ba he niye ní nɛ nyɛɛ ye!
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ ba he dã, kɛ na nyɔ nyu e hia we sika; a jua we!
Mɛni he je nyɛ puɛɔ sika kɛ heɔ nɔ nɛ be nyɛ tɔe?
Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ ní tsumi mi hiɔwo kɛ heɔ nɔ́ nɛ tɔɛ nɔ?
Nyɛɛ bu mi tue saminya nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ; kɛkɛ nyɛ maa ye ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ nyɛ he.
“Ye ma, nyɛ ta tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ; nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami.
I kɛ nyɛ maa so somi ko nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene; nɛ gbaami nɛ i wo David si ke ma ha e nina a, ma kɛ ha nyɛ.
I wo lɛ je ma amɛ a nyatsɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛngua, nɛ e nɔ i gu kɛ je ye he wami kpo.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, o ma tsɛ je mahi nɛ li mo kɛ ba; sa a, a li mo, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma wo fo kɛ ba o ngɔ!
Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ma ha ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi.” Be mi nɛ Yawɛ he kɛ we nɛ ɔ, nyɛ hla e se blɔ nɛ nyɛɛ fa kue ha lɛ.
Nyɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ, nyɛ kpa awi yemi, nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛ ko susu nɔ́ yaya hu.
Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ.
E naa mɔbɔ, nɛ be tsuaa be ɔ, e kɛ nɔ tɔmi paa.
Yawɛ ke, “E slo bɔ nɛ i susuɔ nɔ́ he, nɛ e slo bɔ nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ susuɔ nɔ́ he; jehanɛ e slo ye blɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a he.
Bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti kɛ ɔ, ja ye blɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ, nɛ ja nɔuu ye susumi ɔmɛ hu pã nyɛ susumi ɔmɛ.
“Ye munyu ngɛ kaa snoo kɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛɔ kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ pueɔ zugba.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ haa dumi níhi puɛɔ.
Wa naa wu nɛ wa duɔ, kɛ ngma nɛ wa yeɔ.
Munyuhi nɛ i tuɔ ɔ, ja a maa pee.
Munyu tsuaa munyu nɛ jeɔ ye nya a, nɔ́ nɛ i ke e pee ɔ, ja e pee loko e maa kpale kɛ ba.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i to ke e ba mi ɔ maa ba mi kokooko.
“Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi maa je lejɛ ɔ.
A maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ je ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ maa hia la, nɛ pu mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo maa fia a dɛ mi.
Mio tso nane mi ɔ, sɛsɛo maa puɛ.
Tso kpakpa maa puɛ ngɛ mio tso nane mi.
E maa pee okadi nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ a kɛ ma kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ tsu.”
Je ma amɛ tsuo maa pee Mawu ma Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa, ejakaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma ba he nyɛ yi wami.
Nihi nɛ baa a je mi saminya, nɛ a pee we yayami, se mohu a yeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a ble we lɛ ɔ, ma gbaa mɛ.” Nubwɔ nɛ kɛ e he ba mɛtɛ Yawɛ ma a he ɔ, e ko de ke, “Yawɛ be suɔe kaa ma piɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ ja lɛ.” Nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ, nɛ e be bi ɔ, e ko susu kaa Mawu be lɛ ngɔe kɛ piɛ e ma a he.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ dee ji, “Ke o yeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ o peeɔ ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ o yeɔ ye somi ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, ye ma a ma kai o biɛ ngɛ ye we ɔ pe binyumuhi, loo biyihi nɛ o ngɛ po.
Ma ha mo biɛ kpakpa nɛ a ma kai kɛ maa ya neneene.” Jehanɛ, nibwɔhi nɛ kɛ a he ba mɛtɛ ma a he, nɛ a suɔ Mawu sane, nɛ a jaa lɛ, nɛ a yeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kɛ e somi ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ dee ji, “Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba Zion, ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ; ma ha nyɛ bua maa jɔ ngɛ ye sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa sã ngɛ ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ma he.
Ejakaa a ma tsɛ ye we ɔ je mahi tsuo a sɔlemi we.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ e ma Israel nya buae kɛ je ma se kɛ ma we ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ji, “Ma bua ni kpahi a nya kɛ piɛ nihi nɛ a bua a nya momo ɔ a he.” A bu Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ fɔ Yawɛ de je ma amɛ nɛ je ma se ɔ ke á ba kaa lohwe dikali, nɛ a ba tsɔtslɔɔ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a mi.
E ke, “Ma hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ sa kaa a kaa ye ma a hɛ mi ɔ, hɛ yuyuili ji mɛ tsuo; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko!
A ngɛ kaa we he bumi gbehi nɛ kpa we ngmlaa; daa nɛ ɔ, mahe mi kɛkɛ a hii nɛ a hii nlae.
Lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ!
A ngɛ kaa gbehi nɛ li tɔ biɛ!
Ma nɔ yeli nɛ ɔmɛ be juɛmi kokooko!
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ; mɛ nitsɛmɛ a se nami pɛ a hlaa.
Dã tɔli nɛ ɔmɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ ba nɛ wa ya hla wai nɛ waa nu.
Wa maa nu dã bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ!
Hwɔɔ lɛɛ e maa pee gbeye!’ ”
A bu Israel fɔ kaa e ja amaga Ke nɔmlɔ kpakpa gbo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko susuu we he, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi hulɔ kaa yayami nɛ maa ba a nya Mawu ngɛ dalɔ ɔ jee kɛ je, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ayimayi ko kó ba ye lɛ hwɔɔ se.
Nihi nɛ baa a je mi saminya, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, ke a gbo ɔ, a naa tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi.
Se, nyɛ yayami peeli nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ní peeli, kɛ gba puɛli, kɛ yi yaholi tsuo sɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ!
Mɛnɔ he fɛu nyɛ ngɛ yee ɔ?
Nyɛ lakpatsɛmɛ, yayami peeli a bimɛ, mɛnɔ he nyɛ pa nyɛ nya mi hatoo, nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ lilɛ kpo bilaa kɛ wo ɔ?
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ he mi akɔnɔ teɔ si, nɛ́ nyɛɛ kɛ bɔɔ ajuama ngɛ tso nguanguahi nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi.
Nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ kɛ sãã bɔ ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
Nyɛ ya ngɔɔ dongo tɛhi kɛ jeɔ kɔ̃ mi, nɛ nyɛ jaa mɛ.
Nyɛ ngɔɔ wai kɛ sãã bɔ kɛ haa tɛhi; nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ ngma hu kɛ sãã bɔ ha mɛ ja nɔuu.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susuu kaa ye bua maa jɔ he?
Nyɛ ya kuɔɔ yo gaga amɛ, ya sãã bɔ; nɛ nyɛ ya bɔɔ ajuama ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ amaga amɛ ngɔ maa nyɛ tsu ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ sinya se, nɛ nyɛ jaa mɛ.
Nyɛ jeɔ ye se nɛ nyɛ ya ngmɛɛ nyɛ sa amɛ, nɛ nyɛ dlaa a nɔ saminyayoo.
Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ plã amɛ ya hwɔɔ si bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ woɔ mɛ hiɔ sisiisi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ yeɔ nya a. Nyɛ ngɔɔ nu, kɛ nu kɛ e he via fuu kɛ hiaa blɔ kɛ ya jaa mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Molek ɔ. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ na mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja a, nyɛ tsɔɔ nihi kɛ yaa ma se tsitsaa lokoo, kɛ yaa gbeje tete po.
Nyɛ gbaa nyɛ he nya babauu kɛ kpaa si; pɔ hu tɔɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa.
Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ amaga amɛ haa nyɛ he wami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngmɛɛ we a he.
Yawɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ gbeye nyɛ ya ye, loko nyɛ ye lakpa, nɛ nyɛ hɛ je ye nɔ pɛsɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Akɛnɛ i pee dii kɛ je blema lokoo he je ɔ, nyɛ bui mi, nɛ nyɛ yi mi gbeye hulɔ, pi jã?
Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ da, se ma ha nyɛ maa na paa kaa amaga amɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ a se nyɛɛe ɔ be nyɛe maa pee nɔ́ kpakpa ko ha nyɛ.
Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ balɔ tsɛe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ amaga babauu ɔmɛ nɛ a je ngmlaa ha nyɛ koo!
Kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ po maa bɛɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho; mumi nɛ a woɔ si kake pɛ ma fli mɛ kɛ ho.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ye nɔ ɔ, a maa hi zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ma ja mi ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.” Mawu wo si ke e maa piɛ e ma a he nɛ e ma tsa mɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha ye ma a nɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ.
Nyɛ je blɔ tsimi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ je a blɔ mi!
Nyɛɛ je gbɛjegbɛ saminyayoo ha mɛ!
“Imi ji Mawu klɔuklɔu nɛ hii hiɔwe kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɛ.
I hii he klɔuklɔu ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ngɛ e mumi mi, nɛ e tsui mi tsɔ ɔ, i kɛ lɛ hiɔ si; i woɔ e mumi kã, konɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ, nɛ e na wami he.
Imi nitsɛ nɛ i ha ye ma a wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be pɛe, nɛ ye mi mi hu be mɛ fue kɛ ya neneene.
Ye mi mi fu mɛ, nɛ i gbla a tue, nɛ i kua mɛ; ejakaa a peeɔ yayami, nɛ a hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃; se kɛ̃ ɔ, a wa tue, nɛ a ya nɔ pee níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ.
“I na níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, se ma tsa mɛ.
Ma tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ ma piɛ a he; nɛ ma wo kɔmɔ yeli ɔmɛ bua!
Nihi nɛ a ngɛ kpo nya, kɛ tsitsaa tsuo ma na tue mi jɔmi.
Ma tsa ye ma a.
Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ kaa wo nɛ gli nɛ e we oslɔke ɔmɛ ngɛ kue; a ngɛ kaa wo nɛ ngɛ mu níhi, kɛ mɔsɔ jee kɛ ngɛ he puee daa nɛ.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be he jɔmi nae gblegbleegble.” Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Hwɔ hami kpakpa Yawɛ ke, “Kpa ngmlaa boboobo bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ; ha nɛ o nya nɛ wa wawɛɛ kaa titimati!
Jaje ye ma Israel tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ!
A deɔ ke a jaa mi daa kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a le ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
A deɔ hu ke a ngɛ hlae nɛ ma wo mɛ mlaa kpakpahi, nɛ a suɔ kaa a ma ja mi.” Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ bie ke, “Mɛni he je ke wa ha hwɔ nɛ Yawɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je ke wa wa wa he yi mi nɛ e li ɔ?” Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ dee ke, “Anɔkuale ɔ ji kaa be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nyɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hlaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ se nami, nɛ nyɛ waa nyɛ ní tsuli tsuo yi mi.
Nyɛ haa hwɔ, se nyɛ peeɔ basabasa; nyɛ pɛɔ, nɛ nyɛ nɔɔ kunɔ.
Nyɛ susuɔ kaa kikɛmɛ a hwɔ hami ɔ ma ha ma bu nyɛ kue fami tue lo?
Anɛ hwɔ hami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ i ngɛ hlae lo?
Anɛ nɔ nitsɛ e he pimi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ i suɔ lo?
Ke nɔ ko ma e yi si kudɔɔ kaa ngɔwu, nɛ e ngmɛ kpekpe ngɛ la zu mi nɛ e hwɔ nɔ ɔ, enɛ ɔ nyɛ tsɛɔ hwɔ hami ɔ?
Enɛ ɔ maa sa ye hɛ mi lo?
“Hwɔ hami nɛ maa sa ye hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ kpa yi wu tso ní peemi, nɛ nyɛɛ ye dami sane.
Nyɛ kplɔ kuɛpã tso ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ a kuɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ku mɛ dukuduku, konɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye a he.
Nɔ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye, nɛ nihi nɛ be he ko nɛ a maa hi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba nyɛ we mi.
Ke nyɛ na nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ e he gu ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ bo; nyɛ ko pee kpɛle ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ weku li a he.
“Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye dloomi ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ kaa mɔtu pu la nɛ haa je mi tsɔɔ, nɛ nyɛ pa amɛ ma gbo mla.
I kɛ nyɛ maa hi si be tsuaa be, konɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami.
Ke nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɔ ɔ maa je blɔ kpakpa ha nyɛ, nɛ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se, nɛ nyɛ maa ye manye.
Ke nyɛ fa kue ha mi ɔ, ma he nɔ.
Ke nyɛ tsɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa nu ye he.
“Ke nyɛ kpa yi wu tso ní peemi, ke nyɛ kpa nɔ nya pomi yaka gu, kɛ munyu yaya tumi; jehanɛ, ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee, nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ ní, loo nɔ́ ko hia nɔ ko, nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ diblii kpii nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa piani.
Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ daa, nɛ ma ha nyɛ maa ye ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ daa.
Ma ha nyɛ ma na nɔmlɔ tso he wami saminya.
Nyɛ maa pee kaa abɔɔ kɛ e mi nyu babauu, loo kaa pa ko nɛ nyu tɛ mi gblegbleegble.
Nyɛ maa fia gbogbo he ngɛ blema tsu kokoe ɔmɛ a nane mi.
A maa fia kɛ ma sisi tomi momo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Sisi tomi ɔmɛ nɛ a to blema a, nyɛ ma tle mɛ si kɛ ma si ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma tsɛ nyɛ ke nihi nɛ ba fia gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu, nihi nɛ ba dla ma doku ɔmɛ.” Se nami nɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ yemi mi Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke nyɛ maa ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa ligbi klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ suɔmi nya ní pee jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ke nyɛ maa bu ye ligbi klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ be blɔ hiae, nyɛ be ní tsue, nɛ nyɛ be yakayaka munyu tue ligbi nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ bua jɔmi nɛ a naa ngɛ imi Yawɛ ye sɔmɔmi mi ɔ, nyɛ ma na.
Ma ha je ɔ tsuo maa wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛ̃, Yakob ɔ, ma ha nyɛ maa ye e mi ní kpakpa amɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Gbalɔ ɔ pia ma a kaa a pee yayami Nyɛ ko susu kaa Yawɛ nine ngɛ kpoku nɛ e be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ he nyɛ yi wami, aloo e tue ywia nɛ e nui nyɛ kue fami ɔ!
Mohu nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ gba nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ tsi e hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ he nɛ ke nyɛ fa kue nɛ e nui ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ yeɔ fɔ, ejakaa nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si, nɛ nyɛ peeɔ yayamihi babauu.
Yi wu tso níhi a he sɔuu nyɛ susuɔ, nɛ munyuhi nɛ jeɔ nyɛ nya a, lakpa sɔuu.
Ke a kɛ nɔ ko ya kojomi he ɔ, nyɛ yi sane ɔ ha lɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
Nyɛɛ kɛ mlaa tsu we ní, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ lakpa kɛ faa nyɛ he ngɛ sane yemi he.
Ga yayahi nɛ kpataa nihi a hɛ mi sɔuu nyɛ toɔ.
-Nyɛ ga yaya amɛ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔtsɛ hlui.
Ke hlui ɔ ywia a, sinɔ duɔtsɛ jeɔ kpo kɛ jeɔ mi!
Se nyɛ ga yaya amɛ a he be se nami ko kulaa; a ngɛ kaa bo nɛ a ngɔ anani ya kɛ lo!
Be tsuaa be ɔ, yayami he ga sɔuu nyɛ toɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ko ye bemi ɔ, nyɛ he sɔɔ kɛ pueɔ e muɔ si yaka.
He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ gu ɔ, nɔ́ puɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatami sɔuu nyɛ siɔ ngɛ nyɛ se; nɔ ko nɔ ko yi e he ngɛ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ dɛ pɛ nyɛ peeɔ.
Nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ gɔdɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ nyɛ se ɔ, e he mi jɔɛ lɛ gblegbleegble.
Ma a jaje a he yayami Bɔ nɛ ma a ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa na le nɔ́ he je nɛ Mawu je we wɔ kɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi.
Wa hyɛɛ blɔ kaa wa ma na la kɛ nyɛɛ, se wa ná we; diblii kpii mi mohu wa nyɛɛɔ; nɛ wa tataa si kɛ yaa gbogbo he kaa hɛ yuyuili.
Wa tɛɔ si piani katakata kaa nɔ nɛ nyɔ mi.
Wa peeɔ kaa ni gbogboehi ngɛ hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ a kpɛti.
Wɔ tsuo wa yeɔ gbeye, nɛ wa ní peeɔ mɔbɔ.
Wa hyɛɛ Mawu blɔ kaa e ma ba he wa yi wami kɛ je pimi kɛ amimi mi, se lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka.
“Yawɛ, wa tɔmi ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Wa he yayami ɔmɛ yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ wɔ.
Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa le wa nisɛ ní a ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Wa tɔ o nɔ; wa wa nihi yi mi, nɛ wa kua mo.
Wa ja we mo hu.
Ni yayahi a he wa susuɔ, nɛ lakpa pɛ wa yeɔ.
Wa yi dami sane, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ da hu wa pee we.
Wa yi anɔkuale ngɛ sane yemi he; nɛ wa susuu we nɔ́ nɛ da he kulaa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko yi anɔkuale hu; nɔ nɛ yuɔ e he kɛ jeɔ yayami he ɔ, a haoɔ lɛ kaa lɛ mohu ji yayami peelɔ.” Yawɛ pee klaalo nɛ e ma kpɔ e ma a Yawɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔɛ e nya kaa a yi dami sane.
E pee lɛ nyakpɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa da mi ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he wami e kɛ ma he e ma a yi wami; nɛ e ma a maa ye kunimi.
E maa ye dami sane be tsuaa be; dami sane yemi maa pee kaa tsɛ̃i nɛ ha e he.
Yi wami hemi hu maa pee e hiami nɔ́; e maa pee kaa dade pɛɛ nɛ e bu.
E kɛ abofu, kɛ hɛdɔ maa gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue kɛ fa ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ amimi yee ɔ a he.
E maa gbla a tue kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ to nane mi; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma se tsitsaa po be a he yee.
Kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa su bonyoku je ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye Yawɛ gbeye.
E maa ba kaa pa nɛ hia; e maa ba kaa ahumi nɛ hia kɛ ma.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, “Ma ba Yerusalem, nɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ kpa yayami peemi ɔ, ma ba he nyɛ yi wami.
I kɛ nyɛ maa so somi.
I ngɔ ye he wami ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ hu maa pee nyɛ nɔ́ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nyɛ maa bu mi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ nina tsuo, konɛ a bu mi tue kɛ ya neneene.”
Yerusalem he ɔ Yerusalem, tee si nɛ o tso kaa pu; Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ o nɔ.
Diblii maa ha zugba a tsuo nɔ, je ma amɛ maa hi diblii kpii mi, se moo lɛɛ Yawɛ ma je e he kpo ha mo; e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma pue o nɔ.
Je mahi maa nyɛɛ kɛ ba o la a he, nɛ matsɛmɛ maa ba la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ o nɔ ɔ he.
Wo o yi nɔ nɛ o hyɛ o he kɛ kpe.
O nɛ, mɛ tsuo a ngɛ a he nya buae; a ngɛ a he nya buae kɛ ma o ngɔ!
O binyumu ɔmɛ maa je ma se tsitsaa kɛ ba, nɛ o biyi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a maa hɛɛ mɛ kaa bimwɔwi kɛ ba.
Ke e ba mi ja a, o bua maa jɔ; o maa muɔ jɛɛ, nɛ o ma nya saminya; ejakaa je ma amɛ maa ngɔ a juetli, kɛ sika nɛ a na ngɛ wo se ɔ tsuo kɛ ba o ngɔ.
Afukpɔngɔhi babauu ma ba bua a he nya ngɛ o ngɔ; a maa je Midian kɛ Efa.
Sheba bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ sika tsu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ba, nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma ba je Yawɛ yi ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ e pee ha mɛ ɔ he!
A ma bua Kedar tohi tsuo a nya kɛ ba ha mo, konɛ o kɛ sã bɔ.
A kɛ Nebayot agbosuhi ma ba sã bɔ nɛ maa sa Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa wo e we klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi nyami babauu pe daa a. Mɛnihi nɛ a ngɛ fo nɔ kɛ ma kaa bɔku, loo kaa lahuɛhi nɛ kpale kɛ ma a saflɛhi a mi nɛ ɔ?
Spania lɛhi nɛ a nyɛɛ hɛ mi kɛ je tsitsaa wo se zugbahi a nɔ kɛ ma a nɛ.
A ngɔ bimɛ kɛ ma we.
A hɛɛ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ ma, konɛ a kɛ ba ha Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ a kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Ejakaa e wó e ma a nɔ gojoo ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem dee ke, “Nibwɔhi ma ba fia o ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ ma si ekohu, nɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ mo.
O wo ye mi mi la, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i gbla o tue; se jehanɛ lɛɛ, ma je ye suɔmi kpo ha mo, nɛ ma na mo mɔbɔ.
O ma a agbo ɔmɛ maa hi blibli daa nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a ngɔ a ní tsuo kɛ ba be tsuaa be; a maa nyɛɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ba.
Je ma, loo nɔ yemi nɛ be mo sɔmɔe ɔ, a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
“A maa poo Lebanon tso kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ma Yerusalem ekohu: sɛsɛo, odum kɛ tsohi nɛ da tlɔmɔɔ ɔ tsuo.
Enɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ maa pee fɛu, nɛ ye ma a hɛ mi maa ba nyami.
Nihi nɛ wa mo yi mi ɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ maa ba, nɛ a ma ba kpla si ha mo.
Nihi nɛ gbe o he guɛ be ko ɔ, mɛ hu a ma ba kpla si ngɛ o nane nya.
Nɛ a ma tsɛ mo ke, ‘Yawɛ ma,’ ‘Zion, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ma.’ “A be mo kuae, nɛ a be mo nyɛe hu kaa sa be ko nɛ o pee ma doku nɛ nɔ ko gui lejɛ ɔ. Ma wo o nɔ gojoo, nɛ o he maa pee fɛu.
O maa pee he nɛ bua jɔmi maa hi daa.
Je mahi, kɛ matsɛmɛ maa lɛ mo kaa bɔ nɛ binyɛ haa e bi nyɔ ɔ. O maa le jehanɛ kaa imi Yawɛ nɛ i ha o yi na wami.
O maa le kaa imi, Israel Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ i ha o ye o he.
“Akɔblee nane mi ɔ, ma ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ba, dade nane mi ɔ, sika hiɔ, tso nane mi ɔ, akɔblee, nɛ tɛ nane mi ɔ, dade.
O nɔ yeli ɔmɛ be mo yi mi wae hu.
Ma ha a maa ngɔ dami sane yemi, kɛ he jɔmi kɛ hyɛ o nɔ.
A be yi mi wami he nue ngɛ zugba a nɔ hu; a be ní puɛmi, kɛ hɛ mi kpatami he nue ngɛ o huza amɛ a nɔ hu.
Ma bu o he, nɛ ma fa o he.
Ma pee kaa gbogbo ngɛ o se.
Nɛ o ma je ye yi, ejakaa i he o yi wami.
“Tsa pi pu nɛ maa pee la ha mo piani hu, jehanɛ hu tsa pi nyɔhiɔ nɛ ma ha mo la nyɔ mi.
Se mohu imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma pee o la kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ye hɛ mi nyami maa pee kaa la nɛ ma kpɛ ha mo.
O kɔmɔ yemi ligbi ɔmɛ a se maa po.
Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma pee la ha mo kɛ maa ya neneene; pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ lɛɛ a se maa po.
O ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
A maa hi zugba a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Imi lɛ i to mɛ si.
Imi lɛ i pee mɛ jã, konɛ a kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
Wɛtso nyafii pe kulaa ma ba pee ma kpetekpleenyɛ.
Ke be ɔ su ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma ha nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi oya.
Imi ji Yawɛ!”
Sɛ gbi kɛ ha nɔ́ nali Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ ye nɔ; Yawɛ pɔ mi nu, nɛ e tsɔ mi, konɛ ma ngɔ manye munyu ya ha nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ; nɛ ma wo kɔmɔ yeli a bua; nɛ ma ya de nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ ke a he yemi be su ta, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ ke a jémi be su ta.
Yawɛ ke ma ya fiɛ ke be ko nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi ma.
Be nɛ Mawu maa gbla nihi a tue, kɛ kɔmɔ yeli a bua womi be ɔ su ta.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ngɛ Zion ɔ, e ma bu mɛ jlasi nɛ a kɛ mɔmɔ pee, se pi la zu; a bua maa jɔ; a ma kpa kɔmɔ yemi, nɛ a ma la yi jemi la.
A maa bɔ kaa tso nguaa nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma.
Mɛ tsuo a maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a maa wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Ma dokuhi tsuo nɛ pueɔ si kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, a maa fia mɛ kɛ ma si ekohu.
Nibwɔhi ma ba sɔmɔ nyɛ; a ma tsɔ̃ nyɛ to ɔmɛ; a ma hu nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa hyɛ nyɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Se nyɛ ye ma a, a ma tsɛ nyɛ ke Yawɛ osɔfohi, a ma tsɛ nyɛ Mawu sɔmɔli hulɔ.
Je ma amɛ a ní ɔ, nyɛ nyɛ maa ye, nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ kaa lɛ tsuo ba pee nyɛ nɔ́.
Zo nɛ gbe nyɛ, kɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ pue si ɔ, lɛ tsuo nya maa be.
Nyɛ maa hi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ jehanɛ; nyɛ ma na ní babauu nitsɛ pe sa a, nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yawɛ de Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke, “I suɔ kaa a ye dami sane; i sume ojo fiami, kɛ yi mi wami; ma pee ye ma a kpakpa bɔ nɛ sa mɛ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa so somi ko nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
A nina ma na biɛ saminya ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti.
Nihi tsuo nɛ maa na mɛ ɔ ma de ke ma nɛ imi Yawɛ nitsɛ i gbaa ji mɛ.” Yerusalem ngɛ nyae ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu pee ha lɛ ɔ he.
Yerusalem pee kaa ayɛflo nɛ wo june, loo ayɛflo huno nɛ ngɔ mɔmɔ kɛ dla e he kɛ yaa yo kpeemi.
Niinɛ, Mawu he Yerusalem yi wami, nɛ e ye kunimi ha lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ tso tsɛ̃ɔ kɛ jee zu mi, ee, bɔ nɛ wu puɛɔ ngɛ ngmɔ mi ɔ, ja Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ma he e ma a yi wami, nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa na, nɛ a ma je e yi.
I be ye nya mae oo!
I be ye nya mae!
Yerusalem he je ɔ, i be ye nya mae kɛ yaa si a ma he ye ma a yi wami.
Nɛ e kunimi yemi ɔ maa je kpo paa nɛ a maa na kaa jatɛ ngɛ diblii mi.
Yerusalem, je ma amɛ maa na kaa o ye kunimi, nɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ.
A maa wo mo biɛ he.
Biɛ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa wo mo ɔ, lɔ ɔ a kɛ ma tsɛ mo.
O maa pee kaa jlasi saminyayoo ngɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ dɛ mi.
A be mo tsɛe hu ke, “Nɔ nɛ a kua lɛ,” nɛ a be o zugba hu tsɛe ke, “Yo nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ je gba we.” Se a ma tsɛ mo ke, “Mawu ná e he bua jɔmi,” nɛ o zugba a, a ma tsɛ lɛ “Ayɛflo,” ejakaa Yawɛ bua jɔ o he, nɛ e maa ngɔ o zugba a kɛ pee kaa e we ayɛflo.
Kaa bɔ nɛ niheyo kpeɔ yomiyo ayɛflo ɔ, ja nɔ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ maa ngɔ mo hulɔ.
Bɔ nɛ ayɛflo huno nyaa ayɛflo he ɔ, ja o Mawu ɔ bua maa jɔ o he.
Yerusalem, i ngɔ buli ngɔ to o gbogbo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo, a ko pee dii; se mohu a hi Yawɛ kaie ngɛ si ko nɛ e wo e ma a he, konɛ e hɛ ko je nɔ.
A hi lɛ kaie kɛ yaa si e maa to Yerusalem si saminya ekohu.
Nɛ ma a maa pee ma nɛ je ɔ tsuo ma je e yi.
Yawɛ ka e he kita, nɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nɔ mi mae ngɛ dee ji, “Ye ma, i be o blɛfo ngɔe kɛ ha o he nyɛli nɛ a ye hu, nɛ o wai nɛ o gbo he dengme ɔ, nibwɔhi ba be nue hu.
Se mohu, o nihi nɛ du blɛfo nɛ a kpɔ ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa ye, nɛ a ma je imi Yawɛ ye yi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ bua wai yiblii nya a, mɛ lɛ a maa nu dã a ngɛ kue ɔmɛ a mi, ngɛ ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ.” Yerusalem bi, nyɛɛ je kpo; nyɛɛ gu agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ je kpo!
Nyɛɛ je gbɛjegbɛ kɛ ha ma a; nyɛ kukuɔ a nɔ tɛhi tsuo.
Nyɛɛ si aflangaa nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a na.
Yawɛ ngɛ fiɛe kɛ yaa su je mi nyagbe he ɔ tɔɔ; e ke a de Zion biyo ɔ ke, “Be ɔ su jehanɛ, Yawɛ ma nɛ e ba he o yi wami.
E ngɔ nihi nɛ e kpɔ ɔ kɛ ma.” A ma tsɛ nyɛ ke, “Ma klɔuklɔu”, “Ma nɛ Yawɛ kpɔ mɛ.” A ma tsɛ Yerusalem ke, “Ma nɛ a ya hla nɛ a na”, “Ma nɛ Mawu kua we lɛ.”
Yawɛ ye je ma amɛ a nɔ kunimi “Mɛnɔ lɛ je Bozra ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ dla e he saminyayoo kɛ tade tsu, nɛ e ngɛ kɔsɔe wawɛɛ kɛ he wami kɛ ma nɛ ɔ?” “Imi Yawɛ, kpɔlɔ nɛ nine si wa a, i ngɛ dee kɛ ngmlaa ke i ye kunimi oo, i ye kunimi.” “Mɛni he je nɛ e tade tsu kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ wai yiblii ngae kɛ pee dã e tade ɔ?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Imi nɔ kake lɛ i naa je ma amɛ a nɔ kaa a naa wai yiblii nɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko piɛ we ye he.
A wo ye mi mi la, nɛ abofu nya a, i naa a nɔ, nɛ a muɔ ɔ fĩa wo ye tade ɔ mi tsuo.
I pee ye yi mi momo kaa ma gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma he ye ma a yi wami; ejakaa be ɔ su jehanɛ.
Benɛ i hyɛ ɔ, e pee mi nyakpɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha mi.
Se ye mi mi nɛ fu ɔ wo mi he wami, nɛ imi nɔ kake too i ye kunimi.
I kɛ mi mi la naa je ma amɛ a nɔ basabasa, nɛ i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.
I tsɛ̃ a muɔ ngɔ pue zugba.” Yawɛ pee Israel kpakpa Ma gba Yawɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he sane.
Ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma je e yi.
E gbaa Israel ma a babauu; ejakaa Yawɛ mɔbɔ nami, kɛ e suɔmi be nyagbe.
Yawɛ ke, “Imi nitsɛ ye ma ji mɛ; a be mi sisie.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha a yi na wami kɛ je a haomi tsuo kulaa mi.
Pi bɔfo ko nɛ e tsɔ, se lɛ nitsɛ lɛ e he a yi wami.
E suɔmi, kɛ e mɔbɔ nami he je ɔ, e kpɔ mɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ mɛ saminya ngɛ blema be ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a tsɔ atuã; a ha nɛ aywilɛho nu mɛ.
Yawɛ ba plɛ pee a he nyɛlɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ hwu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a kai blema, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose be ɔ, nɛ a bi ke, “Yawɛ nɛ́ je ma a, kɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ kɛ je wo ɔ mi ɔ, jije e ngɛ?
Jije nɔ nɛ ngɔ e mumi klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ wo a mi ɔ ngɛ?
- Nɔ nɛ ngɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ kɛ wo Mose mi kɛ tsu ní nguanguahi, nɔ nɛ gba wo ɔ mi ha mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ po wo ɔ nɛ e kɛ na biɛ nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, jije e ngɛ?” Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ kpaka mɛ kɛ gu muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ a mi slɔkee kaa bɔ nɛ ke okpɔngɔ ngɛ fo tue ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ nɛ́ e tɛ we si ɔ. Yawɛ ha e ma a he jɔmi.
Bɔ nɛ ke a kpaka na kɛ ya kɔ̃ mi nɛ e naa niye ní kpakpa nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, jã Yawɛ kpaka e ma a saminya, nɛ e kɛ na biɛ kpakpa kɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Ma a fa kue ha Mawu Yawɛ, moo hyɛ wɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ o hi he klɔuklɔu he nɛ hɛ mi nyami bɔle mo ngɛ ɔ. O hɛdɔ, kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ?
O tsui mi sami, kɛ suɔmi babauu ɔ hu a se po.
Mo ji wa tsɛ.
Wa nɛmɛ Abraham, kɛ Yakob li wɔ, se mo Yawɛ, wa tsɛ, mo ji wa kpɔlɔ kɛ je blema lokoo.
Yawɛ, mɛni he je o haa nɛ wa tlaa blɔ kɛ jeɔ o blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ wa kpliiɔ wa tsui, konɛ wa ko ye mo gbeye ɔ?
Israel ma a, o nɔ, nɛ o tsɔli ji wɔ tsuo.
Mo nitsɛ o nihi ji wɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kpale kɛ ba!
Wɔ o ma klɔuklɔu ɔ, wa hi o he klɔuklɔu ɔ be bɔɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ wa he nyɛli ba ywia o ma a!
Wa pee kaa nihi nɛ o hyɛ we a nɔ hyɛ, loo ni komɛ nɛ a kɛ o biɛ tsɛ we mɛ hyɛ!
I ná nɛ hiɔwe mi gba enyɔ nɛ o kple si kɛ ba!
I ná nɛ yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ́ tsɔwi la tsoo nɛ e haa nyu fiaa gudaguda ngɛ la nɔ ɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa nu o he, nɛ je ma amɛ a he maa do blibliibli ngɛ o hɛ mi!
Blema, benɛ o pee nyakpɛ níhi nɛ wa hyɛ we blɔ ɔ, o kple si kɛ ba; yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi!
Kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, nɔ ko nui hyɛ, nɛ nɔ ko hu nɛ kaa o se ɔ, mawu kpa ko ngɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ haa nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ!
Nihi nɛ kɛ bua jɔmi peeɔ o suɔmi nya ní, nɛ blɔ nɛ o to ha mɛ ɔ, a ji nɔ ɔ, mo hu o naa a he bua jɔmi.
Wa pee yayami, nɛ o mi mi fu wɔ.
Kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, yayami sɔuu wa ngɛ pee.
Anɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko pa ngɛ ha wɔ kaa a ma he wa yi wami lo?
Wɔ tsuo wa pee yayami, nɛ wa plɛ pee nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we.
Kpakpa nɛ wa peeɔ ɔ po ngɛ kaa tade sɛmusɛmu ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Wa yayami ɔmɛ ha wɔ tsuo wa pee kaa ba gbigbli nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ yaa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ faa kue ha mo; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ba bi we yemi kɛ buami kɛ ji o ngɔ.
O ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa wɔ.
Wa yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ o kua wɔ.
Se kɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, mo ji wa tsɛ.
Wa ngɛ kaa zu, nɛ moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kaa buɛ puɛlɔ; mo lɛ o bɔ wɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o mi mi ko fu wɔ tsɔ; ko kai wa yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ya neneene!
O ma ji wɔ; naa wɔ mɔbɔ.
O ma klɔuklɔu ɔ plɛ pee nga kplanaa.
Zion plɛ pee nga nɔ, nɛ Yerusalem pee ma doku.
Wa sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu saminyayoo, he nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je o yi ngɛ ɔ, a kɛ la sã, nɛ a kpata hehi nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Yawɛ, níhi nɛ ngɛ wa nɔ bae nɛ ɔ, o be he nɔ́ ko pee ha wɔ lo?
Anɛ o maa pee dii nɛ o ha waa na nɔ́ pe bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ nya maa da lo?
Yawɛ maa gbla atuã tsɔli a tue Yawɛ ke, “I pee klaalo konɛ nihi nɛ li mi ɔ nɛ a hla ye se blɔ; i pee klaalo konɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ li mi ɔ nɛ a le mi jehanɛ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, i pee klaalo nɛ i ngɛ ma a dee ke, ‘I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ oo; nyɛ tsɛ mi nɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he.’ Se ma a tsɛ we mi.
Daa nɛ ɔ, i pee klaalo nɛ ma he ye ma a atuu; ma nɛ kplii a tsui, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní ji mɛ.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, ma nɛ ɔ jeɔ blɔ paa nɛ a woɔ ye mi mi la; a sãã bɔhi ngɛ abɔɔhi a mi; a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ; nyɔ mi tsuo a hii yɔkɔhi a mi, kɛ hehi nɛ e sɛ́ nɛ a na mɛ ngɛ; kpotoo lo pohu a yeɔ, kɛ flɔɔ nɛ a ngɔ níhi nɛ a hiee kɛ pee ngɛ a tsesihi a mi.
Se bɔ nɛ mɛ mohu a deɔ ni kpahi ji, ‘Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ya se; nyɛ ko ba wa kasa nya; wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he tsɔ!’ Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa la su ku nɛ ngɛ ye gugwɔ mi sɛe, kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe daa ligbi!
“I pee ye yi mi momo, nɛ i ngma ngɔ fɔ si ke i be ye nya mae hu; ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ kɛ to nane mi sisiisi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
Ejakaa a ya sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A tuɔ munyu hu kɛ siɔ mi ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ, ma gbla a tue sisiisi bɔ nɛ sa.” Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ ko kpataa we e wai yiblii kpakpa hɛ mi; dã mohu e kɛ peeɔ.
Jã kɛ̃ i be ye ma a hɛ mi kpatae pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mi ɔ, ma he a yi wami.
Ma ha Yakob nina babauu.
Ma ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma ba hi yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; lejɛ ɔ tsuo maa pee ye sɔmɔli nɛ i hla nɛ ɔ a nɔ́.
Ye ma a mi bi nɛ hlaa ye se blɔ ɔ, Sharon nga a nɔ maa pee a to lɛmi he, nɛ Haomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi ji he nɛ a nahi maa jɔɔ a he ngɛ.
“Se nyɛ nihi nɛ kuaa imi Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ jeɔ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nɔ́ maa slo.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɔ okplɔɔ kɛ haa mawu nɛ haa nɔ siade, kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ wai nɛ a futu kɛ sãã bɔ ha mawu nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ngɛ je mi, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛ ji klaate.
Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa nɔ basabasa ngɛ klaate nya; ejakaa benɛ i tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he we nɔ, nɛ benɛ i tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bui tue.
Yayami mohu nyɛ pee ngɛ ye hɛ mi; níhi nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a se nyɛ ya nyɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ke, ni nɛmɛ nɛ buɔ mi tue, nɛ a jaa mi ɔ, a ma ná ní babauu maa ye, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ hwɔ maa gbe nyɛ; ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ma na nyu maa nu, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ kuma maa gbe nyɛ; ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ma nya, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ zo maa gbe nyɛ.
Ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ma la, nɛ a bua maa jɔ a he, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma kpa huhui, nɛ nyɛ maa ye nyɛ tsui wawɛɛ; nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma fo ya mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Nyɛ biɛ maa pee nɔ nɛ a kɛ gbiɛɔ ha ye ma nɛ i hla a; ejakaa imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa mi ɔ lɛɛ ma wo mɛ biɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma hla kaa a gbaa lɛ ɔ ma bi Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ma ka kita ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ hu maa ngɔ Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ biɛ kɛ ka; ejakaa blema haomi ɔmɛ maa be kɛ ho, nɛ a be kaie hu.” Je he ɔ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he bɔe; nɛ a be blema ní ɔmɛ kaie hu; hɛ maa je a nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nyɛ nya, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ kɛ ya neneene ngɛ níhi nɛ i ngɛ bɔe ɔ a he.
Ejakaa i ngɛ Yerusalem he bɔe kaa he ko nɛ bua jɔmi sɔuu lɛ a naa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ́ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ hu a bua jɔɔ saminya.
Imi nitsɛ ye bua maa jɔ Yerusalem, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
A be ya fomi, loo kɔmɔ yemi he nue ngɛ ma a mi hu.
Ma he nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, bimwɔyo be gboe hu; nɔmoyo hu be gboe loko e be maa su.
Ke a fɔ nɔ ko ɔ, ja e ye jeha lafa loko e ma gbo.
Yayami peelɔ pɛ nɛ lɛɛ e be nae ja.
A maa po wehi, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa hi mi; a maa pee wai ngmɔhi, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa ye a mi yiblii.
A be wehi poe nɛ ni kpahi ba hi mi, nɛ a be ngmɔ pee nɛ ni kpahi ba ye e mi ní.
Bɔ nɛ tso nguahi a se kɛɔ ɔ, ja ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a se maa kɛ ngɛ je mi.
A ma ná mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nine nya ní tsumi mi ní maa ye, nɛ a bua maa jɔ a he saminya.
A be yaka dengme gboe; a bimɛ be kpatu gbenɔ gboe; ejakaa nihi nɛ imi Yawɛ i gbaa mɛ a nina ji mɛ; a ngmɛdu maa hi si daa.
Loko a ma tsɛ mi ɔ, i he nɔ momo; benɛ a ngɛ kue fae ha mi nɛ a gbi nya lolo ɔ, i nu momo.
Ogbetee kɛ jijɔ ma bla kɛ ye ní; jata ma kpe nga kaa na; nɛ sinɔ lɛɛ zu e maa ye.
Nɔ ko be e nyɛmi awi yee, nɛ nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yawɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ kojoe Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Hiɔwe ji ye matsɛ sɛ, nɛ zugba ji nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ye nane maa nɔ.
Mɛni tsu nyɛ maa ma ha mi mɔ, nɛ jije ye he jɔɔmi he ngɛ?
Ye nine nya níhi ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo.
Nihi nɛ baa a he si, nɛ a naa a he yayami nɛ a tsakeɔ a tsui, nihi nɛ yeɔ mi gbeye, nɛ a buɔ mi tue ɔ, mɛ ji nihi nɛ i suɔ.
“Ma mi bi ɔmɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ.
E si we mɛ kpu kaa a maa ngɔ na, loo nɔmlɔ adesa kɛ sã bɔ.
Slɔɔto ko be mi ke a ngɔ to kɛ sã bɔ, loo a ku gbe kuɛ kɛ pee.
Slɔɔto be mi ke a ngɔ ngma kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ, aloo a ngɔ kpotoo muɔ kɛ ba.
Tsopa kɛ e he via a ngɛ sãe jio, amaga nɛ a ngɛ jae jio, slɔɔto ko kulaa be mi ha mɛ.
Musu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he a nyaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu ma ha amanehlu nɛ a ngɛ gbeye yee ɔ maa ba a nɔ.
Ejakaa i tsɛ mɛ, se nɔ ko nɔ ko he we nɔ; i tu munyu, se a bui tue fɛɛ.
Yayami mohu a pee ngɛ ye hɛ mi; nɛ níhi nɛ sɛ ye hɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a he a nya.” Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ, nyɛ ta tue, “Akɛnɛ nyɛ yeɔ mi anɔkuale ɔ, nyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ nyɛɔ nyɛ, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ pee we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, se nyɛ he fɛu mohu a yeɔ.
A deɔ ke, ‘Yawɛ nɛ je e he wami kpo nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami, konɛ waa na bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nya ha.’ Se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi si mohu a ma pue!
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Bubuubui ngɛ pɛe ngɛ ma a mi!
Bubuubui ngɛ pɛe ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Ngmlaa nɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Yawɛ ngɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue gblae.
“Ye ma klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ kaa yo ko nɛ kpatu fɔ binyumu be mi nɛ e nui kɔɔmi.
Mɛnɔ nu enɛ ɔ eko hyɛ, nɛ mɛnɔ na enɛ ɔ eko hyɛ?
Anɛ ligbi kake too kɛkɛ nɛ zugba nɔ hyiɔ kɛ nimli babauu?
Anɛ si kake too kɛkɛ nɛ a fɔɔ je ma lo?
Se Zion lɛɛ e nɛ nɔ́; benɛ kɔɔmi miɔ nɛ ta e he kɛkɛ e fɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ momo.
Ke fɔmi su gbongu mi ɔ, anɛ ma ko ha a fɔ bi ɔ lo?
Imi nɛ i haa a fɔɔ bi ɔ, anɛ ma nga muklii ɔ nya lo?” Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ lɛ de.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ suɔ Yerusalem ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ nya.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ye kɔmɔ ha lɛ ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo nyɛ na bua jɔmi!
E ní nɛ e na a, nyɛ maa ye eko, nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ kaa bimwɔyo ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nya!
Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha nyɛ ma ná ní kpɔtɔɔ.
Je ma amɛ a juetli ma ba hyi nyɛ ma a mi tɔ kaa pa nɛ hyi ywia nga.
Nyɛ maa pee kaa bimwɔyo nɛ e nyɛ hɛɛ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ ngɛ e tɛ nɔ; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e kɛ lɛ to e kasa nya ngɛ lɛ nyɔ hae, kɛkɛ ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ fɔ e tɛ nɔ ekohu.
Bɔ nɛ binyɛ haa e bi naa bua jɔmi ɔ, jã ma ha nyɛ bua maa jɔ nyɛ he ngɛ Yerusalem.
Ke enɛ ɔ ba mi ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi.
Nyɛ ma na he wami he.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi Yawɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ buɔ mi tue ɔ, i piɛɔ a he, nɛ i kɛ abofu gblaa ye he nyɛli a tue.” Yawɛ maa nyɛɛ la mi kɛ ba.
E maa hi ta zugba lɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa lasiogblee mi kɛ ba, nɛ e ma ba kpata e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ fɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ la kɛ klaate kɛ kpata a hɛ mi.
Nɛ nihi babauu ma gbo.
Yawɛ ke, “Nihi nɛ tsukɔɔ a he, nɛ a peeɔ a he klɔuklɔu kɛ haa wɔ jami, nɛ a toɔ slɛnɛɛ kɛ yaa abɔɔhi a mi ya yeɔ kpotoo lo, kɔkue, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee ɔ, a nyagbe maa pee gbeye.
I le níhi nɛ a ngɛ susue, kɛ níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee.
Be ma nɛ ma bua je ma amɛ tsuo, kɛ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.
Ke a ba a, a ma ba na ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi lɛ i ngɛ a tue gblae.
“Se ma he a ti ni komɛ a yi wami, nɛ ma tsɔ mɛ kɛ maa ya je ma amɛ a ngɔ, kɛ zugbahi a nɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo, he nɛ a nui ye we agbo jemi, kɛ ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ he ngɛ lolo.
Ma tsɔ mɛ Spania, Libia, Lidia he nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li kpakpahi ngɛ ɔ, Tubal, kɛ Hela.
