Jinɛ i susu kaa nɛ Israel pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, e maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba pee ye nɔ́ ekohu; se e pee we ja.
Nɛ e nyɛmiyo Yuda, nɛ lɛ hu e yi anɔkuale kaa lɛ nɔuu ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Yuda na kaa i ha Israel gba mi pomi womi nɛ i fie lɛ, ejakaa e je ye se nɛ e ya bɔ ajuama.
Se Yuda nɛ ngɛ kaa e nyɛmiyo Israel ɔ yi gbeye.
E kɛ yahomi ble zugba a, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si we lɛ kpu.
E juɛmi ji ke e ya ja tso kɛ tɛ ɔ, tsa pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ji lɔ ɔ. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, Yuda, Israel nyɛmiyo yaholɔ ɔ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo; e ní peemi níhi tsɔɔ we kaa e tsake.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke Israel tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã mohu lɛɛ, se afani lɛ kulaa ngɛ Yuda he.
E ke ma ya de Israel ke, “Israel, yaholɔ, moo kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu; ejakaa mɔbɔ nalɔ ji mi, nɛ i be ye hɛ mi tue kɛ wo mo.
Ye mi mi be fue kɛ wo mo kɛ ya neneene.
Moo lɛɛ moo kplɛɛ kɛkɛ kaa o ye fɔ, kaa o tsɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã.
Moo jaje kaa o ngɔ o suɔmi ya ha ma se mawuhi, nɛ o ja mɛ ngɛ tsohi tsuo nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi.
Moo jaje kaa o yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Atuã tsɔli!
Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ koo; ye ma ji nyɛ.
Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba Zion yo ɔ nɔ ekohu: ma tsuaa ma a, ma ngɔ nɔ kake, nɛ we puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya a, ma ngɔ ni enyɔ.
Ma ha nyɛ nɔ yeli nɛ peeɔ ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a kɛ nile kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi maa hyɛ nyɛ nɔ.
Pee se ke nyɛ ba fɔ babauu, nɛ nyɛ he ba hiɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, nihi pa be ye somi daka a he ní sɛɛe hu.
A pa be he susue, nɛ a be kaie hu.
E he pa be mɛ hiae hu, nɛ ekpa hu a be pee.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a ma tsɛ Yerusalem ke, ‘Yawɛ matsɛ sɛ,’ nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo ma ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma ja mi.
A pa be a tsui kpliie nɛ a pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní yayamihi hu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi, kɛ Yuda bi maa ye a he kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi ngɛ omleyi je zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ma tsa bo nya kɛ kpale kɛ ba zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa a weto ni ɔ nɔ ekohu.” Mawu ma a ja amagahi Yawɛ ke, “Israel, jinɛ i susu kaa e maa pee fɛu ke i ngɔ mo ba piɛ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. I to nɛ ma ha mo zugba saminyayoo ko, zugba nɛ ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa ngɛ je ɔ mi.
I hyɛ blɔ kaa o ma tsɛ mi ke ‘Tsaatsɛ’, nɛ i susu kaa o pa be ye hɛ mi atuã tsɔe hu.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ yogbayo jeɔ e huno se nɛ e kɛ nyumu kpahi ya naa bɔmi ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ mo hu o yi mi anɔkuale.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Ngmlaa ko ngɛ pɛe ngɛ yoku kpataa amɛ a nɔ; Israel bi lɛ a wo yana, nɛ a ngɛ kue fae; ejakaa a pee yayami, nɛ a hɛ je Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɔ.
“Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ je Yawɛ se, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba; e ma tsa nyɛ yayami hiɔ ɔmɛ.” Nyɛ ke, “Ee, wa ma Yawɛ ngɔ, ejakaa lɛ ji wa Mawu.
Niinɛ, wɔhi nɛ wa ngɛ jae ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ huhui bami nɛ ɔ, wa na we a he se ko.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ pɛ ji Israel he piɛlɔ, kɛ yi wami helɔ.
Baal jami kpata níhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbo dengme kɛ na ha wɔ blema a, tohi, nahi, kɛ binyumuhi kɛ yihi a hɛ mi.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa kɛ zo nɛ pee wa heha nɔ́ kɛ hwɔ si, ejakaa wa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ. Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee a nɔ́, nɛ wɔ hu kɛ je wa jokuɛwi a si kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, wa kpa we.
Wa yi Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ.”
Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui Yawɛ ke, “Israel bi, ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ba!
Ke nyɛ ma je amaga amɛ nɛ i hiee ɔ kɛ je ye hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ma ka kita ngɛ ye biɛ mi anɔkuale mi, nɛ nyɛ maa ye dami sane, nɛ nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛɛ je ma amɛ tsuo ma ba je ye yi, nɛ a ma de mi ke ma gbaa mɛ.” Yawɛ de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ fa hu ngɛ nyɛ tsui ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ hɛ ɔ a mi; nyɛ ko du ní ngɔ wo miohi a mi.
Somi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ imi Yawɛ, nyɛ so ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha mi, nyɛ Yuda ma, kɛ Yerusalem bi.
Ke nyɛ pee we ja a, ye mi mi ma fu nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Nɛ ke ye mi mi fu ɔ, nɔ ko be nyɛe maa jɔɔ he.” He nyɛli miɔ nɛ a ma tua Yuda Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo!
Nyɛ kpa bubuubui!
Nyɛ de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke a tu fo kɛ ya mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ a mi.
Esɔ nɛ nyɛ pue blɔ kɛ ya Zion!
Nyɛ ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nyɛ ko to tsle!
Ejakaa Yawɛ je omleyi je kɛ ma nɛ e ba kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
Je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpatalɔ ɔ ma kaa jata nɛ hia kpo kɛ je e laami he.
E ma nɛ e ba kpata Yuda zugba a hɛ mi.
Yuda ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie hu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ bu kpekpe ya bo; nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ nya awe, ejakaa Yawɛ mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a ji Yuda nɔ lolo.
Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, sawale maa nu matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo; osɔfo ɔmɛ a he mi ma jɔ̃, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ a hɛ mi maa pee mɛ yaa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Ao, Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, anɔkuale mi ɔ, o sisi Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ pɛ!
Mo lɛ o wo si ke tue mi jɔmi maa ba ma a mi, se klaate mohu ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kuɔ si.” Be ma nɛ a ma de Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ ko maa hia kɛ je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ba a ngɔ; pi kɔɔhiɔ hɛlii nɛ maa muɔ jakati kɛ ho kɛkɛ.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ e fia nɛ ɔ nya maa wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ pe lɔ ɔ!
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ ji Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ ma e ma a tue gblami ɔ nɛ.
He nyɛli ba sá Yuda ma a yi Hyɛ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ fo nɔ kɛ ma kaa bɔku.
A ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ hia kɛ ma kaa lasiogblee, nɛ a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he sɔɔ kulaa pe kɔlehi.
Akuanyɛ!
Wa yi ta pɛ!
Yerusalem, mo fɔ ní yayami ɔmɛ kɛ je o tsui mi, nɛ a he o yi wami.
Kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ o maa hi ní yayamihi a he susue?
Tsɔli ngɔ sɛ gbi yaya kɛ je Dan ma a mi, kɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ma.
A ma nɛ a ba ha nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a le, nɛ Yerusalem hu nɛ e nu kaa he nyɛli komɛ je ma se tsitsaa kɛ ma nɛ a ba sá ma a yi.
He nyɛli nɛ ɔmɛ ma he ose kɛ wo Yuda ma amɛ a he.
A ma sá Yerusalem ma a yi kɛ kpe kaa bɔ nɛ buli buɔ zugba he ɔ; ejakaa ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã.
Yawɛ lɛ de.
Yuda, mo nitsɛ o je mi babɛ, kɛ o ni peepee lɛ ngɔ haomi nɛ ɔ kɛ ba o nɔ ɔ nɛ.
E ngɛ kaa tsopa ko nɛ mo nitsɛ o nu, nɛ e doomi ɔ ya su o tsui he tɔɔ.
Yeremia ye kɔmɔ ha e ma a Ao!
Ao!
Ye mi mi!
Ye mi mi!
Ye tsui!
Ye tsui ngɛ fiae kpla, kpla!
I be nyɛe nɛ ma pee dii; ejakaa i nu nɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae, nɛ ta ose ngɛ pɛe.
Haomi ɔmɛ ba nɔtonɔto kɛ ya si zugba a tsuo hɛ mi kpata.
A hule wa bo tsu ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si tlukaa, nɛ a hía bo ɔmɛ a mi dukuduku.
Ma hi ta nɛ ɔ hyɛe kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Ma hi titimati nɛ ɔ he nue kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Yawɛ ke, “Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ biɛ pɛ; ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ li mi.
A ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi kuasiahi; a be juɛmi.
A he sɔɔ kɛ peeɔ yayami, se kpakpa peemi lɛɛ a li.” Yeremia na hɛ mi kpatami ɔ nɛ ma a I hyɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a fɔɔ si gu nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɔ.
I hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ la ko la ko be lejɛ ɔ. I hyɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ yo ɔmɛ ngɛ mimiɛe; yoku ɔmɛ ngɛ mimiɛe kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.
I na kaa nɔmlɔ adesa kake ngmelu be je ɔ mi; lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔmɛ po te kɛ je.
Zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a plɛ pee nga kplanaa.
Ma amɛ plɛ pee ma dokuhi, ejakaa Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
(Yawɛ de ke zugba a tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata mohu lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, bɔɔ ko maa piɛ nɛ he maa je mi.)
Zugba a maa ye kɔmɔ, nɛ hiɔwe ma yu tuu.
Yawɛ lɛ de, nɛ e be e nya se kpalee.
E to e yi mi momo, nɛ e be tsakee hu.
Ke ma a nu okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa tu fo kɛ je.
Ni komɛ ma ya sɛ pu mi, nɛ ni komɛ ma ya kuɔ tɛ sahi.
A ma si ma amɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie hu.
Yerusalem, o hɛ mi kpata pɛ!
Mɛni he je lɛ o bu bo tsu ɔ?
Mɛni he je lɛ o kɛ june dla o he, nɛ o kpa o hɛngmɛ se tsopa a?
O ngɛ o he dlae yaka gu!
O suɔli ɔmɛ kua mo, nɛ a ngɛ mo hlae nɛ a gbe.
I nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi; i nu kɛmɛmi ko kaa yo nɛ ngɛ e kekleekle bi fɔe.
Mamoo Yerusalem nɛ e kɛ gbafa ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ɔ nɛ.
E juale e nine mi, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Ye yi ta pɛ!
He nyɛli ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a maa gbe mi!”
Yerusalem pee yayami Yerusalem bi, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ gu gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba!
Nyɛɛ po nyɛ hɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kɛ bɔle si!
Nyɛɛ kpa jua amɛ a nɔ nɛ nyɛ hla fitsofitso kaa nyɛ maa na nɔ kake ngmelu nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɔ nɛ bɔɔ mɔde kaa e maa ye Mawu anɔkuale lo?
Ke nyɛ na nɔ kake ngmelu kaa ja a, lɛɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ Yerusalem he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa lɛ.
Nyɛ ngɔɔ Yawɛ biɛ kɛ kaa kita, se nyɛ ní peemi níhi slo.
Anɛ pi anɔkuale yemi pɛ nɛ Yawɛ suɔ lo?
Yawɛ fia nyɛ ní, se nyɛ bui fɛɛ.
Yawɛ kpata nyɛ hɛ mi, se nyɛ kase we ní kɛ ji mi.
Nyɛ kplii nyɛ tsui kaa tɛ sa, nɛ nyɛ kpale we kɛ ji nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a se.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Nimli guhi kɛkɛ ji nimli nɛ ɔmɛ; a be juɛmi; a biɛ.
A li Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ blɔ ɔmɛ.
Kɛ a maa pee kɛ bu lɛ tue kɛɛ?
Ma ya nimli ngua amɛ a ngɔ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ ma ya tu munyu.
Niinɛ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a le nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee.” Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ kaa nimli gu ɔmɛ kɛ̃; mɛ hu a tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã, nɛ a bui lɛ fɛɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, jata maa je pu mi kɛ ba gbe mɛ; ogbetee maa je nga nɔ kɛ ba tsɔtslɔɔ a mi dukuduku, nɛ ngatsɛ ma ba wo ka ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je kpo ɔ, a ma tsɔtslɔɔ lɛ; ejakaa a pee yayamihi fuu, nɛ a tsɔ Mawu hɛ mi atuã si abɔ.
Yawɛ bi ke, “Mɛni he je lɛ ma ngɔ ye ma a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ ɔ?
Ye ma a kua mi nɛ a ya ja yaka mawuhi.
I lɛ ye ma a kɛ ya si a tɔ saminya, se ajuama bɔmi mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ, nɛ yaholi a wehi a mi a naa mɛ ngɛ.
A ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔ kuhi nɛ plɔke saminya nɛ a he mi ngɛ mɛ ngɔɔe, nɛ a he mi abua ngɛ nɔ́ dee ha mɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ dɔ ngɛ e nyɛmi e yo se.
Anɛ e sɛ kaa a gblaa a tue ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo?
Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e sɛ kaa i gblaa a tue lo?
Ma tsɔ he nyɛli nɛ a ya poo ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a wai tso ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si, se i be hae nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ma ha nɛ a kplɔ tso kɔni ɔmɛ, ejakaa pi imi Yawɛ, ye níhi ji mɛ.
Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo yi mi anɔkuale.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ kua Israel Yawɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ sisi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ loo!
Mɛni e ma nyɛ maa pee?
Haomi ko haomi ko be wa nɔ bae fɛɛ!
Ta, loo hwɔ hu be bae.” -A deɔ ke gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ; Yawɛ sɛ gbi ko be mi.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ de mi ke, “Yeremia, akɛnɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ he je ɔ, ma ha nɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ maa pee kaa la ngɛ o nya mi.
Ma nɛ ɔ maa pee kaa lɛ́, nɛ la a maa sã mɛ.” Nyɛ Israel bi, Yawɛ ha nɛ je ma ko je tsitsaa kɛ ma nɛ e ba tua nyɛ.
Blema ma ji ma nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a gbi ɔ, nyɛ li; ke a tu munyu hu nyɛ be sisi nue.
A kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ɔmɛ ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ sɔuu ji mɛ; a gbeɔ nɔ basabasa nɛ a hyɛ we a se.
A maa ye nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ niye ní ɔmɛ tsuatsuaatsua; a maa gbe nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ.
A ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ to ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ, nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ wai, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔkɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tabo ɔmɛ ma kpata jamɛ a ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
Yawɛ ke, “Se jamɛ a be ɔ mi po, i be ye ma a hɛ mi kpatae pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Yeremia, ke a bi mo ke mɛni he je lɛ imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kɛ mɛ ye sane yaya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, de mɛ ke, kaa bɔ nɛ a je ye se nɛ a ya sɔmɔ ma se mawuhi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu kɛ̃ lɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ nibwɔhi ngɛ ma se zugba nɔ.” Mawu bɔ e ma a kɔkɔ Yawɛ ke, “De Yakob nina nɛ ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, Nyɛ kuasiahi, kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ be juɛmi!
Nyɛ ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se nyɛ hyɛ we nɔ́; nyɛ ngɛ tue, se nyɛ nui nɔ́.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Imi ji Yawɛ; mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ yi mi gbeye?
Mɛni he je nyɛ he dui blibliibli ngɛ ye hɛ mi?
Imi lɛ i ngɔ zia kɛ wo huzu ha wo, huzu nɛ ngɛ daa kɛ daa, nɛ wo be nyɛe maa hane ligbi ko ligbi ko.
Ke wo gli kaa mɛni, e be nyɛe maa hane huzu nɛ ɔ. Ke oslɔkehi ngɛ kue nɛ wo ɔ pee hamahama kaa mɛni, e be nyɛe maa be huzu nɛ ɔ he gblegbleegble.
Se nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nimli nɛ a tsui kplii, kɛ atuã tsɔli ji nyɛ; nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã, nɛ nyɛ kua mi.
Nyɛ susuu we hyɛ kaa e sa kaa nyɛɛ wo imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ mi nyami: imi nɛ i haa nɛ gbo kɛ gbiɛ nyu nɛɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi, nɛ i haa nɛ nyɛ kpaa ní daa jeha a!
Se nyɛ ní peemi ní yayami ɔmɛ tsake ní nɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ ní kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ bɔ nyɛ.
“Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
A woɔ ka kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ tsɔɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ klama peeɔ ɔ.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ ke a tsɔ klama a, nimli lɛ a duɔ.
Ju níhi hyi a wehi a mi tɔ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ wo kusii mi.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, a na ní, nɛ a pee nimli nguahi.
A plɔke, nɛ a pee tɔfutɔfu, nɛ a yi mi wa kaa nɔ́ ko.
A ha we awusahi a blɔ fa mi níhi nɛ sa, nɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ hu a yi dami sane ha we mɛ.
“Anɛ e sɛ kaa i gblaa a tue ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo?

Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“I ka kaa ma bua ye ma a nya kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔ hulɔ buaa e ngmɔ niba ní nya a; se e hí peemi.
Ye ma a ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ wai yiblii be nɔ.
A ngɛ kaa ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ngmɔkɔ be nɔ; ba amɛ tete po ngla.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ha nɛ nibwɔhi ba ngɔ a zugba a.” Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ bi a he ke, “Mɛni he je lɛ wa hii si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ?
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa tu fo kɛ ya mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi, nɛ wa ya gbo ngɛ jamɛ a ma amɛ a mi.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ bu wɔ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ e ngɔ nyu kɛ kplu nɛ duɔ ngɛ mi ngɔ ha wɔ ke waa nu, ejakaa wa pee yayami kɛ si lɛ.
Wa hyɛ tue mi jɔmi blɔ, se tue mi jɔmi bɛ; wa hyɛ tsami be blɔ, se gbeye mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ ba.
Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba sɛ Dan ma a mi momo.
Wa ngɛ a okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he nue nɛ a ngɛ a gugwɔ mi flie ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ pɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ zugba a tsuo ngɛ mimiɛe.
Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba konɛ a ba kpata zugba a hɛ mi, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, wa ma a, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo.” Yawɛ ke, “Ma tsɔ sinɔhi kɛ ba nyɛ kpɛti, sangahi ma ba kɔɔ nyɛ; kunya yelɔ ko kunya yelɔ ko be nyɛe maa jɔɔ a he.” Yeremia ye kɔmɔ ha e ma a Ye we aywilɛho ɔ nya wa tsɔ ha mi; i nyɛ we hu.
Ye tsui kpa miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔ.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ, i nu nɛ ye ma a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae nɛ a ngɛ bie ke, “Anɛ Yawɛ be Zion hu lo?
Zion matsɛ ɔ be ma a mi hu lo?” Yawɛ bi ke, “Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi wo ye mi mi la a?
Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ ya kpla si ha ma se wohi?” Ma a he nɔ kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Latsa be ɔ se po, nɛ a kpa ní ta, se a he we wa yi wami lolo.” Bɔ nɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he mi ngɛ mɛ hiae ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu ye he mi ngɛ mi hiae.
Ye ywilɛ ho ye he; gbeye kɛ sawale nu mi.
Anɛ tsopa be Gilead lo?
Tsopatsɛ ko be lejɛ ɔ lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a tsa we ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ lolo ɔ?
I ná nɛ ye yi pee kaa vu kɛ e mi nyu, nɛ ye hɛngmɛhi plɛ pee nyu hɛngmɛ nɛ vo nyu ngɛ mi jee babaaba.
Jinɛ i ko fo ya nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ ha ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ. I ná nɛ i ngɛ hi he ko ngɛ nga a nɔ kaa nibwɔhi a to he kikɛ nɛ ɔ; jinɛ i ko je ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he kulaa nɛ i ya hi lejɛ ɔ banee!
Ejakaa a ngɛ kaa yaholi; nimli yayamihi ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ; a yi mi anɔkuale.
Daa nɛ ɔ, a duɔ a lilɛ nya ngɔ to kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ a dɔ mi nɛ a ma tsɛ̃.
Lakpa, kɛ sisimi sɔuu ji zugba a nɔ; anɔkuale be.
Yawɛ ke, “Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ peeɔ yayami nɔtonɔto; se imi lɛɛ a li mi kaa a Mawu.” Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ e he saminya ngɛ e nyɛmi he; nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nyɛmi nɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ pee e he Yakob kɛ ngɛ e nyɛmi sisie, nɛ jã kɛ̃ nyɛmi ngɛ e nyɛmi he guɛ gbee kɛ ngɛ bee.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e nyɛmi sisie, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko tu we anɔkuale.
A lilɛ be kɛ lakpa yemi, nɛ a kplɛɛ we kaa a ma kpa yayami peemi.
A peeɔ yi wu tso níhi nɔtonɔto; jã kɛ̃ nɛ a sisiɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ ke e ma mi bi ɔmɛ kua lɛ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma gbla a tue, nɛ ma ha nɛ a tsake a je mi babɛ kaa bɔ nɛ sika galɔ tsuɔ sika he ɔ. Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayami.
Anɛ nɔ́ kpa ko pa ngɛ nɛ ma pee mɛ lo?
A lilɛ ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ gbeɔ nɔ; lakpa pɛ a yeɔ.
Nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi tuɔ munyu ngɛ he jɔmi mi, se a tsui mi be ja; klama mohu lɛ a hii a sibi tsɔe.
Anɛ ma ko gbla a tue ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo?
Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma ko gbla a tue lo?
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.” I de ke, “Ma ye kɔmɔ ha yoku ɔmɛ, nɛ ma fo ya ha lohwehi a lɛmi he ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Ejakaa lejɛ ɔmɛ gbli, nɛ a fɔɔ si gu; nɔ ko nɔ ko gui lejɛ ɔmɛ hu.
A pa nui kaa na ngɛ pɛe muu muu ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ hu; lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo tu fo kɛ je.” Yawɛ ke, “Ma pee Yerusalem ma doku, kɛ nga mi gbehi a hi he.
Yuda ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie.” I bi ke, “Yawɛ, mɛni he je a sã zugba a, nɛ e gbli nɛ e pee kaa nga kplanaa nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nɔ hu ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ji ní lelɔ nɛ e maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi?
Mɛnɔ lɛ o ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa fiɛ kɛ ha nihi?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba ji mlaa nɛ i wo ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, a yi nɔ.
A bui mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i de mɛ ke a pee ɔ hu, a pee we.
A wa tue, nɛ a ya pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya níhi mohu.
A ya ja Baal amaga amɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i to kaa ma pee ɔ tue: ma gbla ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tue.
Ma ha mɛ agba nɛ a ye, kɛ duɔ nɛ a nu.
Ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je mahi nɛ a kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nui a he hyɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ ta maa nyɛɛ a se hluu kɛ yaa si ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.” Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ bi yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ susu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae nɛ ɔ he!
Nyɛ ya kpee yihi nɛ nyɛɔ ya a kɛ ba; nyɛ ya kpee yihi nɛ a he be ɔ kɛ ba.” Ma a de ke, “Nyɛ de mɛ nɛ a pee esɔ nɛ a ba wo yana ha wɔ, kɛ yaa si wa hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ maa tɔ nyu, nɛ wa hɛngmɛ se maa fuu kɛ ya fomi sɔuu.” A wo yana ngɛ Zion, nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “Wa yi ta oo, wa yi ta!
Wa hɛ mi pue si pɛ!
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa je wa zugba a nɔ, ejakaa a ku wa we ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.” I de ke, “Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ kɔmɔ yemi, kɛ nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya la lami.
Gbenɔ kuɔ wa saflɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba sɛ wa mɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e kpata wa nihewi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa yihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; jokuɛwi pa fiɛ we ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu, nɛ nihewi kɛ yihewi ta jua amɛ a nɔ.
A sake ni gbogboehi ngɔ pue he tsuaa he glekugleku kaa kuku ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ, loo blɛfo nɛ ní kpali poo pue si nɛ a je he, blɛfo nɛ nɔ ko bua we nya.” Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mi ke ma de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ ke, “Ní lelɔ nɛ ko fĩa kɛ fɔ e nile nɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ, e ko fĩa kɛ fɔ e he wami nɔ, niatsɛ nɛ ko fĩa kɛ fɔ e níhi a nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa fĩa a, e fĩa kaa e le mi saminya; ejakaa ye suɔmi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble; i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ i yeɔ dami sane.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ saa ye hɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” -Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ ma gbla Egipt bi, Yuda bi, Edom bi, Amon bi, kɛ Moab bi a tue.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ nɛ a poɔ huɛ ngɛ a hɛ se ɔ hu piɛ he.
A po nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se somi nɛ pomi okadi nɛ ɔ daa si ha a lɛɛ a yi nɔ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ jio, ye ma Israel ɔ jio, nɔ ko nɔ ko yi ye somi ɔ nɔ.”
Amaga jami kɛ Mawu nitsɛnitsɛ jami Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛɛ bu sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ tue!
Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ je ma kpa amɛ a blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ; ke nyɛ na okadihi ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye kaa bɔ nɛ je ma kpa amɛ yeɔ gbeye ɔ. Je ma amɛ a kusumi ɔmɛ ɔ, lakpa sɔuu.
A ya poɔ tso ngɛ pu mi, nɛ tso kpɛ́lɔ kɛ dade tsuɔ he ní, nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu haa he.
A kaa plɛɛko kɛ woɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ a kɛ nuu tso ɔ ngɔ daa si konɛ e ko nɔ si.
Amaga amɛ ngɛ kaa lohwehi a he gbeye womi níhi nɛ maa si ngɛ jamatlɛ ngmɔ mi; a tu we munyu.
A nyɛɛ we hulɔ; pe a woɔ a nɔ kɛ jeɔ he kake kɛ yaa he kake.
Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye, ejakaa a be nyɛe maa pee nyɛ yayami ko; kpakpa ko hu a be nyɛe maa pee ha nyɛ.” Yawɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ; O je agbo, nɛ o biɛ hu kle nɛ e je agbo ja nɔuu.
Mo, je ma amɛ tsuo a matsɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ be mo gbeye yee?
O sa bu.
Je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ, nɔ ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ, a ní leli ɔmɛ jio, a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ jio.
Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a biɛ, nɛ a jeɔ kuasia.
Amagahi nɛ a kɛ tso pee ɔ, mɛni a ma nyɛ maa kase kɛ je a dɛ?
A kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ a si nɔ jeɔ Spania, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu hu jeɔ Ufaz kɛ ba haa sika ga ní tsuli, nɛ a kɛ peeɔ amagahi.
A buɔ amaga amɛ bo hiɔ, kɛ bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su nɛ bo loli kpakpahi lo.
Se mo Yawɛ, Mawu nitsɛnitsɛ ji mo; mo ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ; neneene matsɛ ji mo.
Ke o mi mi fu ɔ, zugba mimiɛɔ, nɛ je ma amɛ nyɛ we nya dami.
Nyɛ de mɛ ke, jamɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ jae, nɛ pohu pi mɛ nɛ a pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, a hɛ mi ma kpata.
A be mɛ nae ngɛ je ɔ mi he ko he ko hu.
Mawu yi jemi la Yawɛ lɛ bɔ je ɔ ngɛ e he wami nya.
Nile lɛ e kɛ bɔ je ɔ, nɛ jamɛ a nile ɔ nɔuu e kɛ bli hiɔwe mi.
Ke e wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ keɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; Yawɛ lɛ haa afua teɔ si kɛ jeɔ zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ.
E haa oslabai gbaa be mi nɛ hiɔmi ngɛ nɛe, nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jeɔ e nito he ɔ. Nimli adesahi tsuo biɛ; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Sika gali a hɛ mi pue si pɛ; ejakaa amaga amɛ nɛ a puɛɛ ɔ, ní guhi ji mɛ; wami ko wami ko be a mi.
Amaga amɛ ɔ, se nami ko be a he, muɔ ní kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Be mi nɛ Yawɛ ma ba gbla ma a tue ɔ, a we amaga amɛ hu a maa ku mɛ dukuduku.
Yakob Mawu ɔ be kaa mɛ; lɛ ji nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e hla Israel kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
A ma ba nuu ni ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ Yerusalem bi, a sa nyɛ ma a yi oo!
Nyɛ bua nyɛ níhi a nya.
Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma sake nimli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɔ fɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ tɛ ɔ. Ma hao mɛ kɛ yaa si a maa nu he.” Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ kpa bubuubui ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Wa plaa pɛ!
Wa pa a be tsa ba.
Se wa susu kaa wa ma nyɛ ma mia wa hɛ mi kɛ to nɔ.
Wa bo tsu ɔmɛ puɛ; kpahi nɛ fi mɛ ɔ tsɔ.
Wa bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo je wa he; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa ngɔ wa bo tsu ɔmɛ kɛ ma si ekohu ha wɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa ngɔ bo ɔmɛ kɛ kpla bo tsu ɔmɛ a he ekohu.” I he nɔ ke, “Wa nɔ yeli ɔmɛ be juɛmi; a bi we Yawɛ ga womi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a yɛ́ nɔ; nɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Sɛ gbi ko ma!
Ose ko ngɛ pɛe kɛ je omleyi je zugba a nɔ kɛ ma.
Ta nguaa ko ma nɛ e ba kpata Yuda ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ ma amɛ maa pee kaa nga mi gbehi a hi he.” Yawɛ, i le kaa nɔmlɔ adesa ko be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e wami nɔ.
Pi nɔmlɔ adesa nitsɛ he wami nya ji kaa e maa pee kikɛ nɛ ɔ, loo kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Yawɛ, mo ka o ma a hɛ mi; ka wa hɛ mi bɔ pɛ nɛ sa kɛkɛ.
Koo ngɔ abofu kɛ gbla wa tue; ke o pee ja a, wa hɛ mi ma kpata.
Je ma amɛ nɛ li mo ɔ, o mi mi nɛ fu mɛ; ni nɛmɛ nɛ ja we mo ɔ, gbla a tue.
A gbe o ma mi bi nɛ ji Yakob nina a; a kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a pee wa zugba a kaa nga kplanaa nɔ.
Yeremia kɛ somi ɔ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Bu somi munyu ɔmɛ tue.
De Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma bi ɔmɛ ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be somi munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue bue ɔ, imi, Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ ma gbiɛ lɛ.
Benɛ i jé a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ, somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Egipt zugba a ngɛ kaa flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege.
I wo mɛ mlaa ke a bu mi tue, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, a pee.
I de mɛ ke, ke a bu mi tue ɔ, a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, si ko nɛ i wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa ma ha mɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní ɔ, ma ye nɔ.
Jamɛ a zugba a nɔ a ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” I he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ, ha nɛ e ba mi ja.” Jehanɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa fiɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o de ni ɔmɛ ke a bu somi munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ a ye nɔ.
Benɛ i je a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, i ka a hɛ mi saminya nɛ i de mɛ ke a bu mi tue.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu i ngɛ ma a hɛ mi kae kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
Se a bui mi tue fɛɛ; munyu nɛ i kɛ mɛ tu ɔ po, a nui.
A wa tue nɛ a pee yayami kaa kekle ɔ mohu.
I wo mɛ mlaa ke a ye somi ɔ nɔ, se a kua nɔ yemi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i gbla a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ somi tsɔɔ ɔ.” Yawɛ de mi ekohu ke, “Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã.
Yayamihi nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, a kpale ya pee jamɛ a yayami ɔmɛ.
A nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we kaa a maa bu mi tue, nɛ a ya ja mawu kpahi.
Israel ma a, kɛ Yuda ma a tsuo yi somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke, ma ha nɛ haomi maa ba a nɔ nɛ a he be mi jee.
Ke a fa kue ha mi po, i be mɛ tue bue.
Ke e ba mi ja a, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem ɔ ma ya fa kue ha mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa a.
Se kikɛmɛ a mawu nɛ ɔmɛ be nyɛe ma he a yi wami ngɛ jamɛ a haomi be ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ Yuda ma amɛ hiɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ a mawu ɔmɛ hu hiɛ.
Bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ma, nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a nɔ kɛ haa yakayaka mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Baal ɔ, jamɛ a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu kaa gbɛjegbɛhi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kɛ̃.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yeremia, ko kpa pɛɛ ha kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ; koo da a nane mi nɛ o kɛ fa kue ha mi.
Ke amanehlu ba a nɔ nɛ a fa kue ha mi ɔ, i be mɛ tue bue.” Yawɛ ke, “Nimli nɛ i suɔ saminya a, yayami sɔuu lɛ a ngɛ pee.
Anɛ a ngɛ he blɔ kaa a hii ye we ɔ mi lo?
Anɛ a susu kaa ke a wo mi si babauu, nɛ a ngɔ lohwehi kɛ sã bɔ ha mi ɔ, haomi ko nɛ maa ba a nɔ ɔ, a kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a peemi maa tsi jamɛ a haomi ɔ nya lo?
Ke e ba mi ja a, anɛ a ma na bua jɔmi lo?
Sa a, bɔ nɛ i tsɛɔ mɛ ji, ‘Oliv tso kɛ e yi mi ba kusuu saminyayoo nɛ woɔ yiblii kpakpa;’ se ma mɛ e ba amɛ a he la, nɛ ma ku tso kɔni ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ahumi tsuɔ ní ɔ.
“Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, imi lɛ i to Israel kɛ Yuda si kaa bɔ nɛ a duɔ tso; se jehanɛ lɛɛ ma ha nɛ amanehlu maa ba a nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ɔ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ, ejakaa a pee yayami; a ya sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha Baal, nɛ a kɛ wo ye mi mi la.” A so ngɔ wo Yeremia he Yawɛ ha nɛ i le kaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ so ngɔ wo ye he.
I pee kaa jijɔ nɛ he jɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ yaa nɛ a ya gbe, nɛ i li kaa a ngɛ ye he ga yayami ko toe.
Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa po tso ɔ kɛ e yiblii ɔ tsuo ngɔ fɔ he; nyɛ ha nɛ waa gbe lɛ, konɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko kai lɛ hu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i sɔle ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ lee, kojolɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane; mo nɛ o hyɛɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsui mi kɛ e juɛmi mi fitsofitso.
I to ye sane ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo hyɛe konɛ o wo nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa mɛ.” Anatot nyumu ɔmɛ hla kaa a maa gbe mi, nɛ a de mi ke, ke i ya nɔ nɛ i fiɛ ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a maa gbe mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de mi ke, “Ma gbla a tue kokooko!
Nihewi ɔmɛ ma gbo ngɛ ta nga nɔ, nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ hwɔ maa gbe mɛ.
Be nɛ ma ngɔ amanehlu kɛ ba Anatot bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, i to momo.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he be mi jee.”
Yeremia bi Yawɛ munyu Yawɛ, ke i ke i kɛ mo ma hla níhi a nya a, mo lɛ o nɔ́ da.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ sane nɛ ɔ maa fɔ o hɛ mi.
Mɛni he je lɛ nimli yayamihi yaa nɔ ɔ?
Mɛni he je lɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a he mi jɔɔ mɛ ɔ?
O toɔ mɛ si kaa bɔ nɛ a duɔ ní; a tsɛ̃ɛ̃ sipoku, a waa, nɛ a woɔ yiblii.
A woɔ o biɛ ta ji nɛ, se a tsui be o he.
Se Yawɛ, imi lɛɛ o le mi saminya.
O naa ye tsui mi níhi tsuo, nɛ juɛmi nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ o he hu o le.
Moo gbla nimli yayami nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ho kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe.
Bu a he kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ a maa gbe mɛ.
Wa ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ nga a tsuo gbli.
Pu mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ngɛ tae.
Wa zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ, ejakaa wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayami.
Nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ ji, “Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, Mawu tsa nɛ.” Mɛni be nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ kɛ yaa si?
Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yeremia, ke o kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ka fo nɛ o nyɛ we lɛ ɔ, kɛ o maa pee kɛɛ nɛ o kɛ okpɔngɔ maa ka fo?
Ke o ngɛ si tɛe nɛ o ngɛ si nɔe ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɔ ɔ, Yordan hue ɔ mi lɛɛ kɛ o maa pee kɛɛ?
Mo nitsɛ o nyɛmimɛ, kɛ o weku li te si kɛ wo mo; a so o yi nɔ, nɛ a ngɛ o se blɔ hlae kɛ hɛdɔ.
Ke a ha mo hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ mo tu munyu ngɛ he jɔmi mi po, koo ngɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ.” Yawɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ e ma a he Yawɛ ke, “I ngmɛɛ Israel he; ye ma nɛ i je blɔ hla a, i kua mɛ.
I ngɔ nimli nɛ i suɔ mɛ saminya a kɛ wo a he nyɛli a dɛ mi.
Ma nɛ i je blɔ hla a, a te si kɛ wo mi.
A wo a nya nɔ ngɛ ye nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jata huãa ngɛ pu mi ɔ; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi hu i sume mɛ.
Ma nɛ i je blɔ hla a, a ngɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ kayohi ba tua kɛ je he slɔɔtohi.
Nyɛ yá kpee pu mi lohwehi tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba tsɔtslɔɔ e mi.
Ma nɔ yeli babauu ba puɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ; a ba naa ye ngmɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ye zugba saminyayoo ɔ plɛ pee nga kplanaa.
A kpata zugba a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Zugba a tsuo plɛ pee nga kplanaa, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yi he kɔmɔ.
Ní hali ba ha ní ngɛ yoku kpataa amɛ tsuo a nɔ.
I ha nɛ ta ba kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be tue mi jɔmi hu.
Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ du ngma, se a kpa mio mohu.
A gbo dengme, se nɔ́ ko nɔ ko ji mi kɛ bɛ.
A ngmɔ ɔmɛ bɛ ní, ejakaa ye mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.” Yawɛ wo Israel huza nɔ bi ɔmɛ si Yawɛ ke, “Israel huza nɔ bi nɛ a kpata zugba nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha ye ma Israel ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ma de ngɛ a he.
Ma je jamɛ a yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba amɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a hiaa tso kɛ e sipoku ɔ, nɛ ma kpɔ̃ Yuda kɛ je a dɛ mi.
Se ke i ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho se ɔ, ma na mɛ mɔbɔ ekohu, nɛ ma kpale je ma tsuaa je ma kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ, kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma mi ekohu.
Je ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ye ma a, nɛ a kɛ Baal biɛ kaa kita.
Ke a ma kpa a yi mi, nɛ a maa ngɔ mi kɛ pee a Mawu ngɛ Baal nane mi, nɛ a kɛ ye biɛ ma ka kita ja a, lɛɛ a maa bu mɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Se je ma nɛ be mi tue bue ɔ, ma kpata jamɛ a je ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Kploba bɔjuɛ ɔ Yawɛ de mi ke ma ya he kploba bɔjuɛ nɛ ma tsɛ̃, se ma ko ngɔ kɛ wo nyu mi.
I ya he bɔjuɛ ɔ nɛ i tsɛ̃ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ. Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu si enyɔne, nɛ e de ke, “Ngɔɔ bɔjuɛ nɛ o ya he, nɛ ngɛ o mlɛ mi ɔ kɛ ya Yufrate pa a nya, nɛ o kɛ ya laa ngɛ tɛ sa amɛ a kpɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Nɛ i ngɔ bɔjuɛ ɔ ya laa ngɛ Yufrate pa a kasa nya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ɔ.
Be saii se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma kpale kɛ ya Yufrate pa a nya, nɛ ma ya ngɔ bɔjuɛ ɔ kɛ ba.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpale kɛ ho Yufrate pa a nya ya, nɛ i ya tsua bɔjuɛ ɔ kɛ je puɔ ɔ mi he nɛ i ngɔ ya laa ngɛ ɔ.
Se i na kaa bɔjuɛ ɔ puɛ; e hí kɛ ha nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko peemi hu.
Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, “Yuda he nɔ womi, kɛ Yerusalem he nɔ womi babauu ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyagbe ɔ maa ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nimli yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kua mi tue bumi.
A wa tue, nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ; a ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ma ha nɛ a maa pee kaa bɔjuɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ he be se nami ko hu ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ bɔjuɛ mɛtɛɛ nɔ mlɛ mi kpɛii ɔ, ja i to nɛ Israel ma a, kɛ Yuda ma a tsuo nɛ a mɛtɛ ye he.
I pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, konɛ a pee ye ma, nɛ a na biɛ, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ yi jemi kɛ ha mi.
Se a bui mi fɛɛ.” Wai tɔ ɔ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yeremia, de ma a ke imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke a wo wai tɔ tsuaa wai tɔ mi wai nɛ e hyi.
Ke o de mɛ ja a, a ma bi mo ke, ‘Anɛ wa li kaa e sa kaa a wo wai tɔ tsuaa wai tɔ mi wai nɛ e hyi lo?’ Jehanɛ, de mɛ ke imi Yawɛ, ma ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji David nina a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ tsuo dã nɛ a nu kɛ yaa si a maa de kpɔtɔɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma nuu tsɛmɛ kɛ bimɛ ngɔ fia a sibi, nɛ a ma gbo ngɔ pue si kaa tɔ nɛ ywia.
Ma kpata a hɛ mi; ye tsui mi be mi sãe ngɛ a he, nɛ i be mɛ mɔbɔ nae.” Yeremia bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ngɛ he nɔ womi he Israel ma, Yawɛ tu munyu!
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si, nɛ nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue.
Nyɛɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami be mi nɛ e ha we nɛ diblii nɛ wo nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ba tɛ si ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, be mi nɛ e ha we nɛ la nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ nɛ plɛ pee diblii kpii.
Se ke nyɛ bui tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ma fo ya ngɛ laami mi ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ womi ɔ he.
Ma fo ya hluu kɛ yaa si ye hɛngmɛ maa tɔ nyu, ejakaa a nuu Yawɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je.
Yawɛ de mi ke, “De matsɛ ɔ kɛ e nyɛ ɔ ke, a ba a he si, ejakaa a jlasi saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ je a yi nɔ si.
A sa Yuda leneyi je ma amɛ a yi; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mɛ.
A nuu Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.” Yerusalem, hyɛ!
O he nyɛli ɔmɛ je omleyi je kɛ ma.
O nimli kpakpa amɛ nɛ a ha mo ke o hyɛ a nɔ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?
Nihi nɛ mo nitsɛ o tsɔse mɛ nɛ o kɛ mɛ ngɛ kaa huɛmɛ ɔ, ke a wo mɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ o nɔ ɔ, kɛ o ma de kɛɛ?
Anɛ o he mi be mo kɔɔe kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma fɔ lo?
Ke o bi o he ke, “Mɛni he je ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba ye nɔ” ɔ, heto ɔ ji, o he yayami babauu ɔ he je nɛ he nyɛli ba pee mo kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa yo nɛ nyumu kpa e he bo, nɛ e bɔ lɛ ahlua a nɛ.
Anɛ nɔmlɔ yumu ma nyɛ ma tsake e he womi su ɔ lo?
Anɛ ngatsɛ ma nyɛ ma tsake e he huatahuata a lo?
Ke e maa hi peemi ja a, lɛɛ nyɛ nɛ yayami peemi pee nyɛ he nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ma nyɛ maa pee kpakpa.
Yawɛ maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa kaa tsakati nɛ ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ yaa.
Yawɛ de to ke nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ e to nɛ e maa pee nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa nyɛ hɛ je e nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ya fɔ lakpa níhi a nɔ.
Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kpa nyɛ he bo, nɛ nyɛ we ahlua maa je kpo.
Yawɛ na nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ níhi nɛ e sume pee.
E na nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ya ngɛ mawu kpahi a se nyɛɛe ngɛ nga nɔ kɛ yokuhi a nɔ.
E na nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ huhui kpae kaa okpɔngɔ kuhi kɛ okpɔngɔ yihi nɛ ngɛ bɔe.
Yerusalem bi, musu tloo nyɛ!
Mɛni be po nyɛ he ma tsɔ?
Nyu hwɔ nɛ nya wa a Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ha mi nɛ kɔɔ nyu hwɔ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yuda ngɛ kɔmɔ yee; Yuda ma amɛ ngɛ gboe; ma mi bi ɔmɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ zugba mɔbɔmɔbɔ, nɛ bubuubui ngɛ pɛe ngɛ Yerusalem.
Odehe ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ke a ya yɛ nyu kɛ ba, se ke tsɔli ɔmɛ ya su vu ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a nɛ nyu, nɛ a kpaleɔ buɛ mi gu kɛ baa.
Ke a hɛ mi pue si kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a kɛ nɔ́ haa a hɛ mi kɛ tsiɔ zo.
Akɛnɛ hiɔmi nɛ́, nɛ zugba a gbli keketee he je ɔ, ngmɔ huli ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ́ haa a hɛ mi kɛ tsiɔ zo.
Odabɔ tete po fɔɔ nɛ e jeɔ e bi he ngɛ nga nɔ, ejakaa nga ko nga ko be lejɛ ɔ. Nga mi gbe ɔmɛ ya kuɔɔ yoku kpataa amɛ nɛ a hii kɔɔhiɔ mi fue kaa bɔ nɛ ogbeteehi peeɔ ɔ, hluu kɛ ya siɔ a hɛngmɛhi a nɔ peeɔ tsuu, ejakaa niye ní be a dɛ.
Ye ma a fa kue ha mi ke, ‘Yawɛ, wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ wɔ sie lɛɛ, se kɛ̃, moo piɛ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ. Wa tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã be babauu; wa pee yayami kɛ si mo.
Mo pɛ o nɔ Israel ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ; mo lɛ o jeɔ wɔ kɛ jeɔ amanehlu mi.
Mɛni he je o pee kaa nubwɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kaa blɔ nyɛɛlɔ nɛ gba ba to nubwɔ ligbi kake kɛkɛ?
Mɛni he je o pee kaa nyumu nɛ nɔ́ ko ti lɛ si tlukaa, loo katsɛ nɛ nyɛ we nɔ yi wami nɛ e he ɔ?
Yawɛ, niinɛ o kɛ wɔ ngɛ!
O ma ji wɔ; ko kua wɔ.’ ” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A suɔ kaa a maa je ye blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya kpa ngɛ he nɛ a suɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i sume mɛ.
Ma kai yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ, nɛ ma gbla a tue.” Yawɛ de mi ke, “Koo fa kue ha mi ke ma pee ma nɛ ɔ kpakpa.
Ke a ha hwɔ tete po, i be a kue fami ɔ tue bue; nɛ ke a sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ha mi hu, i be hee.
Se mohu ɔ, níhi nɛ i kɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi ji ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ!
Mo nitsɛ o le kaa gbali ɔmɛ deɔ ma a ke ta, loo hwɔ be bae, ejakaa o wo si veveeve kaa tue mi jɔmi pɛ lɛ maa hi zugba a nɔ.” Se Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Lakpa gbami gbali ɔmɛ ngɛ gbae ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ nɛ; i tsɔ we mɛ, i fa we mɛ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ tu we munyu ko hulɔ.
Ninahi nɛ a ngɛ a he munyu tue ɔ, pi ye ngɔ nɛ a je; klaami nɛ a ngɛ klaae ɔ, yakayaka níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a susu ji lɔ ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jamɛ a gbali ɔmɛ nɛ i tsɔ we mɛ, nɛ a kɛ ye biɛ ngɛ munyu tue, nɛ a ngɛ dee ke ta, loo hwɔ be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bae ɔ, bɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ngɛ a he ji, i kɛ ta, kɛ hwɔ ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a gba ní nɛ ɔmɛ ha a hu a hɛ mi ma kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.
A ma sake a gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɔ pue Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a be nɔ ko nɔ ko nae nɛ maa pu mɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ kɛ a yi ɔmɛ, a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Ma wo mɛ hiɔ ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a he.” Yawɛ fa mi ke ma de ma a ke, “Ye hɛngmɛ nɛ tɔ nyu nyɔ kɛ pia daa nɛ ɔ nɛ ma ko kpa ya fomi gblegbleegble.
Ejakaa a fia ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ní kɛ pue si nɛ a plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ke i je kpo kɛ ya nga nɔ ɔ, i naa nihi nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ta mi ngɔ pue si.
Ke i ya ma amɛ a mi hu i naa nihi nɛ hwɔ gbe mɛ ngɔ pue si.
Se gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ kpami kɛkɛ a hii kpae ngɛ zugba nɛ a li nɔ.” Ma a fa kue ha Yawɛ Yawɛ, anɛ o kua Yuda kulaa lo?
Anɛ o ngɛ Zion bi ɔmɛ hiee lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o plaa wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ e hi tsami ɔ?
Wa hyɛ blɔ kaa tue mi jɔmi maa ba, se nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi kɛ bɛ; wa hyɛ blɔ kaa be maa ba nɛ a ma tsa wɔ, se haomi kɛ gbeye sɔuu lɛ bɔle wɔ.
Yawɛ, wa ngɛ jajee ke wa pee yayami kɛ si mo, nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu pee yayami kɛ si mo.
Kai o siwo ɔmɛ, nɛ o ko kua wɔ.
Ko ha nɛ Yerusalem hɛ mi nɛ pue si.
Lejɛ ɔ o sɛ saminyayoo ɔ ngɛ.
Somi nɛ o kɛ wɔ so ɔ, koo po mi.
Je ma amɛ a we amaga amɛ ekoeko be nɛ ma ha nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ ha wɔ; hiɔwe tete po be nyɛe ma ha nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu, o nɔ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ, ejakaa mo lɛ o peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Haomi maa ba Yuda ma a nɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ke Mose kɛ Samuel ba da ye hɛ mi nɛ a fa kue ha mi tete po, i be nimli nɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ nae.
Fie mɛ kɛ je ye hɛ mi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a ho.
Ke a bi mo ke jije a maa ya a, de mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Nihi nɛ hiɔ maa gbe ɔ, ha nɛ hiɔ nɛ gbe mɛ!
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa nɔ ta a, ha nɛ a nɔ ta!
Nihi nɛ hwɔ maa gbe ɔ ha nɛ hwɔ nɛ gbe mɛ!
Ni nɛmɛ hu nɛ a maa nuu nyɔguɛ ɔ, ha nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho!
Imi Yawɛ, i to kaa haomihi nɛ a nya wa eywiɛ maa ba a nɔ; ni komɛ ma gbo ngɛ ta mi; gbehi ma tsɔtslɔɔ ni komɛ; lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye ni komɛ, nɛ ni komɛ lɛɛ pu mi lohwehi maa ye mɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Manase, Hezekia bi ɔ pee benɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Yerusalem he je ɔ, ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa ye gbeye.” Yawɛ ke, “Yerusalem bi, mɛnɔ maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ, aloo mɛnɔ maa ye nyɛ kɔmɔ?
Mɛnɔ ma gba nɛ e ba bi si ke kɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛɛ lo?
Nyɛ kua mi; nyɛ plɛ nyɛ se kɛ wo mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi hu i wo ye nine nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ i kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ i ngɔɔ nyɛ he kɛ kee nyɛ daa nɛ ɔ, pɔ ba tɔ mi jehanɛ.
I ngɔ nɔ́ mi sami nɔ́ kɛ sa nyɛ mi ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
I kpata nyɛ, ye ma a hɛ mi; i gbe nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa nyɛ kpa we nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ peemi.
I ha nɛ yalɔyihi a he hiɛ babauu ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ pe wo nya zia.
I gbe nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ a nihe mi, nɛ i ha nɛ a nyɛmɛ ɔmɛ na nɔ́.
I ha nɛ haomi nɛ nya wa, kɛ ní gbeyegbeyehi ba a nɔ tlukaa.
Bimɛ kpaago a nyɛ ɔ hɛli; nɔ́ nɔ e nɔ, ejakaa e bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a yi ta.
Piani be mi ɔ, lɛɛ e pu ɔ nɔ si momo, nɛ diblii kpatu wo; a pue e hɛ mi si, nɛ a bɔ lɛ ahlua.
Ma ha nɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa gbe nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yeremia ngɔ e nidɔ ní kɛ fɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi Akuanyɛ!
Imi nɔmlɔ ɔ, i be bua jɔmi ko bua jɔmi ko kulaa!
Mɛni he je ye nyɛ fɔ mi kɛ ba je nɛ ɔ mi kulaa?
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ mi ngɛ nya sãe, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ mi ngɛ pɛe ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
I pɛ sika ha we nɔ ko, nɛ i pɛ sika ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ hulɔ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ mi gbiɛe.
Yawɛ, ha nɛ a gbiɛ mi!
Anɛ i sɔmɔ we mo saminya lo?
Anɛ i fa we kue ha mo ngɛ ye he nyɛli nɛ ɔmɛ a he, benɛ a ngɛ haomi kɛ fimi mi lo?
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ku dade mi.
Omleyi je dade nɛ a kɛ akɔblee futu mi ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa ku?
Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yayami nɛ ye ma a pee ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ he je ɔ, ma ha nɛ he nyɛli ma ba ha a ní, kɛ a juetli kɛ je.
Ma ha nɛ a ma sɔmɔ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba ko nɛ a li nɔ; ejakaa ye mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ a slɛ, nɛ maa tso daa nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Yawɛ, o le kaa o he lɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ.
O le kaa o he lɛ a ngɛ mi jɛe ngɛ.
Kai mi nɛ o piɛ ye he.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ, gbla a tue ha mi.
Koo to o tsui si ha mɛ nɛ a ba ná ye he blɔ nɛ a gbe mi.
O kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ i nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o de mi ɔ fitsofitso.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu, o nɔ́ ji mi, nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o munyu ɔ ha nɛ i na bua jɔmi kɛ be nɔ.
I ya piɛ we nihi nɛ ngɛ mle yee ɔ a he; i kɛ mɛ muɛ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ nya we.
Se imi nɔ kake too i hi si kaa bɔ nɛ o fa mi ke ma pee ɔ; ejakaa o ha nɛ ye mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Mɛni he je i ngɛ nɔ́ nae kɛ mwɔɔ?
Mɛni he je ye pa amɛ be tsa ba a?
Mɛni he je a gbo we ɔ?
Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o sisi mi kaa pa nɛ gbli latsa be mi lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Ke o kpale kɛ ba a, i kɛ o blɔ he ɔ ma ha mo, nɛ o ma ba pee ye tsɔlɔ ekohu.
Ke o maa fiɛ fiɛmi kpakpa, nɛ o be munyu gu tue ɔ, lɛɛ o maa pee ye gbalɔ ekohu.
Ma a maa kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ, nɛ e be hiae kaa moo o ya a ngɔ.
Ma ha nɛ o maa pee kaa akɔblee gbogbo nɛ he wa ngɛ a hɛ mi; a kɛ mo maa hwu ta, se a be mo nyɛe.
I kɛ mo maa hi si; ma bu o he, nɛ ma he o yi wami.
Ma je mo kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yawɛ tsɔɔ Yeremia bɔ nɛ e hi si ha Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, “Koo ngɔ yo, nɛ ko fɔ binyumuhi loo biyihi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Bimɛ nɛ a fɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, kɛ a fɔli nɛ fɔ mɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Hiɔ yaya maa gbe mɛ.
Nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee ha mɛ, nɛ nɔ ko be mɛ pue hulɔ; a gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pee kaa kuku ngɛ zugba.
Ni komɛ maa nɔ ta, nɛ hwɔ hu maa gbe ni komɛ, nɛ a nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ ma plɛ pee niye ní ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi.
“We nɛ ya ngɛ mi ɔ, koo ya lejɛ ɔ. Ko ya ye kɔmɔ ha nɔ ko.
I be ye ma a tue mi jɔmi hae hu; ye suɔmi kɛ mɔbɔ nami ɔ hu se po.
Niatsɛmɛ, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsuo ma gbo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ; se nɔ ko be mɛ pue, nɛ nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee ha mɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be blɔ jee nɛ e maa plaa e he, loo e maa po huɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
Ke nɔ ko suɔlɔ gbo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ lɛ be ní yee, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ lɛ be ní nue kɛ wo lɛ bua.
Ke nɔ ko tsɛ, loo e nyɛ tete po gbo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee ha lɛ.
“We mi he nɛ a ngɛ ní yee nɛ a ngɛ ní nue hoo ngɛ ɔ, koo ya lejɛ ɔ. O kɛ mɛ ko ya hi si nɛ nyɛɛ ye ní nɛ nyɛɛ nu ní.
Bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ dee ji ma ha nɛ nyami, kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ ayɛflo he ní peemi hoo ɔ se maa po.
Nyɛ maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ paa kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ nyɛ wami be mi.
“Ke o ya de ma nɛ ɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, a ma bi mo ke mɛni he je lɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
A ma bi mo ke mɛni tɔmi a tɔ Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɔ, nɛ mɛni yayami po a pee kɛ si lɛ.
Ke a bi mo ja a, de mɛ ke, Yawɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je ye se nɛ a ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ.
A kua mi, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ hu a yi nɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nɔ́ pa pe nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ po.
Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ tue wa; nyɛ peeɔ yayami bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ, nɛ nyɛ bui mi fɛɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma fie nyɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ nyɛ, loo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ po li nɔ.
Nyɛ ma ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ i be nyɛ mɔbɔ nae.’ ” Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ maa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ nihi kɛ ye biɛ be kita kae hu kaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ jé Israel ma a kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Mohu ɔ, a kɛ ye biɛ ma ka kita kaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ kpale Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa a kɛ je omleyi je zugba kpahi a nɔ kɛ ba we ekohu.
Lejɛ ɔmɛ ji hehi nɛ i fie mɛ kɛ ho ɔ nɛ.
Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɛ i ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ le i de.” Tue gblami maa ba Yawɛ ke “Ma tsɔ hɛli babauu kɛ ba nɛ a ba hɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kaa a hɛɛ lo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma tsɔ de dali babauu kɛ ba nɛ a ba da mɛ kaa a daa lohwe de ngɛ yo tsuaa yo, kɛ yoku tsuaa yoku nɔ, kɛ tɛ puɔ tsuaa tɛ puɔ mi ngɛ tɛ sa amɛ a nɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, i ngɛ hyɛe.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ a ngɛ pee nɛ i nɛ; a ní yayami ɔmɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
Ma gbla a tue si enyɔ ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ a yi wu tso ní ɔmɛ a he.
A ngɔ amagahi nɛ ngɛ kaa ni gbogboehi nɛ wami ko be a mi ɔ kɛ ble ye zugba a; nɛ zugba a hyi tɔ kɛ a níhi nɛ a hiee ɔ.” Yeremia fa kue ha Yawɛ Yawɛ mo ji ye he bulɔ; mo lɛ o haa mi he wami.
Ke haomi ba ye nɔ hu, mo ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ ye he.
Je mahi maa je je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ kɛ ba o ngɔ, nɛ a ma ba de mo ke, “Gbosi ní nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ na pɛ ji lakpa mawuhi, kɛ amagahi nɛ se nami ko be a he.
Anɛ nɔmlɔ ma nyɛ maa pee mawuhi ha lɛ nitsɛ e he lo?
Dɛbi!
Ke e bɔ mɔde kaa mɛni po, mawu nitsɛnitsɛhi lɛɛ e be nyɛe maa pee.” Yawɛ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ maa na ye he wami kɛ ye kɔni si wami; a maa na kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Yuda he yayami kɛ e tue gblami Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ Yuda bi, nyɛ he yayami ɔ, dade ningma tso a kɛ ngma; a kɛ sika tɛ nya piɔpiɔ ngma ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ a kpɛ́ ngɛ nyɛ bɔ sami la tɛ koli ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ jaa amagahi, kɛ yo mawu Ashera amaga amɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ tso kusuu tsuaa tso kusuu sisi, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ kɛ yo ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Ma ha nɛ nihi ma ba ha nyɛ sika kɛ juetli, ngɛ yayamihi nɛ nyɛ pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo ɔ he.
Zugba a nɛ i ha nyɛ ɔ maa je nyɛ dɛ, nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ nyɛ he nyɛli ngɛ zugba nɛ nyɛ li nɔ.
Ejakaa ye mi mi nɛ fu ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ a slɛ nɛ maa hi tsoe daa.” Munyu slɔɔtohi Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ jeɔ ye se nɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ ya fɔɔ nɔmlɔ nɔ, nɛ e hyɛɛ yemi kɛ buami blɔ kɛ jee adesa dɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ!
E ngɛ kaa tso nɛ ba be yi mi ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ, tso nɛ ngɛ nga nɔ he nɛ gbli keketee, tso nɛ ngɛ ngo zɔ̃ zugba nɔ, he nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ ko puɛ́ ngɛ.
Nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nae gblegbleegble!
“Se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ imi Yawɛ ye nɔ ɔ, ma gbaa lɛ.
Jamɛatsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa tso nɛ a du ngɛ pa tue nɛ je sipoku kɛ wo nyu mi.
Ke sa pu ba a, e yi gbeye, ejakaa e ba amɛ hii mumumumu flɔflɔɔflɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Ke nyu hwɔ ba hu, e yi kɔmɔ, ejakaa e woɔ yiblii kɛ mwɔɔ.
“Mɛnɔ maa le nɔmlɔ adesa tsui mi?
E nɔ nɔ sisilɔ ko be ɔ, e hiɔ ɔ hu be tsa ba.
Imi Yawɛ, i hlaa nimli a juɛmi, nɛ i kaa a tsui.
I woɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ e ní peepee, kɛ e je mi babɛ he.” Nɔ nɛ náá ní ngɛ blɔ nɛ dɛ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa bebee nɛ ya bu hlui nɔ nɛ e pɛ bi, nɛ pohu pi lɛ nɛ ngmɛ hlui ɔ. E nihe mi ɔ, e dɛ mi ma ba ta; nɛ e nyagbe be mi ɔ, e ma ba pee kuasia.
Wa jami he klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ kaa matsɛ sɛ kɛ e hɛ mi nyami saminyayoo nɛ a wo nɔ gojoo kɛ je blema.
Yawɛ, Israel ma a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua mo ɔ, zo maa gbe lɛ.
A maa laa kaa biɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ zu mi, ejakaa a kua mo Yawɛ, mo wami nyu vu ɔ. Yeremia bi Yawɛ yemi kɛ buami Yawɛ, tsa mi, nɛ ye he mi nɛ wa mi kɛ pi si.
He mi, konɛ ye yi nɛ na wami, ejakaa mo pɛ o yi i jeɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ma a deɔ mi ji, “Yawɛ munyuhi nɛ o kɛ ngɛ wa he gbeye woe ɔ, ha nɛ a ba mi koo!” Se Yawɛ, mo nitsɛ o le faii kaa tsa pi imi nɛ i nyɛ o nɔ ke o ha nɛ haomi nɛ ba ma nɛ ɔ nɔ.
O le kaa pi imi nɛ i to kaa amanehlu be ko nɛ ba.
Nɔ́ nɛ je ye nya nɛ i de ɔ, mo nitsɛ o le.
Yawɛ, koo wo ye he gbeye; mo pɛ ji ye wesa he ngɛ amanehlu be mi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ, ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ; se imi lɛɛ ha nɛ ma ye ye he.
Ha nɛ sawale nɛ nu mɛ, se imi lɛɛ koo wo ye he gbeye.
Ngɔɔ haomi kɛ ba a nɔ, nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ yemi Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yeremia, ngɔɔ ye sɛ gbi ɔ kɛ ya Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.
Jee sisi kɛ je ma agbo ɔ nya; lejɛ ɔ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ guɔ kɛ baa ma a mi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a guɔ kɛ jeɔ kpo.
De Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ guɔ kikɛmɛ a agbo nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ke a bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
De mɛ ke, ke a suɔ nɛ a yi nɛ na wami ɔ, lɛɛ a ko tloo tlomi ko Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ; a ko tloo nɔ́ ko kɛ gu Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba ma a mi.
Jehanɛ se hu, a ko tloo nɔ́ ko kɛ je a we ɔmɛ a mi kɛ je kpo Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ a ko tsu nɔ́ ko hulɔ.
Se mohu ɔ, a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa ligbi klɔuklɔu kaa bɔ nɛ i wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ mlaa ke a pee ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ i de mɛ ɔ, a bui tue fɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ i ke a pee ɔ hu, a pee we.
A wa tue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ, nɛ a ba kase ní.
“De nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ke a ye imi Yawɛ, ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ.
A ko tloo tlomi ko kɛ gu agbo ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.
A ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa ligbi klɔuklɔu, nɛ a ko tsu nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Ke a pee ja a, matsɛmɛ, kɛ ganɔhi maa gu Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba nɛ a ma ba hi David matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
A kɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa hi ta zugba lɛhi a mi, kɛ okpɔngɔhi a nɔ.
Nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, Yerusalem ma a ma hyi tɔ kɛ nimli.
Nihi maa je Yuda ma amɛ, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ a mi kɛ ba; a maa je Benyamin zugba a nɔ, nga nɔ, yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ Yuda leneyi je.
A maa hɛɛ sami bɔhi, niye ní bɔhi, sina bɔhi, bɔ kpahi, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ba imi Yawɛ, ye we ɔ.
Se e sa kaa a bu mi nɛ a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa ligbi klɔuklɔu.
A ko tloo tlomi ko kɛ gu Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a mi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ; ke a pee ja a, ma mɛ Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a he la.
La a maa sã Yerusalem mɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa gbe.”
Yeremia ngɛ buɛ sɔlɔ ɔ we mi Yawɛ de mi ke, “Tee si, nɛ o ya buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ we mi, nɛ ma ha mo ye sɛ gbi ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya, nɛ i ya na lɛ ngɛ buɛ puɛmi tɛ ɔ se nɛ e ngɛ ní tsue.
Se buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ na kaa buɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ puɛe ɔ pee we kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale futu zu ɔ nɛ e kɛ puɛ nɔ́ kpa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nyɛ Israel ma, anɛ i be he blɔ kaa i peeɔ nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ pee zu nɛ ɔ lo?
Bɔ nɛ zu ngɛ ngɛ buɛ puɛlɔ dɛ mi ɔ, ja pɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Be tsuaa be nɛ ma de ke ma kpata je ma, loo nɔ yemi ko hɛ mi kulaa, nɛ jamɛ a je ma a ma kpa a ní yayami ɔmɛ peemi ɔ, imi hu ma kpale ye nya se; yayami nɛ i to ke ma pee mɛ ɔ, i be pee hu.
Jã kɛ̃, ke i de ke ma pee je ma, loo nɔ yemi ko agbo, se jamɛ a je ma a ya bui mi tue, nɛ a pee yayami kɛ si mi ɔ, ma kpale ye nya se; kpakpa nɛ i to ke ma pee mɛ ɔ, i be pee hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke, i ngɛ a yi nɔ soe, nɛ ma gbla a tue.
De mɛ ke a jɔɔ yayami peemi, nɛ a dla a blɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
Ke o de mɛ ja a, a ma he nɔ ke, ‘Dɛbi!
Nɔ́ nɛ wa tsui suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa maa pee.
Wa maa wa tue, nɛ wa maa pee yayami bɔ nɛ wa suɔ.’ ” Ma a kua Yawɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ bi je ma amɛ tsuo kaa nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba hyɛ lo.
Israel ma a pee nɔ́ ko nɛ he wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ!
Lebanon tɛ sa yo ɔmɛ ɔ, anɛ snoo ta a nɔ hyɛ lo?
Nyu jɔjɔɛ ɔ nɛ jeɔ yo ɔmɛ a mi babaaba pueɔ si ɔ, anɛ e se po hyɛ lo?
Se ye ma a lɛɛ, a hɛ je ye nɔ; a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa amagahi.
A je blema blɔ kpakpa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ya ngɛ lakpa blɔhi a nɔ nyɛɛe.
A nyɛɛ we gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu; nane blɔhi a nɔ mohu lɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.
A ha nɛ a zugba a pee gbeyegbeye kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa hie daa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e he mi maa po, nɛ e ma mimiɛ e yi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ bunyuku ɔ, jã pɛ ma gbɛ ye ma a ngɔ fĩa ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ke haomi ba a nɔ ɔ, ma plɛ ye se ngɔ wo mɛ; i be yee kɛ bua mɛ.” A so Yeremia yi nɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa to Yeremia he ga. Daa nɛ ɔ, wa ma na osɔfohi nɛ maa tsɔɔ wɔ ní.
Wa ma na ní leli nɛ maa wo wɔ ga, kɛ gbali nɛ ma ha wɔ Mawu sɛ gbi.
Ke wa to ga nɛ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ nɛ ma ha nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se maa po.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa po sane ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ waa jɔɔ e munyu ɔmɛ tue bumi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu mi tue, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ ye he ɔ, o nu.
Anɛ e sa kaa a kɛ yayami nɛ to kpakpa nane mi lo?
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a tsua muɔ ha mi nɛ ma nɔ mi.
Kai kaa i ba o ngɔ nɛ i ba tu a he munyu kpakpa ha mo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o kɛ mɛ ko ye ngɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ nya.
Se Yawɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ, ha nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbo kɛ hwɔ; ha nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ta mi.
Ha nɛ nyɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee yalɔyihi kɛ yosahi; ha nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ gbe tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nihewi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ta nga nɔ.
Ha nɛ ta nɛ ba tua mɛ tlukaa, nɛ bubuubui nɛ pɛ ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi.
A tsua muɔ ngɔ fɔ si ha mi nɛ ma nɔ mi, nɛ a tsɔ mi klama nɛ ma du.
Se mo Yawɛ!
Gahi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ toe kɛ ngɛ ye he woe konɛ a kɛ gbe mi ɔ, o le.
Koo ngɔ a he kɛ ke mɛ, nɛ ko je o hɛ ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Ha nɛ a nɔɔ si ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ ye, be mi nɛ o mi mi fu.”
Buɛ nɛ ywia a Yawɛ de mi ke ma ya he buɛ nɛ a kɛ zu puɛ.
E de mi hu ke ma ngɔ ma a mi nikɔtɔma komɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ wa ya gu buɛ sɔli agbo ɔ mi kɛ ya Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ma ha mi ɔ, ma ya fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yawɛ ke ma de ke, “Yuda matsɛmɛ, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
I kɛ haomi nɛ nya wa maa ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu he ɔ, e he mi maa po.
Ma pee kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa ma a kua mi, nɛ a sã bɔhi kɛ ha mawu kpahi, nɛ a kɛ ble hiɛ ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a mawu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ jio, a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ jio, Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ jio, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ja we hyɛ.
A pue nihi babauu nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko a muɔ si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma bɔ sami la tɛhi kɛ ha Baal, konɛ a kɛ a bimɛ nɛ sã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ.
I wui mɛ mlaa ke a pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ; e bɛ ye juɛmi mi hyɛ po.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be ma nɛ a be hiɛ ɔ tsɛe ke Tofet, loo Hinom kɔ̃ mi hu.
Mohu ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ ma tsɛ lɛ ji kɔ̃ nɛ a pueɔ muɔ si ngɛ mi.
Ma ha nɛ yi mi nɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ to ɔ maa pee yaka ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Ma ha a he nyɛli maa ye a nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ a maa gbe mɛ; nɛ ma ngɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi nɛ a ye.
Ma ha nɛ Yerusalem ma nɛ ɔ maa pee ma doku, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a hiee; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e he mi maa po, nɛ e maa ye gbeye ngɛ amanehluhi nɛ maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ he.
Ma ha nɛ he nyɛli ma ba sa ma a yi, nɛ a maa hao ma mi bi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, hluu kɛ yaa si ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ ma bɔni mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, kɛ a bimɛ nyumuhi kɛ yihi yemi.” Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma ywia buɛ ɔ ngɛ nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ a hɛ mi, nɛ ma de mɛ ke, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ zu buɛ nɛ ɔ ywia tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ kɛ pueɔ si nɛ e be hie dlami ɔ, ja pɛ ma pee ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ.
Ma kpata ma a, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ni gbogboe ɔmɛ po ja a ya pu mɛ ngɛ Tofet; ejakaa a be blɔ nae ngɛ he kpa ko kɛ pu mɛ.
I ngɛ ye he kita kae kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Tofet ɔ, ja pɛ ma pee ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ.
Ma ble wehi tsuo ngɛ Yerusalem kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Tofet ɔ. Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a mɔhi, kɛ tsu kpahi nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a yi mi kɛ haa dodoehi, nɛ a sãã wai bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ haa mawu kpahi ɔ, ma ble mɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i je Tofet, he nɛ Yawɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ya fiɛ e munyu ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ́ i je lejɛ ɔ, i ba da si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kue ɔ mi, nɛ i de ma a tsuo ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Kaa bɔ nɛ i de to ɔ, i kɛ haomi nɛ nya wa maa ba ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ mahi tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ tue wa, nɛ nyɛ nui ye munyu ɔmɛ.’ ”
Yeremia kɛ osɔfo Pashur pɛ Osɔfo Pashur, Imer bi ɔ, nɛ ji tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ hyɛɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ nu fiɛmi nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Pashur ha nɛ a fia mi ní, nɛ a bɔ mi pã ngɛ Benyamin agbo ɔ yiti je ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi.
E nɔ jena mɔtu, benɛ Pashur je mi ngɛ pã a mi ɔ, i de lɛ ke, “Pi Pashur nɛ Yawɛ wo mo!
Biɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha mo ji Magormisabib.
Yawɛ nitsɛ ke, ‘Ma ha o ma plɛ pee bubui ha mo nitsɛ o he, kɛ o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
He nyɛli maa gbe o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si kɛ klaate, nɛ o maa na paa kɛ o hɛngmɛ.
Ma ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ; e maa nuu ni komɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho e ma mi ya, nɛ e ma ya gbe mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma ha nɛ he nyɛli maa ha a níhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ ma a mi: níhi nɛ a gbo dengme kɛ na, weto ní kpakpahi, kɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a juetli; nɛ a maa muɔ kɛ ya Babilonia.
Nɛ mo Pashur!
A maa nuu mo hu o kɛ o we mi bimɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ kɛ ya Babilonia.
Lejɛ ɔ o ma ya gbo ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a maa pu mo, kɛ o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o gba lakpa gbami ha mɛ ɔ ngɛ.’ ” Yeremia kɛ Yawɛ na Yawɛ, o sisi mi pɛ nɛ ye yi mi plɛ.
O he wa pe mi nɛ o ye ye nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ ye he fɛu yee; daa ligbi ɔ, muɔ kɛkɛ a ngɛ mi muɔe.
Daa nɛ ɔ, munyuhi nɛ maa je ye nya a, haomi kɛ yi wu tso níhi a he e kɔɔ.
Yawɛ, daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe, nɛ a ngɛ ye he fɛu yee ngɛ o munyu ɔ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he.
Se ke i de ke, “I be Yawɛ biɛ ta woe hu, nɛ i be fiɛe ngɛ e biɛ mi hu” ɔ, o sɛ gbi ɔ peeɔ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ ye tsui mi, kɛ ye wuhi a mi.
I bɔɔ mɔde saminya kaa ma tsi nya, se jehanɛ lɛɛ, i pa nyɛ we hu.
I nuɔ nɛ nihi babauu tuɔ munyu ngɛ a kuɔ si, nɛ a kɛ woɔ ye he gbeye.
A deɔ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ wa ya po e nya ha nɔ yeli ɔmɛ!” Ye huɛmɛ kpakpahi tete po hii blɔ hyɛe kaa ye nane ma kpata lo.
A deɔ ke, “Alini e maa du klama, kɛkɛ ɔ, wa nine maa su e nɔ nɛ wa maa ye wa he lue.” Se mo Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ o ngɛ ye se kpɛii kaa tatsɛ kpanaa; ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ be mi nyɛe.
Zo maa gbe mɛ daa, ejakaa a be nyɛe maa pee nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
A zo ɔ hu nɔ ko hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
Se mo, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ!
Moo lɛɛ o hyɛɛ nimli a tsui mi kɛ a juɛmi mi; o le nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
I tu ye sane ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbla ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue ha mi nɛ ma na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
Nyɛ la ha Yawɛ!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Ejakaa e jeɔ nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ kɛ jeɔ yayami peeli a dɛ mi.
Á gbiɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ!
Ligbi ɔ nɛ maa fɔ mi ɔ, a ko gbaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!
Nyumu ɔ nɛ ba bɔ tsaatsɛ amaniɛ ke, “A fɔ binyumuyo ha mo”, nɛ tsaatsɛ bua jɔ e he ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ!
Ha nɛ jamɛ a nyumu ɔ nɛ pee kaa jamɛ a ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ kpata a hɛ mi nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko be mi ɔ pɛ.
Mɔtu ɔ, ha nɛ bubuubui nɛ pɛ kɛ wo lɛ; piani lɛɛ e nu nɛ a he ose ngɛ ta mi, ejakaa e gbi mi ngɛ maa mi mi.
Kaa e pee ja, jinɛ maa mi mi ɔ pee ye yɔkɔ.
Mɛni he je a fɔ mi kulaa?
Pe a fɔ mi nɛ ma ba na nɔ́, nɛ ma hao, nɛ zo nɛ gbe mi ye wami ligbi tsuo lo?
A gba kɛ to ke a maa ye Yerusalem nɔ kunimi Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia tsɔ Pashur, Malkia binyumu ɔ, kɛ osɔfo Zefania, Maaseya binyumu ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ke, “Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba tua wɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bi Yawɛ ga womi ha wɔ kaa alini Yawɛ ma tsu nyakpɛ ni ha wɔ, nɛ e ma ha nɛ Nebukadnezar maa kpale e se lo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ i de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke a ya de Zedekia ke, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ, de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Kaldea bi nɛ ba sa nyɛ ma a yi, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ, ma ha nɛ nyɛ ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ ɔ maa pee yaka ngɛ a hɛ mi.
Ma bua nya kɛ ba pue ma nɛ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu.
Imi nitsɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hwu kɛ ye he wami tsuo, kɛ mi mi la nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi; hiɔ nɛ nya wa maa gbe nimli, kɛ lohwehi tsuo.
Se mo, Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia!
Mo, kɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a yi ma na wami ngɛ ta, kɛ hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar, kɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ a dɛ mi.
Nebukadnezar ma kpata nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.
E be nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he ngmɛɛe, nɛ e be nɔ ko nɔ ko mɔbɔ nae.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue!
I kɛ nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe nɛ nyɛɛ hla kake, blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi, kɛ blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hi ma nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e yi maa ta; ta, loo hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe lɛ.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je ma a mi kɛ ya Babilonia bi nɛ ba sa ma a yi ɔ a ngɔ, nɛ e ma ya nu a nane ɔ, e yi ma na wami; nɛ e maa ya we mi hɛ ngmengmle.
I pee ye juɛmi kaa ja i kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi kokooko; i be nyɛ mɔbɔ nae.
Ma ngɔ ma a kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ e maa mɛ he la.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” A maa gbla Yuda matsɛ we ɔ tue -Yawɛ de mi ke ma ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Yuda matsɛ we ɔ nɛ ji David nina a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
Nyɛɛ ye dami sane daa ligbi.
Nyɛ je nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ amimi yee ɔ kɛ je amimi yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi.
Ke nyɛ pee we ja a, yayami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ ma ha nɛ ye mi mi maa wo la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hie peemi ngɛ he.
Mo Yerusalem, o maa si piɔpiɔɔpiɔ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi kaa tɛ sa ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ.
Se i kɛ mo maa to ní.
O deɔ ke nɔ ko be nyɛe ma ba tua mo, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa sɛ o mɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Se imi lɛɛ ma gbla o tue ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he.
Ma mɛ o matsɛ we ɔ he la, nɛ la a maa sa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ bɔle si.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yeremia sɛ gbi kɛ ha Yuda matsɛ we ɔ -Yawɛ de mi ke ma ya Yuda matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ ma ya de Yuda matsɛ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ David sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a nɛ guu agbo nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Imi Yawɛ, i wo nyɛ mlaa ke nyɛɛ ye dami sane, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
Nyɛ je nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ amimi yee ɔ kɛ je amimi yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi.
Nyɛ ko wa nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi yi mi; nɛ nyɛ ko pue nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ɔ muɔ si ngɛ he klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ maa ye mlaa nɛ i wo nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ David nina maa ye matsɛ daa.
Nɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, a tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a maa hi ta zugba lɛhi a mi, kɛ okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ be ngɛ matsɛ we agbo nɛ ɔmɛ a mi daa.
Se ke nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ lɛɛ i ngɛ ye he kita kae kaa ja matsɛ we nɛ ɔ pee we doku kokooko.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ ” “Yuda matsɛ we ɔ ngɛ fɛu ngɛ ye hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Gilead zugba a, loo Lebanon yo ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha lejɛ ɔ maa pee we doku nɛ nɔ ko be mi.
Ma tsɔ nihi nɛ a ma ya puɛ lejɛ ɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa hɛɛ gbiɛ.
A maa poo seda titima kpakpa amɛ, nɛ a ma sake kɛ wo la mi.
“Pee se ɔ, je mahi babauu ma ba gu lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma bi a sibi ke mɛni he je nɛ imi Yawɛ, i pee ma ngua nɛ ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma he nɔ ke i ye nyɛ sane nɛ ɔ, ejakaa somi nɛ imi, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, nyɛ yi nɔ; nyɛ ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi mohu a se, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ.” Yeremia sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Yoahaz he Yuda ma, nyɛ ko fo ya ha Matsɛ Yosia; nyɛ ko ye e gbenɔ ɔ he kɔmɔ.
Nyɛɛ wo yana kɛ ha e binyumu Yoahaz mohu; ejakaa nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, e be kpalee kɛ ba hu gblegbleegble; zugba nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, e be nae hu.
Yosia binyumu Yoahaz nɛ ba ye e tsɛ se kaa Yuda matsɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nɛ a kɛ lɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, e be kpalee kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hu gblegbleegble.
He nɛ a nu lɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ɔ, lejɛ ɔ e ma ya gbo ngɛ; zugba nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e be nae hu gblegbleegble.” Yeremia sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Yehoyakim he Nɔmlɔ nɛ guu blɔ nɛ dɛ nɔ nɛ e kɛ poo we, nɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ sisimi maa mɔ, nɔ nɛ haa nɛ e nyɛmi sɔmɔɔ lɛ yaka nɛ e wui lɛ hiɔ ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!
Nɔmlɔ nɛ deɔ ke, “Ma ma mɔ nguaa kɛ e mi hiɔwe tsu agboagbohi”; kɛkɛ nɛ e jeɔ saflɛhi ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e kaa seda tso kɛ woɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e saa we ɔ he tsopa tsu saminyayoo ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!
Ke o ngɔ seda kɛ po we saminyayoo nɛ ngɛ fɛu pe ni kpahi a wehi ɔ, anɛ lɔ ɔ peeɔ mo matsɛ slɔɔto ko lo?
O tsɛ hi si saminya, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hi ha lɛ; e ye je mi ngɔɔmi nɛ e fiɛ e yi nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Ejakaa e ye dami sane ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
E ye ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nɔ́ nali a sane ha mɛ, nɛ e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ya nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Anɛ pi enɛ ɔ peemi ji Yawɛ lemi lo?
Se moo lɛɛ o susumi pɛ ji bɔ nɛ o maa pee kɛ sisi nihi nɛ o kpɔ a níhi yaka.
O pueɔ nihi nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko a muɔ si; o yeɔ o ma a amimi, nɛ o waa mɛ yi mi.
Yawɛ lɛ de.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim, Yosia binyumu ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke e gbo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee ha lɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be dee ke, ‘Ye nyɛmi due!
Due!’ Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ya foe ha lɛ ke, ‘Ye nyɔmtsɛ!
Ye matsɛ!’ A maa pu lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a puɔ teji; a maa gbla lɛ kɛ ho, nɛ a ma ya sake lɛ kɛ fɔ Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a se.” Yeremia sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Yerusalem he Yerusalem ma, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya kpa bubuubui ngɛ Lebanon.
Nyɛɛ ya Bashan nɛ nyɛ ya kpa bubuubui ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ya kpa kuu ngɛ Moab yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, ejakaa a kpata nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Benɛ nyɛ ná nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu, se nyɛ kua lɛ tue bumi.
Kɛ je nyɛ nihe mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ji kaa nyɛ bui Yawɛ tue.
Kɔɔhiɔ maa muɔɔ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho; a maa nuu nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ; a maa bɔ nyɛ ma amɛ ahlua ngɛ ní yayamihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ a he.
Nyɛ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi si himi mi ngɛ seda tsohi nɛ a kɛ je Lebanon kɛ ba a a mi.
Se kɛ̃, haomi kɛ he hiami maa ba nyɛ nɔ kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi; nyɛ ní maa pee mɔbɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Mawu maa gbla Yehoyakin tue Yawɛ de Matsɛ Yehoyakin, Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim bi ɔ ke, “Ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ke mo ji womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ngɛ ye hiɔ nine nguɛ he po, ma je mo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ma ngɔ mo kɛ wo nihi nɛ o ngɛ gbeye yee, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mo hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ a dɛ mi.
Ma ngɔ mo kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar, kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Ma ha nɛ a maa nuu o kɛ o nyɛ nɛ fɔ mo ɔ nyɔguɛ kɛ ya ma ko mi nɛ pi lejɛ ɔ nɛ a fɔ nyɛ ngɛ.
Nɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ma ya gbo ngɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ ma ya ja ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa suɔ kaa nyɛɛ na zugba nɛ ɔ ekohu; se nyɛ be kpalee kɛ ba hu gblegbleegble.” I bi ke, “Anɛ Matsɛ Yehoyakin ba pee kaa buɛ nɛ ywia nɛ a sake ngɔ fɔ he nɛ nɔ ko sume hu lo?
Anɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ a nuu lɛ kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ho zugba nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li ɔ nɔ ya lo?” Zugba lee, zugba!
Bu Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue!
“A gbiɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ gbidigbidi, e be bimɛ nae kɔkɔɔkɔ; e be nɔ yae gblegbleegble e wami be ɔ tsuo.
E be nina nae nɛ ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ David se, ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha hwɔɔ se Ma nɔ yeli nɛ kpataa Yawɛ ma a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩaa a, musu tloo mɛ!
Ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ nɛ sa kaa a hyɛ ma a nɔ saminya a, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ dee ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ hyɛ we ye ma a nɔ fɛɛ!
Nyɛ gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa, nɛ nyɛ fie mɛ kɛ ho.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ nyɛ ní peemi ní yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Ye ma nɛ piɛ ɔ, ma bua a nya kɛ maa je zugbahi a nɔ hehi nɛ i fie mɛ kɛ ho ɔ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ekohu.
A ma fɔ, nɛ a he maa hiɛ babauu.
Ma je nɔ yeli kpakpahi ha mɛ nɛ a hyɛ a nɔ.
A be gbeye yee hu; sawale be mɛ nue hu, nɛ i be a tue gblae hu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ ma hla dalɔ ko kɛ je David nina a a kpɛti nɛ e ba ye matsɛ.
Matsɛ nɛ ɔ maa ye dami sane, nɛ e maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
E yi nɔ ɔ, a ma he Yuda yi wami, nɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba Israel.
A ma tsɛ lɛ ke ‘Yawɛ ji wa yi wami hemi.’ ” Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ nihi be kita kae ngɛ ye biɛ mi hu kaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ jé Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ. Mohu ɔ, a kɛ ye biɛ ma ka kita kaa Mawu hɛ kalɔ nɛ jé Israel nina a kɛ je ma se zugbahi a nɔ, omleyi je zugba a, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ i fie mɛ kɛ ho ɔ kɛ ba.
Nɛ a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ.” Yeremia sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ gbali ɔmɛ a he I hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli.
Yawɛ kɛ e munyu klɔuklɔu ɔ a he je ɔ, i pee kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã, loo nɔ nɛ nu dã pe nine.
Zugba a nɔ hyi tɔ kɛ nimli nɛ yi Yawɛ anɔkuale.
A peeɔ yayami, nɛ a kɛ a he wami tsu we nɔ́ kpakpa.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu gbiɛ zugba a; zugba a bɛ ní hu, nɛ e nɔ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Yawɛ ke, “Gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo li Mawu; nimli yayamihi ji mɛ.
I naa mɛ nɛ a ngɛ yayami pee ngɛ ye we ɔ mi tete po.
Blɔhi nɛ a ngɛ nɔ nyɛɛe ɔ, blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ maa sla, nɛ a maa wo diblii; ma ha nɛ a ma tɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa nɔɔ si.
I kɛ haomi maa ba a nɔ; a tue gblami be ɔ su ta.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
I na Samaria gbali ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔ; a gba ngɛ Baal biɛ mi, nɛ a ha nɛ ye ma, Israel nane kpata.
Se i na kaa Yerusalem gbali ɔmɛ po pe mɛ kɛ yayami peemi; a puɛɔ gba, nɛ a yeɔ lakpa; a ya piɛɔ nihi a he nɛ a kɛ peeɔ yayami; nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nɔ ko kpa we yayami peemi.
Ngɛ imi ye hɛ mi ɔ, nimli yayamihi ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora bi.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ i ngɛ dee ngɛ Yerusalem gbali ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ma ha mɛ agba nɛ a maa ye kaa niye ní, nɛ i kɛ duɔ maa wo nyu mi ha mɛ nɛ a nu.
Ejakaa mɛ Yerusalem gbali ɔmɛ a he je nɛ ní yayamihi gbɛ fĩa zugba a nɔ tsuo.’ ” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko bu munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɛ tue ɔ tue; sisimi a ngɛ nyɛ sisie ɔ nɛ.
Ninahi nɛ a jeɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi mi e je; pi imi Yawɛ ye nya mi munyuhi ji lɔ ɔmɛ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a deɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume nɛ a buɔ ye munyu ɔ tue ji, ‘Nyɛ ko ye tsui tete!
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hi.’ Tue wali ɔmɛ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ a deɔ mɛ ji, ‘Haomi ko haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ bae fɛɛ.’ ” I de ke, “Gbali nɛ ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ yi mi?
A ti mɛnɔ nu Yawɛ sɛ gbi hyɛ, nɛ e ma de pohu ke e nu sisi?
Aloo a ti mɛnɔ bu e munyu ɔ tue hyɛ, nɛ e pee kaa bɔ nɛ munyu ɔ tsɔɔ kaa a pee ɔ?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ!
Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ kaa ahumi.
E ngɛ kaa lasiogblee nɛ maa fia vuguvugu kɛ bɔle yayami peeli a yi he.
Yawɛ mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e to ke e maa pee ɔ kɛ gbe nya.
Be komɛ a se loko e ma a maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi saminya.” Yawɛ ke, “I tsɔ we gbali nɛ ɔmɛ, se kɛ̃ a he sɔ kɛ ya fiɛ.
I ha we mɛ sɛ gbi ko, se kɛ̃ a gba ngɛ ye biɛ mi.
A le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ye yi mi jinɛ a ko fiɛ ha ye ma a. Ke a pee ja a, ye ma a maa je a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ hu a ma kpa peemi.
“Anɛ ke i ngɛ nyɛ kasa nya pɛ loko Mawu ji mi?
Ke i ngɛ se lokoo ɔ lɛɛ pi Mawu ji mi lo?
Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa laa e he ngɛ he ko nɛ i be lɛ nae lo?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa i ngɛ he tsuaa he lo?
I ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba tsuo.
Munyuhi nɛ lakpa gbali ɔmɛ tuɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, i nu lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A deɔ ke imi lɛ i ha mɛ sɛ gbi ngɛ nlami mi.
Mɛni be gbali nɛ ɔmɛ maa ye lakpa kɛ yaa si?
A deɔ níhi nɛ be mi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ ye ma a. Nlamihi nɛ a sɛɛɔ kɛ haa a sibi ɔ, a susuɔ kaa lɔ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ ye ma a hɛ maa je ye nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ je ye nɔ nɛ a ya sɔmɔ Baal ɔ. Ke gbalɔ ko nla a, e sɛɛ e nlami ɔ.
Se ke nɔ ko ná sɛ gbi kɛ je ye ngɔ ɔ, e fiɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mi.
Jakati kɛ ngma a, mɛni bɔmi lɛ ngɛ a kpɛti?
Ye sɛ gbi ɔ, anɛ e be kaa la lo?
Anɛ e be kaa hamle nɛ ywiaa tɛ sa wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbali nɛ juɔ ye sɛ gbi kɛ jeɔ a sibi a dɛ nɛ a fiɛɛ ɔ, i kɛ mɛ ná.
Jehanɛ, gbali nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a munyu lɛ a tuɔ, se kɛ̃ a deɔ ke imi ye ngɔ lɛ a naa sɛ gbi ɔ kɛ jee ɔ, mɛ hu i kɛ mɛ ná.
Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ tue!
Gbali nɛ sɛɛɔ lakpa nlami ɔ, i kɛ mɛ ná.
A sɛɛɔ kikɛmɛ a nlami nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ lakpa yemi, kɛ fiami kpataa ye ma a nane.
I tsɔ we mɛ, nɛ i fa we mɛ ke a ya tsu nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ; a he be se nami ko kulaa kɛ ha ma a. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ tlomi Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yeremia, ke ji nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko, aloo gbalɔ ko, aloo osɔfo ko bi mo ke, ‘Mɛni ji Yawɛ sɛ gbi?’ ɔ, de lɛ ke, ‘Mo ji tlomi nɛ Yawɛ tloo ɔ nɛ, nɛ e ma sake mo kɛ fɔ he.’ Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko, aloo gbalɔ ko, aloo osɔfo ko li peemi nɛ e de ke ‘Yawɛ tlomi’ ɔ, ma gbla e kɛ e we mi bimɛ a tue.
Nɔ́ nɛ mohu nɛ sa kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bi e nyɛmi, loo e huɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mɛni heto lɛ Yawɛ ha?
Kɛ Yawɛ de kɛɛ?’ Se ‘Yawɛ tlomi’ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ ko wo nɔ ta; nɔ tsuaa nɔ munyu maa pee nɔ ɔ nitsɛ tlomi.
Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, wa Mawu ɔ munyu ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsake a hɛ mi.
Yeremia, bi gbali ɔmɛ ke, ‘Mɛni heto lɛ Yawɛ ha?
Kɛ Yawɛ de kɛɛ?’ Ke a ya yi ye mlaa a nɔ nɛ a de ke ‘Yawɛ tlomi’ ɔ, lɛɛ de mɛ ke, ma wo a nɔ, nɛ ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ he ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo, mɛ, kɛ ma a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha a kɛ a nɛmɛ.
Ma bɔ mɛ ahlua, nɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si kɛ ya neneene.
Nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ be nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ jee gblegbleegble.”
Kusii enyɔ kɛ a mi ngmɔkɔ Yawɛ je nina ko ngɔ tsɔɔ mi be ko.
I na kusii enyɔ kɛ a mi ngmɔkɔ nɛ maa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar nuu nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya momo: Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin, Yehoyakim bi ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli, ga ní tsuli, kɛ sɔli.
Ngmɔkɔ kpakpahi ngɛ kekleekle kusii ɔ mi; a ngɛ kaa ngmɔkɔhi nɛ fuu kɛ sɛɛ hlami ɔ. Kusii enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ ngmɔkɔ yayahi nɛ hí yemi lɛ ngɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi mi ke, “Yeremia, mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “I na ngmɔkɔhi.
Ngmɔkɔ kpakpa amɛ hi saminya.
Ngmɔkɔ yaya amɛ lɛɛ a hí kulaa; e sɛ nɛ a yeɔ.” Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i buu ni ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho Babilonia ya a nimli kpakpahi saminya kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔkɔ kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma hyɛ a nɔ saminya.
Ma bu a he, nɛ ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.
I be hae nɛ a na nɔ, se mohu ma piɛ a he.
I be a hɛ mi kpatae, se mohu ma to mɛ si kaa bɔ nɛ a duɔ tso ɔ. Ma ha nɛ a maa nu he ngɛ a tsui mi tɔɔ kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
A maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu; ejakaa a maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu kɛ a tsui tsuo.
“Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ nɛ a nuu we mɛ kɛ yɛ Babilonia a, bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngmɔkɔ nɛ sa nɛ hí yemi ɔ, jã pɛ imi, Yawɛ ma pee mɛ.
Mɛ ji Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ho Egipt ya a. Ma ngɔ haomi nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ba a nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa nu sawale.
A maa ye a he fɛu, a maa bɔ mɛ ahlua, nɛ a maa wo mɛ la ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ ma fie mɛ kɛ ya a. Ma ha nɛ ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ma ba sɛ a kpɛti kɛ yaa si a ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po be piɛe ngɛ zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha a kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔ nɔ.”
He nyɛli nɛ je omleyi je ɔ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim, Yosia bi ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i ná sɛ gbi ko kɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yuda ma a tsuo he.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar hu na jeha kake ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ.
I de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Kɛ je be nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yosia, Amon bi ɔ na jeha nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ hluu kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, be tsuaa be ɔ, i naa sɛ gbi kɛ jeɔ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ haa nyɛ.
I deɔ nyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ fitsofitso; se nyɛ bui tue.
Daa nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔɔ e tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ.
Se nyɛ bui mɛ tue, nɛ sɛ gbi nɛ a kɛ ba a hu nyɛ bui.
A de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, konɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ blema kaa nyɛ weto ní ɔ, nyɛɛ hi nɔ daa.
A de nyɛ ekohu ke nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se; nyɛ ko sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko ja mɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, nyɛ ko puɛ amagahi nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba wo Yawɛ mi mi la.
E ji nyɛ bu Yawɛ tue jinɛ lɛ hu e ko gbla we nyɛ tue.
Se Yawɛ nitsɛ de ke nyɛ bui lɛ tue fɛɛ.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ we amaga amɛ wo e mi mi la, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he awi.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ nyɛ bui Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tue he je ɔ, bɔ nɛ lɛ hu e ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ma tsɔ nɛ a ya kpee omleyi je ma amɛ tsuo, kɛ Babilonia matsɛ Nebukadnezar, ye tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ba.
Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ Yuda zugba a, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ je mahi tsuo nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ ma ba hwu ta.
Ma kpata zugba nɛ ɔ, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; a ma plɛ pee gbeye nɔ́, muɔ nɔ́, kɛ he fɛu yemi nɔ́ kɛ ya neneene.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Ma ha nɛ nyami, kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ ayɛflo he ní peemi hoo ɔ se maa po.
A be nu nae kɛ wo a kane ɔmɛ a mi hu, nɛ blɛfo maa ta.
Zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ jeha nyingmi kpaago.
Jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, ma gbla Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ma a tue ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Ma kpata Babilonia zugba a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ ya neneene.
Níhi tsuo nɛ i de to; haomihi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi nɛ Yeremia fiɛ ke a maa ba je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, i kɛ maa gbla Babilonia tue.
Ma wo Babilonia bi ɔmɛ hiɔ ngɛ níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he; mɛ hu a ma ba sɔmɔ je mahi babauu, kɛ matsɛmɛ nguanguahi kaa nyɔguɛhi.’ ” Mawu maa gbla je ma amɛ a tue Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke, “O nɛ wai kplu nɛ ye mi mi la hyi lɛ tɔ.
Ngɔɔ kɛ ya ha je mahi tsuo nɛ ma tsɔ mo a ngɔ ɔ nɛ a nu.
Ke a nu ɔ, a hɛ mi ma tsitsɛɛ mɛ nɛ a fo godo ngɛ ta a nɛ i tsɔ kɛ ma a ngɔ ɔ he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i he kplu ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ, nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ya ha je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ tsɔ mi a ngɔ ɔ, nɛ a nu.
Yerusalem bi, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nu.
Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ; a plɛ pee he fɛu yemi nɔ́, kɛ gbiɛmi.
-Ni kpahi tsuo nɛ mɛ hu a sa a nya kplu nɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ; Egipt bi tsuo, kɛ nibwɔhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ; matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Uz zugba a nɔ ɔ; matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Filisti ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ: Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, kɛ Ashdod fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ; nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Edom, Moab, kɛ Amon; matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Tiro, kɛ Sidon; matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba amɛ a nɔ ngɛ Mediterenia woɔ se ɔ; Dedan, kɛ Tema, kɛ Buz ma amɛ; nihi tsuo nɛ poɔ huɛ ngɛ a yi mi; Arabia matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; futufututsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Zimri, Elam, kɛ Media; omleyi je matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he kɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he kɛ we.
Je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ sa a nya kplu nɛ ɔ.
A se ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa nu kɛ gbe nya ji Babilonia matsɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “De ma a ke imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ mɛ fae ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ kplu ɔ mi ɔ kɛ yaa si e maa tɔ dã, nɛ e maa vie, kɛ yaa si e maa nɔ si nɛ e be nyɛe maa te si hu; ejakaa i tsɔ ta nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ma a ngɔ.
Se ke a kplɛɛ we kaa a ma he kplu ɔ ngɛ o dɛ nɛ a nu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, de mɛ ke imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ ji ɔ, ja a nu kɛ̃.
Ma bɔni hɛ mi kpatami ní tsumi ɔ kɛ je imi nitsɛ ye ma a mi.
Pe a susu kaa a maa ye a he lo?
Dɛbi!
A be a he yee; ja a gbla a tue kokooko.
Ejakaa ma ha nɛ ta maa ba je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yeremia, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de mo ɔ, gbaa kɛ tsɔɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ.
De mɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ ma huã kɛ je hiɔwe lokoo.
E ma wo gbi kɛ je e hi he klɔuklɔu ɔ. E maa huã, nɛ e ma he ose wawɛɛ kɛ wo e ma a kaa bɔ nɛ wai ngali kpaa huhui ɔ. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ huhui maa pɛ kɛ ya je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ tɔɔ.
Yawɛ kɛ je ma amɛ ná.
E maa kojo nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e maa gbe mɛ.
Yawɛ lɛ de.’ ” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke haomi maa ba je ma amɛ a nɔ nɔtonɔto, nɛ ahumi nɛ nya wa maa fia kɛ je je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ tɔɔ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nihi nɛ Yawɛ maa gbe ɔ, a ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ he kɛ maa je je ɔ nyagbe he kake kɛ maa ya nyagbe he kake.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee ha mɛ, nɛ a be mɛ ngɔe kɛ ho nɛ a ya pu hulɔ; a ma plɛ pee kuku ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛ ma nɔ yeli nɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ ye ma a nɔ, nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ kpa bubuubui!
Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ wuwlua si ngɛ la zu mi; ejakaa ligbi ɔ nɛ a maa gbe nyɛ ɔ su.
A ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔtslɔɔ agbosu mi.
Nyɛ be blɔ nae kɛ tu fo.
-Nyɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bubuubui kpae kɛ hɛdɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ puɛ nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ.
Yawɛ kɛ abofu kpata nyɛ tue mi jɔmi ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Yawɛ je e ma a he kaa jata nɛ si e muɔ kɛ fɔ si.
Ta ní puɛmi ɔ, kɛ Yawɛ abofu nɛ nya wa a ha nɛ zugba a plɛ pee nga kplanaa.
A kojo Yeremia Benɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim, Yosia bi ɔ bɔni matsɛ yemi ɔ, e kɛ we kulaa nɛ Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ. Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya da si ngɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Nihi nɛ jeɔ Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ baa lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ba jaa mi ɔ, de mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ i fa mo ke o fiɛ ha mɛ ɔ. Ko si ekoeko.
Alini a maa bu tue nɛ a maa kpale kɛ je a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ke a pee ja a, lɛɛ yi mi nɛ i to kaa ma gbla a tue ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ma tsake jamɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ.” Yawɛ fa mi ke ma de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Imi Yawɛ, i de ke nyɛɛ bu mi tue nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ.
I de nyɛ ke ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ nɛ i tsɔɔ kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ bu a munyu ɔmɛ tue.
Se nyɛ bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ wa tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ma pee we nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Shilo ɔ. Nɛ ma ha nɛ ma nɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee gbiɛmi nɔ́ ko kɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo.” Osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo nu nɛ i ngɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Benɛ i de nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ke ma de ɔ gbe nya a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo nu mi.
Nɛ a de ke, “Ja o gbo!
Mɛni he je lɛ o fiɛ ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ke we nɛ ɔ ma ba pee kaa Shilo ɔ?
Mɛni he je lɛ o de ke a ma kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi hie hu ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo ba bua kɛ wo ye he ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Benɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nu sane nɛ ba a, a he sɔ kɛ je matsɛ we ɔ mi kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ a ba hi si ngɛ agbo he ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ, de ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ ma a ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nu kɛ nyɛ tue ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔ tu munyu kɛ si wa ma a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ja a gbe lɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo ke, “Níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ i de kɛ si we nɛ ɔ, kɛ ma nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba de.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ; nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, lɛɛ yi mi nɛ e to kaa e maa gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e ma tsake jamɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ. Imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ susu kaa e hi, loo e da ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mi.
Se nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le ɔ kaa ke nyɛ gbe mi ɔ, nyɛ pue nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ɔ muɔ si, nɛ musu maa tloo nyɛɛ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ejakaa Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ ke ma ba tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo de osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ tu munyu ngɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ biɛ mi; e sɛ kaa a gbeɔ lɛ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ ekomɛ te da si, nɛ a de ma a tsuo nɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke, “Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia yi nɔ ɔ, gbalɔ Mika nɛ je Moreshet ɔ de Yuda ma a tsuo ke, ‘A ma hu Zion kaa a huɔ ngmɔ.
Yerusalem ma hyi tɔ kɛ ní kokoehi nɛ a bua nya glekugleku, nɛ yoku ɔ nɔ he nɛ we ɔ maa si ngɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee hue.’ Nɛ Mika de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, anɛ Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia kɛ ma a tsuo gbe lɛ lo?
Dɛbi!
Nɔ́ nɛ Hezekia pee mohu ji kaa e ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ e hla e se blɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, yi mi nɛ Yawɛ to kaa e kɛ amanehlu maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ tsake jamɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa kɛ amanehlu agbo nɛ ba wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nɔ.” Nyumu ko hu gba ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi kɛ si ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ zugba a kaa bɔ nɛ Yeremia gba a pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E biɛ ji Uria, Shemaya nɛ je Kiriat Yearim bi ɔ. Benɛ Matsɛ Yehoyakim kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ Uria de ɔ, matsɛ ɔ hla kaa e maa gbe lɛ.
Uria nu he, nɛ e ye gbeye, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ho Egipt ya.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Matsɛ Yehoyakim tsɔ nyumu komɛ Egipt nɛ a ya nu Uria ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyumu nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji Elnatan, Akbor bi ɔ.
A ngɔ Uria kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba ha Matsɛ Yehoyakim.
Matsɛ Yehoyakim ha nɛ a gbe Uria, nɛ a sake e gbogboe ɔ kɛ fɔ gɔ ɔ mi he nɛ a puɔ ni guhi ngɛ ɔ.
Se Shafan bi Ahikam, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, fa ye he.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngɔɛ mi kɛ wui ma a dɛ mi nɛ a ya gbe mi.
Yeremia kpla teji kuɛpã tso Benɛ Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia, Yosia bi ɔ bɔni matsɛ yemi ɔ, e kɛ we kulaa nɛ Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ba imi Yeremia, ye ngɔ.
Yawɛ de mi ke ma ya pee kuɛpã tso kɛ e he kpa nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee kɛ kpla ye kuɛ.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma tsɔ nɛ a kɛ sɛ gbi ya ha Edom matsɛ, Moab matsɛ, Amon matsɛ, Tiro matsɛ, kɛ Sidon matsɛ.
E de mi ke ma ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ gu ma nɛ ɔmɛ a nane mi dali ɔmɛ nɛ ba Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a nine nɔ.
E de mi ke ma fa mɛ nɛ a ya de a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ lɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Imi lɛ i kɛ ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ kɔni si wami bɔ je ɔ, nimli adesahi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi; nɛ i kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ i suɔ.
Imi lɛ i ngɔ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar, ye tsɔlɔ ɔ dɛ, nɛ i ha nɛ pu mi lohwehi tete sɔmɔɔ lɛ.
Je ma amɛ tsuo ma sɔmɔ lɛ, kɛ e bi, kɛ e bibi hluu kɛ yaa si be maa su nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ hu e ma ba sɔmɔ je mahi nɛ a he wa, kɛ matsɛmɛ nguanguahi.
“Se ke je ma ko, aloo nɔ yemi ko kua ke mɛɛ lɛɛ a be kikɛmɛ a Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar nɛ ɔ sɔmɔe ɔ, ma ngɔ ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kɛ gbla a tue hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ha nɛ Nebukadnezar ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko bu nyɛ gbali ɔmɛ, klaali ɔmɛ, kpade tsɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ kunya yeli ɔmɛ tue.
