Mɛ tsuo a deɔ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ. Lakpa gbami lɛ a ngɛ gbae kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa je mi kɛ ba ji a ma ba ngɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ ya tsitsaa lokoo.
Ma fie nyɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Se ke je ma ko maa ba a he si ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ lɛ ɔ, ma ha nɛ a maa hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ; a ma hu zugba a, nɛ a maa hi nɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” I tu munyu nɛ ɔ kɛ̃ kɛ tsɔɔ Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ. Nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ e ma a, nɛ nyɛ yi ma na wami.
Mɛni he je o maa hi si nɛ ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ gbe mo, kɛ o ma a tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ?
Yawɛ de to ke je ma nɛ be Babilonia matsɛ ɔ sɔmɔe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ deɔ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko bu mɛ tue.
Lakpa gbami lɛ a ngɛ gbae kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ nitsɛ de ke pi lɛ nɛ tsɔ mɛ; pe a ngɔ e biɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sisie kɛkɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ maa fie nyɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɛ lakpa munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i de osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ ke, “Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ a maa ngɔ Yawɛ we ɔ juetli ɔ kɛ je Babilonia kɛ ba a, nyɛ ko bu mɛ tue.
Lakpa munyu lɛ a ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ko bu mɛ tue kulaa!
Nyɛ sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami.
Mɛni he je lɛ ma nɛ ɔ maa pee ma doku?
Ke gbali ji mɛ niinɛ, nɛ a na ye sɛ gbi ɔ, ha nɛ a fa kue ha imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mohu, konɛ ma ko ngmɛ blɔ nɛ a ba muɔ juetli nɛ piɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ Yuda matsɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya.” -Benɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɔ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin, Yehoyakim bi ɔ, kɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, e si ní nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ngɛ se: titima amɛ, akɔblee nyu nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ tlɔɔke ɔmɛ, kɛ ní kpa komɛ.
“Níhi nɛ piɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ Yuda matsɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ dee ngɛ a he ɔ tue.
A maa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ maa ya Babilonia, ya to ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si ma kai mɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba to a blɔ he ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yeremia kɛ gbalɔ Hanania Jamɛ a jeha a nɔuu mi ɔ, Azur bi Hanania, gbalɔ ɔ nɛ je Gibeon ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ mi sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, Hanania de mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Babilonia matsɛ ɔ he wami ɔ, i he ngɛ e dɛ.
Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha enyɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ we ɔ juetli tsuo nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ba muɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, ma ngɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ ekohu.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin, Yehoyakim bi ɔ, kɛ Yuda ma a tsuo nɛ a nuu mɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, mɛ hu ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ ekohu.
Niinɛ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ he wami ɔ, ma he ngɛ e dɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de gbalɔ Hanania ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo nɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a hɛ mi ke, “Saminya!
Yawɛ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Gbami nɛ o gba a, Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ e ba mi, konɛ Yawɛ we ɔ juetli tsuo nɛ a muɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ, e kpale mɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ ekohu.
Se kɛ̃, moo bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo, kɛ ma a tsuo dee ɔ tue.
Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ i kɛ mo tsuo wa hɛ mi blema lokoo ɔ gba ke ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ba je mahi babauu, kɛ matsɛ yemi nguanguahi a nɔ.
Gbalɔ nɛ gbaa ke tue mi jɔmi maa ba a, ke jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ munyu ɔ na ba mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa Yawɛ lɛ tsɔ lɛ niinɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Hanania je kuɛpã tso ɔ kɛ je ye kuɛ, nɛ e ku mi dukuduku.
Nɛ e de ngɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi ke, “Yawɛ ke, kuɛpã tso ɔ nɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ngɔ wo je ma amɛ tsuo a kuɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ lɛ Yawɛ ɔ maa ku jamɛ a kuɛpã tso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha enyɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i je lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Hanania ku kuɛpã tso ɔ nɛ ngɛ ye kuɛ ɔ mi dukuduku se ɔ, Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi ke ma ya nɛ ma ya de Hanania ke, “Yawɛ ke o ku tso kuɛpã tso ɔ lɛɛ, se e maa pee dade nɔ́ kɛ to nane mi.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke e kɛ dade kuɛpã tso maa fɔ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kuɛ, nɛ a ma ba sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar.
Yawɛ ke e ma ha nɛ pu mi lohwehi po ma sɔmɔ Nebukadnezar.” I bɔ gbalɔ Hanania amaniɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ i ya nɔ nɛ i de lɛ ke, “Hanania, bu tue!
Yawɛ tsɔ we mo fɛɛ, nɛ o ha nɛ ma nɛ ɔ he lakpa munyu ɔmɛ ye.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ ke e ma je mo kɛ je je ɔ mi.
O ma gbo jeha nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu, ejakaa o de ma a ke a tsɔ atuã kɛ wo Yawɛ.” Nɛ gbalɔ Hanania gbo jamɛ a jeha a mi nɔuu, ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ mi.
Yeremia ngma womi kɛ mane Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Babilonia I ngma womi kɛ mane osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, ma nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo nɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ngɔ kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya a. Benɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je Yerusalem momo.
Mɛ ji Matsɛ Yehoyakin, e nyɛ, matsɛ we ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem, ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ sɔli ɔmɛ.
I ngɔ womi ɔ kɛ mane Elasa, Shafan bi ɔ, kɛ Gamaria, Hilkia bi ɔ. Mɛ ji nihi nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia tsɔ mɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ngɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nihi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ha nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛɛ po wehi nɛ nyɛɛ hi a mi.
Nyɛɛ pee ngmɔhi nɛ nyɛɛ ye a mi ní.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ yihi nɛ nyɛ fɔ binyumuhi kɛ biyihi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ yihi ha nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ha nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ gba, konɛ mɛ hu a fɔ bimɛ.
Nyɛɛ bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nyɛ nɔ nɛ ko gbɔ.
Ma a nɛ i ha nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya mi ɔ, nyɛ hla jamɛ a ma a nɔ yami.
Nyɛɛ fa kue ha imi Yawɛ, konɛ ma na mɛ mɔbɔ; ejakaa ke a na a he ɔ, nyɛ hu e maa hi ha nyɛ.
Imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, gbali, kɛ klaali nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sisi nyɛ.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a de nyɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ suɔ nɛ ba mi.
Lakpa gbami lɛ a ngɛ gbae ha nyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ nɛ; i tsɔ we mɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ “Yawɛ ke, ‘Babilonia jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, ma kai nyɛ.
Nɛ, si nɛ i wo ke ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba we ekohu ɔ, ma ye jamɛ a siwo ɔ nɔ.
Yi mi nɛ i to ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ, imi nɔ kake too pɛ lɛ i le; i to nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛ he mi nɛ jɔ nyɛ, se pi kaa ma hao nyɛ.
Ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ, i to nɛ ma ha nyɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, ke nyɛ tsɛ mi nɛ nyɛ fa kue ha mi ɔ, ma bu nyɛ tue.
Nyɛ ma hla ye se blɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa na mi.
Ke nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ tsui tsuo kɛ hla ye se blɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa na mi, nɛ ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba nyɛ zugba a nɔ ekohu.
Je mahi, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ i fie nyɛ kɛ ho ɔ, ma bua nyɛ nya kɛ je lejɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ma kpale nyɛ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ i ha nɛ a nuu nyɛ kɛ je ɔ ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ “Nyɛ deɔ ke Yawɛ je gbali ha nyɛ ngɛ Babilonia.
Se matsɛ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ David sɛ ɔ nɔ, kɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi bi tsuo, nɛ ji nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu we mɛ kɛ piɛ we nyɛ he kɛ ya a, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ a he ɔ tue.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, ‘Ma ha nɛ ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ma ba sɛ a kpɛti; nɛ ma ha a maa pee kaa ngmɔkɔ nɛ sa, nɛ hí yemi.
I kɛ ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa nyɛɛ a se; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa nu sawale.
A maa ye a he fɛu, nɛ a maa bɔ mɛ ahlua ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ ma fie mɛ kɛ ya.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba a nɔ, ejakaa sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ i haa mɛ be tsuaa be kɛ guu ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a bui fɛɛ.
A sume kaa a maa nu kɛ a tue po.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i ha nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ tue.’ “Kolaya bi Ahab, kɛ Maaseya bi Zedekia nɛ a ngɛ lakpa gbami gbae ngɛ ye biɛ mi kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E ke e maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar dɛ, nɛ Nebukadnezar maa gbe mɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, ke a ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbiɛ nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a ma de ji, ‘Yawɛ nɛ pee mo kaa Zedekia kɛ Ahab nɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ sã mɛ hɛ ngmengmle ngɛ la mi ɔ!’ Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa a pee ní yayamihi ngɛ Israel; a puɛ gba, nɛ a tu lakpa munyuhi ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi, pohu e fa we mɛ ke a tu jamɛ a munyu ko.
Pi Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní ji nɛ ɔ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ, e na, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye he odase.
Yawɛ lɛ de.” Womi ɔ nɛ Shemaya ngma a -Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ha mi sɛ gbi kɛ ha Shemaya nɛ je Nehelam ɔ. Shemaya nɛ ɔ ngma womi ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ mi kɛ mane osɔfo Zefania, Maaseya bi ɔ, kɛ osɔfo kpa amɛ tsuo, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ. Womi ɔ nɛ Shemaya ngma kɛ mane Zefania a, nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ji, “Yawɛ wo mo osɔfo ngɛ Yehoyada nane mi konɛ o hyɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nɔ.
O blɔ nya ní tsumi ji godotsɛ tsuaa godotsɛ nɛ peeɔ e he gbalɔ ɔ, o hyɛ nɛ a bɔ lɛ pã nɛ a wo e kuɛ dade kɔsɔkɔsɔ.
Yeremia, Anatot no ɔ nɛ ngɛ lakpa gbami gbae ha ma a, mɛni he je o ka we e hɛ mi mɔ?
Yeremia ngma womi ya ha nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho Babilonia ya a ke a se maa kɛ ngɛ ma se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a po wehi nɛ a hi a mi, nɛ a pee ngmɔhi nɛ a ye a mi ní.” Osɔfo Zefania kane womi nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke -ma tsɔ nɛ a ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Shemaya he ɔ ya ha nihi tsuo nɛ a nuu mɛ kɛ ho ɔ ke, “Imi Yawɛ, ma gbla Shemaya kɛ e nina tsuo a tue.
I tsɔ we lɛ, se e kɛ nyɛ ba tu munyu kaa nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ; nɛ e ha nɛ nyɛ he e lakpa munyu ɔmɛ ye.
E nina ko nina ko be nyɛ kpɛti hie.
Ní kpakpahi nɛ ma ba pee kɛ ha ye ma a hwɔɔ se ɔ, e be je mi hie kɛ yaa si jamɛ a be ɔ nɛ e ba na kɛ e hɛngmɛ; ejakaa e de ye ma a ke a tsɔ atuã kɛ wo mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yawɛ wo e ma a si Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke, “Ngmaa munyuhi nɛ i kɛ mo tu ɔ tsuo kɛ wo womi mi, ejakaa be ma nɛ ma pee ye ma Israel, kɛ Yuda saminya ekohu.
Zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ekohu, nɛ e ma ba pee a weto ní.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ ngɛ Israel kɛ Yuda dee ke, “Wa nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe, sawale kɛ gbeye, se pi tue mi jɔmi.
Nyɛ bi nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ!
Anɛ nyumu ko nu kɔɔmi nɛ e fɔ hyɛ lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ i na nɛ nyumuhi tsuo nu a mlɛ mi kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi ɔ?
Mɛni he je nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi pee kaa la zu la zu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Ligbi ko ma nɛ ngɛ gbeye; ligbi nɛ ɔ eko bɛ hyɛ.
E ji amanehlu be kɛ ha Yakob nina, ye ma a, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a yi ma na wami.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ku kuɛpã tsohi nɛ ngɛ a kuɛ ɔ, nɛ ma tsɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ.
Nɛ a be ni kpahi sɔmɔe hu.
Se mohu, a ma sɔmɔ imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, kɛ David nina ko nɛ ma wo matsɛ ha mɛ ɔ.
“Ye ma, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; Israel ma, nyɛ tsui nɛ ko po.
Ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je zugba nɔ, he nɛ a nuu nyɛ kɛ ho ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ɔ. Nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba we, nɛ nyɛ ma ba hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi; nyɛ he mi maa jɔ nyɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ he gbeye woe.
Ma ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba kpɔ nyɛ.
Je ma amɛ nɛ i fie nyɛ kɛ ya a ngɔ ɔ, ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae kɛ pi si.
I be hae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ he kulaa; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tue bɔ nɛ sa.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nyɛ pa a be tsa ba.
Nɔ ko be nɛ maa hyɛ nyɛ nɔ, tsopa ko be nɛ a kɛ maa to nyɛ pa amɛ a nɔ; nyɛ be he wami nae.
Nyɛ suɔli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ je nyɛ nɔ, a bi we nyɛ si hu.
I ba tua nyɛ kaa he nyɛlɔ tuaa nɔ; i gbla nyɛ tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ, ejakaa nyɛ pee yayami nguanguahi babauu.
Nyɛ ko tu nyɛ plaami ɔmɛ a he munyu hu; tsa ba ko be ha nyɛ.
I gbla nyɛ tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ pee yayami nguanguahi babauu.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, nihi tsuo nɛ kpataa nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, a ma kpata mɛ hu a hɛ mi.
A maa nuu nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.
Nihi tsuo nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ, a maa wa mɛ hu yi mi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ haa nyɛ níhi ɔ, a maa ha mɛ hu a níhi.
Nyɛ he nyɛli tsɛɔ nyɛ ke nihi nɛ a fie mɛ; a deɔ ke, ‘Zion nɛ be huɛ.’ Se kɛ̃, ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma na he wami ekohu; ma tsa nyɛ pa amɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ ke, “Ma kpale ye ma a kɛ ba a zugba a nɔ ekohu, nɛ ma na we puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya mɔbɔ.
A maa ma Yerusalem ekohu ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ, nɛ matsɛ we ɔ maa ma si ngɛ e ma he.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ma la yi jemi la, nɛ a ma hwɔ lele.
Ma gbaa mɛ; a maa hiɛ babauu, nɛ ma wo a hɛ mi nyami.
A bimɛ ɔmɛ ma ba hi si kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi si ɔ; nɛ ma to ma a si wawɛɛ ekohu.
Nihi tsuo nɛ maa wa mɛ yi mi ɔ, ma gbla a tue.
-A nɔ yelɔ ɔ maa je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma a mi; a matsɛ ɔ maa je mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɔuu a kpɛti.
Ma tsɛ lɛ, nɛ e maa ba ye ngɔ.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ye he be mi nɛ i tsɛ we lɛ?
A maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” -Yawɛ we abofu ngɛ kaa ahumi; e ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa.
E maa fia vuguvugu kɛ be ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi nɔ.
Yawɛ we abofu ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e maa gbe níhi tsuo nɛ e to ke e maa pee ɔ nya.
Pee se kulaa loko e ma a maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi saminya.
Israel maa kpale kɛ ba we Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ ma ba pee Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.
I na nihi nɛ a he je gbenɔ mi ɔ mɔbɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a jɔɔ a he ɔ, i je ye he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.
Israel ma, kɛ je blema lɛ i je suɔmi nɛ nya wa kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Nɛ kɛ ba si piɔ hu jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ ngɛ; e se pui.
Ma to nyɛ si ekohu.
Nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ fao ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa do kɛ bua jɔmi ekohu.
Nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔhi ngɛ Samaria yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ekohu; ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma du ní ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa ye niba ní ɔ. Niinɛ, be ma nɛ buli ma kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Efraim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ma de ke, ‘Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya Zion, ngɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ.’ ” Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ la ha Israel; nyɛ hwɔ lele ha ma nɛ he wa pe je ma amɛ tsuo ɔ. Nyɛ la yi jemi la, nɛ nyɛɛ fiɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ he e ma a yi wami; Yawɛ he nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo a yi wami.’ Ma ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ je omleyi je zugba a nɔ, ma ya bua a nya kɛ je zugba a nyagbe he tɔɔ.
Hɛ yuyuili, akpaketsɛmɛ, yihɔyihi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ miɔ nɛ a ma fɔ po maa piɛ a he kɛ ba.
Nihi babauu nitsɛ maa kpale kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ ekohu.
Ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba kɛ a hɛ mi ya, kɛ kue fami.
Ma kpaka mɛ kɛ nyɛɛ pahi a tue ngɛ blɔ tlɔmɔɔ nɔ, konɛ a ko tɛ nɔ.
I ngɛ kaa tsɛ kɛ ha Israel, nɛ Efraim ji ye kekleekle bi.” Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ je mahi, nyɛɛ bu mi tue nɛ nyɛɛ fiɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ wo kpɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsitsaa lokoo ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ gbɛ Israel ma a ngɔ fĩa a, lɛ nɔuu e ma bua a nya ekohu, nɛ e maa hyɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ hyɛɛ e tohi ɔ.’ I he Israel yi wami, nɛ i kpɔ mɛ kɛ je je ma ko nɛ he wa pe mɛ ɔ dɛ mi.
A ma ba la ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ a bua maa jɔ ye nike ní ɔmɛ, blɛfo, wai, oliv nu, to, kɛ na a he.
A maa pee kaa ngmɔ nɛ a pue e mi ní ɔmɛ a nɔ nyu; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mɛ hiae hu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, yihewi ɔmɛ maa do kɛ bua jɔmi, nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ kɛ nimowi ɔmɛ tsuo ma nya.
Ma jɔɔ a bua; ma ha nɛ a kɔmɔ yemi ɔ maa plɛ pee bua jɔmi, nɛ a we aywilɛho ɔ ma plɛ pee nyami.
Ma ha nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa ye ní kpakpahi nɛ a maa tɔ; ye ma a hu maa ye nɛ a maa tɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ maa na Israel mɔbɔ Yawɛ ke, “A nu gbi ko ngɛ Rama, kɔmɔ yemi kɛ ya fomi nɛ nya wa, Rahel ngɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ foe nɛ e kplɛɛ we kpatami, ejakaa a be hu.
Nyɛɛ jɔɔ ya fomi, nɛ nyɛ tsu vo nyu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.
Níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee kɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a maa wo he hiɔ; bimɛ ɔmɛ maa je he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu.
Hwɔɔ se hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha nyɛ; nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ maa kpale kɛ ba we ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“I nu nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ke, ‘Yawɛ, jinɛ wa ngɛ kaa lohwe nɛ hɛ mi jɔɛ; se o tsɔse wɔ nɛ wa he jɔ.
Moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu, ejakaa mo ji Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Jinɛ wa je o se, se wa pia wa he, nɛ wa tsake wa tsui.
Benɛ o gbla wa tue se ɔ, wa ywilɛ ho wa he.
Zo gbe wɔ kpɔtɔɔ; ejakaa wa pee yayamihi babauu ngɛ wa nihe mi.’ “Israel, mo ji ye bi nɛ i suɔ saminya; mo ji bi nɛ i suɔ pe bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Be tsuaa be nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko kɛ si mo ɔ, ja i kɛ suɔmi kai mo kɛ̃.
Ye hɛ jaa ngɛ o he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma na mo mɔbɔ kɛ̃.
Nyɛɛ ma tsohi ngɛ blɔ he kɛ to blɔ ɔ he so.
Blɔ nɛ nyɛ maa nyɛɛ nɔ kɛ ya a, nyɛɛ to blɔ ɔ he hɛ saminya.
Israel ma, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba koo!
Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi.
Nyɛ ma nɛ nyɛ be hemi kɛ yemi!
Kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ nyɛ yi mi maa pee nyɛ enyɔɔnyɔ?
I bɔ nɔ́ he ko kɛ wo je ɔ mi; yo mohu maa bu nyumu he.” Mawu ma a ma ba bɔ hwɔɔ se Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke “Ke i kpale ma a kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ekohu ɔ, a ma de ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, kɛ ma amɛ a mi ekohu ke, ‘Yawɛ nɛ gbaa Yerusalem yo klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ lɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ hii ɔ.’ Nihi maa pee kake kɛ hi si ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, kɛ ma amɛ a mi: ngmɔ huli, kɛ to hyɛli kɛ a tohi.
Nihi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, ma ha mɛ he wami he, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ gbe mɛ ɔ, ma ha mɛ ní nɛ a maa ye nɛ a maa tɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ye hɛ tsɛ̃, nɛ i na kaa i hwɔɛ mahe nɛ ngɔ ye he saminya.
“Imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ke, be ma nɛ ma ha nɛ nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi ma hyi Israel zugba a, kɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ tɔ.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i gbo dengme nɛ i kɛ hia mɛ, nɛ i ku mɛ pue si, nɛ i butu mɛ, nɛ i kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ i kɛ haomi ba a nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu ma gbo dengme kɛ ma mɛ, nɛ ma to mɛ si ekohu.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a be dee hu ke, ‘Tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye wai yiblii ngmlikiti nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a lungu fĩa.’ Se mohu ɔ, ke nɔ ko pee yayami ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e yayami ɔ lɛ maa gbe lɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye wai yiblii ngmlikiti ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e lungu lɛ maa fĩa.” Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a, kɛ Yuda ma a maa so somi he.
Somi nɛ ɔ maa je kpa ngɛ somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ he.
Benɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ nɛ i nu a kɔni si nɛ i kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.
I kɛ mɛ hi si kaa a huno, se somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ lɛɛ a yi nɔ fɛɛ.
Se somi he ɔ nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a maa so jehanɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ lɛɛ e maa hi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ma ngɔ ye mlaa kɛ wo a mi, nɛ ma ngma ngɛ a tsui nɔ.
Ma pee a Mawu, nɛ a maa pee ye ma.
Nɔ ko pa be e nyɛmi, loo e he nɔ ko tsɔɔe hu ke e le Yawɛ, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le mi, kɛ je jokuɛyo pe kulaa nɔ kɛ yaa si nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɔ.
Ma ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ, nɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ hu i be kaie hu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ lɛ pee pu, konɛ e tso piani.
Lɛ nɛ pee nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi konɛ a kpɛ nyɔ mi.
Yawɛ lɛ klɛɔ wo mi, nɛ e haa nɛ oslɔke ɔmɛ gliɔ E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
Yawɛ ngɛ si woe ke, be abɔ nɛ adebɔ mlaa nɛ ɔ ngɛ nɛ e se pui ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nɛ Israel ma a hu be gue.
Ke a ma nyɛ ma susu hiɔwe, nɛ zugba a sisi tomi ɔ hu a ma nyɛ ma hla a, lɛɛ Yawɛ hu ma kua Israel ma a ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ a he.
Yawɛ lɛ de.
Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ a maa ma Yerusalem ehe ekohu kɛ ha mi, kɛ je Hananel mɔ ɔ bonyoku je, kɛ yaa si kɔ̃ nya agbo ɔ he.
Susumi kpa a maa je lejɛ ɔ tɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ ya gu Gareb yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa dɔ e yi kɛ ba Goa.
Nɛ kɔ̃ ɔ tsuo maa pee klɔuklɔu kɛ ha mi: gɔ ɔ, kuku ɔ, kɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Kidron pa a yi mi ɔ, hluu kɛ yaa si okpɔngɔ agbo ɔ beleku je.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ma a ngɔe hu, nɛ a be e hɛ mi kpatae hu gblegbleegble.”
Yeremia he zugba ko Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma a mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar hu na jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ momo ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ tabo ɔ ya sa Yerusalem ma a yi, be mi nɛ imi, Yeremia lɛɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ Yuda matsɛ we ɔ. Matsɛ Zedekia wo mi tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e po ye nya ke i kɛ Yawɛ biɛ fiɛ ke, “Ma ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, e maa ngɔ ma a, nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia be e he yee.
A maa nu lɛ kɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ; e maa na lɛ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa tu munyu.
A maa ngɔ Zedekia kɛ ya Babilonia, nɛ e ma ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si i kɛ lɛ maa to ní.
Ke e kɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ hwu ta po e be mɛ nyɛe.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ de mi ke Hanamel, ye tsɛko Shalum bi ɔ ma ba de mi ke ma he e zugba a nɛ ngɛ Anatot ɔ. Ejakaa ye nyɛmi tutuutu ji lɛ, nɛ i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i kpɔɔ zugba a. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ɔ, Hanamel ba ye ngɔ ngɛ kue ɔ mi nɛ e ba de mi ke ma he e zugba a nɛ ngɛ Anatot ngɛ Benyamin zugba a mi ɔ. Hanamel de mi ke imi lɛ i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i kpɔɔ zugba a kɛ peeɔ ye weto ní, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma he zugba a. Kɛkɛ nɛ i na kaa Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu niinɛ.
I he zugba a, nɛ i ngmɛ sika nɛ nya ji sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma kɛ kpaago, nɛ i kɛ wo Hanamel hiɔ.
A pee womi ngɛ zugba a juami ɔ he, nɛ i kɛ ye nine wo sisi, nɛ i sɔu nya.
I tsɛ nihi odase, nɛ i ngmɛ sika a ngɛ sɛni nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ̃ zugba a he womi ɔ nɛ a sɔu nya a, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a sɔu we nya a tsuo.
Womi ɔ nɛ a sɔu nya a tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a ye zugba a nya ha, kɛ mlaa nɛ kɔɔ zugba a juami ɔ he.
I ngɔ womi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Baruk, Maseya bi Neria bi ɔ ngɛ ye tsɛko bi Hanamel, kɛ odase yeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a nine kɛ wo womi ɔ sisi ɔ, kɛ Yuda bi tsuo nɛ hii si ngɛ kue ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi.
I de Baruk ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo fae ke o he zugba juami he womi nɛ ɔmɛ, nɔ́ nɛ a sɔu nya a, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a sɔu we nya a tsuo, nɛ o ngɔ ya wo zu kplu ko mi, konɛ a se nɛ kɛ.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ke nihi ma ba he wehi, zugbahi, kɛ wai ngmɔhi ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu.” Yeremia fa kue ha Yawɛ Benɛ i ngɔ zugba a he womi ɔ kɛ ha Baruk, Neria bi ɔ se ɔ, i fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, mo lɛ o kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko peemi wɛ ha mo.
O jeɔ o suɔmi nɛ se pui gblegbleegble ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ni akpeakpe.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o kɛ tsɛmɛ a tɔmi gblaa bimɛ a tue.
Mawu nɛ kle, nɛ ngɛ he wami ji mo; o biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
O toɔ nile gahi, nɛ o peeɔ ní nguanguahi.
O naa níhi tsuo nɛ nimli adesahi peeɔ, nɛ o woɔ mɛ hiɔ bɔ pɛ nɛ sa mɛ.
Blema lokoo ɔ, o pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, o ngɛ jamɛ a nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ, kɛ okadi ɔmɛ pee kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ o kɛ he biɛ.
O pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi kɛ wo wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he gbeye, nɛ o kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ jé o ma Israel kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ.
O ha mɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ.
Se benɛ a ba su zugba a nɔ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ pee a weto ní ɔ, a bui mo tue; o mlaa amɛ hu a yi nɔ fɛɛ.
Níhi nɛ o fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ, a pee we ekoeko fɛɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ o kɛ haomi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
“Babilonia bi ɔmɛ fia kpoku kɛ wo ma a he konɛ a ngɔ ma a; amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a tua ma a. Ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ma ha nɛ a maa ngɔ ma a. O maa na kaa níhi nɛ o de ɔ tsuo ba mi.
Se Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lee, mo lɛ o fa mi ke ma he zugba a ngɛ odase yeli a hɛ mi, be mi nɛ o le paa kaa a ngɔ ma a kɛ wo Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ; nimli adesahi tsuo a Mawu ji mi.
Anɛ nɔ́ ko peemi wa ha mi lo?
Ma ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar kɛ e tabo ɔ a dɛ mi; a maa ngɔ ma a, nɛ a maa mɛ ma a he la.
A maa sã ma a, kɛ wehi nɛ nihi sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a yi mi kɛ haa Baal, nɛ a ngɔɔ dã kɛ sãã wai bɔ ha mawu kpahi kɛ woɔ ye mi mi la a. Kɛ je blema teteete ɔ, yayami sɔuu lɛ Israel bi, kɛ Yuda bi ngɛ pee, nɛ a kɛ ngɛ ye mi mi la woe.
Kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ ma nɛ ɔ, ye mi mi la sɔuu lɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ woe.
I to kaa ma kpata ma a hɛ mi, ejakaa Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ, a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ pee yayamihi babauu nɛ a kɛ wo ye mi mi la.
A plɛ a se ngɔ wo mi, nɛ a kua a tsui tsakemi.
I gbo dengme kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ní be babauu, se a bui tue fɛɛ; nɔ́ ko hu a kase we.
We ɔ nɛ a ma nɛ a ja mi ngɛ mi ɔ tete po a ngɔ a we amagahi nɛ i hiee ɔ ya to lejɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ ble we ɔ.
A ya ma bɔ sami la tɛhi ha Baal ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi, konɛ a ngɔ a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ kɛ sã bɔ ha mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Molek ɔ. I wui mɛ mlaa ke a pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ; e bɛ ye yi mi po hyɛ kaa a maa pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ ha nɛ Yuda ma a nɛ pee yayami.” Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi he si womi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke, “Yeremia, ni ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ke ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ma ha nɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba ye ma nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛ ngɛ he piɛe ɔ hu tue.
Ma bua ma a nya kɛ je zugbahi a nɔ hehi nɛ i fie mɛ kɛ ho, benɛ ye mi mi fu mɛ ɔ, nɛ ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ekohu nɛ a ba hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.
Ma ha nɛ mɛ tsuo a maa pee a yi mi kake, nɛ a maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami daa.
Ke a pee ja a, e maa hi ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ kɛ a nina.
I kɛ mɛ maa so neneene somi kaa ma pee mɛ kpakpa daa.
Ma ngɔ ye gbeye yemi kɛ wo a tsui mi, nɛ a be ye se jee hu gblegbleegble.
Ma ná a he bua jɔmi, nɛ ma suɔ kaa ma pee mɛ kpakpa.
Nɛ ma to mɛ si saminya ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.
“Kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɔ haomi nɛ kle kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ba ma nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu kɛ̃ lɛ ma ha mɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ i wo si ɔ. Ni ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ke zugba nɛ ɔ ma ba pee nga kplanaa nɔ, nɛ nimli kɛ lohwehi be nɔ hie hu.
A ngɛ dee hu ke a maa ngɔ zugba a kɛ wo Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Se, na nɛ o le kaa nihi ma ba he zugba ekohu ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nihi maa ngɔ a sika kɛ ba he zugba.
A kɛ a nine maa wo womihi nɛ a maa pee ngɛ zugba amɛ a he ɔ a sisi; a maa sɔu womi ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ma tsɛ nihi nɛ a ba ye odase.
A maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ; a maa pee ngɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ a mi, a maa pee ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi; a maa pee ngɛ yo nɔ ma amɛ a mi; nɛ a maa pee ngɛ nga nɔ ma amɛ, kɛ leneyi je ma amɛ hu a mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi he si womi ekpa Benɛ i ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ngɛ kue ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, i ná Yawɛ sɛ gbi ekohu.
Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ pee je ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ to e blɔ he ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu.
Nɔ nɛ e biɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ, de mi ke, “Tsɛ mi, nɛ ma he mo nɔ; ma sɛɛ mo ní nguanguahi a he sane, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o li.
-Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke a maa ku Yerusalem we ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda matsɛ we ɔ ngɔ pue si.
E he be se nami bae ha nyɛ kaa nyɛ maa je kpo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta ngɛ kpoku nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle ma a he.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma ha nɛ nihi nɛ i kɛ abofu maa gbe ɔ a gbogboe ma hyi ma a mi tɔ.
Ní yayamihi nɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ pee he je ɔ, i kua ma a.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, be ma nɛ ma tsa Yerusalem hiɔ ɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ma na he wami.
Ma ha nɛ a ma plɔke, nɛ a ma na he jɔmi.
Ma ha nɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ma na a he ekohu, nɛ ma to mɛ si kaa kekle ko ɔ. Ma tsu a he kɛ je yayamihi tsuo nɛ a pee kɛ si mi ɔ a he; ma ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ ye hɛ mi atuã nɛ a tsɔ ɔ kɛ pa mɛ.
Yerusalem ma ha nɛ ma na biɛ, yi jemi, kɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti, ke je ma amɛ nu ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ i pee ha ma a. Ke je ma amɛ nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a na bɔ nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ he jɔmi ba ma a mi ɔ, a tsui maa po nɛ a he maa do blibliibli.” Yawɛ ke, “Nihi deɔ ke hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nga kplanaa nɔ, he nɛ nimli loo lohwehi be.
Niinɛ, ke a de ja a, a nɔ́ da.
Yuda ma amɛ pee ma dokuhi, nɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ hu a nɔ fɔɔ si gu; nɔmlɔ adesa ko, loo lohwe ko be lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Se ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ, nyɛ maa nu bua jɔmi, kɛ lele hwɔmi gbi ekohu.
Nyɛ maa nu ayɛflo kɛ e huno a gbi, kɛ la nɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ sina bɔhi kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ lae ke, ‘Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ si, ejakaa Yawɛ hi, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa!’ Ma ha nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ he jɔmi maa ba zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa kekle ko ɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Zugba nɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa nga kplanaa nɔ, kɛ ma amɛ nɛ plɛ pee ma dokuhi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa, loo lohwe be a mi ɔ, be ma nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee lohwehi a lɛmi he, nɛ to hyɛli kɛ a lohwehi ma ba hi hiɛ ɔ ekohu.
Ngɛ yo nɔ ma amɛ, kɛ nga nɔ ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yuda leneyi je, Benyamin zugba a nɔ, Yerusalem kɔpe ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi ɔ, to hyɛli maa kane a tohi ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ si nɛ i wo Israel bi, kɛ Yuda bi ɔ, ma ye nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma hla dalɔ ko kɛ je David nina a a kpɛti nɛ e ye matsɛ.
Matsɛ nɛ ɔ maa ye dami sane, nɛ e maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
E yi nɔ ɔ, a ma he Yuda yi wami, nɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba Israel.
Nɛ biɛ nɛ a kɛ ma tsɛ lɛ ji, ‘Yawɛ ji wa dami.’ Imi, Yawɛ, i ngɛ si woe kaa David nina maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ daa.
Jehanɛ hu, a ma na osɔfohi kɛ maa je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ maa sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpahi ha mi daa be tsuaa be.” Yawɛ de mi ke, “I kɛ piani kɛ nyɔ so somi, nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, piani kɛ nyɔ baa ngɛ a be mi pɛpɛɛpɛ daa ligbi.
Jamɛ a somi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa po mi.
I kɛ ye tsɔlɔ David so somi kaa e nina maa ye matsɛ daa.
Jehanɛ se hu, i kɛ osɔfohi nɛ je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ hu so kaa a ma sɔmɔ mi daa be tsuaa be.
Kikɛmɛ a somi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa po a mi.
Ma ha nɛ ye tsɔlɔ David nina, kɛ osɔfohi nɛ je Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ a he maa hiɛ babauu kaa hiɔwe dodoehi, loo wo nya zia; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane mɛ.” Yawɛ de mi ke, “Tse o nu kaa nihi ngɛ dee ke weku enyɔ, Israel kɛ Yuda nɛ i hla a, imi Yawɛ, i kua mɛ!
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a gbeɔ ye ma a he guɛ, nɛ a bui mɛ hu kaa je ma ko ji mɛ.
Se imi Yawɛ, i kɛ piani kɛ nyɔ so somi, nɛ i pee mlaahi nɛ yeɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i nyɛ pee he je ɔ, somi nɛ i kɛ Yakob nina, kɛ ye tsɔlɔ David so ɔ hu ma ye nɔ sisiisi.
Ma hla David nina ko nɛ e ye Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a nina a nɔ.
Ma na ye ma a mɔbɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ a ma ná a he ekohu.”
Sɛ gbi kɛ ha Zedekia Benɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar kɛ e tabo ɔ, kɛ je mahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e sisi ɔ ba tua Yerusalem kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ, i ná sɛ gbi kɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ.
Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ fa mi ke ma ya de Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia ke, “Imi Yawɛ, ma ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ e maa sã ma a. Mo nitsɛ hu o be o he yee; a maa nu mo kɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ. O maa na lɛ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, nɛ o kɛ lɛ maa tu munyu; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a maa ngɔ mo kɛ ho Babilonia ya.
Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia, bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ngɛ o he ɔ tue!
O be gboe ngɛ ta nga nɔ.
O ma gbo ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pu o nɛmɛ, nɛ ji matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu a maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha mo.
A maa wo yana, nɛ a ma de ke, ‘Nɛnɛ!
Due!
Due!’ Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia ngɛ Yerusalem.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ tabo ɔ ya tua ma a momo, nɛ a kɛ Lakish kɛ Azeka hu ngɛ ta hwue.
Ma nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ nɛ piɛ.
Israel yi somi ɔ nɔ Matsɛ Zedekia, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ma a mi tsuo so kaa a ma ha nɛ a Hebri nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye a he, nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ kó pee nyɔguɛ hu.
Ma a, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo kplɛɛ kaa a maa ngmɛɛ a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ye a he, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi kó pee nyɔguɛ hu.
Niinɛ, a pee ja, nɛ a ha nɛ a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ ye a he.
Se pee se ɔ, a tsake a yi mi tomi ɔ. Nyɔguɛhi, nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ a ha nɛ a ye a he ɔ, a kpale ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a nyɛ a nɔ, nɛ a pee mɛ nyɔguɛhi ekohu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke ma ya de ma a ke, “Benɛ i ya je nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ i ha nɛ a ye a he kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi ɔ, i kɛ mɛ so somi ko.
I de mɛ ke daa jeha kpaago ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛmi Hebri no nyɔguɛ ko nɛ sɔmɔ lɛ jeha ekpa a, e ha nɛ e ye e he.
Se nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bui mi tue fɛɛ, nɛ munyu nɛ i kɛ mɛ tu ɔ hu a ngɔɛ.
Be bɔɔ ji nɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsake nyɛ yi mi tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ sa ye hɛ mi.
Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ kaa nyɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ, Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye a he.
Nyɛ so somi ngɛ ye hɛ mi, ngɛ we ɔ he nɛ a jaa mi ngɛ ɔ.
Se nyɛ kpale nyɛ nya se, nɛ nyɛ pue ye hɛ mi si.
Nyɛ nyɔguɛhi, nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a ye a he ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya a, nyɛ ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ nyɛ ba nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a ba pee nyɛ nyɔguɛhi ekohu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ gbo tue; nyɛ ha we nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ, Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye a he.
Saminya!
Imi lɛɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he mɔ!
Ma ngmɛɛ nyɛ he kɛ wo gbenɔ dɛ mi, nɛ ta, hiɔ, kɛ hwɔ maa gbe nyɛ.
Nɛ ma ha nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ tsuo a mi.
-I kɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, Yerusalem ma nimeli ɔmɛ, matsɛ we ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo so somi.
Okadi nɛ a pee ji a gbe na bi, nɛ a gba mi enyɔ, nɛ a nyɛɛ fa enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi kɛ be.
Se a yi somi ɔ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ a pee na bi ɔ, ja nɔuu ma pee mɛ.
Ma je mɛ kɛ wo a he nyɛli, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ, a dɛ mi.
A gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pee lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi a niye ní.
Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia kɛ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu, ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo a he nyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ a dɛ mi.
Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo Babilonia tabo ɔ nɛ jɔɔ nyɛ se nyɛɛmi ɔ a dɛ mi.
Ma fa mɛ, nɛ a maa kpale kɛ ba ma nɛ ɔ mi ekohu.
A ma ba tua ma a; a maa ngɔ ma a, nɛ a maa sã ma a. Ma ha nɛ Yuda ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ma amɛ a mi hie hu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yeremia kɛ Rekab bi ɔmɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim, Yosia bi ɔ yi nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa Rekab bi ɔmɛ a we ɔ mi nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya tu munyu.
Ke o kɛ mɛ tu munyu ɔ gbe nya a, ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba tsu kake mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ o ba ha mɛ wai nɛ a nu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i ya ngɔ Rekab we ɔ tsuo kɛ ba.
Mɛ ji Yaazania, Habazinia bi Yeremia bi ɔ, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo.
I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ ba wo gbalɔ Hanan, Igdalia bi ɔ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi.
Tsu nɛ ɔ ngɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ kasa nya, ngɛ Shalum bi Maaseya tsu ɔ yiti je.
Maaseya ji agbo nya bulɔ.
Jehanɛ, i ngɔ buɛhi, kɛ kpluhi nɛ wai hyi mɛ tɔ kɛ ma Rekab bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ nu dã.” Se a he nɔ ke, “Wa be wai nue, ejakaa wa nɛ̃, Yonadab wo wɔ mlaa ke wa ko nu wai ligbi ko ligbi ko, wɔ jio, wa nina jio.
E ke wa ko po we, wa ko du ní, wa ko pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ wa ko hi ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko.
E wo wɔ mlaa ke waa hi bo tsu mi wa wami be ɔ tsuo, konɛ wa se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ wa ba to nubwɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.
Mlaa nɛ wa nɛ̃, Yonadab, Rekab bi ɔ wo wɔ ke wa ko nu dã wa wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, wa ngɛ nɔ yee, nɛ wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nui dã wɔ nitsɛmɛ jio, wa yi ɔmɛ jio, wa binyumu ɔmɛ jio, wa biyi ɔmɛ jio.
-Jã kɛ̃, wa mɛ wehi nɛ waa hi a mi; bo tsuhi a mi wa ngɛ.
Wai ngmɔ, loo zugba, loo blɛfo be wa dɛ.
Mlaa nɛ wa nɛ̃, Yonadab wo wɔ ɔ, wa ye lɛ tsuo nɔ.
Se benɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ba tua zugba a, wa ya ye Babilonia kɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ a tabo ɔmɛ gbeye, nɛ wa pee wa yi mi kaa wa maa tu fo kɛ je a nya kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Enɛ ɔ he je lɛ wa ba ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nɛ.” -Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke ma ya nɛ ma ya de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke “Imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ bie ke anɛ nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ maa kase ní lo.
Mɛni he je nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ maa bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue?
Mlaa nɛ Yonadab, Rekab bi ɔ wo e nina ke a ko nu wai ɔ, a ye nɔ.
Nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nui dã.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ kpamisa nɛ ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue, se nyɛ bui mi tue fɛɛ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ.
A ba deɔ nyɛ ke nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
A bɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ ke nyɛ ko ja mawu kpahi, nɛ nyɛ ko sɔmɔ mɛ hulɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ hi zugba a nɛ i ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ.
Se nyɛ bui mi tue, nɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ hu nyɛ ngɔɛ.
Yonadab nina ye mlaa nɛ a nɛ̃ wo mɛ ɔ nɔ, se nyɛ ma nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ bui mi tue fɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, bɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ Yuda ma, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi, ní yayamihi tsuo nɛ i wo si ke e maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ba nyɛ nɔ jehanɛ.
Ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu, se nyɛ nui; i tsɛ nyɛ, se nyɛ he we nɔ.” Se Rekab we ɔ lɛɛ i de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mlaa nɛ nyɛ nɛ̃, Yonadab wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ye nɔ; blɔ nyahi tsuo nɛ e to, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ pee pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ si woe kaa nyumu nɛ ma sɔmɔ mi be Yonadab, Rekab bi ɔ we mi tae gblegbleegble.’ ”
Baruk kane womi kpo ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu nɛ e de ke, “Yaa hla womi kpo nɛ o ngma níhi tsuo nɛ i de mo nɛ kɔɔ Israel, Yuda, kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a he ɔ kɛ wo mi.
Ngmaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de mo kɛ je be nɛ i kɛ mo tu munyu kekleekle ngɛ matsɛ, Yosia yi nɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Eko piɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ maa nu kaa i to ye yi mi kaa ma kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ a maa kpale kɛ je a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ke a pee ja a, ma ngɔ a tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i tsɛ Baruk, Neria bi ɔ, nɛ munyuhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu ɔ, i tsɛ ha lɛ, nɛ e ngma kɛ wo womi kpo ko mi.
Jehanɛ, i de Baruk ke, “A ha we mi blɔ kaa ma ya Yawɛ we ɔ hu.
Se ma suɔ nɛ moo lɛɛ o ya lejɛ ɔ be mi nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae.
Yaa kane womi kpo ɔ, ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ́ ma a tsuo nɛ nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de mi, nɛ imi hu i tsɛ ha mo nɛ o ngma a. Kane womi kpo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ Yuda bi nɛ je a ma amɛ a mi kɛ ba a, mɛ hu a nu.
Alini a maa fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ a maa kpale kɛ je a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ; ejakaa abofu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ tu munyu kɛ si ma nɛ ɔ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Neria bi Baruk ya kane Yawɛ munyu ɔmɛ nɛ e ngma kɛ wo womi kpo ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim, Yosia bi ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne ɔ mi ɔ, Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ nihi nɛ je Yuda ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ ha hwɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Baruk kane nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ kɛ ha ma a tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi kpo ɔ mi ɔ. E kane womi kpo nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, ngɛ Gemaria, Shafan bi ɔ tsu ɔ mi.
Gemaria nɛ ɔ ji matsɛ pɛdiyo, nɛ e tsu ɔ ngɛ yiti je kue ɔ mi, ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ agbo he ɔ sinya a nya.
A kane womi kpo ɔ kɛ ha ma nimeli ɔmɛ Benɛ Mikaya, Shafan bi Gemaria bi ɔ nu níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ de, kaa bɔ nɛ a kane kɛ je womi kpo ɔ mi ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho matsɛ we ɔ mi ya, nɛ e ya na ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a bua a he nya ngɛ matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ tsu ɔ mi.
Nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji Elishama, matsɛ pɛdiyo; Delaya, Shemaya bi ɔ; Elnatan, Akbor bi ɔ; Gemaria, Shafan bi ɔ; Zedekia, Hanania bi ɔ, kɛ ma nimeli kpa amɛ tsuo.
Mikaya bɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e nu nɛ Baruk kane kɛ je womi kpo ɔ mi kɛ ha ma a. Kɛkɛ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo tsɔ Yehudi ke e ya de Baruk nɛ e ngɔ womi kpo ɔ nɛ e kane kɛ ha ma a kɛ ba.
Nɛ Neria bi Baruk hɛɛ womi ɔ kɛ ba.
(Yehudi nɛ ɔ, Kushi bi Shelemia lɛɛ e bi Netania bi ji lɛ).
Benɛ Baruk ba a, a de lɛ ke, “Hii si, nɛ o kane womi ɔ nɛ waa nu.” Nɛ Baruk pee ja.
Benɛ a nu munyu ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, a tsui po.
Mɛ tsuo a plɛ hyɛ a sibi a hɛ mi, nɛ a de Baruk ke, “E hia kaa wa ya sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔ ha matsɛ ɔ.” A bi Baruk ekohu ke, “Kɛ o pee kɛ ngma munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛɛ?
Anɛ Yeremia lɛ tsɛ munyu ɔmɛ kɛ ha mo lo?
De wɔ koo!” Baruk he nɔ ke, “Yeremia nitsɛ lɛ e tsɛ munyu ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha mi, nɛ i kɛ ni ngmami nyu ngma kɛ wo womi kpo ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ de Baruk ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya laa o he, o kɛ Yeremia tsuo.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ le he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ.” Matsɛ ɔ sã womi kpo ɔ Ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɔ womi kpo ɔ kɛ to Elishama, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ho ya na matsɛ ɔ ngɛ e kue ɔ mi, nɛ a bɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Matsɛ ɔ tsɔ Yehudi ke e ya nɛ e ya ngɔ womi kpo ɔ kɛ ba.
Yehudi ya ngɔ womi kpo ɔ ngɛ Elishama tsu ɔ mi kɛ ba, nɛ e ba kane ha matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ daa si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ kasa nya a. Nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne, loo fĩɛ be ji jamɛ a be ɔ nɛ; nɛ matsɛ ɔ hii si ngɛ tsu nɛ e yeɔ fĩɛ be ngɛ mi ɔ mi, nɛ ngɛyu kɛ e mi la nɛ tsɛ̃ maa si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Ke Yehudi kane womi ba fa etɛ, loo eywiɛ gbe nya pɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ha bi ko po mɛ, kɛkɛ e sake kɛ wo la mi ngɛ ngɛyu ɔ mi.
Matsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e pee ja hluu kɛ ya si womi kpo ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ sã.
Se matsɛ ɔ jio, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ nu sane nɛ ɔ jio, nɔ ko nɔ ko yi gbeye; nɔ ko nɔ ko hu hía we e tade kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ ɔ hao lɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa Elnatan, Delaya, kɛ Gemaria kpa matsɛ ɔ pɛɛ ke e ko sã womi kpo ɔ, se e bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa matsɛbinyumu Yerameel, kɛ Seraya, Azriel bi ɔ, kɛ Shelemia, Abdeel bi ɔ ke a nu imi, kɛ ye womi ngmalɔ Baruk ɔ tsuo.
Se Yawɛ ngɔ wɔ kɛ laa.
Yeremia ngma womi kpo ehe Benɛ Matsɛ Yehoyakim sã womi kpo ɔ nɛ i tsɛ munyu ɔmɛ kɛ ha Baruk nɛ e ngma wo mi ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma kɛ̃ womi kpo kpa, konɛ níhi tsuo nɛ i ngma kɛ wo kekle womi kpo ɔ mi ɔ, ma ngma kɛ wo enɛ ɔ hu mi.
Yawɛ de mi ke ma de Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim ke, “O sã womi kpo ɔ, nɛ o bi Yeremia ke mɛni he je e ngma ke Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba kpata zugba nɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e maa gbe e mi nimli, kɛ lohwehi tsuo lo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo, Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘O nina ko nina ko be Matsɛ David sɛ ɔ nɔ hie gblegbleegble.
Ke o gbo ɔ, a ma sake o gbogboe ɔ kɛ fɔ he; piani ɔ, pu maa tsoo lɛ, nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi jɔ yluduu maa fia lɛ.
Ma gbla mo, kɛ o nina, kɛ o ma nimeli ɔmɛ a tue ngɛ nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Mo jio, Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ jio, Yuda bi ɔmɛ jio, nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko bui ye kɔkɔ bɔmi munyu ɔmɛ tue fɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ní yayamihi nɛ i to kaa a maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ ma ha nɛ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ maa ba nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ̃ womi kpo kpa kɛ ha Baruk, womi ngmalɔ ɔ, nɛ e ngma munyuhi tsuo nɛ i tsɛ kɛ ha lɛ ɔ kɛ wo mi.
Lɔ ɔmɛ ji munyuhi tsuo nɛ a ngma kɛ wo kekle womi kpo ɔ nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim sã a mi, kɛ munyu kpahi babauu nɛ piɛ he.
Zedekia ba bi Yeremia nɔ́ ko Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar wo Zedekia, Yosia bi ɔ Yuda matsɛ ngɛ Yehoyakim bi Yehoyakin nane mi.
Se sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ha mi ɔ, lɛ Zedekia a, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo bui tue fɛɛ.
Matsɛ Zedekia tsɔ Yehukal, Shelemia bi ɔ, kɛ osɔfo Zefania, Maaseya bi ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ke a ba de mi nɛ ma kpa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ha wa ma a. Jamɛ a be ɔ, a wui mi tsu lolo, nɛ i nyɛɛɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Babilonia tabo ɔ ba sa Yerusalem ma a yi momo.
Se benɛ a nu kaa Farao ɔ tabo ɔ je Egipt kɛ ma a, a gbee senyasenya kɛ je Yerusalem.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de mi ke ma ya de Zedekia ke, “Farao ɔ tabo ɔ nɛ ba piɛ o he ɔ maa kpale a se kɛ ya mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ngɛ Egipt.
Ke a je ɔ, Babilonia bi ɔmɛ maa kpale kɛ ba, nɛ a ma ba tua ma nɛ ɔ ekohu.
A maa ngɔ ma a, nɛ a maa mɛ he la.
Imi Yawɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he; nyɛ ko susu kaa Babilonia bi ɔmɛ be kpalee kɛ ba hu.
A maa ba kokooko!
Ke e ba mi kaa nyɛ ye Babilonia tabo ɔ tsuo nɔ, nɛ e piɛ nihi nɛ plaa kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ a bo tsuhi a mi po, jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa te si nɛ a maa sã ma nɛ ɔ kɛ̃.” A nu Yeremia kɛ wo tsu Benɛ Egipt tabo ɔ ma, nɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ je Yerusalem ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, imi hu i je Yerusalem kɛ yaa Benyamin zugba a nɔ, konɛ weku weto ní ɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ma ya ngɔ ye blɔ fa mi nɔ́.
Se benɛ i su Benyamin agbo ɔ nya a, bulɔ ko nu mi nɛ e po ye nya ke, “Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ o tu fo kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Bulɔ ɔ nɛ nu mi ɔ biɛ ji Iriya, nɛ Hanania bi Shelemia lɛɛ e bi ji lɛ.
I he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!
Pi Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ i tu fo kɛ yaa!” Se Iriya bui mi tue.
Mohu ɔ, e nu mi kɛ ya ha ma nimeli ɔmɛ.
Ma nimeli ɔmɛ a mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
A fia mi ní, nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Yonatan ɔ we ɔ mi.
(Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a kɛ lejɛ ɔ pee he nɛ a woɔ nɔ tsu ngɛ.)
A kɛ mi wo tsu ko nɛ mi wo diblii mi ngɛ zugba a sisi, nɛ i hi lejɛ ɔ be babauu.
Be ko se ɔ, Matsɛ Zedekia tsɔ nɛ a ba ngɔ mi kɛ ba e ngɔ.
Nɛ e bi mi ngɛ laami mi zaa ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ke, “Anɛ sɛ gbi ko je Yawɛ ngɔ lo?” I he nɔ ke, “Ee, sɛ gbi ko ba!” I ya nɔ nɛ i de lɛ ke, “A maa ngɔ mo kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi.” Jehanɛ, i bi Matsɛ Zedekia ke, “Mɛni yayami i pee mo, loo o tsɔli ɔmɛ, loo ma nɛ ɔ, loko nyɛ wo mi tsu ɔ?
O gbali ɔmɛ nɛ de mo ke Babilonia matsɛ ɔ be bae nɛ e ba tua mo, loo zugba nɛ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛnɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu mi tue, nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ ma bi mo ɔ ha mi.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, ko ha nɛ a kpale mi kɛ ya wo tsu ngɛ matsɛ pɛdiyo Yonatan we ɔ mi hu.
Ke o pee ja a, ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Zedekia fa, nɛ a ya wo mi tsu ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ kue ɔ mi.
Daa ligbi ɔ a jeɔ abolo sali ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ, ba haa mi abolo bɔbɔɛ kake.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ hluu kɛ ya si abolo ta ma a mi tsuo.
A kɛ Yeremia wo vu mi Shefatia, Matan bi ɔ, Gedalia, Pashur bi ɔ, Yehukal, Shelemia bi ɔ, kɛ Pashur, Malkia bi ɔ ba nu kaa i ngɛ ma a dee ke Yawɛ de ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hi ma a mi ɔ, ta, loo hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ e he ya ha Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ɔ, a be lɛ gbee; e yi ma na wami.” Jehanɛ, a nu nɛ i de ma a ke Yawɛ de ke, “I kɛ ma nɛ ɔ ma ha Babilonia tabo ɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ ma a.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Ha nɛ a gbe nyumu nɛ ɔ. Munyuhi nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ ha nɛ ta buli nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ a kɔni mi ngɛ jɔe.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, ma a si gbeemi e ngɛ hlae, se pi ma a nɔ yami.” Matsɛ Zedekia de mɛ ke, “Saminya!
E ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee lɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee lɛ.
I be nyɛe ma tsi nyɛ nya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a nu mi nɛ a kɛ kpa siu mi kɛ wo matsɛbinyumu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Malkia a e vu mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ kue ɔ mi.
Nyu be vu ɔ mi; mɔsɔ kɛkɛ lɛ ngɛ mi.
Nɛ i pu ngɛ mɔsɔ ɔ mi.
Se Ebedmelek, Etiopia no nɛ a puɛ lɛ, nɛ e tsuɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ nu kaa a kɛ mi wo vu mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ngɛ sane mi hyɛe ngɛ Benyamin agbo ɔ nya.
Ebedmelek ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, nɔ́ nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ pee nɛ ɔ dɛ.
Vu ɔ mi nɛ a ngɔ gbalɔ Yeremia ya wo nɛ ɔ, hwɔ maa gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa niye ní ta ma a mi.” Matsɛ ɔ fa Ebedmelek ke e ya ngɔ nyumuhi etɛ kɛ piɛ e he, nɛ a ba gbla mi kɛ je vu ɔ mi nɛ ma ko gbo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Ebedmelek kɛ nyumu ɔmɛ ya matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ a ya hla tako piɛ, kɛ bo gbagbɛ ngɛ daka ko mi ngɛ nito he ɔ.
A kɛ kpa fi ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a siu kɛ ba ha mi ngɛ vu ɔ mi.
Ebedmelek, Etiopia no ɔ de mi ke ma ngɔ tako piɛ ɔ, kɛ bo gbagbɛ ɔ kɛ wo ye ngasi, ngɛ kpa a sisi.
I pee ja, kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ tangme kpa gbla mi kɛ je vu ɔ mi, nɛ a ya wo mi tsu ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ kue ɔ mi.
Zedekia bi Yeremia ga womi Ligbi ko ɔ, Matsɛ Zedekia tsɔ nɛ a ba ngɔ mi kɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ agbo etɛne ɔ nya.
Matsɛ ɔ de mi ke, “Ma bi mo munyu ko.
O kɛ nɔ́ ko kó laa mi.” I he nɔ ke, “Ke i tu anɔkuale ɔ, o maa gbe mi, nɛ ke i wo mo ga hu, o be tue bue.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Zedekia ka mi kita ngɛ laami mi ke, “I na Yawɛ hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ ha wɔ wami ɔ kaa i be mo gbee; nimli nɛ ngɛ mo hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ, mɛ hu i be mo ngɔe kɛ wo a dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de Zedekia ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ke o maa ya nɛ o ya nu Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a nane ɔ, a maa ngɔ o wami kɛ ke mo, nɛ a be ma nɛ ɔ sãe.
A ma he o kɛ o we ɔ tsuo nyɛ yi wami.
Se ke o yɛ nɛ o ya nu a nane ɔ, lɛɛ a maa ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ a maa sã ma a. Ke e ba mi ja a, o be nyɛe maa tu fo kɛ je a dɛ.’ ” Se Matsɛ Zedekia de mi ke, “Wa nyɛmimɛ Hebri bi ɔmɛ nɛ tu fo kɛ ya piɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, i ngɛ gbeye yee kaa a maa ngɔ mi kɛ wo mɛ mohu a dɛ, nɛ a maa pee mi basabasa.” I de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, a be mo ngɔe kɛ wo a dɛ.
I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ i kɛ ha mo nɛ ɔ tue.
Ke o pee ja a, e maa hi ha mo, nɛ o yi ma na wami.
Se ke o kplɛɛ we kaa o maa ya nɛ o ya ha yi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ je tsɔɔ mi ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I na nɛ a ngɔ yi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ngɛ Yuda matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ kɛ yaa Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Benɛ a yaa a, nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Matsɛ ɔ huɛmɛ kpakpa amɛ sisi lɛ nɛ a ye e nɔ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ e nane pu mɔsɔ lɛɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ je e he?’ ” Jehanɛ, i de matsɛ ɔ ke, “A ma kpaka o yi ɔmɛ, kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ya ha Babilonia bi ɔmɛ, nɛ mo nitsɛ hu o be a dɛ mi jee.
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ maa nu mo, nɛ ma nɛ ɔ lɛɛ a maa sã.” Zedekia de mi ke, “Ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ le nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ mo sɛɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a be mo gbee.
Ke ma nimeli ɔmɛ nu kaa i kɛ mo sɛɛ ní ɔ, a ma ba bi mo nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ mo sɛɛ ɔ.
A maa wo mo si ke o de mɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛkɛ a be mo gbee.
Ke a ba o ngɔ kɛ munyu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, moo lɛɛ de mɛ ke pe o ba fa kue ha mi nɛ ma ko ha nɛ a ngɔ mo kɛ ya wo tsu hu, nɛ o ba gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba nɛ a ba bi mi munyu, nɛ imi hu i ha mɛ heto pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mi ke ma de mɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ye nya doomi, ejakaa ní ɔ nɛ i kɛ matsɛ ɔ sɛɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nui he.
I hi tsu ɔ mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ kue ɔ mi kɛ ya si a ba ngɔ Yerusalem.
A kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji nyɔngma a mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ngɔ e tabo ɔ tsuo kɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ e ba sa ma a yi.
Benɛ Zedekia ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ kake ngɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, jamɛ a jeha a we nyɔhiɔ eywiɛne ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ, a ywia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ nɛ a je puɔ ngɛ mi.
Benɛ a ngɔ Yerusalem ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba hi si ngɛ a blɔ hehi ngɛ kpɛti agbo ɔ mi.
A ti ni komɛ ji Nergal Sarezer, Samgar Nebo, Sarsekim, kɛ Nergal Sarezer kpa ko.
Benɛ Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo na mɛ ɔ, a tu fo kɛ je ma a mi nyɔ ɔ mi.
A gu matsɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi, kɛ ya be ngɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, nɛ a tu fo kɛ yaa Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi je.
Se Babilonia tabo ɔ nyɛɛ a se, nɛ a ya nu Zedekia ngɛ Yeriko nga a nɔ.
A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ha Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ Ribla, ngɛ Hamat zugba a nɔ.
Nɛ lejɛ ɔ Nebukadnezar kojo lɛ nɛ e bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ.
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ gbe Zedekia bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Zedekia hɛ mi.
E gbe Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ja nɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ta Zedekia hɛngmɛ.
E ha nɛ a bɔ lɛ pã, nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya.
Babilonia bi ɔmɛ sã matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a wehi, nɛ a ku Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
Nebuzaradan, tatsɛ ɔ nuu nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ku kɛ ba piɛ e he ɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya.
Se Nebuzaradan, tatsɛ ɔ si ohiatsɛmɛ komɛ nɛ weto ní be a dɛ ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ wai ngmɔhi kɛ zugba.
A je Yeremia ngɛ tsu mi Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar fa Nebuzaradan, tatsɛ ɔ fami nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yeremia he ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya ngɔ Yeremia, nɛ o hyɛ e nɔ saminya.
Koo pee lɛ yayami ko; se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, pee ha lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Nebuzaradan, tatsɛ ɔ, kɛ asafoatsɛnguahi Nebushazban kɛ Nergal Sarezer, kɛ Babilonia matsɛ we asafoatsɛngua kpa amɛ tsuo ba ngɔ mi kɛ je tsu ɔ mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ.
A ngɔ mi kɛ wo Shafan bi Ahikam bi Gedalia dɛ, konɛ e hyɛ nɛ ma ya su we mi.
Nɛ i hi ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha Ebedmelek Benɛ i ngɛ tsu mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke ma ya de Ebedmelek, Etiopia no ɔ ke bɔ nɛ lɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Kaa bɔ nɛ i de to ɔ, ma ha nɛ haomi maa ba ma nɛ ɔ nɔ, se pi nɔ́ kpakpa.
Nɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba a, o maa na paa kɛ o hɛngmɛ.
Se moo lɛɛ ma he o yi wami jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɛ a be mo ngɔe kɛ wo nihi nɛ o ngɛ mɛ gbeye yee ɔ a dɛ mi.
Ma baa o yi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo gbee.
O maa ye o he, ejakaa o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ ye nɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yeremia ya hi Gedalia ngɔ Nebuzaradan, tatsɛ ɔ, ngɔ mi ngɛ pã mi kɛ ya Rama.
I piɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ yaa Babilonia a a he.
Se imi lɛɛ e ngmɛɛ ye he ngɛ Rama, nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Tatsɛ ɔ tsɛ mi kɛ ya se, nɛ e de mi ke, “Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ de to ke e ma kpata zugba nɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ná pee nɔ́ nɛ e de to ke e maa pee ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba nyɛ nɔ, ejakaa nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ bui lɛ tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ pã nɛ ɔ jee ngɛ o kɔni si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Ke o suɔ kaa o kɛ mi maa ya Babilonia a, i kɛ mo maa ya nɛ ma ya hyɛ o nɔ saminya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se ke e dɛ ha mo kaa o kɛ mi maa ya a, lɛɛ mo ko ya.
Hyɛ, zugba a tsuo lɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
He tsuaa he nɛ hi ha mo nɛ o suɔ kaa o maa ya a, yaa.” Benɛ i na we nɛ ma ha lɛ heto ɔ, Nebuzaradan de mi ke, “Moo kpale o se kɛ ya Gedalia ngɔ.
Shafan bi Ahikam bi Gedalia nɛ ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ wo lɛ Yuda ma amɛ a nɔ amlaalo.
Yaa nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya hi si ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ke o sume lejɛ ɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ o suɔ kaa o maa ya a, yaa.” Tatsɛ ɔ ha mi niye ní, kɛ nike ní, nɛ e wo mi blɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i je kɛ ho Ahikam bi Gedalia ngɔ ya ngɛ Mizpa, nɛ i kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ya hi si.
Gedalia, Yuda amlaalo ɔ Se Yuda asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ekomɛ lɛɛ a yɛ nɛ a ya ngɔ a he kɛ ha lolo.
A nu kaa Babilonia matsɛ ɔ wo Gedalia amlaalo ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ nihi tsuo nɛ a kɛ mɛ yɛ Babilonia lolo, nɛ ji zugba a nɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo e dɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a we bi ɔmɛ tsuo ba Gedalia ngɔ ngɛ Mizpa.
Mɛ ji Ishmael, Natania bi ɔ, Yohanan, Karea bi ɔ, Seraya, Tanhumet bi ɔ, Efai nɛ je Netofa a bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Yezania nɛ je Maaka a. Gedalia de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ kita kae kaa nyɛ ko ye gbeye kaa nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ he ya ha Babilonia bi ɔmɛ.
Nyɛɛ hi zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ e maa hi ha nyɛ.
Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ ma hi Mizpa kaa nyɛ nya dalɔ, nɛ ke Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, ma tu munyu ha nyɛ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya bua wai, kɛ tso yibliihi, kɛ oliv nu nya kɛ to, nɛ nyɛɛ hi mahi nɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ a mi.” Israel bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Moab, Amon, Edom kɛ zugba kpa amɛ a nɔ ɔ ba nu kaa Babilonia matsɛ ɔ si Israel bi komɛ ngɛ Yuda, nɛ e ngɔ Shafan bi Ahikam bi Gedalia ngɔ to a nya kaa amlaalo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je hehi tsuo nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ ho ɔ, nɛ a kpale kɛ ba Yuda zugba a nɔ.
A ba Gedalia ngɔ ngɛ Mizpa, nɛ a ba bua wai kɛ tso yibliihi babauu nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A gbe Gedalia Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yohanan, Karea bi ɔ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ta nga a nɔ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɔɛ a he ya ha we Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ba Gedalia ngɔ ngɛ Mizpa.
A ba de lɛ ke, “Anɛ o li kaa Amon matsɛ, Baalis tsɔ Netania bi Ishmael kɛ ba nɛ a ba gbe mo lo?” Se Gedalia he we mɛ yi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yohanan de lɛ ngɛ laami mi ke, “Ha nɛ ma ya nɛ ma ya gbe Ishmael, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lee.
Mɛni he je e sa kaa e gbe mo ɔ?
Ke e pee ja a, Yuda bi tsuo nɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ o ngɔ ɔ maa gbɛ fĩa, nɛ Yuda ma nɛ piɛ ɔ a hɛ mi ma kpata.” Se Gedalia he nɔ ke, “Koo pee ja!
Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee ngɛ Ishmael he ɔ be mi!”
Jamɛ a jeha a mi nɔuu, nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, Elishama bi Netania bi Ishmael kɛ nyumuhi nyɔngma ba Gedalia ngɔ ngɛ Mizpa.
Ishmael je matsɛ we mi, nɛ matsɛ tsɔli nikɔtɔma amɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake ji lɛ.
Benɛ mɛ tsuo a bua nɛ a ngɛ ní yee ɔ, Ishmael kɛ nyumuhi nyɔngma nɛ piɛ e he ɔ hia klaate wo Gedalia he, nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Israel bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Gedalia ngɔ ngɛ Mizpa, kɛ Babilonia ta buli nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Ishmael gbe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E nɔ jena benɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nui he lolo kaa a gbe Gedalia a, nyumuhi nyingmi kpaanyɔ komɛ je Shekem, Shilo, kɛ Samaria kɛ ba.
Nɛ a ma a, a sɛ a kpɛnihi, nɛ a hía a he tadehi, nɛ a je blɔ nɛ a plaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.
A hɛɛ niye ní bɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a dɛ mi kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Ishmael, Netania bi ɔ je Mizpa ya kpee mɛ; benɛ e yaa a tsuo, e ngɛ ya foe ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Benɛ e kɛ mɛ ya bua a, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba waa ho Ahikam bi Gedalia ngɔ ya.” Benɛ a ba su ma a mi pɛ, Ishmael kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a sake a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ wo vu ko mi.
Se a ti ni nyɔngma de Ishmael ke, “Koo gbe wɔ!
Wa ngɔ ngma, blɛfo, oliv nu, kɛ hwo ngɔ laa ngɛ nga a mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he, nɛ e gbi mɛ ngɔ piɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Vu ɔ nɛ Ishmael sake nihi tsuo nɛ e gbe ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ wo mi ɔ, jamɛ a vu ɔ, Matsɛ Asa lɛ tsua.
Matsɛ ɔ tsua vu nɛ ɔ be mi nɛ Israel matsɛ, Baasha ba tua lɛ ɔ.
Vu nɛ ɔ mi lɛ Netania bi Ishmael sake ni gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ wo tɔ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ Ishmael nuu nihi tsuo nɛ piɛ ngɛ Mizpa a kɛ je.
Matsɛbiyi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ tatsɛ Nebuzaradan ngɔ kɛ wo Ahikam bi Gedalia dɛ mi po, Ishmael nuu mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ yaa Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Benɛ Yohanan, Karea bi ɔ, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ e he ɔ nu ní yayamihi nɛ Netania bi Ishmael pee ɔ, a ngɔ a ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ nyɛɛ e se konɛ a kɛ lɛ ya hwu ta.
A ya na lɛ ngɛ taku agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Gibeon ɔ kasa nya.
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ Ishmael nuu ɔ na Karea bi Yohanan, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ, a nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tu fo kɛ ba Yohanan ngɔ.
Se Ishmael kɛ e we bi kpaanyɔ komɛ lɛɛ a je Yohanan dɛ mi, nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ya.
Jehanɛ, ni ɔmɛ nɛ Netania bi Ishmael nuu kɛ je Mizpa kɛ yaa benɛ e gbe Ahikam bi Gedalia se ɔ, Yohanan kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ba ngɔ mɛ: ta buli, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ nyumuhi nɛ a puɛ mɛ.
-A ye Babilonia bi ɔmɛ gbeye, ejakaa Netania bi Ishmael gbe Ahikam bi Gedalia, nɔ nɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ngɔ to a nya kaa amlaalo ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ ka Egipt blɔ, konɛ a tu fo kɛ je Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a nya.
Benɛ a yaa a, a ya to si ngɛ Kimham, ngɛ Betlehem kasa nya.
Ma a de Yeremia ke e fa kue ha mɛ Jehanɛ Karea bi Yohanan, Heshaya bi Azaria, kɛ tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo; nimli wawi kɛ nimli nguahi ba, nɛ a ba de mi ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ wa ma bi mo ɔ ha wɔ!
Kpa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ha waa kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a yi na wami ɔ.
Be ko ɔ, wa he hiɛ babauu, se piɔ lɛɛ wɔ nihi bɔɔ pɛ lɛ piɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ɔ. Kpa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ pɛɛ konɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ nɛ wa maa nyɛɛ nɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa wɔ peemi.” I he nɔ ke, “Saminya!
Ma kpa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ha nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ bi ɔ; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mi ɔ, ma ba bɔ nyɛ.
I be nyɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ laae.” Mɛ hu a de mi ke, “Sɛ gbi tsuaa sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ma ha mo ke o ba de wɔ ɔ, wa maa ye nɔ.
Ke wa pee we ja a, Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ ye odase kɛ si wɔ!
Wa suɔ jio, wa sume jio, wa maa bu Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ wa tsɔ mo e ngɔ ɔ tue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e hi ha wɔ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ, wa maa bu lɛ tue.” Yawɛ ha Yeremia heto Ligbi nyɔngma se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpee Karea bi Yohanan, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ e he ɔ, kɛ ma a tsuo, ni wawi kɛ ni nguahi, nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ nyɛ tsɔ mi e ngɔ ke ma ya kpa lɛ pɛɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ke nyɛ maa hi zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ma gbaa nyɛ, nɛ i be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae; ma to nyɛ si, nɛ i be nyɛ hiae hu.
E dɔ mi babauu kaa i gbla nyɛ tue kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko ye Babilonia matsɛ ɔ gbeye hu.
I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ ma je nyɛ kɛ je e dɛ mi.
Ma na nyɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ya nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ -“Se nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ piɛ ngɛ Yuda a, nyɛ ko de ke nyɛ be Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue bue; nyɛ ko de ke nyɛ be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ hie.
Nyɛ ko de ke, ‘Dɛbi, wa yaa nɛ wa ya hi Egipt zugba a nɔ; ta ba be wɔ nae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; wa be ta titimati ko hu he nue, nɛ hwɔ be wɔ yee hulɔ.’ Ke nyɛ de ja a, lɛɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Ke nyɛ pee nyɛ yi mi kaa nyɛ ma ya hi Egipt ɔ, lɛɛ ta a nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gbeye yee ɔ ma ba na nyɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; mi mi hwɔ nɛ nyɛ tsui ngɛ poe ngɛ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se, nɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ nɔuu nyɛ ma gbo ngɛ.
Nyɛ ti nihi tsuo nɛ maa pee a yi mi kaa a ma ya hi Egipt ɔ, ke a nɔɛ ta a, lɛɛ mi mi hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe mɛ.
Tue gblami nɛ i kɛ maa ba jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be piɛe, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu he be mi jee.’ “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ i ngɔ ye mi mi la nɛ nya wa a kɛ kple Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, ja pɛ ma pee nyɛ ke nyɛ je kɛ ho Egipt ya.
Nyɛ ma plɛ pee kita kami nɔ́, gbeye nɔ́, gbiɛmi nɔ́, kɛ ahlua nɔ́.
Nyɛ be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nae hu.’ ” I ya nɔ nɛ i de ke, “Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ piɛ ngɛ Yuda a, Yawɛ de nyɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ ko ya Egipt.’ Nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa i bɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, kaa blɔ nɛ nyɛ hia a, blɔ ɔ dɛ, nɛ tue gblami nɛ maa nyɛɛ se ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ wami ma he.
Nyɛ de mi ke ma kpa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ wo si ke nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ maa pee.
Lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ i de nyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ tsɔ mi ke ma ba de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bui tue fɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le klɛdɛɛ kaa he nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ ma ya hi ɔ, nyɛ ma ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ ya nɔɛ ta a, lɛɛ mi mi hwɔ, loo gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe nyɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”
A ngɔ Yeremia kɛ ho Egipt ya I bɔ ma a níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ tsɔ mi ke ma ba de mɛ ɔ. Benɛ i gbe nya a, Hoshaya bi Azaria, Karea bi Yohanan, kɛ nyumuhi he nɔ woli kpa amɛ tsuo de mi ke, “Lakpa munyu o ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ tsɔ we mo ke o ba de wɔ ke wa ko ya hi Egipt.
Neria bi Baruk ji nɔ nɛ wo o yi mi nɛ e su mo kɛ wo wa he.
E pee enɛ ɔ konɛ e ngɔ wɔ kɛ wo Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi nɛ a gbe wɔ, loo a nuu wɔ kɛ ya Babilonia.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fami ɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a hi Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bui fɛɛ, Karea bi Yohanan jio, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ jio, ma a jio.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yohanan, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ nihi tsuo nɛ piɛ ngɛ Yuda a kɛ ho Egipt ya.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a fie kɛ ho je ma amɛ a nɔ ya nɛ a kpale kɛ ba a, jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he, nyumuhi, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ matsɛbiyihi.
Imi Yeremia, Neria bi Baruk, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ tatsɛ Nebuzaradan si ha Gedalia nɛ e ngɛ a nɔ hyɛe ɔ, wɔ hu wa piɛ nihi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ho ɔ a he.
A bui Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue, nɛ a je kɛ ho Egipt zugba a nɔ ya, kɛ ya su Tapanhes tɔɔ.
Benɛ wa ngɛ Tapanhes ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa hla tɛ agboagbo komɛ nɛ o pu ngɛ zu mi ngɛ he nɛ a ka tɛ ngɛ, ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ. Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee ɔ, ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a na mo.
De mɛ ke imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i yaa ngɔ Babilonia matsɛ Nebukadnezar, ye tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ. E maa ngɔ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ ba ma tɛ nɛ nyɛ pu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e we akatabai ɔ maa ma lejɛ ɔ. Ke Nebukadnezar ba a, e ma ba kpata Egipt zugba a hɛ mi; nihi nɛ i de to kaa gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe mɛ; nihi nɛ i de to kaa a maa nuu kɛ ho ɔ, a maa nuu mɛ kɛ ho; ni nɛmɛ nɛ i de to kaa a maa nɔ ta a, a maa nɔ ta.
Ma mɛ Egipt mawu ɔmɛ a jami he ɔmɛ a he la, nɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ maa sã mawu ɔmɛ; aloo ke e suɔ ɔ, e maa muɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
Kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ nuɔ ngmo ngɛ e bo mi nɛ e peeɔ lɛ falifali ɔ, ja pɛ Nebukadnezar maa pee Egipt zugba a falifali.
Nɛ ke e gbe nya a, e maa je lejɛ ɔ kɛ tue mi jɔmi.
E maa ku amagahi nɛ a kɛ tɛ pee, nɛ maa si ngɛ Heliopolis ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, nɛ e maa sã Egipt mawu ɔmɛ a jami he ɔmɛ.”
Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ e kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Egipt Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Israel bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ a he, nihi nɛ ngɛ Migdol, Tapanhes, kɛ Memfis ma amɛ a mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a leneyi je ɔ tsuo.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na bɔ nɛ i kpata Yerusalem, kɛ Yuda ma kpa amɛ a hɛ mi.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ma amɛ pee ma dokuhi nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi, ejakaa ma amɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayami, nɛ a wo ye mi mi la.
A sã bɔhi nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔ mawu kpahi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ, loo nyɛ, loo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ po li gblee.
Daa nɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ a ba deɔ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa i hie.
Se nyɛ bui tue.
Nyɛ yaa nɔ nɛ nyɛ sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa mawu kpahi, nɛ nyɛ kpale we kɛ ji nyɛ blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ye mi mi la nɛ nya wa a puɛ ní ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã nɔ́ ɔ. Nɛ ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ a pee ma dokuhi kaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ bie ke mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he yayami nguaa kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ pee?
Anɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ kpata, nyumuhi, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ bimwɔwi, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko piɛ ngɛ Yuda lo?
Nyɛ ngɛ amagahi sɔmɔe, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sãe ha mawu kpahi ngɛ Egipt hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, he nɛ nyɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hi ɔ. Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee kɛ ngɛ ye mi mi la woe ɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee nɛ nyɛ kɛ kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi, konɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a hie nyɛ, nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ biɛ kɛ pee gbiɛmi nɔ́ lo?
Ní yayamihi tsuo nɛ a pee ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, anɛ nyɛ hɛ je nɔ lo?
Níhi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee, níhi nɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a yi ɔmɛ pee, kɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ kɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ pee ɔ, anɛ nyɛ hɛ je nɔ lo?
Se kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ bɛ nyɛ he si.
Nyɛ wui ye hɛ mi nyami, nɛ mlaahi tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ, kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ yi mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i to ye yi mi kaa ma ngɔ haomi kɛ ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ma kpata Yuda tsuo hɛ mi.
Yuda bi nɛ piɛ, nɛ a to a yi mi kaa a maa ya Egipt nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ, ma hyɛ nɛ a kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Mɛ tsuo a ma gbo ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, nimli wawi, kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo.
Ni komɛ ma gbo ngɛ ta mi, nɛ hwɔ maa gbe ni komɛ.
Nihi maa hie mɛ; a maa bɔ mɛ ahlua, nɛ a kɛ a biɛ maa gbiɛ nɔ.
Ma ngɔ ta, hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kɛ gbla nihi nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ a tue kaa bɔ nɛ i gbla Yerusalem tue ɔ. Yuda bi nɛ piɛ, nɛ a ho Egipt ya nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ, a ti nɔ ko he be mi jee, nɛ nɔ ko yi be wami nae.
Yuda zugba a nɛ a ko suɔ nɛ a ba hi mi ekohu ɔ, a ti nihi bɔɔ kɛkɛ lɛ a maa kpale kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ; pi mɛ tsuo.” Nyumuhi tsuo nɛ le kaa a yihi sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa mawu kpahi, yihi tsuo nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ Israel bi nɛ ngɛ Egipt leneyi je ɔ, nimli babauu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo de mi ke, “Munyu ɔ nɛ o kɛ wɔ tu ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ, wa be tue bue fɛɛ.
Níhi tsuo nɛ wa de ke wa maa pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ wa maa pee.
Wa maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha wa yo mawu ɔ nɛ ji hiɔwe manyɛ ɔ, nɛ wa maa sã wai bɔ ha lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ waa kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, wa matsɛ ɔ, kɛ wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ pee be ko ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ niye ní babauu; wa plɔke, nɛ haomi ko be wa nɔ.
Se kɛ je be mi nɛ wa kpa tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ wai bɔ sami kɛ ha hiɔwe manyɛ ɔ, wa yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ ta, kɛ mi mi hwɔ ngɛ wɔ gbee.” Yi ɔmɛ de kɛ piɛ he ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, tse wa bɔɔ keeki kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe manyɛ ɔ su ngɛ ɔ, nɛ́ wa sãã?
Tse wa sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa hiɔwe manyɛ ɔ, nɛ wa sãã wai bɔ haa lɛ?
Anɛ tsa pi wa hunomɛ ɔmɛ a gbi nɔ nɛ wa peeɔ níhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔmɛ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ma a tsuo, nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ke, “Tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ sã ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susu kaa Yawɛ li lo?
Nyɛ bu kaa e hɛ je nɔ?
Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ.
Nyɛ zugba a plɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ a hiee, nɛ nihi kɛ e biɛ gbiɛɛ nɔ; ejakaa nyɛ yi wu tso ní peemi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ ba ti Yawɛ.
Haomi mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kɛ haomi nɛ ɔ ba ji nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.
Nyɛ sã tsopa kɛ e he via ha mawu kpahi; nyɛ bui Yawɛ gbi tue, nɛ e mlaa amɛ, kɛ e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ yi nɔ.” -I de ma a tsuo, titli yi ɔmɛ ke, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɛ Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ tsuo ka hiɔwe manyɛ ɔ kita, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ ní peepee ma nɔ mi.
Nyɛ wo lɛ si veveeve kaa nyɛ maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via ha lɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa sã wai bɔ ha lɛ.
Saminya!
Nyɛɛ pee ja!
Nyɛɛ ye nyɛ si womi ɔ nɔ.
Se jehanɛ, nyɛ Israel bi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Egipt, nyɛɛ bu kita nguaa nɛ imi, Yawɛ hu i ka ye he, ngɛ ye biɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi ɔ tue.
Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, i be nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko blɔ ngmɛe hu nɛ e ngɔ ye biɛ kɛ ka kita nɛ e de ke, ‘I na Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, hɛ kalɔ ɔ!’ Ma hyɛ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hie ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ Israel bi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ nɔ kake ngmelu po he be mi jee.
Nyɛ ti ni komɛ ma gbo ngɛ ta mi, nɛ hwɔ maa gbe ni komɛ.
Se nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ ko kɛ̃ a he maa je mi, nɛ a maa kpale kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ya Yuda zugba a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ loko nihi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ maa le kaa imi lɛ ye munyu ba mi, aloo mɛ.
Imi Yawɛ, ma to nyɛ okadi kaa ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; nɛ lɔ ɔ nyɛɛ kɛ maa na kaa si ko nɛ i wo kaa ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ maa ba mi niinɛ.
Ma ngɔ Egipt matsɛ, Hofra kɛ wo e he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ a dɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia a. I ngɔ Matsɛ Zedekia nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar, nɛ ji e he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ e gbe ɔ dɛ mi.”
Mawu wo Baruk si Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim, Yosia bi ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Neria bi Baruk ngma munyu ɔ nɛ i de lɛ ke e ngma a. Kɛkɛ nɛ i de lɛ ke, Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, “Baruk, munyu nɛ ngɛ o nya jee ji, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ ye yi ta pɛ!
Ejakaa Yawɛ pa ngɔ aywilɛho kɛ piɛ ye haomi ɔ he.
Ye kɛmɛmi ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ, nɛ i be he jɔmi!’ “Se imi Yawɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ma a, lɔ ɔ nɔuu i ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ; nɔ́ nɛ i du ɔ, lɔ ɔ i ngɛ hiae ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ ma pee je ɔ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Moo lɛɛ ní nguahi o ngɛ hlae ha o he?
Ko hla!
Ejakaa ma ngɔ haomi kɛ ba adesahi tsuo a nɔ.
Se moo lɛɛ he tsuaa he nɛ o maa gu ɔ, o he maa je mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
A ye Egipt nɔ ngɛ Karkemish Yawɛ kɛ mi tu je ma amɛ a he munyu; e je sisi kɛ je Egipt nɔ.
Egipt matsɛ, Neko tabo ɔ nɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ye a nɔ ngɛ Karkemish, ngɛ Yufrate pa a nya a, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Sane nɛ ɔ ba ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne ɔ mi.
“Egipt asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke, ‘Nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ nyɛ tsɛi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ hia ta!
Nyɛɛ mia nyɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ hi a nɔ!
Nyɛ bu nyɛ dade pɛɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya da nyɛ blɔ hehi!
Nyɛɛ duɔ nyɛ akplɔ ɔmɛ a nya.
Nyɛ kpla nyɛ ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ!’ ” Yawɛ bi ke, “Se mɛni i ngɛ hyɛe ɔ?
Sawale nu Egipt tabo ɔ, nɛ a gbee senyasenya kɛ ma.
A ye a ta buli kpanaa amɛ a nɔ; a kɛ gbenɔ kɛ kã tu fo kɛ ma kitikiti, nɛ a plɛ we nɛ a hyɛ a se.
Nihi nɛ a he sɔɔ wawɛɛ po, a he be mi jee; ta buli kpanakpanaa amɛ hu, ja nɔuu.
A ma tɛ nɔ́, nɛ a maa nɔɔ si ngɛ omleyi je, ngɛ Yufrate pa a nya.
Mɛnɔ lɛ ma nɛ ɔ, kaa Nilo pa a, kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala kɛ ha zugba a tsuo hɛ mi ɔ?
Egipt lɛ hia kɛ ma kaa Nilo pa a nɛ, kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala kɛ ha zugba a tsuo hɛ mi.
Egipt de ke, ‘Ma hia kɛ ba ha je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi.
Ma kpata mahi, kɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛ okpɔngɔhi, nyɛɛ ya nyɛ hɛ mi esɔ.
Nyɛ zugba lɛhi, nyɛ sa fo!
Nyɛ katsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ je kpo: Sudan kɛ Libia tsɛi hɛɛli, kɛ Lidia kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li nɛ nyɛ nine nya da.’ ” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa ye e he lue; mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, e maa gbla e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.
Yawɛ klaate ɔ maa pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ ye ní nɛ e tɔ, aloo nɔ ko nɛ nu muɔ nɛ e de kaa dã.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɔ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ bɔ sãe ngɛ omleyi je, ngɛ Yufrate pa a tue.
Egipt ma, nyɛɛ ya Gilead nɛ nyɛ ya hla tsopa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!
Tsopahi babauu nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ he be se nami; nyɛ be he wami nae.
Je ma amɛ nu kaa nyɛ hɛ mi pue si; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nu ngmlaa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kpae ɔ. Katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a sibi tɛe, nɛ a ngɛ si nɔɔe.
Nebukadnezar ba Benɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ma nɛ e ba tua Egipt ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nyɛɛ fiɛ ngɛ Egipt ma amɛ a mi, ngɛ Migdol, Memfis, kɛ Tapanhes ke, ‘Nyɛɛ mia, nɛ nyɛɛ pee klaalo, ejakaa ta ngɛ ní puɛe ngɛ mahi nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ a mi kɛ ma!
Kɛ ba lɛ kɛɛ loko Apis, nyɛ mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ tu fo kɛ je nyɛ he ɔ?
Ee, Yawɛ lɛ fia lɛ nɔ́ kɛ fɔ si!’ Nyɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ a sibi a nɔ, nɛ a de ke, ‘Nyɛ ha nɛ waa te si, nɛ waa tu fo kɛ je he nyɛli ɔmɛ a klaate ɔ nya.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa kpale kɛ ya wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa ma mi, he nɛ a fɔ wɔ ngɛ ɔ.’ “Egipt matsɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ wo lɛ biɛ he; nyɛ tsɛ Farao ɔ ke, ‘Nyapuutsɛ nɛ e he wami ta!’ Imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, imi ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Tabor yo ɔ daa si gagaa ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a kpɛti, aloo kaa bɔ nɛ Karmel yo ɔ daa si ngɛ wo tue ɔ, jã ji bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ ma mo tuami ɔ e he wami ngɛ.
Nyɛ Egipt bi, nyɛ dla nyɛ he, ejakaa a ma ba nuu nyɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.
Nyɛ ma a nɛ a tsɛɛ Memfis ɔ, a ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Memfis maa pee ma doku, nɛ nɔ ko be mi hie hu.
Egipt ngɛ kaa na yo saminyayoo nɛ pwɔlwɛ je omleyi je ba kɔ lɛ.
Ta buli nɛ Egipt bɔ mɛ apaa a, mɛ po a ngɛ kaa na bimɛ kɛkɛ.
A nyɛ we nɛ a da si ngɛ ta a nya; mɛ tsuo a tu fo kɛ je ta a nya.
A haomi be ɔ su, a hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ su.
Egipt bi ɔmɛ tu fo ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nya kɛ a nɔ ngmlaa kaa sinɔ nɛ ngɛ si sãe kɛ yaa.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ ba tua lɛ kɛ gbiɛhi kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ tso hɛɛe, aloo nihi nɛ ngɛ hue tso gbae.
A ta buli ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ ko li a nya; a he hiɛ babauu pe baalɛhi po.
A bɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ahlua; nihi nɛ je omleyi je ɔ ye a nɔ kunimi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, “Ma gbla Amon, Tebes mawu ɔ, kɛ Egipt mawu kpa amɛ tsuo a tue.
Farao ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu ma gbla a tue.
Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo nihi nɛ ngɛ mɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Se pee se ɔ, nihi ma ba hi Egipt ekohu kaa sa a. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ ma he e ma a yi wami “Ye ma, nyɛ tsui nɛ ko po, Israel bi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
Ma je nyɛ kɛ je jamɛ a ma se zugba a nɔ he nɛ a nuu nyɛ kɛ ho ɔ. Nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba we, nɛ nyɛ ma ba hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi; nyɛ he mi maa jɔ nyɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ he gbeye woe.
Ye ma, nyɛ tsui ko po, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Je ma amɛ, hehi nɛ i fie nyɛ kɛ ho ɔ, ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i be hae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ he kulaa; ma gbla nyɛ tue bɔ nɛ sa kɛkɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Filistia he Loko Egipt matsɛ ɔ ya tua Filistia a, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu nɛ kɔɔ Filistia he.
Yawɛ ke, “Hyɛ!
Nyu babauu je omleyi je kɛ ma kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala.
Nyu nɛ ɔ ma ba ha zugba a nɔ tsuo; e maa ha mahi, nimli, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ.
Ngmlaa maa je nyumuhi po a nya, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa wo yana ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
A maa nu nɛ okpɔngɔhi a nane kokloto ngɛ si sie glɛi, glɛi, glɛi!
A maa nu nɛ zugba lɛhi a nane ngɛ pɛe kplakatsa, kplakatsa, kplakatsa!
Tsɛmɛ be plɛe nɛ a hyɛ a bimɛ; a nine mi maa je wu.
Be ɔ su nɛ a ma kpata Filisti bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ɔ, Tiro, kɛ Sidon a hɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kpata Filisti bi ɔmɛ, ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ je Kreta wo ɔ nya kɛ ba a a hɛ mi.
Amanehlu agbo ba Gaza bi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ Ashkelon bi ɔmɛ pee dii.
Filisti bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛni be a maa ye kɔmɔ kɛ ya si?
Ngmlaa je nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛ bi ke, ‘Yawɛ klaate, mɛni be o ma kpa ní tsumi?
Yaa sɛ o kpo ɔ mi, nɛ o jɔɔ o he, nɛ o pee dii!’ Se kɛ klaate ɔ maa jɔɔ e he kɛɛ, be mi nɛ i ha lɛ ní tsumi ke e tsu ɔ?
I fa klaate ɔ ke e ya tua Ashkelon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nya a.”
A kpata Moab zugba a hɛ mi Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ngɛ Moab he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Musu tloo Nebo bi ɔmɛ, ejakaa a kpata a ma a hɛ mi!
A pue Kiriataim hɛ mi si, nɛ a ngɔ ma a.
A ku mɔ ngua a ngɔ pue si, nɛ a bɔ lɛ ahlua.
Moab hɛ mi nyami ɔ ta.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ Heshbon, nɛ a to kaa a ma kpata Moab zugba a hɛ mi.
Madmen ma a hu, a ma ya tua lɛ, nɛ a ma kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Horonaim bi ɔmɛ jé ngmlaa, ejakaa a ngɛ níhi a hɛ mi kpatae basabasa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
“Moab jokuɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ wo yana ke, a kpata Moab ma a hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a wo yana kɛ yaa, benɛ a ngɛ Luhit yoku ɔ kuɔe ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ mɛ nɛ a ngɛ awe nyae, benɛ a ngɛ kplee kɛ ma Horonaim ɔ.
A ke, ‘Nyɛɛ tu fo esɔ, kaa nga mi teji yo, nɛ nyɛ kɛ he nyɛ yi wami!’ “Moab bi, nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ he wami, kɛ nyɛ juetli nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hu a ma ba ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ho.
Nyɛ mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kemosh ɔ, a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ma se ya kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e we osɔfo ɔmɛ.
He nyɛlɔ ɔ ma kpata mahi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi; ma ko ma ko he be mi jee.
A ma kpata kɔ̃ kɛ nga kplanaa tsuo a hɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Nyɛɛ ma kaimi nɔ́ ko ha Moab; ejakaa e be kɛe nɛ a ma kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Moab ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie hu.” Nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ha Yawɛ kɛ yi si fiami ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume kaa a maa ngɔ klaate kɛ pue muɔ si kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ!
A kpata Moab ma amɛ a hɛ mi Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Moab he mi jɔ lɛ kɛ je sa, nɛ a ngɔɛ lɛ kɛ yɛ ma se hyɛ.
Moab ngɛ kaa wai atiati nɛ a si ngɛ tɔ mi kɛ ma si, nɛ a plɛ we kɛ wui tɔ kpa mi.
Bɔ nɛ e ngɛ sa a, ja ko e ngɛ; e nya nyu gbo we, nɛ e puɛ we hulɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ be ma nɛ ma tsɔ he nyɛli kɛ ba nɛ a ba kpata Moab hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ́ puɛli ma plɛ wai ngɔ pue si nɛ a maa ywia wai tɔ ɔ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa pee Moab ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi loko Moab bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si kaa bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi pue si be ko ɔ.
A ma kpa si kaa mamoo a mawu Kemosh ɔ be he wami ko kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ hu a mawu Betel ɔ nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ.
“Moab bi!
Mɛni he je nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Wɔɔ lɛɛ ta buli katsɛmɛ nɛ he biɛ ji wɔ ɔ?’ A kpata Moab zugba a, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi; a gbe Moab nihewi kpakpa amɛ tsuo.
Imi matsɛ ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, imi lɛ i de.
Moab amanehlu be ɔ su ta; Moab hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ ma kɛ fo.
“Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ bɔle Moab, nyɛ ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ nu bɔ nɛ e biɛ pɛɛ be ko ɔ, nyɛɛ ye lɛ kɔmɔ.
Nyɛ de ke, ‘E nɔ yemi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ se po; e hɛ mi nyami, kɛ e he wami ɔ ta.’ Nyɛ Moab bi, nyɛ je nyɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɔ fɔ si; nyɛ ba hi si ngɛ zia mi ngɛ zugba.
Moab he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba tua nyɛ hulɔ, nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛ Aroer bi, nyɛ ya da blɔ he nɛ nyɛɛ huɔ!
Nyɛ bi nihi nɛ ngɛ fo tue kɛ yaa a ke, ‘Mɛni sane ba?’ A ma he nɔ ke, ‘A bɔ Moab ahlua; a kpata Moab hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ nya awe!
Nyɛɛ fiɛ ngɛ Arnon pa a nya ke a kpata Moab hɛ mi!’ “A gbla ma nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ a tue: Holon, Yaza, Mefat, Dibon, Nebo, Bet Diblataim, Kiriataim, Betgamut, Betmeon, Keriot, kɛ Bozra.
A gbla mahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ a tue, mahi nɛ ngɛ se lokoo, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a he kɛ we.
Moab he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ je e dɛ; a kpata Moab hɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” A maa ba Moab si Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ ha nɛ Moab nɛ pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ tɔ dã, ejakaa e te si kɛ si mi.
Moab ma kokloo si ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e vie mi, nɛ nihi maa muɔ lɛ.
Tse Israel plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ ha mo?
Israel ɔ, anɛ juli a kpɛti a naa lɛ ngɛ lo?
Be tsuaa be nɛ o maa tu Israel he munyu ko ɔ, o maa tuu, ma mimiɛ o yi!
Pi ja lo?
“Nyɛ Moab bi, nyɛɛ je nyɛ ma amɛ a mi!
Nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya hi tɛ sa amɛ a mi!
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ ní kaa okpohi nɛ a maa tsu ngɛ puɔhi a mi ngɛ kɔ̃ he ɔ. Moab woɔ e he nɔ tsɔ!
E he womi, e nɔ buimi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e buu lɛ nitsɛ e he ha a, i le lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Imi Yawɛ, i le kaa Moab bi ɔmɛ bui nɔ.
Fiami puu kɛkɛ a le, nɛ a tsu we nɔ́ kpakpa ko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma fo ya ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ, nɛ ma ye kɔmɔ ha Kir Heres bi ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ Sibma bi, ma fo nyɛ kulaa pe bɔ nɛ ma fo Yazer bi.
Sibma ma, o ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ kɔnihi gba kɛ ya be ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ he kɛ ya su Yazer tɔɔ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a kpata o tso yiblii ɔmɛ, kɛ o wai yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami se po ngɛ Moab zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní ɔ nɔ.
I ha nɛ wai se po ngɛ wai ngami he ɔmɛ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ wai, nɛ ke a ngɛ wai ɔ pee nɛ a hii lele hwɔe kɛ hii he toe ɔ, jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be hu.
“Heshbon kɛ Eleale bi ngɛ awe nyae, nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa a he nue ngɛ Yahaz tɔɔ.
Ngmlaa a ngɛ pɛe ngɛ Zoar, Horonaim, kɛ Eglat Shelishiya tɔɔ.
Nimrim pa a po gbli.
Ma ha nɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ ma kpa sami bɔ sami ngɛ a jami he ɔmɛ, nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a sãã ha a mawu ɔmɛ hu se maa po.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ a kpaa ya la mɔbɔmɔbɔ ngɛ bɛ mi ɔ, ja nɛ i ngɛ tsui yee ha Moab, kɛ Kir Heres ma mi bi ɔmɛ, ejakaa a ní nɛ a na a tsuo hɛ mi kpata.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ sã e yi nɔ kpalokpalo, nɛ e sɛ kpɛni.
Mɛ tsuo a poo a kɔnihi a he, nɛ a ngɔ kpekpe kɛ muɔ a mlɛ mi.
Ngɛ tsuhi a yi mi, kɛ blɔhi a nɔ ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o maa nu kɛkɛ ji kɔmɔ yemi, ejakaa i ha nɛ Moab pee kaa buɛ nɛ ywia wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ nɛ nɔ ko sume hu.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a kpata Moab zugba a hɛ mi ha!
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ ngɛ awe nyae ha!
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a bɔ Moab ahlua ha!
Moab plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́, kɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ je mahi tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ hiee.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Peepee ko be ha Moab Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E ke, “Je ma ko ma ba tua Moab tlukaa kaa kɔle nɛ gbɛ e pɛlihi a mi kɛ ma.
A maa ngɔ ma amɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, sawale maa nu Moab ta buli ɔmɛ kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi.
A ma kpata Moab hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ e be ma pee hu; ejakaa e te si kɛ si mi.
Haomi fɔɔ si ha Moab bi; a tsua muɔ kɛ to mɛ, nɛ a tsɔ mɛ klama hulɔ.
Yawɛ lɛ de.
Ke nɔ ko tu fo kɛ je haomi ɔ nya a, e ma ya nɔ muɔ mi.
Nɛ ke e je muɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e ma ya du klama.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi, ejakaa Yawɛ to be nɛ a kɛ ma kpata Moab hɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ a he wami ta maa ka kaa a maa tu fo nɛ a ya laa a he ngɛ Heshbon mɔ ɔ mi, he nɛ Matsɛ Sihon ye tsɛ ngɛ be ko ɔ.
Se la sã Moab zugba a tsuo; atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a zugba a sã kɛ je zugba a nya he kake kɛ ya si he kake.
Moab bi, due!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔɔ Kemosh ɔ, a kpata nyɛ hɛ mi, nɛ a nuu nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ kɛ je.” Se be ma nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ Moab maa bɔ ekohu.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de to ke e maa ba Moab nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ maa gbla Amon tue Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Amon he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Jije Israel nyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Anɛ nɔ ko be nɛ ma fa a zugba a he lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a ngmɛɛ Gad bi ɔmɛ a zugba a he ngɔ ha Milkom jali ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ngɔ zugba a kɛ pee a nɔ́ ɔ?
Se be ma nɛ ma ha nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Amon matsɛ ma Raba a maa nu nɛ a he ose kɛ ma.
A ma kpata ma a hɛ mi, nɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma a, a maa mɛ a he la.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, zugba a nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba kpɔ ngɛ Israel dɛ ɔ, Israel nine maa su nɔ ekohu.
Nyɛ Heshbon bi, nyɛɛ wo yana, ejakaa a kpata Ai hɛ mi.
Raba yihi, nyɛ nya awe!
Nyɛ bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ.
Nyɛɛ hi fo tue kɛ hi bee basaa kɛkɛ.
Nyɛ mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Milkom ɔ, a ma ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ma se ya, kɛ e we osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ je Mawu se, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ fĩae?
Nyɛ he wami ɔ ta.
Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ sika nɔ, nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e ba tua nyɛ ɔ?
Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ haomi kɛ ba nyɛ nɔ.
Mahi nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ tsuo maa fie nyɛ kɛ fo kpatakpata kɛ je nyɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ ma bua nyɛ nya ekohu.
“Se pee se ɔ, ma ha nɛ Amon ma ba na e he ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ maa gbla Edom tue Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ngɛ Edom he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Anɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ a juɛmi ɔ ta lo?
Anɛ a ga woli ɔmɛ wui mɛ ga hu lo?
Anɛ a nile ɔ se po lo?
Nyɛ Dedan bi, nyɛ plɛ nɛ nyɛɛ tu fo!
Nyɛ ya laa nyɛ he ngɛ muɔhi a mi.
Ma kpata Esau nina a hɛ mi, ejakaa be ɔ nɛ ma kɛ gbla a tue ɔ, be ɔ su.
Ke nihi ngɛ wai yiblii nya buae ɔ, anɛ a si we eko ngɛ tso ɔ nɔ lo?
Ke juli ma jumi nyɔ mi ɔ, pi nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ pɛ nɛ a muɔɔ kɛ yaa lo?
Se imi lɛɛ i kpakpaa Esau nina a he ní, nɛ i pee mɛ pasaa.
A laami he ɔmɛ hu i je mɛ kpo, nɛ a be he ko nɛ a laa a he ngɛ hu.
A kpata Edom bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi; a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po píɛ.
Nyɛ si nyɛ awusa amɛ ha mi nɛ ma hyɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ hu, nyɛ ha nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ.
“Nihi nɛ sɛ́ tue gblami, nɛ a gbla a tue ɔ, moo o susu kaa o maa ye o he lo?
Dɛbi!
Jamɛ a tue gblami kplu ɔ, ja mo hu o nu kɛ̃!
Imi nitsɛ i ka ye he kita ke ma ha nɛ Bozra ma a maa pee ma doku; nihi maa ye a he fɛu, nɛ a kɛ ma a biɛ maa gbiɛ nɔ.
Kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma a tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata kɛ ya neneene.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” I de ke, “Edom, i na sɛ gbi ko kɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ.
Yawɛ tsɔ nɛ a ya de je ma amɛ ke a bua a tabo ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a mia, nɛ a ba tua mo.
Yawɛ maa ba mo si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo bue hu.
O he nɔ womi ɔ sisi mo.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko pa yi mo gbeye hu kaa bɔ nɛ o susuu ɔ. O hi he ji tɛ sa amɛ a kpɛ, ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a yi mi.
