E ngɛ mi kaa o hi he ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo kaa kɔle hi he mohu, se kɛ̃ Yawɛ ma je mo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ba mo si.
Yawɛ lɛ de.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A ma kpata Edom hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, bɔ nɛ ke nɔ ko ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e he mi maa po, nɛ e maa ye gbeye.
Kaa bɔ nɛ a kpata Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a hɛ mi ɔ, ja pɛ a maa pee Edom; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie hu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Kaa bɔ nɛ jata hiaa kpo vlai kɛ jeɔ pu mi ngɛ Yordan pa a he kɛ baa lohwehi a ní yemi he ɔ, ja ma ba tlukaa, nɛ ma ba fie Edom bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ kɛ fo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ nɛ ma hla a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ye ma a nɔ.
Mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ mi sɔ?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ mi maa to ní?
Te nɔ yelɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ye hɛ mi maa da nɛɛ?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yi mi nɛ i to kɛ wo Edom bi ɔmɛ a he, kɛ bɔ nɛ i to nɛ ma pee Teman ma mi bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
A bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi po a maa gbla mɛ ngɛ zugba kɛ je, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ he mi maa po.
Ke Edom hɛ mi kpata a, ose nɛ a ma he ɔ nya maa wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ, bɔ nɛ zugba po ma mimiɛ.
A maa nu ose nɛ ɔ he ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ he tɔɔ.
He nyɛlɔ ɔ ma ba tua Bozra tlukaa kaa kɔle nɛ gbɛ e pɛlihi a mi kɛ ma.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Edom ta buli ɔmɛ maa nu sawale kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi.” Yawɛ maa gbla Damasko tue Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Damasko he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Hamat ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Arpad ma mi bi ɔmɛ hao, ejakaa a nu sane yaya.
A tsui po, nɛ a he mi ngɛ mɛ hiae kaa wo nɛ ngɛ fiae gudugudu nɛ he jɔɔmi be mi.
Damasko ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he wami ta, nɛ a kɛ sawale tu fo kɛ je.
A ngɛ haomi, kɛ he hiami mi kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi.
Kɛ ba lɛ kɛɛ loko ma nɛ he biɛ, kɛ e mi bua jɔmi babauu ɔ, a je ma a he kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa gbe ma nihe ɔ tsuo ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ, nɛ a ma kpata ta buli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ma mɛ Damasko gbogbo ɔ he la, nɛ ma sã Matsɛ Benhadad mɔ ɔmɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.” A maa gbla Kedar wɛtso ɔ kɛ Hazor ma a tue Kedar wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Hazor nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ nɛ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba ye a nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tua Kedar, ma a, nɛ nyɛ kpata beleku je wɛtso ɔ hɛ mi!
Nyɛɛ ngɔ a bo tsu ɔmɛ, a to ɔmɛ, a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he bo ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ kɛ ho.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ a we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ he ose kɛ wo ma a ke, ‘A sa nyɛ yi oo!
Nyɛ yi ta pɛ!’ “Nyɛ Hazor bi, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ya tsitsaa lokoo, nɛ nyɛ ya laa nyɛ he ngɛ muɔhi a mi.
Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar so nyɛ yi nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ e de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Jamɛ a ma a nɛ e mi bi ngɛ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ wa ya tua mɛ!
Ma a fɔɔ si gu, agbo be he ɔ, dade se lami nɔ́ hu be he.’ “Nyɛɛ ha a we afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a na amɛ tsuo!
Nihi nɛ sɛɛ a yi kasa fa a, ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ tsuo, nɛ ma ha haomi maa je hehi munomuno kɛ ba na mɛ.
Hazor maa pee ma doku kɛ nga mi gbehi a hi he kɛ ya neneene.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie hu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” A maa gbla Elam tue Benɛ Zedekia ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ, e kɛ we kulaa nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu nɛ kɔɔ Elam zugba a he.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma gbe Elam kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ɔmɛ tsuo; mɛ ji Elam he wami ɔ nɛ.
Ma ha kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa maa fia kɛ je hehi munomuno kɛ ba Elam.
Ma gbɛ Elam bi ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa he tsuaa he; nɛ a maa na Elam bi nɛ a gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa nɛ ɔ ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a mi.
Ma ha nɛ Elam bi ɔmɛ maa ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ gbeye.
Ye mi mi ma fu Elam bi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ma kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ ma ha nɛ ta ma ba na mɛ.
Ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ma kpata a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ ma to imi nitsɛ ye matsɛ yemi sisi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se pee se ɔ, ma ha nɛ Elam bi ɔmɛ ma ba na a he ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
A ngɔ Babilon Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ha mi nɛ kɔɔ Babilon ma a, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛɛ fiɛ munyu nɛ ɔ kɛ ha je ma amɛ!
Nyɛɛ si aflaangaa, nɛ nyɛɛ fiɛ!
Nyɛ ko laa nɔ́ ko nɔ; nyɛ de ke, ‘A ngɔ Babilon oo, a ngɔ Babilon!
Babilon mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Marduk ɔ, a kpata e hɛ mi.
A pue Babilon wɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si, nɛ a ywia amaga amɛ dukuduku.’ “Je ma ko hia kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ma nɛ e ba tua Babilonia.
A ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ a maa pee lɛ butuu; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie hu.
Nimli kɛ lohwehi tsuo maa tu fo kɛ je.” Israel maa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa wo yana kɛ ba, nɛ a ma ba hla imi, a Mawu ɔ, ye se blɔ.
A ma bi ke a tsɔɔ mɛ Zion blɔ, nɛ a maa nyɛɛ nɔ kɛ ba.
A ma de ke, ‘Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ngɔ wa he ya mɛtɛ Yawɛ he.
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa kɛ lɛ nɛ so neneene somi nɛ a be mi poe gblegbleegble.’ “Ye ma a ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ a hyɛli ɔmɛ ha nɛ a nane kpata ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he, nɛ a wo lalaalo ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hluu kɛ ya si a hi he po laa mɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na mɛ ɔ ma tua mɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ deɔ ji ‘Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa tɔ we.
Mɛ lɛ a pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, Mawu dami sane yelɔ ɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ.’ “Israel bi, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ je Babilonia!
Nyɛɛ je Kaldea bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ!
Nyɛ he nɛ sɔ!
Nyɛɛ pee kekleekle nihi nɛ maa je lejɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ to akpakpohi nyɛɛɔ to kuu a hɛ mi ɔ. Ma ya sú je mahi babauu nɛ a he wa kɛ je omleyi je kɛ wo Babilonia he.
A ma gba ta kɛ wo zugba a, nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ.
Ta buli kpanakpanaahi ji mɛ.
A dɛ nya da, nɛ ke a tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ, e bi nɔ́ he kɔkɔɔkɔ.
A maa ha ní ngɛ Babilonia zugba a nɔ kɛ yaa si nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na bɔ nɛ e suɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” A ma kpata Babilonia hɛ mi Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Babilonia bi, nyɛ kpata ye zugba a hɛ mi.
Nyɛ kle tɔfutɔfu kaa na yihi nɛ ye niye ní kpakpa, nɛ nyɛ kpaa ngmlaa kɛ he wami kaa okpɔngɔ.
Nyɛ bua jɔɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ nyaa.
Se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma nguaa a hɛ mi ma ba pue si, nɛ ahlua maa bɔ lɛ.
Babilon ma ba pee ma nɛ a bui ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti pe kulaa; e ma ba pee ma doku, kɛ nga kplanaa nɛ nyu be nɔ.
Imi Yawɛ, ye mi mi fu Babilon, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie hu; e maa pee ma doku kulaa, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e he mi maa po, nɛ e nya maa kpɛ e he.
“Nyɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li, nyɛ gba ta kɛ wo Babilon he nɛ nyɛ sa ma a yi.
Nyɛ tsɛ̃ nyɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wo ma a he, ejakaa a pee yayami kɛ si imi Yawɛ.
Nyɛ he ose kɛ wo ma a he!
Jehanɛ lɛɛ Babilon ha yi.
Ma a sisi tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ e gbogbo ɔmɛ ku kɛ pueɔ si.
I ngɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a tue gblae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he lue; bɔ nɛ a pee ni komɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee mɛ kɛ to nane mi.
Nyɛɛ fie ní duli, kɛ ní kpali kɛ a dɛ mi ha kɛ je Babilon.
Nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a maa ye ta nɛ ba tua mɛ ɔ gbeye, nɛ a maa je kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ya.” Israel maa kpale kɛ ba Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Israel bi ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ jatahi fie mɛ, nɛ a gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.
Kekleekle ɔ, Asiria matsɛ ba tua mɛ, nɛ e ye mɛ; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba kpe a wuhi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, ma gbla matsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ e zugba a tue kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Asiria matsɛ ɔ. Ma kpale Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ekohu.
A maa ye niye ní nɛ baa ngɛ Karmel yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Bashan zugba a nɔ ɔ.
A ma na ní maa ye bɔ nɛ a suɔ ngɛ Efraim kɛ Gilead zugba a nɔ.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a ma hla kaa a maa na Israel he yayami ko lo, se a be nae.
Yuda hu a be yi wu tso nɔ́ ko nae ngɛ he e, ejakaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ i he a yi wami ɔ, ma ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Mawu maa gbla Babilonia tue Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ ya tua Merataim, kɛ Pekod bi ɔmɛ.
Nyɛɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ pee.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Ta ose pɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ níhi babauu a hɛ mi kpata.
Babilonia, hamle ngua a nɛ ngɛ je ɔ tsuo ywiae dukuduku ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ lɛ hu a ku lɛ ngɔ pue si mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ!
Kɛ ba lɛ kɛɛ loko Babilonia ba plɛ pee ma doku ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti ɔ?
Babilonia, o kɛ imi, Yawɛ hwu ta.
Nɛ klama nɛ i tsɔ mo ɔ, o du klama a; ejakaa o li tete kaa i tsɔ mo klama ko.
I bli ye ta hwumi níhi a to he ɔ, nɛ i kɛ abofu je ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ kpo, ejakaa imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ ma tsu ngɛ Babilonia.
Nyɛ ya tua Babilonia kɛ je he tsuaa he, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia ngma tomi he ɔmɛ.
Nyɛɛ to ta yibu ní ɔmɛ kaa ngma nɛ a to lɛ glekugleku!
Nyɛ kpata zugba a hɛ mi!
Nyɛ ko si nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ nɔ!
Nyɛɛ gbe a ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo!
Nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ!
Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
A tue gblami be ɔ su!” Ni komɛ tu fo kɛ je Babilonia kɛ ba Yerusalem nɛ a ba bɔ ma a amaniɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ye e he lue ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ pee lɛ Yawɛ e we ɔ he.
“Nyɛ ha nɛ nihi nɛ le kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃mi ɔ, a ya nɛ a ya tua Babilon.
Nyɛ ha nɛ ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ tsuɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ he ní ɔ, a ya sa ma a yi kɛ kpe, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko tu fo kɛ je.
Nyɛɛ gbla e tue ngɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo he.
Bɔ nɛ e pee ni kpa amɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee lɛ ngɔ to nane mi ja nɔuu; ejakaa e wo e he nɔ ngɛ imi Yawɛ, Israel Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ, ye nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a maa gbe e nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ma a mi; nɛ a ma kpata e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Babilonia bi, nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ maa to ní.
Nyɛ be ɔ su; be ɔ nɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue ɔ su.
Nyɛ, ma he nɔ woli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma tɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nɔɔ si, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ nɔ woe.
Ma mɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a he la, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A wa Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo yi mi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ nuu mɛ ɔ hɛɛ mɛ kpɛii, nɛ a kplɛɛ we kaa a maa ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a ho.
Se nɔ nɛ ma ba kpɔ mɛ ɔ, e he wa; e biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
Lɛ nitsɛ e maa ye a sane ɔ ha mɛ; e kɛ he jɔmi maa ba zugba a nɔ, se Babilonia bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ e maa hao mɛ.” Yawɛ ke, “Ta ma ba tua Babilonia zugba a!
Ta ma ba na Babilonia bi ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ní leli ɔmɛ.
Ta ma ba na lakpa gbali ɔmɛ, nɛ a ma plɛ pee kuasiahi!
Ta ma ba na ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ sawale maa nu mɛ!
Ta ma ba na okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ zugba lɛ ɔmɛ; ta ma ba na ma se ta buli tsuo nɛ ngɛ Babilonia a; a he wami maa ta, nɛ a maa pee kaa yihi pɛ!
A maa ha a juetli tsuo!
Pahi tsuo a mi nyu maa mii ta, nɛ nyu hwɔ maa ba zugba a nɔ!
Amaga gbeyegbeyehi sɔuu ji zugba a nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ a tsui kɛ ha.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Babilon ma ba pee pu mi lohwehi a hi he, nɛ afukpɔngɔhi, kɛ ogbeteehi maa hi lejɛ ɔ.
Se nɔmlɔ adesa ko nɔmlɔ adesa ko lɛɛ be lejɛ ɔ hie hu gblegbleegble.
Ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Sodom, kɛ Gomora, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie hu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Ma ko je omleyi je kɛ ma.
Je ma agbo ko, kɛ matsɛmɛ babauu hia kɛ je tsitsaa lokoo kɛ ma.
A hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ akplɔ; a yi mi wa, nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko kulaa be a mi.
A he ose, nɛ a hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ma; nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo pee hoo kaa wo nɛ ngɛ fiae gudugudu.
A mia kɛ ma nɛ a kɛ Babilonia ba hwu ta.
Benɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ nu sane nɛ ba a, e nine mi je wu.
E tsui po wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e kpatu pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi.
“Kaa bɔ nɛ jata hiaa kpo vlai kɛ jeɔ pu mi ngɛ Yordan pa a he kɛ baa lohwehi a ní yemi he ɔ, ja imi Yawɛ, ma ba tlukaa nɛ ma ba fie Babilonia bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a ma a mi kɛ fo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ nɛ ma hla a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ye ma a nɔ.
Mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ mi sɔ?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ mi maa to ní?
Te nɔ yelɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ye hɛ mi maa da?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yi mi nɛ i to kɛ wo Babilon ma a he, kɛ bɔ nɛ i to nɛ ma pee ma mi bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
A bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi po a maa gbla mɛ ngɛ zugba kɛ je, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ he mi maa po.
Ke Babilon hɛ mi kpata a, ose nɛ a ma he ɔ nya maa wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ, bɔ nɛ zugba po ma mimiɛ.
Je ma kpa amɛ tsuo maa nu ose nɛ ɔ he.”
A maa gbla Babilonia tue ekohu Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ puɛɔ ní maa fia ngɛ Babilonia zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ma kpata nihi a hɛ mi.
Ma ha nɛ he nyɛli ma ba sa Babilonia zugba a yi kɛ kpe; a ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Babilonia zugba a maa pee falifali kaa zugba nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ jakati ngɛ nɔ kɛ ho; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be piɛe ngɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ ko ngmɛ a ta buli ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a kpla a gbaja amɛ.
Nyɛ ko ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a tsɛ̃ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a nihewi ɔmɛ a yi nɛ na wami!
Nyɛ kpata tabo ɔ tsuo hɛ mi!
A maa plaa mɛ ngɔ pue si ngɛ Kaldea gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Niinɛ, Israel kɛ Yuda pee yayami kɛ si imi, Israel Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ.
Se imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ, imi lɛɛ i kua we mɛ.
Nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ je Babilonia nɛ nyɛ kɛ he nyɛ yi wami.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a gbe nyɛ ngɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔ he.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ ye he lue yee ngɛ a nɔ, nɛ i ngɛ a tue gblae bɔ nɛ sa mɛ.
Babilonia ngɛ kaa sika tsu kplu ko ngɛ ye dɛ mi nɛ ha je ɔ tsuo tɔ dã.
Je ma amɛ tsuo nu wai ngɛ kplu nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a fo godo.
Babilonia nɔ si tlukaa, nɛ e hɛ mi kpata.
Nyɛ nya awe ha lɛ!
Nyɛɛ to e pa amɛ a nɔ tsopa kaa alini e ma na he wami lo.
Nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ Babilonia a de ke, ‘Jinɛ wa ka kaa wa maa piɛ a he, se wa ya nyɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa je e he; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pue e ma mi blɔ.
Mawu gbla Babilonia tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ; Mawu kpata zugba a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’ ” Yawɛ ke, “Ye ma, nyɛ he ose, nɛ nyɛ de ke, ‘Yawɛ wo wɔ nguɔ!
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya Yerusalem, nɛ wa ya bɔ ma a nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ pee.’ ” Yawɛ ha nɛ Media matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a mumi te si, konɛ a ya kpata Babilonia hɛ mi.
Bɔ nɛ e to nɛ e maa ye e he lue, nɛ e maa gbla Babilonia tue ngɛ lɛ Yawɛ, e we ɔ nɛ a ble ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ta a hɛ mi ɔ fa ke, “Nyɛɛ duɔ nyɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a nya!
Nyɛ wo nyɛ tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ a nɔ!
Nyɛ wo aflaangaa amɛ a nɔ kɛ pee okadi nɛ a kɛ ma tua Babilon gbogbo ɔmɛ.
Nyɛɛ hla buli kpakpahi, nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a ya da a blɔ hehi!
Nyɛ ha nɛ ka woli ɔmɛ nɛ a dla a he!” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ to kaa e maa pee Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ja e pee ɔ nɛ.
Pahi fuu ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ a juetli hu hiɛ babauu.
Se a nyagbe ɔ su; a po a wami kpa a. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ka e he kita ke e maa ngɔ nihi babauu kaa baalɛhi kɛ ba tua Babilonia.
A maa ye kunimi, nɛ a ma hwɔ lele.
Mawu yi jemi la Yawɛ lɛ bɔ je ɔ ngɛ e he wami nya.
Nile lɛ e kɛ bɔ je ɔ, nɛ jamɛ a nile ɔ nɔuu e kɛ bli hiɔwe mi.
Ke e wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ keɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; Yawɛ haa nɛ afua teɔ si kɛ jeɔ zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ.
E haa oslabai gbaa, be mi nɛ hiɔmi ngɛ nɛe, nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jeɔ e nito he ɔ. Nimli adesahi tsuo biɛ; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Sika gali a hɛ mi pue si pɛ, ejakaa amagahi nɛ a puɛɛ ɔ, ní guhi ji mɛ; wami ko wami ko be a mi.
Amaga amɛ ɔ, se nami ko be a he, yakayaka níhi, kɛ zo níhi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Be mi nɛ Yawɛ ma ba gbla ma a tue ɔ, a we amaga amɛ hu a maa ku mɛ dukuduku.
Yakob Mawu ɔ be kaa mɛ; lɛ ji nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e hla Israel kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
Yawɛ hamle ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Babilonia, ye hamle ji mo; o ngɛ kaa ye ta hwumi ní.
I ngɔ mo kɛ kpata je mahi, kɛ matsɛ yemihi a hɛ mi.
I ngɔ mo kɛ kpata okpɔngɔhi kɛ a nɔ hili a hɛ mi.
I ngɔ mo kɛ kpata ta zugba lɛhi kɛ a kudɔli a hɛ mi.
I ngɔ mo kɛ gbe nyumuhi kɛ yihi, nikɔtɔmahi kɛ jokuɛwi, nihewi kɛ yihewi.
I ngɔ mo kɛ kpata to hyɛli kɛ a to ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
I ngɔ mo kɛ kpata ngmɔ huli kɛ a na kpakplaahi a hɛ mi.
Amlaalohi kɛ ma ní tsuli hu, mo nɔuu i kɛ kpata a hɛ mi.” A maa gbla Babilonia tue Yawɛ ke, “Yayamihi tsuo nɛ Babilonia kɛ Babilonia ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee Yerusalem he je ɔ, ma gbla a tue nɛ nyɛ maa na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ.
Mo Babilonia nɛ o ngɛ kaa yoku, nɛ o ngɛ je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi kpatae, i kɛ mo na!
Ma nu mo, nɛ ma kpɛne mo kɛ je tɛ sa amɛ a nɔ ba ko si, nɛ o maa pee kaa yo nɛ sã.
Tɛhi nɛ maa je o mi ɔ, a be eko ngɔe kɛ ma tsu; a kɛ be kɔ nya tɛ, loo tsu sisi tomi tɛ pee.
Mohu ɔ, o maa pee kaa zugba kplanaa kɛ ya neneene.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Nyɛɛ si aflaangaa.
Nyɛ kpa titimati nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a nu!
Nyɛ ha nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a mia, nɛ a kɛ Babilonia ya hwu ta!
Nyɛ de Ararat, Mini, kɛ Ashkenaz matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ ke a ya tua Babilonia.
Nyɛ hla tatsɛ nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ okpɔngɔhi babauu kaa baalɛhi kɛ ba.
Nyɛ ha nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a mia, nɛ a kɛ Babilonia ya hwu ta.
Nyɛ ya kpee Media matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, a we amlaalo ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ a nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba.
Yawɛ to e yi mi kaa e ma ha nɛ Babilonia zugba a maa pee kaa nga kplanaa nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie.
Yawɛ yi mi tomi nɛ ɔ ba mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, zugba ngɛ mimiɛe, nɛ e ngɛ hosoe.
Babilonia ta buli ɔmɛ kpa ta hwumi, nɛ a hii si ngɛ a mɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
A kɔni mi jɔ̃, nɛ a pee kaa yihi.
Babilonia agbo ɔmɛ ku kɛ pueɔ si, nɛ we ɔmɛ sã.
Tsɔli babauu ngɛ fo nɔ kɛ yaa nɛ a ya bɔ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ amaniɛ ke he nyɛli ba ngɔ e ma a tsuo.
A ngɔ pa pomi he ɔmɛ, a mɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la, nɛ sawale nu Babilonia ta buli ɔmɛ.
E be kɛe kulaa nɛ a maa poo a mi ngɔ pue si kaa blɛfo ngɛ ngma mi sami he.
Imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ lɛ i de.” Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar poo Yerusalem mi nɛ e ye.
E muɔ níhi kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ ma a fɔɔ si kaa buɛ mi gu.
E mi ma a kaa bɔ nɛ sinɔ ngua miɔ nɔ́ ɔ. E ye ma a mi ní kpakpa amɛ, nɛ e sake nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue he.
Nyɛ ha nɛ Zion bi ɔmɛ nɛ a de ke, “Yi mi nɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ wa wɔ ɔ, a gbla a tue kɛ to nya!” Nyɛ ha nɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ nɛ a de ke, “Haomi nɛ ba wa nɔ ɔ, a gbla Babilonia bi ɔmɛ a tue kɛ to nya!” Yawɛ maa piɛ Israel he Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ye nyɛ sane ɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ ma gbla nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue ha nyɛ.
Ma ha nɛ Babilonia wo ɔ, kɛ pa amɛ ma gbli.
Ma ha nɛ Babilon maa pee ma doku; e maa pee nga mi gbehi a hi he, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie hu.
Nihi nɛ ma ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a nya maa kpɛ a he, nɛ a maa ye gbeye.
Babilonia bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa hi huãe kaa jata; a maa hi pɛe kaa jata bimɛ.
Ke a he mi akɔnɔ te si ɔ, ma tsɛ mɛ ní yemi; ma ha mɛ dã nɛ a nu nɛ a de.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa sɛ mahe vii mi, nɛ a be si tee hu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho nɛ a ya gbe mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a gbeɔ jijɔ, loo apletsi, loo agbosu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Babilon hɛ mi kpata Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Babilon he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Kɛ e ba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ a ngɔ Babilon, ma nɛ je ɔ tsuo jeɔ e yi ɔ!
Kɛ e ba lɛ kɛɛ loko Babilon ba pee nɔ́ nɛ a hiee ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti kikɛ nɛ ɔ!
Wo ɔ te si kɛ wo Babilon, nɛ wo oslɔke ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ ha e nɔ.
Babilon ma amɛ plɛ pee níhi nɛ a hiee; zugba a pee kaa nga kplanaa nɛ nyu be nɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hu ba bi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma gbla Babilonia mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Bel ɔ tue, nɛ ma je e ju ní ɔmɛ kpo; je ma amɛ be lɛ jae hu.
“Babilon gbogbo ɔmɛ ku kɛ pueɔ si.
Ye ma, Israel, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ!
Nyɛɛ tu ye mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a nya fo, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he e yi wami.
Nyɛ nine mi nɛ ko je wu; sanehi nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ hu a ko po nyɛ tsui.
Daa jeha a, a ke sane he ko kɛ̃ maa ba.
Ke sane ɔ kɔ we yi wu tso níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ a he ɔ, lɛɛ matsɛ kɛ matsɛ lɛ na.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be ma nɛ i kɛ Babilonia amaga amɛ maa to ní.
Babilonia zugba a tsuo hɛ mi ma pue si, nɛ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Nihi maa je omleyi je kɛ ba kpata Babilonia hɛ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ma hwɔ lele.
Babilonia kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja a kpata Babilonia hu hɛ mi kokooko, ejakaa e gbe Israel bi babauu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Mawu sɛ gbi kɛ ha Israel bi nɛ ngɛ Babilonia Yawɛ ma a nɛ ngɛ Babilonia a, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ je klaate nya!
Nyɛɛ ho esɔesɔ!
Nyɛ ko to tsle!
Nyɛɛ kɛ we he kɛ mohu lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ susu imi Yawɛ, ye he; nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Yerusalem nɔ.
Nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Wa hɛ mi pue si!
Ahlua bɔ wɔ!
Wa yi ta pɛ!
Ejakaa he klɔuklɔuhi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, nibwɔhi ba ngɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke, be ma nɛ i kɛ Babilon amaga amɛ maa to ní, nɛ a maa nu nihi nɛ plaa a he nɛ a ngɛ kɛmɛe ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Ke Babilon kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ e ya ma mɔ nɛ he wa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tete po, ma tsɔ nihi kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ya kpata e hɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Babilon hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Ngmlaa nɛ nya wa ngɛ pɛe ngɛ Babilon.
A wo yana boboobo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa zugba a hɛ mi kpata!
I ngɛ Babilon hɛ mi kpatae nɛ nɔ ko pa be e he nue hu.
Ta buli ɔmɛ a he sɔ kɛ ba sɛ ma a mi, nɛ a ba tua a he nyɛli ɔmɛ gidigidi kɛ ngmlaa kaa bɔ nɛ oslɔke kuɔ kɛ ba pueɔ wo dɔ mi ɔ.
A ba kpata Babilon hɛ mi; a nuu Babilon ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ a ku a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ.
Mawu nɛ woɔ yayami he hiɔ ji mi, ma gbla Babilon tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ.
Ma ha nɛ a ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ní leli ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ maa tɔ dã.
Ke a hwɔ si ɔ, a be si tee hu.
Imi, matsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.
Ye biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
A maa hule Babilonia gbogbohi kɛ a hɛ mi gbajagbajaa a ngɔ pue si, nɛ a maa mɛ agbo gagaaga amɛ a he la.
Je ma amɛ tsu yaka ní pɛ; a gbo dengme kɛ ha la nɛ e ba sã.
Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.” Yeremia ngɔ sɛ gbi kɛ mane Babilonia Matsɛ Zedekia tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔkɔtɔma kake ji Neria bi Seraya, Maseya bibi ɔ. Yuda matsɛ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha eywiɛne ɔ, benɛ lɛ Zedekia a yaa Babilonia a, Seraya kɛ lɛ ya.
I ngɔ sɛ gbi kɛ ha Seraya kɛ ho.
I ngma amanehlu tsuo nɛ maa ba Babilonia nɔ, kɛ ní kpahi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ Babilonia he kɛ wo womi mi.
I de Seraya ke, “Ke o su Babilon ɔ, moo kane níhi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ ha ma a. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo sɔle nɛ o de ke, ‘Yawɛ, o de ke o ma kpata hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ nɔmlɔ, loo lohwe be hiɛ ɔ hie hu.
O de ke hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee ma doku kɛ ya neneene.’ Seraya, ke o kane womi nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, o fi tɛ kɛ wo he, nɛ o ya sake kɛ fɔ Yufrate pa a mi, nɛ o de ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ Babilonia ma mu kɛ ya nyu sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Babilonia ma mu, nɛ e be hiae hu, ejakaa Yawɛ ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’ ” Yeremia sɛ gbi ɔ nya ta ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.
A kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi Zedekia ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kake benɛ e ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ.
E hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kake.
E nyɛ biɛ ji Hamutal.
Yeremia nɛ je Libna a biyo ji lɛ.
Matsɛ Zedekia pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yehoyakim pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yawɛ mi mi fu Yuda ma a, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ ya si e je e hɛ ngɛ a nɔ.
Zedekia tsɔ atuã kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji nyɔngma a we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo ba tua Yerusalem.
A sa ma a yi, nɛ a fia kpokuhi kɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe.
A sa ma a yi hluu kɛ ya si Matsɛ Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ. Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ, benɛ hwɔ ɔ nya ba wa, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ na we ní nɛ a ye ɔ, a hule gbogbo ɔ nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia bi ɔmɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe mohu, se matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo nyɔ ɔ mi.
A gu matsɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi kɛ ya be ngɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɔ a yi ngɔ ka Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi blɔ.
Babilonia tabo ɔ nyɛɛ Zedekia se, nɛ a ya nu lɛ ngɛ Yeriko nga a nɔ; e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa kɛ je e he.
A ngɔ Zedekia ya ha Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ Ribla, ngɛ Hamat zugba a nɔ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ Nebukadnezar kojo lɛ nɛ e bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ.
Nebukadnezar gbe Zedekia binyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ Zedekia hɛ mi ngɛ Ribla.
E gbe Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ta Zedekia hɛngmɛhi; e bɔ lɛ pã, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilon, nɛ e ya wo lɛ tsu.
Zedekia hi tsu ɔ mi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ ligbi.
A puɛ Yawɛ we ɔ Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, Nebukadnezar tatsɛ, kɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nebuzaradan ɔ ya Yerusalem.
E sã Yawɛ we ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ ni nguahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a wehi, nɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ hule gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ. Nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ku nigii kɛ ho Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, kɛ ga ní tsuli nɛ piɛ ɔ, Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho Babilonia ya.
Se e si ohiatsɛmɛ komɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko be a dɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda, konɛ a tsu ní ngɛ wai abɔɔ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ywia akɔblee titima amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ akɔblee nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ kɛ e sisi daka amɛ; nɛ a muɔ akɔblee ɔ tsuo kɛ ho Babilon ya.
A muɔ buɛ ɔmɛ, sofi ɔmɛ, la gbemi ní ɔmɛ, tsopa kɛ e he via kã amɛ, kɛ akɔblee ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hulɔ kɛ ho.
A muɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, aloo sika hiɔ pee ɔ, kã wawi ɔmɛ, ngɛyu ɔmɛ, kã ngua amɛ, buɛ ɔmɛ, kane tso ɔmɛ, tsopa kɛ e he via kã amɛ, kɛ likɔkɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho.
Akɔblee níhi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo pee kɛ wo Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ ji titima enyɔ ɔmɛ, nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ, kɛ na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nyu nɔ́ ɔ maa si ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ a sisi daka amɛ lɛɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ngmɛ, ejakaa a jiɔ tsɔ.
-Titima enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ fiee; kake kami ji gugue eywiɛ kɛ fa, nɛ kpa gugue etɛ maa kpe he.
Puɔ ngɛ titima enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ akɔblee nɛ a kɛ pee ɔ, e timi ji nine nguɛ eywiɛ.
Akɔblee kpɔ ngɛ titima amɛ eko tsuaa eko yi mi.
Kpɔ kake hiɔwe yami maa pee gugue kake kɛ fa, nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ya kɛ e mi níhi kaa tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ tsɔwitsɔwihi kɛ mimlaa akɔblee kpɔ ɔmɛ.
Níhi kaa tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ tsɔwitsɔwihi nɛ ngɛ akɔblee ya a eko tsuaa eko mi ji lafa, se nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ ekpa ji nɔ́ nɛ o maa na ngɛ zugba.
A ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya Nebuzaradan, tatsɛ ɔ ngɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Seraya e se yelɔ, osɔfo Zefania, kɛ Yawɛ we buli etɛ ɔmɛ hu nyɔguɛ.
Jehanɛ, nihi nɛ e ngɔ kɛ je ma a mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, matsɛ ga woli kpaago nɛ ngɛ ma a mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, asafoatsɛ ɔ pɛdiyo ɔ nɛ buaa ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ yaa ta a, kɛ ma mi bi kpahi nyingmi ekpa.
Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Ribla.
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ fia mɛ ní, nɛ e gbe mɛ ngɛ Ribla, ngɛ Hamat zugba a nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a pee kɛ ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ Nebukadnezar ngɔ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: benɛ e ye jeha kpaago ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ Yuda bi , kɛ ho; benɛ e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ nihi kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho; jehanɛ, benɛ Nebukadnezar ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e tatsɛ Nebuzaradan ba ngɔ Yuda bi nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.
Ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji ,.
Jeha mi nɛ Evilmerodak ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Babilonia ma a nɔ ɔ, e na Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin mɔbɔ, nɛ e je lɛ kɛ je tsu mi jamɛ a jeha a nɔuu.
Nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ɔ nɔ lɛ a ngmɛɛ Yehoyakin he ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yehoyakin na jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaago momo ngɛ nyɔguɛ si himi mi.
Evilmerodak kɛ Yehoyakin hi si saminya, nɛ e ha lɛ blɔ nya nɛ pe bɔ nɛ e pee matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ e ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ piɛ e he ngɛ Babilonia a. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngmɛ Yehoyakin blɔ nɛ e je pã mi tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he ngɔ pue si, nɛ e ya yeɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ okplɔɔ he daa ligbi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ be.
Jehanɛ se hu, matsɛ ɔ haa lɛ yemi kɛ buami sika ko daa ligbi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ be.
NYA TSƆƆMI Kɔmɔ yemi lahi nɛ a po ngɛ asilɛ gbi mi enuɔ nɛ́ a bua nya lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
A kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi jeha loko a fɔ Kristo.
A pee ma a butuu, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a nuu mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a he kɔmɔ asilɛte ɔ ngɛ yee.
E ngɛ mi kaa la amɛ ngɛ mɔbɔ lɛɛ, se wa naa ngɛ mi kaa a ngɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ kaa hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, níhi ma ba hi ha mɛ.
Ngɛ Hebri ngmami ɔ mi ɔ, asilɛte ɔ bɔ mɔde ngɔ Hebri ningma okadi ɔmɛ setsɔ setsɔ kɛ je mi dlami tsuaa mi dlami sisi ngɛ kekleekle yi eywiɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Daa jeha a, Yuda bi haa hwɔ kɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ nɛ a laa la nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ kaiɔ amanehlu nɛ ma a na a. Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha A ye Yerusalem he kɔmɔ .- A gbla Yerusalem tue .- Tue gblami kɛ hɛ nɔ kami .- A ywia Yerusalem ma a ngɔ pue si .- Mɔbɔ nami he kue fami .-
A ye Yerusalem he kɔmɔ Yerusalem, ma nɛ sa be ko ɔ, nihi babauu ngɛ mi ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ e mi je gu kɛ fɔɔ si ha!
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, je ma amɛ buu lɛ ma nguaa, se jehanɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa yalɔyo.
Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa matsɛ biyo ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ ba plɛ pee je ma amɛ a nyɔguɛ.
Ya sɔuu e ngɛ foe nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ tsuo; nɛ vo nyu ngɛ e hɛngmɛ mi jee kɛ ngɛ si kplee.
E suɔli ɔmɛ hu a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa jɔɔ e bua.
E huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kpa ngɛ e se, nɛ a ba pee e he nyɛli.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ ba plɛ pee nyɔguɛhi; pi a suɔmi nya nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya a.
A ya je zugba kpahi a nɔ, nɛ a he mi jɔɛ mɛ.
Benɛ a ngɛ aywilɛho yee ɔ, a he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ba sa a yi.
Zion blɔ ɔ nɔ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Nimli a nane po ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ; a bɛ nɛ a ba ye nyami be ɔmɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko ba gui ma a agbo ɔmɛ a mi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe.
Yihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae.
Zion hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi; a nine su e nɔ jehanɛ.
Yawɛ lɛ ha nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ yayami babauu nɛ e pee ɔ he.
E he nyɛli ɔmɛ nuu e bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.
Yerusalem he fɛu ɔ pee kaa blema nɔ́ ko nɛ be kɛkɛ.
E ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa batslɔɔhi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee, nɛ a pee wudɔwudɔ kɛ ngɛ fo tue ngɛ de dali a nya.
Benɛ Yerusalem ngɛ nɔ́ nae wawɛɛ ngɛ ma se ɔ, e kai e blema si himi, kɛ ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ e ná a. Benɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nine su e nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko ba ji ngmlaa ha lɛ.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ ye e he fɛu, nɛ a bɔ lɛ ahlua ngɛ si nɛ e nɔ ɔ he.
Yerusalem pee yayami wawɛɛ kɛ pue e hɛ mi si.
E pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ e he gu; nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ e he akɔtaa a bui lɛ hu.
Ee, e ngɛ kɛmɛe, nɛ e ngɛ e hɛ mi laae.
Yerusalem he yayami ɔ ngɛ fu jee gbɛɛ; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma e nɔ ɔ pee we lɛ kɔmɔ ko kulaa.
E si nɔmi ɔ nya wa; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa wo lɛ bua.
E jé ngmlaa ke, “Ao!
Yawɛ, moo hyɛ nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi!” E he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpɔ e june ní tsuo ngɛ e dɛ.
E ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a bu kɛ sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ mi nitsɛnitsɛ.
He nɛ mlaa ngmɛ́ ma je li blɔ nɛ a ya a po, a sɛ lejɛ ɔ. E we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe kɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko hlae nɛ a ye.
A ngɔ a juetli ɔmɛ kɛ tsake niye ní, konɛ a yi nɛ na wami.
Ma a ngɛ kue fae ke, “Yawɛ, moo hyɛ nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa ye he guɛ gbo!” Kɔmɔ nɛ ma a ngɛ yee kɛ ngmlaa boboobo kɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ bee ɔ tsɔɔe ji, “Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ bee, anɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee we nyɛ mɔbɔ lo?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ mi ha kaa nɔ ko ye aywilɛho hyɛ kaa ye nɔ́ nɛ ɔ lo?
Benɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔ kɛ ba ye nɔ.” “Yawɛ ha la je hiɔwe ba sɛ ye wuhi a mi.
E tsɔ mi klama, nɛ e ha i nɔ si; kɛkɛ nɛ e kua mi, nɛ i ngɛ aywilɛho yee daa.
“E ngɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ to, nɛ e fi kaa tlomi; kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ tloo mi.
E jiɔ tsɔ ha mi; e ngɛ mi gbee!
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ wo he nyɛli nɛ a he wa pe mi a dɛ mi, nɛ peepee ko kulaa be ye he.
“Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kua ye ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
E tsɔ tabo ko kɛ ba nɛ a ba kpata ye nihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ naa Yuda nɛ ngɛ kaa yomiyo ɔ nɔ kaa a ngaa wai ngɛ wai muɔ mi.
“Enɛ ɔ he i wo yana, nɛ vo nyu ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi jee kɛ ngɛ si puee.
I be bua wolɔ ko nɛ maa wo mi he wami.
Peepee ta ye bimɛ ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa he nyɛlɔ ɔ ye ye nɔ kunimi.
“Imi Zion, i wo ye nine nɔ, konɛ a ye bua mi, se balɔ ko ba ji ngmlaa ha mi.
Yawɛ ha nɛ mahi nɛ bɔle imi Yakob, ba pee ye he nyɛli.
Yerusalem ba pee nɔ́ nɛ a hiee.
“Yawɛ nɔ́ da.
Ejakaa imi lɛ i tsɔ atuã, nɛ i bui e munyu ɔ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ nihi tsuo nyɛɛ bu mi tue, konɛ amanehlu nɛ ba ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ na.
A nuu ye nihewi ɔmɛ, kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.
“I fɔ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nine, konɛ a ba piɛ ye he, se a sisi mi.
Benɛ ye osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ho ma a mi ya ya ngɛ niye ní hlae nɛ a ye nɛ a yi nɛ na wami ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata.
“Yawɛ lee, hyɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe ha; i ngɛ he hiami mi wawɛɛ, nɛ ye tsui ngɛ mi yee.
I tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã.
A ngɛ nihi gbee ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; jã kɛ̃ nihi ngɛ gboe ngɛ we ɔmɛ a mi hulɔ.
“Bu ye kɛmɛmi ɔ tue; nɔ ko be nɛ maa jɔɔ ye bua.
Haomi nɛ ba ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nu he, nɛ a bua jɔ kaa o ha sane nɛ ɔ ba ye nɔ.
Ligbi nɛ o to ha he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, ha nɛ e ba esɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a pee kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ.
“Yayami tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ to ní ngɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ o pee imi hu ngɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ. Ye kɛmɛmi ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ, nɛ ye he wami ta.”
Yawɛ gbla Yerusalem tue Benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi wo la a, e ha nɛ bɔku ha Zion nɔ.
E kpɔ́ Israel he fɛu ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba pue zugba.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ e mi mi fu ɔ, e kua lɛ nitsɛ e we pohu.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpata Israel ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ e nɛ mɔbɔ kulaa.
E ngɔ e mi mi la a kɛ ywia Yuda ma a nya mɔ ngua amɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.
E ha zo gbe nɔ yemi ɔ, kɛ e mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Benɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba tua wɔ ɔ, e piɛ we wa he, mohu ɔ, e kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ nya wa ku Israel he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya la.
E gli kɛ wo wɔ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam kɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatae.
E ngɔ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ka wɔ kaa wa he nyɛlɔ.
E gbe wa suɔli kpakpa amɛ tsuo.
E kɛ e mi mi la nɛ nya wa kaa la a kple Yerusalem nɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpata Israel hɛ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ e he nyɛlɔ ji lɛ.
E ywia e mɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
E ha nɛ Yuda ma a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee babauu.
Mawu we ɔ, he nɛ wa jaa lɛ ngɛ ɔ, e ywia lɛ dukuduku ngɔ pue si.
E gu nyami be ɔmɛ, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Abofu nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ sa matsɛmɛ, kɛ osɔfohi tsuo a he.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sume e bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hu, nɛ e kua sɔlemi we ɔ. E ha he nyɛli ku mɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pue si.
A hwɔ lele ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ wa peeɔ ke wa ngɛ nyami ligbi yee ɔ. Yawɛ to e yi mi kaa a ku Zion gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
E susu a kami kɛ blimi kɛ to, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, mɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo ku kɛ pueɔ si.
Zu ha agbo ɔmɛ a nɔ; a ku a se lami ní ɔmɛ a mi dukuduku.
A nuu matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.
Nɔ ko tsɔɔ we mlaa a hu.
Yawɛ je we nina kɛ ha we gbali ɔmɛ hu.
Yerusalem nimeli ɔmɛ hii si dii ngɛ zugba.
A ngɔ bunyuku ngɔ pue a yi mi, nɛ a ha kpekpe ya bo kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a pia a he.
Yihewi ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ bu si.
I fo ya hluu, nɛ ye hɛngmɛ tsuo fuu.
I ngɛ he hiami mi wawɛɛ.
Ye tsui ngɛ mi yee, ejakaa a ywia ye we bi ɔmɛ a ma a. Jokuɛwi kɛ bimwɔwi ngɛ hɛlie ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ma a mi.
Benɛ a ngɛ awe nyae, nɛ a ngɛ a nyɛmɛ bie ke, “Jije wa ma na abolo ngɛ; jije wa ma na wai ngɛ ɔ” ɔ, a hɛliɔ kaa nihi nɛ plaa ngɛ ma a mi gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ a gboɔ ngɛ a nyɛmɛ a gugue mi.
Yerusalem, i suɔ mo!
Yerusalem, mɛni ma de ha mo?
Kɛ ma pee kɛ jɔɔ o bua kɛɛ?
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ́ amanehlu hyɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba o nɔ nɛ ɔ. O haomi ɔ kle tsɔ, nɛ e nyagbe be.
Mɛnɔ ma he o yi wami?
O gbali ɔmɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nɛ a ma de mo; lakpa pɛ a yeɔ mo.
A fiɛɔ kɛ sisiɔ mo.
A je we o tɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo.
A ha nɛ o susu kaa e hia we nɛ o tsake o tsui.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ba guu ma a nya kɛ bee ɔ, hwɔɔ o yi; a huanyaa a yi, nɛ a yeɔ o he fɛu.
A deɔ ke, “Jamɛ a ma kɛ e he fɛu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?
Je ɔ tsuo fiami nɔ́ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?” O he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ mo sie; a kɛ ninyɛ hyɛɛ mo gãã.
A kpɔɔ nya kɛ woɔ mo.
A deɔ ke, “E tsɔɔ mo!
Mwɔnɛ ji mwɔnɛ!
Wa nine su o nɔ jehanɛ!” Nɔ́ ko nɛ Yawɛ de ke e maa pee ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e pee.
Yawɛ kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e de to be ko ke e maa pee ɔ. E ha nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye wa nɔ, nɛ a bua jɔ a he kaa wa hɛ mi kpata.
Yerusalem lee, moo fa kue boboobo nɛ o tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ!
Ha nɛ o vo nyu ɔmɛ nɛ a hi bee kaa pa nyɔ kɛ pia.
Koo jɔɔ ya fomi, nɛ ko kpa kɔmɔ yemi hulɔ.
Tee si nɛ o nya awe nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Moo fa kue ha lɛ kɛ o tsui tsuo, nɛ o kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e na o bimɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ.
Hyɛ kaa hwɔ ngɛ jokuɛwi gbee ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Yawɛ lee, hyɛ koo!
Moo hyɛ nihi nɛ o ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ!
Yihi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muklii mi bimɛ nɛ a suɔ ɔ yee!
Mawu we ɔ nitsɛnitsɛ mi po a ngɛ osɔfohi, kɛ gbalihi gbee!
Jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi tsuo gbo kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ klaate gbe nihewi, kɛ yihewi.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ o mi mi wo la a, o gbe mɛ tsuo basabasa nɛ o nɛ́ mɔbɔ kulaa.
O kpee ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ a ba bɔle mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nyami ligbi yee.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ o mi mi wo la a, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ye e he.
Ye bimɛ nɛ i lɛ, nɛ i suɔ mɛ ɔ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbe mɛ tsuo.
Tue gblami, tsui tsakemi, kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi Ke a ke Mawu gbla nɔ ko tue ɔ, imi lɛɛ i le nɔ́ nɛ ji.
E tsɛ̃ mi ngɔ wo diblii kpii mi, nɛ la ko la ko be lejɛ ɔ. E fiaa mi ní wawɛɛ nɔtonɔto ligbi mluku ɔ tsuo.
E ha nɛ i ta he lo, nɛ ye he womi pee nyamanyama, nɛ e ku ye wuhi a mi.
Nɔ́ nami, kɛ aywilɛho sa ye yi kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a wo mi tsu.
E ha nɛ i hi diblii kpii mi kaa nihi nɛ gbo blema a a ti nɔ ko.
E bɔ mi pã; e po piɛ kɛ wo ye he, konɛ ma ko na blɔ nɛ ma tu fo kɛ je.
I kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Mawu, konɛ e ba je mi, se e bui mi tue.
E ngɔ tɛ agbohi kɛ fɔ blɔ mi ha mi, nɛ e ha nɛ ye blɔ ɔ kpɛ̃.
E pee kaa osisiblisi nɛ wo ka, loo jata nɛ laa e he, konɛ e nu mi.
E ha nɛ i tla blɔ, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ ye mi; e pee mi posoposo.
E gbla e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ ngɔ ka mi.
E tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba sɛ ye wuhi a mi tɔɔ.
I plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ ha nihi tsuo.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, imi ji a nya mi la nɛ a ngɛ lae.
E ha nɛ i na amanehlu nɛ nya wa.
Ye we amanehlu ɔ ngɛ kaa agba ngɛ ye nya mi.
E ha nɛ i kokloo si ngɛ zugba, nɛ ye lungu kli kaa nɔ nɛ kpe tɛ ngmlitsa.
I li nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ tue mi jɔmi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ ye hɛ je bua jɔmi po nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Ye he wami, kɛ ye hɛ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ se po.” Ye we amanehlu, kɛ hi he ko nɛ be ye dɛ ɔ, ke i kai ɔ, e ngɛ kaa agba, loo duɔ nɛ nya wa ha mi.
Be tsuaa be nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ, e haa nɛ ye he mi jɔ̃ɔ̃.
Se nɔ́ nɛ ke i kai nɛ ye nɔ gbagba tee ji, kaa Yawɛ suɔmi se pui gblegbleegble; e naa mɔbɔ daa.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ ehe daa mɔtu.
Yawɛ we anɔkuale yemi ɔ kle.
Yawɛ ji ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.
Yawɛ mi mi hi ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa Yawɛ se blɔ ɔ; e peeɔ lɛ kpakpa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa waa to wa tsui si kɛ hyɛ Yawɛ blɔ, konɛ e he wa yi wami.
Wa nihe mi ji be nɛ sa kaa waa kase tsui si tomi nɛ ɔ. Ke wa ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e sa kaa waa pee dii, nɛ waa to wa tsui si.
Waa ba wa he si, ejakaa ke wa pee ja a, e be yaka pee.
Ke a ngɛ wɔ ní fiae, loo a ngɛ wa hɛ mi si puee ɔ, wa ha nɛ a pee kɛkɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ be wɔ kuae kɛ ya neneene.
Eko ɔ, e ma ha nɛ wa maa ye aywilɛho lɛɛ, se kɛ̃, e maa na wɔ mɔbɔ, ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ kle, nɛ e ngɛ daa.
E pee we lɛ bua jɔmi kaa e ma ha nɛ waa ye aywilɛho, loo waa na amanehlu.
Ke a wo wɔ tsu, nɛ wa mumi nya ngɛ tae ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le.
Blɔ nya nɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ ha wɔ ɔ, ke a he ngɛ wa dɛ ɔ, e le.
Ke a yi dami sane ngɛ sane yemi he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le.
Ke pi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he wami nya a, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de nɔ́ ko nɛ e ba mi?
Kpakpa jio, yaya jio, Hiɔwe No ɔ lɛ deɔ loko e baa mi.
Nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji wɔ.
Ke wa pee yayami nɛ a gbla wa tue ɔ, mɛni he je wa hii wa nya jee ɔ?
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ wa je mi bami mi saminya, nɛ waa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa wo wa nine nɔ nɛ waa fa kue kɛ je wa tsui mi tɔɔ kɛ ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ke, “Wa tɔ̃; wa tsɔ atuã, lɔ ɔ he nɛ mo Yawɛ, o kɛ wa yayami ɔmɛ pɛ wɔ ɔ nɛ.
“O kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa nyɛɛ wa se, nɛ o ba gbe wɔ; o nɛ wɔ mɔbɔ kulaa.
O we abofu nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔku nɛ mi ti nɛ o kɛ ha o he.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa fa kue ha mo ɔ, e sui o ngɔ.
O ha nɛ wa plɛ nɔ́ nɛ a hiee, kɛ dwɔmi ha je ma amɛ tsuo.
“Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ wɔ sie.
Wa hao, nɛ wa nu sawale.
Wa na amanehlu, nɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi.
Vo nyu ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi jee kɛ ngɛ si puee kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee; ejakaa a kpata ye ma a hɛ mi.
“Ma fo ya, nɛ ye vo nyu ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble; ma pee jã kɛ yaa si Yawɛ nitsɛ maa na kɛ je hiɔwe.
Ke i hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba yihewi ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, i haoɔ wawɛɛ.
“Ye he nyɛli nɛ nyɛɛ mi yaka a tsɔ mi klama, nɛ i du.
A sake mi ngɔ fɔ muɔ mi hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ a ngɔ tɛ kɛ tsi ye yi.
I ho nyu sisi ya, nɛ i de ke, ‘Ye yi ta pɛ!’ “I fa kue ha mo, Yawɛ kɛ je muɔ ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
Kue nɛ i fa nɛ o nu ji, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ba piɛ ye he; koo tsi o tue.’ Benɛ i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he nɔ, nɛ o de mi ke ma ko ye gbeye.
“Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o je ngmlaa ha mi.
Mo lɛ o he ye yi wami.
Yawɛ, moo ye ye sane ɔ ha mi; yayami tsuo nɛ a pee mi ɔ, o le.
O le bɔ nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ sume ye sane ha.
O le bɔ nɛ a so ye yi nɔ.
“Yawɛ, ahlua nɛ a bɔ mi ɔ, o nu.
Yi mi yaya tsuo nɛ a to kɛ wo ye he ɔ, o le.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, ye he munyu yaya sɔuu a ngɛ tue.
Jã kɛ̃ a ngɛ a ga yaya amɛ toe.
Hyɛ!
A ngɛ sihi he jio, a ngɛ si dami nya jio, ye he fɛu sɔuu a ngɛ yee; a ngɔ mi ngɔ pee a nya mi la.
“Yawɛ lee, gbla a tue ngɛ níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he.
Moo gbiɛ mɛ, nɛ o ha a tsui nɛ ye mɛ Yawɛ lee, o kɛ mi mi la nɛ nyɛɛ a se gidigidi, nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi!”
Yerusalem, ngɛ e tue gblami ɔ se Hyɛ bɔ nɛ wa sika tsu ɔ pee tuu ha!
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ɔ tsake ha.
Mawu we ɔ tɛ ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo.
Zion nihewi nɛ a he jua wa ha wɔ kaa sika tsu saminya a, hyɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a buu mɛ kaa zu kplu gu komɛ kɛkɛ nɛ buɛ puɛlɔ puɛ.
Nga mi gbe po haa e bimɛ nyɔ nɛ a pupɔɔ, se ye ma a lɛɛ a yi mi wa; a ngɛ kaa dugumahi ngɛ nga nɔ.
Kuma gbe bimwɔwi; a ngɛ a nya mi lɔe kɛ ngɛ nyu hlae.
Jokuɛwi ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ke a ha mɛ niye ní; se nɔ ko nɔ ko ha we mɛ.
Nihi nɛ ye ní kpakpahi be ko nɛ be ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi kpata ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nihi nɛ a lɛ mɛ ngɛ he kpakpahi be ko nɛ be ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ si kukuɔe ngɛ kuku nɔ.
A gbla ye ma a tue wawɛɛ pe Sodom.
Sodom lɛɛ e tue gblami ɔ ba ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi, nɛ adesa nine be mi.
Sa a, wa ganɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyaii, nɛ a he tsɔ pe sinoo.
A hiɛɛ pe nyɔ nyu po.
A ngɛ he wami saminya kaa kora tɛ; a yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa safiro.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, a hɛ mi yuɔ pe kutu sisi.
A yo we mɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ta he lo; a je wu, nɛ a pee kaa tso gbigbli.
Nihi nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe mɛ ɔ, a nɔ́ hi kulaa pe nihi nɛ hwɔ gbe mɛ ɔ; sekpɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ hwɔ ye mɛ bluu kɛ ya si hwɔ ɔ gbe mɛ kakaaka.
Ye ma a hɛ mi kpatami ɔ ngɛ gbeye.
Binyɛmɛ nɛ suɔ a bimɛ kaa nɔ́ ko po, hoo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ kaa niye ní nɛ a ye.
Yawɛ mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e je e we abofu ɔ kpo; e mɛ Zion he la, nɛ e sã ma a sisi tomi ɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Je ma amɛ, kɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he we yi kaa he nyɛlɔ ko ma nyɛ ma tua Yerusalem, nɛ e ma nyɛ sɛ ma a agbo ɔmɛ a mi.
Se e ba mi ja, ejakaa gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ pee yayami; a pue nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da ngɛ ma a mi ɔ a muɔ si.
A hii nyɛɛe kɛ hii yae kɛ hii bae ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa hɛ yuyuili.
A kɛ muɔ ble a he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ta a tade ɔmɛ a he.
Nihi kpaa ngmlaa kɛ woɔ mɛ, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ble nyɛ he!
Nyɛ ko ta wa he!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lalaalo kɛ kpa ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ, se ma ko ma ko he we mɛ.
Yawɛ hyɛ we a nɔ hu.
Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ e gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.
E pee we osɔfo ɔmɛ a he akɔtaa hu, nɛ wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu, e nɛ mɛ mɔbɔ.
Wa hyɛ yemi kɛ buami blɔ hluu kɛ ya si pɔ tɔ wa hɛngmɛ he, nɛ e ko hu bɛ.
Wa mlɛ kaa je ma ko maa je ngmlaa ha wɔ lo, se lɛ tsuo pee yaka; nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha wɔ.
He nyɛlɔ ɔ ngɛ wa nane hiɔe, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa nyɛ we nɛ waa nyɛɛ kɛ be ngɛ wa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tete po.
Wa nyagbe ɔ su jehanɛ; wa ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta; wa hɛ mi kpata.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ wa se kɛ fo.
A he sɔɔ pe kɔlehi ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi.
A nyɛɛ wa se kɛ gu yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a wo wɔ ka ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.
Wa matsɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ hla lɛ, nɛ woɔ wɔ he wami, nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ kaa e ma ba kpɔ wɔ kɛ je he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ sɛ a kpa mi, nɛ a nu lɛ.
Nyɛ Edom bi nɛ ngɛ Uz zugba a nɔ, nyɛ nya, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ.
Se mohu nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ hu a maa gbla nyɛ tue.
Nyɛ maa hɛɛ nyɛ he gu, nɛ nyɛ maa hi nyɛɛe kɛ zo kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.
A wo Zion he yayami ɔmɛ a he hiɔ ta, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ be hae nɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ma se hu.
Se mo Edom lɛɛ Yawɛ maa gbla o tue; e ma ha o he yayami ɔmɛ maa je kpo paa nɛ a na.
Mɔbɔ nami he kue fami Yawɛ lee, mo kai amanehlu nɛ wa na a; moo hyɛ bɔ nɛ zo gbe wɔ ha.
Wa weto ní plɛ pee nibwɔhi a nɔ́.
Wa we ɔmɛ hu ma se li lɛ ngɛ a mi.
Wa pee awusa bimɛ; wa tsɛmɛ be je mi, nɛ wa nyɛmɛ pee yalɔyihi.
Nyu nɛ wa nuu ɔ po e hia kaa waa wo he hiɔ; nɛ lɛ́ nɛ wa ma slɛ hu ja wa he kɛ sika.
A woɔ wɔ kuɛ pã tso, nɛ a haa wa tsuɔ ní kpakpataa; nɛ ke pɔ tɔ wɔ ɔ, a ha we nɛ wa jɔɔ wa he.
Wa ngɔ wa he ya bɔ Egipt, kɛ Asiria bi a he, konɛ wa ná ngma nɛ waa ye nɛ waa tɔ.
Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee yayami, se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a be je mi, nɛ wa ba ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Nyɔguɛhi lɛ a ngɛ wa nɔ yee; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je a dɛ mi.
Wa hɛɛ wa wami ngɛ wa nguɛ nya kɛ ngɛ wa nya mi ngma hlae kɛ bee; ejakaa awi yeli ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ kpae.
Hwɔ nɛ nya wa ha nɛ wa he womi kota kaa nɔ́ nɛ flɔɔnɔɔ la nɛ sã wɔ.
A nuu wa yi ɔmɛ ngɛ Zion; nɛ a nuu wa bimɛ yihewi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, nɛ a pee mɛ basabasa.
A nuu wa ganɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sɛu mɛ.
Wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu a bui mɛ fɛɛ.
A nyɛɔ wa nihewi ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa nyɔguɛhi nɛ a gblɛ ngma.
Wa binyumuwi ɔmɛ tlooɔ lɛ́ nɛ jiɔ, nɛ a hii si nɔe ngɛ sisi.
Nimowihi hí si ngɛ ma agbo nya hu, nɛ nihewi fiɛ we do hu.
Bua jɔmi ko be ha wɔ ngɛ je mi hu; wa kpa domi nɛ wa ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
Jlasi je wa yi nɔ si.
Wa pee yayami, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, musu tloo wɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ wa ngɛ wa tsui yee wawɛɛ, nɛ wa vo nyu ɔ ha we nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko hu; ejakaa Zion Yo ɔ nɔ je gu kɛ fɔɔ si, nɛ nga mi gbehi ngɛ ma a mi ní kokoe ɔmɛ a mi kpae.
Se mo Yawɛ, mo ji matsɛ kɛ yaa neneene; yi nɔhi tsuo o maa ye tsɛ.
Mɛni he je o hɛ je wa nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ngmɛɛ wa he be babauu nɛ ɔ?
Yawɛ, moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu!
Yawɛ, kpale wɔ kɛ da wa da he ekohu!
Ngɔɔ wa blema hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ ha wɔ ekohu.
Aloo pe o kua wɔ kulaa?
Anɛ o we abofu ɔ nyagbe be lo?
NYA TSƆƆMI Israel bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛli ba tua Yerusalem jeha loko a fɔ Kristo nɛ a nuu Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se tsitsaa Babilonia ya.
Gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ezekiel piɛ a he.
E fiɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo.
Womi nɛ ɔ hɛɛ mi dlami ekpa: Mawu tsɛ Ezekiel kaa e ba pee gbalɔ.
Gbalɔ ɔ bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ke Mawu maa gbla a tue; Yerusalem he wami nya maa hɛ si, nɛ a ma kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Sɛ gbihi nɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ wa e ma a yi mi, nɛ a ha e ma a tla blɔ ɔ, e maa gbla a tue.
Mawu wo e ma a si kaa e ma ba hi ha mɛ hwɔɔ se.
A gba kɛ si Gog.
Gbalɔ Ezekiel kale bɔ nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ ma a ma ba bɔ hwɔɔ se.
Gbalɔ Ezekiel ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nya wa; nɛ e ngɛ juɛmi nɛ nyɛɔ peeɔ foni ngɛ e yi mi saminya hulɔ.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ́ a nu ninahi babauu nɛ e na a a sisi ɔ, e gu foni kalemi nɔ kɛ de e sɛ gbi ɔmɛ.
Ezekiel ma nɔ mi ke e hia kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsui mi nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e ná mumi he.
E de hu ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he akɔtaa.
E fiɛ ke hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ kaa ma a maa bɔ ekohu.
Akɛnɛ osɔfo kɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, níhi nɛ ngɛ e tsui nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ ji Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ sa kaa a pee klɔuklɔu.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Mawu tsɛ Ezekiel .—.
Sɛ gbihi nɛ tsɔɔ tue gblami nɛ maa ba Yerusalem nɔ .—.
Mawu maa gbla je ma amɛ a tue .—.
Mawu wo e ma a si .—.
A gba kɛ si Gog .—.
Yawɛ we he ɔ, kɛ zugba he ɔ a he nina .—.
KEKLEEKLE NINA NƐ EZEKIEL NA NGƐ MAWU HE Mawu matsɛ sɛ Jeha nyingmi etɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ eywiɛne ɔ we ligbi enuɔne ɔ, imi osɔfo Ezekiel, Buzi bi ɔ, i kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, wa ngɛ Kebar pa a nya ngɛ Babilonia.
Hiɔwe nya bli, nɛ i na Mawu he ninahi.
Benɛ a nu Matsɛ Yehoyakin kɛ ho ma se ya a se jeha enuɔne ɔ we ligbi enuɔne ɔ, Yawɛ tu munyu, nɛ i nu.
Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ ngɛ Kebar pa a nya ngɛ Babilonia.
Ma wo ye yi nɔ ɔ, o nɛ ahumi nguaa ko nɛ hia kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ma.
Oslabai ngɛ gbae nɔtonɔto kɛ ngɛ bɔku agbo ko mi jee.
Hiɔwe ɔ nɛ bɔle bɔku ɔ tsuo ngɛ la pãe nylamnylam; nɔ́ ko ngɛ kpɛe kaa akɔblee ngɛ la a mi.
I na nɔ́ ko kaa hɛ kali eywiɛ ngɛ ahumi ɔ kpɛti; a ngɛ kaa nimli adesahi; se a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ hɛ mi eywiɛ kɛ pɛli eywiɛ.
A nanehi ngɛ tlɔmɔtlɔmɔ, nɛ a nane si ngɛ kaa na nane si; nɛ a he ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa akɔblee nɛ́ a sa he.
Nɔmlɔ ninehi ngɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi kakaaka.
A pɛli ɔmɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ ke a ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, a plɛ we a he: a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ yaa e hɛ mi tɛɛ.
Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ hɛ mi slɔɔtoslɔɔto eywiɛɛywiɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a hɛ mi ɔmɛ ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nɔmlɔ hɛ mi ngɛ hɛ mi, jata hɛ mi ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, na hɛ mi ngɛ muɔ nɔ, nɛ kɔle hɛ mi ngɛ se je.
A gbɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a mi; a wo enyɔɔnyɔ nɔ ya bua nya ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ́ kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a nɔ́ tsa; nɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a kɛ ha a nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ a he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛɛɔ kɛ yaa e hɛ kpɛ tɛɛ; he tsuaa he nɛ mumi ɔ suɔ kaa a ya a, mɛ tsuo a yaa kutuu nɛ́ a plɛ we a he.
Nɔ́ ko ngɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ a kpɛti jee kaa la ngu nɛ ngɛ tsoe.
E ngɛ pãe kaa jatɛ kɛ nyɛɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.
La a ngɛ kpɛe, nɛ oslabai ngɛ gbae kɛ ngɛ mi jee.
Hɛ kali ɔmɛ saa fo kɛ yaa kɛ baa kaa oslabai nɛ ngɛ gbae.
Benɛ i ngɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ hyɛe ɔ, tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ba ma si ngɛ a kasa nya kakaaka.
Tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ je a sibi, nɛ a ngɛ kpɛe saminya kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa.
Bɔ nɛ a pee mɛ ɔ, tlɔɔke nane kpa hɔɔ si ngɛ eko tsuaa eko mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛɔ yaa hɛ mi, se je, hiɔ nɔ, loo muɔ nɔ nɛ a plɛ we a he; mɛ tsuo a nyɛɛɔ fiee.
Gahi nɛ a ka nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye ngɛ tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ hɛngmɛhi bɔle ga amɛ a he tsuo kɛ kpe.
Ke hɛ kali ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛɔ a kasa nya, nɛ ke hɛ kali ɔmɛ wo a he nɔ kɛ je zugba a, kɛkɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu wo a he nɔ.
He tsuaa he nɛ a suɔ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ a yaa, nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ si kake too; ejakaa hɛ kali ɔmɛ a mumi lɛ hɛɛ nane ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, nane ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nyɛɛe; nɛ ke a da si ɔ, mɛ tsuo a da si.
Ke hɛ kali ɔmɛ wó a he nɔ kɛ je zugba a, kɛkɛ nane ɔmɛ tsuo hu pee ja, ejakaa hɛ kali ɔmɛ a mumi lɛ hɛɛ nane ɔmɛ.
Nɔ́ ko mluguduu nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klãiklãi kaa ahuhuɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ngɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ a yi nɔ.
Hɛ kali ɔmɛ bli a pɛli ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya a sibi a ngɔ; nɔ kɛ e sibi nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a nɔ́ kakaaka tsa.
Hɛ kali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ pɛli enyɔ ngɔ ha e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.
Benɛ a te kɛ yaa a, i nu a pɛli ɔmɛ a he kaa wo nɛ ngɛ fiae gudaguda, loo ta buli a ngmlaa hoo, loo Mawu Ope ɔ nitsɛ e gbi.
Benɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ ya da si ɔ, a ba a pɛli ɔmɛ si, se gbi ko pɛ ngɛ nɔ mluguduu ɔ nɛ ngɛ a yi nɔ ɔ yi mi.
Ke o hyɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko kaa matsɛ sɛ nɛ hɛɛ tɛ bluu su ngɛ nɔ́ mluguduu ɔ nɔ́, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kɛ je e he ko nɛ a ma tsɛ ke e mlɛ mi kɛ kuɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i na a pee kaa ayawa ngɛ la mi.
Kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ ya pue sisi ɔ tsuo ngɛ kpɛe kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam.
Alale su slɔɔtohi nɛ je kpo ngɛ mi ɔ ngɛ fɛu kaa nɔ́ ko.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kpɛmi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale ɔ je e he kpo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mawu tsɛ Ezekiel ke e ba pee gbalɔ Benɛ i na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, i tsɔ fia si, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu zugba.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ mi dee ke,
“Nɔmlɔ adesa, tee si nɛ o da si nɛ ma de mo nɔ́ ko.” Benɛ e kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ba sɛ ye mi, nɛ e wo ye nɔ kɛ da si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i bu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ mi dee ɔ tue.
E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ma tsɔ mo kɛ ya Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
A nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ atuã, nɛ a kua mi; nɛ mɛ hu a pee a he atuã tsɔli, nɛ a ngɛ ye nɔ tɔe kɛ mwɔɔ.
Ma nɛ e mi bi a tue wa, nɛ a bui mi a ngɔ i ngɛ mo tsɔe ɔ nɛ.
Yaa de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ. Ke atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ bu mo tue jio, a bui mo tue jio, a ma na maa le kɛ̃ kaa gbalɔ ko ngɛ a kpɛti.
“Se mo nɔmlɔ adesa, jamɛ a atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ lɛɛ koo ye mɛ gbeye; a munyu ɔmɛ hu koo bu.
Ke a te si kɛ wo mo, nɛ a bui mo tue ɔ, e maa pee kaa miohi a mi o ngɛ, nɛ nyingmogblakotohi a nɔ o hii si ngɛ, se jamɛ a atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ lɛɛ koo ye mɛ gbeye; a munyu ɔmɛ hu koo bu.
A bu mo tue jio, a bui mo tue jio, moo lɛɛ de mɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ke o de mɛ ɔ. Ejakaa tue gboli ji mɛ.
“Se mo nɔmlɔ adesa, bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue; koo pee o he tue gbolɔ kaa mɛ.
Pãã o nya mi, nɛ o ye nɔ́ nɛ ma ha mo nɛ ɔ.” I na nine ko nɛ a juale ha mi; e hɛɛ womi kpo ko.
E bli womi ɔ mi kɛ fɔ si.
A ngma ní ngɛ womi ɔ hɛ mi, kɛ e se tsuo.
Kɔmɔ yemi, huu fami, kɛ awe nyami munyuhi lɛ ngɛ mi.
Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ha mo ɔ, yé!
Yé womi kpo nɛ ɔ, konɛ o kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ ya tu munyu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i pã ye nya mi, konɛ ma ye womi kpo ɔ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mi hae ɔ. E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yé womi kpo nɛ i ngɔ ha mo nɛ ɔ, nɛ o mi mi nɛ hyi tɔ.” I ye, nɛ e ngɔ ngɛ ye nya mi kaa hwo.
Jehanɛ Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yaa Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ, de mɛ.
Tsa pi nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi kpa nɛ sisi numi wa a ngɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔe, se mohu Israel ma a a ngɔ.
Ke ma nguahi nɛ tuɔ gbi kpahi nɛ wa, nɛ o nui a gbi ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔe ɔ, jinɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu mo tue.
Se Israel ma a be suɔe kaa a maa bu mo tue, ejakaa imi tete po, a sume kaa a maa bu mi tue.
Ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tue wa, nɛ a tsɔɔ atuã.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha o maa wa tue, nɛ o maa kplii o tsui kɛ wo mɛ ja nɔuu.
Ma ha nɛ o hɛ mi maa wa kaa tɛ nɛ he wa pe tslɛbo po.
Koo ye mɛ gbeye, nɛ o tsui ko po ngɛ a hɛ mi; ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ atuã pɛ a tsɔɔ.” Mawu de hu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ta tue saminya, konɛ o kai nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, yaa a ngɔ nɛ o ya tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, a bu tue jio, a bui tue jio.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ wo ye nɔ, nɛ i nu gbi nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ ye se je ke, “Á je Yawɛ yi, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.” Hɛ kali ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ a sibi a he sae, nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ a kasa nya a ngɛ a ní tsue.
Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ pɛe hoo kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba lɛ ngɛ mimiɛe.
Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ benɛ mumi ɔ wo mi kɛ yaa a, e dɔ mi, nɛ ye bua jɔɛ kulaa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i ba su Tel Abib ngɛ Kebar pa a nya.
Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a ngɛ.
I hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago sɔuu; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nu ɔ wo ye he gbeye, nɛ ye he mi po.
Yawɛ pee Ezekiel bulɔ Ligbi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, i pee mo bulɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bu ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ tue saminya, konɛ o kɛ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ha mi.
Ke i de ke yayami peelɔ ko ma gbo, nɛ o bɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔ, nɛ o tui munyu kɛ tsɔɔ we lɛ, konɛ e tsake nɛ e he e yi wami ɔ, jamɛ a yayami peelɔ ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he lɛɛ, se ma bi e muɔ si ngɛ o dɛ.
Se ke o bɔ yayami peelɔ ɔ kɔkɔ, nɛ e kpa we yayami peemi ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he, se moo lɛɛ o ma he o yi wami.
“Jehanɛ, ke nɔmlɔ kpakpa kpa níhi nɛ da peemi, nɛ e ba bɔni yayami peemi, nɛ i fɔ̃ e blɔ mi tso ɔ, e ma gbo.
Akɛnɛ o bɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔ he.
Ma bi e muɔ si ngɛ o dɛ; kpakpa nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo, i be kaie.
Se ke o bɔ dalɔ ɔ kɔkɔ ke e ko pee yayami, nɛ e bu mo tue, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ, e yi ma na wami, nɛ mo nitsɛ hu a ma he o yi wami.” Ezekiel maa pee mumui I nu Yawɛ he wawɛɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Tee si nɛ o ya kɔ̃ ɔ mi; i kɛ mo maa tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ho kɔ̃ ɔ mi ya.
Lejɛ ɔ lɛ i na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i na lɛ ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a. I ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu zugba.
Se Mawu mumi ɔ ba sɛ ye mi, nɛ e wo ye nɔ kɛ da si.
E kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Yaa o we ɔ mi, nɛ o nga sinya kɛ wo o yi.
Nɔmlɔ adesa, a kɛ kpa maa fi mo, nɛ o be kpo nyɛe maa je kɛ ya nihi a kpɛti.
Ma ha nɛ o lilɛ maa mɛtɛ o nya mi; o ma pee mumui, nɛ o be nyɛe maa tu munyu kɛ ka atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kɛ mo maa tu munyu ekohu, nɛ ke i bli o nya a, o ma de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i de mo ɔ.
A ti ni komɛ maa bu mo tue, nɛ ni komɛ hu be mo tue bue; ejakaa ma atuã tsɔli ji mɛ.”
Ezekiel pee okadi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a sa Yerusalem ma a yi Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yaa ngɔ bliikisi nɛ o kɛ fɔ o hɛ mi; nɛ o tɛni Yerusalem ma a ngɛ nɔ.
Moo ma mɔ, nɛ o fia gbogbo kɛ kpoku kɛ wo he.
Ngɔɔ ta buli kɛ gbogbo kuɔmi níhi kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a sa ma a yi.
Ngɔɔ dade pɛtɛɛ ko nɛ o kɛ pee dade gbogbo ngɛ o kɛ ma a nyɛ kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee ma a.
A sa ma a yi!
Mo ji nɔ nɛ sa ma a yi ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi kɛ ha Israel ma a.
-“Jehanɛ, yaa hwɔ si ngɛ o muɔ nɔ.
Ma ngɔ Israel ma a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ.
O maa tloo a he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ o maa na nɔ́ ligbi lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi nɛɛ ngɛ fɔ nɛ a ye ɔ he.
Ligbi kake tue gblami daa si ha jeha kake nɔ́.
Ke o gbe enɛ ɔmɛ a nya a, kpale nɛ o hwɔ o hiɔ nɔ, nɛ o tloo Yuda ma a hu a he yayami ɔmɛ ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ.
Ligbi kake tue gblami daa si ha jeha kake nɔ́.
“Ngɔɔ o hɛ mi kɛ ka Yerusalem ma a nɛ a sa yi ɔ. Je o nine kɛ tsɔɔ ma a. Gbaa kɛ si ma a. Ma fi mo kpa, nɛ o be nyɛe ma plɛ o he kɛ je kasa hiɛ kɛ ya kasa hiɛ kɛ yaa su be nɛ o ma sa ma a yi kɛ gbe nya.
“Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ ngma, akoko, abɔtlamɔ, yɔ, blɛfo akoko, kɛ blɛfo kɛ wo nɔ́ kake mi, nɛ o kɛ pee abolo.
Ligbi lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi nɛɛ ɔ nɛ o maa hwɔ o muɔ kasa nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o maa ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
O niye ní nɛ o maa ye ligbi kake ɔ, e jiimi maa pee kilo mi dlami eywiɛ mi kake.
Nyu nɛ o maa nu daa ligbi maa pee nyu kɔɔpoo enyɔ.
O maa ngɔ nɔmlɔ fĩ kɛ slɛ la; o maa sã abolo ngɛ nɔ, nɛ o maa ye ngɛ ma hɛ mi.” Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ye a niye ní nɛ a ble ɔ ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti he nɛ ma fie mɛ kɛ maa ho ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Kpaoo, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ble we ye he; kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si hluu kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, loo lohwe ko tsɔtslɔɔ mi ɔ, i yi hyɛ; jehanɛ hu, lo nɛ a hiɔ yɛ ye nya mi hyɛ.” Se Mawu de mi ke, “Saminya!
Ma ha o maa ngɔ na fĩ kɛ sã abolo ɔ, se pi nɔmlɔ fĩ.” E de mi hu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ma ha nɛ niye ní he maa hia ngɛ Yerusalem.
Niye ní nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ye ɔ, a maa ngmɛ ngɛ sɛni tɛ nɔ, nɛ nyu nɛ a maa nu hu a ma susu ha mɛ.
A he maa hia mɛ, nɛ a maa ye a tsui ngɛ nyu kɛ ngma he.
Ma ha a niye ní, kɛ nyu maa ta kulaa, nɛ a maa hi a sibi a hɛ mi hyɛe mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
A tue gblami ɔ ma ha a maa ta he lo kanyakanya.”
Ezekiel sɛ e yi kɛ e kpɛni Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ngɔɔ klaate nɛ nya ba kɛ sɛ o yi bwɔmi, kɛ o kpɛni kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ asoyi ngmlaa yi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngmɛɛ bwɔmi ɔ ngɛ sɛni mi, nɛ o dla mi.
Ke a sa ma a yi se ɔ, ngɔɔ la kɛ sã bwɔmi ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake ngɛ ma a kpɛti.
Mi dlami etɛ ɔ mi kake hu ngɔɔ klaate ɔ kɛ poo mi kɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe.
Mi dlami etɛ ɔ mi kake nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ fĩa kɔɔhiɔ mi; kɛkɛ ɔ, ma hia klaate ɔ kɛ nyɛɛ a se.
Ngɔɔ bwɔmi nɛ ɔ mi bɔɔ ko pɛ kɛ muɔ o tade ɔ nya.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, je lɔ ɔ mi eko nɛ o sake kɛ pue la a mi nɛ e sã.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a mi la maa je kɛ ba ha Israel ma a tsuo.” Nɔ́ he je nɛ a kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, Yerusalem ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i ngɔ lɛ kɛ ma je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ ma kpahi bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Se Yerusalem tsɔ atuã; e yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, mohu e pee yayamihi nɛ nya wa babauu pe je ma kpa amɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ. E wa tue, nɛ e bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Yerusalem yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem, bu tue; bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ɔ tue.
Akɛnɛ o tue gbo pe je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mo ɔ, nɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa amɛ hu, o yi a nɔ, se mohu je ma amɛ a kusumi níhi o peeɔ ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ hu, i kɛ mo ná.
Ma gbla o tue ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi paa.
Ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ o pee he je ɔ, ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ bɔ nɛ i pee we nɔ ko hyɛ, nɛ i be pee gblegbleegble hulɔ.
Bɔ nɛ e maa ba ji kaa fɔli ngɛ Yerusalem maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ, nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ hu maa ye a fɔli.
Ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be a bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ o ngɔ tai níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee tsuo kɛ ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, imi Yawɛ hu, i be mo mɔbɔ nae, nɛ i be o yi bae; mohu ma kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ hwɔ maa gbe ma mi bi ɔmɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake; mi dlami etɛ mi kake maa nɔ ngɛ klaate nya kɛ maa bɔle ma a kɛ kpe, nɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake ɔ hu, ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo; nɛ ma hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ a se.
“Ma gbla nyɛ tue wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ ye mi mi la a se maa po, nɛ́ ye bua maa jɔ.
Ke e ba mi ja a, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le kaa imi Yawɛ, i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ yi mi anɔkuale, nɛ lɔ ɔ nɛ wo ye mi mi la a nɛ.
Ma ha Yerusalem maa pee ma doku, kɛ ma nɛ bɔ ahlua ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti.
Nihi nɛ maa be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo maa hie lɛ.
“Ke ye mi mi fu, nɛ ye hɛ dɔ, nɛ i gbla nyɛ tue kikɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ tsuo maa ye gbeye; a maa hie nyɛ, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu.
Ma ha nɛ nyɛ niye ní se maa po kulaa.
Hwɔ maa ye nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa nu hwɔ ɔ he wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kɛ a nya duɔ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae.
Ma ha nɛ hwɔ, kɛ lohwe awi yeli ma kpata nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ma ha gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ ta ma ba kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yawɛ sume amaga jami Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Israel yo ɔmɛ, nɛ o ha mɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ.
De Israel yo ɔmɛ ke a bu Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue.
De mɛ ke a nu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ yo gagaa amɛ, yoku ɔmɛ, dɔgba amɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ tsuo dee ɔ. Imi nitsɛ ma hia ta kɛ wo nyɛ; ma gbɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ.
Ma ku nyɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pue si.
Ma gbe ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɔ pue nyɛ we amaga amɛ a nɔ.
Israel bi nɛ ma gbe ɔ, a gbogboe ɔmɛ ma pue si ngɛ amaga amɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ a wuhi ma fĩa kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ kpe.
Nyɛ ma amɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ ma ba pee ma dokuhi.
Nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ amaga amɛ maa ku dukuduku ngɔ pue si.
Níhi nɛ nyɛ sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ mi ɔ maa ywia, nɛ nyɛ nine nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Nihi babauu ma gbo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha ni komɛ maa piɛ.
Nihi nɛ maa tu fo kɛ je gbenɔ nya a, a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.
A ma kai mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a maa le kaa imi nitsɛ lɛ i gbla a tue, nɛ i pue a hɛ mi si ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa a yi mi anɔkuale kɛ ji a tsui mi; se a kua mi, nɛ a ya ja amagahi mohu.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he mi maa nyɛɛ mɛ ngɛ yayamihi, kɛ ni hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ a he.
A maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɛ́ i de ke ma gbla a tue ɔ, pi nya mi nɛ i pee.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Tsɛ̃ o nguɛ nya!
Ngɔɔ o nane kɛ si si!
De ke akuanyɛ, musu tloo Israel ma a ngɛ yayamihi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ he.
Ta ma kpata ni komɛ a hɛ mi; mi mi hwɔ maa gbe ni komɛ; nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ngɔ ni komɛ hu kɛ ho!
Nihi nɛ ngɛ se lokoo ɔ maa nu hiɔ, nɛ a ma gbo; nihi nɛ ngɛ kpo nya a maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi; nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, hwɔ maa gbe mɛ.
Bɔ nɛ ye mi mi la nɛ nya wa a ma tsu ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A maa na nihi nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ amaga amɛ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a he tsuo kɛ kpe.
A maa na gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ yokuhi nɛ ya hiɔwe, kɛ yohi tsuo a yi mi.
A maa na mɛ ngɛ tsohi tsuo nɛ bɔ kusuu, kɛ tso ngua amɛ a sisi.
Hehi tsuo nɛ a sãã bɔ nɛ jeɔ via ngɛ kɛ haa a we amaga amɛ hu a maa na a gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ ja nɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Niinɛ, ma wo ye nine nɔ ngɛ a nɔ, nɛ ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi bɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ nyɛe maa hi.
Kɛ je leneyi je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ya su Ribla ma a he ngɛ omleyi je, hehi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hii ɔ, ma kpata lejɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Israel tue gblami be ɔ su ta Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ Israel zugba a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O gbe nya pɛ!
Israel zugba a tsuo, o nyagbe ɔ su jehanɛ!
“Israel, o nyagbe ɔ su jehanɛ.
O maa na bɔ nɛ ye mi mi wo la ha; ejakaa ma gbla o tue ngɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he.
Ní hiemi níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ tsuo, ma wo mo a he hiɔ.
I be o yi bae; i be mo mɔbɔ nae.
Se ma gbla o tue mohu ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ o ngɛ pee kpamisa a he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Amanehlu nyɛɛ amanehlu se kɛ ma!
Nyagbe ɔ su oo!
E ná mo jehanɛ!
O yi ta pɛ!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, be nɛ a to ha nyɛ ɔ su.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su.
A be ose hee, nɛ a be nyae ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hu; ejakaa amanehlu be ɔ su jehanɛ.
“E be kɛe kulaa nɛ ye mi mi la ma kple o nɔ.
Ma kojo mo ngɛ ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ kulaa a he.
Ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ ngɛ ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ a he.
O be mɔbɔ nami ko kulaa nae ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi, nɛ i be o yi bae hulɔ; se ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ mohu ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ o ngɛ pee kpamisa a he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i ngɛ o tue gblae ɔ nɛ.” Hyɛ, ligbi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
O nyagbe ɔ su!
Israel, amanehlu be ɔ ba na mo.
Nɔ sisimi ngɛ nɔ yae wawɛɛ kaa tso nɛ gba mɔmɔ, nɛ he womi hu nya wa kaa blɛfo nɛ je deke.
Yi wu tso ní peemi wo wu.
Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be je mi hie hu; jã kɛ̃ a níhi nɛ a ngɛ, a juetli, kɛ a hɛ mi nyami tsuo maa laa.
Be ɔ ma.
Ligbi ɔ su jehanɛ.
Ní juami, kɛ ní hemi tsuo he be se nami hu, ejakaa Mawu maa gbla nɔ tsuaa nɔ tue, nɔ́ jualɔ jio, nɔ́ helɔ jio.
Jua yelɔ ko jua yelɔ ko be je mi tlɔe nɛ e ma ya bi nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye nya momo ɔ si; ejakaa Mawu mi mi fu ma a tsuo.
Yayami peeli a yi be wami nae.
A ma kpa titimati, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee klaalo kɛ ha ta.
Se nɔ ko nɔ ko be ta yae, ejakaa Mawu mi mi fumi maa ba nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ.
A maa gbla Israel tue ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he A maa hia klaate kɛ nyɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ba we ɔmɛ a mi.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ ta nga nɔ ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ ta a nya; nɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ, loo hwɔ ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Ni komɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ya hi lejɛ ɔ kaa lahuɛhi nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a hi he.
Mɛ tsuo a maa ye kɔmɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma fo ya ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he yayamihi a he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nine mi maa je wu, nɛ nakutso tsuaa nakutso mi maa wo nyu.
A ma bu kpekpe ya bo; sawale maa nu mɛ.
A ma sã mɛ tsuo a yi nɔ ha mɛ, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
A ma sake a sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ ngɔ pue gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa níhi nɛ a he tsɔ we.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ we abofu maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ, a sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ɔ be nyɛe ma he a yi wami; a be nyɛe maa ye kaa niye ní nɛ a tɔ, konɛ a na bua jɔmi.
Ejakaa sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ ji níhi nɛ ha nɛ a pee yayami ɔ nɛ.
A ngɔ a he dlami ní saminyawiiwi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee amagahi, níhi nɛ a hiee, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ tai.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ a june ɔmɛ plɛ pee níhi nɛ he tsɔ we ha mɛ.
Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha nibwɔhi ma ba kpɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ maa ha ní, nɛ a ma ble zugba a. Ke a ngɛ ye we ɔ june blee po, i be a nya tsie; juli ma nyɛ maa sɛ mi ya ble lejɛ ɔ faa.
“Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa pee basaa; zugba a tsuo nɔ ma hyi kɛ muɔ si puemi, nɛ ma a mi maa pee gidigidi.
Ma ha je mahi nɛ a yi mi wa wawɛɛ ɔ maa ba, nɛ a ma ba ngɔ nyɛ we ɔmɛ.
Kã peeli nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ maa je fɔ̃, nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba ble nyɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ nine mi maa je wu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ ma hla tue mi jɔmi, se nyɛ be nae.
Amanehlu maa nyɛɛ amanehlu se; nɛ munyu yobu maa nyɛɛ munyu yobu se; nyɛ ma hla nina kɛ je gbali ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se osɔfo ɔmɛ po mlaa maa laa mɛ kulaa; nɛ nyɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu be ga kpakpa ko nyɛe maa wo.
Matsɛ ɔ maa ye kɔmɔ; ganɔ ɔ nine mi maa je wu, sawale maa nu ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo a he maa do blibliibli.
Bɔ nɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ kojoɔ ni komɛ ɔ, jã imi hu ma kojo nyɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
MAWU HE NINA ENYƆNE NƐ EZEKIEL NA A ngɛ amaga jae ngɛ Yerusalem Jeha ekpane ɔ we nyɔhiɔ ekpane ɔ we ligbi enunɔne ɔ, benɛ i kɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ hii si ngɛ ye we ɔ mi ɔ, tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ.
Ma hyɛ ɔ, o nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ.
Kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ kple si ɔ, la sɔuu; nɛ kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ kuɔ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa akɔblee nɛ a sa he.
E je nɔ́ ko kpo kaa nine kɛ nu ye yi bwɔmi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ wo mi kɛ gu kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ ya su Yerusalem.
E ngɔ mi kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ we omleyi je agbo ɔ mi.
Amaga ko nɛ Mawu hiee wawɛɛ ɔ maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i na Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa nina nɛ i na ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ. Mawu kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, hyɛ omleyi je!” I hyɛ, nɛ i na jamɛ a amaga a nɛ a hiee wawɛɛ ɔ maa si ngeɛbɔ sami la tɛ agbo ɔ we omleyi je ngɛ agbo ɔ nya.
Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na ní hiemi ní nguanguahi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ peeɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ; a peeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ konɛ ma je ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ya se lokoo?
Se o maa na ní hiemi ní nguangua kpahi pe enɛ ɔ.” Jehanɛ, e kɛ mi ba kpo nɔ je kue ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e tsɔɔ mi puɔ ko ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi.
E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ywia gbogbo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” I pee ja, nɛ i na sinya ko.
E de mi ke, “Sɛ tsu ɔ mi, konɛ o ya na ní hiemi níhi babauu nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!” Benɛ i sɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ, i na nɛ a tɛni ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe: sinɔ slɔɔtohi babauu, lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ a hiee, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ tsuo.
Israel ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago, kɛ Yaazania, Shafan bi ɔ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ ngɛyu kɛ e mi tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ la su ku ngɛ mi jee kɛ yaa hiɔwe.
Mawu bi mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na nɔ́ nɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ diblii mi!
Tse o na nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ tsue ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we amaga jami he.
Se nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji, ‘Yawɛ nɛ wɔ!
Yawɛ si e zugba a ngɔ fɔ si.’ ” Yawɛ de mi jehanɛ hu ke, “O maa na ní hiemi ní nguangua kpahi nɛ pe nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ po.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ sinya a nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ nya.
Lejɛ ɔ hu, ne yihi nɛ ngɛ ya nyɛe ha Tamuz.
E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o na enɛ ɔ hu lo?
O maa na ní hiemi ní nguanguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ mi.
Nyumuhi maa pee nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ daa si ngɛ kue ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti.
A plɛ a se kɛ wo Yawɛ we ɔ; a ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ kpee beleku je, nɛ a ngɛ pu nɛ te si kɛ ma a jae.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na enɛ ɔ hulɔ!
Anɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ Yuda ma a ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ pi ha mɛ lolo lo?
Hyɛ, a ngɛ yi wu tso níhi pee tsɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Anɛ pi ye mi mi la nɛ a ngɛ woe wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ?
A ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba sɛ ye we ɔ mi nitsɛ tɔɔ!
A ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa a bui mi fɛɛ, pi jã?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa ma kple a nɔ.
A be mɔbɔ nami ko kulaa nae ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi, nɛ i be a yi bae hulɔ.
A maa fa kue boboobo kɛ tsɛ mi, se i be mɛ tue bue.”
A gbla Yerusalem tue Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ Mawu wo gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ma kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛɛ awi yemi dade ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ba!” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumuhi ekpa je yiti je agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ mi kɛ ba kɛ a dɛ mi awi yemi dadehi.
Nɔ ko hu nɛ ha kploba, nɛ e kpla womi ngmami nɔ́ ko ngɛ e kasa nya kɛ mɛ ba.
A ba da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ɔ he.
Jehanɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je kerub ɔ nɔ kɛ ba we ɔ kpoku ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba, nɛ e kpla womi ngmami nɔ́ ngɛ e kasa nya a. E de lɛ ke, “Yaa kpa si kɛ gu Yerusalem ma a mi tsuo.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ haoe, nɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ a he ɔ, pee okadi ngɛ a hɛ nya.” Se ni kpa amɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de mɛ nɛ i nu ji, “Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya kpa ma a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ gbe ni ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ ko baa nɔ ko nɔ ko yi; nyɛ ko na nɔ ko nɔ ko mɔbɔ.
Nyɛɛ gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo: nikɔtɔmahi, nihewi, yihewi, jokuɛwi, bimwɔwi kɛ a nyɛmɛ.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ okadi ɔ ngɛ e hɛ nya a lɛɛ nyɛ ko ta e he.
Nyɛɛ je sisi kɛ je ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni ni ɔmɛ gbemi kɛ je ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ a nɔ.
Mawu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ble we ɔ!
Nyɛ ha nɛ kue ɔmɛ a mi nɛ a hyi kɛ ni gbogboehi.
Nyɛɛ je kpo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a je kpo, nɛ a ya gbe ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a mi.
Benɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ gbee ɔ, e ba piɛ imi nɔ kake too nɛ a gbi mi.
I ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ i kpa ngmlaa ke, “Ao, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ o ngɔ o mi mi la kɛ kple Yerusalem nɔ nɛ ɔ, anɛ o miɔ nɛ o kpata Israel bi nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi lo?” Mawu he nɔ ke, “Israel kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee yayami agbo; fɔ nɛ a ye ɔ kle tsɔ.
Zugba a nɔ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ muɔ si puemi; nɛ Yerusalem ma a mi hu a yi dami sane.
A ngɛ dee ke imi Yawɛ, i kua zugba a, nɛ i nɛ mɛ.
Se i be mɛ mɔbɔ nae; i be a yi bae.
Bɔ nɛ a pee ni kpa amɛ ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ma pee mɛ.” Jehanɛ, nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba, nɛ e kpla womi ngmami nɔ́ ngɛ e kasa nya a kpale kɛ ba, nɛ e ba bɔ Yawɛ amaniɛ ke, “I pee bɔ nɛ o fa mi ɔ.”
Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je e we ɔ Benɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko kaa matsɛ sɛ ba je kpo ngɛ nɔ́ mluguduu ɔ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a yi mi.
Sɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa tɛ kpakpa nɛ hɛɛ bluu su.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu de nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba a ke, “Yaa sɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ a kpɛ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a sisi.
Ngɔɔ o nine enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ya muɔ la ngu hɛuu ɔ eko nɛ o fĩa ngɔ pue ma a nɔ.” I na nɛ́ nyumu ɔ pee ja niinɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, kerub ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ leneyi je.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔku ba hyi kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kpɛti ɔ tɔ.
Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ wo e he nɔ kɛ je kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ba da we ɔ agbo ɔ nya.
Bɔku ɔ hyi we ɔ mi tɔ, nɛ kue ɔ mi tsuo ngɛ kpɛe hleii kɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ.
A nu kerub ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ agbo nya kue ɔ mi tɔɔ kaa Mawu Ope ɔ nitsɛ nɛ ngɛ munyu tue.
Benɛ Yawɛ fã nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba a ke e ya muɔ la ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ nane ɔmɛ a kpɛ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a sisi kɛ ba a, nyumu ɔ ya nɛ e ya da si ngɛ tlɔɔke nane kake kasa nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ kerub ɔ kake je e nine kpo kɛ ya su la a he ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e muɔ la a eko kɛ wo nɔ nɛ ha kploba a dɛ mi.
Nyumu ɔ hɛɛ la a kɛ je kpo.
I na kaa kerub ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɛ nɔ́ ko kaa nɔmlɔ nine ngɛ e pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi.
- I na tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ nɛ je a sibi ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a he kakaaka.
Tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ ngɛ kpɛe saminya kaa tɛ nɛ hɛɛ sika tsu su.
Bɔ nɛ a pee mɛ ɔ, nane kpa bɛle si ngɛ eko tsuaa eko mi; kpo nɔ je nɔ́ ɔ yaa hɛ mi kɛ se; nɛ mi mi je nɔ́ ɔ hu yaa hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, kerub ɔmɛ nyɛɔ nyɛɛɔ kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ a plɛ we a he.
Mɛ tsuo a nyɛɛɔ fiee kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ a hɛ mi nane ɔ yaa a tɛɛ.
Tlɔɔke ɔmɛ a he, a se mi, a nine he, a pɛli ɔmɛ a he, kɛ tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ hɛngmɛhi.
I nu nɛ a tsɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ ke “Tlɔɔke nanehi nɛ poo a he.” Kerub ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɛ hɛ mi eywiɛ.
Kekleekle hɛ mi ɔ, na ku hɛ mi; enyɔne ɔ, nɔmlɔ hɛ mi; etɛne ɔ, jata hɛ mi; nɛ eywiɛne ɔ, kɔle hɛ mi.
Lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu nɛ i na ngɛ nina mi ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a nɛ.
Ke kerub ɔmɛ wo a he nɔ nɛ a bɔni nyɛɛmi ɔ, tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛɔ a kasa nya; nɛ ke kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi, konɛ a kɛ maa te ɔ, tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ plɛ we a he kɛ ji kerub ɔmɛ a kasa nya.
Ke kerub ɔ da si, kɛkɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu da si; ke a te si ɔ, kɛkɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ pee ja; ejakaa kerub ɔmɛ lɛ a hɛɛ mɛ.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je we ɔ agbo ɔ nya kɛ ba da kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi, nɛ a te kɛ je zugba; kɛkɛ nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu pee ja.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ba da si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je agbo ɔ nya, nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ a yi nɔ.
Kerub ɔmɛ nɛ i na ngɛ nina mi ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a, mɛ tutuutu ji Israel Mawu ɔ kerub nɛ ɔmɛ.
Kerub tsuaa kerub ngɛ hɛ mi eywiɛ kɛ pɛli eywiɛ, kɛ nɔ́ ko kaa nɔmlɔ nine ngɛ pɛli tsuaa pɛli sisi.
A hɛ mi ngɛ kaa ní nɛmɛ nɛ i na ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ya e hɛ mi tɛɛ.
A bu Yerusalem fɔ Jehanɛ, Mawu mumi ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je agbo ɔ nya.
I na nyumuhi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ nɛ ganɔ nɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ: Yaazania, Azur bi ɔ, kɛ Pelatia, Benaya bi ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nihi nɛ susuɔ ní yayahi a he, nɛ a woɔ ga yayahi ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
A deɔ ke, ‘E sui be nɛ wa maa ma tsuhi lolo.
Ma nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa dade kutu agbo ko; nɛ wɔ nimli ɔmɛ wa ngɛ kaa lo ngɛ kutu ɔ mi!’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa ke musu tloo mɛ.” Jehanɛ, Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke ma de ni nɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ Israel ma, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue ji nɛ ɔ?
I le níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue.
Nyɛ gbe nihi babauu, nɛ ma nɛ ɔ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ hyi tɔ kɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Niinɛ, dade kutu agbo ji ma nɛ ɔ; se lo ɔ nɛɛ?
Nihi nɛ nyɛ gbe ngɔ pue ma a mi gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, mɛ ji lo ɔ nɛ!
Nyɛ be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hie hu; ma ha a ma je nyɛ kɛ je ma a mi!
Nyɛ ngɛ klaate gbeye yee; se klaate nɔuu a kɛ ma ba tua nyɛ.
Ma je nyɛ kɛ je ma a mi; nɛ ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo nibwɔhi a dɛ mi.
A kɛ klaate ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Nyɛ yi be wami nae ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi, kaa lo yi na we wami ngɛ dade kutu mi.
He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa gu ngɛ Israel zugba a mi ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tue.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ; ejakaa nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ; je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, mɛ mohu a mlaahi a nɔ nyɛ yeɔ.” Benɛ i ngɛ gbae kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Benaya binyumu Pelatia tsɔ nɔ si, nɛ e gbo.
I kpla si, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ i kpa ngmlaa ke, “Ao, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, e ko ba mi ja!
Anɛ Israel bi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, o ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ lo?” Mawu wo nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a si Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu; e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, bɔ nɛ a ngɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ho se ya tsɔ.
Wɔ ji nihi nɛ a ngɔ zugba a kɛ ha kaa wa weto ní.’ “Jehanɛ, de o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, imi nitsɛ nɛ i ha a ho je ma amɛ a zugba amɛ a nɔ ya a nɛ; i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo lɛɛ, se ma bu a he be bɔɔ ko ngɛ hehi nɛ a ho ɔ tsuo.
“De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma bua a nya kɛ maa je je ma amɛ a mi hehi nɛ a gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa a tsuo kɛ maa ba; nɛ ma ngɔ Israel zugba a ngɔ ha mɛ ekohu.
Ke a ba lejɛ ɔ, a ma je ní hiemi níhi, kɛ musu ní ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he.
Ma ha mɛ tsui he, kɛ juɛmi he.
Ma je tsui nɛ wa kaa tɛ ɔ kɛ je a mi, nɛ ma ha mɛ tsui nɛ he jɔ, tsui nɛ buɔ tue; bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma plɛ pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.
Se nihi nɛ suɔ ní hiemi níhi, kɛ musu níhi, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a ngɛ pee kpamisa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ ma gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ je Yerusalem Kɛkɛ nɛ kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi nɛ a te; nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛ a se.
Nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ kpɛe hleii ngɛ a nɔ.
Jehanɛ, hɛ mi nyami nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hleii ɔ je ma a kpɛti kɛ ya ma yo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nɔ.
Ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ kɛ mi ba Babilonia ekohu ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a a ngɔ.
Nɛ i de mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ je kpo tsɔɔ mi ɔ.
Gbalɔ ɔ do ma Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nimli nɛ a tue wa a kpɛti o ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
A ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́; a ngɛ tue hulɔ, se a nui nɔ́; ejakaa atuã tsɔli ji mɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo nɔmlɔ adesa, bua blɔ hiami níhi a nya, nɛ o hia blɔ piani katakata, konɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a na mo kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ blɔ hiae kɛ yaa ma se.
Eko ɔ, atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ma kɔ se kaa o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa atuã tsɔli ji mɛ.
Je o ní ɔmɛ kpo piani benɛ mɛ tsuo a ngɛ hyɛe, nɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, o je ma a mi kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ blɔ hiae kɛ yaa ma se, benɛ a ngɛ mo hyɛe paa.
Benɛ a ngɛ mo hyɛe ɔ, ywia gbogbo ɔ he ko, nɛ o gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo.
A hɛ mi nɔuu ɔ, benɛ du bu ɔ, ngɔɔ o tlomi ɔ ngɔ fɔ o konɔ kɛ je kpo.
Ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha o hɛ mi, konɛ o ko na zugba, he nɛ o ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ yaa a. Nɔ́ nɛ o maa pee nɛ ɔ maa pee okadi kɛ ha Israel ma a.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ke ma pee ɔ, i pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ piani katakata a, i ngɔ ye ní ɔmɛ kɛ je kpo kaa nɔ ko nɛ miɔ nɛ e hia blɔ.
Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, i ywia he ko ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi, nɛ i gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo.
Benɛ du bu ɔ, i ngɔ ye tlomi ɔ ngɔ fɔ ye konɔ kɛ hia blɔ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi paa.
E nɔ jena a, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse Israel bi tue gboli ɔmɛ ba bi mo ke mɛni o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ lo?
De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji, nina nɛ ɔ kɔɔ Yerusalem ganɔ ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a he.
De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ, e ji okadi nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ.
A maa pee nihi nɛ do ma, nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ.
Ke du bu ɔ, Yerusalem ganɔ ɔ maa fi tlomi kɛ fɔ e konɔ, nɛ e maa ywia gbogbo ɔ he ko, nɛ e maa gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo.
E maa ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ he nɛ e yaa a, e hɛngmɛ be hyɛe.
Ma tsɔ lɛ klama nɛ ma du lɛ.
Ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilon ngɛ Kaldea bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Se e ma gbo nɛ e li tete po kaa e su lejɛ ɔ. Ma gbɛ nihi tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, e ga woli ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo; he nyɛli a ta a maa nyɛɛ a se ngɛ he tsuaa he.
“Ke i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ, kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha a ti nihi bɔɔ ko maa piɛ; mɛɛ lɛɛ ta, kɛ hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ be mɛ gbee.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa jaje ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pee ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nɛ a ma de ke a tɔ̃.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Gbalɔ ɔ he do blibliibli kɛ to okadi Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ke o ngɛ abolo yee ɔ, o he nɛ do blibliibli; nɛ sawale nɛ nu mo ke o ngɛ nyu nue.
De ma a tsuo ke sɛ gbi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ kɛ ha mɛ Yerusalem bi nɛ a ngɛ Yuda zugba nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ ji, a he maa do bibliibli kɛ ye abolo, nɛ a kɛ he hiami, kɛ tsui yemi maa nu nyu.
A ma kpata a zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; ejakaa ma amɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a yi mi wa.
Mahi nɛ nihi ngɛ a mi ɔ tsuo ma plɛ pee ma dokuhi.
Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ!” Abɛ nɛ a le saminya, kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ a sume Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nyɛ buu abɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Israel zugba a he ke, ‘Be babauu ngɛ bee, se nina amɛ ekoeko bɛ mi gblee.’ Kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ?
De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Abɛ nɛ ɔ, ma gu, nɛ a be bue hu ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ.
A na nɛ a le mohu kaa be ɔ su ta, nɛ nina amɛ tsuo kulaa maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ!
“Lakpa nina, loo klaami nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, ekoeko be si hie hu ngɛ Israel ma a mi tsuo.
Ejakaa imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, i kɛ mɛ maa tu munyu, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A be be ɔ tsɛ̃e kɛ ya se hu.
Nyɛ ma tue gboli, nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu lɛ nɔ́ nɛ i de nɛ ɔ maa ba mi.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nɔ́ nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ dee ji, ‘Nina amɛ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ na a be mi bae amlɔ nɛ ɔ; hwɔɔ se lokoo he ninahi sɔuu.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de mɛ ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji, ‘A be ye munyu ɔmɛ ekoeko tsɛ̃e kɛ to hu, se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ maa ba mi.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de!’ ”
A gba kɛ si nyumuhi lakpa gbali Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Israel gbali ɔmɛ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi mi kɛkɛ a gbaa a.
De mɛ ke a bu Yawɛ tue!” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Musu tloo gbali kuasiahi nɛ peeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɛ́ hu a gbaa.
