Israel ma, o gbali ɔmɛ a he be se nami; a ngɛ kaa kɔkɔbohi ngɛ ma doku mi.
Israel ma a gbogbo ɔ hehi nɛ ku kɛ pueɔ si ɔ, a ya bui ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a dla we nɛ a fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ wo ma a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a be ta a nya nyɛe maa da ngɛ Yawɛ ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Yakayaka ninahi a naa, nɛ lakpa sɔuu a yeɔ.
A deɔ ke Yawɛ sɛ gbi a hɛɛ ɔ nɛ, pohu i tsɔ we mɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a hyɛɛ blɔ kaa níhi nɛ a de ɔ maa ba mi.
I de mɛ ke, ‘Jamɛ a nina amɛ nɛ nyɛ naa a be mi, nɛ nyɛ gbami ɔmɛ hu lakpa sɔuu.
Nyɛ deɔ ke ye sɛ gbi ji lɔ ɔmɛ, be mi nɛ i de we nyɛ nɔ́ ko!’ ” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Akɛnɛ yakayaka níhi nyɛ gbaa, nɛ lakpa níhi nyɛ naa he je ɔ, niinɛ, i kɛ nyɛ ná!
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ naa yakayaka níhi, nɛ lakpa níhi a klaa a, ma gbla a tue.
A be ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti hie hu; a be a biɛhi ngmae ngɛ ye ma Israel womi ɔ mi, nɛ a be Israel zugba a hu nɔ bae gblegbleegble.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ.
“Gbali ɔmɛ mlɔɔ ye ma a; a deɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ he manye!’ be mi nɛ tue mi jɔmi ko be kulaa; ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he.
De ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he kpae ɔ ke gbogbo ɔ maa nɔ si oo!
Hiɔmi maa nɛ wawɛɛ; gbiɛ ngo ngu agbohi ma pue si, nɛ ahumi maa fia.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke gbogbo ɔ nɔ si ɔ, nihi ma bi nyɛ ke, ‘Tse nyɛ na kaa kalo ɔ nɛ nyɛ kpa gbogbo ɔ he ɔ pee yaka lo?’ ” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ye mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ.
Ma ha ahumi maa fia, nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ; gbiɛ ngo ngu agbohi ma pue si, nɛ gbogbo ɔ maa hule.
Gbogbo ɔ nɛ nyɛ kpa he kalo ɔ maa ku kɛ pue si butuu; e sisi tomi ɔ tsuo maa je kpo.
Ee, e maa ku kɛ pue nyɛ nɔ haa bum!
Nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ!
“Gbogbo ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he ɔ tsuo be a he yee kɛ je ye mi mi la a nya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma de nyɛ ke gbogbo ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he ɔ tsuo be hu oo!
Jamɛ a gbali ɔmɛ de Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke sane yobu ko kulaa be a nɔ bae; mamoo haomi mohu lɛ ma!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
A gba kɛ si yihi lakpa gbali Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si o ma a mi yi ɔmɛ nɛ toɔ a yi mi kɛ deɔ nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ ke a ngɛ gbae ɔ.
De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ kpɛɔ bo tsɔwi kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ a kɛ fii a nine si, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ yi nɔ hami bohi kɛ haa nihi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ na a klaa amɛ a nɔ he wami, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛ maa mlɔɔ ye ma a, nɛ nyɛ kpata a wami hɛ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ na se.
Akoko dɛ kɔkɔ fuu, kɛ abolo nya bɔbɔɛ bɔɔ ko he ɔ, nyɛ gbee nihi yaka gu, nɛ nyɛ heɔ nihi nɛ a sa gbenɔ ɔ mohu a yi wami.
Nyɛ yeɔ lakpa kɛ haa ye ma a, nɛ mɛ hu a buɔ nyɛ tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye he guɛ gbo ngɛ ye ma a hɛ mi.” Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I kɛ nyɛ bo tsɔwi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ fiɔ nine si ɔ na; nyɛɛ kɛ bo nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ klama kɛ duɔ nɔ kaa a duɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ.
Ma tsɔ́ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nine si, nɛ ma ngmɛɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nuu ɔ a he.
Ma kpɔ nyɛ nɔ hami bo ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ be nimli ɔmɛ a nɔ he wami nae hu; nyɛ be mɛ klama tsɔe nɛ a maa du hu.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ ma na le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“Ejakaa dalɔ nɛ i sume kaa e ye aywilɛho ɔ, nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ lakpa munyu ɔmɛ kɛ yeɔ e tsui.
Se nyɛ woɔ yayami peelɔ mohu he wami konɛ e ko kpa yayami peemi, nɛ a ko he e yi wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yakayaka nina ko be kpo jee ha nyɛ hu; nɛ nyɛ be klae hu.
Ma kpɔ ye ma a kɛ je nyɛ he wami sisi, nɛ nyɛ be he wami hie ngɛ a nɔ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Mawu sume amaga jami Israel ma nimeli komɛ ba ye ngɔ.
I ha mɛ sɛ, nɛ a hi si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ amagahi a nɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami pɛ a peeɔ ɔ, anɛ a susuɔ kaa ma ha a ba bi ní ngɛ ye ngɔ lo?
“De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e we amagahi a nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami pɛ e peeɔ kɛ tsiɔ lɛ nitsɛ blɔ ɔ, ke e ba bi ní ngɛ gbalɔ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha lɛ heto bɔ nɛ sa e we amaga babauu jami ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo nɛ a kɛ amaga jami tsɔ a he kɛ je ye he ɔ, ma ha a maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu kɛ a tsui tsuo.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ we amaga amɛ a se kɛ ba; nɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ ni hiemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
“Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko, loo nɔ ko nɛ ba to Israel bi ɔmɛ nubwɔ tsɔ e he kɛ je ye he, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e we amaga amɛ a nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he je yayami pɛ e peeɔ ɔ, ke e ba gbalɔ ko ngɔ nɛ e ba bi ní ɔ, imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha lɛ heto.
Ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ wawɛɛ; ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ pee okadi gbeyegbeye, kɛ abɛ nɛ a maa bu.
Ma kpata e hɛ mi kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“Se ke a mlɔɔ gbalɔ ko nɛ e de nɔ́ ko ɔ, lɛɛ imi Yawɛ lɛ i mlɔɔ jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ma gbla e tue; ma kpata e hɛ mi; ma je lɛ kɛ je ye ma Israel ɔ a kpɛti.
Gbalɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ba bi ní ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ tsuo ma ná tue gblami kake.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ be ye se jee kɛ ya pee yayami kɛ ble a he hu.
Se mohu a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ke ma ko pee yayami, nɛ e yi mi anɔkuale ɔ, tue gblami nɛ e ma na ji, ma ha nɛ e niye ní se maa po, nɛ hwɔ maa ba ma a nɔ; nimlihi kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Ke e ba mi kaa ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ, Noa, Daniel, kɛ Hiob ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ tete po ɔ, a kpakpa peemi ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami pɛ e ma nyɛ he kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami ɔ mi.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Aloo ke i ha lohwe awi yeli ba kpa zugba a nɔ, nɛ a gbe e nɔ bi ɔmɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ pee ma doku ngɛ lohwe awi yeli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko gui lejɛ ɔ hu ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke ke ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tete po, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ po a be nyɛe ma he a yi wami, binyumuhi jio biyihi jio, mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a yi wami a ma he; nɛ zugba a nɔ maa je gu.
“Aloo ke i ha nɛ a hwu ta ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ a kpata nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi a hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke ke ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tete po, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ po a be nyɛe ma he a yi wami, binyumuhi jio; biyihi jio; mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a yi wami a ma nyɛ he.
“Ke i ha nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba jamɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ ye mi mi la ha a pue muɔ si, nɛ a kpata nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae keke Noa, Daniel, kɛ Hiob ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tete po, a binyumuhi jio, a biyihi jio, a be a yi wami nyɛe ma he; mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a yi wami kɛkɛ a ma nyɛ he, ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha tue gblami nɛ nya wa eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba Yerusalem nɔ: ta, hwɔ, lohwe awi yeli, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ.
Nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ni komɛ maa piɛ kɛ̃ nɛ a maa je amanehlu ɔmɛ a mi.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ; nyɛɛ hyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ biyi ɔmɛ a je mi bami, kɛ a ní peepee ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ maa na kaa tue gblami slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ba Yerusalem nɔ ɔ sa mɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ke nyɛ na a jemi bami, kɛ a ní peepee ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa i pee we ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ yaka.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ wai tso he Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, wai tso, loo wai tso kɔni nɛ ngɛ hue mi tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, mɛni e kɛ pe tso kpa amɛ tsuo?
Anɛ a ngɔɔ wai tso, loo e kɔni kɛ tsuɔ nɔ́ ko; aloo a ngɔɔ eko kɛ peeɔ tso plɛɛko, konɛ a ngɔ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi kɛ kpla he lo?
Dɛbi, a ngɔɔ kɛ woɔ la mi kaa lɛ́; nɛ ke e nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ ngla a, anɛ e kpɛti ɔ nɛ la sã he bɔɔ ɔ, mɛni se nami pa ngɛ he?
Hyɛ kaa benɛ e ngɛ nɛ la sɛ he ɔ tete po a kɛ tsu we nɔ ko, nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ nɛ la sã e nya nɛ e ngla a, a kɛ ma tsu nɔ́ ko lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Bɔ nɛ i haa la sãã wai tso pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ hue mi ɔ, ja ma ha la ma kpata Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ma gbla Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a tue.
Ke a je haomi kake mi ɔ, a maa sɛ haomi kpa nɛ nya wa mi; nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ke i gbla a tue wawɛɛ kikɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Ma ha zugba a nɔ tsuo ma plɛ pee nga kplanaa nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ; ejakaa nimli ɔmɛ yi mi anɔkuale.”
Yerusalem, ma nɛ yi anɔkuale Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ní hiemi níhi nɛ Yerusalem pee ɔ, ha nɛ e le.
De Yerusalem ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ lɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Kanaan zugba a nɔ o je; lejɛ ɔ a fɔ mo ngɛ.
Amor no ji o tsɛ, nɛ o nyɛ lɛɛ Hit no ji lɛ.
Benɛ a fɔ mo ɔ, a pui o langmɔ; a ngɔɛ nyu kɛ dui o he, konɛ o he nɛ tsɔ; a kpa we o he ngo; nɛ a ngɔɛ bo ko kulaa kɛ blaa we o he.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ a fɔ mo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ́ mo mɔbɔ nɛ e maa pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko ha mo.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko mi mi sãã we lɛ ngɛ o he, konɛ e suɔ o sane; se mohu a sake mo ngɔ hɛ fɔ nga mi; ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ hie mo.
“Benɛ i ba gu o kasa nya kɛ bee nɛ i na mo ɔ, o ngɛ si wue ngɛ o muɔ ɔ mi.
I de mo jamɛ a be ɔ mi lokoo ke, ‘O yi nɛ na wami, nɛ́ o pee kaa nga nɔ tso nguaa ko.’ I ha nɛ o ba wa, nɛ o he hu ba pee fɛu saminya kaa yiheyo nɛ zangma pue e nɔ.
O nyɔ ɔmɛ ba kle, nɛ o yi bwɔmi ba saminyayoo; se o hɛɛ o he gu pasaa.
“Benɛ i ba gu lejɛ ɔ ekohu ɔ, i na kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ o wa nɛ o su gbami nya.
I ngɔ ye bo kɛ ha o nɔ, nɛ o he fɔ we si gu hu.
I ka mo kita, nɛ i kɛ mo so; nɛ i ngɔ mo ngɔ pee ye yo.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Jehanɛ i ngɔ nyu kɛ fɔ muɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ o he, nɛ i kpa mo nu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ dla o he ha mo: tade nɛ a lo ga níhi saminyayoo kɛ wo mi, tokota kpakpa, mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́, kploba falefale, kɛ sliiki bo.
I ngɔ he dlami ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu kɛ dla o he: nine si ga, kuɛ ní, kɔsɔkɔsɔ, gugwɔ mi ga, kɛ tue nya ní; nɛ i ngɔ jlasi nɛ ngɛ fɛu saminyayoo kɛ fi o yi.
I ha mo sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu june nɛ o kɛ dla o he.
Kploba falefale, sliiki, kɛ bo nɛ a lo ga níhi ngɔ wo mi ji tadehi nɛ o woɔ.
Niye ní nɛ o yeɔ ji abolo nɛ a ngɔ mamu kpakpa kɛ sã, kɛ jehanɛ hu hwo, kɛ oliv nu.
O he pee fɛu wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ o ba pee manyɛ.
O he pee fɛu kɛ pi si, nɛ o he biɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo; ejakaa imi nitsɛ lɛ i dla o he ha mo ja.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Se moo lɛɛ o ngɔ o he fɛu, kɛ biɛ nɛ o na a kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ maa bɔ ajuama mohu; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, o kɛ lɛ hwɔɔ si faa!
O ngɔ o bo ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ ya pee jami hehi nɛ ngɛ fɛu; ajuama nɛ o kɛ mawu kpahi bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hí sɛɛmi; eko bɛ hyɛ, nɛ eko hu be bae gblegbleegble.
Lɔ ɔ se hu, o ngɔ o june kpakpa nɛ ji sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu nɛ imi nitsɛ i ha mo ɔ, nɛ o kɛ pee nyumu amagahi, nɛ o kɛ mɛ bɔ ajuama.
Bo nɛ a lo ga níhi kɛ wo mi ɔ, o ngɔ kɛ ya ha amaga amɛ a he, nɛ o ngɔ ye oliv nu, kɛ ye tsopa kɛ e he via a kɛ ya ma a hɛ mi.
I ha mo niye ní, abolo nɛ a ngɔ mamu kpakpa kɛ sã, kɛ hwo, kɛ oliv nu; se o kɛ ya sã bɔ kɛ ha amagahi mohu, konɛ e je via ha mɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Jehanɛ hu o bimɛ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ o fɔ ha mi ɔ, o gbe mɛ kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ja amagahi.
Anɛ anɔkuale nɛ o yi mi nɛ ɔ pi ha mo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he o kpale gbe ye bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ kɛ pee sami bɔ kɛ ha amagahi ɔ?
Benɛ o ngɛ ní hiemi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pee, nɛ́ o ngɛ ajuama bɔe basaa a, o kaii we gblee kaa o yihe be mi ɔ, o hɛɛɔ o he gu pasaa kɛ hii si wue ngɛ o muɔ mi.” Yerusalem ba e je mi kaa ajuama Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Musu tloo mo oo, musu tloo mo!
Yayamihi nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, o pee jami hehi nɛ ya hiɔwe ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ha o he.
O ha o he fɛu saminyayoo ɔ ba pee afa kaa mɔsɔ nɛ o kpa.
Nɔ ko tsuaa nɔ ko kɛkɛ nɛ o kɛ maa kpe ɔ, o ngɔ o he ngɔ ha lɛ, nɛ o bɔ ajuama basaa.
Lɔ ɔ se hu, o kɛ Egipt bi, he lo akɔnɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ o kasa nya a hu bɔ ajuama ja nɔuu.
O kɛ o we ajuama bɔmi babauu ɔ wo ye mi mi la.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ ye he wami gbla o tue, nɛ i po o niye ní ɔ nɔ.
I ngɔ mo kɛ wo o he nyɛli Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Ahlua ní kpɔtɔɔ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, pee Filisti bi ɔmɛ tete po zo.
“O ya bɔ ajuama kɛ kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ kɛ ya su Asiria bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ tɔɔ.
O kɛ mɛ bɔ ajuama basaa, se lɔ ɔ tete po sui o nya.
O bɔ ajuama hluu kɛ ya su Babilonia bi jua yeli a zugba a nɔ tɔɔ; se lɔ ɔ hu sui o nya.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ o mumu nya ta ha!
O pee o he ajuamatsɛ, nɛ e pee we mo zo ko zo ko kulaa!
O pee jami hehi ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ha o he.
E slo mo ngɛ yaholi kpa amɛ a he; ejakaa moo lɛɛ o he we sika.
O ngɛ kaa yo gba puɛlɔ nɛ sume lɛ nitsɛ e huno, se nibwɔhi mohu e kɛ e he haa!
Yaholi heɔ sika kaa a hiɔwo ngɛ nyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ; se moo lɛɛ mo mohu lɛ o kee o suɔli ɔmɛ tsuo ní; o haa mɛ nyɔ mi ní, konɛ a je he tsuaa he kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ mo ba hwɔ si.
Moo lɛɛ e slo mo kulaa ngɛ yaholi kpa amɛ a he.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko ba nyɛɛ we o se, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ha we mo nɔ́ ko kaa hiɔwo; se mo mohu lɛ o woɔ mɛ hiɔ!
Niinɛ, e slo mo kulaa ngɛ yaholi kpa amɛ tsuo a he.” Mawu maa gbla Yerusalem tue Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem, mo yaholɔ!
Bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ɔ tue.
Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “O kpa o he bo, nɛ o ha o suɔli ɔmɛ na o he gu saplapaa a. O kɛ mɛ bɔ ajuama basaa, nɛ o ja o we amaga amɛ tsuo.
Jehanɛ hu o gbe o bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ sã bɔ kɛ ha amaga amɛ.
Zo ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o tsu he je ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ o suɔ mɛ, nɛ o kɛ mɛ fiɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ o sume a sane ɔ, ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya kɛ bɔle mo kɛ kpe; kɛkɛ ɔ, ma kpa o he bo tsuo ngɛ o he, konɛ mɛ tsuo a na o he gu saplapaa a. Ma bu mo fɔ kaa o puɛ gba, nɛ o pue muɔ si.
Ma ngɔ abofu, kɛ hunga kɛ gbla o tue, nɛ o hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ!
Ma ngɔ mo ngɔ wo ni ɔmɛ a dɛ mi; nɛ a maa ku o jami he ɔmɛ.
A ma kpa o he bo tsuo; a maa ngɔ o june saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ, nɛ o maa hɛɛ o he gu saplapaa.
“A ma sa o yi; a maa fia mo tɛ, nɛ a kɛ klaate maa poo mo kpɔ nya kpɔ nya.
A maa sã o we ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa gbla o tue ngɛ yihi babauu a hɛ mi.
Ajuama nɛ o ngɛ bɔe basaa a, ma ha nɛ o kpa, nɛ o be o suɔli ɔmɛ hiɔ woe hu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye mi mi la a nya maa ba si, nɛ ye hɛ be dɔe kɛ wo mo hu.
Ma pee dii, nɛ ye mi mi be fue kɛ wo mo hu.
O kaii we nɔ́ nɛ i pee ha mo ngɛ o yihe mi ɔ, se mohu o ngɔ je mi bami yaya nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wo ye mi mi la.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ha o na a he hiɔwo sisiisi ɔ nɛ.
Se mɛni he je po nɛ o kpale ngɔ ajuama bɔmi basaa kɛ piɛ yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ a he ɔ?” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Biyo, o je o nyɛ Yawɛ ke, “Yerusalem, abɛ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu kɛ si mo ji, ‘Biyo, o je o nyɛ pɛ!’ O nyɛ lɛ fɔ mo niinɛ; e kua e huno kɛ e bimɛ; o je o nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ; mɛ hu a kua a hunomɛ kɛ a bimɛ.
Nyɛ nyɛ ɔ, Hit no ji lɛ, se nyɛ tsɛ ɔ lɛɛ Amor no.
“O nyɛmiyo nɔkɔtɔma Samaria, kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ o kasa nya ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ o nyɛmiyo jokuɛyo Sodom, kɛ lɛ hu e mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ o leneyi je.
Pi kaa o ya wo o nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ a nane ngɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ a mi kɛkɛ, se e yi be ko kulaa nɛ o ba puɛ wawɛɛ pe mɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ngɛ o je mi bami tsuo mi.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke o nyɛmiyo Sodom, kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ pee we yayamihi kaa níhi nɛ mo Yerusalem, kɛ o mi bi ɔmɛ pee ɔ. O nyɛmiyo Sodom, kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ woɔ a he nɔ; a ngɛ niye ní babauu, a ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a tue mi jɔ mɛ; se a yi bua ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ a wo a he nɔ, nɛ a pee níhi nɛ a hiee ngɛ ye hɛ mi paa he je ɔ, i kpata a hɛ mi.
“Samaria pee we yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ a mi fa tete po; ní yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ hiɛ babauu pe e ní ɔmɛ.
Ke a ngɔ mo kɛ to o nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ní yayamihi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ ha nɛ e peeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ nguɔ!
O hɛ mi lɛ pue si nɛ ɔ nɛ!
O ha a bu o nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ nihi nɛ da pe mo!
Yayamihi nɛ o pee pe mɛ ɔ ha a da pe mo.
O hɛ mi pue si; zo gbe mo kpɔtɔɔ, ejakaa o ha o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ pee kaa nihi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a da!” Sodom kɛ Samaria maa kpale ná ní ekohu Yawɛ de Yerusalem ke, “Ma ha Sodom kɛ Samaria ma amɛ, kɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ maa kpale ná ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu.
Mo nitsɛ hu, ma ha o maa kpale ná ní ekohu, kaa mɛ nɔuu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o hɛ mi nɛ pue si, kɛ zo nɛ gbe mo ngɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he ɔ, ma ha a maa wo a bua.
O nyɛmiyo Sodom kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ maa ba a zu nɔ ekohu; o nyɛmiyo Samaria kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ hu maa ba a zu nɔ ekohu, nɛ mo Yerusalem kɛ o mi bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ maa ba nyɛ zu nɔ ekohu.
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, tse o wo o he nɔ ngɛ o nyɛmiyo Sodom nɔ, nɛ e pee o nya he la, loko yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ tsuo ba je kpo?
Jehanɛ lɛɛ o pee kaa lɛ, nɛ Edom bi, Filisti bi, kɛ ni kpa amɛ nɛ bɔle mo, nɛ a sume mo saasaa a, o ba pee ahlua bɔmi nɔ́ ha mɛ!
Zo ní nɛ o tsu, kɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ o pee ɔ, a he tue gblami bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Somi ko nɛ ngɛ daa Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I kɛ mo maa to ní kaa bɔ nɛ mo hu o pee ɔ; ejakaa o bui somi ɔ, nɛ kita nɛ o ka a, o yi nɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, imi lɛɛ ma kai si nɛ i wo mo benɛ o ji yiheyo ɔ. I kɛ mo maa kpale so somi ko nɛ maa hi si daa.
Lɔ ɔ ma ha o ma kai o sa je mi bami ɔ, nɛ zo maa gbe mo ngɛ o nyɛmiyo nɔkɔtama Samaria, kɛ o nyɛmiyo wayoo Sodom tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ma ha a maa kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ kaa biyihi nɛ imi nitsɛ i ngɔ ha mo, se pi ngɛ somi nɛ o kɛ mi so ɔ nya.
I kɛ mo maa so somi he, konɛ o le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Ma ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pa mo; se kɛ̃ ɔ, o ma kai yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ zo maa gbe mo kpɔtɔɔ.
Ma ngɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pa mo, nɛ e maa pee mo nyakpɛ; o be nyɛe maa pa o nya mi tete po ngɛ zo ní nɛ o tsu ɔ he.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Kɔle ɔmɛ kɛ wai tso ɔ he abɛ ɔ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, buu abɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a, nɛ o de mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Kɔle agbo ko hi si.
E ngɛ pɛli agbohi, kɛ tsɛli pinopino nɛ hɛɛ asasa su.
Ligbi ko ɔ, kɔle ɔ te kɛ ba Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ba ma seda tso ko yi mi.
E kplɔ tso ɔ he kɔnihi nɛ e je ɔ yi mi mlɔmlɔɔmlɔ ɔ. E ngɔ kɔni mumu nɛ e ku ɔ kɛ ho ma ko nɛ a yeɔ jua ngɛ mi mi ya, nɛ e ya ma tso ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, e ngɔ Israel zugba a nɔ wu nɛ a duɔ ɔ eko, nɛ e ya du ngɛ zugba kpakpa ko mi he nɛ nyu ngɛ saminya, konɛ e bɔ.
Niinɛ, tso nɛ ɔ le, nɛ e ba pee wai tso nɛ bɔ kusuu kɛ ha si.
E kɔni ɔmɛ ka gagaaga, nɛ a mi dɔ kɛ ba kɔle ɔ ngɔ; nɛ e sipoku ɔmɛ sɛ zu mi saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee wai tso nɛ gba kɔnihi kɛ a nɔ ba kusuu.
“Kɔle agbo kpa ko hu ngɛ kɛ e pɛli nguanguahi, kɛ e tsɛli fuu.
Kikɛmɛ a wai tso nɛ ɔ dɔ e sipoku ɔmɛ, kɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na nyu saminya.
Zugba kpakpa nɛ nyu ngɛ mi bɔ nɛ sa nɔ nɛ a ma tso nɛ ɔ ngɛ, konɛ e wo yiblii, nɛ e pee wai tso kɛ e he fɛu.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ bie ke tso nɛ ɔ yi ma na wami lo?
Anɛ kekle kɔle ɔ be tso ɔ gblae nɛ e hia e sipoku tsuo kɛ fɔ he, nɛ e ku e kɔni ɔmɛ, konɛ a gbli lo?
E yi mi ba amɛ tsuo ma gbli.
Pi he wami tsɔ ko, loo nihi babauu nɛ a ma na loko a maa hia tso nɛ ɔ.
A ma tso ɔ lɛɛ, se e yi ma na wami lo?
Anɛ ke ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ fia a, tso ɔ be gblie ngɛ he nɛ a ma lɛ ngɛ ɔ lo?” A tsɔɔ abɛ ɔ sisi Yawɛ de mi ke, “Bi ma atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ke a nu abɛ ɔ sisi lo.
De mɛ ke Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ba Yerusalem, nɛ e ba nuu ma a mi matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho Babilonia ya.
E ngɔ matsɛ ɔ bi ko, nɛ e kɛ lɛ so; e ha e ka lɛ kita ke e maa ye lɛ anɔkuale.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ zugba a nɔ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɛ ho, konɛ matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ nɛ ba si kulaa, nɛ e ko nyɛ nɛ e te si gblegbleegble kaa bɔ nɛ a so ɔ.
Se Yuda matsɛ ɔ tsɔ atuã; e tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Egipt ya, konɛ a ha lɛ okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta buli nɛ he hiɛ.
Anɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye kunimi lo?
Anɛ matsɛ nɛ ɔ yi ma na wami lo?
Ke e yi somi ɔ nɔ ɔ, anɛ e yi ma na wami lo?” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke Yuda matsɛ nɛ ɔ ma gbo ngɛ Babilonia, akɛnɛ somi nɛ e kɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ, e yi nɔ ɔ.
(Babilonia matsɛ ɔ lɛ wo Yuda matsɛ ɔ tsɛ).
Ke e ba mi kaa Babilonia bi ɔmɛ fia kpokuhi, nɛ a ma mɔhi, konɛ a kɛ kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi tete po, Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɛ e ta babauu ɔ be he nɔ́ ko nyɛe maa pee ha lɛ.
Somi nɛ e kɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ, e yi nɔ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e yi be wami nae kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I ka ye he kita kaa ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ somi nɛ e so, kɛ si nɛ e wo ɔ, e yi nɔ fɛɛ he je ɔ, ma gbla e tue kokooko.
Ma tsɔ lɛ klama nɛ ma du lɛ.
Ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilonia, nɛ ma ya gbla e tue ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e yi mi anɔkuale.
E tabo ɔ mi katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ hu a maa gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Mawu wo si ke manye maa ba Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Imi nitsɛ ma kplɔ seda tso gagaa a yi mi, nɛ ma ya ma ngɛ he ko.
Ma ya ma tso nɛ ɔ ngɛ yo gagaa ko nɔ.
Israel yo gagaa pe kulaa a nɔ ma ma ngɛ.
E ma gba kɔnihi, nɛ e maa wo yiblii; e maa pee seda tso agbo kɛ e he fɛu.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔto tsuo ma ba hi e hɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Zugba a nɔ tso ɔmɛ tsuo maa le kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i haa tso gagaa peeɔ kpiti, nɛ tso kpiti kaa gagaa.
Imi lɛ i haa tso mumu gbliɔ, nɛ tso gbigbli peeɔ tso mumu ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de, nɛ ma pee.”
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu e ní tsumi he akɔtaa Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Abɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ zugba a he, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ bue kpamisa ke, ‘Tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye wai yiblii ngmlikiti, nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ mohu a lungu fĩa’ a, kɛ a ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ?” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke, nyɛ be abɛ nɛ ɔ bue ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ hu.
Ye níhi ji nimli ɔmɛ tsuo, tsɛ ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo; nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ ma gbo.
“Ke nɔ ko ji dalɔ ɔ, e yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
E ja we Israel amaga amɛ, nɛ e yi ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Jehanɛ hu, e nyɛɛ we e nyɛminyumu e yo se nɛ e ble lɛ; nɛ e yɛ yo nɛ ku nine ngɔ.
E wɛ nɔ ko yi mi.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ́ ko ba to lɛ awaba a, e kpaleɔ kɛ haa lɛ.
Ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, e haa lɛ niye ní; nɛ ke nɔ ko hɛɛ e he gu ɔ, e haa lɛ he ha nɔ́.
Ke e pa sika ha nɔ ko ɔ, e he we hekpa.
E yɛ he nɛ a ngɛ yayami pee ngɛ, konɛ yayami ko sã lɛ.
E kojoɔ nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi a kpɛti sane anɔkuale mi.
Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ buɔ ye gbi tue, nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde, nɛ e yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ; niinɛ, e yi ma na wami.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Jehanɛ, ke nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ binyumuyo ojo fialɔ nɛ pueɔ muɔ si, nɛ e peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e tsɛ pee we hyɛ ɔ, e yeɔ ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha amaga amɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛɔ e nyɛmi e yo se nɛ e bleɔ lɛ, e waa ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ yi mi, e fiaa nihi ojo, e kpale we nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ba to awaba kɛ ha we nɔtsɛ, e jaa amagahi, e peeɔ ní hiemi níhi, nɛ e paa sika kɛ haa nɔ, nɛ e heɔ hekpa a, anɛ nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ yi nɛ na wami lo?
Dɛbi!
E yi be wami nae kɔkɔɔkɔ!
Ní hiemi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ a he ɔ, e ma gbo.
E gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.
“Jehanɛ, waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu nɛ ɔ hu ngɛ binyumu ko.
Binyumu nɛ ɔ na bɔ nɛ e tsɛ ɔ ngɛ, kɛ e yayamihi nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ tsuo; se e ye gbeye, nɛ e ya wo we e tsɛ ɔ nane.
E ja we Israel amaga amɛ, nɛ e yi ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, e nyɛɛ we e nyɛminyumu e yo se nɛ e ble lɛ.
E wɛ nɔ ko yi mi, e fiɛ ojo.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ́ ko ba to lɛ awaba a, e kpaleɔ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ba to awaba a kɛ haa nɔtsɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, e haa lɛ niye ní, nɛ ke nɔ ko hɛɛ e he gu ɔ, e haa lɛ heha nɔ́.
E yɛ he nɛ a ngɛ yayami pee ngɛ, konɛ yayami ko sã lɛ.
Ke e pa sika ha nɔ ko ɔ, e he we hekpa.
E yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a binyumu nɛ ɔ be gboe ngɛ e tsɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he, se mohu, niinɛ, e yi ma na wami.
E tsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, e waa nihi yi mi, e kpɔ̃ɔ̃ e nyɛmi nɔ́ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ngɛ e ma a mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he.
“Se nyɛ biɔ ke, Mɛni he je bi nɛ́ nɔ́ ngɛ e tsɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he ɔ?
Ke bi ko yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e yeɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, niinɛ, e yi ma na wami.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ ma gbo.
Bi be nɔ́ nae ngɛ e tsɛ yayamihi a he, nɛ tsɛ hu be nɔ́ nae ngɛ yayamihi nɛ e bi pee ɔ a he.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a ma na hiɔwo kpakpa, se nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, a maa gbla e tue ngɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he!
“Ke yayami peelɔ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e yeɔ ye mlaa a nɔ, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e be gboe; niinɛ, e yi ma na wami.
A kɛ e yayami ɔmɛ tsuo maa pa lɛ; e yi ma na wami, ejakaa e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ bie ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Anɛ i naa yayami peelɔ ɔ gbenɔ he bua jɔmi lo?” “Dɛbi, nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ mohu ji kaa e maa kpale kɛ je e blɔ yayami ɔ nɔ, nɛ e yi nɛ na wami.
“Se ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da jɔɔ kpakpa peemi, nɛ e bɔni ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ yayami peeli peeɔ peemi ɔ, anɛ e yi ma na wami lo?
Dɛbi, kpakpa nɛ e pee sa a tsuo a be ekoeko kaie hu.
E ma gbo ngɛ e tɔmi nɛ e tɔ, kɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he.
“Nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ɔ dɛ.’ Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Nyɛ susuɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i peeɔ níhi ɔ dɛ lo?
Anɛ pi nyɛ mohu nɛ nyɛ ní peepee ɔmɛ dɛ lo?
Ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kpa nɔ́ nɛ da peemi, nɛ e ya pee yayami, nɛ e gbo ɔ, e gbo ngɛ e he yayami ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ hu, ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e ye dami sane, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, e ma he e yi wami.
Ejakaa jamɛatsɛ ɔ pia e he, nɛ e kpale kɛ je e tɔmi ɔmɛ a mi; niinɛ, e yi ma na wami, e be gboe.
Se nyɛ Israel ma a, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ɔ dɛ.’ Anɛ imi lɛ i pee we nɔ́ nɛ da lo?
Anɛ pi nyɛ Israel ma a mohu nɛ nyɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da lo?
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kojo Israel ma a tsuo; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ba e je mi ha a nɔ ma da kɛ kojo lɛ.
Nyɛ kpa yayami ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ mɔ, konɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ ko kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
Yayamihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee kɛ si mi ɔ, nyɛ sake mɛ ngɔ pue he.
Nyɛ tsake, nɛ́ nyɛ na juɛmi he, kɛ tsui he.
Israel ma, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ kpata a?
Imi lɛɛ i sume kaa nyɛ gbo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Kɔmɔ yemi la Jehanɛ Yawɛ de mi ke ma la kɔmɔ yemi la ko ha Israel ma ganɔ ɔmɛ.
La a deɔ ke, Mɛnɔ ji o nyɛ?
O nyɛ ngɛ kaa jata yo ko nɛ buɔ si ngɛ jata kuhi a kpɛti!
Lohwe katsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ e lɛɔ e bimɛ ngɛ.
E tsɔse e bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake kɛ ya su be nɛ e ba wa.
E tsɔɔ lɛ de, nɛ nimlihi tete po e nuɔ nɛ e yeɔ.
Je ma amɛ ba nu jata bi ɔ he.
A tsua muɔ kɛ tsɔ lɛ klama; e nɔ mi, nɛ e du.
A ngɔ gbowehi kɛ gbla lɛ kɛ ho Egipt zugba a nɔ ya.
Jata nyɛ ɔ mlɛ e bi nɛ ɔ hluu kɛ ya su be nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo ta.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale hla e bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake; e tsɔse lɛ kɛ ya su be nɛ e ba wa.
Benɛ e ba wa a, e kɛ jata kpa amɛ nyɛɛɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa.
Lɛ hu e ba kase de, nɛ nimlihi tete po e nuɔ nɛ e yeɔ.
E ku a mɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e kpata a ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
Ke e wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, sawale nuɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo tsɔ lɛ klamahi kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
A bli a ya a mi ngɔ pue e nɔ.
A tsua muɔ kɛ tsɔ lɛ klama; e nɔ mi, nɛ e du.
A ngɔ gbowehi kɛ gbla lɛ kɛ wo daka ko mi, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ.
A wo lɛ tsu ngɛ mɔ ɔ mi, konɛ a ko nu e gbi ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
O nyɛ ngɛ kaa wai tso ko nɛ a hia ya ma ngɛ pa tue.
E ná nyu saminya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e gba kɔnihi, nɛ e wo yiblii kplanyaa.
E kɔni kake nɛ he wa pe kulaa a ba pee tso nɛ a kɛ peeɔ matsɛ tso; e ka pe tso kɔni kusukusuu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ na kaa tso nɛ ɔ ka saminya, nɛ e pee kusuu kɛ e kɔnihi babauu.
Se a kɛ abofu hia wai tso nɛ ɔ, nɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ si.
Ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ fia, nɛ e ha nɛ tso ɔ gbli, nɛ e yiblii tsuo kplɔ pue si; tso agbo ɔ nitsɛ hu gbli, nɛ a kɛ la sã.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, a hia tso ɔ, nɛ a ya ma lɛ ngɛ nga nɔ; a ma lɛ ngɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ he nɛ nyu ko nyu ko be.
La ba sɛ tso kɔni ɔmɛ a mi; e sã kɔni ɔmɛ, kɛ e yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo.
La a sã tso nɛ he wa a hulɔ.
Tso kpakpa nɛ maa si kaa tso nɛ a kɛ peeɔ matsɛ tso ɔ be hu.
Kɔmɔ yemi la nɛ a pɔɔ lami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mawu suɔmi nya ní, kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa we atuã tsɔmi Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a jeha kpaagone ɔ we nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma a, Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ ba ye ngɔ.
A ba konɛ a ba bi Yawɛ gbi.
I ha mɛ sɛ, nɛ a hi si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ kaa a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bi nɛ ɔ lo?
I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke i be kplɛɛe nɛ nyɛ bi mi ní.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Nɔmlɔ adesa, o maa kojo mɛ lo?
Ke jã a, lɛɛ ha nɛ a le ní hiemi níhi nɛ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsu.
De mɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ. Benɛ i hla Israel ma a, i wo mɛ si ko.
I je ye he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ i de mɛ ke, imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, i ka mɛ kita ke ma je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ya zugba ko nɛ i hla ha mɛ, zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ e ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa nɔ.
I de mɛ ke yakayaka mawuhi nɛ a suɔ nɛ ɔ, a sake mɛ ngɔ pue he, se a ko ngɔ Egipt amagahi kɛ ble a he; ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Se a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã; a kplɛɛ we nɛ a bu mi tue; nɔ ko nɔ ko sakee we yakayaka ní ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he; a hɛɛ Egipt amaga amɛ a mi wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma ha nɛ a nu ye we abofu gbeyegbeye ɔ he ngɛ Egipt.
Se i ha we nɛ e ba mi ja; ejakaa lɔ ɔ ko gbe ye biɛ he guɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
Ye ma a ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ i de ngɛ ke ma je Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba nga a nɔ.
I wo mɛ mlaahi, nɛ i tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ ke a ye nɔ ɔ, a yi ma na wami.
Lɔ ɔ se hu, i ngɔ ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mɛ nɛ a ye mɛ klɔuklɔu, konɛ e pee somi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ mɛ wa kpɛti ɔ he okadi; nɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ nɛ peeɔ mɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
Se Israel ma a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã ngɛ nga a nɔ.
A yi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ; a bui mɛ kaa níhi nɛ ke nɔmlɔ ye a nɔ ɔ, e yi ma na wami.
A ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ hu kpɔtɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma ha nɛ a nu ye we abofu gbeyegbeye ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Se i ha we nɛ e ba mi ja, ejakaa je ma amɛ nɛ na bɔ nɛ i kpaka ye ma a kɛ je Egipt ɔ, ye biɛ he guɛ ma gbo ngɛ a hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ hu, i ka mɛ kita ngɛ nga a nɔ ke zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ e ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa nɛ i ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be lejɛ ɔ yae hu, ejakaa a kua ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ a yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
A ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ hu kpɔtɔɔ.
Ejakaa a suɔ wawɛɛ kaa a ma ja amaga amɛ mohu.
“Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i na mɛ mɔbɔ; i kpataa we a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Se i bɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ kɔkɔ mohu ke, mlaahi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wo ɔ, nyɛ ko ye a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ a we amaga amɛ kɛ ble nyɛ he.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ pee ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ a ba pee okadi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
“Se jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ hu tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã; a nyɛɛ we ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
A ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ hulɔ.
Níhi nɛ ke nɔmlɔ pee nɛ e yi ma na wami ɔ, a pee we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i to ye yi mi kaa ma ha nɛ a nu ye we abofu gbeyegbeye ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Se i ha we nɛ e ba mi ja; ejakaa je ma amɛ nɛ na bɔ nɛ i kpaka ye ma a kɛ je Egipt ɔ, ye biɛ he guɛ ma gbo ngɛ a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpale wo si ekohu ngɛ nga a nɔ.
I ka kita ke ma gbɛ ye ma a ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ a kpɛti ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
I pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa a bui ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ hu, a yi nɔ; jehanɛ hu, a ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ, nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ mohu a suɔ wawɛɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ha mɛ blɔ nya tomi yayahi, kɛ mlaahi nɛ ke nɔmlɔ ye nɔ ɔ, e yi be wami nae.
I ha nɛ a ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bɔhi kɛ ble a he, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bitɛtehi hu kɛ sã bɔ.
I ngɔ enɛ ɔ kɛ gbla a tue, konɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ mi hu nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bɔ musu kɛ si mi; a yi mi anɔkuale.
I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ i wo si kaa ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.
Se he tsuaa he nɛ a na yoku gojoo, aloo tso nɛ bɔ kusuu ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ a ya sã bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A sã bɔhi nɛ jee via, kɛ wai bɔ hulɔ; a pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo ye mi mi la.
I bi mɛ ke, he gojoohi nɛ nyɛ yaa a, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ?
‘He gojoohi’ nɛ ɔ ba pee biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he blee kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ajuama bɔe kɛ ngɛ a ní hiemi níhi a se nyɛɛe ɔ?
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po, nyɛ ngɔɔ nike níhi kɛ ya haa amagahi, nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ ngɔ haa nɛ a sã mɛ ngɛ la mi; nyɛ jaa amagahi babauu kɛ bleɔ nyɛ he.
Israel bi, enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, nyɛ kpale baa ke a bi mi ní ha nyɛ.
I be kplɛɛe nɛ nɔ ko ba bi mi ní ha nyɛ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Nyɛ pee nyɛ yi mi momo ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee nyɛ he kaa je ma kpa amɛ.
Nyɛ maa pee kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba kpahi a nɔ nɛ a jaa tso kɛ tɛ ɔ. Dɛbi, dɛbi!
E be mi bae ja kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Mawu gblaa nɔ tue, nɛ Mawu ngɔɔ yayami nɛ nɔ pee kɛ paa “Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke i ngɛ nyɛ si woe kaa ma ngɔ abofu, kɛ nine si wami tsuo kɛ ye nyɛ nɔ.
Ma je nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti.
Ma bua nyɛ nya kɛ je hehi tsuo nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a. Ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, kɛ abofu nguaa ma ngɔ kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya ‘Je ma amɛ a nga a nɔ.’ Ma kojo nyɛ, nɛ ma bu nyɛ fɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu.
Ma kojo nyɛ nɛ ma bu nyɛ fɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Ye nine si maa wa ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ma ha nyɛ maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ.
Ma je atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tɔ̃ ye nɔ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
A maa je zugba nɔ he nɛ a ya to nibwɔ ngɛ ɔ mohu, se a be Israel zugba a nɔ bae, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ya sɔmɔ e we amagahi.
Se pee se ɔ, nyɛ maa bu mi tue kɛ̃; nyɛ be nyɛ we amaga amɛ ngɔe kɛ ble ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ hu.
Ye yo klɔuklɔu nɛ ji Israel yo gagaa a nɔ nyɛ Israel bi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ma ba ja mi ngɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma ná nyɛ he tsui ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɛ maa ngɔ nike ní slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, sami bɔ ɔmɛ, nike ní kpakpa pe kulaa amɛ, kɛ bɔ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Ke i je nyɛ kɛ je je mahi a nɔ hehi nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, nɛ i ba bua nyɛ nya a, ma ná nyɛ he tsui kaa bɔ nɛ he via, nɛ je ma amɛ maa na kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Zugba a nɛ i ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke ma ngɔ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ, ke i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ ma na maa le kaa niinɛ, imi ji Yawɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma kai nyɛ blɔ yaya amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ní peemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ kɛ ble nyɛ he ɔ. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he maa nyɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ a he.
Nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛ maa na hu kaa ye biɛ Yawɛ ɔ, i sume kaa e puɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ to we ní ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ nɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
La ngɛ tsoe ngɛ leneyi je Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee leneyi je, nɛ o fiɛ kɛ si lejɛ ɔ. Gbaa kɛ si hue nɛ ngɛ leneyi je zugba a nɔ ɔ.
De leneyi je hue ɔ ke nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ, e bu tue saminya.
Hyɛ, ma slɛ la ngɛ o mi, nɛ e maa sã o tso mumu, kɛ tso gbigbli ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa gbe la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam nɛ ɔ. E maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ e blɔ ɔ mi kɛ maa je leneyi je kɛ yaa su omleyi je tɔɔ.
Nimli adesahi tsuo maa na kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i mɛ hue ɔ he la a nɛ, nɛ a be nyɛe maa gbe.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpa pɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ko ha nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ dee ngɛ ye he momo ke, nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ pi abɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e buɔ.”
Yawɛ klaate ɔ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Yerusalem.
Fiɛ tsɔɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ o gba kɛ si Israel zugba a ke, imi Yawɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji i kɛ mo ná.
Ma hia ye klaate kɛ je e kpo ɔ mi, nɛ ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, dalɔ jio, yayami peelɔ jio.
Ma ngɔ ye klaate ɔ kɛ gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ je leneyi je kɛ ya si omleyi je tɔɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa imi Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ i hia klaate kɛ je e kpo ɔ mi, nɛ i be lɛ se kpalee kɛ wo e kpo ɔ mi hu.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, mo nya awe, nɛ o ye kɔmɔ wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o tsui kpa miɔ nɛ e tsɔ ngɛ ma a hɛ mi.
Ke a bi mo nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mo pee loko o ngɛ kɛmɛe kɛ aywilɛho wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, de mɛ ke sane nɛ ma a nya wa tsɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsui maa po; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nine mi maa je wu; nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee vii ngɛ e mi; nɛ nakutso tsuaa nakutso mi maa jɔ kaa nyu.
Be ɔ ma, e su ta, nɛ e maa ba mi amlɔ nɔuu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa nɛ o de ma a ke, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Klaate oo klaate!
A duɔ klaate ko nya; a sa he, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam.
A duɔ klaate ɔ nya, konɛ a kɛ kpata nihi a hɛ mi; a sa he, konɛ e kpɛ nylamnylam kaa oslabai.
Ye ma a be nyɛe ma nyá, ejakaa a bui ye munyu ɔmɛ; a tue nɛ i gbla wawɛɛ ɔ tsuo pee yaka.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sa klaate ɔ he saminya, konɛ a kɛ tsu ní.
A duɔ klaate ɔ nya, nɛ a sa he hulɔ, konɛ a kɛ wo awi yelɔ ko dɛ mi.
Nɔmlɔ adesa, moo wo ya, nɛ o ye kɔmɔ, ejakaa a ma kpata ye ma a hɛ mi; a ma kpata Israel ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi!
A kɛ klaate maa gbe mɛ, kɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɔɔ o nine kɛ kpla o yi, nɛ o ye kɔmɔ!
I ngɛ ye ma a kae ma hyɛ; ke a kplɛɛ we kaa a tsake ɔ, lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba a nɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa nɛ o fia o dɛ mi.
Fɔ̃ klaate ɔ si etɛ.
Klaate nɛ gbeɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Klaate nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi lɛ ngɛ e he poe kɛ ngɛ ma a bɔlee ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ sawale nɛ nu ye ma a, nɛ nihi fuu a hɛ mi nɛ kpata a, i ngɔ klaate nɛ he ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam kaa oslabai nɛ gbee nɔ hulɔ kɛ tsɔɔ ma a. Klaate nɛ nya ba, poo ní kɛ ya hiɔ nɔ; jehanɛ, poo ní kɛ ya muɔ nɔ!
Poo ní kɛ ya he tsuaa he nɛ o hɛ mi tsɔɔ.
Imi hu ma fia ye dɛ, nɛ ye we abofu ɔ se maa po.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Babilonia matsɛ ɔ klaate ɔ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E de ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tɛni gbɛjegbɛ enyɔ nɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ kɛ e dɛ mi klaate ɔ maa nyɛɛ nɔ kɛ ba.
Ha nɛ blɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je zugba kake nɔ kɛ ba.
Ngɔɔ okadi kɛ to blɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a he so ngɛ ma a nya he nɛ blɔ ɔmɛ gba ngɛ ɔ. Okadi kake maa tsɔɔ matsɛ ɔ blɔ nɛ yaa Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Raba a, nɛ kake hu maa tsɔɔ blɔ nɛ yaa Yerusalem, Yuda ma nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he ɔ. Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba da si ngɛ blɔ gbla a nya, konɛ e kla kɛ hla blɔ nɛ e maa gu.
E ma huanya e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ; e ma bi ní ngɛ amaga amɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e maa hyɛ lohwe nɛ a gbe ɔ fafali mi.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi ɔ maa tsɔɔ Yerusalem.
E maa tsɔɔ lɛ kaa e ya fia gbogbo kumi kpoku kɛ wo ma a he; e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e he ose wawɛɛ; e ngɔ gbogbo kumi níhi kɛ to agbo ɔmɛ a nya; e fia kpokuhi, nɛ e ma mɔhi.
Se enɛ ɔ maa pee kaa yaka gbami ngɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; ejakaa a so nɛ a ka kita ngɔ fɔ nɔ momo kaa huɛmɛ ji mɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, gbami ɔ maa bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a maa le kaa a ma ba nuu mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nyɛ ha a kai nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ; a je kpo paa ngɛ nihi tsuo a hɛ mi; mɛ tsuo a na kaa nyɛ yeɔ fɔ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, yayami sɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha nyɛ he nyɛli maa nuu nyɛ nine nya.
“Nɛ mo, Israel ganɔ, nɔmlɔ yayami, kɛ yiwutsotsɛ, o nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; be nɛ a maa gbla o tue wawɛɛ ɔ su jehanɛ.
Bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Pɛne o yi fimi nɔ́ ɔ, je matsɛ pɛɛ ɔ ngɛ o yi!
Níhi ma tsake; bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, a be ja hie hu; nɔ́ nɛ ba si ɔ a ma wo nɔ; nɔ́ nɛ a wo nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si!
Wó ni guhi nɔ yeli.
Ha nɛ nɔ yeli nɛ ba pee ni guhi!
Ma doku, ma doku oo, ma doku!
Ma pee ma a ma doku!
Se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be mi bae kɛ yaa si nɔ nɛ e sa kaa e tsuɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba; nɛ ma ngɔ ma a kɛ wo e dɛ mi.
Klaate ko kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa, nɛ o fiɛ ke Amon bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Israel hɛ mi si puee ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke, ‘A hia klaate ko nɛ a kɛ ma kpata nihi a hɛ mi.
A sa klaate ɔ he, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam kaa oslabai, konɛ a kɛ gbe nihi.
Ninahi nɛ nyɛ na a tsuo, lakpa sɔuu; gbamihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gbae ɔ hu jã kɛ̃.
Nyɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ yayami pɛ nyɛ peeɔ, nyɛ be ɔ su ta; be nɛ a maa gbla nyɛ tue ɔ ma oo!
A kɛ klaate ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’ “Nyɛ ke, ‘Kpale klaate ɔ se kɛ wo e kpo ɔ mi!
Dɛbi!
He nɛ a bɔ nyɛ ade ngɛ, zugba nɔ he nɛ a fɔ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ.
Nyɛ maa nu ye abofu nɛ nya wa a he, be mi nɛ ma gli kɛ wo nyɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam.
Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo dikali nɛ le ga nɛ a kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi a dɛ mi.
A kɛ la maa sã nyɛ.
A ma pue nyɛ muɔ si ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ kaie gblegbleegble.’ ” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Yayamihi nɛ Yerusalem pee Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o pee klaalo nɛ o maa kojo ma nɛ muɔ si pɛ a pueɔ ngɛ mi ɔ lo?
Ke jã a, lɛɛ ha nɛ e le ní hiemi níhi nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo.
De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ dee ji, mo ma nɛ o pue muɔ si babauu, nɛ o puɛ amagahi nɛ o ja mɛ kɛ ble o he, o be ɔ su ta.
O yeɔ fɔ kaa o pue muɔ si, nɛ o puɛ amagahi, nɛ o ja mɛ kɛ ble o he.
Hyɛ, o ha nɛ o nyagbe ɔ na mo haa!
O be ɔ su.
Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ha je ma amɛ ngɛ mo ahlua bɔe, nɛ zugba amɛ tsuo ngɛ o he fɛu yee ɔ nɛ.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ ma se tsitsaa, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nya tsuo maa ye o he fɛu; ejakaa o he guɛ gbo, nɛ basabasa sɔuu a peeɔ ngɛ o mi.
Israel ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami nɔ; a pueɔ muɔ si bɔ nɛ a suɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ma a mi nɛ buɔ e fɔli.
O yeɔ nibwɔhi amimi, nɛ o waa awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi hu yi mi.
O gbeɔ ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he guɛ, nɛ o bleɔ ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ.
Ni komɛ yeɔ lakpa ngɛ ma a mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpata a nyɛmimɛ a hɛ mi.
Ni komɛ ya yeɔ niye ní bɔhi nɛ a sã ngɛ jami hehi; nɛ ni komɛ hu dii he lo akɔnɔ se wawɛɛ.
Nyumu ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ a tsɛmɛ a yihi po hwɔɔ si; nɛ yihi nɛ ku nine po, nyumu komɛ kɛ mɛ hwɔɔ si pani nya.
Ni komɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɛmimɛ a yihi hwɔɔ si; ni komɛ kɛ a nganyɛmɛ, nɛ ni komɛ hu kɛ a tsɛmɛ a biyihi hwɔɔ nɛ́ zo pee we mɛ.
Nyɛ ti ni komɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní nɛ a kɛ pueɔ muɔ si.
Ni komɛ paa sika kɛ haa a nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛhi, nɛ a heɔ hekpa fuu ngɛ a dɛ kɛ naa a he kpɔtɔɔ.
Nɛ a hɛ je ye nɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma tsɛ̃ ye nguɛ nya ngɛ ojo nɛ a ngɛ yee, kɛ muɔ si nɛ a ngɛ puee ɔ he.
Ke i kɛ mo ná a, anɛ o ma nyɛ maa to tsui si, nɛ o maa pee kã kɛ ya si nyagbe lo?
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de, nɛ ma pee hulɔ.
Ma tsɛ̃ o yi se kɛ ya je ma amɛ a mi, nɛ ma gbɛ mo ngɔ fĩa zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní yayamihi nɛ o peeɔ kɛ woɔ o he mu ɔ, ma ha o ma kpa peemi.
O hɛ mi ma pue si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi; se moo lɛɛ, o ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Mawu maa tsu Israel he ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, Israel ma a he be se nami ha mi!
A ngɛ kaa sika fĩ nɛ jeɔ akɔblee, sika hiɔ, dade, loo sumui mi, ke a tsu he se ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke mɛ tsuo kulaa se nami ko kulaa be a he.
Ma bua a nya kɛ ba Yerusalem ma a mi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ a buaa sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, kɛ sumui nya ngɔ woɔ flɔɔnɔɔ mi, nɛ a huu la kɛ woɔ he, nɛ a sileɔ ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ma bua a nya kɛ ba ma a mi.
Ma ngɔ abofu kɛ hɛdɔ kɛ sile mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sileɔ dade ɔ. Ee, ma bua a nya kɛ ba Yerusalem ma a mi; ma slɛ la kɛ wo a sisi.
Ye mi mi la a ma mle mɛ, nɛ a maa sile.
Ee, a maa sile mɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kaa a sileɔ sika hiɔ ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi!
Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i ngɛ a tue gblae ɔ nɛ.” Yayamihi nɛ Israel ganɔ ɔmɛ pee Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ligbi ɔ nɛ ye mi mi ma fu ɔ, nyɛ maa pee kaa zugba nɛ a hu we, nɛ́ hiɔmi hu nɛ́ ngɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ ya so, nɛ a pee a he kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe nɛ ngɛ lohwe nɛ e gbe mi tsɔtslɔɔe.
A gbee nihi, nɛ a ngɔɔ a sika, kɛ a weto ní tsuo ngɛ a dɛ.
Nyumuhi babauu nɛ a gbe ɔ ha yalɔyihi hu a he ba hiɛ ngɛ ma a mi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ plɛɔ ye mlaa a hɛ mi buɔ si, nɛ a bleɔ ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
A li slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu, kɛ nɔ́ gu a kpɛti.
A tsɔɔ we ni ɔmɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we a kpɛti.
A kuɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ bui mi fɛɛ.
Ganɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa ogbeteehi nɛ ngɛ a de lo mi tsɔtslɔɔe.
A gbeɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na ní yaka.
Gbali ɔmɛ laa yayamihi a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ kalo saa gbogbo he.
Lakpa ninahi a naa, nɛ a gbami ɔmɛ hu lakpa sɔuu.
A deɔ ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ tsɔ mɛ, be mi nɛ imi Yawɛ, i de we mɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa.
Zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ amimi, nɛ a haa níhi; a waa dɛgutsɛ, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi.
A yeɔ nubwɔ amimi wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ a yɛ se.
I hla nɔ ko nɛ maa po piɛ kɛ wo a he, loo nɛ e maa tsi puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi ɔ ha ma a, konɛ ma ko puɛ zugba a, se i nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ abofu nɛ nya wa kɛ gbla a tue.
Ye mi mi la a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ a ní yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ a he!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, be ko ɔ, yi enyɔ komɛ hi si; nɔ kɛ e senɔ, nɛ ji yo kake bimɛ.
A puɛ kulaa kɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛ je a yihe mi tɔɔ ngɛ Egipt.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyumuhi fiɛ a nyɔhi a he, nɛ a puɛ mɛ ngɛ.
Nɔkɔtɔma a biɛ ji Ohola, nɛ e senɔ ɔ biɛ ji Oholiba.
I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ pee ye yihi, nɛ a fɔ bimɛ nyumuhi kɛ yihi ha mi.
Biɛ Ohola a daa si ha Samaria, nɛ Oholiba hu daa si ha Yerusalem.
Ohola je ye se ya puɛ gba.
E kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Asiria mohu ya pee e suɔli.
Ta buli nɛ wo tade he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, amlaalohi, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ, mɛ tsuo nihewi okpɔngɔ ta buli nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ e ya su.
Ohola kɛ Asiria nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ biɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ e ja a we amagahi kɛ ble e he.
Yahomi nɛ e je sisi kɛ je e yihe mi ngɛ Egipt, he nɛ a fiɛ e nyɔ he, nɛ a kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama nɛ a puɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ, e kpa we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo Asiria bi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ e suɔ wawɛɛ ɔ a dɛ mi.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kpa e he bo, nɛ a ngɔ e bimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ, a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ.
E tue gblami nɛ ɔ ba pee fɛu yemi nɔ́ ha yihi tsuo.
“Oholiba na nɔ́ nɛ ba awenyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, se e ya nɔ nɛ e bɔ ajuama kulaa pe lɛ.
Lɛ hu e ya nyɛɛ Asiria nyumu ɔmɛ a se, nɛ e kɛ mɛ pee e suɔli.
Ta buli nɛ mia saminyayoo kɛ ta hwumi ní, amlaalohi kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ, mɛ tsuo nihewi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ a hii okpɔngɔhi a nɔ nɛ e ya su.
I na kaa e puɛ kulaa; nyɛmimɛ yihi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, slɔɔto ko be a kpɛti.
-“Oholiba yahomi ɔ nya wa nɛ e hí nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko peemi.
Benɛ e na Babilonia ma ní tsuli a foni nɛ a tɛni ngɛ gbogbo he, bɔ nɛ a ngɔ nɔ́ tsu kɛ pee, nɛ mlɛ mi fimi níhi ngɛ a mlɛ mi, kɛ yi fimi duku gagaaga saminyawiiwi ngɛ a yi mi ɔ, e pee lɛ fɛu tsɔ.
Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e na a foni ɔmɛ ɔ, a he pee lɛ akɔnɔ, nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya tsɛ mɛ ngɛ Babilonia tɔɔ.
Babilonia nyumu ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba hwɔ bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ.
A pee lɛ basabasa, nɛ a ble lɛ kɛ ya si a he pee lɛ tai.
Benɛ e ngɛ ajuama bɔe wawɛɛ, nɛ e ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ na le kaa yaholɔ nitsɛnitsɛ ji lɛ ɔ, imi hu e sane ba gbe ye nya jehanɛ; i sume lɛ hu, kaa bɔ nɛ i sume e nyɛmiyo nɔkɔtɔma a.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e bɔ ajuama a; e pee e he yaholɔ kulaa.
E kai e yihe mi, benɛ e bɔ ajuama basaa ngɛ Egipt ɔ. E kai e suɔli nɛ a nyumu tso kle kaa tejihi a nɔ́, nɛ a he mi abua nya wa kaa okpɔngɔ kuhi a nɔ́ ɔ.” (Oholiba, o yihe mi zo ní nɛ o tsu benɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ fiɛ o nyɔ he, nɛ a puɛ mo kɛ pee yaholɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsu ekohu nɛ ɔ nɛ.)
Mawu gbla Oholiba tue “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Oholiba, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O suɔli ɔmɛ a sane ba gbe o nya nɛ o sume mɛ hu; se ma ha a maa te si kɛ wo mo; a ma ba sa o yi.
Ma ngɔ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ Kaldea bi ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ je Pekod, Shoa, kɛ Koa kɛ ba; Asiria bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba.
Amlaalohi, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ, mɛ tsuo nihewi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu, tsɔli nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ ta buli, mɛ tsuo a maa hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ba.
Ta buli kɛ a ta zugba lɛhi babauu, kɛ a tlɔɔkehi kɛ a mi tlomi maa je omleyi je kɛ ba tua mo.
A kɛ tsɛ̃i agbohi, tsɛ̃i wawi, kɛ dade pɛɛ ma gba ta kɛ wo o he.
Ma ha a maa kojo mo ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a mlaa nya.
Akɛnɛ o wo ye mi mi la he je ɔ, a kɛ abofu maa gbla o tue.
A maa poo o gugwɔ, kɛ o tuehi ngɛ o he; a kɛ klaate maa gbe ni komɛ.
Ee, a maa ngɔ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ kɛ ho, nɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, a maa sã mɛ.
A ma kplɔ o he tade, nɛ a maa ngɔ o june saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ.
Ma ha o yahomi, kɛ ajuama bɔmi basaa nɛ o hɛɛ mi kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ se maa po kulaa.
O be amagahi hyɛe, nɛ o be Egipt bi ɔmɛ kaie gblegbleegble hu.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ngɔ mo ngɔ wo o he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nihi nɛ a he pee mo tai, nɛ o sume mɛ hu ɔ, a kɛ mo maa ye kaa a he nyɛlɔ.
Níhi babauu nɛ o gbo he dengme ɔ tsuo a maa muɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ma si mo ngɔ fɔ si kɛ o he gu saplapaa.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi maa na o yahomi, kɛ ajuama bɔmi basaa a tsuo paa.
O pee o he yaholɔ, nɛ o kɛ je ma amɛ ya bɔ ajuama; o ya ja a we amaga amɛ kɛ ble o he.
O ya wo o nyɛmiyo ɔ nane, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tue gblami kplu ɔ nɛ i ha o nyɛmi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu ma ha mo.” Yawɛ ke, “O nyɛmiyo ɔ kplu ɔ kle; e mi kuɔ hulɔ.
O maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ tsuo.
A maa muɔ mo, a maa ye o he fɛu, ejakaa kplu ɔ hyi buɛii.
E ma ha o maa pee basaa kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã.
Gbeye níhi, kɛ he hiami níhi sɔuu lɛ ngɛ o nyɛmiyo Samaria kplu ɔ mi.
Ma ha o maa nu, nɛ o ma lɔ kplu ɔ mi.
O kɛ he hiami maa fa o yi bwɔmi, nɛ o kɛ kplu kokoe ɔmɛ maa plaa o nyɔ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “O hɛ je ye nɔ, nɛ o plɛ se ngɔ wo mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o maa na o yahomi, kɛ o we ajuama bɔmi ɔ mi nɔ́.” Mawu gbla nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a tue Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o maa kojo Ohola kɛ Oholiba lo?
Lɛɛ, tsɔɔ mɛ ní hiemi níhi gbegbeegbe nɛ a pee ɔ.
A puɛ gba kɛ a we amaga jami ɔ; a pue muɔ si, nɛ binyumuwi nɛ a fɔ ha mi ɔ po a kɛ mɛ sã bɔ ha amagahi.
Nɔ́ nɛ a pee kɛ si mi hu ji, ligbi ɔ nɛ a ble ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu a ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Ejakaa benɛ a gbe ye bimɛ ɔmɛ ha a we amaga amɛ ɔ, a ba ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a ba ble lejɛ ɔ!
“Be komɛ po ɔ, a maa tsɔ nihi kɛ ya tsitsaa ya tsɛ nyumuhi kɛ ba ha mɛ.
Ke a ba a, nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ maa du a he; a ma kpa a hɛ se tsopa, nɛ a kɛ june ma dla a he.
A maa hi sɛ saminyayoo nɔ; a maa ngɔ okplɔɔ kɛ e nɔ ní kpakpahi kɛ ya ma si ngɛ a hɛ mi.
Tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ oliv nu nɛ i ha mɛ ɔ hu piɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, hoo peemi, kɛ nyami he a nuɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A ya ngɔɔ dã tɔli kɛ jeɔ nga a nɔ kɛ ba piɛɔ nihi babauu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo ɔ a he.
A ngɔɔ nine si gahi kɛ woɔ yi ɔmɛ a nine si, nɛ a ngɔɔ jlasi saminyawiiwi kɛ fiɔ a yi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ye he ke, hyɛ kaa yo nɛ bwɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ajuama bɔmi mi ɔ, nyumuhi kɛ lɛ pa ngɛ si hwɔe!
Nyumuhi ngɛ a ngɔ yae kaa bɔ nɛ a yaa yihi yaholi a ngɔ.
Ee, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ a ngɛ Ohola kɛ Oholiba nɔ puee; a pee a he ajamɛatsɛmɛ!
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da maa bu mɛ fɔ kaa a puɛ gba, nɛ a pue muɔ si hulɔ; ejakaa a ngɔ yahomi kɛ pee a ní tsumi, nɛ a pue muɔ si.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha yakayaka nimli babauu ma ba wo a he gbeye, nɛ a maa ha a níhi.
Yakayaka nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa fia mɛ tɛ, nɛ a ma ja mɛ klaate; a maa gbe a bimɛ, nɛ a maa mɛ a we ɔmɛ a he la.
Ma ha yahomi se maa po ngɛ zugba a nɔ, konɛ a kɛ bɔ yihi tsuo kɔkɔ nɛ a ko tsu yahomi ní nɛ nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ tsu ɔ gblegbleegble.
Nɛ nyɛ, nyɛmiyi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ, ma gbla nyɛ tue kaa nyɛ bɔ ajuama nɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Buɛ kɛ e mi kana a Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nɛɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma a we ligbi nyɔngma a, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E fa mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, kadi mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ biɛ ngɛ womi mi kɛ to!
Ejakaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔuu Babilonia matsɛ ɔ bɔni Yerusalem he ka womi.
Buu abɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ ma tue gboli nɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ o de mɛ ke abɛ nɛ ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ i ngɛ mɛ bue.
Ngɔɔ buɛ ɔ kɛ ma la a nɔ; yɛɛ nyu kɛ wo buɛ ɔ mi.
Ngɔɔ lo nɛ o saa a tsuo kɛ wo mi; lo kpakpa a tsuo, kɔni ɔ kɛ fiɔ ɔ, kɛ wu kpakpa pe kulaa a hulɔ; ngɔɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ wo buɛ ɔ mi.
Gbee to nɛ hi pe kulaa, ngɔɔ e lo ɔ tsuo kɛ wo buɛ ɔ mi; moo to lɛ́ kɛ wo sisi.
Ha nɛ e fia nɛ e be saminya; wu ɔmɛ tete po, a be ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Musu tloo ma nɛ muɔ si pɛ a pueɔ ngɛ mi ɔ!
Ma a ngɛ kaa buɛ ko nɛ e mi nɔ kana, nɛ́ kana a ma ngɛ mi.
A tá e mi lo ɔmɛ kakaaka ta; ekoeko piɛ ngɛ mi!
A pue muɔ si ngɛ ma a mi.
Pi zugba nɛ muɔ ɔ pue nɛ a maa ngɔ tabo zu kɛ tsi nɔ, se tɛ sa kpataa nɔ.
Ee, i si muɔ ɔ ngɛ tɛ sa kpataa a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na paa, konɛ a kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa nɛ ye lue.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Musu tloo ma nɛ muɔ si pɛ a pueɔ ngɛ mi ɔ!
Imi hu ma bua lɛ́ nya glegle kɛ wo e sisi!
Ma ngɔ lɛ́ babauu kɛ ba!
Ma ha la a maa tso wawɛɛ, nɛ lo ɔ maa be saminya!
Hwonyu ɔ maa si, nɛ wu ɔmɛ tete ma ngla!
Jehanɛ, ma ha buɛ ɔ mi gu maa ma la hleii ɔ nɔ, konɛ e dɔ la kɛ yaa si akɔblee ɔ maa tsu paa; kɛkɛ ɔ, e mi mu ɔ tsuo maa sile, nɛ e mi kana a tsuo maa ta pɛsɛpɛsɛ!
Hyɛ kaa i gbo dengme yaka!
Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ pɛ i pee nɛ ɔ nɛ; se kana babauu pa ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi kɛ sa; la a po nyɛ we kana a nɛ e je.
Yerusalem, o yahomi basaa nɛ puɛ mo ɔ ji kana a nɛ.
I gbo dengme kɛ bɔ o he mɔde, konɛ o he nɛ tsɔ; se mu ɔ ngɛ o he kpamisa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o he be tsɔe kɛ je o mu ní peemi ní ɔmɛ a mi hu kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ngɔ mi mi la kɛ gbla o tue wawɛɛ.
Imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ i de.
Be ɔ su jehanɛ; bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, ja ma pee.
I be ye nya se kpalee; i be mɔbɔ nae, nɛ i be ye he piae hulɔ.
Yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ a he ɔ, ma gbla o tue bɔ nɛ sa mo.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Gbalɔ ɔ yo ɔ gbenɔ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tlukaa a, ma ha gbenɔ hiɔ ma ba fia o suɔlɔ pe kulaa a, nɛ e ma gbo.
Ke e ba mi ja a, koo ye kɔmɔ; ko fo ya, nɛ koo nga vo nyu hulɔ.
A ko nu o huu fami he; se fi o yi duku, nɛ o wo tokota.
Koo ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha o nya nɔ, nɛ koo ye ya nɔ niye ní kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o ngɛ ya nyɛe.” Mɔtu kpla a, i kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tu munyu.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ gbɔkuɛ nɔuu nɛ ye yo ɔ gbo.
E nɔ jena mɔtu ɔ, i pee kaa bɔ nɛ a de mi ke ma pee ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ bi mi ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ níhi pee kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke ma ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a, nɛ ma de mɛ ke, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ma ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ nyɛ fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ nɔ ke nyɛ naa he wami kɛ jeɔ ɔ.
We ɔ peeɔ nyɛ fɛu saminya, nɛ nyɛ suɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo kaa nyɛ maa ya lejɛ ɔ. Ma ha nyɛ bimɛ, yi ɔmɛ kɛ nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ si ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ klaate nya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ: nyɛ be nɔ́ ngɔe kɛ ha nyɛ nya nɔ, nɛ nyɛ be ya nɔ ní hu yee.
Nyɛ yi fimi ní ɔmɛ maa fi nyɛ yi; nyɛ tokota amɛ maa hi nyɛ nane; nyɛ be kɔmɔ yee, nɛ nyɛ be ya foe.
Se yayamihi nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ta he lo, nɛ nyɛ ma kɛmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ sibi.
Nɛ imi Ezekiel, ma pee nɔ́ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ; bɔ nɛ i pee ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ maa pee.
Yawɛ ke, ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa lɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.” “Nɛ mo, nɔmlɔ adesa, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ ma kpɔ a he wami ɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a bua jɔmi, a hɛ mi nyami, kɛ afɛu nɔ́, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo ɔ maa laa mɛ ɔ, a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ yi na wami kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami ɔ mi ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, o kɛ nɔ nɛ yi na wami ɔ maa sɛɛ ní.
O maa tu munyu, nɛ o be mumui pee hu.
O ma plɛ pee okadi ha mɛ, konɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
A ma kpata Amon hɛ mi Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Amon bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ ke a ma kpata a hɛ mi.
De Amon bi ɔmɛ ke á bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ tue.
Benɛ a ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ a ha Israel zugba a nɔ je gu, nɛ a nuu Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya a, nyɛ muɔ nɛ nyɛ de ke, ‘Yiɛɛ!’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo nihi nɛ je beleku je ɔ a dɛ mi.
A maa ngɔ nyɛ zugba a kɛ pee a nɔ́.
A ma ba po wehi ngɛ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
A maa ye nyɛ tso yiblii, nɛ a maa nu nyɛ na nyɔ nyu.
Raba ma a ma plɛ pee nga nɔ he nɛ afukpɔngɔhi maa ye ní ngɛ.
Ma ha Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a tsuo ma plɛ pee to lɛmi he.
Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“Bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O fia o dɛ mi, nɛ o si si.
O bui Israel zugba a, ejakaa o ngɛ e he juɛmi yaya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ mo ná; ma ngɔ mo ngɔ ha je ma amɛ nɛ a ha o níhi.
A ma je mo ngɔ hɛ ngɔ fɔ, nɛ o hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ maa je je ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” A ma kpata Moab hɛ mi Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Moab bi ɔmɛ de ke Yuda ngɛ kaa je ma kpa amɛ tsuo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mahi nɛ bɔle Moab zugba a kɛ kpe, nɛ fãã e he ɔ, ma ha nɛ a ma ba tua mɛ, nɛ a maa gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.
A ma tua lejɛ ɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa a hulɔ: Bet Yeshimot, Baal Meon kɛ Kiriataim.
Ma ha nihi nɛ je beleku je ma ba tua Moab, kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ tsuo si kake.
A maa ye Moab nɔ; a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a be e biɛ tete po kaie ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti hu.
Ma gbla Moab tue wawɛɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” A ma kpata Edom hɛ mi Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yi wu tso níhi nɛ Edom pee kɛ to níhi nɛ Yuda pee lɛ ɔ nane mi ɔ hiɛ tsɔ; e he lue nɛ e ye ɔ, e pee tɔmi agbo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke ma gbla Edom tue wawɛɛ; ma kpata nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi babauu maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi kɛ maa je Teman kɛ yaa si Dedan tɔɔ.
Nɛ Edom zugba a ma ba pee ma doku.
Ma ha ye ma Israel hu kɛ Edom maa to ní; nɛ Edom maa na bɔ nɛ ye we abofu nya wa ha ke i ngɛ nɔ́ ko tue gblae ɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
A ma kpata Filistia hɛ mi Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yi wu tso níhi nɛ Filistia bi ɔmɛ pee kɛ to nɔ́ nɛ a blema he nyɛli ɔmɛ pee mɛ ɔ nane mi ɔ nya wa; a kɛ ninyɛ kadikadi kpata a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke, i kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ maa to ní; ma tua mɛ, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; Keret bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ be a he yee.
Ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ma ngɔ abofu kɛ gbla a tue, nɛ a maa nu he.
Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
A ma kpata Tiro hɛ mi Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a se jeha nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ngɛ nyɔhiɔ ko mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ Tiro bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nyae, nɛ a ngɛ dee ngɛ Yerusalem he ji, ‘Yiɛɛ!
A ku Yerusalem ngɔ pue si!
E jua yemi, kɛ ní nɛ e na a tsuo ma ba je wa ngɔ.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji: Tiro, i kɛ mo ná.
Ma ha je mahi babauu ma ba tua mo; a maa ba nɔtonɔto kaa bɔ nɛ wo oslɔkehi kuɔ kɛ baa wo dɔ mi.
A ma kpata o ma a hɛ mi; a maa ku gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ gojogojo ɔmɛ kɛ pue si.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma bɛɛ zu ɔ tsuo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e maa piɛ tɛ sa kpataa kɛkɛ.
Wo hɛli ma ka a yahi ngɛ tɛ sa a nɔ, ngɛ wo ɔ kpɛti he nɛ e maa si ngɛ ɔ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Je ma amɛ ma ba ha ní ngɛ Tiro; nɛ a kɛ a klaate maa gbe nimli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ loko Tiro maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Ma ha Nebukadnezar, Babilonia matsɛ nguaa pe kulaa a ma ba tua Tiro.
E kɛ e tabo babauu nitsɛ, nihi nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ ta zugba lɛhi a mi, kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ nane maa je omleyi je kɛ ba.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ o ma amɛ a mi ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Ma ha o he nyɛlɔ ɔ maa tsua muɔ kɛ bɔle mo; e maa fia kpoku kɛ wo o he, nɛ e kɛ tsɛ̃i maa ma si kaa gbogbo kɛ bɔle mo.
E maa ngɔ e gbogbo kumi ní ɔmɛ kɛ si o gbogbo ɔmɛ, nɛ o mɔ gojogojo ɔmɛ hu, e maa ngɔ e dade ɔmɛ kɛ ku mɛ kɛ pue si.
E we okpɔngɔhi maa hiɛ babauu nɛ a se bunyuku ɔ maa laa o nɔ.
Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, e ní gblami tlɔɔke ɔmɛ, kɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ maa sɛ agbo ɔmɛ a mi gidigidi kaa a sɛɔ ma ko nɛ a ye e nɔ momo mi.
A hoo peemi ɔ ma mimiɛ o gbogbo ɔmɛ tete.
Okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ kɛ a dɛ mi klaate maa wo okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ fo kɛ gu ma a gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be e he yee ngɛ a blɔ mi.
A maa gbe nimli ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ o titima amɛ nɛ a he wa a maa nɔɔ si.
O he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma kpɔ ní nɛ o ná a ngɛ o dɛ, nɛ a maa ha o guɛ ní.
A maa ku o gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ, o we saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ.
A maa muɔ tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tso ɔmɛ, kɛ zu ɔ tsuo kɛ ya pue wo mi.
Ma ha o la amɛ a se maa po; a be o saku ɔmɛ a he nue hu.
Ma pee mo tɛ sa kpataa, he nɛ wo hɛli ma ka a yahi ngɛ.
A be mo dlae kɛ pee ma hu.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Tiro ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Benɛ a ngɛ o hɛ mi kpatae, nɛ ngmlaa ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nya jee ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ, a he maa do blibliibli.
Ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ ma kple si kɛ je a sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ma kpa a he bo ngɔ fɔ si; nɛ a ma je a tade ɔmɛ nɛ a lo ní ngɔ wo a mi ɔ ngɛ a he.
A maa hi si ngɛ zugba, nɛ a he maa do blibliibli.
Gbeye ma ha a he maa hi doe blibliibli be ɔ tsuo ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba o nɔ ɔ he.
A ma la mɔbɔ la kɛ nyɛ ya ha mo kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Mo ma nɛ o he biɛ kaa wo nya ma nɛ he wa, a kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ je wo ɔ nɔ!
Jinɛ o kɛ o mi bi nyɛ he ngɛ gbeye ngɛ wo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nyɛ haa sawale nuu wo nya ma amɛ tsuo!
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, ma amɛ a he maa do blibliibli kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a kpata o hɛ mi!
Niinɛ, wo nya ma amɛ tsuo a tsui maa po kaa a kpata o hɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ!” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha o ní maa pee mɔbɔ kaa ma doku nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi.
O ma mu kɛ ya wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
O ma kple si kɛ ya su gbeje nitsɛ, he nɛ blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a be je mi hu ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ o kɛ mɛ maa hi ngɛ blema níhi nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ a mi ngɛ je ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o be nyɛe maa pee ma nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa maa hi mi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi hu!
Ma ha o nyagbe maa pee gbeye; o be je mi hie hu.
Ke a bi o si ɔ, a be mo nae; o maa laa gbidii kɛ yaa neneene.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
La ko nɛ a kɛ nyɛ ya ha Tiro Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, la mɔbɔ la kɛ nyɛ ya ha Tiro ma a. Tiro ji wo nya ma nguaa, nɛ e kɛ je mahi tsuo yeɔ jua kɛ yaa wo se tsitsaa.
De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ lɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Tiro ma, o wo o he nɔ, nɛ o fĩa ke, ‘Ye he ngɛ fɛu kɛ pi si.’ Niinɛ, wo ɔ kpɛti tɔɔ o huzu nya ya su.
Nihi nɛ po mo kɛ ma si kaa ma a, pee mo kɛ o he fɛu kaa pa nɔ lɛ saminyayoo.
Lɛ ɔ nitsɛ tsuo ɔ, Hermon yo ɔ nɔ sɛsɛo tso sɔuu a kɛ kpɛ.
O mi abalaa tso ɔmɛ ɔ, seda tso nɛ je Lebanon a kɛ pee mɛ.
Akɔfa amɛ lɛɛ, Bashan tso nguaa amɛ a kɛ hlɔ mɛ.
Lɛ nɔ tsu bi ɔ, nga nɔ tso tlɔmɔɔ nɛ je Kipro a kɛ pee lɛ.
A topɛ́ tso ɔ mi, nɛ a wo mi suɔ wu.
Kploba a kɛ pee o mi abalaa amɛ, kploba nɛ a lo ní wo mi saminyayoo kɛ je Egipt.
A yoɔ abalaa amɛ ngɛ se lokoo.
Nɔ́ nɛ ha lɛ ɔ yi mi ɔ, bo bluu, kɛ bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su a kɛ pee.
A kɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo je Kipro zugba nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Sidon bi, kɛ Arvad bi ji o lɛ hluili; mo Tiro nitsɛ o mi bi nɛ le ga saminya ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kudɔɔ o lɛ ɔmɛ.
Ma nimeli, kɛ tso ga ní tsuli nɛ ba kpɛ o lɛ ɔ mɛ ɔ, a je blɔ tsɔse mɛ.
Mɛ tsuo ɔ, Biblos a je.
Akua hluili babauu baa kɛ a lɛhi tsuo, nɛ a kɛ mo ba yeɔ jua.
“Ta buli nɛ je Persia, Lidia, kɛ Libia hu ba piɛ o ta buli ɔmɛ a he.
A kɛ a tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ, kɛ dade pɛɛ ɔmɛ ha nɛ o ye kunimi.
Ta buli nɛ je Arvad bu o gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe, nɛ Gamad bi hu bu o mɔ ɔmɛ a he.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ kɛ kpla o gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe.
Mɛ lɛ a ha o he pee fɛu kɛ pi si ɔ nɛ.
“Spania kɛ mo ye jua, ejakaa o ngɛ guɛ ní babauu, nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ, dade, sanylaa, kɛ sumui ba tsakee o guɛ ní ɔmɛ.
O kɛ Hela, Tubal, kɛ Meshek hu ye jua.
A ngɔɔ nɔmlɔ adesa po, akɔblee níhi, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ teji okpɔngɔhi kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní ɔmɛ.
Nihi nɛ je Bet Togarma kɛ okpɔngɔhi, ta okpɔngɔhi, kɛ teji okpɔngɔhi ba tsakee o guɛ ní.
Rodo bi hu kɛ mo ye jua.
A ngɔɔ suɔ wu, kɛ tɛ tso kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní.
Siria bi hu ba heɔ o guɛ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ.
A ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba woɔ o guɛ ní ɔmɛ a he hiɔ: tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ hɛɛ ba mumu su, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, bo nɛ a lo ní kɛ wo mi, kploba kpakpa, tenglɛnglɛ, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ kpɛɔ kaa ahuhuɛ.
Yuda kɛ Israel zugba amɛ hu kɛ mo ye jua.
Ke a ba he ní ɔ, níhi nɛ a kɛ woɔ hiɔ ji ngma, hwo, oliv nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via.
-Nihi je Damasko ba he o guɛ ní, kɛ o nine nya níhi nɛ o pee.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ wai nɛ a na kɛ je Helbon, kɛ kuutu nɛ je Sahar kɛ woɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he hiɔ.
A ngɔɔ dade níhi, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní.
Dedan bi ɔmɛ hu kɛ mo ye jua; a ngɔɔ okpɔngɔ nɔ himi bo kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní.
Arabia bi kɛ Kedar ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo o kɛ mɛ ye jua; mɛɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ woɔ hiɔ ji agbosuhi, jijɔhi, kɛ akpakpohi.
Sheba kɛ Raama bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní ɔmɛ ji juetli, sika tsu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kpakpa.
Haran, Kane, kɛ Eden ma amɛ, kɛ jehanɛ jua yeli nɛ je Sheba, Asur kɛ Kilmad ma amɛ a mi ɔ, mɛ tsuo a kɛ mo ye jua.
A juaa a bo kpakpahi, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ bo nɛ a lo ní kɛ wo mi.
A juaa bo nɛ a kɛ haa zugba, kɛ tangme kpa kpakpahi hulɔ.
O guɛ ní hyiɔ lɛ agbohi babauu.
O pee kaa lɛ ngɛ wo nɔ, lɛ nɛ a wo lɛ tlomi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Benɛ lɛ hluili ɔmɛ kɛ mo ya su wo ɔ nɔ tsitsaa a, wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ ba na mo, nɛ e kpata o hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Tlukaa a, ligbi kake too ɔ, o hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ní babauu nɛ o na a tsuo hɛ mi kpata: guɛ ní wawi, kɛ nguangua amɛ tsuo laa.
Jã kɛ̃ nɛ o lɛ mi bi, kɛ kudɔɔ nuli, nihi nɛ tsiɔ lɛ ɔ mi puɔhi, o jua yeli, kɛ o ta buli tsuo, nimli babauu nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ, mɛ tsuo a mu ngɛ wo ɔ kpɛti; a ya su wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
O lɛ kudɔɔ nuli ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ; a nu ngmlaa a he ngɛ wo ɔ nya tsuo.
“Lɛ hluili ɔmɛ tsuo je a lɛ ɔmɛ a mi: lɛ ɔmɛ a mi bi tsuo ba kpo nɔ.
Mɛ tsuo a ngɛ ya foe wawɛɛ ha mo; a ngɔ zu kɛ pue a yi mi, nɛ a ngɛ si wuwluae ngɛ la zu mi.
A sɛ a yi kpalokpalo; a ha kpekpe ya bo kɛ ngɛ aywilɛho yee; a ngɛ ya nyɛe wawɛɛ ha mo.
A la hɛdo la ko kɛ nyɛ ya ha mo: ‘Tiro nɛ e nɔ jɔ ngɛ wo kpɛti kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ he a kɛ lɛ maa to?
Benɛ o guɛ ní ɔmɛ yaa ma se tsitsaa a, o haa ma amɛ tɔɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi.
Matsɛmɛ ná a he kɛ je o ní nami ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ o hɛ mi kpata ngɛ wo ɔ mi, o mu kɛ ho wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ ya.
O kɛ o lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ o guɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo mu kɛ ho nyu ɔ sisi ya.’ “Bɔ nɛ o nyagbe ba ji nɛ ɔ?
E pee nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ nyakpɛ; a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ po ye gbeye, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa.
Sawale nu jua yeli nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ tsuo; a ngɛ gbeye yee kaa mɛ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata ja nɔuu; o laa kɛ yaa neneene.”
A ma kpata Tiro hɛ mi Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Tiro ganɔ ɔ ke, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ lɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O wo o he nɔ gojoo ke mawu ji mo.
O hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ nɔ; nɛ wo bɔle mo.
Mo nɔmlɔ adesa a, o pee o he kaa mawu ko ji mo.
O susu kaa o le ní pe Daniel, nɛ laami sane ko kulaa be nɛ a kɛ laa mo.
O nile, kɛ o nɔ́ sisi numi ha nɛ o ná ní kpɔtɔɔ: o bua sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ babauu nya kɛ to.
O ngɛ jua yemi he juɛmi saminya, nɛ o ná ní babauu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o wo o he nɔ gojoo ke niatsɛ ji mo!
“Bu tue, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, akɛnɛ o wo o he nɔ gojoo, nɛ o susu kaa o le ní kaa Mawu he je ɔ, ma ha nibwɔhi yiwutsotsɛmɛ kpanakuhi maa je je ma amɛ a mi ma ba tua mo.
Afɛu ní babauu nɛ o gu o nile, kɛ o ga a nɔ kɛ ná a tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata.
A maa gbe mo, nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ gbeje ngɛ wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
Ke e ba mi ja a, anɛ o ma nyɛ ma de ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mo gbee ɔ a hɛ mi ke mawu ji mo lo?
O maa le kaa nɔmlɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji mo.
Nibwɔhi nɛ li imi Mawu ɔ ma kpata o hɛ mi; a maa gbe mo kaa a gbeɔ gbe.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Tiro matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kpata Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, la hɛdo la ko kɛ nyɛ ya ha Tiro matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ɔ he.
De lɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ: Be ko nɛ be ɔ, ke a ke nɔ ko hi kɛ pi si ɔ, lɛɛ mo ji nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́; o nile mi kuɔ, nɛ o he ngɛ fɛu saminya!
Eden, Mawu ngmɔ ɔ nitsɛ mi nɛ o hi.
Tɛ kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo o kɛ dla o he: rubi, daimond, topaz, beril, kanelian, yaspi, safiro, emerald, kɛ garnet.
O ngɛ sika tsu he dlami níhi, kɛ heha ní babauu.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ a bɔ mo ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu lɛ a dla mo saminyayoo jã.
I ngɔ Mawu bɔfo ko nɛ he ngɛ gbeye kɛ to lejɛ ɔ, konɛ e bu o he.
O hi ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ; o slaa si ngɛ tɛhi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam ɔ a kpɛti.
Kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ mo ɔ, o ba o je mi pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a nɛ́ tɔmi ko kulaa ngɛ o he kɛ ya su be ko, kɛkɛ nɛ o bɔni yayami peemi.
Be nɛ jua yemi ba ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ, amimi yemi hu ba hyi o mi tɔ, nɛ o pee yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ha o je ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ; nɛ Mawu bɔfo nɛ bu o he ɔ fie mo kɛ je tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kɛ la nylamnylam ɔ a kpɛti.
O he fɛu ɔ he ɔ, o wo o he nɔ gojoo, nɛ o je kuasia.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i tsɛ̃ mo ngɔ fia si ngɛ zugba bum.
Bɔ nɛ o nyagbe ba ha nɛ ɔ maa pee kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ ha matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
O pee yayami babauu ngɛ o jua yemi ɔ mi, nɛ o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble hehi nɛ o ya jaa Mawu ngɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i mɛ o he la, nɛ i sã mo pioo, nɛ o pee la zu ngɛ nihi tsuo a hɛ mi.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o be hu; o laa gbidii.
Je mahi tsuo nɛ le mo ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ sawale nu mɛ.
A ngɛ gbeye yee kaa mɛ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata ja nɔuu.” A ma kpata Sidon ma a hɛ mi Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Sidon ma a, nɛ o gba kɛ si mɛ.
De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ke i kɛ mɛ ná.
Je ma amɛ maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma pee Sidon ma a he.
Ma gbla Sidon tue, konɛ a na bɔ nɛ i ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Ma ha gbenɔ hiɔ ma ba sɛ ma a mi; a maa ye awi ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ma ba sa ma a yi, nɛ a kɛ klaate maa gbe ma a mi bi ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” A maa gbaa Israel Yawɛ ke, “Je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle Israel kɛ kpe nɛ a pue e hɛ mi si ɔ, ekoeko be e he pee kaa mio, loo mio tso kɛ plaa Israel hu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma kpale ye ma Israel kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti he nɛ i gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa a, nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa le kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi.
Israel ma a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha ye tsɔlɔ Yakob ɔ nɔ.
A maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi.
A maa ma tsuhi, nɛ a ma hu wai ngmɔhi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ pue Israel hɛ mi si ɔ, ma gbla a tue, nɛ Israel ma na he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi kulaa.
Lɔ ɔ loko a ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.”
A maa gbla Egipt tue Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngmane ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Egipt matsɛ ɔ, nɛ o de lɛ ke a maa gbla e kɛ e ma a tsuo a tue.
De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Mo wo mi lohwe gbeyegbeye, i kɛ mo ná.
O ke Nilo pa a o nɔ, nɛ mo lɛ o pee.
Ma wo o nya mi gbowe, nɛ e maa la o tsitsa; kɛkɛ ɔ, lo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ pa a mi maa mɛtɛ o he toto ɔmɛ a he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma gbla mo kɛ je Nilo pa a mi, kɛ lo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ mɛtɛ o he ɔ. Ma sake mo, kɛ lo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ nga a nɔ.
O ma ya nɔ si, nɛ o ma gbo kɛ fɔ lejɛ ɔ.
A be mo pue; ma ha lohwe awi yeli, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ mohu maa ye mo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Egipt ma a tsuo maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Yawɛ ke, “Egipt ngɛ kaa gla nɛ Israel kɛ pee dɛma tso.
Benɛ a pɛtɛ he ɔ, e ku, nɛ e plaa a konɔ tsuo.
A ke a ma kpasa lɛ ɔ, e ku nɛ e ha a nanehi hluã.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ke imi nitsɛ ma ha ta ma ba tua ma a.
A maa gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ; a ma kpata lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be Egipt zugba a nɔ hie hu; zugba a maa pee ma doku nɛ e maa fɔ si gu.
Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“Akɛnɛ o ke Nilo pa a o nɔ́, nɛ́ mo nitsɛ lɛ o pee he je ɔ, i kɛ mo ná, nɛ i kɛ o Nilo pa a hu ná.
Ma ha Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ maa je gu; e maa pee ma dokuhi sɔuu kɛ je Migdol ngɛ omleyi je kɛ yaa su Aswan ngɛ leneyi je, hluu kɛ ma ya su Sudan bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya tɔɔ.
Nane ko nane ko be zugba a nɔ nyɛɛe hu, nɔmlɔ nɔ́ jio, lohwe nɔ́ jio.
Lejɛ ɔ maa fɔ si gu jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
Ma ha Egipt zugba a nɔ maa pee sakosako pe kulaa ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Ma ha Egipt ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
Ma doku ko ma doku ko kɛ mɛ be sɔe.
Ma fie Egipt bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ kɛ ya zugba kpahi a nɔ kɛ ya futu je ma kpahi.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ se ɔ, ma bua Egipt bi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti he nɛ i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa a. Ma ha a ma ba hi a hi he momo ɔ ngɛ Egipt leneyi je.
A ma ba to nɔ yemi ko nɛ he wɛ kulaa sisi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E maa pee nɔ yemi nɛ he wɛ pe kulaa.
Ma pee mɛ ma wayoo, bɔ nɛ a be nyɛe maa ye je ma amɛ ekoeko nɔ hu.
Ke e ba mi ja a, e be ma nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ pee hu.
Ejakaa a ma kai kaa e ji tɔmi agbo kaa Israel ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ Egipt nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel maa le kaa imi ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ.” Matsɛ Nebukadnezar maa ngɔ Egipt zugba a Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaagone ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, Nebukadnezar, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ya tua Tiro.
E ha e ta buli tsu ní kpakpataa ngɛ ta nɛ e kɛ Tiro ngɛ hwue ɔ he: a tloo tlomi nɛ jiɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ yi mi kpa, nɛ e konɔ kpɔ.
Se matsɛ ɔ kɛ e tabo ɔ na we se ko kɛ ji dengme nɛ a gbo ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, i ngɔ Egipt zugba a kɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar dɛ mi woe.
E maa ha ní, nɛ e maa ngɔ ní babauu nɛ Egipt ngɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ho; nɛ ní ɔmɛ maa pee e ta buli ɔmɛ a hiɔwo.
I ngɔ Egipt zugba a kɛ ha lɛ kaa e hiɔwo; ejakaa imi lɛ e tabo ɔ tsu ní ɔ kɛ ha.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ha Israel ma na he wami he, nɛ ma ha Ezekiel maa tu munyu wawɛɛ ngɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi, konɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Yawɛ maa gbla Egipt tue Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa nɛ o ha nɛ a le nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ. Wo yana nɛ o de ke, Ligbi yaya!
Ligbi yaya ko ma!
Ligbi ɔ su ta.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma tsu nyakpɛ ní ɔ maa pee aywilɛho, kɛ amanehlu be nitsɛ kɛ ha ma amɛ.
A maa hwu ta ngɛ Egipt; nɛ Sudan maa hao wawɛɛ.
A maa gbe nihi babauu ngɛ Egipt; a maa muɔ e juetli kɛ je; nɛ ma a maa pee ma doku posoposo.
“Gbaa ke ta buli nɛ a bɔ mɛ apaa kɛ je Sudan, Lidia, Libia, Arabia, kɛ Kub ɔ, a ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ imi nitsɛ ye ni ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu maa nɔ ngɛ ta a mi.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Mahi nɛ piɛɔ Egipt he kɛ je Migdol ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya su Aswan ngɛ leneyi je ɔ, a mi bi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ ta a mi.
Tabo ɔ nɛ Egipt kɛ fĩaa a hɛ mi ma kpata kulaa.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
E zugba a maa pee pasaa kulaa ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ e ma amɛ ma plɛ pee ma dokuhi.
Ke i mɛ Egipt he la, nɛ i kpata e he piɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, kɛkɛ a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“Ke be ɔ nɛ ma kpata Egipt hɛ mi ɔ su ɔ, ma tsɔ nihi nɛ a he sɔɔ kɛ gu wo ɔ nɔ kɛ ya wo Sudan bi ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ ɔ he gbeye, konɛ sawale nɛ nu mɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ su ta!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha Nebukadnezar, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba muɔ Egipt ma a tsuo kɛ ho.
E kɛ e tabo yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma ba kpata zugba a hɛ mi.
A kɛ klaate ma ba tua Egipt.
Zugba a nɔ ma hyi tɔ kɛ ni gbogboehi.
Ma ha Nilo pa a maa mii.
Ma jua Egipt zugba a tsuo kɛ ha yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Ma ha nibwɔhi ma kpata zugba a, kɛ e nɔ bi tsuo a hɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ma kpata wɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ amaga amɛ nɛ ngɛ Memfis ɔ a hɛ mi.
Ganɔ ko be Egipt zugba a nɔ yee hu; lejɛ ɔ maa pee gbeye.
Ma ha nɛ sawale maa nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Ma ha Egipt leneyi je maa pee ma doku pasaa; nɛ Zoan nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ, ma mɛ he la.
Ma gbla Tebes ma a tue.
Pelusium, Egipt ma a nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ hu, ye mi mi maa wo la kɛ wo e he.
Ma kpata Tebes ma a tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ma mɛ Egipt he la, nɛ Pelusium maa hao wawɛɛ.
Ma ku Tebes gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ pue si, nɛ ma a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ nyu.
Heliopolis, kɛ Bubastis ma amɛ a mi nihewi ma gbo ngɛ ta mi, nɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ lɛɛ a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ.
Ma kpɔ Egipt he wami ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e he nɔ womi babauu ɔ se maa po; jamɛ a be ɔ, diblii maa wo ngɛ Tafanes piani katakata.
Amanehlu maa pee kaa bɔku nɛ ha Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ a maa nuu e ma amɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ.
Ke i gbla Egipt tue wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Egipt matsɛ ɔ he wami ɔ ta Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi kpaagone ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, i ku Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɔni.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko to we nɔ tsopa; a fi we hulɔ, konɛ e kɔni ɔ nɛ tsa, nɛ́ e na he wami nɛ e kɛ pɛtɛ klaate he ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, i kɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ná.
Ma kplɔ e kɔni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ma ku kake ɔ kɛ piɛ nɔ́ nɛ ku momo ɔ he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e klaate ɔ maa je e dɛ kɛ nɔ si.
Ma gbɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi klaate, konɛ e na he wami ekohu.
Se Egipt matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, ma kplɔ e kɔni ɔmɛ ngɛ e he.
E ma kɛmɛ ngɛ e he nyɛlɔ ɔ hɛ mi; nyagbe ɔ, e ma gbo.
Ee, Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɔnihi ma kplɔ ngɛ e he; se Babilonia matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, ma wo lɛ he wami.
Ke i wo e dɛ mi klaate, nɛ e wo nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ Egipt blɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ná maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Ma gbɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ kɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma ná maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Egipt ngɛ kaa seda tso Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ we nyɔhiɔ etɛ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke: O he wa saminya!
Mɛni he po ma ngɔ mo kɛ to?
O ngɛ kaa seda tso ko nɛ bɔ kusuu ngɛ Lebanon, e kɔni saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ pee hɔ; e ka gagaa kɛ su bɔku mi tɔɔ.
Nyu babaaba ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ zugba a mi tsuo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e na niye ní bɔ nɛ sa.
Nyu ɔ ha tso kpa amɛ tsuo bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E na nyu babaaba, nɛ e bɔ saminya.
E ka gagaa, nɛ e nɔ kuɔ gojoo pe tso kpa amɛ tsuo.
E gba kɔnihi kusuu; a ti, nɛ a ka gagaaga.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔto ya pee a tsuhi ngɛ e kɔni nguangua amɛ a nɔ.
Nga mi lohwehi tsuo ya fɔ a bimɛ ngɛ e kɔni wawi ɔmɛ a sisi, nɛ je ma nguanguahi tsuo ya hii si ngɛ e sisi hɔ̃ ɔ mi.
E he pee fɛu; e nɔ kuɔ gojoo, kɛ e kɔnihi gagaaga; ejakaa e sipoku na nyu babaaba kɛ je zu mi.
Mawu ngmɔ ɔ mi seda tso ɔmɛ po a he fɛu kɛ lɛ sɔɛ.
Sɛsɛo ɔmɛ kɛ a kɔni nguangua amɛ hu kɛ lɛ sɔɛ.
Papao ɔmɛ kɛ a kɔni wawi ɔmɛ na we lɛ kulaa.
Niinɛ, e he fɛu ɔ nɔ be.
Tso ko tso ko be Mawu ngmɔ ɔ mi nɛ a kɛ maa to e he.
I ha nɛ e pee fɛu saminya kɛ e kɔnihi babauu.
Tsohi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Mawu ngmɔ ɔ mi ngɛ Eden ɔ, a hɛ kɔ e nɔ.
“Jehanɛ lɛɛ, jamɛ a tso ɔ nɛ bɔ kusuu, nɛ e nɔ kuɔ gojoo kɛ su bɔku mi tɔɔ ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ.
Akɛnɛ e nɔ kuɔ gojoo he je ɔ, e wo e he nɔ nɛ e fĩa; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kua lɛ.
Ma ha nubwɔ ko nine maa su e nɔ.
E kɛ lɛ maa ye sisiisi; e maa pee lɛ bɔ nɛ sa lɛ ngɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ e pee ɔ a he.
Nibwɔhi nɛ ji je ma amɛ a kpɛti yiwutsotsɛmɛ pe kulaa maa hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ a maa je e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E kɔni wawi ɔmɛ ma ya pue yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi; nɛ e kɔni agbo ɔmɛ maa ku kɛ pue nyu dɔ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Je ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ e hɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ maa je.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ma ba ma tso nɛ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ si ɔ nɔ, nɛ pu mi lohwehi ma ba hi e kɔni ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, tso nɛ naa nyu saminya a ekoeko be kae kɛ ya hiɔwe ja hu, loo kaa e ma ha e yi mi ma ya su bɔku mi ploplooplo kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Mɛ tsuo a ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa gboɔ ɔ. Mɛ tsuo a ma ya piɛ nihi nɛ ho gbeje ya a a he.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji, “Ligbi ɔ nɛ tso ɔ ma ya su gbeje ɔ, ma ha pahi nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ maa ha e nɔ; a maa pee ja kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ ya nyɛe ha lɛ.
Ma tsi pa amɛ a nya nɛ a ko be hu, nɛ pa wawi, kɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ maa ta.
Akɛnɛ tso ɔ gbo he je ɔ, ma ha diblii maa wo ngɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; pu mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo ma ngla.
Ma ha e maa nɔ si haa bum kɛ maa ya gbeje; nɛ je ma amɛ ma mimiɛ, ke a nu e si nɔmi ɔ. Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ Lebanon tsohi nɛ a je blɔ ha mɛ nyu saminya, nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ho gbeje ya momo ɔ, a bua maa jɔ wawɛɛ kaa tso nɛ ɔ nɔ si.
A ma kpaka lɛ kɛ ho gbeje ya, konɛ e ya piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ momo ɔ a he.
Nɛ mahi tsuo nɛ hi e hɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ maa gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
“Tso nɛ ɔ daa si ha Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo.
Tsohi nɛ ngɛ Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi po ka we, nɛ a he hu pee we fɛu kaa tso nɛ ɔ.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ ya su gbeje ɔ, lɛ hu e maa ya lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma ya piɛ nihi nɛ a pui mɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a he.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Egipt matsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nyaka Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
E de ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, la hɛdo la nɛ o kɛ bɔ Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɔkɔ.
Ngɔɔ ye sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha lɛ: O peeɔ o níhi kaa nɔ́ nɛ jata ji mo ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti; se o ngɛ kaa nyaka nɛ ngɛ pa gudue mohu.
O tuɔ kɛ sɛɛ o pa amɛ a mi tsulaoo; o kɛ o nane gbidii nyu ɔ kɛ puɛɔ pa amɛ.
Ke je ma amɛ ba bua a he nya babauu ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma fɔ ye ya a kɛ pue o nɔ; e maa du mo, nɛ je ma amɛ maa gbla mo kɛ ba kpo.
Ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ zugba; nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ nga mi lohwehi tsuo ma ba ye mo.
Ma sake o gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ pue yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
O muɔ ma pue si ngɛ zugba kɛ maa su benɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo ma pee kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ ma hyi kɛ o muɔ.
Benɛ ma kpata o hɛ mi ɔ, ma tsi hiɔwe hɛ mi; dodoe ɔmɛ maa laa.
Pu maa laa e hɛ mi ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a se; nɛ nyɔhiɔ be kpɛe hu.
Ma ha pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo maa laa, nɛ diblii maa wo ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Je mahi babauu, ngɛ zugbahi a nɔ he nɛ o li tete po, ke a nu bɔ nɛ i kpata o hɛ mi ɔ, a maa ye tsui.
Nɔ́ nɛ ma pee mo ɔ ma ha je mahi babauu a he mi maa po, nɛ sawale maa nu a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ wawɛɛ.
Bɔ nɛ ma fɔ ye klaate ɔ yami kɛ bami ngɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ o maa nɔ si ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a he maa do blibliibli, kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ mɛ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata lo?” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ kɛ mo maa hwu ta.
Ma ha o tabo kpekpemi ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ katsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa a klaate nya.
O kɛ o ma a, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔɔ nɔ ɔ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Ma gbe o lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ pa amɛ a tue, nɛ nane ko nane ko be pa a gbidie hu; nɔmlɔ jio, lohwe jio.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha o nyu ɔ hɛ mi ma tsɔ, nɛ pa amɛ maa be kaa nu.
Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Ke i kpata Egipt ma a, kɛ e mi níhi, kɛ nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a hɛ mi kikɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Kɔkɔ nɛ a ngɛ mo bɔe nɛ ɔ ma ba pee kɔmɔ yemi la nɛ a ma la.
Yihi nɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi ma la la nɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ ya ha Egipt kɛ Egipt bi tsuo.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Gbeje Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ye kɔmɔ ha Egipt ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo.
Ngɔɔ a kɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ kɛ ya zugba a sisi tɔɔ kɛ ya piɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ gbeje ɔ a he.
De mɛ ke, “Pe nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ he ngɛ fɛu pe nihi tsuo lo?
Nyɛ ma ba be kɛ ho gbeje ya, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ma ya hi lejɛ ɔ.
“Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a nyagbe maa ba si kake.
