Ta ma ba kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Katsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ Egipt tabo ɔ he kɛ hwu ta a ma he Egipt bi ɔmɛ atuu kɛ ngmlaa ngɛ gbeje ke, ‘Nihi nɛ li Mawu, nɛ a nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ ba su hiɛ ɔ. Mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ “Asiria ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e ta buli nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ hu ngɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi; a bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Yɔkɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeje muɔ ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
E ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo nɔ ngɛ ta mi; nɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ bɔle e nɔ́ ɔ.
Se be ko nɛ be ɔ, mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ wo nihi a he gbeye wawɛɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi.
“Elam ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; e ta buli kpekpemi ɔ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta a mi ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ hu ngɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi; a bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Nihi nɛ gbo ngɛ ta mi nɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ho gbeje ya kɛ mɔmlɔtɔ.
Benɛ a ngɛ wami mi ɔ, a wo nihi a he gbeye wawɛɛ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a gbo kɛ fɔɔ si kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ.
Elam hwɔɔ si kɛ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a he.
E ta buli kpekpemi ɔ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ngɛ ta mi nɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ji mɛ.
Benɛ a ngɛ wami mi ɔ, a wo nihi a he gbeye wawɛɛ; se jehanɛ lɛɛ a gbo kɛ fɔɔ si kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ.
“Meshek kɛ Tubal tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ta buli ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe.
Mɛ tsuo mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ji mɛ; a gbe mɛ ngɛ ta mi.
Be ko ɔ, a wo je ɔ he gbeye wawɛɛ.
A pu we mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a puɔ katsɛmɛ blema a. Blema a, a puɔ katsɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ mia e ta hwumi ní kɛ yaa gbeje: a ngɔɔ e klaate kɛ hɔɔ e yi sisi, nɛ a kɛ e tsɛ̃i haa e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.
Katsɛmɛ nɛ a wo a hɛ mi nyami kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji nihi nɛ a he sawale nuɔ je ɔ nɛ.
“Kikɛ nɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ a maa ku Egipt bi ɔmɛ a mi kɛ pue mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a nɔ.
“Edom kɛ e matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Be ko ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ; se jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ gbeje, nɛ a kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ tsuo ngɛ he kake.
“Omleyi je ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Sidon bi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Be ko ɔ, a he wami ɔ haa sawale nuɔ je ɔ tsuo; se jehanɛ lɛɛ a kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, zo gbe mɛ tsuo kpɔtɔɔ.
Mɛ tsuo mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a ya su gbeje muɔ voo ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
“Ke Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɛ e tabo ɔ na nihi babauu nɛ a gbe ngɛ ta a mi nɛ ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Imi nitsɛ lɛ i ha Egipt matsɛ ɔ hao je ɔ nɛ; se lɛ nitsɛ kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ a maa pu mɛ, kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe ngɛ ta a mi ɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Mawu pee Ezekiel bulɔ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ke i ha ta ba zugba ko nɔ ɔ. Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ maa hla a kpɛti nɔ kake kaa a ma a he bulɔ.
Ke e na he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a ma a, e ma kpa titimati kɛ wo ma a tue nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu bɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ e be bue ɔ, ke he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba gbe lɛ ɔ, e gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.
Ejakaa e nu titimati ɔ pɛmi, se e bui.
E bu tue jinɛ e ko he lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami.
Jehanɛ hu, ke bulɔ ɔ na he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a ma, nɛ e kpa we titimati kɛ wo ma a tue nɔ ɔ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba gbe yayami peeli ɔmɛ lɛɛ, se ma bi a muɔ si ngɛ bulɔ ɔ dɛ.
“Nɔmlɔ adesa, jehanɛ bu tue, ma pee mo Israel ma a he bulɔ.
Munyuhi nɛ ma tu kɛ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, de mɛ lɛ tsuo.
Ke i de ke yayami peelɔ ko ma gbo ngɛ e yayami nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ he, se o bɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔ, konɛ e tsake kɛ je e blɔ yayami ɔ nɔ nɛ e yi nɛ na wami ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he lɛɛ, se ma bi e muɔ si ngɛ o dɛ.
Ke o bɔ yayami peelɔ kɔkɔ, se e tsakee we e tsui nɛ e kpa yayami nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔ he, se moo lɛɛ o maa ye o he.” Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu e ní tsumi he akɔtaa Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ dee ji, ‘Wa tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ pee tlomi ngɛ wa nɔ, nɛ e ha wa ngɛ he lo tae.
Kɛ wa maa pee kɛ hi je mi kɛɛ?’ De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke i na we yayami peelɔ gbenɔ he bua jɔmi, se mohu i suɔ kaa e kpa yayami peemi, konɛ e yi nɛ na wami.
Israel, nyɛ kpa yayami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ. Mɛni he je nyɛ suɔ mohu kaa nyɛ ma gbo ɔ?
“Nɔmlɔ adesa, jehanɛ de Israel ma a ke, ke dalɔ pee yayami ɔ, kpakpa nɛ e pee be ko ɔ be nyɛe ma he e yi wami.
Ke yayami peelɔ kpa yayami peemi ɔ, a be e tue gblae; nɛ ke dalɔ bɔni yayami peemi ɔ, a be e yi wami hee.
Ke i de dalɔ ko ke bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e yi ma na wami, kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔni kpakpa nɛ e pee be ko ɔ he susumi kaa e hiɛ babauu, nɛ jehanɛ e bɔni yayami peemi ɔ, i be kpakpa nɛ e pee be ko ɔ kaie.
Yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he e ma gbo ngɛ.
Ke i bɔ yayami peelɔ kɔkɔ kaa e ma gbo, kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e bɔni nɔ́ nɛ da peemi kɛ dami sane yemi ɔ, e be gboe; e yi ma na wami.
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ ba to awaba ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ya ha nɔtsɛ; aloo nɔ́ ko nɛ e ya ju ɔ, e kpale ya ha nɔtsɛ.
Ke e kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e bɔni mlaahi nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ a nɔ yemi ɔ, e be gboe; e yi ma na wami.
Yayami nɛ e pee ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ pa lɛ, nɛ e yi ma na wami; ejakaa e pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e ye dami sane.
“Se o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ i peeɔ ɔ dɛ!
Dɛbi, mɛ mohu lɛ a ní peepee ɔmɛ dɛ!
Ke dalɔ kpale kɛ je e dami blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e pee yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ he e ma gbo ngɛ.
Ke yayami peelɔ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e ye dami sane ɔ, e he e yi wami.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Israel ma, nyɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ i peeɔ ɔ dɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔ ma da kɛ kojo lɛ.” A ywia Yerusalem ma a Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngmane ɔ we ligbi enuɔne ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ tu fo kɛ je Yerusalem, ba bɔ mi amaniɛ ke he nyɛli ba ywia Yerusalem ma a. Gbɔkuɛ ɔ nɛ e nɔ jena mɔtu loko amaniɛ bɔlɔ ɔ ba a, Yawɛ he wami ɔ ma ye nya.
Se mɔtu maa pee benɛ e ba a, Yawɛ bli ye nya momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i nyɛ tu munyu.
Ma a pee yayamihi babauu Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nihi nɛ ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ deɔ mi ke, ‘Abraham ɔ nɛ a ngɔ zugba a tsuo ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, nɔ kake too ji lɛ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he hiɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zugba a, wɔ a kɛ ha kaa wa weto ní.’ “De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji, nyɛ yeɔ lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi.
Nyɛ jaa amagahi.
Nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si.
Mɛni ha nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ nɔ ji zugba a?
Nyɛ hiaa klaate kɛ woɔ nyɛ sibi a he.
Nyɛ tsuɔ níhi nɛ a hiee babauu; nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ puɛɔ gba.
Mɛni kulaa lɛ haa nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ nɔ́ ji zugba a?
“De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, nga mi lohwe awi yeli maa ye mɛ.
Nɛ nihi nɛ ya laa a he ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ tɛ muɔhi a mi ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe mɛ.
Ma ha zugba a nɔ tsuo maa pee pasaa kulaa, kɛkɛ ɔ, zugba a mi he wami nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ ɔ se maa po.
Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ maa je gu; lejɛ ɔmɛ maa pee gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔmɛ gue hu.
Ke i pee zugba a tsuo pasaa nɛ e pee ma doku ngɛ yayamihi babauu nɛ a pee ɔ a he ɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Nɔ́ nɛ ba ngɛ gbalɔ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ se Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ke o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ba kpe ngɛ ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ a he, loo a we agbo ɔmɛ a nya a, o he munyu sɔuu lɛ a hii tue.
Bɔ nɛ a deɔ a sibi ji, ‘Nyɛɛ ba nɛ wa ya bu munyu nɛ kpale je Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ba amlɔ nɛ ɔ tue.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye ma a baa o ngɔ, nɛ a ba hii si ngɛ o hɛ mi nɛ a buɔ munyu ɔmɛ tue, se nɔ́ nɛ o deɔ mɛ ke a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ a pee we.
Á yeɔ nɔ he fɛu, nɛ a se nami he pɛ a susuɔ.
A buɔ mo kaa nɔ ko nɛ laa suɔmi la kɛ gbi ngɔngɔɛ, aloo nɔ ko nɛ le saku fiami saminya.
A ba buɔ o munyu ɔmɛ tue lɛɛ, se a yi nɔ.
Níhi nɛ o de mɛ ɔ tsuo maa ba mi sisiisi.
Ke a ba mi ɔ, kɛkɛ a maa le kaa gbalɔ ko kɛ mɛ ba hi si hyɛ.”
Israel to hyɛli ɔmɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Israel nɔ yeli ɔmɛ.
De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Musu tloo nyɛ Israel to hyɛli!
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he pɛ nyɛ ngɛ lɛe; nyɛ hyɛ we to ɔmɛ a nɔ!
Anɛ pi to ɔmɛ mohu nɛ to hyɛlɔ hyɛɛ lo?
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ gbeɔ to nɛ wo zɔ ɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ; nyɛ ngɔɔ to he womi ɔ kɛ kpɛɔ tade nɛ nyɛ woɔ, se to ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ha we mɛ ní.
Ní nɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, nyɛ hyɛ we a nɔ bɔ nɛ sa; hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsa we mɛ; ní nɛmɛ nɛ plaa a, nyɛ fi we pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ; ní nɛmɛ nɛ tla blɔ ɔ, nyɛ ya kpakaa we mɛ; nɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ laa a, nyɛ ya hla we mɛ.
Se yi mi mohu nyɛ waa mɛ.
To hyɛlɔ ko be; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, to ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa, nɛ lohwe awi yeli ya nuu mɛ nɛ a ye.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye to ɔmɛ wo lalaalo kɛ ya gu yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yokuhi nɛ ya hiɔwe tsuo a nɔ.
A gbɛ mɛ fĩa je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ dii a se, loo e hlaa mɛ.
“Jehanɛ, nyɛ to hyɛli, nyɛɛ bu imi Yawɛ tue saminya.
Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ta tue.
Nga mi lohwe awi yeli nuu ye to ɔmɛ, a gbe mɛ nɛ a ye nyamanyama, ejakaa to hyɛlɔ ko be; ye to hyɛli ɔmɛ dí to ɔmɛ a se.
To hyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he lɛe; a hyɛ we to ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ to hyɛli, nyɛɛ bu mi tue saminya.
Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ke i kɛ nyɛ ná.
Ma kpɔ ye to ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ.
I be hae nɛ nyɛɛ lɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he hu.
Ma kpɔ ye to ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ dɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ be mɛ nae maa ye hu.
To hyɛlɔ kpakpa a “Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, imi nitsɛ ma hla ye to ɔmɛ a se blɔ, nɛ ma hyɛ a nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ hlaa e tohi nɛ gbɛ fĩa, nɛ e buaa a nya ekohu ɔ, jã ma hla ye to ɔmɛ a se blɔ.
Ma kpaka mɛ kɛ je he tsuaa he nɛ a gbɛ fĩa ligbi ɔ nɛ jamɛ amanehlu kɔɔhiɔ yaya ba fia mɛ ɔ. Ma je mɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti; ma bua a nya kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Ma lɛ mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, pa amɛ a he, kɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nga mumu ngɛ ngɛ Israel.
Ma ha nɛ a maa ye ní ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ nga mumu ngɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ.
Imi nitsɛ ma lɛ ye to ɔmɛ; nɛ ma ha mɛ he ko nɛ a maa jɔɔ a he ngɛ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Tohi nɛ laa a, ma ya hla mɛ; ní nɛmɛ nɛ tla blɔ ɔ, ma ya tsɔ́ mɛ kɛ ba; ní nɛmɛ nɛ plaa a, ma fi a pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ; hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu ma tsa mɛ.
Se ní nɛmɛ nɛ wo zɔ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ he wami saminya a, ma kpata a hɛ mi; ejakaa i yeɔ dami sane.
“Jehanɛ, nyɛ ye to kuu, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ma kojo jijɔ kake kɛ jijɔ kake a kpɛti; ma kojo akpakpo ɔmɛ kɛ agbosu ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Nyɛ naa niye ní kpakpa nyɛ yeɔ.
Anɛ lɔ ɔ pi ha nyɛ lo?
Lɛɛ mɛni he je niye ní nɛ piɛ ngɛ nyɛ ní yemi he ɔ, nyɛ kpale ya naa nɔ nyamanyama a?
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ naa nyu nɛ mi tsɔ nɛ nyɛ nuɔ.
Anɛ lɔ ɔ nɛ pi ha nyɛ he je nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ nane kɛ gbidiɔ nyu nɛ piɛ ɔ?
Anɛ e sa kaa ye to ɔmɛ nɛ a ye nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ naa nɔ ɔ, nɛ a nu nyu nɛ nyɛ gbidi ɔ lo?
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ tohi nɛ wo zɔ, kɛ tohi nɛ tã he lo ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kojo a kpɛti.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsitsɛɛɔ to hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ mɛ koli kɛ jee to kuu ɔ he kɛ yaa se.
Se imi lɛɛ ma he ye to ɔmɛ a yi wami, nɛ i be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ nɔ ko nɛ wa mɛ yi mi hu.
Ma kojo jijɔ kɛ jijɔ a kpɛti.
Ma ngɔ to hyɛlɔ kake kɛ to a nya nɛ e hyɛ a nɔ.
Lɛ ji ye tsɔlɔ David.
E maa hyɛ a nɔ saminya.
Imi Yawɛ, ma pee a Mawu, nɛ ye tsɔlɔ David maa ye ganɔ ha mɛ.
Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de.
I kɛ mɛ maa so tue mi jɔmi somi.
Ma fie lohwe awi yeli tsuo kɛ je zugba a nɔ, konɛ a hi si ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, nɛ a hwɔ mahe fuaa.
“Ma gbaa mɛ; nɛ ma ha a maa hi ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe.
Ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ e be mi ha mɛ.
Ma gbaa mɛ kɛ hiɔmi babauu.
Nga nɔ tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii, nɛ zugba a maa ba ní saminya; kɛkɛ ɔ, tue mi jɔmi maa ba zugba a nɔ.
Ma kplɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je a kuɛ mi, nɛ a ye a he kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi.
A ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Je ma amɛ ba be mɛ haoe nɛ a ha a ní hu.
Lohwe awi yeli ba be mɛ nue nɛ a ye hu.
A maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a he gbeye woe.
Ma ngɔ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya kɛ ha mɛ; nɛ ma ha hwɔ se maa po kulaa ngɛ zugba a nɔ; kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ be a he guɛ gbee ngɛ je ɔ mi hu.
A maa le kaa imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, i kɛ mɛ ngɛ.
Nɛ mɛ Israel bi ɔ, ye ma ji mɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Nyɛ ye ma, nyɛ ji ye tohi nɛ i ngɛ lɛe, nɛ imi ji nyɛ Mawu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Mawu maa gbla Edom tue Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Edom zugba a, nɛ o gba kɛ si lɛ.
De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, Edom, i kɛ mo ná!
Ma pee mo pasaa.
Ma pee o ma amɛ ma dokuhi; o zugba a tsuo maa pee pasaa; kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“O kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ yi saasaa.
Benɛ a pee yayami nɛ a ngɛ a tue gblae, nɛ a ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, o kɛ klaate gbe mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke a ma kpata o hɛ mi; o yi be wami nae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
O pue muɔ si, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma pue mo hu o muɔ si.
Ma pee Edom yo ɔ nɔ pasaa kulaa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gu lejɛ ɔ, ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Ma ha nɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ma hyi kɛ ni gbogboehi sɔuu; nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a gbogboehi babauu maa hi lejɛ ɔ, kɛ yo ɔmɛ a kpɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
Ma pee mo pasaa kulaa.
O ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie hu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“O de ke e ngɛ mi kaa imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ye mahi ji Yuda, Israel, kɛ a he zugba amɛ lɛɛ, se o níhi ji mɛ tsuo, nɛ o maa ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke bɔ nɛ o mi mi fu wawɛɛ kɛ wo Israel, nɛ o hɛ hu kɔ e nɔ, nɛ o ngɛ lɛ nyɛe ɔ, jã pɛpɛɛpɛ ma pee mo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye ma a ma na maa le kaa i kɛ mɛ ngɛ, nɛ i ngɛ Edom tue gblae ha mɛ.
O ma na maa le jehanɛ kaa imi Yawɛ, i nu o musu bɔmi munyu ɔmɛ nɛ o tu kɛ si Israel yo ɔmɛ ke, ‘Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ pee pasaa; a ngɔ kɛ ha wɔ nɛ waa pee mɛ bɔ nɛ wa suɔ’ ɔ. Pupuupu nɛ o pee, nɛ o tu musu bɔmi munyuhi babauu kɛ si mi ɔ, i nu lɛ tsuo.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma pee mo pasaa, konɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nya kaa o nɔ si!
Benɛ ye ma Israel nɔ si nɛ e pee pasaa a, o nya.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ Seir yo ɔmɛ, kɛ Edom zugba a tsuo maa pee pasaa kulaa.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Mawu maa gbaa Israel Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, o kɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ nɛ tu munyu, nɛ o de mɛ ke sɛ gbi nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ hae ɔ, a bu tue: Israel he nyɛli ɔmɛ pee pupuupu kɛ fĩa, nɛ a de ke, ‘Yiɛɛ!
Blema yo ɔmɛ ba pee wa níhi.’ “Jehanɛ, gbaa nɛ o de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ. Benɛ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle Israel ɔ ba tua lɛ, nɛ a ha e níhi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo pue e hɛ mi si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ Israel yohi, yokuhi, nyu dɔhi, kɔ̃hi, kɛ we dokuhi kɛ nyɛ he mahi nɛ a ha nyɛ mi ní nɛ nyɛ ba pee nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ he fɛu ha mɛ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue.
“Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i kɛ hɛdɔ, kɛ abofu tu munyu kɛ si je ma amɛ, kɛ Edom zugba a tsuo.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a nya, nɛ a gbe ye ma a he guɛ; ejakaa a ngɔ ye zugba a, kɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ ngɔ pee a weto ní.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbaa kɛ tsɔɔ Israel zugba a.
De yo ɔmɛ, pa amɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i kɛ hɛdɔ, kɛ abofu wawɛɛ ngɛ munyu tue, ejakaa je ma amɛ gbe nyɛ he guɛ, nɛ a pue nyɛ hɛ mi si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ kita kae ke ma ba mɛ si kulaa, konɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
Se Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ lɛɛ tso ɔmɛ ma gba kɔnihi, nɛ a maa wo yiblii ha nyɛ ekohu.
Be nɛ nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba we ekohu ɔ su ta.
I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Ma hyɛ nɛ a ma hu nyɛ zugba amɛ ekohu, nɛ a ma du ní ngɛ a nɔ.
Ma ha nyɛ he maa hiɛ babauu.
Nyɛ maa hi ma amɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛ ma dla maa ma doku ɔmɛ mɛ ekohu.
Nimli, kɛ lohwehi a he ma ba hiɛ babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ; a ma plɔke, nɛ a ma fɔ bimɛ.
Ma ha a maa hi zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a hi nyɛ zugba a nɔ sa a. Ma ha nyɛ maa bɔ pe kekle ɔ po.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Ye ma Israel, ma kpale nyɛ kɛ ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma ba hi lejɛ ɔ ekohu.
Zugba a maa pee nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ́, nɛ nyɛ bimɛ hu i be hae nɛ a ma gbo gblegbleegble.
“Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ke e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa nihi deɔ ke zugba nɛ yeɔ nɔmlɔ ji mo, nɛ o ha we nɛ o mi bi a yi naa wami.
Se kɛ je amlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, o be nɔmlɔ yee hu; o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, o be a hɛ mi kpatae hu.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
He guɛ gbemi, kɛ ahlua bɔmi munyuhi nɛ je ma amɛ tuɔ ɔ, zugba a be tue bue hu.
Zugba a be e bimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpatae hu.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Israel ma na wami he Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, a ngɔ a ní peemi níhi, kɛ a blɔ yaya amɛ kɛ ble lejɛ ɔ.
A je mi bami nɛ a kɛ ble a he ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ yo nɛ ku nine nɛ e he tsɔ we ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
I gbla a tue wawɛɛ, ejakaa ye mi mi wo la ngɛ muɔ si nɛ a pue ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ amagahi nɛ a kɛ ble lɛ ɔ a he.
I gbla a tue, nɛ i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa zugba a nɔ tsuo ngɛ a je mi bami, kɛ a ní peemi yaya amɛ a he.
He tsuaa he nɛ a ya a, nihi tuɔ munyu kɛ puɛɔ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.
A deɔ ke, ‘Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, se e fie mɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ e ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.’ Israel ma a puɛ ye biɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ a ya a. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ dɔ mi wawɛɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Nɔ́ nɛ i yaa pee nɛ ɔ, pi nyɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ he, se mohu ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ nyɛ ble ngɛ ma amɛ a mi he nɛ nyɛ ya a, lɔ ɔ he je.
Ye biɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ble ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti ɔ, ma pee lɛ klɔuklɔu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Ma gu nyɛ, ye ma a nyɛ nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi.
Ma je nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti.
Ma bua nyɛ nya kɛ je he tsuaa he kɛ ba nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ ekohu.
Ma ngɔ nyu klɔuklɔu kɛ fĩa nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ he ma tsɔ.
Ma tsu nyɛ he kɛ je amagahi, kɛ mu níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛ kɛ ble nyɛ he ɔ a mi.
Ma ha nyɛ tsui he, kɛ juɛmi he.
Nyɛ tsui nɛ wlua kaa tɛ ɔ, ma je kɛ je nyɛ mi, nɛ ma ha nyɛ tsui nɛ he jɔ.
Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo nyɛ mi, konɛ nyɛɛ bu ye mlaa amɛ tsuo tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Jehanɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi nɔ.
Nyɛ maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee nyɛ Mawu.
Níhi tsuo nɛ bleɔ nyɛ ɔ, ma je nyɛ kɛ je a mi.
Ma ha nɛ ngma maa ba ha nyɛ babauu, nɛ hwɔ be nyɛ yee hu.
Ma ha tso yiblii, kɛ ngmɔ niba ní maa hiɛ babauu, konɛ hwɔ ko ye nyɛ nɛ nyɛ pue nyɛ hɛ mi si ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti hu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma kai nyɛ je mi bami yaya amɛ, kɛ zo níhi nɛ nyɛ tsu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he maa nyɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ a he.
Israel, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa tsa pi nyɛ he nɛ ma tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Pe i suɔ kaa zo nɛ gbe nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ pue si ngɛ nyɛ je mi bami yaya a he.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ke i tsu nyɛ he kɛ je nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, ma ha nyɛ ma ba hi nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ekohu, nɛ nyɛ ma dla maa ma we doku ɔmɛ.
Zugba a nɛ fɔɔ si gu ɔ, a maa kpale hu lɛ ekohu, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ba gu lejɛ ɔ sa a maa na kaa zugba a fɔ we si gu hu, se a kpale hu lɛ.
A ma de ke zugba nɛ ɔ nɛ fɔ si gu kaa nga kplanaa a, lɔ ɔ lɛ ba pee kaa Eden ngmɔ nɛ ɔ. Ma amɛ nɛ a ku pueɔ si, nɛ a ha a mi níhi, nɛ a pee ma dokuhi ɔ, a kpale fia a gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu, nɛ nihi ngɛ ma amɛ a mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle nyɛ kɛ kpe ɔ maa le kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i dla ma we doku ɔmɛ, nɛ i du ní ngɛ zugba nɛ fɔ si gu ɔ nɔ.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de, nɛ ma pee hulɔ!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ́ kake nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ma bi mi nɛ ma pee ha mɛ ji, ma ha a he nɛ hiɛ babauu kaa to kuu.
Ma ha nɛ a ma amɛ ma hyi tɔ kɛ nimli kaa tohi nɛ a kɛ ba bɔ sami, loo nimli kpekpemi nɛ ba Yerusalem nɛ a ba ye nyami be.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Kɔ̃ kɛ e mi wu gbigblihi I nu Yawɛ he wami he wawɛɛ; nɛ e mumi ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ya ma kɔ̃ ko mi.
Lejɛ ɔ tsuo hyi kɛ wuhi babauu.
E kɛ mi bɔle kɔ̃ ɔ tsuo kɛ kpe; nɛ i na kaa wuhi babauu nitsɛ pueɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, wuhi nɛ gbli kadokado sɔuu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ wu nɛ ɔmɛ ma nyɛ ma na wami ekohu lo?” I he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, mo lɛ o le!” E ya nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Gbaa kɛ pue wu nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
De wu gbigbli nɛ ɔmɛ ke á bu Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue.
De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke ma ngɔ mumi kɛ wo nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ maa ba wami mi ekohu.
Ma ngɔ pani kɛ pue nyɛ nɔ; ma ha lo ma ba ha nyɛ he, nɛ he womi ma ba ha nyɛ he.
Ma ngɔ ye mumi kɛ wo nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ maa ba wami mi ekohu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i gba kaa bɔ nɛ a de mi ɔ. Benɛ i ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, i nu nɛ wu ɔmɛ bɔni a he mimiɛmi kɛ a sibi a he sami kpɛkpɛ kpɛkpɛ; nɛ wu kɛ wu tsa.
Pani kɛ lo ba ha wu ɔmɛ a he, nɛ he womi ba ha a nɔ.
Se mumi be nimli tso nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Jehanɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ tsɔɔ mumi ɔ.
De lɛ ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke e je je ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ e ba wo mumi kɛ pue gbogboe nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ a ba wami mi ekohu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i gba kaa bɔ nɛ a de mi ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi ba gbogboe ɔmɛ a mi; a ba pee hɛ kali, nɛ a te da si ngɛ a nanehi a nɔ; a hiɛ babauu nitsɛ!
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, Israel ma a tsuo ngɛ kaa wu nɛ ɔmɛ.
A ngɛ dee ke a gbli kadokado, nɛ a be hɛ nɔ kami ko kulaa; a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbaa kɛ tsɔɔ ye ma Israel, nɛ o de mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma bli a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a nya.
Ma je mɛ kpo, nɛ ma ha a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ekohu.
Ke i bli yɔkɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a pu mɛ ngɛ mi ɔ a nya, nɛ i ha a je kpo kɛ ba a, kɛkɛ ye ma a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ ngɔ wo a mi, nɛ ma ha a maa ba wami mi ekohu.
Ma ha a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ekohu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ, nɛ ma ye nɔ sisiisi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Yuda kɛ Israel plɛ pee nɔ yemi kake Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yaa ngɔ tso, nɛ o ngma ngɛ nɔ ke, ‘Yuda nɔ yemi ɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, yaa ngɔ tso kpa nɛ o ngma ngɛ nɔ ke ‘Israel nɔ yemi ɔ.’ Jehanɛ bla tso enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pee kake, nɛ o hɛɛ ngɛ o dɛ mi.
Ke o ma mi bi ɔmɛ bi mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ, de ke, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ma ngɔ tso ɔ nɛ daa si ha Israel ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ daa si ha Yuda a kɛ bla.
Ma ngɔ tso enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ pee tso kake ngɛ ye dɛ mi.
“Ha nɛ ma a nɛ na tso enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ o ngma ní ngɛ a nɔ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ mi ɔ.
De mɛ ke he tsuaa he nɛ ye ma a ngɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi hehi nɛ a ho ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ma bua a nya, nɛ ma kpale mɛ tsuo kɛ je lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ.
Ma pee mɛ ma kake ngɛ zugba a nɔ ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Matsɛ kake maa ye a nɔ.
A be je ma enyɔ pee hu.
A mi be gbae kɛ pee nɔ yemi enyɔ hu.
Jehanɛ a be amaga jae hu, nɛ a be ní hiemi níhi, kɛ yayami pee kɛ ble a he hu.
Se yayamihi gbegbeegbe nɛ a pee kɛ si mi ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ pa mɛ.
Ma tsu a he, nɛ a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.
Ye tsɔlɔ David ma ba ye matsɛ ngɛ a nɔ.
Mɛ tsuo a maa hi tsɛ kake sisi, nɛ a maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A maa hi zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha ye tsɔlɔ Yakob ɔ nɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ lɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a bimɛ, kɛ a nina tsuo maa hi kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ye tsɔlɔ David maa ye ganɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
I kɛ mɛ maa so he jɔmi somi.
E maa pee somi nɛ maa hi si daa.
Ma baa a yi saminya.
Ma gbaa ma a, nɛ a he maa hiɛ babauu.
Ma ma ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, nɛ we ɔ maa hi lejɛ ɔ daa.
I kɛ mɛ maa hi si.
Ma pee a Mawu; nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.
Ke i ma ye we ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ i ngɛ a kpɛti daa kɛ yaa neneene ɔ, kɛkɛ je ma amɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ; nɛ imi nitsɛ lɛ i hla Israel kaa ye ma a nɛ.”
Gog maa pee kaa ní tsumi dade ngɛ Mawu dɛ mi Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Gog, ganɔ ngua a nɛ ngɛ Meshek, kɛ Tubal ngɛ Magog zugba a nɔ ɔ. Gbaa kɛ si lɛ.
De lɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i kɛ lɛ ná.
Ma mlɔɔ e hɛ mi, nɛ ma ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo e tsitsa mi.
Ma gbla e tabo ɔ, e we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli babauu nɛ a mia kɛ ha ta a kɛ je.
Ta bulɔ tsuaa ta bulɔ hɛɛ tsɛ̃i, nɛ e mia kɛ klaate.
Persia bi, Sudan bi, kɛ Libia bi piɛ a he.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hɛɛ tsɛ̃i, nɛ a bu dade pɛɛ.
Ta buli tsuo nɛ ngɛ Gomer, kɛ Bet Toga ma zugba amɛ a nɔ ngɛ omleyi je piɛ e he.
Je ma kpahi babauu hu piɛ e he ja nɔuu.
De lɛ ke e pee e tabo ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ klaalo.
Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, ma ha e ma ya tua nihi ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A kɛ ta kpata zugba nɛ ɔ hɛ mi be ko, nɛ a si lejɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ si gu jeha babauu, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a bua nihi a nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
E kɛ e tabo ɔ, kɛ je mahi babauu ma ba tua lejɛ ɔ kaa ahumi; a maa ha zugba a nɔ kaa bɔku.” Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Gog dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, susumi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa ba o yi mi, se ga yaya mohu o maa to.
O ma de ke o ma ya tua ma ko nɛ e mi bi hii si kpoo ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi.
Gbogbo be ma amɛ a he ɔ, agbo se lami dade ko hu be.
O ma ya tua ma amɛ, nɛ o maa ha a mi ní.
O ma ya tua ma doku ɔmɛ nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ a mi hyi kɛ nimli ɔ. O ma ya tua ni ɔmɛ nɛ a bua a nya kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ na, to, kɛ weto ní babauu, nɛ a ngɛ he jɔmi mi ngɛ he nɛ je ɔ tsuo nya ba kpe ngɛ.
Sheba bi, Dedan bi, kɛ jua yeli nɛ je Spania ma ba bi ke, ‘O ma nɛ o ba fia wɔ ojo lo?
Anɛ o bua o tabo ɔ nya kɛ ba nɛ o ba ha ní pani nya, nɛ o muɔ wa lohwehi, wa sika tsu, wa sika hiɔ, kɛ wa weto ní tsuo kɛ ho lo?’ ” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ya de Gog ke, “Jehanɛ, benɛ ye ma Israel ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ɔ, o maa hia blɔ kɛ je omleyi je tsitsaa he nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, kɛ o ta buli kpanakpanaa nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ je je mahi babauu a mi kɛ ba.
O ma ba tua ye ma Israel ɔ kaa ahumi nɛ ngɛ fiae huu kɛ nyɛɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Ke be ɔ su ɔ, ma ha o ma ba tua ye zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a na nɔ nɛ i ji, konɛ kɛ gu nɔ́ nɛ ma pee nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a na kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke blema lokoo nɛ i ha ye tsɔli, Israel gbali ɔmɛ gba jehahi babauu ke be ma nɛ ma ha nɔ ko ma ba ye ye ma Israel nɔ ɔ, anɛ mo o he i de ngɛ lo?” Mawu maa gbla Gog tue Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ligbi ɔ nɛ Gog ma ba tua Israel ɔ, ye mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ.
I ngɔ hunga, kɛ hɛdɔ kɛ ngɛ dee ke jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Israel zugba a ma mimiɛ wawɛɛ.
Pa mi lohi, hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, pu mi lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ kɛ sisali, kɛ nimli adesahi ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo maa pee yoyooyo ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
Yohi maa hule kɛ pue si, tɛ sa nguanguahi maa nɔ si, nɛ gbogbo tsuaa gbogbo maa hule kɛ pue si.
Ma ngɔ haomi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu kɛ wo Gog he gbeye.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
A maa hwu ta gbeyegbeye ko ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nimli maa hia klaate kɛ wo a sibi.
Ma ngɔ gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ muɔ si puemi kɛ gbla Gog tue.
Ma ha hiɔmi nɛ nya wa, kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu maa nɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege maa je hiɔwe ma ba kpata e kɛ e ta a, kɛ je ma amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ke e ba mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo maa na kaa i kle, nɛ i ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le jehanɛ kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
A ye Gog nɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Gog, ganɔ ngua nɛ yeɔ Meshek kɛ Tubal je ma amɛ a nɔ ɔ, nɛ o de lɛ ke, i kɛ lɛ ná.
Ma dɔ e yi kɛ gu he kpa; ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ je tsitsaa omleyi je tɔɔ kɛ ba Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ ngɛ e muɔ nine mi ɔ, ma fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e nɔ zugba, nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi nɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi ɔ ma pue si.
Gog maa nɔ ta ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; e tabo ɔ, kɛ je ma amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Ma ha a gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pee niye ní ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ lo, kɛ nga mi lohwe awi yeli tsuo.
A ma gbo kɛ pue nga kplanaa a nɔ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Magog zugba a, kɛ wo nya ma amɛ nɛ a mi bi a tue mi jɔ mɛ ɔ, ma mɛ mɛ tsuo a he la; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Ma ha ye ma Israel maa le ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ; nɛ i be hae nɛ a ble ye biɛ nɛ he tsɔ ɔ hu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo maa le kaa imi Yawɛ ji Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ligbi ɔ nɛ i to ɔ ji kikɛmɛ a ligbi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Hyɛ, e maa ba kokooko.
Israel ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa je kpo, nɛ a ma ya mɛ ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a he la.
A maa sã a tsɛ̃i wawi, kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi, akplɔhi, kɛ tso kpokuhi babauu nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ si ɔ.
A kɛ maa pee lɛ́ nɛ a ma slɛ jeha kpaago sɔuu.
E be hiae kaa a ya lɛ lɛ́, loo a ya poo tso kɛ pee lɛ́.
Ejakaa ta hwumi ní nɛ a bua nya a, a kɛ maa pee lɛ́ nɛ a ma slɛ.
Nihi nɛ ha a níhi, nɛ a fia mɛ ojo ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hu maa ha a níhi, nɛ a maa fia mɛ ojo ja nɔuu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
A maa pu Gog Yawɛ ke, “Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ na ba mi ɔ, ma ha a maa pu Gog ngɛ Israel zugba a mi, ngɛ ‘Blɔ hiali a kɔ̃’ ɔ mi, ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ beleku je.
A maa pu Gog kɛ e ta a tsuo ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a maa wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke ‘Gog ta buli a kɔ̃.’ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ nyɔhiɔ kpaago kɛ pu gbogboe ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a kɛ maa tsu zugba a he ekohu.
Zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo ma bla kɛ pu mɛ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ a maa ye kunimi nɛ ɔ, a maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ se ɔ, a maa hla ni komɛ nɛ maa kpa zugba a nɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba, konɛ gbogboehi nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a pu mɛ, nɛ a tsu zugba a he.
Ke a ngɛ zugba a nɔ kpae, nɛ nɔ ko ya na wu ko ɔ, e pee okadi ngɛ wu ɔ he kɛ yaa si a maa ngɔ wu ɔ ya pu ngɛ Gog ta buli a kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
(Ma ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kasa nya nɛ a ngɔ tabo ɔ biɛ kɛ wo lɛ.)
Bɔ nɛ a maa pee kɛ tsu zugba a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tsɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je he tsuaa he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ kɛ ba nɛ a ba ye ní.
Ma sã bɔ nguaa ko ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a ye lo, nɛ a nu muɔ.
A maa ye katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a lo, nɛ a maa nu zugba a nɔ ganɔ ɔmɛ a muɔ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa Bashan agbosuhi, loo jijɔhi, loo akpakpohi, loo na kuhi nɛ wo zɔ.
Ke i gbe ni ɔmɛ kaa a gbeɔ lohwe kɛ sãã bɔ ɔ, a maa ye zɔ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si e maa gbe a nya, nɛ a maa nu muɔ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si a maa pee gbedee kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.
Ma ngɔ okpɔngɔhi, ta zugba lɛhi, katsɛmɛ, kɛ ta buli slɔɔtoslɔɔto babauu kɛ ngmɛ mɛ okplɔɔ; a maa ye ní nɛ a maa tɔ saminya.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.” Israel maa bɔ ekohu Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha je ma amɛ maa na ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ; ma tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ i gblaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ a tue wawɛɛ ha.
Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ yaa a, Israel bi ɔmɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Je ma amɛ hu maa le kaa imi lɛ i ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ya hi ma se kaa nyɔguɛhi, ejakaa a pee yayami kɛ si mi.
I kua mɛ, i ha a he nyɛli ba ye a nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ a gbe mɛ.
I kɛ mɛ to ní ngɛ mu ní tsumihi nɛ a tsu, kɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he; nɛ i kua mɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ, ma na Yakob nina a mɔbɔ; ma na Israel ma a tsuo mɔbɔ, nɛ ma ha a maa bɔ ekohu.
Ma pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ a na kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi.
Ke a kpale kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ nɔ ko wui a he gbeye ɔ, a hɛ maa je nɔ kaa a pue a hɛ mi si, nɛ a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a le kaa i ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ma kpale ye ma a kɛ je a he nyɛli a zugba amɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ ba.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye ma a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.
A maa le enɛ ɔ; ejakaa imi nitsɛ lɛ i ha a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya kaa nyɔguɛhi ɔ nɛ.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ i bua a nya, nɛ i kpale mɛ kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ, nɛ e píɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ ma se.
Ma ngɔ ye mumi kɛ pue Israel ma a nɔ, nɛ i be mɛ kuae hu.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
YAWƐ WE HE Ɔ HE NINA A ngɔ Ezekiel kɛ ba Yerusalem Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a we jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔne ɔ ji jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a kpata Yerusalem ma a hɛ mi.
Jeha he ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma a, Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mi kɛ je.
I na ngɛ nina a mi nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ba Israel zugba a nɔ; nɛ e ngɔ mi ya fɔ yo gagaa ko yi mi.
I na nɔ́ ko kaa ma ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
Mumi ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ya su ma a he haa; nɛ i na nyumu ko nɛ e he ngɛ kpɛe kaa akɔblee.
E hɛɛ nɔ́ susumi kpa, kɛ nɔ́ susumi tso ngɛ e dɛ mi kɛ daa si ngɛ agbo ko nya.
E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bli o hɛngmɛ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ saminya; ta tue nɛ o nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ o ngɔ o juɛmi kɛ fɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ; ejakaa a ngɔ mo kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mo.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa na a, yaa nɛ o ya de Israel ma a.” Agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ I na Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ bɔle lɛ.
Nyumu ɔ ngɔ nɔ́ susumi tso ɔ kɛ susu gbogbo ɔ. Susumi tso ɔ kami maa pee gugue kake kɛ fa.
Gbogbo ɔ hiɔwe yami ji susumi tso ɔ kake, nɛ e timi hu ja nɔuu.
Jehanɛ e ya agbo nɛ nya blɔ ngɛ beleku je ɔ he.
E kuɔ kpoku ɔmɛ kɛ ya su a nyagbe, nɛ e susu agbo ɔ; kɛ je e yi mi kɛ ba sisi ɔ peeɔ susumi tso ɔ kake.
Blɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ tsu etɛ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ etɛ hu ngɛ muɔ nɔ.
Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ a kami kɛ a blimi tsuo sɔ; eko tsuaa eko ngɛ gugue kake kɛ fa; nɛ gbogbo nɛ e timi ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ tsa tsu kɛ tsu.
Tsu wawi nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, blɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; blɔ ɔ kami ji gugue kake kɛ fa.
Blɔ nɛ ɔ ya sɛ asa agbo ko mi.
-Nyumu ɔ susu tsu nɛ ɔ hulɔ; e ná gugue enyɔ.
Agbo nɛ a guu mi kɛ yaa Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; nɛ agbo ɔ timi ngɛ nyagbe ɔ ji gugue fa.
(Tsu wayowayo etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ muɔ nɔ, kɛ etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a kami sɔ, nɛ gbogbo nɛ po a kpɛti ɔ hu e timi ngɛ ja nɔuu.)
Jehanɛ, nyumu ɔ susu agbo ɔ blimi; e ná gugue etɛ kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ; nɛ ke a bli agbo ɔ, e peeɔ gugue enyɔ kɛ fa.
Kpoku ngɛ tsu wayo tsuaa tsu wayo nya.
Kpoku ɔ hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e nɔ blimi hu nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Tsu wawi ɔmɛ a kami kɛ a blimi sɔ; eko tsuaa eko peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa ngɛ hiɛ, kɛ gugue kake kɛ fa ngɛ hiɛ.
Jehanɛ, e susu tsu ɔ kami kɛ gu gbogbo ɔ se; blɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu kake kɛ kake a kpɛti kami ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ kɛ je tsu kake sinya nya kɛ ya na tsu nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ sinya.
A guu tsu nɛ ngɛ nyagbe ɔ mi kɛ ya jee kpo ngɛ kue kpa mi.
E susu jamɛ a tsu ɔ hulɔ; e blimi ji gugue enuɔ.
Kɛ je gbogbo ɔ he ngɛ agbo ɔ nya kɛ ya su nyagbe tsu ɔ se tsuo peeɔ gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa.
Saflɛ puɔ tsɔwitsɔwi ngɛ kpo nɔ je gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi; ekomɛ hu ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ po tsu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ a mi; nɛ tãhi nɛ a tɛni ngɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a si mami ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
Kue nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ Nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya su kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ mi.
Tsu nyingmi etɛ tsa a sibi a nɔ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he.
A ka tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ zugba a tsuo kɛ bɔle kue ɔ mi kɛ kpe.
Kpɛti kue ɔ ya hiɔwe pe kpo nɔ je nɔ́ ɔ.
A guu agbo nɛ ya hiɔwe ko mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa kpɛti kue ɔ mi.
Nyumu ɔ susu blɔ nɛ ngɛ agbo enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kɛ je yiti je nɔ́ ɔ he kɛ ya su sisi je nɔ́ ɔ he; nɛ e ná gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ Jehanɛ e nyɛɛ ye hɛ mi kɛ ya omleyi je kɛ ya su kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ we agbo ɔ he.
E susu e kami kɛ e blimi.
Tsu wayowayo etɛ nɛ ngɛ muɔ nɔ kɛ etɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ ɔ, a klemi sɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kekle agbo ɔ ngɛ ɔ. E kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Tsu agbo ɔ saflɛ ɔmɛ, e kue ɔ, kɛ tã amɛ ɔ, ke a susu mɛ ɔ, a ngɛ kaa agbo ɔ nɛ hɛ mi kpee beleku je ɔ ní ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaago kɛ yaa he; nɛ e kue ɔ ngɛ mi mi je.
Kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ we agbo ɔ, kɛ omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ hanɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ leneyi je nɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyumu ɔ susu kue enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kami, nɛ e ná gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Agbo nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya leneyi je; agbo ko nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E susu e sinya tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e kue ɔ. E na kaa a kɛ ekpa amɛ sɔ.
Saflɛhi ngɛ agbo ɔ, kɛ kue ɔ mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si kɛ kpe kaa ekpa amɛ nɔuu.
Agbo ɔ mi blɔ ɔ kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaago kɛ ya sɛɛ tsu agbo ko mi ngɛ nyagbe ɔ; enɛ ɔ hu nya blɔ kpee kue ɔ mi je.
A tɛni tãhi ngɛ agbo ɔ mi sinya tso ɔmɛ a he; kake ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ hiɛ.
Agbo ko ngɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ leneyi je.
E susu kɛ je agbo kake he kɛ ya su agbo kpa nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ he, nɛ e ná gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ: agbo nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ Nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya gu agbo nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ mi kɛ ya su kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ mi.
E susu agbo ɔ; enɛ ɔ hu kɛ agbo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ sɔ.
-Tsu wawi ɔmɛ, tsu agbo ɔ, kɛ gbogbo nɛ po a mi ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa agbo kpa amɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Saflɛhi ngɛ agbo nya tsu ɔmɛ a he.
E susu enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kami; e pee gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ a blimi pee gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Tsu agbo ko nɛ hɛ mi kpee kue kaketsɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.
A tɛni tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ tsuo.
A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaanyɔ kɛ yaa agbo nɛ ɔ he.
Mi mi je kue ɔ: agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ Nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya gu agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ kue nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ mi.
E susu agbo ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ kaa ekpa amɛ nɔuu.
Tsu wawi ɔmɛ, tsu agbo ɔ, kɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ nɔuu.
Saflɛhi ngɛ kue ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe, nɛ saflɛhi ngɛ tsu agbo ɔ hu he.
Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ a blimi ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
A tɛni tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ tsuo.
A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaanyɔ kɛ yaa agbo nɛ ɔ he.
Kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ: agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ he.
E susu enɛ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ e na kaa e kɛ ekpa amɛ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E ngɛ kaa ekpa amɛ; e ngɛ tsu wawi, kɛ tsu agbo nɛ a tɛni tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he; jehanɛ hu saflɛhi ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe.
Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ a blimi ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Tsu agbo nɛ ɔ hɛ mi tsɔɔ agbo ɔ nya blɔ.
A tɛni tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ tsuo.
A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaanyɔ kɛ yaa agbo nɛ ɔ he.
Agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ kasa nya tsuhi Tsu bi ko ngɛ agbo ɔ nya nɛ a kɛ sɛɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ omleyi je.
A guu hiɛ ɔ kɛ ya sɛɛ kue nguaa a nɛ hɛ mi kpee kpo nɔ je ɔ mi.
Lohwehi nɛ a gbee nɛ a kɛ lohwe ɔ tsuo sãã sami bɔ ɔ, hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ a fɔɔ a lo ɔ he ngɛ.
Okplɔɔ eywiɛ ngɛ tsu agbo nɛ ɔ mi; enyɔ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ.
Okplɔɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ a gbee lohwehi nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ: sami bɔhi jio, yayami pami bɔhi jio, fɔ yemi bɔhi jio.
Tsu ɔ se hu okplɔɔ eywiɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa enɛ ɔmɛ maa si.
Enyɔ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ enyɔ hu ngɛ muɔ nɔ ngɛ omleyi je agbo ɔ nya.
Okplɔɔ kpaanyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ a gbeɔ lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ; eywiɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ eywiɛ hu ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ.
Okplɔɔ kpa eywiɛ ngɛ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ a nɔ.
Tɛ nɛ a kó a kɛ pee mɛ.
Eko tsuaa eko kami ji nine mi blimi etɛ, e blimi hu nine mi blimi etɛ, kɛ e hiɔwe yami nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Dadehi tsuo nɛ a kɛ gbee lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, okplɔɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ a kɛ pueɔ.
A ka gbowehi kɛ wo okplɔɔ ɔmɛ a tue kɛ kpe, eko tsuaa eko kami ji dɛ mi blimi kake.
Lo ɔ tsuo nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, okplɔɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ a kɛ pueɔ.
Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ba mi mi je kue ɔ mi.
Tsu enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a bliɔ a sinya amɛ kɛ baa we ɔ mi je; kake ngɛ omleyi je agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e hɛ mi kpee leneyi je; nɛ kake hu ngɛ leneyi je agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e hɛ mi kpee omleyi je.
Nyumu ɔ de mi ke tsu nɛ hɛ mi kpee leneyi je ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Kake ɔ hu nɛ hɛ mi kpee omleyi je ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ hu a nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Zadok nina ji osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ mɛ pɛ ji Levi bi nɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa a ba sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ Nyumu ɔ susu kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ. Kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ fiee; eko tsuaa eko kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ; nɛ bɔ sami la tɛ maa si ngɛ we ɔ hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ e kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ kue ɔ nya.
E susu kue ɔ nya titima a; e blimi ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e kami ji gugue etɛ kɛ fa.
Gbogbo nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ muɔ nɔ ɔ, a timi sɔ, gugue fa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Kue ɔ kami ji gugue enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue etɛ.
A kuɔɔ kpoku nyɔngma kɛ yaa sinya a nya.
Titima hi maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; kake ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ muɔ nɔ.
He klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a Pee se ɔ, nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ mi nitsɛ.
E susu sinya a nya titima a; kɛ je hiɛ kɛ yaa a, peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa, nɛ kɛ je hiɛ kɛ yaa hu peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa; ja nɔuu bo tsu mi blimi peeɔ.
Sinya a nya peeɔ gugue enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ sinya a blimi peeɔ gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi kake ngɛ hiɔ nɔ; nɛ muɔ nɔ hu ja nɔuu.
E susu tsu ɔ nitsɛ hulɔ; e kami ji gugue nyɔngma, nɛ e blimi ji gugue enuɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ: titima a ngɛ gugue fa; sinya a peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa; nɛ sinya a blimi peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Jehanɛ e susu tsu ɔ mi nitsɛ.
E ná gugue enuɔ ngɛ tsu ɔ kasa kake, nɛ e ná ja nɔuu ngɛ kasa kpa amɛ tsuo.
Tsu nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛtikpɛti tsu ɔ se.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ji he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.” Yawɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he tsuhi Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ susu Yawɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔ timi; e na gugue kake kɛ fa.
Tsu wawi nɛ eko tsuaa eko blimi ji gugue kake bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe.
A ma tsu wawi nɛ ɔmɛ siaudo etɛɛtɛ; tsu ɔ eko ma eko yi mi, nɛ tsu nyingmi etɛ ngɛ siaudo tsuaa siaudo mi kɛ bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe.
A ma tsu ɔmɛ slɛnɛɛ kɛ wo gbogbo ɔ he kɛ kpla si, se a ma we we ɔ gbogbo ɔ nitsɛ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke a ngɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔ hyɛe ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ gbogbo ɔ timi sɔ kɛ je zugba kɛ ya su e yi mi, se tsu ɔmɛ a mi bli kaa bɔ nɛ níhi nɛ hɛɛ siaudo enyɔne kɛ etɛne ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hiɔwe tsu ɔmɛ a mi bli pe sisi ní ɔmɛ.
A kuɔɔ Yawɛ we ɔ gbogbo nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ he atlakpe kɛ guu tsu ɔmɛ a se kɛ yaa kekleekle siaudo ɔ, kɛ enyɔne ɔ a nɔ.
-Tsu wawi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ, eko tsuaa eko gbogbo timi ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
A guu sinya ko nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa tsu ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ we omleyi je, nɛ a guu kake hu mi kɛ yaa ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ a mi.
I na kpoku ko nɛ e hiɔwe yami ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ kɛ bɔle Yawɛ we ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe.
E hiɔwe yami ji gugue kake kɛ fa; e yi mi ya ta tsu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ɔ a sisi tomi ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
He ko gbajaa ngɛ kpoku ɔmɛ, kɛ tsuhi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ hii mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kasa nya a a kpɛti; e kami ji gugue enuɔ.
Tsu nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ Tsu ko ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ se ngɛ bonyoku je.
Tsu nɛ ɔ kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa; e blimi ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa, nɛ gbogbo nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ timi ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Yawɛ we ɔ klemi Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ susu Yawɛ we ɔ nitsɛ; e kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ; tsu ɔ se, kɛ tsu ɔ, kɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a kami tsuo peeɔ gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ; e blimi ngɛ beleku je kɛ kpo ɔ nɔ tsuo ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
E susu tsu ɔ kami ngɛ bonyoku je, e susu e he ablanaa amɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, nɛ e na gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Yawɛ we ɔ he ní komɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kpɛti tsu ɔ, he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, a ka tso kɛ wo lɛ tsuo he kɛ je zugba kɛ ya ta saflɛ ɔmɛ a nya.
Saflɛ ɔmɛ hu a ha a he.
A tɛni ní kɛ wo we ɔ mi gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya si sinya a yi mi ngɛ tsu ɔ mi.
Tãhi, kɛ kerubhi sɔuu a tɛni, nɛ tã ngɛ kerub kɛ kerub a kpɛti kɛ bɔle tsu ɔ mi tsuo.
Kerub tsuaa kerub ngɛ hɛ mi enyɔ.
Nɔmlɔ hɛ mi nɛ plɛ ngɔ kpee tã ji hɛ mi kake, kɛ jata hɛ mi nɛ plɛ ngɔ kpee tã ngɛ enyɔne ɔ. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ a tɛni ní ɔmɛ kɛ wo we ɔ gbogbo ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe.
A tɛni kerubhi, kɛ tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he kɛ je zugba kɛ ya ta sinya a yi mi.
A pee Yawɛ we ɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ sinya tso ɔmɛ kɔ nya eywiɛɛywiɛ.
Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ tso pee ɔ Ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa hɛ mi ɔ, nɔ́ ko maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ tso pee.
E hiɔwe yami ji gugue fa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e kami ji gugue fa, kɛ e blimi hu gugue fa.
E kɔ nya amɛ, e nane ɔmɛ, kɛ e kasa nya amɛ tsuo tso a kɛ pee.
Nyumu ɔ de mi ke, “Okplɔɔ nɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Sinya amɛ A guu sinya kake mi kɛ sɛɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ nyagbe ɔ, a guu sinya kpa mi kɛ sɛɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a.
A pee sinya nɛ ɔmɛ blablɛ enyɔɔnyɔ; sinya amɛ eko tsuaa eko bliɔ ngɛ kpɛti.
A tɛni kerubhi, kɛ tãhi ngɛ sinya amɛ a he ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ɔ.
A kɛ tso pee gba ngɛ kue ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpo nɔ je.
Saflɛhi nɛ a pee puɔhi ngɛ a mi, nɛ a tɛni tãhi ngɛ a he ngɛ kue ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Tsu enyɔ komɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kasa nya Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ mi je kpo kɛ ba agbo nya kue ɔ he ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ we omleyi je.
Lejɛ ɔ kɛ tsu ɔ nɛ ngɛ we ɔ bonyoku je ɔ he kɛ we.
Kue nɛ ngɛ omleyi je nɛ ɔ kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa.
Blɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu nɛ ɔ, kɛ kpo ɔ nɔ je nɔ́ ɔ a kpɛti ji gugue enuɔ, nɛ tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ a sibi a hanɔ.
A ka tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ zugba a. Agbo nya tsu nɛ ɔ, a ma lɛ siaudo etɛ, nɛ ablanaa ngɛ eko tsuaa eko hɛ mi.
Blɔ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ blimi ji gugue enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ kɛ ya na sinya nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yiti tsu ɔmɛ a mi bli we kulaa; ejakaa ablanaa amɛ hé a blɔ he ɔmɛ pe sisi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ kpɛti ní ɔmɛ.
Tsuhi nɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, a ma mɛ siaudo etɛ, se a be titimahi kaa bɔ nɛ kpo nɔ je tsu ɔmɛ a titima amɛ ngɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tsuhi nɛ ngɛ kpɛti siaudo ɔ nɔ ɔ ya pee wayowayo pe sisi tsu ɔmɛ, nɛ tsuhi nɛ ngɛ siaudo enyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ hu ya pee wayowayo pe kpɛti ní ɔmɛ.
-Tsu ɔ kami mi fa nɛ ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa ngɛ zugba mi ɔ, gbogbo sɔuu kɛ ya pue; gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ tsuhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Tsuhi ngɛ yi mi siaudo ɔ tsuo nɔ kɛ ya su nyagbe ɔ.
-Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi kɛ yaa beleku je, he nɛ a fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ je ɔ, blɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa kpo nɔ je kue ɔ mi.
Tsu kpa ko nɛ je nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ leneyi je, nɛ e kɛ enɛ ɔ he kɛ we kulaa.
Blɔ ngɛ tsu nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ. E kami kɛ e blimi kɛ hehi nɛ a guu kɛ sɛɛ mi ɔ ngɛ kaa kaketsɛ ɔ nɔuu.
Sinya ko ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a sisi kɛ yaa beleku je, he nɛ a fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ je ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ de mi ke, “Tsu enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Osɔfohi nɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ, tsu nɛ ɔmɛ a mi a yeɔ bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ.
Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ a mi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ toɔ bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ: niye ní bɔ, yayami pami bɔ, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ.
Ke osɔfo ɔmɛ sɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, a be kpo jee kɛ ya kpo nɔ je kue ɔ mi; mohu a ma je a tade ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔ ɔ kɛ pue si, ejakaa tade ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
A maa wo tade kpahi loko a maa je kpo kɛ ya he nɛ ma a ngɛ ɔ.” A susu Yawɛ we ɔ Benɛ nyumu ɔ susu Yawɛ we ɔ mi ta a, e kɛ mi je kpo kɛ gu agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ mi kɛ ba kpo ɔ nɔ; nɛ e ba susu lejɛ ɔ hulɔ.
E ngɔ e tso ɔ kɛ susu kpo ɔ nɔ tsuo kɛ kpe.
E ná gugue lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ beleku je ɔ.
-Jehanɛ e susu omleyi je, leneyi je, kɛ bonyoku je tsuo; lɛ tsuo sɔ fiee, gugue lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Gbogbo po he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ he nɛ ji nihi tsuo a nɔ́ ɔ a kpɛti.
Yawɛ kpale kɛ ba e we ɔ mi Nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ba agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i na Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe plamplam kɛ je beleku je kɛ ma.
Mawu gbi ngɛ pɛe hoo kɛ ma kaa wo nɛ gli; nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo pee hleii kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Nina nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nina nɛ i na benɛ Mawu ba kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi, kɛ nina nɛ i na ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a. Kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ mi kɛ bu zugba.
Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ gu agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Yawɛ mumi ɔ wo ye nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mi ya ma mi mi je kue ɔ mi.
E hɛ mi nyami ɔ hyi we ɔ tɔ.
Benɛ nyumu ɔ daa si ngɛ ye kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, i nu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu kɛ je we ɔ mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ye matsɛ sɛ maa si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; ma hi Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel ma a jio, a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ jio, a be ye hɛ mi si puee hu; a be mawu kpahi jae, nɛ a be a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ pue ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hu.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee a kpoku ɔmɛ, nɛ a ma a sinya tso ɔmɛ ngɛ ye kpoku ɔmɛ, kɛ ye sinya tso ɔmɛ a kasa nya haa, nɛ gbogbo kɛkɛ lɛ po wa kpɛti.
Se a ngɔ a ní hiemi níhi nɛ a pee ɔ kɛ ble ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ abofu kpata a hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma kpa mawu kpahi jami, nɛ a ma je a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ je ye kasa nya kɛ ya se lokoo.
Ke a pee ja a, ma hi a kpɛti kɛ maa ya neneene.” Yawɛ ya nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ ye we ɔ ngɛ ha a, kale fitsofitso kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ.
Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ ngɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ a he.
Ke a hɛ mi pue si kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, lɛɛ ngɔɔ we ɔ he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ: e kami, e blimi, e hiɔwe yami, e blɔ nya tomi, hehi nɛ a guu kɛ sɛɛ we ɔ mi, kɛ hehi nɛ a guu kɛ jee kpo.
Tsɔɔ mɛ mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ we ɔ he tsuo.
Kadi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ womi nɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a na bɔ nɛ a to ní ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ha, bɔ nɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo ngɛ, nɛ a ye a nɔ fitsofitso.
Mlaa nɛ kɔɔ imi Yawɛ ye we ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: yo ɔ yi mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si kɛ kpe ɔ maa pee he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.” Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ Nɔ́ susumi tso nɛ kami peeɔ nine mi blimi enyɔ kɛ nine kpɔmi kake nɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ susu Yawɛ we ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu e kɛ susu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi ɔ. Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kami pee nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e blimi hu nine mi blimi enyɔ; nɛ nine mi blimi kake bɔle e tue ɔ kɛ kpe.
Kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ mi dlami nɛ ngɛ sisi ɔ yi mi kɛ ba su zugba mi ɔ peeɔ gugue fa.
Mi dlami nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, a ha e ya se nine mi blimi enyɔ kɛ bɔle la tɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ e hiɔwe yami ji gugue kake.
Mi dlami nɛ tsa enɛ ɔ hu nɔ ɔ, a ha e ya se je nine kpɔ mi kake kɛ bɔle la tɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ kpe.
E yi mi he nɛ a sãã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ peeɔ gugue kake.
Koli eywiɛ maa si glouu ngɛ la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ.
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ yi mi kami kɛ e blimi sɔ, gugue etɛ ngɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Mi dlami ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛti ɔ hu kami kɛ e blimi sɔ, gugue etɛ kɛ fa ngɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; kla nɛ bɔle e tue kɛ kpe ɔ hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi kake; nɛ e sisi ɔ, nine mi blimi enyɔ bɔle la tɛ ɔ kɛ kpe.
Kpokuhi nɛ a kuɔɔ kɛ yaa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ ngɛ la tɛ ɔ beleku je.
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsukɔmi Mlaahi nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee nɛ kɔɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke a ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a maa sã bɔ ngɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ muɔ kɛ fĩa nɔ ɔ gbe nya a, Levi bi osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Zadok nina, nɛ mɛ pɛ lɛ a ba sɔmɔɔ mi ngɛ ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, ha mɛ na ku nɛ a kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ.
Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e pee klɔuklɔu ha Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ngɔɔ muɔ ɔ eko nɛ o kɛ kpa koli eywiɛ ɔmɛ, la tɛ ɔ kpɛti mi dlami ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kla nɛ bɔle la tɛ ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe ɔ. Jehanɛ ngɔɔ na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ. Ha nɛ a sã lɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ he, he nɛ a to nɛ a pee ngɛ ɔ. E nɔ jena a, ngɔɔ akpakpo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Ke o tsukɔ la tɛ ɔ he gbe nya a, ngɔɔ na ku kɛ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba.
Ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ maa ngɔ ngo kɛ fĩa a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ maa sã sami bɔ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ.
Ngɔɔ akpakpo kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ daa ligbi kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago.
Ngɔɔ na ku kɛ agbosu hu nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be mɛ tsuo a he kɛ ba ja nɔuu.
A ngɔ ligbi kpaago kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ á gbaa nɔ kɛ ha bɔ sami.
Ke a gbe ligbi kpaago ní tsumi ɔ nya a, kɛ je ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa a, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye bua maa jɔ ma a tsuo he.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je agbo ɔ Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kpale mi kɛ ba he klɔuklɔu ɔ we agbo ɔ nɛ hɛ mi kpee beleku je ɔ nya.
A nga agbo ɔ. Yawɛ de mi ke, “A gbo nɛ ɔ, á nga daa; a ko bli gblegbleegble.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó gu lejɛ ɔ kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nitsɛ i gu lejɛ ɔ kɛ sɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, á nga daa.
Ganɔ ɔ pɛ lɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e yaa lejɛ ɔ. E ma nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ ye ní ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
É gu kue ngua a nɛ ngɛ se je ɔ mi kɛ ya, nɛ é gu lejɛ ɔ nɔuu kɛ je kpo.” Blɔ nya tomi kɛ ha nihi nɛ maa ya Yawɛ we ɔ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya gu omleyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ ba we ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ i na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ hyi we ɔ tɔ.
I ngɔ ye hɛ mi kɛ bu si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bli o hɛngmɛ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ; bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ tue saminya.
Blɔ nya tomihi, kɛ mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ ye we ɔ he ɔ, kadi mɛ, konɛ o hɛ ko je a nɔ.
Ná nɛ o le kaa pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛkɛ nɛ yaa ye we ɔ.
“De Israel ma atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i be mɛ blɔ ngmɛe nɛ a pee ní hiemi níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ hu.
A ha nibwɔhi mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we, nɛ a bui mi tue ba sɛ ye we ɔ mi, benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ zɔ kɛ muɔ kɛ ngɛ bɔhi sãe ha mi ɔ. Ye ma a yi ye somi ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ a ní hiemi ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu kɛ tɔ ye nɔ.
Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsu we ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he ní ngɛ ye we ɔ, se mohu a ngɔ nibwɔhi kɛ to ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nya.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ke nubwɔ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ nɛ he tsɔ we, nɛ bui mi tue kó sɛ ye we ɔ mi kɔkɔɔkɔ; nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti tete po a ko ya lejɛ ɔ.” Levi bi nɛ be he blɔ kaa a tsuɔ osɔfo ní tsumi Yawɛ de mi ke, “Levi bi nɛ a kɛ Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ kua mi, nɛ a ya ja amagahi ɔ, ma gbla a tue.
A ma sɔmɔ ngɛ ye we ɔ; a maa bu agbo ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ma tsu ní ngɛ we ɔ. Lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpahi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa gbe lohwe ɔ, nɛ mɛ nɔuu lɛ a ma sɔmɔ nihi nɛ ba bɔ sami ɔ. Akɛnɛ a nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ja amagahi, nɛ a ha a pee yayami kɛ si mi he je ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke ma gbla a tue kokooko.
A ko sã kɛ su ye he, nɛ a ko ba tsu osɔfo ní tsumi ha mi.
A ko ba ta ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he; nɛ a ko ya he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a hulɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji a tue gblami ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha a maa hyɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɔ.
Sɔmɔmi ní tsumi, kɛ ní tsumi kpahi nɛ hia kaa a tsu ɔ, mɛ lɛ a ma tsu.” Osɔfo ɔmɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Benɛ Israel ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo kua mi ɔ, Levi weku ɔ mi osɔfohi nɛ ji Zadok nina a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a sɔmɔ mi saminya ngɛ ye we ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ pɛ ji nihi nɛ maa ba ye hɛ mi nɛ a ba sɔmɔ mi.
Mɛ ji nihi nɛ maa ngɔ zɔ, kɛ nu ɔ kɛ ba ha imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ.
Mɛ pɛ ji nihi nɛ maa ba ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ.
A maa ba ye we okplɔɔ ɔ he, konɛ a ba sɔmɔ mi.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hyɛ nɛ a ja mi saminya.
Ke a maa ba Yawɛ we ɔ kpo nɔ je kue ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a wo kploba tade.
A ko wo kuutu nɔ́ ko kɛ ya sɔmɔ ngɛ kue ngua a nɛ ngɛ kpɛti ɔ mi; ye we ɔ nitsɛ mi hu, á pee ja kɛ.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ latsa ko tsa mɛ benɛ a ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, a ngɔ kploba kɛ pee yi fimi nɔ́ kɛ fi a yi; nɛ a wo kploba tade ngɛ a mlɛ mi kɛ ya si nane si, se a ko fi a mlɛ mi nɔ́ ko.
Ke a maa je kpo kɛ ya agbo nya je kue ɔ mi, kɛ ya he nɛ ma a ngɛ ɔ, a je tade ɔmɛ nɛ a wo kɛ sɔmɔ ɔ kɛ pue tsu klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi.
A wo tade kpahi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ heha ní klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ ko ye ma a awi.
“Osɔfo ɔmɛ ko sã a yi nɔ kpalokpalo, nɛ a ko ngmɛɛ a yi bwɔmi he nɛ e ka gagaa hulɔ.
A dla a yi ɔ he bɔ nɛ sa kɛkɛ.
Ke osɔfo ko maa ya he klɔuklɔu ɔ, e ko nu dã.
Osɔfo kó ngɔ yalɔyo, loo yo nɛ e kɛ e huno be hu; e ngɔ yomiyo kɛ je e ma Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, aloo osɔfo ko nɛ be je mi ɔ e yo yalɔyo.
“Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ́ a tsɔɔ ye ma a slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ be klɔuklɔu a kpɛti, kɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ a kpɛti.
Ke sane ko ba a, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɔuu nɛ a hyɛ sane ɔ mi, nɛ á kojo ngɛ ye mlaa amɛ a nya.
Mlaahi, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ kɔɔ nyami be ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ, a hyɛ nɛ a ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ klɔuklɔu.
“Osɔfo ko kó ya gbogboe kasa nya nɛ e kɛ ba ble e he.
Ke e he nɔ kɔklɔɔ kaa e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ, loo e binyumu, loo e biyo, loo e nyɛminyumu, loo e nyɛmiyo nɛ yɛ gba we kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ gbo lɛɛ e ma nyɛ ma ble e he faa.
Ke e tsukɔ e he se ɔ, a kane ligbi kpaago ha lɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.
Jehanɛ, e ya Yawɛ we ɔ mi mi je kue ɔ mi, nɛ e ya sã yayami pami bɔ, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e ya sɔmɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Weto ní nɛ i ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ yi nɔ kake siɔ kɛ haa yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ se kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ a nɔ́ ji osɔfo yemi; imi nitsɛ ji a weto ní, kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a be weto ní kpa ko nae ngɛ Israel ma a mi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a niye ní nɛ a maa ye ji niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ, yayami pami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ ɔmɛ; jehanɛ hu, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa gbaa nɔ kɛ ke mi ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́.
Tso yiblii tsuaa tso yiblii kekleekle nɔ́, kɛ ní slɔɔtohi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma ba sã bɔ ha mi ɔ a mi nɔ́ nɛ hi pe kulaa a peeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́.
Jehanɛ hu, ke a sã abolo ɔ, a ngɔ kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ a bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, konɛ ye gbaami nɛ hi we ɔmɛ a mi.
Osɔfo kó ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, loo lohwe kpa ko tsɔtslɔɔ e mi kɔkɔɔkɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛ jio, nane eywiɛtsɛ jio.”
Zugba a fa nɛ ji Yawɛ nɔ́ ɔ Ke nyɛ ngɛ zugba a mi dlae kɛ ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ, nɛ́ e pee a weto ní ɔ, nyɛ susu fa ko, nɛ nyɛɛ gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Zugba nɛ ɔ kami nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi hu nɛ pee si tomi ekpa kɛ fa.
Lejɛ ɔ zugba a tsuo nɛ pee klɔuklɔu.
Zugba a he nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ maa hi ɔ, e kami nɛ e pee gugue lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, kɛ e blimi hu ja nɔuu.
Zugba nɛ fɔɔ si gu gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa nɛ bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe.
Zugba nɛ ɔ mi fa nɛ e kami ji si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi ji si tomi etɛ kɛ fa maa pee he nɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa maa hi.
He klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ, a kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a maa ma a wehi, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nitsɛ ngɛ.
Zugba a fa nɛ piɛ nɛ e kami ji si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, kɛ e blimi si tomi etɛ kɛ fa a maa pee Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a hi he.
A maa po mahi ha mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, ngɛ zugba klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ hanɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ po zugba kpa nɛ maa pee Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ́, nɛ a maa po mahi ngɛ nɔ.
Zugba nɛ ɔ kami nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, kɛ e blimi si tomi kake kɛ fa kɛ e se nyafii ko.
Zugba nɛ á ha ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ Nyɛ ha ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ zugba a eko.
Nyɛ ha lɛ kɛ je zugba klɔuklɔu ɔ bonyoku je huzu ɔ nya, nɛ e tsa nɔ hluu kɛ ya bonyoku je ngɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ nya.
Ngɛ beleku je ɔ, huzu ɔ ya su zugba a tsuo beleku je huzu ɔ nyagbe he.
Zugba nɛ ɔ kami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ ɔ kami nɛ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Zugba nɛ ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ ma na ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, ganɔ ɔmɛ be ye ma a blɔ nya ní kpɔe ngɛ a dɛ, se mohu a maa dla zugba a mi kɛ ha wɛtso ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mlaahi nɛ a wo ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ Israel ganɔhi, e hiɛ oo e hiɛ!
Nyɛ kpa amimi kɛ awi yemi!
Nyɛɛ ye dami sane, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
Nyɛ ko fie ye ma a kɛ je a zugba nɔ hu.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Nyɛɛ ngɔ sɛnihi nɛ hi, kɛ susumi níhi nɛ da kɛ tsu ní.
“Susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke efa, kɛ susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke bat ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a sɔ fiee; bat ɔ nyɔngma lɛ peeɔ susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke homer ɔ kake; jã kɛ̃ efa a hu nyɔngma lɛ peeɔ homer kake.
Homer nɔ nyɛɛ da kɛ susu níhi.
“Bɔ nɛ nyɛ níhi a ngmɛmi blɔ nya tomi ngɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Sɛni tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ gera a nyingmi enyɔ lɛ peeɔ shekel kake.
Shekel nyingmi ekpa lɛ peeɔ mina kake.
-“Nyɛɛ ngɔ bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ: Ngma nɛ nyɛ naa ngɛ ní kpami mi ɔ mi dlami nyingmi ekpa mi kake.
Akoko nɛ nyɛ naa ngɛ ní kpami mi ɔ mi dlami nyingmi ekpa mi kake.
Oliv nu nɛ nyɛ naa ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ mi dlami lafa mi kake.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke bat ɔ kɛ susu nu ɔ.
Bat nyɔngma peeɔ kor kake.
Tohi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ lɛe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wo zɔ kake ngɛ lafa enyɔ mi.
“Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔhi, sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi kɛ ba, konɛ a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa nyɛ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Ma a tsuo nɛ ngɔ bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ yee ɔ. Sami bɔ ɔmɛ, niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ baa Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, Hejɔɔmi ligbi, kɛ nyami be kpa amɛ tsuo nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ yeɔ ɔ, ganɔ ɔ blɔ nya ji kaa e ha mɛ.
Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e haa bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ peeɔ kusumi kɛ kpataa Yawɛ kɛ haa Israel ma a: yayami pami bɔ, niye ní bɔ, sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ.” Nyami behi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, ngɔɔ na niheyo nɛ kpa ko be e he nɛ o kɛ tsukɔ Yawɛ we ɔ he.
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ kpa musu ɔ muɔ ɔ eko, nɛ e kɛ kpa we ɔ sinya tso ɔmɛ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ we ɔ mi je kue ɔ agbo ɔ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he.
Nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi kpaago ɔ, pee jã kɛ̃ kɛ ha nɔ nɛ li e he be nɛ e tɔ̃, kɛ nɔ nɛ li kaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ peeɔ tɔmi ɔ. Blɔ nɔ nɛ o maa gu kɛ pee Yawɛ we ɔ klɔuklɔu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, nyɛ bɔni Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ yemi.
Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago.
Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ nɛ ngɔ na ku nɛ e kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, kɛ ma a tsuo.
Ligbi kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɛ nyami be ɔ yee ɔ, daa ligbi ɔ, e ngɔ na ku kpaago, kɛ agbosu kpaago nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ nɛ a sãã lohwe ɔ tsuo.
E ngɔ to akpakpo kake hulɔ kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ daa ligbi.
E ngɔ niye ní bɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he: na ku kake ɔ, e ngɔ blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa, kɛ oliv nu lita etɛ, nɛ agbosu kake ɔ hu e ngɔ blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa, kɛ oliv nu lita etɛ ja nɔuu.
“A je Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ yemi sisi kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ. Ke be ɔ su ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ maa sã jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu daa ligbi otsi ɔ mi tsuo.
A maa sã lohwe ɔ tsuo kɛ ha yayami pami; nɛ a kɛ blɛfo, kɛ oliv nu maa piɛ he.”
Ganɔ ɔ kɛ nyami be ɔmɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Agbo nɛ a sɛɛ mi ngɛ beleku je kɛ baa kue ɔ mi ngɛ we ɔ mi je ɔ, a nga lɛ ní tsumi ligbi ekpa amɛ tsuo; se Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, kɛ Nyɔhiɔhe he nyami be ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bli lɛ kɛ fɔ si.
Benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ yayami pami, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ sãe ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ nɛ gu jamɛ a agbo ɔ mi ngɛ kue ɔ kpo nɔ je kɛ ba, nɛ e ba da si ngɛ agbo ɔ sinya tso ɔ he.
E ja Mawu ngɛ agbo ɔ nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ loko e je kpo.
A ko nga agbo ɔ kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, kɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ ɔ, ma a tsuo nɛ ba ja Yawɛ ngɛ agbo ɔ nya.
“Ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ nɛ ngɔ jijɔ ekpa, kɛ agbosu kake nɛ kpa be a he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. E ngɔ blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa kɛ piɛ agbosu ɔ he, se jijɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e ngɔ blɛfo ɔ bɔ nɛ e suɔ kaa e ma ha kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ. Oliv nu lita etɛ nɛ piɛ blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa he kɛ ba.
E ngɔ na niheyo kake, jijɔ ekpa, kɛ agbosu kake nɛ kpa be ekoeko he kɛ ba sã bɔ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ. Blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa nɛ piɛ na ku ɔ he, nɛ lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa nɛ piɛ agbosu ɔ hu he, se jijɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ lɛɛ e ha blɛfo ɔ bɔ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ e ngɔ oliv nu lita etɛ kɛ piɛ he kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ.
Ganɔ ɔ nɛ gu agbo nɛ e kɛ sɛ mi ɔ nɔuu mi kɛ je kpo.
“Nyami be tsuaa nyami be nɛ ma a tsuo ma Yawɛ jami ɔ, nihi nɛ maa gu omleyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, á gu leneyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ je kpo; nɛ nihi nɛ maa gu leneyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ sɛ mi ɔ, á gu omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó gu blɔ nɛ e kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi ɔ kɛ je kpo; é gu agbo nɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi tɛɛ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo.
Ke ma a ma ja Yawɛ ɔ, ganɔ ɔ kɛ mɛ nɛ ba; ke a maa kpale kɛ ya a, e kɛ mɛ nɛ ho.
Nyami be tsuaa nyami be nɛ a maa sã niye ní bɔ ɔ, blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa nɛ piɛ na ku kake he, nɛ lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa nɛ piɛ agbosu kake he, se jijɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ lɛɛ a ha blɛfo ɔ bɔ nɛ a suɔ, nɛ a ngɔ oliv nu lita etɛ kɛ piɛ he kɛ ba.
“Ke ganɔ ɔ je e tsui mi faa kɛ ma bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e maa sã lɛ tsuo jio, sina bɔ jio, a bli agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ ha lɛ.
E sã e bɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Ke e gbe nya a, e je kpo, nɛ a nga agbo ɔ.” Bɔ nɛ a sãã daa ligbi Yawɛ ke, “Daa mɔtu ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha imi Yawɛ.
E ngɔ niye ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ he daa mɔtu kɛ sã bɔ ha imi Yawɛ: mamu kilo enyɔ, kɛ oliv nu lita kake nɛ e kɛ pɔtɔ mamu ɔ. Blɔ nya tomi nɛ kɔɔ bɔ sami nɛ ɔ he ɔ, á ye nɔ daa.
A ngɔ jijɔ ɔ, ma a, kɛ oliv nu ɔ kɛ sã bɔ ha imi Yawɛ daa ligbi.” Ganɔ ɔ kɛ zugba a Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ke ganɔ ɔ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e zugba a fa ko kɛ ke e binyumu ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko ɔ, jamɛ a zugba a maa pee bimɛ ɔmɛ a weto ní.
Se ke e ngɔ zugba a fa ko ngɔ ha e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko ɔ, lɛɛ é hi tsɔlɔ ɔ nine nɔ kɛ yaa si Heyemi jeha nɛ a kpaleɔ níhi kɛ haa nɔtsɛmɛ ɔ maa su.
A kpale kɛ ha ganɔ ɔ ekohu, konɛ e pee e nɔ́; se e bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a weto ní nɛ a na a kɛkɛ nɛ e pee mɛ hu a nɔ́ kulaa.
Ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ fami nɔ́ kɛ ha e bimɛ; se ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ko kpɔ nɔ ko weto ní ngɛ e dɛ.” Yawɛ we ɔ he kuehi Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ya tsu ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛ mi kpee omleyi je ɔ a nya.
Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi mi je kue ɔ we agbo ɔ nya ngɛ leneyi je.
A ma tsu klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ.
Nyumu ɔ tsɔɔ mi he ko ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a beleku je, nɛ e de mi ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ji he nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa hoo lo nɛ a kɛ maa sã fɔ yemi, kɛ yayami pami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ; nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu a maa ngɔ mamu kɛ pee abolo nɛ a kɛ maa sã niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ.
Ke a pee ja a, a be ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɔe kɛ ya kpo nɔ je kue ɔ mi, nɛ́ ní klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ kó ba ye ma a awi.” -Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ mi ya kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɔɔ mi kaa kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɛ kue wayoo ko nɛ kami ji gugue nyɔngma, nɛ e blimi ji gugue kpaago kɛ fa.
A kɛ tɛ fia gbogbo kɛ bɔle eko tsuaa eko kɛ kpe, nɛ a ma la tɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he tsuo kɛ kpe.
Nyumu ɔ de mi ke, “Bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ma a ma ba sã a, kuehi nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ maa hoo lo ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.”
Nyu nɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ Nyumu ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya ekohu.
Nyu hia kɛ je kpoku ɔ sisi, nɛ e be kɛ yaa beleku je, he nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ plɛ e hɛ mi kɛ kpee ɔ. Nyu ɔ hia kɛ je we ɔ leneyi je kɛ ya be ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ leneyi je.
Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ mi gu omleyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ je kpo kɛ lɔgɔ si kɛ ba agbo ɔ nɛ hɛ mi kpee beleku je ɔ nya.
Nyu ɔ ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ agbo ɔ leneyi je kɛ ngɛ bee kaa pa wayoo ko.
Nyumu ɔ ngɔ e nɔ́ susumi kpa a kɛ susu pa a gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ya beleku je, nɛ e ha i nyɛɛ e se kɛ sɛ pa a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyu ɔ ba ta ye nane kpɔ mi.
E susu gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ tsa nɔ, nɛ nyu ɔ ba ta ye nakutso nya ngɛ he nɛ wa su ɔ. E susu gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ekohu.
He nɛ wa su ɔ, nyu ɔ ba ta ye mlɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e susu gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ekohu.
Jehanɛ pa a mi kuɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ i nyɛ we ma ya hɛ mi.
Pa a mi kuɔ tsɔ, ja a sile kɛ po.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, to nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he hɛ saminya!” Jehanɛ, nyumu ɔ kɛ mi nyɛɛ pa a tue kɛ kpale kɛ ba.
I na kaa jehanɛ tsohi babauu nitsɛ maa si ngɛ pa a nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ tsuo.
E de mi ke, “Nyu nɛ ɔ bee ngɛ zugba a mi kɛ yaa beleku je, kɛ yaa Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ e ya sɛɛ Ngo wo ɔ mi.
Nyu nɛ ɔ tsakeɔ wo nyu ɔ kɛ peeɔ nyu mua.
He tsuaa he nɛ pa nɛ ɔ maa be ngɛ ɔ, lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma na pa mi lo babauu.
Ke e ya sɛ Ngo wo ɔ mi ɔ, Ngo wo ɔ ma plɛ pee nyu mua, nɛ wami he maa ba he tsuaa he nɛ pa nɛ ɔ maa be ngɛ ɔ. Kɛ je Engedi pa a nya kɛ yaa si Eneglaim pa a nya tsuo ma hyi kɛ wo hɛli nɛ a ngɛ a yahi kae ngɛ wo ɔ nya.
A maa gbe lo slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu ngɛ pa amɛ a mi kaa bɔ nɛ a naa ngɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ nitsɛ mi ɔ.
Se taku ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔsɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be tsakee; a maa nɔ ngo.
Tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa bɔ ngɛ pa a nya hiɛ kɛ pa a se tsuo.
Tso ba amɛ be nglae, nɛ a yiblii ɔmɛ hu be tae.
Nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ ɔ, a maa wo yiblii he; ejakaa nyu nɛ a naa a, Yawɛ we ɔ mi a naa kɛ jeɔ.
Tso ɔmɛ ma ha niye ní babauu, nɛ a ba amɛ ma ba pee tsopa nɛ a kɛ ma tsa ma a.” Zugba a huzu ɔmɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wo huzu nɛ ɔmɛ ha Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Ke nyɛ maa dla zugba a mi kɛ ha mɛ ɔ, Yosef ma na ngwɔhe enyɔ.
I wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ kɛ ha mɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ dla lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ha nyɛ he, nɛ e pee nyɛ weto ní.
“Zugba a we omleyi je huzu ɔ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya gu Hetlon blɔ kɛ ya gu Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ, kɛ muɔ Zedad, kɛ ya na Berota kɛ Sibraim ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Damasko kɛ Hamat huzu ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, kɛ ya na Tikon nɛ ngɛ Hauran huzu ɔ nya a. Huzu nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ ji kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya na Enon ma a ngɛ Damasko huzu ɔ nya, nɛ e be lejɛ ɔ he kɛ ya gu omleyi je kɛ ya muɔ Hamat huzu ɔ.
“Beleku je huzu ɔ je Hauran kɛ Damasko a kpɛti, kɛ Gilead kɛ Israel zugba a hu a kpɛti ngɛ Yordan pa a he kɛ ya su Tamar tɔɔ ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ nya.
“Leneyi je huzu ɔ je Tamar, kɛ gu Kadesh Meriba nyu ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya muɔ Egipt huzu ɔ, kɛ ya pi Mediterenia wo ɔ.
“Bonyoku je huzu ɔ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya hluu kɛ ya su Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ he.
“Nyɛɛ dla zugba nɛ ɔ ha nyɛ he ngɛ Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya.
Á po zugba ha nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ, Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ, kɛ a bimɛ tsuo nɛ ba pee Israel bi ɔ.
A hyɛ, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na e blɔ nya pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa Israel fɔfɔɛ.
Wɛtso mi he nɛ nubwɔ ko ba to ɔ, a ha lɛ weto ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
A dla zugba a kɛ ha wɛtso ɔmɛ -Zugba a we omleyi je huzu ɔ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya beleku je, hluu kɛ ya na Hetlon ma a, kɛ ya gu Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ, kɛ ya muɔ Enon, kɛ ya su Damasko kɛ Hamat a kpɛti.
Nyɛ susu zugba a, nɛ nyɛɛ wo huzu kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ ngɛ bonyoku je kɛ ha wɛtso ɔmɛ.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ to mɛ setsɔsetsɔ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya pue leneyi je ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Dan Asher Naftali Manase Efraim Ruben Yuda.
Zugba a fa ko nɛ a je blɔ si ngɛ kpɛti ɔ Zugba nɛ tsa Yuda nɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, á si kɛ fɔ si ha ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ ko.
E blimi nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa si leneyi je.
E kami nɛ pee kaa wɛtso kake zugba kami pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya si bonyoku je.
Nyɛ susu he ko pɔtɛɛ ngɛ zugba a kpɛti, nɛ nyɛɛ gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
E kami nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi nɛ pee si tomi ekpa kɛ fa.
Zugba nɛ ɔ fa ko maa pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́.
Kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa bonyoku je ɔ, e pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa leneyi je ɔ, e pee si tomi etɛ kɛ fa.
Yawɛ we ɔ maa ma zugba a kpɛti.
Á ngɔ he klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ je Zadok weku ɔ mi ɔ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ni komɛ ya piɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ pee yayami ɔ, a tsu a blɔ nya ní pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zugba pɔtɛɛ nɛ tsa Levi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ pee Zadok weku ɔ nɔ́.
Nɛ zugba nɛ ɔ maa pee he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.
Nyɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ zugba ko ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ leneyi je.
E kami kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa bonyoku je nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa leneyi je nɛ pee si tomi etɛ kɛ fa.
Zugba a he nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ ji he nɛ hi pe kulaa.
Á ko jua eko; a ko tsake kɛ ha nɔ ko; ejakaa e ji zugba klɔuklɔu nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Zugba nɛ maa piɛ, nɛ e blimi maa pee si tomi kake kɛ fa, kɛ e kami maa pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa a nɛ fɔ si ha ma a tsuo; a maa pee nɔ́ saisaa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; a maa ma a hi hehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ he komɛ hu maa fɔ si kɛkɛ.
A po ma ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; ma a kami kɛ e blimi tsuo nɛ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ beleku je, gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ bonyoku je, gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ leneyi je.
Á ha zugba nɛ e blimi ji gugue nyingmi ekpa kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa nɛ hi ma a he tsuo kɛ bɔle si kɛ kpe.
Ke a po ma a, zugba nɛ maa piɛ nɛ tsa zugba klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ maa pee ma a mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ a nɔ́, nɛ a maa pee a ngmɔhi ngɛ nɔ.
Zugba nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ kami nɛ pee si tomi kake kɛ fa, kɛ e blimi hu si tomi kake kɛ fa; nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je hu, lejɛ ɔ zugba a kami nɛ pee si tomi kake kɛ fa, kɛ e blimi hu si tomi kake kɛ fa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je Israel wɛtso ko mi ɔ ma nyɛ maa pee ngmɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zugba nɛ a maa gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, kɛ he nɛ a maa po ma a ngɛ ɔ tsuo a kami kɛ a blimi nɛ sɔ; e kami maa pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi hu ja nɔuu.
-Ke a susu zugba a he nɛ a maa ma Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a hi he, kɛ he nɛ a maa po ma a ngɛ ɔ, zugba nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je ɔ tsuo nɛ pee ganɔ ɔ nɔ́.
Zugba nɛ ɔ nya ya taa ngɛ beleku je; Mediterenia wo ɔ ji e huzu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda zugba a ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ Benyamin nɔ ɔ ngɛ leneyi je.
Zugba nɛ a ha wɛtso kpa amɛ -Nyɛ susu zugba nɛ ngɛ zugba pɔtɛɛ nɛ ɔ leneyi je ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo huzu kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ. Nyɛɛ dla kɛ ha wɛtsohi nɛ piɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ to mɛ setsɔsetsɔ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya pue leneyi je ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Benyamin Simeon Isakar Zebulun Gad Leneyi je huzu ɔ maa je Tamar kɛ ya pi Meriba Kadesh nyu ɔmɛ.
Huzu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ Egipt pa a nya hluu kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ. Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ dla zugba a kɛ ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ kakaaka, nɛ e pee a weto ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ - Á fia gbogbo eywiɛ kɛ bɔle Yerusalem ma a. Gbogbo tsuaa gbogbo kami nɛ pee gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
A je agbo etɛɛtɛ kɛ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko mi.
Agbo ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko nɛ hɛɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ eko biɛ.
Agbohi nɛ maa hi omleyi je ɔ, biɛhi nɛ á wo mɛ ji Ruben, Yuda, kɛ Levi; ní nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi beleku je ɔ, á tsɛ mɛ Yosef, Benyamin, kɛ Dan; agbohi nɛ maa hi leneyi je ɔ, a wo mɛ Simeon, Isakar, kɛ Zebulun, nɛ bonyoku je agbo ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsɛ mɛ Gad, Asher, kɛ Naftali.
Gbogbo nɛ maa bɔle ma a kɛ kpe ɔ tsuo, ke a susu ɔ, é pee gugue akpe eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ ma tsɛ ma a ji, “Yawɛ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!”
NYA TSƆƆMI A ngma womi nɛ ɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ haoe, nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Matsɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a nya jamɛ a be ɔ pee we Mawu suɔmi nya ní.
Womi ngmalɔ ɔ wo Yuda bi ɔmɛ he wami ke a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ; ejakaa Mawu maa ngɔ he wami ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yaya a dɛ kɛ ha Mawu ɔ nitsɛ e ma a ekohu.
Womi ngmalɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ sane tsɔwitsɔwihi kɛ ninahi kɛ tsɔɔ e munyu ɔ nya.
Womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ mi dlami pɔtɛɛ enyɔ: Sanehi nɛ kɔɔ Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ nɛ a nuu mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya a a ti ni komɛ a he.
Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ Mawu mi, kɛ Mawu tue nɛ a buu he je ɔ, a ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
Sane nɛ ɔmɛ ba ngɛ Babilonia kɛ Persia bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ yemi be ɔmɛ a mi.
Daniel na nina munomunohi nɛ ji okadihi nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ matsɛ yemi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa te si, kɛ bɔ nɛ a maa nɔ si kɛ nyɛɛ a sibi a se.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa je sisi kɛ maa je Babilonia matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ.
Daniel gba kɛ to ke, mahi nɛ li Mawu, nɛ a waa nihi yi mi ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata; se Mawu ma a lɛɛ e maa ye kunimi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ .—.
Ninahi nɛ Daniel na .—.
a. Pu mi lohwe eywiɛ ɔmɛ .- b. Agbosu ɔ kɛ to akpakpo ɔ .—.
d. Mawu bɔfo ɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ .—.
e. Nyagbe be ɔ .-
DANIEL KƐ E HUƐMƐ ƆMƐ A HE SANE Nihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ Nebukadnezar we ɔ Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba tua Yerusalem, nɛ e sá ma a yi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ Matsɛ Yehoyakim ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ Nebukadnezar muɔ june nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ekomɛ kɛ je kɛ ho.
Babilon ya.
June nɛ e muɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ e kɛ ya to e mawu ɔmɛ a nito he ɔ. Nebukadnezar fa matsɛ we nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ashpenaz ɔ ke e ya hla nihewi komɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ je Israel kɛ ba a a kpɛti kɛ ba.
E tsɔɔ nya kaa nihewi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nihi nɛ je matsɛmɛ kɛ odehehi a we mi, nihi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ a le ní hulɔ, nihi nɛ a je blɔ tsɔse mɛ, nihi nɛ a ní tsɔɔmi yi, nɛ jehanɛ hu, kpa ko be a he.
Nihewi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a hi kikɛmɛ a su nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Ashpenaz maa tsɔɔ mɛ Babilonia gbi ɔ kanemi kɛ e ngmami.
Matsɛ Nebukadnezar fa ke daa ligbi ɔ, a ha nihewi nɛ ɔmɛ lɛ nitsɛ e niye ní kpakpa nɛ e yeɔ, kɛ wai nɛ e nuɔ ɔ eko.
E fa ke a tsɔse mɛ jeha etɛ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba lɛ, matsɛ ɔ e ngɔ.
Nihi nɛ a hla a, a ti ni komɛ ji Daniel, Hanania, Mishael, kɛ Azaria.
Mɛ tsuo a je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi.
Matsɛ we nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ha nihewi ɔmɛ biɛ hehi.
E wo Daniel ke Belteshazar; e wo Hanania ke Shadrak; e wo Mishael ke Meshak, nɛ Azaria lɛɛ e wo lɛ Abednego.
Daniel muɔ e yi mi kpɔ kaa e be matsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ yee, nɛ wai ɔ hu e be nue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ko ble e he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpa Ashpenaz pɛɛ ke e ko nyɛ e nɔ ke e ye níhi nɛ a tsɔɔ kaa a ye ɔ doo.
Mawu ha nɛ Ashpenaz na lɛ mɔbɔ.
Se akɛnɛ Ashpenaz ngɛ matsɛ ɔ gbeye yee he je ɔ, e de Daniel ke, “Matsɛ ɔ tsɔɔ niye ní nɛ nyɛɛ ye, kɛ dã nɛ nyɛɛ nu.
Ke e ba na kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be nɔmlɔ tso he wami kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ juami bi nihewi kpa amɛ ngɛ ɔ, e maa gbe mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Daniel ho ya na niye ní nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ Ashpenaz ngɔ lɛ Daniel ɔ, kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo e dɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Moo ka wɔ nɛ o hyɛ ligbi nyɔngma.
Ha wɔ pui nɛ waa ye, kɛ nyu pɛ nɛ waa nu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nihewi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ matsɛ ɔ niye ní a yeɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ wɔ ngɔ to a he nɛ o hyɛ; konɛ nɔ́ nɛ o to kaa o maa pee wɔ ɔ, o pee.” Ashpenaz kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Daniel bi lɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ka mɛ ligbi nyɔngma.
Ligbi nyɔngma se ɔ, a na kaa Daniel, kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ plɔke, nɛ a wo lo nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ mɛɛ a yeɔ matsɛ ɔ niye ní kpakpa a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, niye ní kpakpa kɛ dã a nɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ha mɛ ɔ, niye ní nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ha we mɛ hu; pui kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ e haa mɛ.
Mawu ha nihewi eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nile, kɛ juɛmi nɛ a kɛ kaseɔ womi, kɛ je mi nile.
Daniel lɛɛ Mawu dloo lɛ ninahi kɛ nlamihi a sisi tsɔɔmi ngɔ piɛ he.
Jeha etɛ ɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ to ɔ se ɔ, Ashpenaz ngɔ nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Nebukadnezar ngɔ.
Matsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ tsuo sɛɛ ní.
Se nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ, nihi pɛ nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ná a he bua jɔmi ji Daniel, Hanania, Mishael, kɛ Azaria.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ piɛ matsɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ a he.
Be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ ɔ ma bi a ga womi ngɛ sanehi nɛ hia yi mi susumi wawɛɛ, kɛ nɔ́ he buami nɛ nɔ́ jemi ko be he a he ɔ, e naa kaa nihewi eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a juɛmi mi kuɔ si nyɔngma pe klaali kɛ kunya yeli tsuo nɛ ngɛ e matsɛ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
Daniel tsu ní kaa matsɛ ga wolɔ kɛ ya si be nɛ Persia matsɛ, Sirus ba ye Babilonia nɔ kunimi.
Nebukadnezar nla Benɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, e nla nlami ko.
Nlami nɛ ɔ wo e he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba pee dekla ha lɛ, nɛ e ha we nɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ hwɔ mahe.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e tsɔ ya kpee womi mi leli ɔmɛ, klaali ɔmɛ, kunya yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ ba, konɛ a ba tsɔɔ lɛ e nlami ɔ sisi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ba nɛ a ba da si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “I nla nlami ko, nɛ nlami nɛ ɔ wo ye he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
I suɔ nɛ ma le nlami ɔ sisi.” Nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ matsɛ ɔ tu munyu ngɛ Aram gbi mi ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene!
Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, moo sɛɛ o nlami ɔ ha wɔ, konɛ waa tsɔɔ mo sisi.” Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi, nɛ́ i be tsakee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nlami nɛ i nla a, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa sɛɛ ha mi, nɛ nyɛ nɔuu nyɛ maa tsɔɔ sisi.
Ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ pee ja a, ma ha a ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ maa pee we dokuhi.
Se ke nyɛ sɛɛ nlami ɔ, nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ sisi ɔ, ma ke nyɛ níhi babauu, nɛ ma wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛɛ nlami ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi sisi.” A he nɔ ekohu nɛ a de ke, “Nɛnɛ, ke o ma nyɛ maa sɛɛ wɔ nlami ɔ, wɔ hu wa maa tsɔɔ mo sisi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de ke, “I na nyɛ juɛmi ɔ momo!
Nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ mi gblae nɛ nyɛ kɛ puɛ be, ejakaa nyɛ na kaa i muɔ ye yi mi kpɔ, kaa ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi nlami ɔ, tue gblami kake ma ha nyɛ tsuo.
Nyɛ so kaa nyɛ maa ye mi lakpa hluu kaa alini níhi ma tsake.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛɛ mi nlami ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, kɛkɛ imi hu ma le kaa nyɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mi sisi.” Nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o le nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo.
Matsɛ ko matsɛ ko hu de we e womi mi leli, aloo klaali, aloo kunya yeli hyɛ ke a tsu kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ ko ha lɛ, matsɛ wayo jio, matsɛ ngua jio.
Nɔ́ nɛ nɛnɛ ngɛ bie ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee ha mo, ja mawu ɔmɛ pɛ.
Nɛ mawu ɔmɛ hu tsa pi a hi he ji nimli adesahi a kpɛti.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo matsɛ ɔ mi mi la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e fa ke a gbe ní leli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Babilon.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a fa ke a ya nuu ní leli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a gbe mɛ.
Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he.
Mawu tsɔɔ Daniel nlami ɔ sisi Daniel ho ya na Ariok, matsɛ tabo ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ a fa lɛ ke e ya gbe ni ɔmɛ ɔ. Daniel kɛ he si bami, kɛ ga bi Ariok nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo mlaa nɛ he wa kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Ariok ba je munyu ɔ kpo.
Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Daniel ho ya kpa matsɛ ɔ pɛɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke e ha lɛ be bɔɔ, konɛ e ba tsɔɔ lɛ nlami nɛ e nla a sisi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Daniel ho we mi ya nɛ e ya bɔ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ amaniɛ.
Mɛ ji Hanania, Mishael kɛ Azaria.
E de mɛ ke a fa kue ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, konɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ nɛ e je laami sane nɛ ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko gbe mɛ, kɛ Babilon ga woli kpa amɛ hulɔ.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, a je laami sane ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Daniel ngɛ nina mi, nɛ e je Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ yi.
Daniel de ke, “A je Mawu yi kɛ ya neneene, ejakaa ní lelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ he wami hulɔ.
Lɛ nɛ e haa be, kɛ yi nɔhi baa; e woɔ matsɛ, nɛ e kpaa matsɛ; lɛ nɛ e haa nɔ nile kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.
Níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa, nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa juɛmi sui he ɔ, Mawu jeɔ mɛ kpo; e le níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa ngɛ diblii mi; lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ la bɔle lɛ.
Ye nɛmɛ a Mawu, i ngɛ mo si nae, nɛ i ngɛ o yi jee.
O ha mi nile kɛ he wami; o bu wa kue fami ɔ tue; nɛ o tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ wa ma de matsɛ ɔ.” Daniel sɛɛ nlami ɔ ngɔ ha matsɛ ɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ sisi Kɛkɛ nɛ Daniel ya Ariok ngɔ nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Koo gbe Babilon ga woli ɔmɛ.
Ngɔɔ mi kɛ ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ lɛ nlami ɔ sisi.” (Ariok ji nɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa ke e gbe matsɛ ga woli ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.)
Ariok ngɔ Daniel kɛ ho Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɔ ya amlɔ nɔuu, nɛ e ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i ya na nyumu ko ngɛ nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yuda kɛ ba a a kpɛti nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo o nlami ɔ sisi.” Matsɛ ɔ bi Daniel, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ kpa ke Belteshazar a ke, “Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mi nlami nɛ i nla a, kɛ nlami ɔ sisi lo?” Daniel he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, laami sane nɛ o bi nɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ, aloo klaalɔ, aloo kunya yelɔ, aloo nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛlɔ ko be nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo.
Se Mawu ko ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ jeɔ laami sanehi kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ.
Mawu nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ je ngɔ tsɔɔ mo Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ nlami mi, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ nɛ.
Nlami nɛ o nla, kɛ nina nɛ o na, benɛ o hwɔ mahe ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Nɛnɛ, benɛ o hwɔɔ si ɔ, o nla nɔ́ ko nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.
Mawu nɛ jeɔ laami sanehi ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ mo nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se dee ɔ nɛ.
Imi lɛɛ tsa pi ní nɛ i le tsɔ pe nɔ ko he je nɛ a je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mi.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nlami nɛ o nla nɛ wo o he gbeye ɔ, a tsɔɔ mo nɛ o nu sisi.
“Nɛnɛ, o nla nɛ o na amaga kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɛ daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Amaga nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye kaa nɔ́ ko.
Amaga nɛ ɔ yi ɔ, sika tsu ngmingmiingmi a kɛ pee; e gugue kɛ e kɔnihi lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee; a kɛ akɔblee pee e mlɛ mi kɛ e fiɔhi; a kɛ dade pee e nane tsohi; e nanewɛɛ lɛɛ a kɛ dade pee fa, nɛ fa nɛ piɛ ɔ hu a kɛ zu pee.
Benɛ o ngɛ amaga a hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tɛ agbo ko nɛ nɔ ko nine sɛ he, hia kɛ je yo ɔ mi ba fia amaga a nanewɛɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kɛ zu pee ɔ. Amlɔ ɔ, dade ɔ, zu ɔ, akɔblee ɔ, sika hiɔ ɔ, kɛ sika tsu ɔ tsuo ywia wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, nɛ a pee kaa bunyuku nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ ngma mi sami he ngɛ latsa be mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ba muɔ mɛ kɛ je, nɛ a nɛ mɛ ngɛ he ko he ko hu.
Se tɛ ɔ nɛ ba fia amaga a lɛɛ e ba pee yo agbo nɛ ha je ɔ mi tsuo.
“Nɛnɛ, nlami ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, ma tsɔɔ mo nlami ɔ sisi.
Nɛnɛ, mo ji matsɛ nɛ pe matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
