Womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu nɛ he hia saminya ji kaa Mawu wo si ke e ma ha e mumi ɔ maa ba nimli adesahi tsuo a nɔ: nyumuhi, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Haomi nɛ baalɛ ɔmɛ kɛ maa ba .—.
Mawu wo si ke e maa kpale e ma a kɛ ba ma e glɛ nɔ ekohu .- Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ .—.
Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ e kɛ ha Petuel binyumu Yoel, ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma a ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ngmɔ ní nɛ hɛ mi kpata a he Nyɛ ma nimeli, nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛ Yuda ma a tsuo, nyɛ ta tue.
Anɛ nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba hyɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi nɔ, aloo ngɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ a yi nɔ lo?
Nyɛɛ sɛɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ.
Nyɛ bimɛ nɛ a sɛɛ ha a bimɛ, konɛ nyɛ bimɛ a bimɛ hu nɛ a sɛɛ ha yi nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ a se ɔ. Baalɛ kuuhi babauu ba, ba puɛ ngmɔ niba ní tsuo: Kekleekle kuu ɔ ba poo ní, nɛ a kpe.
Enyɔne ɔ ba kpe niba ní nɛ piɛ ɔ. Etɛne ɔ ba kpe kakaaka nɛ piɛ ngɛ se ɔ. Nyagbe kuu ɔ ba ye niba ní nɛ piɛ ngɛ sisi ɔ tsuo.
Nyɛ dã deli, nyɛ hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana; nyɛ wai dɔkɔdɔkɔ nuli, nyɛ nya awe; ejakaa a je nɔ́ ngɛ nyɛ nya mi.
Baalɛ babauu ba tua zugba a; a ngɛ kaa ta buli pɛ; a he wa, nɛ a he hiɛ; a lungu nya ba kaa jata ku lungu, nɛ a so hu ngɛ kaa jata yo so.
A kpata wa wai tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a kpe wa ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ.
A kpe toto ɔ ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya si tso kɔni ɔmɛ a he pee futaa.
Nyɛ nya awe kaa bɔ nɛ yomiyo nyɛɛ ya kɛ haa nyumu nɛ na we nɛ e kpee lɛ loko e gbo ɔ. Niye ní kɛ wai nɛ a kɛ ba sãã bɔɔ se po ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
Ngmɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata; zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɔmɔ e ngɛ yee; ejakaa blɛfo ɔ hɛ mi kpata; wai tso ɔmɛ gbli, nɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ ylɔ.
Nyɛ ngmɔ huli, nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ; nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ wai ngmɔhi a nɔ, nyɛ nya awe; ejakaa ngma, akoko, kɛ ngmɔ nɔ ní tsuo hɛ mi kpata.
Wai tso ɔmɛ, ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ, kɛ tã amɛ ylɔ; nɛ tso kpa amɛ tsuo gbli, nɛ a gbo.
Ma a bua jɔmi ɔ se po.
Nyɛ osɔfohi nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nyɛɛ ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana!
Nyɛɛ ya Mawu we ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ ya ye kɔmɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ tsuo.
Ejakaa niye ní be ɔ, wai hu be nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa sã bɔ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Nyɛɛ wo mlaa nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ ha hwɔ; nɛ a ba bua a he nya.
Nyɛ bua Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo a nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ we ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ fa kue ha lɛ.
Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su ta; ligbi nɛ Ope ɔ ma kpata wa hɛ mi ɔ su.
E maa pee gbeye jamɛ a ligbi ɔ!
Pi wa niba ní nɛ wa ngɛ hyɛe nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae nɛ ɔ?
Bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami se po ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ. Níhi nɛ a du ɔ tsuo gbo ngɛ zu mi.
A na we ngma a eko kulaa nɛ a kɛ maa to.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, blɛfo gba amɛ a mi je gu, nɛ a ku kɛ pueɔ si.
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ we mi lohwehi ngɛ kɛmɛe ha!
Na amɛ hao, ejakaa a nɛ nga nɛ a kpe; to ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nɔ́ nae jã kɛ̃.
Yawɛ, i ngɛ kue fae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe; ejakaa la sã tso ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nga a nɔ.
La kpata lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ nya nɔ!
Nga mi lohwe ɔmɛ po ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe; ejakaa pa amɛ tsuo gbli, nɛ la hu kpata lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Baalɛ ji Yawɛ ligbi ɔ he okadi Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Zion, ngɛ Mawu yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ bi tsuo, nyɛɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli!
Ejakaa Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su ta.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, je mi ma yu tuu; nɛ je mi tsuo pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Baalɛ maa ha yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tuu kaa ta buli nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye.
Enɛ ɔ eko bɛ hyɛ, nɛ eko hu be bae ja gblegbleegble.
A maa ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã nɔ́ ɔ. Ngɛ a hɛ kpɛ ɔ, zugba a maa hi kaa Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi pɛ; a se je ɔ maa pee zugba kplanaa.
A be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko piɛe.
Baalɛ ɔmɛ maa pee kaa okpɔngɔhi; a maa tu fo kaa ta okpɔngɔhi.
A maa tuu ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a nane si maa hi pɛe kaa ta zugba lɛhi; nɛ ke a ngɛ ní kpee ɔ, e maa pɛ kaa nga nɛ ngɛ sãe.
A maa to slɛnɛɛ kaa tabo ngua ko nɛ gba ta kɛ ma.
Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ, sawale maa nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ma tsake maa pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Bɔ nɛ katsɛmɛ tuaa a he nyɛli, loo ta buli kuɔ gbogbo ɔ, ja baalɛ nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee a ní.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ya e hɛ kpɛ tɛɛ; a ti ekoeko be e blɔ nɔ jee, nɛ nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hlami poe hulɔ.
A maa gblee níhi a mi kɛ be slɔkee, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mɛ blɔ tsie.
A maa tuu kɛ sɛ ma a mi; a maa ma fo ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a maa kuɔ kɛ gu saflɛhi a mi, kɛ sɛ wehi a mi kaa juli.
Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ, zugba ma mimiɛ, nɛ hiɔwe ma si; pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii, nɛ dodoe be kpɛe hu.
Yawɛ maa wo gbi kɛ fa e tabo ɔ he.
E ta buli ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu; nihi nɛ buɔ Yawɛ tue ɔ, a li a yibɔ.
Yawɛ ligbi ɔ maa pee gbeye.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da?
Yawɛ de ke a tsake a tsui Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui anɔkuale mi, nɛ nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɔuu.
Nyɛɛ ha hwɔ; nyɛɛ wo yana, nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ e hao nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi; se pi kaa nyɛ ma hía nyɛ tadehi ngɛ nyɛ he kɛkɛ.” Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ, ejakaa e mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ; e toɔ e tsui si; e yeɔ e siwo nɔ; e mi mi fu we mla, se mohu e kɛ nɔ́ paa.
Alini, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, ma tsake e susumi ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ e maa gbaa nyɛ kɛ niba ní babauu.
Ke e ba mi ja a, nyɛ maa sã niye ní bɔ ha lɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ wai kɛ piɛ he.
Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ; nyɛɛ wo mlaa nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ a ba bua a he nya.
Nyɛ bua ma a nya; nyɛ ha nɛ a ba pee kpe klɔuklɔu.
Nyɛɛ kpee nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba; nyɛ bua jokuɛwi kɛ bimwɔwi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.
Ayɛflo kɛ e huno po, a je kpo ngɛ a tsu mi kɛ ba.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi sinya a nya, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, a wo yana, nɛ a fa kue ke, “Yawɛ, naa o ma a mɔbɔ.
Ko ha nɛ je ma kpa amɛ nɛ a bɔ wɔ ahlua, nɛ a ye wa he fɛu, nɛ a bi wɔ ke, ‘Jije nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ?’ ” Mawu ha zugba a ba ní ekohu Pee se ɔ, Yawɛ kai e ma a, nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Yawɛ de e ma a ke, “Jehanɛ ma ha nyɛ blɛfo, kɛ wai, kɛ oliv nu bɔ nɛ maa su nyɛ nya; je ma kpa amɛ be nyɛ ahlua bɔe hu.
Ma je baalɛ tabo nɛ je omleyi je ba tua nyɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ he kɛ ho lokoo ya.
Ma fie fa kɛ ho zugba kplanaa a nɔ ya.
A hɛ kpɛ ta a ma ya pue Ngo wo ɔ mi, nɛ a se ta a ma ya pue Mediterenia wo ɔ mi.
A gbogboe ɔmɛ maa je fu kanikani.
Ejakaa a pee nyɛ níhi nɛ nya wa.
“Nyɛ ngmɔhi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye, se mohu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɛ nyɛ nya ngɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ Yawɛ pee ha nyɛ ɔ he.
Nyɛ nga mi lohwehi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
Nga mumu puɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ; tso ɔmɛ ngɛ yiblii woe; ngmɔkɔ kɛ wai ba babauu.
“Nyɛ Zion bi, nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee ha nyɛ ɔ he.
E ha gbo nyu nɛ ha nyɛ babauu; gbiɛ nyu hu nɛ ha nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa, kaa kekle ko ɔ. Ngma mi sami he ɔmɛ ma hyi tɔ kɛ ngma, nɛ muɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ wai kɛ oliv nu ngami he ɔmɛ ma hyi, nɛ a maa fo dɔ kɛ wai, kɛ oliv nu.
Ní nɛ baalɛ ɔmɛ ba ha nɛ a ye jeha babauu ɔ, ma ha nyɛ ekohu.
Imi nitsɛ nɛ i je baalɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi a ta nguaa nɛ ɔ kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ maa ye ní nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ.
Nyɛ ma je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ yi ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ha nyɛ ɔ he.
A be ye ma a ahlua bɔe ligbi ko ligbi ko hu.
Israel ma, jamɛ a be ɔ mi loko nyɛ maa le kaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ; ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu.
A be ye ma a ahlua bɔe ligbi ko ligbi ko hu.
Yawɛ ligbi ɔ “Pee se ɔ, ma plɛ ye mumi ɔ kɛ pue nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ; nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ maa fiɛ ye sɛ gbi ɔ; nyɛ nimowi ɔmɛ maa nla nlamihi, nɛ nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ maa na ninahi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma plɛ ye mumu ɔ kɛ pue tsɔli, kɛ mawayihi po a nɔ.
“Ma ha a maa na jamɛ a ligbi ɔ he okadi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ: muɔ, kɛ la, kɛ la su ku kpii.
Pu maa wo diblii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ maa pee tsutsuu kaa muɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se loko Yawɛ ligbi nguaa nɛ ngɛ gbeye ɔ maa ba.
Se nihi tsuo nɛ ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ ɔ, a ma he a yi wami.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ, ‘Nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, a ti ni komɛ a yi ma na wami; mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ i hla a nɛ.’ ”
Mawu maa kojo je ma amɛ Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma ha Yuda ma a kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ma na ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu.
Ma bua je ma amɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa ba Kojomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Ma kojo mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ye ma a he.
A gbɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ fĩa zugba kpahi a nɔ; nɛ a gbá Israel, ye zugba a mi.
A fɔ sɔ kɛ dla nyɔguɛhi nɛ a nuu ngɛ ta mi ɔ ngɔ ha a he.
A kɛ nyumuwi ɔmɛ tsake yaholi, nɛ a jua yiwi ɔmɛ kɛ he wai nɛ a nu.
“Tiro, Sidon, kɛ Filistia zugba a tsuo, mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛ maa pee mi nɛ ɔ?
Nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ he lue lo?
Ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ ma ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yayami ɔ ma kpa bu nyɛ nɔ esɔ.
Nyɛ muɔ ye sika tsu, ye sika hiɔ, kɛ ye juetli kpakpa amɛ kɛ ya wo nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ ngɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba nɔ kɛ ho ma se lokoo ya, nɛ nyɛ jua mɛ ngɔ ha Hela bi.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma kpaka mɛ kɛ je he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ jua mɛ kɛ ho ɔ kɛ ba ekohu.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee mɛ ɔ, ja ma pee nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma ha a maa jua nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ; nɛ mɛ hu a ma ya jua mɛ kɛ ha Sabea bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ma se tsitsaa.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Nyɛɛ fiɛ kɛ ha je ma amɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ ha ta; nyɛ tsɛ nyɛ ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ ba; nyɛ bua nyɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ hia ta.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ kpakplaa amɛ kɛ sɔ klaatehi; nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ tso he suami ha amɛ kɛ sɔ akplɔhi.
Nɔ nɛ he wɛ po nɛ e de ke, “Ta hwulɔ ji mi.” Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ pueɔ si ɔ, nyɛɛ ba mlamlaamla nɛ nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi.’ ” Yawɛ lee, ha nɛ o tabo ɔ nɛ ba ba tua mɛ.
“Je ma amɛ, nyɛ he nɛ sɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ba Kojomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma ba kojo je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ pueɔ si ɔ ngɛ.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ; poo mɛ ngɔ pue si kaa bɔ nɛ a pooɔ blɛfo tsohi pueɔ si ngɛ ní kpami be mi ɔ; ngaa a mi kaa bɔ nɛ a ngaa wai yiblii mi ngɛ wai ngami he kɛ ya siɔ e hyiɔ muɔ ɔ, nɛ e pueɔ si ɔ.” A ya bua a he nya babauu, akpeakpe abɔ ngɛ Kojomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
E be kɛe kulaa nɛ Yawɛ ligbi ɔ ma ba na mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii, nɛ dodoe ɔmɛ be kpɛe hu.
Mawu maa gbaa e ma a Yawɛ wo gbi kɛ je Zion yo ɔ nɔ; e gbi ɔ ké kɛ je Yerusalem.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba mimiɛ.
se Yawɛ ji wesa he kɛ ha e ma Israel ɔ.
“Israel, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ o ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ.
I hii Zion yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Yerusalem maa pee ma klɔuklɔu; nibwɔhi be nyɛe ma ba tua ma a gblegbleegble hu.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ma hyi kɛ wai nɛ ngɔɔ, nɛ na nyɔ nyu maa pɔ he ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Yuda pa amɛ tsuo ma hyi tɔ.
Nyu hɛngmɛ maa hia kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ nyu ɔ ma ya pue Akasia kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
“Egipt ma plɛ pee nga kplanaa, nɛ Edom hu maa pee ma doku.
Ejakaa a ya tua Yuda zugba a, nɛ a gbe ma a mi bi ɔmɛ yaka be mi nɛ a pee we yayami ko.
-Ma ye ni ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe yaka a a he lue; i be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ nɔ tɔli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye a he.
Jehanɛ, nimli maa hi Yuda kɛ Yerusalem daa kɛ daa; nɛ Imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ ma hi Zion yo ɔ nɔ.”
NYA TSƆƆMI Amos ji kekleekle gbalɔ nɛ a ngma e he sanehi babauu ngɛ Baiblo ɔ mi.
Amos je Yuda, se e fiɛ kɛ ha Israel ma a nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ maa pee jeha lafa kpaanyɔ loko a fɔ Kristo.
E pee kaa kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi be ji jamɛ a be ɔ; nɛ Mawu jami hu pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ saminya.
Se Amos na kaa kplɔkɔtɔ ɔ nɛ ba a, niatsɛmɛ pɛ lɛ e ba ha; ejakaa a yi dami sane ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ a waa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi.
A jaa Mawu ji nɛ, se pi anɔkuale jami; nɛ tue mi jɔmi ɔ hu, e biɛ kɛkɛ.
Amos kɛ he hiami, kɛ kã fiɛ ke Mawu maa gbla ma a tue.
E de mɛ ke a ye dami sane nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na kaa bɔ nɛ a naa pa nɛ ngɛ bee ɔ. E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Alini, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa na nimli nɛ a hɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ɔ mɔbɔ” .
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Israel huza a nɔ bi ɔmɛ a tue gblami .—.
Israel tue gblami .—.
Nina enuɔ komɛ .—.
To hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Amos, nɛ je Tekoa ma a mi ɔ, e munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Jeha enyɔ loko zugba mimiɛ ɔ, benɛ Uzia ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, nɛ Yehoash bi Yeroboam ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ, Mawu je ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ Amos ngɛ Israel he.
Amos de ke, “Yawɛ tu munyu ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔtslɔɔ lohwe ko mi.
Yawɛ wo gbi ngɛ Yerusalem kaa hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ sie.
Ba amɛ ngla ngɛ lohwehi a ní yemi he ɔmɛ, nɛ nga nɛ ngɛ Karmel yo ɔ nɔ ɔ gbli.” Yawɛ maa gbla Israel huza a nɔ bi ɔmɛ a tue Siria Yawɛ ke, “Siria ma ngua Damasko bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu; a wa Gilead bi ɔmɛ yi mi, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní a ní.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.
Ma mɛ we ɔ nɛ Matsɛ Hazael po ɔ he la, nɛ Matsɛ Benhadad mɔ ɔmɛ maa sã.
Gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle Damasko ma a, agbohi nɛ a je ngɛ mi ɔ, ma ywia mɛ.
Ma gbe nihi nɛ ngɛ Aven kɔ̃ ɔ mi, kɛ Beteden ma nɔ yelɔ ɔ.
A maa nuu Siria bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ya Kir zugba a nɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Filistia Yawɛ ke, “Gaza ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu; a nuu kɔpehi fuu a mi bi kɛ ho, nɛ a ya jua mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha Edom bi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.
Ma mɛ Gaza gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.
Ma gbe ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ngɛ Ashdod kɛ Ashkelon.
Ma gbla Ekron ma a tue, nɛ Filisti bi nɛ a he maa je tue gblami nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma gbo.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Tiro Yawɛ ke, “Tiro ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu.
A jua kɔpehi babauu a mi bi kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha Edom bi, nɛ kake peemi somi nɛ ngɛ nyɛmi kɛ nyɛmi a kpɛti ɔ, a yi nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.
Ma mɛ Tiro gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.” Edom Yawɛ ke, “Edom ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu.
A kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa fie a nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ klaate, nɛ a nɛ mɛ mɔbɔ kulaa.
Ma mɛ Teman ma a, kɛ Bozra mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.” Amon Yawɛ ke, “Amon ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu.
Benɛ a ngɛ ta hwue ngɛ Gilead nɛ a kɛ kpɔ nihi a zugba a, a pee yi wu tso níhi fuu; a kɛ klaate tsɔtslɔɔ yihɔyihi po a mi mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.
Ma mɛ Raba gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.
A ma he ose hoo ta hwumi ligbi ɔ, nɛ ta a ma puɛ ní kaa lasiogblee.
Nɛ a maa nuu Amon matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Moab Yawɛ ke, “Moab ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu.
A pue Edom matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi si; a sã e wuhi, nɛ a wɛɛ mɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ kɛ pee kalo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.
Ma mɛ Moab zugba a, kɛ Keriot mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.
Be mi nɛ ta a pee hoo, nɛ ta buli he ose, nɛ titimatihi ngɛ pɛe ɔ, Moab ma mi bi ɔmɛ ma gbo ngɔ pue si.
Ma gbe Moab matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.” Yuda Yawɛ ke, “Yuda ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu.
A yi imi Yawɛ, ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ fɛɛ.
Yaka mawuhi nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ sɔmɔ ɔ, jamɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nɔuu a se lɛ a ya nyɛɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko.
Ma mɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.” Mawu maa gbla Israel hu tue Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu.
Nimli kpakpahi nɛ a hɛɛ hiɔ, kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a wo tokota nane hiɛ kɛ hiɛ he hiɔ ɔ, nyɛ juaa mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ja i gbla nyɛ tue.
Nyɛ niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hlaa kaa a ye ohiatsɛmɛ amimi daa; ke ohiatsɛ ngɛ amanehlu mi, kɛkɛ niatsɛ bua jɔ.
Nɔ kɛ e tsɛ po kɛ nyɔguɛ yo kake naa bɔmi, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi bleɔ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ngɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, bohi nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ ba toɔ nyɛ awaba a, jamɛ a bo ɔmɛ a nɔ nyɛ hwɔɔ.
Dã nɛ nyɛ nuɔ ngɛ imi Mawu, ye we ɔ ji dã nɛ nyɛ heɔ ngɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ bu mɛ fɔ ɔ a dɛ.” Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nɛ, nyɛ ye ma!
Nyɛ he ɔ, i kpata nyɛ he nyɛli nɛ ji Amor bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ka gagaaga kaa seda tsohi, nɛ a he wa kaa tso nguahi.
Imi lɛ i je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
I kpaka nyɛ kɛ gu nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ i ngɔ Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba a kɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ e ba pee nyɛ nɔ́.
I hla nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ i pee mɛ gbali.
I pee nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ekomɛ Nazir bi.
Se nyɛ ha nɛ Nazir bi ɔmɛ nu dã, nɛ a puɛ kɔ; gbali ɔmɛ hu, nyɛ wo mɛ mlaa ke a ko de ye sɛ gbi ɔ. Ye ma Israel, anɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be mi lo?
Imi Yawɛ lɛ i ngɛ nyɛ bie!
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ ma kɛmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ tlɔɔke kɛmɛɛ ke a wo lɛ ngma nɛ́ e hyi kɛ be nɔ ɔ. Nyɛ kpɛti nihi nɛ a he sɔɔ po be nyɛe nɛ a tu fo kɛ je.
Nihi nɛ a he wa a ma gbɔjɔ; nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ be nyɛe nɛ a he mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li maa gbee senyasenya; ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nane nya sɔɔ a he be mi jee, nɛ ta buli ngɛ ta okpɔngɔhi a nɔ po a yi be wami nae.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma gbla ma a tue ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ kpakpahi po maa ngmɛɛ a ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a he kɛ fɔ si, nɛ a maa tu fo.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ Israel bi!
Nyɛ ma a tsuo nɛ Yawɛ je kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ tue.
Yawɛ ke, “Ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ, nyɛ pɛ ji ma nɛ i je blɔ hla, nɛ i ngɛ nɔ hyɛe.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔ kle agbo, nɛ e hia kaa ma gbla nyɛ tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ.” Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu gbalɔ ɔ tsuɔ Anɛ ni enyɔ hiaa blɔ nɛ a wui a sibi si ke a maa kpe ngɛ hiɛ, loo hiɛ lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɛ jata huãã ngɛ pu mi be mi nɛ e nɛ de lo lo?
Anɛ jata bi huãã ngɛ muɔ mi be mi nɛ e nui lohwe ko lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ duɔ klama nɛ a kɛ lo kɔɛ nya lo?
Anɛ klama fɛɔ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko sɛ he lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɛ ta titimati pɛɛ ngɛ ma mi nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tsui pui lo?
Anɛ amanehlu baa ma ko nɔ nɛ pi Yawɛ nɛ pee lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu pee nɔ́ ko hyɛ nɛ e ha we nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a le lo?
Dɛbi!
Ke jata ngɛ huãe ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ e tsui pui?
Ke Yawɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, mɛnɔ ma kua ke e be e sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe?
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be!
A kpata Samaria hɛ mi Mawu de gbalɔ ɔ ke e tsɔ nɛ a ya de nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɔ nguanguahi a mi ngɛ Egipt kɛ Ashdod ke, “Nyɛ ya bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle Samaria a nɔ, nɛ́ nyɛɛ hyɛ yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ lejɛ ɔ pee basabasa ha.” Yawɛ ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a mɔ ɔmɛ hyi tɔ kɛ níhi nɛ a gu ju kɛ yi mi wami blɔhi a nɔ kpɔ ngɛ nihi a dɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale po, a li.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, he nyɛli ma ba sa ma a yi.
A maa ywia a mɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa ha ní ngɛ a we saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ a mi.” Yawɛ ke, “Ke jata ye lohwe ko ta a, to hyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔɔ lohwe ɔ nane enyɔ, aloo e tue kake pɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ ba yeɔ odase.
Samaria ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ a ngɛ mle yee ngɛ sa tso bɔdɔbɔdɔhi a nɔ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ a ma he a ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ a yi wami.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue, konɛ nyɛɛ bɔ Yakob nina a kɔkɔ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma gbla Israel tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ma ywia bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Betel ma a mi.
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a he koli ɔmɛ nɛ a saa we ngɛ a he ɔ, ma ku mɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.
Ma ku wehi nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ngɔ pue si.
Wehi nɛ a kɛ suɔ wu dla a mi ɔ maa hule pue si, nɛ wehi babauu a hɛ mi ma kpata.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Amos ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ Samaria yihi nɛ nyɛ plɔke pee tɔfutɔfu kaa Bashan nahi nɛ a je blɔ lɛ mɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ waa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi, nɛ nyɛ sisiɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ, nɛ nyɛ nyɛɔ nyɛ hunomɛ a nɔ ke a ha nyɛ dã nɛ nyɛɛ nu!
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ka e he kita ke, ‘Be ma, nɛ e be kɛe kulaa, nɛ a kɛ gbowe maa gbla nyɛ kɛ ho; nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee kaa lo ngɛ gbowe nya.
A maa gbla nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ gu gbogbo puɔ nɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi tɛɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a ma sake nyɛ ngɔ fɔ he.’ ” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Israel sume ní kasemi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ ba ja Mawu ngɛ Betel, nɛ ke nyɛ ba a, nyɛ ba peeɔ yayami!
Nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ ya ja Mawu ngɛ Gilgal, nɛ ke nyɛ ya lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ ya peeɔ yayamihi babauu kɛ piɛɔ he!
Ke nyɛ ngɔ lohwehi kɛ ma bɔ sami daa mɔtu ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ yayami!
Daa ligbi etɛ, ke nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka kɛ ma a, nyɛ peeɔ yayami!
Ke nyɛɛ kɛ abolo ma Mawu si nami ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ yayami!
Jehanɛ, ke nyɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ bɔ kpa komɛ kɛ ma po, nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛɛ fĩa!
Israel ma, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ peemi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee!
“Imi lɛ i ha nɛ hwɔ ba nyɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi ɔ nɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Yawɛ ke, “Benɛ e piɛ nyɔhiɔ etɛ nɛ a ma kpa nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔ, i tsi hiɔmi nya.
I ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ ngɛ ma ko mi, se ma kpa ko mi lɛɛ e nɛ́.
Hiɔmi nɛ ngɔ pue ngmɔ ko nɔ, se ngmɔ ko lɛɛ e nɔ gbli.
Benɛ kuma miɔ nɛ e maa gbe nyɛ ɔ, nihi je ma enyɔ kɛ etɛ a mi kɛ ya ma ko mi, he nɛ a susu kaa a ma na nyu ngɛ nɛ a nu; se nyu ɔ sui mɛ.
Loloolo ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
“I ha nɛ latsa kɛ gɔgɔ kpata nyɛ niba ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Baalɛhi ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ wai abɔɔ ɔmɛ a mi; ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ, kɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ hu a kpe mɛ tsuo.
Loloolo ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.
“I ha nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba sɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ba Egipt zugba a nɔ be ko ɔ. I ha nɛ nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ gbo ngɛ ta mi, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ha nyɛ ta okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ.
I ha nɛ nyɛ ni gbogboe ɔmɛ je fu wo nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sito he ɔ.
Se loloolo ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.
“I kpata nyɛ ti ni komɛ a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Sodom kɛ Gomora ma amɛ ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he je mi ɔ ngɛ kaa la tso nɛ a hia kɛ je la mi.
Se loloolo ɔ, nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel ma, ma gbla nyɛ tue.
Nyɛ dla nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ imi, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ba kpe!” Mawu lɛ puɛ yo ɔmɛ.
Lɛ nɛ e pee kɔɔhiɔ, nɛ e haa nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa leɔ e yi mi tomi; Mawu haa nɛ piani peeɔ nyɔ mi.
Lɛ nɛ e yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ.
E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ!
A de Israel ma a ke a tsake a tsui Israel ma, nyɛɛ bu kɔmɔ yemi la nɛ ɔ nɛ imi Amos, i ngɛ lae ha nyɛ ɔ tue: Israel bi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa zangmawi!
Nyɛ nɔ ta, nɛ nyɛ be si tee hu.
A gbe nyɛ ngɔ pue nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ; Nɛ nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba wo nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ke, “Ta buli akpe maa je Israel ma ko mi kɛ ya ta, se nihi lafa pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa kpale kɛ ba; ta buli lafa maa je ma kpa ko mi kɛ ya, se nihi nyɔngma pɛ lɛ maa kpale kɛ ba.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Israel ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba pee ye ma ekohu, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami.
Nyɛ ko ya ja mi ngɛ Beersheba hu.
Nyɛ ko ya hla mi ngɛ Betel hu, ejakaa Betel maa pee ma doku, kɛ mumi yayamihi a hi he.
Nyɛ ko ya Gilgal, ejakaa a maa nuu Gilgal ma mi bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je.
“Ke nyɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ ɔ, ma ba nyɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege.
La nɛ ɔ maa sã Betel ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e gbe.” Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a pee, konɛ a yi nɛ na wami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ plɛɔ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si, nɛ nyɛ sisiɔ nihi, musu tloo nyɛ!” Mawu lɛ bɔ dodoehi nɛ́ jeɔ gbo kɛ gbiɛ.
E haa nɛ nyɔ mi peeɔ piani, nɛ piani peeɔ nyɔ mi.
E yɛɔ nyu kɛ jeɔ wo mi, nɛ e plɛɔ kɛ pueɔ zugba.
Lɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mawu he sɔɔ kɛ kpataa matsɛmɛ kɛ a mɔ nguanguahi a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ oslabai gbaa tlukaa a. Nihi nɛ kaa nihi a hɛ mi ngɛ kojomi he, kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ anɔkuale sisiisi ɔ, nyɛ nyɛɛ mɛ, nɛ nyɛ sume mɛ.
-I le kaa nyɛ peeɔ yayami agboagbohi babauu.
Nyɛ waa nimli kpakpahi yi mi.
Nyɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní.
Nyɛ sisiɔ ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ nyɛ plɛɔ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si.
Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, mɔ kpakpahi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tɛ ma a, nyɛ be a mi hie.
Jehanɛ se hu, wai ngmɔ saminyawiiwi nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ be a mi dã nue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ní lelɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ e pee ngɛ kikɛmɛ a be yaya nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ji, e ma e nya nɛ e ko tu munyu.
Nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ kpakpa, se pi nɔ́ yayami, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si saminya kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ deɔ daa ke e kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hie nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ.
Nyɛɛ suɔ nɔ́ kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane ngɛ kojomi he ɔmɛ.
Alini, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ maa na Yosef nina nɛ piɛɔ mɔbɔ.
Nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A maa wo yana ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, kɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nihi maa hi dee ke, ‘Ao!
Ao!’ A ma tsɛ ngmɔ huli po kɛ ba, nɛ a ma ba ye kɔmɔ ha nyɛ; a ma tsɛ nihi nɛ laa kɔmɔ yemi la kɛ ba, nɛ a ba nya awe.
Nihi maa wo yana ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, se pi kaa a maa muɔ.
Ke i ba nɛ ma ba gbla nyɛ tue ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yawɛ tue gblami ligbi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ e peeɔ nyɛ kaa be ɔ su ta, musu tloo nyɛ!
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, haomi ji nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ ahumi haa nɛ diblii woɔ piani katakata a, se pi manye.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ sane maa pee kaa nyumu ko nɛ tu fo kɛ je jata nya mi, nɛ e kɛ osisiblisi ya kpe!
Aloo nyumu ko nɛ je pu mi kɛ ba we mi kɛ pɔtɔ.
Benɛ e kpasa gbogbo nɛ́ e jɔɔ e he ɔ, kɛkɛ sinɔ kɔ lɛ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ maa gbla Israel tue ɔ, bɔ nɛ níhi ma ya ba pɛpɛɛpɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Diblii nɛ́ maa wo jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, e mi ma ti bɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa hyɛ nɔ́ saminya.
Yawɛ ke, “Kusumihi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ, kɛ gua pɔtɛɛhi nɛ nyɛ bɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyami ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, i hiee, nɛ i na we a he bua jɔmi.
Nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, i be ngɔe.
Lohwehi nɛ nyɛ je blɔ lɛ mɛ nɛ a wo zɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha mi ɔ, i be hee.
Nyɛɛ jɔɔ mi haomi kɛ la nɛ nyɛ laa kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ɔ; nyɛ kpa saku ɔmɛ hu, i hla we nɛ ma nu a gbi.
Se mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ye dami sane daa nɛ nyɛ ko kpa kaa bɔ nɛ pa nguaa ko hii bee nɛ e se pui gblee ɔ; nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da be tsuaa be, nɛ nyɛɛ hi kaa pa nɛ nyu tɛ mi gblee.
“Nyɛ Israel bi, jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu nɛ́ i kpaka nyɛ kɛ gu nga a nɔ ɔ, anɛ i bi nyɛ hyɛ ke nyɛ ba ke mi ní, aloo nyɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi lo?
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, akɛnɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi, nɛ nyɛ wo mɛ biɛ ke Sakut kɛ Kaiwan he je ɔ, nyɛ maa tloo jamɛ a amaga amɛ, nɛ ma ngɔ nyɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ maa ya Damasko se tsitsaa a.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ lɛ de.
Yawɛ ma kpata Israel hɛ mi Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ ngɛ Zion, kɛ nyɛ Samaria bi nɛ e peeɔ nyɛ kaa nɔ́ ko he hia we nyɛ, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ Israel ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ mi ganɔhi nɛ ma a mi bi ba biɔ yemi kɛ buami ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ deɔ nyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hyɛ Kalne ma a, Hamat ma nguaa a, kɛ Filisti bi a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Gat ɔ. Sa a, ma nɛ ɔmɛ kle agboagbo, nɛ a ngɛ he wami hu pe Yuda kɛ Israel nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ mɛ ha!” Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ tsitsɛɛ haomi be ɔ yi se kɛ ya tsitsaa.
Se níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ mohu ma ha nɛ nimli basabasahi maa ba, nɛ a ma ba kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ jualeɔ nyɛ se ngɛ sa tso kpakpahi nɛ a he jua wa a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ jijɔ, kɛ na kpakpahi a lo, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa po lahi kaa bɔ nɛ David pee ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ fia la amɛ ngɛ kpa sakuhi a nɔ.
Nyɛ nuɔ dã bami ngɛ tsimi agboagbohi a mi, nɛ nyɛ kpaa nu je via kpakpahi.
Se nyɛ yi kɔmɔ kaa a ma kpata Israel hɛ mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ji kekleekle nihi nɛ a maa nuu nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.
Nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ se maa po.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ ka e he kita ke, “Israel bi ɔmɛ a he nɔ womi ɔ, i hiee; a mɔ nguangua amɛ hu, i sume.
Ma ngɔ a matsɛ ma a, kɛ e mi níhi tsuo kɛ ha a he nyɛli.” Ke nihi nyɔngma ya laa a he ngɛ we ko mi, nɛ a susu kaa a ye a he ɔ, mɛ hu a ma gbo ja nɔuu.
Ke nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ tsɛko, kɛ weku ɔ mi nɔ kpa ko ba nɛ a ba ngɔ gbogboe ɔ, a ma bi nɔ nɛ ya laa e he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ke, “Anɛ nɔ ko piɛ o he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ lo?” Ke nɔ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!” ɔ, weku no ɔ nɛ ma gbogboe ɔ ngɔmi ɔ ma de lɛ ke, “Pee dii!
Wa ko wo Yawɛ biɛ ta nɛ e ba nu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Yawɛ wo gbi ɔ, a maa ku we nguangua amɛ, kɛ wawi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.
Anɛ okpɔngɔhi ma nyɛ maa tu fo ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ ma hu wo mi kɛ na kpakplaa lo?
Dɛbi!
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsake dami sane yemi kɛ pee duɔ; nyɛ tsake nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ.
Nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ, ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ Lodebar ma a. Nyɛ fĩaa nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, “Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wami nya nɛ wa ngɔ Karnaim ɔ nɛ.” Se Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ ke, “Israel bi, ma ha nɛ je ma ko ma ba tua nyɛ zugba a, nɛ a maa hao nyɛ.
A maa ngɔ nyɛ zugba a kɛ maa je Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ he, ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ ma ya ta Ngo wo ɔ he, ngɛ leneyi je.”
Baalɛhi a he nina Nɔ́ ko nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I na lɛ nɛ e ngɛ baalɛhi babauu bɔe be mi nɛ a poo nga kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ ta.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu lɛ nga mumu bɔni puɛmi ekohu.
Benɛ baalɛ ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a ma kpe nga mumu ɔ tsuo ta zugba a nɔ ɔ, i fa kue ha Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ngɔɔ o ma a he yayami ɔ kɛ pa mɛ!
Kɛ o ma a maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami?
Israel ɔ, ma wayoo kɛkɛ ji mɛ; a he wɛ tsɔ ko!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsake e yi mi tomi ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Dɛbi, nɔ́ nɛ o na a be mi bae.” La he nina Nɔ́ kpa ko nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ e ngɔ la kɛ gbla e ma a tue.
La a sã muɔ voo ɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ, nɛ e bɔni zugba a hu sami.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i fa kue ha Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ la a se nɛ po!
Kɛ o ma a maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami?
Israel ɔ, ma wayoo kɛkɛ ji mɛ; a he wɛ tsɔ ko!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsake e yi mi tomi ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Enɛ ɔ hu be mi bae!” Sumui kɛ e nya kpa a he nina Jehanɛ, nɔ́ kpa ko hu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ e hɛɛ sumui kɛ e nya kpa kɛ daa si ngɛ gbogbo ko he.
E bi mi ke, “Amos, mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “Sumui kɛ e nya kpa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, “I ngɔ sumui kɛ e nya kpa nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ ye ma Israel ɔ susue kaa a susuɔ gbogbo.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i be ye yi mi tomi ɔ tsakee hu; ja i gbla a tue kokooko!
A ma kpata hehi tsuo nɛ Isak nina a jaa mi ngɛ ɔ a hɛ mi.
Israel he klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ maa pee kaa kuku nɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ Yeroboam matsɛ yemi ɔ se maa po.” Amos kɛ Amazia Osɔfo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Amazia hi Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Betel.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e tsɔ ya de Israel matsɛ, Yeroboam ke, “Amos ngɛ yi mi yaya toe kɛ wo o he ngɛ mo nitsɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔ. Munyuhi nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ ma ha nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa te si kɛ wo mo, a matsɛ ɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, kɛkɛ pe ma a ywia a nɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Amos ngɛ dee ji, mo nɛnɛ ɔ, o ma gbo ngɛ ta mi.
Se Israel ma a lɛɛ a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ maa je a zugba a nɔ kɛ ho.” Jehanɛ, Amazia de Amos ke, “E maa hi kaa o je ma nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu kɛ ho Yuda ya.
Yaa nɛ o ya gba ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ o na o nya mi ngma.
Se Betel ma nɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ o be hie nɛ o kɛ gba hu gblegbleegble.
Ejakaa hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ lɛ matsɛ ɔ jaa Mawu ngɛ; hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ji ma a tsuo a jami he klɔuklɔu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Amos he nɔ nɛ e de Amazia ke, “Pi gbalɔ ji mi, nɛ pi gbalɔ bi ji mi hulɔ.
To hyɛlɔ ji mi, nɛ i tsuɔ ngmɔkɔ tso he ní.
Se Yawɛ je mi kɛ je to ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tsɔ mi ke ma ngɔ sɛ gbi ya ha e ma Israel.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
Nyɛ ke ma kpa gbami, nɛ ma ko tu munyu kɛ si Israel ma a hu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Amazia, Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘O bimɛ ma gbo ngɛ ta nga nɔ.
He nyɛli ma ba ngɔ o ma a, nɛ o zugba a maa pee ni kpahi a nɔ nɛ a maa dla.
O yo maa bɔ ajuama ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ mo nitsɛ lɛɛ a maa ngɔ mo kɛ ho, nɛ o ma ya gbo ngɛ ma se.
A maa nuu Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ maa ho.’ ”
Tso yibliihi nɛ ngɛ kusii mi ɔ a he nina Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi be ko ngɛ nina kpa mi ji kusii kɛ e mi tso yiblii nɛ fu.
Yawɛ tsɛ ye biɛ, nɛ e bi ke, “Amos, mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “Kusii kɛ e mi tso yiblii nɛ fu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Tso yiblii ɔ daa si ha ye ma Israel.
Bɔ nɛ tso yiblii ɔ fu ɔ tsɔɔ kaa be ɔ su jehanɛ, nɛ ma gbla a tue; i be ye yi mi tomi ɔ tsakee hu.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, yi ɔmɛ nɛ a hii lae ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ɔ ma nya awe mohu.
A ma sake ni gbogboehi babauu kɛ fɔ he tsuaa he dii, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he nue.” Mawu maa gbla Israel ma a tue Nyɛ jua yeli nɛ nyɛ kpɔɔ níhi ngɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ a dɛ, nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛ ma kpata ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a hɛ mi, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ biɔ nyɛ sibi ke, “Mɛni be Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ maa ta nɛ waa jua blɛfo?
Mɛni be Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ maa be, nɛ wa bɔni ngma juami ekohu?” Nyɛ yaa nɔ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, “Wa ma tsake wa sɛni tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ní juami ní kpa amɛ, nɛ wa maa sisi ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa kɛ mɛ yeɔ jua a. Wa maa jua ngma bibliwi po kɛ he jua wawɛ.
Wa ma he ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ pee wa nyɔguɛhi, ejakaa a be nyɛe maa wo a hiɔ ɔmɛ.
Ke ohiatsɛ ko hɛɛ hiɔ nɛ e nya maa su kaa tokota nane hiɛ kɛ hiɛ po, e be nyɛe maa wo.” Tue gblami slɔɔtohi Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ Israel woɔ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ka kita ke, “Ye hɛ be a ní yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
A ní yayami ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ma ha nɛ zugba ma mimiɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa hao.
Zugba a tsuo ma mimiɛ; e maa ya hiɔwe, nɛ e maa ba si kaa bɔ nɛ Nilo pa a nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ, hyiɔ nɛ e faa daa jeha a. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ha nɛ pu maa nɔ si piani katakata, nɛ je ɔ mi maa wo diblii.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Jehanɛ se hu, be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní yee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ, ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma bɔni kɔmɔ yemi jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu; ma tsake nyɛ bua jɔmi la amɛ kɛ pee kɔmɔ yemi lahi.
Ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma sã nyɛ yi nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma bu kpekpe ya bo.
Ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e bi kake too pɛ ɔ gbo; nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.
“Be ma, nɛ ma ha nɛ hwɔ maa ba zugba a nɔ; pi mi mi hwɔ, loo kuma.
Se sɛ gbi nɛ maa je imi Yawɛ, ye ngɔ ɔ, ma bɔ nyɛ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
Nihi maa wo lalaalo kɛ maa je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ maa ya Wo Ngua a nya; a ma tsa nɔ kɛ maa je omleyi je kɛ maa ya beleku je kaa a maa nu ye sɛ gbi ko lo.
Se a be ye nya mi munyu ko nue.
Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nihewi kɛ yihewi tsuãã po, kuma maa ye mɛ nɛ a ma tsɔ fia si!
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa nɔ si, nɛ a be si tee hu gblegbleegble.
Ejakaa a jaa mawuhi nɛ ngɛ Samaria, Dan, kɛ Beersheba a, nɛ a kɛ a biɛhi kaa kita.”
Nɔ ko nɔ ko he be Yawɛ tue gblami ɔ mi jee I na Yawɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
E fa ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ fia titima amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ a yi mi kpɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ wawɛɛ, konɛ tsu ɔ sisi tomi ɔ nɛ mimiɛ, nɛ tsu ɔ nɛ hule ngɔ pue ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a nɔ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, ma gbe mɛ ngɛ ta nga nɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be fo tue kɛ je, nɛ nɔ kake ngmelu po he be mi jee.
Ke a tsua si kɛ ho gbeje ya tete po, ma ya gbla mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ je kpo.
Nɛ ke a kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe po, ma ha a ma kple kɛ ba zugba.
Ke a ya laa a he ngɛ Karmel yo ɔ yi mi tete po, ma ya hla mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma nu mɛ.
Nɛ ke a ya laa a he ngɛ wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ po, ma fa wo mi sinɔ ɔ nɛ e ma ya kɔɔ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba kpaka mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ je ɔ, ma ha nɛ a kɛ klaate maa gbe mɛ.
I muɔ ye yi mi kpɔ kaa ja i kpata a hɛ mi kokooko, se pi kaa ma pee mɛ kpakpa.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, ke e ta zugba a he pɛ kɛkɛ zugba a sile, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye kɔmɔ.
Zugba a tsuo maa ya hiɔwe nɛ e maa ba si kaa bɔ nɛ Nilo pa a nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ hyiɔ nɛ e faa a. Yawɛ poɔ e we ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ngɔɔ hiɔwe nɔ́ mluguduu ɔ kɛ haa zugba a hɛ mi.
E yɛɔ nyu kɛ jeɔ wo mi nɛ e plɛɔ kɛ pueɔ zugba.
Lɛ ji Yawɛ!
Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma, nyɛ ngɛ kaa Sudan bi ɔmɛ nɔuu ha mi; i susuɔ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo nyɛ he fiee.
Anɛ pi imi nɛ i je Filisti bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Kreta lo?
Anɛ pi imi nɛ i je Siria bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Kir kaa bɔ nɛ i kpaka nyɛ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hu kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ lo?
Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ye hɛngmɛ ngɛ Israel, ma nɛ peeɔ yayami nɛ ɔ hyɛe.
Ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ ma bɛɛ nyɛ kɛ maa je je ɔ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i be Yakob nina a tsuo a hɛ mi kpatae.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Ma fa he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ ma ha nɛ a ma hoso Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa sa a mi ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔnguɛ saa blɛfo mi nɛ kake po nɔɛ si ngɛ zugba a.
Se ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti yayami peeli nɛ deɔ ke, ‘Mawu be hae nɛ nɔ́ yayami ko maa ba wa nɔ’ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma gbo ngɛ ta nga nɔ.” Israel maa te si ekohu hwɔɔ se Yawɛ ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, David matsɛ yemi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ pee kaa we ko nɛ hule ngɔ pue si.
Se be ma nɛ ma ha nɛ matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ maa da si ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ sa a. Nɛ nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛ maa ngɔ Edom zugba nɛ piɛ ɔ, kɛ je mahi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ sa be ko kɛ ha mi ɔ.” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e to nɛ e maa pee ɔ hu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ nyɛ zugba a maa ba ní babauu.
Ke nyɛ du ní ɔ, ní kpali a nine be he kpee.
Wai yiblii hu maa ba fuu nɛ wai peeli be deka nae kulaa.
Wai dɔkɔdɔkɔ ma tsle kɛ je yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ pue si.
Ma kpale nyɛ, ye ma a kɛ ba nyɛ zugba a nɔ ekohu.
Nyɛ ma ba dla nyɛ ma doku ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa hi a mi.
Nyɛ ma du wai yiblii, nɛ nyɛ ma na wai maa nu.
Nyɛ ma hu ngmɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mi ní.
Ma to nyɛ si ngɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ i be hae nɛ nɔ ko ba je nyɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ hu.” Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ lɛ de.
NYA TSƆƆMI A li be tutuutu nɛ a kɛ ngma womi nɛ ɔ, se a kaleɔ kaa a kpata Yerusalem ma a hɛ mi ngɛ jeha mi, loko a fɔ Kristo; nɛ lɔ ɔ se loko a ngma womi kuku nɛ ɔ. Edom nɛ ji Yuda he nyɛlɔ kɛ je blema, nɛ ngɛ Yuda leneyi je kɛ beleku je a kpɛti ɔ bua jɔ Yerusalem si gbeemi ɔ he, nɛ e ya piɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he kɛ ha ní.
Obadia gba kaa a maa gbla Edom tue kɛ piɛ ma kpahi tsuo nɛ ji Israel he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a maa ye a nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Edom tue gblami - Yawɛ ligbi ɔ -
Obadia gbami ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Edom ma a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ maa gbla Edom tue Wa nu sɛ gbi ko kɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ; e tsɔ bɔfo ko ke e ya de je ma amɛ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ te si!
Nyɛ ha waa kɛ Edom ya hwu ta!” Mal .- Yawɛ ngɛ Edom dee ke, “Ma ba mo si ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ o he guɛ ma gbo.
O he nɔ womi ɔ sisi mo.
O matsɛ ma a, a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ; o hi he ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsitsaa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o deɔ ngɛ o yi mi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ po ma nyɛ maa gbla mi kɛ ba zugba?’ O ya pee o hi he ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo kaa kɔle tsu, nɛ e peeɔ mo kaa dodoehi a kpɛti nɛ o ngɛ.
Se kɛ ɔ, ma gbla mo kɛ ba zugba.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
“Ke juli ba jumi nyɔ mi ɔ, a muɔɔ níhi bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ.
Ke nihi bua wai yiblii nya a, a siɔ bɔɔ ko kɛ̃.
Se o he nyɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ, a kpata o nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi.
Esau nina, a ha o june.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ o kɛ mɛ peeɔ kake kɛ hwuɔ ta a, a mlɔɔ mo nɛ a fie mo kɛ je o ma a mi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ saminya a, a mlɔɔ mo nɛ a ye o nɔ.
Huɛmɛ nɛ kɛ mo yeɔ ní ɔ hu tsɔ mo klama, nɛ a deɔ ke?
‘Jije a hɛ mi tɛ̃mi ɔ ngɛ?’ “Ligbi nɛ ma gbla Edom tue ɔ, ma kpata e ní leli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ ma ha a ní lemi ɔ tsuo se maa po.
Sawale maa nu Teman ta hwuli kpanaa amɛ, nɛ a maa gbe Edom ta bulɔ tsuaa ta bulɔ.” Mawu lɛ de.
Nɔ́ he je nɛ a maa gbla Edom tue “O nyɛmimɛ ji Yakob nina.
Se o wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ o gbe mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma kpata o hɛ mi, nɛ a ma pue o hɛ mi si kɛ ya neneene.” Mawu lɛ de.
“Benɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba ywia agbo ɔmɛ ɔ, o daa si ngɛ se banee.
Nihi nɛ ba muɔ Yerusalem june ɔmɛ kɛ ho nɛ a ya dla ngɔ ha a he ɔ, o ngɛ kaa mɛ pɛ.
Amanehlu nɛ o nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ na a, e sɛ nɛ o bua jɔɔ he.
E sɛ kaa o naa bua jɔmi ngɛ ligbi nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ nɔ.
E sɛ nɛ o tuɔ he nɔ womi munyu ngɛ a haomi ligbi ɔ nɔ.
E sɛ kaa o sɛɔ ye we bi ɔmɛ a ma a mi ngɛ a we amanehlu be mi E sɛ nɛ o ya piɛɔ nihi a he kɛ nyaa ligbi ɔ nɛ amanehlu ba Yuda nɔ ɔ. E sɛ nɛ o ya haa e nihi ligbi ɔ nɛ amanehlu ba e nɔ ɔ. E sɛ kaa o ya daa blɔ gbla nya nɛ o kpataa nihi nɛ ngɛ fo tue ɔ a hɛ mi.
E sɛ kaa o kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ se ɔ haa a he nyɛli ngɛ a fimi ligbi nɔ.
Mawu maa kojo je ma amɛ “Be ɔ su ta nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kojo je ma amɛ tsuo.
Edom, nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ, a kɛ maa pee mo.
O ní peemi ní ɔmɛ maa kpale ba bu o yi mi.” Mawu lɛ de.
“Ye we bi ɔmɛ na nɔ ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Se je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ, maa na nɔ kulaa pe mɛ, nɛ a maa ta zugba a nɔ.” Mawu lɛ de.
Israel manye yemi “Se a ma he ni komɛ a yi wami ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu.
Yakob we ɔ nine maa su a blɔ fa mi ní ɔmɛ a nɔ ekohu.” Mawu lɛ de.
“Yakob we ɔ maa pee kaa la; Yosef we ɔ maa pee kaa la lilɛ.
Nɛ a maa sã Esau we ɔ kaa a sãã blɛfo tso gbigbli.
Esau nina ko be piɛe.” Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Nihi nɛ je Yuda leneyi je ɔ maa ngɔ Edom; ni nɛmɛ nɛ je bonyoku je yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ maa ngɔ Filisti bi ɔmɛ a zugba a.
A maa ngɔ Efraim kɛ Samaria zugba amɛ; nɛ Benyamin wɛtso ɔ maa ngɔ Gilead.” Mawu lɛ de.
“Israel bi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ maa kpale ba ngɔ Kanaan bi a zugba a kɛ yaa si Zarefat.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho Sefarad ya a maa ngɔ Yuda leneyi je ma amɛ.
Yerusalem manye yeli ɔmɛ ma ya tua Edom, nɛ a maa ye ma a nɔ.
Nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa pee a matsɛ.” Mawu lɛ de.
NYA TSƆƆMI Slo womi nɛ ɔ kulaa ngɛ gbali kpa amɛ a womi ɔmɛ a he.
Womi nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ gbalɔ ko ka kaa tsɔmi nɛ Mawu tsɔ lɛ ɔ, e be yae fɛɛ.
Mawu tsɔ Yona Asiria ma ngua a nɛ a tsɛɛ Nineve ɔ.
(Daa nɛ ɔ, Israel kɛ Asiria ngɛ ta nɔ.)
Yona sume kaa e maa ngɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e le kaa si ko nɛ Mawu wo kaa e ma kpata Nineve ma a hɛ mi ɔ, Mawu be nɔ yee.
Mawu ha nɛ haomi komɛ ba Yona nɔ, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, e kplɛɛ kaa e maa ya tsɔmi ɔ. Niinɛ, Yona ya fiɛ ke a ma kpata ma a hɛ mi.
Se akɛnɛ tue gblami ɔ bɛ mi ja he je ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ dɔ Yona.
Mawu jeɔ e he kpo ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi kaa Mawu Ope.
Se nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ womi nɛ ɔ deɔ wɔ ji Mawu suɔ wɔ, nɛ e naa wɔ mɔbɔ.
Mawu suɔ kaa e kɛ e he nyɛli tete po a he yayami maa pa mɛ, pe kaa e maa gbla a tue, loo e ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha A tsɔ Yona, se e gbo tue .- Yona tsake e tsui nɛ a he e yi wami .- Yona ngɔ sɛ gbi ya ha Nineve .- Mawu na Nineve mɔbɔ .-
A tsɔ gbalɔ Yona Ligbi ko ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Yona, Amitai bi ɔ tu munyu, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa Nineve ma nguaa a mi nɛ o ya kuɛ wo ma mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ ke, i na paa kaa a yi mi wami ɔ su he ko jehanɛ.” Yona gbo tue Se Yona pue he kpa blɔ mohu, konɛ e tu fo kɛ je Yawɛ hɛ mi.
E ho Yopa ya nɛ e ya na lɛ ko nɛ yaa Spania.
E wo hiɔ, nɛ e sɛ lɛ ɔ mi konɛ e kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ya Spania, nɛ e laa Yawɛ.
Se Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko hia ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ wo kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ he wami ɔ miɔ nɛ e maa ywia lɛ ɔ. Lɛ hluili ɔmɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ e mawu.
A je tlomi ɔmɛ kɛ wo wo ɔ mi konɛ lɛ ɔ nɛ pee huyɛhuyɛ ha mɛ.
Se Yona lɛɛ e kple si kɛ ho lɛ ɔ sisi ya tɔɔ, nɛ e ya hwɔ si nɛ e hwɔ mahe vii.
Lɛtsɛ ɔ ba e ngɔ nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Kɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ; mahe lɛ o ngɛ hwɔe?
Tee si nɛ o tsɛ o mawu ɔ, kaa alini wa ní maa pee lɛ mɔbɔ nɛ e ma he wa yi wami lo.” Lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa fɔ sɔ, nɛ wa kɛ hla nɔ nɛ kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba wa nɔ.” A pee ja, nɛ sɔ ɔ ya nɔ Yona nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ mo de wɔ!
Mɛni kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba wa nɔ ɔ?
Mɛni o ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?
Jije zugba nɔ o je?
Nɛ jije no ji mo?” Yona ha mɛ heto ke, “Hebri no ji mi, nɛ i jaa Yawɛ, hiɔwe Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ pee wo kɛ zugba a.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o pee nɛ ɔ?” Ejakaa a le kaa e tu fo kɛ je Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Se wo kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nya ngɛ wae pe kekle ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee mo kɛɛ nɛ wo ɔ he nɛ jɔ ha wɔ?” Yona he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ sake mi ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ mi, kɛkɛ wo ɔ he maa jɔ ha nyɛ; ejakaa i le kaa ye tɔmi he nɛ wo kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ haoe ɔ nɛ.” Se kɛ̃ ɔ, lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ bɔ mɔde hlui lɛ ɔ wawɛɛ kɛ a he wami tsuo kaa a maa su kpo he lo; se a nyɛ we; ejakaa si abɔ nɛ a ngɛ hluie ɔ, si abɔ nɛ wo kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nya ngɛ wae kɛ ngɛ mɛ kpee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpa huhui nɛ a de Yawɛ ke, “Yawɛ lee, wa ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae, ko ha wa hɛ mi nɛ kpata ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ wami he, nɛ ko ha waa gbe nɔ ko nɛ yi fɔ, ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa li he nɔ́ ko!
Ejakaa mo Yawɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa o hɛ mi nɛ o peeɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a nu Yona nɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ mi; nɛ wo ɔ ngmɛ dii.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye wawɛɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sã bɔ ha lɛ, nɛ a wo si kaa a ma sɔmɔ lɛ.
Ngɛ Yawɛ fami nya a, lo agbo ko ba mi Yona, nɛ e hi lo ɔ muklii mi nyɔ kɛ pia nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ.
Yona fa kue ha Yawɛ Yona sɔle nɛ e kpa Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ngɛ lo ɔ muklii mi, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, i tsɛ mo ngɛ ye fimi be mi nɛ o bu mi tue.
I fa kue ha mo kɛ je gbeje lokoo nɛ o nu ye gbi.
O sake mi ngɔ fɔ muɔ voovoohi a mi ngɛ wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ, he nɛ nyu babauu bɔle mi ngɛ, nɛ o we oslɔke ɔmɛ kuɔɔ kɛ pueɔ ye nɔ.
E pee mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ a je mi we nɛ i be o sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ nae hu.
Nyu ɔ bɔle mi, nɛ i ngɛ nyu miie.
Wo ɔ ha ye yi nɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ wosuma blaa ye yi.
I kple si kɛ ho yo ɔmɛ a sisi tomi he ɔ ya tɔɔ, kɛ ya gbeje, he nɛ a sa ye yi wo kɛ yaa neneene.
Se mo Yawɛ, ye Mawu, o je mi kɛ je kikɛmɛ a muɔ nɛ ɔ mi hɛ ngmengmle.
Benɛ ye mumi ngɛ ye mi jee ɔ, i fa kue ha mo Yawɛ ngɛ o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ o bu mi tue.
Nihi nɛ jaa amagahi, nɛ ji níhi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ, a ji nihi nɛ je a Mawu ɔ nɛ sa kaa a ja lɛ ɔ se.
Se imi lɛɛ ma la kɛ je o yi, ma sã bɔ ha mo, nɛ ma ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ; ejakaa mo Yawɛ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ fa lo ɔ ke e ya vie Yona ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ nya; nɛ e pee ja.
Yona bu Yawɛ tue Yawɛ kɛ Yona tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa Nineve ma nguaa a mi, nɛ o ya de ni ɔmɛ sɛ nɛ i kɛ ha mo ɔ.” Yona bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ e ho Nineve ya.
A tsɔɔ kaa Nineve ma a kle saminya, nɛ ligbi etɛ a kɛ ma nyɛ nyɛɛ kɛ po ma a mi.
Yona ba su ma a mi, nɛ kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e bɔni kpami kɛ ngɛ a tue mi woe ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ se ɔ, a ma kpata Nineve hɛ mi.” Nineve bi ɔmɛ he Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ ye, nɛ a ha hwɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ bu kpekpe ya bo, kɛ je nɔmlɔ ngua nɔ kɛ ya si nɔmlɔ wayo nɔ, nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsake a tsui.
Benɛ Nineve matsɛ ɔ nu he ɔ, e te si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ.
E kpa e he ablade bo ɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e hi si ngɛ la zu mi ngɛ zugba.
E tsɔ kɛ sɛ pɔtɛɛ ko ke a ya de Nineve bi ɔmɛ ke, “Imi Nineve matsɛ, kɛ ye nikɔtɔma amɛ wa ngɛ mlaa woe ke, nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko sa e nya nɔ́ ko, loo e nu nyu po; nɔmlɔ jio, na jio, to jio.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bu kpekpe ya bo, konɛ a na he piami ngɛ nimli kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sɔle wawɛɛ kɛ tsɛ Mawu; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kpale kɛ je e blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ e yi mi wami ní ɔmɛ a se, kaa alini Mawu ma tsake e yi mi tomi; kaa alini Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ nya maa ba si, nɛ wa hɛ mi be kpatae.” Benɛ Mawu na nɔ́ nɛ ni ɔmɛ pee, kɛ bɔ nɛ a tsake a je mi babɛ ɔ, e kpale e nya se.
Nɛ yi mi nɛ e to kaa e ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ, e pee we ja hu.
Yona muklii mi fumi, kɛ Mawu mɔbɔ nami Se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ Yona nya kulaa, nɛ e muklii mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ hɛdɔ fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, benɛ i na we ma je ye zugba a nɔ lokoo ɔ, enɛ ɔ nɛ i na nɛ i de ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i tu fo kɛ ho Spania ya a nɛ.
Ejakaa mo Mawu ɔ, i le kaa o mi mi jɔ, o naa mɔbɔ, o toɔ o tsui si, o suɔmi tsakee we; nɛ o kɛ nɔ he yayami paa nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbe mi; e hi kaa ma gbo mohu pe kaa ma hi je mi.” Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “E da ha mo kaa o mi mi fuɔ lo?” Jehanɛ Yona je ma a mi kɛ ho beleku je ya nɛ e ya pee gba ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e hi sisi ngɛ hɔ ɔ mi, konɛ e kɛ hyɛ kaa mɛni sane maa ba Nineve nɔ lo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu ha nɛ tso ko puɛ, nɛ e ha kɛ pee hɔ ngɛ Yona yi nɔ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha e he mi jɔ lɛ.
Yona bua jɔ tso ɔ he saminya.
Se benɛ je ke e naa a, Mawu ha gɔgɔ ko ye tso ɔ, nɛ e ngla.
Benɛ pu te si ɔ, Mawu ha beleku kɔɔhiɔ ko nɛ dɔ la fia, nɛ pu ɔ sãã Yona yi mi, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa hɛli.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “E hi kaa ma gbo mohu pee kaa ma hi je mi.” Se Mawu bi Yona ke, “E da ha mo kaa o mi mi fuɔ tso nɛ ɔ lo?” Yona he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ he blɔ kaa ye mi mi fuɔ kɛ ya siɔ gbenɔ mi po.” Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Nyɔ kake mi tso nɛ ɔ puɛ, nɛ nyɔ kake mi nɔuu e gbo; o gbo we he dengme ko, nɛ pi mo nɛ o ha e puɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, e gbenɔ dɔ mo.
Nɛ imi lɛɛ e sɛ kaa Nineve sane dɔɔ mi lo?
Nineve ɔ, ma ngua, kɛ e mi nimli babauu, maa pee , kɛ se, nɛ a li kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti slɔɔto.
Lohwehi babauu hu ngɛ ma a mi.”
NYA TSƆƆMI Gbalɔ Mika je kɔpe ko mi ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ.
E kɛ Yesaya ji be kake mi bimɛ.
Mika he ye kaa amanehlu nɛ Amos gba ke e maa ba Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ, jamɛ a amanehlu ɔ eko nɔuu miɔ nɛ e maa ba Yuda zugba a hu nɔ.
Mika he ye kaa Mawu maa gbla Yuda tue ngɛ dami sane nɛ a yi ɔ he, kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Israel ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Mika sɛ gbi ɔ tsɔɔ paa kaa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha ma a hwɔɔ se ko.
Sanehi titli nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji: (a) He jɔmi maa ba je ɔ mi, nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo ma ba nyɛɛ Mawu se .
(b) A gba kaa matsɛ nguaa ko maa je David weku ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ he jɔmi maa ba ma a mi .
(c) Mika po Israel gbali ɔmɛ a sɛ gbi ɔmɛ tsuo kuku ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ hlae ngɛ wa dɛ kɛkɛ ji kaa waa ye dami sane, nɛ waa na mɔbɔ, nɛ waa ba wa he si ha wa Mawu ɔ” .
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Tue gblami nɛ maa ba Israel kɛ Yuda a nɔ .—.
A ma kpɔ ma a, nɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba ekohu .—.
Kɔkɔ bɔmi, kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi .—.
Yuda matsɛmɛ, Yotam, Ahaz, kɛ Hezekia a yi nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ha Mika nɛ je Moreshet ɔ. Yawɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɔɔ Samaria kɛ Yerusalem ma amɛ a he ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ Mika.
Kɔmɔ yemi la ngɛ Samaria kɛ Yerusalem a he Nyɛ je mahi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu po nyɛ nya.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
E ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je e we klɔuklɔu ɔ. Yawɛ kple si kɛ je e hi he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ma.
E ma ba nyɛɛ yo ɔmɛ a yi mi ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Yo ɔmɛ maa sile ngɛ e nane sisi kaa hwo gbaku ngɛ la mi; nɔ́ nɛ sile ɔ ma kpa ngɔ pue kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee ngɛ yoku he kɛ yaa kɔ̃ mi.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi, ejakaa Israel ma a pee yayami kɛ si Mawu, nɛ a tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã.
Israel atuã tsɔmi ɔ, mɛnɔ kɛ ba?
Ma nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Samaria a, lɛ!
Mɛnɔ yeɔ fɔ kaa e kɛ amaga jami ba Yuda?
Yerusalem nitsɛ!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha nɛ Samaria maa pee kaa kuku ngɛ nga nɔ, he nɛ a ma du wai tsohi ngɛ.
Ma kpɛne tɛhi ngɛ ma a mi kɛ wo kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ ma a sisi tomi ɔ maa je kpo.
A maa ku Samaria amaga amɛ tsuo dukuduku.
A kɛ la maa sã ní tsuo nɛ e na kɛ je yahomi mi ɔ. Ma kpata e wɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ní nɛ e na a yahomi mi e na kɛ je, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ní ɔ tsuo maa ya pee yahomi mi ní kɛ ha ni kpahi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mika de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma nya awe, nɛ ma ye kɔmɔ.
Ma hɛɛ ye he gu, nɛ ma nyɛɛ nane gu.
Ma huã kaa nga mi gbe, nɛ ma nya awe kaa afukpɔngɔ.
Samaria ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he pa a be tsa ba; Yuda hu miɔ nɛ e maa sɛ jamɛ a haomi ɔ nɔuu mi.
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa hɛ mi kpatami su ye ma, Yerusalem agbo ɔ nya.” He nyɛli ɔmɛ su Yerusalem ta Nyɛ ko sɛɛ ngɛ Gat nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba nu; nyɛ ko wo yana nɛ a ba na.
Bet Leafra bi, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he nɛ wuwlua si!
Nyɛ Shafir bi, nyɛ ba be kɛ ho kɛ nyɛ he gu, kɛ nyɛ he zo.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Zaanan ɔ be nyɛe maa je kpo hu.
Ke nyɛ nu Betezel bi ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ, nyɛ maa na kaa wesa he ko be lejɛ ɔ. Marot bi ɔmɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa a ma ba kpɔ mɛ, se Yawɛ ngɔ haomi kɛ ba su Yerusalem agbo ɔ nya haa.
Nyɛ Lakish bi, nyɛɛ fi nyɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ wo ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a he esɔesɔ.
Nyɛ ji Yuda ma nɛ ya wo Israel nane kɛ pee yayami, nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ Yerusalem ba pee yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda bi, nyɛɛ kɛ Moreshet Gat ma a nɛ ye sɛ.
Israel matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ be yemi kɛ buami ko nae kɛ je Akzib ma a dɛ mi.
Maresha bi, Yawɛ ma je nyɛ kɛ wo he nyɛli komɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ ma a. Israel ma nimeli kɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma ya laa a he ngɛ Adulam tɛ puɔ ɔ mi.
Yuda bi, nyɛ sã nyɛ yi nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ha nyɛ bimɛ nɛ nyɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ngmla nyɛ yi kaa okpokuhi, ejakaa a ma ba ngɔ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je nyɛ he.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi Musu tloo nihi nɛ soɔ yi wu tso níhi, nɛ a toɔ yayami peemi he ga nyɔ mi ngɛ sa mi.
Ke je na nɛ a na he blɔ pɛ, a peeɔ yayami nɛ a to he ga a.
A hɛ kɔɔ nihi a zugbahi a nɔ, nɛ a kpɔɔ zugba amɛ pani nya; ke we ko nɛ muɔ a hɛ hu, a ngɔɔ faa.
A kpɔɔ nihi a wehi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a juɔ a weto níhi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ ke, “I to nɛ i kɛ haomi maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ he be mi jee.
Ke haomi nɛ ɔ na ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ be nyɛ he nɔ woe hu gblegbleegble.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi ma la hɛdo la nɛ ɔ kɛ li nyɛ.
A ma nya awe nɛ a maa ye kɔmɔ ke, Wa yi ta pɛ!
Yawɛ kpɔ wa zugba a ngɛ wa dɛ Nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ha nihi nɛ nuu wɔ nyɔguɛ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke be su nɛ a maa kpale zugba a kɛ ha Yawɛ ma a, nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ko nae.
Ma a de mi ke, “O kɛ wɔ nɛ ko tu munyu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ko de ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ waa nu.
Mawu be wa hɛ mi si puee.
Anɛ o susu kaa a gbiɛ Israel ma a lo?
Anɛ Yawɛ tsui si tomi ɔ ta lo?
Anɛ e maa pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ niinɛ lo?
Anɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e wui mɛ ga kpakpa lo?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ te si kɛ wo ye ma a kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa he nyɛli ji nyɛ.
Ta buli nɛ je ta kɛ ba, nɛ a susumi ji a ma na tue mi jɔmi ngɛ we ɔ, nyɛ kplɔ a tadehi ngɛ a he.
Nyɛ fie yi ɔmɛ ngɛ ye ma a mi kɛ je a we kpakpa amɛ a mi, nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kpɔ ye gbaami ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ a dɛ.
Nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ho; he jɔɔmi he ko be hiɛ ɔ ha nyɛ.
Yayamihi gbegbeegbe nɛ nyɛ pee ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ a he je ɔ, a ma kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
“Gbalɔ nɛ ma nɛ ɔ suɔ ji lakpatsɛ kɛ nɔ sisilɔ; nɔ nɛ ma de mɛ ke, ‘Ma gba nɛ wai kɛ da nɛ nya wa nɛ ba ha nyɛ.’ “Se nyɛ Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ, be ma nɛ ma bua nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nya.
Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba he kake kaa tohi nɛ kpale ba a tsu mi.
Nimli ma ba ha nyɛ zugba a nɔ tɔ ekohu kɛ a he ngmlaa kaa tohi babauu ngɛ a lɛmi he.” Mawu ma bli blɔ ha mɛ, nɛ e ma je mɛ kɛ je a nyɔguɛ si himi ɔ mi.
A maa gu ma agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ je kpo, nɛ a maa ye a he.
A matsɛ ɔ nɛ ji Yawɛ nitsɛ maa nyɛɛ a hɛ mi.
Mika ka Israel hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Nyɛ Israel ma a nɔ yeli, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ blɔ nya ji kaa nyɛɛ ye dami sane, se nyɛ nyɛɛ nɔ́ kpakpa, nɛ nyɛ suɔ yayami mohu.
Nyɛ kpɔɔ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he womi hɛ ngmengmle kɛ jeɔ a wuhi a he.
Nyɛ yeɔ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ kpɔɔ a he womi kɛ jeɔ a he.
Nyɛ kuɔ a wuhi, nɛ nyɛ poɔ mɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya kaa lo nɛ a kɛ maa wo kutu mi.
Be ma nɛ nyɛ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, se e be nyɛ nya mi poe.
E be nyɛ kue fami ɔ tue bue, ejakaa nyɛ pee yayami.
Nyɛ lakpa gbali nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye ma a sisie!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ gbaa he jɔmi kɛ haa nihi nɛ haa nyɛ ní nɛ nyɛ yeɔ; nɛ nyɛ woɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ha we nyɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ a susuma he gbeye!
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, “Nyɛ ligbi ɔ nya ta, nɛ du miɔ nɛ e ma bu nyɛ.
Nyɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ be ní nae hu; ke diblii wo ɔ, nyɛ be klaae hu.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Zo maa gbe gbali ɔmɛ kɛ klaali ɔmɛ; mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ma ma a nya.
Ke a gba a, e be mi bae fɛɛ, ejakaa a be sɛ gbi ko nae kɛ je Mawu ngɔ hu.
Se imi lɛɛ Yawɛ ngɔ e mumi ɔ kɛ wo ye mi tɔ.
E ha mi he wami, kɛ dami sane yemi, kɛ kã nɛ ma kɛ jaje Israel ma a he yayami ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Nyɛ Israel ma nɔ yeli!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yi dami sane, nɛ nyɛ plɛɔ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si!
Nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Mawu ma, Yerusalem ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mae ɔ, muɔ si puemi kɛ yayami peemi lɛ nyɛ kɛ fia.
Ma nimeli ɔmɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní loko a buá sane he; osɔfo ɔmɛ heɔ hiɔwo loko a tsɔɔ mlaa a sisi; gbali ɔmɛ heɔ sika loko a gbaa.
Se mɛ tsuo a buɔ Mawu kua pɛɛ nɛ a deɔ ke, “Yawɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ; nɔ́ ko nɔ ko be wɔ pee!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he ɔ, a maa pee Zion kaa ngmɔ nɛ a hu.
Yerusalem maa pee ma doku, nɛ yo ɔ nɔ he nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ maa si ngɛ ɔ maa hɛ, nɛ e maa pee pú.
Yawɛ maa ye matsɛ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi Nyagbe be ɔ mi ɔ, yo ɔ nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ ma ba pee yo nɛ he biɛ pe yo ɔmɛ tsuo.
Je mahi babauu ma ba hyɛ, nɛ a ma de a sibi ke, “Nyɛ ha waa kuɔ Yawɛ ɔ kɛ ya Israel Mawu ɔ we ɔ. E maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ kaa waa pee, nɛ wa maa nyɛɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ mlaa a maa je Zion; e kɛ e ma a maa tu munyu kɛ je Yerusalem.” E ma dla je ma nguanguahi babauu a kpɛti, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he kɛ we, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.
A kɛ a klaate ɔmɛ maa sɔ̃ kpakplaahi nɛ akplɔ ɔmɛ hu, a kɛ maa sɔ̃ tso he suami hahi.
Je ma amɛ be ta hwue hu gblegbleegble; a be dlae kɛ ha ta hu kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi ngɛ e wai tso, loo e ngmɔkɔ tso sisi, nɛ nɔ ko be nɔ ko he gbeye woe.
Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Je ma amɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ jaa lɛ nitsɛ e mawu.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ, ji nɔ nɛ wa ma sɔmɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Israel maa kpale kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi kɛ ba Yawɛ ke, “Nihi nɛ i gbla a tue, nɛ a na nɔ́ ngɛ nyɔguɛ si himi mi ɔ, be ma, nɛ ma bua jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nya ekohu.
Akpaketsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma se lokoo ɔ, ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba we ekohu; nɛ ma pee mɛ ma agbo.
Ma hi Zion Yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ a nɔ, kɛ maa je jamɛ a be ɔ mi, kɛ maa ya neneene.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Nɛ mo Yerusalem, he nɛ Mawu hii nɛ e kɛ hyɛɛ e ma a nɔ kaa to hyɛlɔ ɔ, o he wami kɛ o blɔ nya nɛ o hɛɛ kaa matsɛ ma a, o maa kpale na ekohu.
Mawu lɛ de.
Mɛni he je o ngɛ ngmlaa kpae wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi ɔ?
Anɛ matsɛ be o dɛ lo?
Anɛ o ga woli ɔmɛ gbo lo?
Nyɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he nɛ wuwlua si, nɛ nyɛ kɛmɛ kaa yo nɛ ngɛ kɔe.
Ejakaa jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa je ma a mi kɛ ya hi nga nɔ.
A maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya Babilon tɔɔ.
Se Yawɛ ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Je mahi babauu ba bua ngɔ wo nyɛ he konɛ a tua nyɛ.
A ke, “Ja wa kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi!
Wa maa na kɛ wa hɛngmɛ kaa ma nɛ ɔ pee ma doku!” Se je ma nɛ ɔmɛ li Yawɛ yi mi, loo ga nɛ e to.
A li tete kaa Yawɛ bua a nya konɛ e gbla a tue kaa bɔ nɛ a gbeeɔ blɛfo ngɛ tso mi ɔ. Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya gbla nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue!
Ma ha nyɛ dade tso nyɛ, kɛ dade tso mi bihi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa gbee je mahi babauu.
Nyɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ níhi nɛ a kpɔ pani nya ngɛ nihi a dɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ba ha imi, je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Mawu lɛ de.
Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya!
A sa ma a yi!
A ba tua Israel hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ!
Nɔ yelɔ ko maa je Betlehem Yawɛ ke, “Mo Betlehem Efrata, Yuda ma amɛ a kpɛti nyafii kake kɛkɛ ji mo; se ma ha nɔ ko maa je o mi ba ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo nɔ.
Matsɛ nɛ ɔ weku kpa ngɛ kɛ je blema be ɔ mi tɔɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ maa ngmɛɛ e ma a he kɛ yaa si be nɛ nɔ nɛ nu kɔɔmi ɔ ma fɔ e bi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bi nɛ ɔ nyɛmimɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, maa kpale kɛ ba a nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ ekohu.
Ke matsɛ nɛ ɔ ba a, e maa ye e ma a nɔ kɛ he wami, kɛ kã nɛ je Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ ngɔ.
E ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, ejakaa a maa bu lɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
E kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba.
Kpɔmi kɛ tue gblami Ke Asiria bi ɔmɛ ba wa zugba a nɔ nɛ a ba tua wa mɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, wa ma ha wa katsɛmɛ kpanaa amɛ nɛ nyɛɛɔ wa hɛ mi ɔ maa ya nɛ a kɛ mɛ ma ya hwu ta.
A kɛ klaate maa ye Asiria bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ a ma je wɔ kɛ je Asiria bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, ke a ba tua wa zugba a. Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ je mahi babauu ma na bua jɔmi ekohu kaa bɔ́ nɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ, aloo hiɔmi nɛ́ nɛ ngɔ pue nga nɔ.
A maa ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, se pi nɔmlɔ nɔ.
Israel bi nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti ɔ, a he ma ba wa kaa jata ngɛ pu mi lohwehi, loo we mi lohwehi a kpɛti.
Ke e sɛ a kpɛti kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e maa naa a nɔ, nɛ e ma tsɔtslɔɔ a mi nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ mɛ.
Israel maa ye e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ e ma kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi.
Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma kpɔ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, nɛ ma kpata nyɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ma kpata ma amɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma ku nyɛ mɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.
Ma kpata nyɛ kunya yeli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ a be klaalɔ ko nae ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti hu.
Ma ywia nyɛ amaga amɛ, nɛ ma hule nyɛ wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛ be níhi nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ pee kɛ nyɛ nine sɔmɔe hu.
Amagahi nɛ nyɛ puɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ ngɔ ha yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a, ma ku mɛ tsuo; nɛ ma kpata nyɛ ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
I kɛ mi mi la nɛ nya wa maa gbla je mahi tsuo nɛ bui mi ɔ a tue kɛ ye ye he lue.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Yawɛ kɛ Israel ná Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma Israel dee ɔ tue.
Yawɛ, tee si nɛ o jaje o sane ɔ; ha nɛ yo ɔmɛ kɛ yoku ɔmɛ nɛ a nu o gbi.
Nyɛ yohi, nyɛɛ bu munyuhi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ e ma a nya poe ɔ tue!
Nyɛ zugba a sisi tomihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ daa, nyɛ ta tue!
Yawɛ kɛ e ma, Israel na, nɛ e maa jaje e sane ɔ. Yawɛ ke, “Ye ma, mɛni i pee nyɛ?
Anɛ i ha nɛ pɔ tɔ nyɛ lo?
Nyɛ ha mi heto.
I je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ; i je nyɛ kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi; i tsɔ Mose, Aaron, kɛ Miriam nɛ a ya kpaka nyɛ kɛ ba.
Ye ma, nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ Moab matsɛ, Balak to nɛ e maa pee nyɛ, kɛ heto nɛ Beor binyumu Balaam ha lɛ.
Nyɛ kai níhi nɛ ba ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ je nyɛ si tomi he ɔ ngɛ Shitim kɛ ya Gilgal ɔ. Nyɛ kai ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ na bɔ nɛ i pee kɛ he nyɛ yi wami.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ hlae Ke i ma nɛ ma ba ja Yawɛ, hiɔwe Mawu ɔ, mɛni ma hɛɛ kɛ ba ha lɛ?
Anɛ ma ngɔ na bihi nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka kɛ ba sá sami bɔ ha lɛ lo?
Anɛ Yawɛ ma na bua jɔmi, ke i ba ha lɛ agbosu akpehi, loo nu nɛ hiɛ babauu kaa pa nɛ ngɛ bee lo?
Anɛ ma ngɔ ye kekleekle bi ba ha lɛ kɛ wo ye yayami ɔmɛ a he hiɔ lo?
Dɛbi!
Yawɛ tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi.
Nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ngɛ wa dɛ kɛkɛ ji kaa waa ye dami sane, nɛ waa na mɔbɔ, nɛ waa ba wa he si ha wa Mawu ɔ. E hi kaa a ye Yawɛ gbeye.
Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem dee ke, “Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ ma a mi, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ ba hiɛ tsɔ!
Sisimi blɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ guɔ kɛ naa ní ɔ, anɛ nyɛ be kpae lo?
Yayami peeli a wehi a mi hyi tɔ kɛ june nɛ a kpɔ ngɛ nihi a dɛ.
A kɛ sɛni tɛ nɛ sui ngmɛɔ níhi.
I nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ sɛni yayahi, kɛ sɛni tɛhi nɛ sui kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, anɛ ma ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ lo?
Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ sisiɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, lakpatsɛmɛ ji nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i je sisi bɔni nyɛ tue gblami momo; ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Nyɛ maa ye ní, se nyɛ be tɔe; anɔkuale mi ɔ, hwɔ maa hi nyɛ yee kɛ sa.
Nyɛ maa muɔ níhi kɛ ya, se nyɛ be nyɛe kɛ to; ke nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ ko to po, ma kpata hɛ mi ngɛ ta mi.
Nyɛ ma du ní, se nyɛ be ní kpae.
Nyɛ maa nga oliv yiblii kɛ pee nu, se nyɛ be nu kpae.
Nyɛ maa pee wai, se nyɛ be nue.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi, ejakaa nyɛ ya ye Matsɛ Omri mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ níhi nɛ e bi Ahab pee ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ pee jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ nɔuu.
Nyɛ ya nyɛɛ a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Je ma amɛ ma li nyɛ, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na nyɛ ɔ maa hie nyɛ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Israel puɛ Akuanyɛ!
I pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ hwɔ gbe lɛ, nɛ e nɛ tso yiblii ko ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a nɔ, aloo wai yiblii ko ngɛ wai tso ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ e ye.
A kplɔ wai yiblii ɔmɛ, kɛ ngmɔkɔ nganangana amɛ tsuo ta.
Anɔkualetsɛmɛ ta zugba a nɔ; dalɔ kake ngmelu po be.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ blɔ ko hlae nɛ e kɛ pue muɔ si; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi klama tsɔe.
Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a he sɔɔ kɛ yayami peemi.
Ma ní tsuli kɛ kojoli heɔ nyɔ mi ní.
Niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ heɔ mɛ kɛ sika.
A tsɔɔ mɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ a suɔ kaa a pee ha mɛ, nɛ a peeɔ kɛ haa mɛ.
A ti ni kpakpahi, loo ni nɛmɛ nɛ da pe kulaa po, a ngɛ kaa nga kɛkɛ; a he be se nami.
Be ɔ nɛ Mawu maa gbla e ma a tue ɔ su ta; haomi kɛ he hiami, kɛ hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ su ta.
Nyɛ ko he nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nyɛɛ ye; nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ huɛmɛ a nɔ; yo nɛ o kɛ lɛ hwɔɔ si po, hyɛ o nya nɔ ngɛ e he.
Ejakaa be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, binyumuhi bui a tsɛmɛ hu; biyihi teɔ si kɛ woɔ a nyɛmɛ, nɛ nganyɛmɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ nganyɛmɛ.
Nɔmlɔ adesa he nyɛli ji lɛ nitsɛ e we mi bi.
Se imi lɛɛ, ma hyɛ Yawɛ blɔ.
I kɛ ye hɛ maa fɔ Mawu nɔ, ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma he ye yi wami.
Ye Mawu ɔ maa bu mi tue.
Yawɛ ma he e ma a yi wami E sɛ kaa wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ yeɔ wa he fɛu.
Wa nɔ si lɛɛ, se wa maa te si ekohu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ wa ngɛ diblii mi, se Yawɛ ma ha wɔ la.
Wa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e mi mi fu wɔ ɔ, wa ma na tsui.
Ejakaa e ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ e maa gbla a tue ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee wɔ ɔ he.
Yawɛ maa ngɔ wɔ kɛ ba la a he, nɛ wa maa na kaa e ma he wa yi wami.
Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ.
Mɛ lɛ a ye wa he fɛu nɛ a bi wɔ ke, “Jije Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ?” Wa maa na kaa a ye a nɔ kunimi, nɛ a naa a nɔ kaa mɔsɔ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, be ma nɛ a maa fia gbogbo kɛ wo nyɛ ma a he ekohu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa hɛ nyɛ huzu ɔ mi kɛ maa ya se tsitsaa.
Nyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.
A maa je Asiria ngɛ bonyoku je, kɛ Egipt ngɛ leneyi je.
A maa je Yufrate pa a he, kɛ wo se, kɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsitsaa lokoo kɛ ba.
Se zugba a hɛ mi ma kpata; ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ.
A fa kue ha Yawɛ Yawɛ, moo hyɛ o ma a nɛ o hla a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ e tohi.
E ngɛ mi kaa a gbɛ ngɔ fia nga a nɔ mohu, se zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní bɔle mɛ.
Ha nɛ a ya ye Bashan kɛ Gilead zugba kpakpa amɛ a nɔ ní kaa bɔ nɛ a pee blema a. Yawɛ, moo pee nyakpɛ níhi ha wɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ o pee be ko benɛ o je wɔ kɛ je Egipt ɔ. Je ma amɛ maa na enɛ ɔ, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ.
A ma yɔse kaa mamoo a he wami ɔ sui he ko saasaa.
Sawale maa nu mɛ; a ma ma a nya, nɛ a kɛ a nine nguɛhi maa hɔɔ a tue puɔ mi.
A maa sã si ngɛ tabo zu mi kaa sinɔhi.
A kɛ he domi kɛ gbeye yemi maa je a mɔ ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba Yawɛ, wa Mawu ngɔ.
Yawɛ, mawu kpa ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ.
O ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ, o kɛ a he yayami paa mɛ.
O mi mi fu we kɛ yɛ neneene, se mohu ɔ, o suɔ kaa o je o suɔmi nɛ se pui gblegbleegble ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ.
O maa na wɔ mɔbɔ ekohu.
O kɛ o nane maa naa wa ní yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o maa muɔ kɛ ya wo wo mi, kɛ yaa su wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ!
Wɔ o ma, Abraham kɛ Yakob a nina a, o maa gbaa wɔ, nɛ o maa na wɔ mɔbɔ daa kaa bɔ nɛ o wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si blema lokoo ɔ.
NYA TSƆƆMI A ngma Nahum womi ɔ ngɛ asilɛ munyu tumi blɔ nɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛli kɛ je blema lokoo ji Asiria bi yiwutsotsɛmɛ.
He nyɛli nɛ ɔmɛ a matsɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Nineve ɔ ba ywia maa pee jeha lafa kpaago loko a fɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo.
Asilɛte ɔ ngɛ nyae kaa Mawu gbla ma yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ he nɔ woli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ a tue.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha A gbla Nineve tue .- A kpata Nineve hɛ mi .—.
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Nineve ma a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nina nɛ Nahum nɛ je Elkosh ɔ na ngɛ Nineve he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ mi mi fu Nineve Yawɛ Mawu ɔ, a kɛ lɛ plee we nɔ́ he; e gblaa nihi nɛ tee si kɛ woɔ lɛ ɔ a tue.
E gblaa e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue bɔ nɛ sa mɛ kɛ yeɔ e he lue.
Yawɛ mi mi fu we mla, se kɛ̃ ɔ, e we abofu nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ nɔ tɔli yeɔ a he kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Yawɛ jeɔ e he wami kpo ngɛ lasiogblee kɛ ahumi mi; nɛ bɔku ngɛ kaa e nane se bunyuku!
Ke Yawɛ wo gbi ɔ, wo miiɔ nɛ e peeɔ zugba gbigbli, nɛ pahi gbliɔ.
Lohwehi a ní yemi he kpakpahi nɛ ngɛ Bashan kɛ Karmel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nglaa; nɛ Lebanon mɔmɔ ɔmɛ taa.
Yoku mimiɛɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; nɛ yokuhi sileɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Ke Yawɛ je e he kpo ɔ, zugba a mimiɛɔ; nɛ je ɔ, kɛ e mi nimli ɔmɛ tsuo a he doɔ blibliibli.
Ke e mi mi fu ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa da nya?
Ke e hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ yi ma na wami?
Ke e je e mi mi la glegleegle ɔ kpo ɔ, tɛ sahi peeɔ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ kaa bunyuku ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Yawɛ mi mi hi; e ngɛ kaa mɔ nɛ he wa ha nihi nɛ ngɛ haomi mi; nɛ nihi nɛ ba saa we ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, e baa a yi.
E kpataa e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ pa nguaa nɛ ngɛ bee kɛ fo kpataa níhi a hɛ mi ɔ; e gbeɔ nihi nɛ tee si woɔ lɛ ɔ. Mɛni yi mi yayami nyɛ ngɛ toe ngɛ Yawɛ he ɔ?
E ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ lɛ kpe si kake pɛ nɔ ɔ nyagbe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ a buaa mio tsohi, kɛ go gbigbli nya nɛ a sãã a, jã e maa sã nyɛ butuu!
Mo Nineve, o mi nɛ nɔ ko je, nɛ e to yi mi yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Israel ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “E ngɛ mi kaa Asiria bi ɔmɛ a he wa, nɛ a he hiɛ babauu lɛɛ, se a ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a be mɛ nae hu.
Ye ma, imi nitsɛ nɛ i ha nɛ nyɛ na amanehlu ɔ nɛ, se i be nyɛ tue gblae hu.
Ma ha nɛ Asiria nɔ yemi ɔ se maa po, nɛ ma kplɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he.” Kita nɛ Yawɛ ka ngɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “A nina ko be si hie; a biɛ maa laa.
Ma poo amaga amɛ nɛ ngɛ a wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ngɔ pue he.
I ngɛ yɔkɔ tsuae ngɔ to Asiria bi ɔmɛ, ejakaa e sɛ kaa a hi je mi!” Hyɛ, tsɔlɔ ko ma ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ manye munyu.
E ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ dee ke wa ye kunimi.
Yuda ma, nyɛɛ ye nyami ligbi ɔmɛ.
Si nɛ nyɛ wo Mawu veveeve ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ be bae nɛ a ba tua nyɛ zugba a hu.
Ejakaa a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
A kpata Nineve hɛ mi Nineve, ta tua mo!
Nyɛ ya da nyɛ blɔ hehi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he!
Nyɛɛ bu blɔ ɔmɛ a he!
Nyɛɛ mia kɛ ha ta!
(Yawɛ miɔ nɛ e wo Israel hɛ mi nyami ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ sa loko he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba kpata ngmɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ).
He nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta buli ɔmɛ hɛɛ tsɛ̃i tsutsuuhi, nɛ a wo tade tsutsuuhi.
A bɔni ta gbami, konɛ a tua ma a!
A ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la!
A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ tue glɛi, glɛi, glɛi!
Ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ si poe hliididididi ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngɛ fo sae kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae ngɛ ma kpe he ɔmɛ.
A ngɛ kpɛe kaa jatɛ; nɛ a ngɛ gbae kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae kaa oslabai.
A tsɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ benɛ a hɛɛ fo kitikiti kɛ yaa a, a ngɛ si tɛe.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ a he sɔ kɛ ya su gbogbo ɔ he, nɛ a wo tsɛ̃i ɔ nɔ kɛ ma si.
Tlukaa a, agbo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ pa a nya a bli, nɛ sawale nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi.
A nu manyɛ ɔ kɛ ho; e mawayi ɔmɛ wo yana kɛ gbi nɛ ngɛ kaa lahuɛhi a gbi, nɛ a gba a gugue ma kɛ ye kɔmɔ.
Nineve ma mi bi ɔmɛ bu kɛ je kpo kɛ je ma a mi kɛ fo kaa bɔ nɛ nyu bee yayaaya kɛ jee taku nɛ gba dɔ tlukaa mi ɔ.
A nu ngmlaa ke, “Nyɛɛ da si!
Nyɛɛ da si!” Se nɔ ko nɔ ko plɛ we nɛ e hyɛ e se.
Nyɛɛ ha sika hiɔ!
Nyɛɛ ha sika tsu!
Juetli hyi ma a tɔ!
Nineve hɛ mi kpata; nimli ɔmɛ ta ma a mi, nɛ ma a pee ma doku!
Sawale nu ni ɔmɛ tsuo; a nabɛni mi ngɛ doe blibliibli; a he wami ta, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Jehanɛ, ma nɛ ngɛ kaa jatahi a hi he ɔ, jije e ngɛ?
Ma nɛ a haa jata bihi ní ngɛ mi ɔ, jije e ngɛ?
He nɛ jata ku, kɛ jata yo ngɔɔ a bihi kɛ yaa, konɛ nɔ́ ko kó sa a he ɔ, jije e ngɛ?
Jata ku ɔ ya gbe de lo, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ mi kɛ ha jata yo ɔ, kɛ e bi ɔmɛ; lo ɔ hyi e hi he ɔ tɔ.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “I kɛ mo ná!
Ma sã o ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ.
Ma kpata o ta buli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ ta mi.
Níhi tsuo nɛ o kpɔ ngɛ nihi a dɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ.
A be o he wami he nue hu ngɛ je ɔ mi.”
Mo Nineve ma, ma nɛ lakpa sɔuu a yeɔ ngɛ o mi, ma nɛ a pueɔ muɔ si ngɛ mi, ma nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a kpɔ ngɛ nihi a dɛ, musu tloo mo!
Bu tue!
Okpɔngɔ kpa amɛ ngɛ pɛe fioko, fioko!
Tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ pɛe kpata, kpata!
Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ tue glɛi, glɛi, glɛi!
Nɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ si hɛe kplalala, kplalala!
Ta buli nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ ba tua ma a; klaate ɔmɛ ngɛ la pãe nylamnylam!
Nɛ akplɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kpɛe plamplam!
A bua ni gbogboe ɔmɛ a nya glekuuglekuu; nihi nɛ gbo ɔ hiɛ babauu; a li a yibɔ; a ngɛ mɛ tɛe, nɛ a ngɛ a nɔ nɔe ngɛ a blɔ mi!
Mɛni kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba?
Nineve, ma nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ mi bi kunya yeli, kɛ azetsɛmɛ ya sisi je ma amɛ, nɛ a ya ja a wɔ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ yo yaholɔ puɛɔ ma a. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Nineve, ma gbla o tue!
Ma ha nɛ o maa hɛɛ o he gu, nɛ ma ha nɛ je ma amɛ maa na mo paslapaa kɛ o he zo ɔ tsuo.
Ma pue o hɛ mi si, nɛ o maa pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ a plɛ níhi nɛ a hiee ngɔ pue e nɔ.
Nihi maa hyɛ mo gaa, nɛ a maa ye gbeye.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na mo ɔ he mi maa po.
E ma de ke, ‘Akuanyɛ!
Nineve hɛ mi kpata pɛ!
Mɛnɔ ma ba ye lɛ kɔmɔ?
Mɛnɔ ma ba wo lɛ bua?’ ” Nineve, anɛ o hi pe Egipt matsɛ ma Tebes ɔ lo?
Lɛ hu tse Nilo pa a bɔle lɛ kaa gbogbo nɛ faa e he lo?
Tebes nɛ yeɔ Sudan kɛ Egipt tsuo a nɔ; nɛ e he wa kaa nɔ́ ko.
Put kɛ Libia piɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ hwu ta a!
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nuu Tebes bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.
A fiaa jokuɛwi ɔmɛ ní nɛ a gbe ngɛ ma a mi blɔ ɔmɛ a kɔ nya amɛ tsuo.
A nuu a ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ a wo mɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ kɛ ho.
A dla mɛ ngɔ ha nihi nɛ ba nuu mɛ ɔ. Nineve, mo hu o maa pee kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã!
O ma hla kaa o maa je o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
O mɔ nguangua amɛ tsuo maa pee kaa ngmɔkɔ tsohi nɛ a nɔ yiblii fu.
Nɔ ko nɛ huanya tso ɔ piɔ kaa yiblii ɔmɛ be tsɔe ba nɔ nɔ ɔ nya mi klom lo!
O ta buli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa yihi pɛ; ke he nyɛli ba tua ma a, nɔ ko be nyɛe maa te si kɛ wo mɛ.
La maa sã agbo ɔmɛ a se lami ní ɔmɛ.
Yaa yɛ nyu ngɔ to; a ma ba sa ma a yi.
Dla o mɔ nguangua amɛ!
Moo naa zu nɛ o kɛ maa pee bliikisi, nɛ o dla bliikisi peemi daka amɛ kɛ to si!
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ja a sã mo, loo ja o nɔ ngɛ ta mi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ baalɛ yeɔ ní kɛ pii si ɔ, jã a ma kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
O fɔ babauu, nɛ o he hiɛ kaa baalɛ!
O jua yeli ɔmɛ hiɛ pe hlami dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe!
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, mɛ tsuo a ho kaa baalɛhi nɛ́ bli a pɛli mi, nɛ a te kɛ je.
O ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu kaa baalɛhi.
Fĩɛ be mi ɔ, a laa a he ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a mi.
Se ke pu je pɛ a te, nɛ nɔ ko li he nɛ a yaa!
Asiria matsɛ, o we amlaalo ɔmɛ gbo, nɛ o ma nimeli ɔmɛ hwɔ mahe kɛ yaa neneene!
O we bi ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba we ekohu.
Tsa ba ko be ha o plaami ɔmɛ, nɛ o pa a kle.
Nihi tsuo nɛ maa nu o hɛ mi kpatami ɔ he ɔ, a bua maa jɔ, nɛ a maa fia a dɛ.
Yi wu tso níhi babauu nɛ o pee ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ e he je mi lo?
NYA TSƆƆMI Jeha lafa kpaago loko a fɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ɔ, kɛ yaa jamɛ a be ɔ nyagbe mi ɔ, gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Habakuk hi si.
Babilonia bi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yee jamɛ a be ɔ. Gbalɔ ɔ hao wawɛɛ kaa dikali nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ yi wu tso níhi pee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Mawu lee, mɛni he je kulaa nɛ o pee kɔ̃, be mi nɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ da pe mɛ a hɛ mi kpatae ɔ?” Heto nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha lɛ ji e ma tsu e ní be mi nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔ.
“Se kɛ̃ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, a yi ma na wami; ejakaa a yeɔ Mawu anɔkuale.” Womi ɔ mi sanehi nɛ piɛ he ji gbami nɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ma kpata nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ a hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ gbe nya ji Mawu yi jemi la nɛ deɔ ke, “Mawu kle”.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa asilɛte ɔ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ pi si saminya.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Habakuk bi sanehi, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha lɛ heto .—.
A ma kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi .- Habakuk fa kue .-
Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha gbalɔ Habakuk ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Habakuk bi ke mɛni he je a yi dami sane Yawɛ lee, kɛ yaa su mɛni be ma fa kue kɛ tsɛ mo loko o maa bu mi tue, nɛ o ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je yi wu tso níhi nɛ a ngɛ wɔ pee ɔ mi?
Mɛni he je o ha i ngɛ yayami kɛ haomi hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛe, nɛ o pui mi ɔ?
Hɛ mi kpatami kɛ yi wu tso níhi bɔle mi kɛ kpe; pɛ kɛ kunɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Mlaa a he wami ɔ ta, nɛ dami sane yemi be hu; yayami peeli ye dali a nɔ, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, a plɛ dami sane yemi hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
Yawɛ ha heto Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de e ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ kɛ kpe ɔ; nyɛ maa na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ ma ha nyɛ he mi maa po.
Ejakaa ma tsu ní tsumi ko ngɛ nyɛ be nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ke a sɛɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ be hee maa ye.
Babilonia bi ɔmɛ hia ta kɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo kpae kɛ yaa ngɔ zugbahi nɛ pi a nɔ.
A he ngɛ gbeye, nɛ a he sɔɔ kɛ ní puɛmi.
Ma ha nɛ a maa te si kɛ wo nyɛ.
Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a he gbeye kɛ sawale nuɔ nihi.
A woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ.
“A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he sɔɔ pe ngatsɛhi, nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ klamaklama pe ogbeteehi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee.
A we okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ jeɔ ma se lokoo kɛ baa, nɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane hii si sie glɛi glɛi glɛi!
A ba yuɔ nɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kɔlehi peeɔ kɛ saa lohwehi nɛ a ya yeɔ ɔ.
“A tabo ɔmɛ kɛ yi wu tso hiaa ta kɛ ya tuaa a he nyɛli.
Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a he sawale nuɔ ni ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ a he hiɛ babauu kaa zia.
A yeɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he fɛu, nɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he peeɔ mɛ muɔ.
Mɔ nɛ he wa pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ a hɛ mi.
A buaa zu nya glekugleku kɛ woɔ mɔ ɔ he, nɛ a ngɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a woɔ fo kɛ jeɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ; a peeɔ yayami nɛ a yeɔ fɔ; a he wami ji a mawu.” Habakuk bi Yawɛ munyu ekohu Yawɛ, mo ji Mawu kɛ je blema lokoo.
Ye Mawu ji mo, o ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ o ngɛ daa kɛ daa.
Yawɛ ye Mawu kɛ ye yi baalɔ; mo nitsɛ nɛ o hla Babilonia bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o ha a te si wo wɔ, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a gbla wa tue.
Se kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ hyɛe nɛ o de we nɔ́ ko ɔ?
Mo nɛ o hɛngmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ o hyɛ we nɔ yayami, loo nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ, mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ hyɛe nɛ nimli yayamihi ngɛ dali a hɛ mi kpatae, nɛ o de we nɔ́ ko ɔ?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o ngɛ nimli adesahi pee kaa a peeɔ pa mi lo, loo kaa a peeɔ lohwe tsɔwi nɛ sãã si nɛ a be nɔ yelɔ ko nɛ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ ɔ?
Babilonia bi ɔmɛ kɛ gbowe ngɛ nimli adesahi sae kaa a saa pa mi lo.
A kɛ a ya amɛ gblaa mɛ kɛ yaa, nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi heɔ ose kaa a nine gbe ní babauu.
A jaa a ya amɛ, nɛ a sãã bɔhi haa mɛ, ejakaa a ya amɛ haa mɛ ní kpakpahi.
Anɛ a kɛ klaate maa hi nihi gbee daa, nɛ a maa ya nɔ nɛ a kpata je ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a be mɔbɔ nae lo?
Yawɛ ha Habakuk heto Ma kuɔ kɛ ya ye bu he ɔ ngɛ mɔ ɔ yi mi, konɛ ma hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e maa bua ye sane ɔ he ha.
Heto nɛ Yawɛ ha mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ngmaa nina nɛ ma je ngɔ tsɔɔ mo nɛ ɔ saminya ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛhi a nɔ, konɛ ke nɔ ko hɛngmɛ gba nɔ ɔ, e kanemi ko wa ha lɛ.
Ngmaa kɛ to; ejakaa be nɛ a ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sui lolo.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, be ɔ ma, nɛ e be kɛe, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma je ngɔ tsɔɔ mo ɔ maa ba mi kokooko.
E maa pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma blɛuu tsɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, hyɛ́ blɔ.
Ejakaa e maa ba mi kokooko, nɛ e be kɛe.
Enɛ ɔ ji sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ: ‘Yayami peeli a hɛ mi ma kpata; se dali lɛɛ, akɛnɛ a yeɔ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ, a yi ma na wami.’ ” A ma kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi Ní nami babauu sisiɔ nɔ.
Nihi nɛ bua ní nya ha a he ɔ, a woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a he mi jɔɛ mɛ; a ngɛ kaa gbenɔ kɛ gbeje, a tɔɛ gblee.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a kɛ ma tsuaa ma hwuu ta, nɛ a ngɔɔ ma amɛ kakaaka a nɛ.
Nihi nɛ a ye a nɔ mohu maa ye kunimi yeli ɔmɛ a he fɛu, nɛ a maa muɔ mɛ.
A ma de ke, “Musu tloo nihi nɛ ngɔɔ níhi nɛ pi a nɔ kɛ peeɔ a nɔ!
Kɛ yaa si mɛni be po nyɛ maa hi awaba níhi kpɔe ngɛ níhi a dɛ konɛ nyɛ ná ní?” Tlukaa a, nyɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa te si kɛ wo nyɛ kɛ abofu.
Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ he maa hi doe blibliibli.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma ba ha nyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ je.
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ha je mahi babauu a ní ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ, je ma amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ maa ha nyɛ hu nyɛ níhi; ejakaa nyɛ kpata nihi a hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ pee yi wu tso níhi kɛ si zugba a, kɛ ma a, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ tsuo.
Mo nɛ o kɛ yi wu tso kpɔ nihi a níhi kɛ ha o weku li, nɛ o hla kaa haomi kɛ nyagba kó ba o we mi ɔ, musu tloo mo!
Gahi nɛ o to nɛ ɔ kɛ zo mohu ba o weku li a nɔ.
Nɛ́ o kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ, mo nitsɛ o hɛ mi nɛ o kpata a nɛ.
Tɛhi nɛ a kɛ fia gbogbo po ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ wo nyɛ, nɛ akpale ɔmɛ hu ma he nɔ.
Mo nɛ o pee yayami kɛ to ma sisi, nɛ o pue muɔ si kɛ fia gbogbo ɔ, musu tloo mo!
Ma amɛ nɛ o ye a nɔ ɔ, ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ a tsu ɔ tsuo pee yaka.
Níhi tsuo nɛ o bua nya a, la sã mɛ.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se be ma nɛ je ɔ ma yɔse Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ wo ɔ hyi tɔ kɛ nyu ɔ. Mo nɛ o kɛ hɛdɔ wa o nyɛmimɛ yi mi, nɛ o pue a hɛ mi si, nɛ o ha a tataa si kaa nihi nɛ a tɔ dã a, musu tloo mo!
Jehanɛ lɛɛ o be ɔ su nee!
A be o hɛ mi nyami woe hu, se mohu a ma pue o hɛ mi si.
Mo nitsɛ o maa tɔ dã, nɛ o maa tataa si.
Yawɛ ma ha nɛ mo nitsɛ o yayami nɛ o pee ɔ maa gbla o tue; a be o hɛ mi nyami woe; o hɛ mi si mohu a ma pue.
O poo Lebanon hue mi tso ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si; jehanɛ lɛɛ pu mi lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi ɔ, maa wo o he gbeye.
Bɔ nɛ e maa ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa o kpata nihi a hɛ mi; o pee yi wu tso níhi kɛ si zugba a, kɛ ma a, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ tsuo.
Mɛni se nami ngɛ amaga he?
E ji nɔ́ ko kɛkɛ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa pee, nɛ lakpa pɛ e toɔ.
Mɛni se nami ngɛ he ha nɔ nɛ pee lɛ ɔ, kaa e maa ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ; mawu nɛ nyɛ we munyu tete po nɛ e tuɔ ɔ!
O deɔ tso kpoku ke, “O hɛ nɛ tsɛ!” Aloo tɛ nɛ tui munyu ke, “Tee si!” Anɛ amaga ma nyɛ je nina ko ha mo lo?
A kɛ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ maa ha he lɛɛ, se wami ko be e mi kulaa.
Musu tloo mo!
Yawɛ ngɛ e we klɔuklɔu ɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, e pee dii ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Habakuk kue fami la nɛ a fia kpa saku kɛ to he Gbalɔ Habakuk fa kue ke, “Yawɛ lee, i nu nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he, nɛ e ha nɛ i ye mo gbeye.
Ní nguanguahi nɛ o tsu blema a, mo tsu ekohu wa yi nɔ nɛ ɔ. Ke o mi mi fu po, moo na mɔbɔ.
Mawu je Edom kɛ ma ekohu; Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ si kplee ngɛ Paran yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma.
E hɛ mi nyami ɔ ha hiɔwe ɔ tsuo; nɛ a ngɛ e yi jee ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
E ma kɛ la nylamnylam kaa oslabai; la ngɛ pae plamplam kɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi jee; lejɛ ɔ e he wami ɔ hɔɔ si ngɛ.
E haa nɛ hiɔhi baa, nɛ gbenɔ nyɛɛɔ se.
Ke e da si ɔ, zugba a mimiɛɔ, ke e wo e hɛ mi nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma amɛ a he doɔ blibliibli.
E ywia blema yo ɔmɛ; e ba yoku ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ daa a si; yo nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ e nyɛɛ blema a nɛ.
I na nɛ sawale nu Kushan bi ɔmɛ, nɛ Midian bi ɔmɛ hu a he ngɛ doe blibliibli.
Yawɛ, anɛ pa amɛ lɛ a wo o mi mi la a lo?
Aloo wo ɔ lɛ ha o hɛ dɔ, benɛ o hi bɔku ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ kaa ta zugba lɛ kɛ ya ye kunimi ɔ?
O je o kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ kpo, konɛ o tsɛ̃ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ o ha oslabai gba zugba a mi.
Benɛ yo ɔmɛ na mo ɔ, a he do blibliibli; hiɔmi nɛ pue si piapiaapia.
Muɔ voo ɔ wo gbi, nɛ oslɔke fluku.
Benɛ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ la pae kɛ fo vuu vuu, nɛ o we akplɔ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam ɔ, pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ daa si dii ngɛ a hi he ɔmɛ.
Abofu o kɛ hia kɛ nyɛɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ o kɛ hɛdɔ naa je ma amɛ a nɔ.
O je kpo nɛ o ya he o ma a, kɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla a a yi wami.
O fia yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ nɔ́ nɛ o gbe, nɛ o kpata e we bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi butuu.
Benɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ hia ta kɛ ma puu kaa ahumi, konɛ a ba gbɛ wɔ ngɔ fĩa, nɛ e pee mɛ kaa peepee ta wa he, nɛ balɔ ko be, lɔ ɔ a nine gbe wɔ ɔ, o tsɛ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ya na a tatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma a. O kɛ o we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ wo ɔ nɔ gidigidi, kɛkɛ nɛ nyu babauu ɔ fia hwɔli.
I nu sane nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ ye he do blibliibli; fɔ̃ ha ye nya bɔni domi.
Ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ pee sikplikpii, nɛ ye nane mi jɔ ngɛ ye sisi.
Ma mlɛ dii kɛ yaa su be nɛ Mawu maa gbla nihi nɛ ba tua wɔ ɔ a tue.
Ke ngmɔkɔ tso gba we mɔmɔ, nɛ wai tso ɔmɛ wui yiblii, ke oliv nu bɛ, nɛ niye ní be ngmɔ ɔ nɔ, ke to ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ na amɛ gbo ta tsu ɔ mi, ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi po, ye bua maa jɔ, nɛ ma nya; ejakaa Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ ye yi wami.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ haa mi he wami.
Lɛ nɛ haa ye nane maa si saminya kaa bayelɔ nɔ́; nɛ i naa tue mi jɔmi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.”
NYA TSƆƆMI Gbalɔ Zefania fiɛ jeha lafa kpaago loko a fɔ Yesu, maa pee jeha nyɔngma loko Matsɛ Yosia ba tsake jami blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ jeha ɔ mi.
Níhi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ fuu pɔɔ a he munyu tumi.
Ekomɛ ji: Haomi be ko maa ba Yuda; a maa gbla Yuda tue, ejakaa Yuda ma a ya ja mawu kpahi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa gbla je ma kpa komɛ hu a tue.
A maa gbla Yerusalem tue, nɛ haomi maa ba ma a nɔ mohu, se be ko se ɔ, ma a maa kpale da si ekohu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi ma a mi ɔ maa pee nihi nɛ baa a he si nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kojomi ligbi ɔ .—.
Israel huza a nɔ bi ɔmɛ a tue gblami .- Yerusalem tue gblami kɛ e yi wami hemi ekohu .-
Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha Zefania, be mi nɛ Amon bi Yosia ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Zefania tsɛ ji Kush, nɛ e nɛmɛ ji Gedalia, Amaria, kɛ Hezekia.
Yawɛ tue gblami ligbi ɔ Yawɛ ke, “Ma kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ngɛ je ɔ mi: nimli adesahi, pu mi lohwehi, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, lohi, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ma kpata nimli adesahi tsuo kulaa a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ kake ngmelu po be piɛe.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
“Ma gbla nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ma a mi, kɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ tsuo a tue.
Baal jali nɛ piɛ ɔ, ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be Baal wɔnɔ ɔmɛ kaie hu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuɔɔ kɛ yaa tsu yi mi, nɛ e ya jaa pu, loo nyɔhiɔ, loo dodoe ɔ, ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ a jaa imi Yawɛ, nɛ a woɔ si ke a maa nyɛɛ ye se, se a kɛ mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Milkom ɔ biɛ kaa kita a, mɛ hu ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ, ma kpata nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi: ni nɛmɛ nɛ kpale kɛ je ye se, nɛ a nyɛɛ we ye se hu; ni nɛmɛ nɛ bɛ ye ngɔ, loo a ba bi we mi ga womi.” Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ maa gbla ma a tue ɔ su ta.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee dii ngɛ e hɛ mi.
