Yawɛ miɔ nɛ e maa gu Yuda he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ e kɛ kpata Yuda ma a hɛ mi, kaa bɔ nɛ a gbeɔ lohwehi kɛ sãã bɔ ɔ. Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma gbla ma tsɔli ɔmɛ, matsɛbimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ ma se kusumi níhi tsuo kulaa a tue.
Nihi nɛ tuɔ kɛ haneɔ kpoku, kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ jali peeɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ juɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbeɔ nihi nɛ a kpɔɔ níhi ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ba woɔ a mawu jami he ɔ, ma gbla mɛ tsuo kulaa a tue.
“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa wo yana ngɛ Lo Agbo ɔ nya ngɛ Yerusalem; a ma nya awe ngɛ Yerusalem ma he ɔ mi, nɛ a ma he ose ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yerusalem dɔ ɔ si je ɔ, ke nyɛ nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ nya awe.
Ejakaa nyɛ jua yeli ɔmɛ tsuo a yi ta!
“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma su kane kɛ kpa Yerusalem.
Nɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ a he yayami mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko pue we a tsui nɔ ɔ, ma ya hla a se blɔ, nɛ ma gbla a tue.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ deɔ a he ke, ‘Oo, Yawɛ tsa be wɔ nɔ́ ko pee.’ A maa ha a níhi, nɛ a we ɔmɛ maa pee we dokuhi.
Wehi nɛ a ngɛ poe ɔ, a be a mi hie, nɛ wai ngmɔhi nɛ a ngɛ hue ɔ, a be a mi dã nue.” Jamɛ a ligbi nguaa a nɛ Yawɛ maa gbla e ma a tue ɔ ma kɛ fo; e su si ta!
E maa pee aywilɛho ligbi, ejakaa ta buli katsɛmɛ po a hɛ maa dɔ, nɛ a ma fo ya boboobo.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Mawu mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nihi a yi ma fi, nɛ a maa hao; a ma kpata níhi a hɛ mi basabasa; bɔku yumu tslitsliitsli maa wo, nɛ je ɔ mi maa pee tuu.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ta titimatihi maa pɛ, nɛ ta buli ma he ose, nɛ a ma ba tua mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he, kɛ mɔ gagaagahi.
Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, i kɛ haomi nɛ nya wa maa ba nimli adesahi a nɔ, nɛ a maa hi si tataae kɛ hi bee kaa hɛ yuyuili.
A pee yayami kɛ si imi Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma kpa a muɔ ngɔ pue si kaa nyu, nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ maa sa ngɛ zugba.” Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma je e mi mi fumi ɔ kpo ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma he ma a yi wami: sika hiɔ jio, sika tsu jio.
E kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ ma kpata je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã nɔ́ ɔ. E maa gbe níhi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi si kake too.
Tsui tsakemi Nyɛ ma nɛ zo be nyɛ hɛ mi, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛɛ pee juɛmi, nɛ nyɛ ko ba ngla nɛ nyɛ gbo kaa dwɔmi nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ mi mi ma fu nyɛ ɔ nɛ e su.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ baa nyɛ he si, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nyɛ hla e se blɔ.
Nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si; alini, ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ, nɛ e maa gbla nihi a tue ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ a maa laa nyɛ nɔ.
Yawɛ maa gbla je mahi nɛ bɔle Israel ɔ a tue Nɔ ko nɔ ko be piɛe ngɛ Gaza ma a mi.
Ashkelon ma a maa pee ma doku.
Piani katakata a, a maa fie Ashdod bi ɔmɛ kpatakpata kɛ maa je a ma a mi.
Ekron ma a hu, a maa pee lɛ butuu.
Nyɛ Filisti bi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wo nya, kɛ nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ, musu tloo nyɛ!
Yawɛ bu nyɛ hu fɔ.
Yawɛ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ kake ngmelu po he be mi jee.
Nyɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nya a ma plɛ pee lohwe lɛmi he, nɛ a maa ma tsuhi ngɛ nɔ kɛ ha to hyɛli kɛ a tohi.
Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi nihi bɔɔ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, nyɛ zugba a nɔ lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a maa hi.
A maa lɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma ya hwɔ we ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Ashkelon.
Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ e ma ha nɛ a maa bɔ ekohu.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Jɛmi nɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ye ma a jɛe, ahlua nɛ a ngɛ mɛ bɔe, kɛ a he nɔ nɛ a ngɛ woe nɛ a ngɛ dee ke a ma kpɔ a zugba a, i nu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi abɔ nɛ imi, Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ ngɛ ɔ, i ngɛ kita kae ke ja a kpata Moab kɛ Amon ma amɛ a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a pee Sodom kɛ Gomora a. Moab kɛ Amon maa pee ma dokuhi; ma amɛ a mi maa hɛ kɛ hu, nɛ zugba a maa pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ngo pue lejɛ ɔ. Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ maa ha a níhi, nɛ a maa ngɔ a zugba a.” Tue gblami nɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ ma na ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa a wo a he nɔ, nɛ a bɔ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma a ahlua.
Yawɛ hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo mɛ.
Yawɛ ma kpata wɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ je ma amɛ, wo kpo ɔ, kɛ zugbahi nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ tsuo ma ja lɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ.
Sudan bi ɔmɛ hu, Yawɛ kɛ klaate maa gbe mɛ.
Yawɛ maa gbla omleyi je ma amɛ a tue.
E ma kpata Asiria hɛ mi, nɛ Asiria ma nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Nineve ɔ maa pee ma doku kaa nga kplanaa nɔ.
Nineve ma plɛ pee tohi kɛ pu mi lohwe slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi a hi he.
Ablɛgogoe maa pee muɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Okpoku kɛ klomi maa hi hwɔe kɛ je saflɛ mi ngɛ mɔ kokoe ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ kuakualabite maa hi pɛe kuaakuaa ngɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a yi mi.
Seda ma kpɔ ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a he.
Ma nɛ e mi bi woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he wami nɔ, nɛ a deɔ a he ke ma ko be nɛ kɛ mɛ sɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba jamɛ a ma a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nineve maa pee ma doku, nɛ pu mi lohwehi ma ba jɔɔ a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ma huanya e yi, nɛ e ma de ke, “Tsia!”
Yerusalem he yayami kɛ ma a kpɔmi Musu tloo Yerusalem!
Ma nɛ́ wo e he mu!
Atuã tsɔli kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a ma.
Yerusalem bui Yawɛ tue; e kplɛɛ we nɛ a kaa e hɛ mi.
E ngɔɛ e hɛ kɛ fɔɛ Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ e hla we e Mawu ɔ se blɔ.
Tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa jatahi nɛ ngɛ huãe.
Kojoli ɔmɛ hu ngɛ kaa ogbeteehi nɛ hwɔ gbe mɛ; gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a yeɔ ní tsuatsuaatsua, nɛ ke je na a, a si we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, biɛ kɛkɛ lɛ tsɛɛ mɛ; lakpatsɛmɛ sɔuu ji mɛ.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ plɛɔ mlaa amɛ a hɛ mi kɛ buɔ si bɔ nɛ maa da mɛ, nɛ a bleɔ níhi nɛ a ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.
Se Yawɛ ngɛ ma a mi; lɛɛ dalɔ ji lɛ; e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ.
Daa ligbi ɔ, e yeɔ dami sane.
Se kɛ ɔ, yayami peeli ɔmɛ yaa nɔ nɛ a peeɔ yayami, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee we mɛ zo.
Yawɛ ke, “I kpata je mahi a hɛ mi; i ku a mɔ nguangua amɛ ngɔ pue si.
Ma amɛ pee ma dokuhi; gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ fɔɔ si gu, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a nɔ.
I de ke, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa bu mi tue; jehanɛ lɛɛ ke i bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, a maa ye gbeye, nɛ e be hiae kaa ma gbla a tue ekohu.’ Se a ya nɔ pee yayami pe kekle ɔ mohu.” Yawɛ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ mlɛ keii kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ ma te si nɛ ma po je ma amɛ a nya.
I to ye yi mi kaa ma bua je ma amɛ, kɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ ma je ye mi mi la nɛ nya wa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
Ejakaa ye mi mi la nɛ ɔ ma kpata je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha je ma amɛ gbi nɛ he tsɔ.
Mɛ tsuo a maa fa kue ha imi Yawɛ, nɛ a maa pee a nya kake kɛ sɔmɔ mi.
Ye nihi nɛ gbɛ fĩa a maa ngɔ nike ní kɛ je tsitsaa Sudan po kɛ ba ha mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, zo be nyɛ pee hu kaa nyɛ ye ma a, nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã.
Ma je he woli, kɛ he nɔ woli kɛ maa je nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ be ye hɛ mi atuã tsɔe hu gblegbleegble ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Ma si nihi nɛ peeɔ a he humi, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ a maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ imi Yawɛ ye nɔ.
Israel bi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, a be nɔ́ yayami pee; a be lakpa yee, nɛ a be nɔ sisie hulɔ.
A ma plɔke, nɛ a he mi maa jɔ mɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa wo a he gbeye.” Bua jɔmi la Yerusalem bi, nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi; Israel ma, nyɛ hwɔ lele.
Yerusalem bi, nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he.
Yawɛ gbla nyɛ tue ta; e fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he.
Yawɛ, Israel matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ be gbeye yee hu.
Be ma, nɛ a ma de Yerusalem ke, “Zion, koo ye gbeye!
O kɔni nɛ ko gbo!
Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; e he wami ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa ye kunimi.
Yawɛ ma na nyɛ he bua jɔmi; e maa suɔ nyɛ sane, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ wami he.
E ma la, nɛ e ma na nyɛ he bua jɔmi kaa bɔ nɛ nihi a bua jɔɔ a he nyami be ɔ.” Yawɛ ke, “Ma je nyɛ kɛ je haomi mi, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛ zo ɔ kaie hu.
Be ma!
Ma gbla nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ a tue; ma he akpaketsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a yi wami, nɛ ma kpale nihi nɛ a nuu nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ ba we ekohu.
Ma tsake a zo ɔ kɛ pee hɛ mi nyami, nɛ je ɔ tsuo ma je a yi.
Be ma!
Ma ngɔ nihi nɛ gbɛ fĩa a kɛ maa ba we ekohu.
Ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma he biɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo; je ma amɛ ma je nyɛ yi, nɛ nyɛ ma na ní babauu ekohu.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
NYA TSƆƆMI Gbalɔ Hagai ná sɛ gbihi kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ngɔ maa pee jeha loko a fɔ Kristo.
Sɛ gbi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi kpitikpiti komɛ nɛ a bua nya a lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ma se ya a kpale kɛ ba we, nɛ a ba ngɛ Yerusalem jeha babauu lɛɛ, se Mawu we ɔ ku kɛ pueɔ si jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo.
Sɛ gbi nɛ ɔmɛ wo ma nimeli ɔmɛ he wami kaa a te si nɛ a ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu; nɛ Mawu ma ha ma a tsuo ma ba pee ni hehi nɛ a tsui mi tsɔ.
Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ si woe hulɔ kaa hwɔɔ se ɔ, kplɔkɔtɔ maa ba, nɛ ma a maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha A fa ke a ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu .- Sɛ gbihi nɛ woɔ nɔ bua, nɛ haa nɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi .-
Yawɛ fa ke a ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu Persia matsɛ, Darius yi nɔ, jeha enyɔne ɔ mi, nyɔhiɔ ekpane ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi kɛ gu gbalɔ Hagai nɔ kɛ ha nimli nɛ ɔmɛ: Sheatiel bi Zerubabel, Yuda amlaalo ɔ, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de Hagai ke, “Ma a ngɛ dee ke, be nɛ sa kaa a ma Mawu we ɔ sui lolo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ mane ma a kɛ gu Hagai nɔ ke, “Ye ma, anɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ hi wehi nɛ a ma saminyawiiwi a mi, be mi nɛ imi nitsɛ ye we ɔ ku kɛ pueɔ si lo?
Anɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpa we si lolo?
Nyɛ du ní gidiglɛmɛɛ, se nyɛ kpa bɔbɔyoo pɛ.
Nyɛ yeɔ ni, se nyɛ tɔɛ gblee.
Nyɛ nuɔ dã, se e sui nyɛ nya.
Nyɛ ngɛ heha ní, se e ha we nɛ nyɛ he mi nɛ pee kulɔɔ.
Nyɛ yeɔ apaa, nɛ a woɔ nyɛ hiɔ, se nyɛ kɛ woɔ kotoku nɛ sisi gu mi.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ yae ha.’ Anɛ nyɛ li nɔ́ nɛ kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ba lo?
Nyɛ ya kuɔ yoku ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ poo tso kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu; kɛkɛ ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ nyɛ ma ja mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
“Nyɛ hyɛɛ blɔ kaa ke nyɛ kpa ní ɔ, nyɛ ma na babauu, se bɔbɔyoo pɛ nyɛ naa.
Jehanɛ, ke nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ba we mi ɔ, kɛkɛ i ha nɛ e pee kɔɔhiɔ.
Mɛni he je i ngɛ ja pee ɔ?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ, be mi nɛ ye we ɔ ku kɛ pueɔ si ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we mae.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́ hu, nɛ zugba a hu bɛ ní ɔ nɛ.
I ha nɛ sapu ye nibɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo; zugba a, yoku ɔmɛ, blɛfo ngmɔ ɔmɛ, wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, oliv abɔɔ ɔmɛ, nimli adesahi, lohwehi, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a gbo he dengme ɔ, sapu ye mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Ma a bu Yawɛ fami ɔ tue Kɛkɛ nɛ Shealtiel Zerubabel, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua, kɛ ma a tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se ngɛ Babilonia kɛ ba a, pee nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, nɛ a bu gbalɔ Hagai, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ tue, ejakaa Yawɛ nɛ tsɔ lɛ.
Ma a tsuo ye gbeye.
Jehanɛ Hagai, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha ma a ke, “I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Yawɛ wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ mumi mi he wami kɛ ha ní tsumi ɔ: Sheatiel bi Zerubabel, Yuda ma a we amlaalo ɔ, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ je ma se kɛ ba a. Mɛ tsuo a bɔni Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, a Mawu ɔ we ɔ he ní tsumi ngɛ Matsɛ Darius yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ ekpane ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛne ɔ.
Yawɛ we he ɔ he fɛu Jamɛ a jeha a, nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kake ɔ, Yawɛ tu munyu ekohu kɛ gu gbalɔ Hagai nɔ.
E de Hagai ke e de Sheatiel bi Zerubabel, Yuda ma a amlaalo ɔ, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ ma a tsuo ke, “Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ma nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ Mawu we ɔ he fɛu ngɛ sa a lo?
Jehanɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ na lɛ kɛɛ?
E peeɔ nyɛ kaa enɛ ɔ pí nɔ ko saasaa.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɔni mi ko wo nyu.
Nyɛ tsu ní ɔ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Benɛ nyɛ maa je Egipt ɔ, i wo nyɛ si nɛ ɔ ke ye mumi ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si daa.
I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
“E be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma mimiɛ hiɔwe, zugba, wo, kɛ zugba gbigbli ɔ tsuo ekohu.
Ma ngɔ je mahi tsuo ngɔ fia si, nɛ a maa muɔ a juetli babauu ɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, nɛ Mawu we ɔ ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ níhi nɛ a he jua wa.
Ye níhi ji je ɔ mi sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ tsuo.
Mawu we he ɔ maa hi fɛu pe momo ɔ. Ma ha kplɔkɔtɔ maa ba ye ma a nɔ, nɛ ni ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Gbalɔ ɔ ya bi osɔfo ɔmɛ ga womi Matsɛ Darius yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, kɛ gbalɔ Hagai tu munyu ekohu.
E de ke, “Bi osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a buá sane nɛ ɔ he ha.
Ke nɔ ko ngɔ lo kpɔ ko nɛ a gbaa nɔ ha Mawu kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e hɛɛ kɛ yaa ngɛ e tade klɔii ɔ mi, ke e ha nɛ e tade ɔ sa niye ní kaa abolo, loo flɔɔ, loo wai, loo nu, loo niye ní saisaa ko he ɔ, anɛ jamɛ a niye ní ɔ hu maa pee nɔ́ nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Mawu lo?” Osɔfo ɔmɛ ha heto ke, “Dɛbi!” Jehanɛ, Hagai bi ke, “Ke nɔ ko ya ta gbogboe ko he kɛ ble e he, jehanɛ, ke kaa e ya ta niye ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko he ɔ, anɛ lɔ ɔ hu ma ble jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ hu lo?” Osɔfo ɔmɛ ha heto ke, “Ee, e bleɔ mɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Hagai de ke, “Yawɛ ke jã pɛpɛɛpɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ kɛ e mi bi ngɛ ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a peeɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a kɛ ba sãã bɔ ngɛ ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ble lɛ momo.” Yawɛ wo si ke e maa gbaa e ma a Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ loko nyɛ bɔni Yawɛ we ɔ mami ɔ, nyɛ nɛ́ lo?
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ke nyɛ ya blɛfo ngmɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa nyɛ ma na susumi nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, susumi nɔ́ nyɔngma pɛ nyɛ naa.
Nyɛ hyɛ blɔ kaa nyɛ ma na dã buɛ nyingmi enuɔ ngɛ wai muɔ ɔ mi; se nyingmi enyɔ pɛ nyɛ naa.
Imi nitsɛ lɛ i ha nyɛ ní ɔmɛ fu ja, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nglaa ní, kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ba kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ gbo he dengme ɔ hɛ mi, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ tsakee we nyɛ tsui.
Mwɔnɛ ɔ ji nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ, nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a fia Mawu we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ gbe nya.
Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nyɛɛ to nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a he hɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa blɛfo be gba mi, nɛ wai tso ɔmɛ, ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ, tsohi nɛ a yiblii ngɔɔ, kɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ wui yiblii lolo lɛɛ, se kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, ma gbaa nyɛ.” Yawɛ wo Zerubabel si Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu nɛ ji nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ha Hagai sɛ gbi enyɔne nɛ e ya de Zerubabel, amlaalo nɛ hyɛɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ ke, “Ma mimiɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nɛ ma ngɔ nɔ yemi ɔmɛ kɛ a he wami ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si.
Ma ha ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ maa nɔɔ si kɛ a kudɔli ɔmɛ; okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ma gbo, nɛ a nɔ hili ɔmɛ maa gbe a sibi.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ngɔ mo, ye tsɔlɔ Zerubabel, Sheatiel bi ɔ, nɛ ma wo mo tsɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi.
Mo ji nɔ nɛ i je blɔ hla.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
NYA TSƆƆMI Zakaria womi ɔ hɛɛ mi dlami titlii enyɔ: Yi - ji gbamihi nɛ Zakaria gba ngɛ be slɔɔtohi a mi, kɛ je jeha kɛ ya si jeha loko a fɔ Kristo.
Gbalɔ ɔ ná gbami nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ninahi a mi.
A kɔɔ bɔ nɛ a maa kpale fia Yerusalem, nɛ a maa ma sɔlemi we ɔ ekohu, nɛ a maa tsukɔ Mawu ma a he, kɛ jehanɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpɔmi be nɛ ma a he.
Yi - ji sɛ gbihi nɛ a bua nya pee se.
A kɔɔ Mesia nɛ a ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ, kɛ nyagbe tue gblami ɔ he.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Kɔkɔ bɔmi, kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi sɛ gbihi .—.
Mahi nɛ bɔle Israel ɔ a tue gblami .- Kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba Israel hwɔɔ se .—.
Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a tsɛe ke a kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ Persia matsɛ, Darius tsɛ yemi be ɔ jeha enyɔne ɔ, nyɔhiɔ kpaanyɔne ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ e sɛ gbi ngɔ ha Ido bibi gbalɔ Zakaria, Berekia bi ɔ ke, “Imi Yawɛ, ye mi mi fu nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ imi hu ma ná nyɛ he tsui ekohu.
Nyɛ ko pee kaa nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Blema lokoo nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɔ ye sɛ gbi ngɔ ha mɛ ke a kpa yayami peemi, nɛ́ a ba a je mi bɔ nɛ sa; se a bui mi tue fɛɛ, nɛ a yi ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ hulɔ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, jije nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Nɛ gbali ɔmɛ nɛɛ!
A ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ?
Mlaahi nɛ i wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔkɔ nɛ i bɔ mɛ kɛ gu ye tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, tse a na mi nɔ́!
Kɛkɛ nɛ jehanɛ a tsake a tsui, nɛ a de ke, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa mɛ ngɛ a ní peemi ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ e to e yi mi ke e ma pee ɔ.” Okpɔngɔhi a he nina Matsɛ Darius tsɛ yemi be ɔ jeha enyɔne ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ kakene nɛ a tsɛɛ Shebat ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, Yawɛ ha imi Zakaria, Berekia bi ɔ sɛ gbi kɛ gu nina ko mi.
Nyɔ mi ɔ, i na Yawɛ bɔfo ko ngɛ okpɔngɔ tsutsuu ko nɔ.
E ha e we okpɔngɔ ɔ da si ngɛ mɔmɔ tso komɛ a kpɛti ngɛ kɔ̃ ko mi.
Okpɔngɔ kpahi daa si ngɛ a se, okpɔngɔ tsutsuuhi, okpɔngɔ futaahi, kɛ ekomɛ nɛ hɛɛ kɔbɛi su.
I bi Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, okpɔngɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni a tsɔɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Ma tsɔɔ mo.
Jehanɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ mɔmɔ tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ Yawɛ tsɔ mɛ ke a ya slaa je ɔ mi tsuo.’ ” Nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ kpa amɛ a nɔ ɔ bɔ Yawɛ bɔfo amaniɛ ɔ ke, “Wa ya slaa je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ wa na kaa tue mi jɔmi ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, jeha nyingmi kpaago sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda ma amɛ ha nɛ o mi mi wo la.
Mɛni be nɛ o bua maa jɔ, nɛ o maa na mɛ mɔbɔ?” Yawɛ kɛ bɔfo ɔ tu munyu, nɛ e wo lɛ bua.
Bɔfo ɔ de mi ke ma fiɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ɔ ke, “Yerusalem, ye ma klɔuklɔu Zion ɔ, i suɔ e sane saminya, nɛ e he nɔ́ dɔɔ mi.
Se mahi nɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ, nɛ a tue mi hu jɔ mɛ ɔ, ye mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ejakaa imi lɛɛ be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ ye mi mi fu ye ma a, se jamɛ a ma kpa amɛ lɛɛ a ha ye ma a nɔ́ nami ɔ ngɛ nɔ yae mohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ ma ba na ma a mɔbɔ.
A maa ma ye sɔlemi we ɔ ekohu, nɛ a ma dla maa fia Yerusalem ma a hulɔ.” Bɔfo ɔ de mi hulɔ ke ma fiɛ ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke e ma amɛ ma ná ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu.
Yawɛ maa kpale ba ngɔ Yerusalem ekohu kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma; nɛ e maa wo Zion bua.” Kolihi a he nina I na nina kpa; i na lohwe koli eywiɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i bi Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ke, “Koli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni a tsɔɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Mɛ ji je ɔ mi he wami ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ Yuda, Israel, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ fĩa a nɛ.” Jehanɛ Yawɛ tsɔɔ mi ga ní tsuli eywiɛ.
I bi ke, “Mɛni nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu ma peemi?” E he nɔ ke, “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ba konɛ koli ɔmɛ nɛ kpata Yuda hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a gbɛ ye ma a ngɔ fĩa a, a ba wo a he gbeye, nɛ́ a kpata a hɛ mi.”
Nɔ́ susumi kpa he nina I na nina kpa ko hulɔ.
I na nɛ nyumu ko hɛɛ nɔ́ susumi kpa ngɛ e dɛ mi.
I bi lɛ ke, “Jije o yaa?” E he nɔ ke, “I yaa susu Yerusalem, nɛ ma na e kami kɛ e blimi.” Jehanɛ, i na nɛ Mawu bɔfo nɛ kɛ mi ba tu munyu ɔ hɛ lɛ kɛ ba hɛ mi, nɛ Mawu bɔfo kpa kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
Kekle bɔfo ɔ de e nyɛmi ɔ ke, “Tú fo nɛ o ya de niheyo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ nɔ́ susumi kpa a ke nimlihi kɛ nahi babauu maa ba Yerusalem, nɛ e he be hiae kaa a fia gbogbo kɛ wo ma a he.
Yawɛ wo si kaa lɛ nitsɛ e maa pee gbogbo nɛ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe kɛ bɔle ma a; e maa bu ma a he, nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa bɔle ma a.” A ke ni nɛmɛ nɛ ho ma se ya a nɛ a kpale kɛ ba we -Yawɛ de e ma a ke, “I gbɛ nyɛ fĩa je kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya, esɔ nɛ nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ je Babilonia kɛ ba Yerusalem.
Nyɛ he jua wa ha mi saminya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa ta nyɛ he ɔ, i be lɛ kplɛɛe.” Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi ke ma ba de je ma amɛ nɛ ba ha e ma a ní ɔ ke, “Yawɛ nitsɛ kɛ nyɛ maa to ní, nɛ nyɛ ni tsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ maa ha nyɛ ní.” Ke nɔ nɛ ɔ ba mi pɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ tsɔ mi.
Yawɛ ke, “Yerusalem bi, nyɛ la nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ; ejakaa i ma nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ba hi si.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, je mahi babauu maa ngɔ a he kɛ ba mɛtɛ Yawɛ he.
E kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ nyɛ maa le kaa lɛ nɛ e tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ Yuda kaa e nɔ́ nɛ he hia saminya ngɛ e zugba klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ, nɛ Yerusalem maa pee ma nɛ e suɔ pe kulaa ekohu.
Nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ pee dii ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; ejakaa e je e hi he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ma.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a he nina I na nina kpa ko.
Yawɛ ha nɛ i na osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Yoshua nɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ Abosiami ba daa si ngɛ Yoshua hiɔ nɔ, konɛ e po Yoshua nya.
Yawɛ de Abosiami ke, “Abosiami, Yawɛ nɛ wo mo hiɔ!
Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ hla Yerusalem kɛ pee e nɔ́ ɔ nɛ wo mo hiɔ.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, anɛ pi la tso nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ a hia kɛ je la nya nɛ ɔ.” Yoshua daa si ngɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ e he tade sɛmusɛmu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ ke, “Nyɛ je tade sɛmusɛmu ɔ ngɛ e he.” Jehanɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de Yoshua ke, “I je o he yayami ɔmɛ; ma ha mo tade saminyayoo nɛ o wo.” E fa nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ ke a hla yi fimi nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ kɛ fi Yoshua yi ha lɛ, nɛ a wo lɛ tade saminyayoo ɔ. Nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ daa si ngɛ hyɛe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ de Yoshua ke, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke o maa ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o maa hɛɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ma ha nɛ o ye ye we ɔ, kɛ e he kue ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ma ha mo blɔ he ngɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ ye hɛ mi ɔ a kpɛti.
Jehanɛ Yoshua, mo osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ o hɛ mi, nyɛɛ bu tue.
Níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se he okadi ma de nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma ha ye tsɔlɔ nɛ ji Tso Kɔni ɔ maa ba.
I ngɔ tɛ kake too kɛ e hɛ mi kpaago kɛ ngɛ Yoshua hɛ mi mae.
Ma kpɛ́ ningma ngɛ tɛ ɔ mi, nɛ ma ha yayami maa ta zugba a nɔ ligbi kake too.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ maa kpee nyɛ sibi kɛ ba nyɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ a sisi.
Yawɛ lɛ de.”
Kane tso ɔ he nina Bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ba ekohu, nɛ e ba hɛli mi si kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɛ̃ɛ̃ɔ nɔ ngɛ mahe mi.
E bi mi ke, “Mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “I na kane tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee.
Tɔ maa si ngɛ e yi mi.
Kane kpaago ngɛ kane tso ɔ he.
Kane ɔmɛ eko fɛɛ eko hɛɛ puɔ kpaago.
Oliv tso enyɔ ngɛ kane tso ɔ kasa nya; kake ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ muɔ nɔ.” I bi bɔfo ɔ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni enɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Anɛ o li ní nɛ ɔmɛ lo?” I he nɔ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, i li.” b Bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha Yawɛ hɛngmɛ kpaago nɛ e kɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ.” Jehanɛ, i bi lɛ ke, “Oliv tso enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kane tso ɔ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛni a tsɔɔ?” I bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Oliv tso kɔni enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu bɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nu ngɛ bee ngɛ a mi ɔ kasa nya a, mɛ hu mɛni a tsɔɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi mi ke, “Anɛ o li?” I he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i li.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni enyɔ nɛ a pɔ mɛ nu, nɛ a daa si ngɛ je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.” Mawu wo Zerubabel si Mawu bɔfo ɔ de mi ke ma ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha Zerubabel: “Pi o nyɛ́mi, loo o he wami nya; se ye mumi ɔ nɛ ma tsu enɛ ɔ. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Mo yo gagaa, mɛni kulaa ji mo ngɛ Zerubabel hɛ mi?
E maa ba mo si, nɛ o maa pee kaa nga kplanaa.
Be nɛ o kɛ nyagbe tɛ ɔ maa ma e blɔ he ngɛ tsu ɔ yi mi ɔ, ma a tsuo ma he ose ke, ‘Afɛu nɔ oo, afɛu nɔ!’ ” Jehanɛ hu Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi kpa ke, “Zerubabel nɛ fia Mawu we nɛ ɔ sisi tomi ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ maa ma tsu ɔ kɛ gbe nya.
Ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi pɛ ye ma a maa le kaa imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ i tsɔ mo a ngɔ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ ní tsumi ɔ yɛ nɔ kpakpa ko ɔ, nɛ ni ɔmɛ pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɔni mi jɔ̃.
Se ke a na Zerubabel nɛ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ mae ekohu ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.”
Womi kpo ɔ nɛ ngɛ tee ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi ɔ he nina Jehanɛ i na nina kpa ko.
I na womi kpo ko nɛ te kɛ bee.
Bɔfo ɔ bi mi ke, “Mɛni o na?” I he nɔ ke, “I na womi kpo ko nɛ ngɛ tee kɛ bee; e kami maa pee gugue enuɔ, nɛ e blimi maa pee gugue enyɔ kɛ fa.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Gbiɛmi nɛ maa ba zugba a tsuo nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A ngma ngɛ womi ɔ ba fa kake ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ju ɔ, a po lɛ ngɔ fɔ he.’ Nɛ a ngma ngɛ ba fa kake hu ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kãã lakpa kita a, a po lɛ ngɔ fɔ he.’ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke e ma ha gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ we mi he nɛ nɔ ko maa ju ngɛ ɔ, a ma kpata we ɔ hɛ mi; nɛ we tsuaa we nɛ nɔ ko ma kã lakpa kita ngɛ mi ɔ, a ma kpata we ɔ hɛ mi kɛ e mi tso kɛ tɛ tsuo.” Yo nɛ ngɛ kusii mi ɔ he nina Bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ba je e he si tsɔɔ mi ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Wo o hɛ nɔ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ je kpo kɛ ma nɛ ɔ!” I bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Kusii.
Ee, kusii nɛ ɔ daa si ha yayami tsuo nɛ a pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.” Sumui a kɛ pee kusii ɔ nya nɔ́ ɔ; a bli kusii ɔ nya, nɛ yo ko hii si ngɛ mi!
Bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Yo nɛ ɔ daa si ha yi wu tso ní peemi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e nyɛ yo ɔ nɔ kɛ wo kusii ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ nya nɔ́ ɔ kɛ bu nya.
Benɛ ma wo ye hɛ nɔ nɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, ne yi enyɔ komɛ nɛ ngɛ tee kɛ ma ye ngɔ kɛ a pɛlihi kaa pa nɔ kayo pɛli.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ba ngɔ kusii ɔ kɛ ho kɔɔhiɔ mi ya.
I bi bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ke, “Jije a ngɔ kusii ɔ kɛ yaa?” E he nɔ ke, “A kɛ yaa Babilonia.
A maa ma tsu ha kusii ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke a ma tsu ɔ gbe nya a, a maa ngɔ kusii ɔ kɛ ya ma e ma he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”
Ta zugba lɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he nina I na nina kpa hulɔ.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i na ta zugba lɛ eywiɛ komɛ nɛ je kpo ngɛ yo enyɔ komɛ a kpɛ kɛ ma.
Akɔblee sɔuu ji yo ɔmɛ.
Okpɔngɔ tsu komɛ ngɛ kekleekle ta zugba lɛ ɔ gblae; enyɔne ɔ, okpɔngɔ yumuhi, etɛne ɔ, okpɔngɔ futaahi, nɛ eywiɛne ɔ lɛɛ okpɔngɔ huatahuatahi nɛ a ngɛ lɛ gblae.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i bi bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni ta zugba lɛ nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ngɛ je kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ a je kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Ta zugba lɛ ɔ nɛ okpɔngɔ yumu ɔmɛ ngɛ gblae ɔ yaa omleyi je, nɛ ta zugba lɛ nɛ okpɔngɔ hiɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ gblae ɔ yaa bonyoku je, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ okpɔngɔ huatahuata amɛ ngɛ gblae ɔ yaa zugba nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ nɔ.
Benɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ma a, e sɔɛ ha mɛ kulaa kaa a ma ya slaa je ɔ mi.
Bɔfo ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya slaa je ɔ mi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya slaa je ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ, bɔfo ɔ de mi kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ya slaa omleyi je ɔ ha Yawɛ abofu ɔ nya ba si.” Yawɛ fa ke á bu Yoshua matsɛ pɛɛ Jehanɛ Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ. E de mi ke, “Heldai, Tobiya, kɛ Yedaya nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya ngɛ Babilonia nɛ a kpale kɛ ba a, hé sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ o pue nɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu kɛ ya Zefania bi Yosia we ɔ mi.
Ngɔɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu nɛ a kɛ ba ke ɔ kɛ pee matsɛ pɛɛ, nɛ o kɛ bu Yehozadak bi Yoshua, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a.
De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nɔ ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Tso Kɔni.
E ma gba kɔni nɛ e ma ba ma Yawɛ we ɔ ekohu.
Lɛ nɛ e maa ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Osɔfo ko maa piɛ e he kɛ tsu ní ɔ. Tue mi jɔmi maa hi a kpɛti, nɛ a maa nu a sibi sisi saminya.’ A kɛ matsɛ pɛɛ nɛ ɔ maa to Yawɛ we ɔ mi kɛ kai Heldai, Tobiya, Yedaya, kɛ Zefania bi Yosia tsuo.” Nihi nɛ ngɛ se lokoo maa ba nɛ a ba piɛ nyɛ he kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi nyɛ ngɔ.
Ke nyɛ maa bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue anɔkuale mi ɔ, lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi.
Yawɛ bu ma a fɔ kaa a yi anɔkuale ngɛ ngma hiɔmi mi Matsɛ Darius yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne nɛ a tsɛɛ Kislev ɔ we ligbi eywiɛne ɔ, Yawɛ ha mi sɛ gbi ko.
Betel bi tsɔ Sharezer, kɛ Regemelek, kɛ a we bi ke a ya Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ a ya fa kue ha lɛ, konɛ e gbaa mɛ.
Jehanɛ, á bi osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ munyu ke, “Jeha babauu nɛ be ɔ, kɔmɔ nɛ wa yeɔ nɛ wa haa hwɔ nyɔhiɔ enuɔne ɔ, anɛ waa ya nɔ waa hi pee kpamisa lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de mi ke, “Bi ni ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ke, nɛ a ha hwɔ daa nyɔhiɔ enuɔne ɔ, kɛ kpaanyɔne ɔ jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ, imi a ha hwɔ ha lo?
Ke a ye ní nɛ a nu ní ɔ, imi a pee kɛ ha lo?
Pi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he nɛ a pee ha lo?” Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu ji sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ha kɛ gu gbali nɛ sɛ hlami ɔ a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yerusalem na ní kpɔtɔɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi babauu ngɛ Yerusalem ma a mi; nɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle ma a, kɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ leneyi je, kɛ yo ɔmɛ a kuɔ si ɔ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ nimli.
Tue gbomi ha a nuu ni ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya Yawɛ ha Zakaria sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ke, “Blema lokoo ɔ, i wo ye ma a mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane; nyɛ mi mi nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na nyɛ sibi mɔbɔ.
Yalɔyihi, awusahi, nibwɔhi, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko wa mɛ yi mi.
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ko to nyɛ sibi a he ga yaya.’ “Se ye ma a bui mi tue fɛɛ; a si a konɔ wo mi, nɛ a tsi a tue, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ.
A kplii a tsui konɛ a ko nu mlaahi, kɛ níhi nɛ i ha gbali ɔmɛ nɛ sɛ a hlami ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, ye mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Akɛnɛ ke i de nɔ́ ko nɛ a bui tue he je ɔ, ke a fa kue ɔ, i he we nɔ.
I gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je mahi nɛ a li nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ lasiogblee lɛ muɔ mɛ; nɛ a si zugba a ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ nɔ ko bi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ ɔ ba pee ma doku.”
Yawɛ wo si kaa e ma wo Yerusalem kɛ ma si ekohu Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ha Zakaria sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ke, “I suɔ Zion sane wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ye suɔmi ɔ ha ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe ngɛ e he.
Ma kpale kɛ ba Zion, nɛ ma ba hi Yerusalem.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ ma a ke ma nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale; nɛ a ma tsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ yo ɔ ke yo klɔuklɔu.
Nimowi, kɛ yimowi nɛ bwɔ kotokoto kɛ a dɛ mi dɛma tso maa hi gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo ma hyi tɔ kɛ nyumuwi, kɛ yiwi nɛ ngɛ fiɛe!
“Ke e he maa wa ha nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi be nɛ ɔ mi kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ ma nyɛ ba ma a mi ɔ, anɛ imi hu e he maa wa ha mi lo?
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke ma ya kpɔ ye ma a kɛ je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je ma amɛ a mi.
Ma ya kpale mɛ kɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.
Ma ye mɛ anɔkuale, nɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ da.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu nyɛ benɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ fiae ekohu ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ wlua nyɛ kɛ tsu ní ɔ. Benɛ jamɛ a be ɔ na we nɛ e su ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e bɔ nɔmlɔ, loo lohwe apaa kɛ tsu ní.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e je kpo ya tsu nɔ́ ko, ejakaa he nyɛli ha we nɔ he jɔmi kulaa.
I ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ te si kɛ wo e nyɛmi.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be ní toe hu kaa sa a. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Ma ha tue mi jɔmi maa ba zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Hiɔmi maa nɛ; zugba a maa ba ní, nɛ wai tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii.
Ma ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha nihi nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nyɛ Yuda bi, kɛ Israel bi, sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa gbiɛmi kɛ ha je ma amɛ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami, nɛ nyɛ maa pee gbaami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ wlua nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ ko ye gbeye!” Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Benɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wo ye mi mi la a, i kpata nyɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi ɔ, nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko kulaa be mi.
Jã kɛ̃, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kpakpa nɛ i to kaa ma pee ekohu ji kaa ma gbaa Yerusalem kɛ Yuda tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
Níhi nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ: nyɛɛ ye nyɛ sibi anɔkuale; nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kpakpa nɛ ye dami sane ngɛ nyɛ kojomi he ɔmɛ, konɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba.
Nyɛ ko so nyɛ sibi a yi nɔ.
Nyɛ ko kã lakpa kita.
I nyɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
Yawɛ lɛ de.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ha Zakaria sɛ gbi ekohu ke, “Nyɔhiɔ eywiɛne, enuɔne, kpaagone, kɛ nyɔngmane ɔ nɛ nyɛ haa hwɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ, a ma ba pee bua jɔmi, ní yemi kɛ nyami be ha Yuda ma a. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ anɔkuale, kɛ tue mi jɔmi.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Be ma nɛ nihi maa je ma slɔɔtohi babauu a mi kɛ ba.
Ma kake mi bi ma ya na ma kpa mi bi nɛ a ma de mɛ ke, ‘Wa yaa nɛ wa ya ja Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ. Wa yaa nɛ wa ya kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e gbaa wɔ.
Nyɛɛ ba nɛ waa ho!’ Nihi babauu maa je ma nguanguahi a mi kɛ ba Yerusalem ba ja Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e gbaa mɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nibwɔhi maa je ma slɔɔtohi a mi kɛ ba Yuda; ni nyɔngma ma ba nu Yuda no kake nɛ a maa pɛtɛ e tade he, nɛ a ma de lɛ ke, ‘Waa kɛ mo maa ya, ejakaa wa nu kaa Mawu kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.’ ”
A maa gbla je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle Israel ɔ a tue Yawɛ sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ ke a maa gbla Hadrak zugba a, kɛ Damasko ma a a tue, ejakaa tsa pi Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ pɛ ji Yawɛ níhi; mohu ɔ, Syria matsɛ ma a hu e nɔ́.
Jã kɛ̃ a maa pee Hamat nɛ e kɛ Hadrak wo huzu ɔ. Tiro kɛ Sidon ma amɛ nɛ le ní kaa nɔ́ ko ɔ, mɛ hu ja nɔuu.
Tiro fia gbogbo kɛ wo e he kulaa kɛ kpe; e bua sika hiɔ nya glekugleku kaa zu, nɛ e sika tsu hu hiɛ kaa kuku nɔ dwɔmi.
Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kpɔ ní tsuo nɛ Tiro na a ngɛ e dɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma sake ní nɛ e na kpɔtɔɔ ɔ ngɔ pue wo mi, nɛ la maa sã ma a. Ashkelon maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ye gbeye.
Gaza hu maa na, nɛ e ma kokloo si.
Ekron hu ja nɔuu, ejakaa e hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo ta.
Gaza matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ Ashkelon maa pee ma doku.
Nimli tsakatsaka ma ba hi Ashdod ma a mi, nɛ Filistia he nɔ womi ɔ se maa po.
Lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi, kɛ ní hiemi ní kpahi ɔ, ma ha nɛ a kpa yemi.
Nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ ma ba pee ye we bi kaa Yuda we puɔ nya amɛ eko.
Ma ha Ekron bi ma ba pee ye we bi kaa bɔ nɛ Yebus ba pee ɔ. Ma bu ye zugba a he nɛ nɔ ko kó ba tua mɛ.
I be yiwutsotsɛmɛ blɔ ngmɛe hu nɛ a ba ye ye ma a nɔ.
Imi nitsɛ i ngɛ hyɛe kɛ ye hɛngmɛ paa.
Matsɛ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se Zion, nyá oo, nyá!
Yerusalem, mo he ose!
Hyɛ, o matsɛ ɔ ma!
E ma kɛ agbo jemi kɛ kunimi yemi.
E ba e he si, nɛ e hi teji okpɔngɔ nɔ; ee, e hi teji okpɔngɔ bi nɔ.
Yawɛ ke, “Ma jé ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel, nɛ ta okpɔngɔhi be Yerusalem hie hu.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃hi nɛ a kɛ hwuɔ ta a, ma ku a mi.
O matsɛ ɔ ma ha tue mi jɔmi maa ba je ma amɛ a kpɛti.
E maa ye tsɛ kɛ maa je wo kpo kɛ yaa su wo kpo; e maa ye tsɛ kɛ maa je Yufrate pa a nya kɛ yaa su zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ tɔɔ.” Mawu ma ha e ma a maa da si ekohu Moo lɛɛ i ngɔ muɔ kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ma somi nɛ i kɛ mo so ɔ nɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o bimɛ nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, ma jé mɛ kɛ je ma se he nɛ ngɛ kaa vu nɛ nyu be mi ɔ kɛ ba we.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ a nuu nyɛ nyɔguɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi.
Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ mɔ ɔ mi.
I ngɛ dee jehanɛ ke yayami tsuo nɛ a pee nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na gbaami kɛ bɔ he totoe enyɔ.
Yuda maa pee kaa ta bulɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃, nɛ Israel maa pee kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi.
Zion bi maa pee kaa ye dɛ mi klaate nɛ i kɛ ma jé ta kɛ wo Hela bi.
Yawɛ ma kple a nɔ; e ma tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ kaa oslabai nɛ ngɛ gbae.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ma ha titimati maa pɛ, nɛ e maa nyɛɛ ngɛ lasiogblee mi kɛ maa je leneyi je kɛ ba.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa bu e ma a he, a maa naa amlami fɔli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Muɔ ma pue si kaa wai nɛ hyi kplu.
A ma pue a he nyɛli a muɔ si basaa kaa bɔ nɛ a kpaa muɔ kɛ pueɔ bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ ɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ ma he a yi wami, ejakaa e tohi ji mɛ.
E ma a ma kpɛ́ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june kpɛɔ ngɛ matsɛ pɛɛ he ɔ. E dɛ mi nɛ kpakpa kɛ afɛu tsuo je; nihewi a blɛfo maa ba saminya; yihewi maa nga wai he bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma plɔke.
Yawɛ wo si kaa e ma he e ma a yi wami Nyɛɛ fa kue ha Yawɛ, konɛ e ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ gbo kɛ gbiɛ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ lɛ haa bɔku hiaa ngɛ ahumi mi; lɛ nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngmɔ baa ní.
Amaga amɛ de we nɔ́ ko nɛ juɛmi ngɛ mi; klaali ɔmɛ lɛɛ lakpa munyuhi sɔuu a tuɔ.
Ni komɛ hu tsɔɔ nlamihi a sisi, nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nyɛ kɛ woɔ nyɛ bua kɛkɛ.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ ma a tsuo ngɛ lalaalo woe kaa tohi, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae, ejakaa a be hyɛlɔ.
Yawɛ ke, “Hyɛ, ye mi mi fu to hyɛli ɔmɛ saminya; ma gbla ma nimeli ɔmɛ a tue kokooko.
Yuda a, ye ma ji mɛ, nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ nitsɛ ma hyɛ a nɔ.
Ma ha a he maa wa saminya kaa ta okpɔngɔ.
A ti ni komɛ maa pee kɔ nya tɛ; ni komɛ maa pee bo tsu plɛɛko, ni komɛ maa pee ta hwumi kɛ̃ɛ̃, nɛ ni komɛ hu maa pee asafoatsɛnguahi.
Ma ha nɛ Yuda bi a he maa wa.
Mɛ tsuo a maa pee kaa ta buli katsɛmɛ ngɛ ta nya; a maa naa a he nyɛli a nɔ, nɛ a maa pee mɛ kaa zugba zu.
I kɛ ye ma a ngɛ saminya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha a kɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa to ní, nɛ ta okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ po a hɛ mi ma pue si.
“Ma wo Yuda ma a he wami; ma he Yosef we ɔ yi wami.
Ma na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ ma kpale mɛ tsuo kɛ ba we ekohu.
A maa pee kaa nihi nɛ i kua we mɛ hyɛ.
Imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ; ma he a kue fami ɔ nɔ.
Israel bi a he maa wa kaa ta buli, a bua maa jɔ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ wai nue.
A nina maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma nya nɔ́ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i pee ha mɛ ɔ he.
“Ma kpee ye ma a; nɛ ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya; ejakaa imi nɛ i kpɔ mɛ.
Ma he a yi wami, nɛ ma ha a he maa hiɛ babauu kaa bɔ nɛ a he hiɛ sa a. E ngɛ mi kaa imi nitsɛ lɛ i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ a nɔ lɛɛ, se a ma kai mi ngɛ ma se lokoo.
A kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a yi ma na wami, nɛ a maa kpale kɛ ba we ekohu.
Ma kpale mɛ kɛ maa je Egipt, nɛ ma bua a nya kɛ maa je Asiria kɛ ba we, nɛ a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ; Gilead kɛ ya pue Lebanon zugba amɛ tsuo po be mɛ kpe.
Ke haomi yi bli kaa wo ɔ, imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma jɔɔ oslɔke ɔmɛ a he ha mɛ.
Nilo pa a tete, nyu maa ta mi.
Asiria, he nɔ wolɔ ɔ, ma ba lɛ si, nɛ Egipt tsɛ yemi ɔ hu se maa po.
Ma ha ye ma a he wami he; nɛ a maa nyɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
A ma kpata yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Lebanon, bli o sinya amɛ, konɛ la nɛ sã o seda tso ɔmɛ!
Nyɛ sɛsɛo tsohi, nyɛ nya awe, ejakaa seda tso ɔmɛ nɔɔ si; a kpata jamɛ a tso kpakpa amɛ a hɛ mi!
Nyɛ Bashan tso nguahi, nyɛ nya awe, ejakaa a gba hue kusuu ɔ ngɔ pue si.
Nyɛɛ bu tue!
To hyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ awe nyae, ejakaa a hɛ mi nyami ɔ ta.
Jata amɛ ngɛ huãe, ejakaa a kpata hue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a nya a hɛ mi.
To hyɛli enyɔ ɔmɛ Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ de mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Zakaria, ngɔɔ o he kɛ pee to kuu nɛ a yaa gbe mɛ ɔ a hyɛlɔ.
Totsɛmɛ ɔmɛ juaa to ɔmɛ, nɛ a deɔ ke, ‘Wa ná ní.
Nyɛ ha wa je Yawɛ yi.’ Nihi nɛ heɔ to ɔmɛ ɔ, ya gbee mɛ nɛ nɔ ko gbla we a tue.
To hyɛli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ, to ɔmɛ a he mɔbɔ ko kulaa pee we mɛ.” Yawɛ de mi ke, “I be nɔ ko nɔ ko mɔbɔ nae hu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Imi nitsɛ ma ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa sɛ e nyɛmi kpá mi.
Ee, a maa sɛ matsɛ ɔ kpá mi.
A ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko he be mi jee.” To je juali ɔmɛ bɔ mi apaa, nɛ i hyɛ to kuu ɔ nɛ a yaa gbe ɔ nɔ.
I ngɔ dɛma tso enyɔ.
I wo kake biɛ ke “Dloomi”, nɛ i tsɛ enyɔne ɔ “Kakepeemi”.
Nɛ i hyɛ to ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɔhiɔ kake mi ɔ, to hyɛli etɛ komɛ nɛ sume mi ɔ, i ngmɛɛ a he, ejakaa a sane ba gbe ye nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i de to kuu ɔ ke, “Jehanɛ, i be nyɛ nɔ hyɛe hu.
Nyɛ ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma gbo ɔ, a gbo.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata a, a hɛ mi nɛ kpata.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, a tsɔtslɔɔ a sibi a mi.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ngɔ dɛma tso nɛ biɛ ji “Dloomi” ɔ, nɛ i ku mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa somi nɛ i kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo so ɔ, a po mi.
A po somi ɔ mi jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ to je juali ɔmɛ nɛ na nɔ́ nɛ i pee ɔ yɔse kaa Yawɛ sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ suɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ wo mi hiɔ, se ke e dɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ faa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngmɛ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ nɛ a kɛ wo mi hiɔ.
Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa fia sika a ngɔ pue nito he ɔ.” Nɛ i pee ja.
Blɔɔ sika nɛ a susu kaa e maa sa mi ji sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ, dɛma tso enyɔne ɔ nɛ biɛ ji “Kakepeemi” ɔ, i ku mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yuda kɛ Israel pi nyɛmimɛ hu.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ngɔɔ o he ngɔ pee kaa to hyɛlɔ nɛ he be se nami.
Ejakaa i ngɛ to hyɛlɔ ko tsɔe kɛ ma zugba a nɔ.
Tohi nɛ a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e kpata a, a nɔ́ pee we lɛ kɔmɔ.
Ní nɛmɛ nɛ laa a, e be a se blɔ hlae.
Hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu e be mɛ tsae; nɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ hu, e be mɛ ní hae; mohu ɔ, e maa ye ní nɛmɛ nɛ wo zɔ ɔ, nɛ e ma kpɔ a nane kokloto tete.
Ye to hyɛlɔ nɛ o he be se nami lee!
To hyɛlɔ nɛ tuɔ fo kɛ jeɔ to kuu ɔ he ɔ, klaate maa po e kɔni, kɛ e hiɔ nɔ hɛngmɛ.
Ee, á po e kɔni nɛ je nya, nɛ e hiɔ nɔ hɛngmɛ nɛ yu kulaa.”
A ma he Yerusalem yi wami hwɔɔ se Sɛ gbi nɛ je Yawɛ ngɔ nɛ kɔɔ Israel he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba; lɛ nɛ ha nɔmlɔ adesa wami.
Yawɛ ke, “Hyɛ, ma ha Yerusalem maa pee kaa kplu kɛ e mi duɔ ha je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ. Ke he nyɛli ba sá Yerusalem yi ɔ, a ma sá Yuda zugba a hu yi ja nɔuu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha Yerusalem maa pee tɛ nɛ jiɔ ha je ma amɛ tsuo.
Ma tsuaa ma nɛ ma wo tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e maa ye e he awi.
Je ma amɛ tsuo ma bla, nɛ a maa te si kɛ wo Yerusalem.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha gbeye maa nu okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ maa nu godo.
Ma bu Yuda ma a he, se a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ma ha a hɛ ma yu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yuda we puɔ nya amɛ ma de a he ke, ‘Nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ woɔ mɛ he wami.’ “Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha Yuda we puɔ nya amɛ maa pee kaa buɛ kɛ e he la gegeege nɛ a to lɛ́ ngɔ wo sisi, loo kaa blɛfo nɛ a kpɔ, nɛ a bua nya pue jatɛ kɛ e nya la nɔ.
Je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata, se Yerusalem lɛɛ e maa ma e ma he ɔ nɔuu.
“Imi Yawɛ, ma ha Yuda bo tsu ɔmɛ maa ye kunimi kekle, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ David nina a, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ma ná a kó pe Yuda nɔ́ ɔ. Ma bu nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem jamɛ a be ɔ a he.
A ti nɔ wudɔwudɔ pe kulaa po maa pee kaa David.
David nina maa nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kaa Yawɛ bɔfo, loo imi Mawu nitsɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, je ma tsuaa je ma nɛ maa te si kɛ si Yerusalem ɔ, ma kpata e hɛ mi.
“David nina, kɛ ni kpahi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, ma ngɔ mumi nɛ naa mɔbɔ, kɛ mumi nɛ faa kue ngɔ wo a mi tɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke a na nɔ nɛ a gbɔ lɛ nɔ́ ɔ, a maa nyɛ ya ha lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a nyɛɛ ya ha bi kake too.
A ma nya awe kaa nihi nyaa awe ha a bitɛte.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa nyɛ ya wawɛɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ha Hadadrimon ngɛ Magido nga a nɔ ɔ.
-Zugba a tsuo maa nyɛ ya weku nya weku nya.
Weku tsuaa weku maa pee e nɔ́ kɔklɔɔ.
David we ɔ maa pee a nɔ́ kɔklɔɔ, nɛ a yi ɔmɛ hu maa pee a nɔ́.
Natan we ɔ maa pee a nɔ́ kɔklɔɔ, nɛ a yi ɔmɛ hu maa pee a nɔ́.
Levi we ɔ maa pee a nɔ́ kɔklɔɔ, nɛ a yi ɔmɛ hu maa pee a nɔ́; nɛ Shimei we ɔ hu maa pee a nɔ kɔklɔɔ nɛ a yi ɔmɛ hu maa pee a nɔ́.
Weku kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ hu maa pee a nɔ́ kɔklɔɔ, nɛ a yi ɔmɛ hu maa pee a nɔ́ ja nɔuu.”
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a ma bli nyu vu ko nya, nɛ a maa ngɔ e mi nyu ɔ kɛ tsu David nina, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ jé a he yayami ɔ, kɛ a he mu ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha amaga amɛ a biɛ maa laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ kaie hu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ma je gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se, ke nɔ ko maa te si ke gbalɔ ji lɛ ɔ, e nyɛ kɛ e tsɛ nɛ fɔ lɛ ma de lɛ ke, ‘Ja a gbe mo; ejakaa o ngɔ Mawu biɛ kɛ ngɛ lakpa yee.’ Ke e ya nɔ ngɛ gbae ɔ, e nyɛ kɛ e tsɛ nɛ fɔ lɛ ɔ maa fia lɛ nɔ nɛ a gbe.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e maa pee gbali tsuo zo kaa nina nɛ maa je kpo ha mɛ ɔ, a ma de, loo kaa a ma tsɛ mɛ gbali tete.
A be tade kunyaa woe nɛ a kɛ sisi nihi hu.
Se mohu ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ ma de ji, ‘Imi lɛɛ, pi gbalɔ ji mi; ngmɔ i huɔ.
Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si ɔ, zugba pɛ ji ye weto ní.’ Ke nɔ ko ma bi lɛ ke, ‘Mɛni pa dokuhi ngɛ o gugue mi nɛ ɔ?’ e ma he nɔ ke, ‘Ye huɛ ko we mi nɛ i ya ná kɛ je.’ ” A fa ke a gbe Mawu to hyɛlɔ ɔ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Klaate, tee si ngɔ wo ye huɛ to hyɛlɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ha mi ɔ!
Moo fia lɛ nɔ konɛ to ɔmɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa.
I kɛ tsɔwitsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ maa to ní.
A maa gbe zugba a tsuo nɔ bi mi dlami etɛ mi enyɔ nɛ a gbo, nɛ e maa piɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake.
Ma ngɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake nɛ ɔ kɛ wo la mi, nɛ ma tsu a he kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika hiɔ he ɔ. Ma tsu a he kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika tsu he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa fa kue ma tsɛ mi, nɛ ma he nɔ.
Ma de mɛ ke, ‘Ye ma ji nyɛ,’ nɛ a ma de ke, ‘Yawɛ ji wa Mawu.’ ”
Yerusalem kɛ je ma amɛ Hyɛ, be ko ma ha Yawɛ!
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ níhi nɛ a ha a, a maa dla ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi paa.
Yawɛ ma bua je ma amɛ tsuo a nya kɛ ba tua Yerusalem.
A maa ngɔ ma a; a maa ha ní ngɛ we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a maa pee yi ɔmɛ basabasa.
A maa nuu ma a mi dlami enyɔ mi kake kɛ ho ma se ya; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, a be a hɛ mi kpatae.
Jehanɛ, Yawɛ kɛ je ma amɛ maa to ní kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ ngɛ ta nga nɔ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ maa da si ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem beleku je.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɔ̃ agbo ko ma gba Oliv yo ɔ mi enyɔ kɛ maa je beleku je kɛ yaa si bonyoku je.
Yo ɔ kasa fa ma ya je omleyi je, nɛ kasa fa hu ma ya je leneyi je.
Nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ maa gu kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ gba yo ɔ mi enyɔ ɔ mi, ejakaa kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ gba Yawɛ yo ɔ mi enyɔ ɔ ma ya su Azal tɔɔ.
Nyɛ maa tu fo kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee blema ngɛ Yuda matsɛ, Uzia yi nɔ, benɛ zugba mimiɛ ɔ. Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ maa ba kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, fĩɛ nɛ nya wa be si hie hu.
Du be bue gblegbleegble.
Nyɔ mi hu je mi maa tɛ paa kaa piani.
Be nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi ɔ, Yawɛ pɛ lɛ le.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyu nɛ haa wami maa je Yerusalem kɛ be; fa ma ya sɛ Ngo wo ɔ mi, nɛ fa hu ma ya sɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ mi.
Nyu ɔ maa hi bee daa, sapu, kɛ hiɔmi nɛmi be mi tsuo.
Nɛ Yawɛ maa ye tsɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ja Mawu kake too ɔ, nɛ e biɛ pɛ a ma tsɛ.
Zugba a tsuo, kɛ je Geba ngɛ omleyi je kɛ yaa su Rimon ngɛ Yerusalem leneyi je ɔ maa pee kplanaa.
Se Yerusalem lɛɛ bɔ nɛ e maa si gojoo ɔ, ja nɔuu e maa hi, kɛ je Benyamin agbo ɔ he kɛ ya agbo momo ɔ, kɛ Kɔ nya agbo ɔ he; jehanɛ kɛ je Hananel mɔ ɔ he kɛ ya su matsɛ dã ngami he ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nimli maa kpale ba hi Yerusalem, ejakaa gbiɛmi nɛ a gbiɛ mɛ ɔ se maa po.
Tue mi jɔmi maa ba Yerusalem.
Nihi nɛ ma je ta kɛ wo Yerusalem ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ maa pee mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: be mi nɛ a ngɛ a nane nya a, a he lo ma pɔtɔ; a hɛngmɛ ma pɔtɔ ngɛ to puɔ mi, nɛ a lilɛ ma pɔtɔ ngɛ a nya mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha nɛ a juɛmi ma tsaka, nɛ a maa nu a sibi a kɔni si, nɛ a maa hi a sibi nɔ́ fiae.
Yuda kɛ Yerusalem po maa hwu ta.
A maa ha je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a ní babauu ɔ: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ heha ní.
Kikɛmɛ hiɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu maa nu okpɔngɔ, teji okpɔngɔ, afukpɔngɔ, teji, kɛ lohwe saisaa nɛ ngɛ a ta a mi.
Mahi tsuo nɛ te si kɛ wo Yerusalem ɔ, a mi nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, daa jeha a, a maa ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya ja Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kaa matsɛ, nɛ a maa ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Je ma ko nɛ be yae nɛ a ya ja Yawɛ Tahohiatsɛ ɔ kaa lɛ ji matsɛ ɔ, hiɔmi be nɛe ha mɛ.
Ke Egipt bi hu ma kua ke a be yae nɛ a ya ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha haomihi nɛ ba je ma amɛ nɛ kua yami nɛ a ya ja lɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ nɔuu maa ba Egipt bi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Egipt bi, kɛ je ma kpahi tsuo nɛ ma kua ke a be yae nɛ a ya ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ, bɔ nɛ a maa gbla mɛ tsuo a tue ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa ngma ngɛ okpɔngɔ kuɛ ngmlɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ke, “Klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ.” Buɛhi nɛ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu kaa kãhi nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɔuu.
Buɛhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ ma ba sã bɔ ɔ, ma ba ngɔ buɛ nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa hoo lohwe nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ɔ ngɛ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, jua yelɔ ko jua yelɔ ko be Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi hie hu.
NYA TSƆƆMI A ngma Malaki womi nɛ ɔ be mi nɛ a dla ma Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, maa pee jeha lafa enuɔ loko a fɔ Kristo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ a je mi bami, kɛ Mawu jami tsuo ba puɛ.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo sisiɔ Mawu bɔ nɛ a suɔ.
Nike ní nɛ sa kaa a ba ha Mawu ɔ, a ba ha we lɛ; Mawu mlaa amɛ hu a yi nɔ.
Ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ gbalɔ Malaki tsu ji kaa e bɔ mɔde kaa e ma ha nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo nɛ ye somi nɛ a kɛ Mawu so ɔ nɔ ekohu.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e ha nɛ a nu sisi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ba kojo e ma a, nɛ e maa pee mɛ klɔuklɔu.
Loko Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba a, e maa wo e tsɔlɔ blɔ kɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e ba fiɛ, nɛ e dla blɔ ɔ kɛ to lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Israel he yayami ɔmɛ .—.
Mawu tue gblami kɛ e mɔbɔ nami .—.
Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha Malaki, nɛ e ya de Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yawɛ suɔ Israel Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I suɔ nyɛ sane saminya.” Se a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni lɛ o peeɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o suɔ wɔ?” Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Anɛ Esau kɛ Yakob ɔ, pi nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ lo?
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i je suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Yakob kɛ e nina, nɛ Esau kɛ e nina lɛɛ i nyɛ mɛ.
I kpata Esau yo nɔ zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ i ngɔ e weto ní ɔ kɛ ha nga mi gbehi.” Ke Esau nina Edom bi ma de ke, “A ywia wa ma amɛ lɛɛ, se wa maa ma mɛ ekohu” ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma he nɔ ke, “Ha nɛ a dla nɛ a ma; ke a ma a, ma ku ngɔ pue si ekohu kɛ yaa si a maa wo mɛ biɛ ke ‘Zugba nɛ a peeɔ yi wu tso ní ngɛ nɔ, kɛ ma nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ kɛ yaa neneene.’ ” Nyɛ maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma de ke, “Yawɛ kle, nɛ zugbahi nɛ ngɛ Israel huzu ɔmɛ a se po, e ngɛ he wami ngɛ a nɔ!” Yawɛ ka osɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Bi buu e tsɛ, nɛ tsɔlɔ hu buu e nyɔmtsɛ.
Ke tsɛ ji mi ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ bui mi mɔ?
Nɛ ke nyɔmtsɛ ji mi ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ yi mi gbeye?
Nyɛ gbeɔ ye he guɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ biɔ ke, ‘Kɛ wa plɛ kɛ gbe o he guɛ kɛɛ?’ Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee ji kaa nyɛ ngɔ niye ní nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ ba ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he.
Nɛ nyɛ biɔ mi ke, ‘Mɛni be wa pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?’ Ma de nyɛ!
Nyɛ ble ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ ngɔ lohwe hɛ yuyuilɔ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi ɔ, anɛ pi yayami ji lɔ ɔ lo?
Ke nyɛ ngɔ lohwe akpaketsɛ, aloo lohwe hiɔtsɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi ɔ, anɛ pi yayami ji lɔ ɔ lo?
Ke nyɛ ngɔ lohwe kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ya ke nyɛ amlaalo ɔ, anɛ e ma na nyɛ he bua jɔmi, aloo e maa pee nyɛ hiami níhi ha nyɛ lo?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ osɔfohi, nyɛɛ ka kaa nyɛ maa fa kue ha Mawu, konɛ e na wɔ mɔbɔ.
Ke nyɛ hɛɛ nike ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ba a, anɛ Mawu maa bu nyɛ kue fami ɔ tue lo?
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “I ná nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ya nga ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ya slɛ la ngɛ ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ yaka gu hu.
I be nyɛ he bua jɔmi; nyɛ nike ní ɔmɛ hu, i be ngɔe.
Je ma amɛ tsuo, kɛ je pu site he kɛ ya si pu sinɔ he ɔ, woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami.
A sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa mi ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ a kɛ nike ní nɛ he tsɔ hu baa.
Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ deɔ ke ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he be se nami ko.
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ngɔɔ niye ní nɛ a hiee kɛ ba sãã bɔ ngɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Mɛni haomi po ji nɛ ɔ!’ Nɛ nyɛ gbeɔ ye he guɛ.
Lohwe nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba sãã bɔ ha mi ji lohwe jujui, loo akpaketsɛ, loo hiɔtsɛ.
Anɛ ma he bɔhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ lo?
Nɔ nɛ to ku ngɛ e to tsu mi, nɛ e wo si ke e kɛ lɔ ɔ maa sã bɔ ha mi, se mohu e ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ kpa ngɛ he kɛ ba a, musu tloo kikɛmɛ a sisilɔ nɛ ɔ!
Ejakaa matsɛ nguaa ji mi, nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo yeɔ mi gbeye.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji kaa nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da nɛ nyɛ kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
Ke nyɛ bui nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue ɔ, ma gbiɛ nyɛ; nɛ gbaami nɛ i ko gbaa nyɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee tue gblami mohu.
Niinɛ, i gbiɛ nyɛ momo, ejakaa nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Ma gbla nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a tue.
Lohwehi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ba sãã bɔ ha mi ɔ, ma ngɔ a fĩ kɛ kpa nyɛ hɛ mi.
Nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya pue kuku nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa na kaa imi lɛ i wo nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ somi ɔ nɛ ngɛ i kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ wa kpɛti ɔ nɛ da si.
“I wo mɛ si ke ma ha mɛ wami, kɛ tue mi jɔmi, nɛ i pee ja konɛ a bu mi.
Niinɛ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a buu mi, nɛ a yeɔ mi gbeye.
A tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ ji anɔkuale ɔ, se pi nɔ́ nɛ dɛ.
A kɛ mi hi si saminya.
Pi kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛkɛ, se a ha nɛ nihi babauu hu kpa yayami peemi.
E sa kaa osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ ma a ní, nɛ a le Mawu anɔkuale mi.
E sa kaa ma a nɛ ya a ngɔ nɛ a ya kase ye suɔmi nya ní.
Ejakaa imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, ye tsɔli ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Se, nyɛ osɔfohi!
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da a nɔ.
Nyɛ ní tsɔɔmi ɔ ha nɛ nihi fuu a nane kpata.
Somi ɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, nyɛ yi nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi hu ma ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hie nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ pee we ye suɔmi nya ní; mlaa a hu, nihi a hɛ mi lɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ kɛ tsɔɔ.” Ma a yi Mawu anɔkuale Anɛ pi tsɛ kake too nɛ wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ lo?
Anɛ pi Mawu kake too ɔ nɛ bɔ wɔ tsuo lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ wa yi wa nyɛmimɛ anɔkuale ɔ?
Somi ɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ, mɛni he je wa yi nɔ ɔ?
Si nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ wo Mawu ɔ, a yi nɔ; mohu ɔ, a tsu musu ní ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ.
A ble Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ e suɔ saminya a. Nyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ yihi nɛ jaa ma se mawuhi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ je lɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
A ko ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ hɛ mi hu gblegbleegble.
Nɔ́ kake hu nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ji kaa nyɛ nyaa awe, nyɛ woɔ yana, nɛ nyɛ foɔ vo nyu kɛ pueɔ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; ejakaa nike ní nɛ nyɛ kɛ baa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, e he we hu.
Nyɛ biɔ ke, “Mɛni he je Yawɛ he we wa nike ní ɔmɛ ngɛ wa dɛ hu?” Ɛ̃ɛ̃, ma tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ he je!
Yawɛ le kaa si ko nɛ o wo o nihe mi yo kpeekpee ɔ, o yi nɔ hu.
Yo nɛ o wo si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ke o kɛ lɛ maa hi si saminya a, o yi lɛ anɔkuale.
O kɛ o yo ɔ, anɛ Mawu pee we nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kake lo?
Mɛni he je lɛ Mawu pee ja a?
Mawu pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ fɔ bimɛ nɛ ma ba pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, si nɛ nyɛ wo nyɛ nihe mi yi kpeekpee ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó je se kɛ ya pee nɔ́ kpa.
Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, “I sume nɛ nɔ fieɔ e yo.
Ke nɔ ko pee e yo yi wu tso nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i sume.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya, konɛ si ko nɛ nyɛ wo nyɛ yi ɔmɛ kaa nyɛ maa ye mɛ anɔkuale ɔ, nyɛ ko je se.” Kojomi ligbi ɔ su ta Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ munyu babauu ɔ woɔ Yawɛ pɔtɔ.
Se nyɛ biɔ ke, “Kɛ wa peeɔ kɛ woɔ lɛ pɔtɔ kɛɛ?” Ɛ̃ɛ̃, bɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ji kaa nyɛ deɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e hi, nɛ Yawɛ suɔ lɛ.” Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ biɔ ke, “Jije Mawu nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ ngɛ?”
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma tsɔ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e ma ya dla blɔ ngɔ to mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ maa ba e we ɔ tlukaa.
Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ nyɛ hla kaa nyɛ maa na a maa ba, nɛ e ma ba fiɛ ye somi ɔ.” Se, ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba a, mɛnɔ lɛ ma nyɛ maa da si?
Ligbi ɔ nɛ e ma ba hia si ɔ, mɛnɔ yi ma na wami?
E maa ba kaa jale nɛ nya wa, aloo la nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ dade he.
E ma ba kojo kaa bɔ nɛ sika hiɔ ga ní tsulɔ tsuɔ sika hiɔ he ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu ga ní tsulɔ tsuɔ sika he ɔ, ja ji bɔ nɛ Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ maa tsu osɔfo ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a ngɔ nike ní nɛ sa kɛ ba ha lɛ Yawɛ ɔ. Nike ní nɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ma ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, ja jã loko nike ní ɔ maa sa e hɛ mi kaa sa a. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba kojo, nɛ ma gbla nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tue amlɔ: kunya yeli, gba puɛli, lakpa odase yeli, nihi nɛ sisiɔ ní tsuli nɛ a wui mɛ hiɔ susui, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa yalɔyihi, awusahi, kɛ nibwɔhi yi mi.
Ee, ma gbla nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui mi ɔ tue.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka hami “Imi ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ; i tsakee we.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ nyɛ, Yakob nina a, nyɛ hɛ mi kpataa we lolo ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ngmɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ a he kɛ fɔ si, nɛ nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa nyɛ.
Se nyɛ biɔ ke, ‘Kɛ wa maa pee kɛ kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ kɛɛ?’ I ngɛ bie ke, Mawu ɔ, anɛ nɔmlɔ sisiɔ lɛ lo?
Dɛbi!
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi sisie.
Nyɛ biɔ mi ke, ‘Kɛ wa plɛ kɛ ngɛ mo sisie kɛɛ?’ Mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka, kɛ nike ní nɛ ma a ba haa mi ɔ, nyɛ sisiɔ mi ngɛ mi.
Gbiɛmi ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ, ejakaa ma a tsuo ngɛ mi sisie.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ tsuo kɛ ba nito he ɔ, konɛ niye ní nɛ hiɛ ngɛ ye we ɔ. Nyɛɛ ka mi nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa i be hiɔwe saflɛhi blie nɛ ma ha nɛ ní kpakpa babauu maa nɛ ngɔ pue nyɛ nɔ babaaba kaa hiɔmi lo?
I be hae nɛ lohwe tsɔwitsɔwihi nɛ kpata nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; nyɛ wai tso ɔmɛ hu maa wo wai yiblii kplanyakplanyaa ngɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo maa na kaa a gbaa nyɛ niinɛ, ejakaa zugba a tsuo maa pee kɛ bua jɔmi sɔuu.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Mawu wo si ke e maa na mɔbɔ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ tuɔ munyuhi nɛ a he wa kɛ siɔ mi.
Se nyɛ biɔ ke, ‘Kɛ wa plɛ kɛ tu munyu kɛ si mo kɛɛ?’ Ɛ̃ɛ̃, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Mawu jami he be se nami; ke wa ye Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ wa pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa nihi nɛ a he yayami ngɛ mɛ dɔe ɔ, mɛni se wa ma na?
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa naa paa kaa he woli ji nihi nɛ a gbaa mɛ saminya; yayami peeli ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ plɔkee ngɛ je mi; a kaa Mawu, se nɔ́ ko pee we mɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ kɛ a sibi tu munyu, nɛ Yawɛ bu tue nɛ e nu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ. Ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ, a ngma nihi tsuo nɛ a yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ a buɔ lɛ ɔ a biɛ.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee imi nitsɛ ye ma.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma tsu ní ɔ, a maa pee ye nihi pɔtɛɛ.
Ma na mɛ mɔbɔ kaa tsɛ naa lɛ nitsɛ e bi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ mɔbɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ye ma a maa na slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ dalɔ kɛ yayami peelɔ a kpɛti; nyɛ maa na slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mi, kɛ nɔ nɛ sɔmɔ we mi ɔ a kpɛti.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su ta Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Be ma nɛ he woli, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo maa sã kaa bɔ nɛ nga sãã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa sã pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a he nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be piɛe.
Se nyɛ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ mi gbeye ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ ye he wami nɛ nya wa a ma tsa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ yi ma na wami kaa bɔ nɛ pu la tsaa hiɔtsɛ ɔ. Nyɛ he mi maa jɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi kaa na bihi nɛ a bli mɛ nɛ a ngɛ tuue kɛ je tsu mi.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma tsu ní nɛ ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ maa pee kaa la zu ngɛ nyɛ nane sisi, nɛ nyɛ maa naa a nɔ.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
“Mlaa slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ kɛ gu ye tsɔlɔ Mose nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kai nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ.
“Se loko Yawɛ ligbi nguaa a nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ maa su ɔ, ma tsɔ gbalɔ Eliya kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Lɛ nɛ e maa dɔ tsɛmɛ a tsui kɛ ba a bimɛ a he, nɛ bimɛ hu a tsui maa ba a tsɛmɛ a he; nɛ e maa pee mɛ kake ekohu.
Ke pi ja a, ma ba, nɛ ma ba kpata nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi.” Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
NYA TSƆƆMI Mateo Sane Kpakpa a tsɔɔ wɔ kaa Yesu ji Kpɔlɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu wo e ma a he si ngɛ somi momo ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.
Yesu nɔ Mawu gu kɛ ye jamɛ a siwo ɔ nɔ.
Yesu ɔ, Yuda fɔfɔɛ ji lɛ, nɛ Yuda bi a kpɛti e hi.
Se sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ, pi Yuda bi kɛkɛ a nɔ́; je ɔ tsuo nɔ́.
A to Mateo womi ɔ ngmami he blɔ nya saminya.
A je sisi kɛ Yesu fɔmi, bɔ nɛ a sɔle lɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ Abosiami ka lɛ.
A tsa nɔ kɛ e ní tsumi ngɛ Galilea, e fiɛmi, e ní tsɔɔmi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ.
Jehanɛ hu a ngma bɔ nɛ Yesu hia blɔ kɛ je Galilea kɛ ya Yerusalem, níhi nɛ ya nɔ ngɛ nyagbe otsi ɔ mi hluu kɛ ya si Yesu sɛumi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje.
Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kaa Yesu ɔ, tsɔɔlɔ nguaa ji lɛ.
E ngɛ Mawu mlaa a ɔ sisi tsɔɔmi ɔ nɔ he wami saminya, nɛ e tsɔɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he ní.
Níhi nɛ e tsɔɔ ɔ, a ma nyɛ bua nya kɛ wo kuu enuɔ mi: Yoku nɔ fiɛmi .
Fiɛmi nɛ ɔ kɔɔ hiɔwe ma a mi bi a je mi bami, a ní tsumi, a blɔ nya, kɛ ba a nɔ ngɛ je mi he.
Sɛ gbi kɛ ha kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ .
Abɛhi nɛ kɔɔ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ he .
Kaselɔ peemi .
Je nɛ ɔ nyagbe, kɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ .
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Yesu Kristo fɔmi kɛ e weku kpa .—.
Yohane, nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛmi .- A sɔle Yesu, nɛ Abosiami ka lɛ .—.
Yesu je e ní tsumi sisi ngɛ Galilea .—.
Yesu je Galilea kɛ ya Yerusalem .—.
Nyagbe otsi ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ e he kɔpe ɔmɛ .—.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ te si, nɛ e je e he si kɛ tsɔɔ .-
Yesu Kristo weku kpa Yesu Kristo, Abraham kɛ David nina a, e weku kpa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Abraham fɔ Isak, nɛ Isak fɔ Yakob, nɛ Yakob fɔ Yuda kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.
Yuda kɛ Tamar fɔ Perez, kɛ Zera; nɛ Perez fɔ Hezron, nɛ Hezron fɔ Ram.
Ram fɔ Aminadab, nɛ Aminadab fɔ Naashon, nɛ Naashon fɔ Salmon.
Salmon kɛ Rahab fɔ Boaz, nɛ Boaz kɛ Rut fɔ Obed, nɛ Obed fɔ Ishai.
Ishai fɔ Matsɛ David, nɛ Matsɛ David kɛ Uria yo ɔ fɔ Salomo.
Salomo fɔ Rehoboam, nɛ Rehoboam fɔ Abiya, nɛ Abiya fɔ Asa.
Asa fɔ Yehoshafat, nɛ Yehoshafat fɔ Yehoram, nɛ Yehoram fɔ Uzia.
Uzia fɔ Yotam, nɛ Yotam fɔ Ahaz, nɛ Ahaz fɔ Hezekia.
Hezekia fɔ Manase, nɛ Manase fɔ Amon, nɛ Amon fɔ Yosia.
Yosia fɔ Yehoyakin, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, be mi nɛ a ba ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya a. Benɛ a ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ya Babilon se ɔ, Yehoyakin fɔ Shealtiel, nɛ Shealtiel fɔ Zerubabel.
Zerubabel fɔ Abiud, nɛ Abiud fɔ Eliakim, nɛ Eliakim fɔ Azor.
Azor fɔ Zadok, nɛ Zadok fɔ Akim, nɛ Akim fɔ Eliud.
Eliud fɔ Eleazar, nɛ Eleazar fɔ Matan, nɛ Matan fɔ Yakob.
Yakob fɔ Yosef nɛ ji Yesu nɛ a tsɛɛ nyɛ Maria huno ɔ. Kristo ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je Abraham nɔ kɛ ba su David nɔ ɔ peeɔ yi nɔ nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ.
Kɛ je David nɔ kɛ ba su be nɛ a ngɔ ma a nyɔguɛ kɛ ya Babilon ɔ peeɔ yi nɔ nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ.
Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ ba su be nɛ a fɔ Kristo ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu peeɔ yi nɔ nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ.
A fɔ Yesu Kristo Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo fɔmi ɔ ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yosef ya bi Yesu nyɛ Maria si, se e na we nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba hi si lolo nɛ a na kaa Maria hɛɛ hɔ kɛ je Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi.
E huno Yosef ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ji lɛ, nɛ e hla we kaa e ma pue Maria hɛ mi si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e to kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e he kpoo.
Se benɛ Yosef ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yosef, David nina, koo ye gbeye kaa o kɛ Maria maa hi si kaa o yo; hɔ nɛ e hɛɛ nɛ ɔ je Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi.
E ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu, ejakaa e ma he e ma a yi wami kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ a mi.” A pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de kɛ gu gbalɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Hyɛ, yiheyo ko ma na muklii, nɛ e ma fɔ binyumu; a ma tsɛ lɛ ke Yimanuel” nɛ sisi ji, “Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Yosef hɛ tsɛ̃ kɛ je mahe ɔ mi ɔ, e pee bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ e yo ɔ.
Se e kɛ lɛ na we nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi hluu kɛ ya su be nɛ Maria fɔ binyumu.
Nɛ Yosef wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu.
Ní leli je beleku kɛ ba Benɛ a fɔ Yesu ngɛ Betlehem nɛ ngɛ Yudea, ngɛ Matsɛ Herode yi nɔ ɔ, ní leli komɛ je beleku kɛ ba Yerusalem ba bi ke, “Bimwɔyo ɔ nɛ a fɔ nɛ e ba ye Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔ matsɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ?
Wa na e dodoe ngɛ beleku, nɛ wa ba, konɛ wa ba ja lɛ.” Benɛ Matsɛ Herode nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e hao, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem hu hao ja nɔuu.
E tsɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kpe, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Jije a ma fɔ Kristo ɔ ngɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Ngɛ Betlehem nɛ ngɛ Yudea a. Ejakaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mo Betlehem ma, ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ, mo ji ma nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a kpɛti; se o mi lɛ matsɛ maa je kɛ ba ye ye ma Israel ɔ nɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ Herode tsɛ ní leli ɔmɛ zaa, nɛ e bi mɛ fitsofitso be mi nɛ dodoe ɔ je.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho Betlehem ya kɛ sɛ gbi ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hla bimwɔyo ɔ fitsofitso.
Ke nyɛ na lɛ ɔ, nyɛ ba de mi, konɛ imi hu ma ya nɛ ma ya ja lɛ.” Benɛ a nu matsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Nɛ ɛ dodoe ɔ nɛ a na ngɛ beleku ɔ nyɛɛ a hɛ mi hluu kɛ ya si dodoe ɔ ya da he nɛ bimwɔyo ɔ ngɛ ɔ yi mi.
Benɛ a na dodoe ɔ, a na bua jɔmi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
A sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ a na bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ Maria a, a kpla si nɛ a ja bimwɔyo ɔ.
A pɛne a kotoku ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ke lɛ ní: sika tsu, mimɛ, kɛ mire.
Akɛnɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ nlami mi ke a ko kpale a se kɛ ya Herode ngɔ hu he je ɔ, a gu blɔ kpa kɛ ho a ma mi ya.
A kɛ bimwɔyo ɔ tu fo kɛ ya Egipt Benɛ ní leli ɔmɛ je ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko je e he kpo tsɔɔ Yosef ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Herode ma ba hla bimwɔyo ɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si!
Ngɔɔ bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ tu fo kɛ ya Egipt.
Nyɛ ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma to mo.” Yosef te si, nɛ e ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ a pue nɔ nyɔ mi kɛ ho Egipt ya ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ Herode gbo.
A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de kɛ gu gbalɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi ke, “Egipt nɛ i tsɛ ye bi ɔ kɛ je.” A gbe Betlehem jokuɛwi Benɛ Herode na kaa ní leli ɔmɛ sisi lɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu wawɛɛ.
E tsɔ nɛ a ya gbe jokuɛ nyumuwi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Betlehem, kɛ lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi; a gbe kɛ je muɔloku nɔ kɛ ya si ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye jeha enyɔɔnyɔ a nɔ.
Herode kale kɛ je be nɛ ní leli ɔmɛ tsɔɔ kaa dodoe ɔ je ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yeremia de ɔ ba mi ke, “A nu gbi ko ngɛ Rama, kɔmɔ yemi kɛ ya boboobo.
Rahel ngɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ foe, nɛ e kplɛɛ we kpatami, ejakaa e bimɛ ɔmɛ gbo.” A kpale kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba Galilea Herode gbenɔ se ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko je e he kpo tsɔɔ Yosef ngɛ nlami mi ngɛ Egipt, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tee si!
Ngɔɔ bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ o kpale o se kɛ ya Israel zugba a nɔ.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ hla kaa a gbe bimwɔyo ɔ, a gbo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yosef te si, nɛ e ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho Israel zugba a nɔ ya.
Se benɛ Yosef nu kaa Arkelao ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ e tsɛ Herode se ngɛ Yudea a, e ye gbeye kaa e maa ya lejɛ ɔ.
A kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ nlami mi, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e je kɛ ho Galilea kpokpa a nɔ ya, nɛ e ya hi ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Nazaret ɔ. Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbali ɔmɛ de to ɔ ba mi ke, “A ma tsɛ lɛ Nazaret no.”
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛmi Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ ba Yudea nga a nɔ, ba bɔni fiɛmi ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui, ejakaa hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ su si ta.” Yohane ji nɔ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya de ngɛ e he ke, “Nɔ ko ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ nga a nɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ je blɔ kɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ; nyɛ ha e blɔ ɔ nɛ da tlɔmɔɔ.’ ” Yohane ɔ, afukpɔngɔ he womi a kɛ lo e tade; lohwe he womi kpa fi e mlɛ mi, nɛ e niye ní ji baalɛ kɛ nga nɔ hwo.
Nihi je Yerusalem, Yudea, kɛ Yordan kpokpa a nɔ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ.
A ba jaje a he yayamihi, nɛ e sɔle mɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a mi.
Benɛ Yohane na kaa Farisi bi, kɛ Saduki bi babauu ma e ngɔ nɛ e sɔle mɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ sinɔhi a nina, mɛnɔ wo nyɛ ga ke nyɛɛ tu fo ngɛ tue gblami nɛ Mawu kɛ ma nyɛ nɔ ɔ nya.
Nyɛɛ pee níhi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui.
Nyɛ ko susu kaa ke nyɛ de kɛkɛ ke nyɛ nɛ̃ ji Abraham ɔ, nɛ tue gblami ko be nyɛ nɔ bae.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Mawu ma nyɛ ngɔ tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee Abraham nina!
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, gbiɛ ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ tso sipoku ɔmɛ a nɔ momo; tso tsuaa tso nɛ wui yiblii kpakpa a, a maa po, nɛ a ma sake ngɔ fɔ la mi.
Imi lɛɛ nyu i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sɔlee kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui.
Se nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ ye se ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ la e kɛ ma tsu nɔ nɛ ɔ. Lɛɛ e pe mi; e tokota tete po, i sɛ nɔ nɛ hɛɛɔ.
E hɛɛ e ngma mi sami tsimi ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e kɛ maa sa e ngma a tsuo mi.
E ma bua e ngma a nya kɛ wo gba mi, se tsakati ɔ lɛɛ e maa sã ngɛ la nɛ gbo we gblegbleegble mi.” A sɔle Yesu Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu je Galilea kɛ ba Yohane ngɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a nya, konɛ Yohane nɛ sɔle lɛ.
Jinɛ Yohane ka lɛ blɔ tsimi; e de Yesu ke, “Imi mohu nɛ e hia kaa o sɔle mi ɔ, nɛ moo o ma ye ngɔ nɛ ɔ?” Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Oo, moo kplɛɛ kɛkɛ, ejakaa kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɔ nɛ wa maa gu kɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yohane kplɛɛ.
Benɛ a sɔle Yesu ɔ, e je kpo amlɔ kɛ je pa a mi.
A bli hiɔwe nya ha lɛ, nɛ e na Mawu Mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ si kplee kaa okpo nɛ ma e nɔ mami.
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “Imi nitsɛ ye bi nɛ i suɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Ee, i ngɛ e he bua jɔmi saminya.”
Abosiami ka Yesu Jehanɛ ɔ, Mumi ɔ ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya, konɛ Abosiami ya ka lɛ.
Benɛ Yesu ha hwɔ nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ se ɔ, hwɔ ye lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Abosiami ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Ke Mawu Bi ji mo ɔ, fa tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a plɛ abolo.” Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ngmami ɔ ke, ‘Pi abolo kɛkɛ nɛ haa nɔmlɔ yi naa wami, se mohu munyu tsuaa munyu nɛ jee Mawu nya a.’ ” Jehanɛ ɔ, Abosiami ngɔ Yesu kɛ ya Yerusalem, ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya da sɔlemi we ɔ yi mi ploplooplo, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke Mawu Bi ji mo ɔ, hlu kɛ ya ma zugba, ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke, ‘Mawu ma ha nɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ maa bu o he.
A maa hɛɛ mo ngɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ o nane tete po be tɛ sie.’ ” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ngmami ɔ de ekohu ke, ‘Koo ka Nyɔmtsɛ, o Mawu ɔ.’ ” Jehanɛ lɛɛ Abosiami ngɔ Yesu kɛ ya yo gagaaga ko nɔ.
E tsɔɔ Yesu matsɛ yemihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ha, nɛ e de Yesu ke, “Ke o kpla si nɛ o ja mi ɔ, ma ngɔ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha mo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Satan, jee hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!
Ngmami ɔ ke, ‘Ja Nyɔmtsɛ o Mawu ɔ, nɛ o sɔmɔ lɛ pɛ!’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ Abosiami si lɛ, nɛ bɔfohi ba nɛ a ba sɔmɔ lɛ.
Yesu je e ní tsumi sisi ngɛ Galilea Benɛ Yesu nu kaa a nu Yohane ɔ, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Galilea ya.
E je Nazaret kɛ ba hi Kapernaum, wo nya ma a nɛ ngɛ Zebulun kɛ Naftali kpokpa a nɔ ɔ.
A pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya de to ɔ nɛ ba mi ke, “Zebulun zugba, kɛ Naftali zugba nɛ ngɛ wo nya blɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se!
Galilea, ma je li a zugba!
Nihi nɛ hi diblii mi ɔ ba na la nguaa.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ hi gbenɔ zugba, kɛ gbenɔ hɔ̃ mi ɔ, la je ha mɛ.” Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu bɔni fiɛmi ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui, ejakaa hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ su si ta.” Yesu tsɛ wo hɛli eywiɛ Benɛ Yesu ngɛ si kpae ngɛ Galilea wo ɔ nya a, e na nyɛmimɛ hɛli enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ ya fɔe ngɛ wo ɔ mi.
Mɛ ji Simon, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Andrea.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba nyɛɛ ye se, nɛ ma ha nyɛɛ maa hɛ nimli kaa a hɛɛ lo.” Amlɔ ɔ, a si a ya amɛ, nɛ a ba nyɛɛ e se.
Benɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, e na nyɛmimɛ enyɔ kpa komɛ ngɛ lɛ mi nɛ a kɛ a tsɛ Zebedeo ngɛ ya kpɛe, nɛ e tsɛ mɛ.
Mɛ ji Yakobo kɛ Yohane.
Amlɔ ɔ, mɛ hu a si a lɛ ɔ, kɛ a tsɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Yesu tsɔɔ ní, e fiɛ, nɛ e tsa nihi Yesu kpa Galilea tsuo; e tsɔɔ ní ngɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ e fiɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane kpakpa a, nɛ e tsa hiɔhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a he.
Yesu he sane gbɛ fĩa Siria zugba a tsuo nɔ; nɛ a ngɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ haomi slɔɔtohi a mi kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e tsa mɛ: kɔkɔtsɛmɛ, hulemi hiɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi.
Nihi babauu je Galilea, Ma Nyɔngma amɛ, Yerusalem, Yudea, kɛ mahi nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ba nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Yoku nɔ fiɛmi Benɛ Yesu na ma kpekpemi ɔ, e kuɔ yoku ɔ, nɛ e ya hi si.
E kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e bɔni mɛ ní tsɔɔmi ke, Bua jɔmi nitsɛ “A gbaa nihi nɛ le kaa mumi mi ohiatsɛmɛ ji mɛ, ejakaa a nɔ́ ji hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.
“A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ, ejakaa Mawu maa jɔɔ a bua.
“A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he jɔ, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu wo he si ɔ, a nine maa su nɔ.
“A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ hlaa kaa be tsuaa be ɔ, a pee nɔ́ nɛ da, ejakaa Mawu ma ha a ma na bua jɔmi babauu.
“A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ naa mɔbɔ, ejakaa a maa na mɛ mɔbɔ.
“A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsui mi tsɔ, ejakaa a maa na Mawu.
“A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ kpataa pɛ, ejakaa a ma tsɛ mɛ Mawu bimɛ.
“A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi ngɛ lɔ ɔ he, ejakaa a nɔ́ ji hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.
“A gbaa nyɛ, ke nihi jɛ nyɛ, nɛ a wa nyɛ yi mi, nɛ a tu munyu yaya slɔɔtohi kɛ si nyɛ ngɛ ye he.
Nyɛ nya, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi, ejakaa nyɛ hiɔwo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ kle agbo.
Gbali nɛ sɛ nyɛ hlami ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu a wa mɛ yi mi.
Ngo, kɛ la “Nyɛ ngɛ kaa ngo kɛ ha je ɔ.
Se ke ngo nya nyu gbo ɔ, mɛni a kɛ ma futu lɛ, nɛ e maa dooɔ ekohu?
E he be se nami hu kaa ja a tsɛ̃ pue he, nɛ nimli naa nɔ.
“Nyɛ ngɛ kaa la kɛ ha je ɔ. Ma nɛ a bɔ ngɛ yoku nɔ ɔ, e be nyɛe maa laa.
Jehanɛ se hu, nɔ ko su we kane kɛ ma sowe sisi; mohu e kɛ maa kane tso nɔ, nɛ́ e tso ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi.
Nyɛ ha nyɛ la a nɛ tso ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ja nɔuu, konɛ a na ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nɛ a wo nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Mlaa he ní tsɔɔmi “Nyɛ ko susu kaa i ba nɛ ma ba gu Mose mlaa a, kɛ níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ. Dɛbi!
I bɛ mɛ gumi; se mohu, i ba, konɛ ma ba tsɔɔ a sisi saminya.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, be abɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba ngɛ nɛ ɔ, a be nɔ́ nyafii tslɛ po jee kɛ je mlaa a mi kɛ yaa si a maa gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsua nɔ nɛ maa tɔ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyafii kake, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ ni kpahi ke a pee ja a, a maa bu lɛ nɔmlɔ nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ ni kpahi hu ke a pee ja a, a maa bu lɛ nɔmlɔ nguaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke loko nyɛ maa sɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, ja nyɛ ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ pee ɔ mi pe mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ.
Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ mi mi fumi he “Tse nyɛ nu kaa a de blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, ‘Koo gbe nɔmlɔ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, a kojo lɛ.’ Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mi mi fuɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, a maa kojo lɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jɛɔ e nyɛmi ke, ‘Yaka nɔmlɔ’ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ maa ba kpe ngua a hɛ mi; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jɛɔ e nyɛmi ke, ‘Kuasia’ a, e maa ya Abosiami a je la a mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o kɛ o nike ní ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ o kai ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa o nyɛmi kɛ mo ngɛ sane ko ɔ, si o nike ní ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Yaa esɔ, nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmi ɔ ya kpata lolo, konɛ o kpale kɛ ba nɛ o kɛ o nike ní ɔ ba ha Mawu.
“Ke nɔ ko sama mo, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔ, o kɛ lɛ nɛ tsa mla.
Ke pi ja a, o pɛbilɔ ɔ maa ngɔ mo ya wo kojolɔ ɔ dɛ mi; kojolɔ hu maa ngɔ mo ya wo tsɔlɔ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ a maa wo mo tsu.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ke o be lejɛ ɔ jee kɛ yaa si o maa wo hiɔ nɛ o ye ɔ sisiisi.
Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ gba puɛmi he “Tse nyɛ nu kaa a de blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ko puɛ gba!’ Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ yo, nɛ e he peeɔ lɛ akɔnɔ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ puɛ gba momo ngɛ e tsui mi.
Ke o hiɔ nɔ hɛngmɛ haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, hiaa nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he.
E hi ha mo kaa o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ ko maa laa pe nɔ́ nɛ a ma sake o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo ngɔ fɔ Abosiami a je la a mi.
Jã kɛ̃, ke o hiɔ nine haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, poo nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he.
E hi ha mo kaa o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ ko maa laa pe nɔ́ nɛ a ma sake o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo ngɔ fɔ Abosiami a je la a mi.
Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ gba mi pomi he “A de hulɔ ke, ‘Ke nɔ ko maa fie e yo ɔ, e ha lɛ fiemi womi.’ Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nɔ ko fie e yo nɛ pi kaa yo ɔ ya bɔ ajuama a, e ha nɛ yo ɔ puɛ gba.
Ke nɔ ko fie e yo ɔ, nɔ kpa nɛ ya ngɔ yo nɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e puɛ gba.
Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ kita kami he “Tse nyɛ nu hulɔ kaa a de blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ko ka kita yaka gu, se o ye si nɛ o wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ.’ Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ ko ka kita kulaa!
Nyɛ ko ka hiɔwe, ejakaa Mawu matsɛ sɛ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ko ka zugba, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu kɛ e nane maa nɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ; loo Yerusalem, ejakaa Matsɛ ngua a ma ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ko ka o yi tete, ejakaa o be nyɛe maa pee yi bwɔmi ngmelu kake po ehiɔ loo eyumu.
Ke nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kɛkɛ nɛ o ma de ji, ‘Ee’; ke e be mi ɔ, de ke, ‘Dɛbi’.
Ke nɔ́ kpa ko piɛ he ɔ lɛɛ Abosiami dɛ mi e je.
Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ peemi kɛ to nane mi he “Tse nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke, ‘A pɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ hɛngmɛ nane mi, nɛ a ku lungu ngɛ lungu nane mi.’ Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke ke nɔ ko pee nyɛ yayami ɔ, nyɛ ko pee lɛ yayami ngɔ to nane mi.
Ke nɔ ko gba o hiɔ ɔ nɔ tue mi ɔ, plɛ kake ɔ hu ha lɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ya sama mo ngɛ o hiɔwe tade he ɔ, ha nɛ e ngɔ o tade klɔii ɔ hulɔ.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko nyɛ o nɔ ke o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya si tomi kake ɔ, o kɛ lɛ nɛ ya si tomi enyɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ba mo nɔ́ ɔ, ha lɛ; ke nɔ ko ke o pa lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, ko kua.
Suɔ o he nyɛli “Tse nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke, ‘Suɔ o huɛ, nɛ o nyɛ o he nyɛlɔ.’ Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he nyɛli, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle ha nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi, konɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ bimɛ.
Ejakaa e haa e pu ɔ jee ngɛ nimli yayamihi, kɛ nimli kpakpahi a nɔ; nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ ha nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ dɛ tsuo.
Ke nyɛ suɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ nyɛ ɔ pɛ ɔ, mɛni hiɔwo pa ngɛ ha nyɛ?
Anɛ tó tsuli ɔmɛ tete pee we ja nɔuu lo?
Nɛ ke nyɛ ngaa nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛni tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee pe ni kpahi?
Anɛ ma je li ɔmɛ tete pee we ja nɔuu lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hi kɛ pi si ɔ!
Nike ní hami “Ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ sa tsumi ngɛ nyɛ Mawu jami mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ kó tsu ngɛ ma hɛ mi nɛ nihi ba na nyɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ be hiɔwo ko ngɛ nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɔ hu.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o maa ke nɔ́ ɔ, koo pee lɛ hoo kaa bɔ nɛ osatotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ ngɛ kpe hehi, kɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ.
A peeɔ jã, konɛ nihi nɛ je a yi.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke a nine su a hiɔwo nɔ momo.
Se moo lɛɛ ke o maa ke nɔ́ ɔ, ko ha nɛ o huɛ nitsɛnitsɛ tete po nɛ le; moo ke nɔ́ ngɛ laami mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o Tsɛ ɔ nɛ lɛɛ e naa níhi nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ maa wo mo hiɔ.
Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ sɔlemi he “Ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, nyɛ ko pee nyɛ ní kaa osatotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ!
A suɔ kaa a da kpe he ɔmɛ, kɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a kɔ nya kɛ sɔle, konɛ nihi nɛ na mɛ.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a nine su a hiɔwo nɔ momo.
Se moo lɛɛ ke o maa sɔle ɔ, yaa sɛ o tsu mi, nɛ o nga sinya a, nɛ o sɔle ngɔ ha o Tsɛ nɛ a nɛ lɛ ɔ. Nɛ o Tsɛ nɛ naa níhi nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ maa wo mo hiɔ.
“Ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, nyɛ ko tu munyu putɛputɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ jali peeɔ ɔ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a susuu kaa ke a tu munyu fuu loko Mawu maa bu mɛ tue.
Dɛbi, nyɛ ko pee nyɛ ní kaa mɛ!
Loko nyɛ ma de ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɔ́ ko bie ɔ, lɛɛ e le níhi nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ momo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɔle kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: ‘Wa Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe; O biɛ ɔ he nɛ tsɔ.
O Matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ ba; a pee nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. Ha wɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ wa daa nya ngma; Ngɔɔ wa tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ pa wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu waa kɛ paa nihi nɛ tɔɔ wa nɔ ɔ. Nɛ o kɛ wɔ ko ya ka mi; se mohu, je wɔ kɛ je nɔ yayami ɔ dɛ mi.’ “Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi a tɔmihi pa mɛ ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ tɔmihi maa pa nyɛ.
Se ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi a tɔmihi pɛ mɛ ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ hu kɛ nyɛ tɔmihi be nyɛ pae.
Ní tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ hwɔ hami he “Jehanɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ, nyɛ ko pee nyɛ hɛ mi mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa bɔ nɛ osatotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ ɔ.
A peeɔ a hɛ mi nyanyaanya, konɛ nihi nɛ a na kaa a ngɛ hwɔ hae.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a nine su a hiɔwo nɔ momo.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ke nyɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ yi bwɔmi, nɛ nyɛ fɔ nyɛ hɛ mi.
Ni kpahi nɛ a ko na kaa nyɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae, ja nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ a nɛ lɛ ɔ pɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ naa nɔ́ nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ ma ha nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hiae ɔ. Hiɔwe juetli “Nyɛ ko to juetli ha nyɛ he ngɛ je ɔ mi he nɛ wɔyewɔye, kɛ kana puɛɔ ní, nɛ juli juɔ ngɛ ɔ.
Se mohu nyɛɛ to juetli ha nyɛ he ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ wɔyewɔye, kɛ kana puɛ we ní ngɛ, nɛ juli hu ju we ɔ. Ejakaa he nɛ o juetli ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ o tsui hu maa hi.
Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ la “Hɛngmɛ ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kane.
Ke o hɛngmɛ nɔ tsɔ ɔ, o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo ma hyi kɛ la.
Se ke o hɛngmɛ nɔ tsɔ we ɔ, lɛɛ o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo maa wo diblii.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke la nɛ ngɛ o mi ji diblii ɔ, lɛɛ jamɛ a diblii ɔ mi ma ti wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Mawu kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ní “Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma sɔmɔ nyɔmtsɛmɛ enyɔ; eko ɔ, e maa nyɛ nɔ kake, nɛ e maa suɔ nɔ kake; aloo e maa pee nɔ kake suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nɔ kake ɔ lɛɛ e be lɛ bue fɛɛ.
O be nyɛe ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ sika tsuo.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ ko hao ngɛ nyɛ wami he, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nu, aloo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, bo nɛ nyɛ ma bu, loo tade nɛ nyɛ maa wo.
Anɛ wami pã we ngma lo?
Anɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ pã we heha nɔ́ lo?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ha; a du we ní, nɛ a kpa we ní; jehanɛ hu, a bua we ní nya kɛ wui ngma gba mi.
Se nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ lɛɔ mɛ.
Anɛ nyɛ he jua wɛ hluu pi mɛ lo?
Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ kɛ yeyeeye peemi ma nyɛ tsɔ e kami nya nine kpɔ mi kami kake?
“Lɛɛ mɛni he je nyɛ peeɔ yeyeeye ngɛ heha nɔ́ he?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ ngɛ puɛe ngɛ nga nɔ; a tsu we ní, nɛ a tsɛ̃ we kpa.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Matsɛ Salomo kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo tete sui enɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake he fɛu.
Nga, nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ e bɔ, nɛ hwɔɔ kɛkɛ a sake kɛ fɔ la mi ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu mia lɛ saminyayoo ha!
Anɛ Mawu be nyɛe nɛ e pee enɛ ɔ kɛ be nɔ ha nyɛ lo!
Oo, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi saasaa!
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ bi ke, ‘Mɛni wa maa ye?
Aloo mɛni wa maa nu?
Aloo mɛni wa maa ngɔ kɛ ha wa he?’ Níhi nɛ ma je li dii se ji enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ le kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he hia nyɛ.
Se nyɛ hla Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ níhi nɛ da ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ kekle, nɛ a kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa piɛ he ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ha hwɔɔ; ejakaa hwɔɔ hu ma kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e haomihi babauu.
Haomihi nɛ baa daa ligbi ɔ, e hia we kaa waa ngɔ ekpa ko kɛ ba piɛ ligbi ko nɔ́ he hu.
Koo kojo ni kpahi “Nyɛ kó kojo nihi, konɛ Mawu hu kó kojo nyɛ.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ kojoɔ nihi ɔ, jã Mawu hu maa kojo nyɛ.
Susumi nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ susuu ha nihi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu a kɛ ma susu ha nyɛ.
Mɛni he je nɛ o naa ngu nyafii nɛ ngɛ o nyɛmi hɛngmɛ nɔ nɛ plai nɛ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ lɛɛ o nɛ ɔ?
Kɛ o ma plɛ kɛ de o nyɛmi ke, ‘Ha ma je ngu nyafii ɔ ngɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ;’ be mi nɛ plai ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ?
Osatotsɛ!
Je plai ɔ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ kekle.
Ke o pee jã loko o maa hyɛ nɔ́ saminya, nɛ o ma je ngu nyafii ɔ ngɛ o nyɛmi ɔ hɛngmɛ nɔ.
“Nyɛ ko ngɔ níhi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ngɔ ha gbehi; ke nyɛ pee jã a, a ma plɛ wo nyɛ, nɛ a ma tua nyɛ.
Nyɛ ko sake nyɛ june ngɔ pue kpotoohi a blɔ mi; ke nyɛ pee jã a, a maa naa nɔ.
Nyɛ bi, nyɛ hla, nyɛ si “Nyɛ bi, nɛ a ma ha nyɛ; nyɛ hla, nɛ nyɛ maa na; nyɛ si, nɛ a ma bli sinya a ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ biɔ ɔ, a haa lɛ; nɔ nɛ hlaa a, e naa; nɛ nɔ nɛ siɔ sinya a, a bliɔ kɛ haa lɛ.
Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ nɛ ke e bi bi lɛ abolo nɛ e ma ha lɛ tɛ?
Aloo mɛnɔ lɛ ke e bi bi lɛ pa mi lo nɛ e ma ha lɛ sinɔ?
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ yayami po, tse nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ haa nyɛ bimɛ ní kpakpahi!
Nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, anɛ lɛɛ e be nyɛe ma ha nihi nɛ biɔ lɛ ɔ ní kpakpahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ lo?
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nihi nɛ pee ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ja nɔuu ngɔ ha mɛ.
Mose mlaa a, kɛ ní nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Agbo tokofii ɔ “Nyɛɛ sɛ agbo tokofii ɔ mi, ejakaa agbo nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa hɛ mi kpatami mi ɔ mi bli.
Blɔ nɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ hu ngɛ gbajaa, nɛ nihi babauu nyɛɛɔ nɔ kɛ sɛɛ mi.
Se agbo nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi ɔ ngɛ tokofii; blɔ ɔ hu hí, nɛ nihi bɔɔ pɛ lɛ naa blɔ ɔ. Tso kɛ e yiblii “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ lakpa gbali a he.
Ke a ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, a naa mɛ kaa jijɔ, se anɔkuale mi ɔ, a ngɛ kaa ogbeteehi; a ní peemi níhi nyɛɛ kɛ maa le mɛ.
Mio tso wui wai yiblii, nɛ zezle hu wui ngmɔkɔ.
Tso kpakpa a, yiblii kpakpa nɛ e woɔ, nɛ tso yaya hu woɔ yiblii yaya.
Tso kpakpa be nyɛe maa wo yiblii yaya, nɛ tso yaya hu be nyɛe maa wo yiblii kpakpa.
Tso tsuaa tso nɛ wui yiblii kpakpa a, a hɛɛ, nɛ a sakeɔ kɛ fɔɔ la mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, níhi nɛ lakpa gbali ɔmɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa le mɛ.
I li nyɛ kulaa “Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛɔ mi ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ maa sɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi; se mohu nɔ nɛ peeɔ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ suɔmi nya ní.
Kojomi ligbi ɔ, nihi babauu ma bi mi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ!
Pi o biɛ mi nɛ wa fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ lo?
Pi o biɛ mi nɛ wa hia mumi yayamihi ngɛ lo?
Nɛ pi mo o biɛ mi nɛ wa pee nyakpɛ ní fuu ngɛ lo?’ Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu ma de mɛ ke, ‘I li nyɛ!
Nyɛɛ je ye nɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ dɛ blɔ!’ Tsu mali enyɔ ɔmɛ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e yeɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa ní lelɔ ko nɛ ma e tsu ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ.
Hiɔmi ba nɛ, nɛ pahi hia, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia wawɛɛ kɛ si tsu ɔ.
Se tsu ɔ hule we, ejakaa a to sisi ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ.
“Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nyumu kuasia nɛ ma e tsu ngɛ zia nɔ.
Hiɔmi ba nɛ, nɛ pahi hia, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia wawɛɛ kɛ si tsu ɔ. Nɛ e hule kɛ pue si butuu nɛ nɔ́ ko piɛ.” He blɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ gbe nya a, ni ɔmɛ a nya kpɛ a he ngɛ bɔ nɛ e plɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní ɔ he.
E tsɔɔ mɛ ní kaa nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya, se pi kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ní ɔ.
Yesu tsa nyumu ko Benɛ Yesu kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se.
Tlukaa a, nyumu ko nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ba e ngɔ ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke o suɔ kaa ye he nɛ tsɔ ɔ, o ma nyɛ pee!” Yesu kpã e nine mi, nɛ e ta nɔ ɔ he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I suɔ; o he nɛ tsɔ!” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, hiɔ ɔ ta ngɛ e he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, ko ya de nɔ ko nɔ́ ko oo!
Se mohu yaa nɛ o kɛ o he ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ, nɛ e hyɛ mo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a na kaa a tsa mo ɔ, yaa sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mose wo mlaa ke a pee ɔ.” Yesu tsa Roma asafoatsɛ ko nyɔguɛ Benɛ Yesu ba Kapernaum ɔ, Roma asafoatsɛ ko ba e ngɔ ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ye nyɔguɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ we mi kɛ hulemi hiɔ nɛ e hí nɔ́ ko peemi.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “I ma ba nɛ ma ba tsa lɛ.” Se Roma asafoatsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, Nyɔmtsɛ, i sɛ kaa i haa nɛ o baa ye we mi; moo lɛɛ moo tu munyu kɛkɛ, nɛ ye nyɔguɛ ɔ ma na he wami.
Imi hu i ngɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ ye nɔ, kɛ ta buli ngɛ ye sisi.
