I deɔ nɔ kake ke, ‘Yaa’, nɛ e yaa; i deɔ nɔ kpa ke, ‘Ba’, nɛ e baa; jehanɛ se hu, i deɔ ye nyɔguɛ ke, ‘Pee enɛ ɔ’, nɛ e peeɔ.” Benɛ Yesu nu nɔ́ nɛ nyumu ɔ de ɔ, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa, nɛ e de nihi nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Israel bi a kpɛti tete po, i nɛ hemi kɛ yemi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ!
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nihi babauu maa je beleku, kɛ bonyoku kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ Abraham, kɛ Isak, kɛ Yakob ma ba ye ní ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Se ni nɛmɛ mohu nɛ sa matsɛ yemi ɔ mi himi ɔ, a ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ tsu ɔ se ngɛ diblii kpii ɔ mi; nɛ a maa wo ya, nɛ a ma kpe lungu nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de asafoatsɛ ɔ ke, “Moo ya; bɔ nɛ o he ye ɔ, é ba mi ja ha mo.” Jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, a tsa nyɔguɛ ɔ. Yesu tsa nihi babauu Benɛ Yesu ba Petro we ɔ mi ɔ, e na Petro nganyɛ nɛ hwɔɔ si kɛ asla.
E pɛtɛ yo ɔ nine si, kɛkɛ nɛ asla a po ngɛ e nɔ, nɛ e bɔni mɛ sɔmɔmi.
Jamɛ a gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a ngɔ nihi babauu nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ.
E hia mumi yayami ɔmɛ kɛ je ni ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya de ɔ nɛ ba mi ke, “E ngɔ wa dengme ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ e tsa wa hiɔ ɔmɛ.” Ni komɛ nɛ hla kaa a maa nyɛɛ Yesu se Benɛ Yesu na nihi babauu nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, e fa e kaseli ɔmɛ ke a ya wo ɔ se je.
Kɛkɛ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ko ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ o yaa a, i kɛ mo maa ya.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Kɔkɔbohi ngɛ muɔ, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ngɛ tsu, se Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ lɛɛ e be he ko nɛ e kɛ e yi fɔɔ.” Kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kpa hu de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha ma ya nɛ ma ya pu tsaatsɛ lolo.” Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ba nyɛɛ ye se!
Ha nɛ ni gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ a pu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ni gbogboehi.” Yesu jɔɔ wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ he Yesu sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ yaa.
Tlukaa a, wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ba hia, nɛ oslɔke bɔni kumi kɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi woe.
Se Yesu lɛɛ e hwɔ mahe.
Kaseli ɔmɛ ya tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa gbo oo!
He wa yi wami!” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ gbeye yee?
Tsia!
Nyɛ be hemi kɛ yemi pɛ!” Jehanɛ ɔ, e te da si, nɛ e nga kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, kɛ wo ɔ tsuo yi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ jɔ dii.
Ni ɔmɛ a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ bie ji, “Mɛni nɔmlɔ slɔɔto ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ, kɛ wo tete buɔ lɛ tue?” Yesu tsa nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ a mi Benɛ Yesu ba su wo ɔ se je ngɛ Gadara bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
Yɔkɔhi a mi a hii; nɛ bɔ nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye ha a, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e guu jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Si kake too ɔ, mumi yayami ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke, “Mo Mawu Bi, mɛni sane waa kɛ mo ngɛ?
Anɛ o ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ba gbla wa tue loko be ɔ nɛ su lo?” Kpotoohi babauu ngɛ ní yee ngɛ lokoo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke, “Ke o hia wɔ ɔ, ha wɔ blɔ nɛ wa ya sɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a mi.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Yoo, nyɛɛ ya!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a je kpo, nɛ a ya sɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a mi.
Si kake too ɔ, kpotoo kuu ɔ tsuo wo fo kɛ kple kɔ̃ ɔ kɛ ya sɛ wo ɔ mi, nɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata.
Kpotoo hyɛli ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ ya sɛ ma a mi, nɛ a ya sɛɛ sane ɔ tsuo, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi ɔ a nɔ ɔ hulɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo bu kɛ ba ná Yesu.
Benɛ a na lɛ ɔ, a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e je a kpokpa a nɔ kɛ ho.
Yesu tsa nɔ ko nɛ nu hulemi hiɔ Yesu sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ e po wo ɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ hulemi hiɔ nue fɔ sa nɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ.
Benɛ Yesu na bɔ nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wa ha a, e de hiɔtsɛ ɔ ke, “Ye bi, wlua mo!
A kɛ o he yayami ɔmɛ pa mo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ tu munyu kusikusi ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ musu bɔe.” Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ, nɛ e bi ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ ní yayahi susue ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ɔ?
Hyɛ, kaa a ma de ke, ‘A kɛ o he yayami ɔmɛ pa mo’, aloo, ‘Tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ’ ɔ, te e mi nɔ́ nɛ demi wa nɛɛ?
Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɛ he blɔ kaa e ngɔɔ nihi a he yayamihi kɛ paa mɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de hiɔtsɛ ɔ ke, “Tee si, ngɔɔ o sa a, nɛ o ho we mi ya!” Nyumu ɔ te si, nɛ e ho we mi ya.
Benɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a je Mawu yi kaa e ha nɔmlɔ adesa he wami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Yesu tsɛ Mateo Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ benɛ e yaa a, e na tó tsulɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mateo nɛ hii si ngɛ e ní tsumi he ɔ. Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ye se!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mateo te si, nɛ e nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní yee ngɛ Mateo we ɔ mi ɔ, tó tsuli babauu, kɛ ni kpa komɛ nɛ a buu mɛ yayami peeli ɔ ba ba piɛ Yesu, kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a he kɛ ye ní ɔ. Farisi bi komɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli ngɛ ní yee ɔ?” Benɛ Yesu nu ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nihi nɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ, tsopatsɛ he hia we mɛ kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ gboe.
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hla ngmami nɛ ɔ sisi: ‘Mɔbɔ nami i ngɛ hlae, se pi bɔ sami!’ I bɛ nɛ ma ba tsɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, se mohu yayami peeli.” Hwɔ hami Pee se ɔ, Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je waa kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ haa hwɔ, nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a hɛ hwɔ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke a fɔ̃ nihi nine kɛ ya yo kpeemi ɔ, anɛ a maa ye kɔmɔ be abɔ nɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ lo?
Dɛbi!
Be maa ba nɛ a maa ngɔ ayɛflo huno ɔ kɛ je a kpɛti kɛ ho; jamɛ a be ɔ loko a maa ha hwɔ.
“Nɔ ko ngɔɛ bo he kɛ ta we tade momo mi.
Ke o pee jã a, he nɛ o ta a ma hía, nɛ puɔ ɔ ma bli mohu pe kekle ɔ. Jã kɛ̃, nɔ ko ngɔɛ wai he kɛ wui lohwe he womi tɔ momo mi.
Ejakaa lohwe he womi tɔ ɔ ma pɛ, nɛ wai ɔ ma pue si, nɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔ ma puɛ.
Wai he ɔ, lohwe he womi tɔ he mi mohu a kɛ woɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a se kɛɔ.” Ma nɔkɔtɔma a biyo ɔ, kɛ yo nɛ ta Yesu tade ɔ he ɔ Benɛ Yesu kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu nɛ ɔ tue ɔ, Yuda ma nɔkɔtɔma ko ba ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye biyo gbo amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu; ba nɛ o ba ngɔ o nine ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, kɛkɛ e maa ba wami mi ekohu.” Yesu te si, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ nyumu ɔ se kɛ yaa.
Yo ko nɛ muɔ ngɛ bee ngɛ e he jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ sɔuu ba je Yesu se tlukaa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ta Yesu tade ɔ nya a he.
E de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Ke i ná ta Yesu tade ɔ he kɛkɛ ma na he wami.” Yesu plɛ e he, nɛ benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e de lɛ ke, “Biyo, o tsui nɛ nɔ o mi; o hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tsa mo.” Nɛ yo ɔ na he wami jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu.
Benɛ Yesu ba nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi, nɛ e na bɛ kpali, kɛ nihi babauu nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae hoo ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ!
Yiheyo ɔ gbo we; mahe kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ hwɔe.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ muɔ lɛ.
Se benɛ a fie ni ɔmɛ kɛ je kpo ɔ, Yesu sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e pɛtɛ yiheyo ɔ nine si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yiheyo ɔ te si.
Nɛ sane nɛ ɔ gbɛ fĩa lejɛ ɔ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Yesu tsa hɛ yuyuili enyɔ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ benɛ e yaa a, hɛ yuyuili enyɔ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ke, “David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ oo naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Benɛ Yesu ya sɛ we ko mi ɔ, hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa ma nyɛ ma tsa nyɛ lo?” A he nɔ ke, “Ee, Nyɔmtsɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ta a hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e de ke, “A pee ha nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ!” Nɛ a hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ bli.
Jehanɛ, Yesu bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ko nu he oo!” Se benɛ a si lɛ ɔ, a ya gbɛ e he sane ɔ ngɔ fĩa lejɛ ɔ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
Yesu tsa amuɛti ko Jehanɛ lɛɛ, benɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jee ɔ, a kɛ amuɛti ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi ba Yesu ngɔ.
Yesu hia mumi yayami ɔ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ, amuɛti ɔ bɔni munyu tumi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee nimli kpekpemi ɔ nyakpɛ, nɛ a de ke, “A nɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko hyɛ ngɛ Israel!” Se Farisi bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Mumi yayamihi a tsɛ ɔ he wami nɛ e kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yesu mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a he Yesu kpa ma amɛ, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
E tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ; e fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ he ɔ, nɛ e tsa hiɔ slɔɔtohi tsuo.
Benɛ e na ma kpekpemi ɔ, e mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa pɔ tɔ mɛ, nɛ a dɛ yaa kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Ngmɔ ɔ ba ní saminya; se mohu apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛ a he pi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa ngmɔtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ, konɛ e wo apaatsɛmɛ blɔ kɛ ba bua ní nya.”
Bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ Yesu tsɛ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ hia mumi yayamihi, nɛ a kɛ tsa hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ hulɔ.
Bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Kekleekle nɔ ji Simon (nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ), kɛ e nyɛmi Andrea, Yakobo, kɛ e nyɛmi Yohane, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ, Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo, Toma, kɛ Mateo tó tsulɔ ɔ Alfeo bi Yakobo, kɛ Tadeo, Simon (ma he doolɔ ɔ), kɛ Yuda Iskariot, nɔ nɛ ba tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ ɔ.
A tsɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ Yesu tsɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ya ma je li a zugba ko nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko sɛ Samaria ma ko mi hulɔ.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ya Israel bi nɛ a ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ laa a a ngɔ.
Nyɛ ya fiɛ ke, ‘Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ su si ta!’ Nyɛ tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ; nyɛ tle ni gbogboehi si; nyɛ tsa nihi nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue, nɛ nyɛɛ hia mumi yayamihi.
Nyɛ ná lɛ yaka gu nɛ nyɛ wui he hiɔ; nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɔ ha nɛ nyɛ ko he hiɔwo.
Nyɛ ko fi sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ, loo akɔblee sika kɛ wo nyɛ mlɛ mi.
Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ko hɛɛ ní balɔ kotoku, loo hiɔwe tade enyɔ, loo tokota, loo dɛma tso tete; apaatsɛ ɔ, e nya ngma sa lɛ.
“Ma tsuaa ma, aloo kɔpe tsuaa kɔpe nɛ nyɛ maa sɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ bi si kaa nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ maa suɔ kaa e he nyɛ atuu lo.
Nyɛ ya to lɛ kɛ yaa su be nɛ nyɛ maa je.
Ke nyɛ sɛ we ko mi ɔ, nyɛ nga ni ɔmɛ!
Ke nihi nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a we ɔ mi he nyɛ atuu ɔ, nyɛɛ ba Mawu gbaami ha mɛ.
Se ke a ha we nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ nya se.
Ke we, loo ma ko mi bi he we nyɛ atuu, nɛ nyɛ sɛ gbi ɔ hu, a bui tue ɔ, nyɛ blɛ nyɛ nane si zu ngɔ pue lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ je.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, kojomi ligbi ɔ, Mawu maa gbla jamɛ a ma a tue kulaa pe Sodom kɛ Gomora tete.
A maa wa nihi yi mi “Hyɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔe kaa jijɔhi kɛ yaa ogbeteehi a kpɛti.
Nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ tɛ̃ kaa sinɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee kpoo kaa okpo.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ; ejakaa nihi maa nuu nyɛ, nɛ a maa kojo nyɛ, nɛ a maa fia nyɛ kpa ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ.
Ye he ɔ, a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya ganɔhi, kɛ matsɛmɛ a hɛ mi.
A ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ ye sane kpakpa a he odase ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, kɛ ma je li tsuo.
Ke a ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ho ɔ, nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma de, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma plɛ kɛ de lɛ ha a he.
Ke be ɔ su ɔ, a maa tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma de.
Ejakaa pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu ɔ, se mohu nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ nɛ maa tu munyu kɛ gu nyɛ nɔ.
“Nyɛmi maa ngɔ e nyɛmi ngɔ ha nɛ a ya gbe lɛ, nɛ tsɛmɛ hu maa ngɔ a bimɛ ngɔ ha ja nɔuu.
Bimɛ maa te si ngɔ wo a fɔli, nɛ a ma ha nɛ a gbe mɛ.
Ye he ɔ, nihi tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ ma wlua lɛ kɛ yaa si nyagbe ɔ, a ma he e yi wami.
Ke a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ngɛ ma ko mi ɔ, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ya ma kpa mi.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ be nyɛ ní tsumi ɔ nya gbee ngɛ Israel ma amɛ tsuo a mi, loko Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba.
“Kaselɔ pã we e tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ nyɔguɛ hu pã we e nyɔmtsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke kaselɔ, kɛ e tsɔɔlɔ ba sɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha lɛ.
Nyɔguɛ hu, ke e kɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ba sɔ ɔ, lɛ hu lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha lɛ.
Ke a tsɛ wetsɛ ɔ Beelzebul ɔ, e we mi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ mɛ biɛ yaya pe jã po!
Nɔ nɛ sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a bu nɔ ɔ, a ma ba je kpo; nɔ́ ko be nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa nɛ a be lee.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ngɛ diblii mi ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛɛ piani katakata; nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tue mi woe nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, nyɛɛ fiɛ ngɛ ma nɔ.
Nihi nɛ gbeɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, se klaa a lɛɛ a nyɛ we lɛ gbemi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.
Mawu nɛ nyɛɔ kpataa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ klaa a tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ Abosiami a je la a mi ɔ, lɛ mohu nyɛɛ ye gbeye.
Otoklii enyɔ ɔ, anɛ pi sika nɛ a yeɔ ɔ mi nyafii pe kulaa kake pɛ nɛ a juaa mɛ lo?
Se a ti nɔ kake nɔɛ zugba nɛ pi nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi tete po a kane lɛ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; nyɛ he jua wa hluu pe otokliihi babauu.
Kristo biɛ ta womi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa wo ye ta ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, imi hu ma wo e ta ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua mi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, imi hu ma kua lɛ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi.
Pi he jɔmi se klaate “Nyɛ ko susu kaa i ba, konɛ ma ha nɛ he jɔmi nɛ ba je ɔ mi.
Dɛbi, pi he jɔmi hami nɛ i ba; se klaate mohu i kɛ ba.
I ba nɛ ma ba ha nɛ binyumuhi nɛ a te si kɛ wo a tsɛmɛ, biyihi nɛ a te si kɛ wo a nyɛmɛ, nɛ nganyɛmɛ nɛ a te si kɛ wo nganyɛmɛ.
Nɔ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ma plɛ e he nyɛli.
“Nɔ nɛ suɔ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ pe imi ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ e binyumu, loo e biyo pe imi ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wo we e sɛumi tso kɛ nyɛɛ we ye se ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ laa e klaa ngɛ ye he ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ.
Hiɔwo kpakpa “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ nyɛ ɔ, imi e ngɛ hee ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ e ngɛ hee ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ gbalɔ akɛnɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, gbalɔ hiɔwo lɛ e ma na.
Nɔ nɛ heɔ dalɔ akɛnɛ dalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, dalɔ hiɔwo lɛ e ma na.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ha ni tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nyu nɛ mi jɔ nɛ e nu akɛnɛ ye kaselɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, e hiɔwo be lɛ bɔe gblegbleegble.”
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ tsɔ nihi Yesu ngɔ Benɛ Yesu tsɔɔ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ta a, e je kɛ ho ma amɛ nɛ a kɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ we ɔ a mi ya, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ní, nɛ e fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a wo Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ tsu.
Benɛ Yohane nu níhi nɛ Kristo ngɛ tsue ɔ a he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ, e tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ba ha Yesu ke, “Anɛ mo ji nɔ nɛ ma a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de Yohane níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue, kɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ. Hɛ yuyuili ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe, glɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, a he ngɛ tsɔe; amuɛtihi ngɛ nɔ́ nue, gbogboehi ngɛ si tee, nɛ a ngɛ sane kpakpa fiɛe ha ohiatsɛmɛ.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ mi mi fu we ngɛ ye he.” Yesu ye Yohane he odase Benɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ yaa a, Yesu tu Yohane he munyu kɛ tsɔɔ ma kpekpemi ɔ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ho nga a nɔ ya nɛ nyɛ yaa hyɛ?
Ngɔwu nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ mimiɛe lo?
Mɛni nyɛ ho hyɛmi ya?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ wo tade bɔdɔɔ lo?
Hyɛ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ tade bɔdɔɔ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a we mi nɛ a hii.
Nyɛ de mi koo!
Mɛni he je nyɛ ho ɔ?
Nɛ́ nyɛ ya hyɛ gbalɔ, pi ja?
Ee!
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ nɛ nyɛ ya na a pe gbalɔ tete.
Ejakaa Yohane ɔ he lɛ a ngma ngɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, i ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ tsɔe kɛ sɛ o hlami, nɛ e ya dla o blɔ ɔ ngɔ to mo.’ Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa ko hí si hyɛ nɛ pe lɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ pe Yohane.
Kɛ je be mi nɛ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ bɔni fiɛmi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ na nɔ́ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ hlaa kaa a maa ngɔ pani nya.
Be nɛ Yohane na we nɛ e ba a, gbali ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ Mose mlaa a, matsɛ yemi ɔ he munyu a tuɔ.
Ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ ma he a sɛ gbi ɔ nyɛɛ ye ɔ, Yohane ɔ ji Eliya nɛ maa ba a nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu!
“Mɛni he po ma ngɔ kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to?
A ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi nɛ hii si ngɛ jua nɔ, nɛ a ngɛ a juami bi dee ke, ‘Wa kpã bɛ ha nyɛ, se nyɛ dui; wa nya awe, se nyɛ yi kɔmɔ.’ Benɛ Yohane ba a, e yi ní, nɛ e nui nɔ́ ko hulɔ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ nihi tsuo de ngɛ e he ji, ‘Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi!’ Benɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba a, lɛɛ e yeɔ ní, nɛ e nuɔ wai.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nihi deɔ ji, ‘Hyɛ, jiklɔɔtsɛ, kɛ dã nulɔ; tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli a huɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ Mawu nile ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ woɔ lɛ nguɔ.” Nihi nɛ he we yi Mahi nɛ Yesu tsu nyakpɛ ní babauu ngɛ a mi ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a ma amɛ a mi ɔ tsakee we a tsui.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yesu ka a hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Korazin, musu tloo mo!
Betsaida, mo hu musu tloo mo!
Nyakpɛ ní babauu nɛ a pee ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, a ya pee ngɛ Tiro, kɛ Sidon mohu jinɛ a tsake a tsui momoomo.
Jinɛ Tiro, kɛ Sidon bi ma bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ a maa ngɔ a he kɛ wuwlua la zu mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsake a tsui niinɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, kojomi ligbi ɔ, Mawu maa na Tiro kɛ Sidon bi mɔbɔ kulaa pe nyɛ!
Nɛ mo, Kapernaum, tse o ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa a ma wo o nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe lokoo?
Siu!
Dla o he!
Abosiami la a mi mohu a ma sake mo kɛ fɔ!
Nyakpɛ ní babauu nɛ a pee ngɛ o mi ɔ, a ya pee ngɛ Sodom jinɛ e ko hi si kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. I ngɛ mo dee ke kojomi ligbi ɔ, Mawu maa na Sodom mɔbɔ kulaa pe mo.” Nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ba jɔɔ nyɛ he Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Tsaatsɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba Nyɔmtsɛ!
I naa mo si, ejakaa níhi nɛ o ngɔ kɛ laa ní leli, kɛ ga leli ɔ, o je kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko.
Ee, Tsaatsɛ, bɔ nɛ o suɔ kaa e ba mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Tsaatsɛ tu níhi tsuo ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko li Bi ɔ, ja Tsɛ ɔ pɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko li Tsɛ ɔ, ja Bi ɔ kɛkɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ Bi ɔ suɔ kaa e maa tsɔɔ mɛ Tsɛ ɔ.
“Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ tloo tlomi nɛ pɔ tɔ nyɛ, nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ nyɛ he.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ ye kuɛpã tso ɔ ngɔɔ tloo, nɛ nyɛɛ kase mi; ejakaa ye he jɔ, nɛ i baa ye he si kɛ jee ye tsui mi.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma na he jɔmi; ejakaa ye kuɛpã tso ɔ tloomi wɛ, nɛ ye tlomi ɔ hu jiɔ we.”
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he sane Pee se ɔ, Yesu ya gu blɛfo ngmɔ komɛ a mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Hwɔ ngɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ yee; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpɔ blɛfo, nɛ a bɔni kpemi.
Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ na a, a de Yesu ke, “Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a peeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ David pee ligbi ko, benɛ hwɔ ngɛ e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ yee ɔ, anɛ nyɛ kane we lo?
David ya sɛ Mawu we ɔ, nɛ e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ye abolo ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ. Mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a peeɔ ja; osɔfo ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a yeɔ jamɛ a abolo ɔ. Aloo nyɛ kane we ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi kaa daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, osɔfohi nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ bleɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, se kɛ̃ a yi fɔ lo?
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe sɔlemi we ɔ. Ngmami ɔ ke, ‘Mɔbɔ nami i ngɛ hlae, se pi bɔ.’ Nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi jinɛ nihi nɛ yi fɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko bui mɛ fɔ.
Ejakaa Mawu Bi ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ tete nyɔmtsɛ ji lɛ.” Nyumu ɔ nɛ nine kake gbo ɔ Benɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, e ya sɛ a kpe he ɔ, nɛ e na nyumu ko nɛ e nine kake gbo.
Ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a po Yesu nya kaa e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ pee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Ke a tsa nɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, anɛ a tɔ mlaa a lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ to kake pɛ, nɛ to ɔ ya nɔ muɔ mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Anɛ e be to ɔ he pɛtɛe nɛ e je lɛ lo?
Anɛ nɔmlɔ he jua wɛ kulaa pi to lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa mlaa a ngmɛɔ blɔ kaa a pee kpakpa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nyumu ɔ nɛ nine kake gbo ɔ ke, “Kpã o nine ɔ mi!” Nyumu ɔ kpã e nine ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nine ɔ tsa, nɛ e kɛ kake ɔ sɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ je kpo, nɛ a ya so Yesu yi nɔ, bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a kpata e hɛ mi.
Mawu tsɔlɔ nɛ e hla Benɛ Yesu nu kaa a so e yi nɔ ɔ, e sã e he si kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, se nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se.
E tsa nihi tsuo nɛ be he wami ɔ, nɛ e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko tu e he munyu nɛ nihi ba nu e he.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de kɛ gu gbalɔ Yesaya nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi ke, “Hyɛ, ye tsɔlɔ nɛ i hla a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i suɔ lɛ, nɛ i naa e he tsui.
Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo e mi, nɛ tue gblami nɛ i to ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, e maa fiɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
E be pɛe; e be ngmlaa kpae, nɛ nɔ ko be e gbi nue ngɛ magbɛ nɔ hulɔ.
E kɛ nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
E maa na dɛgutsɛmɛ mɔbɔ.
E ma tsu ní nɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si e ma ha nɛ dami sane yemi ma he si.
Nɛ ma je li tsuo maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.” Yesu kɛ Beelzebul Jehanɛ, ni komɛ ngɔ nyumu ko nɛ hɛ yu, nɛ e tu we munyu hulɔ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ; nyumu nɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ngɛ e mi.
Yesu tsa lɛ, nɛ e tu munyu, nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu.
Nimli kpekpemi ɔ a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a bi ke, “David Bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?” Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a de ke, “Mumi yayamihi a tsɛ Beelzebul ɔ biɛ mi pɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hiae ngɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yesu le nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ susue ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Matsɛ yemi tsuaa matsɛ yemi nɛ mi ma gba, nɛ a kɛ a he maa hi ta hwue ɔ, e se kɛ we.
Jã kɛ̃, ma tsuaa ma, aloo we tsuaa we nɛ e mi ma gba, nɛ a kɛ a he maa hi ta hwue ɔ, e dɛ si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Satan hia Satan ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa e mi gba, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɛ ta hwue.
Lɛɛ kɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa pee kɛ da si kɛɛ!
Yoo, ke Beelzebul he wami lɛ i kɛ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hiae ɔ, nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔ he wami nya nɛ mɛɛ a ngɛ mɛ hiae ngɛ mɔ?
Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ yeɔ fɔ!
Se imi lɛɛ ke Mawu Mumi ɔ lɛ haa mi he wami nɛ i kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ba na nyɛ momo.
“Kɛ nɔ ko ma plɛ kɛ sɛ nɔ nɛ he wa we mi nɛ e ya ju kɛɛ?
Ja e fi nɔmlɔ nɛ he wa nɛ ɔ kekle, loko e ma nyɛ ya ju ngɛ e we ɔ mi.
“Nɔ nɛ be ye blɔ fa mi ɔ, e te si ngɔ wo mi, ne nɔ nɛ kɛ mi bua we nɔ́ nya a, e ngɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ fĩae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, yayamihi nɛ nihi pee, kɛ musuhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ tsuo maa pa mɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ maa bɔ musu kɛ si Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, a kɛ be lɛ pae.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tu munyu kɛ si Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, a kɛ maa pa lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ maa tu munyu kɛ si Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, a kɛ be lɛ pae ngɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ, aloo yi nɔ nɛ maa ba a mi.
Tso kɛ e yiblii “Ke o du tso kpakpa a, e maa wo yiblii kpakpa; ke tso ɔ hí ɔ, e maa wo yiblii yaya.
Tso yiblii nɛ a kɛ leɔ tso.
Nyɛ sinɔhi a nina!
Nyɛ nimli yayamihi!
Kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ tu munyu kpakpa kɛɛ?
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ hyi tsui mi tɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nya deɔ.
Nɔmlɔ kpakpa jeɔ ní kpakpahi kɛ jeɔ e juetli kpakpahi a mi; nɔmlɔ yayami hu jeɔ ní yayahi kɛ jeɔ e juetli yayahi a mi.
“I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke kojomi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu akɔtaa ngɛ yaka munyu tsuaa yaka munyu nɛ e tu hyɛ he.
Munyuhi nɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ a maa da kɛ wo nyɛ nguɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu a nɔ a maa da kɛ bu nyɛ fɔ.” Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ okadi hlae Kɛkɛ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa ngɛ o nine nya okadi ko hlae nɛ waa hyɛ.” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ yi nɔ yaya bi nɛ nyɛ li Mawu!
Nyɛ ke nyɛ ngɛ ye nine nya okadi hlae, pi ja?
Dɛbi!
Okadi pɛ nɛ a ma ha nyɛ ji gbalɔ Yona nɔ́ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Yona ye nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ ngɛ wo mi lo nguaa a muklii mi ɔ, jã Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ye nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ ngɛ zu mi.
Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Nineve bi ɔmɛ maa te si nɛ a maa po nyɛ nya; ejakaa benɛ a nu nɛ Yona ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a tsake a tsui.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe Yona.
Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Sheba manyɛ ɔ maa te si nɛ e maa po nyɛ nya; ejakaa e hia blɔ kɛ je e ma mi tɔɔ kɛ ba bu Matsɛ Salomo nile munyuhi tue.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe Salomo!
Mumi yayami ɔ maa kpale kɛ ba “Ke mumi yayami je nɔ ko mi ɔ, e ya kpaa si ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ nɛ e hlaa he nɛ e maa jɔɔ e he ngɛ.
Ke e nɛ́ he ko ɔ, e deɔ e he ke, ‘Ma kpale ye se kɛ ya ye we ɔ mi he nɛ i je ɔ.’ Ke e ba a, e naa kaa we ɔ fɔɔ si gu, nɛ a bɛɛ mi, nɛ a dla mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e yaa nɛ e ya ngɔɔ mumi kpa kpaago kɛ baa, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba hii lejɛ ɔ. Mumi yayamihi nɛ pe lɛ nitsɛ po ji mumi nɛ ɔmɛ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nyagbe si himi ɔ ba peeɔ haomi kulaa pe sisije ɔ po.
Yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba mɛ hu a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ Benɛ Yesu kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e nyɛ, kɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ ba da agbo ɔ nya, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ tu munyu.
[ Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko de Yesu ke, “Hyɛ, o nyɛ, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ a suɔ kaa a kɛ mo nɛ tu munyu.”] Se Yesu bi nɔ nɛ ba tsɛ lɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji maa, nɛ mɛnɔmɛ ji ye nyɛmimɛ?” Jehanɛ, e je e nine ngɔ tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, maa, kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ suɔmi nya ní ɔ, lɛ ji ye nyɛminyumu, ye nyɛmiyo, loo maa.”
Ní dulɔ ɔ Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu je we ɔ mi kɛ ho wo ɔ nya ya, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nimli jiji nitsɛnitsɛ ba bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ya sɛ lɛ ko mi nɛ e hi si, be mi nɛ ma a tsuo daa si ngɛ wo ɔ nya.
Nɛ e tu mɛ munyuhi fuu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi.
E de ke, “Ligbi ko ɔ, ní dulɔ ko ho nɛ e ya du ní.
Benɛ e ngɛ wu ɔ fĩae ɔ, ekomɛ ya pue blɔ he, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba kukuɔ.
Ekomɛ ya pue tɛ sa nɔ, he nɛ zu be bɔ nɛ sa.
Wu ɔmɛ puɛ nɔuu, ejakaa zu ɔ mi kuɔ we.
Se benɛ pu je ɔ, pu ɔ sãã mɛ, nɛ akɛnɛ a be sipoku he je ɔ, a ngla.
Wu ɔ ekomɛ hu ya pue miohi a mi; se mio ɔmɛ ha we tso ɔmɛ mumi womi he, nɛ a gbo.
Se ekomɛ hu ya pue zugba kpakpa nɔ, nɛ tso ɔmɛ wo yiblii, ekomɛ lafa, ekomɛ nyingmi ekpa, kɛ ekomɛ hu nyingmi etɛ.” Nyagbe ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu.” Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ Yesu bu abɛhi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ a kɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi laami sane ɔ ha nyɛ; se mɛɛ a kɛ ha we mɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, a ma ha lɛ fuu kɛ piɛ he nɛ e na kɛ be nɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ, bɔɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tete po, a ma kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ.
Nɔ́ he je nɛ i kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ji: a ngɛ hyɛe, se a nɛ; a ngɛ tue bue, se a nui, nɛ a nui sisi hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbami nɛ Yesaya gba a kɔɔ a he niinɛ.
E ke, ‘Niinɛ, nyɛ maa nu, se nyɛ be sisi nue.
Niinɛ, nyɛ maa na, se nyɛ be se kɔe.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kplii a tsui; A wa tue, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́.
A ma a hɛngmɛ, konɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́.
A pee kikɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ a ko nu níhi a sisi; nɛ a ba kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ ma tsa mɛ.’ “Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ a gbaa nyɛ pɛ!
Nyɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe, nɛ nyɛ tue ngɛ nɔ́ nue.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke gbali, kɛ Mawu bimɛ babauu hla kaa a maa na níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, se a nɛ́; a hla kaa a maa nu níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ, se a nui.
Yesu tsɔɔ abɛ nɛ kɔɔ ní dulɔ ɔ he ɔ sisi “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue, konɛ nyɛɛ le nɔ nɛ abɛ nɛ kɔɔ ní dulɔ ɔ he ɔ tsɔɔ.
Nihi nɛ nuɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ he sɛ gbi, se a nui sisi ɔ, a ngɛ kaa wu nɛ ya pue blɔ he ɔ. Nɔ yayami ɔ baa nɛ e ba saa nɔ́ nɛ a du ngɛ a mi ɔ kɛ jeɔ.
Wu nɛ ya pue tɛ sa nɔ ɔ daa si ha nihi nɛ nuɔ sɛ gbi ɔ, nɛ a heɔ amlɔ kɛ bua jɔmi.
Se sɛ gbi ɔ he we si ngɛ a mi, nɛ e se kɛ we hulɔ.
Ke haomi, loo yi wami ba ngɛ munyu ɔ he ɔ, kɛkɛ a nane kpata.
Wu nɛ ya pue mio mi ɔ daa si ha nihi nɛ nuɔ sɛ gbi ɔ, se je nɛ ɔ mi he nya gbami, kɛ sika suɔmi gbee sɛ gbi ɔ, nɛ e wui yiblii.
Se wu nɛ ya pue zugba kpakpa nɔ ɔ lɛɛ e daa si ha nihi nɛ nuɔ sɛ gbi ɔ, nɛ a kɔɔ se hulɔ.
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ yiblii ɔ, ni komɛ lafa, ni komɛ nyingmi ekpa, kɛ ni komɛ hu nyingmi etɛ.” Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ hu he Yesu bu mɛ abɛ kpa ko hu ke, “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyumu ko du wu kpakpa ngɛ e ngmɔ mi.
Se nyɔ mi benɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hwɔ si ɔ, he nyɛlɔ ko ba du hu kɛ futu ngma a, nɛ e je.
Benɛ ngma a ba wa nɛ e wo yiblii ɔ, hu ɔ hu yi je kpo.
Wetsɛ ɔ tsɔli ba bi lɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, anɛ pi wu kpakpa nɛ o du ngɛ o ngmɔ ɔ mi lo?
Jije hu nɛ ɔ je mɔ?’ E he nɔ ke, ‘He nyɛlɔ ko lɛ pee enɛ ɔ nɛ.’ E tsɔli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, ‘Lɛɛ o suɔ kaa waa ya nɛ wa ya hia lo?’ E he nɔ ke, ‘Dɛbi, eko ɔ, ke nyɛ ngɛ hu ɔ hiae ɔ, nyɛ maa hia ngma a hu kɛ futu mi.
Nyɛ ha ngma a, kɛ hu ɔ tsuo nɛ wa kɛ yaa si ngma kpami be ɔ. Ke ngma kpami be ɔ su ɔ, ma de ní tsuli ɔmɛ ke a bua hu ɔ nya kekle nɛ a fi, konɛ a sã.
Lɔ ɔ se loko ma ha nɛ a bua ngma a nya kɛ wo ye gba a mi.’ ” Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ sinapi wu he Yesu bu mɛ abɛ kpa ke, “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Nyumu ko kɛ̃ sinapi wu, nɛ e ya du ngɛ e ngmɔ mi.
Sinapi wu ji wuhi nɛ a duɔ ɔ a kpɛti nyafii pe kulaa.
Se ke e wa a, e ba peeɔ tso nguaa pe tso ɔmɛ tsuo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ baa nɛ a ba peeɔ tsu ngɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ a mi.” Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ masa he Yesu bu mɛ abɛ kpa ke, “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Yo ko ngɔ masa nɛ e kɛ futu kplolo mamu lita nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ya su be nɛ lɛ tsuo fu.” Yesu kɛ abɛhi tsɔɔ ní Abɛhi lɛ Yesu bu nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ ma kpekpemi ɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Niinɛ, e de we mɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e bui abɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nya.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ de ɔ nɛ ba mi ke, “I kɛ mɛ maa tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi.
Níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa kɛ je be nɛ a to je ɔ sisi ɔ, ma fiɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.” Yesu tsɔɔ abɛ nɛ kɔɔ hu ɔ he ɔ sisi Benɛ Yesu si ma kpekpemi ɔ, nɛ e ba we mi ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Abɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ hu ɔ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ he ɔ, tsɔɔ wɔ sisi.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ du wu kpakpa a ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ.
Ngmɔ ɔ ji je ɔ; wu kpakpa a ji matsɛ yemi mi bimɛ ɔmɛ; hu ɔ ji nɔ yayami ɔ bimɛ.
He nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ du hu ɔ ji Abosiami.
Ngma kpami be ɔ ji je nɛ ɔ nyagbe, nɛ ngma kpali ɔmɛ ji hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a bua hu ɔ nya nɛ a sã a, jã nɔuu a maa pee ngɛ je nɛ ɔ nyagbe mi.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa tsɔ e hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ma ba bua nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ mi: ni nɛmɛ nɛ haa nihi a nane kpataa, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo.
A ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la hɛuu ɔ mi; nɛ lejɛ ɔ a maa wo yana, nɛ a ma kpe lungu nya.
Se Mawu ma a lɛɛ, a ma kpɛ kaa pu ngɛ a Tsɛ ɔ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu!
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ juetli nɛ a ngɔ laa a he “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Nyumu ko ya na juetli ngɛ zugba ko mi.
Benɛ e na juetli ɔ, e ngɔ laa ekohu.
Bua jɔmi sɔuu nɛ e na he je ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya jua níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ he jamɛ a ngmɔ ɔ. Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ adiagba he “Jehanɛ ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Jua yelɔ ko lɛ ngɛ adiagba saminyawiiwi hlae.
Benɛ e ya na adiagba saminyayoo kake nɛ he jua wa a, e ho nɛ e ya jua níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ he.
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ ya a he “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Wo hɛli komɛ fɔ ya ngɛ wo mi, nɛ a gbe lo slɔɔtohi babauu.
Benɛ ya a hyi ɔ, a sã kɛ ba wo ɔ nya, nɛ a ba hi si, nɛ a hla lo ɔ mi.
A bua kpakpa amɛ a nya ngɔ wo kusiihi a mi, se yaya amɛ lɛɛ a sake ngɔ pue he.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu a maa pee ngɛ je nɛ ɔ nyagbe mi.
Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ maa je kpo, nɛ a ma ba hla nimli yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ nimli kpakpa amɛ a kpɛti.
A ma sake mɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la hɛuu ɔ mi; nɛ lejɛ ɔ, a maa wo yana, nɛ a ma kpe lungu nya.” Juetli momo kɛ ehe Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi?” A he nɔ ke, “Ee.” E de mɛ ke, “Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mlaa tsɔɔlɔ tsuaa mlaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ ba plɛ pee kaselɔ ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wetsɛ ko nɛ jeɔ ní hehi, kɛ ní momohi kɛ jeɔ e nito he.” A kua Yesu ngɛ Nazaret Benɛ Yesu gbe abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a bumi nya a, e je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi.
E tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ bu lɛ tue ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he.
A bi ke, “Jije nyumu nɛ ɔ ná kikɛmɛ a nile nɛ ɔ kɛ je?
E nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ hu nɛɛ?
Anɛ pi kapitɛ ɔ bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?
Anɛ pi e nyɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ Maria a?
Pi e nyɛminyumuhi ji Yakobo, Yosef, Simon, kɛ Yuda a?
E nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ ɔ, anɛ pi waa kɛ mɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?
Jije e ya ná ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je mɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a mi mi fu lɛ.
Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “A buu gbalɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he, ja lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi, kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we mi pɛ.” Akɛnɛ a he we lɛ yi he je ɔ, e tsu we nyakpɛ ní fuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ gbenɔ Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Galilea nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Herode ɔ nu Yesu he, nɛ e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
A tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje; lɔ ɔ he nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ ní tsue ɔ nɛ.” Herode ha a nu Yohane, nɛ a fi lɛ, nɛ a wo lɛ tsu ngɛ e nyɛminyumu Filipo yo Herodia he.
Be ko ɔ, Yohane de Herode ke, “E dɛ kaa o ngɔɔ Herodia!” Jinɛ Herode hla kaa e gbe Yohane, se e ya ye Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbeye; ejakaa a buɔ Yohane gbalɔ.
Se benɛ Herode ngɛ e fɔmi ligbi yee ɔ, Herodia biyo ɔ ba do ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee Herode fɛu, nɛ e ka kita kɛ wo lɛ si ke, “Bi mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ, nɛ ma ha mo!” Akɛnɛ e nyɛ tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e bi he je ɔ, yiheyo ɔ de ke, “Ngɔɔ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ yi ngɔ fɔ sowe nɔ ba ha mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wa ha matsɛ ɔ, se kitahi nɛ e ka, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ a he je ɔ, e fa ke a pee jokuɛ yo ɔ suɔmi nya ní ɔ ha lɛ.
E tsɔ nɛ a ya po Yohane yi ngɛ tsu ɔ mi.
A ngɔ yi ɔ ngɔ fɔ sowe nɔ kɛ ba ha yiheyo ɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ ya ha e nyɛ.
Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ba, nɛ a ba ngɔ gbogboe ɔ ya pu.
Nɛ a ho nɛ a ya de Yesu.
Yesu ha nyumuhi akpe enuɔ niye ní Benɛ Yesu nu kaa a gbe Yohane ɔ, e ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho he ko banee ya.
Nihi babauu nu he, nɛ a je a ma amɛ a mi, nɛ a gu zugba blɔ kɛ nyɛɛ e se.
Yesu je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ e na ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ e tsa a kpɛti hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Benɛ je jɔ ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “ngapa ji hiɛ ɔ, nɛ du bu.
Wó ni ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ho kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi ya, nɛ a ya he ní nɛ a ye.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “E hia we kaa a ya; nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hla nɔ́ ko ha mɛ nɛ a ye.” Se a de lɛ ke, “Abolo enuɔ, kɛ lo enyɔ pɛ wa ngɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ ba ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!” Yesu fa ma kpekpemi ɔ ke a hi si ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Jehanɛ, e kukuɔ abolo enuɔ ɔ, kɛ lo enyɔ ɔ, nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe nɛ e na Mawu si.
E ku abolo ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu dla ngɔ ha ma a. Mɛ tsuo a ye nɛ a tɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a bua bibliwi nɛ piɛ ɔ nya ngɔ wo kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi, nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Nyumuhi nɛ ye ní ɔ maa su akpe enuɔ, slo yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi.
Yesu nyɛɛ wo hɛ mi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ha e kaseli ɔmɛ sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke a sɛ hlami kɛ ya wo ɔ se je.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo ma kpekpemi ɔ hu blɔ.
Benɛ e wo ni ɔmɛ blɔ se ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake e kuɔ yoku ɔ, nɛ e ya sɔle.
Benɛ je jɔ ɔ, Yesu nɔ kake too nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ ɔ su wo ɔ kpɛti momo.
Oslɔke ngɛ kue kɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi woe, ejakaa a ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kpee.
Makɛ maa pee ngmlɛ eywiɛ mi ɔ, Yesu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Benɛ a na lɛ nɛ e nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma a, a tsui po, nɛ a de ke, “Kpade lɛ ma a nɛ!” Gbeye nu mɛ, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa.
Se amlɔ ɔ, Yesu wo e nya nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ na tsui, imi!
Nyɛ ko ye gbeye!” Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mo ɔ, lɛɛ ha nɛ ma nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ba o ngɔ.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ba!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro je lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ yaa Yesu ngɔ.
Se benɛ e na kaa kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ngɛ fiae huu ɔ, e ye gbeye, nɛ e bɔni mumi kɛ yaa nyu ɔ sisi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, he mi!” Amlɔ ɔ, Yesu kpã e nine mi, nɛ e pɛtɛ e he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo nɛ o hemi kɛ yemi pi!
Mɛni he je nɛ o je nɔ́?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ kpa fiami.
Jehanɛ, kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ja Yesu, nɛ a de ke, “Niinɛ, Mawu Bi ji mo!” Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ Genesaret A po wo ɔ, nɛ a ba Genesaret zugba a nɔ, nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ yo Yesu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ kɛ ya kpa lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi tsuo, nɛ a ya ngɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ.
A kpa lɛ pɛɛ wawɛɛ ke e ha nɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ta e tade ɔ nya a he kɛkɛ.
Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ta he ɔ na he wami.
Blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi Pee se ɔ, Farisi bi, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Kusumi nɛ wa nimeli to sisi blema a, mɛni he je nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ bui ɔ?
A fɔ we a dɛ loko a yeɔ ní!” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ hu mɛni he je nyɛ yi Mawu mlaa a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ dii nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kusumihi a se ɔ?
Mawu wo mlaa ke, ‘Bu o tsɛ, kɛ o nyɛ,’ nɛ e de hu ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.’ Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma de e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ke, ‘Nɔ́ ko nɛ jinɛ o ko ná ngɛ ye dɛ mi ɔ, i ngɔ kɛ ke Mawu’ ɔ, lɛɛ e hia we kaa e bu e tsɛ loo e nyɛ hu.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ peeɔ, nɛ nyɛ siɔ Mawu mlaa a, nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kusumihi a se.
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nɔ́ nɛ Yesaya gba ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi!
Yesaya ngma ke, ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a nya mi munyu kɛkɛ a kɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami; se a tsui mi lɛɛ, a sume mi saasaa.
Yaka gu a jaa mi, ejakaa tsɔɔmihi nɛ a tsɔɔ ji mlaahi nɛ nimli pee.’ ” Níhi nɛ bleɔ nɔ Jehanɛ lɛɛ Yesu tsɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue, konɛ nyɛɛ nu sisi saminya!
Pi nɔ́ nɛ yaa nɔ nya mi ɔ nɛ bleɔ nɔ; mohu ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ jee nɔ nya a lɛ bleɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “O le kaa benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, e dɔ mɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tso tsuaa tso nɛ pi Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ ma a, a maa hia.
Nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɛ a he kulaa!
Hɛ yuyuili nɛ ngɛ hɛ yuyuili blɔ tsɔɔe ji mɛ.
Ke hɛ yuyuilɔ ngɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ tsɔɔe ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a maa nɔ muɔ mi.” Petro de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔ wɔ abɛ ɔ sisi!” Yesu ke, “Anɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ li ní kɛ mwɔɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ yaa nɔ nya mi ɔ, muklii mi e sɛɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e jeɔ kpo lo?
Se níhi nɛ jee nɔ nya a, tsui mi a jee; nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ bleɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa tsui mi nɛ susumi yayami nɛ ɔmɛ jeɔ: nɔmlɔ gbemi, gba puɛmi, ajuama bɔmi, jumi, lakpa odase yemi, kɛ nɔ biɛ puɛmi.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ bleɔ nɔ; se ke nɔ ko fɔ we e dɛ loko e ye ní ɔ, lɔ ɔ ble we nɔ.” Yo ko hemi kɛ yemi Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Tiro, kɛ Sidon zugba a nɔ ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Kanaan yo ko nɛ je lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ba kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!
Ye biyo ngɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi, nɛ e ngɛ lɛ haoe wawɛɛ nitsɛ.” Se Yesu pui e nya mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke, “Yo nɛ ɔ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ nyɛɛ wa se!
Wo lɛ blɔ nɛ e ho!” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Israel ma nɛ ngɛ kaa to nɛ laa a, mɛ pɛ a ngɔ nɛ a tsɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Yesu he nɔ ke, “E dɛ kaa a ngɔɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ a niye ní ɔ nɛ a sakee kɛ fɔɔ si ha gbehi.” Yo ɔ de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e ngɛ mi ja mohu, se tse gbe ɔmɛ hu yeɔ bibliwi nɛ jeɔ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ nɔ pueɔ si ɔ eko!” Jehanɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yo, o hemi kɛ yemi kle!
Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ, a pee ha mo!” Nɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, a tsa e biyo ɔ. Yesu tsa nihi babauu Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ya gu Galilea wo ɔ nya.
E kuɔ yo ɔ nɛ e ya hi si.
Ma kpekpemi nitsɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ slɔɔto babauu ba pue Yesu nane nya, nɛ e tsa mɛ.
Hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ji nihi nɛ hule, hɛ yuyuili, amuɛtihi, glɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ kpahi fuu.
Benɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ na nɛ amuɛti ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue, nɛ glɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he mi wa mɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ hule ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he.
Nɛ a je Israel Mawu ɔ yi.
Yesu ha nyumuhi akpe eywiɛ niye ní Yesu tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe ngɛ nimli kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Ligbi etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa ye.
I sume kaa ma wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho kɛ hwɔ; eko piɔ klibi ma ya po mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.” Kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Nga nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, jije wa ma na niye ní ngɛ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ maa su ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ nya?” Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Abolo enyɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Kpaago, kɛ lo tsɔwi bɔɔ ko.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu fa ma kpekpemi ɔ ke a hi si ngɛ zugba.
Jehanɛ, e kukuɔ abolo kpaago ɔ, kɛ lo ɔ, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ.
Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu dla ngɔ ha ma a. Mɛ tsuo a ye nɛ a tɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a bua bibliwi nɛ piɛ ɔ nya ngɔ wo kusii kpaago a mi, nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Nyumuhi nɛ ye ní ɔ, a yibɔ ji akpe eywiɛ, slo yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu wo ma kpekpemi ɔ blɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e sɛ lɛ mi kɛ ho Magadan zugba a nɔ ya.
A de Yesu ke e pee nyakpɛ ní Farisi bi komɛ, kɛ Saduki bi komɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, konɛ a ba ka lɛ.
A de lɛ ke e pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e je hiɔwe niinɛ.
Se e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, [“Ke pu yaa nɔ si ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Je mi ma tsɔ, ejakaa hiɔwe pee tsutsuu.’ Mɔtu ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Hiɔmi maa nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ejakaa hiɔwe pee tsutsuu, nɛ je ɔ mi pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ.’ Niinɛ, ke nyɛ hyɛ hiɔwe pɛ nyɛ le kaa je mi ma tsɔ, loo hiɔmi maa nɛ.
Se okadihi nɛ kɔɔ yi nɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a he lɛɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa tsɔɔ sisi!]
Mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ yi nɔ bi yayami nɛ li Mawu!
Nyɛ bi ke ma pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko ha nyɛ, pi jã?
Dɛbi!
Okadi pɛ nɛ a ma ha nyɛ ji Yona nɔ́ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu je a he, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Farisi bi kɛ Saduki bi a masa a Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ po mi kɛ yaa wo ɔ se ɔ, a hɛ je nɔ kaa a maa hɛɛ niye ní kɛ to dɛ.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya!
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a masa a he!” Se a tu he munyu ngɛ a kpɛti ke, “E de jã, ejakaa wa hɛɛ we niye ní kɛ bɛ!” Yesu le nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ ní sɛɛe ngɛ niye ní nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ we he ɔ?
Nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi pɛ!
Anɛ nyɛ nɛ níhi a nya kɛ mwɔɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ kai we kaa i ku abolo enuɔ mi kɛ ha nyumuhi akpe enuɔ hyɛ?
Kusii enyɛmɛ a mi nyɛ kukuɔ bibliwi ɔ kɛ wo?
Abolo kpaago ɔ nɛ a kɛ lɛ nyumuhi akpe eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛɛ, nyɛ kaii we?
Kusii enyɛmɛ a mi nyɛ kukuɔ bibliwi ɔ kɛ wo?
Mɛni he je nyɛ nui sisi kaa pi abolo he munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue ɔ?
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a masa a he!” Jehanɛ lɛɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba kɔ se kaa pi masa nɛ a kɛ woɔ abolo mi ɔ he nɛ e de mɛ ke a hɛ nɛ hi a he nɔ ɔ, se mohu, Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ he.
Petro ye Yesu he odase Benɛ Yesu ba Kaisarea Filipi kpokpa a nɔ ɔ, e bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ nihi deɔ ke Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ji?” A he nɔ ke, “Ni komɛ ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ; ni komɛ ke Eliya, nɛ ni kpa komɛ deɔ ke Yeremia, aloo gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.” E bi mɛ ke, “Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ deɔ kɛɛ?
Mɛnɔ ji mi?” Simon Petro he nɔ ke, “Mo ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ Bi ɔ.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Simon, Yona bi, a gbaa mo!
Ejakaa pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ je enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mo; se Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Petro, i ngɛ mo dee ke tɛ sa ji mo, nɛ kikɛmɛ a tɛ sa nɛ ɔ nɔ ma ma ye asafo ɔ ngɛ.
Nɛ gbenɔ tete po be nyɛe maa ye e nɔ.
Ma ngɔ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nya safe ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mo.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa tsi nya ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa tsi nya ngɛ hiɔwe; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa ngmɛ blɔ ke a pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa ngmɛ blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ka e kaseli ɔmɛ kita ke a ko de nɔ ko nɔ ko ke lɛ ji Kristo ɔ. Yesu tu e we amanehlu, kɛ e gbenɔ he munyu Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu bɔni e kaseli ɔmɛ demi paa ke ja e ya Yerusalem, nɛ e ya na amanehlu babauu ngɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
A maa gbe lɛ, se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Mawu ma tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
Petro tsɛ lɛ kɛ ya se, nɛ e bɔni e hɛ mi kami ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, enɛ ɔ ya je ngɛ se lokoo!
Mawu ko ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba o nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!” Se Yesu plɛ e he nɛ e de Petro ke, “Jee ye nɔ kɛ ya se, Satan!
O ngɛ ye nane kpatae.
Ejakaa juɛmi nɛ ngɛ o yi mi ɔ, pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je, se nɔmlɔ adesa.” Jehanɛ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e kua e he, nɛ e wo e sɛumi tso ɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛ ye se.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e wami ngɔ fɔɔ he ngɛ ye he ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ ekohu.
Mɛni se nɔ ko ma na ke e nine su je ɔ tsuo nɔ, se e laa e klaa?
Dɛbi!
Nɔ́ ko be nɛ e ma ngɔ ha nɛ e kɛ kpɔ e klaa a. Ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba ngɛ e tsɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ e ní tsumi nya.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke ni komɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a be gboe kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ ma kaa matsɛ.”
Yesu nɔmlɔ tso su tsake Ligbi ekpa se ɔ, Yesu ngɔ Petro, kɛ Yakobo kɛ e nyɛmi Yohane, nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya yo gagaa ko nɔ ngɛ he ko banee.
Benɛ a ngɛ lɛ hyɛe ɔ, e nɔmlɔ tso su tsake; e hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa pu, nɛ e tade ɔmɛ hiɛ futaa.
Tlukaa a, kaseli ɔmɛ na Mose, kɛ Eliya ba je a he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ a kɛ Yesu bɔni munyu tumi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e hi kaa wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!
Ke o suɔ ɔ, ma pee bo tsu etɛ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, o nɔ kake, Mose nɔ́ kake, kɛ Eliya hu nɔ́ kake.” Benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, bɔku hleii ko ba ha a nɔ, nɛ gbi je bɔku ɔ mi de ke, “Ye Bi nɛ i suɔ lɛ, nɛ i naa e he tsui ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue.” Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nu gbi ɔ, a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ba a ngɔ, nɛ e ba ta a he, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ te si; nyɛ ko ye gbeye!” Se benɛ a bli a hɛngmɛ ɔ, a nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa ja Yesu nɔ kake pɛ.
Benɛ a ngɛ yo ɔ kplee ɔ. Yesu ka mɛ kita ke, “Nyɛ ko sɛɛ nina nɛ ɔ he ní ha nɔ ko kɛ yaa si a ma tle Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ si kɛ je gbeje.” Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ deɔ ke ja Eliya ba lolo ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Niinɛ, Eliya ma, nɛ e ma ba to níhi tsuo blɔ nɔ ekohu.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Eliya ba momo, se nihi li lɛ, nɛ a pee lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ.
Ja nɔuu Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu maa na amanehlu ngɛ a dɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ kɔ se kaa Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ he munyu e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Yesu tsa jokuɛ nyumuyo ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi Benɛ a kpale kɛ ba nimli kpekpemi ɔ a ngɔ ɔ, nyumu ko ba Yesu ngɔ ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, naa ye binyumu ɔ mɔbɔ!
Kɔkɔtsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ hiɔ ɔ deɔ nɔ́ ha lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Bɔɔ kɛkɛ e ya nɔ la mi; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e ya nɔ nyu mi.
I ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba o kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se a nyɛ we nɛ a tsa lɛ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ yi nɔ yayami bi nɛ nyɛ be hemi kɛ yemi!
Mɛni be i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si?
Mɛni be ma to ye tsui si ha nyɛ kɛ yaa si?
Nyɛɛ ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” Yesu nga mumi yayami ɔ yi nɛ e je e mi, nɛ a tsa lɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nigii, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nyɛ we nɛ waa hia mumi yayami ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ejakaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ kle kaa sinapi wu ɔ, nyɛ ma de yo nɛ ɔ ke, ‘Hiaa kɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ,’ nɛ e maa hia.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko peemi be wae ha nyɛ!” [ Se mumi nɛ ɔ, ja sɔlemi, kɛ ngma himi pɛ a kɛ ma nyɛ hia.]
Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu ekohu Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ tsuo a nya ba bua ngɛ Galilea a, Yesu de mɛ ke, “A miɔ nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo nimli adesahi a dɛ mi nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Mawu ma tle lɛ si.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao kaseli ɔmɛ wawɛɛ.
Sɔlemi we ɔ he tó tsumi Benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba Kapernaum ɔ, sɔlemi tsu ɔ he tó tsuli ɔmɛ ba Petro ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ tsɔɔlɔ ɔ woɔ tó ɔ lo?” Petro he nɔ ke, “Ee, e woɔ.” Benɛ Petro ba we ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu sɛ hlami bi lɛ ke, “Simon, kɛ o susuɔ kɛɛ?
Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ a dɛ a heɔ tó ngɛ?
Ma mi bi a dɛ, aloo ma se bi a dɛ?” Petro de lɛ ke, “Ma se bi a dɛ nɛ a heɔ ngɛ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Saminya!
Lɛɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ yeɔ a he mɔ!
Se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa ko tsɔ̃ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nya a, yaa wo ɔ nya nɛ o ya fɔ gbowe.
Kekleekle lo nɛ ma ba mi gbowe ɔ, sá lɛ.
Hyɛ lo ɔ nya mi, nɛ o maa na sika nɛ maa su i kɛ mo tsuo wa sɔlemi we ɔ he tó ɔ nya.
Ngɔɔ nɛ o kɛ wo wa tó ɔ.”
Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa?
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu tsɛ jokuɛ nyafii ko, nɛ e ha e ba da a kpɛti, nɛ e de ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ tsakee we nɛ nyɛɛ pee kaa jokuɛ tsɔwi ɔ, nyɛ be hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi sɛe.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa e he si kaa jokuɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ jokuɛyo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, imi e he ɔ nɛ.
Kami nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami “Hemi kɛ yemi nɛ jokuɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, ke nɔ ko ha nɛ a ti nɔ kake hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ta a, afani nɛ a kɛ teji wɛ muɔ nɔ ɔ kuɛ, nɛ a sake lɛ kɛ fɔ wo mi he nɛ kuɔ.
Musu tloo je ɔ kaa níhi ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami!
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba kɛ̃, se nɔmlɔ nɛ haa nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ baa a, musu tloo lɛ!
“Ke o nine, loo o nane haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, poo nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he!
Afani nɛ o kɛ nine popoe, loo nane popoe sɛ wami mi pe nɛ o ngɛ nine enyɔ, loo nane enyɔ, nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ neneene la a mi.
Jã kɛ̃, ke o hɛngmɛ haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, hiaa nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he!
Afani nɛ o kɛ hɛngmɛ kake sɛ wami mi pe nɛ o ngɛ hɛngmɛ enyɔ, nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ Abosiami a je la a mi.
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ to nɛ laa a he “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko hie bimɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a bɔfohi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ daa si ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi daa.
[ Se Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba nɛ e ba he nihi nɛ laa a a yi wami.]
“Kɛ nyɛ susuu kɛɛ?
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ to lafa, nɛ a kpɛti kake laa a, anɛ e be nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔmɛ sie ngɛ yo ɔmɛ nɔ, nɛ e ya hla nɔ́ nɛ laa a?
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke e na lɛ ɔ, e naa lɔ ɔ he bua jɔmi kulaa pe to nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a laa we ɔ. Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ sume kaa bimɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ laa.
Nyɛmi nɛ peeɔ yayami “Ke o nyɛmi pee mo yayami ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya tsɔɔ lɛ e tɔmi ɔ, o kɛ lɛ ni enyɔ kɛkɛ.
Ke e bu mo tue ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛmi pee nyɛmi.
Se ke e bui mo tue ɔ, ngɔɔ nɔ kake, loo ni enyɔ ngɔ piɛ o he.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ni enyɔ, loo etɛ ɔmɛ maa pee odase yeli kɛ ma munyu ɔ nɔ mi.
Se ke e bui mɛ hu tue ɔ, yaa sɛɛ ha asafo ɔ. Ke e bɛɛe bui asafo ɔ hu tue ɔ, buu lɛ kaa wɔ jalɔ, loo tó tsulɔ.
Nya tsimi kɛ blɔ ngmɛmi “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa tsi nya ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa tsi nya ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ngmɛ blɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa ngmɛ blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.
“Jehanɛ ɔ hu, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ kpɛti ni enyɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ maa pee nyɛ nya kake kɛ kpa nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ ɔ, Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ maa pee ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa he nɛ ni enyɔ, loo ni etɛ bua a he nya ngɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ a kpɛti ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ́ ki ɔ he Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, si enyɛmɛ ke ye nyɛmi tɔ ye nɔ nɛ ma kɛ pa lɛ?
Si kpaago lo?” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, i de we mo ke si kpaago, se mohu si kpaago totoe nyingmi kpaago.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Be ko ɔ, matsɛ ko hi si, nɛ e to kaa e maa hyɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a we akɔtaa mi.
Benɛ e bɔni akɔtaa a mi hyɛmi ɔ, a kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ hɛɛ lɛ hiɔ sika fuu nitsɛ ba.
Se akɛnɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e wo hiɔ ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ fa ke a jua lɛ, kɛ e yo, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ wo hiɔ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, na tsui ha mi nɛ ma wo mo hiɔ ɔ tsuo!’ Matsɛ ɔ mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ hiɔ ɔ tsuo ke lɛ, nɛ e ngmɛɛ e he.
“Se benɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ je kpo ɔ, e na e nyɛmimɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ hɛɛ lɛ hiɔ sika bɔɔ pɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e nu lɛ, nɛ e bɔni e kuɔ si miami ke, ‘Wó mi hiɔ nɛ o hɛɛ mi ɔ!’ E nyɛmi tsɔlɔ ɔ kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ, na tsui ha mi nɛ ma wo mo hiɔ ɔ tsuo!’ Se lɛɛ e kplɛɛ we; mohu ɔ, e ya wo lɛ tsu kɛ yaa si e maa wo lɛ hiɔ ɔ. Benɛ tsɔli kpa amɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, a hao wawɛɛ, nɛ a ho matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya bɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba.
Matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ a ya tsɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Mo tsɔlɔ yiwutsotsɛ!
Akɛnɛ o kpa mi pɛɛ he je ɔ, i ngɔ hiɔ nɛ ɔ tsuo ngɔ ke mo.
Anɛ mo hu e sɛ kaa o naa o nyɛmi tsɔlɔ mɔbɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i na mo mɔbɔ ɔ lo?’ Matsɛ ɔ mi mi fu, nɛ e wo tsɔlɔ ɔ tsu, nɛ́ a gbla e tue hluu kɛ yaa si e maa wo hiɔ ɔ tsuo.” Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɔɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ a tɔmi ngɔ pɛ mɛ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ maa pee nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Yesu tu gba mi pomi he munyu Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ gbe nya a, e je Galilea kɛ ba Yudea kpokpa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se.
Nihi fuu nyɛɛ e se, nɛ e tsa mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Farisi bi komɛ ba e ngɔ ba ka lɛ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ wa mlaa a ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa nyumu fieɔ e yo ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ko he lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ kane we ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke sisije ɔ, bɔlɔ ɔ bɔ adesa nyumu kɛ yo lo?
Nɛ Mawu de ke, ‘Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ma plɛ pee nɔ kake.’ Lɛɛ a pi nimli enyɔ hu, se mohu he lo kake.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɔ tsa a, nɔmlɔ kó gba mi.” Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je Mose wo mlaa ke nyumu nɛ ha yo fiemi womi nɛ e ngmɛɛ e he mɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mose ha nyɛ he blɔ ke nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ nyɛ yihi a he, ejakaa nyɛ tue wa; pi ja ji sane ɔ kɛ je sisije.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ngmɛɛ e yo he, nɛ pi kaa yo ɔ ya bɔ ajuama, nɛ e ma ya ngɔ yo kpa a, e puɛ gba.” E kaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji nyumu kɛ e yo sane ɔ, e he hia we kaa nyumu nɛ ngɔ yo mɔ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha a, mɛ pɛ a he e kɔɔ; pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Ejakaa ní komɛ a he je nɛ nyumuhi ngɔɛ yo; ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ ja lɛ a fɔ mɛ; ni komɛ lɛɛ adesa lɛ pee mɛ ja; ni komɛ hu ngɔɛ yo ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ he.
Tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ maa pɛtɛ he ɔ, e pee ja.” Yesu gbaa jokuɛwi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ni komɛ ngɔ jokuɛ tsɔwi kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ e sɔle ha mɛ.
Se e kaseli ɔmɛ kuɛ wo ni ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ye ngɔ; nyɛ ko tsi mɛ blɔ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue jokuɛwi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ. Niheyo niatsɛ ɔ Ligbi ko ɔ, nyumu ko ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni nɔ́ kpakpa po ma pee nɛ ma na neneene wami?” Yesu hu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ mi nɔ́ kpakpa he sane bie?
Nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ kpakpa.
Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o sɛ wami mi ɔ, ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.” Niheyo ɔ bi ke, “Mɛni mlaahi?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Koo gbe nɔmlɔ; ko puɛ gba; koo ju; koo ye lakpa odase; bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ; suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.” Niheyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ; mɛni pa piɛ mi mɔ?” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o hi kɛ pi si ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya jua níhi nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ sika a kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ o ma na juetli ngɛ hiɔwe.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, kpale kɛ ba nɛ o ba nyɛɛ ye se.” Benɛ niheyo ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho je lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e ngɛ ní babauu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e maa wa ha niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ekohu ke e wa ha niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi pe kaa afukpɔngɔ maa gu abui hɛngmɛ mi.” Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nu enɛ ɔ, a he mi po, nɛ a bi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ po yi wami a ma nyɛ he mɔ?” Yesu hyɛ mɛ too, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nimli be nyɛe maa pee enɛ ɔ; se Mawu lɛɛ e nyɛɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro tu munyu nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa si nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ wa ba nyɛɛ o se.
Mɛni wa ma na mɔ?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, je he ɔ mi, benɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa hi e nyami sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ maa hi matsɛ sɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa kojo Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma si wehi, loo nyɛminyumuhi, loo nyɛmiyihi, loo e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ, loo bimɛ, loo zugba ngɛ ye he ɔ, a maa to lɛ nane mi totoe lafa, nɛ a ma ha lɛ neneene wami.
Se nihi fuu nɛ sɛ hlami amlɔ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee sekpɛli, nɛ sekpɛli ma ba pee hlami sɛli.
Wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Ligbi ko ɔ, nyumu ko je kpo makɛ mla ya bɔ nihi apaa nɛ a ba tsu ní ngɛ e wai ngmɔ mi.
E kɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ ye nya kaa e ma ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika hiɔ yi kake nɛ ji apaatsɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho e wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ya.
Kɛ ma mɔtu ngmlɛ nɛɛ mi ɔ, e je kpo ekohu kɛ ya jua a nɔ.
E na ni komɛ nɛ daa si gu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsu we nɔ́ ko.
E de mɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tsu ní ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ ma wo nyɛ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa.’ Nɛ a ho.
Jehanɛ ɔ, ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ ngmlɛ etɛ ɔ, e je kpo nɛ e ya pee ja nɔuu.
Kɛ ma gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ enuɔ mi nɛ e ya jua a nɔ ekohu ɔ, e na ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a daa si gu.
E bi mɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je nyɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ligbi ɔ tsuo nɛ nyɛ tsu we nɔ́ ko ɔ?’ A he nɔ ke, ‘Nɔ ko ba bɔɛ wɔ apaa.’ E de mɛ ke, ‘Yoo, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tsu ní ngɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ mi.’ “Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ de e tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ke, ‘Tsɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ o wo mɛ hiɔ.
Jee sisi kɛ je sekpɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ yaa su kekletsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ a bɔ mɛ apaa gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ enuɔ ɔ ba, nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ na sika hiɔ yi kake.
Benɛ kekletsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba a, a susu kaa mɛɛ a ma na pe ja; se mɛ hu a ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika hiɔ yi kake.
Benɛ a nine su sika a nɔ ɔ, a tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si nɔ nɛ bɔ mɛ apaa a.
A ke, ‘Sekpɛtsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ngmlɛfia kake pɛ a tsu ní; wɔɔ lɛɛ wa tsu ní ligbi ɔ tsuo.
Pu tsoo wɔ, nɛ latsa tsa wɔ, se o wo waa kɛ mɛ hiɔ fiee!’ “Ngmɔtsɛ ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de ní tsuli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ke, ‘Ye huɛ, bu tue; i tsa sisi we mo!
Anɛ pi sika hiɔ yi kake nɛ i kɛ mo ye nya ke ma ha mo lo?
Ngɔɔ o hiɔwo ɔ nɛ o ho.
I suɔ kaa ma wo nɔ nɛ i bɔ lɛ apaa sekpɛ nɛ ɔ hu hiɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i ha mo ɔ kɛ̃.
Anɛ i be he blɔ kaa i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye sika peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ lo?
Aloo ye mi mi nɛ jɔ ɔ he o hɛngmɛ tsu ngɛ nɛ ɔ?’ ” Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sekpɛli ma ba pee hlami sɛli, nɛ hlami sɛli ma ba pee sekpɛli.” Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu si etɛne Benɛ Yesu yaa Yerusalem ɔ, e ngɔ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ya se banee ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ kɔklɔɔ tu munyu, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Wa yaa Yerusalem, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
A maa bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ a ye e he fɛu, nɛ a fia lɛ kplibi, nɛ a sɛu lɛ.
Se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, a ma tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.” Yakobo kɛ Yohane a nyɛ bi nɔ́ ko Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ a nyɛ kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ.
E kpla si ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ e hiami nɔ́ ko kɛ fɔ e hɛ mi.
Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Wó mi si kaa ke o ba ye matsɛ ɔ, ye binyumuhi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake maa hi o hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake hu maa hi o muɔ nɔ.” Yesu de bimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ li nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bie ɔ. Amanehlu kplu nɛ i miɔ nɛ ma nu nɛ ɔ, anɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ma nyɛ maa nu lo?” A he nɔ ke, “Ee, wa ma nyɛ!” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ee, nyɛ maa nu.
Se kaa nɔ ko maa hi ye hiɔ nɔ, loo ye muɔ nɔ ɔ, jamɛ a blɔ nya a lɛɛ pi imi nɛ i haa nɔ.
Blɔ he nɛ ɔmɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nihi nɛ Tsaatsɛ nitsɛ dla kɛ to ɔ.” Benɛ kaseli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ nu he ɔ, a mi mi fu nyɛmimɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu tsɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ yeɔ a nɔ ha.
Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ yeɔ a nɔ kɛ he wami.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ e ko ba ja ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa suɔ kaa e pee nɔmlɔ nguaa ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, lɛ mohu e plɛ nyɛ sɔmɔlɔ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa suɔ kaa e ye kekleekle blɔ he ɔ, lɛ mohu e plɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ pee ɔ. E bɛ nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ, se e ba sɔmɔ mohu, konɛ e ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha, nɛ e kɛ he nihi fuu a yi wami.” Yesu tsa hɛ yuyuili enyɔ Benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ je Yeriko kɛ yaa a, nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se.
Nyumuhi hɛ yuyuili enyɔ hii si ngɛ blɔ ɔ tue, nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Yesu bee ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke, “David bi!
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Ni ɔmɛ kuɛ wo mɛ, nɛ a de mɛ ke a ma a nya.
Se hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa pe kekle ɔ ke, “David bi lee!
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ oo, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Yesu da si, nɛ e tsɛ mɛ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha nyɛ?” A de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha wa hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ bli.” Yesu mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ e ta a hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, a hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se.
Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi Benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a maa su Yerusalem ɔ, a gba Betfage, ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ he.
Yesu tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya kɔpe nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ɔ mi.
Ke nyɛ su lejɛ ɔ pɛ nyɛ maa na teji yo nɛ a muɔ lɛ si, kɛ e bi.
Nyɛɛ pɛne mɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ ba ha mi.
Nɛ ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ munyu ko ɔ, nyɛ de lɛ ke, ‘A he hia Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.’ Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa ngmɛɛ a he ha nyɛ nɔuu.” A pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ de ɔ nɛ ba mi ke, “Nyɛ de Zion biyo ɔ ke, Hyɛ, o matsɛ ɔ ma o ngɔ.
E he jɔ, nɛ e hi teji nɔ, ee, e hi teji bi nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya pee bɔ nɛ Yesu fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ.
A ngɔ teji ɔ, kɛ e bi ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a ngɔ a tade ɔmɛ ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ Yesu kuɔ nɛ e hi nɔ.
Nihi babauu ngɔ a tadehi ngɔ ha blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu poo tso kɔnihi ngɔ pue blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ tsuo hwɔ lele ke, “Mo kpɔ wɔ, David Bi!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ!
Mo kpɔ wɔ, mo Hiɔwe No!” Benɛ Yesu sɛ Yerusalem ma a mi ɔ, ma a tsuo hwɔ hoo, nɛ a bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ji nɛ ɔ?” Ma kpekpemi ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji gbalɔ Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ngɛ Galilea a nɛ.” Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya fie nihi nɛ ngɛ ní juae, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ní hee tsuo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. E sake sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lahuɛ juae ɔ a sɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “A ngma ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi ke, Mawu de ke, ‘A ma tsɛ ye we ɔ sɔlemi we.’ Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ pee ojo fiali a laami he!” Hɛ yuyuili, kɛ glɔtsɛmɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e tsa mɛ.
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Yesu pee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ.
A na bɔ nɛ jokuɛwi hu ngɛ lele hwɔe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “A je David Bi ɔ yi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a mi mi fu, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ɔ, o ngɛ nue?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ee, i ngɛ nue!
Anɛ nyɛ kane we ngmami nɛ ɔ hyɛ lo?
Ngmami ɔ ke, ‘O dla bimwɔwi, kɛ nyɔ nya bimɛ kɛ to konɛ a la la ngɔngɔɛ kɛ je o yi.’ ” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu si mɛ, nɛ e je ma a mi kɛ ho Betania ya, nɛ e ya hwɔ lejɛ ɔ. Yesu gbiɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ Mɔtu benɛ Yesu kpale e se kɛ yaa ma a mi ɔ, hwɔ ye lɛ.
E na ngmɔkɔ tso ko ngɛ blɔ ɔ he, nɛ e gba kɛ ya he; se e nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ tso ɔ nɔ pe ba kɛkɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de tso ɔ ke, “O be yiblii ko woe hu gblegbleegble!” Nɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ ngla amlɔ nɔuu.
Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ na a, a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a bi ke, “Kɛ ba lɛ kɛɛ loko ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ gbli amlɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ji nɔ́ ɔ, pi nɔ́ nɛ a pee ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ pee.
Ke nyɛ de yo nɛ ɔ tete po ke, ‘Hiaa, nɛ o ya nɔ wo mi ɔ,’ e maa ba mi ja.
Ke nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa fa kue ngɛ he ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nɔ.” He wami nɛ Yesu ngɛ Yesu kpale kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Benɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he wami o kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee?
Mɛnɔ ha mo kikɛmɛ a he wami nɛ ɔ?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ma bi nyɛ munyu ko, nɛ ke nyɛ nyɛ́ ha mi heto ɔ, kɛkɛ imi hu ma tsɔɔ nyɛ he wami nɛ i kɛ peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
He wami nɛ Yohane kɛ sɔle nihi ɔ, jije jamɛ a he wami ɔ je?
E je Mawu ngɔ, loo adesa ngɔ?” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ nya sami ba a kpɛti, nɛ a de ke, “Ke wa de ke, ‘E je Mawu ngɔ’ ɔ, e ma bi wɔ ke, ‘Mɛni he je nyɛ he we lɛ yi mɔ?’ Ke wa de ke, ‘E je adesa dɛ mi’ ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu wa ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ gbeye yee; ejakaa mɛ tsuo a deɔ ke Yohane ɔ, gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ha Yesu heto ke, “Wa li.” Lɛ hu e de mɛ ke, “Lɛɛ imi hu i be nyɛ tsɔɔe nɔ́ he wami nɛ i kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee.
Binyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ a he abɛ “Jehanɛ ɔ, kɛ nyɛ susuu kɛɛ?
Nyumu ko ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, e ya nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, ‘Ye bi, mwɔnɛ ɔ, yaa tsu ní ngɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ mi.’ E he nɔ ke, ‘I be yae.’ Se pee se ɔ, e tsake e yi mi, nɛ e ho.
Tsɛ ɔ ya jokuɛ ɔ hu ngɔ, nɛ e ya de lɛ ja nɔuu.
E he nɔ ke, ‘Yoo tsaatsɛ, ma ya!’ Se e yɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti mɛnɔ lɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛ ɔ suɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Nɔkɔtɔma a.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, tó tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ajuama amɛ sɛ nyɛ hlami kɛ yaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Ejakaa Yohane ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ba tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ kpakpa nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ he we lɛ yi; se tó tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ajuama amɛ he lɛ ye.
Pee se benɛ nyɛ ná le ɔ hu, nyɛ pia we nyɛ he tete, konɛ nyɛ he lɛ nyɛɛ ye.” Wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ a he abɛ Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu abɛ kpa hu tue.
Zugbatsɛ ko hi si.
E pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ e du tso tsɔwi kɛ po piɛ wo he kɛ kpe; e tsua wai tɛ muɔ ngɛ mi, nɛ e ma buli a mɔ hu ngɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ ha ní tsuli apaa humi; nɛ e doma.
Benɛ wai yiblii nya buami be su ɔ, zugbatsɛ nɛ ɔ tsɔ e tsɔli kɛ ya huli ɔmɛ a ngɔ kaa wai yiblii ɔ nɛ a bua nya a, a ya ngɔ lɛɛ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ kɛ ba.
Se huli ɔmɛ nuu e tsɔli ɔmɛ; a kongo nɔ kake, nɛ a gbe nɔ kake, nɛ a fia nɔ kake tɛ.
Jehanɛ, e tsɔ tsɔli kpahi nɛ hiɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ.
Se huli ɔmɛ pee mɛ ja nɔuu.
Pee se ɔ, e tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu kɛ ya a ngɔ.
E de ke, ‘Ye binyumu ɔ lɛɛ a maa bu lɛ.’ Se benɛ huli ɔmɛ na e bi ɔ mohu ɔ, a de a he ke, ‘Ɛhɛɛ, ní yelɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Nyɛɛ ba; nyɛ ha waa gbe lɛ nɛ wa nine nɛ su e weto ní ɔ nɔ!’ Kɛkɛ nɛ a nu lɛ, nɛ a tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je wai ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ ba a, kɛ e maa pee huli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “E ma kpata jamɛ a nimli yayami ɔmɛ a hɛ mi butuu, nɛ e maa ngɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ ngɔ ha apaa yeli kpahi, nihi nɛ maa ngɔ wai yiblii ba ha lɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ kane we enɛ ɔ ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi hyɛ?” Ngmami ɔ ke, “Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ sake fɔ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ tutuutu ba plɛ kɔ nya tɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ pee enɛ ɔ; hyɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ ha!” Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, a ma kpɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, nɛ a kɛ ma ha ma je li a ma ko nɛ maa wo yiblii bɔ nɛ sa.” [ Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nɔ tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e mi ma tsɔtslɔɔ; se nɔ nɛ tɛ ɔ maa nɔ e nɔ ɔ, e maa gblɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.]
Benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu abɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Yesu bu ɔ, a kɔ se kaa a he munyu e ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Nɛ a ka kaa a maa nu lɛ, se a ya ye ma kpekpemi ɔ gbeye, ejakaa ma a buu lɛ gbalɔ.
Matsɛ bi ɔ yo kpeemi he abɛ Yesu kɛ ni ɔmɛ tu munyu ekohu ngɛ abɛhi a mi ke, “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
Be ko ɔ, matsɛ ko ngmɛ okplɔɔ ha e binyumu nɛ kpee yo.
E tsɔ nihi ke a ya tsɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kpee ɔ kɛ ba okplɔɔ ɔ he, se a sume kaa a maa ba.
E kpale tsɔ ni kpahi ke a ya de nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ ke, ‘I gbe niye ní ɔ nya.
A gbe na, kɛ lohwe kpakpahi nɛ wo zɔ; a gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya.
Nyɛɛ ba yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ he koo!’ Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a bui tete, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e blɔ; nɔ kake ho ngmɔ mi ya, nɛ nɔ kake hu ho konɛ e ya ye jua.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nuu tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní, nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɔ si nɔ.
Matsɛ ɔ mi mi fu, nɛ e tsɔ ta buli kɛ ho, nɛ a ya kpata jamɛ a awi yeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a sã ma a.
“Jehanɛ, e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, ‘A to yo kpeemi ɔ he ní gbe nya mohu, se nihi nɛ a fɔ̃ nine ɔ, a sɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ya magbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na a, nyɛɛ kpee mɛ kɛ ba yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ he.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ je kpo kɛ ya blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ a na ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a bua mɛ tsuo a nya, nimli yayamihi, kɛ nimli kpakpahi.
Nɛ yo kpeemi he ɔ hyi tɔ kɛ nihi.
“Se benɛ matsɛ ɔ ba nɛ e ba hyɛ nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ, e na nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ lɛɛ e wui yo kpeemi tade.
Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, ‘Ye huɛ, kɛ o pee kɛɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o wui yo kpeemi tade ɔ?’ Se nyumu ɔ pɛ̃ e nya mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ fi e nine, kɛ e nane ngɔ bla, nɛ nyɛ ya sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ tsu ɔ se ngɛ diblii ɔ mi tsitsaa.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa wo ya, nɛ e ma kpe e lungu nya ngɛ.’ ” Yesu gbe e munyu ɔ nya ke, “A tsɛ nihi fuu, se bɔɔ pɛ a hla.” Tó tsumi Jehanɛ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya so, bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a ma na Yesu he blɔ kɛ gu lɛ nitsɛ e munyu tumi nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɔ a kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ, kɛ Herode we bi komɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ.
A ba de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa anɔkualetsɛ ji mo.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa adesa nɛ hi si ɔ, o tsɔɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ o yi nɔ ko nɔ ko gbeye; ejakaa o hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de wɔ; kɛ o susuu kɛɛ?
Anɛ mlaa ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa a tsu tó ha Kaisare ɔ, aloo a ko tsu?” Se Yesu na ga yaya a nɛ a to ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de ke, “Osatotsɛmɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi dae ɔ?
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi sika nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ tó ɔ.” A ngɔ sika a kɛ ba; nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ofoni ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛnɔ biɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Kaisare ɔ.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Kaisare ɔ níhi ngɔ ha Kaisare ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu níhi ngɔ ha Mawu.” Benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a si lɛ.
Ni gbogboehi a si temi Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Saduki bi, nɛ mɛɛ a deɔ ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose de ke, ke nyumu ko gbo, nɛ e be bimɛ ɔ, e nyɛmi nɛ ngɔ e yalɔyo ɔ, konɛ e wo ngmɛdu ha e nyɛmi nɛ be je mi ɔ. Aa, nyɛmimɛ kpaago hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ yo, nɛ e gbo; nɛ akɛnɛ e si we bimɛ ngɛ e se he je ɔ, e si e yalɔyo ɔ ngɔ ha e senɔ ɔ. E tsa nɔ ja nɔuu kɛ gu nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ a nɔ, kɛ ya su nɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ.
Nyagbe ɔ, yo ɔ hu ba gbo.
Lɛɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ ni gbogboehi maa te si ɔ, nyɛmimɛ kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti mɛnɔ yo e maa pee, nɛ́ mɛ tsuo a kɛ lɛ hi si ɔ?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tɔ!
Ejakaa nyɛ li ngmami ɔmɛ, aloo Mawu he wami.
Benɛ ni gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, a maa hi kaa hiɔwe bɔfohi; a be yo ngɔe, nɛ nɔ ko hu be gbae.
Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ ni gbogboehi a si temi he ɔ, anɛ nyɛ kane we nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de nyɛ ɔ hyɛ?
Mawu ke, ‘Imi ji Abraham Mawu, kɛ Isak Mawu, kɛ Yakob Mawu.’ Mawu ɔ, hɛ kali a Mawu ji lɛ, pi ni gbogboehi a Mawu.” Benɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ nu enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e plɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ní ɔ pee mɛ nyakpɛ.
Mlaa nguaa a Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu kaa Yesu jɔɔ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a ba bua a he nya ngɛ he kake.
A ti nɔ kake nɛ ji mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ bi lɛ munyu nɛ e kɛ ka lɛ.
E bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mlaa a te nɔ́ nɛ pe kulaa nɛɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “ ‘Suɔ Nyɔmtsɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ o tsui tsuo, kɛ o klaa tsuo, kɛ o juɛmi tsuo.’ Enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle mlaa, kɛ mlaa nɛ kle pe kulaa.
Mlaa nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ hu ngɛ kaa jã kɛ̃: ‘Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.’ Mose mlaa a, kɛ tsɔɔmihi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ tsuo daa si ngɛ mlaa enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Kpɔlɔ ɔ he sane Benɛ Farisi bi komɛ ba bua a he nya a, Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ nyɛ susuɔ ngɛ Kristo ɔ he kɛɛ?
Mɛnɔ nina ji lɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “David nina ji lɛ.” Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ mumi ɔ ba David nɔ, nɛ e tsɛ lɛ ‘Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ?
David ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Hii ye hiɔ nɔ kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ wo o nane sisi.” ’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke David tsɛ lɛ ‘Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ Kristo ɔ pa peeɔ e nina mɔ?” Nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ha Yesu heto kpakpa ko.
Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɔ ko kɛ́ kaa e ma bi lɛ munyu ko hu.
Yesu ka mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ tu munyu.
E de mɛ ke, “Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a ngɔ he wami ngɔ wo a dɛ, konɛ a tsɔɔ Mose mlaa a sisi saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ tue nɛ nyɛɛ pee.
Se a ní peemi níhi lɛɛ nyɛ ko pee; ejakaa slo nɔ́ nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ he.
A boɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ, nɛ e tloomi wa kɛ pueɔ nihi a konɔ; se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a nine nguɛ kake tete po sɛ tlomi ɔ he.
Ke a ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ a hɛ ngɛ si poe nɛ a ngɛ hyɛe kaa nihi maa na mɛ lo.
Lohwe he womihi nɛ a ngma Mawu munyu ngɛ a nɔ nɛ a fiɔ ngɛ a hɛ nya, kɛ a nine he ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ a bli gbabagbabaa ha!
Dekehi hu nɛ ngɛ a tade klɔii ɔmɛ a nya a, hyɛ bɔ nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ hu ka gagaaga ha!
A suɔ okplɔɔ yi himi ngɛ ní yemi he, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi hehi ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ; a suɔ nɛ a kɛ bumi nɛ nga mɛ ngɛ jua nɔ, nɛ a tsɛ mɛ ke, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ!’ Nyɛɛ lɛɛ, a ko tsɛ nyɛ ‘Tsɔɔlɔ’, ejakaa nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛmimɛ ji nyɛ, nɛ tsɔɔlɔ kake pɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Nyɛ ko tsɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ zugba a nɔ ‘Tsɛ’, ejakaa Tsɛ kake pɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.
Jehanɛ, a ko tsɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ‘Tsɔɔlɔ’ hulɔ; ejakaa tsɔɔlɔ kake pɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ lɛ ji Kristo.
Nɔ nɛ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e plɛ nyɛ sɔmɔlɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a ma wo e nɔ.
Yesu gbe a we osato peemi ɔ he guɛ “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ!
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ ngaa hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nya ngɔ woɔ nihi, se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ sɛ́ mi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hlaa kaa a maa sɛ mi ɔ hu nyɛ ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ!
[ Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ!
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ kpɔɔ yalɔyihi a wehi ngɛ a dɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ya peeɔ sɔlemi gagaaga!
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tue gblami ɔ maa pee gbeye.]
“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ!
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ kuɔɔ wo, nɛ nyɛ kpaa zugbahi a nɔ kaa nyɛ maa na nɔ kake pɛ nɛ tsake pee Yuda no lo.
Ke nyɛ na nɔ ko kaa ja a, nyɛ peeɔ lɛ nɔ nɛ sa Abosiami a je la a mi yami si enyɔ nɛ bla mohu pe nyɛ nitsɛmɛ po!
“Nyɛ blɔ tsɔɔli hɛ yuyuili, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Ke nɔ ko kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ka kita a, lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa.
Se ke e kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ sika tsu ka kita nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ musu tloo lɛ.’ Hɛ yuyuili kuasiahi!
Te nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa nɛɛ?
Sika tsu ɔ, aloo sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ haa sika tsu ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ?
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Ke nɔ ko kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ka kita a, lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa.
Se ke e kɛ nike ní nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ka kita nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ musu tloo lɛ.’ Hɛ yuyuili!
Te nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa nɛɛ?
Nike ní ɔ, aloo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ haa nike ní ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ka kita a, blɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ nɔ ɔ e kɛ ka kita a nɛ.
Jã kɛ̃, ke nɔ ko kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ka kita a, blɔɔ sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ Mawu nɛ hii lejɛ ɔ e kɛ ka kita a nɛ.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ hiɔwe ka kita a, blɔɔ Mawu sɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ e kɛ ka kita a nɛ.
“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli kɛ Farisi bi!
Musu tloo nyɛ!
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ haa Mawu kowɛ, kɛ anisi, kɛ kumino mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka, se níhi nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa a he hia, níhi kaa dami sane yemi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ anɔkuale yemi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ siɔ.
Jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko si ekpa amɛ hulɔ.
Blɔ tsɔɔli hɛ yuyuili!
Ke anunu nɔ dã mi ɔ, nyɛ tsleɔ pueɔ he, se nyɛ mii afukpɔngɔ!
“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi!
Musu tloo nyɛ!
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ fɔɔ kplu kɛ kã he, se ojo, kɛ adufude níhi hyi mɛ tɔ.
Farisi bi hɛ yuyuili!
Nyɛ fɔ kplu ɔ, kɛ kã a a mi kekle, kɛkɛ ɔ a he hu ma tsɔ!
“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi!
Musu tloo nyɛ!
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ ngɛ kaa yɔkɔhi nɛ a sa a he nɛ a he pee fɛu, se a mi hyi tɔ kɛ ni gbogboehi a wuhi, kɛ ní sasɛhi.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ pɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ; nihi naa nyɛ kaa nimli kpakpahi, se osato, kɛ yayami hyi nyɛ mi mi tɔ.
Yesu de ke a maa gbla Farisi bi ɔmɛ a tue “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi!
Musu tloo nyɛ!
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ fiaa yɔkɔhi kɛ haa gbali ɔmɛ.
Nyɛ dlaa dali ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a he saminyawiiwi, nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ je mi jinɛ wa ko piɛ we a he kɛ pue gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ si.’ Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ odase yee kaa nihi nɛ gbe gbali ɔmɛ a nina ji nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ!
Ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je sisi ɔ, nyɛ tsu kɛ gbe nya!
Sinɔhi kɛ sinɔhi a nina!
Nyɛ tue nɛ a maa gbla ngɛ Abosiami a je la a mi ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ tu fo ngɛ nya kɛɛ?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma tsɔ gbali, kɛ ní leli, kɛ tsɔɔli kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Nyɛ maa gbe a ti ni komɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa sɛu ni komɛ; ni komɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa fia mɛ kpa ngɛ nyɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ nyɛ maa fie mɛ kɛ je ma kake mi kɛ ya ma kake mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nimli kpakpahi tsuo nɛ a pue a muɔ si ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, kɛ maa je Habel nɛ a pue e muɔ si yaka gu ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa su Barakia binyumu Zakaria nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti ɔ nɔ ɔ a he ɔ, a maa gbla nyɛ tue.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, tue gblami nɛ ɔ maa ba yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ!
Suɔmi nɛ Yesu ngɛ kɛ ha Yerusalem “Yerusalem!
Yerusalem!
Mo nɛ o gbee gbali ɔmɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ Mawu tsɔ mɛ o ngɔ ɔ, o fiaa mɛ tɛ!
Hyɛ kaa jinɛ i hla si abɔ kaa ma bua o bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nya kaa bɔ nɛ kungwɔ buaa e bimɛ a nya kɛ woɔ e pɛli sisi ɔ.
Se o kplɛɛ we!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa je o sɔlemi we ɔ he, nɛ e maa fɔ si gu.
I ngɛ mo dee ke, kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, o be mi nae hu kɛ yaa si be nɛ o ma de ke, ‘A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ.’ ”
Yesu de ke be ma nɛ a maa ku sɔlemi we ɔ pue si Benɛ Yesu je sɔlemi we ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ a nine tsɔɔ lɛ tsuhi nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he.
Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyɛe?
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, a maa ku tsu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pue si nɛ a be tɛ kake po sie ngɛ eko nɔ.” Haomi kɛ yi mi wami Benɛ Yesu hii si ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ yi mi ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ laami mi ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni be ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi?
Mɛni okadi maa tsɔɔ o bami be, kɛ je nɛ ɔ nyagbe be?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ ko kó ba mlɔɔ nyɛ.
Ejakaa nihi fuu maa ba, nɛ a ma ba tu munyu ngɛ ye biɛ mi ke, ‘Imi ji Kristo ɔ nɛ!’ nɛ a maa mlɔɔ nihi babauu.
Nyɛ maa nu tahi a he, kɛ akeake hu nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ tahi a he.
Se nyɛ tsui ko po.
Ja ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi; se kɛ̃, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa nyagbe ɔ su ta.
Ma maa te si ngɔ wo ma, nɛ matsɛ yemi maa te si ngɔ wo matsɛ yemi.
Hwɔ nɛ nya wa maa ba, nɛ zugba ma mimiɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa kɔɔmi sisije kɛkɛ.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a maa nuu nyɛ; nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ ha nɛ a wa nyɛ yi mi nɛ a gbe nyɛ.
Nɛ ye he ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi babauu a nane ma kpata; huɛmɛ maa tsɔɔ huɛmɛ a se blɔ, nɛ a maa nyɛ a he.
Lakpa gbali babauu maa te si, nɛ a maa mlɔɔ nihi fuu.
Yayami maa pɔ he ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nihi fuu a nine mi maa je wu.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa da haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nya kɛ yaa su nyagbe ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma he a yi wami.
Nɛ sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ he ɔ, a maa fiɛ kɛ kpa je ɔ mi tsuo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a nu; nɛ lɔ ɔ se loko nyagbe ɔ maa ba.
Ní hiemi nɔ́ nguaa a “Nyɛ maa na ‘Ni hiemi nɔ́ ngua a’ nɛ gbalɔ Daniel tu he munyu ɔ nɛ maa si ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ.
(Ni kanelɔ ɔ nɛ kɔ se!)
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a, a tu fo kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu yi mi ɔ, e ko kple si ya ngɔ e níhi ngɛ we ɔ mi.
Nyumu nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ si ɔ, e ko kpale ya ngɔ e tade.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, yihi nɛ maa hɛɛ hɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi bi nyɔ hae ɔ, due ha mɛ!
Nyɛɛ fa kue ha Mawu nɛ e ko ba mi kaa nyɛ maa tu fo fĩɛ be mi, aloo ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɔ!
Ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, haomi nguaa maa ba nɛ a nɛ eko hyɛ kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ je ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se hu, nɔ́ ko kaa ja be bae gblegbleegble.
Se Mawu po ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ kpiti momo; kaa e pee we jã jinɛ adesa ko adesa ko yi be wami nae.
Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e hla a a he je ɔ, a maa po jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ kpiti.
“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ke nɔ ko de nyɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, Kristo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ’, aloo, ‘E ngɛ lejɛ’ ɔ, nyɛ ko he ye.
Ejakaa lakpa kristohi, kɛ lakpa gbali maa te si.
A maa pee okadi nguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi kɛ mlɔɔ nihi nɛ Mawu hla a tete.
Hyɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee loko be ɔ nɛ su.
“Aloo ke nihi ma de nyɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, e ngɛ nga a nɔ’ ɔ, nyɛ ko ya lejɛ ɔ; ke a de nyɛ ke, ‘E ngɛ se tsu ɔ mi’ ɔ, nyɛ ko he ye.
Ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ oslabai gbaa kɛ jeɔ beleku kɛ yaa bonyoku ɔ.
“He tsuaa he nɛ gbogboe fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ okpokuhi ma bua a he nya ngɛ.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ bami “Haomi nɛ maa ba jamɛ a be ɔ, ke e se po pɛ pu maa tsɔ diblii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ be kpɛe hu.
Dodoehi ma tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ba fia si, nɛ a maa fie he wamihi nɛ bɔle je ɔ kɛ je a blɔ hehi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ we okadi ɔ maa je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe.
Zugba a nɔ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ ma ngɛ hiɔwe bɔku ɔmɛ a mi kɛ he wami, kɛ hɛ mi nyami babauu.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a maa wo yana.
Titimati nguaa a maa pɛ, nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa tsɔ e bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ya je ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ.
A ma ya bua nihi nɛ e hla a a nya kɛ maa je he kake kɛ maa ya he kake.
Ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he ní kasemi “Nyɛɛ hyɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kase ní.
Ke ngmɔkɔ tso kɔnihi plɔke, nɛ a bɔni ba tsɛ̃mi pɛ nyɛ le kaa latsa be ɔ su ta.
Jã nɔuu, ke nyɛ hu nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, nyɛɛ le kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ su si ta; e ngɛ agbo ɔ nya haa kɛ ma.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ nɛ ɔ be bee, ja ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi lolo.
Hiɔwe kɛ zugba maa be kɛ ho, se ye munyu ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be bee kɛ ho gblegbleegble.
Ligbi ɔ, kɛ ngmlɛfia a, nɔ ko li “Se jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a, nɔ ko nɔ ko li.
Hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ li ɔ, Bi ɔ tete li; Tsɛ ɔ nɔ kake too lɛ le.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba tlukaa kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba ngɛ Noa be ɔ mi ɔ.
Be mi nɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ ma ba ha zugba a hɛ mi ɔ, nihi ngɛ ngma yee, nɛ a ngɛ ní nue; nyumuhi ngɛ yihi ngɔe, nɛ yihi hu ngɛ gbae hluu kɛ ya su ligbi ɔ nɛ Noa ya sɛ lɛ ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae kɛ ya si nyu kpekpemi ɔ ba muɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba a, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu níhi maa ya nɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumuhi enyɔ maa hi ní tsue ngɛ ngmɔ si, nɛ a ma ba ngɔ nɔ kake, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake.
Yihi enyɔ maa hi wɛɛe ngɛ wɛ nɔ; a ma ba ngɔ nɔ kake, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ; ejakaa nyɛ li ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma.
Nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa ke wetsɛ ko le nyɔ mi be tutuutu nɛ julɔ maa ba e we mi ɔ, e ko huɔ, nɛ e ko ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ julɔ ɔ ba ju lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ to; ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba tlukaa be mi nɛ nyɛ hɛ be nɔ.
Tsɔlɔ kpakpa a, kɛ tsɔlɔ yaya a “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji tsɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ, kɛ ní lelɔ mɔ?
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to tsɔli kpa amɛ a nya, konɛ e ha mɛ a nya mi ngma ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Tsɔlɔ nɛ ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba we mi, nɛ e ma ba na kaa e ngɛ jã pee ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ pee e weto ní tsuo nɔ hyɛlɔ.
Se ke tsɔlɔ yaya ji lɛ ɔ, e ma de ngɛ e yi mi ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se ya fia si bɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma bɔni nyɛmimɛ tsɔli kpa amɛ kpa fiami, nɛ e kɛ dã tɔli ma ya ye ní, nɛ a maa nu ní.
Jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba ligbi nɛ e hyɛ we lɛ blɔ, kɛ ngmlɛfia nɛ e li.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tsɔtslɔɔ e mi, nɛ tue gblami nɛ sa osatotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e ma na eko.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa wo ya, nɛ e ma kpe e lungu nya ngɛ.
Yihewi nyɔngma amɛ a he abɛ ɔ “Jamɛ a be ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
Be ko ɔ, yihewi nyɔngma komɛ wo a kanehi, nɛ a ho konɛ a ya hyɛ ayɛflo huno blɔ.
A kpɛti ni enuɔ ji kuasiahi, nɛ ni enuɔ lɛɛ ní leli ji mɛ.
Kuasia amɛ ngɔɛ nu kɛ piɛ we kane ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛɛ ɔ a he.
Ní leli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a hɛɛ nu kɛ tɔ ngɔ piɛ a kane ɔmɛ a he.
Se ayɛflo huno ɔ ya bɛ mla, nɛ kɔnɛɛ de yihewi ɔmɛ, nɛ a hwɔ mahe.
“Nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ, huhui pɛ ke, ‘Ayɛflo huno ɔ ma oo!
Nyɛɛ je kpo nɛ nyɛ ba kpee lɛ!’ Yihewi ɔmɛ tsuo te si, nɛ a tsɛ̃ a kane ɔmɛ a mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ kuasia amɛ de ní leli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ ha wɔ nyɛ nu ɔ eko, ejakaa wa kane ɔmɛ ngɛ gboe.’ Se ní leli ɔmɛ de mɛ ke, ‘Eko ɔ, e ba be waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo sue; nyɛɛ ya nu juali ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ya he nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ́.’ Se benɛ a ho hemi ya a, ayɛflo huno ɔ ba, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ dla a he to lɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ho yo kpeemi he ɔ ya.
Nɛ a nga sinya a.
“Pee se ɔ, yihewi kpa amɛ hu ba, nɛ a ba de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ!
Nyɔmtsɛ!
Bli wɔ!’ Se ayɛflo huno ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke i li nyɛ.’ ” Nɔ́ nɛ Yesu de kɛ gbe e munyu ɔ nya ji, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya, ejakaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, loo jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a, nyɛ li.
Tsɔli etɛ ɔmɛ a he abɛ ɔ “Jamɛ a be ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Be ko ɔ, nyumu ko miɔ nɛ e maa doma.
E tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ e tu e weto ní ngɔ wo a dɛ.
E ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika bɔ nɛ nɔ ɔ ma nyɛ maa hyɛ nɔ.
E ha nɔ kake sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ; e ha nɔ kake sika tsu yi akpe enyɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hu na yi akpe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e doma.
Nɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ ɔ ho amlɔ, nɛ e kɛ sika a ya tsu ní; nɛ e na sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ kɛ bɔ he.
Nɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe enyɔ ɔ hu ya na enyɔ kɛ bɔ he ja nɔuu.
Se nɔ nɛ na akpe ɔ ho nɛ e ya tsua si, nɛ e pu e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sika a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
“E ngɛ mi hluu ɔ, tsɔli ɔmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba bu akɔtaa.
Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ ɔ ba, nɛ e kɛ akpe enuɔ kpa hu ba bɔ he.
Nɛ e ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, o ha mi sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ.
O nɛ, i kɛ na akpe enuɔ ngɔ piɛ he.’ E nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Ayekoo, tsɔlɔ kpakpa, kɛ anɔkualetsɛ!
O ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ ko bɔɔ mi; ma ngɔ mo ngɔ to níhi fuu a nya.
Ba nɛ o kɛ mi ba na bua jɔmi!’ “Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe enyɔ ɔ hu ba, nɛ e ba de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, o ha mi sika tsu yi akpe enyɔ.
