O nɛ, i kɛ na akpe enyɔ ngɔ piɛ he.’ E nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Ayekoo, tsɔlɔ kpakpa, kɛ anɔkualetsɛ!
O ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ ko bɔɔ mi; ma ngɔ mo ngɔ to níhi fuu a nya.
Ba nɛ o kɛ mi ba na bua jɔmi!’ “Nɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe ɔ hu ba, nɛ e ba de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, i le mo kaa o yi mi wa; o kpaa ní ngɛ he nɛ o du we ní ngɛ, nɛ o buaa ní nya ngɛ he nɛ o fĩa we ní ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ye gbeye, nɛ i ya tsua si, nɛ i pu o sika a. Ne o ní!’ “Se e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de ke, ‘Tsɔlɔ yaya kɛ alitsɛ!
O le kaa i kpaa ní ngɛ he nɛ i du we ní ngɛ, nɛ i buaa ní nya ngɛ he nɛ i fĩa we ní ngɛ; pi jã?
Jinɛ o ko ngɔ ye sika a ya to ngɛ sika tomi he, konɛ ke i ba a, ma ba he ye ní kɛ hekpa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he e sika a ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu yi akpe nyɔngma a. Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, a kɛ eko maa piɛ he ha lɛ, konɛ e na babauu.
Se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ, a ma he bɔɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tete ngɛ e dɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a tsɔlɔ nɛ he be se nami nɛ ɔ, nyɛ sake lɛ ngɔ wo diblii ɔ mi lokoo.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa wo ya, nɛ e ma kpe e lungu nya ngɛ.’ Kojomi ligbi nguaa a “Ligbi ɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba kaa matsɛ, nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo maa piɛ e he kɛ ba a, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e maa hi e matsɛ sɛ saminyayoo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ma bua je ma amɛ tsuo a nya ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma gba a mi kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ gbaa jijɔ, kɛ apletsi mi ɔ. E maa ngɔ jijɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ da e hiɔ nɔ, nɛ apletsi ɔmɛ maa da e muɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ma de nihi nɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ nihi nɛ Tsaatsɛ gbaa nyɛ, nyɛɛ ba!
Matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ a dla ngɔ to nyɛ kɛ je be nɛ a to je ɔ sisi ɔ, nyɛ ba ngɔ.
Hwɔ ye mi, nɛ nyɛ ha mi ní nɛ i ye; kuma ye mi, nɛ nyɛ ha mi nyu nɛ i nu; nubwɔ ji mi, nɛ nyɛ ha i ba to nyɛ ngɔ.
I hɛɛ ye he gu, nɛ nyɛ wo mi tade.
I nu hiɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba slaa mi; a wo mi tsu mi, nɛ nyɛ ba ye ngɔ.’ “Kɛkɛ ɔ, dali ɔmɛ ma bi lɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni be wa na mo nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mo yee, nɛ wa ha mo ní nɛ o ye, aloo kuma ngɛ mo yee, nɛ wa ha mo nyu nɛ o nu?
Mɛni be wa na kaa nubwɔ ji mo, nɛ wa ha o ba to wɔ, aloo kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, nɛ wa wo mo tade?
Jehanɛ ɔ, mɛni be wa na mo nɛ o be he wami, aloo kaa a wo mo tsu, nɛ wa ba slaa mo?’ Matsɛ ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, be abɔ nɛ nyɛ pee ngɔ ha ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ nyafii pe kulaa a, imi nyɛ pee ngɔ ha a nɛ!’ “Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma de ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ e muɔ nɔ ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ nihi nɛ Mawu gbiɛ nyɛ, nyɛɛ je ye nɔ!
Neneene la nɛ a dla ngɔ to Abosiami, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ya sɛ mi!
Hwɔ ye mi, se nyɛ ha we mi ní ma ye; kuma ye mi, se nyɛ ha we mi nyu ma nu; Nubwɔ ji mi, se nyɛ ha we nɛ ma ba to nyɛ; i hɛɛ ye he gu, se nyɛ wui mi tade; i nu hiɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu a wo mi tsu, se nyɛ ba slaa we mi.’ “Kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a ma bi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni be wa na mo nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mo yee, aloo kuma ngɛ mo yee, aloo kaa nubwɔ ji mo, aloo o hɛɛ o he gu, aloo o be he wami, aloo a wo mo tsu, nɛ wa ba ji ngmlaa ha mo ɔ?’ Matsɛ ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, be abɔ nɛ nyɛ pee we ngɔ ha ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ nyafii pee kulaa a, nyɛ pee we ngɔ ha we imi hulɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa ya neneene he hiami mi; se dali ɔmɛ lɛɛ a maa ya neneene wami mi.”
A so Yesu yi nɔ Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gbe nya a, e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, e piɛ ligbi enyɔ pɛ nɛ a maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ ha nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Kayafa mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya so bɔ nɛ a maa pee kɛ nu Yesu ga mi, nɛ a gbe lɛ.
A de ke, “Wa be nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee nyami be ɔ mi, konɛ basabasa kó ba ma a mi.” A pɔ Yesu nu ngɛ Betania Jehanɛ Yesu ba su Betania, nɛ e ba Simon we ɔ mi.
Simon nɛ ɔ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya hyɛ.
Benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní yee ɔ, yo ko hɛɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ e mi nu kɛ e he via nɛ he jua wa kɛ ba e ngɔ.
Nɛ e plɛ nu ɔ kɛ pue Yesu yi mi.
Benɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ na a, a mi mi fu, nɛ a bi ke, “Kɛ ji yaka ní puɛmi nɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?
Nu kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ, a ko jua we sika fuu, nɛ a ngɔ ha ohiatsɛmɛ lo?” Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ momo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ yo ɔ nya dooe?
E tsu ní tsumi saminyayoo ha mi.
Ejakaa nyɛɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa hi si daa; se imi lɛɛ pi daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
Nu kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ nɛ e plɛ ngɔ pue ye nɔmlɔ tso nɔ ɔ, e kɛ dla mi ngɔ to ye pumi be.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, je nɛ ɔ mi he tsuaa he nɛ a maa fiɛ sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ, a maa sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ yo nɛ ɔ pee nɛ ɔ hu kɛ kai lɛ.” Yuda kplɛɛ kaa e maa tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yuda Iskariot ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ ya, nɛ e ya de mɛ ke, “Ke i je Yesu ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi ɔ, mɛni nyɛ ma ha mi?” A kane sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ ngɔ ha lɛ, nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yuda hla Yesu he blɔ, konɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ wo a dɛ mi.
Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ye Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Jije o suɔ kaa wa ya dla ha mo nɛ o ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ?” E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya asimasi ngɔ ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ nyɛ ya de lɛ ke, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ke, Ye be ɔ su; i kɛ ye kaseli ɔmɛ ma ba ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ o we ɔ mi.’ ” Kaseli ɔmɛ ya pee bɔ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ɔ, nɛ a pee niye ní ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɔ to.
Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ya hi si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he.
Benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha kaseli ɔmɛ hao wawɛɛ, nɛ a bɔni lɛ bimi kakaaka ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, imi lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ ɔ, e kɛ mi ngɛ ní yee ngɛ kaa nɛ ɔ mi.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ e he ɔ, se musu tloo nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ!
Afani nɛ a fɔ we jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ!” Yuda, nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ, bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, imi lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ja o de ɔ nɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ Benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ, Yesu kɛ̃ abolo nɛ e gbaa nɔ, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e ke, “Nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ ye!
Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e wo kplu, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ e ke, “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ nu.
Enɛ ɔ ji ye muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu Mawu somi ɔ nya.
A plɛ ye muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue si ha nihi fuu, konɛ a ngɔ a he yayamihi ngɔ pa mɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, i be wai nɛ ɔ nue hu gblegbleegble kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa nu wai he ɔ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a la yi jemi la, nɛ a je kpo, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Oliv yo ɔ nɔ ya.
Yesu gba ngɔ to kaa Petro ma kua lɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ je ye he.
Ejakaa a ngma ke, ‘Ma fia to hyɛlɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ to kuu ɔ maa gbɛ fĩa.’ Se ke a tle mi si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, ma sɛ nyɛ hlami kɛ maa ya Galilea.” Petro ka Yesu kita, nɛ e de ke, “Ke ni ɔmɛ tsuo si mo ɔ, imi lɛɛ i be mo sie gblegbleegble!” Yesu de Petro ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ke, nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ́ ɔ, o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi.” Petro de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi!
Ke i kɛ mo ma gbo tete po, i be mo kuae kɔkɔɔkɔ!” Kaseli nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a tu munyu ja nɔuu.
Yesu ya sɔle ngɛ Getsemane Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Getsemane, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ ma ya hɛ mi bɔɔ ma ya sɔle.” E ngɔ Petro, kɛ Zebedeo binyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ piɛ e he.
Aywilɛho nu lɛ, nɛ e hao; nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Aywilɛho nɛ nya wa miɔ nɛ e maa gbe mi; nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ fɔ nyɔ.” E ya e hɛ mi bɔɔ, nɛ e ya kpla si, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ e sɔle ke, “Tsaatsɛ, ke e maa hi ɔ, je amanehlu kplu nɛ ɔ kɛ je ye he kɛ ya se!
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a pee bɔ nɛ mo o suɔ; pi nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ.” Benɛ e kpale kɛ ba kaseli etɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, e na kaa a hwɔ mahe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Petro ke, “Lɛɛ nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ fɔ nyɔ ngmlɛfia kake po?
Nyɛɛ fɔ nyɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ nyɛ ko sɛ ka mi.
Mumi ɔ lɛɛ e suɔ kaa e maa pee jã, se he lo ɔ gbede.” Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho si enyɔne, nɛ e ya sɔle ke, “Tsaatsɛ, ke a be amanehlu kplu nɛ ɔ jee kɛ je ye he kɛ ya se, nɛ ja i nu ɔ, lɛɛ a pee bɔ nɛ o suɔ.” E kpale kɛ ba kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ ekohu, nɛ e ba na kaa a hwɔ mahe, ejakaa nyɔ gbe mɛ.
Yesu si mɛ ekohu, nɛ e ho ya sɔle si etɛne, nɛ e tu jamɛ a munyu ɔ nɔuu.
Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ e kpale kɛ ba e kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ba de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mahe hwɔe kɛ mwɔɔ?
Hyɛ!
Ngmlɛfia a su ta, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo yayami peeli a dɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ te nɛ waa ho.
Hyɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ ye se blɔ tsɔɔe ɔ lɛ ma a nɛ!” A nu Yesu Benɛ Yesu ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Yuda, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake ɔ ba hia kpo kɛ nihi babauu ngɛ e se; nɛ a hɛɛ klaatehi kɛ tso kpotihi.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ; kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ tsɔ mɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ e se blɔ tsɔɔe ɔ to mɛ okadi ke, “Nɔ nɛ i ma fĩɔ e nya he ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ nu lɛ!” Yuda ba Yesu ngɔ amlɔ ba de ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ he manye.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e fiɔ Yesu nya he.
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Huɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o ma peemi ɔ, pee esɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ ba yu Yesu nɔ, nɛ a nu lɛ pani nya.
Amlɔ ɔ, nihi nɛ kɛ Yesu ngɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake hia klaate, nɛ e kɛ po osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a tsɔlɔ tue.
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ o klaate ɔ ngɔ to e to he; ejakaa nihi tsuo nɛ hiaa klaate ɔ, a kɛ klaate ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Anɛ o susu kaa i be nyɛe ma kpa Tsaatsɛ pɛɛ, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu e maa tsɔ hiɔwe bɔfohi asafo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ se kɛ ba nɛ a ba je ngmlaa ha mi lo?
Ke e ba jã a, lɛɛ ngmami ɔmɛ nɛ deɔ ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ e sa kaa níhi nɛ ba a, kɛ jamɛ a ngmami ɔmɛ maa pee kɛ ba mi kɛɛ?” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tu munyu nɛ e de ke, “Imi lɛ nyɛ ma numi kɛ klaatehi kɛ tso kpotihi kaa a nuu ojo fialɔ ɔ?
Daa nɛ ɔ, i hii sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ i tsɔɔ ní, se nyɛ nui mi.
Se a pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma a nɛ ba mi.” Amlɔ ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo nɛ a si lɛ.
Yesu ngɛ kpe ngua a hɛ mi Ni nɛmɛ nɛ nu Yesu ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Kayafa, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ngɔ, he nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ ɔ. Petro nyɛɛ a se ngɛ lokoo kɛ ya su kue ɔ he, ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a we ɔ mi.
E sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a kasa nya, konɛ e kɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyagbe ɔ maa ba ha.
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ kpe ngua a tsuo hla kaa a maa na lakpa odase ko ngɛ Yesu he, konɛ a gbe lɛ; se a nɛ eko.
Nihi fuu ba ba ye lakpa odase mohu, se nɔ́ ko ji mi.
A hɛɛ mi hluu ɔ, nyumuhi enyɔ ba, nɛ a ba de ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ de ke, ‘Ma nyɛ ma ku Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ pue si, nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, ma fia ekohu.’ ” Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a te da si, nɛ e bi Yesu ke, “Odase nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ yee kɛ ngɛ mo sie ɔ, o be he nɔ́ ko dee?” Se Yesu pɛ̃ e nya mi.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a kɛ lɛ tu munyu ekohu ke, “I ngɛ mo kita kae ngɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ biɛ mi kaa ke mo ji Kristo, Mawu Bi ɔ, de wɔ!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ja o de ɔ nɛ!
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nyɛ maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ Ope ɔ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e ma ngɛ hiɔwe bɔku ɔmɛ a mi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a hía tade klɔii ɔ nɛ e wo ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “E bɔ musu!
Anɛ odase yeli kpahi a he pa hia wɔ lo?
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, tse nyɛ nu kaa e bɔ musu!
Kɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee kɛɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “E sa gbenɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a su lada ngɔ pue e hɛ mi, nɛ a fiaa lɛ ní.
Ni komɛ hu gba lɛ ma, nɛ a de ke, “Kristo, de wɔ!
Mɛnɔ lɛ fia mo nɔ́ ɔ?” Petro kua Yesu Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, Petro hii si ngɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a mawayo ko ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Mo hu tse o kɛ Yesu, Galilea no ɔ lɛ ngɛ!” Se Petro de ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ke, “Dɛbi!
Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, i li he nɔ́ ko.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya gu kue ɔ we agbo ɔ nya.
Se mawayo kpa ko hu na lɛ, nɛ e de nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ lɛ ngɛ.” Petro kplɛɛ we nɔ ekohu, nɛ e de ke, “I na Mawu kaa i li nyumu ɔ!” Be bɔɔ se ɔ, nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ba Petro ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ni ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji mo; ejakaa o munyu tumi tete jeɔ mo si!” Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ, Petro de ke, “I na Mawu kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, anɔkuale!
Ke pi ja a, Mawu nɛ gbla ye tue!
I li nyumu ɔ!” Amlɔ ɔ, kungwɔ kpa nɔ́.
Nɛ Petro kai munyu ɔ nɛ Yesu tu lɛ ke, “Loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ́ ɔ, o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi” ɔ. Nɛ e je kpo, nɛ e ya fo ya wawɛɛ.
Yesu ngɛ Pilato hɛ mi Benɛ je na a, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo so Yesu yi nɔ, konɛ a gbe lɛ.
A bɔ lɛ pã, nɛ a ngɔ lɛ ya ha Roma amlaalo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Pilato ɔ. Yuda gbenɔ Benɛ Yuda, nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ ɔ na kaa a bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ ɔ, e pia e he, nɛ e kpale sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ ɔ ya ha osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ.
E de mɛ ke “I pee yayami kaa i tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ pee we yayami ɔ se blɔ nɛ a gbe lɛ.” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a he nɔ ke, “Mɛni enɛ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ wa he?
Mo nitsɛ o sane ji lɔ ɔ!” Yuda ya sake sika a ngɔ pue sɔlemi we ɔ mi, nɛ e ho ya wo e kuɛ kpa.
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ ya kukuɔ sika a, nɛ a de ke, “Muɔ sika ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; wa mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a kɛ toɔ sɔlemi we ɔ nito he ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya da, nɛ a kɛ sika a he buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ abɔɔ ɔ, konɛ a pu nibwɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ jamɛ a abɔɔ ɔ ji “Muɔ Abɔɔ.” Enɛ ɔ ha nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yeremia de to ɔ ba mi ke, “A ngɔ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ ɔ, nɛ Israel fɔfɔɛ komɛ to nɛ a kɛ ma he lɛ ɔ ya he buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ abɔɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mi ɔ.” Pilato bi Yesu munyu Yesu daa si ngɛ Roma amlaalo ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ amlaalo ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ja o de ɔ nɛ.” Se benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ e nya poe, e je we nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Níhi babauu nɛ a ngɛ dee kɛ ngɛ mo sie nɛ ɔ, anɛ o nui?” Se Yesu ha we lɛ heto; sanehi nɛ a po ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ, e je we kake po nya.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha amlaalo ɔ nya kpɛ e he nitsɛnitsɛ.
A bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ Daa Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ, Roma amlaalo ɔ peeɔ kusumi ko; e ngmɛɛɔ pã mi no nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ suɔ he haa ma a. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, pã mi no kpanaku ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Baraba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ba bua a he nya a, Pilato bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ he nyɛ suɔ nɛ ma ngmɛɛ ha nyɛ, Baraba, loo Yesu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ?” E le kaa Yuda nimeli ɔmɛ ngɔ Yesu ngɔ ha, ejakaa a nyɛ lɛ kaa e biɛ he si.
Benɛ Pilato hii si ngɛ kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e yo tsɔ nɔ kɛ sɛ gbi ba de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, koo pee dalɔ nɛ ɔ yayami ko oo!
Ejakaa i nla nlami basabasa ngɛ e he nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ i hao wawɛɛ.” Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ wo ni kpekpemi ɔ a yi mi ke a de Pilato nɛ e ngmɛɛ Baraba he ha mɛ, konɛ e gbe Yesu.
Pilato bi ma kpekpemi ɔ ekohu ke, “Ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ he nyɛ suɔ kaa ma ngmɛɛ ha nyɛ?” Nɛ a he nɔ ke, “Baraba!” Pilato bi mɛ ke, “Lɛɛ mɛni ma pee Yesu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ he mɔ?” Mɛ tsuo a he nɔ ke, “Sɛu lɛ!” Pilato bi ke, “Mɛni yayami e pee?” Se enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Sɛu lɛ!” Pilato na kaa e he hia we hu kaa a ya nɔ, ejakaa basabasa miɔ nɛ e maa te si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e yɛ nyu, nɛ e fɔ e dɛ ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ gbenɔ ɔ, ye nine be mi oo, ye nine be mi!
Nyɛ, nyɛ sane!” Ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo he nɔ ke, “Ee, wa nu!
Tue gblami nɛ maa ba ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ gbenɔ se ɔ, e pee waa kɛ wa nina wa nɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato ngmɛɛ Baraba he ngɔ ha mɛ.
Se Yesu ɔ lɛɛ e ha a fia lɛ kpa, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.
Ta buli ɔmɛ ye Yesu he fɛu Jehanɛ ɔ, Pilato ta buli ɔmɛ ngɔ Yesu kɛ ba amlaalo ɔ we ɔ mi; nɛ tabo ɔ tsuo ba bua kɛ bɔle Yesu kɛ kpe.
A je tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ a ngɔ tade tsutsuu klɔii ngɔ wo lɛ.
A pee mio jlasi ngɔ fi e yi, nɛ a ngɔ tso ha lɛ nɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ a ye e he fɛu ke, “Wa nga mo oo, Yuda bi a matsɛ!” A su lada ngɔ pue e nɔ, nɛ a he tso ɔ ngɛ e dɛ nɛ a kɛ fia e yi mi.
Benɛ a ye e he fɛu ta a, a je tade klɔii ɔ ngɛ e he, nɛ a ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tade ɔmɛ ngɔ wo lɛ.
Nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho, konɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.
A sɛu Yesu Benɛ a je ma a mi kɛ yaa a, a na nyumu ko nɛ je Kirene ma a mi, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon.
Ta buli ɔmɛ nyɛ e nɔ ke e wo Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ.
A ya su he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Golgata; e sisi ji “Yikoklodonya.” Nɛ́ a su lejɛ ɔ, nɔ ko ha Yesu wai nɛ a kɛ tsopa nɛ dooɔ futu mi ke e nu; se benɛ e tso hyɛ ɔ, e sume kaa e maa nu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a sɛu lɛ, nɛ a fɔ sɔ kɛ dla e tade ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a hi si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a bu e he.
A ngma sane nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ he je nɛ a ngɛ lɛ sɛue ɔ kɛ mɛtɛ e yi je ke, “Yesu, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, a sɛu ojo fiali enyɔ ngɔ piɛ e he; nɔ kake ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake hu ngɛ e muɔ nɔ.
Nihi nɛ bee ɔ huanya yi, nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Yesu ke, “Mo nɛ o kuɔ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ o kpaleɔ maa lɛ ligbi etɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ!
He mo nitsɛ o yi wami koo!
Ke mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ, jee sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ kɛ kple si!” Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu ye e he fɛu ja nɔuu ke, “E he ni kpahi a yi wami, se lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ́ lɛɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e he!
Pi lɛ nɛ e ke lɛ ji Israel matsɛ ɔ!
Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ é kple si kɛ je sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ koo, kɛkɛ wa ma he ye!
E ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ e deɔ ke Mawu Bi ji lɛ.
Saminya!
Ke Mawu ngɛ e he tsui ɔ, e je lɛ kɛ je tso ɔ nɔ koo!” Awi yeli ɔmɛ nɛ a sɛu ngɔ piɛ Yesu he ɔ, mɛ hu a bɔ lɛ ahlua ja nɔuu.
Yesu gbenɔ Piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, zugba a nɔ tsuo wo diblii ngmlɛfia etɛ sɔuu.
Ngmlɛ etɛ mi ɔ, Yesu kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” E sisi ji, “Ye Mawu, ye Mawu, mɛni he je o kua mi?” Nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a kpɛti ni komɛ nu, nɛ a de ke, “Eliya nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ.” Amlɔ ɔ, a ti nɔ kake sa fo ya ngɔ wo mi kutsa, nɛ e kɛ sɔ dã nɛ kuã mi, nɛ e ngɔ ma pamploo nya, nɛ e ngɔ ha lɛ ke e nu.
Se nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Mlɛ!
Ha waa hyɛ kaa Eliya ma ba je lɛ lo!” Yesu kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ekohu; kɛkɛ nɛ e ma nya.
Tlukaa a, tsu mi pomi bo nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ mi gba enyɔ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba ma si.
Zugba mimiɛ, nɛ tɛ sahi a mi gba, nɛ yɔkɔhi a nya bli.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bimɛ babauu nɛ gbo ɔ, a tle mɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
A je kpo kɛ je a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ benɛ Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje se ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi ya nɛ nihi babauu na mɛ.
Benɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ Yesu he bue ɔ na nɛ zugba mimiɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ, a ye gbeye wawɛɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Niinɛ, Mawu Bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Yihi fuu hu daa si ngɛ se lokoo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe.
Yi nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ Yesu se kɛ je Galilea, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ sɔmɔe.
A kpɛti ni komɛ ji Maria Magdalena, kɛ Maria, Yakobo kɛ Yosef a nyɛ ɔ, kɛ Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ a nyɛ ɔ. Yesu pumi Benɛ du bu ɔ, niatsɛ ko je Arimatia kɛ ba.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Yosef, nɛ lɛ hu Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji lɛ.
E ya Pilato ngɔ, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke e ha lɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ. Pilato fa ke a ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ.
Nɛ Yosef ngɔ gbogboe ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ kploba he ngɔ blaa lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ya fɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yɔkɔ he nɛ e ha a kpɛ ngɛ tɛ sa mi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kpɛne tɛ agbo kɛ tsi yɔkɔ ɔ nya, nɛ e je.
Maria Magdalena, kɛ Maria kake ɔ hu hii si ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yesu yɔkɔ ɔ he bumi E nɔ jena Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a nya ba bua ngɛ Pilato ngɔ.
A de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa kai kaa benɛ jamɛ a sisilɔ ɔ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e de ke, ‘Ligbi etɛ se ɔ, ma te si ekohu.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fa nɛ a ya bu yɔkɔ ɔ he saminya kɛ maa su ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ. Ke pi jã a, e kaseli ɔmɛ ma ba ju lɛ kɛ ho, nɛ a ma ya de ma a ke e te si kɛ je gbeje.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyagbe sisimi nɛ ɔ ma ba puɛ ní kulaa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ.” Pilato de mɛ ke, “Hyɛ, ta buli ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ!
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya bu yɔkɔ ɔ he bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya sɔu yɔkɔ ɔ nya.
Nɛ a ha ta buli ɔmɛ bu he.
Yesu te si Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ se, kɛ yaa otsi ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ makɛ ɔ, Maria Magdalena, kɛ Maria kake ɔ ho, konɛ a ya slaa yɔkɔ ɔ. Tlukaa a, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ; Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo je hiɔwe kple si, nɛ e ba kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ je muɔ ɔ nya, nɛ e hi nɔ.
E hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa oslabai la, nɛ e tade ɔ hu hiɛ futafuta kaa kalo.
Gbeye nu ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ bue ɔ, nɛ a he do blibliibli, nɛ a pee kaa ni gbogboehi.
Bɔfo ɔ de yi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
I le kaa nyɛ ngɛ Yesu nɛ a sɛu ɔ hlae.
E be hiɛ ɔ; e te si kɛ je gbeje kaa bɔ nɛ e de ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ he nɛ a kɛ lɛ fɔ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ya esɔesɔ nɛ nyɛ ya de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, ‘E te si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e sɛ nyɛ hlami kɛ yaa Galilea.
Lejɛ ɔ nyɛ maa na lɛ ngɛ!’ Nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ oo!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je yɔkɔ ɔ he esɔesɔ kɛ gbeye, kɛ bua jɔmi babauu; nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho, konɛ a ya sɛɛ ha Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ.
Tlukaa a, Yesu kɛ mɛ ba kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ he manye!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba nu e nane, nɛ a kpla si, nɛ a ja lɛ.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye!
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji ye kaseli ɔmɛ ke a ya Galilea, nɛ a maa na mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Ta buli ɔmɛ ba bɔ amaniɛ Benɛ yi ɔmɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, ta buli nɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ he bue ɔ, a ti ni komɛ kpale a se kɛ ba ma a mi, nɛ a ba bɔ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ bɔ nɛ níhi ya nɔ ha.
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya kpe, nɛ a to ga. A ha ta buli ɔmɛ sika, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ de ke, nyɔ mi benɛ wa hwɔ mahe ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba nɛ a ba ju lɛ kɛ ho.
Nɛ ke Amlaalo ɔ nu he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa mlɔɔ e hɛ mi, konɛ nyɛ ko na sane.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sane nɛ ɔ mohu ba pee nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ sɛɛe ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ. Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, kaseli nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Galilea yo ɔ nɔ, he nɛ Yesu tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ ya.
Benɛ a na lɛ ɔ, a kpla si nɛ a ja lɛ; se ni komɛ je nɔ́.
Yesu hɛ lɛ kɛ su a he, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “A ha mi he blɔ ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ya je ma amɛ tsuo a ngɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ nyɛɛ pee mɛ ye kaseli.
Nyɛɛ sɔle mɛ ngɔ wo Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Bi ɔ, kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ biɛ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a ye níhi tsuo nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ a nɔ.
Hyɛ, i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si daa kɛ yaa su je mi nyagbe.”
NYA TSƆƆMI A je Marko womi ɔ sisi ke, “Sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo, Mawu Bi ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Womi ɔ kaleɔ Yesu kaa ní tsulɔ kpanaa nɛ ngɛ blɔ nya nguaa.
E he wami nɛ ɔ jeɔ kpo ngɛ e ní tsɔɔmi mi, bɔ nɛ mumi yayamihi po buɔ lɛ tue, kɛ bɔ nɛ e kɛ nihi a he yayamihi paa mɛ.
Yesu nitsɛ de ke lɛ ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, nɛ e ba je ɔ mi konɛ e ba ngɔ e wami kɛ ha nɛ e kpɔ adesahi kɛ je yayami dɛ mi.
Marko womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wa naa Yesu ní nɛ e tsu ɔ wawɛɛ pe munyuhi nɛ e tu.
E wo Yohane ta kpiti, nɛ e tu bɔ nɛ Yohane sɔle Yesu, kɛ bɔ nɛ Abosiami ka Yesu he munyu; kɛkɛ nɛ e tsa nɔ nɔuu kɛ Yesu ní tsumi, hiɔtsɛmɛ nɛ e tsa, kɛ ní nɛ e tsɔɔ.
Be saii se ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ba nu lɛ sisi bɔ nɛ sa; se e he nyɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a te si kɛ wo lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ pe sisije ɔ po.
Nɔ́ nɛ Marko kɛ gbe e womi ɔ nya ji sanehi nɛ ba Yesu nɔ nyagbe otsi ɔ nɛ e si je ɔ mi ɔ, titli e sɛumi, kɛ e si temi.
Marko Sane Kpakpa a nyagbe ɔ ya pee slɔɔto enyɔ, nɛ a ngma mɛ kɛ wo kla mi.
Nihi babauu ngɔɔ lɛ kaa nɔ kpa lɛ ngma níhi nɛ a kɛ wo kla mi ɔ, se pi Marko.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sane kpakpa a sisije .- Yesu ní tsumi ngɛ Galilea .—.
Yesu Galilea jemi kɛ Yerusalem yami .- Yesu nyagbe otsi ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi .—.
Yesu si temi .- Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he si jemi kɛ tsɔɔmi, kɛ e hiɔwe yami .-
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛ Sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo, Mawu Bi ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Sane ɔ je sisi kaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya ngma a ke, “Mawu ke, ‘Ma tsɔ ye tsɔlɔ kɛ sɛ o hlami nɛ e ya dla o blɔ ɔ ngɔ to mo.’ Nɔ ko ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ nga a nɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ dla blɔ ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ je blɔ tlɔmɔɔ ha lɛ nɛ e nyɛɛ nɔ!’ ” Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ ba ngɛ fiɛe nɛ e ngɛ nihi sɔlee ngɛ nga a nɔ.
E ngɛ fiɛe ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ́ a sɔle nyɛ konɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa nyɛ.” Nihi babauu je Yudea kpokpa a nɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ma a mi kɛ ba nga a nɔ ba bu Yohane tue.
A jaje a he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ a sɔle mɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a mi.
Yohane tade nɛ e woɔ ɔ, afukpɔngɔ he bwɔmi a kɛ pee ɛ; nɛ lohwe he womi kpa e kɛ fii e mlɛ mi, nɛ baalɛ kɛ nga nɔ hwo e yeɔ.
E fiɛ ha ni ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ ye se ɔ kle kulaa pe mi; e tokota nya kpa tete po i sɛ nɔ nɛ kplaa si nɛ e pɛneɔ.
Imi lɛɛ nyu i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sɔlee, se lɛɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu e kɛ maa sɔle nyɛ.” A sɔle Yesu, nɛ Abosiami ka lɛ Be bɔɔ se ɔ, Yesu je Nazaret ma a mi ngɛ Galilea kpokpa a nɔ kɛ ba, nɛ Yohane sɔle lɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a mi.
Benɛ Yesu je kpo kɛ je nyu ɔ mi nɔuu pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e na nɛ hiɔwe nya bli, nɛ Mumi ɔ ngɛ si kplee kaa lahuɛ kɛ ma e nɔ.
E nu gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “Mo ji ye bi nɛ i suɔ; i naa o he bua jɔmi saminya.” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsɛ̃ e yi se kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya.
E ya hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ Abosiami ka lɛ; nga mi lohwehi hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se Mawu bɔfohi ba hyɛ lɛ.
Yesu tsɛ wo hɛli eywiɛ Benɛ a nu Yohane wo tsu se ɔ, Yesu ba Galilea, nɛ e ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ. E ke, “Be ɔ su; Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ná nyɛ haa!
Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ nyɛ he sane kpakpa a nyɛɛ ye.” Benɛ Yesu bee ngɛ Galilea wo ɔ nya a, e na hɛli enyɔ, Simon kɛ e nyɛminyumu Andrea nɛ a ngɛ ya fɔe ngɛ wo ɔ mi.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba nyɛɛ ye se nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ nimli ha mi kaa a hɛɛ lo.” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, a si a ya amɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se.
E ya e hɛ mi bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e na nyɛmimɛ kpahi, Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo binyumu ɔmɛ.
A ngɛ a lɛ ɔ mi nɛ a ngɛ a ya amɛ dlae.
Benɛ Yesu hɛ gba a nɔ pɛ nɛ e tsɛ mɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ a si a tsɛ Zebedeo kɛ apaa yeli ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se.
Nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi Jehanɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Kapernaum ɔ. Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, Yesu ya kpe he ɔ, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ní.
Nihi nɛ ba bu lɛ tue ɔ, a he mi po ngɛ e ní tsɔɔmi ɔ he, ejakaa e tsɔɔ mɛ ní kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ he blɔ, pi kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi ngɛ kpe he ɔ. Tlukaa, e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Yesu Nazaret no, mɛni sane waa kɛ mo ngɛ?
O ba nɛ o ba kpata wa hɛ mi; pi ja?
I le mo tsɔ!
Mo ji Mawu tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.” Yesu nga mumi yayami ɔ yi ke, “Ma o nya!
Jee kpo ngɛ e ɔ mi.” Mumi yayami ɔ huanya nyumu ɔ; nyumu ɔ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, kɛkɛ nɛ mumi ɔ je e mi.
Ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ, a he mi po, nɛ a bɔni a he bimi ke, “Mɛni ji nɛ ɔ?
Tsɔɔmi he ko lo?
Nɛ he wumi hu ngɛ mi.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ngaa mumi yayamihi a yi nɛ a buɔ lɛ tue!” Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu he sane gbɛ fĩa Galilea kpokpa a tsuo nɔ.
Yesu tsa nihi babauu Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ a je kpe he ɔ, Yakobo kɛ Yohane piɛ he nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ ho Simon kɛ Andrea a we ɔ mi ya.
Simon nganyɛ fɔɔ si kɛ aslã; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Yesu su lejɛ ɔ pɛ nɛ a de lɛ.
E ya e ngɔ, nɛ e ya nu e nine si, nɛ e wo e nɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ aslã a po ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e te si nɛ e bɔni ni ɔmɛ sɔmɔmi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Gbɔkuɛ benɛ pu nɔ si ɔ, nihi ngɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ nihi nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ a mi tsuo kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ.
Ma a tsuo ba bua, nɛ agbo ɔ nya lejɛ ɔ tsuo hyi kɛ nimli babauu.
Yesu tsa nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nue, nɛ e hia mumi yayamihi babauu.
Se e ha we mumi yayami ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a de nɔ́ ko, ejakaa a le kaa lɛ ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.
Yesu fiɛ ngɛ Galilea Makɛ mla, benɛ je mi tsɔ we lolo ɔ, Yesu te si nɛ e je kpo kɛ ho nga a nɔ he ko banee ya nɛ e ya sɔle.
Se Simon kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu je kpo ya bɔni lɛ hlami.
Benɛ a na lɛ ɔ, a de lɛ ke, “Ni ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ mo hlae.” Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ya ma kpa amɛ nɛ bɔle wɔ nɛ ɔ a mi, konɛ ma ya fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ; ejakaa lɔ ɔ he i ba ngɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ya kpa Galilea tsuo, nɛ e fiɛ ngɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ e hia mumi yayamihi hulɔ.
Yesu tsa nyumu ko Nyumu ko nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ba Yesu ngɔ.
E ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke, “Ke o suɔ ɔ, o ma nyɛ ha ye he nɛ tsɔ!” Yesu muklii mi sã lɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e kpã e nine mi nɛ e ta e he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I suɔ!
O he nɛ tsɔ!” Amlɔ ɔ, he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a ta, nɛ e he tsɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bɔ lɛ kɔkɔ nɛ e wo lɛ blɔ nɔuu.
E de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, ko de nɔ ko nɔ́ ko, se mohu yaa tɛɛ nɛ o kɛ o he ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ, nɛ e hyɛ mo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mose wo mlaa a, konɛ e pee okadi ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ o he tsɔ.” Se nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya bɔni sane ɔ fiɛmi ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Enɛ ɔ ha sane ɔ gbɛ fĩa bɔ nɛ Yesu nyɛ we nɛ e nyɛɛ paa kɛ ya ma ko mi hu; se e hi ngapa he komɛ banee, nɛ nihi jee he tsuaa he kɛ baa e ngɔ.
Yesu tsa nɔ ko nɛ hule pue si Yesu kpale kɛ ba Kapernaum, nɛ pee se ɔ, a nu e he kaa e ba su we mi.
Nihi babauu ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ bɔ nɛ a nɛ́ blɔ ngɛ agbo ɔ nya tete.
Benɛ Yesu ngɛ fiɛe ha mɛ ɔ, a ngɔ nɔ ko nɛ hule pue si, nɛ nihi eywiɛ tloo lɛ kɛ ba.
Akɛnɛ ni ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a nɛ́ blɔ nɛ a kɛ su Yesu ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya hia tsu ɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ mi ɔ yi mi, ngɛ he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tutuutu.
A siu hiɔtsɛ ɔ kɛ sa a nɛ e hwɔɔ si ngɛ nɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ gu puɔ nɛ a gbu ɔ mi.
Yesu na kaa ni ɔmɛ he lɛ ye saminya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de hiɔtsɛ ɔ ke, “Ye bi, a ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mo!” Se mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ susu ngɛ a yi mi ke, “Mɛni e ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ?
E ngɛ musu bɔe.
Nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ yayami maa pa, ja Mawu pɛ.” Yesu na ngɛ mumi mi kaa a ngɛ nɔ́ ɔ he susue, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ susue ɔ?
Te nɔ́ nɛ demi yee nɛɛ; kaa a ma de nɔ nɛ hule pue si ɔ ke, ‘A ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mo,’ loo kaa a ma de ke, ‘Tee si nɛ o hluɛ o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ?’ Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ jehanɛ ɔ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɛ he blɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ kaa e kɛ yayami paa nɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de hiɔtsɛ ɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee ke, tee si, hluɛ o sa a nɛ o ya we mi!” Ngɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, nyumu ɔ te si nɔuu; e ngɔ e sa a, nɛ e je kpo.
Mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a je Mawu yi ke, “Wa nɛ enɛ ɔ eko hyɛ!” Yesu tsɛ Levi Yesu kpale e se ekohu kɛ ho Galilea wo ɔ nya ya.
Nihi babauu ba e ngɔ, nɛ e bɔni mɛ ní tsɔɔmi.
Benɛ e yaa a, e na Alfeo bi Levi nɛ hii si ngɛ tó tsumi he ɔ. Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ye se.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Levi te si pam nɛ e nyɛɛ e se.
Yesu kɛ yayami peeli ye ní Pee se ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya ye ní ngɛ Levi we ɔ mi.
Tó tsuli, kɛ nihi babauu nɛ a buu mɛ yayami peeli nɛ nyɛɛ Yesu se hu piɛ e kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a he kɛ ye ní ɔ. Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ ji Farisi bi ɔmɛ na nɛ Yesu kɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hii si ngɛ ní yee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ yeɔ ní ɔ?” Yesu nu, nɛ e ha mɛ heto ke, “Nihi nɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ, tsopatsɛ he hia we mɛ, se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nue ɔ mohu.
I bɛ nɛ ma ba tsɛ nihi nɛ da, se mohu ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ yayami a he i ba.” Hwɔ hami Ligbi ko ɔ, Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ kaseli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae.
Ni komɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a kaseli ɔmɛ haa hwɔ, se o kaseli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a hɛ́ hwɔ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke nɔ ko kpee yo nɛ e huɛmɛ ba e he nyami ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa e maa ha mɛ hwɔ be mi nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ lo?
Be abɔ nɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ kɛ mɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, a be hwɔ hae.
Se be ma nɛ a maa ngɔ ayɛflo huno ɔ kɛ je a he; jamɛ a be ɔ mi loko a maa ha hwɔ.
“Nɔ ko ngɔɛ bo nya he kɛ ta we tade momo mi.
Ke e pee ja a, bo nya he ɔ ma hía tade momo ɔ, nɛ e ma ha pa a ma blii.
Jehanɛ hu, nɔ ko ngɔɛ wai he ngɔ wui lohwe he womi tɔ momo mi.
Ke e pee ja a, lɛɛ wai he ɔ ma pɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔ, nɛ wai ɔ ma pue si, nɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔ hu ma puɛ.
Wai he ɔ, lohwe he womi tɔ he mi a kɛ woɔ!” Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ko ɔ, Yesu ya gu blɛfo ngmɔ komɛ a mi.
E kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ, nɛ a bɔni blɛfo ɔ kpɔmi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Hyɛ, mɛni he je o kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ kane we nɔ́ nɛ David pee benɛ hwɔ ye lɛ nɛ e nɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye ɔ. Hwɔ ye e kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ ɔ tsuo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ya Mawu we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya ye abolo klɛdɛɛ nɛ a kɛ maa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ba mi benɛ Abiatar ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa yee ɔ. Wa mlaa a nya a, osɔfo ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a yeɔ abolo nɛ ɔ, se David ye eko, nɛ e ha nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ ɔ tete eko nɛ a ye.” Yesu gbe e munyu ɔ nya ke, “Nɔmlɔ he nɛ a pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, se pi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he nɛ a bɔ nɔmlɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ po e nyɔmtsɛ ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ.”
Nyumu ɔ nɛ nine kake gbo ɔ Yesu ba kpe he ɔ ekohu.
Nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nine kake gbo.
Ni komɛ ngɛ Yesu huɔe kaa e ma tsa hiɔtsɛ ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ lo, konɛ a ya po e nya.
Yesu de nɔ nɛ nine gbo ɔ ke, “Hɛɛ mo kɛ ba ye ngɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi ni ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ e da kaa a peeɔ kpakpa, loo a peeɔ yayami Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ; e da kaa a heɔ nɔmlɔ yi wami, aloo a gbee lɛ?” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a pɛ̃ nya mi.
Yesu kɛ abofu hyɛ a hɛ mi kɛ kpe; e dɔ lɛ kaa a tsui wa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nyumu ɔ ke, “Kpã o nine mi!” E pee ja; nɛ a tsa e nine ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ je kpe he ɔ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ, a kɛ Herode bi ɔmɛ ya so Yesu yi nɔ, bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a kpata e hɛ mi.
Nimli babauu ba wo ɔ nya Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ sã a he si kɛ ho Galilea wo ɔ nya ya, nɛ nimli babauu nyɛɛ e se.
A je Galilea, Yudea, Yerusalem, Idumea kpokpa a nɔ, Yordan pa a se, kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon ní ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ba.
Nimli babauu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba Yesu ngɔ, ejakaa a nu níhi nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ a he.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he hiɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke a hla lɛ ko ha lɛ, konɛ asafo ɔ ko mia lɛ.
A nu he kaa e tsa nihi babauu he je ɔ, hiɔtsɛmɛ tsuo bu kɛ ba e ngɔ konɛ a ba ta e he.
Nihi nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ a mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ be tsuaa be nɛ a maa na lɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ nɔɔ si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ a kpaa ngmlaa ke, “Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ!” Yesu bɔ mumi yayami ɔmɛ kɔkɔ veveeve ke a ko je lɛ si kɛ tsɔɔ.
Yesu hla bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ya yoku ko nɔ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsɛ nihi nɛ e suɔ ɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ.
E hla a kpɛti ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, konɛ a kɛ lɛ ba hi si, nɛ́ e tsɔ mɛ nɛ a ya fiɛ.
A ma na he blɔ nɛ a kɛ hia mumi yayamihi.
Ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ e hla a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Simon, (nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Petro hulɔ ɔ), Yakobo, kɛ e nyɛmi Yohane, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ (Yesu wo mɛ Boanerges.
E sisi ji oslabai bimɛ), Andrea, Filipo, Bartolomeo, Mateo, Toma, Alfeo bi Yakobo, Tadeo, Simon ma he doolɔ ɔ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ. Yesu kɛ Beelzebul Jehanɛ Yesu ba su we mi.
Nihi babauu ba bua a he nya ekohu bɔ nɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ na we hɛ mi nɛ a ye ní po.
Benɛ e weku li nu he ɔ, a ho konɛ a ya nu lɛ, ejakaa nihi ngɛ dee ke, “E yi mi ngɛ puɛe!” Mlaa tsɔli komɛ nɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ba a ngɛ dee ke, “Beelzebul ngɛ e mi.
Mumi yayami ɔmɛ a tsɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ haa lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔ nɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu tsɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke, “Kɛ Abosiami maa pee kɛ hia Abosiami kɛɛ?
Ke ma ko mi bi gba ta ngɔ wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ, jamɛ a ma a be nyɛe maa da si.
Ke we ko gba ta wo lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ, jamɛ a we ɔ be si nyɛe maa da.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Abosiami gba ta ngɔ wo lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ e gba e mi ɔ, e be si nyɛe maa da, se mohu e nyagbe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
“Nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ya katsɛ we mi ya ju, ja e fi lɛ kekle, lɔ ɔ loko e ma nyɛ maa ju e níhi.
“I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, a kɛ nimli a he yayamihi tsuo maa pa mɛ; a kɛ munyuhi nɛ a maa tu kɛ bɔ musu tsuo hu maa pa ja nɔuu.
Se nɔ nɛ bɔɔ musu kɛ siɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, a kɛ be lɛ pae gblegbleegble kɛ maa ya neneene; ejakaa e yeɔ fɔ kɛ yaa neneene.” (Yesu de enɛ ɔ, ejakaa ni komɛ ke, “Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi.”) Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ Jehanɛ Yesu nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ e nyɛ ba lejɛ ɔ.
A ba da si ngɛ tsu ɔ se nɛ a tsɔ ke a tsɛ lɛ ha mɛ.
Nihi babauu nɛ kɛ Yesu hii si ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, o nyɛ kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ tsu ɔ se ngɛ mo hlae.” Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji maa, nɛ mɛnɔmɛ ji ye nyɛmimɛ?” E hyɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ e he ɔ a hɛ mi kɛ kpe, kɛkɛ nɛ e ke, “Maa, kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ!
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu ji ye nyɛminyumu, ye nyɛmiyo, kɛ ye nyɛ.”
Ní dulɔ he abɛ Yesu bɔni ní tsɔɔmi ekohu ngɛ Galilea wo ɔ nya.
Nihi nɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sɛ lɛ ko mi nɛ e ya hi si.
Lɛ ɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo pueɔ si ngɛ wo ɔ nya.
E tsɔɔ mɛ níhi fuu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi.
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyumu ko pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya du ní.
Benɛ e ngɛ wu ɔmɛ fĩae ɔ, ekomɛ ya pue blɔ tue, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba kukuɔ.
Ekomɛ ya pue tɛ sa nɔ he nɛ zu fuu be.
A puɛ oya, ejakaa zu ɔ mi kuɔ we.
Se benɛ pu je ɔ, e sã mɛ nɛ a ngla, ejakaa a be sipoku nɛ ya zu mi bɔ nɛ sa.
Wu ɔmɛ ekomɛ ya pue miohi a kpɛti.
Mio ɔ mia mɛ benɛ a ngɛ wae ɔ, nɛ a wui yiblii ko.
Se wu ɔmɛ ekomɛ ya pue zugba kpakpa nɔ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a puɛ nɛ a wa, nɛ a wo yiblii, eko nyingmi etɛ, eko nyingmi ekpa, kɛ eko lafa.” Yesu gbe munyu nɛ ɔ nya ke, “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e nu.” Nɔ́ he je nɛ Yesu bu abɛhi Benɛ e piɛ Yesu nɔ kake too ɔ, nihi nɛ ba bu lɛ tue ɔ, a ti ni komɛ kɛ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ bi lɛ abɛ ɔ sisi.
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ a ha nyɛ he blɔ kaa nyɛɛ le laami sanehi nɛ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi; se ni kpa amɛ lɛɛ abɛ gbi mi a deɔ mɛ sane ɔmɛ ngɛ, konɛ ‘Ke a na a, a ko kɔ se, nɛ ke a nu ɔ, a ko nu sisi.
Ke pi jã a, a maa kpale kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, nɛ e kɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa mɛ.’ ” Yesu tsɔɔ ní dulɔ he abɛ ɔ sisi Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ nui abɛ nɛ ɔ sisi?
Lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ maa nu abɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a sisi mɔ?
Bɔ nɛ Mawu munyu fiɛlɔ tsuɔ ní ɔ, lɔ ɔ a kɛ to ní dulɔ he ɔ nɛ.
Ni komɛ ngɛ kaa wu nɛ ya nɔ blɔ mi.
Ke a nu munyu ɔ, kɛkɛ Abosiami ba je munyu ɔ ngɛ a mi.
Ni komɛ hu ngɛ kaa wu nɛ ya nɔ tɛ sa zugba mi.
Ke a nu munyu ɔ, a heɔ lɛ nɔuu kɛ bua jɔmi.
Se e he we si ngɛ a mi; nɛ e se kɛ we.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke amanehlu, loo yi mi wami te si ngɛ munyu ɔ he ɔ, a ngmɛɛɔ he oya.
Ni kpa komɛ hu ngɛ kaa wu nɛ a du ngɛ mio mi.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ nuɔ munyu ɔ, se je nɛ ɔ mi he nya gbami, ní nami he suɔmi, kɛ ní kpahi a he akɔnɔ sɛɛ a mi, nɛ a gbee munyu ɔ ngɛ a mi, nɛ a wui yiblii.
Se ni kpa komɛ ngɛ kaa wuhi nɛ ya nɔ zu kpakpa nɔ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ ke a nu munyu ɔ, a pɛtɛɛ he, nɛ a woɔ yiblii, eko nyingmi etɛ, eko nyingmi ekpa, kɛ eko lafa.” Kane nɛ a kɛ ma sowe sisi Yesu tsa nɔ ke, “Anɛ nɔ ko suɔ kane kɛ maa sowe, loo sa tso sisi?
Anɛ pi kane tso nɔ nɛ e kɛ maa?
Nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ laa nɛ a be kpo jee, nɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ a pee ngɛ diblii mi nɛ a kɛ be la hɛ mi bae.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e nu.” E de mɛ hu ke, “Nyɛ susu nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ he saminya!
Mlaahi nɛ nyɛ kɛ kojoɔ ni kpahi ɔ, lɔ ɔ Mawu kɛ maa kojo nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ kojomi ɔ nya maa wa wawɛɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, a ma ha lɛ eko ngɔ piɛ he; se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko tsɔ ko ɔ, bɔɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tete a ma kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ.” Bɔ nɛ wu nɛ a du puɛɔ nɛ e waa Yesu tsa nɔ ke, “Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a duɔ wu nɛ e waa.
Nyumu ko ya fĩaa ní ngɛ e zugba nɔ.
E ya hwɔɔ si nyɔ mi, nɛ ke je na a, e teɔ si.
Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, wu ɔmɛ ngɛ puɛe nɛ a ngɛ wae, se kɛ̃ e li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae.
Zugba a nitsɛ lɛ haa ní ɔmɛ waa nɛ a woɔ yiblii, ba mumu ɔ kekle, kɛkɛ ɔ tso ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngma a nitsɛ ngɛ tso ɔ yi mi.
Ke ngma a wa a, nyumu ɔ ngɔɔ ngma kpami ha a kɛ yaa amlɔ nɔuu, ejakaa ngma kpami be ɔ su.” Wu nyafii pe kulaa a Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he wa maa ngɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ to?
Aloo mɛni abɛ wa maa bu kɛ tsɔɔ nya?
E ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɔ wu nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ je ɔ mi ya du.
Be bɔɔ se ɔ, wu ɔ puɛɔ nɛ e ba kleɔ pe pu mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo.
E tsɛ̃ɔ kɔni nguanguahi, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ peeɔ a tsu ngɛ kɔni ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Yesu gu abɛhi fuu nɛ ngɛ kaa enɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ e kɛ fiɛ munyu ɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ nu sisi.
Abɛhi a mi pɛ e kɛ mɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ, se ke e piɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ pɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ mɛ abɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a sisi.
Yesu jɔɔ wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa he Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, benɛ e su gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa po wo ɔ kɛ ya e se je.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ si nimli kpekpemi ɔ, nɛ a ya piɛ Yesu he ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho.
Lɛ kpa komɛ hu fie a se.
Kɛkɛ nɛ wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa hia, nɛ oslɔke bɔni kumi kɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi woe, nɛ nyu miɔ nɛ e ma hyi lɛ ɔ.
Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, Yesu tslɔ sɔnue kɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ lɛ ɔ supa je.
Kaseli ɔmɛ ba tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ wa hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae nɛ ɔ, pi o he sane ko lo?” Yesu te si, nɛ e nga kɔɔhiɔ ɔ yi, nɛ e de wo ɔ ke, “Ngmɛɛ dii!” Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ jɔɔ fiami, nɛ wo ɔ ngmɛ dii.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ gbeye yee kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ loko nyɛ be hemi kɛ yemi ɔ?” Se mɛɛ a he mi po, nɛ a bi a he ke, “Mɛnɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ kɛ wo tete buɔ lɛ tue nɛ ɔ!”
Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba Galilea wo ɔ se ngɛ Gerasa bi ɔmɛ a zugba a mi.
Benɛ Yesu kple si kɛ je lɛ ɔ mi pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi nɛ je yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi kɛ lɛ ba kpe.
Kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ yɔkɔhi a mi e hii, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e fi lɛ hu kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ po.
A bɔ lɛ pã, nɛ a wo lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ si abɔ, se be tsuaa be ɔ, e tsɔɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔ, nɛ e kuɔɔ pã a; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nyumu nɛ ɔ he nɛ e jɔɔ.
Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo yɔkɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ɔmɛ a mi e hii; e kpaa ngmlaa nɛ e kɛ tɛ poɔ e he.
Se benɛ e na Yesu ngɛ lokoo ɔ, e tu fo kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Yesu, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ bi, mɛni o ngɛ hlae ngɛ ye dɛ?
I na Mawu kaa kó pĩ mi!” (E de enɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yesu ke e yi ke, “Mo mumi yayami, jee nyumu ɔ mi!”) Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ a tsɛɛ mo kɛɛ?” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ye biɛ ji Asafo, ejakaa wa he hiɛ.” E kpa Yesu pɛɛ hluu ke e ko fie mumi yayami ɔmɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi.
Kpotoo kuu nguaa ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ ní yee ngɛ yoku ɔ he.
Mumi yayami ɔmɛ kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke, “Ha nɛ wa ya sɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a mi.” E kplɛɛ, nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ je nyumu ɔ mi ya sɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a mi.
Kuu nguaa a tsuo, maa pee akpe enyɔ ɔ sa fo kɛ kple si kɛ ya sɛ wo ɔ mi, nɛ a gbo.
Kpotoo nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ tu fo nɛ a ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ma a, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.
Ni ɔmɛ je kpo konɛ a ba hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba a.
A ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a ba na nyumu ɔ nɛ jinɛ mumi yayamihi asafo ngɛ e mi ɔ. E hii si kɛ e he tade, nɛ e hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ pee mɛ gbeye.
Nihi nɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ba nyumu ɔ nɛ mumi yayamihi hi e mi ɔ, kɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, sɛɛ sane ɔ ha ni ɔmɛ nɛ ba a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e je a zugba a mi.
Jehanɛ benɛ Yesu ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi sɛe ɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ jinɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi ɔ kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e kɛ lɛ maa ya.
Se Yesu kplɛɛ we; mohu e de lɛ ke, “Kpale o se, nɛ o ho we mi ya!
Yaa o weku li a ngɔ nɛ o ya sɛɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ha mo ɔ; de mɛ bɔ nɛ e na mo mɔbɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya bɔni ní nguahi nɛ Yesu pee ha lɛ ɔ fiɛmi ngɛ Ma Nyɔngma amɛ a mi.
Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nu ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he.
Yairo biyo ɔ, kɛ yo ɔ nɛ ta Yesu tade he ɔ Yesu sɛ lɛ ɔ mi kɛ kpale kɛ ho wo ɔ se ya, nɛ nihi babauu ba bu e nɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yairo ɔ ba lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e ba kpla si ngɛ e nane nya, nɛ e fa kue wawɛɛ ha lɛ ke, “Ye biyo wayoo miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
Ba nɛ o kɛ o nine ba pue e nɔ, konɛ e na he wami, nɛ e yi nɛ na wa.” Yesu kɛ nyumu ɔ ho.
Nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se nɛ a mia lɛ.
Yo ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ muɔ ngɛ dɛe ngɛ e he jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ sɔuu.
E kpa tsopatsɛmɛ a nɔ hluu nɛ e dɛ mi ta, se hiɔ ɔ bɛ si; mohu pe e ngɛ nɔ puee.
Yo nɛ ɔ nu Yesu he sane, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ba je e se je ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e ta e tade ɔ he.
Ejakaa e de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Ke i ná ta e tade ɔ he kɛkɛ ɔ, ma na he wami.” Benɛ e ta Yesu tade ɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, muɔ ɔ jɔɔ dɛmi, nɛ e nu he ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi kaa a tsa lɛ.
Yesu nu he ngɛ e mi kaa he wami je e mi, nɛ e plɛ si kake too nɛ e bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ta ye tade ɔ he ɔ?” E kaseli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “O ngɛ hyɛe kaa asafo ɔ ngɛ mo miae, nɛ o pa ngɛ bie ke, mɛnɔ ta o he lo?” Yesu hyɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ be kaa e maa na nɔ nɛ ta e he ɔ lo.
Akɛnɛ yo ɔ le nɔ́ nɛ a pee ha lɛ he je ɔ, e kɛ gbeye yemi, kɛ he domi ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi, nɛ e de lɛ anɔkuale ɔ tsuo.
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Biyo, o hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo!
O hiɔ ɔ nɛ jɔ!
Yaa ngɛ he jɔmi mi.” Benɛ Yesu ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, ni komɛ je Yairo nɛ ji kpe he nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi ba de lɛ ke, “O biyo ɔ gbo; mɛni he je o pa ngɛ tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nya dooe?” Benɛ Yesu nu munyu nɛ a tu ɔ, e de Yairo ke, “Koo ye gbeye; mo he ye kɛkɛ!” E ha we nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ nyɛɛ e se, ja Petro, Yakobo, kɛ Yakobo nyɛmi Yohane pɛ.
A ba Yairo we ɔ mi, nɛ Yesu ba na kaa lejɛ ɔ pee hoo.
Nihi wo yana nɛ a ngɛ awe nyae.
Benɛ e sɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hoo pee nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ya foe kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Jokuɛ ɔ gbo we; mahe kɛkɛ e ngɛ hwɔe.” Se ni ɔmɛ muɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e fie mɛ tsuo kɛ je kpo, nɛ e ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ kɛ sɛ tsu mi he nɛ jokuɛ ɔ hwɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ. E nu jokuɛ ɔ nine si, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Talita kum.” E sisi ji, “Jokuɛ yo, i ngɛ mo dee ke tee si!” Amlɔ ɔ, jokuɛ yo ɔ te si nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi.
(E ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.)
Ni ɔmɛ a nya kpɛ a he nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ he.
Se Yesu wo mɛ si veveeve ke a ko ha nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ le nɔ nɛ ba a. Kɛkɛ nɛ e fa ke a ha lɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye.
A kua Yesu ngɛ Nazaret Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, e ya tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ. Nihi fuu nɛ bu lɛ tue ɔ, a he mi po, nɛ a bi ke, “Jije nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ya ná nile nɛ ɔ ngɛ?
Mɛni nile a kɛ ha lɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni blɔ nɔ e guɔ kɛ tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ?
Anɛ pi kapitɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?
Pi Maria bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?
Pi Yakobo, Yose, Yuda, kɛ Simon a nyɛminyumu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?
Pi e nyɛmiyihi hu nɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee mɛ tai.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “A buu gbalɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he, ja e ma mi, e weku li a kpɛti, kɛ e we mi pɛ.” Nɛ Yesu nyɛ we he wami ní tsumi ko nɛ e tsu ngɛ Nazaret pe kaa e kɛ e nine pue hiɔtsɛmɛ bɔɔ ko a nɔ nɛ e tsa mɛ.
Ni ɔmɛ he we lɛ yi, nɛ enɛ ɔ pee lɛ nyakpɛ.
Yesu tsɔ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ Yesu ya kpa kɔpehi nɛ bɔle lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e tsɔɔ ní.
E tsɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e tsɔ mɛ enyɔɔnyɔ.
E ha mɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ hia mumi yayamihi.
Nɛ e wo mɛ mlaa ke, a ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ to dɛ pe dɛma tso pɛ; a ko hɛɛ niye ní, loo ní balɔ kotoku, loo sika ngɛ a mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ mi.
Nɛ a wo tokota, se a ko hɛɛ hiɔwe tade enyɔne.
E de mɛ ke, “We tsuaa we mi nɛ nyɛ maa ya a, nyɛɛ hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si nyɛ maa je.
Ke nyɛ ya su ma ko mi, nɛ a he we nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ blɛ nyɛ nane si zu kɛ pue si nɛ nyɛɛ je!
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa to mɛ okadi!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya fiɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ke a tsake a tsui.
A hia mumi yayamihi babauu, nɛ a pɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ babauu nu, nɛ a tsa mɛ.
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ gbenɔ Matsɛ Herode ba nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he, ejakaa Yesu biɛ pɛ kɛ kpa he tsuaa he.
Ni komɛ de ke, “Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ lɛ te si kɛ je gbeje, lɔ ɔ lɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsue ɔ nɛ.” Ni komɛ hu ke, “Eliya ji lɛ;” nɛ ni kpa komɛ hu de ke, “Gbalɔ ji lɛ kaa blema gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.” Benɛ Herode nu ɔ, e de ke, “Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ nɛ i po e yi ɔ, lɛ nɛ a tle si kɛ je gbeje.” Ejakaa lɛ, Herode ɔ nitsɛ lɛ e ha nɛ a ya nu Yohane nɛ a fi lɛ, nɛ a wo lɛ tsu.
Herode pee enɛ ɔ, ejakaa e ngɔ Herodia, e nyɛmi Filipo yo ɔ kɛ pee e yo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yohane de lɛ ke, “E dɛ blɔ kaa o ngɔɔ o nyɛmi ɔ yo ɔ ngɔ peeɔ o yo.” Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Herodia dɔ Yohane ninyɛ, nɛ e hlaa kaa e maa gbe lɛ, se e na we he blɔ, ejakaa Herode kplɛɛ we.
Herode nitsɛ hu ngɛ Yohane gbeye yee, ejakaa e le kaa Yohane ɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa, kɛ nɔ klɔuklɔu ji lɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to slɔkee.
Herode suɔ kaa e bu lɛ tue lɛɛ, se be tsuaa be nɛ e maa nu munyu kɛ je Yohane nya, e haoɔ lɛ.
Ligbi ko ɔ, Herode ngɛ e fɔmi ligbi yee, nɛ e tsɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Galilea nikɔtɔma amɛ ní yemi.
Herodia biyo ba ba do, nɛ e sa Herode, kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ hii si ngɛ okplɔɔ he ɔ a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ de jokuɛ yo ɔ ke, “Bi mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ nɛ ma ha mo!” E ka lɛ kita ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma bi mi ɔ, ma ha mo; ke ye matsɛ yemi ɔ mi fa tete po ma ha mo!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jokuɛ yo ɔ je kpo nɛ e ya bi e nyɛ ke, “Mɛni ma bi?” E de lɛ ke, “Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ yi!” Jokuɛ yo ɔ kpale kɛ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “I ngɛ hlae nɛ o ngɔ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ yi ngɔ ha mi ngɛ sowe nɔ amlɔ nɔuu.” E dɔ matsɛ ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, se kita nɛ e ka, kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ hii si ngɛ niye ní ɔ si ɔ a he je ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e kua.
Amlɔ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɔ e plaafo, nɛ e fa lɛ ke e ya ngɔ Yohane yi kɛ ba.
Kɛkɛ nɛ plaafo ɔ ho nɛ e ya po Yohane yi ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ fɔ sowe nɔ kɛ ba ha jokuɛ yo ɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ ya ha e nyɛ.
Benɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a ba wo e gbogboe ɔ nɛ a ya pu.
Yesu ha nimli akpe enuɔ niye ní Kaseli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a ba bɔ lɛ níhi nɛ a ya pee, kɛ níhi nɛ a ya tsɔɔ ɔ tsuo.
Jehanɛ, bɔ nɛ nihi babauu ngɛ bae nɛ a ngɛ yae ɔ ha nɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ na we hɛ mi nɛ a ye ní tete.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ wɔ kɔklɔɔ waa ya he ko banee nɛ nyɛ ya jɔɔ nyɛ he bɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ kɔklɔɔ a sɛ lɛ mi kɛ ho he ko banee ya.
Nihi babauu na mɛ nɛ a yaa, nɛ a yo mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je ma amɛ tsuo a mi kɛ fo kɛ gu nane blɔ nɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ si Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ.
Benɛ Yesu kple ɔ, e na nimli babauu nitsɛ, nɛ e mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ a he, ejakaa a ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔni mɛ níhi fuu tsɔɔmi.
Gbɔkuɛ nya si haa a, kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Ngapa ji hiɛ ɔ, nɛ je hu ngɛ jɔe.
Wó ni ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ya ngmɔ si, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ a mi, nɛ a ya he nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye.” Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ha mɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye.” A bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ waa ya nɛ wa ya he abolo sika hiɔ yi lafa enyɔ nya ha mɛ nɛ a ye lo?” Jehanɛ Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Abolo nyɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ?
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya hyɛ.” Benɛ a ya hyɛ ɔ, a ke, “Bɔbɔɛ enuɔ, kɛ lo enyɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e fa mɛ ke a ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a hi si ngɛ kuuhi a mi ngɛ nga mumu ɔ nɔ.
A hi si kuuhi kuuhi lafalafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔɔnuɔ.
Jehanɛ Yesu wo abolo enuɔ ɔ kɛ lo enyɔ ɔ nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e gbaa nɔ.
E ku abolo ɔ mi nɛ e kɛ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ, konɛ a dla ha ni ɔmɛ.
E dla lo enyɔ ɔmɛ hulɔ ha mɛ tsuo.
Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ kukuɔ abolo bibliwi ɔ kɛ lo bibliwi ɔ ngɔ wo kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Nihi nɛ ye ní ɔ, a yibɔ ji nyumuhi akpe enuɔ.
Yesu nyɛɛ pa hɛ mi Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu ha e kaseli ɔmɛ ya sɛ lɛ mi, konɛ a sɛ e hlami kɛ ya Betsaida ngɛ wo ɔ se; lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e maa wo ni ɔmɛ blɔ loko e maa je.
Benɛ e kɛ ni ɔmɛ ye sɛ gbe nya a, e pue nɔ kɛ ho yo ɔ nɔ ya konɛ e ya sɔle.
Benɛ je jɔ ɔ, lɛ ɔ su wo ɔ kpɛti, nɛ Yesu nɔ kake too ngɛ kpo.
E na kaa pɔ tɔ kaseli ɔmɛ wawɛɛ kɛ lɛ ɔ hluimi; ejakaa a ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kpee.
Makɛ mla maa pee ngmlɛ etɛ kɛ yaa a, Yesu nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma a ngɔ; nɛ e ngɛ hlae nɛ e be a he.
Benɛ a na lɛ nɛ e nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, a susu kaa kpade, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa; ejakaa mɛ tsuo a na lɛ, nɛ a tsui po.
Se Yesu kɛ mɛ tu munyu amlɔ nɔuu; e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko je fɔ̃; imi; nyɛ ko ye gbeye!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ba a ngɔ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi; nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ jɔɔ fiami.
Kaseli ɔmɛ a nya kpɛ a he nitsɛnitsɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa; ejakaa ní kasemi nɛ ngɛ abolo ɔ he ɔ, a kɔ we se, nɛ a juɛmi sui he.
Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ Genesaret A po wo ɔ, nɛ a ba kple ngɛ Genesaret zugba a nɔ; nɛ a muɔ lɛ ɔ si.
Benɛ a je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, amlɔ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ yo Yesu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tu fo kɛ ya kpa lejɛ ɔ kpokpa a tsuo nɔ, nɛ he tsuaa he nɛ a maa nu kaa e ngɛ kɛkɛ a ngɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ sa nɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ.
He tsuaa he nɛ Yesu ya a, kɔpe mi jio, ma mi jio, ngmɔ si jio, a kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ ba pueɔ ma nɔ, nɛ a kpaa lɛ pɛɛ konɛ e ha nɛ a ta e tade ɔ nya kɛkɛ he; nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ ta he ɔ na he wami.
Blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmihi Farisi bi komɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ nɛ je Yerusalem ba Yesu ngɔ.
A na kaa e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ngɛ a he blee ejakaa a fɔ we a dɛ loko a yeɔ ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ yi wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a blema tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngɔɔ a dɛ nɛ sɛ mu kɛ yeɔ ní ɔ?” Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yesaya gba ngɛ nyɛ osatotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ he ɔ ngɛ mi sisiisi kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ke, ‘Ma nɛ ɔ, a nya kɛkɛ a kɛ puaa imi Mawu ɔ, se a tsui lɛɛ e ngɛ se lokoo.
Yaka gu a ke a ngɛ mi jae; nimli adesahi a mlaahi mohu a tsɔɔ!’ “Nyɛ ngmɛɛ Mawu mlaa a he nɛ nyɛ pɛtɛ adesa mlaa mohu he.” Jehanɛ Yesu de mɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ pee saminya kaa nyɛ kua Mawu mlaa a, konɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ blema tsɔɔmi ɔ nɔ!
Ejakaa Mose de ke, ‘Bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ;’ nɛ e de hulɔ ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ gbiɛɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ!’ Se nyɛɛ lɛ nyɛ ke, ke nɔ ko de e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ke, Nɔ́ nɛ jinɛ o ko na kɛ je ye dɛ mi ɔ pee ‘Korban’, aloo a kɛ ke Mawu ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ha we nɛ e pee nɔ́ ko kulaa ha e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ hu.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ blema tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ ɔ gu Mawu munyu ɔ. Níhi babauu nɛ ngɛ kaa enɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ peeɔ.” Níhi nɛ bleɔ nɔmlɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu tsɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ ekohu, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ bu mi tue saminya, konɛ nyɛɛ nu sisi.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ jeɔ kpo nɔ blɔ sɛɔ nɔmlɔ mi nɛ ma nyɛ lɛ ma ble; nɔ́ nɛ bleɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, nɔ ɔ mi e jeɔ.” [ Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e nu.]
Benɛ e je ni ɔmɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba we mi ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ abɛ ɔ sisi.
E de mɛ ke, “Anɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ nui nɔ sisi!
Nyɛ nɛ́ kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ kpo nɔ blɔ sɛɔ nɔmlɔ mi ɔ nyɛ we lɛ blemi, ejakaa tsa pi e tsui mi nɛ e sɛɔ, se mohu e muklii mi nɔ́ ɔ yaa, nɛ e ya jeɔ lɛ pueɔ he.” Yesu de enɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa ngma tsuaa ngma he tsɔ.
E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ nɔmlɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ bleɔ lɛ.
Ejakaa nɔmlɔ tsui mi tɔɔ nɛ juɛmi yayami nɛ ɔmɛ jeɔ: nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi, jumi, nɔ gbemi, gba puɛmi, hɛkɔ, yi wu tso ní peemi, nɔ sisimi, yahomi, ninyɛ, nɔ biɛ puɛmi, he nɔ womi, kuasiahi a sane yemi.
Ní yaya nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, nɔmlɔ mi mi je a jeɔ, nɛ a bleɔ nɔmlɔ.” Yo ko hemi kɛ yemi Jehanɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Tiro kɛ Sidon ní ɔmɛ a mi ya.
E ya sɛ we ko mi, nɛ e sume kaa nɔ ko nɛ le kaa e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; se e nyɛ we e he nɛ e laa.
Yesu lejɛ ɔ sumi nɔuu kɛkɛ nɛ yo ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e biyo wayoo ko mi nu e he, nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya.
Yo nɛ ɔ, Hela no ji lɛ, nɛ he nɛ e je ji Foinike ngɛ Siria.
E ba kpa Yesu pɛɛ nɛ́ e hia mumi yayami ɔ kɛ je e biyo ɔ mi.
Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ha bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a tɔ lolo.
E dɛ kaa a ngɔɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ a we abolo sakee pueɔ si ha gbehi.” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e ngɛ mi ja mohu, se tse gbehi nɛ ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ sisi ɔ hu yeɔ bibliwi nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ ye piɛ ɔ eko!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o de nɛ ɔ he ɔ, yaa!
Mumi yayami ɔ je o biyo ɔ mi.” Yo ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho we mi ya, nɛ e ya na e biyo ɔ nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ sa nɔ nɛ́ mumi yayami ɔ je e mi.
Yesu tsa amuɛti tue kpokutsɛ ko Yesu kpale e se kɛ je Tiro ní ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ ya gu Sidon kɛ ya su Ma Nyɔngma amɛ a mi, kɛ ba Galilea wo ɔ nya.
Ni komɛ kɛ tue kpokutsɛ ko nɛ amuɛti hu ji lɛ ba e ngɔ; nɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ konɛ e ngɔ e ninehi ngɔ pue e nɔ.
Yesu kɛ lɛ je ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ya se, nɛ e kɛ e nine nguɛhi wo e tue puɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e su lada kɛ sa nyumu ɔ lilɛ he.
Jehanɛ Yesu hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e fa huu, nɛ e de amuɛti tue kpokutsɛ ɔ ke, “Hefata”.
E sisi ji, “Bli!” Amlɔ ɔ, e tue ɔ bli, nɛ e lilɛ kpa a pɛne, nɛ e tu munyu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yesu de mɛ ke a ko sɛɛ ha nɔ ko nɔ ko kɔkɔɔkɔ; se si abɔ nɛ e ngɛ mɛ dee ke a ko wo nɔ ta a, si abɔ nɛ a ngɛ sɛɛe ha nihi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ni ɔmɛ a nya kpɛ a he nitsɛnitsɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ saminya!
E haa tue kpokutsɛmɛ nuɔ nɔ́, nɛ amuɛtihi hu tuɔ munyu!”
Yesu ha nimli akpe eywiɛ niye ní Pee se ɔ, nihi babauu ba bua a he nya ekohu.
A nɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe ngɛ nimli kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ a he, ejakaa a kɛ mi hi si ligbi etɛ sɔuu, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa ye.
Ke i ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a kɛ mi mi hwɔ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa we mi ɔ, klibi ma ya po mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa a ti ni komɛ je hehi nɛ kɛ.” E kaseli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Jije nɔ ko ma ná niye ní nɛ maa su nimli kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ nga nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ?” E bi mɛ ke, “Abolo nyɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Kpaago.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nimli kpekpemi ɔ ke a hi si ngɛ zugba.
Jehanɛ Yesu kukuɔ abolo kpaago ɔ, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ konɛ a dla ha ni ɔmɛ.
Nɛ a pee ja.
A ngɛ lo tsɔwi bɔɔ ko hulɔ.
Yesu gbaa nɔ, nɛ e fa ke a dla lɔ ɔ hu ha mɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ye nɛ e tɔ, nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ bua bibliwi nɛ piɛ ɔ nya kɛ wo kusii kpaago mi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Nihi nɛ ye ní ɔ a yibɔ maa pee akpe eywiɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu wo mɛ blɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɔuu e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ sɛ lɛ kɛ ba Dalmanuta ní ɔmɛ a mi.
Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu okadi Farisi bi komɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba bɔni nya sami.
A ka lɛ ke e pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu lɛ ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ.
Se Yesu fa huu ngɛ e mi, nɛ e de ke, “Mɛni he je kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko hlae nɛ a na a?
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, a be kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi ɔmɛ okadi ko hae kɔkɔɔkɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e je a he nɛ e ya sɛ lɛ mi ekohu kɛ ho wo ɔ se ya.
Yesu bɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ Farisi bi kɛ Herode bi a tsɔɔmi he Kaseli ɔmɛ a hɛ je nɔ nɛ a maa hɛɛ niye ní kɛ to dɛ; a hɛɛ we eko ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi, ja abolo bɔbɔɛ kake pɛ.
Yesu bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisi bi a masa a, kɛ Herode masa a he!” A hla mi ngɛ a kpɛti ke, “Be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, abolo nɛ wa hɛɛ we ɔ he je.” Benɛ Yesu nu ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ susue kaa abolo nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ we ɔ he je i de enɛ ɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ kɔ we se, nɛ jehanɛ hu, nyɛ nɛ́ níhi a nya kɛ mwɔɔ?
Anɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ nui nɔ sisi?
Nyɛ ngɛ hɛngmɛ, anɛ nyɛ hyɛ we nɔ?
Nyɛ ngɛ tue hulɔ, anɛ nyɛ nui nɔ́; nɛ nyɛ kaii we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko lo?
Benɛ i ku abolo enuɔ ɔ mi ha nimli akpe enuɔ ɔ, bibliwi kusii nyɛmɛ nyɛ kukuɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.” “Jehanɛ, be nɛ i ku abolo kpaago ɔ mi ha nimli akpe eywiɛ ɔ hu nɛɛ; bibliwi kusii nyɛmɛ nyɛ kukuɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Kpaago.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ nui nɔ́ sisi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?” Yesu tsa hɛ yuyuilɔ ko ngɛ Betsaida Jehanɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba Betsaida; nɛ ni komɛ kɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ko ba e ngɔ, nɛ a kpa lɛ pɛɛ konɛ e ta e he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu nu hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ kɔni si, nɛ e kɛ lɛ je kɔpe ɔ mi.
Yesu su lada pue nyumu ɔ hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ e ninehi ngɔ pue e nɔ; nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “O ngɛ nɔ hyɛe lo?” Nyumu ɔ wo e yi nɔ nɛ e ke, “I ngɛ nimli hyɛe, se a ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe.” Yesu kɛ e nine ha hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ nɔ ekohu.
Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ pã e hɛngmɛ mi; a tsa lɛ, nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ paa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu wo nyumu ɔ blɔ kɛ ho e we mi ya.
E de lɛ ke, “Yaa o we mi tɛɛ; kó gba kɔpe ɔ mi he ko he ko!” Petro ye odase ke Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho mahi nɛ ngɛ Kaisarea Filipi kasa nya a a mi ya.
E bi mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ke, “Kɛ nihi deɔ ngɛ ye he kɛɛ?
A ke mɛnɔ ji mi?” A he nɔ ke, “Ni komɛ deɔ ke, Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ. Ni komɛ deɔ ke Eliya, nɛ ni kpa komɛ hu deɔ ke gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji mo.” Jehanɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ deɔ kɛɛ?
Mɛnɔ ji mi?” Petro he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo ji Kristo ɔ nɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ veveeve ke, “Nyɛ ko sɛɛ sane nɛ ɔ ha nɔ ko nɔ ko.” Yesu tu e we amanehlu kɛ e gbenɔ he munyu Jehanɛ Yesu bɔni e kaseli ɔmɛ ní tsɔɔmi ke, “Ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ na amanehlu babauu, nɛ́ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kua lɛ.
A maa gbe lɛ, nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, e maa te si ekohu.” E tu munyu nɛ ɔ paa.
Enɛ ɔ ha Petro tsɛ lɛ kɛ ya se, nɛ e bɔni lɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi.
Se benɛ Yesu plɛ e he nɛ e na e kaseli ɔmɛ ɔ, e ka Petro hɛ mi ke, “Jee ye nɔ kɛ ya se, mo Satan!
Ejakaa o susuu we Mawu níhi a he, se nimli a níhi a he mohu o susuɔ!” Jehanɛ Yesu tsɛ ni kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e kua e he, nɛ e wo e sɛumi tso ɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛ ye se.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ laa e klaa ngɛ imi, kɛ sane kpakpa a he ɔ, e ma he e yi wami.
Mɛni se nɔmlɔ naa, ke e nine su je ɔ tsuo nɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi kpata a?
Nɔ́ ko be nɛ nɔmlɔ ma ha kɛ kpɔ e wami.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ imi, kɛ ye munyu ɔ, wa he peeɔ lɛ zo ngɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi gba puɛli, kɛ yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lɛ hu e he maa pee Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ zo be mi nɛ e maa ba ngɛ e Tsɛ nyami ɔ mi, kɛ e bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.”
E de mɛ hulɔ ke, “Niinɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke ni komɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ a kpɛti nɛ a be gboe kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa na kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ba kɛ he wami.” Yesu nɔmlɔ tso su tsake Ligbi ekpa se ɔ, Yesu ngɔ Petro, Yakobo, kɛ Yohane; nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya he ko banee ngɛ yo gagaa ko nɔ.
A ngɛ lɛ hyɛe nɔuu nɛ e nɔmlɔ tso su tsake.
E tade ɔmɛ kpɛ nɛ a hiɛ futafuta bɔ nɛ níhi a he fɔlɔ ko be je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ma nyɛ ha a hiɛ ja.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliya kɛ Mose je a he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ nɛ a kɛ Yesu ngɛ munyu tue.
Petro de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, e hi kaa wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. Ha waa ma bo tsu etɛ, o nɔ kake, Mose nɔ kake, kɛ Eliya nɔ kake.” Se e li nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, ejakaa a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Amlɔ ɔ, bɔku ko ba ha a nɔ, nɛ gbi ko je bɔku ɔ mi de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji ye bi nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya a nɛ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a hyɛ a he kɛ kpe, se a nɛ́ nɔ kpa ko hu, ja a kɛ Yesu kɛkɛ.
Benɛ a ngɛ yo ɔ kplee ɔ, Yesu de mɛ veveeve ke, “Nyɛ ko sɛɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ na a ha nɔ ko, ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ te si kɛ je gbeje lolo.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ munyu ɔ ngɔ to a yi mi lɛɛ, se a bi a he ke, “Si temi kɛ gbeje jemi ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ?” A bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ deɔ ke ja Eliya ba lolo ɔ?” E ha mɛ heto ke, “Niinɛ, Eliya maa sɛ hlami kɛ ba nɛ e ba to níhi tsuo blɔ nɔ ekohu.
Se mɛni he je a ngma ngɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ he ke e maa na amanehlu babauu, nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ a bui lɛ ɔ?
Nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa Eliya ba momo, nɛ a pee lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ e he ɔ.” Yesu tsa jokuɛ nyumuyo ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi Benɛ a kpale ba na kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ba na nihi babauu nɛ ba bu a nɔ, nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ níhi a mi hlae.
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ na Yesu ɔ, e pee mɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ a sa fo kɛ ba e ngɔ ba fɔ lɛ.
Yesu bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni mi nyɛɛ kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, i kɛ ye binyumu ba o ngɔ, ejakaa mumi yayami ngɛ e mi, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e tu munyu.
He tsuaa he nɛ e maa nu lɛ ngɛ ɔ, e tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ fiaa si; e nya mi fiaa hwɔli, nɛ e kpeɔ e lungu nya, nɛ e luaa gaganii.
I de o kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ a hia mumi ɔ kɛ je e mi ɔ, a nyɛ we.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi nɛ nyɛ he we Mawu yi!
Mɛni be i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si?
Mɛni be ma to ye tsui si ha nyɛ kɛ ya su?
Nyɛɛ ngɔ jokuɛ nyumuyo ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ.” Nɛ a pee ja.
Benɛ mumi ɔ na Yesu ɔ, amlɔ ɔ, e ha jokuɛ ɔ lua gaganii, nɛ e nɔ si.
E kɛ e he wuwlua si, nɛ e nya mi fia hwɔli.
Yesu bi e tsɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni be enɛ ɔ bɔni lɛ peemi?” E de lɛ ke, “Kɛ je e jokuɛ mi tɔɔ.
Ke pee ɔ, e sakee lɛ fɔɔ la mi, kɛ nyu mi hulɔ, konɛ e tane e yi.
Se ke o ma nyɛ pee he nɔ́ ko ha wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “O ngɛ dee ke, Ke o ma nyɛ, pi jã a?
A ma nyɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ha nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ!” Amlɔ ɔ, bitsɛ ɔ kpa ngmlaa kɛ de ke, “I heɔ yeɔ, se ye hemi kɛ yemi ɔ pi.
Piɛ he ha mi!” Benɛ Yesu na kaa nihi babauu sa fo kɛ ma e ngɔ ɔ, e ke mumi ɔ yi nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo amuɛti kɛ tue kpoku mumi, i ngɛ mo fae ke, jee e mi, nɛ o ko sɛ e mi hu!” Mumi ɔ kpa ngmlaa, nɛ e ha jokuɛ ɔ lua gaganii, nɛ e je e mi.
Jokuɛ ɔ pee kaa nɔ gbogboe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ nihi babauu de ji, “Jokuɛ ɔ gbo.” Se Yesu nu e nine si, nɛ e wo e nɔ, nɛ e te da si.
Benɛ Yesu ba we mi ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ zaa ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nyɛ we mumi ɔ nɛ waa hia a?” E de mɛ ke, “Kikɛmɛ a mumi nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nyɛ we lɛ hiami, ja sɔlemi.” Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu ekohu Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ya gu Galilea.
E sume kaa nɔ ko nɛ le he nɛ e ngɛ, ejakaa e ngɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ní tsɔɔe.
E de mɛ ke, “A maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ wo adesahi a dɛ mi, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ.
Se ke a gbe lɛ ɔ, ligbi etɛ se ɔ, e maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.” Se a nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ e de nɛ ɔ nya, nɛ a ngɛ gbeye yee hulɔ kaa a ma bi lɛ.
Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ ngua pe kulaa?
Jehanɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba Kapernaum; nɛ benɛ a ba su we mi ɔ, Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni mi nyɛ ngɛ hlae ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ?” Se a pɛ̃ nya mi, ejakaa benɛ a ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ma a, a hla mi ngɛ a kpɛti kaa mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ ngua pe kulaa.
Yesu hi si nɛ e tsɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nɔ ko ngɛ hlae nɛ e hi kekle blɔ he ɔ, e pee e he nihi tsuo a sekpɛlɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo a tsɔlɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ jokuɛ wayoo ko kɛ ba da ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e wo lɛ ngɛ e kɔni bɔkɔ mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ jokuɛyo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, imi e he ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ mi ɔ, pi imi kɛkɛ nɛ e he, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hulɔ.” Nɔ nɛ ti si wui wɔ ɔ, e piɛ wa he Yohane de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa na nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ o biɛ ngɛ mumi yayami hiae, nɛ wa tsi lɛ blɔ, ejakaa e piɛ we wa he kɛ nyɛɛ o se.” Se Yesu ke, “Nyɛ ko tsi lɛ blɔ, ejakaa nɔ ko be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ ye biɛ ma tsu nyakpɛ ní nɛ amlɔ nɔuu ɔ e maa tu ye he munyu yayami.
Nɔ nɛ ti si wui wɔ ɔ, e piɛ wa he.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyu nɛ nyɛ maa nu ngɛ imi Kristo ɔ ye he ɔ, hiɔwo kpakpa be lɛ bɔe.
Kahi “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ha jokuɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake maa pee yayami ɔ, afani nɛ a kɛ teji wɛ muɔ e kuɛ, nɛ a ya sake lɛ fɔ wo mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o nine haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, poo; afani nɛ o kɛ nine kake sɛ wami mi pe nɛ o kɛ nine enyɔ maa ya Abosiami a je la a nɛ gbo we gblegbleegble ɔ mi.
[ Lejɛ ɔ, ‘gɔgɔ nɛ yeɔ mɛ, kɛ la nɛ sãã mɛ ɔ gbo we gblegbleegble.’] Ke o nane haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, poo; afani nɛ o kɛ nane kake sɛ wami mi pe nɛ o hɛɛ nane enyɔ nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ Abosiami a je la a mi.
[ Lejɛ ɔ, ‘gɔgɔ nɛ yeɔ mɛ, kɛ la nɛ sãã mɛ ɔ gbo we gblegbleegble.’] Ke o hɛngmɛ kake haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, hiaa nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he; afani nɛ o kɛ hɛngmɛ kake sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi pe nɛ o hɛɛ hɛngmɛ enyɔ nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ Abosiami a je la a mi.
Lejɛ ɔ, ‘gɔgɔ nɛ yeɔ mɛ, kɛ la nɛ sãã mɛ ɔ gbo we gblegbleegble.’ “A kɛ la maa tsu nɔ tsuaa nɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ ngo tsuu bɔ nɛ a sã he ɔ.
“Ngo hi, se ke ngo nya nyu gbo ɔ, kɛ a maa pee lɛ kɛɛ nɛ e maa doo ekohu?
Nyɛ ha nɛ ngo su kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ hi nyɛ mi, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.”
Gba mi pomi he ní tsɔɔmi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu si lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Yudea ní ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ Yordan pa a se ya.
Nihi babauu ba bu e nɔ ekohu, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ ní kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ. Farisi bi komɛ ba e ngɔ ba hla e yi mi.
A bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ wa mlaa a ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa nyumu fieɔ e yo lo?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni mlaa Mose wo nyɛ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Mose ngmɛ blɔ kaa ke nɔ ko maa fie e yo ɔ, e ngma fiemi womi, nɛ e wo lɛ blɔ.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Mose ngma mlaa nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ tue wa.
Se kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ, ‘Sisije ɔ, nyumu kɛ yo Mawu bɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a maa pee nɔ kake.’ Lɛɛ jehanɛ ɔ, a pi ni enyɔ hu, se nɔ kake.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɔ tsa a, nɔmlɔ kó gba mi.” Benɛ a kpale kɛ ba we mi ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ munyu ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ he ekohu.
E de mɛ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fieɔ e yo nɛ e ya ngɔɔ nɔ kpa a, e puɛ gba, ejakaa e pee yayami kɛ si e kekle yo ɔ. Yo nɛ kuaa e huno nɛ e ya gbaa nɔ kpa a, e puɛ gba ja nɔuu, ejakaa e pee yayami kɛ si e kekle huno ɔ.” Yesu gbaa jokuɛwi komɛ Ni komɛ ngɔ jokuɛ tsɔwi kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ konɛ e ngɔ ninehi ngɔ pue a nɔ; se e kaseli ɔmɛ kuɛ wo mɛ.
Benɛ Yesu na a, e tsui fia, nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha jokuɛwi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ye ngɔ; nyɛ ko tsi mɛ blɔ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he we Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jokuɛ nyafii maa pee ɔ, e be mi sɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo jokuɛwi ɔmɛ ngɛ e kɔni bɔkɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ e ninehi ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ e gbaa mɛ.
Nyumu niatsɛ ɔ Benɛ Yesu je kpo kɛ ma blɔ ɔ nɔ ekohu ɔ, nyumu ko sa fo kɛ ba na lɛ.
E ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni ma pee nɛ ma ná neneene wami?” Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ mi tsɛe ke nɔ kpakpa?
Nɔ kpakpa ko be kaa ja Mawu pɛ.
Tse o le mlaa amɛ: ‘Koo gbe nɔmlɔ; ko puɛ gba; koo ju; koo ye lakpa odase; koo sisi nɔ; bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ!’ ” Se nyumu ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, i ye enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si.” Yesu hyɛ lɛ too nɛ e suɔ lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de lɛ ke, “E piɛ mo nɔ kake.
Yaa nɛ o ya jua níhi tsuo nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, nɛ o dla sika a ha ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ o ba nyɛɛ ye se.” Benɛ nyumu ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e hɛ mi tsake, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho kɛ aywilɛho, ejakaa e ngɛ ní babauu.
Yesu hyɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ e wa ha niatsɛmɛ kaa a maa ba Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi!” Nɛ e de kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ a he mi po.
Se Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke “Ye bimɛ, tse nyɛ na bɔ nɛ e wa ha nɔ ko nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ sika nɔ kaa e maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
E wa ha niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi pe kaa afukpɔngɔ maa gu abui hɛngmɛ mi.” Benɛ e de kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ a he mi po saminya, nɛ a bi a he ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ yi wami a ma nyɛ he mɔ?” Yesu hyɛ a hɛ mi too nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nimli a blɔ fa mi ɔ, a be nyɛe maa pee, ja ngɛ Mawu blɔ fa mi; ejakaa Mawu blɔ fa mi lɛɛ a nyɛɔ níhi tsuo peeɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro je nya ke, “Hyɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa si wa níhi tsuo nɛ wa ba nyɛɛ o se.” Yesu de mɛ jehanɛ ke, “Niinɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ si e we, loo nyɛminyumuhi, loo nyɛmiyihi, loo nyɛ, loo tsɛ, loo bimɛ, loo zugba ngɛ imi, kɛ sane kpakpa a wa he ɔ, e nine maa su babauu nɔ ngɛ be nɛ ɔ mi.
E ma na ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ bɔ he totoe lafa: we, nyɛminyumuhi, nyɛmiyihi, nyɛmɛ, bimɛ, zugba, kɛ yi wami hulɔ; nɛ e nine maa su neneene wami nɔ ngɛ je nɛ maa ba a mi.
Kekletsɛmɛ fuu ma ba pee sekpɛli, nɛ sekpɛli ma ba pee kekletsɛmɛ.” Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu si etɛne Jehanɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem, nɛ Yesu nyɛɛ a hɛ mi.
Kaseli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa, nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ, gbeye nu mɛ.
Yesu ngɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ya se ekohu, nɛ e bɔni mɛ níhi nɛ maa ba e nɔ ɔ demi ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue; wa yaa Yerusalem, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ wo osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
A maa bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ma je li ɔmɛ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ maa ye e he fɛu, nɛ a maa la lada ngɔ pue e nɔ.
A maa fia lɛ kplibi, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ; se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, e maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.” Yakobo kɛ Yohane bi nɔ́ ko Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa ma bi mo nɔ́ ko nɛ o pee ha wɔ.” E bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha nyɛ?” A de lɛ ke, “Ke benɛ o hii si ngɛ o nyami sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, ha nɛ wa ti nɔ kake nɛ hi o hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake nɛ hi o muɔ nɔ.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ li nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bie ɔ. Amanehlu kplu nɛ ma nu ɔ, anɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ nu lo?
Nɔ sɔlemi nɛ a kɛ maa sɔle mi ɔ, anɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ lo!” A he nɔ ke, “Wa ma nyɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke, “Kplu nɛ ma nu ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa nu, nɛ nɔ sɔlemi nɛ a kɛ maa sɔle mi ɔ, a kɛ maa sɔle nyɛ hulɔ lɛɛ, se ye hiɔ nɔ, kɛ ye muɔ nɔ himi ɔ, pi ye nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ haa, se mohu nihi nɛ a dla to ɔ a nɔ́.” Benɛ ni nyɔngma amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ nu ɔ, a mi mi fu Yakobo kɛ Yohane.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu tsɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ngɛ he wami saminya nɛ a kɛ yeɔ ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ wawɛɛ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ blɔ be jã.
Mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa nɛ e pee nɔmlɔ ngua ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e pee e he nyɛ tsɔlɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ hlaa nɛ e pee e he nɔkɔtɔma a, e pee e he nyɛ tsuo nyɛ sɔmɔlɔ.
Ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ tete bɛ nɛ a sɔmɔlɔ lɛ, se mohu e ba sɔmɔ, nɛ́ e ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha kɛ kpɔ nihi babauu.” Yesu tsa Bartimeo hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ Jehanɛ a ba su Yeriko, nɛ benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma kpekpemi nihi babauu je lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, a na Timeo bi Bartimeo hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ tue ngɛ nɔ́ bae.
Benɛ e nu kaa Yesu Nazaret no ɔ lɛ bee ɔ, e bɔni ngmlaa kpami ke, “Yesu, David bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Nihi fuu nga e yi ke e pee kɔ.
Se e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ mohu pe kekle ɔ ke, “David bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Yesu da si, nɛ e ke, “Nyɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛ ba!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Na tsui; tee si, e ngɛ mo tsɛe!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e sake e tade klɔii ɔ ngɔ fɔ he; e te si pam; nɛ e ba Yesu ngɔ.
Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha mo?” Hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ha ma hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yaa, o hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo!” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi, nɛ e kɛ Yesu ho.
Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi Benɛ a ba su Oliv yo ɔ he, kɛ ma Betfage kɛ Betania kasa nya, nɛ a kɛ maa sɛ Yerusalem ma a mi ɔ, Yesu tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ kɛ sɛ hlami.
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya kɔpe nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi haa nɛ ɔ mi.
Nyɛɛ maa na teji bi nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hí nɔ hyɛ nɛ a muɔ lɛ si.
Nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ kɛ ba.
Ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ ke, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ teji ɔ pɛnee ɔ, nyɛ de lɛ ke e he ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hiae, se e be kɛe nɛ e maa kpale lɛ kɛ ba.” A pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya na teji bi ko nɛ a muɔ si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya ngɛ blohu ɔ mi.
Benɛ a ngɛ lɛ pɛnee ɔ, nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ?
Teji bi ɔ nyɛ ngɛ pɛnee ɔ?” A he nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke a de ɔ; nɛ a ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a kɛ lohwe ɔ ho.
Benɛ a ngɔ teji ɔ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a ngɔ tadehi ngɔ pue e nɔ, nɛ Yesu kuɔ nɛ ɛ hi nɔ.
Nihi babauu kɛ a tadehi ha blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Ni komɛ hu po tso kɔnihi kɛ je pu mi nɛ a kɛ pue blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ tsuo hwɔ lele ke, “Mo kpɔ wɔ!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ!
A gbaa wa tsɛ David matsɛ yemi nɛ ma a!
Mo kpɔ wɔ!
Mo Hiɔwe No!” Yesu sɛ Yerusalem ma a mi, nɛ e ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e hyɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ kpe, se akɛnɛ je bɔni jɔmi ɔ, e kɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ je kɛ ho Betania ya.
Yesu gbiɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ E nɔ jena benɛ a je Betania kɛ ma a, hwɔ bɔni Yesu yemi.
E na ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ba ngɛ nɔ butuu ngɛ lokoo, nɛ e ho ya hyɛ kaa alini e ma ná nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɔ lo.
Se benɛ e su he ɔ, e nɛ́ nɔ́ ja nɔ́ ko pe ba kɛkɛ, ejakaa ngmɔkɔ womi be sui lolo.
Yesu de ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ ke, “Nɔ ko nɔ ko be o yiblii yee hu gblegbleegble!” E kaseli ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ. Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ Benɛ a su Yerusalem ɔ, Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e bɔni nihi nɛ ngɛ ní juae, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ní hee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ fiemi.
E sake sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lahuɛ juae ɔ a sɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si.
E ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ tloo nɔ́ ko kɛ gu sɔlemi we ɔ. E tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ke, “A ngma ke, ‘Ye we ɔ, a ma tsɛ lɛ je ɔ tsuo sɔlemi we’.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ pee ojo fiali a laami he!” Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bɔni hlami bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a kpata e hɛ mi.
Se a ngɛ lɛ gbeye yee, ejakaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ mɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a he mi po.
Benɛ du bu ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ je ma a mi.
Ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he ní kasemi Mɔtu mla benɛ a kpale kɛ bee ɔ, a na kaa ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ ngla kɛ je hiɔwe ba ma si.
Petro kai nɔ́ nɛ ba a, nɛ e de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, hyɛ, ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ nɛ o gbiɛ ɔ ngla!” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ he Mawu ye!
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma de yo nɛ ɔ ke e hia nɛ e ya nɔ womi, nɛ e ji nɔ́, se mohu e heɔ yeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ maa ba mi ɔ, e maa ba mi niinɛ ha lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee, nɛ nyɛ bi ke a pee nɔ́ ko ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he ye; kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bi ɔ, a maa pee ha nyɛ.
Nɛ ke nyɛ ngɛ kue fae nɛ nyɛ susu kaa nɔ ko tɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kɛ pa lɛ, kɛkɛ nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hu kɛ nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ maa pa nyɛ.
[ “Se ke nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kɛ pɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hu kɛ nyɛ tɔmi be nyɛ pae.”] He blɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ A kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem ekohu.
Benɛ Yesu ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he blɔ o ngɛ nɛ o kɛ peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ?
Mɛnɔ ha mo jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Imi hu ma bi nyɛ munyu kake pɛ nɛ nyɛ ha mi heto, kɛkɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ he blɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ i kɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
He wami nɛ Yohane kɛ sɔlee nɔ ɔ, Mawu lɛ ha lɛ, aloo adesa?” Mɛ sɔuu a hlami ngɛ a kpɛti ke, “Kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Ke wa de ke Mawu lɛ ha lɛ ɔ, e ma bi wɔ ke, ‘Mɛni he je nyɛ he we lɛ yi mɔ?’ ” Se akɛnɛ ma a tsuo he ye kaa Yohane ɔ, gbalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, a ye ma a gbeye kaa a ma de ke adesa dɛ mi e je.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a he nɔ ke, “Wa li.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Lɛɛ imi hu nɔ nɛ ha mi he blɔ nɛ i kɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i be nyɛ tsɔɔe.”
Wai ngmɔ ɔ mi apaa yeli ɔmɛ a he abɛ Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu ngɛ abɛhi a mi ke, “Nyumu ko pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ e du tso tsɔwi kɛ po piɛ kɛ bɔle lɛ.
E tsua wai tɛ muɔ, nɛ e ma buli a mɔ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi.
E ngɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ kɛ ha apaa yeli, kɛkɛ nɛ e doma.
Benɛ be su ha wai yiblii nya buami ɔ, e tsɔ tsɔlɔ kɛ ya apaa yeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, konɛ e ya ngɔ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ba.
Se apaa yeli ɔmɛ nu tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ a fia lɛ ní, nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ e dɛ gu.
Ngmɔtsɛ ɔ kpale tsɔ nɔ kpa apaa yeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Se a ywia e yi, nɛ a pue e hɛ mi si.
Jehanɛ ngmɔtsɛ ɔ tsɔ nɔ kpa ko ekohu, nɛ lɛɛ a gbe lɛ.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu apaa yeli ɔmɛ pee ni kpa komɛ nɛ e tsɔ ɔ hulɔ; a fiaa ni komɛ kpa, nɛ a gbe ni komɛ.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ binyumu kake too nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya.
Nyagbe ɔ, e tsɔ binyumu nɛ ɔ apaa yeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ke, ‘A ma gbo ye bi ɔ zo.’ Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a de a he ke, ‘Ní yelɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ha waa gbe lɛ, konɛ gbosi ní ɔ nɛ pee wa nɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nu e binyumu ɔ, nɛ a gbe lɛ, nɛ a ya sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ se.” Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Lɛɛ ke ngmɔtsɛ ɔ ba a, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ?
E ma ba kpata apaa yeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ ma ha ni kpahi.
Tse nyɛ kane kikɛmɛ a ngmami nɛ ɔ hyɛ?
‘Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ bui, nɛ a sake fɔ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ plɛ pee kɔ nya tɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi enɛ ɔ je; ke wa hyɛ ɔ, e ngɛ nyakpɛ nitsɛnitsɛ.’ ” Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ pee kaa a maa nu Yesu, ejakaa a le kaa a he nɛ e bu kikɛmɛ a abɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se a ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ gbeye yee; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a si lɛ nɛ a je.
Tó tsumi A tsɔ Farisi bi komɛ kɛ Herode bi komɛ Yesu ngɔ, konɛ a ba bi lɛ munyu nɛ a kɛ wo e nya tso kpɛ.
Benɛ a ba a, a de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ o yi nɔ hɛ mi munyu tumi gbeye, ejakaa o hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi; mohu, bɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa adesa nɛ ba e je mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ o tsɔɔ ngɛ anɔkuale mi.
Anɛ e da blɔ kaa a tsuɔ tó haa Kaisare ɔ, aloo e dɛ?
Wa ha, loo wa ko ha?” Se Yesu na kaa osato a ngɛ pee, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha mɛ heto ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi kae?
Nyɛɛ ngɔ sika nɛ a yeɔ ɔ eko kɛ ba ma hyɛ.” A kɛ ba; nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ foni ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛnɔ biɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ɔ?” A de lɛ ke, “Kaisare ɔ nɔ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ Kaisare ɔ níhi ngɔ ha Kaisare ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu níhi ngɔ ha Mawu.” Nɛ Yesu he pee mɛ nyakpɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Gbogboehi a si temi Jehanɛ Saduki bi nɛ deɔ ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ hu ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose ngma ha wɔ ke, ‘Ke nɔ ko nyɛmi gbo nɛ e si e yo, se e be bi ɔ, e nyɛmi nɛ ngɔ e yo ɔ, nɛ e wo nina ha e nyɛmi nɛ be je mi ɔ.’ Be ko ɔ, nyɛmimɛ kpaago hi si, nɛ nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ yo nɛ e gbo nɛ e si we bi.
Nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ hu ngɔ yo ɔ, nɛ e gbo nɛ lɛ hu e si we bi ngɛ e se.
Nɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ hu ja nɔuu kɛ̃.
Nyɛmimɛ kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ yo ɔ hi si, nɛ a si we bimɛ ngɛ a se.
Mɛ tsuo a se ɔ, yo ɔ hu ba gbo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ ni gbogboehi tsuo maa te si ɔ, nyɛmimɛ kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ yo ɔ, a ti mɛnɔ yo e maa pee?
Ni kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ hi si.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ tɔ!
Nyɛ le nɔ nɛ he je?
Nyɛ li ngmami ɔmɛ, nɛ Mawu he wami ɔ hu nyɛ li.
Ejakaa benɛ a ma tle ni gbogboehi si ɔ, a be yo ngɔe, nɛ a be gbae hulɔ; mohu a maa hi kaa hiɔwe bɔfohi.
Se kaa ni gbogboehi maa te si ekohu ɔ, anɛ nyɛ kane we mio tso ɔ he sane ɔ ngɛ Mose womi ɔ mi?
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ ke Mose ke, ‘Imi ji Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu ɔ nɛ.’ Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu ɔ, pi ni gbogboehi a Mawu, se hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ a Mawu ji lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ tɔ!” Mlaa ngua a Benɛ Yesu kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a mi hlae ɔ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E na kaa Yesu ha mɛ sane ɔ nɛ a bi lɛ ɔ heto saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Mlaa amɛ ɔ, te nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa nɛɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Kekleekle nɔ́ ji, ‘Israel, bu tue!
Nyɔmtsɛ wa Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ.
Suɔ Nyɔmtsɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ o tsui, kɛ o klaa, kɛ o juɛmi, kɛ o he wami tsuo!’ Enyɔne nɛ he hia ji, ‘Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.’ Mlaa ko be nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ.” Mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ de Yesu ke, “Saminya tsɔɔlɔ!
O tu anɔkuale, kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛ ji Mawu, nɛ nɔ kpa ko be, ja lɛ kɛkɛ.
Jehanɛ, e sa kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu kɛ e tsui, kɛ e juɛmi, kɛ e klaa, kɛ e he wami tsuo, nɛ́ e suɔ e nyɛmi nɔmlɔ hu kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Ke o ye mlaa enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, e hi pe sami bɔhi, kɛ bɔhi tsuo nɛ o maa sã ha Mawu.” Benɛ Yesu na kaa e ha lɛ heto ngɛ ní lemi nya a, e de lɛ ke, “O kɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ kpɛti kɛ we kulaa.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ́ kaa e ma bi Yesu munyu ko hu.
Mɛnɔ ji Kristo ɔ?
Benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e bi ke, “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ deɔ ke Kristo ɔ David nina ji lɛ ɔ?
Ejakaa Mumi Klɔuklɔu ha David nitsɛ de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Hii ye hiɔ nɔ kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ wo o nane sisi.” ’ Ke David nitsɛ tsɛɔ lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ Kristo ɔ peeɔ David nina mɔ?” Yesu bɔ kɔkɔ ngɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a he Nihi babauu ba bu Yesu tue kɛ bua jɔmi.
E de mɛ ngɛ e ní tsɔɔmi ɔ mi ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi ngɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a he.
A suɔ nɛ a wo tade klɔii, nɛ nihi nɛ kpla si kɛ nga mɛ ngɛ jua nɔ.
A suɔ nikɔtɔmahi a hi he ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, kɛ ní yemi hehi.
A kpɔɔ yalɔyi a wehi ngɛ a dɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, a peeɔ sɔlemi gagaaga konɛ a kɛ laa a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a tue gblami maa pee gbeye.” Yalɔyo ko tsu tó Benɛ Yesu ya hi si ngɛ tó tsumi he ɔ, e hyɛ bɔ nɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ sika ngɛ daka a mi woe ɔ. Niatsɛmɛ babauu kɛ sika ba wo mi bɔ nɛ sa.
Yalɔyo ko hu ba, nɛ lɛɛ e ngɔ sika nɛ a yeɔ ɔ mi nyafii pe kulaa enyɔ pɛ kɛ ba wo mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ́ nɛ kikɛmɛ a yalɔyo ohiatsɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ba wo daka a mi ɔ hiɛ kulaa pe nɔ́ nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba wo mi ɔ. Ejakaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a ná nɛ be nɔ ɔ eko a kɛ ba wo mi, se yo nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e we ohia mi ní tsuo e kɛ ba wo mi ɔ nɛ.”
Yesu gba ke a ma ba kpata sɔlemi we ɔ hɛ mi Benɛ Yesu ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, hyɛ, tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kle loo, nɛ tsu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ma a hu ngɛ fɛu saminya.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “O ngɛ tsu nguangua nɛ ɔmɛ hyɛe?
A be tɛ kake sie ngɛ eko nɔ; a ma tsitsɛɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɔ fia si!” Nyɛ maa na nɔ́, nɛ a maa wa nyɛ yi mi Benɛ Yesu kɛkɛ hii si ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ hanɔ ɔ, Petro, Yakobo, Yohane, kɛ Andrea ba na lɛ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, níhi nɛ o de nɛ ɔ, mɛni be a maa ba mi?
De wɔ!
Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi ɔ, mɛni okadi maa je kpo?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nɔ ko kó mlɔɔ nyɛ!
