Ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nɛ ojo fiali ɔmɛ ya tua lɛ ɔ e nyɛmi?” E he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ na lɛ mɔbɔ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Mo hu yaa nɛ o ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ɔ.” Yesu ya slaa Maria kɛ Marta Benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ yaa ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yesu ba su kɔpe ko mi, nɛ yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marta a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya e we mi.
Marta ngɛ nyɛmiyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Maria.
Maria ba hi si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nane nya, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ tue bue.
Marta hao e he kɛ ní tsumi fuu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ba Yesu ngɔ nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ ye nyɛmi ɔ si ní tsumi ɔ tsuo ngɔ fɔ imi nɔ kake too ye nɔ nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, anɛ e hɛwi mo lo?
Lɛɛ de lɛ nɛ e ba piɛ ye he.” Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Marta, O pee siɛii, nɛ o ngɛ o he haoe ngɛ níhi fuu a he, se nɔ́ kake lɛ hia.
Nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, lɔ ɔ Maria hla a nɛ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be kpɔe ngɛ e dɛ.”
Yesu tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ sɔlemi Ligbi ko ɔ, Yesu ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ he ko, nɛ benɛ e gbe nya a, e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, tsɔɔ wɔ sɔlemi kaa bɔ nɛ Yohane hu tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ ɔ.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, nyɛ de ke, ‘Wa Tsɛ, O biɛ ɔ he nɛ tsɔ; O matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ ba.
Ha wɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ wa daa nya ngma.
Kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ nɛ pa wɔ; ejakaa wɔ hu waa kɛ paa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tɔɔ wa nɔ.
Nɛ ko ha nɛ a ka wɔ.’ ” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ti nɔ kake ya e huɛ ngɔ nyɔ mi kpɛti ya de lɛ ke, ‘Ye huɛ, paa mi abolo etɛ.
Ye huɛ ko nɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ba to mi, nɛ i be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha lɛ nɛ e ye!’ Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘Koo doo ye nya!
A nga sinya a momo, nɛ i kɛ ye bimɛ hwɔ si; i be nyɛe ma te si ba ha mo nɔ́ ko hu.’ Aa, mɛni maa ba?
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke ka e huɛ nɛ ji lɛ ɔ he jinɛ e be si tee nɛ e ha lɛ nɔ́ ko; se akɛnɛ e ngɛ e nya dooe kpamisa he je ɔ, e maa te si kɛ̃, nɛ e ma ha lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛ bi, nɛ a ma ha nyɛ; nyɛ hla, nɛ nyɛ nine maa su nɔ; nyɛ si agbo ɔ, nɛ a ma bli ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ biɔ ɔ, a haa lɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa a, e naa, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma si sinya a, a ma bli ha lɛ.
Tsɛ te nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ ke e bi bi lɛ abolo nɛ e ma ha lɛ tɛ?
Aloo ke e bi lɛ lo, nɛ e maa ngɔ sinɔ ngɔ pee lo ngɔ ha lɛ?
Aloo ke e bi lɛ hlui, nɛ e ma ha lɛ nyingmogblakoto?
Ke nyɛ nimli yayamihi po nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ haa nyɛ bimɛ ní kpakpahi ɔ, nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ lɛɛ e maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ha nihi nɛ biɔ lɛ ɔ kulaa pe kikɛ nɛ ɔ po!” Yesu kɛ Beelzebul Be ko ɔ, Yesu ngɛ mumi yayami nɛ tu we munyu hiae ngɛ nyumu ko mi.
Benɛ mumi yayami ɔ je kpo ɔ, nyumu ɔ bɔni munyu tumi, nɛ nimli babauu ɔ a he mi po.
Se ni ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Beelzebul, mumi yayami ɔmɛ a tsɛ ɔ nɛ e haa Yesu he wami nɛ e kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.” Ni komɛ hu hla kaa a maa ka Yesu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a de lɛ ke, “Moo pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ kaa niinɛ, Mawu he wami nya ní o ngɛ tsue.” Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Ma tsuaa ma nɛ e mi bi gbaa ta kɛ woɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ, jamɛ a ma a ywiaa; we nɛ mi gbami ngɛ mi ɔ, we ɔ ywiaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Satan matsɛ yemi ɔ gba ta ngɔ wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ maa pee kɛ da si kɛɛ?
Nyɛ ke Beelzebul lɛ haa mi he wami nɛ i kɛ hiaa mumi yayamihi.
Yoo, ke Beelzebul lɛ ha mi he wami lɛ i kɛ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hiae ɔ, nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛni a kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ?
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɔuu maa tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ nɔ́ be mi.
Ee, Mawu he wami mohu i kɛ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hiae ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ nyɛ nɔ momo.
“Ke katsɛ ko hɛɛ e dade mi kɛ ngɛ e we he bue ɔ, e níhi tsuo a yi naa wami.
Se ke nɔ nɛ he wa pe lɛ ba tua lɛ, nɛ e ye e nɔ ɔ, e kpɔɔ e ta hwumi níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e dlaa e ju ní ɔ mi.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be ye blɔ fa mi ɔ, e kɛ mi na; nɔ nɛ piɛ we ye he kɛ bua we nya a, e ngɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ fĩae.
Mumi yayami ɔ kpale kɛ ba “Ke mumi yayami je nɔ ko mi ɔ, e ya nyɛɛɔ zugba gbigbli nɔ kɛ hlaa he nɛ e maa jɔɔ e he ngɛ.
Ke e nɛ he ko ɔ, e deɔ e he ke, ‘Ma kpale ye se kɛ ya ye we ɔ mi he nɛ i je ɔ.’ Ke e ba a, e ba naa kaa a bɛɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ a dla mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ, e yaa nɛ e ya ngɔɔ mumi yayami kpahi kpaago nɛ a nya wa pe lɛ nitsɛ kɛ baa, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba hii lejɛ ɔ. Nyagbe ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ si himi ba peeɔ haomi kulaa pe kekle ɔ.” Bua jɔmi nitsɛ Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, yo ko wo e gbi nɔ kɛ je nimli babauu ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ e de ke, “A gbaa yo nɛ fɔ mo, nɛ e lɛ mo ɔ!” Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nuɔ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ɔ mohu!” Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ okadi hlae Benɛ ni ɔmɛ a he ba bɔni hiɛmi fuu ɔ, Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de ke.
“Yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nimli yayamihi ji mɛ!
A ngɛ okadi hlae, se a be mɛ eko hae, kaa ja gbalɔ Yona okadi ɔ. Bɔ nɛ gbalɔ Yona plɛ okadi ha Nineve bi ɔ, ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma plɛ okadi kɛ ha kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ.
Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Sheba manyɛ ɔ maa da si, nɛ e maa ye odase kɛ si yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ejakaa e hia blɔ kɛ je e zugba nɔ tsitsaa kɛ ba bu Matsɛ Salomo nile munyuhi tue.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe Salomo tete.
Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Nineve bi maa da si, nɛ a maa ye odase ngɔ si nyɛ.
Ejakaa benɛ a nu Yona fiɛmi ɔ, a tsake a tsui.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe Yona tete!
Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kane “Nɔ ko su we kane ngɔ mɛ́ kɔkɔɔ mi, loo sowe sisi.
Mohu ɔ, e ngɔɔ kɛ maa kane tso nɔ, konɛ ke nihi ma we ɔ mi ɔ, a na la a. Hɛngmɛ ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kane.
Ke o hɛngmɛ nɔ tsɔ ɔ, e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo kpɛɔ kɛ la; se ke o hɛngmɛ hí ɔ, o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ woɔ diblii.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hyɛ nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ hi, konɛ la nɛ ko plɛ diblii.
Ke o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo mi tsɔ, nɛ he ko he ko wui diblii ɔ, lɛ tsuo ma kpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ kane kpɛɔ nɛ e haa mo la a.” Yesu kã Farisi bi ɔmɛ kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi Benɛ Yesu tu munyu gbe nya a, Farisi no ko tsɛ lɛ ní yemi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ya we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya hi si, konɛ e kɛ lɛ nɛ ye ní ɔ.
Se benɛ Farisi no ɔ na kaa Yesu fɔ we e he loko e maa ye ní ɔ, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, nyɛ Farisi bi, nyɛ fɔɔ nyɛ kplu kɛ kã he, se nyɛ mi lɛɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ ojo fiami, kɛ yi wu tso ní peemi.
Kuasiahi!
Mawu nɛ pee kpo nɔ je ɔ, pi lɛ nɔuu nɛ pee mi mi je ɔ hulɔ ɔ?
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ níhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kplu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ kã amɛ a mi ngɔ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ he ma tsɔ ha nyɛ.
“Nyɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ haa Mawu kowɛ, kɛ pui, kɛ ba slɔɔtohi tsuo mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka, se dami sane yemi, kɛ Mawu suɔmi lɛɛ nyɛ si se.
E sa kaa nyɛ peeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ekpa amɛ hu nyɛ ko si se.
“Nyɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ suɔ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi hehi ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ suɔ hu nɛ nihi nɛ kpla si kɛ nga nyɛ ngɛ jua nɔ.
Musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ ngɛ kaa yɔkɔhi nɛ a tui a he so, nɛ nihi nyɛɛɔ a nɔ nɛ a li.” Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ke o de enɛ ɔ, wɔ lɛ o ngɛ jɛe ɔ nɛ!” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ hu, musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ boɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ pueɔ nihi a konɔ.
Se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ be nyɛ nine nguɛ kake po mi kpae kɛ piɛ a he kɛ tloo tlomi ɔ. Musu tloo nyɛ!
Nyɛ fiaa yɔkɔhi kɛ haa gbali ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbe ɔ. Nyɛ ní peemi níhi tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ ngɔ nyɛ nya; mɛɛ a gbe gbali ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ fia a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu nile ɔ de ke, ‘Ma tsɔ gbali, kɛ tsɔli kɛ ya a ngɔ; a maa gbe a ti ni komɛ, nɛ a maa wa a ti ni komɛ yi mi.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbali tsuo nɛ a gbe kɛ je je mi sisije ɔ, a ma bi a muɔ si ngɛ yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ dɛ.
Kɛ je Habel nɔ kɛ yaa su Zakaria nɛ a gbe ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ a kpɛti ɔ nɔ ɔ, ee, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a ma bi a muɔ si ngɛ yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ!
“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, musu tloo nyɛ!
Safe nɛ bliɔ sinya nɛ yaa nile we ɔ, nyɛ ngɔ kɛ to; nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa ya hu nyɛ tsiɔ mɛ blɔ!” Benɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ je a hɛ ngɔ pi lɛ.
A bɔni e nya munyu womi babauu, kɛ lɛ dami.
A hlaa kaa a wo e nya tso kpɛ, konɛ e de nɔ́ ko nɛ sɛ́, nɛ a kɛ po e nya.
Yesu bɔ kaseli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ osato peemi he Benɛ nimli akpe abɔ akpe ba bua a he nya, nɛ a ngɛ a sibi a nɔ nae ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ zaa ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a masa a he; a we osato peemi ɔ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ́ ko be nɛ a bu nɔ, nɛ a be kpo jee; nɛ nɔ́ ko hu be nɛ a ngɔ laa, nɛ a be lee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ de ngɛ laami mi ɔ, a maa nu ngɛ magbɛ mi; nɛ munyuhi nɛ nyɛ tu ngɔ wo tue mi zaa ngɛ se tsu mi ɔ, a maa fiɛ ngɛ ma nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye “Ye huɛmɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nihi nɛ gbeɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ ko hu ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.
Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ ye gbeye.
Nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, ejakaa lɛɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ gbee nɔ, nɛ ke e gbe nɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ sakee nɔ ɔ kɛ fɔɔ Abosiami a je la a mi.
“Otoklii enuɔ ɔ, anɛ pi sika nɛ a yes mi nyafii pe kulaa enyɔ kɛkɛ nɛ a juaa mɛ lo?
Se kɛ̃, Mawu hɛ ji otoklii kake po nɔ.
Yi bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi tete po Mawu le lɛ tsuo nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; nyɛ he jua wa kulaa pe otokliihi babauu!
Odase yemi ha Kristo “I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa jaje ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi kaa e ngɛ ye blɔ fa mi ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu maa pee ja ha lɛ ngɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Se nɔ nɛ kuaa mi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu ma kua lɛ ngɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tu munyu kɛ si Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, a kɛ maa pa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ maa tu musu bɔmi munyu kɛ si Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, a kɛ be lɛ pae.
“Ke a ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba kpe he ɔmɛ, loo matsɛmɛ, loo ganɔhi a hɛ mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma plɛ kɛ fa nyɛ he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma de ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ ko hao nyɛ kulaa.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ de ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a mi nɔuu.” Niatsɛ kuasia a he abɛ Nimli kpekpemi ɔ a ti nɔ kake de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, de ye nyɛmi ɔ nɛ e kɛ mi nɛ dla gbosi ní ɔ.” Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Maminyumu, mɛnɔ wo mi kojolɔ, loo ní dlalɔ ha nyɛ?” Jehanɛ ɔ, e de ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko kɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɔ; ejakaa pi ní babauu nɛ adesa na a mi nɛ e wami ngɛ.” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kɛ ni ɔmɛ tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke, “Nyumu niatsɛ ko zugba ba ní babauu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔni susumi ngɛ e yi mi ke, ‘I be he ko nɛ i kɛ ye ngmɔ mi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa to.
Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?’ Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ ma pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma ku ye gba amɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ ma ma nguanguahi, nɛ ma to blɛfo, kɛ ní kpahi ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma de ye klaa ke, o he ngɛ ní loo!
O ngɛ ní babauu nɛ a ngɔ to ha mo jehahi fuu.
Fiɛ o yi nɔ bɔɔ!
Yé ní, nɛ o nu ní, nɛ o na bua jɔmi!’ Se Mawu de lɛ ke, ‘Kuasia!
Nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu i ngɛ o wami ɔ hee ngɛ o dɛ.
Lɛɛ níhi nɛ o bua nya ngɔ to ɔ, mɛnɔ níhi nɛ a maa pee?’ ” Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Nɔ nɛ buaa níhi a nya kɛ haa e he, se e pi niatsɛ ngɛ Mawu níhi a mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ baa e nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye, aloo tade nɛ nyɛ maa wo he susumi nɛ hao nyɛ.
Wami pe ngma, nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hu pe tade.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ kuakualabitehi ha; a du we ní, nɛ a kpa we ní hulɔ; a be nito he, loo blɛfo gba; se Mawu lɛɛ mɛ!
Hyɛ kaa nyɛ he jua wa hluu pe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ nɛ ke e hao e he ɔ, kɛkɛ e ma nyɛ tsɔ e kami nya nine kpɔ mi kami kake.
Ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɔ́ nyafii kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ peemi ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je nyɛ haoɔ nyɛ he ngɛ ní kpa amɛ a he mɔ?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ mɔmɔhi nɛ ngɛ puɛe ha; a tsu we ní, nɛ a kpɛ we tade hulɔ.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, Matsɛ Salomo kɛ e ní babauu ɔ, lɛ tete po e be miaa we kaa mɔmɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake.
Hu, nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ e ngɛ, nɛ hwɔɔ kɛkɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ mi nɛ e ngla a, Mawu lɛ wo lɛ tade saminyayoo ɔ nɛ.
Ke Mawu mia hu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, anɛ e be nyɛ miae hluu pe ja lo?
Nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi pɛ!
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he kulaa; nyɛ ko di nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye, loo nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nu se tsɔ.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se nɛ a dii.
Nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ le kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he hia nyɛ.
Nyɛ hla Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mohu, nɛ a maa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ piɛ he ha nyɛ.
Hiɔwe juetli “Kuu nyafii, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; ejakaa nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ he tsui kaa e maa ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ jua níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ tsuo, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ sika a kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ.
Nyɛ hla sika kpɛɛhi nɛ be momo pee, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ juetli ngɛ hiɔwe he nɛ e be tae ngɛ.
Ejakaa julɔ ko julɔ ko be he sue, nɛ wɔyewɔye hu be nyɛe ma kpata hɛ mi.
He nɛ nyɛ juetli ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nyɛ tsui hu maa hi.
Nyɛɛ pee klaalo be tsuaa be “Nyɛɛ mia, nɛ nyɛɛ pee klaalo; nɛ nyɛ kane ɔmɛ nɛ a hi tsoe kaa nihi nɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ho yo kpeemi ya, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe.
Ke a pee klaalo ɔ, ke e kpale kɛ ba nɛ e ba si sinya pɛ kɛkɛ a bli ha lɛ amlɔ.
Jamɛ a tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ba na mɛ kaa a hwɔ we mahe ɔ, a bua maa jɔ!
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e ma sa bo kɛ wo e mlɛ mi, nɛ e ma ha tsɔli ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ okplɔɔ he, nɛ e ma ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye.
Ke e ba nyɔ mi kpɛti, aloo makɛ tete po, nɛ e ba na mɛ jã a, a gbaa mɛ!
Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa ke wetsɛ ko le ngmlɛfia tutuutu nɛ julɔ ma a, e be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ julɔ ɔ ba sɛ e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ju.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee klaalo, ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba be mi nɛ nyɛ hyɛ we lɛ blɔ.” Tsɔlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, kɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ yi anɔkuale Petro bi Yesu ke, “Abɛ nɛ o bu nɛ ɔ, wa he e kɔɔ, loo ni ɔmɛ tsuo?” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ le ní hulɔ ɔ ngɛ ha.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa hia blɔ, nɛ e toɔ we ɔ ngɔ woɔ e dɛ mi; lɛ nɛ e haa tsɔli kpa amɛ a niye ní ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba nɛ e ma ba na kaa e ngɛ ní tsue kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ!
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa tu e níhi tsuo ngɔ wo jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ e hyɛ nɔ.
Se ke jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ ma de ngɛ e yi mi ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se ma ya fia si bɔɔ, nɛ e be bae mla a, lɛɛ e ma bɔni tsɔli kpa amɛ, kɛ mawayi ɔmɛ kongomi.
E maa ye ní, nɛ e maa nu ní, nɛ e maa tɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa kpale kɛ ba tlukaa ligbi nɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ hyɛ we lɛ blɔ, nɛ́ e hɛ be e he nɔ hulɔ.
E maa gbla jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ tue; e maa poo e mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ sa tue gbolɔ.
“Tsɔlɔ nɛ le nɔ́ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ kaa e pee, se e ti si pam nɛ e pee ɔ, a maa fia lɛ kpa wawɛɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ li, nɛ e ya pee nɔ́ nɛ sa tue gblami ɔ, a maa fia lɛ kpa bɔɔ pɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a ha lɛ fuu ɔ, a ma bi fuu si ngɛ e dɛ; nɔ nɛ a tu nɔ́ nɛ pe ja po ngɔ wo e dɛ mi ɔ, a ma bi fuu si ngɛ e dɛ.
Yesu kɛ mi gbami baa “I ba, konɛ ma ba mɛ je ɔ he la, nɛ i ná nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ je sisi momo!
A maa ngɔ mi kɛ wo amanehlu nɛ nya wa mi, nɛ ye he ngɛ mi hiae kɛ yaa si a maa gbe nya!
Nyɛ susu kaa i ngɔ he jɔmi kɛ ma je ɔ mi lo?
Dɛbi, pi he jɔmi, se mi gbami mohu.
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, we kake mi bi enuɔ a mi ma gba: ni etɛ maa te si ngɔ wo ni enyɔ, nɛ ni enyɔ maa te si ngɔ wo ni etɛ.
Mi gbami maa ba tsɛmɛ kɛ a binyumuhi a kpɛti; nyɛmɛ kɛ a biyihi ma ná, nɛ nganyɛmɛ kɛ nganyɛmɛ hu maa pee ja nɔuu.” Yesu kã nimli kpekpemi ɔ a hɛ mi Yesu de nimli kpekpemi ɔ hu ke, “Ke nyɛ na bɔku nɛ ngɛ e he nya buae ngɛ bonyoku ɔ, amlɔ ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Hiɔmi ma’, nɛ e baa mi ja niinɛ.
Nɛ ke leneyi kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ fiae ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Latsa maa tsa’, nɛ e baa mi ja pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ le je nɛ ɔ mi níhi, kɛ hiɔwe níhi a sisi tsɔɔmi.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ li ɔ?
O kɛ o pɛbilɔ ɔ ya kpata “Mɛni he je nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ?
Ke nɔ ko po o nya, nɛ e ngɔ mo kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ kpata ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Ke pi ja a, e maa sã mo ya ha kojolɔ ɔ, nɛ kojolɔ ɔ hu maa ngɔ mo ha polisi ɔ, nɛ a maa wo mo tsu.
I ngɛ mo dee ke, o maa hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si o maa wo o hiɔ ɔ sisiisi.”
Kpa yayami peemi, nɛ o hɛ mi ko kpata Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, ni komɛ ba lejɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ Yesu ba sɛɛ ní.
A de lɛ bɔ nɛ Pilato ha nɛ a gbe Galilea bi ɔmɛ nɛ ya ngɛ bɔ sãe ha Mawu ɔ. Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ susu kaa blɔ nɔ nɛ Galilea bi nɛ ɔmɛ gu kɛ gbo ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mɛ ji yayami peeli kpanakuhi pe Galilea bi tsuo lo?
Dɛbi!
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ tsakee we nyɛ tsui ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma gbo ja nɔuu.
Ni nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ mɔ ɔ ku pue a nɔ ngɛ Siloam nɛ a gbo ɔ, mɛ nɛɛ?
Anɛ nyɛ susu kaa lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mɛ kɛkɛ ji yayami peeli pe nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ lo?
Dɛbi!
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ tsakee we nyɛ tsui ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma gbo ja nɔuu.” Ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ wui yiblii ɔ he abɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu tu mɛ munyu nɛ ɔ ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke, “Be ko ɔ, nyumu ko du ngmɔkɔ tso ngɛ e wai ngmɔ mi, nɛ e ya, konɛ e ya hla yiblii ngɛ tso ɔ nɔ, se e nɛ eko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de e ngmɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ke, ‘Hyɛ, jeha etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i baa ba hlaa yiblii ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ɔ nɔ, se i nɛ eko.
Poo tso ɔ ngɔ fɔ si!
Mɛni he je nɛ e maa hi zugba a puɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?’ Se ngmɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Ye nyɔmtsɛ, ha nɛ e hi si jeha nɛ ɔ hulɔ; nɛ ma tsua he kɛ be, nɛ ma wo sisi kuku.
Ke e wo yiblii jeha nɛ ma a mi ɔ, saminya.
Se ke e wui ɔ, lɛɛ o ma nyɛ ma ha nɛ a po lɛ ngɔ fɔ si.’ ” Yesu tsa yo ko nɛ kpɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ko ɔ, Yesu ya ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ngɛ kpe he ko.
Yo ko ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ mumi yayami wo lɛ hiɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔuu; lɔ ɔ ji e kpɛ, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e kpãã e mi kulaa.
Benɛ Yesu na lɛ ɔ, e tsɛ lɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yo, i ngɛ mo dee ke o hiɔ ɔ ngmɛɛ o he!” E ngɔ e nine kɛ pue yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, e mi kpã, nɛ e da tlɔmɔɔ, nɛ e je Mawu yi.
Kpe he nɔkɔtɔma a mi mi wo la kaa Yesu tsa nɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ma kpekpemi ɔ ke, “Ligbi ekpa lɛ sa kaa a kɛ tsuɔ ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba jamɛ a be ɔ, konɛ a tsa nyɛ; se pi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ!” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Osatotsɛmɛ!
Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ pɛne we e na, loo e teji Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ji kpo ya ha we lɛ nyu?
Hyɛ, yo nɛ ɔ, Abraham nina ji lɛ, nɛ Satan bɔ lɛ pã jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔuu.
Anɛ e sɛ kaa a jeɔ lɛ ngɛ pã mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ lo?” Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ, zo gbe e he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ ma a lɛɛ a na bua jɔmi ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ a he.
Sinapi wu ɔ he abɛ ɔ Yesu bi ke, “Kɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kɛɛ?
Mɛni he ma ngɔ to?
E ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyumu ko ngɔ sinapi wu ya du ngɛ e ngmɔ mi.
E puɛ, nɛ e pee tso agbo, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba pee a tsu ngɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ a nɔ.” Masa he abɛ ɔ Yesu de hu ke, “Mɛni he ma ngɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ to?
E ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Yo ko ngɔ masa kɛ futu mamu susumi nɔ́ etɛ mi kɛ ya si lɛ tsuo sa.” Agbo tokofii ɔ Benɛ Yesu ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem ɔ, e ya kpa mahi kɛ kɔpehi a mi nɛ e tsɔɔ ní.
Nɔ ko bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, anɛ nihi bɔɔ pɛ a yi wami nɛ a ma he lo?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ sɛ agbo tokofii ɔ mi.
Ejakaa, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nihi babauu ma hla kaa a sɛ mi, se a be nyɛe.
Be ma nɛ wetsɛ ɔ maa te si, nɛ e ma nga sinya a. Kɛkɛ ɔ, benɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ we ɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ma bɔni sinya a simi.
Nyɛ ma de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, bli wɔ oo, bli wɔ!’ Se e ma he nɔ ke, ‘I li he nɛ nyɛ je!’ Nyɛ ma de ekohu ke, ‘Waa kɛ mo lɛ ye ní, nɛ waa kɛ mo lɛ nu ní; o tsɔɔ ní ngɛ wa magbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.’ Se e ma de ekohu ke, ‘I li he nɛ nyɛ je!
Nyɛɛ je ye nɔ, nyɛ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ní yayamihi!’ Nyɛ maa wo yana, nɛ nyɛ ma kpe lungu nya, ke nyɛ na Abraham kɛ Isak, kɛ Yakob, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a tsi nyɛ blɔ!
Nihi maa je beleku, kɛ bonyoku, kɛ omleyi, kɛ leneyi kɛ ba, nɛ a ma ba ye ní ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi nɛ kpɛ se amlɔ nɛ ɔ maa pee kekletsɛmɛ, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye kekle blɔ he amlɔ nɛ ɔ maa pee sekpɛtsɛmɛ.” Yesu suɔ Yerusalem saminya Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Farisi bi komɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Jee hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ho; ejakaa Herode ngɛ mo hlae nɛ e gbe.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de jamɛ a kɔkɔbo ɔ ke, ‘I ngɛ mumi yayamihi hiae, nɛ i ngɛ nihi tsae mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ hwɔɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛne ɔ, ma gbe ye ní tsumi ɔ nya.’ Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e hia kaa ma tsa ye blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ, kɛ hwɔɔ, kɛ hwɔɔ se; ejakaa e sɛ kaa a gbeɔ gbalɔ ngɛ he kpa ko kaa ja Yerusalem.
“Yerusalem Yerusalem!
O gbe gbali ɔmɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ a tsɔ mɛ o ngɔ ɔ, o fia mɛ tɛ!
Hyɛ si abɔ nɛ i hla kaa ma bua o bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nya kaa bɔ nɛ kungwɔ buaa e bimɛ a nya ngɔ woɔ e pɛli sisi; se nyɛ kplɛɛ we!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu maa pee nyɛ ma a ma doku.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛ be mi nae hu kɛ yaa su be nɛ nyɛ ma de ke, ‘A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ!’ ”
Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛ ko Hejɔɔmi ligbi ko ɔ, Yesu ya ye ní ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake we mi, nɛ nihi huɔ Yesu kaa a maa na nɔ́ ko ngɛ e he lo.
Nyumu ko nɛ e ninehi kɛ e nanehi fu ba Yesu ngɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu wo e nya nɔ nɛ e bi mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ wa mlaa a ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa a tsa nɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ lo?” Se a pui e nya mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu pɛtɛ nyumu ɔ he, nɛ e tsa lɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ e ho.
Jehanɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko binyumu, loo e na ya nɔ vu mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, anɛ e be lɛ jee ngɛ vu ɔ mi amlɔ ɔ nɔuu lo?” Se a nyɛ we nɛ a ha lɛ enɛ ɔ heto.
He si bami kɛ nubwɔ peemi Yesu na bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ a kpee kɛ ba a ngɛ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi he hlae ha a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo mɛ ga ke, “Ke nɔ ko kpee yo, nɛ a tsɛ mo kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ ɔ, ko ya hi yimɛ a je.
Eko ɔ, a kpee nɔ ko nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe mo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ kpee nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba, nɛ e ma ba de mo ke, ‘Ha nɔ nɛ ɔ blɔ.’ Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ zo o kɛ ma ya hi nane si je ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke a kpee mo ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya hi nane si je, konɛ ke nɔ nɛ kpee mo ɔ ba a, e ba de mo ke, ‘Ye huɛ, ba yimɛ a je.’ Enɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ o hɛ mi maa ba nyami ngɛ nihi tsuo nɛ o kɛ mɛ hii si ɔ a hɛ mi.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si, nɛ nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a ma wo e nɔ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de nɔ nɛ kpee lɛ ɔ ke, “Ke o tsɛ nihi ní yemi piani, loo gbɔkuɛ ɔ, koo kpee o huɛmɛ, loo o nyɛmimɛ, loo o weku li, loo niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ o paka mi.
Ke o pee ja a, mɛ hu a maa kpee mo; kɛkɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa a wo mo nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he hiɔ.
Ke o ngmɛ okplɔɔ ɔ, tsɛ ohiatsɛmɛ, glɔtsɛmɛ, pɔ̃tsɛmɛ, kɛ hɛ yuyuili mohu; nɛ Mawu maa gbaa mo; ejakaa mɛɛ a be nyɛe maa to mo nane mi.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ ni kpakpa amɛ maa te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, Mawu maa to mo nane mi.” Okplɔɔ nguaa a Benɛ nihi nɛ kɛ Yesu hii si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ a ti nɔ kake nu enɛ ɔ, e de Yesu ke, “Nihi nɛ maa ye ní ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, a gbaa mɛ pɛ!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nyumu ko ngmɛ okplɔɔ nguaa, nɛ e kpee nihi fuu.
Benɛ ní yemi be ɔ su ɔ, e tsɔ nɔ ke e ya de nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ ke, ‘A gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya; nyɛɛ ba!’ Se mɛ tsuo a bɔni a nya jemi kakaaka.
Kekleekle nɔ ɔ de tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, ‘I he zugba ko nɛ ma kɛ pee ngmɔ, nɛ e hia kaa ma ya nɛ ma ya hyɛ; i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o na ha mi!’ Nɔ kpa ke, ‘I he na blablɛ enuɔ, nɛ i yaa ma ya ka mɛ ma hyɛ; i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o na ha mi!’ Nɔ kpa hu je e nya ke, ‘I kpee yo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i be nyɛe ma ya.’ Tsɔlɔ ɔ kpale e se, nɛ e ya bɔ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ amaniɛ.
Wetsɛ ɔ mi mi fu wawɛɛ, nɛ e de tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, ‘Jee kpo esɔ kɛ ya gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ blohu ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ o ya ngɔ ohiatsɛmɛ, glɔtsɛmɛ, hɛ yuyuili, kɛ pɔ̃tsɛmɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.’ E kɛ we nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ kpale ba de lɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o de mi ke ma pee ɔ, i ya pee; se loloolo ɔ, blɔ ngɛ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de tsɔlɔ ɔ ke, ‘Jee kpo kɛ ya blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ blohu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ o nyɛ ni ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a ba hiɛ ɔ, konɛ ye we ɔ mi nɛ hyi tɔ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ, ke a ti nɔ ko sa e nya ye niye ní nɛ ɔ fii!’ ” Kristo kaselɔ peemi Ligbi ko benɛ Yesu kɛ nihi babauu ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, e plɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ba ye ngɔ ɔ, loko e ma nyɛ maa pee ye kaselɔ ɔ, ja e suɔ mi kulaa pe e tsɛ, kɛ e nyɛ, kɛ e yo, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e nyɛminyumuhi, kɛ e nyɛmiyihi, kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he tete.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɛ lɛ nitsɛ e sɛumi tso ngɔ fɔɛ e konɔ kɛ ba nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e be nyɛe maa pee ye kaselɔ.
“Ke nɔ ko ngɛ hlae nɛ e ma mɔ ɔ, kekleekle ɔ, e hii si nɛ e buu nya, nɛ e hyɛɛ kaa e ngɛ sika nɛ maa su nya gbemi lo.
Ke e ya pee we ja, nɛ e je mɔ ɔ mami sisi, nɛ e ya nyɛ we nɛ e gbe nya a, nihi tsuo nɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a maa ye e he fɛu.
A ma de ke, ‘Nyumu nɛ ɔ je mɔ mami sisi, se e nyɛ we nɛ e gbe nya.’ “Ke matsɛ ko, kɛ e ta buli akpe nyɔngma yaa nɛ e kɛ matsɛ kpa, kɛ lɛ hu e ta buli akpe nyingmi enyɔ ya hwu ta a, bɔ nɛ e maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kekleekle ɔ, e maa hi si, nɛ e ma susu e yi mi nɛ e hyɛ kaa e ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ matsɛ kpa a nɛ hwu lo.
Ke e na kaa e be nyɛe ɔ, be mi nɛ matsɛ kake ɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo kɛ ma a, e maa tsɔ nihi ya kpee lɛ.
A kɛ lɛ maa sɛɛ ní, konɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba.” Yesu gbe nya ke, “Jã kɛ̃, ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e pee ye kaselɔ ɔ, ja e si níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ. Ngo nɛ nya nyu gbo “Ngo hi, se ke ngo nya nyu gbo ɔ, nɔ́ ko be nɛ a maa pee nɛ e doo ekohu.
E hí nɛ a kɛ woɔ zu mi kaa kuku tete; pe a tsɛ̃ɛ̃ ngɔ pueɔ he.
Tse nyɛ ngɛ tue!
Saminya!
Lɛɛ nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue!”
To nɛ laa a Ligbi ko benɛ tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli babauu ba Yesu ngɔ nɛ a ba bu lɛ tue ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ bɔni munyu huitihuiti tumi ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ yayami peeli bɔɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ yeɔ ní po.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu kɛ mɛ tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke, “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ to lafa, nɛ́ kake laa a, mɛni e maa pee?
E ma si to nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ e ma ya hla nɔ́ nɛ laa a kɛ yaa si e maa na lɛ.
Ke e na lɛ ɔ, e naa bua jɔmi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔɔ e konɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ baa we mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɛɔ e huɛmɛ, kɛ e paka bi, nɛ e deɔ mɛ ke, ‘I na ye to nɛ laa a; nyɛ ha nɛ wa nya!’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, jã nɔuu lɛ bua jɔmi maa ba hiɔwe, ke yayami peelɔ kake tsake e tsui, pe dali nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ kɛ se, nɛ mɛɛ tsui tsakemi he hia we mɛ.
Sika nɛ laa a “Aloo waa ngɔ lɛ kaa yo ko ngɛ sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma, nɛ kake laa.
Mɛni e maa pee?
E maa su kane, nɛ e maa bɛɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ e ma hla sika a fitsofitso hluu kɛ yaa si e maa na.
Ke e na a, e ma tsɛ e huɛmɛ, kɛ e paka bi, nɛ e ma de mɛ ke, ‘I na ye sika nɛ laa a; nyɛ ha nɛ wa nya!’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, jã nɔuu lɛ Mawu bɔfohi ma nya, ke yayami peelɔ kake tsake e tsui ɔ.” Binyumu nɛ laa a Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyumu ko hi si, nɛ e ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ.
Jokuɛyo ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ, gbosi ní nɛ wa ma na hwɔɔ se ɔ, ha mi ye blɔ fa mi nɔ́ nyɔngloo.’ Nɛ nyumu ɔ dla e ní ɔmɛ a mi ngɔ ha e binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Be bɔɔ se ɔ, jokuɛyo ɔ jua e blɔ fami nɔ́ ɔ tsuo, nɛ e kɛ sika a doma kɛ ho ma se he ko lokoo ya.
Lejɛ ɔ e kɛ je mi bami yaya ya kpata e sika a hɛ mi ngɛ.
Benɛ e dɛ mi ba ta a, hwɔ nɛ nya wa ba te si ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo kɛ hwɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ya ye apaa ha nyumu ko ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyumu ɔ ha e ya lɛ kpotoo ngɛ e ngmɔ si.
E ná yɔ nɛ a haa kpotoo ɔmɛ ɔ eko nɛ e ye jinɛ e ko suɔ; se nɔ ko nɔ ko ha we lɛ.
Benɛ e hɛ mi ba tsɔ lɛ ɔ, e de e he ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ we apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ niye ní babauu nɛ a pee we he nɔ́ ko, nɛ imi lɛɛ i ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ hwɔ miɔ nɛ e maa gbe mi!
Ma te si, nɛ ma ya tsaatsɛ ngɔ, nɛ ma ya de lɛ ke, Tsaatsɛ, i pee yayami kɛ si Mawu, nɛ mo hu i pee mo yayami, nɛ i sɛ kaa a tsɛɔ mi o bi hu; ngɔɔ mi kɛ pee o we apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ e te si, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ yaa e tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
“Se benɛ e nyɛɛ tsitsaa lokoo kɛ ma a, e tsɛ ɔ na lɛ, nɛ e ní pee lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e sa fo kɛ ho ya fua lɛ, nɛ e fiɔ e nya he.
E bi ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ, i pee yayami kɛ si Mawu, nɛ mo hu i pee mo yayami, nɛ i sɛ kaa a tsɛɔ mi o bi hu.’ Se e tsɛ ɔ de sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ ya je tade klɔii saminyayoo ɔ kɛ ba wo lɛ esɔ.
Nyɛɛ wo e nine nguɛ ga, kɛ e nane tokota.
Nyɛ ya ngɔ na bi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba gbe nɛ waa ye ní, nɛ wa na bua jɔmi.
Ejakaa ye binyumu nɛ ɔ gbo, se e kpale ba wami mi ekohu; e laa, se a na lɛ.’ Nɛ a bɔni nyami.
“Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo e bi nɔkɔtɔma a ngɛ ngmɔ mi.
Benɛ e kpale kɛ ma, nɛ e su we ɔ mi ta a, e nu nɛ a ngɛ lae, nɛ a ngɛ do fiɛe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake kɛ ba se, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, ‘Mɛni a ngɛ pee ngɛ we ɔ mi?’ E he nɔ ke, ‘O nyɛmi ɔ ba, nɛ o tsɛ gbe na bi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ; ejakaa e bi ɔ kpale kɛ ba we fiafiaafia.’ “Bi nɔkɔtɔma a mi mi fu wawɛɛ, nɛ e kua we ɔ mi sɛmi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ ɔ je kpo nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, ‘Ye bi, i kpa mo pɛɛ, moo ba kɛkɛ.’ Se e kɛ e tsɛ ɔ tu munyu saminya.
E de lɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ jeha abɔ sɔuu nɛ i sɔmɔ mo kaa nyɔguɛ, i tɔ we o mlaa ko nɔ hyɛ nɛ.
Mɛni o ha mi?
To ku kake tete po o ha we mi, konɛ ma tsɛ ye huɛmɛ, nɛ i kɛ mɛ nɛ nya!
Se o bi nɛ ɔ ya nyɛɛ yi yaholi a se, nɛ e kɛ kpata o weto ní tsuo hɛ mi.
Mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ e kpale kɛ ba a, tse o gbe na bi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ!’ E tsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Ye bi, moo lɛɛ i kɛ mo lɛ ngɛ daa nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, o nɔ́.
Se e sa kaa wa nya, nɛ wa na bua jɔmi, ejakaa o nyɛmi nɛ ɔ gbo, se e kpale ba wami mi ekohu; e laa, se a na lɛ.’ ”
Tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɔ sisilɔ ɔ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyumu niatsɛ ko hi si, nɛ e ngɛ tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ hyɛɛ e níhi a nɔ ha lɛ.
Be ko ɔ, a ba po tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ nya ngɔ ha niatsɛ ɔ ke e ngɛ e ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpatae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, niatsɛ ɔ tsɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ngɛ o he ɔ, e ngɛ mi niinɛ lo?
I be hae nɛ o hyɛ ye ní ɔmɛ a nɔ hu; ní tsumi nɛ i ngɔ kɛ wo o dɛ ɔ, ba bu he akɔtaa.’ Tsɔlɔ ɔ de ngɛ e yi mi ke, ‘Ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma kpɔ ní tsumi ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ; kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?
I be nɔmlɔ tso mi he wami nɛ ma nyɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa ma tsu, nɛ nɔ́ bami hu maa pee mi zo.
Yoo, i le bɔ nɛ ma pee, kɛkɛ ɔ, ke ye ní tsumi ɔ je ye dɛ ɔ, ma na huɛmɛ nɛ ma he mi atuu kɛ to we.’ “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba kakaaka.
E bi kekleekle nɔ ɔ ke, ‘Hiɔ nyɛmɛ o hɛɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ?’ E he nɔ ke, ‘Nu tɔ lafa.’ Tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a de lɛ ke, ‘He o womi ɔ!
Hii si esɔ, nɛ o ngma ke o hɛɛ hiɔ nu tɔ nyingmi enuɔ.’ E bi nɔ kpa hu ke, ‘Mo nɛɛ, hiɔ nyɛmɛ o hɛɛ?’ E ha heto ke, ‘Ngma susumi kotoku lafa.’ Tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a de lɛ ke, ‘He o womi ɔ; ngmaa nyingmi kpaanyɔ.’ “Niatsɛ ɔ je tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɔ sisilɔ ɔ yi saminya kaa e to ga kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, je mi bi a nane nya sɔɔ kɛ nɔ sisimi kulaa pe nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye.” Yesu ya nɔ de ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ja lo?
Ma de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee huɛmɛ kɛ gu sisimi blɔ nɔ lo?
Anɛ enɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma na blɔ kɛ ya sihi he nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ lo?
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ nyafii mi ɔ maa ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ nguaa mi; nɔ nɛ yi anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ nyafii mi ɔ, e be anɔkuale yee ngɛ nɔ́ nguaa mi.
Ke je nɛ ɔ mi ní po nyɛ yi anɔkuale ngɛ mi ɔ, mɛnɔ maa tu ní nami nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi?
Nɛ ke nyɛ yi anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ kpa nɔ́ mi ɔ, mɛnɔ maa ngɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ?
“Sɔmɔlɔ ko be nyɛe ma sɔmɔ nyɔmtsɛmɛ enyɔ; e maa suɔ nɔ kake pe nɔ kake; e maa nyɛ nɔ kake, nɛ e maa suɔ nɔ kake; aloo e maa pee nɔ kake suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nɔ kake ɔ lɛɛ e be lɛ bue fɛɛ.
Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ sika tsuo.” Ní komɛ nɛ Yesu de Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, a ye Yesu he fɛu, ejakaa a suɔ sika.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ peeɔ nyɛ he nimli kpakpahi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi, se Mawu lɛɛ e le nyɛ tsui mi.
Ejakaa níhi nɛ adesa buu kaa a he jua wa a, Mawu hɛ mi lɛɛ a pi nɔ́ ko kulaa.
“Mose mlaa a, kɛ níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma a tsu ní kɛ ya si Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ yi nɔ.
Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ, sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe.
Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e he kɛ ngɛ mi woe kã nya.
E wɛ kaa hiɔwe kɛ zugba maa be kɛ ho, kaa a maa po mlaa a mi ngu kake ngmelu mi.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fieɔ e yo, nɛ e ya ngɔɔ yo kpa a, e puɛ gba; nyumu nɛ ya ngɔɔ yo nɛ e huno fie lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e puɛ gba.
Niatsɛ ɔ kɛ Lazaro “Nyumu niatsɛ ko hi si.
E woɔ kploba tade nɛ ngɛ fɛu, nɛ he jua wa; nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e yeɔ ní kpakpa, nɛ e naa bua jɔmi.
Nyumu ohiatsɛ ko hu hi si kɛ e he pahi fuu bami; nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Lazaro.
Ke pee ɔ, a ngɔɔ lɛ ba fɔɔ niatsɛ ɔ we agbo nya, nɛ e jloɔ lɛ kaa e na bibliwi nɛ jeɔ niatsɛ ɔ we okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ pueɔ si ɔ eko nɛ e ye.
Gbehi po baa ba lɔɔ e pa amɛ nɔ.
“Ohiatsɛ ɔ ba gbo, nɛ bɔfohi ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Abraham mi si ya.
Niatsɛ ɔ hu ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ.
Benɛ e ngɛ haomi nɛ nya wa mi ngɛ gbeje, nɛ e wo e yi nɔ nɛ e maa hyɛ ɔ, Abraham ji nɛ ngɛ lokoo, kɛ Lazaro ngɛ e kasa nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ niatsɛ ɔ kɛ ngmlaa de ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ Abraham lee!
I ngɛ nɔ́ nae tsɔ ngɛ la nɛ ɔ mi!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ oo, naa mi mɔbɔ!
Mao tsɔ Lazaro nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ nya ya sɔ nyu mi, nɛ e kɛ ba jɔɔ ye lilɛ he ha mi oo, i kpa mo pɛɛ!’ “Se Abraham de lɛ ke, ‘Ye bi, kai kaa o wami be mi ɔ, o na ní kpakpahi babauu, be mi nɛ Lazaro lɛɛ e na ní yayahi sɔuu.
Se piɔ lɛɛ e na bua jɔmi, nɛ moo lɛɛ o ngɛ nɔ́ nae.
Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, dɔ nguaa ko ngɛ waa kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, konɛ nɔ ko kó nyɛ nɛ e je wa ngɔ kɛ ya nyɛ ngɔ, loo e je nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ba wa ngɔ.’ Niatsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ Abraham, lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ mɔ; moo tsɔ Lazaro kɛ ya ye tsɛ we ɔ. I ngɛ nyɛmimɛ enuɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ha nɛ e ya bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ, konɛ mɛɛ a ko ba nɔ́ nami he nɛ ɔ.’ “Abraham de lɛ ke, ‘Mose kɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ bu mɛ tue.’ Niatsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ Abraham, dɛbi; ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ be mɛ tue bue.
Se ke nɔ ko je gbeje kɛ ya a ngɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a ma tsake a tsui.’ Se Abraham de lɛ ke, ‘Ke a bui Mose kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tue ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke nɔ ko te si kɛ je gbeje tete po, a yi mi be plɛe.’ ”
Yayami Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Níhi nɛ haa nɔ nane kpataa a, ja a ba kɛ̃.
Se nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ guu kɛ baa a, musu tloo lɛ!
Afani nɛ a kɛ teji wɛ muɔ e kuɛ, nɛ a ya sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ wo mi pe nɛ e ma ha nɛ bimɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake maa pee yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya!
“Ke o nyɛmi tɔ o nɔ ɔ, kã e hɛ mi, nɛ ke e pia e he ɔ, kɛ pa lɛ.
Ke e tɔ o nɔ si kpaago ligbi kake, nɛ eko fɛɛ eko se ɔ, e kpale ba de mo ke, ‘I pia ye he’ ɔ, kɛ pa lɛ si kpaago ɔ jã kɛ̃.” Hemi kɛ yemi Bɔfo ɔmɛ de Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Ha nɛ wa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa!” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi kle kaa sinapi wu ngu kake jinɛ nyɛ ko fa sikamore tso nɛ ɔ ke e hia kɛ e sipoku kɛ je zu mi kɛ ya ma wo mi, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ tue.
Sɔmɔlɔ blɔ nya ní tsumi “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ti nɔ kake ngɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɛ huɔ, aloo e lɛɛ lohwe ha lɛ.
Ke e je ngmɔ mi kɛ ba a, pe o ma de lɛ ke e ba hi si esɔesɔ nɛ e ye ní lo?
Dɛbi, nɔ́ nɛ o ma de lɛ mohu ji, ‘Yaa nɛ o ya hoo ní ha mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, dla o he, nɛ o ba sɔmɔ mi kɛ yaa si ma ye ní nɛ ma nu nɔ́ ko.
Ke i gbe nya, konɛ mo hu o ya ye ní nɛ o nu nɔ́ ko.’ Tsɔlɔ ɔ, e hia we lɛ sina kaa e pee nɔ́ nɛ a fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ. Enɛ ɔ kɔɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ he jã kɛ̃.
Ke nyɛ pee níhi tsuo nɛ a fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ de ke, ‘Wɔɔ lɛɛ sɔmɔli nɛ he be se nami kɛkɛ ji wɔ.
Ní tsumi nɛ sa kaa wa tsu ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ wa tsu nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ ” Yesu tsa nyumuhi nyɔngma Benɛ Yesu ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem ɔ, e ya gu huza a nɔ ngɛ Samaria kɛ Galilea a kpɛti.
Benɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa sɛ kɔpe ko mi ɔ, nyumuhi nyɔngma nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.
A ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ke, “Yesu lee!
Tsɔɔlɔ lee!
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ oo, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Yesu na mɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ.” Benɛ a yaa ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a he womi nɔ tsɔ.
Benɛ a ti nɔ kake na kaa a tsa lɛ ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ba, nɛ e ba je Mawu yi kɛ ngmlaa.
E kɛ e hɛ mi ba bu si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e na lɛ si.
Se nyumu ɔ, Samaria no ji lɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi ke, “Pi nyumuhi nyɔngma nɛ i tsa a?
Jije nɛɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Mɛni he je nɛ ma se no nɛ ɔ pɛ lɛ kpale e se kɛ ba na Mawu si ɔ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Tee si nɛ o ya; o hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo.” Bɔ nɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ maa pee kɛ ba Farisi bi komɛ ba bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ba?” E he nɔ ke, “Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ be bae kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa na kɛ hɛngmɛ.
Nɔ ko hu be dee ke, ‘O nɛ, e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ;’ aloo, ‘E ngɛ lejɛ ɔ’; ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, nyɛ mi lɛ e ngɛ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ nyɛ ma hla kaa nyɛɛ na be ɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba ngɛ e hɛ mi nyami mi ɔ we ligbi kake pɛ, se nyɛ be nae.
Ni komɛ ma de nyɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ’, aloo, ‘Hyɛ, e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!’ Se nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ a se.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba, nɛ a maa na lɛ paa kaa bɔ nɛ oslabai kpɛɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ e haa je ɔ tsuo la a.
Se kekleekle ɔ, ja e na amanehlu babauu, nɛ kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ kua lɛ.
Loko Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba a, níhi nɛ ya nɔ Noa be ɔ mi ɔ maa ba mi jã nɔuu.
A ngɛ ní yee, nɛ a ngɛ ní nue; a ngɛ yihi ngɔe, nɛ a kɛ yihi ngɛ gba hae hluu kɛ ya su ligbi ɔ nɛ Noa sɛ lɛ ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ ba, nɛ e ba kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, níhi nɛ ya nɔ Lot be ɔ mi ɔ maa ba mi jã nɔuu.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ a ngɛ ní yee, nɛ a ngɛ ní nue; a ngɛ ní hee, nɛ a ngɛ ní juae; a ngɛ tsohi due, nɛ a ngɛ tsuhi mae.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Lot je Sodom ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege je hiɔwe ba kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu maa ba kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, níhi maa ba mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.
“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ e tsu yi mi ɔ, e ko kple si ba kukuɔ níhi ngɛ we ɔ mi.
Jã kɛ̃, nɔ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ si hu e ko kpale e se kɛ ba we mi.
Nyɛ kai Lot yo ɔ!
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ laa e klaa a, a kɛ maa to ha lɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, ni enyɔ maa hwɔ sa kake nɔ; a maa ngɔ nɔ kake kɛ je, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake ngɛ se.
Yihi enyɔ maa hi nɔ́ wɛɛe ngɛ he kake; a maa ngɔ nɔ kake kɛ je, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake ngɛ se.
[ “Nyumuhi enyɔ maa hi ní tsue ngɛ ngmɔ si; a maa ngɔ nɔ kake kɛ je, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake ngɛ se.”] Kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, jije?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “He nɛ nɔ́ gbogboe fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ okpokuhi ma bua a he nya ngɛ.”
Yalɔyo ɔ kɛ kojolɔ ɔ he abɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kɛ mɛ tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e sa kaa a sɔle daa nɛ a kɔni mi kó wo nyu.
E ke, “Kojolɔ ko hi ma ko mi; e yi Mawu gbeye ɔ, e bui adesa hulɔ.
Yalɔyo ko hu hi jamɛ a ma a mi.
Ke pee ɔ, yalɔyo ɔ baa kojolɔ ɔ ngɔ ba deɔ lɛ ke, ‘Nɔ ko ye mi amimi; i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ye dami sane ha mi.’ Kojolɔ ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ sane ɔ he hluu kɛ ya su be ko.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ngɛ e yi mi ke, ‘E ngɛ mi kaa i yi Mawu gbeye, nɛ i bui adesa hulɔ, se akɛnɛ yalɔyo nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye nya dooe he je ɔ, ma hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane ha lɛ.
Ke i pee we ja a, e maa hi ye ngɔ bae kpamisa, nɛ e be hae nɛ ma na tue mi jɔmi.’ ” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ya nɔ de ke, “Tse nyɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ kojolɔ yi si fialɔ ɔ de ɔ?
Yoo, lɛɛ nihi nɛ Mawu nitsɛ hla a, ke a fa kue ha lɛ nyɔ kɛ pia a, anɛ e be mɛɛ a sane yee ha mɛ lo?
Anɛ e maa to tsle hluu loko e ma ba piɛ a he lo?
Dɛbi, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e maa ye a sane ɔ ha mɛ nɔuu.
Se ke Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kpale kɛ ba a, anɛ e ma ba na nihi ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi lo?” Farisi no ɔ kɛ tó tsulɔ ɔ he abɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ buu a he dali, nɛ a gbee ni kpahi a he guɛ ɔ, Yesu tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
E ke, “Ligbi ko ɔ, ni enyɔ ya sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ a ya sɔle; nɔ kake ɔ, Farisi no ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ kake lɛɛ tó tsulɔ.
“Farisi no ɔ ya da si ngɛ he ko banee, nɛ e sɔle ke, ‘Mawu, i naa mo si kaa i pee we jiklɔɔ; i sisi we nɔ, nɛ i puɛ we gba kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ peeɔ ɔ. I naa mo si ekohu kaa i be kaa tó tsulɔ nɛ ɔ hulɔ.
I haa hwɔ si enyɔ ngɛ otsi mi, nɛ i haa mo níhi tsuo nɛ i naa a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka.’ “Se tó tsulɔ ɔ ya da si ngɛ se lokoo, nɛ e yi nɔ tete po e wo we kɛ yɛ hiɔwe; mohu ɔ, e gbe e gugue nɛ e de ke, ‘Mawu, yayami peelɔ ji mi; naa mi mɔbɔ!’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyumu nɛ ɔ kpale e se kɛ ho we mi ya kaa nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi pe Farisi no ɔ. Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a ma wo e nɔ.” Yesu gbaa jokuɛ tsɔwi Ni komɛ hu ngɔ bimwɔwi kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, konɛ e ta a he.
Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ na a, a kuɛ wo ni ɔmɛ.
Se Yesu tsɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ye ngɔ; nyɛ ko tsi mɛ blɔ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ji Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.
Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he we Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ kaa jokuɛ nyafii ɔ, e be mi sɛe kulaa.” Nyumu niatsɛ ɔ Yuda ma hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ko ba bi Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma na neneene wami?” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ mi tsɛe ke nɔ kpakpa a?
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ hi; Mawu pɛ ji nɔ kpakpa.
Tse o le mlaa amɛ nɛ deɔ ke, ‘Ko puɛ gba; koo gbe nɔmlɔ; koo ju; koo ye lakpa odase; bu o tsɛ, kɛ o nyɛ’ ɔ.” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “I ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si.” Benɛ Yesu nu enɛ ɔ, e de lɛ ke, “E pa piɛ mo nɔ́ kake.
Yaa jua níhi tsuo nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, nɛ o dla sika a ngɔ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ o ma na juetli ngɛ hiɔwe.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ba nɛ o ba nyɛɛ ye se.” Se benɛ nyumu ɔ nu enɛ ɔ, nu lɛ, ejakaa e ngɛ ní babauu.
Yesu hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e wa ha niatsɛmɛ kaa a maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi!
E wa ha niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi kulaa pe bɔ nɛ e wa ha afukpɔngɔ kaa e maa gu abui puɔ mi.” Nihi nɛ nu enɛ ɔ bi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ yi wami nɛ a ma nyɛ he mɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ adesa nyɛ we peemi ɔ, Mawu lɛɛ e nyɛɔ peeɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa si wa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ wa ba pee o se nyɛɛli.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma si e we, loo e yo, loo e nyɛminyumuhi, loo e nyɛmiyihi, loo e bimɛ, nɛ́ e ba pee Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi no ɔ, Mawu ma ha lɛ ní babauu ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi; je nɛ maa ba a mi hu, e ma na neneene wami.” Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu si etɛne Yesu tsɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba se, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ngɛ tue bue!
Wa yaa Yerusalem, nɛ lejɛ ɔ lɛ níhi tsuo nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma ngɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ he ɔ maa ba mi ngɛ.
A maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo ma je li a dɛ mi; ma je li ɔmɛ maa ye e he fɛu, nɛ a ma jɛ lɛ, nɛ a maa la lada ngɔ pue e nɔ.
A maa fia lɛ kpa, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ.
Se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, e maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.” Se kaseli ɔmɛ nui ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko sisi; a ngɔ munyu ɔmɛ a sisi numi ngɔ laa mɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yesu ngɛ dee ɔ, a kɔ we se.
Yesu tsa hɛ yuyuilɔ nɔ́ balɔ ko Benɛ Yesu su Yeriko ta a, hɛ yuyuilɔ ko hii si ngɛ blɔ ɔ he ngɛ nɔ́ bae.
Benɛ e nu nihi babauu a he nɛ a bee ɔ, e bi ke, “Mɛni ba?” A de lɛ ke, “Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ lɛ bee.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa ngmlaa, nɛ e de ke, “Yesu!
David bi!
Naa mi mɔbɔ!” Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi ɔ ke e yi, nɛ a de lɛ ke e ma e nya.
Se e kɛ ngmlaa nɛ nya wa pe kekle ɔ mohu de ke, “David bi lee!
Naa mi mɔbɔ oo, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu da si, nɛ e fa ke a kɛ lɛ nɛ ba e ngɔ.
Benɛ e ba a, Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha mo?” E he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha nɛ ma hyɛ nɔ ekohu.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Moo hyɛ nɔ́!
O hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo.” Amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi, nɛ e nyɛɛ Yesu se, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu yi jee.
Benɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, mɛ tsuo a je Mawu yi.
Yesu kɛ Zakeo Yesu ya su Yeriko, nɛ e ngɛ mi poe kɛ yaa.
Nyumu ko ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Zakeo.
Tó tsulɔ nɔkɔtɔma ji lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ ní.
Zakeo bɔ mɔde kaa e maa na Yesu, se e nyɛ we; ejakaa nɔmlɔ kpiti ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ Yesu se ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu nitsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa fo kɛ sɛ hlami, nɛ e ya kuɔ sikamore tso ko konɛ e hyɛ Yesu; ejakaa lejɛ ɔ blɔ nɛ e maa gu.
Benɛ Yesu ba su lejɛ ɔ, e wo e yi nɔ nɛ e de Zakeo ke, “Zakeo, o he nɛ sɔ nɛ o kple si, ejakaa o we ɔ mi nɛ ma to mwɔnɛ ɔ.” Zakeo he sɔ kɛ kple si, nɛ e fua Yesu atuu.
Nihi tsuo nɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, tu munyu huitihuiti ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ ya to yayami peelɔ we mi.” Zakeo te da si nɛ e de Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, bu tue!
Ma ngɔ ye níhi fa kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ.
Ke i sisi nɔ ko ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ yaka a, ma ku ngɔ bɔ he si eywiɛ ha lɛ.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yi wami hemi ba we nɛ ɔ mi mwɔnɛ ɔ; ejakaa nyumu nɛ ɔ hu Abraham nina ji lɛ.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba, konɛ e ba hla nihi nɛ laa a, nɛ e he a yi wami.” Sika tsu kpɔ ɔmɛ a he abɛ Benɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tue bue ɔ, Yesu tu mɛ munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi, ejakaa e su Yerusalem haa, nɛ ni ɔmɛ susu kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ba nɔuu.
E de mɛ ke, “Be ko ɔ, ablade ko doma kɛ ho lokoo ya, konɛ a ya wo lɛ matsɛ nɛ e kpale kɛ ba.
Loko e je ɔ, e tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti ni nyɔngma, nɛ e ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika tsu kpɔ kakaaka.
E de mɛ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ ngɔ sika nɛ ɔ kɛ tsu ní kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ba.’ Se e ma mi bi ɔmɛ sume lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ nihi kɛ fie e se ke a ya de ke, ‘Wa sume nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ba ye wa nɔ matsɛ.’ “A na ya wo nyumu ɔ matsɛ, nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba.
Amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, e fa ke a tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ e ha mɛ sika a kɛ ba, konɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ a na ngɛ se.
Kekle nɔ ɔ ba ba de ke, ‘Sika tsu kpɔ kake ɔ nɛ o ha mi ɔ fɔ sika tsu kpɔ nyɔngma.’ E de lɛ ke, Ayekoo!
Tsɔlɔ kpakpa ji mo!
O ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ nyafii mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o maa ye ma nyɔngma nɔ́.
Nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ba ba de lɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, o sika tsu kpɔ kake ɔ fɔ sika tsu kpɔ enuɔ.’ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ hu ke, ‘O maa ye ma enuɔ nɔ.’ “Tsɔlɔ kpa hu ba ba de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, o sika tsu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i fi ngɔ wo duku mi ngɔ to.
I ya ye mo gbeye, ejakaa o yi mi wa.
Nɔ́ nɛ pi o nɔ́ kɛkɛ o ngɔ; nɔ́ nɛ o du we kɛkɛ o ya kpa.’ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Tsɔlɔ angmaletsɛ!
Mo nitsɛ o nya mi munyu ma kɛ bu mo fɔ!
Tse o le kaa ye yi mi wa!
Nɔ́ nɛ pi ye nɔ́ kɛkɛ i ya ngɔ; nɔ́ nɛ i du we kɛkɛ i ya kpa.
Saminya!
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o kɛ ye sika a yɛ sika to he, konɛ ke i kpale kɛ ba a, nɛ ma ba he ye ní kɛ hekpa?’ “Jehanɛ ɔ, e de nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a ke, ‘Nyɛ kpɔ sika tsu kpɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ ha tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu nyɔngma a.’ Se a de lɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, sika tsu kpɔ nyɔngma ngɛ e dɛ momo!’ E he nɔ ke, ‘I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha lɛ fuu kɛ piɛ he.
Se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ, bɔbɔyoo nɛ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ tete po a ma kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ.
Se jamɛ a ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ sume kaa ma ye a nɔ matsɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba gbe mɛ ngɛ ye hɛ mi!’ ” Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, e sɛ ni ɔmɛ a hlami kɛ yaa Yerusalem.
Benɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa su Betfage, kɛ Betania, ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya kɔpe nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ mi.
Ke nyɛ su lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa na teji bi nɛ nɔ ko hí e nɔ hyɛ nɛ a muɔ lɛ si.
Nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ. Ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ ke mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lɛ pɛnee ɔ, nyɛ de lɛ ke e he hia Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Nihi nɛ a tsɔ ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se benɛ a ngɛ teji bi ɔ pɛnee ɔ, nɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ teji bi ɔ pɛnee ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “E he hia Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” Nɛ a kɛ teji bi ɔ ba ha Yesu.
Jehanɛ ɔ, a kɛ a tadehi pue lohwe ɔ nɔ, nɛ a wo Yesu ngɔ hi nɔ.
Benɛ e hi teji ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, nihi ngɔ a tadehi kɛ ha blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Benɛ e su Yerusalem ta, ngɛ he nɛ a kpleɔ Oliv yo ɔ ngɛ ɔ, nimli kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ bɔni nyami kɛ ngmlaa boboobo.
A na Mawu si, nɛ a je e yi ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ a na a he.
A de ke, “Mawu nɛ gbaa matsɛ ɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ!
He jɔmi ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ hɛ mi nyami ha Mawu!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisi bi komɛ nɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ha nɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a pee dii!” Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke ni nɛ ɔmɛ ma a nya a, tɛhi tete ma hwɔ lele.” Yesu fo ya pue Yerusalem nɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu su ma a he haa, nɛ benɛ e na ma a, e fo ya pue e nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “I na nɛ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, o le níhi nɛ hia mo loko o ma na tue mi jɔmi!
Se a ngɔ laa mo!
Be ma nɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma sa o yi kɛ kpe; a maa tsi blɔhi tsuo ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ a ma tua mo kɛ je he slɔɔtohi.
A ma kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi hu a maa gbe mɛ tsuo; a be tɛ kake po sie ngɛ e blɔ he.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba o nɔ, ejakaa be ɔ nɛ Mawu ba nɛ e ba kpɔ mo ɔ, o kplɛɛ we.” Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya bɔni nihi nɛ ngɛ ní juae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ fiemi.
E de mɛ ke, “A ngma ke, Mawu ke, ‘A ma tsɛ ye we ɔ ke he nɛ a faa kue ha mi ngɛ!’ Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ pee ojo fiali a laami he!” Daa ligbi ɔ, Yesu ya tsɔɔ ní ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hlaa kaa a maa gbe lɛ.
Se a li blɔ nɔ nɛ a maa gu kɛ pee ja; ejakaa ma a tsuo ngɛ e munyu ɔ tue bue kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ a sume kaa a ma si lɛ.
He blɔ nɛ Yesu ngɛ Ligbi ko benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛe ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ.
A ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he blɔ nɛ o ngɛ nɛ o kɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ha mo he blɔ nɛ ɔ?
Mo de wɔ!” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Yoo, imi hu ma bi nyɛ munyu ko nɛ nyɛ ha mi heto.
He blɔ nɛ Yohane ngɛ nɛ e kɛ sɔle nihi ɔ, Mawu lɛ ha lɛ, aloo nɔmlɔ adesa?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni mi hlami ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti.
A bi a he ke, “Kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Ke wa ke, Mawu nɛ ha lɛ ɔ, e ma de ke, ‘Lɛɛ mɛni he je nyɛ he we Yohane yi mɔ?’ Nɛ ke wa de ke, ‘Nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ha lɛ’ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ tsuo maa fia wɔ tɛ; ejakaa a heɔ yeɔ kaa Yohane ɔ, gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a de Yesu ke, “Wa li.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “He blɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ i kɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, imi hu i be nyɛ tsɔɔe!” Apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ he abɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu bu ni ɔmɛ abɛ ko ke, “Nyumu ko pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ha huli apaa yeli, nɛ e doma kɛ ho he ko ya be babauu.
Benɛ wai yiblii nya buami be su ɔ, e tsɔ e nyɔguɛ apaa yeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, konɛ e ya ngɔ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ba.
Se apaa yeli ɔmɛ fia nyɔguɛ ɔ ní, nɛ a ha nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho dɛ gu.
E kpale tsɔ nyɔguɛ kpa kɛ ho.
Se lɛ hu apaa yeli ɔmɛ fia lɛ ní, nɛ a pue e hɛ mi si, nɛ a ha nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho dɛ gu.
E kpale tsɔ nyɔguɛ etɛne; se lɛ hu apaa yeli ɔmɛ plaa lɛ, nɛ a tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je kpo.
Jehanɛ ɔ, wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ de ke, ‘Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?
Ma tsɔ imi nitsɛ ye binyumu nɛ i suɔ lɛ ɔ; eko ɔ, a maa bu lɛ!’ Se benɛ apaa yeli ɔmɛ na lɛ ɔ, a de a he ke, ‘Gbosi ní yelɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ha waa gbe lɛ!
Kɛkɛ ɔ, gbosi ní ɔ ma ba pee wa nɔ́.’ Nɛ a tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je wai ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ maa pee apaa yeli ɔmɛ kɛɛ?
E ma ba kpata jamɛ a apaa yeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e maa ngɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ kɛ ha ni kpahi.” Benɛ ni ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a de ke, “Kpaoo, e ko ba mi ja!” Yesu hyɛ mɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ e bi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛni ji ngmami nɛ ɔ sisi mɔ?
‘Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ sake fɔ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ ba plɛ kɔ nya tɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nɔ tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ma tsɔtslɔɔ e mi; jã kɛ̃, nɔ nɛ tɛ ɔ maa nɔ e nɔ ɔ, tɛ ɔ maa wɛɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.” Tó tsumi Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ hla kaa a maa nu Yesu jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a mi nɔuu; ejakaa a na kaa a he munyu lɛ e tu ɔ nɛ.
Se a ya ye ma a gbeye.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bɔni lɛ huɔmi.
A ha ni komɛ sika, nɛ a tsɔ mɛ Yesu ngɔ.
A bua pee a he kaa nihi nɛ ma lɛ munyu kɛkɛ bimi; se a juɛmi ji a yaa wo e nya tso kpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha Roma nikɔtɔma amɛ, konɛ a kojo lɛ, nɛ a gbe lɛ.
Slaali ɔmɛ ba de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa munyu nɛ jeɔ o nya, kɛ ní nɛ o tsɔɔ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu.
Wa le kaa o hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi, se mohu o tsɔɔ mɛ Mawu yi mi tomi kɛ ha nɔmlɔ adesa.
Anɛ wa mlaa a ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa a tsu tó ha Kaisare ɔ, loo a ko tsu?” Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ momo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ sika nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ tó ɔ kɛ ba nɛ ma hyɛ!” E ya nɔ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ foni ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛnɔ biɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Kaisare ɔ.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Saminya!
Nyɛɛ ngɔ Kaisare ɔ nɔ́ ngɔ ha Kaisare ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu nɔ́ ngɔ ha Mawu!” A nyɛ we nɛ a wo e nya tso kpɛ ngɛ ma a hɛ mi, ejakaa heto nɛ e ha mɛ ɔ ha nɛ a he mi po.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma a nya.
Ni gbogboehi a si temi Pee se ɔ, Saduki bi komɛ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a he we yi kaa nihi maa te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ munyu.
A ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose ngma mlaa nɛ ɔ ha wɔ ke, ‘Ke nyumu gbo, nɛ e si e yo, se e be bimɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ nyɛminyumu nɛ ngɔ yalɔyo ɔ, konɛ e wo ngmɛdu ngɔ ha e nyɛminyumu nɛ be je mi ɔ.’ Yoo, nyɛmimɛ kpaago hi si.
Tɛte ɔ ngɔ yo, nɛ e gbo, se e si we bimɛ.
Tɛtɛ ɔ ba ngɔ yo ɔ, nɛ Tɛɛ ɔ hu ba ngɔ lɛ.
Nyɛmimɛ kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo ba ngɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a gbo; se a si we bimɛ.
Pee se ɔ, yo ɔ hu ba gbo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ ni gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, mɛnɔ yo nɛ e maa pee?
Nyɛmimɛ kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ hi si.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi ngɔɔ yo, nɛ a kɛ yo haa gba.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ sa kaa a te si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ a hi wami mi ekohu yi nɔ nɛ maa ba a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a be yo ngɔe, nɛ a kɛ yo be gba hae hulɔ.
A maa pee kaa Mawu bɔfohi, nɛ a be gboe hu.
A pee Mawu bimɛ, ejakaa a te si kɛ je gbeje.
Mose nitsɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ma tle ni gbogboehi si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
Ngmami ɔ mi he nɛ a tu hue kpɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ tsoe ɔ he munyu ngɛ ɔ, Mose wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ ta ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke, ‘Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu.’ Mawu ɔ, hɛ kali a Mawu ji lɛ, se pi ni gbogboehi a Mawu; ejakaa e hɛ mi ɔ, nihi tsuo a hɛ ngɛ.” Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, o munyu ɔ ngɔ!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e bi Yesu sane ko hu.
Mɛnɔ ji Kristo ɔ?
Yesu bi ni ɔmɛ ke, “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ a deɔ ke Kristo ɔ, David nina ji lɛ ɔ?
Ejakaa David nitsɛ de ngɛ La Womi ɔ mi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, Hii si ngɛ ye hiɔ nɔ kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.’ Ke David tsɛɔ Kristo ɔ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ Kristo ɔ ba peeɔ David nina mɔ?” Yesu bɔ kaseli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a he Benɛ ma a tsuo ngɛ Yesu tue bue ɔ, e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he saminya ngɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a he.
A suɔ kaa a maa wo tade klɔii kɛ hi nyɛɛe kɛ hi bee.
A suɔ kaa nihi nɛ kpla si kɛ nga mɛ ngɛ jua nɔ.
A suɔ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi he ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ; nɛ ke a tsɛ ní yemi ɔ, a suɔ kaa a maa hi okplɔɔ ɔ yi.
A sisiɔ yalɔyihi, nɛ a kpɔɔ a wehi ngɛ a dɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a peeɔ sɔlemi gagaaga, konɛ a kɛ laa a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Mawu maa gbla a tue pe nine!”
Yalɔyo ko ya tsu tó Ligbi ko benɛ Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ mi ɔ, e na niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɔ a nike ní kɛ ngɛ tó tsumi daka a mi woe.
E na yalɔyo ohiatsɛ ko hu nɛ kɛ kaplɛ enyɔ ba wo daka a mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ́ nɛ kikɛmɛ a yalɔyo ohiatsɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ba wo daka a mi ɔ hiɛ kulaa pe ni ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ́ ɔ. Niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ní babauu ɔ mi bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ ba ke Mawu; se yo ohiatsɛ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ bɔɔ nɛ ngɛ e dɛ nɛ e kɛ maa hyɛ e he nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ e kɛ ba wo daka a mi ɔ nɛ.” Yesu de ke a ma kpata sɔlemi we ɔ hɛ mi Ni komɛ bɔni ní sɛɛmi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he, bɔ nɛ a dla lɛ saminyayoo kɛ tɛ kpakpa, kɛ nike níhi nɛ a kɛ ba ha Mawu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke, “Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, be ma nɛ a maa tsɛ̃ ngɔ fia si bum!
A be tɛ ngmelu kake po sie ngɛ e blɔ he.” Amanehlu kɛ yi mi wami Ni ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni be nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi?
Loko nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi ɔ, mɛni okadi maa je kpo?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ a ko mlɔɔ nyɛ, ejakaa nihi fuu maa ba, nɛ a kɛ ye biɛ maa tu munyu ke, ‘Imi ji Kristo ɔ nɛ!’ A ma de hu ke, ‘Be ɔ su ta!’ Se nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ a se.
Ke nyɛ nu nɛ a ngɛ ta hwue, aloo a tsɔ atuã ngɛ he ko ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; ja kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ ba mi lolo.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyagbe ɔ sui lolo.” E ya nɔ de ke, “Ma maa te si ngɔ wo ma, nɛ matsɛ yemi maa te si ngɔ wo matsɛ yemi.
Zugba ma mimiɛ; hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ba ngɛ he tsuaa he; nɛ gbeye níhi, kɛ nyakpɛ ní nguahi maa ba hiɔwe.
Se loko ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba a, a maa nuu nyɛ, nɛ a maa wa nyɛ yi mi.
A maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ha nɛ a kojo nyɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa wo nyɛ tsu.
Ye he ɔ, a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba matsɛmɛ, kɛ ganɔhi a hɛ mi.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ he blɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa ye odase.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ le ngɔ to, konɛ nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma fa nyɛ he ɔ he.
Ejakaa munyu nɛ maa je nyɛ nya, kɛ juɛmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma fa nyɛ he ɔ, ma ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ nyɛe, loo a maa je nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ he nɔ́.
Nyɛ fɔli, nyɛ nyɛmimɛ, kɛ nyɛ weku li, nyɛ huɛmɛ tete maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ha, nɛ a maa gbe nyɛ ti ni komɛ.
Ye he ɔ, nihi tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ, se nyɛ yi bwɔmi kake ngmelu tete be laae.
Nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kpɛii, nɛ nyɛ ma na neneene wami.
Yesu de ke a ma kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi “Ke nyɛ na nɛ he nyɛli ba sa Yerusalem ma a yi ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le kaa ma a hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ su ta.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yudea a, a tu fo kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a je, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ si ɔ, a ko ba ma a mi.
Ejakaa lue yemi ligbi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; konɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngmami ɔmɛ de ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Yihi nɛ maa hɛɛ mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi nyɔ hae jamɛ a be ɔ, kusiɛ ha mɛ!
Fimi nɛ nya wa maa ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ Mawu mi mi ma fu kikɛmɛ a ma a.
A kɛ klaate maa gbe ni komɛ.
A maa nuu ni komɛ hu nyɔguɛ kɛ ya je ma amɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ maa ngɔ Yerusalem, nɛ a maa ye ma a nɔ hluu kɛ yaa si mɛ hu a be maa su.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma “Nyakpɛ níhi maa ba pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi a hɛ mi.
Nihi babauu ngɛ je ɔ mi a kɔni mi ma jɔ̃; ke wo gli nɛ oslɔke pɛ kɛkɛ gbeye nu mɛ.
Níhi nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ maa wo nihi a he gbeye, nɛ a maa hɛli, ejakaa he wamihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, a maa fie mɛ kɛ je a blɔ hehi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ ma ngɛ bɔku mi, kɛ he wami, kɛ hɛ mi nyami babauu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ bɔni mi bami ɔ, nyɛɛ te si, nɛ nyɛ wo nyɛ yi nɔ; ejakaa e be kɛe nɛ Mawu ma he nyɛ yi wami.” Ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he ní kasemi Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu tu mɛ munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi.
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ susu ngmɔkɔ tso, kɛ tso kpahi tsuo a he.
Ke a tsɛ̃ ba pɛ kɛkɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa latsa be su si ta.
Jã kɛ̃, ke nyɛ na kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi bae ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ su ta.
“Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo be gboe ta nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi.
Hiɔwe kɛ zugba maa be kɛ ho, se ye munyu ɔmɛ lɛɛ a maa hi si daa.
Nyagbe ɔ maa ba tlukaa “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nyɛ ko ya di ní yemi, kɛ ní numi, kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi nɛ ngɔɔ nɔ nya a a se tsɔ.
Ke pi ja a, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ma ba ti nyɛ si tlukaa kaa klama; ejakaa e maa ba nihi tsuo a nɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle daa, konɛ Mawu nɛ ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ kɛ gblee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ maa ba a a mi slɔkee, nɛ nyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ da Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi.” Daa ligbi ɔ, Yesu ya tsɔɔ ní ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ ke je jɔ ɔ, e ya hwɔɔ Oliv yo ɔ nɔ.
Mɔtu mla a, ma a tsuo baa e ngɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ba buɔ lɛ tue.
A so Yesu yi nɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Hetsɔmi ɔ ba su.
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ye ma a gbeye; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hla blɔ nɔ nɛ a maa gu kɛ gbe Yesu ngɛ laami mi.
Yuda kplɛɛ kaa e maa tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ Abosiami ba sɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ Yuda a mi.
Yuda biɛ kpa ji Iskariot.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya sɛɛ ní, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ e maa pee nɛ e je Yesu ngɔ ha mɛ.
A bua jɔ, nɛ a wo lɛ si ke a ma ha lɛ sika.
Yuda kplɛɛ, nɛ e bɔni blɔ hlami, konɛ e ngɔ Yesu ngɔ wo a dɛ mi zaa nɛ ma a kó nu he.
Yesu dla kɛ ha Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ yemi Jehanɛ ɔ, Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ ligbi tutuutu nɛ a gbeɔ to bi ɔ nɛ a kɛ yeɔ Hetsɔmi ɔ ba su.
Yesu tsɔ Petro kɛ Yohane, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya pee Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ ngɔ to wɔ nɛ wa ba ye.” A bi lɛ ke, “Jije nɛ o suɔ nɛ wa ya pee niye ní ɔ ngɔ to mo ngɛ?” E he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Ke nyɛ sɛ ma a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyumu ko nɛ tloo buɛ kɛ nyu maa kpe.
Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya we mi he nɛ e yaa sɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya de wetsɛ ɔ ke, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ke wa ba bi mo ke nibwɔhi a tsu ɔ, he nɛ i kɛ ye kaseli ɔmɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ ngɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ?’ E maa tsɔɔ nyɛ hiɔwe asa nguaa ko nɛ a dla mi, konɛ nyɛ ya pee niye ní ɔ ngɔ to ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” A pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ɔ. Nɛ a ya pee Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ ngɔ to.
Nyɔmtsɛ niye ní ɔ Benɛ ngmlɛfia a su ɔ, Yesu ya hi e blɔ he ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he; e kɛ bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ.
E de mɛ ke, “I kɛ he hiami hyɛ blɔ wawɛɛ kaa i kɛ nyɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi niye ní nɛ ɔ loko ma na amanehlu!
Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, i be eko yee hu kɛ yaa si Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ba, nɛ́ nɔ nɛ Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ maa je kpo paa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu wo kplu, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ nu.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i be wai nɛ ɔ nue hu kɛ yaa si Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ba.” Jehanɛ ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso [nɛ a ngɔ sã bɔ ha Mawu ngɛ nyɛ he.
Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.” Benɛ a ye ní ɔ ta a, e wo kplu ɔ ja nɔuu, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Kplu nɛ ɔ ji Mawu somi he ɔ nɛ a ngɔ ye muɔ nɛ a plɛ ngɔ pue si ha nyɛ ɔ kɛ sɔu nya a nɛ.]
“Se hyɛ!
Nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ ní yee ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ, se musu tloo nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni a he bimi ke a kpɛti mɛnɔ po maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa?
Kaseli ɔmɛ sɔuu ba bɔni nya sami kaa a kpɛti mɛnɔ lɛ sa kaa a buu nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ma je li ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ a ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ti ni komɛ tsɛɔ a he ke ‘Ma he dooli.’ Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e be nyɛ jã.
Mohu ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nɔ nguaa pe kulaa ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e pee e ní kaa jokuɛyo pe kulaa; nɔkɔtɔma a, e pee e ní kaa sɔmɔlɔ.
Te nɔ nɛ pe e nyɛmi nɛɛ: nɔ nɛ hii okplɔɔ he nɛ yeɔ ní, aloo nɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ?
Anɛ pi nɔ nɛ hii okplɔɔ he nɛ yeɔ ní ɔ lo?
Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa nɔ nɛ sɔmɔɔ.
“Ye haomi be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛ ji nihi nɛ daa si kpɛii ngɛ ye se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, he wami nɛ Tsaatsɛ ha mi nɛ ma kɛ ye e ma a nɔ ɔ, imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ jamɛ a he wami ɔ hae.
Nyɛ maa ye ní, nɛ nyɛ maa nu ní ngɛ ye we okplɔɔ ɔ he ngɛ ye matsɛ yemi ɔ mi; nɛ nyɛ maa hi matsɛ sɛhi a nɔ kɛ kojo Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ.
Yesu de to ke Petro ma kua lɛ “Simon, Simon!
Bu tue!
Mawu ha Abosiami blɔ ke e ka nyɛ, nɛ e je nimli kpakpa amɛ kɛ je nimli yayami ɔmɛ a kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔ hulɔ saa ngma mi ɔ.
Se imi lɛɛ i sɔle ha mo Simon, nɛ o hemi kɛ yemi kó ta, konɛ ke o kpale o se kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu ɔ, mo hu o wo o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ he wami.” Petro de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i dla ye he ngɔ to nɛ ke tsu mi oo, gbenɔ mi oo, i kɛ mo maa ya!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Petro, i ngɛ mo dee ke, kungwɔ be nɔ́ kpae nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi.” Sika kpɛɛ, kotoku, kɛ klaate Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Be ko benɛ i tsɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ we sika kpɛɛ, loo kotoku, loo tokota a, anɛ nɔ́ ko hia nyɛ lo?” A he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we wɔ.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛɛ sika kpɛ ɔ, e ngɔ; nɔ nɛ ngɛ kotoku ɔ, e ngɔ; nɔ nɛ be klaate ɔ, e jua e tade, nɛ e kɛ he eko.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke, ‘A bu lɛ ngɔ ta yayami peeli a he’ ɔ, ye he a ngma ngɛ.
Nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ ye he ɔ, ja e ba mi.” Kaseli ɔmɛ de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, hyɛ!
Klaate enyɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!” E he nɔ ke, “E hiɛ!” Yesu ya sɔle ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ nɔ Yesu je ma a mi, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Oliv yo ɔ nɔ ya kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ. E kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ lɛ ho.
Benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ nyɛ ko sɛ ka mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e si mɛ maa pee tɛ fɔmi mi kɛmi, nɛ e ya kpla si, nɛ e sɔle ke, “Tsaatsɛ, ke o suɔ ɔ, je nɔ́ nami kplu nɛ ɔ kɛ je ye blɔ mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ko pee nɔ́ nɛ imi i suɔ; se mohu a pee nɔ́ nɛ mo o suɔ.” [ Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ko je hiɔwe ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ he wami.
E kɛ he hiami sɔle wawɛɛ pe kekle ɔ po, nɛ e he latsa ngɛ tslee kɛ ngɛ si puee kaa muɔloku.]
Benɛ e sɔle ta, nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, e na mɛ nɛ aywilɛho nu mɛ, nɛ a hwɔ mahe.
E de mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mahe hwɔe ɔ?
Nyɛɛ te si nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ nyɛ ko sɛ ka mi.” A nu Yesu Benɛ Yesu ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, nihi babauu ba hia kpo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yuda a nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ba.
E hɛ lɛ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, konɛ e ba fiɔ e nya he.
Se Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Yuda, o ma fiɔ ye nya he, konɛ o kɛ tsɔɔ imi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, ye se blɔ?” Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ Yesu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ma a, a bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, waa hia klaate kɛ wo a he lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ti nɔ kake ja osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ klaate, nɛ e po e hiɔ nɔ tue.
Se Yesu de ke, “E hiɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ e ta nyumu ɔ tue ɔ he, nɛ e tsa lɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ e hia kaa nyɛɛ ngɔ klaate, kɛ okpoti kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ?
Ojo fialɔ ji mi?
Daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ de we ke nyɛ maa nu mi.
Se nyɛ ngmlɛfia a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; diblii matsɛ ɔ ní tsumi be su!” Petro de ke e li Yesu A nu Yesu, nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a we mi ya; nɛ Petro nyɛɛ se ngɛ lokoo.
A slɛ la ngɛ kue ɔ kpɛti, nɛ nihi hii si kɛ bɔle la a, nɛ Petro ho ya piɛ a he.
Mawayi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake na lɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ la a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mawayo ɔ hyɛ Petro too, nɛ e de ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ hu piɛ e he!” Se Petro kplɛɛ we.
E de lɛ ke, “Awenyɛ, i li lɛ!” Be bɔɔ se ɔ, nyumu ko hu yo Petro, nɛ e de ke, “Mo hu a ti nɔ kake ji mo!” Se Petro he nɔ ke, “Awetsɛ, pi a ti nɔ kake ji mi!” Maa pee ngmlɛfia kake se ɔ, nyumu kpa ko hu ma nɔ mi veveeve, nɛ e de ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ hu Galilea no ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ́ jemi ko kulaa be he kaa lɛ hu e kɛ Yesu lɛ ngɛ!” Se Petro de lɛ ke, “Awetsɛ, i li nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ!” Tlukaa a, benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, kungwɔ kpa nɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ plɛ e he nɛ e hyɛ Petro.
Nɛ Petro kai kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ be ko ke, “Loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro je kpo, nɛ e ya fo ya wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
A ye Yesu he fɛu, nɛ a fia lɛ ní Nihi nɛ ngɛ Yesu he bue ɔ ye e he fɛu, nɛ a fia lɛ ní.
A fi e hɛ mi, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ fia mo nɔ́ ɔ?
De wɔ!” Nɛ a de ní kpahi fuu kɛ bɔ lɛ ahlua.
Yesu ngɛ kpe nguaa a hɛ mi Benɛ je na a, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a nya ba bua, nɛ a ngɔ Yesu kɛ ba da kpe nguaa a hɛ mi.
A bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Kristo ɔ lo?
De wɔ!” E he nɔ ke, “Ke i de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ be hee maa ye, nɛ ke sane ko nɛ i bi hu, nyɛ be mi heto hae.
Se e be kɛe kulaa nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa hi Mawu Ope ɔ hiɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a bi lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ tse Mawu bi ji mo?” E he nɔ ke, “Ja nyɛ de ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a de ke, “Odase yeli kpahi a he hia we wɔ hu!
Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu kɛ je e nya!”
Yesu ngɛ Pilato hɛ mi Kpe nguaa a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo te si, nɛ a hɛɛ Yesu mi kɛ ya Pilato ngɔ.
Nɛ a bɔni e nya pomi ke, “Wa nu nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tue puɛe.
Wa nu nɛ e ngɛ mɛ dee ke a ko tsu tó ha Kaisare ɔ, se lɛ nitsɛ ji Kristo, matsɛ ɔ nɛ.” Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ mo ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ja o deɔ nɛ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Pilato de osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke, “I nɛ nɔ́ yayami ko ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ he nɛ buɔ lɛ fɔ.” Se a nya sɔ wo e he, nɛ a de ke, “E ngɔ e ní tsɔɔmi ɔ kɛ ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tue puɛe ngɛ Yudea tsuo.
E je sisi kɛ je Galilea, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ba su hiɛ ɔ.” Yesu ngɛ Herode hɛ mi Benɛ Pilato nu enɛ ɔ, e bi ke, “Nyumu ɔ, Galilea no ji lɛ lo?” Benɛ e na le kaa Yesu je Herode nɔ yemi he ɔ, e ha nɛ a ngɔ lɛ ya ha Herode.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Herode hu ba Yerusalem.
Herode nu Yesu he kɛ, nɛ e je bɔni lɛ hlami nɛ e na pi mwɔnɛ.
E hemi kɛ yemi hu ji kaa Yesu maa pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e na.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a kɛ Yesu ba e ngɔ ɔ, e na bua jɔmi babauu.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e bi Yesu munyuhi fuu, se e ha we lɛ kake po heto.
Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ba da si, nɛ a po Yesu nya babauu.
Herode kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ ye Yesu he fɛu, nɛ a bɔ lɛ ahlua.
A wo Yesu tade klɔii saminyayoo ko, nɛ Herode ha nɛ a kpale lɛ ya ha Pilato ekohu.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Pilato kɛ Herode nu huɛ; jinɛ sa a, a kɛ a he yi.
A bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ Pilato tsɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a kɛ ba kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba po e nya ke e ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tue puɛe.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i hla e sane ɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi, se i nɛ kaa e yeɔ fɔ ngɛ sanehi nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba po e nya a ekoeko mi.
Herode hu bui lɛ fɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ e kpale lɛ ba ha wɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ pee we nɔ́ yayami ko nɛ hia kaa ma bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha nɛ a fia lɛ kpa, nɛ ma ngmɛɛ e he.” [ Daa ke e su Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ, Pilato ngmɛɛɔ pã mi no kake he ngɔ haa ma a.]
Se mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Gbee lɛ, nɛ o ngmɛɛ Baraba he ha wɔ!” (A wo Baraba tsu, ejakaa e tsɔ atuã ngɛ ma a mi be ko, nɛ e gbe nɔmlɔ hulɔ.)
Pilato hla kaa e maa ngmɛɛ Yesu he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ ma a tu munyu ekohu.
Se a kpale kpa ngmlaa ekohu ke, “Sɛu lɛ!
Sɛu lɛ!” Pilato bi mɛ si etɛne ɔ ke, “Se mɛni yayami nɛ e pee?
I nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e pee nɛ sa kaa a gbe lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha nɛ a fia lɛ kpa, nɛ ma ngmɛɛ e he.” Se a ya nɔ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke Pilato nɛ ha nɛ a sɛu Yesu.
Ngmlaa nɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hí peemi ngɛ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Pilato bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ kaa bɔ nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ. E ngmɛɛ nɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ he ha mɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ a wo lɛ tsu kaa e tsɔ atuã, nɛ e gbe nɔmlɔ hulɔ ɔ.
Se Yesu ɔ lɛɛ, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ e pee ɔ.
A sɛu Yesu Benɛ Roma ta buli ɔmɛ ngɔ Yesu kɛ yaa a, a kɛ Kirene no ko kpe nɛ je ngmɔ si kɛ ma ma a mi.
E biɛ ji Simon.
A nu lɛ, nɛ a wo sɛumi tso ɔ ngɔ tloo lɛ, nɛ e kɛ nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Nimli babauu nɛ nyɛɛ Yesu se ɔ, a ti ni komɛ ji yihi nɛ wo yana kɛ ngɛ awe nyae ha lɛ.
Se Yesu plɛ e hɛ mi kɛ kpee mɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Yerusalem yihi!
Nyɛ ko fo ya ha mi; se mohu nyɛ fo ya ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he, kɛ nyɛ bimɛ.
Ejakaa be ma nɛ a ma de ke, ‘Yosahi, kɛ yihi nɛ a mi mi wui ngma, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ha we nyɔ hyɛ ɔ, a he ngɛ ní pɛ!’ Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi ma de ke, ‘Wa na nɛ yo ɔmɛ ba nɔ wa nɔ; nɛ yoku ɔmɛ ha wa nɔ.’ Ejakaa ke tso mumu lɛ a pee enɛ ɔ ɔ, tso gbigbli lɛɛ kɛ e nɔ́ maa hi kɛɛ?” A ngɔ yayami peeli enyɔ komɛ hu kɛ ho, konɛ a ya gbe mɛ ngɔ piɛ Yesu he.
Benɛ a su he nɛ a tsɛɛ “Yikoklodonya a”, a sɛu Yesu, kɛ yayami peeli enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɔ kake ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake hu ngɛ e muɔ nɔ.
[ Nɛ Yesu de ke, “Tsaatsɛ, kɛ pa mɛ!
A li nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a fɔ sɔ kɛ dla e tade ɔmɛ.]
Ma mi bi ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ hyɛe, be mi nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ e he fɛu yee ngɛ dee ke, “Tse o he ni komɛ a yi wami!
Yoo, ke mo ji Kristo ɔ, nɔ nɛ Mawu hla a, he mo nitsɛ o yi wami koo!” Ta buli ɔmɛ hu ye e he fɛu.
A hɛ mɛ kɛ su e he, nɛ a ha lɛ dã nɛ kuã, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Ke mo ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ, he mo nitsɛ o yi wami koo!” A ngma munyu ko ngɔ mɛtɛ e yi je ke, “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yayami peeli nɛ a sɛu ɔ, mɛ hu a ti nɔ kake fia Yesu lilɛ saminya.
E de lɛ ke, “Pi mo ji Kristo ɔ?
He mo nitsɛ o yi wami, konɛ o he wɔ hu wa yi wami!” Se nɔ kake ɔ ka e hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “O yi Mawu gbeye?
Waa kɛ lɛ tsuo ɔ, gbenɔ fɔ kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ a bu wɔ.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nɔ́ ɔ sa wɔ; ejakaa níhi nɛ wa pee ɔ, a he hiɔwo nɛ wa na a nɛ.
Se nyumu nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sɛ.” Nɛ e de Yesu ke, “Yesu, ke o ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ɔ, kai mi!” Yesu de lɛ ke, “I ngɛ mo si woe kaa mwɔnɛ ɔ, i kɛ mo maa hi Paradeiso.” Yesu gbo Piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, pu jɔɔ kpɛmi, nɛ diblii wo ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ mi.
Nɛ sɔlemi we ɔ mi pomi bo ɔ mi gba enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ, i tu ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo o dɛ mi!” Nɛ e de kikɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e ma nya.
Benɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, e je Mawu yi, nɛ e de ke, “E ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa nyumu nɛ ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ!” Ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ba nɔ́ hyɛmi, nɛ ba bua a he nya a, benɛ a na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, kikɛ nɛ ɔ mɛ tsuo a ngɛ a gugue ma gbae, nɛ a kɛ kpale a se kɛ ho we mi ya kɛ aywilɛho.
Nihi tsuo nɛ le Yesu saminya, kɛ yihi nɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ je Galilea a hu daa si ngɛ se lokoo ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe.
A pu Yesu -Nyumu ko hi si.
E biɛ ji Yosef, nɛ e je Yudea ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Arimatia a. Nɔmlɔ kpakpa, kɛ Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ blɔ hyɛe.
Kpe nguaa a mi no ji lɛ mohu, se yi mi nɛ a to, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ, lɛɛ e kplɛɛ we.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ ya Pilato ngɔ, nɛ e ya bi lɛ nɛ e ha lɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ. E ya je gbogboe ɔ kɛ kple si, nɛ e ngɔ kploba ngɔ blaa lɛ, nɛ e ya to lɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ ko mi.
Yɔkɔ nɛ ɔ, a kpɛ ngɛ tɛ sa mi, nɛ a tui nɔ ngɛ mi hyɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji he dlami ligbi ɔ nɛ, nɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ su ta.
Yihi nɛ nyɛɛ Yesu se kɛ je Galilea a, a kɛ Yosef ho, nɛ a ya na yɔkɔ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ a to Yesu gbogboe ɔ ha.
A kpale a se kɛ ho we mi ya ya hla tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ nu via ngɔ to.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a jɔɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa a pee ɔ.
Yesu te si Otsi ɔ we kekleekle ligbi mɔtu mla a, yi ɔmɛ hɛɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a dla ngɔ to ɔ kɛ ba yɔkɔ ɔ he.
A na kaa a kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sɛ mi; se a nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ a pee yaa kɛ daa si.
Tlukaa a, nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ wo tade nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klãiklãi ba da si ngɛ a kasa nya.
Yi ɔmɛ ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ bu si.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hɛ kalɔ ɔ hlae ngɛ ni gbogboehi a kpɛti?
[ E be hiɛ ɔ; a tle lɛ si.]
Nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ e de nyɛ benɛ e ngɛ Galilea a ke ‘Ja a ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ wo yayami peeli a dɛ mi, nɛ a sɛu lɛ; se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, e maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu’ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ yi ɔmɛ kai munyuhi nɛ e tu ɔ.
A kpale a se kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ he, nɛ a ya sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ha bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo.
Maria Magdalena, kɛ Yohana, kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria, kɛ yi kpa komɛ nɛ piɛ a he ɔ ji nihi nɛ ba sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
Bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ yi ɔmɛ ba de mɛ ɔ kaa nyazia, nɛ a he we yi.
[ Se Petro te si, nɛ e sa fo kɛ ya yɔkɔ ɔ he.
E kɔkɔ e yi si, nɛ e na kploba amɛ nɛ pueɔ si.
Nɔ́ nɛ ba a pee lɛ nyakpɛ saminya; kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya.]
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ e se nyɛɛli enyɔ komɛ Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ pue nɔ kɛ yaa kɔpe ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Emao ɔ. Kɔpe nɛ ɔ kɛ Yerusalem kɛmi maa pee si tomi kpaago.
Benɛ a yaa a, a ngɛ níhi nɛ ba a tsuo a he ní sɛɛe.
Benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ sɛɛe nɛ a ngɛ a he sanehi bie ɔ, Yesu nitsɛ ba na mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ.
A na lɛ, se a yo we lɛ.
Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ sɛɛe ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ?” A da si kɛ a hɛ mi mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kleopa a de lɛ ke, “I heɔ yeɔ kaa mo pɛ ji nubwɔ ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ li sanehi nɛ ba lejɛ ɔ lingmi nɛ ɔ!” E bi ke, “Mɛni sanehi?” A he nɔ ke, “Sanehi nɛ ba Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ nɔ ɔ!
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, gbalɔ ji lɛ.
E pee nyakpɛ níhi, nɛ e tu munyu nguahi nɛ sa Mawu, kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi.
Wa osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ ha nɛ a bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ a sɛu lɛ.
Jinɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hyɛ blɔ kaa lɛ nɛ e ma ba kpɔ Israel!
Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, mwɔnɛ ɔ ji ligbi etɛne nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ba mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, yihi nɛ ngɛ wa kpɛti ɔ, a ti ni komɛ ha nɛ wa nya kpɛ wa he.
Makɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a ya yɔkɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nɛ gbogboe ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba, nɛ a ba de wɔ ke Mawu bɔfo komɛ je a he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ de mɛ ke Yesu hɛ ngɛ.
Nihi nɛ waa kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ hu ya yɔkɔ ɔ he, nɛ a ya na yɔkɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ yi ɔmɛ ba de ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se Yesu ɔ lɛɛ a nɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke, “Kuasiahi nɛ nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ ma he níhi tsuo nɛ gbali ɔmɛ de ɔ maa ye!
E hia kaa Kristo ɔ nɛ na amanehlu nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ e sɛ e nyami ɔ mi.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu tsɔɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngmami ɔmɛ de ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ a sisi; e je sisi kɛ je Mose womi ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a ni ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Benɛ a miɔ nɛ a maa su kɔpe mi he nɛ a yaa a, Yesu pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ e yaa e hɛ mi.
Se a nyɛ e nɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Ba to wɔ; ejakaa je ngɛ jɔe, nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ du ma bu.” Nɛ e kɛ mɛ ho, nɛ e ya to mɛ.
Benɛ e kɛ mɛ hii si nɛ a ngɛ ní yee ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ.
A yo lɛ si kake too; kɛkɛ nɛ e laa mɛ, nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu.
A de a he ke, “Benɛ wa ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ma nɛ e ngɛ wɔ ngmami ɔmɛ a sisi tsɔɔe ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ wa nɔ gbagba te ha!” A te si pam, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya nɔuu.
A ya na kaseli nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mɛ tsuo a de ni enyɔ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ te si niinɛ!
E je e he kpo tsɔɔ Simon!” Ni enyɔ ɔmɛ hu bɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a yo lɛ benɛ e ku abolo ɔ mi ɔ. Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ Benɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ amaniɛ nɛ ɔ bɔe ɔ, tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ba da a kpɛti, [nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ he manye.”] A tsui po, ejakaa a susu kaa a na kpade.
Se e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ko je nɔ́ hulɔ!
Nyɛɛ hyɛ ye nine kɛ ye nane, nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa imi nitsɛ.
Nyɛɛ ta ye he, nɛ nyɛ maa na; ejakaa kpade be he lo kɛ wu kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hyɛe ɔ.” [ Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ, e je e nine, kɛ e nane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.]
Bua jɔmi babauu nɛ a na, kɛ bɔ nɛ nɔ́ ɔ pee mɛ nyakpɛ he je ɔ, a he we yi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a yeɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ lo?” A ha lɛ lo kpɔ kake nɛ a hoo, nɛ e he nɛ e ye ngɛ a hɛ mi paa.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ i deɔ nyɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: níhi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ ye he ngɛ Mose mlaa a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ La womi ɔ a mi ɔ, ja lɛ tsuo ba mi.” Jehanɛ ɔ, e bli a juɛmi nya, konɛ a nu ngmami ɔmɛ a sisi.
E de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ a ngma ji kaa ja a gbe Kristo ɔ, nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ligbi etɛ se.
A ngma hu ke, a maa fiɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo ngɛ e biɛ mi kaa a tsake a tsui, konɛ a ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ.
A maa je sisi kɛ je Yerusalem.
Nyɛ ji kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase yeli, nɛ ma ha Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ wo si ɔ.
Se nyɛɛ hi Yerusalem ma a mi kɛ yaa si he wami nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ.” A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho hiɔwe ya Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ngɔ mɛ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ho Betania ya; nɛ e wo e ninehi a nɔ, nɛ e gbaa mɛ.
Benɛ e ngɛ mɛ gbae ɔ, e je a he, [nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ja lɛ,] nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya kɛ bua jɔmi babauu.
Daa nɛ ɔ, o maa na mɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ a ngɛ Mawu yi jee.
NYA TSƆƆMI Yohane Sane Kpakpa a tsɔɔ kaa Yesu ji Mawu Munyu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɛ.
Munyu ɔ “ba plɛ pee adesa, nɛ e kɛ wɔ hi si.” Womi ɔ nitsɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yohane ngma sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ maa kane ɔ, a he ye kaa Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ a wo si kaa e ma ba kpɔ je ɔ; nɛ ke a he Yesu ye ɔ, a ma he a yi wami .
Sisije ɔ, womi ɔ tsɔɔ nya kpiti kaa Yesu ji Mawu Munyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔɔ okadi komɛ nɛ Yesu pee kɛ tsɔɔ kaa lɛ ji kpɔlɔ kɛ Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ a wo si ke e ma ba kpɔ je ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, okadihi nɛ e to ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ nya.
Womi ɔ tsɔɔ kaa ni komɛ he Yesu ye, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se; se ni komɛ te si ngɔ si lɛ, nɛ a he we lɛ yi.
Yi - ɔ tsɔɔ suɔmi agbo nɛ Yesu je kpo tsɔɔ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɛ a nu lɛ ɔ, kɛ he wami womi munyuhi nɛ e tu mɛ loko a sɛu lɛ.
Womi ɔ nyagbe ɔ tsɔɔ kaa a nu Yesu, nɛ a kojo lɛ; a sɛu lɛ, nɛ e gbo; se e kpale kɛ ba wami mi ekohu, nɛ e je e he si tsɔɔ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ si abɔ.
A kɛ yo nɛ ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ ɔ he sane ɔ wo kla mi, ejakaa e be blema womi kpohi fuu, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ sisi ɔ ekomɛ a mi.
Nɛ ní nɛmɛ a mi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ pohu, he kpahi a kɛ wo.
Yohane ma nɔ mi veveeve kaa Kristo nɔ a gu ngɔ neneene wami ngɔ ha je ɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ nɔ kaa Yesu ji blɔ ɔ, anɔkuale ɔ, kɛ wami ɔ, mɛ a naa kikɛmɛ a nɔke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Yohane ngɔɔ je mi si himi mi níhi kɛ toɔ nɔ́ he kɛ tsɔɔ mumi mi níhi a nya saminya.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ji nyu, abolo, la, to hyɛlɔ kɛ e tohi, kɛ wai tso kɛ e yiblii.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije munyu .- Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ, kɛ Yesu kekleekle kaseli ɔmɛ .- Yesu ní tsumi .—.
Nyagbe be ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem .—.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si temi, kɛ e he kpo jemi .- Nyagbe munyu: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je e he kpo ngɛ Galilea .-
Munyu nɛ haa nɔ wami Loko nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ je sisi ɔ, Munyu ɔ ngɛ momo.
Munyu ɔ kɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ, nɛ Munyu ji ɔ Mawu ngɛ.
Munyu ɔ kɛ Mawu kɛ je sisije, nɛ Munyu ɔ nɔ Mawu gu kɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ, a si we Munyu ɔ se kɛ pee ekoeko.
Wami ngɛ Munyu ɔ mi, nɛ wami nɛ ɔ ngɔ la ba ha nimli adesahi.
La a ngɛ tsoe ngɛ diblii mi, se diblii ɔ nyɛ we lɛ nɛ e gbe gblegbleegble.
Mawu tsɔ nɔ ko kɛ ba je ɔ mi.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Yohane.
E ba nɛ e ba ye la a he odase ha nimli adesahi, konɛ mɛ tsuo a he ye.
Yohane ɔ, pi lɛ ji la a; mohu e ba ye la a he odase.
La nɛ ɔ ji la nɛ tsoɔ haa nimli adesahi tsuo.
Munyu ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ e nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ, se mohu je ɔ yo we lɛ.
E ba lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi, se e ma mi bi ɔmɛ he we lɛ.
Se nihi tsuo nɛ he lɛ atuu, nɛ a he lɛ ye ɔ, e ha mɛ blɔ nya kaa a ba pee Mawu bimɛ.
A pee mɛ Mawu bimɛ, pi ngɛ he lo nya kaa nyumu fɔɔ bi aloo nɔmlɔ adesa suɔmi nya; Mawu mi a je kɛ fɔ mɛ.
Munyu ɔ ba plɛ adesa, nɛ e kɛ wɔ hi si.
Dloomi kɛ anɔkuale hyi lɛ babauu.
Wa na lɛ, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kaa lɛ pɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ Bi.
Yohane ye e he odase.
E kɛ ngmlaa de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he munyu nɛ i tu ke, ‘Nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se; se e pã mi, ejakaa e ngɛ loko i ngɛ’ ɔ nɛ.” E mi mi hi kɛ be nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ dloomi nɔtonɔto.
Mawu ha wɔ mlaa kɛ gu Mose nɔ, se dloomi kɛ anɔkuale gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ ba.
Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ lɛ hyɛ.
E bi kake too ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ha.
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ tsɔ osɔfo komɛ, kɛ Levi bi komɛ Yohane ngɔ.
A ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo?” Yohane laa we nɔ́ ko nɔ, se e gba mi paa ke, “Tsa pi imi ji Kristo ɔ.” A bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo mɔ?
Eliya lo?” Yohane he nɔ ke, “Tsa pi imi ji Eliya.” A bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Mo ji gbalɔ ɔ lo?” Yohane he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!” Jehanɛ ɔ, a kpale bi lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo mɔ?
Tsɔɔ wɔ koo!
Ejakaa nihi nɛ tsɔ wɔ ɔ, e hia kaa wa ya ha mɛ heto.
Kɛ o deɔ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he kɛɛ?” Yohane he nɔ ke, “Imi ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ nga a nɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ dla blɔ ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ,’ kaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya de ɔ nɛ.” Nihi nɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba a kpale bi lɛ ke, “Ke pi mo ji Kristo ɔ, pi Eliya ji mo, nɛ pi mo ji gbalɔ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he nɛ o ngɛ nihi sɔlee mɔ?” Yohane he nɔ ke, “Imi lɛɛ nyu i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sɔlee; se nɔ ko daa si ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ li lɛ.
I sɛ e hlami kɛ ba mohu, se i sɛ nɔ nɛ pɛneɔ e tokota nya kpa tete po.” A pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Betania, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je, he nɛ Yohane ngɛ nihi sɔlee ngɛ ɔ. Mawu To Bi ɔ E nɔ jena a, Yohane na Yesu nɛ ma e ngɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, Mawu To Bi ɔ nɛ woɔ je ɔ he yayami kɛ yaa a, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he nɛ i de ngɛ ke, ‘Nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se, se e pe mi, ejakaa e ngɛ loko i ngɛ’ ɔ nɛ.
Imi nitsɛ i li lɛ, se i kɛ nyu ba ngɛ nihi sɔlee, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel ma a nɛ le lɛ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yohane tu munyu kɛ ye Yesu he odase ke, “I na Mumi ɔ nɛ kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kaa lahuɛ ba ma e nɔ.
Imi hu jinɛ i li lɛ, se Mawu, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba sɔle nihi ngɛ nyu mi ɔ lɛ de mi ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ Mumi ɔ ma ba ma a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ sɔle nihi.’ Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi jã pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ i na, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ odase yee ke Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ.” Yesu tsɛ kekleekle kaseli E nɔ jena benɛ Yohane kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ daa si ekohu ɔ, e na Yesu nɛ bee.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yohane de ke, “Ne Mawu To Bi ɔ!” Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ kaseli enyɔ ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a ya nyɛɛ Yesu se kɛ yaa.
