Benɛ Yesu plɛ e he, nɛ e na kaa kaseli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” A he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, jije o hii?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ.” (Jamɛ a be ɔ, a fia gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ eywiɛ).
Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya na e hi he ɔ; nɛ a kɛ lɛ hi si kɛ ya si du bu.
Kaseli enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake biɛ ji Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi ɔ. E kɛ we kulaa nɛ Andrea kɛ e nyɛmi Simon ba kpe.
Andrea de Simon ke, “Wa na Mesia a.” (Mesia sisi ji Kristo).
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Simon kɛ ya Yesu ngɔ.
Yesu hyɛ Simon too, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tse mo ji Yohane bi Simon ɔ. Jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ mo Kefa.” (E sisi ji Petro, loo tɛ sa.)
Yesu tsɛ Filipo kɛ Natanael E nɔ jena a, Yesu to e yi mi kaa e maa ya Galilea.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ Filipo kpe, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Filipo, nyɛɛ ye se.” Filipo je Betsaida, ma mi he nɛ Andrea kɛ Petro hu je ɔ. Benɛ Filipo hu kɛ Natanael ya kpe ɔ, Filipo de lɛ ke, “Natanael, hyɛ, nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ Mose ngma e he sane ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu tu e he munyu ɔ, wa na lɛ.
Lɛ ji Yosef bi Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.” Se Natanael bi Filipo ke, “Anɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko maa je Nazaret lo?” Filipo he nɔ ke, “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!” Benɛ Yesu na Natanael nɛ ma e ngɔ ɔ, e de ke, “Israel no ngmingmiingmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; sé ko be e he.” Natanael bi Yesu ke, “Jije o le mi ngɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “I na mo pi mwɔnɛ; i na mo ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ sisi tɔɔ loko Filipo tsɛ mo.” Natanael kpale he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, niinɛ, mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ!
Mo ji Israel matsɛ ɔ nɛ!” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu bi Natanael ke, “Akɛnɛ i de mo ke i na mo ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ sisi ɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ o he ye ɔ?
O maa na ní nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔ.” Nyagbe ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke hiɔwe nya ma bli, nɛ nyɛ maa na Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kuɔe kɛ ngɛ imi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ye ngɔ bae, nɛ a ngɛ kpalee kɛ ngɛ yae.”
A kpee yo ngɛ Kana E nɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, a kpee yo ngɛ Galilea ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Kana a. Yesu nyɛ ya lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a fɔ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu nine kɛ ya yo kpeemi ɔ.
Be saii mi ɔ, wai nɛ a ngɛ nue ɔ ta; nɛ Yesu nyɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Ni ɔmɛ a wai ɔ ta.” Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Maa, mɛni he je o ngɛ ye nya dooe?
Be nɛ ma tsu ní ɔ sui lolo.” Jehanɛ ɔ Yesu nyɛ de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee.” Yuda bi a kusumi ji a fɔ a he nɛ a kɛ tsú a he.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, didɔ ekpa maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Didɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko tsuaa eko yeɔ nyu lita lafa.
Yesu de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wo didɔ ɔmɛ a mi nyu nɛ a hyi.” A pee jã.
Jehanɛ ɔ, e de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ yɛ eko ya ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ.” A yɛ nyu nɛ plɛ pee wai ɔ ya ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ, nɛ e sa e nya.
Tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ wo didɔ ɔmɛ a mi nyu ɔ le he nɛ wai nɛ ɔ je; se ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ lɛɛ e li.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke a tsɛ ní yemi ɔ, wai kpakpa a kɛ ba maa si kekle; nɛ ke ni ɔmɛ nu bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ ɔ loko a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɛ ɔ baa.
Se moo lɛɛ o ngɔ wai kpakpa a ngɔ to kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ.” Enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yesu pee ngɛ Kana ngɛ Galilea kɛ to okadi kaa Mawu ha lɛ he wami; nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ he lɛ ye.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kɛ e nyɛ, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Kapernaum ya, nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ.
Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ su ɔ, Yesu ya Yerusalem.
E ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya na nihi babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ nahi, tohi, kɛ lahuɛhi juae.
Ni komɛ hu hii si ngɛ a we okplɔɔhi a se ngɛ sika tsakee.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ngɔ tangme tsɔwi kɛ pee kpa, nɛ e fie jua yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ a to ɔmɛ, kɛ na amɛ tsuo kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ. E tsitsɛɛ sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si, nɛ e plɛ a sika amɛ ngɔ pue si.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ lahuɛhi juae ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ esɔ!
Tsaatsɛ we ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ kɛ pee jua nɔ.” E kaseli ɔmɛ kai kaa a ngma ke, “Ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ o we ɔ he.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni okadi o maa to wɔ kɛ ma nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ nɔ mi?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ku sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, ma ma lɛ ekohu.” A kpale de Yesu ke, “Sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ, jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ekpa loko a nyɛ ma; se moo lɛɛ o de ke ligbi etɛ o kɛ maa ma lɛ; o ma nyɛ?” Se sɔlemi we nɛ Yesu ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a tle Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ kai kaa e wo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ ta de mɛ hyɛ, nɛ a he ngmami ɔ, kɛ munyu nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ tu ɔ tsuo ye.
Yesu le adesa su Yesu hi Yerusalem Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ tsuo.
E pee okadihi babauu, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na a, a he lɛ ye.
Se Yesu lɛɛ e le mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ e hɛ fɔɛ a nɔ.
E hia we pohu nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ye nɔmlɔ adesa he odase kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le nɔmlɔ yi mi.
Yesu kɛ Nikodemo Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nikodemo.
Farisi no ji lɛ.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ ba Yesu ngɔ nyɔ mi, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ kɛ ba ji mo.
Níhi tsuo nɛ o peeɔ ɔ kɛ toɔ okadi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee, ja Mawu piɛ e he.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a ji hiɔwe fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ e be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi sɛe.” Nikodemo bi Yesu ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ wa a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma fɔ lɛ ekohu?
Anɛ e ma nyɛ kpale sɛ e nyɛ mi mi nɛ a dla fɔ lɛ nɔ nɛ ji si enyɔ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a ji nyu kɛ mumi mi fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ, e be nyɛe maa sɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Adesa lɛɛ adesa kɛkɛ e fɔɔ, se Mumi Klɔuklɔu lɛɛ e fɔɔ nɔ ehe.
O hɛ mi ko pee mo yaa kaa i de mo ke e hia nɛ a dla fɔ mo ehe.
Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, e fiaa kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ e suɔ; o nuɔ e fiami ɔ, se he nɛ e je, kɛ he nɛ e yaa lɛɛ o li.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a je Mumi mi fɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ.” Nikodemo bi Yesu ekohu ke, “Kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ enɛ ɔ maa ba mi?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tse tsɔɔlɔ nguaa ji mo ngɛ Israel!
Nɛ o li enɛ ɔ?
I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke wɔɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa le ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa deɔ, nɛ wa yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ wa na a he odase.
Se nyɛ sume nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ munyu nɛ wa fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ. Ke i de nyɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ níhi nɛ nyɛ he we yi ɔ, lɛɛ ke i de nyɛ hiɔwe níhi ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ he ye kɛɛ?
Nɔ ko yɛ hiɔwe gblee kaa ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kple si kɛ ba a.” Bɔ nɛ Mose wo sinɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu nɛ e sa kaa a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e na neneene wami.
Ejakaa Mawu suɔ je ɔ saminya, nɛ e ngɔ e Bi kake ɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e hɛ mi ko kpata, se mohu e na neneene wami.
Mawu tsɔ we e Bi ɔ kɛ bɛ je ɔ mi nɛ e ba kojo; se mohu e ba, konɛ e ba he nihi a yi wami.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, a be lɛ fɔ bue; se nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ momo; ejakaa e he we Mawu Bi kake too ɔ yi.
Nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɛ a da kɛ bu mɛ fɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: la a ba je ɔ mi, se adesa suɔ diblii ɔ mohu pe la a, ejakaa a peeɔ yayami.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e nyɛɔ la a; nɛ e sume nɛ e baa la a nya, ejakaa e sume nɛ a naa e ní yayami ɔmɛ.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ anɔkuale se ɔ, e baa la a nya, konɛ la a nɛ tsɔɔ kaa e peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní.
Yesu kɛ Yohane Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya Yudea.
A hi lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ, nɛ e sɔle nihi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yohane hu ngɛ nihi sɔlee ngɛ Aenon, ngɛ Salim kasa nya, ejakaa nyu babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi babauu nitsɛnitsɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e sɔle mɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, a wui Yohane tsu lolo.
Pee se ɔ, kusumi nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tsuɔ nɔ he ɔ, Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ, kɛ Yuda bi komɛ sã nya ngɛ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yohane ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ e kɛ mo hi Yordan pa a beleku je nɛ o tu e he munyu ɔ, o kai lɛ lo?
Hyɛ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi babauu ngɛ e ngɔ yae, nɛ e ngɛ mɛ sɔlee.” Yohane he nɔ ke, “Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma na nɔ́ ko kaa ja Mawu ha lɛ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nu nɛ i de paa ke, ‘Pi imi ji Kristo ɔ, se mohu a tsɔ mi kɛ sɛ e hlami’.
Ayɛflo huno ɔ, e nɔ ji ayɛflo ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ayɛflo huno ɔ huɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a, ke e nu ayɛflo huno ɔ gbi kɛkɛ e bua jɔ.
Enɛ ɔ nɛ haa imi hu i naa bua jɔmi babauu.
E sa kaa e ya nɔ, konɛ imi lɛɛ ma ba si.” Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a pe nihi tsuo.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, je mi no ji lɛ, nɛ je mi níhi a he munyu e tuɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ e na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e nu ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he odase e yeɔ, pohu nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔɛ e munyu ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e munyu ɔ yeɔ ɔ, yeɔ odase kaa Mawu tuɔ anɔkuale.
Nɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ ɔ, Mawu munyu e tuɔ, ejakaa Mawu Mumi hyi lɛ tɔ.
Tsɛ ɔ suɔ e Bi ɔ, nɛ e tu nihi tsuo ngɔ wo e dɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ heɔ Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami ɔ nɔ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui Bi ɔ tue ɔ, e be neneene wami nae.
Mawu maa gbla e tue mohu.
Yesu kɛ Samaria yo ɔ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu kaa Yesu ngɛ kaseli babauu nae, nɛ e ngɛ nihi babauu sɔlee hu pe Yohane.
(Anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yesu nitsɛ sɔle we nɔ ko, se e kaseli ɔmɛ mohu lɛ a sɔle nihi.)
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Yesu nu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ngɛ e he ɔ, e je Yudea, nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho Galilea ya.
Benɛ e yaa a, e hia kaa e gu Samaria.
E ba su Samaria ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Sikar a. Lejɛ ɔ kɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ Yakob ngɔ ha e bi Yosef ɔ he kɛ we kulaa.
Yakob vu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, Yesu ba su vu ɔ he, nɛ e ya hi si, ejakaa pɔ tɔ lɛ kɛ blɔ nyɛɛmi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Samaria yo ko ba nyu yɛmi.
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ha mi nyu ɔ eko nɛ ma nu.” (Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ sɛ ma a mi ya nɛ a yaa he niye ní.)
Yo ɔ bi Yesu ke, “Pi Yuda no ji mo lo?
Nɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o ngɛ imi Samaria no nyu bae nɛ o nu ɔ?” (Yuda bi kɛ Samaria bi yi.)
Yesu de yo ɔ ke, “Ke o le nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ Mawu haa nɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ mo nyu bae nɛ ɔ, jinɛ mo mohu o maa ba lɛ eko, nɛ lɛɛ e ma ha mo nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, vu ɔ mi kuɔ, nɛ o be nɔ́ ko hulɔ nɛ o kɛ maa yɛ nyu ɔ. Nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ, jije o ma ná kɛ je?
Wa nɛ̃ Yakob nɛ ha wɔ kikɛmɛ a vu nɛ ɔ; nɛ lɛ nitsɛ, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e lohwehi tsuo nu e mi nyu.
Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsɔɔ kaa moo o pe Yakob ɔ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuu vu nɛ ɔ mi nyu ɔ eko ɔ, kuma maa ye lɛ ekohu, se nɔ nɛ maa nu nyu nɛ imi ma ha lɛ ɔ, kuma be lɛ yee hu gblegbleegble.
Ejakaa nyu nɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ ma plɛ nyu hɛngmɛ nɛ baa nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami kɛ yaa neneene ngɛ e mi.” Jehanɛ ɔ, yo ɔ de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha mi kikɛmɛ a nyu nɛ ɔ mɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, kuma be mi yee hu, nɛ e be hiae po kaa ma ba hiɛ ɔ ba yɛ nyu.” Yesu de yo ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya tsɛ o huno, nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I be huno.” Yesu de lɛ ekohu ke, “Ke o de ke o be huno ɔ, o tu anɔkuale.
O gba nyumuhi enuɔ momo, nɛ nyumu nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ piɔ hu, pi o huno nitsɛnitsɛ ji lɛ.
O tu anɔkuale sisiisi.” Yo ɔ de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i na kaa gbalɔ ji mo.
Wa nɛmɛ ja Mawu ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ, se nyɛ Yuda bi lɛɛ nyɛ ke Yerusalem ji he nɛ sa kaa wa ja Mawu ngɛ.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Maa, he mi nɛ o ye kaa be ma nɛ nyɛ ma ja Tsɛ ɔ, pi yo nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ pi Yerusalem hulɔ.
Nyɛ Samaria bi, nyɛ li nɔ tutuutu nɛ nyɛ jaa a; se wɔ Yuda bi lɛɛ nɔ nɛ wa jaa a, wa le lɛ; ejakaa wɔ nɛ wa ngɔ yi wami hemi kɛ ba.
Jehanɛ ɔ, be ɔ ma, nɛ Mawu ma ha nihi he wami, konɛ a ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi mi kɛ anɔkuale mi kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ suɔ.
Pohu be ɔ su momo.
Mawu ɔ, Mumi ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, ja a ja lɛ ngɛ mumi kɛ anɔkuale mi.” Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “I le kaa Mesia a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ ma, nɛ ke e ba a, e maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Imi nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, imi ji Mesia a nɛ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba je kpo, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa e kɛ yo ngɛ ní sɛɛe.
Se a ti nɔ ko bi we yo ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae; nɛ a bi we Yesu hu nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ yo ɔ ngɛ sɛɛe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ si e paya buɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho ma a mi ya; nɛ e ya de ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba!
Nyɛ ba hyɛ nyumu ko nɛ de mi níhi tsuo nɛ i pee hyɛ.
Anɛ pi lɛ ji Kristo ɔ lo?” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo bu kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ bɔni Yesu pɛɛ kpami ke e ba wo e nya mi nɔ́ ko.
Se e he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ ngma nɛ i yeɔ, se nyɛ li.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ bi a he ke, “Anɛ nɔ ko ba ha lɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye lo?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ye niye ní ji kaa ma pee nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ní; nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ e tsɔ mi tsumi ɔ, ma gbe nya.
Tse nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘E piɛ hlami eywiɛ nɛ a ma kpa ní.’ Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛɛ hyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa ní ba, nɛ e kpami be su nɛ a ma bua nya.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po ní kpalɔ ɔ ngɛ e hiɔwo nae; e ngɛ ngmɔ ní nya buae kɛ ngɛ wami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ toe, konɛ ní dulɔ ɔ, kɛ ní kpalɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ a bla kɛ nya.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a deɔ ke, ‘Nɔ ko duɔ ní, nɛ nɔ ko hu kpaa’ a ngɛ mi niinɛ.
I tsɔ nyɛ ní kpami ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ he nɛ nyɛ du we nɔ́ ko ngɛ.
Ni kpahi tsu ní ɔ, se nyɛ mohu lɛ nyɛ ba na he se.” Samaria bi babauu nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi ɔ he Yesu ye, ejakaa yo ɔ de mɛ ke, “E de mi níhi tsuo nɛ i pee.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e hi a ngɔ.
Nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi enyɔ.
Benɛ Yesu fiɛ munyu ɔ, nihi babauu pe kekle ɔ he ye.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a de yo ɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ pi o munyu ɔ nya hu nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji je ɔ yi wami helɔ ɔ, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu kɛ wa tue kɛ je lɛ nitsɛ e nya a he.” Yesu tsa amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma ko binyumu Yesu ye ligbi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Galilea ya, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e ye odase ke, “A bui gbalɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi.” Benɛ e ba su Galilea a, ma a tsuo he lɛ atuu, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ngɛ Yerusalem Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ a na paa.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale kɛ ba Kana ngɛ Galilea, he nɛ e ha nyu plɛ pee wai ngɛ be ko ɔ ekohu.
Tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma ko ngɛ Kapernaum nɛ e bi be he wami.
Benɛ e ná le kaa Yesu je Yudea kɛ ba Galilea a, e ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e binyumu miɔ nɛ e ma gbo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ho Kapernaum ya nɛ e ya tsa lɛ.
Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Blɔɔ ke nyɛ nɛ okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ be hee maa ye!” Tsɔlɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha waa ho esɔ, ke pi ja a, ye bi ɔ ma gbo.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yaa, o bi ɔ yi na wami.” Munyu ɔ nɛ Yesu tu nyumu ɔ, e he ye, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Benɛ e ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa we mi ɔ, e sɔmɔli kɛ lɛ ba kpe; nɛ a de lɛ ke, “O bi ɔ yi na wami.” Tsɔlɔ ɔ bi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni be hiɔ ɔ fani ha lɛ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Hiɛ̃ piani ngmlɛ kake be mi nɛ aslã a po ngɛ e nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ bitsɛ ɔ kai kaa jamɛ a be ɔ tutuutu nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke e ya, se e bi ɔ yi na wami ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo he Yesu ye.
Enɛ ɔ ji okadi enyɔne nɛ Yesu pee benɛ e je Yudea kɛ ba Galilea a.
Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛ ko ngɛ taku ko he Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nyami ligbi yee ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ Yesu ya lejɛ ɔ. Taku ko kɛ e he kue enuɔ ngɛ To Agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ kasa nya.
Hebri gbi mi ɔ, a tsɛɛ taku nɛ ɔ Betesda.
Hiɔtsɛmɛ babauu, hɛ yuyuili, glɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hule pueɔ si tsuo ngɛ kue ɔmɛ a mi.
[A ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ a ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi.
Be komɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ma kple si ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi; kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ lɛ kekle e ma ya nɔ nyu ɔ mi ɔ, hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ nɛ ngɛ e he ɔ taa amlɔ.]
Nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nue jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔuu.
Yesu na lɛ nɛ hwɔɔ si, nɛ e le kaa nyumu ɔ na we he wami be babauu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “O suɔ nɛ a tsa mo lo?” Hiɔtsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke a ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i be nɔ ko nɛ ma wo mi ya fɔ taku ɔ mi.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, ke ma su lejɛ ɔ, nɔ kpa sɛ ye hlami ya nɔ mi momo.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Tee si, wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ.” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumu ɔ he mi wa lɛ; e wo e sa a, nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi.
Se Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ a tsa hiɔtsɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ de nɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi; wa mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa o hɛɛɔ o sa.” E he nɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ tsa mi ɔ lɛ de mi ke ma wo ye sa a nɛ ma nyɛɛ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ de mo ke o pee jã a?” Se nɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ li Yesu; nɛ pohu nihi babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu sã e he nɛ e je.
Pee se ɔ, Yesu ya na nyumu ɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Bu tue, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ o na he wami nɛ ɔ, koo pee yayami hu.
Ke pi jã a, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba o nɔ ɔ maa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya de Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji nɔ nɛ tsa lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ je hɛ pi Yesu nɛ a bɔni e nya doomi, ejakaa e tsa hiɔtsɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Yesu de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ ngɛ ní tsue be tsuaa be, nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ní tsue.” Nɔ nɛ e de nɛ ɔ mohu ha Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ dɔ pe kekle ɔ po, nɛ a to kaa ja a gbe lɛ.
Ejakaa pi mlaa a nɛ kɔɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e tɔ̃; se e de hu ke e tsɛ ji Mawu, nɛ́ tsɔɔ kaa e kɛ Mawu sɔ.
Bi ɔ ngɛ he blɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke Bi ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi nya.
Nɔ́ nɛ e na nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ e peeɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ peeɔ ɔ, Bi ɔ hu peeɔ.
Ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ suɔ Bi ɔ saminya, nɛ e tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e peeɔ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ Bi ɔ ní nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ tete, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ nyakpɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tleɔ gbogboe si, nɛ e ngɔɔ wami woɔ mi ɔ, jã nɔuu Bi ɔ hu haa níhi nɛ e suɔ mɛ ɔ wami.
Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kojo we nɔ ko.
E ngɔ jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha Bi ɔ, konɛ Bi ɔ nɛ kojo nihi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa wo Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami kaa bɔ nɛ a woɔ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wui imi Bi ɔ, ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi nyami e wui ɔ nɛ.
“I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buɔ ye munyu tue, nɛ e heɔ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami nɔ.
A be lɛ fɔ bue, ejakaa e po mi ngɛ gbenɔ mi kɛ ho wami mi ya.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke be ma, pohu e su ta, nɛ gbogboehi maa nu Mawu Bi ɔ gbi, nɛ a maa ba wami mi ekohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ wami ngɛ e mi ɔ, ja nɔuu e ha e Bi ɔ hu wami.
Tsɛ ɔ ha Bi ɔ he blɔ kaa e kojo nihi, ejakaa lɛ ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ mi kó pee nyɛ yaa kaa be maa su nɛ gbogboehi tsuo maa nu Mawu Bi ɔ gbi, nɛ a maa je kpo kɛ je a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
A ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee kpakpa a, a maa te si, nɛ a maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee yayami ɔ lɛɛ a maa te si, konɛ a kojo mɛ.
Yesu he odase yemi “I be he blɔ nɛ i peeɔ imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɔ́ ko.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ mi ke ma kojo ɔ, jã pɛ i peeɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yeɔ dami sane.
Ejakaa i hla we kaa ma pee nɔ́ nɛ imi nitsɛ i suɔ, se mohu Tsaatsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ní i peeɔ.
“Ke i ye imi nitsɛ ye he odase ɔ, e sɛ kaa a ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ kaa anɔkuale.
Se mohu nɔ kpa nɛ ngɛ ye he odase yee; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i le kaa anɔkuale e ngɛ tue.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsɔ kɛ ya Yohane ngɔ, nɛ e ye anɔkuale ɔ he odase.
Imi lɛɛ i ngɔɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko odase, se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami he je nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee.
Yohane ba kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe, nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ha nyɛ.
Se be bɔɔ pɛ nɛ nyɛ ná e he bua jɔmi.
Imi lɛɛ i ngɛ odase nɛ pe Yohane nɔ́ ɔ, ejakaa ní tsumihi nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ha mi kaa ma tsu ɔ, jamɛ a ní tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ́ i tsuɔ ɔ nɔuu yeɔ ye he odase kaa Tsɛ ɔ lɛ tsɔ mi.
Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e yeɔ ye he odase, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nui e gbi, nɛ nyɛ nɛ lɛ hyɛ hulɔ.
Nyɛ bui e munyu ɔ, ejakaa imi nɔmlɔ nɛ e tsɔ ɔ, nyɛ he we mi yi.
Nyɛ hlaa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi, ejakaa nyɛ susuɔ kaa a mi nyɛ ma na neneene wami ngɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu yeɔ ye he odase.
Se nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ maa ba ye ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ na wami.
“I hla we nimli a hɛ mi nyami.
I le nyɛ su, nɛ i le hu kaa Mawu suɔmi be nyɛ mi.
I ba ngɛ Tsaatsɛ biɛ mi po nyɛ he we mi; se nɔ ko nɛ maa ba ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya a lɛɛ nyɛ ma he lɛ.
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hlaa nɛ nihi nɛ je nyɛ yi, se nyɛ bɔɛ mɔde, konɛ nɔ nɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji Mawu ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma he mi maa ye mɔ?
Nyɛ ko susu kaa imi lɛ ma po nyɛ nya ngɔ ha Tsaatsɛ.
Mose nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ ɔ, lɛ tutuutu ji nɔ nɛ maa po nyɛ nya.
Kaa nyɛ he Mose ye jinɛ imi hu nyɛ ma he mi maa ye, ejakaa munyuhi nɛ e ngma a, ye he e ngma ngɛ.
Se nɛ nyɛ bui níhi nɛ e ngma a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma he ye munyu ɔmɛ maa ye mɔ?”
Yesu ha nihi akpe enuɔ niye ní Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu po Galilea taku ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Tiberia taku hulɔ ɔ. Nimli babauu nyɛɛ e se, ejakaa a na nɛ e tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ to okadi kaa Mawu Bi ji lɛ.
Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a ya hi si.
Be nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ su ta.
Yesu wo e yi nɔ, nɛ e na nimli babauu nɛ bu kɛ ma e ngɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi Filipo ke, “Jije wa ma he niye ní ngɛ nɛ maa su nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nya?” (Enɛ ɔ po e de gu kɛ hla Filipo juɛmi, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee.)
Filipo he nɔ ke, “Sika hiɔ lafa enyɔ nya abolo po be mɛ sue nya mi bɔ kakaaka.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kpa hu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi ɔ de ke, “Jokuɛ nyumuyo ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ hɛɛ abolo bɔbɔɛ enuɔ nɛ a kɛ ngma pee, kɛ lo tsɔwi enyɔ, se lɔ ɔmɛ po tsa sui nɔ́ ko kɛ ha ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a hi si.” Nga babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ tsuo hi si.
Nyumu ɔmɛ kɛkɛ a yibɔ maa su akpe enuɔ.
Yesu kukuɔ abolo ɔ, nɛ e na Mawu si; kɛkɛ nɛ e dla ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E dla lo ɔ hu ja nɔuu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ná bɔ nɛ maa su e nya.
Benɛ mɛ tsuo a ye nɛ a tɔ ɔ, Yesu de kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ bua bibliwi nɛ piɛ ɔ nya nɛ eko kó dã.” A pee jã, nɛ abolo bɔbɔɛ enuɔ nɛ a kɛ ngma pee, nɛ a ye piɛ ɔ, bibliwi nɛ a bua nya a hyi kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Nihi nɛ na okadi nɛ ɔ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ de ke, “Niinɛ, gbalɔ ɔ nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Benɛ Yesu na kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a nu lɛ pani nya, nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ, e sã e he si, nɛ lɛ nɔ kake e je kpoo kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ ekohu.
Yesu nyɛɛ nyu hɛ mi Benɛ pu maa ho si nɔmi ya a, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho taku ɔ nya ya.
A ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ pi Kapernaum, nɛ a ngɛ taku ɔ poe kɛ yaa.
Jehanɛ ɔ du bu, se loloolo ɔ, a nɛ Yesu hɛ mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko hia ngɛ pa a nɔ, nɛ oslɔke ngɛ kue hamahama.
Kaseli ɔmɛ hlui lɛ ɔ kɛ ya saii, maa pee kaa si tomi etɛ, loo eywiɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ a na Yesu nɛ nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e su lɛ ɔ he.
Sawale nu mɛ, se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye!
Imi!” A he lɛ kɛ wo lɛ ɔ mi kɛ bua jɔmi; amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, lɛ ɔ ya sa kpo he he nɛ a yaa a. Ni ɔmɛ hla Yesu E nɔ jena a, ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ tlɔ taku ɔ se ɔ na kaa lɛ kpa ko be lejɛ ɔ.
A le hu kaa Yesu sɛ́ lɛ ɔ mi kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ, se kaseli ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Lɛ kpa komɛ je Tiberia ba sa kpo he he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na Mawu si, nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ye abolo ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ na kaa Yesu be lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a nɛ́ e kaseli ɔmɛ hulɔ ɔ, a wo lɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Kapernaum ya ya hla Yesu.
Yesu ji abolo nɛ haa nɔ wami Benɛ ni ɔmɛ ba na Yesu ngɛ taku ɔ se ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni be o ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, pi okadihi nɛ nyɛ na a a he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae; se mohu abolo ɔ nɛ nyɛ ye nɛ nyɛ tɔ ɔ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ko gbo ngma nɛ puɛɔ ɔ he dengme.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛ hla ngma nɛ hii si kɛ yaa neneene.
Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ hla lɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi Yesu ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní kɛɛ?” Yesu he nɔ́ ke, “Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛ he nɔ nɛ e tsɔ ɔ nyɛɛ ye.” A he nɔ nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni okadi o maa to wɔ, konɛ wa he mo waa ye?
Mɛni o maa pee?
Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye mana ngɛ nga a nɔ.
E ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi ke, ‘E ha abolo je hiɔwe kɛ ba ha mɛ nɛ a ye.’ ” Yesu de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ́ nɛ Mose ha nyɛ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ ji abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ. Tsaatsɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa nyɛ abolo nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ je hiɔwe.
Mawu we abolo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a, nɛ lɛɛ e ma ha je ɔ wami.” Jehanɛ ɔ, a de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha wɔ abolo nɛ ɔ eko daa.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Imi ji abolo nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ba ye ngɔ ɔ, hwɔ be lɛ yee gblegbleegble; nɛ nɔ nɛ he mi ye ɔ, kuma be lɛ yee gblegbleegble.
Kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ, nyɛ na mi lɛɛ, se nyɛ he we yi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ maa ba ye ngɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa ye ngɔ ɔ, i be lɛ fiee kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ejakaa i je hiɔwe kɛ ba nɛ ma ba pee nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ní, se pi imi nitsɛ ye suɔmi nya ní.
Nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ji kaa nihi tsuo nɛ e tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, ngmelu kake kó je mi; se mohu nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle mɛ tsuo si.
Ejakaa Tsaatsɛ suɔ kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na Bi ɔ, nɛ e heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e na neneene wami.
Nɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle mɛ si kɛ ba wami mi.” Benɛ Yesu de ke, “Imi ji abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ”, ni ɔmɛ tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si lɛ; nɛ a bi ke, “Anɛ pi Yosef bi Yesu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?
Tse wa le e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ!
Nɛ lɛɛ e ke e je hiɔwe ɔ?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ e deɔ jã mɔ?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ kpa munyu huitihuiti tumi.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ba ye ngɔ kaa ja Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ gbla lɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ; nɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle lɛ si.
Nɔ́ nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mawu maa tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní.’ Munyu nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tu ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu, nɛ e maa kase ní kɛ je mi ɔ maa ba ye ngɔ.
Se enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa nɔ ko na Tsɛ ɔ hyɛ; ja imi nɛ i je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, imi pɛ nɛ i na lɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami nɔ.
Imi ji abolo nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye mana ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ a gbo.
Se abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ lɛɛ ke nɔ ko ye ɔ, e be gboe.
Imi ji abolo nɛ je hiɔwe nɛ haa nɔ wami.
Nɔ nɛ maa ye kikɛmɛ a abolo nɛ ɔ eko ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Abolo nɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ ji imi nitsɛ ye he lo nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ɔ tsuo yi nɛ na wami.” Jehanɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ sɔuu bɔni nya sami, nɛ a bi ke, “Kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ngɔ e he lo ha wɔ nɛ waa ye kɛɛ?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke nyɛ yi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ he lo, nɛ́ nyɛɛ nu e muɔ ɔ, nyɛ be wami nae.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye ye he lo, nɛ e maa nu ye muɔ ɔ ma na neneene wami; nɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle lɛ si.
Ejakaa ye he lo ɔ ji niye ní nɛ sa nɛ a ye, nɛ ye muɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a nu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye he lo, nɛ e nuu ye muɔ ɔ hii ye mi, nɛ imi hu i hii e mi.
Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hɛ ngɛ; nɛ e ha nɛ imi hu ye hɛ ngɛ.
Jã kɛ̃, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye he lo ɔ, ma ha lɛ wami.
Abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Abolo nɛ ɔ be kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye nɛ pee se a gbo ɔ. Mohu ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ maa ye abolo nɛ ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.” Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ benɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ngɛ kpe he ɔ ngɛ Kapernaum.
Neneene wami munyuhi Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu nɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, de ke, “Ei!
Tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ he wa lo!
Mɛnɔ maa nu sisi.” Benɛ Yesu kɔ se kaa e kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu huitihuiti tue ngɛ níhi nɛ e de mɛ ɔ a he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Anɛ enɛ ɔ maa wo nyɛ nine mi nyu lo?
Ke nyɛ na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ kpale kɛ yaa hiɔwe he nɛ e je kɛ ba a, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ?
Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ nɛ.
Adesa he wami pi nɔ́ ko kulaa.
Munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu nɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ Mawu mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ.
Se kɛ̃, nyɛ ti ni komɛ he we yi.” (Kɛ je sisije ɔ, Yesu lɛɛ e le ni nɛmɛ nɛ be lɛ hee maa ye; nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ hu e le lɛ.)
Yesu ya nɔ de ke, “Enɛ ɔ nɔuu he je nɛ i de nyɛ ke nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ba ye ngɔ kaa ja Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ha lɛ he blɔ ɔ nɛ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu kpale a se, nɛ a kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ we hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛɛ maa je lo?” Simon Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛnɔ ngɔ wa maa ya?
Mo lɛ o ngɛ neneene wami munyu ɔmɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he ye, nɛ wa na le hulɔ kaa mo ji Mawu Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.” Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Anɛ pi imi nɛ i hla nyɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ lo?
Lɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ kake peeɔ Abosiami ɔ?” Blɔɔ, Simon Iskariot bi Yuda e ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa Yuda a, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji lɛ.
Se pee se ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ba tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ.
Yesu kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kpa si ngɛ Galilea pɛ, se e sume nɛ e ya Yudea zugba a mi, ejakaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe.
Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ngɛ sue ɔ, Yesu nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jee hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya Yudea, konɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a na níhi nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ. Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa ma nɛ le lɛ saminya a, níhi nɛ e peeɔ ɔ, e laa we nɔ.
Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu he.” E nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ tete he we lɛ yi.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ye be ɔ sui lolo; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ be tsuaa be hi ha nyɛ.
Je ɔ be nyɛ nyɛe, se a nyɛɔ mi, ejakaa a yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ ngɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a peeɔ ɔ he.
Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ye nyami be ɔ. Imi lɛɛ i be yae, ejakaa be nɛ maa da mi ɔ na we nɛ e su.” Nɛ e de jã a, e tlɔ Galilea.
Yesu ya Gbasisihimi nyami ɔ Nɛ Yesu nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ je ɔ, pee se ɔ, lɛ hu e pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Se e je we e he si paa; mohu e ngɛ e he lae.
Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ hla lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a bi si ke, “Jije e ngɛ?” Ma a tsuo tu Yesu he munyu kusikusi.
Benɛ ni komɛ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ” ɔ, ni komɛ hu de ke, “Dɛbi, e ngɛ ma a nane tɔtɔe”.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e tu Yesu he munyu ngɛ ma a hɛ mi paa, ejakaa a ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbeye yee.
Benɛ nyami ɔ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ya hia si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e bɔni ní tsɔɔmi.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa, nɛ a bi ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ kase we ní ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ e le ní kikɛ nɛ ɔ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji imi nitsɛ ye yi mi; nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ ngɔ ha mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, e maa na kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ je Mawu ngɔ, se pi imi nitsɛ ye he wami nya.
Ke nɔ ko tuɔ munyu ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami nya a, e ngɛ hɛ mi nyami hlae ha e he.
Se anɔkualetsɛ lɛɛ e hlaa kaa e maa wo nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ mohu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ sisimi be e mi.
Pi Mose nɛ wo nyɛ mlaa a?
Nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko yi nɔ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe mi ɔ?” Ma a tsuo he nɔ ke, “Mo nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ngɛ o mi!
Mɛnɔ ngɛ mo hlae nɛ e gbe?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyakpɛ nɔ́ kake pɛ i pee nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi pee nyɛ yaa.
Mose nɛ fa ke nyɛɛ po nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ.
(Pohu pi Mose nɛ de; nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a je sisi.)
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ poɔ bimwɔyo.
Ke Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ poɔ nɔ, konɛ a ko tɔ Mose mlaa a, mɛni he je nyɛ mi mi fuɔ mi kaa i tsa hiɔtsɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ?
Ke nyɛ ngɛ kojoe ɔ, nyɛ kpa nɔ hɛ mi hyɛmi, nɛ́ nyɛɛ ye dami sane.” Yesu ji Mesia a lo?
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ bi ke, “Anɛ pi nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ?
Hyɛ kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ e daa si paa ngɛ ní tsɔɔe nɛ a de we lɛ nɔ́ ko.
Eko piɔ a na kaa lɛ ji Kristo ɔ niinɛ.
Kristo ɔ nɛɛ, anɛ nɔ ko maa le he nɛ e maa je lo?
Tse wɔ tsuo wa le he nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ je.” Jehanɛ, benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní ɔ tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e kpa ngmlaa kɛ bi ke, “Anɛ nyɛ le mi tutuutu?
He nɛ i je ɔ, nyɛ le?
Pi imi nitsɛ ye he wami nya nɛ i ba.
Nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nyɛɛ nyɛ li lɛ.
Imi lɛɛ i le lɛ, ejakaa e ngɔ nɛ i je, nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a pee kaa a maa nu Yesu amlɔ nɔuu, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ta e he, ejakaa e be ɔ sui lolo.
Ma mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he Yesu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi ke, “Anɛ Mesia a nɛ maa ba a ma nyɛ to okadi pe nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ lo?” A tsɔ nihi nɛ́ a ya nu Yesu Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ngɛ Yesu he munyu tue kusikusi ɔ, a kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ nihi ke a ya nu lɛ kɛ ba.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “E piɛ be bɔɔ pɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, kɛkɛ ma kpale kɛ ho nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ngɔ ya.
Nyɛ ma hla mi, se nyɛ be mi nae; ejakaa he nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba lejɛ ɔ.” Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ bi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ke, “Jije po e yaa nɛ wa be lɛ nae hu ɔ?
Anɛ e maa ho Hela ma nguaa amɛ a mi ya ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ Hela bi ɔmɛ ní lo?
E de ke, wa ma hla lɛ, se wa be lɛ nae; nɛ he nɛ e yaa hu, wa be nyɛe maa ya.
Kɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ?” Pa nɛ haa nɔ nyu nɛ wami ngɛ mi Nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɛ ji nyami ligbi nguaa pe kulaa a, Yesu te da si, nɛ e de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba nu nyu.
A ngma ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, pa nɛ baa nyu babaaba nɛ wami ngɛ mi maa fo dɔ kɛ je e tsui mi.’ ” Blɔɔ, Mumi ɔ he Yesu de enɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ nine maa su Mumi ɔ nɔ.
Se jamɛ a be ɔ, Mumi ɔ bɛ lolo, ejakaa a na we nɛ a wo Yesu hɛ mi nyami.
Ni ɔmɛ a mi gba Benɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji gbalɔ ɔ nɛ.” Ni komɛ hu de ke, “Lɛ ji Mesia a nɛ.” Se ni kpa komɛ lɛɛ a bi ke, “Mesia a, Galilea nɛ e maa je lo?
Ejakaa a ngma ke Mesia a maa pee Matsɛ David nina; nɛ jehanɛ hu, Betlehem, he nɛ Matsɛ David hi ɔ, lejɛ ɔ a ma fɔ lɛ ngɛ.” Benɛ a de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ a mi gba enyɔ ngɛ Yesu he.
Ni komɛ pee kaa a maa nu Yesu, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ta e he.
Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he we yi Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba a, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ bɛ ɔ?” Tsɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ tuɔ munyu ɔ, nɔ ko tu we munyu ja gblee.” Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ e pee nyɛ hu kuasia lo?
Anɛ nyɛ nu hyɛ kaa ma nimeli ɔmɛ, aloo Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po he lɛ ye lo?
Ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ pɛ, ejakaa a li Mose mlaa a.” Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nikodemo, nɛ́ be ko ɔ e ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E de ma a ke, “Wa mlaa a nya a, e sɛ kaa wa buɔ nɔ ko fɔ be mi nɛ wa bi we e nya mi kaa mɛni e pee lo.” A he nɔ ke, “Saminya!
Tse mo hu Galilea no ji mo!
Yaa kpa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kaa o maa na gbalɔ ko nɛ je Galilea lo!”
Yo nɛ ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ ɔ [ Benɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo je kɛ ho we mi ya a, Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho Oliv yo ɔ he ya.
E nɔ jena mɔtu mla a, e kpale e se kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Ni ɔmɛ tsuo ba bu e nɔ, nɛ e hi si, nɛ e bɔni mɛ ní tsɔɔmi.
Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ yo ko nɛ ya ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba da ma a tsuo hɛ mi.
A de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, yo nɛ ɔ ya ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ.
Wa mlaa a nya a, Mose fa ke, ‘Yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.’ Moo lɛɛ kɛ o ngɛ dee kɛɛ?” Enɛ ɔ, a de kɛ da lɛ, konɛ a na nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ ya po e nya.
Se Yesu sɔ̃ si, nɛ e kɛ e nine nguɛ ngma ní ngɛ zugba.
Benɛ a ngɛ nɔ ngɛ Yesu munyu bie ɔ, e wo e yi nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ti nɔ nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ, lɛ kekle e fia yo ɔ tɛ ɔ.” Yesu kpale sɔ̃ si, nɛ e tsa ní ngmami ɔ nɔ ngɛ zugba.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ a nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a bɔni jemi kakaaka, kɛ je nɔkɔtɔma a nɔ kɛ ya si e piɛ Yesu, kɛ yo ɔ pɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu wo e yi nɔ ekohu, nɛ e bi yo ɔ ke, “Maa, nihi nɛ ba po o nya a, jije a ngɛ?
A ti nɔ kake po bui mo fɔ lo?” Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bui mi fɔ.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Saminya, imi hu i bui mo fɔ.
Yaa, se mohu kpa yayami peemi.”] Yesu ji la kɛ ha je ɔ Yesu, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Imi ji je ɔ la a nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ ye se ɔ, e naa la a nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ; nɛ e be diblii mi nyɛɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Farisi bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ o ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he odase yee.
Nɔ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ be mi fɛɛ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “E ngɛ mi mohu kaa imi nitsɛ i ngɛ ye he odase yee lɛɛ, se ye odase ɔ ngɛ mi, ejakaa i le he nɛ i je, kɛ he nɛ i yaa.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li he nɛ i je kɛ ba; nɛ he nɛ i yaa hu nyɛ li.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kojoɔ he lo nya, se imi lɛɛ, i kojo we nɔ ko.
Se ke i kojo tete po ɔ, e da, ejakaa pi imi nɔ kake nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee.
Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ piɛ ye he.
A ngma ngɛ nyɛ mlaa a mi ke, ke ni enyɔ ye odase nɛ kɔɔ ɔ, e peeɔ anɔkuale.
Imi lɛɛ i yeɔ imi nitsɛ ye he odase, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hu yeɔ ye he odase.” A bi lɛ ke, “O Tsɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ li mi, nɛ Tsaatsɛ hu nyɛ li lɛ.
Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ nyɛ maa le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.” Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, be mi nɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ tsu mi he nɛ a kɛ tó tsumi daka amɛ to ɔ.
Se a nui lɛ, ejakaa e be ɔ sui.
He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ya Yesu kpale de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Imi lɛɛ i yaa!
Nyɛ ma hla mi, se nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami.
He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ bi ke, “Ke e de ke he nɛ e yaa a, wa be nyɛe maa ya a, kɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ?
E yaa gbe e he lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ je nɛ ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ; se imi lɛɛ hiɔwe i je.
Je nɛ ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i ji je nɛ ɔ mi.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔ nɛ.
Niinɛ, nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ke nyɛ he we yi kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ.” A bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Sisije ɔ, mɛni i de nyɛ ɔ?
I le nyɛ he sanehi babauu nɛ ma kɛ kojo nyɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ i nu kɛ je e nya a, lɔ ɔ i deɔ je ɔ.” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a li kaa Tsɛ ɔ he munyu Yesu kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ. Jehanɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ná wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa i to we imi nitsɛ ye yi mi kɛ tsu we nɔ́ ko gblegbleegble.
Mohu nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ i deɔ.
Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ; e si we imi nɔ kake too, ejakaa i peeɔ e suɔmi nya ní.” Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nihi babauu nɛ nu ɔ he lɛ ye.
Odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi Yesu de Yuda bi nɛ he lɛ ye ɔ ke, “Ke nyɛ pɛtɛ ye munyu ɔ he ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa pee ye kaseli nitsɛnitsɛmɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le anɔkuale ɔ; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.” A he nɔ ke, “Abraham nina ji wɔ, nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa yi nyɔguɛ ha nɔ ko hyɛ.
Ke o de ke, ‘Nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he’ ɔ, kɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ nyɔguɛ ji lɛ.
Nyɔguɛ hí we mi kɛ yɛ neneene, se bi lɛɛ e hii si kɛ yaa neneene.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Bi ɔ ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he niinɛ.
I le kaa Abraham nina ji nyɛ!
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɛ ye tsɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nyɛɛ gbe mohu ɔ. Imi lɛɛ níhi nɛ Tsaatsɛ tsɔɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ i deɔ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ tsɛ ɔ de nyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ peeɔ.” A he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa tsɛ ji Abraham.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Abraham nina ji nyɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa pee níhi nɛ Abraham pee ɔ nɔuu.
Imi lɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i nu kɛ je Tsaatsɛ Mawu nya a, lɔ ɔ i deɔ nyɛ; se nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe.
Abraham pee we nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Níhi nɛ nyɛ tsɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ peeɔ ɔ nɛ.” A he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ pi ajuama mi bimɛ ji wɔ.
Wa ngɛ tsɛ kake.
Wa tsɛ ji Mawu.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Mawu ji nyɛ Tsɛ niinɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa suɔ mi, ejakaa Mawu nɛ tsɔ mi; se pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ ba.
Mawu ngɔ nɛ i je kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, nyɛ nɛ nya, ejakaa nyɛ bui ye munyu ɔ. Nyɛ tsɛ nɛ fɔ nyɛ ji Abosiami; nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee e suɔmi nya ní.
Kɛ je sisije ɔ, nɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ anɔkuale yi gblegbleegble, ejakaa anɔkuale be e mi.
Ke e ye lakpa a, e tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ e su ngɛ, ejakaa lakpatsɛ kpanaku ji lɛ.
Se imi lɛɛ, i tuɔ anɔkuale; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he we mi yi.
Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ tsɔɔ kaa i pee yayami.
Ke anɔkuale i tuɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je nyɛ he we mi yi ɔ?
Nɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, e nuɔ Mawu munyu.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nui, ejakaa pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ nyɛ je.” Yesu kɛ Abraham Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Ke wa de ke Samaria no ji mo, nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ o mi ɔ, wa tɔ lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mumi yayami be ye mi.
Imi lɛɛ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami i woɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye he guɛ gbee.
I hla we imi nitsɛ ye hɛ mi nyami.
Se nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ ngɛ hlae, nɛ lɛ nɛ maa kojo.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu ye tsɔɔmi ɔ tue ɔ, e be gboe gblegbleegble.” Yuda bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ná nɔ mi mami kaa mumi yayami ngɛ o mi.
Abraham gbo, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu gbo, se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ dee ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu o tsɔɔmi tue ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble.
Tsaatsɛ Abraham nɛ gbo ɔ, o pe lɛ lo?
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, gbali ɔmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ nɛɛ?
Kɛ moo lɛɛ o buɔ o he kɛɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Kaa imi nitsɛ nɛ i woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, lɛɛ lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko; se hyɛ, Tsaatsɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ ke nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami.
Imi le lɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li lɛ.
Ke i de ke i li lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ lakpatsɛ ji mi kaa nyɛ nɔuu.
Se i le lɛ, nɛ i buɔ lɛ tue.
Nyɛ tsɛ Abraham hla nɛ e na ye bami be ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi.
E na hulɔ, nɛ e nya.” Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mo nɛ o na we jeha nyingmi enuɔ po ɔ, o na Abraham lo?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke i ngɛ loko a fɔ Abraham.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a kukuɔ tɛ nɛ a maa fia Yesu, se e laa e he, nɛ e je sɔlemi we ɔ.
Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ Benɛ Yesu nyɛɛ kɛ yaa a, e na nyumu ko nɛ hɛ yu kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ lɛ.
Kaseli ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ pee yayami nɛ a fɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ?
Lɛ nitsɛ, aloo e fɔli?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ yu nɛ ɔ, pi lɛ nitsɛ nɛ pee yayami, nɛ pi e fɔli hulɔ.
Mohu ɔ, e hɛ yu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu he wami ɔ tsuɔ ní ha.
Nɛ je na nɛ ɔ, ja wa tsu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ní tsumi ɔmɛ.
Je maa jɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma tsu ní.
Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ɔ, imi ji je ɔ la a nɛ.” Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, e la lada pue zugba, nɛ e kɛ lada a pɔtɔ zu.
E ngɔ zu ɔ kɛ ha hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yaa Siloam pa a mi nɛ o ya fɔ o he.” (Siloam sisi ji a tsɔ lɛ.)
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya fɔ e he; nɛ benɛ e kpale kɛ ma a, e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi.
E kpɔ mi bi, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ sa a, a naa lɛ nɛ e hii nɔ bae ɔ bi ke, “Anɛ pi nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ hiɔ si, nɛ e hii nɔ bae be ko ɔ?” Ni komɛ de ke, “Nyumu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Se ni komɛ hu de ke, “Dɛbi, pi lɛ; e je lɛ kɛkɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ nitsɛ de mɛ ke, “Imi ji lɛ.” A bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ pee kɛɛ loko jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ o ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ?” E de mɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesu ɔ nɛ pɔtɔ zu, nɛ e ngɔ ha ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de mi ke ma ya fɔ ye he ngɛ Siloam pa a mi.
Benɛ i ya fɔ ye he pɛ nɛ i bɔni nɔ hyɛmi.” A bi lɛ ke, “Jije e ngɛ.” E he nɔ ke, “I li.” Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi nɔ tsami ɔ he munyu Jehanɛ ɔ, a ngɔ nyumu ɔ nɛ sa a e hɛ yu ɔ kɛ ba Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Akɛnɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ Yesu pɔtɔ zu ɔ nɛ e kɛ tsa nyumu hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ kpale bi nyumu ɔ ekohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na tsami ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “E pɔtɔ zu kɛ ha ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ i ya fɔ ye he, kɛkɛ nɛ i bɔni nɔ hyɛmi.” Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je; ejakaa e bui Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.” Se a ti ni komɛ lɛɛ a de ke, “Kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ma plɛ kɛ to okadihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ a mi gba.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ kpale bi nyumu ɔ ekohu ke, “Tse o de wɔ ke e bli o hɛngmɛ!
Saminya, kɛ moo o deɔ ngɛ e he kɛɛ?” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Se loloolo ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he we yi kaa be ko nɛ be ɔ nyumu ɔ hyɛ we nɔ́.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ bi ji nɛ ɔ?
Nyɛ ke a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ?
Kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ?” E fɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, wa le kaa wa bi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ wa le hulɔ kaa a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ.
Se bɔ nɛ ba nɛ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe amlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ wa li; nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ha nɛ e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi ɔ hu wa li lɛ.
Nyɛ bi lɛ; e wa nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma nyɛ je munyu nya.” Nyumu ɔ fɔli ɔmɛ de enɛ ɔ, ejakaa a ngɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ gbeye yee.
Blɔɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ so ngɔ to kaa ke nɔ ko ma gba mi paa ma de ke Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, a maa fie jamɛatsɛ ɔ kɛ je kpe he ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ de ke, “E wa, nyɛ bi lɛ nitsɛ” ɔ nɛ.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpale tsɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ ekohu, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Ka wɔ kita ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kaa o maa tu wɔ anɔkuale!
Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ tsa mo ɔ yayami peelɔ ji lɛ.” Se nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yayami peelɔ ji lɛ oo, pi yayami peelɔ ji lɛ oo; imi lɛɛ i li!
Nɔ́ kake pɛ i le; be ko nɛ be ɔ, hɛ yuyuilɔ ji mi; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ hyɛe.” A bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Kɛ e pee mo kɛɛ?
Kɛ e pee kɛɛ nɛ e bli o hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ?” E he nɔ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ enɛ ɔ momo nɛ nyɛ bui mi tue.
Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ nu ekohu.
Nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee e kaseli lo?” Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a gbiɛ nyumu ɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Mo ji jamɛatsɛ ɔ kaselɔ; wɔɔ lɛɛ Mose kaseli ji wɔ.
Wa le kaa Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu, se kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, he nɛ e je po wa li.” Nyumu ɔ de mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyakpɛ sane ji nɛ ɔ!
Nɔmlɔ nɛ bli ye hɛngmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ li he nɛ e je!
Wa le kaa Mawu bui yayami peeli tue, se nɔ nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye, nɛ e peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu buɔ lɛ tue.
Kɛ je benɛ a bɔ je ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nui hyɛ kaa a bli nɔ ko nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ hɛngmɛ?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, ke pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je ɔ, jinɛ e ko nyɛ we nɔ́ ko peemi.” A he nɔ ke, “Mo nɛ a fɔ mo, nɛ a tsɔse mo ngɛ yayami mi ɔ, o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsɔɔ wɔ ní?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ je a jami ɔ mi.
Mumi mi hɛ yuyui Yesu nu kaa a fie lɛ kɛ je jami ɔ mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, pee se benɛ e na nyumu ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “O heɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ yeɔ lo?” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛnɔ ji lɛ, konɛ ma he lɛ ma ye?” Yesu de lɛ ke, “O na lɛ momo.
Lɛ ji nɔmlɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.” Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpla si ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi.
Yesu de ke, “I ba je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ma ba kojo, konɛ hɛ yuyuili nɛ hyɛ nɔ; nɛ nihi nɛ susuɔ kaa a ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ, a hɛ nɛ yu.” Benɛ Farisi bi komɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu nɛ e de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a bi ke, “Anɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa wɔ hu wa hɛ yu lo?” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Kaa nyɛ hɛ yu mohu ɔ, jinɛ yayami be nyɛ he; se jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Wa ngɛ nɔ hyɛe,’ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he yayami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ he kɛ mwɔɔ.”
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ to hyɛlɔ ɔ he Yesu de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke to tsu ngɛ, nɛ nɔ ko ya kuɔ kɛ gu he kpa kɛ sɛ mi, se e gui to tsu ɔ nya a, jamɛatsɛ ɔ, julɔ kɛ ojo fialɔ ji lɛ.
To hyɛlɔ ɔ, to tsu ɔ nya e guu kɛ sɛɛ mi; nɛ agbo ɔ nya bulɔ ɔ bliɔ haa lɛ.
To ɔmɛ le e gbi, ejakaa e kɛ a biɛ tsɛɔ mɛ, nɛ e tsɔ́ɔ́ mɛ kɛ jeɔ kpo.
Ke e je to ɔmɛ kpo ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛɛɔ hɛ mi, nɛ to ɔmɛ nyɛɛɔ e se, ejakaa a le e gbi.
Ke nɔ kpa ko tsɛ to ɔmɛ ɔ, a nyɛɛ we e se, se a tuu fo kɛ jeɔ e he, ejakaa a li nɔ kpa gbi.” Yesu tu mɛ munyu nɛ ɔ ngɛ abɛ gbi mi, se a nui sisi.
Yesu ji agbo ɔ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu kpale de ekohu ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke imi ji to tsu ɔ nya agbo ɔ nɛ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba a, juli, kɛ ojo fiali ji mɛ; nɛ to ɔmɛ bui mɛ tue.
Imi ji agbo ɔ nɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba guu agbo ɔ mi kɛ sɛɔ mi ɔ, e yi ma na wami.
E maa sɛ mi, nɛ e maa kpale je kpo ya na niye ní.
Se julɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke e ba a, e ba juɔ; e gbeɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi.
Imi lɛɛ i ba, konɛ nyɛ na wami, nɛ nyɛ na kɛ be nɔ.
Yesu, to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a “Imi ji to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ.
I suɔ kaa ma gbo ngɛ to ɔmɛ a he.
Apaa yelɔ ɔ, pi to hyɛlɔ ji lɛ, ejakaa to ɔmɛ pi e níhi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e na ogbetee nɛ ma a, e siɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ e tuu fo kɛ jeɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ogbetee ɔ ba nuɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ a gbɛɛ fĩaa.
Apaa yelɔ ɔ tuɔ fo, ejakaa apaa yelɔ kɛkɛ ji lɛ, nɛ to ɔmɛ a he nɔ dɔɛ lɛ.
- Imi ji to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ.
Tsɛ ɔ le mi, nɛ imi hu i le lɛ; nɛ jã nɔuu i le ye to ɔmɛ, nɛ ye to ɔmɛ hu le mi.
Nɛ i suɔ hu kaa ma gbo ngɛ a he.
I ngɛ to kpa komɛ hulɔ, se mɛɛ a piɛ we kuu nɛ ɔ he.
Ma ngɔ mɛ hu kɛ ba; a maa nu ye gbi, nɛ a maa pee to kuu kake, kɛ hyɛlɔ kake.
“Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi, ejakaa i suɔ kaa ma ngɔ ye wami kɛ fɔ si, konɛ ma kpale ngɔ.
Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ye wami ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ.
Imi nitsɛ ye tsui mi faa nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ha.
I ngɛ he wami nɛ ma nyɛ ma ngɔ ye wami ɔ ngɔ ha, nɛ ma nyɛ ma kpale ngɔ lɛ ekohu.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Tsaatsɛ ke ma pee.” Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ hu ha nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a mi gba ekohu.
A ti nihi fuu de ke, “Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ godo nue ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lɛ tue bue ɔ?” Se ni komɛ hu de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi be nyɛe maa tu munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛ mumi yayami ma nyɛ bli hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ kɛɛ?” Yuda bi ɔmɛ kua Yesu -Be nɛ e su fĩɛ be, nɛ a ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he tsukɔmi kaimi yee ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, Yesu slaa si kɛ ya be ngɛ Salomo ablanaa a mi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ba bu e nɔ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ yaa su mɛni be nɛ o ma ha wa yi mi maa pee wɔ sikɔsikɔ ngɛ o he?
Anɛ mo ji Kristo ɔ?
De wɔ anɔkuale ɔ koo!” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ momo nɛ nyɛ he we yi!
Tsaatsɛ he wami nya nɛ i tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ níhi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ yeɔ ye he odase.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he we yi, ejakaa pi ye tohi ji nyɛ.
Ye to ɔmɛ buɔ mi tue; i le mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛɔ ye se.
I haa mɛ neneene wami, nɛ a be gboe gblegbleegble.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ mɛ ngɛ ye dɛ.
Tsaatsɛ ha mi nɔ́ ko nɛ pe níhi tsuo, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ dɛ.
I kɛ Tsɛ ɔ ni kake ji wɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kukuɔ tɛ ekohu nɛ a maa fia Yesu.
Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “I pee ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ nyɛ na.
Níhi nɛ i pee ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mi.
Te nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ fia mi tɛ ɔ.” Yuda bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Tsa pi kpakpa nɛ o pee ɔ he nɛ wa maa fia mo tɛ ɔ, se mohu musu nɛ o bɔ ɔ he.
Nɔmlɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji mo, se o peeɔ o he Mawu.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “A ngma ngɛ nyɛ mlaa a mi ke, Mawu de ke, ‘Mawuhi ji nyɛ.’ Wa le kaa nɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi nɛ́ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Nimli adesahi nɛ Mawu tsɔ nɛ a ngɔ e sɛ gbi ɔ ba ha mɛ ɔ po Mawu tsɛ mɛ ke mawuhi.
Lɛɛ imi nɛ Tsɛ ɔ hla mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ ke i de ke Mawu Bi ji mi nɛ́ nyɛ deɔ ke i bɔ musu ɔ?
Ke i tsu we níhi nɛ Tsaatsɛ ke ma tsu ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ko he mi nyɛɛ ye.
Se ke jamɛ a ní tsumi ɔmɛ i tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke nyɛ he we imi nitsɛ yi po ɔ, níhi nɛ i peeɔ ɔ, nyɛ he nyɛɛ ye mɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le si kake nyɔngloo kaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi, nɛ imi hu i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi.” A ka ekohu kaa a maa nu Yesu, se a nyɛ we; nɛ e je a dɛ mi slɔkee.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale e se kɛ ho Yordan pa a se ya ngɛ he nɛ Yohane sɔle nihi ngɛ be ko ɔ, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ. Nihi babauu ba e ngɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Yohane pee we okadi ko lɛɛ, se níhi tsuo nɛ e de ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi.” Nɛ nihi babauu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he lɛ ye.
Lazaro gbenɔ Nyumu ko hi Betania, Maria kɛ Marta a ma a mi.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, a tsɛɛ lɛ Lazaro.
Be ko ɔ, Lazaro ba nu hiɔ.
Lazaro nɛ ɔ, Maria nɛ ngɔ nu kɛ e he via kɛ pɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nane, nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu ɔ nyɛminyumu ji lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ kɛ sɛ mane Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o huɛ nɛ o suɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ gboe.” Benɛ Yesu nu kaa Lazaro ngɛ gboe ɔ, e de ke, “Hiɔ nɛ ɔ be Lazaro gbee, se mohu a maa gu enɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami; nɛ enɛ ɔ nɔuu a kɛ maa wo Mawu Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami.” Yesu suɔ Marta kɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ, kɛ Lazaro saminya.
Se benɛ e nu Lazaro hiɔ he ɔ, e kpale ye ligbi enyɔ sɔuu ngɛ he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa kpale wa se kɛ ho Yudea ya.” Kaseli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, pi lingmi pɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ka mo tɛ fiami, nɛ o yaa lejɛ ɔ ekohu?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Anɛ pi ngmlɛfia nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ peeɔ ligbi kake?
Ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ piani ɔ, e tɛ we si, mɛni he je ɔ, e naa je nɛ ɔ mi la a.
Se ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, e tɛɔ si, ejakaa la be.” Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Wa huɛ Lazaro hwɔ mahe, se i yaa nɛ ma ya tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ.” Kaseli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mahe e ngɛ hwɔe ɔ, lɛɛ e maa hi ha lɛ.” Yesu ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa Lazaro gbo momo, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a susu kaa mahe nitsɛ nɛ e ke Lazaro ngɛ hwɔe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu de mɛ kpoo ke, “Lazaro gbo, se e ngɔ ye nya kaa i be lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he ye.
Nyɛ ha waa ya e ngɔ.” Toma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hayo hulɔ ɔ, de e nyɛmimɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha wɔ hu waa kɛ Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ya, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ya gbo.” Yesu ji si temi ɔ kɛ wami ɔ Benɛ Yesu ba su Betania a, e na kaa Lazaro ye ligbi eywiɛ momo ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi.
Betania kɛ Yerusalem a kpɛti kɛmi maa pee kaa si tomi enyɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda bi babauu ba Marta kɛ Maria a ngɔ, konɛ a ba ye mɛ kɔmɔ ngɛ a nyɛminyumu ɔ gbenɔ ɔ he.
Benɛ Marta nu kaa Yesu ma a, e je kpo nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe, se Maria lɛɛ e hii si ngɛ we ɔ mi.
Marta de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ ye nyɛminyumu ɔ ko gbo we.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu, i le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ o ma kpa Mawu ɔ, e maa pee ha mo.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “O nyɛminyumu ɔ maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.” Marta he nɔ ke, “I le kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɛ ni gbogboehi maa te si ɔ, e maa te si kɛ ba wami mi.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Imi ji si temi ɔ, kɛ wami ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, ke e gbo tete po, e maa hi hɛ ngmengmle; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ, nɛ e heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, e be gboe gblegbleegble.
O heɔ enɛ ɔ yeɔ lo?” Marta he nɔ ke, “Ee Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa mo ji Kristo ɔ nɛ!
Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.” Yesu fo ya Benɛ Marta de enɛ ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ho nɛ e ya tsɛ e nyɛmiyo Maria zaa.
E de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ba, nɛ e ngɛ o si bie.” Benɛ Maria nu enɛ ɔ, e te si pam, nɛ e je kpo esɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yesu ya kpe.
Yesu na we nɛ e su kɔpe ɔ mi lolo; mohu ɔ, he nɛ Marta kɛ lɛ ya kpe ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ e ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ Maria ngɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ na bɔ nɛ e te si nɛ e sá e he kɛ je kpo, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se.
A susu kaa e yaa yɔkɔ ɔ he nɛ e ya fo ya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Maria ya su he nɛ Yesu ngɛ ɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ ye nyɛminyumu ɔ ko gbo we.” Yesu na kaa Maria ngɛ ya foe; nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ Maria he ɔ hu ngɛ ya foe ɔ ha Yesu hao ngɛ mumi mi.
E bi mɛ ke, “Jije nyɛ to lɛ ngɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ba nɛ o ba hyɛ.” Yesu fo ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ ha!” Se ni komɛ de ke, “Pi lɛ nɛ e bli hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ hɛngmɛ ɔ!
Anɛ e ko nyɛ we nɛ e pee nɛ Lazaro kó gbo we lo?” Yesu tle Lazaro si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu Yesu hao ngɛ mumi mi ekohu, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho yɔkɔ ɔ he ya.
Tɛ puɔ nɛ a ngɔ tɛ kɛ tsi nya ji yɔkɔ ɔ. Yesu fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je tɛ ɔ.” Marta, nyumu ɔ nɛ gbo ɔ nyɛmiyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ ɔ puɛ, ejakaa ligbi eywiɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ e gbo.” Yesu de lɛ ke, “Anɛ i de we mo ke, ke o he ye ɔ, o maa na Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ lo?” Jehanɛ a je tɛ ɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu wo e hɛ nɔ nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e de ke, “Tsaatsɛ, i naa mo si kaa o buɔ mi tue.
I le kaa o buɔ mi tue be tsuaa be; se i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ nihi nɛ pueɔ si nɛ ɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he ye kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.” Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɛ lɛ kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Lazaro lee-ee, jee kpo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbogboe ɔ je kpo.
Bo nɛ a kɛ pu lɛ ɔ blaa e nine kɛ e nane, nɛ duku fi e hɛ mi.
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ nɛ nyɛ ha e ya.” A so Yesu yi nɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ ba Maria ngɔ ɔ, a ti nihi babauu na nɔ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ, nɛ a he lɛ ye.
Se a ti ni komɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya sɛɛ níhi nɛ Yesu pee ɔ ha Farisi bi ɔmɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tsɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ a de ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ okadi toe.
Ke wa ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ya nɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, ma a tsuo ma he lɛ maa ye.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Roma bi ɔmɛ maa ba ba kpata wa sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ wa ma a tsuo hɛ mi.” A ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kayafa, nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa yee jamɛ a jeha a de ke, “Nyɛ biɛ pɛ!
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nyɛ ha nɔ kake mohu gbo ngɛ ma a tsuo nane mi ɔ, e hi pe nɛ a ma kpata ma a tsuo hɛ mi lo?” Se anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi nɛ e to kɛ de enɛ ɔ. Mohu ɔ, akɛnɛ lɛ nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa yee jamɛ a jeha a nɛ e ngɛ gbae kaa Yesu ma gbo ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nane mi.
Pohu pi ma a nane mi kɛkɛ, se e ma bua Mawu bimɛ tsuo nɛ gbɛ fĩa hu a nya kɛ pee kake.
Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ yaa a, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ so kaa a maa gbe Yesu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu nyɛɛ we ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a na lɛ paa hu.
Se e je kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya hi ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Efraim ɔ. Jehanɛ ɔ, Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ su ta; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi babauu nɛ je ngmɔ si ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Kusumi nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tsukɔɔ a he ɔ, a ya konɛ a ya pee loko nyami be ɔ nɛ su.
Ni ɔmɛ bɔni Yesu hlami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, a bi a he ke, “Anɛ e maa ba Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ, loo e be bae?” Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ya wo ma a si kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le he nɛ Yesu ngɛ ɔ, e ba wo a tue nɔ, konɛ a ya nu lɛ.
A pɔ Yesu nu ngɛ Betania Jehanɛ ɔ, benɛ e piɛ ligbi ekpa nɛ a maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, Yesu ba Betania, he nɛ Lazaro nɛ gbo nɛ Yesu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ ngɛ ɔ.
A pee niye ní ha Yesu, nɛ Marta sɔmɔ lɛ.
Lazaro piɛ nihi nɛ a kɛ Yesu ye ní ɔ a he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Maria ngɔ nardo nu ngmingmiingmi nɛ he jua wa saminya lita fa, nɛ e kɛ ba pɔ Yesu nane, nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu e nane ɔmɛ a he.
Nu ɔ he via a kpe we ɔ mi tsuo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda Iskariot, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ bi ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ a jua we nu kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ sika hiɔ yi lafa etɛ nɛ a kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ?” Se enɛ ɔ nɛ e de ɔ, pi kaa ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ dɔe.
Mohu julɔ ji lɛ; nɛ akɛnɛ sika kpɛɛ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, ke pee ɔ, e juɔ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɔ woɔ mi ɔ eko.
Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Koo doo e nya; e pee nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ to ye pumi be.
Ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ daa, se imi lɛɛ pi daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.” A so Lazaro yi nɔ Yuda bi babauu nu Yesu he ngɛ Betania, nɛ a bu kɛ ba kaa a maa na lɛ, kɛ Lazaro nɛ e tle si kɛ je gbeje ɔ hulɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ ya so nɛ a maa gbe Lazaro hulɔ, ejakaa e he ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu kua mɛ, nɛ a ya he Yesu ye.
Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi E nɔ jena a, nimli kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ba nɛ a ba ye Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ nu kaa Yesu ma Yerusalem.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kukuɔ tã ba, nɛ a je kpo, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya kpe kɛ a nɔ ose ke, “Mo kpɔ wɔ oo!
Mawu nɛ gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ!
Mawu nɛ gbaa Israel matsɛ ɔ!” Yesu na teji ko nɛ e hi nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke, “Zion biyo, koo ye gbeye!
O matsɛ ɔ ma.
E hi teji bi nɔ.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ nui nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi; se benɛ a tle Yesu si, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami se ɔ, a kai kaa a ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yesu he, nɛ e ba mi.
Nihi nɛ a kɛ Yesu nyɛɛ benɛ e tsɛ Lazaro ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a okadi nɛ ɔ nɛ e to mɛ ɔ he nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ya kpee lɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Tse nyɛ na kaa nyɛ nyɛ we nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛɛ pee.
Hyɛ, je ɔ tsuo nɛ hia kɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ nɛ.” Hela bi komɛ ba hla Yesu Nihi nɛ ya Mawu jami ngɛ Yerusalem nyami be ɔ, Hela bi komɛ piɛ a he.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba Filipo nɛ je Betsaida ngɛ Galilea a ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa na Yesu.” Filipo hu ya de Andrea, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ya bɔ Yesu amaniɛ.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su nɛ a maa wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami babauu.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a du we ngma ngu ngɛ zu mi, nɛ e gbo ɔ, lɛɛ ngma ngu kake ngmelu ji lɛ daa.
Se ke e gbo ɔ, e woɔ yiblii babauu.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ e wami ɔ, e wami ɔ maa laa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e wami ngɔ haa ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e maa to e wami ɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e ma sɔmɔ mi ɔ, e nyɛɛ ye se, kɛkɛ ɔ, i kɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ maa hi he kake.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma sɔmɔ mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.” Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu Yesu de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ye mumi ngɛ haoe ngɛ ye mi, nɛ i li nɔ nɛ ma de.
Anɛ ma de Tsaatsɛ nɛ e tsi amanehlu nɛ ɔ nya nɛ e ko ba ye nɔ lo?
Dɛbi!
Lɔ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ i ba, konɛ ma ba gblee be nɛ ɔ kɛ e mi nɔ́ nami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi.
Tsaatsɛ, wo mo nitsɛ o hɛ mi nyami!” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “I wo ye hɛ mi nyami momo, se ma kpale pee ekohu.” Benɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu gbi ɔ, a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Hiɔwe si”; nɛ ni komɛ hu de ke, “Hiɔwe bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ tu munyu.” Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Gbi nɛ ɔ, pi imi ye he nɛ e pɛ, nyɛ mohu nyɛ he.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, be ɔ su nɛ a maa kojo je ɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ nɔ matsɛ yee ɔ, a ma kpa lɛ.
Ke a wo ye nɔ kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ, ma gbla nihi tsuo kɛ ba ye ngɔ.” Munyu nɛ e tu nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ nɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
Ma kpekpemi ɔ he nɔ ke, “Wa mlaa a de ke Kristo ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ moo lɛɛ o deɔ ke a ma wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ji kikɛmɛ a Nɔmlɔ Bi nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Be bɔɔ ko pɛ nɛ e piɛ nɛ la a kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si.
Be mi nɛ la a ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, konɛ diblii ɔ nɛ ko ba na nyɛ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ diblii mi ɔ, e li he nɛ e yaa.
Be abɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ la a nɛ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ nyɛɛ ye, konɛ nyɛ plɛ la a bimɛ.” Yuda bi ɔmɛ he we yi Munyu nɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu je a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya laa e he.
Yesu pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ to okadi ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi paa, se a he we lɛ yi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya munyu ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Yesaya de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, munyu nɛ wa fiɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ he ye?
Mɛnɔ lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je e he si tsɔɔ?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a he ye, ejakaa Yesaya de hu ke, “Mawu ma a hɛngmɛ, nɛ e tsi a juɛmi nya hulɔ, konɛ a hɛngmɛ ko hyɛ nɔ́, nɛ a ko nu nɔ́ sisi.
Mawu pee mɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ a ko kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a tsa mɛ.” Yesaya de enɛ ɔ, ejakaa e na Yesu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi lokoo, nɛ e tu he munyu.
Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he Yesu ye, se Farisi bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a ye odase paa, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko fie mɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ.
A suɔ kaa a sa nimli a hɛ mi pe nɛ a maa pee nɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Yesu munyu kojoɔ nɔ Yesu de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, pi imi nɛ e he ye, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ e he ye ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na mi ɔ, e na nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ. Imi lɛɛ i ba je ɔ mi kaa la, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, e ko hi diblii ɔ mi.
Ke nɔ ko nu ye munyu ɔ, se e yi nɔ ɔ, pi imi nɛ ma kojo lɛ.
I bɛ nɛ ma ba kojo je ɔ; se mohu i ba nɛ ma ba he je ɔ yi wami.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kua mi, nɛ e ngɔɛ munyu nɛ i fiɛ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ maa kojo lɛ.
Nyagbe ligbi ɔ, munyu ɔmɛ nɛ i tu ɔ maa kojo lɛ.
Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ i de ɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ de ekoeko.
Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ fa ke ma de.
I le kaa nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ fa ke e ba mi ɔ haa neneene wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e de mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ i deɔ.”
Yesu fɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a nane he Benɛ e piɛ ligbi kake loko a maa ye Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ, Yesu na kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su nɛ e ma si je ɔ mi kɛ ho Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya.
Yesu suɔ nihi tsuo nɛ he lɛ ye ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ saminya kɛ ya si e gbenɔ mi po.
Gbɔkuɛ, benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba bua kɛ ngɛ ní yee ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, Abosiami wo Simon Iskariot bi Yuda yi mi momo kaa e tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ.
Yesu nitsɛ le kaa Tsɛ ɔ ha lɛ he wami tsuo nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
E le hu kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je kɛ ba, nɛ Mawu ngɔ nɔuu e kpale kɛ yaa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu te si ngɛ niye ní ɔ he; nɛ e je e tade klɔii ɔ ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ e ngɔ papahu kɛ muɔ e mlɛ mi.
Jehanɛ e plɛ nyu ngɔ wo tsɛ̃si mi, nɛ e bɔni kaseli ɔmɛ a nane he fɔmi; nɛ e kɛ papahu nɛ e kɛ muɔ e mlɛ mi ɔ tsu a nane ɔ he.
Benɛ e ba su Simon Petro ngɔ ɔ, Simon bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o ma fɔ ye nane he ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o nui sisi; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba le.” Petro de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, ko fɔ ye nane he kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke i fɔ we o nane he ɔ lɛɛ o pi ye kaselɔ hu.” Simon Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, lɛɛ tsa pi ye nane he kɛkɛ nɛ sa kaa o fɔ mɔ; fɔ ye nine he, kɛ ye yi mi tsuo.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ du e he ɔ, e he tsɔ kɛ pi si momo; nɛ e hia we kaa e fɔ lɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he pe e nane he pɛ.
Nyɛ he tsɔ, se pi nyɛ tsuo.” Yesu le nɔmlɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ momo, lɔ ɔ he nɛ e de ke a he tsɔ se pi mɛ tsuo ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ Yesu fɔ a nane he ta a, e kpale wo e tade klɔii ɔ, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ niye ní ɔ he.
Jehanɛ e bi kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i pee ha nyɛ piɔ ɔ, nyɛ nu sisi lɛɛ?
Tse nyɛ tsɛɔ mi Tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ mi Nyɔmtsɛ hulɔ!
Saminya, e ngɛ mi jã.
Jehanɛ ɔ, imi nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ nyɛ Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, ke i fɔ nyɛ nane he ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ fɔ nyɛ sibi a nane he.
Imi lɛɛ i pee enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ha nyɛ sibi.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nyɔguɛ pã we e nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ tsɔlɔ hu pã we nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ na le anɔkuale ɔ, ke nyɛ tsu e nya ní ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ!
“Pi nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee; ejakaa nihi nɛ i hla a, i le bɔ nɛ a ngɛ.
Se e sa kaa ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nɔmlɔ nɛ kɛ mi dla ye abolo ɔ te si ngɔ si mi,’ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a, i ngɛ nyɛ dee loko e ba mi, konɛ ke e ba mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye kaa ‘Imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ nɛ.’ I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ nɔ nɛ i tsɔ lɛ atuu ɔ, imi nɔuu e he ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ e he ɔ nɛ.” Yesu de to ke a maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hao wawɛɛ ngɛ mumi mi; nɛ e gba mi kpoo nɛ e de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ.” E kaseli ɔmɛ pee yaa, nɛ a hyɛ a sibi a hɛ mi dii; ejakaa nɔ nɛ tutuutu he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ, a li.
E kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɔ nɛ Yesu suɔ lɛ ɔ, hii si ngɛ e kasa nya.
Simon Petro ma lɛ hɛngmɛ ke e bi Yesu nɔ nɛ he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ hɛ lɛ kɛ su Yesu he haa, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛnɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ma ngɔ abolo kɛ sɔ flɔɔ ɔ mi; nɛ nɔ nɛ dɛ mi nɛ ma ngɔ wo ɔ, lɛ ji jamɛatsɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ̃ abolo popoe, nɛ e ngɔ sɔ flɔɔ ɔ mi; nɛ e kɛ ha Yuda, Simon Iskariot bi ɔ. Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ Yuda sɔle abolo ɔ, Abosiami sɛ e mi.
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, pee esɔ.” Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ Yesu de lɛ enɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ Yuda nɛ hɛɛɔ sika kpɛɛ ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ susu kaa alini Yesu tsɔ lɛ ke e ya he ní nɛ hia nɛ a kɛ maa ye nyami be ɔ, aloo e ngɔ nɔ́ ko ya ha ohiatsɛmɛ.
Yuda sɔle abolo popoe ɔ, nɛ e je kpo amlɔ nɔuu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, je jɔ.
Mlaa he ɔ Benɛ Yuda je kpo se ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ, a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami; nɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Nɛ ke a gu Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ hu maa wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
E ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ amlɔ nɔuu.
Ye bimɛ, be nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si ɔ pi saasaa.
Nyɛ ma hla mi, se kaa bɔ nɛ i de Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ɔ, ‘He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba.’ Jehanɛ ɔ, mlaa he i ngɛ nyɛ woe; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi ɔ, kɛkɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa ye kaseli ji nyɛ.” Yesu de to ke Petro ma de ke e li lɛ Simon Petro bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, jije po o yaa?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “He nɛ i yaa a, amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ o be ye se nyɛe maa nyɛɛ; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba nyɛɛ ye se.” Petro de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni ma ha nɛ i be nyɛe ma nyɛɛ o se amlɔ nɛ ɔ?
Gbenɔ tete po ma gbo ngɛ o he.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ei!
O ma gbo ngɛ imi ye he?
I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ hwɔɔ ɔ, o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi.”
Yesu ji blɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye; nɛ imi hu nyɛ he mi nyɛɛ ye.
Sihi hehi babauu ngɛ Tsaatsɛ we ɔ; ke pi ja a, jinɛ i de nyɛ momo, ejakaa i yaa nɛ ma ya dla he ko ngɔ to nyɛ.
Ke i ya nɛ i ya dla he ko kɛ to nyɛ se ɔ, ma kpale kɛ ba, nɛ ma ba ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya hi imi nitsɛ ye ngɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ le he nɛ i yaa, nɛ blɔ ɔ hu nyɛ le.” Toma bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, he nɛ o yaa a po wa li, nɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛ le blɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ kɛɛ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Imi ji blɔ ɔ, imi ji anɔkuale ɔ, nɛ imi ji wami ɔ hulɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa ja e gu ye nɔ.
Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ nyɛ ko le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa nyɛ na lɛ.” Filipo de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, tsɔɔ wɔ Tsɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɔ ko be wɔ hiae hu.” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Filipo, be babauu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si nɛ ɔ, kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o li mi ɔ?
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na mi ɔ, e na Tsɛ ɔ. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o deɔ ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ?
Filipo, anɛ o he we yi kaa i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi lo?
Munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ de.
Mohu Tsɛ ɔ nɛ guu ye nɔ kɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
Ke i de ke i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye munyu ɔ nyɛɛ ye.
Ke nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ nɛ nyɛ he we yi pohu ɔ, lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i tsu ɔ a he ɔ, nyɛ he ye mɔ.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, níhi nɛ i tsuɔ kɛ toɔ okadi ɔ, lɛ hu e ma tsu.
Ee, e maa pee níhi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ tete po, ejakaa i je kɛ yaa Tsaatsɛ ngɔ.
Ke nyɛ kpa nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, ma pee; kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ gu Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, a maa wo Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, ma pee.
Yesu wo Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he si “Ke nyɛ suɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ Hepiɛlɔ kpa nɛ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si daa.
Lɛ ji anɔkuale mumi nɛ tsɔɔ nihi bɔ nɛ tutuutu nɛ Mawu ngɛ ɔ. Je mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔɛ lɛ, ejakaa a nɛ́ lɛ, nɛ a li lɛ hulɔ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛ nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa e kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ e ngɛ nyɛ mi.
“I be nyɛ sie awusa; ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
E piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ je ɔ be mi nae hu; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa na mi.
Nɛ akɛnɛ i ngɛ wami mi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ maa hi wami mi.
Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa i ngɛ Tsaatsɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ ye mi kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ.
“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ e yeɔ a nɔ ɔ, e suɔ mi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ.
Jehanɛ imi hu ma suɔ lɛ, nɛ ma ha nɛ e le mi saminya.” Yuda (pi Yuda Iskariot) bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ wɔ pɛ nɛ o ma ha nɛ waa le mo, se pi je ɔ tsuo ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke nɔ ko suɔ mi ɔ, e maa ye ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ wa maa ba e ngɔ, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ma ba hi si.
Nɔ nɛ sume mi ɔ, e yi ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Munyuhi nɛ nyɛ nu ngɛ ye nya a, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi tomi, se mohu Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ ha mi sɛ gbi ɔ.
“I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ be mi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ. Tsɛ ɔ maa wo Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Hepiɛlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ba ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia kaa nyɛɛ le ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ; nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ, e ma kai nyɛ.
“I ngɛ nyɛ sie kɛ he jɔmi.
Imi nitsɛ ye he jɔmi i ngɛ sie ha nyɛ.
Pi bɔ nɛ je ɔ haa a nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ. Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui; nɛ nyɛ ko je fɔ̃ hulɔ.
I de nyɛ momo ke, ‘I yaa, se ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.’ Nyɛ nu!
Kaa nyɛ suɔ mi ɔ, jinɛ nyɛ ko na bua jɔmi kaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, ejakaa e pe mi.
I ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee ngɔ to loko a ba mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke a ba mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye.
I kɛ nyɛ be munyu tue be kɛkɛ hu, ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ je nɛ ɔ nɔ matsɛ ɔ ma.
E be he wami ko ngɛ imi ye nɔ; se e sa kaa je ɔ tsuo nɛ le kaa i suɔ Tsɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa a, i peeɔ.
“Nyɛɛ te nɛ waa je hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!
Yesu ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ nɛ “Imi ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ, nɛ Tsaatsɛ ji ngmɔtsɛ.
Ye kɔni tsuaa kɔni nɛ wui yiblii ɔ, e poɔ; se nɔ́ nɛ woɔ yiblii ɔ, e sãã he, konɛ e he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e wo yiblii pe kekle ɔ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ munyuhi nɛ i tu nyɛ ɔ tsu nyɛ he momo.
Nyɛɛ hi ye mi nɛ imi hu ma hi nyɛ mi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ tso kɔni be nyɛe maa wo yiblii ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e dɛ he, se ja e mɛtɛ wai tso ɔ he ɔ, jã kɛ̃ nyɛ hu ke nyɛ hi ye mi ɔ, nyɛ be yiblii woe.
“Imi ji wai tso ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ji kɔni ɔmɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hii ye mi, nɛ imi hu i hii e mi ɔ, e maa wo yiblii babauu, ejakaa ke ye he be mi ɔ, nyɛ be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nyɛe ma tsu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mɛtɛ we ye he ɔ, a sakee lɛ fɔɔ he kaa tso kɔni, nɛ e gbliɔ.
Jamɛ a kɔni ɔmɛ ɔ, a buaa nya kɛ woɔ la mi nɛ a sãã.
Ke nyɛ mɛtɛ ye he, nɛ nyɛ he ye munyu ɔmɛ ye ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ ɔ, ke nyɛ bi ɔ, a ma ha nyɛ.
Yiblii babauu nɛ nyɛ woɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ woɔ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ye kaseli.
I suɔ nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ hi si daa.
Ke nyɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ maa hi si daa.
Imi hu i ye Tsaatsɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, lɔ ɔ ha nɛ suɔmi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha mi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble.
“I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ kaa bɔ nɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ ye mi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ na bua jɔmi babauu.
Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ɔ. Suɔmi nɛ se be ji kaa nɔ ko maa ngɔ e wami ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ e huɛmɛ a he.
Ke nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ye huɛmɛ ji nyɛ.
Jehanɛ i tsɛ we nyɛ tsɔli hu, ejakaa tsɔlɔ li nɔ́ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ tsuɔ.
I tsɛɔ nyɛ ye huɛmɛ mohu, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ i nu kɛ je Tsaatsɛ nya a, i de nyɛ.
Pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hla mi.
Imi mohu nɛ i hla nyɛ nɛ i tsɔ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ ya wo yiblii nɛ maa hi si daa.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ.
Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi.
Je ɔ nyɛɔ Kristo se nyɛɛli “Ke je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi a nyɛ kekle.
Kaa je ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ ɔ, jinɛ a ko suɔ nyɛ sane saminya, ejakaa nyɛ piɛ a he.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ pi je ɔ mi bi hu; lɔ ɔ he nɛ je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ kai kaa i de nyɛ momo ke, ‘Nyɔguɛ pã we e nyɔmtsɛ.’ Nɛ́ a wa mi yi mi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee nyɛ kɛɛ?
Ke a bu mi tue ɔ, nyɛ hu a maa bu nyɛ tue.
Ye he ɔ, a maa pee nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, a li lɛ.
Kaa i bɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ba tu munyu ɔ, jinɛ a ko yi fɔ kaa a pee yayami.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ a be nya jemi ko kulaa ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee ɔ he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ, e nyɛɔ Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.
Kaa i ba tsu we ní nguanguahi nɛ nɔ ko tsu we hyɛ ɔ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, jinɛ a ko yi fɔ kaa a pee yayami.
Jehanɛ ɔ, i tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na paa; se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ngɛ i kɛ Tsaatsɛ tsuo nyɛe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa nɛ e ba jã, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ a mlaa a mi ke, ‘A nyɛ mi yaka gu’ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
“Se Hepiɛlɔ ɔ maa ba.
Lɛ ji Mumi ɔ nɛ haa a leɔ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ nɛ.
Ma tsɔ lɛ kɛ je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ma ba ye ye he odase.
Nyɛ hu nyɛ maa ye ye he odase, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ hi si kɛ je sisije.
“I ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
A maa fie nyɛ kɛ je kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ be maa ba nɛ ke nihi ngɛ nyɛ gbee ɔ, a ma susu kaa Mawu lɛ a ngɛ jae.
Nihi maa pee nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa a li Tsɛ ɔ; nɛ a li imi hulɔ.
Se i ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee, konɛ ke be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛ kai kaa i wo nɔ ta de nyɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsuɔ ní “Sisije ɔ, i de we nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ i yaa nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ngɔ, se nyɛ ti nɔ ko bi we mi he nɛ i yaa.
Se nɛ i de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ tsui yee.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke e hi kɛ ha nyɛ mohu kaa ma je, ejakaa ke i ji ɔ, Hepiɛlɔ ɔ be nyɛ ngɔ bae.
Ke i je ɔ lɛɛ ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Ke e ba a, e maa tsɔɔ je ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a susuɔ ngɛ yayami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ Mawu kojomi he ɔ dɛ.
A juɛmi ngɛ yayami he ɔ dɛ, ejakaa a he we mi yi; nɛ a juɛmi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da he ɔ dɛ, ejakaa i yaa Tsaatsɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu.
Nɛ a juɛmi ngɛ Mawu kojomi he ɔ hu dɛ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ matsɛ ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ momo.
“I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ piɛ nɛ ma de nyɛ, se nyɛ be nyɛe he maa pɛtɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ.
Se ke Mumi ɔ nɛ haa a leɔ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ ba a, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ anɔkuale ɔ tsuo.
Ejakaa Mumi ɔ be lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi toe kɛ de nɔ́ ko; mohu níhi nɛ e nu ɔ, a he munyu e maa tu; nɛ e ma de nyɛ níhi nɛ maa ba.
E maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa níhi nɛ i wo nɔ ta a, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɛ ɔ, ye nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i de nyɛ ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de Mumi ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Bua jɔmi maa ba ngɛ kɔmɔ yemi se “E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu; kɛkɛ ɔ, bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa na mi ekohu.” E kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ bi a sibi ke, “Nɔ nɛ e de wɔ nɛ ɔ sisi nɛɛ?
E ke e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ wa be lɛ nae hu; kɛkɛ ɔ, bɔɔ se ɔ, wa maa na lɛ ekohu.
Jehanɛ hu e de ke wa be lɛ nae hu, ejakaa e yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
‘Be bɔɔ’ nɛ ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ?
Nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, wa nui sisi!” Yesu na kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a bi lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ sisi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “I ke, ‘E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu; kɛkɛ bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa na mi ekohu.’ Anɛ enɛ ɔ he munyu nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he bie ɔ?
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma kpa ngmlaa; nyɛ maa wo yana, se je ɔ ma nya.
Nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, se nyɛ kɔmɔ yemi ɔ ma plɛ bua jɔmi.
Ke yo ngɛ kɔe nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ, e haoɔ, ejakaa e dengme gbomi be ɔ su; se ke e fɔ pɛ, dengme tsuo nɛ e gbo ɔ, e hɛ jeɔ nɔ; ejakaa e naa bua jɔmi kaa e fɔ bi kɛ wo je ɔ mi.
Jã nɔuu, nyɛ hu amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee, se ma na nyɛ ekohu.
Nyɛ tsui maa nɔ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ, nɔ ko be hee ngɛ nyɛ dɛ.
“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, e be hiae kaa nyɛ bi mi nɔ́ ko hu.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e maa pee ha nyɛ.
Kɛ ba si piɔ ɔ, nyɛ bi we nɔ́ ko hyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi.
Nyɛ bi, nɛ a maa pee ha nyɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi babauu.
I ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi “Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, abɛ gbi mi i de nyɛ ngɛ.
Se jehanɛ ɔ, be maa ba nɛ i be munyu tue ngɛ abɛ gbi mi hu.
Mohu ma jaje Tsɛ ɔ he sanehi kpookpoo ha nyɛ.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi.
I de we ke ma kpa pɛɛ ha nyɛ, ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ngɛ nyɛ he suɔmi.
Tsɛ ɔ suɔ nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ suɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ i je kɛ ba.
Niinɛ, i je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ je ɔ mi jee kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ o ngɛ munyu tue paa nɛ pi abɛ gbi mi hu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa na kaa o le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e hia we nɛ nɔ ko nɛ bi mo sane ko.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ o je kɛ ba.” Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he ye lo?
Be ma, nɛ e su ta; nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa gbɛ fĩa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ya lɛ nitsɛ e we mi, nɛ e maa piɛ imi nɔ kake too.
Se pohu pi imi nɔ kake nɛ maa piɛ, ejakaa i kɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ.
I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ hi si, konɛ nyɛ na he jɔmi.
Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, haomi maa ba nyɛ nɔ; se nyɛ tsui nɛ nɔ nyɛ mi, ejakaa i ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi.”
Yesu kpa pɛɛ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ se ɔ, e wo hɛ nɔ kɛ hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ke, “Tsaatsɛ, be ɔ su.
Ha nɛ a wo o Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami, konɛ Bi ɔ hu nɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami.
Ejakaa o ha mi he wami nɛ ma ye adesahi tsuo a nɔ, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, ma ha nɛ a na neneene wami.
Ke a na le kaa mo ji anɔkuale Mawu ɔ, nɛ a le Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ o tsɔ ɔ, a ma na neneene wami.
I wo o hɛ mi nyami ngɛ je ɔ mi; ní tsumi nɛ o tu kɛ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, i gbe nya.
Tsaatsɛ, ha nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami amlɔ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ momo ngɛ o hɛ mi benɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ je ɔ.
“Nihi tsuo nɛ o hla kɛ je je ɔ mi nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, i ha nɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ. O nihi ji mɛ, nɛ o tu mɛ ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi.
O munyu ɔ nɛ i kɛ ba ha mɛ ɔ, a ye nɔ.
Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ a le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ o ha mi ɔ je o ngɔ.
Sɛ gbi nɛ o ha mi ɔ, i kɛ ha mɛ nɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a le kaa niinɛ i je o ngɔ, nɛ mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.
“I kpa we pɛɛ ha je ɔ; mohu ni nɛmɛ nɛ o ha mi ɔ, mɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ha; ejakaa o nihi ji mɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, o nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, imi hu ye nɔ; nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo woɔ o hɛ mi nyami.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i be je ɔ mi hu.
Mɛɛ a ngɛ je ɔ mi, se imi lɛɛ i ma o ngɔ.
Tsaatsɛ klɔuklɔu!
Bu a he kɛ mo nitsɛ o he wami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, konɛ a pee kake kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo wa ngɛ ɔ. Benɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ, i bu a he kɛ he wami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ.
A ti nɔ kake ngmelu hɛ mi kpataa we, lɛɛ ja nɔ nɛ a to kaa e hɛ mi nɛ kpata a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ, i ma o ngɔ, nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee be mi nɛ i ngɛ je ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ, konɛ bua jɔmi nɛ i na a, mɛ hu a na.
I ngɔ o munyu ɔ ha mɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je ɔ ngɛ mɛ nyɛe.
Ejakaa a kɛ je ɔ bɔɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i kɛ mɛ bɔɛ ɔ. I kpa we pɛɛ ke o je mɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi; se mohu i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ o bu a he kɛ je nɔ yayami ɔ dɛ mi.
Pi je ɔ mi bi ji mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu pi je ɔ mi nɛ i je ɔ. Ngɔɔ o we anɔkuale munyu ɔ kɛ tsu a he.
Bɔ nɛ o tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ mɛ tsɔe.
A he ɔ, i peeɔ ye he klɔuklɔu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ mɛ hu a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ anɔkuale mi.
“Pi ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ha, se mohu kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ maa nu sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ a maa fiɛ ɔ nɛ a ma he mi maa ye ɔ. I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ mɛ tsuo a pee kake.
Tsaatsɛ!
Bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ye mi, nɛ i ngɛ o mi ɔ, mɛ hu a hi wa mi jã nɔuu.
Pee mɛ kake, konɛ je ɔ nɛ he ye kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.
O wo ye hɛ mi nyami, nɛ i ha mɛ hu a hɛ mi ba nyami ja nɔuu, konɛ a pee kake kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ. I ngɛ a mi, nɛ mo hu o ngɛ ye mi, konɛ a pee kake kɛ pi si; kɛkɛ ɔ, je ɔ maa na kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi; nɛ bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi ɔ, o suɔ mɛ hu ja nɔuu.
“Tsaatsɛ!
Nihi nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, i suɔ kaa mɛ hu a hi lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ. O ha ye hɛ mi ba nyami, ejakaa benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ je ɔ tete po o suɔ mi.
Tsaatsɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da!
Je ɔ li mo, se imi lɛɛ i le mo; nɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ le kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.
I ha nɛ a le mo, nɛ ma ya nɔ ma pee jã, konɛ á suɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma hi a mi.”
Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nu Yesu Benɛ Yesu sɔle kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ je kpo, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho ya po Kedron pa a, kɛ ya sɛ abɔɔ ko mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda, nɔ nɛ ya tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ ɔ le lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yesu kɛ mɛ pɔɔ kpemi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ Roma ta buli komɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ tsɔli komɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi, nɛ Yuda nyɛɛ a hɛ mi.
A dla a he kaa nihi nɛ yaa ta, nɛ a hɛɛ kanehi, kɛ jatɛhi.
Yesu le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a maa pee lɛ ɔ momo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hɛ lɛ kɛ ba hɛ mi nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” A he nɔ ke, “Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.” Yesu de mɛ ke, “Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Yuda, nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ ɔ hu kɛ mɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Yesu de mɛ ke, “Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ” ɔ, a gbee senyasenya, nɛ a ya nɔ si ngɛ zugba.
Yesu kpale bi mɛ ekohu ke, “Mɛnɔ nyɛ ngɛ hlae?” A he nɔ ke, “Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.” Yesu kpale de mɛ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ momo ke, ‘Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke imi nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛ ye se nyɛɛli nɛ ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a ya.” E de enɛ ɔ, konɛ munyu ɔ nɛ e tu ke, “Tsaatsɛ, nihi nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, i ha we nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po hɛ mi nɛ kpata” a, nɛ ba mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon Petro nyla klaate nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ po osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue.
Nyɔguɛ ɔ biɛ ji Malko.
Yesu de Petro ke, “Ngɔɔ o klaate ɔ kɛ wo e kpo ɔ mi.
Amanehlu kplu nɛ Tsaatsɛ to kaa ma nu ɔ, ma ko nu lo?” A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ya Hana hɛ mi Kɛkɛ nɛ Roma asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtama a, kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ta buli ɔmɛ nu Yesu, nɛ a fi lɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ha Hana kekle.
Hana a, Kayafa nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa yee jamɛ a jeha a ngatsɛ ji lɛ.
Kayafa nɛ wo Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ga be ko kaa e sa nɛ nɔ kake mohu nɛ gbo ngɛ ma a tsuo nane mi ɔ nɛ.
Petro de ke e li Yesu Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kpa hu nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a le jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ saminya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaselɔ ɔ nyɛɛ Yesu se kɛ sɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a we ɔ mi; se Petro lɛɛ e tlɔ sinya a nya.
Pee se ɔ, jamɛ a kaselɔ kpa a kpale je kpo, nɛ e kɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ ya tu munyu, kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Petro kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi.
Yiheyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ de Petro ke, “Tse mo hu jamɛ a nyumu ɔ kaselɔ ji mo?” Petro he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi.” Jamɛ a be ɔ, fĩɛ ngɛ yee, nɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ hã kɛ slɛ la, nɛ a daa si ngɛ la a hlue.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro hu ya piɛ a he nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ la a hlue.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa ta Yesu nya mi Jehanɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a bi Yesu e kaseli ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɔɔmi ɔ he sane.
Yesu he nɔ ke, “I tuɔ munyu paa kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he nɛ Yuda bi kulaa kpee ngɛ ɔ, nɛ i de we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ laami mi gblee.
Mɛni he je o ngɛ imi mohu munyu bie ɔ Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba buɔ mi tue ɔ, bi mɛ nɔ́ nɛ i deɔ mɛ.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ le níhi nɛ i de ɔ.” Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake gba lɛ ma, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Heto nɛ o ha osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ji nɛ ɔ?” Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke i de nɔ yaya ko ɔ, de ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a nu.
Se ke kpakpa a, lɛɛ mɛni he je o ngɛ mi gbee ɔ?” Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ngɛ pã a mi, nɛ Hana ha a kɛ lɛ ya ha Kayafa, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a. Petro de ekohu ke e li Yesu Petro daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ la a hlue kɛ mwɔɔ.
