Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e peeɔ kpakpa nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ kaa lɛ ji Mawu niinɛ; e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ kɛ jee hiɔwe kɛ haa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ kpaa ní babauu ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
E haa nyɛ niye ní, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔɔ saminya.” Dengme kpakpa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ gbo loko a nyɛ nɛ a kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsi bɔ ɔ nɛ jinɛ ni ɔmɛ maa sã ha mɛ ɔ nya.
Yuda bi komɛ je Antiokia ngɛ Pisidia, kɛ Ikoniom kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ ba wo ni ɔmɛ a yi mi, nɛ a fia Paulo tɛ; a sã lɛ si kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a susu kaa e gbo.
Se benɛ nihi nɛ he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye ɔ ba bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, e te si, nɛ e ho ma a mi ya.
E nɔ jena a, e kɛ Barnaba pue nɔ kɛ ho Derbe ya.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba kpale kɛ ba Antiokia ngɛ Siria Paulo kɛ Barnaba fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Derbe ma a mi, nɛ nihi babauu ba he Yesu ye.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Paulo kɛ Barnaba kpale kɛ ho Listra, kɛ Ikoniom, kɛ Antiokia ngɛ Pisidia ya.
A wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ he wami, konɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa.
A tsɔɔ mɛ hulɔ kaa, “E sa kaa waa gblee amanehlu babauu mi kɛ sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.” A ha hwɔ, nɛ a sɔle kɛ hla nikɔtɔmahi, nɛ a tu mɛ ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ a he ye ɔ dɛ mi.
A po mi ngɛ Pisidia, nɛ a ya Pamfilia.
A fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Perga, kɛkɛ nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ba Atalia.
Kɛ je Atalia a, a wó lɛ kɛ kpale a se kɛ ba Antiokia ngɛ Siria.
Ní tsumi nɛ a gbe nya nɛ ɔ, hiɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a tu mɛ ngɔ wo Mawu dɛ mi ngɛ loko a je sisi.
Benɛ a ba su Antiokia a, a bua asafo ɔ nya, nɛ a sɛɛ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ ya tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e bli blɔ ngɔ ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a he ye.
Bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ he ye ɔ hi si be saii.
A kpe ngɛ Yerusalem Ni komɛ je Yudea kɛ ba Antiokia, nɛ a ba bɔni nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ ní tsɔɔmi ke, “Ke a pui nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mose mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ, a be nyɛe ma he nyɛ yi wami.” Paulo, kɛ Barnaba kɛ mɛ sã nya wawɛɛ; nɛ a kɛ mɛ je nɔ́ hluu ngɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a to kaa Paulo, kɛ Barnaba, kɛ a ti ni komɛ hu nɛ a ya bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ he.
Asafo ɔ wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho.
Benɛ a gu Foinike kɛ Samaria kɛ yaa a, a sɛɛ ha nihi ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ bɔ nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hu tsake a tsui.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo na bua jɔmi babauu.
Benɛ a su Yerusalem ɔ, asafo ɔ, kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo he mɛ kɛ hɛmuɔ, nɛ mɛ hu a bɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu ngɔ mɛ kɛ tsu ɔ.
Se Farisi bi komɛ nɛ he ye ɔ, a ti ni komɛ te si nɛ a de ke, “Ja a po ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ a ha a ye Mose mlaa a nɔ.” Bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba bua a he nya, konɛ a hla kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ mi.
Benɛ a sã nya hluu ɔ, Petro te da si, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa be saii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu hla mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ma je li ɔmɛ, konɛ mɛ hu a he ye.
Mawu nɛ le adesahi tsuo a juɛmi ɔ kplɛɛ nɔ kaa a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ hulɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha mɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ. E tsɔɔ we slɔɔto ko ngɛ waa kɛ mɛ wa kpɛti; akɛnɛ a he ye ɔ, e ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ.
Lɛɛ jehanɛ mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ Mawu kae, nɛ tlomi nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ po wa nyɛ we waa tloo ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ he ye ɔ tlooe mɔ?
Dɛbi!
Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ mohu nɔ a maa gu kɛ he waa kɛ mɛ tsuo wa yi wami.” Jehanɛ kpe ɔ tsuo pee dii, konɛ a bu Barnaba kɛ Paulo tue.
A bɔ kpe ɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu gu a nɔ kɛ tsu nyakpɛ níhi babauu ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Benɛ a bɔ amaniɛ ɔ ta a, Yakobo wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Simon sɛɛ bɔ nɛ kekle ɔ, Mawu ba slaa ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ e hla a kpɛti ma ko ngɔ ha e he.
Amaniɛ nɛ ɔ maa gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔ nɔ mi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, pee se ɔ, ma kpale kɛ ba; nɛ ma ngɔ David matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ma si kaa sá a. Ma dla e ma doku ɔmɛ, nɛ e tsɛ yemi ɔ maa ma si kpɛii ekohu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, adesahi nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo maa ba ye ngɔ; nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i tsɛ ɔ maa ba ma ba pee ye ma.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ha nɛ a le enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ lɛ de.’ ” Yakobo tsa e munyu ɔ nɔ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji, ma je li nɛ ba he Mawu ye ɔ, wa ko doo a nya.
Mohu ɔ, waa ngma mɛ womi ke a ko ye niye ní nɛ he tsɔ we, a ko ye wɔ nya lo, a hyɛ a he nɔ saminya, nɛ a ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi.
A nyɛ lohwehi nɛ a kika a kuɛ kɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a ko ye lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Ejakaa kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a kaneɔ Mose mlaa a, nɛ a fiɛɔ e munyu ɔ ngɛ kpe he ɔ ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi.” Womi nɛ a ngma mane ma je li nɛ he ye ɔ Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ asafo mluku ɔ tsuo ma nya si kaa a hia mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ kɛ piɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba a he, nɛ a tsɔ mɛ Antiokia.
A hla Yuda, nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barsaba hulɔ ɔ, kɛ Sila, ni enyɔ nɛ asafo ɔ tsuo buu mɛ saminya.
A ngma womi ngɔ ha mɛ ke, “Wɔ, nyɛ nyɛmimɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ, wa biɔ nyɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ma je li a fɔfɔɛhi nɛ ngɛ Antiokia, Siria, kɛ Kilikia a saminya.
Wa nu kaa wa ti ni komɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ba doo nyɛ nya kɛ munyu komɛ, nɛ a kɛ puɛ nyɛ juɛmi, pohu wa ha we mɛ mlaa ko ke a ba wo nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa pee kpe, nɛ wɔ tsuo wa ma nya si kaa waa hia ni komɛ pɔtɛɛ nɛ waa tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ.
A maa piɛ Barnaba kɛ Paulo nɛ wa suɔ mɛ saminya a a he kɛ ba.
Barnaba kɛ Paulo ji nimli nɛ bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ ma kpata a wami hɛ mi ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ní tsumi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ Yuda, kɛ Sila, konɛ mɛ hu a ba jaje ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wa ngma a nɔuu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
E sa Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ wɔ hu wa kplɛɛ nɔ kaa wa ko ngɔ tlomi ko kɛ fɔ nyɛ nɔ hu, kaa ja níhi nɛ he hia nɛ ɔ mɛ nɔuu.
Nyɛɛ nyɛ wɔ nya lo; nyɛ ko ye lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ, loo lohwe nɛ a kika e kuɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya, nɛ nyɛ ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo kayakaya fiɛmi.
Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ yu nyɛ he kɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Nyɛɛ hi si saminya.” A wo tsɔli ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ho Antiokia ya; nɛ benɛ a ya su ɔ, a bua asafo ɔ nya, nɛ a je womi ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ.
Benɛ a kane ɔ, a bua jɔ womi ɔ mi munyu ɔ he.
Yuda, kɛ Sila nɛ a nya mi tsɔ kɛ Mawu munyu fiɛmi ɔ, tu munyu babauu kɛ wo nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ bua kɛ he wami.
Benɛ a kɛ mɛ hi si be bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo mɛ blɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi kɛ ho nihi nɛ tsɔ mɛ ɔ a ngɔ ya.
[ Se Sila lɛɛ e pee e juɛmi kaa e maa tlɔ lejɛ ɔ.]
Paulo kɛ Barnaba hi Antiokia, nɛ a kɛ ni kpahi babauu tsɔɔ ní, nɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ. Paulo kɛ Barnaba a mi gba Pee se ɔ, Paulo de Barnaba ke, “Ha waa kpale wa se kɛ ya mahi tsuo nɛ wa fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ. Wa ya slaa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ waa hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ nɔ yae ha.” Barnaba hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa a maa ngɔ Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ a he.
Se Paulo lɛɛ e susu kaa e dɛ kaa a ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ yaa.
Ejakaa blɔ ko nɛ a hia be ko ɔ, e kɛ mɛ gbi nya, se mohu benɛ a su Pamfilia a, e kpale ngɛ a se.
Enɛ ɔ pee mɛ nya sami babauu, nɛ a mi gba; Barnaba ngɔ Marko ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ a ya wo lɛ kɛ ho Kipro ya.
Paulo lɛɛ, e hla Sila ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tu mɛ ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ́ e bu a he ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho.
A gu Siria, kɛ Kilikia; nɛ benɛ a yaa a tsuo ɔ, a ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ he wami woe.
Timoteo ba piɛ Paulo kɛ Sila a he Paulo ba su Derbe, nɛ e tsa nɔ kɛ ya Listra.
Benɛ e su Listra a, e ba na nɔ ko nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A tsɛɛ lɛ Timoteo.
E nyɛ ɔ, Yuda yo nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ji lɛ; se e tsɛ lɛɛ Hela no.
Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Listra, kɛ Ikoniom ɔ yeɔ Timoteo he odase kpakpa.
Paulo hla kaa e kɛ Timoteo nɛ ya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e po lɛ.
E pee ja ejakaa Yuda bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kpokpa a nɔ ɔ le kaa Timoteo tsɛ ɔ Hela no ji lɛ.
Benɛ a ngɛ ma amɛ a nɔ kpae ɔ, mlaahi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ wo ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, a tsɔɔ mɛ, konɛ a ye nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ha asafo ɔmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi ba wa, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, nihi babauu ba piɛɔ a he.
A je nina ha Paulo ngɛ Troya A po mi ngɛ Frigia, kɛ Galatia zugba a nɔ, ejakaa Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ha we mɛ blɔ kaa a fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɛ Asia.
Benɛ a ba su Misia huzu ɔ nya a, a ka kaa a maa ya Bitinia, se Yesu Mumi ɔ ha we mɛ blɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ Misia he kɛ be, nɛ a po mi tɛɛ kɛ ya su Troya.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, a je nina ko kɛ tsɔɔ Paulo.
E na Makedonia no ko nɛ daa si ngɛ lɛ pɛɛ kpae ke, “Ba Makedonia nɛ o ba ye bua wɔ!” Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ Paulo na nina nɛ ɔ, wa dla wa he, konɛ waa ya Makedonia, ejakaa wa kpa si kaa Mawu lɛ ngɛ wɔ tsɔe ke wa ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lidia tsake pee Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ ngɛ Filipi Wa wó lɛ kɛ je Troya tɛɛ kɛ ya Samotrake, nɛ e nɔ jena a, wa ya su Neapoli.
Benɛ wa je lejɛ ɔ, wa tsa nɔ kɛ ya su Filipi, Makedonia zugba a nɔ ma nguaa ko nɛ ji Roma bi a nɔ yemi he.
Wa hi ma nɛ ɔ mi be saii.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, wa je ma a mi kɛ ya pa nya he nɛ wa susu kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ peeɔ sɔlemi ngɛ ɔ. Wa ya hi si, nɛ wa fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ yihi nɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A ti nɔ kake ji Lidia.
Yo nɛ ɔ je Tiatira ma a mi, nɛ e juaa bo tsu he jua wawɛ.
Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ; nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bli e juɛmi nya nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ Paulo ngɛ dee ɔ, e bu tue saminya.
E ha nɛ a sɔle lɛ kɛ e we ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de wɔ ke, “I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, ke nyɛ na mi kaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yeɔ anɔkuale mi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ba hi ye ngɔ.” E hɛɛ munyu nɛ ɔ mi hluu kɛ ya si wa kplɛɛ nɛ wa ya to lɛ.
A wo Paulo kɛ Sila tsu ngɛ Filipi Ligbi ko benɛ wa yaa he nɛ a sɔlee ngɛ ɔ, waa kɛ nyɔguɛ yiheyo ko nɛ klaami mumi ngɛ e mi kpe.
E kɛ mumi nɛ ɔ peeɔ sika kɛ haa e nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Yiheyo nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ waa kɛ Paulo wa se kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu, Hiɔwe No ɔ tsɔli ji mɛ; nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.” E pee enɛ ɔ hluu kɛ ya si Paulo mi mi wo la, nɛ e plɛ e he nɛ e de mumi ɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo fae ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi ke o je e mi.” Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, mumi ɔ je yiheyo ɔ mi.
Benɛ e nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na kaa blɔ nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ naa sika a se po ɔ, a nu Paulo kɛ Sila kã nya, nɛ a gbla mɛ ya ha ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ he nɛ ma a kpee ngɛ ɔ. Mɛ hu a ngɔ mɛ ya ha Roma kojoli ɔmɛ, nɛ a wo a he munyu ke, “Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ji mɛ, nɛ a ngɛ wa ma a mi hliihlii woe.
Kusumi komɛ nɛ a ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ, a kɛ wa mlaa amɛ yɛ.
Roma bi ji wɔ; wa be kusumi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔe, nɛ waa kɛ be ní tsue hulɔ.” Nɛ a de ja a, kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo te kɛ wo Paulo kɛ Sila.
Jehanɛ Roma kojoli ɔmɛ hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ Paulo kɛ Sila a he, nɛ a fa ke a fia mɛ kpa.
Benɛ a fia mɛ kpa gbegbelii se ɔ, a wo mɛ tsu, nɛ a fa pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ke e ngmɛ a yi saminya.
Bɔ nɛ a de lɛ he je ɔ, e kɛ mɛ ya wo kpɛtikpɛti tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ tso kpoku kɛ bɔ a nane pã.
Maa pee nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ, Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ sɔlee, nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ Mawu yi jee nɛ pamitsɛmɛ kpa amɛ ngɛ a he nue.
Tlukaa a, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ tsu ɔ, kɛ e sisi tomi ɔ tsuo mimiɛ.
Amlɔ ɔ, sinya amɛ tsuo bli, nɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Benɛ pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ hɛli si kɛ je mahe mi ɔ, e na kaa sinya amɛ tsuo a nya fɔɔ si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia klaate nɛ jinɛ e maa gbe e he; ejakaa e susu kaa pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu fo.
Se Paulo kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Koo ye o he awi; wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!” Pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ de kɛ ngmlaa ke a ba ha lɛ kane; nɛ e sa fo kɛ sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya kpla si ngɛ Paulo kɛ Sila a nane nya kɛ he domi blibliibli.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ mɛ je kpo, nɛ e bi ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ́ a he ye yi wami?” A he nɔ ke, “Mo he Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɛ o ye, nɛ a ma he o kɛ o we ɔ tsuo nyɛ yi wami.” Jehanɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ e kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔ mɛ nɛ e ya fɔ a pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ; nɛ a sɔle lɛ, kɛ e we ɔ tsuo amlɔ nɔuu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Paulo kɛ Sila kɛ ya e we ɔ mi, nɛ e ya ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye.
E kɛ e we ɔ tsuo nya kaa jehanɛ ɔ e he Mawu ye.
Benɛ je na a, Roma kojoli ɔmɛ tsɔ ma he buli ɔmɛ kɛ ba de pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ke, “Ngmɛɛ ni ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ho.” Kɛkɛ nɛ pamitsɛmɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ de Paulo ke, “Roma kojoli ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba ke a ngmɛɛ o kɛ Sila nyɛ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ je kpo nɛ nyɛɛ ya.
Nyɛɛ ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi.” Se Paulo de ma he buli ɔmɛ ke, “Hyɛ, nɔ ko bui wɔ fɔ, se wɔ Roma bi ɔ, a fia wɔ kpa ngɛ ma hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a wo wɔ tsu, nɛ jehanɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a ngmɛɛ wa he nigii nɛ waa ho lo?
Dɛbi!
Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ba nɛ a ba je wɔ.” Ma he buli ɔmɛ ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Roma kojoli ɔmɛ.
Nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Paulo kɛ Sila a, Roma bi ji mɛ ɔ, a ye gbeye.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Roma kojoli ɔmɛ ba Paulo kɛ Sila a ngɔ, nɛ a ba ye pɔpu.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a je mɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a de mɛ ke a je ma a mi nɛ a ho.
Paulo kɛ Sila je kpo, nɛ a ho Lidia we ɔ mi ya.
A ya na nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a tu munyu kɛ wo mɛ he wami; kɛkɛ nɛ a pue blɔ, nɛ a je.
Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ Tesalonika Paulo kɛ Sila pue nɔ kɛ ya gu Amfipoli kɛ Apolonia, nɛ a ba Tesalonika, he nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpe he ko ngɛ ɔ. Paulo ya kpe he ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ. E kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya hla ngmami ɔmɛ a mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi etɛ sɔuu.
E tsɔɔ mɛ níhi a mi faii kaa e sa kaa Kristo ɔ nɛ na amanehlu, nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje.
Paulo de mɛ hulɔ ke, “Yesu, nɛ i ngɛ e he sane jajee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ, lɛ ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.” Ni ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ he ye kaa Paulo munyu ɔ ngɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ a he ya bɔ Paulo kɛ Sila a he.
Hela bi Mawu gbeye yeli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu, kɛ yi komɛ nɛ a buu mɛ hu ya piɛ a he ja nɔuu.
Se Yuda bi ɔmɛ je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he hunga, nɛ a ya ngɔ yakayaka nimli dikali komɛ ngɔ piɛ a he.
Benɛ a nya ba bua fuu ɔ, a ha ma a mi tsuo pee hliihlii.
A ya tua nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Yason e we ɔ kaa a maa ngɔ Paulo kɛ Sila ya ha ma a.
Se benɛ a nɛ mɛ ɔ, a gbla Yason, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ kɛ ya ha ma a mi nikɔtɔma amɛ pani nya kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ a ya a, basabasa sɔuu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba su wa ma mi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ Yason he mɛ ngɔ to we.
A ngɛ Kaisare ɔ mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ tɔe; nɛ a ngɛ dee ke matsɛ kpa ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesu.” Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ basabasa ba ma a, kɛ ma nikɔtɔma ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ma nikɔtɔma amɛ ha nɛ Yason, kɛ ni kpa amɛ wo sika kɛ kpɔ̃ a he; nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he.
Paulo kɛ Sila ngɛ Beroya Benɛ je jɔ pɛ nɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo Paulo kɛ Sila blɔ kɛ ho Beroya ya.
Benɛ a su lejɛ ɔ, a be kɛ ho kpe he ɔ ya.
Beroya bi ɔmɛ a tue wɛ kaa Tesalonika bi ɔmɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a he munyu ɔ ye kɛ a tsui tsuo, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, a kpaa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kaa níhi nɛ Paulo de a ngɛ mi ja lo.
A ti nihi babauu he ye, nɛ Hela yihi nɛ ngɛ biɛ, kɛ Hela nyumuhi hu babauu he ye.
Se benɛ Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika a nu kaa Paulo ya fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ Beroya hulɔ ɔ, a ba lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba bɔni ni ɔmɛ a yi mi womi, konɛ a pee basabasa.
Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ wo Paulo blɔ kɛ ho wo kpo ɔ ya; se Sila kɛ Timoteo lɛɛ a tlɔ Beroya.
Nihi nɛ ya je Paulo blɔ ɔ kɛ lɛ ya su Atene tɔɔ loko a kpale kɛ ba Beroya.
Paulo kɛ sɛ mane ke Sila kɛ Timoteo nɛ ba ná lɛ be kpiti mi.
Paulo ngɛ Atene Benɛ Paulo ngɛ Atene, nɛ e ngɛ Sila kɛ Timoteo blɔ hyɛe ɔ, e na amaga babauu ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, daa ligbi ɔ, e kɛ Yuda bi, kɛ Hela bi nɛ ba he Mawu ye ɔ ba hlaa ní a mi ngɛ kpe he ɔ. E kɛ nihi ya buaa ngɛ ma nɔ hulɔ kɛ hlaa ní a mi ja nɔuu.
E kɛ ní leli a kuu nɛ ɔmɛ: Epikuro kɛ Stoike hu sãã nya.
Ni komɛ bi ke, “Mɛni nyapuutsɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ tsuae ɔ?” Ni komɛ hu de ke “E ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ tuɔ ma se jemɛ a wɔhi a he munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nihi.” A de jã, ejakaa Paulo ngɛ Yesu he sane fiɛe, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ kaa ni gbogboehi maa te si kɛ je gbeje.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ Paulo kɛ ho ma kpe ngua nɛ a tsɛɛ Areopago ɔ hɛ mi ya.
A de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔmi he nɛ o ngɛ he munyu tue nɛ ɔ, wa maa suɔ nɛ o de wɔ he nɔ́ ko bɔɔ.
Ní komɛ nɛ o de ɔ, wa nui hyɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa maa suɔ nɛ o blɛke mi bɔɔ ha wɔ.” (Nɔ́ nɛ Atene bi kɛ nibwɔhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ suɔ peemi kɛkɛ ji a nu nɔ́ he ko nɛ a sɛɛ.)
Paulo ya da ma kpe ngua a hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, “Atene bi, i na kaa blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ nyaa jami he saminya.
Ejakaa benɛ i nyɛɛ nyɛ ma a mi kɛ bee ɔ, i hyɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ jaa a. I na bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ke, ‘Mawu nɛ a li lɛ ɔ nɔ́.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ nyɛ li lɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e he sane i ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Mawu, nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ, kɛ e mi níhi tsuo ɔ, lɛ ji hiɔwe kɛ zugba Nyɔmtsɛ; nɛ e hí sɔlemi tsu nɛ a kɛ nine pee mi.
Jehanɛ hu nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we lɛ nɛ wa ma nyɛ ma ha lɛ.
Wa nine nya nɔ́ ko hia we lɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ nɔ́ ko fĩɔ lɛ nɛ adesa ma nyɛ maa pee ha lɛ.
Ejakaa lɛ mohu lɛ e haa wɔ wami, kɛ mumi nɛ wa muɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia wɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e haa wɔ.
Sisije ɔ, nɔmlɔ kake Mawu bɔ, nɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ kake nɛ ɔ mi je ɔ mi nimli adesahi tsuo je.
Lɛ nitsɛ lɛ e ha nɛ a gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Be, kɛ he nɛ ní ɔmɛ maa hi, kɛ a huzu nya a, lɛ nitsɛ lɛ e to pɛpɛɛpɛ loko e bɔ je ɔ. E pee jã, konɛ a hla lɛ Mawu ɔ, kaa alini ke a kpa kɛ ya kɛ ba a, a maa na lɛ lo.
Pohu, niinɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpɛti kɛ we kulaa.
Kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ko de ɔ, ‘Mawu lɛ haa wa hii je mi, nɛ e haa wa yaa nɛ wa baa kaa adesahi.’ Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ la poli ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu de ɔ, ‘Wɔ hu e bimɛ ji wɔ.’ Ke Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ ɔ, e sɛ kaa wa susuu kaa Mawu su ngɛ kaa sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ, loo tɛ ko nɛ nɔmlɔ kɛ e ga, kɛ e juɛmi pee.
Benɛ adesa li ɔ, Mawu ku e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ nimli tsuo ngɛ he tsuaa he fae ke a tsake a tsui.
Ejakaa e to be pɔtɛɛ ko, nɛ e hla nɔ ko nɛ e maa gu e nɔ kɛ kojo je ɔ tsuo ngɛ dami sane yemi nya, ejakaa e tle jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ma enɛ ɔ nɔ mi.” Benɛ a nu nɛ Paulo tu gbogboehi a si temi he munyu ɔ, ni komɛ ye e he fɛu, se ni komɛ hu de lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o de nɛ ɔ, wa suɔ nɛ waa bu mo tue ekohu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo si mɛ.
Se nyumu komɛ he ye.
A ti nɔ kake ji Dionisio; ma kpe ngua a nɛ a tsɛɛ Areopago ɔ mi no ji lɛ.
Yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Damari, kɛ ni kpa komɛ hu he ye.
Paulo ngɛ Korinto Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Paulo je Atene, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Korinto ya.
E ya na Yuda no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Akuila ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A fɔ Akuila ngɛ Ponto.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, kɛ e yo Priskila je Italia kɛ ba we; ejakaa Kaisare Klaudio fa Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke a je Roma.
Paulo ya a ngɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya hi si kɛ tsu ní; ejakaa bo tsu peemi ji a ní tsumi.
Daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, e ya fiɛɔ Mawu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi ngɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e ma tsake Yuda bi, kɛ Hela bi tsuo.
Benɛ Sila kɛ Timoteo je Makedonia kɛ ba a, jehanɛ Paulo tsu we nɔ kpa ko hu pe munyu ɔ fiɛmi kɛkɛ; nɛ e yeɔ odase veveeve ngɔ tsɔɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a te si wo lɛ, nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e huanya e tade mi mu kɛ pue a nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ musu tloo nyɛ!
Imi lɛɛ ye nya be mi.
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, ma je li ɔmɛ a ngɔ ma ya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e si lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho ya to ma je no Mawu jalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Titio Yusto ɔ we mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ hi si.
E we ɔ tsa kpe he ɔ nɔ.
Kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Krispo ɔ, kɛ e we tsuo he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye.
Nihi babauu hu nɛ ngɛ Korinto ɔ nu sɛ gbi ɔ, nɛ a he ye; nɛ a sɔle mɛ.
Ligbi ko nyɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de Paulo ngɛ nina mi ke, “Koo ye gbeye, se mohu fiɛ munyu ɔ. Ko ma o nya, ejakaa i kɛ mo ngɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee mo yayami ko; ejakaa i ngɛ we bi babauu ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Paulo ye jeha, kɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ Mawu munyu ɔ. Benɛ Roma nɔ yemi ɔ wo Galio amlaalo ngɛ Akaya a, Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee a nya kake nɛ a te si wo Paulo, nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ho kojomi he ɔ ya.
A ya po e nya ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ ma a yi mi woe nɛ a ja Mawu ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ nɛ kɛ wa mlaa a yɛ!” Benɛ Paulo miɔ nɛ e ma je e nya a, kɛkɛ nɛ Galio po e nya nɔ, nɛ e de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, “Yuda bi, ju kɛ fɔ̃ sane ko nyɛ kɛ ba jinɛ ma na tsui kɛ bu nyɛ tue.
Se akɛnɛ munyunguhi, kɛ biɛhi, kɛ nyɛ mlaa a he nyɛ ngɛ sane yee ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ya hyɛ mi.
Sanehi nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i be kojoe.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e fie mɛ kɛ je kojomi he ɔ. Mɛ tsuo a ya nu kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sostene ɔ ngɛ kojomi he ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a fia lɛ ní.
Se nɔ́ nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ si we Galio kpu.
Paulo kpale kɛ ba Antiokia Paulo kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ hi si ngɛ Korinto be saii.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ mɛ ye sɛ, nɛ e ngɔ Priskila, kɛ Akuila kɛ piɛ e he, nɛ a ya wó lɛ kɛ ba Siria.
Loko lɛ ɔ maa hia ngɛ Kenkrea a, Paulo ha a sɛ e yi ha lɛ, ejakaa be ko ɔ, e wo Mawu si ko.
Benɛ a ba su Efeso ɔ, Paulo si Priskila kɛ Akuila ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; se loko e je ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e ya kpe he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya hla ní a nya.
A kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e ye be bɔɔ ngɛ a ngɔ, se e kplɛɛ we.
Benɛ a ngɛ sɛ yee ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Ke Mawu suɔ ɔ, ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e wó lɛ, nɛ e je Efeso.
Benɛ e ya kple ngɛ Kaisarea a, e ya Yerusalem, nɛ e ya nga asafo ɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Antiokia ya.
E hi lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ ko; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e pue nɔ ekohu, nɛ e ya kpa Galatia, kɛ Frigia ní ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ tsuo he wami.
Apolo ngɛ Efeso kɛ Korinto Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yuda no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolo, nɛ e se je Aleksandria a ba Efeso.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ nya mi tsɔ saminya, nɛ e le ngmami ɔmɛ a mi fitsofitso.
A tsɔɔ nyumu nɛ ɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kã, kɛ mumi nɛ nya wa fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ; nɛ e tsɔɔ Yesu he ní fitsofitso.
Pohu Yohane nɔ sɔlemi ɔ pɛ nɛ e le.
E kɛ kã bɔni munyu tumi ngɛ kpe he ɔ. Benɛ Priskila kɛ Akuila nu nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba a ngɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ fitsofitso.
Jehanɛ, Apolo to e yi mi kaa e maa po mi kɛ ya Akaya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ susu he, nɛ a ngma womi ya ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Akaya a kɛ wo mɛ ga ke a he lɛ hɛmuɔ.
Benɛ e ba su lejɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu dloomi nya a, a ba he Kristo ye ɔ na e he se saminya.
Ejakaa e tu munyu kɛ he wami kɛ ku Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya la; nɛ e je ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ faii kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.
Paulo ngɛ Efeso Benɛ Apolo ngɛ Korinto ɔ, Paulo ya kpa ni ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ba su Efeso.
E ba na nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ a ti ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Benɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ, anɛ nyɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lo?” A de lɛ ke, “Wa nui hyɛ tete kaa Mumi Klɔuklɔu ko ngɛ.” Paulo bi mɛ ekohu ke, “Lɛɛ kɛ a pee kɛ sɔle nyɛ kɛɛ?” A he nɔ ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ Yohane tsɔɔ ɔ.” Paulo ya nɔ ke, “Yohane tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ tsake a tsui loko a sɔle mɛ.
Nɛ e de Israel ma a ke, ‘Nyɛ he nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ ye se ɔ nyɛɛ ye.
Lɛ ji Yesu ɔ nɛ.’ ” Benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ, a sɔle mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi.
Paulo kɛ e nine pue a nɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.
A tu munyu ngɛ gbihi nɛ a nui mi, nɛ a fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ. Nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a yibɔ maa su nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
Paulo ye nyɔhiɔ etɛ sɔuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kã tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ. E bɔ mɔde kaa e ma ha nɛ a le Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ.
Se ni komɛ wa tue, nɛ a he we yi; nɛ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, a tu munyu yaya kɛ si Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Paulo je a he nɛ e je kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ je a kpɛti; nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e kɛ nihi ya hlaa níhi a mi ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tirano ɔ ni kasemi he.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ jeha enyɔ sɔuu, nɛ Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo nɛ a ngɛ Asia a nu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ. Skeva bimɛ ɔmɛ Mawu tsu nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ nɔ be kɛ gu Paulo nine nɔ.
A ngɔɔ dukuhi, kɛ tade hɛ mi hami bohi tete nɛ Paulo he sa he kɛ ya haa hiɔtsɛmɛ a nɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, hiɔ taa; nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ jee a mi.
Yuda bi klaali komɛ nɛ ngɛ si kpae hu ka kaa a kɛ Yesu biɛ ma tsa nihi nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ a mi.
A deɔ mumi yayami ɔmɛ ke, “Ngɛ Yesu nɛ Paulo ngɛ fiɛe ɔ biɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ mo fae ke jee kpo kɛ je nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ mi.” Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Skeva, nɛ e ji Yuda no hulɔ ɔ binyumuhi kpaago ji nihi nɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔ yee.
Se mumi yayami ɔ he nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Yesu ɔ, i le lɛ, nɛ Paulo hu i le lɛ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔmɛ ji nyɛ?” Nyumu ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ɔ ngɛ e mi ɔ sá fɔ̃ a nɔ kitikiti, nɛ e plaa mɛ tsuo; nɛ a tu fo kɛ je jamɛ a we ɔ mi kɛ a he pahi, kɛ tadehi nɛ hía.
Benɛ Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo nɛ ngɛ Efeso nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, gbeye nu mɛ, nɛ a wo Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu hɛ mi nyami wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nihi nɛ he ye ɔ, a ti nihi babauu hu ba, nɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ, a ba jaje paa ngɛ ma a hɛ mi.
Kunya tsuli ɔmɛ hu a ti nihi babauu ngɔ a womi ɔmɛ kɛ ba pue si ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ a sã.
Womihi nɛ a sã a tsuo a jua nɛ a bua nya a peeɔ sika hiɔ akpe nyingmi enuɔ sɔuu.
Nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ a tsu nɛ ɔ ha nihi babauu ngɛ hehi fuu ba nu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ, nɛ a he ye.
A pee basabasa ngɛ Efeso Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ha Paulo to e yi mi kaa e ma ya gu Makedonia, kɛ Akaya kɛ ya su Yerusalem.
E de ke, “Ke i su lejɛ ɔ, ma ya slaa Roma hulɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e he piɛli enyɔ Makedonia.
Mɛ ji Timoteo, kɛ Erasto; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e hi Asia be bɔɔ.
Be nɛ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, basabasa peemi wawɛɛ ko ba te si ngɛ Efeso ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ blɔ ɔ he.
Sika hiɔ galɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Demetrio ɔ kɛ sika hiɔ pee yo mawu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Artemi ɔ jami he ɔ henɔhi.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e ní tsuli ɔmɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ e ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpahi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ní ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛ le kaa kikɛmɛ a ga ní tsumi nɛ ɔ mi wa naa ní ngɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nu, nɛ nyɛ na níhi nɛ kikɛmɛ a Paulo nɛ ɔ ngɛ pee.
E deɔ ke mawuhi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa kɛ e nine pee ɔ pi mawu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e plɛ nihi babauu a yi mi ngɛ Efeso hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ Asia kpokpa tsuo nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si paa ji, wa ní tsumi ɔ he guɛ ma gbo.
Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu a maa ye yo mawu Artemi jami he ɔ he fɛu, nɛ bɔ nɛ a nyaa e he ngɛ Asia, kɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ se maa po!” Benɛ ni kpekpemi ɔ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a mi mi wo la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a bɔni ngmlaa kpami ke, “Efeso bi a we Artemi ɔ ngɛ he wami saminya!” Ma a mi tsuo pee hoo kɛ ngmlaa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ basabasa peeli ɔmɛ ya nu Gayo kɛ Aristarko, Makedonia bi nɛ piɛ Paulo he kɛ hia blɔ ɔ, nɛ a tsɛ̃ a yi se kɛ fo kɛ ho he nɛ ma a kpee ngɛ ɔ ya.
Jinɛ Paulo nitsɛ hla kaa e maa ya lejɛ ɔ, se nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we.
Asia ma ní tsuli komɛ nɛ ji Paulo huɛmɛ tsɔ ba wo lɛ ga ke e ko ka kaa e ma ya je e hɛ mi kpo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ ɔ, benɛ ni komɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kikɛ ɔ, ni komɛ hu ngɛ nɔ́ kpa dee; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ kulaa ngɛ gidigidi pee, se a ti nihi fuu li nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ a ba kpe ɔ tete.
Akɛnɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ha Aleksandro ba da ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi he je ɔ, ni komɛ susu kaa Aleksandro le basabasa nɛ ba a he nɔ́ ko.
Aleksandro suɔ kaa e ma je e nya kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo e nine nɔ ha ma a kaa a pee dii.
Se benɛ a kpa si kaa Yuda no ji lɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa maa pee ngmlɛfia enyɔ sɔuu ke, “Efeso bi a we Artemi ɔ ngɛ he wami saminya!” Nyagbe ɔ, ma womi ngmalɔ ɔ ha ni ɔmɛ pee dii, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Efeso bi, nɔ tsuaa nɔ le kaa yo mawu Artemi nguaa a jami he, kɛ tɛ nɛ kple si kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ, Efeso ma nɛ ɔ mi ji he nɛ a ngɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa je he nɔ́; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛɛ pee dii, nɛ nyɛ ko pee gidigidi ko kulaa.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, pohu pi kaa a ya ju ní ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, loo a bɔ wa yo mawu ɔ ahlua ko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Demetrio, kɛ e huɛmɛ gali ɔmɛ kɛ nɔ ko ngɛ sane ko ɔ, ligbihi ngɛ nɛ a kɛ hyɛɛ sanehi a mi, nɛ amlaalo ɔ ní tsuli ɔmɛ hu ngɛ; nyɛ ha a kɛ sane ɔ nɛ ya a hɛ mi.
Se ke nɔ́ kpa ko pa ngɛ enɛ ɔ se nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ a kɛ ya ma kpe ɔ hɛ mi nɛ a hla nya.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ ba mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, gbeye ngɛ he kaa a ma nyɛ maa po wa nya ke wa ngɛ ma a mi hliihlii woe.
Ke e ba ja a, mɛni nya jemi wa ngɛ?” Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa kpe ɔ.
Paulo ya Makedonia kɛ Akaya Benɛ basabasa a se po ɔ, Paulo tsɔ ya tsɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba.
E kɛ mɛ tu munyu, nɛ e wo mɛ he wami.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e sɛ mɛ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Makedonia ya.
E kpa si kɛ gu lejɛ ɔ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ e tu munyuhi saminya kɛ wo ni ɔmɛ he wami.
Jehanɛ ɔ, e ba su Akaya, nɛ e ye nyɔhiɔ etɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se benɛ e ngɛ e he dlae nɛ e maa ya Siria a, e na le kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ e yi nɔ soe; Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e to e yi mi kaa e maa kpale e se kɛ ya gu Makedonia ekohu.
E kɛ Piro nɛ je Beroya a e bi Sopater ho.
Nihi hu nɛ piɛ e he ji Aristarko, kɛ Sekundo nɛ a je Tesalonika a, Gayo nɛ je Derbe ɔ, Tihiko kɛ Trofimo nɛ a je Asia a, kɛ Timoteo.
Ni nɛ ɔmɛ sɛ hlami, nɛ a ya mlɛ wɔ ngɛ Troya.
Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ se ɔ, wa wó lɛ kɛ je Filipi, nɛ ligbi enuɔ se ɔ, wa ya na mɛ ngɛ Troya, nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hi lejɛ ɔ otsi.
Paulo kɛ Troya asafo ɔ ye sɛ Otsi ɔ mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ, wa bua wa he nya, konɛ waa ye suɔmi niye ní ɔ. Paulo tu munyu tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ, nɛ e tsa fiɛmi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya su nyɔ mi kɔ̃kɔ̃ɔ̃kɔ̃; ejakaa e nɔ jena nɔuu e maa je.
A su kane fuu ngɛ hiɔwe tsu mi he nɛ a kpe ngɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, niheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yutiko hii si ngɛ saflɛ ɔ nya.
E bɔni mahe hwɔmi kɛ ya su be nɛ e sɛ mi vii, ejakaa Paulo munyu ɔ se kɛ.
Tlukaa a, Yutiko tsɔ kɛ je siaudo etɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ba nɔ zugba tim!
Benɛ a ke a yaa wo e nɔ ɔ, e gbo momo.
Se Paulo kple si, nɛ e ya bu e nɔ, nɛ e fua lɛ.
E de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko jé ngmlaa; wami ngɛ e mi kɛ mwɔɔ!” Benɛ Paulo kpale e se kɛ ya mɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ku abolo, nɛ e ye.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ ni ɔmɛ sɛɛ ní hluu kɛ ya si je mi tsɔ wɛsɛɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ e si mɛ.
A kɛ niheyo ɔ ho we mi ya hɛ ngmengmle; nɛ a bua jɔ a he saminya.
Paulo je Troya kɛ ya Mileto Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa sɛ hlami ya wó lɛ kɛ yaa Aso, nɛ́ wa ya ngɔ Paulo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e kɛ wɔ ye sɛ momo kaa e maa gu nane blɔ.
Benɛ e ba ná wɔ ngɛ Aso ɔ, e ba sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo wa tsa nɔ kɛ ho Mitilene ya.
Wa hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e nɔ jena a, wa ba su Kio hanɔ.
E nɔ jena ekohu ɔ, wa ba su Samo, nɛ jena nɔ ekohu ɔ, wa ba Mileto.
Paulo pee e yi mi kaa e maa tsɔ Efeso he, konɛ e ko ya Asia.
E ngɛ esɔ yee, konɛ ke e ma nyɛ ɔ, e ya ye Pentekoste ligbi ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
Paulo kɛ Efeso nikɔtɔma amɛ ye sɛ Paulo tsɔ kɛ je Mileto nɛ a ya tsɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ kɛ ba.
Benɛ a ba a, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le bɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si be nɛ be ɔ tsuo, kɛ je kekleekle ligbi nɛ i ba Asia a. I ba ye he si saminya kɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ soɔ ye yi nɔ, nɛ a haa nɛ i naa nɔ́ wawɛɛ, nɛ i foɔ ya tete po.
Nyɛ le hu kaa níhi nɛ a he ngɛ se nami ha nyɛ ɔ, i laa we nyɛ ekoeko nɔ; se mohu i fiɛ, nɛ i tsɔɔ nyɛ ní faii ngɛ ma nɔ, kɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi tsuo.
I tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo ke a kpa yayami peemi, nɛ a ba Mawu ngɔ, nɛ a he wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ a ye.
Jehanɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de mi ke ma pee ɔ, i yaa Yerusalem, nɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ ma ya ba ye nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ i le kɛkɛ ji kaa ma tsuaa ma mi ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ jeɔ tsɔɔ mi kaa a maa wo mi tsu, nɛ ma na amanehlu babauu.
Se imi lɛɛ ye wami tete he hia we mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ he hia mohu ji kaa ní tsumi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ha mi ɔ, ma tsu kɛ gbe nya.
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu mi mi hi ha adesahi tsuo ɔ.
“I kpa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nɔ, nɛ i fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i le kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko be mi nae hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ kita kae ke, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko hɛ mi kpata a, lɛ nitsɛ e musu tloo lɛ.
Ejakaa i jaje Mawu yi mi tomi ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ i laa we nyɛ ba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya.
Asafo ɔ tsuo nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tu ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Mawu ngɔ e Bi ɔ kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ dani asafo ɔ kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ saminya.
I le kaa ke i je ɔ, nihi ma ba sɛ nyɛ kpɛti, nɛ a maa pee a ní kaa ogbetee ní hali; a be asafo ɔ yi bae.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpɛti hu nihi maa ye lakpa kɛ puɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a tue kɛ ya nyɛɛ a se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ be tsuaa be, nɛ nyɛ kai kaa i nga vo nyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ní nyɔ kɛ pia jeha etɛ sɔuu.
“Nyagbe ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ tue kɛ ngɛ Mawu kɛ e dloomi munyu ɔ dɛ mi woe.
Munyu ɔ maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛ maa da si kpikpitii; nɛ gbaami nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha e we bi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ nine maa su nɔ.
Ye hɛ kɔɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu, loo tade nɔ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia mi ɔ, ye nine nguɛ nɛ ɔmɛ i kɛ tsu loko i na; ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hiami níhi po, imi lɛ i ha mɛ.
I ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ to nyɛ okadi kaa jã nɛ e sa kaa a tsu ní nɛ a kɛ ye bua nihi nɛ be he wami ɔ, konɛ nyɛ kai Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu munyu nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tu ɔ. E de ke, ‘Gbaami ngɛ nɔ́ hami mi pe nɔ́ sɔlemi mi.’ ” Benɛ Paulo gbe munyu ɔ nya a, e kɛ mɛ tsuo kplã si, nɛ a sɔle.
Mɛ tsuo a wo yana, benɛ a ngɛ Paulo fuae kɛ ngɛ e nya he fiɔe ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ dɔ mɛ pe kulaa ji munyu nɛ je e nya ke, “Nyɛ be ye hɛ mi nae gblegbleegble hu ɔ.” Jehanɛ a ya je lɛ blɔ kɛ ya su lɛ ɔ he tɔɔ.
Paulo ya Yerusalem Waa kɛ mɛ ye sɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ lɛ ɔ hia.
Lɛ ɔ nyɛɛ tɛɛ kɛ ba Koo; nɛ e nɔ jena a, wa ba Rodo, nɛ wa tsa nɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba Patara.
Wa na lɛ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ yaa Foinike, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ya sɛ mi, nɛ wa pue nɔ.
Wa ba su he ko nɛ wa na Kipro jee ngɛ wa hɛ mi, se wa ya gu e leneyi je, nɛ wa ba Siria.
Wa ba kple ngɛ Tiro, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ma je lɛ ɔ mi ní ngɛ.
Wa ya na nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hi si otsi.
Mawu Mumi ɔ ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ de Paulo ke e ko tsa e blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ kɛ ya Yerusalem.
Se nɛ be nɛ wa to nɛ wa maa ye ngɛ a ngɔ ɔ nya ta a, wa si mɛ, nɛ wa pue blɔ.
Nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ba je wɔ blɔ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya su wo ɔ nya.
Wa kpla si ngɛ zia a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ wa sɔle.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, waa kɛ mɛ ye sɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ wa ya sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ mɛ hu a kpale a se kɛ ho we mi ya.
Wa kpale wó lɛ kɛ tsa wa blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ kɛ je Tiro kɛ ba Pitolemai.
Wa ya nga nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hi si ligbi kake.
E nɔ jena a, wa pue nɔ kɛ ho Kaisarea ya.
Sɔmɔli kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ a hla ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Filipo ɔ ji sane kpakpa fiɛlɔ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi.
E pee wɔ nibwɔ, nɛ wa hi e we ɔ mi.
E ngɛ biyiwi eywiɛ nɛ gba we lolo, nɛ a fiɛɔ Mawu munyu ɔ. Wa hi lejɛ ɔ be saii; kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Agabo ɔ je Yudea kɛ ba.
E ba wa ngɔ, nɛ e ba ngɔ Paulo mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ fi lɛ nitsɛ e nanehi, kɛ e ninehi; nɛ e de ke, “Bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ji mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ maa pee lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo ma je li ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.” Benɛ wa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, waa kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo kpa Paulo pɛɛ ke e ko ya Yerusalem.
Se e he nɔ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ; nyɛ ngɛ ya foe kɛ ma tsɔ ye tsui kpa?
Imi lɛɛ, pi fimi nɛ a maa fi mi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe, se mohu i pee klaalo nɛ ma gbo ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Wa nyɛ we nɛ wa tsake e yi mi tomi ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa nyɛ de kɛkɛ ji, “A pee nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ.” Wa ye be saii ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wa bo tlomi, nɛ wa pue nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem.
Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je Kaisarea a, a ti ni komɛ kɛ wɔ ho; nɛ a ha wa ya to Minason.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ, Kipro no ji lɛ, nɛ e ba pee kaselɔ pi mwɔnɛ.
Paulo ya slaa Yakobo Benɛ wa su Yerusalem ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ he wɔ hɛmuɔ.
E nɔ jena a, waa kɛ Paulo ya Yakobo ngɔ.
Wa ya na asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Paulo nga mɛ; nɛ bɔ mɛ níhi nɛ Mawu gu e nɔ tsu ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ tsuo.
Benɛ a bu lɛ tue kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, mɛ tsuo a je Mawu yi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Wa nyɛmi Paulo, hyɛ, Yuda bi akpe abɔ nɛ he ye nɛ ɔ, o le bɔ nɛ a fiɛ we Mose mlaa a he ha.
A nu kaa Yuda bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ mɛ dee ji kaa a ko ye Mose mlaa a nɔ, a ko po a bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ko tsu Yuda bi a kusumi hulɔ.
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, a maa nu kaa o ba.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?
Ga nɛ wa ngɛ mo woe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Nyumuhi eywiɛ ngɛ wa kpɛti nɛ wo Mawu si.
O kɛ mɛ nɛ ya, nɛ kusumi nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tsukɔɔ nɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ya pee, nɛ o wo hiɔ ɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a sɛ a yi.
Ke o pee ja a, nihi tsuo maa na kaa níhi nɛ a ba sɛɛ ngɛ o he ɔ be mi, se mohu mo nitsɛ po o yeɔ Mose mlaa a nɔ sisiisi.
Ma je li nɛ ba he ye ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ wa ngma mɛ womi ke wa ma nya si kaa a ko ye wɔ nya ní, a ko ye lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ a ko ye lohwe nɛ a kika e kuɛ hulɔ.
Jehanɛ hu, a hyɛ a he nɔ saminya, nɛ a ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e nɔ jena a, Paulo kɛ nyumu ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ a he.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a ya wo si kaa otsi se ɔ, a maa gbe kusumi ɔ nya, nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ba sã bɔ.
A nu Paulo ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ Benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ otsi ɔ maa su ɔ, Yuda bi komɛ nɛ je Asia zugba a nɔ ɔ na Paulo ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ sú ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo Paulo he, nɛ a nu lɛ.
A kpa ngmlaa ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ Israel bi, nyɛ ba piɛ wa he!
Kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ yaa he tsuaa he ya tuɔ munyu yaya kɛ gbee Israel ma a he guɛ; e tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ Mose mlaa a, kɛ wa sɔlemi we ɔ. Jehanɛ lɛɛ e ngɔ ma je li tete kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ ba ble he klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ hulɔ!” A de jã, ejakaa a na Paulo kɛ Trofimo nɛ je Efeso ɔ ngɛ ma a mi momo, nɛ a susu kaa Paulo kɛ lɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Ma a mi tsuo pee gidigidi; ni ɔmɛ tu kɛ ba kɛ fo, nɛ a ba nu Paulo; kɛkɛ nɛ a gbla lɛ kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ je kpo.
Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, a nga sinya amɛ.
Benɛ basabasa peeli ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe Paulo ɔ, nɔ ko ya sɛɛ ha Roma asafoatsɛngua a ke Yerusalem tsuo pee gidigidi.
Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, e ngɔ ta buli, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ kɛ piɛ e he kɛ fo kɛ je mɔ ɔ mi kɛ ba na basabasa peeli ɔmɛ.
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ na asafoatsɛngua a, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ɔ, a jɔɔ Paulo kongomi.
Jehanɛ asafoatsɛngua a hɛ lɛ kɛ su Paulo he, nɛ e pɛtɛ e he, nɛ e fa ke a wo lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ ji lɛ; nɛ mɛni e pee?” Lejɛ ɔ tsuo pee hoo kɛ ngmlaa.
Benɛ ni komɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kake dee ɔ, ni komɛ hu ngɛ nɔ́ kpa dee.
Basabasa a nya ba wa bɔ nɛ asafoatsɛngua a nyɛ we nɛ e le nɔ́ tutuutu nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa e we bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ Paulo kɛ ya mɔ ɔ mi.
Benɛ a su atlaakpe ɔ nya a, gidigidi ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ, nɛ e hia kaa ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛɛ Paulo ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi; ejakaa ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nyɛɛ e se gidigidi kɛ ngmlaa ke, “A gbe lɛ!” Paulo je e nya Benɛ ta buli ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a kɛ Paulo maa sɛ mɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e de asafoatsɛngua a ke, “Ma bi mo nɔ́ ko bɔɔ!” Asafoatsɛngua a bi lɛ ke, “O tuɔ Hela gbi lo?
Lɛɛ Egipt no ɔ nɛ tsɔ atuã, nɛ e ngɔ awi yeli akpe eywiɛ ngɔ pue e se kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya lingmi nɛ ɔ, pi mo?” Paulo he nɔ ke, “Imi lɛɛ Yuda no ji mi.
A fɔ mi ngɛ Tarso, Kilikia ma nɛ ngɛ biɛ saminya a. I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ i kɛ ma a nɛ tu munyu bɔɔ.” Asafoatsɛngua a ngmɛ lɛ blɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo da atlaakpe ɔ nɔ, nɛ e fɔ ma a nine ke a pee dii.
Benɛ lejɛ ɔ jɔ klanaa a, e tu munyu ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke:
“Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel bi, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue nɛ ma je ye nya!” Benɛ ni ɔmɛ nu kaa Hebri gbi e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, a pee dii pe kekle ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsa nɔ ke, “Yuda no ji mi; nɛ a fɔ mi ngɛ Tarso ngɛ Kilikia mohu, se Yerusalem hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a lɛ mi ngɛ.
Gamaliel lɛ tsɔɔ mi ní.
A tsɔse mi bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a mlaa a nya.
I kplɛɛ we nɔ́ ngɛ Mawu he kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ pee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ ni komɛ po gbo ngɛ mi.
I nuɔ nyumuhi kɛ yihi tete kɛ ya woɔ tsu.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ kpe ngua a tsuo ma nyɛ maa ye mi odase.
Mɛ nɔuu lɛ a ha mi womi nɛ ma kɛ ya ha wa nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jinɛ i yaa lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ma ya nuu nihi nɛ hɛɛ kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ba Yerusalem, konɛ a gbla a tue.” Paulo sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba loko e tsake e tsui “Benɛ i nyɛɛ blɔ kɛ yaa Damasko, nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ ma su maa pee piani pu dadɛ be mi ɔ, tlukaa a, la nɛ nya wa ko kpɛ nylam kɛ je hiɔwe ba bɔle mi.
I tsɔ fia si, nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ bi mi ke, ‘Saulo, Saulo!
Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ?’ I he nɔ ke, ‘Mo mɛnɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ?’ E de mi ke, ‘Imi ji Yesu, Nazaret no ɔ nɛ o ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ!’ Nihi nɛ kɛ mi nyɛɛ ɔ na la a, se gbi ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ lɛɛ a nui.
I bi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?’ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de mi ke, ‘Tee si nɛ o ya Damasko, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a maa tsɔɔ mo níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu to ha mo kaa o pee ɔ.’ La nɛ kpɛ ɔ ha nɛ i hyɛ we nɔ́ hu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ kɛ mi nyɛɛ ɔ ta ye dɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ mi ya su Damasko.
“Nyumu ko ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania.
E jaa Mawu anɔkuale mi; nɛ e yeɔ Mose mlaa a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yuda bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa.
Lɛ nɛ e ba ye ngɔ, nɛ e ba da ye kasa nya, nɛ e de mi ke, ‘Ye nyɛminyumu Saulo, hyɛ nɔ́!’ Jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, i bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi ekohu, nɛ i na lɛ.
E de mi ke, ‘Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a Mawu ɔ hla mo ngɔ to, konɛ o le e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ o na e Tsɔlɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, konɛ o nu lɛ nitsɛ e nya mi gbi.
Ejakaa o ma ba ye e he odase; nɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o nu nɛ o na a, o maa fiɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ tsle toe?
Tee si nɛ o ha a sɔle mo ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi, nɛ o kpa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ e ngɔ o he yayami kɛ pa mo.’ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de Paulo ke e ya fiɛ ha ma je li ɔmɛ “I kpale ye se kɛ ba Yerusalem ekohu; nɛ benɛ i ya ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ sɔlemi we, nɔ́ nɔ ye nɔ.
Nɛ i na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ mi dee ke, ‘Pee esɔ nɛ o je Yeruslem mlamlaamla, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ye he odase nɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ, a be tue bue.’ I he nɔ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a le kaa sa a, imi nɔuu lɛ i yaa kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ he mo ye ɔ, i ya nuɔ mɛ, nɛ i fiaa mɛ ní.
Benɛ a gbe Stefano, nɔ nɛ ye o he odase ɔ, imi hu i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ye bua jɔ e gbenɔ ɔ he, nɛ nihi nɛ gbe lɛ ɔ, imi lɛ i bu a tade ɔmɛ a he.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de mi ke, ‘Yaa, ejakaa ma tsɔ mo ma je li ɔmɛ a ngɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo!’ ” Ni ɔmɛ bu Paulo tue hluu kɛ ba si e wo munyu nɛ ɔ ta, kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni ngmlaa kpami wawɛɛ ke, “A kɛ lɛ nɛ ho!
A gbe lɛ!
E sɛ kaa e hii je mi!” Benɛ ngmlaa ngɛ pɛe ɔ, a ngɛ a tade ɔmɛ fɔ̃e kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe yae kɛ a nɔ bunyuku kpii.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Roma asafoatsɛngua a fa e we bi ɔmɛ ke a kɛ Paulo nɛ ya mɔ ɔ mi.
E de kɛ piɛ he hu ke a fia lɛ kpa kɛ hla e yi mi, konɛ a le nɔ́ he je nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ lɛ woe kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
Se benɛ a fi lɛ nɛ a maa fia lɛ kpa a, Paulo bi asafoatsɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke, “Roma no nɛ a kojo we lɛ, nɛ a bui lɛ fɔ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa nyɛ fiaa lɛ kpa?” Benɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ nu enɛ ɔ, e ya asafoatsɛngua a ngɔ, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Mɛni o maa ho peemi ya nɛ ɔ?
Nyumu ɔ, Roma no ji lɛ!” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, asafoatsɛngua a ba Paulo ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ Roma no ji mo?
De mi!” Paulo he nɔ ke, “Ee!” Asafoatsɛngua a de lɛ ke, “Sika babauu i ha loko i ba pee Roma no.” Se Paulo he nɔ ke, “Imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi Roma no.” Benɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ yaa a nu enɛ ɔ, a laa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ amlɔ.
Asafoatsɛngua a hu e tsui po; ejakaa e na kaa Paulo ɔ, mamoo Roma no ji lɛ, nɛ e wo lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ.
A kɛ Paulo ba kpe ngua a hɛ mi Asafoatsɛngua a suɔ kaa e le nɔ́ tutuutu he je nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ po Paulo nya a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e nɔ jena a, e je lɛ, nɛ e fa ke osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba bua a he nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Paulo ba da a hɛ mi.
Paulo hyɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kɛ kpe, nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel bi, kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ba ye je mi saminya, nɛ ye he nile bui mi fɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Anania, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a fa nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a ke a gba e nya ma.
Paulo de lɛ ke, “Mo hu Mawu ma gba mo ma kokooko; mo nɛ o ngɛ kaa gli nɛ a sa he kalo!
Mo nɛ o blɔ nya ji kaa o hyɛ nɛ a kojo mi ngɛ mlaa a nya a, hyɛ kaa mo mohu o je mlaa a se fa ke a gba mi ma!” Nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ!
Mawu we osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a o ngɛ jɛe nɛ ɔ?” Paulo he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel bi, i li kaa lɛ ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a. Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, ‘O ma mi nɔkɔtɔma a, koo tu e he munyu yaya!’ ” Benɛ Paulo kpa si kaa kpe ngua mi bi ɔmɛ fa kake ji Saduki bi, nɛ fa hu pee ɔ Farisi bi ɔ, e wo e gbi nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel bi, Farisi no ji mi, nɛ ye fɔli hu Farisi bi ji mɛ.
A ngɛ mi kojoe ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ejakaa i heɔ yeɔ kaa hwɔɔ se ɔ, ni gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.” Benɛ e de kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ pɛ sɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ kpe ɔ mi gba enyɔ.
(Saduki bi deɔ ke ni gbogboehi be si tee kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
A deɔ hu ke hiɔwe bɔfo ko be ɔ, mumi ko hu be.
Se Farisi bi lɛɛ a heɔ ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ.)
Huhui ɔ nya ba wa, nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a se ɔ te si kɛ pɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nɛ nɔ́ yaya ko ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he!
Alini mumi ko, loo hiɔwe bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ tu munyu niinɛ!” Benɛ pɛ ɔ mi ba wa a, asafoatsɛngua a ye gbeye kaa eko ɔ, a ma tsɔtslɔɔ Paulo mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa e ta buli ɔmɛ ke a kple si nɛ a ya ngɔ Paulo ngɛ a dɛ pani nya, nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ ba mɔ ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba da Paulo kasa nya, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Koo ye gbeye.
Bɔ nɛ o ye ye he odase ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ ɔ, ja o ya ye odase jã nɔuu ngɛ Roma hulɔ.” A so Paulo yi nɔ Benɛ je na a, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ya so.
A ka a he kita kaa a be ní yee, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nue kɛ yaa si a maa gbe Paulo.
Nihi nɛ ya so nɛ a ka a he kita nɛ ɔ pe nimli nyingmi eywiɛ.
A ya osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ ya de ke, “Wa ka wa he kita kaa wa be wa nya mi nɔ́ ko woe kɛ yaa si wa maa gbe Paulo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ha nyɛ gbi ya su Roma asafoatsɛngua a. Nyɛ de lɛ ke e ngɔ Paulo ngɔ mane nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ buá de lɛ ke nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ e sane ɔ mi fitsofitso.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa pee klaalo, nɛ wa maa gbe lɛ loko e maa su nyɛ ngɔ.” Se Paulo nyɛmiyo bi ko nu ga nɛ a to ɔ he; nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ya mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e ya de Paulo.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo tsɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ niheyo nɛ ɔ kɛ ya asafoatsɛngua a ngɔ; e hɛɛ sɛ gbi ko kɛ ha lɛ.” Asafoatsɛ ɔ ngɔ niheyo ɔ kɛ ya asafoatsɛngua a ngɔ, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Paulo, nɔ nɛ a bɔ lɛ pã a tsɛ mi, nɛ e de mi ke ma ngɔ niheyo nɛ ɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ, ejakaa e hɛɛ sɛ gbi ko kɛ ha mo.” Asafoatsɛngua a nu niheyo ɔ nine si, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya se, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni sane o ngɛ nɛ o ma de mi?” E de lɛ ke, “Yuda nikɔtɔma amɛ to kaa a ma ba de mo nɛ hwɔɔ ɔ, o ngɔ Paulo kɛ ba kpe ngua a hɛ mi.
A maa buá ma de enɛ ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e sane ɔ mi nɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a hyɛ fitsofitso.
Se moo lɛɛ koo kplɛɛ; ejakaa a ti nihi maa pee nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ se maa wo lɛ ka.
A ka kita kaa a be ní yee, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nue, ja a gbe Paulo lolo.
A dla a he, nɛ a ngɛ o nya tue bue.” Asafoatsɛngua a de niheyo ɔ ke, “Ko de nɔ ko nɔ ko ke o wo sane nɛ ɔ nɔ ta ha mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo niheyo ɔ blɔ.
A kɛ Paulo ya ha amlaalo Felike Jehanɛ asafoatsɛngua a tsɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ hla ta buli lafa enyɔ, okpɔngɔ ta buli nyingmi kpaago, kɛ akplɔ hɛɛli hu lafa enyɔ, nɛ a pee klaalo.
Mwɔnɛ ɔ gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ nɛɛ mi ɔ, a maa je hiɛ ɔ kɛ ya Kaisarea.
Nyɛ hla okpɔngɔ komɛ hu ha Paulo nɛ e hi nɔ; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ya ha amlaalo Felike slɔkee.” Asafoatsɛngua a ngma womi, nɛ e de ngɛ mi ke, “Womi nɛ ɔ je imi Klaudio Lisia, ye ngɔ kɛ yaa ha amlaalo Felike.
Mo he manye oo, mo he manye!
Yuda bi ɔmɛ nu kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ, nɛ jinɛ a maa gbe lɛ.
Se benɛ i ná le kaa Roma no ji lɛ ɔ, i kɛ ye ta buli ɔmɛ ya kpɔ̃ lɛ.
I hla kaa ma le nɔ́ he je nɛ a ngɛ e nya poe ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ lɛ ya a kpe ngua a hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ i na ji, nyumu ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa kaa a gbe lɛ, loo a wo lɛ tsu tete; e nya nɛ a po ɔ kɔɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a mlaa he nɔ jemi sane komɛ a he.
Se benɛ i ná le kaa a so e yi nɔ nɛ a maa gbe lɛ ɔ, i pee ye yi mi kaa a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba o ngɔ amlɔ nɔuu.
I de e nya poli ɔmɛ hu ke sanehi nɛ a ngɛ kɛ si lɛ ɔ, a ba o ngɔ, konɛ a ba jaje.” Kɛkɛ nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ a fa mɛ ɔ.
A ngɔ Paulo, nɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu a kɛ lɛ ba Antipatri.
E nɔ jena a, ta buli nane nyɛɛli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba mɔ ɔ mi ekohu, nɛ a si okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ, konɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ ho.
Benɛ a su Kaisarea a, a kɛ womi ɔ ya ha amlaalo ɔ, nɛ a tu Paulo hu ngɔ wo e dɛ mi.
Amlaalo ɔ kane womi ɔ, nɛ e bi Paulo kpokpa nɔ he nɛ e je.
Jehanɛ, benɛ e ná le kaa Paulo je Kilikia a, e de lɛ ke, “Nihi nɛ kɛ mo na a, ke a ba su hiɛ ɔ konɛ ma bu mo tue.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e fa ke a ngɔ Paulo kɛ ya mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya bu e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ po Paulo nya Ligbi enuɔ se ɔ, Anania, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ ma nikɔtɔma komɛ, kɛ otsiamɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Tertulo ɔ ba Kaisarea.
A ba Felike ngɔ, nɛ a ba po Paulo nya ha lɛ.
A tsɛ Paulo kɛ ba; kɛkɛ nɛ Tertulo bɔni e nya pomi ke, “Wa nɔmo Felike, o ngɛ wa nɔ hyɛe saminya kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha wa tue mi jɔ wɔ be babauu.
A to blɔ nya kɛ ngɛ ní komɛ tsakee kɛ ha ma a nɔ yami.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, wa ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he nyae ngɛ he tsuaa he; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa naa mo si.
I sume kaa ma tu munyu fuu kɛ puɛ o be.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ o bu wɔ tue kpiti.
Wa na nyumu nɛ ɔ kaa ma ywialɔ.
E woɔ Yuda bi a yi mi ngɛ he tsuaa he ke a tsɔ atuã.
Jehanɛ hu, kuu nɛ a tsɛɛ Nazaree ɔ a nyatsɛ kpanaku ji lɛ.
E ka tete po kaa e ma ble sɔlemi we ɔ, se wa nu lɛ.
[Jinɛ wa to kaa wa maa kojo lɛ ngɛ wa mlaa a nya.
Se asafoatsɛngua Lisia ba kpɔ lɛ ngɛ wa dɛ kã nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ho.]
E fa nihi nɛ ngɛ Paulo nya poe ɔ ke a ba mo nitsɛ o ngɔ.
Ke o ta e nya mi ɔ, mo nitsɛ o maa nu níhi tsuo nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ e nya poe ɔ.” Yuda bi ɔmɛ hu fia Tertulo nɔ́ ɔ se pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e de ɔ. Paulo je e nya ngɛ Felike hɛ mi Jehanɛ ɔ, amlaalo ɔ fɔ Paulo nine ke e tu munyu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I le kaa pi mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ o bɔni kojomi ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ná bua jɔmi saminya kaa ma je ye nya ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Ke mo nitsɛ o bu ɔ, o maa na kaa ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ pɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i ba be kɛ ho Yerusalem ya nɛ ma ya ja Mawu.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ́ kaa i kɛ nɔ ko ngɛ nya sãe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ mi a nɛ́ hu kaa i ngɛ ma a yi mi woe ngɛ kpe he ɔ, aloo he kpa ko ngɛ ma a mi.
Jehanɛ hu, sanehi nɛ a kɛ fɔ ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, a be nya nyɛe maa tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ mi.
Niinɛ ɔ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ i jaa ngɛ tsɔɔmi ɔ nɛ mɛɛ a deɔ ke e pi blɔ kpakpa a mi.
Imi hu níhi nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, i heɔ lɛ tsuo yeɔ.
I heɔ Mawu yeɔ kaa adesahi tsuo maa te si kɛ je gbeje hwɔɔ se, ni kpakpahi jio, yayami peeli jio; nimli nɛ ɔmɛ heɔ enɛ ɔ yeɔ ja nɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i bɔɔ mɔde kaa daa nɛ ɔ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ maa sa Mawu, kɛ adesahi tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ ye he nile be mi fɔ bue.
“I hia blɔ kɛ je Yerusalem ya ye jeha babauu ngɛ ma se.
Pee se ɔ, i kpale kɛ ba kɛ ye dɛ mi nike ní nɛ ma ba ha ye ma a mi bi komɛ, konɛ imi nitsɛ hu ma sã bɔ.
Benɛ i ngɛ kusumi ɔmɛ pee ɔ, a na mi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i pee kusumi ɔ kɛ tsukɔ ye he gbe nya momo.
Nɔ ko nɛ́ mi nɛ i kɛ nihi fuu daa si, jehanɛ hu, nɔ ko pee we basabasa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se Yuda bi komɛ nɛ je Asia a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; mɛ mohu nɛ sa kaa a ba o hɛ mi, konɛ ke a ngɛ ye he sane ko ɔ, nɛ a ba jaje.
Nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ po, ke a na nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ngɛ ye he benɛ i daa si ngɛ kpe ngua a hɛ mi ɔ, a de.
Nɔ́ pɛ nɛ a ko nyɛ de ji, benɛ i daa si ngɛ kpe ngua a hɛ mi ɔ, i wo ye gbi nɔ nɛ i de ke, ‘Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ mi kojoe, ejakaa i heɔ yeɔ kaa ni gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.’ ” Felike le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔɔmi ɔ he sane saminya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ̃ munyu ɔ ngɔ to, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke asafoatsɛngua Lisia ba su kɛkɛ ma buá sane ɔ he.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fa asafoatsɛ ɔ ke e ngɔ Paulo kɛ ho nɛ e ya bu e he, se e ha nɛ e na he jɔmi bɔɔ; nɛ ke e huɛmɛ ba nɛ a ba pee nɔ́ ko ha lɛ ɔ, e ko tsi mɛ blɔ.
Paulo ngɛ Felike kɛ Drusila a hɛ mi Be saii se ɔ, Felike kɛ e yo Drusila ba.
E yo ɔ, Yuda no ji lɛ.
Felike ha a ya tsɛ Paulo kɛ ba.
Benɛ Paulo ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi he ɔ, e bu lɛ tue saminya.
Se benɛ Paulo ngɛ dami, he nɔ yemi, kɛ kojomi nɛ maa ba a he munyu tue ɔ, Felike ye gbeye wawɛɛ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Yaa lolo, ke i na deka a, ma tsɛ mo ekohu.” Blɔɔ e hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa Paulo ma ha lɛ sika, enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ke pee ɔ, e tsɔɔ ya tsɛɔ Paulo, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba sɛɛɔ ní.
Jeha enyɔ se ɔ, Porkio Festo ba ye Felike nane mi kaa amlaalo.
Felike hla kaa e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsi Paulo nya ngɛ tsu ɔ mi.
Paulo ngɔ e sane ɔ kɛ ha Roma matsɛ ɔ Festo ba bɔni amlaalo yemi ligbi etɛ se pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e je Kaisarea kɛ ho Yerusalem ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba po Paulo nya ha lɛ.
A kpa Festo pɛɛ ke e hyɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ Paulo kɛ ba Yerusalem; mɛɛ lɛɛ a so e yi nɔ nɛ a maa gbe lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.
Se Festo he nɔ ke, “A wo Paulo tsu ngɛ Kaisarea, nɛ imi nitsɛ hu e be kɛe nɛ ma ya lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ha nyɛ nya dali ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ mi nɛ ya Kaisarea, nɛ ke sane yaya ko ngɛ nyumu ɔ he ɔ, a de ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” Festo ye maa pee ligbi kpaanyɔ, loo nyɔngma ngɛ a ngɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Kaisarea ya.
E nɔ jena a, e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e fa ke a kɛ Paulo nɛ ba.
Benɛ Paulo ba lejɛ ɔ, Yuda bi nɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ba a ba bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ a kɛ sanehi babauu nɛ nya wa ba po e nya.
Se níhi nɛ a de kɛ si Paulo ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a tsɔɔ kaa ní ɔmɛ ngɛ mi niinɛ.
Paulo je e nya, nɛ e de ke, “I tɔ we Yuda bi ɔmɛ a mlaa ko; i pee we nɔ́ ko kɛ ble we sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ Kaisare ɔ hu i tɔ we e nɔ.” Se akɛnɛ Festo hla kaa e maa sa Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi he je ɔ, e bi Paulo ke, “O suɔ kaa o maa ya Yerusalem nɛ ma ya kojo mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo?” Paulo de lɛ ke, “Kaisare ɔ nitsɛ kojomi sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, he nɛ sa kaa a kojo mi ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ i daa si ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I tɔ we Yuda bi a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o le ɔ. Ke i ye sane yaya ko, nɛ i pee nɔ́ nɛ sa gbenɔ ɔ, i de we ke a ngmɛɛ ye he.
Se ke sanehi nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ ye nya poe nɛ ɔ be mi ɔ, nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ngɔ mi ngɔ wo a dɛ mi.
I suɔ kaa Kaisare ɔ nitsɛ nɛ ye ye sane ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Festo kɛ e ga woli ɔmɛ hla munyu ɔ mi; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de ke, “Nɛ o ngɔ o sane ɔ kɛ ha Kaisare ɔ nitsɛ ke e ye ha mo ɔ, ma ha nɛ o ya Kaisare ɔ ngɔ.” Paulo ngɛ Agripa kɛ Bernike a hɛ mi Be bɔɔ ko se ɔ, Matsɛ Agripa kɛ Bernike ba Kaisarea nɛ a ba nga Festo kɛ pee lɛ baba hee.
Benɛ e ye be saii ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Festo bɔ matsɛ ɔ Paulo he sane ɔ. E de lɛ ke, “Felike je pã mi no ko he ngɛ tsu mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. Benɛ i ya Yerusalem ɔ, Yuda osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba ye ngɔ ba po e nya, nɛ a kpa mi pɛɛ ke ma bu lɛ fɔ.
Se i de mɛ ke, e be Roma bi a mlaa a mi kaa a buu nɔ ko fɔ ke a gbe lɛ, ja nɔ nɛ a po e nya a, kɛ e nya poli ɔmɛ kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi nɛ nɔ ɔ ná he blɔ je e nya ngɛ sane nɛ a ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ he lolo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a nya ba bua ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, i tui tsle, se e nɔ jena a, i ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ i fa ke a ngɔ nyumu ɔ kɛ ba.
E nya poli ɔmɛ ba da si; se sane yayahi nɛ i susu kaa a kɛ ma ba po e nya a, a kɛ kake ngmelu po bɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba ji mɛ nitsɛmɛ a Mawu jami he nɔ́ jemi sane komɛ, kɛ Yesu ko nɛ gbo, nɛ Paulo lɛɛ e ke e ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ he sanehi.
I li bɔ nɛ ma pee kɛ hla kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i bi Paulo ke e suɔ nɛ e ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya ye e sane ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ lo?
Se Paulo de ke e ngɔ e sane ɔ kɛ ha Kaisare ɔ nɛ e ye ha lɛ.
E suɔ kaa a bu e he kɛ yaa si Kaisare ɔ nitsɛ maa hyɛ e sane ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i fa ke a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to, nɛ́ a bu e he kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ha nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Kaisare ɔ ngɔ.” Agripa de Festo ke, “I suɔ kaa imi nitsɛ ma bu nyumu nɛ ɔ tue.” Festo he nɔ ke, “Hwɔɔ ɔ, ma ha nɛ o ba bu lɛ tue.” E nɔ jena a, Agripa kɛ Bernike mia saminya kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo sɛ tsu mi he nɛ a kpee ngɛ ɔ. Festo fa nɛ a kɛ Paulo ba tsu ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Festo de ke, “Matsɛ Agripa, kɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ hyɛe.
Yuda bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, kɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hulɔ ɔ ba po e nya wawɛɛ.
A kpa ngmlaa wo mi ke e sɛ kaa e hii je mi hu.
Se imi lɛɛ i na kaa e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ.
Akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ e sane ɔ kɛ ha Roma matsɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ma nya si kaa a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya ha Roma matsɛ ɔ.
Se i be sane tutuutu ko nɛ ma ngma ya ha Roma matsɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i kɛ lɛ ba nyɛ hɛ mi, titli ɔ, mo Matsɛ Agripa o hɛ mi, konɛ ke o hla sane ɔ mi ɔ, ma na nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ngma.
E peeɔ mi kaa e dɛ kaa a ngɔɔ pã mi no ko kɛ maneɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ we nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ e pee.”
Paulo je e nya ngɛ Agripa hɛ mi Jehanɛ Agripa de Paulo ke, “A ngmɛ mo blɔ, mo je o nya!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Paulo fɔ e nine, nɛ e fa e he ke, “Matsɛ Agripa, e ngɔ ye nya kaa ma je ye nya mwɔnɛ ɔ ngɛ o hɛ mi, ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ ye nya poe ɔ a he.
Moo lɛɛ o le Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kusumihi tsuo, kɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o to tsui si, nɛ o bu mi tue.
“Yuda bi tsuo le bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi kɛ je sisije.
A le bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi ha ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye ma a mi, kɛ Yerusalem tsuo.
Ke a maa ye odase anɔkuale mi ɔ, a maa na kaa kɛ je sisije ɔ, i hi si kaa Farisi no.
Wa Farisi kuu ɔ ji nihi nɛ peeɔ veveeve pe kulaa ngɛ Mawu jami mi.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ mi kojoe kaa si ko nɛ Mawu wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ be ko ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ.
Wa wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ ngɛ siwo nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a jaa Mawu saminya nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ a nine nɛ su Mawu siwo ɔ nɔ.
Nɛnɛ, kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ he je nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ye nya poe nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Jehanɛ, nyɛ Yuda bi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ he we yi kaa Mawu ma nyɛ ma tle ni gbogboehi si ɔ?
“Imi nitsɛ hu jinɛ i susu kaa ma bɔ mɔde kɛ puɛ Yesu, Nazaret no ɔ ní tsumi ɔ. I na pee jã hulɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ nitsɛmɛ ngmɛ mi blɔ nɛ i wa nihi nɛ ji Mawu bimɛ ɔ yi mi.
I wo a ti nihi babauu tsu, nɛ ke a bu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ ɔ, imi hu ye nya ngɛ mi.
I ha nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi si abɔ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ i bɔ mɔde kaa a ngmɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
Ye hɛ dɔ wo mɛ, nɛ i tiu mɛ kɛ ya ma se zugbahi a nɔ tɔɔ ya wa mɛ yi mi.
Paulo sɛɛ e tsui tsakemi he ní “Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ho Damasko ya kɛ ye dɛ mi womi nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ ha mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa mɛ lɛ a ha mi he wami.
Nɛnɛ, piani katakata, benɛ i nyɛɛ blɔ kɛ yaa a, i na la ko nɛ kpɛ nylamnylam pe pu po kɛ je hiɔwe ba bɔle mi, kɛ nihi nɛ kɛ mi nyɛɛ ɔ. Wɔ tsuo wa ya nɔ si, nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ngɛ Hebri mi ke, ‘Saulo, Saulo!
Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ mi yi mi wae?
Ke o ke o kɛ mi ná a, o he awi kɛkɛ o ngɛ yee, kaa na nɛ ngɛ e tsɔ̃lɔ tso koli hɛɛe.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ i bi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, mo mɛnɔ?’ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Imi ji Yesu nɛ o ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ.
Se, tee si ngɛ zugba, nɛ o da si.
I je ye he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo, konɛ ma tsɔ mo, nɛ o ya ye ye he odase.
Bɔ nɛ i je ye he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo mwɔnɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo hwɔɔ se ɔ, o ma ya fiɛ kɛ ha nihi tsuo.
Ma je mo kɛ je yayami nɛ Israel ma a maa pee mo ɔ mi, nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ ma tsɔ mo a ngɔ ɔ hu a be mo awi ko nyɛe maa ye.
O ma ya bli a hɛngmɛ, konɛ a je diblii mi kɛ ba la he; o ma ya je mɛ kɛ je Abosiami ɔ he wami sisi kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma he imi Yesu nɛ a ye, nɛ Mawu maa ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ, nɛ a maa ba a hi he ngɛ nihi nɛ Mawu hla kɛ pee e ma a a kpɛti.’ Paulo sɛɛ bɔ nɛ e fiɛ he ní “Matsɛ Agripa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nina nɛ a je tsɔɔ mi kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ, i ye nɔ saminya.
I fiɛ ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke a tsake a tsui, nɛ a kpale kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, nɛ a pee níhi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsake a tsui niinɛ.
I je fiɛmi nɛ ɔ sisi kɛ je Damasko kɛ ya gu Yerusalem kɛ ya muɔ Yudea zugba a, kɛ ya su ma je li ɔmɛ a ngɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ba nu mi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a ka kaa a maa gbe mi ɔ nɛ.
Se Mawu piɛ ye he kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nɛ i daa si ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ nimli tsuo tsɔɔe, nimli wawi kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mose kɛ gbali ɔmɛ de to kaa e maa ba mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ i ngɛ dee.
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa Kristo ɔ maa na amanehlu, nɛ e ba pee kekleekle nɔ nɛ maa te si kɛ je gbeje.
E ma ba fiɛ ha Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo ke a ma nyɛ ma he a yi wami, nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee kaa la kɛ ha mɛ.” Benɛ Paulo je e nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Festo de kɛ ngmlaa kɛ wo lɛ ke, “Paulo, o yi mi ngɛ puɛe pɛ!
Womi kasemi sɔuu lɛ wo mo godo nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Paulo he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ Festo, i nui godo; anɔkuale ɔ i ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛ Agripa, i ngɛ munyu tue kɛ kã kɛ ngɛ mo tsɔɔe, ejakaa o le sane nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
I he we yi kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko ngɛ nɛ a kɛ laa mo; ejakaa a pee we ekoeko ngɛ kɔkɔɔmi.
Matsɛ Agripa, níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma a, tse o heɔ yeɔ?
I le kaa o heɔ yeɔ!” Agripa de Paulo ke, “Be kpiti nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, anɛ o susu kaa o ma nyɛ plɛ ye yi mi nɛ ma pee Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ lo?” Paulo he nɔ ke, “Be ɔ kɛ jio, e kɛ́ we jio; i na nɛ jinɛ Mawu ha e ba mi kaa pi mo nɔ kake kɛkɛ, se mohu nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi tue bue mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ hu ko pee kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ; kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a ko wo mɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo e he nɔ, nɛ amlaalo ɔ, kɛ Bernike, kɛ ni kpa amɛ hu te si ja nɔuu.
Benɛ a gbla a he si bɔɔ ɔ, a de ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa kaa a gbe lɛ, loo a wo lɛ tsu.” Agripa de Festo ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ e sane ɔ kɛ ha we Kaisare ɔ ke e ye jinɛ a ko ngmɛɛ e he.”
A ngɔ Paulo kɛ yaa Roma Benɛ a ma nya si kaa wa ma wo lɛ kɛ ya Italia a, a ngɔ Paulo kɛ pamitsɛmɛ kpa komɛ hu ngɔ wo Roma asafoatsɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yulio ɔ dɛ.
Asafoatsɛ nɛ ɔ, “Roma matsɛ tabo” ɔ mi no ji lɛ.
Wa wó Adramitio lɛ ko kɛ ho.
Lɛ nɛ ɔ yaa gu Asia wo nya ma amɛ a lɛsimuɔ he ɔmɛ.
Aristarko, Makedonia no ɔ nɛ je Tesalonika a piɛ wa he.
E nɔ jena a, wa ya su Sidon.
Yulio hɛɛ Paulo saminya; e ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ya slaa e huɛmɛ, nɛ a ha lɛ níhi nɛ hia lɛ.
Wa hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, se akɛnɛ wa ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kpee he je ɔ, wa ya gu Kipro kasa nya he nɛ zugba a tsi kɔɔhiɔ nya ngɛ.
Kipro ji zugba kpɔ ko nɛ wo bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Wa po Kilikia kɛ Pamfilia wo ɔ, nɛ wa ba da Mira ngɛ Likia.
Asafoatsɛ ɔ na Aleksandria lɛ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ yaa Italia, nɛ e je wɔ ngɔ wo mi.
Wa nyɛɛ blɛuu be saii nɛ dengme loko wa su Kenido ma a hanɔ.
Se akɛnɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ngmɛ́ wɔ blɔ nɛ waa ya hɛ mi he je ɔ, wa gba kɛ ya gu Salmone hanɔ kɛ tsɔ Kreta zugba kpɔ ɔ he.
Zugba kpɔ nɛ ɔ tsi kɔɔhiɔ nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Wa nyɛɛ kpo ɔ he haa, se dengme loko wa po mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Lɛsimuɔ he Jɔjɔɛ.
Hiɛ ɔ, kɛ Lasea ma a he kɛ we.
Wa puɛ be babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si wa na kaa ke wa ke wa ma tsa blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ ɔ, e maa pee haomi sɔuu.
Jehanɛ ɔ Kpatami ligbi ɔ hu be momo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Paulo wo mɛ ga ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ, i na kaa kɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, wa blɔ hiami ɔ maa pee haomi sɔuu.
Lɛ ɔ maa ywia, tlomi ɔ maa laa, nɛ nimli a bimɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.” Se munyu nɛ kudɔɔtsɛ ɔ, kɛ lɛtsɛ ɔ tu ɔ mohu ya asafoatsɛ ɔ yi mi pe ga nɛ Paulo wo mɛ ɔ. Lɛsimuɔ he ɔ pi he nɛ a ma nyɛ maa ye fĩɛ be ɔ ngɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ti nihi fuu wo ga kaa a hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ka kaa alini a maa su Foinike, konɛ a ya ye fiɛ be ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kreta lɛsimuɔ he ji Foinike, nɛ e ngɛ leneyi kɛ bonyoku je, kɛ omleyi kɛ bonyoku je a kpɛti.
Wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nguaa hia Kɔɔhiɔ ba bɔni fiami blɛuu kɛ je leneyi je, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ ba mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbla sɛkɛ ɔ, nɛ a hia kɛ be ngɛ Kreta wo ɔ nya tataata.
Tlukaa a, wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ ko hia ba kpee mɛ.
A tsɛɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ ke, “Omleyi kɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ.” Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ba na lɛ ɔ, se akɛnɛ wa nyɛ we nɛ wa kudɔ lɛ ɔ kɛ kpee kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, wa ngmɛɛ lɛ ɔ he ha kɔɔhiɔ ɔ. Benɛ wa kplaa kɛ ya su wo kpɔ nyafii ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Kauda a we leneyi je ɔ, wa ná mumi womi he bɔɔ, nɛ wa nyɛ nu lɛ ɔ mi boto ɔ.
A wo boto ɔ nɔ kɛ je wo ɔ mi kɛ ba lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a fi boto ɔ kɛ wo angmla a he kpɛkpɛtɛɛ.
A ngɛ gbeye yee kaa alini a ma ya sa zia kɛ mɔsɔ nɔ ngɛ Libia wo ɔ nya; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbe abalaa, konɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ kplaa lɛ ɔ kɛ ya.
Wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a doo wa nya wawɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e nɔ jena a, a bɔni tlomi ɔ jemi ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi kɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi puee.
Ligbi etɛne ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a je lɛ ɔ he ní ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɔ pue wo ɔ mi.
Wa nɛ́ pu kɛ dodoe hɛ mi ligbi babauu.
Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ngɛ fiae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nyagbe ɔ, wa je wa hɛ fɔ si, ejakaa wa be hɛ nɔ kami kaa wa yi ma na wami.
Ni ɔmɛ yi ní be saii enɛ ɔ ha Paulo te da si nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ, jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛ ko bu mi tue, nɛ a ko hiɛ lɛ ɔ kɛ ji Kreta.
Jinɛ wa ko ba nɛ nɔ́, nɛ níhi a hɛ mi hu ko ba kpataa we kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ na tsui!
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be gboe.
Lɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ ma bɔ wɔ.
Ejakaa nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu, nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ji mi, nɛ lɛ nɔuu nɛ i jaa bɔfo ba da ye kasa nya, nɛ e de mi ke, ‘Paulo, koo ye gbeye!
Ja a kɛ mo ya da Kaisare ɔ hɛ mi kokooko.
Mawu na mo mɔbɔ saminya, nɛ e he o kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ nyɛ yi wami.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛ na tsui ejakaa i heɔ Mawu yeɔ, nɛ i le kaa bɔ nɛ e de mi ɔ, jã nɛ e maa ba mi.
Wa ma ya sa si ngɛ zugba kpɔ ko nɛ wo bɔle lɛ nɔ.” Kɛ ba su ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ngɛ wa se tsɛ̃e wawɛɛ ngɛ Adria wo ɔ nɔ.
Maa pee nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ, lɛ ɔ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ susu kaa a su zugba he ta.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a fɔ̃ kpa kɛ e se tɛ kɛ kale wo ɔ mi kuɔmi, nɛ a ná gugue nyingmi enyɔ.
Benɛ a ya hɛ mi bɔɔ ɔ, a fɔ̃ kpa a ekohu, nɛ a ná gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ha a ye gbeye kaa alini nɛ lɛ ɔ ma ya sa si ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a fɔ̃ osɛkɛ eywiɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ supa je kɛ ngɛ mlɛe nɛ je nɛ na mla.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ ɔ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ ka kaa a maa tu fo kɛ je lɛ ɔ mi.
A je boto ɔ ngɔ wo wo ɔ mi, nɛ a buá pee kaa a yaa fɔ̃ osɛkɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ yi je.
Se Paulo de asafoatsɛ ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke lɛ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ je lɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ nyɛ be je mi tlɔe.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ta buli ɔmɛ poo kpa nɛ a kɛ fi boto ɔ, konɛ boto ɔ nɛ ho.
Makɛ, benɛ je mi tsɔ we lolo ɔ, Paulo kpa ni ɔmɛ tsuo pɛɛ ke a ye nɔ́ ko.
E de mɛ ke, “Ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko yɛ nyɛ nya mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye ní, ejakaa lɔ ɔ lɛ ma ha nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso he wami.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛ ti nɔ ko pee.” Benɛ Paulo de enɛ ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, e ku mi, nɛ e bɔni yemi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a nɔ gbagba te, nɛ mɛ tsuo a ye ní.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ a yibɔ ji lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi kpaago kɛ ekpa.
Benɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ye ní bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ ɔ, a je ngma a tsuo ngɔ wo wo ɔ mi, konɛ lɛ ɔ nɛ pee huyɛhuyɛ.
Lɛ ɔ butu Benɛ je na a, lɛ ɔ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ li wo kpo he nɛ a ba su ɔ, se a na wo nya kɔtɔmi he ko kɛ e nya zia, nɛ a pee a yi mi kaa ke a ma nyɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ lɛ ɔ kɛ ya sa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a poo osɛkɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo wo ɔ mi, nɛ a pɛne kpa nɛ fi kudɔɔ ɔ hulɔ.
Jehanɛ a wo abalaa nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ yi ɔ, konɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ nɛ ha nɛ lɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ya hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ wa ngɔ wa yi kɛ pi wo kpo ɔ. Lɛ ɔ ya hɛ zia kpɔ, nɛ e pu zu; e yiti ɔ ya hɛ si kpɛii, se e supa a lɛɛ oslɔke ɔ ywia lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.
Ta buli ɔmɛ pee a yi mi kaa a maa gbe pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ a ti nɔ ko nɛ ko sile kɛ ho nɛ e ba tu fo kɛ je.
Se asafoatsɛ ɔ to e yi mi kaa e ma he Paulo yi wami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsi a nya, nɛ a gbi nɔ ko.
Mohu ɔ, e fa ke nihi tsuo nɛ le silemi ɔ, mɛ kekle a tu ngɔ pue wo ɔ mi, nɛ a sile kɛ ya nu kpo; ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ nɛ a bu gbegbelihi a nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu a kpla lɛ ɔ he kɛ ya nu kpo.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ mɛ tsuo a ya su kpo slɔkee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Paulo ngɛ Melita Benɛ wa su kpo slɔkee ɔ, wa ná le kaa zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ nɛ ɔ biɛ ji Melita.
Ma mi lejɛ ɔ bi ɔmɛ pee wɔ kpakpa saminya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hiɔmi bɔni nɛmi, nɛ fĩɛ ɔ nya wa; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ slɛ la, nɛ a ha wɔ tsuo wa ya hlue la a. Paulo ya bua lɛ tsɔwi nya, nɛ e kɛ ngɛ la a mi woe, kɛkɛ nɛ sinɔ ko je la glegle ɔ mi ba mimlaa e nine.
Benɛ lejɛ ɔ bi ɔmɛ na lohwe ɔ nɛ kplaa si ngɛ Paulo nine he ɔ, a de a he ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ.
E ná je osla mi ngɛ wo ɔ mi lɛɛ, se loloolo ɔ, e sɛsɛɛ ngmɛ́ lɛ blɔ kaa e hi je mi.” Se Paulo huanya sinɔ ɔ ngɔ wo la a mi, nɛ lohwe ɔ yi lɛ awi ko.
Ni ɔmɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa Paulo maa fuu, loo e ma tsɔ fia si nɛ e gbo tlukaa.
Se benɛ a hyɛ blɔ hluu nɛ a nɛ́ kaa nɔ́ ko pee lɛ ɔ, a tsake a juɛmi, nɛ a de ke, “Mawu ko ji lɛ!” Zugba kpɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ nɔkɔtɔma a, a tsɛɛ lɛ Publio.
E ngɛ ngmɔ nɛ kɛ he nɛ sane nɛ ɔ ba ngɛ ɔ kɛ́ we kulaa.
Nyumu nɛ ɔ he wɔ hɛmuɔ, nɛ e pee wɔ nibwɔ saminya ligbi etɛ sɔuu.
Publio tsɛ hwɔɔ si kpotoo kɛ asla yaya kɛ mi mi pa. Paulo ya sɛ tsu mi he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e sɔle.
E ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tsa lɛ.
Benɛ a tsa hiɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ se ɔ, hiɔtsɛmɛ kpahi nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hu ba, nɛ Paulo tsa mɛ.
Ni ɔmɛ ke wɔ ní babauu, nɛ pee se benɛ wa sɛ lɛ nɛ wa maa ho hiami ya a, a ngɔ níhi nɛ maa hia wɔ ba wo lɛ ɔ mi ha wɔ.
Paulo je Melita kɛ ya Roma Hlami etɛ se ɔ, wa je Melita.
Wa wó lɛ ko nɛ je Aleksandria.
Lɛ ɔ he so ji “Hawi ɔmɛ”, nɛ e ba ye fĩɛ be ɔ ngɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Wa ba su Sirakusa, nɛ wa ye ligbi etɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Wa je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Regio ɔ. E nɔ jena a, kɔɔhiɔ bɔni fiami kɛ je leneyi je nɛ wa ye ligbi enyɔ kɛ ba su Puteoli ma a mi.
Wa ba na nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke waa ye otsi ngɛ a ngɔ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ wa ba su Roma.
Benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Roma a nu wa he ɔ, a ba kpee wɔ ngɛ he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ “Apio Jua nɔ” kɛ “Nibwɔhi a to he Etɛ” ɔ tɔɔ.
Benɛ Paulo na mɛ ɔ, e na Mawu si, nɛ e tsui nɔ e mi fuaa.
Paulo ngɛ Roma Benɛ wa ba su Roma a, a ngmɛ Paulo blɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hi e dɛ he, kɛ ta bulɔ kake nɛ ngɛ e he bue.
Ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Paulo tsɛ lejɛ ɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ kpe.
Benɛ a nya ba bua a, e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel bi, i pee we wa ma a yayami ko, nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kusumihi nɛ a si ha wɔ ɔ hu i tɔ we ekoeko nɔ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nu mi ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a ngɔ mi ngɔ wo Roma bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi kaa pã mi no.
Benɛ Roma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ta ye nya mi kɛ hla sane ɔ mi gbe nya a, jinɛ mɛɛ a hla kaa a maa ngmɛɛ ye he kaa i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa kaa a gbe mi.
Se benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we kaa a ngmɛɛ ye he ɔ, e hia doo kaa ma ngɔ ye sane ɔ kɛ ha Kaisare ɔ nɛ e ye, pohu pi kaa i ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ i kɛ maa po imi nitsɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nya.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he je nɛ i tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ i kɛ nyɛ nɛ sɛɛ ní.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ ngɛ ye he nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ Israel bi ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ ɔ he a wo mi ngɛ.” A de lɛ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa na we womi ko kɛ ji Yudea ngɛ o he; nɛ jehanɛ hu, nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko bɛ hiɛ ɔ ba sɛɛ we o he sane ko, aloo o he munyu yaya ko.
Se wa suɔ kaa wa maa bu mo tue nɛ waa le o juɛmi; ejakaa kuu nɛ o ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ, wa le kaa ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ, a tuɔ e he munyu yaya.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a to Paulo be kpa; nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nihi babauu ba e ngɔ ngɛ he nɛ e ba to ɔ. E gbá níhi a mi tsɔɔ mɛ kɛ je mɔtu kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ.
E tsɔɔ mɛ sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he ɔ, nɛ e kɛ níhi nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ fi e munyu ɔ se, konɛ a na anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu he ɔ.
A ti ni komɛ he ye, nɛ ni komɛ hu he we yi.
Se nɔ́ kake too nɛ Paulo de, nɛ lɔ ɔ kɛ nya sami wawɛɛ ba ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ́ kpe ɔ kɛ gbɛ ji, “Nɔ́ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gu gbalɔ Yesaya nɔ ɔ ngɛ mi jã niinɛ!
Mumi ɔ de gbalɔ ɔ ke, ‘Yaa, nɛ o ya de ma nɛ ɔ ke Nyɛ maa nu, se nyɛ be sisi nue.
Nyɛ maa na, se nyɛ be se kɔe.
Ejakaa ma nɛ ɔ nui nɔ́ sisi kulaa; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sɛ we a tue mi.
Ke pi jã a, a maa hyɛ nɔ́, nɛ a maa nu nɔ́, nɛ a juɛmi ma kɔ nɔ́ se.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa kpale kɛ ba imi Mawu, ye ngɔ, nɛ ma he a yi wami.’ ” Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ na na nyɛɛ le kaa Mawu ngɔ yi wami hemi munyu ɔ ya ha ma je li ɔmɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu tue!” [ Benɛ Paulo de kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ́ a yaa a tsuo, a ngɛ nya sãe wawɛɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti.]
Paulo hi we ko mi jeha enyɔ, nɛ e wo he hiɔ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ba slaa lɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ mɛ kpee ngɛ.
E fiɛɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he sane.
E tu munyu kɛ kã nɛ gbeye yemi ko be e mi; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu tsi we lɛ blɔ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Paulo to e yi mi kaa e ma ya slaa Kristo asafo nɛ ngɛ Roma a, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sɛ hlami ngma womi nɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ wo mɛ si.
E to e yi mi kaa e ma ya tsu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ, konɛ pee se ɔ, asafo ɔ nɛ wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ya Spania.
Bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nuɔ Kristo hemi kɛ yemi ɔ sisi, kɛ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ enɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ Kristo we bi tsuo a wami si himi mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ e ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Paulo sɛ gbi kɛ ha Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ jeɔ kpo saminya ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Sisije ɔ, Paulo nga Roma asafo ɔ, nɛ e ha a le kaa e kpaa Mawu pɛɛ kɛ haa mɛ daa.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔɔ munyu oti nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ ji kaa “Sane kpakpa a lɛ tsɔɔ kaa kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu daa, nɛ e kɛ buu nimli adesahi nihi nɛ da.” Paulo ya nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ munyu oti ɔ nya.
E ke adesahi tsuo, Yuda bi jio, ma je li jio, e hia kaa Mawu nɛ bu mɛ nihi nɛ da, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ yayami he wami sisi.
Mawu buɔ nɔ nɔ nɛ da, ke e he Yesu Kristo ye.
Jehanɛ, Paulo tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ tsakpa nɛ ba nɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ haa e naa wami he ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi.
Nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ kpɔɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ yayami, kɛ gbenɔ he wami ɔ sisi, nɛ e naa Mawu he jɔmi.
Kɛ je yi kɛ ya si yi ɔ, Paulo tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu mlaa a tsuɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ he wami ɔ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nɔ nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ e je mi si himi mi.
Paulo ya nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ nya kaa Mawu ha Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo blɔ nya ngɛ yi mi nɛ e to kɛ ha adesahi tsuo ɔ mi.
E mu munyu ɔ nya kaa Mawu nitsɛ e blɔ nya tomi nya nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kua Yesu, nɛ kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, adesahi tsuo ma ba ná Mawu dloomi ɔ.
Se e he we yi kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma kua Yesu kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sa kaa Kristo we bi nɛ ba a je mi ha, titli ɔ, bɔ nɛ e sa nɛ a suɔ ni kpahi.
Sane pɔtɛɛ komɛ hu nɛ e tu a he munyu ji Mawu sɔmɔmi ní tsumi, Kristo we bi a blɔ nya ní tsumi ha a ma, kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a sibi, kɛ bɔ nɛ nɔ he nile tsuɔ ní.
Paulo gbe womi ɔ nya kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e sɛ gbi komɛ, nɛ e je Mawu yi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Nya tsɔɔmi, kɛ munyu oti ɔ nitsɛ .- E hia kaa a he adesa yi wami .—.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu peeɔ kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami .—.
Wami he nɛ a naa ngɛ Kristo mi .—.
Mawu yi mi tomi kɛ ha Israel .—.
Kristo we bi a je mi bami .—.
Nyagbe munyuhi, kɛ ngami .—.
Imi Paulo, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ kɛ bɔfo nɛ Mawu hla nɛ e tsɔ ke ma ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae.
Mawu wo sane kpakpa a he si ngɔ to momoomo kɛ gu e gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ.
Sane kpakpa a kɔɔ e Bi, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he.
A fɔ lɛ kaa adesa, nɛ David nina ji lɛ.
Se a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ngɛ Mawu mumi ɔ he wami nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu Bi ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Kristo nɔ i gu nɛ i na dloomi, nɛ a wo mi bɔfo, konɛ e biɛ ɔ he ɔ, je ma amɛ kulaa nɛ a bu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tue.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Roma, nɛ Mawu tsɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ba pee Kristo we bi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ piɛ he.
I ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ha nyɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Roma nɛ Mawu suɔ nyɛ, nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba pee lɛ nitsɛ e ni klɔuklɔuhi ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Paulo sɔle kɛ na Mawu si Kekleekle ɔ, i gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ si nae ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, ejakaa a ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ mi ɔ he odase yee ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Mawu ɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ kɛ ye tsui tsuo kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ e Bi ɔ he ɔ fiɛmi mi ɔ ji ye we odase kaa i kaiɔ nyɛ daa nɛ i jɔɔ we ngɛ ye sɔlemi mi.
I kpaa pɛɛ kaa alinɔ Mawu suɔmi nya a jehanɛ lɛɛ blɔ ma bli ha mi nɛ ma nyɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ jae wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ i suɔ kaa ma na nyɛ, konɛ ma ba ha nyɛ mumi mi nike ní kɛ wo nyɛ he wami.
I ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa i kɛ nyɛ tsuo waa ngɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ kɛ wo wa sibi he wami.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa i pee ye yi mi si abɔ kaa ma ba slaa nyɛ, konɛ ma ná yiblii komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ i ná ngɛ ma je li kpa amɛ a kpɛti ɔ.
Se kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i na we blɔ.
I ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ nihi tsuo hiɔ, Hela bi, kɛ nihi nɛ pi Hela bi ji mɛ; ní leli kɛ, kuasiahi tsuo i hɛɛ mɛ hiɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ ye tsui nɔ wawɛɛ kaa maa fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Roma a hulɔ.
Mawu he wami ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi Sane kpakpa a he pee we mi zo, ejakaa e ji Mawu he wami nɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ yi naa wami, Yuda bi kekle, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma je li hulɔ.
Ejakaa sane kpakpa a lɛ tsɔɔ kaa kɛ je sisije kɛ yaa si nyagbe ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu daa nɛ e kɛ buu nimli adesahi nihi nɛ da.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ nɛ a gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a yi ma na wami.” Nimli adesahi tsuo yeɔ fɔ Nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ a bɔɔ musu kɛ tsiɔ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ nya a, Mawu kɛ mi mi fumi nɛ jeɔ hiɔwe gblaa a tue.
Mawu gblaa a tue wawɛɛ, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a le ngɛ Mawu he ɔ fɔɔ si paa; Mawu nitsɛ je tsɔɔ mɛ momo.
Kɛ je be nɛ Mawu bɔ je ɔ, e he wami nɛ ngɛ daa, kɛ e su nɛ ji níhi nɛ a nɛ́ kɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ jeɔ kpo paa ngɛ e nibɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ adesa naa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a be nya jemi ko kulaa.
A le Mawu ji nɛ, se e hɛ mi nyami nɛ sa kaa a woɔ kaa Mawu ji lɛ ɔ, a wui; nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ si hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko kulaa be a juɛmi mi; nɛ a kɔ we nɔ́ se, ejakaa a juɛmi mi wo diblii kpii.
A tsɛɔ a he ní leli, se a plɛ pee kuasiahi mohu.
Mawu nɛ gbo we gblee ɔ, a wui e hɛ mi nyami bɔ nɛ sa kaa a peeɔ, se mohu a ya woɔ níhi nɛ a puɛ kaa nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ gboɔ ɔ, aloo lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, loo lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, loo lohwehi nɛ sãã si mohu a hɛ mi nyami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ngmɛɛ a he, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ yaya nɛ ngɛ a tsui nɔ ɔ se; nɛ a kɛ a sibi tsu mu níhi kɛ pue a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hɛ mi si.
Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ a le ngɛ Mawu he ɔ, a he we yi; lakpa níhi mohu a heɔ yeɔ.
Níhi nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a jaa, nɛ a sɔmɔɔ.
Bɔlɔ ɔ nɛ sa kaa a je e yi kɛ ya neneene ɔ, a ja we lɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ we lɛ hulɔ.
Amen!
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu ngmɛɛ a he, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ ní yayahi nɛ ngɛ zo a se.
A yi ɔmɛ tete po kɛ a sibi peeɔ níhi nɛ pi ja nɛ Mawu to.
Nyumu ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu, a hla we yihi a se blɔ.
Se ke akɔnɔ yaya te si ngɛ a mi ɔ, a kɛ a sibi nyumuhi mohu ya naa bɔmi.
Nyumuhi kɛ a sibi nyumuhi tsu zo níhi, nɛ tue gblami nɛ sa mɛ kaa nihi nɛ bɔ musu ɔ, a ná ngɔ wo a he mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, akɛnɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ bui a he kaa e sa mɛ kaa a leɔ Mawu ɔ, Mawu hu ngmɛɛ a he ngɔ ha juɛmi nɛ sɛ́, konɛ a pee níhi nɛ sɛ́.
A peeɔ yi wu tso ní, kɛ yayami slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi.
A jeɔ hunga, a pueɔ muɔ si, a pɛɔ, a sisiɔ nɔ, nɛ a toɔ a sibi a he ga yaya; a yeɔ sieku, nɛ a sume Mawu sane; a bui nɔ, a woɔ a he nɔ, a fĩaa, a toɔ nɔ́ yaya he ga, nɛ a bui a fɔli; a he nile gbo; ke a wo si ɔ, a yi nɔ, nɛ a nɛ́ mɔbɔ.
A le kaa Mawu de ke nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a sa gbenɔ, se kɛ̃ pi kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a peeɔ yayami nɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu a jeɔ nihi nɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ a yi.
Mawu yeɔ dami sane Ye nyɛmi, anɛ o kojoɔ nihi, nɛ o buɔ mɛ fɔ lo?
Ke o peeɔ ja a, lɛɛ o be nya jemi ko kulaa.
Ejakaa ke o kojoɔ ni kpahi, nɛ o buu mɛ fɔ, nɛ mo hu o peeɔ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ, na nɛ o le kaa mo nitsɛ o he fɔ o ngɛ bue ɔ nɛ.
Wa le kaa Mawu buɔ nihi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ fɔ ɔ le da pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Se mo ye nyɛmi nɛ o kojoɔ nihi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ, nɛ́ mo hu o peeɔ ja nɔuu ɔ, anɛ o susuu kaa o maa ye o he, nɛ Mawu be mo kojoe lo?
O bui nɔ́!
Mɛni he je ɔ, Mawu mi mi jɔ, e naa nɔ he tsui, nɛ e toɔ e tsui si.
Blɔɔ o li kaa Mawu mi mi jɔ ha mo konɛ o tsake o tsui lo?
Se akɛnɛ o kplii o tsui, nɛ o pia we o he ɔ, kojomi ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu mi mi ma fu, nɛ e maa kojo kɛ dami sane yemi ɔ, o tue gblami ɔ maa pe nine.
Ejakaa Mawu maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa lɛ ngɛ e ní tsumi ɔ nya.
Nihi nɛ toɔ a tsui si kɛ peeɔ kpakpa daa, nɛ a kɛ hlaa hɛ mi nyami, kɛ bu ha a he konɛ a ko gbo ɔ, Mawu ma ha mɛ neneene wami.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ mi pɛ a foɔ, nɛ a bui anɔkuale, nɛ nɔ́ yayami se pɛ a dii ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi la, kɛ mi mi fumi ma kple a nɔ.
Mawu ma ha nɛ haomi, kɛ nɔ́ nami maa ba yayami peeli tsuo a nɔ, Yuda bi kekle, kɛ ma je li hulɔ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, Mawu maa wo a hɛ mi nyami; bu maa ba a he, nɛ e ma ha mɛ he jɔmi, Yuda bi kekle, kɛ jehanɛ ɔ, ma je li hulɔ.
Ejakaa Mawu hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.
Nihi abɔ nɛ mlaa a kpakaa we mɛ, nɛ a peeɔ yayami ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa kaa nihi nɛ mlaa a kpakaa we mɛ; nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ guu mlaa a nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ, mlaa a nɔuu nɔ a daa kɛ kojoɔ mɛ.
Ejakaa pi nihi nɛ le mlaa a nɛ a buu nihi nɛ da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, se mohu nihi nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, mɛ a maa wo nguɔ.
Ke ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ yi Mose mlaa a nɔ ngɛ a fɔmi su ɔ nya a tsuɔ mlaa a nya ní ɔ, a peeɔ mlaa ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he; pohu mlaa ko yi a nɔ.
A ní peepee tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ hlae kaa a pee ɔ, Mawu ngɔ wo a tsui mi momo; nɛ a he nile hu yeɔ enɛ ɔ he odase.
Ejakaa be komɛ ɔ, a susumi deɔ mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ dɛ, nɛ be komɛ hu e deɔ mɛ ke e da.
Sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu maa gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ba kojo nihi tsuo ngɛ a laami mi sanehi a he ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ níhi maa ba.
Yuda bi kɛ mlaa a Nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sane ngɛ kɛɛ?
Nyɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ he Yuda bi, nɛ nyɛ daa mlaa a nɔ kɛ fĩaa kaa Mawu nihi ji nyɛ.
Nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee, nɛ a gu mlaa a nɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ hi.
Nyɛ buu nyɛ he nihi nɛ tsɔɔ hɛ yuyuili blɔ, aloo la kɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi.
Nyɛɛ buu nyɛ he kuasiahi a tsɔseli, kɛ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko ɔ a ní tsɔɔli; ejakaa nyɛ le kaa niinɛ, nile kɛ anɔkuale tsuo ngɛ mlaa a mi.
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ní ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ tsɔɔ we nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he ní mɔ?
Nyɛ fiɛɔ ke a ko ju; se tse nyɛ juɔ?
Nyɛ deɔ ke a ko puɛ gba; se nyɛ puɛ we gba lo?
Amagahi a he peeɔ nyɛ tai, se tse nyɛ ya juɔ ngɛ wɔ piɛhi a mi?
Nyɛ fĩaa ke nyɛ le mlaa a, se tse nyɛ tɔɔ mlaa a kɛ pueɔ Mawu hɛ mi si?
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nyɛ Yuda bi nyɛ he ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ tuɔ musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ siɔ Mawu.” Nyɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ jinɛ pomi nɛ a po nyɛ ɔ, se nami ngɛ he.
Se nyɛ yi nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ a pui mɛ ɔ. Ke ma je no nɛ a pui lɛ ɔ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ, anɛ Mawu be lɛ bue kaa nɔ ko nɛ a po lɛ lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ Yuda bi, ma je li ɔmɛ maa kojo nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa a ngɔ ha, nɛ́ mlaa a nya a poɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ tɔɔ mlaa a.
Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, pohu a pui mɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji Yuda no nitsɛnitsɛ mɔ?
Pi okadi nɛ a to ngɛ nɔ he lo mi kaa nɔ pomi kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ Yuda no.
Mohu ɔ, Yuda no nitsɛnitsɛ peemi ɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nitsɛ e mi, nɛ nɔ pomi ɔ hu ngɛ e tsui mi.
Mawu mumi ɔ pɛ lɛ tsuɔ enɛ ɔ, pi mlaa nɛ a ngma a. Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ lɛ jeɔ e yi, pi nɔmlɔ adesa.
Lɛɛ mɛni Yuda no kɛ pe ma je no mɔ?
Aloo mɛni se nami ngɛ nɔ pomi he?
Ee, nɔ pomi he ngɛ se nami babauu ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ.
Kekleekle nɔ́ ji kaa a tu Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ wo Yuda bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa ni komɛ he we yi lɛɛ, se anɛ lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu be anɔkuale yee lo?
Dɛbi!
Mawu ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; pohu nimli adesahi tsuo lɛɛ lakpa a yeɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a na kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o deɔ ɔ ngɛ mi; Nɛ ke a kojo mo hu, o yeɔ nguɔ.” Se ke nɔ́ nɛ dɛ nɛ wa peeɔ ɔ, haa nɛ a naa paa kaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ Mawu peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Anɛ ke Mawu kɛ mi mi fumi gbla wa tue ɔ, e tɔ lo?
(Bɔ nɛ i bi nɛ ɔ, ja kɛkɛ adesa tuɔ munyu.)
Dɛbi!
Ke Mawu yi dami sane ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e maa kojo je ɔ?
Se nɔ ko ma bi ke, “Ke ye lakpa a haa nɛ a naa Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ saminya, nɛ lɔ ɔ woɔ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a buu mi fɔ kaa yayami peelɔ ɔ?” Mɛni he je nɛ e sɛ́ kaa wa deɔ ke, “Wa maa pee yayami konɛ kpakpa nɛ je mi kɛ ba,” kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ poo ngɔ fɔɔ wa nɔ ke wa deɔ ɔ?
Jamɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, fɔ nɛ a bu mɛ ɔ sa mɛ.
