Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ?
Anɛ wɔ Yuda bi wa nɔ́ mi hi pee ni kpa amɛ lo?
Dɛbi, pi ja kulaa!
Kaa bɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ nya momo ɔ, Yuda bi kɛ Hela bi tsuo sɔ; mɛ tsuo a ngɛ yayami he wami sisi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ da; nɔ kake ngmelu po be.
Ní lelɔ ko be ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ hlaa Mawu se blɔ.
Mɛ tsuo a tla blɔ; mɛ tsuo a puɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ kpakpa, nɔ kake ngmelu po be.
A tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ; se lɛ tsuo gbenɔ lɛ e kɛ baa.
A munyu ngɛ kaa sanga duɔ.
Gbiɛmi munyu nɛ kɛ nɔ woɔ haomi mi nɛ jeɔ a nya mi.
A he sɔɔ kɛ muɔ si puemi.
He tsuaa he nɛ a be ngɛ ɔ, hɛ mi kpatami, kɛ kɔmɔ yemi a naa.
A ha we nɛ nihi a he mi jɔɔ mɛ.
Mawu gbeye yemi ko kulaa be a hɛ mi.” Jehanɛ ɔ, wa le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mlaa a mi ɔ, nihi nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ a he nɛ e kɔɔ.
Lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nya jemi; je ɔ tsuo yeɔ fɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ye mlaa a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da; nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a tsuɔ ji kaa e haa nɔ leɔ kaa e pee yayami.
Nɔ́ nɛ haa Mawu buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da Jehanɛ lɛɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu guu kɛ buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da a, e je tsɔɔ wɔ.
Pi mlaa sane ji nɛ ɔ. Mose mlaa a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ ye he odase.
Ke nɔ ko he Yesu Kristo ye kɛkɛ Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da.
Nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a peeɔ haa mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; slɔɔto ko kulaa be mi.
Ejakaa nihi tsuo pee yayami, nɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ bɔ mɛ.
Se Mawu gu dloomi nɛ e kɛ haa je ɔ yaka a nɔ kɛ wo nihi tsuo nguɔ.
E pee enɛ ɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɛ ha a ye a he ɔ nɔ.
-Mawu ngɔ Kristo ngɔ ha, konɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu nɛ ngɔ nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.
Mawu pee enɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa dalɔ ji lɛ.
Sa a, e to e tsui si ha nimli tsuo, nɛ e ku e hɛ fɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ; konɛ jehanɛ ɔ a na kaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, Mawu woɔ lɛ nguɔ.
Lɛɛ mɛni nɔ wa maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ mɔ?
Nɔ́ ko kulaa be kaa ja.
Lɛɛ mɛni mɔ?
Ní tsumi ngɛ mlaa a nya lo?
Dɛbi!
Yesu Kristo nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ mohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa yɔse kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɔ a guu kɛ woɔ nɔ nguɔ, se pi ní tsumi nɛ a tsu ngɛ mlaa a nya.
Anɛ Mawu ɔ, Yuda bi kɛkɛ a Mawu lo?
Anɛ pi ma je li ɔmɛ hu a Mawu ji lɛ lo?
Ee, ma je li ɔmɛ hu a Mawu ji lɛ.
Mawu kake lɛ ngɛ kɛ ha Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo; nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu guu kɛ woɔ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ nguɔ.
Nihi nɛ a pui mɛ ɔ hu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ nɔuu a maa gu kɛ wo mɛ nguɔ.
Lɛɛ waa pɛtɛ hemi ke yemi he, nɛ waa ngmɛɛ mlaa a he lo?
Pi ja kulaa!
Mohu ɔ, wa gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ kɛ ngɛ nɔ mi mae kaa mlaa a hi.
Abraham hemi kɛ yemi peeɔ nɔhyɛ nɔ́ Wa tsɛ Abraham ɔ, kɛ wa ma de ngɛ e he kɛɛ?
Kɛ e wami si himi mi sane ngɛ kɛɛ?
Ke ní nɛ e tsu nɔ a da kɛ wo lɛ nguɔ ɔ, lɛɛ jinɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ.
Se ngɛ Mawu blɔ fa mi ɔ, Abraham be nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ e ma nyɛ maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ.
Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da.” Ke nɔ ko tsu ní ɔ, a woɔ lɛ hiɔ; hiɔwo ɔ, e gbo he dengme; pi dloomi nya nɛ e na lɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu pɛ nɔ, se pi ní nɛ e tsuɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ɔ nɛ lɛ pɛ nɛ nyɛɔ woɔ yayami peelɔ nguɔ ɔ daa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ kɛ buɔ lɛ nɔ da.
Enɛ ɔ nɔuu David hu ngɛ tsɔɔe be nɛ e tu nɔ nɛ Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da, nɛ pohu pi nɔ́ ko nɛ e tsu he je ɔ e gbaami he munyu ɔ nɛ.
E de ke, “A gbaa nɔ nɛ a ngɔ e tɔmihi, kɛ e he yayamihi ngɔ pa lɛ!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ́ yayami ko ngɛ e he!” Gbaami nɛ David tu he munyu ɔ, anɛ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ kɛkɛ a nɔ lo?
Dɛbi!
Ni nɛmɛ a pui mɛ ɔ hu e kɔɔ a he.
Ejakaa wa ngɛ dee ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da.” Mɛni be mi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi?
Loko a po Abraham, aloo benɛ a po lɛ ɔ se?
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi loko a po lɛ.
Pomi nɛ a po lɛ ɔ ji okadi ko kɛkɛ nɛ maa nɔ mi kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Abraham ngɛ he je ɔ, Mawu he lɛ momo kaa nɔ nɛ da, be mi nɛ a na we nɛ a po lɛ tete.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ, nɛ pohu a pui mɛ, nɛ Mawu buu mɛ dali ɔ, Abraham peeɔ a tsɛ.
Lɛ nɔuu kɛ̃ e peeɔ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ a tsɛ; pi ngɛ pomi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ kɛkɛ he, se mohu kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa tsɛ Abraham hɛɛ mi benɛ a na we nɛ a po lɛ tete ɔ, a hɛɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔuu mi.
Abraham he Mawu siwo ɔ ye Pi mlaa a nɔ nɛ Abraham ye ɔ he nɛ Mawu wo lɛ si kaa e kɛ e nina maa ye je ɔ nɔ ɔ, se mohu akɛnɛ e he Mawu ye, nɛ Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a he.
Ejakaa ke nihi nɛ mlaa a nɔ pɛ a yeɔ ɔ, mɛ hu gbosi ní yeli ji mɛ ɔ, lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ peeɔ yaka, nɛ siwo ɔ hu se nami be he.
Ejakaa mlaa a kɛ Mawu mi mi la baa; he nɛ mlaa be ɔ, nɔ ko tɔ we mlaa hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu da kɛ wo si ɔ. Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ siwo ɔ nɛ ba pee dloomi nɔ́ ko nɛ a fi kɛ fɔ nɔ kpɛii kɛ ha Abraham nina tsuo.
Pi kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kpɛii kaa bɔ nɛ Abraham he ye ɔ, ejakaa Abraham ji wɔ tsuo wa tsɛ.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Ma pee mo je mahi babauu a tsɛ.” Mawu ɔ nɛ Abraham he ye ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ si nɛ e wo ɔ maa ba mi.
Lɛ ji Mawu nɛ tleɔ ni gbogboehi si kɛ baa wami mi ekohu; nɔ́ nɛ bɛ je mi hyɛ po, e haa e baa.
Bɔ nɛ Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, pohu jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo ta a, lɔ ɔ nɛ ha e ba pee je mahi babauu a tsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Jã o nina hu maa hiɛ” ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Abraham ye maa pee jeha lafa momo; se e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ lɛɛ e ngmɛɛ we he.
Lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ pee kaa nɔ nɛ gbo momo, nɛ e yo Sara hu fɔ we.
Se enɛ ɔmɛ a he susumi ha we nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ta.
E yi mi pee we lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ngɛ si nɛ Mawu wo lɛ ɔ he; se mohu e hemi kɛ yemi ha lɛ he wami he, nɛ e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Ejakaa Abraham he ye wawɛɛ kaa si nɛ Mawu wo lɛ ɔ, e maa ye nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a. Munyu “A bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da” a, pi lɛ nɔ kake e he nɛ a ngma ngɛ.
Se mohu e kɔɔ wɔ hu wa he, wɔ nihi nɛ a maa wo wɔ nguɔ ja nɔuu ɔ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ tle wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, wa heɔ lɛ yeɔ.
Mawu ngɔ Kristo kɛ ha nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he; nɛ a tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu, konɛ e kɛ wo wɔ nguɔ.
A wo wɔ nguɔ Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ, Mawu wo wɔ nguɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, he jɔmi ba waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ.
Si himi nɛ wa ngɛ mi amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu dloomi nya nɛ wa na kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa fĩaa, ejakaa wa nine maa su Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɔ.
Wa le kaa dengme nɛ wa ngɛ gboe ɔ be yaka pee.
Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se ke wa ngɛ nɔ́ nae po, wa naa bua jɔmi, ejakaa wa le kaa nɔ́ nami haa nɛ wa toɔ wa tsui si; nɛ tsui si tomi haa nɛ wa peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní.
Nɛ ke wa ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya ní pee ɔ, e haa waa kɛ wa hɛ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ Kulaa.
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ ha we nɛ zo gbeɔ wɔ, ejakaa kɛ gu Mumi klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ha wa tsui hyi tɔ kɛ e suɔmi ɔ. Ejakaa be nɛ sa mi, be mi nɛ peepee ta wa he ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ yayami peeli a he.
Ejakaa e maa wa kaa nɔ ko maa suɔ nɛ e gbo ngɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ he; pohu nɔmlɔ kpakpa he ɔ, e maa ba mi kaa nɔ ko ma si gugue kaa e ma gbo.
Se suɔmi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ Mawu je kpo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa be nɛ wa ji yayami peeli ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ wa he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ ɔ nɛ a gu Kristo muɔ nɛ pue si ɔ nɔ wo wɔ nguɔ ɔ, a maa gu e nɔ hluu tsɔ kɛ kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Mawu mi mi la a mi.
Jinɛ sa a, Mawu he nyɛli ji wɔ, se kɛ gu e Bi ɔ gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpata waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ a kpata waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti ɔ, e ma he wa yi wami hluu tsɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ wami ɔ mi.
Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se wa fĩaa fɔɔ Mawu nɔ kaa kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e ha nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, a kpata waa kɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ wa kpɛti.
Slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ Adam kɛ Kristo a kpɛti Nɔ kake lɛ pee yayami, nɛ yayami kɛ gbenɔ ba.
Enɛ ɔ ha gbenɔ sã nimli tsuo, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ pee yayami.
Yayami ngɛ je ɔ mi loko mlaa a ba; se be nɛ mlaa be ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko pee we yayami he akɔtaa.
Se kɛ je Adam yi nɔ kɛ ba si Mose yi nɔ ɔ, gbenɔ kpata nimli adesahi a hɛ mi wawɛɛ; pohu nimli nɛ ɔmɛ pee we yayami kaa Adam nɛ lɛɛ e tɔ mlaa a nɛ a wo lɛ ɔ tete ɔ. Adam ji nɔ nɛ maa ba a he okadi.
Se Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ slo kulaa ngɛ yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ he.
Ejakaa yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ ha nihi babauu gbo lɛɛ, se Mawu dloomi ɔ, kɛ nɔke nɔ́ nɛ a gu Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nɔ ha wɔ ɔ hiɛ hluu tsɔ kɛ ha nihi tsuo.
Jehanɛ ɔ, Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ slo kulaa ngɛ si gbeemi nɛ yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ kɛ ba a he.
Ejakaa nɛ Adam pee yayami ɔ, a kojo lɛ, nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ; se lɔ ɔ se ɔ, yayami babauu nɛ nihi pee ɔ, nɔke nɔ́ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu wo nihi tsuo nguɔ.
Ejakaa ke yayami nɛ nɔ kake pee ɔ, ha gbenɔ kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a nine su Mawu dloomi ɔ nɔ, nɛ Mawu gu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ nɔ bu mɛ nihi nɛ da a, Kristo ma ha a na neneene wami hluu tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ yayami kake he ɔ, a bu nihi tsuo fɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu kpakpa kake he ɔ, Mawu maa wo nihi tsuo nguɔ, nɛ a ma he a yi wami.
Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nihi babauu ba pee yayami peeli ngɛ nɔ kake tue gbomi he ɔ, jã kɛ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ kake e tue nɛ e bu ɔ he ɔ, Mawu maa bu nihi tsuo dali.
A wo mlaa a hulɔ, konɛ wa yɔse yayami ɔmɛ babauu; se he nɛ yayami hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ Mawu dloomi ɔ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ babauu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ yayami ye tsɛ kɛ gu gbenɔ nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu Mawu dloomi ɔ ngɛ tsɛ yee kɛ gu dami nɔ; nɛ kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, wa ma na neneene wami.
Kristo he ɔ, wa ngɛ wami mi Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Anɛ waa ya nɔ waa hi yayami pee, konɛ Mawu nɛ hi wɔ mɔbɔ nae daa lo?
Dɛbi!
Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ yayami be a nɔ he wami hu.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ wa maa hi yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa le kaa wɔ nihi abɔ nɛ a sɔle wɔ kɛ wo Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo ɔ gbo ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛ a sɔle wɔ ɔ, wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, nɛ a pu waa kɛ lɛ tsuo, konɛ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tle Kristo si ngɛ nyami mi ɔ, wɔ hu wa na wami he.
Ejakaa ke wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, jã kɛ̃ a ma tle wɔ si kaa bɔ nɛ a tle Kristo si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ. Wa le enɛ ɔ, kaa a sɛu wa nɔmlɔ tso momo ɔ ngɔ piɛ Kristo he, konɛ nɔmlɔ tso su nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ hɛ mi nɛ kpata, nɛ wa ko ye nyɔguɛ ha yayami hu.
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, e kɛ yayami gba mi.
Ke waa kɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa waa kɛ lɛ ma na wami hulɔ.
Ejakaa wa le kaa a tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e be gboe hu; niinɛ, gbenɔ be e nɔ he wami ko kulaa hu.
Kristo gbo ngɛ adesa he yayami he si kake nyɔngloo.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ, nɛ e kɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Ja nɔuu nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ gbo ngɛ yayami peemi blɔ fa mi; se ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ gboɔ ɔ nɔ hu.
Nyɛ ko di nɔmlɔ tso ɔ we akɔnɔ níhi a se.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní komɛ kɛ pee yayami hu.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu.
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa nihi nɛ a tle mɛ si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu, konɛ e ngɔ nyɛ kɛ tsu níhi nɛ da.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ hu; ejakaa mlaa nɛ fiɔ nɔ ɔ, be nyɛ nɔ he wami hu; Mawu dloomi ɔ mohu lɛ hɛɛ nyɛ.
E sa kaa wa pee nɔ́ nɛ da Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ?
Ke mlaa ko fí wɔ, se Mawu dloomi ɔ lɛ hɛɛ wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ waa ya nɔ waa pee yayami lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ha nɔ ko nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ, yayami nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi ɔ jio, Mawu tue bumi nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a jio, nyɛ peeɔ nyɔguɛ kɛ ha lɛ lo?
Se wa naa Mawu si!
Jinɛ sa a, yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu sɔmɔe.
Ní nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.
Mawu ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ nyɛ ba bɔni nɔ́ nɛ da peemi.
I ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ to nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ je mi bami he, ejakaa gbɔjɔmi ngɛ nyɛ he.
Sa a, yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ kɛ tsu mu ní kɛ pee yayami gbegbeegbe; jã kɛ̃ jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee níhi nɛ da, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ.
Be mi nɛ yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, nyɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da.
Níhi nɛ nyɛ pee, nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ a he ngɛ nyɛ zo pee ɔ, mɛni se nyɛ na kɛ je mi?
Nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ mi ji gbenɔ!
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ba pee e nyɔguɛhi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ba pee nihi nɛ a he tsɔ, nɛ neneene wami fɔɔ si ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa yayami he hiɔwo ji gbenɔ; se Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ ji neneene wami nɛ wa naa ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi.
Gba si himi kaa nɔhyɛ nɔ́ Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ le mlaa a; nɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔmlɔ adesa wami be mi nɛ mlaa fiɔ lɛ lo?
Waa ngɔ gba si himi kaa nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́; yogbayo ɔ, mlaa fiɔ lɛ kɛ mɛtɛɛ e huno he be mi nɛ nyumu ɔ ngɛ je mi; se ke nyumu ɔ gbo ɔ, gba sihi mi mlaa ko be nɛ fiɔ yo ɔ kɛ mɛtɛɔ nyumu ɔ he hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e huno ɔ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ e ya gba nɔ kpa a, e puɛ gba.
Se ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, lɛɛ mlaa fi we lɛ; nɛ ke e ya gba nyumu kpa a, e puɛ we gba.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ sane ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ mlaa fi we nyɛ hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ nihi, konɛ wɔ tsuo waa wo yiblii ha Mawu.
Ejakaa be nɛ wa hi si ngɛ he lo nya a, waa kɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsu akɔnɔ ní yayamihi nɛ mlaa a tleɔ si ngɛ wa mi ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ wo yiblii ha gbenɔ.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ye wa he kɛ je mlaa a dɛ mi.
Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ mlaa nɛ fiɔ wɔ ɔ be wa nɔ he wami hu.
Wa tsu we mlaa momo ɔ nɛ a ngma a nya ní hu.
Se mohu blɔ he nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nya wa sɔmɔɔ ngɛ.
Mlaa kɛ nɔ woɔ yayami peemi mi Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de ngɛ mlaa a he kɛɛ?
Mlaa a, nɔ́ yayami ji lɛ lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ke pi mlaa a he ɔ, i ko li nɔ́ nɛ ji yayami.
Ejakaa jinɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ ji hɛkɔ, ke pi mlaa a nɛ de ke, “O hɛ ko kɔ̃ o nyɛmi nɔ.” Se mlaa a nɛ a wo ɔ na he blɔ gu yayami nɔ nɛ e kɛ tle akɔnɔ ní yayamihi si ngɛ ye mi.
Ejakaa ke mlaa a be ɔ, yayami hu gbo.
Imi nitsɛ hu, i hi si hyɛ nɛ i li mlaa; se benɛ mlaa a ba a, e tle yayami si wawɛɛ ngɛ ye mi, nɛ e ba pee gbenɔ ha mi.
Mlaa a nɛ jinɛ e sa kaa e ko ngɔ wami kɛ ba a, e ba pee gbenɔ mohu ha mi.
Yayami ná he blɔ, nɛ e gu mlaa nɔ kɛ sisi mi, nɛ e gbe mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mlaa a ngɛ klɔuklɔu, kita a hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu; e da, nɛ e hi hulɔ.
Lɛɛ nɔ́ kpakpa a plɛ pee gbenɔ ha mi lo?
Dɛbi!
Yayami lɛ kɛ enɛ ɔ ba; e gu nɔ́ kpakpa a nɔ ha gbenɔ ba na mi, konɛ bɔ nɛ yayami su ngɛ nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo paa nɛ a na.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mlaa a haa yayami jeɔ kpo paa kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ hí kulaa.
Adesa su enyɔ Wa le kaa mlaa a mumi mi nɔ, se imi lɛɛ nɔmlɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji mi, nɛ yayami he mi nyɔguɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ, i li.
Nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee ɔ, i pee we lɔ ɔ; se nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔ mohu i peeɔ.
Ke nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ nɔuu mohu i peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e tsɔɔ kaa imi hu i kplɛɛ kaa mlaa a hi.
Ke jã a, lɛɛ pi imi nitsɛ nɛ i tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu, se mohu yayami su nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue.
I le kaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko be ye he lo su ɔ mi.
Ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa jloɔ mi nɛ ma pee, se i nyɛ we.
Kpakpa nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee ɔ, i pee we; se yayami nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔ mohu i peeɔ.
Ke nɔ́ nɛ imi nitsɛ i sume ɔ nɔuu i peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ pi imi nitsɛ nɛ i ngɛ yayami ɔ pee mɔ, se yayami su nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ mohu lɛ haa nɛ i peeɔ yayami ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɛ i naa nɛ ngɛ ní tsue kaa mlaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ke i to kaa ma pee kpakpa a, kɛkɛ i ya pee yayami mohu.
Ngɛ ye tsui mi ɔ, i suɔ Mawu mlaa a saminya.
Se i na kaa mlaa muno ko ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi.
Mlaa nɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ye juɛmi mi ɔ yi kulaa.
Nɔ́ nɛ ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke e da nɛ ma pee ɔ, i ya peeɔ nɔ́ kpa kulaa mohu.
Yayami su nɛ ngɛ ye mi nɛ ɔ peeɔ mi nyɔguɛ.
Hyɛ kaa ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ!
Ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma kpata ye hɛ mi.
Mɛnɔ ma he ye yi wami kɛ je nɔmlɔ tso nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi nɛ ɔ dɛ mi?
Sina ha Mawu kaa e he wa yi wami kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ!
Ke ma po lɛ kpiti ɔ, bɔ nɛ i ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: i kɛ ye juɛmi pɛ lɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Mawu mlaa a nya, se ye he lo ɔ lɛɛ mlaa a nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ lɛ yeɔ e nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke e da a, Mawu mumi ɔ ke e dɛ Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, fɔ bumi ko be ha mɛ hu.
Ejakaa wa ngɛ Kristo mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ, haa wa yeɔ wa he; nɛ yayami, kɛ gbenɔ be wa nɔ he wami hu.
Yayami nɛ adesa peeɔ ɔ, Mawu sume kulaa, se nɔmlɔ adesa gbɔjɔmi ɔ he je ɔ, mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee he nɔ ko.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba ngɛ he lo su nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ mi, konɛ e ba je wɔ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi.
Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa bɛ wa je mi ngɛ he lo mi ní yayami ɔmɛ a nya, se mohu wa nyɛɛɔ ngɛ mumi ɔ blɔ tsɔɔmi nya a, wa nyɛ waa ye mlaa a nɔ sisiisi.
Nihi nɛ baa a je mi ngɛ he lo nya a, he lo mi níhi a he a susuu.
Se nihi nɛ baa a je mi ngɛ mumi ɔ blɔ tsɔɔmi nya a, mumi mi níhi a he a susuu.
He lo nya níhi a he juɛmi ɔ kɛ gbenɔ baa, se mumi mi níhi a he juɛmi ɔ haa nɔ wami, kɛ he jɔmi.
Nɔ nɛ susuɔ he lo mi níhi a he ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu nyɛe, ejakaa e bui Mawu mlaa a; pohu e be nɔ nyɛe maa ye tete.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ he lo nya ní ɔ, a be nyɛe maa sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Ke Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, he lo ɔ be nyɛ nɔ he wami; mumi ɔ mohu lɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ.
Ke nɔ ko be Kristo mumi ɔ, pi Kristo nɔ ji lɛ.
Se ke Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, yayami nɛ nyɛ peeɔ he ɔ, nyɛ gbo ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi, se mumi mi lɛɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ, ejakaa Mawu buu nyɛ nihi nɛ da.
Ke Mawu nɛ tle Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ mumi ɔ nɛ e kɛ tle Kristo si ɔ ma ha nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ gboɔ ɔ ma na wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, sane tloo wɔ, se pi he lo nya nɔ́ ko nɛ wa maa hi si ja.
Ejakaa ke nyɛ peeɔ he lo nya níhi ɔ, nyɛ ma gbo; se ke Mawu mumi ɔ ha nyɛ kpa níhi nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ ɔ tsumi ɔ, nyɛ yi ma na wami.
Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Mawu bimɛ.
Mawu ha we nyɛ mumi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nyɔguɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma pa hi gbeye yee; se mohu e peeɔ nyɛ Mawu bimɛ.
Mumi ɔ lɛ woɔ wɔ he wami, nɛ wa nyɛɔ faa kue kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Tsaatsɛ!
Tsaatsɛ!” Mawu mumi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ wɔ hu wa mumi ɔ yeɔ odase kaa Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ.
Akɛnɛ Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ ɔ, wa peeɔ Mawu we ní yeli hulɔ, nihi nɛ a kɛ Kristo maa dla ní.
Ee, ke waa kɛ Kristo na nɔ́ ɔ, a maa wo waa kɛ lɛ tsuo wa hɛ mi nyami.
Hɛ mi nyami nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se I le anɔkuale mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ nae amlɔ nɛ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ a kɛ maa to wa hɛ mi nyami nɛ Mawu maa wo hwɔɔ se ɔ he.
Adebɔ níhi tsuo to a tsui si kɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ kaa Mawu ma ha nɛ a na e bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
Yi mi pɔtɛɛ nɛ Mawu to ha níhi nɛ e bɔ ɔ, e ya bɛ mi ja pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Pi adebɔ ní ɔmɛ nɛ pee; Mawu nitsɛ blɔ nya tomi ji ja.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha mɛ kaa be ko ma nɛ adebɔ níhi tsuo maa ye a he, nɛ gbenɔ be he wami nae ngɛ a nɔ hu; nɛ a kɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a maa wo a hɛ mi nyami.
Wa le kaa kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, adebɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kɛmɛmi nɔ kaa yo nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃e nɛ e ma fɔ.
Se pi mɛ kɛkɛ, mohu wɔ nitsɛmɛ tete nɛ wa ná mumi ɔ yiblii ɔ, wɔ hu ja nɔuu wa hii kɛmɛmi nɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ wa mi, be mi nɛ wa ngɛ Mawu blɔ hyɛe kaa e pee wɔ e bimɛ kɛ pi si, konɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ ye e he kulaa.
Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ a he wa yi wami ɔ nɛ.
Se ke nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ ɔ su wa dɛ momo ɔ, lɛɛ lɔ ɔ pi hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nitsɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ wa nine su nɔ momo ɔ, anɛ wa hyɛɔ blɔ ekohu lo?
Se ke wa ngɛ nɔ́ ko blɔ hyɛe, nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ kaa wa nine maa su nɔ ɔ, wa toɔ wa tsui si.
Ja nɔuu, ke wa gbede ɔ, mumi ɔ piɛɔ wa he.
Ejakaa ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, wa li nɔ́ tutuutu nɛ sa kaa wa deɔ.
Mumi ɔ nitsɛ daa mi ha wɔ kɛ kɔmɔ yemi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale.
Mawu nɛ le adesahi tsuo a yi mi ɔ lɛ le nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ deɔ, ejakaa pɛɛ nɛ mumi ɔ kpaa ha ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi.
Wa le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, Mawu piɛɔ nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ a he, konɛ e hi ha mɛ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ nɛ to e yi mi, nɛ e tsɛ mɛ.
Nihi nɛ Mawu hla ngɔ to momo ɔ, e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu, konɛ a subai nɛ hi kaa Bi ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Bi ɔ maa pee nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ babauu a kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, mɛ nɔuu e tsɛ, nihi nɛ e tsɛ ɔ, mɛ nɔuu e wo nguɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ e wo nguɔ ɔ, e wo mɛ nɔuu a hɛ mi nyami.
Yesu Kristo tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ wɔ ha Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔ?
Ke Mawu ngɛ wa se ɔ, mɛnɔ maa te si ngɔ wo wɔ?
Mawu nɛ klɔɛ e Bi ɔ he, se mohu e ngɔ lɛ kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ wɔ nimli adesahi tsuo wa he ɔ, anɛ e be níhi tsuo ngɔe kɛ piɛ he ha wɔ lo?
Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, mɛnɔ maa po a nya?
Mawu nitsɛ lɛ woɔ nɔ nguɔ.
Lɛ mɛnɔ lɛ buɔ nɔ fɔ mɔ?
Yesu Kristo loo?
Yesu Kristo lɛɛ e gbo; se nɔ́ nɛ pe lɔ ɔ, Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ mi dae ha wɔ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Mɛnɔ ma gba wɔ kɛ maa je suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi?
Haomi loo, nɔ nami loo, yi mi wami loo, hwɔ loo, oslã loo, aloo klaate?
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “O he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi; a buɔ wɔ kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe.” Dɛbi!
Ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ haa wa yeɔ kunimi babauu.
Ejakaa i ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa gbenɔ jio, wami jio, hiɔwe bɔfohi jio, nɔ yeli kpa komɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe jio, níhi nɛ ngɛ jio, níhi nɛ maa ba jio, he wami kpa ko jio, hiɔwe lokoo jio, zugba sisi jio, níhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ a mi eko jio, Mawu suɔmi nɛ wa na ngɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko be nyɛe ma gba wɔ kɛ maa je mi.
Mawu hla e ma Anɔkuale i ngɛ tue ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ ye he nile maa nɔ mi ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, i yi lakpa.
I yeɔ tsui, nɛ i yeɔ kɔmɔ hu babauu ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Ye weku li ji mɛ ngɛ he lo nya, nɛ i ko suɔ kaa ngɛ mɛɛ a he ɔ, a bu mi musutsɛ, nɛ a po mi kɛ je Kristo he.
Mɛ ji Israel bi; nɛ Mawu nitsɛ nɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ pee e ma; e wo a hɛ mi nyami, e kɛ mɛ so, nɛ e ha mɛ mlaa a; e tsɔɔ mɛ jami blɔ nya tomi, nɛ mɛ nɔuu nɛ e wo si ɔ nɛ.
A mi nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je, nɛ Kristo ɔ tete a nina ji lɛ ngɛ he lo nya.
Kristo ɔ ji Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ yeɔ nihi tsuo a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
A je e yi kɛ ya neneene!
Amen.
I tsɔɔ we kaa Mawu siwo ɔ peeɔ yaka.
Ejakaa pi Israel ma a tsuo ji Israel bi anɔkuale mi.
Nɛ jehanɛ hu pi Abraham nina tsuo ji Abraham bimɛ.
Mohu ɔ, Mawu wo Abraham si ke, “Isak nɔ nɛ o nina maa gu kɛ ba.” Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa pi Abraham bimɛ nɛ e fɔ ngɛ he lo nya a ji Mawu bimɛ.
Se mohu si nɛ a wo Abraham ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Abraham nina.
Mawu wo Abraham si ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha a, ma kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu, nɛ o yo Sara ma fɔ binyumu.” Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, Rebeka bimɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, e kɛ wa tsɛ Isak kake ɔ nɔuu nɛ fɔ mɛ.
Se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ yi mi nɛ Mawu to kɛ hla nɔ kake ɔ nɛ ba mi ɔ, be nɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mɛ tete, pohu a na we nɛ a pee nɔ́ kpakpa ko, loo nɔ́ yaya ko ɔ, e de Rebeka ke, “Nɔkɔtɔma a ma sɔmɔ jokuɛ ɔ,” konɛ e ko ba mi kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ e tsu he, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɛ mɛ ɔ lɛ pee.
Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “I je suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Yakob, se Esau lɛɛ i nyɛ lɛ.” Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Mawu yeɔ sane kpɛkpɛɛ lo?
Dɛbi!
Ejakaa Mawu de Mose ke, “Nɔ nɛ sa mɔbɔ nami ɔ, ma na lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ sa mi mi sami ɔ, ye mi mi maa sã mi ngɛ e he.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ ko suɔmi nya, aloo nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔ ko tsu he je, se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ daa si ngɛ Mawu mɔbɔ nami nɔ.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke Mawu de Egipt matsɛ ɔ ke, “I wo mo tsɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma je ye he wami kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo, konɛ o wo ye biɛ ta ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa e maa na lɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e naa lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ e suɔ kaa e wa tue ɔ, e haa e waa tue.
Mawu gblaa nɔ tue, nɛ e naa nɔ mɔbɔ hulɔ Nyɛ ti nɔ ko ma bi mi ke, “Mɛni he je Mawu piaa wɔ mɔ?
Nɔ́ nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ tsi nya lo?” Se mo nɔmlɔ adesa, mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o ma de Mawu ke nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ dɛ?
Anɛ buɛ ma de nɔ nɛ puɛ lɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni he je o puɛ mi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” Wa le kaa buɛ puɛlɔ ngɛ he wami ngɛ zu nɛ e pɔtɔ ɔ nɔ, kaa e kɛ eko puɛɔ buɛ ko nɛ hi kɛ ha ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ ko, nɛ e puɛɔ buɛ kpa hu ngɛ mi kɛ ha ní tsumi gu ko kɛkɛ.
Anɛ kaa Mawu suɔ nɛ a le bɔ nɛ e mi mi la ngɛ, kɛ e he wami ɔ, jinɛ e ko kpata nihi nɛ woɔ e mi mi la a a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Se e to e tsui si babauu ha mɛ.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ ɔ nɛ a le bɔ nɛ e to momo kaa e maa wo a hɛ mi nyami babauu ha.
Wɔ hu ja e tsɛ wɔ, konɛ waa na kaa pi Yuda bi kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ, se e tsɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hulɔ.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ Hosea womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nihi nɛ a tsɛɔ mɛ ‘Piyemajinyɛ’ ɔ, ma de mɛ ke ‘Ye ma ji nyɛ.’ Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɔ lɛ ‘Asumemo’ ɔ ma je suɔmi kpo ha lɛ.” “Nɛ e maa ba mi kaa he nɛ a ma de mɛ ngɛ ke, ‘Pi ye ma ji nyɛ’ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma tsɛ mɛ ngɛ ke, ‘Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ bimɛ.’ ” Yesaya hu kpa ngmlaa kɛ de ngɛ Israel he ke, “Ke Israel bi hiɛ kaa wo nya zia tete po ɔ, nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ pɛ a yi wami a ma he.
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he maa sɔ kɛ kojo je ɔ tsuo.” Kaa bɔ nɛ Yesaya de to momo ɔ, “Ke pi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Ope ɔ nɛ ha wa nina a eko piɛ ɔ, jinɛ wa ní ko pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora pɛ.” Sane kpakpa a ngɛ kɛ ha Israel hulɔ Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ?
Ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ jinɛ a, kaa a bu mɛ nihi nɛ da a, a bu mɛ ni nɛ da ejakaa a he Mawu ye.
Se Israel nɛ di mlaa nɛ ma ha a bu mɛ nihi nɛ da se ɔ, mɛ mohu a nine sui nɔ.
Kɛ ba kɛɛ?
A nine sui nɔ, ejakaa a hla we lɛ kɛ hemi kɛ yemi.
A susu kaa kɛ gu ní tsumihi a nɔ nɛ a ma na lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a pee kaa nihi nɛ a ngɔ tɛ ngɔ fɔ blɔ mi ha mɛ nɛ a tɛ.
Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Hyɛ, i ngɔ tɛ kɛ ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion; e ma ha nihi ma tɛ si; e ji tɛ sa nɛ maa tsɛ̃ mɛ ngɔ fia si.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ tɛ nɛ ɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
Ye nyɛmimɛ, pɛɛ nɛ i kpaa Mawu daa kɛ jeɔ ye tsui mi kɛ haa Israel bi ji kaa a he a yi wami.
Ejakaa i ngɛ odase ngɛ he kaa a hɛ dɔɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ Mawu he, se blɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ ma ja lɛ ɔ nɛ a li.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu guu kɛ buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da a, a li, nɛ a hlaa kaa a ma wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a blɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔɛ a he ngɔ ha we Mawu, konɛ e bu mɛ nihi nɛ da.
Ejakaa Kristo po mlaa a mi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, Mawu wo lɛ nguɔ.
Yi wami hemi ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ Nɔ nɛ Mose ngma ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ a buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da ngɛ mlaa a nɔ nɛ e yeɔ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ fitsofitso ɔ, e yi ma na wami.” Se kaa nɔmlɔ adesa ma he Mawu ye nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a, nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ he ji, “Ko de ngɛ o tsui mi ke, Mɛnɔ maa kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe?” (lɔ ɔ ji kaa e ma ya ngɔ Kristo kɛ kple si;) aloo “Mɛnɔ maa ya muɔ voo ɔ mi?” (lɔ ɔ ji konɛ e ya ngɔ Kristo kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba.)
Se kɛ e deɔ kɛɛ?
“Munyu nɛ Mawu tu ɔ ngɛ o ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; o le, nɛ e ngɛ o tsui mi.” Jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ.
Ke o kɛ o nya jaje ke “Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ,” nɛ o he ye ngɛ o tsui mi kaa Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a ma he o yi wami.
Ejakaa tsui a kɛ heɔ yeɔ loko Mawu woɔ nɔ nguɔ; nɛ ke waa kɛ wa nya jaje ɔ, a ma he wa yi wami.
Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee.” Slɔɔto ko be Yuda no kɛ ma je no a kpɛti, ejakaa a ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kake, nɛ e mi hi saminya ha nihi tsuo nɛ kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ ɔ, a ma he e yi wami.” Se kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ nɔ nɛ a he we lɛ yi ɔ?
Nɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma he nɔ nɛ a nui e he sane ɔ ye?
Jehanɛ hu kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a maa nu, ke nɔ ko fiɛ we ha mɛ?
Nɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nihi maa fiɛ, ke a tsɔ we mɛ?
Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa a fiɛli a nanehi ngɛ fɛu ha.” Se kɛ̃ ɔ, pi Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ he sane kpakpa a. Ejakaa Yesaya de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa sane ɔ, mɛnɔ he ye?” Lɔ ɔ ji kaa ja a fiɛ Kristo he sane ɔ loko nɔ ko maa nu.
Nɛ ja nɔ ko nu sane ɔ loko e ma he ye.
Se i ngɛ bie ke, Anɛ a nui sɛ gbi ɔ lo?
Anɔkuale, a nu, ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “A gbi jije kɛ ho zugba a tsuo nɔ ya; Nɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ ya su je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ.” I ngɛ bie ekohu ke anɛ Israel li lo?
Mose ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ he nɔ ke, “Ma ha nyɛ maa je je ma ko nɛ a bui lɛ kulaa he hunga; Nɛ i kɛ ma kɛ e mi kuasiahi sɔuu maa wo nyɛ mi mi la.” Yesaya hu kɛ kã de ke, “I ha nihi nɛ hla we mi ɔ na mi, Nɛ nihi nɛ bi we ye si ɔ, i je ye he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ.” Se Israel lɛɛ Yesaya de ngɛ e he ke, “Daa nɛ ɔ, i gbɛ ye gugue mi nɛ ma he nyɛ atuu; Ma tue gboli nɛ a tsui kplii!”
Mawu na Israel ma a mɔbɔ Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ bie ke anɛ Mawu kua lɛ nitsɛ e ma a lo?
Dɛbi!
Mawu kua we e ma a. Imi nitsɛ hu Israel no ji mi; Abraham nina ji mi, nɛ i je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi.
Mawu kua we e ma nɛ e hla blema lokoo ɔ. Tse nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ Eliya yi nɔ benɛ Eliya po Israel nya ha Mawu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, a gbe o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a ywia o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ imi nɔ kake nɛ piɛ, nɛ a ngɛ imi hu hlae nɛ a gbe” ɔ. Mɛni heto Mawu ha lɛ?
E de lɛ ke, “I si gbali akpe kpaago hɛ ngmengmle ngɛ Israel nɛ mɛɛ a kpla we si ha Baal.” Ja nɔuu, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi bɔɔ piɛ nɛ Mawu hla mɛ ngɛ dloomi nya.
Nɛ ke dloomi nya a, lɛɛ pi ní tsumi ko nɛ a tsu he hu.
Kaa ní tsumi ko nɛ a tsu he ɔ, jinɛ dloomi ɔ pi dloomi hu.
Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ?
Israel nine sui nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ nɔ.
Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nine su nɔ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ a wa tue.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mawu ha nɛ a pee kaa nihi nɛ lu; kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ hɛngmɛ ji nɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́; nɛ a ngɛ tue hulɔ, se a kɛ nui nɔ́.” David hu de ke, “Ke a tsɛ ní yemi ɔ, ha nɛ e pee klama nɛ du mɛ; a nɔɔ si nɛ a gbla a tue.
A hɛngmɛ nɛ ma, nɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́; a se tso nɛ kpɛ daa.” Jehanɛ, i ngɛ bie ke, nɛ a tɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔ si ɔ, a nɔ gbidii nɛ a ti hu lo?
Dɛbi!
A si gbeemi ɔ bli blɔ ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ a he a yi wami.
Enɛ ɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ je mɛ hunga.
Ke Yuda bi a si gbeemi ɔ plɛ pee gbaami ha je ɔ tsuo, nɛ a ní nɛ bɔ mɛ ɔ ba pee gbaami ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ke Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo tsake ɔ, gbaami nɛ a maa gbaa je ɔ, kɛ e hiɛmi maa hi kɛɛ?
Mawu he ma je li ɔmɛ a yi wami Ma je li, jehanɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu.
Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ ní tsue kaa bɔfo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, ma tsu kɛ gɛjɛmi.
Eko ɔ, gɛjɛmi nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ he ní tsue ɔ ma ha ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ maa je hunga, nɛ ye he ɔ, Mawu ma he a ti ni komɛ a yi wami.
Ejakaa ke Mawu kua Yuda bi ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he a dla Mawu kɛ je ɔ a kpɛti ɔ, lɛɛ ke e kpale he mɛ ekohu ɔ, kɛ níhi maa hi kɛɛ?
E maa pee kaa nɔ nɛ gbo, nɛ a kpale tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
Ke má bɔbɔyoo nɛ a ti kɛ sã bɔ ha Mawu ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, lɛɛ má a tsuo ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Jã kɛ̃ ke tso sipoku ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, tso kɔni ɔmɛ hu peeɔ klɔuklɔu.
Oliv tso nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ, ke a kplɔ e kɔni ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ a ya ngɔ mo oliv tso nɛ mo nitsɛ lo puɛ ngɛ nga mi ba ta tso ɔ he, nɛ o naa oliv tso sipoku ɔ mi niye ní ɔ eko ɔ, koo fĩa kaa o pe jamɛ a kɔni ɔmɛ nɛ a kplɔɔ ɔ. Ke o maa fĩa a, o hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ kaa pi mo nɛ o hɛɛ sipoku ɔ, se mohu sipoku ɔ nɛ hɛɛ mo.
Jehanɛ eko ɔ, o ma de ke, “A kplɔ kɔnihi, konɛ a ngɔ mi ngɔ ta tso ɔ he.” Saminya!
Hemi nɛ a he we yi he je nɛ a po mɛ; nɛ moo lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi o kɛ daa si ɔ nɛ.
O yi ko fu, se mohu o hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ.
Ejakaa ke Mawu baa we tso ɔ nitsɛ kɔni ɔmɛ a yi ɔ, eko ɔ, mohu e be o yi baae.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kaa Mawu mi mi hi, se e sane wa hulɔ.
Nihi nɛ gbee si ɔ, e kɛ mɛ to ní; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e mi mi jɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ ya nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ke pi jaa, a ma kplɔ nyɛ kɛ pue si ja nɔuu.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ hu, ke a tsake nɛ a ba he ye jehanɛ ɔ, a maa kpale mɛ kɛ ta tso ɔ he ekohu, ejakaa Mawu ma nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ hluu tsɔ.
Nɛ pohu hyɛ kaa oliv tso nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e puɛ ngɛ nga nɔ, nɛ a po mo ngɛ he, nɛ a kɛ ba ta oliv tso nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ he ɔ, e pee pɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pɔɛ he.
Lɛɛ oliv tso ɔ nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ nitsɛ e kɔnihi nɛ a kplɔ ɔ, e be wae kulaa kaa a maa kpale ngɔ mɛ kɛ ta tso ɔ he ekohu.
Mawu naa nihi tsuo mɔbɔ Ye nyɛmimɛ, anɔkuale laami sane ko ngɛ nɛ i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko susu kaa nyɛ hɛ mi lɛ tɛ̃.
Sane ɔ ji kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, pe a ha a wa tue be kuku kɛkɛ kɛ yaa si ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo ma ba le Mawu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma he Israel tsuo yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke, “Yi wami helɔ ɔ maa je Zion kɛ ba; e ma ha Yakob nina a ma kpa musu bɔmi.
Nɛ somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa so ji kaa a ma kpa yayami tsuo peemi.” Ngɛ sane kpakpa a blɔ fa mi ɔ, nyɛ he ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ peeɔ Mawu he nyɛli.
Se akɛnɛ e hla a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ momo he je ɔ, Mawu suɔ mɛ.
Ejakaa ke Mawu tsɛ nɔ ko nɛ e gbaa lɛ ɔ, e tsakee we e yi mi hu.
Nyɛ ma je li, sa a, nyɛ bui Mawu, se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu na nyɛ mɔbɔ, ejakaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ hu ba gbo tue.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ Yuda bi ji tue gboli ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Se mɔbɔ nɛ Mawu na nyɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mɛ hu Mawu ma ba na mɛ mɔbɔ.
Mawu ha nɛ nihi tsuo pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ngɛ tue gbomi he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na mɛ tsuo mɔbɔ.
Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi Niatsɛ mi niatsɛ ji Mawu!
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e nile, kɛ juɛmi hiɛ ha!
Mɛnɔ le bɔ nɛ e toɔ e yi mi ha?
Blɔ nɔ nɛ e guu kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, mɛnɔ le?
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mɛnɔ lɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi, aloo mɛnɔ lɛ wo lɛ ga hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ ha lɛ nɔ ko hyɛ, nɛ e hia kaa e to lɛ nane mi?” Ejakaa Mawu lɛ bɔ níhi tsuo; lɛ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ; nɛ mɛ tsuo a woɔ e hɛ mi nyami kɛ yaa neneene!
Amen!
Bɔ nɛ sa nɛ waa ba wa je mi kɛ ja Mawu I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, Mawu na nyɛ mɔbɔ babauu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha kaa bɔ nɛ a sã, se kɛ̃ e hɛ ngɛ, nɛ e he tsɔ, nɛ e saa Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ wami tsuo nɛ sɔmɔ Mawu, konɛ nyɛ jami ɔ nɛ pee ngɛ mumi mi.
Nyɛ ko ba nyɛ je mi kaa je mi bi ɔmɛ hu; se mohu nyɛ ha Mawu nɛ tsake nyɛ juɛmi, konɛ nyɛ yɔse níhi nɛ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ní kpakpahi nɛ sa e hɛ mi saminya, nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ. I kɛ dloomi nɛ Mawu dloo mi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsuo dee ke, nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó bu lɛ nitsɛ e he tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ sa kaa e buu e he.
Se mohu e pee e he humi kaa bɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e pee ɔ. Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ e he níhi fuu, se e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo tsuɔ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.
Jã kɛ̃ wɔ nimli babauu nɛ ɔ, wa peeɔ nɔmlɔ tso kake ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nike ní slɔɔtohi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo wɔ ɔ, e sa kaa wa tsu a he ní saminya.
Ke gbami ji wa nike ní ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ngɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ kɛ tsu he ní.
Ke a ha wɔ he wami nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔ, wa sɔmɔ; ke ní tsɔɔmi ɔ, wa tsɔɔ.
Ke wa nɔ́ ji kaa waa tu munyu kɛ wo nyɛmimɛ he wami ɔ, waa wo mɛ he wami.
Nɔ nɛ maa ke ní ɔ, e pee kɛ bua jɔmi.
Hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ, e tsu ní ɔ wawɛɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ naa mɔbɔ ɔ, e pee kɛ bua jɔmi.
Suɔmi ɔ, e je nyɛ tsui mi tɔɔ.
Nyɛɛ nyɛ yayami kulaa; nɛ nyɛɛ pɛtɛ nɔ́ kpakpa he.
Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he saminya kaa nyɛmimɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bu e nyɛmi pe lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Nyɛ ko pee hejɔ, mohu nyɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ tsu ní.
Nyɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.
Akɛnɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ.
Ke haomi ba a, nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si nɛ nyɛɛ hi sɔlee daa.
Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye bua mɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nibwɔ peemi he mɔde.
Nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ, nyɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ ha mɛ; nyɛ ko gbiɛ mɛ.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ nɛ nya; nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ya foe ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ nɛ fo.
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ ha nɔ kake ɔ, nyɛɛ pee ja kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ baa a he si ɔ nɛ bɔ; nɛ nyɛ ko bu nyɛ he ní leli tsɔ.
Nyɛ ko pee nɔ ko yayami kɛ to yayami nane mi.
Nyɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ a na kaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pee.
Ke e maa hi ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Ye huɛmɛ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he lue, se mohu nyɛɛ ngmɛ Mawu blɔ nɛ e kɛ e mi mi la nɛ pee.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Ye nɔ ji lue yemi; Imi ma pee kɛ to nane mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.” Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ ya nɔ de ɔ, “Ke hwɔ ngɛ o he nyɛlɔ yee ɔ, ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye; nɛ ke kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu.
Ke o pee jã a, o ma ha zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe lɛ.” Nyɛ ko ha yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ ngɔ kpakpa peemi kɛ ye yayami nɔ kunimi.
E sa kaa a bu ma nɔ yeli tue Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba e he si ha ma nɔ yeli, ejakaa blɔ nya tsuaa blɔ nya a, Mawu lɛ haa nɔ; nɛ nɔ yeli nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ hu he wami nɛ a hɛɛ ɔ, Mawu lɛ ha mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ blɔ nya nɛ ɔ, Mawu blɔ nya tomi ɔ e nɛ ngɛ si tee kɛ ngɛ woe ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ ja a, Mawu maa gbla e tue.
Ejakaa nɔ yeli nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e sɛ kaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa yeɔ mɛ gbeye, se mohu nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ yaya.
Anɛ o suɔ nɛ o ko ye nɔ yelɔ ɔ gbeye lo?
Ke ja a, lɛɛ pee nɔ́ kpakpa; nɛ nɔ yelɔ ɔ ma je o yi.
Mawu tsɔlɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ní tsumi ji kaa e hyɛ nɛ e hi ha mo.
Se ke o pee yayami ɔ, lɛɛ o ye nɔ yelɔ ɔ gbeye; ejakaa a ha we lɛ blɔ nya nɛ ɔ yaka.
Mawu tsɔlɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e kɛ mi mi la gblaa a tue ngɛ Mawu nane mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nɔ yeli; pi kaa nyɛ tue kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu maa gbla ke nyɛ pee we ja, se nyɛ he nile hu maa bu nyɛ fɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ nyɛ woɔ tó ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔli ji mɛ; nɛ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a tsuɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ blɔ nya a, nyɛɛ pee ha lɛ.
Ma tó nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ wo ɔ, nyɛɛ wo; tó nɛ a heɔ ngɛ weto ní he jio, nyɛɛ wo; nihi nɛ sa he si bami ɔ, nyɛɛ ba he si ha mɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ bu nihi nɛ sa bu.
Bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛmimɛ kɛ a sibi nɛ hi si Nyɛ ko hɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hiɔ.
Hiɔ pɛ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ sibi ji suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa suɔ nyɛ he.
Ke nɔ ko suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, kɛkɛ pe e ye mlaa a tsuo nɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Mlaa a nɛ deɔ ke, “Koo bɔ ajuama; koo gbe nɔmlɔ; koo ju; o hɛ ko kɔ̃ nɔ́ ko nɔ,” kɛ ekpa komɛ nɛ piɛ he ɔ, lɛ tsuo kpiti pomi ji nɔ́ nɛ deɔ ke, “Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he” ɔ nɛ.
Ke o suɔ nɔ ko ɔ, o be lɛ yayami ko yayami ko pee.
Ke o suɔ o nyɛmi ɔ, kɛkɛ pe o ye mlaa a tsuo nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ le be nɔ nɛ mi nɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa e sa nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ tsɛ kɛ je mahe nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hwɔe ɔ mi.
Ejakaa be ɔ nɛ Mawu ma he wa yi wami ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e na wɔ haa pe kekleekle nɛ wa he ye ɔ. Nyɔ ɔ be ta kulaa, nɛ je mi miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wa kpa níhi nɛ wa peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ; wa ní peemi ɔmɛ nɛ a kpɛ́ kaa níhi nɛ ta bulɔ kɛ mia.
Nyɛ ha waa ba wa je mi saminya kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe piani, se pi kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi.
Wa ko fiɛ fiɛmi yaya; wa ko de dã; wa ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi; wa ko tsu mu ní; wa ko pɛ, nɛ wa ko je hunga.
Nyɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɛ pee kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo; nyɛ ko susu he lo nya níhi a he, ke pi ja a, e ma jlo nyɛ kaa nyɛ pee.
Koo kojo o nyɛmi Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ Nɔ ko nɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko sã nya ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e susuɔ kaa e sa nɛ e pee, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ko pee he.
Se mohu nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ ba nyɛ kpɛti.
Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; se nɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ, lɛɛ pui pɛ e yeɔ.
Nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ɔ, e ko gbe nɔ nɛ yi ɔ he guɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ pui pɛ ɔ, e ko kojo nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu he lɛ momo.
Mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kojoɔ nɔ kpa tsɔlɔ?
Ke tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ, loo e maa gbee si ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ maa na.
Ee, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e ya nɔ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ he wami nɛ haa nɔ yaa nɔ saminya.
E peeɔ ni komɛ kaa ligbi ɔmɛ ekomɛ a he hia pe ekomɛ, be mi nɛ ni komɛ susuɔ kaa ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee e juɛmi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he.
Nɔ nɛ susuɔ kaa ligbi komɛ a he hia pe ekomɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami e ngɛ woe; nɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ saisaa a, lɛ hu e ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami woe, ejakaa e naa Mawu si ngɛ he.
Nɔ nɛ yi nɔ́ saisaa a, lɛ hu e kɛ woɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ lɛ hu e naa Mawu si.
Wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ ka we kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ́ nɔ ko ma gbo ha lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Ke wa hɛ ngɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ wa hɛ ngɛ kɛ ha, nɛ ke wa gbo hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wa gbo kɛ ha.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nihi ji wɔ.
Ejakaa Kristo gbo, nɛ e kpale ba wami mi ekohu, konɛ e pee Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo.
Lɛɛ mɛni he je moo o kojoɔ o nyɛmi?
Aloo pohu mɛni he je nɛ o gbeɔ o nyɛmi he guɛ ɔ?
Mawu hɛ mi wɔ tsuo wa maa da si ngɛ nɛ e maa kojo wɔ.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ kita kae ke Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma kpla si ha mi Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma gba mi ma de paa ke imi ji Mawu.” Lɛɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e he akɔtaa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Ko ha nɛ o nyɛmi Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ pee yayami Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wa kpa wa sibi kojomi; se mohu nyɛ pee saminya nɛ nɔ ko ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha o nyɛmi nane ma kpata, aloo nɛ ma ha e pee yayami.
Nɛ i ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, i kpá si, nɛ i le kaa niye ní ko niye ní ko be nɛ he tsɔ we.
Se ke nɔ ko buu niye ní ko kaa e he tsɔ we ɔ, lɛ nɛ niye ní ɔ he tsɔ we ha.
Ke o ye niye ní ko, nɛ lɔ ɔ kɛ haomi ba o nyɛmi nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ o sume o nyɛmi ɔ. Ko ha ní nɛ o maa ye ɔ nɛ kpata o nyɛmi nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ e he ɔ hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛ buu nɔ́ kpakpa a, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a tu he munyu yaya.
Ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, pi nɔ́ nɛ a maa ye, loo nɔ́ nɛ a maa nu; se mohu kaa a pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a na bua jɔmi.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ haa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo sɔmɔe ngɛ kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya ní pee, nɛ e saa nimli adesahi hu a hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa di níhi nɛ kɛ he jɔɔmi baa, nɛ waa kɛ maa wo wa sibi he wami ɔ a se daa.
Ko ya di niye ní se, nɛ o kpata nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu pee hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, e he tsɔ.
Se nɔ́ ko nɛ o maa ye, nɛ ma ha o nyɛmi maa pee yayami ɔ, e sɛ kaa o ye.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hi kaa o ko ye lo, nɛ o ko nu wai, nɛ jehanɛ hu, o ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha o nyɛmi nane ma kpata.
Bɔ nɛ o heɔ yeɔ ngɛ munyu nɛ ɔ he ɔ, e pee o kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti sane.
Ke nɔ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e le kaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ da, nɛ e he nile hu bui lɛ fɔ ngɛ he ɔ, e naa bua jɔmi saminya.
Se ke e yi mi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ngɛ niye ní ko he nɛ e ye ɔ, Mawu maa bu lɛ fɔ, ejakaa e be hemi kɛ yemi; nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ o peeɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi be mi ɔ, e ji yayami.
Waa pee níhi nɛ maa sa wa nyɛmimɛ a hɛ mi Wɔ nihi nɛ wa hemi kɛ yemi mi wa a, e sa kaa waa ye bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ. Wa ko susu wɔ nitsɛmɛ pɛ wa he.
Mohu ɔ, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ hi nɛ maa sa e nyɛmi hɛ mi, konɛ e nyɛmi ɔ nɛ na hemi kɛ yemi nɛ pi si.
Ejakaa Kristo hu pee we lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya ní; se mohu ngmami ɔ ke, “Níhi nɛ a de kɛ bɔ mo ahlua a, imi mohu ye hɛ mi si a pue.” Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a ngma konɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ ní.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ngmami ɔmɛ ma ha wa maa to wa tsui si; nɛ a maa wo wɔ he wami nɛ wa na hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi.
Mawu ɔ nɛ haa nɔ toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e woɔ nɔ he wami nɛ ha nɛ nyɛ wo Kristo Yesu nane, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ hi si saminya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa pee kake, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbi kake nɛ wo Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
A ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ hulɔ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he nyɛ sibi atuu kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu he nyɛ atuu ɔ. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Kristo ba sɔmɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa Mawu yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e kɛ ma si nɛ Mawu wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ mi.
E pee ja, konɛ ma je li ɔmɛ tete nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa e na mɛ hu mɔbɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ma je o yi ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti, Nɛ ma wo o biɛ ta kɛ la.” Ngmami ɔ kpale deɔ ke, “Nyɛ ma je li, nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu ma a nɛ nya.” Jehanɛ, e deɔ ekohu ke, “Nyɛ ma je li tsuo, nyɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi; Je mahi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi wawɛɛ!” Yesaya hu de ke, “Ishai nina ko maa ba; E maa te si nɛ e ba ye ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ, Nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.” Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa nihi tsuo hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ, e ha nyɛ hyi tɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nya, konɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ daa.
Paulo tsɔɔ nɔ́ he je nɛ e ngma womi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ Ye nyɛmimɛ, imi nitsɛ i le tsɔ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ tete nyɛ mi mi hi; nyɛ le ní bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ nyɛ nyɛɔ woɔ nyɛ sibi ga.
Se kɛ̃, i ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ a nɔ ta woe kaa a he hia.
I kɛ hɛdɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae kɛ kai nyɛ kaa Mawu dloomi ɔ nya a, i ba pee Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ nɛ ma tsu ma je li ɔmɛ a he ní.
Ma tsu ní kaa osɔfo kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, konɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ tsu ma je li ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a pee kaa bɔ nɛ a sã, nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma nyɛ ma fĩa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi kaa i ngɛ Mawu ní tsue.
Ejakaa i be nɔ́ kpa ko he munyu nyɛe ma tu pe kaa Kristo gu ye munyu tumi, kɛ ní tsumi nɔ nɛ e ha ma je li ɔmɛ ba le Mawu.
Okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ i pee ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ tsu enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye sikpa a tsuo, kɛ je Yerusalem hluu kɛ ya su Ilirikum ɔ, sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ sɔuu i fiɛ.
Nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ i kɛ ma ye hɛ mi ji kaa he nɛ a fiɛ we sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ ngɛ lolo ɔ, ma ya fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi be dee ke i ngɛ tsu fiae kɛ ngɛ nɔ kpa sisi tomi nɔ mae.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nihi nɛ a jaje we e he sane ko kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ hyɛ ɔ maa na lɛ; Nɛ nihi nɛ nui e he hyɛ ɔ maa nu sisi.” Paulo to kaa e maa ya Roma I ka si abɔ kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ, se enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i nyɛ we.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ i be nɔ́ ko peemi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi hu nɛ ɔ, ma ba su nyɛ ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i hla nɛ ma pee be babauu ji nɛ ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa ke kaa ma be kɛ ya Spania, ma ba gba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ya je mi blɔ kɛ ho.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ i pue nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem nɛ ma ngɔ nike ní kɛ ya ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ejakaa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia, kɛ Akaya a kɛ bua jɔmi bua nɔ́ ko nya nɛ a kɛ ya ye bua ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ. Mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛ a to kaa a maa pee enɛ ɔ lɛɛ, se anɔkuale mi ɔ, a blɔ nya ní tsumi ji kaa a ye bua mɛ.
Mumi mi nike ní nɛ Mawu ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, a kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ dla; enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa ma je li ɔmɛ hu, he lo mi ní kpakpahi nɛ Mawu ke mɛ ɔ, a kɛ eko nɛ sɔmɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ.
Ke i ngɔ nike ní tsuo nɛ a bua nya a ya su mɛ ɔ, ma pue blɔ kɛ ba gu nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ho Spania ya.
I le kaa ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, Kristo maa gbaa nyɛ babauu.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, i ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo, kɛ suɔmi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ haa nɔ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ nyɛɛ piɛ ye he kɛ sɔle wawɛɛ nɛ Mawu nɛ ye bua mi.
Nyɛɛ sɔle konɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yudea nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ nɛ a ko doo ye nya, nɛ jehanɛ hu, ní nɛ i yaa tsu ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke Mawu suɔ ɔ, i kɛ bua jɔmi maa ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba jɔɔ ye he bɔɔ.
He jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
Amen!
Paulo ke e biɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ Wa nyɛmiyo Foibe nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Kenkrea asafo ɔ mi ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma wo e ta kɛ je e yi.
Nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa hia lɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ, ejakaa e pee kpakpa ha nihi babauu, kɛ imi nitsɛ hulɔ.
I biɔ Priskila kɛ Akuila, nyɛmimɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ha Yesu Kristo ɔ. Ye he ɔ, e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ a sake a he lo ngɔ fɔ he.
I ngɛ mɛ si nae saminya; ee, pi imi kɛkɛ, se ma je li ɔmɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ mɛ si nae.
I biɔ asafo ɔ nɛ kpeɔ ngɛ a we ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ.
I biɔ Epeneto, kekleekle nɔ nɛ he Kristo ye ngɛ Asia a; ye huɛ saminya ji lɛ.
I biɔ Maria; lɛ hu e gbo nyɛ he dengme wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
I biɔ Androniko kɛ Yunia, ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi nɛ a wo i kɛ mɛ tsuo tsu ɔ.
A he biɛ saminya ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ a sɛ ye hlami ngɛ Kristo mi.
I biɔ Ampliato nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. I biɔ Urbano nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo tsuɔ ní ha Kristo ɔ, kɛ jehanɛ hu ye huɛ Staki nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya a. I biɔ Apele; a yeɔ e he odase kaa e sɔmɔɔ Kristo saminya.
I biɔ Aristobulo weku ɔ hulɔ.
I biɔ Herodion, ye nyɛmi Yuda no ɔ, kɛ nyɛmimɛ Kristo we bi nɛ je Narkiso weku ɔ mi ɔ. I biɔ Trifaina kɛ Trifosa nɛ a tsuɔ ní ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. I biɔ Persi, ye huɛ nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya a; lɛ hu e tsu ní wawɛɛ kɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. I biɔ Rufo, nɔ nɛ je e he si kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsulɔ kpanaa a, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ imi hu kaa e bi ɔ. I biɔ Asinkrito, Felgon, Herma, Patroba, Herme, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ. I biɔ Filologo, kɛ Yulia, kɛ Nerea, kɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ, kɛ Olimpas, kɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ fua nyɛ sibi kɛ nga nyɛ he.
Kristo asafo tsuo biɔ nyɛ.
Nyagbe munyu Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ, nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe, nɛ a kɛ mi gbami ngɛ asafo ɔ mi bae ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he ngɛ a he, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko bɔ.
Ejakaa nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, pi Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ sɔmɔe.
Se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muklii mohu he mɔde nɛ a ngɛ bɔe.
A kɛ munyu dɔkɔɔ gbeɔ nihi nɛ a juɛmi se ti we ɔ a yi mi, nɛ a sisiɔ mɛ.
A nu nyɛ he ngɛ he tsuaa he kaa nyɛ pɛtɛ sane kpakpa a he wawɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ i na nyɛ he bua jɔmi saminya.
I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ pee; se yayami blɔ fa mi lɛɛ a ko nu nyɛ he kulaa.
E be kɛe kulaa nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ ma kpata Abosiami hɛ mi, nɛ wa maa ye e nɔ.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si.
Timoteo nɛ i kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue ɔ ke e biɔ nyɛ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi, Lukio, Yason, kɛ Sosipatre hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Imi Tertio nɛ i ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i biɔ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi.
Gayo, ye wetsɛ ɔ hu ke e biɔ nyɛ.
E we mi nɛ asafo ɔ tsuo kpee ngɛ.
Erasto, ma sika tolɔ ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Kuato hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
[ Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ hi si!
Amen!]
Nyagbe yi jemi sɔlemi Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi.
Lɛ nɛ e ma ha nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi maa wa ngɛ Yesu Kristo he sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ mi.
Kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li anɔkuale nɛ ɔ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma a ha nihi babauu ba na anɔkuale ɔ paa kaa bɔ nɛ neneene Mawu ɔ nitsɛ to nɛ a fiɛ ha je mahi tsuo, konɛ a he Mawu ye, nɛ a bu lɛ tue ɔ.
A je Mawu kake too ɔ nɛ le ní tsuo ɔ yi ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi kɛ ya neneene.
Amen!
NYA TSƆƆMI Paulo Kekleekle Womi Kɛ Ha Korinto Bi tsɔɔ kaa nyagba komɛ nɛ kɔɔ Kristo we bi a je mi bami, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi he ba te si ngɛ asafo ɔ mi.
Paulo nɛ to Korinto asafo ɔ sisi, nɛ e ngma womi nɛ ɔ konɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ níhi a nya.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Hela bi a ma nguaa Korinto kɛ e mi nimli munomunohi ɔ ji Akaya zugba a nɛ Roma bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ yee ɔ e matsɛ ma.
Korinto ma a he biɛ wawɛɛ ngɛ jua yemi, kusumi peemi, yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, kɛ jami slɔɔtohi a mi.
Níhi titli nɛ bɔfo ɔ tu he munyu ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji mi gbami, yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi ngɛ gba si himi mi, níhi nɛ kɔɔ he níle he, asafo blɔ nya tomi kpakpa, Mumi Klɔuklɔu nike níhi, kɛ ni gbogboehi a si temi.
Paulo ngɔ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sane kpakpa a tuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu ha.
Yi ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nike ní nɛ he jua wa pe nike ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu kɛ haa e we bi ɔ ji suɔmi; nɛ e peeɔ kaa yi nɛ ɔ ji munyu nɛ nihi le pe kulaa ngɛ womi ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Mi gbamihi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi .—.
Yo kɛ nyumu a bɔmi, kɛ gba si himi .—.
Kristo we bi, kɛ wɔ jali .—.
Asafo ɔ mi si himi, kɛ Mawu jami .—.
Kristo, kɛ nihi nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ a si temi .- Nike ní nɛ a kɛ ya ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yudea .- Paulo nitsɛ e he sane komɛ, kɛ nyagbe níhi .-
Imi Paulo, nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, e tsɛ mi nɛ ma ba pee Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, i kɛ wa nyɛmi Sostene lɛ wa ngma womi nɛ ɔ. Wa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ yaa ha Mawu we asafo nɛ ngɛ Korinto ɔ, nihi nɛ a tsu a he, nɛ a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ha Yesu Kristo, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ a jaa Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ mɛ hu a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ.
Gbaami ngɛ Kristo mi I naa Mawu si daa kɛ haa nyɛ ngɛ dloomi nɛ e ngɔ ha nyɛ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ he.
Ejakaa nyɛ ya hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, munyu tumi jio, nile jio.
Kristo he odase nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yee ɔ ba he si wawɛɛ nɛ nihi na.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ blɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, mumi mi nike ní ko kulaa be nyɛ hiae.
Mawu nitsɛ maa hɛɛ nyɛ kɛ maa ya nyagbe, konɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a, piami ko piami ko kó hi nyɛ he.
Mawu, nɔ nɛ kpee nyɛ ke nyɛɛ kɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba bɔ huɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ.
Mi gbami ngɛ asafo ɔ mi Nyɛmimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nya nɛ pee kake, nɛ mi gbami kó ba nyɛ kpɛti.
Nyɛ yi mi, kɛ nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa ni komɛ je Kloe we ɔ mi ba wo ye tue nɔ ke pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ji, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ngɛ dee.
Nɔ ko ke, “Paulo nɔ́ ji mi”, nɛ nɔ ko hu ke, “Imi lɛɛ Apolo nɔ́ ji mi”; nɔ kpa ke, “Imi lɛɛ Kefa nɔ́ ji mi”; nɛ nɔ kpa hu ke, “Oo, imi lɛɛ Kristo nitsɛ se nyɛɛlɔ ji mi.” Anɛ a gba Kristo mi lo?
Anɛ Paulo nɛ a sɛu ha nyɛ lo?
Anɛ Paulo biɛ mi a sɔle nyɛ kɛ wo lo?
I naa Mawu si kaa i sɔle we nɔ ko nɔ ko kaa ja Krispo kɛ Gayo pɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko be nyɛe ma de ke a sɔle nyɛ kɛ wo ye biɛ mi.
Niinɛ, i sɔle Stefana kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ hulɔ.
Se i kaii we kaa i pa sɔle nɔ kpa ko hu.
Kristo tsɔ we mi ke ma ba sɔle nihi.
E tsɔ mi ke ma ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a; pi kɛ nya mi dɔkɔɔ, kɛ adesa nile, konɛ gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ kó pee yaka.
Kristo ji Mawu he wami, kɛ e nile Ejakaa nihi nɛ a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata a, buɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ sɛumi tso ɔ he ɔ kaa kuasiahi a sane ko kɛkɛ.
Se wɔ nɛ a ngɛ wa yi wami hee ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ e ji Mawu he wami ha wɔ.
Ngmami ɔ ke, “Ma ha nɛ ní leli a nile ma puɛ, nɛ ga leli a ga tsuo maa pee yaka.” Jije ní leli ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Jije ga leli ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Jije je nɛ ɔ mi sane mi hlali ɔmɛ ngɛ?
Ee, Mawu ha nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nile ɔ plɛ pee kuasiahi a sane.
Mawu ngɔ e nile ɔ kɛ tsi adesa blɔ, konɛ adesa kó nyɛ nɛ e gu lɛɛ e ní lemi nɔ kɛ le Mawu.
Se mohu ɔ, sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe nɛ nihi buu kaa kuasiahi a sane ɔ, Mawu to kaa e kɛ ma he ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a yi wami.
Yuda bi hlaa kaa a pee okadi ha mɛ nɛ a na loko a he sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ a ye.
Hela bi hu hlaa kaa a maa nu nile munyu ko ngɛ mi lo.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe.
Enɛ ɔ peeɔ blɔ tsimi nɔ ha Yuda bi, nɛ Hela bi hu buu lɛ kaa kuasiahi a sane.
Ee, nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, Yuda bi jio, Hela bi jio, mɛɛ a le kaa Kristo ji Mawu he wami, kɛ e nile.
Ejakaa ke Mawu je kuasia tete po, adesa kɛ e nile nɛ nya wa a na we lɛ; ke Mawu gbɔjɔ tete po, adesa kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ na we lɛ saasaa.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ha loko Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ɔ. Ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi ɔ, nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ ji ní leli, nihi bɔɔ pɛ ji nihi nɛ a he wa, nɛ bɔɔ pɛ ji odehehi.
Mawu je blɔ hla je ɔ mi kuasia níhi, konɛ e kɛ gbe ní leli zo.
Mawu hla je ɔ mi níhi nɛ gbɔjɔ, konɛ e kɛ gbe níhi nɛ a he wa a zo.
E hla níhi nɛ je ɔ bui, níhi nɛ a hiee, kɛ níhi nɛ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa a, konɛ e kɛ gbe níhi nɛ je ɔ buu saminya a a he guɛ.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó fĩa ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Se Mawu ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo Yesu ba bɔ.
E ha nɛ Kristo ba pee wa nile.
Kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu pee wɔ nihi nɛ da.
Wa ba plɛ pee e ma klɔuklɔu, nɛ a he wa yi wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa fĩa a, e fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ɔ nɔ.”
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ he Ye nyɛmimɛ, benɛ i ba slaa nyɛ, nɛ i kɛ Mawu laami sane ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, i fiɛ we kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ, loo nile.
Ejakaa benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, i to ye yi mi kaa i be nɔ́ kpa ko tsɔɔe pe sane ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo, kɛ e sɛumi ɔ he ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbɔjɔ, nɛ sawale ha nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli.
Ní nɛ i tsɔɔ, kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ i fiɛ ɔ hu, pi nile munyu nɛ plɛɔ nɔ yi mi nɛ i tu.
Se mohu Mawu Mumi ɔ, kɛ he wami ɔ lɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɔ fɔ adesa nile nɔ, se mohu Mawu he wami nɔ.
Mawu nile Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa ngɛ mumi mi ɔ, i fiɛɔ nile sɛ gbi ko kɛ̃ kɛ haa mɛ; pi nile nɛ adesa tsɔɔ, nɛ pi je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yeli a nɔ́.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa be kɛ ho.
Nile nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ ji nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ laa adesa.
Loko a bɔ je ɔ, Mawu hla nile nɛ ɔ ngɔ to momo nɛ e kɛ wo wa hɛ mi nyami.
Je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li nile nɛ ɔ, a le jinɛ a ko sɛu we Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ.
Se, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a, “Nɔ́ nɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ́ hyɛ, Nɔ́ nɛ tue nui hyɛ, Nɔ́ nɛ adesa ko juɛmi sui he ɔ, Lɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu dla ngɔ to nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ.” Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu gu e mumi ɔ nɔ je laami sane ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ.
Mumi ɔ hlaa níhi tsuo a mi; Mawu juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ tete po, e hlaa mi.
Adesa nitsɛ e mumi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ pɛ lɛ le bɔ nɛ lɛ adesa a ngɛ ha.
Jã kɛ̃, Mawu mumi ɔ pɛ lɛ le bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ ha.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ pi je nɛ ɔ mi mumi ɔ nɛ wa ná, se mohu mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, konɛ waa le níhi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo wɔ ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ, ke waa kɛ mɛ ngɛ mumi mi níhi a he ní sɛɛe ɔ, munyu nɛ mumi ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa tuɔ; wa tu we adesa nile munyu.
Nɔ nɛ be mumi ɔ na we Mawu mumi ɔ nike níhi.
Nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nui mumi ɔ nike níhi a sisi saminya.
Enɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ kuasiahi a sane kɛ haa lɛ; ejakaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mumi mi hɛngmɛ a kɛ naa.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi ɔ naa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; se lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li lɛ kɛ pi si.
Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a, “Mɛnɔ lɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi, nɛ e maa wo lɛ ga?” Wɔɔ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ Kristo susuu e yi mi ɔ, jã wɔ hu wa susuu wa yi mi.
Mawu sɔmɔli Nyɛmimɛ, anɔkuale mi ɔ, i nyɛ we nɛ i kɛ nyɛ nɛ tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ nihi nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ tuɔ munyu.
Se mohu, i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kaa je mi bi, aloo bimwɔwi ngɛ Kristo jami mi.
I ha nyɛ nyɔ nyu, se pi niye ní nɛ jiɔ; ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ ye niye ní nɛ jiɔ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po nyɛ nyɛ we kɛ mwɔɔ.
Nyɛ ngɛ he lo nya kɛ mwɔɔ, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ je mi bi peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ peeɔ.
Be abɔ nɛ hunga jemi, kɛ pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa je mi bi ji nyɛ lo?
Nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ ɔ, anɛ pi lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ lo?
Ke nɔ ko ke, “Paulo nɔ ji mi”, nɛ nɔ ko hu ke, “Imi lɛɛ Apolo nɔ ji mi” ɔ, anɛ pi nɔ́ nɛ je mi bi peeɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ji Apolo ɔ?
Imi Paulo hu, mɛnɔ ji mi?
Mawu tsɔli kɛkɛ ji wɔ, nɛ wa nɔ lɛ nyɛ gu kɛ he Kristo ye.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ wa tsu.
Imi lɛ i ba ma tso ɔ. Apolo ba pue nɔ nyu, se Mawu lɛ ha nɛ tso ɔ wa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ duɔ tso, kɛ nɔ nɛ pueɔ nɔ nyu ɔ, a he hia we kulaa.
Mawu ji nɔ nɛ he hia, ejakaa lɛ nɛ haa nɛ tso ɔ waa.
Nɔ nɛ duɔ tso, kɛ nɔ nɛ pueɔ nɔ nyu ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti; Mawu maa wo a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ kpakpa ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ e tsu ɔ he.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu tsɔli nɛ pee kake kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ji wɔ.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa ngmɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ mi.
Nyɛ ngɛ kaa tsu nɛ Mawu ngɛ fiae.
I ngɔ Mawu dloomi nɛ e ha mi ɔ, nɛ i kɛ to tsu ɔ sisi kaa tsu fialɔ kpanaa nɛ le ga tsuɔ ní; nɛ nɔ kpa ba ngɛ nɔ fiae.
Se e hia kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ kaa e ngɛ tsu ɔ fiae saminya ngɛ sisi tomi ɔ nɔ lo.
Ejakaa Mawu ngɔ Yesu Kristo ngɔ to momo kaa sisi tomi, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa to sisi kpa ko hu.
Ni komɛ maa ngɔ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ, loo tɛ nɛ he jua wa kɛ fia sisi tomi ɔ nɔ; ni komɛ hu maa ngɔ tso, loo gla, loo nga kɛ pee.
Se ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba a, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní nɛ e tsu ɔ maa je kpo paa.
Ejakaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a kɛ la ma je nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi kpo.
La a maa tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi ngɛ ha.
Ke nɔ ko fia tsu ngɔ fɔ sisi tomi ɔ nɔ, nɛ la sa he, se tsu ɔ daa si kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tsu fialɔ ɔ ma na hiɔwo kpakpa.
Ke nɔ ɔ tsu ɔ sã a, nɔ́ laa lɛ; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ a ma he e yi wami kaa nɔ ko nɛ a gbla lɛ kɛ je la mi.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa Mawu sɔlemi we ji nyɛ, nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi lo?
Ke nɔ ko puɛ Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ, Mawu ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Ejakaa Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛ ji sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó sisi e he.
Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko susuu kaa lɛɛ e le ní pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, é pee e he kuasia.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee ní lelɔ nitsɛnitsɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ je ɔ buu kaa nile ɔ ji kuasia nɔ́ ko ngɛ Mawu lɛɛ e hɛ mi.
Ngmami ɔ ke, “Mawu ngɔɔ nile kɛ tsɔɔ ní leli klama.” Ngmami ɔ kpa hu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le kaa ní leli a yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó fĩa ngɔ fɔ adesa ko nɔ, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ ha nyɛ; Paulo jio, Apolo jio, Petro jio, je nɛ ɔ jio, wami jio, gbenɔ jio, amlɔ nɛ ɔ jio, hwɔɔ se jio, ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ ha nyɛ.
Nyɛ hu Kristo níhi ji nyɛ, nɛ Kristo ɔ, Mawu nɔ ji lɛ.
Kristo bɔfohi Nyɛɛ bu wɔ kaa Kristo tsɔli nɛ Mawu ngɔ laami sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ ke waa fiɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ tsɔli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ a dɛ ji kaa a ye anɔkuale ha a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Imi lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ, aloo ni kpahi susuɔ ngɛ ye he ɔ hɛwi mi; imi nitsɛ po, i kojo we ye he.
Ye he nile tete bui mi fɔ, se enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yeɔ nguɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ kojoɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko kojo nɔ ko loko be ɔ nɛ su.
Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba.
Ke e ba a, e ma je diblii mi níhi, kɛ tsui mi ní yayahi nɛ a kɛ laa a tsuo kpo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na yi jemi nɛ sa lɛ ɔ kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ he ɔ, i ngɔ imi, kɛ Apolo ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kase wɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko je nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a se ya pee nɔ́ kpa ko.
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó wó e he nɔ; nɔ ko kó bu nɔ ko nɔmlɔ ngua pe nɔ ko.
Mɛnɔ lɛ pee mo slɔɔto pe ni kpahi?
Mɛni ngɛ o dɛ nɛ pi Mawu nɛ ha mo?
Ke Mawu lɛ ha mo ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o fĩaa kaa nɔ́ nɛ pi nɛ a kɛ ke mo ɔ?
Tse nyɛ ná nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia nyɛ!
Tse nyɛ ná ní momo!
Nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee, be mi nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nɔ́ ko mi; pi jã?
I na nɛ nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee niinɛ, konɛ waa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ ye.
Ejakaa e peeɔ mi kaa Mawu ngɔ wɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ pee sekpɛli.
Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ a bu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ, konɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ je ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfohi, kɛ adesahi tsuo nɛ na mɛ.
Kristo he ɔ, wa plɛ kuasiahi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ba pee ní leli!
Wa gbɔjɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he mi ba wa nyɛ!
Nyɛ hɛ mi ba nyami, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛ mi pue si.
Kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po hwɔ kɛ kuma yee wɔ; wa heha níhi híaa ngɛ wa he; a kongoɔ wɔ, nɛ wa hii kpae kɛ hii bee.
Waa kɛ wa nine nguɛ nyɔngma tsuɔ ní.
Ke nihi ngɛ wɔ jɛe ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa gbaa mɛ; ke a ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ, wa toɔ wa tsui si.
Ke a ngɛ wa biɛ puɛe ɔ, wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa tu he jɔmi munyu.
Je ɔ buu wɔ kaa kuku kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. I ngmɛ́ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ma kɛ pue nyɛ hɛ mi si, se mohu nɛ ma kɛ tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa imi nitsɛ ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ.
Nyɛ ngɛ nihi akpeakpe nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ nɔ hyɛe mohu, se nɛ nyɛ ba le Kristo ɔ, tsɛ kake pɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Ejakaa kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo ba bɔni bɔmi, nɛ i ba pee nyɛ tsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ wo ye nane.
I ngɛ Timoteo nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.
E ngɛ kaa imi nitsɛ ye bi fɔfɔɛ; e yeɔ mi anɔkuale, nɛ i suɔ lɛ, ejakaa e le Kristo.
Ke Timoteo ba a, e ma kai nyɛ bɔ nɛ i plɛ kɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo se nyɛɛe ha, kaa bɔ nɛ a naa ngɛ ye ní tsɔɔmi mi ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi he tsuaa he ɔ. Nyɛ ti ni komɛ susu kaa i be bae ba slaa nyɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bɔni a he nɔ womi.
Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ ma ba slaa nyɛ.
Ke i ba a, pi munyu nɛ kikɛmɛ a he nɔ woli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ tue ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ ma ba nu, se he wami nɛ a kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, ma ba na paa.
Ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ jeɔ e he kpo ngɛ adesa ní tsumi mi, se pi munyu tumi mi.
Te nɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ nɛɛ?
Ke i ma nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, ma hɛɛ kpa kɛ ba, aloo ma ba ngɛ suɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi?
Ajuama bɔmi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi A ngɛ dee ke yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi sanehi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ, wɔ jali tete po pee we.
I nu kaa nɔ ko kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsɛ yo ngɛ si hwɔe.
Nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ woe ngɔ piɛ he!
Niinɛ, e sa kaa nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ mohu.
Nyumu nɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ fie lɛ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
-E ngɛ mi kaa i be nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi mohu, se mumi mi lɛɛ i kɛ nyɛ lɛ ngɛ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ahlua ní nɛ ɔ ɔ, i bu lɛ fɔ momo ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Ke nyɛ kpe nɛ ye mumi piɛ nyɛ he ngɛ Yesu Kristo he wami nya a, nyɛɛ tu nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Satan dɛ mi, nɛ e kpata e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ, Kristo nɛ he e susuma yi wami.
E sɛ kaa nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ.
Blema abɛ ɔ nɛ deɔ ke, “Masa bɔbɔyoo haa nɛ ma a tsuo fuɔ” ɔ, tse nyɛ le?
Nyɛ je yayami nɛ ngɛ kaa masa a kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ pee kaa ma kplolo nɛ masa be mi kaa bɔ nɛ i le nɛ nyɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Ejakaa a ngɔ Kristo ngɔ sã bɔ ha wɔ kaa to bi nɛ a gbeɔ Hetsɔmi nyami be.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa ngɛ wa Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ yee ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ waa ngɔ ma momo kɛ ye.
Ma momo nɛ ɔ ji yayami, kɛ yi wu tso níhi.
Nyɛ ha waa ye lɛ ngɛ anɔkuale yemi mi.
I de ngɛ womi nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ mi ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ fiɛɔ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi kó bɔ.
Pi je mi bi yaholi, loo hɛ tsuli, loo juli, loo wɔ jali a he munyu nɛ i ngɛ tue kulaa; kaa mɛ ɔ, jinɛ e ko hia kaa nyɛɛ je je ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe mohu ji, ke nɔ ko tsɛɔ e he Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ, nɛ e fiɛɔ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi, loo e hɛ tsuɔ, loo e jaa wɔ, loo e jɛɔ nɔ, loo e tɔɔ dã, loo e juɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko bɔ.
Nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko ye ní tete po.
- Pi ye ní tsumi ji kaa ma kojo nihi nɛ be asafo ɔ mi; Mawu lɛ maa kojo mɛ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ, anɛ e sɛ kaa nyɛ kojoɔ mɛɛ lɛɛ lo?
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nyɛ je nɔmlɔ yayami ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.”
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ngɛ munyu yee Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi asafo mi no na sane ɔ, e be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ sane ɔ ya haa nihi nɛ ja we Mawu nɛ a hyɛ mi ha mɛ.
E sa nɛ e kɛ ya ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ lɛ maa kojo je ɔ lo?
Saminya!
Ke nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa kojo je ɔ, lɛɛ sane wawi kojomi pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ha nyɛ.
Tse nyɛ le kaa nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa kojo hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ!
Nɛ daa ligbi munyu tsɔwitsɔwi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa kojo?
Ke sanehi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba a, nyɛ maa ngɔ ya ha nihi nɛ asafo ɔ kɛ mɛ be nɔ ko peemi nɛ a hyɛ mi lo?
Nyɛ ha nɛ ma bi nyɛ munyu nɛ zo nɛ gbe nyɛ.
Anɛ juɛmitsɛ kake too be nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ma nyɛ maa hyɛ nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti sane mi ha mɛ lo?
Se mohu, nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi yaa kojomi he, nɛ nihi nɛ li Kristo ɔ ya hyɛɛ a sane mi ha mɛ.
Kaa nyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ngɛ munyu yee ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ je mi bami sɛ́ Kristo se nyɛɛli saasaa.
Nyɛ ha nɛ ni kpahi pee nyɛ yayami mohu jinɛ tse e ko hi!
Nyɛ ha nɛ ni kpahi sisi nyɛ mohu jinɛ tse e ko hi!
Se nyɛ mohu nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi yayami pee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi sisie, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ tete po.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa yayami peeli be blɔ nya ko ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi lo?
Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he!
Yaholi, loo amaga jali, loo gba puɛli, loo nyumuhi kɛ yihi sɔuu nɛ kɛ a sibi peeɔ yakayaka ní, loo juli, loo hɛ tsuli, loo dã tɔli, loo nihi a biɛ puɛli, loo ojo fiali a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Be ko ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ ti ni komɛ ba a je mi.
Se jehanɛ ɔ, a du nyɛ he, nɛ a kpale tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ a wo nyɛ nguɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ, kɛ wa Mawu ɔ mumi ɔ mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nimli tso ɔmɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami Nɔ ko ma de ke, “I ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ nɛ mlaa ko mlaa ko tsí ye nya.” Ee, se tsa pi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hi ha mo.
Imi hu i ko de ke i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ jã nɔuu.
Se i be hae nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ ye ye nɔ.
Nɔ ko hu ma de ke, “Ngma ngɛ ha muklii, nɛ muklii hu ngɛ ha ngma.” Ee, se Mawu ma kpata nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, pi nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka ní peemi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha; se mohu e ngɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he.
Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ha nɔmlɔ tso ɔ. Mawu tle Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e kɛ e he wami ɔ ma tle wɔ hu si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi ji mɛ lo?
Lɛɛ ma ngɔ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní komɛ kɛ ya pee yaholɔ hu e nɔmlɔ tso he níhi lo?
Dɛbi!
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ nɛ kɛ yaholɔ ya naa bɔmi ɔ, e kɛ lɛ plɛ pee nɔmlɔ tso kake lo?
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ma plɛ pee nɔmlɔ tso kake.” Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ lɛ pee kake ngɛ mumi mi.
Nyɛɛ tu yahomi nya fo.
Yayami tsuaa yayami nɛ adesa peeɔ ɔ, pee we nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɔ́ ko tsɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ, yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ awi.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ, nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, anɛ nyɛ li kaa e sɔlemi tsu ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ lo?
Nyɛ be nyɛ dɛ he; Mawu níhi ji nyɛ.
Mawu hé nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Gba si himi Jehanɛ, níhi nɛ nyɛ ngma ba ha mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E hi ha nyumu kaa e ko ta yo he.
Se ajuama bɔmi he ɔ, nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ná lɛ nitsɛ e yo, nɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ ná lɛ nitsɛ e huno.
Nyumu nɛ ha e yo nɔ́ nɛ ji yo blɔ nya nɛ sa kaa e na kɛ je e huno dɛ mi; yo ɔ hu nɛ pee jã nɔuu ha e huno.
Yogbayo be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɔ; e huno lɛ ngɛ jamɛ a he wami ɔ. Jã kɛ̃ huno hu be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɔ; e yo lɛ ngɛ jamɛ a he wami ɔ. Nyumu kɛ e yo kó tsi a he nya kaa a kɛ a sibi be bɔmi nae.
Lɛɛ ja eko ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a kplɛɛ kaa a maa pee jã be kuku kɛkɛ, konɛ a na deka kɛ sɔle.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, á bɔni bɔmi ekohu.
Ke pi jã a, a be a he nɔ nyɛe maa ye hu, nɛ Satan maa ka mɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, ga kɛkɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe; pi mlaa.
Jinɛ i ko suɔ kaa nihi tsuo nɛ a hi kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ.
Se nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nike ní pɔtɛɛ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ; slo nɔ kake nɔ́ ngɛ nɔ kpa nɔ́ he.
Jehanɛ, nyɛ nyumu kuyo ɔmɛ, kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke e maa hi ha nyɛ ke nyɛ maa ya nɔ maa hi si kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ɔ.
Se ke nyɛ nyɛ́ we nyɛ he nɔ nyɛɛ ye ɔ, e hia kaa nyɛɛ sɛ gba si himi mi.
Ejakaa lɔ ɔ hi pe nɔ́ nɛ akɔnɔ ma ba hao nyɛ.
Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gba si himi mi ɔ, mlaa nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ woe ji yo kó je gba!
Enɛ ɔ, pi imi nɛ i de.
Se ke e na je gba kɛ̃ ɔ, e hi si jã, nɛ e ko gba, aloo e ya nɛ e kɛ e huno ɔ ya dla.
Jehanɛ hu, nyumu ko ngmɛɛ e yo he.
Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ imi, se pi Kristo, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ke nyumu nɛ le Kristo ngɛ yo nɛ lɛɛ e li Kristo, se kɛ̃ ɔ, yo ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, nyumu ɔ ko ngmɛɛ e he.
Ke yo nɛ le Kristo ngɛ huno nɛ lɛɛ e li Kristo, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyumu ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, yo ɔ kó kua lɛ gbami.
Ejakaa nyumu nɛ li Kristo ɔ, e yo ɔ he ɔ, a tsukɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu.
Yo nɛ li Kristo ɔ, lɛ hu e huno ɔ he ɔ, a tsukɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu.
Ke pi jã a, jinɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ a he tsɔ we.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba pee bimɛ nɛ a tsukɔ a he ha Mawu.
Se ke nyumu nɛ li Kristo ɔ suɔ kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e yo nɛ le Kristo ɔ he, aloo yo nɛ li Kristo ɔ suɔ kaa e ma kua e huno nɛ le Kristo ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ faa.
Ke e ba mi jã a, mlaa ko mlaa ko nui nɔ nɛ le Kristo ɔ, nyumu ɔ jio, yo ɔ jio.
Mawu tsɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Mo yo nɛ o le Kristo, kɛ o maa pee kɛ le kaa alini mo lɛ o ma he o huno ɔ yi wami?
Mo nyumu nɛ o le Kristo, kɛ o maa pee kɛ le kaa alini mo lɛ o ma he o yo ɔ yi wami?
Hii si kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɛ mo ɔ Nike ní nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ha nɔ ko loko Mawu ba tsɛ lɛ ɔ, é ya nɔ nɛ e tsu he ní kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.
Ke a po nɔ ko loko Mawu tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e ko de ke e maa gbe pa doku ɔ. Jã kɛ̃ ke a pui nɔ ko loko e ba le Mawu ɔ, e ko ha nɛ a po lɛ.
Ejakaa a po mo jio, a pui mo jio, pi nɔ́ ko; nɔ́ nɛ he hia ji kaa o ye Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ loko Mawu tsɛ lɛ.
Benɛ Mawu tsɛ mo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, tse nyɔguɛ ji mo?
Ko ha lɔ ɔ nɛ hao mo kulaa.
Se ke blɔ ko ngɛ nɛ o kɛ maa ye o he ɔ, bɔɔ he mɔde.
Ejakaa nyɔguɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɛ lɛ ɔ ba peeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ye e he.
Jã kɛ̃ ke nɔ ko ye e he, nɛ Kristo tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e ba peeɔ Kristo nyɔguɛ.
Kristo hé nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ; nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he nimli a nyɔguɛhi.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, enɛ ɔ he ɔ, si himi mi tsuaa si himi mi nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ benɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e kɛ Mawu nɛ hi si jã.
Nihi nɛ sɛ we gba si himi mi, kɛ yalɔyi Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngma ngɛ yihewi nɛ gba we lolo a he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha we mi mlaa pɔtɛɛ ko.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, juɛmi nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ ga nɛ ɔ woe ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ dloo mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, he hiami be ɔ je sisi momo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i susuu kaa mo nɔ, bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, o hi si jã kɛkɛ.
Ke yo ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, kó de ke o ngɛ e he ngmɛɛe.
Ke yo be o dɛ ɔ, ko ya hla eko.
Se ke o ná ngɔ yo ɔ, o pee we yayami.
Jã kɛ̃ ke yo nɛ gba we lolo hu gba a, e pee we yayami.
Se dengme nɛ ngɛ gba si himi mi he je ɔ, i na nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ si mohu amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji kaa be ɔ pi hu.
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, yitsɛmɛ nɛ a hi si kaa nɔ́ nɛ yo be a dɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ya foe ɔ, a pee kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ yi kɔmɔ; nihi nɛ ngɛ muɔe ɔ, a pee kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ be bua jɔmi; nihi nɛ ngɛ ní hee ɔ, a pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ níhi nɛ a he ɔ pi a nɔ́; nihi nɛ a kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe ɔ, a pee a ní kaa nihi nɛ puɛ we a be ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Ejakaa je ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e se be kɛe.
I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ hi si nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kó hao nyɛ.
Nyumu nɛ be yo ɔ ngɔɔ e he ngɔ woɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ mi, nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e maa pee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo ɔ lɛɛ e haoɔ e he ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a he, ejakaa e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e maa sa e yo ɔ hɛ mi.
Ke e ba mi jã a, e juɛmi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ.
Yo nɛ be huno, aloo yiheyo kɛ e he haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi, ejakaa e suɔ kaa e ngɔ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ e mumi tsuo ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Yogbayo lɛɛ e haoɔ e he ngɛ je ɔ mi níhi a he, ejakaa e suɔ kaa e sa e huno hɛ mi.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpakpa he nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, se pi kaa i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma tsi nyɛ nya ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ.
Niinɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya.
I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he tsuo ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛ ko ya se.
Nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ nyumu, kɛ e yo nɛ e bi si, se e ngɔɛ lɛ lolo ɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke nyumu ɔ na kaa e pee we yo ɔ saminya, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e nyɛ we e he nɔ nɛ e hyɛ ɔ, e ngɔ yo ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ. Yayami ko be enɛ ɔ mi.
Ee, a sɛ gba si himi mi.
Se ke nɔ ko muɔ e yi mi kpɔ ke e be yo ngɔe, nɛ pi kaa a nyɛ e nɔ ɔ, ke e nyɛ hyɛ e he nɔ saminya, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e to e yi mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee ji nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e hi kaa e ko ngɔ yo ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ yo ɔ, pee saminya.
Se nɔ nɛ be yo ngɔe ɔ, e nɔ́ ɔ hi kulaa pe nɔ kaketsɛ ɔ. Yogbayo ɔ, be abɔ nɛ e huno ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, mlaa fi lɛ.
Ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e sa kaa nyumu ɔ nɛ pee nɔ ko nɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.
Se ke e hi si bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ babauu mohu.
Bɔ nɛ ye juɛmi deɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ e peeɔ mi kaa imi hu Mawu mumi ngɛ ye mi.
Kusumi lo nɛ a kɛ ha amagahi Jehanɛ ma suɔ nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko ngɛ kusumi lo nɛ a kɛ haa amaga he.
E ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa “wɔ tsuo wa le ní,” kaa bɔ nɛ a deɔ ɔ.
Se nile haa nɔ woɔ e he nɔ, nɛ suɔmi lɛɛ e woɔ nɔ he wami.
Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e le ní ɔ, he nɛ sa kaa e su loko a tsɛ lɛ ní lelɔ ɔ, e sui lejɛ ɔ saasaa.
Se nɔmlɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, Mawu le lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko ngɛ kusumi lo nɛ a kɛ haa amaga a yemi he.
Wa le kaa amaga daa si ha nɔ́ ko nɛ be je nɛ ɔ mi.
Wa le hu kaa mawu kpa ko be ngɛ anɔkuale Mawu kake ɔ se.
Ni komɛ deɔ ke ní komɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ “mawuhi.” Yoo, ke “mawu” nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ “nyɔmtsɛmɛ” nɛ ɔmɛ pɔ he tete po, kɛ̃ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu kake too nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ, lɛ pɛ wa ngɛ.
Lɛ nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ wa ngɛ wami mi.
Wa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kake hulɔ; lɛ ji Yesu Kristo.
E nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ wa ngɛ wami mi.
Se pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le anɔkuale nɛ ɔ. Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, ni komɛ susuɔ kaa amagahi ngɛ wami mi; a susuɔ kaa ke a ha amagahi ní ɔ, mawuhi nɛ a ha ní ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ke a ye kikɛmɛ a ní ɔ, a he nile haoɔ mɛ, ejakaa a susuɔ kaa niye ní ɔ ma ble mɛ.
Ngma kɛkɛ be hae nɛ waa hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu he haa pe bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ. Ke wa yi ɔ, wa laa we nɔ́ ko; ke wa ye hu, wa na we he se tsɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ hia kɛkɛ ji kaa nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ he blɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ye ní ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee jã a, nyɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ mɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ maa pee yayami.
Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e he nile deɔ lɛ ke e sɛ kaa a yeɔ ní ngɛ amaga jami he ɔ na mo “ní lelɔ” nɛ o ngɛ ní yee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Anɛ enɛ ɔ be lɛ he wami woe nɛ lɛ hu e ya ye ní nɛ a kɛ ha amagahi lo?
Kɛkɛ ɔ, o “nile” ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ ji o nyɛmi nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ lɛ hu e he ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Ke o pee o nyɛmi yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Kristo nɛ o pee yayami kɛ si ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa mo lɛ o wo o nyɛmi ɔ he wami nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ e le kaa e sɛ nɛ e peeɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ngma ma ha ye nyɛmi nane ma kpata a, i be lo yee hu gblegbleegble, konɛ ma ko ha nɛ ye nyɛmi ɔ nɛ pee yayami.
Bɔfo blɔ nya, kɛ e ní tsumi Anɛ i be ye dɛ he lo?
Anɛ pi bɔfo ji mi lo?
Anɛ i nɛ Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo?
Nɛ nyɛ nɛɛ?
Ní nɛ i tsu ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, anɛ pi nyɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba lo?
Ke ni kpahi bui kaa bɔfo ji mi ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he mi kaa bɔfo; ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, nyɛ ji okadi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ji mi.
Ke nihi de níhi ngɛ ye he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ faa ye he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa naa niye ní kɛ jeɔ nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ ní nɛ wa ngɛ tsue ɔ he lo?
Ke wa yaa he ko ɔ, anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa yihi nɛ le Kristo ɔ, waa kɛ mɛ nyɛɛɔ kaa bɔ nɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Petro peeɔ ɔ lo?
Aloo i kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ nɛ e sa kaa wa tsu ní loko waa ye ní?
Ta bulɔ te nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e woɔ e he hiɔ nɛɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ peeɔ wai ngmɔ, nɛ e yi e mi yiblii ɔ eko?
Mɛnɔ nɛ lɛɛ to, nɛ e nui to nyɔ nyu ɔ eko?
Pi níhi nɛ a naa ngɛ adesa wami si himi mi daa ligbi kɛkɛ a he munyu nɛ i ngɛ tue.
Nyɛ maa na nɔ́ nɛ i de nɛ ɔ nɔuu ngɛ Mawu mlaa womi ɔ mi.
A ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi ke, “Na nɛ ngɛ blɛfo gblɛe ɔ, koo fi e nya.” Mawu ɔ, anɛ nahi a he nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ dɔe?
Munyu nɛ e tu ɔ, anɛ pi wɔ tutuutu wa he nɛ e kɔɔ lo?
Nihi nɛ gbaa ní, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kpaa ní ɔ, e sa kaa a tsu ní kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa mɛ hu a maa ye niba ní ɔ eko.
Ke wa ba du mumi mi níhi ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ɔ, anɛ e ji nɔ́ ko nɛ he wa tsɔ kaa wɔ hu wa na he lo ɔ hiami níhi kɛ je nyɛ dɛ lo?
Ke ni kpahi ngɛ he blɔ kaa a hyɛɔ níhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ blɔ kɛ jeɔ nyɛ dɛ ɔ, anɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be he blɔ kulaa pe mɛ lo?
Se waa kɛ he blɔ nɛ ɔ tsu we ní.
Mohu ɔ, wa to wa tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, konɛ wa ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ maa tsi Kristo he sane kpakpa a fiɛmi ɔ nya.
I heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, sɔlemi we ɔ a naa a nya mi ngma kɛ jeɔ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu níhi nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ eko a yeɔ.
Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo mlaa ke, nihi nɛ fiɛɔ sane kpakpa a, a na a nya mi ngma kɛ je munyu ɔ fiɛmi mi.
He blɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mohu, se imi lɛɛ i bi we nyɛ nɔ́ ko hyɛ.
Womi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ hu, pi ye juɛmi ji kaa ma kɛ kai nyɛ kaa jehanɛ e sa kaa nyɛ bɔni mi nɔ́ hami.
Afani nɛ ma gbo mohu, pe nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɛ ma da kɛ fĩa a ba bɔ mi!
Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ ha we mi he blɔ kaa ma fĩa, ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ nɛ fa mi ke ma pee jã.
Kaa i fiɛ we sane kpakpa a, jinɛ musu tloo mi pɛ!
Ní nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, imi nitsɛ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma tsu jinɛ i ko hyɛ hiɔwo blɔ.
Se Mawu nitsɛ nɛ hla mi, nɛ e ngɔ ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo ye dɛ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale.
Lɛɛ mɛni hiɔwo sa mi mɔ?
Hiɔwo ɔ kɛkɛ ji he blɔ nɛ i na kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a yaka nɛ i he we nɔ́ ko.
Jehanɛ hu, he blɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa ma hyɛ nɔ́ ko blɔ kɛ je nyɛ dɛ mi ngɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ tsu we ní.
I ngɛ ye dɛ he; pi nɔ ko nyɔguɛ ji mi.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i pee ye he nihi tsuo a nyɔguɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su nihi babauu a nɔ.
I peeɔ ye ní kaa Yuda no ngɛ Yuda bi a kpɛti, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su a nɔ.
Ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ a kpɛti ɔ, i peeɔ ye ní kaa nɔ nɛ sa kaa lɛ hu e yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su a nɔ.
Jã kɛ̃ ngɛ ma je li a kpɛti ɔ, i peeɔ ye ní kaa ma je no, nɛ i yi Yuda mlaa a nɔ.
I peeɔ enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Se enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa i kɛ Mawu mlaa a be nɔ́ ko peemi.
Dɛbi!
Kristo mlaa a nɔ i yeɔ.
Ngɛ nihi nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi gbɔjɔ a kpɛti ɔ, i peeɔ ye ní kaa nɔ nɛ lɛ hu e hemi kɛ yemi gbɔjɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su a nɔ.
Ee, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ ɔ, imi hu i peeɔ ye he kaa lɛ.
I peeɔ enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma gu blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ kɛ he nihi a yi wami.
I peeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ ma kɛ ha nɛ Yesu he sane kpakpa a nɛ gbɛ fĩa.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní kpakpahi nɛ maa je sɛ gbi ɔ mi kɛ ba a, imi hu ma na eko.
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nihi babauu tu fo ɔ, nɔ kake too lɛ naa ayekoo ní ɔ lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ tu fo ɔ jã nɔuu, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ nine nɛ su ayekoo ní ɔ nɔ.
Nihi nɛ kaa a kpɔhi a mi ɔ, a hɛ mi kaa si be tsuaa be, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ná jlasi nɛ puɛɔ.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa peeɔ jã, konɛ wa nine nɛ su jlasi nɛ puɛ we gblegbleegble ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fo nɛ i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ tue tɛɛ kɛ yaa nyagbe; kunɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɔe ɔ, i nɔɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ gbee.
Se mohu ɔ, i waa ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi mi, nɛ i haa nɛ e peeɔ ye suɔmi nya ní.
I peeɔ jã, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke i fiɛ ha ni kpahi se ɔ, imi nitsɛ lɛɛ Mawu ko sake mi ngɔ fɔ he.
Amagahi a he kɔkɔ bɔmi Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ kaa ma kai nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ Mose se ɔ a nɔ.
Mɛ tsuo a hi bɔku ɔ sisi, nɛ mɛ tsuo a po Wo Tsu ɔ. Benɛ a ngɛ bɔku ɔ sisi, kɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ, a sɔle mɛ kaa Mose se nyɛɛli.
Mɛ tsuo a ye mumi mi ní kake, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu mumi mi nyu kake ɔ nɛ je mumi mi tɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ a se ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a tɛ sa a ji Kristo.
Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Mawu na we a ti nihi fuu a he tsui.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi kaa okadihi nɛ a to wɔ, konɛ wa ko ha yayami nɛ pee wɔ akɔnɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee mɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko ja amaga kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Ma a pue si, nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu ní, nɛ a fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmihi.” Wa ko fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ gbo ligbi kake ɔ. Wa ko ka Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ sinɔ kpata a hɛ mi ɔ. Wa ko tu munyu huitihuiti kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ bɔfo nɔ́ puɛlɔ ɔ kpata a hɛ mi ɔ. Níhi nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ peeɔ okadi kɛ ha ni kpahi.
A ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ wɔ kɔkɔ bɔe, ejakaa be nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ kɛ nyagbe be ɔ kɛ we kulaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ susuɔ kaa e daa si ɔ, e hyɛ e he nɛ hi, konɛ e ko nɔ si.
Kahi nɛ baa nyɛ nɔ ɔ, ekoeko be nɛ bɛ adesa nɔ hyɛ.
Se Mawu yeɔ e siwo nɔ, nɛ e be hae nɛ a ka nyɛ pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ.
Ke ka ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ kɛ da nya, konɛ nyɛɛ je mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye huɛmɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ yu nyɛ he kɛ je amaga jami he kulaa.
I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kaa a kɛ juɛmitsɛmɛ tuɔ munyu; nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kɔ se.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ niye ní kplu ɔ nɛ wa naa Mawu si ngɛ he ɔ, anɛ e ha we nɛ wɔ tsuo wa naa gbaami nɛ jeɔ Kristo muɔ mi ɔ eko lo?
Jã kɛ̃ ke wa ku abolo ɔ nɛɛ, anɛ wɔ tsuo wa na we gbaami nɛ jeɔ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi ɔ eko lo?
Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ wa hiɛmi ngɛ ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa yeɔ abolo kake ɔ eko.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi ji wɔ tsuo.
Yuda bi a kusumi, kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ko tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, guu enɛ ɔ peemi mi nɛ a kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ naa huɛ bɔmi.
Lɛɛ kɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ?
Kaa amaga, loo niye ní nɛ a haa amaga a he hia lo?
Dɛbi!
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji, bɔ nɛ wɔ jali sãã a, mumi yayamihi a sãã ngɔ haa, se pi Mawu.
Nɛ i sume kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mumi yayamihi nɛ bɔ huɛ.
