I na nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kasa nya amlɔ nɛ ɔ, jinɛ i kɛ nyɛ ko tu munyu bɔ nɛ sa, ejakaa i ngɛ haoe wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ he.
Hagar kɛ Sara kaa nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa mlaa a nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ ko.
Nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a deɔ ɔ be mi lo?
A ngma ke Abraham ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ; e kɛ yo nyɔguɛ fɔ nɔ kake, nɛ nɔ enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ yo odehe ɔ nɛ fɔ lɛ.
Bi nɛ e kɛ yo nyɔguɛ ɔ fɔ ɔ, a fɔ lɛ kɛkɛ; se bi nɛ yo odehe ɔ fɔ ɔ, Mawu wo e he si.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ a nane mi.
Yi enyɔ ɔmɛ daa si ha somi enyɔ.
A kpɛti nɔ kake ji Hagar.
E je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ; nɛ bimɛ nɛ e fɔ ɔ, nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ.
Hagar ngɛ kaa Sinai yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Arabia a. Lɔ ɔ ji Yerusalem ma nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Se Yerusalem kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ lɛɛ a kɛ lɛ to hiɔwe he ɔ, lɛɛ e ji odehe.
Lɛ ji wɔ tsuo wa nyɛ.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ de ke, “Mo yosa nɛ o fɔ we, mo nya!
Mo nɛ o nui kɔɔmi hyɛ, hwɔ lele, nɛ o nya!
Ejakaa yo nɛ e huno kua lɛ ɔ mohu e bimɛ hiɛ pe yogbayo nɛ ngɛ gba we daa a bimɛ.” Jehanɛ, ye nyɛmimɛ, wɔ lɛ a wo si kaa wa ma ba pee Mawu bimɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a wo si loko a fɔ Isak ɔ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ kaa a fɔɔ adesa kɛkɛ ɔ wa nɔ nɛ a wo e he si loko a fɔ lɛ ɔ yi mi.
Ja nɔuu e ngɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Se kɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ kɛɛ?
E deɔ ke, “Wo yo nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ blɔ nɛ a ho, ejakaa yo nyɔguɛ ɔ bi ɔ be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ yo odehe ɔ bi ɔ yeɔ gbosi ní.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, pi yo nyɔguɛ ɔ bimɛ ji wɔ; odehe mohu ɔ bimɛ ji wi.
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ ní kaa nihi nɛ ye a he niinɛ Wa ye wa he.
Ee, Kristo ha wa ye wa he.
Nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii, konɛ nɔ ko kó ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Paulo, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ha a po nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo he be se nami ko kulaa kɛ ha nyɛ.
I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ nu sisi saminya kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ha nɛ a po lɛ ɔ, e hia doo kaa e ye mlaa a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ hu nɔ.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛ maa ye mlaa a nɔ, konɛ a dla nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, pe nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ je Kristo he ɔ nɛ.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ kua Mawu dloomi ɔ. Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hemi kɛ yemi ji Mawu ma dla waa kɛ lɛ wa kpɛti.
Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ wa mi ɔ lɛ ha wa ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, a po lɛ jio, a pui lɛ jio, lɔ ɔ tsu we nɔ́ ko.
Nɔ́ nɛ he hia wawɛɛ mohu ji hemi kɛ yemi nɛ jeɔ kpo ngɛ suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ ha wa nyɛmimɛ ɔ mi ɔ. Jinɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he mɔde bɔe saminya.
Se mɛnɔ po lɛ ba puɛ nyɛ tue nɛ nyɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi hu ɔ?
Kikɛmɛ a yi mi tsakemi ɔ, Mawu, nɔ nɛ hla nyɛ ɔ, pi lɛ nɛ pee.
“Masa bɔbɔyoo pɛ lɛ haa ma a tsuo fuɔ.” Se imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ.
I le kaa nyɛ be nɔ kpa ko munyu nue.
Nɔ tutuutu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe ɔ, Mawu maa gbla e tue kokooko!
Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke i ngɛ fiɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ke e hia nɛ a po nɔ doo ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kpamisa mɔ?
Ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ he sane ɔ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, e sɛ́ kaa e haoɔ nɔ ko.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i na nɛ a puɛ mɛ, loo a ta mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he kɛkɛ nɛ e jɔ!
Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pe a hla nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ ba ye nyɛ he.
Nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ ye nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ lɛ kaa blɔ nya nɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee níhi nɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ nyɛmimɛ a sɔmɔmi mi.
Ejakaa mlaa a tsuo nɔ yemi ɔ kpiti pomi ji, “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.” Se ke nyɛ pee nyɛ he lohwe dikali nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ́ yeyee pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Mawu mumi ɔ kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa su I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛ ha nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi ha, konɛ nyɛ ko tsu nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔmi nya ní.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ nɛ mumi ɔ suɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ suɔ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ.
Nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he yi.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ be nyɛe maa pee nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ suɔmi nya ní.
Se ke mumi ɔ lɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mlaa a yi nyɛ nɔ hu.
Ke nɔ ko peeɔ he lo ɔ nya ní ɔ, níhi nɛ jeɔ mi kɛ baa ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: gba puɛmi, mu ní tsumi, yahomi, amaga jami, kunya tsumi, ninyɛ, pɛ hlami, hunga jemi, mi mi la womi, pɛ, mi gbami, nya hiɔmi, hɛkɔ, dã demi, fiɛmi yaya, kɛ ní yaya peemi kpahi fuu kaa níhi nɛ i tsi a ta nɛ ɔ. I ka nyɛ hɛ mi momo ngɛ kikɛmɛ a je mi bami nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ekohu ke nihi nɛ peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue gblegbleegble.
Se Mawu mumi ɔ yiblii ji suɔmi, bua jɔmi, he jɔmi, tsui si tomi, mi mi himi, kpakpa peemi, hemi kɛ yemi, he si bami, kɛ he nɔ yemi.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mlaa ko mlaa ko tsi nya.
Nihi nɛ ji Kristo Yesu we bi ɔ, akɔnɔ, kɛ he lo nya níhi nɛ a suɔ ɔ, a ngmɛɛ he kulaa kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a sɛu ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ.
Ke mumi ɔ lɛ haa wɔ wami ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ hulɔ.
Wa ko wó wa he nɔ; wa ko wo wa sibi a mi mi la, nɛ wa hɛ ko kɔ wa sibi a nɔ hulɔ.
Nyɛɛ ye bua nyɛ sibi ngɛ fimi mi Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko tɔ ɔ, nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba blɔ dadɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si blɛuu kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ko ya sɛ jamɛ a ka a eko mi.
Nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ sibi kɛ tloo nyɛ tlomi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ. Ke e peeɔ nɔ ko kaa nɔ ko ji lɛ, se pohu pi nɔ ko kulaa ji lɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he nɛ e ngɛ sisie.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní peepee.
Ke e hi ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ e be hiae kaa e maa ngɔ e he ngɔ to nɔ kpa he; ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa tloo lɛ nitsɛ e tlomi.
Nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, kɛ e tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ dla ní kpakpahi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he.
Mawu ɔ, a yi e he fɛu.
Nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ du ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu e ma kpa.
Ke nɔ ko ya tsu ní ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e ma kpa nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Jã kɛ̃ ke nɔ ko tsu ní ngɛ Mawu mumi ɔ nya, Mawu mumi ɔ ma ha e na neneene wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ko ha nɛ kpakpa peemi nɛ gbe wa nya; ejakaa ke wa kɔni mi wui nyu ɔ, ní kpami be ɔ, wa ma na he se.
Lɛɛ ke e maa hi ɔ, waa pee nihi tsuo kpakpa daa, titli ɔ, nihi nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ. Nyagbe kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ sɛ yemi Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye nine ngma ní agboagbo kɛ mane nyɛ!
Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa nyɛ nyɛ nɔ kaa ja a po nyɛ doo ɔ, nihi a hɛ mi kɛkɛ lɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a sa.
Ejakaa a le kaa ke a de ke loko a ma he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ, ja nɔ ɔ na amanehlu kaa Kristo ɔ, nihi maa wa mɛ yi mi.
Nihi nɛ a kusumi ji kaa a po mɛ ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ po a yi mlaa a nɔ.
A ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ nɛ a fĩa kaa mɛ lɛ a pee lɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ nɛ a po nyɛ.
Se imi lɛɛ i be fĩae ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ kaa ja wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ pɛ.
Gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a sɛu je ɔ kɛ ha mi, nɛ a sɛu imi hu kɛ ha je ɔ.
A po nɔ ko jio, a pui nɔ ko jio, e he hia we kulaa.
Nɔ́ nɛ he hia kɛkɛ ji kaa nɔ ko ma tsake kɛ pee bɔ nɔ he.
Nihi tsuo nɛ maa ba a je mi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Mawu nɛ na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ he jɔmi.
Ee, Mawu nɛ pee enɛ ɔ ha mɛ kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma, Israel ɔ tsuo.
Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nɔ ko kó doo ye nya hu.
Yesu nɔ́ nami okadihi ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
Amen.
NYA TSƆƆMI Womi nɛ Paulo ngma ya ha Efeso asafo ɔ, kekleekle nɔ́ he nɛ e kɔɔ ji, “Yi mi nɛ Mawu to kaa e ma ha nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo maa pee kake, níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ; nɛ Kristo maa ye matsɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ” ɔ .
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, kɛ gu womi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Paulo ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo pɛɛ kpae, konɛ a ngɔ a he ngɔ mɛtɛ Kristo he, nɛ a ba a je mi saminya.
Ke a pee ja a, yi mi nguaa nɛ Mawu to kaa e ma ha nɛ adesahi tsuo maa pee kake ɔ maa je kpo paa nɛ nihi maa na.
Paulo tsɔɔ kake peemi nɛ ɔ nya saminya ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ kekleekle fa a mi.
E tsɔɔ kaa nɛ Tsɛ Mawu hla e ma a, e ngɔ a he yayami ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ kɛ gu e Bi Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e ha a ye a he.
Mawu ha nɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba, nɛ e kɛ to okadi kaa si ko nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ wo ɔ, ja e ba mi.
Ngɛ womi ɔ fa enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, Paulo ngɛ asafo mi bi ɔmɛ ga woe kaa a ba a je mi saminya, konɛ nihi nɛ na niinɛ kaa kake peemi ngɛ a kɛ Kristo a kpɛti.
Kake peemi nɛ ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kɛ gu a kɛ Kristo a kake peemi mi ɔ, Pualo tsɔɔ nya ngɛ blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ.
E ke asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ tso, nɛ e yi ji Kristo.
Enyɔne ji, asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa tsu, nɛ e kɔ nya tɛ ji Kristo.
Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo de ke asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa yogbayo, nɛ e huno ji Kristo.
Mawu gu Kristo nɔ kɛ dloo wɔ babauu.
Enɛ ɔ he susumi ha nɛ Paulo kɛ hɛdɔ ngma womi nɛ ɔ nɛ ke o kane ɔ, ja o he mi po.
Ke wa le suɔmi agbo nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ sisi numi be wae ha wɔ.
Kristo ngɔ e he ngɔ sã bɔ, e kɛ wa he yayami pa wɔ, e dloo wɔ, nɛ e he tsɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Kristo kɛ asafo ɔ .—.
Wami he nɛ wa naa ngɛ waa kɛ Kristo wa kake peemi mi .—.
Nyagbe .-
Imi Paulo, nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ɔ, imi lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Efeso, nihi nɛ kɛ je be nɛ a ba le Kristo Yesu ɔ, a ngmɛɛ we a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he kulaa a. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Kristo haa wɔ mumi mi ní kpakpahi Sina ha Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Mawu ɔ, kɛ e Tsɛ ɔ!
Ejakaa nɛ wa ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, Mawu dloo wɔ mumi mi ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. Benɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ je ɔ tete po ɔ, Mawu hla wɔ ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nihi momo ngɛ Kristo mi.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ wa he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ piami ko kó hi wa he ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Mawu suɔ wɔ saminya, enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e pee e yi mi momo kaa kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e maa ngɔ wɔ kɛ pee e bimɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ e to nɛ e maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E sa kaa wa je Mawu yi kaa e gu e dloomi nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɔ ngɔ e bi nɛ e suɔ ɔ ngɔ ke wɔ yaka gu!
Ejakaa Kristo ngɔ e he ngɔ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ e muɔ kpɔ wɔ, nɛ e dloomi babauu ɔ nya a, a e ngɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ.
Niinɛ, e ha wɔ kɛ be nɔ po!
Mawu ngɔ e nile, kɛ e juɛmi kɛ pee níhi tsuo nɛ e to kaa e maa pee ɔ. Laami nɔ́ ko nɛ e to e yi mi momo ke e maa pee kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e je tsɔɔ wɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to nɛ e maa pee ke be ɔ su ɔ ji kaa e ma ha nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo maa pee kake, níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nɛ Kristo maa ye matsɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa e maa pee, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e to kaa e ba mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.
Mawu hla wɔ, konɛ wa ba pee lɛ nitsɛ e nihi, nɛ́ waa kɛ Kristo nɛ pee kake.
Mawu suɔmi nya ní, kɛ yi mi nɛ e to kɛ je sisije tɔɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nɛ wa ji kekleekle nihi nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Kristo nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi kaa e hɛ mi ngɛ nyami.
Nyɛ hu, benɛ nyɛ nu anɔkuale sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ ji sane kpakpa a nɛ ma ha nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami ɔ, nyɛ he Kristo ye, nɛ Mawu ha nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ e wo he si ɔ ba nyɛ nɔ.
Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kadi nyɛ kaa e nihi ji nyɛ niinɛ.
Si nɛ Mawu wo e ni ɔmɛ ɔ, mumi ɔ e kɛ ma nɔ mi kaa wa nine maa su nɔ.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ woɔ wɔ he wami kaa Mawu ma ha e we bi maa ye a he kulaa.
Nyɛ ha wa je e yi kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Paulo kpa Mawu pɛɛ Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, kɛ je benɛ i nu kaa nyɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo yeɔ saminya, nɛ Mawu we bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ suɔ mɛ ja nɔuu ɔ, i kpa we Mawu si nami ha nyɛ.
Ke i ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i kaiɔ nyɛ, nɛ i kpaa pɛɛ kaa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa Tsɛ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Mumi ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa le bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ anɔkuale mi, nɛ e ma je Mawu kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ saminya.
I kpaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ e bli nyɛ mumi mi hɛngmɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ Mawu wo si kaa e ma ha nyɛ benɛ e tsɛ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa na.
Nyɛ maa le hu kaa níhi nɛ Mawu wo si kaa e ma ha e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami babauu.
Jehanɛ ɔ hu nyɛ ma yɔse kaa Mawu he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ ɔ wa mi ɔ, jamɛ a he wami ɔ nɔuu nɛ Mawu kɛ tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ hi e hiɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ.
Lejɛ ɔ Kristo ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ pã nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ hiɔwe a he wami.
Biɛ nɛ Kristo hɛɛ ɔ hu pã biɛhi tsuo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ, kɛ je nɛ maa ba a tsuo mi.
Mawu ha Kristo he wami ngɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee tsɛ ha asafo ɔ, konɛ e ye níhi tsuo a nɔ.
Asafo ɔ ji Kristo nɔmlɔ tso nɛ haa níhi tsuo a he suu.
Kristo haa níhi tsuo a he suu ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Kɛ je gbenɔ mi kɛ ba wami mi Sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, ejakaa nyɛ gbo Mawu tue, nɛ nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si lɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ je nɛ ɔ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ peeɔ.
Nyɛ ya nyɛɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ mumi yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi ɔ se.
Nihi nɛ gboɔ Mawu tue ɔ, mumi nɛ ɔ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ a mi amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Niinɛ, sa a, wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa ngɛ kaa mɛ; nɛ akɔnɔ yaya nɛ ngɛ wa mi ɔ jeɔ kpo ngɛ wa ní peemi níhi a mi.
Níhi nɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ wa juɛmi suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ wa peeɔ.
Akɛnɛ adesa kɛkɛ ji wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ ɔ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa Mawu maa gbla wa tue.
Mawu mi mi fu wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e mi mi fu adesahi tsuo ɔ, ejakaa wa pee yayami kɛ si lɛ.
Se Mawu lɛɛ e mɔbɔ nami ɔ hiɛ babauu; jã kɛ̃ nɛ suɔmi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ hu kle.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ wa gbo tue, nɛ wa pee kaa nihi nɛ gbo ɔ, e ha wa ba wami mi ekohu benɛ e tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje ɔ. Dloomi nya nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.
Mawu tle waa kɛ Kristo si, konɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ejakaa wa ngɛ e mi.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔhi tsuo nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ kaa Kristo Yesu he ɔ, e suɔ wɔ saminya, nɛ e dloo wɔ babauu.
-Mawu dloomi nya nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami akɛnɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ. Pi dengme ko nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ gbo he je; e ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke nyɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ko fĩa.
Mawu nitsɛ lɛ pee wɔ bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ. E ha waa kɛ Kristo Yesu ba nu huɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ngɔ wa wami be ɔ tsuo kɛ pee nihi kpakpa.
E to blɔ nya nɛ ɔ blema lokoo konɛ waa nyɛɛ ngɛ nya.
Waa kɛ Kristo pee kake Ma je li, pi Yuda fɔfɔɛ ji nyɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ deɔ ke mɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu nitsɛ e nihi ji mɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a tsɛɔ nyɛ ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ.
A tsɛɔ nyɛ jã, ejakaa a po mɛ; se lɔ ɔ po nɔ́ ko kɛkɛ nɛ adesa pee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sa be ko ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ li Kristo.
Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, nyɛ be a kpɛti; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nibwɔhi ji nyɛ.
Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ e ni ɔmɛ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo mɛ ɔ, nyɛ piɛ we he.
Nyɛ hi si ngɛ je ɔ mi kɛkɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ hɛ fɔ we nɔ́ ko nɔ; Mawu nitsɛ tete nyɛ li lɛ.
Sa a, nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti kɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Se jehanɛ ɔ nɛ kɛ gu Kristo muɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ba ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, a kpale nyɛ kɛ ba Mawu kasa nya haa.
Gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo, nɛ e ngɔ e he ngɔ sã bɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛ tsu enɛ ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo nitsɛ ba pee Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li kake, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ he jɔmi ba.
Ninyɛ nɛ pee kaa gbogbo ngɛ Yuda bi kɛ ma je li a kpɛti ɔ, Kristo ha nɛ jamɛ a ninyɛ ɔ se po gbidigbidi.
Kristo gbo nɛ e kɛ po Yuda bi a mlaa a, kɛ a kɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e pee Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ kake ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi; nɛ enɛ ɔ kɛ he jɔmi ba.
Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ e kɛ dla ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake; nɛ e ha niyɛ nɛ ngɛ a kɛti ɔ se po ninyɛ nɛ ngɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ se po.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kristo ba nɛ e ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ haa nɔ he jɔmi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi tsuo.
E fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ma je li nɛ sa a nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu kpɛti kɛ ɔ, kɛ Yuda bi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ e kasa nya haa a. Yuda bi jio, ma je li jio, Kristo nɔ lɛ wɔ tsuo wa maa gu kɛ ba Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ maa piɛ wa he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ma je li, jehanɛ ɔ nyɛ pi nibwɔhi, loo ma se bi hu, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo peeɔ ma mi bi, kɛ Mawu we bi.
Sisi tomi nɛ a fia nyɛ ngɔ ma nɔ ji sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ fiɛ ɔ; nɛ Kristo Yesu nitsɛ ngɛ kaa tsu ɔ kɔ nya tɛ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ha nɛ tsu ɔ he ní slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo nu a he kɛ da si kpɛkpɛtɛɛ.
Lɛ nɛ e haa tsu ɔ waa, nɛ e ba peeɔ sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu nɛ a hla ngɔ to ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nyɛ hu mumi ɔ ngɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ tsuo ngɔ mɛtɛ Kristo he, nɛ nyɛ ba pee Mawu sihi he.
Ní nɛ Paulo tsu ha ma je li ɔmɛ Mawu pee Yuda bi, kɛ nyɛ ma je li tsuo kake.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a wo imi Paulo tsu ngɛ Kristo Yesu, kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he.
I heɔ yeɔ kaa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma je li ɔmɛ nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛ maa nu he.
Yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɛ laami mi ɔ, e je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi.
I ngma enɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko bɔɔ momo.
Ke nyɛ kane nɔ́ nɛ i ngma a saminya a, yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɛ laami mi, nɛ Kristo ha nɛ e ba mi ɔ, nyɛ maa na bɔ nɛ i nu sisi ha.
Yi nɔhi nɛ be ɔ, adesa li laami sane nɛ ɔ.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɔ je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ e bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ.
Laami sane ɔ ji kaa sane kpakpa a he ɔ, gbaami nɛ Mawu gbaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ hu ba na eko.
Mɛ tsuo a ba pee kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ he níhi; nɛ si nɛ Mawu wo kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ, a ná mɛ hu a blɔ nya nɔ.
Mawu dloo mi nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko kaa sane kpakpa a fiɛlɔ, nɛ ma kɛ sɔmɔ lɛ.
E he wami ɔ nɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Jinɛ i pi nɔ ko kulaa ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Se Mawu ha mi dloomi nɛ ɔ kaa ma ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a ma na ke a ba nyɛɛ Kristo se.
Mawu ke ma fiɛ, konɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu bɔ nɛ laami sane nguaa nɛ ɔ ma plɛ kɛ ba mi ha.
Mawu nɛ́ bɔ níhi tsuo ɔ, ngɔ laami sane nɛ ɔ kɛ laa yi nɔhi nɛ be ɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ yeli tsuo, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ a na bɔ nɛ Mawu juɛmi mi kuɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ asafo ɔ ngɛ ní tsue nɛ Mawu yi mi tomi ɔ nɛ ba mi.
Blema lokoo nɛ Mawu to e yi mi kaa e ma tsu nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ nɛ e ha nɛ e ba mi.
Akɛnɛ wa heɔ Kristo Yesu yeɔ, nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ he je ɔ, wa yi gbeye kaa wa maa ya Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui kaa i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ nyɛ he.
I ngɛ nɔ́ nae, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami.
Kristo suɔmi Enɛ ɔ he i kplaa si ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Ejakaa nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ haa mɛ biɛ.
I kpaa Mawu pɛɛ, konɛ kɛ gu e ní babauu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ha nɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ mumi mi he wami.
I kpaa pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ he ye, nɛ Kristo nɛ hi nyɛ tsui mi, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kɛ suɔmi nɛ mi wa.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ma yɔse suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ mi blimi, e kami, kɛ e mi kuɔmi.
Ee, nyɛ ma ba yɔse Kristo suɔmi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa juɛmi sui he ɔ, nɛ nyɛ su maa hi kaa Mawu nitsɛ su.
Mawu kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ wa mi, nɛ e peeɔ níhi nɛ hiɛ babauu kɛ be nɔ kɛ haa wɔ, níhi nɛ wa be nyɛe ma bi, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ wa juɛmi sui he po.
Á gu Kristo Yesu nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ asafo ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene.
Amen.
Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɔ́ kake ji lɛ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya, bɔ nɛ maa sa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ba tsu ɔ. Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si; nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he humi, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si.
Nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi nɛ nyɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ suɔ nyɛ he niinɛ.
Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee kake kɛ hi si.
He jɔmi ɔ nɛ haa nyɛ peeɔ kake ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ haa.
Nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ mumi kake lɛ ngɛ.
Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nɔ́ kake too nɔ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ kake, hemi kɛ yemi kake, kɛ nɔ sɔlemi kake lɛ ngɛ.
Mawu kake lɛ ngɛ; lɛ ji adesahi tsuo a tsɛ.
E tsuɔ ní kɛ guu adesahi tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ adesahi tsuo a mi.
A ha wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ dloomi nike ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo dla ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ. Ngmami ɔ ke, “Benɛ e yaa hiɔwe lokoo ɔ, e ngɔ nihi nɛ e nuu nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ ho; e ha nimli adesahi nike níhi.” Munyu nɛ ɔ sisi ji, loko e ho hiɔwe ya a, e ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ya su zugba a sisi tɔɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ba zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, konɛ a na lɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Lɛ nɔuu nɛ a de ngɛ e he ke, “E ha nimli adesahi nike ní” ɔ nɛ.
E pee ni komɛ bɔfohi, ni komɛ gbali, ni komɛ sane kpakpa fiɛli, ni komɛ osɔfohi, kɛ ni komɛ hu tsɔɔli.
E pee enɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ dla ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ ngɔ ha sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ ya nɔ.
Wɔ tsuo wa ma ba hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ mi, nɛ wa maa le Mawu Bi ɔ saminya.
Wa maa wa ngɛ mumi mi hluu kɛ yaa si wa maa pee kaa Kristo ɔ nitsɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, wa be si hie hu kaa jokuɛwi nɛ heɔ tsɔɔmi yeɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ mimiɛɔ nɔ́ kɛ yaa kɛ baa, konɛ nihi nɛ toɔ ga yaya, nɛ a yeɔ kutupɔ kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ a nine ko su wa nɔ.
Mohu ɔ, e hia kaa waa kɛ anɔkuale yemi nɛ suɔ wa sibi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, wa maa wa ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ wa maa hi kaa Kristo nɛ lɛ ji asafo ɔ yi ɔ. E ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ he wami, nɛ e haa nɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya amɛ tsuo tsaa a sibi a nya.
Nɛ ke he ní ɔmɛ tsuo tsu a blɔ nya ní tsumi pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo waa, nɛ e yiɔ tɔ kɛ suɔmi ní tsumi.
Wami he nɛ Kristo haa wɔ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ke, nyɛ ko ba nyɛ je mi kaa ma je li ɔmɛ hu.
Ejakaa níhi nɛ a susuu ɔ, pi kaa a he be se nami kɛkɛ, se sisi numi be he.
Wami he ɔ nɛ Mawu haa nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a blɔ nya be mi; ejakaa a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, nɛ a tsui hu kplii.
A zo tɔ ywia!
Yahomi he mɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ a hɛ tsuɔ kɛ tsuɔ mu níhi babauu nɛ he peeɔ tai.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ kase ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, pi jã kulaa!
Niinɛ, nyɛ nu Kristo he, nɛ nyɛ ba pee e se nyɛɛli; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ e he ɔ, a tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ba nyɛ je mi saa ngɛ nɔmlɔ su momo ɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ yayahi nɛ puɛɔ nɔ a se ɔ, nyɛ kpa!
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ susuu nyɛ yi mi, kɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ guu kɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, é pee nɔ́ he kulaa.
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa ni hehi nɛ a bɔ mɛ ehe ngɛ Mawu subai nɔ; konɛ a na nyɛ kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ nyɛ he hu tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa lakpa yemi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tu e nyɛmi anɔkuale sisiisi.
Ejakaa wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa ngɛ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní munomunohi.
Ke e ba mi kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko mi mi fu e nyɛmi ɔ, e ko ngmɛ blɔ nɛ lɔ ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e pee yayami.
E bɔ mɔde nɛ e tsui he nɛ jɔ loko pu nɛ nɔ si.
Nyɛ ko ha Abosiami blɔ nɛ e ba sɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Nɔ nɛ juɔ ɔ, e ko ju hu.
Se mohu e ngɔ e nguɛ nyɔngma kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ konɛ e ná nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ye bua nihi nɛ e fi mɛ.
Munyu nɛ maa je nyɛ ti nɔ ko nya a, e ko pee nɔ́ nɛ ma puɛ nɔ, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɛ e he hia, nɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko maa je mi kɛ wo nɔ he wami.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee dloomi kɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tue bue ɔ. Nyɛ ko wo Mawu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi mi la.
Ejakaa mumi ɔ ngɛ kaa so ko nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ kadi nyɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa be ma nɛ Mawu ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.
Nyɛ ha nɛ mi mi doomi, hɛdɔ, mi mi la, kɛ muklii mi fumi se nɛ po ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ pɛ, kɛ nɔ jɛmi basabasa, kɛ ninyɛ tsuo he.
Niinɛ, nyɛɛ na nyɛ sibi mɔbɔ; nyɛ tsui mi nɛ sã nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi a he, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu hu ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ.
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa Yesu se nyɛɛli Akɛnɛ Mawu bimɛ nɛ e suɔ ji nyɛ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kase lɛ.
Nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ sibi ngɛ nyɛ ní peemi mi kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo suɔ wɔ nɛ e ba gbo ngɛ wa he ɔ. Ee, Kristo ngɔ e he ngɔ ha kaa nike ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ he via, nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Akɛnɛ ní klɔuklɔuhi ji nyɛ he je ɔ, e sɛ kaa a woɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, loo mu ní tsumi, loo hɛkɔ ta tete ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti.
E sɛ kaa yakayaka munyu, loo kuasiahi a munyu, loo fɛu yemi munyu nɛ sɛ́ jeɔ nyɛ nya.
Se mohu nyɛɛ na Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ɔ he.
Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, loo a tsuɔ mu ní, loo a hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃ ɔ, a be blɔ nya ngɛ he nɛ Kristo kɛ Mawu ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ.
(Ke nɔ ko kɛ hɛkɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko se die ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wɔ jami pɛ).
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ pee nyɛ kuasia; ejakaa nihi nɛ gboɔ tue, nɛ a peeɔ yayamihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi la gblaa a tue wawɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko bɔ.
Jinɛ sa a, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ diblii mi, se nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ba mɛtɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, he ɔ, nyɛ ba plɛ la.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa nihi nɛ kɛ la ngɛ nyɛɛe.
Ejakaa la kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he okadihi nɛ a naa ji kpakpa peemi, dami sane yemi, kɛ anɔkuale tumi.
Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kase Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní.
Diblii mi níhi nɛ se nami be he ɔ, nyɛ ko pee.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛ je mɛ kpo nɛ nihi nɛ a na.
(Níhi nɛ nihi peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ ngɛ zo tsɔ kaa a maa wo ta tete).
Ke a je nɔ́ ko kpo kɛ ba la nya a, a naa lɛ paa; ejakaa la lɛ haa nɛ a naa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a de ke, “Mo nɔ nɛ o ngɛ mahe hwɔe, o hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ o te si kɛ je gbeje.
Kɛkɛ Kristo ma kpɛ ha mo ɔ nɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ je mi bami nɛ hi!
Nyɛ ko hi si kaa nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, se mohu kaa ní leli.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia kaa a pee ɔ, nyɛɛ pee; ejakaa be nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ, adesa yi mi wa saminya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko je kuasia; se mohu nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛ yo níhi nɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní.
Nyɛ ko de dã, ejakaa e kɛ sakasaka peemi lɛ nyɛɛɔ.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ sɛɛ munyuhi nɛ ngɛ saku fiami, yi jemi, kɛ mumi mi la amɛ a mi ɔ a he ní.
Nyɛɛ fia saku, nɛ nyɛ la kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi tɔɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ na Tsɛ Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he.
Yigbayihi kɛ a hunomɛ Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ sibi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ yeɔ Kristo gbeye.
Nyɛ yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Ejakaa huno ɔ ngɛ e yo ɔ nɔ he wami kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ngɛ asafo ɔ nɔ he wami ɔ. Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha, nɛ e kɛ he asafo ɔ yi wami; ee, asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa Kristo nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa yigbayi nɛ a ba a he si ha a hunomɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi kaa bɔ nɛ asafo ɔ hu baa e he si ha Kristo ɔ. Nyɛ hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu suɔ asafo ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ e he ɔ. Kristo ngɔ sane kpakpa a, nɛ e kɛ tsu asafo ɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ nyu fɔɔ nɔ he ha lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ pee lɛ klɔuklɔu.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ e ngɔ asafo ɔ ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ́.
Asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ he ngɛ fɛu saminya; sé ko be e he ɔ, e hɛ mi kuã we, nɛ nɔ́ yaya kpa ko hu be e he.
Ee, asafo ɔ maa hi klɔuklɔu nɛ piami ko piami ko be e he hie.
Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, e sa kaa nyumu nɛ suɔ e yo kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Ke nyumu ko suɔ e yo ɔ, ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee he lo kake.” Anɔkuale laami munyu komɛ nɛ a he hia saminya jeɔ kpo ngɛ ngmami nɛ ɔ mi; nɛ imi lɛɛ i kɛ ngɛ Kristo kɛ asafo ɔ he toe.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ji, e sa kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e yo kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ yogbayo tsuaa yogbayo nɛ bu e huno.
Fɔli kɛ a bimɛ Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli tue kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔmɔe, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa nyɛ peemi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mawu mlaa nyɔngma amɛ ɔ, kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ siwo piɛ he ji, “Bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ, konɛ e hi ha mo, nɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi.” Fɔli, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a mi mi la; se mohu nyɛ tsɔse mɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo mɛ ga kpakpa nɛ maa sa Kristo hɛ mi.
Nyɔmtsɛmɛ kɛ a nyɔguɛhi Nyɛ nyɔguɛhi, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ha Kristo ɔ; pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sane.
Se mohu nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi tɔɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ, ejakaa Kristo nyɔguɛhi ji nyɛ.
Nyɛ tsu ní kɛ bua jɔmi kaa nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe, se pi adesa.
Nyɛ kai kaa ke mo nɔ ko o pee kpakpa a, nyɔguɛ ji mo jio, odehe ji mo jio Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa to mo nane mi ja nɔuu ekohu.
Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ hi si ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ a susuma he gbeye womi.
Nyɛ kai kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ kake lɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.
Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ mia, nɛ a kɛ mumi yayamihi nɛ hwu ta Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ nɛ waje nyɛ.
Nyɛ kpla tahwu ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ Abosiami ga tsɔmi ɔmɛ a nya nɛ nyɛɛ da.
Ejakaa pi he lo kɛ muɔ nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ.
He nyɛli nɛ waa kɛ mɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ ji nɔ yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nyahi, mumi yayami kpetekpleenyɛhi nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi diblii ɔ mi, kɛ mumihi nɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi nɛ peeɔ yi wu tso níhi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpla ta hwumi níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke ligbi yobu ɔ ba a, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa da nya, nɛ́ ke nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ to ní gbe nya a, nyɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ da si kpɛii.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ da si nɛ nyɛ ha anɔkuale nɛ miaa nyɛ kaa mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́, nɛ dami sane yemi nɛ pee kaa dama ngɛ nyɛ gugue mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ pee klaalo kɛ fiɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa a, nyɛ kɛ pee tokota nɛ nyɛɛ wo.
Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ nyɛ dɛ kaa tsɛi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ kɛ gbe nɔ yayami ɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kɛ a he la a tsuo.
Yi wami hemi nɛ pee dade pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ bu.
Nyɛɛ pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ ji mumi ɔ klaate ɔ he.
Nyɛɛ sɔle kɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ mumi ɔ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mumi ɔ tue, konɛ nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ kpa pɛɛ ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ daa.
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha imi hulɔ, konɛ be tsuaa be nɛ ma tu munyu ɔ, Mawu nɛ ha mi e sɛ gbi, nɛ e ha mi kã nɛ ma kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a mi laami sane ɔ.
Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ he nɛ, i ba pee Yesu Kristo bɔfo, pohu amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a wo mi kɔsɔkɔsɔ.
Nyɛ kpa pɛɛ konɛ ma fiɛ kɛ kã kaa bɔ nɛ sa nɛ ma tu munyu ɔ. Nyagbe sɛ yemi Wa nyɛmi Tihiko nɛ wa suɔ lɛ saminya, nɛ e yeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ anɔkuale ngɛ ní nɛ e ngɛ tsue ha lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma ba bɔ nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ ye he, konɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ yae ha.
I je blɔ ngɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe, konɛ nyɛɛ nu wa he bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ, konɛ nyɛ hu e wo nyɛ bua.
Nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ, Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ ha nɛ a hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi; a suɔ a sibi, nɛ a pɛtɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
Nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ, Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si.
NYA TSƆƆMI Asafohi nɛ Paulo to sisi ngɛ Roma nɔ yemi he nɛ ngɛ Yuropa a, Filipi asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia kpokpa a nɔ ji kekleekle nɔ́.
Paulo ngma Filipi asafo ɔ womi nɛ ɔ benɛ a wo lɛ tsu.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ni kpahi nɛ mɛ hu a ngɛ ní tsue kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ te si wo lɛ, nɛ e hao wawɛɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, lakpa tsɔɔmi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ Filipi asafo ɔ mi ɔ hu hao lɛ wawɛɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, bua jɔmi, kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ jeɔ kpo ngɛ womi ɔ mi ɔ, tsɔɔ kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Paulo ngɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ mi wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Kristo we bi nɛ ngɛ Filipi ɔ ngɔ nike ní kɛ mane Paulo be ko nɛ e fi lɛ wawɛɛ ɔ, nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa na mɛ si.
Enɛ ɔ he titli nɛ e ngma womi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
He blɔ nɛ e na kɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ɔ, e suɔ kaa e maa gu nɔ kɛ wo mɛ he wami hulɔ.
E de mɛ ke a pee kã, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ, pohu e kɛ mɛ tsuo ngɛ nɔ́ nae.
E kpa mɛ pɛɛ ke a pee a he humi kaa bɔ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ; a hɛ kó tsu kɛ di mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a hiamihi a se; nɛ a ko wo a he.
E de mɛ ke a kai kaa e ji dloomi ha mɛ kaa Mawu ha nɛ a kɛ Kristo ba pee kake ngɛ a wami be mi kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ; se tsa pi kaa Yuda bi a mlaa a nɛ kɔɔ kusumihi a he ɔ nɔ nɛ a ye ɔ he je.
Bua jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ Mawu haa nihi nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, Paulo ngma lɔ ɔmɛ hu a he sane ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli a hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ a wami si himi mi nɛ Paulo ma nɔ mi ji bua jɔmi, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi, kake peemi, kɛ hɛ mi miami.
Womi ɔ ha nɛ wa naa paa kaa Paulo suɔ Filipi asafo ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Sanehi nɛ ba Paulo nɔ .- Je mi bami nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ .—.
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito a blɔ hiami he blɔ nya tomi .- Ga womi nɛ kɔɔ he nyɛli, kɛ amanehlu he .—.
Paulo kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Filipi ɔ .- Nyagbe .-
Imi Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Kristo Yesu sɔmɔli ɔ, ngma womi nɛ ɔ mane Kristo Yesu ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, asafo nya dali ɔmɛ, kɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Filipi ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Paulo kpa pɛɛ kɛ ha nihi nɛ maa kane e womi ɔ Be tsuaa be nɛ ye juɛmi maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, i naa Mawu si ha nyɛ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, i kɛ bua jɔmi faa kue ha Mawu ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he; ejakaa nyɛ sa sina kaa nyɛ piɛ ye he wawɛɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi mi kɛ je sisije kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu, nɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ je ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ maa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ yaa si nyɛ maa gbe nya ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a. I suɔ nyɛ saminya, nɛ e sa kaa ma susu nyɛ he wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu dloomi ɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ hɛdɔ, kɛ je sisije nɛ i ngɛ ye nane nɔ kɛ bee, kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ a wo mi tsu ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ wa ná kikɛmɛ a dloomi ɔ, nɛ wa ngɛ he ní tsue.
Bɔ nɛ Kristo Yesu mi mi sãã lɛ ngɛ wa he ɔ, jã ye hɛ ngɛ jae wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ he; Mawu ji ye odase kaa i yi lakpa.
I ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae kaa suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ sibi ɔ mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛ ná nile nɛ ma ha nyɛ nɔ́ se kɔmi mumi, konɛ nyɛɛ le kpakpa mi tso.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, mu ko mu ko, kɛ piami ko piami ko be nyɛ he sae kɛ yaa su ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba.
Kristo Yesu nitsɛ ma ha nyɛ ma na subai nɛ hi saminya ngɛ nyɛ wami si himi mi, konɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a je e yi.
Kristo lɛ haa nɔ wami Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kaa sanehi nɛ ba ye nɔ ɔ mohu ha nɛ sane kpakpa a ya su nihi babauu.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mɔ mi buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ tsuo ba na le kaa Kristo nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ he nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ.
Tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ, ha nɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu ba ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ kã ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe nɛ a yi gbeye.
Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a ti ni komɛ a hɛ kɔɔ ye nɔ, nɛ a jeɔ mi hunga, se ni komɛ hu kɛ juɛmi kpakpa fiɛɔ.
Kuu enyɔne ɔ kɛ suɔmi fiɛɔ, ejakaa a le kaa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ji kaa ma fa sane kpakpa a he.
Ni kpa amɛ fiɛ we sɛ gbi ɔ anɔkuale mi.
Ke a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a woɔ pɛ; a susuu kaa ke a pee ja kɛkɛ a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kɛ piɛ tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ he.
Ja he ɔ mɛni?
E haa mi bua jɔmi mohu kaa lakpa tomi nya jio, anɔkuale mi jio, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, Kristo nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na bua jɔmi.
Ee, ye bua maa jɔ, ejakaa i le kaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kpae, kɛ he wami nɛ Yesu Kristo mumi ɔ haa a, ma kpɔ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ, nɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ ji kaa zo be mi gbee; se mohu be tsuaa be ɔ, ma pee kã saminya, konɛ wami mi jio, gbenɔ mi jio, titli ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ wo Kristo hɛ mi nyami.
Ejakaa imi lɛɛ Kristo ji ye wami, nɛ gbenɔ ɔ, ye se nami.
Se ke e ba mi kaa ke i ngɛ wami mi nɛ ma nyɛ ma tsu ní pe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i li e mi nɔ́ nɛ ma hla.
Nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti i ngɛ.
Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i suɔ kaa ma si wami nɛ ɔ, nɛ i kɛ Kristo ya hi si, ejakaa lɔ ɔ hi kulaa pe.
Se nyɛ he ɔ, e hia kaa ma hi je mi mohu.
I heɔ enɛ ɔ yeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i le kaa i kɛ nyɛ tsuo maa hi si, konɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke wa ba bua ekohu ɔ, nyɛ ma na he blɔ hluu tsɔ kɛ fĩa kaa i ha nɛ nyɛ ba le Kristo Yesu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ hia pe kulaa ji, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa bɔ nɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ, konɛ i nyɛ ba na nyɛ jio, i bɛ́ jio, ma nu nyɛ he kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kake hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kpɛii kɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he plee.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ nyɛ ɔ a ní peepee nɛ wo nyɛ he gbeye.
Nyɛɛ pee kã be tsuaa be.
Lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ a maa na paa kaa a hɛ mi ma kpata, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ a ma he nyɛ yi wami.
Ejakaa enɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu dɛ mi e je.
Blɔ nya nɛ a ha nyɛ kaa Kristo we bi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pi kaa nyɛ ma he ye kɛkɛ, se mohu kaa e he ɔ, nyɛ maa na amanehlu hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ maa piɛ ye he kɛ hwu ta a. Ta nɛ ɔ nɔuu lɛ sa a nyɛ na kaa i ngɛ hwue; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Kristo he si bami kɛ e we agboje Nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Kristo ɔ, e woɔ nyɛ he wami, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ haa nyɛ bua jɔmi.
Nyɛɛ kɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ bɔe, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ nuɔ nɔ́ he ha nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛ naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ pee nyɛ yi mi kake; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛ we oti, kɛ juɛmi hu nɛ pee kake.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu ma na bua jɔmi babauu.
Nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ e nɔ́ mi foe, loo e ngɛ hlae nɛ e fĩa yaka.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he humi, nɛ nyɛɛ bu nyɛ sibi pe nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fo e nyɛmi nɔ́ mi; e ko fo lɛ nitsɛ pɛ e nɔ́ mi.
Kristo Yesu juɛmi ɔ nɛ pee nyɛ hu nyɛ juɛmi.
E hɛɛ Mawu su lɛɛ, se e pee we lɛ kaa doo ɔ, a na lɛ kaa e kɛ Mawu sɔ.
Mohu ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya a, e ngmɛɛ blɔ nya tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ he, nɛ e ba plɛ e he sɔmɔlɔ.
E ba pee kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ e je e he si kaa adesa.
E ba e he si, nɛ e bu tue hluu kɛ ya su gbeje tete; e gbo sɛumi tso nɔ gbenɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Mawu wo e nɔ gojoo, nɛ e ha lɛ biɛ nɛ kle pe biɛhi tsuo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ a maa wo e biɛ ta ngɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ma kpla si ha Yesu, nɛ a maa jaje paa ke, Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ; a maa pee ja kɛ wo Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɛɛ pee kaa la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ je ɔ mi Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
E he hia wawɛɛ kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete nɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue wawɛɛ pe kekle ɔ po.
Nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi, kɛ he domi blibliibli nɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.
Ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, Mawu ngɛ nyɛ he ní tsue, konɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ kɛ pee e suɔmi nya ní.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ mi mi la, nɛ nyɛ ko sã nya ngɛ he.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ he ma tsɔ, nɛ piami ko piami ko be nyɛ he hie; nyɛ maa pee Mawu bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ngɛ yayami peeli, kɛ nihi nɛ a tue wa a a kpɛti.
Ejakaa nyɛ je mi bami he tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ dodoe kpɛɔ.
Ke nyɛ hɛɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ mi wawɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba a, ma nyɛ ma fĩa kaa fo nɛ i tu, aloo dengme nɛ i gbo kɛ tsu nyɛ he ní ɔ pee we yaka.
Ke e maa ba mi kaa a ma plɛ ye muɔ kɛ pue nyɛ he bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sãe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi he ní tsue ɔ nɔ po ɔ, ye bua maa jɔ, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ma nya.
Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ hu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ nya.
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito a blɔ hiami blɔ nya tomi Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa suɔ ɔ, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma tsɔ Timoteo kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke i nu nyɛ he ɔ, ye nɔ gbagba maa te.
Timoteo pɛ ji nɔ nɛ susuu nyɛ he, nɛ e hlaa kaa e hi ha nyɛ; i li nɔ kpa ko hu kaa lɛ.
Ni ɔmɛ kulaa a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ko ngɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ e nɔ mi foe.
Yesu Kristo he sane ɔ pi a kɔmɔ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le Timoteo mɔde bɔmi!
Nyɛ le kaa e tsu ní nɛ se bé; e kɛ mi tsu sane kpakpa a he ní kaa bi kɛ e tsɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i na ye níhi a nya pɛ ma tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ.
Imi nitsɛ hu, ye hɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma ba su nyɛ ngɔ.
Wa nyɛmi Epafrodito nɛ nyɛ tsɔ lɛ ye ngɔ ɔ, e kɛ mi ba tsu ní saminya kaa ta bulɔ kpakpa.
E sɔmɔ mi bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye juɛmi nya a, e hia kaa ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
E hɛ ngɛ jae wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ akɛnɛ nyɛ nu kaa e be he wami ɔ, e ngɛ tsui yee.
Niinɛ, e nu hiɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ e gbo.
Se Mawu na lɛ mɔbɔ; pi lɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu imi hulɔ; e je mi kɛ je kɔmɔ yemi babauu mi.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ e be sɔe ha mi kulaa kaa ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ke nyɛ na lɛ ekohu ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi; kɛkɛ imi hu ma kpa tsui yemi.
Nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ bua jɔmi babauu kaa nyɛ nyɛmi nɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ.
Ejakaa Kristo ní tsumi ɔ he ɔ, e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ e sake e he lo ngɔ fɔ he.
Se e pee enɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ sɔmɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ nane mi.
Dami nitsɛnitsɛ Nyagbe ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ.
Pɔ tɔɛ ye he kaa ma ngma nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekohu; ejakaa lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa le nyɛ he nɔ hyɛmi.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ gbee ɔmɛ a he, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ ní tsuli yaya amɛ a he, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ nihi nɛ woɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he pa ke a po nɔ ɔ a he.
Wɔ mohu ji nihi nɛ a po mɛ anɔkuale mi.
Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa jaa Mawu kɛ guu e mumi ɔ nɔ, nɛ wa fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ.
Wa ngɔɛ wa hɛ kɛ fɔɛ he lo nya ní peemi níhi a nɔ.
Imi lɛ i ko ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ jamɛ a níhi a nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e maa ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ he lo nya ní peemi níhi a nɔ ɔ, imi mohu i ko pee pe ja po.
I ye otsi pɛ nɛ a po mi.
Israel fɔfɔɛ ji mi; i je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi; Hebri no mi Hebri no ji mi; mlaa a nya a, Farisi no kpanaa hulɔ.
Ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ kɛ wa asafo ɔ yi mi.
Ke mlaa a nɔ yemi nɔ a guu kɛ dlaa nɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, lɛɛ piami ko piami ko be ye he.
Níhi tsuo nɛ i ko bu mɛ kaa a he ngɛ se nami ha mi sa a, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, i buu mɛ kaa yaka níhi nɛ a he be se nami mohu.
Pi lɔ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, anɔkuale mi ɔ, i bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kaa níhi nɛ a he be se nami; ejakaa i ba na le kaa Kristo Yesu ji ye Nyɔmtsɛ.
Nile nɛ ɔ he jua wa pe nile tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ye níhi tsuo bɔ mi; ní ɔmɛ pee kaa kuku nɔ níhi kɛkɛ, konɛ Kristo mohu nɛ pee ye nɔ́.
I kɛ lɛ pee kake kulaa.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ pi mlaa nɔ nɛ i yeɔ nɔ nɛ a maa da kɛ wo mi nguɔ hu; mohu ɔ, Kristo nɛ i he ye ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu maa wo mi nguɔ ejakaa i he Kristo ye.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ ji kaa ma le Kristo, nɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ha e ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, ma na nya.
Ma na nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e na nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ e gbo ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, imi nitsɛ hu a ma tle mi si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
Fo mami kɛ oti ɔ he sumi I de we ke ye nine su jlasi ɔ nɔ momo, loo i hi kɛ pi si.
Se mohu, i ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa ye nine maa su nɔ, ejakaa enɛ ɔ he nɛ Kristo Yesu ngɔ mi kɛ pee e nɔ́ ɔ nɛ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, anɔkuale mi ɔ, i ngɔɛ lɛ kaa ye nine su nɔ momo.
Se mohu nɔ́ kake nɛ i peeɔ ji kaa níhi nɛ be ɔ, ma je hɛ ngɛ a nɔ, nɛ ma tiu níhi nɛ ngɛ hɛ mi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ hɛ kɛ pi oti ɔ, konɛ ye nine nɛ su jlasi ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu tsɛ wɔ kɛ je hiɔwe tɔɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ.
Wɔ nihi tsuo nɛ wa wa ngɛ mumi mi ɔ, juɛmi nɛ ɔ lɛ sa kaa waa hɛɛ.
Se ke nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpa susue ɔ, Mawu ma je lɔ ɔ hu kpo paa kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Se bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, blɔ nya tomi nɛ wa ye nɔ hluu kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hɛɛ mi nɛ wa ja nɔuu.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ wo ye nane.
Okadi kpakpa nɛ wa to nyɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ ja a, nyɛɛ kase mɛ.
I de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si abɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu i kɛ vo nyu ngɛ nyɛ dee ekohu ke gbenɔ nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ, nihi babauu a je mi bami peeɔ mɛ e he nyɛli.
Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ma kpata a hɛ mi kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a muklii ji a mawu nɛ a jaa.
A nyaa zo níhi a he, nɛ je mi níhi pɛ a he a susuu.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma a, hiɔwe e ngɛ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ wa ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa wa kpɔlɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa je kɛ ba.
E ma tsake wa nɔmlɔ tso nɛ hɛ mi be nyami ɔ; e maa pee lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ. E ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ yeɔ níhi tsuo a nɔ.
Ga womi Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ha!
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ nyɛ he ha!
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ haa mi bua jɔmi; nyɛ ngɛ kaa jlasi ngɛ ye yi!
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ.
Kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ pɛ ji bɔ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi.
I ngɛ nyɛmiyo Evodia, kɛ nyɛmiyo Sintika pɛɛ kpae kaa a pee kake ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he.
Nɛ mo, ye nyɛmi sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ, i ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae nɛ o ye bua yi nɛ ɔmɛ.
Ejakaa a kɛ Klemente, kɛ nyɛmimɛ kpahi nɛ waa kɛ mɛ sɔmɔ ɔ, piɛ ye he kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a.
A ngma nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a biɛ ngɛ Mawu wami womi ɔ mi.
Kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ daa!
I ngɛ dee ekohu ke, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ!
Nyɛ ná nɔ tsuaa nɔ he tsui.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ su si ta.
Nyɛ ko hao ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he; se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ sɔlemi, kɛ pɛɛ kpami, kɛ sina nɛ wo nyɛ hiami ní ɔmɛ a ta ha Mawu.
Nɛ Mawu he jɔmi nɛ pã adesa juɛmi tsuo ɔ maa bu nyɛ tsui, kɛ nyɛ juɛmi he ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.
Nyagbe ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, nihi nɛ ji anɔkuale, nihi nɛ sa bu, níhi nɛ da, níhi nɛ he tsɔ, níhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu, níhi nɛ woɔ nɔ hɛ mi nyami, ke je mi bami kpakpa ko ngɛ, ke yi jemi ko hu ngɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu.
Nihi nɛ nyɛ kase kɛ je ye nya, kɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ nu, nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ ye he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ pee; nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
Nike ní he sina I na bua jɔmi babauu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kaa be saii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i nui nyɛ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ na he blɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ suɔmi kpo jee kɛ tsɔɔ mi ekohu.
I tsɔɔ we kaa nyɛ susuu we ye he hu, se he blɔ nɛ nyɛ ya na we kɛ pee nɔ́ ko ha mi.
Pi kaa nyɛ hyɛ we ye nɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa imi lɛɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ye nine su nɔ kɛkɛ ye bua jɔ he; ja ji bɔ nɛ i kase, nɛ i le.
I le ohia mi si himi, nɛ i le ní kpɔtɔɔ mi si himi hulɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i kase ji be tsuaa be ɔ, ye bua nɛ jɔ nɔ́ he; i tɔ jio, hwɔ ngɛ mi yee jio, ye bua nɛ jɔ; kpɔtɔɔ be mi jio, hiami mi jio, ye bua nɛ jɔ.
Kristo lɛ woɔ mi he wami, nɛ e haa nɛ i nyɛɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ pee saminya kaa nyɛ ba ye bua mi ngɛ ye nɔ́ nami be ɔ mi.
Nyɛ Filipi bi, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa sisije ɔ, benɛ a bɔni sane kpakpa fiɛmi, nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ je Makedonia a, asafo ko asafo ko kɛ mi bɔɛ huɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hami kɛ hemi mi, ja nyɛ pɛ ji asafo nɛ ye bua mi.
Benɛ i ngɛ Tesalonika a po, pi si kake kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ mane mi ní.
Pi kaa nike ní nɛ i ngɛ hlae doo, se mohu kaa nyɛ maa gu lɔ ɔ peemi nɔ kɛ na biɛ kaa kpakpa peeli.
Níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛ mane ɔ ba su mi; a hiɛ kulaa pe bɔ nɛ i susu!
Epafrodito ngɔ nyɛ manemi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi hu.
Nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa bɔ ko nɛ a sã ha Mawu.
Bɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ jeɔ via liliili; e saa Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ e naa he bua jɔmi.
Ye Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ kɛ maa je e ní babauu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ mi kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ.
A je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ yi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene.
Amen.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi I biɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɔ a he kɛ ha Kristo Yesu ɔ. Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ, titli ɔ, Kaisare ɔ we ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
NYA TSƆƆMI Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ mane asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Kolose ɔ. Kolose ji ma wayoo ko nɛ ngɛ Asia Mainɔ, ngɛ Efeso beleku je.
Pi Paulo nɛ to Kolose asafo ɔ sisi.
Se he nɛ asafo ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ hyɛɔ lejɛ ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ nihi kɛ je Roma kpokpa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Asia a matsɛ ma Efeso ɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Paulo nu kaa lakpa tsɔɔli komɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ngɛ Kolose.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ji, loko nɔ ko maa le Mawu, nɛ a ma he e yi wami kɛ pi si ɔ, ja nɔ ɔ ja “mumi mi nɔ yeli, kɛ blɔ nya hɛɛli komɛ.” Ní komɛ hu nɛ jamɛ a tsɔɔli ɔmɛ de kɛ piɛ he hu ji kaa e sa nɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ pee kusumi pɔtɛɛ komɛ kaa nɔ pomi kikɛ nɛ ɔ; nɛ́ kusumihi nɛ kɔɔ niye ní, kɛ ní kpa komɛ a he ɔ, e ye nɔ sisiisi.
Paulo ngma anɔkuale sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ kɛ si tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔmɛ.
Nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji kaa Yesu Kristo ma nyɛ he nɔ yi wami kɛ pi si.
Hemi kɛ yemi kpa amɛ, kɛ kusumi peemi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a tsɛ̃ɔ nɔ kɛ jeɔ Kristo he mohu.
Kristo nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ Kristo nɔuu nɔ gue kɛ kpale je ɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ ekohu.
Ja je ɔ kɛ Kristo pee kake loko a ma he je ɔ yi wami.
Paulo ya nɔ tsɔɔ nya fitsofitso bɔ nɛ kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nguaa nɛ ɔ ma tsu ní ngɛ níhi nɛ heɔ yeɔ a wami si himi mi.
E hia kaa waa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ Paulo tsɔ kɛ womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya Kolose ji Tihiko; nɛ Onesimo, nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ Paulo ngma womi nɛ a tsɛɔ Filemon ɔ kɛ ya kpa pɛɛ ha lɛ ɔ piɛ e he kɛ ho.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Kristo kɛ e ní tsumi .—.
Wami he ngɛ Kristo mi .—.
Nyagbe .-
Imi Paulo nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ɔ, i kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ mane ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ji wa nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Kolose, nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ a kɛ Kristo pee kake ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Sina sɔlemi Ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ha nyɛ ɔ, wa naa Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ si daa.
Ejakaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, wa nu he.
Nyɛ nu momo kaa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko ngɛ ha nyɛ, benɛ anɔkuale sɛ gbi nɛ ji sane kpakpa a ba su nyɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ nyɛ suɔmi nɛ ɔ daa si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ kaa a kɛ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɔ.
Sane kpakpa a ngɛ nɔ yae, nɛ e ngɛ yiblii woe ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu e ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ mi kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu Mawu dloomi ɔ he nɛ nyɛ nu sisi kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Nyɛ kase Mawu dloomi sane nɛ ɔ kɛ je wa suɔlɔ Epafra nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue ɔ nya.
Lɛ hu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɛ ní tsue ha wɔ.
Suɔmi nɛ mumi ɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, Epafra ba bɔ wɔ he sane.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ wa nu nyɛ he ɔ kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa jɔɔ we Mawu pɛɛ kpami ha nyɛ.
Wa biɔ ke Mawu nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ le e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛ ná nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi nɛ mumi ɔ haa nɔ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ maa sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Nyɛ ma tsu ní kpakpa sɔuu, nɛ nyɛ maa le Mawu saminya pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ le lɛ daa.
-I kpaa Mawu pɛɛ, nɛ e kɛ e he wami nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ he wami, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ́ nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si kɛ na nɔ́, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ na Tsɛ ɔ si.
Lɛ nɛ ha nɛ nyɛ ná he blɔ, nɛ gbosi ní nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ to ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ nine maa su nyɛ nɔ́ nɔ.
E kpɔ wɔ kɛ je diblii he wami ɔ sisi, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ba e Bi nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
E Bi ɔ ha nɛ wa ye wa he; ee, e kɛ wa he yayami pa wɔ.
Kristo kɛ ní nɛ e ba tsu Kristo ji Mawu nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ ɔ subai nɛ a naa.
Lɛ ji nibɔ níhi tsuo a kpɛti tɛte.
Ejakaa e nɔ lɛ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba, níhi nɛ a naa, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a nɛ́.
Ekomɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kojoɔ nihi, nihi a nɔ yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ he wami kpahi.
Mawu gu Kristo nɔ kɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ Kristo nɔuu a bɔ mɛ ha.
Kristo ngɛ loko a bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ níhi tsuo ngɛ a hanɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɛ ji yi kɛ ha asafo ɔ nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ. E mi asafo ɔ puɛ kɛ je.
Lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ a tle si kɛ je gbeje, konɛ e ye kekleekle blɔ he ngɛ níhi tsuo a mi.
Ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ lɛ suɔ kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ su pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ hi Bi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ná he bua jɔmi kaa kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ma dla e kɛ je ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a kpɛti.
Niinɛ, Mawu gu e Bi ɔ muɔ nɛ pue si ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tue mi jɔmi ba.
Sa a, nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti kɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛ pee nyɛ he e he nyɛli.
Nyɛ peeɔ ní yayamihi, nɛ nyɛ susuɔ ní yayamihi hulɔ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ nyɛ ba kpata.
E pee enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, nɛ piami, loo sé ko kó hi nyɛ he ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi; nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii, nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ nyɛ ná benɛ nyɛ nu sane kpakpa a, nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ he.
Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ a fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ bɔ níhi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ he lɛ imi Paulo i ba pee sɔmɔlɔ ngɛ.
Paulo ní tsumi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e peeɔ mi bua jɔmi kaa nyɛ he ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ́ nae, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ngɛ dengme nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ asafo ɔ nɛ ji e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ɔ, ma gbe nya ngɛ ye he lo nɛ ɔ mi.
Mawu je mi nɛ e tsɔ mi nɛ ma ba sɔmɔ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ ma fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ saminya kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ ji laami sane nɛ Mawu ngɔ laa yi nɔhi kɛ je blema lokoo, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e je ngɔ tsɔɔ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Mawu suɔ kaa e ha mɛɛ a le kaa kikɛmɛ a laami sane nɛ he jua wa, nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami nɛ ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hu a kpɛti.
Nɛ laami sane ɔ ji, Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa Mawu maa wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ngɛ Kristo he sane ɔ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsɔɔe.
Wa ngɛ nihi tsuo kɔkɔ bɔe, nɛ wa ngɛ mɛ ní tsɔɔe kɛ nile nɛ mi kuɔ.
Wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ waa gbla nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ kaa nihi nɛ le Kristo kɛ pi si.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ Kristo he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ kɛ tsuɔ ní.
Dengme babauu nɛ i gbo ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea, kɛ jehanɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ li mi hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi po ɔ tsuo nyɛ he ɔ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le.
I ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee nɛ ma kɛ wo mɛ bua, konɛ suɔmi nɛ ha a pee kake.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa nu ní kpakpahi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ tsuo a sisi saminya nɛ nɔ jemi be mi, nɛ a maa le Mawu laami sane ɔ. Mawu laami sane ɔ ji Kristo ɔ nɛ.
Nile, kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ, Kristo mi a naa ngɛ.
I ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ nyami ngɔngɔɛ munyu ko kó ba sisi nyɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa he lo mi ɔ, i be nyɛ ngɔ lɛɛ, se mumi mi ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Ke i hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ toɔ níhi blɔ nya saminya, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ fi si kpɛii ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ mi ɔ, e peeɔ mi bua jɔmi.
Wami he ngɛ Kristo mi Akɛnɛ nyɛ he Kristo Yesu kaa nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ pee kake.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ mɛtɛ lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha lɛ kulaa.
Nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si daa.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nɔ ko kó ngɔ je mi nile, loo yaka sisimi kɛ ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ.
Blema tsɔɔmihi, kɛ mumihi nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ je, se pi Kristo ngɔ.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ Mawu su ngɛ tutuutu ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa naa ngɛ Kristo mi benɛ e ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo pee kake, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kristo nɛ ji yi ha nɔ yeli tsuo ɔ su ngɛ nyɛ mi.
Nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo pee kake ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa a po nyɛ; pi he lo mi nɔ pomi.
Mohu Kristo ha he lo nɛ ɔ we akɔnɔ nɛ nya wa a be nyɛ nɔ he wami hu.
Nɛ a sɔle nyɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa a pu nyɛ ngɔ piɛ Kristo he; nɛ Mawu tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si ekohu.
Ejakaa nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, nɛ e tle Kristo si hulɔ.
Sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ gbo, ejakaa nyɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ he lo nya a, a pui nyɛ.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo ba wami mi ekohu; ee, Mawu ngɔ wɔ tsuo wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ.
Wa he níhi nɛ a ngma kɛ si wɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ sa wɔ ngɛ mlaa a nya a, e gbe lɛ tsuo.
E je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se; ee, e ka ngɔ mɛtɛ sɛumi tso ɔ he.
Kristo kpɔ he wami ngɛ mumi mi nɔ yeli, kɛ he wami ɔmɛ a dɛ.
E bɔ mɛ ahlua paa, nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ je ɔ kaa niinɛ e ye kunimi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɔ ko nɛ wo nyɛ mlaa ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nu he, aloo ngɛ nyami be, Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi he.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ a nini kɛkɛ; nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ ji Kristo.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nihi nɛ buu a he kaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a hi pe nihi tsuo ɔ nɛ a bu nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be nɔ́ ko mi.
A deɔ ke mɛɛ a naa nina pɔtɛɛ komɛ, nɛ a nyɛɔ nyɛ nɔ ke nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami nɛ ja bɔfohi.
Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ woɔ a he nɔ yaka gu.
Nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a mɛtɛ we Kristo nɛ ji yi ɔ he.
Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo ɔ, yi ɔ mi e naa níhi tsuo nɛ hia lɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ.
Niye ní nɛ ɔ guɔ kpɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ pani ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ waa bɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ. Ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, wa gbo lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ wa hɛ ngɛ Nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ gbo, nɛ a kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je mumihi nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ ɔ a dɛ mi.
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ nyɛ ní kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nyɛ haa a pa woɔ nyɛ mlaa ke, “Koo pɛtɛ he, koo sa o nya, nɛ koo ta he tete po” ɔ?
Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɔɔ níhi nɛ ke a tsu a he ní pɛ a hɛ mi kpata a a he.
Adesa mlaahi, kɛ tsɔɔmihi kɛkɛ ji enɛ ɔmɛ.
Niinɛ, ni komɛ susuɔ kaa kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ nile nɛ haa nɔ nitsɛ fiiɔ si ngɛ jami mi.
A buá peeɔ a he humi, nɛ a waa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu lɛ a ngɛ jae.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a tsiɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ we akɔnɔ nya.
A tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hla níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ Kristo hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ ngɛ ɔ. Níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu; pi nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ wami ɔ kɛ Kristo tsuo ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu mi.
Kristo ji nyɛ wami.
Nɛ ke e ba ekohu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo maa hi lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a maa wo nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Wa mi momo kɛ wami he ɔ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi nɛ haoɔ nyɛ, yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, mu ní tsumi, mi mi la, akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ hɛ tsumi nɛ ngɛ kaa amaga jami ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe.
Nihi nɛ gboɔ tue, nɛ a peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi fumi ma kple a nɔ.
Sa a, be nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ba nyɛ je mi ja a, kikɛmɛ a akɔnɔ nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu a se nyɛ ya nyɛɛ.
Se jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo: mi mi la, mimi fumi, kɛ yi wu tso ní peemi.
Nyɛ ko gbe nɔ he guɛ, nɛ munyu yaya ko kó je nyɛ nya.
Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa; nyɛ sake nɔmlɔ su momo ɔ, kɛ e ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue.
Nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ su he.
Nɔmlɔ su he nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu, e bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ mɔde bɔe daa nɛ kaa e maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ fitsofitso.
Ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi ɔ, slɔɔto ko be Hela no kɛ Yuda no a kpɛti; slɔɔto be nɔ nɛ a po lɛ, kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ a kpɛti.
Kɔpe no be ɔ, futufutu no be; nyɔguɛ be ɔ, odehe ko hu be.
Nɔ nɛ he hia ji Kristo; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ, Kristo ngɛ e mi.
Mawu nihi nɛ e hla, nɛ e suɔ ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a na subai nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo: mi mi jɔmi, mɔbɔ nami, he si bami, kpoo peemi, kɛ tsui si tomi.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi ngɛ sane ko ɔ, nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛ kɛ pa nyɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ngɔ pa nyɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, nyɛ ha suɔmi nɛ pee kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo, ejakaa suɔmi ngɛ kaa kpa nɛ fiɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ peeɔ kake, nɛ lɛ tsuo peeɔ pɛ.
He jɔmi nɛ Kristo haa a, nyɛ ha nɛ a na kaa e ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi.
Ejakaa nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ mi ɔ, ní tsumi nɛ Mawu kpee nyɛ ke nyɛ ba tsu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E sa nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si.
Nyɛ ha nɛ Kristo sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ fuu.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ní, nɛ nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi ga kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ.
Nyɛ la La womi ɔ mi lahi, yi jemi lahi, kɛ mumi mi lahi kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi nɛ nyɛ kɛ na Mawu si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ mumi lahi kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee; munyu lɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue jio, ní nyɛ ngɛ tsue jio, nyɛɛ pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi.
Nɛ nyɛɛ gu e nɔ kɛ na Tsɛ Mawu ɔ si.
Wami he ɔ mi si himi Yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa nyɛ peemi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se nyɛɛli ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko wa mɛ yi mi.
Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi saminya.
Tsɛmɛ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bimɛ a mi mi la; ke nyɛ pee ja a, a nine mi maa wo nyu.
Nyɔguɛhi, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sane.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kɛ pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ pee ha, se pi adesa.
Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nike ní nɛ Mawu ngɔ to ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ́ nɔ kaa nyɛ hiɔwo, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ ma na e yayami ɔ he hiɔwo, ejakaa Mawu hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.
Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ saminya ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ.
Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.
Ga womi Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nyɛɛ sɔle daa, nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si.
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ hulɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ bli blɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa fiɛ e sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo laami sane nɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɔle nɛ ma gba laami sane nɛ ɔ mi saminya bɔ nɛ sa kaa ma gba mi.
Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ he we Kristo yi ma bua a, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya, konɛ a na kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ le Kristo.
Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi ngɛ ní sɛɛe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ munyu nɛ maa je nyɛ nya a nɛ ngɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a wo lɛ ngo, nɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ munyu heto bɔ nɛ sa.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi Wa nyɛmi Tihiko nɛ wa suɔ lɛ saminya, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ tsue ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma ba bɔ nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ ye he.
Enɛ ɔ he i ngɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe, konɛ nyɛɛ nu wa he, bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ha, konɛ nyɛ hu e ba wo nyɛ bua.
Onesimo piɛ e he kɛ ma.
Lɛ hu wa nyɛmi nɛ wa suɔ saminya, nɛ yeɔ Kristo anɔkuale ji lɛ; nɛ e je nyɛ asafo ɔ mi.
A ma ba bɔ nyɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ amaniɛ tsuo.
Aristarko nɛ a wo i kɛ lɛ tsuo tsu ɔ ke e biɔ nyɛ.
Barnaba nyɛmi Marko hu ke e biɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛ nine su womi nɔ momo kaa ke Marko ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ atuu.
Yoshua nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yusto hulɔ ɔ ke lɛ hu e biɔ nyɛ.
Ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji Yuda bi nɛ ba he Kristo ye, nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he.
Niinɛ, a ngɛ mi wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Epafra, nyɛ kpɛti no kpa nɛ lɛ hu e tsuɔ ní ha Kristo Yesu ɔ ke e biɔ nyɛ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ sɔlee ha nyɛ kɛ e tsui tsuo.
E ngɛ e he gbee kaa Mawu nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli kpakpahi, nihi nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo, nɛ a peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní sisiisi.
I ngɛ e he odase yee kaa e gbo dengme saminya ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea, kɛ Hierapoli ɔ nyɛ he.
Luka, tsopatsɛ ɔ nɛ wa suɔ lɛ saminya a, kɛ Dema ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛ de nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea ke wa biɔ mɛ.
Wa biɔ Nimfa, kɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kpee ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ.
Ke nyɛ kane womi nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, nyɛ ha nɛ a kane ngɔ ha Laodikea asafo ɔ hulɔ.
Womi nɛ i sɛ hlami ngma mane Laodikea asafo ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kane.
Jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ de Arkipo ke, “Ní tsumi ɔ nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ ke o tsu ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o tsu kɛ gbe nya.” Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya womi nɛ i ngma kaa i biɔ nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kaa i ngɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
NYA TSƆƆMI Roma nɔ yemi he nɛ a tsɛɛ Makedonia a ma nguaa ji Tesalonika.
Benɛ Paulo je Filipi ɔ, e ya to asafo sisi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se e kɛ we kulaa nɛ Yuda bi komɛ ba te si wo lɛ.
A je Paulo ní tsumi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ he hunga, ejakaa benɛ e ba Tesalonika a, ni komɛ nɛ pi Yuda bi ji mɛ nɛ jinɛ a ba ngɔ a he kɛ wo Yuda jami ɔ mi ɔ nya Kristo sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ Paulo fiɛ ɔ he saminya.
Nɛ e ba mi kaa Paulo nɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Berea ya.
Pee se benɛ Paulo ya su Korinto ɔ, e ná sɛ gbi kɛ je e huɛ Timoteo nɛ e kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ ngɔ.
Níhi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ Tesalonika asafo ɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he sɛ gbi ɔ kɔɔ.
Paulo ngma Tesalonika bi ɔmɛ kekleekle womi nɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ wo Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he wami.
E na Mawu si ngɛ munyu nɛ e nu nɛ kɔɔ a hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ a ngɛ ɔ he, nɛ e kai mɛ bɔ nɛ e ba e je mi be mi nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba hi si ɔ.
Sane komɛ hu ba te si ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ngɛ Kristo kpalemi kɛ bami ekohu ɔ he.
Enɛ ɔmɛ hu Paulo tu a he munyu ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Sane bimi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ke nɔ ko ba le Kristo, nɛ e gbo loko Kristo kpale kɛ ba a, neneene wami ɔ nɛ Kristo kɛ maa ba a, anɛ lɛ hu e ma ná lo?
Mɛni be Kristo maa kpale kɛ ba?
Paulo wo mɛ ga kaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a ya nɔ nɛ a tsu a ní ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, konɛ a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ a kɛ hyɛ Kristo bami ɔ blɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .
Sina kɛ yi jemi .—.
Kristo se nyɛɛli a je mi bami .- Kristo maa ba .—.
Nyagbe sɛ gbi .- Nyagbe .-
Imi Paulo, Sila, kɛ Timoteo, wa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha asafo mi bi nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika, nɛ ngɛ Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi ha nyɛ!
Tesalonika bi a si himi, kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi Wa naa Mawu si daa kɛ haa nyɛ tsuo, nɛ daa ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, wa woɔ nyɛ ta.
Wa kaiɔ nyɛ ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu hɛ mi bɔ nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ jeɔ kpo ngɛ nyɛ ní tsumi mi, bɔ nɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nyɛmimɛ, wa le kaa Mawu suɔ nyɛ, nɛ e hla nyɛ kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nihi.
Sane kpakpa a nɛ wa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, pi munyu kɛkɛ nɛ wa ba tu.
Nɔ́ nɛ wa ba de nyɛ ɔ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ bli nyɛ juɛmi nya, nɛ nyɛ na kaa munyu ɔ nɛ wa kɛ ba a, anɔkuale sɔuu.
Benɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ le bɔ nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ hi si ha.
Wa pee ja, konɛ e hi ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Nyɛ kase waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsuo, ejakaa benɛ a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ɔ, Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi he sɛ gbi ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ba pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nihi nɛ he ye ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaya tsuo.
Pi Makedonia kɛ Akaya kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ fiɛ ɔ gbɛ fĩa a, se he tsuaa he ɔ, a nu nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ hu he.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e hia we kaa wɔɔ wa deɔ nɔ́ ko hu.
Ni ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ nyɛ he odase kpakpa kaa benɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he wɔ atuu.
Jehanɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ kpale kɛ je amagahi a se kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ ba sɔmɔ anɔkuale Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ. Mawu Bi Yesu ɔ nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e maa je hiɔwe kɛ ba ekohu.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma je wɔ kɛ je tue gblami nɛ ma a mi.
Paulo ní tsumi ngɛ Tesalonika Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa slaami nɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ pee we yaka.
Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ a wa wɔ yi mi, nɛ a jɛ wɔ kɛ pue wa hɛ mi si ngɛ Filipi loko wa ba nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ Tesalonika a. E ngɛ mi kaa níhi fuu ka wɔ blɔ tsimi, se wa Mawu ɔ wo wɔ kã kaa wa ba fiɛ e sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ maa na kaa munyu nɛ wa kɛ ba fɔ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, pi mu ní tsumi, loo juɛmi yayami mi nɛ e je; wa bɛ nɛ wa ba sisi nyɛ.
Mohu ɔ, wa tuɔ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ wɔ ke waa pee ɔ; ejakaa e na wɔ kaa nihi nɛ sa nɛ a tu sane kpakpa a ngɔ wo a dɛ mi.
Wa hla we kaa waa sa nimli a hɛ mi, se mohu kaa wa maa sa Mawu pɛ hɛ mi; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e le bɔ nɛ wa tsui mi ngɛ ha.
Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, wa bɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyuhi; jehanɛ hu, wa ba sisi we nyɛ nɛ wa kɛ na nyɛ he se.
Mawu ji wa we odase!
Wa bɛ, konɛ nimli ba wo wa hɛ mi nyami, nyɛ jio, ni kpahi jio.
Pohu wa ngɛ he blɔ kaa wa biɔ enɛ kɛ enɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, ejakaa Kristo bɔfohi ji wɔ.
Se benɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, wa pee nyɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛanyɛ hɛɛɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ wa suɔ nyɛ saminya a, wa na he tsui kaa pi Mawu sane kpakpa a kɛkɛ nɛ wa maa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ; se wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa wami tete wa ma ngɔ fɔ si ha nyɛ.
Suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya wa!
Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ma kai bɔ nɛ wa tsu ní kɛ pɔtɔ!
Benɛ wa ngɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ, wa ngɛ ní tsue nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko.
Nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu ji wa we odase kaa wa ba wa je mi saminya ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ nyɛ kpɛti.
Wa peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ nɛ piami ko be wa he.
Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hi si kaa tsɛ kɛ e bi.
Wa wo nyɛ he wami; wa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ wa wo nyɛ ga kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Lɛ nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ke nyɛɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ e nyami ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ kake he hu nɛ wa naa Mawu si ngɛ daa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ wa ngɔ Mawu munyu ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bu tue, nɛ nyɛ he lɛ atuu, pi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa sɛ gbi, se mohu kaa Mawu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Niinɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi.
Nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ pee nyɛ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ pee Mawu asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a mi bi nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Kristo Yesu ɔ. Nyɛ na amanehlu ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma mi bi a dɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ mɛ hu a na amanehlu ngɛ Yuda bi a dɛ mi ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ.
Mɛ lɛ a wa wɔ yi mi.
Mawu na we a he bua jɔmi; a te si wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ!
Ma je li tete po a ke wa ko fiɛ ha mɛ, konɛ a ko he a yi wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami ɔ, pe a ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ nɔ toe babauu daa ligbi.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ kple a nɔ!
Paulo suɔ nɛ e ya slaa Tesalonika bi ɔmɛ ekohu Nyɛmimɛ, e ngɛ mi kaa wa si nyɛ, nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ mi gba be kpiti ko ngɛ he lo mi, se wa hɛ ji nyɛ nɔ.
Hɛja sɔuu ha nɛ wa bɔ mɔde wawɛɛ kaa waa na nyɛ hɛ mi ekohu.
Wa hla kaa waa kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ; ee, imi Paulo nitsɛ, i ka si abɔ kaa ma ba.
Se Abosiami tsi wɔ blɔ.
Ejakaa ke wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ba, nɛ wa ba pue ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ, mɛni nɔ wa maa fĩa kɛ fɔ?
Mɛni ma ha wɔ bua jɔmi?
Nɛ mɛni jlasi waa kɛ maa fĩa kaa wa ye kunimi?
Anɛ pi nyɛ lo?
Ee, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa wo wa hɛ mi nyami; nyɛ lɛ nyɛ ma ha wɔ bua jɔmi.
A tsɔ Timoteo Benɛ wa nyɛ we hu ɔ, wa kplɛɛ kaa wa maa tlɔ Atene kɛkɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ Timoteo, wa nyɛmi nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní kaa Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kɛ fiɛɔ Kristo he sane kpakpa a. Wa tsɔ lɛ, konɛ e ba wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e ha nyɛ fi si ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ amanehlu nɛ ngɛ bae ɔ ko wo nyɛ ti nɔ ko he gbeye.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha wɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa de nyɛ ngɔ to kaa wa maa na amanehlu.
Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ lɛ ba mi nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, benɛ i nyɛ we tsui tomi hu ɔ, e hia kaa ma tsɔ Timoteo nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ́ e ba hyɛ kaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wa kɛ mwɔɔ lo.
I ya ye gbeye kaa alini Abosiami ba ka nyɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ wa dengme nɛ wa gbo ɔ maa pee yaka.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Timoteo kpale kɛ ba, nɛ e ba bɔ wɔ amaniɛ saminyayoo nɛ kɔɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ he.
E ba de wɔ ke nyɛ susuɔ wa he daa nɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ jaa ngɛ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa hɛ jaa ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ woɔ wɔ he wami ngɛ amanehlu, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ mi.
Ke nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ mɛtɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kulaa a, wɔ hu wa ma na he wami he.
Nyɛ he ɔ, Mawu haa wɔ bua jɔmi babauu nɛ wa be nyɛe maa na lɛ si saasaa.
Daa nyɔ kɛ pia a, wa kpaa lɛ pɛɛ kɛ wa tsui tsuo kaa waa na nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, konɛ waa wo nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi he wami.
Wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɛ a bli blɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ suɔmi ɔ mi nɛ wa, konɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa suɔ nyɛ ɔ. Nɛ e wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tsui nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ piami ko be nyɛ he hie ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi be mi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba a.
Si himi nɛ saa Mawu hɛ mi Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ kase kɛ je wa ngɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi nɛ e sa Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ jã nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ.
Se kɛ̃, ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, nɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ga woe kaa nyɛɛ pee kɛ ya nɔ pe jã po.
Ejakaa mlaa nɛ wa wo nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ le.
Mawu suɔmi nya ji kaa nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi.
E sa kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le bɔ nɛ e maa ye e he nɔ ha nɛ nyɛ he ma tsɔ, nɛ bu maa hi nyɛ he.
Nyɛ ko di akɔnɔ se kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ peeɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko kó ya pee e nyɛmi yayami kaa e ma ya ngɔ e nyɛmi e yo.
Wa de nyɛ enɛ ɔ momo, nɛ wa bɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ wawɛɛ kaa nihi nɛ peeɔ jã a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa gbla a tue.
Mawu tsɛ we wɔ nɛ wa ba tsu mu ní, se mohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa he nɛ tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e bui, se mohu Mawu, nɔ nɛ ha nyɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Jehanɛ, suɔmi nɛ sa kaa e hi nyɛmimɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a kpɛti ɔ, e hia we kaa ma ngma nyɛ womi ngɛ lɔ ɔ he hu.
Mawu tsɔɔ nyɛ momo kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he, nɛ niinɛ ɔ, nyɛ suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia a saminya.
Se wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee pe ja po.
Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he kpoo, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko wo ni kpahi a sane mi.
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nine nɛ tsu ní kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee jã a, nihi nɛ li Kristo lolo ɔ maa bu nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛ he ngɔe kɛ fɔ nɔ ko nɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma Nyɛmimɛ, wa suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le anɔkuale sane nɛ kɔɔ nihi nɛ gbo ɔ a he, konɛ nyɛ ko ye kɔmɔ kaa nihi nɛ be hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi.
Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu gbo, nɛ e te si ekohu.
Jã kɛ̃, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa ke Yesu ma a, Mawu maa ngɔ nihi nɛ gbo ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ba.
Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ de ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa ngɛ nyɛ dee nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba a, wɔ nihi nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ, nɛ wa maa hi wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, wa be ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ a hlami sɛe kɛ ya kpee lɛ.
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba kɛ ose nɛ nya wa.
Bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a maa wo gbi, nɛ Mawu titimati ɔ maa pɛ.
Nihi nɛ he Yesu ye loko a gbo ɔ maa te si kekle.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɛ maa hi wami mi jamɛ a be ɔ, a ma sa waa kɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ya kɔɔhiɔ mi ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya kpee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nɛ waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa hi si daa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wo nyɛ sibi a bua.
Nyɛ dla nyɛ he ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami Nyɛmimɛ, be tutuutu nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi ɔ, e hia we kaa waa ngma nyɛ.
Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le tsɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ julɔ baa nyɔ mi.
Be mi nɛ nihi ma de ke, “Wa he mi jɔ wɔ, nɛ wa tue mi hu jɔ wɔ” ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ yo nɛ mi wa nuɔ kɔɔmi si kake too ɔ; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be e he yee.
Se nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pi diblii mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ligbi ɔ ma ba ti nyɛ si kaa julɔ.
Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ la bimɛ ji nyɛ; ee, piani bimɛ ji nyɛ; wa pi nyɔ, loo diblii bimɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ko hwɔ mahe kaa bɔ nɛ ni kpahi peeɔ ɔ; se mohu waa hi hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ wa hɛ mi nɛ ka si.
Ejakaa nyɔ mi nɛ a hwɔɔ mahe, nɛ nyɔ mi dã deli deɔ dã.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ piani bimɛ ji wɔ, nɛ e hia kaa wa hɛ mi nɛ ka si.
Wa hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ suɔmi ɔ mi nɛ wa kaa dama, nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa a ma he wa yi wami ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu mi nɛ wa kaa dade pɛɛ.
Mawu hla we wɔ kɛ to, nɛ e na wa he abofu.
Se mohu, e wo wɔ kɛ to, konɛ e he wa yi wami kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ.
Kristo ba gbo ha wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, waa kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ye bua nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Nyagbe ga womi kɛ sɛ yemi Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛmimɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu nihi nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ asafo ɔ hɛ mi nyɛɛli nɛ tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ mɛ ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ a ngɛ tsue ɔ he.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu, nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ!
Nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ hejɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ wo ni nɛmɛ nɛ be tsui ɔ he wami; nyɛɛ ye bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó pee yayami kɛ to yayami nane mi.
Se mohu daa nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde kaa nyɛ maa pee kpakpa ha nyɛ sibi, kɛ nihi tsuo.
Nyɛ na bua jɔmi daa; nyɛɛ sɔle be tsuaa be; nyɛɛ na Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee.
Nyɛ ko gbe Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Nyɛ kó ha gbali ɔmɛ a sɛ gbi nɛ pee nyɛ tai.
Nyɛɛ ka nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hyɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he nɛ wa; se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ji yayami ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je he.
Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa wɔ he jɔmi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kulaa kɛ pi si.
E hyɛ nyɛ mumi, nyɛ klaa, kɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa nɔ nɛ piami ko kó hi he be mi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a. Nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nɛ e maa pee hulɔ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ.
Nyɛ nga nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ha wɔ kɛ suɔmi nɛ mi wa.
I ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi kaa nyɛɛ kane womi nɛ ɔ ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si.
NYA TSƆƆMI Basabasa ba te si ngɛ Tesalonika asafo ɔ mi ngɛ Kristo bami enyɔne ɔ nɛ nihi ya nui sisi ɔ he.
Ni komɛ he ye kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba si enyɔne ɔ momo.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ be mi.
E tsɔɔ nya kaa loko Kristo maa kpale kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, yayami, kɛ yi wu tso ní peemi maa ya nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa nyɛɛ nihi a hɛ mi kɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔ ji “Dikalɔ ɔ”; nɛ e maa te si kɛ wo Kristo.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ bɔfo Paulo ti mi ha Tesalonika asafo bi ɔmɛ ji e ngɛ mi kaa a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae mohu, se e hia kaa a hɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ.
A kɛ a nine nguɛ nyɔngma nɛ tsu ní nɛ a ye kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Paulo ɔ hu e kɛ e huɛmɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ peeɔ ɔ. Nɛ́ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi ko gbe a nya.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Yi jemi kɛ he wami womi .- Tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo bami ɔ he .- Kristo se nyɛɛli a je mi babɛ .- Nyagbe .-
Paulo, Sila, kɛ Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Tesalonika asafo ɔ, nɛ a kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo pee kake ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
A maa gbla nihi a tue Wa nyɛmimɛ!
E hia kaa waa na Mawu si daa ha nyɛ.
E sa kaa waa pee jã, ejakaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ngɛ wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ kɛ ha e nyɛmi ɔ ngɛ nɔ yae bɔ nɛ sa.
Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa fĩaa fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Mawu asafo ɔmɛ a mi kaa nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ mi wa.
Ejakaa be mi nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, nyɛ to nyɛ tsui si, nɛ nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi gblee.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ paa kaa Mawu yeɔ dami sane; e ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ dlae kɛ ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ. Niinɛ, Mawu maa ye dami sane; nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ɔ, Mawu maa hao mɛ ngɔ to nane mi.
Nɛ nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, e ma ha waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo he jɔmi.
E maa pee enɛ ɔ, be mi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu maa hia kpo kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ e bɔfo katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam.
Nihi nɛ li Mawu, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bui Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu sane kpakpa a, e kɛ mɛ maa to ní.
A maa gbla a tue, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.
A ma je mɛ kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
A be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, kɛ e he wami ɔ nae ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba nɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ma je e yi, nɛ nihi nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa piɛ a he, ejakaa sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ wa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he ye.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, wa kpaa Mawu pɛɛ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ je mi bami nɛ sa nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa wo nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi he wami, nɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ to kaa nyɛ maa pee ɔ, nyɛ maa pee.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ní peepee he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma je Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu yi.
Nɛ e he ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ mi maa ba nyami ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nya.
Dikalɔ ɔ Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ a ma bua wa nya nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ya kpe ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ nu kaa mumi mi sɛ gbi ko je kpo, aloo munyu ko ngɛ pɛe, aloo kaa a ngɛ dee ke womi ko je wa ngɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ ba momo ɔ, nyɛ juɛmi mi ko pee nyɛ enyɔɔnyɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko hao hulɔ.
Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ sisi nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɔ.
Ja nyagbe atuã tsɔmi ɔ ba kekle loko ligbi ɔ maa ba.
Dikalɔ ɔ nɛ hɛ mi ma kpata a maa je kpo.
E maa te si ngɔ wo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ mawu, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a jaa a, nɛ e ma wo e he nɔ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
E ma ya hi Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ mi tete po, nɛ e ma de ke lɛ ji Mawu.
Anɛ nyɛ kaii we kaa benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo lo?
Se nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ tsi e nya nɛ e ba je we e he kpo lolo ɔ?
Ke be ɔ su ɔ, dikalɔ ɔ ma ba hia kpo kɛ̃.
Yi wu tso ní nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ, a je sisi momo.
Se nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a be bae, ja a je nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ tsie ɔ ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi lolo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma je dikalɔ ɔ kpo paa.
Se ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ba a, e kɛ mumi nɛ maa je e nya mi ɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ e hɛ mi kpɛmi ɔ ma kpata dikalɔ ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Dikalɔ ɔ maa ba kɛ Abosiami he wami, nɛ e ma ba pee lakpa nyakpɛ ní, kɛ okadi slɔɔtohi.
E maa gu yi wu tso ga blɔ nɔ kɛ sisi nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata a. Ee, a hɛ mi ma kpata, ejakaa a sume nɛ a ngɔ anɔkuale ɔ, konɛ a he a yi wami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ma tsaka a juɛmi, nɛ a ma he lakpa munyu maa ye.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi, se yayami mohu he a bua jɔɔ ɔ, a maa bu mɛ fɔ.
A hla nyɛ, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami Se nyɛmimɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ, e hia kaa waa na Mawu si daa ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa kɛ je sisije lokoo ɔ, Mawu hla nyɛ, nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami kɛ gu mumi ɔ nɛ maa tsu nyɛ he ɔ, kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ nɔ.
Mawu tsɛ nyɛ kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ wa fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ, konɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ na nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ da si kpɛii!
Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ wa de nyɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ wa ngma nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nitsɛ, kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e gu e dloomi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e wo wɔ he wami, nɛ e ha wɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ nya wa a, e wo nyɛ bua, nɛ e ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ tsu ní kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ tu munyu kpakpa daa.
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ, konɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ ya nɔ nɛ e gbɛ fĩa, nɛ a he lɛ kɛ manye ngɛ he tsuaa he kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ɔ. Nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ Mawu nɛ je wɔ kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi; ejakaa pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ.
Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yeɔ anɔkuale.
E maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he, nɛ dikalɔ ɔ be nyɛe maa pee nyɛ nɔ́ ko.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha wa he nyɛ ye saminya.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa de ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ pee, nɛ nyɛ maa ya nɔ maa pee.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ nu Mawu suɔmi ɔ, kɛ Kristo tsui si tomi ɔ sisi saminya.
E hia kaa a tsu ní Nyɛmimɛ, wa ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ tsu we ní, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bɛ a je mi saminya kaa bɔ nɛ wa tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ kó bɔ.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le veveeve kaa e hia kaa nyɛɛ kase wɔ.
Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa pee we hejɔ.
Wa yi nɔ ko ní yaka nɛ́ wa wui he hiɔ; mohu ɔ, wa tsu ní kɛ pɔtɔ.
Wa tsu ní nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ wa ko pee tlomi ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko.
Wa pee enɛ ɔ, pi kaa wa be jamɛ a blɔ nya a, se mohu, konɛ waa ngɔ wa he ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kase wɔ.
Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa wo nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ ke, “Ke nɔ ko sume kaa e ma tsu ní ɔ, e ko ye ní.” Wa ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa wa nu kaa ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ peeɔ hejɔ; a tsu we ní, se mohu a ngɔɔ a nya ngɔ woɔ nihi a sanehi a mi.
Wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ mlaa woe, nɛ wa ngɛ mɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa a ba a je mi saminya, nɛ a kɛ a nine nguɛ nyɔngma nɛ tsu ní nɛ a ye.
Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko ha pɔ nɛ tɔ nyɛ kɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi.
Ke nɔ ko sume kaa e maa ye nɔ́ nɛ wa ngma nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kadi lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko bɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, zo maa gbe lɛ.
Nyɛ ko bu lɛ he nyɛlɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmi.
Nyagbe munyuhi Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ nɛ haa wɔ he jɔmi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ ha nyɛ he jɔmi daa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
Imi Paulo nitsɛ, ye nine nya womi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Womi tsuaa womi nɛ ma ngma a, bɔ nɛ i gbeɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kikɛ nɛ ɔ i ngmaa womi.
I biɔ nyɛ saminya.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si.
NYA TSƆƆMI Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha niheyo Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Timoteo.
E je Asia Mainɔ; e nyɛ ɔ Yuda no, se e tsɛ lɛɛ Hela no ji lɛ.
Timoteo ba piɛ Paulo he kɛ tsu ní, nɛ e nyɛɛ e se kɛ kpa si kɛ fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ. Paulo Kekleekle Womi nɛ e ngma ya ha Timoteo ɔ tuɔ nɔ́ etɛ pɔtɛɛ komɛ a he munyu.
Kekleekle nɔ́ ji, lakpa tsɔɔmi ba te si ngɛ asafo ɔ mi; nɛ e hia kaa Pualo nɛ ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Timoteo nɛ e kɛ tsɛ e juɛmi se ngɛ he.
Yuda bi, kɛ ni kpa komɛ nɛ pi Yuda bi ji mɛ a juɛmi nya a, a heɔ yeɔ kaa yayami hyi je ɔ mi tsuo.
Nɛ loko a ma he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ, e hia kaa nɔ ɔ kó ye ní komɛ, nɛ e kó ngɔ yo hulɔ.
Enyɔne ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sa kaa a to blɔ nya kɛ ha Mawu jami, asafo nɔ hyɛmi, kɛ jehanɛ, bɔ nɛ sa nɛ asafo nya dali, kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ buaa mɛ ɔ nɛ ba a je mi ha.
Nyagbe ɔ, ga nɛ Paulo ngɛ Timoteo woe ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji bɔ nɛ e ba e je mi ha kaa Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa, nɛ kuu slɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ, e hyɛ a nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Ga womi nɛ kɔɔ asafo ɔ, kɛ e nɔ hyɛli a he .—.
Ga womi nɛ kɔɔ Timoteo ní tsumi he .—.
Imi Paulo nɛ ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ngɛ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, nɔ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ ɔ fami nya a, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Timoteo, ye bi nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
