Tsɔɔli nɛ ngɛ tsɔɔmi yaya tsɔɔe ɔ, bɔɔ mɛ kɔkɔ O ma kai kaa benɛ i je Efeso kɛ yaa Makedonia a, i wo mo ga kaa o hi si ngɛ Efeso.
Ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ lakpa tsɔɔmi tsɔɔe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ o hi Efeso, nɛ o bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ nɛ a kpa.
De jamɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ke, sanehi nɛ be mi, kɛ weku kpa tslalaa se dimi ɔ, a jɔɔ be puɛmi ngɛ he.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nya sami nɛ se nami be he nɛ a kɛ baa; blɔ nya nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha wɔ ɔ lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɔ we he kulaa; hemi kɛ yemi kɛkɛ a kɛ leɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo fae ke o pee nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi kɛ tsui nɛ mi tsɔ; wa he nile be wɔ fɔ bue, nɛ wa ma he Kristo maa ye anɔkuale mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ, ni komɛ ngmɛɛ he, nɛ nya sami nɛ he be se nami ha nɛ a tla blɔ.
A hlaa kaa a maa pee a he Mawu mlaa tsɔɔli, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nya mi munyu, aloo níhi a he munyu nɛ a ngɛ tue kɛ kã a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nui sisi.
Mose mlaa a, wɔ tsuo wa le kaa e hi; se e sa kaa a ye nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
E sa kaa wa kai kaa mlaa he hia we nimli kpakpahi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a woɔ mlaa ha ji mlaa tɔli, awi yeli, nihi nɛ li Mawu, yayami peeli, nihi nɛ Mawu mumi be a mi, nihi nɛ gbee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsɛmɛ kɛ a nyɛmɛ, kɛ muɔ si pueli kpahi.
Ni kpahi hu nɛ a woɔ mlaa ha mɛ ji nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, nyumuhi nɛ kɛ nyumuhi hwɔɔ, nɔmlɔ juli, nihi nɛ ngɔɔ nya, nihi nɛ kaa kita kɛ yeɔ lakpa odase, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa a yɛ́.
A naa tsɔɔmi kpakpa nɛ ɔ ngɛ sɛ gbi nɛ haa nɔ hɛ mi baa nyami ɔ mi.
Mawu lɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi ke ma fiɛ.
E sa kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je Mawu yi.
Paulo na Mawu si kaa e na lɛ mɔbɔ I naa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu si kaa e ha mi he wami nɛ ma kɛ tsu ní.
I naa lɛ si kaa e sa e hɛ mi kaa e hla mi nɛ ma ba sɔmɔ lɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa sa a, i tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu; i wa lɛ yi mi, nɛ i pee níhi basabasa.
Se Mawu na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, i he we yi lolo; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ hu i li.
Se wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dloomi babauu ɔ nya a, suɔmi, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu haa nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, imi hu i ná.
Kristo Yesu ba je ɔ mi, konɛ e ba he yayami peeli a yi wami.
Anɔkuale munyu nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ sa kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Imi nitsɛ ɔ, yayami peelɔ kpanaku ji mi pe nihi tsuo.
Se Mawu na mi mɔbɔ.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ ngɔ mi ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ kɛ ha yayami peeli tsuo, kaa e toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e peeɔ kpakpa, konɛ ni kpahi hu nɛ a na kaa neneene wami ɔ, mɛ hu a nine maa su nɔ.
Mawu kake too, Neneene Matsɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa nɛ a nɛ lɛ ɔ, a je e yi, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ ya neneene!
Amen.
Ye bi Timoteo, munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu blema ngɛ o he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ imi hu i ngɛ mo fae ke o pee.
Ha munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee kaa ta hwumi níhi ngɛ o dɛ nɛ o kɛ tsu ní saminya.
O hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa, nɛ o he nile nɛ hi hɛ ngmengmle.
Ni komɛ ya bui a he nile tue, nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ta.
A ti ni komɛ ji Himeneo, kɛ Aleksandro.
I tu mɛ ngɔ wo Abosiami dɛ mi, konɛ a gbla a tue.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ a ma kpa musu bɔmi munyu tumi.
Mawu jami he blɔ nya tomi Kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ pee ji kaa daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, nɛ nyɛɛ da mi ha nihi, konɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ si ha nihi tsuo.
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha matsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya, konɛ wɔ nɛ wa ji Kristo we bi ɔ, waa pee wa he kpoo, nɛ waa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Waa ye Mawu gbeye saminya, nɛ waa ba wa je mi bɔ nɛ sa.
Sɔlemi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hi, nɛ e saa Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi.
Ejakaa Mawu suɔ kaa nimli tsuo nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ, konɛ a he a yi wami.
Mawu kake kɛkɛ lɛ ngɛ, kɛ nɔ kake nɛ dlaa Mawu kɛ adesa a kpɛti.
Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ji Kristo Yesu.
Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi, konɛ nimli tsuo nɛ a ye a he kɛ je yayami mi.
Enɛ ɔ he hu nɛ Mawu tsɔ mi kaa bɔfo, konɛ ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ a he Kristo nɛ a ye anɔkuale mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi; i yi lakpa.
He tsuaa he nɛ asafo ɔ ma bua a he nya ngɛ kɛ ja Mawu ɔ, nyumuhi nɛ a sɔle.
E hia kaa a pee Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ ngɔ a he kɛ ha Mawu kulaa.
Ke a ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, a wo a nine nɔ, nɛ mi mi la kó hi mi; nɛ a ko hla kaa a maa sã nya ngɛ nɔ́ ko he.
Jã kɛ̃ i suɔ kaa yihi hu nɛ a ngɔ juɛmi kɛ to a he dlami he.
A dla a he bɔ nɛ sa kɛkɛ kaa humi.
A gbɔ a yi ngɛ hɛngmɛ nɔ.
A ko ngɔ sika tsu, loo adiagba kɛ hɔɔ a yi mi; nɛ a ko wo tade nɛ he jua wa tsɔ hulɔ.
Se mohu a tsu ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ sa yihi nɛ ngɔ a he kɛ ha Mawu kulaa a. E sa kaa yo nɛ ba e he si, nɛ e pee kpoo kɛ kase ní.
I ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa yo nɛ tsɔɔ ní, loo e ye nyumu nɔ; e pee dii.
Ejakaa Adam nɛ a bɔ kekle loko a bɔ Hawa.
Jehanɛ hu, pi Adam nɛ a sisi; yo ɔ mohu nɛ a sisi, nɛ e tɔ Mawu mlaa a.
Se ke yo ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ he Mawu ye, nɛ e suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu kɛ humi ɔ, Mawu ma he e yi wami kɛ gu bimɛ nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ a nɔ.
Subai nɛ sa Mawu we asafo nɔ hyɛli Anɔkuale sane ji kaa ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa hyɛ Mawu asafo nɔ ɔ, e na ní tsumi kpakpa.
Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, sé kó hi e he.
É hi yo kake; é le e he nɔ hyɛmi; e hɛ mi nɛ ka si, nɛ bu nɛ hi e he.
É le nubwɔ peemi, nɛ e nyɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ ní hulɔ.
E ko pee e he dã delɔ; nɛ e ko pee nɔ nɛ hɛ mi jɔɛ, loo nɔ nɛ suɔ pɛ.
E ko pee e he sika suɔlɔ.
E pee nɔ ko nɛ le lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ hyɛmi saminya, nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ nɛ e bimɛ maa ba a he si, nɛ a bu nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ hyɛ Mawu asafo ɔ nɔ.
E ko pee nɔ ko nɛ tsake e tsui kɛ we.
Ke pi ja a, e ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ Mawu maa gbla e tue kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Abosiami ɔ. Asafo nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, é ba e je mi saminya, konɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ja we Mawu tete po nɛ a hɛɛ e biɛ kpakpa mi.
Ke pi ja a, e ma pue e hɛ mi si, kɛkɛ e sɛ Abosiami klama mi.
Asafo ɔ mi sɔmɔli kpahi Asafo ɔ mi sɔmɔli nɛ yeɔ bua a, e hia kaa a pee nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, pi nihi nɛ a nya ngɛ enyɔɔnyɔ.
A ko nu wai tsɔ, nɛ a hɛ ko tsu ngɛ sika he hulɔ.
Anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, á hɛɛ mi bɔ nɛ a he nile be mɛ fɔ bue.
A ka mɛ hu nɛ a hyɛ a subai kekle, nɛ ke sane ko be a he ɔ, a sɔmɔ.
Sɔmɔli yi ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu a pee nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ a ko ye sieku.
A pee nihi nɛ a hɛ ka si, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
Asafo mi sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, é hi yo kake pɛ, nɛ e nyɛ nɛ e hyɛ e we, kɛ e bimɛ a nɔ saminya.
Sɔmɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya a, a naa biɛ kpakpa.
Nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a ngɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu kɛ kã.
Laami sane nguaa I ngɛ mo ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, se e be kɛe nɛ ma ba o ngɔ.
Se ke ye se ya kɛ ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ sa nɛ wɔ Kristo we bi waa ba wa je mi ha.
Mawu weku ɔ mi bi ji wɔ, nɛ wɔ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ we asafo.
Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ, asafo ɔ nɔ nɛ a fia ngɔ fɔ, nɛ asafo ɔ nɛ faa he.
Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ wa jami ɔ he ɔ ji laami sane nguaa; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa je he nɔ́.
Kristo ba je nɛ ɔ mi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa; E ye nguɔ ngɛ mumi mi; E je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Mawu bɔfohi.
A fiɛ lɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti; A he lɛ ye ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ nyami mi.
Lakpa tsɔɔmihi Mawu mumi ɔ deɔ paa ke, nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ni komɛ ma kua Kristo, nɔ nɛ a he ye ɔ, nɛ a ma ya nyɛɛ mumi yayamihi mohu a se; a maa bu lakpa munyuhi, kɛ tsɔɔmi yayamihi tue.
A maa pee a he lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ nɔ sisili nɛ a he nile gbo pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a nɔ sisili nɛ ɔmɛ deɔ ke Kristo we bi be he blɔ kaa a sɛɛ gba si himi mi; kɛ jehanɛ hu, niye ní komɛ ngɛ nɛ e sɛ kaa a yeɔ.
Se wɔ nɛ wa heɔ Kristo yeɔ saminya a, wa le anɔkuale ɔ kaa Mawu bɔ niye ní tsuo ha wɔ kaa waa ye faa, nɛ waa na lɛ si ngɛ he.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ hi.
Wa ko kua ekoeko; mohu ɔ, wa sɔ́le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ waa na Mawu si ngɛ he.
Ejakaa Mawu munyu ɔ, kɛ si nɛ wa naa Mawu ɔ haa niye ní ɔ he tsɔɔ.
Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ kpakpa Mawu munyu ɔ kasemi, kɛ Kristo hemi kɛ yemi nɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛɛ mi kpɛii ɔ ma ha mo mumi mi he wami.
Ke o tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a le ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ kpakpa ji mo.
Se yimowi a yakayaka nyaziahi nɛ se nami be he ɔ, koo di se.
Bɔɔ Mawu jami he mɔde mohu.
Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he mi kami ɔ, se nami bɔɔ kɛkɛ lɛ ngɛ he, se mumi mi nɔ́ ɔ lɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a wo si ɔ, e he ngɛ se nami babauu ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a mi tete.
Anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a pɛtɛ he kulaa, nɛ a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wa gboɔ dengme kɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ, ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ.
Lɛ ji nihi tsuo a yi wami helɔ, titli ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ. Tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ a he kita.
Ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ gbe o he guɛ kaa niheyo kɛkɛ ji mo.
Se mohu bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o munyu tumi, o je mi bami, suɔmi nɛ o ngɛ, o hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ bɔ nɛ o he tsɔ ɔ nɛ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ. Yaa nɔ nɛ o hi ngmami ɔ kanee ha asafo ɔ; hii munyu ɔ fiɛe, nɛ o hi mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ba.
Mumi mi níhi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo mo kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ benɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ a nine kɛ pue o yi mi ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o tsu a he ní daa.
Ngɔɔ o he wami tsuo kɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ be tsuaa be, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a na o mɔde bɔmi.
Timoteo, hyɛ mo nitsɛ o he nɔ saminya; nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ hu hyɛ nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Ejakaa ke o pee ja a, o ma he mo nitsɛ o yi wami, kɛ nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ hulɔ.
Bɔ nɛ sa nɛ Timoteo kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a hi si Ko ka nyumu nɔkɔtɔma hɛ mi; se mohu tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ o tsɛ maa tu munyu.
Nihewi hu o kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ mo nitsɛ o nyɛminyumuhi maa hi si.
Yi nikɔtɔma amɛ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si kaa mo nitsɛ o nyɛmɛ, nɛ o kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ hi si kaa o nyɛmiyihi; se hyɛ nɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kó ba je mi.
Yalɔyihi nɛ be nɔ ko ɔ, moo bu mɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
Se ke yalɔyo ko ngɛ bimɛ, loo bibimɛ ɔ, bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ bibimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a le kaa ngɛ Mawu jami blɔ nya tomi nya a, kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a peeɔ ha a fɔli ji a hyɛ a nɔ.
A pee enɛ ɔ kɛ to fɔli ɔmɛ nane mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi.
Yalɔyo nɛ lɛ nɔ kake too e ngɛ, nɛ e be nɔ ko nɛ maa hyɛ e nɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ.
E sɔlee nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ kpaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ e ye bua lɛ.
Se yalɔyo nɛ fiɛɔ e yi nɔ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ lɛɛ, se e gbo momo.
Tsɔɔ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó tu a he munyu yaya.
Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ hyɛ we e nyɛmimɛ a nɔ, titli ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ɔ, blɔɔ e ngmɛɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
Afani nɔ nɛ he we Kristo yi ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he.
A ko ngma yalɔyo ko biɛ, lɛɛ ja nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi ekpa, nɛ e gba si kake pɛ.
É pee yo nɛ he biɛ kaa e peeɔ kpakpa, yo nɛ nyɛ tsɔse bimɛ saminya, yo nɛ nyɛ hyɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to lɛ, yo nɛ sɔmɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ he si bami, yo nɛ je nihi kɛ je haomi mi, nɛ ngɔ e be tsuo kɛ tsu ní kpakpahi.
Se yalɔyi nɛ wɛ ɔ, koo ngma a biɛ, ejakaa ke gba ngɛ mɛ jloe ɔ, a maa ngmɛɛ Kristo he ma ya gba.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a yeɔ fɔ kaa si nɛ a wo Kristo ke a be gbae kulaa hu ɔ, a yi nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ se hu a puɛɔ be kɛ hii nihi a we mi kpae.
Nɔ́ nɛ pe enɛ ɔ po ji kaa a yeɔ sieku; a jeɔ si, nɛ a ngɔɔ a nya kɛ woɔ nihi a munyu mi; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ sɛ́ kaa a deɔ hu, a maa hi dee putɛputɛɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ mohu kaa yalɔyihi nɛ wɛ lolo ɔ, a gba nɛ a fɔ bimɛ; nɛ a hyɛ a we nɔ saminya, konɛ wa he nyɛli ko na he blɔ ko kulaa kɛ tu munyu yaya kɛ si wɔ.
I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa yalɔyi komɛ kpale ya nyɛɛ Satan se momo.
Se ke yo Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ko ngɛ yalɔyihi nɛ peeɔ e weku li ɔ, e hyɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ko ngɔ tlomi ngɔ fɔ asafo ɔ nɔ.
Yalɔyihi nɛ be nɔ ko nɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ ɔ, asafo ɔ nɛ bɔ a he mɔde.
Asafo nikɔtɔmahi nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya, titli ni nɛmɛ nɛ fiɛɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ ní hulɔ ɔ, a hyɛ nɛ a wo a hɛ mi nyami totoe enyɔ.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Na nɛ ngɛ blɛfo gblɛe ha mo ɔ, koo fi e nya.” Ngmami kpa hu deɔ ke, “Ní tsulɔ ɔ, e hiɔwo sa lɛ.” Ke nɔ ko ba po asafo nɔkɔtɔma ko nya ha mo ɔ, koo nu, ja nihi enyɔ, loo etɛ ba ye odase kɛ si lɛ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, ka a hɛ mi ngɛ asafo ɔ tsuo hɛ mi, kɛkɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ maa ye gbeye.
Ngɛ Mawu, kɛ Kristo Yesu, kɛ bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ mo kita kae nɛ o ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee ɔ, koo hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ hu, ko ha nɛ nɔ ko ní peepee nɛ sa o hɛ mi pe nɔ kpa nɔ́.
Koo ye esɔ kaa o maa ngɔ o nine kɛ pue nɔ ko nɔ kɛ wo lɛ asafo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ e tsu ní ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Ke nɔ ko ngɛ yayami pee ɔ, ko ya piɛ e he.
Pee o he klɔuklɔu.
Akɛnɛ o muklii mi haoɔ mo, nɛ o pɔɔ hiɔ numi kpitikpiti he je ɔ, koo nu nyu sɔuu hu, se mohu nuu wai bɔɔ.
Ni komɛ a yayami jeɔ kpo paa, nɛ a kɛ buu mɛ fɔ nɔuu, se ni komɛ lɛɛ pee se loko a nɔ́ jeɔ kpo.
Jã kɛ̃ nɔ́ kpakpa hu jeɔ kpo paa nɛ a naa; nɛ níhi nɛ ji kpo paa hu, a nyɛ we nɛ a laa nɔ.
Sɔmɔli tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ, ha nɛ a bu a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ná he blɔ nɛ e tu munyu yaya kɛ si Mawu, loo Kristo jami ɔ. Nyɔguɛhi nɛ le Kristo, nɛ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu le Kristo ɔ, a ko susu kaa akɛnɛ mɛ tsuo Kristo we bi ji mɛ he je ɔ, e hia we kaa a buɔ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tue.
Mɛ mohu nɛ e sa kaa a bu a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya; ejakaa a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ naa a he se ɔ, mɛ hu wa nyɛmimɛ Kristo we bi ji mɛ.
Lakpa tsɔɔmi kɛ sika suɔmi Tsɔɔ mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a tsu he ní bɔ nɛ sa.
Ni komɛ ngɛ tsɔɔmi kpa komɛ tsɔɔe nɛ pi wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sane kpakpa a nitsɛ, loo Mawu jami tsɔɔmi tutuutu.
Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a he nɔ kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɛ woe; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ.
A suɔ nɛ a wo pɛ, nɛ a sã nya babauu ngɛ níhi a he.
Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ a hɛ kɔɔ a sibi a nɔ; a nɔɔ kunɔ, nɛ a jɛɔ a he basabasa; yayami sɔuu a susuu ngɛ a sibi a he; nɛ a sãã nya be tsuaa be.
A juɛmi be tutuutu, nɛ a li nɔ nɛ ji anɔkuale hu.
E peeɔ mɛ kaa Mawu jami ji blɔ ko nɛ a guu nɔ kɛ naa ní kpɔtɔɔ.
Se niinɛ, ní nami agbo ji Mawu jami, ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e níhi a he ɔ. Ejakaa waa kɛ nɔ́ ko bɛ je nɛ ɔ mi; nɛ e fɔɔ si paa kaa wa be nyɛe waa kɛ nɔ́ ko maa ya hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa ngɛ nya mi ngma, kɛ heha ní kɛkɛ ɔ, e hiɛ ha wɔ hluu.
Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a na ní ɔ, a sɛɛ ka mi.
A ya dii kuasia níhi, kɛ akɔnɔ yayami se.
Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi taa, nɛ a hɛ mi kpataa.
Ejakaa sika suɔmi ji yayamihi tsuo a sipoku.
Ni komɛ kɛ hɛdɔ ya di sika se, nɛ a ngmɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
Nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba kɛkɛ ji tsui yemi babauu.
Paulo wo Timoteo ga Se moo lɛɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔde: dami sane yemi, Mawu suɔmi nya ní peemi, hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi, tsui si tomi, kɛ he si bami.
Hwuu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he ta kpakpa a, konɛ o nine nɛ su neneene wami ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu tsɛ mo nɛ o ba ye Kristo he odase wawɛɛ ngɛ nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
- I ngɛ mo fae ngɛ Mawu, kɛ Kristo Yesu hɛ mi kaa o ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ veveeve kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba.
Mawu lɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ wami, nɛ Kristo Yesu ye Mawu he odase wawɛɛ ngɛ Pontio Pilato hɛ mi.
Ke be ɔ su ɔ, Mawu ma ha Kristo Yesu maa ba.
Mawu pɛ ji je ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ nɛ pe kulaa.
Lɛ ji matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ tsuo a nyɔmtsɛ.
E ma je Kristo kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e be nɛ e to nɛ sa a mi.
Lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa nɛ e be gboe gblegbleegble; nɛ la nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su he ɔ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Nɔmlɔ adesa ko adesa ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, nɛ adesa ko be nyɛe maa na lɛ hulɔ.
A je e yi daa; e maa ye tsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene!
Amen.
Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, nyɛɛ a nɔ nɛ a ko wo a he nɔ.
Á ko ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ní nɛ a na a nɔ, ejakaa ní nami se maa po.
Á ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu mohu nɔ.
Lɛ nɛ e haa wɔ ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ wa yeɔ faa.
A ko pee kpɛle, se a bɔle nine ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Ke a pee ja a, a maa to juetli kpakpa si ha a he kɛ ha hwɔɔ se; nɛ a nine maa su wami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɔ.
Timoteo, níhi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, baa yi saminya.
Yakayaka ní sɛɛmi nɛ tsɔɔ we Mawu gbeye yemi, kɛ nya sami tslalaa nɛ juɛmi be mi ɔ, yu o he ngɛ he.
Kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ lɛ ni komɛ buu ke nile.
Enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ni komɛ susu kaa a nine su nɔ ɔ ha nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ bɔ mɛ.
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!
NYA TSƆƆMI Paulo ngma e womi enyɔne ɔ titli kaa slɔmi kɛ ha Timoteo, kaa e nyɛmi wayoo ní tsulɔ, kɛ e he piɛlɔ.
Womi ɔ we oti ji tsui nami.
Paulo wo Timoteo ga, nɛ e wo lɛ he wami kaa e ya nɔ nɛ e ye Yesu Kristo he odase saminya.
E de lɛ ke, anɔkuale tsɔɔmi nɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a, kɛ somi momo ɔ mi ɔ, e pɛtɛ he saminya, nɛ e tsu he ní bɔ nɛ sa kaa tsɔɔlɔ, kɛ Mawu munyu fiɛlɔ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a peemi mi ɔ, e maa na nɔ́, nɛ nihi maa te si kɛ wo lɛ.
Paulo slɔ Timoteo kaa e hyɛ saminya ngɛ yi mi flɛflɛ ní sɛɛmi, kɛ nya sami nɛ juɛmi be mi he.
Ejakaa se nami be he, nɛ nihi nɛ buɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tue ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, Paulo ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e wami, kɛ e yi mi tomi nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ kɛ ma Timoteo hɛ mi kaa nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́.
Lɔ ɔmɛ ji e hemi kɛ yemi, tsui si tomi, suɔmi, tsui nami, kɛ nɔ́ nami, be mi nɛ a ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Yi jemi kɛ slɔmi .—.
Ga womi kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi .—.
Paulo nitsɛ he sane .- Nyagbe .-
Imi Paulo nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ngɛ wami nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi nɛ a wo he si ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Timoteo, ye bi nɛ i suɔ mo saminya.
Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Paulo na Mawu si, nɛ e wo Timoteo he wami Mawu ɔ nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe kɛ ye tsui tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, i naa lɛ si.
Daa nyɔ kɛ pia ke i ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i kaiɔ mo.
Ke i kai o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ, i hlaa wawɛɛ kaa ma na mo, konɛ ye bua nɛ jɔ.
I kaiɔ o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o hɛɛ mi anɔkuale mi kaa bɔ nɛ o nã Loise, kɛ o nyɛ Eunike hu hɛɛ mi ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ngɛ mo kaie kaa Mawu nike ní nɛ e kɛ dloo mo benɛ i ngɔ ye nine kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ, o tsu he ní saminya.
Ejakaa mumi nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ ha we nɛ wa yeɔ gbeye; mohu e ji mumi nɛ woɔ wɔ he wami, nɛ haa wa suɔ nɔmlɔ, nɛ wa yeɔ wa he nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko ha nɛ odase nɛ o maa ye ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ nɛ pee mo zo.
Imi hu nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, ye he ko pee mo zo.
Mohu ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o na nɔ́ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nae ɔ, nɛ Mawu ma ha mo he wami nɛ o kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Mawu he wa yi wami, nɛ e tsɛ wɔ, konɛ wa ba pee e nihi.
Pi nɔ́ kpakpa ko nɛ wa pee he je, se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi nya nɛ e dloo wɔ.
Wa ná kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ blema lokoo loko a bɔ je ɔ. Jehanɛ lɛɛ, e jé e dloomi ɔ kpo paa ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kɛ gu wa yi wami helɔ Kristo Yesu bami nɔ.
Kristo Yesu gu sane kpakpa a nɔ nɛ e ha gbenɔ se po; nɛ e ngɔ wami ba ha wɔ, konɛ wa ko gbo gblegbleegble.
Mawu pee mi bɔfo kɛ tsɔɔlɔ, konɛ ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a, nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae nɛ ɔ nɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye nine mi wui nyu; ejakaa nɔ nɛ i he ye ɔ, i le lɛ.
I heɔ yeɔ kaa sane kpakpa a fiɛmi ɔ nɛ e tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, e maa bu he kɛ yaa su nyagbe ligbi ɔ. Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ɔ, pɛtɛ he kaa nɔhyɛ nɔ́, nɛ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ wa na kɛ gu Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, koo ngmɛɛ he.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ ngɛ wa mi ɔ, é wo mo he wami, konɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, o bu he.
Kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Asia a tsuo kpa ngɛ ye se; a ti ni komɛ ji Figelo kɛ Hermogene.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na Onesiforo kɛ e we ɔ mɔbɔ; ejakaa ke e ngɛ mi hluu ɔ, e ba woɔ mi bua.
Tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ pee we lɛ zo.
Benɛ e ná ba su Roma pɛ nɛ e bɔni mi hlami hluu kɛ ya si e ba na mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na lɛ mɔbɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e sɔmɔ mi saminya ngɛ Efeso ɔ, o hɛ ji nɔ.
Kristo Yesu ta bulɔ kpakpa Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, nɛ Mawu dloo wɔ nɛ wa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, o he nɛ wa.
Níhi nɛ o nu nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ, tsɔɔ nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu, konɛ mɛ hu a tsɔɔ ni kpahi.
Mia o hɛ mi kɛ na nɔ́ kaa Kristo Yesu ta bulɔ kpakpa.
Ke ta bulɔ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ, e suɔ kaa e maa pee nɔ́ nɛ maa sa e tatsɛ ɔ hɛ mi be tsuaa be; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e peeɔ klaalo kɛ haa e tatsɛ ɔ pɛ; e kɛ e he wui ma mi sanehi a mi.
Loko fo dalɔ ko nine maa su kunimi yemi jlasi nɔ ɔ, ja e ye fo dami he mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ gboɔ dengme kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, lɛ kekle e yeɔ ngmɔ niba ní ɔ eko.
Susuu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ he, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma ha nɛ o nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ sisi.
Kai kaa Yesu Kristo, Matsɛ David nina nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ he sane kpakpa a ji nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ.
Sane nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae; a wo mi kɔsɔkɔsɔ tete po kaa nɔ́ nɛ awi yelɔ ji mi.
Se Mawu munyu ɔ fiɛmi lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa tsi nya.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i toɔ ye tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, nɛ i naa nɔ́ ngɛ nihi nɛ Mawu hla a a he, konɛ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ, a he mɛ hu a yi wami, nɛ a nine nɛ su hɛ mi nyami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɔ.
Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke waa kɛ lɛ gbo ɔ, waa kɛ lɛ maa hi wami mi hulɔ.
Ke wa mia wa hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ nami mi ɔ, waa kɛ lɛ maa ye matsɛ hulɔ.
Ke wa kua lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e ma kua wɔ.
Ke wa yi anɔkuale ɔ, lɛɛ anɔkuale pɛ e yeɔ daa, ejakaa e be nyɛe maa ye lakpa kɛ si lɛ nitsɛ e he.” Ní tsulɔ kpakpa Kaii mɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
Bɔɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ke a ko pɛ ngɛ munyuhi a he, ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi kɛ bɛ, se mohu jamɛ a munyu ɔmɛ gbeɔ e nuli ɔmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi.
Bɔɔ mɔde wawɛɛ kaa ní tsulɔ kpakpa, konɛ Mawu nɛ ná o he bua jɔmi.
E ko pee mo zo kulaa kaa o maa tsɔɔ anɔkuale munyu ɔ saminya.
Se yakayaka ní sɛɛmi nɛ tsɔɔ we Mawu gbeye yemi ɔ, yu o he kɛ je he; ejakaa e haa nɛ nihi hɛɔ a he kɛ jeɔ Mawu he kulaa mohu.
Bɔ nɛ pa yaya gbo we gblee, se e hiaa kɛ haa si mohu ɔ, ja lɛ jamɛ a ní sɛɛmi yaya amɛ a mi sanehi gbɛɛ fĩaa.
Ni enyɔ komɛ nɛ tsɔɔ lakpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji Himeneo kɛ Fileto.
A tla blɔ kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ he, nɛ a ngɛ dee ke be ɔ nɛ gbogboehi maa te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ be momo.
A ngɔ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ Kristo we bi babauu a hemi kɛ yemi hɛ mi kpatae.
Se tsu sisi tomi tɛ nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ ma si ha hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he wa, nɛ e be mimiɛe.
Munyu nɛ a kɛ sɔu tɛ ɔ nya ji, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le lɛ nitsɛ e nihi.” Ekpa hu deɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ deɔ ke Mawu nɔ́ ji lɛ ɔ, é kpa yayami peemi.” Pi sika tsu níhi, kɛ sika hiɔ níhi kɛkɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ we ngua mi, se mohu nyu yɛmi níhi nɛ a gbɔ, kɛ ekomɛ hu nɛ a puɛ hii mi.
A kɛ ekomɛ tsuɔ ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ a buu, nɛ ekpa komɛ lɛɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní be saisaa.
Ke nɔ ko tsu e he, nɛ e kpa yayami peemi ɔ, a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ be titli ko nɛ a buu mi, ejakaa e tsu e he saminya, nɛ e plɛ pee nyu yɛmi nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma nyɛ maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ tsu ní tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ní tsumi kpakpa be tsuaa be.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihewi a we akɔnɔ yaya a, yu o he kɛ je he kulaa, nɛ o kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ Kristo anɔkuale nɛ bɔ.
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya kaa Kristo we bi nɛ yeɔ dami sane, nɛ tsuɔ a hemi kɛ yemi he ní; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛɛ hi si saminya ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Kuasiahi a nɔ́ jemi nɛ a kase we nɔ́ kpakpa ko kɛ ji mi ɔ, tuu nya fo, ejakaa o le kaa nɔ́ jemi ɔ, kunɔ e kɛ baa.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, e sɛ́ kaa e pɛɔ, mohu ɔ, e mi nɛ jɔ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ; e pee ní tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa nɛ toɔ e tsui si.
Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, e sa kaa e pee nɔ nɛ kɛ mi mi jɔmi tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi nɛ tee si kɛ siɔ lɛ ɔ. Alini Mawu maa na jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ nɛ a tsake a tsui, konɛ a ba le anɔkuale ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa hɛli a he si, nɛ klama nɛ Abosiami tsɔ ha mɛ kaa a pee e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ya nɔ mi ɔ, a ya be mi nɔe.
A bɔ Timoteo lakpa tsɔɔmi he kɔkɔ O hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, je mi maa wa.
Nihi ma hla kaa a ma fo mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a nɔ mi; a maa pee a he sika suɔli, fĩali, he woli, kɛ lilɛtsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ bui a fɔli, nihi nɛ li sina, kɛ nihi nɛ Mawu jami pi a he sane ko.
Nihi maa pee a ní kaa nɔ́ nɛ pi adesahi kulaa ji mɛ, nihi nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko be a mi, nihi a biɛ puɛli, nihi nɛ peeɔ basabasa nɛ a li zo, awi yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ sume nɔ́ kpakpa.
Nimli maa pee a he nɔ se blɔ tsɔɔli, nihi nɛ bui nɔ́, he nɔ woli, kɛ nihi nɛ suɔ je mi akɔnɔ pe bɔ nɛ a suɔ Mawu, nihi nɛ tsɛɔ a he Mawu jali, se anɔkuale mi ɔ, a bui e mi he wami ɔ kulaa.
Nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, yu o he kɛ je a he.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ yaa nihi a we mi, nɛ a ya puɛɔ yihi juɛmi flɛflɛtsɛmɛ a yi mi.
Yi nɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami plɛ tlomi ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ ngɛ akɔnɔ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ mɛ gblae ɔ a he.
Daa nɛ ɔ, yi nɛ ɔmɛ bɔɔ mɔde kaa a maa kase ní, se anɔkuale ɔ lɛɛ a be lee gblegbleegble.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Yane kɛ Yambre te si kɛ wo Mose ɔ, ja nɔuu nɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu te si kɛ ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ nya tsie.
Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a juɛmi mi kuɔ we ɔ, a hemi kɛ yemi hu gbo.
Se a be he ko sue, ejakaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ nihi maa na kaa kuasia kɛkɛ a ngɛ jee.
Nɔ́ nɛ ba Yane kɛ Yambre a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu maa ba mɛ hu a nɔ.
Nyagbe slɔmi Se Timoteo, moo lɛɛ, ní nɛ i tsɔɔ, bɔ nɛ i baa ye je mi, oti nɛ i kɛ fɔ ye hɛ mi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i heɔ yeɔ ɔ, o le.
O le bɔ nɛ i toɔ ye tsui si, bɔ nɛ i suɔ nɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ ye hɛ mi ka si.
O le bɔ nɛ a wa mi yi mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ i na nɔ́.
O le níhi nɛ ba ye nɔ ngɛ Antiokia, Ikonium, kɛ Listra; o le bɔ nɛ a tua mi wawɛɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ; se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je mi kɛ je ní ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.
Niinɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e pee e he Mawu jalɔ nɛ le Kristo Yesu ɔ, a maa wa lɛ yi mi.
Nimli yayamihi, kɛ nɔ sisili maa ya nɔ maa pee yayami kɛ be nɔ; a maa sisi nihi hluu kɛ yaa si a maa sisi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he.
Se moo lɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo nɛ o he ye ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o pɛtɛ he.
Nihi nɛ tsɔɔ mo ní ɔ, o le mɛ.
O kai kaa kɛ je o jokuɛ mi tɔɔ o le ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔ ma ha nɛ o maa le ní, nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ o heɔ yeɔ ɔ ma he o yi wami.
Ngmami tsuaa ngmami ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ ha nɛ nihi ngma; nɛ e hi kɛ ha ní tsɔɔmi, kɛ ha hɛ mi kami, kɛ ha nɔ dlami, kɛ tsɔsemi nɛ ma ha nɔ nɛ ba e je mi saminya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔlɔ ɔ maa hi kɛ pi si, nɛ e he maa su kɛ tsu nɔ́ kpakpa.
I ngɛ Mawu, kɛ Kristo Yesu odase tsɛe kɛ ngɛ mo ga woe.
Kristo ma ba ye matsɛ; e ma ba kojo nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o fiɛ sɛ gbi ɔ be tsuaa be nɛ o ko kpa.
Ke o ngɛ munyu ɔ fiɛe ɔ, ná tsui kɛ tsɔɔ tue buli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nya konɛ a na nya saminya.
Ka ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ o wo mɛ ga ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Be ma nɛ nihi be suɔe kaa a maa bu tsɔɔmi kpakpa tue.
Mohu ɔ, a ma hla ní tsɔɔli ha a he; a ma hla nihi nɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ níhi nɛ maa ngɔ ngɛ a tue mi.
A be suɔe kulaa kaa a maa nu anɔkuale ɔ; a ma hla kaa a maa bu nyazia mohu tue.
Se moo lɛɛ, o hɛ nɛ ka si be tsuaa be.
Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, to o tsui si.
Bɔɔ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi he mɔde wawɛɛ, konɛ o pee Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa.
Imi lɛɛ a miɔ nɛ a ngɔ mi kɛ sã bɔ.
Ee, be ɔ nɛ ma je je ɔ mi ɔ su.
Ta kpakpa a, i hwu; i tu fo ɔ tsuo gbe nya.
I pɛtɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ngɔ ye hiɔwo nɛ ji jlasi nɛ e kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a ngɔ to ha mi.
Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ maa ngɔ ye jlasi ɔ ngɔ ha mi.
Pi imi nɔ kake pɛ nɛ e ma ha, se mohu e ma ha nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ a ngɛ e bami ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ. Paulo nitsɛ he sane Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ ngɛ be kpiti mi; ejakaa Dema lɛɛ e ya suɔ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ je nɛ ɔ, nɛ e je ye he kɛ ho Tesalonika ya.
Kreske ho Galatia ya, nɛ Tito hu ho Dalmatia ya.
Luka pɛ lɛ ngɛ ye ngɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Hla Marko nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba, ejakaa e he hia saminya ngɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔ he.
Tihiko lɛɛ i tsɔ lɛ Efeso.
I si ye tade klɔii ɔ kɛ ha Karpo ngɛ Troya; ke o ma a, ngɔɔ kɛ ba.
Ngɔɔ womi ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba, titli ɔ, ní nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɔ lohwe he womi kɛ pee ɔ. Aleksandro, sɔlɔ ɔ ye mi sane yaya ko; nɔ́ yeyee nɛ e pee mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ wo lɛ hiɔ.
Moo hyɛ o he ngɛ e he, ejakaa e te si wawɛɛ ngɔ si munyu ɔ nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ. Kekleekle nɛ i ya fa ye he ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ mi yɛ.
Mɛ tsuo a si mi; Mawu kó gbla a tue ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.
Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ ye he, nɛ e wo mi he wami, nɛ i nyɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a kɛ ha ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu je mi kɛ je gbenɔ nya mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ee, e je mi kɛ je gbenɔ mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je mi kɛ maa je ní yayamihi tsuo a mi, nɛ e kɛ mi maa ya hiɔwe he nɛ e ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ ɔ fiafiaafia.
A maa wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ maa ya neneene.
Amen.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi I biɔ Priskila, Akuila, kɛ Onesiforo kɛ e we ɔ tsuo saminya.
Erasto tlɔ Korinto, se Trofimo lɛɛ i si lɛ ngɛ Mileto, ejakaa e be he wami.
Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba loko fĩɛ be ɔ nɛ su.
Eubulo, Pude, Lino, kɛ Klaudia ke a biɔ mo.
Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ke mɛ hu a biɔ mo.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ gbaa mo.
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!
NYA TSƆƆMI Tito ɔ, ma je no ji lɛ, nɛ e ba tsake e tsui nɛ e pee Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ.
E piɛ Paulo he kɛ tsu ní, nɛ e nyɛɛ e se kɛ kpa si kɛ fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ. Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha niheyo Tito, e he piɛlɔ nɛ ngɛ Kreta, he nɛ e si lɛ ngɛ konɛ e hyɛ asafo ɔ nɔ ɔ. Womi ɔ tuɔ nɔ́ etɛ titli komɛ a he munyu.
Kekleekle ɔ, Paulo ngɛ Tito kaie bɔ nɛ sa kaa asafo nya dali nɛ a ba a je mi ha.
Paulo hɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ, ejakaa Kreta bi babauu be subai kulaa.
Enyɔne ɔ, Paulo ngɛ Tito ga woe bɔ nɛ e ma plɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kuu slɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ ní, nyumu nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ yi nikɔtɔmahi, nihewi, kɛ nyɔguɛhi.
(Yihewi ɔmɛ lɛɛ yi nikɔtɔma amɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ ní).
Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo ngɛ Tito ga woe ngɛ je mi bami nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛli he.
Titli ɔ, e hia kaa a kɛ nihi nɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi kaa huɛmɛ; a ko nyɛ nɔ, a kɛ nihi kó sã nya, nɛ a ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ kɛ mi gbami maa ba asafo ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Asafo nya dali .- Kuu slɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ a ní tsumihi .- Yi jemi kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi .- Nyagbe .-
Imi Paulo, Mawu tsɔlɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ. Mawu hla mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi, konɛ ma ya wo nihi nɛ Mawu hla mɛ ɔ a hemi kɛ yemi mi he wami, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu jami mi.
Wa ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa enɛ ɔ ma ha wɔ neneene wami.
Mawu nɛ yi lakpa a wo si kaa e ma ha wɔ kikɛmɛ a neneene wami nɛ ɔ be nɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be nɛ sa mi ɔ, e ha nɛ siwo nɛ ɔ ba mi kɛ gu e sane kpakpa a nɛ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ i ngɛ fiɛe, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ fa mi ke ma pee ɔ. I ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ha mo Tito, ye bi nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ nɛ i kɛ mo tsuo wa hɛɛ mi ɔ mi.
Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Kristo Yesu dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Tito ní tsumi ngɛ Kreta I si mo ngɛ Kreta, konɛ níhi nɛ piɛ ɔ, o to blɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ o wo asafo nya dali ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi.
Mo kai níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ. Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, e pee nɔ ko nɛ piami be e he, nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo kake pɛ, nɛ e bimɛ le Kristo.
Bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nihi nɛ a yeɔ a he odase kpakpa; pi yaholi, loo nihi nɛ tsɔɔ atuã.
Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, akɛnɛ Mawu ní tsumi nɔ e ngɛ hyɛe he je ɔ, e sɛ kaa piami ko hii e he.
E ko pee nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ, loo nɔ nɛ tsui fiaa mlamlaamla, loo dã tɔlɔ, loo kunɔ nɔlɔ, loo nɔ ko nɛ dii sika se tsɔ.
Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, e pee nɔ nɛ peeɔ nibwɔ, nɛ e suɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɔ nɛ juɛmi ka si, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; nɔ nɛ ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu kulaa, nɛ e yeɔ e he nɔ.
Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e he ye ɔ, e hɛɛ mi wawɛɛ.
Ke e pee jã loko lɛ hu e ma nyɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ní nɛ he tsɔ saminya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ teɔ si siɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ mɛ a tɔmi.
Ejakaa nihi babauu tsɔ atuã, nɛ a ngɛ yakayaka munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nihi sisie.
Nihi nɛ deɔ ke ja a po nɔ ɔ, mɛ titli lɛ a ngɛ ní nɛ ɔ tsue.
E hia kaa a ku nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nya la, ejakaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ ngɛ wehi fuu a nane kpatae.
A ngɛ níhi nɛ dɛ blɔ tsɔɔe.
Blɔɔ zo blɔ nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ ngɛ sika pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kreta fɔfɔɛ, nɛ ji mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbalɔ ko lɛ de ke, “Daa nɛ ɔ, Kreta bi ngɛ lakpa yee; a ngɛ kaa lohwe awi yeli pɛ!
Daa nɛ ɔ, hejɔ peemi, kɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ pɛ ji a ní tsumi.” Anɔkuale sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ka a hɛ mi wawɛɛ, konɛ a hɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ya be Yuda bi a nyaziahi tue bue, nɛ mlaahi nɛ nihi nɛ kua anɔkuale ɔ wo mɛ ɔ hu a be nɔ yee.
Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he tsɔ ha mɛ.
Se nihi nɛ ble a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he tsɔ we ha mɛ; ejakaa a ble a juɛmi, kɛ a he nile tsuo.
A deɔ ke a le Mawu, se a ní peepee tsɔɔ we jã.
Yakayaka nimli, kɛ atuã tsɔli ji mɛ; a tsu we nɔ́ kpakpa ko gblee.
Tsɔɔmi kpakpa Se moo lɛɛ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpakpa a he ɔ, lɔ ɔ o tsɔɔ asafo ɔ. Nyumu nikɔtɔma amɛ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu, konɛ a pee a he nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ka si, nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ a juɛmi ka si.
A hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi nɛ a ngɛ, kɛ a tsui si tomi ɔ, á hɛɛ mi wawɛɛ.
Yi nikɔtɔma amɛ hu o kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu jã nɔuu, konɛ a ba a je mi saminya kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye.
A ko pee a he sieku yeli, nɛ a ko ngɔ dã numi ngɔ pee a ní tsumi.
Mohu ɔ, a tsɔɔ nɔ́ kpakpa, konɛ a tsɔse yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ a suɔ a hunomɛ, kɛ a bimɛ.
A tsɔse mɛ, nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye a he nɔ saminya, nɛ a he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ a pee a he yigbayi kpakpahi nɛ le a we yi baami, nihi nɛ a mi mi jɔ, nɛ baa a he si ha a hunomɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be Mawu munyu ɔ he munyu yaya tue.
Nihewi ɔmɛ hu, tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ jã nɔuu, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye a he nɔ saminya.
Mo nitsɛ o ba o je mi saminya ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, konɛ lɔ ɔ nɛ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ kpakpa ha ni ɔmɛ.
Ke o ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, ha nɛ a na kaa o juɛmi mi tsɔ, nɛ o hɛ dɔ.
Munyu nɛ maa je o nya a, e pee munyu kpakpa nɛ a be he nɔ́ yaya ko nae nɛ a de.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ wɔ ɔ nɛ́ nɔ́ yayami ko nɛ a de ngɛ wa he ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ.
Tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ba a he si ha a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sa a hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
A ko je munyu nya, nɛ a ko ju mɛ hulɔ.
Se mohu á ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, konɛ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ a na nya saminya.
Ejakaa Mawu je e dloomi ɔ nɛ e kɛ ma he adesahi tsuo a yi wami ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ.
Dloomi nɛ ɔ bɔɔ wɔ kɔkɔ kaa wa kpa yayami peemi, nɛ wa ko di je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi a se.
E tsɔɔ wɔ kaa waa hyɛ wa he nɔ saminya; waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ waa ye Mawu gbeye, be mi nɛ wa ngɛ gbaami nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ fɔ nɔ ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, wa Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa je kpo.
E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he.
E kpɔ wɔ kɛ je yi wu tso níhi a peemi mi, nɛ e ngɔ wɔ ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma klɔuklɔu, nihi nɛ a hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi he.
Tsɔɔ o we bi ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o ngɔ he blɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ wo mɛ he wami, nɛ o kɛ ka a hɛ mi hulɔ.
Ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ gbe o he guɛ.
Je mi bami nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ Mo kai o we bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a ba a he si ngɔ ha ma nɔ yeli, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya.
Á bu mɛ, nɛ a pee klaalo kaa a ma tsu ní tsumi kpakpa be tsuaa be.
A ko tu nihi a he munyu yaya, nɛ a ko pɛ; se mohu a he nɛ jɔ, nɛ a tsɔ a hɛ mi ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
Ejakaa sa a, wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa je kuasia; wa gbo tue, nɛ wa tla blɔ.
Wa ya di akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ he lo mi níhi nɛ haa wɔ bua jɔmi a se.
Wa susuu nihi a he yayami, nɛ wa hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃; nɔ́ peeɔ wɔ tai, nɛ wa nyɛɛ wa sibi.
Se benɛ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ je e mi mi himi, kɛ e suɔmi ɔ kpo ɔ, e he wa yi wami.
Pi nɔ́ nɛ da nɛ wa pee he nɛ e he wa yi wami ngɛ; mɔbɔ kɛkɛ lɛ e na wɔ kɛ gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ du wa he, nɛ wa pee kaa nihi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ehe, nɛ́ a na wami he.
Kɛ gu wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu plɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ pue wa nɔ babauu.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ wɔ nɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nɔ ɔ, neneene wami ɔ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, wa nine nɛ su nɔ.
Anɔkuale munyu sisiisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I suɔ kaa o di ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se wawɛɛ, konɛ nihi nɛ ba he Mawu ye ɔ nɛ a ngɔ a be kɛ tsu ní kpakpahi.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ hi, nɛ a he ngɛ se nami ha nihi tsuo.
Se nya sami yaka gu, weku kpa se jami, pɛ, kɛ mlaa a he nɔ́ jemi ɔ lɛɛ je o he kɛ je mi.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he be se nami, nɛ a he hia we hulɔ.
Nɔ ko nɛ ma hla kaa e kɛ mi gbami nɛ ba nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, ka e hɛ mi si kake, loo si enyɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, kɛ lɛ ko bɔ hu.
Na nɛ o le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji yayami peelɔ nɛ je e glɛ nɔ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he yayami ɔ buu lɛ fɔ.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi Ke i tsɔ Artema, loo Tihiko kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ ngɛ Nikopoli, ejakaa i to kaa ma ya ye fĩɛ be ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Moo bɔ mɔde nɛ o wo Zena, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ Apolo blɔ saminya; hyɛ nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa hia mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a nine nɛ su nɔ.
Ha nɛ wa we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kase bɔ nɛ a maa ngɔ a be kɛ tsu ní kpakpa ha.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke fimi be ba a, nɔ́ ko be mɛ hiae; a ko pee a he nihi nɛ a he be se nami ko.
Nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ.
De wa suɔli ɔmɛ nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ ke wa biɔ mɛ.
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!
NYA TSƆƆMI Filemon ji Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ kpanaa ko.
Ni komɛ deɔ ke Kolose asafo ɔ mi no ji lɛ.
Filemon ngɛ nyɔguɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Onesimo.
Onesimo tu fo kɛ je e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ Paulo ya kpe tlukaa.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a wo Paulo tsu.
Kɛ gu Paulo nɔ ɔ, Onesimo ba pee Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ.
Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsɔ Onesimo kɛ ya ha e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Paulo kpa Filemon pɛɛ nɛ e kpale he e nyɔguɛ ɔ ekohu.
Pi kaa e maa ngɔ Onesimo tɔmi ngɔ pa lɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu e he lɛ kaa e nyɛmi Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije munyuhi - Paulo je Filemon yi - Paulo kpa pɛɛ ha Onesimo - Nyagbe munyuhi -
Imi Paulo nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Kristo Yesu he ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha Filemon, wa suɔlɔ, kɛ wa huɛ nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, kɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kpee ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmiyo Apia, kɛ wa huɛ ta bulɔ Arkipo.
Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Filemon suɔmi kɛ e hemi kɛ yemi Ye nyɛmi Filemon, be tsuaa be nɛ ma sɔle ɔ, i woɔ o ta, nɛ i naa Mawu si.
Ejakaa suɔmi nɛ o jeɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o ngɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ, i nu he.
Ye sɔlemi ji kaa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ waa kɛ mo wa hɛɛ mi ɔ ma ha waa nu ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ wa naa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ a sisi saminya.
Ye nyɛmi, o suɔmi ɔ wo mi he wami, nɛ e ha mi bua jɔmi babauu.
O ha nɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ a tsui nɔ a mi.
Paulo kpa pɛɛ ha Filemon Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, jinɛ kaa o nyɛmi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ ma nyɛ o nɔ, nɛ o pee nɔ nɛ sa.
Se akɛnɛ i suɔ mo he je ɔ, ma ngɔ hiami nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ fɔ o hɛ mi mohu.
Hyɛ, imi Paulo, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ kpanaa nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu a bɔ mi pã ngɛ lɛ nɔuu e he ɔ, imi nɛ i ngɛ mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ bae ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae ngɛ Onesimo nɛ peeɔ ye bi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ he.
Tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ ha i ba pee e tsɛ.
Jinɛ sa a, e he be se nami kɛ ha mo, se jehanɛ lɛɛ e he ba se nami kɛ ha imi kɛ mo tsuo.
I ha nɛ e kpale kɛ ma o ngɔ; pohu e he hia mi kaa imi nitsɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
I ko suɔ kaa e kɛ mi nɛ hi si, konɛ e sɔmɔ mi ngɛ o nane mi, be mi nɛ sane kpakpa a he ɔ, a wo mi tsu ɔ.
Se i sume kaa ma je o se kɛ pee nɔ́ ko, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ o ko je o tsui mi faa pee ɔ, e ko ba pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a nyɛ o nɔ.
Eko ɔ, o kɛ Onesimo nyɛ kpɛti gbɛ be bɔɔ kɛkɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ e ba hi si ngɛ o ngɔ daa.
Jehanɛ ɔ, e pi nɔ ko nɛ a maa bu lɛ nyɔguɛ hu, se mohu nɔ nɛ pe nyɔguɛ.
O nyɛmi saminya ji lɛ ngɛ Kristo mi nɛ imi po i fiɛ we e he, hluu nɛ mo nɛ he lo mi jio, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi jio, o nɔ ji lɛ kulaa a. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ke o buu mi o huɛ tutuutu nɛ o kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, he Onesimo atuu kaa bɔ nɛ o ma he mi.
Ke ji e ye mo sane yaya ko, aloo e hɛɛ mo hiɔ ko ɔ, buu jamɛ a akɔtaa tsuo ha mi.
Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ma wo mo hiɔ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E hia we nɛ ma wo nɔ ta ha mo kaa mo nitsɛ tete, Kristo nɛ o le amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o hɛɛ mi o yi nɔ hiɔ po.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmi, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, pee enɛ ɔ ha mi.
Ha ma tsɛ ye tsui ngɔ wo ye tsui mi, ejakaa ye nyɛmi nɛ le Kristo ji mo.
I heɔ yeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi fɔe ngɛ womi nɛ i ngma mo nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, o maa pee.
I le hulɔ kaa o maa pee pe bɔ nɛ i bi nɛ ɔ tete po.
E piɛ nɔ́ kake; ma suɔ hu nɛ o dla nibwɔhi a to he ko kɛ ha mi.
Ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ ngɛ kue fae ɔ, Mawu maa pee nɛ ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi Epafra, nɛ lɛ hu Kristo Yesu he ɔ, a wo i kɛ lɛ tsu ɔ ke e biɔ mo.
Marko, Aristarko, Dɛma, kɛ Luka, ye huɛmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, mɛ hu a ke a biɔ mo.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!
NYA TSƆƆMI A ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Kristo se nyɛɛli komɛ nɛ miɔ nɛ a ngmɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi he, ejakaa a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae wawɛɛ.
Womi ngmalɔ ɔ we oti ji kaa e maa wo mɛ he wami.
E de mɛ ke e hia kaa a le kaa Mawu je e he si kulaa gbe nya kɛ gu Kristo nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa saminya.
Womi ngmalɔ ɔ ma nɔ́ etɛ nɔ mi: Yesu Kristo ji Mawu Bi kɛ yaa neneene.
E bu e Tsɛ ɔ tue pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ gu amanehlu nɛ e na a mi.
Kaa Mawu Bi ɔ, Kristo pe gbali ɔmɛ nɛ hi si somi momo be ɔ. E pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ hulɔ, nɛ e pe Mose tete po.
Mawu nitsɛ wo Yesu osɔfo kɛ yaa neneene; e pe osɔfohi tsuo nɛ hi si somi momo be ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, a kpɔ lɛ kɛ je yayami peemi, gbeye yemi, kɛ gbenɔ mi.
Yesu ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha wɔ yi wami hemi nitsɛnitsɛ.
Se kusumi nɛ Hebri bi peeɔ ngɛ a jami ɔ nya, nɛ a gbeɔ lohwehi nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ kaa a kɛ ma he nɔ yi wami ɔ sui he ko kulaa.
Blema Israel bi komɛ nɛ he biɛ kaa a hemi kɛ yemi mi wa a, a wo a ta kɛ pee nɔhyɛ nɔ ngɛ yi ɔ mi.
Womi ngmalɔ ɔ wo ga kaa nihi nɛ maa kane womi ɔ nɛ a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa.
E ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ngɛ yi ɔ mi ke a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kɛ ya si nyagbe; a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Yesu pɛ nɔ, nɛ ke a ngɛ nɔ́ nae jio, a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae jio, a to a tsui si.
Nyagbe ɔ, womi ngmalɔ ɔ wo nihi nɛ maa kane womi ɔ ga, nɛ e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Mawu je e he si tutuutu kɛ gu Kristo nɔ .- Kristo pe Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo .—.
Kristo pe Mose kɛ Yoshua tsuo .—.
Kristo ji osɔfo nɛ pe osɔfohi tsuo .—.
Kristo somi ɔ pe somi tsuaa somi .—.
Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ nɛ pe bɔhi tsuo .- Hemi kɛ yemi he hia wawɛɛ .—.
Bɔ nɛ wa maa sa Mawu hɛ mi .- Sɔlemi .- Nyagbe munyuhi .-
Mawu tu munyu kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ Blema a, Mawu kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu munyu si abɔ kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ blɔ slɔɔtohi babauu a nɔ; se mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ lɛɛ e Bi ɔ nɔ e gu nɛ e kɛ wɔ tu munyu.
Lɛ nɔuu e nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi ní tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ Mawu hla kaa e ye e ní tsuo.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ, jã nɔuu Bi ɔ hu hɛ mi ngɛ nyami.
Bi ɔ ngɛ kaa Mawu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
E kɛ e munyu ɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛɛ je ɔ tsuo.
Benɛ e ngɔ je ɔ he yayami tsuo kɛ ho ɔ, e ya hi si ngɛ hiɔwe ngɛ matsɛ ngua a hiɔ nɔ.
Mawu Bi ɔ ji ngua Mawu ha nɛ e Bi ɔ pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ biɛ nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ hu he jua wa pe a nɔ́ ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu de we e bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti eko hyɛ gblee ke, “Ye Bi ji mo; mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.” Nɛ Mawu tu we hiɔwe bɔfo ko he munyu hyɛ ke, “Ma pee e Tsɛ, nɛ e maa pee ye Bi.” Se benɛ Mawu miɔ nɛ e maa tsɔ e bitɛte ɔ je ɔ mi ɔ, e de ekohu ke, “Ha nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ja lɛ.” Bɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ a he ji, “Mawu haa e bɔfo ɔmɛ peeɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ, nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ peeɔ kaa la lilɛhi.” Bi ɔ lɛɛ Mawu de ngɛ e he ke, “Mawu ji mo; o maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene!
Nɛ dami sane yemi maa pee o matsɛ tso.
O suɔ dami sane yemi; se mlaa nɔ tɔmi lɛɛ o nyɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je Mawu nɛ ji o Mawu ɔ pɔ mo nu, nɛ o na bua jɔmi kulaa pe o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.” Mawu de hulɔ ke, “Mo Nyɔmtsɛ, blema lokoo ɔ, mo lɛ o bɔ je ɔ; mo nitsɛ lɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba.
A hɛ mi ma kpata, se moo lɛɛ o maa hi si daa.
O maa ku a mi kaa a kuɔ tade mi; nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpa kaa bo kpaa.
Se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ kɛ̃; o be gboe gblegbleegble.” Mawu de we Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko hyɛ ke, “Hii ye hiɔ nɔ kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.” Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni ji a ní tsumi mɔ?
Mumihi ji mɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔɔ Mawu.
Ke Mawu ma he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ, mɛ lɛ Mawu tsɔɔ.
Yi wami hemi kpetekpleenyɛ Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa waa pɛtɛ níhi nɛ wa nu ɔ a he saminya, konɛ wa ko gba kɛ je he.
Sɛ gbi nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba a ngɛ mi sisiisi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbo tue, loo e bui ɔ, a gbla e tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ.
Ke wɔɔ lɛɛ wa bui yi wami hemi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛ ye wa he kɛɛ?
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ tu yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ he munyu kekle; nɛ nihi nɛ nu ɔ, mɛ hu a ma nɔ mi ha wɔ.
Mawu nitsɛ pee okadi kɛ nyakpɛ ní slɔɔtohi babauu kɛ ye yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ he odase.
Jehanɛ hu, e dla Mumi Klɔuklɔu nike ní ɔmɛ ngɔ ha kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔ kɛ ma nɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ haa nɛ wa yi naa wami Je nɛ maa ba nɛ wa ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ, Mawu ha we Mawu bɔfohi he blɔ nɛ a ye tsɛ ngɛ nɔ.
Odase nɛ nɔ ko ye ngɛ ngmami ɔ he ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ adesa, nɛ o susuɔ e he?
Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ bi, nɛ o hyɛɛ e nɔ?
Nɛ o bɔ lɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ o ha bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ pe lɛ.
O wo e hɛ mi nyami, nɛ o ha bu ba e he.
O pee lɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ yelɔ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, ke kaa Mawu pee adesa níhi tsuo a nɔ yelɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ adesa be he wami ngɛ nɔ.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa nɛ́ kaa adesa ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ.
Se Yesu lɛɛ wa na kaa gbenɔ mi amanehlu ɔ nɛ e na a ha nɛ a kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu fi lɛ jlasi.
Nɛ Mawu bɔ lɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ e ha bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ pe lɛ.
Mawu pee lɛ jã, konɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ dloomi ɔ nya a, Yesu nɛ ba gbo kɛ ha nihi tsuo.
Nɛ e sa hu kaa Mawu nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ́ lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ha nɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ ɔ, e ha a yi wami hemi sisi jelɔ ɔ nɛ ba na amanehlu, nɛ e kɛ dla lɛ kɛ pi si, konɛ e wo bimɛ babauu a hɛ mi nyami.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ nihi a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ e tsu a he ɔ tsuo a tsɛ kake.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pee we Yesu zo kaa e ma tsɛ mɛ nyɛmimɛ.
E deɔ Mawu ke, “Ma wo o biɛ ta ha ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ i kɛ asafo ɔ ma la kɛ je o yi.” E deɔ hu ke, “Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ.” E kpale deɔ hu ke, “Ne mi kɛ bimɛ nɛ Mawu ha mi ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ he lo kɛ muɔ ji bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu e pee he lo kɛ muɔ.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ kɛ gu e gbenɔ mi ɔ, e kpata Abosiami, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ gbenɔ he wami ɔ hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma ha nihi nɛ a wami be tsuo a ngɛ gbenɔ gbeye yee, nɛ a pee yoyooyo kaa nyɔguɛhi ɔ maa ye a he.
Niinɛ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa tsa pi Mawu bɔfohi a he nɛ e ba ngɛ, se mohu Abraham nina a he.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ɔ, e hia kaa Yesu nɛ pee kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa anɔkualetsɛ, kɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu sɔmɔe, nɛ e kɛ e he nɛ sã kpatami bɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ a he yayamihi kɛ pa mɛ.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ, nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ka mi ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa wo mɛ he wami; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ ɔ, a ka lɛ, nɛ e na amanehlu.
Yesu pe Mose Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he tsɔ, nɛ Mawu tsɛ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo, nyɛɛ hyɛ Yesu, hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa jajeɔ ɔ he bɔfo, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a. E ye Mawu nɛ hla lɛ ke e tsu ní nɛ ɔ anɔkuale kaa bɔ nɛ Mose hu ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ a buɔ nɔ nɛ maa tsu pe tsu ɔ nɛ e maa a, jã kɛ̃ bu ngɛ Yesu hu he hluu pe Mose.
Tsu tsuaa tsu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ fiaa; se Mawu lɛ bɔ níhi tsuo.
Mose ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ kulaa nɔ kaa sɔmɔlɔ, nɛ e ye odase ngɛ níhi nɛ a ma de hwɔɔ se ɔ a he.
Se Kristo lɛɛ e ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ kaa Mawu bi.
Ke waa kɛ kã kɛ gɛjɛmi hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ mi kpɛii ɔ, wa peeɔ Mawu we bi.
Mawu we bi maa jɔɔ a he Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ, nyɛ ko wa tue kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ngɛ nga a nɔ benɛ a tsɔ atuã, nɛ a ka Mawu ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ka mi ngɛ, pohu a na níhi nɛ i tsu jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye mi mi fu jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ, nɛ i de ke, ‘Daa nɛ ɔ, a dɔ a tsui kɛ je ye he, nɛ a li ye blɔ ɔmɛ.’ Ye mi mi fu mɛ, nɛ i ka kita ke, ‘Ke a nane ma he nɛ i to nɛ a jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ fii!’ ” Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó hɛɛ juɛmi yaya nɛ be hae nɛ e he ye, nɛ e ko ba tsɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ hɛ mi atuã.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ tu he wami womi munyu daa ligbi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ma de ke “mwɔnɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ ɔ, yayami be nyɛ ti nɔ ko sisie nɛ e gbo Mawu tue.
Ejakaa wa hɛ nɛ wa kɛ fɔ Kristo nɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ, ke wa hɛɛ mi kpɛii hluu kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, lɛɛ wa peeɔ nihi nɛ a kɛ Kristo pee kake.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ, nyɛ ko wa tue kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee benɛ a tsɔ Mawu hɛ mi atuã a.” Mɛnɔmɛ lɛ a nu Mawu gbi, nɛ a tsɔ atuã a?
Anɛ pi nihi nɛ Mose kɛ mɛ je Egipt ɔ tsuo lo?
Mɛnɔmɛ lɛ Mawu mi mi fu mɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu ɔ?
Anɛ pi mɛ ji nihi nɛ pee yayami nɛ a fiaa si gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ lo?
Benɛ Mawu ka kita ke, “He nɛ i to kaa a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii” ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ e ngɛ dee?
Anɛ pi nihi nɛ gbo tue ɔ lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa naa kaa a nyɛ we nɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa a he we Mawu yi.
Mawu wo si ke e ma ha wa ma ya jɔɔ wa he ngɛ he jɔɔmi he.
Siwo nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ e ko ba mi kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko ya nyɛ we nɛ e su lejɛ ɔ. Ejakaa wɔ hu a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ nɔuu.
A nu sɛ gbi ɔ lɛɛ, se e he ya bɛ se nami ha mɛ; ejakaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nu ɔ ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nu ɔ nɔ.
Wɔ nɛ wa he ye ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma ya jɔɔ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ. Mawu de ke, “Ye mi mi wo la nɛ i ka kita ke, ‘He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!’ ” Mawu de enɛ ɔ, pohu níhi nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee ɔ, be nɛ e bɔ je ɔ tɔɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ tsuo nya.
Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ he ko deɔ ngɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ he ji, “Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, Mawu jɔɔ e he, nɛ e tsu we nɔ́ ko.” Ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ he ko hu ke, “He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!” E fɔɔ si paa kaa ni komɛ kɛ̃ maa sɛ mi, pohu ni nɛmɛ nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ kekle ɔ na we jamɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ; ejakaa a he we Mawu yi.
Se Mawu to be kpa kɛ ha kikɛmɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ be ɔ ji “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ.” Be babauu se ɔ, Mawu ha David tu munyu nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a wo ta momo ɔ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ, nyɛ ko wa tue.” Ejakaa kaa Yoshua ha mɛ he jɔɔmi ɔ, jinɛ Mawu ko tu we ligbi kpa ko he munyu hu pee se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa he jɔɔmi be ko ngɛ ha Mawu ma a nɛ a maa ye.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma na he jɔɔmi nɛ Mawu wo he si ɔ, e maa jɔɔ e he kaa Mawu, nɛ e be ní tsue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa bɔ mɔde, konɛ wa nine nɛ su he jɔɔmi nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko kó gbo tue kaa mɛ, nɛ e ba laa blɔ.
Ejakaa Mawu munyu hɛ ngɛ, e ngɛ he wami, nɛ e nya ba pe klaate nya enyɔtsɛ.
E gbuu kɛ sɛɛ nɔ mi kɛ ya siɔ e gbaa klaa, kɛ mumi ɔ mi, kɛ jehanɛ hu kpɔji nya amɛ, kɛ wu mi zɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
Mawu munyu ɔ jeɔ adesa tsui mi níhi, kɛ e yi mi tomi kpo.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ laa Mawu.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e we akɔtaa ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Yesu ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kpetekpleenyɛ Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa jajeɔ ɔ mi wawɛɛ.
Ejakaa wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ po mi kɛ ho hiɔwe ya tɔɔ.
Lɛ ji Yesu, Mawu Bi ɔ. Wa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, e pi nɔ nɛ be nyɛe maa nu wa gbɔjɔmi ɔmɛ a he ha wɔ.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, Abosiami ka lɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ kaa wɔ nɔuu, se lɛɛ e pee we yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa kɛ kã nɛ hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu dloomi sɛ ɔ he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ wa na dloomi nɛ maa ye bua wɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, a hlaa lɛ kɛ jeɔ e nyɛmimɛ nɛ mɛ hu he lo kɛ muɔ ji mɛ a kpɛti.
E ní tsumi ji kaa e da nimli adesahi tsuo a nane mi, nɛ e ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba ha Mawu, konɛ e sã bɔ nɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ ma a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nitsɛ ɔ, sé ngɛ e he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e taa bua si ha nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko mi, kɛ nihi nɛ tlaa blɔ ɔ. Akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ ɔ sé ngɛ e he ɔ, e hia kaa e sã bɔ, pi kɛ ha ma a kɛkɛ, se ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Hɛ mi nyami nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko ngɔɛ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he.
Mawu pɛ lɛ hlaa nɔ, nɛ e woɔ lɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ e hla Aaron ɔ. Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, hɛ mi nyami nɛ Kristo ná kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, pi lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.
Mawu lɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye Bi ji mo, mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.” Mawu de ngɛ ngmami ɔ he kpa hu ke, “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.” Benɛ Yesu ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, ngmlaa, kɛ hɛ mi vo nyu nɛ e kɛ kpa Mawu, nɔ pɛ nɛ ma nyɛ je lɛ kɛ je gbenɔ mi ɔ pɛɛ.
Akɛnɛ e yeɔ Mawu gbeye he je ɔ, Mawu hu bu lɛ tue.
Mawu Bi ji lɛ mohu, se kɛ gu amanehlu nɛ e na a mi ɔ, e kase tue bumi.
Benɛ Mawu ha nɛ e hi kɛ pi si ɔ, e ba pee nɔ nɛ haa nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ naa neneene yi wami hemi.
Nɛ Mawu wo lɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kaa Melkizedek pɛ.
Nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ Wa ngɛ munyuhi fuu nɛ wa maa tu ngɛ enɛ ɔ he, se e sisi tsɔɔmi wa, nɛ nyɛ nɔ́ sisi numi yee.
Jinɛ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛ pee tsɔɔli, se hyɛ nyɛ mohu nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hia kaa a tsɔɔ nyɛ Mawu munyu ɔ mi sisije ní ɔmɛ ekohu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɔ nyu lɛ hi ha nyɛ, pi niye ní nitsɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɔ pupɔe ɔ, bimwɔyo ji lɛ kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ e li nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da he.
Se nihi nɛ wa a, a nɔ ji niye ní nitsɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ a tsɔse a juɛmi, nɛ a le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wa si sisije níhi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ, nɛ waa ya wa hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ sa nihi nɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Sisije níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, e hia we kaa wa pa hi lɔ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kpamisa.
Wa de nyɛ ke je mi bami yaya nɛ he be se nami ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ he, konɛ nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye.
Níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ kɔɔ nɔ sɔlemi, nine nɛ a kɛ pueɔ nɔ nɔ, gbogboehi a si temi, kɛ nyagbe kojomi he ɔ, e hia we kaa waa hi lɔ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kpamisa.
Ke Mawu suɔ ɔ, wa maa ya wa hɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ he we Kristo yi hu ɔ, kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ tsake mɛ ekohu kɛɛ?
Be ko ɔ, a na Mawu la a, Mawu nike ní ɔ hu a tso hyɛ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu ba a nɔ.
A kpa si kaa Mawu munyu ɔ hi, nɛ he wami nɛ maa hi si ngɛ je nɛ maa ba a mi ɔ, a nu he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a gbee si.
Jehanɛ ɔ nɛ a je blɔ ngɛ Mawu Bi ɔ sɛue ekohu, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ ahlua bɔe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ha a tsake a tsui?
Zugba nɛ hiɔmi nɛɔ pueɔ nɔ babaaba, nɛ nyu ɔ sɛɔ zu mi, nɛ ní nɛ a duɔ ɔ baa saminya kɛ ha nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nɔ ɔ Mawu gbaa zugba a lɛ.
Se ke mio, kɛ hu lɛ puɛɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ se nami ko be he kulaa.
Mawu maa gbiɛ zugba a, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, a kɛ la maa sã lɛ.
Wa huɛmɛ nɛ wa suɔ, ke wa ngɛ munyu tue kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ po, nyɛɛ lɛɛ wa heɔ nyɛ yeɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa pee, nɛ lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ Mawu ma he nyɛ yi wami.
Mawu yi tue gbogboe sane.
Ní nɛ nyɛ tsu, kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ je kpo ha lɛ ɔ, e hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
Nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ sɔmɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee kɛ mwɔɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ hlae ji kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa hɛɛ mi kɛ ya si nyagbe.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma na a nɔ mi mami.
Nyɛ ko pee hejɔ; se mohu nihi nɛ he Mawu ye, nɛ a to a tsui si, nɛ lɔ ɔ he a nine su nɔ́ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kase mɛ.
Mawu ma e munyu ɔ nɔ mi Benɛ Mawu wo Abraham si ɔ, e ka lɛ kita kɛ ma nɔ mi.
Akɛnɛ nɔ ko be nɛ pe lɛ Mawu ɔ he je ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ kɛ ka kita.
E de ke, “I ngɛ mo si woe kaa ma gbaa mo, nɛ ma ha o nina maa hiɛ babauu.” Abraham to e tsui si, nɛ e nine su nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke e ma ha lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ma ka kita a, e ngɔɔ nɔ ko nɛ pe lɛ biɛ kɛ kaa, nɛ e kɛ maa munyu nɛ e tu ɔ nɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nihi nɛ Mawu wo mɛ si ɔ, a yi mi nɛ tɛ mɛ kaa Mawu tsakee we e yi mi tomi ɔ, e ka kita kɛ ma nɔ mi.
E tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ be tsakee gblegbleegble, nɛ Mawu hu be a he lakpa yee.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ gu a nɔ ɔ, wɔ nihi nɛ wa ba sa we ngɛ Mawu ngɔ ɔ, e maa wo wɔ he wami, konɛ waa pɛtɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ he nɛ wa.
Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa osɛkɛ nɛ nu wɔ kɛ da si kpɛii, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ya su sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi pomi bo ɔ se tɔɔ.
Wa he ɔ, Yesu sɛ wa hɛ mi kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya, nɛ e ya pee osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.
Osɔfo Melkizedek Melkizedek ɔ, Salem matsɛ, kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we osɔfo ji lɛ.
Be ko ɔ, Abraham kɛ matsɛmɛ komɛ ya hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ.
Benɛ e kpale kɛ ma a, e kɛ Melkizedek ba kpe, nɛ Melkizedek gbaa lɛ.
Abraham hu ha lɛ ta yibu ní tsuo nɛ e na a mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake.
Kekleekle ɔ, e biɛ Melkizedek ɔ sisi ji, “Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ dami sane.” Jehanɛ hu, Salem matsɛ ji lɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e biɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e ji, “Matsɛ nɛ e kɛ tue mi jɔmi baa.” A wui Melkizedek tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ta; e weku kpa ko be ɔ, be nɛ a fɔ lɛ, kɛ be nɛ e gbo hu nɔ ko li.
E ngɛ kaa Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ osɔfo yee kɛ yaa neneene.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ we agboje!
Abraham, wa nɛ̃ nɛ he biɛ ɔ po ha lɛ ta yibu ní ɔ nɛ e na ngɛ ta mi ɔ tsuo mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake.
Levi nina a, ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ osɔfo blɔ nya a, mlaa tsɔɔ kaa a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kakaaka ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ, pohu a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛ hu Abraham nina ji mɛ.
Melkizedek ɔ, pi Levi nina ji lɛ, se e he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Abraham, nɔ nɛ lɛɛ Mawu wo lɛ si ɔ dɛ, nɛ e gbaa lɛ.
E fɔɔ si paa kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ kuɔ lɛ gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ e sisi.
Hiɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a gboɔ.
Se ngɛ he ko lɛɛ nɔ nɛ a ye e he odase kaa e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, lɛ nɛ he.
Lɛɛ wa ma de ke kɛ gu Abraham nɔ ɔ, a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Levi nɛ jinɛ lɛ nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a hu e dɛ.
Ejakaa benɛ Abraham kɛ Melkizedek kpe ɔ, Levi ngɛ e nɛ̃ Abraham mi mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
Kaa Levi, nɛ e yi nɔ a wo mlaa a, e nina nɛ yeɔ osɔfo ɔ tsu ní bɔ nɛ sa a, jinɛ e he be hiae kaa osɔfo kpa ko kaa Melkizedek nɛ pi Aaron nina ji lɛ kulaa a nɛ ba.
Ejakaa ke a tsake osɔfo yemi blɔ nya tomi ɔ, lɛɛ e hia kaa a tsake mlaa a hulɔ.
Jehanɛ hu, nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ a de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, wɛtso kpa kulaa mi no ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ ko ji jamɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi nɛ e ba sɔmɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he gblee.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, wa le kaa Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi nɛ e je; nɛ Mose de we nɔ́ ko kɛ kɔ Yuda wɛtso ɔ osɔfo yemi he.
Osɔfo nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ dee ɔ mi tsɔ paa, ejakaa osɔfo kpa ba nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek.
Mawu lɛ wo lɛ osɔfo; pi ngɛ adesa mlaa nɛ tsɔɔ weku mi nɛ e je ɔ nya.
Se mohu wami nɛ ngɛ daa, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpata hɛ mi ɔ he wami nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ wo lɛ osɔfo.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.” Lɛɛ mlaa momo ɔ nɛ he wami be mi, nɛ he be se nami hulɔ ɔ, a po mi.
Ejakaa Mose mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ hi kɛ pi si.
Se nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ jehanɛ ɔ hi saminya; nɛ wa nyɛɔ wa hɛɛ kɛ suu Mawu he.
Mawu ka kita hu kɛ ma enɛ ɔ nɔ mi; ni komɛ lɛɛ benɛ a wo mɛ osɔfo ɔ, Mawu ka we kikɛmɛ a kita nɛ ɔ.
Se Yesu lɛɛ, Mawu ka kita nɛ e kɛ wo lɛ osɔfo.
Mawu de lɛ ke, “I ngɛ mo kita kae, nɛ i be ye nya se kpalee.
‘Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene.’ ” Slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ mi ji Yesu ba pee nɔ nɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ so somi nɛ hi pe kulaa.
Slɔɔto kpa hu nɛ ngɛ ji kaa jamɛ a osɔfo ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu, ejakaa gbenɔ ha we nɛ a se nɛ kɛ nɛ a kɛ tsu ní.
Se Yesu lɛɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e we osɔfo yemi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ maa gu e nɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ jio, hwɔɔ se jio, e ma he a yi wami.
Ejakaa e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha mɛ.
Lɛɛ Yesu ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ sa wɔ.
E ngɛ klɔuklɔu; sé ko be e he ɔ, e pee we yayami hulɔ.
E je e he kɛ je yayami peeli a he, nɛ a wo e nɔ kɛ po mi kɛ ho hiɔwe tɔɔ ya.
Osɔfo kpahi nɛ ye osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, e be kaa mɛ.
E hia we kaa daa ligbi ɔ, e sã yayami pami bɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yayami he kekle, loko e ba sã ngɛ ma a tsuo nɔ́ ɔ he.
Benɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, blɔɔ e sã bɔ ɔ tsuo si kake nyɔngloo.
Mose mlaa a nya a, nihi nɛ a wo mɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, sé ngɛ a he.
Se si nɛ Mawu wo nɛ e ka kita ngɔ fɔ nɔ ngɛ Mose mlaa a se ɔ, lɔ ɔ a kɛ wo Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si kɛ yaa neneene ɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa.
Yesu, wa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ dee ɔ we oti ɔ tsɔɔ kaa wa ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ hii si ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.
E sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ ji bo tsu nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma, se pi nɔmlɔ adesa ko nɛ ma a.
A woɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa, konɛ e ngɔ nike ní kɛ ha Mawu, nɛ e sã bɔ ha lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a hu e hia nɛ e ná nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ha Mawu.
Je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ngɛ jinɛ e be osɔfo yee kulaa.
Ejakaa osɔfohi ngɛ nɛ ngɔɔ nike ní kɛ haa Mawu kaa bɔ nɛ Yuda mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Ní nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa ní tsumi nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ henɔ, loo e nini kɛkɛ.
Mose hu kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu e tsu ní.
Benɛ e maa ma bo tsu ɔ, Mawu de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ nɛ o pee ní ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.” Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ osɔfo ní tsumi nɛ a ha Yesu ɔ pã osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ kulaa.
Jã kɛ̃ somi nɛ Yesu ha nɛ Mawu kɛ e ma a so ɔ hu pe a nɔ́ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu wo mɛ si ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ pe kekle ní ɔmɛ a he.
Kaa tɔmi ko be kekleekle somi ɔ he ɔ, jinɛ somi enyɔne he hia we.
Se Mawu na kaa a tɔ̃; enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e de ke, “Be ma nɛ i kɛ Israel, kɛ Yuda maa so somi he.
Somi he nɛ ɔ maa slo kulaa ngɛ somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so blema benɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ he.
Somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngmɛɛ a he.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ somi nɛ i kɛ Israel maa so hwɔɔ se ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma ngɔ ye mlaa a kɛ wo a juɛmi mi, nɛ ma ngma ngɔ to a tsui nɔ.
Ma pee a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.
Nɔ ko be e huɛ, loo e nyɛmi dee ke, ‘Moo le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.’ Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le mi kɛ maa je nɔ nyafii pe kulaa nɔ kɛ yaa si nɔ nguaa pe kulaa nɔ.
Ma na mɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ a tɔmi ɔmɛ a he; nɛ i be a he yayami ɔmɛ kaie hu gblegbleegble.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.” Ke Mawu ngɛ somi he he munyu tue ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa kekleekle somi ɔ wo momo.
Jehanɛ hu, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wo momo, loo e bwɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ e maa laa.
Mawu jami ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba Kekleekle somi ɔ hɛɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ a kɛ ma ja Mawu, kɛ he ko hulɔ nɛ adesa pee nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu nɛ a ma ja Mawu ngɛ.
A ma bo tsu, nɛ a po mi enyɔ.
A tsɛɛ bo tsu ɔ he nɛ a guu kɛ sɛɛ mi ɔ he klɔuklɔu.
Kane tso, kɛ okplɔɔ kɛ e nɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A tsɛɛ tsu mi pomi bo enyɔne ɔ se bo tsu ɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.
Níhi nɛ ngɛ tsu nɛ ɔ mi ji tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ, somi daka a nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ha he ɔ kɛ e mi sika tsu kplu ɔ nɛ mana a ngɛ mi ɔ, Aaron dɛma tso ɔ nɛ tsɛ̃ ba be ko ɔ, kɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ. Kerubhi nɛ tsɔɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ daa si ngɛ somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi ngɛ he nɛ a kɛ tɔmi paa ngɛ ɔ.
Se wa be nyɛe ma gba níhi a mi fitsofitso amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Ke a to níhi blɔ nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ yaa kekleekle bo tsu ɔ mi daa ligbi ya tsuɔ a jami blɔ nya ní.
Se bo tsu enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a pɛ lɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ si kake ngɛ jeha mi.
Pohu ja e hɛɛ lohwe muɔ kɛ ya ngɛ yayami nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e pee, kɛ yayamihi nɛ ma a li a he be nɛ a pee ɔ a he.
Nɔ́ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ngɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ji kaa be abɔ nɛ kekleekle bo tsu ɔ maa si kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ a na we nɛ a bli blɔ nɛ a guu kɛ yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a lolo.
Enɛ ɔ tsuo ji okadi nɛ kɔɔ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ si himi he.
E tsɔɔ kaa nike níhi, kɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã kɛ haa Mawu ɔ be nyɛe ma ha nɛ nɔ nɛ ma Mawu jami ɔ tsui mi ma tsɔ bɔ nɛ sa; ejakaa niye ní, kɛ dã, kɛ he tsumi kusumihi pɛ a he nɛ e kɔɔ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, he lo blɔ fa mi níhi nɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si be nɛ Mawu maa pee níhi tsuo ehe kɛkɛ.
Se Kristo ba kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kɛ ha blɔ nya tomi kpakpa nɛ wa na nɛ ɔ. Bo tsu nɛ e sɔmɔɔ ngɛ mi ɔ kle, nɛ e hi kɛ pi si.
Pi adesa nɛ pee, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa pi je nɛ ɔ mi níhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ eko.
Benɛ Kristo gu bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, e pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si kake nyɔngloo.
Pi to, loo na muɔ nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ɔ; mohu ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ e kɛ he wa yi wami kɛ ya neneene.
To kɛ na muɔ, kɛ na bi nɛ a sã a la zu ji níhi nɛ a kɛ fĩaa nihi nɛ ble a he ɔ a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi.
Ke enɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo muɔ nɛ e gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ daa a nɔ nɛ e kɛ pue si ɔ tsu ní kulaa pe jã.
Bɔ ɔ nɛ Kristo nɛ sé ko be e he ɔ ngɔ e he kɛ sã, nɛ e gbo ngɛ wa he ɔ ma ha nɛ wa ma je wa hɛ kɛ je kusumihi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ a he, nɛ wa ma sɔmɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ Kristo tsu nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa lɛ Kristo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ha Mawu kɛ e ma a so somi he ɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ Mawu tsɛ mɛ ɔ, a nine nɛ su neneene gbosi ní nɛ Mawu wo he si ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa benɛ a kɛ kekleekle somi ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, nɔ ko ba gbo nɛ e kɛ kpɔ nihi tsuo nɛ pee yayami jamɛ a be ɔ. Loko a maa ngɔ nɔ ko gbosi ní yemi he blɔ nya tomi womi kɛ tsu ní ɔ, e hia kaa a ye odase kaa niinɛ nɔ ɔ be je mi hu.
Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ngɛ je mi ɔ, gbosi ní yemi blɔ nya tomi womi nɛ e pee ɔ, a kɛ tsu we ní; ja e gbo.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ kekleekle somi ɔ po muɔ a kɛ ma nɔ mi ɔ nɛ.
Kekleekle ɔ, Mose tsɔɔ ma a mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu wo ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a nitsɛ tsɔɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ, kɛ jijɔ he bwɔmi tsutsuu kɛ sɔ na kɛ to muɔ, kɛ nyu, nɛ e kɛ fĩa womi kpo ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ ma mluku ɔ tsuo a nɔ.
Benɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee ɔ, e de ma a ke, “Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Bo tsu ɔ, kɛ kplu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, Mose ngɔ muɔ kɛ fĩa mɛ tsuo a nɔ jã nɔuu.
Niinɛ, ngɛ mlaa a nya a, muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ tsuɔ níhi tsuo a he; nɛ ke a pue we muɔ si ɔ, a kɛ yayami pɛ.
Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ kɛ je wa he yayami Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je nɛ ɔ mi níhi nɛ ji hiɔwe ní ɔmɛ a henɔ ɔ lɛ e sa kaa a peeɔ kusumi kaa jã kɛ tsuɔ a he.
Se hiɔwe ní nitsɛnitsɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e hia kaa a pee kusumi nɛ hi pe ja kulaa nɛ a kɛ tsu a he.
Ejakaa Kristo ɔ, pi he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ a kɛ nine pee, nɛ ji nɔ́ nitsɛ ɔ henɔ kɛkɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ya.
Mohu ɔ, hiɔwe nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ e ho; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ wa he.
Yuda osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a daa jeha kɛ muɔ nɛ pi lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ.
Se Kristo ya lejɛ ɔ, pi nɛ e ngɔ e he ya sã bɔ si abɔ.
Kaa jã a, jinɛ kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ je ɔ, amanehlu sɔuu Kristo maa hi nae kpitikpiti.
Mohu ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ je mi nyagbe miɔ nɛ e maa su ɔ, Yesu ba je e he kpo si kake nyɔngloo.
E ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ kɛ je wa he yayami.
Mawu to kaa adesa nɛ gbo si kake, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kojo lɛ.
Jã nɔuu Kristo hu a ngɔ lɛ kɛ sã bɔ si kake pɛ, konɛ e kɛ je adesa he yayami.
E maa ba si enyɔne ɔ, pi nɛ e ba tsu yayamihi a he ní hu, se mohu e ma ba he nihi nɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ ɔ a yi wami.
Yuda bi ɔmɛ a mlaa a ngɛ kaa ní kpakpahi nɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ a nini kɛkɛ, pi ní ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee kɛ gu kikɛmɛ a bɔ kake too nɛ a hii sãe nɔtonɔto daa jeha a nɔ kɛ tsu nihi nɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔ a he nɛ a hi kɛ pi si kɛɛ?
Nihi nɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, kaa a je a he yayami ɔmɛ niinɛ ɔ, a he nile be mɛ fɔ bue ngɛ a he yayami he hu, nɛ e be hiae kaa a sã bɔ hu.
Se anɔkuale mi ɔ, bɔhi nɛ a sãã daa a haa nɛ a kaiɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ mohu.
Ejakaa na muɔ, kɛ to muɔ be nyɛe ma je yayami gblegbleegble.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, benɛ Kristo ma je ɔ mi ɔ, e de Mawu ke, “Bɔ nɛ a sãã, kɛ nike ní ɔ, o hla we, se o ha mi nɔmlɔ tso.
Sami bɔ, kɛ yayami pami bɔ ɔ, o bua jɔɛ he.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, ‘Mawu, ne mi!
I ba konɛ ma ba pee o suɔmi nya ní kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ ye he ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ.’ ” Kekleekle ɔ, Kristo de Mawu ke, “Bɔ, kɛ nike ní ɔ, o hla we; sami bɔ, kɛ yayami pami bɔ ɔ, o na we he bua jɔmi.” E de enɛ ɔ, pohu bɔhi nɛ a sãã a, mlaa a nya a sãã ngɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, e de ke, “Mawu, ne mi!
I ba, konɛ ma ba pee o suɔmi nya ní.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔhi tsuo nɛ a sãã blema a, Mawu po mi, nɛ e ngɔ Kristo nɔ́ ɔ kɛ to nane mi.
Yesu Kristo pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní; e ngɔ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ sã bɔ si kake too nyɔngloo, nɛ e kɛ je wɔ tsuo wa he yayami.
Yuda osɔfo tsuaa Yuda osɔfo ɔ, e ní tsumi ji kaa e sã bɔ kake too ɔ si abɔ daa ligbi; se bɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a jeɔ yayami gblegbleegble.
Se Kristo lɛɛ bɔ kake too e ngɔ e he kɛ sã kɛ je yayami kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ mlɛe ngɛ kɛ yaa si Mawu maa ngɔ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ e nane maa nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa bɔ kake too ɔ nɛ Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã a ha nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ Mawu tsu a he ɔ hi kɛ pi si kɛ yaa neneene.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu yeɔ enɛ ɔ he odase.
Kekleekle ɔ, e de ke, “Be ma nɛ i kɛ ye ma a maa so somi nɛ ɔ: Ma ngɔ ye mlaa kɛ to a tsui mi, nɛ ma ngma kɛ wo a juɛmi mi.” E de hu ke, “A he yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa nɔ tɔmihi nɛ a pee ɔ, i be kaie hu.” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Mawu ngɔ nihi a he yayami kɛ pa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e he hia we hu kaa a sã bɔ kɛ je yayami hu.
Nyɛ ha waa hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu he Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ gu Kristo gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ he blɔ faa nɛ wa yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. Yesu gu tsu mi pomi bo nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ e bli blɔ he nɛ yaa wami mi ha wɔ.
Wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ hyɛɔ Mawu we ɔ nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa ngɔ tsui nɛ mi tsɔ, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ pi si kɛ hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu he.
Nyɛ ha a tsu wa tsui he bɔ nɛ wa he nile be wɔ fɔ bue, nɛ́ waa pee kaa nihi nɛ a kɛ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ heii du a he.
Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ wa yeɔ he odase ɔ, nyɛ ha waa pɛtɛ he nɛ wa nɛ wa ko mimiɛ, ejakaa Mawu nɛ wo si ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ.
Nyɛ ha waa kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ susu he bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi, nɛ waa pee wa sibi kpakpa.
Nyɛ ko ha wa jɔɔ wa he nya buami kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ hlaa peemi ɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ya nɔ nɛ waa wo wa sibi he wami wawɛɛ, titli ɔ, akɛnɛ nyɛ le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ su ta a. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ wa na le anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ sane kpakpa a he ɔ, ke wa je blɔ ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, bɔ kpa ko be nɛ a maa sã kɛ je yayami ɔ. Mohu ɔ, waa kɛ gbeye yemi nɛ hyɛ kojomi nɛ ma a, kɛ la gegeege nɛ ma kpata nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ Mawu a hɛ mi ɔ blɔ.
Ke nɔ ko tɔ Mose mlaa a, nɛ a da ni enyɔ, loo etɛ a we odase nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ ɔ, a nɛ́ lɛ mɔbɔ; pe a gbeɔ lɛ.
Lɛɛ nɔ ko nɛ hia nane kɛ si Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ Kristo muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu somi ɔ nya kɛ tsu e he ɔ, e buu lɛ kaa yaka nɔ́ ko kɛkɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, e wo Mawu mumi ɔ mi mi la a, kɛ a maa pee lɛ kɛɛ?
Anɛ e sɛ́ kaa a gblaa e tue wawɛɛ pe jã lo?
Ejakaa wa le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de ke, “Ma ye ye he lue!
Ma gbla a tue ngɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he.” Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e de ke, “Ma kojo ye ma a.” Nɔ nɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nine maa gbe lɛ ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!
Nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ hi si sa a. Benɛ nyɛ ba le Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ hɛ mi miami na amanehlu babauu.
Be komɛ ɔ, a jɛɔ nyɛ, nɛ a peeɔ nyɛ nisɛ ní ngɛ ma hɛ mi; nɛ be komɛ hu, a buu nyɛ kɛ piɛɔ nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ a he.
Niinɛ, nyɛ mi mi sã nyɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ a he; nɛ benɛ a ngɛ nyɛ níhi tsuo kpɔe ngɛ nyɛ dɛ pani nya a, nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi ngmɛɛ he ha mɛ faa.
Ejakaa nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nine su nɔ ɔ hi kulaa pe lɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kɔni mi ko jɔ̃ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ he, ejakaa nyɛ nine maa su hiɔwo agbo ko nɔ.
E hia kaa nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si, nɛ nyɛɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ e wo he si ɔ, nyɛ nine nɛ su nɔ.
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ke, “E piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ ma a ma ba su si; e be kɛe kulaa.
Ye ma a, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a yi ma na wami.
Se nɔ nɛ kpaleɔ e se ɔ, i be e he bua jɔmi nae.” Nihi nɛ kpaleɔ ngɛ Mawu se, nɛ a hɛ mi kpataa a, pi mɛ ji wɔ.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa piɛɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ a he, nɛ a he wa yi wami.
Hemi kɛ yemi Hemi kɛ yemi ji níhi nɛ wa ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ a nɔ mi mami.
Hemi kɛ yemi tsɔɔ wɔ kaa níhi nɛ wa nɛ́ kɛ wa hɛngmɛ ɔ, a ngɛ niinɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Mawu ná nihi nɛ hi si blema a a he bua jɔmi.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha wa nu sisi kaa Mawu munyu a kɛ bɔ je ɔ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa níhi nɛ wa nɛ́ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ pee níhi nɛ wa naa a. Hemi kɛ yemi Habel kɛ sã bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi kulaa pe Kain nɔ́ ɔ. Kɛ gu e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ bua jɔ e nike ní ɔ he.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Habel be je mi lɛɛ, se kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ.
Hemi kɛ yemi he ɔ, a ngɔ Henok kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, konɛ e ko gbo.
A nɛ́ lɛ, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ lɛ kɛ je.
Ngmami ɔ ye odase kaa loko a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ɔ, e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Ke nɔ ko be hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, e be nyɛe maa sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Ejakaa e hia kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su Mawu he ɔ, e he ye kaa Mawu ngɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ hlaa e se blɔ ɔ, e gbaa mɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Noa bu Mawu tue, benɛ e de lɛ ke nɔ́ ko ma nɛ bɛ hyɛ ɔ. E kpɛ lɛ nɛ a kɛ he e kɛ e yo kɛ e bimɛ a yi wami.
Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, je ɔ yeɔ fɔ kaa a pee yayami; se Noa lɛɛ Mawu wo lɛ nguɔ kaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Abraham bu Mawu tue, benɛ a tsɛ lɛ nɛ a de lɛ ke e je he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ ma ba pee e weto ní ɔ nɔ.
Abraham pue nɔ kɛ ho, pohu e li he nɛ e yaa.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Abraham ya to nubwɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ Mawu wo lɛ si ke e ma ha lɛ ɔ nɔ be saii.
E kɛ Isak, kɛ Yakob nɛ siwo ɔ kɔɔ a he ɔ hi bo tsuhi a mi.
Ejakaa ma nɛ Abraham ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ji ma nɛ Mawu nitsɛ to sisi, nɛ lɛ nɔuu e fia.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha Abraham na he wami nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ bi be mi nɛ e bwɔ, nɛ Sara nitsɛ hu pee yosa, ejakaa e bu nɔ nɛ wo lɛ si ɔ anɔkualetsɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham nɔ kake too nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ yi ta a, e nina ba hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe, loo wo nya zia nɛ hi kanemi.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ he Mawu ye ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a wo mɛ he si ɔ, a nine sui nɔ loko a gbo.
A na ní ɔmɛ ngɛ lokoo kɛkɛ nɛ a nya he, nɛ a ye odase ngɛ ma hɛ mi kaa nibwɔhi, kɛ ma se bi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma hlae.
Ma mi he nɛ a je ɔ, a ngɛ he susue jinɛ a ko na he blɔ nɛ a kpale kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
Mohu ɔ, ma ko nɛ hi kulaa pe lɔ ɔ, nɛ ji ma nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee we Mawu zo kaa a ma tsɛ lɛ ke a Mawu; ejakaa e dla ma ko ngɔ to mɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Abraham ngɔ e bi Isak kɛ ha Mawu, benɛ Mawu ka lɛ hyɛ ɔ. E ngɛ mi kaa bi nɛ ɔ he si nɛ a wo Abraham lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ e pee klaalo kaa e maa ngɔ e bi kake too ɔ kɛ sã bɔ ha Mawu.
Mawu de Abraham ke, “O bi Isak lɛ ma ba wo nina ha mo.” Abraham he ye kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma tle Isak si kɛ je gbeje tete.
Nɛ ke a ma de ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ha Abraham niinɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ Isak kɛ gbaa Yakob kɛ Esau kɛ ha hwɔɔ se je mi si himi.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Yakob miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, e ma e yi si ngɛ e dɛma tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sɔle nɛ e gbaa Yosef bimɛ ɔmɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Yosef gbenɔ be su ta a, e tsɔɔ Isarel bi ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ a ma plɛ kɛ je Egipt ha, nɛ e de mɛ bɔ nɛ a pee e gbogboe ɔ hulɔ.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Mose fɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ laa nyɔhiɔ etɛ benɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ.
A na kaa e he ngɛ fɛu saminya, nɛ mlaa a nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ wo ɔ, a yi mlaa a he gbeye.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Mose ba wa a, e kplɛɛ we kaa a tsɛ lɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ biyo ɔ bi.
E suɔ mohu kaa e kɛ Mawu ma a nɛ na amanehlu pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa ye ngɔɔmi ngɛ yayami peemi mi be bɔɔ ko.
Ngɛ Mose susumi nya a, ke a bɔ nɔ ko ahlua ngɛ Kristo ɔ he ɔ, juetli babauu nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ po he jua wɛ kaa lɔ ɔ, ejakaa e hɛ ngɛ hiɔwo nɛ e ma na hwɔɔ se ɔ nɔ.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Mose je Egipt nɛ e yi matsɛ ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ gbeye.
E kpale we e se, ejakaa Mawu nɛ e nɛ́ kɛ e hɛngmɛ ɔ, e pɛtɛ e he wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ lɛ hyɛe paa.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ Mose kɛ to Hetsɔmi ɔ sisi, nɛ e fã Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ muɔ kɛ fĩa a sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ bɔfo nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ ko ba gbe Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha Israel ma a po Wo Tsu ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.
Se benɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ka kaa mɛ hu a maa pee ja a, a tlɔ wo ɔ mi, nɛ a gbo.
Hemi kɛ yemi nya nɛ Yeriko gbogbo ɔmɛ hule pue si benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ bɔle ma a ligbi kpaago ɔ. Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Rahab, yaholɔ ɔ gbo we kɛ piɛ we tue gboli nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ a he, ejakaa nihi nɛ ya slaa zugba a, e he mɛ kɛ bua jɔmi.
Anɛ e hia kaa ma pa de nɔ́ ko lo?
Be ngɛ jinɛ i ko sɛɛ nyɛ Gideon, Barak, Samson, Yefta, David, Samuel, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a he ní.
Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mahi hwu ta, nɛ a ye kunimi; a ha nɛ jatahi ma a nya.
Hemi kɛ yemi a kɛ gbe la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ngɛ hehi, hemi kɛ yemi ha a je klaate nya, e ha ni wudɔwudɔhi ba pee katsɛmɛ; a kɛ ta buli nɛ je ma se hwu ta, nɛ a ye kunimi.
Kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ, yi komɛ a weku li nɛ gbo ɔ, a tle mɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
A wa ni komɛ yi mi wawɛɛ, nɛ a kplɛɛ we kaa a maa ngmɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he, nɛ a ye a he.
Mohu ɔ, a suɔ nɛ a na nɔ́ kɛ gbo, konɛ a tle mɛ si kɛ ba wami nɛ hi kulaa pe kekle nɔ ɔ mi.
A ye ni komɛ a he fɛu; a fia ni komɛ kpa, nɛ ni komɛ lɛɛ a bɔ mɛ pã, nɛ a wo mɛ tsu.
A fia ni komɛ tɛ nɛ a gbo; a kɛ sau poo ni komɛ a mi enyɔɔnyɔ; nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe ni komɛ.
A bu jijɔ he womi, kɛ apletsi he womi kaa heha ní.
A ye ohia, a wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní.
Je ɔ sɛ́ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ!
A wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ, kɛ yohi a nɔ.
A hi tɛ puɔhi, kɛ muɔhi a mi.
Hyɛ nihi abɔ nɛ he Mawu ye, nɛ a ngɛ odase kpakpa nɛ ɔ yee ngɛ a he!
Se nɔ́ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nine sui nɔ.
Ejakaa Mawu to blɔ nya kpakpa ha waa kɛ mɛ tsuo, nɛ ja wa piɛ he loko níhi maa hi kɛ pi si.
Wa Tsɛ Mawu Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nimli kpekpemi nitsɛnitsɛ kaa bɔku nɛ tsu a hemi kɛ yemi he ní nɛ bɔle wɔ kɛ kpe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, níhi tsuo nɛ tsiɔ wɔ blɔ, titli ɔ, yayami peemi nɛ gblaa wɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ngmɛɛ he, konɛ waa kɛ hɛ mi miami nɛ tu fo nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ wa hɛ mi ɔ. Nyɛ ha waa hyɛ Yesu, ejakaa e nɔ wa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ daa si ngɛ.
Akɛnɛ e le bua jɔmi nɛ e ma na pee se he je ɔ, gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ pi zo nɔ́ ko kulaa kɛ ha lɛ.
Mohu ɔ, e to e tsui si kɛ na amanehlu ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hii si ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ susu si nɛ yayami peeli te ngɔ wo lɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e to e tsui si kɛ na nɔ́ wawɛɛ ɔ he, konɛ pɔ ko tɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ kɔni mi ba jɔ̃.
Ta nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ yayami ngɛ hwue nɛ ɔ, nyɛ sui he nɛ a ma de ke a ma pue nyɛ muɔ si ngɛ ɔ lolo.
Anɛ nyɛ hɛ je bua womi munyu nɛ kɛ nyɛ tuɔ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ bimɛ tuɔ munyu ɔ nɔ lo?
“Ye bi, koo ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi ɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nyafii; nɛ jehanɛ ke e gbla o tue ɔ, ko ha o nine mi nɛ wo nyu.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ lɛ e tsɔseɔ, nɛ e fiaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ngɔ peeɔ e bi ɔ kpa.” Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ mi kaa Mawu lɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔsee kaa e bimɛ ji nyɛ.
Te bi nɛ ngɛ nɛ e fɔli tsɔse we lɛ nɛɛ?
Tsɔsemi nɛ a haa nihi tsuo ɔ, ke nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ na we ɔ, lɛɛ ajuama mi bimɛ ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ pi e bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ.
Jehanɛ hu, adesa blɔ fa mi ɔ, wa ngɛ tsɛmɛ nɛ tsɔseɔ wɔ, nɛ wa buɔ mɛ.
Anɛ e sɛ kaa wa baa wa he si ha Tsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ mumihi a nɔ he wami ɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami lo?
Wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔseɔ wɔ be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ bɔ nɛ sa mɛɛ a hɛ mi; se Mawu lɛɛ e tsɔseɔ wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e hi ha wɔ, nɛ wɔ hu waa pee klɔuklɔu kaa lɛ.
Be mi nɛ a ngɛ nɔ ko tsɔsee ɔ, bua jɔmi be mi; e dɔɔ lɛ wawɛɛ.
Nihi nɛ a tsɔse mɛ ɔ, pee se ɔ, a naa he se; a yeɔ dami sane, nɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a hii si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Ga womi kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ninehi nɛ mi jɔ, kɛ nakutsohi nɛ ngɛ kpokpoe ɔ, nyɛ wlua nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ nɔ gbagba nɛ te.
Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ, konɛ glɔ̃ nane ɔ kó to kpa, se mohu a tsa lɛ.
Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, ejakaa nɔ nɛ be klɔuklɔu ɔ, e be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nae.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ kó bɔ nɔ ko.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ́ ko ko dɔ nyɛ kadikadi nɛ ba ble níhi babauu kɛ puɛ ní.
Nɔ ko kó pee e he yaholɔ, loo mu ní tsulɔ kaa Esau, nɔ nɛ jua e tɛte blɔ nya kɛ he niye ní nya mi bɔ kake ɔ. Nyɛ le kaa pee se benɛ e hla kaa e tsɛ nɛ gbaa lɛ ɔ, e tsɛ ɔ kplɛɛ we.
Esau kɛ hɛdɔ fo ya kaa e ma kpale e nya se, se e na we he blɔ.
Pi Sinai yo ɔ nɛ a be nyɛe maa ta he ɔ he nɛ nyɛ ba.
Be ko benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya lejɛ ɔ, diblii, kɛ bɔku wo kpii, kɔɔhiɔ hia huu, nɛ la ngɛ tsoe plamplam ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ.
Titimati ngɛ pɛe, nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ munyu tue.
Benɛ a nu gbi ɔ, a kpa pɛɛ ke a ko de nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ he hu.
Ejakaa mlaa a nɛ a wo mɛ ke, “Ke lohwe tete nane sa yo ɔ he ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ a gbe” ɔ, a be nyɛe nɔ nɛ a ye.
Niinɛ, nɔ́ nɛ a je kpo tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ he ngɛ gbeye tsɔ; nɛ Mose nitsɛ po de ke, “I ngɛ gbeye yee, nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli.” Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ba su Zion yo ɔ, nɛ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ ma a he.
Nyɛ ba su hiɔwe Yerusalem ngɛ Mawu kɛ e bɔfohi babauu nɛ a be nyɛe kanemi, nɛ a bua kɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ a ngɔ.
Nyɛ ba sɛ bitɛtehi nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ a kpɛti.
Mawu nɛ ji adesahi tsuo a kojolɔ ɔ, kɛ mumihi nɛ hɛɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a ha a hi kɛ pi si ɔ, a hɛ mi nyɛ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yesu, nɔ nɛ ha a so somi he ɔ, e ngɔ nyɛ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Muɔ nɛ a fĩa, nɛ tsuɔ ní kpakpahi nɛ pe Habel nɔ́ ɔ he nyɛ ba a nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue.
Nihi nɛ bui nɔ nɛ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tue ɔ, a yi a he.
Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ ke nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu tue nɛ wa bui lɛ tue ɔ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛ ye wa he kɛɛ?
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, gbi nɛ Mawu wo ɔ ha nɛ zugba a mimiɛ; se jehanɛ lɛɛ e wo si ke, “Pi zugba a kɛkɛ nɛ ma mimiɛ si kake ekohu, se mohu ma ha nɛ hiɔwe hu ma mimiɛ kɛ piɛ he.” Munyu, “Si kake ekohu” ɔ, tsɔɔ paa kaa níhi nɛ a bɔ nɛ a mimiɛ ɔ maa je a hi he, konɛ níhi nɛ a be nyɛe ma mimiɛ ɔ nɛ a hi si daa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa na Mawu si, ejakaa e ha wɔ blɔ nya nɛ waa ye tsɛ nɛ be tsakee gblegbleegble.
Nyɛ ha waa ngɔ bu, kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ ba ja lɛ kɛ wa tsui tsuo bɔ nɛ maa sa e hɛ mi; ejakaa wa Mawu ɔ, la nɛ kpataa nɔ́ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ji lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ wa maa sa Mawu hɛ mi Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi daa kaa nyɛmimɛ.
Nyɛ ko jɔɔ nibwɔ peemi hulɔ, ejakaa nibwɔ peemi nɔ nɛ ni komɛ gu kɛ he hiɔwe bɔfohi atuu nɛ a li tete.
Nyɛ kai nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo lɛ a wo tsu.
Nyɛ kai nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae.
Nyɛ ha gba si himi he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyumu kɛ yo nɛ a ye a sibi anɔkuale.
Ejakaa Mawu maa kojo yaholi, kɛ gba puɛli.
Nyɛ ko di sika se; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ he.
Ejakaa Mawu de ke, “I be mo sie, nɛ i be mo kuae gblegbleegble.” Lɛɛ nyɛ ha waa kɛ kã nɛ de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji ye he piɛlɔ, i be gbeye yee.
Mɛni adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi?” Nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ kai mɛ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a hi si saminya hluu kɛ ya si a gbenɔ be; nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a he Mawu ye ha, nɛ nyɛɛ kase mɛ.
Yesu Kristo ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu e ngɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ; nɛ e ngɛ ja nɔuu kɛ yaa neneene.
Nyɛ ko ha ni komɛ nɛ ngɔ tsɔɔmi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ kɛ sane kpakpa a kɔ we nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je blɔ kpakpa a nɔ.
Mawu dloomi ɔ lɛ woɔ wa mumi mi he wami; se mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ niye ní he ɔ, se nami ko kulaa be he kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ. Wa ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ be he blɔ kaa a yeɔ e nɔ ní.
Yuda bi a we osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ngɔɔ lohwehi a muɔ kɛ ya sãã bɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, konɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ ma a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.
Se lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ya sãã ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se.
