Jã kɛ̃ Yesu hu na amahehlu ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ se, konɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ɔ kɛ je ma a he yayami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya e ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se, nɛ a bɔ wɔ ahlua ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee lɛ ɔ. Ejakaa wa be ma nɛ ngɛ daa ngɛ zugba a nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, se ma nɛ maa ba a mohu se blɔ wa ngɛ hlae.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa wa je Mawu yi daa.
Wɔ nihi nɛ wa heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ waa kɛ wa nya jaje ɔ kɛ jeɔ e Bi ɔ yi ɔ ji bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ sãe ha Mawu kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ hɛ ko je kpakpa peemi nɔ; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ dla níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ saa Mawu hɛ mi saminya.
Nyɛɛ bu nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha mɛ.
Mɛ lɛ a hyɛɔ nyɛ nɔ daa, nɛ a maa bu akɔtaa ha Mawu.
Nyɛ ha nɛ a pee enɛ ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, se pi kɛ mi mi la, ejakaa lɔ ɔ maa ye nyɛ awi.
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ daa.
Wa le kaa wa he nile bui wɔ fɔ; ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, wa suɔ kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa maa pee ɔ, bu nɛ hi he.
I ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ a ha nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ be kpiti mi.
He jɔmi Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ gu muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu neneene somi ɔ nya a nɔ, nɛ e je to ɔmɛ a hyɛlɔ ngua a nɛ ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, e dla nyɛ kɛ pi si kɛ ní tsumi kpakpa sɔuu, konɛ nyɛɛ pee e sɔumi nya ní; nɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e ha nyɛ tsu níhi nɛ maa sa e hɛ mi, konɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene.
Amen.
Nyagbe munyuhi Ye nyɛmimɛ, womi nɛ i ngma nyɛ nɛ ɔ nya kɛ we kulaa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye slɔmi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa wa nyɛmi Timoteo nɛ a wo lɛ tsu ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngmɛɛ e he.
Ke e ba su ye ngɔ mla a, i kɛ lɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ ngɔ.
Wa biɔ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Italia a hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
Amen.
NYA TSƆƆMI Yakobo womi ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ a ba je mi ha saminya.
A ngma womi ɔ kɛ mane ni klɔuklɔuhi tsuo nɛ gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Yakobo ngɔ munyu he za womi níhi kɛ tsɔɔ munyuhi a nya.
E tu ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi fuu a he munyu kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sa kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ ba e je mi ha.
Níhi nɛ e tu a he munyu ɔ ekomɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: ní nami kɛ ohia, ka, je mi bami kpakpa, nɔ he susumi yaya, hemi kɛ yemi kɛ e mi ní tsumi, nɔ́ nɛ lilɛ tsuɔ, nile, pɛ, he nɔ womi kɛ humi peemi, ni kpahi kojomi, fiami, tsui si tomi, kɛ kue fami.
Yakobo tsɔɔ wɔ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi kaa ke nɔ ko he Mawu ye kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e he hia wawɛɛ kaa a na ngɛ e ní peepee mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .
Hemi kɛ yemi kɛ nile .- Ohia kɛ ní nami .- Ka .- Sane kpakpa a tue bumi, kɛ e nɔ yemi .- A bɔ kɔkɔ ngɛ nɔ hɛ mi hyɛmi he .- Hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ e he ní tsumi .- Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ, kɛ e lilɛ nɔ hyɛmi .- Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ, kɛ je ɔ .—.
Ga womi slɔɔto komɛ .-
Imi Yakobo, Mawu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ ɔ lɛ i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
Nyɛ he manye!
Hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ nile Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛɛ kɛ ka slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ kpee ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ wawɛɛ mohu; ejakaa nyɛ le momo kaa ke nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi wa, nɛ nyɛ ye ka amɛ a nɔ ɔ, e woɔ nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ toɔ nyɛ tsui si.
Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si saminya kɛ gblee kahi tsuo a mi kɛ manye, konɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si kulaa, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kó hia nyɛ.
Se ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ nile hlae ɔ, e kpa Mawu pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ha lɛ; ejakaa Mawu haa nɔ nɔ́ faa nɛ mi mi gbigblimi be mi.
Se ke o ngɛ Mawu nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ kpae ɔ, he ye, nɛ o ko je nɔ́ kulaa kaa Mawu ma ha mo nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ bie ɔ. Nɔ nɛ jeɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wo mi oslɔke nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ fiae kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.
-Nɔmlɔ nɛ jeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e juɛmi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ, nɛ e nyɛ we nɔ́ ko nya si mami ɔ, e ko susu kaa e ma na nɔ́ ko kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi.
Ohia kɛ ní nami Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ohiatsɛ ɔ, ke Mawu wo e nɔ ɔ, e fĩa; nɛ Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ niatsɛ ɔ, lɛ hu ke Mawu ba lɛ si ɔ, e fĩa, ejakaa niatsɛmɛ hɛ mi ma kpata kaa mɔmɔ nglaa ngɛ nga nɔ.
Ke pu je, nɛ je mi dɔ la a, mɔmɔ nglaa, nɛ e wɔleɔ pueɔ si, nɛ afɛu ko be e he hu.
Ja nɔuu niatsɛ ɔ hu benɛ e hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, e hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa.
Ka Nɔ nɛ ke a ngɛ lɛ kae ɔ, e toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e ngmɛɛ we e hemi kɛ yemi he ɔ, á gbaa lɛ.
Ejakaa ke e nyɛ gblee ka a mi ɔ, neneene wami nɛ Mawu wo si kaa a ma ha nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ.
Ke a ka nɔ ko ɔ, e ko de ke Mawu lɛ ka lɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ka Mawu kaa e maa pee yayami lo.
Pohu Mawu nitsɛ kɛ́ nɔ.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we akɔnɔ nɛ gblaa lɛ, nɛ́ sisiɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ kaa lɛ.
Nɛ akɔnɔ ɔ, ke e ngɔ hɔ ɔ, e fɔɔ yayami, nɛ yayami hu ke e wa a, e fɔɔ gbenɔ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sisi nyɛ.
Nike ní kpakpa, kɛ níhi nɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ wa naa yaka a, lɛ tsuo Mawu lɛ haa wɔ.
Mawu lɛ bɔ pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. E haa nɛ a haa wɔ la daa, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e tsakee we gblegbleegble.
Mawu gu sane kpakpa a nɔ kɛ ha wɔ mumi mi wami.
Lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya nɛ e pee enɛ ɔ. Ejakaa e suɔ kaa e pee wɔ nihi nɛ a he hia pe nibɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Sane kpakpa a tue bumi kɛ e nɔ yemi Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi enɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛ he ko sɔ kɛ tu munyu, nɛ nyɛ mi mi hu ko fu mla.
Mi mi fumi ha we nɛ nɔ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je mi bami yaya nɛ woɔ nɔ he mu ɔ, nyɛ kpa lɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ ko pee nyɛ sibi yi wu tso nihi hu.
Nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami nɛ he munyu ɔ nɛ a du kɛ wo nyɛ mi ɔ, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɛ ma he nyɛ klaa yi wami.
Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he kaa nyɛ maa bu munyu ɔ tue kɛkɛ; mohu nyɛɛ pee munyu ɔ nɔ yeli.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu munyu ɔ tue kɛkɛ, se e yi nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ya hyɛɛ e he ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi, nɛ e naa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tutuutu.
E naa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ ke e je lejɛ ɔ nɔuu pɛ e hɛ jeɔ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ nɔ.
Sane kpakpa a ji Mawu mlaa nɛ hi kɛ pi si, nɛ haa nɔ yeɔ e he.
Ke nɔ ko kase sane kpakpa a mi tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ saminya, nɛ e mia e hɛ mi nɛ e hɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ e kase ɔ nɔ, se mohu e ye nɔ ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ saminya ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ tsue ɔ mi.
Anɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko susuu kaa e ngɛ Mawu jae bɔ nɛ sa lo?
Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, e kɔ e lilɛ mi.
Ke e kɔɛ e lilɛ mi ɔ, tsa pi Mawu nɛ e ngɛ jae, se lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɛ sisie.
Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ma ja Mawu nɛ maa sa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: awusahi kɛ yalɔyihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, e hyɛ a nɔ.
Jehanɛ e hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he nɔ saminya, konɛ je mi akɔnɔ yaya ko tɔtɔ e nane.
Nyɛ ko hyɛ nihi a hɛ mi Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ yeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ko bu ni komɛ pe ni komɛ.
Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ya kpe ngɛ jami he ɔ, nɛ ni enyɔ ba.
Nɔ kake ha ablade bo, nɛ e wo sika tsu nguɛ ní.
Nɔ kake ɔ lɛɛ ohiatsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ e ha bo gbagbɛ, loo bo sɛmusɛmu.
Nɔ nɛ dla e he saminya a, nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ bu, nɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ba hi hiɛ!” Se ohiatsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ de lɛ ke, “Dá si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he ko!” aloo “Ba sɔ̃ si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!” Tse nyɛ na nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ!
Mi gbami nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti bae ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi a he ga yaya toe.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue.
Tse nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ je ɔ buu mɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔ, mɛ Mawu hla a. Akɛnɛ a heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba pee mumi mi niatsɛmɛ, nɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ha nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ ba pee a nɔ.
Se nyɛ pueɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si.
Anɛ pi niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ?
Anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a ngɔɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔ?
Biɛ kpakpa nɛ a wo nyɛ ɔ, anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a gbeɔ he guɛ ɔ?
E ngɛ ngmami ɔ mi ke, “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.” Matsɛ yemi ɔ mi mlaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ke o ye nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ o pee saminya.
Se ke nyɛ hyɛɔ nihi a hɛ mi ɔ, yayami nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ fɔ kaa nyɛ tɔ mlaa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, se e ma tɔ mlaa a kake ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ kaa e tɔ mlaa amɛ tsuo.
Mawu ɔ nɛ wo mlaa ke a ko puɛ gba a, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e wo mlaa ke a ko gbe nɔmlɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o puɛ we gba, se o gbeɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, o tɔ mlaa a tsuo.
Nyɛ munyu tumi, kɛ nyɛ ní peepee tsuo nɛ tsɔɔ kaa mlaa nɛ haa wa yeɔ wa he ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa kojo wɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ nɛ́ mɔbɔ ɔ, benɛ a maa kojo lɛ ɔ, Mawu be lɛ mɔbɔ nae; se ke o naa mɔbɔ ɔ, Mawu be mo fɔ bue.
Hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ e he ní tsumi Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nɔ ko ke e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, se e ní peepee tsɔɔ we ja a, mɛni se nami ngɛ he?
Anɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ma nyɛ he e yi wami lo?
Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmimɛ komɛ be heha ní, loo niye ní.
Ke nyɛ ha we mɛ níhi nɛ hia mɛ nɛ ɔ, mɛni se nami ngɛ he kaa nyɛ ma de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi!
Nyɛ ya hlue la; nyɛɛ ye ní nɛ nyɛɛ tɔ?” Hemi kɛ yemi hu ja nɔuu e ngɛ; ke ní tsumi piɛ we he ɔ, e ji hemi kɛ yemi nɛ gbo.
Se nɔ ko ma de ke, “Moo lɛɛ o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ imi lɛɛ i tsuɔ ní” Yoo, tsɔɔ mi o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o tsu we he ní ɔ, nɛ imi hu i kɛ níhi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo kaa i heɔ yeɔ.
Nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu kake pɛ lɛ ngɛ!
Saminya!
Mumi yayami ɔmɛ po heɔ yeɔ ja nɔuu.
Nɛ lɔ ɔ haa a nuɔ sawale, nɛ a he doɔ blibliibli.
Kuasia!
O ngɛ hlae nɛ nɔ ko nɛ de mo ke hemi kɛ yemi kɛkɛ nɛ ní tsumi piɛ we he ɔ, e wui yiblii.
Mɛni ba loko Mawu bu wa nɛ̃ Abraham dalɔ ɔ?
E ní tsumi ɔ nya!
Ejakaa e ngɔ e bi Isak kɛ fɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa e kɛ maa sã bɔ ha Mawu.
Tse nyɛ na!
Abraham he ye, nɛ e tsu he ní hulɔ.
Ní nɛ e tsu ɔ ha nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ba wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ ba mi ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ha nɛ Mawu bu lɛ dalɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he nɛ a tsɛɛ Abraham ke Mawu huɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛɛ tse nyɛ na kaa ní tsumi nɔ Mawu guu kɛ buɔ nɔ dalɔ, se pi hemi kɛ yemi pɛ nɔ.
Yo ajuama a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rahab ɔ, lɛ hu ja nɔuu.
Mawu da nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ nɔ kɛ bu lɛ dalɔ.
Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya slaa zugba a nigii ɔ, Rahab he mɛ atuu; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ a gu he kpa kɛ je slɔkee.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ ke mumi je nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ e plɛɔ nɔ́ gbogboe ɔ, jã hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ní tsumi piɛ we he ɔ peeɔ hemi kɛ yemi gbogboe.
Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ hyɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ti nihi fuu kó pee nyɛ he tsɔɔli.
Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, wɔ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, wa tue gblami nya maa wa pe ni kpa amɛ.
Wɔ tsuo wa pɔɔ tɔmi peemi babauu.
Se ke nɔ ko tɔ we ngɛ munyu tumi mi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ji lɛ, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo nɔ hulɔ.
Ke wa ngɛ hlae nɛ okpɔngɔ nɛ bu wɔ tue ɔ, waa kɛ dade woɔ e nya mi.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ wa suɔ kaa e ya a, e yaa.
Aloo waa ngɔ lɛ nɛ ngɛ pa nɔ.
Ke e kle kaa mɛni, nɛ ja kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa nɛ ma nyɛ tsɛ̃ e yi se po, kudɔɔ nyafii ko kɛkɛ kudɔɔtsɛ ɔ kɛ plɛɔ lɛ ɔ kɛ yaa he nɛ e suɔ.
Ja nɔuu lilɛ ngɛ; lilɛ ngɛ nyafii lɛɛ, se e fĩaa ní nguahi.
Hyɛ kaa la bɔbɔyoo pɛ maa sã hue tso!
Ee, lilɛ ngɛ kaa la.
Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ kake nɛ ji lilɛ ɔ, yi wu tso ní sɔuu e tsuɔ.
E kɛ yayami bleɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo.
La nɛ je Abosiami a je nitsɛnitsɛ lɛ e kɛ mɛɛ wɔ kɛ kpataa wa hɛ mi pɛsɛɛ.
Adesa nyɛɔ jɔɔ adebɔ ní kpahi tsuo a he, nga mi lohwehi jio, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ jio, níhi nɛ sãã si jio, pa mi lohi jio.
Se lilɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e jɔɔ he gblegbleegble.
E ji nɔ́ yayami nɛ jɔɛ nɔ he mi; duɔ nɛ gbee nɔ hyi lɛ tɔ.
Lilɛ waa kɛ naa wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ si; nɛ lɛ nɔuu waa kɛ gbiɛɔ wa sibi adesa nɛ Mawu bɔ ngɛ e subai nɔ ɔ. Adesa lilɛ kake ɔ, e kɛ gbaa, nɛ e kɛ gbiɛɔ nɔ hulɔ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, e sɛ́ kaa e baa jã.
Anɛ nyu hɛngmɛ baa nyu mua, kɛ nyu doodooe kɛ jee hɛngmɛ kake ɔ nɔuu mi lo?
Ye nyɛmimɛ, anɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ma nyɛ wo oliv tso yiblii lo?
Anɛ wai tso ma nyɛ wo ngmɔkɔ lo?
Jã nɔuu ngo nyu be nyɛe maa pee nyu mua.
Nile nɛ je hiɔwe Anɛ ní lelɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti lo?
Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi lo?
Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, e ba e je mi saminya.
E ngɔ he si bami kɛ tsu ní kpakpa kɛ ye e nile ɔ he odase.
Se ke hunga jemi yaya, kɛ pɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ hlae kaa e hi ha lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko fĩa, nɛ́ nyɛ ba ye lakpa ngɔ si anɔkuale ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a nile nɛ ɔ, pi hiɔwe nɛ e je; zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɔ́; Mawu mumi be mi, mumi yayami sɔuu.
He nɛ hunga jemi ngɛ, nɛ nihi suɔ kaa e hi ha mɛ pɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɛ a naa sakasaka peemi, kɛ awi yemi slɔɔtohi babauu ngɛ.
Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ nile nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ, kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ a naa ngɛ e he ji kaa e he tsɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a naa kaa e he jɔ; e hɛ ka si, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ he ha nɔ.
E naa nɔ mɔbɔ saminya, nɛ ní kpakpahi sɔuu e tsuɔ.
E hyɛ we nihi a hɛ mi, nɛ e pee we osato.
Nihi nɛ kpataa pɛ, nɛ a haa he jɔmi baa a, a ngɛ wu kpakpa due, nɛ yiblii nɛ a woɔ ji dami sane yemi.
Je ɔ kɛ huɛ bɔmi Ta kɛ pɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, mɛni kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ baa?
Anɛ pi nyɛ he lo mi akɔnɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi lo?
Ke nɔ́ ko pee nyɛ akɔnɔ nɛ nyɛ nine sui nɔ ɔ, nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si.
Jã kɛ̃ ke nyɛ hɛ kɔ̃ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ a níhi a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ nine sui nɔ ɔ, nyɛ woɔ pɛ, nɛ nyɛ gbaa ta kɛ woɔ nyɛ sibi.
Níhi nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ nine sui nɔ; ejakaa nyɛ bi we Mawu.
Ke nyɛ kpa pɛɛ hu, nyɛ nine sui nɔ, ejakaa nyɛ yi mi tomi ɔmɛ hí; níhi nɛ ma ha nyɛ bua jɔmi pɛ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ kpaa.
Nyɛ gba puɛli nɛ nyɛ yi Mawu anɔkuale!
Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, nɔ ɔ ngɛ Mawu nyɛe lo?
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ je ɔ bɔɔ ɔ, e peeɔ Mawu he nyɛlɔ.
Anɛ nyɛ susuu kaa yaka gu nɛ a ngma ke, “Mumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ wo wa mi ɔ, e jeɔ he hunga wawɛɛ” ɔ?
Se mɔbɔ nɛ Mawu naa wɔ ɔ nya wa kulaa pe lɔ ɔ po.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, Mawu baa mɛ si; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ baa a he si ɔ lɛɛ e dlooɔ mɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Mawu.
Nyɛɛ te si kɛ wo Abosiami, nɛ e maa tu nyɛ nya fo.
Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ su Mawu he, nɛ e maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su nyɛ he.
Yayami peeli, nyɛ fɔ nyɛ dɛ!
Nyɛ yi mi enyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛ, nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui.
Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ; nyɛɛ wo yana, nɛ nyɛ nya awe.
Nyɛ kpa muɔmi, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana.
Nyɛ kpa nyami, nɛ nyɛɛ nu sawale!
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ma wo nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ ko tu nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu yaya Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko tu nyɛ sibi a he munyu yaya.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ e nyɛmi he nyumu yaya a, mlaa a e ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ sie ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kojoɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ mlaa a kojoe.
Ke nɔ ko tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ mlaa a, pi mlaa a nɔ yelɔ ji lɛ, se mohu e peeɔ mlaa a kojolɔ.
Mawu pɛ ji mlaa wolɔ kɛ kojolɔ.
Lɛ nɔ kake nɔuu pɛ lɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami, nɛ e kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi hulɔ.
Se moo lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo, nɛ o kojoɔ o nyɛmi adesa?
Nyɛ ko fĩa ngɔ fɔ hwɔɔ se nɔ Jehanɛ, nyɛ ti ni komɛ deɔ ke, “Hwɔɔ, loo hwɔɔ se ɔ, ma hia blɔ kɛ ya ma ko mi, nɛ ma ya ye jeha ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma ya ye jua nɛ ma na ní.” Nyɛ ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ deɔ ja a, nyɛɛ bu tue.
Anɛ nyɛ le hwɔɔ se je nami mi sane?
Nyɛ ngɛ kaa afua nɛ woɔ be kpiti, kɛkɛ a nɛ́ lɛ hu.
Nɔ́ nɛ mohu nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ deɔ ji, “Ke Mawu suɔ nɛ wa yi na wami ɔ, wa maa pee enɛ ɔ, loo enɛ.” Se nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ fĩaa.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ji yayami peemi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ le nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ e pee we ɔ, yayami e pee ɔ nɛ.
A ngɛ niatsɛmɛ kɔkɔ bɔe Jehanɛ nyɛ niatsɛmɛ hu nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛɛ wo yana, nɛ nyɛ nya awe; ejakaa aywilɛho sanehi maa ba nyɛ nɔ!
Ní babauu nɛ nyɛ na a plɛ pee kɔɔhiɔ, nɛ wɔyewɔye ye nyɛ heha ní kpakpahi.
Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ bua nya a maa nɔ kana.
Jamɛ a kana a maa ye odase kɛ si nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpe nyɛ he lo kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ la sã.
Nyɛ ngɛ juetli babanu buae kɛ ngɛ toe nyagbe be nɛ ɔ mi.
Apaa yeli nɛ hu nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ wui mɛ hiɔ.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ha!
Ní kpali nɛ bua nyɛ ngmɔ ní nya a a ngmlaa a ya su Nyɔmtsɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tue mi tɔɔ.
Nyɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔ nyɛ he saminya ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ ye ɔ ha nyɛ wo zɔ saminya kɛ ha ligbi nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ. Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, se a be he wami nɛ a kɛ ma fa a he ɔ, nyɛ bu mɛ fɔ, nɛ nyɛ gbe mɛ.
Tsui si tomi kɛ sɔlemi Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, e hia kaa nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si kɛ ya su be nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba.
Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ ngmɔ hulɔ toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e mlɛɔ kɛ ya siɔ zugba a baa ní saminya.
E toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e mlɛɔ kɛ ya siɔ gbo kɛ gbiɛ nyu nɛɔ pueɔ dumi ní ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ja.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ, nyɛ lua nyɛ, ejakaa be ɔ na wɔ haa.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko pia nyɛ sibi, konɛ Mawu ko kojo nyɛ.
Hyɛ, kojolɔ ɔ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, gbali ɔmɛ nɛ fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ to a tsui si wawɛɛ kɛ na amanehlu.
Nyɛ ha nɛ a pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ.
Niinɛ, nihi nɛ to a tsui si wawɛɛ ɔ, wa buu mɛ nihi nɛ a gbaa mɛ.
Nyɛ nu bɔ nɛ Hiob to e tsui si, nɛ́ nyagbe ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha e na ní babauu.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛ ko ka kita.
Nyɛ ko ka hiɔwe; nyɛ ko ka zugba, nɛ nyɛ ko ka nɔ́ kpa ko hulɔ.
Ke nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ mi anɔkuale ɔ, nyɛ de ke “Ee”; se ke e be mi ɔ, nyɛ de ke, “Dɛbi.” Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu be nyɛ fɔ bue.
Ke amanehlu ba nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e sɔle.
Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko bua jɔ ɔ, e la yi jemi la.
Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko be he wami ɔ, e ha nɛ a tsɛ asafo ɔ mi nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba; a sɔle ha lɛ, nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi.
Ke a sɔle kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ha lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, hiɔtsɛ ɔ ma na he wami.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tsa lɛ kulaa, nɛ e maa ngɔ yayami tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ he ɔ kɛ pa lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ sibi; nyɛɛ sɔle ha nyɛ sibi konɛ a tsa nyɛ.
Ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, e tsuɔ ní saminya.
Eliya a, nɔmlɔ adesa ji lɛ kaa wɔ nɔuu.
E sɔle kɛ hɛdɔ ke hiɔmi kó nɛ; nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́ ngɛ zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ kɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa sɔuu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale sɔle, nɛ Mawu ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ saminya, nɛ zugba a ba ní.
Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko tla kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ he, nɛ nɔ ko kpale lɛ kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsake yayami peelɔ ko ɔ, e ma he yayami peelɔ ɔ yi wami, nɛ a maa ngɔ e he yayami babauu ɔ kɛ pa lɛ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Petro ngma e kekleekle womi ɔ ya ha Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ gbɛ fĩa Asia Mainɔ omleyi je ɔ. Biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɛ mɛ ji, “Nihi nɛ Mawu hla.” Petro ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya wo ni ɔmɛ a mumi mi he wami, ejakaa kɛ je be nɛ a ba he Kristo ye ɔ, yi mi sɔuu a ngɛ mɛ wae, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae.
Petro kai mɛ Yesu Kristo he sane kpakpa a, kaa Kristo gbenɔ, e si temi, kɛ si nɛ e wo kaa e maa ba ekohu ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa mɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e hia kaa a to a tsui si ngɛ amanehlu nɛ a ngɛ nae ɔ mi, nɛ a le kaa a kɛ lɔ ɔ ngɛ mɛ kae kaa a he Kristo ɔ ye niinɛ lo.
Á na nɛ a le hu kaa “Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a, a nine maa su a hiɔwo nɔ.” Kɛ piɛ he wami nɛ e wo mɛ ngɛ amanehlu nɛ a ngɛ nae ɔ he ɔ, Petro wo mɛ ga hu kaa a bɔ mɔde nɛ a hi si kaa Kristo we bi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- A kai ni ɔmɛ kaa Mawu ma he a yi wami .- A slɔ mɛ kaa a pee a he klɔuklɔu .—.
Nɔ́ nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ peemi ngɛ amanehlu be mi .—.
Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ ba e he si, nɛ e tsu ní .- Nyagbe munyuhi .-
Imi Petro, Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ Mawu hla, nɛ nyɛ gbɛ fĩa Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia, kɛ Bitinia zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ manee.
Tsɛ Mawu hla nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e to ke e maa pee ɔ, nɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ pee nyɛ ma klɔuklɔu, konɛ nyɛɛ bu Yesu Kristo tue, nɛ e muɔ ɔ nɛ tsu nyɛ he.
Mawu dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ fuu ha nyɛ.
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ mi wa Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ yi.
E na wɔ mɔbɔ babauu kaa e tle Yesu Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e kɛ ha wɔ wami he; ejakaa suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ be nyagbe.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ haa wɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ mi wa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa Mawu ngɔ gbosi ní nɛ puɛ we, nɛ mu be he, nɛ kpa we hulɔ ɔ ngɔ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.
Mawu ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ lɛ Mawu ɔ yeɔ, nɛ́ e kɛ e he wami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ he bue ɔ. Mawu pee klaalo kaa e ma he nyɛ yi wami nyagbe be ɔ mi.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu slɔɔtohi nae be bɔɔ ko lɛɛ, se nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ɔ he.
A kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae kaa nyɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ niinɛ lo.
Sika tsu po nɛ puɛɔ ɔ, a kaa ngɛ la mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ he jua wa kulaa pe sika tsu ɔ, ja a ka lɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e mi nɛ wa.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu ɔ, a ma je nyɛ yi, nɛ a maa bu nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi maa ba nyami.
Nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, se nyɛ suɔ lɛ; amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ, se nyɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ, nɛ nyɛ naa bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ nyaa bɔ nɛ e be hie kalemi, ejakaa nyɛ yi wami hemi ɔ nɛ e he nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nɔ.
Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ gba, nɛ a de ke dloomi ko ngɛ ha nyɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ, hla kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi sane ɔ mi fitsofitso.
A bɔ mɔde kaa a maa na be nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e ma plɛ kɛ ba ha.
Be ɔ nɛ Kristo mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Mumi ɔ de to ke Kristo maa na amanehlu, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hɛ mi maa ba nyami.
Mawu je tsɔɔ gbali nɛ ɔmɛ kaa ní tsumi nɛ a ngɛ tsue ɔ, pi mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ma na he se, se nyɛ mohu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a fiɛ sane kpakpa ngɔ ha nyɛ tsuo.
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ a tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e he wami a kɛ fiɛ ha nyɛ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tete ko suɔ kaa a maa nu sisi.
Si himi klɔuklɔu Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ juɛmi klaalo kɛ ha ní tsumi.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ dloomi nɛ Mawu ma ha nyɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ bu Mawu tue.
Akɔnɔhi nɛ hao nyɛ benɛ nyɛ li anɔkuale ɔ lolo ɔ, nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ se hu.
Se mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ je mi bami he nɛ tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ngmami ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa i ngɛ klɔuklɔu.” Ke nyɛ ngɛ kue fae ha Mawu ɔ, nyɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ke Tsaatsɛ.
Ee, Mawu hyɛ we nihi a hɛ mi, se mohu e kojoɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e ní peemi níhi a nya.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ bu kɛ ha lɛ nyɛ wami be nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ tsuo.
Ejakaa yakayaka si himi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ le hĩɔ nɛ Mawu wo loko e kɛ kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je mi nɛ nyɛ ye nyɛ he.
Pi nɔ́ ko nɛ puɛɔ kaa sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ, se mohu, gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo, nɛ e ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ nɛ he jua wa a. Ee, Kristo ngɛ kaa to bi nɛ kpa, aloo mu ko be e he.
Mawu hla lɛ momo loko a to je ɔ sisi, nɛ a je lɛ kpo ngɛ nyagbe be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ nyɛ he.
Nyɛ gu e nɔ kɛ he Mawu ye; Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si, nɛ e wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ lɛ nɔuu e nɔ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, anɔkuale tsɔɔmi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo he ɔ, nyɛ ye nɔ.
Nyɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ ba na suɔmi kpakpa kɛ ha nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Yesu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi saminya kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.
Kɛ gu Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ daa a nɔ ɔ, a fɔ nyɛ ehe.
Nyɛ ba pee Tsɛ nɛ gbo we, se pi nɔ nɛ gboɔ ɔ bimɛ.
Ngmami ɔ ke, “Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ kaa nga; Nɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa nga mɔmɔ, Nga gbliɔ, nɛ mɔmɔ wɔleɔ, Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.” Munyu ɔ ji sane kpakpa a nɛ a fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kristo ji tɛ nɛ haa wami Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa yayami tsuaa yayami peemi, lakpa, osato, ninyɛ, kɛ nihi a he munyu tumi.
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ ní kaa bimwɔwi, nihi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ehe.
Nyɛ ha nɛ mumi mi nyɔ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ ɔ nɛ jlo nyɛ.
Nyɛ hla nɛ nyɛɛ nu, nɛ nyɛɛ wa, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpa si, nɛ nyɛ na kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi jɔ.” Nyɛɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Lɛ ji tɛ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ adesa kua lɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ he be se nami ɔ nɛ.
Se Mawu lɛɛ e hla lɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa saminya.
Nyɛɛ ba kaa tɛhi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a fia nyɛ kɛ ma si kaa mumi mi we.
Nyɛ maa pee osɔfo klɔuklɔuhi, nɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa sã mumi mi bɔ nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke, “I hla tɛ ko nɛ he jua wa saminya, nɛ i kɛ ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion kaa kɔ nya tɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ, e he jua wa ha nyɛ saminya; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ, “Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ kua a, lɔ ɔ tutuutu ba plɛ pee kɔ nya tɛ.” Ngmami kpa ko hu de ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji tɛ nɛ ma ha nɛ nihi a nane ma tɛ nɔ; tɛ sa nɛ ma ha nɛ nihi maa nɔɔ si.” A tɛ nɔ́, ejakaa a yi Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ nɔ; bɔ nɛ Mawu to ha mɛ ji ja a nɛ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, wɛtso nɛ Mawu hla ji nyɛ, odehe osɔfohi, je ma klɔuklɔu, kɛ Mawu nitsɛ e ma.
E hla nyɛ nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ kɛ je diblii mi kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e la nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ ɔ he, konɛ nyɛ ba fiɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ. Sa a, pi Mawu e ma ji nyɛ; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ma ji nyɛ.
Sa a, Mawu nɛ́ nyɛ mɔbɔ; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e na nyɛ mɔbɔ.
Mawu nyɔguɛhi Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
I ngɔ sane nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe kaa nibwɔhi, kɛ blɔ hiali ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi.
Nyɛ ko ya di he lo mi níhi a se, ejakaa a kɛ nyɛ klaa ngɛ ta hwue daa.
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Ke nyɛ pee jã, nɛ a po nyɛ nya kaa yayami peeli ji nyɛ po, kpakpa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, a maa na.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu ma ba kojo je ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nɔ yemi tsuaa nɔ yemi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, matsɛ nɛ ngɛ blɔ nya pe nihi tsuo, aloo amlaalohi nɛ e hla nɛ a gbla yayami peeli a tue, nɛ a je nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a yi ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee kpakpa, konɛ kuasia amɛ nɛ hii ní tsuae putɛputɛɛ ɔ, a kpa munyu tumi kɛ si nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ hi si kaa nihi nɛ ye a he, se nyɛ ko ngɔ he yemi nɛ ɔ kɛ pee yayami nɛ nyɛɛ laa nɔ.
Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ hi si kaa Mawu tsɔli.
Nyɛɛ bu nɔ tsuaa nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Kristo ɔ; nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ bu matsɛ ɔ. Kristo amanehlu nɛ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ Sɔmɔli, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya; pi nihi nɛ a mi mi hi, nɛ a he jɔ kɛkɛ, se ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi tete.
Ke o na amanehlu nɛ sɛ́, nɛ o le kaa lɔ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu maa gbaa mo.
Ke o pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, nɛ a ngɛ mo kpa fiae ngɛ he, nɛ o to o tsui si ɔ, mɛni se nami ngɛ he?
Se ke o pee kpakpa, nɛ o ngɛ he amanehlu nae, nɛ o to o tsui si ɔ, Mawu maa gbaa mo.
Enɛ ɔ he Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ejakaa Kristo nitsɛ na amanehlu, nɛ e kɛ lɔ ɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se.
E pee we yayami ko ɔ, lakpa ko hu ji e nya.
Benɛ a ngɛ lɛ jɛe ɔ, lɛɛ e jɛ we nɔ ngɔ to we nane mi.
Benɛ e ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e gbíɛ nɔ ko; se mohu e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu, kojolɔ ɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ. Kristo nitsɛ tloo wa he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ na nɔ́ ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ.
E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ wa ko ngɔ wa he ngɔ ha yayami hu, se mohu waa ba wa je mi bɔ nɛ sa.
E pa amɛ lɛ tsa nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Jinɛ nyɛ laa blɔ kaa tohi.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ hyɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ he bulɔ ɔ ngɔ.
Yigbayihi kɛ a hunomɛ Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, nyɛ yigbayihi hu, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke a ti ni komɛ he we Mawu munyu ɔ yi ɔ, nyɛ je mi bami nɛ tsake mɛ.
E be hiae kaa a kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu po, ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa na kaa nyɛ je mi bami he tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ níhi kaa yi gbɔmi, loo sika tsu ní womi, loo bo nɛ ngɛ fɛu bumi kɛ dla nyɛ he.
Se mohu, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ha ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ he fɛu ɔ nitsɛnitsɛ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ he jɔ, nɛ e ngɛ kpoo ɔ, e he fɛu nɛ tsakee we ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa saminya ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Ejakaa yi klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ blema a ba a he si ha a hunomɛ.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a he pee fɛu.
Sara nitsɛ pee jã; e bu Abraham, nɛ e tsɛ lɛ e nyɔmtsɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ Sara bimɛ, ke nyɛ peeɔ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye ɔ. Nyɛ hunomɛ ɔmɛ hu, ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ na nya ha mɛ saminya kaa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso blɔ fa mi ɔ, yo he wɛ tsɔ.
Nyɛɛ bu mɛ, ejakaa Mawu ma ha nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo ma na wami kaa dloomi ní nɛ je lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ.
Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ ko kó tsi nyɛ sɔlemi blɔ.
Nɔ́ nami ngɛ kpakpa peemi he Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi.
Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ.
Nyɛɛ na nyɛ sibi mɔbɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si.
Nyɛ ko ngɔ yayami kɛ ma yayami nane mi, aloo jɛmi kɛ ma jɛmi nane mi.
Ke nihi pee nyɛ yayami, loo a jɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ de Mawu nɛ e gbaa mɛ mohu.
Ejakaa gbaami Mawu wo si ke e maa gbaa nyɛ benɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ngmami ɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e na bua jɔmi, nɛ e se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi ɔ, e kpa lakpa yemi, kɛ nɔ he munyu yaya tumi.
E jɔɔ yayami peemi, nɛ e pee kpakpa.
E bɔ mɔde wawɛɛ, nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ buu dali a he, nɛ ke a fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ yayami lɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ yi.” Ke nyɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi he ɔ, mɛnɔ maa pee nyɛ yayami?
Nɛ ke nyɛ naa amanehlu tete po ngɛ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ peeɔ he ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ pɛ!
Nyɛ ko ye nihi nɛ maa pee nyɛ yayami ɔ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he hulɔ.
Se nyɛ ja Kristo ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ bu nɛ sa lɛ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ he ngɔ to, konɛ ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ ke nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ nine maa su nɔ hwɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ heto.
Se nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ bu, nɛ nyɛ ko nyɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ hi si saminya, nɛ nyɛ he nile ko bu nyɛ fɔ.
Ke nyɛ pee jã a, nyɛ je mi bami kpakpa kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ ma ha zo maa gbe nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu yaya kɛ siɔ nyɛ ɔ. Ejakaa e hi kaa nɔ ko maa pee kpakpa nɛ e na amanehlu, ke lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ ɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee yayami.
Ejakaa Kristo gbo kekleekle nɔ́ kɛ nyagbe nɔ́ ngɛ ní yayamihi a he.
Lɛ dalɔ ɔ, e gbo ngɛ yayami peeli a nane mi, konɛ e ngɔ wɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ.
Benɛ a gbe Kristo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, e hɛɛ nɔmlɔ adesa su.
Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu ha nɛ e ba wami mi ɔ, mumi ji lɛ.
Nɛ kaa mumi ɔ, e ya mumihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya fiɛ ha mɛ.
Nihi nɛ bui Mawu tue be mi nɛ Noa ngɛ e lɛ ɔ kpɛe ɔ a mumihi ji lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Mawu to e tsui si wawɛɛ ha mɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a tsake a tsui.
Nihi bɔɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu ha we nɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ nɛ gbe mɛ.
A hiɛmi ji kpaanyɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ sɔlemi okadi ɔ nɛ.
Ke a sɔle wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa a fɔ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, nɛ wa he tsɔ.
Mohu ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa waa kɛ Mawu so kaa wa maa hi si saminya nɛ wa he nile ko bu wɔ fɔ, nɛ kɛ gu si nɛ Yesu Kristo te ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ma he wa yi wami.
Yesu Kristo ho hiɔwe ya; e ya hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ bɔfohi, kɛ mumi mi níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ he wami a nɔ yee.
Wami he Akɛnɛ Kristo na nɔ́ ngɛ he lo mi he je ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ jamɛ a juɛmi ɔ nɔuu.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ naa nɔ́ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e kɛ yayami be sane ko hu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa si nyɛ maa gbe nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi si himi nya a, nyɛɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ, se pi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsui suɔ.
Sa a, nyɛ puɛ be babauu kɛ pee níhi nɛ ma je li suɔ peemi, yahomi, akɔnɔ níhi a se dimi, dã demi, fiɛmi sakasaka, jiklɔɔ peemi, kɛ wɔ jami ní kpɔtɔkpɔtɔ peemi.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e peeɔ mɛ nyakpɛ kaa nyɛ piɛ we a he kɛ pee we jamɛ a yakayaka ní ɔmɛ hu; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tuɔ nyɛ he munyu yaya.
Se a maa bu akɔtaa ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ dla e he ngɔ to nɛ e maa kojo hɛ kali, kɛ ni gbogboehi tsuo ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ni gbogboehi tete po ɔ nɛ.
A kojo mɛ ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi kaa nimli adesahi mohu lɛɛ, se a ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ Mawu nɛ hi si ngɛ mumi mi.
Mawu nike níhi a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi Níhi tsuo a nyagbe ɔ su ta.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ́ nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle.
Nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa ji kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he saminya; ejakaa suɔmi haa yayami babauu nɔ.
Nyɛ he nyɛ sibi atuu ngɛ nyɛ wehi a mi, nɛ nyɛ ko de ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi wa tsɔ.
Nike ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ sibi kaa Mawu dloomi nike ní slɔɔto ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, e fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ; ke nɔ ko ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, e ngɔ he wami nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ kɛ sɔmɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, e ha nɛ nihi nɛ a je Mawu yi kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ.
Mawu nɔ́ ji hɛ mi nyami, kɛ he wami kɛ yaa neneene.
Amen.
Nɔ́ nami kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, bɔ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kae, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, e ko pee nyɛ nyakpɛ.
Nyɛ ko susu kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ bɛ hyɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ.
Se mohu, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ kaa amanehlu nɛ Kristo na a, nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ nae.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke e ba ekohu kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi babauu.
Ke nihi jɛ nyɛ kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ji nyɛ ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ pɛ.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mumi nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, nɛ ji mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó na amanehlu kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ, aloo julɔ, aloo yayami peelɔ, aloo nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ e he woɔ ni kpahi a sanehi a mi.
Se ke nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ, zo ko pee nyɛ.
Se mohu nyɛɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami kaa a tsɛɛ nyɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli.
Be ɔ nɛ a maa je kojomi sisi ɔ su ta, nɛ Mawu maa kojo lɛ nitsɛ e ni ɔmɛ kekle.
Ke a kɛ wɔ je sisi ɔ, nihi nɛ he we sane kpakpa a nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ yi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛ a nyagbe maa pee gbeye!
Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Ke dengme loko a ma he nimli kpakpahi a yi wami ɔ, lɛɛ yayami peeli nɛ li Mawu ɔ, mɛɛ kɛ a nyagbe maa hi kɛɛ?” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ naa amanehlu, akɛnɛ lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to ha mɛ ɔ, a ya nɔ nɛ a pee kpakpa, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ a bɔlɔ ɔ nɔ kulaa.
Lɛɛ ke e wo si ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ.
Mawu asafo ɔ I ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ asafo mi nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ tsɔɔe kɛ je ye tsui mi tɔɔ kaa nyɛ nyɛmi asafo mi nɔkɔtɔma.
Amanehlu nɛ Kristo na a, i yeɔ he odase, nɛ Kristo hɛ mi nyami nɛ Mawu ma je tsɔɔ nihi ɔ, imi hu ma na.
I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa Mawu asafo ɔ nɛ e ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ saminya kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ lɛɔ e to kuu ɔ. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi, se pi kaa a nyɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ pee.
Nyɛ tsu ní, pi ngɛ hiɔwo nɛ nyɛ ma na a he, se mohu kaa nyɛ ná nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ he bua jɔmi.
Bɔ nɛ Mawu to kaa nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha nyɛ ke nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko ye a nɔ; se mohu nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha Mawu asafo ɔ. Nɛ ke to hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ba a, nyɛ nine maa su hɛ mi nyami jlasi nɛ maa hi kpɛe nylamnylam daa a nɔ.
Ja nɔuu, nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ hu, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nikɔtɔma amɛ.
Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ sibi kɛ he si bami.
Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke, “Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mɛ toɔ ní; se nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, Mawu dlooɔ mɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ he wa, nɛ e buu nyɛ he ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke e su be nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e to ɔ, e ma wo nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ haomi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ e nɔ; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e hyɛɛ nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si; nyɛɛ pee klaalo!
Nyɛ he nyɛlɔ, Abosiami ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae, nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko hlae nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ e mi.
Nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛɛ tsi lɛ blɔ.
Ejakaa nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, mɛ hu kikɛmɛ a amanehlu nɛ ɔ nɔuu a ngɛ nae.
Se ke nyɛ na amanehlu be bɔɔ se ɔ, Mawu nɛ dlooɔ wɔ níhi tsuo ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he hia ha nyɛ.
E maa waje nyɛ; e maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma fi si kaa nyɛ le lɛ daa.
Lɛ nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ba hi e hɛ mi nyami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ mi; ejakaa nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo ba pee kake.
Mawu maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Amen.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi I ngɛ nyɛ womi kpiti nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ gu Silvano nɔ.
I buu wa nyɛmi nɛ ɔ saminya kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale.
I ngɛ nyɛ he wami woe, nɛ i ngɛ nɔ mi mae ngɛ dee ke Mawu dloomi nitsɛnitsɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ.
Asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Babilon, nɛ lɛ hu Mawu hla mɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Ye bi Marko hu ke e biɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛɛ fua nyɛ sibi kɛ nga nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ nɛ le Kristo.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, nyɛ he manye!
NYA TSƆƆMI Petro ngma e womi enyɔne ɔ ya ha nihi babauu nɛ ba pee Kristo se nyɛɛli kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ he nɛ e ngma womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ ji, lakpa tsɔɔli komɛ ba te si, nɛ a kɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ bɔni Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a tue puɛmi.
Enɛ ɔ kɛ yakayaka fiɛmi ba, nɛ e hia kaa a tsi nya.
E hia kaa nihi nɛ ba le Yesu ɔ, a hɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he ɔ mi wawɛɛ.
Nihi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a na Yesu, nɛ a nu nɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, mɛ lɛ a fiɛ kikɛmɛ a anɔkuale ɔ kɛ kpa si.
Nɔ́ nɛ pa hao Petro pe kulaa ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ke Kristo be kpalee kɛ ba ekohu ɔ. Petro tsɔɔ nya kaa, akɛnɛ Mawu hla we kaa nɔ ko hɛ mi nɛ kpata, se mohu kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsake e tsui he je nɛ e peeɔ mɛ kaa Yesu bami be ɔ kpɛ se ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Mawu tsɛ wɔ, nɛ e hla wɔ .- Lakpa tsɔɔli .- A wo Kristo nyagbe bami ɔ he si .-
Imi Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ, kɛ e bɔfo ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ yaa ha nihi nɛ a nine su hemi kɛ yemi nɛ he jua wa saminya kaa wɔ hu wa nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.
Wa Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛ ha mɛ kikɛmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.
Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ babauu ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ le Mawu, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo saminya.
Mawu tsɛ wɔ, nɛ e hla wɔ Mawu ha wɔ níhi tsuo nɛ maa hia wɔ ɔ, konɛ waa ba wa jemi kaa Mawu jali nitsɛnitsɛmɛ.
E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa wa le lɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ tsɛ wɔ kɛ gu lɛ nitsɛ e nyami, kɛ e mi mi himi ɔ mi ɔ. E ha wɔ nike ní nguanguahi nɛ a he jua wa, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. Kɛ gu nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa tu je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ a nya fo, konɛ nyɛ na lɛ Mawu ɔ e su ɔ eko.
Enɛ ɔ tutuutu he je ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde wawɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kpakpa peemi ngɔ piɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he; nyɛɛ ngɔ nile ngɔ piɛ kpakpa peemi ɔ he.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ he nɔ yemi ngɔ piɛ nile ɔ he; nyɛɛ ngɔ hɛ si kami ngɔ piɛ he nɔ yemi ɔ he; nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu gbeye yemi ngɔ piɛ hɛ si kami ɔ he; nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛmi peemi ngɔ piɛ Mawu gbeye yemi ɔ he, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ suɔmi ngɔ piɛ nyɛmi peemi ɔ he.
Kikɛmɛ a su nɛ ɔmɛ a he hia nyɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ na mɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, nyɛ ma tsu ní nɛ maa wo yiblii saminya, nɛ nyɛ he maa ba se nami, akɛnɛ nyɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ kɛ yɛ tsitsaa; e hɛ je nɔ kaa a tsukɔ e he kɛ je e sá yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde, konɛ nyɛɛ ma nɔ mi kaa niinɛ, nihi nɛ Mawu tsɛ, nɛ e hla ji nyɛ.
Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ be si gbee ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ nyɛ na a mi gblegbleegble.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ blɔ nɛ nyɛ maa sɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ le kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ momo, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ hu nyɛ pɛtɛ he lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ i to kaa ma ya nɔ ma hi nyɛ kaie ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, i susu kaa e sa kaa ma ya nɔ ma hɛli nyɛ si ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
I le kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ mi ɔ.
Se ma bɔ mɔde ma to blɔ nya ha nyɛ, konɛ ye gbenɔ se ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ be tsuaa be.
Nihi nɛ na Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ Nɛ wa fiɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ke wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, pi sanehi nɛ a po de nɔ nɛ wa da.
Se wa na e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa hɛngmɛ.
Wa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ benɛ Tsɛ Mawu wo e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, gbi pɛ kɛ je hɛ mi nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji ye Bi nɛ i suɔ, nɛ i naa e he tsui!” Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe, benɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa na kaa munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu ɔ ba mi niinɛ.
Nyɛ hu ke nyɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛ bu tue ɔ, e maa hi ha nyɛ; ejakaa e ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ diblii mi kɛ yaa si je maa na, nɛ nɔkɔ la a ma kpɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi.
Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e juɛmi kɛ tsɔɔ gbami ko sisi ngɛ ngmami ɔ mi.
Ejakaa gbami sɛ gbi ko bɛ hyɛ nɛ adesa po de kɛkɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya.
Se mohu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ baa nihi a nɔ nɛ a tuɔ munyu kɛ jeɔ Mawu ngɔ.
Lakpa tsɔɔli Lakpa gbali te si ngɛ ma a mi be ko nɛ be ɔ, nɛ ja nɔuu lakpa tsɔɔli maa te si ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti.
A kɛ lakpa tsɔɔmihi nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi maa ba ngɛ laami mi.
Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ kpɔ mɛ ɔ po a ma kua lɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ a ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi si kake too.
Nihi babauu maa nyɛɛ a se kɛ yakayaka je mi bami, nɛ a he ɔ, nihi maa tu munyu kɛ si Kristo, kɛ e blɔ ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ maa tu nyɛ munyuhi nɛ a po de, konɛ a kɛ sisi nyɛ nɛ a ná nyɛ he se.
Se Mawu bu mɛ fɔ momo be saii ji nɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ hu su ta.
Bɔfohi nɛ pee yayami ɔ, Mawu ngɔɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e tsitsɛɛ mɛ ngɔ wo gbeje muɔ mi.
A fi mɛ ngɔ wo diblii mi, nɛ a maa hi mlɛe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si kojomi ligbi ɔ. Mawu ngɔɛ blema bi ɔmɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e ngɔ nyu kpekpemi kɛ kpata yayami peeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Noa nɛ fiɛ ke a ye dami sane ɔ, e kɛ ni kpaago kpa komɛ pɛ lɛ Mawu he a yi wami.
Mawu gbla Sodom kɛ Gomora ma amɛ a tue.
E ngɔ la kɛ kpata ma nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ to okadi kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba yayami peeli a nɔ.
E he Lot hu yi wami.
Lot nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ bui mlaa a yakayaka je mi bami haoɔ lɛ wawɛɛ.
Benɛ nɔmlɔ kpakpa nɛ ɔ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, e naa, nɛ e nuɔ ní yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ a he; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao e tsui.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le bɔ nɛ e peeɔ nɛ e jeɔ nimli kpakpahi kɛ jeɔ ka mi.
E le bɔ nɛ e peeɔ kɛ hii nimli yayamihi a tue gblae hluu kɛ yaa su kojomi ligbi ɔ tɔɔ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nihi pɔtɛɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ he lo mi akɔnɔ yaya se, se Mawu mlaa a lɛɛ a bui.
Kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsui wa; a woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ nibɔ ní kpakpahi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe po a bui; se mohu a jɛɔ mɛ.
Bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a he wa, nɛ a hiɛ kulaa pe lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ tete po pui a nya, nɛ a jɛ we mɛ hulɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Se kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa pu mi lohwehi; a be juɛmi.
A bɔ mɛ nɛ a nuu mɛ nɛ a gbe kɛkɛ; nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui sisi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu yaya.
A ma kpata a hɛ mi kaa pu mi lohwehi, nɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ, a maa na nɔ́ kɛ to nya.
Piani ke a ngɛ yakayaka fiɛmihi fiɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ a bua jɔ; zotsɛmɛ kɛ ahluatsɛmɛ ji mɛ.
Benɛ a futu nyɛ kɛ ngɛ ní yee ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo a ngɛ a yakayaka nyɛɛmi ɔmɛ nyɛɛe.
A hɛngmɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ kpa ko kaa ja yihi yaholi pɛ.
Pɔ tɔɛ mɛ kɛ yayami peemi.
A sisiɔ nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ, nɛ a naa a he blɔ.
A kase jiklɔɔ peemi, nɛ a le saminya.
Mawu gbiɛ mɛ pɛ!
A je blɔ tlɔmɔɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a laa blɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Beor bi Balaam pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Balaam ya di se nami se, nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ; se a ka e hɛ mi ngɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he.
Gbalɔ ɔ teji ɔ pã e nya mi, nɛ e tu munyu kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ e tsi godo ní tsumi nɛ gbalɔ ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma tsu ɔ nya.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa nyu vuhi nɛ nyu be a mi; a ngɛ kaa bɔkuhi nɛ ahumi ngɔ kɛ yaa.
Mawu dla he ko ngɔ to mɛ ngɛ diblii nɛ mi ti mi.
Akɛnɛ nya puu munyu nguahi jeɔ a nya he je ɔ, a guu he lo akɔnɔ níhi a nɔ nɛ a kɛ ya sisiɔ nihi nɛ je si himi yaya nɛ dɛ blɔ mi kɛ́ we.
A woɔ mɛ si ke a maa ye a he, be mi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a pee a he nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha níhi nɛ puɛɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ yeɔ nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, nɔ ɔ peeɔ nyɔguɛ ha jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ. Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nihi na le wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tu je nɛ ɔ mi mu níhi a nya fo.
Pee se, ke a ngɔ a he ya wo yayami mi ekohu, nɛ yayami ɔ ye a nɔ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nyagbe si himi ba peeɔ mɔbɔ kulaa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ po.
Afani nɔ́ nɛ a na we nɛ a le Kristo, pe nɛ a le lɛ, nɛ pee se ɔ, a je mlaa klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ a ha mɛ ɔ he.
Nɔ́ nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi niinɛ: “Gbe kpaleɔ kɛ yaa lɛ nitsɛ e vie he,” kɛ “Kpotoo nɛ a du ha lɛ ɔ kpaleɔ ya wuɔ mɔsɔ ekohu.”
A wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami ɔ he si Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, enɛ ɔ ji womi enyɔne nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae.
I bɔ mɔde ngɛ womi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kaa ma tsɛ nyɛ juɛmi se kɛ ba níhi nɛ nyɛ le momo ɔ a he.
Nyɛ kai munyuhi nɛ gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tu blema lokoo ɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa kpɔlɔ ɔ mlaa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha nyɛ ɔ. Kekleekle ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nɔ he fɛu yeli komɛ maa ba, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a we akɔnɔ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ a maa pee.
Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ma de ke, “E wo si kaa e maa kpale kɛ ba ekohu, pi jã lo?
Jije e ngɛ?
Ejakaa kɛ je be nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbo nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ kɛ je be mi nɛ a bɔ je ɔ, jã nɔuu nɛ a ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” A jeɔ blɔ peeɔ kaa a li kaa blema lokoo ɔ, munyu kɛkɛ lɛ Mawu tu, nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba ba, kaa a je zugba kɛ je nyu mi, nɛ nyu a kɛ bɔ zugba a. Nɛ nyu nɔuu, nyu kpekpemi ɔ a kɛ kpata jamɛ a be ɔ mi je ɔ hɛ mi.
Se hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ je Mawu nya a nɔuu lɛ hɛɛ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ la nɛ ba kpata a hɛ mi hwɔɔ se.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ li Mawu, nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Se ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Nɔ́ kake nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ ji kaa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, ligbi kake ngɛ kaa jeha akpe, nɛ jeha akpe hu ngɛ kaa ligbi kake.
Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo si ke e maa pee ɔ, pi tsle nɛ e ngɛ toe ngɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ ngɛ susue ɔ; e tsui si kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ toe ha nyɛ.
Ejakaa e sume nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ mi nɛ kpata, se mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsake e tsui.
Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ maa ba kaa bɔ nɛ julɔ baa a. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, hiɔwe maa be kɛ ho kɛ kemi nɛ nya wa.
Níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo maa sã, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ je ɔ, kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa laa.
Akɛnɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kɛɛ?
E sa kaa nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu, konɛ nyɛɛ hi Mawu ligbi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ nyɛɛ hi sɔlee nɛ e su mla.
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, hiɔwe ma mle kɛ la, nɛ e maa sã, nɛ la a ma ha níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo maa sile.
Se wa ngɛ hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he blɔ hyɛe kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a yeɔ dami sane ngɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ Mawu ko na mu, loo piami nɔ́ ko ngɛ nyɛ he; nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsui si tomi ɔ kaa he blɔ nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ nɛ a kɛ he nyɛ yi wami.
Enɛ ɔ nɔuu wa suɔlɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Paulo hu ngma nyɛ kɛ nile nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.
E tuɔ enɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu ngɛ womihi tsuo nɛ e ngma a a mi.
Ní komɛ nɛ e de ɔ, a sisi numi yee, nɛ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, kɛ ni komɛ hu nɛ a yi mi peeɔ mɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ɔ, tsɔɔ sisi ngɛ blɔ kpa nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngmami kpa amɛ ɔ. Blɔ nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ kpataa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Se ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ le enɛ ɔ momo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi saminya, nɛ nihi nɛ bui mlaa a, a ní peemi ní yayami ɔmɛ kó gbla nyɛ se, nɛ nyɛ si nɛ nyɛ da a ko bɔ nyɛ.
Se nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ wa ngɛ dloomi ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo ɔ saminya.
Á wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene!
Amen.
NYA TSƆƆMI Kekleekle womi nɛ Yohane ngma a kɔɔ nɔ́ enyɔ pɔtɛɛ komɛ a he.
E ngma, konɛ e kɛ wo nihi he wami, nɛ a kɛ Mawu, kɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ.
Jehanɛ se hu, Yohane kɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nihi kɔkɔ bɔe, nɛ́ a ko ya nyɛɛ lakpa tsɔɔmi se, nɛ huɛ bɔmi nɛ ɔ ko ba puɛ.
Nɔ́ nɛ kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ ba ji: ni komɛ he ye kaa ke a fɔ nɔ ko kɛ ba je nɛ ɔ mi pɛ kɛkɛ e ba nɔ yayami mi.
A tsɔɔ nya kaa ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ Yesu nɛ ji Mawu Bi ɔ, e be nyɛe nɛ e pee adesa mɔ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ kaa ke a he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ, e sɛ kaa je nɛ ɔ mi sane ko peeɔ lɛ kɔmɔ ko kulaa.
A tsɔɔ hulɔ kaa, ní komɛ kaa je mi bami kpakpa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, aloo kaa o suɔ o nyɛmi ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɔ we yi wami hemi he.
Yohane ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ si lakpa tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ. E ke Yesu Kristo ɔ, adesa ji lɛ.
E tsɔɔ nya kaa nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ, nɛ a suɔ Mawu hulɔ ɔ, e sa kaa a suɔ a sibi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- La kɛ diblii .—.
Mawu bimɛ, kɛ Abosiami bimɛ .- Anɔkuale mumi, kɛ lakpa mumi .- Suɔmi ní tsumi .- Wa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi .-
Munyu nɛ haa nɔ wami Wa ngɛ nyɛ munyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ ngmae.
Munyu ɔ ngɛ kɛ je sisije.
Wa nu, nɛ wa na kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa hɛngmɛ; ee, wa na lɛ, nɛ wa nine ta he.
Benɛ wami ɔ jé e he kpo ɔ, wa na lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa ngɛ odase yee, nɛ wa ngɛ jajee ke lɛ ji neneene wami ɔ nɛ.
E kɛ Tsɛ ɔ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ wa na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae.
Wa ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee, konɛ nyɛ ba piɛ wa he, nɛ waa kɛ Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ.
Wa ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ kɛ pi si.
Mawu ji la Jehanɛ, sɛ gbi nɛ wa nu kɛ je e Bi ɔ nya, nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ ji kaa Mawu su ngɛ kaa la, nɛ diblii ko kulaa be e mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa de ke waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ huɛ bɔe, se kɛ̃ wa ngɛ diblii ɔ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ lakpa yee; munyu nɛ jeɔ wa nya, kɛ wa ní peemi tsuo anɔkuale be mi.
Se ke wa ba wa je mi saminya ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ e su ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ wa sibi ngɛ huɛ bɔe.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e Bi Yesu Kristo muɔ ɔ maa tsukɔ wa he, nɛ e ma je wa he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ke wa de ke yayami ko be wa he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wa ngɛ sisie; nɛ Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.
Se ke wa jaje wa he yayami ɔmɛ ha Mawu ɔ, e maa ye e siwo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa pee bɔ nɛ sa.
E kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa wɔ; e maa tsu wa he, nɛ e ma je ní yayahi nɛ wa pee ɔ tsuo.
Ke wa ke wa pee we yayami ɔ, lɛɛ wa ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa Mawu mohu ji lakpatsɛ; nɛ Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.
Wa he piɛlɔ Kristo Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami.
Se ke nɔ ko pee yayami pohu ɔ, wa ngɛ nɔ nɛ daa mi kɛ haa wɔ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Lɛ ji Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a. Nɛ Kristo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ a kɛ pee kpatami kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ; pi wɔ kɛkɛ, se je ɔ tsuo he yayami.
Ke wa yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ waa kɛ naa anɔkuale mi kaa wa le lɛ.
Ke nɔ ko ke e le Mawu, se e yi e mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ; e tu we anɔkuale.
Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu anɔkuale mi.
Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ maa le kaa niinɛ, waa kɛ Mawu ngɛ huɛ bɔe.
Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke e ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ, e ba e je mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo ba e je mi ɔ. Mlaa he ɔ Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, mlaa nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, pi mlaa he; mlaa momo ɔ nɛ nyɛ ná kɛ je sisije ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu.
Sɛ gbi nɛ nyɛ nu momo ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji mlaa momo ɔ nɛ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, mlaa nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, mlaa he, ejakaa a naa e we anɔkuale ɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e tsu ní ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ. Diblii ɔ ngɛ bee kɛ yaa, nɛ la nitsɛ ɔ bɔni kpɛmi momo.
Ke nɔ ko de ke e ngɛ Kristo mi, se e sume e nyɛmi ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi, kɛ mwɔɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ Kristo mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he nɛ ma ha nɔ ko nane ma kpata.
Se nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi nyɛɛe nɛ́ e li he nɛ e yaa.
Ejakaa diblii ɔ yu e hɛ.
Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa Kristo he ɔ, a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ.
Tsaatsɛmɛ!
I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nihewi!
I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.
Bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le Tsɛ ɔ. Tsaatsɛmɛ!
I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nihewi!
I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ he wa; Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.
Nyɛ ko suɔ je ɔ, loo níhi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ. Ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, lɛɛ e sume Tsɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, je ɔ mi e je.
Níhi nɛ he lo ɔ dii se, níhi nɛ hɛngmɛ dii se, kɛ níhi nɛ nihi fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ tsuo je je nɛ ɔ mi; ekoeko ji Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
Je ɔ, kɛ e mi níhi nɛ peeɔ nɔ akɔnɔ ɔ ngɛ bee kɛ yaa.
Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyagbe be ɔ su ta!
A de nyɛ ke Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ ma; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Kristo he nyɛli fuu ba momo.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa le kaa nyagbe ɔ su ta.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi wa kpɛti nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je; nɛ lɔ ɔ he je nɛ a si wɔ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa wa kpɛti nɛ a je jinɛ a kɛ wɔ ko hi si.
Se a si wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e fɔ si paa kaa a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ wɔ bɔɛ.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, Kristo ha nyɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ. Pi kaa anɔkuale ɔ nɛ nyɛ li nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae.
Dɛbi!
Akɛnɛ nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ, lɔ ɔ he mohu nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi ɔ ngmae ɔ nɛ; nɛ nyɛ le hu kaa anɔkuale ɔ, lakpa be mi.
Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji lakpatsɛ?
Ee, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ deɔ ke pi Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, lɛ ji lakpatsɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ; e kua Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Bi ɔ tsuo.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua Bi ɔ, e kua Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Se nɔ nɛ ma he Bi ɔ, e he Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je sisije ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ.
Ke nyɛ pɛtɛ jamɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ he wawɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ maa hi Bi ɔ, kɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi daa.
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Kristo nitsɛ wo wɔ he si ɔ ji neneene wami.
I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ngɛ nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a puɛ nyɛ tue ɔ a he.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ Kristo ha e mumi ɔ ba nyɛ nɔ.
Be abɔ nɛ e mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ, e hia we nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ba tsɔɔ nyɛ ní.
Ejakaa mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ tsɔɔe; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ, pi lakpa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue, konɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi Kristo mi.
Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi Kristo mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke e je e he kpo ɔ, wa nɔ gbagba nɛ te.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba a, zo be wɔ gbee ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Tse nyɛ le kaa Kristo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ da e peeɔ.
Lɛɛ e hia kaa nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu bi ji lɛ.
Mawu bimɛ Nyɛɛ hyɛ suɔmi sɔuu nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ, kaa e ma tsɛ wɔ e bimɛ; niinɛ Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, je ɔ li wɔ, ejakaa lɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ hu je ɔ li lɛ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ, se bɔ nɛ wa ma plɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ wa li lolo.
Nɔ́ nɛ wa le kɛkɛ ji kaa ke Kristo je e he kpo ɔ, wa maa hi kaa lɛ; ejakaa wa maa na lɛ paa kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tutuutu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, peeɔ e he klɔuklɔu kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ kaa e ngɛ Mawu mlaa nɔ tɔe, ejakaa yayami ji mlaa nɔ tɔmi.
Nyɛ le kaa Kristo ba, konɛ e ba wó wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ho.
Nyɛ le hulɔ kaa Kristo ɔ, yayami ko be e he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, e pee we yayami hu.
Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e nɛ Kristo, nɛ e li lɛ hulɔ.
Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ sisi nyɛ!
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, dalɔ ji lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu dalɔ ji lɛ ɔ. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami lɛɛ Abosiami bi ji lɛ, ejakaa kɛ je sisije tɔɔ nɛ Abosiami bɔni yayami peemi.
Enɛ ɔ he tutuutu nɛ Mawu Bi ɔ ba a nɛ, konɛ níhi nɛ Abosiami tsu ɔ, e ba kpata lɛ tsuo hɛ mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e yɛ nɔ nɛ e hii yayami pee, ejakaa e hɛɛ Mawu su nitsɛnitsɛ.
Nɛ akɛnɛ Mawu bi ji lɛ he je ɔ, e be nyɛe maa pee yayami.
Slɔɔto titli nɛ ngɛ Mawu bimɛ, kɛ Abosiami bimɛ a kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da, aloo nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi ɔ, pi Mawu bi ji lɛ.
Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi Sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ ji kaa waa suɔ wa sibi.
Wa ko pee kaa bɔ nɛ Kain pee ɔ; ejakaa Abosiami mumi ngɛ e mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi Habel.
Mɛni he je Kain gbe e nyɛmi ɔ?
Ejakaa níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ, ní ɔmɛ dɛ, se e nyɛmi ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ da.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi ko pee nyɛ yaa.
Wa le kaa wa be kaa ni gbogboehi hu, se wa je gbenɔ mi kɛ ba wami mi, ejakaa wa suɔ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ gbenɔ mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko be neneene wami nae.
Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he.
Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa na bɔ nɛ suɔmi tsuɔ ní ha.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa wɔ hu waa ngɔ wa wami ngɔ ha ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ a he.
Ke nɔ ko ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ní, nɛ e na e nyɛmi nɛ e fi lɛ, se e mi mi sãã we lɛ ngɛ e nyɛmi ɔ he nɛ e ye bua lɛ ɔ, anɛ e ma nyɛ de ke e suɔ Mawu lo?
Ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Ke wa ke wa suɔ nɔ ko ɔ, wa ko de kɛ nya kɛkɛ; wa suɔmi ɔ nɛ pee anɔkuale suɔmi nɛ jee kpo ngɛ ní peemi mi.
Kã peemi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ maa le kaa wa ngɛ Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ blɔ fa mi, nɛ wa he nile be wɔ fɔ bue ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Se ke wa he nile buɔ wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu kle pe wa he nile ɔ, nɛ e le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hulɔ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa he nile bui wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa yi gbeye kaa wa maa ya Mawu hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa bi lɛ ɔ, e haa wɔ, ejakaa wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ wa peeɔ níhi nɛ sa e hɛ mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ e fa wɔ ke waa pee ji kaa wa he e Bi Yesu Kristo waa ye, nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo fa wɔ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, e hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii e mi.
Nɛ mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ he je ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu ngɛ wa mi.
Anɔkuale mumi kɛ lakpa mumi Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ ko he nɔ tsuaa nɔ ko kɛkɛ nɛ deɔ ke e ná Mawu mumi ɔ nyɛɛ ye.
Se mohu nyɛɛ ka nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa mumi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ je Mawu ngɔ lo.
Ejakaa je ɔ hyi tɔ kɛ lakpa gbali sɔuu.
Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma yo Mawu mumi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa jaje kaa Yesu Kristo ba je ɔ mi kaa adesa a, mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ ngɛ e mi.
Se nɔ nɛ jajeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a de ngɛ Yesu he nɛ ɔ be mi ɔ, e mumi ɔ ji Mawu ngɔ.
Mumi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ je Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔ.
Nyɛ nu kaa e ma, pi jã?
Ee, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ná ba je ɔ mi momo.
Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu níhi ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye lakpa gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
Ejakaa mumi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, e he wa kulaa pe mumi nɛ ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe ɔ a mi.
Jamɛ a lakpa gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ kɔɔ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a he nɛ a tuɔ.
Nɛ je ɔ buɔ mɛ tue, ejakaa je ɔ mi nɛ a je.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu níhi ji wɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le Mawu ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue; nihi nɛ kɛ Mawu be ɔ, mɛɛ a bui wɔ tue.
Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ naa slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mumi ɔ, kɛ lakpa mumi ɔ a kpɛti.
Mawu ɔ suɔmi ji lɛ Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Nyɛ ha waa suɔ wa sibi, ejakaa suɔmi ɔ, Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ, nɛ e le Mawu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sume nɔmlɔ ɔ, e li Mawu; ejakaa Mawu ɔ, suɔmi ji lɛ.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu gu kɛ je e suɔmi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: e tsɔ e Bi kake too ɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa na wami.
Bɔ nɛ suɔmi ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: pi wɔ nɛ wa sɛ hlami kɛ suɔ Mawu; Mawu mohu lɛ suɔ wɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba, konɛ e ba dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti, nɛ a ngɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ.
Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ Mawu suɔ wɔ ɔ, wɔ hu e sa kaa waa suɔ wa sibi.
Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ lɛ hyɛ.
Se ke wa suɔ wa sibi ɔ, Mawu hii wa mi, nɛ suɔmi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi waa.
Mawu ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e mumi ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ.
Nɛ enɛ ɔ waa kɛ na kaa niinɛ, Mawu ngɛ wa mi; nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ e mi.
Wa na enɛ ɔ, nɛ wa ngɛ odase yee kaa Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba kaa je ɔ yi wami helɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jajeɔ paa kaa Yesu ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ ɔ, Mawu hii e mi, nɛ lɛ hu e hii Mawu mi.
Suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa le, nɛ wa ji he nɔ́.
Mawu ɔ, suɔmi ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔmlɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo ɔ, e hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii e mi.
Suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi wa wawɛɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ, wa ko ye gbeye.
Ejakaa wa je mi bami ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo nitsɛ ba e je mi.
He nɛ suɔmi ngɛ ɔ, gbeye yemi be lejɛ ɔ; suɔmi nɛ mi wa a fieɔ gbeye tsuo kɛ yaa se.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ gbeye ɔ, Mawu suɔmi nɛ mi wa a be e mi.
Ejakaa gbeye yemi, kɛ tue gblami lɛ nyɛɛɔ.
Wa suɔ Mawu, ejakaa lɛ nɛ suɔ wɔ kekle.
Ke nɔ ko ke e suɔ Mawu, se e nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi nɛ e naa kɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e maa suɔ Mawu nɛ e nɛ ɔ. Mlaa nɛ Kristo wo wɔ ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, e sa kaa e suɔ e nyɛmi hulɔ.
Wa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ ko tsɛ ɔ, e suɔ nɔ ɔ bi hulɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ waa kɛ maa na kaa wa suɔ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ ji wa maa bu Mawu tue, nɛ wa maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Ejakaa ke wa suɔ Mawu ɔ, wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Nɛ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi wɛ kulaa, ejakaa Mawu bimɛ tsuo ma nyɛ maa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi; ee, wa hemi kɛ yemi waa kɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ kunimi.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi?
Ja nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ.
Yesu Kristo he odase Benɛ Yesu Kristo ba a, a sɔle lɛ kɛ nyu, nɛ e plɛ e muɔ ngɔ pue si, nɛ e gbo.
Pi nyu ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ ba, se nyu kɛ muɔ tsuo.
Nɛ mumi ɔ nitsɛ yeɔ odase kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ mi, ejakaa mumi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ.
Odase yeli etɛ lɛ ngɛ; mumi ɔ, kɛ nyu ɔ, kɛ muɔ ɔ; nɛ nɔ́ etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ odase kake too ɔ. Wa heɔ adesa we odase yeɔ, se Mawu we odase ɔ mi jiɔ kulaa pe adesa nɔ́.
Nɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ lɛ ye odase nɛ ɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ he.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ ngɔɔ odase nɛ ɔ kɛ toɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui mi, nɛ e hii he susue.
Se nɔ nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ ha nɛ Mawu plɛ lakpatsɛ; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ e Bi ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ɔ he we yi.
Odase ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Mawu ha wɔ neneene wami kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Bi ɔ, e ngɛ wami; nɔ nɛ be Mawu Bi ɔ, e be wami hulɔ.
Neneene wami I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ ngɛ neneene wami.
Wa yi gbeye ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, ejakaa wa le kaa ke waa kɛ juɛmi kpakpa bi lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue.
Be tsuaa be nɛ wa bi lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue.
Nɛ akɛnɛ wa le kaa e ngɛ mi jã niinɛ he je ɔ, wa le hu kaa níhi nɛ wa biɔ lɛ ɔ, e haa wɔ.
Ke o na o nyɛmi nɛ ngɛ yayami pee, nɛ pi yayami nɔ́ nɛ ma ha nɛ e hɛ mi nɛ kpata a, moo fa kue ha Mawu, konɛ e ha lɛ wami.
Nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ yayami nɔ́ nɛ ha we nɛ nɔ hɛ mi kpataa a, enɛ ɔ kɔɔ a he.
Se yayami ngɛ nɛ haa nɔ hɛ mi kpataa, nɛ lɔ ɔ lɛɛ i de we ke nyɛɛ fa kue ha Mawu ngɛ he.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔ, e ji yayami; se yayami ngɛ nɛ ha we nɛ nɔ hɛ mi kpataa.
Wa le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e bua jɔɛ yayami peemi he.
Ejakaa Mawu Bi ɔ baa e yi, nɛ Abosiami na we e he blɔ.
Wa le kaa Mawu níhi ji wɔ, pohu je ɔ, Abosiami lɛ ngɛ nɔ yee.
Wa le kaa Mawu Bi ɔ ba, nɛ e ba bli wa juɛmi nya, konɛ waa le anɔkuale Mawu ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, waa kɛ anɔkuale Mawu ɔ ngɛ, ejakaa wa ngɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ mi.
Lɛ ji anɔkuale Mawu ɔ nɛ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ji neneene wami.
Ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɛ hi ngɛ amagahi a he!
NYA TSƆƆMI Yohane Womi Enyɔne ɔ, “Nɔkɔtɔma a” lɛ ngma ya ha “Awenyɛ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, kɛ awenyɛ ɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ.” Blɔɔ asafo ko, kɛ e mi bi a ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Kɛ gu sɛ gbi kpiti nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yohane ngɛ kue fae ha asafo mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ á suɔ a sibi.
E ngɛ mɛ ga woe hulɔ nɛ a hyɛ a he saminya ngɛ lakpa tsɔɔli, kɛ níhi nɛ a ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ a he.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije - Suɔmi he hiami - Kɔkɔ bɔmi ngɛ lakpa tsɔɔmi he - Nyagbe -
Imi nɔkɔtɔma a, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo awenyɛ nɛ a hla mo ɔ, kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ akɛnɛ nyɛ hɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ. Pi imi nɔ kake too nɛ i suɔ nyɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ suɔ nyɛ.
Ejakaa anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ wa mi, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ kɛ wɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Tsɛ ɔ Bi Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi mi.
Anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi I na bua jɔmi babauu, benɛ i nu kaa o bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ baa a je mi ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, awenyɛ nɛ i suɔ!
I kpa mo pɛɛ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, pi mlaa he, se mohu mlaa a nɛ a wo wɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ. Suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ tsɔɔ kaa waa ye Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ, mlaa a ji kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he.
Sisili fuu ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
Mɛ ji nihi nɛ kplɛɛ we kaa Yesu Kristo ba je ɔ mi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa.
Nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji sisili, kɛ Kristo he nyɛli ɔ nɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he saminya, konɛ ní nɛ wa tsu ɔ, nyɛ ko je mi dɛ gu; se mohu nyɛ ná hiɔwo nɛ sa.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je Kristo sane kpakpa a se ya tsɔɔ nɔ́ kpa a, e li Mawu.
Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ sane kpakpa a pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ le Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Bi ɔ tsuo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ba tsɔɔ we ní kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo tsɔɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko he lɛ atuu, nɛ nyɛ ba de lɛ ke, “He manye!” tete po.
Ke nɔ ko ha lɛ hɛ mi ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa e kɛ lɛ peeɔ kake kɛ tsuɔ ní yayamihi.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ ma ngma nyɛ mohu, se i sume kaa i kɛ ningma nyu ngmaa ngɔ fɔ womi hɛ mi.
Mohu ɔ, i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa ma ba slaa nyɛ.
Ke i ba a, i kɛ nyɛ maa sɛɛ ní hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, nɛ wa ma na bua jɔmi babauu.
Nyɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ nyɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ ke a biɔ nyɛ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Yohane Womi Etɛne ɔ, “Nɔkɔtɔma a” lɛ ngma ya ha asafo nya dalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Gayo.
Womi ngmalɔ ɔ jé Gayo yi kaa e ngɛ dengme gboe ngɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli kpa komɛ a he.
E bɔ lɛ kɔkɔ hu ngɛ nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Diotrefe ɔ he.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije - A je Gayo yi - A bu Diotrefe fɔ - A je Demetrio yi - Nyagbe -
Imi nɔkɔtɔma a, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Gayo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya kɛ ye tsui tsuo ɔ. Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ, i ngɛ kue fae ha Mawu, nɛ o ya nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
O hi gblagblaagbla ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi kaa bɔ nɛ i le nɛ o ngɛ mumi mi he wami ɔ. I na bua jɔmi babauu benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ba bɔ mi amaniɛ ngɛ o he ɔ.
A tsɔɔ kaa o ngɔ o he ngɔ ha Mawu kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ peeɔ mi bua jɔmi pe kulaa ji kaa ma nu kaa ye bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ nya.
A jé Gayo yi Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ saminya!
Dengme nɛ o ngɛ gboe ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he, titli nibwɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, o tsui tsuo o kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔ tsue.
A ba ye suɔmi nɛ o ngɛ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ he odase ha asafo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o wo mɛ blɔ saminya bɔ nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ a kɛ tsa a blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ.
Ejakaa blɔ nɛ a hia nɛ ɔ, Kristo ní tsumi a ngɛ tsue, nɛ a he we nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ a dɛ mi yemi kɛ buami ko kulaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nɛ wa le Kristo ɔ, e hia kaa waa ye kɛ bua nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ waa piɛ a he kɛ tsu anɔkuale ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ. Diotrefe kɛ Demetrio I ngma womi kpiti ko ngɔ mane asafo ɔ.
Se Diotrefe, nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e pee e he nɔkɔtɔma a bui mi kulaa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i ba a, lakpa munyuhi nɛ e ngɛ tue ngɛ wa he ɔ, ma wo nɔ ta, konɛ nyɛɛ na nihi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ.
Se enɛ ɔ tete pi ha lɛ.
Ke nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ɔ, e he we mɛ atuu.
Asafo ɔ mi bi komɛ nɛ mɛɛ a suɔ kaa a ma he nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ atuu po, e tsiɔ a nya; nɛ e hlaa kaa e fie mɛ kɛ je asafo ɔ mi!
Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ!
Ko ya wo nihi nɛ peeɔ ní yayamihi a nane; moo kase nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa mohu.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, Mawu nɔ́ ji lɛ; nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e li Mawu.
Demetrio lɛɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa; nɛ jã nɔuu nɛ anɔkuale ɔ nitsɛ hu tsɔɔ.
Wɔ hu wa ngɛ e he odase yee ja nɔuu, nɛ nyɛ le kaa anɔkuale wa ngɛ tue.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ ma ngma mo, se i sume kaa i kɛ ningma tso kɛ ningma nyu ngmaa.
Mohu ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma na mo, nɛ wa maa sɛɛ ní hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.
I ngɛ he jɔmi bae ha mo.
O huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ke a biɔ mo.
Nga wa huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka ha wɔ.
NYA TSƆƆMI Yuda ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Yesu se nyɛɛli tsuo, konɛ a hyɛ a he saminya ngɛ lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ mɛ hu a deɔ ke a heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ a he.
Womi kpiti nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa Petro Womi Enyɔne ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ nɔuu.
Yuda ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ mumi mi he wami.
E de mɛ ke, “Hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ Mawu ha e nihi nɛ e hla mɛ si kake nyɔngloo ɔ, a hɛɛ mi wawɛɛ.” Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije - Lakpa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a su, a tsɔɔmi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ha - Yuda wo ga ke a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ - Gbaami -
Imi Yuda, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ, kɛ Yakobo nyɛminyumu ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha Kristo se nyɛɛli tsuo, nihi nɛ Tsɛ Mawu suɔ, nɛ e hla mɛ, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to ha Yesu Kristo ɔ. Mɔbɔ nami, suɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ babauu ha nyɛ.
Lakpa tsɔɔli Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Jinɛ i ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ ma ngma nyɛ womi, nɛ wɔ tsuo wa yi wami hemi sane ɔ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nya saminya.
Se i na kaa e hia kaa ma ngma nyɛ nɔuu ngɛ nɔ́ kpa he mohu.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mumi mi he wami woe, konɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha e nihi nɛ e hla mɛ si kake nyɔngloo ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ mi wawɛɛ.
I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa ni komɛ nɛ li Mawu ju si ba sɛ wa kpɛti.
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ dloomi nɛ Mawu dloo wɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ plɛ hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kɛ laa a yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Yesu Kristo, wa Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kake too ɔ hu a kua lɛ.
Blema lokoo lɛ ngmami ɔmɛ de to kaa a ma kpata nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛ le enɛ ɔ momo lɛɛ, se i suɔ kaa ma kai nyɛ.
Benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ jé Israel bi ɔmɛ si kake nyɔngloo kɛ je Egipt se ɔ, e kpata ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛ kai Mawu bɔfohi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya sa a, nɛ pee se ɔ, a tsɔ atuã kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a si himi he ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ fi mɛ, nɛ Mawu ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to gbogboehi a je ngɛ diblii nɛ mi ti mi.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ a maa hi hluu kɛ yaa si ligbi ngua a maa su, nɛ a maa kojo mɛ.
Nyɛ kai Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe ɔ. Ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ yayahi a se kaa bɔ nɛ jamɛ a bɔfo ɔmɛ pee ɔ nɔuu.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tue gblami ji kaa a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo la nɛ gbo we mi, konɛ a pee okadi kɛ ha nihi tsuo.
Jã nɔuu lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ hu bleɔ he lo ɔ; a teɔ si kɛ siɔ Mawu nɔ yemi ɔ, nɛ a jɛɔ ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ po.
Mawu bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Mikael tete po pee we enɛ ɔ. Benɛ e kɛ Abosiami pɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ sã nya kaa mɛnɔ lɛ sa kaa e ngɔ Mose flɔ̃ ɔ, Mikael jɛ we Abosiami; e yi e he fɛu hulɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ e de lɛ ji, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ka o hɛ mi!” Se nimli nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui sisi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu yaya.
Se níhi nɛ a nuɔ he kaa pu mi lohwehi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a susuu we yi mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu ji níhi nɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.
Musu tloo mɛ pɛ!
A ya ngɔ Kain blɔ ɔ. Yayami nɛ Balaam pee ɔ, a ngɔ a he ya wo jamɛ a yayami ɔ mi ngɛ se nami he.
A tsɔ atuã kaa bɔ nɛ Kora tsɔ atuã a, nɛ a hɛ mi kpata kaa lɛ.
Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba futu nyɛ kɛ ngɛ suɔmi niye ní yee ɔ, a woɔ ní ɔ he mu.
A yeɔ ní tsuatsuaatsua nɛ a susuu we ni kpahi a he.
A ngɛ kaa bɔku nɛ nyu be mi nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ fiae kɛ bee.
A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ ní kpami be po a nɛ yiblii ngɛ a nɔ; tsohi nɛ gbo, nɛ a hia mɛ kɛ sipoku tsuo ngɔ fɔ si.
A ngɛ kaa wo mi oslɔke nɛ ngɛ kue hamahama, nɛ a zo ní ɔmɛ je kpo paa kaa hwɔli.
A ngɛ kaa dodoehi nɛ ngɛ si bɔlee kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae; nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu dla he ko ngɔ to mɛ momo ngɛ gbogboehi a je diblii nɛ mi ti ɔ mi.
Henok, Adam nina tutuutu ekpane ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e gba blema lokoo ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kɛ e bɔfo klɔuklɔuhi akpeakpe abɔ.
E maa kojo nimli tsuo; nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ, e maa gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ musu bɔmi munyuhi nɛ a tu kɛ si Mawu ɔ a he.” Daa nɛ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu huitihuiti tue kɛ ngɛ bee; nɔ́ muɛ a hɛ gblegbleegble.
Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he akɔnɔ yayahi a se nɛ a dii.
A fĩaa; a peeɔ nya puu, nɛ a gbee nihi a yi mi, konɛ a kɛ na ni ɔmɛ a he blɔ.
A ngɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ga woe Se nyɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kai níhi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔmɛ de to ɔ.
A de ke, “Nyagbe be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi maa ba nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu; a maa pee ní yayamihi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsui suɔ.” Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nimli nɛ kɛ mi gbami baa a nɛ.
A he lo ɔ lɛ yeɔ a nɔ; a be mumi ɔ.
Se nyɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ!
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi klɔuklɔu ɔ mi wawɛɛ nɛ nyɛ nane nɛ pi si ngɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ sɔle ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami ɔ nya.
Be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo blɔ hyɛe nɛ e ba na nyɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛ neneene wami ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ maa hi si daa.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi peeɔ mɛ sikɔsikɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ na mɛ mɔbɔ; nyɛ je ni komɛ hu kɛ je la a mi; nyɛɛ na ni kpa komɛ hu mɔbɔ nɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ mi.
Se tadehi nɛ a wo ɔ tete po nyɛɛ hie; ejakaa a kɛ he lo akɔnɔ wo he mu.
Yi jemi sɔlemi Lɛ nɔ nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ maa hyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ be si nɔe, nɛ e maa hɛɛ nyɛ kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ ba e hɛ mi nyami klɔuklɔu ɔ mi nɛ piami ko be nyɛ he hie ɔ, lɛ Mawu kake too, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ, a gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.
E nɔ́ ji agboje, kɛ he wami, kɛ he blɔ kɛ je blema lokoo kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ yaa neneene tɔɔ!
Amen.
NYA TSƆƆMI A ngma womi nɛ ɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ yi mi wae wawɛɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a ngɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi kaa lɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he.
Womi ngmalɔ ɔ ngma womi nɛ ɔ titli nɛ e kɛ wo nihi nɛ maa kane ɔ he wami ke a ngɛ mɛ konɛ yi mi wae jio, a ngɛ nɔ nae jio, a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ a ye lɛ anɔkuale daa.
Nina kɛ níhi babauu nɛ a je tsɔɔ Yohane titli lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
A ngɔ okadi komɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi bɔ nɛ blema Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ma nyɛ maa nu sisi hluu, se ni kpahi lɛɛ laami sane ji ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha mɛ.
A gu nina slɔɔtohi a nɔ kɛ ti munyu oti ɔmɛ a mi si abɔ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ sa kaa a tsɔɔ womi ɔ sisi fitsofitso ɔ be tɛ kake nɔ; nihi slɔɔtoslɔɔto hɛɛ juɛmi munomuno ngɛ he.
Se nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ jeɔ kpo paa ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji kaa nyagbenyagbe ɔ, kɛ gu Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu maa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ butuu; e maa ye Abosiami hu nɔ ja nɔuu.
Ke Mawu ye kunimi ɔ gbe nya a, lɛ nitsɛ e nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ, e maa gbaa mɛ babauu; e ma ha mɛ hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he.
Hiɔwo nɛ a ma na ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha Sisije .- Kekleekle nina, kɛ womihi nɛ a ngma asafo kpaago ɔmɛ .—.
Womi kpo kɛ e nya sɔumi nɔ kpaago ɔ .—.
Titimati kpaago ɔmɛ .—.
Sinɔ ngua a, kɛ lohwe awi yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ .—.
Nina munomunohi .—.
Sowe kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ daa si kɛ ha Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ .- A kpata Babilon hɛ mi, nɛ a ye lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ, kɛ Abosiami a nɔ kunimi .—.
Nyagbe kojomi .- Hiɔwe he, zugba he, kɛ Yerusalem he .—.
Nyagbe .-
Ní komɛ nɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ ɔ, a he sane lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Mawu je nina a ngɔ tsɔɔ Kristo, konɛ lɛ hu e tsɔɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba mi ngɛ be kpiti mi.
Kristo tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ kɛ ya e tsɔlɔ Yohane ngɔ, nɛ e ya ha nɛ e le ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Níhi nɛ Yohane na a, e ye lɛ tsuo he odase ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Enɛ ɔ ji sɛ gbi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ kaneɔ womi nɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ nuɔ sɛ gbi nɛ a gba ngɔ to ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ɔ, á gbaa mɛ.
Ejakaa be ɔ nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi ɔ su ta.
Yohane ngɔ sɛ gbi ngɔ mane asafo kpaago ɔmɛ Imi Yohane nɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ ngɛ Asia.
Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je blema, nɔ nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ba a dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, mumi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale odase ɔ, nɛ lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ Mawu tle si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ lɛ nɛ e yeɔ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ dloo nyɛ, nɛ e ha nyɛ he jɔmi ja nɔuu.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e to matsɛ yemi sisi ha wɔ, nɛ e pee wɔ osɔfohi, konɛ wa sɔmɔ e Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, nyɛ ha waa wo e hɛ mi nyami, nɛ e ye matsɛ kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene.
Amen.
Hyɛ!
E ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ma, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na lɛ; nihi nɛ gbɔɔ lɛ ní ɔ hu maa na lɛ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ maa wo yana ha lɛ.
Ee, é ba mi ja!
Amen.
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, nɛ e ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ba a ke, “Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no.” Yohane na Kristo nɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee Imi nyɛ nyɛmi Yohane lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ. Kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ɔ, a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kaa nyɛ nɔuu.
I kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ wa ngɛ Kristo matsɛ yemi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ e sa kaa waa to wa tsui si ngɛ amanehlu nɛ wa ngɛ nae ɔ mi.
A ngɔ mi ya fɔ Patmo zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa i fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ i ye Yesu he odase.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ, mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe wawɛɛ kaa titimati ngɛ ye se.
Gbi ɔ de ke, “Ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ o na a ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ o kɛ mane asafohi nɛ ngɛ ma kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: Efeso, Smirna, Pergamo, Tiatira, Sarde, Filadelfia, kɛ Laodikea.” I plɛ ye he, konɛ ma hyɛ nɔ nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ munyu tue ɔ. Nɛ benɛ i plɛ ɔ, i na sika tsu kane tso kpaago, nɛ nɔ ko kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɛ a kpɛti.
E wo tade klɔii, nɛ e ngɔ kpa nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee kɛ fi e gugue.
E yi bwɔmi hiɛ futaa kaa to he bwɔmi hiɔ, loo snoo; nɛ e hɛngmɛ ngɛ kpɛe plamplam kaa la.
E nane ngɛ kpɛe kaa ayawa nɛ a tsu he ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi, nɛ e gbi ngɛ pɛe wawɛɛ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
E hɛɛ dodoe kpaago ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi, nɛ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ nɛ nya ba ngɛ e nya mi, nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa piani pu.
Benɛ i na lɛ ɔ, i nɔ si ngɛ e nane nya kaa nɔ gbogboe.
Se e ngɔ e hiɔ nine ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Koo ye gbeye!
Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no.
Imi ji hɛ kalɔ ɔ!
I gbo, se hyɛ, ye hɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
I ngɛ gbenɔ kɛ gbeje a nya safe.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ o na nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ. Dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ o na ngɛ ye hiɔ nine mi, kɛ sika tsu kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, laami sane nɛ kɔɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ a bɔfohi, nɛ kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ.”
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ Nɛ e de ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Efeso asafo ɔ nya a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ hɛɛ dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi, nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ sika tsu kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ, dengme nɛ o gboɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ o toɔ o tsui si.
I le hu kaa o ha we yayami peeli hɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ tsɛɔ a he bɔfohi, se pi bɔfohi ji mɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ o ka mɛ, nɛ o na kaa lakpatsɛmɛ ji mɛ ɔ, i le lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
O toɔ tsui si; o naa amanehlu ngɛ ye he nɛ pɔ tɔɛ mo.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane ko.
O sume mi hu kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi sa a. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hɛli o he si ngɛ nɔ nɛ mi nɛ o gbee si ngɛ ɔ he.
Mo tsake o tsui, nɛ o hi si kaa kekle ɔ. Ke o tsakee we o tsui ɔ, ma ba o ngɔ, nɛ ma ba je o kane tso ɔ kɛ je e ma he ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ́ kake nɛ o pee nɛ hi ji kaa ní nɛ Nikolai bi ɔmɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ, o nyɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i nyɛɛ ɔ nɔuu.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!
“Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ blɔ nɛ a maa ye tso nɛ haa nɔ wami nɛ ngɛ Mawu abɔɔ ɔ mi ɔ yiblii.” Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Smirna a Nɛ e de ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Smirna a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ nɛ ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e gbo, nɛ e kpale ba wami mi ekohu.
I le o haomi ɔmɛ!
I le kaa nɔ́ ko be o dɛ lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, niatsɛ ji mo.
Nihi nɛ deɔ ke Yuda bi ji mɛ, pohu e be mi ja a, ní yayahi nɛ a deɔ ngɛ o he ɔ, i le lɛ tsuo.
Abosiami jali a kuu ji mɛ!
Koo ye amanehlu nɛ ma o nɔ ɔ gbeye!
Hyɛ!
Abosiami miɔ nɛ e maa wo nyɛ ti ni komɛ tsu, konɛ a kɛ ka nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ maa na nɔ́ ligbi nyɔngma.
Ye mi anɔkuale kɛ yaa si gbenɔ mi tete po, nɛ ma ha mo wami kaa kunimi nɛ o ye ɔ he jlasi.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue.
“Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ be mɛ nae.
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Pergamo ɔ “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Pergamo ɔ, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ nɛ ngɛ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ nɛ nya ba a ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I le o hi he ɔ kaa Abosiami matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Se o pɛtɛ ye biɛ he.
Nɛ benɛ a gbe Antipa tete po ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o ngɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, o ngmɛɛ we he.
Niinɛ, Antipa ye ye he odase nɛ e ye mi anɔkuale.
Nɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he je ɔ, a gbe lɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ he nɛ Abosiami ngɛ ɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane bɔɔ ko.
Ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ya wo Balaam tsɔɔmi ɔ. Balam lɛ tsɔɔ Balak kaa e tsɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ klama nɛ a ye wɔ nya lo, nɛ a fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi.
Ja nɔuu ni komɛ hu ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ a hɛɛ Nikolai bi ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo tsake o tsui!
Ke pi ja a, ma ba o ngɔ be kpiti.
Ma ngɔ klaate nɛ ngɛ ye nya mi ɔ, nɛ i kɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ maa hwu ta.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!
“Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ mana nɛ a kɛ laa a eko.
Jehanɛ se hu, ma ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ tɛ hiɔ nɛ a ngma biɛ he ngɛ nɔ.
Biɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li, ja nɔ nɛ a ngɔ tɛ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ pɛ.
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Tiatira a “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Tiatira a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Mawu Bi ɔ, nɔ nɛ e hɛngmɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la, nɛ e nane hu ngɛ kpɛe kaa ayawa nɛ a tsu he ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ; i le o suɔmi, o hemi kɛ yemi, bɔ nɛ o sɔmɔɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ o toɔ o tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ nami mi.
I le kaa o ngɛ ní tsue amlɔ nɛ ɔ kulaa pe kekle ɔ po.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane.
O ngmɛ blɔ nɛ Yezebel, jamɛ a yo ɔ nɛ tsɛɔ e he gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ ye ma a ní tsɔɔe.
E kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ sisi mɛ, nɛ a ya ngɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi fiɛe; nɛ a ngɛ wɔ nya ní hu yee.
I ha lɛ be, konɛ e kɛ tsake e tsui, se e sume kaa e ma kpa e yakayaka nyɛɛmi ɔ. Hyɛ, ma ha nɛ e tlɔ sa mi kpotoo kɛ hiɔ, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ e kɛ mɛ puɛ gba a, ma ha nɛ a maa na nɔ́ wawɛɛ.
Ma pee enɛ ɔ, ja e kɛ mɛ tsuo tsake a tsui ngɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ a kɛ lɛ pee ɔ a he.
Ma gbe e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ hulɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, asafo ɔmɛ tsuo maa na kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ le adesahi tsuo a juɛmi, kɛ a tsui mi.
Ma wo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ɔ he.
“Se nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ Tiatira a, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ we tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ se; nɔ́ nɛ ni kpa amɛ tsɛɔ Abosiami laami sanehi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ hu, nyɛ kase we.
Nyɛɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, i hla we nɔ́ kpa ko ngɛ nyɛ dɛ kaa nyɛɛ pɛtɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si ma ba.
- Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi, ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ya nɔ maa pee ye suɔmi nya ní kɛ yaa si nyagbe ɔ, he blɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ, imi hu ma ha mɛ.
Ma ha nɛ a maa ye je ma amɛ a nɔ kɛ kɔni si wami, nɛ a ma tsɔtslɔɔ a mi kaa buɛ nɛ ywia tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ.
Nɛ ma ha mɛ dodoe nɛ a tsɛɛ nɔkɔ ɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Sarde ɔ “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Sarde ɔ, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mumi kpaago ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e hɛɛ dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I le ní nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ. I le kaa o he biɛ kaa nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ, pohu o gbo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, wo lɛ he wami.
Ejakaa ní nɛ o tsu ɔ, i nɛ kaa e hi kɛ pi si lolo ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaii nɔ́ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ o nu ɔ. Bu tue, nɛ o tsake o tsui.
Ke o pee we ja a, ma ba na mo tlukaa kaa julɔ be mi nɛ o hɛ be o he nɔ.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o ngɛ nihi bɔɔ ko ngɛ Sarde, nihi nɛ wui a tade ɔmɛ mu.
Mɛɛ a maa wo nɔ́ hiɔ, nɛ a kɛ mi maa nyɛɛ, ejakaa a sa ja.
Nihi nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, a maa wo ní hiɔ ha mɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ i be a biɛ gbee ngɛ hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi.
Nɛ ma jaje ngɛ Tsaatsɛ kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi paa kaa ye nihi ji mɛ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Filadelfia a “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Filadelfia a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ klɔuklɔu nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛ nɛ e hɛɛ David safe ɔ nɛ.
Ke e bli sinya a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga; nɛ ke e nga a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma bli.
I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ.
I le kaa o he wɛ tsɔ; se o yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o yeɔ mi anɔkuale.
Hyɛ, i bli sinya ko ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga.
Hyɛ!
Ni ɔmɛ nɛ je Abosiami jali a kuu ɔ mi ɔ, lakpatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ deɔ ke Yuda bi ji mɛ, pohu e be mi ja a, nɔ́ nɛ ma pee mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma ha nɛ a maa ba nɛ a ma ba kpla si ngɛ o nane nya.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma na le kaa i suɔ mo.
I wo mo mlaa ke o to o tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ nami mi; nɛ o ye nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, amanehlu nguaa a nɛ ma je ɔ tsuo nɔ ɔ, ke be ɔ su ɔ, imi hu ma ha nɛ o maa ye o he.
Ee, a kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ maa ka nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi.
I ma nɔuu!
Nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ, konɛ jlasi nɛ o ma na, ke o ye kunimi ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ ko kpɔ ngɛ o dɛ.
Nɔ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee titima ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e be lejɛ ɔ jee gblegbleegble.
