Ma ngma ye Mawu ɔ biɛ, kɛ ye Mawu ɔ ma, Yerusalem he ɔ biɛ ngɛ e he.
Ma he nɛ ɔ maa je ye Mawu ɔ ngɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ba.
Jehanɛ, ma ngma ye biɛ he ɔ hu ngɛ e he.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!” Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea a Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Laodikea a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke, “Sɛ gbi nɛ je Amen, odase ɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lɛ ji níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ sisije.
I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ.
I le kaa o be yluduu, nɛ o be kalakala hulɔ.
I ná nɛ o ngɛ yluduu, loo kalakala!
Se akɛnɛ o ngɛ kulɔkulɔ, akɛnɛ o be yluduu, nɛ o be kalakala hu he je ɔ, ma sú mo ngɔ pue he kaa a suɔ lada.
O deɔ ke, ‘I na ní kpɔtɔɔ; i plɔke, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi!’ Se o li tete kaa o ngɛ dengme mi, nɛ o ní ngɛ mɔbɔ!
O li kaa ohiatsɛ ji mo!
O li kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, nɛ o hɛngmɛ hu yu!
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo ga woe nɛ o ba he sika tsu ngɛ ye dɛ; ee, ba he sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ngɛ ye dɛ, konɛ o na ní.
He ní hiɔ hu nɛ o wo, nɛ a ko na kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, ejakaa e ngɛ zo.
Jehanɛ, he tsopa nɛ o nga ngɔ pue o hɛngmɛ nɔ, konɛ o hyɛ nɔ́.
Nihi nɛ i suɔ mɛ ɔ, i kaa a hɛ mi, nɛ i gblaa a tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o hɛ nɛ dɔ, nɛ o tsake o tsui.
Hyɛ, i daa si ngɛ sinya a se, nɛ i ngɛ sie.
Ke nɔ ko nu ye gbi nɛ e bli sinya a, ma sɛ mi, nɛ i kɛ lɛ maa ye ní, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ mi maa ye ní.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ blɔ nɛ a maa hi ye kasa nya ngɛ ye matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ye kunimi, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i hii si ngɛ Tsaatsɛ kasa nya ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue.”
A ngɛ Mawu jae ngɛ hiɔwe Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na nina kpa.
I na nɛ a bli sinya ko ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ hiɔwe.
Nɛ gbi ɔ nɛ i nu nɛ pɛ kaa titimati, nɛ e kɛ mi ba tu munyu be ko ɔ de ke, “Ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo níhi nɛ maa ba mi be kpiti mi.” Amlɔ ɔ, mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ.
Nɛ hyɛ, matsɛ sɛ ko ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa yaspi kɛ sardi tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa.
Alale nɛ e su ngɛ kaa emerald tɛ nɛ he jua wa po kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ. Matsɛ sɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ kpa komɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ hii si ngɛ a nɔ.
A wo ní hiɔ, nɛ sika tsu jlasi fi a yi.
I na nɛ oslabai gba, nɛ i nu gbihi, nɛ hiɔwe hu si kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi.
Jatɛ kpaago nɛ a su, ngɛ tsoe ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ ɔmɛ ji mumi slɔɔto kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ ngɛ kaa wo, nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa ahuhuɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ kristolo ɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Hɛ kali eywiɛ daa si kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɔ nya amɛ tsuo a he kɛ kpe, nɛ a hɛ mi, kɛ a se tsuo hɛngmɛ sɔuu.
Kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ kaa jata, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa na ku.
Hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kaa adesa hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa kɔle nɛ te kɛ bee.
Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ pɛli ekpa, nɛ a mi mi je kɛ kpo nɔ je tsuo hɛngmɛ sɔuu.
Nɛ nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo ɔ, a hii lae nɛ a kpa we ke, “Klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu ji Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, nɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, nɛ e ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ e maa ba a.” Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ laa yi jemi la, kɛ sina la, nɛ a kɛ woɔ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ngɛ daa a hɛ mi nyami.
Ke a wo la a nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nikɔtɔma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ mi kɛ buɔ si ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a jaa lɛ.
A ngɔɔ a jlasi ɔmɛ kɛ pueɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa Mawu!
Mo ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami, bu, kɛ he wami kɛ ha.
Mo lɛ o bɔ níhi tsuo; o bɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ o suɔ kaa a hi.
Nɛ a ngɛ ja pɛ!”
Womi kpo ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ I na womi kpo ko ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɔ nine mi.
A ngma ní ngɛ womi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago.
Nɛ i na bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɛ ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ sa kaa e tsɔ womi nya sɔumi ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e bli womi kpo ɔ nya?” Se nɔ ko nɔ ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba, loo zugba a sisi nɛ ma nyɛ ma bli womi ɔ nya, loo e ma nyɛ maa hyɛ mi.
I wo ya wawɛɛ, ejakaa a nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ sa nɛ ma bli womi kpo ɔ nya, loo e maa kane.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake de mi ke, “Ko fo ya.
Hyɛ!
Jata a nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ ji David nina a ye kunimi.
Nɛ lɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ tsɔ womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago ɔmɛ, nɛ e ma nyɛ bli womi kpo ɔ nya.” Jehanɛ, i na To bi ko nɛ daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a kpɛti.
To bi ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a gbe.
E ngɛ koli kpaago, kɛ hɛngmɛ kpaago.
Hɛngmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji Mawu mumi slɔɔto kpaago nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya je ɔ mi tsuo.
To bi ɔ ya he womi kpo ɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɔ nine mi.
Benɛ To bi ɔ sɔle womi kpo ɔ, hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ To bi ɔ hɛ mi.
A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ kpa saku, kɛ sika tsu sowe nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via hyi lɛ tɔ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ ji ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a sɔlemi.
Hɛ kali ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ la la he kɛ ha To bi ɔ ke, “Mo nɛ o sa kaa o heɔ womi kpo ɔ, nɛ o tsɔɔ nya sɔumi ní ɔmɛ.
Ejakaa a gbe mo, nɛ o kɛ o muɔ ɔ he adesahi tsuo, wɛtsohi, gbihi, mahi, kɛ je mahi kɛ ha Mawu.
O to matsɛ yemi sisi ha mɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ osɔfohi, konɛ a sɔmɔ wa Mawu ɔ; nɛ a maa ye matsɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, i nu bɔfohi babauu akpeakpe abɔ a gbi nɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ kpe.
Nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ke, “To bi nɛ a gbe ɔ, e sa kaa a ngɔ he wami, ní nami, nile, agboje, bu, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ yi jemi kɛ ha lɛ.” Nɛ i nu nɛ nibɔ níhi tsuo ngɛ hiɔwe, zugba a, kɛ zugba a sisi, kɛ wo mi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ nɛ wa maa ngɔ yi jemi, agboje, kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ ha kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene.” Kɛkɛ nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ de ke “Amen!” Nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ a ja Mawu kɛ To bi ɔ.
To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi ní ɔmɛ Jehanɛ i na nɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ. I nu nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake wo gbi kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔwe lɛ ngɛ sie, nɛ e de ke, “Ba!” Benɛ i ke i hyɛɛ ɔ, nyumu ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ hiɔ ko nɔ kɛ e dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃.
A ha lɛ jlasi, nɛ e je kpo kaa kunimi yelɔ nɛ yaa nɛ e ya ye kunimi.
Benɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ enyɔne ɔ, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ enyɔne ɔ de ke, “Ba.” Kɛkɛ nɛ okpɔngɔ kpa ba, nɛ lɛɛ e tsuɔ.
Mawu ha okpɔngɔ nɔ hilɔ ɔ he blɔ nɛ e kɛ ta nɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ nimli nɛ gbe a he.
A ha lɛ klaate gagaa ko.
Jehanɛ ɔ, To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ etɛne ɔ, nɛ i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ etɛne ɔ de ke, “Ba!” Nɛ́ i ke i hyɛɛ ɔ, okpɔngɔ yumu ko ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ hɛɛ sɛni ngɛ e dɛ mi.
I nu nɛ nɔ́ ko pɛ kaa adesa gbi kɛ je hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Gbi ɔ de ke, “Ngma susumi nɔ́ kake ligbi kake hiɔwo, blɛfo susumi nɔ́ etɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo; se nu tso ɔmɛ, kɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ko kpata a hɛ mi.” - Benɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ eywiɛne ɔ nya a, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ de ke, “Ba!” Nɛ benɛ i ke i hyɛɛ ɔ, okpɔngɔ lazulazu ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ biɛ ji Gbenɔ, nɛ Gbeje nyɛɛ e se haa.
Mawu ha mɛ he wami ngɛ je ɔ mi dlami eywiɛ mi kake nɔ, konɛ a ngɔ ta, hwɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ lohwe awi yeli kɛ kpata je ɔ hɛ mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ, To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ enuɔne ɔ. Nɛ i na nihi nɛ ye Mawu munyu ɔ he odase nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ he ɔ a klaahi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi.
A kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Ope, mo nɛ o ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale!
Mɛni be o maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si?
Ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ a gbe wɔ ɔ, kojo mɛ nɔuu nɛ o gbla a tue!” A ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ tade hiɔ klɔii, nɛ a de mɛ ke a jɔɔ a he be bɔɔ ko lolo kɛ yaa si a maa gbe a nyɛmimɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a gbe mɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu sɔmɔɔ Mawu kaa mɛ kɛ̃.
Benɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ekpane ɔ, i nu nɛ zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ.
Pu kpa tsomi; diblii wo kpii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ pee tsutsuu kaa muɔ.
Dodoe ɔmɛ tsɔ fia si kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔkɔ tso yiblii kplɔɔ pueɔ si ke kɔɔhiɔ nguaa fia a. Hiɔwe hɛ lɛ kɛ ho kaa womi kpo nɛ a hluɛ̃, nɛ yohi, kɛ zugba kpɔhi nɛ wo bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe tsuo hia kɛ je a blɔ hehi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, niatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ hɛɛ biɛ, odehehi, nyɔguɛhi, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, kɛ tɛ sahi a sisi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A de yo ɔmɛ, kɛ tɛ sa amɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba ha wa nɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ko na wɔ, nɛ́ To bi ɔ hu ko gbla wa tue!
Ejakaa ligbi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye nɛ a maa gbla wa tue ɔ, ligbi ɔ su.
Nɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da?”
Israel bi , Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na Mawu bɔfohi eywiɛ nɛ a daa si ngɛ je ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ.
A tsi kɔɔhiɔ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ kɔɔhiɔ ko fia ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo wo nɔ, loo kɛ muɔ tso ko.
I na bɔfo kpa ko hu nɛ ngɛ kuɔe kɛ je pu site he kɛ ma, nɛ e hɛɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́.
E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ e de bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Mawu ha mɛ he wami ke a kpata zugba a, kɛ wo ɔ a hɛ mi ɔ ke, “Nyɛ ko kpata zugba a, loo wo ɔ, loo tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si wa maa ngɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kɛ kadi wa Mawu ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ nya lolo.” Nɛ a de mi ke nihi nɛ a ngɔ Mawu nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kɛ kadi a hɛ nya a, a yibɔ ji ,.
A je Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi; -nihi akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ je wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi.
Wɛtso ɔmɛ ji Yuda, Reuben, Gad, Asher, Naftali, Manase, Simeon, Levi, Isakar, Zebulun, Yosef, kɛ Benyamin.
Asafo kuu nguaa a Enɛ ɔ se nɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, nimli asafo nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane ji nɛ.
A je je ma amɛ tsuo a mi, wɛtso munomuno, nimli munomuno, kɛ gbi munomuno.
A daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ a he tade hiɔ klɔiiklɔii; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ tã kũɔmi ngɛ e dɛ.
Nɛ mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Wa Mawu ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami.” Bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo daa si kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a ja Mawu, nɛ a de ke, “Amen!
Wa Mawu!
Wa ngɛ o yi jee; wa ngɛ o hɛ mi nyami woe, nɛ wa ngɛ mo si nae kɛ yaa neneene.
Ejakaa o le ní; o kle, nɛ o je agbo!
Amen!” Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake bi mi ke, “Nihi nɛ wo tade hiɔ klɔiiklɔii nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ jije a je?” I de lɛ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, i li; mo lɛ o le!” E de mi ke, “Haomi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ gblee mi kɛ be slɔkee.
A fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ha nɛ a hiɛ futaa ngɛ To bi ɔ muɔ ɔ mi.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a jaa lɛ nyɔ kɛ pia ngɛ e sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ maa baa a yi.
Hwɔ be mɛ yee hu; kuma be mɛ yee hu.
Pu, loo pu la nɛ nya wa hu be mɛ sããe, ejakaa To bi ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kpɛti ɔ maa lɛ mɛ; nɛ e ma tsɔ̃ mɛ kɛ maa ya nyu vuhi nɛ haa nɔ wami a he.
Nɛ Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu tsuo.”
Nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaagone ɔ Benɛ bɔfo ɔ tsɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaagone ɔ, hiɔwe jɔ dii maa pee ngmlɛfia fa.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i na bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, nɛ a ha mɛ titimati kpaago.
Bɔfo kpa ba ba da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e hɛɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee.
A ha lɛ tsopa kɛ e he via fuu nɛ e kɛ piɛ Mawu we bi ɔmɛ tsuo a sɔlemi ɔ he, konɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ nɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Tsopa kɛ e he via la su ku ɔ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ je bɔfo ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ dɛ mi kɛ ho hiɔwe ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ ɔ; e je la ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɔ wo mi tɔ, nɛ e hɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ.
Hiɔwe si, gbihi pɛ, oslabai gba, nɛ zugba mimiɛ.
Titimati kpaago ɔmɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ titimati kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ pee klaalo, konɛ a kpa titimati ɔmɛ.
Kekleekle bɔfo ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu, kɛ la nɛ muɔ futu mi ba pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, tsohi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, kɛ ba mumu tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ sã.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo enyɔne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ a sake nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa yo nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ mi.
Wo ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake plɛ muɔ.
Wo ɔ mi nibɔ ní hɛ ngmengmlehi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake gbo, nɛ lɛhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ ɔ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake hɛ mi kpata.
Bɔfo etɛne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ dodoe nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa jatɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake a mi.
Dodoe ɔ biɛ ji Doomi.
Nyu ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake plɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dooɔ.
Nɛ nihi babauu nɛ nu nyu ɔ gbo, ejakaa nyu ɔ dooɔ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo eywiɛne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko sa pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a he, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a tsu ní bɔ nɛ sa.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, piani ɔ, pu nyɛ we nɛ e tso piani be ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake; nyɔ mi hu nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a kpɛ nyɔ mi be ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i hyɛ, nɛ i nu kɔle ko he nɛ te kɛ bee ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.
Kɔle ɔ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Musu oo musu!
Musu oo musu!
Nihi tsuo nɛ maa hi je ɔ mi be mi nɛ bɔfo etɛ ɔmɛ ma kpa titimati ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, musu tloo mɛ!”
Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo enuɔne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i na dodoe ko nɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ zugba, nɛ a ha lɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya safe ɔ. Dodoe ɔ bli muɔ voo ɔ nya, nɛ la su ku kpii je mi kaa flɔɔnɔɔ nguaa mi la su ku; la su ku nɛ je muɔ ɔ mi ɔ ha nɛ pu, kɛ kɔɔhiɔ pee yumuu.
Baalɛhi je la su ku ɔ mi pue zugba, nɛ Mawu ha mɛ he wami kaa nyingmogblakotohi pɛ.
A de mɛ ke a ko ta nga, loo ba mumu, loo tso ko tso ko he; nimli adesahi nɛ Mawu nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ he okadi be a hɛ nya a, á ye mɛ pɛ awi.
A ngmɛ́ baalɛ ɔmɛ blɔ kaa a gbe nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, se mohu kaa a pii mɛ nyɔhiɔ enuɔ sɔuu.
A maa nu piimi nɛ a pii mɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ke nyingmogblakoto tsɛ̃ nɔ nɛ e yee nɔ ɔ. Jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nimli ma hla gbenɔ se blɔ, se a be nae; a maa suɔ kaa a gbo, se gbenɔ maa tu a nya fo.
Baalɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔhi nɛ a mia mɛ kɛ ha ta; ní komɛ fi a yi kaa sika tsu jlasi, nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kaa nimli a hɛ mi.
A yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa yihi a yi bwɔmi, nɛ a lunguhi ngɛ kaa jata nɔ́.
A wo ní komɛ ha mɛ ngɛ a gugue mi kaa dade damahi, nɛ ke a fia a pɛlihi a mi ɔ, e pɛɛ wawɛɛ kaa ta zugba lɛhi fuu nɛ okpɔngɔhi gbla kɛ yaa ta.
A ngɛ hlemi kɛ e nya duɔ kaa nyingmogblakoto hlemi.
Nɛ hlemi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi lɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ ma pii nimli nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ ngɛ.
Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ a nɔ ji bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya a. Hebri gbi mi ɔ, e biɛ ji Abadon, se Hela gbi mi lɛɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolion.
Kekleekle musu ɔ se po; se hyɛ, musu enyɔ pa ngɛ se kɛ ma!
Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ekpane ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ je sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ koli ɔmɛ a mi.
Gbi ɔ de bɔfo ekpane ɔ nɛ hɛɛ titimati ɔ ke, “Bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a fi mɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa nguaa a nya a, yaa pɛne mɛ!” Bɔfo ekpane ɔ ya pɛne bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ.
Blɔɔ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to nɛ a pee mɛ klaalo, konɛ jeha nɛ ɔ tutuutu we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ɔ tutuutu we ngmlɛfia nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a gbe adesahi tsuo a mi dlami etɛ mi kake.
A tsɔɔ mi okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ a yibɔ; a hiɛmi ji ayɔ lafa enyɔ.
Bɔ nɛ i na okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ wo dama; ekomɛ tsu tsutsuu kaa la; ekomɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, nɛ ekomɛ hu ngɛ kaa kungwɔ zɔ.
Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a yi ngɛ kaa jata yi, nɛ la, kɛ la su ku, kɛ la hɛuu ngɛ a nya mi jee.
Nɔ́ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nya mi jee ɔ gbe adesahi tsuo a mi dlami etɛ mi kake.
Ejakaa he wami nɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, a nya mi, kɛ a hlemi nya e ngɛ.
Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a hlemi ngɛ kaa sinɔ nɛ yi ngɛ he, nɛ lɔ ɔ a kɛ yeɔ awi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ piɛ, nɛ mɛɛ haomi nɛ ɔmɛ gbi mɛ ɔ, a tsakee we a tsui, nɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nine pee ɔ, a ngmɛɛ we he.
A kpa we mumi yayamihi jami.
Amagahi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ, loo ayawa, loo tɛ, loo tso pee ɔ, pi kaa a kpa mɛ jami; pohu amaga amɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, a nui nɔ́, nɛ a nyɛɛ we hulɔ.
Jehanɛ hu, a tsakee we a tsui, konɛ a jɔɔ muɔ si puemi, loo nyuami, loo nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi, loo jumi.
Mawu bɔfo ɔ kɛ womi kpo wayoo ɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, i na Mawu bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ kpa nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma.
Bɔku bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ alale ngɛ e yi je; e hɛ mi ngɛ kaa pu, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa la titimahi.
E hɛɛ womi kpo wayoo ko nɛ a bli mi ngɛ e dɛ mi.
E kɛ e hiɔ nane ma wo nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e muɔ nane ma zugba nɔ; nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe.
Benɛ e pee ja a, hiɔwe wo gbi, nɛ e si si kpaago.
Benɛ hiɔwe si si kpaago ɔ, jinɛ i miɔ nɛ ma ngma nɔ́ nɛ a de ɔ.
Se i nu nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ de ɔ, kɛ to o yi mi; koo ngma!” Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ɔ nɛ i na nɛ daa si, nɛ e nane kake ngɛ wo nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ zugba nɔ ɔ, wo e hiɔ nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e ka kita ngɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ biɛ mi.
Lɛ nɛ e bɔ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba, kɛ wo, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a mi.
Bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Mawu be tsle toe hu!
Se ke bɔfo kpaagone ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɔ laa, nɛ e de e tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nɛ e ba mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi nɛ i nu nɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu.
E ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ daa si, nɛ e nane kake ngɛ wo nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ zugba nɔ ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya he womi kpo nɛ a bli mi ɔ ngɛ e dɛ.” I ya bɔfo ɔ ngɔ, nɛ i ya de lɛ ke e ha mi womi kpo wayoo ɔ. E de mi ke, “Ngɔɔ nɛ o ye; e maa ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kaa hwo ngɛ o nya mi, se e maa doo ngɛ o mi mi.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i sɔle womi kpo wayoo ɔ ngɛ bɔfo ɔ dɛ nɛ i ye.
E ngɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kaa hwo ngɛ ye nya mi; se benɛ i mi ɔ, e doo ngɛ ye mi mi.
Nɛ a de mi ke, “Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ mahi, je mahi, gbihi, kɛ matsɛmɛ babauu a he ɔ, e sa kaa o fiɛ ekohu.”
Odase yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, a ha mi tso ko nɛ maa hi kɛ nɔ́ susumi, nɛ a de mi ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya susu Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, nɛ o kane nihi nɛ ngɛ Mawu jae ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ mi.
Se kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ we agbo ɔ nya a lɛɛ ko susu.
Si lɔ ɔ, ejakaa a ngɔ kɛ ha je ma amɛ, nɛ a ma si ako ngɛ ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi nyɔhiɔ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Ye we odase yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ ma bu kpekpe ya bo; nɛ ma ha a maa gba ligbi akpe kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.” Odase yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ ji oliv tso enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kane tso enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu, je ɔ tsuo nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔ ko hla kaa e ye mɛ awi ɔ, la jeɔ a nya mi, nɛ e kpataa a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma hla kaa e ye mɛ awi ɔ, ja a gbe lɛ.
Mawu ha mɛ he wami nɛ a ma nyɛ nga hiɔwe nya nɛ hiɔmi be nɛe be mi nɛ a ngɛ gbae ɔ.
A ngɛ he wami ngɛ nyu nɔ kaa a ma ha nɛ nyu nɛ plɛ pee muɔ; a ngɛ he wami hulɔ kaa a kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ slɔɔtohi baa zugba a nɔ si abɔ nɛ a suɔ.
Ke a gbe odase yemi ɔ nya a, lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ jeɔ muɔ voo ɔ mi ɔ kɛ mɛ ma ba hwu ta.
E maa ye a nɔ, nɛ e maa gbe mɛ, nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ma pue si ngɛ magbɛ nɔ, ngɛ ma nguaa a nɛ a sɛu a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ mi.
A tsɛɛ jamɛ a ma a ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke Sodom, loo Egipt.
Nɛ ma amɛ, wɛtso ɔmɛ, gbi slɔɔto ɔmɛ, kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa hi a gbogboe ɔmɛ hyɛe gaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ kɛ fa nɛ a be kplɛɛe nɛ a pu mɛ.
Nihi tsuo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma nya kaa nimli enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ gbo.
A tsui maa nɔ a mi, nɛ a maa ke a sibi ní, ejakaa jamɛ a gbali enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ haomi babauu kɛ ba je ɔ mi.
Ligbi etɛ kɛ fa a se ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ a kpale ba wami mi ekohu.
A te si da a nane nɔ, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na mɛ ɔ ye gbeye wawɛɛ.
Jehanɛ ɔ, gbali enyɔ ɔmɛ nu gbi ko nɛ pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je hiɔwe.
Gbi ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!” Nɛ benɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ hyɛe ɔ, a ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ bɔku mi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ; ma a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake hɛ mi kpata, nimli akpe kpaago gbo, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ a wo Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
Musu enyɔne ɔ se po; se hyɛ, musu etɛne ɔ ngɛ se kɛ ma!
Titimati kpaagone ɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaagone ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i nu gbihi nɛ ngɛ pɛe wawɛɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e Kristo ɔ nɛ a ngɛ je ɔ nɔ yee.
Nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene!” Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si; nɛ a ja Mawu, nɛ a de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, Mo nɛ o ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ o hi si hyɛ hulɔ ɔ, Wa naa mo si kaa o tsu o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ he ní, nɛ o bɔni matsɛ yemi!
Je ma amɛ a mi mi fu mo, se jehanɛ ɔ, be su nɛ mo hu o mi mi ma fu mɛ.
Be su nɛ o maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ gbo ɔ, nɛ o tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ, ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ nimli wawihi kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ, be su nɛ o maa wo mɛ hiɔ.
Nihi nɛ kpataa zugba a hɛ mi ɔ, be su nɛ o ma kpata mɛ hu a hɛ mi.” Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nya bli, nɛ a na e somi daka a nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ oslabai gba; hiɔwe si, zugba mimiɛ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu agboagbo nɛ pue zugba a nɔ.
Yo ɔ kɛ sinɔ nguaa a Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nyakpɛ okadi nguaa ko je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe.
I na yo ko; tade nɛ e wo ji pu.
Nɛ nyɔhiɔ ngɛ e nane si, nɛ jlasi kɛ e mi dodoe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ fi e yi.
Yo ɔ fɔmi be su, nɛ e nu kɔɔmi nɛ nya wa.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e bɔni ngmlaa kpami.
Nyakpɛ okadi nguaa kpa ko hu je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe.
I na wo mi sinɔ nguaa ko.
E ngɛ yi kpaago, kɛ koli nyɔngma, nɛ jlasi fi yi tsuaa yi.
Sinɔ ɔ ngɔ e hlemi kɛ gbla dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, nɛ e hɛ mɛ ngɔ pue zugba.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya da yo nɛ miɔ nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ ke e fɔ pɛ nɛ lɛ sinɔ ɔ nɛ ye bi ɔ. Yo ɔ ba fɔ binyumu, nɔ nɛ maa ye je ɔ tsuo nɔ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ.
Se bɔfo ko ba ngɔ bi nɛ ɔ kɛ ho Mawu ngɔ ya ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Yo ɔ tu fo kɛ ho nga nɔ ya ngɛ he ko nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ to lɛ, nɛ a ya hyɛ e nɔ ligbi akpe kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.
Jehanɛ ɔ, ta ba te si ngɛ hiɔwe.
Bɔfo nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mikael ɔ, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ ya tua sinɔ nguaa a, nɛ sinɔ nguaa a, kɛ lɛ hu e bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hwu.
Se a ye sinɔ nguaa a, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a hi hiɔwe hu.
A sake sinɔ nguaa a ngɔ fɔ he.
Ee, jamɛ a blema sinɔ nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abosiami, loo Satan nɛ sisi nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, a sake lɛ kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ je ɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ ngmlaa ngɛ hiɔwe ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ yi wami hemi ba!
Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu maa ngɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ ye matsɛ!
Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ e Kristo he wami ɔ je kpo.
Ejakaa Abosiami nɛ daa si ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ e poɔ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nya haa lɛ ɔ be lejɛ ɔ hu.
A sake Abosiami kɛ je hiɔwe ngɔ fɔ si.
Wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ye e nɔ kunimi kɛ gu To bi ɔ muɔ ɔ, kɛ odase ɔ nɛ a ye ɔ nɔ.
A de we ke a maa baa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wami yi, se mohu a suɔ kaa a maa ngɔ a wami tete ngɔ ha, nɛ a gbe mɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ!
Se je ɔ, kɛ wo, nyɛɛ lɛɛ musu tloo nyɛ!
Abosiami kple si kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.
E mi mi fu wawɛɛ, ejakaa e le kaa be bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ piɛ ha lɛ.” Benɛ sinɔ nguaa a na kaa a sake lɛ ba fɔ zugba a nɔ ɔ, e nyɛɛ yo ɔ nɛ fɔ binyumu ɔ se kɛ fo.
Se a ha yo ɔ kɔle nguaa a pɛli enyɔ ɔmɛ, konɛ e kɛ tu fo kɛ ya e hi he ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
A maa hyɛ e nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jeha etɛ kɛ fa, nɛ sinɔ nguaa a nine be e nɔ sue.
Kɛkɛ nɛ sinɔ nguaa a sú nyu kaa pa kɛ je e nya mi kɛ pue yo ɔ se, konɛ nyu ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho.
Se zugba a ye bua yo ɔ; zugba a bli e nya mi, nɛ e mii nyu nɛ sinɔ nguaa a sú kɛ je e nya mi pue si ɔ. Sinɔ nguaa a mi mi fu yo ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho, konɛ e kɛ yo ɔ nina nɛ piɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ hu nɛ fiɛɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu he ɔ ya hwu ta.
Nɛ sinɔ nguaa a ya da si ngɛ wo ɔ nya.
Lohwe awi yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ ko nɛ je wo ɔ mi kɛ ma.
E ngɛ koli nyɔngma, kɛ yi kpaago.
Jlasi ngɛ koli tsuaa koli he, nɛ a ngma biɛ nɛ ji musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ yi tsuaa yi he.
Lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ i na a ngɛ kaa ogbetee; e nane ngɛ kaa osisiblisi nane, nɛ e nya ngɛ kaa jata nya.
Sinɔ nguaa a ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ he blɔ nɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ matsɛ ɔ eko.
Sinɔ nguaa a yi kake ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ plaa wawɛɛ; se pa a gbo.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a nyɛɛ lohwe ɔ se.
Ni ɔmɛ tsuo ja sinɔ nguaa a, ejakaa e ngɔ e blɔ nya a kɛ ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ.
A ja lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Mɛnɔ kɛ lohwe nɛ ɔ sɔ?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa hwu ta?” A ngmɛ lohwe ɔ blɔ nɛ e tu munyu nguahi, kɛ musu bɔmi munyuhi putɛputɛɛ kɛ si Mawu, nɛ a ha lɛ blɔ hulɔ nɛ e kɛ je e he wami kpo nyɔhiɔ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ.
E bɔni musu bɔmi munyuhi tumi kɛ si Mawu, Mawu biɛ ɔ, Mawu hi he ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.
A ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ.
A ha lɛ he wami ngɛ wɛtso munomuno, nimli munomuno, kɛ gbi munomuno tsuo a nɔ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ ma ja lɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ kɛ wo hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi loko a bɔ je ɔ, mɛ pɛ lɛ a be lɛ jae.
To bi ɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ nɔ́ ji jamɛ a womi ɔ.
“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu tue!
Ke a to ke a nu nɔ ko nyɔguɛ ɔ, ja a nu lɛ nyɔguɛ.
Ke nɔ ko kɛ klaate gbe nɔ ɔ, ja a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e hia kaa Mawu we bi nɛ to a tsui si, nɛ a pɛtɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he wawɛɛ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ kpa ko nɛ je zugba a mi.
E ngɛ koli enyɔ; koli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa to bi kolihi, nɛ lohwe ɔ tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ sinɔ nguaa a tuɔ munyu.
E ngɔ jamɛ a he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ kake ɔ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsu ní ja nɔuu ngɛ kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ nane mi.
E nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ nɛ a ja kekleekle lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ e pa a gbo ɔ. Lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ peeɔ nyakpɛ ní nguahi; e haa nɛ la po jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ baa zugba nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa.
Mawu ngmɛ lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ blɔ nɛ e pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ kekleekle lohwe ɔ hɛ mi.
Kɛ gu nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, e sisiɔ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ e haa a peeɔ yayami.
E nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a puɛ amaga nɛ ngɛ kaa lohwe awi yelɔ kake ɔ nɛ a kɛ klaate plaa lɛ wawɛɛ se e gbo we ɔ. Mawu ha lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ blɔ kaa e mu mumi kɛ wo amaga a mi, konɛ amaga a nɛ na wami, nɛ e tu munyu.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma ha nɛ a gbe nihi tsuo nɛ ja we lɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ nyɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, nimli wawihi kɛ nimli nguahi, niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ, odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi tsuo; nɛ a kadi a hiɔ nine, loo a hɛ nya.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma he ní, loo e maa jua ní, kaa ja a kadi lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ kekleekle lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ biɛ, loo yibɔ nɛ daa si ha biɛ ɔ. Ja ní lelɔ ji mo loko o maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e tsɔɔ yibɔ ɔ nɛ daa si ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ sisi, ejakaa yibɔ ɔ daa si ha nɔmlɔ biɛ.
Yibɔ ɔ ji .
To bi ɔ kɛ Mawu ni ɔmɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, i hyɛ, nɛ i na To bi ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ nimli ,.
A ngma To bi ɔ, kɛ e Tsɛ ɔ tsuo a biɛ ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ nya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee, loo hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ sie wawɛɛ.
Gbi nɛ i nu ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ke kpa saku fiali ngɛ saku fiae nɛ e pɛɛ ɔ. Nimli , ɔ daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a ngɛ la he ko lae.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e kase la nɛ ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo, ja mɛ nimli , ɔ nɛ Mawu he a yi wami ɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nyumuhi nɛ a kɛ yihi fiɛ we yakayaka fiɛmi, nɛ a ble we a he; a he tsɔ.
He tsuaa he nɛ To bi ɔ yaa a, a kɛ lɛ yaa.
Mɛ pɛ ji nihi nɛ Mawu he a yi wami ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Mawu kɛ To bi ɔ a nihi ji nimli nɛ ɔmɛ; a ngɛ kaa kekleekle tso yiblii nɛ a hla ngɔ to ha Mawu.
A yi lakpa hyɛ; sé ko be a he.
Mawu bɔfo etɛ ɔmɛ Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ te ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo kɛ bee.
E hɛɛ sɛ gbi ko nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Sɛ gbi ɔ kɔɔ sane kpakpa a he, nɛ e yaa nɛ e ya fiɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, mahi kɛ wɛtsohi, kɛ gbihi kɛ nimli tsuo.
Bɔfo ɔ de kɛ gbi nɛ wa ke, “Nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami!
Ejakaa be ɔ su nɛ e maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Nyɛ ja nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba, kɛ wo kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi nɛ baa a!” Bɔfo enyɔne ba ngɛ kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ se, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata!
Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛ mi kpata!
Babilon yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo puɛ; e ngɛ kaa dã nɛ nya wa nɛ e ha mɛ nɛ a nu.” - Mawu bɔfo etɛne ba ngɛ Mawu bɔfo enyɔ ɔmɛ a se.
Nɛ e de kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Nihi tsuo nɛ jaa lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ e we amaga a, nɛ a kɛ amaga a kadi a hɛ nya, loo a nine he ɔ, ja a nu wai nɛ daa si ha Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji wai ngmingmiingmi nɛ Mawu nitsɛ plɛ kɛ wo kplu nɛ daa si ha e mi mi fumi ɔ mi.
A ma pii nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ ngɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi ngɛ Mawu bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ To bi ɔ a hɛ mi.
La a nɛ a ma pii mɛ ngɛ mi ɔ maa tso gegeege kɛ maa ya neneene.
He jɔmi ko be ha nihi nɛ jaa lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ kɛ e we amaga a, loo ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ e biɛ kadi mɛ ɔ; a maa na nɔ́ nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo.” Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e hia kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ a heɔ Yesu yeɔ anɔkuale mi ɔ nɛ a to a tsui si daa.
Nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Ngmaa: A gbaa gbogboehi nɛ gboɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ.” “Ee!” Mumi ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “A maa jɔɔ a he kɛ je a dengme gbomi ɔ mi; se a ní tsumi ɔmɛ nyɛɛɔ a se.” Nyagbe kojomi ɔ he nina Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i hyɛ nɛ i na bɔku hiɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ nɔ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ. Sika tsu jlasi fi e yi, nɛ e hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba ngɛ e dɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo kpa je sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ e de nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔ nɔ ɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ o ngma kpami ha a nɛ o kɛ kpa ní!
Jehanɛ lɛɛ ní ba saminya ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ be su nɛ a ma kpa ní!” Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔ nɔ ɔ bɔni ní tsumi kɛ e ngma kpami ha a, nɛ e poo ngma a tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ma.
Lɛ hu e hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba.
Bɔfo kpa hu nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ la nɔ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ ba.
E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ e de bɔfo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba a ke, “Ngɔɔ o ha nɛ nya ba a kɛ poo wai yiblii ɔmɛ, nɛ o bua nya.
Wai yiblii ɔmɛ fu ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ bɔni ní tsumi ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ e ngma kpami ha a. E poo wai yiblii ɔ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sake ngɔ pue wai ngami nɔ́ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi.
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu maa gbla yayami peeli a tue.
A nga wai yiblii ɔ ngɛ wai ngami nɔ́ ɔ mi ngɛ ma a nya.
Nɛ muɔ je wai ngami nɔ́ ɔ mi be kaa pa; e kami maa pee si tomi lafa enyɔ, nɛ e mi kuɔmi hu maa pee nane enuɔ.
Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ nyagbe haomi ɔmɛ ɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, i na okadi kpa ngɛ hiɔwe; okadi nɛ ɔ kle nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ.
I na bɔfohi kpaago nɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a ngɔ nyagbe haomi kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ba je ɔ mi.
Haomi kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ daa si ha nyagbe tue gblami nɛ Mawu maa ngɔ kɛ ba.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na nɔ́ ko gbajaa ngɛ ye hɛ mi kaa wo; e hɛ mi tsɔ ngleinglei kaa ahuhuɛ, nɛ la ngɛ tsoe ngɛ mi.
I na ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye kunimi ɔ hulɔ; a hɛɛ kpa sakuhi nɛ Mawu ha mɛ ɔ ngɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a daa si ngɛ wo nɛ e hɛ mi tsɔ ngleinglei kaa ahuhuɛ ɔ kasa nya.
Ee, a ye lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ e we amaga a, kɛ nɔ nɛ yibɔ ko daa si ha e biɛ ɔ a nɔ kunimi.
Nɛ a ngɛ Mawu tsɔlɔ Mose la a, kɛ To bi ɔ la a lae ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope, O ní tsumi ɔmɛ kle, nɛ a ngɛ nyakpɛ!
Je ma amɛ a matsɛ, o ní peemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo da, anɔkuale sɔuu!
Nyɔmtsɛ, nihi tsuo maa wo o hɛ mi nyami!
Nihi tsuo ma de ke o kle; ejakaa mo pɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ maa ba nɛ a ma ba ja mo; ejakaa dami sane nɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ na paa!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na nɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nya bli, nɛ bo tsu klɔuklɔu ɔ maa si ngɛ mi.
Bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ haomi kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ je kpo kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ.
A wo tade nɛ a kɛ kploba ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai pee; nɛ a ngɔ kpa nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee kɛ fi a gugue.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ha bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika tsu kplu kake nɛ wai hyi lɛ tɔ.
Wai kɛ kplu nɛ ɔ daa si ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ. Mawu hɛ mi nyami, kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ha nɛ la su ku hyi sɔlemi we ɔ tɔ.
Nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e je sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ ya si haomi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ba a a se po.
Mawu mi mi fumi kplu ɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe gegeege kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ. Gbi ɔ ngɛ bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ dee ke, “Wai ɔ nɛ daa si ha Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ kplu kpaago ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya plɛ ngɔ pue zugba.” Kekleekle bɔfo ɔ ho nɛ e ya plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue zugba.
Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ we okadi ɔ ngɛ a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa amaga a tsuo hia pa yaya nɛ yee nɔ.
Bɔfo enyɔne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue wo mi.
Nyu ɔ pee kaa nɔ gbogboe muɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ gbo.
Bɔfo etɛne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ wo pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi a mi, nɛ a pee kaa muɔ.
Nɛ i nu nɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nyu nɔ ɔ ngɛ Mawu dee ke, “Mo ji Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
Mo ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa a. O ye dami sane ngɛ o kojomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi!
Ejakaa adesa pue o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ si.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o ha mɛ muɔ ke a nu.
Ee, nɔ́ pɛ nɛ sa mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope!
O yeɔ dami sane, nɛ o gblaa nɔ tue bɔ nɛ sa!” Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo eywiɛne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue pu nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ pu ɔ dɔ la wawɛɛ, nɛ e sãã nimli adesahi.
Pu la nɛ nya wa a sãã mɛ saminya, nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ.
Se a tsakee we a tsui, konɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Bɔfo enuɔne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Diblii wo ngɛ lohwe ɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ nihi a he hia mɛ, nɛ a ta a lilɛ.
A tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nae, kɛ pa nɛ a hia a he.
Se ní yayahi nɛ a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a tsakee we a tsui ngɛ he.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo ekpane ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue Yufrate pa nguaa a mi.
Nyu ɔ mii ngɛ pa a mi, nɛ e kɛ je blɔ ha matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ maa je beleku je kɛ ba a. Kɛkɛ nɛ i na mumi yayami etɛ nɛ a ngɛ kaa ovɔnɔhi.
A je sinɔ nguaa a, kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ a nya mi kɛ ma.
Abosiami mumi nɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní ji mɛ.
Mumi yayami etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ yaa je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a ngɔ, konɛ a ya bua a nya kɛ ha ta nɛ maa ba ligbi nguaa a nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ maa kojo je ɔ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Hyɛ!
I ma kaa julɔ!
Nɔ nɛ huɔɔ, nɛ e peeɔ e tade klaalo ɔ, a gbaa lɛ!
E be e he gu hɛɛe nɛ e zo ba je kpo!” Jehanɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke Harmagedon ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo kpaagone ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue kɔɔhiɔ mi.
Nɛ gbi ko pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ de ke, “A gbe nya!” Kɛkɛ nɛ oslabai gba, nɛ hiɔmi si, nɛ zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ.
Kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ adesa a, zugba mimiɛ we kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ.
Zugba nɛ mimiɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a nɛ eko hyɛ.
Ma nguaa a mi gba etɛ, nɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpata.
Mawu kai Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ e nu wai kɛ je e kplu ɔ mi.
Wai nɛ ɔ daa si ha Mawu mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a. Zugba kpɔhi tsuo nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ laa, nɛ a nɛ yokuhi hu.
Gbiɛ ngo ngu lokpolokpohi nɛ eko tsuaa eko jiimi ji kilo nyingmi enuɔ je hiɔwe ba nɔɔ nimlihi a nɔ.
Nimli adesahi tu musu bɔmi munyu kɛ si Mawu ngɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ e kɛ hao mɛ ɔ he, ejakaa nɔ́ ɔ nya wa tsɔ.
Ajuama kpanaku ɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ kplu kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ba de mi ke, “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ Mawu maa gbla ajuama kpanaku ɔ tue ha.
Jamɛ a ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ a ma ngɔ fɔ pahi babauu a tue ɔ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama; nɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ pee kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã, benɛ e kɛ mɛ fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ.” Mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ho nga nɔ ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i na yo ko nɛ hii si ngɛ lohwe awi yelɔ tsutsuu ko nɔ.
A ngma biɛhi fuu kɛ tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ lohwe ɔ he tsuo.
Lohwe ɔ ngɛ yi kpaago, kɛ koli nyɔngma.
Yo ɔ wo tade he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, nɛ tsuɔ hulɔ; nɛ a kɛ sika tsu june, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa, kɛ adiagba dla e he ha lɛ.
E hɛɛ sika tsu kplu nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ zo ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e we ajuama bɔmi níhi nɛ a hiee ɔ.
A ngma biɛ ko nɛ ji laami sane ngɛ e hɛ nya ke, “Babilon kpetekpleenyɛ, ajuamahi a nyɛ, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee tsuo a je he.” I na kaa yo ɔ tɔ dã; ee, e nu ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ Yesu he ɔ a muɔ, nɛ e pee kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã.
Benɛ i na lɛ ɔ, ye nya kpɛ ye he wawɛɛ.
Bɔfo ɔ bi mi ke “Mɛni he je nɛ o nya kpɛ o he ɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Yo ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, laami sane ɔ nɛ kɔɔ e he ɔ, ma je tsɔɔ mo.
Lohwe ɔ nɛ o na a, be ko ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ, se piɔ lɛɛ e be je mi hu.
E be kɛe nɛ e maa je muɔ voo ɔ mi kɛ ba, nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ a ngmɛ a biɛ ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi loko a bɔ je ɔ, ke a na lohwe ɔ, a nya maa kpɛ a he saminya.
E hi si be ko; amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e be je mi, se e maa kpale ba ekohu.
“Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hia juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.
Yi kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha yoku kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ yo ɔ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ.
A daa si ha matsɛmɛ kpaago hulɔ.
Ni enuɔ gbo momo; nɔ kake ngɛ tsɛ yee kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ nɔ kake na we nɛ e ba lolo.
Ke e ba a, e maa ye tsɛ be bɔɔ kɛkɛ.
Lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, nɛ piɔ lɛɛ e be je mi hu ɔ, e maa pee matsɛ kpaanyɔne; e ye tsɛ momo kaa matsɛmɛ kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
“Koli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ o na a daa si ha matsɛmɛ nyɔngma nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a yi tsɛ lolo.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ma ha mɛ blɔ nya nɛ a kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ maa ye tsɛ ngmlɛfia kake.
Mɛ tsuo a maa hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ a maa ngɔ a he wami, kɛ a blɔ nya a kɛ ha lohwe ɔ. Lohwe ɔ, kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma ya tua To bi ɔ.
Se To bi ɔ, kɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ maa ye a nɔ kunimi.
Lɛ ji nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, nɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ Mawu tsɛ, nɛ e hla mɛ ngɔ to, nɛ a yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale.” Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Nyu kpekpemi ɔ nɛ o na nɛ yo ajuama a hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ daa si ha mahi, je mahi, nimli slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi, kɛ gbi munomunohi.
Koli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ o na a, kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ maa te si ngɔ wo yo ajuama a; a maa ngɔ e níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa hɛɛ e he gu.
A maa ye e he lo ɔ, nɛ a kɛ la ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Matsɛmɛ nyɔngma amɛ nɛ a maa pee enɛ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu ha nɛ a to a yi mi kaa a pee nɔ́ nɛ e to kaa a pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ tsuo a maa kplɛɛ kaa a maa ngɔ a tsɛ yemi blɔ nya a kɛ ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ kɛ yaa si yi mi nɛ Mawu to ɔ maa ba mi.
“Yo ɔ nɛ o na a daa si ha ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ e matsɛ ɔ yeɔ ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ.”
A kpata Babilon hɛ mi Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma.
E hɛɛ blɔ nya nguaa, nɛ la nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ ha nɛ je ɔ mi tsuo tsɔ heii.
E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata!
Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛ mi kpata!
Piɔ lɛɛ e plɛ mumi yayamihi tsuo a si himi he; e plɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ lohwe awi yeli nɛ a hiee tsuo a si himi he.
Ejakaa Babilon yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo puɛ; ee, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ wai nɛ nya wa nɛ e ha mɛ nɛ a nu.
Je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ jua yeli tsuo gu e ní babauu ɔ nɔ nɛ a pee niatsɛmɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi kpa nɛ tu munyu kɛ je hiɔwe ke, “Ye ma!
Nyɛɛ je kpo ngɛ e mi oo, nyɛɛ je ma a mi!
Nyɛ ko ya piɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ pee yayami, konɛ haomi nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ, ko ba nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ!
Ejakaa a to e yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ya si hiɔwe tɔɔ.
Nɛ Mawu miɔ nɛ e maa gbla ma a tue ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Bɔ nɛ e pee mo ɔ, pee lɛ ja nɔuu ngɔ to nane mi.
Níhi nɛ e pee ɔ, pee lɛ ja totoe enyɔ ngɔ to nane mi.
Dã nɛ e futu ha mo ɔ, mo futu dã nɛ nya wa kaa ja totoe enyɔ ngɔ wo e kplu ɔ mi ha lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ e pee ní nguahi, nɛ e fiɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, pii lɛ, nɛ e ye aywilɛho ja nɔuu.
Ejakaa e pɔɔ e he demi ke, ‘Manyɛ ji mi, nɛ i hii si ngɛ ye sɛ ɔ nɔ!
Pi yalɔyo ji mi; i be aywilɛho yee gblegbleegble!’ Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, haomi nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba e nɔ ligbi kake too: gbenɔ hiɔ, aywilɛho, kɛ hwɔ.
Nɛ a kɛ la maa sã lɛ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ maa kojo lɛ ɔ, e kle.” Je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ Babilon bɔ ajuama, nɛ a fiɛ a yi nɔ ɔ, ke be nɛ a sã ma a, nɛ a na la su ku nɛ ngɛ jee ɔ, a maa wo yana, nɛ a ma nya awe ha ma a.
A maa da si ngɛ se lokoo, ejakaa a maa ye gbeye kaa a maa gbla a kɛ Babilon tsuo a tue.
A ma de ke, “Tsaoo!
Akuanyɛ!
Babilon, ma nguaa!
Ma kpetekpleenyɛ!
Ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ gbla o tue ha!” Jua yeli nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo hu maa wo yana, nɛ a ma nya awe ha lɛ, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be a guɛ ní ɔmɛ hee hu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ní nɛ ɔmɛ hee hu: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, adiagba, kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, seda, bo tsu, tso slɔɔtohi nɛ a he wa, suɔ wu níhi tsuo, tso slɔɔtohi nɛ a he jua wa saminya, akɔblee, dade, marble, sinamon, tsopa kɛ e he via, mire, mimɛ, dã, nu, mamu, ngma, na, to, okpɔngɔ, zugba lɛ, nyɔguɛ, kɛ nimli nɛ a hɛ ngɛ tete.
Jua yeli ɔmɛ ma de ke, “Ní kpakpahi nɛ e jlo mo kaa o ná a, lɛ tsuo se po; ní babauu nɛ o ná, kɛ o yi nɔ nɛ o fiɛ saminya a, lɛ tsuo bɔ mo, nɛ o be nae hu gblegbleegble.” Jua yeli nɛ ye jua ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi, nɛ ba pee niatsɛmɛ ɔ, a maa da se lokoo, ejakaa a maa ye gbeye kaa a maa gbla a kɛ Babilon tsuo a tue.
A maa wo yana, nɛ a ma nya awe boboobo; nɛ a ma de ke, “Tsaoo!
Akuanyɛ!
Babilon, ma nguaa!
Ma kpetekpleenyɛ!
Sa a, kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ bo tsu lɛ e buɔ, nɛ sika tsu, june, kɛ adiagba e kɛ dlaa e he!
Nɛ ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, ní babauu nɛ e na a tsuo bɔ lɛ!” Lɛ kudɔɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ sɛ lɛ kɛ yaa he, lɛ mi bi, kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ jua ngɛ wo nɔ tsuo ya da se lokoo.
Nɛ benɛ a sã ma a, nɛ a na la su ku nɛ je ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa, nɛ a de ke, “Ma ko ma ko be nɛ kle kaa ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ!” A kɛ zu wo a yi mi, nɛ a wo yana, nɛ a nya awe.
A kpa ngmlaa, nɛ a de ke, “Tsaoo!
Akuanyɛ ha ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ!
Lɛtsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ yeɔ jua ngɛ wo hɛ mi ɔ gu ní babauu nɛ e na a nɔ ba plɛ niatsɛmɛ.
Nɛ ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, ní babauu nɛ e na a tsuo bɔ lɛ!” Hiɔwe!
Mo nya kaa a kpata Babilon hɛ mi!
Nyɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi, bɔfohi, kɛ gbali, nyɛ nya!
Ejakaa Mawu bu lɛ fɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee nyɛ ɔ he!
Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ ko wo tɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa wɛ nguaa ko, nɛ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ wo mi, nɛ e de ke, “Kikɛ nɛ ɔ a maa hɛ Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ he, nɛ a be lɛ nae hu gblegbleegble.
Babilon, la be pɛe gblegbleegble ngɛ ma a mi hu!
A be kpa saku, loo adesa gbi, loo bɛ, loo titimati he nue hu gblegbleegble ngɛ ma a mi!
A be ga ní tsulɔ ko ga ní tsulɔ ko kulaa nae ngɛ ma a mi hu; wɛ tɛ hu a be e nya nue hu!
Kane be tsoe ngɛ ma a mi hu; nɛ a be ayɛflo huno, kɛ ayɛflo nya nue hu.
O jua yeli ɔmɛ ji nimli nguahi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ o ngɔ kunya yemi kɛ sisi nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi!” Babilon yeɔ fɔ kaa e gbe gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ.
Ee, Babilon pue ni kpahi babauu hu a muɔ si ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i nu nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe boboobo kaa nihi babauu a gbi ke, “A je Mawu yi!
Mawu ji wa yi wami helɔ!
E je agbo, nɛ e ngɛ he wami!
E yeɔ dami sane; e gblaa nɔ tue bɔ nɛ sa!
Yo ajuama kpanaku ɔ nɛ ngɔ yahomi kɛ ngɛ je ɔ puɛe ɔ, e bu lɛ fɔ.
Mawu gbla e tue, ejakaa e gbe lɛ Mawu ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ.” Nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ekohu nɛ a de ke, “A je Mawu yi!
La nɛ maa sã ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble!” Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si nɛ a ja Mawu nɛ hii si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Amen!
A je Mawu yi!” To bi ɔ yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, gbi ko pɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi, nyɛ e tsɔli tsuo!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye, nimli wawi, kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!” Jehanɛ ɔ, i nu nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe kaa nihi babauu a gbi, loo pa nɛ hia kɛ bee, loo hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ sie wawɛɛ.
I nu nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “A je Mawu yi!
Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu Ope ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee!
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ wa nya!
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa je e yi, ejakaa e kle!
Ejakaa be ɔ su nɛ To bi ɔ maa kpee yo, nɛ ayɛflo ɔ dla e he ngɔ to.
Mawu ha lɛ tade nɛ a kɛ kploba ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai pee.” Ní kpakpahi nɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji kploba a nɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ a kpee mɛ kɛ ba To bi ɔ yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbaa mɛ!” Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Anɔkuale munyu nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ i bu si ngɛ e nane nya konɛ ma ja lɛ.
Nɛ e de mi ke, “Ko ja mi!
Imi hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ ji mi kaa mo, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Odase ɔ nɛ Yesu ye ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ tsuo lɛ wa he ye.
Já Mawu mohu!” Ejakaa odase ɔ nɛ Yesu ye ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ woɔ gbali ɔmɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ gbaa.
Okpɔngɔ hiɔ nɔ hilɔ ɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, i na nɛ a bli hiɔwe nya, kɛkɛ nɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, okpɔngɔ hiɔ ko ji nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ biɛ ji Anɔkualetsɛ kɛ Dalɔ; dami nya e kojoɔ, nɛ e hwuɔ ta.
E hɛngmɛ ngɛ kaa la lilɛ, nɛ jlasi babauu fi e yi.
A ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ko; se nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ ji, ja lɛ pɛ.
E wo tade klɔii ko nɛ a kɛ tsɔ muɔ mi.
Nɛ biɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ji “Mawu munyu.” Hiɔwe ta buli ɔmɛ wo tade nɛ a kɛ kploba hiɔ ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai kpɛ, nɛ a hi okpɔngɔ hiɔhi a nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ e se.
Klaate nɛ nya ba je e nya mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ e kɛ maa fia je ma amɛ ní, nɛ e maa ye a nɔ kunimi.
E maa ye tsɛ ngɛ a nɔ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ.
E kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we abofu, kɛ mi mi la ma kple a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngaa wai mi ngɛ wai ngami nɔ́ mi ɔ. Nɛ a ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e tade klɔii ɔ, kɛ e fiɔ he ke, “Matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ.” Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo ko nɛ daa si ngɛ pu ɔ nɔ.
E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ e tsɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ teɔ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bua ngɛ Mawu we okplɔɔ nguaa a he!
Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ye matsɛmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ, ta buli, kɛ okpɔngɔhi kɛ a nɔ hili a lo.
Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ye nimli tsuo a lo, nyɔguɛ, kɛ odehe, nimli wawi, kɛ nimli nguahi!” Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a tabo ɔmɛ nɛ a bua a he nya, konɛ a gba ta ngɔ wo nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛ hu e tabo ɔ.
A nu lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ nɛ pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ tsuo.
E pee nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ kɛ sisi nihi nɛ a kɛ lohwe ɔ kadi mɛ ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa lohwe ɔ we amaga a.
A hɛ lohwe ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ tsuo ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi hɛ ngmengmle.
A kɛ klaate nɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ nya mi ɔ gbe a ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ye a lo ɔ bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ.
Jeha akpe ɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo ko nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma; e hɛɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya safe, kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ jiɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
E nu sinɔ nguaa a, jamɛ a blema sinɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ Abosiami, loo Satan ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔ fi lɛ, konɛ e hi si jeha akpe.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ muɔ voo ɔ mi, nɛ e nga sinya ngɔ wo e yi, nɛ e sɔu muɔ ɔ nya, konɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ jeha akpe.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, e be nyɛe maa sisi je ma amɛ hu.
Jeha akpe ɔ se ɔ, a maa pɛne lɛ be bɔɔ ko.
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na matsɛ sɛ komɛ nɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, a ha mɛ he blɔ kaa a kojo.
Jehanɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ye Yesu he odase, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a he nɛ a gbe mɛ ɔ, i na mɛ hu a klaahi.
Mɛɛ a ja we lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, loo e we amaga a; a kɛ lohwe ɔ kadi we a hɛ nya, loo a nine he.
A kpale ba wami mi ekohu, nɛ a kɛ Yesu ye matsɛ jeha akpe.
Ni gbogboehi nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a bɛ wami mi ekohu kɛ ya si jeha akpe ɔ su.
Enɛ ɔ ji ni gbogboehi a si tlemi kekleekle nɔ́.
Nihi nɛ a bu mɛ ngɔ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ma tle mɛ si be nɛ ɔ mi a he ɔ, Mawu gbaa mɛ, nɛ e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu.
Gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ be he wami ngɛ a nɔ, se mohu a maa ye osɔfo, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ Kristo; nɛ a kɛ Kristo maa ye matsɛ jeha akpe.
A ye Satan nɔ Jeha akpe ɔ se ɔ, a ma je Satan ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ma ya sisi je ma amɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ.
A tsɛɛ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ ke Gog, kɛ Magog.
Satan ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya kɛ ba nɛ a ba hwu ta.
A hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia.
A gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
Nɛ ma nɛ Mawu suɔ, nɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ pueɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ya sa e yi.
Se la je hiɔwe ba kpata a hɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ nɛ a hɛ Abosiami ɔ nɛ sisi mɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi he nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ a ma pii mɛ nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ ya neneene.
Nyagbe kojomi ɔ Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na Mawu nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ hiɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɔ.
Tlukaa a, hiɔwe kɛ zugba laa, nɛ a nɛ mɛ hu.
Jehanɛ ɔ, i na nihi nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo nɛ daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, ni nguahi, kɛ ni wawihi.
A bli womihi a nya; womi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ nimlihi tsuo pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a ngma kɛ wo mi.
A bli womi kpa hu nya; nɛ enɛ ɔ lɛɛ nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ a biɛ nɛ a ngma kɛ wo mi.
A kojo ni gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ wo jé ni gbogboehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ ngɔ ha.
Gbenɔ, kɛ gbeje hu jé ni gbogboehi tsuo nɛ a kɛ to ɔ ngɔ ha.
Nɛ a kojo mɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ pee ɔ he.
A hɛ gbenɔ, kɛ gbeje ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ ji gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a nɛ kaa a ngma e biɛ ngɛ hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi ɔ, kɛkɛ a hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi.
Hiɔwe he kɛ zugba he Jehanɛ ɔ, i na hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he, ejakaa kekleekle hiɔwe, kɛ kekleekle zugba a be kɛ ho.
Nɛ wo be hu.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i na ma klɔuklɔu ɔ, Yerusalem ma he ɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ma zugba.
A dla e he ha lɛ kaa ayɛflo nɛ a wo lɛ ní ta nɛ a kɛ lɛ yaa ha e huno.
I nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he kɛ de ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu hi he ji nimli a kpɛti!
E kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ a maa pee e ma.
Mawu nitsɛ kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ e maa pee a Mawu.
Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu tsuo.
Nɔ ko be gboe hu; nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee hu; nɔ ko be ya foe hu, nɛ nɔ ko be nɔ́ nae hu.
Ejakaa ní momo ɔmɛ a se po.” Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ de ke, “Hyɛ, i ngɛ níhi tsuo pee ehe!” E de imi hulɔ ke, “Ngmaa enɛ ɔ, ejakaa anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “A gbe nya!
Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no, sisije kɛ nyagbe!
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, ma ha lɛ nyu nɛ je vu nɛ baa nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ mi nɛ e nu nɛ e be he hiɔ woe.
Nihi tsuo nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ ma na nike ní nɛ ɔ kɛ maa je ye dɛ mi; ma pee a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.
Se fɔ̃li, nihi nɛ he we yi, nihi nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ a hiee, nɔmlɔ gbeli, yaholi, nyuali, wɔ jali, kɛ lakpatsɛmɛ tsuo lɛɛ he nɛ fɔɔ si ha mɛ ji taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ. Lɔ ɔ ji gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ.” Yerusalem ma he ɔ Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ kplu kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ nyagbe haomi kpaago ɔmɛ hyi mɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, a ti nɔ kake ba ye ngɔ, nɛ e ba de mi ke, “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ayɛflo ɔ nɛ ji To bi ɔ yo ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ho yo gagaa ko yi mi ya.
E tsɔɔ mi Yerusalem, ma klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ ma zugba a; nɛ e hɛɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe.
Ma a ngɛ kpɛe kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa nitsɛnitsɛ, aloo yaspi tɛ; e mi hu tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ.
Gbogbo nɛ ti, nɛ ya hiɔwe saminya bɔle ma a kɛ kpe.
Agbo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ he, nɛ bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ daa si ngɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya.
A ngma Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a biɛ ngɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya.
Agbo etɛ ngɛ beleku je, etɛ ngɛ omleyi je, etɛ ngɛ leneyi je, nɛ etɛ hu ngɛ bonyoku je.
Gbogbo nɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe ɔ, a fia ngɔ fɔ sisi tomi tɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngma To bi ɔ bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a biɛ ngɛ a nɔ.
Bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ hɛɛ sika tsu tso nɛ a kɛ susuɔ nɔ́ ngɛ e dɛ mi nɛ e kɛ ma susu ma a, kɛ agbo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbogbo ɔ. Ma a fɔɔ si kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami kɛ e blimi sɔ.
Bɔfo ɔ kɛ nɔ́ susumi tso ɔ susu ma a, nɛ e pee kilomita akpe enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ; e kami, e blimi, kɛ e hiɔwe yami tsuo sɔ.
Bɔfo ɔ susu gbogbo ɔ hulɔ, nɛ e hiɔwe yami pee gugue nyingmi etɛ kɛ ekpa.
Nɔ́ nɛ bɔfo ɔ kɛ susu gbogbo ɔ, lɔ ɔ a kɛ susuɔ nɔ́ daa.
A kɛ yaspi tɛ fia gbogbo ɔ, nɛ ma a nitsɛ lɛɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ a kɛ fia.
Sisi tomi nɛ a fia ma a gbogbo ɔ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, a kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa slɔɔtohi hɔɔ mi.
Kekleekle tɛ nɛ he jua wa a ji yaspi; enyɔne ɔ, safiro; etɛne ɔ, agate; eywiɛne ɔ, emerald; enuɔne ɔ, sardoniki; ekpane ɔ, sadio; kpaagone ɔ, krisolito; kpaanyɔne ɔ, berilo; nɛɛne ɔ, topasi; nyɔngmane ɔ, krisopraso; nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ, hiakinto, nɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji ametisto.
Agbo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, adiagba nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ sɔuu, agbo tsuaa agbo ɔ, adiagba kake a kɛ pee.
Gbɛjegbɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, sika tsu ngmingmiingmi a kɛ pee; e mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ.
I nɛ sɔlemi we ko ngɛ ma a mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ ji e sɔlemi we.
Pu, loo nyɔhiɔ nɛ ma kpɛ he hia we ngɛ ma a mi; ejakaa Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ji la nɛ kpɛɔ ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ To bi ɔ ji e kane.
Nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ maa nyɛɛ ngɛ la a mi, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ mi nyami babauu ɔ kɛ ba ma a mi.
Agbohi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a be ngae ligbi ko ligbi ko, ejakaa diblii be woe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ je ma amɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ mi nyami, kɛ agboje kɛ ba ma a mi.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we be ma a mi bae.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ a hiee, loo e yeɔ lakpa hu be mi bae.
Nihi nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ To bi ɔ hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi ɔ, mɛ pɛ lɛ a maa ba ma a mi.
Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ɔ tsɔɔ mi pa kɛ e mi nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ; e mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ.
Pa a hia kɛ je Mawu, kɛ To bi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ he kɛ ba be ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kpɛti.
Tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ ngɛ pa a tue hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
E woɔ yiblii si nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ jeha mi; nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ ɔ, e woɔ si kake, nɛ a kɛ e ba a tsaa nihi ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu gbiɛ be ma a mi hie hu.
Mawu, kɛ To bi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa hi ma a mi, nɛ Mawu tsɔli ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ lɛ.
A maa na e hɛ mi, nɛ a maa ngma e biɛ ngɛ a hɛ nya.
Diblii be si hie hu, nɛ kane, loo pu la he be mɛ hiae, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ma ha mɛ la, nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yesu bami Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa e mumi ɔ baa gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔmɛ, konɛ a ba tsɔɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ be kpiti mi.” Yesu ke, “Hyɛ!
I ma nɔuu!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ pɛtɛɔ munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he!” Imi Yohane lɛ i nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ i na hulɔ.
Benɛ i nu, nɛ i na a, i bu si ngɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mi ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nane nya, konɛ ma ja lɛ.
Se e de mi ke, “Ko ja mi!
Imi hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ ji mi kaa mo, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ pɛtɛɔ munyuhi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he ɔ. Já Mawu mohu!” Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Koo sɔu munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to, nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ nya, ejakaa be ɔ su.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami peelɔ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee yayami; mutsɛ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e wo e he mu; nɔmlɔ kpakpa a, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee kpakpa, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu.” Yesu ke, “Bu tue!
I ma nɔuu!
I hɛɛ ye hiɔwo ɔ kɛ ma, nɛ ma wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ ní nɛ e tsu ɔ nya.
Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no, sisije kɛ nyagbe!” A gbaa nihi nɛ fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he ɔ. Ee, a maa ye tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ yiblii ɔ eko, nɛ a maa gu agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya ma a mi.
Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be mɛ blɔ hae nɛ a sɛ ma a mi: gbe ɔmɛ, nyuali ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbeli ɔmɛ, amaga jali ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ suɔ lakpa yemi ɔ.
“Imi Yesu lɛ i tsɔ ye bɔfo ɔ, konɛ e ba fiɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi.
Imi ji David nina a nɛ.
Imi ji nɔkɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ nɛ.” Mumi ɔ, kɛ ayɛflo ɔ ke, “Ba!” Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu enɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e de ke, “Ba!” Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ba; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ ɔ, e ba ngɔ nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ kaa nike ní.
Nyagbe Imi Yohane, i ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to, nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ kɔkɔ bɔe.
Mo nɔ nɛ o kɛ nɔ́ ko maa piɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, haomi kpaago nɛ a wo ta ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu maa ngɔ eko kɛ piɛ he kɛ gbla o tue.
Mo nɔ nɛ o ma je munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to, nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ eko kɛ je mi ɔ, ní kpakpahi nɛ a wo si ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu ma je o blɔ fa mi nɔ́ kɛ je mi.
O blɔ nya kaa o maa ye tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ yiblii ɔ eko, nɛ o maa hi ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu ma kpɔ ngɛ o dɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he odase yee ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Ee, i ma nɔuu!” Amen.
Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu, ba!
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu dloomi ɔ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
Amen.
